title: Takoradi Nsaano Nnwuma Suapɔn.
text:
Takoradi nsaano dwuma suapɔn yɛ sukuu a mmaa ne mmarima adi afra a ɛwɔ takoradi. Wɔsii sukuu no wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe mmienu a Ghana a aban ne German aban  a wɔde wɔn nsa hyɛɛ aseɛ a wɔboa sane tae akyi na wɔpagyaa suapɔn no. sukuu no agye din ɛnam nsaano nnwuma mfidie a ɛwɔ hɔ a wɔde kyerɛkyerɛ asuafoɔ no adeɛ sane boa wɔn na wɔnya nimdeɛ firi adeɛ a wɔrekyerɛ wɔn no ho.

Abakɔsɛm. 
Takoradi nsaano nnwuma suapɔn no wɔdaa no adi wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe mmienu mu ɛna wɔde asuafoɔ aduasa mmienu hyɛɛ aseɛ. Na saa asuafoɔ yi hyɛ atadeɛ a soro no ahosuo yɛ wiemhyɛn ne trɔsa.

title: Obomeng
text: Obomeng yɛ kuro ketewa bi a ɛwɔ kwahu bepɔso a ɛwɔ apuiɛ mantam (Ghana) wɔ abibirem atɔeɛ. Ɛwɔ kwahu anaafoɔ mansini abatoɔ nan ase. Ɛnkane no na Obomeng na ɛyɛ kuro a ɛdikan a sɛ woforo kwahu bepɔ no a wohunu ansa na wɔresi Atibie kwan no.

title: Volta kɔkɔɔ
text:
Volta kɔkɔɔ  yɛ nsutene a ɛwɔ abibirem atɔeɛ (West Africa).  Ɛtene fa  Ouagadougou a ɛwɔ  Burkina Faso  (a nkane no na wɔfrɛ no Upper Volta) ɛna ne tenten bɛyɛ sɛ brɔfo kwansin ahaasa ne aduasa mmienu a ɛbɔ White Volta mu wɔ Ghana. wɔ French  kasa mu no wɔfrɛ no Volta Rouge, ɛtene bɛyɛ 200 mi (320 km) south-southeast ansa na ɛne White Volta (a wɔ French  kasa mu no wɔfrɛ no Volta Blanche no) abɛdi afra wɔ beaeɛ a ɛbɛn Gambaga scarp a ɛwɔ  Atifi mantan ahodoɔ no mu wɔ ɔman Ghana mu.
  

Nsuo no ahyeaseɛ firi Burkina Faso ne Ghana ntam . Ɛtene fa Ghana atifido apuiɛ mantam (Upper East region) na atene akɔgu volta fitaa mu (White Volta).

Red Volta River, river in West Africa, rising in Burkina Faso northwest of Ouagadougou.

title: Ohum Afahyɛ
text:
Ohum afahyɛ yɛ tete afahyɛ a Akuapemfoɔ ne Akyemfoɔ  a wɔwɔ apuiɛ mantam wɔ Ghana na ɛdi. Ɔdi saa afahyɛ no benada anaa wukuada wɔ ɛbɔ anaa ahinime bosome mu a ɛgyina bosome korɔ a wɔdii Ohunkan afahyɛ. Sɛ wɔrebɛdi afahyɛ no a wɔbra obiara wɔ dede yɛ ho kɔpem nawɔtwe mmienu. Akyemfoɔ no da wɔn Ɔboadeɛ ase sɛ wɔde nsuo Birim ahyira wɔn nsaase. Wɔde nnɔbaeɛ a wɔnya firii wɔn nsaase so ne nsuom yɛ ahyɛnsodeɛ ne nkaedum ma wɔn nananom a wɔde nsi ne anem pere bɔɔ wɔn kuro no ho ban. Amanfoɔ no hyɛɛ bɔ sɛ wɔbɛkɔ so adi amanneɛ no so asane ahwɛ wɔn ahennie no so yie ama no adi mu ama asomdwoe aba afahyɛ no  mu. Wɔhyɛɛ wɔn hene no bɔ sɛ wɔbɛkɔ adi nokware ama no ne n'ahemfo ne ne mpanimfoɔ no nyinaa wɔ wɔn mpaninnie ne bambɔ a wɔde bɔɔ wɔn. Wɔdi Ohumkyire de da tweaduampɔn ase wɔ bayerɛ foforɔ a wanya na wɔsane serɛ no sɛ ɔnkɔ so ara nyɛ saa wɔ afe a ɛdi wɔn anim no..wɔ  siesie krom  praprah efie  ne mbonten so  biara  ansa na wɔndi afahyɛ

title: Roselyn Ngissah
text:
Roselyn Ngissah yɛ Ghana sinitwafoɔ a w'agye din paa. Sini ahorow a watwa no bi ne Adams Apple, Away Bus ne princess Tyra.Ɔyɛ obi a w'aben wɔ sinitwa mu paa na otumi di sɛ polisini,ɔyere ne abofra.

Mprɛmprɛn yi de bɛsi afe mpem mmienu ne aduonu baako (2021) mu no deɛ na ɔnwaree. Na mmom ayɛ atesɛm sɛ ɔne owura bi a yɛfrɛ no Kojo Ranna retwe mpena a ɛmu yɛ den a aka sɛ wɔbɛware. Berɛ a ɔne nsɛmtwerɛfoɔ retwetwe nkɔma no, Roselyn de too dwa sɛ, “Aane meretwɛn no sɛ ɔno ankasa bɛpae mu aka akyerɛ me ne dɔ, na nka menwene ho mpo na m'apene so ama no. Efiri sɛ ɔyɛ nipa papa, ɔyɛ obi a mɛpɛ sɛ me ne no bɛtena me nkwa nna nyinaa.”

N'awoda Ne Ne Mfeɛ
Wɔwoo Roselyn wɔ Ɔgyefoɔ da a ɛtɔ so nnwɔtwe wɔ  Ghana nanso wɔtetee no wɔ Lagos,Nigeria. Wei nti ɔne ne nnamfo ne n'ebusuafoɔ bom di n'awoda wɔ Ɔgyefoɔ da a ɛtɔ so nnwɔtwe afe biara.

Nhomasua
Roselyn nyaa nhomasua mfiyiaseɛ wɔ Lagos, Nigeria.Ɔkɔɔ ntoasoɔ skuul wɔ Tema Secondary School na ɔtoaa so wɔ 'University of Ghana,Legon'.Osuaa 'Theatre Arts' wɔ suapɔn no mu.

Adwuma 
Roselyn firii sinitwa ase wɔ Ghana,wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nan (2004) mu. Sini a odii kan twaae ne 'Sicily'. Sinitwa adwumakuo a wɔfrɛ no 'Correale Pictures' na etwaa saa sini yi wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nan (2004) mu.Firi saa berɛ no, w'ayɛ sini ahorow pii a emu nea ɛgyee din paa no mu bi ne 'Princess Tyra','Power of the gods' ne 'Somewhere in Africa'. Esiane n'edwumaden ne mmɔden a ɔbɔ wɔ sinitwa mu no nti, otumi di dwuma biara a wɔde bɛma no wɔ sini mu. W'agye abasobɔdiɛ ahorow pii wɔ sinitwa mu na emu baako ne abasobɔdiɛ a ɔgyee wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du (2010) mu sɛ  'Sinitwani a ɔbɔ ne ho mmɔden paa' wɔ Ghana Sinitwafoɔ Abasobɔ ase.

wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nwɔtwe (2008)mu no, ɔnyaa akwanya sɛ nka ɔbɛyɛ adwuma wɔ sikakorabea bi a saa berɛ no na yɛfrɛ no sɛ Merchant Bank, berɛ a na wabɔ ne ho mmɔden yie wɔ mmerɛ a na ɔresum aban afe baako no, n'adwumam panin hunuu ne mmɔdenmɔ nti ɔpɛɛ sɛ nka ɔtoa so yɛ adwuma wɔ sikakorabea hɔ.

Na mmom esiane Roselyn Ngissah dɔ a ɔwɔ de ma sinitwa adwuma no nti, ɛmaa no yii sinitwa adwuma no gyaa sikakorabea adwuma no. Na mfie bebree akyi no a nsɛmtwerɛfoɔ bisaa no saa agyinasie no ho asɛm no, ɔkyerɛɛ mu sɛ ɔnnuu ne ho da sɛ ɔkɔwuraa sinitwa adwuma no mu.

title: Samuel Takyi
text:
Samuel Takyi ( wɔwoo no Ɔpɛnimaa bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduonu mmiɛnsa wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu mu) yɛ Ghana ntɔkwakonii. Ɔwiee sukuu wɔ "Men's featherweight" nkyekyɛmu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu "summer Olympics", ɔboroo Jean Caicedo of Ecuador wɔ ɔfa a ɛdikan no mu. Ɔsane toa so dii nkunim wɔ David Avila Ceiber a ɔwɔ Colombia so wɔ "quarter final". Duke Ragan a ɔwɔ USA dii ne so nkunim wɔ"semi final bout" na ɔfaa nkunim akyɛdeɛ a ɛyɛ"bronze medal".

Abrabɔ Ahyɛaseɛ ne nnwomasua. 
Ɔyɛ Eunice Smith a ɔtɔn nsuomunam wɔ makola dwam ne Godfred Takyi a ɔtɔn ntadeɛ ba barima. Ɔhyɛɛ ne nnwomasua ase wɔ "St Mary's Nursery and preparatory School" ɛna ɔsane kɔ ntoasoɔ sukuu a mmaa ne mmarima adi afra wɔ"Bishop mixed Junior High School". Ɛno akyire no ɔde ne ho kɔbɔɔ apomuden kuo bi ɛna ɔfirii hɔ kɔɔ" the black bombers team" a ɛyɛ "boxing squad of Ghana". Samuel hyɛɛ nkɔkwa koo yi ase wɔ berɛ a na wadi mfeɛ nnwɔtwe na ɔsane nim bɔɔlo bɔ yie paa ara nanso ɛnam din gyeɛ nti ɔno na na ɔda adaka no ano sɛ wɔrebɔ bɔɔlo  wɔ Ussher ne Jamestown baabi a na ɔte.

title: Nasa, Ghana
text:
Nasa yɛ akurase bi a ɛwɔ Ghana wɔ abakɔsɛm ahennie wɔ Wala a ɛwɔ mprenpren atifido atɔeɛ mantam wɔ Ghana.Ɛyɛ brɔfo kwansin dunan wɔ atifi atɔeɛ wɔ Wa, Ghana. Wɔ afe apem ahannwɔtwe ne aduowɔtwe nson de kɔpem afe apem ahannwɔtwe ne aduowɔtwe nnwɔtwe ɔpɛ berɛ mu no, na Nasa yɛ kuro a ɛdi mu pa ara. Ɔpɛ berɛ no mu no Zabarima a ɛhyɛ Babatu ase ahokwka ne asoɔkyee no nti  ɛseɛ kuro no. Saa atoyerɛnkyɛm yi maa wɔhweree nnipa bebree ɛna ɛgyaa ɛfii ne prɔka wɔ kuro no agya. Adan ahodoɔ a Babatu asoɔkyee seɛ no bi ne Nkramofo asɔredan a ɛwɔ kurom hɔ. Na nnipa dodoɔ a ɛwɔ Nasa wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduasa baako yɛ ɔha ne aduanan nkron. Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduanan nwɔtwe mu no nnipa dodoɔ a na ɛwɔ hɔ yɛ ahanu ne aduonwɔtwe nkron. Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduosia nnipa akenkan mu no ɔnyaa nnipa ɔha ne

aduasa nsi wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduoson mu no na nnipa a wɔte kurom hɔ no dodoɔ yɛ ahanu ne du nsia.a.

title: Ruth Ama Gyan-Darkwa
text:
Ruth Ama Gyan-Darkwa(wɔwoo no kotonimaa bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduonu mmiɛnsa (23) wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan (2004)  mu) yɛ Ghana nimdefoɔ a ɔwɔ adom akyɛdeɛ. Ɔyɛ ɔsuanii a ɔsua koraa wɔgyee no wɔ Kwame Nkrumah suapɔn mu wɔ Kumasi.

Ne mfeɛ a ɛdikan ne nnwomasua 
Wɔwoo Gyan-Darkwa kɔtɔnimaa bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduonu mmiɛnsa wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan mu wɔ Kumase a  Kwadwo Gyan-Darkwa ne ne yere na ɛwoo no. Ɔkɔɔ ne mfiteaseɛ ne ne ntoasoɔ sukuu wɔ" Christ our Hope International" wɔ Kumase ne "The Abraham Lincoln " wɔ ne nnidisoɔ so. Ɛno akyire no ɔsane kɔɔ "Justice International School" wɔ Kumase. Ɛnam ne nimdeɛ a na ɛwɔ anim nti ɔtwaa mperɛ mmienu ama baako wɔ suadan biara a ɔbɛkɔ mu na yahuri no atera so kɔ suadan foforɔ mu. Ɔdii mfeɛ nkron a na watwa mperɛ baako wɔ "Justice International School" wɔ Kumasi no, ɔkɔ twerɛ ntoasoɔ sukuu nsɔhwɛ( B.E.C.E) na ɔtwaeɛ. Ɛbaa na saa no wɔgyee no wɔ "St. Louis Senior High School' a ɛwɔ Kumasi a ɔsua abɔdeɛ mu nyansapɛ wɔ berɛ a wadi mfeɛ du. 

Ɔwiee ntoasoɔ sukuu a ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne dunson wɔ berɛ wadi mfeɛ du mmienu. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne dunson mu no, wɔgyee no wɔ Kwame Nkrumah suapɔn mu sɛ ɔmmɛ sua nkontaabuo, sane nso yɛɛ osuani a ɔsua a wagye no suapɔn no mu. Ɛnam ne nimdeɛ nti Ghanafoɔ pii no ara bɛyɛɛ ɔno ne n'abusuafoɔ mmoa wɔ sika fam. Ɔmanpanin abɛdiakyire yere Samira Bawumia hyɛɛ ne bɔ sɛ ɔbɛhwɛ no wɔ ne suapɔn sukuu a ɔrekɔ no mu na wasane ahwɛ n'awofoɔ apomuden atua ka biara. Ne nuabaa, Josephine Gyan-Darkwa, a ɔno nso twaa ne nsɔhwɛ a n'anisoadehunu ne sɛ ɔbɛkɔ Germany akɔsua "medicine" nso nyaa nnwomasua boafoɔ nkrataa firii "Benard Antwi Boasiako" sɛ ɔkɔtoa n'adesua so wɔ Germany.

Anikasɛm bi a ɛfa Ruth ho 
Awuraa Ruth Ama Gyan-Darkwa awie Kwame Nkruma suapɔn sɛ adesuafoɔ a ɔsua yie pa ara a wawie Kwame Nkrumah suapɔn a ɛwɔ Kumasi no. Ɔnyaa akwanya kɔɔ suapɔn no mu berɛ  a na wadi mfie du-mmiensa wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du-nson mu sɛ ɔnkɔ sua nkontabuo a yɛka no borɔfo kasa mu sɛ BSc Mathematics berɛ a na wabɔ ne ho mmɔden yie pa ara wɔ ne ntoasoɔ sukuu sɔhwɛ a yɛfrɛ no sɛ WASSCE no. ɔwie suapɔn no, abɔdin krataa a ɔdekɔɔ fie ne Second Class Upper wɔ nkontabuo mu.

Awuraa Ruth Ama Gyan-Darkwa yɛ owura ne owura yere Kwadwo Gyan-Darkwa a ɔyɛ adwuma wɔ space college no ba baa. Ruth firi kuro a yɛfrɛ no sɛ Anyimon a ɛwɔ Berekum mpɔtam hɔ a ɛwɔ Bono ne Ahafo mantam no mu wɔ ɔman Ghana mu, nanso ɔne ne papa a ɔkyerɛ adeɛ wɔ Prempah Kɔlɛgyi no na ateɛ wɔ Prɛmpɛ Kɔlɛgyi sukuu mu hɔ ɛsiane sɛ ne papa yɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ panin wɔ Kɔlɛgyi no mu.   

Ruth Ama Gyan-Darkwa ne Ghana abatoɔ kɔmisa dadaa a yɛfrɛ no sɛ Afari Gyan bɔ abusua korɔ. Ama Ruth hyɛɛ ne sukuu ase wɔ berɛ a wadi afe ne abosome nson wɔ sukuu a yɛfrɛ no sɛ Christ Our Hope International school a ɛwɔ Kumasi ansa na akyire yi no ɔrekɔtoa so wɔ Abraham Lincoln J.H.S a ɛyɛ adantamo sukuu. ɔtwerɛɛ ne suhwɛ a ɛdi kan a yɛfrɛ no sɛ BECE no wɔ berɛ a na ɔwɔ JHS 1 wɔ sukuu a yɛfrɛ no sɛ Justice international sukuu a ɛwɔ Asuofua wɔ Asante mantam no mu, ɔbɔɔ ne ho mmɔden yie pa ara wɔ sɔhwɛ no mu maa ɔnyaa akwanya kɔɔ ST. Louis SHS berɛ a na wadi mfie du, na berɛ a na ɔrewie ST Louis ntoasoɔ sukuu no na wadi mfie du-mmienu.

title: Hɔmɔwɔ
text:
Hɔmɔwɔ yɛ ɔtwa berɛ afahyɛ a Gafoɔ a ɛwɔ Ghana na ɛdi. Afahyɛ no hyɛ aseɛ ɔsanaa bosome no mu na wahyɛ aseɛ adua nnɔbaeɛ bi te sɛ aburo ne bayerɛ ansa na nsutɔ berɛ aduru. Wɔredi saa afahyɛ no a, Wɔsa asa bi a yɛfrɛ no kpanlogo. Gafoɔ di Hɔmɔwɔ de yɛ nkaedum wɔ ɛkɔm a ɛte sii wɔnso wɔ wɔn abakɔsɛm bi mu berɛ a aborɔfo no sane dii Ghana so no.

Baabi a yɛnyaa   edin no firiiɛ. 
Edin Hɔmɔwɔ (Hɔmɔ- ɛkɔm, wɔ-dede) ɛbɛtumi akysɛ "woreyɛ dede (anaa woretweetwee) ɛkɔm wɔ Ga kasa mu. Hɔmɔwɔ amanneɛ hyɛɛ aseɛ wɔ berɛ a ɛkɔm baeɛ  a ɛmaa nnuane saeɛ ɛnam nsuo a na ɛbɛma mfudeɛ anyini ntɔ wɔ Nkran punpuni mantam, beaɛ a Gafoɔ te. Sɛ nsuo no sane ba ne dada mu a, Gafoɔ hyɛ saa da no de di Hɔmɔwɔ afahyɛ, ɛno nti na yɛnyaa saa din no ne ne nkyerɛaseɛ no.Wɔdi Hɔmɔwɔ afahyɛ no gidigidi wɔ Ga nkuro nyinaa a baabi a ɛhɔ yɛ dɛ paa ara ne Ga-Mashie. Wɔdua aburo a wɔde bɛyɛ aduane a yɛfrɛ no kpokpoi anaa kpekple a wɔde bɛdi afahyɛ no. Saa da no duru a, yɛbra obiara wɔ dede yɛ ho, sɛdeɛ wɔn gyedie kyerɛ wɔn sɛ dede no bɛtumi ama aburo no nnyini. Wɔde aduane no di abɛnkwan ɛna wɔsane de bi petepete kurom hɔ. Mpɛmpii no nananom mpaninfoɔ ne mmusuapanin na ɛyɛ saa. Abusuapanin biara de "kpokpoi no pete n'abusua fie. Sɛ wɔrehyɛ fa no a, wɔnante kɔ kwan ho ne kurotia na wɔrebɔ dondo mu, kankye, ɛregye wɔani, keka wɔn anim, to dwom sane sa tete asa. Saa da no kwan so yɛ butubutu nti wɔsi akwan bebree sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛtumi adi afahyɛ no. Ɛwom sɛ ɛyɛ Ga tete amanneɛ deɛ, nanso wɔto nsa frɛ mmusuakuo afoforɔ ma wɔbɛka wɔn ho di saa afahyɛ yi. Nkuro a ɛdi Hɔmɔwɔ ne La, Teshie, Teshie Nungua, Osu, Ga-Mashie, Tema, Prampram ne Ningo.

Beaeɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ.

title: Emelia Brobbey
text:
Emelia Brobbey (wɔwoo no ɔpɛpɔn bosome da a ɛtɔ so nsia wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe mmienu) yɛ Ghana sinitwanii, ɔyɛ adwuma wɔ tɛlɛvision so sane yɛ nnwontoni. Ɔno na afe no mu nyinaa Wɔyii no sɛ sinitwafoɔ a ɔda nso wɔ sinitwafoɔ no nyinaa mu ɛna wɔsane yii no sɛ sinitwanii a ɔyɛ boafoɔ wɔ afe no mu wɔ "City People" anigyeɛ abasobɔdeɛ wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du-nsia mu. Ɔnyaa Ghana sinitwanii a ɔyɛ adeɛ ne obia ɔpɛ nnipa asɛm wɔ "3G" abasobɔdeɛ wɔ New York wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne dunnwɔtwe. Ɔnyaa mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne dunkron ɔbaa sinitwanii a ɔyɛ adeɛ wɔ ZAFAA wiase nyinaa abasya "African Film Academy Awards" na ɛde maa no wɔ badwam.

Abrabɔ Ahyɛaseɛ ne nnwomasua. 
Wɔwoo Emelia Brobbey wɔ ɔpɛpɔn bosome a ɛto so nsia wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe mmienu ɛna ɔnyinii wɔ Akyem Swedru a ɛwɔ apuiɛ mantam wɔ Ghana. Ɔwiee Akyem Swedru ntoasoɔ sukuu ɛna ɔtoaso kɔɔ "Presbytarian Teachers Training College". Ɔnyaa akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ"certificate A" wɔde Emelia kɔtoo  Obuasi sɛ ɔnkyerɛ abɔdeɛ mu nyansapɛ. Ɛno akyire no obi de no wuraa sinitwa mu. Ɔsan nso wɔ nsɛmtwerɛ dwuma nkrataa, nnwomasua nkrataa wɔ "Human Resourse Management ne ICM" nkrataa wɔ nsɛmtwerɛ dwuma mu.

Nnwom. 
Ɔde nwom"Fa me kɔ" baa abɔten mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne dunkron. Nnipa pii tweetwee no wɔ nwom a ɔde baa abɔten ɛne ne ne a na ɛnnyɛ no ho. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu mu no ɔsane de nwom foforɔ baa abɔnten "Ɔdɔ electric".

Nnoɔma a watumi anya. 
Wɔ ɔbɛnem bosome no mu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu mu no, Wɔyii no sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ ntamgyinani mma "Covid-19 National Trust Fund".

title: Mabel Simpson
text:
Mabel Simpson yɛ ɔbaa a ɔyɛ Ghana adepam nii a ɔda mSimps ano wɔ Ghana.

Abrabɔ Ahyɛaseɛ. 
Owura ne Owurayere Simpson na ɛwoo Mabel wɔ nkran, nkran   punpuni mantam wɔ Ghana.

Nnwomasua. 
Simpson kɔɔ ne mmɔfrase sukuu wɔ "Ridge church School" ɛna ne ntoasoɔ sukuu wɔ "Wesley High Girl's School" a ɔkɔsua nsano dwuma. Mabel kɔɔ Kwame Nkrumah suapɔn a ɔsua "communication design" ne nsaano dwuma a ɔde "second class upper" na ɛwie sukuu ɛwɔ "BA communication design" mu.

Nnwuma. 
Ɔhyɛɛ mSimps ase wɔ berɛ a ɔgyee adepam fidie wɔ ɔnana hɔ. Berɛ a na ɛwɔ mfeɛ aduonu nnum a ɛwɔ dwɛtire sini ahanu no, ɔsan ne ti firi n'adwuma a na ɔwɔ mu wɔ  ɔsanaa bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mu hyɛɛ mSimps ase. Ɔdii bɛyɛ mfeɛ num ansa na mSimps ɛtumi akɔ amannɔne, seisei mSimps wɔ nnipa a wɔtɔn ne nnoɔma wɔ US,Australia,canada ne abibirem anaafoɔ.

N'abrabɔ. 
Ɔyɛ sugyanii a ɛsom wɔ "St Augustine Anglican" asɔre wɔ Dansoman.

Abasobɔdeɛ. 

 CNN ne BCC a ɛwɔ amannɔne abɔ no abaso sɛ babunu a ɔyɛ nnwuma bebree.
 Mabel yɛ obi a ɔtɔ so du a ɛtwatoɔ wɔ dwuma bi a wɔdi no wɔ joy kasa fidie so a yɛfrɛ no me nnwuma wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du baako mu.
 Ɔsane nso yɛ obi a ɔtɔɔso mmiɛnsa wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu wɔ "Ennablis/UT BANK Business Launchpad" akansie mu.
 Ɔdii nkunim wɔ "Accessory Brand" wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmiɛnsa mu wɔ "Glitz Africa Fashion week"
 Mabel nyaa mma baage a yɛde sɛn yɛn ho ne nea yɛde kura abasobɔdeɛ wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmiɛnsa wɔ nsaano dwuma nnoɔma a yɛyɛ no wɔ Ghana a ɛdikan abasobɔdeɛ mu.

title: Université Paris-Saclay
text:
Université Paris-Saclay()  yε sukuupɔn a ɛwɔ Gif-sur-Yvette, France.

Paris-Saclay University yɛ amansan suapɔn a wɔyɛ nhwehwɛ mu a wɔwɔ Paris, France ahenkuro no mu. ɛka Paris-Saclay dwumadie ahodoɔ no ho bi, a wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛyɛ nhwehwɛmu a yɛka no borɔfo mu sɛ research-intensive adesua kampus ne dwadie ahodoɔ nyinaa wɔkyerɛ bi wɔ Plateau de Saclay a ɛbɛn Paris, na ɛhɔ nso ne beaɛ titiriw a wɔtee afoforɔ sane nso yɛ nhwehwɛ mu ahodoɔ wɔ Paris-Saclay. 

Paris-Saclay suapɔn no agye ne din yie pa ara wɔ nkontabuo adesua mu.  ɛbɛsi afe 2021 mu no, na nnipa du mmienu (12) bi a wɔgyee abasobɔdeɛ nyinaa yɛ wɔn a wɔkɔgyee nteteeɛ wɔ suapɔn yi mu ne ne associated research institute no mu, a ɛmu bi ne Institut des Hautes Études Scientifiques -  a ɛhɔ na yɛhunu no sɛ ɛyɛ awoɔ bea de ma ɛnɛ mmerɛ yi mu algebraic geometry ne catastrophe theory adesua mu.
Frεnkye

Abakwasɛm
wɔ afe 2019 mu no, Paris-Saclay suapɔn yi bɛhyɛɛ Paris-Sud (Paris XI) suapɔn a wɔtee no afe 1971 mu no anan mu,  a saa suapɔn no nso bɛhyɛɛ suapɔn a yɛfrɛ no sɛ University of Paris a wɔtee ɛno nso wɔ 1150 mu no anan mu.

Berɛ a wiase nyinaa ntɔkwa a ɛtɔ so mmienu no baa awieɛ no (World War II), na ɛho abɛhia sɛ wɔyɛ nhwehwɛ mu ntɛntɛm so de fa nuclear physics ne chemistry mu nti na nnipa a wɔbɛyɛ saa nhwhwɛmu yi ho abɛhia yie pa ara, a na ɛno nso ɛhia nnipa dodoɔ no ara mmoa wɔ mmeaɛ beberee mu. 

University of Paris, afei École Normale Supérieure ɛne Collège de France hwehwɛɛ baabi a ɛhɔ bae a ɛwɔ Paris atɔeɛ fam a ɛbɛn Orsay. ɛkyire yi no adekyerɛ dwumadie bi a na ɛkɔ so wɔ Faculty of Sciences a ɛwɔ Paris no wɔde ne nyinaa baa Orsay wɔ afe 1956 berɛ a  Irène Joliot-Curie ne Frédéric Joliot-Curie de adesrɛdeɛ kɔeɛ. ɛsiane nnipa dodoɔ a na wɔreba suapɔn no mu no nti ɛmaa Orsay suapɔn beɛeɛ hɔ no nso bɛdee ne ho wɔ March 1, 1965. Afei ɛbɛyɛɛ University of Paris-Sud (Paris XI) wɔ afe 1971 mu. 

Mprɛmprɛn yi ɛkura laboratory ahodoɔ akɛseɛ wɔ n'asaase (236 ha) no so wɔ na Kampus a ɛwɔ Paris-Saclay no. French laboratory akɛseɛ ahodoɔ no mu pii ka ho; ɛbinom ne baabi a wɔyɛ nhwehwɛ mu de fa particle physics, nuclear physics, astrophysics, atomic physics and molecular physics, condensed matter physics, theoretical physics, electronics, nanoscience ne nanotechnology ho.

title: Molly Germaine Prempeh
text:
Molly Germaine Prempeh (wɔwoo no afe apem ahankron ne aduanan nson [1947]) wɔwoo no wɔ "Seychelles" a ɔyɛ Ghana hemaa. Ɔhemaa Hugutte babaa ne no ɛna ɔnanakansoa ne Prempeh I,  Britishfoɔ bɔɔ ɔne n'abusuafoɔ asu firii hɔ wɔ afe apem ahankron mu.Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du num mu no ɔyɛɛ n'adwene sɛ ɔbɛkɔ"Seychelles" akɔsra n'abusuafoɔ sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a wɔn bɛsane aka abom wɔ berɛ a ɔfirii ne kurom a yɛwoo no bɛyɛ mfeɛ aduosia.

"Seychelles" nsrahwɛ. 
Wɔwoo Germaine Prempeh wɔ "Seychelles" nanso ɔtenaa Kumase, Ghana bɛyɛ mfeɛ aduosia nnwɔtwe. Wɔ ɔpɛpɔn bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du num mu no ɔkɔɔ "Seychelles" nsrahwɛ deɛ ɛdi kan berɛ a watena Ghana mpɛn pii sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a ɔne n'abusuafoɔ bɛsan aka abom. Berɛ a ɔduruu Praslin wiemhyɛnbea no, ne sewaa Sylvia Prempeh babaa Marie-Rose Mahoune na ɛbɛhyiaa no. Ɔhyiaa n'abusuafoɔ a aka no, ɛyɛɛ wɔn nwanwa sɛ ɔtumi ka wɔn kasa a yɛfrɛ no "creole". Berɛ a na ɔwɔ"Seychelles" ɔkɔsraa ne nananom amu wɔ "Seychelles" akyi ne aboronsan a ɛtoaso mmienu wɔ Le Rocher, a na wɔfrɛ no " Ashanti camp".

N'abrabɔ. 
Wɔwoo mmamu nsia ɛna ne nana kansoa nso yɛ du nan.

Beaɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ.

Afahyɛ. 
Nnipa a ɛwɔ Awukugua di Ohum na saa afahyɛ yi wɔdi no wɔ Obubuo anaa Ɔpɛnimaa bosome mu. Ohum yɛ Ghana afahyɛ baako a nnipa pii firi akyirikyiri ne bɛntɛe ne amanɔne ba bɛdi saa afahyɛ yi bi. Wɔdi Ohum afahyɛ de kae nnɔbaeɛ foforɔ a wanya, te sɛ Hɔmɔwɔ a Gafoɔ na ɛdi no, Ahoboa ne Bakatue yɛ Ahantafoɔ ne Aboakyere a Awutufoɔ ne Afutufoɔ na ɛdi, Kundum yɛ Fantefoɔ, Adaekɛse yɛ Asantefoɔ, Hogbestosto yɛ Anglofoɔ(Ewe), Dambaa yɛ Dagombafoɔ ɛna Appoo yɛ Bono-Ahafofoɔ na ɛdie.Ohum yɛ ɛnkane tete Afahyɛ a Akuapemfoɔ di, ne titire Larteh ne Okerefoɔ a Abiriwfoɔ a wɔyɛ Guan ka ho.

text:
Volta Tuntum anaa Mouhoun yɛ nsuo a ɛtene fa Burkina Faso a ɛtene bɛyɛ brofo kwansin apem, ahaasa ne aduonum mmienu (840ml) kɔ Volta fitaa a ɛwɔ Dagbon, Ghana mu. Wɔ Ghana no ɛne ɛhyeɛ no fa baabi bom a ɛda savannah mantam ne Bono mantam ntam. Wasi Bui Dam no wɔ saa nsuo no so wɔ Ghana. Saa nsuo no kyɛ Bui National Park a ɛwɔ Ghana mu mmienu.

title: Afari, Ghana
text:
Afari yɛ kuro bi a ɛda Kumase ne Nkawie ntam a ɛwɔ Atwima Nwabiagya mansini a ɛwɔ Ghana Asante mantam. Saa kuro yi yɛ beaɛ a wɔbɛsi Kumase Asraafoɔ Ayaresabea. Ɛyɛ kuro bi a ɛwɔ mfasodeɛ wɔ Atwima Nwabiagya mansini ɛna seesei ɛno na ɛyɛ kuro a atumpɔn wɔ mansini hɔ. Ɛka nkuro a akyɛ wɔ Asante Mantam. Adwuma titire a nnipa a ɛwɔ Afari yɛ ne kuadwuma ne ahina yɛ. Wɔn tee sɛ adehyeɛ a ɛwɔ kuro hɔ yɛ Oheneba Acheampong Kwasi a na ɔyɛ Oti Akenten babarima, kwaman hene a ɔdikan asefoɔ, ɛne Kumase ansa na Kumase rebɛka Asante ahennie ho. Wɔtee sɛ saa adehyeɛ yi abusuafoɔ no tu firii Abrenyase, ɛnkane "Yaa Asantewaa Girls senior High School" wɔ Tanoso ɛna wɔkɔ tenaa Afari. Kuro no nnyaa odikuro biara mmaa  no nnii wɔn so bɛyɛ mfeɛ aduonu a atwam yi berɛ a ɔheneba Acheampong Kwasi akonnwa no tɔeɛ wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu a ɔgyae kuro no saa a wamfa obiara anto kuro no ano, ɛnam saa nti aha kuro no mpuntuo a ɛno na ɛmaa kuro no yɛɛ kuro a atumpɔn ntɛm paa wɔ mantam no mu. Ɛwɔ sɛ obiara yɛ ahwɛyie sɛ wɔrebɛtɔ asaase a ɛnam sɛ wɔnni ɔdikuro biara ɔwɔ ho kwan sɛ ɔtɔn nsaase ma nnipa biara. Ɛnam sɛ wɔnni odikuro nti akuafoɔ afa saa akwanya no so tɔn wɔn nsaase ma nkorɔfoɔ bi a ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔtɔn ma wɔn a ɛde ntawantawa bɛba sɛ wɔde odikuro si kuro no so a. Nnipa a aɛqɔ Afari no pɛ nnipa asɛm yie sane nso yɛ adwumadenfoɔ. Ɛnam y ahɔhoɔ si dan wɔ hɔ na ebi tena hɔ nti, ɛwɔ sɛ nnipa yɛ ahwɛyie wɔ krɔno ho ne nnoɔma nketenkete a wɔwia ho. Sɛ wɔsi Asraafoɔ Ayaresabea no wie a, Afari bɛba abɛka nkuro a ɛwɔ nnipa tena hɔ esiane sɛ wode firi hɔ rekɔ Kumase nwa biara a wobɛtumi de sima aduasa akɔ hɔ.Sɛ kaa bɔ dɔmpe wɔ kwan mu a ɛbɛtumi aha mmerɛ no.

Beaɛ a menya mmoa firiiɛ.

title: Benita Sena Okity-Duah
text:
Benita Sena Okity-Duah(wɔwoo no Ayɛwohomummɔ bosome da a ɛtɔ so du nkron wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduoson nsia) yɛ Ghana adepamfoɔ, amanyɔni ne ɛnkane mmarahyɛbedwani ma Ledzokuku mpɛsoa wɔ Nkran pupuni mantam.

Abrabɔ ahyɛaseɛ ne nnwomasua. 
Wɔwoo no wɔ Ayɛwohomummɔ bosome da a ɛtɔ so du nkron wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduoson nsia wɔ Anloga a  ɛwɔ Fram mantam wɔ Ghana. Ɔnyaa "Miss Ghana Pageant" wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nson berɛ a na ɔyɛ ɔsuani a wadi mfeɛ aduonu. Ɔkɔɔ ne ntoasoɔ sukuu wɔ Achimota sukuu wɔ Nkran. Ɛno akyire no akɔsua adepam wɔ "London School of Fashion" mfeɛ nan.

Nnwuma. 
Ɔsane baa Ghana mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne mmiɛnsa, ɛfiri hɔ no ɔbɔɔ no ho mmɔden wɔ Ghana adepamfoɔ dwumayɛkuo no mu.

Amanyɔsɛm. 
Benita de ne diberɛ a na ɔkura sɛ "Women's Organizer"  ma kyineɛ amanyɔkuo "National Democratic Congress" ma Ledzokuku mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Nkran pupuni mantam too hɔ. Ɔkɔgyinaa hɔ maa n'amanyɔkuo berɛ a na wɔrebɛtɔ aba ɛna ɔmaa saa berɛ mmarahyɛbedwani Nii  Nortey Dua a na ɔwɔ so dii ntwo ɛna ɔgyinaa hɔ maa kyineɛ amanyɔkuo"National Democratic Congress" wɔ ne mpɛsoa so. Ɔdii nkunim wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu abatoɔ na ɔyɛɛ anamsini maa nnipa a ɛwɔ Ledzokuku a ɛwɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbedwam. Biom, ɔsom sɛ ɔsoafoɔ abɛdiakyire a ɔhwɛ mmaa ne mmarima, mmɔfra ne asetena mu banbɔ nsɛm so wɔ Ghana firi Oforinsuo bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmiɛnsa de kɔsi Ayɛwohomummɔ bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nan mu. Na ɔsane yɛɛ ɔsoafoɔ abɛdiakyire a ɔhwɛ nsuomunam ne mpataa so wɔ Ghana. Benita dii ntwo maa Dr. Benard Okoe-Boye a na ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo"New patriotic party" bɛfaa akonnwa no wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia mmarahyɛbedwa abatoɔ no mu.

N'abrabɔ. 
Benita waree Steve Okity-Duah. Na ankasa a yɛde too no berɛ a yɛwoo no ne Benita Golomeke, ɔnyaa wɔ"Embassy pleasure Ma Ghana" wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nson abasobɔdeɛ. Ɔyɛ Okristoni sane nso yɛ ekuoba wɔ " The church of christ of Latter-day saints".

Beaɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ.

title: DJ Zel
text:
Zelda Nana Yaa Adepa Dedaa Manteaw (wɔ woo no afe mpem mmienu ne du [2010] mu)   ne din a wonim no wɔ prama so ne  DJ Zel, ye Ghanani wɔ woo no wɔ Britain a ɔye nnwombɔfo, nnwomtoni ne asawdifo. ɔyɛ obi osua koraa a odiikan nyaa akwanya bɔɔ nnwom wɔ akasafidie so wɔ United Kingdom na sesei, ɔyɛ adwuma sɛ ɔkasafoɔ wɔ dwumadie a w'ato din UniAfrik wɔ kasafiedie ɛde GN Radio wɔ UK.

Nnwuma 
Manteaw  hyɛɛ  n'adwuma ase sɛ nnwombofo wɔ Bosome a ɛtɔ so dubaako , afe mpem mmienu ne du-nwɔtwe (2018) mu. Onyaa ntetee sɛ nnwombɔfo wɔ Subbass Academy of Electronic Music wɔ Webster, na mprenpren, ɔregye ntetee wɔ senea wɔbɔ nnwom anaa DJ wɔ beae a w'ato din London Sound Academy, a ɛwɔ North West London. Oyɛɛ dwumadie wo Barbican Centre maa Mayor no wɔ London, Sadiq Khan , ma London Living Wage. ɔsan nso yɛɛ dwumadie wɔ st George's Catheral ne UnAfrik Live Jam wɔ Leicester.

Abasobɔdeɛ 
W'anya abasobɔdeɛ  a ɛfa nnwombɔ ho wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du-nkron (2019) mu dwumadie a w'ato din International African Achievers Merit Awards a ɛkɔɔ  so wɔ  Accra.

text:

title: Serwaa Amihere
text:
Serwaa Amihere yɛ Ghana nsɛmtwerɛni ne kaseɛbɔni a ɔyɛ adwuma wɔ GHOneTV. Ɔnyaa "tɛlɛvision" female Newscaster

of the year" abasobɔdeɛ wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nwɔtwe wɔ kasafidie ne tɛlɛvision abasobɔdeɛ mu. Ɔhyɛɛ aseɛ sɛ obi a ɔhwɛ "awardwinning current affairs show", "State of affairs" a Nana Aba Anamoah na ɔdi saa dwuma no. Ɔno na ɔda cheers nnawɔtwe awieeɛ agokansie so wɔ GHOneTV.

Abrabɔ ahyɛaseɛ ne nnwomasua. 
Wɔwoo Serwaa wɔ ɔbenem bosome da a ɛtɔ so nnawɔtwe wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron mu sɛ Frank Yeboah ne Lydia Tetteh abakan. Ɔkɔɔ Yaa Asantewaa ntoasoɔ sukuu ɛna ɔsua nkontabuo wɔ "Methodist" Suapɔn.

Nnwuma. 
Serwaa yɛ obi a ɔdi mu wɔ kaseɛbɔ mu wɔ GHOneTV so ne Ghanani a ɔdikan a ɔdii nkunim wɔ "RTP" abasobɔdeɛ a ɔnyaa abasobɔdeɛ wɔ kaseɛbɔ a ɔbɔɔ ne ho mmɔden wɔ mu wɔ afe no mu nyinaa mpɛn mmiɛnsa.

Abusua. 
Ɛnkyɛree biara na Serwaa Amihere daa no  adi wɔ abɛɛfo ntentan baako a yɛfrɛ no "Instagram"  so sɛ ɔwɔ ba a, ɛyɛ adeɛ a ɔde asie n'akyitaefoɔ, wɔn a wɔpɛ mfeefeemu bisaa no no saa mmuaeɛ no na ɔde maa wɔn sɛ ɔwɔ ba. Ansa na Serwaa rebɛka sɛ ɔwɔ ba no, ɔdaa mfonini baako bi adi wɔ abɛɛfo ntentan so a na ne nuabaa, ɔmaame ne abaayewa ketewa bi ka ho a watwerɛ aseɛ sɛ"m'akoma a ɛwɔ mfonini baako mu". Ne saa nti nnipa pii no ara susuu sɛ abaayewa no bɛtumi ayɛ ne ba ampa.

Abasobɔdeɛ.

title: Kitase Akuapim
text:
Kitase Akuapim yɛ kuro bi a ɛwɔ Akuapim anaafoɔ mansini adantam a ɛwɔ Ghana anaafoɔ apueɛ mantam. Ɛne Peduase a ɛyɛ baabi a wɔfa de firi Nkran kɔ Akuapem bɔ hyeɛ.

Afahyɛ 
Nnipa a ɛwɔ kitase di Odwira afahyɛ na saa fa yi mpɛn pii no wɔhyɛ no ɛbɔ anaa ahinime bosome no mu. Odwira yɛ Ghana afahyɛ baako a nnipa pii firi akyirikyiri ne bɛntɛe ne aburokyire  bɛdi saa fa no bi. Wɔ mfeɛ bebree a atwam no, Odwira afahyɛ abɛyɛ afahyɛ a ɛdi mu wɔ Ghana, nkorɔfoɔ de ahokeka kɔ hɔ, ɛda amammerɛ bebree adi, ɛtwe nnipa firi baeɛ bebree a wɔde anigyeɛ, nkunim ne nkabom di afahyɛ no. Ansa na Odwira rebɛka Ghana amammerɛ ho no, na nnipa a ɛwɔ Akropong, Amanokrom ne Aburi a ɛwɔ apueɛ mantam na ɛdi saa afahyɛ no.

title: Sheila Bartels
text:
Sheila Bartels yɛ Ghanani a ɔyɛ nnwuma bebree sane nso yɛ amanyɔni.Ɔpre akonnwa wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu Ghana abatoɔ no mu na ɔnyaa mmarahyɛbedwa akonnwa maa Ablekuma atifi mpɛsoa so.

Amanyɔsɛm. 
Bartels yɛ ekuoba wɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo"New patriotic party" mu. Wɔ ɔpɛnimaa bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu mu no, wɔyii no sɛ mmarahyɛbedwanii ma Ablekuma atifi mpɛsoa wɔ berɛ a ɔpree wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu Ghana abatoɔ akyire no a ɔdii nkunim no. Ɔnyaa mma mpem aduonum nan, aha nnwɔtwe ne aduonu baako a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu aduosia nnwɔtwe akyirepɔ aduo nsia firii mma dodoɔ a wɔtoo no mu. Wɔtoo ne so aba yii no gyaa Ashley Mensah Winifred a ɔwɔ kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo"National Democratic Congress" mu ne Princess Agyemang Awuku a ɔwɔ "Ghana Union Movement" mu. Wɔnyaa mma mpem aduonu nkron, ahanson ne aduoson mmienu ne ahanu ne du nsia firii mma dodoɔ a wɔtoo no mu wɔ ne nnidisoɔ so a ɛne ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduasa nan akyirepɔ aduokron ne akyirepɔ aduowɔtwe nan mma wɔtooeɛ no yɛpɛ Wɔ ne nnidisoɔ so.

N'abrabɔ 
Ɔyɛ babaa ma Kwamena Bartels a na ɔno nso yɛ mmarahyɛbedwanii ma Ablekuma atifi firi  ɔpɛpɔn bosome wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduoson num de kɔsi ɔpɛpɔn bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nkron mu.Wɔwoo no ɔbenem bosome wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduoson num. Ɔfiri Gomoa Assin a ɛwɔ Ghana mfimfini mantam.

Beaɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ.

title: Dakoa Newman
text:
Dakoa Newman (wɔwoo no kitawonsa bosome da a ɛtɔ so nsia wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe num) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni a ɔyɛ ekuoba wɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo"New patriotic party" mu. Ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbedwanii ma Okaikwei anaafoɔ mpɛsoa. Ɔyɛ babaa ma Victor Newman a ɛno nso amanyɔni.

Abrabɔ ahyɛaseɛ ne nnwomasua. 
Wɔwoo no kitawonsa bosome da a ɛtɔ nsia wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe num wɔ abusua a wɔyɛ akristofoɔ na  ɔfiri Akropong ne Osu wɔ ne nnidisoɔ so. Ɔwiee ne ntoasoɔ sukuu wɔ"Wesley Girls Senior High School" wɔ Cape Coast ɛna ɔkura PMI wɔ "Risk management" wɔ (mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nson) . Ɔsane nso kura amanyɔsɛm adesua nkrataa a ɔnya firii"Univ of Ghana,Legon".

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔ Ayɛwohomummɔ bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu mu no, ɔgyinaa hɔ maa ɔsono amanyɔkuo "New patriotic party"  akonnwa maa Okaikwei anaafoɔ. Newman maa n'asɔretiafoɔ Arthur Ahmed ne Nana Fredua a ɔwɔ mmarahyɛbedwam dii ntwo a ɔnyaa mma ahanan ne aduanan, ɛna nnipa mmienu no nso nyaa ahaasa ne aduonu nson ne aduonu nson  mma wɔ ne nnidisoɔ so. Ɔdii nkunim wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu ɔpɛnimaa bosome mmarahyɛbedwa abatoɔ wɔ Okaikwei anaafoɔ mpɛsoa so. Wɔdaa no adi sɛ nkunimdifoɔ a ɔnyaa mma mpem aduanan, ahaasa ne aduokron mmiɛnsa a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu aduosia akyirepɔ aduowɔtwe mmienu tiaa n'asɔretiafoɔ Abaraham Kotei Neequaye a ɔwɔ kyineɛ amanyɔkuo"National Democratic Congress" mu a ɔnyaa mma mpem aduonu nsia,  ne du nkron a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyem aduasa nkron akyirepɔ du nwɔtwe.

N'abrabɔ 
Ɔyɛ babaa ma Ghana amanyɔni Victor Newman.

title: Eugene Arhin
text:
Eugene Arhin ()yɛ Ghana amanyɔni. Ɔyɛ ekuoba ma ɔsono amanyɔkuo"New patriotic party" ne ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ wɔ nkitahodie mu ma Ghana manpanin, Nana Addo Dankwa Akuffo-Addo.

Nnwomasua 
Arhin kɔɔ ntoasoɔ sukuu wɔ " Presbytarian Boys Secondary School, Legon" . Ɔtoa ne nnwomasua so wɔ Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology a ɔnyaa ne nnwomasua nkrataa wɔ "Materials Engineer" wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nsia mu.

Nnwuma. 
Ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ boafoɔ afe baako a ɛyɛ ɔhyɛ wɔ ne "National Service" mu wɔ "Department of Materials Engineering". Ɔsane yɛ adwuma Danquah adwumayɛkuo, adwuma a wɔde din no too Dr. J.B Danquah sɛ obi a ɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu.

N'amanyɔsɛm abrabɔ 
Wɔ ɔpɛpɔn bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nson mu no ɔmanpanin Nana Addo Dankwa Akuffo-Addo yii no sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ wɔ nkitahodie mu "Flagstaff house". Ne yie no mu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nson ɔsom sɛ ɔtwerɛtwerɛfoɔ ma Nana Addo Dankwa Akuffo-Addo mfeɛ mmienu. Wɔ aba wɔsane too no wɔ ɔpɛpɔn bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu baako mu no a ɔde Nana Addo Dankwa Akuffo-Addo sii akonnwa no so biom no, ɔmanpanin sane yii no sɛ ɔnsom wɔ saa diberɛ no ara mu.

title: Fatimatu Abubakari
text:
Fatimatu Abubakar yɛ Ghana mmarahyɛbedwanii, amanyɔnii na ɔsane yɛ nnwuma bebree. Ɔyɛ ekuoba wɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo"New patriotic party" mu na ɔsane nso yɛ mprempren yi ɔsoafoɔ abɛdiakyire wɔ nkitahodie kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ ma Ghana manpanin.

Abrabɔ ahyɛaseɛ ne nnwomasua. 
Wɔwoo Abubakar wɔ Kumase a ɛwɔ Asante Mantam. Ɔwiee Suapɔn wɔ University of Ghana a ɔnyaa ne nkrataa wɔ adwene mu ne Ngreesi kasa mu. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe mu,berɛ a na ɔrekɔ ne suapɔn sukuu wɔ University of Ghana no, ɔsom sɛ ɔmanpanin abɛdiakyire wɔ "Akuafo Hall Junior Common Room" ɛna ɔsane kɔpree ɔtwerɛtwerɛfoɔ maa "National Union of Ghana Students" wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mu.

Nnwuma ne amanyɔsɛm abrabɔ. 
Na ɔyɛ ɔsoafoɔ abɛdiakyire a ɔma nkaebɔ firi Ayɛwohomummɔ bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu baako. Wɔ ɔpɛpɔn bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nson mu no ɔmanpanin Nana Addo Dankwa Akuffo-Addo yii no sɛ ɔsoafoɔ abɛdiakyire wɔ"Flagstaff house" sɛ nkitahodie kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ. Wɔ ne yie mu no, ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ "Lansdown Resort, Danquah Institute ne SRM Engineering"

title: Sunyani
text:
Sunyani ( yɛ kurow a n'ahenkuro ne Sunyani Municipal ne Bono Mantamu a ɛwɔ Ghana mu. Bere a wɔkan nnipa ne agyapadeɛ wɔ afe 2010 wɔ Ghana no, na nnipa a wɔwɔ Sunyani yɛ 74,240. Nnipa a wɔwɔ kurow no mu dodoɔ no ara yɛ Bonofoɔ.

Abakɔsɛm 
Sunyani yɛ kurow a kwae atwa ho ahyia wɔ ɔman Ghana atɔe famu. Tete no, na wonim Sunyani sɛ beae a abɔmmɔfoɔ a wokum asono taa bɔ nsraban. Wonyaa kurow no din firii Akan asɛmfua 'Ɔsono' mu. Wɔ afe 1924 mu no, aban a na ɛwɔ so saa bere no a na wɔyɛ aborɔfo no yɛɛ Sunyani ɔmansini dwumadibea kɛseɛ. Sunyani bɛyɛɛ beae a wotu kookoo, bese ne nduane bi te sɛ aburo ne bayirɛ bere a wɔyɛɛ kwan a efiri Kumase rekɔ Sunyani no. Ɛnnɛ, Sunyani na Bono-Ahafo mantam aban ne asɛnniibea kɛseɛ no nyinara wɔ. ɛwɔmu sɛ wode Sunyani toto Kumase ho a Sunyani sua, nanso kurow no gu so ara reyɛ kɛse na atrɛw adu Fiapre ne Abesim. Sunyani yɛ kurow a emu te a wɔn esiesie no yie na ne dwadie mu nsɛm nso gu rekɔ n'anim.

Sikasɛm 
Sunyani sikasɛm mu fa kɛseɛ no ara firi kuayɔ mu esiane sɛ ɔmanfoɔ no mu bɛyɛ ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu aduanan nnwɔtwe(48%) de wɔn ho hyɛ kuayɔ mu.Nnipa no mu ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu aduonu nnan(24%) yɛ aban nnwuma ahodoɔ, wɔn mu ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu du nnum(15%) de wɔn ho hyɛ adwadie akɛseɛ mu ɛnna emu ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu du mmiɛnsa(13%) yɛ adwuma wɔ nnwumakuo akɛseɛ mu.Mmea ne wɔn a wonni nnwuma ahoroɔ mu nimdeɛ pii de wɔn ho hyɛ adwadie a ɛkɔ so Wukuada biara no mu. Sunyani mpuntuo no mu fa kɛseɛ no ara gyina nsuo papa a wonya wɔ kuro no mu. Wonnya wɔn anyinam ahoɔden firi Volta Region Authority (VRA). Wonya nsuo firi nsubɔten ahoroɔ ne Osuo a ɛtɔ mu nanso nsuo ho taa yɛ den wɔ ɔpɛ berɛ mu.

Infidiedwuma

Mprenpren, Sunyani ne beaɛ baako a ɛka Atifi fam ho a African Global Limited (AGP) nkorabata akɛseɛ no wɔ wɔ ɔman Ghana mu. Eyi yɛ adwumakuo a ɛyɛ nnuro a wɔn ase firi adwumakuo AGP Canada. Wɔn dwumadibea ti wɔ Toronto, Ontario, Canada a wɔyɛ nnuro.Adwumakuo a etu famu agudie a ɛwɔ nkorabata wɔ aman ahodoɔ so a ne din d kke Newmont no fa a ɛbɛn Sunyani kuro Kenyase no kɔ so hyɛ kuro no sikasɛm ne ne mpuntuo mu kena.

Sikakorabea 
Sunyani wɔ sikakorabea ahodoɔ pii nkorabata. Sikakorabea ahodoɔ yi bi ne Bank of Ghana, Ghana Commercial Bank, Barclays Bank, SG-SSB Bank, OmniBank, Zenith Bank, Agricultural Development Bank of Ghana, Stanbic Bank, Ecobank Ghana ne National Investment Bank. Sikakorabea nkumaa ahodoɔ nsia, 'credit union' ahodoɔ ne nsiakyibaa nnwumakuo ahodoɔ ka saa sikakorabea akɛseɛ nkorabata yi ho ma ekurow no mufo sika ho nsam kɔ yie.

Nikitahodie

Sunyani kurow yɛ kurow bi a yɛde nnɛyi nkitahodie mfiedie asiesie no yiye a mfiedie bi te sɛ telefon a esi faako ne nkrasɛm Nhoma, abɔten so telefon, telefon a wokura kyin, intanet ne e-mail nyinaa ka ho. Nea ɛka ho: nkrataa mena ho dwumadie nso bi wɔ hɔ a ɛyɛ posɔfese, ne nkrataa kyerɛw a akɔ anim a nnwumakuo a ɛde baeɛ no bi ne EmS ( Express mail service) DHL ne FedEX.

Nsrahwɛ

Nsrahwɛ wɔ Sunyani gyina nyame abɔdeɛ a etwa kurow no ho ahyia. Bɛyɛ 3-star ahɔhodan mmiɛnsa ne nnɛyi ahɔhodan bɛyɛ du num ne ahɔhodan a ɛwɔ soro, ne ahɔhofie ne adidibea nso wohu bi wɔ kurow yi mu. Kurow yi mu nnoɔma a ɛtwetwe nnipa bi ne kooko fie, abansoro tenten a agye kurow no afa, adan, Bono mantam adwumakuw no adwumayɛbea ti, beaeɛ bebree a wɔtɔtɔn afadeɛ afɛɛfɛ. Adan ahorow a ɛyɛ anika wɔ Sunyani bi ne, Christ the King Cathedral, ne Queen of peace dan, Knight of St. John fie. Bio, Kintampo nsu aworoeɛ ne Boabeng asoroboa fie a ɛwɔ Fiema, ɛyɛ kwantia a ɛda kurow no akyi.

Apɔmuden

Sunyani wɔ ayaresabea mmiɛnsa, baako a ɛyɛ Sunyani Mantam ayaresabea yɛ ɔman nkosoɔ dwumadie a wɔbue ano wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne mmiɛnsa mu. Ayaresabea nwɔtwe ne baabi a wɔhwɛ apemfoɔ nso mmiɛnsa di dwuma wɔ kurow yi mu. Wobɛhunu ayaresabea bebree nso wɔ kurow yi mu.

Akwantuo

Sunyani wimhyɛn gyinabea som Sunyani kurow no a adi dwuma nkakrankakra wɔ kurow no mu a wɔbue ano wɔ Kitawonsa bosome ne da ɛtɔ so dummiɛnsa wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduoson nan mu. Nanso, ɛnam ɔkwan tenten ho nsɛmsɛm nti enye sɛ wimhyɛn a ɛso kakra no bɛdi dwuma wɔ wimhyɛn gyinabea hɔ na mpen pii no Sunyani wimhyɛn gyinabea fa akwantufoɔ kɔ Kumase wimhyɛn gyinabea ne Takoradi wimhyɛn gyinabea. Baguam akwantuo bi ne ɔkwanso akwantuo a Metromassfoɔ de baeɛ, Vip ne Taxicab anaa Trotro. Baguam akwantuo no bi nso firi Sunyani kɔ nkurow akɛseɛ bi te sɛ Accra, Kumasi, Mim, Ahafo, Cape Coast, Takoradi, Tamale; Tema; Ho; Wa; Bolgatanga; Elubo; Aflao; Techiman.

Nwomasua

Sunyani kurow yɛ fie ma nhomasua a akɔ akyiri beberee wɔ yɛn man Gaana mu, deɛ ɛka ho bi ne Sunyani Technical University a ɛyɛ kane Sunyani Polytechnic, University of Energy and Natural Resources a ɛwɔ Fiapre a ɛbɛn kane Sunyani Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology - Agric school, Catholic University College of Ghana a ɛwɔ Fiapre ne College of Science, Arts and Education a ɛwɔ Penkwase - Law school. Sukuu akɛseɛ ahodow bi nso ne University of Cape Coast, ne  Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology - KNUST a wɔkura mmere kumaa ne mmere tenten adesua wɔ Sunyani.

Sunyani wɔ ntoasoɔ sukuu bebere a St. James Seminary a woyi asukuu num a wɔnim adeɛ wɔ Gaana a wɔka ho bie no nso ka ho. Ebi nso ne Sunyani Business Senior High School, Sunyani Secondary School, a ɛtwetwe asukuufoɔ beberee firi Brong - Ahafo mantam ne nkurow a ɛwɔ akyiri ba, ntoasoɔ sukuu a agye din yiye pa ara ( Susec - a wagye abasobɔdeɛ wɔ WASSCE nsɔhwɛ twerɛ mu firi 2011 ).

Mfitiaseɛ sukuu, ntoasoɔ ne nsanodwuma sukuu pii na wobɛhunu wɔ Sunyani ne nkurow a ɛbɛn no, ebi ne, St. Mary's; Lawrence Demonstration; Wesley's; Divine Montessori; Ridge Primary; Twene Amanfo Secondary Technical school ( TASTECH ); Sunyani Business Senior High School; Notre Dame High School ( Ghana ) ne Don Bosco Vocational Technical Institute.

Abasobɔdeɛ

Sunyani nyaa abasobɔdeɛ wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nson mu sɛ kurow a ɛmu teɛ yiye.

Kuro a ɛbɛn no 
Sunyani ne Techiman a ɛbɛn no kaa wɔn ho boo yɛɛ adeɛ a seisei ara ɛne wɔn wɔ anuanom ayɔnkofa wɔ wɔntam.

Beaɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Queen Victoria
text:
Victoria () (Alexandrina Victoria; Kɔtɔnimaa bosome no da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nan (24) wɔ afe apem ahawɔtwe ne du nkron (1819) - Ɔpɛpɔn bosome no da a ɛtɔ so aduonu mmienu (22) wɔ afe apem ahankron ne baako (1901)) yɛ Ngyiresi (Great Britain) ne Ireland Hemaa. ɔhyɛɛ n'ahennie ase wɔ afe apem ahawɔtwe ne aduasa nson (1837), ayɛwohomumɔ da ɛtɔ so eduonu, (20th June). 

Ɔdii ahennie no mfeɛ eduosia mmiensa (63) ne abosom nsuon (7). Ɛma no yɛ ɔhemaa a w'adi ahennie no akyɛ paa ɛwɔ Ngyiresi man no abakɔsɛm mu. Ɔsiesiee ɔman no,  ɛbuebuee ndwuma kuo ahoroɔ,  na ɔde nsakyereɛ ahoroɔ nso baa ɔman no amanyɔsɛm, abɔdeɛmu nyansapɛ nhwehwɛmu ɛna asraafo dwumadie. Britain mmarahyɛbadwam' no kɔɔ asetena na wɔ maa no abodin sɛ India hemaa,  (Empress of India) wɔ afe apem ahawɔtwe ne aduoson nsia (1876) mu.

Ɔhemaa Victoria amanmuo baa awieɛ wɔ afe  apem ahankron ne baako (1901); bere a ɔfuraa ne ntoma ne tenten mu.

Victoria yɛ Kent ne Stratheam (King George III ne ba barima a ɔtɔ so nnan ) diadefoɔ ɛne Saxe-Coburg Saalfeld hene ba baa Victoria ba. Ne maame ɛne ahenfie dwumayɛfoɔ, John Conroy na ɛtetee no bere a ne Papa ne ne Nana firii mu wɔ afe apem ahawɔtwe ne aduonu (1820) mu. 

Ɔbɛyɛɛ Ɔhemaa wɔ bere a na w'adi mfeɛ du nnwɔtwe (18) bere a ne Papa nuammarima mmiensa nyinaa firii mu.  Ɛwɔ mu sɛ na yɛde mmara na abu ɔman no deɛ, nanso kokoam' no Victoria bɔɔ mmɔden de nnipakuo binom dii aban dibrɛ. Ɛwɔ Nipa nyinaa anim no, na Victoria yɛ nuonyamfoɔ ne obi ah odi mu.

Awoɔ ne abusua 
Victoria papa ne Prince Edward, Duke of Kent  me Strathearn,  ɔno na ɔtɔ so nan wɔ mma a ɔhene na ɔdi adeɛ wɔ United Kingdom, George III awo. Ɛfiri afe apem ahannwɔtwe ne du nson mu no, na Edward wɔfaase, Princess Charlotte of Wales nkoa na ɛyɛ George III nana. Ne wuo a ɔwuiɛ wɔ afe apem ahannwɔtwe ne du nson mu no de adedie nsɛnsɛm bɛtoo Duke of Kent ne ne nuanom a wɔnnwareeɛ so sɛ wɔnware na wɔnya mma. Wɔ afe apem ahannwɔtwe ne du nnwɔtwe (1818) mu no ɔwaree Princess Victoria a ɔwɔ Saxe-Coburg-Saalfeld, German kunanii baa a ɔyɛ ɔhene ba a ɔwɔ mma mmienu-Carl(afe apem ahannwɔtwe ne nan dekɔ afe apem ahannwɔtwe ne aduonum nsia) ne Feodora(afe apem ahannwɔtwe ne nson dekɔ afe apem ahannwɔtwe ne aduoson mmienu) berɛ a ɔwaree Emich Carl , ɔhene a ɔtɔ so mmienu wɔ Leiningena ɛyɛ n'awareɛ a ɛdikan.Na ne nuabarima Leopold yɛ ɔhemaa Charlotte kunanii. Wɔwoo Duke ne Duchess of Kent ba baako pɛ, Victoria bɛyɛ anɔpa nnɔnan mpaeɛ fa wɔ kɔtonimaa bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nan wɔ afe apem ahannwɔtwe ne du nkron (24 May, 1818) wɔ Kensington ahemfie wɔ London.

Archbishop a ɔda Charles Manners-Sutton ano too Victoria din wɔ Ayɛwohomummɔ bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nan wɔ afe apem ahannwɔtwe ne du nkron (24 June,1819)  wɔ Cupola dan mu a ɛwɔ Kensington ahemfie. Wɔbɔɔ no asu de no too Alexandrina a ɛyɛ ne nananom baako din a yɛfrɛ no Tsar Alexander I wɔ Russia, na wɔtoo no Victoria a ɛyɛ ɔmaame din. Ɛnam hyɛ a Kent nuapanyin George, Princes Regent hyɛɛ wɔn nti wɔde edin foforɔ bi a wɔsusuu sɛ wɔde bɛto no - Georgina(anaa Georgiana), Charlotte ne Augusta baeɛ.

Victoria na na ɔtɔ so num wɔ adidie mu wɔ berɛ a wɔwoo no aberɛ a wɔwoo George III mma mmarima mpaninfoɔ: Princes Regent(George a ɔtɔ so); Frederick, Duke of York; William, Duke of Clarence(a akyire wɔfrɛ no William IV); ne Victoria papa, Edward,Duke of Kent. Na Prince Regent nni mma, ɛna Duke of York nso mma; ne saa nti wɔtwerɛ wɔn ho firii wɔn yerenom ho ɛnam sɛ na watwam wɔ awoɔ ho nti,  nti ɛnam saa nti na wɔnni mma a mmara mu no ɛyɛ wɔn ara deɛ. William ne Edward waree da baako wɔ afe apem ahannwɔtwe ne du nnwɔtwe (1818) nanso William mma mmienu a ɛyɛ ɔno ankasa mma wui berɛ a wɔsua no. Nea ɔdikan no ne Princess Charlotte, a wɔwoo no a ɔwui wɔ ɔbenem bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nson wɔ afe apem ahannwɔtwe ne du nkron(27 March, 1819), bosome mmienu akyiri ansana  wɔrewo Victoria.Victoria papa wui wɔ ɔpɛpɔn bosome nom wɔ afe apem ahannwɔtwe ne aduonu, berɛ a na Victoria nya nni afe. Nnawɔtwe twam no ne nanabarima wui ɛna ne ba panin George IV di adeɛ. Sɛ Frederick ne William ba a na Victoria na ɔto so mmiɛnsa wɔ adidie mu. William babaa a ɔtɔ so mmienu, Princess Elizabeth of Clarence dii nnawɔtwe du mmienu firi ɔpɛnimaa bosome a ɛtɔ so ddu wɔ afe apem ahannwɔtwe ne aduonu dekɔ ɔbenem bosome a ɛtɔ so na wɔ afe apem ahannwɔtwe ne aduonu baako(10 Dec, 1820-4 March,1821) ɛno na ɛmaa Victoria bɛtoo so nan wɔ adidie mu.

Duke of York wui wɔ afe apem ahannwɔtwe ne aduonu nson(1821) ɛna George IV nso wui wɔ afe apem ahannwɔtwe ne aduasa mu (1830); ɛna adidie no kɔɔ wɔn nuabarima a ɔtease, William hɔ ɛna Victoria bɛyɛɛ  a ɔbɛdi adeɛ sɛ wannwo obi foforɔ a. Regent Act 1830 yɛɛ nhyehyɛeɛ soronko maa Victoria maame sɛ ɔngyina hɔ sɛ adedifoɔ sɛ William wu a wɔberɛ a na Victoria nso nyɛ ketewa. Ɔhene William annyɛ adi sɛ Duchess mmɛyɛ obi a ɔdi adeɛ, wɔ afe apem ahannwɔtwe ne aduasa nsia mu no ɔdaa no adi sɛ ɔpɛ sɛ ɔtenase kɔpem sɛ Victoria bɛdi n'awoda a ɛtɔ so du nnwɔtwe, sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛsi kwan na obiara mmɛgyina hɔ sɛ ɔdiadefoɔ.

Beaɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ.

title: Asutifi North (Ghana mmarahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Asutifi North () abatoɔ mpasua no yɛ abatoɔ mpasua a ɛwɔ ɔman Ghana mu, abatoɔ mpesua a ɛne Asutifi North abatoɔ mpesua no bɔ hyeɛ bi ne Asutifi South abatoɔ mpasua no.  Asutii North abatoɔ mpesua no wɔ Ahafo mantan no mu a nkane no nka ɛwɔ Bono-Ahafo mantam no mu de bɛsi sɛ abatoɔ kɔmisa kyekyɛɛ mantam ahodoɔ mu bio na ɛmaa Asutii North abatoɔ mpasua no kɔdii Ahafo mantam.

Asutii North abatoɔ mpasua mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no yɛ akonnwa a amannyɔkuo akɛseɛ a ɛwɔ Ghana no mu biara, mekyerɛ ɔsono amannyɔkuo NPP ne kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo NDC mmienu nyinaa atena so pɛn.

Benhazin Joseph Dahah yɛ saa mpasua no mmarahyɛbadwani. Wɔnam ɔsono amanyɔkuo (New patriotic party) so na wɔtoo no so aba yii no a ɔnyaa mma dodoɔ bɛyɛ apem ahasa ne aduonu nson (1,327)  de bɛyɛɛ saa mmarahyɛbedwani no. Na Ɔsane nso yɛ anamsini ma saa mpɛsua no wɔ mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtɔ so nsia wɔ berɛ a ɛtɔ so nan a wɔ Ghana sane gyee kabimamenkabi amanmuo too mu.

Beaɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ.

title: Juabeso (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Juabeso( abatoɔ mpesua no yɛ abatoɔ mpesua nkron a ɛwɔ Western North mantam no mu wɔ Ghana. Nkane no na wɔhyɛ Juaboso-Bodi abatoɔ mpesua no mu firi mfie mpem mmienu ne nan abatoɔ mu a wɔte firii Sefwi-Bibiani mansini no abatoɔ mpesua no mu de kɔ si sɛ wotee mansini no anaafoɔ fam firii Bodi mansini no mu maa yɛnyaa Juaboso abatoɔ mpesua no wɔ Ayɛwohomumɔ bosome no da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nwɔtwe wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du-mmienu abatoɔ mu. Juaboso abatoɔ mpesua no ahenkron ne Juaboso. Kwabena Mintah Akandoh na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma saa mpɛsoa no. Ɛnam kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo National Democratic Comgress so na wɔtoo no so aba yii no ma no nyaa mma dodoɔ mpem nson, ahasia ne du nkron (7,619) de bɛyɛɛ mmarahyɛbedwani. Na ɔno na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbedwani a ɔte akonnwa no so ansa na wɔreto mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe aba no.

Ɛhyeɛ 
Abatoɔ mpesua ahodoɔ a ɛne Juaboso abatoɔ no bɔ hyeɛ bi ne Bia East abatoɔ mpesua no, Bia West abatoɔ mpesua ne Asunafo North Municipal mansini no. wɔn a wɔ ne Juaboso bɔ hyeɛ wɔ apuiɛ fam bi nso ne Asunafo South abatoɔ mpesua no ne Bodi mansini no abatoɔ mpesua no. saa ara nso na Suaman mansini no abatoɔ mpesua no nso ne Juaboso bɔ nyeɛ wɔ  anaafoɔ fam, ɛna ɔne La Cote d’lvoire nso bɔ hyeɛ wɔ atɔeɛ fam. Juaboso mansini no wɔ nkuro akɛseɛ ahodoɔ nan bi te sɛ: Kofikrom-Proso, Asempaneye, Benchema-Nkatieso ne Boinzan. Wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du (2010) nipa ne adan akenkan dwumadie no mu kyerɛɛ sɛ,  nnipa dodoɔ a wɔtete Juaboso abatoɔ mpesua no so no yɛ mpem aduonum nwɔtwe, ahanan ne aduasa num (58,435). wɔn mu mpem aduonu nkron, ahanson ne aduanan mmienu na wɔyɛ mmarima (29,742 ), ɛna wɔn mu mpem aduonu nwɔtwe, ahansia ne aduokron mmiensa nso yɛ mmaa (28,693).

Baabia menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Tano North (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Tano North () abatoɔ mpɛsua no yɛ abatoɔ mpɛsua a ɛwɔ ɔman Ghana mu. Abatoɔ mpɛsua a ɛne Tano North abatoɔ mpɛsua no bɔ hyeɛ bi ne Tano South abatoɔ mpɛsua no. Tano North abatoɔ mpɛsua no wɔ Ahafo mantan no mu.  Ɛnkane no na ɛwɔ Bono-Ahafo mantam no mu de bɛsi sɛ abatoɔ kɔmisa kyekyɛɛ mantam ahodoɔ mu. Ɛmaa Tano North abatoɔ mpesua no kɔdii Ahafo mantam.

Tano North abatoɔ mpɛsua no yɛ abatoɔ mpɛsua ahodoɔ nsia a ɛwɔ Ahafo mantan no mu baako. Nkane no na nka mansini no din ne Tano mansini ɛfiri afe apem aha nkron ne aduowɔtwe nwɔtwe (1988) mu de bɛsi afe mpem mmienu ne nan (2004). Ɔpɛnimaa bosome no mu na abatoɔ kɔmisa tee Tano abatoɔ mpɛsua no atɔeɛ fam no firi Tano mansini no mu. Ɛmaa ɛdin no sesa bɛyɛɛ Tano North abatoɔ mpɛsua. Tano North abatoɔ mpɛsua no ahenkuro ne  Duayaw-Nkwanta.

Freda Prempeh yɛ mmarahyɛbedwani ma saa mpɛsoa no. Ɛnam Ɔsono amanyɔkuo (New Patriotic Party) so na wɔtoo no so aba yii no a ɔnyaa mma dodoɔ bɛyɛ mpem num, ahankron ne aduonu mmiɛnsa (5,923)  de bɛyɛɛ mmarahyɛbedwanii. Na ɔsan nso yɛ anamsini ma saa mpɛsoa no wɔ kwasafoman a ɛtɔso nan no mu.

Beaɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ.

title: Tano South (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Tano South () abatoɔ mpɛsua no yɛ abatoɔ mpɛsua a ɛwɔ ɔman Ghana mu. Abatoɔ mpɛsua nu ɛne Tano North abatoɔ mpɛsua no bɔ hyeɛ. Tano South abatoɔ mpɛsua no wɔ Ahafo mantan no mu a nkane no nka ɛwɔ Bono-Ahafo mantam no mu de bɛsi sɛ abatoɔ kɔmisa kyekyɛɛ mantam ahodoɔ mu bio na ɛmaa Tano South abatoɔ mpɛsua no kɔdii Ahafo mantam.

Tano South  abatoɔ mpɛsua no yɛ abatoɔ mpɛsua ahodoɔ nsia a ɛwɔ Ahafo mantan no mu baako. Nkane no na nka mansini no din ne Tano mansini ɛfiri afe apem aha nkron ne aduowɔtwe nwɔtwe (1988) mu de bɛsi afe mpem mmienu ne nan (2004). Ɔpɛnimaa bosome no mu na abatoɔ kɔmisa tee Tano abatoɔ mpɛsua no atɔeɛ fam no firi Tano mansini no mu na ɛmaa ɛdin no sesa bɛyɛɛ Tano South abatoɔ mpɛsua so. Tano South abatoɔ mpɛsua no ahenkuro ne  Bechem.

Yeboah Sekyere Benjamin na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbedwanii wɔ saa mpɛsoa no so. Ɛnam Ɔsono amanyɔkuo (New Patriotic Party) so na wɔtoo aba yii no ma no bɛyɛɛ mmarahyɛbedwanii  a ɔnyaa mma mpem ahasa, aha no ne mmiɛnsa.

Beaɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ.

title: Asunafo North (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Asunafo North ( abatoɔ mpesua no ka abatoɔ mpesua a Ghana abatoɔ kɔmisa tetee ma yɛde too aba wɔ berɛ a ɛdi kan koraa a ɔman Ghana gyee kabimamenkabi amanmuo too mu. Asunafo North abatoɔ mpesua no mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no yɛ akonnwa a Ɔsono amannyɔkuo New Patriotic Party (NPP)  na watena so dodoɔ pa ara, ansa na Kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo National Democratic Congress(NDC) nso aba a wɔn nso atena akonnwa no so bi nanso ɛnte sɛ Ɔsono amannyɔkuo New Patriotic Party ( NPP) deɛ no.

Wɔ afe apem aha nkron ne aduokron mmienu (1992) abatoɔ mu no, Asunafo North mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa abatoɔ mu no, Kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress (NDC) ananmusini a wɔde no baeɛ ne owura David Kwasi Amankwah, na berɛ a abatoɔ no baa awieɛ no, na wadi nkunim ama n'amannyɔkuo (NDC) New Democratic Congress. Owura David Kwasi Amankwah nko ara ne Kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress(NDC) ananmusini a watumi atena Asunafo North abatoɔ mpesUua mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no so.

Mfei mpem mmienu (2000) mu no, Ɔsono amanyɔkuo New Patriotic Party (NPP) ananmusini a wɔde no baa Asunafo North mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa abatoɔ mu no bɔɔ ne ho mmɔden yie pa ara. onipa a ɔbɛgyinaa mu maa Ɔsono amanyɔkuo New Patriotic Party(NPP) no ne owura Benjamin Osei Kuffour, na berɛ a abatoɔ no baa awieɛ no na wabɔ ne ho mmɔden agye akonnwa no afiri Kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress (NDC)ananmusini no nsam.Wɔ abtoɔ no mu no,Owura Osei Kuffour nyaa mma no mu mpem aduonu, ahanson ne aduowɔtwe nan (20,784). Ɛno yɛ ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduonum nson ne akyiripɔ aduonum (57.50%). Na deɛ ɔgyina maa (NDC) National Democratic Congress ɛne Christiana Atakora Mensah. Onyaa mma no mu mpem dunan ,aha mmiensa ne nsia (14,326) a ɛno nso gyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduasa nkron ne akyiripɔ aduoson (39.70%). Francis Amofah nso na ɔgyina maa Convention People's Party (CPP) amanyɔkuo no nyaa aha mmiensa ne aduonum nkron (359) a ɛno yɛ ɔha nkyekyɛmu baako ne akyiripɔ hwee (1.00%). Owura Michael Mahama Nabila nso yɛ (PNC) ananmusinii na onyaa mma no mu aha mmienu ne aduanan num (245) ɛno nso yɛ ɔha nkyekyɛmu hwee ne akyiripɔ aduoson (0.70%). Yeboah Kwasi Eric a ogyina mu maa UGM no nso nyaa mma no mu aha mmienu  ɛne nson (207) a ɛno yɛ ɔha nkyekyɛmu hwee ne akyiripɔ aduosia (0.60%). Asare Bediako na ɔgyina maa amanyɔkuo (NRP) ,onyaa mma no mu aha mmienu (200) a ɛyɛ ɔha nkyekyɛmu hwee ne akyiripɔ aduosia (0.60%).

Mfei mpem mmienu ne nan (2004) mu no, Ɔsono amanyɔkuo New Patriotic Party ananmusini a wɔde no baa mfei mpem mmienu (2000) abatoɔ mu no wɔsesaa no de nipa foforɔ na ɛbɛgyinaa Asunafo North mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa abatoɔ no. Ɔsono amanyɔkuo New Patriotic Party  (NPP) de Owura Robert Sarfo-Mensah na ɛbaeɛ, na abatoɔ no baa awieɛ no na watumi adi nkunim wɔ Asunafo North abatoɔ mpesua mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no so. Owura Robert Sarfo-Mensah de mma mpem aduonu mmiensa ,aha nan ne aduonu nsia (23,426) ɛdii nkunim. Ɛno gyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduonum baako ne akyiripɔ nson.(51.7%). Owura Robert Sarfo-Mensah na ɔkɔ gyinaa Asunafo North abatoɔ mpesua no ananmu wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam na ɔkɔtoaa n'amannyɔkuoba owura Benjamin Osei Kuffour adwuma so wɔ Asunafo North din mu. Christiana Atakorah Mensah a ɔgyina maa National Democratic Congress (NDC) amanyɔkuo no nso nyaa mma no mu mpem dunkron, aha mmienu ne aduowɔtwe nwɔtwe (19,288) a ɛno yɛ ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduanan mmienu ne akyiripɔ nsia (42.6%). Commey Kingsley na ɔgyina maa Convention People's Party (CPP) amanyɔkuo no nso nyaa mma no mu ahanum ne aduonu nsia (526) a ɛno yɛ ɔha nkyekyɛmu baako ne akyiripɔ mmienu (1.2%). Owura Benjamin Osei Kuffour

Mfei mpem mmienu ne dunsia (2016) mu no, Ɔsono amanyɔkuo New Patriotic Party (NPP) ananmusini a wɔde no baa wɔ mfei mpem mmienu ne nan (2004) abatoɔ mu no wɔsesaa no de nipa foforɔ na ɛbɛgyinaa Asunafo North mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa abatoɔ no. Ɔsono amanyɔkuo New Patriotic Party  (NPP) de Owura Evans Bobie Opoku na ɛbaeɛ, na abatoɔ no baa awieɛ no na watumi adi nkunim wɔ Asunafo North abatoɔ mpesua mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no so. Owura Evans Bobie Opoku na ɔkɔ gyinaa Asunafo North abatoɔ mpesua no ananmu wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam na ɔkɔtoaa n'amannyɔkuoba owura Robert Sarfo-Mensah adwuma so wɔ Asunafo North din mu wɔ Ghana Mmerahyɛbadwam. Wɔ mfei mpem mmienu ne dunsia abatoɔ mu no, Owura Evans Opoku Bobie nyaa mma no mu mpem aduasa baako,aha nsia ne aduowɔtwe baako(31,681). a eno yɛ ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduonum nsia ne akyiripo aduonum baako (56.51%) Mohammed Kwaku Doku a ɔno na ɔyɛ National Democratic Congress ananmusinii no nso nyaa mma no mu mpem aduonu nan (24,000) a ɛno nso gyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu aduanan mmienu ne akyiripo aduowɔtwe baako (42.81%). Seth Adomako (PPP) nso nyaa mma no mu aha mmienu ne aduoson num (275) a ɛyɛ ɔha nkyekyɛmu hwee ne akyiripɔ aduanan nkron (0.49%). Stella Opoku (CPP) nso nyaa mma no mu ɔha ne du (110) a ɛno nso gyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu hwee ne akyiripɔ aduonu (0.20%).

Ɛhyeɛ 
Asunafo North mpɛsoa yɛ mpɛsua baako a wɔteeɛ wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron mmienu (1992) Ghana mmarahyɛbedwa abatoɔ no mu. Na saa mpɛsoa yi wɔ Bono-Ahafo mantam, a seisei deɛ ɛwɔ Ahafo mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana.

title: Asunafo South (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Asunafo South () abatoɔ mpesua no yɛ abatoɔ mpesua a ɛwɔ ɔman Ghana mu, abatoɔ mpesua a ɛne Asunafo South abatoɔ mpesua no bɔ hyeɛ bi ne Asunafo North abatoɔ mpesua no. Asunafo South abatoɔ mpesua no wɔ Ahafo mantan no mu a nkane no nka ɛwɔ Bono-Ahafo mantam no mu de bɛsi sɛ abatoɔ kɔmisa kyekyɛɛ mantam ahodoɔ mu bio na ɛmaa Asunafo South abatoɔ mpesua no kɔdii Ahafo mantam.

Asunafo South abatoɔ mpesua mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no yɛ akonnwa a amannyɔkuo akɛseɛ ammienu a  ɛwɔ Ghana ha no mu biara, mekyerɛ ɔsono amannyɔkuo New Patriotic Party  (NPP)  ne kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo National Democratic Congress  (NDC) mmienu no nyinaa atena so pɛn.

George Boakye  yɛ saa mpɛsoa no so mmarahyɛbedwanii. Ɛnam ɔsono amanyɔkuo"New patriotic party" (NPP) so na wɔn too aba yii no. Na ɔnyaa mma.no mu ahannsia ne aduonum mmiɛnsa (653)  Na ɛno na  ɛyɛ mma dodoɔ a ɛma no bɛyɛɛ mmarahyɛbedwanii. Ɔdii Eric Opoku a na ɔyɛ anamsini ma saa mpɛsoa no wɔ kwasafoman a ɛtɔ so nan wɔ berɛ a ɔnam kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo (NDC) "National Democratic Congress"  so dii nkunim.

title: Asutifi South (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Asutifi  South () abatoɔ mpesua no yɛ abatoɔ mpesua ahodoɔ nsia a ɛwɔ Ahafo mantan no mu baako. Nkane no na nka mansini no din ne Asutifi mansini ɛfiri afe apem aha nkron ne aduowɔtwe nwɔtwe (1988) mu de bɛsi afe mpem mmienu ne du-mmienu (2012), Ayɛwohomumu bosome no da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nwɔtwe (28) mu na abatoɔ kɔmisa tee Asutifi abatoɔ mpesua no anaafoɔ fam no firi Asutifi mansini no mu na ɛmaa ɛdin no sesa bɛyɛɛ Asutifi South abatoɔ mpesua so.  Asutifi  South abatoɔ mpesua no ahenkuro ne  Hwidiem.

Asutifi  South abatoɔ mpesua no yɛ abatoɔ mpesua a ɛwɔ ɔman Ghana mu, abatoɔ mpesua a ɛne Asutifi  South abatoɔ mpesua no bɔ hyeɛ bi ne Asutifi  North abatoɔ mpesua no. Asutifi  South abatoɔ mpesua no wɔ Ahafo mantan no mu a nkane no nka ɛwɔ Bono-Ahafo mantam no mu de bɛsi sɛ abatoɔ kɔmisa kyekyɛɛ mantam ahodoɔ mu bio na ɛmaa Asutifi  South abatoɔ mpesua no kɔdii Ahafo mantam.

Asutifi South yɛ mpɛsoa no baako a ɛwɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbedwam. Wɔyi mmarahyɛbedwanii baako a ne din wɔ abatoɔ nkrataa no so a ɔgyina hɔ ma saa mpɛsoa no. Asutifi anaafoɔ wɔ Asutifi mansini a ɛwɔ Ghana Ahafo mantam.

Ɛhyeɛ 
Akonnwa no wɔ Asutifi mansini mu a ɛwɔ Bono-Ahafo mantam wɔ Ghana. Abatoɔ mpesua ahodoɔ a ɛne Asutifi South abatoɔ mpesua no bɔ hyeɛ bi ne Asutifi North abatoɔ mpesua so, Asunafo North abatoɔ mpesua so ne Asunafo South abatoɔ mpesua so. Nkuro ahodoɔ nso a ɛbɛn Asutifi South ahenkro Hwidiem bi ne Goaso, Kukuom, Kenyasi ne nkaeɛ.

Mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ. 
Asutifi South abatoɔ mpesua so mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no akonnwa a Ghana amannyɔkuo akɛseɛ no nyinaa atena so pɛn. Afe apem aha nkron aduokron nsia (1996) abatoɔ mu no, Kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo National Democratic Congress de ananmusini a yɛfrɛ no owura Collins Dauda na ɛbɛgyinae, na abatoɔ no nyinaa baa awieɛ no, na owura Collins Dauda adi nkunim wɔ abatoɔ no mu, a ɔkɔgyinaa Asutifi South manfoɔ no anan mu wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam.

Wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne baako (2001) mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no abatoɔ mu no, Ghana amannyɔkuo akɛseɛ no nyinaa de ananmusifoɔ bae, NDC Kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo de owura Collins Dauda na ɛbɛgyinae, ɛna NPP Ɔsono amanyɔkuo nso de Awuraa Cecilia Djan Amoah na ɛbaeɛ. Abatoɔ no nyinaa baa awieɛ no, na NPP Ɔsono amanyɔkuo no ananmusini Awuraa Cecilia Djan Amoah adi nkunim agye Asutifi South mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no afiri NDC Kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo ananmusini owura Collins Dauda nsam, a na ɛyɛ berɛ a ɛdi kan koraa  NPP Ɔsono amanyɔkuo no adi Asutifi South mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no so nkunim.

Wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nan (2004) mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no abatoɔ mu no, Ghana amannyɔkuo  no nan na wɔde wɔn ananmusifoɔ bae, NDC Kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo de owura Collins Dauda na ɛbɛgyinae, ɛna NPP Ɔsono amanyɔkuo nso de owura Thomas Broni na ɛbaeɛ, people's National Convention nso de owura Nana Ababio Cosmos na ɛbae, ɛna Convention People's Party nso de owura Augustine Adu Adjei bɛgyinaeɛ. Abatoɔ no baa awieɛ no, na NDC Kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo no ananmusini owura Collins Dauda a wɔde no baeɛ no na adi nkunim wɔ Asutifi South abatoɔ mpesua no so mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no abatoɔ mu.

Abatoɔ. 
Mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan Ghana mmarahyɛbedwam abatoɔ: Asutifi South.

Ɛnam Philip Kofi Adjapong Amoah  wuo no nti, a na ɔyɛ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party anamsini a ɔgyina hɔ ma mmarahyɛbedwam nti, wɔtuu abatya na ɛrekɔso wɔ saa mpɛsoa no hyɛɛ ɔpɛpɔn bosome da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne baako no mu. Cecilia Djan Amoah, a na ɔyɛ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party a ɔbɛsii n'ananmu a na ɔsane yɛ ɔkunani ma ɔwufoɔ no dii aba noa ɔnyaa mma dodoɔ ahanum ne aduonum.

Asutifi anaafoɔ abatoɔ a wɔtuhyɛɛda, mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne baako (2001). 
Wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne baako (2001) mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no abatoɔ mu wɔ Asutifi South abatoɔ mpesua no so no, Ɔsono amannyɔkuo New patriotic party de Awuraa Cecilia Djan Amoah na ɛbaeɛ, abatoɔ no baa awieɛ no na wanya mma no mu Mpem nnwɔtwe,ahanu ne aduonu (8,220), a sɛ yɛde kɔ ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu a  Awuraa Cecilia Djan Amoah nyaa Ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduonum baako akyirepɔ nson (51.7%). Awuraa Cecilia Djan Amoah de mma no mu Mpem nnwɔtwe,ahanu ne aduonu (8,220) na ɛdii nkunim wɔ abatoɔ no mu.

Saa ara nso na Kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress ananmusini a wɔde no bae nso ne owura Collins Dauda. Abatoɔ no baa awieɛ no na wanya mma no mu Mpem nson, ahan nsia aduoson (7,670) a sɛ yɛde kɔ ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu mu a, owura Collins Dauda nyaa Ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduanan nwɔtwe ne akyirepɔ mmiɛnsa (48.3%). Owura Collins Daudade mma Mpem nson, ahan nsia aduoson (7,670) na ɛtɔɔ so mmienu.

title: Suaman (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Suaman () yɛ mpesua no mu baako a ɛwɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbedwam. Wɔyii mmarahyɛbedwani baako a ne din wɔ abatoɔ nkrataa no mu a ɔgyina hɔ ma saa mpesua no. Suaman wɔ Aowin/Suaman mansini a ɛwɔ atifi atɔeɛ mantam wɔ Ghana. Suaman abatoɔ mpesua no yɛ abatoɔ mpesua nkron a ɛwɔ Western North mantam no mu wɔ Ghana. Nkane no na wɔhyɛ Aowin/Suaman abatoɔ mpesua no mu. Yenyaa Suaman abatoɔ mpesua no wɔ ayɛwohomumɔ bosome no da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nwɔtwe wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du-mmienu(2012) abatoɔ mu. Suaman abatoɔ mpesua no ahenkron ne Dadieso.

Ɛhyeɛ 
Akonnwa no wɔ Aowin/Suaman mansini a ɛwɔ atifi atɔeɛ mantam wɔ Ghana. Wɔtee saa mpɛsoa yi wɔ berɛ a wɔrebɛto mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan ɔpɛnimaa Amanpaninfoɔ ne mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ a ɛfiri Aowin-Suaman mpɛsoa dada no akɔ Suaman ne Aowin mpɛsoa foforɔ no mu. Suaman mansin no ne ɔman Ivory Coast bɔ ɔhye wɔ atɔe fam.

Mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ 
Wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nan mu no, amannyɔkuo akɛseɛ mmienu a ɛwɔ Ghana ha nyinaa de wɔn ananmusini baeɛ. NDC kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo no de ananmusini a yɛfrɛ no Owura Stephen Michael Essuah Kofi Ackah na ɛbae, ɛna  NPP ɔsono amannyɔkuo no nso de Owura Prof Kojo Kwarteng na ɛbaeɛ. Abatoɔ no baa awieɛ no na NDC kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo no ananmusini a wɔde no bae no adi nkunim wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no abatoɔ mu.

Abatoɔ

Afe mpem mmienu ne nan mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa abatoɔ:Suaman 
wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nan Ghana mmarahyɛbedwam akonnwa abatoɔ mu wɔ suaman abatoɔ mpesua so no, NDC kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo no ananmusini  a yɛfrɛ no Owura Stephen Michael Essuah Kofi Ackah nyaa mma no mu Mpem nsia, ahankron ne aduasa baako (6,931) a sɛ yɛde kɔ ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu a ɛgyina hɔ ma Ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu aduonum nson ne akyire pɔ nnwɔtwe (57.8%). Owura Stephen Michael Essuah Kofi Ackah de mma Mpem nsia, ahankron ne aduasa baako (6,931) na ɛdii nkunim wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no abatoɔ mu wɔ Suaman abatoɔ mpesua so.

saa ara nso na NPP Ɔsono amannyɔkuo no de ananmusini a yɛfrɛ no  Owura Prof Kojo Kwarteng na ɛbɛsii wɔn anan mu. Abatoɔ no baa awieɛ no, na NPP Ɔsono amannyɔkuo no ananmusini no anya mma no mu Mpem num , ne aduosia mmiɛnsa (5,063) a sɛ yɛde kɔ ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu mu a, ɛgyina hɔ ma Ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu aduanan mmienu ne akyire pɔ mmienu (42.2%). Owura Prof Kojo Kwarteng de mma Mpem num , ne aduosia mmiɛnsa (5,063) na ɛtɔɔ so mmienu wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no abatoɔ mu wɔ Suaman abatoɔ mpesua so.

title: Sefwi-Akontombra(Ghana Parliament Constituency)
text:
Sefwi-Akontombra( yɛ mpɛsoa no mu baako a ɛwɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbedwam. Wɔyi mmarahyɛbedwanii baako a ne din wɔ abatoɔ nkrataa no so a ɔgyina hɔ ma saa mpɛsoa no. Sefwi-Akontombra wɔ Sefwi-Akontombra mansini a ɛwɔ atifi atɔeɛ mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana. Sefwi-Akontombra abatoɔ mpesua no yɛ abatoɔ mpesua nkron a ɛwɔ Western North mantam no mu wɔ Ghana. Nkane no na wɔhyɛ Sefwi-Wiawso abatoɔ mpesua no mu firi afe apem aha nkron aduowɔtwe nwɔtwe (1988) mu a wɔte firii Sefwi-Bibiani mansini no abatoɔ mpesua no mu de kɔ si sɛ wotee mansini no anaafoɔ fam firii mansini no mu maa yɛnyaa Sefwi-Akontombra abatoɔ mpesua no wɔ ogyefuo bosome no da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nkron wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nwɔtwe abatoɔ mu. Sefwi-Akontombra abatoɔ mpesua no ahenkron ne Akontombra.

Ɛhyeɛ. 
Akonnwa no wɔ Sefwi-Akontombra mansini wɔ atifi atɔeɛ mantam, a ɛka Ghana atɔeɛ mantam ho. Wɔtee saa mpɛsoa yi wɔ berɛ a wɔrebɛto mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan ɔpɛnimaa amanpaninfoɔ ne mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ aba wɔ berɛ a wɔrekyɛ ankane sefwi-wiawso mpɛsoa de akɔ seisei sefwi-Akontombra ne sefwi-wiawso mpɛsoa mu.

Mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ 
Sefwi-Akontombra aboatoɔ no mpesua no mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no, wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nan abatoɔ mu no, amannyɔkuo akɛseɛ mmienu a ɛwɔ ɔman Ghana mu no nyinaa ne wɔn ananmusifoɔ bɛgyinaa bi. NDC kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo no de owura Herod Cobbina na ɛbaeɛ, saa ara nso NPP ɔsono amannyɔkuo no nso de owura Baidoo Appiah Kubi na ɛbɛgyinaa wɔn anan mu wɔ Sefwi-Akontombra mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no abatoɔ mu. Abatoɔ no baa awieɛ wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nan mu no, na NDC kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo no ananmusini owura Herod Cobbina na adi nkunim wɔ afe no mu.

Abatoɔ. 
Mfeɛ mpem mmienu Ghana mmarahyɛbedwam abatoɔ:Essikado-Ketan

Wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nan abatoɔ mu no wɔ Sefwi-Akontombra aboatoɔ no mpesua no mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no mu no, kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo NDC ananmusini a wɔde no baeɛ ne owura  Herod Cobbina. Abatoɔ no baa awieɛ no ɔnyaa mma no mu Mpem dunan, ahanan ne aduoson nson (14,477), a sɛ yɛde kɔ ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu a, owura  Herod Cobbina nyaa mma no mu Ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu aduonum nkron (59%).  Owura  Herod Cobbina de mma  Mpem dunan, ahanan ne aduoson nson (14,477) a ɔnyaeɛ no na ɛdii nkunim wɔ Sefwi-Akontombra aboatoɔ no mpesua no mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no abatoɔ mu.

Saa ara nso na, wɔ afe korɔ no ara abatoɔ mu no wɔ Sefwi-Akontombra aboatoɔ no mpesua no mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no mu no, ɔsono amannyɔkuo NPP ananmusini a wɔde ne baeɛ no owura  Baidoo Appiah Kubi. Abatoɔ no baa awieɛ no ɔnyaa mma no mu Mpem du, ne aduosia (10,060), a sɛ yɛde kɔ ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu a, owura  Baidoo Appiah Kubi nyaa mma no mu Ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduanan baako (41%).  Owura  Baidoo Appiah Kubi de mma  Mpem du, ne aduosia (10,060) a ɔnyaeɛ no na ɛtɔɔ so mmienu wɔ Sefwi-Akontombra aboatoɔ no mpesua no mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no abatoɔ mu.

title: Sefwi-wiawso (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Sefwi-Wiawso( yɛ mmarahyɛbedwam mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Ghana atifi atɔeɛ mantam. Mmarahyɛbedwanii a ɔda saa mpɛsoa no ano ne Kwaku Afriyie, a ɔnam ɔsono amanyɔkuo"New patriotic party" so too no so aba wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia abatoɔ nom. Sefwi-Wiawso abatoɔ mpesua no yɛ abatoɔ mpesua nkron a ɛwɔ Western North mantam no mu wɔ Ghana. Nkane no na wɔhyɛ Sefwi-Wiawso abatoɔ mpesua no mu firi afe apem aha nkron aduowɔtwe nwɔtwe (1988) mu a wɔte firii Sefwi-Akontombra abatoɔ mpesua no mu de kɔ si sɛ wotee mansini no anaafoɔ fam firii mansini no mu maa yɛnyaa Sefwi-Wiawso abatoɔ mpesua no wɔ ogyefuo bosome no da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nkron wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nwɔtwe abatoɔ mu. Sefwi-Wiawso abatoɔ mpesua no ahenkron ne Wiawso.

Mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ 
Sefwi-Wiawso abatoɔ mpesua no mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no anya mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ ahodoɔ nson na watena akonnwa no so. wɔ Afe apem ahankron ne aduonum nsia (1956) abatoɔ mu no, "Convention peope's party" ananmusini a wɔde no baeɛ ne Owura William Kwabena Aduhene, abatoɔ no baa awieɛ no, na CPP amannyɔkuo a wɔn ahyɛnsodeɛ ne Akokɔ no adi nkunim wɔ Sefwi-Wiawso abatoɔ mpesua no mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no abatoɔ no mu. Owura William Kwabena Aduhene tenaa Sefwi-Wiawso abatoɔ mpesua no mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no so firi afe apem ahankron ne aduonum nsia de kɔpem Afe apem ahankron ne aduosia num (1956-1965) ansa na ɔrefiri akonnwa n so.

Amannyɔkuo a ɛbɛyii CPP amannyɔkuo a wɔn ahyɛnsodeɛ ne Akokɔ no ananmusini firii Sefwi-Wiawso abatoɔ mpesua no mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no so ne "Peope's party".  wɔ Afe apem ahankron ne aduosia nkron (1969) abatoɔ mu no, Peope's party ananmusini a wɔde no baeɛ ne Owura Sebastian Kwaku Opon, abatoɔ no baa awieɛ no, na Peope's party ananmusini no adi nkunim wɔ Sefwi-Wiawso abatoɔ mpesua no mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no abatoɔ no mu. Owura Sebastian Kwaku Opon, tenaa Sefwi-Wiawso abatoɔ mpesua no mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no so firi afe apem ahankron ne aduosia nkron de kɔpem Afe apem ahankron ne aduoson mmienu (1969-1972) ansa na ɔrefiri akonnwa n so.

Amannyɔkuo a yɛfrɛ no "Progressive peope's party" na ɛbɛyii "Peope's party" no ananmusini no firii Sefwi-Wiawso abatoɔ mpesua no mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no so.  wɔ Afe apem ahankron ne aduoson nkron (1979) abatoɔ mu no, Progressive Peope's party ananmusini a wɔde no baeɛ ne Owura Isaac K Fuakye, abatoɔ no baa awieɛ no, na Progressive Peope's party ananmusini no adi nkunim wɔ Sefwi-Wiawso abatoɔ mpesua no mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no abatoɔ no mu. Owura Isaac K Fuakye, tenaa Sefwi-Wiawso abatoɔ mpesua no mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no so firi afe apem ahankron ne aduoson nkron de kɔpem afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe baako (1979-1981) ansa na ɔrefiri akonnwa n so.

Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron mmienu (1992) abatoɔ mu no, Kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo "National Democratic Congress" na ɛbɛyii "Peope's party" no ananmusini no firii Sefwi-Wiawso abatoɔ mpesua no mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no so.   Kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo "National Democratic Congress" ananmusini a wɔde no baeɛ ne Owura John Kwaku Danso, abatoɔ no baa awieɛ no, na  Kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo "National Democratic Congress" ananmusini no adi nkunim wɔ Sefwi-Wiawso abatoɔ mpesua no mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no abatoɔ no mu. Owura John Kwaku Danso, tenaa Sefwi-Wiawso abatoɔ mpesua no mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no so firi Afe apem ahankron ne aduokron mmienu de kɔpem afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia (1992-1996) ansa na ɔrefiri akonnwa n so.

Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia (1996) abatoɔ mu no, Kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo "National Democratic Congress" sesaa wɔn ananmusini a wɔde no baa afe apem ahankron ne aduokron mmienu (1992) abatoɔ mu no. Ananmusini a Kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo "National Democratic Congress" de no bɛgyinaa Sefwi-Wiawso abatoɔ mpesua no mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no abatoɔ mu no ne Owura Isaac Kobina Nyame-Ofori. Abatoɔ no baa awieɛ no, na  Kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress ananmusini no adi nkunim wɔ Sefwi-Wiawso abatoɔ mpesua no mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no abatoɔ no mu. Owura Isaac Kobina Nyame-Ofori, tenaa Sefwi-Wiawso abatoɔ mpesua no mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no so firi Afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia de kɔpem mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan (1996-2004) ansa na ɔrefiri akonnwa n so.

Wɔ afe Mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan (2004) abatoɔ mu no, Kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress sane yɛɛ nsesaeɛ bio wɔ wɔn ananmusini a wɔde no baa afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia (1996) abatoɔ mu no. Ananmusini a Kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo "National Democratic Congress" de no bɛgyinaa Sefwi-Wiawso abatoɔ mpesua no mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no abatoɔ mu no ne Owura Paul Evans Aidoo. Abatoɔ no baa awieɛ no, na  Kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress ananmusini no adi nkunim wɔ Sefwi-Wiawso abatoɔ mpesua no mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no abatoɔ no mu. Owura Paul Evans Aidoo, tenaa Sefwi-Wiawso abatoɔ mpesua no mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no so firi Mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan de kɔpem mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia (2004-2016) ansa na ɔrefiri akonnwa n so.

Afe a NPP Ɔsono amannyɔkuo no tumi tenaa Sefwi-Wiawso abatoɔ mpesua no mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no so ne afe mpem mmienu ne du nsia abatoɔ mu (2016). Wɔ saa afe yi abatoɔ mu no, NPP Ɔsono amannyɔkuo de ananmusini a yɛfrɛ no Owura Kwaku Afriyie na ɛbɛgyinaeɛ. Abatoɔ no baa awieɛ no na ɔsono amannyɔkuo NPP ananmusini Owura Kwaku Afriyie adi nkunim berɛ a ɛdi kan koraa wɔ Sefwi-Wiawso abatoɔ mpesua no mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no abatoɔ no mu.

title: Abura-Asebu-Kwamankese (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Abura-Asebu- Kwamankese () yɛ mpɛsua  wɔ Ghana mmrahyɛbadwafie. Owura Elvis Morris Donkoh ne mmarahyɛbadwani ma Abura-Asebu-Kwamankese)mpasua no mprenpren. Ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party (NPP) amanyɔkuo no muni na ɔde mma mpem aduonu mmienu, ahanu ne aduanan num  (22,245) na edii nkunim wɔ abatoɔ no mu bɛyɛɛ mmarahyɛbadwani. Okodii Anthony Christian Dadzie a na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma mpasua no wɔ Adehyeman A Ɛtɔ So Nnan no mu adeɛ. Na ɔyɛ National Democratic Congress (NDC) amanyɔkuo no muni.

title: Aowin (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Mathias Kwame Ntow ne mmarahyɛbadwani ma Aowin (mpɛsoa no. Wɔyii no sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ bere a kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo ( NDC ) no de mma mpem mmieɛnsa aha nwɔtwe ne aduokron nwɔtwe( 3898) dii nkunim no. Owura Mathias Kwame Ntow bɛgyee Aowin abatoɔ no mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no firii NPP Ɔsono amanyɔkuo no ananmusini a yɛfrɛ no Samuel Adu Gyamfi a ɔno na na ɔte akonnwa no so saa mmerɛ no nsam maa kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo NDC wɔ mpasua no so kɔsii Aowin manfoɔ no  anan mu wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam.

Aowin mpɛsoa no mansini ne Aowin/Suaman mansini a ɛwɔ atɔeɛ atififam mantam mu wɔ Gaana.  Amanyɔkuo a ɛte so seisie wɔ Aowin mpɛsoa no so ne kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo NDC a Owura Mattias Kwame Ntow  ne wɔn mmarahyɛbadwani.  Aowin abatoɔ mpesua no yɛ abatoɔ mpesua nkron a ɛwɔ Western North mantam no mu wɔ Ghana. Nkane no na wɔfrɛ wɔn  Aowin/Suaman abatoɔ mpesua so firi afe apem aha nkron aduowɔtwe nwɔtwe (1988) mu a wɔnyaa wɔn abatoɔ mpesua no firii Aowin-Amenfi abatoɔ mpesua no mu de kɔsi sɛ wɔtee mansini no atifi-atɔeɛ fam firii mansini no mu maa yɛnyaa Aowin abatoɔ mpesua no wɔ ayɛwohomumɔ bosome no da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nwɔtwe (28) wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du-mmienu (2012) abatoɔ mu. Aowin abatoɔ mpesua no ahenkron ne Enchi.

title: Kade (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Kade () abatoɔ mpɛsoa no wɔ Ghana Apueɛ Mantam. Kwabena Ohemeng-Tinyase na ɔyɛ mpɛsoa no so mmarahyɛbadwamni. Wɔtoo aba maa no sɛ Ɔman-ho-dɔ Amanyɔkuoni (NPP) wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne dunsia abatoɔ no mu.

Ɔbɛdii Ofosu Asamoah a ɔnyaa mma mpem du-baako, ɔhawɔtwe ne aduonum mmienu kyɛne deɛ ɔne no sii akan no maa no dii mpɛsoa no abatoɔ no so nkonim bɛyɛɛ mmarahyɛbadwamni wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du-mmienu no adeɛ.

text:

title: Bia East (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Bia East () yɛ mpɛsoa baako a ɛwɔ Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam. Ɛyii mmrahyɛbadwani baako bere a sɛ yɛto aba a neɛ ɔnya mma bebere no na adi nkunim no ne mu. Bia East mpɛsoa no wɔ Bia East mansin no mu wɔ atɔeɛ atififam mantam wɔ Ghana. Amanyɔkuo a ɛte so siesie wɔ Bia East ne kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo ( NDC ) a Owura Richard Acheampong ne wɔn mmrahyɛbadwani.

Bia East abatoɔ mpesua no yɛ abatoɔ mpesua nkron a ɛwɔ Western North mantam no mu wɔ Ghana. Nkane no na wɔfrɛ abatoɔ mpesua no Bia mansini abatoɔ mpesua so, kɔsi sɛ wɔtee mansini no apuiɛ fam Bia mansini no mu maa yɛnyaa Bia East abatoɔ mpesua no wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du-mmienu abatoɔ mu. Bia East abatoɔ mpesua no ahenkron ne Sefwi Adabokrom.  wɔ tee  Bia mansini no abatoɔ mpesua no firii Sefwi-Bibiani mansini no abatoɔ mpesua no mu wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nan abatoɔ no mu.

Mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ 
Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du-nsia (2016) mu abatoɔ mu no, NDC kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo no de ananmusini a yɛfrɛ no owura Richard Acheampong na ɛbɛgyinaeɛ yɛnto ne so aba ma ɔmmɛyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani mma Bia East abatoɔ mpesua no so. Abatoɔ no baa awieɛ no na owura Richard Acheampong a ɔgyina maa  amannyɔkuo NDC a wɔn ahyɛnsodeɛ ne kyiniiɛ  no na ɔdii nkunim, kɔhyɛɛ ɔmamfoɔ a wɔwɔ Bia East abatoɔ mpesua no so anan mu wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam.

Ɛhyeɛ 
Abatoɔ mpesua ahodoɔ a wɔne Bia East mansini no abatoɔ mpesua no bɔ hyeɛ bi ne Dormaa mansini no a wɔbɔ hyeɛ wɔ apuiɛ fam, ɛna ɔne Asunafo North abatoɔ mpesua no nso bɔ hyeɛ wɔ atifi fam, Juaboso abatoɔ mpesua no nso wɔ Bia East abatoɔ mpesua no anaafoɔ fam, ɛna Bia West mansini no abatoɔ mpesua no nso ne no bɔ hyeɛ wɔ n'atɔeɛ fam.

title: Kintampo North (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Kintampo North()  mpasua no ka mpasua a wɔn ananmusini wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwafie no ho.Wɔ abatoɔ berɛ biara mu no, woyi ananmusini baako ma no gyina mpasua no ananmu wɔ mmarahyɛbadwafie.Kintampo North mpasua no wɔ Kintampo Mansini a ɛwɔ Bono Atifi fam Mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana.

Ɛhyeɛ
Mpasua no hyeɛ ahodoɔ nyinaa wɔ Kintampo Mansini a ɛwɔ Bono Atifi Mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana.

Abatoɔ
Stephen Kunsu na na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbedwanii ma saa mpɛsoa no wɔ berɛ a wɔtoo afe 2008 abatoɔ no.. Ɛnam kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress so na wɔtoo no so aba ma no nyaa mma mpem nan, ahasa ne aduoson mmiɛnsa de dii nkunim de bɛyɛɛ mmarahyɛbedwanii. Ɔsane nso gyinaa hɔ maa saa mpɛsoa no wɔ kwasafoman a ɛtɔ so nan no mu.

Wɔ afe 2020 abatoɔ no mu no,Michael Sarkodie Baffoe  a ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuo no muni no  nyaa mma no mu ɔha mu nkyekyem eduonu-nnum ne ekyiripɔ nnum(25.5). Joseph Kwame Kumah a ɔyɛ National Democratic Congress amanyɔkuo no muni no nso nyaa mma no mu ɔha mu nkyekyemu eduoson nnan ne ekyiripɔ nnan(74.4). Joseph Kwame Kumah na edii nkunim wɔ abatoɔ no mu.

Firi berɛ a wofirii aseɛ too aba wɔ mpasua no so no, National Democratic Congress amanyɔkuo no nko ara na adi nkunim wɔ abatoɔ biara a wɔato wɔ mpasua no so no mu.

title: Bodi (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Bodi() ka mpɛsua a ɛwɔ mmarahyɛbadwam no ho bi. Ɛde First past the post abatoɔ na ɛyii Mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔdi kan. Bodi mpɛsua no wɔ Bodi mansini no mu wɔ atɔeɛ atififam mantam mu wɔ Ghana Mpɛsua no so mmarahyɛbadwani da so ara yɛ Sampson Ayi a wadi mpɛsua no so fiti mmerɛ a wɔtee Bodi abatoɔ mpɛsua no.Kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo ( NDC ) no na ɛte so siesie wɔ mpɛsoa no so a Owura Sampson Ahi ne wɔn mmrahyɛbadwani.

Bodi abatoɔ mpesua no yɛ abatoɔ mpesua nkron a ɛwɔ Western North mantam no mu wɔ Ghana. Nkane no na wɔhyɛ Juaboso-Bodi abatoɔ mpesua no mu firi ɔsanaa bosome no mu wɔ mfie mpem mmienu ne nan abatoɔ mu a wɔte firii  Bodi mansini no abatoɔ mpesua no mu de kɔ si sɛ wotee mansini no anaafoɔ-apuiɛ fam firii Bodi mansini no mu maa yɛnyaa Bodi abatoɔ mpesua no wɔ Ayɛwohomumɔ bosome no da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nwɔtwe wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du-mmienu abatoɔ mu. Bodi abatoɔ mpesua no ahenkron ne Bodi.

Mmrahyɛbadwafoɔ 
Wɔ mfie mpem mmienu ne du-nsia (2016) abatoɔ mu no, NDC kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo no anamusini a wɔde no bɛgyinaeɛ ne Sampson Ahi. Abatoɔ no baa awieɛ no na Owura Sampson Ahi na adi nkunim wɔ Bodi abatoɔ mpesua no mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no abatoɔ no mu, a mprɛmprɛn yi ɔno ara na ɔda so yɛ wɔn mmarahyɛbadwani.
