title: Adaklu (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Adaklu() ka mpasua a wɔn ananmusini wɔ Ghana Mmarahyɛbadwam no ho.Ɛde 'first past the post' abatoɔ nhyehyeɛ no na eyi mmarahyɛbadwani baako. Adaklu  mpasua no wɔ Adaklu mansini a ɛwɔ Firaw Mantam wɔ Ghana. Ghana Abatoɔ Kuo no tee mpasua yi wɔ afe 2012 abatoɔ mmerɛ no mu.

Mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ 

Wɔtoo aba a edi kan wɔ mpasua no so wɔ Ɔpɛnimma bosome no mu wɔ afe 2012. National Democratic Congress amanyɔkuo no muni Kwame Agbodza na edii nkunim wɔ saa abatoɔ no mu. Onyaa mma no mu mpem du, ahankron ne aduonu nkron (10,929).  Ɔsan dii nkunim wɔ afe 2016 abatoɔ no mu.

Abatoɔ

Mpem mmienu ne aduonu (2020) Ghanaman nyinaa abatoɔ: Adaklu.
Kwame Governs Agbodza na na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma Kyinie amanyɔkuo (NDC) no. Ɔnyaa mma mpem dummiɛnsa ɔha ne dunson (13,117) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduowɔtwe num akyiri pɔ aduonum num (85.55%).

Raybon Evans Anyadi na na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma Ɔsono amanyɔkuo (NPP) no. Ɔnyaa mma mpem mmienu ahanu ne dunum (2,215) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu dunan akyiri pɔ aduanan num (14.45%).

Edward Agbovi a na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma Liberal Party of Ghana no annya amma no biara.

Mma dodoɔ: Mpem du ahankron ne mmienu (10,902) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduoson baako akyiri pɔ du (71.10%).

Nimpa dodoɔ a wɔtoo aba no: Mpem dunum ahasa ne aduasa mmienu (15,332) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduoson nwɔtwe akyiri pɔ aduowɔtwe mmiɛnsa (78.83%).

Nimpa dodoɔ a wɔtwerɛ wɔn din: Mem dunkron ahanan ne aduanan nwɔtwe (19,448).

Mpem mmienu ne dunsia (2016) Ghanaman nyinaa abatoɔ: Adaklu.

Kwame Governs Agbodza na na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma Kyinie amanyɔkuo (NDC) no.  Ɔnyaa mma mpem du ahasa ne aduasa nson (10.337) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduowɔtwe nwɔtwe akyiri pɔ aduokron nsia (88.96%).

Samuel C.K. Buame a na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma Akokɔ amanyɔkuo (CPP) no nso nyaa mma apem ne aduanan nwɔtwe (1,048) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu nkron akyiri pɔ ohunu mmienu (9.02%).

Hiagbe Edem Dzanku a na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma NDP amanyɔkuo no nso nyaa mma ahanu ne aduasa num (235) a sɛ wode kɔ ɔha nkyekyɛmu a agyina hɔ ma mmienu akyiri pɔ ohunu mmienu (2.02%).

Mma dodoɔ: Mpem nkron ahanu ne aduowɔtwe nkron (9,289) a sɛ wode kɔ ɔha nkyekyɛmu a agyina hɔ ma aduoson nkron akyiri pɔ aduokron nan (79.94%).

Nimpa dodoɔ a wɔtoo aba no: Mpem dubaako ahansia ne aduonu (11,620).

Mpem mmienu ne dummienu (2012) Ghana mmarahyɛbadwam abatoɔ: Adaklu.

Kwame Governs Agbodza a na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma Kyinie amanyɔkuo no nso nyaa mma mpem dubaako ahanwɔtwe ne aduonu num (11,825) a sɛ wode kɔ ɔha nkyekyɛmu a agyina hɔ ma aduowɔtwe nson akyiri pɔ aduokron nwɔtwe (87.98%).

Justice Jowawa Aklamanu a na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma Ɔsono amanyɔkuo (NPP) no wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne dummienu mmarahyɛbadwam abatoɔ no, ɔnyaa mma ahanwɔtwe ne aduokron nsia (896) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu nsia akyiri pɔ aduosia nson (6.67%).

Hiagbe Edem Dzanku na na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma NDP amanyɔkuo no, ɔnyaa mma ahanson ne dunkron (719) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu num akyiri pɔ aduasa num (5.35%).

Mma dodoɔ: Mpem du ahankron ne aduonu nkron (10,929) a sɛ wode kɔ ɔha nkyekyɛmu a agyina hɔ ma aduowɔtwe baako akyiri pɔ aduasa baako (81.31%).

Nimpa dodoɔ a wɔtoo aba no: Mpem dummiɛnsa ahanan ne aduanan (3,440).

title: Atebubu-Amantin (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Atebubu-Amantin()  mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Atebubu-Amantin mansini a na ɛyɛ Atebubu mansini wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne mmiɛnsa nom. "Legislature instrument L1 1770" na ɛtee Atebubu-Amantin mpɛsoa no. Wobɛhunu mpɛsoa no wɔ Bono apueɛ mantam, a na ɛka Bono-Ahafo mantam Ghana.

Mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ 
Emmanuel Owusu-Mainu na na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbedwanii ma saa mpɛsoa no aberɛ a ɔtee mpɛsoa no wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne mmiɛnsa mu wieeɛ no. Wɔtoo no so aba yii no mprenu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan ne mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ nom. Na ɛnam kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress so. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ no ɔdii nkunim a ɔnyaa mma mpem ahaasa,ɔha mmiɛnsa ne aduokron num a ɛyɛ mma dodoɔ. Ɛnam saa nti ɔgyinaa hɔ maa mpɛsoa no sɛ mmarahyɛbedwanii wɔ mmarahyɛbedwa a ɛtɔ so nan ne num wɔ kwasafoman a ɛtɔ so nan wɔ Ghana. Sanja Nanja a na ɔwɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress dii Emmanuel Owusu-Mainu n'adeɛ wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu mmarahyɛbedwam abatoɔ berɛ wɔsɛe mmarahyɛbedwa a ɛtɔ so num wɔ kwasafoman a ɛtɔ so nan wɔ Ghana. Ɔsane nso gyinaa hɔ maa mpɛsoa no sɛ mmarahyɛbedwanii wɔ mmarahyɛbedwafie a ɛtɔ so nsia wɔ kwasafoman a ɛtɔ so nan wɔ Ghana nom. Ɛno akyire na ɔgyinaa hɔ maa Atebubu-Amantin mpɛsoa sɛ mmarahyɛbedwanii wɔ mmarahyɛbedwafie a ɛtɔ nson wɔ kwasafoman a ɛtɔ so nan wɔ Ghana.

Kwadwo Adae a na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma Kyinie amanyɔkuo (NDC) no wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne nwɔtwe (2008) mmarahyɛbadwam abatoɔ no, ɔnyaa mma apem nan ahanan ne aduonum nsia (4,456) a agyina hɔ de ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu dunwɔtwe akyiri pɔ nson (18.7%).

George Asiamah a na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma CPP amanyɔkuo no wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne nwɔtwe (2008) mmarahyɛbadwam abatoɔ no nso nyaa mma ahasa ne dunsia (316) a agyina hɔ de ma ɔha a nkyekyɛmu baako akyiri pɔ mmiɛnsa (1.3%).

Lovia Berkoh a na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma PNC amanyɔkuo no wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne nwɔtwe (2008) mmarahyɛbadwam abatoɔ no nyaa mma ɔha ne aduosia nwɔtwe (168) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu ohunu akyiri pɔ nson (0.7%).

Mma dodoɔ: Apem dunsia ahanan ne mmiɛnsa (16,403) a wode kɔ ɔha nkyekyɛmu a agyina hɔ de ma aduosia akyiri pɔ num (60.5%).

title: Kumawu (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Kumawu() yɛ mpɛsoa baako a ɛwɔ mmrahyɛbɛdwam fie wɔ Ghana. Wɔ yi anamusini sɛ ɔkɔ si wɔn anan sɛ mmrahyɛbɛdwamni berɛ a wɔ tɔ aba ɛdi kan wɔ mpɛsoa no mu.

Kumawu wɔ sekyere Afram plain mansin a ɛwɔ Asante Mantam wɔ Ghana.

Ɛhyeɛ. 
Akonwa no wɔ sekyere Afram Plain mansin a ɛwɔ Asante Mantam ɛwɔ Ghana.

Mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ 
Ɛwɔ afe mpem mmeinu ne du-nsia (2016) abatoɔ no mu philip Basoah a ɔfiri ɔsono amanyɔkuo (NPP) na ɔnya adwa no.

Ɛwɔ afe mpem mmeinu ne du-mmienu (2012) abatoɔ no mu no Philip Basoah a ɔfiri ɔsono amanyɔkuo(NPP) na ɔnya adwa no.

Ɛwɔ afe mpem mmeinu ne nnwɔtwe (2008) abatoɔ  no mu no Yaw Baah a ɔfiri ɔsono amanyɔkuo (NPP) no mu na ɔnya adwa no.

Ɛwɔ afe mpem mmeinu ne nan (2004) abatoɔ no mu Yaw Baah a ɔsane  firi ɔsono amanyɔkuo(NPP) no mu na ɔnya adwa no.

Ɛwɔ afe mpem mmeinu (2000) no mu no Reo Addai Basoah a ɔfiri ɔsono amanyɔkuo (NPP) no mu na ɔnya adwa no na noa nso na ɔtena akongua no so afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia (1996).

Abatoɔ

Ɛwɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du-sia (2016) wɔ Ghana mmrahyɛbɛdwafoɔ abatoɔ wɔ kumawu no. 
Philip Basoah a ɔgyina ma Osono amayɔkuo (NPP) no nya mma mpem aduonu-baako ahanson ne aduokron nan (21,794) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha aduoson nnwɔtwe akyiri pɔ du nson (78.17%).

Emmanuel William Amoako a ɔno nso firi kyineɛ amayɔkuo (NDC) no nso nya mma mpem num ahannwɔtwe ne aduokron nkron (5,899) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu  aduonu bako akyiri pɔ du-nsia (21.16%).

Opoku kyei Clliford a ɔfiri akɔko amayɔkuo (CPP) nso nya mma ɔha ne aduowɔtwe nnwɔtwe (188) a agyina hɔ ma hwii akyiri pɔ aduosia nson (0.67%).

Mmrahyɛbɛdwafoɔ abatoɔ wɔ kumawu wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du mmienu (2012) mu no. 
Philip Basoah a ɔgyina ma Osono amayɔkuo (NPP) no nya mma mpem dunnwɔtwe ahanwɔtwe ne aduonum nnwɔtwe (18,858) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduosia nnwɔtwe akyiri pɔ aduokron nsia (68.96%).

Asiamah Samuel nso a ɔgyina ma kyineɛ amayɔkuo (NDC) no nso nya mma mpem nan  ɔha ne aduonan mmienu (4,142) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu dunum akyiri pɔ dunum (15.15%).

Dominic Oteng a ɔgyina ma IND amayɔkuo no nso nya mma mpem mmiensa ahankron ne aduokron baako (3,991) a sɛ wode kɔ ɔha nkyekyɛmu a agyina hɔ ma du-nan akyiri pɔ aduonum nkron (14.59%)

Collins Kumi Boateng a ɔgyina ma PPP amayɔkuo no nso nya mma ahasa ne bako (301) a sɛ wode kɔ ɔha nkyekyɛmu a agyina hɔ ma baako akyiri pɔ du (1.10%).

Asante Issac a ɔgyina ma PNC amayɔkuo no nya mma aduonum mmiensa (53) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu hwii akyiri pɔ du-nkron (0.19%)

Yaw Opoku Mensa a ɔgyina ma NDP ne John Agyemang Badu a ɔgyina ma PPP no anya hwee.

Mmrahyɛbɛdwafie abatoɔ wɔ kumawu wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe (2008) mu no. 
Yaw Baah a ɔgyina mu ma Ɔsono amayɔkuo (NPP) no nya ɛmma mpem dunum ahanu ne dunson (15,217) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduonum nsia  akyiri pɔ aduosia nwɔtwe (56.68%).

Dominic Oteng nso a ɔgyina hɔ ma IND amayɔkuo nso nya mma mpem nson ɔha ne aduonu (7,120) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduonu nsia akyiri pɔ aduasa nnwɔtwe (26.38%)

Ohene Akwasi Agyemang a ɔgyina ma Kyinie  amanyɔkuo (NDC) no nso nya mma mpem nan ahanu ne aduoson nnwɔtwe (4,278) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu dunum akyiri pɔ aduowɔtwe num (15.85%).

Kofi Adu Poku a ɔgyina ma CPP amanyɔkuo no nya mma ɔha ne aduokron nkron (199) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu hwi akyiri pɔ aduoson nan (0.74%).

Yaw Opoku Mensa a ɔgyina ma DFP amanyɔkuo no nya mma ɔha aduoson nan (174) a agyina hɔ ma hwi akyiri pɔ aduosia nan (0.64%).

Ɛwɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nan (2004) abatoɔ wɔ kumawu no. 
Yaw Baah a ɔgyina ma Osono amayɔkuo (NPP) no nyaa mma mpem dunkron ahanu ne aduonu mmiɛnsa (19,223) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduoson akyiri pɔ ohunu (70.0%).

George Amankwaa a na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma Kyinie amanyɔkuo (NDC) no nyaa mma mpem num ahansia ne aduowɔtwe (5,680) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduonu akyiri pɔ aduoson (20.70%).

Kofi Adu Poku a na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma Akokɔ amanyɔkuo (CPP) no nyaa mma apem ahanwɔtwe ne aduasa baako (1,831) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu nsia akyiri pɔ aduoson (6.70%).

Patrick Osei Aboagye a na ogyina mu ma IND amanyɔkuo no nyaa mma ahanum ne aduonum nsia (556) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu mmienu akyiri pɔ ohunu (2.0%).

Yaw Opoku Mensah a na ogyina mu de ma GCPP amanyɔkuo no nyaa mma ɔha ne aduowɔtwe nson (187) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu ohunu akyiri pɔ aduoson (0.70%).

Mfe mpem mmienu (2000) Ghanaman mmarahyɛbadwam abatoɔ: Kumawu

Reo Addai Basoah a na ogyina mu de ma Ɔsono amanyɔkuo (NPP) no wɔ mfe mpem mmienu (2000) mmarahyɛbadwam abatoɔ no ɔnyaa mma mpem dummiɛnsa ahanum ne aduonum nan (13,554) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduonum nson akyiri pɔ aduowɔtwe (57.80%).

Opanin Kwame Adu a na ogyina mu de ma Kyinie amanyɔkuo (NDC) no wɔ mfe mpem mmienu (2000) mmarahyɛbadwam abatoɔ no, ɔnyaa mma mpem nsia ne aduonum nson (6,057) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduonu num akyiri pɔ aduowɔtwe (25.80%).

Kingsford O. Boateng a na ogyina mu de ma IND amanyɔkuo no wɔ mfe mpem mmienu (2000) mmarahyɛbadwam abatoɔ no, ɔnyaa mma mpem mmiɛnsa ɔha ne aduonu nkron (3,129) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu dummiɛnsa akyiri pɔ aduanan (13.40%).

Bannor B. Augustine a na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma NRP amanyɔkuo no wɔ mfe mpem mmienu (2000) mmarahyɛbadwam abatoɔ no, ɔnyaa mma ahanu ne aduoson mmiɛnsa (273)a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu baako akyiri pɔ aduonu (1.20%)

Okra Frimpong a an ɔyɛ anamsini de ma CPP amanyɔkuo no wɔ mfe mpem mmienu (2000) mmarahyɛbadwam abatoɔ no, ɔnyaa mma ɔha ne aduowɔtwe nsia (186) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu ohunu akyiri pɔ aduowɔtwe (0.80%).

James Yaw Owusu a na ogyina mu ma PNC amanyɔkuo no wɔ mfe mpem mmienu (2000) mmarahyɛbadwam abatoɔ no so nyaa mma ɔha ne aduasa nwɔtwe (138) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu ohunu akyiri pɔ aduosia (0.60%).

Osei Bonsu Thompson a na ogyina mu de ma UGM amanyɔkuo no wɔ mfe mpem mmienu (2000) mmarahyɛbadwam abatoɔ no, ɔnyaa mma ɔha (100) a na agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu ohunu akyiri pɔ aduanan (0.40%).

Mfe mpem dunkron ne aduokron nsia (1996) Ghanaman mmarahyɛbadwam abatoɔ: Kumawu

Jargisu Ibrahim a na ogyina mu ma Kyinie amanyɔkuo (NDC) no nyaa mma mpem nkron ahasa ne aduonum nan (9,354) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduasa akyiri pɔ aduokron (30.90%)

Ernest Boakye Yiadom a na ogyina mu de ma PNC amanyɔkuo no nyaa mma ahanum ne aduasa mmienu (532) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu baako akyiri aduowɔtwe (1.80%).

title: Afadjato South (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Afadjato South () yɛ mpɛsuasoɔ no mu baako a ɛwɔ Ghana Mmarahyɛbadwam fie. Wɔtoo aba yi anamsini baako sɛ ɔkɔ si wɔn anan wɔ Mmarahyɛbadwam a odii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ no mu. Afadjato South wɔ Afadzato mansini no mu wɔ Volta Mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana. Ghana Aban Kɔmisan na ɔtee mpɛsua no wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne dummienu (2012) no mu ɛnam Ghanaman nyina abatoɔ no.

Afadjato South mpɛsua a ɛwɔ Ghana Mmarahyɛbadwam

Angela Alonwu-Tay na ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani de ma Kyinie Amanyɔkuo (NDC) no wɔ Afadzato South Mansini no mu wɔ Volta Mantam wɔ Ghana.

Ɛhyeɛ 
Mpɛsua no wɔ Afadzato South Mansini a ɛwɔ Volta Mantam wɔ Ghana.

Mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ 

Wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne dummienu (2012) abatoɔ no Joseph Zaphanat Amenowode na na ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani de ma Kyinie Amanyɔkuo (NDC) no.

Mfe mpem mmienu ne dunsia (2016) abatoɔ no Angela Alorwu-Tay na na ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani de ma Kyinie Amanyɔkuo (NPP) no.

Ɔpɛnimma bosom no mu wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne dummienu (December 2012)mu na wɔtoo aba a na adi mu wɔ Ghanaman nyinaa abatoɔ no mu. Kyinie Amanyɔkuo (NDC) no anamsini na odii nkonim a onyaa mma mpem dunwɔtwe ɔha mmienu ne aduanan num (18,245). Kyinie Amanyɔkuo (NDC) no ɛsan nyaa akonnwa no so tenaa bio wɔ mfe mpem aduonu ne dunsia (2016) Ghanaman nyina abatoɔ no mu.

Abatoɔ 
Mfe mpem mmienu ne aduonu (2020) Ghanaman nyinaa abatoɔ: Afadjato South

Kyinie Amanyɔkuo (NDC) no anamsini Anagela Alorwu-Tay wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam no nyaa mma mpem dukron ahanum ne aduoson nson (19,577) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduoson baako akyiri pɔ aduowɔtwe mmiɛnsa (71.83%).

Ɔsono Amanyɔkuo (NPP) no anamsini wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam James Etornam Flolu nso nyaa mma mpem nson ahansia ne aduoson nsia (7,676) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduonu nwɔtwe akyiri pɔ dunson (28.17%).

NDP Amanyɔkuo no anamsini wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam no nyaa mma ahanu ne dunwɔtwe (218) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu ohunu akyiri pɔ nwɔtwe (0.8%).

Mma dodoɔ: Mpem dubaako ahankron ne baako (11,901) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduanan mmiɛnsa akyiri pɔ aduosia nsia (43.66%).

Nimpa dodoɔ a wɔtoo aba no: Mpem aduonu nson ahanu ne aduonum mmiɛnsa (27,253).

Nimpa dodoɔ a wɔtwerɛ wɔn din: Mpem aduasa num ahanu ne aduonu nwɔtwe (35,228).

Mpem aduonu ne dunsia (2016) Ghanaman nyinaa abatoɔ: Afadjato South

Kyinie Amanyɔkuo (NDC) no anamsini wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam Angela Oforiwa Alorwu-Tay nyaa mma mpem dunkron ahanan ne aduowɔtwe nsia (19,486) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduowɔtwe mmiɛnsa akyiri pɔ aduosia nkron (83.69%).

Ɔsono Amanyɔkuo anamsini wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam Seneadza Semanu Wisdom nyaa mma mpem mmiɛnsa ɔha ne aduasa mmiɛnsa (3,133) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu dummiɛnsa akyiri pɔ aduonan nsia (13.46%).

PPP Amanyɔkuo anamsini wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam Fia Kwesi Hanson nso nyaa mma no mu ahansia ne dummienu (612) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu mmienu akyiri pɔ aduosia mmiɛnsa (2.63%).

CPP Amanyɔkuo no anamsini George Kofi Kotoku nyaa mma aduonum mmiɛnsa (53) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu ohunu akyiri pɔ aduonu mmiɛnsa (0.23%).

Mma dodoɔ: Mpem dunsia ahasa ne aduonum mmiɛnsa (16,353) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduoson akyiri pɔ aduonu mmiɛnsa (70.23%).

Nimpa a ɛtoo aba no: Mpem aduonu mmiɛnsa ahanu ne aduowɔtwe nan (23,284).

Mfe mpem mmienu ne dummienu (2012) Ghanaman nyinaa mmarahyɛbadwam abatoɔ: Afadjato South

Kyinie Amanyɔkuo (NDC) no anamsini wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam Joseph Zaphanat Amenowode nyaa mma mpem aduonu mmienu ne aduonu nkron (22,029) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduowɔtwe nan akyiri pɔ aduasa mmiɛnsa (84.33%).

Ɔsono Amanyɔkuo (NPP) no anamsini wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam Emma Millicent Kartey Kofiedu nso nyaa mma mpem mmiɛnsa ahanson ne aduowɔtwe nan (3,784) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu dunan akyiri pɔ aduanan nkron (14.49%).

CPP Amanyɔkuo anamsini wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam Constant Yao Kumah Gidi nyaa mma ahasa ne du (310) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu baako akyiri pɔ nkron (1.9%).

Mma dodoɔ: Mpem dunwɔtwe ahanu ne aduanan num (18,245) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduosia nkron akyiri pɔ aduowɔtwe nan (69.84%).

Nimpa dodoɔ a wɔtoo aba: Mpem aduonu nsia ɔha ne aduonu mmiɛnsa (26,123).

title: Biakoye (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Biakoye( yɛ mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwam no mu baako. Ɛde first past the post abatoɔ yii mmarahyɛbadwani baako. Biakoye mpɛsoa no wɔ Biakoye mansisni a ɛwɔ Oti mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Amanyɔkuo a ɛte so siesie wɔ mpɛsoa no so ne kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo ( NDC ) a Owura Kwadwo Nyanpon Aboagye yɛ wɔn mmarahyɛbadwani.

Ahyeɛ 
Mpɛsoa no wɔ Biakoye mansini a ɛwɔ Oti mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Wɔ ne atififam ne Krachi apueeɛ mansini, wɔ atɔeɛfam, Volta asubɔnten, wɔ anaafoɔfam ne Hohoe mansini ne Kpando mansini a ne nyinaa wɔ Volta mantam mu na wɔ ne apueeɛfam ne Ghana - Togo hyeɛ. Beaeɛ ankasa a na mpɛsoa no wɔ ne Volta mantam a ɛwɔ Gaana kɔsi sɛ yɛtee mantam afoforo a edi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne dunwɔtwe (2018) Ɔpɛnimma referendum akyi.

Mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ 

 Nea wɔyii no kane wɔ mpɛsoa no so wɔ afe apem  ahankron ne aduosia (1960) abatoɔ no mu ne Sylvanus Desmond Magnus- George a ɔgyina maa Convention People's Party (CPP) Amanyɔkuo no.
 Nea ɔtɔ so a wɔyii no wɔ mpɛsoa no so wɔ Afe apem ahankron ne aduosia nkron (1969) ne Obed Asamoah a ɔgyina maa National Alliance of Liberals ( NAL) Amanyɔkuo no.
 Nea ɔdi so ne Kwadzo Amoah a ɔgyina maa People's National Party (PNP) wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduoson nkron mu (1979).
 Nea ɔdi so ne Kwabena Adjei a ɔgyina maa Kyiniiɛ Amanyɔkuo (NDC) wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron mmienu (1992) mu.
 Nea ɔdi so ne Emmanuel Kwasi Bandua a ɔgyina maa Kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo (NDC) no wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan (2004) mu.
 Nea ɔdi so ne Kwadwo Nyanpon Aboagye a ɔgyina maa Kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo (NDC) no wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne dunsia (2016) mu. Fiti mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne dunsia mu a Kwadwo Nyanpon dii nkunim no, Kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo no na atena mpɛsoa no akonnwa so wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam de besi nnɛ.

title: Agotime-Ziope
text:
Agotime-Ziope()  ka mpasua a wɔn ananmusini wɔ Ghana Mmarahyɛbadwam no ho. Abatoɔ berɛ biara mu no, wɔde 'first past the post' abatoɔ nhyehyeɛ no yi mmarahyɛbadwani baako.Agotime-Ziope mpasua no wɔ Agotime-Ziope mansini a ɛwɔ Firaw Mantam wɔ Ghana. Wɔtee mpasua yi wɔ berɛ a na wɔrebɛto afe 2012 abatoɔ no.

Mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ 

Wɔtoo aba berɛ a edi kan wɔ mpasua no so wɔ afe 2012 abatoɔ no mu. National Democratic Congress amanyɔkuo no muni no de mma no mu 12,550 na edii nkunim wɔ saa abatoɔ no mu. Wɔtee saa mpasua yi firii Ho East mpasua a na ɛwɔ hɔ berɛ bi no mu. Ɛwom sɛ wɔsesa mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ no mu wɔ mpasua yi so deɛ, nanso National Democratic Congress amanyɔkuo no akɔ so adi nkunim wɔ mpasua no abatoɔ mu firi berɛ a wɔteeɛ ho.

Abatoɔ 

 mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu (2020) Ghanafoɔ abatoɔ.

Wɔ saa afe yi mu no, nnipa mmienu na egyinaeɛ peree mpɛsoa no akonnwa no. Na wɔ abatoɔ no akyi no Charles Agbeve a ɔgyina maa kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo (NDC) no na ɛde mma mpem dunkron, ɔha ne aduanan mmiɛnsa (19,143) a egyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduowɔtwe nson ne akyirepɔ aduowɔtwe (87.80%) dii nkunim saa afe no bɛyɛɛ mpɛsoa no mmarahyɛbadwani. Nea ɔne no gyinaeɛ a ɔdii no so nkunim ne John Kwaku Amenya a ɔgyina maa Ɔsono amanyɔkuo (NPP) no nso nyaa mma mpem mmienu, ahansia ne aduonum nkron (2,659) a egyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu dummienu ne akyirepɔ aduonu (12.20). Mma dodoɔ a wɔnyaa ne mpem dunsia ahanan ne aduowɔtwe nan (16,484) a egyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduoson num ne akyirepɔ nsia (75.6). Mma a ɛkɔ baeɛ ne mpem aduonu baako, ahanwɔtwe ne mmienu (21,802) na na abatoɔfoɔ nso yɛ mpem aduonu nwɔtwe, ahankron ne aduonum (28,950).

 Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne dunsia (2016) Ghana  abatoɔ: Azotime-Aziope

Wɔ saa afe yi mu no, dibeaperefoɔ a egyina wɔ mpɛsoa no so ne;

Charles Agbeve a ɔgyina maa kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo (NDC) no nyaa mma mpem dubaako, ahansia ne dunan (11,614) a egyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduosia nkron ne akyirepɔ aduosia mmienu (69.62%), Amenya Wisdom Elvis Ativoe a wannyina amma amanyɔkuo biara no nso nyaa mma mpem mmiɛnsa ahanu ne aduonu nkron (3,229) a egyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu dunkron ne akyirepɔ aduasa nsia (19.36%), David Yaoga Sunu a ɔgyina maa kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo (NDC) no nso nyaa mma apem baako ahasa ne aduonu nkron (1,329) a egyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu nson ne akyirepɔ aduokron nson (7.97%) na nea ɔtwa toɔ John Kwaku a ɔgyina maa ɔsono amanyɔkuo (NPP) no nso nyaa mma ahanum ne du (510) a egyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu mmiɛnsa ne akyirepɔ ohunu ne nsia (3.06%). Mma dodoɔ a wɔnyaa yɛ mpem nwɔtwe ahasa ne aduowɔtwe num (8,385) a egyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduonum ne akyirepɔ aduonu nsia (50.26%) na deɛ ɛkɔ baeɛ yɛ mpem dunsia ahansia ne aduowɔtwe mmienu (16,682). Wɔ saa abatoɔ yi mu no nea ɔdii nkunim bɛyɛɛ mpɛsoa no mmarahyɛbadwani ne Charles Agbeve a ɔgyina maa kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo no.

 

 wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne dummienu (2012) Ghana mmarahyɛbadwam abatoɔ: Azotime-Ziope

Wɔ saa afe yi mu no, dibeaperefoɔ a egyina wɔ mpɛsoa no so wɔ abatoɔ no mu ne;

Juliana Azumah-Mensah a ɔgyina maa kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo (NDC) no nyaa mma mpem dunan ahanan ne aduowɔtwe num (14,485) a egyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduoson nwɔtwe ne akyirepɔ aduowɔtwe nwɔtwe (78.88%), nea ɔdi so ne David Yaoga Sunu a ɔgyina maa kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo (NDC) no nso nyaa mma apem baako ahankron ne aduasa num (1,935) a egyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu du ne akyirepɔ aduonum mmiɛnsa (10.53%), nea ɔdi so ne David Dickson Dzorkpe a ɔgyina maa ɔsono amanyɔkuo (NPP) no nso nyaa mma apem baako ahanson ne aduonu baako (1,721) a egyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu nkron ne aduasa nsia (9.35%) na deɛ ɔtwa toɔ no ne Sakpa Yaa Kuma Donkor a ɔgyina maa akokɔ amanyɔkuo (CPP) no nso nya mma ahanu ne aduanan baako (241) a egyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu baako ne akyirepɔ aduasa baako (1.31%). Mma dodoɔ a ɛbaeɛ yɛ mpem dummienu ahanum ne aduonum (12,550) a egyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduosia nwɔtwe ne akyirepɔ aduasa num (68.35%). Wɔ saa abatoɔ yi mu no, nea ɔdii nkunim bɛyɛɛ mpɛsoa no mmarahyɛbadwani ne Juliana Azumah-Mensah a ɔgyina maa kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo no.

title: Achiase (Ghana mmarahyɛbedwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Wɔtee Achiase( mpɛsoa wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu aberɛ a wɔreto Ɔpɛnimaa aba no. Robert Kwasi Amoah(kyerɛkyerɛni) a ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party ne Dr. Kwasi Akyem Apea-Kubi(ɔhwɛ mma awodeɛ mu) a ɔwɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress na ɛpere mmarahyɛbedwan akonnwa no wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu a Robert Kwasi Amoah na ɔdii nkunim. Wɔnya mpɛsoa no wɔ berɛ wɔtee wɔn ho firii Akim Swedru mpɛsoa, a ɛbɛyɛ Achiase mpɛsoa ne Akim Swedru mpɛsoa. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia abatoɔ mu no, Robert Kwasi Amoah a na ɔte akonnwa no so no sane tenaa so biom wɔ mmarahyɛbedwafie berɛ a ɔne S.Y Kwakye(Ɔhwɛ sikasɛm mu) pere akonnwa no. ɛrekɔ Mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu abatoɔ nom no, Mr Robert Amoah hweree akwanya a ɔde bɛpere mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ akonnwa wɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party aporɔbɔ de maa Kofi Ahenkorah Marfo(Ɛnkane ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party mpɛsoa titinanii). Me Marfo dii nkunim wɔ abatoɔ nom de bɛyɛɛ mmarahyɛbedwanii a ɔmaa Dr Kwasi Akyem Apea-Kubi dii ntwo a ɛyɛ ne mperɛ nan so nie( 2000, 2008,2012,2020) a wɔsusu sɛ ɛwɔ sɛ ɔdi nkunim.

title: Jomoro (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Jomoro ()like yɛpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwam no mu baako. Ɛde first past the post abatoɔ yii mmarahyɛbadwani baako. Jomoro mpɛsoa no wɔ Jomoro mansini a ɛwɔ atɔeɛ mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Amanyɔkuo a ɛte so siesie wɔ mpɛsoa no so ne Kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo ( NDC ) a Dorcas Affo-Toffey ne wɔn mmrahyɛbadwani.

Ahyeɛ 
Jomoro mpɛsoa no wɔ Jomoro mansini a ɛwɔ atɔeɛ mantam mu wɔ Ghana a ɛwɔ ahyeɛ a ɛte saa ara. Wɔ ne atɔeɛfam ne Côte d'lvoire. Ne anaafoɔfam hyeɛ ne Atlantic Ocean. Ne apueeɛfam hyeɛ ne Nzema East mansini na wɔ ne atififam nso ne Aowin/Suaman ne Wasa Amenfi West mansini.

Mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ 
Jomoro abatoɔ mpesua no anya mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ ahodoɔ pii afifirii amannyɔkuo ahodoɔ no mu. wɔ afe apem aha nkron ne aduoson nkron  (1979) abatoɔ mu no, owura James Leuven Mensah a na ɔyɛ People's National Party( PNP ) amannyɔkuo ba no na na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani de ma ɔmanfoɔ a wɔwɔ Jomoro abatoɔ mpesua no so.

wɔ afe apem aha nkron ne aduokron mmienu  (1992) abatoɔ mu no, owura Joseph Emmanuel Ackah a na ɔyɛ kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo (National Democratic Congress)  ba no na na ɔyɛ mmarahy bad want de ma ɔmanfoɔ a wɔwɔ Jomoro abatoɔ mpesua no so. wɔ saa afe yi abatoɔ mu no, NDC kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo nko ara ne amannyɔkuo a wɔde wɔn ananmusini ba bɛgyinaa wɔ abatoɔ mpesua ahodoɔ no mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no abatoɔ mu.

wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nan (2004) abatoɔ mu no, amannyɔkuo ahodoɔ nan na wɔde wɔn ananmusini ba bɛgyinaa wɔ Jomoro abatoɔ mpesua no mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no abatoɔ mu. kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo National Democratic Congress de owura Lee Ocran na ɛbɛgyinaeɛ, ɔsono amannyɔkuo (New Patriotic Party) nso de owura Anthony Ransford Tandoh na ɛbɛgyinaeɛ, Convention People's Party (CPP) nso de owura Philip Ackatiah Armah na ɛbɛgyinaeɛ, People's National Convention 
( PNC ) nso de Awuraa Doris Eduku na ɛbɛgyinaeɛ. Abatoɔ no baa awieɛ no na kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo (National Democratic Congress) ananmusini owura Lee Ocran na adi nkunim.

wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nwɔtwe (2008) abatoɔ mu no, amannyɔkuo ahodoɔ nan a wɔde wɔn ananmusini ba bɛgyinaa wɔ  afe mpem mmienu ne nan (2004) abatoɔ mu no wɔ Jomoro abatoɔ mpesua no mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no abatoɔ mu no ara na wɔsane de wɔn nnipa baeɛ. kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo (National Democratic Congress) sane de owura Lee Ocran na ɛbɛgyinaeɛ bio, ɔsono amannyɔkuo (New Patriotic Party) nso sesaa owura Anthony Ransford Tandoh a wɔde no baa  afe mpem mmienu ne nan (2004) abatoɔ mu na wɔde owura Martin Nyameke Ackah na ɛbɛgyinaeɛ, Convention People's Party (CPP) nso sesaa owura Philip Ackatiah Armah a wɔde no baa  afe mpem mmienu ne nan (2004) abatoɔ mu na wɔde Awuraa Samia Yaba Christina Nkrumah na ɛbɛgyinaeɛ, People's National Convention 
( PNC ) nso sesaa Awuraa Doris Eduku  a wɔde no baa  afe mpem mmienu ne nan (2004) abatoɔ mu no na wɔde Awuraa  Jemaima Soboe ɛbɛgyinaeɛ. Abatoɔ no baa awieɛ no na Convention People's Party (CPP)  ananmusini Awuraa Samia Yaba Christina Nkrumah na adi nkunim.

wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du-mmienu (2012) abatoɔ mu no, owura Francis Kabenlah Anaman a na ɔyɛ kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo ?(National Democratic Congress)  ba no na na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani de ma ɔmanfoɔ a wɔwɔ Jomoro abatoɔ mpesua no so.

wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du-nsia(2016) abatoɔ mu no, owura Paul Essien a na ɔyɛ ɔsono amannyɔkuo New Patriotic Party  ba no na na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani de ma ɔmanfoɔ a wɔwɔ Jomoro abatoɔ mpesua no so.

title: Suame (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Suame () yɛ mpɛsoa nom baako a ɛwɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbedwam. Wɔyi mmarahyɛbedwanii baako a ne din wɔ abatoɔ nkrataa nom a ɔgyina hɔ ma saa mpɛsoa no.  Na Suame wɔ Kumase Metropolitan mansini mu nanso seisei deɛ ɛwɔ mansini adantam a ɛwɔ Asante mantam wɔ Ghana. Wɔte mpɛsoa no akonnwa berɛ a wɔreto mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ aba a Old Tafo-Suame mpɛsoa nom kyɛ yɛɛ Old Tafo ne Suame mpɛsoa wɔ ne nnidisoɔ so.

Ɛhyeɛ 
Mpɛsoa no akonnwa no hyɛ Kumase Metropolitan Assembly ɛne Tafo Nhyiaeso, Afigya Kwabre South,Bantama na ɛbɔ hyeɛ.

Abakɔsɛm 
Ghana abatoɔ kɔmisa ne nnipa afoforɔ bɛyɛ aduonu nkron na  wɔdikan  tee mpɛsoa no wɔ mfeɛ mpem ne nan, a ɛtoo mpɛsoa nom firii ahanu dekɔɔ ahanu ne aduasa.

Mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ 
Wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nan (2004) abatoɔ mu no, amannyɔkuo ahodoɔ nan na wɔde wɔn ananmusini babɛgyinaa wɔ Suame mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no abatoɔ no mu sɛ yɛnto wɔn so aba ma wɔn mmɛyɛ mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ mma ɔmanfoɔ a wɔwɔ Suame abatoɔ mpesua no so. Ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party de Owura Osei Kyei Mensah Bonsu na ɛbɛgyinaeɛ, Kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo National Democratic Congress nso de Owura Paul Richard Yeboah na ɛbɛgyinaeɛ, amanyɔkuo a yɛfrɛ wɔn convention peope's party a wɔn ahyɛnsodeɛ ne Akokɔ no nso de Owura Frederick Antwi na ɛbɛgyinaeɛ, afei People's National convention nso de Owura Young Sampson Agonno na ɛbɛgyinaeɛ. Abatoɔ no nyinaa baa awieɛ no na Ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party ananmusini Owura Osei Kyei Mensah Bonsu na adi nkunim wɔ Suame mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no abatoɔ no mu

Abatoɔ

Mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan (2004) Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ:suame 
Wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nan (2004) abatoɔ mu no wɔ Suame mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no abatoɔ no mu, Ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party de Owura Osei Kyei Mensah Bonsu na ɛbaeɛ, abatoɔ no baa awieɛ no na wanya mma no mu Mpem aduanan nwɔtwe ne ahanum (48,500) a sɛ yɛde kɔ ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu a, ɛgyina hɔ ma Ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu aduowɔtwe mmienu ne akyire pɔ baako (82.1%). Owura Osei Kyei Mensah Bonsu de mma Mpem aduanan nwɔtwe ne ahanum (48,500) na ɛdii nkunim wɔ Suame mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no abatoɔ no mu.

Saa ara nso na Kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress nso de Owura Paul Richard Yeboah na ɛbaeɛ, abatoɔ no baa awieɛ no na wanya mma no mu Mpem ahannwɔtwe,ahanan ne aduanan nwɔtwe (8,448) a sɛ yɛde kɔ ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu a, ɛgyina hɔ ma Ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu du-nan ne akyire pɔ mmiɛnsa (14.3%).  Owura Paul Richard Yeboah de mma Mpem aha nwɔtwe,ahanan ne aduanan nwɔtwe (8,448) na ɛtɔɔ so mmienu wɔ Suame mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no abatoɔ no mu.

Amanyɔkuo a yɛfrɛ wɔn convention peope's party a wɔn ahyɛnsodeɛ ne Akokɔ no nso de Owura Frederick Antwi na ɛbɛgyinaeɛ, na berɛ a abatoɔ no baa awieɛ no na wanya mma no mu apem , ɔha ne aduonum nson (1157), a sɛ yɛde kɔ ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu a, Owura Frederick Antwi  mma no gyina hɔ ma Ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu mmienu ne akyiri pɔ hwee (2.0%). convention peope's party  ananmusini no de mma apem , ɔha ne aduonum nson (1157), na ɛtɔɔ so mmiensa wɔ Suame mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no abatoɔ no mu.

Afei People's National convention nso de Owura Young Sampson Agonno na ɛbɛgyinaeɛ, na abatoɔ no baa awieɛ no na wanya mma no mu aha nkron ne aduasa nan (934) a sɛ yɛde kɔ ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu mu a, Owura Young Sampson Agonno mma no gyina hɔ ma Ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu baako ne akyire pɔ nsia (1.6%). People's National convention ananmusini no de mma aha nkron ne aduasa nan (934) na ɛtɔɔ so nan wɔ Suame mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no abatoɔ no mu.

title: Amenfi West (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Amenfi West( yɛ mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwam no mu baako. Ɛde first past the post abatoɔ yii mmarahyɛbadwani baako. Amenfi West mpɛsoa no wɔ Wasa Amenfi mansini a ɛwɔ atɔeɛ mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Amanyɔkuo a ɛte so siesie wɔ mpɛsoa no so ne Kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo (NDC ) a Owura Eric Afful yɛ wɔn mmarahyɛbadwani.

Wassa Amenfi West mansini yɛ abatoɔ mpesua du-nan a ɛwɔ Western mantam no mu, wɔ Ghana. Nkane no na saa abatoɔ mpesua yi ka Wassa Amenfi mansini no abatoɔ mpesua no ho wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe nwɔtwe mu (1988), a saa mpeusa yi nyinaa nso wɔtete firii nkane Aowin-Amenfi mansini no abatoɔ mpesua no mu, ɛfiri berɛ a wɔtee mpesua no anaafoɔ-atɔeɛ fam no firii mu maa yɛbɛnyaa Wassa Amenfi West mansini no wɔ ɔsanaa bosome no mu wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nan (2004) mu; ɛnam so ma yɛfrɛɛ abatoɔ mpesua no fa aka no sɛ Wassa Amenfi West mansini. Abatoɔ mpesua yi hyɛ atifi fam wɔ atɔeɛ mantam no mu a wɔn ahenkuro ne  Asankragua . wɔ ɔbɛnim bosome no da a ɛtɔ so du-num wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du-nwɔtwe (2018) mu no na wɔ pagyaa abatoɔ mpesua no mu maa no bɛyɛɛ municipal a ɛno nti ɛnɛ yɛfrɛ mansini no sɛ Wassa Amenfi East Municipal mansini no. Ɛkyire yi no nso, wɔsane tee abatoɔ mpesua foforɔ firii mpesua dadaa yi mu ma yɛsane bɛnyaa Wassa Amenfi Central mansini no wɔ ayɛwohomumɔ bosome no da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nwɔtwe wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du-mmienu mu; nanso abatoɔ mpesua dadaa no din no da so ara yɛ Wassa Amenfi West mansini .

Ahyeɛ 
Mpɛsoa no wɔ Wasa Amenfi atɔeɛ mansini a ɛwɔ atɔeɛ mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

Abatoɔ mpesua ahodoɔ a ɛne Wassa Amenfi West mansini no bɔ hyeɛ bi ne Jomoro abatoɔ mpesua, ne Wassa Amenfi Central abatoɔ mpesua no ne Ellembelle abatoɔ mpesua no.

title: Berekum West (Ghana mmrahyɛbedwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Berekum West ka mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbedwam. Wɔyi mmarahyɛbedwanii baako a ne din wɔ abatoɔ nkrataa nom a ɔgyina hɔ ma saa mpɛsoa no. Berekum West wɔ Berekum mansini adantam wɔ Bono mantam.

Berekum West (abatoɔ mpesua no yɛ abatoɔ mpesua du-mmienu a ɛwɔ Bono mantam no mu baako wɔ ɔman Ghana mu. Nkane no na Berekum West abatoɔ mpesua no ka Berekum mansini no abatoɔ mpesua no ho bi wɔ ɔbɛnim bosome no da a ɛtɔ so du wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe nkron (1989) mu, a wɔnyaa saa abatoɔ mpesua yi nyinaa firii Berekum-Jaman mansini no abatoɔ mpesua no mu (a ɛkyire yi no mmara maa ho kwan maa wɔpagyaa mansini no mu de kɔɔ Berekum Municipal District wɔ ɔgyefuo bosome no da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nkron wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nwɔtwe "2008" mu ); kɔsi sɛ abatoɔ kɔmisa tetee mansini no atɔeɛ fam no firii mansini no mu ma yɛbɛnyaa Berekum West mansini no wɔ ɔbɛnim bosome no da a ɛtɔ so du-num wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du-nwɔtwe (2018) mu. Jinijini ne Berekum West abatoɔ mpesua no ahenkuro.

Ɛhyeɛ 
Mpɛsoa no hyɛ Berekum mansini adantam wɔ Bono mantam wɔ Ghana. Abatoɔ mpesua a ɛne Berekum West abatoɔ mpesua no bɔ hyeɛ ne  Berekum East abatoɔ mpesua no , Jaman North abatoɔ mpesua no , Jaman South abatoɔ mpesua no , Sunyani West abatoɔ mpesua no , Dormaa East abatoɔ mpesua no , Dormaa Municipal abatoɔ mpesua no , ne Tain abatoɔ mpesua no.

Mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ 
Berekum West abatoɔ mpesua no yɛ mpesua a ɔsono amannyɔkuo NPP ho yɛ den wɔ hɔ yie pa ara.  wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du mmienu  (2012) abatoɔ mu, amannyɔkuo ahodoɔ nsia na wɔde wɔn ananmusifoɔ baeɛ. NPP Ɔsono amannyɔkuo no ananmusini a wɔde no bɛgyina maa yɛtoo ne so aba ne owura Kwaku Agyemang-Boateng, kyiniiɛ mannyɔkuo NDC nso de owura Lord Stephen Oppong na ɛbɛgyinaeɛ, Progressive peope's party nso de owura Justice Amankona Diawuo na ɛbaeɛ, URP nso de owura Hinne Owusu Frank na ɛbaeɛ, afei National Democratic party nso de owura Kwasi Boafo na ɛbaeɛ, ɛna CPP amannyɔkuo a wɔn ahyɛnsodeɛ ne Akokɔ no nso de owura Ataboadey Cyril na ɛbɛsii wɔn ananmu.      Abatoɔ no baa awieɛ no na NPP Ɔsono amannyɔkuo no ananmusini  owura Kwaku Agyemang-Boateng adi nkunim wɔ Berekum West abatoɔ mpesua no mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no abatoɔ no mu.

Wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du-nsia  (2016) abatoɔ mu no nso, amannyɔkuo ahodoɔ mmiensa na wɔde wɔn ananmusifoɔ baeɛ. Amannyɔkuo no binom sesaa wɔn ananmusifoɔ a wɔde wɔn baa wɔ  afe mpem mmienu ne du mmienu abatoɔ mu, NPP Ɔsono amannyɔkuo no deɛ wɔn ananmusini a wɔde no bɛgyina maa yɛtoo ne so aba wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du mmienu abatoɔ mu no a ɔne owura Kwaku Agyemang-Boateng no ara na wɔsane de no baeɛ, kyiniiɛ mannyɔkuo NDC nso sesaa owura Lord Stephen Oppong na wɔde owura Dickson kyere-Duah bɛgyinaeɛ, Progressive peope's party nso sesaa owura Justice Amankona Diawuo na wɔde owura Solomon Kwadwo Amponsah baeɛ. title: Akatsi North (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Akatsi North yɛ mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Gaana mmarahyɛbadwam no mu baako. Ɛde first past the post abatoɔ yii mmarahyɛbadwani baako. Akatsi North mpɛsoa no wɔ Akatsi North mansini a ɛwɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ Gaana. Abatoɔ Kɔmisa tee mpɛsoa no wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne dummienu (2012) mu ansa Gaana abatoɔ no. Amanyɔkuo a ɛte so siesie ne Kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo ( NDC ) a Owura Peter Nortsu-Kotoe yɛ wɔn mmarahyɛbadwani.

Mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ 
Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne dummienu mu na wɔtee amanyɔkuo no.

Mmarahyɛbadwani a wɔyii no kane wɔ mpɛsoa no so ne Peter Nortsu-Kotoe a ɔgyina maa Kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo (NDC) wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne dummienu.

Abatoɔ 
Abatoɔ a adi kan wɔ mpɛsoa no so, wɔtoo no wɔ Ɔpɛnimma bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne dummienu mu. Kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuoni na ɛde mma dodoɔ mpem nwɔtwe ahankron ne nwɔtwe dii nkunim faa akonnwa no.

Akatsi North mpɛsoa no yɛ Kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo (NDC) ahoɔdenbea. Fiti mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne dummienu de kɔ si mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu Ghana abatoɔ mu no, Owura Peter Nortsu-Kotoe a ɔgyina ma Kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo (NDC) no na atena mpɛsoa no akonnwa so wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam.

title: Central Tongu
text:

Wɔakyɛ mpasua no mu mmiɛnsa.  Wɔfrɛ nkyekyem yi Bakpa, Mafi ne Kpoviedzi. Mafi Adidome ne wɔn ahenkuro.

title: Sissala East (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Sissala East( ka mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbedwam. Wɔyi mmarahyɛbedwanii baako a ne din wɔ abatoɔ nkrataa nom a ɔgyina hɔ ma saa mpɛsoa no. Sissala East wɔ Sissala mansini adantam wɔ atɔeɛ do mantam wɔ Ghana. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ nom na wɔtee saa mpɛsoa no.

Ɛhyeɛ 
Mpɛsoa no hyɛ Sissala East mansini wɔ Sissala mansini a ɛwɔ atɔeɛ do mantam wɔ Ghana. Burkina Faso na  wɔne wɔn bɔ wɔ serɛm. Sissala West mpɛsoa nso deɛ yɛ atifi atɔeɛ ɛna Wa East nso deɛ yɛ anaafoɔ atɔeɛ. Efiri atifi kɔ anaafoɔ a ɛrekɔ apueɛ hyeɛ no so no wobɛhunu Chiana-Paga mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Kassena/ Nankana mansini ne Builsa North ne Builsa South mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Builsa mansini,ne nyinaa hyɛ atɔeɛ do mantam mu.

Abakɔsɛm 
Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan mu no, Ghana abatoɔ kɔmisa tee Sissala West firii saa mpɛsoa nom. Mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ no ne abatoɔ no mma a watwerɛ no ha no wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan mu no yɛ Ɛnkane Sissala mpɛsoa dea.

Mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ 
Alhaji Amidu Sulemana yɛ ekuoba wɔ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress mu a wɔtoo ne so aba wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron mmienu mu wɔ Sissala East. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu mu no wɔtoo Moses Dani Baah a ɔno nso wɔ Peope's National convention amanyɔkuo mu so aba wɔ saa mpɛsoa nom. Alhassan Dubie Halutie a ɛno nso wɔ  National Democratic Congress mu wɔ Sissala East no wɔtoo no so aba wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe mu.

Abatoɔ 
Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ no wɔ Sissala East a ɛwɔ atɔeɛ do mantam no, nnipa mmiɛnsa a wɔn firi amanyɔkuo afoforɔ mu na ɛgyinaa hɔ maa mpɛsoa no.Na Alhassan Dubie Halutie gyinaa hɔ maa kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress maa mpɛsoa. Ɔnyaa mma mpem nson ne aduosia a sɛ wode kɔ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduasa nsia akyirepɔ nkron. Moses Dani Baah nso gyinaa hɔ maa people's National convention a ɔnyaa mma mpem nsia, ahannwɔtwe ne aduanan mmiɛnsa a ɛne ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduasa num akyirepɔ nnwɔtwe yɛ pɛ. Saa nso na Ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party anamsini ma saa mpɛsoa no nso nyaa mma mpem num, ahanu ne aduonu nsia a ɛne ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduonu nson akyirepɔ mmiɛnsa yɛ pɛ. Na abatoɔ kɔmisa no de too dwa wɔ aberɛ a ɔde mma no too dwa no sɛ Alhassan Dubie Halutie a ɔwɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress na woayi no sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ mmarahyɛbedwanii mma saa mpɛsoa no.

title: Sissala West (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Sissala West( ka mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbedwam no ho. Wɔyi mmarahyɛbedwanii baako a ne din wɔ abatoɔ nkrataa nom a ɔgyina hɔ ma saa mpɛsoa no. Sissala West wɔ Sissala West mansini a ɛwɔ atɔeɛ do mantam wɔ Ghana.Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ nom na wɔtee saa mpɛsoa no.

Ɛhyeɛ 
Mpɛsoa no akonnwa no hyɛ Sissala West mansini a ɛwɔ atɔeɛ do mantam wɔ Ghana. N'ayɔkofoɔ a wɔ ne wɔn te wɔ atɔeɛ f ne Jirapa, Lambussie ne Nadowli East. Atifi fam deɛ yɛ Burkina Faso. Nadowli East mpɛsoa no toa so twa anaafoɔ fam no hyia ɛna Sissala East mpɛsoa no nso twa apueɛ hyia.

Abakɔsɛm 
Ghana abatoɔ kɔmisa ne nnipa afoforɔ aduonu nkron na wɔtee mpɛsoa no wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan mu, a ɛtoo mpɛsoa nom firii ahanu dekɔɔ ahanu ne aduasa. Wɔyɛɛ yie wɔ aberɛ a wɔkyɛɛ Sissala mpɛsoa a wɔdikan teeɛ nom dekɔɔ Sissala East ne Sissala West mpɛsoa wɔ ne nnidisoɔ so.

Mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ 
Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu nom no, Haruna Bayirga wɔ ɔwɔ People's National convention  gyinaa hɔ maa mpɛsoa no. Amin Amidu Sulemana a ɔne wɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress nso gyinaa maa mpɛsoa no wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu nom wɔ Sissala West mpɛsoa so.

Abatoɔ 
Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ nom wɔ Sissala West no, nnipa num na na wɔn din wɔ abatoɔ nkrataa nom a wɔgyinaa hɔ maa mpɛsoa no.Wɔn din na edidi soɔ yi. Haruna Bayirga a na ɔwɔ People's National convention nyaa mma mpem num, ahankron ne aduonum(5,950) a ɛne ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduasa nson akyirepɔ baako (37.1)yɛ pɛ. Robert Bakah Wavei a na ɔno wɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress nso nyaa mma mpem num, ahasa ne baako (5,301) a ɛne ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduasa mmiɛnsa akyirepɔ baako (33.1)yɛ pɛ. Ɛna George Hikah Benson nso nyaa mma mpem nan, ahanum ne du nson (4,517) a ɛne ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduonu nnwɔtwe akyirepɔ mmienu (28.2)yɛ pɛ a ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party. J.B Adunah a ɔwɔ akokɔ amanyɔkuo convention peope's party nso nyaa mma apem ne aduokron nson(197) a ɛne ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu baako akyirepɔ mmienu (1.2)yɛ pɛ. Na Ibrahim Lious nso a ɔwɔ Democratic freedom party nso nyaa mma aduonum nson(57) a ɛne akyirepɔ nan (0.40) yɛ pɛ.  Abatoɔ kɔmisa bobɔɔ mma no nyinaa wieeɛ no Haruna Bayirga na ɔnyaa akonnwa no wɔ Sissala West mpɛsoa no so.

text:

title: North Dayi (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
North Dayi( ka mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbedwam no ho. Wɔyi mmarahyɛbedwanii baako a ne din wɔ abatoɔ nkrataa nom a ɔgyina hɔ ma saa mpɛsoa no. North Dayi wɔ Anfoega mansini a ɛwɔ Fram mantam wɔ Ghana.

Ɛhyeɛ 
Mpɛsoa no hyɛ Ɛnkane Kpando mansini a ɛwɔ Fram mantam wɔ Ghana. Ɛwɔ South Dayi mpɛsoa dekɔ anaafoɔ ɛna Hohoe South mpɛsoa dekɔ apueɛ. Hohoe North mpɛsoa no dekɔ atifi-apueɛ ɛna Jasikan mansini deɛ kɔ atifi.

Mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ. 
Stephen G. Obimpeh a ɔwɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress gyinaa maa mpɛsoa no wɔ Afe apem ahankron ne aduokron mmienu. Akua Sena Dansuah a ɔno nso wɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress mu nso gyinaa hɔ maa mpɛsoa no wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu nom. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu nom no George Loh nso gyinaa hɔ wɔ wɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress nam wɔ Mpɛsoa nom. Ɛna Joycelyn Tetteh nso a ɔwɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress mu peree akonnwa no bi wɔ mpɛsoa nom.

Abatoɔ 
Wɔ mfeɛ mmienu ne nnwɔtwe Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ nom no, nnipa nan na ɛgyina maa mpɛsoa no a wɔfiri amanyɔkuo afoforɔ mu. Nnipa a wɔtoo aba pii no yɛ mpem aduonu,  ɔhanan ne aduokron nson (20,497) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduonum nnwɔtwe akyirepɔ nnwɔtwe.(58.8)  Kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress anamsini ma mpɛsoa no a yɛfrɛ no Akua Sena Dansua nyaa mma mpem aduonu nsia, ahanson ne aduasa nan(26,734)  a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduoson nsia akyirepɔ nson(76.7). Ken Stephen Anku   a ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party mu nso nyaa mma mpem nsia,ahanu ne aduasa nson(6,237) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu du nson akyirepɔ nkron(17.9). Briku Nelson Yesutor a ɔwɔ akokɔ amanyɔkuo convention people's party nso nyaa mma apem, ahanson ne aduosia nsia(1,766) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu num akyirepɔ baako (5.1). Raphael Yao Menu nso nyaa mma ɔha ne aduasa nnwɔtwe (138) a ɛyɛ akyirepɔ nan(0.4) wɔ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu mu. Anamsini no wɔ Democratic freedom party amanyɔkuo mu.

Mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ no kɔɔ so wɔ North Dayino nnipa mmiɛnsa na na wɔn din wɔ abatoɔ nkrataa nom a ɛwɔ sɛ wɔto aba ma no. Nnipa mpem aduonu num, ahanson ne aduonum nan(25,754)  a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduosia nkron akyirepɔ nnwɔtwe(69.8) nnipa na ɛtoo aba no paa. Abatoɔ kɔmisa kekaa mma no bom de ho nsunsuansoɔ no bɛtoo dwa no na Akua Sena Dansua a ɔwɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress anya mma mpem aduonu nkron, ahanson ne aduosia num (29,765) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduonwɔtwe akyirepɔ nson(80.7). Ɔno na ɔnyaa mma bebree. Mma mpem nan ne du baako a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu du akyirepɔ nkron na Cephas Jones Donkor a ɔwɔ Ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party anamsini ma mpɛsoa no nyaeɛ, Akokɔ amanyɔkuo convention people's party anamsini ma saa mpɛsoa no, Cephas Aquinas Kwame M. Ntumy nso nyaa mma mpem mmiɛnsa, ɔha ne du nnwɔtwe (3,118), a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu nkron akyirepɔ nan(9.4).

Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoo no wɔ North Dayi wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu nom no, mpem du nson, ahanson ne aduowɔtwe nson(17,787) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduonum nan akyirepɔ nnwɔtwe (54.8)na ɛyɛ nnipa dodoɔ a ɛtoo aba no. Nnipa nan na ɛgyina wɔ saa mpɛsoa no so sɛ wɔnnyo aba mmawɔn sɛ mmarahyɛbedwanii a wɔn din wɔ abatoɔ nkrataa nom. Nea ɔnyaa mma no dodoɔ no wɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress a yɛfrɛ Akua Sena Dansua nyaa mma aduonu mmiɛnsa, ahankron ne aduosia mmienu a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduoson mmiɛnsa akyirepɔ nnwɔtwe. Thomas Aquinas  Kwame M. Ntumy a ɔwɔ akokɔ amanyɔkuo convention people's party nyaa mma mpem nsia, ɔha ne aduoson num a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu du nkron.

Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ North Dayi wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia nom no, na nnipa mmiɛnsa na wɔn din wɔ  abatoɔ nkrataa nom a wɔgyinaa hɔ maa mpɛsoa. Na nnipa ɛtoo aba no paa yɛ mpem aduasa nsia, ahannwɔtwe ne du baako (36,811) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduowɔtwe num akyirepɔ nsia(85.6). Nea ɔnyaa mma no dodoɔ yɛ Stephen George Obimpeh a ɔwɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress a ɔnyaa mma no mpem aduasa nkron, ahanan ne aduanan num(39,445) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduokron baako akyirepɔ nson(91.7%) . People's convention party anamsini ma mpɛsoa no, Vincent Wilson Bulla nyaa mma mpem mmienu, ahannsia ne aduasa nan(2,634) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu nsia akyirepɔ baako (6.1). Augustine Yawo Adjei a ɛno nso wɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party na ɔnya mma nom ketewa a ɛyɛ ahankron ne aduanan nan(944) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu mmienu akyirepɔ mmienu (2.2)

title: Fanteakwa North (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Fanteakwa North( ka mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbedwam no ho. Wɔyi mmarahyɛbedwanii baako a ne din wɔ abatoɔ nkrataa nom a ɔgyina hɔ ma saa mpɛsoa no. Fanteakwa North wɔ Fanteakwa mansini wɔ a ɛwɔ apueɛ mantam wɔ Ghana.

Ɛhyeɛ 
Mpɛsoa no hyɛ Fanteakwa mansini a ɛwɔ Ghana apueɛ mantam.

Mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ 
Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia (2016) Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ no wɔ Fanteakwa North no nnipa baako pɛ na ɔgyina wɔ saa mpɛsoa no so a ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party mu, wɔfrɛ no Kwabena Amankwah Asiamah.

Abatoɔ 
Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Fanteakwa North no, nnipa nan na wɔtwerɛɛ wɔn din wɔ abatoɔ nkrataa nom a na wɔgyina hɔ am mpɛsoa no. Kwabena Amankwah Asiamah a ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party no nyaa mma mpem du baako, ahasa ne aduasa (11,330) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduonum mmiɛnsa akyirepɔ nan.(53.04 Abass Fuseini Sbaabe nso nyaa mma mpem nkron, ahanan ne aduoson mmienu (9,472) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduanan nan akyirepɔ du num (44.15%). Nkansah Amos nso nyaa mma ahanan ne aduowɔtwe mmiɛnsa (483) a ɛne ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu mmienu akyirepɔ aduonu num (2 .25%), a ɔwɔ progressive peoples party. Nea ɔnyaa aba ketewa no wɔ akokɔ amanyɔkuo convention people's party a wɔfrɛ no Ohene Nyarko Solomon, nyaa mma ɔha ne aduonu baako a wɔ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu mu no ɛbɛyɛ akyirepɔ aduonum nsia.

Beaɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Abetifi (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Abetifi( mpɛsoa no wɔ Ghana apueɛ mantam. Bryan Acheampong na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbedwanii ma saa mpɛsoa no seisei. Ɛnam ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party so na wɔtoo no so aba yii no ma no nyaa mma mpem nkron, ahanson ne aduonu nan kyɛn wɔn a wɔne wɔn peree akonnwa no a na wɔsusu sɛ wɔbɛtumi anya aba no abɛyɛ mmarahyɛbedwanii ama mpɛsoa no. Wɔdii Peter Wiafe Pepera a ɔgyinaa hɔ maa mpɛsoa no a na ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party mu adeɛ wɔ kwasafoman a ɛtɔ so num.

Mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ 
Nnipa nsia na ɛperee mmarahyɛbedwa akonnwa no wɔ Abetifi a wɔampere akonnwa afe korɔ noa mu. Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduosia num (1965) no Benjamin Kofi Asamoah a ɔwɔ akokɔ amanyɔkuo convention people's party mu peree akonnwa no ɛna Emmanuel Kwadwo Adu a ɔwɔ Progress party amanyɔkuo mu nso bɛgyina wɔ mpɛsoa no so afe apem ahankron ne aduosia nkron (1969). Ɛno akyi no Opoku Preko a ɔwɔ National convention party nso kɔpere akonnwa no wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron mmienu. Anwie hɔ na Eugene Atta Agyepong nso peree akonnwa wɔ saa mpɛsoa no so mperɛnsa wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron (1996) , mfeɛ mpem mmienu (2000) ɛna mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan(2004) mu. Peter Wiafe Pepera a ɛwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party mu no nso gyinaa hɔ maa mpɛsoa no wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe (2008) ɛna mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu (2012). Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia(2016) no Bryan  Acheampong a na ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party gyinaa hɔ maa mpɛsoa no.

Abatoɔ 
Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia (2016)Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ nom wɔ Abetifi no, nnipa mmienu na ɛpere mmarahyɛbedwa akonnwa no wɔ mpɛsoa no so. Ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party anamsini Bryan Acheampong nyaa mma mpem aduonu mmiɛnsa, ahanan ne aduasa mmienu (23,432) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduoson nan akyirepɔ aduosia baako(74.61) ɛna  Emmanuel Tabi a ɔwɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress mu nso nyaa mma mpem nson, ahankron ne aduoson num(7,975) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduonu-num akyirepɔ aduasa nkron (25.39%).

Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu(2012)  Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ wɔ Abetifi no, Nnipa mmienu na ɛgyinaa hɔ maa mpɛsoa no. Simon Edem Asimah a ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party nyaa mma mpem aduonu, ahanson ne aduosia nsia (20,766) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduosia mmiɛnsa akyirepɔ aduonnwɔtwe nan(63. 84) ɛna Samuel Asamoah nso a ɔwɔ progressive peoples party nso nyaa mma mpem du baako, ahanson ne aduosia nan(11,764) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduasa nsia akyirepɔ du nsia (36.16).

Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe (2008)mu wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ nom no Peter Wiafe Pepra  nkoa na ɛperee mpɛsoa no akonnwa no. Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia (1996), mfeɛ mpem mmienu (2000), ɛna mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan mu no (2004)  Eugene Atta Agyepong a ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party mu nkoa na ɔperee mpɛsoa no akonnwa no. National convention party anamsini Opoku Preko nkoa na ɔperee mpɛsoa no akonnwa no wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron mmienu (1992).

Beaɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ.

title: Ayawaso West (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Ayawaso West anaa Ayawaso Wuogon( ka mpɛsoa  a ɛwɔ Nkran a ɛwɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbedwam. Wɔyi mmarahyɛbedwanii baako a ne din wɔ abatoɔ nkrataa nom a ɔgyina hɔ ma saa mpɛsoa no. Ayawaso West mpɛsoa wɔ Nkran "Metropolitan" a ɛwɔ Nkran punpuni mantam wɔ Ghana.

Mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ 
Nnipa nsia na ɛgyina maa Ayawaso West mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ akonnwa. Francis Napoleon K. Kumah a ɔwɔ National convention party gyinaa hɔ sɛ mmarahyɛbedwanii ma mpɛsoa no wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron mmienu (1992). Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia (1996)  nso Owurayere Rebecca Akweley Adotey a  ɔwɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress gyinaa maa mpɛsoa no.  Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu (2000)mu no, George Isaac Amoo, ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party anamsini gyinaa hɔ maa mpɛsoa no. Akosua Frema Osei-Opare  nso kɔpere akonnwa wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan(2004)  nom wɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party anan mu. Emmanuel Kwabena Kyeremateng Agyarko a ɔyɛ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party nii  gyina maa mpɛsoa no wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu (2012) . Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nkron(2019) nom nso Lydia Alhassan  a ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party mu gyinaa hɔ maa mpɛsoa no.

Abatoɔ 
Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nkron(2019) mu no, abatoɔ soronko bi kɔɔso  Ayawaso West mpɛsoa so a wɔde yi obi foforɔ asi akonnwa a obi nte so. Ɛbaa no saa no nnipa nan na ɛkɔperee akonnwa no. Abatoɔ kɔmisa kekaa mma no bom de ɛho nsunsuansoɔ bɛtoo dwa no na Lydia Seyram Alhassan a ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party mu anya mma mpem du mmienu ne aduanan baako (12,041) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduosia nnwɔtwe akyirepɔ aduowɔtwe (68.80). Kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress mu nnipa Kwasi Delali Brempong nyaa mma mpem num, ahasa ne aduanan baako(5,341) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduasa akyirepɔ aduonum mmienu (30.52). William Kofi Dowokpor a ɔwɔ progressive peoples party nso nyaa mma ɔha ne mmienu (102) a ɛyɛ akyirepɔ aduonum nnwɔtwe (0.58). Liberal party of Ghana amanyɔkuo anamsini Clement Boadi nyaa mma du nson(17) a ɛyɛ akyirepɔ baako (0.1). Nnipa dodoɔ a ɛtoo aba no nyɛ mpem nsia ne ahanson (6,700) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduasa nnwɔtwe akyirepɔ aduonu nnwɔtwe (38.28)

Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe(2008) nom no wɔtoo aba yii mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ nom. Nnipa mpem mmiɛnsa ne aduasa nkron (3,039) na ɛtoo aba no a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu num akyirepɔ nan(5.4). Nnipa num na ɛperee mpɛsoa no akonnwa no. Akosua Frema Osei-Opare a ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party nyaa mma mpem aduonu nan, ahannsia ne mmiɛnsa (24,603) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduanan mmiɛnsa akyirepɔ mmienu (43.2). Albert Kwadwo Twum Boafo a ɔwɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress nso nyaa mma mpem aduonu baako, ahanum ne aduosia nan (21,564) a ɛne ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduasa nson akyirepɔ nnnwɔtwe (37.8) . William Kofi Dowokpor a ɛwɔ akokɔ amanyɔkuo convention people's party nso nyaa mma mpem nson m, ahankron ne du(7,910) a ɛne ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu du mmiɛnsa akyirepɔ nkron (13.9) yɛ pɛ. Samuel Kobby Adiepena a wayɛ ne ho kɔntɔnkorɔ a ɔmfaa ne ho mmɔden amanyɔkuo biara ho no nyaa mma mpem mmienu, ahanum ne aduanan  nson (2,547) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu nan akyirepɔ num(4.5). People's National convention anamsini Henry Haruna Asante  nso nyaa mma ahasa ne aduoson nan(374) a ɛyɛ akyirepɔ nson

yɛ. William Kofi Dowokpor nso a ɔwɔ akokɔ amanyɔkuo convention people's party nso peree akonnwa no nyaa mma mpem nson, ahankron ne du(7,910) a ɛne ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu nan akyirepɔ num(13.9)  yɛ pɛ.

Beaɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ.

title: Ayawaso Central (Ghana mmarahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Ayawaso Central( ka mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbedwam no ho Ɛka mansini foforɔ a Ghana aban teeɛ a ɔdaa no adi kyerɛɛ ɔman no nyinaa wɔ berɛ korɔ noa mu. Wɔyi mmarahyɛbedwanii baako a ne din wɔ abatoɔ nkrataa nom a ɔgyina hɔ ma saa mpɛsoa no.

Mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ 
Mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ a wɔgyinaa hɔ maa mpɛsoa wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron mmienu(1992) ne Said Sinare a ɔwɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress. Ɛna Sheikh Ibrahim Cudjoe Quaye a ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party mu gyinaa hɔ maa mpɛsoa no wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia (1996), mfeɛ mpem mmienu (2000), mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne mmienu (2002),  ɛna mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan (2004), mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe (2008) . Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu (2012) ne mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia (2016) mu no Henry Quartey a ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party mu nso gyinaa hɔ maa mpɛsoa no bi.

Abatoɔ 
Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ aba a wɔtoiɛ de yi mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe(2008) nom wɔ Ayawaso Central no  nnipa num na wɔgyina maa mpɛsoa no. Ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party anamsini Sheikh Ibrahim Cudjoe Quaye nyaa mma mpem aduasa, ahankron ne du num(30,915) a ɛne ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduanan nkron akyirepɔ baako(49.1) yɛ pɛ . Kwasi Ofei Agyemang a ɔwɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress mu nyaa mma mpem aduasa ne aduosia nnwɔtwe (30,068) a ɛne ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduanan nson akyirepɔ nson yɛ pɛ. Daniel Kofi Aidoo a ɔwɔ akokɔ amanyɔkuo convention people's party nyaa mma apem, ɔha ne aduosia (1,160) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu baako akyirepɔ nnwɔtwe. People's National convention anamsini Zalia Seidu nyaa mma aduosia me aduonu mmienu (622) a ɛne ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu baako yɛ pɛ. Benjamin Bediako nso nyaa mma aduonu ne num(205) a ɛyɛ akyirepɔ mmiɛnsa(0.3%) wɔ Democratic freedom party anan mu.

Beaɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ.

title: Lambussie (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Lambussie yɛ mpɛsuasoɔ no mu baako a ɛwɔ Ghana Mmarahyɛbadwam. Wɔtoo aba yi mmarahyɛbadwani baako a odii nkonimwɔ abatoɔno mu. Lambussie wɔ Jirapa Lambussie mansini a ɛwɔ Atɔe Sor Mantam wɔ Ghana. Lambussie mpɛsua a ɛwɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwam. Edward K.Dery na na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani de ma Kyinie Amanyɔkuo (NDC) no wɔ Jirapa/ Lambussie mansini no mu wɔ Atɔe Sor Mantam wɔ Ghana.

Ɛhyeɛ 
Jirapa/ Lambussie Mansini a ɛwɔ Atɔe sor Mantam wɔ Ghana na akonnwa no wɔ.

Mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ 
Abatoɔ a ɛdikan a wɔtoo no wɔ afe apem dunkron ne aduokron mmienu (1992) mu na wɔyii Mmarahyɛbadwani Jocob Bawiine  Boon sɛ ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani mfa mma Kyinie Amanyɔkuo (NDC) no.

Afe apem dunkron ne aduokron nsia (1996) mu abatoɔ no, wɔtoo aba yi Luke Koo sɛ ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani mfa mma Kyinie.Amanyɔkuo no.

Afe apem dunkron ne aduokron nkron (1999) mu abatoɔ a adikan no wɔyii Alice Teni Boom sɛ ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani mfa mma Kyinie Amanyɔkuo (NDC) no.

Mfe mpem mmienu ne nwɔtwe (2008) abatoɔ no, wɔtoo aba yi John Duoghr Baloroo  sɛ ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani mfa mma Ɔsono Amanyɔkuo (NPP) no.

Mfe mpem mmienu ne dummienu (2012) abatoɔ no, wɔtoo aba yi Edward K. Dery sɛ ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani mfa mma Kyinie Amanyɔkuo no.

Abatoɔ 
Mfe mpem mmienu ne dunsia (2016) Ghanaman nyinaa abatoɔ: Lambussie.

Mfe mpem mmienu ne dunsia (2016) abatoɔ no Edward K.Dery a na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma Kyinie Amanyɔkuo (NDC) no. Ɔnyaa mma no mu mpem nwɔtwe ahankron ne aduasa baako (8,931) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduonum nwɔtwe akyiri pɔ aduonu nkron (58.29%).

Bakye Yelviel-Dong Baligia a na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma Ɔsono Amanyɔkuo (NPP) no wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne dunsia (2016) abatoɔ no mu no, ɔnyaa mma mpem nsia ɔha ne du (6,110) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduasa nkron akyiri pɔ aduowɔtwe nwɔtwe (39.88%).

Ɔdeneho Amanyɔkuo (Independence) no anamsini Ernest Sanyare Beinpuo nso nyaa mma ɔha aduonu nwɔtwe (128)a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu ohunu akyiri pɔ aduowɔtwe nan (0.84%).

CPP Amanyɔkuo no anamsini David Mwinfor Deribaa nso nyaa mma ɔha ne baako (101) a sɛ wode kɔ ɔha nkyekyɛmu a agyina hɔ ma ohunu akyiri pɔ aduosia nsia (0.66%).

APC Amanyɔkuo anamsini Tawiah Kaapeke nso nyaa mma no mu aduonum baako (52) a sɛ wode kɔ ɔha nkyekyɛmu a agyina hɔ ma ohunu akyiri pɔ aduasa mmiɛnsa (0.33%).

Mma dodoɔ: Mpem mmienu ahanwɔtwe ne aduonu baako (2,821) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu dunwɔtwe akyiri pɔ aduanan baako 18.41%).

Nimpa a ɛtoo aba no: Mpem dunum ahansia ne aduoson nkron (15,679) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduosia num akyiri pɔ nwɔtwe (65.8%).

Nimpa dodoɔ a wɔtwerɛ wɔn din: Mpem aduonu mmiɛnsa ahanwɔtwe ne aduonu mmiɛnsa (23,823).

Mpem mmienu  ne dummienu (2012) Ghanaman nyinaa abatoɔ: Lambussie 
Edward K.Dery  a na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma Kyinie Amanyɔkuo (NDC) no nyaa mma mpem nwɔtwe ahanan ne aduanan nan (8,444) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduonum mmienu akyiri pɔ aduosia nkron (52.69%).

Ɔdeneho Amanyɔkuo (Independence) a na Issakah Sagito yɛ wɔn anamsini no nso nyaa mma mpem nan ɔha ne aduosia nan (4,164) a sɛ wɔde hɔ ɔha nkyekyɛmu a agyina hɔ ma  aduonu num akyiri pɔ aduokron nwɔtwe (25.98%).

John Doughr Baloroo a na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma Ɔsono Amanyɔkuo (NPP) no nso nyaa mma no mu mpem mmienu ahanum ne aduosia nkron (2,569) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu dunsia ne akyiri pɔ ohunu mmiɛnsa (16.03%).

Beinpuo Ernest Sanyare a na ɔno nso yɛ anamsini de ma PPP Amanyɔkuo no nso nyaa mma ahanan ne aduonu mmiɛnsa (423) a na agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu mmienu akyiri pɔ aduosia nan (2.64%).

PNC Amanyɔkuo no anamsini Alhassa Zakaria nso nyaa mma ɔha ne aduokron nan (194) a s wode kɔ ɔha nkyekyɛmu a agyina hɔ ma baako akyiri pɔ aduonu baako (1.21%).

David Mwinfor Deribaa a na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma CPP Amanyɔkuo no nyaa mma ɔha ne aduowɔtwe (180) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu baako akyiri pɔ dummienu (1.12%).

NDP Amanyɔkuo no anamsini Amoah Basing nso nyaa abatoɔ no mu mma aduonum baako (51) a sɛ wode kɔ ɔha nkyekyɛmu a agyina hɔ ma ohunu akyiri pɔ aduasa mmienu (0.32%).

Mma dodoɔ: Mpem nan ahanu ne aduowɔtwe (4,280) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduonu nsia akyiri pɔ aduoson baako (26.71%).

Nimpa dodoɔ a wɔtoo aba no: Mpem dunsia ahanwɔtwe ne dunwɔtwe (16,818) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduowɔtwe baako akyiri pɔ nson (81.7%).

Nimpa dodoɔ a wɔtwerɛ wɔn din: Mpem aduonu ahanum ne aduoson baako (20,571).

Mpem mmienu ne nwɔtwe (2008) Ghanaman mmarahyɛbadwam abatoɔ 
John Doughr Baloroo a na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma Ɔsono Amanyɔkuo (NPP) no nyaa mma Mpem nsia ahanum ne dummiɛnsa (6,513)a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduonum num akyiri pɔ nan (55.4%).

Alice Teni Boon a na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma Kyinie Amanyɔkuo (NDC) no nso nyaa mma mpem nan ahanson ne dunsia (4,716) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduanan akyiri pɔ baako (40.1%).

Amoah T Basing a na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma PNC Amanyɔkuo no nyaa mma ahanu ne  aduosia  baako (261) a sɛ wode kɔ ɔha nkyekyɛmu a agyina hɔ ma mmienu akyiri pɔ mmienu (2.2%).

CPP Amanyɔkuo no anamsini Bele-Irs Vitus nyaa mma ɔha ne aduanan baako (141) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu baako akyiri pɔ mmienu (1.2%).

DFP Amanyɔkuo no anamsini Baloroo David nso nyaa mma ɔha ne aduonu nan (124) a sɛ wode kɔ ɔha nkyekyɛmu a agyina hɔ ma baako akyiri pɔ baako (1.1%).

Mma dodoɔ: Apem ahanson ne aduokron nson  (1,797) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu dunum agyiri pɔ mmiɛnsa (15.3%).

Nimpa a wɔtoo aba: Mpem dummienu ɔha ne aduosia nson  (12,167).

Nimpa a wɔtwerɛ wɔn din: Mpem dunwɔtwe ahanwɔtwe ne aduoson num (18,875)

Afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia (1996) Ghanaman nyinaa abatoɔ 
Luke Koo a na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma Kyinie Amanyɔkuo (NDC) no nyaa mma mpem nkron ahanson ne aduowɔtwe num (9,785) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduoson nkron akyiri pɔ aduonkron nwɔtwe (79.98%)

Ɔsono Amanyɔkuo (NPP) no anamsini Anthony Boloroo nso nyaa mma apem ahanum ne aduokron nsia (1,596) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu dummiɛnsa akyiri pɔ ohunu nan (13.04%).

Alexander Ambreh Bayowoh a na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma PNC Amanyɔkuo no nyaa mma ahanwɔtwe ne aduonum nan (854)a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu nsia akyiri pɔ aduonkron nwɔtwe (6.98%).

Mma dodoɔ: Mpem nwɔtwe ɔha ne aduowɔtwe nkron (8,189) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduosia nsia akyiri pɔ aduokron nan (66.94%).

Nimpa dodoɔ a wɔtoo aba no: Mpem dummienu  ahanu ne aduasa num (12,235) a sɛ wode kɔ ɔha nkyekyɛmu a agyina hɔ ma aduoson mmiɛnsa akyiri pɔ dunkron (73.19%).

Nimpa a wɔtwerɛ wɔn din: Mpem dunsia ahason ne dunson (16,717).

Afe apem ahankron ne aduokron mmienu (1992) Ghanaman mmarahyɛbadwam abatoɔ 
Kyinie Amanyɔkuo (NDC) no anamsini Jocob Bawline Boon nyaa mma mpem nsia ahanum ne du (6,510).

Nimpa dodoɔ a wɔtoo aba no: Mpem nsia ahanson ne aduosia mmiɛnsa (6,763) a sɛ wode kɔ ɔha nkyekyɛmu a agyina hɔ ma aduasa nson akyiri pɔ num (37.5%).

Nimpa a wɔtwerɛ wɔn din: Mpem dunwɔtwe ne aduonu mmienu (18,022).

title: Kpone-Katamanso (Ghana mmarahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Kpone-Katamanso( ka mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbedwam no ho. Wɔyi mmarahyɛbedwanii baako a ne din wɔ abatoɔ nkrataa nom a ɔgyina hɔ ma saa mpɛsoa no. Kpone-Katamanso wɔ Tema mansini adantam wɔ Nkran punpuni mantam wɔ Ghana.

Mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ 
Mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ a ɔgyina ma Kpone-Katamanso mpɛsoa no yɛ num a obiara firi n'amanyɔkuo mu. Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron mmienu (1992) mu no Joseph Teye Tetteh  na ɔgyina maa mpɛsoa no a na ɔwɔ Kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress mu. Beatrice Love Naa-Afiaye Ashong a ɔwɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress mu nso gyinaa maa mpɛsoa no wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia (1996). Joseph Nii Laryea Afotey Agbo  a ɔwɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress sane gyinaeɛ maa mpɛsoa no wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan mu(2004), mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe (2008) ɛna mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu mu(2012).

Abatoɔ 
Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe nom no wɔtoo Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ aba wɔ Kpone-Katamanso a nnipa mmiɛnsa pɛ na ɛperee akonnwa no. Nnipa a ɛtoo aba no yɛ mpem du ne aduonu nkron (10,029) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduasa akyirepɔ num(30.5). Abatoɔ kɔmisa ne de mma no ho nsunsuansoɔ bɛtoo dwa no, Joseph Nii Laryea Afotey Agbo a ɔwɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress nyaa mma mpem aduonu, ahanson ne nkron(20,709) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduosia mmiɛnsa(63.0%) Samuel Okoe Amanquah nso a ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party nso nyaa mma mpem du, ahannsia ne aduowɔtwe(10,680) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduasa mmienu akyirepɔ num(32.5). Daniel Teye Botchway a na ɔwɔ akokɔ amanyɔkuo convention people's party nyaa mma apem, ahanum ne  nan(1,504) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu nan akyirepɔ nsia(4.6).

 Nea ɔbetuu Danzi Paul Kpal wɔ mpɛsoa no akonnwa so wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia (1996) ne Moses Aduku Asaga a ɔgyina maa kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo (NDC) no na odii nkunim bɛyɛɛ mpɛsoa no mmarahyɛbadwani. Azongo Peter Tasiri a ɔgyina maa People's National Convention (PNC) no nso nyaa mma ahasa ne aduokron baako (391) a egyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu mmienu ne akyirepɔ mmiɛnsa (2.3%). Wɔ saa abatoɔ yi mu no nea odii nkunim bɛyɛɛ mpɛsoa no mmarahyɛbadwani ne Simon Atingban Akunye a ɔgyina maa kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo no.

title: Weija (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Weija( mpɛsoa (seisei deɛ awu)  yɛ tete mpɛsoa a wɔkyɛɛ mu mpɛsoa mmiɛnsa-Anyaa- sowutuom,Bortianor-Ngleshie-Amanfrom ne Weija Gbawe wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu Ghana abatoɔ nom. Ɛnni anamsini biara wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbedwam ɛna wɔnto aba nyi mmarahyɛbedwanii biara. Ɛnkane Weija wɔ Ga West mansini a ɛwɔ Nkran punpuni mantam wɔ Ghana.

Mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ 
Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan (2004) ne mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe (2008) nom no Shirley Ayorkor Botchwey a ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party na gyina maa mpɛsoa no.

Abatoɔ 
Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe(2008) Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ wɔ Weija no, wɔtoo mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ num so aba. Shirley Ayorkor Botchway a ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party nyaa mma mpem aduosia nsia, ahasa ne aduoson baako (63,371) a  ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduonum mmiɛnsa akyirepɔ nson(53.7). Ɛna Kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress anamsini Sheriff Nii Otto Dodoo nso nyaa mma mpem aduonum baako, ahankron ne aduosia baako (51,961) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduanan nan akyirepɔ baako (44.1). Mma mpem mmienu,ɔha ne num(2,105) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu baako akyirepɔ nnwɔtwe (1.8) na Osman Ahmed Okyere a ɔwɔ akokɔ amanyɔkuo convention people's party nyaeɛ. Democratic freedom party anamsini Joshua Nee Sackey Oku nyaa mma ahasa ne aduonum nnwɔtwe (358) a ɛyɛ akyirepɔ mmiɛnsa(0.3%). title: Tema West (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:

Ɛhyeɛ 
Mpɛsoa no hyɛ Nkran"Metropolitan" mansini a ɛwɔ Nkran punpuni mantam wɔ Ghana mu.

Mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ 
Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron mmienu(1992) mu no Gladys Boateng a ɔwɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress gyina maa mpɛsoa no. Abraham Ossei Aidoo a ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party nso gyinaa hɔ maa mpɛsoa no wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia (1996)nom. Irene Naa Torshie Addo a ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party nso gyina maa mpɛsoa no wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe (2008)nom. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia (2016) mu no Kingsley Carlos Ahenkorah peree mpɛsoa no akonnwa no.

Abatoɔ 
Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe (2008) Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ wɔ Tema West no nnipa mmiɛnsa na ɛgyina maa mpɛsoa. Ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party anamsini Irene Naa Torshie Addo nyaa.ma mpem aduasa nkron ne aduoson nsia(39,076) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduonum num akyirepɔ baako (55.1). George K. Medie a ɔwɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress nso nyaa mpem aduasa, ahanan ne aduasa nan(30,434) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduanan mmienu akyirepɔ nkron (42.9). Isaac Kofi Asempa a ɔwɔ akokɔ amanyɔkuo convention people's party nso nyaa apem, ahasa ne aduowɔtwe mmienu (1,382) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu baako akyirepɔ nkron (1.9).

Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia Ghana abatoɔ wɔ Tema West no , nnipa num na ɛperee mpɛsoa no akonnwa no. Kingsley Carlos Ahenkorah a ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party nyaa mma mpem aduanan nan, ahanum ne aduoson nkron(44,579) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduonum nkron akyirepɔ aduonum mmienu (59.52). Kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress anamsini James Enu nyaa mma mpem aduonu nkron, ahanson ne aduanan mmienu (29, 742) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduasa nkron akyirepɔ aduoson baako (39.71). Marshall  Dogbatsey nso nyaa mma ahanan ne nan(404) a ɛyɛ akyirepɔ aduonum nan(0.54%) wɔ progressive peoples party anan mu. Akokɔ amanyɔkuo convention people's party anamsini Peterkin Kwame Kin-Adano nyaa aduokron nkron (99) a ɛyɛ du mmiɛnsa. Awotwe Kwaku a ɔwɔ National Democratic party nso nyaa mma aduoson nnwɔtwe a ɛyɛ akyirepɔ du.

title: North Tongu (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
North Tongu()ka mpasua a wɔn ananmusini wɔ Ghana Mmarahyɛbadwam no ho. Abatoɔ berɛ biara mu no, wɔde 'first past the post' abatoɔ nhyehyeɛ no yi mmarahyɛbadwani baako. North Tongu mpasua no wɔ North Tongu mansini a ɛwɔ Firaw Mantam wɔ Ghana. Mpɛsoa no mmarahyɛbadwani siesie ne Samuel Okudzeto Ablakwa a ɔyɛ kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo (NDC) no kuoba.

Ɛhyeɛ 
Mpasua  no hyeɛ ahodoɔ nyinaa wɔ North Tongu Mansini a ɛwɔ Firaw Mantam wɔ Ghana. Wɔtee mpasua yi wɔ berɛ a na wɔrebɛto afe 2004 abatoɔ no. Wɔkyɛɛ North Tongu mpasua a na ɛwɔ hɔ saa berɛ no mu mmienu ma no bɛyɛɛ North Tongu ne Central Tongu mpasua.Eyi nti mpasua yi hyeɛ ne North Tongu mpasua a na ɛwɔ hɔ ansa wɔrebɛto afe 2004 abatoɔ no yɛ soronko.

Mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ 
Afe apem aha nkron ne aduokron mmienu (1992) mu a Ghana man hyɛɛ kabimamenkabi amanmuo ase. North Tongu abatoɔ mpesua no anya mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ ahodoɔ nan na asi wɔn anan mu wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam. Mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔdi kan ne Owura Austin Akufo Gamey  na ɔgyina NDC Kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo (NDC) no anan mu na ɔdii nkunim wɔ afe apem aha nkron aduokron mmienu (1992). Mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa abatoɔ no mu wɔ North Tongu abatoɔ mpesua so. Ɛnyɛ Owura Austin Akufo Gamey nko ara ne  Kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo (NDC) no ananmusini a watumi atena North Tongu abatoɔ mpesua mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no so na mmom ɔno ne mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔdi kan wɔ North Tongu abatoɔ mpesua no so.

Afe mpem mmienu (2000) abatoɔ mu no, North Tongu abatoɔ mpesua no nyaa mmarahyɛbadwani foforɔ maa no kɔsi wɔn anan mu wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam. Mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔtɔ so mmienu ne Owura Joe Gidisu a na ɔno nso gyina Kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo (NDC) no anan mu na ɔdii nkunim wɔ afe apem mmienu (2000) mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa abatoɔ no mu wɔ North Tongu abatoɔ mpesua so. Ɛnyɛ Owura Austin Akufo Gamey  ne Owura Joe Gidisu nko ara ne  Kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo (NDC) no ananmusifoɔ a wɔatumi atena North Tongu abatoɔ mpesua mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no so ɛfiri sɛ  North Tongu abatoɔ mpesua no so NDC na atena so dodoɔ.

wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nan (2004) mu no, Amannyɔkuo ahodoɔ no nyinaa sesaa wɔn ananmuini a wɔde wɔn baa afe mpem mmienu mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa abatoɔ no mu. Amannyɔkuo ahodoɔ mmiensa pɛ na wɔde wɔn nipa bɛgyinaa sɛ yɛnto wɔn so aba ɛna kɔntɔnkorɔ baako nso ka ho ma wɔyɛ nan. NPP ɔsono amannyɔkuo no de owura Nicholas Ahiadorme na ɛbɛgyinaeɛ, NDC kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo no nso de Owura Charles Hodogbey na ɛbɛgyinaeɛ, ɛna People's National Convention nso de owura David Amansunu nso baeɛ, owura Cosmos Etse Astse Asem nko ara onipa a wangyina wɔ amannyɔkuo biara anan mu, na mmom ɔgyinaa sɛ kɔntɔnkorɔ. Abatoɔ no nyinaa baa nawieɛ no na NDC kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo no ananmusini Owura Charles Hodogbey na wadi nkunim wɔ saa abatoɔ no mu, a ɔno nso kɔtoaa n'amannyɔkuoba Owura Joe Gidisu adwuma no so wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam de maa  North Tongu abatoɔ mpesua no so.  Owura Charles Hodogbey  tenaa North Tongu abatoɔ mpesua no mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no so mprɛnu.

Afe mpem mmienu ne du-mmienu (2012) abatoɔ mu no, North Tongu abatoɔ mpesua no nyaa mmarahyɛbadwani foforɔ maa no kɔsi wɔn anan mu wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam. Mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔtɔ so nan ne Owura Samuel Okudzeto Ablakwa a na ɔno nso gyina Kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo (NDC) no anan mu na ɔdii nkunim wɔ afe apem mmienu ne du-mmienu (2012) mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa abatoɔ no mu wɔ North Tongu abatoɔ mpesua so. Owura Samuel Okudzeto Ablakwa a wɔyɛ Kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo (NDC) no ananmusifoɔ no ara na ɔda so te North Tongu abatoɔ mpesua mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no so mprɛmprɛn.

title: Wulensi (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Wulensi (Ghana mmarahyɛbadwam mpɛsua)

Wulensi () yɛ mpɛsuasoɔ no mu baako a ɛwɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwam. Wɔtoo aba yi mmarahyɛbadwani baako a odii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ no mu. Wulensi wɔ Nanumba Anafoɔ mansini a ɛwɔ Atifi Mantam wɔ Ghana.

Wulensi mpɛsua a ɛwɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwam .

Alhaji Saani Iddi na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani de ma Ɔdeneho Amanyɔkuo (Independence) no wɔ Nanumba Anafo mansini no mu wɔ Atifi Mantam wɔ Ghana.

Ɛhyeɛ 
Nanumba Atɔe mansini a ɛwɔ Atifi Mantam wɔ Ghana na akonnwa no wɔ.

Mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ 
Afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia (1996) mu no Alhaji Saani Iddi na na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani de ma Ɔsono Amanyɔkuo (NPP) no.

Mfe mpem mmienu (2000) mu no na Samuel Nyimakan yɛ mmarahyɛbadwani de ma Kyinie Amanyɔkuo (NDC) no.

Mfe mpem mmienu ne mmienu (2002) mu no Wumbei Kofi Karim na na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani de ma Ɔsono Amanyɔkuo (NPP) no.

Mfe mpem mmienu ne nwɔtwe (2008) mu no Alhaji san bɛyɛɛ mmarahyɛbadwani de ma Ɔdeneho Amanyɔkuo (Independence) no.

Ɛnam owuo a ɛbɛtoo mmarahyɛbadwani a na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma Ɔdeneho Amanyɔkuo (Independence) no Alhaji Saani Iddi wɔ Ayɛwohomumɔ bosom no mu wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne dummienu (June 2012) mu. Ghana aban kɔminsan hyɛɛ Kitawonsa bosom da a ɛtɔ so aduasa baako wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne dummienu (31 July 2012) mu sɛ wɔbɛsan ato aba  bio ayi mmarahyɛbadwani foforɔ a ɛkɔ hia sɛ wɔn a wɔpɛsɛ  wɔto aba ma wɔn no kɔ sensane nkrataa so wɔ Kitawonsa bosom da a ɛtɔ  so mmiɛnsa ne Kitawonsa bosom da a ɛtɛ so nan wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne dummienu (3 July and 4 July 2012) no mu.

title: Ningo-Prampram (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Ningo-Prampram( mpɛsoa yɛ mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbedwam. Mpɛsoa no nyaa ne din firii nkuro mmienu a ɛhyɛ mpɛsoa nom. Saa nkuro no na ɛso paa ɛne Ningo a akyɛ ne prampram ɛsua koraa sɛ wode toto afoforɔ ho a na ɛmu sua. Wɔyi mmarahyɛbedwanii baako a ne din wɔ abatoɔ nkrataa nom a ɔgyina hɔ ma saa mpɛsoa no. Ningo-Prampram wɔ Ningo-Prampram mansini wɔ Nkran punpuni mantam wɔ Ghana."Central University College"wɔ ne nkyekyɛmu no baako wɔ Miotso a ɛbɛn Prampram. Nhyehyɛeɛ gu akwan mu a wɔde ne nkyekyɛmu no baako bɛkɔ Ningo-Prampram. "Hope City" a wɔyɛɛ wɔn adwene sɛ wɔbɛsi no kasoa no nso wɔde kɔ hɔ. Nhyehyɛeɛ sane so gu akwan a wɔrebɛsi amanɔne wiemhyɛn beaɛ foforɔ wɔ baabi a ɛbɛn Ningo.

Mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ 
Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron mmienu (1992) mu no,  Stanley Basil Bade Carboo a ɔwɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress peree mpɛsoa no akonnwa no bi. Enoch Teye Mensah a ɔno nso wɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress nso peree akonnwa no wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia (1996). Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia (2016) mu no, Sam George Nartey a ɔwɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress nso gyina maa mpɛsoa no.

Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe(2008) Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ nom wɔ Ningo-Prampram no nnipa nan na ɛperee akonnwa no. Enoch Teye Mensah a ɔwɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress nyaa mma mpem du nnwɔtwe, ahasa ne aduasa nkron (18,339) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduoson baako akyirepɔ num(71.5). Mma mpem nsia, ɔha ne aduokron nsia (6,196) a ɛwɔ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduonu nan akyirepɔ baako(24.1%) na Abed Tawiah Okorno a ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party nyaeɛ. Christian Chartey Zuttah a ɔnni amanyɔkuo biara mu nyaa ahannsia ne aduasa nkron (639) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu mmienu akyirepɔ num(2.5). Akokɔ amanyɔkuo convention people's party anamsini Abdulai Nii Martey nyaa ahanan ne aduowɔtwe nson(487) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu baako akyirepɔ nkron (1.9).

La Dade Kotopon yɛ mpɛsoa baako a ɛwɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbedwam. Wɔyi mmarahyɛbedwanii baako a ne din wɔ abatoɔ nkrataa nom a ɔgyina hɔ ma saa mpɛsoa no. La Dade Kotopon mpɛsoa no wɔ Nkran punpuni mantam wɔ Ghana.

Mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ 
Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron mmienu (1992) mu no, Lemuel Nii-Amon Kotei a ɔwɔ National convention party amanyɔkuo mu peree mpɛsoa no akonnwa no. Sylvester A. Mensah a ɔwɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress nso peree akonnwa no afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia (1996). National People's party anamsini Godfred Ako-Nai gyina maa mpɛsoa no wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu (2000). Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan (2004) nom no  Nii Amasah Namoade nso kɔperee mpɛsoa no akonnwa no bi. Vincent Sowah Odotei a ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party mu peree akonnwa no wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia (2016). Mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu baako (2021) mu na Rita Naa Odoley Sowah gyina maa mpɛsoa no.

Abatoɔ

Beaɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ.

title: Ablekuma North (Ghana mmrahyɛbedwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Ablekuma North( yɛ mpɛsoa no baako a ɛwɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbedwam. Wɔyi mmarahyɛbedwanii baako a ne din wɔ abatoɔ nkrataa nom a ɔgyina hɔ ma saa mpɛsoa no. Ablekuma North wɔ Nkran"Metropolitan" a ɛwɔ Nkran punpuni mantam wɔ Ghana.

Ɛhyeɛ 
Mpɛsoa no hyɛ Ga East mansini a ɛwɔ Nkran punpuni mantam wɔ Ghana.

Mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ 
.Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron mmienu (1992) mu no Adam Baako Nortey Yeboah a ɔwɔ kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo (National Democratic Congress) peree akonnwa no. Kwamena Bartels a ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party nso peree akonnwa no wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia (1996), mfeɛ mpem mmienu (2000) ɛna mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan (2004) nom. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe (2008) ne mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu (2012)nom no Justice Joe Appiah a ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party gyina maa mpɛsoa no. Nana Akua Owusu Afriyie a ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo (New patriotic party) nso gyina maa mpɛsoa no wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia(2016).

Abatoɔ 
Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe (2008) Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ wɔ Ablekuma North no nnipa num na wɔgyina maa mpɛsoa no. Ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party anamsini Justice Joe Appiah nyaa mma aduanan num, ahannsia ne aduasa(45,630) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduonum nson akyirepɔ nsia(57.6). Ashford Tawiah Smith a ɔwɔ kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo (National Democratic Congress) nyaa mma mpem aduasa,ɔha ne aduonum(30,150) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduasa nnwɔtwe akyirepɔ baako (38.1). Mma apem, ahanum ne du mmienu (1,512) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu baako akyirepɔ nkron (1.9) na Ernest Kweku Ortsin a ɔwɔ akokɔ amanyɔkuo (convention people's party) nyaeɛ. Doris Osei Frimpong a ɔnni amanyɔkuo biara mu nyaa mma apem, ɔha ne aduosia num (1,165) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu baako akyirepɔ num(1.5%). Bala S Maikankan a ɔwɔ People's National convention nyaa mma no ahanson ne aduoson mmienu (772) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu baako (1.0%).

Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan(2004) Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ wɔ Ablekuma North no, nnipa num na ɛgyinaa hɔ maa mpɛsoa no. Kwamena Bartels a ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo (New patriotic party) nyaa mma mpem aduonum num, ahankron ne aduokron nkron (55,999) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduosia num akyirepɔ nan. Ashford Tawiah Smith a ɔwɔ kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo (National Democratic Congress) nyaa mma mpem aduonu nson, ahankron ne aduowɔtwe nnwɔtwe (27,988) a ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduasa mmienu akyirepɔ nson(32.7). Benjamin Agbo a ɔwɔ akokɔ amanyɔkuo convention people's party nyaa ahanso ne aduosia nkron (769) a ɛyɛ akyirepɔ nkron(0.9). Bala S. Maikankan a ɔwɔ People's National convention nyaa ahannsia ne du mmienu (612) a ɛyɛ akyirepɔ nson(0.7) . Kow Asare Nyarko a ɔnni amanyɔkuo biara mu nyaa ahasa ne nan(304) a ɛyɛ akyirepɔ nan(0.4)

Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu (2000) Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ wɔ Ablekuma North no nnipa mmiɛnsa na ɛperee mpɛsoa no akonnwa no. Kwamena Bartels a ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo "New patriotic party" nyaa mma mpem aduasa nan, ahanum ne nnwɔtwe (34,508) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduosia nkron akyirepɔ mmienu (69.2). Albert Okpoti Botchway a ɔwɔ kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo "National Democratic Congress" nyaa mpem du nan, ahanu ne aduasa nsia(14,236) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduonu nnwɔtwe akyirepɔ nsia(28.6). Akokɔ amanyɔkuo "Convention People's Party" anamsini Doreen Naadjah Sackey nyaa mma apem ne aduokron mmienu (1,092) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu mmienu akyirepɔ mmienu (2.2%).

Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia (1996) Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ wɔ Ablekuma North no, nnipa mmiɛnsa na na wɔn din wɔ abatoɔ nkrataa nom a wɔgyinaa hɔ maa mpɛsoa no. Ɔsono amanyɔkuo "New patriotic party" anamsini Kwamena Bartels nyaa mma mpem aduasa num, ahanson ne aduanan nson(35,747) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduosia baako akyirepɔ baako (61.1). Denanyoh Ben Mensah a  ɔwɔ kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo "National Democratic Congress" nyaa mma mpem aduonu, ahanu ne du nan(20,214) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduasa nan akyirepɔ num (34.5). Nathaniel Addo  a ɔwɔ National convention party nyaa mpem mmienu, ahanum ne aduonum nkron (2,559) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu nan akyirepɔ nan (4.4%).
