title: Krowor (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Krowor( yɛ mpɛsoa nom baako a ɛwɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbedwam. Wɔyi mmarahyɛbedwanii baako a ne din wɔ abatoɔ nkrataa nom. Krowor wɔ Ledzokuku-Krowor mansini adantam a ɛwɔ Nkran punpuni mantam wɔ Ghana.

Ɛhyeɛ 
Mpɛsoa no akonnwa no hyɛ Ledzokuku-Krowor mansini adantam wɔ Nkran punpuni mantam wɔ Ghana.

Mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ 
Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron mmienu (1992) mu no, J.A Tawiah a ɔwɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress gyina maa mpɛsoa no. Joshua Alabi a ɔwɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress mu nso peree akonnwa no bi wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia (1996). Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu (2000) no, Emmanuel Adjei Boye nso peree mpɛsoa no akonnwa no bi. Abraham Laryea Odai, Ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party anamsini nso gyinaa maa mpɛsoa no wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan (2004) mu. Nii Dakley Quaye Kumah a ɔwɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress nso pere akonnwa no wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe (2008) nom. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia mu no Elizabeth Afoley Quaye a ɔyɛ Kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo New patriotic party nii gyina maa mpɛsoa no.

Abatoɔ 
Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ wɔ Krowor no nnipa mmiɛnsa wɔperee akonnwa no. Nii Dakley Quaye a ɔwɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress nyaa mma mpem aduonu nson,ahasa ne aduasa nkron (27,339) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduonum nan akyirepɔ mmienu (54.2%). Joseph Ayikoi  Otro a ɔno nso wɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New Patriotic party nyaa mpem aduonu baako,ɔha ne aduasa nsia (21,136) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduanan mmienu akyirepɔ mmiɛnsa (42.3). Mma apem, ahanum ne aduasa (1,530) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu mmiɛnsa akyirepɔ baako(3.1) na Emmanuel Attuquaye Botchway a ɔwɔ akokɔ amanyɔkuo convention people's party nyaeɛ.

Abraham Laryea Odai a ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party nyaa mma  mpem aduonu num, ahanan ne num(25,406) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduanan nsia akyirepɔ nkron(46.9) wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan (2004)mu. Dr. Nii O akley Quaye-Kumah a ɔwɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress nyaa mpem aduonu nan, ahasa ne aduasa nkron (24,339) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduanan nan akyirepɔ nkron(44.9). Theophilus Boye Mensah a ɔwɔ akokɔ amanyɔkuo convention people's party nso nyaa mpem mmienu, ahannwɔtwe ne nnwɔtwe (2,808)a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu num akyirepɔ mmienu (5.2). Emmanuel Borquaye Boyefio a ɔnni amanyɔkuo biara nyaa ahankron ne aduanan num (945) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu baako akyirepɔ nson(1.7) ɛna Theophilus Twi Okunnor a ɔnni amanyɔkuo biara mu no nso nyaa mma ahannsia ne aduonum nnwɔtwe (658) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu baako akyirepɔ mmienu (1.2).

Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu (2000) Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ wɔ Krowor mpɛsoa no nnipa nsia na ɛperee mmarahyɛbedwa akonnwa no wɔ hɔ. Emmanuel Adjei Boye a ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party no nyaa mma mpem du nan, ahanu ne aduoson num(14,275) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduanan nsia akyirepɔ num(46.5%). Kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress, Joshua Alabi nso nyaa mpem du mmienu, ahankron ne aduoson num (12,975) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduanan mmienu akyirepɔ mmienu (42.2%). National Reform Party amanyɔkuo ni, Seth Nakai- Akee Bortier nso nyaa mpem mmienu, ahanu ne aduasa nan(2,234) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu nson akyirepɔ mmiɛnsa (7.3). Theophilus M. Boye a ɔwɔ akokɔ amanyɔkuo convention people's party mu gyina hɔ maa mpɛsoa no a ɔnyaa ahanson ne aduasa nkron (739) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu mmienu akyirepɔ nan(2.4). People's National convention nnipa, Joseph Nii-Anum Kpakpo nyaa ahanum ne aduokron num(595) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu baako akyirepɔ mmiɛnsa (1.3). Kudoto Egypt a ɔwɔ United Ghana Movement nyaa aduowɔtwe nsia (86) a ɛyɛ akyirepɔ mmiɛnsa.(0.3).

Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia(1996) Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ nom no  Joshua Alabi a ɔwɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress nkoa na ɔperee akonnwa no ɛna J. A Tawiah a ɔwɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress nkoa na ɔperee mpɛsoa no akonnwa no wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron mmienu(1992) Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ wɔ Krowor no.

title: Ablekuma South (Ghana mmarahyɛbedwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Ablekuma South( Ablekuma Anaafoɔ (south) Yɛ mpesua no mu baako a ɛgyina mu ɛwɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwam. Wɔn faa first past the post abatoɔ nhyehyeɛ so too aba yii mmarahyɛbadwanii baako a na ne din wɔ abatoɔ nkrataa no mu a ɔgyina hɔ ma saa mpesua no. Ablekuma South wɔ Nkran" Metropolitan area" wɔ Nkran punpuni mantam wɔ Ghana. Ɛyɛ "Sub Metropolitan"mansini nsia no mu  baako a ɛwɔ Nkran "Metropolitan"? Assembly".

Abakɔsɛm 
Ɛfiri afe apem ahannwɔtwe ne aduoson nson mu a Ghana ahenkuro sesa firi "Cape Coast" no, Nkran ayɛ Ghana ahenkuro ɛfiri saa afe no de bɛsi nnɛ. Seisei no,ɛyɛ"Metropolis" a ɛwɔ abibirem a ɛnyini wɔ afe biara mu no susupɛn ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu mmiɛnsa ne  akyirepɔ baako (3.1%). Ɛdikan no, wɔyɛɛ sɛ wɔn bɛ te kuroman futufoɔ kuo (Town Council) wɔ afe apem ahannwɔtwe ne aduonum nkron(1859) wɔ mmara mu nanso wɔ nsusuiɛ no sɛeɛ wɔ ɔpɛpɔn bosome no mu wɔ afe apem ahannwɔtwe ne aduosia baako (January 1861) no mu. Na deɛ ɛteɛ ne sɛ, wɔn dii nkae tee Nkran kuroman futufoɔ kuo (Accra Town Council) no wɔ afe apem ahannwɔtwe ne aduokron nnwɔtwe no mu  (1898) ɛwɔ Kuroman futufoɔ kuo tumi mmera no ase   (Town Council Ordinance)  wɔ afe apem ahannwɔtwe ne aduokron nan(1894).

Ɛhyeɛ 
Mpɛsoa no akonnwa no hyɛ Nkran "Metropolitan" (area) mpotɛm a ɛwɔ Nkran punpuni mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɛne Ablekuma Atifido fam (North),Ashiedu Keteke ɛne Ablekuma mfinfini (Central) na ɛbɔ hyeɛ. Ɛhyeɛ a ɛda wɔn adwuma beaɛ no fa Kpakpo Oti kwan no so a ɛkyim fa  "ring (road) kwan (West) Atoeɛ efiri hɔ a,na afa "Eastward" kɔ Lartebiokorshie na afa bɛnkum afiri"Lartebiokorshie" kwan no so akɔ "Link" kwan ne "Chemu" kwan. Na wafiri hɔ akɔ "Sempe Traffic Light" kwan no de afa Mampong kwan no so akɔ Oblogo kwan,afei efiri Oblogo de rekɔ "Mars" nkwantanan soɔ. Efiri"Mars" a na ɛde  kɔ Dansoman"roundabout" . Firi Dansoman kwan no so a na  ɛde rekɔ nkokɔ afuom na ɛrekɔ Dansoman kwantenpɔn no so de akɔsi SSNIT ne Otorjor, Opetekwei, Gbegbeyise ne Shaibu.

Mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ 
Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron mmienu (1992) mu no, Quannor Metel a ɔwɔ kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo (National Democratic Congress) na ɛgyina maa mpesua no. Theresa Ameley Tagoe a ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo (New patriotic party) peree akonnwa no wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia (1996). Fritz Baffour a ɔwɔ kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo (National Democratic Congress) peree akonnwa no mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe (2008) mu. Dr.  Alfred Okoe Vanderpuije a ɔwɔ kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo (National Democratic Congress) nso peree akonnwa no mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia (2016) mu.

Abatoɔ 
Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe (2008) Ghana mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ abatoɔ wɔ Ablekuma South no  nnipa nson  na ɛperee mpesua no akonnwa no. Fritz a ɔwɔ kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo (National Democratic Congress) nyaa mma mpem aduonum nsia, ɔha ne aduosia mmienu (56,162) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduonum baako akyirepɔ mmiɛnsa (51.3). Ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party anamusini, Francis Kojo Smithi peree akonnwa no nyaa mma mpem aduonum, ahannwɔtwe ne aduoson nkron (50,879) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduanan nsia akyirepɔ num (46.5). Godfred Agyemang Kennedy a ɔwɔ People's National convention nso nyaa mma ahankron ne du num(915) a ɛyɛ akyirepɔ nnwɔtwe (0.8%). Mma ahannwɔtwe ne aduasa nson(837) a ɛyɛ akyirepɔ nnwɔtwe na Appostle Veronica Quartey a ɔwɔ akokɔ amanyɔkuo convention people's party nyaeɛ. Jonathan Nii Odotei Quarcoo a ɔ (Democratic freedom party) nyaa ahasa ne du num(315) a ɛyɛ akyirepɔ mmiɛnsa (0.3%). John Kabutey Tettegah a ɔnni amanyɔkuo biara mu nyaa mma ahasa ne du mmiɛnsa (313) a ɛyɛ akyirepɔ mmiɛnsa (0.3%). Democratic people's party Nii Goodman Baah nyaa aduokron (90) a ɛyɛ ɔha nkyekyɛ mu hwee ne akyirepɔ baako (0.1%).

Nnoɔma watumi anya wɔ ne Sikasɛm mu. 
Ablekuma South aboa ma Nkran a ɔwɔ Ghana sikasɛm atu mpɔn. Nsuomunam ne ɛho adwuma yɛ ade titire wɔ Ablekuma South ɛnam sɛ mpɔtam mpɔtam pii wɔ nsuo ano nti. Nnwumakuo ahodoɔ pii bi te sɛ sikakorabea,dwam, ahomegyebea, nnwomasua ne fangoo beaɛ ne nea ɛkeka ho nyinaa wɔbɛhunu bi wɔ Ablekuma South.

Botaeɛ 
Ablekuma South botaeɛ ne sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ ama nkuro a ɛwɔ Nkran abrabɔ akɔyie wɔ aberɛ wɔbɛnya mpaninfoɔ adi wɔn so ne akwanya bebree a ɛbɛma wɔn sikasɛm ne wɔ abrabɔ atumpɔn, na wasane asiesie wɔn kuro ama no ayɛ akɔnnɔ na kuro no nso anya ahobammɔ wɔ beaɛ a wɔte no.

Anisoadehunu 
Ablekuma South anisoadehunu ne sɛ wɔbɛma kuro no ani ada hɔ, wɔn ayɛ den asane agyi

Beaɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ.

title: Ketu South (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Ketu South()ka mpasua a wɔn ananmusini wɔ Ghana Mmarahyɛbadwam no ho. Abatoɔ berɛ biara mu no, wɔde 'first past the post' abatoɔ nhyehyeɛ no yi mmarahyɛbadwani baako.Afadjato South mpasua no wɔ Ketu mansini a ɛwɔ Firaw Mantam wɔ Ghana.

Ɛhyeɛ 
Mpasua no wɔ Ketu South 'Municipal' a ɛwɔ Firaw Mantam wɔ Ghana. Mpasua yi ne 'Republic of Togo' bɔ hyeɛ wɔ Atifi Apueɛ fam. Ketu North mpasua no wɔ Atifi Atɔeɛ fam. 'Atlantic Ocean' wɔ Anafoɔ Apueɛ  fam. Keta  Mansini no na ɛwɔ mpasua yi Anafoɔ Atɔeɛ fam.

title: Ho central
text:
Ho Central( yɛ abatoɔ mpesua a ɛwɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwam no mu baako. wɔtoo wɔn aba wɔ berɛ a ɛdi kan a abatoɔ kɔmisa maa kwan ma mpesua biara too aba de yii wɔn ananmusifoɔ wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam no bi. Ho Central wɔ Ho municipal mansini no mu wɔ Frao mantam (Volta region) mu wɔ Ghana.

Ɛhyeɛ 
Ho Central abatoɔ mpesua no wɔ Ho municipal mansini no mu wɔ Frao mantam (Volta region) mu wɔ Ghana. Ho Central abatoɔ mpesua no mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no yɛ akonnwa a NDC kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo no na watena so dodoɔ pa ara.

Mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ 
Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron ne mmienu abatoɔ mu no (1992), Ho Central abatoɔ no mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no abatoɔ mu no, amannyɔkuo a yɛfrɛ wɔn National Convention Party ananmusini a wɔde no bae ne Owura Vincent Kofi Darkey-Mensah. Abatoɔ no baa awieɛ no na National Convention Party ananmusini no adi nkunim wɔ  Ho Central abatoɔ no mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no abatoɔ mu.

Ho Central abatoɔ no mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no abatoɔ mu no, Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron ne nsia (1996) abatoɔ mu no, amannyɔkuo a ne din de National Democratic Congress a wɔn ahyɛnsodeɛ ne kyiniiɛ no ananmusini a wɔde no bae ne Owura Kofi Attor. Abatoɔ no baa awieɛ no na  kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo National Democratic Congress ananmusini Kofi Attor adi nkunim wɔ  Ho Central abatoɔ no mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no abatoɔ mu.

Wɔ afe mpem  mmienu ne nan abatoɔ mu no (2004), Ho Central abatoɔ no mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no abatoɔ mu no, amannyɔkuo a yɛfrɛ wɔn National Democratic Congress a wɔn ahyɛnsodeɛ ne kyiniiɛ no sesaa wɔn ananmusini a wɔde no baa afe apem ahankron ne aduokron ne nsia (1996) abatoɔ mu no. NDC kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo no de Owura Capt (rtd.) George Kofi Nfodjoh na ɛbɛgyinaa wɔn ananmu wɔ Ho Central abatoɔ mpesua no so.  Abatoɔ no baa awieɛ no na kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo National Democratic Congress ananmusini Owura Capt (rtd.) George Kofi Nfodjoh adi nkunim wɔ  Ho Central abatoɔ no mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no abatoɔ mu.

Wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du-mmienu abatoɔ mu no (2012), Ho Central abatoɔ no mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no abatoɔ mu no, amannyɔkuo a yɛfrɛ wɔn National Democratic Congress a wɔn ahyɛnsodeɛ ne kyiniiɛ no sane yɛɛ nsesaeɛ bio wɔ wɔn ananmusini a wɔde no baa afe mpem  mmienu ne nan abatoɔ mu no (2004), abatoɔ mu no. NDC kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo no de Owura Benjamin Komla Kpodo na ɛbɛgyinaa wɔn ananmu wɔ Ho Central abatoɔ mpesua no so. Abatoɔ no baa awieɛ no na kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo National Democratic Congress ananmusini Owura Benjamin Komla Kpodo adi nkunim wɔ Ho Central abatoɔ no mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no abatoɔ mu.

title: Gushegu (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Gushegu (yɛ mpesua nom baako a ɛwɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwam. Wɔyi mmarahyɛbadwanii baako a ne din wɔ abatoɔ nkrataa nom a ɔgyina hɔ ma saa mpesua no. Gushegu wɔ atifi mantam wɔ Ghana.

Mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ 
Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduosia num (1965) wɔ Gushegu mpesua so no, Sulemana Ibn Iddrisu a ɔwɔ akokɔ amanyɔkuo convention people's party na wɔtoo na no tenaa mpesua no akonnwa no. Seth Adam Ziblim  a ɔwɔ National Alliance of Liberal amanyɔkuo nso tenaa akonnwa no so wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduosia nkron (1969). Abdulai Al-Hassan a ɔwɔ popular Front party amanyɔkuo nso bɛyɛɛ mmarahybadwanii wɔ mpesua no so wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduoson nkron (1979). Wɔ kwasafoman a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa abatoɔ wɔ Gushegu-Karaga mpesua wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduoson nkron (1979) no Issahaka Mahama a ɔwɔ kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress na ɔdii aba no. Gushegu-Karaga abatoɔ a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ kwasafoman a ɛtɔ so nan wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron mmienu (1992) no kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo anamusini Issahaka Mahama na ɔsane tenaa akonnwa no so.Iddrisu Huudu a ɔwɔ kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress nso bɛgyee akonnwa no firii Issahaka Mahama nsam wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia (1996). Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan (2004) mu no Rita Tani Iddi a na ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party tenaa akonnwa no so wɔ Gushegu mpesua so. Kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress anamusini Thomss Kwesi Nasah nso gyee akonnwa no firii ne nsam wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe (2008) nom. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia (2016) mu no ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party de anamusini foforɔ a wɔfrɛ no Ziblim Iddi ma no bɛperee akonnwa no. Alhassan Tampuli Sulemana a ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party nso bɛgyee akonnwa no firii Ziblim Iddi nsam wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu (2020) nom.

title: Mfantseman
text:
()

Mfantseman yɛ mpasua baako a ɛwɔ mmrahyɛbadwamu wɔ Gaana. Wɔ to aba abatoɔ afe biara mu yi mmarahyɛbadwani ma no si wɔn anan mu wɔ mmarahyɛbadwamu. Mfantseman wɔ Dayi Anaafoɔ mansini mu wɔ  Flawu mamtamu wɔ Gaana. Wɔ te mpasua yi wɔ afe 2012  wɔ abre a wɔ bɛ to Gaana abatoɔ kese no.

Ahyeɛso 
Mpasua yi wɔ Mfantseman Mansini wɔ Mfinfini mamtamu wɔ Gaana.

Mmarahyɛbadwafo

Ne wuo no si yɛ wɔ abre a na aka nda kakrabi ma wɔn ato afe  2020 abatoɔ, Article 112 (5) ma 1992 Gaana ɔmanmara kyerɛ sɛ , ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔ to aba foforo wɔ mpasua no so  gye sɛ Gaana abatoɔ kɛse no pɛ.

Amanyɔkuo anan na wɔgyina wɔ mpasua no so ma wɔ to wɔn so aba.

title: Karaga (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Karaga( yɛ mpesua nom baako a ɛwɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwam wɔ Ghana. Wɔyi mmarahyɛbadwanii baako a ne din wɔ abatoɔ nkrataa nom a ɔgyina hɔ ma saa mpesua no. Karaga wɔ Karaga mansini a ɛwɔ Ghana atifi mantam.

Abakɔsɛm 
Ɛka  mpesua beberebe no a wɔtee no wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan (2004) amanpaninfoɔ ne mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ abatoɔ no ho.

Ɛhyeɛ 
Mpesua no akonnwa no hyɛ Karaga mansini  a ɛwɔ Ghana atifi mantam.

Mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ 
Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan(2004) mu no Iddrisu Dawud a ɔwɔ kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress na ɔperee mpesua no akonnwa no.

Abatoɔ 
Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe (2008) Ghana mmarahyɛbedwam abatoɔ nom no, nnipa nsia na ɛperee mpɛsoa no akonnwa no. Iddrisu Dawuda a ɔwɔ kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress nyaa mma mpem du mmiɛnsa, ahasa ne aduosia baako(13,361) a  ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduonum nsia akyirepɔ mmienu (56.2%). Baba Wahab a ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party nso nyaa mma mpem nkron, ahanson ne aduowɔtwe mmiɛnsa (9,783) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduanan baako akyirepɔ baako(41.1%). People's National convention anamusini Mohammed Tong Doo nso nyaa mma ahasa ne baako (301) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu baako akyirepɔ mmiɛnsa (1.3). Ɔhanu ne aduosia nan(264) a  ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu baako akyirepɔ baako na Haruna Abukari a ɔwɔ Democratic freedom party nso nyaeɛ. Adam Abubakari Mohammed  a ɔwɔ akokɔ amanyɔkuo convention people's party nso nyaa aduasa ne nsia(36) a ɛyɛ akyirepɔ nan(0.4). Democratic people's party anamusini Adam Yussifu anya mma biara.

Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan Ghana mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ abatoɔ wɔ Karaga no, nnipa mmienu na ɛperee mpesua no akonnwa no. Kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress anamusini Iddrisu Dawuda sane peree akonnwa no biom a ɔnyaa mma mpem du nan, ahannwɔtwe ne aduosia nnwɔtwe (14,868) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduosia nan akyirepɔ mmiɛnsa (64.3). Osman Issah Abubakari a ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party nso peree mpesua no akonnwa a ɔnyaa mpem nnwɔtwe,ɔha ne aduokron mmienu (8,192) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduasa num akyirepɔ num(35.5)

title: Kpandai (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Kpandai (yɛ mpesua nom baako a ɛwɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwam no ho. Wɔyi mmarahyɛbadwanii baako a ne din wɔ abatoɔ nkrataa nom a ɔgyina hɔ ma saa mpɛsoa no. Kpandai wɔ Ghana atifi mantam. Mmarahyɛbedwani a ɔte mpesua no akonnwa no so seisei ne Daniel Nsala Wakpal. Ɛnam kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress so na wɔtoo no so aba yii no ma no nyaa mma mpem mmienu ne aduoson mmiɛnsa (2,073) a ɛyɛ mma dodoɔ a ɔnya kyɛnn n'sɔretiafoɔ a ɔde dii nkunim wɔ mpesua no abatoɔ nom de bɛyɛɛ mmarahyɛbadwanii. Ɔbɛgye akonnwa no firii Mathew Nyindam a ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbedwanii a ɔgyina maa mpesua no wɔ kwasafoman a ɛtɔ so nsia wɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party anan mu ɛna ɔsane nyaa akwanya biom gyina maa mpesua no mfeɛ nan biom wɔ berɛ ɔdii nkunim wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia biom wɔ kwasafoman a ɛtɔ so nson wɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party anan mu. Ɛno akyire no "Deputy Chief" no dii ntwo maa n'sɔretiafoɔ, Daniel Nasal Wakpal a ɔwɔ kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress aberɛ a ɔnyaa mma mpem aduonu mmienu,ahannsia ne aduosia nkron(23,669) tia Kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress anamusini no mma mpem aduonu num, ahankron ne aduanan baako (25,941). Mmarahyɛbadwanii ma Kpandai mpesua  Daniel Nsala Wakpal yɛ anamusini ma mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ a yɛtoo wɔnso aba yii wɔn wɔ mfeɛ  mpem mmienu ne aduonu (2020) Ghana mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ abatoɔ wɔ kwasafoman a ɛtɔ so nson wɔ Kyiniiɛ a amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress anan mu.

Mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ 
Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron mmienu (1992), afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia (1996) ɛna mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe (2008) nom no, Kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress anamusini Lipkalimor Kwajo Tawiah na ɔperee akonnwa no. Matthew Nyindam a ɔno nso wɔ Kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress nso bɛtoa  so wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu (2012), mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia (2016) mu. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu mu no(2020) Daniel Nsala Wakpal a ɔwɔ kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress nso bɛgyee akonnwa no firii Matthew Nyindam nsam

Ɛhyeɛ 
Mpesua no akonnwa no hyɛ Kpandai mansini a ɛwɔ Ghana atifi mantam.

title: Builsa North (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Builsa North( Builsa Atifi fam (Builsa North) yɛ mpɛsoa no mu baako a ɛgyenam  wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛwɔ Ghana mu. Wɔn faa first past the post abatoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ anaa sɛ abatoɔ kwan so de too aba yii mmarahyɛbadwani baako. Yɛ bɛ hunu Builsa Atifi fam wɔ Builsa mansini no mu wɔ Atifi Apueɛ Mantan mu wɔ Ghana  (Upper East Region of Ghana). Amanyɔkuo a ɛte so siesie wɔ saa mpɛsoa no soɔ ne kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress (NDC) a James Agalga yɛ wɔn mmarahyɛbadwani. James Agalga firii Ɛkuro a yɛ frɛ no sɛ Chuchuliga na wɔn woo no ɛda Kwasiada wɔ Bosome kutawonsa ne da a ɛtoso du wɔ mfei apem ahankron aduoson nkron (10 June 1979) a na manyɔkuo ne National Democratic Congress (NDC).

Ahyeɛ 
Builsa mpɛsoa no wɔ Builsa mansini a ɛwɔ Atifi Apueɛ Mantan mu wɔ Ghana (Upper East Region).

1.1 Farebae 
Builsa Atifi (North) 23 mansini no ka amammuo mansini dummiɛnsa (13)a ɛwɔ (Upper East) Atifi Apueɛ Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Wɔnyaa Builsa Atifi (North) mansini no de firii Builsa Mansini no mu wɔ Ɔbɛnem bosome no ne da a ɛtɔ so dunum wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne dummienu (15th March 2012) no mu de firi tumi a mmerahyɛ badwamfoɔ de di dwuma mu (Act of Parliament), afe apem ahankron ne aduokron mmiɛnsa (1993) (Act 462) a Sandema yɛ Mansini no amammuo kuropɔn. Deɛ ɛhia pa ara nti a wɔn tee saa mansini ne sɛ ɛde aban ndwuma  bɛbrɛ Ghanafoɔ a wɔn tete hɔ no nyinaa pono ano. Builsa Atifi (North) mansini no kura nnipa dodoɔ mpem aduonum nsia, ahanan ne aduoson nson (56,477) a wɔn wɔ mpɔtam aduokron nwɔtwe (98).

Nneɛma a ɛda adi

1.2.1 Beaeɛ a ɛwɔ ne ne kɛseɛ 
Mpɛsoa no tenten mu (longitudes) da 10 05"West ne 10 35" West ne latitudes 100 20" North. Builsa North mantam ɛhyeɛ ne Kassena-Nankana West mantam a ɛwɔ ne atififam, wɔ ne atɔeɛfam ne Sissala East mantam, wɔ ne apueeɛfam ne Kassena-Nankana East Municipal na wɔ anaafoɔfam ne Builsa South mantam. Mantam no kata nsase bɛyɛ 816.44030 Km2 so.

1.2.2 Ahotɔ ne asuka ho nsɛm

Beaeɛ no asase mfonini no kyinkyim na esiane firi susufidie ( meters) ahanu (200) de kɔsi ahasa (300) wɔ atɔeɛ ne atifi fam a ɛwɔ mansini ne mu ne titire deɛ ɛwɔ Bachonsa ne Chuchuligu beaeɛ. Wɔ Sissili, Kulpawn, Tono, Asibelika ne Azimzim mmɔnka mu no, nsianeeɛ no nyɛ gidigidi na efiti susufidie (meters) ɔha ne aduonum (150) de kɔsi ahanu (200) mu.

1.2.3 Ewiem tebea

Mansini no wɔ bosome a ɔhyɛw ne awɔ wɔ mu a efiti 21.90 C ne 34.10 C. Mansini no ɔhyɛw anaa awɔ a ɛwɔ soro paa no baa wɔ Ɔbɛnem bosome mu na ebetumi akɔ soro 450 C, na deɛ ɛwɔ fam koraa no nso ba wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome no mu. Berɛ a nsuo ntɔ no deɛ ɛba ne ɔpɛ mframa. Nsutɔberɛ yɛ baako pɛ, a ɛhyɛ ase nketenkete firi Oforisuo bosome de kɔsi akɛseɛ mu wɔ Ɔsaana-ɛbɔ bosome mu, na ɛtete ntam a egyae koraa wɔ Ahinime bosome no mfinimfin mu berɛ a ɔpɛberɛ no bɛhyɛ aseɛ no.

1.2.4 Afifideɛ 
Nea wobɛhunu wɔ mansini no ho ne Savannah kwae a ɛwɔ nnua a ne haban no po wɔ mmerɛ ne mmerɛ mu, egya a agye ntam kwan kɛseɛ, ne nnua a ɔpɛ ntumi wɔn a wɔn akɛseɛ gu mu ahodow bebere ne nwura a ahwete afebɔɔ a nhaban nso ka ho bi. Ɛnam nipa dwumadie nti, Savannah kwae no so ate a abɛyɛ asase tam a nnua a ekuta bi ne baobab, acacia, sheanut ne dawadawa a ɛso mfasoɔ de sika ba.

1.2.5 Anwea 
Wɔnya Builsa North anwea firi sɛnea yɛsi yɛ aboɔ bi te sɛ Granite, Birimian rocks, Voltaian shale, kane ne siesie Alluvium of mixed origin ne terraces asubɔnten dada. Ɛwɔ yienom mu no, anwea a yɛtae hunu wɔ mansini no mu ne granite origin a ɛkata mansini no nsase bɛyɛ ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduoson (70%) ( bɛyɛɛ 153,300ha) so.

Amanyɔsɛm Amammuo 
Builsa North mansini no nhyiam no kuta nnipa dodoɔ aduanan num (45) a ɛmu aduasa baako (31) yɛ nnipa a wɔtoo aba yii wɔn, emu dunan (14) nso yɛ nnipa a wɔyii wɔn ne ex-officio nkurɔfoɔ a wɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwamfoɔ ne mansini no mpanimfoɔ (DCE). Mansini no  mprempren nhyiamfoɔ wɔ mmaa nsia (6) a wɔ wɔn mu no, wɔtoo aba yii mu nan (4) na mmienu (2) nso nyɛ abatoɔ na wɔde yii wɔn. Mansini no wɔ Town Councils mmienu (2) ne Area Councils mmiɛnsa (3) ne beaeɛ a yɛto aba aduasa baako (31). Yeinom ne Sandema Town Council, Wiaga Town Council, Siniensi Area Council, Kadema Area Council ne Chuchuliga Area Council. Amanmuo mu no, mansini no nhyiam wɔ ekuo kuo a adidisoɔ yi a wɔde dwuma wɔ District Coordinating Director; Health Service Directorate, Ghana Education Service (GES), Department of Community Development, Birth and Deaths Registry, District Environmental Health unit, Department of Agriculture ase. Aman agyinananfoɔ a adidisoɔ yi nka ekuo kuo a ɛwɔ mansini no nhyiam no ho nso di dwuma wɔ mansini no mu; National Service Secretariat,  the National Commission for Civic Education (NCCE), Immigration Service, CEPS, ne Polise adwumakuo no.

1.3.1 Agyinatukuo a ɛwɔ mansini no nhyiam 
Agyinatukuo a adidisoɔ wɔ ammamuo mmara mu na wɔdi dwuma wɔ amanyɔsɛm ne ammamuo wɔ mansini no mu. Agyinatukuo mpanimfoɔ (a agyinatukuo nketewa a adidisoɔ yi boa wɔn): Sikasɛm ne Ammamuo, Nnwuma, Atɛntenenee ne Ahobammɔ, Mpuntuo ho nhyehyɛeɛ, Apɔmuden ne Atenaeɛ, Nwomasua, Kuadwuma, Mma ne Mmɔfra. Agyinatukuo afoforo a ɛwɔ mansini no mu: Mansini HIV/AIDS agyinatukuo, Mansini ahobambɔ agyinatukuo, Mansini ntɔtɔfeewa agyinatukuo, Mansini ntɔtɔfeewa nhwehwɛ mu bio agyinatukuo, mpanimfoɔ ho nsɛm agyinatukuo, ne Mansini no Sikasɛm ho ntotoeɛ.

Asetena ne Amammerɛ Tebea

1.4.1 Amammerɛ nhyehyɛeɛ 
Wɔ Builsa North mansini mu no ahenie a ɛkorɔn yɛ baako pɛ a ɛwɔ Sandema Traditional Area. Amammerɛ beaeɛ a ɛwɔ tumi no wɔ akandifoɔ nkyekyɛmu dummienu a yɛfrɛ wɔn sɛ„Kanbunabas“ a wɔhyɛ Sandema Nab ase. Saa akandifoɔ mu nkyekyɛmu nketewa yi hwɛ nsɛm bi te sɛ ahenie, amammerɛ, amaneɛ ne nsɛm bi a ɛfa amammerɛ kuo ne ankorɛankorɛ akandifoɔ nkyekyɛmu nketewa a Sandema Nab di wɔnyina soɔ. Ahenie nhyehyɛdeɛ ne adwumakuofoɔ bi bɔm di dwuma a ɛde asomdwoeɛ bɛba beaeɛ hɔ.

1.4.2 Mmusua 
Abusua a agye afa mansini no mu nyinaa ne Builsa. Builsafoɔ yɛ bɛyɛ ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduowɔtwe mmiɛnsa (83) wɔ nnipa dodoɔ no nyinaa mu. Ɔha nkyekyɛmu dunson (17) a aka no yɛ mmusua nketewa a ɛyɛ Kantosi, Mamprusi, Sissala, Nankani, Mossi ne mansini no akwantufoɔ adwumayɛfoɔ kakra a wɔfiri Burkina-faso. Saa mmusua yi akyɛ wɔ mansini no mu yiye a wɔboa mansini no mpuntuo.

1.4.3 Ɔsom ahodoɔ 
Ɔsom akuo titire a ɛwɔ mansini no mu ne Akristofoɔ, Nkramofoɔ, ne amammerɛfoɔ. Ɔsom a ɛdɔɔso ne abibifoɔ amammerɛ som, a ɛyɛ ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduanan nsia (46) wɔ mansini no nnipa dodoɔ nyinaa mu nea adi so ne Kristo som a ɛyɛ ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduonu nwɔtwe (28)  na Nkramo som nso yɛ aduonu mmiɛnsa (23). Ɔsom a aka no nso yɛ bɛyɛ ɔha nkyekyɛmu mmiɛnsa ne akyirepɔ ohunu (3.0) wɔ asomfoɔ dodoɔ no nyinaa mu. Sunsum dibea yi boa ma asomdwoe ne mpuntuo ba.

1.4.4 Afahyɛ 
Afahyɛ yɛ dwumadie bi a ɛho hia pa ara wɔ Builsa North mansini mu. Feok afahyɛ yɛ afahyɛ bi a wɔdi no afe afe de kae nkunim a Builsa nananom nsamanfoɔ dii no wɔ Babatu ne ne mammɔfoɔ nkoa kafoɔ so wɔ nineteenth century. Afahyɛ yi tae ba wɔ Ɔpɛnimma nanwɔtwe a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa na abɛyɛ buronya mfitiaseɛ wɔ mansini no mu. Ɛnam sɛ mansini no abakɔsɛm ho hia nti nsrahwɛfoɔ dodoɔ no ara de wɔn ho hyɛ afahyɛ yi die mu.

1.4.5 Awareɛ 
Amammerɛ awareɛ nhyehyɛeɛ wɔ akwan soronko anaa ayeforɔ yere ho sika tua, ɛyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a ayeforɔ kunu abusua yɛ awareɛ ahyɛdeɛ a wɔde nneɛma bi te sɛ base, schnapp ne sika dodoɔ bi ba. Nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛwɔ soro yi boa ma ayɔnkofa a ɛda mmusua yi mu yɛ den.

1.4.6 Adedie

Mansini no di agyadeɛ. Ɔbabarima panin na ɔdi ne papa a wawuo no adeɛ a abusuafoɔ nyinaa gye tum. Nhyehyɛeɛ no mma ho kwan ma mmammaa nnya agyapadeɛ ho kwan wɔ wɔn amammerɛ mu a agyapadeɛ bi te sɛ asase nso ka ho.

1.4.7 Ayiyɛ

Ayiyɛ ka dwumadie a ɛho hia pa ara wɔ Builsa mansini no mu. Ɛho hia pa ara a ɛkyerɛ akwantuo a ɛtwa toɔ wɔ asase so de ma owuofoɔ ne dea ɛde no rekɔ nananom nsamanfoɔ hɔ anaa „awiase foforo mu.“  Wakyɛ ayiyɛ ho nhyehyɛeɛ no mu mmienu. Deɛ adi kan no wɔfrɛ no "Kumka“ wɔyɛ no mmerɛ kumaa bi mu firi berɛ a nipa no bɛwu. Wɔde nnawɔtwe yɛ ayie no ne ho nhyehyɛeɛ nyinaa ma owufoɔ no. Deɛ ɛtwa toɔ no nso wɔfrɛ no "Juka“ wɔyɛ saa ayie wɔ berɛ a abusua mpanimfoɔ akɔ nhyiamu bebree na wɔn nyinaa adwene akɔ bɛnkorɔ mu.

1.4.8 Asase din ne wɔn wura 
Builsa North mansini no asase nyɛ ankorɛankorɛ bi dea na mmom abusua mpanimfoɔ a wɔhwɛ asase no so wɔ wɔn abusua ananmu dea. Ɔhene no na mmom ɔhwɛ asase no nkyekyɛeɛ ne ne tɔn so. Tindanafoɔ (kuromafoɔ anaa wɔn a wɔbɛ tenaa asase no so kane) ne asase no wuranom ankasa.

Sikasɛm 
Builsa North mansini no yɛ akuraase bi a dwuma a ebu afa so wɔ hɔ ne kuadwuma a ɛyɛ adwuma titire a akuafoɔ a wɔn anakasa yɛ wɔn dwuma yɛ de nya sika. Builsa North mansini no wɔ beaeɛ a ɛyɛ pa ara a ɛtwetwe nsrahywɛfoɔ. Deɛ ɛka ho bi ne Sissili Central kwae a wɔde asie a ne beaeɛ wɔ 155.09sq km, Abuga Crocodile pond a ɛwɔ Uwasi, Fiisa Abosomfie ne Doninga nkoa dwa.

title: Kumbungu (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Kumbungu( yɛ mpesua nom baako a ɛwɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbedwam. Wɔyi mmarahyɛbedwanii baako a ne din wɔ abatoɔ nkrataa nom a ɔgyinaa hɔ ma saa mpesua no. Kumbungu wɔ Ghana atifi mantam. Mmarahyɛbedwani a ɔte akonnwa no so seisei ne Dr. Hamzah Adam. Ɔdii nkunim wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu nom(2020).

Mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ 
Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron mmienu (1992) no Alhassan Musah a ɔwɔ kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress na ɔperee akonnwa no. Wɔde anamusini foforɔ baeɛ ma no bɛgyina maa mpesua no wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia (1996) a yɛfrɛ no Muhammed Mumuni. Yakubu K Moro a ɔwɔ kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress nso bɛtoa ne nnwuma no so wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan (2094) nom. Ɛna Muhammed Mumuni  a ɔwɔ kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress nso bɛtoa so wl mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu (2012) nom. Ɔhɔ na Moses Amadu Yahaya a ɔwɔ akokɔ amanyɔkuo convention people's party nso bɛtuu no wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmiɛnsa (2013). Wɔfrɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia mu no (2016) Ras Mubarak a ɛwɔ kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress nso bɛgye firii wɔn nsam. Ɛna Hamza a ɔwɔ kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress tu wɔn adeɛ so wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu(2020) nom.

Abatoɔ 
Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia (2016) Ghana abatoɔ wɔ Kumbungu no, nnipa num na ɛgyina maa mpesua no. Ras Mubarak a ɔwɔ kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress nyaa mma mpem du nnwɔtwe, ahanson ne aduoson nson(18,777) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduonum num akyirepɔ mmiɛnsa (55.3%).Akokɔ amanyɔkuo convention people's party anamusini  Amadu Moses Yahaya nyaa mpem nnwɔtwe, ahanan ne num(8,405) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduonu nan akyirepɔ aduosia mmiɛnsa (24.63). Iddrisu Muntaru a ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party nso nyaa mpem num, ɔha ne aduokron nsia (5,196) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu du num akyirepɔ aduonu mmiɛnsa (15.23%). Mma apem,ahannsia ne aduonu mmiɛnsa (1,623) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu nan akyirepɔ aduoson nsia na Abubakari Abdul Gatawu a ɔwɔ progressive peoples party amanyɔkuo mu nyaeɛ. Ɛna All people's Congress anamusini Mohammed Muntaru Sulemana nso nyaa mma ɔha ne aduonu baako (121) a ɛyɛ akyirepɔ aduasa n(0.35%).

Beaɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ.

title: Bimbilla (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Bimbilla( yɛ mpesua nom baako a ɛwɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbedwam. Wɔyi mmarahyɛbedwanii baako a ne din wɔ abatoɔ nkrataa nom a ɔgyinaa hɔ ma saa mpɛsoa no. Bimbilla wɔ Nanumba North mansini a ɛwɔ Ghana atifi mantam.

Ɛhyeɛ 
Mpesua no hyɛ Nanumba North mansini a ɛwɔ Ghana atifi mantam.

Mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ 
 
 Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron mmienu (1992) mu no Mohammed Ibn Chambas a ɔwɔ kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress na ɔgyina maa mpɛsoa no. 
 George Mpambi Dagmanyi a ɔwɔ People's National convention nso gyina maa mpesua no wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia (1996). 
 Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu (2000) mu no Mohammed Ibn Chambas a ɔwɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress na ɔbɛdii akonnwa no so. 
 Ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party anamusini Dominic Aduna Bingab nso bɛdii mpesua no so wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne mmienu nom(2002).      
 Mohammed Ibn Abass no bɛgyee akonnwa no wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan (2004) nom a na ɔwɔ Kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress mu. 
 Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe (2008) nom no Dominic Aduna Bingab Nitiwul a ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party sane bɛtenaa akonnwa no so biom wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe (2008) nom.

Abatoɔ

Hyɛ no nso 
Dominic Aduna Bingab Nitiwula ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party mu na ɔdii nkunim wɔ abatoɔ wɔtoo ma obi atena mpesua no akonnwa no so ɛnam sɛ ada hɔ akyɛ wɔ ɔbenim bosome da a ɛtɔ so du na  mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne mmienu nom(14,march 2002) berɛ Mohammed Ibn Chambas gyae akonnwa no too hɔ kɔfaa n'adwuma foforɔ sɛ ɔtwerɛtwerɛfoɔ ma "Economic Community of West Africa States".

Beaɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ.

title: Sagnarigu (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Sagnarigu (yɛ mpesua nom baako a ɛwɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbedwam. Wɔyi mmarahyɛbedwanii baako a ne din wɔ abatoɔ nkrataa nom a ɔgyina hɔ ma saa mpɛsoa no. Sagnarigu wɔ Tamale  mansini adantam a ɛwɔ Ghana atifi mantam. Wɔtee mpesua no aberɛ a wɔreto Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu (2012) nom.

Ɛhyeɛ 
Sagnarigu mpesua akonnwa no hyɛ Tamale "Metropolitan" mansini a ɛwɔ Ghana atifi mantam mu.

Mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ 
Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu(2012) nom no, Alhassan Bashir Fuseini a ɔwɔ kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress nkoa na ɔperee mmarahyɛbedwan akonnwa no.

Abatoɔ 
Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ wɔ Sagnarigu no, nnipa nan na ɛperee mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ akonnwa no wɔ saa mpesua no so. Kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress anamusini Alhassan Bashir Fuseini nyaa mma mpem aduonu nsia, ahannwɔtwe ne aduokron nnwɔtwe (26,898) ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduoson akyirepɔ aduosia nnwɔtwe (70.68). Habib Iddrisu a ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party nso nyaa mpem nson, ahannwɔtwe ne aduowɔtwe nnwɔtwe (7,888) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduonu akyirepɔ aduoson mmiɛnsa (20.73). Mma mpem mmienu, ahannwɔtwe ne aduonu (2,820) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu nson akyirepɔ aduanan baako (7.41) na akokɔ amanyɔkuo convention people's party anamsini Zalia Issah nyaeɛ. Progressive people's party anamsini Jamaldeen Ahmed nso nyaa mma ahanan ne aduanan nkron(449) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu baako akyirepɔ du nnwɔtwe (1.18).

Beaɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ.

title: Tamale Central (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
p
Tamale Central( yɛ mansini nom baako a ɛwɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbedwam. Wɔyi mmarahyɛbedwanii baako a ne din wɔ abatoɔ nkrataa nom a ɔgyina hɔ ma saa mpɛsoa no. Tamale Central wɔ Tamale"Metropolitan"mansini wɔ atifi mantam wɔ Ghana. Wɔtee mpesua no akonnwa wɔ berɛ a wɔreto mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ aba no. Wɔm reto aba ayi obi ama no atena akonnwa a bi tenaa so akyɛ wɔ mpesua hɔ no wɔ Oforisuo bosome da a ɛtɔ nan wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nsia (4,april 200-) mu no, Alhassan Fuseini Inusah a ɔwɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress na ɔdii nkunim a ɔnyaa mma dodoɔ a ɛyɛ mpem du nson, ahanum ne mmienu (17,502). Ɛna Alhassan Wayo Seini a ɔwɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress nso twee ne diberɛ saneɛ de ne ho kɔbɔɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party nanso ɔdii ntwo wɔ abatoɔ nom.

Ɛhyeɛ 
Mpesua no akonnwa no wɔ Tamale mansini adantam a ɛwɔ Ghana atifi mantam.

Mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ. 
Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan nom no(2004) Alhassan Wayo Seini a ɔwɔ kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress nkoa na ɛperee mpɛsoa no akonnwa no. Ɛna mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nsia (2006) nso  Alhassan Fuseini Inusah a ɔwɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress na ɛbɛtenaa akonnwa no so.

Abatoɔ 
Wɔ berɛ a wɔreto aba ayi obi ama  no atena akonnwa a asi hɔ akyɛ wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nsia nom wɔ Tamale Central no nnipa num na ɛperee akonnwa no. Kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress anamsini Alhassan Fuseini Inusah nyaa mma mpem aduonu nkron, ne  aduowɔtwe baako (29,081) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduosia nnwɔtwe akyirepɔ mmiɛnsa (68.3). Alhassan Wayo Seini a ɔnni amanyɔkuo biara mu nso nyaa mma mpem du baako,ahanum ne aduoson nkron (11,579) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduonu nson akyirepɔ mmienu (27.2). Basharu Alhassan Daballi a ɔwɔ akokɔ amanyɔkuo convention people's party nso nyaa apem,ahasa ne aduosia num(1,365) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu mmiɛnsa akyirepɔ mmienu (3.2).  Ahanan ne du nsia (416) a  ɛyɛ akyirepɔ nkron (0.9) na Ahmed  Abdul-Rahim a ɔnni amanyɔkuo biara mu nyaeɛ. Rita Adams Rukaya a ɛwɔ Democratic people's party nso nyaa ɔha ne aduonum nson(157) a ɛyɛ akyirepɔ mmiɛnsa (0.3)

Ɛwɔm sɛ Alhassan Wayo Seini afiri National Democratic Congress akɔ New patriotic party deɛ nanso berɛ a wɔn repɛ abi ama no asi akonnwa no so na ɔnni amanyɔkuo biara mu. Mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan(2004) Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Tamale Central no, nnipa nan na na wɔn din wɔ abatoɔ nkrataa nom a wɔgyinaa hɔ maa mpɛsoa no. Alhassan Wayo Seini a ɔwɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress no nyaa mma mpem aduasa num, ahannsia ne aduasa num(35,635) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduonum nnwɔtwe akyirepɔ mmienu (58.2).  Adam Mohammed Amin, ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party anamusini nso nyaa mpem aduonu  mmienu,ahannsia  ne du nan (24,614) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduanan akyirepɔ mmienu (40.2). Iddrisuɔwɔ People's National convention nyaa mma ahannsia ne aduokron mmiɛnsa (693) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu baako akyirepɔ baako (1.1). Dr. Adam Game Nasser a ɔwɔ akokɔ amanyɔkuo convention people's party nso nyaa mma ahasa ne aduonu nkron (329) a ɛyɛ akyirepɔ num(0.5).

Beaɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ.

title: Bawku Central (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Bawku Central( yɛ mpesua nom baako a ɛwɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbedwam. Wɔyi mmarahyɛbedwanii baako a ne din wɔ abatoɔ nkrataa nom a ɔgyina hɔ ma saa mpɛsoa no. Bawku Central wɔ Bawku mansini adantam a ɛwɔ apueɛ do mantam wɔ Ghana.

Ɛhyeɛ 
Mpesua no akonnwa no hyɛ Bawku mansini adantam a ɛwɔ apueɛ do mantam wɔ Ghana mu.Ɛnam mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ no nti, wɔyii Pusiga mansini ɛfiri Bawku Central mpesua na ɛnkane wɔfrɛ no Bawku East mansini. Mpesua no a ɛwɔ hɔ seisei no sua kyɛn nea na ɛwɔ hɔ ansana wɔreto mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan mu no (2004) abatoɔ no.

Mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ 
Mmarahyɛbadwanii a ɔte akonnwa no so seisei no Mahama Ayariga a wɔtoo no so aba wɔ ɔpɛnimaa bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu nom(December, 2020). Na Ayariga yɛ Ghana mmarahyɛbedwanii ma Bawku Central firi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne num(2005) nom nanso ɔdii ntwo wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe (2008) abatoɔ nom maa Adamu Dramani Sakande a ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party mu faa akonnwa no. Akonnwa no bɛdaa hɔ pann wɔ aberɛ Adamu dii nyammrasɛm a wɔkyerɛ no tum sɛ wagyina hɔ ama yato aba ama no wɔ berɛ ɔyɛ ɔman ba wɔ ɔman foforɔ so a ɛtia Ghana  amammra nom. Ayariga sane bɛnyaa n'akonnwa no biom wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu (2012) Ghana abatoɔ nom. Wayi ama no abɛyɛ mmarahyɛbedwanii ama mpesua no wɔ kwasafoman a ɛtɔ so nan, nsia, nson ne nnwɔtwe wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbedwa wɔ Ghana asɛnnibea kɛseɛ (Supreme Court)) de Adamu Draamani Sakande tomm sɛ wɔde nsɛm bi a ɛnnyɛ nokware abɛto dwa wɔ kitawonsa bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nson wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu (27 july,2012). Wei nso di asɛm bi a Mr Sumaila Biebel, a ɔhwɛ anantwie so de baa "hight Court" wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nkron(2009) mu sɛ Dramani wɔ aman mmienu "British ne Burkinabé" nkrataa ɛtumi ma no tu kwan nni ɔntumi nyina sɛ mmarahyɛbedwanii.

Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron mmienu (1992) mu no, Hawa Yakubu a ɔnni amanyɔkuo biara no petee Bawku Central mpesua akonnwa no. Fati Seidu a ɔwɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress nso peree akonnwa no wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia (1996). Hawa Yakubu de ne ho kɔbɔɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress peree mpesua no akonnwa no wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu (2000) nom. Ɛna mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan mu no Kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress de nnipa foforɔ baeɛ ma no bɛperee akonnwa no a wɔfrɛ no Mahama Ayariga. Adamu Dramani Sakande a ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party nso gyinaa hɔ maa mpɛsoa no wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe n(2008). Mahama Ayariga a ɔwɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress sane bɛperee akonnwa no biom wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu (2012) ɛna mfeɛ mpem ne du nsia (2016) mu.

Abatoɔ 
Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe(2008) Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ nom no, nnipa num na ɛgyina maa mpɛsoa no.  Adamu Dramani a ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party mu no nyaa mma mpem aduonu, ɔha ne aduonum nson (20,157) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduonum mmiɛnsa akyirepɔ nan(53.4). Mahama Ayariga a ɔwɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress nso nyaa mma mpem du nson, ahasa ne aduowɔtwe num(17, 385) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduanan nsia akyirepɔ baako(46.1). Democratic freedom party anamusini Alhaji Imoro Yaro-N-Kano nyaa  aduoson baako(71) a ɛyɛ akyirepɔ baako (0.1). People's National convention anamusinii Amidu Alhaji Mamudu Sisaka nyaa aduonum nan(54) a ɛyɛ akyirepɔ baako (0.1). Rodalin Imoru Ayarna a ɔwɔ akokɔ amanyɔkuo convention people's party nso nyaa aduonum mmienu (52) a  ɛyɛ akyirepɔ baako (0.1).

Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan (2004) wɔ  Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ nom no, nnipa nsia na ɛperee mpesua no akonnwa no. Mahama Ayariga a ɔwɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress nyaa mma du nnwɔtwe, ahanum ne du nnwɔtwe (18,518) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduanan nwɔtwe akyirepɔ nsia(48.6). Abubakar Ustarz a ɔnni amanyɔkuo biara mu no nso nyaa mpem nnwɔtwe, ahanum ne aduoson nan(8,574) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduonu mmienu akyirepɔ num (22.5). Mma ahasa ne aduonum mmiɛnsa (353) a ɛyɛ akyirepɔ nkron (0.9) na Tiaban Kunduma a ɔwɔ akokɔ amanyɔkuo convention people's National nyaeɛ. Amidu Mahama a ɔwɔ people's National convention nyaa ahasa ne aduasa mmiɛnsa (333) a ɛyɛ akyirepɔ nkron (0.9). Ɔha ne aduosia baako (161) a ɛyɛ akyirepɔ nan(0.4) na Sadat Amadu a ɔnni amanyɔkuo biara nyaeɛ.

Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu (2000) Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ wɔ Bawku Central no, nnipa num na ɛperee mpesua no akonnwa no. Hawa Yakubu a ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party nyaa mma mpem aduonu mmienu, ahaasa ne aduasa num(22,335) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduanan nwɔtwe akyirepɔ nsia(48.6). Fati Seidu a ɔno nso wɔ Kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress nso nyaa mma mpem aduonu baako, ahanan ne aduosia baako (21,461) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduanan nsia akyirepɔ nson(46.7). People's National convention anamusini Abdul k. Yussif nyaa apem,ahanu ne aduasa nkron (1,239) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu mmienu akyirepɔ nson(2.7). United Ghana Movement anamusini Hadi Melayia nso nyaa mma ahanum ne num (505) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu baako akyirepɔ baako (1.1). Yakubu S Kundiima a ɔwɔ akokɔ amanyɔkuo convention people's party nso nyaa mma ahanan ne aduonum baako (451) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu baako(1.0).6

title: Wa East
text:
Wa East (Ghana mmarahyɛbadwam mpɛsua ) (yɛ mpɛsuasoɔ no mu baako a ɛwɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwam. Wɔtoo aba yi mmarahyɛbadwani baako a odii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ no mu. Wa East wɔ Wa Apuei mansini a ɛwɔ Atɔeɛ Sor Mantam wɔ Ghana.

Wa East mpɛsua a ɛwɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwam.

Godfred Seidu Jasaw na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani de ma Kyinie amanyɔkuo (NDC) no wɔ Wa East mansini no mu wɔ Upper West Mantam wɔ Ghana.

Ɛhyeɛ 
Wa East mansini a ɛwɔ Upper West Mantam wɔ Ghana na akonnwa no wɔ.

Mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ 
Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron mmienu (1992) mu no Alhaji Issahaku Saliah na na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani de ma Kyinie amanyɔkuo (NDC) no.

Wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne nan (2004) mu no Bayon Godfrey Tangu na na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwami de ma Ɔsono amanyɔkuo (NPP) no. 

Wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne aduonu (2020) mu no Godfred Seidu Jasaw na na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma Kyinie amanyɔkuo (NDC) no.

Abatoɔ 
Mfe mpem mmienu  ne nwɔtwe (2008) mmarahyɛbadwam abatoɔ

Bayon Godfred Tangu a na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma Ɔsono amanyɔkuo (NPP) no nyaa mma mpem du ne aduanan nson (10,047) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduanan nwɔtwe akyiri pɔ ohunu (48.0%).

Ameen Salifu a na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma Kyinie amanyɔkuo (NDC) no nyaa mma nkron ne aduasa nson (9,037) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduanan mmiɛnsa akyiri pɔ mmienu (43.2%). 

Adam Basuglo Surajdeen a na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma Ɔdeneho amanyɔkuo (Independence) no nyaa mma apem ahasa ne dunkron (1,319) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu nsia akyiri pɔ mmiɛnsa (6.3%). 

Ibrahim Hidaja Sungjum a na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma PNC amanyɔkuo no nyaa mma ahasa ne aduoson baako (371) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu baako akyiri pɔ nwɔtwe (1.8%).

Yakubu Sangu a na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma CPP amanyɔkuo no nyaa mma ɔha ne aduanan (140) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu ohunu akyiri pɔ nson (0.7%). 

Mma dodoɔ: Apem ne du (1,010) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu nan akyiri pɔ nwɔtwe (4.8%).

title: Nkoranza North (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Nkoranza North () yɛ mpɛsuasoɔ no mu baako a ɛwɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwam. Wɔtoo aba yi mmarahyɛbadwani baako a odii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ no mu. Nkoranza North wɔ Nkoranza Mansini a ɛwɔ Bono East Mantam wɔ Ghana.

Nkoranza Atifi mpɛsua a ɛwɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwam.

Wɔtee mpɛsua no wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne nan (2004) mu a na Derek Oduro na ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani de ma Ɔsono amanyɔkuo(NPP) no wɔ Nkoranza mansini no mu wɔ Bono Atɔeɛ Mantam wɔ Ghana.

Wɔtee akonnwa no titiri Ghanaman mmarahyɛbadwam abatoɔ a wɔtoo no wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne nan (2004) mu a Ɔsono amanyɔkuo (NPP) no adi so afiri saa berɛ no bɛsi ɛnnɛ berɛ yi.

Abatoɔ a an ɛtɔ so mmienu a wɔtoo no wɔ Ɔbɛnem bosom da a ɛtɔ so dummiɛnsa wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nson (March 13 2007) mu a Ɔsono amanyɔkuo (NPP) no anamsini Derek Oduro nyaa mma no mu dodoɔ a ɔde dii nkonim wɔ akonnwa no so.

Ɛhyeɛ 
Akonnwa no wɔ Nkoranza Mansini a ɛwɔ Bono Apuei Mantam wɔ Ghana. Ɛkata Atifi mansini fam. Atɔeɛ fam no yɛ Nkoranza Anafo mpɛsua. Atɔeɛ hyeɛ no yɛ Techiman Atifi mpɛsua a ɛwɔ Techiman mansini no mu. Atifi fam no yɛ Kintampo Anafo mpɛsua a ɛwɔ Kintampo Anafo mansini no mu ɛna Pru mpɛsua no nso wɔ Pru mansini a ɛwɔ Atifi Apuei fam. Atebubu Amantin mpɛsua a ɛwɔ Atebubu-Amantin mansini no mu na ɛtee Apuei hyeɛ no. Ejura Sekyedumase mpɛsua a ɛwɔ Ejura/Sekyedumase mansini no mu wɔ Asante Mantam na ɛtee Atɔeɛ Apuei hyeɛ no.

Abakwasɛm 
Ghana aban kominsan dii kan tee mpɛsua no wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne nan (2004) mu a ɛnnɛ mmerɛ yi mpɛsua aduonu nkron (29) na abɛka ho ama mpɛsua no akɔ sor afiri ahanu (200) kɔsi ahanu ne aduasa (230).

Mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ 
Mfe mpem mmienu ne nan (2004) mu na wɔtee mpɛsua no.

Wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne nan (2004) abatoɔ no Eric Amoateng na na ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani de ma Ɔsono amanyɔkuo (NPP) no.

Wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne nwɔtwe (2008) abatoɔ no Derek Oduro na na ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani de.ma Ɔsono amanyɔkuo (NPP) no.

Abatoɔ 
Mfe mpem mmienu ne nwɔtwe (2008) Ghanaman Mmarahyɛbadwam abatoɔ.

Ɔsono amanyɔkuo (NPP) no anamsini Derek Oduro nyaa mma no mu mpem nkron ahanu ne dubaako (9,211) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduonum baako akyiri pɔ nwɔtwe (51.8%).

Kyinie amanyɔkuo (NDC) no anamsini Kwadwo Agyei Dwomor so nyaa mma mpem nwɔtwe ɔha ne aduanan mmienu (8,142) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduanan num akyiri pɔ nwɔtwe (44.8%).

Amayaw Yahaya a na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma Akokɔ amanyɔkuo (CPP) no nyaa mma ahanan ne dunum (415) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu mmienu akyiri pɔ mmiɛnsa (2.3%).

Osei Bonsu Jnr a na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma DPP amanyɔkuo no annya amma no bia.

Mma dodoɔ: Mpem mmiɛnsa ahanson ne aduanan mmienu (3,742) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu dunkron akyiri pɔ nwɔtwe (19.8%).

Nkoranza North abatoɔ a ɛtɔ so mmienu, mfe mpem mmienu ne nson (2007).

Derek Oduro na na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma Ɔsono amanyɔkuo (NPP) no wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne nson (2007) abatoɔ a awɔtoo no bio no, ɔnyaa mma mpem du ɔha ne aduoson nkron (10,179) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduosia mmiɛnsa akyiri pɔ nson (63.7%).

Kofi Amoako-Gyambah na na ɔyɛ anamsini ma Kyinie amanyɔkuo (NDC) no wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne nson (2007) abatoɔ wɔtoo no bio no, ɔnyaa mma mpem num ahansia ne aduokron nan (5,694) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduasa num akyiri pɔ nsia (35.6%).

Osei Bonsu Jnr na na ogyina mu ma DPP amanyɔkuo no wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne nson (2007) abatoɔ a wɔtoo no bio no, ɔnyaa mma ɔha ne aduonu mmienu (122) a na agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu ohunu akyiri pɔ nson (0.7%).

Mma dodoɔ: Mpem nan ahanan ne aduowɔtwe num (4,485) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduonu nwɔtwe akyiri pɔ baako (28.1%).

Nimpa a wɔtoo aba no: Mpem dunkron ahanan ne aduokron (19,490) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduowɔtwe akyiri pɔ num (80.5%).

Mfe mpem mmienu ne nan (2004) Ghanaman Mmarahyɛbadwam abatoɔ.

Mfe mpem mmienu ne nan (2004) Ghanaman Mmarahyɛbadwam abatoɔ no Eric Amoateng na na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma Ɔsono amanyɔkuo (NPP) no, ɔnyaa mma mpem nkron ɔha ne aduanan nan (9,144), sɛ wode kɔ ɔha nkyekyɛmu a agyina hɔ ma aduanan nwɔtwe akyiri pɔ nan (48.4%).

Mfe mpem mmienu ne nan (2004) Ghanaman Mmarahyɛbadwam abatoɔ no Francis Hayford Amoako na na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma Kyinie amanyɔkuo (NDC) no, ɔnyaa mma mpem num ahanan ne mmienu (5,402) a sɛ wode kɔ ɔha nkyekyɛmu a agyina hɔ ma aduonu nwɔtwe akyiri pɔ nsia (28.6%).

Mfe mpem mmienu ne nan (2004) Ghanaman Mmarahyɛbadwam abatoɔ no, Prince Adjei Ofosu na na ogyina mu ma Ɔdeneho amanyɔkuo (Independence) no, ɔnyaa mma mpem nan ahasa ne aduonum nan (4,354) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduonu mmiɛnsa akyiri pɔ ohunu (23.0%). Mma dodoɔ: Mpem mmiɛnsa ahanson ne aduanan mmienu (3,742) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu dunkron akyiri pɔ nwɔtwe (19.8%).

title: Dormaa Central (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Dormaa Central () yɛ mpesua nom baako a ɛwɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbedwam. Wɔyi mmarahyɛbedwanii baako a ne din wɔ abatoɔ nkrataa nom a ɔgyina hɔ ma saa mpesua no. Dormaa Central wɔ Dormaa mansini adantam a ɛwɔ Bono mantam wɔ Ghana. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu Ghana abatoɔ nom na wɔtee mpesua no.

Ɛhyeɛ 
Mpesua no akonnwa no hyɛ Dormaa mansini adantam a ɛwɔ Bono mantam wɔ Ghana.

Mmarahybadwafoɔ 
Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ abatoɔ no Kwaku Agyemang-Manu a ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party nkoa na ɔperee mpesua akonnwa no.

Abatoɔ 

 
 
 
 

Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduosia nkron (1969) ne afe apem ahankron ne aduoson nkron (1979)mu no na Dormaa mpesua nkoa na ɛwɔ hɔ. Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron mmienu (1992) ne mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe (2008) abatoɔ ntam no, na Dormaa West ne Dormaa East mpesua nkoa na ɛwɔ hɔ. Wɔtee Dormaa Central mpesua no ansan woreto mfeɛ mpem ne du mmienu (2012) aba no.

Beaɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ.

title: Bortianor-Ngleshie-Amanfrom(Ghana mmarahyɛbadwam mpesua)
text:
Bortianor-Ngleshie-Amanfrom() uyɛ mpesua nom baako a ɛwɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbedwam. Wɔyi mmarahyɛbedwanii baako a ne din wɔ abatoɔ nkrataa nom a ɔgyina hɔ ma saa mpɛsoa no. Bortianor-Ngleshie-Amanfro wɔ Ga south mansini adantam a ɛwɔ Nkran punpuni mantam wɔ Ghana.

Ɛhyeɛ 
Mpesua no akonnwa no hyɛ Ga South mu a ɛwɔ Nkran punpuni mantam wɔ Ghana.

Mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ 
Habib Saad a ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party na ɔgyina maa mpesua no wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia (2016) nom.

Abatoɔ 
Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia (2016) mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ no, nnipa num na ɛgyina maa mpesua no. Habib Saad a ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party nyaa mma mpem aduonu nsia ne aduasa nsia (26,036) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduonum mmiɛnsa akyirepɔ nkron (53.09). Kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress anamsini Bright Edward Kodzo Demordzi nyaa mma mpem du nkron, ahanan ne num(19,405) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduasa nkron akyirepɔ aduonum nson(39.57%). Adjetey Larbie a ɔwɔ progressive peoples National nso nyaa mma mmienu, aduonum ne aduonu nkron (2,529) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu num akyirepɔ du nsia (5.16%). Evans Nii Djabum Mensah a ɔwɔ Democratic people's party nso nyaa mma ahannwɔtwe ne aduosia nson (867) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu baako akyirepɔ aduoson nson(1.77%). Akokɔ amanyɔkuo convention people's party anamsini Peter Adzido nso nyaa ahanu(200) a ɛyɛ akyirepɔ aduanan baako (0.41%).

Beaɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ.

title: Sene West (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Sene Atɔeɛ () yɛ mpasua baako a ɛwɔ mmarahyɛbadwamu wɔ Ghana. Wɔ te mpasua yi ansa wɔreto Ghana abatoɔ kese no wɔ afe  2012  mu.  Wɔ to aba yi mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ Ghana abatoɔ biara mu. Sene  Atɔeɛ  mpasuaso wɔ Bono Apueeɛ mantam wɔ Ghana.  Wɔ te mpasua yi fi  Sene mpasua mu. Wɔ afe 1992 mu no na ɛka Sene mpasuaso ho wɔ nkani Brong Ahafo mamtamu. Wɔ kyɛ Sene mpasua mu mienu frɛ no Sene Apueɛ ne Sene Atɔeɛ wɔ afe 2012 mu. T  Wɔ kyɛ Brong Ahafo mamtamu miensa frɛ no, Bono, Ahafo and Bono Apueeɛ mamtamu. Sene Atɔeɛ wɔ Bono Apueeɛ mamtamu.

Ɛhyeɛ 
Egwa yi wɔ  Sene mansini mu wɔ Bono Apueeɛ mamtamu wɔ Ghana.

Mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ

Abatoɔ

title: Shatta Wale
text:
Shatta Wale() yɛ nnwontuni wɔ Ghana. Charles Nii Armah Mensah Jr., ( yɛwoo no 17 Ahinime  1984) ɔyɛ Ghana reggae-dancehall nnwomtoni. Edin a nnipa dodoɔ no ara nim wɔ ne nnwomtoɔ mu ne Shatta Wale, a kane no na yɛfrɛ no Bandana. Ne nnwom a agye din pa ara ne "Dancehall King", "My level", ne "We taking over " a ɛnam so maa no nya abasobɔdɛ sɛ Artiste of the year wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne dunan (2014) mu wɔ Vodafone Ghana Music Awards abasobɔdeɛ no mu. Ɔsan ne Amerika nnwomtonibaa Beyonce yɛɛ nwom  "Already". Wale san yɛ siniyɛfoɔ a yɛhunu no wɔ sini Never say Never, The trial of Shatta Wale ne Shattered Lives mu. Wɔyii Wale nnwom a ɔyɛeɛ a yɛto no din "Moko Hoo" wɔ Ghana Music Awards mu.

Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne dunan (2014) mu no, ɔbaa n'anim bɛtoo so aduasa nwɔtwe (38) wɔ E.tv's "Top 100 Most Influential Ghanaian" abasobɔbeɛ nhyehyeɛ no mu no. Ɛfiri saa berɛ no, ne din ba abasobɔdeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ no mu afe bi ara. Ɔnyaa dibea sɛ "Most Influential Musician" wɔ abɛɛfo ntetan kɛseɛ so wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne dunson (2017) mu. Ɔnyaa record-setting sɛ dancehall nnwomtoni a ɔde nyaa abasobɔdeɛ dubaako (11) wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne dunkron (2019) 3 Music Awards dwumadie ase.

Abrabɔ mfitiaseɛ 
Yɛwoo Charles Nii Armah Mensah Jr. wɔ Polisefoɔ ayaresabea a ɛwɔ Nkran, Ghana wɔ Ahinime bosome ne da a ɛtɔ so dunson wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe nan (1984). Charles Nii Armah Mensah Snr ne Elsie Evelyn Avemegah ne na wofoɔ. Ne papa yɛ amanyɔni, dwadeni ne legal practitioner.

Shatta Wale kɔɔ Seven Great Princes Academy a ɛwɔ Dasoman, borɔno bia ɛwɔ Nkran mu, ɛhɔ na ɔdaa ne dɔ a ɔwɔ ma adwinni (arts) adi na ɔyɛɛ ahwɛgorɔ a agye din yiye, By the Fireside, wɔ Ghana National Theatre.

2019-2020

Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne dunkron (2019) mu no ɔne Beyonce bɔɔmu too nnwom a yɛto din "Already" wɔ ne album The Lion King: so, akyadeɛ yi maa yɛbɔɔ ne din wɔ Grammy Awards mu.

2021

Wɔ mfeɛ mpem aduonu ne aduonu baako (2021) mu, yɛbɔɔ ne din wɔ abasobɔdeɛ mmienu mu na ɔdii nkunim sɛ 'Best Virtual Entertainer of the year' abasobɔdeɛ wɔ International Reggae and world Music Awards (IRAWMA) mu.

Konsɛte ( Concert ) 
Ɔyɛ Ghanani a ɔdii kan hyehyɛɛ digital concert wɔ YouTube so a na wato din sɛ Faith Concert. Wɔhyehyɛɛ saa concert yi sɛdeɛ ɛde anidasoɔ bɛbrɛɛ Ghanafoɔ ne n'atiefoɔ nyinaa ɛwɔ wiase afanaa nyinaa berɛ a na wɔreko atia yare kɔdiawuo COVID-19 Asoeɛ a ɛhwɛ nkutahodie so, Ghana, yii ɔno ne Kuami Eugene a ɔyɛ Highlife nnwomtoni sɛ annwomtofoɔ a ɛda COVID-19 app virtual concert a wɔyɛɛ no ɛdwoda Oforisuo bosome ne da a ɛtɔ so dummiɛnsa, wɔ mfeɛ mpem aduonu ne aduonu (2020) mu no ano. Wɔ Memeneda Ahinime bosome ne da a ɛtɔ so dunson wɔ mfeɛ mpem aduonu ne aduonu (2020) mu, Ɔtoo n'awoda apontoɔ kɛseɛ a ne nnamfofoɔ ne n'abusuafoɔ baa bi wɔ East Legon berɛ a na wadi mfeɛ aduasa nsia (36).

Abɔdin 
Mayor a ɔwɔ Worcester, Joseph Petty, maa Shatta Wale kurow no safoa wɔ Oforisuo bosome ne da a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe, wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne dunson mu (2017) mu.

Wɔ Ɔbɛnem bosome ne da a ɛtɔ so dunwɔtwe wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne dunwɔtwe mu no (2018), wɔmaa Wale nnidie abasobɔdeɛ ɛnam ne mmoa a ɔde boa reggae wɔ Ghana wɔ 37th Annual Chicago Music Awards (CMA) mu, ɛne 36th International Reggae & World Music Awards (IRAWMA).

Nnwuma a ne nsa hyehyɛ aseɛ 
Ɛwɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne dunan mu (2014), Wale bɛyɛɛ adwumakuo no ho dawurobɔ nanmusini maa Guinness Ghana Breweries, ne Rush Energy Drink nso.

Wɔ Ɛbɔ bosome mu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne dunson (2017) mu no, Kasapreko Company, wɔn a wɔyɛ nsa a ɛboro ne nea ɛmmoro wɔ Ghana, maa obiara hunuu sɛ Wale ne wɔn dwumakuo no ho dawurobɔ ananmusini foforo ma Storm Energy Drink.

Wɔ Obubuo bosome ne da a ɛtɔ so dunson wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne dunson (2017) mu no, Shatta Wale ne Boss Baker Roll nyaa nteaseɛ maa no bɛyɛɛ adwumakuo no ho dawurobɔni nanmusini. Infinix Ghana, smartphone adwumakuo, wɔ Wukuada, Ɛbɔ bosome no ne da a ɛtɔ so dubaako, wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne dunkron (2019) bɔɔ dawuro sɛ Shatta Wale ne wɔn dwumadie ne ho dawurobɔ ananmusini.

Ntawantawa 
Wɔ Ahinime bosome mu wɔ mfeɛ mpem aduonu ne aduonu baako (2021) mu no, wɔsusu sɛ Shatta Wale hyehyɛɛ nnaadaa sɛm bi sɛ yato no tuo ma ɔregye ayarehwɛ. Akyire no ɔde ne ho kɔmaa apolisefoɔ a na ɔreka sɛ wɔrehwehwɛ no. Ghana polise adwumakuo no kyii no sɛ ɔrehyehyɛ nsɛm a ɛde suro ne ehu bɛba. Wɔde no too apolisefoɔ asoeɛ nnawɔtwe. Wɔ ɛbenada, Ahinime bosome ne da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nsia wɔ mfeɛ mpem aduonu ne aduonu baako (2021) mu no, wɔmaa no self-recognizance bail a wɔgyee no Ghana sika mpem ɔha (GH100,00) wɔ today's hearing mu. Watu asɛm no akɔhyɛ Obubuo bosome ne da a ɛtɔ so nkron, 2021. Nnawɔtwe mmienu akyi no wɔyii nnwomtoni, wɔsan so kyii no wɔ ɔne apolisefoɔ nsɛm ho berɛ a na wɔne nnipa a wagye din pa ara reyɛ nhyiam bia yɛfrɛ no behest of Ghana's Police Chief. Shatta Wale kaa di a wɔne no anni no yie wɔ nhyiam no ase berɛ wɔmaa kwan maa ne mfɛfoɔ nyina de wɔn phone dii dwuma a na wɔpɛ nanso wɔn amma ne saa akwanya no bi. Akyire no ɔbaa nhyiam no ase bɛkutoo IGP George Akuffo Dampare anim serɛɛ bɔne fakyɛ.

title: Walewale (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Walewale () yɛ mpesua nom baako a ɛwɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbedwam. Wɔyi mmarahyɛbedwanii baako a ne din wɔ abatoɔ nkrataa nom a ɔgyina hɔ ma saa mpɛsoa no. Walewale wɔ West Mamprusi mansini adantam a ɛwɔ atifi apueɛ mantam wɔ Ghana. Ɛyɛ mansini adantam ahenkuro a ɛwɔ West  Mamprusi mansini nom. Ɛnkane no na wɔfrɛ mpesua no West Mamprusi mpesua.

Ɛhyeɛ 
Mpesua no akonnwa no hyɛ Nanumba South mansini a ɛwɔ atifi mantam wɔ Ghana.

Mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ 
Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron mmienu (1992) nom no, Ben Baluri Saibu a ɔwɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress mu na ɔdii nkunim wɔ abatoɔ nom. Sussana Adams a ɔno nso wɔ National Democratic Congress nso peree mpesua no akonnwa no afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia (1996) a ɔnyaeɛ. People's National convention anamusini Issifu Asumah nso gyinaa maa mpesua no wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu (2000). Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan (2004) mu no kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress de anamusini foforɔ,  Alidu Iddrisu Zakari  ba ma no bɛperee akonnwa.

Abatoɔ 
Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ wɔ Walewale no, nnipa num na ɛgyina maa mpesua no. Alidu Iddrisu Zakari a ɔwɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress nyaa mma mpem du mmiɛnsa, ahannwɔtwe ne aduasa nkron (13,839) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduanan akyirepɔ nsia(40.6). Ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party anamusini Nabila Sulemana nso nyaa mma mpem du mmienu, ahannwɔtwe ne aduonu nnwɔtwe (12,828) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduasa nson akyirepɔ nsia(37.6). Mma mpem nson ne aduonu(7,020) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduonu akyirepɔ nsia(20.6) na people's National convention anamusini Abdallah Abubakar nyaeɛ. Akokɔ amanyɔkuo convention people's party anamsini Azaratu Iddrisu Sampa nyaa ahanu ne aduosia num(265) a ɛyɛ akyirepɔ nnwɔtwe (0.8). Adam Mampaya Dadimsugru a ɔwɔ Democratic freedom party nyaa mma no ɔha ne aduosia baako (161) a ɛyɛ akyirepɔ num(0.5).

Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan (2004) Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ wɔ Walewale no nnipa nan na ɛperee mpesua no akonnwa no. Alidu Iddrisu Zakari a ɔwɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress sane peree akonnwa no wɔ saa afe nom a ɔnyaa mma mpem du baako, ahanu ne aduonum num(11,255) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduasa num akyirepɔ mmiɛnsa (35.3). Ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party anamusini Nabila Sulemana nso nyaa mma mpem du, ahanan ne aduokron (10,490) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduasa mmienu akyirepɔ nsia(32.6). Mma mpem du ne nson(10,007) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduasa baako akyirepɔ baako (31.1) na people's National convention anamusini Mbah Jacob Kanzoni nyaeɛ. Ahmed Issahaku a ɔwɔwɔ akokɔ amanyɔkuo convention people's party anamsini nyaa mma ahasa ne aduonum nkron(359) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu baako akyirepɔ baako (1.1).

Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu (2000) Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ West Mamprusi mpesua so no, nnipa num na ɛperee mpesua no akonnwa no. people's National convention anamusini Issifu Asumah nyaa mma mpem du nnwɔtwe, ahankron ne nson (18,907) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduonum num akyirepɔ nan(55.4) National Democratic Congress anamusini Sussana Adams nso nyaa mma mpem du mmienu,ahanson ne aduasa num(12,735) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduasa nson akyirepɔ mmiɛnsa (37.3). Mma apem, ahanum ne nkron (1,509) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu nan akyirepɔ nan(4.4) na ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party anamsini Amadu Abdul-Karim nyaeɛ. Akokɔ amanyɔkuo convention people's party anamsini Shani Danladi nyaa ahansia ne aduasa baako (631) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu baako akyirepɔ nnwɔtwe (1.8).IIiasu Yusif a ɔwɔ National Reform Party nso nyaa mma ahasa ne aduasa nkron (339) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu baako (1.0).

Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia (1996) Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ wɔ Walewale no nnipa nan na ɛperee mpesua no akonnwa no. Kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress anamsini Susanna Adams nyaa mma mpem aduonu mmiɛnsa, ne aduonu baako (23,021) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduosia mmiɛnsa (63 .0).  People's Convention party anamusini Stephen Sumani Nayina nso nyaa mma mpem nnwɔtwe, ahanson ne aduosia baako (8,761) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduonu nan(24.0). Amadu Sulemana a ɔno nso wɔ People's National convention nyaa mma mpem mmiɛnsa, ahannwɔtwe ne aduasa mmiɛnsa (3,833) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu du akyirepɔ num (10.5). Sulemana Wakaso Musah a ɔwɔ National convention party nso nyaa mma ahankron ne aduasa nnwɔtwe (938) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu mmienu akyirepɔ num (2.5).

title: Ledzokuku (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Ledzokuku() yɛ mpesua nom baako a ɛwɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbedwam. Wɔyi mmarahyɛbedwanii baako a ne din wɔ abatoɔ nkrataa nom a ɔgyina hɔ ma saa mpesua no. Ledzoku wɔ Dangme East wɔ Nkran punpuni mantam wɔ Ghana. Gulf of Guinea (ɛfiri Kpeshie Lagoon de kɔ Sakumono junction) aka mansini adantam no ne anaafoɔ no abom . Ɛtoaso saa fa keteke kwan no so fa Sakumono de fa "in the run traffic light" ."Spintex road  de rekɔ Coca cola roundabout" ne apueɛ no na ɛbom. Ɛfa benkum ne nifa wɔ Johnson wax. Ɛhyeɛ no atifi na moto kwan dekɔ Tetteh Quarshie"interchange"  de fa anaafoɔ  a Ashitey Akomfra abatoɔ beaɛ ne kpeshie Lagoon. Mpesua no yɛ efie ma ayaresabea baako a agye din wɔ Nkran, Lekma ayaresabea.

Mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ 
Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron mmienu (1992) mu na Nii Adjei-Boye Sekan a ɔwɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo (National Democratic Congress) mu peree mpesua no akonnwa no. saa anamsini yi sane peree akonnwa no wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia (1996) wɔ amanyɔkuo noa mu. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu (2000) mu no Eddie Akita a ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo (New patriotic party) nso peree akonnwa no. Dr. Gladys Norley Ashitey a ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo (New patriotic party) nso gyina maa mpesua no wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan (2004) nom. Kyiniiɛ (National Democratic Congress) anamsini Nii Nortey Dua nso peree akonnwa no wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe (2008) mu. Kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo no (National Democratic Congress) sane yii anamusini foforɔ ma no bɛperee akonnwa no a yɛfrɛ no Benita Sena Okity-Duah wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu (2012).Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia (2016) mu no Ɔsono amanyɔkuo (New patriotic party) nso sesaa wɔn anamusini de Dr. Benard Okoe Boye. (National Democratic Congress) nso sesaa wɔn anamusini wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu (2020) a yɛfrɛ no Ben Ayiku ma no peree mpesua no akonnwa no.

Abatoɔ 
Mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ a yɛtoo wɔn so aba yii wɔn wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe (2008) nom wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ wɔ Ledzokuku no, nnipa nsia na ɛgyina maa mpesua no. Nii Nortey Dua a ɔwɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo (National Democratic Congress) nyaa mma mpem aduanan mmienu ne aduowɔtwe nson (42,087) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduonum nsia akyirepɔ nsia(56.6). Gladys Norley Ashitey a ɔwɔ kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo New patriotic party nso nyaa mma mpem aduasa,ahansia ne aduonu mmienu (30,622) a ɛ

Me ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduanan baako akyirepɔ mmienu (41.2). Mma ahannwɔtwe ne aduasa mmienu (832) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu baako akyirepɔ baako (1.1) na akokɔ amanyɔkuo convention people's party anamsini Griffiths Agoe Sowah nyaeɛ. Olan Adjetey a ɔnni amanyɔkuo biara mu nyaa ahannsia ne du mmienu (612) a ɛyɛ akyirepɔ nnwɔtwe (0.8). Nathaniel Nii Okai Aryittey a ɔwɔ (Democratic freedom party) nyaa mma ɔha ne du(110) a ɛyɛ akyirepɔ baako (0.1). New vision Party anamusini Angela Adams nyaa aduowɔtwe nsia(86) a ɛyɛ akyirepɔ baako (0.1).

Mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ a yɛtoo wɔn so aba yii wɔn wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia (2016) nom wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ wɔ Ledzokuku no, anamusifoɔ num na na wɔn din wɔ abatoɔ nkrataa nom a yɛtoo wɔn so aba. Benard Okoe Boye a ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party mu nyaa mma mpem aduanan num, ahanu ne aduonum nkron(45,259) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduonum akyirepɔ aduoson num (50.75). Kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo (National Democratic Congress) anamusini Benita Sena Okity-Duah nyaa mma mpem aduanan mmiɛnsa ne aduokron mmienu (43,092) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduanan nwɔtwe akyirepɔ aduasa mmienu (48.32%). Mma ahanan ne aduasa mmiɛnsa (433) a ɛyɛ akyirepɔ aduanan nkron(0.49) na akokɔ amanyɔkuo convention people's party anamsini Emmanuel Nii Ashia Anyankor nyaeɛ. Stephen Stanley Quaye a ɔnni amanyɔkuo biara nso nyaa mma ahasa ne du(310) a ɛyɛ akyirepɔ aduasa num(0.35%). People's National convention anamusini Yakubu Faharudeen nso nyaa mma aduokron num(95) a ɛyɛ akyirepɔ du baako (0.11).

title: Klottey Korle (Ghana mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa)
text:
Klottey Korle yɛ mpesua nom baako a ɛwɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbedwam. Wɔyi mmarahyɛbedwanii baako a ne din wɔ abatoɔ nkrataa nom a ɔgyina hɔ ma saa mpɛsoa no. Klottey Korle wɔ Nkran punpuni mantam wɔ Ghana. Mmarahyɛbadwanii a ɔte Klottey Korle mpesua no akonnwa no so seisei ne Dr. Zanetor Agyemang-Rawlings.

Mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ 

Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron mmienu (1992) mu no Nathan Tetteh Mensah a ɔwɔ EGLE amanyɔkuo mu na ɔtenaa mpesua no akonnwa no so. Kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo ?National Democratic Congress) anamusini David Lamptey nso peree mpesua no akonnwa no wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia (1996). Nii Adu Daku Mante a ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo (New patriotic party) nso peree akonnwa no wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu (2000) nom. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe (2008) nom no, kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo (National Democratic Congress) de anamusini foforɔ a yɛfrɛ no Nii Armah Ashietey ba bɛperee akonnwa no. Kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo (National Democratic Congress) sane de Zanetor Agyemang-Rawlings baa mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia (2016) nom ma no sane bɛgyina maa mpesua no.

Abatoɔ 
Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu (2020) Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ wɔ Klottey Korle no, nnipa mmiɛnsa na ɛperee mpesua no akonnwa no. Zanetor Agyemang-Rawlings a ɔwɔ kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo (National Democratic Congress) nyaa mma mpem aduasa nkron, ahasa ne aduanan mmiɛnsa (39,343) a ɛyɛ akyirepɔ aduonum num akyirepɔ aduosia nsia(55.66). Prince Appiah Debrah a ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party nso nyaa mma mpem aduasa mmiɛnsa, ɔha ne aduonum nan(31,154) ɛyɛ aduanan nan akyirepɔ nson(44.07). Liberal party of Ghana anamusini Fred Ntow Boateng nyaa mma ɔha ne aduokron(190) a ɛyɛ akyirepɔ aduonu nson(0.27).

Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia (2016) Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ wɔ Klottey Korle  mpesua no, nnipa nan na ɛperee mpesua no akonnwa no. Zenator Agyemang Rawlings a ɔwɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress nyaa mma mpem aduasa mmiɛnsa, ahansia ne nkron (33,609) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduonum akyirepɔ aduonu nkron (50.29). Ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party anamusini Philip Kojo Addo Addison nyaa mma mpem aduonu nkron, ɔha ne aduonu mmienu (29,122) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduanan mmiɛnsa akyirepɔ aduonum nson(43.57). Nii Noi Nortey Valentino a ɔnni amanyɔkuo biara mu nso nyaa mma mmiɛnsa, ahankron ne du baako (3,911) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu num akyirepɔ aduowɔtwe num(5.85). Mma ɔha ne aduokron nan(194) a ɛyɛ akyirepɔ aduonu nkron (0.29) na Godwin Opare Addo a ɔwɔ akokɔ amanyɔkuo convention people's party nyaeɛ.

Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu (2012) Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ wɔ Klottey Korle no nnipa nson na ɛperee mpesua no akonnwa.Nii Armah Ashietey a ɔwɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress nso nyaa mma mpem aduasa nsia, ɔha ne aduonu mmienu (36,122) a ɛyɛ akyirepɔ aduanan nwɔtwe akyirepɔ aduonum num(48.55).

Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe (2008) Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ wɔ Klottey Korle no nnipa mmiɛnsa na ɛperee mpesua no akonnwa no.Nii Armah Ashietey a ɔwɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress nyaa mma mpem aduasa, ahansia ne aduasa mmiɛnsa (30,633) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduonum akyirepɔ nsia(50.6). Mma mpem aduonu nnwɔtwe ne du baako (28,011) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduanan nsia akyirepɔ mmiɛnsa (46.3) na Samuel J. Adjei Tawiah a ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party nyaeɛ. Akokɔ amanyɔkuo convention people's party anamsini Monica Naa Ayao Quarcoopome nso nyaa mma aha ne ahankron (1,900) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu mmiɛnsa akyirepɔ baako (3.1).

Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan (2004) Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ nom wɔ Klottey Korle no, nnipa nan na ɛperee mpesua no akonnwa no. Ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party anamusini Nii Adu Daku Mante nyaa mma mpem aduasa mmienu, ahanu ne aduosia mmiɛnsa (32,263) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduanan num akyirepɔ nsia(45.6).Nii Armah Ashietey a ɔwɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress sane peree mpesua no akonnwa no biom a ɔnyaa mma mpem aduasa, ahasa ne aduonum baako (30,351) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduanan num akyirepɔ nsia (45.6). Mma mpem mmiɛnsa ne mmiɛnsa (3,003) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu nan akyirepɔ num(4.5) na Godwin Opare-Addo a ɔwɔ akokɔ amanyɔkuo convention people's party nyaeɛ. People's National convention anamusini Richard Addo Buckman nyaa mma ahankron ne du (910) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu baako akyirepɔ nan(1.4).

Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu (2000) mu wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ wɔ Klottey Korle mpesua so no, nnipa nsia na ɛgyina maa mpesua no. Nii Adu Daku Mante a ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party sane peree mpesua no akonnwa no a ɔnyaa mma mpem aduonu nkron, ahanu ne aduanan (29,240) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduonum baako akyirepɔ nson(51.7). National Democratic Congress anamusini David Lamptey nyaa mma mpem aduonu, ahanu ne aduonu mmienu (20,222) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduasa num akyirepɔ nson(35.7). H.M Nii Torgbor Cofie-Squire a ɔwɔ United Ghana Movement nyaa mma mpem mmienu, ahanson ne du nson (2,717) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu nan akyirepɔ nnwɔtwe (4.8). Akokɔ amanyɔkuo convention people's party anamsini Godwin Opare-Addo nyaa mma mpem mmienu,ahanu ne aduokron nnwɔtwe (2,298) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu nan akyirepɔ baako (4.1). Emmanuel C. Gustav Lartey a ɔwɔ National Reform Party nso nyaa mma apem, ahasa ne aduanan mmiɛnsa (1,343) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu mmienu akyirepɔ nan (2.4). People's National convention anamusini U. Babamma Mohammed nyaa mma ahanson ne aduanan nson(747) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu baako akyirepɔ mmiɛnsa (1.3).

Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia (1996) mu wɔ Klottey Korle Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ nom no nnipa num na ɛgyina maa mpesua no akonnwa no.David Lamptey a ɔwɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress nyaa mma mpem aduonu, ahanan ne aduowɔtwe num(20,485) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduasa mmiɛnsa akyirepɔ du mmienu(33.12). Tei Okunor a ɔnni amanyɔkuo biara mu no nso nyaa mma mpem du nson, ahanu ne num(17,205) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu ahanu nson akyirepɔ aduowɔtwe baako (27.81). Ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party anamusini Gilbert K. Quartey nyaa mma mpem du nson ne aduokron (17, 090) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduonu nson akyirepɔ aduosia mmiɛnsa (27.63). Adolg Lutterodt a ɔwɔ People's Convention party mpem nan, ahannwɔtwe ne aduokron nson (4,897) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu nson akyirepɔ aduokron mmienu (7.92). Kwame Nyarko Akuffo-Mensah a ɔnni amanyɔkuo biara mu no nso nyaa mma mpem mmienu,ɔha ne aduoson mmiɛnsa (2,173) a ɛyɛ ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu mmiɛnsa akyirepɔ aduonum baako (3.51)

title: John Mahama
text:
John Dramani Mahama (Wɔwoo noObubuo 29, 1958) yɛ Ghanani amanyɔni. Na ɔyɛ Ɔmanpanin wɔ Ghana ɛfiri afe 2012 kɔ si afe 2017. Na ɔsaanso yɛ Ɔmanpanin abɛdiakyire wɔ Ghana ɛfiri Ɔpɛpɔn 6, 2009 kɔ si Kitawonsa 2012. Ɔsoom sɛ mmarahyɛ badwani nso

wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛ badwa mmienu, mmiɛnsa, ɛne ɛnan adehyeman a ɔto so ɛnan a ɛfiri afe 1997 kɔ si afe 2009 ɛwɔ Bole Bamboi abatoɔ mpɛsua.

N'adwuma 
Ɔde ne ho dɔmee National Democratic Congress (NDC). Na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛ badwani wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛ badwa mmienu, mmiɛnsa , ɛne ɛnan adehyeman a ɔto so ɛnan a ɛfiri afe 1997 kɔ si afe 2009 ɛwɔ Bole Bamboi abatoɔ mpɛsua.

Na ɔyɛ Ɔmanpanin ne abadiakyiri wɔ Ghana ɛfiri afe 2009 kɔ si afe 2012 ɛmmerɛ a na John Evans Atta Mills ɛyɛ Ɔmanpanin. Ɔbɛ yɛ Ɔmampanin ɛmmerɛ John Evans Atta Mills ɛda ne benkum so afi 2012. Ɔno akyiri ɔbɛ yɛ Ɔmampanin wɔ Ghana ɛfiri afe 2013 kɔ si afe 2017.

N'ahyaseɛ ne nwumasua 
Ɔka  Gonja abusua ho a ɛwɔ Savanna mantam mu wɔ Ghana, Mahama firi Bole a ɛwɔ Savanna mantam mu. Wɔwoo Mahama wɔ Damongo wɔ Damango-Daboya abatoɔ mpɛsua so wɔ Atifi mantam mu. Nagya, Emmanuel Adama Mahama, a ɔyɛ Okuani a ɔdɔ mmoofuo na ɔsane yɛ Ɔkyerɛkyerɛni, yɔ mmarahyɛbadwa a ɔdi kan ma West Gonja abatoɔ mpɛsua so sane yɛ Atifi mantam suafoɔ wɔ Ɔmampanin , Kwame Nkrumah aberɛ so. Mahama's papa some sɛ ɔmampanin futufoɔ ma  Hilla Limann a  Jerry John Rawlings too naban guu wɔ 1981.

Mahama kɔɔ ne mmɔfra ase sukuu ase wɔ had  Accra Newtown Experimental School (ANT1) ansan Ɔrekɔ akɔ da bɔɔdek sukuu wɔ Achimota  mmɔfra sukuu. Ɔwie adamtam sukuu wɔ Ghana Secondary Sukuu (Tamale, Atifi mantam mu). Ɔtoa so wɔ  University of Ghana, Legon, ɔgyee degree nteteeɛ a ɛfa abakwasɛm mu wɔ afe 1981 ne  diploma fa nkitahodie ho wɔ afe  1986. berɛ a ɔyɛ suani no, na ɔka  Commonwealth Hall (Legon). Ɔsane sua adeɛ wɔ Institute of Social Sciences wɔ Moscow wɔ Soviet Union, Ɔnyaa ne masta wɔ afe 1988 mu.
