title: Yaa Gyasi
text:
Yaa Gyasi(wɔwoo no wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe nkron) yɛ Ghana-Americani a ɔtwerɛ nnwoma. Ne nnwoma a ɔdikan twerɛɛ ne Homegoing a ɔdaa no adi maa amansan hunuuiɛ wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia mu, ɔdii mfeɛ aduonu nsia no ɔnyaa National Book Critics Circle John Leonard abasobɔdeɛ wɔ ne nnwoma a ɛdikan a ɔtwerɛɛ nom, PEN/Hemingway abasobɔdeɛ wɔ ne nnwoma a ɔtwerɛɛ a na ɛyɛ bɛserɛmka, National Book Foundation "5 under 35" animuonyamhyɛ wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia ne America nnwoma abasobɔdeɛ. Wɔ n'abasobɔdeɛ mu no ɔnyaa Vilcek akyɛdeɛ ɛnam  sɛdeɛ ɔsi bɔ ne tirim yɛ nnoɔma wɔ kasadwini wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu mu.

Abrabɔ ahyɛaseɛ ne nnwomasua 
Wɔwoo no wɔ Mampong a ɛwɔ Ghana, ne papa ne Kwaku Gyasi, French kunini wɔ University of Alabama a ɛwɔ Huntsville ne Sophia a ɔyɛ nɛɛse. N'abusua no kɔɔ United States wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron baako berɛ a ne papa rebɛwie ne Ph.D wɔ Ohio State University.  N'abusua no sane tenaa IIinois ne Tennessee ɛna ɔdii mfeɛ du no, wɔtetee Gyasi wɔ Huntsville, Alabama.

Gyasi kae sɛ berɛ a na ɔsua no na ɔfɛre adeɛ,ɔbɛn ne nua mmarima ma wɔne no kyɛ adesuadeɛ a woanya wɔ berɛ a wɔnnyini wɔ asraadɔmkuo nom wɔ Alabama, ɛna na ɔtwe bɛn nnwoma sɛ ne nnamfofoɔ. Wɔmaa ne adesua nkrataa a LeVar Burton atintim so de hyɛɛ no nkuran wɔ nnwoma a ɔdiikan twerɛɛ,  a ɔdekɔɔ Readin Rainbow Young Writers ne Illustrators Contest. Ɔdii mfeɛ du nson wɔ berɛ a ɔkɔ Grisson ntoasoɔ sukuu no, aberɛ Gyasi kann Toni Morrison Solomon nnwom  ɛkenyaa no sɛ ɔde atwerɛ bɛyɛ n'adwuma.

Ɔnyaa ne Bachelor of Arts wɔ English mu wɔ Stanford University, ne Masters of Fine Arts firii Lowa Writers Workshop,   adesuadeɛ a wɔbɔ wɔn tirim twerɛ adeɛ wɔ University of Lowa.￼

Nnwuma 
Ankyɛ aberɛ a ɔwie Stanford no,  ɔhyɛɛ ne nnwoma atwerɛɛ ase na ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ dwumakuo bi a ɛwɔ San Francisco, nanso n'ani annye wɔ adwuma nom ɛna ɔgyae berɛ a Lowa gyee no wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu mu.

Ne nnwoma a ɛdikan a ɔtwerɛɛ a ɛyɛ Homegoing ne kenyaa no berɛ a na ɔyɛ abɔfra a na wɔrekɔ nsrahwɛ wɔ Ghana nea ɛdikan wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nkron. Wɔwiee nwoma no mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du num berɛ wɔn a wɔde nnwoma no to dwa kann wieeɛ no, a nnipa pii pɛɛ sɛ ɔbɛboa no ansana ɔregye  nnoɔma nson bi ato hɔ ansa afiri Knopf hɔ. Ta-Neshisi coates yii Homegoing maa National Book Foundation, The PEN/Hemingway abasobɔdeɛ wɔ nnwoma a ɛdikan a ɛdimu, ne America nnwoma abasobɔdeɛ wɔ ɔkwan ahodoɔ a ɔfaa so boaa America kasadwini mu.

Ne ntwereɛ nso apii wɔ saa  beaɛ ɔdaa no adi no sɛ African American Review, Callaloo, Guenica The Guardian, ne Granta.

Gyasi hwɛɛ Toni Morrison (Song of Solomon), Gabriel Garcia Márquez(one thousand years of Solitude), James Baldwin(Go Tell It on the Mountain),Edward P. Jones(Lost in the city)￼ ne Jhumpa Lahiri(Unaccustomef Earth) sɛ nkuranhyɛsɛm.

Bɛyɛ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia mu no, Ghana tenaa wɔ Berkeley, California.

Wɔ ɔbɛnem bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu baako mu no, ɔtwerɛɛ krataa wɔ "this question of 'the Business of reading', wɔ sɛdeɛ yɛsi kan,nea ntira a yɛkan ne sɛdeɛ akenkan si kɔ no anaa sɛ yɛ ma yɛn" Ɔtwerɛɛ, "Berɛ a meretu me ho adi hɔ agye tumi a ɛwɔ kasadwini adi sɛ mɛgye ho akyinnyeɛ, ama emu adɔ, mɛsesa, mesane nim sɛ woretɔn nnwoma afiri abibifoɔ atwerɛfoɔ hɔ no nni nyinasoɔ biara, a ɛde nsunsuansoɔ bɔne ba akyire wɔ nnoɔma a yɛhu ne nea yɛnhunu a ɛha tete no"

￼

Nnwuma 

 Homegoing (mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia(2016)
 Transcendent Kingdom (mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu (2020)

Abasobɔdeɛ 

 National Book Critics Circle's John Leonard abasobɔdeɛ ma nnwoma a ɛdikan a ɛdi mu.
 PEN/Hemingway abasobɔdeɛ ma nnwoma a ɛdikan a ɛyɛ bɛserɛmka.
 2016: National Book Foundation's "5 under 35
 America nnwoma abasobɔdeɛ.
 2017: Granta Best of Young American Novelists.
 2020: Vilcek Prize for Creative Promise in Literature, Vilcek Foundation.
 2021: Women's Prize for Fiction, shortlisted for Transcendent Kingdom.

Beaɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ. 

Ganafoɔ

title: Brian Gitta
text:
Nnianim 
Brian Gitta yɛ panini paa ne kɔfabae mma ThinkIT dwumakuo.

Brian Gitta yɛ bibini a wadi nka a wayɛ afidie nwanwasoɔ a etumi kyerɛ sɛ obi anya atiridi yareɛ (malaria) a mogya nka ho.

Brian Gitta ne n'apamfoɔ no yɛɛ afidie bi a yɛfrɛ no Matibabu a aboa  ama nkurotoa bi anya apɔmuden. Na na'nisoadehunu nyinaa ne sɛ ɔbɛyɛ Point -Of- Care - Testing (POCT) ama nkuro nketoa a wɔnni apomuden nso anya bi.

Saa afidie yi  tumi kyerɛ sɛ yadeɛ atiridi (malaria ) wɔ nkwamoa anaa mogya mu.

Brian Gitta firi Uganda man mu.

Ne mmɔfra ashyaseɛ ne nwomasua 
Brian Gitta yɛ onipa bi a na na'ni  gye kɔmputa ( computer ) agudie ho yie.

Na ɔkɔɔ ne mmɔfra sukuu wɔ Bright school,  Kawenpe wɔ Uganda.

Brian Gitta kita abɔdin krataa a ɛyɛ degree a efiri Makerere  suapɔn mu ( University ). 

Brian Gitta yɛ abranteɛ bi a wadi mfie aduonu nnan (24 yrs).

N'adwuma 
Brian Gitta yɛ obi a ɔbue Nnwoma. ( Entrepreneur ).

Nea w'ayɛ 
Brian Gitta ne nadwumakuo ayɛ mfidie bi te sɛ, Matiscope a ɛsɔ Kanea ne magnetism a wɔde yɛ mogya mu nhwehwɛ mu. Bio nso wayɛ Yotta a ɛyɛ kɔmputa ( computer ) kwan so a wɔfa so de hwehwɛ beaeɛ ne apomuden nketahodie. Wasan ayɛ Yotta krataa a yɛde hwehwɛ ayarefoɔ tenabea ne wɔn ayare hwɛ mu. Wɔyɛɛ saa mfidie yi wɔ Kumpala, Uganda,  na Matibabu banodani Brian Gitta ne napamfoɔ ( Josuah Businge, Josiah Kavuma,  Moris Atwine,  Simon Lubambo, ne Shafik Sekitto) na ɛyɛeɛ.Saa mfidie yi boa kyerɛ sɛ atiridi ( malaria )  mmoa wɔ mogya mu ma wɔyɛ nhwehwɛ mu.

Abasobɔdeɛ/Abodin 
Ekuo Matibabu nyaa abodin firii Villgro Kyenya Bayer Foundation.  Merck Accelerator and Resilent Africa Network ( RAN).,  a nadwuma hyɛ United State Agency International Development. Matibabu san nyaa abodin firii UN  Empowerment Awards a ɛyɛ Microsoft Imagine Cup., Royal Academy of Engendering.,Tech Open Air Festival, Republica, Global Sunkalp Forum,  Tech Crunch Hardware., 2019 Rolex Laureate.

Beaɛ a me nyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Smart Havens Africa
text:
Smart Havens Africa yɛ dwumakuo bi a wɔn dwumadie fa nnipa asetena mu nsɛm ho. Dwumakuo yi wɔ uganda na wɔn dwumadie titire ne sɛ wɔboa nkuro anaa mmaa a wɔyɛ mmerɛ ma wɔnya fie a ne boɔ nnyɛ den na ɛsan so tumi kura nnipa yie. Nea ɔtee dwumadie yi ne Anne Rweyora.

Abakɔsɛm 
Smart Havens Africa dwumakuo no, wɔtee no wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne dunwɔtwe mu (2018). Anne Rweyoro na ɛtee kuo yi. Ɔne BBC nkitahodie nkɔmɔdie mu no, ɔdaa no adi sɛ nea nti a ɔde too no ho so sɛ obedi saa dwumadie no ne sɛ, berɛ a ne papa wuuiɛ no ne papa abusuafoɔ bɛgyee fie ne agyapadeɛ a ne papa de gyaa wɔn nyinaa firii wɔn nsɛm maa wɔn asetena mu nsɛm bɛyɛ den pa ara. Wei maa no bɛhunuu sɛdea ɛteɛ sɛ wonni sika kɛseɛ a wode besi anaa bɛhan dan. Nti, ne botaeɛ a ɔde tee kuo Smart Havens Africa ne sɛ ɔbɛma nnipa ne titire mmaa a wɔwɔ abibirem bɛnya wɔn ankasa fie a ne boɔ nnyɛ den.

Dwumadie ho nsɛm 
Smart Havens Africa dwumakuo no botaeɛ ne sɛ wɔbɛ ma mmaa de sika kumaa bi bɛnya fie a wɔn mmerɛ ho. Kwan a wɔfa so si dan no ne sɛ, wɔde nea yɛka no borofo kasa mu green materials ne bolɔk a wɔn ankasa ayɛ na wɔde si wɔn adan a wɔsisi no. Sɛdeɛ wɔyɛ bolɔk (block) no boa ma ne boɔ kɔ fam na bio, bolɔk no a wɔde si adan no nso nhia sɛ wɔbɛ pelasta ho. Wei ma ɛboɔ no so te bɛyɛ ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduonum (50%). Bolɔk no a wɔde si adan no nhia egya biara na ne saa nti, ɛboa ma wɔn nsɛe abibirem nnua, na ɛsan so boa ma wɔbɔ mframa a yɛhome kɔ yɛn mu ho ban.

Dwumakuo no ho mfasoɔ 

Dwumakuo yi hwɛ sɛ wɔbɛpagya Uganda mpɔtam akɔ soro na wɔn dwuma ne sɛ wɔbɛma amamfoɔ enya nsaano dwuma ho nimdeɛ ho akwanya. Wɔma mmaa ne mmabunu nteteeɛ ne dwumasua a wɔpɛ sɛ adansie anaa deɛ yɛka no real estate wɔ borofo kasa mu ho akwanya. Wɔsan so ma mma dwadiefoɔ akwanya wɔ adansie, adwumasua ne dwadie mu.

Nea ɔde dwumakuo no baaeɛ 
Nea ɔtee saa dwumakuo yi ne Ann Rweyora. Anne Rweyora yɛ Ugandani san so yɛ industrial designer a na ɔnni baabi te bɛyɛ mfeɛ aduonu ne akyire a ne papa firii mu. Ann ne nea ɔhwɛ Smart Havens Africa dwumakuo no so. Ne botaeɛ a ɔde tee dwumakuo yi ne sɛ ɔbesisi adan a ne boɔ wɔ fam a ebetumi ekura nnipa a wɔyɛ mmerɛ ne wɔn a wɔn sika sua sɛ wɔde benya adan wɔ beaeɛ a fie a ɛwɔ hɔ nyinaa nsase wuranom yɛ asikafoɔ. Anne Rweyoro ayɛ Global Social Benefit institution (GSBI)  mu kuoba pen. Ɔdii nkunim wɔ Africa Prize of Engineering Innovation ne Takenda Young Entrepreneur wɔ mfeɛ mpem aduonu ne aduonu mu (2020). Nea ɛhyɛɛ ne nkuran sɛ ɔbɛyɛ ma fie nya ho nsɛm ayɛ mmerɛ maa no nyaa akwanya a wɔbɔɔ ne din wɔ Royal Academy of Engineering Africa abasobɔdeɛ mu a na ɔka nnipa dunum a wɔyii wɔn sɛ wɔfata abasobɔdeɛ no ho.

Beaeɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Roy Allela
text:
Roy Allela yɛ Kenyani a wayɛ ade sorɔnko wadi mfeɛ aduonus num. Ɔno na wayɛ Sign-IO abɛɛfo mfididwumanwanwasoɔ a yɛde sesa kasa a yɛye yɛ nsa na ɛyɛ kɔ kasa a yɛde yɛano ka mu.

Ne botaeɛ ne sɛ yɛbɛtumi de mfidie asua adeɛ na ɛbɛ boa ama yɛatumi asi asetena mu haw ano kwan.Ɛwɔ nimdeɛwɔ adea bɔrɔfo kasa mu yɛtrɛ no " programming " mu.

Deɛ Ɛkanyan Allela maa no yɛɛ afidie nwanwasoɔ yi yɛ ne nkitahodie mu berɛa ɔme na abusua rekasa, na ɔnsane nnim kasa a yɛde yɛn nsa yɛ nso.

Sign-IO afidie dwuma mmienu a ɛdikan a obibini yi yɛeɛ no wɔ sɔ hwɛe wɔ. Migori ɛwɔ Kenya

Ne mmɔfra ase ne n'adesua 
Wɔwoo Roy Allela sane tete no wɔ Kenya man mu.Ɔkɔɔ sukuu wɔ University of Nairobi suapɔn mu firi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne

du-mmienu Ku si mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du-nsia mu. Ɔnyaa abusing krataa wɔ"Microprocessor Technology ne Instrument".

Abɔdin ne na dwuma 
Sign-IO afidie nwanwaso a Roy Allela yɛeɛ no abɛyɛ mfasodeɛ kɛseɛ ama nnipa a wɔwɔ haw wɔ kasa ho. Wɔ yi Allela Sign-IO afidie no wɔ mfeɛ mmienu ne du-nkron mu

" Africa Prize of the Royal Academy of Engineers abasobɔdeɛ no mu. Allela Sign-IO afidie no na nyaa " Hardware Trailblazer " abasobɔdeɛ no wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du- nson mu a "Asme innovation showcase (ISHOW)" akansie a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ American Society of Mechanical(ASME).

Ɔsane bɛdii knumin wɔ " Intel University App Challenge" akansie mu. Allela ayɛ adwuma sɛ "Software Engineer" ɛfiri mfeɛ mpem ne du- nsia ne ɔkyerɛkyerɛni wɔ "Oxford University"suapɔn mu.

Beaɛ Menyaa mmoa firieɛ

title: Plastic Pavement Blocks
text:
Plastiki a amanfoɔ tɔ dabiara abɛyɛ nwura bi a ɛha ɔman biaa. Plastiki ɛyɛ adeɛ nso a ɛmpurɔ dabiara da nti sɛ yɛ tu dodoɔ naa twene a ɛbɛ yɛ nwura bebree a ɛku tia ɔman no. Ɛnam saa asɛm yi nti amanfoɔ di nnimdeɛ kwan so di yi Plastiki yɛ adeɛ a ɛda mu soronko di boa ewiase, saa adeɛ bi ni Plastic Pavement Blocks.

Abakɔsɛm 
Plastic Pavement Blocks ɛyɛ nnimdeɛ a Kenya nii baa bi nyaa yɛ a nnɛ wode aba ennisuɔ . Obaa yi din de Nzambi Matee. Nhwehwɛmu twerɛ sɛ onyaa saa nnimdeɛ yi na wɔde mfie aduonu nkron. Na ɔsan yɛ sukuu ni. Ɔwiee sukuu na ɔkura degree wɔ Material Science mu ɛna ɔnyaa scholarship kɔ US abrokyiman mu kɔ suaa ni dwumadie no ho nsɛm.  Ni nnimdeɛ de abasobɔde ahodoɔ de abrɛ no. Adeɛ yi betumi de nsesa yɛ kɛse aba wiase mu.

Nipa a dwumadie no da ni nanso 
Nzambi Matee, ababaawa a plastic pavement block dwumadie no yɛ no dea no wɔ dwumakuo bi a watu ni din sɛ Gjenge Makers. Saa nkorɔfoɔ yi de plastic no yɛ adeɛ broni frɛɛ no sɛ 'slabs'  de si nnoɔma ahodoɔ. Wɔ afi mpem Mmienu ne aduonu mu no onyaa abasobɔde a wɔn ato ne din sɛ Young Champions of the Earth Africa.

Mfasoɔ 
Plastic pavement block dwumadie yi de mfaso abrɛ ewiase. Mfasoɔ bi yi ne, ama nwura a ayɛ ɔman no mu mma no ɛso ate. Saa dwumadie so boa United Nations Sustainable Development Goals no wɔ de atu dwa sɛ ɛbɛ boa ewiase nyinaa sɛ obiara boa na wɔde so a.

Bɛbi a Mmoa Firii

title: Mshila Sio
text:
Mshila Sio yɛ Kenyani a ɔsɔne nsu bɔne so ma ɛbɛyɛ nsu papa. N’adwuma a ɔy3 no din de Omiflo a ɛwɔ Nairobi wɔ Kenya man mu.

Mmofrase ne Suukukɔ 
Wɔwoo Mshila wɔ Kenya. Ɔkɔɔ sukuu wɔ Australia man mu wɔ afe 2012/2013.

Adwuma 
Sio tuu kwan kɔɔ Spain sɛ ɔkɔ sra abusuafo. Ɛhɔ no ohyiaa mmrante ne mbabawa bi a na wɔde mmfiri sɔne nsu bɔne so sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a nnipa betumi de saa nsu no adi dwuma. N’ani bɛgyee eyi ho efisɛ wɔ abibi man mu no ɛyɛ den yiye sɛ wobenya nsu. Afie nso nyarewa pii a Afrikafo nya no fi nsu bɔne a wɔnom anaa wɔde di dwuma mu. Saa nsu yi ara sɛe asase a wɔte so no. Ɔsan n’akyi kɔɔ Kenya na ɔne mmrante ne mmabawa no yɛɛ nhwehwɛmu ne adwuma mfe pii sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobetumi ayɛ biribi a wɔde bɛboa ne kuromafo.

Esaine sɛ ne sikasɛm nyɛ nti na ɛyɛ den ma no sɛ ɔbɛyɛ afiri a ɛbɛ sɔne nsu no so. Onyaa mmoa fii Amerika manpayin a na ɔte akongua so saa bere no (Barak Obama) wɔ nhehyɛe a wɔfrɛ no Mandela Washington fellowship and Aqua For All hɔ. Wɔde sika hyɛɛ n’adwuma no mu na eyi boa maa otumi yɛɛ afiri no.

Nsu bɔne gu ahorow eyi nti bere biara a obi bɛpɛ sɛ Sio yɛ nsu ho adwuma no, ɛsɛsɛ ɔsesa afiri a ɔde bedi dwuma no kakraa. Afei nso ɔhwɛ nea wɔde nsu no bɛyɛ sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a sɛ ɔsɔne so a wobetumi de adi dwuma sɛnea wɔpɛ no. Ɔde Phytofix na ɛsɔne nsu no so. Phytofix de phytoremediation ne hydroponic nyansahu sɔne nsu so yiye a wonsɔe sika pii. 

Sɛ Sio de mfiri a ɔyɛ no sɔne nsu so a, wonte nka bɔne biara wɔmu. Afie ɔmfa anyinam kanea ahoɔden anaa nnuru nni dwuma. Eyi boa ma ɛbɔ yɛn asaase no ho ban

Abasobɔde a w'anya 
Wɔ afe 2021 no, Sio de ne nsu sɔne mfiri adwuma no kɔɔ No Waste Challenge akansi ase. Esaine sɛ n'adwuma no yɛ nea ebetumi aboa nnipa pii no, ɔno na odii kan wɔ akansi no mu.

Beae a menyaa mmoa fii

title: Elo-cart
text:
Kar trɔk yɛ kenyan adwumakuo bi a wɔn tirimpɔ ne sɛ wɔbɛyɛ ɛlɛtrɔnik ho nneɛma na woapɛ ano aduro a ɛbɛte yɛn brɛ so. Nipa a ɔda saa adwumakuo yi ano yɛ mfidie dwuma yi de Owura kenneth Guantial a ɔfiri Kenya, w’adi mfeɛ aduasa nan(34)  ɔyɛ obi a ɔwɔ dɔ ma wiase bammɔ ho. Ɛno nti on ɔyaa tirimpɔ bi sɛ ɔbɛyɛ abɛɛfo afidie bi a ɛbɛtumi ayɛ adwuma ate nnipa brɛ so. Ɔhyɛɛ dwumadie yi ase wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nnum mu na n’adwuma no atu mpɔn ma wɔayɛ ɛlɛtrik kar bi ama adwadifoɔ a ɛwɔ apue fa mu Afrika ne Nairobi, ɔde mpepem ahyɛ ɛlɛtrik trɔk no nko ara mu. Bio kar ne kɔba yɛ mmiensa na ɛyɛ trɔk bi a ɛfa nnoɔma nketewa na ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ nkuro akɛseɛ be nketewa mantam a ɛwɔ sub-Saharan Afrika ne akyirikyiri.

Anisoadehunu 
Ne anisoadehunu ne sɛ ɔbɛyɛ wiase nyinaa sodifoɔ wɔ adwinnie, dansie ne sɛ ɔbɛyɛ afidie a ɛte adwadifoɔ ne fiefoɔ brɛ so wɔ wiase afana nyinaa

Botaeɛ 

Ne botaeɛ ne sɛ, ɔbɛbɔ mmɔden aso aba, ɛne sɛ ɔbɛma no awɔ hɔ daa, atumpɔn wɔ mfidie nketewa yi ho na afei ɔde ne nyansa akɔ anim wɔ sika fam

title: African Business Hero
text:
African Business Heroes yɛ akansie a Abibiremfoɔ nko ara na ɛsi de kyerɛ wɔn nimdeɛ ne suahunu a ama wɔn ankasa tumi yɛ wɔn adwuma.  Ɛyɛ akansie a Jack Ma hyɛɛ aseɛ wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du- nson mu berɛ a Ɔdii kan sraa Abibirem asaseyantam no(African Continent ). Deɛ ɛkanyan no koraa yɛ ahokeka ne anisoadehunu a mmabunu  a ɔhyiaa wɔn no daa no adi kyerɛɛ no no. Ɛmaa no nyaa ɔpɛ pa sɛ Ɔbɛboa asɔ nnipa Ɔha a wɔyɛ wɔn ankasa adwuma asene wɔ mfeɛ du ɛdi yɛanim yi. African Business Heroes yɛ Ɛkuo bi a ɛnyɛ adwuma mpɛ mfasoɔbiara. Jack Ma tee sɛ ɔdereboa abibimamfoɔ wɔn ankasa yɛ wɔn adwuma. Wɔn botaeɛ ne St wɔbɛyi Adom akyɛdeɛ a nnipa bi a wɔwɔ Abibiman mu wɔ na Savia ama no atumpɔn de aboa wɔn mpɔtam ne deɛ  ɛboro saa. Asane akanyan Abibiremfoɔ a wɔoɛ sɛ wɔyɛ wɔn ankasa adwuma.

Wɔn Botaeɛ 
African Business Heroes boataeɛ ne sɛ Ɔbɛhyɛ Abibimanfoɔ a wɔyɛ wɔn ankasa adwuma mu kena berɛ a, ɔhwehwɛ, ka nsɛm,wɔrekyerɛkyrɛ na wɔrebɔ nnipa Ɔha wɔfiri Abibiman mu abasoɔ wɔ sika fam de aboa wɔn nnwuma wɔ mfeɛ du ɛdi yɛanim yi.

Wɔn anidasoadehunu 
Wɔn anisoadehunu ne sɛ ɛrekɔ si mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduasa mu no, Na nnipa Ɔha a wɔyɛ Akunini wɔ African Business Heroes mu no akanyan afoforɔ bɛboro Ɔpepe ne akyire.

Abakwasɛm 
Ɛwɔ  Obubuo bosome mu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du-nkron mu no, na wɔdaa African Business Heroes  akansie no adi wɔ Nkran a ɛwɔ Ghana berɛ a na wɔahunu  nnwuma kuo soronko  du akunini  a wɔde nnoɔma pa ne nsesaeɛ ɛreba wɔn mpɔtam. Deɛ ɔtee  saa adwuma yi mu biara nyaa Ɔpɔpɔ Ɔha wɔ Ghana sika mu($1Million ) sɛ mmoaa, maa wɔmmu biara kaa wɔasɛm kyerɛɛ Abibaman ne ɛwiase. Bio saa nnipa yi nyaa nkyerɛkyerɛ firii nnipa bi hɔ, faa nteteɛ mu Sane nyaa ayɔnkofa akwanya. 

Bio,  Jack Ma pagyaa mmoa no a ɔde ma no mu berɛ a ɔhunuu wɔn dwumadie no maa mmoa no nyinaa Ku sii Ghana sika ɔpepepee ɔha ($100 million). Mmoa yi bɛkɔ so mfeɛ du aboa Abibimamfoɔ.

Deɛ ɔde kuo no baeɛ ho asɛm 
Jack Ma yɛ Chianani a ɛyɛ ɔno ankasa adwuma.  Ɔsane yɛ obi a ɔhwehwɛ nnipa nkɔsoɔ berɛ a ɔde mmoa ma nnipa sɛ wɔmfa nyɛ adwuma pa. Jack ma kɔfabaeɛ ma adwuma kuo 'Alibaba Gruop', ɔno ara ne Otitenani ma adwuma kuo no.

Ne Mmɔfra ase ne ne Sukuu kɔ 
Wɔwoo Jack Ma wɔ Ahinime bosome da ɛtɔ so du afe apem ahenkron-aduosia nan mu (September 10,1964) wɔ ɔman Chiana.

Jack Ma kɔɔ sukuu wɔ 'Hangzhou Teachers College' ɛna 'Hangzhou Normal University '. Ɔwieɛ sukuu no afe apem ahenkron aduowɔtwe -nwɔtwen nyaa abɔdin krataA wɔ 'Bachelor of Arts English '.

Jack Ma wɔ mma mmiɛnsa ɛna ne yere ne Zhang Ying. TNA amanyɔkuo 'Communist Party of China' ho.

Abasobɔdeɛ 
Ɛwɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan mu no, Jack Ma nyaa abasobɔdeɛ sɛ Ɔka  borɔfo kasa mu ' Top 10 Economic Personalities of the year' wɔ ' China Central Television '.

Ɛwɔ Ahinime bosome mu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne num mu no, 'World Economic Forum ' yii Ma sɛ ɔno ne borɔfo kasa mu ' Young Global Leader '

Akansifoɔ 
Wɔn a wɔsi akan no nyinaa yɛ Abibirem ha foɔ a wɔfiri aman bɛyɛ aduonum-nan (54 countries ) so. Ɔman bi te  sɛ Ghana,  South Africa, Kenya,Nigeria, Egypt ne deɛ ɛkeka ho a, wɔn ankasa yɛ wɔn adwuma anaa abue wɔn adwumaa wɔtumi fa afoforɔ adwuma mu. Saa nnipa yi na wɔba akansie yi bɛkyerɛ wɔn Adom akyɛdeɛ ne nnoɔma a watumi de ayɛ.

Nkunimdifoɔ 
Nnipa pii no ara na wɔkɔ akansie yi nanso ɛnyɛ wɔn nyinaa na wɔtumi di nkunim. Nnipa mmiɛnsa a wɔdii kan wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du-baako  no ne Deɛ ɔdii kan ne Khadija Mohammed ɔfiri Egypt man mu a wate adwuma kuo Praxil . Ɔnyaa abasobɔdeɛ Ghana sika ɔpepepee Ahasa (300,000 Million ).

Deɛ ɛtɔ mmienu ne Ikenna  Nzewi a ɔno nso firii Nigeria man mu wate adwuma kuo Releaf. Ɔno nso nyaa Ghana sika ɔpepepee Ahanu ne ɔha nkyɛmu  fa (250,000 million ).

Deɛ ɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa ne Navalago Osemboa ɔka wɔn a wɔtee adwuma kuo ' End Athletic . Ɔno nso firi Kenya.  Ɔnyaa Ghana sika ɔpepepee ɔha ne ɔha nkyɛmu fa.

He nnipa nson a wɔ ka ho ma wɔyɛ nnipa du. Ɛbinom firii ɔman Uganda ne deɛ ɛkeka ho . Atɛmmuafoɔ no ho dwirii wɔn wɔ nnipa a wɔtumi bɛduruu akansie no awieɛ ne wɔn nnwuma kuo a wɔatete no ho.

Mfasoɔ a ɛwɔ  African Business Heroes ho 
Deɛ ɛdi kan, Ɛma Akansifoɔ no nya akwanya ne mpanimfoɔ awakwadare wɔ adwuma no mu di nhyiamu ma wɔtu wɔn fo. Kyerɛkyerɛ wɔn fa adwuma no ho.

Deɛ ɛdi hɔ bio,  Ɛma nnipa du a wɔbɛduru akansie no awieɛ no nyaa sika mmoa a ɛfifi Ɔpepepee baako ne fa(1.5million )de  kɔ si Ɔpepepee Ahasa  de boa wɔn adwuma. 

Ɛma  wiase  nyinaa hunu wɔn nnoɔma pa a wɔreyɛ berɛ a African Business Heroes yi wɔn kyerɛ wɔ kasamfonyin so, Kowaa nkrataa mu ne Kasafidie so.

Bio,  Ɛma wɔsane nya nnipa a wɔbɔkyerɛkyerɛ wɔ de wɔn afa nteteɛ mu ama wɔatumi agyina wɔn nnwuma. 

Afei, Ɛma ayɔnkofa bɛda akansifoɔ ne atɛmmuafoɔ no Nyame.

Beaeɛ a me nyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Kunlé Adeyemi
text:
Kunlé Adeyemi  (wɔwoo no 7 Oforisuo 1976) yɛ adansi mu nimdefo a ofi Nigeria. Adeyemi na ɔde adwumakuw NLÉ sii hɔ. NLÉ yɛ adansi adwuma a ɛwɔ  Amsterdam, wɔ Netherlands.

Ne mmofraberem ne sukuukɔ 
Wɔwoo Adeyemi 7 Oforisuo 1976 wɔ Kaduna, kurow a ɛwɔ Nigeria atifi fam. Osuaa adansi ho nimdeɛ wɔ  University of Lagos in Lagos, Nigeria.

N'adwuma 
Adeyemi yɛɛ adwuma wɔ Office for Metropolitan Architecture (OMA). Bere a ɔwɔ OMA no, ɔne Rem Koolhaas, nea ɔda adwuma no ano no boom no yɛɛ adwuma. Wɔboom yɛɛ adwuma wɔ adansi nnwuma ahorow wɔ Europe, Asia, Africa ne Middle East. Akyiri no ɔde n'ankasa adansi ho nimdeɛ adwuma sii hɔ. Ɔfrɛɛ n'adwuma no NLÉ wɔ Amsterdam, wɔ Netherlands.

Ade foforo a w'ayɛ 
Adeyemi yɛ obi a wonim no sɛ ɔhyehyɛe na osii Makoko floating school. Ɔde kurom hɔ nneɛma na esii dan no. Adeyemi de nádwene si nkurow a ɛrekɔ n'anim wɔ wiase. Afe 2013 mu no, Adeyemi kasa faa African Water Cities Project, titiriw no Makoko Floating School ne sɛnea ohu adansi wɔ Africa daakye.

Adeyemi san kyerɛ adansi wɔ sukuupɔn ahorow. Ɛhɔ no ɔkasa fa adansi a wobesisi wɔ Africa ha a ɛbɛboa yɛn daakye. Ɔsan kaa LafargeHolcim Awards jury ma Middle East Africa.

title: Nyungu Afrika
text:
Nyungu Afrika yɛ adwumakuw a wɔde abrɔbɛ ne aboro yɛ afihyikɔ mu nsiesie de. Mary Nyaruai yɛ Nyungu Afrika dwumakuo no kɔfabaeɛ. Mary Nyaruai de saa adi yi  baeɛ wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2021.

Nea Nyungu Afrika yɛ ne de 
Mary Nyaruai yɛ Kenyani a ɔkɔɔ suapɔn a yɛfrɛ ho University of Nairobi. Ɛhɔ na ɔnya abodin krata wɔ kasa nkitahodie ne emu nkyerɛaseɛ a pɔtɔ kasa mo nu yɛfrɛ no Communication wɔ mfe  mpem mmienu ne aduonu mmienu (2022).

Abasobɔdeɛ a Mary Nyaruai anya bi ne ‘Africa Green Grant Award' a ɛhyɛ “Eleven Eleven  Twelve Foundation” ase, No Waste Challenge a ɛhyɛ “What Design Can Do” nso ase. Academy Fow Women Entrepreneurs Award a ɛno nso hyɛ  Academy for Women Entrepreneurs ase.

title: Omiflo
text:
Omfiflo yɛ adwumakuo bi a Owura bi a ne din de Mshila Sio a ɔfiri Kenya ayɛ. Adwumakuo yi nam abɛɛfo kwan so sɔne nsufi anaa nsubɔne so wɔ ɔkwan a ɛnyɛ den so. Wɔmfa nnoɔma wɔde sɔne nsuo so, nnuro anaa ahoɔden foforɔ biara nka ho. Mmom, wɔyɛ no wɔ ɔkwan bi a ɛnyɛ den koraa so. Sɛdeɛ wɔayɛ no ne sɛ,  wɔaduadua mfifideɛ binom a ɛnyini wɔ nsuo mu, a ɛno na akɔyɛ biribi a ɛsɔne nsuo no so korɔgyenn.

Abakɔsɛm 
Mshila Sio a ɔfiri Kenya na ɔhyɛɛ adwumakuo yi ase. Owura yi hyɛɛ adwumakuo no ase wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne dumienu awieeɛ rekɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne dumiɛnsa no mu hɔ. Ɔnyaa saa adwuma yi ho adwene berɛ a ɔkɔsraa n'abusuafoɔ wɔ Spain. Ɔka sɛ, "Mekɔhyiaa nnipakuo binom a na wɔnam akwan sononko binom rekyerɛ sɛdeɛ yɛbɛsiesie nsuo ne nsufi na ɛkaa m'akoma pa ara." Berɛ a ɔfiri Spain bɛduruu Kenya no, ɔne nnipa a ɔhyiaa wɔn wɔ Spain no kɔɔ so ara dii nsawɔsoɔ maa n'adaeɛso no baa mu.

Sɛdeɛ ɔyɛɛ no 
Deɛ ɛdi kan koraa no, wɔhwehwɛ afifideɛ bi a ɛfata dwumadie no pa ara na wɔde ayɛ adwuma. Mfifideɛ nketenkete binom a wɔahyɛda aduadua wɔ nsuo mu no tumi ma nsuo no nkwa mframa a wɔfrɛ no 'Oxygen' no. Wɔ yei sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a nkwa mframa a ɛwɔ nsu no mu no bɛdɔɔso. Bio, wɔsan de biribi a wɔfrɛ no 'phytofix' wɔ pɔtɔ kasa mu no yɛ adwuma na ɛ no na ɛboa ma afifideɛ akɛseɛ binom tumi tetɛ nsuo ani a ɛnkɔ aseɛ. Nsuo a wɔde di dwuma no bɛtumi ayɛ tadeɛ a nnipa ahyɛda ayɛ. Deɛ ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa, wɔgyina ɛsu ahodoɔ a ɛda adi wɔ nsufi ho no so na wɔayɛ tadeɛ no. Deɛ nti a wɔyɛ no saa ne sɛ, ɛsono nneɛma wɔde di dwuma no mu biara su. Sɛ wɔyɛ tadeɛ foforɔ biara a, wɔbɛtumi de 'Omiflo phytofix' no bi ahyɛ mu.

Omiflo botaeɛ 
Omiflo ahyɛda ayɛ wɔn dwumadie no wɔ akwan sononko binom so a ɛgyina nneɛma nketenkete binom so. Saa nneɛma yinom bi ne, nsufi korɔ wde reyɛ adwuma, sɛde wɔbɛtumi de nsuo a wɔasɔne so no adi dwuma, ne nneɛma binom a ɛyɛ fɛ wɔ dwumadie no ho.

Onipa a ɔde dwumadie yi baeɛ 
Mshila Sio yɛ Kenyani a ɔsɔne nsufi so ma ɛbɛyɛ nsu pa.  N’adwuma no din de Omiflo a ɛwɔ Kenya ahenkuro Nairobi mu. Wɔwoo Mshila wɔ Kenya ɛnna ɔkɔɔ sukuu wɔ Australiaman mu wɔ afe 2012/2013 mu.

title: Benjamin Bonsu
text:
Benjamin Bonsu ka adesuafoɔ a wɔyɛɛ Afidie a wɔde yɛ okyinsromma mu nhwɛhwɛmu a wɔfrɛ no Ghanasat-1, eyi ne berɛ a edin kan a ɔman Ghana de afidie firii asaase yi so kɔɔ okyinsromma no mu. Adesuafoɔ a na wɔka Owura Benjamin Bonsu ho ne Owura Ernest Matey ne Owura Joseph Quansah. Saa berɛ no na Owura Benjamin Bonsu reyɛ ne Ph.D. wɔ Mfidie a wɔde yɛ abɔde3 mu nhwehwɛmu. Na ɔkyerɛkyerɛni a wɔaben yie paa wɔ mfiedie a wɔde yɛ okyinsromma mu nhwɛhwɛmu, Professor Mengu Cho, na ɛhwɛ no so.

Nhomasua

Wɔ afe 2013, Benjamin nyaa abodin a edi kan wɔ 'Electronics and Communcation Engineering' firii suapɔn All Nations University a ewɔ ɔman Ghana. Wɔ afe 2016, onyaa abodin a ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ 'Space Systems Engineering' firii suapɔn Kyushu Institute of Technology wɔ Japan na afei ɔyɛɛ ne Ph.D. toaa so wɔ suapɔn koro no ara mu.

Adwuma

Benjamin adi nnwuma ahoroɔ a agye din pii mu te sɛ CANSAT a wɔyɛɛ no afe 2013, 'Ground Station Project' wɔ afe 2014 na afei GhanaSat-1 a wɔdaa no adi 2017, Kitawonsa da ɛtɔ so nson. Nhwehwɛmu ahoroɔ a ɔreyɛ no fa kɛseɛ no ara fa  mfidie a ne bo nyɛ den na afie ɛho adwuma da fam a wɔde yɛ abodeɛ mu nhwɛhwɛmu. N'atirimpɔw kɛseɛ paa ne sɛ wɔde nneɛma soronko mmienu a woka si ani a ɔfa baako yɛ hye na ɔfa a aka nu yɛ nwunu berɛ a anyinam ahoɔden refa mu bɛyɛ adwuma wɔ mfidie a wɔde okyinsromma ahoroɔ so no mu. 

Benjamin Bonsu ka kuo ketewaa bi a ɛwɔ SGAC mu a wɔfrɛ no SSPG-SGAC ne SLPG-SGAC. Afei nso, Owura Benjamin ka kuo a emufoɔ firi aman ahoroɔ so a wɔyɛɛ HORYU-4 afidie a wɔde kyerɛɛ sɛnea ayinam ahoɔden ano den firi ase wɔ soro.

Nea w'ayɛ 

Owura Benjamin Bonsu dii kuo a ɛfiri Ghana nu anim de wɔn ho kɔkaa dwumadie a na edin a ɛda so ne Joint Global Multi-Nation Birds satellite a na suapɔn Kyushu Institute of Technology (KIT) , Japan, na na asɔ  adwumadie no asene. Na wɔyɛ dwumadie yi ma aman ahoroɔ a wontumi mfaa afiri biara nkɔɔ okyinsromma mu anaa nimdeɛ a wɔwɔ fa mfidie a ɛte saa ho sua. Aman ahoroɔ nnan na ɛde wɔn ho hyɛɛ dwumadie yi mu; Ghana, Mongolia, Nigeria ne Bangladesh. Hyɛ no nsow sɛ GhanaSat-1 ne okyinsromma mu nhwɛhwɛmu afiri a edin kan a ɔman Ghana atumi ayɛ. Suapɔn All Nations University na ɛfaa dwumadi no ho ka nyinaana eyi maa wɔbɛyɛɛ ankorankorɛ (private) suapɔn a edi kan a ɛde afidie akɔ onkyinsromma mu wɔ Africa.

Beaɛ A Minyaa Mmoa Firiiɛ

title: Tunde Owolabi
text:
Tunde Owolabi yɛ afrika ni a ɔfiri Nigeria. Ɔwoo no wɔ Lagos. Ɔyɛ nnwuma beberee na ɔsan nso wɔ nnwumakuo beberee a ɛyɛ ɔno ankasa dea.

Ne ho asɛm 
Tunde Owolabi yɛ Afrikani a ɔfiri Lagos a ɛwɔ Nigeria. Ɔsuaa mfonyinyɛ wɔ Okunini Abayomi Barber a ɔyɛ Nigeria Artist wɔ Lagos suapɔn mu, na ɔnyaa abɔdin krataa wɔ graphic design mu wɔ College of Technology. Ɔne nnwumakuo yi a ɛdidisoɔ yi adi dwuma: "Lines and colours" wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne mmiɛnsa mu (2003), "Inner thoughts" a ɛwɔ Nimbus African Art Center wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnan mu (2004), ɔsan ne mpɔtam nnwumakuo a ɛdidisoɔ yi nso dii dwuma: Guinness Group Exhibition wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnan mu (2004) ne dwumakuo God's of this age a ɛwɔ Didi Museum.

Ɔpaa ne dwumadie ho ntoma a ɛdi kan a ɛyɛ African Elegance wɔ Battersea Art Gallery, London wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nkron (2009). Yɛbɛhunu ne nnwuma a wayɛ no wɔ Hungarian Embassy ne Nigerian Stock Exchange.

Aso Oke- The wooven beauty a na ɛno nso yɛ ne dwumadie a ɛtɔ so mmienu a ɔdaa no adi wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du-nan (2014)

Tunde ne Neville Brody a wagye din wɔ dwomfoɔ adwuma mu ayɛ adwuma sɛ odwumfoɔ wɔ The Research Studio a ɛwɔ London.

Ɔyɛ obi a ɔpɛ coffee, n'ani gye aduane noa ho; ɔpɛ akwantuo na afei nso ɔyɛ obi a mmerɛ biara no ɔda nnoɔma foforɔ adi. Ɔyɛ obi a ɔwɔ adom akyɛdeɛ beberee ebi ne: mfoni twa, ɔdwomfoɔ.

Tunde Owolabi paa Ethnik dwumakuo wɔ Kotonimaa da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nkron wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du-nsia(2016) mu wɔ Araba's Café, Victoria Island, Lagos a ɛwɔ Nigeria. Seisei ɔte Lagos na ɛhɔ ara na ɔyɛ n'adwuma na ne studio no nso ɛhɔ ara na ɛwɔ.

Abrabɔ ahyease ne nwomasua 
Ɔnyaa adantamu abodin krataa wɔ University of Arts, London wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nwɔtwe de kɔsi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nkron (2008-2009).

Ɔsan nyaa abodin krataa wɔ Yaba College of Technology.

Adwumasɛm 
 

Ɔyɛ obi a ɔtwa mfoni.

Ɔyɛ odwomfoɔ

Ɔyɛ obi a ɔde ne nsa nwene adeɛ (artist).

Nnoɔma a w'ayɛ 
Ɔde Nigeria ntoma bi a wɔfrɛ no Aso Oke yɛ nnoɔma bi te sɛ: baage, ntaade ne mpaboa. Ɔwɔ studio a ɔdi ne dwuma a w'ato ne din Tunde Owolabi Studio.

title: Leti Arts
text:
Leti Arts yɛ Ghana adwumakuw a ɛhyehyɛ video games. Ghanani Eyram Tawia ne Kenyani Wesley Kirinya na woboom de adwumakuw yi sii hɔ.

Sɛnea wɔde sii hɔ 
Wɔde Leti Arts sii hɔ wɔ afe 2009 mu. Ghanani Eyram Tawia ne Kenyani Wesley Kirinya de saa adwuma yi sii hɔ sɛ wɔde bɛboa ma abibiman mu anansesɛm akɔ anim. Na wɔyɛ saa denam comics ne video games a wɔhyehyɛ so. Adwumakuw yi wɔ Madina - Accra, Ghana. Video games ne comics a wɔhyehyɛ no bi wɔ hɔ a wotimtim wɔ nhoma mu ne afei wɔ Android mfideɛ so. Kan no na wɔfrɛ adwumakuw no Leti Games Ghana Ltd nanso wɔsesaa edin no kɔɔ Leti Arts wɔ afe 2013 mu.

Wɔn a wɔka adwumakuw no ho 
Eyram Tawia - Ɔyɛ Ghanani. Ɔka ho bi na wɔde adwuma no sii hɔ. Ɔsan yɛ adwuma no mu CEO(Chief Eɔecutive Officer)

Wesley Kirinya - Ɔyɛ Kenyani. Ɔka ho bi na wɔde adwuma ni sii hɔ. Ɔsan yɛ adwuma no CTO(Chief Technical Officer)

Jake Manion - Ɔyɛ adwuma no mu Chief Creative Officer

Kwadwo Frimpong - Ɔyɛ adwuma no mu Creative Director.

title: Mphethi Morojele
text:
Mphethi Morojele yɛ South Afrikani a ɔyɛ adan ho mfonin. Ɔno na ɔda adwumakuo a wɔfrɛ wɔn "MMA Design Studio" ano, na ɔno ara nso ne adwuma no wura. Berɛ wɔhyɛɛ adwumakuo yi ase wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron-num (1995) mu no, na edin a ɛda adwumakuo no so ne 'MMA Architects.'

N'abrabɔ ahyɛaseɛ ne ne sukuukorɔ 
Wɔwoo Mpethi wɔ kuro bi a ɛwɔ South Afrika a wɔfrɛ no Lesotho mu Afe apem ahankron ne aduokron (1990) mu no, ɔgyee abodin a wɔfrɛ no Bachelor of Architecture firii Cape Town suapɔn no mu. Afe apem ahankron ne aduokron mmiɛnsa mu no, ɔtoaa n'adeusa so gyee abodin Master of Science in Architecture wɔ Barlett a ɔwɔ London Suapɔn a wɔfrɛ no University College of London no mu.

N'adwumasɛm 
Ɔwiee n'adesua no, Mphethi kɔkyerɛɛ adeɛ wɔ sukuu a wɔde tete nnipa a wɔyɛ adan ho mfonin a ɛwɔ suapɔn a wɔfrɛ no University of Witwatersrand a ɛwɔ South Afrika ahenkuro Johannesburg mu.  Ɛsiane sɛ ne ɔnam Afrikafoɔ nimdeɛ ne wɔn amammerɛ so na ɛyɛ ne nnwuma nyinaa nti, wɔagye din wɔ Abibirem ha ne amanɔne nyinaa. Mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne dunan mu no, na ɔka baasonkuo a wɔyɛ abɔdeɛ mu nhwehwɛmu a wɔfrɛ wɔn International Union of  Architects (UIA) no fa a ɛwɔ Durban no ho. Ɔka nnipa a wɔhyehyɛɛ ekuo a wɔfrɛ no African Architecture Awards no ho.  Ɔno na adwumakuo a wɔfrɛ no MMA Design Studio a ɛwɔ South Afrka ahenkuro Johannesburg mu no yɛ ne dea. Wayɛ ɔtɛmmuafoɔ ama amanɔne akansie ahodoɔ pii binom te sɛ UIA, the European Union, the Holcim Awards (Africa and Middle East).

Nnwuma ahodoɔ 
Mphethi adwumakuo no de wɔn ho ahyɛ nnwuma ahodoɔ a ɛfa adansie ho mfonin ahodoɔ ne nkuro akɛseɛ mu nnwuma ahodoɔ pii mu wɔ aman pii so wɔ Abibire mu ha. Saa nkuro ahodoɔ yi mu bi ne South Afrika, Lesotho, Mozambique, Uganda, Ethiopia, Botswana ne Burundi. Ɔno na ɔdii ɔman Faahodie Agodibea kɛseɛ a wɔka no pɔtɔ kasa mu sɛ 'Freedom Park' a ɛwɔ Pretoria no ho dwuma. Saa agodibea yi kɛseɛ bɛyɛ ahinanan aduonum mmienu (52 hɛkta).  Ɔno ara nso na ɔyɛɛ Faahodie Agodibea Adekoradan, nea wɔka no pɔtɔ kasa mu sɛ 'Freedom Park Musuem' no. Ɔno korɔ yi ara na ɔdii anim ma wɔsii ɛdan maa South Afrikafoɔ Aban asoeɛ a ɛwɔ Addis Ababa wɔ Ethiopia ne deɛ ɛwɔ Berlin wɔ Germany no.  Ɔno ara nso na ɔhwɛ maa wɔyɛɛ 'Westwood Way Private Residence' a ɛwɔ Johannesburg ne Parktown Girls High Science Centre no ho nnwuma nyinaa.

title: Empress Gifty
text:
Empress Gifty(a ɛnkane wɔfrɛ no Empress Gifty Osei) yɛ Ghana nnwomtoni ne obi a ɔpɛ ahosiesie. Ɔyɛ Obiba ɔdiikan too Nyame nnwom wɔ Ghana a ɔnyaa nnipa ɔpepepe baako wɔ abɛɛfo ntentan a wɔfrɛ no Instagram so.

Abrabɔ ahyɛaseɛ ne nnwomasua 

￼Oppong ne Annan abusua mu na wɔwoo Empress a na wɔn mmienu firi mfimfini mantam ne atɔeɛ mantam wɔ Ghana.Ɔhyɛɛ ne mmɔtafowa sukuu wɔ Mantey Din mmɔtafowa sukuu ne Oninku ntoasoɔ sukuu a ne nyinaa wɔ Tema. Ɔtoaa so kɔɔ fahyen sukuu wɔ Tema ɛna ɔwieɛ no, ɔbui ɔno ara fahyen sukuu wɔ Tema a ɔkyerɛɛ mmɔfra adeɛ wɔ ntaadehyɛ ne abrabɔ mu.

Nnwom adwuma 
Empress Gifty ne Opanka ne Zaza a wɔn wɔ South Africa bɔmm hyɛɛ adwuma.Ɔwɔ nnwom a agye din bi te sɛ Aseda, Fɛfɛɛfɛ, Ɛpikyɛ, Adansedie,Adom, Jesus over do, Jesus be too much, Odiyompo ne Ɛyɛ woa.

Wɔ mfeɛ mpem ne du nnwɔtwe wiase nyinaa Nyame nnwom abasobɔdeɛ mu no wɔbɔɔ no abaso maa no afe no mu nyinaa nnomtonii abasobɔdeɛ. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nkron mu no ɔno na ɔdii wɔn a wɔyi wɔn wɔ nwomtoɔ mu wɔ Maranatha Global som nwom abasobɔdeɛ mu wɔ Kenya.

Ɔnyaa VGMA nyame nwom afe no mu nyinaa abasobɔdeɛ ne albɔn wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu ɛna ɔsane nyaa 4syte Nyame nnwom mfonin wɔ afe no mu nyinaa wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu baako.

Ɔno na  ɛnam no so ma  Resurrection Effect Concert ba kasamfoni so afe biara.

N'abrabɔ ankasa 
Waware Ghana amanyɔni, Hopeson Adorye  a wɔwɔ mma mmienu.

title: Jessica Opare-Saforo
text:
Jessica Opare Saforo(wɔwoo no Oforisuo bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nkron wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe baako) yɛ Ghana Nsɛntwerɛni, Kasamfoni ne obi a ɔdi dwuma wɔ kasafidie so na ɔsane yɛ nnwuma pii. Biom, ɔno na ɔdi anim ma wɔde Transformation with Jess a ɛyɛ adeɛ a ɛdikan a  ɛma nipa so te wɔ Ghana wɔ kasamfoni so. Ɔno ne The Voice Ova Company a ɛyɛ dwumakuo a ɛboa nnipa a ɛwɔ adom akyɛdeɛ wɔ nne mu di yie nyinaa Kɔfabaeɛ.

Nnwomasua 
Saforo kɔɔ ne ntoasoɔ sukuu wɔ Akosombo ntoasoɔ sukuu  na ɔnyaa ne Bakyela degree wɔ Art mu firii University of Ghana,Legon a Ɔsuaa Economics ne Psychology.

Nnwuma 
Saforo yɛɛ adwuma wɔ kasafidie so bɛyɛ mfeɛ aduonu ɛna kasamfoni so bɛyɛ mfeɛ du nsia ɛno nti na ɔyɛ nsɛntwerɛni a wakyɛ wɔ nsɛntwerɛ adwuma mu. Ɔhyɛɛ aseɛ sɛ nsɛntwerɛni wɔ Vibe kasafidie so wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ɛna wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan mu ɔkɔɔ Choice Fm. Ɛno akyire no ɔkɔɔ Citi FM wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne num mu a ɛbɛyɛɛ tetenani maa Citi Drive ɛna ɛno akyire no ɛbɛyɛɛ Brunch wɔ Citi ɛna Traffic Avenue. Na ɔno na ɔdi anima wɔde Celebrity Fanzone ba wɔ GH One kasamfoni so, celebrity a woanya abasobɔdeɛ ne wɔn abrabɔ ho nsɛm nanso seisei deɛ ɔdi dwuma bi te sɛ Sister sister, mmaa nkitahodie wɔ wɔn awareɛ mu. Ɔbɛyɛɛ adwuma sɛ ɔtotoiɛfoɔ wɔ Citi  97.3 Fm ne Citi kasamfoni so, kasamfoni ne kasafidie yi mmienu yɛ adeɛ a agye din wɔ Ghana.

GhanaWeekend de too dwa sɛ Jessica agyae adwuma yɛ wɔ Citi kasafidie ne kasamfoni no so wɔ ɔpɛpɔn bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nnwɔtwe wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu mmienu. Ɔda dwumadie ahodoɔ pii wɔ abɛɛfo ntentan so,'Brunch in the citi', 'sex in the Citi,' 'sister sister', 'upside Down' ne Traffic Avenue'(a na wɔfrɛ no 'Citi Drive') a na ɛyɛ adeɛ a wɔyɛ no awia berɛ.

title: Matibabu (Rapid Malaria test)
text:
Matibabu  koeɛ ma ɛkwan a ɛda mpɔtɛm ɛne wɔn kwanpa  a wɔn de nya ayaresa no bɛsi.

Dwumadie ne Botaeɛ 
Wo ne nyinaa mu no,sɛ yɛnni ɛboɔ a ɛwɔ fɔm anaa sɛ nneɛma a yɛde yɛ nhwehwɛ mu (diagnostic ) sɛ yɛ bɛ nya mmuaeɛ afiri atiridii yadeɛ (malaria) wɔ mmuaeɛ a yɛ nnya no ntɛm wɔ yareɛ ahodoɔ mu wɔ mpɔtɛm a wɔn sika sɛm wɔ fɔm( nea ɛboa ma morbidity ne mortality wɔ atiridii yareɛ a ano yɛ den mu no kɔ soro) ɛne sɛ yɛ sa atiridii yareɛ no ɛma no boroso wɔ sɛ yɛde nsunsuanso a ɛdaadi ntotoeɛ a ɛdaadi wɔ nimdeɛ a yɛnni wɔ ayaresa nhwehwɛ mu ( ɛno nso ka nneɛma a  ɛseɛ sika wɔ yareɛ a ɛnnyɛ atiridii yareɛ  sa mu ne titirie pa ne sɛ ɛfiri mmereɛ a yɛ kamfo Artemisinin-based ayaresa akwan no sɛ ne boɔ yɛden no) Ɛtoso biom no, sɛ yɛnnya  nsɛm a ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ na ɛnsisi so a yɛ bɛtumi de yɛn ho atoso firi apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ asoɔeɛ  ɛmpo sɛ ɛyɛ nokware pɛfiee mpo sɛ wɔn wɔ taaboo nnyinasoɔ ahodoɔ  ntotoeɛ a apɔmuden adwumayɛfoɔ de di wɔn dwuma. Nsɛm ne nneɛma a ɛnsisisoɔ deɛ ɛyɛ papa ne dodoɔ  a yɛ nya anaa y'ɛnsa ka firi apɔmuden asoeɛ no nkyɛn no dodoɔ noara yɛ deɛ atwam anaa sɛ y'ɛnnfa nyɛ adwuma wɔ sa mmerɛ potii no mu  biom. Mprenpren, nsɛm ne nnoɔma a y'aboaboa ano ne nhwɛsoɔ akwan a y'ɛnsa ka no nyinaa firi Ɔman no apɔmuden ntotoeɛ nkratoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ mu (HMIS). Yɛ dinkae fa nsɛm ne nnoɔma firi apɔmuden adwumaeɛ bea npenpensoɔ wɔ nwuma a yɛde di dwuma ɛne abaafo ayaresa ntwerɛtohɔ dwumadie ma apɔmuden dwumadibea kakraa bi mpo na ɛwɔ saa ahoden no. Yɛ ntaeɛ nfa twerɛtohɔ nwoma nni  dwuma ɛsane sɛ ne papa mu nwie pɛyɛ na ɛsane nso taa yera wɔ kwan so wɔ mmereɛ a yɛde kɔ di dwuma.(nhwehwɛ mu nsɛm a ɛnsisi).HMIS amaneɛ bɔ a ɛntumi nkɔ wɔ ne brɛ ano,sɛ y'ɛnnfa ankorankorɛ apɔmuden ne nso nneɛma nka ho na yɛ gya no wɔ mpɔtɛm ho ara,sɛ HMIS mpaepae mu nneɛma a ɛnso ɛne amanyɔsɛm mmoa a ɛsoa. Sɛ yɛnni dwumadie nhehyɛ akwan papa a ɛbɛma yɛn nsa aka ɛne amaneɛ bɔ a ɛfa nea ɛwɔ hɔ a yɛ de ma no ɛnso no nti ɛkyerɛ sɛ ayaresa bea ahodoɔ no tar nnya nnuro ne mfidie aɛhohia wɔ mmerɛ tenten mu ,ɛno nti nnuro ne nhwehwɛ mu dwumadie no yɛntumi nfa yɛn ani nni akyire. Apɔmuden nkratoɔ a ɛnnoɔso ɛne nneɛma nhyehyɛeɛ yɛ ahohiadeɛ a ɛbɛ ma yɛn adwenkyereɛ atumpɔn ɛne sɛ yɛ bɛ nya ntamgyina mmoa brɛano brɛano. Yɛɛ akɔ beaeɛ a nneɛma ne nsɛm akwan a yɛ faso de di dwuma a nsunsuansoɔ papa ba  ɛne sɛ yɛɛ fa nneɛma a ɛfata  apɔmuden dwumadie nhyehyɛeɛ.    

Afidie anaa sɛ adeyɔdeɛ no wɔ ahoɔden a ɛtumi hunu atiridii (malaria)yareɛ mmoawa (parasites) no wɔ red blood cells no mu wɔ nhwehwɛ mu botaeɛ mu.Afidie no y'aso ahwɛ na yɛde di dwuma wɔ ayaresa bea akɛseɛ ne nkumaa mu ɛne bea a wɔ yɛ ayaresa mu mpɛnsɛnmpɛnsɛnmu. Botaeɛ ne sɛ ɔbɛyɛ point-care-testing (POCT) akwannya wɔ nkurase nkurase a wɔn nni ayaresa akwanya.

Adenwene /Ayɔdeɛ 
Ndwumakuo a wɔn maa anoyie na ɛdidisoɔ yi ;

 Matiscope: matiscope  yɛ portable parasite-based hardware afidie a ɛde nngyinasonsɛm ɛfiri ɛhae a apeteɛ ne atweboɔ de hunu plasmodium a ɛwɔ yɛn mogya a y'atweɛ no mu . Adeyɔdeɛ no ma ntohyɛsoɔ nhwehwɛ mu ne nhwehwɛ mu a ɛnfa ntohyɛsoɔ so wɔ desktop point of care.
 Yotta : kyere nneɛma bi tesɛ, beaeɛ nsɛm ne apɔmuden nhwehwɛ mu nkratoɔ, anonymized adwenkyereɛ wɔ nsɛm a ahobaebɔ ntotoeɛ wɔm  firi beaeɛ a  nneɛma a yɛde di akotene asie,  nea ɛnoankasa ɛne nimdeɛfoɔ nneɛma nhwehwɛm, customize output ɛne mmuayɛ ne anoyie wɔ berɛm. Virtualization nso boa yɛn ma yɛ dwane firi prediction algorithms boa ma yɛ te mmeaeɛmeaeɛ nyarewa a ɛtrɛtrɛ.
 Yotta cards: ɔyarefoɔ a yɛɛ di 'akyire sɛ yɛ bɛ boa no ama n'nya ayaresa bea ntotoeɛ ɛne ani a ɛdi aduro nsɛmnsɛm, nsrahwɛ nhyehyɛeɛ, ɔyarefoɔ no Kaade no ɛsie ma no anya ayaresa no biseabɔ na ɛdi so. 

Yotta surveillance apps: Ahoɔden no image recognition algorithms so, yɛ de nhwɛsoɔ akwan na ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ ayaresa bea wɔ nyarewa ahodoɔ a y'aboaboa ano nsɛm wɔ ɛbrɛano wɔ online ɛne offline ahoɔden so.

Afidie no yɛyɔɔ no wɔ Kampala a ɛwɔ Uganda man no mu a Matibabu CEO Brian Gitta ɛne ne  kuo (Joshua Businge, Josiah Kavuma, Moris Atwine, Simon Lubambo and Shafik Sekitto).

Abasobɔdeɛ 
Ɛkuo a ɛwɔ matibabu,  ahunu sɛ Villgro Kenya, Bayer Foundation,e4impact, Merck Accelerator ɛne  Resilient Africa Network(RAN)a ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ The United States Agency for International Development no ase.

Yɛ agye matibabu atum mpreɛn beberee wɔ UN Empowerment Award nam the Microsoft Imagine Cup,American Society for Mechanical Engineers’ iShow,The Duke of York’s Pitch@Palace, Royal Academy of Engineering The Aspirin Social Innovation Award, e4Impact, Disrupt 100,Times magazine next generation leaders, 2019 Rolex Laureate deɛ ɛkaho biom, y'adane taboo ngyinasoɔ akwan ahodoɔ  adi sɛ  Consumer Electronics Show (CES), The Tech Open Air Festival, Republica, Global Sankalp forum, TechCrunch Hardware Battlefield. Yɛ too nsa frɛ Brian Gitta ma no kɔ hyia Bill Gates a na ɛno nso ka MTV Base Africa dwumadie wɔ mfei  2016.

Afutufoɔ 
Matibabu na ɔka  Merck Accelerator dwumadie wɔ Merck Innovation Center in Darmstadt, Germany.
Matibabu afutufoɔ no be ne Dr. Nicole Kilian (Heidelberg University Hospital), Robert Karanja, MSc (Villgro Kenya) and Kush Mahan, MSc (ZoneIn).

title: Bintou Keita
text:
Bintou Keita (wɔwoo no wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduonum nnwɔtwe) yɛ obi a ɔwɔ United Nations a ɔnyaa ne diplomat firii Guinea. Ɔyɛ obi a wako adare wɔ sɛdeɛ yɛsi siesie ntawantawa a ɛwɔ nnipa ntam. Firi ɔpɛpɔn bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu baako mu no, wayɛ ɔtwerɛtwerɛfoɔ ama UN  ntamgyinafoɔ wɔ Democratic Republic of the Congo.

Abrabɔ ahyɛaseɛ ne nnwomasua 
Wɔwoooo Keita wɔ Guinea wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduonum nnwɔtwe. ￼Ɔnyaa degree wɔ Social Economy adesua mu firii University of Paris. Ɔkɔɔ Paris Suapɔn IX kɔnyaa ne Masters degree wɔ Business Administration ne Management mu.

Nnwuma 

Ɔhyɛɛ aseɛ yɛɛ adwuma maa United Nations wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe nkron mu. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nwɔtwe mu no ɔgyae n'adwuma a na ɔyɛ sɛ Joint Special Envoy abɛdiakyire ma (African Union-United Nations Hubrid Operation in Darfur(UNAMID). Ne dwumadie dada a na ɔyɛ no Anita Kiki Gbeho na ɛbɛtoaa so.

Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nkron mu no, Keita bɛyɛɛ ɔtwerɛtwerɛfoɔ abɛdiakyire maa abibiman.  Wɔ ne nkitahodie bi mu no ɔkaa sɛ ɔpɛ sɛ ɔboa ma mmaa dɔɔso wɔ asraadɔmkuo mu. Ne papa wɔ asraadɔmkuo nom a ɔhyɛɛ ne nkuran sɛ ɔmmɛka ho. Seisei ɔrehwɛ asraafoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ saa adwuma nom wɔ abibirem ɛna wahunu sɛ baabi wɔ hɔ a mmaa anaa mmaa ne mmarima a yaka wɔn abom bɛtumi ayɛ adwuma a ɛbɛtumi ama mmarima nkoa adi ntwo. Ɛnkane no na mmaa nkoa yɛ ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu num wɔ asraafoɔ mu.

  Wɔ ɔpɛpɔn bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu baako mu no,wɔyii no sɛ ɔmmɛdi United Nations Organization Stabilization Mission a ɛwɔ Democratic Republic of the Congo MONUSCO so na ɔnsane nyɛ twerɛtwerɛfoɔ mma UN ntamgyinafoɔ wɔ Democratic Republic of the Congo. Ɔdii nkunim wɔ Algeria UN Leila Zerrougui mu. Wɔ Oforisuo bosome mu no ɔde nsɛm kɔmaa mpaninfoɔ no. Berɛ a ɔregye atom sɛ nnipa wɔ ho akwannya sɛ ɔbɛka biribi afa MONUSCO ho no, ɔhunuu sɛ nsɛm no bi nyɛ koraa. Ɔtwerɛɛ sɛ "wahunu sɛ nkitahodie a ɛda United Nations ne Democratic Republic of the Congo mu no ano yɛ den na ɛmu trɛ a wahunu no baabi".

title: Marietta Brew Appiah-Oppong
text:
Marietta Brew Appiah-Oppong( wɔwoo no wɔ Tema) yɛ Ghanani baa a ɔyɛ legal practitioner ne ɛnkane Ghana Aban Lɔya ne Ghana ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ atɛntenenee so. Ɔmanpanin Mahama na ɔyii no wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmiɛnsa mu. Ɔno ne ɔbaa a ɛtɔ so mmienu a wakuraa saa diberɛ no wɔ ɔman yi mu, nea ɔdikan no ne Owurayere Betty Mould-Iddrisu. Ne berɛ a ɔdii no sɛ Ghana Aban Lɔya no kɔɔ awieeɛ wɔ ɔpɛpɔn bosome da a ɛtɔ so nsia wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nson mu. Wɔyii no sɛ ɔmmɛsom Arbitration Kɔɔto wɔ International Chamber of Commerce firi Kitawonsa bosome da a ɛdikan wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nnwɔtwe mu bɛyɛ mfeɛ mmiɛnsa. Ɔyɛ animuonyamfoɔ kuoba wɔ Council a ɛwɔ Ghana Association of Restructuring and Insolvency Advisors (GARIA).

Nnwomasua 
Marieta hyɛɛ ne nnwomasua ase wɔ Tema Parents Association sukuu. Ɔkɔɔ ne ntoasoɔ sukuu wɔ St Roses sukuu (Akwatia) ɛhɔ na ɔtenaa nyaa ne Ordinary Level Certificate (O Level) ne Advanced Level Certificate (A Level). Ɔnyaa ne Bakyela wɔ mmara mu degree wɔ University of Ghana, Legon ne Okunini nkrataa a ɔde bɛyɛ mmara adwuma firii Ghana School of Law,(Makola). Ɛno akyire no na ɔkɔɔ Institute of Social studies,Hague a ɛwɔ Netherlands, kɔpɛɛ post Graduate degree.

Nnwuma 
Marietta abɛyɛ obi a ɔyɛ mmaranimnii bɛyɛ mfeɛ aduonu ni a ɔhyɛɛ saa adwuma no ase wɔ Fugar ne Co. Law firm. Ɔsane kɔyɛɛ panin wɔ wɔ Litthur Brew ne Co Law firm. Ɔyɛ onimuonyamfoɔ a ɔka Council wɔ Ghana Association of Restructuring and Insolvency Advisors (GARIA).

Amanyɔsɛm 
Na ɔka Ghana@50 Commission nhwehwɛmu no ho ne ekuoba wɔ Volta River Authority(VRA) mu a ɛnkane Manpanin John Atta-Mills a wanya ne baabi kɔ ma ɔyii no wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nkron mu. Ɛnkane Manpanin John Dramani Mahama yii Marietta Brew Appiadu-Oppong￼ sɛ Aban Laya ma Ghana ne Ghana ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ atɛntenenee so firi ɔgyefoɔ bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmiɛnsa dekɔ ɔpɛpɔn bosome da a ɛdikan wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nson mu.

International Chamber of Commerce 
Wɔ Ayɛwohomummɔ bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nwɔtwe mu no, wɔyii no sɛ ɔnsom mfeɛ mmiɛnsa wɔ amanɔne beaɛ a wɔhwehwɛ kɔɔto nsɛm mu bɛyɛ mfeɛ mmiɛnsa a ɛhyɛ aseɛ wɔ Kitawonsa bosome da a ɛdikan wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nnwɔtwe mu dekɔ Ayɛwohomummɔ bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduasa wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu baako mu. Berɛ a wɔyɛ wɔn adwene sɛ wɔbɛfa no no hyɛɛ aseɛ wɔ Ayɛwohomummɔ bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduonu baako wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nnwɔtwe, wɔ ICC world Council nhyiamudie wɔ Paris.

title: Veronica Bekoe
text:
Veonica Bekoe yɛ obi a ɔnyaa Abɔdeɛ mu nyansapɛ Biologist  firii Ghana.Nnipa dodoɔ noa nim no ɛnam sɛ ɔno na ɔyɛɛ de Veronica bucket  baa a ɛbɛte nyarewa a ɛtumi sae so.

Nnwomasua 
Veronica kɔɔ ntoasoɔ sukuu wɔ Aburi Girls. Ɛno akyire na ɔkɔɔ Kwame Nkrumah suapɔn a ɔnyaa ne abɔdeɛ mu nyansapɛ bakyela  wɔ Biological Science/Biology bɛyɛ afe apem ahankron ne aduosia nnwɔtwe ne afe apem ahankron ne aduoson mmienu ntam.

Nnwuma 
N'adwuma ba ɔyɛɛ no wɔ Ghana apomuden bea no mu trɛɛ firii afe apem ahankron ne aduoson mmienu dekɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe, ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ aban apomuden bea ne labo a yɛhwehwɛmu fa nnipa ho,  ɔyɛɛ adwuma maa National AIDS/STI control program ɛna ɔko daree mu wɔ medical Laboratory Practice bɛboro mfeɛ aduasa.  Wako adare wɔ Labo ntotoiɛ mu, development of training manuals, nkyerɛkyerɛ nnipa adeɛ, ɔma nnipa kwan a wɔbɛfa so afiri nnipa ne nea ɛkeka ho.

Nnoɔma a ɔyɛɛeɛ 
Yɛnim Veronica sɛ ɔno na ɔyɛɛ Veronica bokiti. Wɔyɛɛ bokiti no sɛ yɛde bɛtu yareɛ a ɛbaa wone na worefe ase. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu mu no abibirem ne wiase afanaa de saa bokiti yi ko tia yadeɛ kodiawuo Kotoka birus(COVID-19) anaa SARS-COV-2.  Ɛnam sɛ ɔhunuu ɔhaw bi a na ɛwɔ beaɛ a ɔyɛ adwuma nti na ɛmaa no de saa  bokiti no baeɛ, ɔhunuu sɛ wɔnni adeɛ wɔde nsuo bɛgum ama no atene na wɔde ahohoro wɔ nsa na wɔde nsuo gu adeɛ mu desi hɔa wɔnhohoro wɔn nsa sɛ wɔyɛ adwuma wɔ ayaresabea a ɛyɛ hu ma wɔn apomuden ɛfiri sɛ na ɛwɔ sɛ obiara de saa nsuo no hohoro wɔn nsa kɔpem sɛ nsuo no bɛyɛ fii, ɔhunuu saa no ɔde bokiti bi a adeɛ wɔ ho a nsuo bɛfa mu a yɛde tɔn Hausa Koko a nnipa pii frɛ no Akwadaa gyae su a ɛna na seisei ɛyɛ Veronica bokiti a yɛnim no baabiara no.

Abasobɔdeɛ 
Owurayere Rebecca Akufo-Addo maa no abasobɔdeɛ wɔ ɛkwan a ɔfaa so de yɛɛ bokiti a yɛde nsuo gum ma no tene na yɛde samina  ka ho hohoro yɛ nsa de te yɛn ho firi yareɛ pii ho.

title: Mary Spio
text:
Mary Spio yɛ obi a ɔkora  hyɛn, tech innovator ne obi a ɔkura nnwuma pii. Ɔno ne CEEK Virtual Reality adwumawura ne ne Kɔfabaeɛ.

Abrabɔ ahyɛaseɛ ne nnwomasua 
Yɛtetee Spio wɔ Ghana. Ɔkɔɔ Holy Child ntoasoɔ sukuu a ɛwɔ Cape Coast. Ɔdii mfeɛ du nsia no ɔtu kɔtenaa Syracuse, New York a ɛwɔ US. Ɔkɔɔ Syracuse suapɔn a ɔnyaa abɔdeɛ mu nyansapɛ bakyela degree wɔ Electrical engineering wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nnwɔtwe. Ɛno akyire no ɔkɔsuaa Masters degree wɔ Electrical engineering ne computer Science mu firii Georgia Institute of Technology.

Nnwuma 
Spio somm wɔ U.S wiemhyɛnbea bɛyɛ mfeɛ nsia wideband ne obi a ɔsiesie satellite a yɛde di nkɔmmɔ. Aberɛ ɔsom wieɛ wɔ wiemhyɛnbea hɔ no ɔsane kɔɔ beaɛ a wɔde satellite di nkɔmmɔ ɛna ɔnya akwanya a ɔbɛsiesie ansan abui satellite akɔ beaɛ pii wɔ NASA dwumadie mu. Ɔbɛyɛɛ Boeing dwumakuo panin a ɔda satellite a yɛde di nkɔmmɔ wɔ hɔ ano.￼

CEEK VR

Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du num mu no, Spio kɔfaa CEEK Virtual Reality platform baeɛ, a seisei ɛyɛ beaɛ a yɛda biribi adi wɔ abɛɛfo ntentan so a ɛboa ma nnipa pii noa tumi nya wɔn akyidɔmfoɔ ne wɔn nya nkitahodie  wɔ Virtual Reality headsets so, gaming Consoles, kasanomaa, kasanomaa kɛseɛ so, dɛsktɔp, laptɔp ne kasamfoni so. CEEK VR platform no mu trɛ kɔɔ CEEK VR App ne CEEK wɛɛbsite.

Ɔtwerɛfoɔ 
Spio yɛ ɔtwerɛ nnwoma sane yɛ ɔtwerɛfoɔ ma it's Not Rocket Science: 7 Game-changing Traits for uncommon success, nnwoma bi a wɔdaa no adi maa amansan hunuuiɛ wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du num, ne A song for Carmine, a love-romance novel. Ɔsane boa ma wɔtwerɛɛ chicken soup for the soul wɔ mmerɛ bi a atwam.

Beaɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ.

title: Afia Pokua
text:
Afia Pokua (a nnipa dodoɔ noa frɛ no Vim Lady) yɛ Ghana nsɛntwerɛni ne obi a ɔdi Despite Media Group anim,di dwuma wɔ Peace kasafidie so,Okay kasafidie so Neat kasafidie so ne Hello kasafidie a ɛwɔ Kumase.

Nnwomasua 
Ɔkɔɔ ne ntoasoɔ sukuu wɔ Labone sukuu. Ɔsane kɔɔ Ghana Institute of Journalism ne Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration ma bakyela degree wɔ mmara mu.

Nnwuma 
Ɔyɛ ɛnkane samufoɔ ma Adom kasafidie,a ɛyɛ Multimedia Group Limited. Bɛyɛ mfeɛ nson nie Afia yɛɛ sɛ ɔbɛgyae adwuma wɔ Multimedia ɛnam ntawantawa bi a ɔne nea ɔtoto nnoɔma wɔ Kasafidie hɔ nyaeɛ.

Wɔ ahinime bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nkron mu no, ɔfirii Multimedia de ne ho kɔbɔɔ UTV, kasa mfonin a ɛyɛ Despite Media Group dea. Seisei Afia ne kyeame ma Egyaso Gyasi, kaseɛbɔ dwumadie bi a agyedin a woyɛ no wɔ Okay kasafidie so ɛfiri Ɛdwoada kɔpɛm Efiada bɛyɛ anwummerɛ nnɔnson ne nnɔnkron abɔ apae mu ntam. Ɔno na ɔsane yɛ kyeame ma UTV anɔpa dwumadie bi a yɛyno Adekye Nsoroma.

Abasobɔdeɛ ne nkaeɛ 
Kasafidie ne kasamfoni abasobɔdeɛ na ɔgyee nsɛntwerɛni baa a ɔdimu wɔ kasafidie so abasobɔdeɛ wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nkron ne mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu mu.

N'abrabɔ ankasa 
Wɔ Kɔtonimaa bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu mu na Afia daa no adi a ɛdikan sɛ ɔwɔ babarima a ɔwɔ ne mmabunu mfie mu.

Atuhoakyɛ adwuma 
Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nnwɔtwe mu no, ɔkɔfaa SugarDem Ministry baeɛ, a ɛyɛ ekuo bbi a ɛboa tene PepperDem asoeɛ a ɛboa ma mmaa ne mmarima nya nkitahodie soronko.

title: Gloria Amon Nikoi
text:
Na Gloria Adwoa Amon Nokoi, née Addae ( Ayɛwohomummɔ bosome da a ɛtɔ so nsia wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduonu nso dekɔ obubuo bosome a ɛtɔ so du wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mu) yɛ Ghana diplomat a ɔsomm sɛ ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ amanɔne nsɛm so wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduoson nkron wɔ Armed Force Revolutionary Council (AFRC) aban ase.  Ɔyɛ Ghanani baa a ɔdiikan kuraa saa diberɛ no

Nnwuma 
Ɔkɔɔ Achimota College. Na Nikoi yɛ Ɔtɛmmuafoɔ abɛdiakyire ma United Nations firi afe apem ahankron ne aduosia nkron dekɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduoson nan. Ɛno akyire no Gloria Nikoi yɛɛ adwuma sɛ Panin wɔ Ghana asoeɛ a ɔhwɛ amanɔne nsɛm so.

Asraafoɔ atuaten  wɔ Ayɛwohomummɔ bosome da a ɛtɔ so nan wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduoson nkron akyire a ɛtoo  ban kunini a ɔda asraafoɔ ano no, wɔmaa no yɛɛ amanɔne soafoɔ bɛyɛ abosome nnan wɔ Armed Force Revolutionary Council (AFRC) wɔ Flight Lieutenant Jerry Rawlings  aban mu. Ɛkɔɔ awieeɛ ɛbɔ bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nan wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduoson nkron mu, Kwasafoman a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa wɔ Dr. Hilla Limann amanyɔkuo People's National party aban pɛn so.

Gloria Nikoi bɛyɛɛ kasamafoɔ maa erstwhile sikakorabea ma adansie, Ghana sikakorabea wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe baako mu. Ɔsane nso yɛɛ ɔtenetenefoɔ maa African Development Sikakorabea (AfDB). Ɔbɛyɛɛ kasamafoɔ a ɔdikan ma council no wɔ Ghana Stock Exchange  wɔ berɛ a wɔdii no wɔ Obubuo bosome da a ɛtɔ so du mmienu wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron.

N'abrabɔ ankasa 
Ɔwaree Amon Nikoi, ɛnkane aban man Ghana sikakorabea ne ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ sikasɛm so, a ɔne no nyaa mma mmiɛnsa.

Owuo ne ayiyɔ 
Ɔwuu owupa wɔ Washington, D.C wɔ Obubuo bosome da a ɛtɔ so du wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du wɔ berɛ a wadi mfeɛ aduowɔtwe mmiɛnsa. Wɔyɛɛ n'ayie wɔ Nkran Ridge Asɔre, ɔhɔ na na ɔkɔ asɔre.

Beaɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ 

Ganafoɔ

title: Abena Amoah
text:
Abena Amoah yɛ obaa a ɔwɔ Ghana a ɔdi sikakorabea anim ne sika afutuo anim. Wɔ Ayɛwohummumɔ bosome da a ɛtɔ so du num wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu mu no, wɔyii no sɛ ɔtenetenefoɔ abɛdiakyire ma Ghana Stock Exchange. Wɔ saa diberɛ no mu no Ms. Amoah asɛdeɛ ne sɛ ɔbɛhwɛ ama Exchange no dwumadie biara bɛkɔ tɔɔtee na wasane aboa ɔtenetenefoɔ wɔ adwuma no nhyehyɛeɛ ne kwan a wɔbɛfa ama no atumpɔn. Wɔ ne yie no mu no,na Abena ne chief Executive officer ma Baobab afotufoɔ, sikasɛm afotufoɔ adwumakuo bi a ɔde baeɛ. Amoah asom wɔ Wapic Insurance Limited (Ghana), Access Bank Limited (Ghana) ne African Women's Development Fund. Ɔgyee Newmont Gold Ghana abasobɔdeɛ wɔ National Youth Excellence abasobɔdeɛ wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nsia mu. Ɛna wɔbɔɔ ne din sɛ ɔno na ɔda nso  mmaa ɔha mu a wɔyɛ nnwuma pii wɔ Ghana wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia.

Nnwomasua 
Abena Amoah wiee ne bakyila degree wɔ University of Ghana Business sukuu a ɔnyaa first class wɔ Administration mu. Ɔkɔɔ me ntoasoɔ sukuu wɔ St Roses sukuu wɔ ɔnimuonyamfoɔ Sister Solamen Ott ne Simon Zeta nsam a ɛwɔ German Dominican Nuns a ɛwɔ Akwatia, apueɛ mantam Ghana.

Nnwuma 
Amoah yɛɛ sɛ ɔbɛsi Baobab afotufoɔ aberɛ a ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ obi a ɔda Investment banking ne Sikasɛm nkyekyɛmu wɔ Renaissance ahenkuro a ɛwɔ Ghana mfeɛ bi a atwam no.  W'asom sɛ ɔtenetenefoɔ wɔ dwumakuo pii mu a ebi ne Ghana Stock Exchange, Ghana Venture Capital trust Fund, Pioneer Aluminium, Newworld Renaissance ahobanbɔ, Strategic African securities ne Ghana Securities Industry Association. Wɔ Ɔsanaa bosome da a ɛtɔ so du num wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu mu no, wɔyii no sɛ ɔtenetenefoɔ abɛdiakyire ma Ghana Stock Exchange.

Nea wanya 

 Ɔsomm sɛ ɔtenetenefoɔ maa Ghana Stock Exchange.
 Ɔsomm wɔ African Women's Development Fund dɔm ano sɛ ɔtenetenefoɔ ne kasamafoa sikasɛm kuo no.
 Na ɔyɛ aban wɔ Millennium Excellence abasobɔdeɛ wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne num.

title: Dzifa Bampoh
text:
Dzifa Gbeho Bampoh a wɔnim no wɔ abɛɛfo ntentan so sɛ Dzifa Bampoh yɛ Ghana nsɛntwerɛni, nkitahodienii ne obi a ɔwɔ abɛɛfo ntentan so. Seisei Dzifa ne Ɔsamufoɔ panin wɔ 3Fm ne TV3. Ɔdii mfeɛ du mmienu sɛ nsɛntwerɛni wɔ Multimedia Group Limited (Joy FM) ansa na ɔrekɔ yɛ panin wɔ Tullow Ghana sɛ ɔkasamafoɔ ne nhwehwɛmu tenetenefoɔ wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nson.

Nnwuma 
Nsɛntwerɛnii

Dzifa hyɛɛ ne nnwuma ase wɔ kasafidie so wɔ Ghana Broadcasting Corporation (GBC) firi afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nson dekɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne num, a ɔyɛ kyeame ma "UniiQ Breakfast Drive" (mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne mmienu dekɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne num) ne GTV mmabunu dwumadie, "Next Level" (firi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne mmiɛnsa dekɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan).

Ɔno akyire no ɔkɔɔ Multimedia Group Limited (Joy FM) firi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne num dekɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nson, a ɔdi dwuma pii wɔ  nsesamu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmiɛnsa dekɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nson. Ɔkyeame ma kaseɛbɔ mpensenpensemu dwumadie"Newsnite" firi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nson dekɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nson, abatoɔ dwumadie "Joint Caucus"  wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia ne efie nsɛnsɛm firi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nsia dekɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu. Dzifa dii Joy ahobanbɔ ano firi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du num dekɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nson ɛna na ɔyɛ ɔtotoiɛ ma Ɔmanpanin firi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nsia dekɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe.

Seisei Dzifa na ɔda 3Fm ne TV3 kaseɛbɔ nyinaa ano. Ɔdii kasafidie ne kasamfoni anim a ɔboa ma kaseɛbɔ bɔ ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne ho ne nsɛm a ɛba dabiara. Ɔno ne kyeame ma "First Take"  kaseɛbɔ mpensenpensemu a wɔyɛ no wɔ 3Fm, nkitahodie soronko ne "Key Points"  ma TV3.

Kasamafoɔ

.￼ 
Na Dzifa yɛ kasamafoɔ ne hwehwɛmu tenetenefoɔ ma Tullow Ghana firi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nson dekɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu  wɔ nkitahodie, abɛɛfo ntentan mu, ne nhwehwɛmu mu.

Abasobɔdeɛ 
Dzifa gyee mmaa abasobɔdeɛ-abɛɛfo ntentan wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nson, RTP abasobɔdeɛ wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nan ne mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du baako sɛ "Newsnite Anchor", CIMG dwumadie wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nson wɔ Joy kasafidie "Home Affairs" so ne mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne mmiɛnsa mmabunu dwumadie a ɛfa abɛɛfo ntentan ho ntamgyinafoɔ ma GTV "Next Level" so.

title: Portia Arthur
text:
Portia Asare(wɔwoo no ɔpɛpɔn bosome da a ɛtɔ so nson wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron) yɛ Ghanani a ɔtwerɛ nnwoma sane ma nkaeɛbɔ. Ɔdaa ne nnwoma a yato ne din The Odds adi wɔ Kitawonsa bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nnwɔtwe mu. Ɔhyɛɛ nnwoma no ase wɔne mmɔfra berɛ mu, a ɛboa hyɛ mmabunu no nkuran ma wɔkan  wɔ berɛ a ɔde nnwoma boa wɔn wɔ wɔnnwomasua mu na ɔto akenkan kuo wɔ sukuu ne nsɔre ahodoɔ pii mu.

Nnwomasua 
Arthur wiee Kwame Nkrumah suapɔn na ɔkɔsuaa Publishing wɔ hɔ.

Ɔwɔ nnoɔma yi a ɛma no di mu wɔ baabiara.

Nnwuma 
Portia yɛ ɔtwerɛfoɔ ne nsɛntwerɛfoɔ.

Abasobɔdeɛ ne nkaeɛ 
Wɔyii Arthur sɛ ɔno ne obi a ɔnim ahosiesie wɔ afe nom wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nkron Ghana lifestyle abasobɔdeɛ mu. Wɔsane yii no wɔ Makeup Blog wɔ afe nom wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nkron Ghana Makeup abasobɔdeɛ mu wɔ ntoboa a ɔde boaa abrabɔ wɔ Pulse Ghana. Wɔ ɔpɛpɔn bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduasa baako wwɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu no, wɔgyee no tomm wɔ abɛɛfo ntentan Instagram ne Facebook.

title: Gisèle Rabesahala
text:
Marie Gisèle Aimée Rabesahala (wɔ woo no wɔ afe apem ahankron aduonu nkron, Kɔtɔnimaa bosome no mu [May 1929]  ɛna ɔwuiɛ wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du-baako mu, Ayɛwohomummɔ bosome no da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nson – [27 June 2011]) na ɔyɛ Malagasy amanyɔni ɛna na ɔsane nso yɛ ɔbaa a na ɔyɛ activist a ɔno ne ɔbaa a ɔdi kan a ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔsoafoɔ wɔ Madagascar amanmuo mu berɛ a ɛdi kan koraa. ɔde ne ho kɔwuraa amannyɔsɛm mu wɔ berɛ a na wadi mfie du nson (17), a na ɔbɔ ntoa de ma amannyɔfoɔ a wɔdeda afiease, ɛna ɔnam so de bɛyɛɛ Madagascar man no mu ɔbaa a ɔdi kan a ɔbɛyɛɛ municipal councilor, ansa na ɔrebɛyɛ ɔbaa a ɔdi kan wɔ Malagasy a ɔno ankasa rete n'amannyɔkuo na wasane nso ayɛ amanyɔkuo no foroakaatufoɔ a ɔdi kan. Na ɔyɛ Marxist ni a na ɔwɔ atuhoakyɛ yie pa ara a na ɔka nnipa a wɔkabɔɔm tee communist Congress amannyɔkuo no a ɛnam so maa wɔnyaa faahodie de maa Madagascar man no, wɔgyee tumi no bɛdii ɔman no so wɔ afe apem ahankron aduoson num (1975) mu. wɔ afe  apem ahankron aduoson nson (1977) mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ Madagascar soafoɔ a ɔdi kan a ɔyɛ ɔbaa, a na ne dwumadie titire ne deɛ yɛka no wɔ borɔfo kasa mu sɛ "promoting revolutionary art and culture", nanso ɔhweree n'adwuma wɔ afe 1991 mu berɛ a ne fa a ɔyɛ hɔ soafoɔ no wɔguu wɔn dwumadie no ɛfiri sɛ na Madagascar man no asane agye multi-party kabimamenkabi amanmuo no atom bio. ɔkɔɔ so dii ne dwuma sɛ amannyɔni ne nsɛmtwerɛni de kɔsi sɛ ɔwuiɛ wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du-baako (2011) mu.

title: Daniel Nii Laryea
text:

Wɔ wo Laryea wɔ Nkran ɛwɔ afe 1987. Ɔkɔɔ sukuu wɔ Accra Academy.

title: Aisha Yesufu
text:
Aisha Somtochukwu Yesufu (wɔwoo no wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa bosome a ɛtɔ so du mmienu wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduoson mmiɛnsa mu) yɛ Nigerianii ɔbaa a ɔboa ma dwumadie bi kɔ so  ɛna ɔsane yɛ nnwuma pii. Ɔka ho na wɔtee #BringBackOurGirls anamɔtuo, a Boko Haramfoɔ bɛfaa  mmaa pii bɛyɛ ahanu a wɔwɔ ntoasoɔ wɔ Chibok, Nigeria wɔ Oforisuo bosome da a ɛtɔ so du nan wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nan mu. Ɔde ne ho hyɛɛ anamɔtuo bia wɔfrɛ no End SARS mu a wɔsɔre tiaa Nigeria Polisifoɔ a wɔde ɔhyɛ baa wɔnsoɔ.

Abrabɔ ahyɛaseɛ ne nnwomasua 
Wɔwoo Aisha Somtochukwu Yesufu wɔ Kano States na wɔtetee no wɔ hɔ, na ɛwɔ Agbede  a ɛwɔ Edo State. Ɔbɛbrɛɛ ɛnam sɛ ɔyɛ ɔbaa  wɔ mpɔtam a na  mmarima nkoa wɔ. Ɔkaa sɛ berɛ a na wadi mfeɛ du baako no, na ɔnni nnamfonom a wɔyɛ mmaa ɛfiri sɛ na wɔ nyinaa aware na ebi nso awu wɔn mmɔfra berɛ mu, ɛna berɛ a ɔdii mfeɛ aduonu nan s ɔwareeɛ no na  na ne nnamfonom pii noa yɛ mmerewa. Ɔse ɛnam na ɔpɛ nnwoma nti ɛboa no ne mmɔfra berɛ mu, ɛna akenkan nso boaa no hunuu sɛ " yɛwɔ wiase a ɛboro tokuro bi a na ɔnyini wɔm ɛna na ɔpɛ saa abrabɔ no". Ɔpɛɛ kwan wɔ Nigerian Defence Academy wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron baako, nanso ɛnam sɛ na ɔyɛ ɔbaa nti wɔbɔɔ no san yɛ. Afei deɛɔkɔɔ Usmanu Danfodiyo suapɔn wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron mmienu, nanso wɔtoo sukuu nom no, ɔkɔɔ Ahmadu Bello suapɔn kɔsuaa medicine. Yesufu firii Ahmadu Bello suapɔn berɛ a wɔsane too saa suapɔn nom biom, ɛnam sɛ wɔkuu okunini bi wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nan. Ɔwiee ne nnwomasua wɔ Bayero University Kano a ɔwiee ne degree wɔ microbiology mu.

Abasobɔdeɛ 
Na ɔka BBC mmaa ɔha wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu.Na Yesufu ka abibifoɔ mmaa ɔha a wɔdi mu wɔ New African koowa nkrataa mu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu.

N'abrabɔ ankasa 
Yesufu waree ne kunu Aliu wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nnwɔtwe. Wɔm wɔ mma mmienu.

title: Abigail Ashley
text:
Abigail Ashley yɛ Ghana Kasamfoni nsɛntwerɛfoɔ,ɔdi kyeame wɔ kasafidie so, apomuden kasamafoɔ ne tetenani ma dwumadie bi a wɔfrɛ no "Behind my smile Foundation" a ɛnni aban mu(NGO) a wɔn botaeɛ ne sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ apomuden a ɛfa yɛn saa ho. Ɔno na ɔtwerɛɛ "A Decade of My Life" Behind my smile.

Ashley yɛ nsɛntwerɛni sane yɛ kyeame ma "My Health, My Life" wɔ United Television so wɔ Ghana. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nson mu no wɔyii no kaa mmabunu aduonum a wɔma nnipa ani kɔ wɔn ho wɔ Ghana.

N'abrabɔ 
Wɔyɛɛ no nhwehwɛmu na ɔtumi dederiim wɔ ne saa yareɛ koankorɔ ho berɛ a wɔmaa no mfeɛ num sɛ ɔmfa ntena asaase so. Wɔpaepae no mu maa no saa foforɔ.

Abasobɔdeɛ 
Wɔhyɛɛ no animuonyam wɔ Edition a ɛtɔ so nkron wɔ 3G abasobɔdeɛ wɔ Bronx a ɛwɔ New York, USA. Ɛnam ne ntoboa a ɔde maa ankorankorɛ ne aporɔbɔ a ɔbɔ sɛ nnipa ɛhwɛ wɔn asetena mu yie fa wɔn apomuden ho nti na wɔmaa no abasobɔdeɛ no.

title: Gizella Tetteh Agbotui
text:
Gizella Tetteh Agbotui(wɔwoo no wɔ Obubuo bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduasa) yɛ ɔdansini wɔ Ghana na ɔsane yɛ amanyɔni. Ɔkɔpere wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu Ghana abatoɔ nom na ɔdii nkunim wɔ mmarahyɛbedwa akonnwa no so maa Awutu Senya West mpesoa so.

Abrabɔ Ahyɛaseɛ ne nnwomasua 
Wɔwoo no wɔ Obubuo bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduasa wɔ Cape Coast a ɛwɔ mfimfini mantam wɔ Ghana, Gizella Tetteh mmɔtafoa  adesua hyɛaseɛ firii afe apem ahankron ne aduoson num dekɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe baako wɔ University primary sukuu wɔ Cape Coast. Ɔkɔɔ Wesley Girls ntoasoɔ sukuu firi afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe baako dekɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe nwɔtwe. Ɔnyaa BSc wɔ Environmental Design ne post graduate diploma wɔ Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology (KNUST) firi afe apem ahankron ne aduokron dekɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nson. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nson mu no ɔnya MBA wɔ marketing wɔ University of Ghana Business sukuu, Legon.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Agbotui yɛ ekuoba wɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic congress mu. Wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu mu no, wɔyii no sɛ mmarahyɛbedwani ma Awutu Senya West mpesoa berɛ a ɔpere akonnwa no wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu Ghana abatoɔ wɔ kyineeɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic congress ananmu na ɔdii nkunim. Ɔnyaa mma mpem aduasa mmienu, ahanson ne nnwɔtwe (32,708) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduonum baako akyirepɔ aduonum nnwɔtwe (52.58%) wɔ mma no nyinaa mu. Wɔyii no gyaa George Ansah a na ɔwɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New Partriotic Party mu, Edith Mansah Dzonyrah a ɔwɔ Ghana Union Movement mu ne Samuel Yawson a ɔno nso wɔ akokɔ amanyɔkuo convention people's party mu. Wɔnyaa mma ɔpepepem aduonu nkron, ahannwɔtwe aduasa mmienu, ahansia ne aduoson nnwɔtwe ne ɔha ne aduokron mmiɛnsa mma wɔ mma no nyinaa mu. Mma no ne ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduanan nson akyirepɔ num (47.05%) ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu baako akyirepɔ nson(1.07%) ne (0.30%) yɛ pɛ.

Nnwuma 
Owurayere Gizella Tetteh Agbotui yɛ Zella adansie adwumawura, a ɛyɛ adansie adwumakuo wɔ Ghana. Wayɛ saa adwuma yi bɛboro mfeɛ aduonu baako a wakoadare kɔ kwan asiesie, Wiemhyɛn gyinabea,(IAP) ne Certified Management Professional(PMP).

N'abrabɔ ankasa 
Agbotui nuabaa ne Hannah Tetteh a ɔsomm sɛ Awutu Senya West mpesoa mmarahyɛbedwanii ne ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ amanɔne nsɛm so. Waware Owura Agbotui Serlom a wɔwɔ mmabaa mmienu, Annalise Elikem Agbotui ne Arlene Emefa Agbotui.

title: Aba Andam
text:
Professor Aba A. Bentil Andam (a wɔwoo no wɔ afe apem ahankron aduanan nwɔtwe mu [1948]) yɛ Ghanani a ne dwuma titirew a wɔdi ne particle physicist a na ɔyɛ panin paa a ɔda Ghana Academy of Arts and Sciences ano firi afe mpem mmienu ne du-nson mu (2017) de kɔ si – afe mpem mmienu ne du-nkron mu (2019). ɔno ne ɔbaa a ɔfiri ɔman Ghana mu a ɔyɛɛ physicist.

Abrabɔ ahyɛaseɛ ne nwomasua 
Aba A. Bentil Andam a wɔwoo no wɔ Ghana wɔ afe apem ahankron aduanan nwɔtwe mu (1948) wɔ kuro a wɔfrɛ no sɛ Ajumako Kokoben. ɔkɔɔ ne ntoasoɔ sukuu wɔ  Mfantsiman Senior High School. ɔgyee n'abɔdin krataa a ɛdi kan wɔ suapɔn a wɔfrɛ no sɛ University of Cape Coast a ɛwɔ ɔman Ghana mu wɔ afe apem ahankro aduosia nkron mu de kɔ si afe apem ahankron aduoson mmiensa mu (1969-1973), a na ade titirew a na ɔsua ne physics ɛna afei nso na ɔsane nso sua biribi kakra fa nkontabuo nso ho (mathematics). Afei ɔkɔtoaa ne nwomasua no so wɔ Britain aborɔkyi man mu a ɛhɔ na ɔkɔnyaa n'abɔdin krataa a ɛtɔ so mmienu a wɔfrɛ no borɔfo kasa mu sɛ master's degree ɛfirii suapɔn a wɔfrɛ no sɛ University of Birmingham wɔ afe apem ahankron aduoson nsia mu de kɔ si afe apem ahankron aduoson nson mu (1976-1977) afei ɔtoaa so sua adeɛ gyee abɔdin krataa a wɔfrɛ no Ph.D ɛfirii Durham University wɔ afe apem ahankron aduoson nwɔtwe mu de kɔ si afe apem ahankron aduowɔtwe baako mu (1978-1981). Berɛ a na ɔregye nteteɛ wɔ  University of Cape Coast ɛne Durham University nyinaa mu no, na ɔno nkɔ ara ne ɔbaa a ɛyɛ physicist wɔ saa mmerɛ no mu.

Adwumayɛ 
Wɔ afe apem ahankron aduowɔtwe nsia mu no (1986) ɔbɛyɛɛ chartered physicist ɛna afei nso na ɔsane nso yɛ Institute of Physics kuoba amapa. sɛ wode n'abodin krataa ahodoɔ a wagye no wɔ abɔdeɛ mu nyansapɛ nwomasua mu no to nkyɛn a, na ɔsane nso te French kasa no a na ɔtumi ka no yie pa ara, ɛna na ɔsane nso wɔ abɔdin krataa ahodoɔ beberee wɔ French kasa no nkorabata ahodoɔ pii mu, a ɛbi mpo ne Diplome de Langue d’Alliance Francaise de Paris; the French Proficiency Certificate of Ghana Institute of Languages; and the Certificate of Translation, Alliance Francaise de Paris.

Abɔdin ne Animuonyamhyɛ ahodoɔ 
Ɔne nnwumakuo ahodoɔ pii na adi dwuma a ɛbinom ne; The World Innovation Foundation (ɛfiri afe mpem mmienu ne mmienu mu 2002), Ghana Academy of Arts and Sciences (ɛfiri afe mpem mmienu ne mmiensa mu 2003), ɛna the Institute of Physics (ɛfiri afe mpem mmienu ne nan mu 2004). ɔno na na ɔyɛ panin paa a na ɔda Ghana Academy of Arts and Sciences kuo no ano (ɛfiri afe mpem mmienu ne du-nson mu 2017- de kɔ si ɛfiri afe mpem mmienu ne du-nkron mu 2019), ɔno ne ɔbaa a na ɔtɔ so mmienu a ɔbɛkuraa saa diberɛ yi mu.

Awaresɛm 
Aba A. Bentil Andam hokafoɔ a ɔwaree no ne Professor Kwesi Akwansah Andam a na ɔno nso yɛ Civil Engineer, afei nso na ɔsane nso yɛ nwomanimfoɔ a woayɛ suapɔn Vice Chancellor mpo pɛn. wɔwoo mma nan.

title: Gladys Casley-Hayford
text:
Gladys May Casely-Hayford a wɔtaa frɛ no Awuah Laluah(Kɔtɔnimaa bosome da a ɛtɔ so du baako wɔ afe apem ahankron ne nan mu dekɔ ahinime bosome wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduonum mu) yɛ obi a wɔwoo no wɔ sika mpoano na ɔyɛ Sierra Leone ɔtwerɛfoɔ. Wagye no atom sɛ ɔnone ɔtwerɛfoɔ a ɔdikan twerɛɛ wɔ krio kasa mu.

Abrabɔ ahyɛaseɛ ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Gladys too Casely-Hayford abusua a ɛwɔ Axim, Gold Coast wɔ kɔtonimaa bosome da a ɛtɔ so du baako wɔ afe apem ahankron ne nan mu. Wɔ ne mmɔfra berɛ mu no na wɔfrɛ no Acquah Laluah, na nnwoma akenkan ho paa, na ɔdii mfeɛ nson na ɔsɛe  Charles Kingsley. Na ɔtumi to dwom, sa, na ɔtwerɛ anwonsɛm wɔ ne mmɔfra berɛ mu. Ɛnam ne nteteeɛ pa mu no nti na ɔtumi ka borɔfa kasa, creole ne Fante kasa yie(a ɛyɛ ne papa kasa). Ɔkɔɔ ne mmɔtafowa ne ne ntoasoɔ sukuu wɔ Gold Coast nanso ɛnam n'apomuden nsɛm nti wɔde no kɔɔ England na ɔkɔɔ sukuu wɔ Europe, a Penrhos College,Colwyn Bay a ɛwɔ wales ka ho, na ɔne nnwomkuo bi a wɔfrɛ no Berlin Jazz  tuu kwan sɛ obi a ɔsa. Ɔsane kɔɔ US nso. Ɛnam sɛ na nnoɔma nkɔ yie mma no wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduasa mmienu nti no, na ɛwɔ sɛ ɔba fie. Ɔbaa abibiman mu no, ɔkyerɛɛ adeɛ wɔ Girls Vocational sukuu a na ɛwɔ Freetown, Sierra Leone, a na ɔmaame Adelaide Casely-Hayford na ɛda ano.

N'abrabɔ ne adwuma 
Acquah Laluah waree Arthur Hunter. Wɔ sukuu mu no ɔkyerɛɛ abibirem anansesɛm ne kasadwini. Na ɔnim n'abibirem ho nsɛnsɛm nti,ɔdii anwonsɛm da a 'Rejoice' ne "Nativity" ka ho. Ɛwɔm sɛ ɛnnyɛ n'anwonsɛm no nyinaa na wɔdaa no adi maa amansan hunuui wɔ ne pɛn so,  ɛnyɛ n'anwonsɛm no nyinaa na wɔboa ano wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduosia mu. Anwonsɛm bi te sɛ "Nativity" wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduonu nson, "The Serving Girl' wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduanan baako ne "creation" wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduonu nsia,  na wɔkabom; atwerɛfoɔ a wɔfiri Harlem Renaissance anigyee n'adwuma no ho.

Ne wuo 
Gladys Casely Hayford tenaa Freetown, Sierra Leone pii wɔ n'asetena mu. Ɔtu kɔɔ Nkran beaɛ a ne papa abusuafoɔ te, ɛna ɛhɔ na ɔnyaa blackwater Fever a ɔwui wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduonum.

title: Leila Zerrougui
text:
Leila Zerrougui (wɔwoo no wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduonum nsia) yɛ Algeriani a wako adare wɔ  nnipa faahodie ho nsɛm mu. Ɔsomm maa UN sɛ ntamgyinafoɔ twerɛtwerɛfoɔ ne tetenani ma United Nations Stabilization Mission wɔ Democratic Republic of the Congo (MONUSCO) firi ɔpɛpɔn bosome nom wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nnwɔtwe nom.

Abrabɔ Ahyɛaseɛ ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Zerrougui wɔ Souk Ahras. Ɔwiee sukuu wɔ L'Ecole Nationale d'Administration(Algiers) wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe. Ɛfiri afe apem ahankron ne aduokron mmiɛnsa mu no, na wakuru diberɛ pii wɔ nnwomasua wɔ Algeria mmara sukuu mu, ɛna na ɔyɛ ɔkukuni wɔ L'Ecole Supérieure de la Magistrature(Algiers). Wada nnoɔma pii adi wɔ asoeɛ a ɛhwɛ nnipa faahodie ho nsɛnsɛm ho.

Nnwuma 
Firi Ɛbɔ bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu dekɔ  kɔtɔnimaa bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nson mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ ntamgyinafoɔ twerɛtwerɛfoɔ maa mmɔfra ne asraafoɔ ho nsɛnsɛm. Wɔ wie mu no, ɔsomm sɛ ankorankorɛ a ɔhwɛ ma nnipa ani da hɔ na ɔma obiara hunu ne kwan yie na ɔbɔ mmarima ne mmaa a asraafoɔ nkɔkwasɛm no nya nsunsuansoɔ wɔn so.

Na ɔyɛ kuoba wɔ adwumayɛkuo bi mu wɔ Arbitrary Detention mu wɔ United Nations nnipa faahodie ase firi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne baako mu, na ɔsomm sɛ working Group-Rapporteur kasamafoɔ firi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne mmiɛnsa kɔpem Kɔtɔnimaa bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe mu. Ɛnam saa mu nti, ɔyɛɛ adwuma kyɛɛ wɔ Algeria beaɛ a wɔbu atɛn ɛna wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu mu no, wɔyii no sɛ Algeria kɔɔto baatan.

Ɔsomm sɛ ɔtɛmmuafoɔ a wɔbu mmɔfra a wɔnnii mfeɛ du nnwɔtwe atɛn ne ɔtɛmmuafoɔ ma ntɛm ara  atɛmmuo firi afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe dekɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe nsia, na firi afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe nsia dekɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nson mu no na ɔyɛ ɔtɛmmuafoɔ ma mente me ho ase kɔɔto. Firi afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nnwɔtwe dekɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu mu no, ɔsomm sɛ ɔfotufoɔ ma ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ atɛntenenee so, ɛfiri mfeɛ mpem mmienu dekɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe mu no na ɔyɛ ɔfotufoɔ ma Algeria manpanin. Ɔsane nso ne Algeria aban yɛɛ nnwuma pii wɔ ne diberɛ mu na ɔka Algeria National Commission on the Reform of the Judiciary.

Berɛ a wɔyii no sɛ ntamgyinafoɔ wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne mmienu mu no,na ɔyɛ ɔtwerɛtwerɛfoɔ abɛdiakyire ne nea ɔda United Nations Stabilization Mission wɔ Democratic Republic of the Congo (MONUSCO)abɛdiakyire, ɛhɔ na ɛfiri mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe mu no, ɔbɛdaa ekuo bi a wɔn botaeɛ ne sɛ wɔbɛboa akentene nnoɔma a ɛwɔ mmara mu na wabɔ wɔn  a wɔnka wɔn ho no ban. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmiɛnsa mu no Abdallah Wafy bɛdii n'adeɛ.

title: Pearl Nkrumah
text:
Pearl Nkrumah (wɔwoo no wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe mu) yɛ Ghana sikakorabea dwumayɛni,ɔyɛ nnwuma pii, mmaranimnii ne corporate Executive, a ɔno na ɔtenetene Access sikakorabea a ɛwɔ Ghana Plc, ɔhyɛɛ aseɛ ɔgyefoɔ bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu mmienu no. Ɔyɛ ɔbaa a ɔdikan a ɔresom wɔ saa diberɛ nom, firi berɛ a wɔdii saa sikakorabea no wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nkron mu.

Ne ho nsɛm ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Nkrumah wɔ Ghana wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe mu.Ɔkɔɔ mmɔtofoa ne ntoasoɔ sukuu,ansa na wɔde no kɔɔ aban suapɔn a ɛso paa wɔ ɔman nom a wɔfrɛ no University of Ghana. Ɔwiee sukuu wɔ bakyela degree of Science wɔ Business Administration mu. Ne degree a ɛtɔ so mmienu, wɔ Master of Business Administration mu no nso ɔnya firii saa suapɔn korɔ noa mu. Ɔsane nso kura bakyela of Law degree,a Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration no bɔɔ no abaso.

Nnwuma 
Ɔyɛɛ ne sikakorabea adwuma ase wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan mu,sɛ obi a ɔgye sika wɔ Standard Chattered Ghana. Wɔ mfeɛ pii akyire no wɔmaa no asɛdeɛ pii, a ɔbɛyɛɛ abɛdiakyire a ɔtoto sikakorabea ho nsɛm ɛna ɛno akyire no nso ɔbɛyɛɛ nnwumakuo pii totoiɛfoɔ. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu mu berɛ a ɔrebɛnya mfeɛ nkron wɔ Standard Chattered Ghana no, ɔfirii hɔ na Stanbic sikakorabea a ɛwɔ Ghana bɛfaa no.

Wɔ Stanbic sikakorabea a ɛwɔ Ghana nso, Nkrumah guuso kɔɔ soro wɔ n'anim, firi obi a ɔtoto nsɛm wɔɔ nkitahodie mu wɔ sikakorabea dekɔ da nnwumakuo foforɔ pii ano, na ɔda SME banking ano. Berɛ a ɔfirii Stanbic no na ɔda dwadie kɛseɛ ano, a na ɔhwɛ wɔn a wɔtɔ nnoɔma so, beaɛ wɔde sika to, wɔn a wɔne wɔn bom di nkitaho. Wɔbɔɔ no abaso sɛ wɔde mmabunu sikasie baa Stanbic sikakorabea a ɛwɔ Ghana," adeɛ a ɛbɛboa  mmabunu nso de sika asie"

Nnoɔma ahodoɔ bi a wɔma no yɛɛ 
Wɔ ne diberɛ mu  sɛ executive Director wɔ Access Bank Ghana no, Pearl Nkrumah bɛtenaa Board of directors na ɔka kuo a wɔtoto nnoɔma yie wɔ sikakorabea hɔ.

title: Princella Adubea
text:
Princella Adubea (born  December 1998) yɛ Ghanani bɔɔlobɔni a osi n'akan  sɛ atenatofo wɔ Spain bɔɔlobɔkuo a w'ato din Racing Santander na afei, Ghanaman mmaa bɔɔlobɔkuo a ɛde Ghana Women's national football team. Osii akan maa ɔman Ghana bre a onni mfie 20 prennu wɔ akansie ɛde World Cup no wɔ afe 2016 ne 2018. Osii akan maa bɔɔlobɔkuo a ɛde Sporting de Huelva.

Bɔɔlobɔkuo 
Adubea hyɛɛ ne bɔɔlobɔ nnwuma ase wɔ bɔɔlobɔkuo a ɛde Ampem Darko Ladies a ɛwɔ Techiman, wɔ afe 2014 mu. Odii bɔɔlobɔkuo no anim maa wodii nkunim nea edikan wɔ mmaa bɔɔlobɔ akansie a ɛde Ghana Women's Premier League, bre a wɔtoo atena baako tiaa Hascacas Ladies a w'antumi ante ka no.  ɔtoo atena mpɛn 19 wɔ akansie 11 a onyaa mu akwanya no na eyi maa no begyina hɔ maa nea w'ato atena dodoɔ wɔ saa bɔɔlobɔ akansie afe no mu. ɔsan nso dii nkunim sɛ nea ɔtoo atena dodoɔ wɔ afe 2016  Ghana's women FA Cup akansie no mu . Onyaa abasobɔtde a w'ato din SWAG Female Footballer of the year no mu bre a ɔpaa n'akansifo a wtn ne Elizabeth Addo ne Sandra Owusu-Ansah ho no.

ɔboaa ne bɔɔlobɔkuo no maa wokoraa won nkunimde no so bre a otoo atena baako de tiaa Lady Strikers wɔ Baba Yara agopramma so. ɔsan nso too atena mpɛn 16 na eyi maa no koraa ne nkunimdie a ɛne atena dodoɔ tofoɔ ne mprennu soɔ.

Honours

title: Anita Amankwa
text:
Anita Amankwa  (Wɔwoo no  September da ɛtɔ so 2, afe 1989) yɛ Ghanani mmaa amanmanmu bɔɔlobɔni a osi akan sɛ odikanfo. ɔka mmaa bɔɔlobɔkuo a ɛde Ghana women's national football team no ho. Na ɔka ekuo a esii akan wɔ 2007 FIFA Women's World Cup ho. Osii akan ma bɔɔlobɔkuo a ɛde Takoradi Ladies a ɛwɔ Ghana

title: Abena Busia
text:
Abena Pokua Adompim Busia (wɔwoo no afe apem ahankron ne aduonum mmiɛnsa) yɛ Ghana twerɛfoɔ, anwonsɛm twerɛfoɔ, suapɔn kyerɛkyerɛni ne diplomat. Ɔyɛ Abrefa Busia a ɔyɛ Prime Minister ma Ghana babaa, ɛna ne nuabaa ne Akosua Busia. Busia yɛ kunini wɔ borɔfo kasadwini mu,ɔsane yɛ mmaa ne mmaa ne mmarima adesua wɔ Rutgers University. Ɔyɛ Ghana ntamgyinafoɔ wɔ Brazil, a wɔyii no wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nson mu, a adehyeman du mmienu a ɛwɔ South Africa na ɛbɔɔ n'abaso.

title: Grace Adams
text:
Grace Adams (wɔwoo no November da a ɛtɔ so 2 , afe 1995) yɛ Ghanani bɔɔlobɔfo a osi akan sɛ atenatofo ma Ghana mmaa bɔɔlobɔkuo a ɛde Berry Ladies ne Ghana man mmaa bɔɔlobɔkuo Ghana women's national team.

Bɔɔlobɔkuo 
Adams hyɛɛ bɔɔlobɔ nnwuma ase wɔ Ghana wɔ Ghana Prison Ladies, ɛno akyi na otu kɔɔ United states kɔtoaa n'adesua ne osuani agodini agodini. Onyaa akwanya koo suapɔn a ɛde University of South Florida firi afe 2015 kosii afe 2018 mu, na ɔbɔ maa wɔn bɔɔlobɔkuo a ɛde South Florida Bulls wo American Athletics Conference. Odii nkunim wo afe 2017 ofa no mu.

Wo August da ɛtɔ so 16, afe 2019 mu no, ɔde ne ho kɔ dɔɔm bɔɔlobɔkuo ɛde Rivers Angels a wosi akan wɔ Nigeria Women Premier League a ɛyɛ afe baako kɔntraagye. Wo ɔpepɔn da a ɛtɔ so 24, afe 2020 mu no, Adam de nsa hyehyɛɛ nkrataa ase maa SAAS a ɛwɔ Lebanon, wɔ bre 2019-20 no mfinfin. Osii akan mpen nsɔn na ɔboaa atenato mpɛn 5; ɔboaa n'afa no maa wodii nkunim wɔ saa bɔɔlobɔ afe no mu.

Adam san n'akyi baa Ghana bɛbɔɔ  maa Berry Ladies wɔ National Women's League no mu.

Amanman mu akansie 
Adam bɛyɛɛ Sahene maa mmaa wonni mfe 20 a wɔde Under-20 no wɔ 2014 FIFA U-20 Women's World Cup no mu. Wɔ bosome a ɛtɔ dubaako no da a ɛtɔ so 30 no mu no, Adam sii akan maa Ghanaman mmaa mpanyinfoɔ bɔɔlobɔkuo no, wo bre a na adamfofa akansie bi bɔɔ so wɔ wɔn ne Morocco ntam; ɔbaa mu wɔ sima 80 no mu ma Ghana dii nkunim 2-0.

title: Saidat Adegoke
text:
Saidat Adegoke (wɔ woo no  September da ɛto 24, afe 1985 wo  Ilorin, Kwara state Nigeria) ye Nigeriani bɔɔlobɔni.

Nnwuma 
Adegoke hyɛɛ ne bɔɔlobɔ ase wo bɔɔlobɔkuo a w'ato din Remo Queens wo ne kurom a ɛyɛ Nigeria wɔ afe 2007 mu. Wɔ Italy bɔɔlobɔ afa a ɛne Serie A no mu no, osii akan maa ACF Trento. Bre a wowie akansie 2016  wɔ ɔfa a edikan wɔ Serie A no mu, na w'ato atena mprɛnsa, no ofirii hɔ kɔɔ bɔɔlobɔkuo   a ɛde A.C.F Milan wɔ bosome a ɛtɔ nnwɔtwe no mu,afe 2008. Bre a ɔwɔ Milan no, onyaa nkɔsoɔ pii ma ɛno nti bre a awie wɔ afe 2011 mu, na w'ato atena 19 wɔ akansie 52 a onyaa mu kyɛfa no. Wɔ 2011-2012 bɔɔlobɔ bre no ahyɛase no, ofirii hɔ kɔɔ bɔɔlobɔkuo foforo a ɛde FCF Como 2000.

Amanman mu akansie 
ɔka Nigeria bɔɔlobɔkuo a ɛde Nigeria Women's national football team no ho efiri afi 2010 mu.

title: Harriet Bruce-Annan
text:
Harriet Dansowaa Bruce-Annan (N'awoo din ne: Grace Akosua Dansowaa Ani-Agyei; wɔ woo no afe apem ahankron aduosia num [1965] wo Accra, Ghana) yɛ Ghanani a n'adwuma ne sɛ ɔnam  abɛforo kwan so hyehyɛ mfidie na afei nso, ɔnsan nso yɛ ohummɔborɔfoɔ a ɔte Dusseldorf, Germany. Wonnim no sɛ adwumakuo African Angel a ɛyɛ adɔyɛ kuo  a ɛboa mmɔfra a wɔn  wɔ ahiafo atenae a ewo Bukom mpɔtam  no hyehyɛfo.

N'asetenam ne Nnwuma 
Wɔ woo Bruce-Annan wɔ Accra,afe apem ahankron aduosia num (1965) mu. Wɔtetee no wɔ Adabraka, na daa nyinaa na ɔkɔ ne nana a na ɔte ahiafoɔ tenabea bi a wɔfrɛ no Bukuom no hɔ nsrahwɛ. ɛmfa ho ɔbrɛ ne ɔhaw ɔfaa mu wɔ ne mmɔfrase no, w'ammu ne mmɔfrase abonfia. Denam mmoa a onya firii ne wɔfa hɔ no, osuaa sɛnea wɔnam abɛɛforo so hyehyɛ dwumadie anaa mfidie wɔ Ghana. Adwumakuo a odikan nyaa mu akwanya no yɛ Germanyfoɔ kɔmputa adwumakuo. Wɔ afe apem ahankron aduokron nkron (1990) mu no, bre a ne kunu ka kyerɛɛ  no sɛ ɔbɛboa no ama w'anya suapɔn mu akwanya wɔ amanɔne no, ɔne tu kɔtenaa Germany.Nanso, esiane ateetee a na ɔfa mu wɔ awareɛ mu nti, oguane kɔɔ mmaa guankɔbea a ɛwɔ Dusseldorf. Adwuma a odikan yɛe wɔ hɔ ne sɛ, na ɔyɛ apɔwmudensohwefo boafo, akyire ɔkɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ yaanee so wɔ Düsseldorf fair na afei, nsanombea a ɛde Golden Unicorn pub wɔ  Ratinger Straße. Bre ɔda so wɔ Dusseldorf no, ɔhyɛɛ ase gyegyee sika de kɔboaa nnyanka a wɔn wɔ ahiafo atenae a ɛwɔ Bukuom, wɔ Accra. Wɔ ɛbɔ bosome no mu no (September) da a ɛtɔ  so du-num (15), afe mpem mmienu ne mmienu (2002) mu no, Bruce-Annan ne afoforo nsia hyehyɛɛ ekuo a ɛde African Angel Association. Ekuo no yɛ nea ɔboa mmɔfra a wɔn wɔ  Bukum wɔ  wɔn sukuu kɔ ne nnwumasua mu. 

Wɔ  afe mpem mmienu ne nwɔtwe (2008) mu no, wɔ too nsa frɛɛ Bruce Annan kɔɔ   Berlin Senate ma no de ne nimdeɛ kɔ boa nyiamu a ɛfa amanman mu atukɔtena ho nsɛm. Wɔ  afe mpem mmienu ne nkron (2009) mu no, ɔkɔyɛɛ TV so dwumadie a ɛde NDR na afei nso, dwumadie bi Mark Lanz nso yɛ so. Bruce-Annan akɔ nsrahwɛ wɔ mmeae pii wɔ Germany ne Austria bre a na ɔda ne nnwuma ahorɔw adi no.

Abasobɔdeɛ 
Wɔ Ɔbɛnim bosome no ( March ) da a ɛtɔ so aduasa baako (31), afe mpem mmienu ne du-baako (2011) mu no, nhomawa a w'ato din Bild der Frau at a gala a ɛwɔ Berlin no maa no abasobɔdeɛ a ɛde heroine of everyday life". Sika a ɛda so no yɛ euros no 30,000

Bre a na wɔredi mmaa afofie da a ɛde World Women's Day wɔ ɔbɛnim (March) bosome mu, wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du-mmiensa (2013) mu no, Germany aban no maa no abasobɔdeɛ a w'ato din Cross of Merit.

Nhoma a w'kyerɛw 

 Beate Rygiert: African Angel: changing the world with 50 cents / Harriet Bruce-Annan. Lübbe publishing house, Bergisch Gladbach 2009,  .
