title: Stella Saaka
text:
Stella Saaka yɛ Ghanani  a ɔko ma mmaa fahodie wɔ Talensi mpɛsoa so wɔ Atifi Atoe Mnatam mu wo Ghana. Mmaa a wɔn wɔ Atifi Apuei fam no yɛ nea wonni hokwan sɛ wonya wɔn ankasaa nsaase. Wonim no sɛ ɔno nkoaa ne ɔbaa a otumi maa mpanyinfoɔ  no tee ase wɔ hia a ɛho hia sɛ mma nya wɔn nsaase, na eyi maa no nyaa asase a ne keseɛ bɛyɛ acre 29 de maa mmea 30 de yɛ wɔn mfuo wɔ Talensi mpɛsoa no so. Wɔ afe 2019 mu no, U.S ananmusini a ɔde Stephanie Sullivan de abasobɔde a w'ato din Ghana Women of Courage maa no. Sesei, ɔsom sɛ ɔkyerewfo ma adwumakuo a wɔhwɛ mmaa kuayɛ ho nsɛm so, a wɔn din de Women in Agriculture Platforms(WAP), aban adwuma a wɔn a wɔde won sika hyɛ mu ne US Agency for International Development (USAID)

Ekuo a ede Internaional Women of Courage Award ye oman no kuo baako pe a ehwe  ma wobo mmaa a wobo won ho mmoden wo amanman mu, senea 

ɔne mmaa 30 no de wɔn ho hyɛɛ kuayɛ mu wɔ asase a ne kɛseɛ yɛ 29 ɛka no so, na eyi ama mma no anya sika de boa wɔn mmuasua. Ne mmɔden bɔ no ama mmaa a wotu kɔ nkuro akɛseɛ mu wɔ ɔpɛ bre mu no so ate, esiane sɛ mmaa no nya nnwuma yɛ wɔ Talensi mpesoa no mu. Afei nso, saaka denam amanyɔsɛm so atumi ne mapnyinfo no akɔ adwenkoro mu ma mmaa anya akwanya sɛ wɔn adwenkyerɛ a ɛfa mpontuo ho no du bedwa mu. Ede besi nne, ɔne ne mfɛfo a wɔn wɔ WAP yɛ nea wogyina hɔ sɛ ananmusifo ma wɔn mpɛsoa ahorɔw so wɔ mpuntuo kuo a ɛde Medium Term Development Planning sessions.

title: Abena Dugan
text:
Abena Dugan yɛ Ghanani obabun ne odimafo. Wo afe 2018 mu no, wɔpaw no sɛ otitenani ɔhwɛ  adwumakuo a w'ato din Commonwealth Youth Council no fa bi a ɛde Partnership and Resources, na eyi maa no bɛyɛɛ Ghanani a odikan a w'anya saa dibea no. Commonwealth Youth Council no yɛ adwumakuo kɛseɛ ne nea ɛwɔ akwaa ahorɔw pii a ɛma mmabun akwanya wɔ wiase, ɛnam saa nti, Dugan yɛ nea ogyina mmabun a wɔn wɔ aman ahorɔw  53 mu anan mu.

Nhomasua 
ɔkɔɔ sukuu wɔ St. Louis Secondary School na na ɔyɛ asuafo ananmusifo kuo no kyerɛwfo wɔ Suapɔn a ɛde Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology a ɛwɔ kumasi. ɔsan nso kura abɔdin krataa a ɛde Master's degree bre a owiee n'adesua a ɛfa Development Finance ho wɔ suapɔn a ɛde University of Ghana, Legon. ɔsan nso kura abɔdin krataa a efiri Oxford Executive Leadership Programme 2020 na sesei, ɔyɛ mmeranim suani wɔ University of Leeds Uk.

Nnwuma 
Se ɔka Commonwealth Heads of Government Meeting 2018, ogyinae ma wɔtoo ne so aba ma no dii nkunim beyee ɔkwankyerɛfo wɔ  adwumakuo no fa a ɛde Partnership and Resource. Ansa na ne nsa bɛka saa dibea yi no, na ɔsom sɛ nea ɔhwɛ nhyehyei so wɔ Commonwealth Alliance for young entrepreneurs West Africa Chapter. ɔsan nso ka wɔn wɔtee adwumakuo a ɛde Climate Resilient Network na ɔka ekuo bi a w'ato din World Students Environmental Network

title: Efua Asibon
text:
Efua Asibon  ka Ghanafo mmea miɛnsa a wonyaa  abasobɔdeɛ a w'ato din Queen's Young Leader Award wɔ  afe mpem mmienu ne du-nson (2017) mu. ɔyɛ adwuma sɛ obi a ɔhwɛ  adwumakuo Facebook fa bi so wɔ Ireland, ɔka wɔn a w'ato adwumakuo a ɛde Disabelled, ankorɛankorɛ adwumakuo a ɛhwɛ wɔn a w'adi dem ho nsɛm so wɔ Ghana, na wɔhwɛ ma wɔn a w'ade dɛm nya akwanya ahorɔw pii a nhomasua nso ka ho bi.

Nhomasua 
Okura abɔdin krataa ɛne Master's degree a ɛfa International Development and Humanitarian Emergencies firii suapɔn a ɛde London School of Economics and Political Science. Ogyee abasobɔdeɛ a ɛne Queen's Young Leader Award no wieɛ no, Onyaa akwanya ma wɔtetee no wɔ Cambridge's Institute of Continuing Education a ɛwɔ UK.

Abasobɔdeɛ 

 Wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du-nson (2017) mu no, onyaa abasobɔdeɛ  a ɛne the Queen's Young Leader Award
 Onyaa abasobɔdeɛ a w'ato din  Africa Women Innovation and Entrepreneurship Forum (AWIEF) Award wo afe mpem mmienu ne du-nkron (2019) mu
 Wɔde no kaa wɔn a wɔpaw wɔn sɛ WomanRising's 100 Most Outstanding Women Entrepreneurs wɔ Ghana

title: Eva Mends
text:
Eva Esselba Mends yɛ Ghanani a w'aben wɔ Sika ho ntotoe a ɛne ɛkɔnomise mu. ɔyɛ ɔbaa a odiakn a wɔpaw no sɛ okwakyerefo a oda sikasɛm ho ntotoeɛ ano wo adwumakuo a ɛde Ministry Of Finance wɔ Ghana. Aban no paw no wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du-nson (2017) mu.

Nhomasua 
ɔkɔɔ Suapɔn a ɛde University of Ghana kosuaa sikasɛm ho ntotoeɛ a ɛne ekɔnɔmise ne Political Science. Okuraa abɔdin krataa a ɛde Executive Master's degree in  firii Public Administration onyaa firii suapɔn a ɛde Ghana Institute of Management and Public administration. Osuaa nnema nkenkete bi wɔ Havard ne Duke University.

Nwuma 
Mends de ne ho kɔdɔɔm adwumakuo a ɛde Finance Ministry no bre a na ɔreyɛ National Service, wɔ afe apem ahankron aduokron baako (1991) mu na efiri saa bre no besi nnɛ, w'akura dibea ahorɔw pii a emu bi ne otitenani a ɔhwɛ The Americas Desk wɔ afe apem ahankron aduokron nwɔtwe (1998) mu, Otitenani a ɔda Budget Development ano wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nsia (2006) mu, ekuo anɔ titenani a ɔda Public Financial Managemnet reform ano wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du-mmiensa (2013) mu. Wɔ bosome a ɛtɔ so nnum no mu wo afe mpem mmienu ne du-nson (2017) mu no, wopaw no sɛ ɔkwankyerɛfo a ɔda sikasɛm ho ntotoe ano wɔ adwumakuo a ɛde Ministry Of Finance,dibea a okurae kosii afe mpem mmienu ne du-nkron (2019) mu. Wonim no se obi a ɔboa maa nsakrae ahorɔw kɔɔ so a emu bi ne Gender responsive Budgeting, Programs Base Budgeting ne Public Financial Management Act foforo a ewɔ hɔ no. Sesie, ɔyɛ ɔkwankyerɛfo a ɔhwɛ ntotoe so wɔ Ministry of Finance.

Ntotoho

title: Akosua Adomako Ampofo
text:
Josephine Akosua Adomako Ampofo  yɛ Ghanani nhomsuamu ɔbenfo a  ɔkyerɛ ade fa bɔbiasu ho wɔ suapɔn a ɛne University of Ghana. ɔyɛ obi a ɔko ma mma yiyedie,na afei nso, ɔpere ma nnipa yiyie die.

Ne mmofrase ne nhomasua 
Ampofo maame yɛ Germanini na ne papa yɛ Ghanani a ofiri Asanteman mu. Ne papa abusua no yɛ nea wɔdɔm amanykuo a ɛde Converntions Peoples Party (CPP). Ampofo kɔɔ ntoaso sukuu a ɛne Aburi Girl's Secondary school. Ampofo nyaa suapɔn abɔdin krataa a edikan firi sapɔn a ɛde Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology, bre a owie n'adesua a ɛfa adansie ho nnema no. ɔtoa so suaa ade faa mpontuo nhyehyɛeɛ ho ma no nyaa abodin krataa a ɛne Master Degree. Ampofo nyaa suapɔn abɔdin a ɛkɔ anim a ɛne Phd fri suapɔn a ɛde Vanderbilt University bre a owiee n'adesua a ɛfa nnipa nneyɛe ho no. ɔsan nso kura abɔdin krataa a ene Post-Graduate Diploma a onya firii suapɔn a ɛde Technical Universit of Dortmond, a ɛwɔ Germany.

Nhomasua mu Adwuma 
Ampofo hyɛ adekyere ase wɔ University of Ghana wɔ afe 1989. Wo afe 1994 ne 1995 ntam no, na okura dibea a ɛne Junior Fulbright. Wɔ afe 2005 mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔbaa odikan sɛ otitenani wɔ suapɔn no fa bi a ɛde Centre for Gender Studies and Advocacy (CEGENSA), okuraa saa dibea no kosii afe 2009 mu. Wɔ afe 2008 mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ koowaa krataa mu samufoɔ kowaa krataa a ɛne Ghana Studies, na okuraa saa dibea no kosii afe 2013 mu. ɔsan nso yɛɛ adwuma sɛ koowaa krataa mu samufoɔ  ma Contemporary Journal of African Studies.

Na ɔyɛ Mellon Fellow wɔ afe 2014 mu wɔ University of Cape Coast Town, faako a ɔyɛ adwuma ma Centre for African Studies. Wɔ afe 2015 mu no, ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ Senior Fulbright Scholar-in-Residence a ɛwo suapɔn a ɛne Concordia University Irvine. 

ɔyɛ adwuma sɛ Kohunufo maa nwumakuo a ɛmu bi ne UNIFEM, UNICEF, World Health Organization (WHO), Save the Children, UNAIDS, Ministry for Gender & Social Protection, Ghana; Participatory Development Associates; Gender Studies and Human Rights Documentation Centre and Kofi Annan International Peacekeeping Training Centre.

Adwumakuo a ɔdom 
Wɔ afe 2019 mu no, sɛ okandifo ma African Studies Association of Africa (ASAA) no, ɔhwɛ maa wɔyɛ nyiamu a edikan wɔ East Africa. Ampofo ka wɔn a wɔhyehyɛɛ  ekuo a ɛde ASAA a wɔhyehyɛe wɔ afe 2013 mu no. ɔsan nso dɔm akuo ahorɔw a ɛde Association and Sociologists for Women and Society, (SWS), African Studies Association, United States, Ghana Domestic Violence Coalition, the Network for Women's Rights in Ghana, the Council for Social Science Research in Africa (CODESRIA)  neInternational Sociological Association, (ISA). ɔsan nso dɔm ekuo a ɛde Ghana Academy of Arts and Sciences

title: Felicia Edem Attipoe
text:
Felicia Edem Attipoe yɛ Ghanani baa wiemhyɛn kwankyerɛfo, ɔbaa a odikan a w'naya akwanya wɔ adwuma a mmarima di mu akotene wɔ Ghana no mu. Na wonim no sɛ a obi a na odi akotene wɔ dwumadie a w'ato din Key Soap Concert Party so, aseresɛm dwumdie bi a na ɛkɔ so.

Nhomasua 
Attipoe kɔɔ ntoaso sukuu a ne din de OLA Senior High School a ɛwɔ Ho, Frao Mantam no mu. ɔtoaa n'adesua so kɔɔ suapɔn a ɛde African University of College of Communication, na onyaa abɔdin kraataa a ɛde First Degree. ɔsan nso kura abɔdin krataa a ɛfa nfonitwa ho firii suapɔn a ɛde Temple University a ɛwɔ Japan. Okura abɔdin krataa a ɛfa wiemhyɛn nsɛm ho a ɛne Aerodrome Safety, Marshalling and Radio Telephony a efiri School of Aviation.

Nnwuma 
N'adwuma akwantuo a ɛfa wiemhyɛn kwankerɛ no hyɛɛ ase wɔ afe apem ahankron aduokron nkron (1999) mu, bre a wɔfaa no sɛ ɔkyerɛwfo wɔ adwumakuo a ɛde Ghana Civil Aviation no. Bre a Ghana Civil Aviation tee ne ho no, ɔde ne ho kɔdɔɔm Ghana Airport Company Limited sɛ ɔkyerɛwfo na ɔyɛɛ adwuma mfie du. Wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du-baako (2011) mu no, woyii no kɔɔ adwumakuo no mpanyinfoɔ no baako ɔfis a ɛde Ramp Manager no sɛ ɔkyerɛwfo. Bre a ohuu sɛ ontumi nnyɛ pii sɛ okyerɛwfo no, na afei nso ne kon ado bre a ɔhwɛ mmaraima sɛ wɔkyerɛkyerɛ wiemhyɛn ahorɔw akwan, ɔsrɛɛ kwan wɔ ɔkwankyerɛfo a pɔtɔ kasamu wɔka no director of operations no hɔ, sɛ ɔpɛ sɛ ɔde ne ho hyɛ mu bi. Nti bre a akwanya no bae sɛ wɔbɛtete wiemhyɛn akwankyerɛfo no, ɔde ne ho hyɛɛ   mu.

Abasobɔdeɛ 
Wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du-nkron (2019) mu no -  Onyaa abasobɔdeɛ a w'ato din Most Inspiring Woman in Aviation Industry ɛyɛ nea edikan a wɔde hyehyɛɛ so.

N'setena mu nsem 
ɔye ɔwofo a ɔwɔ mmɔfra mienu.

title: Abunuabunu
text:
Abunuabunu yɛ nkwan a won a wɔn wɔ Bono ne Ahafo Mantam mu wɔ Ghana no yɛ. Wɔde mankani ahaban a wɔfrɛ no kontomire ne atosodeɛ ahorɔw te sɛ (Tomantose, nnwa, adwen anaa nsuomnam, gyene, mako, kwahu nsosuaa ne nkyene.

ɔkwan a wɔfa so kyɛ 
Abunuabunu  yɛ aduane eho nnya na wɔ amanfoɔ wɔn wɔ Kumasi. Wɔde nkwan yi di fufuo anaa banku nanso, wobetumi de adi aduane biara a wo pɛ.

Ayɛdeɛ 

 Nnwa
 Adwene
 Mmire
 Koobi 
 10-15  Mankani Ahaban (Kontomire)
 kwansesaawa 
 Atosodeɛ (gyene, Makobunu , tomantose, kakaduro, garlic)
 Nkyene
 andwene a w'ahow
 dawawa

Sɛnea wɔyɛ no 

 Fa ankaatwɛdeɛ hohoro nnwa no
 Twitwa mmire ne koobi no mu nketenkete gu dadesɛn keseɛ mu
 Fa nnwa no gu so
 Fa nkyene ne gyene,kakduro ne garlic a w'anyam afra no punu wɔ dadesɛn no mu
 Hohoro tomantose ne gyene foforo gu so, na afei kata dadesɛn no so
 Tete kontomire nnua no, na hohoro kontomire no yiyie
 Fa nkontomire no gu dadesɛn mu, na mako, nusuo nekwansesaawa gu so, kata so ma no nhuru beye sima 5 -8 .
 Yiyi tomantose ne gyene no na hwɛ sɛ aben anaa, nyam ne nyinaa fra.
 Fa sɔnyɛ sɔne so gu nkwan no mu
 Hohoro adwene a w'ahow no na fa to nkwan no mu.
 Kata so ma no nhuru bɛyɛ sima 5
 Twitwa Ahaban no, Mako ne kwansesaawa ma ɛnfe fekoko na fa gu nkwan no mu.
 Fa nsuo kakra gu mu sɛ wohwɛ na api dodo 
 Ka hwɛ na fa nkyene gu mu
 Ma ogya no mmara fɔm na ma nkwan no nsi so bɛyɛ sima 6 kosi du natam
 Fa di fufuo, mmotuo anaa bibiara a wo pɛ

Ntotoho

title: Nana Ama Dokua Asiamah Adjei
text:
Nana Dokua Asiamah Adjei (wɔwoo no 24 Kitawonsa 1982) yɛ Ghanani amanyɔni ne mmarahyɛ badwani a ogyina hɔ ma Akuapem Atifi mmarahyɛ badwam mpɛsoa so wɔ Apuei manatam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔyɛ anyokuo New Patriotic Party no mu ni , na mprenpren, ɔsom sɛ Soafo abediakyire a ɔhwɛ Adwadie ne mfirinnwuma so. Ɔyɛ kane Soafo abdiakyire a ɔhwɛ amaneɛbɔ so

Ne mmɔfrase ne nhomasua 
Wɔ woo Adjei wo 24 July, afe 1982 mu a n'awofo ne Owura ne Owura yere Aforo Asiama-Adjei a wɔn firi Akropong, wɔ Apuei Mantam no mu. Ɔkɔɔ ne mfitiase ne ntoasoɔ sukuu wɔ Alsyd Academy ne St Roses Senior High. Okura suapɔn abodin krataa a ɛne Bachelor's Degree in Psychology a onyaa firii suapɔn a ɛde University of Ghana, na afei abodin krataa foforo a ɛde Masters Degree a onyaa firii Exter University bre a owie n'adesua a ɛfa Logistics and Supply Chain ho wɔ United Kingdom.

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Adjei yɛ ɔwarefoɔ a ne kunu din de Charlse Bissue. Ɔyɛ Kristoni.

text:
Amon Neequaye (wɔ woo no 6 June 1963) yɛ Ghanani akutrukuboni. Osii akan wɔ afa a ɛne men's bantamweight wo1984 Summer Olympics.

title: Thomas Arimi
text:
Thomas Arimi (wɔ woo no 17 October 1933) yɛ Ghanani akutrukuboni. Osii akan wɔ akansie a w'ato din men's light heavyweight a ɛkɔ so wɔ 1964 Summer Olympics no mu

Ntotoho

title: James Armah
text:
James "Bukom Fire" Armah wɔ woo no 11 March 1976 wɔ  Accra), yɛ Ghanani akutrukuboni a osii akan wo mfe 1990, 2000 ne 2010 mu, maa odii nkunim wɔ akansie a African Boxing Union featherweight , Commonwealth lightweightn  ne Commonwealth super featherweight na osii akan wɔ WBO Asia Pacific light welterweight  (mprenu), WBO Oriental light welterweight , ne WBA Pan African light welterweight a ɔne Chad de sii ani.  N'akodie no gu ahorɔw firi126 lb (57 kg; 9 st 0 lb), a egyina hɔ ma featherweight kosi 152 lb (69 kg; 10 st 12 lb),a egyina ho ma   light middleweight

Wɔ n'awaree akyi no, ɔne ne yere sii gyinae wɔ afe 2017 mu tu kɔtenaa Grafton, New South Wales a ɛwɔ Australia, beae a ne yere abusuafoɔ  te. Armah de ne ho hyɛɛ akutruku adwuma mu wɔ bre a ɔwɔ hɔ.

Ntotoho

title: Borteyman
text:
Borteyman yɛ mpɔtam a ɛwɔ Kpone Katamanso mansini a ɛwɔ Nkran punpuni mantam wɔ Ghana.

Nnoɔma a ɛwɔ 
Ɛyɛ beaɛ a nnipa nim sɛ wɔfrɛ no Borteyman a agokansie bɛyɛ Amerika ɔpepepe ɔha ne aduanan numkɔ so wɔ hɔ a akansie bɛkɔ so wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu mmiɛnsa abibirem agorɔ nom. Saa agoprama no wɔ nnoɔma bi te sɛ: borɔfo kwansin ahanan kwan nsia a bɔɔlo bɔfoɔ fa hɔ de kɔsua bɔɔlo bɔ; mmaa ne mmarima ahosiesie beaɛ, beaɛ a akyitaafoɔ bɛyɛ ahanum bɛgyina; beaɛ a nnipa bɛyɛ pem bɛkɔ akɔ dware wɔ akansie mu,kwan nnwɔtwe a wɔn a wɔbɛsware wɔ akansie nom bɛfa so ne beaɛ nnwɔtwe a wɔde bɛsɔ wɔn ho ahwɛ; beaɛ a nnipa ahanum bɛgyina mmerɛ tiawa bi(handball,judo,karate,taekwondo,etc); beaɛ a nnipa mpem bɛtena a akansie pii bɛtumi akɔso wɔ hɔ(badminton, ntɔkwa,volleyball, nnoɔma pɛgyaa); beaɛ num  a wɔbɔ tennis a ɛbɛtumi afa nnipa mpem a akyitaafoɔ atitire beaɛ ka ho ne beaɛ mmɔfra bɛdi agorɔ.  Nana Akuffo-Addo kɔtwaa ahoma bue kwan maa wɔhyɛɛ agoprama no sie ase.

Adansie ho dwumadie 
Ɛyɛ beaɛ a adansie ho nnoɔma nhyehyɛeɛ boɔ yɛ fo a  State Housing Company Limited da ano a ɛkura dankora num ne unit aduoson mmienu.

Beaɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Charlotte Osei
text:
Charlotte Kesson-Smith Osei (Ɔwo no wɔ ɔgyefuo da ɛda ɛdi kan wɔ afe Ɔha nkron ne aduosia nkron mu)Ɔyɛ UN abatoɔ Kɔmmisan,ɔyɛ ɔtemuani wɔ Ghana na ɔyɛ kane Pani Paa na ɔda Abatoɔ Kɔmmisan nsɛmsoɔ wɔ Ghana firi afe mpem aduo nu ne du num de kɔsii Ayɛwohomumɔ wɔ afe apem ne aduo nu ne du nnwɔtwe mu a ɔgye ne deberɛ firi ne na na ɛman sikasem a wantoto no yie nti. Ɔdi no ayideɛ ho nsem kɔ dan kɔɔto Baatan.Ɔno ne ɔbaa ɔdi kann a wɔ yɛ Abatoɔ  Kɔmmisan firi da Ghana nya ne fahodeɛ.Ansana Ɔbɛyɛ Abatoɔ Kɔmmisan no na ɔyɛ Kɔmmisan de  Civic Adesua nsem soɔ.Ɛwɔ Kotonimma bosome wɔ afe  mpem mmienu ne aduo kronmu no, Ama nkabom kuo no yi no sɛ ɔmɛka wɔn a ɔbɛboa afe mpem mmienu ne aduo kron wɔ  Afghanistan ɔmanpanyin abatoɔ no mu ntotoeɛ.

Na Brabɔ Mfitiaseɛ Ne ne Nnwoma Sua. 
Ɔwo no wɔ Nigeria. Na Ɔmaame nnyɛ Ghanani saa nso na ɔpapa nso nyɛ Ghana nonanso na no awofoɔ no yɛ Ghanafoɔ.

Ɔnya ne mfimfim nnwomasua no wɔ Ghana National College a ɛwɔ Cape Coast Ɔtoa ne Nnwoma Sua so wɔ Universityof Ghana,ɛhɔ na Ɔnya abɔdin krataa wɔ LLB wɔ afe apem ahankron aduokron mmienu mu ɛna Ghana beaɛ a wɔ tete wɔn a ɔdi asem na ɛkɔ na ɔma no tumi sɛ ɔbɛtumi ado asem wɔ asem de beaɛ wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduokron nan mu.

Na ɔsane wɔ kura  Nimdeɛ nkrataa wɔ ɛdwadeɛmu a Ɔnya firii suapɔn a ɛwɔ South Africa, Pretoria (2006),Nimdeɛ krataa wɔ Aban mmra(LLM) Edo firi Queen's university, Kingston, Ontario, Canada.

Na Dwuma ho Nsem. 
Osei yɛ akyerɛkyerɛ boafoɔ wɔ beaɛ a ɔkyerɛ wɔn a ɔdi asem beaɛ a ɛwɔ University of Ghana, Legon wɔ afe apem nkron ne aduokron nan de kɔsii afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduokron num .Ɔyɛ adwuma sɛ asem dini ma  Laryea adwumakuo a na ɛwɔ nkran  firii afe, ɔsane yɛ adwuma wɔ Ghana kɔmmertial sika korabea sɛ Opanin Paa ɔda Aban nsɛmsem soɔ a ɛfa kɔɔto nsem soɔ  firi afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduokron nson di kɔsii afe mpem mmienu ne mmienu mu.
Ɔsane  kyerɛ adeɛ wɔ ɛdwadeɛmu mmra ho asem mu wɔ Suapɔn mu firi afe apem aduokron nson de kɔsii afe mpem mmienu ne mmiensa mu. 
Firi afe mpem mmienu ne mmienu de kɔsii afe mpem mmienu ne num mu noɔyɛ adwuma sɛ ɔfutufoɔ de ma Unibank Ghana,na ɛfiri afe mpem mmienu ne numde kɔsi afe mpem mmienu ne du baako mu no ɔno na ɔyɛ kɔfarebaeɛ ne ɔfutufoɔ panin de ma asemdifoɔ nnwuma.

Na Ɔyɛ Ɔtitinanine de ma national Ɔman no Kɔmmisan ma aninbea adesua nsem soɔ firi afe mpem mmienu ne du de kɔ sii afe mpem mmienu ne du nan mu.Ɔyi no sɛ Ghana Ɔtitinanine ma Ghana Abatoɔ ho nsem na ɔno na ɔgyina sɛ panin paa wɔ Ghana abatoɔ nsɛmsem a ɛfa ɔmampanyi ne mmrahyɛbɛdwamfoɔ ntotoeɛ nsem soɔ.Na ɛwiase nkabom kuo nso yi no  sɛ Ɔtitinanin sɛ wɔn a ɔnto aba si abatoɔ nkɔmissan de maa Afganistan ,Ashr Ghani.ashe was appointed chairperson of the Electoral Commission of Ghana  and she presided as the Returning Officer for Ghana's 2016 Presidential and Parliamentary elections In May 2019, the United Nations appointed Charlotte Osei as an International Non Voting Electoral Commissioner to Afghanistan, this was confirmed by a Presidential Decree issued by the President of Afghanistan, Ashraf Ghani. Ɔhwɛ sɛ ɔbɛboa atoto sɛnea wɔn bɛyɛ ɛbɛboa ama pɛpɛpɛ ne fin bɛbawɔ ntiaseɛ  sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ pɛpɛpɛ bɛkɔso wɔwɔn Abatoɔ nsem soɔ.

title: Joseph Quansah Naayi Kojo-Krobo
text:
Joseph Quansah Naayi Kojo-krobo yɛ Ghanani a ɔyɛ mfidie ho adwuma.

Sukuu 
Quansah kɔɔ sukuu wɔ 'All Nation's University College'. All Nation University College yɛ ankrankorɛ suapɔn a ɛwɔ Ghana Apueɛ Mantam mu, mere kyerɛ Koforidua. Ɛhɔ na Ɔpanin Joseph Kwansa Kɔsuaa mfididwuma mu nimdeɛ (engineering), ɛnam so maa no bɛyɛɛ mfididwuma mu okunini.

Adwuma 
Quansah ne ne nnamfofoɔ mmiensu; Benjamin Bonsu, ne Ernest Teye Matey kaa wɔn tiri bam ho sɛ wɔbɛyɛ afidie nwanwasoɔ bi a wɔfrɛ no 'Satellite'. Ɔhyɛɛ aseɛ aseɛ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du-num (2015) mu na ɔwiee wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du-nson mu. Ɛyɛ 'All Nations University College' ne Japanfoɔ suapɔn baako a wɔfrɛ no 'Kyushu Institute of Technology' na wɔka bɔɔ mu yɛɛeɛ.

Mfasoɔ 
Afidie no y3 adeɛ a ɛho hia yie pa ara, ɛfiri sɛ ɛho mfasoɔ a ɔman no bɛnya no dɔɔso yie. Ebi ne sɛ, ɛbɛboa ama yɛahunu ewiem nsakyeraeɛ ne ɔkwan a yɛbɛfa so asi ano. Ɛnam sɛ ɛtumi tu kɔ wiem nti no ɛbɛboa ama yɛahunu nnoɔma bɔne a ɛkɔ so wɔ ɔman yi ahyeɛ so na ama mpanimfoɔ ahunu ɔkwan a wɔbɛfa so amia bambɔ mu wɔ ɔman no ahyeɛ so. Ɛsan boa ma kasamfonini, kasanoma ne nnoɔma bebree nya mframapa de di wɔn dwuma ahodoɔ pii.

Satellite 
Nhwehwɛmu kyerɛ sɛ afidie yi ho ka som Amerika sika no ($50,000). Afidie yi kɛseɛ ne ɛmu (4) duro nso yɛ (1000 grams). Ɛwom sɛ suapɔn baako a ɛwɔ Japan man mu ka ho deɛ, nanso ɔman Ghana ha yi ara na wɔyɛɛ no na wɔsane sɔ hwɛɛ wɔ “All Nation’s University College” a ɛwɔ Koforidua (Apueɛ Mantam mu). Wei ne adwumaden a Owura  Joseph Quansah Kojo-Krobo de ne ho hyɛɛ mu a enti ama no agge din wɔ Ghana ha ne wiase nyinaa na ama no ayɛ nipa sononko sɛ ɔno ne bibini a ɔdi kan wɔ ɔman mu a watumi ayɛ afidie nwanwasoɔ sei.

title: Ernest Matey
text:
Ernest Matey yɛ Ghanani a ɔyɛ mfiri ho adwuma. W'aben wɔ abɔde mu nyansapɛ ne mfiri adesua mu.

Ne mmofrase ne sukuukɔ 
Matey kɔɔ All Nations  Sukuupɔn a ɛwɔ Koforidua mantam mu. Esaine ne mmɔdenbɔ wɔ adesua mu nti, All Nations Sukuupon no sɔɔ n’ase maa no tumi kɔtoa n’adesua so wɔ Kyushu Institute of Technology wɔ India.

Ɛmfa ho sɛ Ernest adi mfe aduasa no, ɔnno na ɔkasa ma ɔman Ghana wɔ Space Generation Advisory Council a ɛhyɛ wiase nkabom nkuo no ase.
Ganafoɔ

title: Ama Hemmah
text:
Ama Hemmah (wɔ woo no wɔ afe apem ahankron aduanan nson mu [1947]– ɛna ɔwui wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du mu [2010]) yɛ Ghanani abɛsiriwa a nnipa bɔnefoɔ bi de gya hyee no animono so maa no toaa nananom wɔ asamando a na saa nnipa bɔnefoɔ yi susu sɛ Ama Hemmah yɛ obi a ɔyɛ bayifoɔ. Maame abɛsiriwa a na wadi mfie aduoson mmienu (72-year-old) wuu wu yaayaa paa ara yie berɛ a nnipa bɔnefoɔ yi hyee no animono so no.

Owuo no farebae 
Wɔ obubuo bosome no da a ɛtɔ so aduonu (20) wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du mu no, berɛ a na abɔ anɔpa bɛyɛ nɔndu no, wɔ beaeɛ a yɛfrɛ no sɛ Tema site 15 no, nsɛmpakani bi a yɛfrɛ no sɛ Samuel Fletcher Sagoe bɛsraa Ama Hemmah nuabaa a yɛfrɛ no sɛ Emillia,  ɛhɔ na nsɛmpakani yi hunuu Hemmah sɛ ɔte ne nuabaa panin yi dan mu berɛ a na Emillia nso mma nyinaa wɔ sukuu mu.  Ɛhɔ na nsɛmpakani a yɛfrɛ no Sagoe ɛbɛprɛ asɛm bi atom a ɛmaa owura bi a yɛfrɛ no sɛ Samuel Ghunney ɛne afoforɔ bi a wɔtete mantam ho adwene reba Hemamah so. Sɛdeɛ owura  Augustine Gynening a ɔyɛ Assistant Commissioner de ma Ghana apɔlisifoɔ adwumakuo no de too dwa no, na nnipa bɔnefoɔ yi susu sɛ Hemmah yɛ bayifoɔ.  Saa nnipa bɔnefoɔ num yi de Hemmah faa ateetee ne aniayaw ne ayakayakadeɛ mu sɛ ɔnka n'anum asɛm, kɔsi sɛ wɔpɛɛ sɛ wobɛtutu saa bayie sunsum no afiri ne nipadua mu a ɛno nti wɔde  no hyɛɛ kerosene mu a wɔde gya too mu maa ɔhyeeɛ. Saa nnipa bɔnefoɔ yi kyerɛ sɛ wɔde anointing oil mmom na ɛguu ne so na fofie anto Atta na ɛkɔdanee gya hyee maame abɛsiriwa, a wɔkyerɛ sɛ ɛnyɛ wɔn boapayɔ.

Dɔkotani baa bi a, na ɔyɛ adesuani a yɛfrɛ no Deborah Pearl Adumoah, na ɔbabɛboa Hemmah de no kɔɔ apolisifoɔ asuoeɛ. ɛkyire yi no wɔde Hemmah kɔɔ Tema aban ayaresabea sɛ nka ɔnkɔgye ayarehwɛ, nanso ɛda a ɛtɔ so mmienu no ɔtwaa n'ani hwɛɛ dan yayaaya. ɔnyaa mfie aduoson mmienu. 

Wɔn a wɔdii saa awuo yi ne Samuel Ghunney, a wadi mfie aduonum (50-year-old) a ne dwuma a wɔdie ne sɛ wɔtwitwa mfonin (photographer); ɛna Samuel Fletcher Sagoe, a wadi mfie aduonum num (55); ɛna Emilia Opoku, a ɔno nso adi mfie aduasa nson (37); ɛna Nancy Nana Ama Akrofie, a ɔno nso adi mfie aduanan nsia (46); ɛne Mary Sagoe, a ɔno nso adi mfie aduonum mmienu (52).

Baabi a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Deborah Owusu-Bonsu
text:
Deborah Owusu-Bonsu(a wɔwoo no Kitawonsa 25 1984)) a nnipa dodoɔ no ara nim no sɛ wɔfrɛ no Sister Derby yɛ Ghanani a ɔyɛ adwuma wɔ kasamfoni so, ɔyɛ nnwomtoni na ɔyɛ model na Akan ɛna ɔyɛ ɛnkane e.tv a ɛwɔ Ghana dwumayɛni.

Abrabɔ ahyɛaseɛ ne nnwomasua 
Wɔwoo Deborah Vanessa Owusu-Bonsu  wɔ Kitawonsa bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduonu num wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe nan, ɔpapa yɛ Asantenii na ɔmaame yɛ Romaniani. Na n'awofoɔ yɛ nnipa bi a wɔm gye nnwom ne ɛho dwumadie bi. Ɔyɛ kyeame wɔ Kasamfoni, model, nnwomtoni, obi a ɔdwidwi nnoɔma fa adesua ho. Owusu-Bonsu nuabarima ne nnwomtoni a wagye din paa wɔ hip Life nnwomtoɔ mu a wɔfrɛ no Wanlov the Kubolor a wɔyii sini bi a yɛfrɛ no Coz Ov Moni.  Owusu-Bonsu kɔɔ Christ the King mmɔtofoa sukuu, ɛna ɔkɔɔ ne ntoasoɔ sukuu wɔ Wesley Girls'. Owusu-Bonsu nyaa ne bakyela degree wɔ Publishing Studies wɔ Kwame Nkrumah suapɔn mu ɛna ɔtoaa ne Master degree so kɔsua Book/Journal Publishing firii University of the Arts London.

Adwuma a ɔyɛ 
Owusu-Bonsu akyerɛ adwuma a ɔyɛ ne sɛdeɛ n'ani so gye adwuma a wɔyɛ no ho a ɔyɛ adwuma kamakama wɔ nnwumakuo nketewa ne akɛseɛ a ɛwɔ Ghana, United States ne United Kingdom. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu mu no, Owusu-Bonsu kɔtoo nnwom twee na ɔde nnwom (single) a wato ne din 'Uncle Obama' a ɔkasa fa Barack Obama ho a ɛgyee Kasamfoni a ɛwɔ United States a wɔfrɛ no CNN so. Firi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu no, Owusu-Bonsu na na ɔyɛ kyeame ma dwumadie bi a wato no di 'The late Nite celebrity show' a wɔyi no wɔ e.tv a ɛwɔ Ghana. Ɛno akyire no ɔkɔɔ GHOne kasamfoni so a ɔkɔyɛɛ dwumadie kyeame maa 'Gliterrati' mmerɛ tiawa bi mu na ɔsane maa Berla Mundi.

N'abrabɔ 
Ɔne rapper bi wɔfrɛ no Medikal twee mpena bɛyɛ mfeɛ mmiɛnsa ansa na ɔne no regyae wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nson mu.

title: Aisha Ayensu
text:
Aisha Ayensu yɛ obi a  ɛpam ntadeɛ ma Ghana abasobɔdeɛfoɔ a nnipa pii noa nim no sɛ ɔyɛ ntadeɛ ma Beyonce, Genevieve Nnaji, Jackie Appiah ne Sandra "Alexandrina" Don-Arthur. Ɔno na ɔda Christie Brown ano sane toto nnoɔma yie wɔ hɔ, ɛyɛ dwumakuo bi a ɛwɔ Ghana a ɛdi dwuma wɔ ntaade hyɛ mu. Folu Storms totoo m'ani maa BBC World Service kasafidie dwumadie bi na wɔyii no sɛ ɔka Forbe nnipa wɔyɛ adwumaden wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia mu.

Nnwomasua 
Na Ayensu nim biribi fa adwene nnoɔma ne ntadeɛ ho. Ɔkɔɔ ne ntoasoɔ sukuu wɔ Achimota na ɔkɔgyee nteteeɛ wɔ ntaadehyɛ mu firii Joyce Ababio College of Creative Design.

Nnwuma 

Ɛnam nkuran a ne nanabaa hyɛɛ no nti ɔkɔdaa Christie fashion Brown ano wɔ ɔbɛnem bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe mu wɔ Ghana a amanɔnefoɔ pii noa nim saa dwumakuo yi. Wɔfrɛ no "Platinum Standard" wɔ NdaniTV so wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nan ɛna Folu Storms nso totoo n'ano berɛ a ɔkɔsraa nkran wɔ Abibiman sini foforɔ bi a wɔyii wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia. Ɔno na ɔtoto nnoɔma yi na ɔsane da Christie Brown a ɛyɛ beaɛ a wɔyɛ Ghana ntadeɛ wɔ hɔ. Afua Hirsch totoo n'ano wɔ wɔn dwumadie "In the studio" so maa BBC World Service kasafidie dwumadie wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia mu. Wei yɛ bosome nsia ansa na ɔregye afe sika ɔhɔ na ɔkɔnya haw wɔ sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ ama nnipa a ɛwɔ wiase nyinaa bɛgye  n'amammerɛ atom na saa adeɛ wei maa wɔdii mfeɛ du wɔ n'adwuma mu. Wɔsane yii no sɛ ɔka Forbe nnipa wɔyii wɔn a wɔn dwuma sɔ ani wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia mu.

Abasobɔdeɛ 
Abasobɔdeɛ a ɛdidisoɔ yi na ɔgyeeɛ:

 2009 - Emerging Designer of the Year, Arise Africa fashion event in South Africa
 2010 - Ghanani nkoa na wɔyii no sɛ ɔmmɛda ne dwumadie adi wɔ Arise L'Afrique-á-Porter, a ɛwɔ Paris berɛ a wɔreyɛ Paris Fashion Week
 2018 - Best Fashion Designer, Africa Prestigious Abasobɔdeɛ
 2018 - African Designer wɔ afe nom, Glitz Style Abasobɔdeɛ

title: Gifty Osei Boakye Bingley
text:
Gifty Osei Boakye Bingley yɛ ɛnkane Ghana nsɛntwerɛni a ɔyɛ adwuma wɔ kasamfoni no so na ɔsane ma kaseɛbɔ a seisei ɔyɛ communications and strategy Executive. Ɔyɛ adwuma ma Togo a ɔyɛ kwankyerɛfoɔ ma corporate communications and corporate Responsibility.

Nnwomasua 
Gifty wiee sukuu nyaa ne bakyela degree firii Ghana Institute of Journalism (GIJ) wɔ nsɛntwerɛ mu ɛna ɔnyaa ne master's degree wɔ Political Communication mu firii University of Leeds ɛna Master's degree wɔ development Management mu firii Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration (GIMPA). Ɔsane yɛ ekuoba wɔ Charted Institute of Public Relations(CIPR) wɔ United Kingdom.

Nnwuma 
Seisei African Union afa Gifty Osei Boakye Bingley sɛ  nkitahodie mu panin a ɔdi dwuma sɛ titinani a ɔda Public Information ne panin wɔ nkitahodie mu ano. Ɔde ne ho kɔbɔɔ AMISOM, a ɛyɛ dwumakuo bi ɛda nnoɔma pii adi a wɔnya mfasoɔ mfiri mu a Africa Union Peace and Security Council (AU PSC) ne  United Nations Security Council na ɛde baeɛ wɔ Kitawonsa bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nnwɔtwe mu.

Berɛ a na ɛwɔ TV3

Gifty sane dii mfeɛ du wɔ TV3, beaɛ a ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ nsɛntwerɛni dekɔɔ obi a ɔda kaseɛbɔ ano ne sesamufoɔ abɛdiakyire, obi ɔboa ma kaseɛbɔ ba abɔnten na ɔsane toto kaseɛbɔ ahodoɔ ano yie.

title: Mercy Amua-Quarshie
text:
Mercy Amua-Quarshie Ghanani a ɔgye awoɔ sane hwɛ mma awodeɛ mu yareɛ wɔ Dallas, Texas. Ɔnyaa Barlex Labs Abasobɔdeɛ wɔ OBGYN nkyerɛkyerɛ beaɛ wɔ berɛ ɔrebɛwiee ne OBGYN wɔ Boston Medical Centre/Boston suapɔn.

Abrabɔ ahyɛaseɛ 
Wɔwoo no Ghana, abibirem atɔeɛ, nanso ɔnyinii wɔ New York, ɔhɔ na ɔnyaa ne medical degree firii New York University School of Medicine wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron num ɛno akyire na ɔkɔɔ Boston Medical Center/Boston University kɔsuaa residency wɔ OBGYN mu.

Nnwomasua ne nnwuma 
Amua-Quarshie wiee Master of Public Health wɔ Columbia Suapɔn a ɛwɔ New York wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron baako mu. Ɔwiee suapɔn wɔ New York University School of Medicine wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron num na ɔkɔɔ Boston Medical Center/Boston University ma OBGYN residency adesua wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nkron. Wɔtoo ne din sɛ ɔno na wayɛ adeɛ wɔ OBGYN nkyerɛkyerɛ mu ɛna ɔnyaa Berlex Labs abasobɔdeɛ wɔ ne berɛ ana ɔwɔ hɔ no. Ɔsane baa New York punpuni mantam berɛ a Ɔwiee ne nteteeɛ wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nkron mu, a na ɔyɛ adwuma wɔ ayaresabea ne ankorankorɛ adwumakuo mu.  Ɛno akyire no ɔne n'abusuafoɔ kɔɔ anaafoɔ, Dallas Fort Worth mantam, ɔhɔ na ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ OBGYN physician wɔ ayaresabea mu beyɛ mfeɛ pii wɔ Methodist ayaresabea. Ɔyɛ obi a wako adarem wɔ mmaa awoɔtwaa mu wɔ North American Menopause Society (NAMS).

title: Thomas Partey
text:
Thomas Teye Partey yɛ Gaana nii bɔɔlo bɔ nii a wɔ woo no 13 june 1993. ɔsi akan ma Arsenal bɔɔlo kuo a  ɛwɔ Inglese aburokyire mman mu na sanso si akan ma Gaana mman bɔɔlo kuo no.

Partey hy3 ne bɔɔlo ase wɔ Spanish kuo a wɔ fr3 no Atlético Madrid wɔ afe 2013 mu. Wɔ fri hɔ kɔ sii akan maa Mallorca ne Almería, na ɔsan baa Atlético wɔ afe 2015 mu. ɔsane n'akye baa no, ɔde ne kuo no gyee UEFA Europa League ne UEFA Super Cup in 2018. Afe 2020n0 mu no, ɔde ne ho kɔ dɔm Arsenal bɔɔlo kuo a na 3boa a 3da ne tiri so som £45 million (€50 million). Yei ma no b3y33 Gaana bɔɔlo nii a ne boɔ y3 dene wɔ wiase yi mu.

Partey de ne mman Gaana agyina akono mper3 mmiensa wɔ Africa Cup of Nations (2017, 2019, and 2021). Wɔ bɔɔ n'abaso s33 Gaana bɔɔlo nii a wɔbɔ ne ho mmɔden wɔ afe 2018 ne 2019.

Club career

Atlético Madrid 
Partey ansa na ɔb3 dɔm Atlético Madrid wɔ afe 2012 no, na ɔsi akan ma Odometah bɔɔlo kuo a 3wɔ Odumasi Krobo, Gaana mman mu. Abrantie yi sii akan beberee maa Atlético Madrid.

Mallorca and Almería 
Partey kɔ sii akan mmer3 kakra maa Mallorca. ɔhy33 ne goal a 3di kan wɔ amanone maa ne kuo no sii atip3n 2–2 wɔ ne Hércules.

Arsenal

Wɔ 15 October 2020, Premier League kuo Arsenal paa ne ho ntoma wɔ mmere a ɔne Atlético Madrid de wɔn nsa hy33 nkrataa ase tɔɔ no sika 3som boɔ £45 million (€50 million). Partey hy3 ataade3 a ne ahyensoɔ y3 18. Abrantie yi abɔ ne ho mmɔden pii wɔ ne bɔɔlo kuo yi mu ama no anya abasobɔde3pii nsoso.

title: Baffour Annor
text:
Baffour Annor yɛ Ghanani amanyɔni ne mmarahyɛbadwani a na ogyina hɔ ma Ahafo Ano North mansin a ɛwɔ Asante Mantam wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafie a ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ Ghana adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nnan.

Abrabɔ ahyɛase ne sukuu 
Wɔwoo Annor wɔ Ahinime bosome da a ɛtɔ so nnan, wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduanan baako (1941) mu wɔ Ahafo Ano a ɛwɔ Asante mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

Amanyɔsɛm 

Wɔtoo aba yii Annor maa no kɔɔ Mmrahyɛbadwafie deɛ ɛdikan wɔ   National Democratic Congress din mu  wɔ Afe apem ahenkron aduokron -nsia Ghanafoɔ abatoɔ wɔtoeɛ no mu sɛ ɔgyina  Ahafo Ano North abatoɔ mpasua a ɛwɔ  Asanti mantam wɔ Ghana so foɔ anan mu. Ɔnyaa mma no mpem du- mmienu,  ahenum ne  aduasa -nsia (12,536 votes) firii mma dodoɔ a wɔtooeɛ ɛyɛ  mpem aduonu -mmienu,   ahenum ne du- nkron (22,519 valid votes cast) a  ɛkyerɛ ɔha mu abupɛn aduanan - num akyire po aduoson ( 45.70% ) bere a neɛ na ɔne no repere akonwa no  Owura James Brown Ford Donkor ɔgyina ma New Patriotic Party nso nyaa mma no mpem nkron,  ahensia aduonu - nwɔtwe (9,628 votes ) a ɛkyere ɔha mu abupɛn aduasa num akyire po du (35.10% ) ne Owura Kwabena Nketia a ɔgyina ma  People's National Congress nso nyaa mma no Ahasa ne aduonum - num ( 355 votes) a ɛkyerɛ ɔha mu abupɛn baako akyire po aduasa (1.30%). Ɛwɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu Ghanafoɔ abatoɔ no mu,  wɔtuu no mmrahyɛbadwa nkonwa no so bere a  Owura Kwame Owusu Frimpong ɔgyina wɔ New Patriotic Party din mu nyaa mma no mpem du- mmienu,  ahenan ne aduasa- mmienu (12,432 votes ) firii mma mpem aduonu -mmiɛnsa,  ahenkron ne num ( 23,905 valid votes cast ) a ɛkyerɛ ɔha mu abupɛn aduonum-mmienu (52.00%) a Owura Baffour Annor a ɔgyina  National Democratic Congress din mu no nso nyaa mma no mpem du,  ahenson aduowɔtwe nnan (10,784 votes) a ɛkyerɛ ɔha mu abupɛn aduanan -num akyire po du (45.10%,) Owura Johnson O.Antoh ɔgyina maa People's National Congress nso nyaa mma no ahenum ne du- num( 515 votes) a ɛkyerɛ Ɔha mu abupɛn mmienu akyire po aduonu  (2.20%) ɛna  Paul K. A. Mono ɔgyina ma Convention People's Party nso nyaa mma no ɔha ne aduoson - nnan (174 votes)a ɛkyerɛ ɔha mu abupɛn hwee akyire po aduoson  ( 0.70 votes).

title: Kwesi Akomeah Kyeremateng
text:
Kwasi Akomia Kyeremateng yɛ Ghana mmrahyɛbadwani a ɔgyina hɔ ma Afigya-Sekyere apuei fam a ɛwɔ Ghana. Ɔgyinaa abatoɔ berɛ mu wɔ 1996 kɔsi 2008 mu. Ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma New Patrotic Party wɔ mfie mmienu,mmiɛnsa ne nan ntam.

Mmrahyɛbadwam mu nsɛm 
Akomia na yɛdii kan yii no sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa bosome wɔ afe apem aha-nkron aduokron nsia (1996) Ghana abatoɔ mu sɛ New Patrotic Party ni ma Afigya-Sekyerɛ apuei amanyɔkuo a ɛwɔ Asante mantam, Ghana. Ɔgyinaeɛ no nnipa 18,500 firi 29,734 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 46.30% tia Pious Mercilus G. Griffiths a ɔyɛ National Democratic Congress (NDC) ni nso nyaa  nnipa 11,234 ma wɔtoo aba no maa no. Yɛsane too aba bio maa no sɛ ɔmmra mmarahyɛbadwam ma ɔnyaa nnipa 26,162 Firi nnipa 36,276 a wɔtoo aba no wɔ mfie 2000 mu Ɛno gyina hɔ ma 71.70% a ɛtia Edward O. Aboagye a ɔyɛ NDC ni a ɔno nso gyinaeɛ nyaa nnipa 8,935 a Ɛgyina hɔ ma 24.50, Ernest A. Boadu a ɔyɛ NRP nnipa nso nyaa nnipa 421 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 1.20%, Emmanuel A. Gyasi a ɔyɛ UGM ni nso nyaa nnipa 307 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 0.80%  Ɛna Kwakwa Amoah a ɔyɛ PNC nnipa a ɔnyaa 213 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 0.60%

title: Poku Adu-Gyamfi
text:
Poku Adu Gyamfi () yɛ Ghanani amanyɔni ne mmarahyɛbadwani a na ogyina hɔ ma Bosomtwe mpɛsua a ɛwɔ Asante Mantam wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbedwafie a ɛtɔ so mmiɛsa wɔ Ghana adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nan.

Abrabɔ mfitiaseɛ ne nnwomasua 
Wɔwoo Adu wɔ Bosomtwe, a ɛwɔ ɔman Asante mantam wɔ Ghana. Ɔkɔɔ Hohenhem asuapɔn na ɔsan kɔɔ kuadwuma ho nyansahunu adesua bea a ɛwɔ beaɛ a nsuo ne ewia bɔ (Hans-Ruthenberg-Institute).

Amanyɔsɛm 
Adu na odikan a ɔsono amanyɔkuo (NPP) no too aba yii no kɔɔ mmarahyɛbadwam wɔ Ghanaman nyinaa abatoɔ a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Ahinime bosom no mu wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia (1996). Ɔnyaa abatoɔ no mu mma mpem dubaako, ahansia ne nsia (11,606) firii mma mpem aduonu mmienu, ahanum ne aduasa nson (22,537) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduasa nan akyiri pɔ aduosia (34.60%) de kyɛn Joseph Oteng-Adjei ne kyinie amanyɔkuo mma no a wɔnyaa abatoɔ no mu mma mpem nson, ahansa ne aduasa nkron (7,339), Bernard Kwabena Asamoah a ɔyɛ anamsini de ma akokɔ amanyɔkuo no so nyaa mma mpem mmiɛnsa,    ahasa ne aduowɔtwe nkron (3,389) ɛna Joseph Appiah a na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma PNC amanyɔkuo no nso nyaa mma ahanu ne mmiɛnsa (203) firii abatoɔ no mu. Ghanaman nyinaa abatoɔ a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ mfe mpem aduonu wɔ Bosomtwe mpasua a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam wɔ Ghana no, ɔnyaa mma mpem dunum, ɔha ne aduosia (15,160) firii mma mpem aduonu mmienu ne aduowɔtwe num (22,085) a na agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduosia mmiɛnsa akyiri pɔ aduasa (63.30%) ɛkyɛn Joseph O. Adjei, anamsini de ma kyinie amanyɔkuo (NDC) a ɔno nso nyaa mma no mu mpem nson, ahasa ne aduosia baako (7,361) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduasa mmienu akyiri pɔ aduonu (32.20%), Suleiman Mohammed a na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma PNC amanyɔkuo no nyaa mma ahanu ne aduonu num (225) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu baako akyiri pɔ ohunu (1.00%) ɛna Violet Kankam a ɔyɛ anamsini de ma akokɔ amanyɔkuo no so nyaa mma ɔha ne aduonu nkron (129) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu ohunu akyiri pɔ aduosia (0.60%). Simon Osei Mensah betuu adeɛ so wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne nan (2004) mmarahyɛbadwam abatoɔ no.

N'adwuma 
Na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwanni wɔ mfe apem ahankron ne aduokron nson (1997) de kɔsi mfe mpem aduonu ne num (2005) de ma Bosomtwe mpasua a ɛwɔ Asante mantam wɔ Ghana.

title: Collins Dauda
text:
Collins Dauda yɛ Ghanani. Ɔsan yɛ Ɔkyerɛkyerɛni, amanyɔni ne mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ National Democratic Congress (NDC) amanyɔkuo mu. Na Ɔyɛ ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ asoeɛ a ɛhwɛ  Nsaase , Kwaeɛ ne fam agudeɛ  nsɛm so. Seisei ɔno ne ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Nsuo,  Nnwuma ne Adansie nsɛm so.

N'abrabɔ Ahyɛase Ne Ne Nwumasu 
Wɔwoo no Ɔgyefoɔ bosome da  a ɛtɔ so du-mmiɛnsa, wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduonum-nson(13th February, 1957) wɔ Mehame a ɛwɔ Ahafo mantam (akane Brong Ahafo mantam). Dauda firi Maheme a ɛwɔ Ahafo mantam mu wɔ Ghana. N'awofoɔ ne Issaka Naaba ne Mariama Issah.

His parents were Issaka. Ɔkɔɔ ntoaso sukuu wɔ Mim na Ɔnyaa abɔdin krataa " GCE Ordinary Level and GCE Advanced  Level" ɛfiri afe apem ahenkron aduoson- mmiɛnsa kɔ si afe apem ahenkron aduowɔtwe- baako(1973-1981).

Adwuma 
Dauda kyerɛɛɛ adeɛ wɔ  Kukuom  Aworokakya ntoasoɔ sukuu( Kukuom Agricultural Senior High School)  wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduowɔtwe-num. Wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduowɔtwe nsia  mu na ɔkɔkaa akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ a wɔwɔ Ahafoman ntoasoɔ sukuu mu, ɔtoaso kyerɛɛ Adeɛ kɔ sii afe apem ahenkron aduokron -mmienu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Dauda bɛyɛɛ  kaa nkuro nketewa amamuo ho wɔ Asutifi mansini firi afe apem.ahenkron aduoson nwɔtwe kɔ si afe apem ahenkron aduowɔtwe baako. Na ɔka nnipa kuo a wɔfrɛ wɔn  "Consultative Assembly", a wɔyɛɛ afe apem ahenkron aduokron mmienu  Ghana mmara ɛfiri afe apem ahenkron aduokron baako de kɔ si afe apem ahenkron aduokron mmienu mu. Wɔtoo aba yii no deɛ ɛdikan sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduokron mmienu  mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ abatoɔ no mu wɔ National Democratic Congress din mu, yei maa no yɛɛ mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔdiikan wɔ Asutifi South wɔ Ghana  adehyeman nnan mu. Wɔtoo aba yii no bio sɛ mmarahyɔbadwani wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduokron nsia mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ abatoɔ no mu. Nanso wɔtoo aba tuu no firii akonwa so wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu mu bere a wɔde soo too ne so sɛ ɔde tumi bɔne bi akum deɛ na ɔne no repere akonwa no a wɔfrɛ no Okunini Gyan -Amoah a ɔfirii mu ade rebɛkye aman wɔakɔ to aba no. Ɔsane nyaa akonwa no bio wɔ mfeɛ mmienu ne nnan mu. Ɔtenaa so firii mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nnan mu de kɔ sii mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson mu wɔ Ghana adehyeman nnan mu. Ɛwɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne mmienu mu ne mfeɛ mmienu ne nnan mu, bere a na ɔnni mmarahyɛbadwafie bio no,  na ɔyɛ  Mantam mu Titenani ma  National Democratic Congress (NDC) amanyɔkuo no wɔ kane Brong Ahafo Mantam mu.  Firii Ɔgyefoɔ bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nkron kɔ si mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du -nsia mu, wɔpaa Collins Dauda sɛ ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Nsaase ne Agudie nsɛm so ɛna wɔsesaa no bɛyɛɛ no ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Nsuo ho nsɛm so ne  Nwuma ne Adansie so. Na ɔno ne abadiekyire ma ɛkuo a wɔ hwɛ Nsaase ne Kwaeɛ panin wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduokron nnan kɔ si afe apem ahenkron aduokron nsia. Akyire ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔtitenani nii maa saa ɛkuo yi wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduokron nson de kɔ si mfeɛ mmienu. Ɔsane somm Sikasɛm ne mmabunu, agodie ne amammerɛ asoeɛ. Abatoɔ

Wɔtoo aba yii Dauda ne mprensa so sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani de ma Asutifi South abatoɔ mpasua so a na ɛwɔ Brong Ahafo mantam  wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnan abatoɔ Ghanafoɔ nyinaa kɔtoeɛ no. Ɔkɔ sii ne mpasua  anan mu wɔ Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nnan wɔ Ghana adehyeman nnan my. Ɔdii nkunim National Democratic Congress  din mu. Ne mpasua no ka mpasua du a National Democratic Congress amanyɔkuo no dii nkunim firii abatoɔ mpasua aduonu nnan mu no wɔ Brong Ahafo  mantam mu. Asutifi South abatoɔ mpasua so foɔ hunky deɛ yɛfrɛ no brɔfo kasa mu ‘skirt and blouse’  bere a deɛ Ɔdii nkunim ɔmapanin abatoɔ no wɔ yɛ John Kufour  ɔgyina maa New Patriotic Party a na ɔne  National Democratic  Congress na,ɛrepere akonwa no. National Democratic Congress amanyɔkuo no bɛyɛɛ dɔmkumaa wɔ mmarahyɛbadwafie bere a wɔnyaa mmarahyɛbadwa nkonwa aduokron nnan firii mmarahyɛbadwa nkonwa ahanu ne aduosia mu. Wɔtoo aba yii Dauda bere Ɔnyaa mma no mpem ahenkron ,ahensia  aduosia nwɔtwe (9,668 ) firii mma a wɔgye too mu a ne nyinaa yɛ mpem du nwɔtwe ne ahenson(18700 ) a ɛne ɔha mu abupɛn aduonum baako akyire po aduoson (51.70%) yɛ pɛ. Wɔto tiaa  Thomas Broni a na ɔgyina ma New Patriotic amanyɔkuo , Nana Nsiah Ababio Williams Cosmus a na ɔgyina ma People's National Convention ne Adu Adjei Augustine a na ɔno so gyina ma Convention People's party amanyɔkuo. Wɔn nyinaa nyaa ɔha mu abupɛn aduanan nsia akyire po aduokron.(46.90%),wɔnyaa ɔha mu abupɛn baako ne akyire po aduonu (1.20%) ne  0.30% sedeɛ ɛdidisoɔ yi.wɔ mma no nyinaa mu. Ɛwɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nwɔtwe abatoɔ mu no, wɔtoo aba yii no ne mprenan soɔ sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma Asutifi South abatoɔ mpasua so. Ɔkɔɔ so gyinaa nabatoɔ mpasua anan mu wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nnum wɔ Ghana adehyeman nnan.

Kuo na ɔka ho wɔ Mmrahyɛbɛdwafie 
Na Dauda ka kuo ɔhwɛ sikasɛm ho nsɛm wɔ mmarahyɛbadwafie ne ɛkuo a ɛhwɛ Nsaase ne Kwaeɛ so. Afei nso na,ɔka kuo a ɛhwɛ sɛ wɔbɛpaw obi ho

Asɛm a Waka Afa Nyiyimu Ho 
Ɛwɔ Ɔsanaa bosomno mu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du-nsia mu no, bere a Dauda rekasa kyerɛ n'aamanyɔkuo akyidifoɔ wɔ Koforidua no, ɔkaa sɛ amanyɔkuo New Patriotic Party wɔ abakwasɛm wɔ nyiyimuu ho tia nnipa a wɔte  Zongo people ne" saa nti wɔmma wɔnhunu sɛ National Democratic Congress foɔ nti saa"

N'abrabɔ 
Dauda aware mmaa mmienu ɛna ɔwɔ mma du-baako.  Collins Dauda yɛ Kramoni.

title: Stephen Kwaku Balado Manu
text:
Stephen Kweku Balado Manu yɛ  obi a yɛwoo no Ɔsannaa 23,1958 mu. Ɔyɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛni sane yɛ kane mmarahyɛbadwani ma Ghana adehyeman. Ɔyɛ kane Mmrahyɛbadwani a ɔgyina maa Ahafo Ano Anafoɔ Mpasua a ɛwɔ Asante Mantam mu, wɔ mmarahyɛbadwafie a ɛtɔ so mmienu, mmiɛnsa, nnan ne Nnum wɔ Ghana adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nnan mu.Ɔka New Patriotic Party ho.

N’ABRABƆ NE NE SUKUU HO NSEM
Ɔfiri Tamale kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana atifi mantam. Ɔka University of cape cost ho. Ɔkura mpanin krataa wɔ Bachelor of Arts mu wɔ French ne sociology. Ɔnyaa saa abasobɔ yi wɔ mfeɛ 1988 mu. Ɔtoa ne sukuu so wɔ saa suapɔn hɔ a bio ma ɛyɛ Education planning ne  Administration. Ɛnam ne saa yɔ nti ɔnyaa Mphil sane bɛnyaa Panin wɔ aban mu ne ɔkandini wɔ Ghana institution of management ne public administration mu wɔ 2006.

N’ADWUMA AHYƐASEƐ
Stephen yɛ kwankyerɛfo a ɔboa  wɔ Ghana Education Service mu.

MMARAHYƐ BADWA MU NSƐM
Ɔsan yɛ amanyɔkuoni ma New Patriotic Party.  Ɔbɛgyinaa sɛ amanyɔkuo ni wɔ  Ahafo Ano south Mpatam firi ɔpɛpɔn 2005 mu abera a ɔdii kan wɔ wɔ ɔpɛnimaa 2004 abatoɔ mu. Ɔsane kɔɔ bio nyae sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani maa saa mantam hɔ a bi wɔ mfeɛ 2008 mu.

ABATOƆ NO MU NSƐM

Stephen na yɛdii kan yii no baa mmrahyɛ badwam ma Ahafo Ano South mansin mu wɔ 1996 Ghana Abatoɔ kɛseɛ no mu aberɛ a ɔgyinaeɛ sane dii nkonim wɔ tikiti a ɛyɛ New Patriotic Party. Ɔde aba 17,015 sɛ yɛte firi 33,464 a ɛyɛ aba no nyinaa wɔ ne mansin mu aberɛ a neɛ ɔne no gyinaeɛ , Gabriel Barima a ɔyɛ National Democratic Congress nso nyaa aba16,449.

Wɔ afe 2000 mu no, Manu sane dii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ kɛseɛ no mu sɛ mmrahyɛ badwani ma Ahafo-Ano South Mansin a ɛwɔ Ashanti Region, Ghana. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ tikiti a ɛyɛ New Patriotic Party. Ne mansini ka mmrahyɛ badwa akonnwa a ɛyɛ aduasa baako(31) sɛ yɛ te firi aduasa mmiensa(33) a wɔdii nkonim ma New Patriotic Party ho wɔAshanti Region abatoɔ no mu. New Patriotic Party dii nkonim no ara a ɛyɛ 99 wɔ mmrahyɛ badwa 200 no. Sɛ yɛte aba 19,017 firi 33,599 a ɛyɛ aba no nyinaa a ɔno na yɛ yii no. A sɛ yɛkeka bom a ɛyɛ 56.6% Wɔ abatoɔ ne nyinaa mu. Yɛyii no gyaa Osei Kuffour a  ɔyɛ National Democratic Congress, Samuel K. Boateng a ɔyɛ Convention People's Party, Bernard K. Bekoe a ɔyɛ New Reformed Party ne Ampratwu-Konadu a ɔyɛ United Ghana Movement ni. Wɔn mo nyaa 14,054, 209, 188 ne 131 aba firii aba no nyinaa mu nnidisoɔ sa ara. A ɛyɛ 41.8%, 0.6%, 0.6% ne 0.4% sa ara ma abatoɔ no.

Yɛyii Stephen sɛ mmrahyɛ badwani ma Ahafo Ano South Mansin a ɛyɛ Ashanti Region, Ghana neɛ ɛtɔ so mmienu biom wɔ afe 2004 Ghana abatoɔ kɛseɛ no mu. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ tikiti a ɛyɛ New Patriotic Party.  Ne mansin ka aduasa nsia(36)  mmrahyɛ badwa akonnwa no mu a yɛte firi aduasa nkron(39) mu a ɔdii nkonim ma New Patriotic Party wɔ Ashanti Region abatoɔ no mu.  New Patriotic Party  dii nkonim no ara a ɛyɛ 128 wɔ mmrahyɛ badwa akonnwa no ho sɛ yɛ te firi 230 mu a. Sɛ yɛde aba 37,273 no a na ɛyɛ aba no nyinaa gyina hɔ a, ɔnyaa aba 24,096 a ɛyɛ 64.6% wɔ aba no nyinaa mu. Yɛyii no gyaa Bright Simon Osei a ɔyɛ National Democratic Congress ni. Ɔno nso nyaa 35.4% wɔ abatoɔ ne nyinaa mu.

Wɔ afe 2008 mu no, ɔsane dii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ kɛseɛ no mu wɔ tikiti a ɛyɛ New Patriotic Party ma mansini korɔ no ara mu. Na ne mansin ka mmrahyɛ badwa akonwa no a ɛyɛ aduasa nnan(34) sɛ yɛ te firi aduasa nkron(39) mu a ɛyɛ New Patriotic Party wɔ Ashanti Region abatoɔ no mu. New Patriotic Party anya mmrahyɛ badwa nkonwa no ara na mmom wɔnyaa 109 firi mmrahyɛ badwa akonwa 230 mu . Yɛde aba 21,585 a yɛte firi 37,936 aba no nyinaa mu a ɛyɛ 56.9% na dii nkonim. Yɛyii no gyaa Nyamesem Wilson a ɔyɛ People's National Convention, Thomas Kwakwah a ɔyɛNational Democratic Congress, Acheampong J. Martin a ɔyɛ Convention People's Party, Yaw Agyemang ne Andrew Kwasi Adjapong a wɔn nyinaa gyina wɔn ho so. Wɔnyaa 0.91%, 39.56%, 0.86%, 0.62% ne 1.14% nnidisoɔ sa ara wɔ aba ne nyinaa mu.

NE SOM A ƆWOM
Ɔyɛ catholic Christoni a w’aware wɔ mma nsia.

BEAƐ A MENYAA MMOA FIRIIƐ

title: Samuel Kwofie
text:
Samuel Kwofie yɛ Ghanani akane amanyɔni ne mmerahyɛbadwani a na ɔka mmerahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtoso mmienu wɔ Adehyeman Ghana amanmuo a ɛtoso nnan,ogyina hɔ ma Ahanta West abatoɔ mpɛsuaso a ɛwɔ Atɔeɛ Mantanm  wɔ Ghana.

Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ ne Sukuu 
Wɔwoo Samuel wɔ Ahanta West wɔ Atɔeɛ Mantam wɔ Ghana man mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Samuel gyinaa mu maa Ɔsono (NPP) amanyɔkuo no wɔ Ahanta West Mpɛsua no maa wɔn too aba yii no kɔɔ mmarahyɛbadwafie wɔ Atɔeɛ Mantam wɔ Ghana. Wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome mu wɔ afe apem aha-nkron ne aduokron nsia abatoɔ kɛseɛ no mu no, odii Isaack K. Brace a ɔgyinaa mu maa 'People's National Congress' amanyɔkuo ne Francis M.Fynn a ɔno nso gyinaa mu maa Kyiniiɛ (NDC) amanyɔkuo ne Kaku Aluade a ɔno nso gyinaa mu maa "Convention People's Party" ne Moses Andoh a ɔno nso gyinaa mu maa "National Congress Party"  no so nkunim. Samuel Johnfiah na ɔdii no so nkunim wɔ wɔn party abatoɔ no mu.

 N'awoda(Ateasefoɛ)

Anthony Boakye-Yiadom yɛ Ghana mmrahyɛbadwani. Ɔka amanyɔkuo a ɛgyina hɔ ma Amansie West mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti region, Ghana. Wɔ mmrahybadwa a na ɛtɔ so mmienu ne  ɛnan wɔ Republic of Ghana sane wɔ tiki wɔ New Patriotic Party mu. Ɔyɛ Kristoni sane yɛ Pentecost asɔre panin.

MMRAHYƐ BADWA NO MU NSEM
Ne amammuo dwumadie no hyɛɛ aseɛ abera ɔkɔgyinaa sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani ma Amansie west amanyɔkuo wɔ mfeɛ 1996 mu abera wɔreto aba ayi New patriotic party mu nnipa. Ɔgyee akonnwa no firi Owura Kofi Amankwaa Peasah a na ɔyɛ National Democratic Congress ni. Abera a ɔnyaa mma 24,874 de dii Owura Kwaku Aninkora Sie a ɔyɛ National Democratic Congress a ɔnyaa aba 11,789, Owura E.K.Berko nso a ɔyɛ People's National Convention nso nyaa aba 1,174 ɛna Owura John Nimoh a ɔyɛ National Convention Party ni nso nya aba 1,160. Ɛnam Stephen Cobbinah Buor-Karikari a ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party ni so na ɔnyaa ankonwa no wɔ Ghanafoɔ abatoɔ kɛseɛ no mu wɔ mfeɛ 2000 abatoɔ mu.

BAABIA MENYAA MMOA FIRIIƐ

title: Kwadwo Baah-Wiredu
text:
Watwerɛ wie wɔ Asante Twi mu

Kwadwo Baah-Wiredu (1952 – Ɛbɔ 24 2008) yɛ Ghanani a na ɔyɛ amanyɔni sane yɛ akantant. Na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔgyina Ɔmanfoɔ wɔwɔ Asante Akyem Atifi mpɛsua so anan mu firi Ɔpɛpɔn bosome afe apem ahakron aduokron- nnson(1997) kɔpem sɛ owuu wɔ Ɛbɔ bosome ne da a ɛtɔ so aduonu-nnan afe mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe mu (Ɛbɔ 24,2008).Ɔyɛɛ ɔsoafoɔ a na ɔhwɛ nkuro nkuro so wɔ ɔmanpanin dadaa John Agyekum Kuffour aberɛ so firi afe mpem mmienu ne baako mu.

Abrabɔ ahyaseɛ ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Baah-Wiredu wɔ Asante Akyem Agogo. Ɔhyɛɛ nadamtam sukuu ase wɔ Kumase High sukuu a ɛwɔ Asantemantam mu wɔ afe apem ahakron -aduosia -nson. Ɔnyaa GCE abɔdin krataa wɔ afe apem ahakron aduoson- mmienu (1972). 

Ɔtoa so kɔɔ "sixth form" wɔ Prempeh kɔlege a ɛwɔ kumase Asantemantam mu. Baah-Wiredu toa so kɔɔ suapɔ wɔ "University of Ghana,Legon" wɔ afe apem ahakron aduoson nnan mu nam so nyaa abɔdin krataa wɔ  "B.Sc. in Administration (Accounting option)".

Afei, ɔsane toa so de mfeɛ nnan kɔ gyee nteteeɛ wɔ Institute of Chartered Accountants  maa no bɛyɛɛ akantant wɔ afe apem ahakron aduowɔtwe num (1985).

Adwuma 
Kwadwo Baah-Wiredu Yɛɛ adwuma wɔ wiemhyɛn gyinabea ahodoɔ wɔ Ghana ne  "Volta River Authority" adwumakuo no mu. Ɔyɛɛ kwankyerɛfoɔ panin wɔ kwan a kɔmputa fa so yɛ adwuma ne Ɔpanin ɔhwɛ sika sɛm so ma Ananse Systems. Ɔbɛyɛɛ mmarahyɛbadwani.

Amanyɔ 
Baah-Wiredu  hyɛɛ namanyɔ ase wɔ afe apem ahakron aduokron nson berɛ a ɔdii nkunim wɔ afe apem ahakron aduokron nsia Ghana abatoɔ mu. Ɔyɛ wɔn a na ɔyɛ kampan tia "Union government" (UNIGOV)  General Acheampong's asrafoɔ kuo bɔɔ nabaso wɔ afe apem ahakron aduoson nnwɔtwe (1978).  

Ɔde ho kɔ bɔɔ New Patriotic Party(NPP) amanyɔ kuo berɛ a ɔtee no afe apem ahankron aduokron mmienu(1992). Ɔbɛyɛɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ Ghana wɔ afe apem ahankron aduokron nsia (1996) mu.

Ɔsuafoɔ 
Ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔsiafoɔ wɔ Ɔmanpanin John Kufuor's NPP aban mu aberɛ so wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne baako mu (2001). Ɔyɛɛ ɔsuafoɔ a na ɔhwɛ nkuro akɛseɛ ne nkumaa mpuntuo wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne baako kɔpem mmiɛnsa mu(2001-2003) sane yɛɛ nwomasua , mmabunu ne agokansie mu suafoɔ firi afe mpem mmienu ne mmiɛnsa kɔpem nnum mu (2003-2005). Ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔsuafoɔ a ɔhwɛ ɔman no sikasɛm so wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nnum (2005), wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nnum (2005) mu no ɔde ɔman no akɔnhoma sika kɔ too ɔman no mmarahyɛbadwam ɔno ne ɔsuafoɔ ɔdikan yɛɛ saa.

Abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Baah-Wiredu ware woo mma nsia.

Ne Wuo 
Ɛbɔ bosom ne da ɛtɔ so aduonu nnam afe mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe (Ɛbɔ 24,2008), Baah-Wiredu wuu wɔ South Africa  berɛ a na ɔregye ayaresa wɔ bere tiawa yadeɛ bi ho.

title: John Frank Abu
text:
John Frank Abu yɛ Ghanani amanyɔnii a na ogyina mu ma Amenfi Central mansini wɔ Atoeɛ Mantam wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwafie a na edikan ne deɛ na ɛtɔ so mmienu na afei ɛsan tɔ so mmiɛnsa mu wɔ Ghana adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nnan. Na ɔyɛ mansoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ sika kɔkɔɔ adwuma so ne nkanea na afei nso na ɔyɛ mansoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ dwadie ne nnwumakuo so. Na ɔyɛ Mansoafoɔ wɔ Atɔeɛ Mantam a na ogyina mu ma kyiniiɛ (NDC) amanyɔkuo wɔ aban mu.

Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ ne Sukuu 
Wɔwoo Abu wɔ Amenfi Central wɔ Atɔeɛ Mantam wɔ Ghana. Ɔkɔɔ ne ntoasoɔ Sukuu wɔ "University of Guelph" Suapɔn mu wɔ Canada, ɛhɔ na ɔnyaa abɔdini krataa a ɔfrɛ no Dɔkota wɔ Filɔsɔfi a brɔfo kasa mu no ɔfrɛ no (Doctor of Philosophy), (PhD). Ɔkɔ suaa 'Agriculture wɔ 'University of Ghana' Suapɔn mu na onyaa abɔdini krataa a ɔfrɛ no 'Master of Science and Bachelor of Science degrees'.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔ afe apem aha-nkron ne aduokron nson (1997) mu no, Ɔmanpanin Jerry John Rawlings too ne nsa frɛɛ no sɛ ɔmɛyɛ mansoafoɔ ma nkanea ne sika kɔkɔɔ tuo ho adwuma. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nson (2007) mu no, ɔtoo aba yii no sɛ NDC oti tena nii ma Atoeɛ mantam, ɔde mma aduosia nnwɔtwe (68) na etuu Mr Seidu Adamu a ɔne no sii akan a ɔno nso nyaa mma aduosia (60).

Odii kan too aba yii Abu maa no kɔɔ mmarahyɛbadwafie sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ mmarahyɛbadwafie a edikan wɔ  Ghana adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nnan wɔ 1992 Ghana mmarahyɛbadwam abatoɔ a ogyinaa mu maa Kyiniiɛ (NDC) amanyɛkuo no. Ɔbaa mmarahyɛbadwam wɔ mmarahyɛbadwafie a ɛtɔ so mmienu mu wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome wɔ afe apem aha-nkron aduokron nsia mu (1996) Ghana abatoɔ kɛseɛ no mu. Ɔnyaa mma 18,644 a ɛkyerɛ ɔha nkyenkyemu 67.7% a efiri 27, 551 mu. Deɛ ɔne no sii akan a ne din de Emmanuel O.K Duah a ɔno nso nyaa 8,136 mma a ɛkyerɛ ɔha nkyekyemu 25.9% nna Kofi Osei nso nyaa 624 mma a ɛno nso kyerɛ ɔha nkekyemu 2.3%, Lawrence K. Afari nso nyaa 147 mma nna Kwame Adjei-Amoahene nso nyaa 0 mma.

Adwuma 
Abu yɛ Oti tena nii ma Tema Oil Refinery Limited. Na ɔyɛ mansoafoɔ ma sika kɔkɔɔ tuo adwuma ne anyinam nkanea. Na ɔsan nso yɛ adwuma sɛ mansoafoɔ ma dwadie ne nnwumakuo ahodoɔ. Ɔsan nso yɛ obi a ɔhwɛ kuayɔ nsɛm so.

title: Daniel Tekpertey
text:
Daniel Tekpertey yɛ Ghana mmrahyɛbadwani a ɔgyina hɔ ma National Democratic Congress sɛ nnipa a ɔka mmiensa mmrahyɛbadwa wɔ nnan adehyeman, Ghana ma Yilo Krobo a ɛwɔ Eastern Mantam. Ghana

N'abrabɔ, sukuu ne mmrahyɛbadwamu nsɛm 
Yɛ woo daniel wɔ yilo krobo a ɛwɔ Eastern mantam, Ghana. Ɔgyinaa mu maa Yilbo krobɔ sɛ mmrahyɛ badwani  ma yɛtoo aba maa no mmerɛ a Ghana abatoɔ kɛseɛ no kɔɔ so wɔ afe 1996 mu. Ɔtenaa akonnwa no so kɔsi afe 2004 ma Raymond Tawiah a ɔno nso ye National Democratic Congress ni nso fa dii so.

Daniel nyaa Yilo Krobo Kuro no akonnwa tenaa so ɛnam Ghana abatoɔ kɛseɛ a yɛtoo no afe 2000 no mu . Abatoɔ no mu no, ɔnyaa aba 13,960  a ɛyɛ 49.10% . Yɛkaa no nyinaa bɔɔ mu no ɔnyaa aba 28,456. Nnipa Num a wɔkɔeɛ nyinaa no Mr. Tekpertey na dii  National Democratic Congress (NDC) akonnwa no so nkonim. Nkorɔfo a ɔne wɔn kɔeɛ te sɛ Christian Kofi Tettey a ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party (NPP) nso nyaa aba 9,264 a Ɛyɛ 32.60%.

Abatoɔ

Daniel nyaa Yilo Krobo Kuro no akonnwa tenaa so ɛnam Ghana abatoɔ kɛseɛ a yɛtoo no afe 2000 no mu . Abatoɔ no mu no, ɔnyaa aba 13,960  a ɛyɛ 49.10% . Yɛkaa no nyinaa bɔɔ mu no ɔnyaa aba 28,456. Nnipa Num a wɔkɔeɛ nyinaa no Mr. Tekpertey na dii  National Democratic Congress (NDC) akonnwa no so nkonim. Nkorɔfo a ɔne wɔn kɔeɛ te sɛ Christian Kofi Tettey a ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party (NPP) nso nyaa aba 9,264 a Ɛyɛ 32.60%.

Jonas Tetteh Numo a ɔyɛ National Reform Party (NRP) nso nyaa aba 12.00% a ɛyɛ 3,425.  Convention People's Party(CPP) nso nyaa aba 1,112  a yɛkeka bɔm a ɛyɛ 3.90% . Mmrahyɛbadwafoɔ mmienu  bi nso kɔpere akonwa no bi a na wɔfiri People's National Convention (PNC) ɛna United Ghana Movement (UGM) mu.

title: George Buadi
text:
George Buadi yɛ Ghana amanyɔni a ɔwoo no Kitawonsa bosome da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa wɔ afe apem aha-nkron ne aduosia mmiɛnsa mu (3 July 1963). Ogyinaa mu maa Amanfi East mansini wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwafie a ɛtɔ a edi kan ne deɛ ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ Ghana adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nnan mu wɔ Atɔeɛ mantam.

Abrabɔ ahyeaseɛ ne sukuu 
Wɔwoo Buadi wɔ Kitawonsa bosome da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa wɔ afe apem aha-nkron ne aduosia mmiɛnsa mu (3 July 1963) wɔ Amanfi East Mansini mu wɔ Atɔeɛ mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔkɔɔ "University of Ghana" suapɔn ne "Ghana School of Law" suapɔn na onyaa abɔdini kraa a brɔfo kasa mu no yɛfrɛ no 'Bachelor of Arts ne Bachelor of Law' ɛbrɛ a ɔsuaa 'political science ne Law' wieeɛ no.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Buadi gyinaa mu maa Kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo (NDC) maa yɛ too aba yii no sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma Amenfi East mpasua wɔ Atoeɛ mantam wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome wɔ afe apem aha-nkron ne aduokron mmienu mmarahyɛbadwam abatoɔ.

Adwumasɛm 
Buadi yɛ mmaranimfoɔ na ɔsan nso yɛ amanyɔnii

Ɔno ankasa n'abrabɔ 
Buadi yɛ kristonii

title: Kojo Armah
text:
Emmanuel Kofi Armah Buah ɔwo no afe ahankron aduosiane nsia mu no yɛ Ghana Amayɔni bi a ɔsom wɔ asoeɛ a ɛhwɛ anyinam ahoɔden ne fangɔ si firi afe mpem mmienu ne ne du -mmiensa so.Buah yɛ Amayɔni ma "National Democratic Congress"amanyɔ kuo no,na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbadwani ma Ellembelle Mansin a ɛwɔ Western Region.

Ne nnwoma sua 
Emmanuel Armah Kofi Buah kura adesua mu abɔdin krataa wɔ mmra sem ho nimdeɛ a Ɔnya firii Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology na ɔsane wɔ abasobɔdeɛ wɔ Masitɛse wɔ sɛnea yɛ tɔtɔ neama firi  University of Maryland, Suapɔn bi ɛwɔ abrokyire mu.

Amanyɔsem mu  
Ɔmanpaanin Atta Mills ɛwɔ afe mpem aduo nu ne nkron mu yi Kofi Buah  sɛ ɔson sɛ abadeɛkyerɛ a ɔhwɛ Asoeɛ anyinam ho nsem soɔ. Ɛwɔ Ɔpɛpɔn da a ɛtɔso du nson no wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du-mmiensa,Ɔyi Buah sɛ panin a ɔhwɛ Asoeɛ a ɛhwɛ anyinam nsem ne Fangɔ ho nsem .Ɔwie  no  Owura Boakye Agyarko na ɔdi no anamu wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du-son mu  wɔ aberɛ a  a ɛde New Patriotic Party fa amanpanin adwa a ɔto no afe mpem mmienu ne du nsia. Wayɛ mmrahyɛbdwani de ama Ellembelle mpesuaso.Ɔsom wɔ asoeɛ a ɛhwɛ ɛdwadeɛ ,nnwuma ɛde afidie di dwuma ne wɔn a ɔhwɛ ɔman nsrahwɛ beaɛ nsem soɔ na ɔka wɔn a ɔhwɛ nfaso deɛ ho asem ,akwan nya ho asem

Nea ɛfa ne ho 
Buah wɔ maa mmienu

title: Grace Coleman
text:
Grace Coleman Oforisuo bosom da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nkron, afe apem ahankron ne aduanan mmiɛnsa  kɔsi Ɔsanaa bosom da ɛtɔ so mpen mmienu ne nkron (29 April 1943- 27 August 2009) no na ɔyɛ Ghanani amanyɔnni ne mmarahyɛbadwanni wɔ Effiduase Asokore mpasua a na ogyina hɔ ma mmarahyɛbadwam a na ɛtɔ so nan wɔ adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nan wɔ Ghana.

Abrabɔ mfitiaseɛ ne nnwomasua 
Wɔwoo Coleman wɔ Effiduase a ɛwɔ Asante Mantam wɔ Ghana. Ɔkɔɔ "Wesley Girls High School" firii afe apem ahankron ne aduosia mmienu  (1962), ɔnyaa ne abodin krataa a ɛwɔ anim na ɔsan toa n'adesua so kɔɔ Cape Coast asuapɔn (Legon) a ɔkɔsua sikasem ma no nyaa ho abodin. Coleman nyaa ne abodin krataa a ɛso wɔ "Vanderbilt University" a ɛwɔ amanone wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduoson nkron (1979),  na ɔsan so nyaa adinkanfo ne mpotuo abodin wɔ "Harvard asuapɔn wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nwɔtwe (1998).

N'adwuma 
Afiri afe apem ahankron ne aduosia nnwɔtwe de kɔsi afe apem ahankron ne aduoson nan (1968 - 1974), Coleman kɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ Ghana sikakorabea (GCB), Ejisu nkorabata bi a ɛwɔ Kumasi, babia onyiniiɛ a ɔbɛyɛ nkorabata no so panin, na afiri afe apem ahankron ne aduoson num ne afe ahankron ne aduowɔtwe (1975 &1980) no, na ɔyɛ panin wɔ asoeɛ a wɔhwe sikasem so sikasɛm ntotoeɛ ho.

Na ɔyɛ Ghana ɔsoafo de ma Netherlands firi afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe  kɔsi afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe mmienu (1980 - 1982), ɛwɔ Limann aberɛ so. Ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛnii, firii afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe mmiɛnsa kɔsi afe apem ahankron ne aduokron baako (1983 - 1991) na ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛnii panin wɔ sukuu a wɔsua nsonsoneɛ a ɛwɔ amammerɛ mu wɔ Holland.

Na Coleman yɛ sikasɛm soafoɔ abadiekyiri ne ne sikasɛm ntotoeɛ wɔ Kufuor aban a na adikan no.

Amanyɔsem 
Abatoɔ a adikan a Coleman de kɔɔ mmarahyɛbadwam yɛ Ɔpɛnimma bosom wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia (1996) Ghanaman nyinaa abatoɔ a na ogyina mu ma ɔsono amanyɔkuo (NPP) no ɛwɔ Effiduase Asokore mpasua so a ɛwɔ  Asante mantam wɔ Ghana. Ɔnyaa mma mpem dummiɛnsa, ɔha ne aduonum nan (13,154) firii mma mpem dunkron ne aduoson nson (19,077) no mu a na agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduonum nan akyiri pɔ aduokron (54.90%). Ɔsan nso nyaa n'akonwa no bio wɔ mfe mpem mmienu (2000) abatoɔ no. Wɔ mfe mpem mmienu (2000) mu no, Coleman san dii nkonim abatoɔ no mu sɛ mmarahyɛbadwanni de ma Effiduase Asokore mpɛsua a ɛwɔ Asante mantam mu. Odii nkonim de ma ɔsono amanyɔkuo (NPP) no. Ɔsono amanyɔkuo (NPP) no mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ aduasa mmiɛnsa (33) a wɔdii nkonim wɔ Asante mantam abatoɔ no a na wɔ wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam no, na ne mpasua no ka emu aduasa baako (31) no ho bi. Ɔsono amanyɔkuo (NPP) no dii nkonim sɛ dɔmkeseɛ  a na wɔwɔ Mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ aduokron nkron (99) a na Mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ dodoɔ nyinaa nso yɛ ahanu (200). Ɔnyaa mma mpem dummiɛnsa, ahankron ne aduonum nan(13,954) firii mma dodoɔ mpem dunkron, ahanson ne aduokron nkron (19,799). Na agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduoson baako akyiri pɔ mmienu (71.2%).Wɔtoo me so aba de tia Kwasi Amakye-Boateng a na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma kyinie amanyɔkuo (NDc) no, Osei Kwabena a na ɔno nso yɛ Covention People's Party anamsini, Osei Addiya a na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma National Reformed Party, Lovia Yeboah nso yɛ anamsini ma People's National Convention ɛna Alfred O. Baah nso yɛ anamsini de ma United Ghana Movement. Mma dodoɔ a wɔnyaa no wɔ abatoɔ no mu yɛ 4,408, 729, 246, 235, ɛne 35. Na agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduonu mmienu akyiri pɔ num (22.5%)ɔha nkyekyɛmu mmiɛnsa akyiri pɔ nson (3.7%), ɔha nkyekyɛmu baako akyiri pɔ mmiɛnsa (1.3%), ɔha nkyekyɛmu baako akyiri pɔ mmienu (1.2%), ɔha nkyekyɛmu ohunu akyiri pɔ mmienu (0.2%). 

Ɔsan so dii nkonim wɔ mpem mmienu ne nan (2004) abatoɔ no mu a ɔnyaa mma mpem dummiɛnsa ne aduonum baako (13,051) firii mma a na dodoɔ  na ɛyɛ mpem aduonu mmiɛnsa, ahanum ne aduonu nan (23,524) a na agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduonum num akyiri pɔ aduonum (55.50%).

N'abrabɔ 
Na Coleman ware David Coleman a ɔwɔ mmofra nan. Owuii wɔ Ɔsanaa bosom da ɛtɔ so aduonu nson mfe mpem mmienu ne nkron (27 August 2009) ɛnam ahomgyeɛ a na ɔngye na asikyire yareɛ nso a na ɔwɔ na ɛmaa no wuiiɛ.

title: Austin Akufo Gamey
text:
Austin Akufo Gamey (wɔwoo no Ahinime 26,1949) yɛ Ghana manyɔni. Ɔyɛ obi a w'aben wɔ adwumawura ne odwumayeni ho nsɛmsɛm mu nso. Na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma North Tongu mpasua a ɛwɔ Firaw mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana firi afe 1992 kosi afe 2001. Wɔ Jerry John Rawlings ammamuo no mu no, wɔpaw no sɛ mansoafo a ɔhwɛ adwumasɛm ne asetra mu yiyedie so. Seesei ɔyɛ ɔbenfoɔ wɔ adwumasɛm mu ne Alternative Dispute Resolution mu wɔ Ghana.

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Wɔwoo Gamey wɔ Ahinime 26,1949, wɔ Volo, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Salem mpɔtam wɔ North Tongu. North Tongu wɔ Firaw Mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana. N'awofoɔ ne Owura Emmanuel T.T Avorvuttor  ne Lucia Aya Avorvuttor a wɔn nyinaa akɔ wɔn kra akyi. Na ne maame yɛ kuani ne dwadini. Edin a wɔde maa Austin Gamey wɔ ne mmɔfrase ne Augustine Akufo Gameduabao na akiri yi wotwaa so yɛɛ no Austin Gamey. Bere a ɔrenyin no, na wɔfrɛ no Gamey wɔ baabi a na wɔte no. Ɔtɔ n'awofoɔ mma so nnum.

Ne nhomasua ho nsɛm 

Ofirii sukuu ase wɔ Evangelical Presbyterian Primary School na ɔtoaa so wɔ Local Authority Middle School a ɛwɔ Volo mpɔtam wɔ North Tongu. Berɛ a owiee mfitiaseɛ sukuu no, West African Examination Council (WAEC) twaa abasobɔ krataa a na ɛbɛkyerɛ sɛ wawie sukuu no mu. Ɛno akyiri no, otu kɔtenaa Ashaiman a ɛwɔ Greater Accra Mantɔw mu wɔ afe 1967 mu. Ɔsan firii Ashaiman kɔtenaa Tema wɔ afe 1968. Na ɔde ne ho hyɛ agodie mu paa  na ɛno boa maa no nyaa kwan wɔ Akodzo Middle School a ɛwɔ Tema denam ne kyerɛkyerɛni panyin a na ɔwɔ ne sukuu dada no mu no so.

Wɔ afe 1968 mu no, Gamey wiee Middle School na onyaa n'abasobɔdiɛ. Esian sɛ na ɔbɔ mmɔden wɔ mmirikatuo mu nti na wɔtaa frɛ no ''Akodzo Miller''.

Firi afe 1970 kosi afe 1971 no,na ɔyɛ adwuma de tua ne skuul ho ka wɔ Accra Polytechnic a seesei wɔfrɛ no Accra Technical University no  berɛ a na ɔkɔ skuul wɔ hɔ no. Otu kɔɔ Adabraka wɔ saa berɛ no ara mu. Wɔ afe 1976 mu no, onyaa kwan kɔɔ Sierra Leone kosuaa Advanced Industrial Relations.

Ɔsan toaa n'adesua no so wɔ Institute of Labour Studies a ɛwɔ Geneva ne Turin Center. Firi afe 19997 kosi afe 1998 no, ɔkɔɔ sukuu wɔ suapɔn ahodoɔ pii wɔ United States of America ne Canada. Saa berɛ yi mu na onyaa abasobɔ krataa wɔ Preventive and Professional Coaching in Mediation mu firii Mediation Training Institute wɔ United States of America.

N'adwumasɛm
Firi afe 1985 kosi 1986 no, ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ industrial relations officer wɔ Tema. Afei wɔyɛɛ no  executive manager wɔ Mankoadze Fisheries a ɛwɔ Tema wɔ firi afe 1987 kosi afe 1992. Na ɔyɛ panyin a ɔda Institute of Human Resource and Management Practitioners a ɛwɔ Ghana ano firi afe 1998 kosi afe 2003. Firi afe 2004 kosi afe 2006 no, na ɔyɛ Presidential Commissioner wɔ 'pensions' so.

Wɔ afe 2020 mu no, ɔtee 'Gamey and Gamey Academy of Mediation' .

Amanyɔsɛm
Wɔ afe 1992 mu no,woyii no sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma North Tongu mpasua no. Ogyinaa North Tongu abatoɔ mpasua no ananmu wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa a edi kan wɔ adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu. Ɔsan dii nkunim wɔ aba a wɔtoo wɔ 1996 abatoɔ no mu. Eyi kyerɛ sɛ ɔyɛɛ mmarahyɛbadwani mpɛn mmienu wɔ  Rawlings ammamuo no ase.

N'abrabɔ
Austin yere ne Gladys Gamey a ɔyɛ kyerɛkyerɛni. Ne mma yɛ nson; mmaa  mmienu ne mmarima nnum. Ɔyɛ Kristoni ne Ɔsɔfo wɔ Token Tabernacle.

title: Edward Osei-Kwaku
text:
Edward Osei-Kwaku yɛ Ghana mmarani ne amanyɔnni. Na ɔsom sɛ asoeɛ a wɔhwɛ amanpaninfoɔ nsɛm so abadiekyiri, san so yɛ asoeɛ wɔhwɛ mmabunu ne akorɔdie  nsɛm so berɛ a na Kufour wɔ aban mu no. Ɔsan nso som sɛ mmarahyɛbadwanni de ma Asokwa Atɔeɛ mpasua firii Ɔpɛpɔn bosom da a ɛtɔ so nson wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nson (1997) de kɔsi Ɔpɛpɔn bosom da ɛtɔ so nsia wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne num (2005).

Ne nnwomasua 
Na Osei-Kwaku yɛ adesuani wɔ Adisadel Kɔlegye (Cape Coast) na ofirii hɔ no ɔnyaa abodin krataa ɛwɔ mmara mu wɔ University of Ghana.

N'adwuma 
Na ɔwɔ amanyɔsem mu no, na Osei-Kwaku san yɛ adwuma sɛ mmarani ma Afriyie asoeɛ.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Na Osei-Kwaku yɛ kuoba de ma Ɔsono amanyɔkuo (NPP), ɔsom sɛ mmarahyɛbadwanni de ma Asokwa Atɔeɛ mpasua no firii Ɔpɛpɔn bosom da a ɛtɔ so nson wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nson de kɔsi Ɔpɛpɔn bosom da a ɛtɔ nsia, afe mpem mmienu ne hum (7 January 1997 - 6 January 2005). Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia (1996) Ghanaman nyinaa abatoɔ no, ɔnyaa mma mpem aduanan mmienu, ahanson ne aduasa nan (42,734) a na agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduonum mmienu akyiri pɔ nson (52.7%) nna mfe mpem mmienu Ghanaman nyinaa abatoɔ no ɔnyaa mma mpem aduanan nwɔtwe, ahanson ne aduasa nwɔtwe (48,738) a na agyina hɔ ma  ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduoson nan akyiri pɔ num (74.5%). Berɛ a Kufour aban wɔ so no, wɔyii no sɛ asoeɛ a wɔhwɛ aban nsɛm so abadiekyiri  na ɔsan nso kɔyɛɛ asoeɛ wɔhwɛ mmabunu ne agorɔkansie nsɛm soɔ. Berɛ a na ɔyɛ panin a ɔhwɛ mmabunu ne agorɔkasie nsɛm so no, ɔhwɛɛ sɛ ɔbɛboa ama Ghana akɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne nwɔtwe (2008) CAN akorɔkansie no bi. Ɔsan nso boa ma wɔyɛɛ Ghana akorɔpaman titiri no yie, Nkran akorɔpaman (Accra Sport Stadium) so ne Kumasi akorɔpaman so (Baba Yara Stadium).

N'abrabɔ 
Na Oseu-Kwaku yɛ Kristoni san so yɛ kuoba wɔ St Cyprian Anglican asɔre wɔ Ghana. Owuu wɔ Benada Ɛbɔ bosom da a ɛtɔ so dummiɛnsa wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne num mu (13 September 2005).

title: David Kwasi Amankwah
text:
David Kwesi Amankwah yɛ Ghana amanyɔni. Na ɔyɛ ananmusini ma Asunafo North  a ɛwɔ Bono Ahafo mantam mu no wɔ Mmrahyɛbadwafie.

Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ ne skuul 
Wɔwoo Amankwah wɔ Ayɛwohommumɔ da a ɔto so 16, afe apem aha-nkron aduanan mmiɛnsa (1943) mu wɔ Bono Ahofo mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana no mu. Ɔgyee ne suapɔn mu nteteeyɛ wɔ Cape Coast Suapɔn kɛseɛ no mu wɔ Mfinfini mantam mu. N`abodin krataa a ɛkura no nye Abodie mu nyansapɛ mu ɔbenfo wɔ nhomasua mu (Bsc. Science degree in Education).

Adwumayɛ 
Amankwah yɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛnyi ne obi ɔyɛ amnyɔsɛm wɔ Ghanaman yi mu.

N`amanyɔnsɛm akwantu 
Bere a odi kan a wɔtoo aba yii no kɔɔ Ghana adehyeman  a ɔto so nnan (4th republic) no  mmrahyɛbadwa fie nye afe 1993, ɔpɛpɔn da ɔtɔ so nson. Saa aber yi na w`adi nkonim wɔ afe 1992 Ghana mmrahyɛbadwa fie abatoɔ a wɔtoo no Ɔpɛnimaa bosom no da ɔto so 29, afe 1992 mu no mu.

Wɔ afe 1996 mu no, wɔsan too aba ma no bio ma ɔkɔɔ mmrahyɛabadwa fie wɔ Ghanafoɔ nyinaa aba a wɔtoo no mu. Amanyɔkuw a, ɔgyinaa hɔ maa wɔn nye National Democratic Congress (NDC). Afoforo a ɔne wɔn sii akan no mu bi nye, Osei Benjamin Kuffour a ɔyɛ amanyɔwkuw New Patriotic Party (NPP)  mu ni ne Michael Maham Nabla a ɔno nso yɛ amanyɔwkuw People's National Convention (PNC) mu ni. Amankwah de aba no mu 20,326, kyerɛ nnipa dodow a wɔtoo maa no, na edii nkonim na onii a na odi n`akyi nye NPP ni Benjamin Osei Kuffour na ɔno nso aba yɛ 17,048, kyerɛ abatofoɔ a wɔto maa no. Afei ma otwa to anaa ɔto so abiesa nye PNC ni  Michael Maham Nabla na ɔno nso aba dodow yɛ 618. Sɛ yɛhyehyɛ no pɛpɛɛpɛ a, ɛbɛyɛ ɔha mu nkyekyɛm aduanan baako ne akyirpɔw nwɔtwe (41.80%), ɔha mu nkyekyɛm aduasa nnum ne akyiripɔw baako (35.10%) ne ɔha mu nkyekyɛm baako ne akyirpɔw mmiɛnsa (1.30%).

Amankwah sii Asunafo North Mpɔtɛmfoɔ no ananmu fi afe 1993 besii afe 2000. Ɔfii hɔ no, NPP ni  Benjamin Osei Kuffour na ɔbɛsii n`ananmu wɔ afe 2000 Ghanafoɔ abatoɔ no mu.

title: Emmanuel Baah Danquah
text:
Emmanuel Baah Danquah yɛ obi a ɔyɛ amanyɔsɛm wɔ Ghana man mu. Na ɔka Ghana repɔbric a ɔto so nnan (4th republic of Ghana) mmrahyɛbadwa a ɔto so ebien no ho. Na Baah Danquah yɛ ananmu si ni ma Asutifi North mpɔtɛmfo no wɔ Ghana mmrahyɛbadwa fie na amanyɔkuw a na odi wɔn anim nye National Democratic Congress (NDC).

N`abrabɔ ne ne skuulkɔ 
Afe 1961, Ɔgyefuo bosome no da ɔto so 20 mu na wɔwoo Emmanuel Baah wɔ Bono Ahafo Mantɔw a ɛwɔ Ghana no mu. Ɔgyee abodin ( Bachelor of Arts) a ɔfa senea yɛtoto nneɛma ho wɔ Ghana suapɔn kɛseɛ (University of Ghana) no mu. Ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ adekyerɛfo ansa na ɔde ne ho rewura amanyɔsɛm mu.

Amanyɔsɛm Akwantu 
Emmanuel hyeɛɛ n`amanyɔw akwantu no ase fii 1961 afe no mu wɔ Bono Ahafo mantɔw nbo mu wɔ Ghana aber ɔdii nkonim wɔ Ghanafoɔ mmrahyebadwafo abatoɔ a wɔtoo no afe 1992, pɛnimma bosome no da ɔto so 29 mu. 
 
Wɔsan too aba yii no wɔ Gaana repɔbric a ɔto so nnan (4th republic of Ghana), mmrahyɛbadwa a ɔto so ebien no aba a Ghanafoɔ toi no wɔ afe 1996 mu no ma osii ne mpɔtɛmfoɔ anan bio. Wɔn a ɔde wɔn akyi kaa fam no nye, Georges Nsiah-Afriyie a ɔyɛ amanyɔkuw New Patriotic Party(NPP) mu ni ne Michael K.Manu a ɔno nso yɛ amanyɔkuw People's National Convention(PNC) mu ni. Emmanuel nyaa aba no mu ɔha mu nkyekyɛm aduanan ne akyiripɔw nnwɔtwe (40.80%), kyerɛ, nnipa dodow a wɔto maa no. Afei Georges nso nyaa  ɔha mu nkyekyɛm aduasa nnum ne akyirpɔw nsia (35.60%) na Michael so nyaa ɔha mu nkyekyɛm baako ne akyirpɔw ko (1.10%).

Wɔ afe 2000 Ghanafoɔ mmrahyebadwa abatoɔ no mu no,  Paul Okoh a ofi New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuw no mu no dii nkonim wɔ Emmanuel so wɔ aber onyaa aba no mu ɔha mu nkyekyɛm aduanan nkron ne akyirpɔw baako (49.10%) na Emmanuel Baah nso nyaa  ɔha mu nkyekyɛm aduanan nnan ne akyirpɔw ko (44.10%) no.

title: Johnson Asiedu Nketiah
text:
Johnson Asiedu Nketiah, a yɛfrɛ no ntotom nyinaa sahene, yɛ Ghanani amanyɔni a ɔyɛ ɔtwerɛfoɔ panin ma National Democratic Congress (NDC) amanyɔ kuo no.

Abrabɔ ahyeaseɛ 
Wɔwoo Asiedu Nketiah wɔ Seikwa  a ɛwɔ Wenchi mansini mu wɔ Brong-ne Ahafo mantam mu mprenpren deɛ ɛyɛ Bono mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa bosome ne da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nnan afe apem ahankron aduonum nsia(Ɔpɛnimaa 24,1956), nagya ne ɔpanin, Nana Kwaku Asiedu, a ɔyɛ kuani a ɔfiri Ɔyoko abusua mu ne maame de  Madam Hagar Akosua Afrah a ɔfiri Akwamu abusua mu. Ɔno na ɔtɔ so nnum ne maame mma nkron no mu.

Nwomasua 
Owura Asiedu Nketiah hyɛɛ ne mmɔfra sukuu ase wɔ Seikwa Presbyterian sukuu mu. Afei, Ɔtoa so kɔɔ kɔlege wɔ St. Joseph’s College of Education wɔ Bechem firi afe apem ahankron aduoson nnsn(1974) kɔpem afe apem ahankron aduoson nwɔtwe(1978) ɛhɔ na ɔnyaa abɔdin krataa sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛni wɔ afe apem ahankron aduoson nwɔtwe (1978).

Ɔhyɛɛ nadwuma sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛni wɔ Seketia Presby sukuu a ɛwɔ Jaman North mansini mu wɔ  Bono mantam mu. Ɔnyaa kwan sɛ osuani wɔ University of Ghana suapɔn no mu sɛ Business sukuuni wɔ 1983 sɛ ɔnkɔ yɛ Bachelor of Science Degree in Business Administration (Banking and Finance option).

Na Nketiah ka mpanimfoɔ a ɔyɛɛ Post Graduate Training Programme in Stock Brokerage and Investment Analysis berɛ a Ghanafoɔ de Stock Exchange  baeɛ. Ɔnyaa abɔdin wɔ Maseta of Science Degree in Defense and International Politics firii Ghana Armed Forces Command kɔlege wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du-nkron (2019).

Adwuma 
Aseidu Nketia yɛɛ adwuma wɔ GIHOC Distilleries adwuma kuo mu. Afei, ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔkwankyerɛfoɔ panin maa Nkoraman sikakorabea ne Sehwi Asawinso sikakorabea sɛ ɔkwankyerɛfoɔ panin a ɔkyerɛkyerɛ.Wayɛ adwuma wɔ National Trust Holding (NTHC) adwuma kuo mu pɛn sɛ stockbroker ne investment banker.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Aseidu Nketia yɛ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔyii no kaa abadwafoɔ  ɛhwɛ sikasɛm ntotoeɛ so wɔ Ghana.Ɔyɛɛ ɔtitenani maa Mines ne ahoɔdenneɛ abadwa kuo, afei ɔsane ka abadwafoɔ a ɔhwɛ nnuane ne mfudeɛ ne kookoo nsɛm ho, bio ɔyɛɛ dɔm dodoɔ a ɔwɔ mmarahyɛbadwa fie no nnaano panin abadeɛkire. Ɔyɛɛ ɔsuafoɔ abadeɛkyire ɔhwɛ nnuane ne nnuaba so wɔ Ɔmanpanin Jerry John Rawlings aberɛ so.

Wɔ National Democratic Congress' (NDC) Mpanimfoɔ nhyiamudie ase wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nnum, Ɔpɛnimaa bosome mu ɔtoo aba maa no dii nkunim ɔde ɔha nkyɛmuu aduowɔtwe na ɛdii nkunim wɔBede Ziedeng, owura Sylvester Mensah ne owura Antwi Boasiako bɛyɛɛ ɔtwerɛtwerɛfo panin a ɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa ma NDC amanyɔ kuo no. Ɔyii no bio wɔ afe 2010, ne 2014. Ɔpɛpɔn bosome mu. 

Ɔtoo aba yi sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani maa no bɛyɛɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome ne da a ɛtɔ so nson afe apem ahankron aduokron mmiɛnsa (Ɔpɛpɔn 7,1993) wɔ nkunimdie a ɔdii no wɔ afe apem ahakron aduokron mmienu Ghana abatoɔ mu wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa bosome ne da a ɛtɔ so aduonu-nkron(Ɔpɛnimaa 29,1992). Wɔ afe mpem mmienu Ɔpɛnimaa abatoɔ no ɔtotoo ɔne owura Rojo Mettle-Nunoo ano.

Amanfoforɔ so amsnyɔsɛm 
Wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du-nson In (2017), no ɔyii owura Asiedu Nketiah sɛ ɔmampanin abadeakyire ma Socialist International in absentia at Cartagena sɛ ɔmɛdi  António Guterres adeɛ. Ɔsane yii no sɛ ɔmɛsom George Papandroe.

Abrabɔ 
Owura Asiedu yɛ kristoni a ɔka Presbyterian asɔre a ɛwɔ Ghana.  Ɔyɛ ɔwarefoɔ a ɔwɔ mma nnum ne yere din Awuraa. Vida Adomah Asiedu Nketiah, .

title: David Yaw Mensah
text:
David Yaw Mensah yɛ obi a ɔyɛ amanyɔsɛm wɔ Ghana man mu na  na ɔyɛ ɔnanmusini wɔ mmrahyɛbadwa fie ma Bono Ahafo mantɔw no fa a wɔfrɛ no Atebubu North mpɛsoaso hɔfo no.
Na Yaw Mensah yɛ mmrahyɛbadwemnyi wɔ Ghana mmrahyɛbadwa a ɔto so ebien ne mmiɛnsa (2nd and 3rd Parliament) wɔ Ghana repɔbrik nnan (4th republic of Ghana) no mu.

N`abrabɔ ne ne sukuu 
Wɔwoo Mensah wɔ afe 1943, Ɔpɛpɔn bosome no mu. Ɔkɔɔ sukuu wɔ Presby Training College a ɛwɔ Akropong wɔ apuei mantɔw mu. Saa nteteeyɛ skuul yi mu na onyaa abodin krataa a ɔma obi tum kyerɛ ade.

Adwumayɛ 
Adwuma titiriw a ɔyɛ ne adekyerɛ. Eyi ne adwuma titiriw ɔyɛ a ɔwɔ ho abodin krataa nanso ɔsan yɛ Ghana amanyɔni.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Mensah yɛ National Democratic Congress(NDC) amnyɔkuw no mu ni. Wɔtoo aba yii no ma ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔnanmusini wɔ mmrahyɛbadwa fie ma Bono Ahafo mantɔw no fa a wɔfrɛ no Atebubu North mpɛsoaso hɔfo no. Osii mpɔtɛm hofo no ananmu wɔ Ghana mmrahyɛbadwa a ɔto so ebien ne mmiɛnsa (2nd and 3rd Parliament) wɔ Gaana repɔbrik nnan (4th republic of Ghana) no mu.

Ɔde n`adwuma baa awieɛ no, Emmanuel Owusu Mainu besii n`nanmu aber a wɔsesaa mpɔtɛm hɔ din no fii Atebubu North kɔɔ Atebubu Amantin wɔ afe 2004 Ghanafoɔ abatoɔ mu no.

Abatoɔ 
Abere a odi kan a wɔtoo aba yii Menah ma no kɔɔ mmrahyɛbadwa fie yɛ afe 1993, bosome Ɔpɛpɔn ne da ɔto so 7. Saa aber yi na w`adi nkonim wɔ mmrahyɛbadwa fie abato no mu wɔ afe 1992, Ɔpɛnimma bosome no da ɔto so 29 Ghanafoɔ abatoɔ no mu.

Afei wɔ afe 1996, Ghanafo abato no mu nso, nnipa a wɔn dodow yɛ 22,140 san to maa no ma no dii nkonim wɔ Atebubu North mpɛsoaso hɔ bio. Sɛ yɛde kɔ Ɔha mu nhyehyɛmu a, aba a onyaa no gyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛm aduanan nson ne akyirpɔw nnan (47.40%).  Mensah, wɔ afe 2000 mu san gyinaa mu ma wɔtoo ne so aba wɔ National Democratic Congress (NDC) amanyɔkuw no din mu wɔ ne mpɛsoa no so. Na ne mpɛsoa no ka mmrahyɛbadwa agua nson a NDC amanyɔkuw no nya fii agua aduonu baako a na ɛwɔ Bono Ahafo mantɔw no mu no. Saa afe yi, amanyɔkuw National Democratic Congress bɛyɛɛ dɔm kumaa wɔ mmrahyɛbadwafie esiane sɛ mmrahyɛbadwa agua a ne dodow yɛ aha mmienu (200) no, ɛmu aduokron mmienu (92) na wodii mu nkonim wɔ Ghana mmrahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa mu. Aba dodow a Yaw Mensah nyaa fii aba 29,893 mu no yɛ 13,229 (44.6%). Wɔn a, ɔne wɔn sii akan no nye Joseph Kwabena Manu a na ɔndom amanyɔkuw biara, Winston Samuel Binabiba a na ɔdom National Reform Party amanyɔkuw no, Mahama Ikunjoony a na ɔdom New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuw, Francis Kwabena Dorkoseh a na ɔdom People's National Convention amanyɔkuw, ne  Niekuu Bayor Franklin a na Convention People's Party amanyɔkuw no. Aba wɔn mu biara nyaa dodow yɛ 10,563; 533, 529, ne 177 wɔ ndidisoɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ mu wɔ nnipa dodow a wɔtoo aba no nyinaa mu. Sɛ wode kɔ ɔha mu nkyekyɛm a, wobenya 39.5%, 2.0%, 2.0%, ne 0,7% ndidisoɔ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

Ɔsom 
Mensah yɛ Kristo kyidinyi.

title: Nana Asante Frempong
text:
Nana Asante Frempong yɛ ghana amanyɔni a ɔsoom wɔ mmrahyɛbadwafie firi afe mpem-mmienu ne baako (2001) de kɔ sii afe mpem-mmienu ne nson (2007). Na ɔka Ghana mmrahyɛbadwamu atenaseɛ a ɛtɔ so mmiensa no ho. Na Nana Asante Frempong yɛ mmrahyɛbadwani de ma Kwabere East mpɛsoa so a ɛwɔ Asante mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

Ne ho asɛm 
Wɔwoo Nana Asante Frempong wɔ Sakora Wonoo, kuro ketewa bi a ɛwɔ Kwabere Mpɛsoa so Asante mantam mu. Saa kuro ketewa yi mu na ɔhyɛɛ n'adesua ase. Wɔ mfie du mu no, wɔ ɛbrɛ a na ɔkɔ "Local Catholic Primary School", ɔfaa mfie mmiensa nsaanodwumausua wɔ kente nwene mu. Ɛnkɔsi sɛ na obɛwura Opoku Ware ntoasoɔ sukuu mu no na ɔyɛ ɔbenfo wɔ kente nwene mu.

title: Matthew Kwaku Antwi
text:
Matthew Kwaku Antwi yɛ Ghanani mmarahyɛbadwanni wɔ Ghana kwasafoman mu. Na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwanni de ma Atwima- Kwanwoma mpasua a ɛwɔ Asante mantam wɔ Ghana wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam a ɛtɔ so nan wɔ kwasafoman a ɛtɔ so nan wɔ Ghana. Na ɔyɛ kuoba de ma Ɔsono amanyɔkuo (NPP) no.

Abrabɔ mfitiaseɛ ne ne nnwomasua 
Wɔwoo Antwi wɔ Ahinime bosom da a ɛtɔ so nan, afe ahankron ne aduanan baako (October 4, 1941). Ɔwɔ abɔde nyansahu abɔdin krataa wɔ kuadwoma nyansahu ne PhD.

N'adwuma 
Antwi yɛ abɛɛfo suahunu hwehwɛmuni.

Amanyɔkuo adwuma 
Antwi yɛ kuoba wɔ Ɔsono amanyɔkuo (NPP) no mu. Ɔhyɛɛ n'adwuma ase wɔ afe apem.ahankron ne aduokron nson (1997) berɛ a ɔdii nkonim wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia (1996) Ghanaman nyinaa abatoɔ a ɛkɔɔ so no mu. Wɔsan too ne so aba wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosom da a ɛtɔ so nson wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nan (7 January 2005) berɛ a ɔdii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosom no mu wɔ mfe mpem mienu ne nan ( December 2004) wɔ afe no ewiei. Susan too ne so aba sɛ mmarahyɛbadwanni de maa Atwima-Kwanwoma mpasuaso wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam a ɛtɔ so nan wɔ kwasafoman a ɛtɔ so nan no mu wɔ Ghana.

N'abrabɔ 
Ɔyɛ kristonni.
