title: Joe Donkor
text:
Joe Donkor (1942–2019) yɛ Ghanani amanyɔni a na ɔyɛ ɔsoafoɔ abadiekyire ma asoeɛ ɛhwɛ nnwomasua so ne asoeɛ a ɛhwɛ apaadie ne nnwuma ho nsɛm so. Ɔsom sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani maa Tano North  abatoɔ mpasua a na ɛwɔ kane Brong Ahafo  mantam mu a ɛwɔ Ghana.

Nahyɛase ne ne sukuuu kɔ 
Wɔwoo Donkor wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduanan mmienu  mu. Ɔhyɛɛ ne nwomasua ase wɔ Yamfo Roman Catholic mfitiaseɛ sukuu. Ɔwieeɛ no ɔkɔɔ ntoaso sukuu wɔ Achimota a ɛwɔ Nkran. Bere a na ɔwɔ  afe a ɔbɛwieɛ sukuu no mu no,  na ne kane Ghana Ɔmanpanin Jerry John Rawlings   ahyɛ ne sukuu ase wɔ saa sukuu korɔ yi mu.  Donkor nyaa abɔdin krataa wɔ Ghana suapɔn a ɛwɔ Legon,  bere a ɔkɔ  suaa  adeɛ  wɔ hɔ no. Ɔwiee ade sua  no, ɔkɔ yɛɛ adwuma wɔ SIC akyire  ɔnyaa mmoa kɔtoaa n'adesua so wɔ United Kingdom.

N'amanyɔsɛm dwumadie 
Ɔsane baa Ghana wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduowɔtwe baako mu bɛtoaa nadwuma a ɔyɛ no SIC no so sɛ Ɔkwankyerɛfo panin  mfeɛ nwɔtwe  a ɛfiri afe apem ahenkron aduowɔtwe baako kɔ si afe apem ahenkron aduowɔtwe nkron mu.

Mmarahyɛbadwani 
Ɛwɔ afe apem ahenkron aduokron mmienu mu wɔ Ghana adehyeman nnan mu no, Donkor  gyina maa Wɔtoo ne to aba wɔ Tano North abatoɔ mpasua so wɔ New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuo no din mu sɛ ɔrepɛ mmrahyɛbadwa akonwa no. Wankɔ mmarahyɛbadwafie ɛƒiri sɛ Okunini Albert Adu Boahen a na ɔyɛ Ɔsono amanyɔkuo (New Patriotic Party) frankaatuni no bɔɔ abatoɔ no guiɛ.  Donkor  sane gyinaa bio wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduokron nsia mu maa Wɔtoo aba yii no sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani maa no bɛkaa nnipa mmiɛnsa a Wɔtoo aba yii wɔn sɛ mmrahyɛbadwafoɔ wɔ kane Brong Ahafo wɔ Ɔsono amanyɔkuo din mu (New Patriotic Party)no ho. Mmrahyɛbadwafoɔ mmienu a na,wɔka ne ho no firi  Sunyani East ne  Sunyani West.

Donkor  bɔɔ ntoa wɔ nkuro nketewa nyinaa mu bere na aduru sɛ wɔbɔ ntoa  no yɛɛ sɛ nnipa no bɛto aba n'amanyɔkuo no. Wɔtoo aba no maa no kɔɔ  mmrahyɛbadwfie wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduokron nsia sɛ dɔmkumaa no mu baako. Ɛwɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne baako mu no, Ɔsane nyaa mmarahyɛbadwa akonwa kɔɔ mmrahyɛbadwfie sɛ dɔmkɛseɛ no mu baako a na Ɔmanpanin John Agyekum Kuffour na naban te adwa soɔ.

Akyire  wantumi ankɔ mmrahyɛbadwafie wɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo no din mu ne mprensa so bere a Ernest Akobour tuu no wɔ Ɔsono amanyɔkuo aba a Wɔtoo de yi obi kɔ gyina ne din mu wɔ amansan abatoɔ mu no.

Sɛ ɔyɛ Ɔsoafoɔ 
Ɛwɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne mmienu mu no, Ɔmanpanin Kuffour paa no sɛ ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ nnwuma ne apaadie so abadiekyire. Akyire no wɔsesaa no yɛɛ no ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ  nnwomasua so abadiekyire  wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne mmiɛnsa mu.

Abatoɔ 
Ɛwɔ mfeɛ mmienu mu no, Donkor  nyaa Tano North abatoɔ mpasua a ɛwɔ kane Brong Ahafo mmrahyɛbadwa akonwa no. Wɔtoo aba yii no wɔ Ɔsono amanyɔkuo New Patriotic Party din mu. Na ne mpasua no ka mpasua nson a Ɔsono amanyɔkuo no dii nkunim wɔ mmrahyɛbadwa nkonwa aduonu baako a na ɛwɔ Brong Ahafo mantam mu wɔ Ghana no. Ɔsono amanyɔkuo New patriotic party nyaa dɔmkumaa wɔ mmrahyɛbadwafie bere a wɔnyaa mmrahyɛbadwa nkonwa aduokron mmienu(92) firii mmrahyɛbadwa nkonwa ahanu(200)  no mu wɔ mmrahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa wɔ Ghana adehyeman nnan no mu. Ɔnyaa mma no mpem du mmiɛnsa ahenan ne nwɔtwe (13,408votes) firii mma mpem aduonu mmiɛnsa  ahenkron aduonu nnan(23,924votes) mu.  Yei ne ɔha mu abupɛn aduonum nsia akyire po nwɔtwe (56.8%) yɛ pɛ. Wɔtoo aba yii ne gyaa  Nana Opoku Acheampong na ɔgyina ma National Democratic Congress, Alex Owusu Kwakye na ɔgyina ma National Reform Party, Appiah Kwadwo John na ɔgyina ma  People's National Convention and Addo Kwasi na,ɔgyina ma Convention People's Party. Wɔnom nyaa mma no 9,361, 374, 264 and 190  te sɛdeɛ wɔn din didisoɔ no pɛpɛɛpɛ.  Woka wɔn mma no nyinaa bɔmu a ɛyɛ Ɔha mu abupɛn aduasa nkron akyire po nson.

Nabrabɔ 
Na Donkor aware wɔ mma nson. Ɔfiiri mu Ɔbɛnim bosome mu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nkron (March 2019)

title: Nana Yaw Otto
text:
Nana Yaw Otto yɛ Ghana Amayɔni bi a na ɔka wɔn a na ɔwɔ mmrahyɛbɛdwafie a na ɛtɔ so mmienu no wɔ Ghana na ɔkɔ gyina Sene mpɔtamu anamu wɔ Mmrahyɛbɛdwafie Na ɔka amanyɔkuo a ɔfrɛ no National Democratic Congress.￼

Na abrabɔ mfitiaseɛ 
Ɔwɔ Nana wɔ aƒe apem ahankron ne aduosia ne mmienu wɔ obubuo bosome da ɛtɔso aduonu mmienu wɔ Brong Ahafo Region of Ɔnya abɔdin krataa wɔ mfidie ne abɛfo dwumadie mu wɔ nnoɔma mu wɔ University of Mines and Technology, a ɛwɔTarkwa. Na ɔyɛ afidie ne abɛfo dwumadie ansa na ɔwura amayɔsem mu.

Na amayɔsem ho nsɛm 
Ɔyi Nana kɔ mmrahyɛbɛdwafie wɔ aberɛ a ɔdi nkonim wɔ ɔpɛpɔn da ɛtɔ so nson wɔ afe ahankron ne aduokron mmienu wɔ mmrahyɛbɛdwafoɔ Abatoɔ no mu a ɔto no Ɔpɛnima bosome a ɛtɔ so aduonu nkron wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduokron mmienu.

Ɔsane nso yi no kɔ mmrahyɛbɛdwafie  ɛtɔso mmienu ne nan no mu wɔ aberɛ a ɔdi nkonimdie anɔ tire bɔ no wɔ afe ahankron ne aduokron nusia wɔ Ghana Abatoɔ na Ɔnya maa aduosia nakyirepɔ aduosa ɔha nkyekyemu sene ne yɔnkɔ a ɔtwa K.S Odi-Ssempa Daanyansah a ɔgyina ma Convention people Party nso nya.

title: David Lamptey
text:
David Lamptey yɛ Gaana mmrahyɛbedwani ma Klottey-Korley mpotɛmu wɔ Osu kro ni so, kro a ɛwɔ Nkran mantam .Na ɔsan yɛ edwuma  de boa amanfoɔ nnipa a brɔfo kasa mu no yɛ ni sɛɛ Philanthropist.

Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ ne Adesua 
Lamptey ɛyɛ panyin a na ɔda Radio XYZ ne Sidalco Group of Companies ano. Ɔbɛ yɛɛ mmrahyɛbedwani ɛma National Democratic Congress Dwumakuo mmrɛ a ofiri New Patriotic Party aban mu. Ɔbua yɛ Nnuro de bua nnuaba bebree.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Lamptey tease no na ɔka mmrahyɛbedwa a ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ Ghana repɔblik nnan mu ɛma Klottey-Korley mpotɛmu wɔ Nkran ɛma National Democratic Congress amyanyɔkuowɔ afi 1996 ɛmmerɛ a Ghana ɛto aba ɛnna odi nkunim wɔ Tei Okunor a ɔgyina hɔ ma amanyɔkuo biaa, Gilbert K. Quatey a agyina ma ɔsono amanyɔkuo no New Patriotic Party   Adolf Lutterodt ɛma Convention Peoples Party  amanyɔkuo, Kwame Nyarko Akuffo-Mensah a w'agyina ama amamnyɔkuo biaa, ɔgyina maa ne nko, Mohammed Buniyamina ogyina hɔ ma PNC amanyɔkuo nipa a ɔtwatoɔ yɛ  Oti Vanderpu a ɔno nso w'agyina ama amamnyɔkuo biaa, ɔgyina maa ne nko.

Abusua nni nkwa nna 
Lamptey ware yɛ, na ni mma yɛ nnwɔtwe. Owu wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa bosome ɛda ɛtɔso enum so wɔ afi 2012 na wɔ sie no Ogyefoɔ bosome mu da a ɛtɔ so nkron wɔ afe 2013 mu. Owu yɛ na aka nna mmienu na abato mmrɛ aso, mwei ma ni wuo no yɛ bebree wanwa.

title: Abraham Kofi Asante
text:
Abraham Kofi Asante yɛ Ghanani amanyɔni a na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ mmarahyɛbadwafie a na ɛtɔ so mmienu ne mmiɛnsa wɔ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nnan mu. Na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma Amenfi West mpasua no wɔ Atoeɛ mantam a na ogyina mu ma Kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo no (NDC) wɔ Ghana.

Abrabɔ ahyeaseɛ ne sukuu 
Asante kɔɔ ne ntoasoɔ sukuu wɔ Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology Suapɔn. Onyaa abɔdini krataa wɔ 'Bachelor of Science degree in chemistry' mu wɔ suapɔn korɔ no ara mu. Ɔsane nso kɔɔ University of Ghana suapɔn ɛhɔ na ɔkɔ nyaa  abɔdin krataa a brɔfo kasa mu yɛfrɛ no 'Master of Business Administration'. Afei nso ɔsan kɔ nyaa abɔdin krataa a yɛfrɛ no  Master of Science wɔ brɔfo kasa mu wɔ  Ghana Telecom University College suapɔn.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Asante kɔɔ mmarahyɛbadwafie a na ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa wɔ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nnan mu. Na Ɔyɛ Kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo ananmusini ma Amenfi West mpasua wɔ Atoeɛ mantam wɔ Ghana. N'amanyɔkuo abrabɔ no hyɛɛ aseɛ firii ɛbrɛ a onyaa afe apem aha-nkron aduokron nsia (1996) abatoɔ kɛseɛ  no maa NDC amanyɔkuo no. Onyaa mma  16,085 firii 24,396 a ɛkyerɛ ɔha nkyekyemu  46.70%. Onyaa mma no kyɛn deɛ ɔne no sii akan a yɛfrɛ no Owura Samuel Alberto Tekyi a ɔno nso nyaa mma  8,311

title: Afieye Ashong
text:
Beatrice Love Naa-Afieye Ashong yɛ mmrahyɛbedwani ɛma Kpone Katamanso Constituency wɔ Nkran mantam.  Ɔsane nso ka nipakuo a wɔtee kuo a wɔfrɛ no Gods Love Society a ɛyɛ kuo a ɛnhyɛ aban ase, ɛna ɔsane nso yɛ mmarahyɛbadwani dadaa de ma Kpone Katamanso abatoɔ mpesua no so wɔ Nkran mantam no mu wɔ ɔman Ghana mu.

Abrabɔ ahyɛaseɛ 
Wɔ woo Beatrice Love Naa-Afieye Ashong baabi wɔ a  Kpone Katamanso a ɛwɔ Nkran punpuni mantam no mu wɔ ɔman Ghana mu. Edin a yɛ de frɛ no wɔ mmrahyɛbɛdwafie yɛ Afieye Ashong.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Na Ashong ka mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtɔ so mmienu ne mmiensa wɔ Ghana kabimamenkabi amanmuo a ɛtɔ so nan no mu. Ɔhyɛɛ n'amanyɔsɛm no ase wɔ afe apem ahankron aduokron nsia mu berɛ a ɔgyinaa wɔ kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress din mu sɛ yɛnto ne so aba ma ɔmmɛyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani mma ɔmanfoɔ a wɔwɔ Kpone Katamanso abatoɔ mpesua no so wɔ afe apem ahankron aduokron nsia abatoɔ no mu. Ɔnyaa mma no mu 7,901, a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 59.50% wɔ mma dodoɔ a wɔtoeɛ no nyinaa mu na ɔde dii nkunim wɔ berɛ a ɛdi kan. Ɔsane nso gyinaa bio wɔ afe mpem mmienu 2000 abatoɔ no mu wɔ ɔman Ghana mu, ɔsane nso dii nkunim bio a ɔnyaa mma no mu 5,420, a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 51.35% wɔ mma dodoɔ a wɔtoeɛ no nyinaa mu. Ɔde n'amanyɔsɛm nyinaa baa awieɛ berɛ a ɔbaa abɔtene bɛkaa sɛ ɔnnyina bio, na ɔde ne som no nyinaa reba awieɛ wɔ afe 2004, ɔpɛpɔn bosome no mu.

Abatoɔ 
Wɔ afe apem aha nkron aduokron nsia abatoɔ keseɛ mu no, Ashong de mma 7,901 a ɛkyerɛ ɔha mu nkyekye mu 59.50% dii deɛ ɔne no sii akan no so nkunim wɔ Kpone Katamanson wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam a tɔ so mmienu wɔ Ghana adehyeman a tɔ so nan no mu. Wɔn a ɔne wɔn sii akan no ne George T. Noye a ogyinaa mu maa New Patriotic Party  amanyɔkuo no, onyaa mma 2,609 a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyemu 19.60% , Emmanuel Kweku Sagoe nso na ogyinaa mu maa National Convention Party,  onyaa mma 562 a ɛkyerɛ ɔha nkyekye mu  4.20% ɛna Theophilus Tei Okunor nso gyinaa mu maa People's National Convention onyaa mma 138 a ɛkyerɛ 1.00% .

title: J.E. Afful
text:
John Edward Afful  yɛ Ghanani amanyɔni a na ɔka Ghana mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so mmienu no ho wɔ Ghana adehyeman nnan no mu. Na ɔgyina hɔ ma amanfoɔ wɔwɔ Abura-Asebu-Kwamankese abatoɔ mpasua wɔ Mfimfini mantam (Central Region ) mu a ɛwɔ Ghana.

Nahyease 
Wɔwoo Afful wɔ Abura-Asebu-Kwamankesekuro a ɛwɔ Mfinfini Mantam (Central Region ) mu wɔ Ghana ha.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔtoo aba yii Afful maa no kɔ gyinaa Abura Asebu Kwamankese a ɛwɔ Mfinfini Mantam mu  anan mu wɔ mmarahyɛbadwafie wɔ National Democratic Congress din mu. Ɔnyaa mma no mpem aduonu ahanu aduosia mmienu (20,262 votes)firii mma mpem aduasa mmiɛnsa ahenum aduowɔtwe nnum( 33,585 8total votes cast ) a wɔtoeɛ no mu. Ene ɔha mu abupɛn aduanan nnan akyire po du na ɛyɛ pɛ( representing 44.10%) bere onipa a ɔne no repere akonwa no a wɔfrɛ no Andrew Kingsford Mensah a ɔgyina wɔ Ɔsono amanyɔkuo New Patriotic Party din mu nyaa mma no mpem du mmiɛnsa ne aduowɔtwe nwɔtwe (13,088 votes)a ɛne ɔha mu abupɛn aduonu nwɔtwe akyire po aduonum(28.50%) yɛ pɛ ne Emmanuel F. Appiah -Kubi a na ɔgyina ma Convention People's Party no nso nyaa mma no ahanu aduasa nnum  (235 votes)a ɛkyerɛ ɔha mu abupɛn hwee  akyire po aduonum(0.50%). Berɛ a ɛwɔ mmrahyɛbadwa mu no wɔpaw no sɛ ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ mpɔtam,abɔdeɛm Nyasa pɛ ne abɛɛfo kwantenpɔn ho nsɛm so

title: Papa Owusu Ankomah
text:
Papa Owusu-Ankomah yɛ Ghana mmaranimni ne amanyɔni. Ɔka wɔn a wɔtee Ɔsono Amanyɔkuo (NPP) no ho. Ɔdii dwuma sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani maa Sekondi mpɛsua firi afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia mu (1996) de kɔsi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne dunsia mu (2016). Wɔ Ayɛwohomumɔ bosome mu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne dunson (2017)mu no, wɔpaw Papa Owusu-Ankomah sɛ Ghana High Commisiona ma UK ne Ireland. Ne srahwɛ dwumadie no siiɛ wɔ mfeɛ mpem aduonu ne aduonu (2020) mu wɔ Obubuo bosome ne da a ɛtɔ so aduasa no mu. Na wɔfrɛ no Quiet Dynamo ma Ghana amanyɔnsɛm. Ɔhyiaa Queen Elizabeth II berɛ a na ɔreda ne Credence nkrataa adi wɔ Buckingham Ahemfie wɔ London.

Abrabɔ ahyɛseɛ 
Wɔwoo Owusu-Ankomah wɔ Ghana wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduonum nwɔtwe (1958) mu wɔ Oforisuo bosome ne da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nson maa adwadie abusua bi a na wɔdi dwa fa adansie ho wɔ atɔeɛ mantam mu. Yaw Owusu-Ankomah a ɔyɛ ne papa no firi Atibie a ɛwɔ Kwahu mansini mu wɔ apueeɛ mantam mu, na ne maame, Araba Owomoye Owusu-Ankomah, nso firi Dixcove a ɛwɔ atɔeɛ mantam mu.

Nwomasua 
Owusu-Ankomah hyɛɛ ne nwomasua ase firi primary wɔ Takoradi, ɔfirii hɔ na ɔkɔɔ Mfantsipim ntoasoɔ sukuu. Wɔ Mfantsipim ntoasoɔ sukuu mu na ɔnyaa ne West African Examination Council's Advanced Level nsɔhwɛ ababɔdin krataa maa no de toa so kɔɔ suapɔn. 

Wɔ University of Ghana, Legon suapɔn mu no ɔsuaa mmara ho nsɛm. Ɔwieeɛ no na ɔkura LL.B (Hons) 2nd Class Upper Division wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduoson nkron (1979) mu na ɔde toa so kɔɔ Ghana School of Law, a owiee ne nwomasua wɔ mmara mu wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe baako (1981). Wɔgyee no tum sɛ mmaranimni sa afe no ara.

Adwuma 
Owusu-Ankomah yɛ mmaranimni. Odii dwuma sɛ Aban lawya (Attorney General) maa Ghana firi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne mmiɛnsa (2003) mu de kɔsi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne num (2005) mu. Ansana ɔrebɛwura amanyɔnsɛm mu no, na ɔka wɔn a wɔhwɛ practice of Owusu-Ankomah, Amanquah ne deɛ ɛkeka ho.

Amanyɔkuo ho dwumadie 
Na Owusu-Ankomah ka nnipakuo a wɔtee Atɔeɛ mantam Ɔsono amanyɔkuo (NPP) fam deɛ no, odii dwuma sɛ kuo no panini, na ɔsane nso ka wɔn a wɔtee Danquah-Busia kuo ne ekuoba ma atɔeɛ mantam dawurubɔ kuo ho wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron mmienu (1992) ne afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia (1996) mu. Na ɔka Publicity kuo na ɛhwɛ NPP mfeɛ mpem mmienu (2000) abatoɔ no nnwuma so, na firi Ahinime bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne baako (2001) de kɔsi Ɔbɛnem bosome mu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne mmiɛnsa (2003) mu no na ɔyɛ panini wɔ kasa nkitahodie kuo mu. 

Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia (1996) Ghanaman nyinaa abatoɔ mu no, Owusu- Ankomah nyaa mma mpem aduonu nwɔtwe, ahanwɔtwe ne mmienu (28,802) firi mma dodoɔ mpem aduanan nan, ahanum ne nson (44,507) mu a egyina hɔ m ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduonum mmiɛnsa ne akyirepɔ aduowɔtwe (53.80%) de dii nkunim wɔ n'akansifoɔ Albert Bosomtwi-Sam a na ɔyɛ kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo (NDC) no mu nnipa a Ɔnyaa mma mpem dunan, ahankron ne aduokron (14,990) ne Anthony Ackah a ɔno nso yɛ PNC amanyɔkuo no mu nnipa a ɔnyaa mma ahanson ne dunum (715).  

Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu (2000) mu no, ɔnyaa mma mpem aduonu nwɔtwe, ahanan ne aduasa nan (28,434) a na egyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduosia nson ne akyirepɔ aduosia (67.60%) de dii nkunim wɔ berɛ a n'akansifoɔ Anthony Richard Cudjoe a ɔyɛ NDC kuoba no nyaa mma apem ɔha ne baako, ahansia ne aduosia baako (11,661) a egyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduonu nson ne akyirepɔ aduoson (27.70%), Charles Van Dyck, CPP kuo mu nnipa no nso nyaa mma apem, ahanu ne aduonu mmiɛnsa (1,223) a egyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu mmienu ne akyirepɔ aduokron (2.90%) ne Abu Seidu PNCni no nso nyaa mma ahanson ne aduonum nkron a egyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu baako ne akyirepɔ aduowɔtwe (1.80%).  

Ɔde mma 17, 433 dii nkunim wɔ Ghana abatoɔ wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan (2004) mu. Wɔ mma dodoɔ no nyinaa 26,307 no ɔnyaa ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduosia nsia ne akyirepɔ aduasa (66.30%) a n'akansifoɔ Betty Busumtwi-Dam NDC kuo no mu nnipa nyaa mma 8,086, Omar Ahmed Bekure PNC kuoni no nso nyaa mma 444 na Joe Victor Eghan CPP kuoni no nso nyaa mma 344.  

Odii nkunim bio wɔ 2008 abatoɔ mu  onyaa ma 13,005  a egyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduonum num ne akyirepɔ aduanan baako (55.41%) wɔ mma dodoɔ no nyinaa mu. N'akansifoɔ  Betty Busumtwi-Sam nyaa mma 9,578, Mrs Hildergard Krakue nso nyaa mma  727,  Frederick Akor Larbi nso nyaa mma 88 ne Oliver Peter Vanderpuye-Orgle a ɔno nso nyaa mma 72.

Mmarahyɛbadwam dwumadie 
Berɛ a Ɔsono Amanyɔkuo (NPP) dii nkunim wɔ Ghana abatoɔ mu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu (2000) mu no wɔyii Owusu-Ankomah sɛ mmarahyɛbadwam nnipa dodoɔ kuo baanodani abɛdiakyire na akyire no wɔtoo aba yii no sɛ ekuo no baanodani wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam. 

Berɛ a na ɔwɔ mmarahyɛbadwam no, odii dwuma wɔ ekuo ahodoɔ bebree mu, ebi ne: the Standing Committee on Subsidiary Legislation, the Select Committee on Foreign Affairs, Finance Committee ne  the Committee on Constitutional, Legal and Parliamentary Affairs.

Ɔne Aban nkitahodie 
Wɔ mpanimfoɔ kuo bi mu wɔ aban mu no,Owusu-Ankomah adi adwumayɛfoɔ bi anim wɔ Asoeɛ a ɛhwɛ pɛpɛɛpɛyɛ, mmaabunu ne agorɔdie ho nsɛm so,  mmarahyɛbadwam ho nsɛm, nwomasua, Science ne agorɔ asoeɛ, asoeɛ ɛhwɛ adwadie ho nsɛm so, mfidie nnwuma, ne Private Sector Development and Presidential Special Initiatives so. Wɔ ne dwumadie mu sɛ mansoafoɔ ma nnwomasua, science ne agorɔ mu no, Ghana Black Stars nyaa wɔn abakwasɛm a yɛfrɛ no run to the round of sixteen wɔ brofo kasa mu wɔ world cup mu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nsia mu (2006). Ɔno ara nso na ɔboa maa wɔsane hyehyɛɛ  Ghana mmofrase sukuu no bio.

N'abrabɔ 
Owusu-Ankomah yere ne Augustine Owusu-Ankomah. Wɔwɔ mma mmiɛnsa.

title: Black Sherif
text:
Mohammed Ismail Sherif Kwaku Frimpong (wɔwoo no 9 Ɔbɛnem 2002) a yɛnim no sɛ Black Sherif yɛ Ghana ndwomtoni a ofri Konongo, Ghana. Mfitiaseɛ no ɔnyaa din wɔ afe 2021 mu denam ne dwom "First Sermon" a ɔyii no adi wɔ May mu no so. Wɔde "Second Sermon" dii eyi akyi wɔ July mu.

Ne nkɔsoɔ baeɛ wɔ Oforisuo afe 2022 mu denam ne nnwom a ɛyɛ dɛ "Kwaku the Traveller" a ɛkɔɔ nɔma 1 wɔ Ghana ne Nigeria Apple Music charts mu.Afei oyii ne album a edi kan, "The Villain I Never Was", adi wɔ Ɔberɛfɛw da 5, afe 2022.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Black Sherif na wɔtetee no wɔ Konongo-Zongo, wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Bere a n’awofo baanu no nyinaa traa amannɔne no, Black Sherif ne ne maame nuabea ne n’abusua kɛse mufo afoforo trae bere a na wadi mfe 10 no. N’asetra a ɔde tu kwan no maa ohuu nkɛntɛnso ahorow pii ne amammerɛ ahorow wɔ ne mmofraase pɛɛ.

Ɔkɔɔ ne mfitiaseɛ nwomasua wɔ Konongo Zongo Islamic Basic School na akyiri yi ɔkɔɔ Pinamang Educational Complex, faako a ɔwiee ntoaso sukuu ketewa (J.H.S). Afei akyiri yi owiee ne ntoaso sukuu wɔ Kumasi Academy, faako a n’ani gyee nnwom ne asaw ho.

Ɔyɛ sukuuni wɔ University of Professional Studies (UPSA) na seesei ɔresua ade wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu ne ntoaso sukuu wɔ Kumasi Academy, baabi a ɔpaw.

N'adwuma 
Black Sherif hyɛɛ n'adwuma ase wɔ afe 2019 mu denam ne dwom "Cry for Me" a ɔyii no adi wɔ YouTube so. Ne nnwom a edi kan "Money" no, woyii no adi wɔ May 25, 2020, ne nnwom video. Wɔ May 2021 mu no, wɔyii ne nnwom "First Sermon" adi, na ɛmaa n'atiefoɔ kɔɔ soro bio. Dwom no a ɛtoa so, "Second Sermon," no, woyii no adi wɔ July mu na wɔne ne yɔnko Afrikani mfoniniyɛfo Burna Boy nyaa remix.

Ne nkɔsoɔ baeɛ wɔ Oforisuo afe 2022 mu denam ne dwom "Kwaku the Traveller" a ɛduruu 1 wɔ Ghana ne Nigeria Apple Music charts mu na ɛbɛyɛɛ ne dwom a agye din paa. Ɔyii ne album a ɛdi kan, The Villain I Never Was, adi wɔ October mu, a nnwom a ɛyɛ single "45" ne "Soja" na ɛboaa no.

Black Sherif yɛɛ nnwom wɔ Music of Black Origin (MOBO) Awards mfeɛ aduonu nnum a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ OVO Arena wɔ Wembley, UK no ase.Wɔ December 2022, Black Sherif yɛɛ ne kɔnsɛt a edi kan, "Mozama Disco Concert" wɔ Accra.

Wɔ 20 Ɔpɛpɔn 2023 no, Black Sherif nyaa Hip Hop a ɛsen biara abasobɔde wɔ Soundcity MVP Awards, a wɔyɛɛ no ​​Eko Convention Center wɔ Lagos.

Adwinni ho nimdeɛ 
Black Sherif nnwom yɛ highlife, reggae, ne hip-hop a wɔde afrafra, titiriw UK drill. Ɔaka sɛ ne nnwom nkɛntɛnsoɔ ne rapfoɔ Kanye West, Travis Scott, Saint Jhn, Dave, Stormzy, J Hus, ne Ghana adwumfo Mugeez ne Sarkodie.

Akyinnyegye ahorow 
Wɔ 11 April 2022 no, wɔde asɛm kɔdan Black Sherif sɛ wɔabu apam so bere a Sherif ne Empire Shadrach Agyei Owusu, Waynes Chavis Consult CEO no de ne nsa hyɛɛ apam ase no, na ɔrehwehwɛ sɛ asɛnnibea no nsiw Black Sherif kwan sɛ ɔnyɛ ne dwumadi wɔ nhyiam ahorow ase a onni tumi krataa. Nea eye ma Black Sherif ne sɛ, Accra Asɛnnibea Kunini (Commercial Division) buu ahyɛde a wɔde too gua a ɛhwehwɛ sɛ esiw odwontofo no kwan sɛ ɔbɛbɔ nnwom a oyii no adi wɔ ne mpanyimfo dedaw no ase no gui.

title: Joseph Ghansah
text:
Joseph Ghansah yɛ Ghanani amanyɔni a ɔsanso yɛ mmerahyɛbadwani  wɔ Ghana mmerahyɛbadwafie a ɛtoso mmienu wɔ Adehyeman Ghana amanmuo a ɛtoso nan a ɔgyinaa hu maa Tarkwa Nsuaem abatoɔ mpɛsuaso a ɛwɔ Atɔeɛ Mantanm a ɛwɔ Ɔman Ghana mu.

Abrabɔ Ahyeaseɛ 
Yɛ woo Ghansah wɔ Tarkwa-Nsuaem a ɛwɔ  Ghana Atɔeɛ Mantanm.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ghansah  mmerɛ a ɛdinkae a yɛ too aba maa no kɔɔ mmerahyɛbadwam no, ɔkɔɔeɛ wɔ People's Convention Party tumi krataa so de maa Tarkwa-Nsuaem abatoɔ mpɛsuaso a ɛwɔ Atɔeɛ Mantanm a ɛwɔ Ɔman Ghana mu wɔ ɛmmerɛ a Ɔman Ghanafoɔ nyinaa abatoɔ a wɔn kɔ tooeɛ wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa bosome no mu wɔ afe apam ahankron ne aduokron nsia  (1996 Ghanaian general elections). Ɔgyinaeɛ wɔ abatoɔ akansie no mu na ɔde mma no mu mpem aduonu nan ahanson ne du nwɔtwe( 24,718) wɔ aba a yɛ tooeɛ no nyinaa mu no dii nkunim wɔ Owura John Aidoo  a na ɔgyina maa National Convention Party (NCP) amanyɔkuo) a ɔno nso nyaa mma no mu apem, ahansia ne aduonu mmienu (1,622 ), Mr. Joe Arthur a ɔno nso firi National Democratic Congress  (NDC) amanyɔkuo no mu no nso nyaa mma no mu mpem dunum ne du mmienu (15,012) ɛne Rose Esi Amoah a ɔno nso firii New Patriotic Party(NPP) amanyɔkuo.Wɔ mmerɛ a ɔbɔɔ ne ho mmoɔden sɛ anka ɔbɛtumi akɔ mmerahyɛbadwafie ne mprɛnuu soɔ, ɔdii nkuguo maa  Gifty Eugenia Kwofie a ɔfiri  New Patriotic Party(NPP)  amanyɔkuo no mu no dii ne so nkunim wɔ mfei mpem mmienu abatoɔ no a Ɔman Ghana nyinaa kɔ tooeɛ no mu.( 2000 Ghanaian general elections).Ɔbɛ yɛɛ amanmusini demaa Owura Mathew Kojo Kum a ɔfiri  National Democratic Congress(NDC).amanyɔkuo dwumadibea na ɔyɛɛ ɔsomeɛ sɛ mmerahyɛbadwani  mprɛ baako pɛ.

title: James Edusei Sarkodie
text:
James Edusei Sarkodie yɛ Ghanani amanyɔni a ɔsom sɛ mmarahyɛbadwanni de ma Atwima Nwabiagya mpasua firii afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nson de kɔsii mfe mpem mmienu ne num (1997 - 2005).

Abrabɔ ahyɛse ne ne nnwomasua 
Wɔwoo Edusei wɔ Atwima a ɛwɔ Asante mantam wɔ Ghana.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Abatoɔ a adikan a Edusei de kɔɔ mmarahyɛbadwam yɛ Ɔpɛnimma bosome no mu wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia (1996) wɔ Ghanaman nyinaa abatoɔ a na ogyina mu ma ɔsono amanyɔkuo (NPP) New Patriotic Party no a ɛwɔ Atwima Mponua mpasua so a ɛwɔ Asante mantam wɔ Ghana. Ɔnyaa mma mpem aduasa baako ne aduowɔtwe nwɔtwe (31,088) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduosia baako ne akyiri pɔ aduokron (61.90%). Wɔ mfei mpem mmienu Ghanaman nyinaa abatoɔ no, ɔnyaa mma mpem aduasa nwɔtwe, ahankron me aduonum nkron (38,959) de  firii mma dodoɔ a na ɛyɛ mpem aduanan mmiɛnsa, ɔha ne aduonum mmiɛnsa (48,153) a na agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu  aduowɔtwe ne akyiri pɔ aduokron (80.90%). Benito Owusu Bio tuu no adeɛ so wɔ mfei mpem mmienu ne nan  (2004) mmarahyɛbadwam abatoɔ no mu.

Abatoɔ

Wɔ mfei mpem mmienu (2000) no, Sarkodie dii nkonim wɔ Ghanaman nyinaa abatoɔ no mu sɛ mmarahyɛbadwanni de ma Atwima Mponua mpasua a ɛwɔ Asante mantam wɔ Ghana. Odii nkonim ma ɔsono amanyɔkuo (NPP)New Patriotic Party no. Ɔsono amanyɔkuo (NPP) no Mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ aduasa mmiɛnsa (33) a wɔdii nkonim wɔ Asante mantam abatoɔ no a na wɔn wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam no, na ne mpasua no nso ka ɛmu aduasa baako (31) no ho bi. Ɔsono amanyɔkuo (NPP) New Patriotic Party no dii nkonim sɛ dɔmkeseɛ a na wɔn wɔ mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ ɔha (100) a na mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ dodoɔ nyinaa nso yɛ ahanu (200). Abatoɔ a ɛkɔɔ so no, ɔnyaa mma mpem aduasa nwɔtwe, ahankron ne aduonum nkron (48,959) firii mma dodoɔ mpem aduanan nwɔtwe, ahankron ne aduanan nson a won gye too mu (48,947). Wei gyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduowɔtwe ne akyiri pɔ nkron (80.9%). Odii Baffour Osei Wusu a na ɔyɛ frankatuni de ma kyinie amanyɔkuo  (NDC) New Democratic Congress no so nkunim san nso dii Alex Addo Kuffour a na ɔyɛ frankatuni ma People's National Convention(PNC) amanyɔkuo no so nkunim, Yaw Boateng a na ɔno nso yɛ fankatuni de ma National Reformed Party(NRP) no ne D.D   Boateng a na ɔyɛ frankatuni ma Convention People's Party(CPP) amanyɔkuo no nyinaa so nkunim. Mma a wɔnyaa no wɔ abatoɔ no mu yɛ mpem nson , ahanwɔtwe ne aduowɔtwe (7,880), ahansia ne aduowɔtwe mmiɛnsa (683), ahasa ne aduasa nsia (336) ne ahanu ne aduokron num (295). Wei gyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu dunsia ne akyiri pɔ nan ((16.4%), ɔha nkyekyɛmu baako ne akyiri pɔ nan (1.4%), ɔha nkyekyɛmu ohunu anaa hwee ne akyiri pɔ nson (0.7%) ne ɔha nkyekyɛmu ohunu anaa hwee ne akyiri pɔ nsia (0.6%).

N'adwuma 
Na Edusei yɛ mmarahyɛbadwanni firii mfei mpem mmienu ne baako (2001) de ma Atwima Mponua mpasua no so foɔ.

title: George Mpambi Dagmanyi
text:
George Mpambi Dagmanyi yɛ Ghana amanyɔni. Na ɔka Ghana mmarahyɛbadwam a ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ 4th Republic mu. Na ogyina hɔ ma Bimbilla abatow mpesua a na ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Mantam.

Ne mmofraberem 
Wɔwoo Dagmanyi wɔ Bimbilla  a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Mantam.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Yɛtoo aba maa Dagmanyi kɔɔ mmarahyɛbadwam wɔ People's National Convention(PNC) din mu. Ɔno pɛ na yɛtoo aba maa no wɔ PNC din mu wɔ saa abatow no mu Wɔpaw no de ma Bimbilla abatoɔ mpesua wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa 1996 Ghana abatoɔ mu. Onyaa 13796 mma efi 31169 mma a wɔtoo nyinaa mu; eyi gyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛm aduasa mmienu (32.1%). Wɔn a wɔne no gyinaa wɔ saa abatow no mu ne Aliu Aduna Mahama, Mohammed Ibn Chambas ne Justice K. Grundow. Wonyaa mma 9467 egyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛm aduonu mmienu (22.1%), mma 7488 egyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛm dunsɔn (17.4%), mma 418  egyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛm biako (1.0%). Wɔgyinaa wɔ Convention People's Party(CPP), National Democratic Congress(NDC) ne National Congress Party(NCP).

Mohammed Ibn Chambas tuu no wɔ 2000 Ghana abatoɔ mu.

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Dagmanyi yɛ Kristoni.

title: Innocent Mahamadu Yahaya
text:
Innocent Mahamadu Yahaya yɛ Ghana amanyɔni. Na ɔka Ghana mmarahyɛbadwam a ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ 4th Republic mu. Na ogyina hɔ ma Chereponi abatow mpesua a na ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Mantam.

Ne mmofraberem 
Wɔwoo Yahaya Oforisuo da a ɛtɔ so dunsɔn afe 1954 mu wɔ Chereponi a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Mantam. Ɔkɔɔ sukuu wɔ Academy of Social Sciences. Ɛhɔ na onyaa abodin krataa wɔ Political Economy mu. Ɔsan nyaa abodin krataa wɔ adekyerɛ mu fi Gbewaah Training College.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔtoo aba maa Yahaya kɔɔ mmarahyɛbadwam wɔ National Democratic Congress(NDC) din mu. Wɔpaw no de ma Chereponi abatow mpesua wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa 1996 Ghana abatoɔ mu. Onyaa 9092 mma efi 17158 mma a wɔtoo nyinaa mu; eyi gyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛm aduasa akron (39.6%). Wɔn a wɔne no gyinaa wɔ saa abatow no mu ne Jakpa Samson Mariba, Bawa Ali Manshi ne Tabi Anthony Bondo Yaw. Wonyaa mma 3825, mma 2794 ne mma 1510.

Wotuu no wɔ 2000 National Democratic Congress(NDC) amanyɔkuw abatow no mu. Wotuu no de Mohammed Seidu Abah sii n'ananmu wɔ 200 Ghana abatow no mu.

title: Susana Adam
text:
Susana Adam yɛ Gaana ni. Ɔyɛɛ mmrahyɛbɛdwamni maa Mamprusi Atɔe mpesua so fri afe 1997-2001.

Adam kɔɔ mmrahyɛbɛdwa fie wɔ National Democratic Congress (NDC) din mu. Wc afe 1996, mmrahyɛbɛdwa abatoɔ nu, ɔdii nkunim. Adam nyaa mma 23,021 a ɛyɛ 63% wɔ abatoɔ no mu.

Afe 2000 mmrahyɛbɛdwa abatoɔ, Adam nyaa mma 12,735 a ɛyɛ 37.3% na Issifu Asumah a ogyina hɔ maa People's National Convention (PNC) nyaa 18, 907 a ɛyɛ 55.4%. Adam dii nkuguo wɔ saa abatoɔ no mu.

Afe 2004, w'antumi agyina hɔ ma National Democratic Congress, Alidu Iddrisu Zakari dii nkunim wɔ mmrahyɛbɛdwa primaries no mu maa amanyɔ kuo no.

title: Ibrahim Adam
text:
Ibrahim Adam yɛ Ghana amanyɔni. Na ɔka Ghana mmarahyɛbadwam a ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ 4th Republic mu. Na ogyina hɔ ma Choggo/Tishigu abatow mpesua a na ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Mantam.

Ne mmofraberem ne ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Adam Kɔtɔnimaa da a edi kan 1956 wɔ Ghana. Ɔkura abodin krataa, Bachelor of Science(BSc.) wɔ Agriculture mu. Ɔyɛ Animal Scientist.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Yɛtoo aba maa Adam kɔɔ mmarahyɛbadwam wɔ National Democratic Congress(NDC) din mu. Wɔpaw no de ma Choggo/Tishigu abatoɔ mpesua wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa 1996 Ghana abatoɔ mu. Onyaa 22,368 mma efi 32725 mma a wɔtoo nyinaa mu; eyi gyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛm aduasa biako(31.30%). Wɔn a wɔne no gyinaa wɔ saa abatow no mu ne Mohammed A. Sadique, Abubakr Al-Hassan. Faiz Aouni Moutrage, Iddrisu Hudu , Al-Hassan Wayo Seini ne Abdul-Samed Muhtar. Wonyaa mma 20,801  egyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛm aduonu mmienu (29.10%), mma 5,020 egyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛm nsɔn (7.00%), mma 1,744  egyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛm mmienu (2.40%), 1,738 egyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛm mmienu (2.40%), 1,394 egyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛm mmienu (2.00%) ne 461 egyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛm 0.60% . Wɔgyinaa wɔ Convention People's Party(CPP), National Congress Party(NCP), Independent candidate, People's National Convention (PNC), New Patriotic Party (NPP)  ne National Congress Party(NCP).

Wotuu nowɔ 2000 Ghana Mpesua Abatow no mu. Wɔpaw Alhaji Abubakari sii n'ananmu.

title: Mary Salifu Boforo
text:
Mary Salifu Boforo (wɔ woo no 25 Ogyefoɔ 1951) yɛ Gaanani. Ɔsan yɛ ɛnkane Gaana mmrahyɛbɛdwani ma Savelugu mpesua a ɛwɔ Atifi mantamu. Ɔtenaa mmrahyɛbɛdwa fie firi afe 1996 kɔ pem afe 2017. Na ɔsan yɛ mmrahyɛbɛdwam nipa maa National Democratic Congress (NDC). Wɔ afe 2016 abatoɔ mu ɔdii nkuguo fri hɔ na w'ankɔ mmrahyɛbɛdwafie bio.

Abrabɔ ahyaseɛ ne sukuu 
Wɔ woo Boforo wɔ Savelugu, afe 1951 wɔ Ogyefo bosome mu da ɛtɔso 25. Ɔkɔɔ nsaanodwuma sukuu wɔ National Vocational Training Institute afe 1972. Boforo yɛɛ Kuadwuma na ɔsan wɔ Abodootobea ne Sikakrabea adwuma ansana ɔbɛyɛ mmrahyɛbɛdwani.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Afiri afe 1996 na Boforo yɛ mmrahyɛbɛdwani maa Savelugu abatoɔ mpesua so. Afe 2014, odii nkan bɛ yɛɛ First Deputy Majority Chief Whip wɔ mmrahyɛbɛdwa fie. Boforo yɛ nipa nia w'atena mmrahyɛbɛdwa fie akyeɛ yie. Afe 2016, ɔdii nkuguo na Alhassan Abdulai Red gyina hɔ maa National Democratic Congress (NDC). Boforo bɔ dawuro ma mma ne nkwaadaa mfaahodie. Ɔsan yɛɛ dawurobɔ panyin ne Oguamtrani ma Ghana Developing Communities Association. Ɔyɛ  nipa bia wɔ kai no wɔ mmrahyɛbɛdwafie esan n'amaneɛbɔ wɔ mmrahyɛbɛdwafie, ɔkaa sɛɛ: " The fight for equality between men and women goes beyond the case made for social justice but rather a fundamental human right that must be achieved." Ase kyerɛ ne sɛɛ pɛpɛɛpɛyɔ ko a ɛda mmarima ne mmaa ntam no kyɛn aseteram atɛntrenee nanso nipa ho mfaahodie na ahia. Boforo bɔ dawuro ma mmaa wɔ bɔ dwuma den wɔ Afrika Atɔeɛ. Ɔsan dii adansieɛ sɛɛ dwuma a w'adi wɔ Savelugu kyerɛ sɛ mmaa bɛ tumi aboa wɔn nkuro.

1996 Abatoɔ Boforo nyaa mma 14,971 a ɛyɛ 50.90% na Alhassan Abudulai Abubakari a ogyina hɔ ma amanyɔkuo New Patriotic Party (NPP) nyaa mma 5,585 a ɛyɛ 19.00% na  Bawa Muhammed Baba ogyina hɔ ma amannyɔkuo Convention People's Party (CPP) nyaa mma 2,108 a ɛyɛ 7.20%. Ɛnam saa abatoɔ yi so na Boforo di nkan kɔɔ mmrahyɛbɛdwafie.

Abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Boforo yɛ ɔwarefo ɔsan wɔ nkwaada nnan. Ɔyɛ Kramoni.

title: Joseph E.K. Abekah
text:
Joseph E.K Abekah yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɔni a na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbedwani ma Effia-Kwesimintsim mpɛsoa wɔ mmrahyɛbedwafie a ɛtɔso mmienu wɔ Ghana adehyeman amanmuo a ɛtɔso nan.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ɔyii Abekah sɛ mmrahyɛbedwani ma Effia-Kwesimintsim wɔ afe apem wɔha nkron ne aduokron nsia(1996) wɔ Ghana abatoɔ kɛseɛ no ma People's Convention amanyɔkuo. Ɔyii James Mike Abban a ɔka amanyɔkuo a wɔfrɛ no National Convention Party firii hɔ, Mahama nso anya aba no maa Joe Baidoo Ansah a ɔwɔ NPP amanyɔkuo no faeɛ wɔ abatoɔ a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne mmiɛnsa(2003).

Abatoɔ 
Ɔde mma mpem mmiɛnsa ne nan ɔha nkron ne aduonum nnwɔtwe(34,958) firi mma mpem num ne nsia ɔha nson ne baako(56,701) wɔ Ghanafoɔ dodoɔ a ɛkɔ too aba no wei gyina hɔ ma ɔha mu abupɛn aduosia baako ne akyiri pɔ nsia num(61.65%). Ɔnyaa abatoɔ no firii Ebenezer Kofi Quansah a ɔgyina mu maa NPP amanyɔkuo ɔnyaa mma no mu ɔha abupɛn hwee(0%) ,Abdular Mohammed Seidu ma NDC amanyɔkuo ɔnyaa mma no mu ɔha abupɛn aduasa n'akyiri pɔ aduonu num(30.25%)  ne S A.B Ackah a ɔwɔ PNC amanyɔkuo no ɔnyaa mma no ɔha mu abupɛn nnwɔtwe n'akyiri pɔ baako(8.1%).

title: Samuel Nkrumah Gyimah
text:
Samuel Nkrumah Gyimah yɛ ɔmanyɔni sane yɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛni. Ɔsom sɛ mmrahyɛbedwani ma Odotobri mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Asante mantam wɔ mmrahyɛbedafie a ɛtɔso mmienu ne mmiɛnsa wɔ Ghana adehyeman amanmuo a ɛtɔso nan.

Abrabɔ ne nnwomasua 
Ɔwoo Nkrumah Gyimah wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduonum ne mmienu(1952). Ɔhyɛɛ sukuu ase wɔ Jakobu beaeɛ ɔwoo no, ɔkɔɔ ntoasoɔ sukuu wɔ Boa Amponsem na ɔkɔɔ suapɔn sukuu nso wɔ University of Ghana. Samuel Nkrumah ɛwu n'ayiyɔ wɔ Ɔbubuo bosome ne da ɛtɔso nson wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu wɔ Jakobu a ɛwɔ Amansie mfinifini mansini a ɛwɔ Asante mantam.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Samuel Nkrumah Gyimah yɛ mmrahyɛbedwani a na ɔka mmrahyɛbedwafie a ɛtɔso mmiɛnsa wɔ Ghana adehyeman amanmuo a ɛtɔso nan wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu Ghana abatoɔ kɛseɛ no mu. Ɔgyina mu maa NPP amanyɔkuo wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduokron nsia(1996) nanso ɔdii nkukuo wɔ afe mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan mu de ma Emmanuel Akwasi Gyamfi a ɔno nso wɔ NPP amanyɔkuo no mu. Wɔ Nkrumah Gyimah pɛn so no ɔde adesrɛdeɛ too aban n'anim sɛ ɔnyɛ akwan a aseɛseɛ mma nkurasienkurasie.

Abatoɔ 
NPP amanyɔkuo no n'adikan de ne baa mmrahyɛbedwafie wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduokron nsia(1996) Ghana abatoɔ kɛseɛ no ma Odotobri mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Asante mantam. Ɔnyaa mma mpem du nson ɔha num ne aduosia nan(17,564) firii mma mpem aduonu num ɔha ne aduosia num(25,065) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu abupɛn aduonum nnwɔtwe n'akyiri pɔ aduasa(58.30%) de tia George Adu Mensah a ɔwɔ NDC amanyɔkuo no, ɔnyaa mma mpem nson ɔha num ne nson(7,507) ne Veronica Rita Akosuah Nsafoah a ɔfri IDN amanyɔkuo ɔno nso nyaa mma hwee(0). Ɔyii Gyimah sɛ mmrahyɛbedwani ma Odotobri mpɛsoa wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu(2000) wɔ Ghana abatoɔ kɛseɛ no. Ɔnyaa no maa NPP amanyɔkuo no. Na ne mpɛsoa ka nkonnwa aduasa baako firi aduasa mmiɛnsa a NPP amanyɔkuo nyaa no wɔ Asante mantam ha. Ne nyinaa mu no NPP amanyɔuo no nyaa mmrahyɛbedwafoɔ ɔha(100) firii ahanu(200) mu. Ɔde mma mpem du nnwɔtwe ahasa ne aduokron num(18,395) wɔ nnipa dodoɔ a ɔtoo aba no. Wei gyina hɔ ma ɔha mu abupɛn aduowɔtwe(80%). Ɔdii nkunim wɔ John A.Frimpong a ɔwɔ NDC amanyɔkuo ɔnyaa mma mpem mmiɛnsa ɔha num ne aduoson nkron(3,579) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu abupɛn du num n'akyire pɔ nsia(15.6%), Francis A.A Mintah a ɔwɔ CPP amanyɔkuo ɔnyaa mma ɔha nsia ne aduosia nnwɔtwe(668) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu abupɛn mmienu n'akyire pɔ nkron(2.9%) ne Isaac a ɔwɔ People's National Convention a ɔno nso nyaa mma aha ne aduonum nson(357) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu abupɛn baako n'akyire pɔ nsia(1.6%).

title: Adam Mahama
text:
Adam Mahama yɛ Ghana amanyɔni. Na ɔka Ghana mmarahyɛbadwam a ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ 4th Republic mu. Na ogyina hɔ ma Damongo/Daboya abatow mpesua a na ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Mantam.

Ne mmofraberem ne ne sukuukɔ 
Wɔwoo Mahama Obubuo 29, 1958 wɔ Daboya  a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Mantam. Wɔsan nim no sɛ Mahama Sakan. Ɔkɔɔ sukuu wɔ Navrongo Secondary School ne Tamale Secondary School. Wɔ University of Ghana no, onyaa abodin krataa wɔ Soil Science mu. Mahama wɔ Master's of Science degree wɔ Management and Implementation of Development Projects mu. Onyaa saa abodin krataa yi fii UMIST ne The Victoria University of Manchester.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Yɛtoo aba maa Mahamai kɔɔ mmarahyɛbadwam wɔ National Democratic Congress(NDC) din mu. Wɔpaw no de ma Damongo/Daboya abatow mpesua wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa 1996 Ghana abatow mu. Onyaa 8356 mma efi 17604 mma a wɔtoo nyinaa mu; eyi gyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛm aduanan nsɔn (47.47%). Wɔn a wɔne no gyinaa wɔ saa abatow no mu ne Alex Seidu Sofo, Abdulai Adams ne Skido Alhassan Ewuntomah. Wonyaa mma no mu ɔha mu nkyekyɛm aduanan mmienu(42.59%), nsɔn(7.9%) ne mmienu(2.04%). Wɔgyinaa wɔ People's Convention Party(PCP), People's National Convention(PNC) ne National Convention Party.

Alex Seidu Sofo tuu no wɔ 2000 Ghana abatow mu.

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Adam Mahama wɔ mma dumien. Ɔyɛ Kristoni.

title: Mustapha Ali Iddris
text:
Mustapha Ali Iddris yɛ Ghana amanyɔni. Na ɔka Ghana mmarahyɛbadwam a ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ 4th Republic mu. Na ogyina hɔ ma Gukpegu-Sagonida abatow mpesua a na ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Mantam.

Ne mmofraberem 
Wɔwoo Iddris 28 Oforisuo 1955 wɔ Gukpegu-Sagonidaa ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Mantam.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Yɛtoo aba maa Gukpegu-Sagonidaa kɔɔ mmarahyɛbadwam wɔ New Patriotic Party(NPP) din mu. Wɔpaw no de ma Gukpegu-Sagonidaa abatoɔ mpesua wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa 1996 Ghana abatoɔ mu. Onyaa mma no mu ɔha mu nkyekyɛm aduanan mmienu (42.4%) efi 31964 mma a wɔtoo nyinaa mu. Wɔn a wɔne no gyinaa wɔ saa abatow no mu ne .Iddrisu H. Ayub ne Basit Aboulai Fuseini.  Wonyaa mma no mu ɔha mu nkyekyɛm 0.80% ne 32%. Wɔgyinaa wɔ Convention People's Party(CPP) ne National Democratic Congress(NDC) Ná Iddris yɛ Atifi Mantam suafo na ɔsan nso yɛ Minister for Works and Housing.

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Ná  Iddris wɔ ɔyere ne mma mmienu. Ná ɔyɛ nkramoni.

Ne wu 
Mustapha Ali Iddris fii mu 2 Ayɛwohomumɔ 2013 wɔ 37 Millitary Hospital. Wosiee no wɔ Tamale Cemetary.

title: Gladys Asmah
text:
Gladys Asmah (16 Ahinime 1939 – 24 Ayɛwohumumɔ 2014)yɛ   Amayɔni wɔ  na wasan anya abua nadwuma. Ɔno na kane na ɔda asoeɛ a ɛhwɛ mpataa a ɛwɔ nsuo mu na ɔsane yɛ mmrahyɛbadwani de ma Takorade mpesua so. Ɔsane da Asoeɛ a ɛhwɛ mama nsɛmsoɔ berɛ a na Ɔmanpanin Kufuor yɛ Ɔmanpanin.

Abrabɔ ahyeaseɛ ne sukuu 
Mrs. Gladys Asmah (ɔwo no wɔ afe ahankron no aduosia ne nkron wɔ Ahinime bosome, wɔ Cape Coast, a ɛwɔ Mfinifim Mantam no .Ɔkɔ Wesley  maa  Sukuu sɛ ne ahyɛ aseɛ ne mfimfim Sukuu na Ɔtoa so wɔ  Ghana National College a no nyinaa wɔ Cape Coast.

Ɔni wɔn a ɔhwɛ keteke akwanhwɛfoɔ a ɛwɔ Ghana yɛ adwuma kakra na ɔsane yɛ hwɛso no de ma asoeɛ a ɔyɛ nhwehwɛ mu wɔ nnoɔma mu hu sɛ ɛyɛ papa wɔ beaɛ a ɔyɛ Tobinco  mfeɛ mmiensa.

Mrs. Asmah firi Ghana wɔ afe mpem  ahankron ne aduo nsia ne mmiensa wɔ Ayɛwohommumɔ sɛ ɔkɔtoɔ no adesua so wɔ abrokyi man mu. Ɔkɔ Middlesex Suapɔn nea doɔdoɔ nono nim Hendon College na ɔdin Leeds College of Education Home Economics na  ɔka nkorɔfoɔ a wɔn din no de Institutional Management Association a ɛwɔ London

Ne nnwumasem 
Ɔni  British Council yɛ adwuma sɛ hwɛ so nu abadea akyi wɔ Overseas' Students Centre, Portland Palace, London, abra na ɔyɛ suani wɔn aborokyire ɔyɛ no adwene sɛ, ɔbɛsua sɛnea  apam adeɛ nti ɔdi ne bɔ adwumakuo a ɔpam adeɛe. Mrs. Asmah boa boa adepam afidie na ɔhyɛ aseɛ sɛ ɔpam ntadeɛ yɛ hyɛ no ammumerɛ ne atadeɛ na yɛhyɛ gun atadɛɛ so wɔ Birmingham.

Afie dea ɔbɛtena Ghana , na ɔdi ne adwuma no kɔ nkrataa nsem so wɔ afe ahankron ne aduoson  num.Ɔyɛ no a adwuma na sɛ beaɛ ɛbɛ boa mma ama wɔ atumi anya  berebeMr Asmah boa mame foɔ a ɔwɔ Tarkwa wɔ  adwuma kwan si sɛ nea wɔn bɛ nya sika na ɔboa wɔn ma wɔn nya nimdeɛ a ɔbɛtumi de ayɛ  abɛ ngɔ. Ɛberɛ si sɛ wɔn a ɔhwɛ nipa yie yɛ mu nsem soɔ no baeɛ wɔ Takoradi no na ɔyɛ no adwene sɛ ɔbɛ boa boa ɛmma ano na ɔdi wɔn afa nsano Nnwoma mu, na ɔdi ne adwuma bea no maa sɛ ɔmfa di wɔn dwuma no.

Na amanyɔsem 
Na ɔyɛ amanyɔkuo nu de ma New Patriotic Party. Ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbɛdwani de ma Takorade firii ɔpɛpɔn da a ɛtɔso nson wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduokron nson de kɔsii ɔpɛpɔn da ɛtɔ so nsia wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nkron mu Ɔbɛyɛ ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ mama ne mmɔfra nsɛmsoɔ wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne bakoo de kɔsii afe mpem mmienu ne num na ɛwɔ afe mpem mmienu ne num de kɔsii afe mpem mmienu ne nkron mu no na ɔyɛ ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ mpataa nsem so Asmah ka mmrahyɛbɛdwafie a ɛdi kan nea ɛtɔso mmienu, mmiensa,nan ne nie ɛtɔso num wɔ Republik a ɛtɔso nan no mu wɔ Ghana.

Ɛwɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia wɔ Ghana Abatoɔ no mu no Ɔnya mma ɔpepe aduonu num ne ahanum  aduoson nkron firii mma ɔpepe aduosa nnwɔtwe ne adusa nsia a na ɛgyina hɔ ma aduonu nsia akyerepɔ aduowɔtwe sene nea Ɔni no si akan Esther Nkansah  NDC ni a Ɔnya mma ɔpepe du ne ahasa ne aduonan mmienu, Alex Fosu Blankson a ɔnya mma ɔpepe baako ahasa ne aduonu mmiensa ne   Timothy Norbert Kublenu a ɔnya mma ahason aduokron ne mmienu .

Ɔnya mma ɔpepe aduonu nsia ne aha nan aduosa baako a na ɛgyina hɔ aduoson mmiensa akyerepɔ aduonum wɔ ɔha nkyekyemu sene wɔ a Ɔni wɔn sii akan Crosby  Mochi ɔka  NDC amanyɔkuo ni Eustace Haizel   CPP amanyɔkuo ni, Elizabeth Comfort Baido  NRP amanyɔkuo ni  and Samuel Ekow Renn PNC amanyɔkuo ni.

Owuo 
Gladys Asmah wui wɔ Ayɛwohummumɔ bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduonu-nnan wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du-nnan (2014), wɔ Nkran Korle-Bu Teaching Hospital. Wɔgyee ne too hɔ nnawɔtwe mmienu. Wɔsiee no wɔ Takoradi, ɛhɔ ara nso na ɔyɛɛ ayie no wɔ Obubuo bosome da edi kan wɔ mfeɛ mmienu ne du-nnun

title: Richard Dornu Nartey
text:
Richard Dornu Nartey (ɔwo no Oforisuo da ɛtɔso aduonu nsia wɔ afe ahankron ne aduonan nkron)yɛ Ghana Amayɔni na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbɛdwani ma mmrahybɛdwa a ɛdi kan ne nea ɛtɔso mmienu wɔ ɔma Ghana adwa ɛtɔso nan no mu .Ɔkɔ mmrahyɛbɛdwafie kɔgyina   Shama anannu ɛkuro a ɛwɔ atɔeɛ fa mu wɔ Ghana.

Na Abrabɔ Mfitiaseɛ 
Ɔwo Nartey wɔ afe ahankron ne aduonan nkron wɔ Shama wɔ Ghana.

Ɔsua adeɛ wo University of Ghana ne Ghana Institute of Management ne 1949 at Shama, Ghana.Ɛhɔ na ɔnya abodin nkrataa wɔ kasa Nimdeɛ mu na Ɔnya Diploma  abodin nkrataa wɔ  Nnwuma ntotoeɛ.

Na Amanyɔsem 
Ɔyi Nartey sɛ ɔnkɔ mmrahyɛbɛdwafie berɛ a ɔto  afe ahankron ne aduokron mmienu Abatoɔ no mu. Na ɔka wɔn a ɔkɔ mmrahyɛbɛdwafie ɛwɔ Ghana Repubrik a ɛtɔso nan wɔ Ghana. Shama mpɛsoa adwa no na Ernest Nii Tachie-Otoo  a ɔka Action amanyɔkuo wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduoson nkron no mu.Na ɔkɔ mmrahyɛbɛdwafie ɛwɔ National Democratic amayɔkuo no din nu.Ɛwɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduonan mmienu mu no amanyɔkuo atitire a ɔwɔ Ghana no  wura wura Abatoɔ no mu yɛɛ saa maa  nipa dodoɔ a ɔfiri National Democratic Congress amanyɔkuo nipa kuo dodoɔ nɔa na ɔkɔ mmrahyɛbɛdwafie. 

Ɛwɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia abatoɔ no mu nu ,ɔdi nkunim wɔ mma ɔpepe aduonu ahasonne aduonum nsiaa na ɛgyina hɔ ma aduosa nkron akyerepɔ aduoson firii mma dodoɔ a ɔto no mu.

Ɔwɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nson no mu no ɔfrɛ amanyɔfoɔ bi sɛ ɔmoa wɔ akwan a ɔman no bɛtu mpɔm .ɔde saa asem yɛ tɔ dea berɛ a na wɔn yɛ anodesɛm dwumadie a  

National Commission for Civic Education (NCCEa na wɔn ne asem a eda so ne " sɛnea yɛbɛ tumi de Kabima me nkabi ayɛ dwuma wɔ yɛ dada abrabɔ mu,  A ɛyɛ nsem a ɛkɔso wɔ sekondi.

Ne nnwuma 

Ɔka Mmrahyɛbɛdwafoɔ a na ɔtɔ so firi Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da ɛtɔso nson wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron mmiensa de kɔsii afe mpem mmienu ne bakoo wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da ɛtɔso nson no mu de maa Shama mpɛsoa na ɔsane yɛ asoeɛ abadiakyerɛ de ma asoeɛ a ɛhwɛ asase ne nnua ho nsem soɔ.

Nea ɛfa ne ho 
Ɔyɛ Owarefoɔ yɛ kristoni.

title: Lipkalimor Kwajo Tawiah
text:
Lipkalimor Kwajo Tawiah yɛ Ghana amanyɔni. Na ɔka Ghana mmarahyɛbadwam a ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ 4th Republic mu. Na ogyina hɔ ma Kpandai abatow mpesua a na ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Mantam.

Ne mmofraberem 
Wɔwoo Lipkalimor 9 Ɛbɔ 1960 wɔ Nanjuro-Saboba  a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Mantam. Ɔkɔɔ sukuu wɔ University of Education, Winneba ne Institute of Management and Public Administration wɔ afe 2008.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Yɛtoo aba maa Lipkalimor kɔɔ mmarahyɛbadwam wɔ People's National Convention(PNC) din mu. Ɔno pɛ na yɛtoo aba maa no wɔ PNC din mu wɔ saa abatow no mu Wɔpaw no de ma Bimbilla abatoɔ mpesua wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa 1996 Ghana abatoɔ mu. Onyaa 13796 mma efi 31169 mma a wɔtoo nyinaa mu; eyi gyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛm aduasa mmienu (32.1%). Wɔn a wɔne no gyinaa wɔ saa abatow no mu ne Aliu Aduna Mahama, Mohammed Ibn Chambas ne Justice K. Grundow. Wonyaa mma 9467 egyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛm aduonu mmienu (22.1%), mma 7488 egyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛm dunsɔn (17.4%), mma 418  egyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛm biako (1.0%). Wɔgyinaa wɔ Convention People's Party(CPP), National Democratic Congress(NDC) ne National Congress Party(NCP).

Lipkalimor yɛ Kristoni.

title: Comfort Owusu
text:
Comfort Owusu yɛ obi a yɛwoo no Oforisuo 28, 1940. Ɔyɛ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔyɛ kuoba wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛ Ɛtɔ so mmiensa wɔ Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nnan a ɔgyina hɔ ma mfantsiman apuei mansini a ɛwɔ Mfinimfini mantam, Ghana.

Na brabɔ ne sukuu mu nsɛm
Yɛwoo Owusu afe 1940 mu wɔ Mfantsiman apuei a ɛwɔ mfimfini mantam, Ghana. Ɔkɔɔ morris sukuu a ɛyɛ etire yɛ ne amammerɛ. Ma ɔnyaa ne deploma degree wɔ amammerɛ ne sɛ neɛ yɛsi seisei yɛn ho fa.

Mmrahyɛbadwa mu nsɛm
Owusu ka Baako, mmienu ne mmiensa mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛyɛ nnan adehyeman wɔ Ghana.Ne mmrahyɛbadwa adwuma no hyɛɛ aseɛ afe 1992 berɛ a ɔbɛyɛ mmrahyɛbadwa mu nnipa ma mfantsiman mansini a ɛwɔ mfimfini mantam wɔ tikiti a ɛyɛ National Convention party. Ɔgyinaa mmrahyɛbadwa akonnwa no biom wɔ afe 1996 ne 2000 Ghana abatoɔ kɛseɛ no mu ma Mfantsiman Apuei mansini na ɔsan bɛtenaa akonnwa no so sɛ  National Democratic Congress ni. ɔdii mmrahyɛbadwa akonnwa no ho nkonim mpren mmiensa ma Mfanstiman apuie Mansini. Afe 2000 mu no, ɔnyaa aba 7,110 wɔ Ghana abatoɔ kɛseɛ no mu.

Adwuma
Owusu yɛ obi a ɔhwɛ boa nnipa ahosiesie na mprenpren yi deɛ ɔka mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ a wɔn wɔ Mfantsiman Apuei Mansini a ɛwɔ mfinimfi mantam, Ghana.

title: Alban Sumana Bagbin
text:
Alban Sumana Kingsford Bagbin  (Wɔwoo no wɔ afe 1957, ɛbɔ bosome no mu) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni. Na ɔka Ghana mmarahyɛbadwa a edikan, ɛtɔ so mmienu, miɛnsa, ɛnan, ɛnum, nsia, ne nea ɛtɔ so nson no ho wɔ repɔblik nnan (4th Republic) no mu. Na ogyina hɔ ma Bimbilla abatow mpesua a na ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Mantam. Seisei ɔno nye Ghana mmrahyɛbadwa no kyeame. Na Bagbin yɛ apɔwmuden soafo wɔ aban mu fi afe 2012, ɔpɛpɔn bosome no mu kosii ɔgyefo bosome no mu wɔ afe 2013, a  Hanny-Sherry Ayittey besi n`ananmu. Wɔ afe 2019 mu no, ɔkɔ preɛ manpanyin akonya agua wɔ National Democratic Congress (NDC) amanyɔkuw no mu, nanso ɔmanpanyin dada John Mahama dii ne so nkonim. Wɔ ɔpɛpɔn bosome no mu, aafe 2021 no, wɔtoo aba yii Bagbin ma no bɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbadwa fie kyeame wɔ Ghana mmrahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nwotwe(8th parliament) wɔ repɔblik nnan(4th republic) yi mu.

Abrabɔ ahyɛase ne skuul 
Wɔwoo Bagbin wɔ Ɛbɔ bosome ne da ɛtɔ so aduonu nnan (24) wɔ afe 1957 mu wɔ Bimbilla  a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Mantam. N`awofo nye  Sansunni Bagbin(papa) ne Margaret B. Bagbin(maame) a wɔn nyinaa yɛ akuafoɔ. Ɔyɛ wɔn ba ɔtɔ so nnan wɔ wɔn mba nkron no mu na wɔyɛ Dagaaba ahosu kuw no mu fo. Ofi sombo abusua a ɛwɔ Ghana atifi atɔei mantam (upper west region) mu. Beaɛ a onyaa n`adesua nteteeyɛ nye Wa ntoasoɔ skuul ne ntoasoɔ skuul a ɛwɔ Tamale. Bagbin nyaa abodin krataa, Bachelor of Arts degree wɔ borofo kasa ne mmra mu wɔ Ghana suapɔn keseɛ no mu wɔ afe 1980.

Alban Bagbin toa ne nhomasua so wɔ Ghana mmranimfoɔ skuul(Ghana School of Law) a ɛwɔ Makola wɔ Nkran. Owiee sukuu yi ara pɛ na wɔfrɛɛ no kaa mmranyinfoɔ kuw no ho wɔ afe 1982 mu. Bagbin san nyaa abodin krataa a ɛne, Executive Masters in Governance ne Leadership fii Ghana nteteeyɛbea a wɔfrɛ no, Institute of Management and Public Administration (GIMPA).

N`adwumasɛm 

Bagbin yɛɛ adwuma sɛ ɔkyerɛwkyerɛwfo de maa Akontaabu adwumakuo (Statistical Service Board) no fi afe 1980 kosii afe 1982. Ansa na Bagbin rokɔ Tripoli a ɛwɔ Lybia akɔkyerɛ ade wɔ wɔn ntoasoɔ skuul a ne din de  Suk Juma Secondary School no, ɔkɔ yɛɛ adwuma sɛ ntotoeyɛfo panyin de maa erstwhile State Hotels Corporation, a na  ɛyɛ ananmusifo ne ewiase nyinaa ahɔhodan kuw wɔ afe 1982 mu kosii afe 1983.

Aber a Bagbin san baa Ghana wɔ afe 1986 mu no, ɔde ne ho kɔdom mmranyinfoɔ kuw a ne din de  Akyem Chambers, na na atɛnbuafoɔ a wɔdi asɛm, ne wɔn a wɔkyerɛkyerɛ mmra mu na ɛwɔ  saa kuw yi mu. Ofii ase sɛ Attorney, na nkakrakakra ɔbɛyɛɛ kuw no mu ni. Abere a na ɛreyɛ adwuma wɔ Okyeman Chambers wɔ afe 1989 ne afe 1992 no, woyii no sɛ onyɛ  external solicitor ɛmma  Nii Ngleshie adehyeɛ abusua a ɛwɔ James Town no, Credit Unions Association of Ghana (CUA) ne ankoranko ndwumakuw ahorow pii a ɛwɔ Nkran.

Aber na w`ayɛ adwuma mfe nson wɔ Okyeman Chambers no, wɔ afe 1993 mu no, ofii hɔ, na de bɛ si nnɛ, ɔyɛ Law Trust adwumakuw no mu ni.

Bagbin yɛ Kristoni.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Yɛtoo aba maa Bagbin kɔɔ mmarahyɛbadwam wɔ National Democratic Congress amanyɔkuw no din mu.  Wɔpaw no de ma Bimbilla abatoɔ mpesua wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa 1996 Ghana abatoɔ mu. Onyaa 13796 mma efi 31169 mma a wɔtoo nyinaa mu; eyi gyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛm aduasa mmienu (32.1%). Wɔn a wɔne no gyinaa wɔ saa abatow no mu ne Aliu Aduna Mahama, Mohammed Ibn Chambas ne Justice K. Grundow. Wonyaa mma 9467 egyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛm aduonu mmienu (22.1%), mma 7488 egyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛm dunsɔn (17.4%), mma 418  egyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛm biako (1.0%). Wɔgyinaa wɔ Convention People's Party(CPP), National Democratic Congress(NDC) ne National Congress Party(NCP).

Mmrahyɛbadwanyi

1996 Abatoɔ 
Wɔ afe 1996 mu no, Bagbin dii nkonim wɔ Nadowli North abatoɔ mpɛsoa no so. Nnipa dodow a wɔtow aba no yɛ 19,485, na Bagbin nyaa mu 12,605 a ɛkyerɛ ɔha mu nhyehyɛmu aduoson nsia ne akyirpɔw aduanan nsia (76.46%), ɛnna Lawerence Banyen a ɔyɛ amanyɔkuw NPP mu ni no nyaa mba no mu 2,213 a ɛyɛ ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu dumiɛnsa ne akyiripɔw aduanan ebien (13.42%), Yuoni Moses Vaalandzeri a ɔyɛ PNC amanyɔkuw mu ni no nyaa mba 1,490, kyerɛ ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu nkron (9.04%) ne NCP amanyɔkuw no mu ni Baslide Kpemaal a ɔno nso nyaa mba no 177, kyerɛ ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu baako (1.07%).

Afe 2000 Abatoɔ 
Wɔ aba a Ghanafoɔ tow yɛ wɔ afe 2000 mu no, Bagbin san dii nkonim wɔ ne mpɛsoa no so bio sɛ mmrahyɛbadwanyi wɔ Nadwoli North abatoɔ mpɛsoa no so. Nkruɔfo dodow a wɔto maa no no yɛ 9,004, na na ɛyɛ ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu aduonum nwotwe ne akyirpɔw nsia (58.60%) wɔ aba no nyinaa mu. Wɔn odii wɔn so nkonim no nye Dr. Anleu-Mwine D.B a na ɔngyina amnyɔkuw biaa akyir, amanyɔkuw Peoples National Congress ba Clement Kanfuri Senchi, amanyɔkuw New Patriotic Party ba Ningkpeng Pauline, John Bayon Boniface Wetol, Domayele Marcel Aston a na woyɛ National Reform Party amanyɔkuw no mu fo a na wofi United Ghana Movement Party kuw no mu.

Afe 2004 Abatoɔ 
Wɔ afe 2004, aber na worebɛto aba no, wɔkyɛɛ Nadwoli North abatoɔ mpɛsoa no mu ebien, Nadwoli West ne Nadwoli East abatoɔ mpɛsoa. Wɔtow aba maa Bagbin sɛ mmrahyɛbadwanyi wɔ Nadowli West mpɛsoa no so wɔ afe 2004 abatoɔ no mu. Onyaa aba dodow 11,296, kyerɛ ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu aduonum ne akyirpɔw nnum(50.5%) fii aba 22,349 no mu, kyerɛ Ghanafoɔ dodow a wɔto maa no. Wɔn a odii wɔn nkonim no nye, Clement K. Senchi(aba dodow a onyaa yɛ 625) a ɔyɛ People's National Convention amanyɔkuw no mu ni, Daniel Anleu-Mwine Baga(aba dodow a onyaa yɛ 5,297) a ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuw no mu ni, Sasuu Bernard Kabawunu(aba dodow a onyaa yɛ 152) a ɔyɛ Convention People's Party amanyɔkuw no mu ni, Bisung Edward(aba dodow a onyaa yɛ 188) a ɔyɛ Democratic People's Party amanyɔkuw no mu ni ne Dapilaa Ishak(aba dodow a onyaa yɛ 4,791) a na ɔngyina amnyɔkuw biara anan mu.

Mmrahyɛbadwa Kyeame 
Bagbin na seisei ɔyɛ Mmrahyɛbadwa kyeame wɔ repɔblik nnan(4th republic) no mmrahyɛbadwa a ɛto so nwotwe(8th parliament) no mu. Wɔkaa ntam de no sii agua so wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn da a ɔtɔ so nson, afe 2021 mu, aber amanyɔkuw National Democratic Congress(NDC) yii no sɛ ɔnkɔ prɛ mmrahyɛbadwa kyeame agua no. Bagbin dii Mike Oquaye, onii a amanyɔkuw NPP yii no sɛ ɔnkɔ prɛ mmrahyɛbadwa kyeame agua no so nkonim.

N`abrabɔ 
Alban Bagbin yere nye Alice Adjua Yornas Bagbin, a ɔyɛ  UNICEF kuw no fa a ɛwɔ Nkran no dwumadi sohwɛfo wɔ Ghana ha. Bagbin yɛ nyamesomnyi a ɔkɔ asɔre wɔ Roman Catholic som bea.

title: John Kwadwo Gyapong
text:

Ne mmofraberem 
Wɔwoo Gyapong 22 Ɔpɛnimaa 1950. Ɔkɔɔ sukuu wɔ Kejebi Ntoaso sukuu. Ɛhɔ na onyaa GCE Ordinary Level krataa. Otoaa n'adesua so wɔ Kpando ntoaso sukuu. Ɛhɔ no onyaa GCE Advanced Levol krataa. Onyaa abasobɔde wɔ adesua(Bachelor of Science in Education) mu wɔ University of Cape Coast.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Yɛtoo aba maa Gyapong kɔɔ mmarahyɛbadwam wɔ National Democratic Congress(NDC) din mu.  Wɔpaw no de ma Bimbilla abatoɔ mpesua wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa 1996 Ghana abatoɔ mu. Wɔpaw no sii Seth Kwabena Akompi a na ɔno nso dom NDC kuw no ananmu. Onyaa 16008 mma efi 25165 mma a wɔtoo nyinaa mu; eyi gyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛm aduosɔn mmiɛnsa (73.4%). Wɔn a wɔne no gyinaa wɔ saa abatow no mu ne Fudu Kassim, James Yaw Fato ne Seth Frank Alifui ne Joseph Yaw Biadoo. Wonyaa mma 4,942 egyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛm dunan (14.80%), mma 3,875 egyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛm dubiako (11.605), mma 213 egyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛm 0.6% ne mma 127 egyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛm 0.4%. Wɔgyinaa wɔ Independent candidate, Convention People's Party(CPP), Independent candidate ne Convention People's Party(CPP) din mu.

title: Cled Mawuko Kwasi Sowu
text:
Cled Mawuko Kwasi Sowu yɛ Ghana amanyɔni. Na ɔka Ghana mmarahyɛbadwam a ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ 4th Republic mu. Na ogyina hɔ ma Anlo abatow mpesua a na ɛwɔ Ghana Firaw Mantam.

Ne mmofraberem 
Wɔwoo Sowu wɔ Tegbi  a ɛwɔ Ghana Firaw Mantam. Wɔwoo no 15 Oforisuo 1905. Ɔfiri  Tegbi a ɛben Keta a wɔ firaw mantam mu, Ɔkɔɔ sukuu wɔ Mfantsipim sukuu a ɛwɔ Mfimfini mantan Cape Coast.  Squadron kandini  Sowu gyee nteteeɛ firii  Royal Air Force asrafoɔ hɔ wɔ 1958 ɔno ne Ghanani a ɔdikan hure firii soro bɛsii fam. Ɔfaa no sɛ ɔsrani wɔ afe 1961 na ɔgyee no tumm wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa 4, 1962. Ɔkɔɔ nahomegeɛ mu wɔ Ɛbɔ 18, 1973.

Nwumasua 
Ɔkɔɔ suapɔn wɔ London  ɛhɔ na ɔnyaa ne bakyela degree. Ɔfiri hɔ na ɔkɔɔ  Granfield kolege a ɛyɛ Aeronautics ne  Harvard suapɔn kɔ yɛɛ  ne maseta.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Yɛtoo aba maa Sowu kɔɔ mmarahyɛbadwam wɔ National Democratic Congress(NDC) din mu.  Wɔpaw no de ma Anlo abatoɔ mpesua wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa 1996 Ghana abatoɔ mu. Onyaa 36,479 mma efi mma a wɔtoo nyinaa mu. Eyi gyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛm aduowɔtwe nsɔn (87.40%). Wɔn a wɔne no gyinaa wɔ saa abatow no mu ne Clemence Kwami Abotsi, Felix Yao Tettey ne Napoleon Agobada. Wonyaa mma 630 egyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛm aduonu mmienu (1.50%), mma 537 egyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛm dunsɔn (1.30%) ne hwee. Wɔgyinaa wɔ Indepenent candidate, New Patriotic Party(NPP) ne independent candidate ananmu.

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Sowu yɛ Kristoni.

Ne wuo

Ɔwuu wɔ Ɔpɛnmaa 4, 2010, wɔ ne fie a ɛwɔ  East Legon, Nkran. Ɔnyaa mfeɛ 78.

title: Steve Senu Akorli
text:
Steve Senu Akorli yɛ Ghana amanyɔni. Na ɔka Ghana mmarahyɛbadwam a ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ 4th Republic mu. Na ogyina hɔ ma  Ho East abatow mpesua .

Na Brabɔ Mfitiaseɛ 

Ɔwɔ Senu wɔ afe ahankron ne aduonan nnwɔtwe wɔ Ahinemi Bosome da a ɛtɔso du mmienu no mu wɔ Kpetsuon a ɔwɔ Volta Mansin mu wɔ Ghana .

Ne Amayɔsem 

Ɔyi Senu sɛ ɔnkɔ mmrahyɛbɛdwafie a ɛdi kan wɔ Ghana Repubrik a ɛtɔso nan wɔ afe ahankron ne aduokron mmiensa wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da ɛtɔso nson mu wɔ abrɛ a ɔdi nkonim wɔ Ghana Abatoɔ a ɔtɔ no wɔ afe ahankron ne aduokron mmienu mu wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa bosome da ɛtɔso aduonu nkron no mu sɛ ɔnkɔ gyina Ho mpɛsoa Aban mu mmrahyɛbɛdwafie a ɛtɔso bakoo de kɔsii ne nan so wɔ Ghana Repubrik a ɛtɔso nan.

Ne Nnumadie 

Na ɔyɛ Ɔsoafoɔ de Ma Rawlings berɛ a na ɔyɛ Ɔmanpanin wɔ Ghana no.

Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbɛdwani firi afe ahankron ne aduokron mmienu de kɔsii afe mpem mmienu ne nan no mu  ɛhɔ na ɔdi ne dwumadie siiɛ.

Ne wuo. 

Senu yareɛ wɔ Oforisuo bosome da ɛtɔso aduonu nsia wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du nkron no mu maa ɔdi kɔɔ ayaresabea a ɛwɔ Voltal mansin nanso ɛkyerɛ no wiemu hyen de no kpɔ Korle Bu ayaresabea na ɛhɔ na ɔkɔ wu.

Wɔ kora no akyi wɔ Adakpu Kpetsuon aɛhɔ na ɔfi wɔ kutawonsa bosome da ɛtɔso aduonu num wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du nkron no mu.

Nea ɛfa na Abrabɔ ho. 
Ne hokafoɔ ne Owurayere Victoria Akorli .

Na ɔne no wu mma nsia.

title: Modestus Yao Z. Ahiable
text:
Modestus Yawo Zebu Ahiablea a wɔwoo no Ahinime bosome ne da a ɛtɔ so du afe apem ahankron aduanan nnwɔtwe (Ahinime 10, 1948) Modestus yɛ Ghanani amanyɔni sane yɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma   Ketu North ɔ Volta mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔsome sɛ Ghana nnan mu sini wɔ Benin firi 2009 kɔpem 2013. Ɔsome sɛ  mantam suafoɔ ma Volta firi  1993 kɔpem 1997 wɔ Ɔmampanin  Jerry Rawlings aban mu.

N'abrabɔ ne ne nwomasua 
wɔwoo Ahiable wɔ Ahinime 10, 1948 wɔ Volta  mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔkɔsua  tekya deɛ wɔ St Francis kolege ɛhɔ na ɔsua tekya die. Ahiable yɛ Kristoni.

Nadwuma

Ahiable yɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛni ankasa.

Amanyɔsɛm

Ɔhyɛɛ namanyɔsɛm ase sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔka National Democratic Congress amanyɔkuo ho. Ɔyii no kaa mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛdikan wɔ Ɔman Ghana wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome ne da a ɛtɔ so nson(Ɔpɛpɔn  7,1993) berɛ a ɔdii nkunim wɔ 1992 Ghana mmarahyɛbadwa abotoɔ wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa 29, 1992.

Ɔsane yii no bio sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma Ketu North abatoɔ mpɛsoa so foɔ wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so  2 ne 3 wɔ Ghana. Wɔ afe 1996 Ghana nyinaa abatoɔ mu, Ɔnyaa mma no  35,308 firii mma 38,390 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 74.30%  de kyɛn Samuel Kofi A. Dzamesi a ɔwɔ New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuo  no nyaa mma  3,082 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 6.50%.

Ɔde mma 16,252  na ɛdii nkunim a ɛgyina hɔ ma  57% . Nabatoɔ mpɛsoa no ka mpɛsoa du nkron 19 a  National Democratic Congress amanyɔkuo no nyaa wɔ  Volta mantam mu.

Ɔsome sɛ mantam suafoɔ ma Volta mantam firi 1993 kɔpem 1997 wɔ Ɔmampanin Jerry Rawlings aban mu.

Diplomatic career 
Wɔ afe 2009, Ɔmampanin John Evans Atta Mills yi no sɛ  Ghana nan mu sini wɔ Benin. Ɔsome firii  2009 kɔpem 2013.

2000 abatoɔ 
Ɔyii Ahiable sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma  Ketu North abatoɔ mpɛsoa so foɔ wɔ afe 2000 Ghana nyinaa abatoɔ mu. Ɔgyina wɔ  National Democratic Congress amanyɔkuo no din mu.

Ne mpɛsoa no ka mpɛsoa  19 a  National Democratic Congress amanɔkuo no nyaeɛ wɔ  Volta mantam mu.  National Democratic Congress amanyɔkuo no nyaa mmarahyɛbadwa akonwa  92 firii nkonwa  200 wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ mmiɛnsa wɔ Ghana.

Ɔnyaa mma 16,252 firii 29,698 mu. Wei gyina hɔ ma 57% .

Saafoɔ yi na ɔdii wɔn so nkunime Conor C. K. Dzakpasua ɔgyina sɛ ankorankorɛ, Akagla Prosper ɔnni amanyɔkuo biara, Albert Korbla Avinu New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuo, Oscar S.Y. Dzramedo  Convention People's Party amanyɔkuo, J.K. Wotordzor  National Reformed Party amanyɔkuo, Kpemli K.K Christian People's National Convention ne Kponyoh C. Kwasi United Ghana Movement amanyɔkuo.

Mma obiara nyaeɛ ne 5,696, 2,159, 1,802, 1,557, 716, 184 ne 134. Wei gyina hɔ ma 20%, 7.6%, 6.3%, 5.5%, 2.5%, 0.6% ne 0.5%.

title: Stephen Obimpeh
text:
Stephen George Obimpeh yɛ Ghana amanyɔni. Na ɔka Ghana mmarahyɛbadwam a ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ 4th Republic mu. Na ogyina hɔ ma North Dayi abatow mpesua a na ɛwɔ Ghana Firaw Mantam. N'a ɔyɛ sraani wɔ Ghana Navy mu.

Ne mmofraberem 
Wɔwoo Obimpeh 26 Ɛbɔ 1941 wɔ Vakpo a ɛwɔ Ghana Firaw Mantam. Ɔhyɛɛ sukuu ase wɔ Vakpo ɛna ɔtoaa so wɔ Ghana Secondary Technical School(GSTS) wɔ Takoradi. Wɔfaa no wɔ Ghana Military Academy mu. Ɔsan toaa n'adesua so wɔ  Britannia Royal Naval College Dartmouth, U.K. Wɔfaa no adwuma mu wɔ Ghana Armed Forces wɔ afe 1963 mu.

N'adwuma mu nsɛm 
N'a Stephen Obimpeh yɛ  po so ɔsraani panyin. Na ɔsan yɛ titrani a ɔda  Association of Retired Naval Officers ano.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Yɛtoo aba maa Obimpeh kɔɔ mmarahyɛbadwam wɔ National Democratic Congress din mu.  Wɔpaw no de ma North Dayi abatoɔ mpesua wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa 1996 Ghana abatoɔ mu. Bere a na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani no na ɔyɛ guamtrani ma Finance Select Committee. Na ɔyɛ Minister for Health wɔ Ghana fi afe 1993 kosi afe 1996. Ɔsan somee sɛ Minister of Agriculture fi afe 1996 kosi 1997.

Wɔ afe 1996 abatow no mu no onyaa 39,445 mma efi mma a wɔtoo nyinaa mu; eyi gyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛm aduɔkron baako (91.7%). Wɔn a wɔne no gyinaa wɔ saa abatow no mu ne Vincent Wilson Bulla ne Augustine Yawo Adjei. Wonyaa mma 2,634 egyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛm asia (6.1%) ne mma 944 egyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛm mmienu (2.2%). Wɔgyinaa wɔ People's Convention Party(PCP) ne New Patriotic Party(NPP) din mu.

title: Kenneth Dzirasah
text:
Kenneth Dzirasah yɛ Ghana amanyɔni. Na ɔka Ghana mmarahyɛbadwam a ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ 4th Republic mu. Na ogyina hɔ ma South Tongu abatow mpesua a na ɛwɔ Ghana Firaw Mantam.

Ne mmofraberem 
Wɔwoo Dzirasah wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da a ɛtɔ du-mmiɛnsa afe apem aha-nkron ne aduonum nnan (1954) wɔ Ghana Atifi Mantam. Ɔkɔɔ sukuu wɔ University of Ghana ne Ghana School of Law. Ɛhɔ no na onyaa abodin krataa wɔ mmarasua mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Dzirasah somee sɛ First Deputy Speaker wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwam wɔ afe 2000 mu. Ɔsan somee sɛ Second Deputy Speaker wɔ Ghana mmahyɛbadwam wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnan (2004). Ɔmanpanyin a na odi Ghana so saa bere no ne John Agyekum Kufour.

Yɛtoo aba maa Dzirasah kɔɔ mmarahyɛbadwam wɔ National Democratic Congress din mu.  Wɔpaw no de ma South Tongu abatoɔ mpesua wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa mu wɔ afe apem aha-nkron aduokron nsia (1996) Ghana abatoɔ mu. Onyaa

22254 mma efi mma a wɔtoo nyinaa mu; eyi gyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛm aduosɔn mmienu (72.10%). Wɔn a wɔne no gyinaa wɔ saa abatow no mu ne Kuma Abenyega, Francis Seko Ahorgba ne Paul Kofi Hormeku. Wonyaa mma 4,235 egyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛm dumiensa (13.70%), mma 258 egyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛm 0.80%, mma 195  egyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛm 0.60%. Wɔgyinaa wɔ Independent, Convention People's Party(CPP) ne People's National Convention(PNC) din mu.

title: Sampson Kwaku Boafo
text:
Sampson K.Boafo yɛ Ghana mmrahyɛbedwani sane yɛ ɔmanyɔni ma NPP amanyɔkuo no. Ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbedwani ma Subin mpɛsoa wɔ mmrahyɛbedwafie a ɛtɔso nan wɔ Ghana adehyeman amanmuo a ɛtɔso nan. 
Ghana.

Adwuma 
Boafo yɛ ɔmanyɔni, ɔtɛmmuafoɔ wasane ne ate Founder City Temple International. Ɔsom sɛ mmrahyɛbedwani ma Subin mpɛsoa toaso mprɛnsa.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Boafo dikan som  mmrahyɛbedwafie wɔ Asante Akyem ɛwɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduoson nkron wɔ Ghana adehyeman amanmuo a ɛtɔso mmiɛnsa wɔ Hilla Limann a w'anya ne baabi kɔ.

N'amanyɔ adwuma no ankɔ awieyɛ pa firi sɛ ankyɛ biara na ɛwɔ Ɔpɛnimaa bosome ne da ɛtɔso aduasa baako wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduowɔtwe mu na asraafoɔ bɛdii ɔman no so. Na Jerry John Rawlings na yɛ wɔn kandifoɔ. Boafo sane baa mmrahyɛbedwafie wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduokron nson wɔ Ghana adehyeman a ɛtɔso nan. W'asom wɔ akuokuo a ɛwɔ mmrahyɛbedwafie ɛbinom ne ahobanbɔfoɔ ma ɔman Ghana ne asɛmdifoɔ nso. Na Boafo yɛ suafo wɔ oman panin dadaa John Agyekum Kuffour berɛ so ma Subin mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Asante mantam. Ɔwoo no wɔ Asante mantam. Na ɔyɛ Suafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Ahennie ne Amammerɛ so.

Abatoɔ 
Ɔdikan baa mmrahyɛbedwafie wɔ NPP amanyɔkuo ne din mu maa Subin mpɛsoa wɔ Asante mantam wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduokron nsia wɔ Ghana abatoɔ kɛseɛ no mu. Ɔnyaa mma mpem aduasa nnwɔtwe ahanan ne du mmienu(38,412) firii mma mpem adonum mmiɛnsa ahasa ne aduanan nan(53,344) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu abupɛn aduonum num n'akyire pɔ aduoson(55.70%) de tia Sarkodie Joseph J.A Tuffour a ɔwɔ NDC amanyɔkuo ɔnyaa mma mpem du baako ahanu ne aduowɔtwe(11,280) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu abupɛn du nsia n'akyire pɔ aduanan(16.40%). Asamoah Comfort a ɔgyina mu ma IND amanyɔkuo nyaa mma apem baako ɔha nnwɔtwe ne aduasa nson(1,837) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu abupɛn mmienu n'akyiri pɔ aduoson(2.70%). ne Hussien Aminu ɔnyaa mma apem baako ɔha nnwɔtwe ne du num(1,815) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu abupɛn mmienu n'akyire pɔ aduosia(2.60%). Ɔsane baa mmrahyɛbedwafie wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu must(2000) abatoɔ no akyi. Ɔnyaa mma mpem aduanan nan ɔha nkron ne nson(44,907) firii mma mpem aduonum nsia ɔha nnwɔtwe ne aduokron nnwɔtwe(56,898) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu abupɛn aduoson nnwɔtwe n'akyiri pɔ aduokron(78.90%) de tia Kwame Adu Boffour a ɔdɔm NDC amanyɔkuo. Ɔnyaa mma mpem nkron ɔha ne aduoson nson a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu abupɛn du nsia(16.00%), Huseini Aminu a ɔwɔ PNC amanyɔkuo no nyaa mma apem baako ɔha num ne aduanan baako(1,541) na Serwaa Kyeretwie a ɔwɔ CPP amanyɔkuo nso nyaa mma apem baako ahasa ne aduoson nson(1,373).  Boafo sane baa mmrahyɛbedwafie maa Subin mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Asante mantam wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan(2004) Ghana abatoɔ kɛseɛ no akyi. Ɔdii nkunim maa NPP amanyɔkuo no. Na ne mpɛsoa ka nkonnwa aduasa nsia(36) a NPP amanyɔkuo nya firii nkonnwa aduasa nkron(39) ɛwɔ Asante mantam. NPP amanyɔkuo no nyaa nkonnwa no dodoɔ wɔ mmrahyɛbedwafie, ɔnyaa ɔha ne aduonu nnwɔtwe(128)firii nkonnwa ɔhanu ne aduasa(230). Ɔnyaa mma mpem aduanan mmienu ɔha nson ne du mmien(42,712)firii mma mpem aduosia baako ɔha ne aduasa mmiɛnsa(61,133) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu abupɛn aduosia nkron n'akyiri pɔ nkron(69.9%) wɔ aba dodoɔ a ɔtooeɛ. Ɔdii nkunim wɔ Huseini Aminu Ali a ɔwɔ PNC amanyɔkuo ɔnyaa mma mpem nnwɔtwe ahanan ne aduokron baako(8,491) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu abupɛn baako n'akyiri pɔ nan(1.4%), Abraham Kwesi Mensah a ɔwɔ NDC amanyɔkuo ɔnyaa mma apem baako ɔha ne aduokron nnwɔtwe(1,098) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu abupɛn du nnwɔtwe n'akyiri pɔ mmienu(18.2%), Kwame Appiah Boateng a ɔwɔ CPP amanyɔkuo ɔnyaa mma apem baako ɔha nsia ne du baako(1,611) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu abupɛn mmienu n'akyire pɔ nsia(2.6%) ne Charles Hagan Kofi a ɔgyina mu ma ɔno ara ne ho so nyaa mma mpem nan ɔha nnwɔtwe ne aduosia mmiɛnsa(4,863) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu abupɛn nnwɔtwe(8%) nyinaa so.

title: Yaw Barima
text:
Yaw Barimah (ɔwo no Ɔpɛnima bosome da ɛtɔso aduonu mmienu wɔ afe ahankron ne aduonan nkron ) na  Ghana Amayɔn na ɔdi asem na ɔka mmrahyɛbɛdwafie a ɛtɔso mmienu , mmiensa ne nan wɔ Ghana ɔgyina ma Juaben south mpesoa nea ɛnɛ yi ɔfrɛ no Koforidua wɔ Ghana.

Na abrabɔ mfitiaseɛ ne ne nnwomasua 
Ɔwo Barimah  wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa bosome da ɛtɔso aduonu mmienu wɔ afe ahankron ne aduonan nkron wɔ Kokoben Akropong wɔ Asante mantam wɔ Ghana. Ɔkɔ Sukuu wɔ TI Ahmadiyyaa ɛwɔ Kumasi wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduoson .Ɔtoa so wɔ University of Ghana na ɔnya abɔdin krataa wɔ nnwomasua mu wɔ Arts.ɔkɔ sukuu wɔ Suapɔn a ɔteete mmranimfoɔ wɔ Ghana wɔ afe ahankron ne aduoson nan ɛhɔ na ɔsua mmra na Ɔbɛyɛ lawya.

title: Gabriel Yaw Amoah
text:
Gabriel Yaw Amoah yɛ amanyɔni sane yɛ ɔtemmuafoɔ. Ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbedwani wɔ mmrahyɛbedwafie a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa wɔ Ghana adehyeman amanmuo a ɛtɔ so nan. Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbedwani ma Bosome Freho mansini sane yɛ mansini panin ma ne mansini.

Abrabɔ ahyɛaseɛ ne nnwomsua 
Ɔwoo Amoah wɔ Bosome Freho a ɛwɔ Asante mantam.

Amanyɔsɛm 
NPP amanyɔkuo na dii kan yi Amoah baa mmrahyɛbedwafie ɛwɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduokron nsia(1996) sɛ mmrahyɛbedwani ma Bosome Freho mpɛsoa so wɔ Asante mantam. Na ɔka mmrahyɛbedwafie a ɛtɔ so mmienu ne mmiɛnsa wɔ Ghana adehyeman amanmuo a ɛtɔ so nan ma NPP amanyɔkuo. Na amanyɔ adwuma hyɛɛ aseɛ wɔ berɛ a ɔbaa mmrahyɛbedwafie wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron aduokron nsia(1996) sɛ mmrahyɛbedwani ma Bosome Freho mpɛsoa so. Ɔdii Owusu Pra Ababio so nkunim, ɔnyaa mma mpem nkron ahanan ne aduonum baako(9,451) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu abupɛn aduanan(40%) wɔ wɔn a ɔtoo aba no. Amoah kɔgyinaa biom wɔ mfe mpem mmienu mu akyire a ɔdi nkunim wɔ mmrahyɛbedwafoɔ aba edikan na ɔnyaa mma mpem du ahanson ne aduasa nan(10,734) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu abupɛn aduosia num(65%).

Ɔsane kɔgyina nanso wantumi ankɔ n'anim ɔdi nkoguo ma NPP amanyɔni foforɔ na nyaeɛ. Ɔyii no sɛ mansini panin maa ne mansini.

Adwuma 
Amoah yɛ ɔtɛmmuafoɔ sane yɛ mmrahyɛbedwani ma Bosome Freho mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Asante mantam.

title: John Kweku Kumah
text:
John Kweku Kumah (ɔwɔ no ɔbɛnem da ɛtɔ so aduasa wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduasa ne nnwɔtwe mu ) ɔyɛ Ghana Amayɔni na ɔka wɔn a ɔkɔ mmrahyɛbɛdwafie ɛwɔ  mmrahyɛbɛdwafie a ɛdi kan ne nea ɛtɔso mmienu wɔ ɔma adwa ɛtɔso nan na ɔkɔ Ghana mmrahyɛbɛdwafie ma Twifo  Denkyira mpɔtamu sɛ  National Democratic Congress amanyɔkuoni.

Abrabɔ ahyaseɛ ne sukuu 
Ɔwɔ John wɔ mfimfim mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana. Na Ɔnya no abasobɔdeɛ krataa wɔ Nnwoma Sua firi University of Ghana Legon.

Ɔtoa ne Nnwoma Sua si wɔ mfimfim mantam wɔ  Ghana na Ɔnya Abɔdin krataa wɔ Nnwoma mu fa art ho firi mfimfim nnwomasua kɛseɛ a ɔfrɛ no University of Cape Coast.Ɔyɛ adwuma sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛni ansa na ɔwura amayɔsem mu.

Na amanyɔsɛm  

John suaeɛ  yɛ sɛ ɔba mmrahyɛbɛdwafie a ɛdi kan wɔ Repubrik a ɛtɔso nan wɔ Ghana na wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron mmiensa wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn da ɛtɔso so nson no mu no ɛberɛ a ɔdi nkunim wɔ afe ɔka aduokron ne aduokron mmienu Abatoɔ a ɔto no Ɔpɛnima bosome da ɛtɔso aduonu nkron.

Ɔsane sua na mmrahyɛbɛdwafie wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da ɛtɔso nson wɔ afe ahankron ne aduokron nson wɔ aberɛ a ɔdi nkonim wɔ afe ahankron ne aduokron nsia wɔ Ghana Abatoɔ no mu.

Bɔ no kandini wɔ afe ahankron ne aduokron nsia abatoɔ no mu berɛ ɔdi nkunim wɔ ne akansini a ɔfrɛ no Kwaku Nyamaa -Akyeampong so a Ɔnya aduonum bakoo akyerepɔ aduoson firii mma dodoɔ a ɔto yɛ no anea Ɔni no pere adwa no nso nya aduosa nan ne akyerepɔ aduowɔtwe wɔ mma dodoɔ a wɔtɔeɛ.

Ɛwɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nan Twifo/Hemang/lower/ Denkyira  mpɛsoa dɔwo kyɛ mu Hemang-Lower-Denkyira mpɛsoa ne Twifo -Atti Morkwaa mpɛsoa.

Ɔgyina Benjamin Bimpong Donkor ne Elizabeth Amoah

Ɔno ankasa n'abrabɔ 
Ɔyɛ kristoni

title: Peter Boakye-Ansah
text:
Peter Boakye-Ansah yɛ amanyɔni sane yɛ mmrahyɛbedwani wɔ mmrahyɛbedwafie a edi kan ne deɛ ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ Ghana adehyeman amanmuo a ɛtɔ so nan. Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbedwani ma Ejura Sekyedumasi mpɛsoa firi Ɔpɛpɔn bosome ne da ɛtɔ so nson wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduokron mmiɛnsa (1993) de kɔ si Ɔpɛpɔn bosome ne da ɛtɔ so nsia wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne baako (2001) mu.

peter

Abrabɔ ahyeaseɛ ne nnwomasua 
Ɔwoo Boakye-Ansah wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduanan nkron. Ɔkɔɔ suapɔn sukuu wɔ Osei Tutu Training College ɛhɔ na ɔnyaa n'adekyerɛ abɔdin krataa ɛna ɔsane kɔɔ Bonsu Agricultural Training sukuu ɛhɔ na ɔkɔ nyaa kuayɔ ho nimdeɛ de bɛyɛɛ kuafoɔ mpanin abɛdieɛ kyire.

Adwuma ne amanyɔsɛm 
Ansa na ɔwura amanyɔsɛm mu no na Boakye-Ansah yɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛni. Na ɔsane yɛ Ejura Sekyedumasi mansini twerɛtwerɛfoɔ ansa na ɔba mmrahyɛbedwafie. Na ɔka mmrahyɛbedwafie a edikan wɔ Ghana adehyeman amanmuo a ɛtɔ so nan ma NDC amanyɔkuo wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome ne da ɛtɔ so nson wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduokron mmiɛnsa wɔ berɛ a ɔtoo Ghana abatoɔ kɛseɛ wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa bosome ne da ɛtɔ so aduonu nkron wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduokron mmienu. Wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduokron nsia Ghana abatoɔ kɛseɛ no Boakye-Ansah gyina maa Ejura Sekyedumasi biom ɛno ɔnyaa mma mpem du nsia ahankron ne aduokron mmienu(16,992) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu abupɛn aduosia mmienu(62%).

Ɔsom sɛ mmrahyɛbedwani maa Ejura Sekyedumasi mpɛsoa wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome ne da ɛtɔ so nson (7) wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduokron mmiɛnsa (1993) de kɔ si Ɔpɛpɔn bosome ne da ɛtɔ so nsia wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne baako (2001). Sampson Atakora a ɔfiri NDC amanyɔkuo na bɛsii na nan.

Asetena ne abrabɔ 
Boakye-Ansah yɛ ɔkristoni. Ɔwuu wɔ Kitawonsa bosome ne da ɛtɔ so du nkron wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne du nnwɔtwe (2018) wɔ berɛ ɔyare kakra akyi no.

title: Eugene Atta Agyepong
text:
Eugene Atta Agyepong yɛ Ghana amanyɔni. Na ɔka Ghana mmarahyɛbadwam a ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ 4th Republic mu. Na ogyina hɔ ma Abetifi abatow mpesua a na ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Mantam.

Ne mmofraberem 
Wɔwoo Agyepong 23 Ɔpɛpɔn 1939 wɔ Abetifi  a ɛwɔ Ghana Apuei Mantam.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Yɛtoo aba maa Agyepong kɔɔ mmarahyɛbadwam wɔ New Patriotic Party(NPP) din mu.  Wɔpaw no de ma Abetifi abatow mpesua wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa 1996 Ghana abatow mu. Onyaa 14,089 mma wɔ mma a wɔtoo nyinaa mu; eyi gyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛm aduasa mmienu (37.10%). Wɔn a wɔne no gyinaa wɔ saa abatow no mu ne Peter Kwasi Wiafe Peprah, Akua Konadu, Kwabena Osei Ntiri ne Prince Opoku. Wonyaa mma 10,598 egyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛm aduonu nsɔn (27.90%), mma 2,299 egyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛm nsia (6.10%), mma 2,149  egyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛm anum (5.70%) ne mma 310 a egyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛm 0.80%. Wɔgyinaa wɔ National Democratic Congress(NDC), Independent,  Convention People's Party(CPP), ne People's National Convention(PNC).

Ɔsomee sɛ guamtrani wɔ Finance Committee ma Ghana mmarahyɛbadwam.

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Agyepong yɛ Kristoni.

title: Fuzzy Dapaah Torbay
text:
Fuzzy Dapaah Torbay yɛ Ghana Amayɔni na ɔka mmrahyɛbɛdwafie a ɔdi ne nea ɛtɔso mmienu wɔ mmrahyɛbɛdwam  wɔ Ghana akonwa ɛtɔso nan ɔkɔ mmrahyɛbɛdwafie kɔgyina ma Okere mpɔtamu wɔ  National Democratic Congress (NDC) anan mu.

Na Abrabɔ Mfitiaseɛ 
Fuzzy was born on 22 May 1952 in the Eastern Region of Ghana. He attended Okuapeman Secondary School in Akropong. He then proceeded to learn more skills in Metal Fabrication and Manufacturing at Varta Ag. Industries where he became an artisan. He worked as an industrialist and agriculturist after his experience at Varta Ag. Industries.

title: Solomon Kwabena Sarfoh
text:
Solomon Kwabena Sarfoh yɛ amanyɔni na ɔsane yɛ mmrahyɛbedwani ma Mampong mpɛsoa so wɔ Asante mantam . Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbedwani sane yɛ otitenani a ɔyi wɔn a ɔhwɛ akwan ne ahyɛn so.

Abrabɔ ne nnwomasua 
Ɔwoo Kwabena Sarfoh wɔ Mampong kuro a ɛwɔ Asante mantam.

Amanyɔsɛm 
NPP amanyɔkuo na dikan yi Kwabena Sarfoh wɔ mmrahyɛbedwafie wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa bosome wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduokron nsia wɔ Ghana abatoɔ. Ɔnyaa mma mpem mmienu ne baako ɔha ne aduowɔtwe mmiɛnsa(21,183) firii mma mpem mmienu ne nkron ahasa ne aduowɔtwe num(29,385) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha abupɛn aduonum nkron n'akyiri pɔ aduonum(59.50%) tia Elizabeth Nico a ɔwɔ NDC amanyɔkuo no. Elizabeth nyaa mma mpem nnwɔtwe ahanu ne mmienu(8,202) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu abupɛn aduonu mmiɛnsa n'akyiri pɔ hwee(23.00%). Sarfo ka mmrahyɛbedwafie a ɛtɔso mmienu ne mmiɛnsa wɔ Ghana adehyeman amanmuo a ɛtɔso nan ma NPP amanyɔkuo no.

Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbedwani ma Mampong mpɛsoa wɔ mfe mpem mmienu mu wɔ Ghana abatoɔ keseɛ no, ɔnyaa mma mpem mmienu ne baako ɔha ne aduowɔtwe mmiɛnsa(21,183) firii mma mpem mmienu    ne mmiɛnsa ahasa ne aduonum mmienu a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu abupɛn aduoson nan n'akyiri pɔ aduasa. Ɛwɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne nan no ɔyii no firii mu berɛ a ɔkɔtoo mmrahyɛbedwafoɔ mfitiaseɛ aba no maa Peter Abum Sarkodie a ɔfri NPP amanyɔkuo saa na si na nan. Akyire ɔyii no sɛ otitenani a ɔyi wɔn a ɔhwɛ akwan ne hyɛn so wɔ mmrahyɛbedwafie.

title: Kwabena Adusa Okerchiri
text:
Kwabena Adusa Okerchiri yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne mmarahyɛbadwani a na ɔte New Patriotic Party(NPP) akonnwa so ma Nkwakwa mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Apueeɛ mantam mu wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwafie. Ɔtenaa mpɛsoa no akonnwa so ne mprensa soɔ wɔ mmarahyɛbadwafie firi Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nan mmarahyɛbadwam a ɛtɔ so mmienu kɔsi mmarahyɛbadwam a ɛtɔ so nan firi afe apem ahankron ne aduosia nsia (1966) de kɔsi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan(2004) mu. Adjei Baah na ɛbetuu no.

Ne mmofraberem 
Wɔwoo Kwabena wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduosia (1960) mu na ɔfiri Apueeɛ Mantam mu. Ɔkɔɔ sukuu wɔ University of Ghana a ɛwɔ Ghana.

N'adwuma 
Kwabena Adusa yɛ adwuma sɛ mmaranimni.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ɔpɛnimma bosome wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia(1996) Ghana abatoɔ mu na Adusa a ɔgyina maa New Patriotic Party (NPP) amanyɔkuo wɔ Nkwakwa mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Apueeɛ mantam mu wɔ Ghana nyaa ne abatoɔ nkunimdie a adi kan. Ɔnyaa mma mpem dunwɔtwe, ahanu ne aduoson nkron(18,279) firii mma dodoɔ a na ɛyɛ mpem aduasa-nan, ne aduowɔtwe nsia(34,086) mu a na ne mma no gyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduanan baako ne akyirepɔ aduanan(41.40%) berɛ a ne akansifoɔ Williams Bimpong Asante a ɔgyina maa National Democratic Congress(NDC) amanyɔkuo no nyaa mma mpem dubaako, ahanan ne aduosia(11,460) na Ebenezer Kese Antwi a ɔgyina maa CPP amanyɔkuo no nso nyaa mma mpem nan, ahansia ne aduasa nan(4,634), El-Abdul-Hameed Sachibu a ɔgyina maa PNC amanyɔkuo no nso nyaa mma ahanan ne aduonum nkron (459) na Kofi Frimpong nso a ɔyɛ DPP kuoba nso nyaa mma ahanu ne aduonum nan(254).

Okerchiri yɛ Kristoni.

title: Clement Samuel Crabbe
text:

Wonyaa mma 9467 egyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛm aduonu mmienu (22.1%), mma 7488 egyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛm dunsɔn (17.4%), mma 418  egyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛm biako (1.0%). title: Theresa Joyce Baffoe
text:
Theresa Joyce Baffoe yɛ Ghana mmrahyɛbedwani a na ɔgyina mu ma New Edubease mansini a ɛwɔ Asante mantam. Na ɔsane ka wɔn a ɔyi wɔn a ɔhwɛ dwadie nsɛm so wɔ mmrahyɛbedwafie.

Abrabɔ ne nnwomasua 
Ɔwoo Joyce Baffoe wɔ Kitawonsa bosome ne da ɛtɔso aduonu nan wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduonum nan wɔ New Edubease a ɛwɔ Asante mantam. Ɔkɔɔ akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ sukuu wɔ Holy Child Training College ɛhɔ na ɔkɔ nyaa kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ nimdeɛ sane nyaa n'abɔdin krataa a edikan.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Baffoe bɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbedwani wɔ mmrahyɛbedwafie a edikan wɔ Ghana adehyeman amanmuo a ɛtɔso nan wɔ Ahinime bosome wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduokron mmiɛnsa wɔ berɛ a ɔtoo aba ma no bɛsii Mary Eugenia Ghann a ɔkɔɔ ne kra akyi berɛ a na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbedwani ma New Edubease.

NDC amanyɔkuo sane yii  Baffoe baa mmrahyɛbedwafie  wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduokron nsia abatoɔ no. Ɔnyaa mma mpem du nson ɔha ne du baako(17,114) firii mma mpem aduonu nan ne ɔha num(24,500) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu abupɛn aduonum num n'akyire pɔ aduonum(55.50%) de tia George Akwasi Boadu a ɔgyina mu ma NPP amanyɔkuo, ɔnyaa mma mpem num ahanu ne nsia(5,206) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu abupɛn du nsia n'akyire pɔ aduokron(16.90%), Sophia Afrakoma Owusu a ɔgyina mu ma CPP amanyɔkuo ɔnyaa mma apem ɔha nsia ne aduoson nnwɔtwe(1,678) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu abupɛn num n'akyiri pɔ aduanan(5.40%) ne Kwasi Adjei Aboagye a ɔgyina mu ma PNC amanyɔkuo no ɔno nso nyaa mma ahanum ne mmienu(502) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu abupɛn baako n'akyiri pɔ aduasa.

Na Baffoe ka mmrahyɛbedwafie a ɛtɔso mmiɛnsa wɔ Ghana adehyeman amanmuo a ɛtɔso nan akyire a ɔyii no baa mmrahyɛbedwafie toaso mmiɛnsa wɔ mfe mpem mmienu abatoɔ kɛseɛ no. Ɔgyinaa NDC amanyɔkuo wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduokron mmienu ɛna akyire ɔdii nkunim wɔ akɛnsie no mu wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduokron nsia wɔ Ghana abatoɔ kɛseɛ no mu. Ɔnyaa mma mpem du baako ɔha nkron ne nnwɔtwe(11,908). Ɔdii nkukuo wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne nan Ghana abatoɔ kɛseɛ no mu. Akyire ɔyɛ n'adwene sɛ ɔmma biom no, Ernest Kofi Yankah na sii na nan ɔnyaa mma mpem du nan ɔha nson ne aduasa mmienu(14,732) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu abupɛn aduonum nan n'akyire pɔ aduanan num(54.45%) wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe. Ɔgyina sɛ mmrahyɛbedwani maa New Edubease mpɛsoa mprɛnsa.

Adwuma 
Ɔyɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛni. Ɔkyerɛ adeɛ mfeɛ aduonu nnwɔtwe ansa na ɔwura amanyɔsɛm mu. Ɔsane som sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ panin mfeɛ du nan na ɔsane yɛ panin wɔ wɔn a ɔhwɛ Ghana nyinaa nnwomasua ho nsɛm so.

N'asetena ne abrabɔ 
Joyce Baffoe yɛ ɔkristoni a ɔsom wɔ Roman Catholic asɔre a ɛwɔ Ghana.
