title: Ibrahim Cudjoe Quaye
text:
Sheikh Ibrahim Cudjoe Quaye yɛ Ghana amanyɔni. Na ɔka Ghana mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ 4th Republic mu. Na ogyina hɔ ma Ayawaso Central abatow mpesua. Ɔsan nso yɔɛ Ɔmantam Ɔsoafoɔ wɔ Kurowpɔn Nkran Mantam mu wɔ Kufuor aban ase firi afe 2001 kɔsi afe 2009.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Quaye Ɔpɛpɔn 30, 1937. Ɔfiri La-Accra a ɛwɔ Accra Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔkɔɔ Cambridge Sukuu. Onyaa adansedi krataa wɔ 1958 mu. Ɔsan nso yɛ Rapid Results College no ade. Ɔnyaa Diploma wɔ Adwumayɛ ho nimdeɛ mu wɔ kɔlege no mu wɔ 1962 mu. Ɔsan nso yɛ Rapid Results College no ade na ɔnyaa Diploma wɔ Adwumayɛ ho nimdeɛ mu wɔ kɔlege no mu. Eyi yɛ afe 1962. Wɔ afe 1967 mu no, onyaa Diploma wɔ Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu fii kɔlege koro no ara mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Quaye hyɛɛ n’amammui adwuma ase wɔ afe 1969 mu bere a ɔbɛyɛɛ mmarahyɛ baguani a ɔpɛ sɛ wɔto aba ma no wɔ Progress Party (PP) din mu sɛ obegyina Bawku West mantam ananmu ansa na wɔrefi 1969 Ghana mmarahyɛ bagua abatow no ase mu. Quaye yɛ New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuw no muni.

Wɔpaw no sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ adwuma wɔ afe 1996 Ghana Amansan Abatow no mu na ɔbɛyɛɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanyin a ɛto so 4 no Mmarahyɛ Bagua a ɛto so abien no muni a obegyina Ayawaso Mfinimfini Mantam a ɛwɔ kurowpɔn Nkran Mantam mu ananmu, na ofii n'adwuma ase wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 1997 mu. Wɔsan paw no sɛ onni mantam no anim wɔ Mmarahyɛ Bagua a ɛto so 3, 4 ne 5 a ɛtoatoa so. Ɔsan nso yɛɛ kurowpɔn Nkran Ɔmantam Soafo wɔ John Kufuor aban ase.

Abatoɔ 
Wɔpaw Quaye sɛ mmarahyɛ baguani maa Ayawaso mfifini mantam a ɛwɔ kurowpɔn Nkran mantam mu wɔ Ghana wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow mu. Odii nkonim wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so. Ná ne mansin no yɛ mmarahyɛ bagua nkongua 16 no fã wɔ nkongua 27 a New Patriotic Party no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa kurowpɔn Nkran Mantam no mu. New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmarahyɛ bagua nkongua 128 wɔ nkongua 230 mu. Ɔde abatow mba 36,021 na edii nkonim no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu wɔ 67,404 mu. Ná eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu ɔha biara mu nkyem 53.4 yɛ pɛ. Odii nkonim wɔ Zalia Seidu a ofi People’s National Convention amanyɔkuw mu, Mariama Sinare a ofi National Democratic Congress amanyɔkuw mu, Christiana Martey a ofi Convention People’s Party amnyɔkuw mu ne Charles Boateng a ɔyɛ obi a ɔde ne ho. Eyinom nyaa abatow 858, 29,360, 482 ne 683 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu ɔha biara mu nkyem 1.3, ɔha biara mu nkyem 43.6, ɔha biara mu nkyem 0.7 ne ɔha biara mu nkyem 1.0 yɛ pɛ.

Wɔ afe 2008 mu no, odii nkonim wɔ amansan abatow no mu wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so. Ná ne mansin no ka mmarahyɛ bagua nkongua 18 a ɛwɔ nkongua 27 a New Patriotic Party no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu wɔ kurowpɔn Nkran Mantam mu no ho. New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmarahyɛ bagua nkongua 108 wɔ nkongua 230 mu. Wɔde abatow mba 30,915 paw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu mba 62,960 no mu. Ná eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu ɔha biara mu nkyem 49.1 yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Kwasi Ofei Agyemang a ofi National Democratic Congress, Zalia Seidu a ofi People’s National Convention, Daniel Kofi Aidoo a ofi Convention People’s Party ne Benjamin Bediako a ofi Democratic Freedom Party mu. Eyinom nyaa abatow 30,058, 622, 1,160 ne 205 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu ɔha biara mu nkyem 47.74, ɔha biara mu 0.99, ɔha biara mu nkyem 1.84 ne ɔha biara mu nkyem 0.33 yɛ pɛ.

Ankorankoro Asetra 
Quaye yɛ Nkramonyi. Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baanum.

title: Theresa Amerley Tagoe
text:
Theresa Amerley Tagoe (Wɔwoo no wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome ne da ɔto so du mmiɛnsa, afe 1943 mu ɛnna owuo yɛ wɔ afe 2010, Obubuo bosome ne da ɔto so aduonu nnum) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni. Na ɔka Ghana mmarahyɛbadwam a ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ 4th Republic mu. Na ogyina hɔ ma Ablekuma South mpesua no so fo wɔ MMrahyɛbadwa mu a na ɛwɔ Ghana . Na ɔyɛ amanyɔkuw New Patriotic Party mu ni.

Ne mmofraberem 
Wɔwoo Tagoe a ɔka Ga abusua kuw no ho no wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome ne da ɔto so du mmiɛnsa, afe 1943 mu.

Nhomasua 
Tagoe kɔɔ ntoasoɔ sukuu wɔ  Aburi Girls ntoasoɔ sukuu. Nana ɔyɛ Sukuufo no anodanyi(School Prefect). Onyaa abodin krataa, bachelor's degree wɔ French kasa mu wɔ Ghana suapɔn kunini no mu (University of Ghana).

Philanthropy 
Tagoe wɔ ntetee sukuu a ɛtete mmaa akyerɛkyerɛfo (girls' secretarial school), a French kasa ka nneɛma a wɔsua no ho. Ɔsan nso fii ase tee kuw a wɔhwɛ wɔn a wonni bi na na wɔn anisoadehunu ne sɛ wobɛhwɛ ngyanka ne mmaa a wɔnenam mbontenso ama w`asua adetɔn na na wɔsan bɔ guam adetɔnfoɔ bosea de di gua wɔ Nkran mmɔnten so.

Amanyɔsɛm 

Na Teresa Tagoe yɛ Nkran Mantam soafoɔ abadiekyir (Deputy Greater Accra Minister) ne ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ nsaase, kwaa ne abodeɛ mu ndepa so (Deputy Minister for Lands, Forestry and Mines) abadiekyir aber a ɔmanpanyin John Agyekum Kuffour di ade no.

Tagoe asan ayɛ adwuma sɛ mmaa ano boaboafo wɔ ɔman Ghana mu wɔ amanyɔkuw New Patriotic Party kuw no mu.

Wɔtoo aba yii no kɔɔ mmrahyɛbadwa fie wɔ ɔpɛpɔn bosome ne da ɔto so nson, afe 1997 mu, aber a odii nkonim wɔ afe 1996 Ghanafoɔ abatoɔ no mu. Onyaa aba no mu ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu aduasa nkron ne akyirpɔw nkron(39.90%) fii aba dodow a wɔtow no mu. Aba dodow a onyaa yɛ 47,644, na wɔn a odii wɔn so nkonim no nye Ebo Hawkson a ɔyɛ National Democratic Congress amanyɔkuw no ba. Ebo nso nyaa aba no mu  42,568, kyerɛ ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu aduasa nnum ne akyirpɔw nson (35.70%).

Tagoe yɛ Kristoni. Teresa wɔ mba mbarima ebien.

Legacy 
Tagoe somee sɛ  Council of State kuw no muni na ɔsan tenaa  Council of Women World Leaders kuw no mfe pii.

title: Kofi Konadu Apraku
text:
Kofi Konadu Apraku yɛ ɔmanyɔni, ɔnim sika ntotoeɛsɛm ho na ɔsane ka mmrahyɛbedwafie a ɛtɔso mmienu, mmiɛnsa ne nan wɔ Ghana adehyeman amanmuo a ɛtɔso nan. Ɔyɛ ɔmanyɔni ma NPP amanyɔkuo no. Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbedwani ma Offinso Atifi mpɛsoa wɔ mmrahyɛbedwafie a ɛtɔso nan wɔ Ghana adehyeman amanmuo ɛtɔso nan.

Abrabɔ ne nnwomasua

Ɔwoo Kofi wɔ Akumadan a ɛwɔ Asante mantam wɔ Ɛbɔ bosome ne da ɛtɔso nson wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduonum nan(1954). Ɔkɔɔ ntoasoɔ sukuu wɔ Tweneboah Kodua firi afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduosia nson(1967)de kɔsi afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduowɔtwe mmienu(1972) ɛna ɔkɔ toaso wɔ South Albany a ɛwɔ Oregon U.S.A abrokyire man mu ɛkyire ɔdii nkunim wɔ AFS International Essay akansie no, ɔkɔɔ sua sedeɛ yɛ toto sikasɛm wɔ Oregon State suapɔn sukuu wɔ USA abrokyire man mu na ɔnyaa n'abɔdin krataa.

Adwuma

Na Kofi ka New Partnership for Africa Development na ɔsane yɛ ɔsuafɔ ma Mantam nkabom wɔ ɔmanpanin dada John Agyekum Kufour berɛ so wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne mmiɛnsa(2003) de kɔsi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nsia(2006). Ɔsane som sɛ ɔsuafoɔ ma dwadie ne nnwuma so wɔ ɔmanpanin dada John Agyekum Kufour wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne baako(2001) de kɔsi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmiɛnsa(2013). Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe(2008) Economic Community of West Africa(ECOWAS) yii no wɔ asuafoɔ a ɔhwɛ sikasɛm ntotoeɛsɛm ho mmra ne sikasɛm ntotoeɛ nhwehwɛmu a ɔsane hwɛ dodoɔ nhwehwɛmu yie berɛ no berɛ no wɔ nkabom wɔ sikasɛm ntotoeɛ ma ECOWAS nkrofoɔ, ma ɔhwɛ sɛ kwan a ECOWAS ka sɛ  ɔbɛka sika nyinaa abom no bɛyɛ adwuma. Na ɔsane kasa fa no so ma Aman nyinaa sika korabea International Monetary Fund(IMF), African Development sika korabea ne sika korabea ɛkeka ho a ɛbeboa ECOWAS nkɔsoɔ.

Amanyɔsɛm

Ɔdikan de Kofi Konadu Apraku ba mmrahyɛbedwafie wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome ne da ɛtɔso nson wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduokron nson(1997) ma ne mpɛsoa. Ɔnyaa mma mpem du ɔha nan ne aduonum nsia(10,456) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu abupɛn aduasa nson n'akyiri pɔ aduowɔtwe(37.80%) firii mma mpem aduonu baako ɔha nan ne aduonu nnwɔtwe(21,428). Ɔne Nana Oduro Baah a ɔwɔ NDC amanyɔkuo a ɔnyaa mma mpem du ɔhanu ne aduonum nson(10,257) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu abupɛn aduasa nson n'akyiri pɔ du(37.10%), Manu Yaw Joseph a ɔwɔ PNC a ɔnyaa mma ahasa ne aduonum nnwɔtwe(358) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu abupɛn baako n'akyiri pɔ aduasa(1.30%) ne Emmanuel Kwame Boakye a ɔwɔ IND amanyɔkuo a ɔnyaa mma ahasa ne aduonum nson(357) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu abupɛn aduasa(1.30%) mo nyinaa n'akɔɔ akansie.  Ɔsane yii no baa mmrahyɛbedwafie wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome ne da ɛtɔso nson wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne baako(2001) wɔ berɛ a ɔdii nkunim wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu abatoɔ mu no, ɔnyaa mma mpem du mmiɛnsa ɔha ne aduosia(13,160) de firii mma aduonu baako ɔha num ne aduanan ne mmiɛnsa(21,543) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu abupɛn aduosia baako(61%). Ɔsane baa mmrahyɛbedwafie biom sɛ mmrahyɛbedwani ma Offinso Atifi mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Asante mantam wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan(2004) abatoɔ kɛseɛ no mu a ɔnyaa mma mpem du mmiɛnsa ahasa ne aduowɔtwe nkron(13,389) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu abupɛn aduonum n'akyire pɔ aduasa(50.30%). Na ɔka nnipa du nson a ɔgyina wɔ abatoɔ wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nson(2007) a NPP amanyɔkuo nyaa ma wɔn kandifoɔ a ɔgyinaa ma amanyɔkuo no wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe abatoɔ no mu.

title: J. H. Owusu Acheampong
text:
'Bold text'Bold text'''== Joseph Henry Owusu Acheampong''' yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɔni sane mmrahyɛbedwani wɔ mmrayɛbedwafie a ɛtɔso mmienu wɔ Ghana adehyeman amanmuo a ɛtɔso nan. Na ɔyɛ mmrahyebedwani ma Berekum mpɛsoa so ma NDC amanyɔkuo no. ==

Abrabɔ ahyɛaseɛ 
Ɔwoo Owusu Acheampong wɔ Bono mantam. Ɔgyee n'abɔdin krataa edikan wɔ kuayɛ mu wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn sukuu. Akyire ɔkɔ toa n'adesua so wɔ London abrokyire man mu ɛhɔ na ɔnyaa n'abɔdin krataa ɛtɔso mmienu wɔ kuayɛ ne sikasɛm ho wɔ London Suapɔn sukuu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ɔyii no baa mmrahyɛbedwafie a edikan wɔ Ghana adehyeman amanmuo a ɛtɔso nan wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome ne da ɛtɔso nson wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduokron mmiɛnsa akyire a ɔdii nkunim wɔ Ghana abatoɔ keseɛ a ɔtoo no Ɔpɛnimaa bosome ne da ɛtɔso aduonu nkron wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduokron mmienu.

Ɔsane baa mmrahyɛbedwafie a ɛtɔso mmienu wɔ Ghana adehyeman amanmuo a ɛtɔso nan wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduokron nson akyire a Ghana abatoɔ keseɛ aba no wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne nsia.

Ɔdii Michael Kojo Adusah a ɔgyina mu ma NPP amanyɔkuo no ɔnyaa ɔha mu abupɛn aduanan n'akyiri pɔ aduasa(41.30%) na deɛ ɔne no kɔɔ akansie nso nyaa ɔha mu abupɛn aduonu nnwɔtwe n'akyire pɔ aduowɔtwe. Akyire a Acheampong som ne mpɛsoa berɛ baako no ɔsii n'adwene pi sɛ ɔnkɔ akansie no biom nanso ɔde ne ho maa n'amanyɔkuo no.

N'asetena mu abrabɔ 
Ɔwu wɔ Ayɛwohomumɔ bosome ne da ɛtɔso du mmiɛnsa wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne du nson.

title: Nicholas K. Adjei-Kyeremeh
text:
Nicholas K.Agyei Kyeremeh yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɔni sane yɛ mmrahyɛbedwani wɔ mmrahyɛbedwafie a ɛtɔso mmienu wɔ Ghana adehyeman amammuo a ɛtɔso nan no. Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbedwani ma Dormaa Atifi mpɛsoa so a ɛwɔ Bono mantam. Ɔsom berɛ baako pɛ wɔ mmrahyɛbedwafie.

Abrabɔ ahyɛaseɛ 
Yɛ woo Adjei Kyeremeh wɔ Dormaa Atifi a ɛwɔ Bono mantam.

Amanyɔsɛm 
NDC amanyɔkuo na dikan yi Adjei Kyeremeh wɔ mmrahyɛbedwafie berɛ a ɔtoo Ghana abatoɔ keseɛ wɔ Dormaa Atifi mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Bono mantam wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduokron nsia(1996). Ɔde mma mpem nkron ne ɔha ne mmiɛna(9,103) firi mma mpem du nsia ɔha nkron ne du nkron(16,919) wei gyina hɔ ma ɔha mu abupɛn aduasa nkron akyiri pɔ du(36.10%) de tia Stephen Adomako Yeboah ɔwɔ NPP amanyɔkuo no ɔnyaa mma apem ɔha nan ne aduosia mmiɛnsa(1,463) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu abupɛn aduonu nkron akyiri pɔ aduasa(29.60%) ne Gyabah Samuel a ɔgyina mu maa PNC amanyɔkuo a ɔno nso nyaa mma ɔha mmiɛnsa ne aduonum mmiɛnsa a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu abupɛn baako akyiri pɔ aduanan(1.40%)wɔ Ghanafoɔ dodoɔ a ɛkɔ too aba no mu.

title: Amadu Ali
text:
Amadu Ali yɛ  Ghanani amanyɔni ne ɔkyerɛkyerɛni. Ɔsomm sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani maa Atebubu South abatoɔ mpasua a na,ɛwɔ kane  Brong Ahafo mantam wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so mmienu no mu wɔ Ghana adehyeman nan mu.

Nahyɛase ne Ne Sukuu kɔ 
Wɔwoo Ali wɔ Kitawonsa bosome da ɛtɔ so aduasa baako wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduonum mmiɛnsa.  Ɔkɔɔ Tamale  'Business ' ntoasoɔ sukuu, ɛhɔ na ɔnyaa abɔdin wɔ 'West African Examination Certificate ' na, akyire ɔkɔ toaa nadesua so wɔ  Cape Coast Suapɔn mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔtoo aba yii Ali kɔɔ mmarahyɛbadwafie deɛ ɛdi kan wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduokron mmienu wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwa abatoɔ akonwa abatoɔ no mu. Ɔno  ne Nipa a Ɔdii kan kɔɔ mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛdi kan wɔ Ghana adehyeman nan mu wɔ Kyiniɛ Amanyɔnkuo (National Democratic Congress ) din mu.

Ɔsane bɛyɛɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ Ghana Adehyeman  nnan mu bere  a wɔtoo aba yii no wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduokron nsia Ghanafoɔ abatoɔ no mu. Ne dwumadie sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani no baa awieɛ wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da a ɛtɔ so nsia mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne baako no mu. Ɔsane gyina maa wɔtoo ne so aba yii no bio wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu abatoɔ Ghanafoɔ abatoɔ no mu. Ɔnyaa akonwa no bere a Ɔnyaa mma no mpem mmiɛnsa ahensia aduanan -nnum . Na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma Atebubu South abatoɔ mpasua so wɔ National Democratic Congress firi Ɔpɛpɔn da a ɛtɔ so nson wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduokron mmiɛnsa kɔ si sɛ Owura  Emmanuel Owusu Manu tuu no adeɛ so wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnan abatoɔ no mu bere a ɔpue  firii Atebubu-Amantin abatoɔ mpasua so.

Abatoɔ 
Ɛwɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnan Ghanafoɔ abatoɔno mu, Ali dii nkunim bere a Ɔnyaa mma no mpem du ahanu ne aduanan nnum(10,245 votes) a ɛkyerɛ ɔha mu abupɛn aduonum mmienu  akyire po aduoson(52.70%) firii mma dodoɔ a Wɔtoeɛ a,ɛyɛ mpem du-nkron ahanan  aduasa (19,430 total votes ). Mumuni Ibrahim Mohammed  na,ɔgyina New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuo no din mu no nyaa mma no mpem nsia  ne ahansia (6,600 votes ) a ɛkyereɛ ɔha mu abupɛn aduasa -nnan (34.00%). Deɛ na ɔka ho repere akonwa no wɔ  National Reform Party (NRP)  din mu Owura George Kwasi Nyarko nso nyaa mma no apem ahenson ne aduokron nnan ( 1,794 vote) a ɛne ɔha mu abupɛn nkron  akyire po aduonu yɛ pɛ.(9.20%).  Mma a aka no Owura Anthony Kwame Amevor ɔgyina ma People's National Convention (PNC) ne  Annor Z. Nikitins ɔgyina ma,Convention People's Party (CPP) na ɛkyɛɛ. Wɔn nyaa mma ahanum ne aduonu nnan. Kyerɛ ɔha mu abupɛn mmienu ne akyire po aduoson ne Ɔha mu abupɛn baako ne akyire po aduanan sɛ deɛ wɔn din toa so no

title: Cina Soul
text:
Christie Quincyna Quarcoopome a yɛnim no sɛ Cina Soul yɛ Ghana ndwomtoni ne nnwom kyerɛwfo ne nnwom a wɔkyere gu kasɛt so.  Ɔyɛ obi a ɔdii kan wɔ afe 2014 Vodafone Ghana Music Icons akansi a wɔyɛeɛ wɔ Accra, Ghana.

Mfitiase asetra 
Wɔwoo Christie Quincyna Quarcoopome na wɔtetee no wɔ Kokomlemle, Ghana, Accra maa n’awofoɔ a wɔyɛ Ghanafoɔ na ɔfiri Jamestown wɔ Accra. Ɔyɛ Ga Abusuakuo a ɛwɔ Ghana kuromni. Cina Soul nyaa ne Junior High sukuu wɔ Deyoungsters International School na Senior high school adesua wɔ Aburi Girls Senior High School na ɔkɔɔ so suaa adwene ne fam tutu wɔ Ghana Sukuupɔn mu. Cina yɛ mmofra baasa mu nea ɔto so abien, ɔwɔ onuawa panyin ne kumaa a wɔn nyinaa yɛ nnwontofo a wɔn ho akokwaw; talente a ebia anka wobenya afi wɔn agya hɔ.

Nnwom ho adwuma

Adwuma a ɔyɛe mfiase 
Cina Soul mmɔdenbɔ a ɛdi kan a ɔbɔɔ nnwom ne sɛ ɔde ne ho hyɛɛ Vodafone Ghana Music Icons mu wɔ afe 2014 mu na ɔdaa ne ho adi sɛ obi a ɔdii kan. Ɛno akyi no yɛhunuu mashups ne covers a ɛtoatoa so a ɛfa nnwom titire bi a Mr Eazi 's Bankulize ne Cyna's Bamidele ka ho.  Wɔ afe 2016 mu no, Cina yii ne album a edi kan, 'Metanoia' a M.anifest, Worlasi ne KiDi, record a ɛmaa no kɔɔ anim, na ɛmaa onyaa baabi wɔ charts mu denam singles so; Awo ne Julor.  Cina Soul de ne ho hyɛɛ Black Girls Glow Project a Dzyadzorm ne Poetra Asantewa na wɔhyɛɛ aseɛ wɔ afe 2017 mu no mu kɛseɛ. Wɔ nnwom te sɛ Adomaa, Fu ne Ria Boss akyi no, kuw no yii wɔn nnwom nhoma a edi kan, Mother of Heirs adi wɔ July 2017.  Cina Soul yɛɛ nnwom wɔ Allianz Awards,  Goethe-Institut wɔ December 2017 mu kaa Nana Yaa ho wɔ "Ghana Goes Germany",  Vodafone Ghana Music Awards wɔ afe 2017. Ɔsan nso yɛɛ n’ankasa kɔnsɛt, ‘Metanoia X’.

title: Nana Akomea
text:
Nana Akomea yɛ obi a yɛwoo no ɔsanaa 5, 1961. Ɔyɛ Ghana mmrahyɛ badwani a wasom sɛ mmmrahyɛ badwa ma Okaikwei South  firi afe 1997 kɔsi 2009, a ɔgyina hɔ ma New Patriotic Party.

NABRABƆ NE SUKUU HO NSƐM
Akomea firi nsutam a ɛwɔ fanteakwa mansini wɔ eastern  mantam, Ghana. Wɔ afe 1996 mu no, Akomea nyaa ne Post Graduate Degree wɔ Communication Studies mu firii University of Ghana hɔ.

ADWUMA A ƆYƐ
Akomea yɛ nsenkyerɛni ne Dawurubɔ ni ɛna Nkitahodie nimdefo. Ɔyɛɛ adwumaq wɔ Focal Point Advertising Company ansa na ɔrebɛyɛ mmrahyɛbadwani.

MMRAHYƐ BADWA MU NSƐM

Akomea was the Director of Communications for the New Patriotic Party. He held this position since 31 January 2011 after the resignation of Kwaku Kwarteng, the previous director. In the political space, he has been the minister of information (2003-2005), and the Minister for Manpower Development and Employment (2007-2009).

ABATOƆ NO MU NSƐM
Yɛdii kan yii Akomea sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma Okaikwei Anafoɔ mpatam wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa nnum ne nan adehyeman,Ghana. Yɛ yii ne sɛ kannifoɔ ɔnyaa aba 35,438 a yɛte firi aba no nyina mu a ɛyɛ 64,916 de ɛkyerɛ 54.6%. Yɛyii no gyaa Isaac Mensah a ɔyɛ National Democratic Congress ni. William Aryee a ɔyɛ Democratic Freedom Party ni ɛna Anthony Mensah A ɔyɛConvention People's Party ni. Wɔn nyinaa nyaa 39.77%, 0.36% and 5.28% ne kwanso ne kwanso wɔ aba a wɔnyaeɛ no mu.

1996 ABATOƆ
Akomea gyinaa maa ne mantam wɔ tikiti a ɛyɛ New Patriotic Party wɔ afe 1996 Ghana Abatoɔ kɛseɛ no mu. Ɔdii Agbemor Yeboah Ernest a ɔyɛ National Democratic Congress so nkonim wɔ 44.70%  a ɛyɛ aba 35,284. Aberɛ a neɛ ɔne no pere yɛ no nso nyaa 29.00% a ɛyɛ aba 22,928 .

NE SOM ABRABƆ
Ɔyɛ Okristoni (Presbyterian) ne Osigyani sane wɔ mma mmienu.

title: Theresa Nyarko-Fofie
text:
Theresah Nyarko Fofie yɛ Ghana amanyɔni sane yɛ mmrahyɛbedwani wɔ mmrahyɛbedwafie a ɛtɔso mmienu wɔ Ghana adehyeman amanmuo a ɛtɔso nan. Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbedwani ma Nkronza mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Bono mantam ma NDC amanyɔkuo no.

Abrabɔ ahyɛaseɛ 
Ɔwoo Nyarko Fofie wɔ Ɛbɔ bosome ne da a ɛtɔso du mmienu wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduonum wɔ Bono mantam wɔ akrisfoɔ abusua mu.

Ɔnyaa n'abɔdin krataa edikan wɔ nnwomasua mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn sukuu mu, na ɔyɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ ansa n ɔwura amanyɔsɛm mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ɔyii Nyarko Fofie wɔ mmrahyɛbedwafie wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome ne da ɛtɔso nson wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne adukron nson(1997)  aberɛ ɔdii nkunim wɔ a Ghana  abatoɔ kɛseɛ a ɔtoo no afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduokron nsia(1996). Ɔdii Yaw Kudom a ɔwɔ NPP amanyɔkuo so nkunim. Theresah de ɔha mu abupɛn aduanan nkron n'akyiri pɔ aduoson(49.70%) na Yaw Kudom nso dnyaa ɔha mu abupɛn du nnwɔtwe n'akyiri pɔ hwee(18.00%). Ɔsom mmrahyɛbedwafie mfeɛ nan wieɛ no ɔsi n'adwene pɔ sɛ ɔnsane mma biom Hayford Francis Amoako n'asii na nan wɔ mfe mpem(2000) Ghana abatoɔ keseɛ no mu na ɔbaa n'adwuma mu Ɔpɛpɔn bosome ne da ɛtɔso nson wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne baako(2001).

title: Richard Winfred Anane
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Richard Winfred Anane  yɛ obi a yɛwoo no ɔbɛnim 12,1954.ɔyɛ oduruyɛfoɔ ne Seisei ghana mmrahyɛbadwani a ɔsan yɛ soafoɔ ma Ɛkwan ne Kwantempɔn nsem so, soafoɔ ma Apomuden nsem so sane yɛ mmrahyɛbadwa mu nnipa a wasom Nhyiaeso firi afe 1997 de kɔsi 2017.

N’ABRABƆ NE SUKUU MU NSƐM

Ɔfiri Santasi a ɛwɔ Ashanti mantam. Ɔgyee ne ntoasoɔ sukuu mu nteteeɛ wɔ Asanteman Senior High School. Wɔ afe 1983 mu nk, Anane  abasobɔdeɛ wɔ MB CHB mu firii Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology (KNUST) a ɛwɔ Kumase.

ADWUMA A ƆYƐ
Na Anane yɛ dokotani wɔ Hebron Ayaresabea a ɛwɔ Bantama ansa na ɔrebɛyɛ mmrahyɛ badwa mu nnipa wɔ afe  1997 mu.

MMRAHYƐ BADWA MU NSƐM
Anane ka New Patriotic Party ho. ɔgyinaa wɔ2012 Ghana abatoɔ kɛseɛ no wɔ tikiti a ɛyɛ New Patriotic Party ma ɔdii nkonim. abatoɔ no mu no ɔnyaa aba 36,067 firi aba 47, 535 mu de ɛgyina hɔ ma 75.9%. Wɔ 2012 abatoɔ no mu no, ɔbɛdaa sonoko wɔ ne mansini mu hɔ. Anane som wɔ afa afa beberee mu. Mpo ɔbɛhyɛɛ John Agyekum Kufuor ase sɛ soafo a ɔhwɛ apɔmuden nsem so ne soafoɔ a ɔhwɛ ɛkwan ne kwantempɔn nsem so firi afe 2001 de kɔsi 2006 mu.

N’ABATOƆ MU NSƐM
Yɛdii kan yii Anane sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani ma Nhyiaeso Mansini a ɛyɛ Ashanti Region, Ghana wɔ 2004 Ghana abatoɔ kɛseɛ no. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ tikiti a ɛyɛ New Patriotic Party.  Na ne Mansini ka aduosa mmiensa mmrahyɛbadwa akonnwa a sɛ yɛte firi aduasa nkron a wɔdii nkonim ma New Patriotic Party abatoɔ no mu ma  Ashanti Region.  New Patriotic Party dii nkonim naa a na ɛyɛ Mmrahyɛbadwa akonnwa 128 sɛ yɛte firi nkonnwa 230 mu a. Ɔde aba 36,307 a yɛte firi 46,626 mu na ɔde nyaa mmrahyɛbadwa akonwa no. Yɛkeka abatoɔ no nyinaa bɔm no na ɛyɛ 77.9% . Yɛyii no gyaa Eric Baah-Nuako a na ɔyɛ National Democratic Congress ni ne Kwame Appiah Boateng a ɔno nso yɛ Convention People's Party ni. Yɛkeka bɔɔ mu no, wɔnyaa aba 8,908 ne 1,411 sɛ neɛ ɛteɛ. A na ɛyɛ 19.1% ne 3% wɔ aba no nyinaa mu.

Wɔ afe 2008 mu nso Ɔdii nkonim wɔ Ghana abatoɔ kɛseɛ no mu wɔ tikiti a ɛyɛ New Patriotic Party ma mansini korɔ no a biom.Na ne Mansini ka mmrahyɛbadwa aduasa nnan a yɛte firi aduasa nkron akonnwa no a New Patriotic Party nyaeɛ wɔ abatoɔ no mu ma Ashanti Region no. .  New Patriotic Party dii nkonim no ara wɔ mmrahyɛbadwa akonwa no mu ma wɔnyaa.109 sɛ yɛte firi 230 mu a. Yɛyii no wɔ aba 36,067 ɔnyaeɛ no mu sɛ yɛ te tiri 47,535 mu a ɛyɛ abatoɔ no nyinaa. Yɛkeka abatoɔ no nyinaa bɔm no na ɛyɛ 75.87%. Ɔdii Joseph Bernard Boadu a ɔyɛ National Democratic Congress ni, Kwame Appiah Boateng a ɔyɛ Convention People's Party ni, Kwaku Bonsu a ɔyɛ Reformed Patriotic Democrats ni ne Kwame Owusu a ɔno nso nko ara gyinaeɛ no nyinaa so nkonim. Wɔnyaa aba 9,426, 1,055, 197 ne 790 nnidisoɔ sa ara wɔ abatoɔ no nyinaa mu. A yɛkeka bɔm no na ɛyɛ 19.83%, 2.22%, 0.41% and 1.66% wɔ abatoɔ no mu.

Ɔsane dii nkonim wɔ Ghana abatoɔ kɛseɛ a yɛtoo no 2012 no mu wɔ tikiti a ɛyɛ, New Patriotic Party ma Mansini korɔ no ara. Ɔde aba 45,389 a yɛte firi aba ne nyinaa mu a ɛyɛ 56,558 na dii nkonim. yɛkeka aba no nyinaa bom a ɛyɛ 76.21% . Yɛyii no gyaa Nana Afua Anima a ɔyɛ National Democratic Congress ni, Yaw Sekyere a ɔyɛ Progressive People's Partyni, Emmanuel Dapaah a ɔyɛ Convention People's Party ne Peter Boakye-Yiadom a ɔyɛ National Democratic Party ni. Wɔnyaa aba 12,304, 666, 807 and 392 sɛ neɛ ɛsɛ wɔ abatoɔ ne nyinaa mu. a yɛkeka bom a ɛyɛ 20.66%, 1.12%, 1.35% and 0.66% Sɛneɛ ɛsɛ.

ƆSOM A ƆWOM
Anane yɛ Roman Catholic ni. Waware wɔ mma nnan.

BEAƐ A MENYAA MMOA FIRIIƐ

title: Kwame Osei-Prempeh
text:
Kwame Osei-Prempeh  Ghana mmrahyɛbadwani a yɛwoo no  Ɔpɛnima 19, 1957. Ɔka Mmrahyɛbadwa nnum a ɛyɛ Adehyeman, Ghana ma Nsuta-kwamang Beposo wɔ Asante mantam.

N'abrabɔ ne ne Sukuu mu nsɛm 
Yɛwoo Prempeh wɔ  Kwamang a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam, Ghana. Ɔkɔɔ sukuu wɔ Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology ma.Onyaa Degree wɔ Bachelor of Social Science mu wɔ afe 1982. Ɔsane toaso wɔUniversity of Ghana afe 1987 mu na ɛhɔ nso ɔkɔyɛɛ Quantum Chemistry Laboratory, QCL. Ɔsan kɔɔ sukuu biom wɔ Ghana school of Law ma onyaa Degree wɔ Bachelor of Law mu afe 1989.

Adwuma a ɔyɛ 
Na Prempeh ka adwumakuo Sarpong Legal Services a ɛwɔ Ashanti Region -Kumasi ho. Na ɔka mmrahyɛ badwa akonnwa ma Nsuta-Kwamang Beposo mansini a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam, Ghana. Ɔbɛyɛɛ Panin a ɔhwɛ ma biribiara totɔ yie wɔ Group Chief Executive a ɛwɔ GOIL Company Limited wɔ Ayewohomumu 3, 2019, ansa na ɔrebɛyɛ panin mfie mmienu akyi.

Mmrahyɛbadwani mu nsɛm 
Prempeh ka New Patriotic Party ho. Ɔno na yɛ dii kan yii no baa mmrahyɛbadwa mu wɔ ɔpɛnimaa, 1996 Ghana abatoɔ kɛseɛ no mu sɛ tikitu ma New Patriotic Party. Ɔgyinaeɛ no ɔnyaa abatoɛ 12,586  a yɛte firi abatoɔ 24,444 nnyinaa mu a ɛyɛ 51.5%  a ɛtu.Thomas Fokuo Agyepong a ɔyɛ NDC ni a aba 10,313 na ɔnyaeɛ de gyina hɔ ma 33.70%. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ afe 2000 Ghana abatoɔ kɛseɛ no mu wɔ ma onyaa aba 13,568 a yɛte firi 21,358 a ɛyɛ 63.50% a etia Ebenezer A. Frimpong Prempeh a ɔyɛ NDC ni, Osei O. Emmanuel a ɔyɛ NRP ni, Osei Kwadwo a ɔyɛ CPP ni, Salisu Muhammed a ɔyɛ PNC ni ne Kofi A. Kankam a ɔyɛ UGM ni a wɔn nyaa aba 6,889 aba 304, aba 285, aba 221, ne aba 91  nnidisoɔ sa ara. Ɔnyaa aba beberee a ɛyɛ 15,704 sɛ yɛte firi  aba 24,344 a ɛyɛ 64.50% de tia Samuel Otu a ɔyɛ NDC mu nnipa E.O.Adu-Amankwaah a ɔyɛ IND mu nnipa ne George Osei Owusu Amankwah a ɔyɛ CPP, wɔn nyaa  aba 7,769, 547 ne 324 nnidisoɔ sa ara. Ɔnyaa 17,403 a yɛte firi aba 24,879  ne mu a ɛgyina hɔ ma 69.95% mmerɛ a afe 2008 abatoɔ kɛseɛ no kɔɔ so no. Ɔdii Kwame Asafu-Adjei so nkonim wɔ 2012 abatoɔ kɛseɛ no mu.

Adwuma mu suahunu ahodoɔ 
Owura Osei-Prempeh wɔ osuahu pii a wanya wɔ Ɔman Adwumayɛ ne Ankorankoro Adwumayɛ mu sɛ mmaranimfo panyin. Ɔyɛɛ Ghana Mmaranimfoɔ Panyin Abadiakyiri ne Atemmuo soafoɔ firi June 2006 kɔsi Ɔpɛpɔn 2009 na na ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni ma Nsuta- Kwamang Beposo wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ afe 1997 ne 2013 ntam.

Bere a na ɔwɔ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no mu no, ɔyɛɛ Boayikuw a ɛhwɛ Amansan Mmara, Mmara ne Mmarahyɛ Bagua Nsɛm so ne Atemmu Boayikuw no Titenani.

N'asetena abrabɔ 
Prempeh yɛ ɔwarefoɔ a ɔwɔ mma nnan. Ɔyɛ kristoni na ɔkɔ Adventist Asɔre ho.

Abasobodeɛ 
Ghana mmrahyɛbadwani Kwame Prempeh enya abasobodeɛ CEO abasobodeɛ   wɔ Kotonima bosome a  ɛtɔ so aduonu mmienu mu wɔ Kempinski Hotel mmerɛ a CEO foɔ akukudam hyia yɛ.

title: Samuel Kwame Amponsah
text:
Samuel Kwame Amponsah yɛ amanyɔni , okuani ne mmrahyɛbɛdwani wɔ Ghana. Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbɛdwani ma Mpohor-Wassa East abatoɔ mpasua a ɛwɔ Atɔeɛ mantam mu. Ɔka National Democratic Congress amanyɔkuo a ɛwɔ Ghana  no ho.

Mfitiaseɛ ne nhomasua
Amponsah firi Ghana Atɔeɛ mantam mu. Ɔsuaa Nkontaabuo nyaa ne PhD wɔ Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology wɔ Ghana.

Adwuma
Amposah yɛ ɔsraani.

Amanyɔsɛm
Na Amponsah ka Mmarahyɛbɛdwafie a ɛtɔ so mmienu ne mmiɛnsa wɔ Ghana adehyeɛ mmerɛ a ɛtɔ so nnan no ho. Amponsah ka National Democratic Congress amanyɔkuo no ho. Afei nso na ɔyɛ  Mpohor-Wassa East abatoɔ mpasua no nanmusini wɔ aban mu. Ne dwumadi wɔ amanyɔsɛm mu no firii aseɛ berɛ a odii nkonim sɛ National Democratic Congress mmarahyɛbɛdwani wɔ Mpohor-Wassa East abatoɔ mpasua so wɔ afe 2000. Amponsah nyaa abatoɔ no mu dodoɔ 20,352 a ɛyɛ ɔha mu nkyɛmu aduanan ne akyiripɔw nson. Nnipa dodoɔ a wɔtoo aba wɔ saa abatoɔ mpasua so ma ɛyɛɛ yie no dodoɔ yɛ 38,121. Afoforɔ a wogyina maa wɔtoo wɔn so aba de kaa Amponsah ho saa berɛ no ne Mary Stella Ankomah, Paul King Arthur ne Alex Bessah Dogbeh a wɔn nso wonyaa 15288, 1612 ne 909.

Afe 2000 abatoɔ
Wɔtoo aba yii Amponsah sɛ mmarahyɛbɛdwani ma Mpohor-Wassa East abatoɔ mpasua no wɔ afe 2000 ɔman Ghana abatoɔ mmerɛ no mu. Odii nkonim sɛ National Democratic congress amanyɔkuo no mu ni wɔ aban mu. Na n'akonwa nu ka nkonwa du-nkron a amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress nyaeɛ wɔ Atɔe mantam mu. National Democratic Congress nyaa nkonwa ahaanu nu mu dodoɔ aduokron mmienu wɔ aban mu, ɛno nti wɔbɛyɛɛ amanyɔkuo kumaa wɔ mmarahyɛbɛdwafie a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa wɔ Ghana adehyeɛ-mmerɛ a ɛtɔ so nnan wɔ afe 2000 no mu. Odii nkonim berɛ a onyaa mma 31,515 no mu 11,674 a ɛyɛ ɔha mu nkyekyɛ mu aduasa ne akyiripɔw nnan. Afoforɔ a wogyina maa wɔtoo wɔn so aba kaa Amponsah ho ne Patrick Somiah Ehomah a ɔnyɛ amanyɔkuo biara mu ni, Peter Nnanwaan a na ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuo mu ni, Abraham Yankson a na ɔyɛ Convention People's Party amanyɔkuo mu ni, Stephen Blay a na ɔyɛ National Reformed Party amanyɔkuo mu ni, Richard Aduko Raqib a na ɔyɛ People's National Convention amanyɔkuo mu ni ne Patrick Tandoh Williams a na ɔyɛ United Ghana Movement amanyɔkuo mu ni. Mma dodoɔ a wɔn mu biara nyae ne  10,454, 6,869, 1,263 ne 300 sɛnea wɔn din no nnidisoɔ te wɔ ɔkasamu a edi eyi anim no. Ɛmu biara yɔ ɔha mu nkyɛmu 34.2 , 22.5, 4.1 ne 1.0 pɛpɛɛpɛ.

title: Kwadjo Agyei Addo
text:
Kwadjo Agyei Addo yɛ Ghana mmrahyɛbedwani sane yɛ ɔmanyɔni wɔ mmrahyɛbedwafie a ɛtɔso nan wɔ Ghana adehyeman a ɛtɔso nan. Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbedwani ma Fanteakwa Atifi mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Apueeɛ mantam.

Abrabɔ ahyɛaseɛ ne nnwomasua 
Ɔwoo Agyei Addo wɔ Ahinime bosome ne da ɛtɔso du num wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduonum baako wɔ Fanteakwa wɔ Apueeɛ mantam. Ɔkɔɔ Akrokerri Suapɔn sukuu ɛhɔ na ɔnyaa n'abɔdin krataa wɔ adekyerɛ mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
NPP amanyɔkuo na dii kan de Addo kɔɔ mmrahyɛbedwafie wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa bosome wɔ mfe mpem mmienu wɔ Ghana batoɔ kɛseɛ sɛ mmrahyɛbedwani ma Fanteakwa Atifi mpɛsoa so. Ɔnyaa mma mpem aduonu ɔha nnwɔtwe ne aduosia nson(20,867) firii mma mpem aduasa  nsia ɔha nnwɔtwe ne aduonum nnwɔtwe  a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu abupɛn aduonum nsia akyiri pɔ nsia(56.6%).  Ɔdii nkuguo wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe wɔ mmrahyɛbedwafoɔ abatoɔ edikan, Kwabena Amankwah Asiamah na nyaa aba no wɔ Ghana abatoɔ kɛseɛ no.

2004 Abatoɔ 
Ɔyii Addo wɔ mmrahyɛbedwafie sɛ mmrahyɛbedwani ma Fanteakwa Atifi mpɛsoa so wɔ mmrahyɛbedwafie ɛtɔso nan ne Ghana adehyeman amanmuo a ɛtɔso nan wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome ne da ɛtɔso nson wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne num de kɔsi Ɔpɛpɔn bosome ne da nsia wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne nkron. Wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne nan wɔ Ghana abatoɔ kɛseɛ. Ɔdii nkunim wɔ Samuel Ofosu Ampofo a ɔwɔ NDC amanyɔkuo nyaa mma mpem du num ne ɔha nsia ne aduoson nnwɔtwe(15,678) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu abupɛn aduanan mmienu n'akyire pɔ mmienu(42.5%) ne Gyimah Aikins Nyantakyi a ɔwɔ CPP amanyɔkuo ɔno nso nyaa mma ahasa ne nsia(306) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu abupɛn hwee n'akyire pɔ nnwɔtwe(0.8%) wɔ nnipa dodoɔ ɔbɛtoo aba. Addo mpɛsoa so ka mpɛsoa aduonu mmienu a ɔdii nkunim maa NPP amanyɔkuo wɔ Apueeɛ mantam. Ne nyinaa mu no NPP amanyɔkuo no nyaa mmrahyɛbedwafie akonnwa ɔha ne aduonu nnwɔtwe wɔ mmrahyɛbedwafie a ɛtɔso nan  wɔ Ghana adehyeman a ɛtɔso nan.

Adwuma 
Ɔyɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛni sane yɛ sika dwuma.

Asetena ne abrabɔ 
Kwadjo Agyei Addo yɛ ɔkristoni.

title: Adina (ndwomtoni)
text:
Adina Thembi Ndamse (awo bere 3 October) a yɛnim no sɛ  Adina yɛ Ghana ne South Africani ndwomtoni a ɔwɔ Ghana. Ɔdii kan akansie bi a wɔfrɛ no "stars of the Future"  wɔ afe 2008 mu. Ne ndwom a eto so nnwotwe a ɔtoo no din "aka ekyi" , ma no nyaa abasobɔdeɛ no mmprenu so -- ndwomtoni baa a ɔbɔ ne ho mmɔden wɔ afe 2018 wɔ "Vodafone Ghana Music Awards" afahye wɔ ɔman Ghana mu. Wɔ ɔpɛnim bosom afe 2021, na ɔka mmaa akukudam wɔ ndwom toɔ mu ɛwɔ "3Music Awards Women's Brunch

Mmɔfrase Abrabɔ 
Adina hyɛ ndwom to ase ne mmɔfra bere mu.Ɔkɔɔ sukuu wɔ  Wesley Girls High School". Ɔkɔɔ ntaosoɔ sukuu wɔ  Central University a ɔnyaa abɔdin nkrataa wɔ "Environmental and Development Studies".  Ne mmɔfra bere mu no ɔde ne ho dom ndwom toɔ kuo bi a yɛ frɛ no "National Theater Choir". Saa bere no mu no, ɔbɔ ne ho mmɔden paa.

Adina nyaa din wɔ bere a ɔbɔɔ ne ho mmɔden wɔ dwom kuo afahye bi a yɛfre no "Stars of the Future", nnipa kuo a wɔ hyehye saa dwuamadie yi yɛ "Charter House Ghana" a  ɔdii kan wɔ mu.

title: Anthony K Gyapong-Mensah
text:
Anthony K. Gyapong-Mensah yɛ Ghanani amanyɔni ne mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ  Ghana mmarahyɛbadwa ɛtɔ so mmienu ne mmiɛnsa wɔ Ghana adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu. Na ɔgyina hɔ sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani de ma Juabeso abatoɔ mpasua a ɛwɔ Atɔeɛ mantam mu (Western Region).

Na ɔka National Democratic Congress amanyɔkuo a ɛwɔ  Ghana ha no ho.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Na Gyapong-Mensah ka mmarahyɛbadwa aɛtɔ so mmienu ne mmiɛnsa  wɔ Ghana adehyeman nnan no ho. Wɔtoo aba yii no kane sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ Ghanafoɔ abatoɔ a Wɔtoo no wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduokron nsia no mu. Ɔnyaa mma ni mpem aduasa nwɔtwe, ahanum ne aduasa - nkron( 38,539 votes) firii mma mpem aduanan -nsia ahanan ne aduonu- nson a wɔtoeɛ no mu a ɛkyerɛ ɔha mu abupɛn aduosia baako akyire po aduonum. Bere a Owura Aborampah Aseidu-Mensah a ɔgyina ma,New Patriotic Party no nso nyaa mma  no mpem nson ahenwɔtwe  ne aduowɔtwe - nwɔtwe (7,888 votes ) ɛna Owura Ayuba Tank a ɔgyina ma  People's National Convention no nso nyaa hwee( 0 Votes).

Owura Kingsley Asoah-Apima firii akonwa no so na ɔbɛdii n'adeɛ ɛna ɔno so firii mmrahyɛbadwa nkonwa no so Owura Sampson Ahi na ɔbɛtenaa so. Na,ɔyɛ Kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuoni ( National Democratic Congress) na ɔgyina hɔ ma Juabeso abatoɔ mpasua a ɛwɔ Atɔeɛ mantam( Western Region) wɔ Ghana ha  Na amanyɔsɛm adwuma no hyɛɛ aseɛ bere a ɔgyina maa Wɔtoo ne so aba wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu Ghanafoɔ abatoɔ  no mu wɔ National Democratic Congress din mu.

Abatoɔ 
Wɔtoo aba yii Gyapong-Mensah sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani de ma amanfoɔ wɔte Juabeso  mantam mu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu Ghanafoɔ  abatoɔ no mu. Ɔdii nkunim wɔ  National Democratic Congress din mu. Na ne mpasua ka mpasua nkron a National Democratic Congress dii nkunim wɔ mu ni ho firii mpasua du-nkron no mu wɔ  abatoɔ a wɔtoo no wɔ Atɔeɛ Mantam(Western Region). National Democratic Congress amanyɔkuo no bɛyɛɛ dɔmkumaa wɔ mmarahyɛbadwafie bere a wɔnyaa mmarahyɛbadwa nkonwa no aduokron -mmienu  firii mmarahyɛbadwa  nkonwa ahanu no mu wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwa ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no mu wɔ Ghana Adehyeman nnan mu.  Ɔnyaa mma no mpem aduonu mmiɛnsa  ahenkron aduanan- nnum  (23,945 votes) firii mma mpem Ahasa nson, ahenkron ne baako (37,901 total votes ) a,wɔtoeɛ no mu. Yei ne Ɔha mu abupɛn aduosia mmiɛnsa  akyire po nsia yɛ pɛ.

Wɔtoo aba no maa gyaa Christopher Sakpaku a na ɔgyina,hɔ ma New Patriotic Party, Andoh Tandoh Michael na ɔgyina hɔ ma National Reformed Party, Samuel Alex A. Larbi na,ɔgyina hɔ ma Convention People's Party, Sharif Abubakar Nkrumah na ɔgyina hɔ ma People's National Convention and Minnah Kenndey na ɔgyina hɔ ma United Ghana Movement. Wɔnom nyaa mma no  mpem du ahenan aduokron baako( 10,491), apem ahenson aduanan nnum(1,745), ahenson ne aduokron mmiɛnsa ( 793), ahenum ne du-baako(511) ne ɔha ne aduoson mmienu ( 172) sɛ deɛ wɔn din didi soɔ no equivalent to 27.9%, 4.6%, 2.1%, 1.4% and 0.5% respectively of total valid votes cast.

title: Ahmed Musah
text:
Ahmed Musah yɛ Ghanani amanyɔni a ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so mmienu a na ɔgyina Asokwa East abatoɔ mpasua so wɔ Asante mantam mu wɔ Ɔman Ghana mu.

Abrabɔ ahyaseɛ 
Wɔwoo Musah wɔ Asokwa East wɔ Asante mantam mu a ɛwɔ Ghana man mu.

Amanyɔ 
Ɔyii Musah sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ manyɔ kuo NDC din mu wɔ afe mpem mmienu Ghana abatoɔ mu wɔ Asokwa East abatoɔ mpasoa so a ɛwɔ Asante mantam mu. Ɔdii Othman Baba Yahya, a ɔyɛ mantam no mu ekuo ba de mma mpem aduasa, aha mmiɛnsa ne aduowɔtwe mmienu (30,382) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduonu-nsia akyire pɔ aduoson (26.70%).  Dr. Edward Baffoe Bonne a ɔyɔ New Patriotic Party amanyɔ kuo no ba bɛtuu no adeɛ so. Ɔsome sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani mfeɛ nnan.

Adwumayɔ 
Musah yɛ Ghanani amanyɔni a ɔsom sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma Ɔmanfoɔ a ɔwɔ Asokwa East abatoɔ mpasoa so wɔ Asante mantam mu firi afe apem ahankron aduokron nson kɔ pem afe mpem mmienu ne baako mu(1997 -2001).

title: Seidu Paakuna Adamu
text:
Seidu Paakuna Adamu yɛ Ghana amanyɔni a na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma mmarahyɛbɛdwafie a ɛtɔ so mmienu ne mmiɛnsa ɛwɔ Ghana adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nnan. Ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbɛdwani dadaa a na ogyina mu ma Bibiani mpɛsua wɔ Atoeɛ mantam ɛna na ɔsan nso gyina mu ma NDC amanyɔkuo no.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Adamu yɛɛ mmarahyɛbadwani maa mmarahyɛbadwafie a na ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa wɔ Ghana adehyeman a na ɛtɔ so nnan mu. Ɔka NDC amanyɔkuo no ho na afei nso ogyinaa mu maa Bibiani mpɛsua wɔ Atoeɛ mantam wɔ Ghana. N'amanyɔkuo adwuma no hyɛɛ aseɛ firii ɛberɛ a 1996 Ghana abatoɔ keseɛ no, ɛberɛ a odii nkunim maa NDC amanyɔkuo no.Onyaa mma 24,437 firii mma 37,712 mu a ɛkyerɛ ɔha nkyekyemu 52.30%. Odii Christopher Addae a ogyinaa mu maa NPP amanyɔkuo no so nkunim nna ɔsan nso dii Moses Jasi-Addae a ɛyɛ EGLE kuo ba a ɔno nso nyaa mma 13,275 no so nkunim.

Mfeɛ mpem mmienu abatoɔ (2000 Elections) 
Ɔtoo aba yii Adamu maa no bɛ yɛɛ mmarahyɛbadwani maa Bibiani mpɛsua wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu (2000) wɔ Ghana abatoɔ kɛseɛ no mu. Odii nkunim wɔ abatoɔ no mu maa NDC amanyɔkuo no. Na ne mpɛsua no ka mmarahyɛbadwam nkonnwa nkron no ho, sɛ yɛ yi nkonnwa du-nkron a NDC nyaa no wɔ Atoeɛ mantam no mu a. NDC amanyɔkuo no na ɛnyaa domkumaa no, wɔ mmarahyɛbadwafie nkonnwa ahanu (200) no mu no, NDC amanyɔkuo no nyaa mu aduokron-mmienu (92) wɔ mmarahyɛbadwafie a na ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa wɔ Ghana adehyeman a na ɛtɔ so nnan mu. Ɔde mma 19,818 na ɛkɔɔ mmarahyɛbadwafie a na ɛno kyerɛ ɔha nkyekyemu 53.7% wɔ mma no nyina ara mu. Odii Christopher Addae a ogyinaa mu maa NPP amanyɔkuo ne Anthony K. Gyasi a ɔno nso gyinaa mu maa Convention People's Party ne Richard A. Donkor a na ɔno nso gyinaa mu maa  Reformed Party ne John Boakye Adae a na ɔno nso yɛ independent candidateni  no so nkunim.

title: Joseph Emmanuel Ackah
text:
Joseph Emmanuel Ackah yɛ Ghanani amanyɔni ne kuani a na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ mmarahyɛbadwafie a na edi kan, ne deɛ ɛtɔ so mmienu ne mmiɛnsa wɔ Ghana adehyeman a na ɛtɔ so nnan mu. Ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani dadaa ma Jomoro constituency wɔ Western Region na ogyina mu ma NDC amnyɔkuo no.

Abrabɔ ahyeaseɛ ne sukuu 
Wɔwoo Ackah wɔ Ɔsanaa bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduasa baako wɔ afe apem aha-nkron aduasa nnan mu (31 August 1934). Owiee ne Sukuu wɔ University of Ghana suapɔn mu. Onyaa abɔdini krataa a brɔfo kasa mu ɔfrɛ no 'Bachelor of Arts degree in history' wɔ Suapɔn no mu. Ackah san so kɔɔ  University of Cape Coast. Onyaa ' Post-graduate Certificate wɔ Education mu wɔ suapɔn no mu.

Adwumasɛm 
Ackah yɛ kuani a ɔbɔ ne ho mmɔdene paa ara yie.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ɔtoo aba yii Ackah wɔ 1992 Ghana mmarahyɛbadwam abatoɔ no wɔ mmrahyɛbadwam a edi kan wɔ Ghana adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu.

Ackah was first elected during the 1992 Ghanaian parliamentary election as member of the 1st parliament of the 4th republic. He succeeded James V. Leuven Mensah of the People's National Party(PNP). He is also a member of the 2nd and 3rd parliament of the 4th republic of Ghana. He is a member of the National Democratic Congress and a representative of the Jomoro constituency of the Western Region of Ghana. His political career began when he contested in the 1992 and won on the ticket of the National Democratic Congress. After the term ended, he contested again in the 1996 Ghanaian general elections and in 2000 Ghanaian general election

text:

N’ABRABƆ MU NSƐM 
Yɛwoo Boachie wɔ Tano anafoɔ fam a ɛwɔ e Brong Ahafo mantam, Ghana.

MMRAHYƐ BADWA MU NSƐM
Boachie na yɛdii kan yi no baa mmrahyɛbadwani mu wɔ tikiti  sɛ National democratic congress ni ma Tano anafoɔ fam mansin a ɛwɔ Brong-Ahafo region Mantam, Ghana. Wɔ gyinaeɛ no nnipa 13,390 na to maa no firi 24,879 nnipa a ɛbɛtoo aba no a ɛrekyerɛ 39.50% sɛ w’adi Rex Ofori-Agyeman so nkunim a ɔno nso nyaa 9,568 nnipa ma wɔn too aba maa no a ɛrekyerɛ 28.20%, Godfred Kwaku Oppong a ɔno nyaa 1,267nnipa ma wɔ to maa no no  de gyina hɔ ma 3.705%, Osman Asante-Bonsu nso nyaa 330 nnipa ma wɔn too aba maa no de kyerɛ 1.00% ne Daniel Kofi Nti nso a ɔnyaa 324 nnipa ma wɔn to maa no a ɛregina hɔ amma 1.00%.

N’ADWUMA AHYƐASEƐ

title: Samuel Oppong
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Samuel Oppong yɛ Ghana mmrahyɛbadwani na ɔka mmrahyɛbadwa mmienu a ɛyɛ nnan de gyina hɔ ms Agona Atɔeɛ mansin wɔ Central Region, Ghana.

N'abrabɔ
Yɛwoo Opoong wɔ Agona Atɔeɛ fam a ɛyɛ Mfinfii Region, Ghana.

Amanyɔsɛm
Oppong na yɛ yii no baa mmarahyɛbdwa mu wɔ tikiti a ɛyɛ National Democratic Congress ma Agona Atɔeɛ mansin mu wɔ Central Mantam, Ghana.

Oppong a ɔyɛ National Democratic Congress ni gyinaa abatoɔ ano nyaa aba 19,473  a ɛrekyerɛ 39.30% sɛ yɛ te firi aba 40,309  no mu a ɔde nyaa mmrahyɛbadwa akonnwa no aberɛ Owura Kofi Tawiah a ɔno nso yɛ New Patriotic Party nyaa aba 14,831 a ɛkyerɛ 29.90%, John F. Edwin, Jnr nso nyaa aba 3,362 , Isaac Ebo Bartels a ɔno nso gyinaeɛ nyaa aba 2,091, Baba Rockson nso gyinaeɛ nyaa aba 552 ɛna Mattew Caurie nso gyinaeɛ ma wɔanya nnipa baako mpo ama nanto aba amma no. Akyire no Samuel K. Obodai a ɔno nso yɛ New Patriotic Party ni nso bɛtuu no adeɛ so. Ɔgyinaeɛ no, nnipa 21,443 na too aba maa no a ɛgyina hɔ ma 57.50%.

Adwuma
Seisei no, ɔno na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbadwani ma Agona atɔeɛ fam mansin mu.

title: Florence Kumi

title: Isaac Eduasar Edumadzi
text:
Isaac Eduasar Edumadzi (Ɔpɛpɔn 1, 1957, Mfinimfin Mantam  — Ɔpɛpɔn 11,  2018, Cape Coast) yɛ Ghana mmrahyɛbadwani sane ka New Patriotic Party ho. Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbadwani ma Ejumako/Enyan/Essiam a ɛwɔ Central Region. Ɔsom wɔ kane  Ɔmanpanin dada  John Agyekum Kufour amammuo mu wɔ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nan mmarahyɛbadwam a ɛtɔ so nan no mu.

Na mammuo mu nsɛm 
Isaac Edumadze na yɛdii kan yii no baa mmrahyɛbadwam wɔ Ghana abatoɔ mu wɔ New Patriotic Party tikiti so ma Ejumako/Enyan/Essiam mansini a ɛwɔ Mfinimfin Mantam, Ghana. Ɔgyinaeɛ no ɔnyaa mma mpem dunum, ahansia ne aduosia (15,660) a efiri mma dodoɔ mpm aduasa nan, ahankron ne aduonum mmiɛnsa (34,953) a egyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduasa mmienu ne akyirepɔ du (32.10%) a ɔde dii Joseph K.Enos a ɔgyina maa  National Democratic CongressNDC  a ɔno nso nyaa mma mpem dunan, ahanwɔtwe ne aduasa nkron  (14,839), Lawrence Yaw Awuah a ɔgyina maa CPP amanyɔkuo no nso nyaa mma mpem mmiɛnsa, ahansia ne aduoson mmienu (3,672) ɛna Joseph Mensah a ɔyɛ PNC ni nso nyaa mma ahanson ne aduowɔtwe mmienu (782). Ɔgyinaa bio wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu (2000) mu ma ɔdii nkonim nyaa mma mpem dunum, ahasa ne aduasa nsia(15,336) wɔ mma dodoɔ mpem aduasa, ne ahanum(30,500) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduonum ne akyirepɔ aduasa (50.30%) a ɔde dii Mary Padmore Dadzie a ɔyɛ NDC ni so a ɔno nso nyaa mma mpem dummienu, ahansia ne aduowɔtwe baako(12,681),  Kwame Adomako-Mensah a ɔyɛ NRP ni nso gyinaeɛ nyaa mma apem, ahasa ne dunan(1,314), Jonathan Siliman Otabil a ɔgyina maa  CPP amanyɔkuo no nso nyaa mma ahanson ne aduanan nson (747), Robert Anthony Gyaisie a ɔyɛ PNC ni nso gyinaeɛ nyaa mma ahasa ne nson(307) ɛna Kojo Banafo a ɔyɛ UGM ni nso gyinaeɛ nyaa mma ɔha ne dunum (115).

Na ɔka New Patriotic Party ho. John Akyekum Kufour sane yii no sɛ ɔsomfoɔ ma Central Region wɔ ɔgyefoɔ bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne baako mu (2001). Ɔbɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbadwani firi Ɔpɛpɔn bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne num (2005) mu aberɛ a yɛtoo amansan nyinaa abatoɔ no wɔ mfeɛ  2004 Ghana abatoɔ kɛseɛ no mu. Ejumako/Enyan/Essiam mansini a ɛwɔ  Mmrahyɛbadwa nnan a ɛyɛ adehyeman Ghana aberɛ a na ɔhyɛ Ɔmanpanin J.A Kufour's te akonnwa soɔ no. Yɛkeka bom no, onyaa aba bɛyɛ 21,534 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 57.80% abera Samuel Aggrey Forson a ɔno nso ne no repere a ɔyɛ National Democratic Congress ni nso nyaa aba 14,474 a ɛgyina hɔ ma aba 38.80%, Kwame Asoandze Edu-Ansah a ɔno nso yɛ Convention People's Party ni nso nyaa aba 1,276 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 3.40% aba yɛato ama no nyinaa. Abera James Appiah-Mensah a ɔno nso gyinaeɛ no anya hwee, Isaac Edumadze, na nyaa mmrahyɛbadwa akonwa no de ma Ejumako/Enyan/Essiam mansin. Isaac nso gyinaa wɔ ne mansin mu wɔ mmienu mmrahyɛbadwa a ɛyu nnan adehyeman. Yɛ yii aberɛ a yɛkaa sɛ w’adi nkonim wɔ 1996 Ghana abatoɔ kɛseɛ no mu.

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm
Ɔyɛ obi a, wagye din sɛ okuani wɔ Ajumako Kuro a ɛwɔ central Region  na ɔsan nso yɛ Kristoni ma pa.

Ne wuo mu nsɛm
Yɛde too dwa sɛ wawu Ɔpɛpɔn 11, 2018 wɔ Cape Coast Ayaresabea awia bi.Na obiara nim sɛ ne ho nyɛ nti berɛ a yɛde no kɔɔ ayaresabea no, ankyɛ biara na ɔwuiɛ.

title: Michael Afedi Gizo
text:
Michael Afedi Gizo a wɔwoo no Ɔbɛnem da a ɛtɔso du, Afe apem, aha nkron ne aduanan nsia(March 10, 1946) yɛ   Ghana amanyɔni a na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani de ma Kane  Dangme Atɔeɛ abatoɔ mpɛsoa a seesei ɛyɛ Shai-Osudoku abatoɔ mpesoa so no wɔ aban a ɛtɔso mmienu, Ghana adehyeman nnan no mu a ogyinaa maa National Democratic Congress (NDC) amanyɔkuo  no ɔyɛɛ Nkran mantam soafoɔ firi (1992)  dekɔpem (1996). Ɔsan nso som asoɛeɛ a ɛhwɛ nsrahwɛ soɔ no sɛ nkitahodie soafoɔ wɔ (2015) mu no, Owura Gizo gye too mu sɛ ɔbɛyɛ Shai Osudoku nananom arena nkonwa hene. Ɔdii Nene Naga kassa a ɔtɔso nson a wanya nebaabi kɔ no adeɛ. Seesei, ɔno na ɔyɛ odikuro wɔ Agome

Abrabɔ ahyeaseɛ ne sukuukɔ 
Wɔwoo Gizo wɔ Ɔbenem bosome da a ɛtɔso du, Afe apem, ahankron ne aduanan nsia . Ɔkɔsuaa Amansan nkitahodie  wɔ Ghana Nsɛmtwerɛ sukuu.

Wɔtoo aba yii no kɔ Ghana adehyeman a ɛtɔso nnan no aban a ɛtɔso mmienu ne mu wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn da a ɛtɛso nson,  afe apem,  ahankron ne aduɔkron mmeɛnsa. Ɛno akyi, Gizo beyɛɛ mmarahyɛ badwani de maa Shai- Osudoku abatoɔ mpɛsoa no wɔ (1996 abatoɔ ne mu).  David Tetteh Assumang na ɔdii n'adeɛ.

Gizo dii nkunim nyaa  Dangme Atɔeɛ a seesi ɛyɛ  Shai - Osudoku mmarahyɛ badwafie akondwa no dii so. Ɔsan nso dii nkunim ne'mprɛsa so wɔ Adehyeman a ɛtɔso nnan no mu a ogyina maa ( NDC) amanyɔkuo  no. Wɔbɔɔ ne din sɛ ɔno na w'adi nkunim, bere a otwaa  Kwame Tetteh-Korly Agban ogyina New Patriotic Party (NPP) anan mu no, ne John Awuku Dziwornu a ogyinaa  Convention Peoples Party (CPP) anan mu no. Gizo nyaa ɔha mu nkyekyɛ mu  aduosia ne akyiri pɔ aduɔwɔtwe wɔ batoɔ no nyina ara mu a, ɛyɛ mma 14,81. N'akansifoɔ no neo nyaa 10.30% a ɛyɛ mma no mu 2,319 ne  4.90% a ɛyɛ mma no mu 1,108 pɛpɛɛpɛ

title: Reo Addai Basoah
text:
Reo Addai Basoah(1936- Kitawonsa 30,2002), na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbedwani ɛma Kumawu abatoɔ mpasua a ɛwɔ Asante mantam wɔ Ghana. Na ɔka mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so mmienu ne mmiɛnsa ho wɔ Ghana Adehyeman nnan no mu.Na ɔno ne ɔtitenani ma Ghana mmrahyɛbadwa kuo a ɛhwɛ sikasɛm ntotoeɛ ho nsɛm so kɔsii afe apem ahenkron aduokron nson ansa na ɔbɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbadwani bere a Ɔnyaa afe apem ahenkron aduokron nsia mmrahyɛbadwa  abatoɔ  no.

Basoah wuu wɔ Korle-Bu Teaching Ayaresabea wɔ Kitawonsa da ɛtɔ so Aduasa mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne mmienu mu bere a ɔyare yadeɛ ketewaa bi.

N'ahyɛase ne ne sukuukɔ 
Wɔwoo Basoah wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduasa - nsia. Ɔkɔɔ sukuu wɔ  Cambridge Technical College a ɛwɔ  London. Ɔsane nso suaa adeɛ wɔ 'Yale University' suapɔn mu ansa na ɔkɔ toaa so wɔ 'King's College' a ɛwɔ Cambridge kɔ suaa deɛ brɔfo kasa mu yɛfrɛ no 'Economics'. Ɛwɔ afe apem ahenkron aduosia mmienu mu na ɔbɛyɛɛ Mmranimfoɔ a yɛfrɛ no brɔfo kasa mu  'Barrister-at-Law 'wɔ 'Lincoln's Inn'. Basoah same yɛɛ adwuma sɛ nwomasua ho Dawurobɔni wɔ ' Commonwealth Economic Committee' a na ɛwɔ London ne  'World Bank' a ɛwɔ Washington, D.C. firi afe apem ahenkron aduosia - num de kɔ si afe apem ahenkron aduoson mmienu mu

Amanyɔsɛm 
Basoah hyɛɛ n'amanyɔsɛm adwuma no ase wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduokron mmienu mu bere a ɔkɔɔ mmrahyɛbadwafie sɛ 'commissioner for the state enterprise commission' Akyire wɔpaw no sɛ ɔtitenani de ma abadwakuo a ɛhwɛ Sikasɛm ho ntotoeɛ so wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduokron nson mu. Ɔgyina maa wɔtoo ne so aba wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduokron nsia abatoɔ no mu bere a na ɔgyina,wɔ Kumawu abatoɔ mpasua so wɔ New Patriotic Party din mu. Ɔnyaa akonwa no bere a Ɔnyaa mma no mpem du- num ne aduonu - num (15,025 votes )wɔ saa afe abatoɔ no mu  Ɔsane gyinaa bio wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu abatoɔ no mu na wɔsane too aba no maa no bio bere  ɔnyaa mma no mpem du - mmiɛnsa,  ahenum aduonum nnan (13,554 votes) a ɛkyerɛ ɔha mu abupɛn aduonum - nson akyire po aduowɔtwe. Owura Basoah firii mu bere a na ɔwɔ mmrahyɛbadwafie redi dwuma sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani.

Ne wuo 
Basoah firii mu wɔ  Korle-Bu Teaching Hospital ayaresabea bere a ɔyare nna kakraa bi a wɔgyee ne too ayaresabea hɔ nna nsa

title: Joseph Darko Mensah
text:
Joseph Darko-Mensah (Ɔgyefoɔ bosome da a ɛtɔ aduonu mmienu mu wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduanan mmienu (1942) de kɔpem kɔtɔnimaa da a ɛtɔ so du nsia wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du baako (2011) mu no ɔdii dwuma sɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne mmaranimni a ɔyɛ ɛkuoba ma mmarahyɛbɛdwa a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa wɔ Kwasafoman a ɛtɔ so nan wɔ Ghana.Ɔgyinaa mu maa Okaikwei North mpɛsua a ɛwɔ Nkran pumpuni Mantam mu de maa Osono Amanyɔkuo NPP mu.

Amanyɔsɛm nnwuma

Ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwam kuoba 
Darko Mensah hyɛɛ ne dwumadie ase sɛ mmarahyɛbɛdwani wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nson (1997) ne mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne baako (2011) mu wɔ berɛ a ɔdii nkonim wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia(1996) ne mfeɛ mpem mmienu (2000) wɔ mmarahyɛbɛdwa abatoɔ mu no ɔnyaa mma dodoɔ a na ɛyɛ 33,067 wɔ abatoɔ a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Ghana ne mma 36,511 wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu (2000) abatoɔ mu wɔ berɛ a ɔgyinaa mu maa Ɔsono Amanyɔkuo (NPP).Ɔdanee akwonnwa no maa Madam Elizabeth K.Tawiah Sackey wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan (2004) mu wɔ berɛ a Ghana too aba no.

Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia mmarahyɛbɛdwam abatoɔ (1996 parliamentary elections). 
Wɔtoo aba maa Darko Mensah sɛ mmarahyɛbɛdwani de ma Okaikwei North abatoɔ mpɛsua so wɔ Nkran Pumpuni mantam mu wɔ Ghana,Ɔbɛyɛɛ ɛkuoba wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam a ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ Kwasafoman a ɛtɔ so nan wɔ Ghana.Ɔdii nkonim a mma a Ɔnyae nyinaa yɛ 34,641 a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu aduasa num ne akyiripɔ aduonu (35.20%) de kyɛɛn nakansifoɔ a deɛ ɔdi kan ne Philip Kwame Agbeyome a ɔgyinaa mu maa National Democratic Congress Amanyɔkuo a ɔnyaa mma no mu 33,067 a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu aduasa mmiɛnsa ne akyiripɔ aduonum (33.50%),Kwaku Oteng Anane nso a ɔgyina maa Convention peoples Party Amanyɔkuo no nso nyaa mma no mu 5,697 a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu num ne akyiripɔ aduowɔtwe (5.80%),Abdullah Nii Armah nso a ɔgyinaa mu maa People's National Convention Amanyɔkuo no nso nyaa mma no mu 3,193 a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu mmiɛnsa ne akyiripɔ aduonu (3.20%) ne Mohammed Saleh Sinare a ɔgyinaa mu maa National Convention Party Amanyɔkuo no nso nyaa mma no mu 474 a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu hwee ne akyiripɔ aduonum (0.50%).

Mfeɛ mpem mmienu mmarahyɛbɛdwa abatoɔ (2000 Parliamentary Elections) 
Ɔsan nyaa Okaikwei mmarahyɛbɛdwam akonwa no wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu mu (2000) wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbɛdwa abatoɔ no mu. Ɔnyaa mma no mu ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu aduonum num ne akyiripɔ aduonum (55.50%) firii mma a wɔtoeɛ no nyinaa mu.Darko- Mensah ne afoforɔ na ɛperee akonwa no ɛbi firi National Democratic Congress Amanyɔkuo mu a Owurayere Mawuenyenga Sally Okauleyna gyinaa mu maa NDC amanyɔkuo no,ɛbi nso firi People's National Convention (PNC) a ɛyɛ Awuraa Alhajia Salamatu Ali-Lawal gyinaa mu maa saa amanyɔkuo no,ɛbi nso ne National Reform Party (NRP) amanyɔkuo a Owura Barikisu Shardow Shahad gyinaa amanyɔkuo no anan mu ne Convention People's Party (CPP) amanyɔkuo a Owura Reindorf Nii Kwao Mettle gyina maa saa amanyɔkuo yi. Mma a wɔtoeɛ no nyinaa yɛ 65,742. Owura Darko-Mensah nyaa mma no mu 35,611 de kyɛɛn Owurayere Okailey,mma a ɔde twee Owurayere Okailey mu no yɛ 12,045. Owurayere Okailey nyaa mma no 24,466 a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu aduasa nson ne akyiripɔ aduonu (37.20%).Amanyɔkuo nkae no ne wɔn mma wɔnyae no na ɛdidisoɔ yi ; PNC amanyɔkuo  nyaa mma no mu 2,268, NRP amanyɔkuo nyaa mma no mu 1,328 ɛna CPP amanyɔkuo nso nyaa mma no mu 1,169.

Bere a ɔde amnyɔsɛm baa awieɛ 
Joseph Darko-Mensah gyae amanyɔsɛm na ɔhyɛɛ ne mmara dwumadie ase wɔ berɛ a Ɔsono Kokuroko amanyɔkuo (NPP) yii no firii amanyɔkuo no mu a na wɔn nnyinasoɔ ne sɛ wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan (2004) abatoɔ mu no wɔgyedi sɛ Owura Joseph Darko anni nokware amma amanyɔkuo no.

title: Isaac Kobina Nyame-Ofori
text:
Isaac Kobina Nyame-Ofori yɛ Ghana amanyɔni, okuani ne mmrahyɛbadwam a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa mu nnipa wɔ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nan no mu. Na ɔyɛ kane mmarahyɛbadwani ma Sefwi-Wiawso mpɛsua no wɔ Atɔeɛ Mantam mu ne Kyiniiɛ Amanyɔkuo (NDC) no mu kuoba.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Na Nyame-Ofori ka adehyeman Ghana a ɛtɔ so nan ne mmarahyɛbadwam a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no ho. Ɔyɛ National Democratic Congress (NDC) kuoba ne nea Ogyina ma Sefwi-Wiawso mpasua a ɛwɔ Atɔeɛ mantam (Western Region) mu wɔ Ghana. Ne amanyɔsɛm dwumadie no hyɛɛ aseɛ wɔ berɛ a ogyinaa wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu (2000) Ghana nyinaa abatoɔ mu wɔ NDC amanyɔkuo no ananmu na odii nkunim.

Mfeɛ mpem mmienu (2000) Abatoɔ 

Wɔyii Nyame-Ofori sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma Sefwi-Wiawso mpasua no wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu (2000) Ghanamamfoɔ nyinaa abatoɔ no mu. Odii nkunim wɔ abatoɔ no mu ɛwɔ NDC amanyɔkuo no ananmu. Ne mpasua no ka mmarahyɛbadwam nkonnwa nkron (9) wɔ dunkron (19) a NDC amanyɔkuo no dii nkunim faeɛ wɔ saa abatoɔ no mu maa Atɔeɛ Mantam a obɛsii John Kwaku Danso ananmu. 

National Democratic Congress (NDC) bɛyɛɛ dɔmkuma a na wɔkura mmarahyɛbadwafie nkonnwa aduokron mmienu (92) wɔ mmarahyɛbadwafie nkonnwa dodoɔ ahanu (200) no mu wɔ adehyeman Ghana a ɛtɔ so nan ne mmarahyɛbadwam a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no mu. Ɔde mma mpem aduasa mmienu, ahanson ne aduonum mmiɛnsa (32,753)  firi mma dodoɔ a ɛbaeɛ a ɛyɛ mpem aduonum mmienu, ahanwɔtwe ne aduowɔtwe mmiɛnsa (52,883) no mu. Na mma a onyaeɛ no gyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduosia mmiɛnsa ne akyirepɔ nkron (63.9%) wɔ mma dodoɔ a ɛbaeɛ no nyinaa mu. N'akansifoɔ a odii wɔn so nkunim ne Kwasi Blay a ogyina maa New Patriotic Party (NPP) amanyɔkuo no ne Francis Kwabena Bih a ɔno nso gyina maa Convention People's Party (CPP) amanyɔkuo no. Kwasi Blay nyaa mma mpem dunwɔtwe, ahanum ne aduasa nson (18,537) a na egyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduasa nsia ne akyirepɔ baako (36.1%) ɛna Francis Kwabena Bih nso nyaa mma ohunu a na egyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu ohunu.

title: Kwadwo Mama Adams
text:
Kwadwo Mama Adams yɛ Ghanani mmarahyɛbadwanni ne kuoba a wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam a ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ kwasafoman a ɛtɔ nan a na ogyina mu ma Techiman South mpasua a ɛwɔ Brong Ahafo mantam wɔ Ghana.

Abrabɔ mfitiaseɛ 
Wɔwoo Adams wɔ Ɔsanaa bosom a ɛtɔ so dummienu wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduonum nwɔtwe (12 August 1958) wɔ Techiman South a ɛwɔ Brong Ahafo mantam wɔ Ghana.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔdikan too aba yi Adams wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam a na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma kyinie amanyɔkuo (NDC) no wɔ Ɔpɛnimma bosom wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia Ghanaman nyinaa abatoɔ ɛkɔso wɔ Techiman Atɔeɛ mantam mu. Ɔnyaa mma mpem aduonu nan, ɔha ne aduosia nan (24,164) firii mma dodoɔ a ɛyɛ mpem aduasa nkron, ahansia ne aduokron nwɔtwe (39,698) a na agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduanan nsia akyiri pɔ aduasa (46.30%) kyɛn Jarvis Reginald Agyeman-Badu a na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma Ɔsono amanyɔkuo (NPP) no a ɔnyaa mma  mpem dunum, ahanum ne aduasa nan (15,534) a na agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduonu nkron akyiri pɔ aduowɔtwe (29.80%).

N'adwuma 
Sɛ na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwanni a na ɔwɔ Techiman South mpasuaso no, na ɔyɛ ɔsoafo abadiekyiri de ma Brong Ahafo mantam no.

Ne wuo 
Moto akwanhyia na ekum Adams berɛ a na ɛhyɛn a na ɔde firi Nkran rekɔ Sunyani no ne lɔrry kɛseɛ bi kɔnya akwanhyia wɔ Suhum. Wɔde ne funu no kɔɔ Korle-Bu asopiti kɔyɛɛ nhwehwɛmu. Owuu wɔ Ɛbɔɔ bosom a ɛtɔ so nson mfe mpem mmienu ne mmienu (7 September 2002).

title: Isaac Kwadwo Adjei Mensah
text:
Isaac Adjei Mensah yɛ Ghanani amanyɔni sane yɛ mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔka mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson no ho wɔ Ghana na ɔgyina amanfoɔ a ɔwɔ Wassa East batoɔ mpasoa so Atɔeɛ mantam mu wɔ NDC amanyɔ kuo no din mu.

Abrabɔ ahyaseɛ ne nwomasua
Wɔwoo Isaac Adjei Mensah wɔ Benada Ɔbɛnem bosome ne da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nsia afe apem ahankron aduosia mmiɛnsa mu (Ɔbɛnem 26,1963). Ɔfiri Dompim naba 1, kuro ɛwɔ Apueeɛ mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔkɔɔ suapɔn wɔ University of Ghana wɔ afe apem ahankron aduowɔtwe nwɔtwe(1988) Ɛna ɔnyaa abɔdin krataa wɔ  bakyera degree wɔ Sociology afe apem ahankron aduokron nkron (1991). Afei ɔkɔ toa so wɔ  Tromsø suapɔn mu, Norway wɔ afe apem ahankron aduokron mmienu (1992) wɔ masta degree mu. Ɔgraduate wɔ afe ahankron aduokron nson  (1997) wɔ MBA in Public Policy. 

Adwuma

Ansana ɔbɛyɛ amanyɔni no, na Isaac yɛ Mantam nipa nketahodie kwankyerɛfoɔ panin ma Newmont adwumakuo wɔ Ghana firi afe mpem  mmienu ne nsia kɔpem du- mmienu (2006 - 2012).

Amanyɔ

Isaac Adjei Mensah ka  National Democratic Congress (NDC) amanyɔ kuo ho. Wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du-mmienu (2012), Ɔgyina wɔ Wassa East abatoɔ mpasoa so wɔ NDC amanyɔ kuo din mu na ɔdii nkunim. Ɔsane dii nkunim bio wɔ 2016 abatoɔ mu gyina hɔ ma Wassa East amanfoɔ din mu mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson wɔ fourth republic. Wɔ mmarahyɛbadwamu no na ɔka akuo akuo ahodoɔ no mu bias, ebi ne nwomasua, adan ne sika ntotoeɛ abadwa kuo ho. 

Nankasa abrabɔ

Waware awo mma baanum sane yɛ kristoni a ɔka Pentecost asafo no ho. 

Beaeɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Babalami Abu-Sadat
text:
Babalami Abu-Sadat yɛ Ghana amayɔni a na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛ badwani de ma Awutu- Senya abatoɔ mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ mfinfini matam mu  wɔ Ghana adehyeman a ɛtɔso nnan no aban a ɛtɔso mmienu no mu.. Wɔ woo Abu-Sadat  wɔ Awutu Senya a ɛwɔ Mfinfini mantam no mu. Na Sadat yɛ mmarahyɛbɛdwani ma Awutu Senya East  abatoɔ mpɛsoa no.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Abu-Sadat dii kan too aba yii no kɔɔ mmarahyɛ badwafie, bere a ogyinaa National Democratic Congress amanyɔkuo no anan mu wɔ Awutu Senya abatoɔ mpɛsoa so a ɛwɔ Mfinfini mantam Wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa abatoɔ a wɔtoo no afe 1996 no mu. Ɔyaa mma 20,347 firii mmamu  40,166 a wɔtoo a na egyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu aduanan ne akyiri pɔ aduoɔwɔtwe (40.80%). New Patriotic Party ananmusini Haruna Esseku a ɔne no sii  akan no nyaa 11,722 a egyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛ mu aduonu ne akyiri pɔ aduonum (23.50%). Convention Peoples Party Clifford Okyne a ɔne no gyinaaeɛ no nso nyaa mma 7,234 a na egyina hɔ ma  ɔha nkyekyɛmu dunan ne akyiri pɔ aduonum(14.50%)  wɔn a ɛkeka ho no nso bi ne , Haruna Atta-Husseyin ogyina PNC anan mu na nyaa mma no  493 ne NCP ananmusini  S. K. Romeo-Tetteh  a onyaa mma no 370.

Baabi a mmoa firiiɛ

title: Christine Churcher
text:
Christine Churcher (woo no wɔ Ɛbɔ bosom da a ɛtɔ so aduonu baako wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduonum nan (born 21 September 1954)  yɛ amanyɔni a ɔdikan wɔ Ghana. Ɔyɛ amanyɔnni de ma Cape Coast mpasua a ɛwɔ mfinimfin mantam wɔ Ghana wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam a ɛtɔ so mmienu, mmiɛnsa, nan ne num wɔ Ghana adehyemam man mu.

Abrabɔ ahyɛseɛ ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Churcher wɔ Ɛbɔ bosom da a ɛtɔ so aduonu baako wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduonum nan (21 September 1954). Ɔkɔɔ Kwesi Plange mmɔfrase sukuu a yɛsan nso frɛɛ no Pere Planque Memorial Preparatory sukuu a ɛwɔ Cape Coast firii afe apem aduonum nkron de kɔsi afe apem ahansia ne num (1959-1965). Afiri afe apem ahankron ne aduoson num ne afe apem ahankron ne aduoson nwɔtwe (1975 - 1978) no, Churcher sua borɔfo ne abakwasɛm wɔ Ghana asuapɔn mu na ɔwiei wɔ nkonimdimu. Afei, Churher nyaa "Master in Philosophy" wɔ mpanimfoɔ adesua wɔ Ghana asuapɔn mu.

N'adwuma 
Churcher Ghananni mmarahyɛbadwanni. Ghana dibea sɛ ɔman yi mu asoeɛfoɔ dodoɔ no ara na wagyina. Wayɛ adwuma sɛ asoeɛ a ɛhwɛ atenaseɛ ne abɔdeɛ mu nyansapɔ.  Wasan asom sɛ panin a ɔhwɛ Ghana fangoo nnwumasoɔ. Wasan asom bio sɛ asoeɛ a ɛhwɛ ɔman yi nwomasa soɔ.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Churcher agyina mu de ama Cape Coast mpasua a ɛwɔ mfinimfin mantam wɔ Ghana wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam a ɛtɔ so mmienu, mmiɛnsa ne nan wɔ kwasafoman a ɛtɔ so man wɔ Ghana mu.

Abatoɔ

Churcher na ɔdikan a wɔtoo ne so aba de ne kɔɔ mmarahyɛbadwam a na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma Ɔsono amanyɔkuo (NPP) no wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia (1996) Ghanaman nyinaa abatoɔ a wɔtoo no Cape Coast mpasua so wɔ mfinimfin mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔnyaa mma mpem aduasa, ahanan ne aduokron nsia (30,496)  de firii mma dodoɔ a ɛyɛ mpem aduonum nsia, ahanan ne aduonu nwɔtwe  (56,428) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduanan nsia akyiri pɔ aduonu (46.20%) de Kyinie dea na ɔne no resi akan no, S.Valis-Akyianu a na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma kyinie amanyɔkuo (NDC) no a ɔno nso nyaa mma mpem aduonu num, ahankron ne aduasa mmienu  (25,932).

Wɔtoo Churcher so aba sɛ kuoba wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa wɔ adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nan wɔ Ghana wɔ afe mpem mmienu  Ghanaman nyinaa abatoɔ a wɔtoo no wɔ Cape Coast anafoɔ mpasua a na ɔgyina mu ma Ɔsono amanyɔkuo (NPP) no nyaa abatoɔ no mu mma mpem aduasa baako,  ahanum ne aduoson mmiɛnsa (31,573) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduonum num akyiri pɔ aduoson (55.70%) de kyɛn dea na ɔne no resi akan no. Wɔsan too aba yii no wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam a ɛtɔ so nan wɔ adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nan wɔ Ghana wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nan (2004) Ghana Ghanaman nyinaa abatoɔ no mu. Ɔsan nso som sɛ mmarahyɛbadwanni de ma Cape Coast mpasua no firii Ɔpɛpɔn bosom a ɛtɔ so nson wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne num de kɔsi Ɔpɛpɔn bosom da a ɛtɔ so nsia wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nkron (7 January, 2005 - 6 January, 2009). Ɔnyaa mma mpem aduasa nsia, ahanu ne aduasa nan (36,264) wɔ abatoɔ no mu firii mma.mpem aduoson, ahanwɔtwe ne aduosia nsia (70,866) a ɛyɛ mma dodoɔ no nyinaa. Wei gyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduonum baako akyiri pɔ mmienu  (51.2%) de ma mma dodoɔ no nyinaa. Wɔtoo ne so aba de tia MacDonald Konns Tongo a na ɔyɛ anamside ma People's National Congress ne Araba Bentsi-Enchill Safohen a na ɔyɛ anamsini ma Convention People's Party. Wei nom nyinaa gyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu ohunu akyiri pɔ nwɔtwe (0.8%) ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduanan nan akyiri pɔ num (44.5%) ne ɔha nkyekyɛmu mmiɛnsa akyiri pɔ num (3.%) wɔ abatoɔ no mu. Wɔtoo Churcher so aba yii no wɔ Ɔsono amanyɔkuo (NPP) no mu. Ne mpasua no ka mpasua dunsia (16) a wadii nkonim wɔ mfinimfin mantam abatoɔ no mu maa ɔsono amanyɔkuo (NPP) no. No nyinaa mu.no, Ɔsono amanyɔkuo (NPP) no nyaa mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa ɔha ne aduonu nwɔtwe (128) wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam a ɛtɔ so nan no mu wɔ Ghana.

title: Kwadwo Adjei Darko
text:
Kwadwo Adjei Darko yɛ Ghana amanyɔni a na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani a na ɔgyina hɔ ma Sunyani Atoeɛ (Sunyani West) abatoɔ mpasoa so (Constituency) wɔ Bono ne Ahafo mantam no mu wɔ Ghana (Brong Ahafo Region of Ghana).

Abrabɔ Ahyɛaseɛ ne Nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Adjei Darko wɔ Kɔnimaa bosome ne da a ɛtɔ so du wɔ afe apem aha-nkron ne aduannan-nwɔtwe (10th May ,1948). Ɔnyaa suapɔn mu abɔdin krataa ɛdikan wɔ Oguaa anaa sɛ Cape Coast Suapɔn no mu( University of Ca pe Coast ). Ɔnyaa Sukuupɔn abɔdin krataa a ɛdikan wɔ abɔdeɛ nyansapɛ abɔdin krataa Bachelor of Science Degree) wɔ Oguaa Suapɔn no mu (University of Cape Coast) na ɔbenee ne ho yie wɔ nwomasua mu.

Adwumayɔ 
Adjei Darko na n'adwuma a ɔyɛ ne  ɔbia ɔyɛ mfone yɛ.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Adjei-Darko na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔgyina ɔmanfoɔ a ɔwɔ Sunyani Atoeɛ (Sunyani West )abatoɔ mpasoa so (Constituency) wɔ mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa ne nnan wɔ Ɔman Ghana mu ( 3rd and 4th Parliament of Ghana) wɔ ɛyɛ Adehyeman Ghana amammuo a ɛtoso nnan no mu (4th Republic of Ghana)  .Na ɔyɛ ɔsuafoɔ a ɔhwɛ fam agudie tuo so wɔ mfie mpem mmienu ɛne mfie mpem mmienu ne nwɔtwe mu( 2000 and 2008), na ɔsan nso yɛ ɔsuafoɔ a ɔhwɛ nkuro nketewa ne akɛseɛ mpontuo ɛne abɔdeɛ a atwa yɛn ho ahyia so wɔ Ghana mu a na  ɔsan nso yɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ Sunyani Atoeɛ abatoɔ mpɛsoa no so (Sunyani West Constituency). W'ayɛ nnwuma pii aboa ma nkuro nketewa atu mpɔn wɔ Ɔman Ghana mu  ɛnkaɛnka ne beaeɛ a yɛtu  nkyene ne ɛfɔm agudeɛ a yɛ frɛ no sikaboɔ (Salt and Diamond). Nanso, ɛkɔpem Kɔtɔnimaa bosome no wɔ mfie mpem mmienu ne nkron no mu no  (May 2009)  na Adjei-Darko nnyɛ ɔssuafoɔ bio. Ɔbɔɔ ne ho mmɔden wɔ asuaeɛ ɛhwɛ mmaa so no maa wɔn mu nketeisia anaa sɛ maa bunu a na w'asi adwumaeɛ kwanso mu binom maa nyaa ahyɛn na mpo ɔse ɔno ara ne botoom sika tɔ bi maa wɔn mu bnom nso maa nyaa bi..

2000 Abatoɔ  
Adjei Darko wɔn dii nkae too aba maa no sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ mfie mpem mmienu Ghana ɔman mu abatoɔ no mu (2000 General Elections) wɔ Ghana.Eno nti na ɔno ne Mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔgyina hɔ ma Sunyani Atoeɛ (Sunyani West) abatoɔ mpɛsoa no so (Constituency) wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbedwakuo a ɛtoso mmiensa (3rd Parliament of Ghana) wɔ Adehyeman Ghana amammuo a ɛtoso nnan no mu (4th Republic of Ghana). Wɔn too aba yii no ne mma mpem du-nnan, aha-nwɔtwe ne ne aduonu-mmiensa (14,823) de firii  mma mpem aduonu-nson, aha-nwɔtwe ne aduo-wɔtwe nsia (27,886) wɔ mma a wɔn gye too mu sɛ ɛyɛ no nyinaa mu.Wei ne ɔha nkyekyemu susupɛn aduonum-mmiensa ne akyiripɔ mmienu (53.2%) na ɛyɛ pɛ wɔ mma a wɔn gye too mu sɛ ɛyɛ no nyinaa mu. Wɔn too aba maa no sɛ nkunimdifoɔ wɔ wɔn a ɛdidisoɔ yi so Kwadwo Nyamekye-Marfo a na ɔfiri National Democratic Congress (NDC) amanyɔkuo no mu, Kwaku Twumasi-Ankrah a na ɔno nso firi Convention People's Party (CPP) amanyɔkuo no mu, Kyei-Mensah Monica a na ɔno nso firi ɛyɛ National Reform Party (NRP) amanyɔkuo no mu,Patrick Obeng-Mensah a ɔno gyinaeɛ nkorɛankorɛ anaa kɔntenkorɔ sɛ yɛn nto ne so aba (independent candidate) ɛne Wilberforce Nabita Amoah a na ɔno nso firi ɛyɛ People's National Convention (PNC) amanyɔkuo no mu. Nea ɛdidisoɔ yi ne mma a wɔn mu biara nyaaeɛ mma mpem du-baako, ɔha baako ne du-baako (11,111 votes), mma aha-nsia ne aduonum (650 votes) mma aha-num na aduoson-nwɔtwe (578 votes) , mma aha-nan ne aduowɔtwe-nson (487 votes) ɛne aha-mmienu ne aduasa-nson (237 vtes) wɔ mma a wɔn gye too mu sɛ ɛyɛ no nyinaa mu. Wei nom ne ɔha nkyekyemu susupɛn a edidisoɔ yi na ɛyɛ pɛ, aduasa-nkron ne akyiripɔ nwɔtwe (39.8%), mmienu ne akyiripɔ mmiensa (2 .3%), mmienu ne akyiripɔ baako (2.1%), baako ne akyiripɔ nson (1.7%) ɛne hwee ne akyiripɔ nwɔtwe (0.8%) wɔ mma a wɔ gye too mu sɛ ɛyɛ no nyinaa mu. Adjei Darko wɔn too aba ma no kɔ yɛɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ ɛyɛ  New Patroitic Party(NPP) amanyɔkuo no tumi krataa so. Ne mpɛsoa (Constituency) no ka mmarahyɛbadwafie nkonwa du-nan (14) a ɛyɛ New Patroitic Party(NPP) amanyɔkuo no nyaa de firii mmarahyɛbadwam nkonwa aduonu-baako (21) mu wɔ saa abatoɔ no mu wɔ Bono ne Ahafo mantam no mu (Brong Ahafo Region of Ghana). Wɔ ne nyinaa mu no New Patroitic Party(NPP) amanyɔkuo na ɛnyaa Mmarahyɛbadwafie nkonwa no mu kɛseɛ a na ne dodoɔ nyinaa yɛ ɔha (100) de firii ɛyɛ mmarahyɛbadwam nkonwa aha-mmienu (200) mu wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtoso mmiensa (3rd Parliament of Ghana) wɔ Adehyeman Ghana amammuo a ɛtoso nnan no mu (4th Republic of Ghana).

2004 Elections 
Wɔn sanso too aba maa no biom sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔgyina hɔ ma Sunyani Atoeɛ (Sunyani West) abatoɔ mpɛsoa no so wɔ mfie mpem mmienu ne nwɔtwe Ɔmanmu Ghana abatoɔ no mu (2008 Ghanaian General Elections) Na ɔsanso kɔ gyinaa mu sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani de maa wɔ abatoɔ mpɛsoa no so wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtoso nnan (4th Parliament of Ghana) wɔ Adehyeman Ghana amammuo a ɛtoso nnan no mu (4th Republic of Ghana). Na mma a wɔn to maa no de kɔɔ mmarahyɛbedwam no yɛ mpem aduonu, aha-mmiensa ne aduonum (20,350) na onyaa saa mma yi de firii mpem aduasa-nwɔtwe,ɔha ne aduowɔtwe-nwɔtwe (38,188) wɔ mma a wɔn tooeɛ no deɛ wɔn gye too mu no nyinaa mu.  Na wei ne ɔha nkyekyemu susupɛn aduonum-mmiensa ne akyiripɔ mmiensa (53.3%) wɔ mma a wɔn gye too mu sɛ ɛyɛ no nyinaa mma a wɔn tooeɛ no mu na ɛyɛ pɛ 4,5 wɔn too aba yii no sɛ nkunimdifoɔ wɔ wɔn a ɛdidisoɔ yi so,

Ahmed Boadan na ɔfiri National Democratic Congress (NDC) amanyɔkuo no mu, Gyabah Samuel a na ɔno nso firi ɛyɛ Convention People's Party (CPP) amanyɔkuo no mu, King Kingsford Fordjo na ɔfiri Democratic People's Party (DPP), Obiri Francis a ɔgyina sɛ ankorankoreɛ anaasɛ kontenkorɔ sɛ wɔn to ne so aba.  Wei ne mma a wɔn wɔn a wɔn too wɔnso aba no nyinaa nyaaeɛ mma mpem du-mmienu, aha-nwɔtwe ne aduasa-nsia (12,836 votes), aha-mmiensa ne mmienu (302 votes) , aha-mmienu ne nsia (206 votes), ɛne mpem nnan aha-nan ne aduokron-nnan (4,494 votes) wɔ mma wɔn tooeɛ no deɛ wɔn gye too mu sɛ ɛyɛ no nyinaa mu. Wei ne ɔha nkyekyemu susupɛn a edidisoɔ yi so na ɛyɛ pɛ aduasa-mmiensa ne akyiripɔ nsia (33.6%) hwee ne akyiripɔ nwɔtwe (0.8%), hwee ne akyiripɔ num (0.5%), ɛne du-baako ne akyiripɔ nwɔtwe (11.8%) wɔ mma a wɔn tooeɛ no ɛmu dodoɔ a wɔn gye too mu sɛ ɛyɛ no nyinaa mu.  Adjei Darko wɔn sanso too aba maa wɔ New Patriotic Party (NPP) amanyɔkuo no tumi krataa so. Na ne mpɛsoa no ka mmarahyɛbadwafie nkonwa du-nan a New Patriotic Party (NPP) amanyɔkuo nyaa de mmarahyɛbadwam nkonwa aduonum-nan no mu wɔ Bono ne Ahafo mantam no mu wɔ Ghana wɔ saa abatoɔ no mu. (Brong Ahafo region of Ghana). Wɔ ne nyinaa mu no New Patroitic Party (NPP) amanyɔkuo no na ɛnyaa Mmarahyɛbadwafie nkonwa no mu kɛseɛ a na ne dodoɔ nyinaa yɛ ɔha ne du-nan (144) de firii mmarahyɛbadwam nkonwa aha-mmienu ne aduasa no mu wɔ Adehyeman Ghana amammuo a ɛtoso nan no mu.

Abrabɔ 
Adjei Darko yɛ kristoni.

title: Ato Quarshie
text:
Ato Quarshie yɛ Ghana amanyɔni a na ɔka mmarahyɛbadwa a edi kan , mmienu ne mmiɛnsa wɔ Ɔman Ghana mu a ɔgyina ɔmanfoɔ a wɔwɔ Komenda Edina abatoɔ mpasoa so wɔ mfimfini mantam mu.

Ɔbra ahyaseɛ ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Ato Quarshie wɔ Komeda a ɛwɔ mfimfini mantam a ɛwɔ ɔman Ghana mu. Ɔkɔɔ suaɔn wɔ Hohenheim ɛhɔ na ɔnyaa nabɔdin krataa wɔ deɛ ɛdidi soɔ yi mu Bachelor of Science,Master of Science and Doctor of Philosophy degrees in Agricultural Economics, Agricultural Economics, Development Economics.

Amanyɔ 
Quarshie dii nkunim bɛyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa bosome afe apem ahankron aduokron mmienu Ghana abatoɔ mu (Ɔpɛnimaa1992) wɔ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress(NDC) din mu wɔ  Komenda Edina abatoɔ mpasoa so wɔ Mfimfini mantam mu.

Wɔ afe ahankron aduokron nsia abatoɔ mu ɔde mma 1996, 26,671 wɔ mma ɔtoeɛ 42,444  a ɛgyina hɔ ma  49.80%  de tea Catherine B.Aubyn CPP amanyɔkuo ba mma wei na ɔnyaeɛ 14,083, Benjamin Kweku Prah PNC amanyɔkuo ba ɔnyaa mma 1,690 ne Francis William Boham deɛ wanya mma biara.

Ɔde mma 16,903 wɔ mma  36,499 mu dii nkunim wɔ afe mpem mmienu (200) Ghana abatoɔ berɛ so a ɛgyina hɔ ma 46.30% . Amanyɔkuo ahodoɔ mu nipa pii ne no na ɔkɔ peree akonwa no wɔ Komenda Edina abatoɔ mpasoa so. Saa nipakuo yi ne wɔn amanyɔkuo na edidi soɔ yi , Dr. Paa Kwesi Nduom CPP amanyɔkuo nyaa mma 15,941 , George Manso Howard  NPP amanyɔkuo ɔnyaa mma 3,477 , PNC amanyɔkuo nyaa 178  a na John K. Assifuah-Nunoo na ɛgyin mu ne Robert Mensah Emmanuel  NRP amanyɔkuo ɔnɔ deɛ wanya mma no bi.

Dr. Quarshie dii akonwa mpresa firi 1992 -2000 kɔpem sɛ ɔdii nkoguo wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nnan (2004) wɔn amanyɔkuo abatoɔ mu.

Adwuma 
Quarshie  yɛ ɔsuafoɔ a na ɔhwɛ akwan ne kwantenpɔn so.  Afei ɔyɛɛ mmarahyɛbadwani maa ɔmanfoɔ a ɔwɔ Komenda Edina abatoɔ mpasoa so wɔ Mfimfini mantam mu firi afe apem ahankro ne aduokron mmienu kɔpem afe mpenu ne nnum mu (1992 - 2005).

title: Enoch Teye Mensah
text:
Enoch Teye Mensah a yɛwoo no Kɔtɔnimaa bosome da a ɛtɔ so dunson (17) wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduanan nsia (1946-2023) mu yɛ amanyɔni. Na ɔyɛ mansoafoɔ ma asoeɛ a ɛhwɛ nnwomasua so ne mmarahyɛbadwani firi Ɔpɛpɔn bosome mu wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nson (1997) mu de kɔsi Ɔpɛpɔn bosome mu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne dunson mu (2017).

Nwomasua ne Abrabɔ ahyɛase 
Wɔwoo Mensah wɔ Kɔtɔnimaa bosome da a ɛtɔ so dunson (17) wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduanan nsia (1946) mu na ofiri Prampram a ɛwɔ Nkran mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana mu. Ɔkɔɔ sukuu wɔ SNAPS kɔlege of Accountancy, a owieeɛ wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduosia nwɔtwe mu (1968). Ɔsane so nyaa ne RSA III wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduoson mu (1970),  na ɔbɛyɛɛ Institute of Financial Accountants mu nipa wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe nsia (1986). Ɔyɛ Account Ɔfesa a ɔyɛ adwuma wɔ University of Ghana, Legon sɛ sikasɛm ho kyeame (Accounting Officer).

Amanyɔsɛm 
Sɛ Nkran kurow sohwɛfoɔ (Mayor)

Wɔ PNDC asraafoɔ mmerɛ so wɔ Ghana no, na wayɛ Nkran AMA no panyin akyɛ, na ɛno ɛnam so na ɔde bɛyɛɛ kurow no sohwɛfoɔ. Ɔkɔ kaa Kyiniiɛ Amanyɔkuo (National Democratic Congress) no ho wɔ berɛ a wɔtee kuo no wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron mmienu mu (1992).

Sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani 
Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia mu (1996) no, Ogyinaeɛ wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwam abatoɔ na odii nkunim bɛyɛɛ Ningo-Prampram mpasua no mmarahyɛbadwani, a ɔtenaa mpasua no akonnwa so wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam bɛyɛ mfeɛ du. Berɛ NDC dii nkoguo wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu (2000) abatoɔ akyire no, ɔkɔɔ so yɛɛ mmarahyɛbadwani. Sam George bedii Mensah adeɛ wɔ Obubuo bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduonu baako wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne dunum (2015) NDC mpasua agyinafoɔ abatoɔ no mu. Wadi dwuma sɛ mmarahyɛbadwam dɔmkuma Chief Whip ansa wɔrebɛto Ghana mmarahyɛbadwam abatoɔ wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nwɔtwe mu (2008). Wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nkron (2009) mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ dɔmkɛseɛ no Chief Whip wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam.

N'abrabɔ 
Mr. Mensah aware wɔ mma nson.

Abatoɔ 
Mr. Mensah yɛ Ghana amanyɔni na wɔyii sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma mmarahyɛbadwam a ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ  Ghana adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nan berɛ wɔtoo afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia (1996) Ghanaman nyinaa abatoɔ no mu. Ɔde mma mpem dunum, ahansia ne aduoson nson (15,677) a na egyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduonum nsia ne akyirepɔ du (56.10%) a ɔde dii n'akansifoɔ; Desmond Nene Quaynor a onyaa mma apem, ahanum ne aduosia nkron (1,569) a egyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu num ne akyirepɔ aduosia (5.60%) wɔ mma dodoɔ a ɛbaeɛ no nyinaa mu na Gwendolyn Sara Addo a wannyina amma amanyɔkuo biara no nso nyaa mma apem, ahanum ne aduasa nson (1,537) a egyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu num ne akyirepɔ aduonum (5.50%) . Ɔkɔɔ so tenaa Ningo Prampram akonnwa so wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam de kɔsii mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne dunsia (2016) mu a Samuel George Nartey betuu no.

Abasobɔdeɛ 
Ɔmampanini dada John Agyekum Kufuor de Companion of the Order of the Volta abasobɔdeɛ maa no.

title: Thomas Kweku Aubyn
text:
Thomas Kweku Aubyn yɛ Ghanani amanyɔni a ɔka mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ Ɔman  Ghana mu gyina hɔ ma Gomoa East abatoɔ mpasoa so wɔ mfimfini mantam mu wɔ Ghana .

Abrabɔ ahyaseɛ 
Wɔwoo Thomas Kweku Aubyn wɔ Gomoa East wɔ mfimfini mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Aubyn yɛ nipa ɔdi kan a ɔyii no sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ National Democratic Congress amanyɔkuo no din mu a ɔgyina hɔ ma Gomoa East abatoɔ mpasoa so wɔ mfimfini mantam mu wɔ afe apem ahankron aduokron nsia (1996) Ghanafoɔ nyinaa abatoɔ . Ɔde mma 18,390  firi mma wei mu 29,720 a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekye mu aduanan mmiɛnsa ne akyirepɔ aduonu  43.20% de kyen  Kofi Nyarko-Annan a ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuo no ba ɔnyaa mma no10,547 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 24.80% ne Abraham Kofi Sackey a ɔyɛ Convention People's Party amanyɔkuo no nso nyaa  783 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 1.80%.

title: Kwame Addo-Kufuor
text:
Wɔwoo  Kwame Addo-Kufuor Ketawonsa bosome ne da a ɛtɔ so du-nnan afe apem ahankron ne aduanan(Kitawonsa14, 1940)  Ɔyɛ Ghanani mmarahyɛbadwani sane yɔ Dɔkota. Addo-Kufuor ka mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ no ho a na ɔgyina amanfoɔ a ɔwɔ Manhyia firi 2001 kɔpem 2007, na ɔyɛ ɔsuafoɔ ɔhwɛ banbɔ so wɔ ne nua Ɔmanpanin John Kufuor firi Ayɛwohummumɔ bosome afe mpenu  ne nnwɔtwe ne mpenu ne nkron mu (2008 ne 2009).

Adwuma 
Addo-Kufuor yɛ dɔkotani ankasa.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Addo-Kufuor ka New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuo ho. Ɔbɛyɛɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome afe apem ahankron aduokron nson (1997) wɔ berɛ a ɔdii nkunim wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa bosome Ghanafoɔ nyinaa abatoɔ mu wɔ 1996. Ɔsane yii no bio sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma Manhyia abatoɔ mpasoa so wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nnan.

Abatoɔ

1997 mmarahyɛbadwa abatoɔ 
Addo yɛ mmarahyɛbani a ɔyii no wɔ afe apem ahankron aduokron nsia(1996) Ɔpɛnimaa Ghanafoɔ nyinaa abotoɔ  ma Manhyia abatoɔ mpasoa so wɔ Asante mantam mu. Mma a Ɔnyaeɛ ne 59,227 de firii  72,789  mma mu  a ɛgyina hɔ ma 63.30%  de tea Yaw Addai Boadu a ɔɛ NDC amanyɔkuo ba a ɔnyaa 13,562 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 14.50%.  Ɔsane yii no bio maa no mma 64,067 firii 78,368 mma mu a ɛgyina hɔ ma 81.80% de tea Samuel B.Donkoh a ɔyɛ NDC amanyɔkuo ba a ɔnyaa mma 12,244 ɛgyina hɔ ma 15.60%, Salifu Mumuni PNC nyaa 1,614  ɛgyina hɔ ma 2.10% ne Nana O. Boateng ɔnyaa 443 ɛgyina hɔ ma  0.60%.

2004 mmarahyɛbadwa abatoɔ 
Ɔtoo aba maa Addo-Kofuor sɛ mmarahyɛbɛdwani ma Bekwai abatoɔ mpɛsua so wɔ Asante Mantam mu a ɛwɔ Ghana wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan mu (2004) wɔ abatoɔ a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Ghana mu no.ɔdii nkonim de maa Ɔsono Kokuroko amanyɔkuo (NPP) no. Na ne mpɛsua no ka mmarahyɛbɛdwam akonwa aduasa nsia (36) a na ne nyinaa dodoɔ yɛ aduasa nkron (39) a Ɔsono amanyɔkuo (NPP) nyaa wɔ saa abatoɔ no mu wɔ Asante Mantam mu. Ɔsono Kokuroko amanyɔkuo no nyaa mmarahyɛbɛdwa akonwa no mu ɔha ne aduonunwɔtwe (128) de firii mmarahyɛbɛdwam akonwa a ne dodoɔ yɛ ahaanu ne aduasa (230). Ɔdii nkonim wɔ berɛ a ɔnyaa mma no mu mpem aduosia nsia,ahaanu ne du (66,210 ) de firii mma a ne dodoɔ yɛ mpem aduowɔtwe nson,ahansia ne aduonu nkron (87,629) mu a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu aduosonum ne akyiripɔ nsia (75.6%) a na ɛyɛ mma a wɔtoeɛ no nyinaa dodoɔ. Wɔyii no gyaa Salifu Mumuni a ɔgyinaa  mu maa People's National Convention amanyɔkuo no, Kwame Boateng a ɔgyinaa mu de maa National Democratic Congress amanyɔkuo no,E.A.Ohene Darko a ɔno nso gyina maa Convention People's Party amanyɔkuo no ne Kofi Pervical Akpaloo a na ɔyɛ kɔntɔnkorɔ ananmusini (Independence Candidate). Wɔn mma a wɔnyaeɛ na ɛdidisoɔ yi; ahansia ne aduosia nson (667) , mpem nkron,ahanum ne aduonum (9,550) , ahanan ne aduokron nwɔtwe (498) ne mpem du ,ahanson ne nan (10,704) . Saa mma yi gyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu hwee ne akyiripɔ nwɔtwe (0.8% ) ,ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu du ne akyiripɔ nkron (10.9%) ,ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu hwee ne akyiripɔ nsia (0.6%) ne ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu dunan ne akyiripɔ mmienu (12.2%) wɔ nnidisoɔ mu.

Ɔbra ahyɛaseɛ ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Addo-Kufuor Kitawonsa bosome ne da a ɛtɔ so du-nnan afe apem ahankron ne aduanan(Kitawonsa14, 1940).  Ɔwie suapɔn wɔ Cambridge suapɔn mu. Ɔkura bachelor's degree wɔ nnuroyɛ mu.  Ɔsane sua adeɛ wɔ Middlesex Medical sukuu asopite ne Jesus College.

Nabrabɔ 
Addo-Kufuor yɛ kristoni

title: Kwaku Acheampong Bonful
text:
Kwaku Acheampong Bonful (wɔwoo no wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome mu ne da  a ɛtɔ so aduasa baako wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduanan nson (31 January,1947),na ɔyɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne ɛkuoba de ma mmarahyɛbɛdwam a ɛdi kan ne deɛ ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ Kwasafoman a ɛtɔ so nan a ɔgyina maa Prestea-Huni Valley abatoɔ mpesua so wɔ Atɔeɛ Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

Abrabɔ ahyeaseɛ ne sukuu 
Wɔwoo Bonful wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome ne da a ɛtɔ so aduasa baako wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduanan nson (31 January 1947) wɔ Prestea-Huni Valley a ɛwɔ Atɔeɛ Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔkɔɔ Kalini Party of School,a ɛwɔ Germany na ɛhɔ na ɔnyaa abodin krataa. Ɔsan kɔɔ University of Ghana ne Ghana School of Law na ɔnyaa LLB ne Bachelor of Law wɔ a ɔsuaa political science of law wieɛ no.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔyii Bonful maa no bɛyɛɛ mmarahyɛbɛdwam kuoba wɔ berɛ a ɔgyinaa mu maa National Democratic Congress amanyɔkuo no mu de maa Prestea-Huni Valley abatoɔ mpɛsua so wɔ Atɔeɛ Mantam mu wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron mmienu mu (1992) Ghana abatoɔ mu no. Wɔtoo aba maa no bio wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia abatoɔ no mu (1996). Ɔnyaa mma no mu mpem du-nkron ahanan ne aduasa mmiɛnsa (19,433) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu aduasa mmienu ne akyiripɔ aduokron (32.90%) de kyɛɛn Akwasi Gyima-Bota, Benjamin Bekoe, Emmanuel Ewudzi, Joseph Imbiah Tismark, Nana Nuako ne Albert Kwaku Obbin,wɔn mma a wɔnyae na ɛdidisoɔ yi deɛ ɔdi kan nyaa mma no mu mpem dunwɔtwe ahanan ne aduokron nwɔtwe (18,498),deɛ ɔtɔ so mmienu nyaa mma no mu mpem mmienu ahaanu ne aduasa nan (2,234), deɛ ɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa nyaa mma no mu mpem baako ahansia ne du-nwɔtwe (1, 618), deɛ ɔtɔ so nan nyaa mma no mu mpem baako ahaasa ne aduonum (1,350) na deɛ ɔtwa toɔ nso nyaa mma no mu hwee (0). Albert Kwaku Obbin a ɔgyinaa mu de maa Osono kokuroko amanyɔkuo (NPP) no dii no so nkonim wɔ berɛ a ɔnyaa mma no mu mpem du-nkron ɔha ne aduasa baako (19,131) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu aduanan nnwɔtwe ne akyiripɔ aduanan (48.40%) de dii Bonful a na ɔne no ɛpere akonwa no so nkonim,Bonful nyaa mma no mu mpem du-mmienu ahaanu ne aduanan (12,240) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu aduasa baako ne akyiripɔ hwee (31.00%) de firii mma a na ne dodoɔ yɛ ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu ɔha (100%)   mu.

Adwumasɛm 
Na Bonful yɛ Ɔsoafoɔ abɛdiakyire a ɔhwɛ ahobambɔ nsɛm so na Ɔsan yɛ mmarahyɛbɛdwam kuoba de ma Prestea -Huni  Valley abatoɔ mpɛsua so de firi afe apem ahankron ne aduokron mmiɛnsa (1993) de kɔpem mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne baako mu(2001). Na ɔyɛ obi a wagye nteteɛ wɔ mmara mu sɛ mmaranimni.

Berɛ A owuiɛ 
Bonful nyaa lɔre akwanhyia wɔ Tarkwa -Bogoso kwan so da Yawoada. Ɔwuu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne mmienu mu wɔ Ɔsanaa bosome da a ɛdi kan mu (1st August,2002).

title: Kwaku Al-Hassan Dadzie
text:
Kwaku Al-Hassan Dadzie yɛ Ghanani amanyɔnni wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nan a na ɔyɛ anamsini ma Assin South mpasua no wɔ mfinfini mantam wɔ Ghana firi afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia de kɔsi afe mpem mmienu (1996-2000).

Abrabɔ mfitiaseɛ 
Wɔwoo Dadzi wɔ Assin South wɔ mfinfini mantam wɔ Ghana.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Abatoɔ a ɛdikan a Dadzi de kɔɔ mmarahyɛbadwa mu yɛ Ɔpɛnimma bosom wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia (1996) Ghanaman nyinaa abatoɔ a na ogyina mu ma Kyinie Amanyɔkuo (National Democratic Congress) no ɛwɔ Assin South mpasua so a ɛwɔ mfinfini mantam wɔ Ghana. Ɔnyaa mma dunan, ahankron ne aduanan num (14,945) firii mma a ne dodoɔ yɛ aduonu nwɔtwe, ahanu ne aduokron mmienu (28,292) a na agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduanan mmiɛnsa akyiri pɔ du (43.10%) a na ɛkyɛn Ɔsono Amanyɔkuo (New Patriotic Party) no anamsini no deɛ a ɔnyaa mma dummienu, ahanan ne aduowɔtwe nwɔtwe (12,488) a na agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduasa nsia akyiri pɔ ohunu (36.00%), Emmanuel Koomson a na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma Convention People's Party no nyaa mma ahansia ne aduonu nkron (629) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu baako akyiri pɔ aduowɔtwe (1.80%) na Michael Damtse nso nyaa, mma ahanu ne aduasa (230) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu ohunu akyiri pɔ aduoson (0.70%). Dominic K. Fobih a na ɔyɛ anamsini ma ɔsono amanyɔkuo (New Patriotic Party) no nyaa mma dunsia, ɔha ne aduanan (16,140) de firii mma dodoɔ a na ɛyɛ mpem aduonu nsia ahanson ne aduosia nan (26,764) a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduosia akyiri pɔ aduasa (60.30%) na ɔde dii ne so nkonim.
