title: Moctar Musah Bambah
text:
Alhaji Moctar Musah Bambah yɛ Ghanani amanyɔni a ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔgyina hɔ ma amanfoɔ a ɔwɔ Wenchi East abatoɔ mpasoa so wɔ  Brong Ahafo mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Na ɔka Ghana mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no ho. Afei na ɔyɛ ɔsuafoɔ abadeakyire a ɔhwɛ Ɔmanpanin abrabɔ mu.

Amanyɔ 
Bambah iyɛ New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuo ba. Ɔtoo aba yii no sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔgyina hɔ ma amanfoɔ a ɔwɔ Wenchi East abatoɔ mpasoa so wɔ  Brong Ahafo mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Na ɔka Ghana mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no ho. Ɔbɛdii Profɛsa George Yaw Djan-Baffuor adeɛ berɛ a abatoɔ mpasoa no sesa kɔ yɛɛ Wenchi abatoɔ mpasoa so wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nnan mu (2004) wɔ Ghana nyinaa abatoɔ mu. Ɔkɔɔ mmarahyɛbadwam Ɔpɛpɔn bosome ne da a ɛtɔ so nson afe apem ahankron aduokron nson(Ɔpɛpɔn 7,1997).

Abatoɔ 
Ɔyii Bambah sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ Wenchi East abatoɔ mpasoa so wɔ afe mpem mmienu(2000) mu wɔ Ghana nyinaa abatoɔ mu. Ɔgina maa  New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuo no. Nabatoɔ mpasoa no ka mpasoa du-nnan 14 a NPP amanyɔkuo no nya firii mpɛsoa aduonu baako 21 no wɔ Brong Ahafo mantam mu. New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuo no nyaa mmarahyɛbadwa akonwa ɔha firii nkonwa ahaanu mu wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa wɔ Ghana. Ɔnyaa mma 14,954 firii 27,536 mu. Wei gyina hɔ ma 55.9% aba no nynaa mu. Nipa yi na ɔdii wɔ so nkunim   Frederick Osei-Dabankah National Democratic Congress, Kwaku Amoa-Tutu  National Reform Party, Agyenim Boateng Agyei  Convention People's Party ne Takyi Kwame Anokye of the United Ghana Movement. Mma a wɔnyaa yɛ 10,563, 533, 529 ne 177 firi mma ɔtoeɛ nyinaa. Ɛgyina ma  39.5%, 2.0%, 2.0% ne  0.7%.

title: Joshua Alabi
text:
Wɔatwerɛ wei wɔ Asante Twi mu  

Joshua Alabi (Ɔbɛnem 1, 1958) Ɔyɛ Ghanni  Russian a yatete no sɛ nwomasuani ne amanyɔni, a  ɔyɛ ɔkwankyerɛfoɔ panin abadeɛkyire ma  University of Professional Studies, Accra (UPSA) firi 2012 kɔpem 2016. Ɔyɛɛ opanin kwankyerɛfoɔ ma suapɔn no firi  2009 kɔpem 2012 ne abadeakyire firi 2005 kɔpem 2008. Wɔ Ghana amanyɔsɛm, Alabi yɛ National Democratic Congress (NDC) amanyɔkuo ba ɔgyina hɔ ma Krowor abatoɔ mpɛsoa so wɔ  Accra Ponponi mantam mu firi 1997 kɔpem 2001 ne ɔsuafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Nkran ne Serem  mantam mu firi 1997 kɔpem 2001. 

Alabi ka National Democratic Congress amanyɔkuo sane ka wɔn a ɔboa maa Nkran mantam NDC amanyɔkuo gyinaeɛ wɔ 2001 berɛ a wɔn dii nkoguo wɔ 2000  Ghana nyinaa abatoɔ mu. Ɔwieeɛ no ɔgyina sɛ otitenani ma NDC amanyɔkuo a ɛwɔ Nkran pomponi mantam mu firi 2001 kɔpem 2005.Nabrabɔ ne nwomasua

Ɔyɛ Ga abusuakuo a wɔfiri Nungua, Ɔwoo Alabi wɔ Ɔbɛnem bosome ne da a ɛdi kan afe apem ahankron aduonum nnwɔtwe(Ɔbɛnem 1,1958) wɔ  Accra. Ne papa yɛ fitani ne kuani na ne maame yɛ dwadini. Ɔhyɛɛ ne mmɔfra ne adanta sukuu wɔ St. John's Preparatory Suuu (ɛnɛ yi St. John's Grammar Sukuu) wɔ Achimota, a ɛwɔ Nkran, firi 1965 kɔpem 1971. Afei ɔkɔ toa so wɔ Tamale ntoasoɔ Sukuu ɛhɔ na ɔnyaa A-Level abɔdin firi 1971 kɔpem 1976.

Alabi wie nenteteeɛ sɛ prɔfɛhyenaa  Accountancy ne Marketing wɔ  Institute of Professional Studies (IPS) firi 1976 kɔpem 1980. Akyire no ɔtuu kwan kɔɔ amanɔne kɔyɛɛ ne maseta degree wɔ

Industrial Economics (MSc) firii Moscow Institute of National Economy, Plekhanov (mprempren ɛyɛ Russian Economics Suapɔn) wɔ 1986 ne  MSc in International Marketing firii Strathclyde Suapɔn wɔ Glasgow Scotland ɛhɔ na ɔbɔɔ naba so wɔ 1992.

Ɔyɛ Prɔfɛsa wɔ Marketing afa mu wɔ UPSA, Ɔka Chartered Institute of Marketing (CIM), Ghana.

Nwumasua mu adwumayɔ

Ɔwie ne nteteeɛ a ɛdi mu wɔ IPS, Alabi nyaa adekyerɛ mu kwan wɔ Northern School of Business wɔ Tamale firi 1980 kɔpem 1981 ansana ɔfiri hɔ akɔtoa n'adesua so wɔ Soviet Union anya degree abɔdin ahodoɔ. Ansana ɔrebɛyɛ kyansela abadeakyire no, Alabi dii mfeɛ aduonu ne akyire sɛ suapɔn kyerɛkyerɛni firi 1987 kɔpm 2005. Wɔ naberɛsoɔ no na ɔyɛɛ panin a na ɔda  Marketing Department ano 1989,  Dean wɔ Management Fakɔɔti firi 2003 kɔpem 2005. Ɔbɔɔ no abaso sɛ panin wɔ suapɔn akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ no  wɔ 2001, suapɔn no abadwakuo bɔɔ no prɔfɛsa wɔ 2008. Ɔbɔɔ nabaso sɛ suapɔn no so panin firi 2005 kɔpem 2012.

Amanyɔsɛm

Ɔyii Alabi sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔgyina hɔ ma amanfoɔ a ɔwɔ Krowor abatoɔ mpɛsoa so wɔ Nkran mantam mu wɔ National Democratic Congress (NDC) amanyɔkuo no din mu firi 1997 kɔpem 2001. Berɛ a ɔwɔ mmarahyabadwafie no, na Alabi ka abadwakuo a wɔhwɛ dwadie ho (1997 kɔpem 2001); sane ka abadwakuo a wɔhwɛ nnuane ne mfudeɛa firi (1997 kɔpem 2001). 

Agokansiemu adwumayɔ

Wɔ agokansie mu no, Alabi yɛ twerɛtwerɛfoɔ panin ma Ghana League Clubs Association (GHALCA) firi 1994 kɔpem 1997. Afei na ɔsane ka Ghana Football Association's abadwakuo no ho (GFA) na ɔyɛ nanmusini ma Ghana Black Stars abadwakuo no firi 1994 kɔpem 1997.

Nabrabɔ

Alabi yɛ kristoni. Ne yere ne Goski B. Alabi, a ɔno nso yɔ nwomasua mu prɔfɛsa wɔ ntotoeɛ ne akannie mu. Wɔwɔ mma baanu (2). 

Abasobɔ

Obubuo bosome ne da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nkron afe mpem mmuenu ne du-nsia(Obubuo 29,2016) mu no Ghana Ɔmanpanin John Dramani Mahama bɔɔ Alabi aba so sɛ “Officer of the Order of the Volta” honour.

Kitawonsa bosome afe mpem mmienu ne du-num 2015, Alabi gyee abasobɔ firii Chartered Institute of Bankers (CIB) sɛ nkaeɛ ne nsesaeɛ a ɔde baa  IPS sɛ ɛbɛyɛɛ suapɔn ankasa, ne ne mmɔdenmmɔ wɔ sikasɛm ntoroeɛ mu.

Yɛbɔɔ ne di sɛ abibiman Vice-Chancellor afe 2013 mu no ɔno na ɛdi kan. Bio, Alabi nyaa abasobɔ firii National Union of Ghana Students, (NUGS) hɔ wɔ ne mmoa ɔde aboa nwumasua wɔ Ghana.

Chartered Institute of Marketing Ghana (CIMG) bɔɔ Alabi aba so sɛ Ghanani a ɔdi akotene wɔ dwadie mu wɔ Ghan wɔ 2012 mu .

IMANIfoɔ maa no abasobɔ sɛ Ghana's Most Influential Public Sector Leader wɔ afe 2012.

title: Jacob Scherrer Arthur
text:
Scherrer Arthur, a.k.a Jacob, yɛ Ghanani amanyɔni ne akuoba wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam mmienu ne mmiɛnsa no mu wɔ kwasafoman a ɛtɔ so nan a agyina hɔ ma Mfantseman West mpasua a ɛwɔ  mfinimfin mantam wɔ Ghana. Ɔyɛ anamsini de ma kyinie amanyɔkuo (NDC) no.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔdikan too aba yi Jacob kɔ mmarahyɛbadwam a na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma kyinie amanyɔkuo (NDC) no wɔ Ahinime bosom mu wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia (December 1996) Ghanaman nyinaa abatoɔ ɛkɔso a na ɔyɛ mmarabyɛdwanni firi Ɔpɛpɔn bosom da a ɛtɔ so nson wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nson (7 January 1997) de ma Mfantseman West  mpasua a ɛwɔ mfinimfin mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

Abatoɔ 
Wɔ afe ahankron ne aduokron nsia (1996) no, ɔnyaa mma mpem dunkron, ɔha ne aduoson mmienu (19,172) firii mma dodoɔ a na ɛyɛ mpem aduonu baako, ahankron ne nan (21,904) no mu a na agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduoson baako akyiri pɔ aduanan (71.40%) de Kyɛn nea ɔne no resi akan no Comfort Ohene-Darko a na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma CPP amanyɔkuo no nso nyaa mma mpem mmienu, ahanson ne aduasa mmienu (2,732), Kenneth Appiah Mends a na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma NCP amanyɔkuo no annya amma no bi na Isaac Kow Taylor a na ɔyɛ frankatuni de ma NPP amanyɔkuo no nso annya amma no bi.   Wɔ mfe mpem mmienu (2000) Ghanaman nyinaa abatoɔ no, ɔnyaa mma mpem dunsia ne dunwɔtwe wɔ abatoɔ no mu a na agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduanan akyiri pɔ ohunu (40.00%)  na ɔde dii nkonim. Ɔne amanyɔkuo afoforɔ bi gyinaeɛ a na wɔyɛ ; Ɔsono Amanyɔkuo (NPP), National Reform Party (NRP), People's National Convention (PNC) ne Convention People's Party (CPP). Saa nkorɔfoɔ yi nyaa mma no mu aduasa nwɔtwe akyiri pɔ aduanan (38.40%), ɔha nkyekyɛmu mmienu akyiri pɔ du (2.10%), ɔha nkyekyɛmu ohunu akyiri pɔ aduowɔtwe (0.80%) na ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduonu baako akyiri pɔ aduokron (21.90%) wɔ abatoɔ no mu. Mma dodoɔ no nyinaa yɛ mpem aduonu mmiɛnsa, ahansia ne aduosia nkron (23,669).

N'adwuma 
Jacob yɛ mmarahyɛbadwanni dadaw wɔ Mfantseman West mpasua a ɛwɔ mfinimfin mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

N'abrabɔ 
Jacob Scherrer Arthur yɛ kristoni.

title: Mike Allen Hammah
text:
Mike Allen Hammah, wɔwoo no wɔ Ɔsanaa bosom da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nwɔtwe wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduonum num(28 August 1955) yɛ mmarahyɛbadwanni na na ɔsan nso yɛ obia na ɔhwɛ nsaase ne ɔbɔadeɛ nnoɔma so wɔ Ghana. Ɔyɛ obia na ɔhwɛ akwatuo nsɛmsoɔ kɔsi Ɔpɛpɔn bosom da a ɛtɔ so nan mfe mpem mmienu ne dubaako (4 January 2011) mu a ɔmanpanin Mills baa aban mu a ɔyii no firii adeɛso. Na ɔsan yɛ mmarahyɛbadwanni de ma Effutu mpasua so wɔ mfinimfin mantam wɔ Ghana.

Abrabɔ ahyɛseɛ ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Hammah wɔ Ɔsanaa bosom da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nwɔtwe wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduonum num (28. August 1955). Ɔfirii Winneba a ɛwɔ mfinimfin mantam wɔ Ghana. Ɔkɔɔ Ghana Secondary Technical School ɔkɔɔ ne ntoasoɔ sukuu wɔ Takoradi wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduosia nkron ne afe apem ahankron ne aduoson nsia (1969 and 1976). Wawie Kwame Nkrumah asuapɔn babia ɔnyaa ne aadansie mfididwuma abɔdin a adikan wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe (1980). Ɔsan tow ne nwomasua so ɛwɔ (Post-Graduate level) wɔ Central University College babia ɔnyaa ne (Master of Business Administration) abasobɔdeɛ wɔ sikasɛm mu wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nwɔtwe (2008) mu.

N'adwuma 
Hammah adwuma a ɔyɛ ne adansie nhyehyeɛ, adansie ho nimdefo ne obi a osusu nsase.

Amanyɔsɛm adwuma 
Hammah yɛ kuoba de ma kyinie amanyɔkuo (NDC). Mmarahyɛbadwam a ɔdikan kɔsɔm yɛ no hyɛ aseɛ wɔ afe ahankron ne aduokron nsia ne mfe mpem mmienu  (1996 and 2000) sɛ mmarahyɛbadwanni a na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma Effutu mpasua no na wɔyii no sɛ  ɔsoafo abadiekyiri a ɔhwɛ akwan ne akwantuo nsɛmsoɔ wɔ saa berɛ no mu.

Abatoɔ 
Wɔdikan too aba yi Hammah wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam a na ɔyɛ anamsini de ma kyinie amanyɔkuo (NDC) no  wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia Ghanaman nyinaa abatoɔ ɛkɔso wɔ Effutu  mpasua a ɛwɔ mfinimfin mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Abatoɔ a wɔtoo yɛ no, ɔnyaa mma mpem dubaako ahasa ne aduokron nwɔtwe (11,398) a na agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduanan mmienu akyiri pɔ aduowɔtwe (42.80%) de kyɛn deɛ na ɔne no resi akan Joseph Nunoo-Mensah  ɔsono amanyɔkuo (NPP) no anamsini a ɔnyaa mma mpem nkron ɔha ne aduanan nan (9,144), Emma H.Tandoh a na ɔyɛ CPP anamsini no annya aba biara wɔ abatoɔ no mu na Kingsley Arko-Sam a na ɔyɛ IND amanyɔkuo no anamsini no nso annya hwee wɔ abatoɔ no mu. Ɔsan nso di nkonim wɔ mfe mpem mmienu (2000) a ɔnyaa mma mpem nkron ahason ne dunsia (9,716) de firii mma dodoɔ a na ɛyɛ mpem aduonu ne aduanan (20,040) a na agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduanan nwɔtwe akyiri pɔ du (48.10%) de kyɛn ne kansifo Oheneba A. Akyeampong a ɔyɛ ɔsono amanyɔkuo no anamsini, Frank Ebo Sam a ɔyɛ IND anamsini, Kingsley Arko Sam a na ɔyɛ CPP amanyɔkuo no anamsini na Ebenezer Newman-Acquah a na ɔyɛ PNC amanyɔkuo no anamsini no nyaa mma mpem nkron ahanan ne aduoson (9,470), mma ahasa ne aduokron nkron (399), mma ahanu ne aduoson num (275) ne mma ɔha ne aduowɔtwe (180).

Wɔtoo aba yi no sɛ mmarahyɛbadwanni wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam a ɛtɔ so num wɔ adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nan wɔ Ghana de ma Effutu mpasua berɛ a ɔdii nkonim wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne nwɔtwe (2008) Ghanaman nyinaa abatoɔ a ɛkɔɔ so a na ɔyɛ frankatuni de ma kyinie amanyɔkuo (NDC) no. Wɔ saa abatoɔ yi mu no wɔyii no berɛ a ɔnyaa mma mpem dunum ahanu ne aduokron nson (15,297) de firii mma dodoɔ mpem aduonu nwɔtwe ne aduonum num (28,055) a wɔtoo no wɔ abatoɔ no mu a agyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduonum nan akyiri pɔ num (54.5%). Wɔtoo aba yii no de tia Owusu-Agyei a na ɔyɛ ɔsono amanyɔkuo (NPP) no frankatuni na Henry Kweku Bortssie a na otu frankaa de ma CPP amanyɔkuo no. Wei gyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduanan mmiɛnsa akyiri pɔ aduasa nkron (43.39%) na mmienu akyiri pɔ ohunu nwɔtwe (2.08%).

N'abrabɔ 
Hammah aware a ɔwɔ mmɔfra baasa (3). Ɔyɛ kristoni a ɔkɔ Methodist asɔre.

Hammah is married with three children. He is a Christian (Methodist).

title: Ishmael Ashitey
text:
Ishmael Ashitey (Obubo 20, 1954 –  Ɔpɛpɔn 7, 2022) yɛ Ghanani amanyɔni a ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuo. Ɔyɛ ɔsuafoɔ ɔhwɛ Nkran mantam wɔ Ghana. Ɔmanpanin Nana Addo Danquah Akuffo-Addo yii no Ɔpɛpɔn bosome mu afe mpem mmienu ne du-nson mu, mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ gyee no too mu Ɔgyefuo bosome mu.

Nabrabɔ ne nwumasua 
Wɔwoo Ashitey wɔ Obubuo bosome ne da a ɛtɔ so aduonu afe apem ahankron aduonum nnan (Obubuo 20, 1954. Ɔkɔɔ adantam sukuu wɔ Manhean Middle Mixed wɔ Tema. Ɔtoa so wɔ Kpando Technical Institute wɔ Volta mantam ɛnna akyire ɔkɔɔ Nkran  Polytechnic ɛhɔ na ɔkɔsua  Mechanical engineering. Ɔgyee diploma abɔdin wɔ mechanical engineering mu wɔ KNUST. Ɔkɔɔ Ghana Institute of Management ne Public Administration. Ɔfiri hɔ na ɔkɔyɛɛ ne masta wɔ Governance ne Leadership.

Adwumayɔ 
Wɔ namanyɔsɛm mu no, Ashitey yɛ  mechanical engineer. Ɔne adwumakuo pii na ayɛ adwuma wɔ Ghana ne aman ahodoɔ wɔn ne He worked in many companies  Nkran Brewery adwumakuo, Tema nnade dwumakuo, Tecnofin Nederlands ne General Establishment for Plastics & Industries wɔ Libya.

Amanyɔ 
Ashitey asome sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ  Tema East abatoɔ mpɛsoa so wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛdidi soɔ yi  2, 3 ne 4  wɔ Ɔman Ghana mu. Ɔhyɛɛ aseɛ firii Ɔpɛpɔn7, 1997 kɔpem Ɔpɛnpɔn 6, 2009.

1996 Abatoɔ 
Ashitey dii nkunim wɔ 1996 Ghanafoɔ nyinaa abatoɔ mu sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa a ɔtɔ so mmienu wɔ  Ghana ɛnna ɔgyee no tom wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 7, 1997. Ɔde mma 33,421 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 35.80% wɔ mma no nyinaa mu de dii  Nii Adjei Larbie so nkunim National Democratic Congress amanyɔkuo de mma  29,914 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 32.00% , Seth Laryea Tetteh Convention People's Part amanyɔkuo nyaa   4,211 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 4.50%  ne Frank Sontim-Bour Yendork  People's National Convention amanyɔkuo nyaa mma 1,803 ɛgyina hɔ ma 1.90%.

2000 abatoɔ 
Ashitey dii nkunim sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ Tema East abatoɔ mpɛsoɔ mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa wɔ afe mpenu Ghanafoɔ nyinaa abatoɔ mu. Ɔgyina maa New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuo din mu. Nabatoɔ mpɛsoa so ka mpɛsoa nsia a  New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuo no nya firii mpɛsoa aduonu mmienu wɔ Nkran mantam mu.  National Democratic Congress amanyɔkuo nyaa mmrahyɛbadwa akonwa no aduokron mmienu firii nkonwa ahaanu mu wɔ mmrahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa wɔ Ghana. Ɔnyaa mma 35,044 firii 63,034. Wei gyina hɔ ma 56.2%. Ɔdii saa foɔ so nkunim  Eben T. Anuwa-Armah National Democratic Congress, Dr. Frederick W. Asante Akuffo  Convention People's Party, William Kobb-Lumor  National Reform party, Erasmus Aruna Quao  People's National Convention ne Mensah Steve  United Ghana Movement.  Deɛ obiara nyaa na ɛdidi soɔ yi  18,432, 5,028, 2,262, 1,198 ne 402. Ɛgyina hɔ ma  29.6%, 8.1%, 3.6%, 1.9 and 0.6%.

2004 Abatoɔ 

Ɔyii Ashitey sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nnan wɔ Ɔman Ghana mu wɔ afe mpenu ne nnan Ghana nyinaa abatoɔ berɛ mu. Ɔde mma 41,519  na edii nkunim firii 86,284 mma mu. Wei gyina hɔ ma 48.1% . Amanyɔkuo yi mu nipa na ɔdii wɔn so nkunim Emelia Kai Adjei  National Democratic Congress, Charles Akwetey Fynn-Williams Convention People's Party; ne Albert Anawi Nuamah, Lord Koranteng Hamah ne Ramseyer Agyeman Prempeh a ɔni amanyɔkuo biara. Wei nom gyina hɔ ma  31.6%,1.7%, 6.4%, 2.0% ne 10.3% . Ashitey gyinaa wɔ  New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuo no din mu.  Ne mpɛsoa no ka mpɛsoa du nson 17 New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuo no nyaa no wɔ Nkran mantam mu. Ne nyinaa nkafua no, New Patriotic Party nyaa mmarahyɛbadwa nkonwa no aha aduonu nnwɔtwe 128 wɔ Ghana.

Nabrabɔ 
Na Ashitey yɛ kristoni a ɔyɛ Presbiniquities, afei ɔpɛ akenkan,asuo mu adwareɛ ne nnwom. Ɔwɔ yere ne mma baanan.

Newuo 
Ɔwuu wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 7, 2022 wɔ International Maritime Hospital wɔ Tema, ɔnyaa mfeɛ aduoson 67. Ɛbinom kyerɛ sɛ ɔwuu wɔ Tema aban ayaresabea nyaa mfeaɛ aduo nnwɔtwe 68.

title: Freddie W.A. Blay
text:
Frederick Worsemao Armah Blay dodoɔ no ara frɛ no Freddie Blay yɛ lɔyani Ghanani amanyɔni a na ɔka mmarahyɛbadwa ɛtɔ so mmienu,  mmiɛnsa ne nnan wɔ Ghana Adehyeman nnan mu a na ɔgyina hɔ ma  Ellembelle abatoɔ mpasua a ɛwɔ Apueɛ mantam ( Western Region) mu a ɛwɔ Ghana.

Adwuma 
Wɔ paw Blay  sɛ ɔtitenani ma adwumakuo 'Ghana National Petroleum Corporation '(GNPC). Ɛwɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu baako mu no, 2021, Ɔmanpanin Nana Akufo-Addo sane paw no bio sɛ ɔtitenani ma amanyɔkuo korɔ no ara bio.

Seisei ɔno ne mpanin pa ara Ɔsane 'Blay and Associates' alɔyafoɔ no ano. Ɔsane yɛ ɔtitenani ne ɔbi a ɔwɔkyɛfa kɛseɛ wɔ nnwumakuo 'Western Publications Limited, publishers of the Daily Guide newspaper, the flagship of the Group, Business Guide, News-One and Young Blazers' no.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Na Blay yɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ Ghana . Ɔsomm sɛ mmarahyɛbadwa Kyeame abadiekyire a ɔdi kan wɔ Ghana mmrahyɛbadwa ɛtɔ so nnan no mu.  Wɔtuu no akonwa so wɔ Ghanafoɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoo no wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa da ɛtɔ so nson wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nwɔtwe mu bere a Owura Armah Kofi Buah ɔgyina ma National Democratic Congress amanyɔkuo no nyaa akonwa no. Na ɔka Convention People's Party amanyɔkuo no ho, nanso ɔgyaeɛ bɛkaa  New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuo no ho bere a Convention People's party amanyɔkuo mma no kasa tia no sɛ wammɔ ntoa amma amanyɔkuo no frankaatumi Owura  Paa Kwesi Nduom, na mmom ɔde ne ho taa New Patriotic Party  frankaatuni Nana Akufo-Addo akyire. Freddie Blay kɔɔ Adisadel College ntoasoɔ sukuu.

Afe 1996, 2000 ne 2004  Abatoɔ

Wɔtoo aba yii Blay  sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani de ma Ellembelle abatoɔ mpasua a ɛwɔ Apueɛ mantam mu (Western region ) wɔ Ghana  wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduokron -nsia(1996), mfeɛ mpem mmienu ( 2000,) ne mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnan( 2004 ) Ghanafoɔ nyinaa abatoɔ no mu. Ɔgyinaa hɔ maa ne mpasua so wɔ mmrahyɛbadwa ɛtɔ so mmienu,  mmiɛnsa ne nnan wɔ Ghana Adehyeman nnan mu. Ɔgyinaa wɔ Convention Peoples' Party amanyɔkuo no din mu,  saa bere no na amanyɔkuo no ne  New patriotic Party amanyɔkuo no retwe kora.  Ɛno nti wangyina wɔ NPP din mu wɔ  Ellembelle abatoɔ mpasua so.Ɛwɔ mmrahyɛbadwafie wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduokron nsia no, Dɔmkumaa a na New Patriotic Party na ɔda ano no, yii no sɛ mmrahyɛbadwa kyeame abadiekyire a ɔtɔ so mmienu  bere a  National Democratic Congress amanyɔni  Ken Dzirasah na ne ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwa Kyeame a ɛdi kan.

Bere New Patriotic Party nyaa mfeɛ mpem mmienu abatoɔ no, Blay bɛyɛɛ Mmrahyɛbadwa Kyeame  abadiekyire a ɛdi kan na  Dzirasah yɛ deɛ ɔtɔ so mmienu. Ɛwɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnan mu no,   NDC amanyɔkuo no de Ala Adjetey a na ɔyɛ kane Mmrahyɛbadwa Kyeame no kɔɔ bio tiaa Dɔmkɛseɛ  NPP ni Ebenezer Sekyi-Hughs. Yei maa no yɛɛ den maa Dzirasah ne NDC amanyɔkuo no. Mmrahyɛbadwa Kyeame a ɛtɔ so mmienu akonwa no kɔ maa NPP ni  Alhaji Alhassan.

Wɔtoo aba no maa deɛ ɛdi kan wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduokron - nsia abatoɔ no mu bere a Ɔnyaa mma no, mpem du-baako,  ahensia aduoson nnan (11,674 votes ) firii mma  Mpem aduonu nnum ne aduokron nkron (25,099 valid votes cast ) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu abupɛn aduasa akyire po aduonu (30.20%) na deɛ ne no repere akonwa no Awuraa Constance Nyamikey-Quaicoe ɔgyina ma National Democratic Party no nso nyaa mma no mpem du- baako ahensia aduosia - mmiɛnsa (11,663 votes) ɛna  Abdul Karim Pennah ɔgyina ma PNC  no nso nyaa mma apem ahenson aduosia mmienu (1,762 votes). Wɔtoo aba yii Blay wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnan abatoɔ no mu bere a Ɔnyaa mma no  mpem du - nwɔtwe,  ahenan aduonu -nwɔtwe (18,428 votes ) firii mma mpem aduasa nnan  ahenkron aduosia - nkron (34,969 total valid votes cast. ) Yei kyerɛ ɔha mu abupɛn  aduonum mmienu akyire po nson (52.7% of the total valid votes cast). Wɔyii no gyaa Shaibu Chie Issaka na,ɔgyina hɔ ma People's National Convention, Kaku Korsah na,ɔgyina ma  National Democratic Congress ne Kyiamah Kaku a na ɔgyina hɔ sɛ kontokorɔ. Wɔnom nyaa mma no Ahasa aduowɔtwe nwɔtwe (388 votes,) mpem du- baako Ahasa aduonu mmienu (11,322 votes ) ne ahenkron ne mmienu (902 votes) sɛdeɛ wɔ din didisoɔ no. Wɔtoo aba maa  Blay wɔ Convention People's Party amanyɔkuo no din mu.

Beaɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Abraham Ossei-Aidooh
text:
Abraham Ossei Aidooh yɛ Ghanani amanyɔni a ɔfiri  New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuo mu. kɔpem 2008, ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ dodoɔ nnaano panin wɔ Ghana; ansana no na ɔyɛ  dodoɔ nnaano no abadeakyire. Afei na ɔka mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛwɔ Pan-African.

Ɔbra ahyaseɛ ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Aidooh wɔ Ɔsanaa bosome afe apem ahankron aduonum mmiɛnsa born on (Ɔsanaa 6, 1953.) Ɔnyaa abɔdin krataa wɔ bakyela degree wɔ mmaranim mu wɔ University of Ghana, Sukuu a ɛhwɛ mmarasua. Ɔyɛ kristoni.

Adwuma 
Aidooh yɛ lɔyani ankasa.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Na Aidooh ka mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nnan berɛ a ɔdii nkunim wɔ 1996 Ghana nyinaa abatoɔ mu a ɔgyina maa  New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuo no. Na ɔka mmarahyɛbabwa a ɛtɔ so 2, 3, ne 4 wɔ Tema west abatoɔ mpɛsoa so.

Abatoɔ 
1996 abatoɔ

Ɔyii Aidooh sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔgtina  Tema West abatoɔ mpɛsoa so wɔ Nkran mantam mu sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔka mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ Ɔman Ghana mu. Ɔgyina maa New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuo no ɔde mma 22,521 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 46.50% de kyen wɔn ɔne wɔn pre deberɛ no Esther IIan-Agbodo Ogbogu a ɔwɔ National Democratic Congress amanyɔkuo no nyaa  15,511 ɛgyina hɔ ma  32.00%  ne George Alfred Ackah a ɔwɔ Convention People's Party amanyɔkuo no mu a ɔno deɛ wanya mma no bi.

2000 abatoɔ 
Ɔyii Aidooh sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma  Tema West abatoɔ mpɛsoa so foɔ wɔ 2000 Ghana nyinaa abatoɔ mu. Ɔgyina maa New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuo.

2004 Abatoɔ 
Ɔyii Aidooh sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma  Tema West abatoɔ mpɛsoa so foɔ wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nnan wɔ 2004 Ghana nyinaa abatoɔ mu. Ɔnyaa mma 37,97 firii 71,009 mu. Wei gyina hɔ ma  53.5% ma mma no nyinaa. Saafoɔ yi na ɔdii wɔn so nkunim George Komla Medie  National Democratic Congress, Godfried Allan Lomotey of the Convention People's Party, Kojo Amoako of the Every Ghanaian Living Everywhere Party; ne Kenneth Nana Amoateng, Ayele A.J.  Avon ne Justice Awortwe Edwards - all wɔn gyinaa sɛ ankorankorɛin. Aidooh gyina wɔ  New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuo din mu. Nabatoɔ mpɛsoa no  ka mpɛsoa du nson 17 a New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuo no nyaa no wɔ Nkran mantam mu. Ne nyinaa nka fua,  New Patriotic Party nyaa mmarahyɛbadwa nkonwa no ɔha ne aduonu nnwɔtwe 128 wɔ Ghana.

title: Samira Bawumia
text:
Samira Bawumia (née Ramadan) (wɔwoo no Ɔsanaa bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduonu wɔ afe apem aha-nkron aduowɔtwe (1980) mu). Ɔyɛ Ghana amanyɔni nna ɔsan nso yɛ ɔbaapanin ɔtɔ so mmienu wɔ Ghana. Ne ho kafoɔ ne Ghana manpanin a ɔtɔ so mmienu, Mahamadu Bawumia.

Sukuusɛm 
Samira hyɛɛ ne sukuu ase wɔ Answarudeen Islamic sukuu wɔ Fadama ne Alsyd Academy wɔ Nkran, ansana ɔtoa so akɔ 'Akosombo International Sukuu (AIS)' ne Mfantsiman Girls' Secondary Sukuu wɔ Saltpond a ɛwɔ Central Region Ghana man mu. Ɔkɔɔ ne ntoasoɔ sukuu wɔ 'Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology (KNUST), ɔkɔsuaa 'BA. Social Science in Law and Sociology and Technology'. Ɔsan nso toaa so kɔɔ 'Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration (GIMPA)' ɛhɔ na onyaa ne 'postgraduate studies', yɛ maa no abaso bɔdeɛ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɔno ne osuanii a ɔbɔɔ ne ho mmɔdene wɔ 'Master of Business Administration (MBA)' mu. Ɔyɛ Ɔbaa bi a ɔte kasa ahodoɔ pii, ebi ne Ewe, Ga, Twi, Fante ne Mamprusi.

Nea yɛ de kae no 
Nkyɛɛ biaa na wɔyɛɛ Mrs. Bawumia ambasadɔ wɔ Global Alliance for Clean Cookstoves ɛna ɔkɔ kaa UN Secretary General dadaa Kofi Annan a wanya ne baabi kɔ ho, ɛne  Academy Award-winning actor Julia Roberts, ɛna  Grammy-nominated Ghanaian musician Rocky Dawuni sɛ to work with the Alliance and its partners to raise awareness of household air pollution and encourage broader adoption of clean cooking solutions in developing countries in a bid to create cleaner environments and eradicate deaths caused by pollution from the burning of solid fuels for cooking. In 2019, she was acknowledged as the first of seven individuals honored by Sustainable Energy for All (SEforAll) in conjunction with Ashden. This was in recognition for her efforts towards the United Nations' Sustainable Development Goal (SDG) 7, which is to ensure access to modern reliable, renewable and affordable energy for all by 2030.

title: Baskin-Robbins
text:
Baskin Robbins yɛ wiase nyinaa nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn a ɛyɛ ice cream dan a ɛwɔ franchises wɔ aman bɛboro 30 so. Wɔ mmeae 5800 no, 2800 wɔ United States. Wɔde sii hɔ wɔ 1953 mu denam ice cream adwuma ahorow abien a ɛsono emu biara a Burt Baskin ne Irv Robbins a na wɔyɛ asewnom de kaa ho no so. Ansa na wɔbɛka abom no, na wɔfrɛ ice cream adwuma abien a ɛsono emu biara no Burt’s Ice Cream Shop ne Snowbird Ice Cream. Ná Snowbird Ice cream wɔ nneɛma ahorow 21 a ɛyɛ dɛ saa bere no, na wɔkamfoo no sɛ ɛyɛ foforo na ɛyɛ foforo.

Bere a wɔkaa nnwuma abien no boom yɛɛ Baskin-Robbins, a akyiri yi ɛbɛyɛɛ ice cream aguadidan a agye din wɔ wiase nyinaa akyi no, piaa asɛm a ɛne sɛ ‘31 flavors.’ Baskin-Robbins yɛɛ adebɔ ho adwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɔfaa so de nhwɛsode nhyehyɛe no too gua no mu —ma nkurɔfo de nsenia a ɛyɛ pink bɛsɔ ice cream a ɛyɛ dɛ ahorow no ahwɛ kosi sɛ wobenya dɛ a wɔpɛ no. Afei nso, Baskin-Robbins na odii kan de ice cream keeki no kyerɛɛ ɔmanfo.

Ice cream a wɔde yɛ nneɛma

title: Nzulezo
text:
Nzulezo yɛ akuraa bi a ɛbɛn Beyin akuraa, kilomita 90 wɔ Takoradi atɔeɛ fam, wɔ Jomoro Mantam jomoro Ghana Atɔeɛ Mantam mu.[1] Nnipa bɛboro 500 na wɔte mpɔtam hɔ.

Nzulezo hwɛ Ɔtare Tadane, na ne nyinaa yɛ nnua ne asɛnka agua. Wɔ afe 2000 mu no, wɔyii no sɛ UNESCO Wiase Agyapadeɛ, na ɛyɛ beaeɛ titire a nsrahwɛfoɔ kɔ hɔ.[1] Beae no reyɛ nsrahwɛfo fibea kɛse, na nsrahwɛfo ba bɛhwɛ akuraa no ase ne ɛhɔnom nsa bi a wɔyɛ wɔ akuraa no ase nso.[2]

Abɔseɛ 
Edin "Nzulezo" wɔ Nzema kasa mu kyerɛ "nsu ani", na ɛyɛ akuraa bi a ɛwɔ nnua a ɛwɔ "Ewuture" mfiase a ɛbɛn atifi fam atɔe mpoano. "Ewuture" no na wɔhwɛɛ nsuo akwan ne nneɛma ne nnipa a wɔde fa so. Sɛnea ɛhɔnom anansesɛm kyerɛ no, nnipa kuw bi a wofi Oualata, kurow bi a ɛwɔ tete Ghana Ahemman no mu ne nnɛyi Mauritania a efi ntontom akyi bae na wosii akuraa no. Enti ntontom yɛ totem na Nzulezofo bu no.[4]

Adesie 

Wɔkyekyeree Nzulezu wɔ Ɔtare Tadane so. Nzulezo atrae no yɛ adan a wɔde nnua a wɔde gyina so.[1]

Nea enti a wɔkyekyeree Nzulezo wɔ nsu so ne ahobammɔ ne ahobammɔ bere a wɔtow hyɛ wɔn so wɔ ɔko bere mu efisɛ ɛda Kesee Fam Atɔe mpoano wɔ asase mu akwansin anum.[3]

Nnwuma titiriw a emufo yɛ ne kuayɛ, bere a mpataayi di dwuma a ɛto so abien. Ɔtare no yɛ nea ɛhɔfo hu sɛ ɛbɔ ho ban fi asiane ahorow bi ho (e.g. ogya).[1] Akuraa no ase no nyaa afie no bi a nsuyiri bi a ɛtɔe wɔ afe 2009 mu no fa bi guu nsu ase ampa.[5]

Nnwuma a wɔyɛ 
Akuraa no ase wɔ ayarehwɛfo ne akwahosan ho adwumayɛfo kakraa bi.[2]

Mfitiaseɛ sukuu wɔ hɔ na sɛ mfitiaseɛ sukuu wie a, ɛsɛ sɛ asuafoɔ firi akuraa no ase kɔ ntoasoɔ sukuu ne sukuupɔn.[6] Nanso, ɛde besi afe 2019 no, na akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ ho ayɛ na ama mpɔtam hɔfoɔ.[2]

Wiase Agyapade Gyinabea 
Wɔde saa beae yi kaa UNESCO Wiase Agyapade a Wɔahyɛ Da a Wɔahyehyɛ no ho wɔ Ɔbɛnem 17, 2000, wɔ Amammerɛ mu.[1]

Wɔpaw akuraa no sɛ ɛnyɛ Wiase Agyapade esiane hia a ɛho hia wɔ nnipa ho adesua mu nti: nea ɛka ho sɛ ɛyɛ tete nkurow kakraa bi a wɔtraa nnua ne asɛnka agua so a wɔaka wɔ wiase no mu biako no, ɛhɔnom atetesɛm ahorow pii a wɔakora so a ɛne ɔtare no som wɔ abusuabɔ .[1] Ɔtare Tadane ba nyamesom amanne nyinaa mpoano, na Dwoda, yɛ da kronkron ma ɔtare no, na wɔabara sɛ wɔmfa ɔtare no nni dwuma na wɔyɛ adwuma wɔ so mma dwumadi biara Dwoda da mũ no nyinaa.[1]

Nzulezo Ahyɛmma a Wɔde Fa Nnipa 
Nnansa yi ara wɔabue akuraa no ase ama nsrahwɛfo, nanso anohyeto ahorow bi wɔ hɔ (wɔma kwan ma wɔkɔ hɔ pɛnkoro pɛ dapɛn biara).[1] Ɔkorow nkutoo na wobetumi de akɔ akuraa no ase; ɔkwan a ɛfa kwae a osu tɔ na owia bɔ kɛse wom no gye bɛyɛ dɔnhwerew biako kosi kilomita 5. Wɔ akuraa no ase no, asɔredan ne sukuu wɔ hɔ. Esiane sɛ akuraa no atew ne ho kɛse nti, Nzulezo nya akwahosan ho haw ahorow pii, a asramma a ɛtrɛw kɛse ka ho.[1]

title: Winneba
text:
Winneba yɛ kuro a ɛno ne Effutu Mansini a ɛwɔ Mfimfini Mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana anafoɔ fam no kuropɔn. Nnipa a wɔwɔ Winneba no ano si mpem aduanan-nnum, ahankron ne aduonum nnan. Winneba a wɔfrɛ no Simpa no yɛ beaeɛ a agye din wɔ afaredwuma mu wɔ Ghana a ɛda mpoano. Ɛda Cape Coast apueeɛ fam, akwansini ɔha ne aduanan. mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔwɔ hɔ mprempren yi ne Alexander Kwamina Afenyo-Markin.

Abakɔsɛm 
Firi tete no kɔpem berɛ a Britainfoɔ kyekyeree Gold Coast man no, na Effutu yɛ beaeɛ a wɔyi nnoɔma a ɛfiri aburokyire. Wɔsii Fort Winneba wɔ ha.

title: Elsie Effah Kaufmann
text:
Elsie Effah Kaufmann yɛ Ghanani nimdifoɔ a wɔwoo no wɔ Ɛbɔ 7, 1969. Ɔyɛ nimdefoɔ mu panin, nnuruyɛ mu nhwehwɛmu afidiyɛfo na seesei ɔsane yɛ National Sicence and Maths akansie no kyeame.  Wɔ Ɔpɛnemaa bosome afe apem mmienu ne aduonu (2020), wɔpaw Kaufmann sɛ ɔbenfo abadiakyiri wɔ University of Ghana. Seesei, wɔapaw no sɛ Dean of School of Engineering Sciences wɔ University of Ghana na ɔbɛfiri ne dwumadie ase wɔ Ayɛwohomummɔ, 1 2022.

N'adesua 
Wɔwoo no wɔ Assin a ɛwɔ Mfinimfini mantam a ɛwɔ Ɔman Ghana mu. Ɔkɔɔ ntoasoɔ sukuu wɔ Aburi Girls' Senior High School. Ɔnyaa n'abasobɔdeɛ International Baccalaureate Diploma firi United World College of the Atlantic a ɛwɔ Wales wɔ 1988. Ɔtoa so wɔ  University of Pennsylvania kɔ yɛɛ  Bachelor of Science in Engineering (BSE),  Master of Science in Engineering (MSE) ne PhD in Bioengineering.

title: Sammy Gyamfi
text:
Sammy Gyamfi yɛ Ghanani a wɔwoo no Ɔbɛnem 28, 1989. Ɔyɛ Mmaranimfoɔ na ɔsan nso yɛ ammayɔni. Ɔyɛ obi a wakwadare wɔ amanyɔsɛm mu pa ara. Mprempren ɔyɛ kasamafoɔ ma 'National Democratic Congress' amanyɔkuo no.

Ne sukuu ho asɛm 
Sammy Gyamfi kɔɔ ntoasoɔ sukuu wɔ st. James Seminary. Ɔwieeɛ no, ɔkɔtoaa n'adesua so wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn no mu na ɛhɔ na ɔkɔnyaa n'abɔdin krataa a ɛdi kan.

N'amanyɔsɛm 
Sammy Gyamfi kɔpree dibrɛ sɛ ɔkasamafoɔ wɔ afe 2018 mu maa National Democratic Congress Amanyɔkuo no. Abatoɔ no baa awieeɛ no na w'adi nkunim wɔ nipa a ɔne no kɔpreeɛ no. saa brɛ no na Fred Agbenyo na Ɔyɛ kasamafo a ɔtɔ so mmienu ma  National Democratic Congress amanyɔkuo no a ɔne no kɔpreeɛ, abatoɔ baa awieeɛ no na Sammy Gyamfi de mma   mpem nnan na atwe no mu (4,000). Sammy Gyamfi nyaa mma no mu 6,225 firii mma 9,000 a wɔtoeɛ no mu. Fred Agbenyo nso nyaa mma no mu 2,225.

title: Securitas AB
text:
Wɔde Securitas AB sii hɔ wɔ afe 1934 mu wɔ Helsingborg, Sweden sɛ AB Hälsingborgs Nattvakt, bere a Erik Philip-Sørensen (sv) (1909-2001) tɔɔ ahobammɔ adwumakuw ketewaa bi no.

Wɔ afe 1972 mu no, wɔsesaa kuw no din Securitas (nl), de Roma nyamewa a ɔwɔ din koro no ara din, ahobammɔ ne ahotɔ nyame, a wɔde ahyɛnsode a ɛyɛ nsensanee kɔkɔɔ abiɛsa ne asɛmfua "Securitas" din. Wɔaka nsɛntitiriw no ho asɛm sɛ egyina hɔ ma kuw no gyinapɛn atitiriw “Nokwaredi, ani a ɛda hɔ ne mfaso a ɛwɔ so”2. Securitas nso kyerɛ “Ahobammɔ” wɔ Latin kasa mu.

Efi afe 2003 no, Securitas kuw no ayɛ Pinkerton Ɔman Nhwehwɛmu Dwumadibea a bere bi na wonim no sɛ ankorankoro nhwehwɛmu adwumayɛbea a ɛwɔ tumi sen biara wɔ United States no fa. Mprempren ɛde ahwehwɛfo mpem aduanan awotwe yɛ adwuma wɔ ɔman no mu nyinaa.

Securitas a ɛwɔ Canada no.

Wɔ August 2011 mu no, Securitas dii nkonim wɔ apam bi mu sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ “ahobammɔ wɔ Canada wimhyɛn gyinabea aduasa abien so wɔ apam bi a ne bo bɛyɛ Canada dɔla ɔpepem 481 (euro ɔpepem 340) ase”3.

Wɔ Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 2015 mu no, Securitas AB gyee Diebold, Amerika adwumakuo bi a ɛyɛ sika a wɔde ma ho adwuma titire no ɛlɛtrɔnik ahobanbɔ dwumadie, gyee dɔla ɔpepem 3504.

Wɔ December 2021 mu no, Securitas de too gua sɛ wɔayɛ apam sɛ wɔbɛtɔ no wɔ afe 2022 mu ama dɔla ɔpepepem 3.2 a ɛfa Stanley Security, Stanley Black & Decker adwumakuw bi a ɛyɛ ɛlɛtrɔnik ahobammɔ ho adwuma titiriw, a na Securitas de too gua wɔ sikakorabea wɔ afe 2006 mu, ansa na ɛrekɔ baguam .a Stanley Black & Decker bɛgye wɔ afe 20115 mu

title: Lamlameta
text:
Lamlameta yɛ agorɔ bi a amammerɛ kwan so no nnipa a ɛwɔ Konso a wɔte Olanta mpɔtam a ɛwɔ Ethiopa na ɛdi saa agorɔ no. British adesuani bi a wɔfrɛ no Richard Pankhurst na ɔdii kan kyerɛkyerɛɛmu afe apem ahankron ne aduoson baako mu. Mpem pii no mmarima na ɛdi saa agorɔ no.Edin  "Lamlaleta" kyerɛ sɛ abɔnta.

Nhyehyɛeɛ 
Taboo a wɔde di saa agorɔ yi de "toma tagéga, ɛwɔm bɛyɛ sɛ ntɔkwa mmienu a ɛmu biara yɛ amena du mmienu; a wɔfrɛ no awa. Wɔrehyehyɛ agorɔ no a wɔde mma mmienu toto amena biara mu. Sɛ eduru wo so a nea ɔreto no sesa aba ɛwɔ n'anim no nyinaa de toto amena nom hyia. Mpem pii no nea wɔde hyɛ aseɛ no yɛ amena a ɛbɛn wo nsa nifa. Sɛ yɛhwɛ nea ɔdiikan toiɛ no faeɛ noa, amena biara a ɛtoa so a ɛyɛ n'asɔretiafoɔ no dea a mma mmienu kum no wɔbɔtra. Agodifoɔ no to aba no ara kɔsi sɛ wɔde mma a ɛkura wɔn no nea aka no bɛto amena a aba biara nnim. Sɛ saa amena no yɛ nea ɔreto no amena na amena no a ɛne no di nhwɛnim no mma mmienu na ɛgu n'asɔretiafoɔ no amena mu a ɛneɛ wadi mma. Sɛ ɛba no saa mma biara a ɛgu n'asɔretiafoɔ no amena mu biara a ɛyɛ mmienu no wɔsesa firi taboo no so. Agorɔ no kɔ awieɛ wɔ aberɛ a wɔn a wɔredi agorɔ no mu baako aba asa. N'asɔretiafoɔ no sesa mma a ɛwɔ taboo no so nyinaa. Nea ɔnyaa mma pii no na wadi nkunim.

title: M'semen
text:
M'semen, msemmen anaa rghaif, yɛ paano aduane bi a ɛfiri Maghreb, a mpɛmpii wobɛhunu bi wɔ Algeria, Morocco, ne Tunisia. Wɔde ɛwoɔ anaasɛ tea anaa kɔfe na ɛfie. Wɔbɛtumi de nam(khlea) anaa gyeene ne ntoosi ahyehyɛ M'semen mu.

Aduane no ahodoɔ ne ne sɛsoɔ 
Aduane no bi wɔ hɔ a wɔbobɔ esam no kurukuruwa de yɛ sɛ 'disk' a yɛfrɛ no malwi wɔ abibirem atifiatɔeɛ.  Ɛsane nso sɛ Somali sabaayah.

Sedeɛ yɛsi yɛ aduane no

Wɔde esam, semolina hwiite, yeast a aho, nkuto a anane, nkyene, asikyire ne nsuo kakra na ɛyɛ saa aduane no. Wɔka saa akadeɛ yi nyinaa bom ma no bɛyɛ mmɔre kamakama. Wɔtwitwa mmɔre nom pii te sɛ bɔɔlo, na wɔde anwa afa ho abobɔ no amoamoa no ama ayɛ pɛ. Ne botaeɛ ne sɛ ɔbɛ buebue mmɔre no mu nyinaa ama no ayɛ pɛ anaasɛ ama no ayɛ kurukuruwa na wasane abobɔ ne fa no ama no ayɛ pɛ na wayɛ ahyɛnsodeɛ bi ato ho.Sɛ wɔbobɔ m'semen no wie a, wɔsane yɛ foforɔ de kata nea wabobɔ no so  na ama msemen no a ɛhyɛn no ayɛ nnwɔtwe. Adeɛ baako ne sɛ aberɛ a wɔrebobɔ no nyinaa na wɔde semolina no Pete so sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a ɛmma no ntare tare ho na ama kwan ama agya no aboa ama nea ɛhyehyɛ mu no mmɔ mu na mmom emu  atete sɛ wɔnoa.

title: Enkutatash
text:
Enkutatash yɛ afoofida a wɔdi no wɔ Ethiopia ne Eritrea afe ahyɛaseɛ mu. Wɔ Ethiopia kalɛnda so no wɔdi no Meskerem da a ɛdikan, a ɛyɛ ɛbɔ bosome da a ɛdikan wɔ Gregorian kalɛnda so.

Nhwehwɛmu 
Saa afoofida yi gyina Ethiopia kalɛnda so. Ɛyɛ afe foforɔ a ɛwɔ Ethiopia/Eritrean. Osebɔ kɛseɛ paa kɔso wɔ ɔman no mu, ne titire ɛwɔ Ragual asɔre wɔ Entoto bepɔso.

Incultureparent kyerɛɛ mu sɛ, " sɛ wɔpɔn firi asɔre anɔpa ba a, abusuafoɔ nyinaa hyia kyɛ wɔn aduane  a wɔfrɛ o injera( paano a State ne abomu). Akyire no, mmabunu no hyehyɛ wɔn ho fɛfɛɛfɛ ne wɔn ayɔnkofoɔ to afe foforɔ nnwom".  Ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ nsrahwɛ ho nsɛm wɔ Ethiopia kyerɛɛ mu sɛ, "Enkutatash nyɛ adeɛ a ɛnka ɔsom afoofida ho. Ɛnnɛ mmere yi Enkutatash yɛ berɛ a yɛde sesa ɛnkane afe foforɔ nkyea a ɛwɔ nkuro akɛseɛ mu- wɔ lieu beaɛ a nhwiren a wɔde kuta nsam pii wɔ. Wɔhyɛ Ethiopia mfeɛ kan firi mfeɛ nnwɔtwe a ɔwɔ berɛ pɔtee bi a ɛnnyɛ ka mu.  Ɛfiri sɛ saa berɛ pɔtee no no di Dionysius nkontabuo akyi,  barima hoteni a wadi mfeɛ ahansia, saa nso na non-Chalcedonian man toaaso de Annius nkontabuo dii dwuma, barima hoteni a wanya mfeɛ ahanum, a abɛhyɛ Kristo nkaebɔ anan bɛyɛ mfeɛ nnwɔtwe akyire no. Ɛnam saa nti, wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia a ɛwɔ Gregorian nnapono/kalɛnda so wɔ Enkutatash mu no, ɛbɛyɛɛ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nkron wɔ Ethiopia kalɛnda so.

title: Eskista
text:
Eskista yɛ amanneɛ bi a ɛwɔ Ethiopia amammerɛ asa mu firi Amhara nnipakuo bi mu a mmarima, maamefoɔ ne mmɔfra na ɛdi saa dwuma no. Ɛnam ne dwumadie soronko a wɔde wɔn abɛtiri yɛ a ɛne Shim-shim asa a ɛyɛ Tigrinya efipamfoɔ a ɛwɔ Eritrea ɛkyɛ nti ama nnipa pii noa nim saa asa no.Wɔ bobɔ sane pem san wɔ abɛtiri, pia wɔ bo ne wɔn kɔn ahoɔden so wɔ kwan pii so sɛ wɔresa saa asa noa. Eskista yɛ asa bi a wɔsa wɔ Ethiopia amanneɛ nnwom mu, nanso wobɛtumi asa saa asa no wɔ ɛnnɛ mmere yi nnwom ahodoɔ bi mu te sɛ nwoma wɔto no wɔ abɛɛfo mmere yi Ethiopia nnwom mfonin mu. Adeɛ a ɛyɛ den wɔ Ethiopia asa mu ne nnoɔma a ɛkɔso wɔ wɔn amammerɛ asa no. Wɔwɔ Eskista ahodoɔ wɔ mantam aduonu mu, a wɔn mu biara wɔ wɔn ara tetea abakwasɛm ne baabi soronko a ɛfiri, ɛwɔm sɛ pii no ara gyina akuafoɔ adantam binom a ɛwɔ Ethiopia adwumaden so. Nhwɛsoɔ ne sɛ, Muchi Mit(a wɔfrɛ no Zobiew) wɔ yɔ no wɔ Menjar na wɔde wɔn nan hyɛ mu suasua te sɛ nea Teff yɛ no, saa beaɛ no na ɛkyerɛ sɛ wonim yɛ ma no boro so.

text:

title: Apoo Afahyɛ
text:
Apoo Afahyɛ () yɛ afahyɛ bia wɔdi no afe biara wɔ atɔeɛ mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana (ne titire Techiman ne Wenchi nkuro mu), mu a wɔde nnawɔtwe baako ne edie wɔ abosome Ɔbɛnem ne Oforisuo mu. Neɛ nti a wɔdi afahyɛ no ne sɛ wɔde bɛte wɔn ho efiri asetena mu tumi bɔne biara ho, ne sɛ wɔde bɛka nnipakuo bi ne mmusua bi abɔm, na wɔdi amammerɛ dwumadie ahodoɔ beberee. Wɔnyaa asɛmfua 'poo' firii asɛmfua 'po' mu a ɛkyerɛ sɛ 'worepo biribi.'

Abakɔsɛm 
Nsɛm bia yɛde yɛn ano aka afa saa amammerɛ yi ho kyerɛ sɛ, saa afahyɛ yi hyɛɛ ase wɔ Nana Kwakye Ameyaw ahennie mu; na ɔyɛ panini bia ɔka obi nka bie, nti na Techimanfoɔ no ntumi nna wɔ tirimupɔw bi adi wɔ berɛ a ɔhyɛ biara nni mu. Berɛ a na wɔntumi nnyina saa ɔhyɛ yi ano bio no, wɔkɔɔ wɔn abosom anim. Wɔkyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnyi nna bi nto hɔ a wɔde bɛkɔ ɔhene no anim akɔda wɔn yaw ne titire nea ɛfa ɔhyɛ no ho ɛdi. Saa berɛ yi no wɔgye tumm sɛ wɔremmɔ obiara sumboɔ wɔ kasa bi ho ɛmfa ho ne wo debrɛ. Nnipa no bɛka sɛ 'merekɔpo me haw' a ɛkyerɛ sɛ merekɔka me boso asɛm, ɛnam wei so na wɔnyaa 'Apoo' afahyɛ no.

Amammerɛ 
Wɔn a wɔdi Apoo afahyɛ wɔ gyedie bi sɛ wɔtumi daa wɔn yaw ne amaneɛ a na wɔrekɔm no adi no, wate kuromafoɔ no kra ho afiri mmusuo ho. Wɔ Apoo afahyɛ no ahoboaboa ne ɛhoteɛ dwumadie mu no,  mmaa siesie wɔn fie ne akwan ahodoɔ so sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a mmusuo biara nsane mma wɔn so bio. Akɔmfoɔ a ɛwɔ nkuro no mu nso bɛto santene na wɔn asɛe honhom bɔne biara wɔde esie wɔ kuro no mu; wɔfrɛ saa dwumadie yi sɛ 'Nnusintuo 

Dwumadie a adi kan a ɛho hia yie ne Hereko' amammerɛ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ 'wɔregyegye ntowma fitaa'. Mmaa na ɛkɔfa saa nnɔteɛ yi firi Aponkosu asuo mu ba na wɔde siesie abosom fie ahodoɔ a ɛwɔ kuro no mu ansaana Apoo afahyɛ no ahyɛase. Akɔmfoɔ no nso de saa nnɔteɛ yi bi yɛyɛ wɔn ho berɛ wɔn ne wɔn abosom no redi nkitaho.

Wɔsi twene so dema nkurɔfoɔ hunu sɛ wɔahyɛ afahyɛ no ase. Nea ɔdi Apoo afahyɛ no santene anim ne Ɔman Kɔmfoɔ, kuro no mpanimfoɔ, ahene nketewa ne guasɛmfoɔ. Wɔ Apoo afahyɛ no santene no mu no, wɔda wɔn yaw ɛdi na wɔbɔ wɔn a wɔyɔɔ nnoɔma bɔne nso akutia. Wɔnyi wɔn hene no mpo mfiri saa akutiabɔ yi mu. Saa berɛ yi na wɔtoto abusua nsɛm na wɔka nnipa nso bɔ mu.

Wɔ afahyɛ no mu no, wɔde santene a wɔtooeɛ no bɛkɔ Bonohene wawuo nna so, ɔyɛ ɔhene ma Bonofoɔ. Ɔman kɔmfoɔ ne aman mpanimfoɔ no bi bɛkɔ akɔtwa ne nna no ho ahyea na wɔn egu nsa ayi apaeɛ. Nnipa a wɔka santene no ho bɛtwene wɔn abɔnten kɔsi sɛ wɔbɛwie. 'Banmuhene', a ɔyɛ nnipa a ɔwɔ adehyeɛ amusieeɛ no yɛ 'ɛtɔ' na wɔde ma nananom nsamanfoɔ. Ahene nketewa no de nsa gu ahenennwa a banmuhene no srɛ nkɔsoɔ ne asomdwoeɛ firi nsamanfoɔ no hɔ. Wɔtwa odwan de ne mogya no gu adeɛ bi mu. Wɔde odwan no fa bi gu emusieeɛ hɔ na wɔde nkaaeɛ nso ama mfena a ɛwɔ ahemfie hɔ ma wɔn de ayɛ aduane ama mpanimfoɔ no. Wɔde ɛtɔ no bi ma kuromafoɔ no na wɔwiee a Akɔmfoɔ no bɔ twene sa na amamfoɔ no nso ato nnwom wɔ emusieeɛ hɔ.

Nna a edi akyire no nkuro no nnipa di dwuama beberee firi anɔpa kɔsi anadwo. Mmusua ahodoɔ nso yɛyɛ nnuane ne wɔn abusuafoɔ di degye wɔn ani. Asa yɛ adeɛ bia ɛho hia wɔ Apoo afahyɛ no mu. Kuro no mu akɔmfoɔ siesie wɔn ho de sa. Binom so nam asa no so ne wɔn abosom twetwe nkɔmɔ. 

Nnipa a ɛwɔ kuro no mu nso siesie wɔn ho sa gye wɔn ani yie.

Afahyɛ no awieeɛ no, kɔmfo panini di santene anim kɔ ahemfie na ɔka nsɛm bi wɔde wie afahyɛ no. Wɔfiri ahemfie hɔ a wɔde santene no kɔ asuo a ɛwɔ kuro no mu ho, a ɔkɔmfo baa ne kuro mpanimfoɔ no yɛ amammerɛ bi. Wɔde ntwoma fufuo, adwera leaves ne asuo no bi fra pete abosom fie hɔ. Nnipa no san ba nkuro no mu bɛto Apoo ho nnwom.

title: Fiok Afahyɛ
text:
Fiok Afahyɛ yɛ afahyɛ bia wɔdi wɔ Sandema a ɛwɔ Upper East mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Wɔdi Afahyɛ no wɔ Ɔpɛnimma bosome no mu afe biara.

Sɛdeɛ wɔdi afahyɛ no 
Wɔn a wɔsa ako asa firi nkuro ahodoɔ a ɛwɔ mantam no mu bɛsa wɔ abɔnten. Wɔfa ako nnoɔma bi te sɛ pea, akumaa tiatia ne ako ho nnoɔma beberee di dwuma da ako a akɔso wɔ mfeɛ a etwam no adi. Wɔsan so da kwan a wɔfa so gyina ɔhaw ano ne kwan a Babatu faa so dii nkuguo.

Afahyɛ no so mfasoɔ 
Afahyɛ no ho hia yie wɔ Builsa mmeaeɛ seisei. Wɔkyerɛ sɛ afahyɛ no ama wɔn ehunu nipa a wɔn yɛ na ɛsan so de nkabɔm aba.

title: Dipo
text:
Dipo  yɛ ammamerɛ bi a ɔyɛ no wɔ Ghana  a Krobofoɔ na ɔyɛ saa ammamerɛ yi wɔ apuieɛ Mantam wɔ Ghana. Ɔyɛ saa afahyɛ yɛ wɔ Oforisuo bosome no afe biara mu. Ɔyɛ Saa afahyɛ de ma Maa bunu wɔ adu wɔn mpanimfie wɔ yɛ saa ammamerɛ yi de kyerɛ sɛ saa Mabunu yi adu wɔn awareɛ mfeɛ so. ammamerɛ. Awofoɔ te  saa nkaeɛbɔ a ɛfa Bragorɔ anaa Dipo yi ho a ɔde wɔn maa a wadu saa mfeɛ no si kɔ ɔman komfoɔ  ho. Ɛmma wɔn ka saa afahyɛ ye ho no yɛ de wɔn fa ammamerɛ  ahodoɔ mu na Ɔkomfoɔ no hwɛ sɛ saa Mabunu no mfa  barima da anasɛ wɔn mu bi mfa afuro ansaa na wa ma ho kwan ama wayɛ saa ammamerɛ yi.

Sɛnea ɔyɛ Dipo/Bragorɔ 
Ɛda a ɛdi kan no ɔyɛ  mmabunu no nyinaa tire so nuwo na ɔde ntoma twan wɔ asen de kɔsii wɔn kotodwei.Ɔbaapanin bi na ɔyɛ saa amannea no na ɛno kyerɛ sɛ wafiri mmɔfra mu rekɔ mpanimfie mu. Wɔ de wɔn kyene kuro nomu nyinaa (dipo-yo).

Anɔpa tutu no ɔkomfoɔ no kɔ dware Mmabunu no anɔpa. Ɔyi apaei  de sre nhyira firi ɔbo adaeɛ ho ma Mmabunu. Ɔde Abirekyere mogya hohorɔ wɔn nan ase wɔ wɔn awofoɔ anim. Ɔyɛ wei de pamɔ bɔnyine  homhom biara firi wɔn  bra mu.Wɔ de wɔn tena boɔ a musuo biara ni ho. Wie kyerɛ sɛ ɔyɛ Mmabunu.

Na sɛ ɔhunu sɛ Mma no bi nyim anaa wafa barima da wɔtwa no asi firi kuro no so na abranteɛ biara ani ngye ne ho sɛ ɔni no bɛ tena mpo.

Wo de wɔ hyɛ dan mu kyerɛkyerɛ wɔn sɛnea ɔyɛ aduane nannwɔtwe no ɔkyerɛ wɔn sɛnea ɔyɛ aduane,ɔsiesie fie,ne sɛnea awoɔ ne abatetiɛ tie. Ɔbapanin a ɔkyerɛ wɔn da nnoɔma yi bɛ kyekyɛ wɔn nea wɔn kununom hwehwɛ firii wɔn ho wɔ awareɛ mu.Wɔ kyerɛ wɔn klama asa a wɔ bɛsa no da a ɔwie dwumadie no.

Nea Ɔyɛ no Afahyɛ da no 
Nnwɔtwe no yea mu a ɔde wɔn nyinaa bɛgyina kuro no mu ma wɔn nyinaa nso bɛkyɛ wɔn da no mu anigyie de kɔ wɔn mma yɔ mu.

Wɔ Futa wɔn kente afadeɛ de nhwiniɛ to wɔn asen,kɔn ne wɔn nsa. Wɔn  to dwom de ntwene sa klama asa. Saa merɛ yi nyinaa no abranteɛ a no anigyie Mmabunu yi ho bi nso a ɔhyɛaseɛ hwehwɛ Ɔbaa no abusua mu.

Mfasoɔ  Ɛwɔ Soɔ 
Ɛde animuonyam berɛ ɔbaa no abusua nyinaa.Ɛmma wɔn de ɔbuoɔ ma wo ɛsane ma wo nya animuonyam na ɛbɛma wo  ɔhokane kamakama.

title: Bragoro
text:
Bragoro a yɛsane frɛ no Brapue yɛ amammerɛ bi a Akanfoɔ ne titire Asantefoɔ yɛ ma obi a waduru ne mpanin mfeɛ so. Amammerɛ kwan so, sɛ ababaawa bi bu ne nsa a ɛdikan a, wɔyɛ saa amammerɛ a wɔfrɛ no bragoro no ma no. Wɔgyedi sɛ ɛno na ɛma no kɔ ne mpanin fie so. Sɛ ababaawa bi bu ne nsa a ɛdikan a ɔmaame kɔbɔ mpaninfoɔ, ɔbaahemaa ne mpaninfoɔ a ɛwɔ mpɔtam hɔ amanneɛ ma wɔhunu sɛ ne babaa no aduru sɛ wɔbɛyɛ saa amammerɛ no ama no. Ɛwɔm sɛ Bragoro wɔ mfasoɔ deɛ nanso ɛreyera.

title: Gmayem festival
text:
Gmayem afahyɛ a wɔsane frɛ no Mgmayem afahyɛ yɛ afahyɛ bi a ahemfo ne nnipa a ɛwɔ shai Osudoku mansini a ɛwɔ Ghana na ɛdi. Wɔdi Mgmayem afahyɛ afe biara na ɛde nnipa ba saa mpɔtam hɔ, wɔn a wɔwɔ hɔ ne wɔn a wɔwɔ aburokyire ma wɔ kabom de mpontuo aba ɔman nom. Wɔdi saa afahyɛ no de kaeɛ kɔm bi a ɔdii hɔ mfeɛ bi a atwam nom. Sɛ wohwɛ nnabupono no so a, watwe ayie nyinaa asensɛn hɔ kɔpem sɛ wɔbɛdi  afahyɛ no awie na wasrɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnni nhyehyɛeɛ no so na mmara ne wɔn a wɔbɛtua saa nhyehyɛeɛ no bɛdi no nwononwono. Wɔdi saa afahyɛ no ahinime bosome wɔ afe biara mu nanso ɛnam wɔn amammerɛ nnabupono no nti ɛsesa.

title: Asafotufiam Afahyɛ
text:
Asafotufiam Afahyɛ () yɛ afahyɛ bia wɔdi no wɔ Ada a ɛwɔ Dangme East wɔ Nkran Mantam wɔ Ghana. Wɔdi afahyɛ no wɔ Ɔsanaa bosome ne nnwɔtwe a adi kan wɔ afe biara mu.

Beaeɛ a afahyɛ no firi baeɛ 
Edin 'Asafotufiam' no, wɔnyaa firii 'Asafotufiami' mu a wɔ Dangme kasa mu no ɛkyerɛ 'etuo tu nkyekyɛmu'. Edin "Asafo-tu-fiam" no kura edin nkyekyɛmu mmiɛnsa.

Deɛ adi kan ne "Asa" a ɛyɛ "Sa" ne dodoɔ kabea, a ɛyɛ din asɛm. "Sa" a ɛyɛ ne din ankasa, a ɛtɔ mmerɛ bi a wɔfrɛ no "Osa", "Asa" anaa "Aesir", a ɛkyerɛ tumi kɛseɛ a ɔbɔɔ wiase nyinaa no sunsum honam. Deɛ ɛfiri Ga-Adamgbefoɔ hɔ no kyerɛ sɛ, edin "Osa" ne din a seisei wɔka no Osiris. Na "Osa" yɛ Nubiani barima tuntum bi a na anka wɔsom no wɔ waise. Ɔka tete Ada mpanimfoɔ a na wɔsommo no ho bi.

Neɛ ɛtɔ so mmienu ne "Tu". "Tu" yɛ edin a wɔde frɛ etuo wɔ Dangbe. Edin "Tu" asekyerɛ ne Sunsum, honam ne kra. 

Deɛ ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa ne "Fia" anaa "Fiam" a ɛkyerɛ sɛ to tuo. "Tufiam" nkyerɛase ne etuo toɔ. 

"Asafotu" yɛ akofoɔ a wɔto tuo wɔ afahyɛ berɛ no mu.

Abakɔsɛm 
Adangmefoɔ koo ako beberee a na wɔde rehwehwɛ beaeɛ ama wɔn nkurɔfoɔ atena. Ako a ɛgyee din no bi ne Katamanso ko a esii wɔ afe apem ahanwɔtwe ne aduonu nsia (1826) mu, Glover ko a esii wɔ afe apem ahanwɔtwe ne aduoson nsia (1876) mu, ne Nonobe ko a esii wɔ afe apem ahanson ne aduonum (1750). Adafoɔ tumi gyinaa ako yi nyinaa ano ma wɔn tumi sii Ada kuropɔn no. Sɛdeɛ na ako no reyɛ beberee no wɔyii apayɛ bɔɔ wɔn akofoɔ no ho ban san so de gyee wɔn baa fie asomudwoe mu.    

Wɔ afe apem and ahankron mu (1900) no, wɔtwaa apayɛ a na wɔyɛ de ma akofoɔ no ɛnam sɛ na ako biara mma bio. Kuromafoɔ no hunu sɛ ɛwɔ sɛ wɔbɔ saa akofoɔ yi aba so, nti wɔhyehyɛɛ Asafotufiam Afahyɛ a wɔde sii saa apayɛ no anan mu maa saa akofoɔ no a na wɔrefiri ako mu aba no.     

sɛdeɛ wɔde bɛda wɔn abakɔsɛm adi nti, sɛ eduru saa afahyɛ yi a, akofoɔ no hyehyɛ ako ntadeɛ. Saa berɛ yi nso yɛ berɛ a wɔde kyerɛ mmɛranteɛ ako.    

Wɔwɔ Asafo kuo afa afa mmienu wɔ Ada, wɔn ne Akomfode ne Asorkor. Nnipa a ɛwɔ saa kuo yi mu nyinaa de ɛna adeɛ.

Sɛdeɛ wɔde afahyɛ no 
Afahyɛ no die hyɛ aseɛ wɔ Yawoada wɔ nnawɔtwe a adi kan wɔ Ɔsanaa bosome no mu. Yawoada no yɛ da a wɔde ma akwantufoɔ akwaaba ba fie, wɔ saa da no ara nso na wɔsiesie kuro no mu ne wɔn afie. 

Wɔ Efiada ahomenakye no, Asafo kuo mmienu no si twene de kae amanfoɔ no wɔn santene a wɔderekɔ Luhuese. Saa berɛ no nso wɔde kyerɛ mmeranteɛ sɛdeɛ wɔkura tuo.

title: Bobiri Butterfly Sanctuary
text:
Bobiri forest Deserve ne Butterfly Sanctuary yɛ nsrahwɛbea a ɛwɔ Ghana ne Afranfrantɔ kronkronbea baakopɛ a ɛwɔ abibire atɔeɛ. Ɛwɔ afranfrantɔ bɛyɛ ahanan. Ɛwɔ Nkran-Kumase kwantenpɔn so wɔ Kubease akurase, bɛyɛ kwansini aduasa sɛ worefiri kumase akɔ hɔ a. Sɛ worefiri KNUST akɔ hɔ nso a ɛbɛyɛ sima aduonu num. Ɛkata mpɔtam nsia so, ɛno ne Krofrom, Kubease,Ndobom, Koforidua, Nkwankwaduam ne Tsteteseakasum. Bobiri kwaeɛ no nso yɛ beaɛ a wɔde asie yɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ hɔ na ɛwɔ afranfrantɔ abusua pii wɔ Ghana. Wɔtee saa beaɛ no wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduasa baako na ne kɛseɛ bɛyɛ 54.65km.

title: Nancy Agag
text:
Nancy Agag a wɔsane  twerɛ no Nancy Ajaj(wɔwoo no ɔbenem bosome da a ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduoson nkron), yɛ nnɛmafoɔ yi Sudanese nnwomtoni a ɔsane twerɛ nnwom. Wɔ ne nnwom mu no, ɔde tete Sudanesefoɔ no bi fra ne nnwom nom to. Ne nnwom no nhyehyɛeɛ no yɛ nnɛmafoɔ deɛ no bi, ɔno ara ne kuo a wako adare wɔ nnwom mu na ɛbɔ nwom no, na ɔgye n'ani wɔ Sudan ne amanɔne nso.

N'abrabɔ ne ne nnwom adwuma 
Wɔwoo Nancy Agag wɔ Omdurman na ɔnyinii wɔ Netherlands, ɛhɔ na Ɔsuaa Social History ne nnwom. Ne papa  Badr al-Din Ajaj nso yɛ nnwomtoni a wagye din paa, na wɔkumm no berɛ a ɔsane baa Sudan.

Ɛfiri mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan rekɔ no, Nancy Agag ne ne kuo no yɛɛ mmɔsoɔ pii wɔ Sudan, US, England, Canada,Qatar ne Netherlands.Ɔtoo nnwom a agyedin a ɛfa ne kurom ho nso, wayɛ nnwom ne nnwom mfonin ahodoɔ pii. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia mu no, German amammerɛ fie a ɛwɔ Khartoum too ne nnwom mmienu de yɛɛ amanɔne dwumadie bi, a wɔde nnwom mfonin a ɛfiri Sudan, Egypt ne Middle East kaa ho.

Nancy Agag ka mmaa kakra bi a wɔto nnwom no ho a wɔpuee nnɛɛmafo ntaadehyɛ mu, mpo wamfa duku a ɛyɛ ɔhyɛ sɛ wɔmfa nkata wɔnti anhyɛ wɔ Omar al  Bashir aban dwumadie no ase kɔpem mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nkron mu. Ansana wɔrebɛgu Public order Law no, na mpaninfoɔ de akwansideɛ pii asi mmaa ahosiesie ho wɔ badwam.

Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nnwɔtwe ne du nkron Suadanese atuateɛ mu no, ɔde ne nnwom bi a wɔfrɛ no 'Birth' too dwa, sɛ wohwɛ Sudanese nnwom yiyie no mua "the sounds of sudan', kyerɛɛ sɛdeɛ na Sudan ɔpɛnimaa atuateɛ no teɛ.

title: Sometutuza
text:
Keta-Sometutuza anaa Keta-Sometutu afahyɛ yɛ afahyɛ bi a wɔdi no afe biara a wɔtwa nnɔbaeɛ a ahemfo ne nnipa a wɔwɔ Agbozume a ɛwɔ Ketu Anaafoɔ mansini a ɛwɔ Ghana Fram mantam na ɛdie. Hogbestosto afahyɛ nnwɔtwe mmienu akyire na wɔdi saa afahyɛ no. Nnipa a ɛwɔ Somey a wɔwɔ Agbozume,Denu ne nkuro a ɛwɔ hɔ na ɛdi de kae tu a wɔtu de firii keta wɔ afe apem ahannson ne aduokron mmienu dekɔ aduokron nan mu wɔ Keta-Anloga ntɔkwa no akyire. Wɔdi saa afahyɛ no memeneda a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa wɔ Obubuo bosome mu.

Sɛdeɛ wodi afahyɛ no 
Wɔyɛ afɛfɛdeɛ nnoɔma wɔ afahyɛ no ase.Ahemfo ahodoɔ nso ba bɛdi dwuma wɔ aseɛ. Wɔde Ketu amammerɛ na ɛhyɛ afahyɛ no ase￼ ne dwabɔ no ankasa ase wɔ Agbozume. Ahemfo no de obuo ma wɔn manhene na wasane ayɛ wɔn som no foforɔ akyerɛ wɔn. Sɛ wɔredi afahyɛ noa, wɔda Ewe kente ahodoɔ pii ne amammerɛ ntadeɛ bi a wanwene nso adi.

Mfasoɔ 
Wɔdi saa afahyɛ no de kae atoyerɛnkyɛm a ɛtoo wɔn maa wɔfirii ketu, baabi a wɔfiri ne baabi a wabɛduru seisei.

Wɔsusu sɛ sɛ Wa Naa no tumi huri tra nantwie a ɛbɛma ne nkwa aware. Ɔhene no ahoɔden na ɛbɛma wɔahunu sɛ ɔbɛtumi atoaso adi ne manfoɔ so. Ɛnwɔsɛ Ɔhene no honam anaa n'ataadeɛ ka nantwie no. Sɛ ɔhene no antumi anyɛ saa adeɛ no a, wɔsusu sɛ ɛyɛ nnome a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɔnni ahoɔden na ɔntumi ntoaso nni kuro no so.

title: Gwandarafoɔ
text:
Gwandarafoɔ  ye yɛ abusuakuo bi a ɔwɔ Nigeria.Na yɛ bɛhunu wɔn wɔ Abuja, Nassarawa, Kano, Niger ne Kaduna.

Nea ɔfiri 

Gwandarafoɔ firi Kano.Wɔ firi Bargauhe adwene mu a yɛnim sɛ ɔfiri wɔn a na ɔyɛ Kane ansa na Bagaudas. Ɛwɔ afe ahanan aduoson ne nsia, wɔ firi Kano berɛ a Prince Karsi (Gwandara)sɛ nea na ɛbɛyɛ a wɔ bɛdwani ɛfiri nkramo som ho.Prince Gwandara yɛ nua Kumasi ma Ɔhene a na ɔtesoɔ a ɔgye nkramosom de baa kano na ɔwetaso sɛ kwan biaraso ɔbɛma wɔn anya asom foforɔ. Ɔno nso yɛ adwene sɛ ɔbɛdi ne Nananom abosim akyea na wɔn gyedie kyerɛ wɔn sɛɛmoa wɔ tumi. Ɛnam ɛhu asem a wɔte yɛ nti nɔa na ɛdi wɔn bɛkɔ nkoasom mu nti,Ɔni ne kye gyinafoɔ kɔ atifi fa mu a ɛwɔ Gwagwa. Ɛnam ntansa ahodoɔ a na ɔde bɔ no nti ɔdwane firii hɔ kpɔ jukun ɛhɔ na afie wɔn mu kyekyɛ yɛ wɔ Nigeria.

Beaɛ a Me Nya Moa Firiɛ

title: Alkayida
text:
Alkayida, a wɔsane frɛ no Akayida yɛ Ghana asa bi a sɛ wɔresa a wɔkɔ nkyɛn nkyɛn,a  wɔde honam yɛ nneyɔeɛ bi wɔm na ekuo bi nso yɛ adeɛ baako wɔ asa nom ne ankorankorɛ kansie. Sɛ wɔresa Akayida a wɔdwodwo wɔn ho, yɛ nneyɛeɛ biara wɔm, wɔde wɔn nan di dwuma wɔm na wɔde hip-life asa nso agyina mu. Wɔde wɔnsa ne wɔn abɛtire sosɔ wɔn honam mu yɛ nneyɛeɛ pii wɔ kwan bi so. Guru a ɔyɛ hip-life nwontoni a ɔmaa asa no gyee din yie no kaa sɛ, wɔntwerɛ asa no din "Akayida".

Sɛdeɛ wɔsa saa asa no 
Asa a wɔtwerɛ no Alkayida no hyɛɛ aseɛ nkakrankakra a wɔtu anamɔn bia anka ɛyɛ akɔ sɛ asa foforɔ na seisei asa no ne ne nhyehyɛeɛ abɛyɛ krabɛhwɛ na "Alkayida" a wɔntwerɛ no yie "Al Qaeda" ɛnyɛ adeɛ sɛ ɛne azonto no nkɔ nkoa na mmom ɛgyae  amammerɛ a ɛwɔ Ghana hip-life no mu agyeegyee mu kɔ ekuo bi a wɔde owuo ne sɛeɛ kɛseɛ ba a wɔfrɛ no Al-Qaeda.

Kwan a ɛfaa so hyetaa baabiara 
Guru a ɔyɛ hip-life nwontoni na ɔde Alkayida asa baeɛ berɛ a ɔmaa no gyee din wɔ no nwom "Alkayida (Boys Abrɛ)" mu. 'Brɛ' wɔ Asante kasa mu kyerɛ sɛ wabapa. Wɔ Guru nnwom Alkayida u no, ne nyesoɔ ne "Boys Abrɛ", na saa nyesoɔ yi kɔwura mmabunu kasa mu. Wɔhyɛɛ ɛda maa Asamoah Gyan ne Black star dom no maa wɔsaa "Alkayida" maa obiara hwɛɛ bi  wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nan wiase nyinaa bɔɔlobɔ. Gyan ne wɔn a aka no saeɛ berɛ a na Ghana ne Germany bɔ bɔɔlo a wɔtoo atena no.  Wɔsaa azonto mmom na ɛnyɛ Alkayida.

Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nan mu no, Panamaniannii bi  ɔsa, deejay ne Honduran bi a ɔda a wɔfrɛ no AlBeezy de nwom "Lacaida" baa abɔten a na ɛne Guru nwom no reyɛ asɛ nanso na n'atwerɛ no da nso na asa no deɛ ɛyɛ ɛ. Wei maa asa no gyee din kakra wɔ Panama na ɛkwan bi nso no, ɛmaa Guru nwom e Azonto nwom nso kɔɔ n'anim.

title: Gomoa Atɔeɛ Mansini
text:
Gomoa Atɔeɛ mansini yɛ mansini aduonu mmienu a ɛwɔ Ghana mfimfini mantam. Na ɛka ɛnkane Gomoa mansini a na ɛso wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe nwɔtwe mu, kɔpem sɛ mansini a ɛwɔ apueɛ nom kyɛeɛ ma wɔtee Gomoa apueɛ mansini a edikan, a Gomoa yɛ n'ahenkuro,wɔ ɔgyefoɔ bosome da a ɛtɔso aduonu nkron wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe mu (a akyire wɔkyɛɛ mansini foforɔ nom mmienu wɔ ɔbɛnem bosome da a ɛtɔ so du num wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe mu:Gomoa mfimfini mansini (Ahenkuro:Potsin)); ɛne sɛ wato nkaeɛ a aka no din Gomoa Atɔeɛ mansini. "District Assembly" no wɔ mfimfini mantam anaafoɔ apueɛ fam na Apam yɛ n'ahenkuro.

title: Dangme East
text: Dangme East mansini  yɛ a na kane wɔka Nkran mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana ho. Mpasua yi yɛ mpasua bi a wɔtee no wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe nwɔtwe (1988) mu a wɔtee firii kane Dangme mansini mu. Nanso, wɔ Ayɛwohomumɔ bosome ne da a ɛtɔ aduonu nwɔtwe (28) mu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne dummienu (2012) wɔkyɛɛ mansini no mu mmienu: Ada East Mansini(Ada Foah) ne Ada Wast Mansini (sege).

title: Batakari
text:
Abibirem Fugu a wɔsane frɛ no Batakari wɔ Ghana kasa mu yɛ mmarima atadeɛ a yɛagye atom wɔ amammerɛ kwan so a ɛfiri Abibirem Atɔeɛ na ne saa nti ɛwɔa Ghana atifi fam.Ɛwɔm sɛ ɛfiri Ghana Atifi fam deɛ nso wɔagye atom wɔ Ghana afanaa nyinaa mu. Edin Fugu no nkyerɛaseɛ firi Moshie din a wɔde ma atadeɛ. Dagombafoɔ frɛ ntoma no Bingba.

title: Joyce Ababio
text:
Joyce Ababio(wɔwoo no wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe nwɔtwe) yɛ Ghanani a ɛpam ntaadeɛ. Ɔno ne Joyce Ababio College of Fashion Design nyinaa kɔfabaeɛ ne CEO.

Nnwomasua 
Joyce Ababio kɔɔ Achimota sukuu. Ɔkɔɔ ne ntoasoɔ sukuu wieɛ no, ɔkɔɔ sukuu wɔ St. Cloud State Suapɔn a ɛwɔ Minnesota, USA. Ɔsuaa Medical Technology afe akyire no,ɔne n'afutufoɔ kasaeɛ ma wɔde no kɔɔ Texas mmaa Suapɔn,ɛhɔ na ɔnyaa ne degree wɔ Fashion Designing mu.

Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmiɛnsa mu no, ɔbuii sukuu a ɔde ato no ho a wɔfrɛ no Joyce Ababio College of Creative Design (JACCD) wɔ Nkran, Ghana.

Abasobɔdeɛ ne Nkaeɛ 
Nnoɔma a ɔnyaeɛ na ɛdidisoɔ yi.

Ateasefoɔ

title: Atta-Kwame Fie
text:
Efie a wɔde atɛkyɛ asi a wɔfrɛ no "Atta Kwame" no yɛ tete ne amammerɛ dan a Mpempii no ɛwɔ Ghana nkurase. Nnipa a ɛwɔ Asante mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana gyedi tom sɛ wɔn a wɔyɛ ahiafoɔ na wɔde atɛkyɛ si wɔn fie na ɛnnyɛ adeɛ a ɛyɛ fɛ a ɛbɛma wɔn asetena awie pɛyɛ akyɛ. Nsuo bɛtumi aseɛ saa afie yi ɛna anwia a wɔde sii adan no nyɛ adeɛ a ɛbɛtumi adi mfeɛ pii.

Yɛn amammerɛ fie no ka ɔman no agyapadeɛ ho. Nhwɛsoɔ baako ne afie a wɔde atɛkyɛ asi wɔ Ghana, a ebi ma abusua kɛseɛ baabi de wɔn ti to. Nsuyiri aseɛ adan no pii. Ɛwɔ sɛ wɔn a wɔde nhyehyɛeɛ gu kwan so ma wɔn ani kɔ ho. 

Awerɛhosɛm ne sɛ, Afie ahodoɔ pii noa nni tebea papa mu. Ɔhaw baako a ɛwɔ hɔ paa ara ne nsiesie a atokyema. Afie a wɔde atɛkyɛ asie pii no ara asɛe. ￼ Amanneɛ titire baako ne sɛ baabi a wɔsii dan no yɛ beaɛ a nsuo wɔ a ɛhɔ yɛ mmerɛ 

Wɔde nsakraeɛ aba adan a wɔde atɛkyɛ asie no ama ɛnɛ wɔn a wɔte hɔ  abisadeɛ no awie pɛyɛ. Nnoɔma a wɔde yɛ no wɔde Dɔteɛ, hyire ne mmoba na ɛkafra de sie.

Beaɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ.

title: Nzema Apueɛ Mansini Adantam
text:
Nzema Apueɛ Mansini Adantam ka mansini du nan a ɛwɔ Atɔeɛ mantam, Ghana. Wɔtee no sɛ mansini bi kɛkɛ wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe nwɔtwe na wɔfrɛ no Nzema Apueɛ mansini no, a ɛnkane Nzema Mansini bɛdwafoɔ na ɛteɛ,kɔpem ɔmanpanin a na ɔte adwa so saa berɛ no, John Agyekum Kufour kyɛɛ atɔeɛ fam a ɛwɔ mansini nom wɔ Ɔgyefoɔ bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nnwɔtwe wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe mu de tee Ellembelle mansini,ɛne sɛ wɔde beaɛ ɔkaeɛ no yɛɛ Nzema Apueɛ mansini,a ɛno akyire no wɔde yɛɛ mansini adantam wɔ afe korɔ no ara mu ma no bɛyɛɛ Nzema Apueɛ mansini Adantam. Mansini adantam no wɔ anaafoɔ atɔeɛ fam wɔ atɔeɛ mantam na Adum yɛ n'ahenkuro.

Tenabea Ahodoɔ a ɛwɔ hɔ

title: Peki
text:
Peki yɛ kuro bi a ɛwɔ South Dayi Mansini a ɛwɔ Fram mantam wɔ Ghana. Ɛwɔ nkuro a ɛhyehyɛ mu bɛyɛ nnwɔtwe, a ebiara wɔ ahemfo -Tsame,Avetile,Afeviwofe,Blengo,Dzake,Wudome,Dzobati ne Adzokoe. Saa ahemfo nketewa yi nyinaa kaa ntam kyerɛɛ ɔhempɔ  a wɔfrɛ no Deiga. Wɔfrɛ ɔhene a ɔde adwa so seisei no Deiga Kwadwo Sei XII. Ɛnam Peki ntoasoɔ sukuu so, E.P Seminary ne Aban kɔlegyi GOVCO so na ama kuro no agye din. Sukuu no yɛ sukuu bi a ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ hɔ.

Abakɔsɛm 
Kwadwo Sei Tutu Yao II frɛ Reverend Lorenz Wulf a ɛwɔ North German Missionary society ma no baa Peki. Wulf bɛduruu Obubuo bosome da a ɛtɔ so du nan wɔ afe apem ahannwɔte ne aduanan nson, ɛda a wɔde di Evangelical Presbyterian Asɔre kuo a ɛwɔ Ghana. Wɔ afe apem ahannwɔte ne aduanan nwɔtwe mu no ɔtee sukuu.

Adan a ɛwɔ hɔ 
 Peki Government Hospital
 Peki College of Education
 Peki Senior High School

Beaɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Claudia Lumor
text:
Claudia Lumor (a wɔwoo no Kotonimaa bosome da a ɛtɔ so du nson wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe) yɛ Ghanani a ɔtintim nwoma so, Glitz Africa Magazine ne Glitz Style Abasobɔdeɛ kɔfabaeɛ. Ɔsane yɛ obi a ɔda Glitz Fashion week Ghana ano.

Nnwomasua 
Lumor wiee Kwame Nkrumah suapɔn wɔ B.A Economics ne Law mu. Ɔsane suaa Corporate Fianance Law wɔ Westminster Law￼ sukuu wɔ London.

Ne Nnwuma 
Ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ Santander Sikakorabea a ɛwɔ UK ɛna ɛno akyire no ɔbaa Ghana ne Stanbic Sikakorabea bɛyɛɛ adwuma wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nom. Na Lumor din ka 'womanRising' akasafoɔ, ekuo a ɛboa mmaa a ɛwɔ nsaano nnwuma pii ho. Saa dwumadie no frɛɛ mmaa num a wɔwɔ nimdeɛ wɔ nnwuma ahodoɔ mu: Kafui Sanku, Deloris Frimpong Manso,Ekow Mensah,Vera Osei-Bonsu ne Cynthia Quarcoo. Na ɔka tetenafoɔ aduonum a wɔsua wɔ Ghana a Advance Media ne The YCEO de wɔn din too dwa nom. Ɔyɛ ntamgyinafoɔ mapa ma UNFPA.

Nea yɛde kae no  

 Young creative entrepreneur of the year - British Council Fashion And Design 2015.
 Start up and Entrepreneur of the year - Ghana Startup Awards 2017.
 100 most Influential women in Ghana.

Beaɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Edith Dankwa
text:
Dr. Edith Dankwa yɛ obi a ɔyɛ nnwuma pii, kɔnsɔtan ne obi a ɔda  Business and Finance Time Limited ano. Ɛnam ne nnwuma a ɔyɛ nti ama nnipa pii no ara nim no ɛna ɔsomfoɔ ma nnwuma pii a  na ɛhwehwɛ sɛ ɛbɛtrɛ ne nnwuma mu wɔ Abibirem.  Ɔtotoo Business Time Africa Magazine (BT),Energy Today Magazine (ET) ne the Business ne Financial Time(B&FT) koowaa nkrataa wɔ ne dwumakuo Umbrella , the Business ne Financial Time Limited ase.

Nnwomasua 
Ɔnyaa ne bakyela of degree wɔ Management studied firii Cape Coast suapɔn, akyire na ɔkyɛɛ ne MBA firii GIMPA Business sukuu mu. Ɔwɔ Post Graduate Diploma wɔ Marketing mu a ɔnya firii the Chartered Institute of Marketing, Ghana ne Post Graduate nkrataa wɔ Newspaper Management firii Inwent International Institute of Journalism, Germany. Edith sane ka Institute of certified Economics of Ghana a ɔwɔ doctoral degree wɔ Business Administration (International Business) firii Walden University a ɛwɔ USA.

Nnwuma 
Dr. Dankwa asom wɔ TV3 adwumakuo nom, the International chamber of Commerce(Ghana), Ghana need Agency ne Unilever Ghana.￼ Ɔsane yɛ ekuoba wɔ Executive Women Network, tetenani wɔ African Business Leaders Foundation ne Institute for Development and Policy Ɔmanpanin.

Nnoɔma ɔnyaeɛ ne Abasobɔdeɛ 
 The Entrepreneurs Foundation of Ghana, bɔɔ Dr. Dankwa abasobɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu sɛ ‘Best Print Media Entrepreneur’ wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du baako nom.
 eTV Ghana recognised her as one of the 100 Most Influential Personalities in Ghana for 2013.
 Top 100 Most Inspirational Women of the Year by Glitz Awards.

Beaɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Gladys Amoah
text:
Na Gladys Amoah yɛ obi a ɔto Unilever Ghana. Wɔyii no no wɔhyɛɛ n'adwuma ase Obubuo bosome a ɛdikan wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nnwɔtwe dekɔ Ɔpɛnimaa bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduonu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nkron. Na Gladys na ɔsane yɛ ntotoiɛ fa sɛdeɛ dwadifoɔ adetɔ bɛtu mpɔn wɔ Unilever Ghana ɛno akyire na ɛbɛyɛɛ ntotoeɛfoɔ panin wɔ saa dwumakuo no ara mu berɛ a Mr. Ziobeieton Yei paa ne ho akyi firii hɔ wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nnwɔtwe mu no.

Ne Nnwuma 
Berɛ a na ɔyɛ kwankyerɛfoɔ ma adetɔfoɔ no ɔnyaa suahunu wɔ adetɔfoɔ nnoɔma a ɛkɔso ntɛntɛm bɛyɛ mfeɛ aduonu wɔ ne pɛn so. Ɔsane nyaa diberɛ wɔ dwadie mu wɔ mfeɛ a atwam nom firii fie,nsɛm a ɛfa ankorankorɛ ho, efie ho nnuane. Owurayere Amoah de ne ho kɔbɔɔ dwumakuo bi wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu mu na ɔbɛyɛɛ ahonidie ho kwankyerɛfoɔ maa adetɔfoɔ wɔ South Africa a ɛfa ankorankorɛ ho.

Beaɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Nku
text:
Nku  yɛ biribi a ɛyɛ sradeɛ a ɛtumi yɛ mmerɛ sɛ nsuo a wɔde fa tiri nwii mu.  Deɛ nku yɛ pa ara ne sɛ, ɛma tiri nwii no ani yɛ fɛ na ama no anya ahoɔden nso.  Ɛkyɛ sene nnoɔma nkaeɛ a wɔde yɛ tiri nwi mu, na  ɛwɔ  sɛ wohohoro nwi no mu mpɛn bebree ansa na ne nyinaa atumi afiri mu.   Mfiha  du-nwɔtwe ne du-nkron berɛ mu nku no  na ɛyɛ sradeɛ nko ara. Nnɛ berɛ yi mu deɛ, wɔde ngohwam  ne ɛwoɔ afrafra mu ayɛ no yie. Ɛsiane sɛ nku boa ma tiri nwii yɛ den nti ɛboa ma sɛ wopɛsɛ wosiesie ho a, ɛyɛ fɛ na wommerɛ koraa.

Beaeɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Dzigbordi Dosoo
text:
Dzigbordi Dosoo yɛ Ghanani baa a ɔyɛ nnwuma pii, kasafoɔ ne kɔnsɔtan a ɔwɔ beaɛ a ɔdi dwuma a wɔfrɛ no Dzigbordi a wɔda no adi wɔ aman aduanan nsia wɔ Abibirem,UK ne Europe. Ɔka wɔn a wɔsiesie nnipa honam wɔ abibirem a wɔfrɛ no Kanshi. Ɔno ne Allure Africa, adeɛ bi a wɔtɔn no abibirem ne beaɛ ahodoɔ pii kɔfabaeɛ.

N'abrabɔ ahyɛaseɛ ne nnwomasua 
Dosoo kɔɔ ne ntoasoɔ sukuu wɔ Accra Girls ntoasoɔ sukuu. Ɔnyaa ne bakyela degree wɔ Finance ne Accounting firii Virginia State Suapɔn mu, na ɔkɔɔ Harvard suapɔn. Ɔyɛ obi a w'aben wɔ mfonin nnwuma mu, Etiquette ne obi a ɔyɛ nimdefoɔ wɔ International protocols mu.

Nnwuma 
Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nnwɔtwe mu, mfeɛ du akyi wɔ ne Sikasɛm adwuma mu no, Dosoo buii spa adwuma wɔ Ghana￼. Ɔdiikan buii Allure Saloon, a ɛno akyire no ɛbɛyɛɛ Allure Africa. Na ɔda Business Linksges International, beaɛ a wɔdi sikasɛm wɔ hɔ a ɛdane bɛyɛɛ Eagle Group wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan ano. Ɔyɛ obi a ɔsiesie nnipa honam ma no yɛ kama a wɔfrɛ no Kanshi a wɔfrɛɛ no ma no bɛdii dwuma wɔ women's West Daily wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mu ansana ɔrekɔ United States market wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nan mu.

N'abrabɔ ankasa 
Na ɔyɛ Lionel Van Mate Dosoo,ɛnkane Bank of Ghana Aban abɛdiakyire yere. Ɔwɔ ba baako pɛ.

Abasobɔdeɛ 
 2009 Marketing Woman of the Year by the Chartered Institute of Marketing.
 2017 Inspiration Award – Heart of Beauty and Innovation, and Repêchage President’s Award, Repechage Annual Conference in New York.
 Nominated for 2019 Women's Choice Awards Africa, The Boss Lady of the year Category.

Beaɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Abena B. Brigidi
text:
Abena B. Brigidi (Mrs) yɛ Ghanani a ɔde sika hyɛ adwuma mu na ɔsane yɛ ɔkasafoɔ. Ɔyɛ obi a ɔnim sikasɛm adwuma yɛ yie paa bɛyɛ sɛ mfeɛ du wɔ dwumakuo a ɛhwɛ sika so. Abena a ware David Cobbina Brigidi a ɔyɛ Legal practitioner.

N'abrabɔ ahyɛaseɛ 
Brigidi kɔɔ Achimota sukuu ne Aburi Girls ntoasoɔ sukuu. Ɛnyaa bakyela degree firii University of Ghana wɔ Humanities mu ne MBA wɔ General Management firii University of East London. Ɔne Restoration Center of the Assemblies of God church Roman Ridge na ɛsom.

N'adwuma 
Brigidi gyae Halifax PLC, sikakorabea bi a ɛdi ne dwuma wɔ United Kingdom sɛ Scotland sikakorabea dwadifoɔ. Ɔkɔɔ Zenith sikakorabea a ɛwɔ Ghana sɛ fotufoɔ ma adetɔfoɔ ne ntotoeɛfoɔ ne obi a ɔda adetɔfoɔ ano wɔ nkorabata a ɛwɔ Ghana. Ɛfiri Zenith sikakorabea na ɔkɔɔ All-Time Capital, sikakorabea bi a wɔde sika hyɛm yɛ adwuma wɔ Nkran sɛ abɛdiakyire ma adetɔ ne adetɔn a ɔyɛ n'asɛdeɛ toto nnoɔma yie ma ne tu mpɔn. Wɔ mfeɛ mmienu akyire wɔ  All-Time Capital no ɔkɔɔ Kariela oil ne Gas a ɛwɔ Ghana wɔ ɔpɛpɔn bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du ne ɔsanaa bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nan ntam, ɛhɔ na ɔdii mfeɛ nan sɛ panin wɔ sikasɛm mu.

Na Brigidi yɛ tetenani ne ɔpanin wɔ Nimed Capital Limited, sikakorabea bi a agye din yie paa ara.

Beaɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ 

Ateasefoɔ

title: Ngoma Twene
text:
Ngoma (wo bɛtumi anɔ din sɛ  engoma anaang'oma anaa sɛ ingoma) yɛ adeɛ a yɛ de bɔ dwom a nkurɔfoɔ bi a ɔfrɛ wɔn  Bantu a wɔn wɔ Abibiman mu na  ɔde de dwuma sɛ adwa a wɔ de bɔ dwom.Yɛ nya  Ngoma firi Kongo kasa mu a ɛkyerɛ sɛ "Twene". Nipa ahodoɔ pii a wɔ te Bantu mantam no obiara wɔ nsusuie foforɔ fa saa twene yi ho na wɔn wɔ din ahoɔdoɔ a ɔde ma no. Wɔ Kikongo, "ngoma" wɔ de sa twene yi gyina hɔ ma asa,wɔ afofida ne nni ahodoɔ.

Sɛ nea wɔ de di dwuma wɔ Great Lakes Mansion ne South Africa 
Ngoma twene no ɔfiri no engoma wɔ Abibiman wɔ Great Lake Mansin no mu. Wɔ  Swahili, ngoma din no baeɛ ɛfiri sɛ na nipa ntumi mmɔ engoma na ɛyɛ wɔn den sɛ wɔ bɛka nti ɛma "e"no yira wɔ ne bɔ no mu.

Banyankorbulwɔn twene ade mu a ɔnfa nni agorɔ rdn; titire ne nea ɛfa wɔn ahene  nsem ho na nea ɔda ano ne y Bagyendanwana ɛne hɔ a ,ɔn ahenenie nso pi. p.

Bagandafoɔ a wɔ firii Ugandawɔ kwan sorɔnko a wɔ ne ngoma twene wɔ twaka na ebinom gyedi sɛ ɛhɔ mpo na twene no firi baeɛ.Baganda na ɔyɛ twene no mma. Ngoma no na ɔde di nkitahodeɛ ne wɔn afofida na ɛgyina hɔ ma tumi. Ngoma nso nɔa wɔ anasesɛm toɔ mu.

Sɛnea Ngoma Twene no tie 
Ngoma Twene no ɔde dua na ayɛ na ɔde nantwie Ngoma na adura ɛho  emom ɛbi wɔ hɔ yɛde zebra wedea na adura ho.Wɔ bɔ twene no wɔ akuokuo nson mu na ɛkuo biara ne senea ne dɛ tie ne dwuma ɛdi. Saa ntwene nson no nyinaa wɔ ne dwumadie  ne no din na ne nkyekyemu nan. Nea ɛso wɔ mu no ne bakisimba na ɛno na ɛgyigyi paa .Empuunya  no nso gyegyi na ɛdi nea ne gyegyi no si no akyire. Nankasa no yɛ ketewa na wɔ de dua na ɛbɔ na ɛno nso ano yɛ den.  Nea ɛta toɔ ne Engalabi twene no na ɛne Ngoma Twene no na ɛsɛ nso ngoma twene no wa na ɛyɛ kurukuruwaa den twene a aka no nyinaa na ɛwɔ nhoma wɔ ho nanso twene aka no wɔ nantwie nhoma wɔ ho.Na Engalabi no wɔ koterɛ Ngoma   na ɛno na ɛgyigyi kɛseɛ. 

Twene ahodoɔ a agyi din no bi wɔ abo bi mana mu no ne   Djembe, Dundun, Bata, and Bougarabou . Djembe kyerɛ sɛ"yɛn nyinaa ahyia wɔ asmomdwe mu" malifoɔ nkyerɛmu nono.

title: Ekuru Aduane
text:
Ekuru   yɛ aduane bi a Yorubafoɔ yɛ wɔ Nigeria.Wɔ de adua a yɛ aye ho na ɛyɛ.

Ɛtesɛ moin-moin na ne mmienu ye yɛ firi ɛdua mu .ɛnte sɛ nea   moi-moi ɔde Mali ne aduane akadeɛ bebere ka ho ansa na wa noa no  Ekuru dea wɔ kyekyere no wɔ ahanan mu anaa ɔde gu adwa mu ansa na wa kyi ho.

Wɔ de ɛno ne mako abɔmu .ɛbinom nso di ɛni aburo a yɛ anoa anaa sɛ Eba anaa nkuruma nkwan.

Wɔn a ɔdi aduane yi yɛ Nigeriafoɔ ab ɔyɛ atefi apuieɛ fa wɔn wɔ Osun brɔno.

Wɔ Ammamerɛ 
Ekuru yɛ aduane bi a Yorubafoɔ gyidie ne sɛ baeɛ a ɔnoa saa aduane no  ayanfoɔ ntumi ntu nkɔ baye gorɔ. 

Enam sɛ nea aduane no awo nti no wɔ de ye asem kase "ahia me sɛ ekuru" a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɔni ne ho hwee.

title: Akua Sarpong-Ayisa
text:

Abrabɔ Ahyɛaseɛ 
Wɔwoo Sarpong-Ayisa wɔ Mampong a ɛwɔ Asante mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana.Ɔne ne nuanom nsia ne n'awofoɔ nyinaa tenaa Nkran, ɛhɔ na ɔnyinii wɔ hɔnom.

Nnwomasua 
Berɛ a ɔkɔɔ ne mmɔtafowa sukuu wiee wɔ St  John's Preparatory sukuu wɔ nkran no, ɔtoaa so kɔɔ Oda ntoasoɔ sukuu. Ɛfirii hɔ no ɔkɔɔ Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology a Ɔsuaa Estate Management nanso ɛnam sɛ suapɔn no too sukuu nom mmerɛ tiawa bi nti amma no antumi anwie. Wɔtoo sukuu nom no, ɔkɔɔ wiemhyɛn adesua a ɛboa wɔn a wɔfiri wɔ Ghana Airways.

Beaɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Sarah Adwoa Safo
text:
Sarah Adwoa Safoa(wɔwoo no ɔpɛnimaa bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nnwɔtwe wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe baako mu) yɛ Ghana mmaranimfoɔ ne amanyɔni. Ɔyɛ ɔsono amanyɔkuo New Patriotic Party mmarahyɛbedwani ma Done Kwabena mpesoa a ɛwɔ Nkran pupuni mantam wɔ Ghana. Seisei ɔyɛ ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ mmaa ne mmarima, mmɔfra ne asetena mu bambɔ nsɛm so.

N'abrabɔ ahyɛaseɛ 
Ghana sɔfo a ɔwɔ nnwumakuo pii a wɔfrɛ no Apostle Kwadwo Safo na ɔwoo Adwoa Safoa wɔ ɔpɛnimaa bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nnwɔtwe wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe baako. Wɔkyerɛɛ no adeɛ wɔ fie na ɔtwerɛɛ na ɔdii nkunim wɔ ne GCE A'Level nsɔhwɛ mu wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nnwɔtwe. Wɔdii mfeɛ du nson no, ɔkɔɔ University of Ghana faculty of Law, ɛhɔ na ɔnyaa ne bakyela degree wɔ Law (L.L.B) wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne mmienu nom. Na Safo na ɔyɛ Law Student Union no ɔmanpanin abɛdiakyire berɛ a na ɔrebɛwie sukuu no. Ɛtoaso kɔɔ Ghana school of Law na ɔdii mfeɛ aduonu mmienu no wɔfrɛ no wɔ ahinime bosome nom wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan nom. Ɔnyaa ne LLM firii George Washington University.

Ne nnwuma 
Ɔne Aban Lɔya na ɛyɛɛ adwuma wɔ Columbus mansini mu, Washington DC a ɛwɔ United States ɛno akyire no na ɔbaa Ghana bɛsomm ne man. Ɔbaa wɔ berɛ a mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne num rekɔ awieɛ no, ɔde ne ho kɔ dɔmm Law firm Kulendu @ Law, ɛna Zoe,Akyea ne nea ɛkeka ho sɛ mmaranimfoɔ ɛna ɔsomm sɛ agyinatuni a ɔdi asɛm ma mmara kuo wɔ Ghana sɛ asɛmdifoɔ.

Ɔyɛɛ adwuma mfeɛ mmienu sɛ mmaranimfoɔ wɔ Public Procurement Authority(PPA) ɛna na ɔboa wɔ kwan a wɔfa so de nnoɔma toto akwan mu ma PPA ne ɛdin a wɔsesa firii Public Procurement Board dekɔɔ Public Procurement Authority.

Safo na wɔdii kan yii no sɛ mmarahyɛbedwani ma Dome Kwabenya wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu mu. Ɛna wɔtoo no so aba bio yii no wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia ne aduonu nom. Na ɔyɛ dɔmkɛseɛ a ɛwɔ mmarahyɛbedwam wɔ kwasafoman a ɛtɔ so nso wɔ Ghana abɛdiakyire ɛne ɔbaa a ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbedwani wɔ Ghana a ɛbɛtɔɔ so mmienu.

Wɔyii no sɛ ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Government Procurement so wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nson a ɔsom kɔpem mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu baako, wɔ Nana Addo Dankwa Akuffo Addo, a ɔyɛ ɔmanpanin a ɛtɔ so num wɔ Ghana.

Wɔ mmarahyɛbedwa a ɛtɔ so nnwɔtwe wɔ kwasafoman a ɛtɔ so nan nom no, ɔmanpanin Nana Addo Dankwa Akuffo Addo yii no sɛ ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ mmaa ne mmarima, mmɔfra ne bambɔ nsɛm so a na ɔyɛ Procurement soafoɔ ma mmarahyɛbedwa a ɛtɔ so nson wɔ Ghana.

N'abrabɔ ankasa 
Ɔwaree wɔ ɔsanaa bosome da a ɛtɔ so du nson wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nkron nom.

Abasobɔdeɛ ne nkaeɛ 
Wɔyii Adwoa wɔ Nobles Forum abasobɔdeɛ wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu mu. Glitz Africa hyɛɛ no animuonyam yii no fraa afe no mu nyinaa mmaa du ￼a wɔkɔ wɔn anim.

title: Mpoto Mpoto
text:
Mpoto Mpoto () yɛ Ghana aduane bi a wɔde bayerɛ anaa mankani na ɛyɛ. Nigeria foɔ frɛ no Asaro wɔ Yoruba kasa mu.

Kwan a yɛfa so yɛ 
Nnoɔma a yɛde yɛ

 Mankani anaa bayerɛ 
 Gyeene
 Tomatoes mmienu 
 Amane

 Nsuo

Kwan a yɛfa so yɛ 
Deɛ adi kan, wobɛ senesene mankani anaa bayerɛ no na watwitwam nketenkete na wahohoro ho.

Deɛ ɛtɔ so mmienu, wode mankani anaa bayerɛ no a watwitwa no ne gyeene ne mako ne ntoosi bɛgu dadesɛn mu na wode nsuo a ɛdɔɔ so ara yie ɛgu ho na wakata so de esi gya so anoa. 

Deɛ adi hɔ, wode wo amane no a wahohoro ho no bɛka nea esi gya so no ho. Wowie a na wayiyi gyeene, mako ne ntoosi no ayam. Woyam wie a na wode aka mankani anaa bayerɛ no a esi gya so no ho. Wode gum a na wode atser no etwi mankani anaa bayerɛ no kakra wɔ dadesen no mu na wode ngo ne nkyene nso aka ho. Wowie a na wama egya no ayɛ ketewa bi nti sɛ wohwɛ na makani no ayɛ mmrɛ a na ɛkyerɛ sɛ wo awie wo mpoto mpoto no yɛ.

title: Wa Naa's Palace
text:
Wa Naa's Palace  ɛyɛ beaɛ a Ɔhene a wɔ Wa te ɛhɔ na Walafoɔ bebree te wɔ upper west Mansin mu wɔ Ghana. Ahemfie no wɔ kuro no mfimfim na ɛhɔ na abusua no nyinaa wɔ na mpanimfoɔ a ɛwɔ ahenie no nso wɔ. Ɛhɔ na ammamerɛ ,amamyɔsem ,Gyidie ne nsɛm a ɛhia a ɛfa ɔman no ho kɔ so.Ɛwɔ ahemfie hɔ no ɔhene no tena gyata nhoma  so anaa sɛ adow anaa nnantwei anaa a Odwan.

Sɛ nea Ahenfie no tie 
Ɔde anetie na ayɛ saa Ahenfie no. Sɛ nea ɔdi dan no yɛ Moorish ne Sahel Sudan foɔ kwan aɔfa so ɛhɔ na yɛnim sɛ nea ɔdi dan nya adwene firiɛ de sii dan no. Saa ɛdan yi sɛ so nnɔso wɔ upper west nti  saa dan yi akyere wɔ kuro no mu nso ɛda so sii hɔ ɛnam ni fɛ nti.

Abakɔsem 
Abakɔsem kyerɛ sɛ Wafoɔ no firii Sudan a ɛwɔ anafoɔ fa a ɛwɔ Abibiman mu. Na ɔyɛ aguanhwɛfoɔ na nea ɔbɛkɔ biara na nwan de wɔɔn akyi . Na ɔduru nea ɔti sisiɛ no na ɔyɛ wɔn si hene na ɛno na ɛnamso ma saa ɛdin WA NAA  baeɛ na ɛkyerɛ sɛ Nea ɔdi yɛn anim kan. Ye Gini sɛ ɔde anetie a awoɔ a yɛ abɔbɔ na ɛsi dan no  na ɔde ndua a ɛte sɛ atwerɛ Yna ɛboa sɔ dan no soro no mu. Ɔsi dan no sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a aatamfo ntumi ɛmɛ twe nfan wɔn so.Ɛhɔ nso na na ɔsie wɔn ahemfo dodoɔ naa wɔ ahemfie no anim.

Wɔn a ɔboa ma wɔ siiiɛ 
Ɛwɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nkron mu no  ɛkuo a ɔfrɛ no World Monuments Fund  ne Ghana  Museums ne Monuments Board dwene sɛnea ɔsɛ dan nɔa ɛbɛkyɛ a ɛnsie da ɛfiri sɛ na ɛyɛ fɛ na ɛyɛ tete dan awɔn nsi bio   na ɛwɔ sɛ ɔhwɛ no yie na ɔwie da no wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du mmienu mu.

title: Bob-Ngo Afahye
text:
Bob-ngo   yɛ afahyɛ bi a nhemfo ne ɔmanfoɔ a ɔwɔ Jirapa brɔno so di wɔ Upper West mansin a Ɛwɔ Ghana. Ɔde no wɔ Oforisuo bosome no mu.

Sɛnea ɔdi afahyɛ no 
Sɛ ɛduru afahyɛ berɛ no si ɔma kwan ma ahɔhoɔ bɛkyɛ nnuane ne nea dɔkɔ dɔkɔ. Nkurɔfoɔ no hyɛ wɔn ammamerɛ ntadeɛ ne Nhemfo nkaeɛ no nyinaa bɔ dwa. Wɔ tɔ dwom di asa.

Mfasoɔ a ɛwɔ afahyɛ no so 
Ɔdi afahyɛ di kae nsɛm bi atwa mu. Ɔdi afahyɛ de yi musuo biara a Dawadawa  aduaba a na ɛyɛ aduane a nkoa  diafahyɛ yi de kyerɛ sɛ ɛyɛ akyiwadeɛ sɛ wo bɛ dua dawadawa.

text:
Nakore Mosque ɛyɛ nkramosom dan a wɔ asi no tesɛ nea Sudanesefoɔ a ɔhyɛhyɛ dan si wɔn dan ɛwɔ Nakore, southwest a ɛwɔ Wa a ɛwɔ Upper West Mansin a ɛwɔ Ghana. Ɛyɛ Nkramo dan ketewa bi.

Abakɔsem

title: Gyakie
text:
Jackline Acheampong (a wɔwoo no wɔ ɔpɛnimaa bosome da a ɛtɔ so du nsia wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nnwɔtwe) a wɔ n'adwuma mu wɔfrɛ Gyakie yɛ Ghana afrobeat nwontoni. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nkron mu no Gyakie de nwom a wato no din "Love is Pretty" baa abɔnten a ɛbui kwan maa ne nwom foforɔ "Never Like This". Wɔ Ɔsanaa bosome mu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu mu no, "forever" a na ɛka ne nnwom num a wato no din "seed" bɛgyee din wɔ Ghana, Kenya ne Nigeria. Gyakie papa din de Nana Acheampong.

Wɔtetee Gyakie wɔ kumase a ɛwɔ Asante mantam wɔ Ghana. Ɔwiee T.I Ahmadiyya ntoasoɔ sukuu, kumase ɛna ɔkɔɔ Kwame Nkrumah suapɔn kɔyɛɛ International Business.

title: Pilolo
text:
Pilolo () yɛ agorɔ bi a Ghana mmɔfra de no abɔnten. Agorɔ no din nkyerɛase ne sɛ " berɛ aduru sɛ wobehwehwɛ biribi". Ɛyɛ agorɔ bi a mmɔfra mmienu anaa deɛ ɛboro saa na adi, nnipa dodoɔ a adi agorɔ no na wɔhwɛ ho pɛ ho nnua a wɔde besie ama wakɔ hwehwɛ. Agorɔ no yɛ ahomeka yie sɛ mmɔfra no dodoɔ yɛ beberee a.

Mmɔfra a wɔde anigyeɛ de mmirika rekɔ berɛ a wahunu abaa no a wɔde sieeɛ no

Obia a onni agorɔ no bi de mmaa no sie berɛ a wɔn a wɔredi agorɔ no akata wɔn ani. Nea onni agorɔ no bi ni teamu sɛ "pi-lo-lo" ɛba no saa na afei obiara ahyɛase rehwehwɛ abaa no bi. Sɛ wohunu abaa no bi a, wode bɛkɔ beaeɛ ɛkyerɛ sɛ woawie no.

Agorɔ no su

 Mmɔfra baanu anaa deɛ ɛboro saa na edi.
 Ɛyɛ mmaa ne mmɛrima agorɔ 
 Beaeɛ biara a wɔde agorɔ wɔ ha ɛyɛ no, wɔtumi de wɔ hɔ.
 Deɛ wɔde di agorɔ yi yɛ abaa yɛbubu mu nketenkete. 
 Ɛyɛ agorɔ a abɔntene nko ara na wɔde no.

Agorɔ no ho mfonini 

Wɔrehwehwɛ mmaa no a wɔde asie no

 nea ɔretwerɛ twerɛ deɛ obiara anya

title: Gloria Akuffo
text:
Gloria Akuffo (wɔwoo no ɔpɛnimaa bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduasa baako wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduonum nan) yɛ Ghana mmaranimfoɔ ne amanyɔni a ɔsom sɛ Ghana Aban Lɔya ne ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ atɛntenenee so, ɛfiri mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nson mu. Ɔyɛ ɛnkane Aban Lɔya abɛdiakyire ne Wiemhyɛn soafoɔ.

Abrabɔ ahyɛaseɛ no nnwomasua 
Ɔfiri Akropong -Akuapem a ɛwɔ apueɛ mantam ne Shai Osudoku a ɛwɔ Nkran pupuni mantam. Gloria Akuffo wiee University of Ghana wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduoson nkron(1979) wɔ B.A (Hons) Law ne Political Science mu. Ɔbɛyɛɛ mmaranimfoɔ ne Kɔɔto baatan a ɛwɔ Ghana hwehwɛfoɔ a ɔdi dwuma wɔ Ghana Bar Association wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe mmienu mu.

Nnwuma 
Na ɔka Private Legal firm, Owusu-Yeboa, Akuffo and Associates a ɛwɔ Nkran ho. Ɔno na ɔda Litigation at Blay and Associates ano.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ɔyɛ Ɔsono amanyɔkuo New Patriotic Party kuoba. Na ɔyɛ ɔsoafoɔ abɛdiakyire a ɔhwɛ atɛntenenee ne Aban Lɔya abɛdiakyire firi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne baako dekɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne num mu, a na ɔyɛ ɔbaa a ɔdikan a ɔdii saa diberɛ no. Ɛfiri mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne num mu dekɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nsia mu no na Akuffo yɛ ɔsoafoɔ abɛdiakyire ma Nkran pupuni mantam. Akuffo somm sɛ wiemhyɛn ɔsoafoɔ a ɔdikan firi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nsia kɔpem mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe mu. Wɔyii ko sɛ ntamgyinafoɔ ma Ireland wɔ Kitawonsa bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe mu.

Mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu abatoɔ adesrɛ

title: Kate Quartey-Papafio
text:
Kate Quartey-Papafio ka wɔn a wɔde cabling Company Reroy cables a ɛwɔ Ghana kɔfabaeɛ no ho. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu baako mu no, wɔde Kate kaa mmaa asikafoɔ num a wɔn wɔ Ghana a wɔn sika bɛyɛ sɛ ɔpepem $250.

Nnwuma ne Animuonyamhyɛ 
Kate ne ne kunu na ɛhyɛɛ Reroy cables wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron mmienu mu, berɛ a wantumi anya adansedie papa ansi wɔ fie.Ɔno ne ɔbaa ɔdikan a ɔyɛ CEO ma cables manufacturing firm wɔ ECOWAS. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nan mu no, Chartered Institute of Marketing Ghana (CIMG) bɔɔ n'abaso sɛ ɔbaa ɔboa wɔ dwadie mu afe no mu nyinaa. Wɔ afe no ara mu wɔ Osagyefo Kwame Nkrumah African Genius mmaa  abasobɔdeɛ mu no, ɔnyaa nnwumakuo pii akyɛdeɛ. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia mu no, Europe Business Assembly bɔɔ no abaso.

Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nson mu no, Kate, William Ato Essien, CEO ma capital Bank ne nnipa mmienu bi na wɔbuu wɔn sɛ wɔwia sika de bi yɛ basabasa a ɛmaa sikakorabea no guiiɛ. Wɔ Kitawansa bosome da a ɛtɔ so nnwɔtwe wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu baako mu no, kɔɔto kɛseɛ a ɛwɔ Ghana gyae no maa no faa ne ho diiɛ.

title: Nana Oye Lithur
text:
Nana Oye Lithur Ghana mmaranimfoɔ ne amanyɔni. Na ɔyɛ asoafoɔ a na ɔhwɛ mmaa ne mmarima, mmɔfra ne asetena bambɔ nsɛm so wɔ Ghana firi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmiɛnsa kɔpemm mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nson, Ɔmanpanin John Mahama yii berɛ a wɔtoo aba wieɛ no. Ɔyɛ kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress ekuoba.

Ne ho asɛm 
Ɔkɔɔ sukuu wɔ Ridge Church School ne Wesley Girls' ntoasoɔ sukuu. Ɔnyaa ne bakyela degree wɔ Law mu firii University of Ghana,Legon ɛna ne masters wɔ Law, Human Rights and Democratization in Africa firii University of Pretoria, South Africa.

Wadi Executive Director of the Human Rights Advocacy Centre diberɛ da saa ara nso Regional coordinator(Africa Office) ma commonweath Human Rights Initiative ka ho. Wasom sɛ steering committed ama International consortium wɔ nyinsɛn yiguo ne ofutufoɔ ma International consortium wɔ asɛdeɛ a ɛwɔ sɛ yɛyɛ wɔ yɛn honam akwaa no ho.

Abasobɔdeɛ ne Animuonyamhyɛ

 Champion of Women's Rights Award (2012).

title: Francisca Ashietey Odunton
text:
Francisca Ashietey Odunton yɛ Ghana nsɛntwerɛni,ne diplomat. Na ɔyɛ ɛnkane ɔtenetenefoɔ ma Ghana Broadcasting Corporation na seisei ɔyɛ Ghana high commissioner ma Kenya.

Francisca Ashietey Odunton kɔɔ sukuu wɔ Aburi Girl's ntoasoɔ sukuu. Ɔkɔɔ Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology a ɔnyaa ne degree wɔ bakyela of Arts wɔ social Science a ɔyɛɛ English.

Ashietey Odunton yɛ mmaranimfoɔ a ɔwɔ suahunu wɔm bɛyɛ mfeɛ du nsia, a wɔfrɛ no wɔ Ghana berɛ a ɔnyaa ne LLB firii Ghana school of Law wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nson. Ɔnyaa ne masters degree firii London School of Economics. Ɔwiee ne suapɔn wɔ United National suapɔn wɔ Tokyo,Japan.￼

Ntamgyinafoɔ 
Wɔ Ɔsanaa bosome da a ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nson a na ɛyɛ wukuada, Ghana manpanin Nana Addo Dankwa Akuffo Addo bɔɔ Francisca Ashietey Odunton sɛ ɔno na ɔyɛ Ghana High commissioner ma Kenya. Ɔka Ghanafoɔ nan a wɔbɔɔ wɔn din sɛ wɔmmɛdi Ghana asoeɛ ahodoɔ pii wɔ wiase.￼

N'abrabɔ 
Ashietey Oduntonaware Olu Christopher Odunton ɛna ɔwɔ mma mmienu -Akushika ne Duku.
