Amanyɔkuo ahodoɔ a ɛwɔ Ghana

title: Kabi-Ma-Menkabi
text:
Kab-Ma- MenkAbi  (ɛwɔ Greek kasa mu δημοκρατία (dēmokratía) dēmos 'people' and kratos 'rule') yɛ amammuo bi a ɔmanfoɔ no wɔ tumi ka nsɛm a ɛfa wɔn ho bi na wɔtumi nso kyerɛ deɛ wɔpɛ, anaa sɛ wɔtumi ti nnipa a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔdi wɔn soɔ . Deɛ wɔtumi ka sɛ ɔka 'nnipa ho' ne sɛdeɛ wɔkyɛ tumi asesa wɔ mmerɛ yi mu ɛna asesa wɔ aman foforɔ so, mmerɛ rent nanim yi Kabul-Ma-Menkabi aman mu nnipa dodoɔ no ara na abɛka ho. Deɛ ɛkura Kabi ma menkabi amammuo pa ara me sɛ wotumi te kuo biara na wode wo ho dɔm kuo biara wopɛ, wotumi pɛ agyapadeɛ,  wotumi dɔm som biara wopɛ ne wotumi kyerɛ wadwene,  wɔbu Nnipa nyinaa pɛ, wotumi kɔka ɔman bi ho, wotumi te amammuo bi ase, wotumi to aba na afei wotumi sesa amammuo bi a worempɛ  anaa ɛtiatia nnipa fawohodie so te sɛ ɔbɛgye obi nkwa afiri ne nsa.

Kabi ma menkabi asesa ne ho pii wɔ mmerɛ a atwam yi. Ahyɛaseɛ no na kabi ma menkabi bi yɛ deɛ wani sɛ mu. Ɛnnɛ yi kabi ma menkabi a yɛtaa hunu pa ara ne sɛ obi regyina amanfoɔ no anan mu, berɛ ɔmanfoɔ no bɛto aba ayi nnipa bi sɛ wɔnnyina wɔ anan mu wɔ mmrahyɛbadwafie anaa Ɔmanpanin Bea

Agyinasie fa kɛseɛ wɔ kabi ma menkabi amammuo mu no gyinaa nnipa dodoɔ nnyetomu so,ɛna nnipa dodoɔ mmorosoɔ anaa nteaseɛ nso ka agyinasie ho wɔ kabi ma menkabi amammuo mu. Yei kyerɛ hia ɛhia sɛ wɔbɛgye obiara adwenekyerɛ ne nnyetom mu wɔ nsɛm a Ɛho hia pa ara -  Nnipa dodoɔ nnyetom- Ɛno nti wɔtaa si gyinaeɛ wɔ amammara kwan so. Ɛwɔ kabi ma menkabi a ɛmu nyɛden a dodoɔ nnyetom tumi no taa yɛ adwuma wɔ kabi ma menkabi a ɔbi na ɔgyina ɔmanfoɔ no anan mu Nanso Amammara no de akwansideɛ to Dɔm kɛseɛ ne Dɔm kumaa kyengyeɛ ho. Ɛtaa yɛ ankoreankore fawohodie te sɛ fawohodie wɔ kasa mu anaa fawohodie wɔ ɛkuo teɛ ho.

Asɛmfua Kabi Ma Menkabi firii aseɛ wɔ Afeha a ɛtɔ so num A.Y.B mu a na ɛkyerɛ amammuo a wɔ 'Greek'  nkuro mu te sɛ 'Classical Athens'  a ɛna ɛkyerɛ sɛ 'Amanfoɔ Amammuo  a na ɛne wɔn a wɔwɔ sika ne agyapadeɛ amammuo no bɔ Abira. '(ἀριστοκρατία, aristokratía)' Kyerɛ 'Animdefoɔ  Amammuo'. Aborɔfo Kabi. Ma,Menka bi yɛ soronko firi kabi ma menka a adikan nyinaa ho. Yɛtaa ka sɛ ɛfirii ase wɔ nkuro akɛseɛ mu te sɛ 'Classical Athens ne Roman Republic' a fawohodie ahodoɔ de ma  mmarima  a wɔwɔ hɔ ansa na saa nhyehyɛeɛ no retwam rema  anibue rehyɛ aseɛ. Sɛ yɛhwɛ a Kabi Ma Menkabi amammuo a ɛhyɛɛ aseɛ wɔ teteberɛ mu nyinaa ne nnɛ yi deɛ nyinaa abakwasɛm mu no, na kabi Ma menkabi amammuo foɔ no yɛ Animdefoɔ nko ara ansa na wɔmaa kwan maa ɔman mu no nyinaa de wɔn ho hyɛɛ mu wɔ berɛ a wɔmaa ɔmanfoɔ no nyinaa kwan sɛ wɔnkɔ to aba wɔ Afeha a ɛtɔ so du- nkron ne aduonu mu.

Kabi Ma Menkabi amammuo ne amammuo afoforɔ bɔ abira te sɛ amammuo Nipa baako pɛ kura tumi te sɛ Kaa Nkabi amammuo anaa deɛ tumi kura nnipa ketewa bi. 

Karl Popper kyerɛɛ Kabi Ma Menkabi mu ne nsonsoneɛ  ɛda Kaa Nkabi mu berɛ ɔde gyinaa akwannya a amanfoɔ no wɔ de yi wɔ akandifoɔ ne sɛ wɔbɛ sesa wɔ a ɛnhia aban tuguo biara no. Ɛwiase adwenekyerɛ kɔ ma Kabi Ma Menkabi amammuo no yɛ kɛseɛ pa ara na ɛgye no tom

Beaɛ Menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Abusuani
text:
Abusua (a efi Latin: Familia) yɛ nnipa kuw bi a ɛfa adwene a ɛfa adwene ho (ɛnam awo a wogye tom so) anaasɛ Affinity (ɛnam aware anaa abusuabɔ foforo so). Abusua no atirimpɔw ne sɛ ɛbɛma emufo ne ɔmanfo yiyedi akɔ so. Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ yiye no, mmusua de nkɔmhyɛ, nhyehyɛe, ne ahobammɔ ma bere a asɔremma no nyin na wosua sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ ɔmanfo mu no.[1] Abakɔsɛm mu no, nnipa aman dodow no ara de abusua di dwuma sɛ beae titiriw a wɔde wɔn ho bata ho, wɔhwɛ wɔn, na wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ asetra mu .

Nnnipa ho animdefo kyekyɛ abusua ahyehyɛde dodow no ara mu sɛ matrifocal (ɛna ne ne mma), patrifocal (agya ne ne mma), conjugal (ɔyere, ne kunu, ne mma, a wɔsan frɛ no nuklea abusua), avuncular (ɔbarima, ne nuabea, . ne ne mma), anaasɛ wɔatrɛw mu (wɔ awofo ne mmofra akyi no, ebetumi ayɛ nananom, maame nuabeanom, ne papa nua mma, anaa wɔn nuabeanom).

Abusua anato ho adesua no botae ne sɛ ɛbɛhwehwɛ abusua abusua ahorow mu denam abakɔsɛm so. Abusua nso yɛ sikasɛm mu ade titiriw a wosua ho ade wɔ abusua sikasɛm mu. Wobetumi de asɛmfua "mmusua" adi dwuma wɔ kasakoa kwan so de ayɛ akuw a ɛka nnipa nyinaa ho kɛse te sɛ mpɔtam, ɔman, ne wiase nyinaa akuraa.

Asetenam 
Aabusua no dwumadi atitiriw no mu biako ne sɛ ɛbɛma wɔanya nhyehyɛe bi a ɛbɛma wɔatumi ayɛ nnipa na wɔawo wɔn wɔ abɔde mu ne asetra mu. Eyi betumi aba denam honam fam nneɛma (te sɛ aduan) a wɔbɛkyɛ so; ɔhwɛ ne ntetee a wɔde ma ne nea wogye (abusuabɔ a wɔtete no); hokwan ne asɛyɛde ahorow a ɛwɔ mmara mu; ne abrabɔ pa ne nkate mu abusuabɔ.[5][6] Enti, osuahu a obi nya wɔ n’abusua ho no sesa bere a bere kɔ so no. Sɛ yɛhwɛ mmofra adwene a, abusua no yɛ "abusua a ɛkyerɛ kwan": abusua no som sɛ ɛbɛhwehwɛ mmofra wɔ asetra mu na edi dwuma titiriw wɔ wɔn amammerɛ ne wɔn asetra mu. Sɛ yɛhwɛ ɔwofo (ɔwofo) no a, abusua no yɛ "abusua a wɔwo wɔn", a ne botae ne sɛ ɛbɛwo mmofra, ayɛ wɔn amammerɛ na wɔne wɔn abɔ fekuw.[8] Nanso, ɛnyɛ mma a wɔbɛwo nkutoo ne abusua no adwuma; wɔ aman a nna mu kyɛfa wɔ adwuma mu, aware, ne abusuabɔ a efi mu ba a ɛda nnipa baanu ntam no, ɛho hia sɛ wɔhyehyɛ ofie a sikasɛm mu mfaso wɔ so.[9][10][11]

C. C. Harris ka sɛ atɔe fam adwene a ɛfa abusua ho no yɛ nea emu nna hɔ na ɛne ofie no yɛ basaa, sɛnea ɛda adi wɔ nsɛm ahorow a wɔde asɛmfua no di dwuma wom no mu no.[12] Olivia Harris ka sɛ saa adwene a ɛyɛ basaa yi nyɛ akwanhyia, na mmom ɛkyerɛ abusua adwene a ɛwɔ kapitalist, atɔe fam aman a wɔhyɛ asetra mu mmara a ɛka sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ nuklea abusua mufo bom tra, na ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔnyɛ abusuafo saa no bom tra; ɛmfa ho adwene ne mmara mu nhyɛso ahorow no, mmusua ɔha biara mu nkyem kɛse nhyia nuklea abusua su a eye no.[13]

Kɛseɛ 
mmea awo dodow nyinaa gu ahorow wɔ ɔman biara mu, efi mmofra 6.76 a wɔwoo wɔn/ɔbea wɔ Niger kosi 0.81 a ɛba fam wɔ Singapore (ɛde besi afe 2015).[14] Awo dodow no ara sua wɔ Europa Apuei Fam ne Europa Kesee Fam aman dodow no ara mu, na ɛkɔ soro wɔ Afrika aman dodow no ara a ɛwɔ Sahara anafo fam no mu.[14]

Wɔ amammerɛ ahorow bi mu no, abusua kɛse a ɛna no pɛ no nya mmofra no de so nkɛntɛnso kosi mpanyin afe so.[15] Ɔwofo mma dodow ne mma dodow a awiei koraa no wɔn mma bɛwo no wɔ abusuabɔ kɛse.[16] ]

Korɔ 
Ɛwom sɛ atɔe famfo amammerɛ mu nnipa ho animdefo ne asetra ho animdefo a wodii kan buu abusua ne abusuafo sɛ abusuabɔ a ɛnam "mogya" so (a egyina nsusuwii ahorow a abu so wɔ wɔn ankasa amammerɛ mu so) wɔ abusuabɔ wɔ amansan nyinaa mu de, nanso nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛe akyiri yi[5] ada no adi sɛ aman pii te abusua ase mmom denam adwene a ɛne sɛ wɔbɛtra abom so, aduan a wɔkyɛ (e.g. nufusu abusuafo) ne ɔhwɛ ne ntetee a wɔkyɛ. Asetra ho animdefo wɔ anigye titiriw wɔ abusua ahorow no dwumadi ne ne gyinabea wɔ aman a wɔakyekyɛ mu (titiriw kapitalist) mu.[17]

Sɛnea nhomanimfo Max Weber, Alan Macfarlane, Steven Ozment, Jack Goody ne Peter Laslett adwuma kyerɛ no, nsakrae kɛse a ɛde nnɛyi aware baa Atɔe Fam demokrase aman mu no “nyamesom-amammerɛ gyinapɛn nhyehyɛe a Yudasom mu nneɛma bi, tete Kristosom, de mae no na ɛmaa ɛyɛɛ den.” , Roma Katolekfo mmara ne Protestantfo Ɔsesɛw".[18]

Asetena mu nsɛm, abakɔsɛm ne nnipa ho nhwehwɛmu pii de ne ho ma sɛ wɔbɛte saa nsakrae yi ase, ne nsakrae a ɛba abusua no mu a ɛba bere kɔ so no. Levitan ka sɛ:

Mmere asesa; ɛyɛ nea wogye tom kɛse na ɛhyɛ nkuran sɛ ɛnanom yɛ adwuma na agyanom nso de bere pii ne mmofra no bɛtra fie. Ɔkwan a wɔfa so kari pɛ wɔ dwumadi ahorow mu wɔ awofo no ntam no bɛboa mmofra ma wɔanyin na wɔasua asetra mu asuade ahorow a ɛsom bo. Nkitahodi ne pɛyɛ ho hia kɛse wɔ mmusua mu, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛkwati dwumadi mu nhyɛso.[19]

Abusua a awo ntoatoaso pii wom

Abakɔsɛm mu no, abusua su a na abu so sen biara ne nea nananom, awofo, ne mmofra bom tra mu sɛ kuw biako. Sɛ nhwɛso no, ofie no betumi ayɛ afuw bi wuranom, wɔn mma a wɔanyinyin no mu biako (anaa nea ɛboro saa), abofra a wanyin no hokafo, ne abofra a wanyin no ankasa mma (wuranom no mmanana). Wɔmfa abusua kɛse no mufo nka abusua kuw yi ho. Ɛtɔ da bi a, wɔde awo ntoatoaso mmusua a "wɔahuruw" te sɛ nananom a wɔne wɔn mmanana te ka ho.[20]

Wɔ U.S. no, nhyehyɛe yi so tew wɔ Wiase Ko II akyi, na ɛkɔɔ baabi a ɛba fam wɔ 1980 mu, bere a na nnipa baawɔtwe biara mu biako te abusua a awo ntoatoaso pii wom mu wɔ U.S. no.[20] Nnipa dodow no akɔ soro fi saa bere no, nnipa baanum biara mu biako wɔ U.S. te abusua a awo ntoatoaso pii wom mu de besi afe 2016.[21] Nnipa dodow mu nsakrae ne sikasɛm mu nsakrae a ɛbata Boomerang Awo Ntoatoaso no ho no fa bi na ɛma nkurɔfo ani gye ho kɛse.[20]

Awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ ahodoɔ afie ntaa mma wɔ Canada, baabi a na nnipa bɛyɛ 6% a wɔte Canada no te awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ ahodoɔ mmusua mu kɔsi afe 2016, nanso na awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ ahodoɔ afie dodoɔ no rekɔ soro ntɛmntɛm, a ɛnam Aboriginefoɔ mmusua dodoɔ a ɛrekɔ soro, atubrafoɔ mmusua, ne adan a ɛdɔɔso nti ɛka a wɔbɔ wɔ mmeae bi.[22]

Aware (nuklea) abusua

Wɔtaa de asɛmfua "nuklea abusua" di dwuma de kyerɛ aware mmusua. Abusua "aware" mu no, ahokafo ne mmofra a wɔnwaree a wonnyaa mfe nkutoo na ɛka ho.[23][failed verification] Asetra ho animdefo binom[a?] kyerɛ nsonsonoe a ɛda awarefo mmusua ntam (a ɛde ne ho kakra fi awofo no abusuafo ne mmusua afoforo nyinaa mu ) ne nuklea mmusua (a wɔne wɔn abusuafo kura abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den kakra).[24][25]

Abusua nhyehyɛe afoforo – a (sɛ nhwɛso no) awofo a wɔadi afra, awofo a wonni ahokafo, ne ofie ayɔnkofa – afi ase rekasa atia nuklea abusua no su a ɛyɛ daa no.[26][27][28]

Ɔwofo biako abusua

Abusua a ɔwofo biako na wɔwom no yɛ ɔwofo biako ne wɔn mma, baabi a ɔwofo no yɛ okunafo, wagyae aware (na ɔnsan nware bio), anaasɛ ɔwaree da. Ebia ɔwofo no nkutoo na ɔwɔ mmofra no sohwɛ, anaasɛ awofo a wɔatetew mu no betumi ayɛ awofo a wɔkyɛ ho nhyehyɛe a mmofra no kyekyɛ wɔn bere mu (ebia ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ) wɔ ɔwofo biako mmusua ahorow abien ntam anaasɛ ɔwofo biako abusua biako ne abusua biako a wɔadi afra ntam. Sɛ wɔde toto mmofra a wɔhwɛ wɔn nkutoo ho a, mmofra honam fam, adwene ne asetra mu yiyedi betumi atu mpɔn denam awofo a wɔkyɛ wɔn ho nhyehyɛe ne mmofra a wobenya awofo baanu no nyinaa ho kwan kɛse so.[29][30] Ɔwofo biako mmusua dodow akɔ soro[bere bɛn?], na mmofra a wɔwɔ United States nyinaa mu bɛyɛ fa bɛtra ɔwofo biako abusua mu wɔ bere bi ansa na wɔadi mfe 18.[31] Mmusua dodow no ara a ɔwofo biako na wɔwom no ɛna na odi wɔn anim, nanso mmusua a ɔwofo biako na wɔwom a agyanom na wodi wɔn anim no dodow rekɔ soro.[32][33][34]

Matrifocal abusua no

Asɛm titiriw: Matrifocal abusua

"Matrifocal" abusua no yɛ ɛna ne ne mma.[35] Mpɛn pii no, saa mmofra yi ne n’asefo a wɔwoo wɔn, ɛwom sɛ ɛkame ayɛ sɛ mmofra a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma no kɔ so wɔ ɔman biara mu de. Saa abusua yi taa ba wɔ baabi a mmea wɔ nneɛma a wɔn ankasa betumi atete wɔn mma, anaasɛ mmarima tumi fa baabiara sen mmea. Sɛ nkyerɛase no, "abusua anaa ofie kuw bi yɛ matrifocal bere a ɛfa ɔbea ne ne mma ho no. Wɔ eyi mu no, saa mmofra yi agya (wɔn) wɔ kuw no asetra mu bere ne bere mu na wogye dibea a ɛto so abien." Mmofra no maame nyɛ mmofra no agyanom no mu biako yere ankasa."[36] Wɔde edin no, matrifocal, too gua wɔ Guiana nanso wɔkyerɛ ase wɔ ɔkwan soronko so wɔ aman afoforo so. Wɔ Nayar mmusua fam no, abusua no wɔ ɔbarima no sɛ "mfinimfini" anaa abusua no ti, anaasɛ ɛyɛ mpena/agya/onua, sen sɛ ɛbɛyɛ ɛna.[35]

Abusua a wɔatrɛw mu

asɛmfua "abusua a wɔatrɛw mu" nso abu so, titiriw wɔ United States. Saa asɛmfua yi wɔ ntease ahorow abien a ɛsono emu biara:

Ɛyɛ adwuma sɛ asɛmfua a ɛne "consanguinal abusua" (consanguine kyerɛ "mogya koro no ara mu").

Wɔ aman a awarefo abusua di so mu no, ɛkyerɛ "abusuafo" (abusuafo a wɔyɛ ahomaso a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu a ɛtrɛw kɔ akyiri sen ofie kuw no) a wɔnyɛ awarefo abusua no mufo.

Saa ahorow yi kyerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛyɛ papa anaasɛ ɛyɛ mmara a wohu wɔ aman pɔtee bi mu. Ɔman biara bɛda nsakrae bi adi wɔ mmusua a wɔahyehyɛ ne wɔn adwene ankasa mu.[37]

Abakɔsɛm mu no, na mmusua a wɔatrɛw mu ne abusua kuw titiriw wɔ Katolekfo amammerɛ ne aman mu (te sɛ Europa Kesee Fam ne Latin Amerika),[38] ne Asia, Mfinimfini Apuei ne Apuei Fam Ortodɔks aman mu.

Abusua a wɔpaw

Asɛmfua abusua a wɔpaw, a ɛtɔ mmere bi a wɔsan frɛ no "abusua a wɔapaw" anaa "abusua a wɔahu" no abu so wɔ LGBTfo mu, asraafo a wɔadi ako, ankorankoro a wɔayɛ wɔn ayayade, ne wɔn a wɔne wɔn awofo "awofo" nni nkitaho biara. Ɛkyerɛ nnipa kuw a wɔwɔ ankorankoro bi asetra mu a ɛma abusua dwumadi a ɛtaa ba sɛ mmoa nhyehyɛe no di ho dwuma. Asɛmfua no ma nsonsonoe da "abusua a wofi mu" (abusua a ɛwɔ abɔde mu anaa nea wɔtete nnipa wom) ne wɔn a wɔde nsi fa saa dwuma a eye no ntam.[39]

Abusua a wɔpaw no betumi ayɛ abusua a wofi mu no mufo bi anaa wɔn nyinaa anaasɛ wɔrenka ho. Saa abusua yi nyɛ abusua a edi abusua nhyehyɛe "a ɛyɛ daa" akyi te sɛ agya, ɛna, ne mma a wɔwɔ. Eyi yɛ abusua yɛ nnipa kuw a wɔde wɔn ho to wɔn ho wɔn ho so te sɛ nea abusua a wofi mu bɛyɛ.[40] Saa nsɛmfua yi fi nokwasɛm a ɛyɛ sɛ LGBT ankorankoro pii, sɛ wopue a, wohyia pow anaa aniwu fi mmusua a wɔtetee wɔn wom no hɔ.[41] Ankorankoro a wɔwɔ anammɔn 12 no mu nso de asɛmfua abusua a wɔpaw no di dwuma, a wɔde "abusua" abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den ba denam ahotɔ nhyehyɛe no so.

Sɛ́ abusua nhyehyɛe no, mmusua a wɔpaw wɔn no hyia nsɛm a ɛyɛ soronko. Sɛ mmara kwan so ahobammɔ nni hɔ a, mmusua a wɔpaw no betumi apere bere a aduruyɛ, nhomasua anaa aban ahyehyɛde ahorow ntumi nhu sɛ ɛfata no.[41] Sɛ abusua a wofi mu no apow abusua a wɔapaw wɔn no mufo a, wobetumi anya awerɛhow a wɔde besi ananmu, abufuw, adehwere, anaasɛ dadwen a wɔde bɛbata wɔn abusua foforo no ho.[41]

Abusua a wɔadi afra

Asɛmfua abusua a wɔadi afra anaa mpena abusua no kyerɛ mmusua a awofo a wɔadi afra wom: awofo biako anaa wɔn baanu nyinaa san waree, de kan abusua no mma ba abusua foforo no mu.[42] Afei nso wɔ asetra ho adesua mu, titiriw wɔ asetra mu adwene ho ɔbenfo Michael Lamb nnwuma mu no,[43] atetesɛm abusua no kyerɛ "abusua a ɛwɔ mfinimfini a wɔwɔ agya a odi nkonim ne ɛna a ɔtra fie, a wɔaware wɔn ho wɔn ho na wɔtete wɔn awosu mufo." mmofra," na ɛnyɛ amanne kwan so de ma nea ɛka mmara yi ho. Mprempren U.S. afie dodow no ara nyɛ amanne wɔ saa nkyerɛase yi ase.[44] Wɔn a wɔkasa tia asɛmfua "amammerɛ abusua" no kyerɛ sɛ wɔ amammerɛ dodow no ara mu ne mmere dodow no ara mu no, abusua a wɔatrɛw mu nhwɛso no na abu so kɛse, ɛnyɛ nuklea abusua no,[45] ɛwom sɛ anya atetesɛm a ɛware wɔ England[46] sen de Europa ne Asia mmeae afoforo a ɛde atubrafo pii baa Amerika no. Nuklea abusua no bɛyɛɛ ɔkwan a abu so sen biara wɔ U.S. wɔ 1960 ne 1970 mfe no mu.[47]

Wɔ nkitahodi nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛwɔ mmusua mu ho no, gyidi ahorow bi wɔ abusua no mu a ɛkyerɛ sɛnea ɛsɛ sɛ emufo di nkitaho na wɔne wɔn di nkitaho. Saa abusua nkitahodi nhyehyɛe ahorow yi fi gyidi ahorow abien a ɛhyɛ ase mu. Baako ne nkɔmmɔbɔ kwankyerɛ (baabi a wobu hia a nkitahodi ho hia no sɛ ɛsom bo) ne abien, kwankyerɛ a ɛne ne ho hyia (baabi a ɛsɛ sɛ mmusua si nsɛdi anaa nsonsonoe a ɛfa suban, gyidi, ne gyinapɛn ahorow ho so dua kodu).[48]

Mmusua a wɔde afrafra yɛ nea emu yɛ den, efi mmusua a wɔyɛ mpena so kosi mmusua a wɔbom tra so (ankorankoro bi a ɔne ahwɛfo a wɔnwaree a wɔne mpena anaa anuanom fa te). Bere a ɛnyɛ soronko koraa wɔ mpena mmusua ho no, mmusua a wɔbom tra no de adwene mu nkɛntɛnso a abu so ba mmerante ne mmabaa so.[49] Anka mmabun binom bɛtaa "nsɛmmɔnedi nneyɛe," na wɔahyia ɔhaw ahorow wɔ sukuu mu fi adesua mu mmɔdenbɔ a ɛso tew so kosi nneyɛe a ɛde ɔhaw ba a ɛkɔ soro so. Ɛne nhwehwɛmu afoforo a wɔyɛe wɔ mpena mmusua akwan horow so a ebinom nyaa abusua mu osuahu, nanso afoforo nni abusuabɔ no hyia. Nkate mu a wɔtwe wɔn ho fi mmusua a wɔyɛ mpena mufo ho no boa ma saa adwenem naayɛ yi ba, na ɛma nhyɛso a ebia mmusua yi de besi hɔ no kɔ anim.[50] Nsakrae a efi abusua dedaw mu kɔ abusua foforo a ɛhyɛ mmusua a wɔadi afra ase no nso bɛyɛ ɔhaw efisɛ ebia dwumadi ahorow a bere bi na wɔyɛ wɔ abusua dedaw no mu no renkɔ so yiye wɔ abusua foforo no mu mma mmabun.

Abusua a wɔware ɔyere biako

Abusua a wɔware ɔyere biako no gyina mmara kwan so anaa asetra mu ɔyere biako a wɔware so. Wɔ saa tebea yi mu no, ankorankoro bi wɔ ɔhokafo biako pɛ (a ɔyɛ aban de) wɔ wɔn nkwa nna mu anaa bere biara mu (i.e. serial monogamy).[52] Eyi kyerɛ sɛ ebia obi rennya mmara kwan so ahokafo ahorow pii bere koro mu, efisɛ eyi taa yɛ nea aware abien ho mmara bara, (adeyɛ a ɛne sɛ obi ne obi bɛware bere a ɔda so ara ware ɔfoforo wɔ mmara kwan so[53]) wɔ tumidi ahorow a hwehwɛ sɛ wɔware ɔyere biako.

Abusuabɔ ho nsɛmfua 
Obusuani a odi kan ne obi a ɔkyɛ wo DNA no 50% denam agyapade a wonya tẽẽ so, te sɛ onua a odi mũ, ɔwofo anaa asefo.

Ade foforo wɔ hɔ a wɔde kyerɛ sɛnea abusuabɔ no te, a wɔde awo ntoatoaso a wɔkan kɔ soro kosi nana a odi kan a ɔbom yɛ no so na wɔsan kɔ ankorankoro a wɔde wɔn ani asi so no so, a wɔde di dwuma wɔ abusua anato ne mmara mu atirimpɔw ahorow ho. [60] .

Nsɛmfua a wɔde di dwuma

Wɔ ne nhoma Systems of Consanguinity and Affinity of the Human Family mu no, nnipa ho nimdefo Lewis Henry Morgan (1818–1881) yɛɛ abusua mu nsɛmfua a wɔde di dwuma wɔ wiase nyinaa ho nhwehwɛmu a edi kan. Ɛwom sɛ mprempren wobu n’adwuma no fa kɛse no ara sɛ ɛyɛ bere a atwam de, nanso ɔkae sɛ abusuabɔ ho nsɛmfua da nsonsonoe ahorow a ɛsono emu biara adi. Sɛ nhwɛso no, abusua mu nsɛmfua dodow no ara kyerɛ nsonsonoe a ɛda ɔbarima ne ɔbea ntam (nsonsonoe a ɛda onua ne onuawa ntam) ne awo ntoatoaso ntam (nsonsonoe a ɛda abofra ne ɔwofo ntam). Bio nso, ɔkyerɛe sɛ, abusuabɔ ho nsɛmfua de mogya ne aware na ɛma abusuafo ntam nsonsonoe (ɛwom sɛ nnansa yi nnipa ho animdefo binom aka sɛ aman pii de nsɛmfua a ɛnyɛ "mogya" kyerɛkyerɛ abusuabɔ mu de).

Morgan yɛɛ nsonsonoe a ɛda abusuafo nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde nsɛmfua a wɔde kyekyɛ nneɛma mu di dwuma ne nea wɔde nsɛmfua a wɔde kyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma mu di dwuma no ntam. Wɔte nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde kyekyɛ nneɛma mu no ase mpɛn pii na wɔ ɔkwan a ɛnteɛ so sɛ ɛyɛ nea "wɔde adesua bom" ne abusuafo a asɛmfua biako a nokwarem no wonni abusuabɔ koro no ara ne ego. (Ɛte sɛ nea nea ɛkyerɛkyerɛ "abusuabɔ koro no ara" ase wɔ nkyerɛase ahorow a ɛtete saa ase no yɛ abusua anato mu abusuabɔ. Eyi yɛ ɔhaw esiane sɛ abusua anato ho nkyerɛkyerɛmu biara, ɛmfa ho sɛnea wɔahyehyɛ no pɛpɛɛpɛ no, de nsɛmfua a efi amanfo ntease a ɛfa abusuafo ho mu di dwuma.) Nea Morgan nsɛmfua no ma ɛda nsow ankasa ne wɔn (classificatory) abusuabɔ nhyehyɛe a ɛnkyerɛ nsonsonoe a ɛda lineal ne collateral abusuabɔ mu ne saa (nkyerɛkyerɛmu) abusuabɔ nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ saa. Morgan a ɔyɛ mmaranimfo no baa sɛ ɔbɛma saa nsonsonoe yi aba de abɔ mmɔden sɛ ɔbɛte Seneca agyapade ho nneyɛe ase. Senecani barima bi nsunsuanso no, ne nuabeanom mma na wonya fii awo mu sen sɛ n’ankasa mma benya.[63] Morgan kyerɛɛ abusua mu nsɛmfua ho nhwɛso atitiriw asia:

Hawaii kasa: egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne awo ntoatoaso so nkutoo na ɛkyerɛ abusuafo mu nsonsonoe.

Sudanfo: abusuafo baanu biara nni hɔ a wɔka asɛmfua koro.

Eskimo: wɔ abusuafo mu nsonsonoe a egyina ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne awo ntoatoaso so akyi no, ɔsan nso kyerɛ nsonsonoe a ɛda abusuafo a wɔyɛ abusuafo ne abusuafo a wɔde wɔn ho to wɔn so ntam.

Iroquois: wɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne awo ntoatoaso akyi no, ɛsan nso kyerɛ nsonsonoe a ɛda anuanom a ɛsono wɔn bɔbeasu ntam wɔ awofo awo ntoatoaso no mu.

Crow: matrilineal nhyehyɛe a ɛwɔ Iroquois nhyehyɛe bi mu nneɛma bi, nanso ɛwɔ "skewing" afa a awo ntoatoaso yɛ "frozen" ma abusuafo binom.

Omaha: te sɛ Crow nhyehyɛe nanso patrilineal.

Dwumadi ahorow 
Atɔe fam aman dodow no ara de Eskimo abusuafo nsɛmfua di dwuma.[64] Saa abusuabɔ ho nsɛmfua yi taa ba wɔ aman a aware mu yɛ den wom mu, baabi a mmusua wɔ baabi a wotumi nantew kakra no. Mpɛn pii no, aman a wɔwɔ awarefo mmusua nso ani gye ho sɛ wɔbɛtra baabi foforo; enti sɛ obi ware a, ɔtew ne ho fi ne mmofraberem nuklea abusua no ho (abusua a wɔde wɔn ani kyerɛ wɔn kwan) na ɔyɛ nuklea abusua foforo (awo abusua). Mpɛn pii no, nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛtete saa no fa no sɛ ɛna no kunu nso ne agya a ɔwoo no. Nhyehyɛe no de nsɛmfua a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ nuklea abusua no mu kɛse di dwuma na ɛde nkakrankakra de kyekyɛ nneɛma mu kɛse bere a abusuafo no bɛyɛ nea wɔde wɔn ho to so kɛse no.

Nuklea abusua

Nhyehyɛe no si nuklea abusua no so dua. Nuklea abusua no mufo de abusuabɔ ho nsɛm a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ mu kɛse di dwuma, na wɔkyerɛ okunu, ɔyere, ɛna, agya, ɔbabarima, ɔbabea, onuabarima, ne onuawa nkutoo tẽẽ. Wɔaboaboa abusuafo a aka no nyinaa ano akuwakuw. Nuklea abusua no mufo betumi ayɛ lineal anaasɛ collateral. Kin a eyinom yɛ abusua ma wɔn no de nkyerɛkyerɛmu nsɛm a egyina nsɛmfua a wɔde di dwuma wɔ nuklea abusua no mu so anaasɛ wɔde nuklea abusua asɛmfua no di dwuma tẽẽ no frɛ wɔn.

Nuklea abusua a wɔde kyerɛ kwan

Onua: ɔwofo bi ba barima.

Onuawa: ɔwofo bi ba a ɔyɛ ɔbea.

Agya: ɔwofo a ɔyɛ ɔbarima.

Nana: ɔwofo bi agya.

Ɛna: ɔwofo a ɔyɛ ɔbea.

Nanabea: ɔwofo bi maame.

Nuklea aware abusua

Okunu: ɔhokafo a ɔyɛ ɔbarima.

Ɔyere: ɔhokafo a ɔyɛ ɔbea.

Ɔba: ɔwofo (awofo) no ba barima.

Nana: abofra bi ba.

Ɔbabea: ɔwofo (awofo) no ba a ɔyɛ ɔbea.

Nanabea: abofra bi babea.

Nuklea abusua a ɛnyɛ lineal

Ɔhokafo: okunu anaa ɔyere

Stepparent: ɔwofo bi hokafo a ɔnyɛ ɔwofo ankasa

Onua: onuawa anaa onua

Onua fa: onua a asɛmti no ne no kyɛ ɔwofo biako pɛ a ɔwoo no

Step-sibling: ɔwofo a ɔnyɛ ɔwofo a ɔwoo no no ba

Abusuafo a wɔde wɔn ho to wɔn so

Onua yɛ obusuani a ɔde ne ho to so a wonnyae no kakraa bi. Wɔ abusuafo a wɔde wɔn ho to wɔn so a woyi wɔn fi hɔ biako foforo, awo ntoatoaso biako a ɛne nana biako ntam kwan ware kɛse wɔ ɔfa biako fam no, nsɛmfua a wɔde kyekyɛ nneɛma mu pii ba asɛm no mu. Saa nsɛmfua yi (Aunt, Uncle, Niece, ne Nephew) nsi nsɛmfua a wɔde di dwuma wɔ nuklea abusua no mu no so efisɛ dodow no ara nyɛ ofie no mufo wɔ atetesɛm mu. Saa nsɛmfua yi nkyerɛ nsonsonoe a ɛda abusuafo a wɔde wɔn ho to wɔn so ne obi a waware obusuani a wɔde wɔn ho to wɔn so (a wɔde wɔn ho to wɔn so ne nea wɔaka abom nyinaa) ntam wɔ atetesɛm mu. Collateral abusuafo a woyi afoforo fi hɔ wɔ ɔfa biara ne Cousins. Eyi ne asɛmfua a wɔde kyekyɛ nneɛma mu sen biara na wobetumi de nneɛma a wɔde gyina akyi ne awo ntoatoaso (a woyi fi hɔ) akyerɛ nsonsonoe a ɛda ntam.

Sɛ asɛmti no nkutoo na ɔwɔ yiyi foforo no a, obusuani no yɛ asɛmti no awofo nuanom, wɔde nsɛmfua Aunt ne Uncle di dwuma ma abusuafo mmea ne mmarima. Sɛ obusuani no nkutoo na ɔwɔ yiyi foforo no a, obusuani no ne subjects anuanom abofra no, wɔde nsɛmfua Niece ne Nephew di dwuma ma abusuafo mmea ne mmarima. Ɔhokafo a ɔwoo no maame nuabea anaa ne nua barima no hokafo yɛ ne maame nuabea anaa ne nua barima, na ɔhokafo bi nuabeanom ne ne nuabeanom mma yɛ ne nuabeanom ne ne nuabeanom mma. Bere a asɛmti no yi fi hɔ bio ma aunts ne uncles ne obusuani no ma nieces ne nephews no, prefix "grand-" no sesa nsɛmfua yi. Sɛ woyi anim bio a, prefix no bɛyɛ "great-grand-," de "great-" foforo ka ho ma awo ntoatoaso biara a ɛka ho. Wɔ awo ntoatoaso dodow bi mu no wobetumi de dodow bi asi ananmu, sɛ nhwɛso no, "nanana a ɔto so anan", "nanana a ɔto so anan" anaa "nanana a ɔto so anan".

Sɛ asɛmti no ne obusuani no nya biribi foforo a woyi fi hɔ a wɔyɛ wɔn nuanom mmarima. Cosin a woyi no fi hɔ kakraa bi no yɛ cousin a odi kan, i.e. subjects no papa nua barima anaa aunt ba. Wɔde nneɛma a wɔde bɔ obi ho ban ne nea woyi fi hɔ no dodow di dwuma de kyerɛkyerɛ abusuabɔ a ɛda wɔn nuanom mmarima ntam no mu pɛpɛɛpɛ. Abodin krataa no yɛ awo ntoatoaso dodow a edi nana a ɔbom yɛ akyi ansa na wɔahu awofo a ɔyɛ ne nuanom no mu biako, bere a nea woyi fi hɔ no yɛ nsonsonoe a ɛda awo ntoatoaso dodow a efi ne wɔfase biara so kosi nana a wɔbom yɛ no ntam (nsonsonoe a ɛda awo ntoatoaso a wɔfase no yɛ ntam). efi).[65][66]

Awo ntoatoaso a wɔanyinyin mu nuanom mma (wɔ ɔkwan foforo so no, obi awofo nuanom mma a wodi kan), ɛwom sɛ wɔ mfiridwuma mu no bere a woyi wɔn nuanom mmarima a wodi kan no fi hɔ pɛn de, nanso wɔtaa kyekyɛ wɔn mu sɛ "aunt" ne "uncles".

Abusuafo a wɔaka abom

Wɔn a wɔka Borɔfo kasa no hyɛ abusuabɔ agyirae denam aware so (gye sɛ ɔyere/okunu) a wɔde ahyɛnsode "-in-law" ahyɛ mu. Obi hokafo maame ne n’agya bɛyɛ n’asew ne n’asew; obi babarima yere bɛyɛ n’asew na ne babea kunu bɛyɛ n’asew. Asɛmfua "asew" no kyerɛ abusuabɔ abien a ɛsono emu biara titiriw, obi nuabarima yere, anaasɛ obi hokafo nuabea. "Asew" yɛ obi nuabea kunu, anaa ne hokafo nuabarima. Nsɛmfua "onuabarima fa" ne "onuabarima fa" kyerɛ anuanom a wɔwɔ ɔwofo biako pɛ a ɔwoo wɔn. Asɛmfua "aunt-in-law" yɛ obi papa nua barima yere, anaa ne hokafo maame nuabea. "Uncle-in-law" yɛ obi maame nuabea kunu, anaa obi hokafo papa nua ba. "Cousin-in-law" yɛ obi nua barima hokafo, anaasɛ obi hokafo nua barima. Asɛmfua "niece-in-law" yɛ obi nua ba yere, anaa obi hokafo nuabea. "Nephew-in-law" yɛ obi nuabea kunu, anaasɛ obi hokafo nuabea ba. Obi hokafo nanabea ne ne nanabea bɛyɛ ne nanabea ne ne nanabea; obi banana yere bɛyɛ ne sewaa na obi banana kunu bɛyɛ ne sewaa.

Wɔ India Borɔfo kasa mu no, wobetumi aka onua bi a ɔyɛ mmaranimfo a ɔyɛ wo nua no hokafo ho asɛm sɛ obi a ɔne no yɛ nua (specificity a co-sister[67] anaa co-brother[68]).

Abusuafo ahorow 
Patrilineal Nsɛm a Wɔahyehyɛ

Patrilineality, a wɔsan frɛ no male line anaa agnatic kinship, yɛ abusuabɔ nhyehyɛe bi a ankorankoro bi abusua mufo fi ne papa abusua mu na wɔhwehwɛ mu. Mpɛn pii no, ɛfa agyapade, hokwan ahorow, din, anaa abodin ahorow a nnipa a wɔnam abusuafo mmarima so nya no ho.

Patriline ("agya abusua") yɛ obi agya, ne nananom afoforo a wɔnam mmarima nkutoo so hwehwɛ wɔn. Enti obi agya abusua no yɛ kyerɛwtohɔ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ obi fi ɔbarima bi mu a ankorankoro a wɔwɔ awo ntoatoaso a ɛwɔ ntam no nyinaa mu no yɛ mmarima. Wɔ amammerɛ mu nnipa ho adesua mu no, agya abusua yɛ mmarima ne mmea abusuafo kuw a wɔyɛ abusuafo, a wɔn mu biara fi nana koro no mu denam nananom mmarima so.

Matrilineal a ɛwɔ hɔ

Matrilineality yɛ abusuafo nhyehyɛe bi a ankorankoro bi abusua mufo fi ne maame abusua mu na wɔhwehwɛ mu.

Ebia ɛne ɔmanfo nhyehyɛe bi a ɛkyerɛ sɛ obiara ne ne matriline—wɔn maame abusua—na ebetumi afa agyapade ne abodin ahorow a wobenya ho nso wɔ abusuabɔ. Matriline yɛ abusua a efi nana a ɔyɛ ɔbea so kɔ aseni mu a ankorankoro a wɔwɔ awo ntoatoaso a ɛwɔ ntam no nyinaa mu no yɛ ɛnanom – ɔkwan foforo so no, "ɛna abusua".

Wɔ matrilineal abusua nhyehyɛe mu no, wobu ankorankoro sɛ ofi abusua kuw koro no ara mu ne ne maame. Saa matrilineal abusua nhyehyɛe yi ne patrilineal abusua nhyehyɛe a abu so kɛse no bɔ abira.

Afa abien a ɛsiane

Afa abien a wofi mu yɛ abusuafo nhyehyɛe bi a ankorankoro bi abusua mufo fi agya ne ɛna no nyinaa mu na wɔfa so hwehwɛ mu. Abusuafo a wɔwɔ ɛna no afa ne agya afa no ho hia pɛpɛɛpɛ ma nkate fam abusuabɔ anaasɛ agyapade anaa ahonyade a wɔde bɛma afoforo. Ɛyɛ abusua nhyehyɛe a wɔde abusua ne agyapade fa awofo baanu no nyinaa so pɛpɛɛpɛ.[70] Mmusua a wɔde saa nhyehyɛe yi di dwuma no nam awofo baanu no nyinaa so hwehwɛ abusua mu bere koro mu na wohu nananom pii, nanso ɛnte sɛ abusua a ɛwɔ adwene mu no, wɔmfa nni dwuma mfa nhyehyɛ abusua akuw.[71]

Sɛnea wɔtaa yɛ no, wohu eyi wɔ akuw bi a ɛwɔ Afrika Atɔe Fam, India, Australia, Indonesia, Melanesia, Malaysia ne Polynesia mu. Nnipa ho animdefo gye di sɛ mmusuakuw nhyehyɛe a egyina aman abien abusua so boa asɔremma ma wɔtra mmeae a emu yɛ den efisɛ ɛma ankorankoro de wɔn ho to mmusua ahorow abien a wɔahwete wɔ beae a ɛtrɛw so.

title: Atɛntenee
text:
Atɛntrenee, wɔ ne ntease a ɛtrɛw mu no, ne nnyinasosɛm a ɛne sɛ nkurɔfo nya nea ɛfata wɔn, a nea afei ɛyɛ "ɛfata" no nkyerɛase a mfuw pii nya so nkɛntɛnso, a adwene ne adwene ahorow pii wom, a abrabɔ pa ho nteɛso ho nsusuwii ahorow a egyina so ka ho abrabɔ pa, ntease, mmara, nyamesom, pɛyɛ ne atɛntrenee. Ɛtɔ mmere bi a ɔman no bɛbɔ mmɔden sɛ ɛbɛma atɛntrenee ayɛ kɛse denam asennibea ahorow a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma ne wɔn gyinaesi ahorow a wɔde bedi dwuma no so.

Tete Helafo nyansapɛfo Plato na wɔde atɛntrenee ho nsusuwii ahorow a edi kan sii hɔ wɔ n’adwuma The Republic mu, ne Aristotle wɔ ne Nicomachean Ethics mu.Wɔn a wɔkamfo ɔsoro ahyɛde nkyerɛkyerɛ kyerɛ no aka sɛ atɛntrenee fi Onyankopɔn hɔ. Wɔ 1600 mfe no mu no, nyansapɛfo te sɛ John Locke kae sɛ atɛntrenee fi abɔde mu mmara mu. Social contract theory kae sɛ wonya atɛntrenee fi obiara adwene a ɛne ne ho hyia mu. Wɔ 1800 mfe no mu no, nyansapɛfo a wɔpɛ mfaso te sɛ John Stuart Mill kae sɛ atɛntrenee gyina nea eye sen biara a ebefi mu aba ama nnipa dodow no ara so. Nsusuwii ahorow a ɛfa atɛntrenee a wɔkyekyɛ ho no sua nea ɛsɛ sɛ wɔkyekyɛ, wɔn a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔkyekyɛ wɔn ntam, ne nea ɛsɛ sɛ wɔkyekyɛ no yiye. Wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔyɛ pɛ no aka sɛ atɛntrenee betumi atra hɔ wɔ pɛyɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow no mu nkutoo. John Rawls de asetra mu apam nsusuwii bi dii dwuma de kae sɛ atɛntrenee, ne titiriw no, atɛntrenee a wɔkyekyɛ no yɛ ɔkwan bi a wɔfa so yɛ atɛntrenee. Robert Nozick ne afoforo kae sɛ agyapade hokwan ahorow, a ɛno nso wɔ atɛntrenee a wɔkyekyɛ ne abɔde mu mmara mu no ma sikasɛm nhyehyɛe bi ahonyade nyinaa yɛ kɛse. Nsusuwii ahorow a ɛfa atɛntrenee a wɔde tua ka ho no ka sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ wɔtwe nneɛma bɔne aso na ama wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wobu atɛntrenee. Atɛntrenee a wɔde san ba a ɛne no wɔ abusuabɔ kɛse (a ɛtɔ mmere bi a wɔsan frɛ no "atɛntrenee a wɔde siesie") yɛ ɔkwan a wɔfa so bu atɛntrenee a ɛtwe adwene si wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn basabasa ne wɔn a wɔyɛ mmaratofo no ahiade so.

Ɔsoro ahyɛde 
Wɔn a wɔkamfo ɔsoro ahyɛde nkyerɛkyerɛ kyerɛ no ka sɛ atɛntrenee, ne nokwarem no abrabɔ pa nyinaa, yɛ Onyankopɔn ahyɛde a ɛwɔ tumi. Sɛ nhwɛso no, awudi yɛ mfomso na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔtwe n’aso, efisɛ Onyankopɔn ka saa. Nsusuwii no nkyerɛase ahorow bi si so dua sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ wotie Onyankopɔn esiane sɛnea ɔne adesamma abusuabɔ te nti, afoforo nso ka sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ wotie Onyankopɔn efisɛ ɔyɛ papayɛ ankasa, na ɛnam so yɛ nea ɔka sɛ ɛbɛyɛ papa ama obiara.

Yebetumi ahu Ɔsoro ahyɛde nkyerɛkyerɛ a Plato de mae no ho adwennwen wɔ ne nkɔmmɔbɔ, Euthyphro mu. Wɔfrɛ no Euthyphro dilemma, na ɛkɔ so sɛnea edidi so yi: "So nea ɛyɛ abrabɔ pa no yɛ nea Onyankopɔn ahyɛ esiane sɛ ɛyɛ abrabɔ pa nti, anaasɛ ɛyɛ abrabɔ pa esiane sɛ Onyankopɔn na ɔhyɛ nti?" Nea ɛkyerɛ ne sɛ, sɛ nea etwa to no yɛ nokware a, ɛnde atɛntrenee boro owu ntease so; sɛ kan no yɛ nokware a, ɛnde abrabɔ pa wɔ hɔ a ɛde ne ho fi Onyankopɔn ho, na enti ɛhyɛ nnipa a wowuwu atemmu ase. Mmuae bi, a Immanuel Kant ne C. S. Lewis gyee din wɔ nsɛm abien mu ne sɛ ɛyɛ nea ɛfata wɔ deductively mu sɛ yɛbɛka sɛ abrabɔ pa a ɛwɔ botae bi a ɛwɔ hɔ no kyerɛ sɛ Onyankopɔn wɔ hɔ na nea ɛne no bɔ abira

Nkabom 
Atɛntrenee yɛ abusuabɔ a ɛfata a ɛne ne ho hyia a ɛda onipa anaa kurow no afa horow a ɛreko no ntam. Enti, atɛntrenee ho nkyerɛkyerɛmu a Plato de ma ne sɛ atɛntrenee yɛ nea obi ankasa nya na ɔyɛ. Onipa a ɔteɛ yɛ onipa a ɔwɔ beae a ɛfata pɛpɛɛpɛ, ɔyɛ nea obetumi biara na ɔde nea wanya no yɛ pɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ ma. Eyi fa ankorankoro gyinabea ne amansan nyinaa gyinabea nyinaa ho. Obi kra wɔ afa abiɛsa – ntease, honhom ne akɔnnɔ. Saa ara nso na kurow bi wɔ afa abiɛsa – Socrates de teaseɛnam ho bɛ no kyerɛkyerɛ n’asɛm no mu: teaseɛnam yɛ adwuma sɛ ne nyinaa efisɛ apɔnkɔ abien no tumi no, teaseɛnamkafo no na ɔkyerɛ kwan. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔdɔ nyansa – nyansapɛfo, wɔ asɛmfua no ntease biako mu – di tumi efisɛ wɔn nkutoo na wɔte nea eye ase. Sɛ obi yare a, ɔkɔ oduruyɛfo nkyɛn sen sɛ ɔbɛkɔ okuafo nkyɛn, efisɛ oduruyɛfo no nim akwahosan ho asɛm. Saa ara nso na ɛsɛ sɛ obi de ne ho to ne kurow so ma obi a onim papa no ho ɔbenfo, na ɛnyɛ ɔmanyɛfo ara kwa a ɔbɔ mmɔden sɛ obenya tumi denam nea nkurɔfo pɛ a ɔde bɛma no so, sen sɛ ɔde nea eye ma wɔn bɛma wɔn. Socrates de hyɛn no ho mfatoho no di dwuma de kyerɛkyerɛ saa asɛm yi mu: kurow a ɛnteɛ no te sɛ hyɛn a ɛwɔ po a ɛda hɔ mu, a hyɛn mu panyin bi a ɔwɔ tumi nanso wabow nsa (nnipa mpapahwekwa), afotufo kuw bi a wontumi mfa wɔn ho nto wɔn so a wɔbɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔbɛdannan hyɛn no mu panyin no ma ɔde ama tumi wɔ hyɛn no kwan so (amammuifo), ne ɔkwankyerɛfo (nyansapɛfo) a ɔno nkutoo na onim sɛnea wɔde hyɛn no bɛkɔ hyɛn gyinabea. Wɔ Socrates fam no, ɔkwan biako pɛ a hyɛn no bɛfa so adu baabi a ɛrekɔ no – papa no – ne sɛ hyɛn no kwankyerɛfo no bɛfa so.[2]

Nsusuwii ahorow a ɛfa atɛntrenee a wɔde tua ka ho 

Nsusuwii ahorow a ɛfa atɛntrenee a wɔde tua ka ho no fa asotwe a wɔde ma wɔ bɔne a wɔayɛ ho, na ɛsɛ sɛ wobua nsɛmmisa abiɛsa:

dɛn nti na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔtwe aso?

henanom na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔtwe wɔn aso?

asotwe bɛn na ɛsɛ sɛ wonya?

Saa ɔfa yi susuw atɛntrenee a wɔde tua ka ho kyerɛwtohɔ atitiriw abien no ho, ne wɔn mmuae a wɔde ma wɔ nsɛmmisa yi ho. Mfaso ho nsusuwii ahorow hwɛ nea ebefi asotwe mu aba daakye kwan, bere a nsusuwii ahorow a wɔde tua so ka no hwɛ nneyɛe pɔtee bi a wɔyɛ no akyi, na wɔbɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔbɛma asotwe a ɛfata akari pɛ.

Mfaso ho adwene

Sɛnea mfaso ho nimdefo no kyerɛ no, atɛntrenee hwehwɛ sɛ wɔde yiyedi a ɛwɔ hɔ nyinaa anaa nea wɔkyekyem pɛpɛɛpɛ no yɛ kɛse wɔ ankorankoro a ɛfa ho nyinaa mu. Asotwe ko tia nsɛmmɔnedi wɔ akwan abiɛsa so:

Nneɛma a wɔde siw ano. Ebia asotwe ho ahunahuna a wotumi gye di no bɛma nkurɔfo apaw nneɛma ahorow; ahunahuna a wɔayɛ no yiye betumi ama nkurɔfo apaw nneɛma a ɛbɛma wɔanya yiyedi kɛse. Eyi ne nsusuwii ahorow bi a emu yɛ den a ɛfa asotwe a ɛfata ho no hyia: sɛ mpɛn pii no ɛsɛ sɛ ɛne nsɛmmɔnedi no hyia.

Nneɛma a wɔde siesie wɔn ho. Ebia asotwe bɛma "nnipa bɔne" ayɛ wɔn a "wɔyɛ papa". Wɔ utilitarian no fam no, nea "onipa bɔne" betumi akyerɛ ara ne "onipa a ɛda adi sɛ ɔde nneɛma a wɔmpɛ (te sɛ amanehunu)" bɛba". Enti, mfaso ho adwene betumi akamfo asotwe a ɛsakra obi ma enti ɛnyɛ den koraa sɛ ɛde nneɛma bɔne bɛba no akyerɛ.

Ahobammɔ/Ahoɔden a wontumi nyɛ ho hwee. Ebia nnipa bi wɔ hɔ a wɔde nneɛma bɔne ba a wontumi nnye wɔn. Sɛ ɛte saa a, ebia wɔn a wɔde wɔn bɛto afiase no bɛma yiyedi ayɛ kɛse denam hokwan ahorow a wobenya de apira wɔn a wɔbɛto ano hye so na enti mfaso no wɔ ɔmanfo a wɔbɛbɔ wɔn ho ban no mu.

Enti, nea enti a wɔde asotwe ma ne sɛ wɔbɛma yiyedi ayɛ kɛse, na ɛsɛ sɛ asotwe yɛ obiara a ohia, ne ɔkwan ne sɛnea emu yɛ den biara a wohia na ama wadu saa botae no ho. Ɛtɔ mmere bi a eyi betumi ama wɔatwe wɔn a wɔn ho nni asɛm no aso, anaasɛ wɔde asotwe a emu yɛ den a ɛnsɛ bɛba wɔn so, bere a ɛno de nea eye sen biara bɛba wɔ ne nyinaa mu no (ebia sɛ wokum wɔn a wosusuw sɛ wɔyɛ sotɔɔ mu korɔnfo kakraa bi a wɔte ase wɔ television so a, ɛbɛyɛ ade a etu mpɔn a wɔde besiw sotɔɔ mu korɔnbɔ ano, sɛ nhwɛso no). Ɛsan nso kyerɛ sɛ ebia asotwe bɛyɛ nea ɛnteɛ da, a egyina nokwasɛm ahorow a ɛfa nea efi mu ba ankasa ho no so.[17]

Atuatua ho ka

Retributivist no besusuw sɛ consequentialism yɛ mfomso. Sɛ obi yɛ biribi bɔne a ɛsɛ sɛ yɛyɛ ho biribi denam asotwe a yɛde bɛma wɔ adeyɛ a wɔayɛ no ankasa ho, a nea efi mu ba a asotwe no de ba no mfa ho. Ɛsɛ sɛ wɔma bɔne kari pɛ anaasɛ wɔyɛ no yiye wɔ ɔkwan bi so, na enti ɛfata sɛ wɔtwe ɔsɛmmɔnedifo no aso. Ɛka sɛ nnipa a wodi fɔ nyinaa, ne nnipa a wodi fɔ nkutoo, fata asotwe a ɛfata. Eyi ne nsusuwii ahorow bi a emu yɛ den a ɛfa asotwe a ɛfata ho no hyia: sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ ɛne nsɛmmɔnedi no hyia, na ɛsɛ sɛ ɛyɛ wɔn a wodi fɔ nkutoo ne wɔn nyinaa de.[18] Nanso, ɛtɔ mmere bi a wɔka sɛ aweredi yɛ aweredi a wɔde akata so ara kwa.[19] Nanso, nsonsonoe wɔ aweredi ne aweredi ntam: kan no nyɛ animhwɛ na ɛwɔ nsenia a ɛfata, bere a nea etwa to no yɛ ankorankoro de na ebetumi ayɛ nea anohyeto nni mu wɔ nsenia mu.[20]

title: Afidie
text:
Afidie yɛ adeɛ bi a yɛhunu na yɛde adwuma ɔhyɛ mu ne adane adane mu. Wɔtae de saa din no ma nnoɔma nnipa di wɔn nsa ayɛ na ɔde ngyin si. Nnipa ne mmoa bɛtumi atwe afidie no sɛ ɛyɛ mframa ne nsuo ne ahoɔdin a nkanie bɛtumi ahyɛ no de ayɛ adwuma. Wɔn bɛtumi de kɔmputa nso ama afidie no ayɛ adwuma.

Owura bi a ɔfiri Renaissan a ɔyɛ filosofa hunuu mfidie nsia bi a na wɔde fa nnoɔma .

Ɛnnɛ yi mfidie wayɛ no sɛ adeɛ a ɛwɔ nhyehyeɛ ne adeɛ a yɛde hwɛ danedane no wo nadwuma yɛ mu.Nhwɛsoɔ, kaa akɛseɛ bi te sɛ keteke,lɔɔre, kodoɔ ne wiemmuhyɛn; nnoɔma a yɛde yɛ efie nnwuma bi te sɛ, kɔmputa,  nnoɔma yɛde yɛ adansie hu nnwuma ne adeɛ a ɛkora nsuo; afei mfidie a yɛde yɛ mfuom nnwuma.

Abɔseɛ 
Asɛmfua Afidie wɔ borɔfo kasa mu  no ɔnya firii French a ɛfiri Latin kasa machina, ɛna akyire na ɔyi firii  Greek (Doric μαχανά makhana, Ionic μηχανή mekhane 'contrivance, machine, engine', a derivation from μῆχος mekhos 'means, expedient, remedy'). Asɛmfua afidie (Greek: μηχανικός) firi  Greek mfitiaseɛ. Na ne nkyerɛase no dɔɔso nanso na wɔmfa nne dwuma gye. Akyire na  ɔnyaa nteaseɛ wɔ medieval French, ɔnyaa firii French de kɔɔ Borɔfo kasa mu wɔ afe 16th century mfimfini mu.

Wɔ afe 17th century, asɛmfua afidie nso bɛtumi akyerɛ sɛ scheme or plot. Ɛnnɛ yi nkyerɛaseɛ ma afidie no Sɛdeɛ wasi ahyehyɛ no ayɛ no sɛ ngyen a yɛde hyɛ  theater ne asogyafoɔ ngyen 16th ne early 17th centuries nyinaa.

Abakwasɛm 
Akuma a wɔde aboɔ ayɛ ama no ayɛ nam na nipa na ɔde ne nsa ɛma no ahoɔden ma no de paepae adeɛ mu ma no yɛ nkumaa. Akuma yɛ afidie a edi kan na ɛka afidie nsia a edii kan bae na ɔhwɛɛ so de yɛɛ mfidie bebree . Afidie a ɛtɔ so mmienu a akyɛ ne ramp a wɔde adi dwuma firi tete berɛ so a wɔde fa nnoɔma a ɛmu yɛduru.

Mfidie nnan no a aka no wɔnyaa no tete apueeɛ fa mu. Afidie a ɛtware ne ho ɔnyaa firii Mesopotamia (Ɛnnɛ yi Irak) Wɔ afe 5th millennium BC. Afidie  leva baa kane bɛyɛ mfeɛ 5,000 a atwam wɔ apueeɛ fa mu hɔ na atumi afa nnoɔma akɛseɛ akɛseɛ wɔ tete berɛ mu Egyptfoɔ mfidi nnwuma mu.

Beaeɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Odunsini
text:
Abibiduro yɛ pharmacognosy adesua ne kwan a Yɛfa so de nnua a yɛde yɛ nnuro di dwuma. Yɛnni adanseɛ pii a ɛfa abɔdeɛ nyansapɛ a ɛma nnua a wɔde dii dwuma wɔ 21st century wie pɛyɛ.  Nnoɔma wɔde yɛ abibinnuro no bi ne fungal ne wowa bi tesɛ fagudeɛ,Abena ne mmoa binom ho akwaa. Wɔsane frɛ abibinnuro phytomedicine anaasɛ phytotherapy. Paraherbalism kyerɛ ɔkwan foforɔ ne pseudoscientific kwan bi a wɔfa so de nnua ne mmoa ho nnoɔma bi yɛ nnuro bi a wɔnnye ntom anaasɛ baabi a wɔma apomuden ho nnoɔma yi mpɔn. Paraherbalism de ne ho ka a wɔka sɛ  sɛ wokora nnoɔma a yɛde yɛ nnuro ahodoɔ pii firi baabi a wɔnyɛ saa nnuro pii a ɛyɛ kyɛn baabi a wɔyɛ nnuro pii, a adanseɛ biara nni mu.

Abakɔsɛm 
Wɔn a wɔhwɛ tete nnoɔma kyerɛ sɛ abibinnuro firi paleolithic pɛn so, bɛyɛ mfeɛ mpem aduosia ni. Adanseɛ a wɔatwerɛ ato hɔ fa ahahannuro kyerɛ sɛ ɛfiri Sumerianfoɔ hɔ bɛyɛ mfeɛ mpem num, a ɛboa nnua ahodoɔ ano guu hɔ.Tete amammerɛ no bi twerɛɛ biribi faa nnua ne nea yɛde sa wɔ nwoma a wɔfrɛ no "herbals". Wɔ Egypt mu no, wɔbɔ ahahannuro din wɔ Egyptian Medical papyri, a ɛda amusieɛ bi adi anaasɛ afahyɛ bi a wɔhunu no wɔ aduro toa bi a ɛkura ahahan pii. Wɔ Egypt mmerɛ mu no, na Ebers papyrus baeɛ bɛyɛ 1550BC na ɛfaa baabi bɛyɛ ahanson a na ɛhɔ na nnua firi. Greek ahahannuro a ɛdiikan baeɛ no firi Theoprastus a ɛwɔ Erosos a wɔ 4th century BC mu no, wɔtwerɛ wɔ Greek Historia Plantarum mu, firi Diocles of Carystus a ɔtwerɛɛ wɔ 3rd century BC ne Krateuas a ɛtwerɛɛ wɔ 1st century BC mu. Saa nnwuma yi mu kakraa bi pɛ na ɛtumi gyinaeɛ, nanso nea ɔkaeɛ no, abenfoɔ a wɔtwerɛɛ biribi faa ho no maa Egyptfoɔ ahahannuro no kɔɔ n'anim. Wɔhunuu nnuaba a wɔde yɛ nnuro wɔ Bronze Age china a ɛyɛ beaeɛ a wɔn a wɔhwehwɛ nnoɔma a atwam yɛ wɔ nnwuma firi shang dynasty (c. 1600–1046 BC).Bɛyɛ sɛ baeɛ ahanu ne aduonu nan no mu ɔha a wɔbɔɔ din wɔ Huangdi Neijing,  Chinafoɔ nnuro a wɔhwɛ no nyinaa yɛ ahaban. Na ahahan yɛ adeɛ a wɔde yɛ abibinnuro wɔ India, a na nea wɔde saa nyarewa paa yi nnuane.De Materia Medica,  yɛ adeɛ Pedanius Dioscorides (c. 40–90 AD) a ɔwɔ Anazarbus twerɛ no wɔ Greek mu, Cicilia, aduroyɛfoɔ ne obi a ɔsua agodideɛ yɛ nhwɛsoɔ ma ahahannuro a wɔdi dii dwuma wɔ mfeɛ bi a atwam bɛpemm 1600s mu.

Ɛnnɛ mmerɛ yi abibinnuro 
World Health Organization (WHO) kyerɛɛ mu sɛ nnipa a ɛwɔ Asia ne Abibiman mu no ɔhamu nkyekyɛmu aduowɔtwe na ɛde abibinnuro sa nyarewa a ano nyɛ den. Nnuro a wɔtwerɛ ma wɔn no bi  te sɛ artemisinin, digitalis, quinine ne taxanes yɛ ahahannuro. 

Nhyehyɛeɛ ho mpɛnsɛmpɛnsɛmu

Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du num mu no, Australia aban nkorabata a wɔhwɛ apomuden nsɛm so daa ayaresa ho nhwehwɛmu adi a wɔyɛ de hwɛ sɛ aponkyibaa krataa  bɛtumi afa emu biara ho a; ahahannuro ka nsɛm titire  du nson a wayɛ ho nhwehwɛmu a wanya adanseɛ biara wɔ ho sɛ ɛyɛ. Wɔrefiri aseɛ anya akwankyerɛ afa ahahannuro a ano yɛ hye na ɛnni ɔhaw biara no, European Medicines Agency de kwan foforɔ baeɛ wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nson a ɛhwehwɛ sane ma yɛhunu nhwehwɛmu a ɛdi mu a wɔde yɛ monographs fa abibinnuro ho. Wɔ United States no, National Center for complementary and Integrative Health ma National Institute of Health tua wɔ a na wɔkɔ sɔ abibinnuro ahwɛ no, ɔde nkrataa ɛfa nhwehwɛmu no ho a ɛyɛ nokware baeɛ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɛnni haw, ɛyɛ aduro papa ne nnua pii no ara ho nsunsuansoɔ, na wɔmaa nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛ faa ahahannuro no kaa hɔ.Cancer Research a ɛwɔ UK kyerɛɛ mu sɛ ɛfiri mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du num mu no, "wɔnni adanseɛ biara fa wɔn adesua ho sɛ abibinnuro bɛtumi asa, anaa asi kokoram ano kwan".

Prevalence of use

Abibinnuro yɛ adeɛ a nnipa de sa yareɛ koankorɔ bi te sɛ kokoram, asikyire yareɛ, ntehyeewa ne sawa mu yareɛ. Aboadeɛ pii bi te sɛ mfeɛ, sɛ obi yɛ ɔbaa anaa barima, abusuakuo bi ne baabi a wɔfiri, nwomasua, ne diberɛ a obi  wɔ yɛ adeɛ a ɛma nnipa pii nom abibinnuro.

Burstein HJ, Gelber S, Guadagnoli E, Weeks JC (June 1999). "Use of alternative medicine by women with early-stage breast cancer". The New England Journal of Medicine. 340 (22): 1733–9. doi:10.1056/NEJM199906033402206. PMID 10352166.Beaeɛa menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Sasabrɔ
text:
Sasabrɔ yɛ tebea bi a ɛde koankorɔ, ne titire yaw bi a ɛba wo dwonku.Sasabrɔ  nkyerɛ baabi pɔtee a ɛnkɔ yie, na mmom ɛfa tebea ahodoɔ bɛyɛ ahanu a ɛbi ne arthritis ne "non-articular rheumatism" a wɔsane frɛ no "regional pain syndrome" anaasɛ "soft tissue rheumatism". Soft tissue disorder ne sasabrɔ wɔ nnoɔma bi a ɛsɛ. Ɛtɔ mmerɛ bi a wɔde  "Soft tissue rheumatic disorder" kyerɛ saa tebea yi mu. Wɔde edin "Sasabrɔ" di dwuma wɔ MeSH mu de kyerɛ "connective tissue disorder " Nkorabata a wayi asi hɔ de nhwehwɛmu ne sasabrɔ ayerasa ne "rheumatology".

Ahodoɔ 
Sasabrɔ a ɛyɛ koankorɔ, yaw pii(bi te sɛ wo dwonku, wo kɔn anaa wakyi) pii noa deɛ ɛdeba yɛ yareɛ a  yɛde san. Wɔ 20th century mu na yɛhunuu sɛ wɔn etiology no nni hɔ na ɛnyɛ adeɛ yɛtumi sa. Postinfectious arthritis a yɛsane frɛ no reactive arthritis ne sasabrɔ atiridii yɛ nhwɛsoɔ.  Wɔ United States, wakyekyɛ sasabrɔ a ɛnkɔ yie mu du a ɛgyina nomenclature ne nkyekyɛmu a American college of Rheumatology (ACR) kaeɛ wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe mmiɛnsa mu.

 Diffuse connective tissue diseases
 Rheumatoid arthritis
 Juvenile arthritis
 Systemic lupus erythematosus
 Sjögren syndrome
 Scleroderma
 Polymyositis
 Dermatomyositis
 Behçet's disease
 Relapsing polychondritis
 Arthritis associated with spondylitis (i.e. spondarthritis)
 Ankylosing spondylitis
 Reactive arthritis
 Psoriatic arthritis
 Osteoarthritis (i.e. osteoarthrosis, degenerative joint disease)
 Rheumatic syndromes associated with infectious agents (direct and indirect or reactive)
 Metabolic and endocrine diseases associated with rheumatic states
 Gout, pseudogout
 Neoplasms
 Neurovascular disorders
 Bone and cartilage disorders
 Extraarticular disorders
 Bursitis/Tendinitis wɔ n'abɛtire, wrist, biceps, nan, kotodwe (patella), ankle, adwumakuo ne Achilles tendon
 Capsulitis
 Miscellaneous disorders a ɛfa articular manifestations ho
 Palindromic rheumatism yɛ rheumatoid arthritis ahodoɔ bi.

Nhwehwɛmu 
Mmogya ne dwonsɔ bɛma yɛahunu baabi a creatinine ne uric acid no aduro na ama yɛahunu sɛ sawa no yɛ adwuma,sɛ ESR no ne CRP no bɛtumi ayɛ yie a. Sɛ wɔma no fa aduane a wahyɛ no sɛ wɔmfa no wie a, dwonsɔ foforɔ bɛma wahunu sɛ nnipadua no ma uric acid bebree anaasɛ nnipadua no mma uric acid. Rheumatoid agyinaeɛ bɛtumi ayɛ adwuma, ne titire wɔ ekuo bi a ɛbɛtumi de rheumatoloid arthritis aba. Wɔde paneɛ twe nsuo firi dwonku de hwɛ sɛ nsuo bi abobɔ wɔ hɔ a. Uric acid crystal a ɛwɔ nsuo no mu kyerɛ gout. Mpempii no wɔnnyɛ nhwehwɛmu biara, na nea wɔyɛ ara ne sɛ wɔyi tebea foforɔ firi hɔ ansana wanya nhwehwɛmu papa.

Ntotoeɛ 
Ayaresa a wɔde sasabrɔ nyarewa pii no ara yɛ analgesic bi te sɛ paracetamol ne non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs). Steroids, ne titire glucocorticoids ne analgesic a ano yɛ den na wɔde ma wɔn a wɔyareɛ no ano yɛ den.

Abakɔsɛm 
Edin Sasabrɔ firi late Latin rheumatismud, a ɛfiri Greekῥευματίζομαι a ɛkyerɛ sɛ "worebɔ afiri flux ho", a rheum no kyerɛ honam nsuo,sɛ mmogya and nsuo firi nnipadua no mu pii a. Ansana 17th century bɛba no, dwonku yaw a na wɔsusu sɛ viscuous humors na ɛde ba a ɛwuraa dwonku no mu a wɔfrɛ no gout, edin a wɔfa firii Middle English firi tete French kasa yiye mu"ko;gout, Sasabrɔ", na ɛnyɛ wonworam wɔ w'ani so fa ɛnɛ din a wɔde frɛ uric acid a ɛdɔɔso no. Borɔfo din a wɔde maa Sasabrɔ no wɔde dii dwuma kɔpem 17th century, a na wɔgyedi sɛ dwonku a ayɛ koankorɔ no nea ɛde ba yɛ rheum a ɛdɔɔso a ɛkyerɛ sɛ nnipadua no nsuo kɔ dwonku no mu.

Beaeɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Awofoɔ
text:
Ɔwofo yɛ obi a ɔhwɛ mma a wɔwɔ wɔn ankasa su mu. Wɔ nnipa mu no, ɔwofo ne abofra hwɛfo (baabi a "abofra" kyerɛ asefo, ɛnyɛ mfe a wadi ankasa). Ɔwofo a ɔwoo no ankasa yɛ obi a ne gamete no maa abofra, ɔbarima nam mmadwoa so, na ɔbea faa mmadwoa mu bae. Awofo a wɔwoo wɔn no yɛ abusuafo a wodi kan na wɔwɔ 50% awosu mu hyia. Ɔbea nso betumi afa awo ananmu abɛyɛ ɔwofo. Ebia awofo binom yɛ awofo a wogye wɔn mma, a wɔtete wɔn mma na wɔtete wɔn, nanso wɔne abofra no nni abusuabɔ wɔ awosu mu. Nnyisaa a wonni awofo a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma no, wɔn nananom anaa abusua no mufo afoforo betumi atete wɔn.

Ɛnyɛ mmara sɛ awofo bɛtɔn wɔn mma, de anya mfaso anaasɛ wɔrennya mfaso, anaasɛ wɔbɛtɔn wɔn a wɔmpɛ.

Wobetumi nso akyerɛkyerɛ ɔwofo bi mu kɔ akyiri sɛnea nana bi yii awo ntoatoaso biako fii hɔ no. Esiane nnansa yi aduruyɛ mu nkɔso nti, wobetumi anya awofo bɛboro baanu a wɔwoo wɔn.[1][2][3] Nhwɛso ahorow a ɛfa awofo a wɔwoo wɔn a wɔto so abiɛsa ho no bi ne nsɛm a ɛfa awo a wɔde wɔn si ananmu anaa onipa a ɔto so abiɛsa a ɔde DNA nhwɛsode ahorow ama wɔ awo ho nhyehyɛe a wɔboa ma ɛsakraa wɔn a wɔde ma no no awosu mu nneɛma ho.[4]

Awofo ahorow a wɔtaa nya ne ɛnanom, agyanom, mpenanom, ne nananom. Ɛna ne, "ɔbea a ɛfa abofra anaa mmofra a wawo wɔn ho."[5] Nanso, baabi a ɛyɛ nea ɛfata wɔ asetra mu sɛ ɔwofo de ne ho bɛhyɛ wɔn mma asetra mu no gu ahorow wɔ amammerɛ biara mu ɛtɔ mmere bi a wɔka sɛ nea ɛda ne ho mu kakraa bi adi no da mmofra anibiannaso adi,[6] bere a ɛtɔ mmere bi a wɔka sɛ nea ɛde ne ho hyɛ mu dodo no bɔ ne ho ban dodo, ɛyɛ cosseting, ɛyɛ hwene, anaasɛ ɛde ne ho hyɛ mu.[7]

Ahorow ahorow 
Abɔde a nkwa wom

obi awofo ankasa ne nnipa a onipa no nya n’awosu fi wɔn hɔ. Wɔtaa de asɛmfua no di dwuma sɛ ɛho hia sɛ wɔma nsonsonoe da ankorankoro bi awofo ne wɔn awofo a wɔwoo wɔn no ntam nkutoo a, Sɛ nhwɛso no, ankorankoro bi a ne papa asan aware no betumi afrɛ agya no yere foforo no wɔn mpena na wakɔ so akyerɛ wɔn maame sɛnea ɛte biara, ɛwom sɛ obi a a wɔne wɔn maame a wɔwoo wɔn no anya nkitahodi kakraa bi anaasɛ wonni bi koraa no betumi afrɛ wɔn ɔwofo a ɔtetee wɔn no sɛ wɔn maame, na wɔn maame a wɔwoo wɔn no sɛ saa, anaasɛ ebia wɔde ne din a edi kan afrɛ wɔn.[citation needed]

Maame

Ɛna yɛ ɔbea a ɔne ankorankoro foforo wɔ ɛna abusuabɔ, sɛ́ ɛyɛ nea efi nyinsɛn mu, denam awo a ɔwo, anaasɛ ɔtetee onipa no wɔ ɔwofo dwumadi mu.[8] Ebia mmea bɛboro biako ne ankorankoro bi benya abusuabɔ a ɛte saa. Esiane sɛ ɛna asetra, amammerɛ, ne nyamesom mu nkyerɛkyerɛmu ne ne dwumadi ahorow yɛ den na ɛsono emu biara nti, ɛyɛ den sɛ wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ ɛna mu ma ɛne nkyerɛase a wogye tom wɔ amansan nyinaa mu no ahyia. Ɛna a wɔde si ananmu a wɔde di dwuma no betumi ama wɔakyerɛkyerɛ mu sɛ ɛnanom baanu a wɔwoo wɔn wɔ hɔ.[9]

Agya

agya yɛ ɔwofo barima a ɔwɔ asefo biara.[10] Ebetumi ayɛ onipa a ɔde ne ho hyɛ abofra ntetee mu anaasɛ ɔde abɔde mu nneɛma, mmadwoa, a ɛma abofra no wo ba no ama.

Nanabea

Nananom yɛ obi ankasa awofo awofo, sɛ́ ɛyɛ agya anaa ɛna no. Abɔde biara a ɔwo wɔ nna mu a ɔnyɛ awosu mu chimera no wɔ awosu mu nananom anan, awosu mu nananom awotwe, awosu mu nananom dunum ne nea ɛkeka ho. Ɛntaa mma, te sɛ nea ɛfa anuanom anaa anuanom fa a wɔne wɔn ho da ho no, dodow yi sua.

Agyayɛ ho nsɛm 
Asɛm titiriw: DNA a wɔyɛ agyayɛ ho nhwehwɛmu

Wɔyɛ agyayɛ ho sɔhwɛ de kyerɛ sɛ ɔyɛ agyayɛ, kyerɛ sɛ, sɛ ebia ɔbarima bi ne onipa foforo agya a ɔwoo no anaa. Ebia eyi fata esiane hokwan ne nnwuma a agya no wɔ nti. Saa ara nso na wobetumi ayɛ awo ho nhwehwɛmu. Eyi ntaa mma, efisɛ anyɛ yiye koraa no, wɔ awo ne nyinsɛn mu, gye sɛ nyinsɛn a ɛfa nkwaboaa a wɔde kɔ baabi foforo anaasɛ wɔde nkesua ma ho no, ɛda adi sɛ onii ko a ɛna no yɛ. Nanso, wɔde di dwuma wɔ nsɛm dodow bi te sɛ mmara mu akodi a wɔkasa tia obi awo ho asɛm, baabi a ɛna no ntumi nsi pi esiane sɛ onhuu ne ba bere tenten nti, anaasɛ ɛho hia sɛ wohu nnipa a wɔawuwu no.

Ɛwom sɛ ɛnyɛ adanse a wotumi de ho to so koraa de, nanso awo mu su ahorow pii te sɛ aso a ɛbata ho, okunafo no anim a ɛpaapae, anaasɛ ne hwene a ɛpaapae no betumi ayɛ awofoyɛ (a ɛnyɛ) ho sɛnkyerɛnne a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ efisɛ wotumi hu no ntɛm ara na wonya denam awosu mu nkwaadɔm a ɛwɔ autosomal so no so.

Ɔkwan a wotumi de ho to so kɛse a wɔfa so hu awofoyɛ ne DNA nhwehwɛmu (a wonim no sɛ ankorankoro awosu mu nsateaa a wɔde kyerɛw, ɛwom sɛ akwan dedaw no de ABO mogya kuw ahorow a wɔde kyerɛw, protein ne enzyme afoforo ahorow mu nhwehwɛmu, anaasɛ nnipa leukocyte antigens a wɔde bedi dwuma no aka ho de. Mprempren akwan horow a wɔfa so yɛ agyayɛ ho nhwehwɛmu ne de polymerase chain reaction (PCR) ne restriction fragment length polymorphism (RFLP) di dwuma Nanso, fa kɛse no ara no, ɛkame ayɛ sɛ awosu mu nsateaa a wɔde kyerɛw nsɛm no agye sɔhwɛ ahorow afoforo no nyinaa.

Dwumadie ne asɛdeɛ 
Ahwɛfoɔ

Asɛm titiriw: Mmara kwan so ɔhwɛfo

Mmara kwan so ɔhwɛfoɔ yɛ obi a ɔwɔ mmara kwan so tumi (ne asɛdeɛ a ɛne no hyia) sɛ ɔhwɛ onipa foforɔ ankasa ne n’agyapadeɛ yiedie so, a wɔfrɛ no ward. Wɔtaa de ahwɛfo di dwuma wɔ tebea horow abiɛsa mu: ɔhwɛ a wɔde ma ɔpanyin a ontumi nyɛ hwee (esiane onyin anaa mmerɛwyɛ nti), ɔhwɛ a wɔde ma abofra ketewaa bi, ne ɔhwɛ a wɔde ma mpanyimfo a wɔadi dɛm wɔ nkɔso mu.

Aman ne aman dodow no ara wɔ mmara a ɛkyerɛ sɛ abofra kumaa awofo ne mmara kwan so ahwɛfo a wɔhwɛ saa abofra no so, na awofo no betumi akyerɛ wɔn a wɔbɛyɛ abofra no mmara kwan so hwɛfo sɛ owu a, sɛ asɛnnibea no pene so. Atemmu ahorow bi ma ɔwofo a ɔwɔ abofra bi kwan ma ɔde tumi a mmara kwan so hwɛfo wɔ no di dwuma a wɔmfa asɛnnibea nhyɛ mmara ase. Wɔ tebea horow a ɛtete saa mu no, wɔfrɛ ɔwofo a ɔyɛ ade wɔ saa dibea no mu no sɛ saa ɔwofo no ba no awosu mu hwɛfo.

Awofoyɛ

Asɛm titiriw: Awofoyɛ

Ɔwofoyɛ anaa abofra ntetee yɛ adeyɛ a ɛma abofra nipadua, nkate, asetra, sikasɛm, ne adwene mu nkɔso fi ne mmofraase kosi ne mpanyin afe so no nya nkɔso na ɛboa. Ɔwofoyɛ kyerɛ afa horow a ɛfa abofra a wɔtete no ho a wɔde awosu mu abusuabɔ no to nkyɛn.[11]

Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna afrafra 
Anyɛ yiye koraa no, abofra wɔ agya biako a ɔwoo no ne anyɛ yiye koraa no ɛna biako a ɔwoo no, nanso ɛnyɛ abusua biara na ɛyɛ atetesɛm mu nuklea abusua. Nneɛma pii wɔ hɔ a ɛsono emu biara, te sɛ mmofra a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma, awofo a wɔkyɛ, mmusua a wɔyɛ mpena, ne LGBT awofo, a akyinnyegye aba ho.

Asetra mu nyansahu nhoma ahorow no pow adwene a ɛne sɛ awofo a wɔyɛ mmarima ne mmea a wɔde wɔn ho afra a eye sen biara wɔ hɔ anaasɛ mmofra ne mmabun a wɔwɔ awofo a wɔne wɔn bɔbeasu koro no nya nkɔso mu ɔhaw biara bere a wɔde toto wɔn a wɔwɔ awofo baanu a wɔne wɔn bɔbeasu bɔbeasu ho no. Mprempren adwumayɛfo ne fekuw akɛse no gye tom sɛ adwene a wɔagye atom yiye na wogye tom wɔ adwuma no mu sɛ awofo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛka abom a eye sen biara nni hɔ.[14] Abusua adesua nhoma ahorow no kyerɛ sɛ ɛyɛ abusua nhyehyɛe ahorow (te sɛ awofoyɛ ne abusuabɔ pa a ɛwɔ abusua no mu) na ɛboa ma wohu mmofra yiyedi ne "nea ebefi mu aba," sen abusua nhyehyɛe ahorow, ankasa, te sɛ dodow, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna , nna ne awofo a wɔbom tra tebea.[13]

title: Asensene
text:
Asensene yɛ tebea bi a obi kɔ mu a ɛma nnipadua no moa anaa yɛ ketewa na ɛdwodwo a ɛma nnipadua no wosowoso. Ɛnam sɛ epileptic seizures ka nsensene ho nti, edin nsensene yɛ adeɛ a ɛtɔ da a wɔde ma seizure. Nsensene ne  anyinam ahoɔden a ɛma obi bɔpiti sisi so ne improper enriched Air scuba diving.  Non-epileptic nsensene ne ɛtwerɛ nni twaka biara, na deɛ ɛdeba yɛ non-epileptic seizure. Nsensene yɛ edin bi kɛkɛ a yɛde ma honam a ɛmoamoa a yɛntumi nsi ano kwan. Wɔde nsensene sesa "seizure" berɛ biara. Seizure bɛtumi ama obi anya nsensene, nanso ɛnyɛ saa na ɛteɛ. Nsensene yɛ seizure su bi a ɛma adwene no nni dwuma yie. Mpempii no wɔnhunu nea ɛde nsensene ba.Yareɛ bɛtumi de nsensene aba, aduro bi ho nsunsuansoɔ anaasɛ tebea a obi kɔ mu sɛ ɔyare a. Ɛtɔ mmerɛ bi a wɔde edin ahoɔden gyina hɔ nsensene anaa epileptic seizure.

Nsɛnkyerɛnne 
Sɛ obi wɔ nsensene a, ɔtumi nya nsɛnkyerɛnne ahodoɔ pii. Ebi ne a brief blackout, adwene ntanta, drooling, ɔntumi ngya ne nan, ne honam wosowoso, ɔntumi nhyɛ muscles spasms so, home twa mmerɛ tiawa bi ne nea ɛkeka ho. Yɛwɔ nsɛnkyerɛnne kakra bi a ɛno ba mmerɛ tiawa bi firi pere dekɔ sima, ɛwɔm sɛ ɛbɛtumi akyɛ deɛ. Nsensene a ɛba mmɔfra so ntɛntɛm no wɔ yɔbea no sesa.

Nea ɛde ba 
Yɛwɔ tebea pii a ɛbɛtumi ayɛ ne ho sɛ nsensene.

Yɛwɔ nnoɔma kakra bi a ɛbɛtumi ayɛ nea ntira a nsensene ba a ebi ne, epileptic seizure,febrile seizures, non-epileptic seizures, paroxysmal kinesigenic dyskinesia,  ne aduro bi nsunsuansoɔ. Epileptic seizure ahodoɔ pii ɛsan nnipa bɛyɛ ɔpepem aduosia wɔ wiase afanaa nyinaa.

Epileptic seizures.

Ɛtwerɛ yɛ neuronal disorder a ɛwɔ nnoɔma pii a ɛde ba. Ɛyɛ yareɛ bi a ɛntumi nsan obi na ɛtumi toa obi mpofirm. Seizure a ɛtumi toa obi mpofirm no yɛ adeɛ a ɛma adwene no anaa nnipadua no nyinaa sɛe. Epileptic bɛtumi asɛe adwene no akwaa pii. Epileptic seizure bɛtumi anya ɛsu foforɔ. Nsunsuansoɔ a ɛwɔ Epileptic seizure wɔ cerebral blood flow(CBF) no bɛtumi akyɛ.

Paroxysmal kinesigenic dyskinesia

Yɛwɔ ɛkwan a ɛda infantile nsensene ne Paroxysmal dyskinesia mu. Paroxysmal kinesigenic dyskinesia (PKD), nea ɛde ba yɛ sɛ obi ntumi ntu ne nan ɛna ɔbrɛ anaa anigyeɛ bi nti. Twaka a ɛda nsensene ne PKD ntam no yɛ pathophysiology nnoɔma bi.

Ntotoiɛ 
Sɛ febrile nsensene ba mmɔfra so a,  ɛho bɛba sɛ wɔbɛsa nea ɛde atiridii no baeɛ. Yɛwɔ ayaresa a yɛdikan de ma obi ahoɔden pii, a obi bɛtumi ayɛ de aboa ɔyarefoɔ bi a ɔwɔ nsensene.
