title: Dwamena Bekoe
text:
Dwamena Bekoe yɛ Ghanani amanyɔni a ɔsomm sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani maa  Asuogyaman ababtoɔ mapasua a ɛwɔ Atɔeɛ mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

N'abrabɔ, ne sukuukorɔ ne n'amanyɔsɛm 
Bekoe ka mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa wɔ Repɔblik a ɛtɔ so nan wɔ Ghana no ho. Wɔtoo aba maa no sɛ mmarahyɛ badwani wɔ mfeɛ mpenu ɔman abatoɔ no mu sɛ Kyiniiɛ Amanyɔkuo no ananmusini berɔ a ɔnyaa abatoɔ no mu mpem dunan, ahankron ne num. Mfeɛ mpenu ne nan mu no, ɔdii ntwo maa  Kofi Osei-Ameyaw a na ɔgyina Ɔsono Amanyɔkuo no anan mu no dii ne so nkunim.

N'adwumasɛm 
Owura Bekoe ne adwumakuo a wɔfrɛ wɔn Dwabeks Enterprise Limited no daanodini.

Abatoɔ ahodoɔ 
Bekoe ka mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa wɔ Repɔblik a ɛtɔ so nan wɔ Ghana no ho. N'adwuma sɛ amanyɔni no hyɛɛ aseɛ wɔ mfeɛ mpenu ɔman ababtoɔ no mu berɛ a ɔgyinaa sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ Asuogyaman ababtoɔ mapasua a ɛwɔ Atɔeɛ mantam mu wɔ Ghana maa Kyiniiɛ Amanyɔkuo no dii nkunim wɔ abatoɔ no mu. Ɔnyaa abatoɔ no mu mpem dunan, ahankron ne num a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyɛmu aduonum-mmienu akyiripɔ aduokron. Amanyɔfoɔ a na ɔne wɔn repere saa akonnwa no ne  Dr. Godfried Kofi-Siaw a ɔgyinaa hɔ maa New Patriotic Party, Ɔsono Amanyɔkuo no, Joseph Emmanuel Addi a ɔgyinaa hɔ maa National Reform Party, ne David Dosoo a ɔno nso gyinaa hɔ maa People's National Convention. Mma wɔn nyinaa nyaa no sɛdeɛ wɔahyehyɛ edin no ne mpem dumienu, ahanum ne aduoson nkron a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyɛmu aduanan-nan akyiripɔ aduoson, ahanan aduonu-nsia a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyɛmu baako akyiripɔ aduonum ne ahanu aduonum-mmiɛnsa a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyɛmu ɔha mu nkyɛmu hwee akyiripɔ aduokron wɔ mma dodoɔ a wɔtoeɛ no nyinaa mu. Ekuo bi a wɔfrɛ wɔn Functional Executive Committee (FEC) a ɛhyɛ National Democratic Congress, Kyiniiɛ Amanyɔkuo no mu no de wɔn nsa hyɛɛ aseɛ gyee Owura Dwamena Bekoe too mu sɛ anka ɔnsan nnyina wɔn anan mu wɔ mfeɛ mpenu ne nan abatoɔ no mu sɛ Asuogyaman ababtoɔ mapasua no mmarahyɛbadwani nanso berɛ a ɔsane gyinaa bio no, ɔdii ntwo maa Kofi Osei-Ameyaw a na ɔgyina New Patriotic Party, Ɔsono Amanyɔkuo no dii ne so nkunim.

Baabi menyaa mmoa

title: Felix Owusu-Adjapong
text:
Felix Owusu-Adjapong yɛ Ghanani amanyɔni a wɔwoo no Ɔgyefuo 13, afe apem ahankron aduanan-nan no mu. Ɔdii dwuma sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani maa New patriotic party, Ɔsono Amanyɔkuo no wɔ  Akyem Swedru  abatoɔ mpasua a ɛwɔ Atɔeɛ mantam no mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔsane dii dwuma sɛ ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ ahoɔden mu nsɛm so. Bio nso, na ɔyɛ daanodini New patriotic party, Ɔsono Amanyɔkuo no.

N'abrabɔ ne ne sukuukorɔ 
Felix Owusu-Adjapong suaa Land Economy wɔ Kwame Nkrumah suapɔn a ɛwɔ Kumase no mu. Ɔsane gyee nteteɛ wɔ Adansie ne adansɛm mu wɔ Bouwcentrum Institute a ɛwɔ Rotterdam, ɛnna ɔsan suaa Urban Land Appraisal wɔ University of Reading a ɛwɔ England no mu. Afei, ɔsane kɔsuaa mmara wɔ Ghana School of Law mu.

N'adwuma sɛ amanyɔni 
Owusu-Adjapong somm sɛ mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so mmienu, mmiɛnsa ne nan no muni wɔ Ghana Repɔblik a ɛtɔ so nan no mu. Ɔno ne mmarahyɛbadwani a wɔdii kan too aba maa no wɔ Akyem Swedru abatoɔ mpasua no mu wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron-nsia ɔman abatoɔ no mu.  Ɔnyaa mma a wɔtoeɛ no nyinaa mu mpem num, ahanwɔtwe ne aduonu-nan a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyɛmu aduanan-num akyiripɔ aduasa wɔ saa afe abatoɔ no mu. Wɔsane too aba maa no sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ mfeɛ mpenu ɔman abatoɔ no mu berɛ a ɔnyaa mma mpem dunan, ahansia ne dunan a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyɛmu aduonum-nsia akyiripɔ aduowɔtwe.

Ɔgyefuo bosome no mu wɔ mfeɛ mpenu ne baako mu no, wɔyii no sɛ ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Akwantuo ne Nkitahodie so, ɛnna Oforisuo bosome no mu wɔ mfeɛ  mpenu ne mmiɛnsa mu nso, wɔyii no sɛ Ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ mmarahyɛbadwa ho nsɛm so. 

Mfeɛ mpenu ne nan ɔman abatoɔ no mu nso, wɔtoo aba yii no sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani berɛ a ɔnyaa mma no mu mpem aduonu-baako ne aduanan-nwɔtwe a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyɛmu aduosia-nsia akyiripɔ aduokron-nan wɔ saa abatoɔ no mu. Mfeɛ mpenu ne nson mu hɔ no, ɔde n'adwuma sɛ ɔsoafoɔ no too hɔ kɔperee ɔmampanin dibea wɔ New patriotic party, Ɔsono Amanyɔkuo no mu nanso anyɛ yie. Wantumi annyina sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ mfeɛ mpenu ne nwɔtwe abatoɔ nu mu bio maa  Joseph Ampomah Bosompem gyinaa n'anan mu dii nkunim maa New patriotic party, Ɔsono Amanyɔkuo no berɛ a ɔnyaa abatoɔ no mu mpen nwɔtwe, ahanan aduosia-nkron. Ayɛwohomumɔ bosome no mu wɔ mfeɛ mpenu ne nwɔtwe mu no, wɔyii no sɛ ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ ahoɔden mu nsɛm so,  Ɔdii saa dwuma yi ara kɔsii sɛ kuffour aban no baa awieeɛ wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome no mu wɔ mfeɛ mpenu ne nwɔtwe mu.

Baabi a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Francis Osafo-Mensah
text:
Francis Osafo-Mensah yɛ Ghanani amanyɔni a na ɔyɛ mmarahybadwani ma Mpraeso abatoɔ mpasua a ɛwɔ Atɔeɛ mantam mu wɔ Ghana no. Ɔsane somm sɛ ɔsoafoɔ maa saa mantam korɔ no ara na na ɔka mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nan no ho wɔ Ghana Repɔblik a ɛtɔ so nan no mu.

N'abrabɔ ne ne sukuukorɔ 
Wɔwoo no afe apem ahankron ne aduasa-nsia too abusua bi a wɔagye din pa ara mu wɔ Atɔeɛ mantam mu. Ɔgyee ne suapɔn abodin a ɛdi kan firii  Durham University a ɛwɔ United Kingdom no mu. Adeɛ a ɛdii n'adesua no mu atintimman ne sɛ, ɔsuaa nnuroyɛ ne ayaresa ho adeɛ pa ara.

N'adwumasɛm 
Osafo-Mensah adwuma ne sɛ ɔyɛ dɔkotani a ɔpaepae nnipa mu sa wɔn yareɛ. Ɔsane yɛ dɔkotani a wakwadare wɔ nnuroyɛ mu.

N'abrabɔ sɛ amanyɔni 
Mensah abrabɔ sɛ amanyɔni no hyɛɛ aseɛ wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron-nsia no mu berɛ a ɔgyinaa  New Patriotic Party, ɔsono amanyɔkuo no anan mu sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ  Mpraeso mpasua no mu. Ɔdii nkunim wɔ abatoɔ no mu berɛ a ɔnyaa mma a wɔtoeɛ no nyinaa mu mpem dunan, ahankron ne nsia a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyɛmu aduanan baako wɔ mma dodoɔ a wɔtoo no afe no mu nyinaa mu. Ɔsane tenaa adwa no so wɔ mfeɛ mpenu abatoɔ no mu berɛ a ɔnyaa mma wɔtoeɛ no mu mpem dumiɛnsa ne aduowɔtwe. Na nnipa ɔne wɔn repere saa adwa no firi amanyɔkuo a ɛdidi soɔ yinom mu;  National Democratic Congress (NDC), People's National Convention (PNC), National Reform Party (NRP) ne United Ghana Movement (UGM).

Nnipa a wɔgyinaa mu maa saa amanyɔkuo yinom ne Mike K.S. Akyeampong, Asiamah Godfried Nyarko,Kwabena Adjei ne Aninakwa Samuel Kyeramanteng (Wɔahyehyɛ edin no sɛdeɛ wɔahyehyɛ amanyɔkuo no). NDC nyaa aba a wɔtoeɛ no nyinaa mu mpem du, ahasa ne dunwɔtwe a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyɛmu aduanan-mmienu akyiripɔ aduokron. PNC nyaa aba no mu ahanu aduosia-num a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyɛmu baako akyiripɔ du, NRP nyaa ɛmu ahanu aduosia-baako a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyɛmu baako akyiripɔ du, ɛnna UGM nso nyaa aba no mu ɔha ne dumiɛnsa a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyɛmu hwee akyiripɔ aduonum. Mensa sane dii akonnwa no ne mprɛnsa so wɔ mfeɛ mpenu ne nan ɔman abatoɔ no mu berɛ ɔgyinaa New Patriotic party, Ɔsono Amanyɔkuo no anan mu nyaa mmaa dodoɔ a wɔtoe no mu ɔha mu nkyɛmu aduosia-nson akyiripɔ nan. N'adwuma sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani no baa awieeɛ wɔ mfeɛ mpenu ne nkron no mu.

N'abrabɔ 
Francis Osafo-Mensah yɛ Kristoni.

Wobɛtumi nso asane ahwɛ 

 New Patriotic Party mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ.
 Mpraeso abatoɔ mpasua no mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ

Baabi a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Godfred Kwame Otsere
text:
Godfred Kwame Otsere yɛ Ghanani a ɔyɛ amanyɔsɛm. Ɔsomm sɛ mmarahybadwani maa  Ayensuano abatoɔ mpasua a ɛwɔ Atɔeɛ mantam mu wɔ Ghana no wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa ne nan no mu wɔ Ghana Repɔblik a ɛtɔ so nan no mu.

N'adwumasɛm 
Ɔyɛ Ghanani amanyɔni.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Na ɔka  New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuo no ho. Wɔtoo aba maa no sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ Ayensuano abatoɔ mpasua no mu berɛ a wɔtoo mfeɛ mpenu ne mfeɛ mpenu ne nan ɔman abatoɔ no. Ɔdii Evans Kodjo Ahorsey a na ɔgyina mu ma National Democratic Congress amanyɔkuo no anan mu no so nkunim kɔsomm sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani maa abatoɔ mpasua no wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa wɔ Repɔblik a ɛtɔ so nan no mu. Ne som no hyɛɛ aseɛ firii Ɔpɛpɔn da a ɛtɔ so nso, mfeɛ mpenu ne baako kɔsii Ɔpɛpɔn da a ɛtɔ so nsia, mfeɛ mpenu ne num no mu. Ɔsane tenaa adwa no so berɛ a ɔdii nkunim wɔ mfeɛ mpenu ne nan ɔman abatoɔ no mu. Mfeɛ mpenu ne nwɔtwe abatoɔ no mu no, ɔdii ntwo maa Samuel Ayeh-Paye a ɔno nso firi New Patriotic Party mu no dii ne so nkunim.

Mfeɛ mpenu abatoɔ 
Mfeɛ mpenu ɔman abatoɔ mu no, Otsere dii nkunim sɛ mmarahybadwani maa  Ayensuano abatoɔ mpasua a ɛwɔ Atɔeɛ mantam mu wɔ Ghana no. Na ɔgyina New Patriotic Party, Ɔsono Amanyɔkuo no anan mu. N'akonnwa no ka nkonnwa dunwɔtwe a New Patriotic Party dii so nkunim wɔ nkonnwa aduonu-nsia a na wɔrepere wɔ Atɔeɛ mantam mu wɔ saa abatoɔ no mu ho. Yɛka nkonnwa a New Patriotic Party no nyaeɛ nyinaa bɔm a, wɔnyaa nkonnwa ahanu no mu aduokron-nkron wɔ saa abatoɔ no mu. Otsere nyaa mma no mu mpem dumienu, ahansia ne dunwɔtwe. Yei kyerɛ sɛ, ɔnyaa aba dodoɔ a wɔtoo saa berɛ no mu ɔha mu nkyɛmu aduonum baako akyiripɔ aduanan. Nnipa ɔdii wɔn so nkunim no ne Evans Kodjo Ahorsey a na ɔgyina hɔ ma National Democratic Congress amanyɔkuo no, Samuel Nartey a na ɔgyina hɔ ma Convention People's Party ne Evans Oheneaku Asamaning a na ɔgyina hɔ ma United Ghana Movement amanyɔkuo no. Evans Kodjo Ahorsey nyaa mma no mu mpem du ne ahanu a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyɛmu aduanan-baako akyiripɔ aduonum, Samuel Nartey nso nyaa apem ne aduokron-nsia a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyɛmu nan akyiripɔ aduonum, ɛnna Evans Oheneaku Asamaning nyaa mma ahansia aduonum-nson a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyɛmu mmienu akyiripɔ aduoson.

Mfeɛ mpenu ne nan ɔman abatoɔ 
Berɛ a wɔtoo aba wɔ New Patriotic Party, Ɔsono Amanyɔkuo no mu no, Owura Otsere dii nkunim kɔgyinaa sɛ Suhum-Kraboa-Coaltar abatoɔ mpasua no mu mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ mantam no mu. na ɛno ne ne mprɛnsa so a wapere saa adwa no. Abatoɔ no baa awieeɛ no, ɔnyaa mma dodoɔ mpem aduasa-baako ne aduokron a wɔtoeɛ no mu mpem dunson, ahansia ne ahasa nsia a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyɛmu aduonum-nsia akyiripɔ aduoson. Ɔdii  Francis Asare a na ɔgyina National Democratic Congress amanyɔkuo no anan mu no ne Samuel Andrews Donkor a na ɔgyina Convention People's Party anan mu no so nkunim. Mma dodoɔ a wɔtoeɛ no nyinaa mu no, Francis Asare nyaa mma mpem dumienu, ahansia ne aduowɔtwe-mmiɛnsa a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyɛmu aduanan akyiripɔ nwɔtwe ɛnna Samuel Andrews Donkor nso nyaa mma no mu ahanson aduoson-baako a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyɛmu mmienu akyiripɔ num. Ne mpasua no ka mpasua aduonu-mmienu a New Patriotic Party dii so nkunim wɔ Atɔeɛ mantam mu wɔ saa abatoɔ no mu ho. Yɛka ne nyinaa bɔ mu a, New Patriotic Party, Ɔsono Amanyɔkuo no nyaa mmarahyɛbadwa nkonnwa ɔha aduonu-nwɔtwe wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nan no mu wɔ Ghana Repɔblik a ɛtɔ so nan no mu.

Baabi a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Kinston Akomeng Kissi
text:
Kinston Akomeng Kissi yɛ Ghanani a wɔwoo no Kitawonsa da a ɛtɔ so nan, afe apem, ahankron ne aduonun nson. Ɔyɛ Ghanani amanyɔni a na ɔka mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa wɔ Ghana Repɔblik a ɛtɔ so nan no ho a na ɔgyina hɔ sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma Akwatia abatoɔ mapsua a ɛwɔ Ghana Atɔeɛ mantam mu no.

Ne mfiaseɛ abrabɔ ne ne sukuukorɔ 
Wɔwoo Kissi Kitawonsa da a ɛtɔ so nan, afe apem, ahankron ne aduonun nson wɔ Akwatia a ɛwɔ Ghana mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔtoo aba maa Kissi sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ New Patriotic Party, Ɔsono Amanyɔkuo no din mu wɔ mfeɛ mpenu Ghanaman abatoɔ no mu. Ɔne amanyɔfoɔ binom na wɔperee adwa no nanso ɔno na ɔmanfoɔ yii no sɛ wɔn mmarahyɛbadwani. Baba Jamal Mohammed Ahmed a na ɔgyina National Democratic Congress amanyɔkuo no anan mu no nyaa mma a wɔtoeɛ no mu mpem dumienu, ne aduosia-nkron a na ɛyɛ ɔha mu nkyɛmu aduanan-mmienu akyiri pɔ aduowɔtwe. Mary Adwoa Buabeng a ɔno nso gyinaa sɛ kɔntenkorɔ no na ɔtoo so mmiɛnsa a ɔnyaa mma no mu apem, ahanun ne aduonu-nan a na ɛyɛ ɔha mu nkyɛmu num akyiri pɔ aduanan. Christian Addo a na ɔgyina National Reform Party anan mu no nyaa mma no mu ahasa aduokron-nson. Samuel Adjei a na ɔno nso gyina Convention People's Party anan mu no nyaa mma ahanu ne aduoson-mmienu a na ɛyɛ ɔha mu nkyɛmu baako. Kwame Kwarkoh Dickson a na ɔgyina People's National Convention amanyɔkuo no anan mu no nso nyaa mma ɔha aduosia-mmienu a ɛyɛ ɔha mu nkyɛmu hwee akyiri pɔ aduosia.  Kissi mma mpem aduonu-nwɔtwe, ahanu ne aduonu-mmienu a wɔtoeɛ no mu mpem dumiɛnsa, ahanwɔtwe ne num a ɛyɛ ɔha mu nkyɛmu aduanan-nwɔtwe akyiri pɔ aduokron. Mfeɛ mpenu ne nan abatoɔ no mu no, ɔnyaa mma mpem aduasa -nson, ɔha aduasa-num  a wɔtoeɛ no mu mpem dunkron, ahasa aduowɔtwe-nsia a ɛyɛ ɔha mu nkyɛmu aduonun-mmienu akyiri pɔ aduonu.

N'adwumasɛm 
Kissi yɛ okuani ɛnna ɔsan yɛ mmarahyɛbadwani dada ma Akwatia abatoɔ mapsua a ɛwɔ Ghana Atɔeɛ mantam mu no. Ɔsane nso yɛ odwadini. Afei nso, na ɔyɛ daanodini ma adwumakuo bi a wɔfrɛ no Precious Minerals Marketing Company (PMMC) wɔ Ghana.

N'abrabɔ 
Kissi yɛ Kristoni.

Baabi a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Michael Teye Nyuanu
text:
Wɔwoo Michael Teye Nyuanu Ayɛwohomumɔ da a ɛtɔ so dumiɛnsa, afe apem ahankron aduonum-num mu. Ɔyɛ Ghanani amanyɔni a na ɔka mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so mmienu, mmiɛnsa ne nan no ho wɔ Repɔblik a ɛtɔ so nan wɔ Ghana no ho. Ɔsomm sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani wɔ Lower Manya abatoɔ mpasua a ɛwɔ Atɔeɛ mantam mu no mu. Edin a na nkurɔfoɔ sane de nim no ne MTN.

N'abrabɔ 
Nyuanu Teye yɛ ɔwarefoɔ a wawo mma nan. Ɔyɛ Kristoni mapa a ɔkɔ asɔre a wɔfrɛ no Baptist.

Ne mfiaseɛ abrabɔ ne ne sukuukorɔ 
Wɔwoo Michael Teye Nyuanu Ayɛwohomumɔ da a ɛtɔ so dumiɛnsa, afe apem ahankron aduonum-num mu wɔ Ghana Atɔeɛ mantam mu kuro bi a wɔfrɛ no Manya Kpogunor so. 

Ɔkɔɔ suapɔn a wɔfrɛ no Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration (GIMPA) kɔgyee nteteɛ nyaa abodin a wɔfrɛ no Business Administration wɔ mfeɛ mpenu ne baako mu. Afei, ɔsane toaa n'adesua so suaa deɛ wɔfrɛ no Executive Masters in Governance and Leadership  wɔ GIMPA suapɔn no ara mu.

N'adwumasɛm 
N'adwuma a ɔhyɛɛ da suaeɛ pa ara ne Account Officer. Bio, ɔsane wɔ ahyɛn ahodoɔ a wɔyɛ adwuma ma no. Afei nso, na ɔyɛ ɔkasafoɔ abɛdiakyire ma ECOWAS mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ no.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔtoo aba maa no sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ afe apem, ahankron aduokron-nsia mu berɛ a ɔnyaa mma mpem aduasa, ahankron aduosia-mmiɛnsa a wɔtoeɛ no mu mpem aduonu-nan, ahanson aduosia-mmiɛnsa a ɛyɛ ɔha mu nkyɛmu aduonum-nkron akyiri pɔ aduonum. Nnipa a ɔdii wɔn so nkunim no ne Kodjiku Lawerence Kpabitey a na ɔyɛ NPP amanyɔkuo no ananmusini, Robert Kwesi Nartey a na ɔyɛ PNC amanyɔkuo no ananmusini, Samuel Terlabie a na ɔyɛ CPP amanyɔkuo no ananmusini ne John Tetteh Akuerter a na ɔyɛ EGLE amanyɔkuo no ananmusini no. Abatoɔ no baa awieeɛ no, na Kodjiku Lawerence Kpabitey anya mma dodoɔ a wɔtoeɛ no mu mpem num, ahanson ne dunwɔtwe. Robert Kwesi Nartey nso nyaa mma no mu ahanan ne aduowɔtwe-mmienu. Nnipa baanu a wɔka wɔn ho no deɛ, obiara antumi anya aba biara. 

Nyaunu Teye gyinaa National Democratic Congress amanyɔkuo no anan mu. Ɔtumi boroo onipa a na ɔbɛn no pa ara no so mma mpem nan, ahansia ne aduokron-nson bɛyɛɛ mmarahyɛbadwani. Ɔdii nkunim ɛfiri sɛ, ɔnyaa mma no mu ɔha mu nkyɛ mu aduonum-mmiɛnsa. Ɔne nnipa nan a wɔfiri amanyɔkuo a ɛdidi soɔ yi mu na wɔperee adwa no, New Patriotic Party (NPP), Convention People's Party (CPP), National Reform Party (NRP), ne People's National Convention (PNC).  Henry Derma Narh a na ɔgyina NPP amanyɔkuo no anan mu no nyaa mma no mu mpem nkron, ahanu aduokron-baako. Owura Accam nso a na ɔgyina CPP amanyɔkuo no anan mu no tɔɔ so mmiɛnsa berɛ a ɔnyaa no mu apem, ahansia no. Afei, Thomas Narh Batsa a na ɔgyina NRP amanyɔkuo no anan mu no nyaa mma no mu apem ne aduosia mmienu ɛnna Robert Nartey a na ɔgyina PNC amanyɔkuo no anan mu no nyaa mma no mu ahasa aduosia-baako. Henry Derma Narh nyaa ɔha mu nkyɛmu aduasa-num akyiri pɔ aduonum. Owura Accam nso nyaa ɔha mu nkyɛmu nsia akyiri pɔ du. Afei, Thomas Narh Batsa nyaa ɔha mu nkyɛmu nan akyiri pɔ du, ɛnna Robert Nartey nyaa ɔha mu nkyɛmu baako akyiri pɔ aduanan. Na ɔnsane nso ka mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ Repɔblik a ɛtɔ so nan wɔ Ghana no ho wɔ afe apem, ahankron aduokron-nson no mu.

Mfeɛ mpenu ne nan abatoɔ no mu no, ɔnyaa mma mpem aduasa-num, ahanu aduanan-nwɔtwe a wɔtoeɛ no mu mpem dunwɔtwe, ahanum aduoson-baako a ɛyɛ ɔha mu nkyɛmu aduonum-mmienu akyiri pɔ aduoson. Nnipa a na ɔne wɔn repere a ɔdii wɔn so nkunim no ne Owurayere Difie Agyarko Kusi a a na ɔgyina NPP amanyɔkuo no anan mu no, Anim Amartey Francis Cecil a na ɔgyina IND amanyɔkuo no anan mu no, Emmanuel Kwame Adjei Okrah a na ɔgyina CPP amanyɔkuo no anan mu no, Robert Nartey Kwesi a na ɔgyina PNC amanyɔkuo no anan mu no ne Cecilia Kosi Akuerter a na ɔgyina EGLE amanyɔkuo no anan mu no. Owurayere Difie Agyarko Kusi nyaa mma no mu mpem dunum, ahanu aduonu-nwɔtwe. Anim Amartey Francis Cecil nyaa mma no mu ahanson ne nan. Emmanuel Kwame Adjei Okrah nso nyaa mma ahanu aduowɔtwe-nsia. Afei, Robert Nartey Kwesi nyaa mma ahanu aduasa nwɔtwe, ɛnna Cecilia Kosi Akuerter  nso nyaa mma ahanu aduo-baako.

Bio nso, na ɔka nnipakuo a wɔbɔ ɔmampanin abɛdiakyire ho dawuro no ho. NDC amanyɔkuo no twee n'adwuma no sɛneeɛ berɛ a ɔne nnipa baasa bi a wɔfiri amanyɔkuo no mu kɔdii aniammɔhosɛm bi wɔ Lower Manya Krobo abatoɔ mpasua no mu. Afei, ɔbɛgyinaa sɛ kɔntɛnkorɔ wɔ mfeɛ mpenu ne dumienu abatoɔ no mu peree sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani berɛ ɔyii ne ho firii NDC amanyɔkuo no mu no.

Baabi a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Ofosu Asamoah
text:
Wɔwoo Ofosu Asamoah Obubuo da a ɛtɔ so aduonu-num, afe apem ahankron aduosia-nkron no mu. Na ɔyɛ mmaranimni sane yɛ mmarahyɛbadwani a na ɔgyina Kade abatoɔ mpasua a ɛwɔ Ghana Atɔeɛ mantam mu no anan mu.

N'abrabɔ mfitiaseɛ ne ne sukuukorɔ 
Wɔwoo Ofosu Asamoah Obubuo da a ɛtɔ so aduonu-num, afe apem ahankron aduosia-nkron no mu. Ɔfiri Kade, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Atɔeɛ mantam mu no anan mu. Ɔgyee n'abodin a ɛdi kan Bachelor of Arts wɔ Mmara ne Amanyɔsɛm mu firii University of Ghana suapɔn mu wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron-nan mu. Ɔwieeɛ no, ɔsane toaa so kɔsuaa adeɛ wɔ Ghana School of Law suapɔn no mu sane gyee abodin Bachelor of Law wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron-nson mu.

N'amanyɔsɛm 
Ofosu yɛ  New Patriotic Party, Ɔsono amanyɔkuo no mu ni. Na ɔka baasonkuo a wɔhyɛ amammara ho ntotoeɛ, mmara ne mmarahyɛbadwa ho nsɛm so no ho. Ɔbɛkaa mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so num no ho wɔ Ghana Repɔblik a ɛtɔ so nan no mu berɛ a ɔmanfoɔ sane too aba maa no wɔ mfeɛ mpenu ne nwɔtwe ɔman abatoɔ no mu sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ Kade abatoɔ mpasua a ɛwɔ Ghana Atɔeɛ mantam mu no. Ɔtenaa adwa so sɛ mmarahybadwani mpɛn nan firii Ɔpɛpɔn mu wɔ mfeɛ mpenu ne baako mu kɔsii Ɔpɛpɔn mu wɔ mfeɛ mpenu ne dunson no mu.

Abatoɔ ahodoɔ 
Mfeɛ mpenu no mu no, Asamoah dii nkunim sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ Kade abatoɔ mpasua a ɛwɔ Ghana Atɔeɛ mantam mu no. Ɔgyinaa mu maa New Patriotic Party, Ɔsono amanyɔkuo no. Ne mpasua no ka mmarahyɛbadwa nkonnwa dunwɔtwe a New Patriotic Party, Ɔsono amanyɔkuo no nyaa wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa nkonnwa aduonu-nsia no nyinaa mu no ho wɔ saa afe abatoɔ no mu wɔ Atɔeɛ mantam mu. New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuo no nyaa mmarahyɛbadwa nkonnwa a na ne nyinaa dodoɔ ahanu no mu aduokron-nkron wɔ saa abatoɔ no mu. Asamoah nyaa mma a wɔtoeɛ no mu mpem aduonu, ahasa ne dumiɛnsa a na ɛyɛ ɔha mu nkyɛmu aduosia-mmienu akyiri pɔ aduonu. Nnipa a ɔdii wɔn so nkunim no ne  Faustina Koranteng Addo a na ɔgyina National Democratic Congress amanyɔkuo no anan mu, George Ankomah Yeboah a na ɔgyina Convention People’s Party amanyɔkuo no anan mu, Appiah-Twum Barimah a na ɔgyina People's National Convention amanyɔkuo no anan mu ne Ohene Antwi Tutu a na ɔgyina National Reformed Party amanyɔkuo no anan mu. Abatoɔ no baa awieeɛ no, Faustina Koranteng Addo nyaa mma no mu mpem dubaako, ahasa aduosia-nkron a na ɛyɛ ɔha mu nkyɛmu aduasa akyiri pɔ aduowɔtwe, George Ankomah Yeboah nyaa mma ahanum aduowɔtwe-nwɔtwe a ɛyɛ ɔha mu nkyɛmu baako akyiri pɔ aduowɔtwe, Appiah-Twum Barimah nyaa mma ahanu aduasa-nwɔtwe a ɛyɛ ɔha mu nkyɛmu hwee akyiri pɔ aduoson ɛnna Ohene Antwi Tutu nyaa mma ɔha aduoson-nsia a ɛyɛ ɔha mu nkyɛmu hwee akiyiri pɔ aduonum.

N'adwumasɛm 
Ofosu yɛ mmaranimfoɔ. Na ɔka Kimberly Chambers ho. Ɔbɛyɛɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ Ghana wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn, mfeɛ mpenu ne baako mu.

N'abrabɔ 
Ofosu yɛ ɔbarima warefoɔ a ɔkura mmɔfra nan. Ɔyɛ Kristoni a ɔkɔ Presby asɔre.

Baabi a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Peter Kwaw
text:
Peter Kwaw yɛ Ghanani a ɔyɛ amanyɔsɛm. Ɔsomm sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani maa  Lower West Akim abatoɔ mpasua a ɛwɔ Atɔeɛ mantam mu wɔ Ghana no wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa ne nan no mu wɔ Ghana Repɔblik a ɛtɔ so nan no mu.

N'abrabɔ mfitiaseɛ ne ne sukuukorɔ 
Wɔwoo Kwaw wɔ Lower West Akim a ɛwɔ Atɔeɛ mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Berɛ a ɛdi kan a wɔtoo aba maa Kwaw yɛ Ɔpɛnima, mfeɛ mpenu ɔman abatoɔ no mu berɛ ɔgyinaa sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuo no din mu. Ɔnyaa mma mpem aduasa-mmeinu, ahanu ne aduonum-mmienu a wɔtoeɛ no mu mpem dunwɔtwe, ɔha ne mmiɛnsa a na ɛyɛ ɔha mu nkyɛmu aduonum-nsia akyiri pɔ du. Ne mpasua no ka mmarahyɛbadwa nkonnwa dunwɔtwe a New Patriotic Party, Ɔsono amanyɔkuo no nyaa wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa nkonnwa aduonu-nsia no nyinaa mu no ho wɔ saa afe abatoɔ no mu wɔ Atɔeɛ mantam mu. Nnipa a ɔdii wɔn so nkunim no ne Isaac Nti-Ababio Newton of the National Democratic Congress, Felix Atta-Owusu a na ɔgyina National Reformed Party amanyɔkuo no anan mu, Mark Ayitey Kwablah a na ɔgyina Convention Peoples Party amanyɔkuo no anan mu, Joseph Otoo-Essilfie a na ɔgyina  United Ghana Movement amanyɔkuo no anan mu ne Hassan Al-Haji Salisu a na ɔno nso gyina Peoples National Convention amanyɔkuo no anan mu no. Abatoɔ no nyinaa baa awieeɛ no, Isaac Nti-Ababio Newton nyaa mma no mu mpem dumienu, ahanson aduosia-nwɔtwe a ɛyɛ ɔha mu nkyɛmu aduasa nkron akyiri pɔ aduosia, Felix Atta-Owusu nso nyaa mma ahansia ne aduonu-mmiɛnsa a ɛyɛ ɔha mu nkyɛmu baako akyiri pɔ aduokron, Mark Ayitey Kwablah nyaa mma ahasa ne aduanan-mmienu a ɛyɛ ɔha mu nkyɛmu baako akiri pɔ du, Joseph Otoo-Essilfie nso nyaa mma ahanu ne aduasa-mmienu a ɛyɛ ɔha mu nkyɛmu ɔha mu nkyɛmu hwee akyiri pɔ aduoson ɛnna Hassan Al-Haji Salisu nyaa mma no mu ɔha ne aduowɔtwe-mmiɛnsa a ɛyɛ ɔha mu nkyɛmu hwee akyiri pɔ aduosia.

N'adwumasɛm 
Kwaw yɛ mmarahyɛbadwani dada ma Lower West Akim abatoɔ mpasua a ɛwɔ Atɔeɛ mantam mu wɔ Ghana no firii mfeɛ mpenu ne baako kɔsii mfeɛ mpenu ne num no mu.

Baabi a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Ransford Agyapong
text:
Ransford Agyapong yɛ Ghanani amanyɔni ne mmarahyɛbadwani dada ma  Suhum abatoɔ mpasua a ɛwɔ Atɔeɛ mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Seesei, ɔne titenani ma New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuo no baasonkuo a wɔhwɛ abatoɔ ho nsɛm so wɔ Suhum abatoɔ mpasua a ɛwɔ Atɔeɛ mantam mu no so.

N'abrabɔ mfitiaseɛ ne n'adesua 
Agyapong firi Suhum a ɛwɔ Atɔeɛ mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Agyapong ka mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no ho wɔ Repɔblik a ɛtɔ so nan no mu wɔ Ghana. N'adwuma sɛ amanyɔni no hyɛɛ aseɛ wɔ afe apem, ahankron aduokron-nan no mu berɛ a ɔgyinaa New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuo no anan mu sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani maa Suhum abatoɔ mpasua no, nanso ɔdii ntwo wɔ saa abatoɔ no mu maa Solomon Kodjoe Akwetey a na ɔgyina National Democratic Congress amanyɔkuo no anan mu no dii ne so nkunim berɛ a ɔnyaa mma dodoɔ a wɔtoeɛ no mu mpem dunwɔtwe, ɔha aduowɔtwe-baako a ɛyɛ ɔha mu nkyɛmu aduanan-mmiɛnsa akyiri pɔ aduokron wɔ saa afe abatoɔ no mu. Ɔsan gyinaa mfeɛ mpenu Ghana abatoɔ no mu peree sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani bio, nanso saa berɛ yi de, ɔdii nkunim berɛ a ɔnyaa mma dodoɔ a wɔtoeɛ no mu mpem dunsia, ahanan aduokron-nan a ɛyɛ ɔha mu nkyɛmu aduonum-nan akyiri pɔ aduokron wɔ saa afe abatoɔ no mu. Ɔde n'adwuma sɛ amanyɔni no baa awieeɛ wɔ n'afe a ɛtwa toɔ no mu wɔ mfeɛ mpenu ne nan no mu.

N'adwumasɛm 
Seesei, Agyapong ne titenani ma New Patriotic Party manyɔkuo no baasonkuo a wɔhwɛ abatoɔ ho nsɛm so wɔ Suhum abatoɔ mpasua no so.

Baabi a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Samuel Ofosu-Ampofo
text:
Wɔwoo Samuel Ofosu-Ampofo Ɔbɛnem da a ɛtɔ so du, afe apem, ahankron ne aduosia-mmeinu no mu. Ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani dada. Ɔsane yɛ District Chief Executive ma Fateakwa Atifi fam wɔ Ghana Atɔeɛ mantam mu. Ɔsane yɛ ɔsoafoɔ dada wɔ Atɔeɛ mantam mu na na ɔyɛ National Organizer ma  National Democratic Congress amanyɔkuo no. Ampofo sane yɛ ɔsoafoa dada a na ɔhwɛ aban ne ɔmanfoɔ ntam nkitahodie ne nkuro mpuntuo so. Seesei, ɔne titenani ma  National Democratic Congress (NDC) amanyɔkuo no wɔ ɔman yi mu.

N'abrabɔ mfitiaseɛ ne ne sukuukorɔ 
Wɔwoo Ampofo wɔ Kyebi. Ɔhyɛɛ ne sukuu ase wɔ  Asamankese, Anum L/A Middle School firii afe apem, ahankron ne aduoson-nsia kɔsii afe apem ahankron ne aduoson-nkron. Afei, ɔtoaa so kɔɔ  ntoasoɔ sukuu wɔ Akwatia Technical Institute firii afe apem ahankron ne aduoson-nkron kɔsii afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe-mmienu. Ɔfiri hɔ no, ɔkɔsuaa  Post Graduate Certificate in Public Administration wɔ Ghana Institute of Management & Public Administration (GIMPA) ne Haggai Institute a ɛwɔ Hawaii Islands.

Ɔsane nso toaa so kɔɔ  University of Education, Winneba a ɛwɔ Kumase no kɔsuaa adeɛ akwamma biara firii  afe apem ahankron ne aduokron-baako kɔsii  afe apem ahankron ne aduokron-mmiɛnsa. Ampofo sane kɔɔ  University of Mines and Technology(UMAT) a ɛwɔ Tarkwa kɔgyee nteteɛ nyaa abodin  mechanical engineering wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduowtwe-mmiɛnsa mu kɔsii afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe-num no mu. Ɔsane nso yɛ osuani dada wɔ USA-Specialized Studies in Advanced Leadership wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron-nwɔtwe afe no mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ampofo ka mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so mmienu ne mmiɛnsa wɔ Ghana Repɔblik a ɛtɔ so nan no ho. Ɔsane yɛ amanyɔni a ɔwɔ  National Democratic Congress amanyɔkuo no mu. N'adwuma sɛ amanyɔni no hyɛɛ aseɛ berɛ a ɔmampanin Jerry John Rawlings yii no sɛ District Chief Executive firi afe apem, ahankron ne aduokron-nan kɔsii afe apem, ahankron ne aduokron-nsia no mu.

Mmarahyɛbadwani 
Afe apem, ahankron ne aduokron-nsia ɔman abatoɔ no mu no, Ɔperee adwa sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ  Fanteakwa Atifi abato mpasua no mu wɔ Ghana Atɔeɛ mantam mu. Ɔnyaa mma dodoɔ a wɔtoeɛ no mu mpem aduonu-baako, ahanu ne aduowɔtwe-nan wɔ saa afe abotoɔ no mu de dii nkunim. Ɔsane tenaa adwa no sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani berɛ ɔdii nkunim wɔ mfeɛ mpenu ne nwɔtwe abatoɔ no mu no. Ɔnyaa mma a wɔtoeɛ no mu mpem dunum, ahanan aduowɔtwe-nson a ɛyɛ ɔha mu kyɛmu aduanan-nkron akyiri pɔ aduoson. 

Ɔsane peree adwa korɔ no ara wɔ mfeɛ mpenu ne nan ɔman abatoɔ no mu nanso saa berɛ yi deɛ, ɔdii ntwo maa Kwadjo Agyei Addo a na ɔgyina New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuo no anan mu no dii nkunim. Mfeɛ mpenu ne nwɔtwe ɔman abatoɔ no mu no, ɔsane bɛgyinaa sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani peree adwa kroɔ no ara bio, nanso ɔsane dii ntwo maa Kwabena Amankwa Asiamah a na ɔgyina New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuo no anan mu no dii nkunim.

title: Anna Nyamekye
text:
((Databox}}

Anna Nyamekye yɛ Ghana amanyɔni a na ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani ma Jaman Anaafoɔfam abatoɔ mpɛsoaso a ɛwɔ Brong ne Ahafo mantam no mu (Brong Ahafo Region) wɔ Ghana.

Abrabɔ Ahyɛaseɛ ne Sukuu 
Nyamekye yɛ woo no wɔ Obubuo bosome no ne da a ɛtoaso aduonu num wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduonum nan no mu. Onyaa ne sukuupɔn abodin krataa sɛ abɔdin krataa a ɛdi nkae wɔ nimdeɛ pɛ mu wɔ Oguaa Suapɔn mu (University of Cape Coast).

Adwuma 
Nyamekye na ɔyɛ nimdeɛpfoɔ na ɛno ne n'adwuma.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Nyamekye yɛ mmarahyɛbedwani a na ɔgyina ma Jaman Anaafoɔfam abatompɛsoaso (Jaman South Constituency) wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbedwakuo a ɛtoaso mmiensa wɔ Adehyeman Ghana amamuo a ɛtoso nan no mu. Ɔsan so yɛɛ adwuma sɛ ɔmansoafoɔ abɛdeakyire a ɔhwɛ nnuane ne kuadwuma so. Na ɔsanso yɛ ɔmansoafoɔ a na ɔhwɛ mmoa mmoa so.

2000 Abatoɔ 
Nyamekye ɛwɔ mfie mpem mmienu abatoɔ no mu ne mmerɛ a  wɔn dii nkae too aba yii no sɛ  mmarahyɛbedwani a na ɔgyina hɔ ma Jaman Anaafoɔfam abatompɛsoaso (Jaman South Constituency)wɔ akane Bono ne Ahafo mantam no mu a ɛnnɛ yi ɛyɛ Bono mantam no mu (Brong Region) wɔ Ghanaman abatoɔ a wɔn to no wɔ Ghana afanaa nyinaa no mu. Wɔ mmarahyɛbedwam no ɔno ɛna na ɔgyina hɔ ma saa abatoɔ mpɛsoa no so wɔ mmarahyɛbedwakuo a ɛtoso mmiensa wɔ Adehyeman Ghana amamuo a ɛtoso nan no mu. Wɔ abatoɔ no mu no mma a wɔn de yii no kɔɔ mmarahyɛbedwam no,onyaa mpem du-nkron aha-son ne aduonu (19,720) de firii mma mpem adua-nan,aha-nwɔtwe ne aduosia nkron (40,869) a wɔn gye too mu no mu. Waei ne gyinapɛn bɛ yɛ sɛ ɔha nkyekyemu aduanan-nwɔtwe ne akyiripo mmiensa na ɛyɛ pɛ wɔ mma a wɔn gye too mu no mu. Wɔn too aba yii no sɛ nkunimdifoɔ wɔ Nicholas Appiah-Kubi a na ofiri ɛyɛ kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo a ɛno ne (National Democratic Congress) NDC mu, Clement Anane a na ofiri National Reform amanyɔkuo (National Reform Party) no mu , Stephen Kwabena Nkyibena a na ɔno nso firi (Convention Peoples Party)  a ɛno ne CPP amanyɔkuo no mu ɛne Fedal Miss Gyasi a na ɔno nso firi (People's National Convention) a ɛno nso ne PNC amanyɔkuo. waei ne mma a wɔn a ɔgyinaeɛ ma wɔn too wɔn so aba no nyaeɛ wɔ ne nnidisoɔ. Nyamekye nyaa mma no mu mpem du-nkron, aha-nson ne aduonu, Appiah-Kubi nso nyaa mma no mu mpem,  du-nwɔtwe,  aha-nwɔtwe ne nson,Anane nso nyaa mma no mu apem,aha-num ne aduokron baako, Kwabena Nkyibena aha-nan ne mmiensa ɛne Gyasi na ɔno nso nyaa mma no mu aha-mmiensa ne aduanan nwɔtwe. Waei nso ne susupɛn wɔ ɔha nkyekyem wɔ sɛ nea abatoɔ no kɔeɛ wɔ ne nnidisoɔ. Nyamekye ,ɔha nkyekyemu aduanan-nwɔtwe ne akyiripo mmiensa, Appiah-Kubi nso nyaa ɔha nkyekyemu aduanan nsia, Anane nso nyaa ɔha nkyekyemu mmiensa ne akyiripɔ nkron, ɔha nkyekyemu baako nso kɔ maa Kwabena Nkyibena ɛna ɔha nkyekyemu hwee ne akyiripɔ nkron nso kɔ maa Gyasi. Wɔn too aba maa Nyamekye maa no kɔɔ mmarahyɛbedwam wɔ (New Patroitic Party) a ɛyɛ NPP amanyɔkuo no tumi krataa so. Na ne mpɛsoa no ka mmarahyɛbedwam nkonwa du-nan a (New Patroitic Party) NPP amanyɔkuo no nyaa de firii mmarahyɛbadwam nkonwa aduonu baako a ɛno ne ne dodoɔ nyinaa wɔ abatoɔ no mu wɔ akanee no Bono ne Ahafo mantam (Brong Ahafo Region) no a ɛnnɛ ɛno ne Bono mantam (Bono Region) no mu wɔ Ghana. Wɔn a wɔ to aba wɔ saa mpɛsoa no so no too aba a yɛ frɛ no sɛ sikɛɛte ne braawoso wɔ saa afe no abatoɔ no mu a deɛ akyere ne sɛ wɔn too aba de maa ɛyɛ saa mmerɛ no mu no amanyɔkuo a na wɔn nni abae mu no,ɛmu kɛseɛ a na ɛwɔm a na ɛno ne (National Democratic Congress) NDC amanyɔkuo no nnipa wɔn de no baeɛ bɛgyina sɛ yɛn to ne so aba sɛ Ɔman Panin no nanso mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no deɛ wɔ to de maa Nyamekye a na ɔfiri New Patroitic Party ɛyɛ NPP amanyɔkuo no mu. Wɔ ne nyinaa mu no New Patroitic Party ɛyɛ NPP amanyɔkuo no nyaa mmarahyɛbadwam no nkonwa dodoɔ no ara na wɔn nyaa ɔha (100)de firii nkonwa dodoɔ aha mmienu (200) no mu ɛwɔ Adehyeman Ghana amamuo a ɛtoso mmiensa no mu wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtoaso nan no mu.

2004 Abatoɔ 
Nyamekye wɔn sanso too aba yii no sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani ne mprenu soɔ wɔ ɔman Ghana abatoɔ a wɔn to no wɔ ɔman mu no nyinaa mu no wɔ mfie mpem mmienu ne nan abatoɔ no mu. Wɔ gyina hɔ sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani de maa mpɛsoa no so wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtoso nan wɔ Adehyeman Ghana amammuo a ɛtoso nan no mu. Wɔn de abatoɔ no mu mma mpem du-nson aha-nwɔtwe ne aduanan-mmienu a ɛno ne mma a ɔnyaeɛ de firii ɛyɛ mma mpem aduasa-baako,aha-mmienu ne aduokron wɔ mma a wɔn gye to mu na yii no sɛ ɔkɔ gyina wɔn aman mu wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam. Waei ne susupɛn ɔha kyekyɛ mu mpem aduonum-nson ne akyiripɔ mmienu wɔ abatoɔ wɔn gye to mu  no nyinaa mu. Wɔn too aba maa no dii nkunim wɔ Osei Kuranteng a na ɔfiri People's National  Convention party a yɛ twa no tiawa sɛ PNC amanyɔkuo, Ahamed Ashams Dinu a na ɔfiri National Democratic Congress a yɛ twa no tiawa sɛ NDC amanyɔkuo,Oteng Agyeman Jacob a na ɔfiri Convention People's Paty a yɛ no tiawa sɛ CPP amanyɔkuo no mu ɛne Oppong Maabena Martin a na ɔno nso firi Democratic People's Paty a yɛ twa ɛnoso tiawa sɛ DPP amanyɔkuo no mu. Awei no mo nyaa mma no mu aha-nson ne aduo-wɔtwe mmienu (782),mpem adu-mmienu ne aduo-wɔtwe num(12,085),aha mmiensa ne aduasa-son (337), ɔha ne aduoson mmiensa (173) wɔ ne nnidisoɔ nnidisoɔ. Waei ne susupɛn wɔ ɔha nkyekyemu na ɛyɛ pɛ ,ɔha nkyekyemu mmienu ne akyiripɔ nun,(2.5%),aduasa- nwɔtwe ne akyiripɔ nson (38.7%),baako ne akyiripɔ baako (1.1%) ɛne hwee ne akyiripɔ nsia (0.6%) ne nnidisoɔ nnidisoɔ mu wɔ Ɔman Ghana nyinaa abatoɔ a wɔ toɔ no mu. Nyamekye wɔn sanso too aba maa no wɔ (New Patroitic Party) ɛyɛ NPP amanyɔkuo no tumi krataa so. Na ne mpɛsoa so no ka mmarahyɛbadwan nkonwa du-nan  (14) a NPP (New Patroitic Party) nya de firii nkonwa aduonum-nan no ho wɔ akanee no Bono ne Ahafo mantam no mu wɔ Ghana wɔ mfie mpem mmienu ne nan Ghanaman abatoɔ no mu.  Wɔ ne nyinaa mu no New Patroitic Party na ɔnyaa Mmarahyɛbadwani nkonwa dodoɔ no ara na wɔn nyaa  a na ne dodoɔ no yɛ aha ne du-nan (114) wɔ aba wɔ tooeɛ wɔ saa afe no mu na wɔn nyaa de firii aha-mmienu ne aduasa (230) mmarahyɛbadwam nkonwa no ne dodoɔ nyinaa mu wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtoso nan wɔ Adehyeman Ghana amamuo a ɛtoso nan no mu.

Ankorankoreɛ Abrabɔ 
Nyamkye yɛ Okristoni.

title: Benjamin Osei Kuffour
text:
Benjamin Osei Osei Kuffour yɛ Ghana amanyɔni a na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ akane no Bono ne Ahafo mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana. Na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔka mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtoso mmiensa wɔ Adehyeman Ghana amamuo a ɛtoso nan no mu (4th Republic of Ghana)

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔpaw Kuffour sɛ mmarahyɛ baguani ma Wenchi Apuei fam amansin no wɔ afe 2000 Ghana amansan abatow no mu .  Wɔpaw no wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so .  Na ne mansin no yɛ mmarahyɛ bagua nkongua 14 no fa wɔ nkongua 21 a New Patriotic Party no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Brong Ahafo Mantam no mu.    New Patriotic Party no nyaa dodow no ara a ɛyɛ mmarahyɛ bagua nkongua ɔha wɔ nkongua 200 a ɛwɔ mmarahyɛ bagua a ɛto so 3 a ɛwɔ Ghana man a ɛto so 4 no mu.  Wɔde abatow 20,784 paw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 36,814 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 57.5% yɛ pɛ.  Wɔpaw no sen Christiana Atakora Mensah a ofi National Democratic Congress, Francis Amofah a ofi Convention People's Party, Michael Mahama Nabila a ofi People's National Convention, Yeboah Kwasi Eric a ofi United Ghana Movement ne Asare Bediako a ofi National Reform Party   Eyinom nyaa abatow 14,326, 359, 245, 207 ne 200 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtowee nyinaa mu 57.5%, 39.7%, 1.0%, 0.7%, 0.6% ne 0.6% yɛ pɛ.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Angelina Baiden-Amissah
text:
Angelina Baiden-Amissah (wɔwoo no Ɔgyefoɔ da a ɛtɔ so nwctwe afe apem ahankron ne aduonum nan 1954) yɛ Gaana amanyɔni na ɔsan yɛ ɛnka ne mmrahyɛbɛdwani ma Ghana abatoɔ mpasoa a ɛwɔ Atoeɛ mantam.

Amanyɔsɛm ne Adwuma 
Na Baiden-Amissah ka  mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtɔ so nnan  wɔ Ghana kabimamenkabi amanmuo a ɛtɔ so nan no mu na ɔgyina hɔ ma Shama. Na ɔsan so ka mmrahyɛbɛdwafie a ɛtɔso miensa wɔ 4th republic wɔ ɔman no mu. Ɔhyɛɛ amanyɔ adwuma ase afe 2000 abatoɔ mmerɛ. Ogyina New Patriotic  Party din mu. Odii nkunim ne mma 8,284 a ɛyɛ 31%. Afe 2004 ɔsan dii nkunim wɔ abatoɔ mmerɛ no ma ne mpasoa no na ɔnyaa mma 14,782. Afei 2008 afe abatoɔ no, odii nkuguo maa Gabriel kwadwo Essilfie dii ne so nkunim.

Baiden-Amissah ka mpaninfoɔ a wɔ da Ghana Cylinder manufacturing Company. Ɔsan so yɛ nwomanimfoɔ. Na ɔsan yɛɛ Ɔsomfoɔ abadiakyiri ma Ministry of Education, Science and Sports.

Abrabɔ 
Baiden-Amissah yɛ Kristoni.

title: Albert Kwaku Obbin
text:
Albert Kwaku Obbin (born 4 Kɔtɔnimaa1956) yɛ Gaana amanhyɔni ne ɛkane mmrahyɛbɛdwani ma Prestea-huni valley abatoɔ mpasua wɔ Atoeɛ mantam, na ɔsan dɔn New Patriotic Party.

Abrabɔ ahyeasɛ ne adwuma 
Wɔ woo Obbin afe 1956. Ɔgyii diploma abɔdin wɔ Social Studies wɔ University of Education a ɛwɔ Winneba. Afei nso wɔ bachelor's abɔdina wɔ Social science nnwomasua mu firi University of Cape Coast na ɔsan kura Executive Masters wɔ Governance ne Leadership firi Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration.

Amanyɔsem 
Obbin hyɛ ne amanyɔ dwuma ase afe 2000 bere a odii nkunim wɔ saa afe no abatoɔ mu. Na ɔbɛyɛ mmrahyɛbadwani ma mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtɔ so miensa wɔ Gaana adehyeman a ɛtɔso nnan mu. Odii nkunim afe 2000 ne afe 2004 maa amanyɔkuo New Patriotic Party.

Wɔ afe 2000 abatoɔ no ɔnyaa mma 19,131 na ɛyɛ 48.40%. Saa afe no,  amanyɔkuo New patriotic party dii nkunimwɔ mpasua 9 firi 19 a ɛwɔ atɔɛ mantam no mu. Na wɔ san dii nkunim wɔ mpasua no dodoɔ a ɛyɛ 99 wɔ mmrahyɛbadwafie. Bere a wɔ to aba afe 2000 no Obbin dii nkunim maa Kwaku Acheampong Bonful a ɔdɔn National Democratic Congress, Mubashir Tamiru Dari Convention People's Party ne Akosua Wirekowah of the Peoples National Convention dii nkuguo. Wɔn nyinaa nyaa mma 31.00%, 18.10% ne 2.40% pɛpɛɛpɛ.

Afe 2004 abatoɔ no Obbin san so dii nkunim bere a ɔnyaa mma 23,852 a na ɛyɛ 43.70%. Nanso afe 2008 abatoɔ no w'antumi agyina amma Prestea-huni valley maa  dii ne so nkunim. Obbin yii mma 18,077 firi mma 52,815 mu na Francis Adu-Blay Koffie yii  21,887 firii mma 52,815 mu. Afe 2012 abatoɔ no w'antumi angyina, na w'ansan ankɔ mmrahyɛbadwafie bio.

Ne som 
Obbin yɛ Kristoni.

Beaɛ menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Edith Hazel
text:
Edith Hazel  yɛ Gaana mmranyɛbadwani, amanyɔni ne ahemmɔfo  na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbadwani ma Evalue Gwira abatoɔ mpasua a ɛwɔ Atɔɛ mantam mu, efiri afe 2001 kɔ si 2005.

Abrabɔ ahyɛase ne sukuu 
Hazel kɔɔ sukuu wɔ University of Ghana. Wɔ Kitawonsa bosome afe 2014, wɔ paw no sɛ Gaana ahemmɔfo ma Dɛnmaak ne Finland. Na ɔsan so bɛ yɛɛ abadiakyiri maa Gaana mpayinfoɔ a wɔ hwɛ Gaana nsɛm so wɔ Washington D.C Amerika.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔ yiii Hazel sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani ma Evalue Gwira mmere a wɔ too aba afe 2000 na ɔkɔɔ mmrahyɛbadwafie National Democratic Congress din mu. Na ɔka mmrahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtɔ so miɛnsa wɔ Ghana kabimamenkabi amanmuo a ɛtɔ so nan no mu. Ogyinaa hɔ maa National Democratic Congress. Afe 2004, Hazel dii nkunim wɔ abatoɔ no mu. Saa abatoɔ no Hazel dii Kojo Armah Convention Peoples Party, Sagary Nokoe  New Patriotic Party ne Nana Kwabena Erskine National Reform Party; na wɔn nyinaa yii mmaa 5,994, 2,702 ne 115 a ɛyɛ  38.90% , 17.50% ne 0.70% pɛpɛɛpɛ.

Beaɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Joe Baidoo-Ansah
text:
Joe Baidoo-Ansah wɔ woo no afe 1964, ɔyɛ Nsɛmkyerɛni, Ɔkasamafoɔ, wɔapata nipa ahofadi na ɔsan yɛ amanyɔni. Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbadwani  ma Kwesimintsim abatoɔ mpasua wɔ New Patriotic Party din mu. Ɔkɔɔ mmrahyɛbadwafie efiri afe 2001 kɔsi 2017. Na ɔsan so yɛɛ aban soafoɔ bɛdiakyiri wɔ Nsrahwɛ ne amanɔne nhyehyɛ ho. Ɔsan yɛɛ soafoɔ ma  Wimhyɛn nnwuma, Nnwuma, Private sector mpuntu dwuma ne President's special Initiatives, wɔ bere a John A. Kufuor yɛ manpayin. Ɔyɛɛ Ɔmanoayin kɔ sii sɛ wɔ kyɛ Effia abatoɔ mpasua ne Kwesimintsim abatoɔ mpasua mu.

Abrabɔ ahyɛase ne Sukuu 
Baidoe-Ansah wɔ woo no Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da ɛtɔso 28 afe 1964. wɔ kuro a wɔ frɛ no Asakae wɔ Atɔɛ mantamu wɔ Gaana. Afe 1997, na ɔnyaa n'abɔdin master's degree wɔ Human rights wɔ London Sukuupɔn (University of London). Ɔsan so kɔɔ Kofi Annan International Peacekeeping Center sukuupɔn na ɔnyaa master's of arts in Conflict, Peace and Security. Baidoo-Ansah din nkan yɛ Nsɛmkyerɛni, ɔgye abasobɔde sɛ "best Investigative Journalist" afe 1994.

Adwuma 
Baidoe-Ansah yɛ Nsɛmkyerɛni, Ɔkasamafoɔ ne ɔbenfo wɔ "conflict and peace". Na Baidoe-Ansah yɛ news editor maThe Independent dawurobɔ krataa. Ansa ɔbɛyɛ mmrahyɛbadwani no, na ɔyɛ kwankyerɛfo payin  a ɔda Ghana Committee on Human and Peoples Rights (GCHPR).

Amanyɔsɛm 
Baidoe-Ansah yɛɛ mmrahyɛbadwani firi afe 2001 wɔ Effia/Kwesimintsim abatoɔ mpasua so na ogyina hɔ ma New Patriotic Party. Na ɔyɛ wɔn mmrahyɛbadwani de kɔpem sɛ wɔ kyɛɛ mmrahyɛbadwa no mienu. Akyiri no ogyina hɔ ma Kwesimintsim abatoɔ mpasua no firi afe 2013 kɔ si 2017. Bere a na Baidoe-Ansah wɔ mmrahyɛbadwa fie no na ɔka kuo bebree ho ebi te sɛ: Appointment Committee, Foreign Affairs Committee, Ɔpayin a ɔda Youth and Sports Committee, Ranking Member ma Committee wɔ Government Assurances ne Chairman ma Communications Committee. Ɔsan bɛ yɛ Ɔsomafo ma Nsrahwɛ ne amanone nsɛm.

Abrabɔ 
Baidoe-Ansah w'are Theresa Baidoe-Ansah,a owui afe 2019 bosome Ɔpɛnimaa da ɛtɔso 25. Wɔn mienu wɔ nkwadaa miensa. Baidoe-Ansah yɛ Catholic ni.

Beaɛ menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Michael Coffie Boampong
text:
Michael Coffie Boampong (6 Ɔbɛnem 1962 – 29 Ɔpɛpɔn 2018) yɛ Gaana ni na ɔsan so yɛ Nkontabufoɔ ne amanyɔni na ɔka mmrahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtɔ so nsia wɔ Gaana kabimamenkabi amanmuo adehyeman nnan ho. Na ɔyɛ National Demcratic Congress nipa a ɔkɔɔ mmrahyɛbadwafie ma Bia West abatoɔ mpasua wɔ Atɔɛ mantamu.

Abrabɔ ahyease ne sukuu 
Wɔ woo Boampong afe 1962 bosome Ɔbɛnem da ɛtɔso 6. Ɔfiri Sefwi Essam, kuro a ɛwɔ atɔɛ mantamu wɔ Gaana. Ɔkɔɔ ne sukuu wɔ Kumase Polytechnic,na ɔnyaa n'abɔdin Diploma in Business Studies (Accounting Option) afe 1987.

Amanyɔsem 
Wɔ afe 2001 abatoɔ no na Boampong di nkan kɔ mmrahyɛbadwafie, a ogyina hɔ ma  Bia atɔɛ. Na ɔsan dii nkunim mprɛnsa soɔ nti som ne manfoɔ firii afe 2001 kɔ si 2012. Wɔ afe 2000 abatoɔ no ɔyii maa 24,267 a ɛyɛ 68.50% na odii Benjamin Armah New Patriotic Party ne Albert Adomako  Convention People's Party so nkunim na wɔ yii mma 11,179 ne 0 pɛpɛɛpɛ a ɛyɛ 31.50% and 0.00% pɛpɛɛpɛ

Wɔ mmrahyɛbadwafie nu na ɔka kuo bebre ho bi te sɛ: committee ma Poverty Reduction Strategy, Roads ne Transport, ne Special Budget Committee.

Adwuma 
Boampong yɛ nkontabufoɔ. Na ɔsan yɛ Assistant Inspector of Taxes wɔ IRS.

N'abrabɔ ne ne wuo 
Boampong ware yɛ na ɔwɔ nkwaa nsia. Ɔyɛ Kristoni. Boampong wu afe 2018 bosome Ɔpɛpɔn da ɛtɔso 29 wɔ 37 Military Hospital wɔ Nkran.

Beaɛ menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Abraham Owusu Baidoo
text:
Abraham Owusu Baidoo yɛ Gaana mmrahyɛbadwani. Na ɔsan ka Gaana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtɔ so mmiensa wɔ Ghana adehyeman amanmuo a ɛtɔ so nan no mu. Ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbadwani ɛma Twifo/Hemang/Lower/Dɛnkyira wɔ mfifini mantamu. Ɔkɔɔ mmrahyɛbadwafie National Democratic Congress din mu.

Abrabɔ ahyɛase ne nwomasua 
Wɔ woo Baidoo wɔ Lower Dɛnkyira a ewɔ mfifini mantamu.

Amanyɔsɛm ne adwuma 
Afe 2000 na Abraham di nkan kɔɔ Gaana mmrahyɛbadwafie. Na ogyina hɔ ma ne manfoɔ wɔ Twifo/Hemang/Lower/Denkyira abatoɔ mpasua so. N'amanyɔkuo ne National Democratic Congress. Mmre a wɔ too 2000 abatoɔ no, Baidoo di nkum ne mma 17,319 a ɛyɛ 49.20%, Dwuma Odoom New Patriotic Party nyaa 15,682  ɛyɛ 44.60%, Elizabeth Bimpong of the Convention Peoples Party nyaa 1,705 a ɛyɛ 4.80% ɛna Jonathan R. Adofo of the National Reform Party nso nyaa 488 a ɛyɛ 1.40% abatoɔ no awieyɛ.

Beaɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Harry Halifax-Hayford
text:
Harry Halifax Hayford yɛ Gaana mmrahyɛbadwani ne Mmranimfoɔ. Ghanaian. Na ɔka mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtɔ so miensa wɔ Ghana kabimamenkabi adehyeman amanmuo a ɛtɔ so nan no mu. Na amanyɔkuo ne National Democratic Congress, Ɔyɛɛ mmrahyɛbadwani maa Abura- Asebu-Kwamankese abatoɔ mpasua a ɛwɔ Mfifini mantan.

Abrabɔ ahyɛase ne Amanyɔsɛm 
Hayford, wɔ woo no wɔ Mfifini mantan. Na adwuma ankasa Mmranimfoɔ. Afe 2000, na ɔhyɛɛ n'amanyɔ adwuma ase bere a wɔ too ne so aba sɛ ɔgyina Abura- Asebu-Kwamankese abatoɔ mpasua no din mu wɔ mmrahyɛbadwafie. Saa afe n'abatoɔ no, Hayford ne n'amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress nyaa mma 13,66 a ɛyɛ 44.90%. Na Andrew Kingsford Mensah New Patriotic Party, Raymond Nonnatus Osei Convention People's Party nyaa 2,570 a ɛyɛ 8.40%, Joshua Alfred Amuah nyaa 1,093 a ɛyɛ 3.60%, Ametorwo Richard Korbla People's National Convention nyaa 321a ɛyɛ 1.10% na Yeboah Peter United Ghana Movement nyaa 263 a ɛyɛ 0.90%. Afe 2004, Hayford antumi ankɔ mmrahyɛbadwafie bio efirisɛ ɛmrɛ too delegate so aba wɔ ne mpasua so no ɔdii nkuguo maa Augustine Solomon Ekye dii ne so nkunim.

Beaɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Charles Omar Nyanor
text:
Charles Omar Nyanor a wɔ san frɛ no Clement Charles Omar Nyanor (1 Ɛbɔ 1935 – 30 Oforisuo 2004) yɛ Gaananani na ɔyɛ Sikasɛm ho obenfo (Economist), Banker, Amanyɔsɛm ho obenfo, Mmraninfoɔ, Industratist ne Gaana amanyɔni. Na ɔka ka mmarahyɛbadwakuo a adi nkan wɔ Ghana kabimamenkabi  adehyeman amanmuo a ɛtɔ so mienu ho. Ɔkɔɔ mmrahyɛbadwafie ma Dɛnkyira abatoɔ mpasua wɔ Mfifini mantan.

Abrabɔ ahyɛase ne sukuu 
Wɔ woo Nyanor Ɛbɔ bosome da adi nkan afe 1935. Ɔfiri  Dunkwa-on-Offin. Ɔkɔɔ sukuupɔn University College, London ne Lincoln's Inn, London, hɔ na ɔnyaa n'abɔdin Bachelor of Science degree wɔ Economics afe 1964. Ɔsan so yɛ Associate wɔ Institute of Bankers (AIB), London afe 1965. Ɔnyaa ne Barrister-at-Law afe 1966.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Nyanor baa Gaana afe 1967, na ɔsan yɛ payin ma Project Appraisal ne Implementation ne mmra asɛm a ɛfa project implementation ho wɔ  National Investment Bank. Ne fnfɛfoɔ taa frɛ no. Mmrɛ Dr. K.A. Busia yɛ manpayin no, na Nyanor yɛ soafoɔ badiakyire ma Ministry of Finance and Economic Planning ɛfri afe 1969 kɔ si 1972 (Progress Party). Mmrɛ a ɔwɔ Ministry of Finance no, ɔboa maa wɔ sii Merchant Bank, ne ndwuma nketwa mpuntuo ma "Bank for housing and construction." Afe 1969 Nyanor kɔɔ mmrahyɛbadwafie. Afe 1996, na ogyina ma New Patriotic Party. Ɔsan yɛɛ soafoɔ ɔhwɛ private sector development wɔ Ɔmanpayin John A. Kuffour, ɛkyire na ɔbɛ yɛɛ soafoɔ ma state in charge of Divestiture implementation committee.

Bere bi, Dunkwahene Nana Kwaku Ofori II yii Nyanor sɛɛ ɔnyɛ Hene nso amanyɔsɛm nti Nyanor antumi endi hene. Afe 2000 Gaana abatoɔ no, ɔnyaa mma 25,994 a ɛyɛ 63.90%. Na Kwaku Oduro-Bonsu National Democratic Congress nyaa 13,335 a ɛyɛ 32.80%, Beatrice Buadu Convention Peoples Party nyaa 891 a ɛyɛ 2.20%, Apeko-Kow Anderson National Reform Party nyaa 289 a ɛyɛ 0.70%, Kwasi Antoban Joseph United Ghana Movement nyaa 167 a ɛyɛ 0.40%. Nyanor dii nkunim ma Upper Denkyira abatoɔ mpasua.

Adwuma 
Na ɔyɛ payin wɔ Investment development officer wɔ National Investment Bank, wɔ Accra. Ɔyɛ Private Legal Practitioner, ɔsan yɛ Ɔtitenani ma SPPC.

Abrabɔ 
Ɔyɛ Kritoni. Wa ware wɔ mmɔfra mienu. Deɛ ɔde gye n'ani bɔɔlbɔ.

Owuo 
Nyanor, wu  afe Oforisuo bosome da 30, mmrɛ ɔyare kakrabi.

Beaɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Dominic Fobih
text:
Dominic Fobih (Born 16 Kitawonsa 1942) yɛ Gaana amanyɔni, Ɔbenfo ne Ɔkyerɛkyerɛni. Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbadwani ma Assin South a ɛwɔ mfifini mantan efriri afe 2001 de kɔ 2017. N'amanyɔkuo ne New Patriotic Party. Na ɔsan yɛ soafoɔ ma Lands, Forestry and Mines bere a John Agyekum Kufour yɛ Gaanaman payin.

Abrabɔ ahyɛase ne sukuu 
Wɔ woo Fobih Kitawonsa bosome ne da ɛtɔso 16. wɔ kuro bi a wɔ frɛ no Assin Jakai wɔ mfifini mantan wɔ Gaana. Ɔnyaa n'abɔdin PhD wɔ Educational psychology wɔ University of Alberta a ɛwɔ Canada afe1979.

Adwumasɛm ne Amanyɔsɛm 
Fobih New Patriotic Party amanyɔni. Mmrɛ a wɔ too afe 2000 abatoɔ no, ɔnyaa mma 16,963 wɔ 31,843 abatoɔ no nyinaa a ɛyɛ 53.3%. Ɛfiri 2003 kɔsi 2007 bere a ɛkane Gaanaman payin John Agyekum Kuffour's tesoɔ no, na Fobih yɛ soafoɔ ma Minister of Lands, Forestry and Mines. Afe 2008 kɔsi 2012 na Fobih yɛ mmrahyɛbadwani ma Assin South mansini. Afei so, bere a ɔwɔ mmrahyɛbadwafie no, na commitee a ɔwom yɛ Adesua ne adan commitee (Education and House committees). Afe 2012 na ɔyɛ kasamafo ma adesua ho sɛm wɔ mmrahyɛbadwafie. Fobih yɛ Ɔkyerɛkyerɛni wɔ University of Cape Coast sukuupɔn. Seisei ɔyɛ ɔtitenamni ma Ghana Education Trust fund (GETFUND).

N'abrabɔ 
Fobih aware wɔ nkwadaa nkron.Ɔsan yɛ Kristoni.

Beaɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Felix Twumasi-Appiah
text:
Felix Twumasi-Appiah  Wɔwoo no wɔ Ɔsanaa bosome no ne da a ɛtoso aduasa wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduosia-nwɔtwe no mu.(30th August 1968)  ƆyɛGhana amanyɔni na ɔsan nso yɛ adwuma sɛ adwuma mu ɔhwɛsofoɔ ne adwuma mu dwumadie hwɛsofoɔ panin.

Abrabɔ ahyɛaseɛ ne Sukuu 
Twumasi Appiah  wɔn woo no ɔw kuro bi a yɛfrɛ no Wiase a ɛwɔ Sene mansini no mu  Sene District wɔ Bono ne Ahafo mantam no mu (Brong Ahafo Region) a ɛwɔ Ghana. Ɔkɔɔ sukupɔn wɔ Institute of Maritime Studies a ɛwɔ Havanna wɔ Cuba man no mu a ɛhɔ na onyaa Bsc.(Hons) abɔdin krataa wɔ mmaninnsɛm anaasɛ obi fa kwammɔne so nya ne ho wɔ Maritime Akwantusɛm nnosoatwe ho nsɛm  ( Bsc.(Hons) in Exploitation of Maritime Transpotation).

Adwuma ne Abrabɔ 
Twumasi-Appiah yɛ adwuma mu ɔhwɛsofoɔ ne adwuma mu dwumadie hwɛsofoɔ panin. W'ayɛ adwuma sɛ deɛ ɛfa nnwumakuo ho futufoɔ ɔbenenfo wɔ dwumadie bi mu (Corperate Consultant) wɔ Ta&a sɛ adwuma no mu ɔbenefoɔ futufoɔ panin wɔ Medivac(Gh) Ltd adwumakuo no mu, sɛ  ɔboafoɔ panin a ɔde sika ahyɛ afutufoɔ abenfoɔ adwumakuo Westgate Investment Ltd dwumakuo ɛne sɛ adwuma mu ɔhwɛsofoɔ panin a ɔhwɛ sɛ nneɛma a adwumakuo no bɛ nya de ade di dwuma no wɔn nsa bɛ ka wɔ ne korɔeɛ ne ne mmaeɛ mu no nyinaa so wɔ dwumakuo bi a yɛfrɛ wɔn sɛ Reha-Medical Supply. Ansaana waei mo nyinaa bɛba no na w'adi nkae ayɛ adwuma sɛ ɔpaninpaa ɔda akwantuo ne nsrahwɛ adwumakuo (travel and tour establishment) a yɛfrɛ wɔn sɛ TranstourGH Ltd no titenafoɔ, sɛ nnoɔmatam a wɔde ɛhyɛn afa ne nnoɔma kuradan so hwɛsofoɔ panin de ma AFGO(K.I.A) ɛne sɛ dwumadie mu torofoɔ panin wɔ Ghana Suhyɛn Gyinabea Tumikurafoɔ adwumakuo (Ghana Port and Harbour Authority). Ɔtumi ka Brofo kasa ne Spanish kasa.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Na ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani (Member of Parliament) de ma Sene abatoɔ mpɛsoaso a akyire no wɔn sesaa no bɛyɛɛ no Sene Atoeɛ abatoɔ mpɛsoaso (Sene West) de firi ɛyɛ mfie mpem mmienu de bɛ si mfie mpem mmienu ne du-mmienu (2000-2012). sɛ na ɔyɛ ɛkuoba de ma  National Democratic Congress a ɛno ne (NDC).amanyɔkuo no. Ɛnam ɛno nti yɛɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani de ma Sene abatoɔ mpɛsoa no so a na ɔka Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtoso num wɔ Adehyeman Ghana amammuo a ɛtoso nan no mu (4th Republic of Ghana).

Abatoɔ 
2000 Abatoɔ 

Wɔ mfie mpem mmienu Twumasi-Appiah de nkunim wɔ Ɔman Ghana nyinaa abatoɔ a wɔn toɔ sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔgyina hɔ ma Sene abatoɔ mpɛsoa no so wɔ Bono ne Ahafo mantam no mu a ɛwɔ Ghana (Brong Ahafo Region of Ghana). Ɔdii nkunim wɔ National Democratic Congress(NDC) amanyɔkuo no tumi krataa so. Ne mpɛsoa no ka mmarahyɛbadwam nkonwa nson (7) a wɔn nya de firii nkonwa aduonu-baako (21) a New Patroitic Party(NPP)amanyɔkuo no dii nkunim wɔ so no wɔ saa abatoɔ no mu wɔ Bono ne Ahafo mantam no mu ( Brong Ahafo Region). Ɛyɛ National Democratic Congress (NDC)  a yɛ twa no tiawa no nyaa mmarahyɛbadwam nkonwa no ketoa anaa sɛ ɛmu kumaa a na ne dodoɔ nyinaa yɛ aduokron-mmienu (92) ɛno ne deɛ wɔn nyaaeɛ de firii mmarahyɛbadwam nkonwa no aha-mmienu(200) no mu wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtoso mmiensa wɔ Adehyeman Ghana amammuo a ɛtoso nan no mu. Wɔ abatoɔ no mu no, onyaa  mma no mu mpem du-nnan, aha-num ne aduosia-nson (14,567) de firii ɛyɛ mma no mu mpem aduonu-baako,aha-nan ne aduisia-num (21,465) na ɛyii no wɔ mma a wɔn gye too mu no nyinaa mu. Waei ne ɔha mu susupɛn a edidisoɔ yi na ɛyɛ pɛ,ɔha nkyekyemu aduosia-nwɔtwe ne akyiripɔ baako (68.1%) wɔ mma a wɔn gye too mu no nyinaa mu. Wɔn too aba yii no sɛ nkunimdifoɔ wɔ wɔn a ɛdidisoɔ yi so, lsaac Sunkwa-Hyeaman a na ɔfiri New Patroitic Party(NPP) a wɔn twa no tiawa sɛ NPP amanyɔkuo no mu,Geofery Agbo a na ɔno nso firi National Reform Party a ɛno no ne NRP amanyɔkuo no, Abukasim Tahiru a ɔfiri Convention People's Party a ɛno nso ne CPP amanyɔkuo no. Deɛ edidisoɔ yi ne nea wɔn mu biara nyaaeɛ mpem nnum, ɔha ne aduo-num mmienu (5,152),apem, aha-mmienu ne aduanan-nwɔtwe (1,248) ɛne aha-nan ne aduonu-nwɔtwe (428) waei ne mma a wɔn nyaaeɛ wɔ mma a wɔn gye too mu no nyinaa mu. Na waei ne ɔha nkyekyemu susupɛn a edidisoɔ yi na ɛyɛ pɛ, ɔha nkyekyemu aduonu-nan ne akyiripɔ baako (24.1%), ɔha nkyekyemu num ne akyiripɔ nwɔtwe (5.8%) ɛne ɔha nkyekyemu mmienu ne akyiripɔ hwee (2.0%). 

2004 Abatoɔ  

Twumasi-Appiah wɔn sanso too aba maa no wɔ ne mprenusoɔ sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani de ma Sene abatoɔ mpɛsoaso, akyire no wɔn too hɔ din sɛ Sene Atoeɛ fam abatoɔ mpɛsoaso a ɛwɔ Bono ne Ahafo mantam no mu (Brong Ahafo Region of Ghana) wɔ mfie mpem mmienu ne nan Ɔman Ghana abatoɔ a Ɔman mu no nyinaa toɔ no mu. Ogyina hɔ maa saa mpɛsoa no so wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtoso nan no wɔ Adehyeman Ghana amammuo a ɛtoso nan no mu. Wɔn de mma no mu mpem aduonu, aha-nson ne aduoson-nnum (20,775) na ɛyii no na onyaa saa mma no de firii ɛyɛ mpem aduonu-nkron, aha-nwɔtwe ne aduokron-nan(29,894) wɔ mma a wɔn gye too mu no nyinaa mu. Waei ne ɔha nkyekyemu susupɛn aduosia-nkron ne akyiripɔ aduonum (69.50%) na ɛyɛ pɛ wɔ mma a wɔn gye too mu no nyinaa mu. Wɔn too aba yii no sɛ nkunimdifoɔ wɔ wɔn a ɛdidisoɔ yi so Sunkwa-Hyeaman Isaac a ɔfiri New Patriotic Party (NPP) amanyɔkuo no mu ɛne Yushahu Hallaru Alhaji Yussif a ɔfiri Convention People's Party(CPP) amanyɔkuo no mu. Awaeinom nso nyaa mpem nwɔtwe,aha-aduosia ne aduanan (8,640) ɛne aha-nan ne aduoson-nkron (479) wɔ mma dodoɔ a wɔn gye too mu no nyinaa mu. Waei nso ne ɔha nkyekyemu susupɛn a edidisoɔ yi na ɛyɛ pɛ, aduonu-nwɔtwe ne akyiripɔ aduokron (28.90%) ɛne ɔha nkyekyemu baako ne akyiripɔ aduosia (1.60%). wɔ mma a wɔn gye too mu no nyinaa mu. Twumasi-Appiah wɔn to aba maa no wɔ  National Democratic Congress (NDC) amanyɔkuo no tumi krataa so. Ɛyɛ National Democratic Congress (NDC) amanyɔkuo no nyaa mmarahyɛbadwam nkonwa no mu ɛdu (10) de firii aduonu-nan (24) a na ɛno ne mmarahyɛbadwam nkonwa dodoɔ wɔ Bono ne Ahafo mantam no mu ( Brong Ahafo Region) wɔ Ghana ɔman mu no nyinaa abatoɔ no mu. Wɔ ne nyinaa mu no National Democratic Congress (NDC) na ɛnyaa mmarahyɛbadwam nkonwa no mu ketewa anaa sɛ kumaa a ne dodoɔ yɛ aduokron-nan (94) de firii aha-mmienu ne aduasa (230) a ɛno ne mmarahyɛbadwam nkonwa dodoɔ no nyinaa wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtoso nan wɔ Adehyeman Ghana amammuo a ɛtoso nan no mu. 

2008 Abatoɔ 

Twumasi-Appiah Wɔn sanso too aba yii no sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani ne mpriensa soɔ a ɔgyina hɔ ma Sene abatoɔ mpɛsoa no so hɔ foɔ wɔ mfie mpem mmienu ne nwɔtwe (2008)  Ɔman Ghana abatoɔ a Ɔman mu no nyinaa toɔ no mu. Ɔsanso gyina hɔ sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani de maa saa mpɛsoa no so wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtoso num (5) wɔ Adehyeman Ghana amammuo a ɛtoso nan (4) no mu. Wɔn de mma mpem dummienu, aha-mmienu ne aduasa-mmienu (12,232) na yii no na onyaa waei de firii ɛyɛ mpem aduonu-num ahankron ne aduonu-nan (25,924 wɔ mma a wɔn gye too mu no nyinaa mu. Waei ne ɔha nkyekyemu susupɛn na ɛyɛ pɛ a ɛno ne ɔha nkyekyemu aduonum-nan ne akyiripɔ aduosia-nan (54.60%) wɔ mma a wɔn gye too mu no nyinaa mu. Wɔn too aba maa no dii nkunim wɔ wɔn a ɛdidisoɔ yi so  Mohammed Belinyi Abdulai a na ɔfiri New Patriotic Party (NPP) amanyɔkuo no mu, Emmanuel Osei Ramson a na ɔfiri Convention People's Party (CPP) amanyɔkuo no mu, Opoku Senkyire Gabriel a na ɔno nso firi Democratic People's Party (DPP) ɛne Sumani Bapio Issahaku of the People's National Convention (PNC) amanyɔkuo no mu. Deɛ ɛdidisoɔ yi ne mma a wɔn nyinaa nyaaeɛ mpem nkron, aha-nan ne aduanan (9,440), aha-nan ne aduoson (470), aha-mmiensa ne dunum (315) ɛne aha-mmiensa ne num (305) wɔ mma a wɔn gye too mu no nyinaa mu. Waei ne ɔha nkyekyemu susupɛn a edidisoɔ yi na ɛyɛ pɛ aduanan-baako ne akyiripɔ aduanan-nson ( 41.47%, ), ɔha nkyekyemu mmienu ne akyiripɔ nsia(2.06%, ), ɔha nkyekyemu baako ne akyiripɔ aduasa-nwɔtwe (1.38%) ɛne ɔha nkyekyemu baako ne akyiripɔ aduasa-nan (1.34%) wɔ mma a wɔn gye too mu no nyinaa mu.Twumasi-Appiah wɔn sanso too aba maa no biom wɔ National Democratic Congress (NDC) tumi krataa so. Ɛyɛ National Democratic Congress(NDC) amanyɔkuo no nyaa nkonwa nwɔtwe (8)na ɛde firii mmarahyɛbadwam nkonwa aduonu-nan (24) a na ɛwɔ Bono ne Ahafo mantam no mu wɔ saa afe no abatoɔ no mu. Wɔ ne nyinaa mu no  National Democratic Congress (NDC) na ɔnyaa mmarahyɛbadwam nkonwa dodoɔ a ɛno ne ɔha ne du-nan (114) de firii aha-mmienu ne aduasa (230) wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtoaso num wɔ Adehyeman Ghana amammuo a ɛtoso nan no mu.(5th parliament of the 4th republic of Ghana)

Ankorankoreɛ Abrabɔ 
Twumasi-Appiah yɛ ɔwarefoɔ a ɔwɔ mma mmienu.  Ɔyɛ Kristoni na ɔne Owusɔre Tumi ne daa nkwa paanoo(Resurrection Power and Living Bread Christian Center)  afakuo no na ɛsom.

Ghana mmrahyɛbadwafoɔ 2001–2005
National Democratic Congress (Ghana) Amanyɔfoɔ

title: George William Amponsah
text:
George William Amponsah  yɛ Ghana amanyɔni a na ɔyɛ Ghana Mmarahyɛbadwani de ma Asunafo Anaafoɔfam abatoɔ mpɛsoa no so (Asunafo South Constituency)  wɔ akanee no Bono ne Ahafo mantam no mu a ɛnnɛ yi ɛno ne Bono mantam mu (Brong Ahafo Region) wɔ Ghana. Na ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani a na ɔka Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtoso mmiensa wɔ Adehyeman Ghana amammuo a ɛtoso nan no mu.(the 3rd parliament of the 4th republic of Ghana).

Abrabɔ Ahyɛaseɛ ne Sukuu 
Amponsah yɛ Ghana Mmarahyɛbadwani a na ɔgyina hɔ ma Asuafo Anaafoɔfam abatoɔ mpɛsoaso.Wɔn woo no wɔ ɛyɛ Ahinime bosome no ne da a ɛtoso aduonu-mmiensa wɔ mfie apem ahankron ne aduisia-num (23ed October,1965). Wɔn woo no wɔ kuro a yɛ frɛ no Asutifi a ɛwɔ Asante mantam no mu. Abɔdin krataa a ɛkura no ne (tescher's Certificate "A") akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ abɔdin krataa a ɛdikan.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Amponsah yɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔfiri New Patroitic Party NPP amanyɔkuo no mu. Wɔn too aba yii no sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔgyina hɔ ma Asuafo Anaafoɔfam abatoɔ mpɛsoaso (Asuafo South Constituency) wɔ Bono ne Ahafo mantam no mu (Brong Ahafo Region) wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtoso mmiensa wɔ Adehyeman Ghana amammuo a ɛtoso nan no mu (3rd Parliament in the 4th Republic of Ghana). Eric Opoku a ɔfiri National Democratic Congress NDC amanyɔkuo no mu na ɛbɛ dii n'adeɛ wɔ mfie mpem mmienu ne nan Ɔman Ghana nyinaa abatoɔ no mu (2004 Ghanaian General Elections).

Abatoɔ 
Amponsah wɔn too aba yii no sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani de maa Asunafo Anaafoɔfam abatoɔ mpɛsoaso wɔ mfie mpem mmienu abatoɔ no mu (2000 Ghanaian general elections). Wɔn too aba yii no sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ New Patroitic Party(NPP) amanyɔkuo no tumi krataa so. Ne mpɛsoa no so no ka mmarahyɛbadwam nkonwa du-nan(14) a New Patroitic Party(NPP) amanyɔkuo no mu nyaa de firii ɛyɛ mmarahyɛbadwam nkonwa aduonu-baako (21)no mu wɔ saa abatoɔ no mu wɔ Bono ne Ahafo mantam no mu. Ɛyɛ New Patroitic Party(NPP) amanyɔkuo no nyaa mmarahyɛbadwam nkonwa no dodoɔ,wɔn nyaa mmarahyɛbadwam nkonwa no mu ɔha (100)  de firii mmarahyɛbadwam nkonwa aha-mmienu (200)no mu wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtoso mmiensa wɔ Adehyeman Ghana amammuo a ɛtoso nan no mu. Wɔn de mma mpem du, aha-nson ne aduokron-mmienu (10,792) na ɛyii no na onyaa saa mma yi de firii ɛyɛ mma mpem aduonu-baako, aha-num ne aduonu-nan (21,524) wɔ mma a wɔn tooeɛ na wɔn gye too mu no nyinaa mu. Waei ne ɔha mu susupɛn bɛyɛ ɔha nkyekyemu aduonum ne akyiripɔ nkron (50.9%) na ɛyɛ pɛ wɔ mma a wɔn  tooeɛ na wɔn gye too mu no nyinaa mu. Wɔn too aba yii no sɛ nkunimdifoɔ wɔ wɔn a ɛdidisoɔ yi so    

Francis Adu a na ɔfiri  the National Democratic Congress NDC amanyɔkuo no mu, Yaw Ohene a na ɔno nso firi ɛyɛ Convention People's Party CPP amanyɔkuo no mu ɛne Twumasi Ankra a na ɔno nso firi ɛyɛ National Reform Party  NRP amanyɔkuo no mu.Nea ɛdidisoɔ yi ne mma a wɔn nyaaeɛ wɔ abatoɔ no mu,mpem nwɔtwe, aha-nwɔtwe ne du-nsia, (8,816) apem ne aha-mmiensa (1,300)ɛne aha-mmienu ne aduokron-nsia (296). Waei ne ɔha mu susupɛn a edidisoɔ yi na ɛyɛ pɛ, ɔha nkyekyemu aduanan-baako ne akyiripɔ nsia, (41.6%), ɔha nkyekyemu nsia ne akyiripɔ baako (6.1%) ɛne ɔha nkyekyemu baako ne akyiripɔ nan (1.4%) wɔ mma a wɔn tooeɛ na wɔn gye too mu no nyinaa mu.

Ankorankoreɛ Abrabɔ 
Amponsah yɛ ɔkristoni. na ɔyɛ warefoɔ a ɔwɔ mma nsia.

Bea me nyaa mmoa firiieɛ

title: James Victor Gbeho
text:
James Victor Gbeho (yɛwoo no wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da a ɛtɔ so dummienu wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduasa num mu(1935) wɔ Keta a ɛwɔ Ghana) yɛ Ghana mmaranimni ne diplomat a na ɔyɛ ECOWAS kuo mu panin firi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du(2010) mu kɔsi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne dummienu(2012) mu.

Ɔyɛɛ mansoafoɔ a na ɔhwɛ Ghana Amanɔne sɛm so firi afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nson(1997) de kɔsi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne baako(2001) mu wɔ Mampanini Jerry John Rawlings amammuo ase, ne mmarahyɛbadwani ma Anlo mpɛsoa no firi Ɔpɛpɔn bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne baako(2001) kɔsi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne num(2005) mu. Na ɔsan so yɛ Amanɔne nhyehyɛeɛ fotufoɔ ma Ɔmanpanin John Atta Mills amammuo.

Nnwomasua 
Victor kɔɔ sukuu wɔ Achimota School, Philip Gbeho ɔhyehyɛɛ Ghana national ne ne papa na ne wɔfa nso ne Komla Dumor a ɔyɛ nsɛntwerɛni.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Victor Gbeho yɛɛ mmarahyɛbadwani maa Anlo mpɛsoa no wɔ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nan mmarahyɛbadwam a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa sɛ ɔkansifoɔ a wannyina amma amanyɔkuo biara.

Abatoɔ 
Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu(2000) Ghanaman nyinaa abatoɔ mu na yɛyii no sɛ Anlo mpɛsoa no mmarahyɛbadwani a wannyina amma amanyɔkuo biara. Ɔno ne ɔkansifoɔ a ɔtɔ so mmienu a wannyina amma amanyɔkuo biara odii nkunim sɛ mpɛsoa so no mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ Volta Mantam abatoɔ mu.

Gbeho nyaa mma mpem dunkron, ne aduowɔtwe mmiɛnsa (19,083) a egyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyemu aduosia nwɔtwe ne akyirepɔ mmienu (68.2%) wɔ mma dodoɔ a ɛbaeɛ nyinaa mu ɛyɛ mma mpem aduonu nwɔtwe, ɔha ne aduonum nsia (28,156) mu.

Akansifoɔ a ɔdii wɔn so nkunim ne Clend M. Kwasi Sowu a ɔgyina maa kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo (NDC) a ɔnyaa mma mpem nan, ahanu ne aduonu mmiɛnsa (4,223) a egyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyɛmu dunum ne akyirepɔ baako(15.1%), Esther IIan A. Nyamalor a wannyina amma amanyɔkuo nso nyaa mma mpem mmiɛnsa ne ahanwɔtwe (3,800) a egyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyɛmu dummiɛnsa ne akyirepɔ nsia(13.6%), Godwin Kwaku Defeamekpor a ɔgyina maa Ɔsono amanyɔkuo (NPP) no nso nyaa mma ahasa ne aduonu nson(327) a egyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyɛmu baako ne akyirepɔ mmienu(1.2%), Clemence Kwami Abotsi a ɔgyina maa Akokɔ Kɔkɔɔ (CPP) amanyɔkuo no nso nyaa mma ahanu ne aduanan-nkron(249) a egyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyɛmu ohunu ne akyirepɔ nkron(0.9%), Cornelius Kofi Binewoatsor a ɔgyina maa National Reformed Party nso nyaa mma ɔha ne aduosia mmienu(162) a egyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyɛmu Ohunu ne nsia(0.6%), Prince Richard Abotsi a ɔgyina maa United Ghana Movement amanyɔkuo no nso nyaa mma ɔha ne dunwɔtwe(118) a egyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyɛmu ohunu ne akyirepɔ nan(0.4%) ne Goyimwole Enukomeko a ɔno nso annyina amma amanyɔkuo biara nso nyaa mma ohunu.

Beaeɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Joe Gidisu
text:
Joe Kwashie Gidisu yɛ amanyɔni ne kyerɛkyerɛni ne kane mansoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ akwantempɔn ne akwantempɔn akɛseɛ so.

Abrabɔ ahyɛase ne nnwomasua 
Wɔwoo Joe Gidisu wɔ Ɔgyefuo bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduonu-mmienu wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduonum mmienu(1952) mu wɔ Bakpa Alabonu a ɛwɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔkɔɔ ne mmɔfrase sukuu wɔ Bakpa Alabonu Local Authority Primary School firi afe apem ahankron ne aduonum nkron (1959) kɔsi afe apem ahankron ne aduosia mmiɛnsa(1963) mu.

Ɔtoaa so kɔɔ Mafi Devime Local Authority sukuu a ɔwie wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduosia nson(1967) mu. Ɔsan toaa ne nnwomasua so wɔ Kibi Men's Training College a ɔnyaa ne adekyerɛ krataa 'A'. 

Gidisu kɔɔ University of Ghana a ɔnyaa B.A Hons wɔ hɔ wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe baako(1981) mu. Ɔtoaa so kɔɔ Netherlands a ɔkɔ yɛɛ ne postgraduate adesua wɔ institute of Social Studies, The Hague a ɔnyaa M.A wɔ Development Studies mu.

Adwuma 
Gidisu kyerɛɛ adeɛ wɔ Bontibor Local Authority Primary School firi afe apem ahankron ne aduoson baako(1971) mu ne afe apem ahankron ne aduoson mmiɛnsa(1973) mu. Ɔfirii Kibi Men's Training College no, ɔkyerɛɛ adeɛ wɔ Dormaa Ntoasoɔ Sukuu wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduoson nson(1977) ne afe apem ahankron ne aduoson nwɔtwe(1978) mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Gidisu bɛyɛɛ mmarahyɛbadwani maa North Tongu  mpɛsoa no wɔ Ɔpɛnimma bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu (2000) mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ abatoɔ no mu. Berɛ a wɔkyekyɛɛ mpɛsoa no mu no, ɔgyina maa Central Tongu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan(2004) mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ abatoɔ no mu na ɔdii nkunim bɛtenaa mpɛsoa no akonnwa so wɔ mmarahyɛbadwafie wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome mu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne num(2005) mu.

Ɔtenaa mpɛsoa no akonnwa so bio wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nwɔtwe(2008) berɛ a ɔdii nkunim wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam abatoɔ no mu. Abatoɔ no akyi no, Ghana Mampanini John Evans Atta Mills yii no sɛ Mansoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ akwantempɔn ne akwan akɛseɛ so wɔ Ɔgyefuo bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nkron(2009) mu.

title: Hayford Francis Amoako
text:
Hayford Francis Amoako yɛ Ghana amanyɔni a na ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani de ma Nkoranza abatoɔ mpɛsoaso wɔ Bono ne Ahafo mantam no mu (Brong Ahafo Region of Ghana) Na ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani a na ɔka Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtoso mmiensa wɔ Adehyeman Ghana amammuo a ɛtoso nan no mu.

Abrabɔ Ahyɛaseɛ ne Sukuu 
Amoako yɛ Ghana Mmarahyɛbadwani a na ɔfiri National Democratic Congress (NDC) amanyɔkuo no mu. Na ɔgyina hɔ ma Nkoranza abatoɔ mpɛsoa no so sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani. Wɔn woo no wɔ ɛyɛ Bosome Kitawonsa no ne da a ɛtoso nson wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduo-num nson no mu. Ɔnyaa sukuu abɔdin krataa B.SC/LLB (Hons). Ɔfiri Nkoranza kuro no mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Amoako yɛ National Democratic Congress (NDC) amanyɔkuo no ba. Wɔn too aba yii no sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani de maa Nkoranza abatoɔ mpɛsoaso (Nkoranza constituency) wɔ Bono ne Ahafo mantam no mu (Brong Ahafo region) wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtoso mmiensa wɔ Adehyeman Ghana amammuo a ɛtoso nan no mu. (3rd parliament of the 4th republic of Ghana) .  Kwame Ampofo Twumasi na ɛdii n'adeɛ wɔ mmerɛ a wɔn sesaa abatoɔ mpɛsoa no so bɛyɛɛ no Nkoranza Anaafoɔ afam abatoɔ mpɛsoaso  (Nkoranza South constituency) wɔ mfie mpem mmienu ne nan Ɔman Ghana nyinaa abatoɔ no mu (2004 Ghanaian General elections). Wɔn yii no sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ atwerɛtwerɛfoɔ sahene (Interim General Secretary) mfa ma National Democratic Congress (NDC) amanyɔkuo no. Wɔn yii no sɛ saa mmerɛ no ɔmmɛyɛ atwerɛtwerɛfoɔ sahene anaa panin mfa ma ɛyɛ National Democratic Congress NDC amanyɔkuo no wɔ mfie mpem mmienu ne aduonu-mmienu (2012) wɔ mmerɛ a na Joseph Mamboah-Rockson de ne diberɛ ato hɔ sɛ ɛkuo no twerɛtwerɛfoɔ panin anaa sahene ,na ɛfiri hɔ deekorɔ no na ɔbɛyɛɛ amanyɔkuo no atwerɛtwerɛfoɔ sahene anaa panin a na ɔda amanyɔkuo no ano.

2000 Mfie Mpem Mmienu Abatoɔ 
Amoako  wɔ too aba maa no sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔgyina hɔ ma Nkoranza abatoɔ mpɛsoaso (Nkoranza Constituency) wɔ mfie mpem mmienu Ɔman Ghana nyinaa abatoɔ a yɛ tooeɛ no mu. (2000 Ghanaian general elections). Wɔn too aba maa no sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ National Democratic Congress (NDC) amanyɔkuo no tumi krataa so. Na ne mpɛsoa no ka mmarahyɛbadwafie nkonwa nson (7) a National Democratic Congress (NDC) amanyɔkuo no nyaa de firii mmarahyɛbadwam nkonwa aduonu-baako (21) no mu wɔ Bono ne Ahafo mantam no mu ( Brong Ahafo Region). Ɛyɛ National Democratic Congress (NDC) amanyɔkuo no na ɛnyaa Mmarahyɛbadwafie nkonwa no mu ketewa a dodoɔ a wɔn nyaaeɛ no ne aduokron-mmienu (92) de firii mmarahyɛbadwafie nkonwa aha-mmienu (200) no mu wɔ mmarahyɛbedwakuo a ɛtoso mmiensa wɔ Adehyeman Ghana amammuo a ɛtoso nan no mu.Wɔn de mma a wɔn tooeɛ no mu mpem aduonu, aha-nwɔtwe ne aduonu-nwɔtwe (20,828)  na ɛyii no ,na ɔnyaa saa mma dodoɔ yi de firii mma mpem aduanan-mmiensa, ɛne aduokron-nwɔtwe (43,098) wɔ mma a wɔn gye too mu no nyinaa mu. Waei ne ɔha mu susupɛn bɛyɛ ɔha nkyekyemu adunan-nsia ne akyiripɔ mmienu (46.2%) na ɛyɛ pɛ wɔ mma a wɔn gye too mu sɛ ɛyɛ no mu. Wɔn too aba maa no sɛ nkunimdifoɔ wɔ wɔn a ɛdidisoɔ yi so Kwame Amporfo Twumasi a na ɔfiri New Patriotic Party(NPP) amanyɔkuo no mu, Justice Owoahene Acheampong a na ɔno nso firi ɛyɛ People's National Convention(PNC) amanyɔkuo no mu, Kwaku Poku-Boah a na ɔfiri Convention People's Party(CPP) amanyɔkuo no mu, James Opoku-Worae a na ɔbɔ nso firi National Reform Party (NRP) amanyɔkuo no mu,  Owusu Benjamin a na ɔno nso firi United Ghana Movement(UGM)  amanyɔkuo no mu ɛne Thomas Owusu-Ansah a na ɔno nso firi ɛyɛ Every Ghanaian Everywhere(EGE) amanyɔkuo no mu. Neɛ ɛdidisoɔ yi ne mma a wɔn nyinaa nyaaeɛ wɔ ne nnidisoɔ mu, mpem adu-nkron, aha-mmiensa ne aduo-wɔtwe nan (19,384), aha-nson ne aduasa-num (735), aha-num ne aduasa-mmiensa (533),  aha-mmiensa ne aduo-wɔtwe mmiensa (383) ɛne ɔha ne du-baako (111). Waei ne mma a ɔnyaeɛ de firii mma a wɔn tooeɛ no mu a wɔn gye too mu sɛ ɛyɛ no nyinaa mu. Waei nso ne ɔha mu susupɛn a edidisoɔ yi na ɛyɛ pɛ, ɔha nkyekyemu aduanan-nsia ne akyiripɔ mmienu (46.2%), ɔha nkyekyemu baako ne nwɔtwe (1.8%), ɔha nkyekyemu baako ne akyiripɔ mmiensa (1.3%), ɔha nkyekyemu hwee ne akyiripɔ nkron (0.9%), ɔha nkyekyemu hwee ne akyiripɔ mmiensa (0.3%) ɛne ɔha nkyekyemu hwee (0%)  wɔ mma a wɔn gye too mu no nyinaa mu.

Ankorankoreɛ Abrabɔ 
Amoako yɛ okristoni.

title: Johnson Asiedu Nketia
text:
Johnson Asiedu Nketiah, ɛdin a yɛ de nim no paa ne General Mosquito, ɔyɛ Ghana amanyɔni a ɔno na ɔyɛ ɔwterɛtwerɛfoɔ sahene anaa panin (General Secretary) de ma National Democratic Congress (NDC) amanyɔkuo no.

Abrabɔ Ahyɛaseɛ ne Sukuu 
Asiedu Nketia  wɔn woo no wɔ Seikwa B/A wɔ Wenchi Mansini no mu (Wenchi Municipal District)  wɔ Bono ne Ahafo mantam no mu (Brong Ahafo Region) a ɛnnɛ yi ɛyɛ Bono mantam no mu (now Bono Region) a ɔwɔ Ghana man no mu wɔ Ɔpɛnimma bosome no ne da a ɛtoso aduonu-nan wɔ mfie mpem aha-nkron ne aduo-num nsia (24th December 1956)  no mu a agya a ɔwoo noɔ ne Nana Kwaku Asiedu a na ɔyɛ ɔkuani a na ɔfiri ɛyɛ Oyoko Adehyeɛ abusua (Oyoko Royal family) no dehyeɛ a ɛnnɛ yi ɔnteaseɛ biom ɔne Maame Hagar Akosua Afrah a ɔno nso firi ɛyɛ Akwamu Adehyeɛ abusua (Akwamu Royal family)  no mu na ɛwooeɛ. Ɛno ne ɛba a ɔtɔso nnum wɔ mma nkron no mu. Na ne wɔfa nimpɔn ne Agyemang Badu.

Nimdeɛ pɛ /Sukuu 
Owura Asiedu Nketiah hyɛɛ sukuu ase wɔ Seikwa Baasere mfitiaseɛ sukuu no mu (Seikwa Presbyterian Primary School). Na ɔsanso toaso sɛ ɔbɛ nya nteteeɛ sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛni wɔ Ɔhoteeni Joseph Nimdeɛ pɛ Suapɔn no mu (St. Joseph’s College of Education) wɔ Bechem de firi ɛyɛ mfie mpem aha-nkron ne aduoson-nan (1974) de bɛsi mfie mpem aha-nkron ne aduoson-nwɔtwe (1978) a ɛhɔ na owie sɛ obi a yɛde no afa nteteɛ mu sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛni wɔ mfie apem ahankron ne aduoson-nwɔtwe (1978) no mu. Ɔhyɛɛ 

n'adwumaeɛ ase sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛni a w'afa nteteeɛ mu wɔ Seketia Presby anaa sɛ Baasere mfitiaseɛ sukuu (Presbyterian Primary School) wɔ Jaman Atifido Mansini no mu (Jaman North District). a ɛwɔ Bono ne Ahafo mantam no mu. Onyaa suapɔn mu kwae kɔɔ ɛyɛ Ghana Sukuupɔn mu nefa a ɛno ne dwadie nimdeɛ so ( University of Ghana Business School)  wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe-mmiensa (1983) no mu na ɔkɔ suaa nimdeɛ sɛ (Bachelor of Science Degree) wɔ ɛdwadie nketahodie mu (Business Administration) wɔ sikasɛm kora ne ntotoeɛ (Banking and Finance). Nketiah yɛ ɛkuo ba a ɔka wɔn a wɔn dii nkan anaa sɛ ɔkannifoɔ kuo a w'awie suapɔn anyaa nteteɛ wɔ  dwumadie ɛfa sikasɛm dwadie (Stock Brokerage) ɛne sɛ wo de sika ɛhyɛ dwumadie bi mu anaa sɛ wo rebɔ ka wɔ biribi ho (Investment) wɔ ne nhwehwɛmu wɔ mmerɛ a Ghana adwamanso a wɔn to toɔn adwumakuo (Ghana Stock Exchange) no wɔn dii nkae daa no adi. Onyaa suapɔn krataa abɔdin a edikan wɔ abɔdeɛ nyansapɛ mu (Master of Science Degree) wɔ Banbɔ mu ne amanaman amanyɔnsɛm (Defense in International Politics ) wɔ Ghana Aseraafoɔ ɔhyɛ suapɔn mu (Ghana Armed Forces Command College) wɔ mfie mpem aduonu ne du-nkron no mu.

Adwuma 
Aseidu Nketia ayɛ adwuma wɔ GIHOC Distilleries Company Limited. W'asanso ayɛ adwuma adwuma mu ɔhwɛsofoɔ panin (manager) wɔ Nkoranza nkurasenkurase Sika korabea adwumakuo (Nkoraman Rural Bank ) no mu ɛne Sehwi Asawinso nkurasenkurase Sika korabea adwumakuo (Sehwi Asawinso Rural Bank) adwumakuo no mu  sɛ nteteɛfoɔ panin. W'asanso ayɛ adwuma wɔ bea a okura Ɔman mu awerɛhyɛmu adwumakuo (National Trust Holding Company Limited) (NTHC)  no mu sɛ sikasɛm dwadie ne adwuma Sika nhyɛmu ho sika korafoɔ.

Amanyɔnsɛm 
Sɛ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo ba ,Asiedu Nketia ayɛ adwuma wɔ appointment committee, afa a wɔn hwɛ sikasɛm ntotoeɛ kuo no mu (Finance Committee), amansan nkontabuo kuo (Public Account committee ). W'ayɛ titenadoɔ de ama ekuo a wɔn fam agudeɛ tuo so ne beaeɛ a wɔ hwɛ ahoden neɛ so (Mines and Energy committee),sɛ ekuo ba panin a ɔdi otitenafoɔ no akyi de maa aduane nneɛ ne kuadwuma kuo no  (Ranking member for food and agriculture) ɛne cocoa ho nsɛm nkaeɛ ekuba no (Cocoa Afdairs Committee) ɛne mmarahyɛbadwafie ɛdɔm kɛseɛ kuo no titenani abadiakyire ɔkannifoɔ ɔhwɛ sɛ ekuo bɛdi nhyehyɛeɛmapa so wɔ mmarahyɛbadwafie hɔ (Duputy Majority Chief whip). Na ɛyɛ Ɔsuafoɔ abɛdeakyire wɔ asoeɛ a wɔn hwɛ nnuane ne nfudeɛ  ne kuadwuma so wɔ Jerry John Rawlings amammuo no mu. Wɔ National Democratic Congress NDC amanyɔkuo no wɔn a w'ayi wɔ sɛ ananmusifoɔ wɔ mmea mmea a yɛ to aba no ananmusifoɔ nhiamu a wɔn to aba yiyi wɔn mpaninfoɔ wɔ bosome Ɔpɛnimaa mu wɔ mfie mpem mmienu ne num no (Delegate Congress in 2005).  Nketia de mma no mu ɔha nkyekyemu bɛyɛ sɛ aduo-wɔtwe (80%) na ɛdii nkunim wɔ Bede Ziedeng, Owura Sylvester Mensah ɛne Owura Antwi Boasiako so na ɔde bɛyɛɛ ɔtwerɛfoɔ sahene a ɔtoso mmiensa de ma National Democratic Congress NDC amanyɔkuo no. Wɔn sanso too aba maa no biom sɛ amanyɔkuo no twerɛtwerɛfoɔ sahene wɔ mfie mpem mmienu ne du  no mu wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome no mu(January 2010)  ɛne mfie mpem aduonu ne du-nan (2014)no mu Wɔn too aba maa no kɔɔ mmarahyɛbedwafie sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a edikan (1st Parliament of Ghana) wɔ Adehyeman Ghana amammuo a ɛtoso nan (4th Republic of Ghana)  no mu wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome no ne da a ɛtoso nson wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron-mmiensa (7th January 1993)  wɔ mmerɛ a na y'abɔ ne din sɛ nkunimdifoɔ wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduonkron-mmienu (1992) no mu wɔ Ɔman Ghana nyinaa abatoɔ a wɔn tooeɛ (Ghanaian General Elections) wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa bosome no ne da a ɛtoso aduonu-nkron no mu wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron mmienu (29th, December 1992).no mu. Wɔ mfie mpem aduonu ne aduonu Ɔpɛnimaa bosome no abatoɔ a wɔn wɔn de kɔɔ asɛnnibea (Court) no  (In 2020 December Election Pertition)  ,wɔn frɛɛ no totoo n'ano ɔne Rojo Mettle-Nunoo.

1996 Ghana Ɔman mu no nyinaa abatoɔ 
Wɔn sanso too aba maa no biom maa no kɔɔ mmarahyɛbedwafie sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani ne mprenusoɔ a na ɔka Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtoso mmienu (2nd Parliament of Ghana) wɔ Adehyeman Ghana amammuo a ɛtoso nan (4th Republic of Ghana) wɔ Ɔman Ghana nyinaa abatoɔ a wɔn toɔ wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron-nsia (Ghanaian General Elections in 1996) no mu wɔ National Democratic Congress NDC amanyɔkuo no tumi krataa so. Ɔdii nkunim wɔ Obeng    

a na ɔfire New Patriotic Part (NPP) amanyɔkuo  mu no so, ɔnyaa mma no mu ɔha nkyekyemu aduanan-baako ne akyiripɔ aduosia ( 41.60%) wɔ mma a wɔn tnoeɛ no deɛ wɔn gye too mu sɛ ɛyɛ no nyinaa mu a wɔ susupɛn mu no ɛne mma mpem du-nkron, aha-mmiensa ne aduo-wɔtwe nsia (19,386)  na ɛyɛ pɛ na Obeng nso nyaa du-nkron ne akyiripɔ du (19.10%) wɔ ɔha nkyekyemu mu na ɛno nso  wɔ susupɛn mu no ɛne mma mpem nwɔtwe, aha-nkron ne num (8,905) na ɛyɛ pɛ.

2000 Ɔman Ghana Abatoɔ 
Wɔ mfie mpem mmienu mu no (in 2000)  Asiedu Nketia dii nkunim wɔ Ɔman Ghana nyinaa abatoɔ no mu sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani de maa Wenchi Atoeɛ abatoɔ mpɛsoa no so foɔ (Wenchi West Constituency) wɔ Bono ne Ahafo mantam no mu wɔ Ɔman Ghana mu. Ɔdii nkunim wɔ National Democratic Congress NDC amanyɔkuo no tumi krataa so. Na ne mpɛsoa no ka mmarahyɛbadwa nkonwa nso (7) a National Democratic Congress NDC amanyɔkuo no nyaa de firi ɛyɛ mmrahyɛbadwa nkonwa aduonu-baako (21) no mu no ho  wɔ mmarahyɛbedwam abatoɔ no mu wɔ Bono ne Ahafo mantam no mu wɔ Ghana.  

Ɛyɛ National Democratic Congress NDC amanyɔkuo no na nyaa mmarahyɛbadwafie nkonwa no mu ketewa wɔn nyaa mmarahyɛbadwam nkonwa no mu aduokron-mmienu (92) de firii mmarahyɛbadwam nkonwa aha-mmienu (200) wɔ Adehyeman Ghana amammuo a ɛtoso nan no mu. Wɔn de mma a wɔn tooeɛ no mu mma mpem du-baako, aha-nson ne aduonu  (11,720) wɔ mma mpem aduonu-nan, aha-num ne aduasa-baako (24,531) wɔ mma a wɔn gye too mu sɛ ɛyɛ no nyinaa mu.   Wei ne ɔha nkyekyemu aduanan-nkron ne akyiripɔ mmienu (49.2%) na ɛyɛ pɛ wɔ mma a wɔn tooeɛ no nyinaa mu. Wɔn too aba maa no sɛ nkunimdifoɔ wɔ wɔn a ɛdidisoɔ yi so J

JDanquah a na na ɔfiri  the New PatriotParty ic (N P)aamanyɔkuo no my, Kusi EdwaKofi  rd a na ɔno nso firɛyɛ Nationalnal Reform (NRP) amanyɔkuo no mu ɛne  and Joana Mayfair Aresesa na  na ɔno nso firi ɛhe Convention People’s (C a)aamanyɔkuo no mu. Sɛ nea wɔn mu biara nyaaeɛ wɔ aba wɔn tooeɛ no mu na ɛdidisoɔ yi mpem du-baako, ne aduanan-baako11,041) a,,aha-num ne aduanan-mmien5 2041), ɛne,aha-num ne nso507) (  na ɛde firii mma a wɔn gye too mu sɛ ɛyɛ no nyinaa  S.cSɛ ɛba no ɔha nkyekyemu mu nso a deɛ ɛdidisoɔ yi ne deɛ wɔn mu biara nyaaeɛ  aduanan-nsia ne akyiripɔ na46.4to )m6mmienu ne akyiripɔ mmiensa2.3 .4%,) ɛne mmienu e 2kyiripɔ baako.1%and) wɔ mma wɔn tooeɛ no nyinaa mu.

Amanaman so Amanyɔnsɛm 
Wɔ mfie mpem aduonu ne du-nson (2017) no mu no, Owura Asiedu Nketia, wɔn too aba yii no  sɛ ekuo no panin abadiakyire de ma ekuo a yɛ frɛ wɔn sɛ Socialist International wɔ Absentia wɔ Cartagena sɛ ɔdiadifoɔ akanee Ɔmansoafoɔ panin a ɔfiri Portugal Ɔman no mu ɛne ɛnnɛ yi deɛ ɔyɛ UN amansankuo no twerɛtwerɛfoɔ sahene Antońiò Guterres. Wɔn too aba maa no sɛ ɔnyɛ adwuma mfa mma ɛyɛ deɛ ɔyɛ ekuo no panin a ɔda wɔn ano, George Papandroeu, a na w'ayɛ ɔmansoafoɔ de ma Greece ɔman no ne mprenusoɔ.

Ankorankoreɛ Abrabɔ 
Asiedu Nketia  yɛ okristoni a ɔyɛ Baasere asorekuo no ba a ɔne wɔn na ɛsom (Presbyterian Church of Ghana).  Ɔyɛ ɔwarefoɔ a ne ho kafoɔ ne Mrs. Vida Adomah Asiedu Nketiah a ɔne awo mma mu nnum  (5) children.
