title: Nkrabeah Effah Dartey
text:
Nkrabeah Effah Dartey  yɛ Ghana amanyɔni a na ɔsanso yɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani de ma Berekum abatoɔ mpɛsoa no so wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtoso mmiensa wɔ Adehyeman Ghana amammuo a ɛtoso nan no mu( 3rd Parliament of Ghana of the 4th Republic of Ghana).

Abrabɔ Ahyɛaseɛ ne Nwomasua 
Effah Dartey hyɛɛ ne Nwomasua ase wɔ Achimota Skuul (Achimota School).sanso kɔɔ Dormaa Ntoasoɔ Sukuu (Dormaa Secondary School) na onyaa ne GCE A Level abɔdin krataa (Certificate).

Adwuma 
Effah Dartey n'adwuma a ɔyɛ ne mmaranimfoɔ anaasɛ lɔyani (borrowed).Na ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ ɔno ara ankasa ne ankorɛankorɛ mmara adwumakuo mu (private law firm). Effah Dartey yɛ ɔsraani panin a w'ayɛ adwuma wɔ Ghana Aseraafoɔ adwumakuo (Ghanaian Army) no mu a w'akɔ ahome gyeɛ mu.a ɔkɔɔ n'anim sɛ Asraafoɔ panin a na n'abɔdin kɔduruu Asraafoɔ sahene (Captain) wɔ Oforisuo bosome no, ne da a ɛtoso aduonu-nson wɔ afe apem ahankron aduowɔtwe-mmiensa (27th April,1983) na onyaa saa abɔdin yi. Wɔ Ɔsanaa bosome no ne da a ɛtoso du-nan wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe-mmiensa (14th August 1987) no mu no na ɔfirii Ghana Asraafoɔ adwumakuo no mu (Ghana Armed Forces).Effah Dartey yɛɛ adwuma wɔ ɔman Ghana adwumakuo a ɛhwɛ wɔn a ɛkɔfa fangoo bɛtoɔn nsɛmkaeɛ ne atwerɛtwerɛ adwumayɔbea (National Secretariate for Petroleum Retailors Association) firi afe apem ahankron aduowɔtwe-nson on mu de bɛsii mfie mpem mmienu ne baako no mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Effah Dartey wɔn too aba maa no kɔɔ mmarahyɛbadwafie ne mprenusoɔ maa no kɔ gyinaa hɔ maa Berekum abatoɔ mpɛsoa no so hɔ foɔ wɔ Bono ne Ahafo mantam no mu (Brong Ahafo Region)  wɔ mfie mpem mmienu ne mfie mpem mmienu ne nan Ɔman Ghana abatoɔ no mu (2000 and 2004 Ghanaian General Elections).Na ɔsanso yɛɛ adwuma sɛ ɔmansoafoɔ abɛdeakyire ma asuaeɛ ɛhwɛ ɛfie nsɛm so. (Deputy Minister of Interior).

2000 Elections 
Effah Dartey Wɔn dii nkae too aba maa no kɔɔ mmarahyɛbadwafie sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔgyina hɔ ma Berekum abatoɔ mpɛsoa no so wɔ mfie mpem mmienu Ɔman Ghana abatoɔ no mu (2000 Ghanaian General Elections). Ɔgyina hɔ ma Berekum abatoɔ mpɛsoa no so foɔ wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtoso mmiensa wɔ Adehyeman Ghana amammuo a ɛtoso nan no mu (3rd Parliament of the 4th Republic of Ghana). Wɔn de mma mpem aduonu-mmiensa aha-mmienu ne aduowɔtwe-nwɔtwe (23,288 votes) de firii mma mpem aduasa-nsia aha-mmienu ne aduowɔtwe-nwɔtwe (36,288 votes) wɔ mma a wɔn tooeɛ no deɛ wɔn gye too mu sɛ ɛyɛ no nyinaa mu. Wei ne ɔha nkyekyemu susupɛn aduosia-nan ne akyiripɔ aduonu (64.20%) na ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ wɔ mma a wɔn gye too mu sɛ ɛyɛ no nyinaa mu. Wɔn too aba maa no sɛ nkunimdifoɔ wɔ wɔn a ɛdidisoɔ yi so J.H. Owusu-Acheampong a na ɔfiri National Democratic Congress (NDC) amanyɔkuo no mu, Kofi Kumi Atta-Frimpong a na ɔno nso firi Convention People's Party (CPP) amanyɔkuo no mu, Dickson Kofi Nuako a na ɔno nso firi ɛyɛ National Reform Party(NRP) ɛne Andrews Hinneh a na ɔno nso firi ɛyɛ United Ghana Movement (UGM) amanyɔkuo no nso mu. Wei ne mma a wɔn mu biara nyaaeɛ wɔ saa abatoɔ no mu, mma mpem du-mmienu aha-mmiensa ne aduokron-mmiensa (12,393 votes), mma aha-mmienu ne aduosia-mmienu (262 votes), mma aha-mmienu ne aduonum-baako (251 votes) ɛne mma aduokron-nnan (94 votes). Wei ne ɔha nkyekyemu susupɛn a edidisoɔ yi na ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ aduasa-nnan ne akyiripɔ aduonu (34.20%), hwee ne akyiripɔ aduoson (0.70%), hwee ne akyiripɔ nson(0.7%) ɛne hwee ne akyiripɔ mmiensa (0.3%) wɔ mma a wɔn tooeɛ no deɛ wɔn gye too mu sɛ ɛyɛ no nyinaa mu no. Effah Dartey wɔ too aba maa no bɛyɛɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ New Patriotic Party (NPP) amanyɔkuo no tumi krataa so. Na ne mpɛsoa no ka mmarahyɛbadwafie nkonwa du-nan (14) a New Patriotic Party (NPP) amanyɔkuo nyaa de firii mmarahyɛbadwam nkonwa aduonu-baako (21) wɔ Bono ne Ahafo mantam no mu wɔ Ghana. Wɔ ne nyinaa mu no New Patriotic Party (NPP) amanyɔkuo na ɛnyaa Mmarahyɛbadwafie nkonwa no mu kɛseɛ a ne dodoɔ ne ɔha (100) de firii mmarahyɛbadwam nkonwa aha-mmienu no mu wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtoso mmiensa wɔ Adehyeman Ghana amammuo a ɛtoso nnan no mu.

2004 Elections 
Effah Dartey Wɔn sanso too aba maa no kɔɔ mmarahyɛbadwafie sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani de maa Berekum abatoɔ mpɛsoa no so foɔ wɔ ne mprenusoɔ ɛwɔ mfie mpem mmienu ne nnan ɔman Ghana nyinaa abatoɔ no mu. Ɔno na ɔgyina maa saa abatoɔ mpɛsoa no so foɔ wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtoso nnan wɔ Adehyeman Ghana amammuo a ɛtoso nnan no mu. Wɔn de mma mpem aduonu-nwɔtwe aha-num ne aduosia-baako (28,561 votes) na yii no na onyaa saa mma yi de firii ɛyɛ mma dodoɔ mpem aduanan-nson aha- nsia ne aduasa-num (47637 votes) wɔ mma a wɔn tooeɛ no deɛ wɔn gye too mu sɛ ɛyɛ no nyinaa mu no.Wei ne ɔha nkyekyemu susupɛn yi na ɛyɛ pɛ aduosia ne akyiripɔ hwee (60.0%) wɔ mma a wɔn tooeɛ no deɛ wɔn gye too mu sɛ ɛyɛ no nyinaa mu. Wɔn too aba maa no sɛ nkunimdifoɔ wɔ onnipa baako pɛ so a ɔno ne Stephen Oppong a na ɔfiri National Democratic Congress (NDC) amanyɔkuo no mu. Ɔno nso nyaa mma a wɔn tooeɛ no mu mpem du-nkron ne aduoson- nnan (19,074 votes)  wɔ mma a wɔn tooeɛ no deɛ wɔn gye too mu sɛ ɛyɛ no nyinaa mu.Wei nso ne ɔha nkyekyemu susupɛn aduanan ne akyiripɔ hwee (40.0%) na ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ wɔ aba wɔn tooeɛ no ɛmu deɛ wɔn gye too mu sɛ ɛyɛ no nyinaa mu no. Effah Dartey Wɔn sanso too aba maa no biom wɔ New Patriotic Party (NPP) amanyɔkuo no tumi krataa so. Na ne mpɛsoa no ka mmarahyɛbadwafie nkonwa du-nan (14) a New Patriotic Party (NPP) amanyɔkuo no nyaaeɛ de firii mmarahyɛbadwam nkonwa aduonu-nan (24) no ho wɔ Bono ne Ahafo mantam no mu wɔ Ghana ɛwɔ saa abatoɔ no mu. Wɔ ne nyinaa mu no New Patriotic Party NPP amanyɔkuo no na ɛnyaa Mmarahyɛbadwafie nkonwa no mu dodoɔ no ara a ɛyɛ ɔha ne du-nan (114) de firii ɛyɛ mmarahyɛbadwam nkonwa aha-mmienu ne aduasa (230) no mu wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtoso nnan wɔ Adehyeman Ghana amammuo a ɛtoso nnan no mu (4th Parliament of the 4th Republic).

Ankorɛankorɛ Abrabɔ

Effah Dartey yɛ owarefoɔ a ɔwɔ mma nnan. Ɔyɛ okristoni.

Bea me nyaa mmoa firiieɛ

title: Paul Okoh
text:
Paul Okoh yɛ Ghana  amanaman mu nkutahodiefoɔ (Ghanaian Diplomat )  a ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party (NPP) amanyɔkuo a ɛwɔ Ghana no kuoba. Seisei ara yi ɔno ne Ɔman Ghana ananmusini  wɔ Egypt man no mu (Ambassador to Egypt).

Abrabɔ Ahyɛaseɛ ne Nwomasua 
Okoh  Wɔn woo no wɔ ɛyɛ Ɔgyefoɔ bosome no ne da a ɛtɔso aduonu-mmienu wɔ afe apem aha-nkron ne aduanan-nkron (22nd February 1949).ɔfiri Kenyasi nɔma wan (Kenyasi no1) a ɛwɔ Bono ne Ahafo mantam no mu wɔ Ghana(Brong Ahafo Region of Ghana ). Onyas sukuupɔn abɔdin krataa Diploma ɛne suapɔn abɔdin krataa a ɛdikae wɔ nwomasua ne Ɔsom  (both Diploma and Bachelor of Education and Religion) de firii ɛyɛ Oguaa  Suapɔn Sukuu (University of Cape Coast ).

Adwuma 
Okoh  yɛ nwomanimfoɔ  (Educationists ). Na ɔyɛ ɔkwankyerɛfoɔ abɛdiakyire  ɛne ɔpanin a ɔda Dompase ntoasoɔ sukuu (Dompoase Secondary Scholl )  ano n o abɛdiakyire (Assistant Headmaster ) a ɛwɔ Dompoase  Adansi.

Amanfoforɔso Ananmusie 
Wɔ kitawonsa bosome wɔ mfie mpem mmienu ne du-nson (July 2017) no mu no Ɔman Panin Nana Akuffo-Addo bɔ Paul Okoh din sɛ Ghana man no ananmusini wɔ Egypt man no mu (Ghana's Ambassador to Egypt). Na ɔka Ghanafoɔ suronko aduonu-mmienu a yɛ bɔɔ wɔn din sɛ wɔn mmɛyɛ animdifoɔ mma Ghana ne amanaman ahodoɔ  ho nkɔmodie ne botaeɛ wɔ wiase aman nyinaa so no ho.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Okoh yɛ New Patriotic Party (NPP) amanyɔkuo no ba. Na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani de ma Asutifi Atifi afam abatoɔ mpɛsoa no so (Asutifi North Constituency ) wɔ Bono ne Ahafo mantam no mu (Brong Ahafo Region of Ghana) a ɛwɔ Ghana.Wei ne Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtɔso mmiensa, ɛnnan ne ɛnum wɔ Adehyeman Ghana amanmuo a ɛtɔso nnan no mu. (3rd, 4th and 5th parliaments of the 4th republic of Ghana).

2000 Abatoɔ 
Wɔ ɛyɛ mfie mpem mmienu mu no (2000), Okoh yɛ nkunimdifoɔ wɔ Ɔman Ghana nyinaa anaasɛ ɔmanmu nyinaa abatoɔ no mu (Ghanaian general elections) sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani  a ɔgyina hɔ ms ɛyɛ Asutifi Atifi fam abatoɔ mpɛsoa no so foɔ (Asutifi North constituency) wɔ Bono ne Ahafo mantam no mu wɔ Ghana (Brong Ahafo Region of Ghana). Ɔdii nkunim wɔ New Patriotic Party (NPP) amanyɔkuo no tumi krataa do a ne ɔgyina hɔ ma Asutifi Atifi fam abatoɔ mpɛsoaso (Asutifi North constituency) ɛwɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtɔso mmiensa wɔ Adehyeman Ghana amammuo a ɛtɔso nnan (3rd parliament of the 4th republic of Ghana). Okoh mpɛsoa no ka mmarahyɛbadwafie nkonwa du-nnan (14) a New Patriotic Party (NPP) amanyɔkuo no dii so nkunim de firii mmarahyɛbadwam nkonwa aduonu-baako (21) no mu no ho bi wɔ saa  abatoɔ a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Bono ne Ahafo mantam no mu (Brong Ahafo Region). Ɛyɛ New Patriotic Party (NPP) amanyɔkuo no dii nkunim nyaa mmarahyɛbadwafie nkonwa ɛmufa  kɛseɛ a na ne dodoɔ nyinaa yɛ ɔha (100) de firii mmarahyɛbadwa nkonwa aha-mmienu (200) no mu wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtɔso mmiensa wɔ Adehyeman Ghana amanmuo a ɛtɔso so nnan no mu. (3rd parliament of the 4th republic of Ghana).Okoh wɔn de mma mpem nson aha-nsia ne aduowɔtwe-mmienu (7,682 votes) de firii mma mpem du-num ahankron ne aduoson-nwɔtwe (15,978 votes) wɔ mma a wɔn tooeɛ no,ɛmufa dodoɔ a wɔn gye too mu sɛ ɛyɛ no nyinaa mu. Wei ne ɔha nkyekyɛmu susupɛn aduanan-nkron ne akyiripɔ baako (49.1%) na ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ wɔ mma a wɔn tooeɛ no deɛ wɔn gye too mu dɛ ɛyɛ no nyinaa mu. Wɔn too aba maa no sɛ nkunimdifoɔ wɔ wɔn a ɛdidisoɔ yi so  Baah Danquah Emmanuel a na ɔfiri  National Democratic Congress (NDC) amanyɔkuo no mu,  Georges Nsiah-Afriyie a ɔno kɔ gyina kontenkorɔ  sɛ wɔn nto ne so aba (independent candidate), Norbert Anane-Nyarko a na ɔno nso firii ɛyɛ Convention People's Party (CPP) amanyɔkuo no mu ɛne Darkwa Anthony a na ɔno nso firi National Reform Party (NRP) amanyɔkuo no mu. Wei ne mma a wɔn mu biara nyaaeɛ  mma mpem nsia aha-nwɔtwe ne aduokron-num (6,895), ahankron ne nsia (906), ɔha ne aduanan-nson (147) ɛne mma hwee (0) wɔ mma wɔn tooeɛ no deɛ wɔn gye too mu sɛ ɛyɛ no nyinaa mu. Ne wei mo nso ne ɔha nkyekyɛmu susupɛn a ɛdidisoɔ yi na ɛyɛ pɛ aduanan-nnan ne akyiripɔ baako (44.1%,), ɛnum ne akyiripɔ nwɔtwe (5.8%), hwee ne akyiripɔ nkron (0.9%) ɛne hwee (0%) wɔ mma wɔn tooeɛ no nyinaa deɛ wɔn gye too mu sɛ ɛyɛ no nyinaa mu.

2004 Abatoɔ 
Wɔ mfie mpem mmienu Ɔman Ghana nyinaa abatoɔ no mu no (2004 Ghanaian general elections), Okoh wɔn too aba maa no kɔɔ mmarahyɛbadwafie sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔgyina hɔ ma Asutifi Atifi fam abatoɔ mpɛsoa no so wɔ ne mprɛnusoɔ (Asutifi North constituency).Odii nkunim wɔ abatoɔ no mu New Patriotic Party (NPP) amanyɔkuo no tumi krataa so. Okoh mpɛsoa no ka mmarahyɛbadwafie nkonwa du-nan (14) a New Patriotic Party (NPP) amanyɔkuo no nyaa de firii ɛyɛ mmarahyɛbadwam nkonwa aduonu-nan (24) no mu wɔ Bono ne Ahafo mantam no mu (Brong Ahafo Region). Ɛyɛ New Patriotic Party (NPP) amanyɔkuo na wɔn nyaa ɛyɛ mmarahyɛbadwafie nkonwa no mu fa kɛseɛ a na ne dodoɔ yɛ ɔha ne aduonu-nwɔtwe (128) de firii mmarahyɛbadwam nkonwa aha-mmienu ne aduasa  (230) no mu ɛwɔ saa abatoɔ no mu. Okoh wɔ de mma mpem nkron aha-nson ne aduanan-baako (9,741votes) de firii ɛyɛ mpem du-nwɔtwe aha-mmienu ne aduonu-nsia (18,226) wɔ mma wɔn tooeɛ no nyinaa deɛ wɔn gye too mu sɛ ɛyɛ no nyinaa mu, na wri ne ɔha nkyekyɛmu susupɛn aha-num ne akyiripɔ aduasa (53.40%) wɔ mma a wɔn tooeɛ no nyinaa mu no deɛ wɔn gye too mu sɛ ɛyɛ no nyinaa mu. Wɔn too aba yii no sɛ nkunimdifoɔ wɔ wɔn a ɛdidisoɔ yi so Samuel Nana Asamoah a na ɔfiri  Convention People's Party (CPP) amanyɔkuo no mu ɛne Eric Addae a na ɔno nso fir ɛyɛ National Democratic Congress (NDC) amanyɔkuo no mu. Wei ɔha nkyekyɛmu baako ne akyiripɔ hwee (1.00%) ɛne aduanan-num ne akyiripɔ aduosia (45.60%) wɔ mma a wɔn tooeɛ no deɛ wɔn gye too mu sɛ ɛyɛ no nyinaa mu.

2008 Abatoɔ 
Wɔ mfie mpem mmienu ne nwɔtwe Ɔman Ghana abatoɔ a ɛkɔɔso wɔ Ghana afanaa nyinaa no (2008 Ghanaian general elections), Okoh wɔn de mma mpem du ne aduonu-nwɔtwe (10,028 votes) na ɛyii no na onyaa de firii mma mpem aduonu ahankron ne du-nson (20,917) wɔ mma a wɔn gye too mu sɛ ɛyɛ no nyinaa mu. Na Wei ne ɔha nkyekyɛmu susupɛn aduanan-nson ne akyiripɔ nkron (47.9%) na ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ wɔ mma a wɔn gye too mu sɛ ɛyɛ no nyinaa mu.Wɔ too aba maa no sɛ nkunimdifoɔ wɔ wɔn a ɛdidisoɔ yi so Eric Addae a na ɔfiri National Democratic Congress (NDC) amanyɔkuo no mu, Emmanuel Osei Kofi a na ɔno nso firi ɛyɛ Democratic Freedom Party (DFP) amanyɔkuo no mu, Yaa Durowaa a ɔno nso firi Democratic People's Party (DPP), amanyɔkuo no mu,Badu Augustine a ɔno nso na ɔfiri  Convention People's Party (CPP) amanyɔkuo no mu ɛne Patrick Kennus Boakye a ɔno nso kɔ gyinaeɛ sɛ kontenkorɔ (independent candidate). Deɛ ɛdidisoɔ yi ne ɔha nkyekyɛmu susupɛn a wɔn mu biara nyaaeɛ na ɛyɛ pɛ aduanan -baako ne akyiripɔ aduosia (41.60%), hwee ne akyiripɔ aduonum-nson (0.57%), hwee ne akyiripɔ aduonu-baako (0.21%) hwee ne akyiripɔ aduosia-nnan (0.64%) ɛne nkron ne akyiripɔ num (9.05%) wɔ mma a wɔn gye too mu no nyinaa mu wɔ mfie mpem mmienu ne nwɔtwe Ɔman Ghana nyinaa abatoɔ no mu (2008 Ghanaian general elections).

Ankorɛankorɛ Abrabɔ 
Okoh yɛ ɔwarefoɔ a ɔwɔ mma nkron (9 children). Ɔyɛ okristoni a ɔyɛ Roman Asore ( Catholic Church) kuo no ba a ɔne wɔn na ɛsom.

title: Prince Oduro-Mensah
text:
Prince Oduro-Mensah yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ɛne Mmarahyɛbadwani a na ɔka Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtɔso mmiensa wɔ Adehyeman Ghana amammuo a ɛtɔso nnan (3rd Parliament of the 4th Republic of Ghana) a ɔgyina hɔ ma Techiman Anaafoɔfam abatoɔ mpɛsoaso (Techiman South Constituency) wɔ Bono ne Ahafo mantam no mu wɔ Ghana.

Abrabɔ Ahyɛaseɛ ne Nwomasua 
Mensah Wɔn woo wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduonum-nwɔtwe  (1958) wɔ Techiman Anaafoɔfam (Techiman South) a ekuro bi wɔ Bono ne Ahafo mantam no mu wɔ Ghana (Brong Ahafo Region of Ghana). Ɔkɔɔ sukuu wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Abɔdeɛ Nyansapɛ ne nimdeɛ sononko  (Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology) na onyaa suapɔn abɔdin krataa a ɛdikan (Degree). Ɔsan nso kɔɔ sukuu wɔ nwomasua ne nimdeɛpɛ suapɔn a ɛwɔ Winneba (University of Education, Winneba) na onyaa suapɔn abɔdin krataa  Diploma wɔ Social Science (abɔdeɛ nyansapɛ) ɛne  (English Education) brofo nimdeɛpɛ.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Mensah wɔn too aba maa no kɔɔ mmarahyɛbedwafie deɛ ɛdikan wɔ New Patriotic Party (NPP) amanyɔkuo no tumi krataa so wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa bosome no mu wɔ mfie mpem mmienu Ɔman Ghana nyinaa abatoɔ a wɔn toɔ no mu. (December 2000 Ghanaian General Elections) wɔ Techiman Anaafoɔfam abatoɔ mpɛsoaso (Techiman South Constituency) wɔ Bono ne Ahafo mantam no mu wɔ Ghana (Brong Ahafo Region of Ghana). Onyaa mma no mu mpem du-nson aha-mmiensa ne aduonum (17,350 votes) de firii mma mpem aduasa-nkron ɔha ne aduasa-nson (39,137 votes) wɔ mma a wɔn tooeɛ no deɛ wɔn gye too mu sɛ ɛyɛ no nyinaa mu na wei gyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyemu aduanan-nnan ne akyiripɔ aduasa (44.30%).Ɔdii nkunim New Patriotic Party (NPP) amanyɔkuo no tumi krataa so wɔ Techiman Anaafoɔfam abatoɔ mpɛsoaso (Techiman South Constituency) wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtɔso mmiensa wɔ Adehyeman Ghana amammuo a ɛtɔso nnan no mu (3rd parliament of the 4th republic of Ghana). Mensah abatoɔ mpɛsoa no ka mmarahyɛbadwafie nkonwa du-nan (14) a New Patriotic Party (NPP) nyaa de firii mmarahyɛbadwam nkonwa aduonu-nnan (24)  no ho wɔ saa abatoɔ no mu wɔ Bono ne Ahafo mantam no mu wɔ Ghana (Brong Ahafo Region of Ghana). Ɛyɛ New Patriotic Party (NPP) amanyɔkuo no a ɛnyaa mmarahyɛbadwan nkonwa no mu fa kɛseɛ a na ne dodoɔ nyinaa yɛ ɔha (100) de firii mmarahyɛbadwam nkonwa aha-mmienu (200) wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtɔso mmiensa wɔ Adehyeman Ghana amammuo a ɛtɔso nnan no mu (3rd parliament of the 4th republic of Ghana).Wɔn too aba yii no sɛ nkunimdifoɔ wɔ wɔn ɛdidisoɔ yi so Kwadwo Maama Adam a na ɔfiri National Democratic Congress (NDC) , Joshua Kwame Owusu-Brempong kontenkorɔ  (independent candidate), Moses Kofi Boakye of the Convention People's Party (CPP), Afrifa Okyere Benjamin a na ɔfiri United Ghana Movement Party (UGM) ɛne Kofi Boakye Saarah-Mensah a na ɔno nso firi National Reform Party (NRP). Deɛ edidisoɔ yi ne mma a wɔn mu biara nyaaeɛ mpem du-nsia ahankron ne aduasa-nsia (16,936),  mpem mmiensa aha-nan ne aduisia-num (3,465), ahankron ne aduokron (990), aha-mmienu ne aduoson-mmiensa (273) ɛne ɔha ne aduonu-mmiensa (123) wɔ mma a wɔn tooeɛ no deɛ wɔn gye too mu no nyinaa mu. Wei ne ɔha nkyekyemu susupɛn a edidisoɔ yi so na ɛyɛ pɛ aduanan-mmiensa ne akyiripɔ aduasa 43.30%) , nwɔtwe ne akyiripɔ aduokron (8.90%), mmienu ne akyiripɔ aduonum (2 .50%) , hwee ne akyiripɔ aduoson (0.70%), ɛne hwee ne akyiripɔ aduasa (0.30%) wɔ mma a wɔn tooeɛ no deɛ wɔn gye too mu sɛ ɛyɛ no nyinaa mu.

Adwuma 
Mensah akane Mmarahyɛbadwani de ma Techiman Anaafoɔfam abatoɔ mpɛsoaso  (Techiman South Constituency) wɔ Bono ne Ahafo mantam wɔ Ghana in the (Brong Ahafo Region of Ghana).

title: Stephen Adoma-yeboah
text:
Stephen Adoma-Yeboah yɛ Ghana amanyɔni a na ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani de ma Dormaa Apueɛ (Dormaa East) abatoɔ mpɛsoa no so (Constituency) foɔ wɔ Bono ne Ahafo mantam no mu (Brong Ahafo Region of Ghana) wɔ Ghana. Na ɔka Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtɔso mmiensa wɔ Adehyeman Ghana amammuo a ɛtɔso nnan no mu.(3rd parliament of the4th republic of Ghana).

Abrabɔ Ahyɛaseɛ ne Sukuu 
Adoma-Yeboah yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ɛne Mmarahyɛbadwani a na ɔno na ɔgyina hɔ ma Dormaa Apueɛ Dormaa East abatoɔ mpɛsoa no so Constituency. Wɔn woo no wɔ Ɔman Ghana mu na ɔkɔɔ sukuu wɔ Ghana a onyaa  suapɔn abɔdin krataa : B.SC/LLB (Hons).

Amanyɔsɛm  
Adoma-Yeboah yɛ New Patriotic Party(NPP) amanyɔkuo no ba. Wɔn too aba yii no kɔɔ Mmarahyɛbadwafie sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔgyina hɔ ma Dormaa Apueɛ (Dormaa East constituency ) abatoɔ mpɛsoa no so wɔ Bono ne Ahafo mantam wɔ Ghana (Brong Ahafo Region of Ghana) wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtɔso mmiensa wɔ Adehyeman Ghana amammuo a ɛtɔso nnan no mu (3rd parliament of the 4th republic of Ghana).  Yaw Ntow Ababio na ɛdii n'adeɛ ɛwɔ mfie mpem mmienu ne nnan Ghana man nyinaa abatoɔ no mu (2004 Ghanaian General election).

Abatoɔ 
Adoma-Yeboah yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ɛne Mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔgyina hɔ ma Dormaa Apueɛ (Dormaa East) abatoɔ mpɛsoa no so (Constituency) wɔ mfie mpem mmienu Ɔman Ghana abatoɔ no mu (2000Ghanaian General Elections).  Wɔn too aba yii no sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ New Patriotic Party (NPP) amanyɔkuo no tumi krataa so.  Na ne mpɛsoa no ka mmarahyɛbadwafie nkonwa du-nan a New Patriotic Party (NPP) amanyɔkuo no nyaasɛ de firii mmarahyɛbadwam nkonwa aduonu-baako no mu wɔ saa abatoɔ no mu wɔ Bono ne Ahafo mantam no mu. New Patriotic Party NPP amanyɔkuo no na ɛnyaa Mmarahyɛbadwafie nkonwa no mu deɛ ɛdɔɔso a ne dodoɔ nyinaa yɛ ɔha (100) de firii mmarahyɛbadwam nkonwa aha-mmienu (200) no mu wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtɔso mmiensa no mu wɔ Adehyeman Ghana amammuo a ɛtɔso nnan no mu. Wɔn de mma mpem nkron aha-nson ne aduowɔtwe-mmienu (9,782 votes na ɛyii no de firii mma mpem du-nsia ne ɔha ne aduasa-nwɔtwe (16,138 votes) wɔ mma a wɔn tooeɛ no deɛ wɔn gye too mu sɛ ɛyɛ no nyinaa mu. Wei ne ɔha nkyekyemu susupɛn aduosia ne akyiripɔ nkron (60.9%) wɔ mma a wɔn tooeɛ no deɛ wɔn gye too mu sɛ ɛyɛ no nyinaa na ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ. Wɔn too aba yii no sɛ nkunimdifoɔ wɔ wɔn a ɛdidisoɔ yi so  Nicholas Kwabena Agyei-Kyereme a na ɔfiri National Democratic Congress (NDC) amanyɔkuo no mu, Obeng Kwasi Emmanuel a na ɔno nso firi ɛyɛ National Reform Party (NRP) amanyɔkuo no mu ɛne Kyeremeh Addae Hinneh a na ɔno nso firi ɛyɛ Convention People's Party (CPP) amanyɔkuo no mu.  Deɛ ɛdidisoɔ yi ne mma a wɔn mu biara nyaaeɛ wɔ abatoɔ no mu, mpem nnum aha-num ne aduokron-nkron  (5,599 votes), aha-mmiensa ne aduokron-nson (397 votes) ɛne mma aha-mmienu ne aduokron-baako (291 votes) wɔ mma a wɔn tooeɛ no deɛu wɔn gye too mu sɛ ɛyɛ no nyinaa mu. Wei ne ɔha nkyekyemu susupɛn a edidisoɔ yi na ɛyɛ pɛ aduasa-nnan akyiripɔ nwɔtwe     ( 34.8%), mmienu ne akyiripɔ nnum (2.5%) ɛne baako ne akyiripɔ nwɔtwe (1.8%) wɔ mma a wɔn tooeɛ no deɛ wɔn gye too mu sɛ ɛyɛ no nyinaa mu.

Ankorɛankorɛ Abrabɔ 
Adoma-Yeboah yɛ okristoni.

title: Yaw Asiedu Mensah
text:
Yaw Asiedu Mensah yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ɛne Mmarahyɛbadwani a na ɔgyina hɔ ma Dormaa Atoeɛ (Dormaa West) abatoɔ mpɛsoa no so (Constituency) wɔ Bono ne Ahafo mantam no mu wɔ Ghana (Brong Ahafo Region of Ghana).

Abrabɔ Ahyɛasɛ ne Nwomasua 
iedu Mensah wɔn woo no wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome no ne da aduonu-nsia wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduasa-nkron (26th January 1939). Ɔwɔ GCE A Level abɔdin krataa wɔ nimdeɛ pɛ mu (GCE A Level in Education).

Adwuma 
Asiedu Mensah yɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ.

Amanyɔsɛm Adwuma

2000 Abatoɔ 
Asiedu Mensah dii nkae kɔɔ mmarahyɛbadwafie sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔgyina hɔ ma Dormaa Atoeɛ (Dormaa West) abatoɔ mpɛsoa no so ( constituency) wɔ mmerɛ a ɔdii nkunim wɔ mfie mpem mmienu mpɛsoaso abatoɔ no mu wɔ Ɔman Ghana nyinaa abatoɔ no mu (2000 Ghanaian genera l elections).Ɔgyina hɔ sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani de ma mpɛsoa no so foɔ wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtɔso mmiensa wɔ Adehyeman Ghana amammuo a ɛtɔso nnan no mu (3rd parliament of the 4th Republic of Ghana). Asiedu-Mensah wɔ n de mma mpem aduonu aha-mmiensa ne aduasa-baako (20,331votes) a ɛfiri ɛyɛ mma mpem aduanan aha-nsia ne aduisia-num (40,665 votes) a ɛno ne aba a wɔn tooeɛ no ɛmu fa dodoɔ a wɔn gye too mu sɛ ɛyɛ no nyinaa no na ɛyii noɔ. Na wei gyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyemu aaduonum ne akyiripɔ hwee (50.0%) 

wɔ mma a wɔn gye too mu sɛ ɛy ɛ no nyinaa muWɔn too aba maa no sɛ nkunimdifoɔ wɔ wɔn a ɛdidisoɔ yi so Thomas Kwame Yeboah a na ɔfiri National Democratic Congress (NDC) amanyɔkuo no mu, Dr. Solomon Anso Manson a ɔgyinaeɛ sɛ kontenkorɔ (independent candidate), Chou-En-Lai Paul Ankomah a na ɔno nso firi National Reform Party (NRP), Kofi Adu-Gyamfi a ɔno nso firi Convention People's Party (CPP), amanyɔkuo no mu,Christopher AA-Bagme a ɔno nso firi People's National Convention (PNC) amanyɔkuo no mu ɛne Arhin Seth Asante a na ɔno nso firi ɛyɛ United Ghana Movement (UGM) amanyɔkuo no mu. Deɛ edidisoɔ yi ne mma a wɔn mu biara nyaaeɛ mma mpem du-nson aha-nsia ne du-nwɔtwe (17,618 votes), mma apem ne aduowɔtwe-nwɔtwe,(1,088votes), mma aha-num ne aduowɔtwe-nwɔtwe (588votes), mma aha-nan ne aduosia (460votes), aha-mmiensa ne aduosia-nkron (369votes) ɛne mma aha-mmienu ne du-baako (211 votes) de firii mma a wɔn gye too mu sɛ ɛyɛ no nyinaa mu. Wei ne ɔha nkyekyemu susupɛn a edidisoɔ yi na ɛyɛ pɛ aduanan-mmiensa ne akyiripɔ mmiensa (43.3%), mmienu ne akyiripɔ nson (2.7%), baako ne akyiripɔ nnan (1.4%), baako ne akyiripɔ baako (1.1%), hwee ne akyiripɔ nkron (0.9%) ɛne  hwee ne akyiripɔ nnum (0.5%) wɔ mma a wɔn tooeɛ no deɛ wɔn gye too mu sɛ ɛyɛ no nyinaa mu. Asiedu-Mensah wɔn too aba maa no wɔ New Patriotic Party (NPP) amanyɔkuo no tumi krataa so. Na ne mpɛsoa no ka mmarahyɛbadwafie nkonwa du-nan (14) a New Patriotic Party NPP nyaa de firii mmarahyɛbadwam nkonwa aduonu-baako (21) no mu wɔ saa abatoɔ no mu wɔ Bono ne Ahafo mantam no mu (Brong Ahafo Regon of Ghana). Wɔ ne nyinaa mu no New Patriotic Party (NPP) amanyɔkuo no na ɛnyaa Mmarahyɛbadwafie nkonwa no mu fa kɛseɛ a na ne dodoɔ nyinaa yɛ ɔha (100) de firii mmarahyɛbadwam nkonwa no aha-mmienu (200) no mu wɔ Ɔman Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtɔso mmiensa wɔ Adehyeman Ghana amammuo a ɛtɔso nnan no mu (3rd parliament of the 4th Republic of hana).

2004 Abatoɔ 
Asiedu Mensah wɔn sanso too aba maa no kɔɔ Mmarahyɛbadwafie ne mprenusoɔ de maa Dormaa Atoeɛ (Dormaa West) abatoɔ mpɛsoa (Constituency) no so foɔ wɔ mfie mpem mmienu ne nan Ɔman Ghana nyinaa abatoɔ no mu (2004 Ghanaian General Elections).Ɔgyina hɔ sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani de maa abatoɔ mpɛsoa no so foɔ (Constituency) wɔ Ɔman Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtɔso nnan wɔ Adehyeman Ghana amammuo a ɛtɔso nnan no mu (4th parliament of the 4th republic of Ghana). Asiedu-Mensah Wɔn de mma mpem aduonu-mmiensa aha-nson ne aduosia-nan (23,764 votes) de firii mma mpem aduanan-nson aha-nan ne du-mmienu (47,412) wɔ mma a wɔn tooeɛ no deɛ wɔn gye too mu sɛ ɛyɛ no nyinaa mu. Wei ne ɔha nkyekyemu aduonum ne akyiripɔ baako (50.1%) wɔ mma a wɔn tooeɛ no deɛ wɔn gye too mu sɛ ɛyɛ no nyinaa mu. Wɔn too aba yii no sɛ nkunimdifoɔ wɔ wɔn a ɛdidisoɔ yi so Oppong Asamoah Vincent a na ɔfiri National Democratic Congress (NDC) amanyɔkuo no mu ɛne Kwadwo Agyei-Dwomor a na ɔno nso firi ɛyɛ Democratic People's Party (DPP).Deɛ edidisoɔ yi ne mma a wɔn mu biara nyaaeɛ mma mpem aduonu-mmienu aha-nsia ne baako (22,601 votes) ɛne mma apem ɛne aduanan-nson (1,047 votes) wɔ mma a wɔn tooeɛ no deɛ wɔn gye too mu sɛ ɛyɛ no nyinaa mu. 4.5 Wei ne ɔha nkyekyemu susupɛn aduanan-nson ne akyiripɔ nson (47.7%) ɛne mmienu ne akyiripɔ mmienu (2.2%) wɔ mma a wɔn tooeɛ no deɛ wɔn gye too mu sɛ ɛyɛ no nyinaa mu. Asiedu-Mensah wɔn too aba maa no wɔ  New Patriotic Party (NPP) amanyɔkuo no tumi krataa so. Na ne mpɛsoa (constituency) no ka mmarahyɛbadwafie nkonwa du-nan (14) a New Patriotic Party (NPP) amanyɔkuo no nyaaeɛ de firii mmarahyɛbadwam nkonwa aduonu-nnan wɔ Bono ne Ahafo mantam no mu  (Brong Ahafo region of Ghana) wɔ saa abatoɔ no mu. Wɔ ne nyinaa mu no  New Patriotic Party (NPP) amanyɔkuo no na ɛnyaa Mmarahyɛbadwafie nkonwa no mu fa kɛseɛ a na ne dodoɔ nyinaa yɛ ɔha ne du-nan (114) de firii mmarahyɛbadwam nkonwa aha-mmienu ne aduasa (230) no mu wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtɔso nnan wɔ Adehyeman Ghana amammuo a ɛtɔso nnan no mu. (4th parliament of the 4th republic of Ghana).

title: Yaw Effah-Baafi
text:
Yaw Effah-Baafi wɔn woo no wɔ ɛyɛ Ɛbɔ bosome no ne da a ɛtɔso aduonu-baako wɔ mfie apem ahankron ne aduonum-nnum (born 21 September 1955) a someɛ sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani de maa Kintampo Anaafoɔfam (Kintampo South) wɔ Bono ne Ahafo mantam wɔ Ghana (Brong Ahafo Region of Ghana).

Abrabɔ Ahyɛaseɛ ne Nwomasua 
Effah-Baafi wɔn woo no wɔ ɛyɛ Ɛbɔ bosome no ne da a ɛtɔso aduonu-baako wɔ mfie apem ahankron ne aduonum-nnum (21 September 1955 ) ɛwɔ Tanfiano No. 2 wɔ Bono ne Ahafo mantam no mu (Brong Ahafo Region). ɔkɔɔ sukuu wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Abɔdeɛ Nyansapɛ ne nimdeɛ sononko Suapɔn no mu (Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology (KNUST) ɛhɔ na onyaa suapɔn abɔdin krataa BSc wɔ Kuadwuma mu wɔ mfie apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe-nnum (BSc in Agriculture in 1985). Na ɔsan nso wie sukuu wɔ (Ghana institute of Management and Public Administration)(GIMPA) ɛhɔ ne bea a onyaa  (postgraduate certificate in Administration) wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron-nson (1997) ɛne EMGL wɔ mfie mpem mmienu ne nwɔtwe (2008).

Adwuma 
Effah-Baafi yɛ okuani (agriculturist). Na ɔyɛ mantam mu panin de ma ɛyɛ On-Fam trial wɔ MOFA. (Regional Coordinator for On-Farm trial in MOFA). Ɔsanso yɛɛ adwuma sɛ ɔpanin a ɔda Kintampo nkurankura sika korabea adwumakuo no (board chairman of Kintampo Rural Bank).

Amanyɔsɛm 
Effah-Baafi yɛ National Democratic Congress (NDC) amanyɔkuo no ba Na ɔyɛ ɔman suafoɔ abɛdeakyire de  ma asuaeɛ wɔn hwɛ nnuane, nfudeɛ ne kuadwuma so (Deputy Minister in the Ministry of Food and Agriculture). Na ɔsan nso yɛ ɔman suafoɔ abɛdeakyire de ma asuaeɛ ɛhwɛ ahensie ne amammerɛ nkutahodie wɔ Ghana (Deputy Minister in the Ministry of Chieftaincy and Traditional Affairs Ghana). Wɔn too aba maa no sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome no mu wɔ mfie mpem mmienu ne baako no mu na ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani mprɛ nnam so. Na ɔka ɔkuo a wɔn hwɛ ɛkwan a yɛ bɛ fa so atu ohia ase (Poverty Reduction Strategy), akwan ne akwantuo (Road and Transport), ɔhyɛ akwan a yɛ gyinaso yɛ adwuma kuo(Standing Orders Committee), ekuo a wɔn hwɛ mmera ɛgyina amansan nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛmfiri Mmarahyɛbadwam (Subsidiary Legislation Committee).

Abatoɔ

Mfie Mpem Mmienu Abatoɔ (2000 abatoɔ) 
Wɔ mfie mpem mmienu (2000), Effah Baafi dii nkunim wɔ Ɔman Ghana nyinaa abatoɔ no mu sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani de maa Kintampo Anaafoɔfam abatoɔ mpɛsoaso wɔ Bono ne Ahafo mantam no mu wɔ Ghana (Brong Ahafo Region of Ghana). Ɔdii nkunim wɔ  National Democratic Congress (NDC) amanyɔkuo no tumi krataa so. Na ne mpɛsoa no ka mmarahyɛbadwafie nkonwa nson (7)  a National Democratic Congress (NDC) amanyɔkuo no nyaaeɛ de ɛyɛ mmarahyɛbadwam nkonwa aduonu-baako (21) no mu wɔ saa abatoɔ no mu wɔ Bono ne Ahafo mantam no mu (Brong Ahafo Region). National Democratic Congress (NDC) amanyɔkuo no na ɛnyaa Mmarahyɛbadwafie nkonwa no mu ketewa a na de dodoɔ nyinaa yɛ aduokron-mmienu (92) de firii mmarahyɛbadwam nkonwa aha-mmienu (200) wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtɔso mmiensa wɔ Adehyeman Ghana amammuo a ɛtɔso nnan no mu (3rd Parliament of the the 4th Republic of Ghana). Wɔn de mma mpem du-nnan ɔha ne aduasa-nnan(14,134 ) na yii no sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani de firii ɛyɛ mma mpem aduanan-nnum aha-nwɔtwe ne baako (45,801) wɔ mma a wɔn gye too mu sɛ ɛyɛ no nyinaa mu. Wei ne ɔha nkyekyemu susupɛn aduasa-mmienu ne akyiripɔ hwee (32.0% ) na ɛyɛ pɛ wɔ mma a wɔn gye too mu sɛ ɛyɛ no nyinaa mu. Wɔn too aba maa no sɛ nkunimdifoɔ wɔ wɔn a ɛdidisoɔ yi so Yaw Adjei-Duffour a na ɔfiri the New Patriotic Party (NPP) amanyɔkuo no mu, Ishmael Bin Abdallah, Emmanuel Nsiah Dwomoh and Gladys Abena Nsia a ɔkɔ gyana sɛ kontenkorɔ  (independent candidates) Peter Ndela a na ɔfiri ɛyɛ People's National Convention (PNC), Ahmed Mohammed Dapaah a na ɔfiri ɛyɛ Convention People's Party (CPP) amanyɔkuo no mu, Sulemana Badivare Kukuje a na ɔno nso firi ɛyɛ ɛyɛ National Reform Party (NRP) ɛne Anarwat Joseph Yendu a na ɔno nso firi ɛyɛ United Ghana Movement (UGM) amanyɔkuo no nso mu. Deɛ edidisoɔ yi ne mma a wɔn mu biara nyaaeɛ mpemadu-mmiɛnsa ne aduasa-nkron (13,039),mpem nnan aha-nson ne aduosia (4,760), mpem mmiensa, aha-nan ne aduoson-mmiensa (3,473), apem aha-nson ne aduasa-nson (1,737, ), mpem mmiensa, aha-num ne aduokron-mmiensa (3,593), apem aha-nsia ne aduonu-nsia (1,626) ahankron ne aduoson-nsia (976) ɛne aha-nwɔtwe ne du-num (815) wɔ mma a wɔn tooeɛ no deɛ wɔn gye too mu sɛ ɛyɛ no nyinaa mu. Wei nso ne ɔha nkyekyemu susupɛn a wdidisoɔ yi na ɛyɛ pɛ aduonu-nkron ne akyiripɔ nnum (29.5%) edu ne akyiripɔ nwɔtwe (19.8%, ) nson ne akyiripɔ nkron (7.9%,) mmiensa ne akyiripɔ nkron (3.9%,) ɛne wɔtwe ne akyiripɔ baako (8.1%,), mmiensa ne akyiripɔ nson (3.7%,) mmienu ne akyiripɔ mmienu (2.2%,) ɛne baako ne akyiripɔ nwɔtwe (1.8%) wɔ mma a wɔn gye too mu sɛ ɛyɛ no nyinaa mu.

(2004 Abatoɔ) mfie mpem mmienu ne nan abatoɔ 
Effah- Baafi Wɔn too aba yii no sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani de maa Kintampo Anaafoɔfam abatoɔ mpɛsoaso  (Kintampo South constituency) ɛwɔ mfie mpem mmienu ne nan Ɔman Ghana nyinaa abatoɔ no mu (2004 Ghanaian General Elections).  Na ɔgyina hɔ sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani de ma saa abatoɔ mpɛsoa no so foɔ wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtɔso nnan wɔ Adehyeman Ghana amammuo a ɛtɔso nnan no mu  (4th parliament of the 4th republic of Ghana).4][15] wei ne mma a wɔn to de yii no mma mpem du-nnan ne aduanan (14,040votes) de firii mma mpem aduonu-nan, aha-nwɔtwe ne aduosia-nkron (24,869votes) wɔ mma a wɔn gye too mu sɛ ɛyɛ no nyinaa mu.  Wei ne ɔha nkyekyemu susupɛn ahannum ne akyiripɔ aduonum (56.50% ) na ɛyɛ pɛ wɔ mma a wɔn gye too mu sɛ ɛyɛ no nyinaa mu. Wɔn too aba yii no sɛ nkunimdifoɔ wɔ wɔn a ɛdidisoɔ yi so Kwasi Adu Gyan a na ɔfiri New Patriotic Party (NPP) amanyɔkuo no mu, Appiah Emmanuel Kwame a na ɔno nso firi ɛyɛ Democratic People's Party (DPP) ɛne Duffour Stephen K a na ɔno nso firi ɛyɛ Convention People's Party (CPP). Deɛ ɛdidisoɔ yi ne nea wɔn mu biara nyaaeɛ wɔ ɔha nkyekyemu aduasa-nwɔtwe ne akyiripɔ du (38.10%) , nnan ne akyiripɔ hwee (4.0%) ɛne baako ne akyiripɔ aduonum (1.50%) wɔ mma a wɔn tooeɛ no deɛ wɔn gye too mu sɛ ɛyɛ no nyinaa mu. Effah-Baafi Wɔn too aba maa no wɔ ɛyɛ  National Democratic Congress (NDC) amanyɔkuo no tumi krataa so. Ne mpɛsoa no so no ka mmarahyɛbadwafie nkonwa ɛdu (10) a n'amanyɔkuo nyaaeɛ de firii mmarahyɛbadwam nkonwa dodoɔ aduonu-nan (24) wɔ Bono ne Ahafo mantam no mu. (Brong Ahafo Region). Wɔ mfie mpem mmienu ne nan Ɔman Ghana nyinaa abatoɔ no mu (2004 Ghanaian General Elections), National Democratic Congress (NDC) amanyɔkuo no na ɛnyaa Mmarahyɛbadwafie nkonwa no mu ketewa a na ne dodoɔ nyinaa yɛ aduokron-nnan (94) de firii mmarahyɛbadwam nkonwa aha-mmienu ne aduasa (230) wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtɔso nnan wɔ Adehyeman Ghana amammuo a ɛtɔso nnan no mu (4th parliament of the 4th republic of Ghana). 

Effah-Baafi wɔn sanso too aba maa no sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔgyina hɔ ma Kintampo Anaafoɔfam (Kintampo South Constituency) abatoɔ mpɛsoa no so wɔ mfie mpem mmienu nwɔtwe wɔ ɔman Ghana abatoɔ a wɔn toɔ no mu (2008 Ghanaian General Elections). Ɔgyina hɔ ma abatoɔ mpɛsoa no so foɔ wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtɔso nnum wɔ Adehyeman Ghana amammuo a ɛtɔso nnan no mu (5th parliament of the 4th republic of Ghana). Wɔn de mma mpem du-mmiɛnsa, ɛne nkron (13,009votes) de firii mma mpem aduonu-mmiensa ahankron ne aduonu-baako (23,921)  wɔ mma a wɔn tooeɛ no deɛ wɔn gye too mu sɛ ɛyɛ no nyinaa mu. Na wei nso ne ɔha nkyekyemu susupɛn aduonum-nan ne akyiripɔ aduasa-nwɔtwe (54.38%) na ɛyɛ pɛ wɔ mma a wɔn gye too mu sɛ ɛyɛ no nyinaa mu. Wɔn too aba maa no sɛ nkunimdifoɔ wɔ wɔn a ɛdidisoɔ yi so Yaw Adjei-Duffour a na ɔfiri New Patriotic Party (NPP) amanyɔkuo no mu ɛne Atomeh Koranteng Joseph a na ɔno nso firi ɛyɛ People's National Convention (PNC). Deɛ edidisoɔ yi ne ne ɔha nkyekyemu a wɔn mu biara nyaaeɛ aduanan-nnan ne akyiripɔ aduonum-mmienu (44.52%) ɛne baako ne akyiripɔ du-nsia (1.16%) wɔn mma a wɔn tooeɛ no deɛ wɔn gye too mu sɛ ɛyɛ no nyinaa mu. Effah-Baafi wɔn too aba maa no biom wɔ National Democratic Congress (NDC) amanyɔkuo no tumi krataa so. Ɛyɛ National Democratic Congress (NDC) amanyɔkuo no na ɛnyaa Mmarahyɛbadwafie nkonwa no mu dodoɔ a na ne dodoɔ nyinaa yɛ ɔha ne du-nan (114) de firii mmarahyɛbadwam nkonwa aha-mmienu ne aduasa (230) wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtɔso nnum wɔ Adehyeman Ghana amammuo a ɛtɔso nnan no mu (5th parliament of the 4th Republic of Ghana).

Ankorɛankorɛ Abrabɔ 
Effah-Baafi yɛ ɔwarefoɔ a ɔwɔ mma nnum. Ɔyɛ okristoni a ɔkɔ asɔre wɔ Pentecost.

title: Daniel Kwame Ampofo
text:
Daniel Kwame Ampofo a yɛwoo no Kɔntɔnimaa bosome da a ɛtɔ so nsia wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduonum (1950) mu yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nan mu mmarahyɛbadwam a ɛtɔ so naan mu nnipa a ɔgyina hɔ ma South Dayi mpɛsoa wɔ Fraw mantam wɔ Ghana.

Abrabɔ Ahyɛase ne nnwomasua 
Wɔwoo Ampofo wɔ Dayi a ɛwɔ Fraw Mantam mu wɔ Ghana wɔ Kɔntɔnimaa bosome da a ɛtɔ so nsia wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduonum (1950) mu. Ɔnyaa Bachelor of Science degree abasobɔdeɛ wɔ University of Ghana mu. Ɔtoaa so kɔɔ University of Pennsylvania a ɔnyaa ne Masters of Science abasobɔdeɛ.

Adwuma 
Ampofo adwuma a ɔyɛ ne chemical engineer.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ampofo yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni. Na ɔyɛ South Dayi Constituency mmarahyɛ baguani wɔ Ghana republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmarahyɛ bagua a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa akyi a ɔdii nkonim wɔ afe 2000 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu.

2000 Abatow a Wɔyɛe 
Wɔpaw Ampofo sɛ mmarahyɛ baguani mma South Dayi mantam no wɔ afe 2000 Ghana amansan abatow no mu . Odii nkonim wɔ abatow no mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so .

Na ne mansin no yɛ mmarahyɛ bagua nkongua 17 a ɛwɔ nkongua 19 a National Democratic Congress dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Volta Mantam no mu no fa .    National Democratic Congress dii nkonim kakraa bi a ne nyinaa yɛ mmarahyɛ bagua nkongua 92 wɔ nkongua 200 a ɛwɔ mmarahyɛ bagua a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa a ɛwɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu.

Wɔde abatow 10,392 paw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 14,239 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 74.1% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Kofi Sabon Asare a ofi Convention People's Party, Agyepong D. Odoba a ofi New Patriotic Party ne Yao Peter Nkrumah a ofi People's National Convention .

Eyinom nyaa abatow 2,662,920 ne 49 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 19%, 6.6% ne 0.3% yɛ pɛ.

2004 Abatow a Wɔyɛe 
Wɔsan paw no sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so wɔ December 2004 Ghana Amansan abatoɔ a ɔgyinaa South Dayi Mansin ananmu wɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔnyaa abatoɔ 3,168 wɔ abatoɔ 6,305 a ɛfata a wɔtoo no mu a egyina hɔ ma 50.20%.

Wɔpaw no sen Ernest Patrick Mallet a ofi New Patriotic Party no mu ne Bernard Duose a ɔyɛ obi a ɔde ne ho. Eyinom nyaa abatow 2,284 ne abatow 853 f abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa. Eyinom ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 36.2% ne 13.5% yɛ pɛ.

Na ne mantam no yɛ amansin 20 a National Democratic Congress dii nkonim wɔ Greater Accra mantam mu wɔ saa abatow no mu no fa.  Sɛ yɛka ne nyinaa bom a, National Democratic Congress no nyaa mmarahyɛ bagua nkongua 94 wɔ Ghana republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmarahyɛ bagua a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ampofo yɛ Kristoni.

title: Nana Asante-Frimpong
text:
Nana Asante Frimpong yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ a ɔdii dwuma berɛ baako firi afe 2001 kɔsi afe 2007.[1][2] Na ɔyɛ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmarahyɛ bagua a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no muni na na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛ baguani ma Kwabre apuei fam mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.[3][4]

Mfitiase asetra 
Wɔwoo Frimpong wɔ Kware East wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.[3]

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ɔhyɛɛ n’amammui adwuma ase wɔ afe 1997 mu akyi a ɔdaa ne ho adi sɛ odii nkonim wɔ 1996 Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ no mu.. Ɔnyaa abatoɔ 333,035 wɔ abatoɔ 45,342 a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ no mu a ɛgyina hɔ ma 58.80% tiaa Oppong Kyekyeku Kwaku Kaaky a ɔyɛ NDC muni a ɔtoo aba 10,808, Kwaku Dua-Twum a PNC muni a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 1,499 ne Abdullah Uthman a ɔyɛ PNC muni a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 0.[5]

Wɔsan paw Frimpong sɛ mmarahyɛ bagua a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no muni wɔ Fourth Republic of Ghana wɔpaw no sɛ mmarahyɛ baguani ma Kwabre Mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ afe 2000 Ghana Amansan Abatow no mu. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so de abatoɔ 41,098 a egyina hɔ ma abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ saa afe no nyinaa mu 80.90%.[6] Ɔkaa sɛ ɔpɛ sɛ ɔsi akan wɔ 2004 Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ no mu nanso Kofi Frimpong dii no so nkonim wɔ afe 2004 amanyɔkuo mfitiaseɛ abatoɔ mu.[3][7] Ɔdii dwuma bere biako pɛ sɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni.

title: Kwesi Botchwey
text:
Kwesi Botchwey (13 Ɔbɛnem 1944 – 19 Ɔbɛnem 2022) yɛ Ghana aban panyin ne Ɔbenfoɔ a ɔkyerɛ Nnwuma wɔ Nkɔsoɔ Sikasɛm mu wɔ The Fletcher School of Law and Diplomacy of Tufts University.

Botchwey yɛ Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ Sikasɛm ne Sikasɛm Nhyehyɛe so fi afe 1982 kosi afe 1995. Jerry Rawlings na ɔpaw no sɛ ɔmmoa mma Ghana sikasɛm a asɛe no ntumi nnyina.

Nwomasua

Botchwey nyaa ne ntoaso sukuu adesua wɔ Presbyterian Boys’ Senior High School wɔ Ghana. Botchwey nyaa LL.B. wɔ Ghana Sukuupɔn mu, LL.M wɔ Yale Mmara Sukuu mu, ne oduruyɛfo abodin krataa wɔ Michigan Sukuupɔn Mmara Sukuu mu. Ɔkyerɛɛ ade wɔ Zambia Suapɔn, Dar es Salaam Suapɔn (Tanzania) ne Ghana Suapɔn mu.

title: Shai Hills Resource Reserve
text:
Shai Hills Resource Reserve yɛ ahodeɛ akoraeɛ a ɛwɔ Doryumu wɔ Shai Osudoku Mantam mu a ne nyinaa wɔ Greater Accra Mantam mu. Wɔde sii hɔ wɔ afe 1962 mu a ne kɛse yɛ kilomita ahinanan 47 (ha 4,700; mita ahinanan 18) a akyiri yi wɔtrɛw mu kɔɔ kilomita ahinanan 51 (ha 5,100; mita 20 ahinanan) wɔ afe 1973 mu.

Abakɔsɛm 
Wɔde beae no too gua sɛ Kwae a Wɔakora So wɔ afe 1962 mu a ne nyinaa yɛ kilomita ahinanan 47 (ha 4,700; mita 18 ahinanan) a akyiri yi wɔtrɛw mu kɔɔ kilomita ahinanan 51 (ha 5,100; mi 20 ahinanan) wɔ afe 1973. Wɔyɛɛ no ​​Game Production Reserve wɔ 1971 mu. Na beaeɛ a wɔabɔ ho ban no yɛ Shaifoɔ fie ansa na Britaniafoɔ repam wɔn wɔ afe 1892 mu, wɔda so ara tumi hu Shaifoɔ adwuma nkae wɔ beaeɛ a wɔakora soɔ no.

Ahomegye 
Reserve no ayɛ beaeɛ a wɔyɛ anigyeɛ dwumadiɛ te sɛ Picnics, na wɔ afe 2017 mu no, wɔyɛɛ National Biking & Abseil Festival.

Beaeɛ 
Shai Hills Resource Reserve wɔ Tema–Akosombo kwan no ho. Ɛne Accra, Ghana ahenkurow no ntam kwan bɛyɛ kilomita 57 (35 mi) a ɛma ɛyɛ wuram mmoa a wɔkora wɔn so a ɛbɛn Accra sen biara.

Ahunahuna ahorow 
Wɔde ahunahuna pii te sɛ asiane a efi kar a ɛretu mmirika mu aba reserve no mu efisɛ akraman no bi nya kwan kɔ ɔkwan kɛse no so. Reserve no nso bɛn aboɔ a wɔtuo na yei nso ka da biara da dwumadiɛ a ɛwɔ abɔnten so no.

Nsrahwɛ a wɔde kɔsrasra mmeae ahorow 
Shai Hills Resource Reserve no yɛ nea sare ne kwae mu afifide a ɛso yɛ kusuu na ɛwɔ hɔ. Ɛkame ayɛ sɛ afifide ahorow 400 na ɛtrɛw wɔ nkoko 5 a ɛsono emu biara a ɛwɔ Shai Hills Resource Reserve no so. Ɛkame ayɛ sɛ mmoa titiriw du du pii wɔ hɔ a antelope, akraman, nnomaa (te sɛ violet Turaco, Paradise Flycatcher, Green Turaco Red-billed Hornbill, Yellow-fronted Tinkerbird, ne Red-necked Buzzard), akraman, mpataa, duiker, guinea nnomaa ka ho , kobs, bonsu a wɔn ho yɛ ahabammono, monitor lizards, African python, royal python, ne asono.

Nsrahwɛ ahorow 
Nsrahwɛfo betumi akɔsra ɔmantam a ɛyɛ fɛ a abotan a ɛwɔ nkoko so ne asasetaw a sare wɔ so a wɔakora so wɔ hɔ no afe mũ no nyinaa. Sɛ́ wobɛkɔ akɔhwɛ beae a wɔakora so no wɔ osutɔ bere a edi kan (May kosi July) mu no betumi ayɛ den esiane ɔkwan no tebea a ɛyɛ den nti. Dwumadi ahorow a agye din ne agodie a wɔhwɛ, nnomaa a wɔhwɛ, abɔde mu nantew, ne abotan a wɔforo.

Beae a menyaa mmoa fii

title: Tono Dam
text:
Tono Dam yɛ kuayɛ abura akɛseɛ a ɛwɔ Afrika atɔeɛ fam no mu baako, ɛwɔ Kassena-Nankana Mantam mu wɔ Upper East Region, Ghana atifi fam.Atare a ne tenten yɛ kilomita 2 no gugu asase bɛyɛ hekta 2,490 so nsuo.

Abakɔsɛm 
Wofii ase sii abura no wɔ 1975 mu, na Taysec, Britania mfiridwuma adwumakuw bi na wowiee wɔ 1985 mu. Ghana Aban na ɛde sii hɔ sɛ ɛbɛma akuafoɔ nketewa ayɛ aduane nnɔbaeɛ afe mũ no nyinaa wɔ nsuo a wɔde gugu nnɔbaeɛ so nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔahyehyɛ na wɔhwɛ so mu. Wɔhyehyɛɛ Irrigation Company of Upper Region (ICOUR) sɛ wɔnhwɛ Dam no so.

Nsiesiei a wɔde siesie nneɛma 
Wɔ afe 2008 mu no, wɔsan siesiee kɔnkrit a ɛwɔ abura no mu nsuo a ɛtwe ade ba fam no mu no. Ghana Aban a ɛhyɛ The Ghana Commercial Agriculture Project (GCAP) ase no nya sika firi Wiase Sikakorabea ne USAID hɔ de siesie Dam no.

Nsunsuansoɔ 
Dam no som bɛyɛ mpɔtam ason, tumi a ɛma nsuo ma nsuo afe mũ no nyinaa no ama aburow, soya bean, ne tomato a wodua no akɔ soro. Eyi ama ɛhɔnom akuafo asetra atu mpɔn. Dame no ayɛ ɔtare a nnomaa atrae a ɛda nsow wom.

Yareɛ 
Tebea a abura no wom no ma ɛyɛ nea eye ma mogya a ɛbɛtɔ schistosomiasis ɔyare mmoawa no. Saa ɔyare mmoawa yi fa honam ani kɔ nipadua no mu na ɛtra dwensɔtwaa anaa akisikuru no afasu mu. Ebetumi ama mogya atɔ no yaw na ayɛ awo, sɛ wɔansa a.

Beae a mennya mmoa fii

title: Sakumono Lagoon
text:
Sakumono Lagoon yɛ mpoano ɔtare bi a ɛwɔ Sakumono a ɛbɛn Tema wɔ Greater Accra Mantam mu wɔ Ghana, Afrika Atɔe fam. Beae no kɛse yɛ hekta 1,340. Wɔkyerɛɛ no sɛ Ramsar nsuten beae a ɛho hia wɔ amanaman ntam wɔ 14 August 1992.[1]

Honam fam nneɛma 
Beae no trɛw yɛ mpoano nkyene atare a ne trabea titiriw ne ɔtare a ɛda hɔ, nsuyiri a atwa ho ahyia, nsu pa atɛkyɛ ne mpoano savanna sare, a ɛne po no wɔ abusuabɔ ketewaa bi.

Fauna 
Beae no nya nnomaa ahorow a wotu kɔ mmeae foforo a wɔn ho yɛ na na wɔn ase reyɛ atɔre ne mpataa ahorow pii

title: Boti Nsuo
text:
Boti Nsu Aworoeɛ (Water falls) yɛ nsuo a ɛtɔ mmienu a ɛwɔ Boti wɔ Yilo Krobo Mantam mu wɔ Ghana Apueeɛ Mantam mu. Wɔfrɛ saa ahwease abien yi a efi nsubɔnten abien mu no sɛ ɔbea ne ɔbarima; sɛnea ɛhɔnom anansesɛm kyerɛ no, sɛ wɔka bom a, nyankontɔn na ɛba.

Beae 
Ahwease no wɔ Koforidua a ɛyɛ apuei fam ɔmantam no ahenkurow no atifi fam apuei kilomita 17 (akwansin 11). Ɛyɛ bɛboro simma 30 pɛ kar akwantu fi Koforidua, na bɛboro simma 90 fi Accra, a egyina akwan a wɔfa so fa kar so.

title: Bunso Arboretum
text:
Bunso Arboretum yɛ afifide turo a ɛwɔ Bunso wɔ Apuei Fam Akim Mantam mu wɔ Apuei Fam Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

Beae 
Nnua dan no wɔ kilomita 3 (akwansin 1.9) fi Bunso nhyiam wɔ Accra–Kumasi kwan kɛse no so.

Nneɛma a wɔde yɛ adwuma 
Nhwiren ne nnua ahorow ahorow wɔ nnua akorae no mu. Ɛwɔ ntontom kronkronbea ne canopy nantew, nea ɛto so abien a wosii wɔ Ghana. yɛ afifide turo a ɛwɔ Bunso wɔ Apuei Fam Akim Mantam mu wɔ Apuei Fam Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

Nneɛma a ɛwɔ hɔ 
Nnua dan no wɔ kilomita 3 (akwansin 1.9) fi Bunso nhyiam wɔ Accra–Kumasi kwan kɛse no so.

Nneɛma a wɔde yɛ adwuma[edit]

Nhwiren ne nnua ahorow ahorow wɔ nnua akorae no mu. Ɛwɔ ntontom kronkronbea ne canopy nantew, nea ɛto so abien a wosii wɔ Ghana.[1][2]

title: Tafi Atome Adoe Kronkronbea
text:
Tafi Atome Adoe Kronkronbea(Sanctuary) yɛ atetesɛm mu kwae kronkron a wɔkora so a wɔde sii hɔ wɔ afe 1993 mu wɔ Asomdwoe Kuw Tuhoamafo bi akwankyerɛ ase sɛ abɔde a nkwa wom ho nsrahwɛ adwuma a egyina mpɔtam hɔ so. Tafi Atome yɛ Mona ne Patas bonsu fie.[1][2]

Beaeɛ 
Kronkronbea no wɔ bɛyɛ kilomita 230 wɔ ahenkurow Accra Atifi Apuei ne kilomita 43 wɔ Hohoe anafo fam wɔ Volta mantam mu wɔ Ghana.[3][4]

Abakɔsɛm 
Mfeha abien a atwam ni no, wohu bonsu no sɛ wɔte kwae a ɛhɔ yɛ hyew a atwa akuraa ketewa Tafi-Atome ho ahyia no mu na wɔayɛ kronkron efisɛ na wogye di sɛ wɔyɛ abɔfo a wofi anyame no hɔ. Wɔ 1996 mu no, akuraa no fii ase bɔɔ mmɔden kɛse sɛ wɔbɛbɔ wɔn kwae ne bonsu ho ban, na wɔama nsrahwɛfo a wɔbɛkɔ akɔhwɛ hɔ nso. Nkuraasefo, ɔman ahyehyɛde ahorow ne NGO ahorow a wɔaka abom na ɛyɛɛ kronkronbea no. Esiane mmɔdenbɔ ahorow yi nti, bonsu dodow akɔ soro, na wɔakora kwae a nnomaa ne nwansena ahorow pii wom no so.[5]

Nneɛma a wɔde yɛ adwuma no a wɔbɛma ayɛ yiye 
Wɔ November 2020 mu no, nkɔsoɔ a na ɛka ho ne beaeɛ foforɔ a wɔgye nsrahwɛfoɔ, nnɛyi aguaree a nnipa 7 te mu, ntamadan mmiɛnsa (3) a wɔde bɛma nsrahwɛfoɔ, ban a wɔde waya ne nnua ayɛ atwa beaeɛ no ho ahyia, adan ne adan no ho mfonini, kar gyinabea na wɔhyɛɛ sɛ wɔmfa asase a wɔabɔ so. [6] .

title: Wli Nsuo
text:
Wli Nsuo(Waterfalls) a ɛtɔ gu fam no yɛ nsuo a ɛtɔ a ɛkorɔn sen biara wɔ Ghana na ɛware sen biara wɔ Afrika Atɔeɛ fam. Ɛwɔ asehwe a ɛwɔ fam ne nea ɛwɔ soro.

Beaeɛ 
Wli Nsuo a ɛtɔ gu fam no ne Hohoe ntam kwan yɛ kilomita 20 wɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

Abɔde mu nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia

Wim mmoa 
Sɛ wo nantew wɔ kwae a ɛwɔ Agumatsa wuram mmoa akorae no mu a, wunya hokwan hu nnuaba mu nwansena, nwansena, nnomaa, bonsu ne akraman akuw kɛse bi.

Nwansena 
Wotumi hu akraman akuw kɛse bi sɛ wɔbata abotan no ho na wɔretu wɔ wim.

Abakɔsɛm 
Wli nsuo a ɛtɔ no yɛ nsuo a ɛtɔ a ɛkorɔn sen biara wɔ Afrika Atɔeɛ fam a ɛwɔ Ghana[4] Wɔfrɛ ahweaseɛ no wɔ mpɔtam hɔ sɛ Agoomatsa nsuo - a ɛkyerɛ sɛ, "Ma Me Nsen." Ɛwɔ Hohoe kuropɔn a ɛwɔ Volta Mantam mu, asase a Ewefo amammerɛ te so. Ɛfiri ahenkuro Accra rekɔ hɔ bɛyɛ kilomita 280.

title: Fort Prinzenstein
text:
Fort Prinzenstein (Danish: Fort Prinsensten) yɛ abankɛseɛ a ɛwɔ Keta, Ghana a wɔde dii dwuma wɔ nkoatɔn mu. Wɔkyekyeree abankɛse a ɛte saa pii wɔ Afrika, nanso Prinzenstein yɛ kakraa bi a ɛda Volta Asubɔnten no apuei fam no mu biako. Keta yɛɛ hyɛn gyinabea a ɛbue kosii sɛ Tema Hyɛn Gyinabea no fii ase yɛɛ adwuma wɔ atɔe fam wɔ afe 1962 mu.[2] Wɔakyerɛ abankɛseɛ no sɛ Wiase Agyapadeɛ (ne abankɛseɛ ne abankɛseɛ foforɔ dodoɔ bi a ɛwɔ Ghana) ɛnam abakɔsɛm mu hia a ɛho hia ne adanseɛ a ɛfa Atlantic nkoatɔn ho nti.

Mfiase no, Denmark aguadifo na wosii no wɔ afe 1784 mu de bɔɔ wɔn ho ban wɔ Sagbadre Ko a wɔko tiaa Anlo Ewefo no akyi na wɔde maa mpɔtam hɔ dwoodwoo fi atubra aman afoforo ho. Nneɛma dodow no ara, titiriw ɔbo a wɔde sii abankɛse no, fi Accra.[3] Abantenten no ka adan atitiriw anan a Denmarkfo sii no ho.[6] Abantenten no dii dwuma titiriw wɔ nkoatɔn mu, a na Europafo a wɔwɔ Afrika Atɔe fam no ka ho. Sɛ yɛde nkoatɔn to nkyɛn a, na abankɛse no di atirimpɔw a ɛyɛ nnam ho dwuma wɔ nneɛma a wɔde fi amannɔne ba ne nea wɔde kɔ amannɔne te sɛ sika kɔkɔɔ ne asonse aguadi mu wɔ give-and-take a wɔde yɛ atuo, brandy, dade abaa, ntama, anantwinini akutu ne nea ɛkeka ho mu.

Abakɔsɛm 
Na Dutch West India Company asi Fort Singelenburgh wɔ beaeɛ a mprempren abankɛseɛ no wɔ wɔ afe 1734 mu, nanso Dutchfoɔ gyaw abankɛseɛ no wɔ afe 1737 mu, ɛbɛyɛ sɛ ɛnam Dutchfoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛɛ Akwamu a wɔdii nkoguo no afa wɔ Akyem-Akwamu ntawntawdie no mu nti. Ná Denmarkfo anya wɔn ho wɔ Keta, Anlofo aguadi ahenkurow no mu. Nanso, wɔ afe 1783 mu bere a Anlofo fow Denmarkfo ananmusifo a wɔwɔ mpɔtam hɔ no, Christiansborg Amrado no maa asraafo dɔm a wɔtwee wɔn fii nnipa a na wɔwɔ atetesɛm a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔmpɛ Anlofo no mu bae: Adafo, Akwapimfo, Ga ne Krobofo. Enti Denmarkfoɔ tumi dii Anlofoɔ so nkonim na wɔhyɛɛ apam bi wɔ afe 1784 mu a ɛmaa wɔn kwan sɛ wɔbɛsi Fort Prinzenstein na ɛhyɛɛ Anlofoɔ sɛ wɔne wɔn nko ara nni gua.

Ɛde besi 1803 no, na wɔde abankɛse no yɛ afiase ma nkoa a wɔretwɛn sɛ wɔde wɔn bɛkɔ Caribbean. Wɔ afe 1850 mu no, wɔtɔn abankɛse no, ne Denmark Gold Coast nkae no maa Britain. Eyi ne bere a Keta bɛyɛɛ Britania atubraman. Wɔde abankɛse no dii dwuma sɛ afiase bere bi ansa na ɛpo no sɛee ne fa bi wɔ afe 1980 mu. Wɔ mmɔdenbɔ mu sɛ wɔbɛbɔ abankɛseɛ no nkaeɛ ho ban no, ICOMOS Ghana ne Ghana Tete Nneɛma Akoraeɛ ne Nkaedum Boayikuo ne Danish Aban Nnanmusini yɛɛ adwuma wɔ afe 1991 mu bɔɔ mmɔden bi sɛ wɔbɛkora so, nanso ɛpo no nkɛntɛnsoɔ a ɛwɔ abankɛseɛ no so no kɔɔ so. Mprempren nsrahwɛfo kɔsra abankɛse no nkae.[\ Nsrahwɛfoɔ a wɔfiri wiase mmeaeɛ ahodoɔ te sɛ United Kingdom, United States, Germany, Benin, France, Ireland, Norway, Switzerland, Sweden, Denmark ne Finland kɔsra abankɛseɛ no.

title: Jabisa Kwae Mmoa Yɛmmea
text:
Jabisa Kwae Mmoa Yɛmmea(Forest Park) yɛ kwae mu abɔnten so atrae wɔ Gambia. Ɛyɛ hekta 16.

Ɛwɔ Lower River, akontaabu a ɛkyerɛ sɛ asase no sorokɔ boro po so yɛ mita 11.

Beae a menyaa mmoa fii

title: Allunhari
text:
Allunhari yɛ kurow bi a ɛwɔ Gambia apuei fam. Ɛwɔ Fulladu Apuei Mantam mu wɔ Upper River Division mu. Ɛde besi afe 2008 no, wɔbu akontaa sɛ nnipa dodoɔ yɛ 5,573.

Beae a menyaa mmoa fii

title: Aljamdu
text:
Aljamdu yɛ kurow bi a ɛwɔ Gambia atɔe fam. Ɛwɔ Upper Niumi Mantam mu wɔ North Bank Division. Ɛde besi afe 2008 no, wɔbu akontaa sɛ nnipa dodoɔ yɛ 1,100.

Adɔeyɛ 
Atuhoamafo bɛboro 2000 a wofi Aljamdu akuraa ase hyiaam wɔ Sheikh Ɔbenfo Alhaji Dr Yahya Jammeh aburow afuw a ne kɛse yɛ hekta 3.5, a ɛwɔ akuraa no apuei fam sɛ wɔrekɔyɛ adwuma na wɔatwa ɛmo pii.

Beae a menyaa mmoa fii

title: Niumi Ɔman Mmoa Yɛmmea
text:
Niumi Ɔman Mmoa Yɛmmea (National Park) yɛ ɔman mmɔnten so atrae a ɛwɔ The Gambia. The gye mpoano a ɛwɔ ɔman no atifi fam mantam mu, wɔ Sine-Saloum Delta anafo fam ano. Ne kɛse bɛyɛ hekta 4,940 (kilomita ahinanan 49.4) na ɛka nsuten ne afifide ahorow ahorow ho, efi nsu pa atɛkyɛ so kosi anhwea a wɔtetew ne atare a nkyene wom so. Rhizophora mangrove kwae dɔɔso wɔ abɔnten so atrae hɔ, na nnomaa atɛkyɛ ne atɛkyɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ no yɛ beae titiriw a nnomaa guan, na wohu nnomaa ahorow bɛboro 200 wɔ ha.

Asase ho nsɛm 
Niumi Ɔman Mmoa Yɛmmea no wɔ mpoano a ɛwɔ Sine-Saloum Delta anafo fam ano no. Abɔnten so atrae a ɛda North Bank Mantam no kɛse bɛyɛ ha 4,940 (49.4 square km). Gambia de ne fa a ɛwɔ Delta no too gua sɛ ɔman mmɔnten so atrae wɔ afe 1986 mu.[3] Wɔ abɔnten so atrae no atifi fam no, wɔ delta no anafo fam no, Jinack supɔw ne nsupɔw nketewa pii wɔ hɔ.

Mmoa ne afifide a ɛwɔ hɔ 
Wɔ ɔmantam mu no, abɔnten so atrae no yɛ Afrika Atɔe Fam Po so abɔde a nkwa wom mpɔtam hɔ no fa. Ɛka nsuten ne afifide ahorow ahorow ho, efi nsu pa atɛkyɛ so kosi anhwea a wɔtetew ne atare a nkyene wom so. Rhizophora mangrove kwae dɔɔso wɔ abɔnten so atrae hɔ, na wohu kwae a ɛyɛ nwura wɔ Jinack Supɔw ne Mbankam ntasu so. Sterna dougallii na nnipa dɔɔso wɔ Atlantic mpoano. Atɛkyɛ ne atɛkyɛ yɛ beae a ɛho hia a nnomaa guan, na wohu nnomaa ahorow bɛboro 200 wɔ ha. Wɔakyerɛw nnomaa ahorow 293 a wofi mmusua 63 mu a ɛfa nnomaa ho. Nnomaa ahorow pii a wohu wɔ abɔnten so no yɛ nea ɛyɛ mmerɛw anaasɛ wɔn ase reyɛ atɔre a Green turtle, Humpback dolphin, Red Colobus ne manatees te sɛ Trichechus senegalensis ka ho. Wɔ kwae mu mmeae a ɛwɔ abɔnten so no, Patas bonsu (Erythrocebus patas), Vervet Bonsu (Cercopithecus aethiops), Spotted hyena (Crocuta crocuta), ne warthog (Phacochoerus africanus) dɔɔso kɛse.

title: Asubɔnten Gambia Ɔman Mmoa Yɛmmea
text:
Asubɔnten Gambia Ɔman Mmoa Yɛmmea (River Gambia National Park) yɛ ɔman mmɔnten so atrae a ɛwɔ Gambia.

Asase ho nsɛm 
Wɔde sii hɔ wɔ 1978 mu, na Asubɔnten Gambia Ɔman Mmoa Yɛmmea no wɔ Niamina Apuei fam mantam mu wɔ Central River Division. Ɛda Gambia Asubɔnten no benkum so. Baboon Nsupɔw so nsupɔw a ne kɛse yɛ hekta 585 (acre 1,450) a nsupɔw kɛse biako ne nketewa anan na ɛwom no ka abɔnten so atrae no ho. Ɔman no mmɔnten so atrae no nyɛ nea ɔmanfo betumi akɔ.

Asubɔnten Gambia Ɔman Mmoa Yɛmmea bɛn Nyassang Kwae Mmoa Yɛmmea. Wɔ asase mfonini ahorow bi so no, wɔde mmɔnten so atrae abien no abom ayɛ beae biako.

Afifide a ɛwɔ hɔ 
Afifide a ɛwɔ Baboon Nsupɔw a ɛyɛ petee no so no yɛ kwae a osu tɔ na owia bɔ kɛse wom a ɛte sɛ kwae a ɛwɔ asubɔnten ho no su.

Fauna 
Efi 1979 no, Asubɔnten Gambia Ɔman Mmoa Yɛmmea yɛ beae a wɔreyɛ adwuma bi a wɔde bɛsan de akraman aba, a Chimpanzee Rehabilitation Project (CRP) na Stella Marsden (Eddie Brewer babea) akwankyerɛ ase. Wɔsan de akraman a wɔagye wɔn afi mmoa aguadi a mmara mma ho kwan no mu ba wuram wɔ abɔnten so. Wɔpaw Marsden sɛ Officer of the Order of the British Empire esiane n’adwuma nti. Ansa na 1979 reba no, na wɔtete primate no wɔ Abuko Abɔde a Wɔakora So. Ɛnnɛ, chimpanzee akuw pii te asubɔnten nsupɔw abiɛsa a ɛsõ sen biara (ha 435, ha 77 und ha 53) a nnipa nhaw wɔn. Ɛde besi July 2006 no, na ɛyɛ 77. Wɔ wuram no, chimpanzee ase tɔree wɔ Gambia wɔ afeha a ɛto so 20 mfiase mu hɔ.

Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ na wɔabɔ mmoa ne ahɔho no ho ban no, wɔmma kwan mma wɔnkɔ nsupɔw no so, efisɛ akraman betumi ayɛ nnipa basabasa kɛse. Sɛ aban pene so nkutoo a, wobetumi ayɛ nneɛma a wɔayi afi mu. Wɔtew hyɛmma a wɔde fa nsupɔw no so mpo so kɛse wɔ 1998. Bere bi a atwam no, na ebinom bɔ mmɔden sɛ wobewia akraman afi abɔnten so.

Sɛ chimpanzee a wɔtaa yɛ (Pan troglodytes verus) da nkyɛn a, Asubɔnten Gambia Ɔman Mmoa Yɛmmea nso wɔ hɔ a Guinea akraman (Papio papio), bonsu a ɛyɛ ahabammono (Chlorocebus sabaeus), atɔe fam colobus kɔkɔɔ (Piliocolobus badius), ne marmosets (Callithrix) te. Mmoa afoforo a wɔnom nufusu bi ne ɔkraman a ɔdɔɔso (Phacochoerus africanus) ne asukɔnkɔn bi (Hippopotamus amphibius), a abɛyɛ nea wɔn ho yɛ na wɔ Gambia. Nea ɛka ho no, aardvark (Orycteropus afer senegalensis), ɛwo a wɔfrɛ no honey badger (Mellivora capensis), serval (Leptailurus serval brachyura), Hausa genet (Genetta thierryi), Afrikafo otter a onni nsateaa (Aonyx capensis), ne Afrika Atɔe Fam manatee ( Nnuru a wɔfrɛ no Trichechus senegalensis).

Wɔ akraman mu no, bushbuck (Tragelaphus scriptus), Maxwell duiker (Cephalophus maxwellii), ne common duiker (Sylvicapra grimmia) wɔ hɔ. Saa ara na mmoa a wɔwea fam dɔɔso, na nea ɛka ho ne Nil akokɔsrade (Crocodylus niloticus), awɔ, ne akraman. Nnomaa nkwa nso wɔ nnomaa ahorow pii.

title: Bijilo Kwae Mmoa Yɛmmea
text:
Bijilo Kwae Mmoa Yɛmmea (Forest Park), a wɔtaa frɛ no Adoe Yɛmmea(Monkey Park),[1] yɛ kwae mu abɔnten so atrae wɔ Gambia, ɛda mpoano beae a ɛwɔ bɛyɛ kilomita 11 wɔ Banjul Kombo Saint Mary Mantam no atɔe fam.

Abakɔsɛm 
Bijilo Kwaeɛ Atenaeɛ a ɛwɔ mmoa ahodoɔ pii no yɛ kwaeɛ a wɔabɔ ho ban a wɔde too gua wɔ afe 1952 mu na ne kɛseɛ yɛ hekta 51.3[2] a ɛwɔ mpoano wɔ Senegambia mpɔtam Kololi anafoɔ fam pɛɛ. Kwae a wɔato mu a Borassus aethiopum nnua pii wɔ so titiriw na ɛwɔ abɔnten so atrae no mu. Wobuee abɔnten so atrae no maa ɔmanfo wɔ afe 1991 mu na mprempren nnipa bɛboro 23,000 na wɔba hɔ afe biara.[3] Abɔnten so atrae no hweree ne reserve gyinabea no fa bi wɔ afe 2018 mu bere a na wɔresi Sir Dawda Kairaba Jawara Amanaman Ntam Nhyiam Asa no.[4]

Nneɛma 
Ɛwɔ 4.5 km abɔdeɛ kwan wɔ abɔnten so Park no aba awiei a ɛde nsrahwɛfoɔ fa mmeaeɛ ahodoɔ a ɛwɔ kwaeɛ, mpoano scrubland ne anhwea dunes na ɛwɔ hɔ nso ‘treet’ nanteɛ kwan a ɛtwa scrub ne kwaeɛ a ɛbɛn mpoano a wɔtaa ka ho asɛm to sɛ ‘nnomaa ho kwan’. Saa kwan yi ne nea wɔn a wɔhwɛ nnomaa a wɔbɛsra hɔ no ani gye ho. Ɔtare ketewa bi wɔ kwae no mu a wɔhwɛ so ma ɛyɛ adwuma sɛ nsu tokuru ma kwae mu mmoa pii. Wɔayɛ nsɛnkyerɛnne, benkyi ne baabi a wobetumi ahwɛ nneɛma ama nsrahwɛfo.[3]

Wim mmoa 
Bijilo Kwaeɛ Park wɔ mmoa ahodoɔ a wɔnni akyi berɛmo, mmoa a wɔwea fam ne mmoa a wɔnom nufusuo. Bonsu a wɔn ho yɛ ahabammono, Temminck colobus kɔkɔɔ, Campbell bonsu mona ne patas asraafo wɔ hɔ. Nsrahwɛfo ama bonsu a wɔn ho yɛ ahabammono no aduan na eyi de nsɛm aba, na abɔnten so atrae no rebɔ mmɔden wɔ din mu sɛ wobegyae saa adeyɛ yi, ɛwom sɛ abɔnten so atrae adwumayɛfo da so ara tɔn atoko ma nsrahwɛfo daa de ma bonsu no aduan de.[5] Senegal kwae mu akokoaa a ɔtra anadwo no nso dɔɔso. Nufuboa ahorow afoforo a wobetumi ahu ne Gambia owia squirrel, African civet, genets, mongooses, brush-tailed porcupine ne mmoa nketewa afoforo a wɔnhyɛ no nsow kɛse. Kwae no nso yɛ mmoa a wɔwea fam a wɔn ho gu ahorow a agama, nyankontɔn ne monitor akraman ka ho, ne nkoekoemmoa ne mmoa a wonni akyi berɛmo bi a ogya ntɛtea, ɔkraman, nwansena, ntontom, ne sika kɔkɔɔ silk orb-weaver ka ho.

Wɔakyerɛw nnomaa ahorow bɛboro 133 wɔ Bijilo Kwae mu Mmoa Yɛmmea a nea ɛka ho ne nnomaa ahorow te sɛ black-necked weaver, red-billed hornbill, greater honeyguide, bearded barbet, oriole warbler, palm-nut vulture ne long-tailed nightjar. Eyinom ne nnomaa ahorow pii no ma mpɔtam hɔ yɛ nea Europafo pii a wɔhwɛ nnomaa a wɔkɔsra Gambia no ani gye ho.[3] Nnomaa a wɔhwɛ no sow aba kɛse kɔ mpoano baabi a wobetumi ahu atubrafo te sɛ Caspian tern ne osprey.[6]

title: Albert Guadibea
text:
Albert Guadibea (Market) a kan no na wɔfrɛ no Adehye Albert Guadibea (Royal Albert Market) no yɛ mmɔnten so gua a ɛwɔ Banjul, The Gambia. Esiane sɛ ɛwɔ Liberation Avenue nti, wosii gua no wɔ afeha a ɛto so dunkron mfinimfini. Wɔde Albert, Prince Consort, Ɔhemmaa Victoria a ofi United Kingdom of Great Britain ne Ireland kunu, a odii Gambia so wɔ atubrafo bere so no din too so.

title: Kachikally dɛnkyɛm ɔtare
text:
Kachikally dɛnkyɛm ɔtare(Crocodile Pool) no wɔ Bakau, Gambia, mfinimfini, na efi ahenkurow Banjul rekɔ hɔ bɛyɛ akwansin 16. Ɛyɛ dɛnkyɛm atare kronkron abiɛsa a wɔde di dwuma sɛ mmeae a wɔyɛ awo amanne ahorow no mu biako. Afoforo no ne Folonko a ɛwɔ Kombo Anafo fam ne Berending a ɛwɔ atifi fam mpoano.

Owurayɛ 
Kachikally yɛ dɛnkyɛm atare a ankorankoro wɔ a ɛyɛ Bojang abusua a ɛwɔ Bakau, mmusua a wɔhyehyɛɛ kurow no ne asase wuranom atitiriw no mu biako dea. Kachikally nso yɛ Bakau kurow no mfinimfini mantam no din; amansin afoforo ne Sanchaba ne New Town, Mile 7, Farrokono.

Adɛnkyɛm 
Wonnim dɛnkyɛm dodow pɔtee nanso wobu akontaa sɛ wɔyɛ bɛyɛ 80. Wɔde bere tenten kaa sɛ mmoa no nyinaa yɛ Nil dɛnkyɛm (Crocodylus niloticus), nanso nhwehwɛmu kyerɛ sɛ wɔyɛ soronko, a ɛne Afrika Atɔe Fam dɛnkyɛm (Crocodylus suchus) a wɔfrɛ no crocodylus suchus. Wɔabɔ amanneɛ sɛ albino dɛnkyɛm wɔ hɔ. Wɔma dɛnkyɛm kwan ma wɔkyinkyin kwa, na ahɔho betumi akɔ wɔn nkyɛn na wɔde wɔn nsa aka wɔn. Ɛtɔ mmere bi a wɔde dɛnkyɛm a wohu wɔn wɔ wuram no kɔ atare kronkron no mu na wɔtete wɔn wɔ.

title: Abuko Ɔman Mmoa Yɛmmea
text:
Abuko Ɔman Mmoa Yɛmmea (National Park) yɛ abɔde akorae a ɛwɔ Gambia a ɛda Abuko kurow no anafo fam. Ɛyɛ beae a nsrahwɛfo ani gye ho na ɛno ne wuram mmoa a wodi kan a wɔakyerɛ sɛ wɔbɛkora so wɔ ɔman no mu.

Abakɔsɛm 
Wodii kan bɔɔ beae no ahobammɔ kakra wɔ 1916 mu bere a wɔbɔɔ Lamin Asuten a ɛsen fa beae a wɔakora so no ho ban ma ɛyɛɛ beae a wɔboaboa nsu ano no. Asubɔnten no a wɔabɔ ho ban no maa wuram mmoa ne afifide a ɛwɔ kwae no mu no kɔɔ soro.

Wɔ 1967 mu no, wuram mmoa ho ɔpanyin Eddie Brewer ne ne babea Stella Marsden kɔsraa mpɔtam hɔ na wohuu hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔkora kwae no ne ne wuram mmoa so. Brewer de adesrɛ kɔmaa aban sɛ wɔmmɔ mpɔtam hɔ ho ban. Wɔ afe 1968 mu no, wɔhyehyɛɛ Wim Mmoa Dwumadibea, a mprempren ɛyɛ Gambia Mmoa Yɛmmea ne Wim Mmoa Ho Dwumadibea wɔ beae a wɔkora mmoa so.

Nnua a wɔfrɛ no Flora 
Afifide no yɛ savanna ne gallery kwae a wɔtaa yɛ. Nnua a ɛtaa ba, a ne sorokɔ bɛyɛ anammɔn aduasa ne: ngo nnua, mahogany, iroko ne anthocleista procera.

Fauna 
Bonsu ahorow abiɛsa na ɛwɔ hɔ: vervet bonsu, red colobus bonsu ne patas bonsu. Mmoa afoforo a wɔnom nufusu bi ne antelope, squirrel, porcupine, African palm civets, mongooses, galagos, ne mpɔtorɔ ahorow pii a cane rats ka ho.

Nnomaa a wɔwea fam a wɔwɔ abɔnten so no bi ne monitor lizard, Nile akokɔsrade, dwarf akokɔsrade, spitting cobra, black cobra, python, puff adder ne green mamba. Wɔakyerɛw nnomaa ahorow bɛboro 270 wɔ kwae no mu. Nwansena ne nwansena nso dɔɔso.

Wɔ beae no awiei biako no, wɔde adan pii a wɔabɔ ho ban a ɛyɛ nyisaa atrae ma mmoa a wohia mmoa, a ɔdan a wɔabɔ ho ban a wɔde akraman kuw bi kura mu ka ho.

title: Abanga Asubɔnten
text:
Abanga Asubɔnten (River) no yɛ asubɔnten a ɛwɔ Gabon. Ɛyɛ Ogooué nsubɔnten a ɛfata no mu biako. Ɛforo wɔ Cristal Mmepɔw a ɛbɛn Medouneu no so. Ne tenten bɛyɛ kilomita 160. Ɛka asubɔnten Ogooué a ɛbɛn Bifoun kurow no ho.

title: Abanda Abodan
text:
Abanda Abodan(Caves) yɛ abodan a ɛyɛ den wɔ Gabon, na ɛwɔ Fernan Vaz Asubɔnten no atifi. Oduruyɛfo Marco Marti ne Claude Werotte na wodii kan kaa wɔn ho asɛm wɔ afe 2000 mfiase, na wɔhwehwɛɛ mu yiye wɔ abodan mu akwantu pii a Oslisly, Testa, Sebag ne Shirley yɛe no mu. Asase ase kwan a ɛte sɛ safe a ɛwɔ Abanda abodan mu, Gabon, a akraman wɔ hɔ

Abodan a ɛde ne ho abien na ɛwɔ hɔ: Dinguembou ɔbodan (350m) ne Mugumbi ɔbodan (400m). Wobetumi afa nnua a ɛda hɔ a emu dɔ bɛyɛ mita 7 so akɔ akwan a ɛda fam no so. Wɔgye nwansena akuakuo akɛseɛ (Egypt nnuaba a wɔfrɛ no bat, Sundevall’s roundleaf bat, Giant roundleaf bat) a wɔbu akontaa sɛ nnipa bɛboro 100,000 na wɔte hɔ. Wɔahu Picathartes berebuw wɔ abodan no apon ano.

Wonim sɛ akokɔsrade nketewa a wɔn kɔla yɛ borɔdɔma a wɔte abodan mu no dɔɔso wɔ Abanda Abodan no mu. Herpetologist Matthew H. Shirley na ɔkaa wɔn ho asɛm wɔ nyansahu mu akwantuo a ɛdi kan wɔ abodan no mu wɔ afe 2010 mu akyi. Saa akokɔsrade yi te sum mu koraa, wodi akraman ne abodan mu kriket dodow no ara na woguare wɔ nsu a wɔfrɛ no bat guano mu.

title: Elobey Grande
text:
Elobey Grande, anaa Great Elobey, yɛ supɔw bi a ɛwɔ Equatorial Guinea, a ɛda Asubɔnten Mitémélé ano. Nnipa kakraa bi na wɔte hɔ. Elobey Chico yɛ supɔw ketewaa bi a ɛwɔ mpoano, mprempren nnipa biara nni hɔ nanso bere bi na ɛyɛ Río Muni ahenkurow a na wɔyɛ atubrafo no. Supɔw no wɔ Gulf of Guinea.

title: Moukalaba-Doudou Ɔman Mmoa Yɛmmea
text:
Moukalaba-Doudou Ɔman Mmoa Yɛmmea (National Park) yɛ ɔman mmɔnten so atrae a ɛwɔ Gabon. Ne kɛse yɛ kilomita 4,500 (1,700 sq mi). Ɔman no mmɔnten so atrae ahorow ahorow ka ho, a kwae a osu tɔ kɛse wom ne sare sare a ɛyɛ nwini ka ho.

WWF fii nkɔso nhyehyɛe bi ase wɔ abɔnten so wɔ 1996 mu.

title: Crystal Mountains Ɔman Mmoa Yɛmmea
text:
Crystal Mountains Ɔman Mmoa Yɛmmea (National Park) (Franse kasa mu: Parc National des Monts de Cristal) yɛ mmɔnten so atrae abien na ɛyɛ Gabon ɔman mmɔnten so atrae 13 no mu biako. Ɛwɔ Monts de Crystal wɔ Woleu-Ntem Asasetaw no atɔe fam ano, wɔ Equatorial Guinea ne Asubɔnten Ogooué ntam. Wɔde mmɔnten so atrae abien, Mbe Ɔman Mmoa Yɛmmea ne Mt Sene Ɔman Mmoa Yɛmmea, sii hɔ wɔ September 4, 2002, a egyina afifide ahorow a ɛdɔɔso soronko so na ɛyɛ kan Pleistocene kwae a osu tɔ na owia bɔ kɛse guankɔbea no fa.

Mmoa ahodoɔ pii te sɛ asono anaa bonsu tena abɔnten so, na wobɛtumi ahunu nwansena ahodoɔ ɔhaha pii wɔ ha, ebinom ho yɛ na koraa, te sɛ euphaedra brevis, cymothoe anaa graphium angrier.

title: Pongara Ɔman Mmoa Yɛmmea
text:
Pongara Ɔman Mmoa Yɛmmea (National Park) yɛ ɔman mmɔnten so atrae a ɛwɔ Gabon a ɛbɛn ahenkurow Libreville, wɔ Gabon Asubɔnten no ano ne Atlantic Po no anafo fam. Ne kɛse yɛ kilomita 929. Kwae a ɛhɔ yɛ nwini ne mangrove kwae titiriw na ɛwɔ ɔman no mmɔnten so atrae no mu.

Nkyerɛmu 
Pongara Ɔman Mmoa Yɛmmea da Gabon Asubɔnten no anafo fam na ne kɛse yɛ hekta 96,302 (371.82 sq mi). Beae no yɛ kwae kɛse na ɛwɔ mmeae ahorow a mangrove kwae, atɛkyɛ kwae, asubɔnten ho kwae ne kwae a nsu yiri fa mu wɔ mmere horow mu ka ho. Afei nso, mpoano beae tenten bi a anhwea wɔ ne sare bi a sare wɔ so wɔ hɔ. Nsubɔnten pii sen fa abɔnten so atrae no mu kɔ asubɔnten no ano, a Asubɔnten Remboué, Asubɔnten Igombiné ne Asubɔnten Gomgoué ka ho.

Nhwiren ne nnua a ɛwɔ hɔ 
Avicennia ne Rhizophora ahorow na ɛwɔ mangrove kwae ahorow no mu kɛse, na eyinom ne sika kɔkɔɔ aboa nhoma fern (Acrostichum aureum) boa ma atrae no gyina na ɛma nsu no brɛ ase. Anyɛ yiye koraa no, nkurɔfo atra ha fi Abo Foforo bere no mu na wɔboaboa nnua ano, dua cassava ne banana, na wɔbɔ abɔmmɔ na wɔyi mpataa.

Mmoa a ɛwɔ hɔ 
Asono, gorilla, bonsu, anantwinini, duikers ne chimpanzee wɔ kwae a osu tɔ na owia bɔ kɛse wom mu, Hawksbill po mu mpɔtorɔ (Eretmochelys imbricata), po mu mpɔtorɔ a wɔn ho yɛ ahabammono (Chelonia mydas) ne ngodua ridley po mu mpɔtorɔ (Lepidochelys olivacea) kɔsra asubɔnten no ano na wɔde mpoano no di dwuma denam po mu mpɔtorɔ a wɔde aboa nhoma ayɛ a wɔde bɛwo. Mpɔtam hɔ ahyehyɛde bi a ɛhwɛ mpɔtorɔ a wɔyɛ aboa nhoma so hwɛ mpɔtorɔ mmea no so bere a wɔba mpoano sɛ wɔrebɛto wɔn nkesua no, wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ wɔn agyirae, wwɛn wɔn berebuw no, wɔyɛ mpɔtorɔ a wɔtow wɔn ho adwuma na wɔkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ma mpɔtam hɔfo. Nnomaa pii a wotu kɔ mmeae foforo kɔsra asubɔnten no ano na nnomaa a wɔtu mmirika bɛyɛ 10,000 di awɔw bere wɔ hɔ.

title: Akanda National Park
text:
Akanda Ɔman Mmoa Yɛmmea (National Park) yɛ Ɔman Mmoa Yɛmmea 13 a ɛwɔ Gabon a Ɔmampanyin Omar Bongo de sii hɔ wɔ afe 2002 mu wɔ mfeɛ mmienu nhwehwɛmu a DFC, WCS ne WWF yɛeɛ akyi no mu baako. Wɔayɛ ɔman no mmɔnten so atrae 13 no sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a egyina hɔ ma ɔman no mu abɔde a nkwa wom ahorow na ɛhyɛ nsrahwɛfo ho nkuran. Akanda National Park wɔ ɔman no atifi fam apuei, ɛbɛn Libreville, na mpoano wɔ Mondah ne Corisco po no ano.

Mangrove ne mpoano a asorɔkye a ɛwɔ hɔ titiriw na ɛwɔ ɔman no mmɔnten so atrae no mu. Gabon wɔ mangrove atɛkyɛ a ɛwɔ Afrika nyinaa mu 2.5% pɛ, nanso Akanda ne Pongara National Park a ɛbɛn hɔ no yɛ mangrove a wɔabɔ ho ban wɔ asasepɔn no so nyinaa mu 25%. Wɔdi dwuma titiriw wɔ abɔde a nkwa wom mu na wɔboa ma mpoano a atwa Libreville ho ahyia no gyina. Nnipa a wɔtow hyɛ wɔn so fi adan ne nnɔbae a wodua nyinaa mu no yɛ asiane ma mmɔnten so atrae abien no nyinaa.

Po mu mmoa dɔɔso wɔ po abien no nyinaa mu, na Corisco po no ma mpɔtorɔ nya baabi a ɛho hia a wodidi. Akanda ho hia wɔ amanaman ntam sɛ beae a nnomaa a wotu kɔtra mmeae foforo kɔ, na ɛhɔ na nnomaa a wɔte saa dɔɔso sen biara wɔ Gabon. Ɛyɛ IUCN Beae a Ɛho Hia.

Wiase Agyapade Mmeae a Ɛwɔ Asiane Mu

title: Bepɔw Nimba Strict Abɔde a Wɔkora So
text:
Mount Nimba Strict Nature Reserve yɛ beae a wɔabɔ ho ban ne UNESCO Wiase Agyapade a ɛwɔ Guinea ne Côte d’Ivoire nyinaa, a ne nyinaa yɛ hekta 17,540, na ne kɛse yɛ hekta 12,540 wɔ Guinea, ne hekta 5,000 wɔ Côte d’Ivoire. Akorae no kata Nimba Mmepɔw no afa atitiriw so, beae a ɛyɛ soronko wɔ asasesin mu a afifide ne mmoa a wɔdɔɔso soronko wɔ hɔ, a mmoa ahorow a wɔte hɔ wɔ beae biako te sɛ ntontom a wɔwo nkwa mu, ne apɔnkɔ nan ase akraman dodow soronko ka ho . Ne bepɔw a ɛkorɔn sen biara ne Bepɔw Richard-Molard a ne tenten yɛ mita 1,752 (5,750 ft), a ɛyɛ aman abien no nyinaa bepɔw a ɛkorɔn sen biara.

Abakɔsɛm 
Wɔde abɔde a wɔkora so a ɛyɛ katee no sii hɔ wɔ 1943 mu denam Ahyɛde a ɛto so 4190 SE/F so wɔ Côte d’Ivoire ne 1944 mu denam ahyɛde a wɔde mae wɔ Guinea so. Wogyee Guinea fa no toom sɛ biosphere akorae wɔ 1980 mu. Wɔkaa mmeae abien no nyinaa boom yɛɛ Wiase Agyapade Beae biako wɔ 1981 (Guinea) ne 1982 (Côte d’Ivoire) mu. Wofii ase hwehwɛɛ dade a wɔde tu fam wɔ mmepɔw so beae a ɛyɛ mmerɛw sen biara no wɔ 1992 mu, na wɔkyerɛw beae a wɔakora so no sɛ UNESCO Wiase Agyapade a ɛwɔ asiane mu fi saa bere no. Esiane ahobammɔ a ɛkɔ anim nti, Guinea Parks Foundation resi beae bi a wɔhwɛ nneɛma a wɔkora so so . Guinea Aban ne CEGENS penee adwuma no so wɔ afe 2016 mu.

Asase ho nsɛm 
Nimba Bepɔw no yɛ abon teateaa a ɛtrɛw bɛyɛ 40 ne tenten yɛ kilomita, a ɛkyerɛ atifi fam apuei–anafo fam atɔe; ɛyɛ Guinea Mmepɔw no kesee fam fa bi . Ne bepɔw a ɛkorɔn sen biara ne Bepɔw Richard-Molard a ne tenten yɛ mita 1,752 (5,750 ft). Mmepɔw afoforo a ɛwɔ soro no bi ne Grand Rochers a ɛwɔ 1694 mu m (5558) na ɛwɔ hɔ ft), Mont Sempéré wɔ afe 1682 mu m (5518) na ɛwɔ hɔ ft), Mont Piérré Richaud wɔ afe 1670 mu m (5479), ne Mont LeClerc wɔ afe 1577 mu m (5174) na ɛwɔ hɔ ft). Wɔn nyinaa wɔ Guinea fa a ɛwɔ beae a wɔakora wɔn so no. Asubura bɛyɛ aduonum na ɛwɔ hɔ, a Cavally, Cestos, ne Sassandra Asubɔnten no mfiase ka ho. Dade a ɛyɛ papa a wotu no de asiane kɛse ba asase ne wuram mmoa soronko no so.

Berɛ tenten mu wien bɔberɛ 
Nimba Bepɔw no wɔ wim tebea a ɛyɛ mmepɔw a ɛwɔ equatorial ase. Ɔhyew sesa kɛse bere a ɛkɔ soro no, na awiabere dodow a ɛsen biara no fi 24 °C ne 33 °C, na nea ɛba fam koraa anadwo no betumi akɔ fam asen 10 °C. Osu ntɔ kɛse wɔ mmeae bi a wɔkora so no, esiane osu-sunsuma a ɛwɔ abon a ɛkorɔn no so nti. Mpɛn pii no, anafo fam mmepɔw no yɛ nwini sen atifi fam de a mframa bɔ kɛse a Ɔpɛ mframa a ɛyɛ kusuu a efi Sahara no nya so nkɛntɛnso no . Nimba Bepɔw no, ne beae a wɔakora so no nso wɔ wim tebea nketenkete a ɛyɛ soronko.

Abɔde a Atwa Yɛn Ho Ahyia Ho Adesua 

Bepɔw Nimba Strict Nature Reserve da Guinea Kwae a ɛwɔ Afrika Atɔe Fam Abɔde a Nkwa Wom Ahorow a Ɛho Hia no mu . Ɛwɔ afifide ne mmoa a wɔdɔɔso titiriw, na ɛhɔ na afifide ahorow bɛboro 2000 a ɛwɔ ntini mu, mmoa ahorow 317 a wɔwɔ akyi berɛmo, a emu 107 yɛ mmoa a wɔnom nufu, ne mmoa ahorow bɛboro 2,500 a wonni akyi berɛmo . Wɔyɛ abɔde a nkwa wom ho nhwehwɛmu wɔ beae a wɔakora so no, efisɛ mmoa ahorow a wonnim wɔn pii da so ara wɔ hɔ. Mmoa a wɔwɔ akyi berɛmo a ɛwɔ hɔ titiriw ne Nimba viviparous toad ( Nimbaphrynoides occidentalis ), Lamotte nhaban kurukuruwa a wɔfrɛ no bat ( Hipposideros lamottei ), ne Nimba otter shrew ( Micropotamogale lamottei ). Mmoa afoforo a wɔn ho yɛ na na wɔn ase reyɛ atɔre ne Afrika Atɔe fam gyata ( Panthera leo senegalensis ), pygmy hippopotamus ( Choeropsis liberiensis ), ɔsebɔ duiker ( Cephalophus zebra ), ne atɔe fam akraman ( Pan troglodytes verus ) a wɔde abo di dwuma sɛ nnwinnade.

Asase so afifide gu ahorow sɛnea ɛkorɔn ne sɛnea ɛkɔ titiriw no.

 Bepɔw no atew ne ho afi wim nsupɔw afoforo a ɛwɔ Forest Guinea no ho denam West Sudan savanna a ɛwɔ asasetaw so ne Guinea kwae-savannah mosaic so . Savanna atrae ahorow no abubu esiane kwae a ɛwɔ gallery ne kwae nsupɔw a wɔatoto mu a ɛyɛ canopy nti.
 Atɔe fam Guinea Asasetaw Kwae no kata mmepɔw a ɛwɔ asasetaw ase no so kodu mita 600. Kwae a ɛda nsow ne kwae a ɛkorɔn a nhaban fabi gu a ɛwɔ akataso titiriw ne nea ɛrepue. Nnua ahorow 40-70 na wohu wɔ hekta biako mu, na kwae mu nnua ahorow a ɛkɔ soro kodu 500 na wɔakyerɛw wɔ mpɔtam hɔ.
 Guinea Montane Kwaeɛ no wɔ mita 600 ne 1200–1400 ntam. Wɔ mmeae a ɛba fam no, kwae atenten a nhaban fabi gu no trɛw kodu mita 900; sɛ wɔde toto asasetaw ho a, wodi hia wɔ mmoa ahorow mu. Wobetumi ahu kwae ntiantiaa a ɛso yɛ kusuu wɔ abon no apuei fam awiei. Efi soro mita 900, baabi a ɛkame ayɛ sɛ mununkum kata bepɔw no so afe no fakɛse no ara no, kwae a nsɔe wɔ hɔ, a wobetumi akyekyɛ mu abiɛsa: Parinari exclesa kwae (1), kwae a ɛwɔ atifi (2), ne kwae a nnua fern wɔ wɔ nkoko a asase ase nsu dɔɔso wom (3). Wɔ nnua beae no atifi no, Protea kwae mu nsakrae kɔ sare so.
 Sare a atew ne ho a ɛwɔ mmeae a ɛkorɔn no trɛw fi mita 1200 kosi 1400 kosi mmepɔw a ɛkorɔn sen biara no so. Ɛhɔ na mmoa a wɔwɔ akyi berɛmo a wɔagye din sen biara ne Nimba viviparous toad ( Nimbaphrynoides occidentalis ), ne Lamotte nhaban kurukuruwa ( Hipposideros lamottei ), nea etwa to no ho kyerɛwtohɔ fii beae biako pɛ a wotu fagude. Afifide a ɛwɔ hɔ no bi ne Asplenium schnellii, Osbeckia porteresii ne Blaeria nimbana .

Nsrahwɛ 
Bepɔw Nimba da akyirikyiri beae bi wɔ aman abiɛsa hye so wɔ Guinea, Côte d’Ivoire, ne Liberia, na ɛne wɔn ahenkurow ntam kwan ware. Nokwarem no, bepɔw no faa ɛwɔ Liberia no asɛe kɛse esiane kan adwuma a na wotu fagude nti. Nanso, wɔabɔ abon no faa ɛwɔ Guinea no ho ban kɛse; na enti saa ɔfayi da so ara yɛ mmepɔw so abɔde a nkwa wom a enni dɛm, ne mmoa ahorow a wɔaboaboa wɔn ho ano soronko (ne ɔfaa ɛyɛ ketewaa koraa, Ivoryefo nso). Sɛ wobɛkɔ abɔde akorae a ɛyɛ katee no mu a, ɛyɛ nea eye sen biara a wubetumi apaw afi Guinea, baabi a ɛhɔnom nsrahwɛfo bi yɛ nhyehyɛe ma wɔkyerɛ akwantu fi Conakry.

title: Manovo-Gounda St. Floris Ɔman Mmoa Yɛmmea
text:
Manovo-Gounda St. Floris Ɔman Mmoa Yɛmmea yɛ ɔman mmɔnten so atrae ne UNESCO Wiase Agyapade a ɛwɔ Central African Republic mantam Bamingui-Bangoran, a ɛbɛn Chad hye so. Wɔkyerɛw too Wiase Agyapade Mmeae a wɔahyehyɛ no mu wɔ 1988 mu esiane nkwa ahorow a ɛwɔ mu nti.

Nnomaa ahorow a ɛda nsow ne asono tuntum, asono, Sudan cheetahs, asono, asono a wɔn anim yɛ kɔkɔɔ, ne anantwinini, akraman, gyata ; nsu mu nnomaa ahorow pii nso wɔ atifi fam nsuyiri mmeae.

Beae no wɔ asiane mu esiane wuram mmoa a wɔntaa nhu a wɔrewuwu ne mmoa ahorow a wɔrepopa wɔn nti. Atɔe fam ɔkraman tuntum a na ɔyɛ Central African Republic kurom hɔfo no ase atɔre wɔ afe 2011 mu. Wɔde beae no kaa Wiase Agyapade a Ɛwɔ Asiane mu no ho bere a wɔbɔɔ amanneɛ sɛ abɔmmɔfo a wokurakura akode kɛse adidi ne abɔmmɔ a mmara mma ho kwan, a ebia wɔatwa wuram mmoa a wɔwɔ abɔnten so atrae no mu bɛyɛ 80%. Tuo a wɔtotow guu abɔnten so atrae hɔ adwumayɛfo baanan so wɔ 1997 mfiase ne tebea a na ahobammɔ resɛe wɔ ɔkwan a ɛkɔ akyiri so no maa nkɔso adwuma ne nsrahwɛ nyinaa gyaee.

Central African Republic aban no hyɛɛ nyansa sɛ wɔmfa beae no sohwɛ ho asɛyɛde mma ankorankoro fapem bi. Wiase Agyapade Boayikuw no kamfoo kyerɛe sɛ wonsiesie tebea a wɔbɛkora so ho amanneɛbɔ a ɛkɔ akyiri ne nhyehyɛe a wɔde besiesie beae no wɔ ne 1998 nhyiam ase. Nkurɔfo reyɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde bɛwo mmoa de asan akanyan wuram mmoa a wofi abɔde mu no.

Beaeɛ 
Abɔnten so atrae no wɔ Bamingui-Bangoran mantam no apuei fam awiei wɔ ɔman no atifi fam no fa kɛse no ara. Abɔnten so atrae no atifi fam hye ne amanaman ntam hye a ɛne Chad wɔ wɔ Aouk (Bahr) ne Kameur Asubɔnten no so. Apuei fam hye ne Vakaga Asubɔnten, atɔe fam hye ne Manovo Asubɔnten bɛyɛ 40 km wɔ N’Délé apuei fam, na anafo fam hye no yɛ Massif des Bongo abon no. Ndéle-Birao kwan no fa abɔnten so atrae no mu.

title: Virunga Ɔman Mmoa Yɛmmea
text:
Virunga Ɔman Mmoa Yɛmmea yɛ ɔman mmɔnten so atrae a ɛwɔ Albertine Rift Bon mu wɔ Democratic Republic of the Congo apuei fam . Wɔbɔɔ no wɔ 1925 mu. Wɔ ne sorokɔ mu no, efi 680 m (2,230) na ɛwɔ hɔ ft) wɔ Semliki Asubɔnten bon mu koduu 5,109 m (16,762) na ɛwɔ hɔ ft) wɔ Rwenzori Mmepɔw so . Efi atifi fam kosi anafo fam no, ɛtrɛw bɛyɛ 300 km (190) na ɛwɔ hɔ mi), a ne fa kɛse no ara wɔ amanaman ntam ahye a ɛne Uganda ne Rwanda wɔ apuei fam no so. Ne kɛse yɛ 8,090 kilomita

Ogya mmepɔw abien a ɛyɛ nnam wɔ abɔnten so atrae hɔ, Bepɔw Nyiragongo ne Nyamuragira . Wɔayɛ ɔman no mmɔnten so atrae no atrae ahorow ne wuram mmoa ahorow no kɛse . Wɔakyerɛw mmoa ne nhwiren ahorow bɛboro 3,000 ho asɛm, na emu bɛboro 300 wɔ Albertine Rift a apuei fam gorilla ( Gorilla beringei ) ne sika kɔkɔɔ bonsu ( Cercopithecus kandti ) ka ho .

Wɔ 1979 mu no, wɔkyerɛw Ɔman Mmoa Yɛmmea no din sɛ UNESCO Wiase Agyapade esiane mmeae ahorow a ɛdɔɔso a ɛwɔ hɔ, abɔde a nkwa wom ne mmoa a wɔte hɔ a ɛyɛ soronko, ne bepɔw so akraman a wɔntaa ntra a ɛbɔ ho ban nti.  Wɔakyerɛw no din wɔ Wiase Agyapade a Ɛwɔ Asiane mu Kyerɛwtohɔ mu fi 1994 esiane ɔmanfo basabasayɛ ne nnipa a wɔdɔɔso wɔ ɔmantam no mu nti.

Atuatewfo akuw de ntua a edi awu pii aba abɔnten so atrae hɔ, na wɔakunkum mmɔnten so ahwɛfo pii.
