title: Bahi Abotan-Adwinni Mmeae
text:
Bahi Abotan-Adwinni Beae anaa Bahi abotan so mfonini yɛ abotan ho adwini (rock art) a ɛwɔ mmeae abiɛsa (3) wɔ Dodoma mantam mu (Dodoma region) wɔ Tanzania.  Wogye di sɛ saa mfoni fitaa yi yɛ Wamiafo a wɔtraa ɔmantam no mu ansa na Wagogofo (wɔn a wɔte hɔ mprempren) reba no na wɔyɛe. Wɔkyerɛ sɛ wɔyɛɛ mfonini ahorow a ɛkyerɛ anantwi, nnipa ahoni, nkuku, akutu, anomaa, ne agyan, ne agyan, ne sɛnkyerɛnnede afoforo no wɔ mmere atitiriw te sɛ ayi ase. Ɛwom sɛ Wagogofo no nnim mfitiase ntease a mfonini ahorow no kyerɛ ma Wamiafo no yiye de, nanso wɔakɔ so de mmeae no adi dwuma sɛ mmeae kronkron a wɔyɛ osutɔ ho guasodeyɛ ahorow. Anyɛ yiye koraa no, wobu akontaa sɛ Bahifo mfonini ahorow no adi mfe 340 a egyina Bahifo panyin no abusua anato so wɔ 1929 mu, a ɛdaa bere a wobu akontaa sɛ ne nana Kimanchambogo baa mpɔtam hɔ adi. Mpɛn pii no, wɔde ɔkwan a wɔfa so yɛ mfonini fitaa no bata akuafo a wɔka Bantu kasa ho.

title: Ɔtare Rukwa
text: Ɔtare Rukwa yɛ ɔtare a ɛwɔ endorheic a ɛwɔ Rukwa Bon mu wɔ Rukwa Mansin, Songwe Mantam ne Katavi Mantam mu wɔ Tanzania anafo fam atɔe. Ɔtare no ne nsu a ɛwɔ asase mu a ɛso sen biara wɔ ɔman no mu a ɛto so abiɛsa (3).

title: Momba Mansin
text: Momba Mansin yɛ mansin a ɛwɔ Songwe Mantam mu, Tanzania.[1] Wɔhyehyɛɛ no fii Mbozi Mansin no atɔe fam bere a wɔbɔɔ Songwe Mantam fii Mbeya Mantam mu no.

title: Songwe Mantam
text: Songwe Mantam (Mkoa wa Songwe wɔ Swahili kasa mu) yɛ Tanzania mantam a wɔbɔɔ no wɔ 29 Ɔpɛpɔn 2016 firii Mbeya Mantam no atɔeɛ fa.[3][4] N’ahenkuro ne Vwawa.[1]

title: Ivuna
text:
Ivuna yɛ adwumayɛbea a ɛhwɛ adwumayɛ so wɔ Momba Mansin mu, Songwe Mantam mu wɔ Tanzania. Sɛnea afe 2002 nnipakan kyerɛ no, nnipa dodow a wɔwɔ ward no nyinaa yɛ 21,690.

Wɔde Ivuna nkyene a ɛwɔ Ɔtare Rukwa anafo fam apuei no adi dwuma de ayɛ nkyene fi afeha a ɛto so 13 mfiase, anaa ansa na ɛno reba, kosi afeha a ɛto so 15. Wɔahu Dade Mmere mu nkuku pii wɔ ha.

title: Dade Mmere mu (Iron Age)
text: Dade Mmere no yɛ bere a etwa to a wɔde mfe abiɛsa (3) kyekyɛɛ adesamma abakɔsɛm a edi kan ne abakɔsɛm a edi kan no mu. Abo Mmere (Paleolithic, Mesolithic, Neolithic) ne Kɔbere Mmere (Chalcolithic) na edii n’anim. Wɔde adwene no adi dwuma kɛse wɔ Dade Mmere mu Europa ne Tete Apuei a Ɛbɛn no ho, nanso, sɛ wɔde toto ho a, wɔde adi dwuma wɔ Wiase Dedaw no mmeae afoforo nso.

title: Kaole
text:
Kaole yɛ ɔman abakɔsɛm beae a ɛwɔ Bagamoyo Mansin mu wɔ Pwani Mantam mu wɔ Tanzania. Beae no wɔ abakɔsɛm mu kurow Bagamoyo apuei fam akwansin abiɛsa wɔ India Po no mpoano. Swahilifo abo dedaw a wɔde akorade ayɛ a efi afeha a ɛto so 13 ne afeha a ɛto so 16 ntam no wɔ mpɔtam hɔ. Amamfõ no bi fi afeha a ɛto so 13 mu na ɛwɔ asɔredan abien ne adamoa 30.

Wɔde akorade abo a wɔde abo adum a ɛhyɛ adamoa no bi agyirae na esii adamoa a ɛwɔ Kaole no. Sɛnea ɛhɔnom atetesɛm kyerɛ no, adamoa no bi yɛ mpɔtam hɔ sodifo a na wonim wɔn sɛ "diwanis" no adamoa. Wogye di sɛ "Diwanis" yɛ Sheikh Ali Muhamad al-Hatim al-Barawi asefo. Wɔasisi tete nneɛma akorae ketewaa bi, baabi a wɔda nneɛma bi a wohuu wɔ amamfõ no mu adi. Saa nneɛma yi bi yɛ Chinafo de ma enti ɛma wonya tete aguadi mu abusuabɔ ho adanse.

Abakɔsɛm 
Mfiase no, wɔtraa Kaole wɔ afeha a ɛto so 8 mu sɛ aguadi kurow. Anka mangrove nnua, sandalwood, ebony ne asonse bɛyɛ nneɛma atitiriw a wɔde di gua. Ná wɔde nnua na esisi Kaolefo atrae dodow no ara, na ɛmaa ɛnyɛ den sɛ abo asɔredan ne adamoa no. Akyiri yi, Zaramofoɔ a wɔwɔ mpɔtam hɔ no frɛɛ beaeɛ no Kaole, a ɛkyerɛ "kɔ na hwɛ". Nea odii kan suaa Kaole Amamfõ no ho ade ne Britania fam tutufo Neville Chittick, bɛyɛ afe 1958.

title: Luxmanda
text:
Luxmanda yɛ beae a wotutu fam hwehwɛ tetefo nneɛma mu a ɛwɔ Babati Mantam a ɛwɔ Tanzania atifi fam mfinimfini . Wohuu no wɔ afe 2012 mu. Tutuo a wɔatu wɔ mpɔtam hɔ no ama wɔahu sɛ ɛyɛ beaeɛ a ɛso sen biara na ɛwɔ anafoɔ fam paa wɔ Savanna Pastoral Neolithic (SPN) mu, a ɛyɛ mmoayɛn amammerɛ a wɔgye tom wɔ fam tutu mu a ɛwɔ Afrika apueeɛ fam wɔ berɛ bi a wɔfrɛ no Pastoral Neolithic (bɛyɛ 5000– 1200 BP). Radiocarbon a ɛkyerɛ bere a fango, nnipa collagen, ne nneɛma a nkwa wom a ɛwɔ dɔte nneɛma mu no kyerɛ sɛ na nnipa te Luxmanda mfe 3,200 kosi 2,900 a atwam ni. Wɔanya dɔte (a ɛyɛ Narosura su), abo a wɔde ayɛ, nnompe a wɔayɛ adwuma, asonse, ne ostrich nkesua a wɔaboaboa ano a ɛka mmoa ne nnipa nnompe ho afi Luxmanda beae no. Na Luxmandafo yɛ mmoahwɛfo a wɔn ho akokwaw kɛse, na na wɔde wɔn ho to anantwi, nguan, mpapo, ne mfurum so de di wɔn asetrade. Wonnim wɔn kasa mu abusuabɔ, nanso abakɔsɛm mu kasa ho abenfo binom asusuw sɛ na nnipa a wɔwɔ SPN no ka Kushi kasa ahorow. Pastoral Neolithic no akyi no Pastoral Iron Age ne Bantufo Ntrɛwmu.

Tete DNA nhwehwɛmu 
Admixture clustering analysis a wɔyɛe wɔ nkokoaa nnompe a wadi mfe 3,100 a wotutuu wɔ Luxmanda no hui sɛ onipa no kura ne nananom bɛyɛ 38±1% a ɛfa Pre-Pottery Neolithic amammerɛ a ɛwɔ Levant ho. Awosu mu nsɛm foforo a efi Luxmanda kyerɛ sɛ ɛbɛyɛ sɛ saa abusuabɔ yi fi akuafo a wofi Levant ansa na wɔreyɛ nkuku no asefo a wotu kɔɔ Afrika, anaasɛ abusua a wɔtaa fi nananom a wɔnyɛ Afrikafo a wɔtraa Afrika anaa Apuei Fam a Ɛbɛn mfirihyia mpempem pii a atwam no mu. Mmarima no nyinaa yɛɛ nhwehwɛmu sɛ Y chromosomal DNA a E1b1b subclades ayɛ akuwakuw, a abien maa A1b subclades a ɛyɛ ambivalent bae esiane collagen a ɛnnɔɔso nti.

Na Afrika fa a ɛwɔ Luxmanda ankorankoro abusua mu no fata sɛ ɛne abɔmmɔfo-aboaboafo dodow bi a wɔte Ethiopia ca. 4,500 BP (wɔ nnipa mmienu a wɔde afrafra tebea ase, a wɔsusu sɛ nananom dodoɔ yɛ 62.2–62.8% ma hunter-gather fa no ne 37.2-37.8% ma Pre-Pottery Neolithic B fa no) anaasɛ ɛfiri nnipa dodoɔ bi a wɔne Dinka wɔ abusuabɔ nso ( wɔ nnipa mmiɛnsa afrafra tebea ase, a wɔsusu sɛ nananom dodoɔ yɛ 39% ± 1% nananom a ɛfa Levantine ho). Bio nso, haplogroup nhwehwɛmu kyerɛe sɛ Luxmanda nhwɛsode no kura haplogroup L2a1 (mtDNA). Na nyansahufo adi kan akyerɛ sɛ sɛ wɔkyekyem pɛpɛɛpɛ a, nananom a wɔne Eurasia Atɔe Fam wɔ abusuabɔ wɔ Afrika apuei fam a mprempren abu so wɔ ɔmantam no mu no baa bɛyɛ afe 3000 BP. Awosu mu nsɛm foforo no kyerɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔyɛɛ Savanna Pastoral Neolithic no na ɛyɛ wɔn asɛyɛde sɛ wɔtrɛw tete nananom a ɛfa Levant ho no mu wɔ ɔtare mantam no mu, faako a na wɔasisi atrae foforo no. Ɛbɛyɛ sɛ Luxmanda ankorankoro no dodow nso na ɛde mmoayɛn baa Afrika kesee fam, efisɛ wohui sɛ ankorankoro bi a wadi mfe 1,200 a ɔyɛ mmoahwɛfo a ofi Western Cape no ne Luxmanda nhwɛsode no wɔ abusuabɔ.

text:

title: Kéran Ɔman Mmoa Yɛmmea
text:
Ghana nsubɔnteneOti-Kéran Ɔman Mmoa Yɛmmea wɔ Togo atifi fam, wɔ Kara mpɔtam hɔ. Ɔkwan biako pɛ na ɛfa saa beae yi. Nsrahwɛfo pii nkɔ Togo efisɛ ɔman no mmɔnten so atrae atitiriw no na wotumi kɔ hɔ kɛse wɔ Ghana.

Asetra mu nkɛntɛnso 
Oti-Kéran Ɔman Mmoa Yɛmmea no yɛ abɔde akorae a ɛwɔ Togo atifi fam a mfiase no wɔatrɛw mu kɛse fi 1960 mfe no mu no dea. Wɔyɛɛ saa nneyɛe yi a mpɔtam hɔfo ampene so na wɔamfa wɔn ho anhyɛ mu. Sɛ́ anka wobenya sika afi nsrahwɛ ne aguadi hokwan afoforo a ebetumi abata ɔman no mmɔnten so atrae ahorow mu no, woyii nkurɔfo fii wɔn asase so na wogyaee kuayɛ mu nkɔso, na ɛde ohia ne ɔkɔm mpo kɔɔ soro. Bio nso, wuram mmoa - titiriw asono - a wofi mmeae a wɔabɔ ho ban nanso wɔammɔ ho ban no sɛee mfuw ne nnɔbae wɔ mpɔtam a atwa ho ahyia no. Eyi maa ɛhɔfo no ani nnye mmeae a wɔabɔ ho ban ne wuram mmoa no ho. Wɔ amammui mu basabasayɛ mu wɔ 1990 mu no, ɔtan yi gyaee denam ntua akɛse a wɔtow hyɛɛ mmeae a wɔabɔ ho ban no so ne mmoa a wokunkum wɔn pii, na ɛde nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia no sɛee kɛse bae.

Nhyehyɛe a wɔsan yɛe fi 1999 
Esiane ɔsɛe a ɛtrɛw ne nnipa ntua a wɔde baa mmeae a wɔabɔ ho ban no nti, Togo atumfoɔ yɛɛ nsakrae wɔ abɔnten so atrae no hye so fi 1999. Wɔayi mmeae a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri a wobu no sɛ wɔasɛe no dodo sɛ wɔbɛsan ayɛ no abɔde mu de no afi ɔman no mmɔnten so atrae no mu na wɔayi afi aban mu ama nnipa nkɔso. Eyi maa ɔman no mmɔnten so atrae a mprempren wɔato din Oti-Kéran Ɔman Mmoa Yɛmmea no kɛse so tew fi 179550 koduu hekta 69000. Wɔayɛ nhyehyɛe sɛ nea aka no bɛyɛ daakye abɔde a nkwa wom a wɔbɛkora so no fa, a Oti-Mandouri Ɔman Mmoa Yɛmmea no de bɛbata WAP ( W, Arli, Pendjari ) beae nhyehyɛe a wɔabɔ ho ban wɔ Burkina Faso, Benin, ne Niger no ho . Nanso, ɛda so ara wɔ asiane mu esiane nnipa a wɔte hɔ, kotoku a wɔyɛ, fango a wɔyɛ, ne nnipa dwumadi afoforo a ɛwɔ abɔnten so atrae no hye so nti.

Abɔde a nkwa wom ho nsrahwɛ 
Ná abɔde a nkwa wom ho nsrahwɛ anya nkɔso yiye wɔ Oti-Kéran Ɔman Mmoa Yɛmmea ansa na 1990 reba. South Africa adwumakuw bi de sika hyɛɛ nsrahwɛ nhyehyɛe (ahɔhodan, akwan, mmeae a wɔhwɛ nneɛma ne nea ɛkeka ho) ne abɔde a nkwa wom ho nsrahwɛ mu no maa sika a wonyae ɔsram biara fii mmeae a wɔabɔ ho ban sohwɛ mu a ɛbɛyɛ CFA ɔpepem 50-60 (U$100000-120000) wɔ Oti-Kéran nkutoo. Saa bere no na wobu no sɛ ɔmantam nhwɛsode ma mmeae a wɔabɔ ho ban abɔde a nkwa wom ho nsrahwɛ nkɔso na mfonini ahorow da so ara wɔ hɔ a ɛfa asono akuwakuw ne mmeae atitiriw afoforo a ɛtwetwe nsrahwɛfo wɔ Park no mu. Ɛnnɛ nneɛma a wɔde yɛ adwuma no nyinaa asɛe na abɔde a nkwa wom ho nsrahwɛ adwuma no nnya mfii ase ankasa wɔ Oti-Kéran mpɔtam hɔ wɔ bere tenten a ɛde asetra ne amammui mu ɔhaw ahorow bae no akyi. Mpɔtam hɔ nsrahwɛfo kakraa bi pɛ na wofi aman a ɛbemmɛn hɔ (WAP complex Niger, Burkina Faso, Benin) ba, nanso wonni nneɛma anaa dabere a ɛfata wɔ Togo a ɛbɛhyɛ wɔn nkuran ma wɔatra hɔ akyɛ. Ɔman no Nsrahwɛ Dwumadibea no de ne mmɔdenbɔ reto Plateau Mantam no mu na wobu no sɛ ɛho hia sɛ wɔsan hyɛ mmeae a wɔabɔ ho ban wɔ Oti-Keran / Oti-Mandouri Complex no sohwɛ mu den na wɔsan de atrae ne mmoa si hɔ ansa na wɔayɛ nhyehyɛe a ɛfa abɔde a nkwa wom ho nsrahwɛ ho atu mpɔn.

Mmoa 
Ɔsɛe a ɛbaa 1990 mfe no mu no maa mmoa ahorow a ɛwɔ Togo ɔman mmɔnten so atrae ahorow no so tew bere a wɔde totoo nea ɛwɔ Burkina Faso ne Benin a ɛbɛn hɔ no ho no. Nhwehwɛmu bi a wɔyɛe wɔ afe 2008 mu no bobɔɔ mmoa ahorow a edidi so yi din ɛwom sɛ ɛkae sɛ wɔn gyinabea nyɛ nokware de:

Mmoa a wɔnom nufusu

 Afrika asono (African elephant - Loxodonta africana) - Ade a wɔtaa hu na wɔtwetwe wɔ 1980 mfe no mu, ɛbɛyɛ sɛ ɛkaa kakraa bi na wɔatɔre asono ase wɔ 1990 mfe no mu. Nhwehwɛmu bi a wɔyɛe wɔ wim wɔ afe 2003 mu no antumi anhu asono wɔ abɔnten so. Ɛnnɛ, wɔbɔ ankorankoro ne akuw a wotu kɔtra mmeae foforo a ɛba bere ne bere mu ho amanneɛ. UNDP adwuma bi a ɛfiri afe 2010 no botaeɛ ne sɛ wɔbɛsan de mmoa dodoɔ bɛyɛ aduonu asi hɔ wɔ abɔnten so.
 Ngodua kontromfi (Olive baboon - Papio anubis).
 Tantalus adoe (Tantalus monkey - Chlorocebus tantalus) - Wɔtaa kyerɛw din sɛ Cercopithecus aethiops .
 Patas adoe (Patas monkey - Erythrocebus patas ) - Wɔnam wim nhwehwɛmu bi so sii so dua sɛ saa mmoa yi wɔ hɔ wɔ afe 2003.
 Adowa a yɛ frɛ Kob (Kobus kob kob) - Wɔnam wim nhwehwɛmu bi so sii so dua sɛ saa mmoa yi wɔ hɔ wɔ afe 2003.

 Adowa a ne ho yɛ kɔkɔɔ (Red-flanked duiker - Cephalophus rufilatus).
 Adowa a yɛfrɛ no Common duiker 03.
 Afrika anantwinini (African buffalo - Synceros caffer brachyceros).
 Susono 
 kɔkɔte (Warthog - Phacochoerus africanus africanus ) - Wɔnam wim nhwehwɛmu bi so sii so dua sɛ saa mmoa yi wɔ hɔ wɔ afe 2003.
 Afrika Atɔe Fam gyata (West African lion - Panthera leo senegalensis) - Wɔabɔ gyata ankorankoro ho amanneɛ wɔ mmeae bi, nea etwa to wɔ afe 2005 mu. Gyata biara nni Togo a ɛtra hɔ daa.
 kɔtɔkɔ a ne ho yɛ den (Crested porcupine - Hystrix cristata).
 Asase so opurow a ne ho yɛ nsensanee (Striped ground squirrel - Xerus (Euxerus) erythropus erythropus ) .

title: Abdul Manaf Nurudeen
text:
Abdul Manaf Nurudeen (wɔwoo no 8 Ɔpɛpɔn 1999) yɛ Ghana bɔɔlbɔfoɔ. ɔkyere bɔɔl ma Belgium bɔɔlbɔ kuo Eupen ne Ghana mmarima mpanyimfo bɔɔlbɔ kuw.

Club adwuma 
Sɛ́ babunu bɔɔlbɔfoɔ no, Manaf Nurudeen kɔkaa Senegal Aspire Academy ho .

Wɔ afe 2017 mu no, ɔde ne nsa hyɛɛ Eupen ase wɔ Belgium. Wɔ 7 Ɔbɛnem 2020 no, ɔdii kan debut maa Eupen wɔ 1–1 draw ne Waasland-Beveren . 

Manaf Nurudeen hyɛ bɔɔlbɔfo dade kyɛw. 

Manaf Nurudeen gyinaa Ghana ananmu wɔ 2019 Africa U-20 Cup of Nations .

Wɔdii kan frɛɛ no kɔɔ Ghana ɔman bɔɔlbɔfoɔ  kuo no mu wɔ September 2021 mu maa World Cup qualifiers a wɔne Ethiopia ne South Africa bɛdi, na ɔkɔɔ so tenaa benkyi so wɔ saa agodie yi mu. 

Nurudeen kaa Ghana kuo no ho wɔ afe 2021 Africa Cup of Nations a wɔyii wɔn firii mu wɔ akansi no kuo mu.  Ɔne Ghana dii kan wɔ adamfofa akansi mu wɔ 3-0 mu wɔ Algeria wɔ 5 Ɔbɛnem 2022.

title: Minaret a ɛwɔ Jam
text:
Minaret of Jam yɛ UNESCO Wiase Agyapade Beae a ɛwɔ Afghanistan atɔe fam . Ɛwɔ beae bi a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri na ɛkame ayɛ sɛ wontumi nkɔ hɔ wɔ Shahrak Mantam mu wɔ Ghor Mantam mu, wɔ Hari Asubɔnten no nkyɛn . Nsɛm a wɔka kyerɛ 62 m (203) na ɛwɔ hɔ ft)  anaa 65 m (213) na ɛwɔ hɔ ft)  wɔde birikisi a wɔato na esii minaret a ɛkorɔn bɛyɛ afe 1190 mu na agye din wɔ birikisi, stucco ne tile a wɔde ahwehwɛ ayɛ a ɛyɛ nwonwa, a ɛyɛ kufic ne naskhi nkyerɛwee a ɛsesa, geometric nsusuwso, ne nkyekyem ahorow a efi Kur’aan mu . Efi 2002 no, minaret no da so ara wɔ Wiase Agyapade a Ɛwɔ Asiane mu, a ɛwɔ asiane kɛse mu sɛ asase bɛsɛe, na wɔankora so denneennen.  Wɔ afe 2014 mu no, BBC bɔɔ amanneɛ sɛ abantenten no wɔ asiane a ɛreyɛ abubu mu.

Wɔ afe 2020 mu no, Islam Wiase Nhomasua, Nyansahu ne Amammerɛ Ahyehyɛde (ICESCO) de Minaret of Jam din too Islam wiase no amammerɛ agyapadeɛ ho. Sɛnea Afghanistan Amannɔne Nsɛm Ho Dwumadibea (MoFA) kyerɛ no, Minaret of Jam ne Afghanistan amammerɛ agyapade a edi kan a ICESCO de ne din ahyɛ mu.

Etymology ho adesua 
Asɛmfua minaret yɛ Arabic kasa [منارة] na ɛtaa kyerɛ abantenten bi a ɛbɛn asɔredan bi a muezzin frɛ anokwafo fi hɔ ma wɔbɔ mpae. Nanso ɛsan nso kyerɛ kaneadua na ɛwɔ ntease afoforo. Ɛha no, wɔde di dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛnyɛ den so.

Beaeɛ 
Ɛbɛyɛ sɛ Jam Minaret no wɔ beae a na Ghurid Ahemman no ahenkurow Firozkoh, wɔ no. 

Minaret a ɛyɛ kurukuruwa no gyina nnyinaso a ɛwɔ ahinanan so; na ɛwɔ nnua abrannaa 2 na na kanea bi wɔ so. Ne nkyerɛkyerɛmu a wɔde ma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfata so no ne Ghazni minarets a Masud III sii no di nsɛ kɛse.  Wosusuw sɛ ɛyɛ nea ɛkanyan Qutub Minar a ɛwɔ Delhi, India no tẽẽ .

Jam Minaret no yɛ kuw bi a wɔyɛ minarets ne abantenten bɛyɛ 60 a wosisii wɔ afeha a ɛto so 11 ne 13 ntam wɔ Asia Mfinimfini, Iran ne Afghanistan, a Kutlug Timur Minaret a ɛwɔ Old Urgench (a wobu no bere tenten sɛ eyinom mu nea ɛware sen biara a ɛda so ara wɔ hɔ) ka ho.  Wosusuw sɛ wosii minarets no sɛ Nkramofo nkonimdi ho sɛnkyerɛnne, bere a na abantenten afoforo yɛ agyiraehyɛde anaa ɔwɛn abantenten ara kwa.

Abakɔsɛm 
Wɔ afeha a ɛto so 12 ne 13 mu no, na Ghuridfo dii nea mprempren wɔfrɛ hɔ Afghanistan no so, nanso na wodi Iran apuei fam mmeae bi, Asia Mfinimfini fam, India Atifi fam ne Pakistan mmeae bi nso so.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Kwae a osu tɔ na owia bɔ kɛse wɔ Sumatra Agyapade
text:
Wɔkyerɛw Tropical Rainforest Heritage of Sumatra beae no sɛ UNESCO Wiase Agyapade wɔ afe 2004 mu. Ɛyɛ Indonesia ɔman mmɔnten so atrae abiɛsa a ɛwɔ Sumatra supɔw so : Gunung Leuser Ɔman Mmoa Yɛmmea, Kerinci Seblat Ɔman Mmoa Yɛmmea ne Bukit Barisan Selatan Ɔman Mmoa Yɛmmea . Wɔakyerɛw beae no wɔ Criteria vii - beae a ɛyɛ fɛ a ɛda nsow; ix- nhwɛsoɔ a ɛda nsow a egyina hɔ ma abɔdeɛ a nkwa wom ne abɔdeɛ mu nneɛma a ɛkɔ so titire; na x- kura abɔdeɛ mu atraeɛ a ɛho hia na ɛho hia paa a wɔde bɛkora so wɔ beaeɛ hɔ.  Wɔde Tropical Rainforest Heritage a ɛwɔ Sumatra no ahyɛ Asiane Nkyerɛwde no mu fi afe 2011 de aboa ma wɔadi asiane ahorow a efi mmoa a wɔkyere wɔn we, nnuatwa a mmara mma ho kwan, kuayɛ a wɔtow hyɛ so, ne nhyehyɛe a wɔayɛ sɛ wɔbɛfa beae no so de aba no so.

Beae ne ne kɛse 
Sumatra Kwae a Osu tɔ kɛse wom Agyapade no yɛ ɔman mmɔnten so atrae abiɛsa: Gunung Leuser Ɔman Mmoa Yɛmmea (GLNP) (8629.75 km 2 ), Kerinci Seblat Ɔman Mmoa Yɛmmea (KSNP) (13,753.5 km 2 ) ne Bukit Barisan Selatan Ɔman Mmoa Yɛmmea (BBSNP) (3568 km 2 ). Kwae a osu tɔ na owia bɔ kɛse wom no nyinaa yɛ 25,000 km 2 na ɛwɔ hɔ. Wɔpaw Tropical Rainforest Heritage of Sumatra efisɛ, nea edi kan no, egyina hɔ ma kwae a ɛho hia wɔ Sumatra supɔw so, esiane abɔde a nkwa wom ahorow nti, kwae a ɛwɔ asasetaw ne mmepɔw so nti. Wɔayɛ saa supɔw kɛse a bere bi na ɛyɛ kwae a osu tɔ na owia bɔ kɛse wom yi mu ma ayɛ mmeae a atew ne ho, wɔ mfe 50 ntam.

Asase ho nsɛm ne wim tebea 
Gunung Leuser National Park a ɛwɔ supɔw no atifi fam no yɛ 150 ne tenten yɛ kilomita, boro 100 ne tɛtrɛtɛ yɛ kilomita na ne fa kɛse no ara yɛ mmepɔw. Abɔnten so atrae no 40% yɛ mmepɔwmmepɔw, na ɛboro mita 1,500. 12% wɔ abɔnten so atrae no nkutoo, wɔ anafo fam fa a ɛwɔ fam no, wɔ fam mita 600 nanso ɛyɛ 25 km tu mmirika sian kɔ mpoano. Mmepɔw du-baako boro mita 2,700 na beae a ɛkorɔn sen biara ne Gunung Leuser a ɛkɔ mita 3,466. Wɔfrɛ beae a atwa Gunung Leuser ho ahyia no Leuser Ecosystem .

Afifide ne mmoa a wɔte hɔ 
GLNP yɛ Indonesia mmeae 18 a Wiase Nyinaa Abɔde Ho Foto (WWF) de ahyɛ wiase nyinaa abɔde a nkwa wom mpɔtam 200 a ɛho hia ma wiase abɔde a nkwa wom a wɔkora so no fa. 174 mammals, 3 yɛ nea ɛwɔ hɔ na 21 a wɔakyerɛw wɔn din sɛ wɔn a wɔwɔ asiane mu wɔ afe 2000 mu. Kakraa bi na wonim fa mmoa nketewa a wɔnom nufusu no ho. Wɔakyerɛw nnomaa ahorow 380 din, 13 yɛ nea ɛwɔ hɔ na 52 wɔ asiane mu. Nnomaa ahorow a ɛho hia no bi: orangutan, Sumatra asono, ne bonsu a ne ho yɛ mprako dua. Afifide a ɛho hia ne: Rafflesia arnoldi, ne Amorphophallus titanum . Nnomaa ahorow pii a ɛho hia: Rueck’s blue-flycatcher, ne dua ananse a ne ntaban fitaa .

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: East Rennell
text:
East Rennell yɛ Rennell Supɔw no kesee fam fa a ɛwɔ Solomon Islands a wɔakyerɛ sɛ ɛyɛ UNESCO Wiase Agyapade Beae . Rennell yɛ coral atoll a ɛso sen biara a wɔama so wɔ wiase na beae a ɛwɔ East Rennell a atwa Ɔtare Tegano ho ahyia no wɔ mmoa ahorow pii a ɛwɔ hɔ .

Wɔ afe 2013 mu no, Wiase Agyapadeɛ Boayikuo no de East Rennell kaa Wiase Agyapadeɛ a Ɛwɔ Asiane mu no ho ɛnam sɛ nnuatwa adwuma no wɔ asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ ma beaeɛ no boɔ a ɛda nsow wɔ amansan nyinaa mu nti.

Beaeɛ 
Rennell wɔ Pacific Atɔe fam na ɛyɛ Solomon Nsupɔw no anafo fam pɛɛ, na ne kɛse bɛyɛ 86 by 15 km (53 ne 9 mi) . Ɛyɛ akorade supɔw a wɔama so sen biara wɔ wiase, na ne 37,000 hectares (91,000 acres) . Kwae a ɛyɛ den na ɛkata so kɛse na supɔw no anafo fam awiei mfinimfini no, Ɔtare Tegano (a wɔsan frɛ no Te Nggano) wɔ hɔ, a bere bi na ɛyɛ atoll no ɔtare ; ɔtare no ani wɔ po so na nsu no yɛ nkyene. Abotan atwa ho ahyia na nsupɔw nketewa a wɔde abo a wɔfrɛ no limestone ayɛ wɔ so. East Rennell a wɔkyerɛe sɛ Wiase Agyapade wɔ 1998 mu no wɔ supɔw no kesee fam awiei; beae no bi ne Ɔtare Tegano, asase a atwa ho ahyia, ne po mu mmeae a efi supɔw no so kɔ hɔ yɛ po so akwansin abiɛsa no. Beae no nsɛee, ahum taa sɛe no, na "wobu no sɛ ɛyɛ abɔde mu nhwehwɛmu dan ankasa a wɔde yɛ nyansahu mu nhwehwɛmu."

Abakɔsɛm 
Supɔw no sofo bɛyɛ 800 na wɔte nkuraa anan a atwa Ɔtare Tegano ho ahyia mu. Wɔyɛ akuafo ne apofofo a wɔde wɔn ho to kwae ne nsu so na ama wɔanya wɔn ahiade atitiriw nyinaa. Wɔwiee beaeɛ no sohwɛ nhyehyɛeɛ wɔ afe 2007 mu a wɔne supɔ no sofoɔ a wɔgye tom sɛ wɔwɔ hokwan sɛ wɔtoa wɔn atetesɛm amammerɛ nneyɛeɛ ne wɔn asetena kwan so. Wosusuw sɛ eyinom nsɛe beae no, IUCN ka sɛ "amammerɛ mu wurayɛ betumi ayɛ nea ɛfata kɛse ma nneɛma a wɔkora so sen sɛ na asase no wɔ aban adwumayɛbea bi a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri tumi ase".

Afifide ne mmoa a wɔte hɔ 
Kwae a ɛyɛ den akata supɔw no so a ɛma nnomaa ahorow pii no nya atrae. Ɛretwa nnua wɔ supɔw no atɔe fam awiei, wɔ beae no akyi, na ɛde nnomaa a wɔwɔ supɔw no nyinaa so no reto asiane mu denam kwae no mmeae a wohia no a ɛresɛe no so. Ne saa nti, wɔ afe 2013 mu no, UNESCO de East Rennell kaa ne List of World Heritage in Danger ho . Wɔakyerɛw nnomaa ahorow aduonum wɔ supɔw no so, na eyinom mu aduonu biako na ɛwɔ hɔ.  BirdLife International akyerɛ sɛ beae no yɛ Nnomaa Beae a Ɛho Hia (IBA) efisɛ ɛboa nnomaa ahorow yi pii dodow, a nnuaba mmorɔnoma a wɔde dwetɛ akata wɔn so, yellow-bibbed lories, Rennell akɔre, green pygmy akɔre, cardinal myzomelas, Rennell ka ho gerygones, Rennell fantails, Melanesiafo nwansena a wɔkyere nwansena, Rennell shrikebills, aniwa a ɛda hɔ kwa ne Rennell aniwa fitaa, ne Rennell starlings .

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Shahrisabz
text:
Shakhrisabz ( Uzbek kasa mu asɛmfua   Shahrisabz ; Tajik kasa   ; Persian     : "kurow a ɛyɛ ahabammono" / "kurow a ɛyɛ ahabammono"; Russian   ) yɛ kurow a ɛwɔ ɔmantam biara mu wɔ Qashqadaryo Mantam mu wɔ Uzbekistan kesee fam .  Sikasɛm mu Nkɔmmɔbɔ Ahyehyɛde (ECO) apaw Shakhrisabz sɛ ne nsrahwɛfo ahenkurow ama afe 2024.

Ɛwɔ bɛyɛ 80 km wɔ Samarkand anafo fam, wɔ beae a ɛkorɔn 622 m. Nnipa dodow a wɔwɔ hɔ yɛ 140,500 (2021).  Wɔ abakɔsɛm mu no, na wɔfrɛ Shahrisabz sɛ Kesh anaa Kish, na bere bi na ɛyɛ Asia Mfinimfini fam kurow kɛse, na na ɛyɛ Sogdiana, Persia Achaemenid Ahemman no mantam bi a ɛho hia wɔ kurow kɛse mu. Wonim no titiriw nnɛ sɛ afeha a ɛto so 14 Turco-Mongol nkonimdifo Timur awobea .

Abakɔsɛm 
Kan no na wɔfrɛ no Kesh anaa Kish ("akoma-sɔ") na wɔde toto tete Nautaca ho wɔ bere tiaa bi mu, Shahrisabz yɛ Central Asia ’s tete nkurow no mu biako. Wɔde sii hɔ bɛboro mfe 2,700 a atwam ni na ɛyɛɛ Achaemenid Ahemman anaa Persia fa fi afeha a ɛto so 6 kosi 4 A.Y.B. Wɔ saa bere yi nyinaa mu no, Kesh kɔɔ so yɛɛ nkurow akɛse a ɛho hia wɔ Sogdiana, ɔmantam kɛse bi a ɛwɔ Ahemman no mu. Nhoma ahorow a efi Achaemenid bere no awiei no ka kurow no afasu a wosiesiee no ho asɛm.  Wɔafrɛ no Shahrisabz fi Timurid bere so.

Alexander Ɔkɛseɛ ɔsahene Ptolemy faa Bactria satrap na ɔyɛ ne ho sɛ Persia ahengua, Bessus, wɔ Nautaca ma enti ɛmaa Achaemenid Ahemman a bere bi na ɛyɛ kɛse no baa awiei. Alexander Ɔkɛseɛ paw sɛ ɔbɛdi n’awɔw bere mu na ohyiaa ne yere Roxanna wɔ mpɔtam hɔ wɔ afe 328-327 A.Y.B. Wɔ afe 567 ne 658 A.D. ntam hɔ no, Kesh sodifo tuaa tow maa khaganfo a wɔwɔ Turkey ne Atɔe Fam Turkey khaganates mu. Wɔ afe 710 mu no, Arabfo  dii kurow no so nkonim na bere a Mongolfo dii Khwarezmia so nkonim wɔ afeha a ɛto so 13 mu akyi no, ɔmantam no bɛyɛɛ Barlas abusuakuw no tumi ase, na ɛte sɛ nea na wɔn abusuakuw nyinaa ne ɔmantam yi wɔ abusuabɔ.

Tebea a wɔwoo Timur 
Kesh yɛ beae a wɔwoo Timur wɔ 1336 mu, na ɛhɔnom Barlas panyin ketewaa bi abusua na wɔwoo no, na wɔ Timurid ahemman no mfiase mfe no mu no, kurow no nyaa ne mmoa kɛse. Timur buu Kesh sɛ ne “kurom” na ɔyɛɛ nhyehyɛe sɛ awiei koraa no ɛbɛyɛ beae a n’adamoa bɛto. Nanso, wɔ n’ahenni mu no, dwumadibea titiriw dan kɔɔ Samarkand mmom. Wɔ Timur bere so no, wosisii wiase adansi ho adwinni ahorow a ɛyɛ nwonwa: Ak-Saray ahemfie, Dorusiodat nkaedum dan.  Kurow no dii aperepere sɛ wobenya ahofadi wɔ Bukharan nniso ase na Russiafo boaa Bukharan emir ma odii kurow no so nkonim wɔ afe 1870 mu.

Abakɔsɛm mu mmeae 
Nkaedum ahorow pii a ɛyɛ nwonwa a aka a efi Timurid ahemman no mu no ama wɔatumi akyerɛw kurow no fa dedaw no wɔ UNESCO Wiase Agyapade Kyerɛwtohɔ mu . Nanso, mfinimfini mmere mu kurow no mmeae akɛse a wɔsɛee no wɔ afe 2015 mu de yɛɛ abɔnten so atrae ne mmeae a nsrahwɛfo kɔ no ama UNESCO ahaw. Ebetumi aba sɛ nea wɔakyerɛw no betumi ayera.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Mfinimfini Mmere mu Nkaedum a ɛwɔ Kosovo
text:
Mfinimfini Mmere mu Nkaedum a ɛwɔ Kosovo ( Serbian mu     ; Albanian   ) yɛ Wiase Agyapade Beae a Serbia Ortodɔks Kristofo asɔredan ne nkokorafie anan a egyina hɔ ma apuei fam Ortodɔks Byzantine ne atɔe fam Romanesque asɔre adansi a wɔaka abom ma ɛyɛ Palaiologian Renaissance kwan no. Nemanjić ahemman a na ɛyɛ Serbia ahemman a ɛho hia sen biara wɔ Mfinimfini Mmere no mu no mufo na wɔhyehyɛɛ adansi no . Mmeae ahorow no wɔ nnɛyi Kosovo .  [lower-alpha 1]

Wɔ afe 2004 mu no, UNESCO gyee Dečani Nkokorafie no toom sɛ ɛsom bo a ɛda nsow wɔ amansan nyinaa mu. Mfe abien akyi no, wɔtrɛw beae a agyapade wɔ no mu sɛ nea wɔayi no nnidiso nnidiso, ma wɔde nyamesom nkaedum afoforo abiɛsa kaa ho: Patriarchate of Peć Monastery, Our Lady of Ljeviš ne Gračanica Monastery .

UNESCO ho akyinnyegye 
Akyinnyegye kɔ so wɔ mmɔden a Kosovo rebɔ sɛ ɛbɛka UNESCO ho, na ɛno bɛma wɔakyerɛw mmeae no sɛ Kosovo fa na ɛnyɛ Serbia no ho.  Wɔatow ahyɛ nkaedum ahorow yi so, titiriw wɔ mmusuakuw mu basabasayɛ a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ afe 2004 mu, wɔ Kosovo UNMIK nniso bere mu, bere a wɔsɛee Yɛn Awuraa a ofi Ljeviš kɛse no.     Wɔ Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 2015 mu no, UNESCO Adwumayɛkuo no kamfoo Kosovo sɛ wɔnyɛ emufoɔ. Wɔtoo aba sɛ wɔbɛkɔ asɔremma no wɔ UNESCO Amansan Nhyiamu ase wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2015.

UNESCO nnyee Kosovo nnye ntom sɛ ɔman ba, nyansahyɛ no antumi annye dodow nkyem abiɛsa mu abien wɔ ahyehyɛde no Nhyiam Kɛse a wɔyɛe wɔ Paris wɔ November 9, 2015.   Ade titiriw biako nti a wɔpoo Albaniafo adesrɛ yi    ne 2004 basabasayɛ a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Kosovo, bere a wɔsɛee Ortodɔks asɔredan 35, wɔsɛee no anaasɛ wɔsɛee no,   a Yɛn Awuraa a ofi Ljeviš a ɛyɛ a Wiase Agyapade Beae .   Asɔredan no yɛ nea wɔfow bere nyinaa - mpo ne adansi nneɛma, pɔtee no, wɔawia kɔbere a ɛsom bo mpɛn pii afi ɔdan atifi.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Everglades Ɔman Mmoa Yɛmmea
text:
Everglades National Park yɛ Amerika ɔman mmɔnten so atrae a ɛbɔ Everglades a edi kan a ɛwɔ Florida no ɔha biara mu aduonu anafo fam ho ban . Abɔnten so atrae no yɛ sare a ɛso sen biara wɔ United States a ɛhɔ yɛ hyew na ɛyɛ sare a ɛso sen biara wɔ Mississippi Asubɔnten no apuei fam . Sɛ wɔkyekyem pɛpɛɛpɛ a, nnipa ɔpepem biako na wɔba abɔnten so atrae hɔ afe biara.  Everglades yɛ ɔman mmɔnten so atrae a ɛto so abiɛsa a ɛso sen biara wɔ United States a ɛtoatoa so no mu wɔ Death Valley ne Yellowstone akyi . UNESCO de Everglades & Dry Tortugas Biosphere Reserve too gua wɔ 1976 mu na wɔkyerɛw abɔnten so atrae no din sɛ Wiase Agyapade wɔ 1979 mu, na Ramsar Apam no de abɔnten so atrae no kaa ne Nsuten a Ɛho Hia Amanaman Ntam ho wɔ 1987 mu. Everglades yɛ mmeae abiɛsa pɛ a ɛwɔ wiase a ɛwɔ din abiɛsa no nyinaa mu no mu biako.

Asase ho adesua 
South Florida asase yɛ petee kakra na ɛyɛ petee bere nyinaa. Limestone a ɛwɔ Everglades ase no yɛ ade titiriw wɔ abɔde a nkwa wom a egu ahorow a ɛwɔ abɔnten so atrae no mu no mu. Bere bi na Florida yɛ asasepɔn kɛse Gondwana no fa a ɛwɔ Afrika no fa . Bere a ɛtetew mu akyi no, tebea horow maa po mu nneɛma a emu nnɔ no tumi de calcium carbonate guu anhwea, akorade, ne akorade mu ma ɛdanee limestone.  Akorade, anhwea, ne brozoan nketenkete a wɔahyɛ no den wɔ ntoatoaso pii so ma ɛyɛɛ nneɛma wɔ limestone a wɔfrɛ no ooids, a ɛmaa tebea horow a ɛma nsu tumi fa mu bae.

Berɛ tenten mu wien bɔberɛ 
Sɛnea Köppen wim tebea nkyekyɛmu nhyehyɛe kyerɛ no, Royal Palm a ɛwɔ Everglades National Park no wɔ wim tebea a osu tɔ na owia bɔ kɛse ( Am ). Awɔw bere tenten, ɛyɛ hyew, na ɛyɛ nsu paa na awɔw bere mu yɛ hyew na ɛyɛ kusuu.

Nsu ho nhwehwɛmu 
Bere a wɔtaa yɛ wɔ Florida atifi fam fa no, nsuten biara nni asase ase a ɛde nsu kɔ Everglades nhyehyɛe no mu. Asase ase atare bi a wɔfrɛ no Florida aquifer da bɛyɛ 1,000 feet (300 m) wɔ South Florida asase ase .  Everglades wɔ tumi kɛse a wɔde sie nsu, esiane limestone a ɛtumi fa mu wɔ asase a ɛda adi no ase nti. Nsu no mu dodow no ara ba wɔ osutɔ mu, na wɔkora dodow a ɛho hia so wɔ limestone no mu. Nsu a efi Everglades mu no dan osu wɔ nkurow akɛse mu, na ɛma wonya nsu pa ma ɔmantam no. Nsu nso sen kɔ abɔnten so bere a ɛtɔ sɛ osu kɔ atifi fam kɔ Kissimmee Asubɔnten no nsuten ne Ɔtare Okeechobee fibea afoforo so akyi, na epue wɔ Everglades nna bi akyi. Nsu bunbun Ɔtare Okeechobee so kɔ asubɔnten bi a 40 to 70 miles (64 to 113 km) trɛw, a ɛkame ayɛ sɛ ɛkɔ baabiara a wontumi nhu.

Abɔde a nkwa wom nhyehyɛe 
Wɔ afeha a ɛto so 20 mfiase no, na adwene a wɔtaa nya wɔ nea ɛsɛ sɛ wɔbɔ ho ban wɔ ɔman mmɔnten so atrae ahorow mu no ka asase ho nneɛma a ɛyɛ hu te sɛ mmepɔw, geysers, anaa nkoko ho bere nyinaa. Bere a Florida nnipa fii ase nyaa nkɔanim kɛse na nkurow akɛse a ɛbɛn Everglades no nyaa nkɔso no, na ɛyɛ den ma wɔn a wɔkamfo abɔnten so atrae no sii hɔ no sɛ wɔbɛma aban a ɛwɔ ɔman no mu ne Floridafo agye atom sɛ abɔde a nkwa wom a ɛyɛ anifere na ɛsakra bere nyinaa wɔ Everglades no fata ahobammɔ saa ara.  Bere a wɔde abɔnten so atrae no sii hɔ wɔ 1947 mu no, ɛbɛyɛɛ beae a edi kan wɔ U.S. mu a wɔbɔɔ afifide ne mmoa a wofi ɔmantam bi mu ho ban a ɛne asase ho mfonini bɔ abira.  Ɔman Mmoa Yɛmmea Dwumadibea no gye abɔde a nkwa wom a ɛsono emu biara a ɛsono emu biara a ɛwɔ abɔnten so atrae no mu a ɛsakra ne kɛse bere nyinaa esiane nsu dodow a ɛwɔ hɔ ne nneɛma afoforo a atwa yɛn ho ahyia nti.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Potosí
text:
Potosí, a na wɔfrɛ no Villa Imperial de Potosí wɔ atubrafo bere so no yɛ ahenkurow ne Potosí Dwumadibea a ɛwɔ Bolivia no kuropɔn. Ɛyɛ nkurow a ɛkorɔn sen biara wɔ wiase no mu biako a ɛyɛ 4,090 m (13,420) na ɛwɔ hɔ ft) .  Mfehaha pii no, na ɛhɔ na na Spain atubrafo dwetɛ mfidie no wɔ . Wɔakora kuropɔn no atubrafoɔ adansiɛ no fa kɛseɛ so wɔ kuropɔn no abakɔsɛm mu mfimfini, a - ne Cerro Rico de Potosí a ɛho hia wɔ wiase nyinaa - yɛ UNESCO Wiase Agyapadeɛ a wɔakyerɛ sɛ ɛyɛ no fa.

Potosí da Cerro de Potosí  ase —ɛtɔ mmere bi a wɔfrɛ no Cerro Rico ("bepɔw a ɛyɛ fɛ") — bepɔw a nnipa pii susuw sɛ ɛyɛ dwetɛ a "wɔde" a ɛhyɛ kurow no so. Cerro Rico ne nea enti a Potosí ho hia wɔ abakɔsɛm mu efisɛ na ɛno ne dwetɛ titiriw a wɔde ma Spain Ahemman no kosii sɛ Guanajuato a ɛwɔ Mexico no boroo no so wɔ afeha a ɛto so 18 mu.

Asase ho adesua 
Cerro Rico de Potosí a ɛwɔ Bolivia Tin Belt no ne dwetɛ a ɛdɔɔso sen biara wɔ wiase, na wɔatu fi afeha a ɛto so dunsia no mu, na ebedu 1996 no, na ɛyɛ tɔn 60,000. Akontaabu kyerɛ sɛ dwetɛ pii da so ara wɔ mmeae a wotu dwetɛ no. Potosí bɛyɛɛ kurow a ɛto so abien a ɛso sen biara, ne beae a wɔyɛɛ mint a edi kan no, wɔ Amerika. Eduu 1891 no, dwetɛ bo a ɛba fam no maa nsakrae baa tin a wotu mu, na ɛkɔɔ so kosii 1985 mu. Bere a wɔyɛɛ no kɛse wɔ afeha a ɛto so dunsia ne dunwɔtwe mu no, na dwetɛ a ɛkɔ soro kodu 40% wɔ aboɔden abo no mu.  : 1 . 374 na ɛwɔ hɔ

Abakɔsɛm

Berɛ tenten mu wien bɔberɛ 
Potosí wɔ wim tebea a ɛntaa nsi ma kurow a ne kɛse te, esiane ne sorokɔ kɛse a ɛboro mita 4000 nti. Semi-drid na sɛ wɔkyekyem pɛpɛɛpɛ a, ɔhyew a ɛwɔ ne bosome a ɛyɛ hyew sen biara mu te 10 no so pɛɛ °C threshold, kurow no wim tebea trɛw nea ɛwɔ mmepɔw so wim tebea a ɛwɔ mmeae a osu tɔ na owia bɔ kɛse ( Cwc, sɛnea Köppen wim tebea nkyekyɛmu kyerɛ no ), a ɛwɔ po ase su ne alpine wim tebea (E). Awɔw bere mu yɛ nwini na ɛyɛ nsu na da biara da dodow a ɛkɔ soro no ntaa nkɔ soro nsen 20 °C, bere a awɔw bere mu no, nna a ɛyɛ nwini na anadwo a awɔw wom kɛse no yɛ −4 °C. Saa ɔhyew a ɛba fam yi fi osu a ɛtɔ kɛse wɔ awɔw bere mu asram no mu a ɔhyew a efi mu ba no ma ɔhyew mu nsakrae a ɛkɔ soro ba awiabere mu.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Río Plátano Nkwammoaa a Wɔkora So
text:
Río Plátano Abɔde a Nkwa Wom Akorae no yɛ 5,250 km 2 asase a wɔakora so wɔ La Mosquitia mantam a ɛwɔ Caribbean mpoano wɔ Honduras . Asase no fa kɛse no ara fa Río Plátano ho . Nnomaa a wɔakora so no wɔ mmoa ahorow pii a wɔn ase reyɛ atɔre ne Honduras kwae no afa akɛse no bi. Ɛyɛ Wiase Agyapade ne abɔde a nkwa wom akorae fi 1982. Wɔ afe 2011 mu no, UNESCO de beae a wɔakora so no too Wiase Agyapade a Ɛwɔ Asiane mu no din mu.

Reserve no ka mmepɔw ne asasetaw so kwae a osu tɔ na owia bɔ kɛse wom, a wuram mmoa ne afifide ahorow ahyɛ mu ma, na nnipa bɛboro 2000 na wɔte hɔ. Akorae no yɛ Mesoamerican Biological Corridor a efi Mexico kɔ anafo fam fa Amerika Mfinimfini fam no fa.

Abakɔsɛm 
Wɔ 1960 mu no, wɔde asase no too nkyɛn sɛ "Ciudad Blanca Fam Atutuw Beae," a wɔde tete atrae a wɔka ho asɛm a wɔfrɛ no la Ciudad Blanca . Wɔsesaa akoraeɛ no din "Río Plátano Biosphere Reserve" wɔ afe 1980 mu na wɔde kaa Wiase Agyapadeɛ ho wɔ afe 1982.

Wɔyɛɛ nhyehyɛe ne nkɔsoɔ ho nhyehyɛeɛ wɔ afe 1980 mu na wɔde dii dwuma wɔ afe 1987 mu a Dwumadibea a ɛhwɛ Abɔdeɛ mu Nneɛma a Wɔyɛ no Foforo so. Wɔ 1997 mu no, 3250 foforo Wɔkyerɛɛ km 2 sɛ beae a wɔbɛbɔ ho ban ama reserve no. Wɔ 1997 mu no, Germany Nkɔso Sikakorabea no fii nhyehyɛe bi a ɛbɛma wɔatrɛw beae a wɔakora so no mu kɛse akɔ Patuca Asubɔnten ne Bosawas Biosphere Reserve a ɛwɔ Nicaragua no ase. Mprempren, wɔatwe Germanfo nhyehyɛe no akyɛ.

Mmeae a wotutu fam hwehwɛ tetefo nneɛma mu 
Akorae no da so ara wɔ mmeae bɛboro 200 a wotutu fam hwehwɛ tetefo nneɛma mu,  a beae a Christopher Columbus dii kan duu Amerika asasepɔn so no ka ho.  Akorae no nso wɔ nkurow a asɛe, a abo a efi adan ne akwan so, abotan a wɔasen, ne nkae afoforo ka ho.

Nnipa a wɔte mpɔtam hɔ 
Akorae no yɛ beae a ɛhɔfo bɛboro 2,000 ne atubrafo dodow a ɛrenya nkɔanim te.  Nnipa a wɔte hɔ no bi ne amammerɛ akuw anan a ɛsono emu biara koraa na ɛyɛ soronko: iskito, Pech, Garifunas, ne ladino . Akuw nketewa no, Pech, Garifunafo, ne Miskitofo a wɔte hɔ no mu dodow no ara te atifi fam, wɔ asubɔnten no ho. Saa nnipa yi wɔ hokwan ahorow wɔ asase no ho na wɔn mu dodow no ara de asase no yɛ kua.  Ɛnyɛ den sɛ wɔbɛma Pechfo kuayɛ nketewa no ayɛ nea ɛbɛkɔ so atra hɔ daa. Kuw a ɛsõ sen biara, ladino, no mu pii fi anafo fam hyɛn beae a wɔakora wɔn so no.  Asase hokwan ho ntawntawdi yɛ ade titiriw a ɛde ntawntawdi ba mmusuakuw ntam. Mprempren ntawntawdi a ɛfa asase hokwan ahorow ho no fa nnipa a wɔnyɛ kurom hɔfo a wɔtow hyɛ asase wuranom a wɔyɛ aborɔfo so na wohunahuna wɔn ho —a wɔhyɛ wɔn ma wofi wɔn abakɔsɛm mu nsase so.

Fa to hɔ 
Wɔ 1996 mu no, wɔde Wiase Nyinaa Agyapade a Ɛwɔ Asiane mu din too beae a wɔakora so no din. Reserve management nhyehyeɛ bi a wɔde dii dwuma wɔ afe 2000 mu no bi ne macrozoning, subzoning, ne nhyehyɛeɛ pɔtee a wɔbɛyɛ ama nsɛm a ɛfa nneɛma a wɔkora soɔ ho.  Macrozoning nhyehyɛe no de buffer zones, amammerɛ zones, ne nucleus zones sii hɔ. Na ahunahuna no nyinaa, titiriw wɔ nuklea mmeae no, so atew wɔ afe 2006 mu a ɛkyerɛ sɛ nkɔso kɛse aba wɔ mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛkora nneɛma so no mu, na ɛde Wiase Agyapade a ɛwɔ Asiane mu din no fii hɔ wɔ afe 2007  Nanso, sɛ yɛhwɛ nhwehwɛmu a wɔayɛ nnansa yi wɔ afe 2010 ne 2011 mu a, ɛte sɛ nea mfaso biara a wogye toom mfiase no, ɛnyɛ saa na ɛte mprempren. Nnansa yi ara (2011) UNESCO yɛɛ asɛmpatrɛw adwuma kɔɔ Rio Plátano na wohuu dwumadi a mmara mma ho kwan wɔ beae titiriw no mu. Nnubɔne a wɔde fa sum ase, asase a wotutu ma anantwi didi, ne mpataayi ne abɔmmɔ a mmara mma ho kwan wɔ asubɔnten no ho no rekɔ so mprempren. Wɔ afe 2011 mu no, UNESCO de beae a wɔakora so no too Wiase Agyapade a Ɛwɔ Asiane mu no din mu.

Berɛ tenten mu wien bɔberɛ 
Nsu a ɛtɔ afe biara no yɛ 2,850 and 4,000 mm (112 ne 157) na ɛwɔ hɔ in), na ɛhɔfo ahu su bi a ɛfa ɔpɛ bere ho.  Wim tebea a ɛwɔ ɔmantam no mu no yɛ ade titiriw a ɛbɛma wɔakora kwae a ɛsom bo a ɛyɛ nsu so na ɛho hia ma kuayɛ a ɛhɔfo de wɔn ho to so no.

Asase ho nsɛm 
Asase no fi La Moskitia mpoano fa atare mu na ɛfa Río Plátano ho kɔ mmepɔw no so. Beae a wɔde siw ano no nso ka Paulaya ne Sico bon no ho, na awiei koraa no ɛbɛtrɛw akodu Patuca Asubɔnten no ho . Bepɔw a wɔakora so no mu dodow no ara yɛ mmepɔw, a Pico Dama, granite a ɛyɛ kɛse, ne Punta Piedra, bepɔw a ɛkorɔn sen biara a ɛwɔ 1,326 m (4,350) na ɛwɔ hɔ ft) .

Ɛkame ayɛ sɛ Río Plátano nsu a ɛwɔ hɔ nyinaa, ne nsu akwan nketewa afoforo pii ka beae a wɔakora so no ho. Mmepɔw so asase a ɛwɔ ɔmantam no fa kɛse no ara. Nsubɔnten no bɔ mframa fa mmeae a ɛwɔ fam ne mmeae a mmepɔw wɔ no nyinaa. The yɛ oxbows pii bere a ɛtwam asasetaw a ɛyɛ tratraa a ɛtetew nkoko ase ne atare no ntam no. Asubɔnten no ama oxbow atare, atɛkyɛ, ne abɔde mu nsuten.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Abannennen a ɛwɔ Panama Caribbean Afa: Portobelo-San Lorenzo
text:
Abannennen a ɛwɔ Panama Caribbean Afa: Portobelo - San Lorenzo yɛ asraafo adan, a Spain Ahemman no sii wɔ afeha a ɛto so 17 ne 18 mu wɔ Caribbean mpoano wɔ Colon Mantam mu wɔ Panama. Amamfo no wɔ Colon mantam no mpoano. Esiane sɛ ɛho hia wɔ amammerɛ mu nti, UNESCO akyerɛw mmeae no wɔ 1980 mu sɛ Wiase Agapade Beae wɔ Ahwehwɛde (i) ne (iv) ase, a nkyerɛkyerɛmu no ka ho sɛ, “Afeha a ɛto so 17 ne 18 asraafo adansi ho nhwɛso a ɛyɛ nwonwa, Panamafo yi.” abankɛse a ɛwɔ Caribbean mpoano no yɛ ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe a Spain Ahemman no sii de bɔɔ Atlantic po so aguadi ho ban no fa."

Beaeɛ 
Portobelo ne San Lorenzo abannennen no wɔ bɛyɛ 80 kilometres (50 mi) fi wɔn ho wɔn ho ntam wɔ Panama Atlantic mpoano. Portobelo asraafo adan no maa ahobammɔ kataa Panama hyɛn gyinabea no fa a ɛwɔ Caribbean no so bere a abannennen a ɛwɔ San Lorenzo no bɔɔ Asubɔnten Chagres a ɛwɔ n’ano no ho ban no.  Wɔkyekyee hyɛn gyinabea no sɛ Caribbean hyɛn gyinabea foforo a wɔde besi nea ɛwɔ Nombre de Dios no ananmu a wɔde bɛfa Panama Isthmus so . Na atirimpɔw titiriw ne sɛ wɔbɛkwati asase so kwan a ɛka no wɔ osutɔ asram no mu no. Ná Chagres Asubɔnten-Cruces kwan a wɔfa so kɔ hɔ no yɛ nsu kwan ne asase so kwan a wɔaka abom a wɔkyekyee sɛ ɔkwan foforo a wɔfa so kɔ Portobelo a ɛfa Camino Real ne Panama City .  . Abannennen a ɛwɔ Panama Caribbean Afa: Portobello – San Lorenzo na Spain Ahemman no huu.

Akyi asɛm 
Wɔ afe 1502 mu no, ahum a ano yɛ den bi kyeree Christopher Columbus wɔ po mu, na wɔhyɛɛ no ma osii fam wɔ akuraa bi a ɛwɔ Panama Supɔw so ase. Sɛnea anansesɛm kyerɛ no, ɔtoo din Puerto Bello (Poro Hyɛn Gyinabea Fɛfɛ). [3] [4] Wɔ afe 1586 mu no, Bautista Antonelli siesiee nhyehyɛe maa abannennen no mu nea edi kan a ɛbɛma wɔatumi akɔ Portobelo Po ne Chagres Asubɔnten no ano, na osii saa ara wɔ 1590 mfe no mu. Nanso, wɔde San Felipe de Portobelo kurow no sii hɔ wɔ March 20, 1597.  Wɔ mfehaha pii mu no, Portobelo nyaa nkɔso bɛyɛɛ Spainfo adwumayɛbea a ɛyɛ anifere wɔ Wiase Foforo no mu efisɛ na ɛne ɔkwan bi a wɔde abo ayɛ a ɛkɔ Panama kurow no mu wɔ abusuabɔ yiye no. [5] Nea na ɛho hia sɛ hyɛn gyinabea no yɛ beae titiriw a wɔde nneɛma kɔ amannɔne ma Spainfo Nkonimdifo no ne sɛ wɔbɛboaboa sika kɔkɔɔ ne dwetɛ a wɔafow afi Incafo atuo mu no ano bere tiaa bi. Wɔde ademude a wɔafow no wɔ mfurum akwantufo mu fii Pacific fa a ɛwɔ Panama Isthmus no kɔɔ Portobelo wɔ Caribbean fa, ansa na awiei koraa no wɔde rekɔma Spain hene. [3]

Abakɔsɛm 
Bere a akuraa no ho hia kɛse no, wodii ahobammɔ ho haw ahorow ho dwuma denam asraafo abannennen a wosisii fi 1600 kosii abannennen a etwa to a wɔyɛe wɔ Santiago ne Fernando wɔ po no ano wɔ 1753 mu no so. Sɛ wɔka ne nyinaa bom a, wosii abannennen ahorow 10 wɔ nkoko a ɛwɔ Portobelo hyɛn gyinabea akyi no so, na ɛmaa ɛbɛyɛɛ "Spain mpoano sohwɛbea a wɔabɔ ho ban kɛse sen biara wɔ Amerika". [5] [6] Wɔtow hyɛɛ abannennen no pii so na wobubui ma ɛbɛyɛɛ amamfõ akuwakuw; abannennen a wosii wɔ 1753 mu nkutoo na ɛda so ara wɔ tebea pa mu, bere a Admiral Vernon twaa Portobello ho hyiae wɔ ɔko a etwa to no mu no. [6] Ansa na ɛno reba no, Sir Francis Drake antumi antow ahyɛ abankɛse no so bere a atiridii kum no na wosiee no wɔ po no ano no. Nanso na wahyew Nombre De Dios wɔ 1596 mu. Ne din da n’adaka a kɔbere wom a wɔasie wɔ po mu no so. Wɔ 1597 mu, wɔ Drake asɛm no akyi no, Spain Ahemman no sii gyinae sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ hyɛn gyinabea no den bere a wɔde sikakorabea no kɔɔ Portobelo no. Wɔdii kan sii Fort San Felipe wɔ hyɛn gyinabea no abrannaa so na wɔde ahyɛnsodeɛ 35 na ɛbɔɔ ho ban. Wosii Fort San Jeronimo wɔ apuei fam, na wosii Fort Santiago de la Gloria, wɔ po no ano atɔe fam. Wɔde akorade abo afasu a ɛyɛ den te sɛ granite na esii abankɛse yi. [4] Wɔ afe 1668 mu no, Welsh Buccaneer Sir Henry Morgan tow hyɛɛ Portobelo so, na ɔde antweri a ɛtrɛw a ɛbɛma mmarima 3 akɔ wɔn anim akɔforo abannennen no afasu. Ɔsram biako na adwowtwafo no faa kurow no, nanso wɔammɔ amanneɛ sɛ wɔsɛee adan a wɔde bɔ wɔn ho ban no kɛse. Wɔ 1688 mu no, Engiresini Po so Adwowtwafo Bartholomew Sharp ne Franseni po so hyɛn mu dwumayɛni La Sound tow hyɛɛ abannennen no so na wɔsɛee nneɛma ahorow. Ntuo a ɛbaa wɔ 1744 mu no maa abankɛseɛ no antumi annye nanso amanneɛbɔ dan no sɛee kɛseɛ. [5]

Dan nhyehyɛeɛ 
Portobelo Po no wɔ abannennen pii, a ɛyɛ Europafoɔ adwini a ɛfa asraafoɔ adansiɛ ho, a wɔsii wɔ atubrafoɔ berɛ mu (1596–99). Ná adan a wosisii wɔ mfe a edi kan no mu no yɛ mfinimfini mmere mu kwan so (Antonelli Spaniafo mfonini ahorow). Nanso, wɔ afeha a ɛtɔ so dunwɔtwe mu no, wɔkyekyeree adan no denam neo-classical features (a Salas ne Hernandez (1753–60)) a wɔsan yɛɛ no foforo so, sɛnea wohu wɔ Santiago Fort, San Jeronimo Fort ne San Fernando Fort, ne San Lorenzo Fort. Amanneɛbɔ-dan a wɔsɛee no wɔ afe 1744 mu no, wɔasan asi na mprempren wɔde di dwuma sɛ tete nneɛma akorae. Atuo a wɔde nsɔe guu mu wɔ ntua ahorow mu sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔremfa nni dwuma daakye no reyɛ nwunu a nnua nteaseɛnam no aporɔw na wɔayi afi hɔ. Nanso, abankɛse no wɔ tebea a wɔakora so yiye mu. [8]

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Chan Chan
text:
Ná Chan Chan yɛ kurow a ɛso sen biara wɔ Amerika Kesee Fam bere a na ɛwɔ hɔ ansa na Columbia reba no .  Mprempren ɛyɛ beae a wotutu fam hwehwɛ tetefo nneɛma mu wɔ La Libertad Mantam mu 5 kilometres (3.1 mi) Trujillo atɔe fam, Peru .

Chan Chan wɔ Moche Bon no ano  na na ɛyɛ Chimorfo abakɔsɛm ahemman no ahenkurow fi 900 kosi 1470,  bere a wodii wɔn so nkonim na wɔde wɔn kaa Inca Ahemman no ho no .  Chimor, nkonimdi man,  nyaa nkɔso fii Chimú amammerɛ a ɛde ne ho sii hɔ wɔ Peru mpoano bɛyɛ afe 900 Y.B.

Etymology ho adesua 
Ebia wonyaa edin no fii Quingnam "Jiang" anaa "Chang" a ɛkyerɛ Owia, a Chan-Chan bɛyɛ nea efi mu ba ankasa: Owia-Owia. Wɔkyerɛ sɛ nea ɛkyerɛ ankasa bɛyɛ: Owia kɛse, Owia a ɛhyerɛn, owia a ɛyɛ fɛ anaa owia a ɛhyerɛn (esiane sɛ Quingnam kasa no su titiriw ne sɛ asɛmfua bi a wɔsan yɛ no abien no nya ntease foforo nti). Nsusuwii foforo ka sɛ anka edin no befi asɛmfua: Shian anaa Sian mu. "Shi" nne no kyerɛ ase sɛ Ɔsram na "An" kyerɛ ase sɛ ofie, a ɛkyerɛ Ɔsram Fie, na ɛma wohu sɛ Ɔsram no ne onyame titiriw.

Abakɔsɛm tiawa 
Wogye di sɛ Chimúfo na wosii Chan Chan bɛyɛ afe 850 Y.B.  Na ɛyɛ Chimor ahemman no ahenkurow a wobu akontaa sɛ nnipa 40,000–60,000 na wɔte mu.

Bere a Incafo dii Chimú so nkonim bɛyɛ afe 1470 A.D. akyi no, Chan Chan hwee ase.  Inkafo de nhyehyɛe bi a wɔfrɛ no "Mitma nhyehyɛe a ɛfa mmusuakuw mu apete" a ɛtetew chimú ɔmanfo no mu kɔɔ mmeae a Incafo adi so nkonim dedaw nnansa yi ara no dii dwuma. Bɛboro mfeɛ aduosia kakra akyi wɔ afe 1535 A.D. mu no, Francisco Pizarro hyehyɛɛ Spain kuropɔn Trujillo a ɛpiaa Chan Chan kɔɔ sunsuma mu kɔɔ akyiri.  Bere a na ɛnyɛ ahenkurow a nnipa ahyɛ mu ma bio no, na wɔda so ara nim Chan Chan yiye sɛ ɛwɔ ahonyade kɛse na nea efii mu bae ne sɛ Spainfo fow no.  Wohu Chimú ahonyade kɛse no ho sɛnkyerɛnne wɔ afeha a ɛto so dunsia mu nneɛma a wɔfow fii amusiei ɔdamoa bi mu wɔ Chan Chan din mu; wohuu ademude a ɛne sika kɔkɔɔ peso 80,000 yɛ pɛ (ɛkame ayɛ sɛ sika kɔkɔɔ dɔla 5,000,000 U.S. dɔla ).

Adansi adan 
Chan Chan wɔ adan ahorow pii a wɔasɛe emu pii. Na adan no mu pii bi ne asɔredan, afie, nsukorabea ne ayi asetena mpo. Na adan no pii yɛ po te sɛ mfonini te sɛ mpataa, nnomaa, asorɔkye ne nea ɛkeka ho. Ɔkwan a Chimúfo faa so de ahunmu no dii dwuma no yɛ nwonwa. Wɔnam mmeae a ɛyɛ den so na esi ɔdan no fa kɛse no ara wɔ ahinanan anaa ahinanan mu.

Na kurow no nso yɛ abankɛse 10 nanso 4 pɛ na wɔasan anya. Eyi kyerɛ sɛ na Chan Chan kurow no wɔ sodifo 10, na Chimúfo no asi wɔn bo kɛse wɔ “Awurade Kɛse a ɔwɔ soro” no so. Amammerɛ no traa ase wɔ classist society a na sodifo ne anyame no wɔ soro afei ɛkɔɔ fam koduu nkoa so. Mpɛn pii no, abankɛse bi tenten yɛ anammɔn 40 na wosi a ɔkwan biako pɛ na wɔfa so kɔ mu. Na ɛyɛ beae a ɛte sɛ ahemfie a wɔde nneɛma fɛfɛ asiesie na wosii maa “onyame anaa sodifo”

title: Coro ne ne Hyɛn Gyinabea
text:
Coro ne ne Hyɛn Gyinabea yɛ UNESCO Wiase Agyapade beae a ɛwɔ Coro kurow mu wɔ Venezuela .  Coro wɔ asase mu, nanso ɛwɔ hyɛn gyinabea, La Vela de Coro, wɔ Caribbean mpoano.

Abakɔsɛm

Wiase Agyapade beae 
Wɔkyerɛw Coro ne ne Hyɛn Gyinabea sɛ Wiase Agyapade wɔ afe 1993 mu, na wodii gyinapɛn (iv) ne (v) akyi. Esiane sɛ wɔasisi dɔte a ɛyɛ soronko wɔ Caribbean nti, Coro nkutoo ne nhwɛso a ɛda so ara wɔ hɔ a ɛkyerɛ sɛnea wɔde mpɔtam hɔ atetesɛm ne Spainfo Mudéjar ne Dutchfo adansi ho akwan afrafra kɛse. Nkurow a edi kan a wɔtraa ase wɔ atubrafo so no mu biako (wɔde sii hɔ wɔ 1527 mu), na ɛwɔ abakɔsɛm mu adan bɛyɛ 602.

Wiase Agyapade a Ɛwɔ Asiane Mu 
Wɔ afe 2005 mu no, wɔkyerɛw beae no too Wiase Agyapade a Ɛwɔ Asiane mu din mu .  Ade biako a ɛma wobuu beae no sɛ asiane wom ne nneɛma a osu kɛse a ɛtɔe no sɛee. Wɔsan nso huu hia a ehia sɛ wɔbɔ beae no ho ban fi nkɔso a enni tema ho, na wɔ eyi mu no wɔhyɛɛ nyansa sɛ wɔbɛsan akyerɛkyerɛ mmeae a wɔde siw ano no mu.

Wɔ afe 2018 mu no UNESCO nsa kaa amanneɛbɔ bi firii Amanaman Ntam Bagua a ɛhwɛ Nkaedum ne Mmeaeɛ so (ICOMOS), a ɛhyɛɛ no nsow sɛ berɛ a nsɛm a "Ɔman a ɛwɔ Ɔman no mu" (kyerɛ sɛ Venezuela) daa nkɔso a ɛma abotɔyam adi wɔ nteɛso akwan pii a wɔde bedi dwuma no mu, na ɛho hia sɛ wɔyɛ nsɛm foforo ne nneyɛe de hwɛ hu sɛ wɔadi nsɛm atitiriw a wɔadi kan ahu sɛ ɛka agyapade no ho dwuma yiye.

Nneɛma a wonya fi mu

title: Mohammed Seidu Abah
text:
Mohammed Seidu Abah yɛ Ghana amanyɔni na na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbadwani ma Chereponi mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi fam mantam mu . Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbadwani wɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Abah yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua no muni . Wɔpaw no sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani maa Chereponi mantam a ɛwɔ Atifi fam mantam mu wɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa wɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu. Doris A. Seidu na odii n'ade wɔ afe 2004 Ghana Amansan abatow mu .

Wɔpaw Abah sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani maa Chereponi mantam no wɔ afe 2000 Ghana amansan abatow no mu . Wɔpaw no wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so. Na ne mansin no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 18 no fa wɔ nkongua 23 a National Democratic Congress dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Atifi Fam Mantam no mu.    National Democratic Congress dii nkonim kakraa bi a ne nyinaa yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 92 wɔ nkongua 200 a ɛwɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa a ɛwɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu.  Wɔde abatow 6,270 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 14,908 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 44.6% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Bawah Mamshie Ali a ofi Ɔmanfo Ɔman Nhyiam no mu, Jabanyit K. Lanzari a ofi Nhyiam Nnipa Kuw no mu ne Abubakar S. Malba a ofi New Patriotitc Kuw no mu. Eyinom nyaa abatow 3,879, 2,504, 965, ne 453 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtowee nyinaa mu 27.6%, 17.8%, 6.9% ne 3.2% yɛ pɛ.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Alfred Wallace Gbordzor Abayateye
text:
Alfred Wallace Gbordzor Abayateye (wɔwoo no Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 20, 1965) yɛ sikakorabea dwumayɛni ne amanyɔni. Na ɔyɛ kan mmrahyɛbadwani ma Sege mantam a ɛwɔ Greater Accra mantam mu wɔ Ghana .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Abayateye wɔ afe 1965 mu. Ɔfiri Anyamam-Ada a ɛwɔ Greater Accra mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔsuaa Akontaabuo wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu, ɛhɔ na ɔnyaa Diploma wɔ afe 1987.

Ankorankoro asetra ne adwuma 
Abayateye yɛ Kristoni na waware na ɔwɔ mma baanum. Ɔne Presbyterian Asɔre a ɛwɔ Ghana no som . Ɔyɛ Accountant wɔ n'adwuma mu na mprempren ɔyɛ Deputy Manager of Bank of Ghana .

Amanyɔsɛm 
Abayateye hyɛɛ n'amammui adwuma ase wɔ afe 2004 mu bere a ɔbɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbadwani wɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 4 a ɛwɔ Ghana republic a ɛto so 4 no mu maa Sege mantam no wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so .  Ɔsan dii nkonim wɔ Sege atenaeɛ no mu wɔ afe 2008 mu na ɔbɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 5 wɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu, a ɛno nso wɔ NDC tekiti so.  Ɔdii nkonim wɔ atenaeɛ no mu a ne nyinaa yɛ 12,451 wɔ abatoɔ 19,182 a ɛfata a wɔtoo no mu a ɛyɛɛ 64.9%.  Ɔhweree n'akongua wɔ NDC 2012 mmrahyɛbagua primaries mu maa Christian Corlety Otuteye .

title: Oppey Abbey
text:
Oppey Abbey (Ɔpɛpɔn 5, 1945 – Ɔpɛpɔn 22, 2019) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni na ɔyɛ Fourth Parliament a ɛwɔ Fourth Republic no muni a ɔgyina Awutu-Senya Constituency ananmu wɔ Central Region of Ghana.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Abbey wɔ Awutu Senya West wɔ Central Region wɔ Ghana wɔ November 5, 1945. Ɔnyaa Diploma wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so bere a osuaa mfiridwuma akyi .

Adwuma 
Abbey, a ɔyɛ mfiridwuma ho nimdefoɔ no yɛ kan MP ma Awutu-Senya, na ɔno na ɔdii kan dii nkonim wɔ New Patriotic Party (NPP) tekiti so wɔ afe 2004 mu na ɔkɔɔ mmrahyɛbagua no mu wɔ Ɔbɛnem 7, 2005.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔdii kan paw Abbey sɛ ɔmmra mmrahyɛbagua no mu wɔ December 2005 Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ mu Ghanani wɔ Ticket of the New Patriotic Party sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma Awutu-Senya Mantam no mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 32,539 wɔ abatoɔ 64,740 a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ no mu a ɛgyina hɔ ma 50.30%.  David Nana Larbie a ɔwɔ National Democratic Congress no dii no so nkonim wɔ afe 2008.

Ɔsomm wɔ mmrahyɛbagua no Amannɔne Nsɛm ne Adwumayɛ Boayikuw ahorow mu.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ná Abbey yɛ Kristoni .  Ɔwuiɛ wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn da a ɛtɔ so aduonu mmienu, afe 2019.

title: Masoud Baba Abdul-Rahman
text:
Masoud Baba Abdul-Rahman yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɛfo a ɔyɛɛ mmarahyɛ baguani maa Pru mantam .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Abdul-Rahman wɔ 4 Ɔbɛnem 1952.  Ɔfiri Yeji a ɛwɔ Brong Ahafo mantam mu wɔ Ghana .  Ɔnyaa ne Bachelor of Science wɔ Botany ne Diploma wɔ Nhomasua mu wɔ Cape Coast Suapɔn mu wɔ afe 1979.

Adwuma 
Ɔyɛ nhomasua ho ɔbenfo .  Na ɔyɛ Ɔkwankyerɛfo Abadiakyiri wɔ Ruyan Consult and Future Leaders Academy.

Amanyɔsɛm

2004 abatow mu 
Wɔdii kan paw Abdul-Rahman sɛ mmarahyɛ baguani ma Pru mantam no wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu . Ɔnam saayɛ so gyinaa amansin no ananmu nea edi kan wɔ Ghana republic a ɛto so 4 no mmarahyɛ bagua a ɛto so 4 no mu. Wɔde abatow 22,080 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow 34,969 a ɛfata a wɔtow no mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 63.10% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Amoah Ɔhene David a ofi Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no mu, Francis Dorkose Dawuda a ofi Ɔmanfo Ɔman Nhyiam no mu ne Kingsley K. A. Abonkrah a ɔyɛ ɔkannifo a ɔde ne ho. Eyinom nyaa abatow 12,029, 555 ne 305. Eyinom ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 34.40%, 1.6% ne 0.9% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw Abdul-Rahman wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so . Na ne mansin no yɛ mmarahyɛ bagua nkongua 10 no fa wɔ mmarahyɛ bagua nkongua 24 a National Democratic Party for the Brong Ahafo Mantam no nyinaa dii no mu. National Democratic Congress dii nkonim kakraa bi a ɛyɛ mmarahyɛ bagua nkongua 94 wɔ nkongua 230 mu wɔ saa abatoɔ no mu maa mmarahyɛ bagua mufoɔ maa mmarahyɛ bagua a ɛtɔ so nnan wɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu.

Wɔsan paw Abdul-Rahman wɔ National Democratic Congress (NDC) tekiti so na onyaa abatow dodow no ara 4,096  de bɛyɛɛ MP . Wɔpaw no sɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni ma Pru amansin no wɔ mmarahyɛ bagua a ɛto so 5 a ɛwɔ Ghana man a ɛto so 4 no mu.   Wɔde abatow 13,090 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow 31,063 a ɛfata a wɔtow no mu, a ɛne abatow a ɛfata nyinaa mu 42.1% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Alhaji Gariba Iddrisu a ofi Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo, Bijabi Joses a ofi Democratic Freedom Party, Ponada Donkor George Evans a ofi Democratic People’s Party, Ebenezer Agben a ofi Convention People’s Party ne Amoah King David a ɔyɛ ɔkannifo a ɔde ne ho. Eyinom nyaa abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 28.95%, 0.82%, 1.03%, 0.45% ne 26.61%. Wɔpaw no wɔ afe 2008 Ghana amansan abatow mu .

Abdul-Rahman aware a ɔwɔ mma baanum. Ɔyɛ Nkramofo.

Hwɛ nso

title: Umar Abdul-Razak
text:
Umar Abdul Razak (wɔwoo no 1 Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 1975) yɛ Ghana kuayɛfoɔ na na ɔyɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ wɔ Tolon Senior High school .  Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbadwani nso ma Tolon mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Mantam mu .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Abdul-Razak wɔ October 1, 1975 mu. Ɔfiri Lungbunga a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi fam mantam mu. Onyaa Bachelor of Science Degree wɔ Renewable mu fii Sukuupɔn no mu maa nkɔso ho adesua .

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ɔyɛ Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua no muni . Na ɔyɛ Fourth Republic of Ghana mmrahyɛbagua a Ɛto so Anum no muni sɛ National Democratic Congress ananmusifo.  N’amammui adwuma no hyɛɛ aseɛ berɛ a ɔsii akan wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu na ɔnyaa abatoɔ a ne nyinaa yɛ 19, 123 na ɛnam so kuraa atenaeɛ no mu maa National Democratic Congress.  Ɔsan sii akan wɔ n’ahengua no ho wɔ afe 2008 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu na ɔdii nkonim a ne nyinaa yɛ 17,356 a na ne nyinaa yɛ ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 50.02.  Ɔdii nkogu wɔ afe 2012 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu wɔ New Patriotic Party no muni bi a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ Wahab Suhiyinu Wumbei anim.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Razak yɛ Islam Nyamesom (Muslim ) muni na waware na ɔwɔ mma mmienu.

title: Raymond Tawiah Abraham
text:
Raymond Tawiah Abraham (wɔwoo no 10 Ɔbɛnem 1955) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni akontaabufoɔ a na ɔyɛ Ghana Republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnum ne anan no muni, na ɔgyina Yilo Krobo amansin ananmu wɔ Apueeɛ Mantam .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Abraham wɔ 10 Ɔbɛnem 1955 wɔ Yilo Krobo wɔ Ghana Apuei Fam. Ɔfiri Somanya wɔ Apueeɛ Mantam mu.  Ɔkɔɔ Ghana Suapɔn na onyaa Diploma wɔ Ɔmanfoɔ adwumayɛ mu . Ɔnyaa ne MBA (Post Graduate School of Management, Paris, France) wɔ afe 2006 mu, onyaa ne BSc (Administration) UG wɔ afe 2007 mu na onyaa ne EMGL (GIMPA) wɔ afe 2008.

Adwuma 
Abraham yɛɛ adwuma sɛ El Shaddai Medical Laboratory Limited kwankyerɛfo panyin. Ɔyɛ akontabufoɔ wɔ n’adwuma mu na na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma Yilo Krobo Mansin a ɛwɔ Ghana Apueeɛ Mantam mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔpaw Abraham sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ mmrahyɛbagua no wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so wɔ December 2004 Ghana Amansan abatow mu sɛ mmrahyɛbagua muni wɔ Fourth Republic of Ghana mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so anan mu ma Yilo Krobo Mansin a ɛwɔ Ghana Apuei Fam Mantam mu. Ɔnyaa abatoɔ 20,685 wɔ abatoɔ 36387 a ɛfata a wɔtoo no mu a ɛgyina hɔ ma 56.80%. Ɔsan sii akan wɔ afe 2008 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu na ɔnyaa abatoɔ 18,345 wɔ abatoɔ 34,896 a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ no mu a ɛgyina hɔ ma 52.53% tiaa wɔn a wɔsɔre tia no, Christian Kofi Tettey a ɔfiri New Patriotic Party a ɔno nso nyaa abatoɔ 13,658 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 39.11%, Francis Opai Tetteh a ɔfiri Convention People’s Party a ɔnyaa abatoɔ dodoɔ a ɛyɛ 2,598 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 7.44% ne Terkpetey Fred Kwasi a ɔfiri People’s National Convention a ne abatoɔ dodoɔ yɛ 325 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 0.93%   a ɛmaa ɔkuraa n’akongua sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani t ama mmrahyɛbagua a Ɛto so Anum a ɛwɔ Ghana Aman a Ɛto so Anan no mu ama Yilo Krobo Mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Apuei Fam .

Ankorankoro asetra 
Abraham yɛ Kristoni na ɔyɛ Methodist asɔre a ɛwɔ Ghana no muni. Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baanan.

title: Stephen Michael Essuah Kofi Ackah
text:
Stephen Michael Essuah Kofi Ackah yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nson a ɛwɔ Ghana Republic of the Fourth Republic no muni a ɔgyina Suaman Constituency ananmu wɔ Western Region wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Ackah fi Suaman-Dadieso a ɛwɔ Atɔe Fam mantam mu. Ɔnyaa ne ntoasoɔ sukuu akyi kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ nteteeɛ wɔ Wesley College, Kumasi na ɔkɔɔ Specialist Training College (STC), Winneba baabi a ɔnyaa ne diploma. Ɔnyaa ne Bachelor of Education (BEd) wɔ Physical Education mu wɔ University of Education, Winneba wɔ afe 2000 mu, na ɔnyaa ne Executive Masters wɔ Governance and Leadership (EMGL) Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration (GIMPA) wɔ afe 2000.

Adwuma 
Ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ Ghana Education Service GES) sɛ ɔkwankyerɛfoɔ boafoɔ ne ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ wɔ Ejisuman Senior High School.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ackah kɔɔ mmrahyɛbagua mu wɔ 7 Ɔbɛnem 2005 a ogyinaa Suaman mantam ananmu wɔ National Democratic Party tekiti so . Wakɔ so atena mmrahyɛbagua mu mfe anan a ɛtoatoa so wɔ mmrahyɛbagua mu.

Wɔ mmrahyɛbagua mu no, wasom wɔ boayikuw ahorow mu, a mmrahyɛbagua Boayikuw, Mpɔtam Aban ne Nkuraase Nkɔso Boayikuw, Mmabun, Agumadi ne Amammerɛ Boayikuw, ne Budget Boayikuw Titiriw ka ho.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ackah aware a ɔwɔ mma baasa. Ɔyɛ Kristoni a ɔyɛ fekubɔ wɔ Methodist.

title: Joseph Kofi Adda
text:
Joseph Kofi Kowe Adda (22 April 1956 – 14 October 2021) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni, a ɔyɛɛ mmrahyɛbaguani na ɔsan nso yɛ Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ wimhyɛn so wɔ New Patriotic Party aban mu wɔ Ɔmanpanyin Akufo-Addo ase kɔsii Ɔbɛnem 2021. Ná ɔyɛ Sikasɛm ho Ɔbenfo ne Adwumayɛ ho Ɔfotufo nso.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Joseph Adda wɔ Navrongo, Kassena-Nankana Mantam ahenkuro a ɛwɔ Ghana Apuei Fam Mantam mu.  Ɔnyaa ne ntoaso sukuu wɔ St. John’s School, Sekondi na onyaa Bachelor of Science abodin krataa wɔ amammuisɛm ne sikasɛm mu wɔ Indiana Wesleyan Sukuupɔn, Marion, Indiana, United States, a ɔkɔɔ mu wɔ 1979 ne 1982 ntam hɔ. Wɔ 1982 ne 1984 ntam no, na ɔwɔ Columbia Sukuupɔn, New York, faako a osuaa Master’s degree wɔ Amanaman Ntam Nsɛm mu, a na ne ho akokwaw wɔ Sikasɛm ne Sikakorabea.  Ɔkɔɔ so nyaa adansedi krataa a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wawie sukuu wɔ Afrika Adesua mu wɔ sukuupɔn koro no ara mu. Wɔ 1989 mu no, onyaa adansedi krataa wɔ Franse kasa ne anibuei mu wɔ Sorbonne Sukuupɔn, Paris, France .

Adwuma a ɔyɛe mfiase 
Ná Joseph Adda yɛ Sikasɛm ho Ɔbenfo ne Adwumayɛ ho Ɔfotufo.  Ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ Executive officer wɔ Ministry of Trade and Industry, Ghana wɔ afe 1979 mu. Wɔ 1983 ne 1984 ntam no, ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ Nhwehwɛmu Nhwehwɛmufo a ɔreyɛ adwuma wɔ Wiase Aguadi Asoɛe a Ɛto so Abiɛsa, New York, U.S.A. Wɔ mfe abien a edi hɔ no mu no, na ɔyɛ akontaabu sohwɛfo ne Adwumayɛ ho nteteefo wɔ Equitable Financial Service, Inc., a ɛwɔ New Jersey, U.S.A. Owura Adda nso ayɛ adwuma wɔ Essex Mantam Kɔlege, Newark, New Jersey, U.S.A. (1986 – 1988), Thomson McKinnon Securities Inc., New York (1989 – 1991) ne Deloitte ne Touche Consulting, (Afrika Atɔe Fam), Accra ( 1991 – 1994) na ɔkyerɛwee. Efi afe 1994 no, Joseph Adda ayɛ Omni Consulting International (Ghana) Ltd. no sohwɛfo  Wɔ afe 1996 ne afe 2000 ntam no, ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ nnwuma ahodoɔ mu wɔ Ministry of Finance, Ghana.

Abatow a wɔyɛ 
Adda dii kan bɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbaguani wɔ afe 2003 mu. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ by-election a wɔyɛ maa Navrongo Central constituency a ɛwɔ Upper East Region of Ghana no mu wɔ deɛ ɔdi tumi, John Achuliwor wuo akyi.  Ɔkɔɔ so kuraa n'akongua so wɔ 2004 mmrahyɛbagua abatow no mu . Odii nkonim wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so . Na ne mansin no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 2 no fa wɔ nkongua 13 a New Patriotic Party no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Upper East Region no mu.  New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 128 wɔ nkongua 230 mu.  Wɔde abatow 12,444 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 31,657 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 39.3% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Gabriel Pwamang a ofi Peoples’ National Convention, Andema Emmanuel a ofi National Democratic Congress, Azantinlwo Anemana Jennifer Grace a ofi Convention People’s Party, Bagonia Grace a ofi Democratic People’s Party, Donald Amuah ne Achuliwor A. Otito Werseh a wɔn baanu nyinaa yɛ ahofadifo . Eyinom nyaa abatow 6,512, 6,201, 140, 83, 2,262 ne 4,015 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtowee nyinaa mu 20.6%, 19.6%, 0.4%, 0.3%, 7.1% ne 12.7% yɛ pɛ.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ɔmampanyin John Kufuor paw Adda sɛ Ɔmanpanyin John Kufuor paw Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ Adwumayɛfo Nkɔso ne Adwumayɛ so wɔ afe 2005.  Wɔ 28 April 2006 no, wɔde no kɔɔ aban mpanyimfo nsakrae mu kɔɔ dibea sɛ Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ Ahoɔden so .  Akyiri yi, Ɔmampanyin Kuffuor de Felix Owusu-Adjapong sii n’ananmu sɛ Ahoɔden ho Ɔsoafo. Joe Adda kuraa n’akongua so bere a NPP dii nkogu wɔ amansan abatow mu wɔ afe 2008 mu no. Nanso ɔhweree atenaeɛ no wɔ afe 2012 abatoɔ no mu wɔ Mark Woyongo anim . Wɔ May 2017 mu no, Ɔmampanyin Nana Akufo-Addo bɔɔ Joseph Kofi Adda din sɛ asomfoɔ dunkron a wɔbɛhyehyɛ ne kabinet no fa . Wɔde asomfo 19 no din kɔmaa Ghana mmrahyɛbagua no na Aban no Kasafo, Rt. Hon. Ɔbenfo a ɔbenfo. Mike Ocquaye na ɔkyerɛwee . Sɛ́ Kabinet soafo no, na Joseph Kofi Adda ka ɔmampanyin no mu kuw no ho na ɔboaa gyinaesi dwumadi atitiriw wɔ ɔman no mu.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ná Adda waree na ɔwɔ mma baanu.  Ná ɔyɛ Kristoni. Ná ɔyɛ Katolekni.

Owuo 
Adda wui Dwoda, 14 Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 2021 anɔpatutuutu wɔ Legon Ayaresabea a ɛwɔ Accra.

title: Christopher Addae
text:
Christopher Addae yɛ ɔhwɛfoɔ ne Ghana amanyɔni a ɔsom sɛ Fourth Republic mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so Anum a ɔgyinaa Bibiani-Anhwiaso-Bekwai Mansin a ɛwɔ Ghana Atɔeɛ Mantam ananmu no muni . Bere a ɔdaa ne ho adi sɛ nkonimdifo wɔ abatow no mu wɔ ne mansin mu wɔ afe 2008 Ghana amansan abatow no mu akyi .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Addae wɔ 25 Ɔpɛpɔn 1963. Ɔfiri Nambro-Sefwi Anhwiaso a ɛwɔ Ghana Atɔeɛ Mantam mu . Ɔnyaa ne Master of Arts abodin krataa wɔ Amanaman Ntam Nsɛm mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu wɔ afe 1992.

Adwuma 
Addae yɛɛ adwuma sɛ Ɔhwɛfo ne Ɔhwɛfo . Ɔyɛ Bibiani-Anhwiaso-Bekwai Ɔmantam Panyin fi afe 2001 kosi afe 2005.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔdii kan paw Addae sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ mmrahyɛbagua no mu wɔ December 2004 mu bere a wɔwiee afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no . Ɔsan nso yɛɛ mmrahyɛbadwani a ogyinaa Bibiani-Anhwiaso-Bekwai Mantam no ananmu wɔ Atɔe Fam mantam mu wɔ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no nkatanim ase, na onyaa abatow 24,241 a wɔtow fii abatow 48,624 a ɛfata wɔ ne Mantam mu no mu.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Addae yɛ ɔwarefo. Ɔyɛ Kristoni na ɔyɛ Seventh Day Adventist Asɔre no muni .

title: Simons Addai
text:
Simons Addai yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne nwomasua ho nimdefoɔ. Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbadwani ma Techiman South mantam no firi 7 Ɔbɛnem 2009 kɔsi 6 Ɔbɛnem 2013 wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Addai wɔ 14 Ɔpɛpɔn 1954.  Ɔfiri Krobo-Techiman, Brong Ahafo Mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana. Ɔnyaa ne bachelor’s degree (BEd) wɔ Cape Coast Suapɔn mu wɔ afe 2003.

Adwuma 
Addai yɛ nhomasua ho ɔbenfo. Ɔne Ghana Education Service yɛɛ adwuma sɛ Principal Superintendent ne ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo wɔ Bamiri LA JSS.

Amanyɔsɛm

2004 Abatow a Wɔyɛe 
Wɔdii kan paw Addai sɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanyin a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan a ɛfirii aseɛ firi Ɔpɛpɔn 2005 kɔsii Ɔpɛpɔn 2009 no muni  Wɔpaw no sɛ ɔmmɛgyina amansin no ananmu wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu. Wɔde abatow 27,803 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a wɔtow nyinaa mu 58,160 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 47.80% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Amadu Bermah Suleman a ofi Ɔmanfo Ɔman Nhyiam no mu, Prince Oduro-Mensah a ofi Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no mu, Joshua Kwame Owusu Brempong a ofi Nhyiam no mu Nnipa Kuw no mu ne Abdel Hamid Baba a ɔyɛ ɔkannifo a ɔde ne ho. Eyinom nyaa abatow 1,775, abatow 24,416, abatow 735 ne abatow 3,431 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 3.1%, 42.0%, 1.3% ne 5.9% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw Addai wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so. Na ne mansin no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 10 fa wɔ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 24 a ne nyinaa yɛ ma Brong Ahafo mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana no mu. Sɛ yɛka ne nyinaa bom a, National Democratic Congress dii nkonim wɔ mmrahyɛbagua ananmusifo kakraa bi 94 mu wɔ nkongua 230 a ɛwɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 4 a ɛwɔ Ghana man a ɛto so 4 no mu.

2008 Abatow no 
Addai yɛ mmrahyɛbadwani ma Techiman South mantam firi 7 Ɔbɛnem 2009 kɔsi 6 Ɔbɛnem 2013 wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so .  Ɔnam saayɛ so gyinaa amansin no ananmu wɔ Ghana republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 5 no mu. Wɔpaw no wɔ afe 2008 Ghana amansan abatow mu.  Ɔnyaa abatoɔ 28,586 wɔ abatoɔ 56,478 a ɛfata a wɔtoo wɔ afe 2008 Ghana mmrahyɛbagua abatoɔ mu no mu .   Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 50.61% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Prince Yaw Donyina a ofi Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no mu, Amoah David Dumah a ofi People's National Convention, Lale David Den a ofi Democratic Freedom Party no mu ne Daniel Mensah a ofi Convention People's Party no mu . Eyinom nyaa abatow 26,829, abatow 633, abatow 165 ne abatow 265 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne 7.50%, 1.12%, 0.29% ne 0.47% yɛ pɛ. Wɔ saa abatoɔ no mu no, National Democratic Congress nyaa dodoɔ no ara mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 114 wɔ nkongua 230 a ɛwɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 5 a ɛwɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu.

Ankorankoro asetra

title: Josephine Hilda Addo
text:
Josephine Hilda Addoh yɛ Ghana amanyɔni na ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party no muni . Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma Kwadaso Mantam no wɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan wɔ Republic of Ghana a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Addoh wɔ 27 Ɔpɛpɔn 1957. Ɔwɔ Bachelor of Arts abodin krataa.

Adwuma 
Addoh yɛ adwumayɛfoɔ, n’ani gye adan ne afie ho na ɔyɛ n’ankasa adwuma.

Amammui mu adwuma 
Hilda a wonim no sɛ ɔkasa mu ahoɔden kɛse na ɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu no yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni . Ɔbɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbagua muni fi Ɔpɛpɔn 2005 bere a ɔdaa ne ho adi sɛ nkonimdifo wɔ Amansan Abatow mu wɔ December 2004. Wɔpaw no sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani ma Kwadaso mantam wɔ Ghana Republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu na ɔsan nso bɛyɛɛ Pan-African mmrahyɛbaguani a bere bi odii ananmusifoɔ anim kɔɔ Zimbabwe wɔ Mugabe-Tsvangirai abatoɔ no mu.

Abatow a wɔyɛ 
Wɔpaw Addoh sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani mma Kwadoso mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana nea edi kan wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow no mu.  Odii nkonim wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so. Ná ne mantam no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 36 no fa wɔ nkongua 39 a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Ashanti Mantam no mu. New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 128 wɔ nkongua 230 mu.  Wɔde abatow 43,929 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 52,830 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 83.2% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Joseph Yammin a ofi National Democratic Congress, Essien Daniel a ofi Convention People’s Party ne Owusu Ansah.Cosmos a ofi Every Ghanaian Living Everywhere kuw no mu. Eyinom nyaa abatow 7,173, 1,436 ne 292 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 13.6%, 2.7% ne 0.6% yɛ pɛ.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Addoh yɛ Kristoni.

Hwɛ nso 
MP a wɔpaw wɔn wɔ afe 2004 Ghana mmrahyɛbagua abatow mu din

title: Joseph Nii Laryea Afotey-Agbo
text:
Joseph Nii Laryea Afotey-Agbo (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn 31, 1967) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni na na ɔyɛ Greater Accra Regional Minister wɔ Ghana.   Ansa na eyi reba no, na ɔyɛ Volta Ɔmantam Soafo.  Ɔyɛ Fourth Republic of Ghana mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nson no muni a ɔgyina Kpone-Katamanso Mantam a ɛwɔ Greater Accra Mantam mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ɔyɛ Kristoni (Presbyterian). Ɔwaree (ɔwɔ mma baason).

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Afotey-Agbo wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn da a ɛtɔ so aduasa baako, afe 1967.  Ɔfiri Katamanso-Nungua, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Greater Accra Mantam mu wɔ Ghana . Owiee Ghana Institute of Journalism na onyaa ne diploma abodin krataa wɔ ɔmanfo ntam abusuabɔ mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Afotey-Agbo yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi Bagua (NDC) no muni. Ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani a ɔgyina Kpone-Katamanso Mansin ananmu wɔ 4th, 5th, 8th, ne mprempren ne 7th Parliament wɔ 4th Republic of Ghana. Ɔsom sɛ boayikuw muni wɔ boayikuw ahorow a ɛhwɛ Atwa Yɛn Ho Ahyia, Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma Boayikuw, Mmabun, Agumadi ne Amammerɛ Boayikuw, ne Hokwan Boayikuw so.  Ɔyɛɛ Aman soafoɔ wɔ afe 2009 ne 2012 ntam. Ɔsan nso yɛɛ Ɔmantam Ɔsoafoɔ wɔ Greater Accra Mantam mu wɔ afe 2012 ne afe 2014 ntam.

Adwuma 
Ɔyɛ JNL Afotey-Agbo Ventures no kwankyerɛfo panyin (MD).  Ɔayɛ mmrahyɛbaguani firi Ɔpɛpɔn 2005 kɔsi nnɛ.

title: Alfred Kwame Agbesi
text:
Alfred Kwame Agbesi (wɔwoo no 20 Ɔpɛpɔn 1955) yɛ mmaranimfoɔ ne amanyɔniɔ wɔ Ghana . Ɔyɛ Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua no muni . Na ɔyɛ kan mmrahyɛbaguani a ɔhwɛ Ashaiman (Ghana mmrahyɛbagua mantam) so na na ɔyɛ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua no kannifo abadiakyiri wɔ John Dramani Mahama nniso ase.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Alfred Kwame Agbesi wɔ 20 Ɔpɛpɔn 1955.  Na ɔfiri Agave-Afedume a ɛwɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.  Ɔsuaa adeɛ wɔ Ghana. Ɔnyaa Mmaranimfoɔ abodin krataa wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu, Legon wɔ afe 1979 ne BL (GSL) afe 1981.

Adwuma 
Ɔne Ghana atemmuo adwuma no yɛɛ adwuma sɛ Mmaranimfoɔ ansa na ɔrebɛyɛ mmrahyɛbadwani ama Ashaiman .  Enti ɔyɛ mmaranimfo ne Ghana amammuifo wɔ n’adwuma mu.

Amammui mu adwuma 
Alfred Agbesi yɛ Ghana mmrahyɛbadwani a ɔhwɛ Ashaiman mantam so firi afe 2005 kɔsi afe 2016 berɛ a ɔdii nkoguo wɔ mmrahyɛbaguani a ɔwɔ Ashaiman mantam mu mprempren Ernest Norgbey wɔ Primaries of the National Democratic Congress wɔ afe 2015

Bere a wɔpaw no wɔ afe 2008 mu akyi no, wɔpaw no sɛ Ghana ananmusifo a wɔbɛkɔ ECOWAS mmrahyɛbaguani wɔ Abuja, Nigeria wɔ afe 2009 mu na wɔsan paw no bio wɔ afe 2013 mu sɛ onnyina Ghana ananmu.

2004 Abatow a Wɔyɛe 
Wɔpaw Agbesi sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani maa Ashaiman Mantam no nea edi kan wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow no mu.  Wɔde abatow 53,559 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 94,091 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 56.9% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Hajia Hajara M. Ali a ofi Ɔmanfo Ɔman Nhyiam no mu, Teye Emmanauel Kinsford Kwesi a ofi Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no mu, Phoyon Isaac Bruce Mensah a ofi Nhyiam no mu Ɔmanfo Kuw no mu ne Amable Kwame Samuel yɛ obi a ɔde ne ho. Eyinom nyaa abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 2.9%, 38.3%, 0.9% ne 1.0%. Wɔpaw Agbesi wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so . Na ne mansin no yɛ amansin 10 a National Democratic Congress dii nkonim wɔ Greater Accra mantam mu wɔ saa abatow no mu no fa.  Sɛ wɔka ne nyinaa bom a, National Democratic Congress no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 94 wɔ Ghana man a ɛto so 4 no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 4 no mu .

Ankorankoro asetra 
Agbesi aware a ɔwɔ mma baanum.  Ɔyɛ Kristoni.

title: Samuel Owusu Agyei
text:
Samuel Owusu Agyei yɛ Ghana amanyɔni na na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbadwani ma Effutu mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Mfinimfini mantam mu wɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan wɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu na na ɔyɛ ɔman soafoɔ a ɔhwɛ ɔman nnwuma mu nsakraeɛ so

Nwomasua 
Agyei kɔɔ Wales Sukuupɔn, baabi a onyaa Master of Science abodin krataa wɔ sikasɛm mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Agyei hyɛɛ amammuisɛm mu bere a wɔpaw no sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani ma Effutu Mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Mfinimfini mantam mu wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow no mu wɔ New Patriotic Party tekiti so no .  Enti ɔgyinaa amansin no ananmu wɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan mu firi 7 Ɔbɛnem 2005 kɔsi 6 Ɔbɛnem 2009. Agyei dii dwuma bere biako pɛ sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani maa Effutu mantam no . Wɔtuu no wɔ abatoɔ a ɛdi akyire no mu, afe 2008 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu, denam mmrahyɛbadwani a ɔdi kan maa ɔmansin korɔ no ara mu wɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa a ɛwɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu, Mike Allen Hammah, a ɔfiri ɔsɔretia kuo kɛseɛ no mu – National Democratic Congress, .   a Mike Allen Hammah too aba a ne nyinaa yɛ abatow a ɛfata a ɛyɛ 12,010 tiaa Hammah abatow a ɛfata a ɛyɛ 15,124.  Agyei yɛ New Patriotic Party no muni.

Ɔsan nso yɛ kan Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ Ɔmanfoɔ nnwuma mu nsakraeɛ so wɔ Ghana Ɔmanpanyin Kan Ne Ɔheneba John Agyekum Kuffour nnisoɔ mu.

2004 Abatow a Wɔyɛe 
Wɔpaw Agyei sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 13,651 wɔ abatoɔ a ɛyɛ 26,710 a wɔtoo no nyinaa mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 51.1% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sɛ ɔnyɛ mmrahyɛbadwani a ɔwɔ hɔ mprempren ma ɔmantam koro no ara, Hammah Mike Allen a ofi National Democratic Congress ; ne Sunu-Nuquaye Stephen a ofi Nhyiam Nnipa Kuw no mu, Adelina Dennis a ofi Great Consolidated Popular Party no mu ne; Frank Ebo Sam ne Isaac Arthur Aidoo – nnipa baanu a wɔde wɔn ho.Eyinom nyaa abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 46.6%, 1.4%, 0.3%, 0.2% ne 0.4%. Wɔpaw Agyei wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so .  Na ne mantam no yɛ amansin 16 a New Patriotic Party dii nkonim wɔ Central mantam mu wɔ saa abatow no mu no fa.  Sɛ wɔka ne nyinaa bom a, New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 128 wɔ Ghana man a ɛto so anan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so anan no mu .

Agyei yɛ Kristoni.

title: Elizabeth Agyemang
text:
Elizabeth Agyemang (wɔwoo no 13 May 1949) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni na na ɔyɛ Ghana mmrahyɛbaguani .  Ɔgyinaa Oforikrom ananmu wɔ Ashanti mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party no muni na ɔyɛ Ɔmanpanyin Abadiakyiri wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Agyemang wɔ Kotei wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana . Ɔkura ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ adansedie krataa 'A'. Onyaa adansedi krataa no wɔ 1971 mu. Onyaa ayarehwɛfo adansedi krataa nso fii Alexandria Ayaresabea a ɛwɔ Virginia, U.S.A. Eyi sii afe 1989.

Adwuma 
Efi Ɔpɛpɔn 2005 kosi Ɔpɛpɔn 2017 no, Elizabeth gyinaa Oforikrom mantam ananmu wɔ Ashanti mantam mu wɔ Ghana .  Odii nkonim wɔ ne mmrahyɛbagua no mu denam abatow 58,812 a onyae wɔ abatow 90,333 a ɛfata a wɔtow wɔ ne mantam mu no so.

Wɔ Oforisuo 2017 mu no, Ɔmampanyin Nana Akufo-Addo, bɔɔ ne din sɛ ɔmantam asomfo abadiakyiri du a wɔbɛyɛ n’aban no fa no mu biako. Ghana mmrahyɛbagua no Appointments Committee no hwehwɛɛ ne mu wɔ saa bosome no ara mu. Boayikuw no penee so na wɔde ne din kɔmaa mmrahyɛbagua no Kasafo ma mmrahyɛbagua no fie kɛse no nnye ntom bio.

Abatow a wɔyɛ 
Wɔpaw Agyemang sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani mma Oforikrom mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana nea edi kan wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow no mu. Odii nkonim wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so . Ná ne mantam no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 36 no fa wɔ nkongua 39 a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Ashanti Mantam no mu.  New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 128 wɔ nkongua 230 mu.  Wɔde abatow 47,388 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 71,594 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 66.2% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Minir Abdullah Dawood a ofi Nnipa Ɔman Nhyiam no mu, Abofra George Cudjoe a ofi Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua no mu ne Adelaide Borden a ofi Nhyiam no mu Nnipa Kuw no mu . Eyinom nyaa abatow 2,516, 21,056 ne 634 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtowee nyinaa mu 3.5%, 66.2%, 29.4% ne 0.9% yɛ pɛ.

Wɔ afe 2008 mu no, odii nkonim wɔ amansan abatow no mu wɔ New Patriotic Party tekiti so maa ɔmansin koro no ara.  Ná ne mansin no ka mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 34 a ɛwɔ nkongua 39 a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Ashanti Mantam no mu no ho .  New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 109 wɔ nkongua 230 mu.  Wɔde abatow 40,704 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 64,538 mu.  Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 63.07% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Munir Abdullah Dawood a ofi Ɔmanfo Ɔman Nhyiam no mu, Terlabi Ebenezer Oklety a ofi Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua no mu ne Afful Hayfor a ofi Nhyiam no mu Nnipa Kuw no mu . Eyinom nyaa abatow 1,120, 21,572 ne 1,142 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne 1.74%, 33.43% ne 1.77% yɛ pɛ wɔ abatow a wɔtow no nyinaa mu.

Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔdii nkonim bio wɔ amansan abatoɔ mu maa ɔmansin korɔ no ara. Wɔde abatow 58,812 paw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 90,333 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 65.11% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Awidu Gariba a ofi National Democratic Congress, Raphael Brobbey a ofi Progressive People’s Party, Salifu Zakari a ofi Convention People’s Party, Faustina Adjei a ofi National Democratic Party ne Nana Osei Tutu Prempeh a ɔyɛ obi a ɔde ne ho. Eyinom nyaa abatow 29,393, 1,246, 311, 419 ne 152 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne 32.54%, 1.38%, 0.34%, 0.46% ne 0.17% yɛ pɛ wɔ abatow a wɔtow nyinaa mu.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Agyemang aware a ɔwɔ mma baasa.  Ɔda ne ho adi sɛ ɔyɛ Kristoni.

title: Dan Abdul-latif
text:
Dan Abdul-latif (wɔwoo no 1st January, 1970) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni . Ɔyɛ Ghana Mantam a Ɛto so Anan no mmrahyɛbagua a Ɛto so Awotwe no muni a ogyina Ablekuma Mfinimfini Mantam no ananmu wɔ Ablekuma Mfinimfini Kuropɔn Mantam mu wɔ Nkran Mantam mu wɔ Ghana .

Mfiase Asetra ne Adwuma 
Wɔwoo Abdul-latif wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn da a ɛtɔ so mmienu, afe 1970. Ɔfiri Tamale a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi fam mantam mu. Ɔwɔ Degree wɔ Nkitahodi Ho Nsɛm mu (2020).  Na ɔyɛ Ysan Cevre Isiklan Dirma Malzemeleri ST Ltd. adwumayɛbea Panyin

Amanyɔsɛm 
Abdul-latif yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua(NDC) no muni .  Wɔ August 2021 mu no, ɔsii akan na odii nkonim wɔ NDC Parliamentary Primaries wɔ Ablekuma Central Constituency sɛ ɔbɛyɛɛ party no kandifoɔ wɔ December 2020 abatoɔ no mu .  Ɔdii nkonim wɔ December 2020 mmrahyɛbagua abatoɔ no mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 47,040 a ɛgyina hɔ ma abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 49.7%, na ɔboroo nea ɔsɔre tia no titire ne mmrahyɛbaguani a ɔdi tumi seesei Ebenezer Gilbert Nii Narh Nartey a ɔfiri New patriotic Party a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 46,836 a ɛgyina hɔ ma abatoɔ a ɛfata nyinaa mu 49.5% to.

Boayikuw ahorow 
Ɔsom sɛ Nkitahodi Boayikuw ne Aban Boayikuw no muni wɔ Ghana Aman a Ɛto so Anan mmrahyɛbagua a Ɛto so Awotwe no mu

title: Mustapha Ahmed
text:
Mustapha Ahmed (wɔwoo no 8 June 1960)  yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne mmrahyɛbagua a Ɛtɔ so Nsia a ɛwɔ Fourth Republic of Ghana no muni a ɔgyina Ayawaso North Constituency ananmu wɔ Greater Accra Region wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Ahmed wɔ 8 June 1960 wɔ Bawku wɔ Upper East Region.  Ɔfiri Bawku, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Upper East Region wɔ Ghana .  Owiee Ghana Suapɔn Aduruyɛ Sukuu ne Nsõ Ho Adesua na onyaa ne Bachelor's degree's wɔ Dental Surgery mu wɔ afe 1983.

Adwuma 
Ahmed yɛ oduruyɛfo a ɔyɛ nsensan ho oprehyɛn wɔ n’adwuma mu. Ɔsan yɛ Ghana amanyɔni.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ahmed yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua (NDC) no muni. Ɔbɛyɛɛ Fourth Republic of Ghana mmrahyɛbagua a Ɛto so Abiɛsa no muni a ogyinaa Ayawaso Apuei Mansin ananmu wɔ January 2001 mu bere a odii nkonim wɔ ne abatow mu wɔ afe 2000 Ghana amansan abatow mu no . Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbagua a Ɛto so Anan ne Anum no muni wɔ ne san a wɔsan paw no wɔ afe 2004 ne 2008 Ghana amansan abatow mu no akyi.

2004 Abatow 
Wɔpaw Ahmed wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani ma Ayawaso Apueeɛ mantam no wɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan wɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu firi 7 Ɔbɛnem 2005 kɔsi 6 Ɔbɛnem 2009. Wɔde abatow 49,354 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata nyinaa mu 87,902. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 56.1% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Abdiel Godly Babaaali a ofi Nnipa Ɔman Nhyiam no mu ne Daddah Braimah B. a ofi Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no mu .Eyinom nyaa abatow 4,095 ne abatow 34,453 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne 4.7% ne 39.2% yɛ pɛ wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Wɔpaw Ahmed wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so . Na ne mansin no yɛ amansin 10 a National Democratic Congress dii nkonim wɔ Greater Accra mantam mu wɔ saa abatow no mu no fa.  Sɛ wɔka ne nyinaa bom a, National Democratic Congress no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 128 wɔ Ghana man a ɛto so anan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so anan no mu.

2008 Abatow no 
Wɔsan paw Ahmed wɔ afe 2008 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani ma Ayawaso Apueeɛ mantam no wɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 5 a ɛwɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu firi 7 Ɔbɛnem 2009 kɔsi 6 Ɔbɛnem 20013.  Wɔde abatow 44,655 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 78,120 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 57.16% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Mohammed Salisu Baba a ofi Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no mu, Alhaji Mohammed Muftao a ofi Ɔmanfo Ɔman Nhyiam no mu, Bernard Anvuur Billy a ofi Democratic Freedom Party no mu, Amin Abdul Karim Larry a ofi Ɔmanpanyin Kuw no mu ; ne Ahaji Haruna Bubakari Dabre, Daniel Danquah, Mohammed Amin Lamptey ne Samuel Kwesi Gyasi - wɔn nyinaa yɛ wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔde wɔn ho. Eyinom nyaa abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 33.31%, 0.98%, 0.76%, 2.25%, 0.0%, 0.4%, 4.67% ne 0.49%.  Wɔsan paw Ahmed wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.Na ne mantam no yɛ amansin 18 a National Democratic Congress dii nkonim wɔ Greater Accra mantam mu wɔ saa abatow no mu no fa.  Sɛ yɛka ne nyinaa bom a, National Democratic Congress no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 114 wɔ Ghana republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu.

Ahmed yɛ Nkramofo. Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baasa.
