title: Paul Evans Aidoo
text:
Paul Evans Aidoo (wɔwoo no 4 Ɔbɛnem 1958) yɛ Ghana ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo ne amanyɔni . Ɔyɛ Sefwi-Wiawso mmrahyɛbaguani na ɔyɛ Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ Ghana Atɔe Fam Mantam so .     Ansa na ɔredi Atɔe Fam Mantam no anim no, na ɔyɛ Brong-Ahafo Ɔmantam Soafo. Ghana Centre for Popular Education and Human Rights akasa atia no sɛ "ɔhyɛ ɔtan ho nkuran" bere a ɔsomfo no hyɛɛ nkurɔfo nkuran sɛ wɔmfa wɔn a wosusuw sɛ wɔyɛ mmarima a wɔne wɔn ho da no nkɔmmɔ. Ɔkae sɛ: "Wɔrebɔ mmɔden nyinaa sɛ wobeyi saa nnipa yi afi ɔmanfo no mu."

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Paul Aidoo wɔ 4 August 1958 wɔ Sefwi-Ewiase wɔ Sefwi-Wiawso Mantam mu wɔ Ghana Atɔeɛ Mantam mu. Ɔsuaa adeɛ wɔ kokoam maa General Certificate of Education Ordinary Level wɔ afe 1980 mu. Ɔkɔɔ Enchi Akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ Nteteeɛ Kɔlege wɔ afe 1977 ne 1981 ntam, na ɔfatae sɛ ɔde Akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ Abodin krataa'A'.

Dwumadi 
Aidoo yɛɛ adwuma sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo wɔ afe 1981 ne 1985 ntam. Afei ɔne Ɔman Nkabom Nhyehyɛe no yɛɛ adwuma sɛ Ɔmantam Nkitahodifo wɔ 1985 ne 1997 ntam hɔ. Wɔ afe 1997 ne 2001 ntam no, na ɔyɛ Ɔmantam Panyin wɔ Mpɔtam Aban Dwumadibea. Efi afe 2002 kosi afe 2004 no, na ɔyɛ sukuu panyin wɔ Ghana Nhomasua Dwumadibea .

Amanyɔsɛm 
Aidoo yɛ National Democratic Congress no muni na odii nkonim wɔ Sefwi-Wiawso atenae so wɔ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua abatow mu wɔ afe 2004.   Ɔkɔɔ so kuraa n'akongua so wɔ afe 2008 abatow no mu .  Wɔ afe 2009 mu no, Ghana Ɔmampanyin, John Atta Mills na ɔpaw no sɛ Atɔe Fam Ɔmanpanyin, John Atta Mills na wɔ Oforisuo 2013 mu no, ɔpaw no sɛ Brong-Ahafo Mantam soafoɔ afei wɔsan paw no sɛ Atɔeɛ mantam soafoɔ wɔ Oforisuo 2014 mu denam Ghana Ɔmampanyin, John Dramani so Mahama .Wɔ July 2011 mu no, ɔfrɛɛ Ghana Bureau of National Investigations sɛ wɔnkyere mmarima a wɔne wɔn ho da nyinaa wɔ Western Region na ɔka kyerɛɛ afiewuranom ne wɔn a wɔagye adan no sɛ wɔmfa wɔn a wɔsusu sɛ wɔyɛ mmarima a wɔne wɔn ho da no nkɔmmɔ.  Wɔbɔɔ amanneɛ sɛ ɔkaa sɛ, "Sɛ wɔkyere wɔn wie a, wɔde wɔn bɛba mmara anim". (Nhyehyɛe bi a ɛwɔ nsɛmmɔnedi ho mmara ɔfa a ɛwɔ Ghana 1992 amansan mmara mu no kasa tia "honam fam nimdeɛ a ɛnyɛ awosu". Amanyɔ mmara no ma nnipa hokwan ahorow "a abusuakuw, beae a wofi, amammui adwene, kɔla, nyamesom, gyidi anaa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mfa ho", nanso ɛnyɛ nna).

Ankorankoro asetra 
Aidoo aware a ɔwɔ mma baawɔtwe. Ɔyɛ Katolekni .

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Abolimbisa Roger Akantagriwen
text:
Abolimbisa Roger Akantagriwen (wɔwoo no 6 Oforisuo 1964) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni na ɔyɛ Ghana Mantam a ɛtɔ so nnan mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan no muni a ɔgyina Builsa Anafoɔ Mansin ananmu wɔ Upper East Region .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Akantagriwen wɔ Builsa wɔ Upper East Region wɔ Ghana wɔ 6 March 1964. Ɔkɔɔ Nhomasua Sukuupɔn na onyaa Abodin krataa wɔ Bachelor of Art (Education) mu.

Adwuma 
Akantagriwen yɛ Nhomasua ho nimdefoɔ na na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma Builsa South mantam a ɛwɔ Upper East Region of Ghana firi afe 2005 kɔsi afe 2009.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔdii kan paw Akantagriwen sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ mmrahyɛbagua no mu wɔ December 2004 Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ no mu wɔ Tekete a ɛwɔ Ɔman Ho Kuo Foforɔ a ɛgyina hɔ ma Builsa Anafoɔ Mansin a ɛwɔ Ghana Apueeɛ Apuei Mantam mu no Tekete so. Ɔnyaa abatoɔ 4,820 wɔ abatoɔ 10,947 a ɛfata a wɔtoo no mu a ɛgyina hɔ ma 44.00%.  Ɔdii nkoguo wɔ afe 2008 Amansan abatoɔ no mu wɔ Alhassan Azong so.

Abatow a wɔyɛ 
Wɔpaw Akantagriwen sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani mma Builsa South mantam a ɛwɔ Upper East Region of Ghana wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow no mu.  Odii nkonim wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so. Na ne mansin no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 9 no fa wɔ nkongua 13 a National Democratic Congress dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Upper East Region no mu.  National Democratic Congress no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 94 a ɛyɛ kakraa bi wɔ nkongua 230 mu.  Wɔde abatow 4,820 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 10,974 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 44% yɛ pɛ.  Wɔpaw no sen Achianah Joseph Amoabil a ofi Nnipa Ɔman Nhyiam no mu, Theodore Kaboa Ayaric a ofi Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no mu ne Kunde Daniel Collins a ofi Nhyiam Nnipa Kuw no mu .  Eyinom nyaa abatow 2,631, 3,413 ne 83 wɔ abatow a wɔtow nyinaa mu.  Eyinom ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 24%, 31.2% ne 0.8% yɛ pɛ.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Akantagriwen yɛ Kristoni.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Abdul-Razak Tahidu
text:
Abdul-Razak Tahidu yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne mmrahyɛbadwani ma Chereponi mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Apueeɛ mantam mu

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo no 28 Ɔbɛnem 1977 na ɔfiri Chereponi a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Apueeɛ mantam mu. Ɔnyaa ne mfitiaseɛ nwomasua wɔ afe 1992 mu na ɔnyaa ne SSSCE wɔ afe 1995 mu. Ɔsan nso nyaa ne Teacher adansedie krataa wɔ afe 2000 mu ne ne Degree wɔ Basic Education mu wɔ afe 2007 mu na ɔsan nso nyaa ne master’s degree wɔ Leadership & Development mu wɔ afe 2013.

Adwuma 
Na ɔyɛ Budget and Examinations Officer wɔ Ghana Education Service na akyiri yi ɔyɛ District Chief Executive wɔ Ministry of Local Government ma Chereponi mantam no.

Amammui mu adwuma 
Ɔyɛ NPP muni na mprempren ɔyɛ MP a ɔhwɛ Chereponi Constituency so.  Ɔdii nkonim wɔ mmrahyɛbagua no mu de abatoɔ 19,800 berɛ a Samuel Abdulai Jabanyite a ɔdi tumi seesei no nyaa abatoɔ 12,859.   Mprempren, ɔyɛ Petroleum Commission no baguafo panyin.

Boayikuw ahorow 
Ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani na ɔsan yɛ Aguadi, Nnwuma ne Nsrahwɛ Boayikuw no muni.

title: Simon Atingban Akunye
text:
Simon Atingban Akunye (wɔwoo no 2 Ɔpɛpɔn 1954) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni.  Na ɔyɛ Ghana Aman a Ɛto so Anan no mmrahyɛbagua a Ɛto so Anum no muni, a ogyina hɔ ma Pusiga mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi apuei mantam mu.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Akunye wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2, 1954. Ɔyɛ obi a ofi Pusiga wɔ Upper East Region wɔ Ghana. Ɔyɛ ɔyarehwɛfo panyin a wɔakyerɛw ne din . Onyaa ne ayarehwɛ ho adansedi krataa wɔ Nigeria. Eyi sii wɔ 1984 mu. Ɔsan nso wɔ Executive master’s degree wɔ Governance and Leadership mu wɔ Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration . Ɔnyaa adansedie krataa no wɔ afe 2008.

Adwuma 
Akunye yɛ ayarehwɛfo panyin wɔ Akunye Nkaedi Ayaresabea.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔdii kan too aba too Akunye kɔɔ mmrahyɛbagua mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu .  Ɔtuu mmirika dii tumi a ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ afe 2008 mu a ɔdii nkonim wɔ mu. Nanso, ɔdii nkogu wɔ National Democratic Congress primaries mu wɔ afe 2016 mu. Ɛno akyi no, ɔsii gyinae sɛ ɔbɛkɔ Independent wɔ afe 2016 Ghana mmrahyɛbagua abatoɔ mu, nanso ɔhweree Pusiga atenaeɛ no maa Laadi Ayii Ayamba a ɔfiri National Democratic Congress .

Abatow a wɔyɛ 
Wɔpaw Akunye sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani maa Pusiga mantam a ɛwɔ Upper East Region of Ghana wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow mu. Odii nkonim wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.   Na ne mansin no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 9 no fa wɔ nkongua 13 a National Democratic Congress dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Upper East Region no mu. National Democratic Congress no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 94 a ɛyɛ kakraa bi wɔ nkongua 230 mu.  Wɔde abatow 12,112 paw no wɔ abatow 18,700 a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 64.8% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Yahaya Seidu Awinaba a ofi Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no mu . Onyaa abatow 6,588 wɔ abatow a wɔtow nyinaa mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 35.2% yɛ pɛ.

Wɔ afe 2008 mu no, wɔpaw no sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani wɔ ɔmansin koro no ara mu. Odii nkonim wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so . Wɔde abatow 8,803 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 15,684 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 56.13% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Azongo Peter Tasiri a ofi Nnipa Ɔman Nhyiam no mu, Mohammed Imoro Asoko a ofi Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no mu ne Abugbila Daniel a ofi Nhyiam Nnipa Kuw no mu . Eyinom nyaa abatow 391, 5,021 ne 1,469 wɔ abatow a wɔtow nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 2.49%, 32.01% ne 9.37% yɛ pɛ.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ɔyɛ Katolekni na waware na ɔwɔ mma baawɔtwe.

Hwɛ nso 
Pusiga (Ghana mmrahyɛbagua mantam) .

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Iddrisu Zakari Alidu
text:
Iddrisu Zakari Alidu yɛ Ghana amanyɔni na ɔyɛ Walewale MP . Ɔyɛ Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua no muni . (NDC) a ɛwɔ hɔ.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Zakari wɔ 6 March 1956 wɔ Janga ne kurom wɔ Ghana Atifi Mantam mu. Ɔkɔɔ Sukuupɔn a ɛhwɛ Nhomasua so, Winneba baabi a ɔwiee ne Bachelor of Education wɔ Akontaabuo mu na ɔsan nso kɔɔ Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration (GIMPA) a ɛwɔ Achimota wɔ Accra kɔyɛɛ ne Executive Masters wɔ Aban ne Akannifoɔ mu(EMGL) wɔ afe 2008 mu.

Adwuma 
Zakari yɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo wɔ n’adwuma mu.

Amammui asetra 
Wɔpaw Zakari wɔ National Democratic Congress (NDC) tekiti so sɛ onni Walewale mantam no ananmu bere a odii nkonim wɔ abatow 11,355 mu wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow no mu akyi . Ɔnyaa abatoɔ a wɔtoo no nyinaa mu 35.30% wɔ afe 2004 abatoɔ no mu na ɔdii nkonim de gyinaa Walewale mantam ananmu .  Ɔsan sii akan bio na ɔdii nkonim wɔ afe 2008 Ghana amansan abatoɔ a ɛmaa no hokwan sɛ ɔbɛgyina ne mansin ananmu ne mprenu so.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baakron na ɔyɛ Nkramofo .

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Adams Abdul Salam
text:
Adams Abdul-Salam (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛnimma bosome da a ɛto so dunsia wɔ afe apem ahankron aduowɔtwe nnum, December 16, 1985) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni a ɔyɛ National Democratic Congress no muni. Ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbadwani ma New Edubease Mmarahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa wɔ Ashanti mantam mu.

N'abrabɔ Mfitiaseɛ Ne Ne Nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Adams Abdul-Salam wɔ New Edubiase wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ 16 Ɔbɛnem 1985. Ɔkɔɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so, Ghana baabi a ɔwieeɛ ne Bachelor of Arts abodin krataa wɔ Amanyɔsɛm mu wɔ afe 2009. Abdul-Salam wɔ master’s degree wɔ Nkuraase Nkɔsoɔ mu a ɔsi Nkuraaseɛ Nhyehyɛeɛ so dua wɔ Brandon Suapɔn, Canada, wiee wɔ afe 2016.  Ɔsane nso yɛ obi a wawie Kumasi ntoasoɔ sukuu, a ɔwieeɛ wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne mmiɛnsa (2003).

Adwumayɛ

Adwumayɛ mfitiaseɛ 
Abdul-Salam yɛɛ Nkuraase Nhyehyɛeɛ sohwɛfoɔ wɔ Nkuraaseɛ Nkɔsoɔ Asoɛeɛ, Canada na akyiri yi ɔyɛɛ Nhwehwɛmufoɔ a ɔka ho wɔ Nkuraaseɛ Mpɔtam ne Adwene mu Akwahosan Dwumadibea, Brandon Suapɔn Canada.

Bɔɔlbɔ ho nhyehyɛe 
Ɔsan nso yɛɛ Adwumayɛfoɔ Panyin wɔ New Edubiase United Football Club. Mprempren ɔsom sɛ kuw no badwafo.

Amanyɔsɛm

mmrahyɛbagua no mu mmɔdenbɔ 
Abdul-Salam dii nkonim wɔ mmrahyɛbagua no mu sɛ ɔbɛgyina National Democratic Congress ananmu ama New Edubease Constituency ansa na afe 2020 abatoɔ no aba wɔ Oforisuo 2019 mu wɔ berɛ a wankɔ a wɔansɔre atia no.

Wɔ December 2020 mu no, Ɔdii nkonim wɔ New Edubease Constituency mu wɔ mmrahyɛbagua abatoɔ no mu. Ɔdii nkonim denam abatoɔ 19,961 a ɔnyaeɛ a ɛgyina hɔ ma 52.4% tiaa nea ɔsɔre tia no paa a ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbadwani a ɔdi tumi seesei, George Boahen Oduro a ɔfiri New Patriotic Party a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 17,913 a ɛgyina hɔ ma abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ no mu 47.0%.  New Edubease nkongua no yɛ nkongua a New Patriotic Party gyee fii National Democratic Congress no nsam wɔ 2016 mmrahyɛbagua Abatoɔ mu nanso wɔantumi ankora so mfeɛ 4 foforɔ.

Mmrahyɛbadwani 
Abdul-Salam kaa ntam sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani a obegyina New Edubease Mantam no ananmu wɔ Ghana Ɔmanpanyin a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 8 no mu wɔ 7 Ɔbɛnem 2021.

Boayikuw ahorow 
Ɔsom sɛ ɔmannifoɔ wɔ Mmarahyɛ Boayikuo nketewa ne mmrahyɛbagua no Mpɔtam Aban ne Nkuraase Nkɔsoɔ Boayikuo no mu.

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Abdul-Salam yɛ Nkramoni. Ne nuabarima panyin, Yakubu Abdul-Salam yɛ New Edubiase United Football Club no CEO, Ɔhyehyɛɛ ne ne Titenani. Ɔyɛ Bissa fi abusuakuw mu.

Adɔeyɛ 
Wɔ May 2022 mu no, ɔde nsa ho aduru bɛboro 4,500 maa nnipa a wɔwɔ New Edubiase Constituency wɔ COVID-19 ɔyaredɔm no mu wɔ Ghana.

Ntotoho

title: George Kwame Aboagye
text:
George Kwame Aboagye ( wɔwɔɔ 24 August 1968) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nson a ɛwɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no muni a ɔgyina Asene-Akroso-Manso Mansin ananmu wɔ Apueeɛ Mantam mu wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so.

title: Joseph Amenowode
text:
Joseph Zaphenat Amenowode yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne nhomanimfo . Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani wɔ Hohoe South na na ɔyɛ Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ Volta Mantam so wɔ Ghana firi Ɔbɛnem 2009 kɔsii sɛ wɔyii no fii adwumam wɔ 6 Oforisuo 2012. Wayɛ adwuma sɛ sukuupɔn mu ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo ansa na ɔrekɔ amammuisɛm mu.

Mfitiase asetra wɔ nhomasua mu 
Amenowode abusua no fi Ve-Deme a ɛwɔ Hohoe Municipal District wɔ Volta Mantam mu.  Wɔwoo no wɔ Accra, Ghana ahenkurow mu. Ɔkɔɔ Hohoe Evangelical Presbyterian Secondary School wɔ 1966 ne 1971 ntam hɔ na onyaa General Certificate of Education (GCE) Ordinary Level . Ɔkɔɔ Kpando Ntoaso Sukuu kɔyɛɛ ne sukuu afe a ɛtɔ so nsia, na ɔwiee GCE Advanced Level wɔ afe 1973 mu. Ne sukuupɔn mu adesua a edi kan no wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so a onyaa Bachelor of Arts Honors abodin krataa wɔ afe 1979 mu.Ɔkɔɔ so afe biako foforo wiee adesua akyi abodin krataa wɔ 1980 mu. Wɔ 1991 mu no, onyaa abodin krataa a ɛkorɔn wɔ sukuupɔn koro no ara mu.  Ɔkɔɔ Pratt Institute wɔ New York City baabi a owiee Master of Professional Studies abodin krataa wɔ Art Therapy mu wɔ afe 1997.

Adwuma 
Amenowode mfiase no na ɔkyerɛ ade wɔ Ghana Nhomasua Dwumadibea . Akyiri yi ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo wɔ Nhomasua Sukuupɔn, Winneba a ɛwɔ Central Region of Ghana.

Na ɔyɛ kan mmrahyɛbagua Boayikuw a Wɔapaw a Ɛhwɛ Adwumayɛ, Asetra mu Yiyedi ne Ɔman Nnwuma so no Titenani.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Joseph Amenowode yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua no muni .  Odii kan gyinaa abatow mu wɔ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua abatow mu wɔ afe 2004 mu, na odii nkonim de dodow no ara 17,720 (75.6%)  na ɔfaa n’akongua wɔ Fourth Republic mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so anan no mu. Ɔkɔɔ so kuraa n'akongua so wɔ afe 2008 abatow no mu .  Wɔ afe 2009 mu no, Ghana Ɔmanpanyin, John Atta Mills, paw no sɛ Volta Mantam Ɔmanpanyin, dibea a ɔdii mu kɔsii sɛ wɔgyaee no wɔ aban mu nsakraeɛ bi a Ɔmanpanyin Mills yɛeɛ wɔ afe 2012 mfitiaseɛ mu.

Hwɛ nso 

 Mills aban asomfo din a wɔahyehyɛ
 Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua (Ghana) .
 Hohoe Kesee Fam

title: Kwadwo Nyanpon Aboagye
text:
Kwadwo Nyanpon Aboagye yɛ Ghana amanyɔni na ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanin a ɛtɔ so nnan mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nson no muni a ɔgyina Biakoye Mansin ananmu wɔ Oti Mantam mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so. Wɔ April 2022 mu no, ɔyɛɛ nhyehyɛe maa wɔn a wɔte Biakoye no aniwa mu nhwehwɛmu ne oprehyɛn a wontua hwee.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Aboagye fi Apesokubi. Ɔwɔ BSC wɔ Civil Engineering mu wɔ Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology, adansedi krataa wɔ nnwumakuw nniso mu fi GIMPA . Ɔsan nso yɛ Ghana Mfiridwuma Asoɛe ne Ɔmanfoɔ Mfiridwuma Asoɛeɛ, UK.

title: Joseph Zaphenat Amenowode
text:
Joseph Zephinat Amenowode yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ. Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani wɔ Hohoe South na na ɔyɛ Ɔmanpanyin wɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ Ghana firi Ɔpɛpɔn 2009 kɔsii sɛ wɔyii no firii adwuma mu wɔ 6 Oforisuo 2012, wayɛ adwuma sɛ sukuupɔn mu ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ ansa na ɔrekɔ amanyɔsɛm mu.

Mfitiase asetra ne Nhomasua 
Amenowode abusua no firi Ve-Deme a ɛwɔ Hohoe Municipal District wɔ Volta Mantam mu, wɔwoo no wɔ Accra, Ghana ahenkuro mu. Ɔkɔɔ Hohoe Evangelical Presbyterian Secondary School wɔ afe 1966 ne 1971 ntam hɔ nyaa General Certificate of Education (GCE) Ordinary Level, ɔkɔɔ Kpando Secondary School kɔyɛɛ ne adesua a ɛtɔ so nsia, na ɔwiee GCE Advanced Level wɔ afe 1973 mu.Ne sukuupɔn mu adesua a edi kan no wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so a onyaa Bachelor of Arts Honors abodin krataa wɔ afe 1979 mu, ɔtoaa so afe foforo de wiee adesua akyi abodin krataa wɔ afe 1980 mu. Wɔ afe 1991 mu no, onyaa master’s degree wɔ sukuupɔn koro no ara mu, ɔkɔɔ Pratt Institute wɔ New York City baabi a owiee Master of Professional Studies abodin krataa wɔ Art Therapy mu wɔ afe 1997.

Adwuma 
Na Amenowode yɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ wɔ University of Education Winneba a ɛwɔ Central Region of Ghana. Mfiase no na ɔkyerɛ ade wɔ Ghana Nhomasua Dwumadibea.

Amammui mu adwuma 
Joseph Amenowode yɛ National Democratic Congress muni, ɔdii kan gyinaa hɔ maa afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatoɔ, ɔdii nkonim wɔ dodoɔ 17,720 (75.6%) na ɔdii n’akongua wɔ Fourth Republic of Ghana mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu. Ɔdii nkonim denam abatoɔ a ɔnyaeɛ no mu 89% (abatoɔ 20,605 a ɛfata a wɔtoo no mu 18,340). Ɔkɔɔ so kuraa n’akongua so wɔ afe 2008 abatoɔ no mu. Wɔ afe 2009 mu no, Ghana Ɔmanpanyin John Atta Mills paw no sɛ Volta Mantam Ɔmanpanyin, dibea a ɔdii mu kɔsii sɛ ɔgyaee no wɔ aban mu nsakraeɛ bi a Ɔmanpanyin Mills yɛeɛ wɔ afe  mfitiaseɛ

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ɔyɛ Kristoni a ɔyɛ Global Evangelical Church no muni. Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baason.

title: Elizabeth Amoah Tetteh
text:
Elizabeth Amoah-Tetteh (wɔwoo no 25 Ɔbɛnem 1945) yɛ nhomasua ho nimdefo  ne Ghana amanyɔni. Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma Twifu-Atti Morkwaa mantam no wɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 5 a ɛwɔ Ghana Republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Amoah-Tetteh wɔ 25 Ɔbɛnem 1945. Ɔfiri Twifo-Abodom a ɛwɔ Central Region wɔ Ghana. Wɔ 1974 mu no onyaa Diploma wɔ Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ mu wɔ Specialist Training College a ɛwɔ Winneba no mu .

Adwuma 
Amoah-Tetteh yɛɛ adwuma sɛ ɔkwankyerɛfoɔ boafoɔ ma Data Collection wɔ Teacher Education Division a ɛwɔ Ghana Education Service wɔ Accra.  Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma Twifo-Atti Morkwaa mantam no na ɔsan nso yɛ Nhomasua Minista Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Pre-tertiary Education so   wɔ bere a Nea Ɔkorɔn no Ghana Ɔmanpanyin Kan John Dramani Mahama nniso no mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Elizabeth Amoah-Tetteh dii kan gyinaa Twifo-Atti Morkwaa mantam ananmu sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani wɔ mmrahyɛbagua a Ɛto so Anum a ɛwɔ Ghana Republic a Ɛto so Anan no mu bere a odii nkonim wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so wɔ afe 2008 Ghana amansan abatow no mu akyi    Ɔnyaa abatoɔ dodoɔ a ɛyɛ 14,724 wɔ abatoɔ 28,632 a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ a ɛgyina hɔ ma 51.4% sene n’akannifoɔ afoforɔ, Abraham Dwuma Odoom a ɔfiri New Patriotic Party a ɔtwee abatoɔ 13,086 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 42.90% ne Rose Buah-Bassuah a ɔfiri Conventions People’s Party a nso nyaa abatoɔ 1,577 a egyina hɔ ma 5.2%.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Amoa-Tetteh aware a ɔwɔ mma baason. Ɔyɛ Kristoni.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so 

Ghana mmrahyɛbadwafoɔ 2005–2009

title: Anthony Evans Amoah
text:
Anthony Evans Amoah yɛ Ghana amammuifo ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a ogyinaa Wassa East Constituency ananmu wɔ Fourth Republic of Ghana mmrahyɛbagua a Ɛto so Anum mu bere a wɔbɔɔ no dawuru sɛ ɔno na odii nkonim wɔ 2008 Ghana amansan abatow no mu akyi

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Amoah wɔ 8 Ayɛwohomumɔ 1952.  Ɔyɛ Mpohor kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Atɔeɛ Mantam mu no kuromni . Ɔnyaa ne Nyansapɛ mu Master of Sociology wɔ afe 1995 mu ne Master of Business Administration wɔ afe 2000 mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu .

Adwuma 
Amoah yɛɛ adwuma sɛ Journalist ne Advertiser ansa na ɔrekɔ mmrahyɛbagua mu. Ɔsan nso yɛɛ adwuma sɛ Nnipa Nnwuma sohwɛfo wɔ Graphic Communications Group Limited,

Amanyɔsɛm

2004 Abatow a Wɔyɛe 
Wɔdii kan paw Amoah sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani wɔ afe 2004 Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ no mu .  Wɔpaw no sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani wɔ Mpohor Wassa Apuei mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Atɔe fam mantam mu. Ɔnam saayɛ so gyinaa amansin no ananmu wɔ Ghana republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu. Wɔde abatow 19,635 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 40,736 mu.Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 48.2% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen David Ansah a ofi Ɔmanfo Ɔman Nhyiam no mu, Joseph Kobina Danyame a ofi Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua no mu ne Mary Ankomah a ofi Nhyiam no mu Nnipa Kuw no mu . Eyinom nyaa 1%, 24.6% ne 26.2% wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Wɔpaw Amoah wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so.

Ɔyɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni . Ɔyɛɛ Atɔeɛ Mantam Ɔmanpanin  wɔ John Kufuor aban ase kɔsii afe 2008 ansa na ɔresi akan sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani no bɛgyina Wassa Apueeɛ Mantam no ananmu wɔ Atɔeɛ mantam mu.  Wɔ afe 2008 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu no, ɔdii nkonim wɔ ne mmrahyɛbagua atenaeɛ mu de abatoɔ 16,014 too aba wɔ abatoɔ 37,936 a ɛfata mu   Ɔgyinaa ananmu dii tumi afe baako pɛ.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Amoa aware a ɔwɔ mma baanum. Ɔyɛ Kristoni na ɔyɛ Pentekoste Asɔre no muni .

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so 

Ghana mmrahyɛbadwafoɔ 2005–2009

title: Eric Amoateng
text:
Eric Amoateng yɛ amanyɔni ne kan mmrahyɛbaguani wɔ Ghana . Wɔkyeree no wɔ nnubɔne ho aguadi ho wɔ afe 2005 mu wɔ United States na wɔde no too afiase.

Adwuma 
Mfiase no na Amoateng yɛ adwuma sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo.  Afei ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ aguadi sohwɛfo maa Koajay adwumakuw a ɛtɔɔ sukuu nneɛma na wɔkyekyɛe no.

Na Amoateng nso yɛ Amoma, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Kintampo Anafoɔ Mantam mu wɔ Brong Ahafo Mantam mu, a wɔde abodin Nana Amoateng Ameyaw II, no panin (ɔhene).  Wɔkyerɛ sɛ ɔsɛee sika pii wɔ ne nkurɔfo ho na onyaa din wɔ adɔeyɛ mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Amoateng bɔɔ mmɔden sɛ obegyina hɔ sɛ New Patriotic Party (NPP) kandifo wɔ Nkoranza mantam mu wɔ afe 2000 mu wɔ akyinnyegye bi mu a wantumi. Wɔbɔɔ amanneɛ sɛ na ebinom hwɛ yiye wɔ n’ahonyade ho. Wɔbɔɔ amanneɛ nso sɛ, wɔ afe 2001 mu no, wɔbɔɔ Amoateng sobo sɛ wadi visa.

Amoateng gyaee ne panin dibea wɔ afe 2004 mu sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a obegyina December 2004 mmrahyɛbagua abatow no mu wɔ NPP tekiti so, na ɔfaa Bomini a ɔwɔ Nkoranza North mantam a ɛbɛn hɔ wɔ Nkoranza Mantam mu wɔ Brong Ahafo mantam mu wɔ Ghana, sɛ ne kurom. Wɔkasa tiaa ne kandifo a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ Nkoranza North mantam no wɔ Sunyani Asɛnnibea Kunini no mu wɔ afe 2004 mu, nanso awiei koraa no wɔtwee asɛm no fii hɔ.  Ɔdii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ no mu ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 46.9 a ɔnyaa ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 22.3 ma ɔbɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbaguani a ɔdi kan koraa maa Nkoranza Atifi fam amansin a wɔabɔ no foforɔ no, ɛfiri 7 Ɔbɛnem 2005.

Abatow a wɔyɛ 
Wɔpaw Amoateng sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani mma Nkoranza Atifi fam wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow mu. Ɔnam saayɛ so gyinaa amansin no ananmu wɔ Ghana republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu. Wɔde abatow 9,144 paw no wɔ abatow 18,900 a ɛfata a wɔtow no mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 48.40% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Hayford Francis Amoako a ofi National Democratic Congress ne Kwame Ofosu Adjei Prince a ɔyɛ obi a ɔde ne ho. Eyinom nyaa abatow 5,402 ne 4,354. Eyinom ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 28.60% ne 23.00% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw Amoateng wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so. New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 14 wɔ nkongua 24 a Brong Ahafo mantam no nyae nyinaa mu.   Wɔ saa abatow a wɔyɛe wɔ afe 2004 mu no, kuw no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 128 wɔ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 230 mu.

Wɔkyeree obi, di n’asɛm na wɔde no to afiase 
Wɔkyeree Amoateng wɔ Amerika wɔ 12 Ɔbɛnem 2005.  Na ɔne n’adamfo bi, Nii Okai Adjei atu kwan akɔ USA wɔ Emirates Airline wimhyɛn mu akɔ John F. Kennedy Amanaman Ntam Wimhyɛn Gyinabea (JFK). Wɔkyerɛ sɛ na akwantu no rekɔtɔ nsateaa dɔn a wɔde bɛsan atɔn wɔ Ghana a wɔagye US$9,000 afi Amoateng hɔ.  Wohuu nkuku nnaka ason a na efi London asi fam wɔ Newark Liberty Amanaman Ntam Wimhyɛn Gyinabea, a na ɛrekɔ JFK da koro a atwam no mu no, heroin nkaribo 136 wom. Ná nnubɔne no bo a wɔbɔɔ ho amanneɛ wɔ mmɔnten so no bɛyɛ U.S. dɔla ɔpepem 6. Ahobammɔ adwumayɛfo hwɛɛ Amoateng ne Adjei bere a wɔde nneɛma no kɔmaa na wɔde kɔ baabi a wɔde wɔn ankasa sie wɔ Staten Island no . Ade kyee no, wɔkyeree wɔn bere a wɔkɔhwɛɛ nneɛma no.   Amoateng kaa sɛ ɔwɔ diplomatic immunity wɔ ne kyere akyi a wantumi.  Wɔbɔɔ wɔn sobo sɛ "wɔabɔ pɔw sɛ wɔbɛkyekyɛ heroin".

Amoateng ne Adjei mfiase no gyee sobo a wɔbɔɔ wɔn sɛ wɔabɔ pɔw sɛ wɔbɛkyekyɛ nnubɔne bere a wɔde wɔn kɔɔ asɛnnibea no toom.  Akyiri yi Adjei sesaa nea ɔkae sɛ odi fɔ no ma ɛbɛyɛɛ nea odi fɔ.  Eyi akyi no, wɔbɔɔ Amoateng sobo a ɛto so abien.  Wɔ August 2006 mu no, wɔbɔɔ Amoateng sobo a ɛto so abiɛsa sɛ "ɔkyekyɛ nnubɔne a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ a ɛyɛ bɛyɛ kilogram biako anaa nea ɛboro saa a heroin wom."

Wɔ 19 March, 2007 mu no, Amoateng sesaa ne ho a ɔkae no yɛɛ no fɔ.  Wɔde no too afiase mfe du wɔ December 12, 2007.  Odii n'afiasenna wɔ Moshannon Valley Correctional Center a ɛwɔ Pennsylvania, United States .

Fallout a efi kyere a wɔkyeree no mu

mmrahyɛbagua no 
Wɔkyeree no akyi no, wɔgyee akyinnyeɛ kyɛeɛ sɛ ebia ɛsɛ sɛ Amoateng kɔ so yɛ MP ma Nkoranza North anaa. Kyei-Mensah-Bonsu, Majority Chief Whip, kɔɔ so kae sɛ "kosi sɛ wobeyi asɛm no afi hɔ no ɔda so ara yɛ obi a wosusuw sɛ ɔyɛ ɔsɛmmɔnedifo na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔma sobo no yɛ nokware".  Bere a dodow no ara kannifo a ɔwɔ mmrahyɛbagua no mu no de too gua sɛ aban no bekura abankɛse no ama MP no, ɔsɔretia no sii so dua sɛ wɔnyɛ abatow foforo mfa nsi n’ananmu.  Eyi kɔɔ so bɛboro asram du.  Ne mmabarima no mu baako, Augustine AkwasiAkwasi i ne papa ho ban wɔ April 2006.  Awiei koraa no, Amoateng de krataa a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɔregyae adwuma no kɔmaa mmrahyɛbagua no bɛyɛ May 2006 nanso wɔpoo eyi esiane nhyehyɛe nti.  mmrahyɛbagua no Kasafo, Ebenezer Sekyi-Hughes, hyɛɛ mmara wɔ 30 Ɔbɛnem 2007, sɛ wɔnsan nhwɛ asɛmmisa a ɛfa Amoateng a onni mmrahyɛbagua no mu bere tenten no ho.  Nanso, ɔde krataa a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɔregyae adwuma a wɔkyerɛw no 4 Ɔpɛpɔn 2007, kɔmaa Ghana mmrahyɛbagua no Kasafo a wɔgye toom.Awiei koraa no, wɔyɛɛ abatow foforo a wɔde besi Amoateng ananmu wɔ 13 March 2007, asram 16 wɔ ne kyere akyi.  Derek Oduro a ɔyɛ asraafo panyin a wakɔ pɛnhyen na ɔkaa ntam wɔ 21 March 2007.

nhwehwɛmu a ɛwɔ Ghana 
Ɛte sɛ nea nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛe wɔ Ghana mu sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ebia wobegye agyapade a wonya denam nnubɔne so no anyɛ yiye. Na Narcotic Controls Board (NACOB) ahunu Amoateng yɔnko, Nii Okai Adjei agyapadeɛ nanso wɔantumi anni Amoateng agyapadeɛ akyi ebia ɛnam NPP aban mpaninfoɔ de wɔn ho gyee mu nti.  NACOB kyerɛɛ sɛ wɔabɔ wɔn tirim sɛ wɔbɛsan abue nhwehwɛmu bere a Amoateng asan aba Ghana no.  Wɔkyeree no sɛ NACOB bisabisaa no nsɛm bere a ɔbaa Ghana wɔ 7 August 2014, wɔ Kotoka Amanaman Ntam Wimhyɛn Gyinabea .  Wɔde no too Nima Polisifo Dwumadibea nnanan kosii sɛ obetumi adi tebea horow a Accra Ɔmansin Asɛnnibea bi de sii hɔ sɛ ɔde ne ho bɛto afiase no ho dwuma.

Amoateng nso hyiaa asɛm sɛ okura akwantu ho nkrataa a ɛnyɛ nokware bere a ɔresan aba no. Ne Ghana akwantuo krataa a ne nɔma H2347080 a wɔde maeɛ wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2009 mu berɛ a na ɔda so da afiase no, ne deɛ Ghana atubrafoɔ mpaninfoɔ de maa ɔbaa bi no yɛ pɛ. Nanso, wobuu no bem efisɛ, ɛwom sɛ na aban mmaranimfo no gye di sɛ wɔde nnaadaa na enyaa akwantu tumi krataa no de, nanso Asɛnnibea Kunini no kae sɛ aban mmaranimfo no antumi ankyerɛ sɛ Amoateng nim sɛ wɔayɛ ne akwantu tumi krataa no atoro.  Wɔ afe 2017 mu, mfeɛ 12 akyi a wɔkyeree no ne mfeɛ mmiɛnsa akyi a wɔyii no firii afiase no, NACOB kaa sɛ wɔantumi annye n’agyapadeɛ ɛfiri sɛ wɔda so ara nni n’atemmuo no ho nsɛm a ɛfiri United States.

Nsɛm a ɛho nhia 

 Wɔ 13 Ɔpɛpɔn 2006 no, Nkoranza mantam baa dwumadibea guamtrani a ɔwɔ NPP no kamfoo atuhoamafo a wɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ Amoateng atoko afuw a ne kɛse yɛ hekta 300 no mu bere a na onni hɔ no. 
 Wɔ 24 March 2006 no, Busunyafoɔ yɛɛ nhyiamu bi de boaa no a NPP ananmusifoɔ kɔɔ bi. Nsɛm bi a wɔakyerɛw wɔ nhyiam no ase sɛ "Cocaine anaa Cocaine Biara Nni Amoateng Da so Yɛ Yɛn MP". 
 Wɔ Ayɛwohomumɔ 2007 mu no, Busunya mpanyimfo ne nnipa a wɔwɔ Nkoranza mantam mu no de Amoateng din too abɔnten bi din esiane "boa a ɔde maa mpɔtam hɔ asetra ne sikasɛm mu nkɔso nti". Wɔsan nso bɔ amanneɛ sɛ ɔboaa ma "wɔde sika tuaa mmɔnten awotwe ne nsuo a ɛkɔ nsuo mu wɔ kuro a ɛyɛ amansin no ahenkuro no mu".

Nsɛm a Wɔahyɛ no Nsow 

Ghana mmrahyɛbadwafoɔ 2005–2009

title: David Apasera
text:
David Asibi Ayindenaba Apasera yɛ Ghana amanyɔni. Na ɔyɛ ɔmampanyin a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ ɔmanpanyin wɔ People’s National Convention (PNC) mu wɔ afe 2020 Ghana amansan abatow no mu . Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbadwani ma Bolgatanga wɔ Upper East Region of Ghana wɔ afe 2001 ne 2009 ntam.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Apasera wɔ Ghana na ɔfaa ne mfitiaseɛ nwomasua wɔ ɔman no mu.

Adwuma 
pasera yɛ Ghana amanyɔni a ɔyɛ n’ankasa adwuma.

mmrahyɛbagua no mu abatow 
Apasera dii kan tuu mmirika kɔɔ abatoɔ mu wɔ afe 1996 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu baabi a ɔde People’s National Convention’s (PNC) tekiti sii akan wɔ Bolgatanga mansin no mu. Ɔdii nea ɛtɔ so mmienu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ bɛyɛ 21%.  Nanso ɔdii MP a ɔdi tumi seesei, Simon Abingya a ɔfiri National Democratic Congress (NDC) mu wɔ afe 2000 abatoɔ mu maa nkongua korɔ no ara sɛ ɔbɛyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ama Bolgatanga a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 50.9% na ɔnyaa dodoɔ 7,575.  Apasera kuraa n’akongua so wɔ afe 2004 amansan abatoɔ no mu, ɔdii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 38.6% nanso ɔnyaa abatoɔ dodoɔ no ara a wɔatew so 2,205.   Na ɔyɛ MP baanum a wofi PNC ne CPP a ɔne MP a ɔde ne ho a ɔne NPP yɛɛ apam wɔ mmrahyɛbagua mu wɔ afe 2005 mu no mu biako.  Wɔ afe 2008 amansan abatoɔ mu no, ɔdii nea ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa, ɔdii Emmanuel Akolbire a ɔfiri NDC ne Mercy Alima Musah a ɔfiri New Patriotic Party (NPP) akyi a ɔnyaa abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 20.1%. Eyi maa ne bere a ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbadwani ma Bolgatanga no baa awiei wɔ Fourth Republic mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so anan no mu wɔ 6 Ɔbɛnem 2009.

Ansa na afe 2012 abatoɔ no reba, wɔsan hyehyɛɛ Bolgatanga mantam no yɛɛ no Bolgatanga Mfinimfini ne Bolgatanga Apueeɛ mantam. Apasera dii Rockson Akugre so nkonim wɔ abatow 100 mu maa 83 maa PNC a wɔayi no sɛ ɔnkɔsi akan wɔ Bolgatanga Apuei fam agua no ho.  Nanso wantumi anni nkonim, na ɔdii nea ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 13.1%.  Apasera sii akan wɔ PNC primaries mu maa Bolgatanga East nkongua no ansa na afe 2016 abatoɔ no reba . Akasakasa bi sii ɔne Bernard Mornah a na ɔyɛ PNC guamtrani saa bere no ntam. Ɔbɔɔ Mornah sobo sɛ wapopa ne din afi din a kuw no de kɔmaa Ghana Abatow Bagua no mu .   Awiei koraa no, wantumi ankɔ abatow adaka no so.

Ɔmampanyin a wɔpaw no 
Nanso afe 2020 mu no, ɔtumi nyaa amanyɔkuo no din sɛ wɔbɛsi akan wɔ afe 2020 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu sɛ wɔn ɔmampanyin. Nea ɔne no retu mmirika no ne Divine Ayivor.   Ɔyɛ nnipa dumien a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔpaw wɔn wɔ abatow no mu no mu biako.

Forum for Kan mmrahyɛbaguafo 
Ná David Apasera yɛ Forum for Former mmrahyɛbaguafo no kannifo. Ɔhwehwɛɛ pɛnhyen nhyehyɛe bi ne akatua afoforo a wɔde bɛma kan mmrahyɛbagua no mufo denneennen.  Ɔko maa pɛnhyen hokwan ahorow no kosii Ghana Asɛnnibea Kunini no nyinaa . Justice Gbadegbe, wɔ ne valedictory atemmu mu no ɔkae sɛ ɛne ɔman mmara nhyia Chinery Hesse amanneɛbɔ a ɛkamfo pɛnhyen sika a na ɛyɛ nea ogyinaa so yɛɛ n’asɛyɛde no.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Apasera yɛ Kristoni. Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baanan.

Hwɛ nso 

 Bolgatanga mantam mu
 Nnipa Ɔman Nhyiam

title: Kwabena Appiah-Pinkrah
text:
Kwabena Appiah-Pinkrah (wɔwoo no Ɔbɛnem 23, 1947)  yɛ ɔfotufoɔ  ne Ghana amanyɔni wɔ Republic of Ghana. Ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni a ɔgyina Akrofoum mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan,5,6 ne 7 mu.   Ɔyɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Appiah-Pinkrah Ɔberɛfɛw da 23, afe 1947.   Ɔfiri Akrofoum, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana .   Ɔyɛ Fairleigh Dickson Sukuupɔn a ɛwɔ United States of America no ade.   Ɔwɔ Master of Arts wɔ Amanaman Ntam Adesua mu wɔ sukuupɔn no mu.   Onyaa abodin krataa (abodin krataa a ɛkorɔn) wɔ Bremen Sukuupɔn mu West Germany.

Adwuma 
Appiah-Pinkrah yɛ adwumayɛfoɔ ne nkɔsoɔ ho ɔfotufoɔ.  Ɔyɛ Global Linkages Company Limited a ɛwɔ Accra no panyin.

Amammui mu adwuma 
Appiah-Pinkrah yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni . Ɔbɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbagua muni fi Ɔpɛpɔn 2005 bere a ɔdaa ne ho adi sɛ nkonimdifo wɔ Amansan Abatow mu wɔ December 2004. Efi saa bere no, wadi tumi mpɛn anan a ɛtoatoa so.  Ɔyɛ MP a ɔhwɛ Akrofoum mantam so. Wɔapaw no sɛ mmrahyɛbagua muni ama saa mantam yi wɔ Republic of Ghana a ɛto so anan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so anan, anum, asia ne ason no mu.  Na ɔyɛ Mpɔtam Aban ne Nkuraase Nkɔsoɔ Boayikuo ne Aban Awerɛhyɛmu Boayikuo no muni wɔ 7th Parliament a ɛwɔ 4th Republic of Ghana.

Abatow a wɔyɛ 
Wɔpaw Appiah-Pinkrah sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani ama Akrofoum mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana nea edi kan wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow no mu. Odii nkonim wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so. Na ne mansin no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 36 no fa wɔ nkongua 39 a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Ashanti Mantam no mu.  New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 128 wɔ nkongua 230 mu.  Wɔde abatoɔ 10,808 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 15,645 a ɛne abatoɔ a ɛfata nyinaa mu 70.4% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Joseph K. Abim a ɔwɔ National Democratic Congress no mu . Ɔnyaa abatoɔ a ɛfata nyinaa mu 29.6%.

Wɔ afe 2008 mu no, odii nkonim wɔ amansan abatow no mu wɔ New Patriotic Party tekiti so maa ɔmansin koro no ara. Ná ne mansin no ka mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 34 a ɛwɔ nkongua 39 a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Ashanti Mantam no mu no ho.  New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 109 wɔ nkongua 230 mu.  Wɔde abatoɔ 8,976 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 14,606 a ɛne abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 61.45% yɛ pɛ.  Wɔpaw no sen Opoku Ampofo Manu a ofi National Democratic Congress, Anthony Kwakye Ameyaw a ofi Convention People’s Party ne Boniface Nickson a ɔyɛ obi a ɔde ne ho. Eyinom nyaa abatow a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 32.38%, 4.92% ne 1.24%.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Appiah-Pinkrah yɛ Kristoni.   Ɔne Methodist Asɔre no yɛ fekubɔ .  Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baanan.

Hwɛ nso 

 MP a wɔpaw wɔn wɔ afe 2004 Ghana mmrahyɛbagua abatow mu din
 MP a wɔpaw wɔn wɔ afe 2008 Ghana mmrahyɛbagua abatow mu din
 MP a wɔpaw wɔn wɔ afe 2012 Ghana mmrahyɛbagua abatow mu din
 MP a wɔpaw wɔn wɔ afe 2016 Ghana mmrahyɛbagua abatow mu no din

title: James Appietu-Ankrah
text:
James Appietu-Ankrah (wɔwoo no 6 Ɔpɛpɔn 1948) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni na ɔyɛ Fourth Parliament of the Fourth Republic no muni a ɔgyina Lower West Akim Constituency ananmu wɔ Ghana Apueeɛ Mantam mu.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Ankrah wɔ 6 July 1948 wɔ Akim kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Apuei Fam mantam mu . Ɔnyaa ne ntoaso sukuu adesua wɔ Alisadel College .  Ɔde ne din kɔhyɛɛ Cambridge Tutors College na onyaa Diploma wɔ aguadi mu.

Adwuma 
Ankrah yɛ insurance broker na ɔwɔ SIC Insurance Company Limited board mu sɛ Independent a ɔnyɛ adwumayɛfoɔ kwankyerɛfoɔ firi afe 2017.  Ɔyɛ kan mmrahyɛbadwani ma Lower West Akim mantam no firi afe 2005 kɔsi afe 2009.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔdii kan paw Ankrah sɛ ɔmmra mmrahyɛbagua mu wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so wɔ December 2004 Ghana amansan abatoɔ a wɔreyɛ ama Lower West Akim Constituency a ɛwɔ Ghana Apueeɛ Mantam mu no berɛ a ɔdii nkonim wɔ Party no Primary Election mu akyi.  Ɔnyaa abatoɔ 22,239 wɔ abatoɔ 38,198 a ɛfata a wɔtoo no mu a egyina hɔ ma 58.20%.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ankrah yɛ Kristoni.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: George Kofi Arthur
text:
George Kofi Arthur (wɔwoo no 24 Ɔpɛpɔn 1969) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni. Na ɔyɛ Fourth Republic mmrahyɛbagua a Ɛto so Nsia a egyina Amenfi Central Constituency ananmu wɔ Ghana Atɔe Fam mantam mu no muni .

Ankorankoro asetra 
Arthur yɛ sigyani. Ɔda ne ho adi sɛ ɔyɛ Kristoni.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Arthur wɔ 24 Ɔpɛpɔn 1969 wɔ Agona Amenfi wɔ Atɔeɛ mantam mu . Ɔkɔɔ University of Education, Winneba baabi a onyaa Bachelor of Education abodin krataa wɔ Technology mu. Ɔsan nso kɔɔ Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration baabi a ɔnyaa EMGL wɔ afe 2008.

Adwumafa 
Arthur yɛ nhomasua ho ɔbenfo . Ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ Mynd FM a ɛwɔ Kumasi no kwankyerɛfo panyin . Afe 2005 mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ Ghana mmrahyɛbaguani .

Amanyɔsɛm 
Arthur yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua no muni .   Wɔ afe 2004 mu no, ɔsii akan sɛ ɔbɛdi Amenfi Central Constituency atenaeɛ wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu na ɔdii nkonim. Ɔnyaa abatoɔ 14,139 a ɛyɛ 48.10% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu na ɛno nti ɔdii akansifoɔ afoforɔ a Peter Yaw Kwakye-Ackah ne James Boateng ka ho no so nkonim.  Wɔsan paw no wɔ afe 2008 Ghana amansan abatoɔ ne afe 2012 Ghana amansan abatoɔ a ɛmaa no hokwan sɛ ɔgyina ne mansin ananmu wɔ afe a ɛtɔ so mmienu ne mmiɛnsa.

2004 Abatow a Wɔyɛe 
Wɔpaw Arthur wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow no mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so .  Enti ɔgyinaa Amenfi Central Constituency ananmu wɔ Ghana republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu firi 7 Ɔbɛnem 2005 kɔsi 6 Ɔbɛnem 2009. Wɔpaw no sen Pater Yaw Kwakye-Ackah a ofi Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no mu ne James Boateng a ofi Convention People’s Party mu . Eyinom nyaa abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 47.7% ne 4.2%.

2008 Abatow no 
Wɔsan paw Arthur wɔ afe 2008 Ghana amansan abatow no mu .  Ɔnam saa kwan yi so san gyinaa Amenfi Central Constituency ananmu wɔ Ghana republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 5 no mu firi 7 Ɔbɛnem 2009 kɔsi 6 Ɔbɛnem 2013. Wɔde abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoo no nyinaa mu 39.31% na ɛpaw no. Wɔpaw no wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so. Wɔpaw no sen Padmore Kofi Yonkopa Arthur a ofi New Patriotic Party, James Boateng a ofi Convention People's party ne Peter Yaw Kwakye Ackah a ɔyɛ independent candidate,. Eyinom nyaa abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 33.2 5, 0.7% ne 26.7%.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so 

Ghana mmrahyɛbadwafoɔ 2005–2009

title: David Tetteh Assumeng
text:
David Tetteh Assumeng yɛ Ghana amanyɔni. Ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbadwani ma Shai Osudoku Mansin firi 7 Ɔbɛnem 2005 kɔsi 6 Ɔbɛnem 2017.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Assumeng wɔ 10 Ɔpɛpɔn 1961. Ɔfiri Osudoku a ɛwɔ Greater Accra Mantam mu wɔ Ghana . Ɔnyaa ne Diploma wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu wɔ afe 2004 mu na ɔnyaa ne Masters wɔ Aban ne Akannifoɔ mu (EMGL) wɔ Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration (GIMPA) wɔ afe 2008.

Adwuma 
Ansa na ɔrekɔ amammuisɛm mu no, na Assumeng yɛ Ɔman Mmabun Bagua a ɛwɔ Ada West District no Mmabun Ntamgyinafo .

Amanyɔsɛm 
Assumeng kɔɔ mmrahyɛbagua no mu wɔ 7 Ɔbɛnem 2005 wɔ National Democratic Congress a egyina Shai Osudoku Mansin ananmu no tekiti so . Ɔdii nkoguo wɔ NDC primaries mu wɔ afe 2015 mu na ɛno nti wantumi ansi akan wɔ atenaeɛ no ho wɔ afe 2016 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu .  N'ahennie wɔ mmrahyɛbagua mu no baa awieeɛ wɔ 6 Ɔbɛnem 2017.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Assumeng aware a ɔwɔ abofra. Ɔkyerɛ sɛ ɔyɛ Kristoni na ɔyɛ Presbyterian Asɔre a ɛwɔ Ghana no muni .

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Alexander Asum-Ahensaha
text:
Alexander Asum-Ahensah (wɔwoo no 23 Ɔpɛpɔn 1953) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne nwomasua ho nimdefoɔ. Ɔyɛ kan mmrahyɛbaguani ma Jaman North wɔ Brong Ahafo Mantam mu wɔ Ghana .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Asum-Ahensah wɔ 23 Ɔpɛpɔn 1953.  Ne kurom ne Goka a ɛwɔ Brong Ahafo mantam mu wɔ Ghana.  Wɔ 1989 mu no, onyaa Nhomasua mu Diploma wɔ Accra Mfiridwuma Ho Nteteebea .  Wɔ 1997 mu no owiee sukuu no nyaa Nhomasua mu Bachelor of Education wɔ Cape Coast Sukuupɔn mu .  Ɔnyaa Executive Masters wɔ Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration .

Adwuma 
Asum-Ahensah yɛ nhomasua ho ɔbenfo.  Ɔne Ghana Nhomasua Dwumadibea ayɛ adwuma sɛ ɔkwankyerɛfo boafo a ɔhwɛ Ɔhwɛ so ma Jaman Atifi Mantam no.   Bere a ɔde ne ho hyɛɛ amammuisɛm mu akyi no, wɔpaw no sɛ Ɔmanpanyin ne Amammerɛ ho Ɔsoafo wɔ National Democratic Congress aban a Ɔmampanyin John Atta Mills di anim no mu .

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔpaw Asum Ahensah sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani nea edi kan wɔ afe 2004 Ghana Amansan abatow no mu.  Wɔpaw no sɛ ɔmmɛgyina Jaman North mantam no ananmu wɔ bere a wɔhyehyɛɛ no foforo wɔ Ghana republic a ɛto so 4 no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 4 no mu akyi.   Wɔpaw no wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so. Na ne mansin no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 10 no fa wɔ nkongua 24 a National Democratic Congress dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Brong Ahafo mantam no mu.  National Democratic Congress no dii nkonim kakraa bi a ne nyinaa yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 94 wɔ nkongua 230 a ɛwɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 4 a ɛwɔ ɔman a ɛto so 4 no mu no mu.  Wɔde abatoɔ 12,027 na ɛpaw Asum Ahensah wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 22,888 a ɛne abatoɔ a ɛfata nyinaa mu 52.50% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Kofi Oti Adinkrah a ofi New Patriotic Party, Twene Aduasare Kwasi a ofi Convention People’s Party ne M. Abdulai Freeman a ofi Democratic People’s Party mu. Eyinom nyaa abatow a wɔtowee nyinaa mu 45.50%, 1.90% ne 0.00%.

Wɔsan paw Asum-Ahensah sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani muni wɔ Jaman North mantam mu wɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 5 ma Ghana man a ɛto so 4 no mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so .  Wɔde abatoɔ a ɛfata 24,166 a wɔtowee nyinaa mu 13,359 na ɛpaw no, a ɛne abatoɔ a ɛfata nyinaa mu 55.28% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Siaka Stevens a ofi Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no mu, Otteng Atta Dickson a ofi Ɔmanfo Ɔman Nhyiam no mu ne Nyuah Abraham Justice a ofi Nhyiam no mu Ɔmanfo Kuw no mu . Eyinom nyaa abatow a ɛfata nyinaa mu 42.94%, 1.04% ne 0.74%.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Asum-Ahensah aware na ɔwɔ mma baanum.1  Ɔyɛ Kristoni na ɔne Pentekoste Asɔre no som .

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Samuel Nii-Aryeetey Attoh
text:
Samuel Nii-Aryeetey Attoh yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne mfiridwuma ho ɔpanin. Ɔyɛɛ mmrahyɛbadwani maa Trobu-Amasaman mantam.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Samuel Nii-Aryeetey Attoh wɔ 26 Ɔbɛnem afe 1956. Na ɔyɛ Ghana Suapɔn no mu ade.  Ɔnyaa Diploma wɔ Nhomasua mu wɔ sukuupɔn no mu.

Adwuma 
Na Attoh yɛ mfiridwuma ho ɔpanyin wɔ n’adwuma mu.

Amammui mu adwuma 
Ná Attoh yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni . Ɔbɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbadwani firi Ɔpɛpɔn 2005 berɛ a ɔdaa ne ho adi sɛ ɔdii nkonim wɔ Amansan Abatoɔ mu wɔ December 2004.  Na ɔyɛ MP a ɔhwɛ Trobu-Amasaman mantam so.

Abatow a wɔyɛ 
Wɔ afe 2004 mu no, ɔsii akan wɔ Trobu-Amasaman mmrahyɛbagua no mu. Odii nkonim wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so. Ná ne mansin no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 16 no fa wɔ nkongua 27 a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Greater Accra Mantam no mu . New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 128 wɔ nkongua 230 mu.  Wɔde abatow 31,459 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 69,090 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 45.5% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Daniel Addoquaye Pappoe a ofi Nnipa Ɔman Nhyiam no mu, Ernest Attuquaye Armah a ofi Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua no mu, Foli Emmanuel Wonder Kwadzo a ofi Nhyiam no mu Nnipa Kuw no mu ne Lawrence Kessy a ɔyɛ ɔkannifo a ɔde ne ho. Eyinom nyaa abatow 1,044, 31,017, 4,013 ne 1,557 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne 1.5%,44,9%, 5.8% ne 2.3% yɛ pɛ wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ná Attoh yɛ Kristoni.

Owuo 
Attoh wui wɔ 6 Ɔpɛpɔn 2017.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Mark Anthony Awuni
text:
Mark Anthony Awuni yɛ Ghana amanyɔni a ɔfiri Ghana . Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbagua ni a ogyinaa Binduri mantam a ɛwɔ Upper East Region of Ghana ananmu wɔ 4th Parliament a ɛwɔ 4th Republic of Ghana no mu. Ɔyɛ Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua no muni .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Awuni wɔ Oforisuo da 12, afe 1950. Ɔyɛ Claver House Institute adeyɛ. Ɔwɔ Diploma wɔ Nhomasua mu wɔ asoɛe no mu.

Adwuma 
Awuni yɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo wɔ n’adwuma mu.

Amammui mu adwuma 
Awuni yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi Bagua no muni . Ɔbɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbagua muni fi Ɔpɛpɔn 2005 bere a ɔdaa ne ho adi sɛ nkonimdifo wɔ Amansan Abatow mu wɔ December 2004.  Wɔpaw no sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani maa Binduri mantam no wɔ Ghana Republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu.

Abatow a wɔyɛWɔpaw Awuni sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani maa Binduri mantam a ɛwɔ Upper East Region of Ghana nea edi kan wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow no mu.  Odii nkonim wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so .  Na ne mansin no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 9 no fa wɔ nkongua 13 a National Democratic Congress dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Upper East Region no mu.  National Democratic Congress no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 94 a ɛyɛ kakraa bi wɔ nkongua 230 mu.  Wɔde abatow 9,797 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 19,939 mu.  Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 49.1% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Yakubu Stephen a ofi New Patriotic Party, Barichie Tilata Yakubu a ofi Convention People’s Party ne Aboyella Charles a ɔyɛ obi a ɔde ne ho.  Eyinom nyaa abatow 6,216, 199 ne 3727 wɔ abatow a wɔtow nyinaa mu.   Eyinom ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 31.2%, 1.0% ne 18.7% yɛ pɛ.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Awuni yɛ Kristoni.

Hwɛ nso 
MP a wɔpaw wɔn wɔ afe 2004 Ghana mmrahyɛbagua abatow mu din

title: Mahama Ayariga
text:
Mahama Ayariga (wɔwoo no 12 May 1974) yɛ mmaranimfo ne amanyɔni wɔ Ghana . Ɔyɛ Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua no muni . Na ɔyɛ Amanneɛbɔ ne Nsɛm ho Amanneɛbɔ ho Ɔsoafo ne Mmabun ne Agumadi ho Ɔsoafo wɔ John Dramani Mahama nniso ase. Mprempren ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni a ogyina Bawku Central constituency ananmu wɔ Upper East Region of Ghana wɔ 4th,6th ne 7th Parliament a ɛwɔ 4th Republic of Ghana no mu.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Mahama Ayariga wɔ 12 May 1974 wɔ Bawku wɔ Upper East Region wɔ Ghana.  Ɔsuaa adeɛ wɔ Ghana ne Nigeria ne United States of America . Ɔkɔɔ Barewa Kɔlege a ɛwɔ Zaria wɔ Kaduna Mantam mu, Nigeria. Ɔwɔ Master of Law (LLM) abodin krataa wɔ Harvard Law School a ɛwɔ United States of America ne Bachelor of Law (LLB) Abodin krataa wɔ University of Ghana, Legon.  Ná ɔyɛ Legal Resource Center a ɛwɔ Accra no kwankyerɛfo panyin.

Ayariga nua panin Ayariga Hassan na na ɔyɛ ɔmanpanyin wɔ People’s National Convention (Ghana) mu wɔ afe 2012 Amansan Abatoɔ a ɛbɛba wɔ Ghana no mu.

Adwuma 
Ayariga yɛ mmaranimfo wɔ n’adwuma mu. Ɔhyɛɛ n’adwuma ase sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ boafoɔ wɔ abɔdeɛ mu nneɛma ho mmara ne amanaman ntam mmara mu wɔ Faculty of Law, University of Ghana. Ɔsan nso kaa ho na ɔhyehyɛɛ Legal Resources Centre, ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛhyɛ nnipa hokwan, mpɔtam nkɔsoɔ ne asetena mu atɛntrenee ho nkuran na na ɔyɛ ne kwankyerɛfoɔ panin.

Amammui mu adwuma

mmrahyɛbaguani 
Ayariga yɛ Ghana mmrahyɛbaguani ma Bawku Central mantam firi afe 2005 nanso ɔhwere n’akongua wɔ afe 2008 Abatoɔ no mu maa Adamu Dramani Sakande a ɔfiri NPP mu. Akongua no bɛyɛɛ obiara bere a asɛnnibea bi buu Adamu fɔ na ɔde no too afiase sɛ ogyinaa abatow no akyi bere a na ɔyɛ ɔman foforo ba a ɛne Ghana amansan mmara nhyia no.  Ayariga san gyee atenaeɛ no wɔ afe 2012 Amansan Abatoɔ no mu .  Wɔapaw no sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani ma saa mantam yi wɔ Republic of Ghana a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan, nsia ne ason no mu.

Ɔman soafo a ɔhwɛ ɔman so 
Wɔ afe 2009 mu bere a Ɔbenfo John Evans Atta Mills dii nkonim wɔ abatow no mu no, Ayariga bɛyɛɛ Ɔmampanyin no kasamafo ansa na akyiri yi wɔrepaw no sɛ Ɔmanpanyin Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Aguadi ne Nnwuma so. Akyiri yi wɔpaw no sɛ Nhomasua soafo Abadiakyiri.   Mahama Ayariga, Ɔmanpanyin John Dramani Mahama na ɔpaw no sɛ Ɔmanpanyin John Dramani Mahama na ɔpaw no sɛ Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ Amanneɛbɔ so wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2013.  Mahama Ayariga som wɔ Appointments Committee a ɛwɔ Ghana 7th Parliament of the 4th Republic no mu.

Abatow a wɔyɛ 
Wɔpaw Ayariga sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani mma Bawku mantam a ɛwɔ Upper East Region of Ghana wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow no mu.  Odii nkonim wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.   Na ne mansin no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 9 no fa wɔ nkongua 13 a National Democratic Congress dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Upper East Region no mu.  National Democratic Congress no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 94 a ɛyɛ kakraa bi wɔ nkongua 230 mu.  Wɔde abatow 18,518 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 38,108 mu.  Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 48.6% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Amidu Mamudu Sisala a ofi Peoples’ National Convention, Hawa Yakubu a ofi New Patriotic Party, Yussif Taiban Kundima a ofi Convention People’s Party, Sadat Amadu ne Abubakar Jibreel Ustarz a wɔn baanu nyinaa yɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho. Eyinom nyaa abatow 333, 10,169, 353, 161 ne 8,574 wɔ abatow a wɔtow nyinaa mu.  Eyinom ne 0.9%, 26.7%, 0.9%, 0.4% ne 22.5% yɛ pɛ wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu.

Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, wɔpaw no sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani wɔ saa amansin koro no ara mu. Odii nkonim wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so . Wɔde abatow 24,071 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 43,876 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 54.86% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Awuni Aguuda Joseph a ofi Peoples' National Convention, Alhassan Haruna a ofi New Patriotic Party, Iddrisu Mubarak a ofi Progressive People's Party ne Ibrahim Zaliya a ofi Convention People's Party . Eyinom nyaa abatow 303, 19,082, 269 ne 151 wɔ abatow a wɔtow nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne 0.69%, 43.49%, 0.61% ne 0.34% yɛ pɛ wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu.

Akyinnyegye 
Ɔbɔɔ Hon. Boakye Agyarko a wɔayi no sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ Energy Ministry sɛ ɔbɛtua minority caucus a wɔwɔ committee no mu no adanmudeɛ ama wɔapene so.  Ɔkasafoɔ no hyehyɛɛ AD-HOC boayikuo bi a ɔhwehwɛɛ mu na ɔde n’amanneɛbɔ kɔmaa mmrahyɛbagua no wɔ Oforisuo 29, 2017. Amanneɛbɔ no kyerɛ sɛ Mahama Ayariga antumi ankyerɛ sɛ ne sobo a ɔde bɔɔ Owura Agyarko no nyɛ nokware ma enti ɛsɛ sɛ ɔpa fie no kyɛw a biribiara nhyɛ mu.   Wɔ afe 2019 mu no, akyinnyegyeɛ aba sɛ ɔrehyia asɛnnibea asɛnnie sɛdeɛ wɔsusu sɛ wayɛ bɔne bi sɛ wɔde no bɛkɔ asɛnnibea wɔ Asɛnnibea Kunini no mu ɛwom sɛ wɔasɔre tia bi deɛ, mmrahyɛbagua no Kasafoɔ, Prof. Aaron Michael Oquaye wɔ June 4, 2019, sii gyinaeɛ sɛ, wɔbɛgyae mmrahyɛbaguani a ɔhwɛ Bawku Central so, Mahama Ayariga, sɛ ɔnkɔdi n’asɛm wɔ Asɛnnibea Kunini (Sikasɛm Asɛnnibea) na wɔamfi ase nkɔdi asɛm a ɛhia tia no.  Wɔ June 2020 mu no, mmrahyɛbagua no Kasafo no ampene Mahama Ayariga a ɔkasa tiaa Abatoɔ Bagua no gyinaesie sɛ wɔde Ghana kaad ne akwantuo tumi krataa no bɛyɛ adansedie krataa nko ara a ɛfata a wɔde bɛkyerɛw wɔn din akɔto aba wɔ afe 2020 abatoɔ no mu.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ayariga yɛ ɔwarefo.  Ɔyɛ Nkramoni.  Ne papa, Frank Abdulai Ayariga, nso yɛɛ mmrahyɛbadwani maa Bawku Mantam no wɔ Hilla Limann ɔman nniso a ɛto so abiɛsa no mu.

Hwɛ nso 

 Frank Abdulai Ayariga na ɔkyerɛwee
 Hassan Ayariga na ɔkyerɛwee

title: Juliana Azumah-Mensah
text:
Juliana Jocelyn Azumah-Mensah (wɔwoo no 15 June 1950) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne ɔyarehwɛfoɔ . Ná ɔyɛ Ɔsoafo a ɔhwɛ Mmea ne Mmofra Nsɛm So . Ɔsan yɛ mmrahyɛbagua ni a ɔhwɛ Ho Apuei amansin so .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Juliana Azumah-Mensah wɔ Koforidua, Ghana Apuei Fam Mantam ahenkurow mu. Wɔ 1956 ne 1964 ntam no, ɔkɔɔ Roma Katolek Mfitiase ne Mpɔtam Hɔ Mfinimfini Sukuu a ɛwɔ Agortime-Kpetoe wɔ Volta Mantam mu no . Ɔnyaa ne ntoaso sukuu wɔ OLA Girls Senior High School (Ho) wɔ Ho, Volta Mantam no ahenkuro, faako a ɔnyaa GCE Ordinary Level wɔ 1969 mu.

Ɔkɔɔ United Kingdom faako a ɔtetee ne ho wɔ Ipswich East Anglia School of Nursing wɔ Ipswich, Suffolk . Ɔfatae wɔ August 1973 mu sɛ Ɔman no Ayarehwɛfo a Wɔakyerɛw Wɔn Din . Afe biako akyi no, ɔtetee ne ho wɔ Awogye ho wɔ Saint Peter Ayaresabea a ɛwɔ Chertsey wɔ Surrey, na owiee sukuu wɔ August 1975 mu sɛ Ɔman Awogyefo a Wɔagye Din .

Ɔde ne din kɔhyɛɛ Birmingham Sukuupɔn mu kɔyɛɛ adesua akyi adesua, na ɛmaa onyaa MSc wɔ Akwahosan Ho Nsɛm ne Adwumayɛ mu wɔ October 1997.

Adwuma 
Azumah-Mensah fii ase yɛɛ adwuma sɛ ɔkyerɛwfo panyin wɔ Ministry of Finance and Economic Planning wɔ afe 1969 mu. Ofii hɔ kɔyɛɛ adesua foforo wɔ UK wɔ afe biako akyi. Afei ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ ɔyarehwɛfo ne awogyefo wɔ ayaresabea ahorow mu wɔ UK .

Otu kɔɔ Saudi Arabia, faako a ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ King Abdulaziz Sukuupɔn Ayaresabea wɔ 1978 ne 1984 ntam hɔ. Ɔsan kɔɔ UK, na ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ Mayday Sukuupɔn Ayaresabea wɔ afe 1984 ne 1987 ntam hɔ

Ɔsan baa Ghana wɔ afe 1988 mu na ɔyɛɛ adwuma mfeɛ mmienu sɛ Principal Nurse wɔ Ho Diocese. Wɔ afe 2001 ne 2005 ntam no, ɔne Katolekfo Akwahosan Dwumadibea yɛɛ adwuma. Na ɔde no akɔtena Ho, faako a ɔsom sɛ Ɔkyerɛwfo Panyin/Akwahosan Dwumadibea sohwɛfo wɔ Ho Asɔre no mu ne Ɔmantam no sohwɛfo a ɔhwɛ nkitahodi so.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔdii kan paw Juliana Azumah-Mensah sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani maa Ho Apueeɛ Mantam no wɔ National Democratic Congress (NDC) tekiti so wɔ afe 2004 mmrahyɛbagua abatoɔ mu  na ɔdii n’akongua wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2005 . Ɔkɔɔ so kuraa n'akongua so wɔ afe 2008 abatow no mu .

Ɔmanpanyin John Atta Mills na odii kan paw no sɛ Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ nsrahwɛ so wɔ afe 2009.  Wɔde no kɔɔ Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ Mmea ne Mmofra Nsɛm so wɔ Ɔbɛnem 2010, kɔsii afe 2012.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baanu. Ɔfiri Agortime-Kpetoe a ɛwɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

Hwɛ nso 

 Mills aban asomfo din a wɔahyehyɛ
 Ho East (Ghana mmrahyɛbagua no mantam) .

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Benjamin Kofi Ayeh
text:
Benjamin Kofi Ayeh (wɔwoo no 16 Ɔbɛnem 1962)  yɛ aguadifoɔ, Ghana amanyɔni ne akontabufoɔ.  Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbadwani ma mmrahyɛbagua a Ɛto so Nsia a ɛwɔ Ghana Mantam a Ɛto so Anan ne mmrahyɛbagua a Ɛto so Anan a ɛwɔ Ghana Mantam a Ɛto so Anan no mu . Ɔgyinaa Upper Denkyira West ananmu wɔ Central mantam mu wɔ Ghana .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Benjamin Kofi Ayeh wɔ 16 Ɔbɛnem 1962  wɔ Ayanfuri wɔ Central mantam mu .  Ɔnyaa ne Charted Accountant (Ghana) Intermediate wɔ afe 1986 mu na ɔnyaa ne EMGL wɔ afe 2008 mu wɔ Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration .  Ɔsan yɛ akontaabufo a ɔfata a wɔagye no atom .

Adwuma 
Benjamin Kofi Ayeh ne Fambenycold Limited, Accra yɛɛ adwuma sɛ adwumayɛfoɔ panin (CEO).  Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma Upper Denkyire West Constituency wɔ Central Region of Ghana wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so maa Ghana republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan wɔ 2004 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu Ɔyɛ aguadifo, akontaabufo ne amanyɔni.  Ná ɔyɛ obi a na anka ɔyɛ nnipa kakraa bi mpire panyin abadiakyiri nso.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ná Benjamin Ayeh yɛ obi a na anka ɔyɛ nnipa kakraa bi mpire panyin abadiakyiri  na na ɔyɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni .    Wɔ afe 2004 mu no, ɔsii akan wɔ Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti ase na ɔdii nkonim wɔ Upper Denkyira West mantam mu mmrahyɛbadwani, maa mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan wɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu

2004 Abatow a Wɔyɛe 
Wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu no, Ayeh nyaa abatoɔ 12,177 wɔ abatoɔ 18,017 a ɛfata a wɔtoo no nyinaa mu. Eyi gyina hɔ ma abatow a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 67.6%. Wɔpaw no sen Oduro-Bonsu Kwaku a ofi National Democratic Congress ne Thomas Maxwell Aidoo a ofi Convention People’s Party mu . Eyinom nyaa abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 30.2% ne 2.2%.  Na Ayeh mantam no yɛ amansin 16 a New Patriotic Party dii nkonim wɔ Central mantam mu wɔ saa abatow no mu no fa.  Sɛ yɛka ne nyinaa bom a, New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 128 wɔ Ghana republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu.

2008 Abatow no 
Wɔsan paw Ayeh sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani wɔ afe 2008 Ghana amansan abatow a wɔyɛ maa Upper Denkyira West mantam no mu.  Ɔnam saayɛ so gyinaa amansin no ananmu wɔ Ghana republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 5 no mu. Wɔde abatow 9,339 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 18,183 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 51.36% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Yankey M. Ackah a ofi National Democratic Congress, George Mensah a ofi Democratic Freedom Party ne Dr. Thomas Maxwell Aidoo a ofi Convention People’s Party mu. Eyinom nyaa abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 38.45%, 0.46% ne 9.73%. Wɔsan paw Ayeh wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so.  Na ne mansin no yɛ amansin 8 a New Patriotic Party dii nkonim wɔ Central mantam mu wɔ saa abatow no mu no fa.  Sɛ yɛka ne nyinaa bom a, New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 107 wɔ Ghana republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 5 no mu.

2012 Abatoɔ 
Ɔsii akan wɔ afe 2012 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu na wɔsan paw no sɛ ɔnsom ne berɛ a ɛtɔ so mmienu sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani mma mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nsia wɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu ama Upper Denkyira West mantam.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Benjamin Kofi Ayeh yɛ ɔwarefoɔ.  Ɔyɛ Kristoni na ɔyɛ fekubɔ wɔ Yesu Kristo Asɔre a ɛwɔ Nna a Ɛdi Akyire Ahotefoɔ mu .

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so 

Ghana mmrahyɛbadwafoɔ 2005–2009

title: Moses Dani Baah
text:
Moses Dani Baah yɛ Ghana amanyɔni na na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma Sissala Apueeɛ mantam a ɛwɔ Upper West Region wɔ Ghana. Ná ɔyɛ Nnipa Ɔman Nhyiam no muni.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Baah wɔ July, 1951 mu. Ɔkɔɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ nyansahu ne mfiridwuma so (KNUST). Ɔnyaa Diploma wɔ Civil Engineering mu wɔ KNUST.

Adwuma 
Baah yɛ Site Engineer wɔ n’adwuma mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔpaw Baah sɛ mmrahyɛbagua muni maa Sissala Apuei mantam, a kan no na ɛyɛ Sissala mantam a ɛwɔ Upper West mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔgyinaa amansin no ananmu wɔ Ghana republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu .

2000 Abatow a Wɔyɛe 
Wɔpaw Baah sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani mma mantam a ɛwɔ Upper West mantam mu wɔ Ghana wɔ afe 2000 Ghana amansan abatow mu. Enti ɔgyinaa amansin no ananmu wɔ Ghana republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu.  Wɔde abatow 16,009 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a wɔtow nyinaa mu.

Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 55.40% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Amidu Sulemana a ofi National Democratic Congress Party, Lamini M. Dawudu a ofi New Patriotic Party ne Issah Musah a ofi United Ghana Movement.

Eyinom nyaa abatow 12,046, abatow 632 ne abatow 219 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu.  Eyinom ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 41.70%, 2.20% ne 0.80% yɛ pɛ.  Wɔde Peoples National Convention no tekiti na ɛpaw Baah.

Wɔpaw Baah sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani maa Sissala Apuei mantam no wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow mu. Ɔno, enti, ɔgyinaa amansin no ananmu wɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu firi 7 Ɔbɛnem 2005 kɔsi 6 Ɔbɛnem 2009.

Wɔde abatow 14,186 paw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 19,129 mu. Wɔpaw no sen Alhassan Dubie Halutie a ɔwɔ National Democratic Congress no mu. Wɔde Nnipa Ɔman Nhyiam no tekiti na ɛpaw Baah.

Na ne mansin no yɛ amansin mmienu pɛ a Nnipa Ɔman Nhyiamu no dii nkonim wɔ Ghana Atifi Atɔeɛ mantam mu wɔ afe 2004 Ghana Amansan abatoɔ no mu no fa. Abatoɔfoɔ a wɔwɔ Sissala Apueeɛ mantam mu no too aba wɔ ‘skirt ne blouse’ kwan so wɔ saa abatoɔ no mu sɛ ɔmampanyin a ɔdii nkonim wɔ amansin korɔ no ara mu ne John Kuffour a ɔfiri New Patriotic Party no mu.

Ne nyinaa mu no, kuw no dii nkonim wɔ mmrahyɛbagua ananmusifo 4 pɛ mu wɔ nkongua 230 a na ɛwɔ Ghana man a ɛto so 4 no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 4 no mu.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so 

Ghana mmrahyɛbadwafoɔ 2005–2009

title: Yaw Baah
text:
Yaw Baah (wɔwoo no 17 Ɔbɛnem 1959)  yɛ mmaranimfoɔ  ne Ghana amanyɔni a ɔte Republic of Ghana. Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni a ogyinaa Kumawu mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan ne 5 no mu.    Ɔyɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Baah wɔ 17 Ɔbɛnem 1959.  Ɔfiri Kumawu kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana .  Ɔyɛ adeɛ a ɛfiri Ghana Suapɔn (UG) .  Ɔwɔ Bachelor of Arts abodin krataa wɔ Sikasɛm ne Amanyɔsɛm mu wɔ sukuupɔn no mu.  Ɔnyaa abodin krataa no wɔ afe 1986.  Ɔsan nso yɛ Lincoln’s Inn a ɛwɔ London no ade.  Efi hɔ no, onyaa Bachelor of Law wɔ afe 1997.

Adwuma 
Baah yɛ mmaranimfo wɔ n’adwuma mu.  Ná ɔyɛ Denwest Mmara Ho Afotu Dwumadibea a ɛwɔ London no kwankyerɛfo.

Amammui mu adwuma 
Baah yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni .  Ɔbɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbagua muni fi Ɔpɛpɔn 2005 bere a ɔdaa ne ho adi sɛ nkonimdifo wɔ Amansan Abatow mu wɔ December 2004. Ɔtu mmirika kɔdi tumi afe a ɛtɔ so mmienu. Na ɔyɛ MP a ɔhwɛ Kumawu mantam so wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.  Wɔpaw no sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani maa saa mantam yi wɔ Ghana Republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan ne anum mu.

Abatow a wɔyɛ 
Wɔpaw Baah sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani mma Kumawu mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana nea edi kan wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow no mu. Odii nkonim wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so .  Na ne mansin no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 36 no fa wɔ nkongua 39 a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Ashanti Mantam no mu.  New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 128 wɔ nkongua 230 mu.  Wɔde abatow 19,223 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 27,477 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 70% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen George Amankwaa a ofi National Democratic Congress, Kofi Adu Poku a ofi Convention People's Party, Yaw Opoku Mensah a ofi Great Consolidated Popular Party ne Patrick Osei Aboagye a ɔyɛ ɔkannifo a ɔde ne ho. Eyinom nyaa abatow 5,680, 1,831, 187 ne 556 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 20.7%, 6.7%, 0.7% ne 2% yɛ pɛ.

Wɔ afe 2008 mu no, odii nkonim wɔ amansan abatow no mu wɔ New Patriotic Party tekiti so maa ɔmansin koro no ara.  Ná ne mansin no ka mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 34 a ɛwɔ nkongua 39 a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Ashanti Mantam no mu no ho.  New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 109 wɔ nkongua 230 mu.  Wɔde abatow 15;217 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow 26;980 a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 56.4% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Ohene Kwasi Agyemang a ofi National Democratic Congress, Yaw Opoku Mensah a ofi Democratic Freedom Party, Kofi Adu Poku a ofi Convention People’s Party ne Dominic Oteng a ɔyɛ obi a ɔde ne ho. Eyinom nyaa abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 4,278, 174, 191 ne 7,120. Eyinom ne 15.86%,0.64%, 0.71 ne 26.39% yɛ pɛ wɔ abatow a wɔtow nyinaa mu.

Ankorankoro asetar 
Baah yɛ Kristoni.  Ɔyɛ Methodist Asɔre no muni.  Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baanu.

Hwɛ nso

title: Emmanuel Kwasi Bandua
text:
Emmanuel Kwasi Bandaa (wɔwoo no 11 Ɔpɛpɔn 1949) yɛ Ghana mmaranimfoɔ ne amanyɔni. Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbadwani a ogyinaa Biakoye mantam ananmu wɔ Volta mantam mu wɔ Ghana wɔ Fourth Republic of Ghana mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so anan ne anum ne asia mu

Ankorankoro asetra 
Bandaa aware a ɔwɔ mma baasa. Ɔyɛ Kristoni.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Bandaa wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn da a ɛtɔ so 11, afe 1949. Ɔfiri Bowiri-Anyinase a ɛwɔ Volta mantam mu wɔ Ghana.   Onyaa ne Bachelor of Arts abodin krataa wɔ Sikasɛm ne Asetra Ho Adesua mu. Onyaa Nhomasua ho adansedi krataa wɔ Cape Coast Sukuupɔn mu wɔ 1980 mu. Ɔsan nso yɛ obi a wawie Ghana School of Law a onyaa ne Bachelor of Law abodin krataa wɔ afe 1990.

Amammui mu adwuma 
Bandaa yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua no muni .  Wɔdii kan paw no sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ adwuma wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 16,083 wɔ abatoɔ 24,207 a ɛfata wɔ ne Mantam mu.  Ɔgyinaa ne mansin ananmu kɔsii 6 Ɔbɛnem 2017.  Na ɔyɛ Adwumayɛ, Amannɔne Nsɛm, Asase ne Kwae ho boayikuw muni.

Adwumafa 
Bandaa yɛ mmaranimfo.  Na ɔyɛ Bank of Ghana sohwɛfoɔ Panyin Abadiakyiri.  Ɔyɛ MP firi Ɔpɛpɔn 2005.

Boayikuw no 
Na ɔyɛ boayikuw a ɛhwɛ adwumayɛ, amannɔne nsɛm, Asase ne kwae so no muni.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Haruna Bayirga
text:
Haruna Bayirga (wɔwoo no 18 Ɔbɛnem 1952) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne adansi mfiridwuma ho nimdefo.  Ɔsan nso yɛ kan mmrahyɛbadwani ma sissala west constituency a ɛwɔ Upper West Region of Ghana .  Mprempren Bayirga yɛ Buwah Limited adwuma no kwankyerɛfo panyin.

Ɔbɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbadwani maa sissala west constituency wɔ afe 2005 mu bere a ɔsii akan sɛ Candidate a ɔde ne ho no.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Bayirga wɔ Ɔbɛnem da a ɛtɔ so dunwɔtwe wɔ Zini a ɛwɔ Ghana atifi atɔeɛ mantam mu.  Osuaa adansi ho ade wɔ Accra Polytechnic wɔ 1977 mu na afei ɔkɔɔ Italy kɔhwehwɛɛ adansedi krataa wɔ adansi mfiridwuma mu.

Adwuma 
Wɔ amammuifo a ɔyɛ akyi no, Bayirga yɛ ɔdansifo wɔ n’adwuma mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
N’amammui asetena hyɛɛ aseɛ wɔ afe 2004 mu baabi a ɔsii akan sɛ obi a ɔde ne ho maa Sissala atɔeɛ mantam no. Ɔdii nkonim a ne nyinaa yɛ 4,788 abatoɔ a ɛyɛ ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 30.60% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu.  Wɔ afe 2008 mu no,ɔsan sii akan bio maa nkongua koro no ara a na ɔyɛ ɔmanfoɔ ɔman nhyiamu kuo no muni na ɔdii nkonim a ne nyinaa yɛ abatoɔ 5,950. Ɔsan sii akan ne mprɛnsa so wɔ afe 2012 mu wɔ party no ananmusifo nhyiam ase na wɔkae sɛ obiara nsɔre ntia no nanso ɔdii nkogu wɔ Amin Amidu Suleman a ɔyɛ ɔman demokrase nhyiam no anim.

2004 Abatow a Wɔyɛe 
Wɔpaw Bayirga sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani ma Sissala West mantam no wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow no mu . Enti ɔgyinaa amansin no ananmu wɔ Ghana republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu. Wɔde abatow 4,788 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 15,643 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 30.6% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Benson George Hikah a ofi New Patriotic Party, Amidu Sukemani a ofi National Democratic Congress ne Kale Monetuo Peters a ɔyɛ obi a ɔde ne ho. Eyinom nyaa abatow 4,419, abatow 4759 ne abatow 1,677 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 28.2%, 30.4% ne 10.7% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw Bayirga wɔ Nnipa Ɔman Nhyiam no tekiti so .  Na ne mansin no yɛ amansin mmienu pɛ a Nnipa Ɔman Nhyiamu a ɛwɔ Upper West Region dii nkonim wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu no fa.  Nnipa Ɔman Nhyiam no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua ananmusifo a wɔn dodow yɛ 4 wɔ nkongua 230 a ɛwɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 4 a ɛwɔ Ghana man a ɛto so 4 no mu .

Ankorankoro asetra 
Bayirga yɛ Muslimi na waware na ɔwɔ mma baanum.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Godfrey Tangu Bayon
text:
Godfrey Tangu Bayon (wɔwoo no afe 1956) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nson a ɛwɔ Ghana Republic of the Fourth Republic no muni a ɔgyina Wa East Constituency ananmu wɔ Upper West Region wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Bayon wɔ 3 Oforisuo 1956. Ɔfiri Ducie, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Upper West Region wɔ Ghana.  Ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo ansa na ɔrekɔka amammuisɛm ho wɔ afe 2001 mu. Ɔnyaa A Level Certificate wɔ Gbewah Training College wɔ afe 1982.   Ɔsan kɔɔ Mpanyimfo Nhomasua Asoɛe. Wa wɔ afe 1973.

Adwuma 
Bayon yɛɛ adwuma sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo wɔ Ghana Nhomasua Dwumadibea fi afe 1977 kosi afe 2000.  Ɔsom sɛ Ducia Mfitiase Sukuu no panyin.  Bayon yɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo wɔ n’adwuma mu.

Amammui mu adwuma 
Bayon yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo (NPP) no muni. Ɔyɛ Wa Mantam Panyin wɔ afe 2001 ne 2005 ntam. Wɔpaw no sɛ Ɔmanpanyin (Akwan ne Akwan akɛse) soafo wɔ saa bere no Ɔmampanyin John Kufour aban ase wɔ afe 2007 ne 2008 ntam  Ɔgyinaa Wa East Constituency ananmu wɔ 4th Republic of Ghana mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan, 5 ne 7.

2004 Abatow a Wɔyɛe 
Wɔpaw Bayon sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani ma Wa Apuei amansin no wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow no mu . Ɔnam saayɛ so gyinaa amansin no ananmu wɔ Ghana republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu. Wɔde abatow 10,947 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 21,307 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 51.4% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Albert Solomon Bawah Sulley a ofi Nnipa Ɔman Nhyiam no mu ne Saliah Issaku Alhaji a ofi Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua no mu . Eyinom nyaa abatow 1,085 ne abatow 9,275 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 5.1% ne 43.5% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw Bayon wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so . Ne nyinaa mu no, New Patriotic Party no dii nkonim dodow no ara a ne nyinaa yɛ mmrahyɛbagua ananmusifo 194 wɔ nkongua 230 a ɛwɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 4 a ɛwɔ Ghana man a ɛto so 4 no mu.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Bayon yɛ Kristoni(Baptist) na waware na ɔwɔ mma mmienu.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: William Ofori Boafo
text:
William Ofori Boafo (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn 30, 1946) yɛ mmaranimfoɔ ne Ghana amanyɔni. Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani a ogyina Akropong Mansin ananmu wɔ Ghana Apuei fam mantam mu wɔ Ghana Ɔmanpanyin a ɛto so 4, 5 ne 6 mmrahyɛbagua no mu.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Boafo wɔ December 30, 1946. Ɔfiri Akropong, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Apueeɛ mantam mu.   Ɔyɛ Ghana Suapɔn no mu ade .  Onyaa Bachelor of Law abodin krataa wɔ sukuupɔn no mu.  Eyi sii afe 1969.  Ɔsan nso yɛ adeɛ a ɛfiri Ghana School of Law a ɔkɔɔ ne mmara adesua so na ɔnyaa Bachelor of Law abodin krataa.  Eyi nso sii afe 1970.

Adwuma 
Boafo yɛ mmaranimfo wɔ n’adwuma mu.   Ná ɔyɛ ɔhokafo wɔ Onimpa Akouku & Company.

Amanyɔsɛm adwuma 
Boafo yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni .   Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan, 5 ne 6 no muni na ɔsan nso yɛ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nson no muni a ɔregye n’adwuma wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2005.  Ɔsii akan sɛ wɔbɛsan apaw no bio wɔ Akropong Mantam mmrahyɛbagua no mu wɔ Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ a ɛdi akyire no nyinaa mu na ɔdii nkonim. Ɔgyina ne Constituency ananmu de bɛsi nnɛ.  Na ɔyɛ boayikuw a ɛhwɛ Ahobammɔ ne ɔman no mu, Standing Orders  no muni.

Abatow a wɔyɛ 
Wɔpaw Boafo sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani mma Akropong mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Apuei Fam mantam mu nea edi kan wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow no mu. Odii nkonim wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so . Ná ne mansin no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 22 no fa wɔ nkongua 28 a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Apuei Fam Mantam no mu.  New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 128 wɔ nkongua 230 mu.  Wɔde abatoɔ 21,655 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 34,199 a ɛne abatoɔ a ɛfata nyinaa mu 63.3% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Ohene Nyarkoh a ofi Nnipa Ɔman Nhyiam no mu, Richie Agyemfra-Kumi a ofi Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua no mu, Kwabena Awuku-Lokko a ofi Nhyiam no mu Nnipa Kuw no mu ne Ronni Nanan Esi Botsio a ɔyɛ ɔkannifo a ɔde ne ho . Eyinom nyaa abatow a ɛfata nyinaa mu 0%, 28.9%, 3.7% ne 4%.

Wɔ afe 2008 mu no, odii nkonim wɔ amansan abatow no mu wɔ New Patriotic Party tekiti so maa ɔmansin koro no ara. Ná ne mansin no ka mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 19 a ɛwɔ nkongua 28 a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no dii wɔ saa abatow a wɔpaw maa Apuei Fam Mantam no mu no ho .  New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 109 wɔ nkongua 230 mu.  Wɔde abatoɔ 20,245 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 34,350 a ɛne abatoɔ a ɛfata nyinaa mu 58.94% yɛ pɛ.  Wɔpaw no sen Hawa Isaka a ofi Ɔmanfo Ɔman Nhyiam no mu, Anthony Gyampo a ofi Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua no mu, Augustus Osae-Akonnor a ofi Nhyiam no mu Ɔmanfo Kuw no mu Samuel Apenteng a ɔyɛ ɔkannifo a ɔde ne ho. Eyinom nyaa 0.85%, 30.64%, 6.75% ne 2.82% wɔ abatow a wɔtow no nyinaa mu.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Boafo aware a ɔwɔ abofra baako. Ɔyɛ Kristoni ( Presbyterian ).

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: George Boakye (amanyɛni)
text:
Na Air Vice-Marshal George Yaw Boakye (25 Ɔbɛnem 1937 – 26 June 1979) yɛ wimhyɛnkafoɔ ne amanyɔni . Ɔyɛ kan Ghana Wim Asraafoɔ Panyin (November 1976 - June 1979) na ɔyɛ Supreme Military Council (SMC) no muni wɔ Ghana . Ɔbɛyɛɛ SMC no muni wɔ November 1976 mu ɛnam ne dibea sɛ Ghana Wim Asraafoɔ Panyin nti. Wɔde atuo a wɔtow kum no wɔ June 26, 1979 mu.

Wɔsan Siee no bio 
Wɔ afe 2001 mu no, Asraafo Panyin ne Ɔsahene a wokunkum wɔn no akunafo de adesrɛ kɔmaa Ɔmampanyin Kuffuor na ɔhyɛɛ sɛ wontutu wɔn afunu. Wɔ 27 December 2001 no, wɔsan de Ghana asraafoɔ mpaninfoɔ mmiɛnsa, Generals ne Colonel, nnompe nkae kɔmaa wɔn mmusua wɔ asraafoɔ asɔredan bi mu; Mfe 22 akyi a wokunkum Asraafo Panyin no wɔ Afrika Atɔe Fam man no mu nsɛm a mogyahwiegu wom sen biara fi bere a wonyaa ahofadi no biako mu. Ná guasodeyɛ a wɔyɛe wɔ ahenkurow Accra mu a nnipa bɛboro 2,000 a wɔhyɛ awerɛhow ntade tuntum ne kɔkɔɔ baa ase no yɛ mmɔden a saa bere no Ɔmampanyin, John Kufuor, bɔe sɛ ɔbɛtwe nsensanee bi wɔ ti bi a ɛyɛ sum ase wɔ kan Britania atubraman no abakɔsɛm mu no fa.  Wɔ December 27, 2001 no, wosiee Air Vice-Marshal Boakye ne Ɔsahene Panyin Kotei a wɔda adaka a wɔde ɔman frankaa akata so mu no de asraafo anuonyam a edi mũ siee Osu Asraafo Amusiei wɔ Accra .

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Stephen Asamoah Boateng
text:
Michael Coffie Boampong (6 Oforisuo 1962 – 29 Ɔbɛnem 2018) yɛ Akontaabufoɔ ne Ghana amanyɔni ne mmrahyɛbagua a Ɛtɔ so Nsia a ɛwɔ Ghana Ɔmanpanin a ɛtɔ so nnan no muni a ɔgyinaa Bia West Mansin ananmu wɔ Atɔeɛ Mantam mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Boampong wɔ 6 Oforisuo 1962. Ɔfirii Sefwi Essam, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Atɔeɛ Mantam mu . Owiee Kumasi Polytechnic, Ghana, na onyaa ne Diploma wɔ Adwumayɛ ho Adesua mu (Accounting Option) wɔ afe 1987.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ná Boampong yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua (NDC) no muni. Ɔbɛyɛɛ MP a ɔgyinaa Bia West Constituency ananmu wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2001 mu na ɔdii nkonim mprɛnsa a ɛtoatoa soɔ wɔ ɛno akyi. Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔsii akan wɔ Bia West nkongua no ho wɔ NDC mmrahyɛbagua a Ɛtɔ so Nsia a ɛwɔ Republic a Ɛto so Anan no tekiti so na ɔdii nkonim, na ɛno ne n’ahennie berɛ a ɛtwa toɔ.   Na ɔyɛ boayikuw no muni wɔ boayikuw ahorow a ɛhwɛ Ohia so Tew Ho Nhyehyɛe, Akwan ne Kar, ne Budget Boayikuw Titiriw no mu.

Wɔpaw Boampong sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma Bia West mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Atɔe Fam Mantam mu wɔ afe 2000 Ghana amansan abatow no mu. Enti ɔgyinaa amansin no ananmu wɔ Ghana republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu. Wɔde abatow 24,267 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a wɔtow nyinaa mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 68.50% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Benjamin Armah a ofi Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no mu ne Albert Adomako a ofi Convention People’s Party mu . Saa nnipa baanu yi nyaa abatow 11,179 ne 0 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne 31.50% ne 0.00% yɛ pɛ wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Wɔpaw Boampong wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.   National Democratic Congress no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua akron wɔ Atɔe Fam Mantam no mu wɔ saa abatow no mu. Sɛ yɛka ne nyinaa bom a, kuw no dii nkonim wɔ nnipa kakraa bi a wɔka bom yɛ mmrahyɛbagua ananmusifo 89 wɔ nkongua 200 a ɛwɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 3 a ɛwɔ Ghana Republic a ɛto so 4 no mu.

Adwuma 
Ná Boampong yɛ adwuma sɛ akontaabufo. Ná ɔyɛ Towtua Ho Nhwehwɛmufo Boafo wɔ IRS. Ɔyɛ MP fi Ɔpɛpɔn 2001.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ná Boampong aware na na ɔwɔ mma baanum. Ná ɔyɛ Kristoni ( Methodist ).

Owuo 
Boampong wui wɔ 29 Ɔbɛnem 2018 berɛ a wɔde no too 37 Asraafoɔ Ayaresabea, Accra wɔ yareɛ tiawa bi akyi.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Yaw Brempong-Yeboah
text:
Wɔwoo Yeboah 5 May 1954 wɔ Atiwa West wɔ Ghana Apuei Fam . Ɔkɔɔ Ghana Suapɔn na onyaa ne Bachelor of Science bere a osuaa Kuadwuma ho nyansahu akyi .

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔdii kan paw Yeboah sɛ ɔmmra mmrahyɛbagua mu wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so wɔ December 2000 Ghana Amansan abatoɔ a ɔgyinaa Atiwa West Constituency ananmu wɔ Eastern Region no mu.   Ɔnyaa abatoɔ 18,689 wɔ abatoɔ 27,959 a ɛfata a wɔtoo no mu a egyina hɔ ma 66.80%.  Ɔnyaa abatoɔ 25,468 wɔ abatoɔ 34,314 a ɛfata a wɔtoo no mu a ɛgyina hɔ ma 74.20% wɔ afe 2004 mu  Kwasi Annoh Ankamah dii no so nkonim wɔ wɔn Party's Parliamentary Primary mu wɔ afe 2008.

Adwuma 
Yeboah yɛ aguadi sohwɛfo wɔ n’adwuma mu. Ɔyɛ Ɔmanpanyin Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Amannɔne Nsɛm so na na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani wɔ Atiwa Atɔe Fam Mantam no mu.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Yeboah yɛ Kristoni. Ná Yeboah wɔ abofra biako a na onnim.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Joseph Yieleh Chireh
text:
Joseph Yieleh Chireh (wɔwoo no 8 Ɔpɛpɔn 1954) yɛ Ghana nnuruyɛfoɔ, mmaranimfoɔ, ɔman nanmusifoɔ ne amanyɔni .   Ɔyɛ obi a na anka ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma Wa West . Ɔsomm wɔ 4th Republic of Ghana mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan, 5, 6 ne 7 mu. Ɔsan yɛ Pan-African mmrahyɛbaguani .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Chireh wɔ Lassia Tuolu a ɛwɔ Upper West Region wɔ Ghana. Ɔmaa osuaa ne ntoaso sukuu wɔ Navrongo Ntoaso Sukuu a ɛwɔ Upper East Region a osuaa ade maa ne GCE Ordinary ne Advanced level adansedi krataa no nyinaa.  Ɔsuaa adeɛ wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so firi afe 1975 na ɔnyaa Bachelor of Pharmacy abodin krataa wɔ afe 1979 mu. Ɔkɔɔ Ghana Mmara Sukuu wɔ afe 2001 mu na ɔfatae sɛ mmaranimfo wɔ afe 2006.

Amanyɔsɛm ne aman ntam nkitahodi adwuma 
Ɔyɛ National Democratic Congress no muni. Yieleh Chireh yɛɛ Adetɔ Adwumayɛkuo a PNDC Aban hyehyɛeɛ wɔ afe 1991 mu no Titenani. Sɛ́ oguamtrani no, wɔde anuonyam ma no sɛ odii anim wɔ nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛe wɔ adetɔ mu nneyɛe bɔne ho wɔ Ministries, Departments and Agencies (MDAs) a wɔapaw mu a ɛda nsow wɔ wɔn mu ne Ministry of Health, Volta River Authority, Electricity Corporation of Ghana ne kan Post & Telecommunications Corporation nso.

Ɔasom wɔ dwumadie ahodoɔ mu firi Ɔmantam soafoɔ, Ɔmanpanin, mmrahyɛbagua muni kɔsi Ɔmanpanin a ɔhwɛ Mpɔtam Aban ne Nkuraaseɛ nkɔsoɔ so ne akwahosan soafoɔ nso.

mmrahyɛbaguani 
Ɔsii akan wɔ Wa West mantam mu atenaeɛ a wɔabɔ no foforɔ no mu wɔ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua abatoɔ mu wɔ December 2004 mu, a ɔdii nkonim ma ɔdii n’akongua wɔ Fourth Republic mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu .  Wɔpaw Chireh sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani ma Wa west mantam no wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow no mu . Ɔnam saayɛ so gyinaa amansin no ananmu wɔ Ghana republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu. Wɔde abatow 13,256 paw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 19,980 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 66.3% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Vaari Matthew Saa-hi a ofi Nnipa Ɔman Nhyiam no mu ne Edward Yirimambo a ofi Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no mu . Eyinom nyaa abatow 653 ne abatow 6,071 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne 3.3% ne 30.4% yɛ pɛ wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Wɔpaw Chireh wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so . Wɔ saa abatoɔ no mu no, National Democratic Congress dii nkonim wɔ nnipa kakraa bi a wɔka bom yɛ mmrahyɛbagua ananmusifoɔ 94 wɔ nkongua 230 a ɛwɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan a ɛwɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu.

2008,2012 abatoɔ 
Ɔkuraa n’akongua mu wɔ afe 2008  mu akyi a ɔdii nkonim a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 10,468 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 50% tiaa n’asɔretiafoɔ a wɔbɛn no paa Dari Daniel Kuusongno a ɔfiri New Patriotic Party, Edward B. Yirimanbo, ɔkannifoɔ a ɔde ne ho a na ɔwɔ abatoɔ 4,455 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 21.3% ne abatoɔ 5,541 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 26.5% na ɛwɔ hɔ.  Wɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 5 no mu no ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ Amannɔne Nsɛm boayikuo, Adwumayɛ, Asetena mu Yiedie ne Ɔman Nnwuma boayikuo mu.

2016 abatoɔ 
Wɔsan too aba maa Chireh sɛ onnyina Wa West mantam no ananmu mma afe a ɛtɔ so nnan wɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nson no mu. Ɔnyaa abatoɔ 12,658, 42.49% berɛ a n’asɔretiafoɔ titire mmienu Patrick Bandanaa, a ɔyɛ ɔkannifoɔ a ɔde ne ho ne Dari Daniel Kuusongno a ɔfiri New Patriotic Party a ɔhyiaa no wɔ afe 2008 mu no nyaa abatoɔ 8,806, 29.56% ne 7,415%, 24.89%.

Ɔman soafo a ɔhwɛ ɔman so 
Wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2009 mu no, Ghana Ɔmampanyin foforo John Atta Mills paw no sɛ Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ Mpɔtam Aban ne Nkuraase Nkɔso so.  Ɔsom sɛ John Atta Mills aban mpanyimfo kuw no muni.  Ɔsomm wɔ hɔ kɔsii 4 Ɔbɛnem 2011, berɛ a Ɔmanpanin, John Evans Atta Mills paw no sɛ Akwahosan ho Ɔsoafoɔ wɔ kabinet nsakraeɛ mu.

Adwumayɛfo fekuw 
Ɔyɛ Pharmacist a wɔakyerɛw ne din wɔ Ghana Pharmacy Council, ɔyɛ Ghana nnuruyɛ fekuw no yɔnko ne West Africa post graduate college of pharmacist no yɔnko.  Ɔsan yɛ mmaranimfoɔ ne Ghana Mmaranimfoɔ Kuo no muni.

FBNBank Ghana no guamtrani 
Chireh yɛɛ adwuma sɛ board chairman  maa FBNBank Ghana, First Bank of Nigeria Limited fa bi mfeɛ mmienu, mfeɛ 6 dii dwuma mfeɛ mmienu a ɛfiri afe 2014 kɔsi afe 2020.

Ankorɛankorɛ 
Chireh yɛ Kristoni na waware na ɔwɔ mma 4.

Hwɛ nso 

 Rawlings aban no
 Mills aban asomfo din a wɔahyehyɛ
 Wa West mantam mu

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so
