title: Herod Cobbina
text:
Herod Cobbina yɛ Ghana amanyɔni a ɔyɛɛ mmrahyɛbadwani wɔ Sefwi-Akontombra Mantam no mu firi afe 2005 kɔsi afe 2017.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Cobinna wɔ 1 July 1956. Ɔfiri Akontombra kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Atɔeɛ Mantam mu . Ɔnyaa ne ordinary level ('O'-Level) adansedie krataa wɔ afe 1979 mu fii Sefwi Wiawso hɔ Ntoaso Sukuu .

Adwuma 
Ansa na ɔrehyɛn mmrahyɛbagua no mu no ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ Ɔmantam Adetɔnbea sohwɛfo ma Cocoa Inputs Company Limited.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Cobbina yɛɛ mmrahyɛbadwani a ɔgyinaa Sefwi-Akontombra Mansin ananmu firi 6 Ɔbɛnem 2005 kɔsi 6 Ɔbɛnem 2017 wɔ National Democratic Congress no mufoɔ ne tekiti ase .  Ɔdii nkoguo wɔ ne primaries mu wɔ Kenneth Yeboah anim na ɔsii gyinaeɛ sɛ ɔbɛgyae asɔre no mu na wasi akan sɛ obi a ɔde ne ho nanso ɔhweree atenaeɛ no wɔ afe 2016 amansan abatoɔ mu sɛ obi a ɔde ne ho.  Ná wakɔ mmrahyɛbagua mu mfe abiɛsa a ɛtoatoa so wɔ mmrahyɛbagua mu.   Ná ɔyɛ Boayikuw a Ɛhwɛ Adwumayɛ, Ahobammɔ ne Mfinimfini Fam So no muni.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Cobbina aware na ɔwɔ mma baasa. Ɔkyerɛ sɛ ɔyɛ Kristoni ne Katolek Asɔre no muni .

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so 

Ghana mmrahyɛbadwafoɔ 2005–2009

title: J. B. Danquah-Adu
text:
Joseph Boakye Danquah Adu (2 Ɔpɛpɔn 1965 – 9 Ɔpɛpɔn 2016), yɛ Ghana chartered accountant ne amanyɔni a ɔfiri amammui abusua a wɔagye din mu. Na ɔyɛ Ghana mmrahyɛbaguani ma New Patriotic Party wɔ afe 2005 ne 2009 ntam, ne bio firi afe 2013 kɔsii ne wuo.

Mfitiase asetra 
Wɔwoo JB Danquah Adu wɔ 2 July 1965 wɔ Old Tafo wɔ Ghana Apuei Fam. Ne nana, J. B. Danquah a wɔde ne din too ne din no, na ɔboaa kɛse wɔ Ghana ahofadi ho apereperedi mu, na ɔyɛ amammuifo kuw bi a wɔtoo din Big Six no muni, na akyiri yi ɔsɔre tia Kwame Nkrumah, Ghana ɔmanpanyin ne ɔmampanyin a odi kan no.  Ɛtɔ da bi a wɔkyerɛw edin Danquah no sɛ Dankwa.  Ná ne ntoaso sukuu adesua wɔ Presbyterian Boys’ Senior High School a ɛwɔ Legon .

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ná waware na na ɔwɔ mma baanu.

Asetra wɔ amammuisɛm mu 
Ɔde ne ho bɔɔ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua bere a odii nkonim wɔ Ghana amansan abatow mu wɔ afe 2004 mu de gyinaa Abuakwa North ananmu . John Agyekum Kufuor aban no na ɛpaw no sɛ Ɔmanpanyin Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Mmea ne Mmofra Nsɛm so. Ɔhweree atenaeɛ no maa, Samuel Kwadwo Amoako a ɔyɛ n’ankasa kuo, New Patriotic Party no muni wɔ afe 2008 amansan abatoɔ no mu. Nanso ɔsan dii nkonim wɔ afe 2012 amansan abatoɔ no mu denam National Democratic Congress ’s Victor Smith a ɔdii nkonim no so. Na ɔyɛ Budgets Committee titiriw ne Aguadi, Nnwuma ne Nsrahwɛ Boayikuw a ɛwɔ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 5 a ɛwɔ 4th Republic no nyinaa muni.

Owuo 
Wɔ 9 Ɔpɛpɔn 2016 no, wɔde sekan kum no anɔpatutuutu.  Ɛno akyi no, polisifo kyeree ɔbarima bi wɔ awudi no ho.  Ɔbarima no, Daniel Asiedu, akyiri yi, ɔkae sɛ wakum MP no, wɔ apereperedi bi mu bere a ɔrebɔ mmɔden sɛ obewia no, na wɔbɔɔ no sobo sɛ wadi awu.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so 

Ghana mmrahyɛbadwafoɔ 2005–2009

title: Joe Danquah
text:
Joe Danquah yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ ne mmrahyɛbaguani ma Tain mantam a ɛwɔ Brong Ahafo mantam mu wɔ Ghana .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Danquah da a ɛtɔ so 9, afe 1972. Ne man yɛ  Ɔnyaa Bachelor of Arts abodin krataa wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu .

Amammui mu adwuma 
Wɔpaw Danquah sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani ma Tain mantam no wɔ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no mu wɔ bere a wɔhyehyɛɛ no foforo wɔ afe 2004 mu akyi. Ansa na ɔrekɔ mmrahyɛbagua no mu no ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ Ɔmantam Panyin.

2004 Abatow a Wɔyɛe 
Eyi yɛ bere a odii nkonim wɔ abatow mu wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow mu maa amansin no akyi. Ɔnam saayɛ so gyinaa amansin no ananmu wɔ Ghana republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu. Wɔde abatow 16,328 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 32,351 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 50.5% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Ahmed Ibrahim a ofi National Democratic Congress ne Joana Mayfair Abrebrese a ofi Convention People's Party ne Jemima Yahaya a ofi Every Ghanaian Living Everywhere Party . Eyinom nyaa abatow 15,410, abatow 373 ne abatow 240 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne 47.6%, 1.2% ne 0.7% yɛ pɛ wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu.   Wɔpaw Asiedu Mensah wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so . Na ne mansin no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 14 fa wɔ nkongua 24 a New Patriotic Party dii wɔ Brong Ahafo mantam mu wɔ Ghana wɔ saa abatow no mu no fa.   Sɛ yɛka ne nyinaa bom a, New Patriotic Party no nyaa dodoɔ no ara a ɛyɛ mmrahyɛbagua ananmusifoɔ 114 wɔ nkongua 230 a ɛwɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan a ɛwɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu.

2008 Abatow no 
Danquah antumi ankura ne dibea wɔ afe 2008 Ghana amansan abatow mu sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma Tain Mantam no.  Ɔsɔretia kuw kɛse, National Democratic Party no kandifo – Ahmed Ibrahim na otuu no fii n’ahenni so.  Nanso, wɔ abatow no akyi no, Danquah bɔɔ sobo sɛ nea efii ne hweree no fi ahunahuna a nnipa a wɔpaw no wɔ abatow no mu a National Democratic Congress no mufo de mae no mu bae.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Danquah yɛ Kristoni.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Akua Sena Dansua
text:
Akua Sena Dansua (wɔwoo no 23 April 1958) yɛ Ghana nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ne nkitahodi ho ɔfotufo a ne ho akokwaw, amammuifo ne nniso ne akannifo ho ɔbenfo.   Na ɔyɛ North Dayi Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni wɔ Ghana na na ɔyɛ Germany Ɔman Ba .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Dansua wɔ Hohoe wɔ Hohoe Municipal District wɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ 23 April 1958. N’abusua fi Botoku, a ɛno nso wɔ Volta Mantam mu. Ɔhyɛɛ ne mfitiaseɛ adesua ase wɔ Kadjebi-Akan Mpɔtam Aban Nsɔhwɛ Mfitiaseɛ ne Mfinimfini Sukuu mu. Afei ɔkɔɔ so kɔɔ ntoaso sukuu wɔ Mawuli Sukuu a ɛwɔ Ho, Volta Mantam no ahenkurow mu.

Adwuma 
Ɔne Weekly Spectator atesɛm krataa a ɛwɔ Accra, Ghana, yɛɛ adwuma sɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo, na awiei koraa no ɔbɛyɛɛ krataa no Features Editor. 

Akua Dansua yɛ Abatoɔ Boafoɔ wɔ Abatoɔ Bagua a ɛwɔ Ghana wɔ afe 1979 ne 1980 ntam. Efi 1983 kosi 1987 no na ɔyɛ Nigerian Reporter atesɛm krataa no Amanneɛbɔfo Panyin.

Amanyɔsɛm

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Iddrisu Dawuda
text:
Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Dawuda wɔ 22 May 1950 wɔ Karaga, Northern Region of Ghana. Ɔnyaa Akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ adansedie krataa. ‘A’ wɔ afe 1972 mu fii Kanton Akyerɛkyerɛfo Ntetee Kɔlege ne Diploma wɔ Mfitiase Nhomasua mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Na Dawuda yɛ Fourth Republic of Ghana mmrahyɛbagua a Ɛto so Anum no muni a wɔpaw no wɔ National Democratic Congress (NDC) tekiti so wɔ December 2008 Ghana amansan abatow mu sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma Karaga mantam. Odii Baba Wahab a ofi New Patriotic Party (NPP) ne afoforo baasa so nkonim ma odii nkonim wɔ Karaga mmrahyɛbagua no mu de abatow 13,352 wɔ abatow 23,441 a ɛfata a wɔtow no mu = 57.0%.   Ɔsomm firi afe 2004 kɔsi afe 2012, Dawuda hweree atenaeɛ no wɔ afe 2012 mu maa Alhassan Sualihu Dandaawa (NDC).

Adwuma 
Na ɔyɛ GES ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo panyin ne ɔkwankyerɛfo boafo wɔ Sakasaka Mfitiase 'C Sukuu a ɛwɔ Tamale, Atifi Mantam mu. Ɔsan nso ayɛ mmrahyɛbadwani ama Karaga mantam (Jan. 2005 kɔsi December 2012).

Ankorankoro asetra 
Dawuda yɛ Muslimi, ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma nsia.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so 

Ghana mmrahyɛbadwafoɔ 2005–2009

title: Ernest Debrah
text:
Ernest Akobuor Debrah (Ɔpɛpɔn 3, 1947. Ne man yɛ [3] Ɔberɛfɛw  6 April 2016)  yɛ Ghana amanyɔni.

Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ ne Nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Ernest Kwaku Akobour Debrah wɔ Ɔbɛnem da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa, afe apem ahankron aduɔson nson, na ne maame James Emmanuel Debrah ne Elizabeth Akosua Kontoh Debrah. Ná ɔyɛ mma dumien a n’awofo woo wɔn no mu nea ɔto so abiɛsa. Ɔfiri Tanoso a ɛwɔ Brong Ahafo Mantam mu wɔ Ghana .  Ɔwiee ne mfitiaseɛ ne ntoaso sukuu wɔ Sunyani Ntoaso Sukuu ne Ghana National College, Ernest Debrah wiee Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so wɔ afe 1972 mu a ɔnyaa Bachelor of Science abodin krataa wɔ Asase Sikasɛm mu.  Afei ɔkɔɔ so nyaa Master of Business Administration abodin krataa wɔ adwumayɛ mu wɔ Strathclyde Sukuupɔn, Glasgow wɔ afe 1995.

Adwuma 
Debrah yɛ sikasɛm ho ɔbenfo wɔ n’adwuma mu.  Ɔayɛ adwuma sɛ Retain Banking Unit no sohwɛfoɔ panin wɔ Société Générale - Social Security Bank, a akyiri yi wɔbɛfrɛɛ no Societe Generale Ghana Limited adwumayɛbea ti.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Na Debrah yɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma Tano North mantam no wɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan ne 5 wɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu. Na ɔyɛ Aduan ne Kuadwuma soafoɔ (Ɔpɛpɔn 2005 kɔsi Ɔpɛpɔn 2009), na wadi kan ayɛ Ɔmantam Ɔsoafoɔ ama Brong-Ahafo na afei Ɔmantam Ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Atifi Mantam so firi Ɔpɛpɔn 2001 kɔsi Ɔpɛpɔn 2004. Wɔpaw no sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani fi Tano North wɔ December 2004 mu. Wɔmaa no abasobɔdeɛ wɔ afe 2009 mu wɔ Akuafoɔ Da afahyɛ no mu.

Abatow a wɔyɛ 
Wɔdii kan paw Debrah sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani mma Tano North mantam no wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu. Wɔde abatow 15,868 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 26,983 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 58.80% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Charles Appiagyei a ofi Ɔman Democratic Congress, Nyamekye Florence a ofi Democratic People's Party, Daniel Dabie Boateng a ofi People's National Convention ne Nana Ampabeng Daniel K Kyeremeh a ofi Convention People's Party . Eyinom nyaa abatow 10,253, abatow 485, abatow 210 ne abatow 167 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne 38.00%, 1.80%, 0.80% ne 0.60% yɛ pɛ wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow wɔ saa abatow no mu nyinaa mu. Debrah dii nkonim wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so . Na ne mansin no yɛ amansin 14 a ɛwɔ amansin 24 a New Patriotic Party dii nkonim wɔ Brong Ahafo mantam mu wɔ saa abatow no mu no fa. Sɛ yɛka ne nyinaa bom a, New Patriotic Party no nyaa dodoɔ no ara a ɛyɛ mmrahyɛbagua ananmusifoɔ 128 wɔ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 230 a ɛwɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan a ɛwɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ná Ernest Akobuor Debrah yɛ Kristoni na ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baanan.

Owuo 
Ɔwuiɛ wɔ yareɛ tiawa bi akyi Dwoda 6 Ayɛwohomumɔ 2016, wɔ ne tenabea.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so 

Ghana mmrahyɛbadwafoɔ 2005–2009

title: Benjamin Bimpong Donkor
text:
Benjamin Bimpong Donkor (wɔwoo no 7 Ɔpɛpɔn 1959) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne ɔsomfoɔ a ɔyɛ obuo. Ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbadwani ma Hemang Lower Denkyira mantam firi 7 Ɔbɛnem 2005 kɔsi 6 Ɔbɛnem 2013.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Donkor fi Jukwa-Mfuom a ɛwɔ Ghana Mfinimfini Mantam mu . Wɔwoo no wɔ 7 July 1959. Ɔnyaa ne Diploma wɔ Bible Adesua mu wɔ Heritage Bible Institute wɔ afe 1998.

Adwuma 
Donkor yɛ ɔsomfo a ɔkyerɛ obu. Ɔyɛ Springs of Life Chapel International sɔfo.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Donkor yɛ mmrahyɛbadwani ma Hemang Lower Denkyira mantam no firi 7 Ɔbɛnem 2005 kɔsi 6 Ɔbɛnem 2013 wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so .  Wɔ afe 2008 Ghana mmrahyɛbagua abatoɔ mu, ɔnyaa abatoɔ 7,067 wɔ abatoɔ 20,024 a ɛfata a wɔtoo no nyinaa mu.

2004 Abatow a Wɔyɛe 
Wɔpaw Donkor sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani muni wɔ Hemang Lower Denkyira mantam mu wɔ afe 2004 Ghana Amansan abatow mu. Enti ogyinaa amansin no ananmu nea edi kan wɔ Ghana republic a ɛto so 4 no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 4 no mu. Wɔde abatow 12,410 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 20,057 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 61.9% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen ɔkannifo foforo biako pɛ wɔ saa abatow no mu Peter Bright Amankrah a ofi National Democratic Congress no mu. Ɔnyaa abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 38.1%. Wɔpaw Donkor wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so. Na ne mantam no yɛ amansin 16 a New Patriotic Party dii nkonim wɔ Central mantam mu wɔ saa abatow no mu no fa. Sɛ yɛka ne nyinaa bom a, New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 128 wɔ Ghana republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu.

2008 Abatow no 
Wɔsan paw Donkor sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani muni wɔ Hemang Lower Denkyira mantam mu wɔ afe 2008 Ghana Amansan abatow no mu . Enti ɔgyinaa amansin no ananmu ne mprenu so wɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 5 no mu . Wɔde abatow 7,067 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 20,024 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 35.29% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Godfred Appiah a ofi Ɔmanfo Ɔman Nhyiam no mu, Foster Joseph Andoh a ofi Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua no mu, Osei Heyman a ofi Nhyiam no mu Nnipa Kuw no mu ne Bright Wireko-Brobby a ɔyɛ ɔkannifo a ɔde ne ho. Eyinom nyaa abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 1.17%, 28.46%, 2.16% ne 32.92%.  Wɔsan paw Donkor wɔ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no tekiti so . Na ne mansin no yɛ amansin 8 a New Patriotic Party dii nkonim wɔ Central mantam mu wɔ saa abatow no mu no fa.  Sɛ yɛka ne nyinaa bom a, New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 107 wɔ Ghana republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 5 no mu.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Donkor aware a ɔwɔ mma baanum. Ɔyɛ Kristoni na ɔyɛ Springs of Life Chapel International no muni.

title: Owusu Achaw Duah
text:
Owusu Achaw Duah yɛ Ghana aduruyɛ ho ɔbenfo ne amanyɔni.  Ɔyɛ Martin Luther King Akwahosan Ntetee Sukuu no panyin ne ne titrani .  Wɔ afe 2006 mu no, wɔpaw no sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani ma Offinso South amansin no denam abatow foforo a wɔyɛe wɔ Kwabena Sarfo wu akyi wɔ August 2006.

Nwomasua 
Owusu nyaa ne adansedi nkrataa a ɛyɛ mpapahwekwa ne nea ɛkɔ akyiri fi Konongo Odumase Senior High ne Opoku Ware Senior High sukuu ahorow mu. Ɔwiee Ghana Suapɔn Aduruyɛ Sukuu wɔ afe 1973 mu na ɔsan nso wɔ Telemedicine akyi adesua.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Owusu sii akan na odii nkonim wɔ Offinso South mantam mu abatow mu wɔ afe 2006 mu wɔ New patriotic Party tekiti so .

Adwuma 
Ɔyɛ aduruyɛ kwankyerɛfo wɔ Oduruyɛfo Martin Luther King Ayaresabea a ɛwɔ Accra na ɔyɛ abɔnten so nhwehwɛmufo wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma Sukuupɔn mu . Ɔyɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo a wakɔ pɛnhyen na na anka ɔyɛ Chemical Pathology Department a ɛwɔ University of Ghana Medical School no Titenani.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Owusu aware a ɔwɔ mma 5.

title: Ignatius Kofi Poku Edusei
text:
Ignatius Kofi Poku-Adusei yɛ Ghana amanyɔni a ɔte Republic of Ghana. Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni a ogyina hɔ ma Bekwai mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu. Ɔyɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Poku-Adusei wɔ Ɔkɔtɔberɛ da 25, afe 1963. Ɔyɛ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so, KNUST . Ɔwɔ Bachelor of Arts abodin krataa wɔ Social Sciences mu wɔ sukuupɔn no mu. Ɔsan nso yɛ Ghana Suapɔn (UG) adeɛ . Efi hɔ no, onyaa abodin krataa a ɛkorɔn wɔ Adwumayɛ ho nimdeɛ mu.

Adwuma 
Poku-Adusei yɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo/ ɔhwɛfo wɔ n’adwuma mu.

Amammui mu adwuma 
Poku-Adusei yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni . Ɔbɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbagua muni fi Ɔpɛpɔn 2005 bere a ɔdaa ne ho adi sɛ nkonimdifo wɔ Amansan Abatow mu wɔ December 2004. Wɔpaw no sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani ma Bekwai mantam wɔ Ghana Republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu.

Abatow a wɔyɛ 
Wɔ afe 2000 mu no, Adusei dii nkonim wɔ amansan abatow no mu sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani ma Bekwai mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana . Odii nkonim wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so . Ná ne mansin no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 31 no fa wɔ nkongua 33 a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Ashanti Mantam no mu .  New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 100 wɔ nkongua 200 mu.  Wɔde abatow 30,811 paw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 36,062 mu.  Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 85.7% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Michael OK Boakye a ofi National Democratic Congress, Stephen A. Kwarteng a ofi People's National Convention, Emmanuel K. Adade a ofi National Reformed Party ne Michael OK Annan a ofi Convention People's Party . Eyinom nyaa abatow 4,260, 340, 333 ne 193 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtowee nyinaa mu 11.9%, 0.9%, 0.9% ne 0.5% yɛ pɛ.

Wɔpaw Poku-Adusei sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani maa Bekwai mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana nea edi kan wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow no mu. Odii nkonim wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so . Na ne mansin no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 36 no fa wɔ nkongua 39 a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Ashanti Mantam no mu.  New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 128 wɔ nkongua 230 mu.  Wɔde abatow 34,830 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 43,896 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 79.3% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Janet Adarkwah a ofi Ɔmanfo Ɔman Nhyiam no mu, Jonas Owusu-Boateng a ofi Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua no mu, Grace Abena Nketia a ofi Nhyiam no mu Ɔmanfo Kuw no mu, Beatrice Kusi-Appiah a ɔyɛ ɔmanpanyin a ɔde ne ho. Eyinom nyaa abatow 870, 3,739, 241 ne 4,216 wɔ abatow a wɔtow nyinaa mu. \  Eyinom ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 2.0%, 8.5%, 0.5% ne 9.6% yɛ pɛ.

title: Edward Michael Ennin
text:
Edward Michael Ennin (wɔwoo no 16 May 1070) yɛ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 5 a ɛwɔ Ghana Republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no muni ma Obuasi Apueeɛ wɔ Ashanti mantam mu wɔ Ghana .  Wɔpaw no wɔ New Patriotic Party (NPP) tekiti so nyaa abatow dodow no ara ma ɔbɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbaguani .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Ennin wɔ May 16 1970 wɔ Old Edubiase wɔ Ashanti mantam mu .  Ɔnyaa ne Diploma wɔ Data Processing mu wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so .  Onyaa adansedi krataa no wɔ 1997 mu wɔ sukuupɔn no mu.   Ɔsan nso nyaa EMGL abodin krataa wɔ Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration .   Ɔnyaa abodin krataa no wɔ afe 2008.

Adwuma 
Ennin yɛ Insurance broker ne programmer.  Ɔyɛ sikakorabea dwumayɛni ne sikasɛm ho ɔbenfo nso. Ná ɔyɛ Ashanti Ɔmantam Anamusini wɔ All Risk Consultancy Limited.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ennin yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni .   Ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanyin a Ɛto so Anan no mmrahyɛbagua a Ɛto so Anum, Nsia ne Nson no muni. Wɔkaa ntam bere a odii n’asɔretiafo no so nkonim denam abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 59.08% a onyae no so. Ɔka boayikuw a ɛhwɛ Aban Awerɛhyem, Atopae ne Ahoɔden so no ho. Ɔayɛ mmrahyɛbaguani firi Ɔpɛpɔn 2005 de bɛsi nnɛ.

Abatow a wɔyɛ 
Wɔpaw Ennin sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani maa Obuasi Apuei mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana nea edi kan wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow no mu. Odii nkonim wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so . Na ne mansin no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 36 no fa wɔ nkongua 39 a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Ashanti Mantam no mu.  New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 128 wɔ nkongua 230 mu.  Wɔde abatow 43,102 paw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 74,717 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 57.7% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Michael Carr Aaron a ofi People’s National Convention, Ɔtemmufo Dasah a ofi National Democratic Congress ne Adelaide Borden a ɔyɛ obi a ɔde ne ho. Eyinom nyaa abatow 550, 4,426 ne 26,639 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 0.7%, 5.9% ne 35.7% yɛ pɛ.

Wɔ afe 2008 mu no, odii nkonim wɔ amansan abatow no mu wɔ New Patriotic Party tekiti so maa ɔmansin koro no ara.  Ná ne mansin no ka mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 34 a ɛwɔ nkongua 39 a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Ashanti Mantam no mu no ho .  New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 109 wɔ nkongua 230 mu.  Wɔde abatow 46,785 paw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 75,085 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 62.31% yɛ pɛ.  Wɔpaw no sen Mohammed Issifu a ofi Nnipa Ɔman Nhyiam no mu, John Alexander Ackon a ofi Ɔman Democratic Congress, Elyass Abdulsalam a ofi Democratic Freedom Party, David Kenyah a ofi Nhyiam no mu Nnipa Kuw ne Albert Joseph Ababio a ofi Reformed Patriotic Democrats.  Eyinom nyaa abatow 331, 26,169, 147, 1,501 ne 152 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu.  Eyinom ne 0.44%, 34.85%, 0.20%, 2% ne 0.2% yɛ pɛ wɔ abatow a wɔtow no nyinaa mu.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ennin aware na ɔwɔ mma baanan.  Ɔyɛ Kristoni ( Methodist ).

title: Kofi Frimpong
text:
Kofi Frimpong (wɔwoo no 17 Ɔbɛnem 1951)   yɛ aguadifoɔ   ne Ghana amanyɔni a ɔwɔ Republic of Ghana.  Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani a ogyinaa Kwabre Apuei mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 4,5 ne 6 mu. Ɔyɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Frimpong wɔ 17 Ɔbɛnem 1951.    Ɔfiri Ntonso, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana .   Ɔyɛ adeɛ a ɛfiri Ghana Suapɔn (UG) mu.   Ɔwɔ Bachelor of Arts abodin krataa wɔ Sociology ne Political Science mu wɔ sukuupɔn no mu.   Ɔnyaa abodin krataa no wɔ afe 1978.

Adwuma 
Frimpong yɛ aguadifo.   Ná ɔyɛ Bakota Medical Technology Limited a ɛwɔ Kumasi no kwankyerɛfo panyin.   Eyi sii ansa na ɔrepere amammui dibea wɔ afe 2004.

Amammui mu adwuma 
Frimpong yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni .   Ɔbɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbagua muni fi Ɔpɛpɔn 2005 bere a ɔdaa ne ho adi sɛ nkonimdifo wɔ Amansan Abatow mu wɔ December 2004. Otuu mmirika dii nkonim mpɛn abien bio na odii nkonim.  Na ɔyɛ MP a ɔhwɛ Kwabre East mantam so.   Wɔpaw no sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani maa saa mantam yi wɔ Ghana Republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan, nnum ne nsia mu.

Abatow a wɔyɛ 
Wɔpaw Frimpong sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani mma Kwabre Apuei mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana nea edi kan wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow no mu. Odii nkonim wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so . Na ne mansin no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 36 no fa wɔ nkongua 39 a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Ashanti Mantam no mu.  New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 128 wɔ nkongua 230 mu.  Wɔde abatow 42,094 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 51,871 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 81.2% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Augustine Yeboah Domfeh a ofi National Democratic Congress ne Agnes Donkor a ofi Convention People’s Party mu . Eyinom nyaa abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 8,906 ne 871. Eyinom ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 17.2% ne 1.7% yɛ pɛ.

Wɔ afe 2008 mu no, odii nkonim wɔ amansan abatow no mu wɔ New Patriotic Party tekiti so maa ɔmansin koro no ara.  Ná ne mansin no ka mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 34 a ɛwɔ nkongua 39 a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Ashanti Mantam no mu no ho.  New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 109 wɔ nkongua 230 mu.  Wɔde abatow 41,454 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 54,517 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 76.04% yɛ pɛ.  Wɔpaw no sen Bismark Adu-Asere a ofi National Democratic Congress, Zacharia Awuah a ofi Democratic Freedom Party ne Alice Duah Boateng a ofi Convention People's Party . Eyinom nyaa abatow 10,824, 555 ne 1,684 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne abatow a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 19.85%, 1.02% ne 3.09% yɛ pɛ.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Frimpong yɛ Kristoni.   Ɔyɛ Seventh-Day Adventistni.  Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma du.

title: Kwame Owusu Frimpong
text:
Kwame Owusu Frimpong yɛ Ghana amanyɔni. Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbadwani ma Ahafo Ano North mantam wɔ 4th parliament wɔ 4th republic.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Frimpong wɔ 10 Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 1960. Ɔnyaa ne sukuupɔn wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu baabi a ɔnyaa diploma wɔ Akontaabuo mu.

Adwuma 
Ansa na Frimpong rekɔ amammuisɛm mu no, na ɔyɛ Sikakorabea sohwɛfo.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Frimpong yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni .  Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbadwani wɔ Ahafo Ano Atifi fam mantam mu wɔ mmrahyɛbagua bere abien: mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 3 wɔ Ghana man a ɛto so 4 mu, ne mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 4 wɔ Ghana man a ɛto so 4 mu. Wɔ n’ahennie a ɛdi kan mu no, ɔgyinaa amansin no ananmu firi 7 Ɔbɛnem 2001 kɔsi 6 Ɔbɛnem 2005 na n’ahennie a ɛtɔ so mmienu no, ɔgyinaa amansin no ananmu firi 7 Ɔbɛnem 2005 kɔsi 6 Ɔbɛnem 2009. Bere a na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani no, na ɔyɛ Ghana-China mmrahyɛbagua Adamfofa Fekuw (GCPFA) no guamtrani.

Abatow a wɔyɛ 
Wɔ afe 2000 mu no, Frimpong dii nkonim wɔ amansan abatow no mu sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani ma Ahafo-Ano Atifi fam mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana . Odii nkonim wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so . Ná ne mansin no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 31 no fa wɔ nkongua 33 a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Ashanti Mantam no mu .  New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 99 wɔ nkongua 200 mu.  Wɔde abatow 12,432 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 24,420 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 52% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Annor Baffour a ofi National Democratic Congress, Johnson O. Antoh a ofi People’s National Convention ne Paul K. A. Mono a ofi Convention People’s Party . Eyinom nyaa abatow 10,784, 515 ne 174 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 45.1%, 2.2% ne 0.7% yɛ pɛ.

Wɔpaw Frimpong sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani maa Ahafo Ano North mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana no bio wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow no mu.  Odii nkonim wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so .  Ná ne mansin no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 36 no fa wɔ nkongua 39 a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Ashanti Mantam no mu .  New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 128 wɔ nkongua 230 mu.  Wɔde abatow 15,045 paw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 28,469 mu.  Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 52.8% yɛ pɛ.  Wɔpaw no sen Atta Sampson a ofi Nnipa Ɔman Nhyiam no mu, Addai-Amankwah David K. a ofi Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua no mu, Tabi John a ofi Nhyiam no mu Nnipa Kuw no mu ne Adu Gyamfi Emmanuel a ofi Democratic Nnipa Kuw no mu .  Eyinom nyaa abatow 220, 12,789, 222 ne 193 wɔ abatow a wɔtow nyinaa mu.  Eyinom ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtowee nyinaa mu 0.8%, 44.9%, 0.8% ne 0.7% yɛ pɛ.

title: Inusah Fuseini
text:
Inusah Abdulai Bistav Fuseini (wɔwoo no 23 Ɔbɛnem 1962) yɛ Ghana mmaranimfoɔ ne amanyɔni . Ɔyɛ kan mmrahyɛbadwani a ɔhwɛ Tamale Central mantam so ne kan Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ Asase ne Abɔde mu Nneɛma so wɔ Ghana aban mu . Na ɔyɛ ɔyɔnko panyin wɔ Law Trust Company a ɛwɔ Accra no mu ansa na ɔrekɔ amammuisɛm mu.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Fuseini fi Tishiegu-Tamale, wɔ Ghana Atifi Fam Mantam mu. Ná ɔyɛ ɔyɔnko panyin wɔ Law Trust Company a ɛwɔ Accra no mu ansa na ɔrekɔ amammuisɛm mu.  Ɔkɔɔ akyerɛkyerɛfo ntetee kɔlege wɔ Bagabaga Training College (mprempren Bagabaga College of Education ) baabi a onyaa ne kyerɛkyerɛfo adansedi krataa sɛ ɔbɛyɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo a ɔyɛ adwumaden. Afei ɔkɔɔ Ghana Suapɔn, Legon, kɔyɛɛ ne bachelor’s degree wɔ mmara mu.  Ɔsan nso wɔ mmara mu abodin krataa a ɛkorɔn wɔ Ghana Sukuupɔn mu .

Amammui mu adwuma 
Fuseini a ɔyɛ National Democratic Congress muni no bɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbadwani bere a Wayo Seini guan fii NDC mu kɔɔ New Patriotic Party no mu no. Eyi maa wɔpaw abatow foforo wɔ Tamale Central mantam mu wɔ 4 April 2006. Fuseini dii nkonim wɔ abatow no mu a na nnipa dodow no ara yɛ 17,502.  Ɔdii nkonim wɔ Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu wɔ December 2008 mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 66%,  wɔ Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu wɔ December 2012  ne afe 2016 mu no, ɔnyaa 59.81%.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Fuseini yɛ Nkramofo na waware na ɔwɔ mma baanan.

 Tamale Mfinimfini

title: Gershon Kofi Bediako Gbediame
text:
Gershon Kofi Bediako Gbediame yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ ne Ghana Republic of the Fourth Parliament no muni a ɔgyina Nkwanta South Constituency ananmu wɔ Volta mantam mu wɔ Ghana wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Gbediame wɔ Pusupu Ntruo wɔ Volta mantam mu.  Ɔkɔɔ Cape Coast Suapɔn mu baabi a ɔnyaa abodin krataa wɔ Abɔdeɛ mu Nneɛma ho nimdeɛ mu ne abodin krataa wɔ Nhomasua mu wɔ afe 1979.

Adwuma 
Gbediame yɛ nhomasua ho ɔbenfo . Ná ɔyɛ Ɔhwɛfo Panyin ne ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo wɔ Presbyterian Boys’ Senior High wɔ Legon . Ɔbɛyɛɛ MP wɔ afe 1997.   Ná ɔyɛ Abɔde mu Nneɛma Ho Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo .  Ɔyɛ kan Majority Chief Whip bere a ɔde ne ho sii E. T. Mensah ananmu no.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Gbediame yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua no muni .    Ɔwɔ afe a ɛtɔ so 5 a ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani. Odii nkonim wɔ ne mmrahyɛbagua abatow mu wɔ 1997 mu denam abatow 36,819 a ɛfata a onyae no mu 13, 870 so. Eyi yɛ abatow no nyinaa mu 37.67%. Ɔwɔ mmrahyɛbagua mu fi 1997 de besi nnɛ.

Wɔpaw Gbediame sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani muni ma Nkwanta South mantam no wɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 5 a ɛwɔ ɔman a ɛto so 4 no mu .

Wɔpaw no wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so na onyaa abatow 18,171 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu, a ɛne abatow a ɛfata nyinaa mu 57.72% yɛ pɛ.

Wɔpaw no sen Joseph Booker Yaw Denteh a ofi Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no mu ; ne David Boamah Asomani, Oliver Ayivi ne Okogye A. K. Joseph, nnipa baasa a wɔde wɔn ho.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Gbediame aware a ɔwɔ mma baanum.  Ɔyɛ Kristoni a ɔyɛ fekubɔ wɔ Great Commission Church International.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so 

Ghana mmrahyɛbadwafoɔ 2005–2009

title: Kobina Tahir Hammond
text:
Kobina Tahir Hammond (wɔwoo no Ɔbɛnem 16, 1960) yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɛni,Ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma Adans-Asokwa mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana wɔ 3rd, 4th, 5th, 6th, 7th ne 8th Parliament wɔ 4th Ghanaian Republic. Ɔyɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Hammond wɔ June 16, 1960 mu. Ɔfiri Asokwa kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana . Ɔwɔ Bachelor of Arts abodin krataa wɔ Mmara ne Amanyɔsɛm mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn (UG) . Ɔnyaa abodin krataa no wɔ afe 1986. Ɔsan nso yɛ Gray’s Inn, Holborn Mmara Sukuu, London, UK no ade. Efi hɔ no, onyaa Bachelor of Law wɔ afe 1991.

Adwuma 
Na Hammond yɛ ɔhokafo wɔ Chancery Chambers a ɛwɔ London no mu.

Amammui mu adwuma 
Hammond yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni .   Ɔbɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbadwani firi Ɔbɛnem 2001 berɛ a ɔdaa ne ho adi sɛ ɔdii nkonim wɔ Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ mu wɔ December 2000.  Efi saa bere no, wadi tumi mpɛn anum a ɛtoatoa so. Ɔno ne MP a ɔhwɛ Adamsi-Asokwa mantam so. Wɔapaw no sɛ mmrahyɛbagua muni ama saa mantam yi wɔ Ghana Republic a ɛto so anan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so abiɛsa, anan, anum, asia ne ason mu.  Wɔsan paw no wɔ afe 2020 Amansan abatoɔ no mu sɛ ɔmmɛgyina hɔ wɔ Fourth Republic of Ghana mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 8 no mu. Na Kobina yɛ Sikasɛm Boayikuo no muni, ne Mines and Energy Committee wɔ 7th Parliament a ɛwɔ 4th Republic of Ghana no mu.

Abatow a wɔyɛ 
Wɔ afe 2000 mu no, Hammond dii nkonim wɔ amansan abatow no mu sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani ma Adans-Asokwa mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana . Odii nkonim wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so.  Ná ne mansin no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 31 no fa wɔ nkongua 33 a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Ashanti Mantam no mu . New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 99 wɔ nkongua 200 mu.  Wɔde abatow 10,306 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 19,407 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 54.4% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Theresa Mensah a ofi National Democratic Congress, Nana Yaw Frimpong a ofi People's National Convention, Kwame Amoh a ofi Convention People's Party, Peter Kofi Essilfie a ofi National Reformed Party ne Prince Lawrence a ofi United Ghana Movement so Eyinom nyaa abatow 7,230, 1,001, 241, 92 ne 61 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne 38.2%, 5.3%, 1.3%, 0.5% ne 0.3% yɛ pɛ wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu.

Wɔpaw Hammond sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani mma Adansi-Asokwa mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana ne mprenu so wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow no mu. Odii nkonim wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so. Na ne mansin no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 36 no fa wɔ nkongua 39 a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Ashanti Mantam no mu.  New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 128 wɔ nkongua 230 mu. Wɔde abatoɔ 15,176 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 24,112 a ɛne abatoɔ a ɛfata nyinaa mu 62.9% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Seidu S. Adams a ofi Peoples’ National Convention ne Ɔsɔfo Evans Amankwa a ofi National Democratic Congress . Eyinom nyaa abatow a ɛfata nyinaa mu 0.7% ne 36.3%.

Wɔ afe 2008 mu no, odii nkonim wɔ amansan abatow no mu wɔ New Patriotic Party tekiti so maa ɔmansin koro no ara. Na ne mansin no ka mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 34 a ɛwɔ nkongua 39 a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Ashanti Mantam no mu no ho.  New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 109 wɔ nkongua 230 mu.  Wɔde abatoɔ 13,659 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 24,524 a ɛne abatoɔ a ɛfata nyinaa mu 55.7% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Alhaji Abdul-Lateef Madjoub a ofi Ɔman Democratic Congress, Amoako Anaafi a ofi Democratic Freedom Party ne Owusu-Boamah Francis a ofi Convention People's Party mu . Eyinom nyaa abatow a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 37.59%, 5.43% ne 1.28%.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Hammond yɛ Nkramofo. Ɔka Ahmadiya kuw no ho. Ɔwaree.

title: Rita Tani Iddi
text:
Rita Tani Iddi yɛ Ghana amanyɔni a na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbadwani wɔ Gushiegu mantam mu firi afe 2005 kɔsi afe 2009.

Rita dii nkonim wɔ Gushiegu atenaeɛ no mu wɔ December 2004 amansan abatoɔ no mu wɔ New Patriotic Party (NPP) tekiti so nanso ɔdii nkoguo wɔ mmɔden a ɛdi hɔ a ɔbɔeɛ sɛ ɔbɛgyina ɔmansin no ananmu wɔ December 2008 amansan abatoɔ no mu . Bere a na ɔwɔ mmrahyɛbagua no mu no, ɔyɛɛ Ɔsomfo abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Asase ne Abɔde mu Nneɛma so a ɔhwɛ Tow a Wɔtow So no mmɔho abien. Mprempren ɔyɛ Ghana commissioner abadiakyiri wɔ United Kingdom ne Ireland.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Tani wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn da a ɛtɔ so 14, afe 1949. Ɔkɔɔ Cape Coast Sukuupɔn mu baabi a onyaa Diploma wɔ Ofie Nyansahu mu, ɛno akyi no ɔtoaa ne nhomasua so wɔ Nhomasua Sukuupɔn mu, Winneba, faako a onyaa ne Bachelor of Education wɔ Ofie Nyansahu mu .

Adwuma 
Rita Tani Iddi yɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo wɔ adwuma mu, ɔkyerɛɛ ade wɔ sukuu ahorow pii mu wɔ Ghana, eyinom bi ne Yendi Senior High School ne Berekum Training College. Wɔpaw no sɛ Ɔmantam Panyin wɔ Gushegu Mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Mantam mu .  Ɔsan nso bɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbagua a Ɛto so Anan a ɛwɔ Ghana Aman a Ɛto so Anan no mmrahyɛbadwani a ogyina Gushegu mantam ananmu na ɔyɛɛ Ɔmanpanyin Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Asase, Kwae ne Atopae so a na ɔhwɛ atopae adwuma so wɔ bere a na ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanyin dedaw no, John Agyekum Kufuor aban na seesei ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanyin Abadiakyiri. Tani Iddi nso yɛ Ghana amanyɔni.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Rita Tani yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ, a ɔsii akan wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani maa Gushegu mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Fam Mantam mu wɔ New Patriotic Party tekiti so . Ɔdii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ no mu a ne nyinaa yɛ 14,643 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 52.80% sene nea ɔne no reko, Iddrisu Hudu a ɔfiri National Democratic Congress a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 13,108 a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa a ɛgyina hɔ ma 47.20%, na ɛmaa ɔbɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma Fourth Parliament of the Fourth Republic of Ghana .

Ɔsan nso yɛɛ Ɔmanpanyin Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Asase, Kwae ne Atopae so a ɔhwɛ atopae adwuma no so wɔ Kufour nniso no mu.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Rita Tani yɛ Kristoni wɔ ɔsom mu.

Hwɛ nso 

 MP a wɔpaw wɔn wɔ afe 2004 Ghana mmrahyɛbagua abatow mu din
 Gushiegu (Ghana mmrahyɛbagua no mantam) .

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Samuel Johnfiah
text:
Samuel Johnfiah (wɔwoo no 9 September 1952) yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɔni a ɔyɛɛ mmrahyɛbadwani maa Ahanta West mantam wɔ Ghana republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 5 mu.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo no wɔ 9 September 1952. Ɔfiri Hotopo a ɛwɔ Ghana Atɔeɛ Mantam mu . Ɔnyaa ne National Diploma wɔ General Agriculture mu wɔ University of Ghana wɔ afe 1984.  Ɔsan nso nyaa ne Executive Masters wɔ Governance & Leadership (EMGL) mu wɔ Ghana Institute Management and Public Administration wɔ afe 2008.

Adwuma 
Ansa na ɔrebɛyɛ mmrahyɛbadwani no, na ɔyɛ Ahantaman Nkuraase Sikakorabea no panyin Abadiakyiri.

Amanyɔsɛm 
N’amammui adwuma hyɛɛ aseɛ wɔ afe 2001 mu berɛ a ɔdaa ne ho adi sɛ ɔdii nkonim wɔ afe 2000 Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ mu na ɔkaa ntam wɔ 7 Ɔbɛnem 2001. Ɔyɛɛ mmrahyɛbadwani a ɔgyinaa Ahanta West mantam ananmu wɔ Ghana republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 5 no mu.

Wɔpaw no wɔ afe 2008 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 20,871 wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata 38,798 a wɔtoo no nyinaa mu, a ɛne 53.8% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Joseph Jones Amoah a ofi National Democratic Congress, Comfort Amoo a ofi Democratic Freedom Party ne David Oscar Yawson a ofi Convention People’s Party mu. Eyinom nyaa abatow a ɛfata nyinaa mu 24.21%, 4.61% ne 17.38%.

Ɔhweree atenaeɛ no wɔ afe 2012 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu maa George Kwame Aboagye a ɔfiri National Democratic Congress . Ɔyɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni .

Wɔ afe 2000 mu no, Johnfiah dii nkonim wɔ amansan abatoɔ no mu sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani ma Ahanta West mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Atɔeɛ Mantam mu. Odii nkonim wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so . Na ne mansin no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 9 no fã wɔ nkongua 19 a New Patriotic Party no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Ghana Atɔe Fam Mantam no mu. New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 99 wɔ nkongua 200 mu.

Wɔde abatow a ɛfata a ne nyinaa yɛ 16,478 na ɛpaw no. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 60.90% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen William Cudjoe S. Kingsford a ofi National Democratic Congress, Joseph A. Eddie Mensah a ofi Convention People’s Party, Joseph Kweku Arthur a ofi People’s National Convention, Eva Parker a ofi National Reformed Party ne Joseph Jones Amoah a ofi United Ghana Anamɔntuo. Eyinom nyaa abatow 8,107, 1,358, 509, 416 ne 170 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne 30.00%, 5.00%, 1.90%, 1.50% ne 0.06% yɛ pɛ wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Johnfiah aware a ɔwɔ mma baanum. Ɔyɛ Kristoni na ɔyɛ Methodist Asɔre no muni .

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Stephen Cobbinah B. Karikari
text:
Stephen Cobbinah Buor-Karikar i yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɛni na ɔyɛ Fourth Republic mmrahyɛbagua a Ɛto so Abiɛsa no muni a ɔsom maa Amansie West mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana .

Amanyɔsɛm 
Na Buor-Karikar yɛ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no muni. Wɔpaw no wɔ afe 2000 Ghana amansan abatow mu a ogyinaa New Patriotic Party ananmu . Ɔnyaa abatoɔ 28,657 a egyina hɔ ma 77.82%.  Ɔhweree nkongua no wɔ afe 2004 mu maa Kofi Krah Mensah a ofi (NPP).

Adwuma 
Buor-Karikar yɛ kan mmrahyɛbaguani ma Amansie West mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti mantam mu wɔ Ghana.  Ansa na ɔrekɔ amammuisɛm mu no, na ɔyɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo wɔ Cape Coast Sukuupɔn mu .

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Benjamin Kumbuor
text:
Benjamin Bewa-Nyog Kumbuor yɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ Ghana Bammɔ Dwumadibea so na ɔyɛ Ghana amanyɔni . Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma Nandom mantam no.

Nwomasua 
Wɔbɔ amanneɛ sɛ ne din a etwa to nso ne Kunbuor. Kumbuor nyaa ne ntoaso sukuu wɔ Nandom Ntoaso Sukuu mu, onyaa ne LLB fii Ghana Sukuupɔn mu, na ɔfatae sɛ mmaranimfo bere a owiee Ghana Mmara Sukuu no .

Ɛno akyi no ɔkɔɔ Warwick Sukuupɔn a ɛwɔ United Kingdom no na onyaa ne LLM a ɛda nsow. Akyiri yi wɔmaa no Britania Chevening Scholarship sɛ ɔmfa nwie ne PhD wɔ Mmara mu wɔ Nkɔso mu (1997-2000).

Ɔsan nyaa Amannɔne Sukuufo Abasobɔde (OSSA) Oduruyɛfo Abasobɔde wɔ Warwick Sukuupɔn mu .

Adwuma 
Bere bi na Kumbuor yɛ adwuma sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo boafo a wawie sukuu wɔ Warwick Sukuupɔn a ɛwɔ United Kingdom no mu . Efi saa bere no wama ɔkasa nso wɔ Ghana Mmara Sukuu mu . Ɔsan nso ayɛ ɔkwankyerɛfoɔ wɔ Commission on Human Rights and Administrative Justice wɔ Ghana.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Kumbuor yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua no muni . Ɔdii kan gyinaa hɔ maa abatoɔ wɔ afe 2000 mmrahyɛbagua abatoɔ mu na ɔdii nkonim wɔ dodoɔ no ara mu 62.5%.  Ɔkuraa n’akongua so wɔ abatoɔ a ɛdi hɔ no mu mfeɛ nnan akyi, nanso ɔhweree wɔ afe 2008 abatoɔ no akyi berɛ a n’apam no san baa tumidi mu.  Wɔ afe 2009 mu no, George Yankey gyaee adwuma wɔ NDC aban mu wɔ adifudepɛ ho animguasesɛm bi akyi.  President Mills paw Kunbuor sɛ ne Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ Akwahosan so.

Wɔ nsakraeɛ a wɔyɛeɛ wɔ aban mpanyimfoɔ mu wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2011 akyi no, Ɔmanpanin Mills paw Kumbuor sɛ Ɔmanpanyin Mills sɛ Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ Mfinimfini no so.

Martin Amidu, Mmaranimfoɔ Panyin a ɔgyaee adwuma no akyi wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2012 mu no, Ɔmampanyin Mills paw Owura.Kunbuor sɛ Mmaranimfoɔ Panyin.

2000 Abatow a Wɔyɛe 
Wɔpaw Kumbuor sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani maa Lawra-Nandom mantam a ɛwɔ Upper West mantam mu wɔ Ghana wɔ afe 2000 Ghana amansan abatow mu.  Enti ɔgyinaa amansin no ananmu wɔ Ghana republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu.

Wɔde abatow a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 22,347 na ɛpaw no.  Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 74.40% yɛ pɛ.  " . Wɔpaw no sen Tenku Charles a ofi Peoples National Convention,Stephen Yir-Eru Engmen a ofi New Patriotic Party ne David Nandoh a ofi National Reform Party no so.

Eyinom nyaa abatow 2,2347, abatow 3,570, abatow 3,487 ne abatow 641.  Eyinom ne 74.40%, 11.90%, 11.60%, 2.10% yɛ pɛ wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu.  Wɔde National Democratic Congress tekiti na ɛpaw Kumbuor . National Democratic Congress no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 7 wɔ Upper West Region wɔ saa abatow no mu.

Sɛ yɛka ne nyinaa bom a, kuw no dii nkonim wɔ nnipa kakraa bi a wɔka bom yɛ mmrahyɛbagua ananmusifo 89 wɔ nkongua 200 a ɛwɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 3 a ɛwɔ Ghana man a ɛto so 4 no mu.

2004 Abatow a Wɔyɛe 
Wɔpaw Kunbuor sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani maa Lawra-Nandom mantam a ɛwɔ Upper West mantam mu wɔ Ghana wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow no mu .  Ɔnam saayɛ so gyinaa amansin no ananmu wɔ Ghana republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu.

Wɔde abatow 19,306 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 31,138 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 62.0% yɛ pɛ.  Wɔpaw no sen Bapullu Debis Dery a ofi Ɔmanfo Ɔman Nhyiam no mu, Dery Ambrose P a ofi Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no mu ne Seidu Adama Billah a ofi Nhyiam Nnipa Kuw no mu .

Eyinom nyaa abatow 912, abatow 10,549 ne abatow 371 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu.  Eyinom ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 2.9%, 33.9% ne 1.2% yɛ pɛ.  Wɔpaw Kunbuor wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so .

Na ne mansin no yɛ amansin 7 a National Democratic Congress dii nkonim wɔ Upper West mantam mu wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow mu no fa. National Democratic Congress no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua ananmusifo kakraa bi a wɔn dodow yɛ 94 wɔ nkongua 230 a na ɛwɔ Ghana man a ɛto so 4 no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 4 no mu .

Ankorankoro asetra 
Kunbuor aware na ɔwɔ mma baasa.

Hwɛ nso 

 Mahama aban asomfo din
 Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua (Ghana) .

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Gifty Eugenia Kwofie
text:
Gifty Eugenia Kusi (nee Kwofie) (wɔwoo no 11 Ɔpɛpɔn 1958) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni . Ɔyɛ Fourth Republic of Ghana mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan no muni wɔ Tarkwa-Nsuaem (Ghana parliament constituency) mu firi afe 2001 kɔsi afe 2017. Ɔsan nso yɛ nhwehwɛmu boafoɔ titire wɔ Community Health dwumadibea wɔ University of Ghana Medical Schoo l - Korle-Bu .

Mfitiase asetra 
Kusi (nee Kwofie) fi Nsuaem- Tarkwa a ɛwɔ Ghana Atɔe Fam Mantam mu .

Nwomasua 
Kusi nyaa Master of Philosophy abodin krataa wɔ Sociology mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu wɔ afe 1999.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Kusi aware a ɔwɔ mma baanan.  Ɔyɛ Kristoni a ɔkɔ Pentekoste Asɔre.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Kusi hyɛɛ n’adwuma ase wɔ amammuisɛm mu fi afe 2001, bere a ɔsii akan na odii nkonim wɔ mmrahyɛbaguani agua no so wɔ New Patriotic Party (NPP) tekiti so maa Tarkwa-Nsueam Mantam no.    Ɔkuraa Tarkwa-Nsueam Constituency atenaeɛ no mu mfeɛ 16, na ɛmaa ɔbɛyɛɛ 4th Republic of Ghana mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa, 4, 5, ne 6 no muni.   Ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party(NPP) Nteɛsoɔ Boayikuo,  Ghana mmrahyɛbagua Adwumayɛ Boayikuo,   Ghana mmrahyɛbagua Boayikuo a ɛhwɛ Bɔbeasu ne Mmofra so no muni.  ne Ghana mmrahyɛbagua no boayikuw a ɛhwɛ Akwahosan so.  Ɔyɛ Atɔe Fam mantam Ɔsoafo Abadiakyiri.        wɔn ho hyɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu.

Adwuma 
Na ɔyɛ Nhwehwɛmu Boafo Panyin wɔ Mpɔtam Akwahosan Dwumadibea a ɛwɔ UGMS . Ɔsan yɛɛ adwuma wɔ Korle-Bu Nkyerɛkyerɛ Ayaresabea .

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Stephen Amoanor Kwao
text:
Stephen Amoanor Kwao (wɔwoo no 12 September 1951) yɛ Ghana nhomasua ho nimdefo ne ɔmanyɔni . Ɔyɛ kan mmrahyɛbaguani ma Upper Manya mantam no na ɔyɛ Ɔman Soafo wɔ Ghana Ɔmampanyin Dwumadibea .     Ɔsan nso yɛ obi a na anka ɔyɛ Ghana Nhomasua adwuma no kwankyerɛfo abadiakyiri ne kan ɔman kyerɛwfo wɔ National Democratic Congress nso.  Ɔsan yɛ kan ɔsomfo a ɔhwɛ Adwumayɛ ne Asetra mu Yiyedi so.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Stephen Kwao wɔ 12 September 1951 wɔ Akrusu Saisi, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Manya Krobo Mantam mu wɔ Ghana Apuei Fam mantam mu .  Ne mfitiaseɛ nwomasua wɔ Akrusu Saisi Roman Katolek Mfitiaseɛ Sukuu ne Asesewa Roman Katolek Mfinimfini Sukuu. Ne ntoaso sukuu wɔ Saint Martin Ntoaso Sukuu a ɛwɔ Adoagyiri-Nsawam baabi a onyaa General Certificate of Education Ordinary Level wɔ afe 1971 mu. Na n’akyerɛkyerɛfo ntetee titiriw no wɔ Mount Mary Training College a ɛwɔ Somanya-Krobo wɔ Apuei Fam Mantam mu. Afei ɔkɔɔ nea mprempren wɔfrɛ no Nhomasua Sukuupɔn, Winneba wɔ 1992 ne 1996 ntam hɔ, na onyaa nhomasua ho adansedi krataa. Owiee Bachelor of Education abodin krataa wɔ 1999 mu wɔ saa sukuu koro no ara mu.

Nhomasua adwuma 
Stephen Kwao yɛ sukuu panyin boafo wɔ Asesewaa Roman Katolek sukuu ahorow mu wɔ 1977 ne 1985 ntam hɔ. Ɔbɛyɛɛ Asesewa Roman Catholic Complex Junior Secondary School no panyin wɔ 1987 ne 1992 ntam hɔ. Bere a owiee ne nhomasua ho adansedi krataa no, ɔkyerɛɛ ade wɔ Krobo Mmabaa Ntoaso Sukuu mu mfe abien. Wɔ 1999 mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ Dzomoa Roman Katolek Mmofra Ntoaso Sukuu no panyin boafo. Akyiri yi ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔkwankyerɛfo abadiakyiri wɔ Ghana Nhomasua Dwumadibea .

Amanyɔsɛm 
Kwao bɛyɛɛ nnam wɔ akuw amammuisɛm mu fi bere a Republic a ɛto so anan no fii ase. Ɔyɛ Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua (NDC) no amansin guamtrani wɔ afe 1992 ne 1993 ntam  Ɔde NDC tekiti sii akan wɔ afe 2000 Ghana mmrahyɛbagua abatow no mu, na odii nkonim 8,644.   Ɔdii nkonim wɔ n’akongua mu wɔ December 2004 abatoɔ no mu a ne nyinaa yɛ 15,764 a ɛyɛ 60.90% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu.   Ɔkɔɔ so kuraa n’akongua so bio wɔ afe 2008 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu a ne nyinaa yɛ 14,398 a ɛyɛ 66.87% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoo no nyinaa mu.  Wɔ afe 2009 mu no, Ɔmampanyin Mills paw Kwao sɛ Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ Adwumayɛ ne Asetra mu Yiyedi so. Wɔde no kɔɔ Ɔmampanyin Dwumadibea sɛ Ɔman Soafo wɔ aban mpanyimfo nsakrae mu wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2010.

Ankorɛankorɛ 
Stephen Kwao yɛ Kristoni na waware na ɔwɔ mma baanan.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Adams Ebenezer Mahama
text:
Adams Ebenezer Mahama yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɔni na na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbadwani ma Mion mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi fam mantam mu . Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbadwani wɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Mahama yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua no muni . Wɔpaw no sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani maa Mion mantam a ɛwɔ Atifi fam mantam mu wɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no mu. Ahmed Alhassan Yakubu na odii n'ade wɔ afe 2004 Ghana Amansan abatow mu .

Wɔpaw Mahama sɛ mmrahyɛbagua muni maa Mion mantam no wɔ afe 2000 Ghana amansan abatow no mu . Wɔpaw no wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so. Na ne mansin no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 18 no fã wɔ nkongua 23 a National Democratic Congress dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Atifi Fam Mantam no mu.    National Democratic Congress dii nkonim kakraa bi a ne nyinaa yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 92 wɔ nkongua 200 a ɛwɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa a ɛwɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu.  Wɔde abatow 6,125 paw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 20,706 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 31.8% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Alabira Ibrahim a ofi Convention People’s Party, Iddisah K. Jacob a ofi People’s National Convention, Prince A. Baako a ofi New Patriotic Party, Emmanuel B. Lag a ɔyɛ ɔkannifo a ɔde ne ho ne Stephen O. Yacham a ofi Ɔman Nsakrae Kuw no mu.   Eyinom nyaa abatow 5,578, 3,055, 2,964, 969 ne 559 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne 29.0%, 15.9%, 15.4%, 5.0ne 2.9% yɛ pɛ wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Samuel Nyimakan
text:
Samuel Nyimakan yɛ Ghana amanyɔni na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbagua a Ɛtɔ so Anan no muni a ɔgyina Wulensi Mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Mantam mu.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Samuel wɔ Wulensi, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Mantam mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔdii kan paw Samuel sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ mmrahyɛbagua no wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so wɔ December 2000 Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ a ɔgyinaa Wulensi Mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Mantam mu no ananmu.  Ɔnyaa abatoɔ 9,537 wɔ abatoɔ 17,536 a ɛfata a wɔtoo no mu a egyina hɔ ma 54.40%.  Na ne mansin no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 16 no fã wɔ nkongua 21 a National Democratic Congress dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Atifi Fam Mantam no mu.  Wɔpaw no sen Alhaji Sani Iddi a ofi Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no mu, Binyam S.Jangboja a ofi Ɔman Nsakrae Kuw no mu ne Ayi Abudu-Rhaman a ofi Convention Peoples Party no mu .  Saa akansifoɔ yi nyaa 6,884, 837ne 278. Eyinom ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 39.30%, 4.80% ne 1.60% yɛ pɛ.

Wɔamma Samuel sɛ ɔngyina hɔ sɛ obi a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔpaw no wɔ Wulensi Mantam mu wɔ afe 2003.

Adwuma 
Samuel yɛ obi a na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma Wulensi Mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi mantam mu fi afe 2001 kosi afe 2005.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Francis Yaw Osei Sarfo
text:
Francis Yaw Osei Sarfo yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɛni a ɔyɛɛ mmarahyɛbedwani wɔ Krachi West Constituency .

Mfitiase asetena ne nnwomasua 
Wɔwoo Francis wɔ Ahinime 1, 1955.  Ɔfiri Bejamse, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ Ghana . Ɔnyaa ne BA wɔ Amanyɔsɛm ne Asase Ho Adesua mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu wɔ afe 1981.  Na ɔwɔ ne PLC nso fi Ghana Mmara Sukuu mu .

Adwuma 
Ɔyɛ adwuma sohwɛfo.  Ná ɔyɛ Akpabe Impex Limited adwumakuo no kwankyerɛfo panyin. Ɔsan nso yɛ Ɔmantam Panyin firi September 1996 kosi January 2001.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ɔka NDC amanyokuo ho.  Na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbedwaani ma Krachi West Constituency a ɛwɔ Volta mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

2004 Abato a Wɔyɛe 
Wɔpaa Sarfo sɛ mmarahyɛbedwaani maa Krachi West mantam no wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abato no mu .  Enti na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbedwani ma Krachi West mantam no wɔ mmarahyɛbedwa a ɛto so anan a ɛwɔ Ghana man a ɛto so nan no mu. 

Wɔde abato 15,687 na ɛpaa no wɔ abato a ɛfata a wɔtoo nyinaa mu 34,952 mu. Eyi ne abato a ɛfata nyinaa mu 44.9% yɛ pɛ.  Wɔpaa no sen Kofi Tarkum a ofi Nnipa Ɔman Nhyiam no mu, Kofi Mensah Demitia a ofi Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuo Foforo no mu ; ne Alhaji Abu Safiano Baba, Owusu Michael Kwasi ne Apraku Kwadwo Sampson- wɔn nyinaa yɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho. Eyinom nyaa abato a ɛfata a wɔtoo no nyinaa mu 23%, 25.4%,5.1%, 0.3% ne 1.3%. 

Wɔpaa Sarfo wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so . Na ne mantam no yɛ amansin 21 a National Democratic Congress dii nkunim wɔ Greater Accra mantam mu wɔ saa abato no mu no fã.  

Sɛ wɔka ne nyinaa bom a, National Democratic Congress no nyaa mmarahyɛbedwa akonnwa 94 wɔ Ghana man a ɛto so nan no mmarahyɛbedwaa a ɛto so nan no mu .

Ankorankoro asetena 
Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma mmienu. Ɔda ne ho adi sɛ ɔyɛ Kristoni.
