title: Abubakar Boniface Siddique
text:
Abu-Bakar Siddique Boniface (a wɔsan yɛ no: Abubakar Saddique Boniface) (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn 14, 1960) yɛ Ghana ɔmanpanyin na mprempren ɔyɛ Ɔmanpanyin wɔ Ɔmampanyin Abadiakyiri Dwumadibea ne kan ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ nkurow a ɛwɔ Mfinimfini ne Zongo Nkɔso so.    Na ɔyɛ Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ Mmabun, Adwumayɛ, ne Adwumayɛ so (Nnipa, Mmabun ne Adwumayɛ) wɔ afe 2005 ne July 2007 ntam. Wɔ August 2007 mu no, Boniface kɔkaa Ministry of Water Resources, Public Works and Housing ho sɛ aban soafo .

Amanyɔsɛm 
Abu-Bakar Saddique Boniface a ofi New Patriotic Party, yɛ Ghana republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan no muni a wɔpaw no wɔ afe 2004 mu wɔ Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu maa salaga mantam no na ɔsan yɛ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa a ɛwɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan a wɔpaw no wɔ afe 2000 mu no muni Ghana ɔsahene abatow a nnipa dodow no ara na wɔtow aba 1821. Ɔgyee atenaeɛ no firii Hamidu Baba Braimah a ɔwɔ National Democratic Congress hɔ saa berɛ yi a na ɔyɛ Independent. Wɔ n’amammui adwuma mu no, Alhaji Abubakar Saddique Boniface ahyɛ bɔ sɛ ɔde nsi bɛyɛ n’asɛdeɛ - sɛ Ɔman Ɔsoafoɔ na ɔne Zongofoɔ nyinaa adi no yie ɛmfa ho sɛ wɔn nyamesom, mmusuakuo ne asetena mu nsonsonoeɛ wɔ hɔ.

Nwomasua 
Abu-Bakar Saddique Boniface kɔɔ sukuu wɔ Exeter Sukuupɔn mu baabi a onyaa ne master of Arts wɔ Sikasɛm mu na ɛno akyi no ɔkɔɔ Kwame Nkrumah Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma Sukuupɔn mu . Abu-Bakar Saddique Boniface yɛ Sikasɛm ho ɔbenfoɔ ne Ɔman Adwumayɛfoɔ.

Adwuma 
Abu-Bakar Saddique Boniface yɛ Sikasɛm ho ɔbenfoɔ ne Ɔman Adwumayɛfoɔ.

Nhoma ahorow 

 Nkuraase adan ho haw ahorow wɔ Ghana (Kpandai ho nhwehwɛmu) .
 Dwuma a Amannɔne Mmoa Di wɔ Nhyehyɛe mu Nsakrae Dwumadi Mu (Ghana sɛ asɛm a wɔayɛ ho nhwehwɛmu) .
 UK Retail Banking Industry ho nhwehwɛmu ne Retail Banks Abiɛsa Adwumayɛ Nhwehwɛmu

Abusua 
Boniface yɛ Nkramofo, waware a ɔwɔ mma baasa.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Alex Seidu Sofo
text:
Alex Seidu Sofo (2 Ɔpɛpɔn 1950 – 9 Ɔbɛnem 2020) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni. Ɔyɛɛ mmrahyɛbadwani maa Damango-Daboya mantam.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Sofo wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2, 1950, na ɔyɛ kuromni a ofi Busunu wɔ mprempren Savannah Mantam mu.  Ɔnyaa ne Teachers’ certificate A wɔ Nhomasua mu.

Adwuma 
Ná Sofo yɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo wɔ n’adwuma mu. Na ɔsan yɛ Ɔpanyin a ofi Busunu Amammerɛ Mpɔtam (Ɔpanyin Mfrawura).

Amammui mu adwuma 
Sofo yɛ Assemblyman ma Ngbaripe/Hangaline Electoral Area ansa na ɔredi nkonim wɔ afe 2000 Ghana mmrahyɛbagua abatow mu wɔ New Patriotic Party (NPP) tekiti so.   Ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani a ɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa ma Damongo-Daboya Mantam a ɔdii Hon Mahama Shakan ananmu.  Ɔbɛyɛɛ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no muni wɔ afe 2000 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu maa saa berɛ no Damongo-Daboya Mantam no mu na ɔsan nso yɛɛ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan a ɛwɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu wɔ afe 2004 Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ no mu maa saa ara amansin a ɛwɔ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no tekiti so .

Ɔsan nso yɛ Kan Ɔmanpanyin Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ akwan ne akwan akɛse so wɔ kan Ɔmampanyin John Agyekum Kufuor nniso ase.

Abatow a wɔyɛ 
Wɔpaw Sofo sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani maa saa bere no Damongo-Daboya Mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Mantam mu wɔ afe 2000 Ghana amansan abatow mu bere a ɔsom sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani maa Ngbaripe/Hangaline Abatow Mpɔtam a na abatow nyinaa yɛ 8,012 a egyina hɔ ma 45.90% sen ne de no asɔretiafo; Nelson Y. Yakubu a ofi National Democratic Congress a na ɔwɔ abatoɔ 7,665 a ɛgyina hɔ ma abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 43.90%, Abudulai Adams a ɔfiri People’s National Convention a ɔno nso too abatoɔ 703 a ɛgyina hɔ ma abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 4.00%, Alidu Mahama a ɔfiri Convention People’s Party a ɔdii abatoɔ 549 a ɛgyina hɔ ma abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 3.10%, Ewuntomah C. Boreche a ɔfiri National Reform Party mu a ɔno nso nyaa 377 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 2.20% ne Skido A. Ewuntomah a ɔfiri United Ghana Movement a ɔnyaa 143 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 0.80% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu . Wɔsan paw no sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani ma Damango-Daboya mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Fam Mantam mu wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow no mu . Odii nkonim wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so . Ná ne mansin no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 8 no fã wɔ nkongua 26 a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Atifi Fam Mantam no mu .  New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 128 wɔ nkongua 230 mu.  Wɔde abatoɔ 11,975 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 24,723 a ɛne abatoɔ a ɛfata nyinaa mu 48.4% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Benedict Kpeno a ofi Ɔmanfo Ɔman Nhyiam no mu, Ykubu Nelson Nyiniefo a ofi Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua no mu, Alidu Mahama a ofi Convention People’s Party mu ne Skido Alhassan a ofi Every Ghanaian Living Everywhere kuw no mu. Eyinom nyaa abatow a ɛfata nyinaa mu 2.1%, 47.2%, 1.5% ne 0.7%.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Na ɔyɛ Kristoni .

Owuo 
Ɔwui wɔ Ɔbɛnem 9, 2020, wɔ West Gonja District Hospital baabi a na ɔrenya ayaresa.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Abubakari Sumani
text:
Abukari Sumani (wɔwoo no 28 April 1946) yɛ kan Mmaranimni ne Ghana ananmusifo wɔ Saudi Arabia, Pakistan ne Gulf aman mu .  Na ɔsan yɛ amanyɔni ne kan mmrahyɛbadwani ma Tamale Atifi Mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Mantam mu.

Owui wɔ Korle-Bu Nkyerɛkyerɛ Ayaresabea wɔ Kwasida 12 Ɔbɛnem 2017.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Sumani wɔ afe 1946 mu wɔ Savelugu wɔ Ghana Atifi Fam Mantam mu . Ɔsuaa LLB wɔ mmara mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu wɔ afe 1970 mu na akyiri yi ɔkɔɔ Ghana Mmara Sukuu mu kɔnyaa BL wɔ afe 1972.  Ná Sumani yɛ Dagbon adehye abusua no muni na na anka ɔyɛ Ɔmanfo Adetɔ Dwumadibea no baguafo guamtrani.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Na Sumani yɛ Ghana republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 5 no muni. N’amammui adwuma fii ase wɔ afe 2000 mu bere a ɔbɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbadwani maa Tishigu/ Choggu mantam no sɛ National Democratic Congress muni no .  Ɔsan sii akan wɔ afe 2004 Amansan Abatoɔ mu sɛ obi a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔdi nkonim wɔ Tamale North mantam mu na ɔdii nkonim a ne nyinaa yɛ 37,854 abatoɔ a ɛyɛ 73.2% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu.  Ɔkuraa n’akongua no ne mprɛnsa so wɔ afe 2008 mu a ne nyinaa yɛ 31,127 abatoɔ a ɛyɛ 51.60% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoo no nyinaa mu.  Ɔsii akan wɔ afe 2012 abatoɔ no mu na ɔdii nkoguo wɔ Candidate a ɔde ne ho Dahamani Alhassan anim.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Na Sumani yɛ Muslimi na na waware na ɔwɔ mma du.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Emmanuel Kinsford Kwesi Teye
text:
Emmanuel Kinsford Kwesi Teye yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɔni na na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbadwani ma Ashaiman mantam a ɛwɔ Greater Accra mantam mu wɔ Ghana . Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbadwani wɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Teye yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni. Wɔpaw no sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani ma Ashaiman mantam a ɛwɔ Greater Accra mantam mu wɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no mu. Kwame Alfred Agbesi na odii n’ade wɔ afe 2004 Ghana Amansan abatow mu.

Abatow a wɔyɛ 
Wɔpaw Teye sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani maa Ashaiman mantam no wɔ afe 2000 Ghana amansan abatow no mu . Wɔpaw no wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so . Na ne mansin no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 16 no fã wɔ nkongua 22 a New Patriotic Party no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Greater Accra Mantam no mu.    New Patriotic Party no nyaa dodow no ara a ɛyɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua ɔha wɔ nkongua 200 a ɛwɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 3 a ɛwɔ Ghana man a ɛto so 4 no mu.  Wɔde abatow 21,894 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 60,083 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 36.9% yɛ pɛ.  Wɔpaw no sen Alfred Kwame Agbesi ne Nana Kwame Aboagye-Asare,akannifoɔ mmienu a wɔde wɔn ho, Franklin WK Aheto a ɔfiri National Democratic Congress, Doli Tetteh a ɔfiri People’s National Convention, Emmanuel Osabutey a ɔfiri National Reform Party, Samuel Korku Amegah a ɔfiri United Ghana Movement ne Joseph-Willis Kugblenu Doku a ɔwɔ Nhyiam Nnipa Kuw no mu . Eyinom nyaa abatow 20,088, 741, 12,607, 1,134, 1,115, 922, ne 874 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne 33.8%, 1.2%, 1.9%, 1.9%,1.6%, ne 1.5% yɛ pɛ wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Seth Dankwa Wiafe
text:
Seth Dankwa Wiafe yɛ Ghana Amanyɔni na ɔyɛ Fourth Republic of Ghana mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no muni.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Wiafe wɔ Akwapim South wɔ Ghana Apuei Fam . Ɔyɛ mmaranimfoɔ ne General Council Ghana Bar Association no muni.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔdii kan paw Wiafe sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ mmrahyɛbagua no wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so wɔ afe 2000 Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ a ɔgyinaa Akwapim South Constituency ananmu no mu. Na ɔyɛ Ghana republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no muni. Ɔnyaa abatoɔ 22,328 wɔ abatoɔ 39,955 a ɛfata a wɔtoo a egyina hɔ ma 55.9% no mu.  National Democratic Congress dii nkonim kakraa bi a ne nyinaa yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 92 wɔ nkongua 200 a ɛwɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa a ɛwɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu.  Wɔboroo no wɔ afe 2004 abatoɔ no mu wɔ Magnus Opare-Asamoah ( NPP ) 0.70% tiaa 56%.  Wɔ n’amammui adwuma mu no, na Wiafe ne ne Ɔmantam Panyin (DCE), Andrew Y. Nyarko-Adu, wɔ wɔn ho wɔn ho menewam wɔ adanmude ne nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn nnua a mmara mma ho kwan a wɔdan kɔ baabi foforo ho.

Adwuma 
Wiafe yɛ Kan mmrahyɛbaguani a ɔhwɛ Akwapim Anafoɔ Mansin mu wɔ Ghana Apueeɛ Mantam mu firi afe 2001 kɔsi afe 2005.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Prince Jacob Hayibor
text:
Prince Jacob Hayibor (12 September 1962 – 2016) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni a ɔyɛɛ mmrahyɛbadwani ma Hohoe North Constituency wɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Hayibor wɔ 12 September 1962 na ɔfiri Gbi-Wegbe, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔnyaa ne Master of Art wɔ Borɔfo kasa mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu wɔ afe 1996.  Ɔsan nyaa ne Post Graduate Diploma wɔ Nhomasua mu wɔ Cape Coast Sukuupɔn mu wɔ afe 2001.  Ɔsan nso nyaa ne Executive Masters wɔ Aban ne Akannifoɔ mu wɔ Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration wɔ afe 2008.

Adwuma 
Na Hayib yɛ Nhomasua ho Ɔbenfo . Na ɔyɛ Ɔhwɛfo Panyin ne ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo wɔ Obuasi Ntoaso/Mfiridwuma Sukuu mu .

Amanyɔsɛm 
Na Hayib yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi Bagua no muni . Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbadwani ma Hohoe North Constituency a ɛwɔ Volta mantam mu wɔ Ghana.     Ná ɔyɛ kan Savannah Accelerated Development Authority no Titenani.  Ɔdii nkonim 28,169 wɔ abatoɔ 38,315 mu valid votes caste a egyina hɔ ma 73.5%. Ɔdii nkonim tiaa John-Peter Amewu a ɔfiri New Patriotic Party no mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 8,225 a ɛgyina hɔ ma abatoɔ no mu 21.5% Mordzinu Benedictus Kwaku a ɔfiri Democratic Freedom Party no mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 1,242 gyinaa hɔ maa 3.2%, Paul Robert Addo a ɔfiri Convention Peoples Party no nyaa abatoɔ 366 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 1% . ne Victor Nyaxo a ofi Peoples National Convention a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 314 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 0.8%.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Na Hayibor aware a ɔwɔ mma baanan. Na ɔyɛ Kristoni na na ɔyɛ Seventh Day Adventist Asɔre no muni .

Owuo 
Hayibor wui wɔ afe 2016 mu, bere a na wadi mfe 54.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Clement Kofi Humado
text:
Clement Kofi Humado (wɔwoo no 18 December 1953) yɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma Anlo mantam wɔ Ghana . Ɔsan nso yɛ kan Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ Aduan ne Kuadwuma so wɔ Ghana.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Humado was born to the late John Kobla Humado and his wife Grace Abla Humado. They both hailed from Alakple in the Keta Municipality of the Volta Region of Ghana. He graduated from the University of Ghana at Legon in 1976 where he studied Animal Science and Agricultural Extension. He obtained a Graduate Diploma in Agricultural Administration four years later at the same university. In 1985, he completed a Certificate in Monitoring and Evaluation of Public Sector Projects and Programmes course at the University of East Anglia, Norwich, England. He also did other Certificate coursed in 1989 at the Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration and in Finance in 1998 at the University of Reading in the United Kingdom.

Adwuma 
Humado ayɛ adwuma wɔ nnwuma ahorow mu ne sɛ ɔfotufo wɔ kuayɛ ne sikasɛm mu wɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow te sɛ U SAID WEST ADRICA mu.  Ɔsan nso yɛ Head monitoring and Evaluation Deputy Project manager wɔ Amanaman Ntam Sikakorabea a ɛhwɛ Kuadwuma Nkɔso so fi 1991 kosi 1999. Ɔsan nso yɛ Ɔman Panyin a ɔhwɛ Wiase Aduan Dwumadi So fi 1990 kosi 1991.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ɔkɔɔ amammuisɛm mu wɔ afe 2000 mu bere a ɔde ne ho kɔbɔɔ National Democratic Congress baa dwumadibea a ɛwɔ Alakple no . Odii nkonim wɔ Anlo mmrahyɛbagua no mu wɔ December 2004 mmrahyɛbagua abatow no mu .  Ɔmampanyin Mills na ɔpaw no bere a wɔreyɛ nsakrae wɔ aban mpanyimfo kuw mu wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2011.  Kan Ɔmampanyin Atta-Mills nso paw no sɛ Ɔsomfo a ɔhwɛ mmabun ne Agumadi so .  Ná ɔyɛ kan Kuadwuma ho Ɔsoafo.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ɔyɛ Kristoni na ɔsom sɛ Katolekni. Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma 5.

Hwɛ nso 

 Anlo (Ghana mmrahyɛbagua no mantam) .
 Mills aban asomfo din a wɔahyehyɛ
 Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Abdul-Rauf Tanko Ibrahim
text:
Abdul-Rauf Tanko Ibrahim yɛ Ghana amanyɔni, Development Planner/ Architect, Quantity Surveyor  na ɔyɛ Fourth Republic of Ghana mmrahyɛbagua a Ɛto so Anan, Anum ne Nson   a ɔgyina Yagaba-Kubori Mansin ananmu wɔ North Eastt Region of Ghana wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Abdul-Rauf Ibrahim wɔ 10 Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 1968. Ɔfiri Yagaba a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Apueeɛ Mantam mu. Ɔkɔɔ Navrongo Ntoaso Sukuu a ɔnyaa ne GCE ‘A’ Level Certificate wɔ afe 1989.

Adwuma 
Abdul-Rauf Ibrahim yɛ Tass Kalia Enterprise Limited no kwankyerɛfoɔ panin firi afe 1983 kɔsi afe 2016.   Ɔsan nso yɛ Hajj Chairman wɔ Office of the President firi afe 2013 kɔsi 2016. Ɔyɛ Nkɔso Nhyehyɛefo, Ɔdansifo ne Dodow Nhwehwɛmufo .

Amanyɔsɛm 
Abdul-Rauf Ibrahim yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbaguani. Ɔsii akan na ɔdii nkonim wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so maa Yagaba-Kubori mantam a na ɛyɛ amansin foforɔ a na abatoɔ 6,460 wɔ abatoɔ 12,080 a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ no mu ma enti ɛyɛ 53.5%.  Ɔkuraa n’akongua no mu na ɔbɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbagua a Ɛto so Anum a ɛwɔ Ghana Aman a Ɛto so Anan no muni wɔ afe 2008 mu. Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔhweree n’akongua sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani wɔ afe 2012 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu maa Ussif Mustapha a ɔfiri asɔretiafoɔ Kuo, New Patriotic Party . Ɔsan gyinaa hɔ bio wɔ afe 2016 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu na ɔdii nkonim. Ɛno nti, ɔbɛyɛɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanyin a Ɛto so Anan no mmrahyɛbagua a Ɛto so Ason no muni wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so .

Na ɔka Atemmuo boayikuo no mufoɔ aduonu baako (21) nso ho,  na ɔka Boayikuo a ɛhwɛ Akwan ne akwantuo so a emufoɔ dunan a wɔwɔ nsɛm a ɛfa Akwan ne akwantuo ho nyinaa wɔ ɔkwan a ɛkɔ akyiri so no ho.  Na ɔyɛ Daa Nhyehyɛe Boayikuw no muni nso.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Abdul-Rauf Ibrahim aware a ɔwɔ mma baanum . Ɔyɛ Muslimi wɔ nyamesom mu.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Haruna Iddrisu
text:
Haruna Iddrisu (wɔwoo no 8 September 1970) yɛ Ghana mmaranimni ne amanyɔni a ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbagua a Ɛto so Ason a ɛwɔ Ghana Republic a Ɛto so Anan no muni a ogyina Tamale South ananmu.  Na ɔyɛ Minority Leader wɔ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua no mu ɛfiri Ɔpɛpɔn 2017 na Ato Forson na ɛbɛdi adeɛ.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Haruna Iddrisu wɔ afe 1970 mu wɔ Tamale, Ghana. Iddrisu suaa adeɛ wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu wɔ afe 1993 ne 1997 ntam hɔ baabi a ɔnyaa BA (Hons) wɔ Asetena Ho Adesua mu.  Na ɔyɛ nnam wɔ asuafoɔ amammuisɛm mu na na ɔyɛ Ɔman Nkabom Kuo a ɛwɔ Ghana Sukuufoɔ Kuo no Titenani wɔ n’afe a ɛtwa toɔ no mu. Iddrisu nso yɛ mmaranimfoɔ na wayɛ Ghana Mmaranimfoɔ Kuo no muni firi afe 2002.

Amammui mu adwuma 
Bere a ɔyɛɛ sukuuni kannifo mfe pii wɔ ne sukuupɔn bere mu no, Iddrisu dan kɔɔ ɔman amammuisɛm titiriw mu na ɔsɔre bɛyɛɛ Ɔman Mmabun Nhyehyɛefo ma Ɔman Demokrasi Nhyiam no wɔ afe 2002.  Ɔdii saa dibea no mfeɛ 8 mpo berɛ a na ɔyɛ Nkitahodiɛ soafoɔ kɔsii sɛ ɔgyaee adwuma wɔ afe 2010 mu na wanhwehwɛ sɛ wɔbɛsan apaw no bio.

Sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani 
Ɔgyinaa MP ananmu wɔ afe 2004 mmrahyɛbagua abatoɔ mu wɔ Tamale South mantam a na wɔhyehyɛɛ no foforɔ saa berɛ no.  Iddrisu yɛɛ Ranking Member of the Parliamentary Select Committee on Communications na ɔsan nso yɛɛ Minority Spokesman on Communications wɔ Parliament a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu berɛ a National Democratic Congress ,n’apam no sɔre tia.

Ɔkuraa n’akongua wɔ afe 2008 mmrahyɛbagua abatoɔ no mu denam abatoɔ a wɔtoo no nyinaa mu 78.2% a ɔnyaeɛ no so.  Ɔsan kuraa n’akongua so wɔ afe 2012 mmrahyɛbagua abatoɔ no mu denam abatoɔ a wɔtoo no nyinaa mu 74.6% a ɔnyaeɛ no so.

Ɛwom sɛ n’apam no dii nkogu wɔ Presidential Elections no mu deɛ, nanso Haruna kuraa n’akongua so wɔ afe 2016 Abatoɔ no mu na wɔpaw no sɛ ɔnni minority caucus no anim sɛ Minority Leader wɔ 7th Parliament of the 4th Republic wɔ Ghana.

Haruna Iddrisu wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2020 mu, de CHPS compound bi maa Duunyin mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a wɔwɔ Ghana Atifi fam mantam mu sɛ wɔmfa akwahosan ho dwumadie mma ahiafoɔ a wɔwɔ mpɔtam hɔ.

Sɛ ɔman soafo 
Ɔayɛ dibea ahodoɔ wɔ aban mu, a nea ɛka ho ne Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ Nkitahodiɛ so wɔ Mills ne Mahama aban ase ne Ɔmanpanin a ɔhwɛ Aguadiɛ so wɔ afe 2013 ne 2014 ntam. Ɔmampanyin Mahama paw no sɛ Ɔmanpanyin Mahama paw no sɛ Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ Adwumayɛ ne Adwumayɛfo Ntam Nkitahodi so wɔ July 2014.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ɔyɛ Muslimi warefoɔ, ɔwɔ mma 3 na ɔfiri Northern Region of Ghana.

Hwɛ nso 

 Mills aban asomfo din a wɔahyehyɛ
 Mahama aban asomfo din
 Tamale South mantam mu
 Data Ho Banbɔ Mmara, 2012 (Mmara 843) – Ghana

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Mohammed Jagri
text:
Mohammed Jagri yɛ Ghana amanyɔni, na ɔyɛ ntamgyinafo. Ɔyɛɛ mmrahyɛbadwani maa Zabzugu-Tatale mantam a ɛwɔ Atifi Mantam no mu .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Mohammed Jagri wɔ 12 Ɔpɛpɔn 1974. Ɔnyaa ne adansedie krataa wɔ Yendi Senior High School.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 4 a ɛwɔ republic a ɛto so 4 no muni. Ɔdii n'akongua wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu wɔ tekiti a ɛfiri National Democratic Congress no so .   Wɔde abatow 16543 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 50.9% yɛ pɛ.  Wɔpaw no sen Jabaah John Bennam a ofi Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no mu ne Adam Kuperi Lagnaboon a ofi Nnipa Ɔman Nhyiam no mu.  Eyinom nyaa abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 47.8% ne 1.3%.  Nnipa a wɔtow aba wɔ saa mantam no mu maa saa abatow no daa ‘ahyɛnsode ne blouse’ abatow adi efisɛ ɔmampanyin a ɔpɛ sɛ odi nkonim wɔ ɔmantam no mu ne John Kuffour a ofi ɔsɔretia kuw kɛse a wɔfrɛ no New Patriotic Party no mu.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ɔyɛ Nkramoni.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Maxwell Kofi Jumah
text:
Maxwell Kofi Jumah (wɔwoo no 26 June 1950) Ɔyɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne kan Kumasi Mayor, kan mmrahyɛbaguani ma Asokwa Mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Jumah fi Amakom Antoa a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana .  Wɔwoo no June 26, 1950 wɔ ne kurom.  Kofi Jumah wɔ Master wɔ Adwumayɛ ho Abodin krataa wɔ Sikasɛm ne Amanaman Ntam Adwumayɛ mu wɔ Rutgers Sukuupɔn Graduate School of Management, United States of America wɔ afe 1983.  Ɔyɛ Prempeh College sukuuni dedaw .

Adwuma 
Jumah yɛɛ adwuma sɛ Ghana Distilleries Company Limited (GDCL) no kwankyerɛfo panyin

Amammui mu adwuma 
Wɔ May 2001 mu no, Ghana Ɔmanpanyin a na ɔwɔ hɔ saa bere no, John Agyekum Kufuor, paw Jumah sɛ Kumasi Kuropɔn Bagua no Kumasi Panyin . Afei ɔkɔɔ so gyinaa Asokwa Mansin ananmu bere a odii nkonim wɔ ne abatow mu wɔ afe 2004 Ghana Amansan Abatow mu no . Ɔkɔɔ so gyinaa ne Mansin ananmu wɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 5 mu wɔ berɛ a wɔsan paw no wɔ afe 2008 Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ no mu akyi .  Wɔ August 2007 mu no, Ghana Ɔmanpanyin, John Agyekum Kufuor kaa ntam sɛ mpɔtam hɔ aban nkuraase ne nkɔsoɔ soafoɔ abadiakyiri.   Ɔsomm wɔ saa dwumadie no mu kɔsii 6 Ɔbɛnem 2009 berɛ a wɔde tumi maa John Evan Atta Mills aban no.

Abatow a wɔyɛ 
Wɔpaw Jumah sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani mma Asokwa mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana nea edi kan wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow no mu.   Odii nkonim wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so.   Na ne mansin no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 36 no fã wɔ nkongua 39 a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Ashanti Mantam no mu.  New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 128 wɔ nkongua 230 mu.  Wɔde abatow 42,942 paw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 55,771 mu.   Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 77% yɛ pɛ.   Wɔpaw no sen Mahama Nyaba a ofi Ɔmanfo Ɔman Nhyiam, Ishmael Butler a ofi Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua, Peter Amankwa a ofi Nhyiam Nnipa Kuw ne Kobina Amo-Aidoo a ɔyɛ ɔkannifo a ɔde ne ho.   Eyinom nyaa abatow 660, 9,155, 512 ne 2,502 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 1.2%, 16.4%, 0.9% ne 4.5% yɛ pɛ.

Wɔ afe 2008 mu no, odii nkonim wɔ amansan abatow no mu wɔ New Patriotic Party tekiti so maa ɔmansin koro no ara. Ná ne mansin no ka mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 34 a ɛwɔ nkongua 39 a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Ashanti Mantam no mu no ho .  New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 109 wɔ nkongua 230 mu.  Wɔde abatow 34,801 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 55,819 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 62.35% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Kwaku Baah Bonsu a ofi National Democratic Congress ne Gyimah Akwanuasah a ɔyɛ obi a ɔde ne ho. Eyinom nyaa abatow 7,653 ne 13,365 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne abatow a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 13.71% ne 23.94% yɛ pɛ.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Jumah aware a ɔwɔ mma 5.  Ɔyɛ Kristoni.

Nidi ne abasobɔde ahorow 
Wɔ June 2019 mu no, wɔmaa Jumah abasobɔdeɛ wɔ Ghana Manufacturers Awards a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa no mu sɛ adwumayɛfoɔ panin (CEO) a ɔsen biara wɔ Afe no mu wɔ adwuma a ɔyɛeɛ wɔ Best GIHOC Distilleries Company Limited.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Imoro Yakubu Kakpagu
text:
Imoro Yakubu Kakpagu (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn 1958) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni na na ɔyɛ Ghana mmrahyɛbaguani ma Kumbungu mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Mantam mu firi afe 2005 kɔsi afe 2013.  Ɔyɛ Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua no muni .Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Kakpagu wɔ Kumbungu wɔ Ghana Atifi Mantam mu wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn afe 1958.  Onyaa ne Mpɔtam Aban Adansedi Krataa fii Mpɔtam Aban Adesua Asoɛe hɔ . N’adesua akyi no wɔde no yɛɛ adwuma wɔ Ministry of Local Government sɛ Revenue Inspector.  Wɔ afe 2008 mu no, ɔwiee Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration a ɔnyaa Bachelor of Public Administration abodin krataa.

Amammui mu adwuma 
Wɔ afe 2004 mu no, Kakpagu hyɛɛ amammuisɛm mu bere a ɔne Kumbungu mmrahyɛbagua agua no sii akan no.

2004 abatow mu 
Wɔn a wogyinaa hɔ maa abatow saa afe no nyinaa yɛ anim foforo efisɛ na wɔapaw mmrahyɛbagua a ɔredi tumi mprempren Muhammad Mumuni sɛ NDC ɔmampanyin a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ ɔmampanyin, John Atta Mills .  Kakpagu ne nnipa baanu foforo a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔpaw wɔn a wɔne, Prince Imoro Alhassan Andani a ofi New Patriotic Party (NPP) ne Mohammed Imoro a ofi Convention People’s Party (CPP) no sii akan. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ no mu de abatoɔ 22,245 a ɛyɛ 77.50% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu. Nea ɔne no resi akan paa ne NPP kandifo a onyaa abatow 5,968 a egyina hɔ ma abatow a wɔtow nyinaa mu 20.80%. CPP kandifoɔ no dii nea ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 498 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 1.70%.

2008 abatow mu 
Wɔ afe 2008 mu no, na constituency primary biara nni hɔ ɛfiri sɛ asɔretiafoɔ NDC sii gyinaeɛ sɛ Kakpagu bɛsi akan wɔ abatoɔ no so wɔ party no tekiti so a obiara nsɔre ntia.  Ɔkɔɔ so kuraa n’akongua so bere a wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔpaw wɔn no baanu Alidu Binda Talhat a ofi NPP ne Peter Ibrahim Neidow a ofi CPP no twaa no mpoa no. Nea ɔdi tumi no dii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ 18,155 a ɛyɛ 67.83% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu. NPP kandifoɔ no nyaa abatoɔ 6,096 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 22.78% na CPP kandifoɔ no nyaa abatoɔ 2,515 a ɛyɛ 9.40% wɔ abatoɔ no nyinaa mu.

2012 mmrahyɛbagua no mfitiaseɛ 
Wɔ afe 2012 ɔmampanyin ne mmrahyɛbagua abatow mu no, kan MP Muhammed Mumuni, san bae sɛ ɔrebɛpere agua no. Odii MP a ɔte hɔ, Kakpagu so nkonim wɔ amansin no mu mfitiase abatow no mu .  Muhammad Mumuni, a saa bere no na ɔyɛ Amannɔne Nsɛm Ho Ɔsoafo no nyaa abatow 161 bere a nea ɔredi tumi no nyaa abatow 133.  Muhammad Mumuni dii nkonim wɔ amansin no mmrahyɛbagua abatow no mu de abatow 18,285 (56.57%). Ɔdii nnipa baanan so nkonim: Abdulai Mohammed Sani a ɔfiri NPP, Amadu Moses Yahaya a ɔfiri CPP, Alhassan Abukari a ɔfiri Progressive People’s Party, ne Imoro Issahaku a ɔfiri National Democratic Party.

2013 amansin mu mfitiaseɛ abatoɔ 
Wɔ Ayɛwohomumɔ 2013 mu no, ɔsii akan wɔ amansin no atenaeɛ no ho wɔ berɛ a Muhammad Mumuni gyaee hɔ sɛ ɔrekɔfa amanaman ntam paw. Eyi yɛ bere a osii akan na odii nkonim wɔ ɔmantam no mmrahyɛbagua mfitiase abatow mu wɔ nnipa baanan afoforo a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔpaw wɔn no mu akyi.  Wɔyɛɛ primaries no wɔ 14 April 2013 wɔ temporal Kumbungu mantam nhyiamu gyaade.  Hon. Kakpagu nyaa abatow 170 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu.  Nea ɔne no resi akan paa, Ɔbenfo Jacob Yakubu, twee abatow 84.

2013 mu abatow a ɛbae

Asɔretiafoɔ New Patriotic Party no amfa wɔn ho anhyɛ abatoɔ a ɛbɛba no mu ɛnam adesrɛ a na asɔre no akannifoɔ de kɔdan Asɛnnibea Kunini no a ɛfa nea ɛfirii afe 2012 Abatoɔ no mu baeɛ no ho.   Kakpagu dii nkogu wɔ abatow no mu wɔ Moses Amadu Yahaya a ofi Convention Peoples’ Party mu no anim.    Nea ɔhweree no kyerɛ sɛ wɔde mfe abien a ɔde dii dwuma sɛ MP maa Kumbungu Mantam no mu no, wɔde ahyɛ MP bere a ɔde maa Muhammed Mumuni no ntam.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Henry Ford Kamel
text:
Henry Ford Kofi Kamel (21 Ɔbɛnem 1961 – 25 Ɔbɛnem 2012) yɛ Ghana sikakorabea dwumayɛni ne ɔmanyɔni . Ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma Buem mantam no firi Ɔpɛpɔn 2005 na ɔsan yɛ Volta Mantam Ɔmanpanin firi Oforisuo 2012 kɔsii ne wuo wɔ 25 Ɔpɛpɔn 2012.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Kamel fi Guanam, beae bi a ɛwɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ Ghana . Wɔwoo no wɔ 21 December 1961. Ɔkɔɔ Ho Mfiridwuma Sukuupɔn mu .

Adwuma 
Kamel tetee ne ho sɛ sikakorabea dwumayɛni ne sikasɛm ho ɔbenfo wɔ n’adwuma mu. Ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ North Volta Rural Bank Limited no kwankyerɛfo panyin.

mmrahyɛbagua no 
Ná Kamel yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua no muni . Ɔdii nkonim wɔ ne abatoɔ a ɛtwa toɔ mu wɔ 7 December 2012 denam dodoɔ a ɛboro 13,627 so.  Ɔdii kan dii nkonim wɔ atenaeɛ no mu wɔ afe 2004 abatoɔ mu de sii Emil Kwadzo Brantuo ananmu sɛ MP wɔ 4th Parliament of the 4th Republic a na dodoɔ no ara yɛ 10,488.  Ɔdii nkonim bɔɔ n'akongua ho ban wɔ afe 2008 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu . Ɔdii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ no mu 65.8%.

Aban 
Wɔ Oforisuo 2012 mu no, Ɔmampanyin John Atta Mills paw Henry Kamel sɛ Volta Ɔmantam Ɔsoafoɔ foforɔ, a ɔde no besi Joseph Amenowode ananmu .    Ɔtenaa saa post yi mu kɔsii sɛ ɔwuiɛ wɔ Buronya Da wɔ afe 2012 mu. Ansa na wɔrepaw no yi, na ɔyɛ Ɔmanpanyin Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Asase ne Kwae so.

Nea ɔyɛe a ɛda nsow no mu biako ne sɛ ɔde asomdwoe baa Gbi Amammerɛ Mpɔtam hɔ wɔ Hohoefo a wɔyɛ aborɔfo ne Zongo Mpɔtam hɔfo ntam. Gbi Amammerɛ Mpɔtam Panyin Panyin, Togbega Gabusu VI, de nidi maa saa asomdwoe mmɔdenbɔ ahorow no.

Owuo 
Wɔbɔɔ amanneɛ sɛ Kamel san kɔɔ ne kurom, Guaman a ɛwɔ Jasikan Mantam mu wɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ 25 December 2012.  Bere a ɔne abusuafo ne nnamfo binom rebɔ nkɔmmɔ da a edi hɔ no, ɔhwee ase mpofirim. Owui ansa na ɔrekɔ Jasikan Aban Ayaresabea.  Na wadi mfe 51.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Na waware na ɔwɔ mma baasa. Na ɔyɛ Kristoni ne Katolekni.

Ne babaa de Kamel for Hope fapem sii hɔ de hyɛɛ no anuonyam sɛ ɔde bɛkɔ nnipa a wɔabɔ wɔn ka wɔ Ghana nkyɛn. Wɔhyehyɛɛ fapem no wɔ 1 May 2013.

Hwɛ nso 

 Mills aban asomfo din a wɔahyehyɛ
 Mahama aban asomfo din
 Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua
 Buem amansin a wɔpaw no

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Stephen Kunsu
text:
Stephen Kunsu yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnum ne ason a ɛwɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no muni a ɔgyina Kintampo North ananmu wɔ Brong Ahafo mantam mu wɔ Ghana .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Kunsu wɔ 30 September 1949  Ne kurom ne Ahenakrom wɔ Brong Ahafo mantam mu. Ɔfatae sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo denam ne Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo Abodin krataa A a otwaa mu wɔ afe 1970 mu.

Adwumafa 
Na ɔyɛ Kintampo Mantam no Ɔmantam Panyin (1999-2000).  Ɔsan nso yɛ Ghana Nhomasua Dwumadibea no kwankyerɛfo boafo ne Ɔmansin sohwɛfo na afei ɔyɛɛ mmrahyɛbaguani fi Ɔpɛpɔn 2005.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Kunsu yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbaguani.  Ɔasom wɔ Ghana republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan, 5 ne 6 mu.

2004 Abatow a Wɔyɛe 
Wɔdii kan too aba baa mmrahyɛbagua no mu wɔ afe 2004 mu wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu. Wɔpaw no sɛ ɔmmɛgyina Kintampo North Constituency ananmu wɔ bere a wɔbɔɔ no foforo wɔ afe 2004. Ɔnam saayɛ so gyinaa amansin no ananmu wɔ Ghana republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu. Wɔde abatoɔ 18,922 na ɛpaw Kunsu wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata 30,677 a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu, a ɛne abatoɔ a ɛfata nyinaa mu 61.70% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Isaac Kwabena Sarkodie Boahin a ofi New Patriotic Party, Kwaku Anane-Gyinde a ɔyɛ ɔmanpanyin a ɔde ne ho, Alhaji Osman Ahmed a ofi Convention People’s Party ne Anthony Mainooh a ofi Democratic People’s Party mu. Eyinom nyaa abatow a ɛfata nyinaa mu 33.00%, 3.30%, 1.10% ne 0.80%. Wɔ saa abatow no mu no, National Democratic Congress dii nkongua 10 wɔ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 24 a ɛwɔ Brong Ahafo mantam mu no mu.   Sɛ yɛka ne nyinaa bom a, kuw no dii nkonim kakraa bi 94 wɔ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 230 a ɛwɔ ɔman a ɛto so 4 no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 4 no mu.

2008 Abatow no 
Wɔ afe 2008 mu no, wɔsan paw no sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma Kintampo North mantam a ɛwɔ Brong Ahafo mantam mu denam abatoɔ 17,965 a ɔnyaeɛ wɔ abatoɔ 32,887 a ɛfata mu, a ɛne abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Awudulai Razak a ofi Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no mu, Yelebepuori A Rashid a ofi Ɔmanfo Ɔman Nhyiam no mu, Jayem B Francis a ofi Democratic Freedom Party no mu, D. D. Boateng a ofi Convention People’s Party no mu, Huseein Abass ne Jonas Osei Bonsu - a wɔyɛ kandifo baanu a wɔde wɔn ho. Eyinom nyaa abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 41.10%, 0.66%, 0.33%, 0.99% ne 2.29%. Kunsu dii nkonim wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.  Ne mansin no yɛɛ mmrahyɛbagua ananmusifo 8 fã wɔ nkongua 24 a National Democratic Congress dii maa Brong Ahafo mantam no nyinaa mu. wɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 5 a ɛwɔ republic a ɛto so 4 no mu.  Wɔ afe 2008 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu no, National Democratic Congress dii nkonim dodoɔ no ara a ɛyɛ mmrahyɛbagua ananmusifoɔ 114 wɔ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 230 mu.

2012 Abatoɔ 
Wɔpaw Kunsu ne mprɛnsa so sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani sɛ obegyina Kintampo Atifi fam amansin ananmu wɔ Brong Ahafo mantam mu wɔ afe 2012 Ghana amansan abatow no mu. Ɔnam saayɛ so gyinaa amansin no ananmu bio wɔ Ghana republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 6 no mu. Wɔde abatow 22,761 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 42,119 mu.   Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 54% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Razak Awdulai a ofi Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no mu, James Kwabena Bomfeh(Jnr) a ofi Convention People’s Party mu, Jonas Osei Bonsu a ofi Progressive People’s Party mu ne Ayimadu Kwadwo Matthew a ofi National Democratic Party mu. Eyinom nyaa abatow a ɛfata nyinaa mu bɛyɛ 41%, 3%, 0.8% ne 0.4%.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Kunsu aware na ɔwɔ mma baanum.  Ɔyɛ Kristoni (Presbyterian).

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: George Kuntu Blankson
text:
George Kuntu Blankson (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn da 25, afe 1957)  yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɔni. Ɔyɛ kan mmrahyɛbagua no muni ma Ekumfi mantam a kan no na ɛyɛ Mfantseman Apuei Mantam no fa .

Mfitiase mfe ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Kuntu Blankson wɔ 25 Ɔbɛnem 1957 wɔ Ekumfi-Otuam, Central Region.  Ɔwɔ abodin krataa wɔ Nico Lopez Sukuupɔn a ɛwɔ Cuba, a onyaa wɔ 1987 mu. Ɔsan nso nyaa adansedi krataa wɔ Nhomasua mu wɔ Las Aspin Center of Education wɔ Washington DC, U.S.A., a onyaa wɔ afe 1999.

Adwuma 
Kuntu Blankson yɛ asetra ho nyansahufo na ɔsan yɛ aguadifo. Ansa na ɔrebɛyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2005 mu no, ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ Ɔmantam Panyin maa Mfantseman Mantam no wɔ afe 1997 kosi afe 2001 na ɔsan nso yɛ Jesus Cares Enterprises

Ankorankoro asetra 
Kuntu Blankson yɛ Kristoni, Pentekoste asɔre no muni . Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baanum.

Amammui asetra 
Kuntu Blankson yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua no muni . Na ɔyɛ Mfantseman East Constituency mmrahyɛbaguani wɔ Ghana Republic a Ɛto so Anan no mmrahyɛbagua a Ɛto so Anum mu bere a wɔpaw no wɔ afe 2008 Ghana amansan abatow mu akyi . Ɔnyaa abatoɔ 8,591, a ɛne 48.0% yɛ pɛ, wɔ abatoɔ 17,893 a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ no mu. Albert Alex Amoah a ofi Convention People’s Party, Ekow Esirifie-Buckman a ɔyɛ independent candidate ne Kwamina Amoasi Andoh a ofi New Patriotic Party no hweree agua no maa no wɔ saa abatow no mu bere a onyaa 1.9%, 9.5% ne 39.5% wɔ abatow a wɔtow nyinaa mu akyi.  Ɔsan nso yɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma Mfantseman/Ekumfi Mansin mu wɔ Fourth Parliament of the Fourth Republic of Ghana  wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu na ɔnyaa abatoɔ a ne nyinaa yɛ 8,385 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 46.30% sene abatoɔ afoforɔ, Kwamina Amoasi- . Andoh a ɔfiri New Patriotic Party a ɔtwee abatoɔ a ne nyinaa yɛ 6,773 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 37.40% ne Charles Kojo Imbeah a ɔfiri Convention People’s Party a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 2,938 no dodoɔ a ɛgyina hɔ ma 16.20%.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Alex Kyeremeh
text:
Alex Kyeremeh yɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni a ɔhwɛ Techiman North so wɔ Brong Ahafo mantam mu wɔ Ghana .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn da a ɛtɔ so 7, afe 1962.  Ɔfiri Krobo-Techiman a ɛwɔ Brong Ahafo mantam mu.

Wɔ afe 2002 mu no, ɔkɔɔ Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration baabi a ɔyɛɛ ne Bachelor of Science wɔ Accounting ne Finance mu.  Wɔ afe 2015 mu no, ɔnyaa Certificate in Management nso firii Ghana Institute of Management and Administration.

Adwuma 
Na Kyeremeh yɛ Freda and Rose Limited adwumakuw no kwankyerɛfo panyin. Ɔayɛ adwuma sɛ Techiman Municipality Assembly no Municipal Chief Executive firi April 2009- Ɔpɛpɔn 2013. Kyeremeh yɛ Akontaabufoɔ ne Sikasɛm sohwɛfoɔ wɔ n’adwuma mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Kyeremeh yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua no muni .   Wɔdii kan paw no sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani wɔ Techiman North mantam mu wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu. Ɔnam saayɛ so gyinaa amansin no ananmu wɔ Ghana republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu. Wɔde abatow 12,877 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 24,731 mu.  Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 52.1% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Christopher Ameyaw Akumfi a ofi New Patriotic Party ne Kofi Kwaw Sarpong a ɔyɛ obi a ɔde ne ho. Eyinom nyaa abatow 11,447 ne abatow 407 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 46.3% ne 1.6% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw Kyeremeh wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so. Ne mansin no yɛɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 10 no fã wɔ nkongua 24 a National Democratic Congress dii wɔ Brong Ahafo Mantam mu maa saa abatow no mu.   Sɛ yɛka ne nyinaa bom a, National Democratic Congress no dii nkonim wɔ nnipa kakraa bi a wɔka bom yɛ mmrahyɛbagua ananmusifoɔ 94 wɔ nkongua 230 a ɛwɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan a ɛwɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu.

Wɔsan paw Kyeremeh sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani mma Techiman North mantam no wɔ afe 2012 Ghana amansan abatow mu.  Ɔnam saayɛ so gyinaa amansin no ananmu wɔ Ghana republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 6 no mu. Wɔde abatow 16,537 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 30,876 mu.  Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 53.56% yɛ pɛ.  Wɔpaw no sen mmrahyɛbaguani a ɔwɔ hɔ mprempren, Christopher Ameyaw Akumfi sɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo, Kwakye Kofi a ofi Progressive People’s Party, Agartha Ampomaa a ofi Convention People’s Party ne Agyemang Badu Opambour a ofi National Democratic Party.  Eyinom nyaa abatow 13,727, abatow 155, abatow 337 ne abatow 120 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu.  Eyinom ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 44.46%, 0.5%, 1.09% ne 0.39% yɛ pɛ.  Wɔsan paw Kyeremeh wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.  Na ne mansin no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 16 fã wɔ nkongua 29 a National Democratic Congress dii wɔ Brong Ahafo mantam mu wɔ Ghana no nyinaa mu.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Alex aware.  Ɔyɛ Kristoni (Katolekni).

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Samuel Nii Ayi Mankattah
text:
Samuel Nii Ayi Mankattah yɛ Ghana  amanyɔni ne mmrahyɛbagua no muni ma Odododiodio mantam. Wɔdii kan paw no sɛ MP wɔ afe 2004 Ɔmampanyin ne mmrahyɛbagua abatoɔ mu wɔ berɛ a NDC mmrahyɛbagua kandifoɔ, Nii Lante Vanderpuije gyaee adwuma wɔ akyinnyegyeɛ bi a ɛfa abatoɔ dinkyerɛw ho akyi. Ɔmansin no atenaeɛ no bɛyɛɛ obiara wɔ ne wuo akyi wɔ afe 2005.

Amammui mu adwuma 
Mankattah dii bɛyɛ asram asia wɔ mmrahyɛbagua mu fi Jan kosi July, 2005.

Wɔ afe 2004 mu no, odii New Patriotic Party MP a na ɔwɔ hɔ mprempren, Reginald Nii Bi Ayibonte .

Abatow a wɔyɛ 
Wɔ afe 2004 mu no, ɔsan sii akan wɔ Odododiodio mmrahyɛbagua no mu. Odii nkonim wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so. Ná ne mansin no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 11 no fã wɔ nkongua 27 a National Democratic Congress dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Greater Accra Mantam no mu . National Democratic Congress no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 94 a ɛyɛ kakraa bi wɔ nkongua 230 mu.  Wɔde abatow 35, 634 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 67,994 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 52.4% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Reginald Nii Bi Ayi-Bonte a ofi Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no mu ne Isaac Nii Annan M Offei a ofi Nhyiam Nnipa Kuw no mu . Eyinom nyaa abatow 31,546 ne 814 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 46.4% ne 1.2% yɛ pɛ. N'ahennie berɛ no baa awieeɛ berɛ a ɔdii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ no mu akyi berɛ tiawa bi berɛ a ɔwuiɛ wɔ 5 July 2005.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Na Mankattah yɛ Kristoni.

Owuo 
Mankattah wui wɔ 5 Ɔpɛpɔn 2005.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Andrew Kingsford Mensah
text:
Andrew Kingsford Mensah (wɔwoo no 26 Ɔbɛnem 1955) yɛ Ghana  amanyɔni ne mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so anan a ɛwɔ Ghana Mantam a Ɛto so Anan no muni a ɔgyina Abura-Asebu-Kwamankese Mansin ananmu wɔ Central Region .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Mensah wɔ Abura-Asebu-Kwamankese wɔ Central Region wɔ Ghana wɔ 26 Ɔbɛnem 1955. Ɔkɔɔ Cape Coast Sukuupɔn na onyaa Abodin krataa wɔ Masters of Arts ( Nhomasua).

Adwuma 
Mensah yɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni ma Abura-Asebu-Kwamankese Mansin firi afe 2005 kɔsi afe 2009 wɔ Central Region of Ghana.  Ɔsan nso yɛ Ɔmantam Panyin a ɔhwɛ Abura-Asebu-Kwamankese Mantam no so.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔdii kan paw Mensah sɛ ɔmmra mmrahyɛbagua no mu wɔ December 2004 Ghana Amansan abatoɔ no mu wɔ Ticket of the New Patriotic Party sɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni ma Abura-Asebu-Kwamankese Mansin wɔ Central Region berɛ a ɔdii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ 19,196 wɔ abatoɔ 35,923 a ɛfata mu cast a egyina hɔ ma 53.40%.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Mensah yɛ Kristoni.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Kofi Krah Mensah
text:
Kofi Krah Mensah yɛ Ghana amanyɔni na ɔsan yɛ aguadini. Ɔyɛɛ mmrahyɛbaguani maa Amansie West amansin a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu no .

Ankorankoro asetra 
Wɔwoo Mensah wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2, 1942. Ɔwɔ Master in Law abodin krataa wɔ Ghana School of Law . Ɔsan nso yɛ Leeds Sukuupɔn mu ade a ɔnyaa Master of Arts abodin krataa wɔ Sikasɛm mu Nkɔsoɔ mu wɔ UK.

Wɔakyerɛw Mensah din wɔ Ghana Parliamentary Register mu sɛ ɔyɛ aguadifo ne Kristoni.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Na Mensah yɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanyin a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan no muni . Ɔdii nkonim wɔ Amansie West mantam no mu wɔ afe 2004 Ghana mmrahyɛbagua abatoɔ mu. Na ne mansin no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 36 no fa wɔ nkongua 39 a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Ashanti Mantam no mu.  Wɔpaw Mensah a na abatow a ɛfata nyinaa mu 84.2%.

Ansa na afe 2008 abatoɔ no reba no, Mesah dii nkoguo wɔ primary a wɔde maa New Patriotic Party no mu wɔ Grace Addo anim .

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Gibril Adamu Mohammed
text:
Na Gibril Adamu Mohammed yɛ Ghana amanyɔni a ɔte Republic of Ghana. Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni a ogyina hɔ ma Asawase mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu. Ná ɔyɛ Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua no muni .

Adwuma 
Na Mohammed yɛ oduruyɛfo wɔ n’adwuma mu.

Amammui mu adwuma 
Na Mohammed yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua no muni . Ɔbɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbagua muni fi Ɔpɛpɔn 2005 bere a ɔdaa ne ho adi sɛ nkonimdifo wɔ Amansan Abatow mu wɔ December 2004. Wɔpaw no sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani maa Asawase mantam wɔ Ghana Republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu.

Abatow a wɔyɛ 
Wɔpaw Mohammed sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani maa Asawase mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana nea edi kan wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow no mu.  Odii nkonim wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.  Na ne mansin no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua abiɛsa no fa wɔ nkongua 39 a National Democratic Congress dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Ashanti Mantam no mu.  National Democratic Congress no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 94 a ɛyɛ kakraa bi wɔ nkongua 230 mu.  Wɔde abatow 33,541 paw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 67,485 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 49.7% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Thomas Atigah a ofi Ɔmanfo Ɔman Nhyiam, Patricia Appiagyei a ofi Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo, Hassan B. A. Abu-Bong a ofi Nhyiam Nnipa Kuw, Adam Diyawu Rahaman a ofi Democratic Nnipa Kuw ne Abdul Majeed Alhassan a ɔyɛ ɔkannifo a ɔde ne ho. Eyinom nyaa abatow 1,598, 29,067, 570, 204 ne 2,505 wɔ abatow a wɔtow nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 2.4%, 43.1%, 0.8%, 0.3% ne 3.7% yɛ pɛ.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Na Mohammed yɛ Nkramofo.

Owuo 
Mohammed wui bere tiaa bi akyi a odii nkonim wɔ mmrahyɛbagua no mu wɔ Asawase mantam mu wɔ 15 Ɔpɛpɔn 2005.

Hwɛ nso 
MP a wɔpaw wɔn wɔ afe 2004 Ghana mmrahyɛbagua abatow mu din

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: John Akparibo Ndebugre
text:
John Akparibo Ndebugre (12 Oforisuo 1950 – 6 Ɔbɛnem 2022)  yɛ Ghana amanyɔni a ɔfiri Ghana man mu . Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni a ogyinaa Zebilla mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Apuei Fam Mantam no ananmu wɔ Ghana Ɔmanpanyin a ɛto so 4 no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 4 no mu . Ná ɔyɛ Nnipa Ɔman Nhyiam no muni .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Ndebugre wɔ Oforisuo da a ɛtɔ so 12, afe 1950. Na ɔyɛ Kwame Nkrumah Sukuupɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma So no ade . Ná ɔwɔ Bachelor of Science abodin krataa wɔ sukuupɔn no mu. Na ɔyɛ Ghana Mmara Sukuu no nso aba . Onyaa Bachelor of Law abodin krataa wɔ sukuu no mu.

Adwuma 
Na Ndebugre yɛ mmaranimfo wɔ n’adwuma mu.

Amammui mu adwuma 
Ná Ndebugre yɛ Nnipa Ɔman Nhyiam no muni . Ɔbɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbagua muni fi Ɔpɛpɔn 2005 bere a ɔdaa ne ho adi sɛ nkonimdifo wɔ Amansan Abatow mu wɔ December 2004.  Wɔpaw no sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma Zebilla mantam wɔ Ghana Republic a ɛto so anan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so anan no mu .

Abatow a wɔyɛ 
Wɔpaw Ndebugre sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani mma Zebilla mantam a ɛwɔ Upper East Region of Ghana nea edi kan wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow no mu.  Odii nkonim wɔ Nnipa Ɔman Nhyiam no tekiti so . Na ne mansin no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 3 no fã wɔ nkongua 13 a Nnipa Ɔman Nhyiam no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Upper East Region no mu.  Nnipa Ɔman Nhyiam no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 4 a nnipa kakraa bi na wɔwom wɔ nkongua 230 mu.  Wɔde abatow 11,026 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 31,188 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 35.4% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Appiah Moses a ofi Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no mu, Cletus Apul Avoka a ofi Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua no mu ne Sulley Aneda Apam a ofi Nhyiam Nnipa Kuw no mu . Eyinom nyaa abatow 8,921, 10,913 ne 328 wɔ abatow a wɔtow nyinaa mu.  Eyinom ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 28.6%, 35% ne 1.1% yɛ pɛ.

Hwɛ nso 
MP a wɔpaw wɔn wɔ afe 2004 Ghana mmrahyɛbagua abatow mu din

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Paa Kwesi Nduom
text:
Paa Kwesi Nduom anaa Papa Kwesi Nduom, (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn 15, 1953) ɔyɛ Ghana adwumayɛni ho ɔfotufo,  amanyɔni, ne Ghana Progressive People's Party no muni a ɔhyehyɛɛ no.  Wɔpaw no mprɛnsa sɛ ɔmampanyin, na na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma Komenda-Edina-Eguafo-Abirem mantam no na ɔsom sɛ ɔman soafo wɔ Kufuor aban no mu .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Paa Kwesi Nduom wɔ Elmina a ɛwɔ Central Region wɔ Ghana.  Wɔde ne papa din too no Joseph Hubster Yorke Kumaa.  Ɔnyaa ne ntoaso sukuu wɔ St. Augustine's College wɔ Cape Coast, faako a onyaa General Certificate of Education (GCE) Ordinary ne Advanced Levels ("O" level ne "A" levels) nyinaa. Ɔkɔɔ so kɔɔ United States baabi a onyaa Bachelor of Arts (Sikasɛm) abodin krataa wɔ Wisconsin–Milwaukee Sukuupɔn mu wɔ afe 1975 mu. Akyiri yi ɔkɔɔ so nyaa Master’s degree wɔ Management (1977) ne Ph.D (Service Delivery Systems) wɔ afe 1982 mu wɔ sukuupɔn koro no ara mu.

Adwuma 
Nduom fii ase yɛɛ adwuma sɛ nkwa ho insurance krataakyerɛwfo wɔ North Western Mutual Life Insurance Company wɔ 1975 ne 1978 ntam hɔ. Wɔ afe a edi hɔ no mu no, ɔne Blue Cross Blue Shield a ɛwɔ Wisconsin yɛɛ adwuma. Wɔ afe 1979 mu no, ɔde ne ho kɔbɔɔ Milwaukee Metropolitan Sewerage District sɛ sikasɛm ne adwumayɛ ho nhwehwɛmufo.  Wɔ 1981 mu no, ɔde ne ho bɔɔ Deloitte ne Touche sɛ ɔfotufo a ɔka ho, na ɔsɔre bɛyɛɛ ɔhokafo wɔ nnwumakuw no adwumayɛbea a ɛwɔ Milwaukee no mu wɔ 1986 mu. Wɔ afe 1992 mu no, ɔboa ma wɔhyehyɛɛ Deloitte & Touche West Africa Consulting dwumadibea.

Ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ adwumakuo no muni wɔ Fan Milk Ghana Limited, Edinaman Ntoaso Sukuu ne Ghana Heritage and Conservation Trust.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ɔmantam Nhyiam

Ne dwumadie a ɛyɛ nnam wɔ amammuisɛm mu no hyɛɛ aseɛ wɔ afe 1997 mu berɛ a wɔpaw no sɛ Komenda-Edina-Eguafo-Abirem Mantam Bagua no muni ma Akotobinsin Abatoɔ Mpɔtam no.

Ɔman amammuisɛm

Wɔ December 2000 mu no, ɔde Convention’s People’s Party (CPP) tekiti sii akan wɔ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua abatow mu maa Komenda-Edina-Eguafo-Abirem mantam no . Nanso, ɔdii nkogu wɔ MP a ɔdi tumi, Ato Quarshie a ɔwɔ National Democratic Congress (NDC) no anim denam abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ no mu 2.6%.  Nanso, asram abien akyi no, Ɔmampanyin John Kufuor paw no sɛ Ɔsoafo a ɔhwɛ Sikasɛm Ho Nhyehyɛe so ɛwom sɛ na ɔnyɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo a edi tumi no muni de. Ɔsan nso yɛɛ adwuma wɔ saa bere yi mu sɛ Ɔman Nkɔso Nhyehyɛe Bagua no Titenani .   Wɔ nsakraeɛ bi a wɔyɛeɛ wɔ kabinet mu wɔ April 2003 mu no, Nduom bɛyɛɛ Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ Ahoɔden so.   Asram dunwɔtwe akyi no, ɔsan sii akan wɔ Komenda-Edina-Eguafo-Abirem agua so wɔ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua abatow mu wɔ December 2004 mu na saa bere yi de odii nkonim nkontaa 33.6 (abatow 30,981 ma 15,427).   Saa bere no, na ɔyɛ CPP Nhyehyɛe Boayikuw no guamtrani. Wɔ Ɔmampanyin Kufuor n’ahenni bere a ɛto so abien no mfiase no, Nduom bɛyɛɛ Ɔmanfo Nnwuma mu Nsakrae ho Ɔsoafo.  Ɔkɔɔ so yɛɛ saa dibea yi kɔsii July 2007 berɛ a ɔgyaee aban mu sɛ ɔrekɔhwehwɛ sɛ n’apam no bɛpaw no sɛ ɔbɛgyina sɛ CPP ɔmampanyin kandifoɔ.

Bid sɛ ɔmampanyin

Wɔ December 2007 mu no, CPP paw Nduom sɛ ɔnkɔsi akan wɔ December 2008 ɔmampanyin abatow no mu .   Ɔdii nkogu wɔ abatoɔ no mu, na ɔnyaa abatoɔ no nnu 1%.  Wɔ CPP amanyɔkuo abatoɔ a ɛbaa afe 2011 mu no, wɔbɔɔ amanneɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔdi nkonim a Nduom boa wɔn, a saa berɛ no Titenani Ladi Nylander ka ho, dii nkoguo wɔ akannifoɔ foforɔ te sɛ Samia Nkrumah, Ghana ɔmampanyin a ɔdi kan Kwame Nkrumah babaa  Asram bi akyi no, Convention People’s Party no bɔɔ Nduom soboɔ sɛ wɔbɛkɔ atia party no mmara.  Wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2012 mu no, Nduom gyaee adwuma wɔ CPP mu na ɔhyehyɛɛ n’ankasa kuw, Progressive People’s Party .  Ɔyɛ Progressive People’s Party ɔmampanyin a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ ɔmampanyin wɔ afe 2012 ne 2016 abatow no mu.

Abusua 
Nduom aware Yvonne Nduom a ɔyɛ adwuma sohwɛ ho ɔbenfo na wawie Cape Coast Sukuupɔn a ɛwɔ Ghana ne Wisconsin Sukuupɔn a ɛwɔ Amerika .  Wɔn aware a wɔwɔ mma baanan, Nana Kweku Nduom, Edjah Kweku Nduom, Chief Nduom, ne Nana Aba Nduom. Nana Kweku aware Esinam Julia Nduom (née Baeta) na wɔwɔ ɔbabea, Maame Adjoa Kakraba Nduom. Edjah aware Kelley Nduom (wɔwoo no Coleman).

Hwɛ nso 
Kufuor aban no

title: George Kofi Nfodjoh
text:
George Kofi Nfodjoh yɛ Ghana amanyɔni a ɔyɛɛ mmrahyɛbaguani maa mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan wɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu. Ɔgyinaa Ɔman Democratic Congress a ɛwɔ Ho Central Constituency ananmu.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo no wɔ 21 September 1946. Ɔfiri Sokode-Bagble kuro bi a ɛwɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ Ghana . Ɔnyaa ne PGD wɔ Nkitahodi Adesua mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu wɔ afe 1986.

Adwuma 
Ɔyɛ Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo ne aguade ho dawurubɔfo. Ɔne AGC Limited yɛɛ adwuma wɔ Obuasi fi 1987 kosi 1997. Ɔyɛ Ho Mantam no Ɔmantam Panyin fi afe 1997 kosi afe 2001.  Na ɔyɛ captain na ɔne Ghana Asraafo no Ɔmanfo Nkitahodi Dwumadibea no yɛ adwuma .

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ɔyɛ Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua no muni . Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma Ho Central mantam a ɛwɔ Volta mantam mu wɔ Ghana.    Wɔpaw no sɛ National Democratic Congress mmrahyɛbagua no muni Fida 2004 maa Ho-Central mantam no.

Ɔnyaa abatoɔ dodoɔ a ɛyɛ 49,463 wɔ ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 84.80% mu de dii n’asɔretiafoɔ a wɔyɛ Seth Dickie Kpodo a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 4,668, Dede Kwesi Levi Michael a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 3,593, Asare Roberta a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 275 ne Tay Prosper a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 302 no so nkonim.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ɔwaree. Ɔyɛ Kristoni na ɔyɛ Katolek Asɔre no muni .

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Dominic Nitiwul
text:
Dominic Aduna Bingab Nitiwul (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn 4, 1977)  yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɔni ne mmrahyɛbagua no muni (MP) ma Bimbilla mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Mantam mu.  Ɔsan nso asom wɔ Pan-African mmrahyɛbagua no mu .   Efi Ɔpɛpɔn 2017 no, Nitiwul ayɛ Ghana Bammɔ Soafo dibea.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Dominic Nitiwul suaa ade wɔ nhomasua asoɛe ahorow mu wɔ Ghana, Germany, ne United Kingdom .  Dominic wiee ne O level wɔ St Charles Secondary ne Seminary School wɔ afe 1992 mu. Wɔ Germany no onyaa adansedi nkrataa wɔ ntawntawdi ano aduru (2003) ne ntawntawdi ano aduru (2005) mu fii Amanaman Ntam Akannifo Sukuu mu. Onyaa ne Master of Business Administration wɔ sikasɛm mu wɔ South Wales Sukuupɔn mu, ne ne Master of Laws wɔ nnwumakuw sikasɛm mu wɔ Westminster Sukuupɔn mu .

Amanyɔsɛm

mmrahyɛbagua no muni 
Wɔpaw Nitiwul sɛ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua wɔ afe 2002 mu bere a na wadi mfe 25.  Wɔ ne nkonimdi kasa no mu no, ɔtwee adwene sii nokwasɛm a ɛyɛ sɛ ɔpɛ sɛ wɔma no abasobɔde wɔ asomdwoe dodow a ɔde bɛba amansin no mu no so.  Eyi fi mmusuakuw ntam ntawntawdi a ɛkɔɔ so bere tenten wɔ Konkombafo ne Nanumbafo ntam no .  Wayɛ adwuma wɔ boayikuw pii mu wɔ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua ne Pan-African mmrahyɛbagua no nyinaa mu . Eyinom bi ne: Sikasɛm Boayikuw, Sikasɛm ne Sikasɛm Boayikuw, Adwumayɛ Boayikuw, Boayikuw a Wɔpaw Nnipa, Mmabun ne Agumadi Boayikuw, Akwan ne Kar Boayikuw, ne Nhomasua Boayikuw.  Ɔyɛ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua no Kannifoɔ Abadiakyiri firi afe 2012 kɔsi afe 2016.

2016 mmrahyɛbagua no abatow 
Nitiwul dii nkonim wɔ afe 2016 mmrahyɛbagua abatow mu maa ne mansin no denam National Democratic Congress kandifo Dr Joseph Mamboah Rockson a odii nkonim no so .  Ansa na wɔreyɛ abatow no na Nitiwul aka sɛ obedi nkonim esiane nokwasɛm a ɛyɛ sɛ nea ɔne no reko no nyɛ ɔmansin no muni na onnim nea ɛrekɔ so wɔ amansin no mu nti; ɔsan nso kaa nkɔso adwuma pii a wayɛ ho asɛm. Nea ɔsɔre tia no no nyaa adwene sɛ Nitiwul asom akyɛ dodo na ogye di sɛ wɔn a wɔpaw no no hia anim foforo.

Nkɔso nnwuma 
Nitiwul ahyɛ aseɛ reyɛ nkɔsoɔ adwuma wɔ Bamboi na ama ne manfoɔ no tebea ayɛ yie.  Ɔmaa wotuu tokuru 69 wɔ mpɔtam ahodoɔ mu wɔ ne mansin mu, na ɔmaa Electricity Company of Ghana trɛw anyinam ahoɔden mu kɔɔ mpɔtam 16. Ɔsii ayaresabea abien, akwan ho adwuma dumien, ne adesuadan mu adan.

Ɔman Bammɔ Soafo 
Wɔ 13 Ɔbɛnem 2017 no, na Nitiwul ka asomfoɔ kuo a ɛdi kan a Ɔmampanyin Nana Akuffo-Addo paw wɔn no ho.  Na nea wɔde no too gua no yɛ Ministry of Defence.   Wɔyɛɛ eyi bere a n’akuw, New Patriotic Party, dii tumi wɔ afe 2016 Ghana amansan abatow mu akyi .   Ghana mmrahyɛbagua no mufo, ne afoforo baawɔtwe na wɔpenee Nitiwul so sɛ ɔnyɛ ɔsom adwuma no.  Ɔmampanyin Akuffo-Addo na ɔdii ne ntam wɔ 27 Ɔbɛnem 2017.  wɔ din a wɔde kɔmaa mmrahyɛbagua no sɛ wɔmfa nnye ntom wɔ 21 Ɔbɛnem 2021 mu no, ɔmampanyin no yii Owura Nitiwul sɛ ɔnkɔ so nkura ne somfoɔ dibea sɛ Ɔman Bammɔ soafoɔ .

Galamsey ko 
Nitiwul ama ɔko a ɔne wɔn a wotu fam a mmara mma ho kwan a wɔfrɛ wɔn galamseyers, no ayɛ ne botae atitiriw no mu biako sɛ Ɔman Bammɔ Soafo.  Wɔn a mmara mma ho kwan no tu dade a ɛsom bo wɔ Ghana mmeae ahorow a wonsusuw nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia ho kɛse anaasɛ wonsusuw ho koraa.  Nsu pii a ɛwɔ ɔman no mu ayow esiane nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia a wɔasɛe no esiane sɛ wotu fam no nti, na wɔde nnuru a epira te sɛ cyanide agu nsu a wɔnom ho fĩ .  Na nniso ahorow a atwam no abɔ mmɔden sɛ wobesiw fagude a mmara mma ho kwan no ano na wɔantumi esiane mmɔden a wɔammɔ abom nti. Bere a ɔne Ghana Asraafo asraafo mpanyimfo ne Ministry of Lands and Natural Resources, yɛɛ adwuma no, Nitiwul boa ma wɔhyehyɛɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde begye mfiri, atu wɔn a wotu fagude no, na wɔasan de nsase a asɛe wɔ ɔman no mu aba.

Basabasayɛfo atɛntrenee ko 
Bere a wɔkumm Major Maxwell Mahama wɔ May 2017 mu no, Nitiwul hyɛɛ bɔ sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ nhwehwɛmu a edi mũ ase de ahu na wɔakyere wɔn a wɔyɛɛ bɔne no.  Ná Mahama adi mfomso sɛ ɔyɛ adwowtwafo a okura akode na na Diasofo binom akum no .

Kabinet Ɔmanpanyin 
Wɔ May, 2017 mu no, Ɔmampanyin Nana Akufo-Addo bɔɔ Dominic Nitiwul din sɛ asomfoɔ dunkron a wɔbɛhyehyɛ ne kabinet no fã .  Wɔde asomfo 19 no din kɔmaa Ghana mmrahyɛbagua no na Aban no Kasafo, Rt. Hon. Ɔbenfo a ɔbenfo. Mike Ocquaye na ɔkyerɛwee .  Sɛ́ Kabinet soafo no, Nitiwul yɛ ɔmampanyin no mu kuw no fã na ɛsɛ sɛ ɔboa wɔ gyinaesi dwumadi atitiriw mu wɔ ɔman no mu.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Nitiwul aware a ɔwɔ mma baanum.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Yaw Ntow Ababio
text:
Yaw Ntow Ababio yɛ Ghana amanyɔni.  Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma Dormaa Apuei mantam a ɛwɔ Brong-Ahafo Mantam mu wɔ Ghana .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Ababio fi Dormaa-Akwamu a ɛwɔ Brong Ahafo Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.  Ɔberɛfɛw da 20, afe 1959. Ne man yɛ   Owiee International Professional Managers Association wɔ United Kingdom wɔ afe 2003 mu, na na ɔwɔ diploma wɔ Management mu.   Ɔsan nso nyaa ne master’s degree wɔ Administration (Democracy, Governance and Law) mu wɔ Cape Coast Suapɔn mu wɔ afe 2007.

Adwuma 
Ababio yɛ Ɔhwɛfoɔ/Ɔhwɛfoɔ.   Ansa na ɔrefi n’adwuma ase wɔ amammuisɛm mu no, ɔne Global Haulage Camp yɛɛ adwuma. Limited wɔ Accra - Ghana sɛ Production Manager.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so no Ababio dii kan bɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbaguani maa Dormaa East mantam a ɛwɔ Brong Ahafo Mantam mu wɔ Ghana bere a wɔpaw no wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow no mu akyi .  Ɔnam saayɛ so gyinaa amansin no ananmu nea edi kan wɔ Ghana republic a ɛto so 4 no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 4 no mu. Wɔde abatow 11,533 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow 19480 nyinaa mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 58.1% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Nicholas K. Adjei-Kyeremeh a ofi National Democratic Congress, Alexander Asante Oppong a ofi Convention People’s Party ne Lovea Amponsah a ofi Democratic People’s Party mu. Eyinom nyaa abatow a ɛfata nyinaa mu 38.00%, 2.90% ne 1.00%. Wɔ saa abatoɔ korɔ no ara mu no, New Partriotic Party no nyaa dodoɔ no ara a ɛyɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua ananmusifoɔ 123 wɔ nkongua 230 a wɔdii nyinaa maa mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan wɔ ɔman a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu.  Dormaa Apuei fam mantam no kaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 24 a kuw no dii wɔ Brong Ahafo mantam mu nyinaa mu 14 ho.   Ababio sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani wɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 4 no nso yɛɛ mmrahyɛbagua no Boayikuw a Wɔapaw a Ɛhwɛ Akwan ne Kar So no Titenani Abadiakyiri.

Wɔ afe 2008 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu no wɔsan paw no wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma Dormaa Apueeɛ mantam.  Ɔnam saayɛ so gyinaa amansin no ananmu wɔ Ghana republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 5 no mu.  Ɔsii akan na onyaa abatow 11,363 wɔ abatow 19,188 a ɛfata a wɔtow no mu.   Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 59.22% yɛ pɛ.  7 Wɔpaw no sen Isaac Kofi Kyeremeh a ofi Ɔman Democratic Congress, Samuel Badu a ofi Democratic Freedom Party, Alexander Asante Oppong a ofi Convention People's Party ne Lovea Amponsah a ofi Democratic People's Party. Eyinom nyaa 33.80%, 4.35%, 2.48% ne 0.16% wɔ abatow a ɛfata nyinaa mu. New Patriotic Party no nyaa dodoɔ no ara nkongua 16 wɔ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 24 nyinaa mu maa Brong Ahafo mantam no wɔ afe 2008 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu.   Nanso, wonyaa nnipa kakraa bi a wɔn dodow yɛ 107 wɔ nkongua 230 mu a ɛyɛ mmrahyɛbagua ananmusifo wɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 5 a ɛwɔ ɔman a ɛto so 4 no mu.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ntow Ababio aware a ɔwɔ mma baanan.   Ɔyɛ Kristoni na ɔyɛ Presbyterian asɔre a ɛwɔ Ghana no muni.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Lee Ocran
text:
Lee Tandoh Ocran  (wɔwoo no bɛyɛ afe 1945; owui 21 Ɔpɛpɔn 2019) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni a ɔyɛɛ Ghana Nhomasua soafoɔ firi afe 2012 kɔsi afe 2013. Ocran na Ɔmampanyin John Atta Mills paw no sɛ Ɔsomfoɔ wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2012 mu wɔ nsakraeɛ a wɔyɛeɛ wɔ kabinet mu wɔ Betty Mould-Iddrisu a ɔgyaee aban no mu ne Martin Amidu a wɔyii no fii adwumam no akyi .

Adwuma 
Wɔ afe 2000 mu no na ɔyɛ Ɔmanpanyin Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia ho nyansahu ne mfiridwuma so. Ɔyɛ kan Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ Nhomasua so firi afe 2012 kɔsi afe 2013. Wɔkaa ntam sɛ VRA board chairman wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2014.  Ɔsan nso yɛ kan Ghana Ɔmanpanyin wɔ South Africa .

Mfitiase asetra 
Efi Ɔpɛpɔn 2005 sɛ ɔkannifoɔ a ɔfiri National Democratic Congress no na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni ma Jomoro mantam  kɔsii sɛ ɔhwereɛ n’akongua maa Kwame Nkrumah, Samia Nkrumah a ɔfiri Convention People’s Party no babaa wɔ December 2008 mmrahyɛbagua abatoɔ mu  Wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2014 mu no wɔkaa Ocran ntam sɛ Volta River Authority board chairman . Wɔ 13 May 2015 no ɔkaa Bui Dam ho asɛm sɛ ɛyɛ White Elephant (akyɛdeɛ a ɛboro so nanso ɛyɛ adesoa).

Ankorankoro asetra 
Na ɔyɛ Kristoni na ɔsom sɛ Katolekni. Ná waware na ɔwɔ mma baasa.

Owuo 
Owui bere a na wadi mfe 74 bere a ɔne nyarewa dii ako akyi.

Hwɛ nso 

 Mills aban asomfo din a wɔahyehyɛ
 Jomoro mantam a wɔpaw no

title: Abraham Laryea Odai
text:
Abraham Laryea Odai yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɔni a ɔyɛɛ mmrahyɛbaguani wɔ Krowor Mantam mu.

Amammui mu adwuma 
Odai yɛ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 4 a ɛwɔ ɔman a ɛto so 4 no muni.  Ɔbɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbaguani bere a odii nkonim wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow mu maa New Patriotic Party no .  Oguan fii mmɔden a wɔbɔe sɛ wobekum no mu wɔ afe 2007.

Abatow a wɔyɛ 
Wɔpaw Odai sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani mma Krowor mantam a ɛwɔ Greater Accra Region of Ghana wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow mu. Odii nkonim wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so . Ná ne mansin no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 16 no fã wɔ nkongua 27 a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Greater Accra Mantam no mu .  New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 128 wɔ nkongua 230 mu.  Wɔde abatow 25,405 paw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 54,155 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 46.9% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Ɔbenfo Nii Oakley Quaye-Kumah a ofi National Democratic Congress, Theophilus Boye Mensah a ofi Convention People’s Party, Theophilus Tei Okunor ne Emmanuel Borquaye Boyefio a wɔn baanu nyinaa yɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho. Eyinom nyaa abatow 24,339, 2,808, 658 ne 945 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtowee nyinaa mu 44.9%, 5.2%, 1.2% ne 1.7% yɛ pɛ.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ɔyɛ Kristoni.

title: Nana Yaw Edward Ofori-Kuragu
text:
Nana Yaw Edward Ofori-Kaguru (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn 19, 1963)  yɛ ahɔhodan sohwɛfo  ne Ghana amanyɔfoɔ a ɔwɔ Republic of Ghana. Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni a ogyinaa Besome-Freho mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 4 ne 5 mu wɔ Ghana Ɔmanpanyin a ɛto so 4 no mu . Ná ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni a ɔde ne ho.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Ofori-Kaguru wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn da a ɛtɔ so 19, afe 1963.  Ɔfiri Tepaso, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana .  Ɔyɛ East London Sukuupɔn, UK no ade.  Ɔwɔ Masters in Business Administration abodin krataa wɔ Sikasɛm mu wɔ sukuupɔn no mu.  Ɔnyaa abodin krataa no wɔ afe 1994.

Adwuma 
Ofori-Kaguru yɛ ahɔhodan sohwɛfo na ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ Cozy Lodge a ɛwɔ Kumasi no kwankyerɛfo panyin.  Ná ɔsan yɛ Cozy Gardens and Restaurant a ɛwɔ Kumasi no kwankyerɛfo panyin.

Amammui mu adwuma 
Ofori-Kaguru yɛ ɔmannifoɔ a ɔde ne ho wɔ Ghana amammuisɛm mu.  Ɔbɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbagua muni fi Ɔpɛpɔn 2005 bere a ɔdaa ne ho adi sɛ nkonimdifo wɔ Amansan Abatow mu wɔ December 2004. Ɔtuu mmirika a ɛtɔ so mmienu na odii nkonim. Ná ɔyɛ Besome-Freho mantam no MP.   Wɔpaw no sɛ mmrahyɛbagua muni maa saa mantam yi wɔ Republic of Ghana a ɛto so anan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so anan ne anum mu. Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, Ɔsii gyinae sɛ ɔbɛsan asi akan ama dibea no wɔ New patriotic party no mufoɔ ase nanso ɔdii nkoguo wɔ primaries no mu maa Kyei Frimpong, nea ɔne no reko no akyi no ɔsii gyinae sɛ ɔbɛsan asi akan ankorankoro bio nanso ɔdii nkoguo bio wɔ General Elections no mu nyaa abatoɔ 4,767 a na ɛyɛ ɛnyɛ nea ɛdɔɔso sɛ ɛbɛboro Kyei Frimpong a ɔtoo abatow 14,325 no so nkonim.

Abatow a wɔyɛ 
Wɔpaw Ofori-Kaguru sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma Besome-Freho mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana nea edi kan wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow no mu. Ɔsii akan sɛ obi a ɔde ne ho. Wɔde abatoɔ 16,209 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 19,796 a ɛne abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 81.9% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Kwame Adarkwa a ofi National Democratic Congress ne Richmond Addai Agyare a ofi Convention People’s Party mu . Eyinom nyaa abatow a ɛfata nyinaa mu 17.3% ne 0.8%.

Wɔ afe 2008 mu no, odii nkonim wɔ amansan abatow mu maa ɔmansin koro no ara.  Wɔde abatoɔ 9,140 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 19,462 a ɛne abatoɔ a ɛfata nyinaa mu 46.96% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Kwadwo Kyei Frimpong a ofi Ɔman Nnipa Kuw no mu, Asiedu Anthony Kennedy a ofi Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua no mu ne Sebastian Sunnoma a ofi Democratic Ahofadi Kuw no mu. Eyinom nyaa abatow a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 41.43%, 11.25% ne 0.35%.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ofori-Kaguru yɛ Katolekni Kristoni.  Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baanu.

Hwɛ nso 

 MP a wɔpaw wɔn wɔ afe 2004 Ghana mmrahyɛbagua abatow mu no din
 MP a wɔpaw wɔn wɔ afe 2008 Ghana mmrahyɛbagua abatow mu din

title: Gifty Ohene-Konadu
text:
Gifty Ohene-Konadu (wɔwoo no 23 Ɔbɛnem 1957)  yɛ ɔman adwumayɛni  ne Ghana amanyɔni a ɔwɔ Republic of Ghana. Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni a ogyina hɔ ma Asante-Akim Anafo mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana     wɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 4 ne 5 a ɛwɔ Ghana Ɔmanpanyin a ɛto so 4 no mu. Ɔyɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Gifty wɔ 23 Ɔbɛnem 1957.  Ɔfiri Juaso, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana .  Ɔyɛ Ghana Suapɔn no mu ade .  Ɔwɔ abodin krataa wɔ asetra ho adesua mu wɔ sukuupɔn no mu.  Gifty nso wɔ ofie sikasɛm ho adansedi krataa wɔ sukuupɔn koro no ara mu.  Onyaa abodin krataa a ɛkorɔn wɔ nkɔso ho adesua mu a na ne ho akokwaw wɔ ɔman nhyehyɛe ne adwumayɛ mu wɔ Asetra mu Adesua Asoɛe a ɛwɔ Netherlands no mu.  Ɔsan nso nyaa abodin krataa a ɛkorɔn wɔ mmarima ne mmea asomdwoe ne ahotɔ mu fii Kofi Annan Amanaman Ntam Asomdwoe Ntetee Asoɛe a ɛwɔ Accra Ghana.

Adwuma 
Gifty yɛ ɔfotufoɔ/nhwehwɛmufoɔ wɔ mmarima ne mmaa ne mpɔtam aban nsɛm ho ne ɔman adwumayɛfoɔ a ne ho akokwa.  Ɔboaboaa ne suahu ano bere a na ɔreyɛ adwuma sɛ adwuma no sohwɛfo panyin mfe 18 wɔ Ɔman Bagua a Ɛhwɛ Mmea ne Nkɔso So (NCWD). Gifty ne Ministry of Women and Children’s Affairs yɛɛ adwuma sɛ nnwuma sohwɛfoɔ mfeɛ 2. Asoɛeɛ foforɔ a ɔne no yɛɛ adwuma no bi ne Ministry of Regional Cooperation ne NEPAD ne Office of the Head of Civil Service sɛ F&A kwankyerɛfoɔ ne HR kwankyerɛfoɔ.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Gifty yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni .  Ɔbɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbagua muni fi Ɔpɛpɔn 2005 bere a ɔdaa ne ho adi sɛ nkonimdifo wɔ amansan abatow mu wɔ December 2004.  Ɔperee ne ho dii nkonim ne mprenu so na odii nkonim wɔ afe 2008 Amansan Abatoɔ mu.  Na ɔyɛ Asante-Akim South mantam no MP.  Wɔpaw no sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani maa saa mantam yi wɔ Ghana Republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan ne anum mu. Na ɔyɛ Ɔmanpanyin Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Aguadi ne Nnwuma so a ɔhwɛ Nnwuma nketewa ne akɛse so wɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 4 a ɛwɔ Ghana Ɔmanpanyin a ɛto so 4 no mu.

Abatow a wɔyɛ 
Wɔpaw Gifty sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani mma Asante-Akim South mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana nea edi kan wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow no mu.  Odii nkonim wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so.  Ná ne mantam no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 36 no fã wɔ nkongua 39 a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Ashanti Mantam no mu.  New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 128 wɔ nkongua 230 mu.  Wɔde abatow 24,085 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 40,384 a ɛne abatow a ɛfata nyinaa mu 59.6% yɛ pɛ.  Wɔpaw no sen Forkuo De-Graft a ofi National Democratic Congress, George Agyepong a ofi Convention People’s Party ne Andrews Frimpong a ɔyɛ obi a ɔde ne ho.  Eyinom nyaa abatow a ɛfata nyinaa mu 30.6%, 1.2% ne 8.5%.

Wɔ afe 2008 mu no, odii nkonim wɔ amansan abatow no mu wɔ New Patriotic Party tekiti so maa ɔmansin koro no ara.  Ná ne mansin no ka mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 34 a ɛwɔ nkongua 39 a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Ashanti Mantam no mu no ho.  New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 109 wɔ nkongua 230 mu.  Wɔde abatoɔ 23,838 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata 38,744 a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu a ɛne abatoɔ a ɛfata nyinaa mu 61.53% yɛ pɛ.  Wɔpaw no sen De-Graft Forkuo a ofi National Democratic Congress ne Quao Ebenezer a ofi Convention People’s Party mu . Eyinom nyaa abatow a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 36.73% ne 2.74%.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ɔdomfo yɛ Kristoni.  Ɔne Seventh Day Adventistfo no bɔ fekuw.  Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baasa.

Hwɛ nso 

 MP a wɔpaw wɔn wɔ afe 2004 Ghana mmrahyɛbagua abatow mu din
 MP a wɔpaw wɔn wɔ afe 2008 Ghana mmrahyɛbagua abatow mu din
