title: Frederick Opare-Ansah
text:
Frederick Opare-Ansah (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn 5, 1968) yɛ Electrical Engineer   ne Ghana  amanyɔni a ɔyɛ Ghana Mantam a ɛtɔ so nnan mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan ne ason no muni a ɔgyina Suhum Mansin ananmu wɔ Apueeɛ Mantam mu wɔ tekiti a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo (NPP) de mae.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Opare-Ansah wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn da a ɛtɔ so 5, afe 1958.  Ɔfiri Amankokrom-Akuapem, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Apueeɛ Mantam mu .   Owiee Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so na onyaa ne Bachelor of Science abodin krataa wɔ anyinam ahoɔden mfiridwuma mu wɔ afe 1994.

Adwumafa 
Opare-Ansah yɛɛ adwuma sɛ Third Rail (Ghana) Limited no kwankyerɛfo panyin.  Ɔyɛ Engineer wɔ n’adwuma mu.

Amammui mu adwuma 
Opare-Ansah yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo (NPP) no muni. Ɔyɛ Ghana Aban mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan, 5, 6 ne 7 no muni.  Odii kan bɛyɛɛ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua no muni a ogyinaa Suhum Mansin ananmu wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2005 mu bere a ɔdaa ne ho adi sɛ odii nkonim wɔ ne mantam abatow mu wɔ afe 2004 Amansan Abatow mu wɔ December mu no. Ɔrenya mmirikatu mpɛn 4 a ɛtoatoa so wɔ dibea mu mprempren efisɛ ɔda so ara gyina ne mansin ananmu wɔ mprempren Ghana mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 7 no mu.  Ɔyɛ Nkitahodi boayikuw no Titenani ne boayikuw a ɔhwɛ Sikasɛm ne Adwumayɛ so no muni.  Wɔ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 5 mu no na ɔyɛ Minority Chief Whip.

Abatow a wɔyɛ 
Opare-Ansah gyinaa Suhum mantam ananmu sɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni maa mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 5 wɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu .   Wɔpaw no wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so denam abatow 17,461 a onya fii abatow 38,577 a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu, a ɛne abatow a ɛfata nyinaa mu 45.3% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Jacob Kwaku Arkoh a ofi Nnipa Ɔman Nhyiam no mu, Samuel Fleischer Kwabi a ofi Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua no mu, Francis Darby Kobena Inkoom a ofi Nhyiam no mu Nnipa Kuw no mu, Matilda Garbrah a ɔyɛ ɔkannifo a ɔde ne ho. Eyinom nyaa abatow a ɛfata nyinaa mu 0.75%, 41.02%, 0.77% ne 12.20%.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Opare-Ansah yɛ Kristoni.  Ɔwaree.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Kwadwo Opare-Hammond
text:
Na Kwadwo Opare-Hammond yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɔni. Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni a ogyina hɔ ma Adenta mantam a ɛwɔ Greater Accra Mantam mu wɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan a ɛwɔ Ghana Republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu. Ná ɔyɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni .

Nwomasua 
Opare Hammond kɔɔ De Montfort Sukuupɔn mu. Onyaa Mmara ho Ɔbenfo wɔ Amanaman Ntam Hokwan a Nnipa Wɔ Ho Mmara mu fii saa sukuupɔn no mu.

Adwuma 
Efi hɔ no, na ɔyɛ Administrator ne Pastor wɔ n’adwuma mu. Ɔsan nso bɛyɛɛ Precious Minerals Marketing Company (PMMC) no kwankyerɛfo panyin. Wɔpaw no sɛ MD wɔ adwumakuw a wɔtɔn aboɔden abo wɔ afe 2017.

Amammui mu adwuma 
Wɔ afe 2004 mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni a odi kan maa Adenta Mantam no bere a wɔtew amansin no fii Ashaiman Mantam no mu akyi. Na Kwadwo Opare-Hammond yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni. Ɔbɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbaguani fi January 2005 bere a ɔdaa ne ho adi sɛ nkonimdifo wɔ 2004 Ghana amansan abatow mu no . Na ɔyɛ Adenta mantam mu MP, na n’ahennie no baa awieeɛ wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2009 mu wɔ mmrahyɛbagua no gui akyi. Wɔ afe 2014 mu no, wɔyii Opare-Hammond fii ne dibea sɛ Sikasɛm ne Adwumayɛ sohwɛfoɔ wɔ New Patriotic Party no mu wɔ soboɔ a wɔbɔɔ no sɛ sikasɛm mu mfata ne asoɔden a ɔde maa saa Ɔman Titenani, Paul Afoko a na ɔwɔ hɔ saa berɛ no akyi.

2004 Abatow a Wɔyɛe 
Wɔde abatoɔ 16,646 na ɛpaw no wei ne abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 44.7% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Joseph Kabu Davies a ofi Ɔman Democratic Congress, Patrick Offei Addo a ofi Convention People's Party, Abdul-Manaf Yunus a ofi Democratic People's Party ne David Pessey a ofi National Reform Party . Eyinom nyaa abatow 17,020, abatow 704, abatow 644 ne abatow 225 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 46.6%, 1.9%, 1.8% ne 0.6% yɛ pɛ. Na Opare-Hammond mantam no yɛ amansin 17 a New Patriotic Party dii nkonim wɔ Greater Accra mantam mu wɔ saa abatow no mu no fa.  Sɛ yɛka ne nyinaa bom a, New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 128 wɔ Ghana republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ná Kwadwo Opare-Hammond yɛ Kristoni.

Owuo 
Wɔbɔ amanneɛ sɛ Kwadwo Opare-Hammond wui wɔ 11 January 2019 wɔ Korle-Bu Teaching Hospital wɔ yareɛ tiawa bi akyi.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Frema Opare
text:
Frema Opare, Akosua Frema Osei-Opare (wɔwoo no afe 1948) yɛ nkɔsoɔ ho nimdefo, ɔbenfo, ne Ghana  amanyɔni. Ɔgyinaa Ayawaso West Wuogon Mansin ananmu wɔ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua no mu. Ɔyɛ ɔbea a ɔyɛ Ghana Adwumayɛfo Panyin mprempren ne nea odi kan .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Frema wɔ 6 Ɔbɛnem 1948. Ɔfiri Wiamoase a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.  Ɔnyaa ne bachelor’s degree wɔ Home Science mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu . Ɔkɔɔ Guelph Sukuupɔn mu kɔyɛɛ abodin krataa a ɛkorɔn wɔ Aduan Ho Nyansahu mu.

Adwuma 
Frema maa ɔkasa wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ wɔ Department of Home Science firi afe 1976 kɔsi afe 1982. Awiei koraa no ɔbɛyɛɛ dwumadibea no Titenani. Ɔne Amanaman Nkabom no nso ayɛ adwuma wɔ Women In Fisheries adwuma no mu wɔ dibea ahorow mu wɔ Uganda, Ethiopia, Congo ne Namibia .  Frema wɔ afe 2005 - 2008 mu yɛɛ adwuma wɔ Ɔmanpanyin John Agyekum Kufuor aban ase sɛ Ɔmanpanyin Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Adwumayɛfoɔ, Mmabun ne Adwumayɛ so. Bere bi nso ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ bere abien sɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni ma Ayawaso West Wuogon .

Amammui mu adwuma 
Frema yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni . Ɔdii dwuma mfeɛ mmienu sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani a ɔgyinaa Ayawaso West Wuogon Mansin ananmu wɔ afe 2005 ne 2013 ntam wɔ NPP tekiti ase .

2004 Abatow a Wɔyɛe 
Wɔpaw Opare sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani wɔ Ayawaso West-Wuogon mantam mu wɔ afe 2004 Ghana Amansan abatow mu.  Ɔnam saayɛ so gyinaa amansin no ananmu wɔ Ghana republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu.  Wɔde abatow 28,636 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 54,988 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 52.1% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Henry Haruna Asante a ofi Ɔmanfo Ɔman Nhyiam no mu, Samuel Adiepena a ofi Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua no mu ne Greenstreet Kobina a ofi Nhyiam no mu Nnipa Kuw no mu . Eyinom nyaa abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 1.0%, 37.9% ne 9.0%. Wɔpaw Opare wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so. Ná ne mantam no yɛ amansin 17 a New Patriotic Party dii nkonim wɔ Greater Accra mantam mu wɔ saa abatow no mu no fã.  Sɛ wɔka ne nyinaa bom a, New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 128 wɔ Ghana man a ɛto so 4 no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 4 no mu .

Ankorankoro asetra 
Frema aware na ɔwɔ mma baanan. Ɔyɛ Kristoni.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Eric Opoku (amanyɔni)
text:
Eric Opoku yɛ Ghana amammuini ne Mmarahyɛ Bagua a ɛtɔ so nson ne Mmarahyɛ Bagua a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe a ɛwɔ Ghana Republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no muni a ɔgyina Asunafo South Constituency ananmu wɔ Brong-Ahafo Mantam mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Eric Opoku wɔ 5 Ɔbɛnem 1970.   Ɔfiri kuro bi a wɔfrɛ no Sankore a ɛwɔ Brong Ahafo mantam mu wɔ Ghana.   Ɔnyaa ne Bachelor of Arts abodin krataa wɔ Social Science mu wɔ Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology wɔ afe 2004.

Adwuma 
Opoku yɛ okuafoɔ/ kuayɛfoɔ.  Ansa na wɔrepaw no sɛ ɔnyɛ mmarahyɛ bagua no, na ɔyɛ adwuma sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo wɔ Ghana Nhomasua Dwumadibea wɔ SDA Mfitiase Sukuu a ɛwɔ Sankore, fi afe 1997 kosi afe 2000.   Ɔne Kuapa Kookoo Ltd nso ayɛ adwuma sɛ Asafo Nkɔsoɔ Ɔkyerɛwfoɔ firi afe 1998 kɔsi afe 2001.

Amammui mu adwuma 
Wɔdii kan paw Opoku sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ mmarahyɛ bagua wɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmarahyɛ bagua a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa mu sɛ mmarahyɛ bagua no muni ma Asunafo Anafoɔ mantam a ɛwɔ Brong Ahafo mantam mu wɔ Ghana.   Ɛwom sɛ ɔhweree n’akongua wɔ abatoɔ a ɛdi hɔ no mu deɛ, nanso wɔsan paw no sɛ ɔkɔɔ mmarahyɛ bagua mu wɔ 7 Ɔbɛnem 2013 berɛ a ɔkaa sɛ ɔdii nkonim wɔ afe 2012 Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ no mu sɛ ɔbɛgyina Asunafo Anafoɔ mantam ananmu na ɔdii dwuma kɔsii Ɔbɛnem 6, 2017. Afei wɔsan paw no wɔ 7 Ɔbɛnem 2017 wɔ afe 2016 Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ no akyi baabi a ɔnyaa abatoɔ a ɛfata no mu 52.97%.

Ɔayɛ adwuma sɛ Brong Ahafo Ɔmantam Ɔsoafoɔ Abadiakyiri firi afe 2009 kɔsi afe 2013.  Wɔ Ghana republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmarahyɛ bagua a ɛtɔ so nson mu no ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ Aduan, Kuadwuma ne Kokoɔ Nsɛm Boayikuo no mu sɛ Ɔmanpanyin a ɔdi kan.  Ɔsan nso yɛɛ Hokwan Boayikuw ne Nnipa a Wɔpaw Wɔn Boayikuw no mu wɔ mmarahyɛ bagua koro no ara mu.

Opoku nyaa abasobɔdeɛ sɛ mmarahyɛ baguani a ɔsen biara wɔ mpɔtam ne nkuraaseɛ nkɔsoɔ ho wɔ afe 2017 mu firii Bureau of Research on Governance, Commerce and Administration (BORGCA) hɔ. Wɔde saa abasobɔdeɛ yi maeɛ wɔ ne mmoa a ɔde maeɛ wɔ nkɔsoɔ nnwuma mu wɔ Asunafo Anafoɔ mantam mu.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Aaron Mike Oquaye
text:
Aaron Mike Oquaye (wɔwoo no 4 April 1944) yɛ Ghana mmaranimni ne amanyɔni a ɔyɛɛ mmrahyɛbagua no Kasafo a ɔto so asia wɔ Fourth Republic of Ghana fi afe 2017 kosi afe 2021.   Ɔyɛ adesua, ɔman nanmusifo ne Baptist somfo, kan no na ɔwɔ aban mpanyimfo asomfo dwumadi ahorow a ɛhwɛ ahoɔden ne nkitahodi so na na ɔsan yɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ India so (2002–04) wɔ Kufuor nniso no mu.

Mfitiase asetra 
Wɔwoo Michael Aaron Oquaye wɔ 4 Ayɛwohomumɔ 1944 wɔ Osu, Accra, Ghana (saa bere no na ɛyɛ Gold Coast), na ne maame ne E. G. N Oquaye a ofi Osu ne Felicia Awusika Abla Oquaye (wɔwoo no Azu) a ofi Odumase-Krobo .  Wɔtetee no wɔ Asamankese wɔ ɔman no Apuei Fam Mantam mu, faako a ɔkɔɔ Roma Katolek Mfitiase Sukuu ne Presbyterian Mfinimfini Sukuu ansa na ɔrekɔ Presbyterian Mmarimaa Ntoaso Sukuu (PRESEC), wɔ Odumase-Krobo ne afei Apam Senior High School .

Na Oquaye papa, E. N. Oquaye, yɛ United Gold Coast Convention (UGCC) a wɔhyehyɛɛ no wɔ Asamankese . Na ɔsan nso yɛ sikakorafoɔ ne sikasɛm sohwɛfoɔ titire wɔ UGCC, Gold Coast Party (GCP), National Liberation Movement (NLM) ne United Party (UP) wɔ Asamankese. Bere a Oquaye yɛ abofra no, n’abusua gyee amammuifo ne anuonyamfo te sɛ Ɔbenfo J. B. Danquah ne Ɔbenfo. Kofi Abrefa Busia sɛ ahɔho wɔ wɔn fie. Okyenhene Nana Ofori Atta II, bere a na ɔwɔ nnommumfa mu wɔ Accra no, na ɔsan kɔ Oquaye abusua fie a ɛwɔ Asamankese no mu daa.

Nhomasua ne mmara adwuma 
Oquaye kɔɔ Presbyterian Boys' Senior Secondary School, faako a onyaa ne GCE "O"-Level Certificate, na afei Apam Secondary School maa ne "A" Level Certificates . Ɔkɔɔ Ghana Sukuupɔn mu na akyiri yi ɔkɔɔ London Sukuupɔn mu, wɔ Lincoln's Inn, London . Ɔwɔ BA (Hons. ) Amanyɔsɛm, LLB (Hons. ), BL ne PhD. Ɔyɛ mmaranimfo ne mmaranimfo a ɔfata, ne nea ɔhyehyɛɛ n’ankasa mmara adwumayɛbea ne ne yɔnko panyin. Ɔyɛ England ne Wales Asɛnnibea Kunini no mmaranimfo, Ghana Mmaranimfo Kuw no muni panyin, ne mmaranimfo ma nnwumakuw ne sikasɛm asoɛe ahorow bi a wɔagye din.

Nhomasua mu adwuma 
Oquaye yɛ Amanyɔsɛm ho ɔbenfoɔ wɔ Ghana Suapɔn, (Legon), na kan no na ɔyɛ Amanyɔsɛm Dwumadibea no Titenani ne sukuupɔn no Adesua Boayikuo no muni, tumidi a ɛkorɔn wɔ faculties no gyinabea. Onyaa ne Ph.D fii Apuei ne Afrika Adesua Sukuu a ɛwɔ London, ne Rockefeller Senior Scholar Award wɔ 1993 ne Senior Fulbright Scholar Award wɔ 1997 mu. Wayɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo a ɔsrasra George Mason Sukuupɔn a ɛwɔ Virginia no mu . Efi 1997 kosi 1999 no, na ɔyɛ Afrika Amanyɔsɛm Fekuw (AAPS) a ɛwɔ Zimbabwe no titrani abadiakyiri.

Nkyerɛwee ne nsɛm a wɔka de gyina nkurɔfo akyi 
Sɛ ɔkyerɛwfo no, Oquaye ayɛ nhwehwɛmu na watintim nkyerɛwee ahorow pii a ɛfa nniso pa, ntawntawdi, amammuisɛm ho adesua, decentralization ne nkɔso, nnipa hokwan ahorow, asraafo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ amammuisɛm mu, NGOs, nkuraase nkɔso ne mmarima ne mmea ho nsɛm ho. Ɔkamfo hokwan ahorow a mmea wɔ, a affirmative action ka ho .

Ɔno na ɔkyerɛw nwoma a wagye abasobɔdeɛ Politics in Ghana, 1972–1979, a ɔkyerɛɛ, nea ɛka ho ne asraafoɔ sɛ Aban ne Amanyɔsɛm mu ɔhaw wɔ Afrika na ɔkaa nsɛm a ɛfa nnipa hokwan a wɔabu so, amammuisɛm a ɛko tia, sikasɛm ho asɛm adwumayɛ a ɛnteɛ ne ɔman no mu ɔsɛe. Ɔkyerɛw nhoma a ɛto so abien, Politics in Ghana, 1982–1992, a ɛfa ɔman anidan amammuisɛm, CDRs, Ɔmanfo Asɛnnibea ahorow, ɔmanfo tumi, animtiaabu pa ne nnipa hokwan ho nsɛm a na ɛwɔ hɔ saa bere no ho. Wɔatintim ne nhomanimfo nsɛm wɔ amanaman ntam nsɛmma nhoma ahorow te sɛ Human Rights Quarterly (U.S.), Journal of Commonwealth and Comparative Politics (UK), African Affairs (UK), ne Review of Human Factor Studies (Canada) mu.

Amammui mu adwuma 
Sɛ osuani wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu no, Oquaye de ne ho bɔɔ ɔsatu no maa JB Danquah / Kofi Abrefa Busia asɛm no. Oquaye foaa Busia ɔfrɛ a ɛne sɛ wɔnsan nkɔ ɔmanfo nniso mu ntɛm na wɔasiw ɔman no asraafo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no akyi denneennen na ɔne n’abusua boa ma wɔhyehyɛɛ Nkɔso Kuw no wɔ Osu wɔ 1969 mu.

Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo 
United Party-Progress Party atetesɛm no na ɛma wɔhyehyɛɛ, wɔ afe 1992 mu, New Patriotic Party (NPP), a Oquaye yɛ ɔmannifo a ɔhyehyɛɛ no. Ɔno ne NPP Ɔmantam Ɔkyerɛwfo a odi kan ma Greater Accra wɔ afe 1992 mu, na ɔsan nso yɛ Party no Titenani a odi kan ma Ga Mantam Nkuraase Mantam, a akyiri yi ɛpaapaee yɛɛ no Ga West District ne Ga East District . Na ɔyɛ Nhwehwɛmu Boayikuw no kyerɛwfo na na ɔyɛ NPP Ɔman Ɔsatu Kuw a edi kan no muni wɔ afe 1992 bosome abiɛsa mu.

Ɔne NPP mfinimfini mpanyimfo afoforo yɛɛ adwuma, a Ɔmampanyin John Kufuor, Nana Addo Dankwa Akufo-Addo, R. R. Amponsah, Prof. Adu-Boahen, Peter Ala Adjetey, B. J. da Rocha ne Samuel Odoi-Sykes, sɛ wɔbɛbɔ NPP nkonimdi wɔ afe 2000 amansan abatow no mu yiye . Wobu dwuma a Oquaye dii wɔ akuw no nkonimdi mu a ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo ntoboa ne kuw no dwumadi afoforo a ɔde ne ho hyɛɛ mu wɔ 1993 ne 2000 ntam no sɛ ɛho hia.

Ɔmanpanyin ne Ɔman Soafo 
Efi afe 2001 kosi afe 2004 no, Oquaye yɛɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanyin wɔ India .  Wɔ February 2005 mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ Ahoɔden so, na akyiri yi wɔde no kɔɔ Nkitahodi Soafo dibea.

mmrahyɛbagua no muni 
Oquaye yɛ NPP mmrahyɛbagua no muni wɔ Dome-Kwabenya mfeɛ mmienu, ɛfiri afe 2004 kɔsi afe 2012.  Ɔyɛɛ n’adwene sɛ ɔrennyina hɔ mma dibea foforo. Ɔboaa ne babarima, Mike Oquaye Jnr, sɛ ɔnko sɛ ɔbɛyɛ NPP mmrahyɛbagua Kandidate ama ɔmansin no. Nanso ne ba no dii nkogu wɔ Sarah Adwoa Safo, a ɔkɔɔ so nyaa nkongua no.

Efi afe 2009 kosi afe 2013 no, na Oquaye yɛ mmrahyɛbagua no Kasafo Abadiakyiri a ɔto so abien. Joe Gharte na odii n’ade wɔ afe 2013.

mmrahyɛbagua no Kasafo 
Oquaye yɛɛ mmrahyɛbagua no Kasafo wɔ Fourth Republic mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so ason no mu.   Wɔ afe 2021 mu no, New Patriotic Party no paw no sɛ ɔnyɛ mmrahyɛbagua no Kasafo a ɔdii nkogu wɔ Alban Kingsford Sumani Bagbin wɔ Ɔbɛnem 7 a National Democratic Congress paw no no anim .  Alban Kingsford Sumani Bagbin de too gua wɔ mmrahyɛbagua no nhyiamu a ɛdi kan no mu sɛ wɔde abatoɔ 138 na ɛpaw no berɛ a Mike Oquaye nyaa abatoɔ 136.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Oquaye yɛ Baptist Asɔre no sɔfo . Ɔwaree Alberta Oquaye ( née Asafu-Adjaye) (Major Rtd.) a ɔyɛ ɔyarehwɛfo a ɔyɛ adwumaden. Ɔyɛ Mike Oquaye Jnr, Ghana Ɔmanpanyin a ɔwɔ India mprempren no agya.

Nneɛma a Oquaye ani gye ho ne bɔɔlbɔ, pon so tɛnis, nhoma akenkan, . retwerɛ, ne nnwom a wotie.

Nhoma ahorow a wɔahyehyɛ 

 Amanyɔsɛm wɔ Ghana, 1982–1992 (Tornado Nwoma, 1980, 1992  .
 Demokrasi, Amanyɔsɛm ne Ntawntawdi Ho Nsiesiei wɔ Nnɛyi Ghana (Gold-Type Publication, 1995)

Akyinnyegye ahorow 
Wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2020 mu no, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfoɔ yɛɛ basabasa wɔ amanneɛbɔ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ mmrahyɛbagua no kasamafoɔ, Aaron Mike Oquaye ahunahuna sɛ ɔbɛbara nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfoɔ a wɔka nsɛm foforɔ a ɛsisi wɔ mmrahyɛbagua no dan mu a ɛnyɛ dan no mu.

Wɔ August 2020 mu no, ɔmaa baguam ɔkasa bi wɔ Founders' Day, a ɔkaa sɛ "Ahofadi nyɛ onipa biako ɔyɛkyerɛ, na ɛyɛ mmɔdenbɔ a wɔbom yɛ". Sɛnea Oquaye kyerɛ no, ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔhyɛ kan ɔmampanyin Kwame Nkrumah nkutoo ni na mmom ɛsɛ sɛ wɔka bom ne Ghana agyanom a wɔhyehyɛɛ no nyinaa. Oquaye nso kaa sɛ ɛnyɛ Nkrumah nko ara na ɔrepere ahofadie ɛwom sɛ ɔko maa Ghana ahofadie. Nkrumah ba Sekou Nkrumah kasa tiaa Prof. Oquaye wɔ saa nsɛm no ho, na ɔkaa sɛ, sɛ mmrahyɛbagua no kasamafoɔ pɛ sɛ ɔkasa tia n’agya a wawuo a, ɛsɛ sɛ ɔka ɔman baako nhyehyɛeɛ ne Preventive Detectionn Act (PDA) a wɔde baeɛ wɔ Nkrumah berɛ so no ho asɛm.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

Nneɛma a wonya fi mu 
"Ɔbenfo a ɔyɛ ɔbenfo. Mike Oquaye" . Ɔmanfoɔ asetena ho nsɛm a ɛfiri Republic of Ghana wɛbsaet hɔ

title: Kofi Osei-Ameyaw
text:
Kofi Osei-Ameyaw yɛ Ghana mmaranimni ne kan mmrahyɛbaguani a ɔgyina Asuogyaman amansin ananmu wɔ Ghana Apueeɛ Mantam mu. Na ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanyin a ɛtɔ so nnan ne 6 mmrahyɛbagua no muni. Ɔyɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Osei-Ameyaw wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 20, 1960. Ɔfiri Gyakiti-Akwamu a ɛwɔ Ghana Apueeɛ Mantam mu. Ɔyɛ Macquarie Sukuupɔn a ɛwɔ Sydney no ade. Onyaa mmara ho abodin krataa wɔ sukuupɔn no mu. Eyi sii wɔ 1985 mu. Mprempren ɔreyɛ mmara ho abodin krataa a ɛkorɔn wɔ sukuupɔn koro no ara mu

Adwuma 
Osei-Ameyaw na ɔhyehyɛɛ Lloyds International College a ɛwɔ Sydney, Australia.  Na ɔyɛ Mirage Royal Apartments a ɛwɔ East Legon ne Careshare Foundation no guamtrani.  Efi January 2020 no, na ɔyɛ Association of Lotto Marketing Companies no kwankyerɛfo panyin.

Amammui mu adwuma 
Osei-Ameyaw yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni .  Ɔbɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbagua muni fi Ɔpɛpɔn 2005 bere a ɔdaa ne ho adi sɛ nkonimdifo wɔ Amansan Abatow mu wɔ December 2004.  Ná ɔyɛ Asuogyaman mantam no MP.  Wɔpaw no sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani maa saa mantam yi wɔ Ghana Republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan ne nsia no mu.

Abatow a wɔyɛ 
Wɔpaw Osei-Ameyaw sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma Asuogyaman mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Apuei Fam mantam mu wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow mu. Odii nkonim wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so . Ná ne mansin no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 22 no fã wɔ nkongua 28 a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Apuei Fam Mantam no mu .  New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 128 wɔ nkongua 230 mu.  Wɔde abatow 17,806 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 34,479 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 51.6% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Emmanuel Dwamena Bekoe a ofi National Democratic Congress, Foli Emmanuel Wonder Kwadzo a ofi Convention People’s Party ne Joses Asare Akoto ne Mustapha Kofi Fiadzigbe a wɔn baanu nyinaa yɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho. Eyinom nyaa abatow 15,873, 142, 426 ne 146 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtowee nyinaa mu 46%, 0.4%, 1.2% ne 0.4% yɛ pɛ.

Wɔ afe 2008 mu no, ɔdii nkogu wɔ amansan abatoɔ no mu wɔ Joses Asare Akoto a ɔfiri asɔretiafoɔ kuo National Democratic Congress mu no mu denam abatoɔ 1,135 so. Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔsan sii akan maa ɔmansin koro no ara. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ afe 2012 amansan abatoɔ no mu wɔ New Patriotic Party tekiti so . Ná ne mansin no ka mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 19 a ɛwɔ nkongua 27 a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu wɔ Apuei Fam Mantam no mu no ho .  New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 108 wɔ nkongua 230 mu.  Wɔde abatow 20,750 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 40,415 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 51.34% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Joses Asare Akoto a ofi National Democratic Congress, Solomon Adu Obuobi a ofi Progressive People’s Party, Slanzy Atsu Wornah a ofi People’s National Convention, Mensah Albert Corbla a ofi Convention People’s Party ne Dwamena Bekoe a ofi National Democratic Party. Eyinom nyaa abatow 18,650, 624, 39, 95 ne 257 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu.  Eyinom ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtowee nyinaa mu 46.15%, 1.54%, 0.10%, 0.24% ne 0.64% yɛ pɛ.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Osei-Ameyaw yɛ Kristoni.  Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baanu.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Simon Osei-Mensah
text:
Simon Osei-Mensah (wɔwoo no 27 May 1961) yɛ Ghana  amanyɔni, ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nsia ne Ghana Aman a ɛtɔ so nnan no muni, na ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party no muni wɔ Ghana . Ɔyɛ Ashanti Mantam soafoɔ wɔ Ghana.  Ɔmanpanyin Nana Addo Danquah Akuffo-Addo na ɔpaw no wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2017 mu na mmrahyɛbagua no mufoɔ penee so wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2017.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Osei-Mensah wɔ 27 Ɔpɛpɔn 1961.  Ɔfiri Yachie kurow a ɛwɔ Ashanti mantam mu mu . Onyaa Sikasɛm mu Nyansahu mu abodin krataa wɔ Ɔman ne Wiase Sikasɛm Sukuupɔn a ɛwɔ Sofia, Bulgaria, mu wɔ 1991 mu. Ɔsan nso wɔ Sikakorabea ho Abodin krataa a efi Adwumayɛbea a ɛwɔ Odense, Denmark, a onyae wɔ afe 1998.

Adwuma 
Osei-Mensah yɛ sikasɛm ho ɔbenfo ne sikakorabea dwumayɛni.  Ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ adwumayɛ sohwɛfo wɔ Kuapa Kokoo Credit Union ansa na ɔrepɛ sɛ onya amammui dibea.

Amammui mu adwuma 
Osei-Mensah yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni.  Ɔbɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbagua muni fi Ɔpɛpɔn 2005 bere a ɔdaa ne ho adi sɛ nkonimdifo wɔ Amansan Abatow mu wɔ December 2004.  Otuu mmirika dii afe a ɛto so abien ne abiɛsa na odii nkonim. Na ɔyɛ MP a ɔhwɛ Bosomtwe mantam so. Wɔpaw no sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani maa saa mantam yi wɔ Ghana Republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan, anum ne nsia no mu.    Wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2020 mu, berɛ a n’apam no san baa n’adwuma mu akyi no, Ɔmampanyin Nana Akuffo-Addo paw no sɛ Ashanti mantam soafoɔ.

Abatow a wɔyɛ 
Wɔpaw Osei-Mensah sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani maa Bosomtwe mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu nea edi kan wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow no mu. Odii nkonim wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so.  Na ne mansin no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 36 no fã wɔ nkongua 39 a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Ashanti Mantam no mu.  New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 128 wɔ nkongua 230 mu.  Wɔde abatoɔ 28,052 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata 34,225 a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu a ɛne abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 82% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Suleiman Mohammed a ofi Ɔmanfo Ɔman Nhyiam no mu, Edward Isaac Boateng a ofi Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua no mu ne Paul Adomako Ansah a ofi Nhyiam no mu Ɔmanfo Kuw no mu . Eyinom nyaa abatow a ɛfata nyinaa mu 1.0%, 14.3% ne 2.8%.

Wɔ afe 2008 mu no, odii nkonim wɔ amansan abatow no mu wɔ New Patriotic Party tekiti so maa ɔmansin koro no ara.  Ná ne mansin no ka mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 34 a ɛwɔ nkongua 39 a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Ashanti Mantam no mu no ho.  New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 109 wɔ nkongua 230 mu.  Wɔde abatoɔ 25,988 paw no wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata 37,194 a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu, a ɛne 69.87% yɛ pɛ, na wɔpaw no sene Suleiman Mohammed a ɔfiri People’s National Convention, Dr. Joseph Oteng Adjei a ɔfiri National Democratic Congress ne Gilbert Adler Alhassan a ɔfiri Convention People’s Party. Eyinom nyaa abatow a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 1.46%, 27.67% ne 0.99%.

Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔdii nkonim wɔ amansan abatoɔ no mu bio wɔ New Patriotic Party tekiti so maa ɔmansin korɔ no ara. Wɔde abatow 34,790 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 52,269 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 66.56% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Joe Oteng-Adjei a ofi National Democratic Congress, Kwame Ofosu Chei a ofi Progressive People’s Party ne Yaw Wiredu a ofi People’s National Convention. Eyinom nyaa abatow a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 32.97%, 0.36% ne 0.11%.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Osei-Mensah yɛ Katolek Kristoni. Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baanum.

title: Emmanuel Asamoah Owusu-Ansah
text:
Emmanuel Asamoah Owusu-Ansah (17 Ɔpɛpɔn 1939 – 22 Ɔbɛnem 2012)  yɛ mmaranimni  ne Ghana amanyɔni a ɔfiri Ghana man mu. Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni a ogyinaa Kwabre West mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan ne 5 no mu. Na ɔyɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Owusu-Ansah wɔ 17 Ɔpɛpɔn 1939.  Ɔfirii Bomso a ɛbɛn Kodie kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana .  Na ɔyɛ Ghana Suapɔn (UG) no adeyɛ .  Ɔnyaa Bachelor of Science abodin krataa wɔ sikasɛm mu wɔ sukuupɔn no mu.  Ɔnyaa abodin krataa no wɔ afe 1967.  Ná ɔyɛ The Hague a ɛwɔ Netherlands no nso ade.  Efi hɔ no, onyaa Ɔmanfo Nnwuma ho abodin krataa a ɛkorɔn.  Eyi sii afe 1974.  Na ɔyɛ obi a wawie Ghana Mmara Sukuu nso .  Ɔnyaa Bachelor of Law abodin krataa wɔ sukuu no mu wɔ afe 1986.

Adwuma 
Na Owusu-Ansah yɛ mmaranimfo wɔ n’adwuma mu.  Na ɔyɛ atemmu ho ɔkyerɛwfo wɔ Atemmu Dwumadibea.

Amammui mu adwuma 
Ná Owusu-Ansah yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni .  Ɔbɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbaguani firi Ɔpɛpɔn 2005 berɛ a ɔdaa ne ho adi sɛ ɔdii nkonim wɔ Amansan Abatoɔ mu wɔ December 2004. Ɔtu mmirika kɔdi tumi afe a ɛtɔ so mmienu. Na ɔyɛ MP a ɔhwɛ Kwabre West mantam so. Wɔpaw no sɛ mmrahyɛbagua muni maa saa mantam yi wɔ Republic of Ghana a ɛto so anan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so anan ne anum mu.

Abatow a wɔyɛ 
Wɔpaw Owusu-Ansah sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani mma Kwabre West mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana nea edi kan wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow no mu. Odii nkonim wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so. Na ne mansin no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 36 no fã wɔ nkongua 39 a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Ashanti Mantam no mu.  New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 128 wɔ nkongua 230 mu.  Wɔde abatow 26,700 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 31,746 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 84.1% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Gabriel Amakye a ofi National Democratic Congress .6 Amakye nyaa abatow 5,046 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 15.9% yɛ pɛ.

Wɔ afe 2008 mu no, odii nkonim wɔ amansan abatow no mu wɔ New Patriotic Party tekiti so maa ɔmansin koro no ara. Ná ne mansin no ka mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 34 a ɛwɔ nkongua 39 a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Ashanti Mantam no mu no ho.  New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 109 wɔ nkongua 230 mu.  Wɔde abatow 27,460 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 33,516 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 81.93% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Joseph Boache Danquah a ofi People’s National Convention, Pius Opoku Boateng a ofi National Democratic Congress, Osei Kwadwo a ofi Reformed Patriotic Democrats ne Akua Donkor a ɔyɛ obi a ɔde ne ho. Eyinom nyaa abatow 3,329, 0, 729, 1998 wɔ abatow a ɛfata nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne 9.93%, 0%, 2.18% ne 5.96% yɛ pɛ wɔ abatow a wɔtow nyinaa mu.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Na Owusu-Ansah yɛ Kristoni na na ɔne no bɔ fekuw sɛ Presbyterian.  Na waware na ɔwɔ mma baanum.

Owuo 
Owusu-Ansah wui wɔ Korle-Bu Nkyerɛkyerɛ Ayaresabea hɔ bere a ɔhwee ase wɔ 22 June 2012.

title: Benito Owusu Bio
text:
Benito Owusu Bio (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn 1, 1968)   yɛ asase ho sikasɛm ho nimdefo   ne Ghana amanyɔni a ɔte Republic of Ghana. Ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni a ogyina hɔ ma Atwima-Nwabiagya mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana Ɔmanpanyin a ɛto so 4,5,6, 7 ne 8 mmrahyɛbagua no mu.  Ɔyɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Owusu Ɔberɛfɛw da 1, afe 1968.   Ɔfiri Akropong kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana .  Ɔyɛ Kwame Nkrumah Sukuupɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma So no ade .  Ɔwɔ Bachelor of Science abodin krataa wɔ Asase Sikasɛm mu wɔ sukuupɔn no mu.   Ɔnyaa abodin krataa no wɔ afe 1994.   Ɔsan yɛ Birmingham Sukuupɔn mu ade .  Ɔwɔ Masters wɔ Sociology mu wɔ Ahɔhoyɛ mu.   Ɔnyaa adansedie krataa no wɔ afe 1998.

Adwuma 
Na Owusu yɛ Hotel Georgia Limited a ɛwɔ Kumasi no panyin .

Amammui mu adwuma 
Owusu yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni .    Ɔbɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbagua muni fi Ɔpɛpɔn 2005 bere a ɔdaa ne ho adi sɛ nkonimdifo wɔ Amansan Abatow mu wɔ December 2004. Efi saa bere no, wadi tumi mpɛn anan a ɛtoatoa so.  Ɔyɛ MP a ɔhwɛ Atwima-Nwabiagya North mantam so.     Wɔapaw no sɛ mmrahyɛbagua muni ama saa mantam yi wɔ Republic of Ghana a ɛto so anan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so anan, anum, asia ne ason no mu.  Na ɔyɛ akwan ne akwantuo Boayikuo ne Ɔmanfoɔ Akontaabuo Boayikuo no muni wɔ 4th Republic of Ghana mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nson no mu.  Bere a na ɔwɔ mmrahyɛbagua mu no, wɔpaw no sɛ Ɔmanpanyin Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Asase ne Abɔde mu Nneɛma so.

Abatow a wɔyɛ 
Wɔpaw Owusu-Bio sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma Atwima-Nwabiagya Atifi fam mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana nea edi kan wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow no mu. Odii nkonim wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so. Na ne mansin no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 36 no fã wɔ nkongua 39 a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Ashanti Mantam no mu .  New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 128 wɔ nkongua 230 mu.  Wɔde abatoɔ 56,337 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 70,252 a ɛne abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 80.2% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Ebenezer Obu Tetteh a ofi Peoples’ National Convention, Nana Appia Manu a ofi National Democratic Congress, Munni Issah a ofi Convention People’s Party ne Ben Owusu Boadu a ofi Every Ghanaian Living Everywhere amammui kuw no mu. Eyinom nyaa abatow a ɛfata nyinaa mu 1.0% 17.1%, 1.5% ne 0.3%.

Wɔ afe 2008 mu no, odii nkonim wɔ amansan abatow no mu wɔ New Patriotic Party tekiti so maa ɔmansin koro no ara. Ná ne mansin no ka mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 34 a ɛwɔ nkongua 39 a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Ashanti Mantam no mu no ho.  New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 109 wɔ nkongua 230 mu.  Wɔde abatoɔ 46,605 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 72,973 a ɛne abatoɔ a ɛfata nyinaa mu 63.87% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Chogkureh Christopher a ofi National Democratic Congress ne Yaw Frimpong ne kuw a ɛde ne ho so. Eyinom nyaa abatow a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 17.07% ne 19.06%.

Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔdii nkonim wɔ amansan abatoɔ no mu wɔ New Patriotic Party tekiti so maa ɔmansin korɔ no ara. Wɔde abatoɔ 27,456 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 45,849 a ɛne abatoɔ a ɛfata nyinaa mu 59.88% yɛ pɛ.  Wɔpaw no sen Anthony Bernard Ansah a ofi National Democratic Congress, Kwadwo Amponsah a ofi Progressive People’s Party ne Dickson Osei-Asibey a ɔyɛ obi a ɔde ne ho. 12,13 Eyinom nyaa abatow a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 18.2%, 0.84% ne 21.08%. Wɔsan paw Benito wɔ afe 2016 ne 2020 amansan abatoɔ mu sɛ ɔnyɛ ananmusifoɔ wɔ Fourth Republic mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nson ne 8 no mu.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Owusu-Bio yɛ Kristoni na ɔyɛ Anglikan asɔre no muni.  Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baasa.

title: Emmanuel Owusu-Mainu
text:
Emmaunuel Owusu-Mainu (wɔwoo no 3 Ɔpɛpɔn 1949) yɛ Ghana nhomasua ho nimdefo ne ɔmanyɔni. Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma Atebubu-Amantin Mantam no wɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so anan ne anum a ɛwɔ Ghana Republic a Ɛto so Anan no mu .

Mfitiase asetra ne adwuma 
Wɔwoo Owusu-Mainu wɔ 3 Ɔpɛpɔn 1949.  Ne kurom ne Amantin  a kan no na wɔfrɛ no Brong Ahafo Mantam ne akyiri yi Bono Apuei Mantam wɔ Ghana.   Ansa na wɔrepaw no sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ mmrahyɛbagua dibea no, ɔne Ghana Nhomasua Dwumadibea (GES) yɛɛ adwuma sɛ ɔkwankyerɛfo boafo a ɔhwɛ Nnipa Nkɔso so wɔ Atebubu Mantam mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔpaw Owusu-Mainu wɔ afe 2004 mmrahyɛbagua abatow a wɔyɛe wɔ 7 December 2004, wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so, sɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni ma Atebubu-Amantin Mantam no bere a wɔhyehyɛɛ no foforo wɔ afe 2003 mu akyi  Ɔnam saayɛ so bɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbagua no mufo a wɔpaw wɔn maa Ghana Ɔmanpanyin a Ɛto so Anan no mmrahyɛbagua a Ɛto so Anan no fã . Ɔdii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 53.5% tiaa Mumuni Ibrahim Mohammed a ɔfiri New Patriotic Party, a ɔnyaa abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 41.3% ne Amankwah Kokro - a ɔyɛ ɔkannifoɔ a ɔde ne ho, nyaa abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 5.2%. National Democratic Congress dii nkonim wɔ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 10 mu wɔ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 24 mu maa Brong Ahafo mantam no wɔ saa abatow no mu.   Sɛ yɛka ne nyinaa bom a, kuw no dii nkonim wɔ nnipa kakraa bi ananmusifo wɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 4 a ɛwɔ ɔman a ɛto so 4 no mu a na wonya nkongua 94 wɔ nkongua 230 a na ɛwɔ hɔ nyinaa mu wɔ saa abatow no mu wɔ afe 2004 no

Ɔkɔɔ so kuraa n'ahengua mu wɔ afe 2008 mmrahyɛbagua abatow a wɔyɛe wɔ 7 December 2008 sɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni a ɔwɔ ɔmantam koro no ara mu ma Ghana Ɔmanpanyin a Ɛto so Anan no mmrahyɛbagua a Ɛto so Anum .  Ɔdii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 49.88% tiaa Cassius Osei-Poku a ɔfiri New Patriotic Party mu, a ɔnyaa abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 37.56% ne Kwaku Tuah Osei - a ɔyɛ ɔkannifoɔ a ɔde ne ho, nyaa abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 12.57%. Ná eyi nso wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so. Sanja Nanja na ɔdii n'ade wɔ afe 2012 mmrahyɛbagua abatoɔ a ɛsan nso yɛ National Democratic Congress for the Sixth Parliament of the Fourth Republic of Ghana .  National Democratic Congress dii nkonim wɔ nnipa dodow no ara mu wɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 5 a ɛwɔ ɔman a ɛto so 4 no mu a na wonya nkongua 114 wɔ nkongua 230 nyinaa mu wɔ saa abatow no mu wɔ afe 2008 no

Ankorankoro asetra 
Emmanuel Owusu-Mainu waree na na ɔwɔ mma du.  Na ɔyɛ Kristoni na ɔne Asomafo Asɔre Foforo no nya fekubɔ.

Owuo 
Owusu-Mainu wui wɔ 18 Ɔpɛpɔn 2014 wɔ 37 Military Hospital wɔ Ghana.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Abdul-Rashid Pelpuo
text:
Abdul-Rashid Hassan Pelpuo yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɔni . Ɔyɛ mprempren mmrahyɛbagua no muni ma Wa Central mantam a ɛwɔ Upper West Region of Ghana.

Ne mmofraase abrabɔ ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo no wɔ Kotonimma bosome da a ɛtɔ so anum (5) afe 1964 na ɔfiri Wa a ɛwɔ Atifi Atɔeɛ mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Na ɔwɔ ne Mfinimfini Sukuu Adesua Krataa wɔ 1976 mu. Ɔsan nso nyaa ne O level nhomasua wɔ afe 1983 mu ne ne A level nhomasua wɔ afe 1986 mu. Ɔsan nso wɔ abodin krataa wɔ Sikasɛm mu (Diploma in Economics) wɔ afe 1994 mu na ɔsan nso nyaa abodin krataa wɔ Adwene ne Nneyɛe Ho Adesua mu (Degree in Psychology) wɔ afe 1994 mu. Ɔsan nso wɔ Master’s abodin krataa wɔ Amanaman Ntam Nsɛm mu (master's degree in International Affairs) wɔ 1998 mu. Onyaa PhD abodin krataa wɔ Nkɔsoɔ Nhyehyɛeɛ mu (PhD in Development Policy) wɔ Ghana Suapɔn (University of Ghana), Afrika Adesua mu (African Studies) wɔ afe 2013.

Adwuma 
Na ɔyɛ ɔfotufo (consultant) ma Institute of Policy Alternatives. Ɔsan nso yɛ Sikasɛm ho Ntamgyinafoɔ Abadiakyiri (Deputy Coordinator of Finance) ma Ɔman Mmabun Badwa (National Youth Council) no na akyiri yi ɔyɛɛ asoɛeɛ korɔ no ara sohwɛfoɔ (Director ) na ɔkɔɔ so bɛyɛɛ Kuadwuma Ag. Regional a ɛwɔ asoɛe koro no ara mu.

Amanyɔsɛm mu Asetra 
Ɔkɔɔ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua no mu wɔ afe 2005 mu bere a odii nkonim wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so wɔ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua abatow mu wɔ December 2004 mu no.

Na Pelpuo yɛ Ɔman Ɔsoafoɔ wɔ Ɔmampanyin adwumayɛbea hɔ berɛ a Ɔmampanyin John Atta Mills paw no sɛ Mmabun ne Agumadi ho Ɔsoafoɔ wɔ September 2009 mu wɔ Muntaka Mohammed Mubarak a ɔno nso yɛ Asawase MP no gyaee adwuma no akyi. Ɔsomm wɔ saa dibea yi mu kɔsii berɛ a wɔreyɛ nsakraeɛ wɔ aban mu wɔ bosome Ɔpɛpɔn afe 2010. Wɔde Ghana ɔbaa a ɔdi kan a ɔhwɛ Agumadiɛ so, Akua Dansua, sii n’ananmu na wɔpaw no sɛ Dodow no Kannifoɔ abadiakyiri wɔ mmrahyɛbagua no mu mmom. Wɔsan nso too aba sɛ Ghanafoɔ baanum a wɔwɔ Afrika mmrahyɛbagua no mu baako wɔ South Africa baabi a ɔdii dwuma berɛ bi kosii afe 2013. Wɔ John Mahama nnisoɔ mu (2012 - 2016) wɔpaw no sɛ Ɔman Ɔsoafoɔ wɔ Ɔmampanyin a ɔhwɛ Ankorankoro Nkɔsoɔ ne Ɔmanfoɔ Ankorankoro Nkɔmmɔdie (PPP) so no Dwumadibea. Ná ɔsan yɛ Sikasɛm sohwɛ Kuw (EMT) no muni. Wɔ afe 2016 mu no ɔdii nkonim wɔ n’akongua so ne mpɛn anan wɔ mfeɛ nnan bio sɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni ma Wa Central Constituency. Wɔpaw no sɛ caucus kɛseɛ a ɛwɔ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua, The Population and Development Caucus no guamtrani ne Parliamentarians for Global Action, Ghana Chapter no kannifoɔ. Ɔsan nso kuraa Aban Awerɛhyem Boayikuo no mufoɔ dibea a ɛwɔ dibea, ɔhwɛ boayikuo a ɛho hia a ɛhwɛ aban Asomfo so na ɛhwɛ wɔn so wɔ bɔhyɛ a wɔhyɛ nkurɔfoɔ no ho na wɔnni saa bɔhyɛ ahodoɔ no akyi. Hwɛ Daa Ahyɛdeɛ (ahyɛdeɛ 151, 2j) ne mmrahyɛbagua Boayikuo a ɛhwɛ Paw Amanneɛbɔ so. Hon Pelpuo nso sii akan wɔ 2020 mmrahyɛbagua ne Ɔmampanyin amansan abatow no mu na odii nkonim wɔ afe a ɛto so anum a ɛyɛ mfe 4 sɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni ma Wa Central @2020 Ɛmfa ho sɛ Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo wɔ hɔ. Wɔpaw no sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ Ɔmanfo ne Nkɔso Kuw no Titenani wɔ afe a ɛto so abiɛsa mu ne Asase Boayikuw no muni a ɔwɔ dibea. Ɔsan nso yɛ Ahoɔden ne Adwumayɛ Boayikuw ahorow no muni. Hwɛ amanneɛbɔ a ɛfiri 2021 mmrahyɛbagua Boayikuo a ɛfa paw ho.

Afe 2004 Abatow 
Wɔpaw Pelpuo sɛ Wa Central mantam no mmrahyɛbaguani wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow no mu. Ɔnam saayɛ so gyinaa amansin no ananmu wɔ Ghana republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu. Wɔde abatow 21,272 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata 41,501 a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 51.3% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Mornah Anbataayela Bernard a ofi People’s National Convention, Mohammed Adama Kpegla a ofi New Patriotic Party, Abu Mumuni a ofi Convention People’s Party, Osman Mohammed a ofi Democratic People’s Party ne Osman Imam Sidik a ɔyɛ obi a ɔde ne ho. Eyinom nyaa abatow 12,280, abatow 7,249, abatow 376, abatow 172 ne abatow 152 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne 29.6%, 17.5%, 0.9%,0.4% ne 0.4% yɛ pɛ wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Wɔpaw Pelpuo wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so. Ne nyinaa mu no, National Democratic Congress dii nkonim wɔ nnipa kakraa bi a wɔka bom yɛ mmrahyɛbagua ananmusifo 94 wɔ nkongua 230 a ɛwɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 4 a ɛwɔ Ghana man a ɛto so 4 no mu.

Boayikuw ahorow 
Ɔyɛ Asase ne Kwae Boayikuw (Lands and Forestry Committee) no muni a ɛwɔ dibea. Ɔsan yɛ Fam Agudie ne Ahoɔden Boayikuw (Mines and Energy Committee) no muni na ɔsan yɛ Adwumayɛ Boayikuw (Business Committee) no muni.

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Abdul Rashid yɛ Nkramoni.

Hwɛ eyi nso 

 Mills aban asomfo din a wɔahyehyɛ
 Wa Central amansin mu

title: Richard Sam Quarm
text:
Richard Sam Quarm yɛ Ghana amanyɔni na na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni ma Gomoa Apueeɛ mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Mfinimfini Mantam mu, wɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan mu.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Quarm wɔ 28 Ɔpɛpɔn 1964. Ɔkɔɔ Ghana Suapɔn, ɛhɔ na onyaa Master of Business abodin krataa. Ɔyɛɛ akontaabu ho adesua titiriw.

Adwuma 
Quarm yɛ akontaabufo wɔ n’adwuma mu. Ɔsan yɛ amanyɔni.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Quarm hyɛɛ amammuisɛm mu bere a wɔpaw no sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani muni maa Gomoa East Constituency a ɛwɔ Central region of Ghana wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow mu no. Ɔyɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni. Quarm dii dwuma bere biako pɛ sɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni maa Gomoa Apuei fam mantam no. Enti ɔgyinaa amansin no ananmu wɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan mu firi 7 Ɔbɛnem 2005 kɔsi 6 Ɔbɛnem 2009. Wɔtuu no wɔ abatoɔ a ɛdi hɔ, 2008 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu, Ekow Panyin Okyere Eduamoah a ɔfiri ɔsɔretia kuo kɛseɛ, National Democratic Congress .

2004 Abatow a Wɔyɛe 
Wɔpaw Quarm sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow no mu a na abatow 19,634 wɔ abatow a ɛfata nyinaa mu 37,801. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 51.9% yɛ pɛ.  Wɔpaw no sen Ɔtemmufo Ekow Asafua-Ocran a ofi Ɔmanfo Ɔman Nhyiam no mu, Theophilus Kofi Ampah a ofi Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua no mu, Grace Ignophia Appia a ofi Nhyiam no mu Ɔmanfo Kuw no mu, Evans Kofi Otoo a ofi Ɔmanfo Ɔman Nhyiam no mu ; ne Kofi Otu ne Michael Leonard Kojo Amoah—wɔn baanu a wɔde wɔn ho. Eyinom nyaa abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 0.6%, 38.2%, 2.9%, 0.7%, 5.1% ne 0.5%.  Wɔpaw Quarm wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so . Na ne mantam no yɛ amansin 16 a New Patriotic Party dii nkonim wɔ Central mantam mu wɔ saa abatow no mu no fa.  Sɛ yɛka ne nyinaa bom a, New Patriotic Party no nyaa dodow no ara a ne nyinaa yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 128 wɔ Ghana man a ɛto so 4 no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 4 no mu .

Ankorankoro asetra 
Quarm yɛ Kristoni.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Joseph Akati Saaka
text:
Joseph Akati Saaka (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn 17, 1950) yɛ Ghana  amanyɔni ne National Democratic Congress muni . Na ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanyin a ɛtɔ so nnan mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 5 ne 6 a ɔgyina Bole Mantam ananmu no muni .

Ankorankoro asetra ne adwuma a ɔyɛe mfiase 
Wɔwoo Mahama a ɔyɛ Gonja abusuakuw no muni wɔ Bole wɔ November 17, 1950.

Bere a onyaa ne Master of Business Administration (Marketing) fii Miami Sukuupɔn, Florida, U.S.A., 1986 mu no, ofii n’adwuma ase sɛ aguadi ho ɔbenfo na wɔde no yɛɛ adwuma sɛ adetɔn ne aguadi sohwɛfo wɔ Dupaul Wood Treatment Company Limited.  Boayikuw a Ɛhwɛ Ohia a Wɔtew So Ho Nhyehyɛe So, Akwahosan. Ɔyɛ Muslimi na waware a ɔwɔ mma baason.

Amammui mu adwuma 
Ɔbɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni wɔ Bole Mantam mu wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2009.  Ɔdii nkonim 11,452 anaa 64.78% wɔ afe 2008 mu maa Bole Bamboi mantam.  Ofii n’amammui adwuma ase saa afe no bere a wɔpaw no sɛ onnyina ne mansin ananmu wɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 5 no mu akyi. Ɔdii John Dramani Mahama a ɔne John Atta Mills tuu mmirika maa ɔmampanyin saa afe no na odii nkonim no ade.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Robert Sarfo-Mensah
text:
Robert Sarfo-Mensah Ghana  amanyɔni ne mmrahyɛbagua a Ɛtɔ so Anum ne Nsia a ɛwɔ Ghana Republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no muni a ɔgyina Asunafo North ananmu wɔ Brong Ahafo mantam mu wɔ Ghana .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo no 1 April 1970  Ɔfiri Mampong wɔ Ashanti mantam mu.  Ɔnyaa ne Executive Master’s wɔ GIMPA wɔ afe 2008.  Ɔsan nso wɔ Bachelor of Arts abodin krataa wɔ Borɔfo kasa mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu wɔ afe 1996.

Adwumafa 
Sarfo-Mensah yɛ okuafoɔ/kuafoɔ.  Wayɛ adwuma sɛ VAT Service no Sikakorabea sohwɛfo Boafo.  Enti wayɛ adwuma sɛ Ɔman Soafo, titiriw Towtua Sohwɛfo.  Wɔ afe 2017 mu no, ɔsan nso yɛɛ Ghana Ɔman Agumadi Aban no sohwɛfoɔ panin wɔ berɛ a saa berɛ no ɔmampanyin Nana Akuffo Addo paw no akyi.    Nanso, ɔmampanyin koro no ara gyaee no adwuma bere a amanneɛbɔ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɔde ne ho ahyɛ visa ho animguasesɛm bi mu wɔ Commonwealth Agumadi a na ɛrekɔ so saa bere no mu wɔ Gold Coast, Australia no puei no.   Wɔ Ghana nhwehwɛmu nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔpae ho ntama mu, a wɔtoo din Number 12 mu no, wɔkyerɛ sɛ wɔkyeree Sarfo-Mensah wɔ kasɛt so sɛ ɔregye sika afi Tiger Eye PI kuw no hɔ de ayɛ nhyiam no mmerɛw denam hwɛ a ɔhwɛɛ sɛ wɔbɛma obi a ɔbɔ bɔɔl no kwan ma wabɔ bɔɔl wɔ bɔɔlbɔ mu no so.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ɔbɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni wɔ afe 2005 mu. Ɔyɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni .   Ɔbɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni nea edi kan wɔ Ghana man a ɛto so 4 no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 4 no mu. Ɔgyinaa Asunafo Atifi fam amansin ananmu wɔ Brong Ahafo Mantam mu.   Ɔkɔɔ so kuraa n’akongua so sɛ mmrahyɛbagua muni maa Asunafo Atifi fam amansin no maa mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 5 wɔ Ghana man a ɛto so 4 no mu.

Abatow a wɔyɛ 
Wɔdii kan paw Sarfo-Mensah wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma Asunafo Atifi fam mantam a ɛwɔ kan Brong Ahafo mantam mu wɔ Ghana.  Odii nkonim wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so .  Na ne mansin no ka mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 14 a ɛwɔ nkongua 24 a New Patriotic Party no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Brong Ahafo Mantam no ho.  Wɔ saa abatow no mu no, New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 128 wɔ nkongua 230 mu.  Wɔde abatoɔ 23,426 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata 45308 a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu a ɛne abatoɔ a ɛfata nyinaa mu 51.7% yɛ pɛ.  Wɔpaw no sen Christina Atakora Mensah a ofi National Democratic Congress, Benjamin Osei Kufour a ɔyɛ ɔkannifo a ɔde ne ho ne Commey Kingsley a ofi Convention People's Party . Eyinom nyaa abatow a ɛfata nyinaa mu 42.60%, 4.60% ne 1.20%.

Wɔsan paw no bio wɔ afe 2008 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 24,162 wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata 45,642 a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu, a ɛne abatoɔ a ɛfata nyinaa 52.9% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Mohammed Kwaku Doku a ofi Ɔman Democratic Congress, Stephen Keabena a ofi Democratic People's Party ne Seth George Mensah a ofi Convention People's Party . Eyinom nyaa abatow a ɛfata nyinaa mu 46.16%, 0.30% ne 0.60%.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Robert aware a ɔwɔ mma baanan.  Ɔyɛ Kristoni ( Pentekoste Asɔre ).

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Kwabena Sarfo
text:
Kwabena Sarfo (wɔwoo no 29 Ɔpɛpɔn 1947) yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɔni. Ɔgyina Offinso South amansin ananmu sɛ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan a ɛwɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu no muni.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Sarfo wɔ Offinso kurotia bi a ɛwɔ Ashanti mantam mu . Ɔyɛ Kwame Nkrumah Sukuupɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma So no ade . Onyaa Bachelor of Science abodin krataa wɔ Nhyehyɛe mu wɔ sukuupɔn no mu.

Adwuma 
Sarfo yɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo wɔ n’adwuma mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔdii kan paw Sarfo sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ mmrahyɛbagua no berɛ a wɔkaa sɛ ɔdii nkonim wɔ afe 2000 Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ no mu na ɔkaa ntam wɔ 7 Ɔbɛnem 2001. Bere a owiee ne dibea a edi kan no, Ɔno na wɔsan paw no bere a wowiee afe 2004 Ghana Amansan Abatow no wɔ New Patriotic Party (NPP) tekiti so. Ɔsan fii n’adwuma ase wɔ January 2005 mu. Ná ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani a ɔwɔ Offinso South mantam mu.

Abatow a wɔyɛ 
Wɔpaw Sarfo sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani wɔ Offinso South mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana nea edi kan wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow no mu.  Odii nkonim wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so .  Na ne mansin no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 36 no fã wɔ nkongua 39 a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Ashanti Mantam no mu.  New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 128 wɔ nkongua 230 mu.  Wɔde abatow 19,694 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 37,946 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 51.9% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Adusei-Poku Daniel a ofi Ɔmanfo Ɔman Nhyiam no mu, Asamoah Serwaa Baabara a ofi Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua no mu, Desmond Osei Kwame a ofi Convention People's Party mu, Nsiah-Boateng Faibil a ofi Every Ghanaian Living Everywhere kuw no mu ne Joseph Akwasi-Kumah a ɔyɛ ahofadi ɔkannifo. Eyinom nyaa abatow 202, 11,637, 148, 95 ne 6,170 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne 0.5%, 30.7%, 0.4%, 0.3% ne 16.3% yɛ pɛ wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Sarfo yɛ Kristoni.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Peter Sarkodie
text:
Peter Abum Sarkodie yɛ Ghana amanyɔni a ɔfiri Republic of Ghana. Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni a ɔgyinaa Mampong mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu. Ɔyɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Sarkodie wɔ Ɔberɛfɛw da 12, afe 1961. Ɔyɛ Cape Coast Sukuupɔn (UCC) no ade . Ɔwɔ Bachelor of Science abodin krataa wɔ nhomasua mu wɔ sukuupɔn no mu.

Adwuma 
Sarkodie yɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo.

Amammui mu adwuma 
Sarkodie yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni . Ɔbɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbagua muni fi Ɔpɛpɔn 2005 bere a ɔdaa ne ho adi sɛ nkonimdifo wɔ Amansan Abatow mu wɔ December 2004. Wɔpaw no sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma Mampong mantam wɔ Ghana Republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu.

Abatow a wɔyɛ 
Wɔpaw Sarkodie sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma Mampong mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana nea edi kan wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow no mu. Odii nkonim wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so . Na ne mansin no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 36 no fã wɔ nkongua 39 a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Ashanti Mantam no mu.  New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 128 wɔ nkongua 230 mu.  Wɔde abatow 28,997 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 36,648 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 79.1% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Mohammed Issahaku a ofi Peoples’ National Convention, Daniel Ohyeamang Appau a ofi National Democratic Congress, Kwaku Duah Agyemang a ofi Convention People’s Party ne Bashir Kassim a ofi Democratic People’s Party. Eyinom nyaa abatow 226, 6,921, 374 ne 130 wɔ abatow a wɔtow nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtowee nyinaa mu 0.6%, 18.9%, 1.0% ne 0.4% yɛ pɛ.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Sarkodie yɛ Kristoni.

Hwɛ nso 
MP a wɔpaw wɔn wɔ afe 2004 Ghana mmrahyɛbagua abatow mu din

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Doris Asibi Seidu
text:
Doris Asibi Seidu yɛ Ghanani nwomasua ho nimdefo, asetena mu adwumayɛni ne amanyɔni a ɔsom sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani maa Chereponi firi afe 2005 kɔsi afe 2009 berɛ a ɔwuiɛ wɔ n’adwuma mu.  Ɔno ne ɔbea a odi kan a ogyinaa ɔmantam no ananmu wɔ mmrahyɛbagua no mu.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Doris wɔ afe 1969 mu wɔ Accra, Ghana.  Ɔsuaa adeɛ wɔ Bimbilla Training College firi afe 1986 kɔsi afe 1990, ne Tamale Training College a ɔnyaa n’akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ Abodin krataa ‘A’ wɔ afe 1995.

Adwuma ne amammuisɛm 
Wɔ afe 2004 mu no, ɔsii akan wɔ Chereponi nkongua a ɛwɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so no ho na odii nkonim. Wɔkoraa no so wɔ mmrahyɛbagua mu wɔ afe 2008 mu berɛ a ɔdii nkonim wɔ atenaeɛ no mu bio a ɔtoo aba 9,188 wɔ abatoɔ 17,559 a ɛfata mu, a ɛyɛ 52.33% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoo no nyinaa mu.   Ɔtraa mmrahyɛbagua mu kosii sɛ owui wɔ 31 July 2009. Wɔyɛɛ abatoɔ foforɔ wɔ 29 September 2009 na Samuel Abdulai Jabanyite a ɔfiri National Democratic Congress no dii nkonim wɔ atenaeɛ no mu. Bere a na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani no, ɔboaa nkɔso adwuma ahorow bi te sɛ anyinam ahoɔden a wɔde bɛma mpɔtam hɔfo wɔ amansin no mu, sukuu ne ayaresabea ahorow a wosisi, ne sika a wɔde bɛma sukuufo a wɔn ho akokwaw na wohia mmoa wɔ ɔmansin no mu nso.  Wɔ mmrahyɛbagua mu no ɔsom wɔ boayikuw ahorow mu a ebi ne; Nhomasua ne Aboɔden abo boayikuw, ne Ahoɔden boayikuw.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Na Doris yɛ Nkramofo. Na waware na na ɔwɔ abofra.

Owuo 
Doris wui bɛyɛ 11:30 anadwo Fida, 31 July 2009 wɔ Korle-Bu Nkyerɛkyerɛ Ayaresabea a ɛwɔ Accra .  Amanneɛbɔ ahorow kyerɛ sɛ owui esiane koma a ɛkyeree denneennen ne nsɛnnennen a efi koma mu nti.  Na ɔwɔ n’asaabo nso ho nsɛnnennen, yare a na ɔne no reko bere bi.   Esiane n’akwahosan tebea nti, na onni mmrahyɛbagua no nhyiam ahorow ase bere tenten.  Owui bere a na wadi mfe 40. Ɔgyaa ne kunu ne ne ba.

Bere a wobisabisaa Daily Guide wɔ February 2009 mu no, ɔkae sɛ; "adeɛ a ɛhia paa ne sɛ ɔbɛma ne mansin no ayɛ beaeɛ a asomdwoeɛ wɔ a mmusuakuo bɛyɛ adeɛ a atwam na ɔsan nso bɛma adwumayɛ akwan ama ne mansinfoɔ; titire mmaa ne mmabun."

Hwɛ nso 

 MP a wɔpaw wɔn wɔ afe 2004 Ghana mmrahyɛbagua abatow mu din

title: Alhassan Wayo Seini
text:
Alhassan Wayo Seini (wɔwoo no 12 September 1945) yɛ Ghana  amanyɔni na na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan wɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Wayo na wɔtetee no wɔ Tamale. Ɔwɔ Kuadwuma Nyansahu mu nimdeɛ na ɔsan nso wɔ Nyansahu mu abodin krataa wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma Sukuupɔn mu .

Adwuma 
Wayo yɛ mmoayɛnfo panin na na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani wɔ Tamale Central Constituency a ɛwɔ Northern Region of Ghana wɔ afe 2005 ne 2009 ntam

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔdii kan paw Wayo sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua no mu wɔ National Democratic Congress (NDC) tekiti so wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu sɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni ma Tamale Central Constituency . Ɔde abatow 35,635 dii nkonim, na ɛyɛ ɔha biara mu nkyem 58.2 wɔ abatow 61,271 a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu.  Akyiri yi ɔgyaee NDC na ɔgyinaa hɔ sɛ obi a ɔde ne ho nanso ɔdii nkoguo wɔ Inusah Fuseini, a ɔgyinaa NDC ananmu wɔ afe 2008 amansan abatoɔ no mu.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ɔyɛ Nkramofni .

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Donald Dari Soditey
text:
Donald Dari Soditey (wɔwoo no September 25, 1957) yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ ne mmrahyɛbagua a Ɛtɔ so Nsia a ɛwɔ Ghana Aman a Ɛto so Anan no muni a ɔgyina Sawla/Tuna/Kalba Mansin ananmu wɔ Atifi Mantam mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Soditey wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn da a ɛtɔ so 25, afe 1957.  Ɔfiri Carpenteryir - Sawla, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Mantam mu .  Ɔnyaa akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ adansedie krataa wɔ afe 1990.  Ɔsan nso suaa Diploma wɔ Nhomasua mu wɔ Nhomasua Sukuupɔn, Winneba .

Adwuma 
Na Donald yɛ Ɔhwɛfo Panyin ne Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo Panyin sɛ Belma Mfitiase Sukuu.  Ɔayɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni firi Ɔpɛpɔn 2005.  Ɔyɛ nhomasua ho ɔbenfo ne ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo nso.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Soditey yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua (NDC) no muni. Wɔ afe 2008 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu no, wɔpaw no sɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni ma Sawla/Tuna/Kalba mantam no ma mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 5 wɔ ɔman a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu .  Wɔpaw no a na abatow a ɛfata nyinaa mu 12,290 wɔ 21,050 mu, a ɛne abatow a ɛfata nyinaa mu 58.38% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Joseph Hongiri Naah Vugu a ofi Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no mu, Yaapuo Edward Kwabena a ofi Ɔmanfo Ɔman Nhyiam no mu, Gilbieri Jonathan Laamiitey a ofi Democratic Freedom Party no mu ne Abdulai A Wahid a ofi Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw no mu no so . Eyinom nyaa abatow a ɛfata nyinaa mu 38.33%, 1.49%, 0.67% ne 1.13%. Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔsii akan wɔ Sawla/Tuna/Kalba atenaeɛ no ho wɔ NDC tekiti so sɛ ɔbɛyɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni wɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nsia a ɛwɔ ɔman a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu na ɔdii nkonim.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Soditey yɛ Kristoni (Katolekni).  Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baawɔtwe.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Amadu Bukari Sorogho
text:
Amadu Bukari Sorogho yɛ Ghana amanyɔni. Ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma Abokobi-Madina Mantam no firi 7 Ɔbɛnem 2005 kɔsi 6 Ɔbɛnem 2013. Efi 7 Ɔbɛnem 2013 kɔsi 6 Ɔbɛnem 2017 no, na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma Madina Mantam .

Adwuma 
Sorogho yɛ Nnipa Nnwuma sohwɛfoɔ ne Ɔmanfoɔ Nkitahodiɛ ho Ɔfotufoɔ wɔ n’adwuma mu. Ansa na ɔrekɔ amammuisɛm mu no, na ɔyɛ Nnipa Nnwuma ne Ɔmanfo Ntam Nkitahodi Ho Ɔfotufo Panyin wɔ Desimone Group Of Companies Limited a ɛwɔ Accra .

Amanyɔsɛm 
Sorogho kɔɔ mmrahyɛbagua mu wɔ 7 Ɔbɛnem 2005 wɔ National Democratic Congress (NDC) a egyina hɔ ma Abokobi-Madina Mantam no tekiti so . Ɔgyinaa amansin no ananmu firi afe 2005 kɔsii afe 2012 berɛ a wɔkyekyɛɛ amansin no mu. Efi 7 Ɔbɛnem 2013 kɔsi 6 Ɔbɛnem 2017 na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma Madina Mantam no .    Ɔsii akan wɔ saa atenaeɛ no ho mpɛn mmienu a ɛtoatoa soɔ nanso ɔdii nkoguo wɔ Saddique Boniface Abu-Bakar a ɔfiri New Patriotic Party mu wɔ afe 2016 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu .  Wɔ afe 2018 mu no ɔsii akan sɛ ɔbɛdi NDC Ɔman Titenani Abadiakyiri nanso ɔdii nkoguo wɔ Said Sinare anim .

Ankorankoro asetra 
Sorogho aware a ɔwɔ mma baanum. Ɔda ne ho adi sɛ ɔyɛ Nkramofo.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Alex Tettey-Enyo
text:
Alexander Narh Tettey-Enyo yɛ nhomasua ho nimdefo ne ɔmanyɔni . Ɔyɛ Ada mmrahyɛbagua no muni firi afe 2005 na ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ nwomasua so wɔ afe 2009 ne afe 2011 ntam.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Alex Tettey-Enyo wɔ ayɛwohomumɔ da ɔto so nsia(6), 1940 wɔ Akuse wɔ Greater Accra Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔhyɛɛ ne mfitiaseɛ adesua ase wɔ Akuse Methodist Mfitiaseɛ Sukuu mu wɔ afe 1946 mu. Wɔ afe 1948 mu no, ɔkɔɔ so wɔ James Town Accra Methodist Mfitiaseɛ Sukuu mu na ɔwiee wɔ Somanya Methodist Mfitiaseɛ/Mfinimfini Sukuu a ɔsuaa adeɛ wɔ afe 1949 ne 1953 ntam hɔ. Ne ntoaso sukuu fii ase wɔ Volta Mantam Ntoaso Sukuu, Odumase Krobo wɔ afe 1954 mu. Ɔtoaa so wɔ Presbyterian Boys’ Secondary nso wɔ Odumase Krobo wɔ 1956 ne 1957 ntam hɔ. Ɔwiee ntoaso sukuu akyi akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ adesua wɔ Wesley College, Kumasi wɔ afe 1959 ne 1960 ntam  Ɔkɔɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so wɔ afe 1961 ne 1962 mu na afei ɔkɔɔ Cape Coast Suapɔn mu baabi a ɔsuaa adeɛ wɔ afe 1962 ne 1965 ntam, na ɔnyaa Bachelor of Arts abodin krataa wɔ nwomasua mu.  Ɔkɔɔ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma Sukuupɔn, Kumasi (1961-1962) ne Sukuupɔn Kɔlege a ɛwɔ Cape Coast (1963-1965).

Adwuma

Nwomasua 
Ɔhyɛɛ n’akyerɛkyerɛ adwuma a edi kan ase wɔ Yilo Ɔman Sukuu a ɛwɔ Somanya no mu wɔ afe 1958 mu. N’adwuma a edi hɔ ne Ghanata Ntoaso Sukuu, Dodowa . Ne sukuupɔn adesua akyi, bere a na ɔyɛ ɔman sohyialist sukuufo ahyehyɛde (Ghanaso) no Titenani no, ɔde ne ho kɔbɔɔ sukuufo kuw bi a wofi Kwame Nkrumah Adwene Ho Asoɛe a wɔkɔɔ GDR mfinimfini kuw sukuu a ɛwɔ Berlin kɔsuaa ade tenten no ho. Bere a ɔwɔ hɔ no, Kwame Nkrumah asehwe akyi no, wɔn a wɔtaa Ɔmampanyin a wɔatu no afi n’ahengua so no akyi no kɔɔ ne nkyɛn sɛ ɔmmɛsan nkɔyɛ adwuma wɔ ne din mu, nanso wampene. Adanse a ɛkyerɛ bere a ɔtraa Berlin no wɔ Bundesarchiv, Berlin Lichterfelde, SAPMO-BArch, DY 30, IV A 2/ 9.09/ 125. Ɔsan kɔɔ ne kan sukuu mu wɔ 1966 mu, na awiei koraa no ɔbɛyɛɛ Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo Panyin Boafo fi 1971 kosi 1974. Wɔ afe 1982 mu no,wɔpaw no sɛ Ada Ntoaso Sukuu panyin, dibea a odii mu kosii afe 1990. Wɔyɛɛ no Nhomasua sohwɛfoɔ maa Dangme Apueeɛ Mantam wɔ Ghana Nhomasua Dwumadibea (GES) wɔ afe 1990 mu. Wɔ afe 1991 mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ Ntoaso Nhomasua sohwɛfo wɔ GES adwumayɛbea ti wɔ afe 1991 mu. Mfeɛ nnan akyi no, na ɔyɛ Adwumayɛfoɔ ne Nteteeɛ sohwɛfoɔ wɔ GES adwumayɛbea ti. Wɔ afe 1996 mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ Ghana Nhomasua Dwumadibea no Ɔkwankyerɛfo Panyin Abadiakyiri na afei ɔyɛɛ Ɔkwankyerɛfo Panyin a ɔyɛ adwuma fi afe 2001.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Tettey-Enyo yɛɛ adwuma sɛ Ɔmantam Ɔkyerɛwfo maa Dangme Apuei Fam Ɔmantam Nhyiam no wɔ afe 1990 mu. Odii kan gyinaa mmrahyɛbagua mu wɔ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua abatow mu wɔ December 2004 mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so, ɔkɔɔ mmrahyɛbagua no mu wɔ January 2005 mu.  Wɔ afe 2009 mu no, Ɔmampanyin John Atta Mills paw Tettey-Enyo sɛ Ɔsoafo a ɔhwɛ Nhomasua so wɔ n’aban mu. Tettey-Enyo bere sɛ ɔsomfo no baa awiei wɔ afe 2011 mu wɔ nsakrae a Ɔmanpanyin Mills yɛe wɔ aban mpanyimfo kuw mu no akyi.

Abusua 
Tettey-Enyo aware a ɔwɔ mma baanum.

Nneɛma a wɔde gye wɔn ani 
Nneɛma a Tettey-Enyo ani gye ho ne akenkan, stamp a wɔboaboa ano, asuguare ne akyinnyegye.

Hwɛ nso 

 Mills aban asomfo din a wɔahyehyɛ
 Ada amansin mu

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Kwame Amporfo Twumasi
text:
Kwame Amporfo Twumasi (wɔwoo no 10 December 1954) yɛ Ghana nhomasua ho nimdefo ne ɔmanyɔni. Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma Nkoranza South Constituency a ɛwɔ Brong Ahafo mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Twumasi wɔ 10 Ɔbɛnem 1954.  Ne kurom ne Nkwabeng a kan no na wɔfrɛ no Brong Ahafo Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.  Ɔnyaa ne BA wɔ Asase ne Sikasɛm mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu wɔ afe 1980 mu. Ɔsan nyaa ne PGDE wɔ Cape Coast Sukuupɔn mu wɔ afe 1996.

Adwuma 
Ansa na wɔrepaw no sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ mmrahyɛbagua dibea no, ɔne Ghana Nhomasua Dwumadibea (GES) yɛɛ adwuma sɛ Ɔhwɛfo Panyin ne Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo kan wɔ Atebubu Ntoaso Sukuu mu na akyiri yi wɔ Nkoranza Ntoaso/Mfiridwuma Sukuu mu. Ɔsan nso yɛɛ Ɔmanpanyin Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Ahoɔden so na ɔsom wɔ boayikuw ahorow bi mu. Ɔtraa hɔ sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo fi September 1981 kosi August 1987 wɔ Sokoto Mantam Aban a ɛwɔ Nigeria no mu wɔ apam bi ase.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔpaw Ampofo wɔ afe 2004 mmrahyɛbagua abatow a wɔyɛe wɔ 7 December 2004, wɔ New Patriotic Party tekiti so, sɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni ma Nkoranza South Constituency . Ɔnam saayɛ so bɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbagua no mufo a wɔpaw wɔn maa Ghana Ɔmanpanyin a Ɛto so Anan no mmrahyɛbagua a Ɛto so Anan no fa.

Ampofo tuu mmrahyɛbaguani a na ɔwɔ hɔ saa bere no fii asɔretiafo kuw kɛse National Democratic Congress mu denam ne paw a wɔpaw no wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow mu no so. Wɔde abatow 17,655 paw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 33,513 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 52.7% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen James Opoku-Worae, ɔkannifo foforo a ofi National Democratic Congress nsraban mu maa saa abatow no; ne Victor Boah a ɔwɔ Democratic People’s Party no mu. Eyinom nyaa abatow 15,521 ne 337. Eyinom ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 46.30% ne 1.00% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw Ampofo wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so. Wɔn a wɔtow aba maa amansin no wɔ ɔkwan a ɛne sɛ abatow no daa ‘ahyɛnsode ne blouse’ abatow nhyehyɛe adi bere a na nea odi nkonim wɔ ɔmampanyin dibea a ofi saa amansin no mu no wɔ tekiti a wɔde bɛkɔ asɔretiafo National Democratic Congress no so no.  Nanso New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 24 biara mu 14 wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Brong Ahafo mantam no.   Sɛ yɛka ne nyinaa bom a, New Patriotic Party no nyaa dodow no ara 128 mmrahyɛbagua ananmusifo wɔ nkongua 230 a ɛwɔ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 4 no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 4 no mu.

Ɔkuraa n'akongua so maa Nkoranza South amansin no maa mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 5 wɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu wɔ afe 2008 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no akyi .  Ɔnyaa abatoɔ 17,531 wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 33,766, a ɛne abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 51.92% yɛ pɛ. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ Emmanuel Kwadwo Agyekum a ɔfiri National Democratic Congress, Yaw Adjei Donyina a ɔfiri Democratic People's Party ne Kwesi Appiah Bekoe a ɔfiri Convention People's Party mu . Eyinom nyaa abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow wɔ afe 2008 Ghana amansan abatow no mu nyinaa mu 47.22%, 0.27% ne 0.59% .

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ampofo aware a ɔwɔ mma baanum.  Ɔyɛ Kristoni na ɔne Katolek Asɔre no yɛ fekuw .

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Kofi Karim Wumbei
text:
Kofi Karim Wumbei (wɔwoo no 7 Ɔpɛpɔn 1955) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo. Ɔyɛɛ mmrahyɛbaguani maa Wulensi Mantam a ɛwɔ Atifi Mantam no mu .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Wumbei wɔ 7 Ɔpɛpɔn 1955. Ɔwɔ Nyansahu mu Ɔbenfo wɔ Nhomasua mu wɔ Cape Coast Sukuupɔn mu .

Adwuma 
Wumbei yɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo wɔ n’adwuma mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wumbei yɛ ɔman a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan no muni a ɔwɔ atenaeɛ wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatoɔ  a wɔyɛ maa New Patriotic Party .

Abatow a wɔyɛ 
Wɔpaw Wumbei sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani muni ma Wulensi mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Mantam mu nea edi kan wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow no mu. Odii nkonim wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so. Na ne mansin no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 8 no fa wɔ nkongua 26 a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Atifi Fam Mantam no mu.  New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 128 wɔ nkongua 230 mu.  Wɔde abatoɔ 10,476 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 22,567 a ɛne abatoɔ a ɛfata nyinaa mu 46.4% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Daniel Okpanul a ofi Ɔmanfo Ɔman Nhyiam no mu, Laliri George Maban a ofi Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua no mu, Alhaji Musah Ziblila Star Boy a ofi Nhyiam no mu Nnipa Kuw no mu, Dawuda Mumuni a ofi Democratic Nnipa Kuw no mu ne Mohammed Iddrisu a ɔyɛ ɔmanpanyin a ɔde ne ho. Eyinom nyaa abatow a ɛfata nyinaa mu 3.9%, 43.7%, 0.9%, 1.3% ne 3.8%.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Wumbei yɛ Nkramofo.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Ernest Kofi Yakah
text:
Ernest Kofi Yakah yɛ Ghana amanyɔni na ɔyɛ Ghana Republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 6 no muni  a ɔgyina New Edubiase Constituency ananmu wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Ernest Kofi Yakah wɔ Ɔbɛnem da a ɛtɔ so mmienu, afe 1959.  Ɔfiri kuro bi a wɔfrɛ no Larve-Dabala a ɛwɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.  Na ɔwɔ ne Diploma Certificate wɔ General Agriculture mu wɔ University of Ghana, Legon.

Adwuma 
Yakah yɛ kuayɛfoɔ.  Ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ Ɔman Atoyerɛnkyɛm Ho Ahyehyɛde mu sɛ Ɔmantam Ntamgyinafo.

Amammui mu adwuma 
Wɔdii kan paw Yakah sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ mmrahyɛbagua wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2005 mu wɔ afe 2004 Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ no akyi a ɔgyinaa New Edubiase Mantam no mufoɔ ananmu.  Wɔ afe 2008 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu no ɔkuraa n’akongua so wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so denam abatoɔ 14,732 a ɔnyaeɛ wɔ abatoɔ 27,054 a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ no mu a ɛne abatoɔ a ɛfata nyinaa 54.5% yɛ pɛ.  Odii nkonim wɔ Kyei Baffour Degraft a ofi Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no mu, Mariam Iddrisu a ofi Ɔmanfo Ɔman Nhyiam no mu ne Joshua Appiah a ofi Nhyiam Nnipa Kuw no mu no so . Eyinom nyaa abatow a ɛfata nyinaa mu 43.79%, 0.91% ne 0.84%. Enti Yakah gyinaa New Edubiase mantam ananmu wɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 5 no mu . Ɔkɔɔ so kuraa n’akongua so bere a wɔpaee mu kae sɛ ɔno na odii nkonim wɔ afe 2012 Ghana Amansan Abatow mu wɔ National Democratic Congress frankaa ase no. Afei ne sɔretia dii no so nkonim wɔ afe 2016 mu.

Abatow a wɔyɛ 
Wɔpaw Yakah sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani mma New Edubiase mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow no mu. Odii nkonim wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so . Na ne mansin no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 3 no fã wɔ nkongua 39 a National Democratic Congress dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Ashanti Mantam no mu.  National Democratic Congress no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 94 a ɛyɛ kakraa bi wɔ nkongua 230 mu.  Wɔde abatow 13,275 paw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 26,440 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 50.2% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Francis Dorpenydh a ofi Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no mu ne Sophia Afrakoma Owusu a ofi Nhyiam Nnipa Kuw no mu . Eyinom nyaa abatow 12,160 ne 1,005 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 46% ne 3.8% yɛ pɛ.

Wɔ afe 2008 mu no, odii nkonim wɔ amansan abatow no mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so maa ɔmansin koro no ara. Na ne mansin no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 3 no fã wɔ nkongua 39 a National Democratic Congress dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Ashanti Mantam no mu.  National Democratic Congress no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 113 a ne nyinaa yɛ dodow no ara wɔ nkongua 230 mu.  Wɔde abatoɔ 14,732 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 27,054 a ɛne abatoɔ a ɛfata nyinaa mu 54.45% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Kyei Baffour-Degraft a ofi Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no mu, Mariam Iddrisu a ofi Ɔmanfo Ɔman Nhyiam no mu, ne Joshua Appiah a ofi Nhyiam Nnipa Kuw no mu . Eyinom nyaa abatow 11,848, 246 ne 228 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyi ne abatow a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 43.79%, 0.91% ne 0.84% yɛ pɛ.

Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔdii nkonim bio wɔ amansan abatoɔ mu maa ɔmansin korɔ no ara. Wɔde abatow 16,777 paw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 32,388 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 51.80% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Charles Mends Cann a ofi Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no mu ne Charles Cooker Anaman a ofi Progressive People’s Party no mu . Eyinom nyaa abatow 13,078 ne 2,533 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne abatow a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 40.38% ne 7.82% yɛ pɛ.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Yakah yɛ Kristoni  na waware na ɔwɔ mma baanum.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Ahmed Alhassan Yakubu
text:
Ahmed Alhassan Yakubu (wɔwoo no 3 December 1957)  yɛ Kuadwuma/Kuafoɔ pa ne Ghana amanyɔni. Ɔsan yɛ Fourth Republic mmrahyɛbagua a Ɛto so Nsia no muni a ogyina Mion Mantam no ananmu .

Ankorankoro asetra 
Yakubu yɛ Muslimni, na waware na ɔwɔ mma mmiɛnsa.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Yakubu wɔ 3 Ɔbɛnem 1957.  Ɔfiri Sang kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Fam Mantam mu .  Owiee Imperial College, London Sukuupɔn, na onyaa ne Doctor of Philosophy abodin krataa wɔ Agronomy mu wɔ afe 2000.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Yakubu yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua no muni . Wɔdii kan paw no sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ mmrahyɛbagua no wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so wɔ December 2004 Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ no mu sɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni ma Mion mantam no . Ɔnyaa abatoɔ 10,568 wɔ abatoɔ 27,034 a ɛfata a wɔtoo no mu a egyina hɔ ma 39.10%.  Ɔdii nkonim wɔ ne sanba a wɔsan paw no wɔ afe 2008 mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 11,977 wɔ abatoɔ 27,118 a ɛfata a wɔtoo no mu a ɛgyina hɔ ma 44.17%.  Ɔsan sii akan wɔ afe 2012 mu na ɔnyaa abatoɔ 9,931 wɔ abatoɔ 25,115 a ɛfata a wɔtoo no mu a ɛgyina hɔ ma 39.54%.

Adwuma 

 Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma mu Nhwehwɛmu Bagua - Savanna Kuadwuma Nhwehwɛmu Asoɛe
 mmrahyɛbagua no muni (Ɔpɛpɔn 2005 – Ɔpɛpɔn 2017) 
 Okuafo/kuafo

title: Hennric David Yeboah
text:
Hennric David Yeboah (1957 – 1 Oforisuo 2019)   yɛ aguadifo  ne Ghana amanyɔni wɔ Republic of Ghana. Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni a ogyina hɔ ma Afigya Sekyere Apuei fam mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 4, 5, ne 6 mu. Ná ɔyɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Yeboah wɔ 11 Oforisuo afe 1957.   Ɔfiri Agona, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana .   Ɔsuaa adeɛ wɔ Malcolm X College a ɛwɔ Chicago, Illinois. Ɔnyaa diploma wɔ 1986 mu wɔ kɔlege a wɔaka ho asɛm no mu.

Adwuma 
Na Yeboah yɛ aguadifoɔ na na ɔyɛ Daphelia Enterprise Limited a ɛwɔ Spintex kwan so wɔ Accra, Ghana no kwankyerɛfoɔ panin.

Amammui mu adwuma 
Ná Yeboah yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni .   Ɔdii kan kɔɔ mmrahyɛbagua mu wɔ afe 2004 mu na na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma Afigya Sekyere East Constituency wɔ Ashanti mantam mu wɔ Ghana.  Ɔde mmirika bedi dwuma mpɛn abien bio wɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 5 ne 6 a ɛwɔ Republic a ɛto so 4 no mu.  Wɔ afe 2015 mu no, ɔdii nkogu wɔ New Patriotic Party primaries mu wɔ Mavis Nkansah Boadu anim .

Abatow a wɔyɛ 
Wɔpaw Yeboah sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ama Afigya Sekyere East mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana nea edi kan wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow no mu.  Odii nkonim wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so.  Na ne mansin no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 36 no fã wɔ nkongua 39 a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Ashanti Mantam no mu.  New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 128 wɔ nkongua 230 mu.  Wɔde abatow 32,143 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 41,220 a ɛne abatow a ɛfata nyinaa mu 78% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Edward Kusi Ayarkwah a ofi Ɔman Democratic Congress, Adamu Alhassan a ofi Convention People's Party ne Alhaji Amidu Adam a ofi Democratic People's Party mu . Eyinom nyaa abatow a ɛfata nyinaa mu 20.5%, 1% ne 0.60%.

Wɔ afe 2008 mu no, odii nkonim wɔ amansan abatow no mu wɔ New Patriotic Party tekiti so maa ɔmansin koro no ara. Ná ne mansin no ka mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 34 a ɛwɔ nkongua 39 a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Ashanti Mantam no mu no ho.  New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 109 wɔ nkongua 230 mu.  Wɔde abatoɔ 33,080 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 43,505 a ɛne abatoɔ a ɛfata nyinaa mu 76.04% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Edward Ayarkwah a ofi Ɔman Democratic Congress, Osman Isshak a ofi People’s National Convention, Amidu Alhaji Adam a ofi Democratic People’s Party ne Obeng Nyantakyi Clement a ofi Convention People’s Party. Eyinom nyaa abatow a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 21.61%, 0.59%, 0.29% ne 1.47%.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ná Yeboah yɛ Kristoni.   Ná ɔyɛ Charismatic Kristofo Asɔre bi muni.  Ná waware na ɔwɔ mma baanum.

Owuo 
Yeboah wuiɛ wɔ 1 March 2019, na wadi mfeɛ aduosia mmienu berɛ a na ɔrenya ayaresa wɔ Komfo Anokye Teaching Hospital wɔ Kumasi.

Hwɛ nso 

 MP a wɔpaw wɔn wɔ afe 2004 Ghana mmrahyɛbagua abatow mu no din
 MP a wɔpaw wɔn wɔ afe 2008 Ghana mmrahyɛbagua abatow mu din
 MP a wɔpaw wɔn wɔ afe 2012 Ghana mmrahyɛbagua abatow mu no din

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Daoud Anum Yemoh
text:
Daoud Anum Yemoh (wɔwoo no May 6, 1954)  yɛ Ghana nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo ne ɔmanyɔni.  Na ɔyɛ Ghana Mantam a Ɛto so Anan mmrahyɛbagua a Ɛto so Nsia no muni a ogyina Domeabra Obom Mantam a ɛwɔ Greater Accra Mantam mu no ananmu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so .

Ankorankoro asetra 
Yemoh yɛ Kristoni. Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baasa.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Yemoh wɔ Ɔberɛfɛw da 6, afe 1954. Ne man  Ɔfiri La-Accra, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Greater Accra Mantam mu wɔ Ghana .  Owiee Ghana Institute of Journalism na onyaa ne Bachelor of Science abodin krataa wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu wɔ afe 1981 mu. Ɔsan nso kɔɔ Sofia-Bulgaria na onyaa ne diploma wɔ Social Sciences mu wɔ Academy of Science and Management wɔ afe 1985.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Yemoh yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua (NDC) no muni.  Wɔdii kan paw no sɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni sɛ ɔmmɛgyina Domeabra Obom Mansin ananmu wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu na ɔdii n’adwuma wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2005.  Ɔbɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbagua a Ɛto so Anum no muni bere a wɔsan paw no bio sɛ ɔnkɔ dibea wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2009.  Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔsii akan ne mprɛnsa so wɔ NDC tekiti so na ɔdii nkonim.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Albert Kwasi Zigah
text:
Albert Kwasi Zigah (wɔwoo no 15 Ɔbɛnem 1959) yɛ Ghana Amanyɔni, na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbagua a Ɛto so Anum a ɛwɔ Ghana Aman a Ɛto so Anan no muni a ɔgyina Ketu Anafoɔ Mansin ananmu wɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Zigah wɔ 15 Ɔbɛnem 1959 wɔ Aflao wɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ Ghana . Ɔkɔɔ Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration(GIMPA) wɔ afe 2008.

Adwuma 
Zigah ne Ghana Private Road Transport Union(GPRTU) a ɛwɔ Trade Union Congress(TUC) no yɛɛ adwuma sɛ Aflao baa dwumadibea(Transport Owner) no guamtrani.

Amanyɔsɛm

mmrahyɛbagua no muni 
Wɔdii kan paw Zigah sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ mmrahyɛbagua wɔ afe 2004 mu wɔ National Democratic Congress(NDC) tekiti so wɔ afe 2005 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu sɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni ma Ketu South Constituency.  Wɔ abatoɔ no mu no, ɔnyaa abatoɔ 48,279 wɔ abatoɔ 70,564 a wɔtoo no mu a ɛgyina hɔ ma 68.40%.  Ɔsan sii akan wɔ afe 2008 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu na ɔkoraa n’akongua so a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 54,720 wɔ abatoɔ 61,011 a ɛfata a wɔtoo no mu a ɛgyina hɔ ma 89.69%.  Ɔdii dwuma mfeɛ mmienu sɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni. Ná ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbagua no boayikuw a wɔpaw wɔn a ɛhwɛ Mpɔtam aban ne Transport so no muni.

NDC De asɛm no kɔdan asɛnnibea 
Zigah na n’apam no antumi ansi akan wɔ mmrahyɛbagua primary a wɔyɛɛ no 29 December 2015 no mu. Ɔde krataa kɔdan Accra Asɛnnibea Kunini no na ɔhwehwɛɛ sɛ wɔmfa mpaemuka nka sɛ nea wɔayi no sɛ onkosi akan wɔ mmrahyɛbagua mu abatow a wɔde bɛma Ketu South Constituency a ɛwɔ NDC no mu no yɛ nea mmara mma ho kwan, enni mu, na enni mu na enni tumi biara. Ɔkaa wɔ adwene a ɛne sɛ wɔmfata a mmara mma ho kwan no mu sɛ, wɔamma no hokwan sɛ ɔde ne ho bɛma sɛ obi a ɔde ne ho bɛhyɛ mfitiase akansi no mu, ɛno nti na ɔyɛɛ ade sɛ ɔbɛhwehwɛ saa ahotɔ ahorow no.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Siga aware a ɔwɔ mma baanum. Ɔyɛ Kristoni na ɔyɛ Katolek Asɔre no muni.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Iddrisu Abdul-Kareem
text:
Iddrisu Abdul-Kareem (wɔwoo no June 1, 1948)  yɛ Ghana Amanyɔni na ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanyin a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a Ɛto so Anum no muni . Ɔgyinaa Nanton mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi fam mantam no ananmu .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Abdul-Kareem wɔ June 1, 1948. Ɔfiri Nanton a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi fam mantam mu . Ɔnyaa abodin krataa wɔ Akontaabuo mu, firi Institute of Planning and Technology Administration a ɛwɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so wɔ afe 1974.

Adwuma ne amammuisɛm 
Abdul-Kareem yɛ Kadil Company Limited a ɛwɔ Tamale, Ghana Atifi fam mantam mu no panyin .  Ɔyɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni. Wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow mu no ɔde New Patriotic Party no tekiti sii akan nanso ɔdii nkogu wɔ Alhaji Alhassan Yakubu a ɔwɔ National Democratic Congress no mu .  Nanso, ɔsan sii akan bio na odii nkonim wɔ Nanton mansin no mu wɔ afe 2008 Ghana amansan abatow mu, na abatow 6,868 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no mu 14,592 no gyina hɔ ma 45.9%.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ɔyɛ Muslimi na waware a ɔwɔ mma baason.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Richard Akuoko Adiyiah
text:
Richard Akuoko Adiyiah (20 Ɔpɛpɔn 1955 – 30 Ɔpɛpɔn 2022)  yɛ Ghana amanyɔni.  Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani a ɔwɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 5 a ɛwɔ ɔman a ɛto so 4 no mu.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Adiyiah wɔ 20 Ɔpɛpɔn 1955. Ɔfiri Dwaaho a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu, Ghana. Ɔnyaa ne ntoaso sukuu wɔ Opoku Ware Sukuu mu na ɔsan nso nyaa abodin krataa a ɛkorɔn wɔ Ɔman Adwumayɛ mu wɔ Kennedy Sukuu a ɛwɔ Aban mu wɔ Harvard Sukuupɔn mu . Ɔsan nso kɔɔ Yale Sukuu a Ɛhwɛ Adwumayɛ So wɔ New Haven .

Adwuma 
Na Adiyiah yɛ Sikasɛm sohwɛfo. Na ɔyɛ Amanaman Nkabom no Observer Mission in Georgia (UNOMIG) no Sikasɛm sohwɛfo Panyin.    Akyiri yi ɔyɛɛ Sikasɛm sohwɛfo wɔ GIHOC Distilleries Company Limited. Wɔpaw no sɛ Produce Buying Company no sohwɛfo panyin.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Na Adiyiah yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni . Wɔ December 2008 mu no, ɔsii akan wɔ afe 2008 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu na ɔdii nkonim. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ Ahafo Ano Atifi fam atenaeɛ no mu denam abatoɔ 16,080 a ɔnyaeɛ wɔ abatoɔ 31,196 mu. Ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma Ahafo Ano North atenaeɛ firi afe 2008 kɔsi afe 2012.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Adiyiah waree na ɔwɔ mma baanan. Na ɔyɛ Kristoni na na ɔyɛ Light House Church International no muni.

Owuo 
Adiyiah wui wɔ ne tenabea wɔ 30 September 2022, bere a na wadi mfe 67.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Kojo Adu Asare
text:
Kojo Adu Asare (wɔwoo no 30 June 1966) yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɔni na na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma Adenta mantam a ɛwɔ Greater Accra Mantam mu wɔ Ghana .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Asare fi Abirim Akuapem a ɛwɔ Ghana Apuei Fam.  Ɔyɛ obi a wagyae ntoaso sukuu panyin.

Adwuma 
Asare yɛ asetena mu nnwumakuw asɛyɛde kuw no CEO.  Ɔsan nso yɛ Vital Concepts limited a ɛwɔ baa dwumadibea wɔ Ghana, Sierra Leone Ne Guinea no panyin.  Ɔyɛɛ kan kyerɛwfo abadiakyiri panyin wɔ National Democratic Congress

Ankorankoro asetra 
Asare yɛ Kristoni na waware na ɔwɔ mma baasa.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Kwabena Owusu Aduomi
text:
Kwabena Owusu Aduomi (wɔwoo no 17 Ɔpɛpɔn 1960) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni na ɔyɛ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua no muni. Ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party (NPP) no muni ne ɔmanpanyin abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ akwan ne akwan akɛse so wɔ Ghana.

Mfitiase asetra 
Wɔwoo Aduomi wɔ 17 September 1960 wɔ Ejisu-Besease, Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Aduomi da ne ho adi sɛ ɔyɛ Kristoni ne Assemblies of God Asɔre no muni. Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baanum.

Nwomasua 
Ɔnyaa ne bachelors of science abodin krataa wɔ civil engineering mu wɔ Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology wɔ afe 1985.

Adwuma 
Aduomi bɛyɛɛ nsiesie mfiridwumayɛfoɔ wɔ akwan akɛseɛ sohwɛfoɔ a ɛwɔ Temale wɔ afe 1987–1994 mu, afei ɔkɔɔ so yɛɛ nnwuma sohwɛfoɔ wɔ akwan akɛseɛ sohwɛfoɔ wɔ atɔeɛ mantam mu wɔ afe 1994–2002 mu. Ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔmantam kwankyerɛfoɔ a ɔhwɛ akwan akɛseɛ so wɔ Ashanti mantam mu wɔ afe 2002–2008 mu. Afei ɔbɛyɛɛ Ghana republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 6 no muni.

Amammui asetra 
Wɔpaw no sɛ MP maa Ejisu Mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana wɔ afe 2009 mu. Wɔpaw no sɛ ɔmmɛka mmarahyɛ boayikuw a ɛka ho ne Mpɔtam Aban ne Nkuraase Nkɔso Boayikuw no ho.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Catherine Afeku
text:
Catherine Ablema Afeku (wɔwoo no Ɔbɛnem 27, afe 1967) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni. Ɔyɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni ne mmrahyɛbagua no muni ma Evalue Gwira Mantam a ɛwɔ Atɔe Fam Mantam no mu . Na ɔyɛ kabinet soafoɔ wɔ Nana Akuffo-Addo aban mu na ɔyɛɛ Ghana nsrahwɛ, amammerɛ ne Adebɔ ho Ɔsoafoɔ firi Ɔpɛpɔn 2017 kɔsi Ɔpɛpɔn 2019.

Wɔsesaa no fii Ministry of Tourism mu kɔɔ Presidency of the Republic of Ghana wɔ 28 Ɔpɛpɔn 2019.  Mprempren ɔyɛ Ɔman Soafo wɔ Ɔmanpanyin Dwumadibea, a wɔde no ahyɛ Ɔsomfo Panyin Dwumadibea.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo no wɔ Axim wɔ Atɔe Fam Mantam mu . Ɔnyaa Master of Business Administration wɔ Keller Graduate School of Management a ɛwɔ DeVry Suapɔn mu wɔ Atlanta, Georgia wɔ afe 2000

Adwumayɛ asetra 
Afeku ne Wiase Sikakorabea ne Stico Petroleum a ɛwɔ Kenya, a ɔsom sɛ adwumayɛ nkɔso ho ɔfotufo no ayɛ adwuma.  Na ɔyɛ adwuma nso wɔ Inlingua kasa Sukuu a ɛwɔ Brescia, Italy no mu .  Wɔ afe 2000 mfitiaseɛ mu no ɔbɛyɛɛ Ghana Aban kasamafoɔ wɔ nnwuma a ɛfa nnwuma ho wɔ John Agyekum Kufour nnisoɔ mu.

Amammui mu adwuma 
Afeku hyɛɛ Ghana amammuisɛm mu wɔ afe 2000 mfitiaseɛ mu wɔ John Agyekum Kufuor ɔmampanyin berɛ mu .  Na ɔyɛ aban kasamafo a ɔhwɛ nneɛma a wɔde yɛ adwuma so.

mmrahyɛbagua no muni 
Ɔsii akan wɔ afe 2008 amansan abatoɔ mu maa Evalue Gwira mantam no.  Odii nea ɔredi tumi, Kojo Armah a ofi Convention People’s Party mu no so nkonim denam abatow 11,671 a onyae no so. Wɔ Ghana Ɔmanpanyin a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 5 mu no, ɔdii kan yɛɛ Ɔkwan ne akwantuo Boayikuo no muni na afei ɔyɛɛ Nkitahodiɛ Boayikuo no muni abadiakyiri.  Akyiri yi ɔbɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbagua no Adwumayɛ Boayikuw no muni. Ɔdii nkogu wɔ ne mmɔdenbɔ a ɔsan paw no sɛ mmrahyɛbagua no mu wɔ afe 2008 amansan abatow no mu. Ɔsan sii akan wɔ amansin no mu wɔ afe 2016 mmrahyɛbagua abatoɔ no mu, faako a ɔdii deɛ ɔdi tumi, Kweku Tanikyi Kesse a ɔfiri National Democratic Congress, so nkonim, na ɔnyaa abatoɔ 11,641 wɔ 20,179 no mu, a ɛgyina hɔ ma abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 57.7%.

Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ nsrahwɛ 
Wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2017 mu no, Ɔmampanyin Akuffo-Addo yii Afeku sɛ Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ nsrahwɛ so . Sɛ́ nsrahwɛfo soafo no, wafi akwantu ahorow pii ase akɔtɔn ɔman no mmeae a nsrahwɛfo ani gye ne nea ebetumi aba no ho gua.

Wɔ March 2017 mu no, ɔtuu kwan kɔɔ The People’s Republic of China, baabi a ɔne sikakorafoɔ ne wɔn a wɔde nneɛma kyerɛ no yɛɛ nhyiamu de kyerɛɛ mmeaeɛ a nsrahwɛfoɔ kɔ ne Ghana adwini ne amammerɛ.

Wɔpaw Afeku sɛ Amanaman Nkabom Wiase Nsrahwɛ Ahyehyɛde (UNWTO) Akannifo Adwumakuw no Titenani. Wɔde eyi too gua wɔ 25 Ɔbɛnem 2018.

Vetting akyinnyegye 
Ansa na mmrahyɛbagua no Boayikuw a Ɛpaw Nnipa no bɛhwehwɛ mu no, amanneɛbɔ ahorow bae sɛ na Catherine ne ne kunu yɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho too wɔn so wɔ ɔmanfo asɛm bi a ɛfa apam a wobuu so wɔ afe 2007   Amanneɛbɔ ahorow no kyerɛe sɛ na Accra Asɛnnibea Kunini bi ahyɛ Afeku abusua no sɛ wontua $217,464.00 a wɔde mfɛntom 50% nka ho mma Amerikafo awarefo bi, Patricia ne Bill Gick, bere a wɔde sobo abɔ wɔn sɛ wɔyɛ nsisi akyi.  Na Catherine ne ne kunu anni asɛnnibea no akwankyerɛ so. Nhyɛso kuw bi a wɔfrɛ wɔn ho Nokware ne Aban a Ɛbu Akontaabuo de adesrɛ kɔtoo Ɔmampanyin Akuffo-Addo sɛ ɔnyi no mfi ne somfoɔ dibea no mu. Bere a boayikuw no hwehwɛɛ Afeku mu no, ɔmaa wohui sɛ wɔantua sika efisɛ na wonnya ntie asɛm bi a wɔde kɔdan asɛnnibea wɔ afe 2013 mu; enti, na ontumi nni atemmu anim.

Ne nhwehwɛmu a mmrahyɛbagua no Boayikuw a Wɔpaw Wɔn no yɛɛ no wɔ 6 Ɔpɛpɔn 2017.  Bere a wɔreyɛ nhwehwɛmu no, nnipa kakraa bi no mufo kae sɛ ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔpene so efisɛ wanyɛɛ Ɔman Dwumadi a ɛyɛ afe biako a ɛyɛ ahyɛde no .  Nea ɔde yii ne ho ano sɛ wanni n’asɛyɛde a ɛwɔ mmrahyɛbagua mu no so no fi sɛ na ɔne n’awofo wɔ Nairobi, Kenya, wɔ bere a wɔahyɛ no mu.  Wɔpenee ne din a wɔde too gua no so wɔ 11 Ɔpɛpɔn 2017 bere a ɔde krataa a wɔde gyae adwuma a Ɔman Dwumadie Ɔkyerɛwfoɔ Dwumadibea no de maa no maa Appointments Committee no.
