Wɔnam adwene koro so na wɔpenee so.

Kabinet soafo panyin 
Wɔ May 2017 mu no, Ɔmampanyin Akufo-Addo bɔɔ Afeku din sɛ asomfoɔ 19 a wɔbɛhyehyɛ ne kabinet no mu baako .  Wɔde asomfo 19 no din kɔmaa Ghana mmrahyɛbagua no na Aban no Kasafo, Rt. Hon. Ɔbenfo a ɔbenfo. Mike Ocquaye na ɔkyerɛwee .  Sɛ́ aban soafo no, na Afeku ka ɔmampanyin no mu kuw no ho na ɛsɛ sɛ ɔboa wɔ gyinaesi dwumadi atitiriw mu wɔ ɔman no mu.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Catherine aware Seth Afeku a ɔne no wɔ mma mmiɛnsa. Ɔyɛ Kristoni na ɔyɛ Katolek Asɔre a ɛwɔ Ghana no muni .

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Owusu Afriyie Akoto
text:
Owusu Afriyie Akoto (wɔwoo no 19 Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 1949)  yɛ Ghana kuayɛ sikasɛm ho nimdefo ne amanyɔni. Ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party no muni na na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni ma Kwadaso Constituency firi afe 2009 kɔsi afe 2017. Mprempren ɔyɛ kabinet soafo wɔ Nana Akufo-Addo aban mu na ɔsom sɛ Ghana Aduan ne Kuadwuma soafo fi afe 2017.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Owusu Afriyie Akoto maa Bafuor Osei Akoto a na ɔyɛ Ɔman Ahofadi Kuw a na ɔwɔ hɔ ansa na ahofadi reba no muni a wagye din na ɔsan nso yɛ kasa ho nimdefo panyin wɔ Manhyia Ahemfie .  Akoto nyaa ne ntoaso sukuu adesua wɔ Opoku Ware Sukuu a ɛwɔ Kumasi . Ɔtoaa so kɔɔ Ghana Suapɔn, Legon na owiee sukuu no nyaa Bachelor of Science abodin krataa wɔ kuayɛ mu.  Afei osuaa ade wɔ Cambridge Sukuupɔn mu, faako a onyaa Nyansahu mu Ɔbenfo wɔ kuayɛ mu sikasɛm mu . Ɔnyaa ne Doctor of Philosophy abodin krataa wɔ Cambridge wɔ afe 1985.

Adwumayɛ asetra 
Afriyie Akoto yɛɛ adwuma wɔ Amanaman Ntam Kafe Ahyehyɛde a ɛwɔ London, England bɛboro mfe du. Dibea ahorow a odii no bi ne sikasɛm ho ɔbenfo, sikasɛm ho ɔbenfo panyin, sikasɛm ho ɔbenfo titiriw, ne sikasɛm ho ɔfotufo panyin. Ɔsan nso yɛɛ ɔfotufo wɔ Wiase Nyinaa Sikakorabea (Amanaman Nkabom adwumakuw) a ɛfa nneɛma a ɛyɛ mmerɛw—a ɛne koko, kɔfe, ne asikre ho. Bere a ɔde bɛboro mfeɛ 18 yɛɛ adwuma wɔ amannɔne no, ɔsan kɔɔ Ghana baabi a ɛfiri afe 1995 kɔsi afe 2008 no, ɔyɛɛ Goldcrest Commodities Limited ne Plantation Resources Limited CEO.

Amammui asetra 
Afriyie Akoto dii kan sii akan wɔ Kwadaso mantam no mu wɔ afe 2004 mu na ɔnyaa abatoɔ a nhyiamufoɔ no towee no nyinaa mu 20. Ɔdii nkogu wɔ ne yɔnko amammui mu nipa foforo Josephine Hilda Addo, a ɔde abatow 26 dii nkonim no anim.  Addo kɔɔ so dii nkonim wɔ amansin abatow mu wɔ afe 2004 amansan abatow no mu .  Afriyie Akoto san sii akan wɔ afe 2007 amansin primary no mu na ɔdii deɛ ɔdi tumi no so nkonim. Ɔdii dwuma mpɛn mmienu sɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni maa Kwadaso firi afe 2009 kɔsi afe 2016. Bere a na ɔwɔ mmrahyɛbagua no mu no, na Afriyie Akoto yɛ Ɔmanpanyin Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Aduan ne Kuadwuma ne Koko Nsɛm So Boayikuw no so. Samiu Kwadwo Nuamah na ɔdii n’ade berɛ a ɔdii nkoguo wɔ NPP mmrahyɛbagua primary mu wɔ afe 2015.

2015 mmrahyɛbagua primary 
Wɔ June 2015 mu no, Afriyie Akoto sii akan wɔ amansin primary no mu a na ɔwɔ anidasoɔ sɛ ɔbɛnya abatoɔ a ɛdɔɔso a ɛbɛma watumi asi akan wɔ amansin no mmrahyɛbagua abatoɔ no mu. Nnipa afoforo baanum a na Addo a na anka ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni ma ɔmansin no ka ho na wosii akan wɔ abatow no mu. Awiei koraa no, nea odii nkonim ne Nuamah, na ɔtwee abatow a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 191. Afriyie Akoto nyaa abatoɔ no nyinaa mu 95. Wɔ ne concession kasa mu no, Afriyie Akoto hyɛɛ bɔ sɛ ɔne Nuamah bɛyɛ adwuma abom de akura mmrahyɛbagua no mu na ɔsii so dua sɛ Nuamah adi nkonim wɔ akongua no mu wɔ ne ho.

Kuadwuma ho Ɔsoafo 
Wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2017 mu no, Ɔmanpanyin Nana Akufo-Addo yii Afriyie Akoto sɛ ɔnyɛ Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ Aduan ne Kuadwuma so .   Wɔpenee no so ɔsram koro no ara.  Bere a ɔreyɛ nhwehwɛmu no, ɔmaa nkurɔfo hui sɛ sikakorafo a wofi South Africa ne United States a wɔakɔsra Afram asasetaw, Kintampo, ne mmeae afoforo wɔ ɔman no mu no ani agye mmoa ntetee hokwan ahorow a saa mmeae no de ma no ho na wɔada anigye adi sɛ wɔde wɔn sika bɛto... sector no mu.

Anisoadehu a Wɔde Ma Ɔsom 
Sɛ Aduan ne Kuadwuma soafo no, Afriyie Akoto hyɛɛ bɔ sɛ ɔbɛma akuafo a wɔde aba a wɔatu mpɔn di dwuma de yɛ kua no dodow akɔ soro, a ɛde besi June 2017 no na ɛyɛ ɔha biara mu nkyem du-baako. Ɔsii so dua sɛ akuafo ɔha biara mu 85 da so ara de aba a wɔde di dwuma wɔ amanne kwan so di dwuma, na ɛma wɔn nnɔbae so tew.  Ɔsan nso ama wɔahu sɛ aban no ne Savanna Kuadwuma Nhwehwɛmu Asoɛe ne Aburow Nkɔso Bagua no bɛyɛ biako de adi aba a ɛho hia ma Planting for Food and Jobs nhyehyɛe no so nkonim.

Kabinet soafo panyin 
Wɔ May 2017 mu no, Ɔmampanyin Akufo-Addo bɔɔ Afriyie Akoto din sɛ asomfoɔ 19 a wɔbɛhyehyɛ ne kabinet no mu baako .  Wɔde asomfo 19 no din kɔmaa Ghana mmrahyɛbagua no na Aban no Kasafo, Rt. Hon. Ɔbenfo a ɔbenfo. Mike Ocquaye na ɔkyerɛwee .  Sɛ́ aban soafo no, Afriyie Akoto ka ɔmanpanyin no mu kuw no ho na ɛsɛ sɛ ɔboa wɔ gyinaesi dwumadi atitiriw mu wɔ ɔman no mu.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Afriyie Akoto aware a ɔwɔ mma baason. Ɔyɛ Ghana Katolek Asɔre no muni.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: John Agyabeng
text:
John Agyabeng (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn 14, 1965) yɛ Ghanani, nhomasua ho nimdefo ne ɔmanyɔni. Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni a ɔhwɛ Agona Dunkwa mantam so wɔ 4th Republic of Ghana mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 5 no mu.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Agyabeng wɔ 14 Ɔpɛpɔn 1965. Ne kurom ne Agona Dunkwa a ɛwɔ Central Region of Ghana. Ɔnyaa Bachelor of Education ne Diploma wɔ Asase ho adesua mu wɔ Cape Coast Sukuupɔn mu wɔ afe 1993 mu. Wɔ afe 2008 mu no, onyaa executive Masters of Governance and Leadership wɔ Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration .

Adwuma 
Na Agyabeng yɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ wɔ Nsaba Presbyterian School a ɛwɔ Ghana Education Service ase. Afei ɔyɛɛ adwuma firi afe 2001 kɔsi afe 2005 sɛ Ɔmantam Panyin wɔ Agona Apueeɛ Mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Mfinimfini Mantam mu . Ɔbɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni maa mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan wɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu na ɔbɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnum no muni maa Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no.

Na Agyabeng yɛ Ɔmantam Panyin (DCE) ma saa bere no Agona Mantam no wɔ Ɔmanpanyin dedaw Nea Ɔkorɔn John Agyekum Kufuor nniso ase.

Na ɔyɛ okuafoɔ na ɔhyɛɛ ne kuayɛ adwuma ase wɔ afe 1998.  Wɔbuu no atɛn sɛ Ɔmansin Kuafoɔ nyinaa wɔ 1 December 2017 wɔ Ɔman Akuafoɔ Da afahyɛ a ɛtɔ so aduasa mmiɛnsa a wɔyɛɛ no Agona Duotu wɔ Central region of Ghana.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Agyabeng gyinaa Agona Apueeɛ mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Mfinimfini Mantam no ananmu sɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni wɔ Ghana a ɛtɔ so nnan mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnum no mu wɔ afe 2008 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu . Wɔpaw no wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so . Wɔde abatoɔ 15,125 na ɛpaw no a ɛne abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 49.62% yɛ pɛ. Theophilus F. Maranga a ofi National Democratic Congress ne Magnus Idan a ofi Democratic Freedom Party no dii nkogu wɔ saa abatow no mu bere a wonyaa abatow nyinaa mu 49.51% ne 0.87% akyi. Ɔkuraa n’akongua so wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu sɛ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan no muni.   Ɔnyaa abatoɔ a wɔtoo no nyinaa yɛ 18,030 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 57.60% sene ne kandifoɔ afoforɔ, Theophilus Fuseini Maranga a ɔyɛ ɔkannifoɔ a ɔde ne ho a ɔtwee abatoɔ a ne nyinaa yɛ 7,427 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 23.70%, Kweku Adu Yeboah a ɔfiri National Democratic Congress a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 5,515 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 17.60% ne Stephen Kwame a ɔfiri Nkrumah Nnipa Ɔman Nhyiamu no mu nso twee abatoɔ a ne nyinaa yɛ 339 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 1.10% wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Agyabeng aware a ɔwɔ mma 5. Ɔyɛ Kristoni.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Boakye Agyarko
text:
Boakye Kyeremateng Agyarko (1956)  yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne kan sikakorabea dwumayɛni. Na ɔyɛ New York Sikakorabea no titrani abadiakyiri .   Na ɔyɛ kan Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ Ahoɔden so wɔ Ghana.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Agyarko wɔ afe 1956 mu, wɔ Kumasi wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu maa Kwasi Agyarko. Na ne papa yɛ oguadini ne United Party adwumayɛfoɔ a ɔfiri Jamase, Ashanti Mantam mu na ne maame yɛ Jane Ladze Padi a ɔfiri Krobo Odumase wɔ Apueeɛ Mantam mu .  Ɔyɛ Dedo Difie Agyarko-Kusi ne Emmanuel Kwabena Kyeremateng Agyarko nuabarima .

Agyarko kɔɔ KO Methodist Mfitiase Sukuu a ɛwɔ Ashtown ne Kwame Nkrumah Sukuupɔn a Ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma So Mfitiase Sukuu a ɛwɔ Kumasi . Afei ɔkɔɔ Mfantsipim Sukuu a ɛwɔ Cape Coast kɔyɛɛ ne ntoaso sukuu fi baabi a onyaa ne GCE Ordinary Level ne GCE Advanced Level nyinaa adansedi krataa.  Ɔnyaa ne Bachelor of Arts abodin krataa wɔ Sikasɛm ne Amanyɔsɛm mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn Legon . Otu kɔɔ United States of America sɛ amammui mu aguanfo. Bere a ɔwɔ hɔ no onyaa Sikakorabea Ho Adwumayɛfo Abodin krataa a Ɛkɔ Anim fii Amerika Sikakorabea Asoɛe ne Adwumayɛ ho Ɔbenfo wɔ Sikasɛm mu Sikasɛm mu wɔ Pace Sukuupɔn, New York.

Adwumayɛ asetra 
Bere a Agyarko wiee Ghana Suapɔn wɔ afe 1980 mu no, ɔyɛɛ ne ɔman som a ɛyɛ ahyɛde wɔ Ghana Union Nation of Students sɛ Ɔman Ntamgyinafo.  Bere a ɔman no som baa awiei wɔ afe 1981 mu no, wɔde no yɛɛ adwuma sɛ sikasɛm ho ɔbenfo kumaa wɔ Management and Investment Consultants wɔ Accra. Ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ hɔ kɔsii afe 1984 baabi a wɔhyɛɛ no ma oguan fii Ghana esiane mmɔden a ɔbɔe sɛ obekum ne nkwa nti.

Wɔkyeree no wɔ ɔkwan a ɛnteɛ so 
Bere a atuatew a entumi nyɛ yiye a Lance Corporal Halidu Giwa ne Sergeant Abdul Malik dii anim akyi no, asraafo mpanyimfo no faa no sɛ ɔka wɔn a wɔbɔɔ atuatew ho nhyehyɛe no ho. Eyi fi amammui mu dwumadi kɛse a na ɔyɛ ne sikasɛm nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɔman no asraafo akannifo a Jerry John Rawlings di wɔn anim gye toom no ho kasatia . Mmarima a wofi Ghana Asraafo mu na wɔkyeree no de no kɔɔ Air Force Base a ɛwɔ Burma Camp wɔ Accra .  Wɔtoo no tuo wɔ base no so na wɔde no kɔɔ 37 Military Hospital funu dan mu.  Wɔ afunu dan mu no, ɔyarehwɛfo bi hui sɛ onwui na ɔde no kɔɔ adwumayɛbea a wɔhwɛ ntɛmpɛ so a Henry Koku Akpalu yɛɛ no oprehyɛn no ntɛm ara. Wɔ oprehyɛn no akyi no ɔnam n’adamfo bi, Monsieur Le Veloire ne ne nuabeanom baanu mmoa so guan fii ɔman no mu.  Agyarko tu kɔɔ United States sɛ amammui mu aguanfo  na ɔde ne din kɔhyɛɛ Pace Sukuupɔn mu .

Sikakorabea a ɛwɔ New York 
Bere a owiee Pace Sukuupɔn no, wɔde no yɛɛ adwuma wɔ Bank of New York, sikakorabea a akyɛ sen biara wɔ United States.  Ɔdii bɛboro mfeɛ aduonu wɔ sikakorabea hɔ na ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ mpaninfoɔ mu wɔ Sikakorabea no nnwuma ahodoɔ mu.  Dibea ahorow a na ɔwɔ no bi ne adwumayɛ sohwɛ ne nhwehwɛmu, nneɛma a wɔyɛ, wiase nyinaa nkitahodi nhyehyɛe sohwɛ, amanaman ntam sikakorabea ne agyapade sohwɛ ne Afe 2000 (Y2K) Adwumayɛkuw no.  Na ɔwɔ ɔhwɛ asɛdeɛ wɔ nnwuma ahodoɔ ne dwumadibea ahodoɔ mu titire wɔ aguadi, sikasɛm, boseabɔ akuw, agyapadeɛ a wɔde hyɛ mu ne sikasɛm a wɔahyehyɛ. Na ɔyɛ nkitahodifo titiriw wɔ New York Sikakorabea a wɔde sii hɔ wɔ Mexico no ho.  Bere a ɔreyɛ adwuma wɔ New York no ɔbɛyɛɛ Amerika Sikasɛm Fekuw no muni ne Amerika Sikakorabea Adwumayɛfo Asoɛe no muni a ɔka ho.  Ɔnam sikakorabea no mu kɔɔ soro na ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔmampanyin abadiakyiri ne Wiase Nyinaa Nkitahodi Ho Dwumadibea Panyin ma Amerikafo wɔ Sikasɛm Ho Dwumadi ne Nnwuma Dwumadibea no mu. Ɔgyaee sikakorabea no wɔ mfeɛ aduonu mmienu akyi sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a ɔbɛtumi asi akan wɔ abatoɔ mu wɔ Ghana.  Bere a ɔwɔ U.S. no ɔkyerɛw dapɛn dapɛn asɛm bi wɔ The Statesman Newspaper mu a wɔato din Letter from America fi 1993 kosi 1998.

Amammu asetra 
Agyarko hyɛɛ amammuisɛm mu wɔ ne mmofraase na na ɔyɛ Ɔman Ntamgyinafoɔ ma Ghana Sukuufoɔ ne Mmabun Fekuo Kuo no firi afe 1979 kɔsi afe 1980.  Na ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party no muni a ɔhyehyɛɛ no wɔ afe 1992.  Wɔ apontow no mu no wadi dibea ahorow pii a The Danquah Busia Club of North America no guamtrani ka ho, na wasom bere tiaa bi sɛ Busia Foundation no sohwɛfo . Wɔpaw no sɛ ɔnyɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo a ɛwɔ Amerika Atifi fam no ntamgyinafo.  Wɔpaw Agyarko sɛ Ɔman Ɔsatuo sohwɛfoɔ wɔ New Patriotic Party no mu wɔ afe 2012 Ɔmampanyin abatoɔ no mu. Wɔpaw no sɛ Policy Adviser ma Presidential Candidate a ɔwɔ New Patriotic Party no mu wɔ afe 2016 abatoɔ no mu.

Asomfo a wɔpaw wɔn 
Wɔ Ɔbɛnem 2017 mu no, wɔpaw Agyarko sɛ ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ ahoɔden so wɔ Akufo-Addo aban mu.    mmrahyɛbagua no penee so wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2017 mu. Sɛ Ahoɔden Soafo no, Agyarko wɔ asɛyɛde a ɛhwɛ nnwuma akɛse dunum a ɛwɔ ɔsom adwuma no ase no so.

Akyinnyegye 
Ansa na Agyarko resi so dua sɛ ɔsomfoɔ wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2017 mu no, Mahama Ayariga a ɔfiri mmrahyɛbagua no boayikuo a ɛpaw no mu bɔɔ no soboɔ sɛ ɔmaa nnipa kakraa bi adanmudeɛ sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a ɛbɛyɛ mmerɛ sɛ wɔbɛpene no so sɛ ahoɔden ho Ɔsoafoɔ .  Ayariga bɔɔ amanneɛ wɔ Radio Gold, sɛ Agyarko nam Muntaka Mubarak, a ɔyɛ nnipa kakraa bi mpire panyin no so abɔ mmɔden sɛ obenya mmrahyɛbagua no Boayikuw a Wɔpaw Wɔn no gyinaesi so nkɛntɛnso denam adanmude a ɔde maa nnipa kakraa bi no mu biara so.  mmrahyɛbagua no Kasafo, Aaron Mike Oquaye hyehyɛɛ mmrahyɛbagua boayikuw bi a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu sɛ wɔnhwehwɛ asɛm no mu.  Nhwehwɛmu no akyi no, Joe Ghartey boayikuw no buu Agyarko bem nanso wɔfaa asɛm kae na wobuu Ayariga fɔ sɛ obuu mmrahyɛbagua no animtiaa esiane sɛ ɔde atoro sobo bɔɔ ne yɔnko dwumayɛni bi na ɔde mmrahyɛbagua no din asɛe nti.  Wɔmaa Ayariga paa kyɛw wɔ mmrahyɛbagua no fam na ɔbɔɔ kɔkɔ sɛ ɔmfa n’adwene nsi ne nneyɛe so daakye.  Bere a wɔpenee so sɛ wɔbɛpaw no sɛ asomfo akyi no, Ayariga kamfoo Agyarko wɔ baguam wɔ n’adwumayɛ ho kyerɛwtohɔ a ɔkae sɛ wɔpenee ne din a wɔde too gua no so esiane sɛ ɔfata nti.

Kabinet Ɔmanpanyin 
Wɔ May 2017 mu no, Ɔmampanyin Nana Akufo-Addo bɔɔ Boakye Agyarko din sɛ asomfoɔ dunkron a wɔbɛhyehyɛ ne kabinet no fa .  Wɔde asomfo 19 no din kɔmaa Ghana mmrahyɛbagua no na Aban no Kasafo, Rt. Hon. Ɔbenfo a ɔbenfo. Mike Ocquaye na ɔkyerɛwee . Sɛ́ Kabinet soafo no, Agyarko yɛ ɔmampanyin no mu kuw no fa na ɛsɛ sɛ ɔboa wɔ gyinaesi dwumadi atitiriw mu wɔ ɔman no mu.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Kwaku Agyemang-Manu
text:
Kwaku Agyemang-Manu (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn 6, 1955) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni. Ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni a ɔhwɛ Dormaa Central so ne Akwahosan Soafo. Ɔyɛ Chartered Management Accountant na ɔnyaa Bachelor of Arts wɔ Sikasɛm ne Akontaabuo mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu wɔ afe 1989.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Agyeman-Manu wɔ Dormaa Ahenkro wɔ saa bere no Brong Ahafo Mantam a mprempren ɛyɛ Bono Mantam mu . Ɔnyaa ne GCE Ordinary Level wɔ afe 1973 mu ne ne GCE Advanced Level wɔ afe 1975 mu. Ɔyɛ Chartered Management Accountant ne Associate Member wɔ afe 1990. Na ɔnyaa Bachelor of Arts wɔ Sikasɛm ne Akontaabuo mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu wɔ afe 1979 mu. Ɔsan nso wiee Management Accountancy wɔ London School of Accountancy.

Adwuma 
Na ɔyɛ sikasɛm sohwɛfoɔ wɔ Ghamot Company Limited ne Toyota Ghana Company Limited nso . Na ɔsan yɛ Akontaabufo Panyin Abadiakyiri wɔ MIM Timber Company Limited.

Amammui mu adwuma 
Agyeman-Manu yɛ New Patriotic Party no muni na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma Dormaa Central Constituency a ɛwɔ saa bere no Brong Ahafo mantam mu wɔ Ghana.  Ɔyɛɛ Ɔmanfoɔ Akontaabuo Boayikuo no Titenani wɔ mmrahyɛbagua a atwam ntɛm ara no mu na na ɔyɛ Ɔman Akwahosan Aban no CEO a ɔreyɛ adwuma wɔ afe 2006 mu, na ɔsan nso yɛ Ɔmanpanyin abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Sikasɛm ne Sikasɛm Nhyehyɛeɛ so wɔ kan Ɔmampanyin Kufuor nniso ase (2001 kɔsi 2008 ). Wɔ saa aban yi mu no, ɔsomm Ɔman Ɔsoafo Abadiakyiri wɔ Nnwuma a edidi so yi mu: Aguadi ne Nnwuma, Mfinimfini, Sikasɛm, Nkitahodi ne Akwan ne Transport. Wayɛ adwuma wɔ Asoɛe ahorow te sɛ Small Arms Commission of Ghana, Ghana Revenue Authority, Bank of Ghana, ne Divestiture Implementation Committee no Boayikuw ahorow mu.

Kabinet soafo panyin 
Wɔ May, 2017 mu no, Ɔmampanyin Nana Akufo-Addo bɔɔ Kwaku Agyemang-Manu din sɛ asomfoɔ dunkron a wɔbɛhyehyɛ ne kabinet no fa.  Wɔde asomfo 19 no din kɔmaa Ghana mmrahyɛbagua no na Aban no Kasafo, Rt. Hon. Ɔbenfo a ɔbenfo. Mike Ocquaye na ɔkyerɛwee .  Sɛ Kabinet Ɔmanpanyin no, Agyemang-Manu yɛ Ɔmanpanyin no mu kuw no fa na ɔboa wɔ gyinaesi nhyehyɛe atitiriw mu ma ɔman no.

Boayikuw no 
Ɔyɛ Members Holding Offices of Profit Committee no muni.

Akyinnyegye ahorow

Woyome animguasesɛm 
Wɔ afe 2005 mu no, Owura Kwaku Agyemang Manu, a saa bere no na ɔyɛ Sikasɛm soafo Abadiakyiri wɔ Kufuor nniso ase no, de krataa bi a na Sikasɛm soafo titiriw no nni hɔ no kɔmaa adwumakuw bi a Owura Alfred Agbesi Woyome na ɔwɔ wɔ agumadibea ahorow a wobesi ama CAN no ho 2008 mu. Afei Owura Woyome de Ghana Aban kɔɔ asɛnnibea wɔ afe 2009 mu na ɔnyaa atemmuo a ɛboro GHC ɔpepem 51, a ɔde ne ho too krataa a Owura Kwaku Agyemang Manu de maeɛ no so.

Animguasesɛm a ɛfa awɔ a wɔkra ho 
Wɔ 8 Ɔpɛpɔn 2019 no, IMANI Center for Policy & Education,  Think Tank a ɛwɔ Ghana no Titenani, dii kan bɔɔ amanneɛ wɔ adetɔ ho mmara sobu ahodoɔ a Ministry of Health (MoH) yɛeɛ wɔ Anti-Snake Venom Serum a wɔtɔɔ wɔ an krataa a wɔabue ano wɔ Facebook so a wɔde kɔmaa Ɔsomfo no. Wɔ mmɔden a wɔbɔe sɛ wobesiw asɛm no ano no, wɔtee Ɔsomfo no wɔ mpɔtam hɔ radio dwumadibea bi, Adom FM so sɛ ɔrebɔ nsɛm a wɔkae sɛ wɔabu tender procurement so no gui. Wɔde mmuaeɛ a ɛdi akyire nso kɔmaa IMANI wɔ yei ho  Akyiri yi wɔhunuu sɛ saa nsɛm a Ɔsomfoɔ no kaeɛ yi yɛ nea wɔayɛ de akata nkitahodie a wɔne mpɔtam hɔ adwumakuo bi a wɔfrɛ no Pharmanova yɛeɛ so. Ɔmanfoɔ Adetɔ Aban (PPA) buu atɛn tiaa Ɔsom Dwumadibea no na wɔkaa nneɛma ahodoɔ a wɔabu so wɔ ne gyinaesie no mu na wɔsrɛɛ Ɔsom adwuma no sɛ wɔmma Pharmanova nnwumakuo mmienu no mfata mma wɔmfa wɔn ho nhyɛ mu mprenu wɔ nsɛm foforɔ mu na wɔne wɔn a wɔaka no nhwɛ tender no bio. Wɔkaa saa aniwusɛm yi ho asɛm kɛse wɔ mpɔtam hɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo mu na nnipa pii bisabisaa wɔn ho sɛ dɛn nti na Ɔsomfo no da so ara wɔ dibea bere a saa nokwasɛm ahorow a emu yɛ den a wɔde too no so yi ama wɔahwere nnipa pii wɔ ɔman no mu esiane aduru a egye ntɛmpɛ a ɛho hia nyinaa yi a wonni nti. Ɛde besi March 2020 no, Ɔsomfoɔ no abɔ mmɔden ahodoɔ ahwɛ sɛ ɔbɛtwa tender a wɔaka ho asɛm no mu, abue tenders foforɔ ama Anti-Snake Venom Serum, abu n’ani agu gyinaesie a PPA de ama no so na wabɔ mmɔden sɛ ɔbɛsan de tenders foforɔ yi ama Pharmanova Ghana Limited.

Kɔndɔm ho animguasesɛm 
Wɔ afe 2019 mu no, Ministry of Health buee tender maa condom wɔ tebea horow a ɛyɛ nwonwa mu. Nea ɛyɛ anigye no, mpɔtam hɔ adwumakuw biara nni hɔ a anka wobetumi de kɔndɔm no ama no amfa wɔn ho anhyɛ mu a ɛmaa nsemmisa sɔree sɛ wobuee tender no ano na wɔbɔɔ ho dawuru kɛse sɛnea Ɔmanfo Adetɔ Mmara no hwehwɛ no a. Ɛyɛ anigye nso sɛ yɛbɛhyɛ no nsow sɛ apam no san kɔɔ Pharmanova Limited nkyɛn.

Nnuru a wɔfrɛ no Pharmanova 
Adwumakuw bi a wɔakyerɛw wɔn din wɔ mpɔtam hɔ a Indiafo na wɔhwɛ so no ayɛ adwuma wɔ Ghana fi afe 2005 na ɛrenya nkɔanim wɔ tender pii mu titiriw wɔ Kwaku Agyemang Manu bere a na ɔyɛ Akwahosan Soafo no ase. Ghana Aban mfii nhwehwɛmu a edi mũ biara ase bere a mpɔtam hɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo atintim nsisi ne tender nsakrae ho adanse kɛse no.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Agyeman-Manu yɛ Kristoni. Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baanum a wonim wɔn.

Baguam atoro a ɛfa ne COVID-19 tebea ho 
Wɔ June 13, 2020 no, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfoɔ dodoɔ bi a ɛwɔ Ghana de too gua sɛ ɔne ne yere ne ne ba no ayɛ COVID-19 na wɔregye wɔn akɔ University of Ghana Medical Center (UGMC).

Wɔgyee Kwaku Agyemang-Manu kɔɔ ayaresabea Yawda na wogyaee no Fida bere a ne yere ne ne babarima wɔ tebea a emu yɛ den mu wɔ UGMC ayaresabea a wɔhwɛ wɔn a wɔyare denneennen no . Ɔkaa sɛ, onnya nhuu COVID-19 wɔ Kwasida bere a ɔne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo bi a wɔfrɛ no Afia Pokuaa aka Vim Lady faa telefon so kasae no. Ɔkae sɛ ɔregye n’ahome nkutoo na ɔnom asikreyare aduru a ɔtaa de di dwuma no.  Wɔka sɛ ne tebea no ama ehu aba Aban mu na mpanyimfo pii retew wɔn ho afi afoforo ho.  Nana Addo Dankwa Akufo-Addo, Ghana President, de too gua wɔ National TV so sɛ ampa ara ne Minister of Health nyaa COVID-19.

Ɛsɛ sɛ yɛhyɛ no nsow sɛ wɔatwe NPP mmrahyɛbagua primaries a ɛwɔ Ministers constituency no akɔ akyiri bio.  Ɛbɛyɛ anigye sɛ yebehu sɛ ebia atrae ne titiriw no n’apam no ananmusifo bɛboa no bio wɔ eyi akyi anaa.

WHO Adwumayɛkuw no hoahoa wɔn ho 
Hon. Wɔafrɛ Kwaku Agyeman-Manu sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ Wiase Akwahosan Ahyehyɛde (WHO) mpanyimfo kuw no mu sɛ Ghana ananmusifo a ɔyɛ WHO man no muni.  Wɔtintim no kɛseɛ wɔ Ghana nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu sɛ ɛyɛ ne nnwuma/nnwuma pa sɛ Ɔsomfoɔ ne ne mfiridwuma ho nimdeɛ na ama wɔapaw saa dibea a ɛkorɔn yi. Ɛsɛ sɛ yɛhyɛ no nsow sɛ WHO paw emufo fi wɔn Aman a wɔyɛ Asomfo nkutoo mu. Esiane sɛ ɔyɛ Akwahosan Soafo wɔ Ghana nti, ɛno nti na ogyina Ghana ananmu na ɛnyɛ n’ankasa. Owura Agyeman-Manu bɛka ho sɛ Afrikafoɔ baason a wɔgyina wɔn aman ananmu no mu baako sɛ wɔbɛboa WHO adwumayɛkuo no wɔ May 2020.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Emmanuel Opam-Brown Akolbire
text:
Emmanuel Opam-Brown Akolbire (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn 15, 1960) yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɔni ne kan mmrahyɛbagua a Ɛto so Nsia a ɛwɔ Ghana Aman a Ɛto so Anan no muni a ogyinaa Bolgatanga Mfinimfini Mantam a ɛwɔ Upper East Region ananmu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Akolbire wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn da a ɛtɔ so dunum, afe 1960.  Ofi Daportindongo-Bolgatanga, kurow bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Apuei Fam Mantam mu . Ɔyɛ obi a wawie Vrije Universiteit Brussel na onyaa ne master’s degree wɔ Management Information System mu wɔ afe 1998.

Adwumafa 
Akolbire yɛ ICT ho ɔbenfo wɔ n’adwuma mu. Na ɔyɛ ICT Director wɔ Central Administration a ɛwɔ University of Development Studies a ɛwɔ Tamale no mu.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Akolbire yɛ Kristoni (Katolekni).  Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baanum.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Joseph Amankwanor
text:
Joseph Sam Amankwanor (wɔwoo no Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 14, 1954) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni na mprempren ɔyɛ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua no muni a ɔgyina Upper West Akim mantam ananmu. Wɔ Ɔbɛnem 22, 2012 no, odii nkonim wɔ abatow a edi kan wɔ National Democratic Congress mu ; Na ɔyɛ Republic of Ghana mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 5 ne 6 no muni.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Amankwanor yɛ Kristoni (Ahemfie Asɔredan). Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baanum.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Amankwanor wɔ Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 14, afe 1954. Ɔfiri Adeiso, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Apueeɛ Mantam mu . Ɔyɛ obi a wawie sukuu wɔ Institute of the Motor Industry, London na onyaa ne adansedi krataa wɔ afe 1980.

Amammui mu adwuma 
Amankwanor yɛ National Democratic Congress (NDC) no muni. Wɔdii kan paw no sɛ ɔmmɛdi tumi wɔ December 2008 mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 18,736 wɔ abatoɔ 34,741 a ɛfata mu.  Ɔgyinaa Upper West Akim mantam ananmu wɔ Ghana Republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 5 no mu. Ɔdii tumi a ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ berɛ a wɔsan paw no wɔ afe 2012 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu denam abatoɔ 15,308 a ɔnyaeɛ wɔ abatoɔ 28,517 a ɛfata wɔ ne mansin mu no so.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Stephen Yakubu
text:
Stephen Yakubu yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɔni ne ɔmanpanyin. Na ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔnanmusifoɔ wɔ Morocco na Ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni ma Binduri mantam a ɛwɔ Upper East Region wɔ Ghana.   Mprempren ɔyɛ Upper East Regional Minister na ɔsan yɛ Ɔmantam Ahobammɔ Bagua no Titenani.

Early life and education 
Wɔwoo Stephen Yakubu wɔ May 25, 1966, wɔ Gotisaliga-Binduri wɔ Upper East Region . Ɔnyaa BSc wɔ Nhyehyɛeɛ mu wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma Suapɔn (KNUST) ne Postgraduate diploma wɔ Information Systems mu wɔ Thames Valley Suapɔn Slough, UK.

Adwuma 
Yakubu ani gye Nkɔso Nhyehyɛe, Nneɛma a Wɔde Sisi, ne Dodow Nhwehwɛmufo ho.

Amammui asetra 
Yakubu yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo (NPP) no muni. Ɔsii akan wɔ Binduri agua no ho wɔ NPP tekiti so. Na ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanyin a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 5 no muni. Ɔnyaa abatoɔ 9,103 wɔ abatoɔ 18,050 a ɛfata a wɔtoo no mu a ɛyɛ abatoɔ a ɛfata nyinaa mu 50.43%.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ɔyɛ n’ankasa adwuma na waware a ɔwɔ abofra biako. Ɔyɛ Kristoni na ɔne Adventist asɔre bi som.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Sammy B. Wusah
text:
Sammy B. Wusah (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn 15, 1957) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne nwomasua ho nimdefoɔ. Ɔsan nso yɛɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni maa Damango-Daboya mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Mantam mu.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Wusah wɔ 15 December 1957 wɔ Lingbensi-Daboya, Atifi Mantam. Ɔnyaa Bachelor of Education abodin krataa (Kuadwuma Nyansahu) UEW  wɔ afe 1999.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Na Wusah yɛ Fourth Republic of Ghana mmrahyɛbagua no muni a wɔpaw no wɔ National Democratic Congress (NDC) tekiti so wɔ December 2008 Ghana amansan abatow mu sɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni ma Damango-Daboya mantam. Ɔgyee atenaeɛ no wɔ December 2008 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu firii Alex Seidu Sofo hɔ a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 2,450 wɔ abatoɔ 25,364 a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ no mu = 49.1% na ɔnyaa mmrahyɛbagua no mu dodoɔ no ara. Ɔhweree nkongua no wɔ afe 2012.

Adwuma 
Ansa na wɔrepaw no sɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni no, na ɔyɛ adwuma sɛ sikasɛm ho ɔpanyin wɔ Ghana Nhomasua Dwumadibea a ɛwɔ West Gonja Mantam mu, Damango.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Wusah yɛ Kristoni a ɔyɛ fekubɔ wɔ Assemblies of God Asɔredan mu. Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baanan.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Kobla Mensah Wisdom Woyome
text:
Kobla Mensah Wisdom Woyome yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nson a ɛwɔ Fourth Republic of Ghana no muni a ɔgyina South Tongu ananmu wɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Woyome wɔ 21 Ɔpɛpɔn 1971. Ɔfiri Dabala kuro bi a ɛwɔ South Tongu Mantam mu wɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.  Woyome yɛ obi a wawie Presbyterian Mmarimaa Ntoaso Sukuu ne Sixth Form Science College, Legon. Woyome wiee ne Bachelors of Science abodin krataa wɔ Kɔmputa Nyansahu ne Akontaabu mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn, Legon wɔ afe 1997 mu. Ɔsan nso nyaa ne postgraduate diploma wɔ adwumayɛ ho adwumayɛ mu wɔ Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration (GIMPA).

Adwuma 
Kobla Mensah yɛ Stewise nnwumakuw kuw no panyin fi afe 2009 kosii sɛ ɔbɛyɛɛ South Tongu MP.

Amammui asetra 
Na ɔyɛ Ghana republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 6 no muni kakraa bi. Wɔpaw no sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ Mmabun, Agumadi ne Amammerɛ Boayikuw no mu sɛ ɔmannifo a ɔwɔ dibea. Ná ɔyɛ Amannɔne Nsɛm Boayikuw ne Daa Nhyehyɛe boayikuw no muni nso.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Wɔkyerɛ sɛ Kobla Mensah Wisdom Woyome yɛ Kristoni na ɔyɛ Action Chapel International kuw no muni. Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baasa.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Adamu Daramani Sakande
text:
Adamu Daramani Sakande (6 May 1962 – 22 September 2020) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni, na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbagua a Ɛto so Anum a ɛwɔ Republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no muni ma Bawku Central Constituency, wɔ Upper East Region of Ghana .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Adamu wɔ 6 May 1962, wɔ Bawku, wɔ Upper East Region wɔ Ghana.  Ɔkɔɔ Portsmouth Suapɔn, NHS-UK na osuaa Counter Fraud and Security Management Service Accredited SMS wɔ afe 2003.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔdii kan paw Adamu sɛ ɔmmra mmrahyɛbagua no mu wɔ December 2008 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu wɔ New Patriotic Party (NPP) tekiti so sɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni ma Bawku Central Constituency wɔ Upper East Region. Wɔ abatoɔ no mu no, ɔnyaa abatoɔ 20,157 wɔ abatoɔ 37,719 a egyina hɔ ma 53.4% no mu. Ɔdii dwuma bere biako pɛ sɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni.

Adwuma 
Adamu ne NHS Primary Case Trust, London yɛɛ adwuma. Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni ma Bawku Central Constituency a ɛwɔ Upper East Region wɔ Ghana.

Akwantu ne afiasenna 
Wobuu Adamu fɔ sɛ odii atoro adanse na ɔyɛɛ atoro. Enti wɔde no too afiase mfe abien bere koro mu wɔ nsɛm no nyinaa ho. Wɔkyerɛe sɛ, ansa na afe 2008 abatoɔ no reba no, ɔkaa atoro asɛm bi wɔ akwammisa krataa bi a ɔde kɔmaa sɛ wɔmfa ne din nhyɛ abatoɔfoɔ din mu na akyiri yi ɔkɔɔ n’anim kɔtoo aba wɔ December 2008 amansan abatoɔ no mu berɛ a na onni hokwan sɛ ɔyɛ saa. Anantwinini tɔnfo bi kae sɛ na Daramani kura Britania ne Burkinabe akwantu tumi krataa nyinaa. Ne mmaranimfo no de asɛm no kɔdan asɛnnibea no sɛ wɔntew atemmu no mu den so esiane Adamu akwahosan ho haw ahorow bi nti.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Adamu waree na na ɔwɔ mma mmienu. Ná ɔyɛ Islam Nyamesom (Muslim) muni.  Anyɛ yiye koraa no, Adamu nyaa akwahosan pa fi afe 2003, na owui wɔ 22 September 2020 wɔ London.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Nii Oakley Quaye-Kumah
text:
Nii Oakley Quaye-Kumah yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɔni ne Mmoa Ho Oprehyɛn Ho Oduruyɛfo . Ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma Krowor Mantam no firi 7 Ɔbɛnem 2009 kɔsi 6 Ɔbɛnem 2017. Na ɔsan yɛ mmoa ayaresabea ahorow bi so panyin.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Quaye-Kumah wɔ 26 Ɔpɛpɔn 1959. Ɔfiri Nungua, a ɛwɔ Greater Accra Mantam mu wɔ Ghana . Ɔnyaa ne Master of Veterinary Science wɔ sukuupɔn bi mu wɔ Ukraine wɔ afe 1989.

Adwuma 
Quaye-Kumah yɛ Mmoa Ho Oprehyɛn Ho Oduruyɛfo . Ansa na ɔrekɔ amammuisɛm mu no, na ɔyɛ Beach Mmoa Ayaresabea a ɛwɔ Nungua ne Westland Mmoa Ayaresabea a ɛwɔ West Legon, Accra.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Quaye-Kumah kɔɔ mmrahyɛbagua mu wɔ 7 Ɔbɛnem 2009 wɔ National Democratic Congress (NDC) a egyina Krowor Mantam no ananmu no tekiti so . Wɔsan paw no sɛ ɔmmɛgyina amansin no ananmu mpɛn mmienu a ɛtoatoa soɔ wɔ afe 2012 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu nanso wantumi annsi akan wɔ atenaeɛ no ho ne mprɛnsa a ɛtoatoa soɔ ɛnam akwahosan pa nti.    Agnes Naa Momo Lartey a ɔsii akan maa NDC wɔ afe 2016 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu  nanso ɔdii nkoguo wɔ Elizabeth Afoley Quaye a ɔfiri New Patriotic Party .

Ankorankoro asetra 
Quaye-Kumah aware a ɔwɔ mma baanum. Ɔkyerɛ sɛ ɔyɛ Kristoni na ɔyɛ International Central Gospel Church (ICGC) no muni.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Aquinas Tawiah Quansah
text:
Aquinas Tawiah Quansah (wɔwoo no 4 April 1964) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni, na na ɔyɛ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua no muni ne Central Regional Minister abadiakyiri wɔ Ghana .  Ɔmampanyin John Evan Atta Mills na ɔpaw no na ɔsom kɔsii Ɔpɛpɔn 2013.

Mfitiase mfe ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Quansah wɔ 4 Ayɛwohomumɔ 1964 wɔ Saltpond, Central Region. Ɔkɔɔ Almeda College a ɛwɔ Atlanta, U.S.A., na owiee sukuu no nyaa abodin krataa wɔ Adwumayɛ ho nimdeɛ mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Quansah yɛ kan mmrahyɛbaguani ma Mfantseman mantam a ɛwɔ Central Region of Ghana. Ɔsii akan maa Mfantseman mantam no atenaeɛ wɔ afe 2012 Amansan Abatoɔ no mu na ɔdii nkonim. Ɔnyaa abatoɔ 31,837, a ɛyɛ 50.95% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu na ɛno nti ɔdii akansifoɔ afoforɔ a Stephen Asamoah Boateng, Eugene Kwaninaabaka Baiden, Onaventure William Appiah ne Veronica Esi Adu-Boateng ka ho so nkonim. Nanso, wɔ afe 2016 mu no, ɔhweree National Democratic Congress nomination no na enti wannya hokwan ankɔgyina party no ananmu wɔ 2016 General Elections no mu .   Na ɔyɛ Mfantseman West MP wɔ afe 2008 Ghana amansan abatow no akyi .

Ankorankoro asetra 
Quansah yɛ Kristoni a ɔyɛ fekubɔ wɔ Harvest Chapel International. Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baanu.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Peter Wiafe Pepera
text:
Peter Wiafe Pepera (wɔwoo no May 9, 1954) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni, na na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni wɔ Abetifi mantam mu wɔ Ghana Apueeɛ Mantam mu. Na ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party of Ghana no muni. Bryan Acheampong na odii n'ade .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Pepera wɔ May 9, 1954 mu. Ɔfiri Abetifi, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Apueeɛ Mantam mu . Na ɔyɛ obi a wawie sukuu wɔ Birmingham Sukuupɔn, UK na onyaa ne Master of Science abodin krataa wɔ nhyehyɛe ho mfiridwuma mu wɔ afe 1980.

Adwuma 
Ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ Paramount Distilleries kwankyerɛfo panyin. Ɔyɛɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni firi Ɔbɛnem 2009 kɔsii sɛ ɔwuiɛ wɔ 21 May 2016.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Na ɔyɛ National Democratic Congress no muni wɔ 1990 mfeɛ no mu kosii sɛ ɔgyaee ne ho kɔɔ New Patriotic Party wɔ afe 2000 mfeɛ no mu.  Bere a ɔwɔ NDC no, Ɔyɛɛ Ɔmanpanyin abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Aguadi ne Nnwuma so wɔ Rawlings aban ase.

Na Pepera yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo (NPP) no muni. Ɔgyinaa Abetifi Constituency ananmu wɔ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 5 no mu. Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔsii akan sɛ wɔbɛsan apaw no bio akɔ Abetifi mmrahyɛbagua adwumayɛbea no wɔ NPP tekiti so sɛ ɔbɛgyina ananmusifoɔ wɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nsia a ɛwɔ ɔman a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu na ɔdii nkonim.  Na ɔyɛ Hokwan, Ofie, Aguadi, Nnwuma ne Nsrahwɛ Boayikuw no muni

Ankorankoro asetra 
Pepera daa ne ho adi sɛ ɔyɛ Kristoni ne Jedi.

Owuo 
Owui bere a na wɔde no too asraafo ayaresabea 37 wɔ Accra wɔ yare bere tiaa bi akyi, na wadi mfe 62

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Yaw Owusu-Boateng
text:
Yaw Owusu-Boateng (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn 25, 1955)  yɛ Ghana nhomasua ho nimdefo ne ɔmanyɔni.  Na ɔyɛ Ghana Aman a Ɛto so Anan mmrahyɛbagua a Ɛto so Nsia no muni a ogyinaa Asene/Akroso/Manso amansin ananmu wɔ Apuei Fam Mantam no mu wɔ Ɔman Ho Kuw Foforo no tekiti so .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Owusu-Boateng wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn da 25, afe 1955.  Ɔfiri Akyem Asene, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Apueeɛ Mantam mu .  Ɔyɛ obi a wawie Cape Coast Suapɔn a onyaa Bachelor of Arts abodin krataa wɔ Sociology ne Geography mu wɔ afe 1986.  Wɔ 1999 mu no, ɔsan nso nyaa ne Postgraduate Certificate wɔ Nhomasua mu wɔ Comparative Education Research ne project Management mu wɔ Copenhagen Sukuupɔn mu wɔ Denmark .

Adwuma 
Ansa na wɔrepaw no sɛ mmrahyɛbagua no, na ɔyɛ adwuma sɛ nhyehyɛe sohwɛfo wɔ American Field Service.

Amammui mu adwuma 
Owusu-Boateng yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni .   Na ɔyɛ Fourth Republic of Ghana mmrahyɛbagua a Ɛto so Anum ne Nsia no muni . Wɔpaw no sɛ ɔmmra mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nsia no mu wɔ 7 Ɔbɛnem 2013 akyi a ɔnyaa abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoo wɔ afe 2012 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu 57.57% .   Ná ɔyɛ boayikuw a ɛhwɛ Adan ne Budget Titiriw so no muni.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ɔyɛ Kristoni, na waware na ɔwɔ mma baasa.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so.

title: Ibrahim Dey Abubakari
text:
Ibrahim Dey Abubakari (wɔwoo no Oforisuo 25, afe 1958) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni, na ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanin mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nsia no muni a ɔgyina Salaga Anafoɔ Mansin ananmu wɔ Atifi Mantam mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Abubakari wɔ Oforisuo 25, afe 1958. Ɔfiri Sirimunchu, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Fam Mantam mu . Ɔkɔɔ Manchester Business School, University of Wales, UK na onyaa ne master’s degree wɔ sikasɛm mu wɔ afe 1996 mu. Ɔsan nso kɔɔ Associates of Cost and Management Accountants wɔ afe 1993.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Abubakari yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua (NDC) no muni. Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔsii akan wɔ Salaga South nkongua no ho wɔ NDC mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nsia a ɛwɔ republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no tekiti so na odii nkonim.  Ɔhyɛɛ n’amammui adwuma ase wɔ afe 2009 mu bere a wɔkae sɛ odii nkonim wɔ afe 2008 Ghana Amansan Abatow mu na wɔpaw no sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 5 wɔ Ghana man a ɛto so 4 no mu.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Abubakari yɛ Nkramofo. Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baanum. Ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ Director of Internal Audit wɔ Ministry of Local Government a ɛwɔ Accra no.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Joseph Kwaku Nayan
text:
Joseph Kwaku Nayan yɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ ne Ghana amammuni a ɔyɛɛ mmarahyɛbedwani maa Nkwanta North Constituency wɔ 4th Republic of Ghana Mmarahyɛbedwani a ɛtɔ so nan ne 5 mu.

Mfitiase asetena ne nnwomasua 
Wɔwoo Joseph wɔ May 22, 1964. Ɔfiri Damanko kuro bi a ɛwɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ Ghana . Ɔnyaa ne Diploma wɔ Nnwoomasua mu wɔ Sukuupɔn a ɛhwɛ Nnwomasua so, Winneba wɔ afe 2006 mu. Ɔkɔɔ so kɔɔ Cape Coast Suapɔn mu baabi a ɔreyɛ ne master’s degree wɔ Aban ne Akannifoɔ mu.

Adwuma 
Ɔyɛ Nhomasua ho Ɔbenfo. Na ɔyɛ Damanko Junior High School Ɔhwɛfoɔ Panyin ne Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ Panyin.  Ná ɔyɛ kan Volta Ɔmantam Soafo Abadiakyiri.   Ná ɔsan yɛ Adwumayɛfo Panyin Abadiakyire a ɔhwɛ mmoa adwuma so.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ɔyɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuo Foforo no muni .  Wɔpaa no sɛ ɔnyɛ mmarahyɛbedwaani sɛ ɔmmɛgyina Nkwanta North Constituency ananmu wɔ Volta mantam mu wɔ Ghana wɔ January 2005 mu. Ɔsii akan sɛ wɔbɛsan apaa no bio wɔ dibea a ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ December 2012 abatoɔ no mu na ɔdii nkunim wɔ abatoɔ 9,426 mu wɔ abatoɔ 21,676 a ɛfata nyinaa mu wɔ ne Mansin mu

Ankorankoro asetena 
Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma mmienu. Ɔda ne ho adi sɛ ɔyɛ Kristoni.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so 

Ghana mmrahyɛbadwafoɔ 2009–2013

title: Thomas Kwesi Nasah
text:
Thomas Kwesi Nasah (wɔwoo no Oforisuo 5, 1972) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni, na ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanin mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nsia no muni a ɔgyina Gushiegu Mansin ananmu wɔ Atifi Mantam mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Nasah wɔ March 5, 1972. Ɔfiri Zamamshiegu, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Fam Mantam mu . Owiee Salaga Ntoaso Sukuu, Ghana na onyaa ne GCE Ordinary Level wɔ afe 1992.

Adwuma 
Na Thomas yɛ adwumayɛfo, okuafo ne kuayɛfo. Na ɔsan nso ka Adwumayɛ Boayikuw, Boayikuw a ɛhwɛ Ohia so Tew Ho Nhyehyɛe, Adwumayɛ ne Adan Ho.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Nasah yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua (NDC) no muni. Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔsii akan maa Gushiegu atenaeɛ no wɔ NDC mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nsia a ɛwɔ republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no tekiti so na ɔdii nkonim.  Ɔhyɛɛ n’amammui adwuma ase wɔ afe 2009 mu bere a wɔbɔɔ no dawuru sɛ odii nkonim wɔ afe 2008 Ghana Amansan Abatow mu maa ne mansin no na wɔpaw no sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 5 wɔ 4th Republic no mu.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Nasah yɛ Kristoni na ɔkɔ Pentekoste Asɔre. Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baanum.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Nii Amasah Namoale
text:
Nii Amasah Namoale (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn 14, 1958) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni a ɔyɛɛ mmrahyɛbaguani maa Dadekotopon mantam a ɛwɔ Greater Accra mantam mu wɔ Ghana firi 7 Ɔbɛnem 2009 kɔsi 7 Ɔbɛnem 2017.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Namoale wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn da a ɛtɔ so 14, afe 1958.  Ɔfiri La-Accra, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Greater Accra Mantam mu wɔ Ghana . Owiee Ofori Panin Ntoaso Sukuu Mpanyimfo . Ɔkɔɔ Cape Coast Suapɔn, Ghana na onyaa ne Master of Philosophy abodin krataa wɔ agronomy mu wɔ afe 2000.

Adwuma 
Namoale yɛ Agronomist wɔ n’adwuma mu. Wayɛ adwuma sɛ ɔkwankyerɛfo boafo wɔ Ministry of Food & Agriculture.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Namoale yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua (NDC) no muni. Wɔpaw no wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani muni ma Dade Kotopon mantam wɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 5 a ɛwɔ Ghana man a ɛto so 4 no mu .  Wɔde abatoɔ 42,678 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatoɔ 74,499 a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu, a ɛne abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 57.3% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Francis Nii Annan Sowah a ofi Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no mu ne Cynthia Akua Mensah a ofi Nhyiam Nnipa Kuw no mu . Eyinom nyaa abatow a ɛfata nyinaa mu 40.37% ne 2.34%. Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔsii akan wɔ Dadekotopon atenaeɛ no ho wɔ NDC tekiti so sɛ ɔbɛnya ananmusifoɔ wɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nsia wɔ republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu na ɔdii nkonim.  Ɔdii nkoguo wɔ Hon Vincent Sowah Odotei wɔ afe 2016 mmrahyɛbagua abatoɔ mu . Wayɛ adwuma sɛ Kuadwuma ho Ɔsoafo Abadiakyiri.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Namoale yɛ Kristoni (Kristo Asɔre).  Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baasa.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Issifu Pangabu Mohammed
text:
Issifu Pangabu Mohammed (wɔwoo no 6 Oforisuo 1962)  yɛ kuayɛfo ne amanyɔni a ɔfiri Ghana .  Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani wɔ National Democratic Congress party no tekiti so, na ogyinaa Ejura-Sekyedumase mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana amansin a ɛto so 4 ne 5 a ɛwɔ Ghana republic a ɛto so 4 no ananmu.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Mohammed wɔ Oforisuo da a ɛtɔ so 6, afe 1962.  Ɔfiri Bawku, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Upper East Region wɔ Ghana .  Ɔnyaa ne GCE O Level ntoaso sukuu abodin krataa wɔ afe 1979.

Adwuma 
Mohammed yɛ Pee Farms a ɛwɔ Ejura no wura ne ne kwankyerɛfo panyin.

Amammui mu adwuma 
Mohammed yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua no muni .  Ɔbɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbagua muni fi Ɔpɛpɔn 2005 bere a ɔdaa ne ho adi sɛ nkonimdifo wɔ Amansan Abatow mu wɔ December 2004. Ɔtu mmirika ne mprenu so na odii nkonim.7,8 Na ɔyɛ MP a ɔhwɛ Ejura-Sekyedumase mantam so. Wɔpaw no sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani maa saa mantam yi wɔ Ghana Republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan ne anum mu.

Abatow a wɔyɛ 
Wɔpaw Mohammed sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani maa Ejura-Sekyedumase mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana nea edi kan wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow no mu. Odii nkonim wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so. Na ne mansin no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 3 no fa wɔ nkongua 39 a National Democratic Congress dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Ashanti Mantam no mu.  National Democratic Congress no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 94 a ɛyɛ kakraa bi wɔ nkongua 230 mu.  Wɔde abatow 17,058 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 33,448 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 51% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Raymond Abuska a ofi Peoples’ National Convention, Richard Ofori Dwamena a ofi New Patriotic Party, Mathias NG Naala a ofi Convention People’s Party ne Dominic Kwabena Anomah B. a ɔyɛ ɔkannifo a ɔde ne ho.  Eyinom nyaa abatow 324, 13,608,240 ne 2,218 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 1%, 40.7%, 0.7% ne 6.6% yɛ pɛ.

Wɔ afe 2008 mu no, odii nkonim wɔ amansan abatow no mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so maa ɔmansin koro no ara. Na ne mansin no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 3 no fa wɔ nkongua 39 a National Democratic Congress dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Ashanti Mantam no mu.  National Democratic Congress no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 113 a ne nyinaa yɛ dodow no ara wɔ nkongua 230 mu.  Wɔde abatoɔ 20,038 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata 38,618 a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu a ɛne abatoɔ a ɛfata nyinaa mu 51.89% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Dr. Josuah Ayarkwa a ofi New Patriotic Party, Patrick K. Konadu a ofi People’s National Convention, KK Nti Oliver a ofi Democratic Freedom Party, Joseph Snwok Lambon a ofi Convention People’s Party ne Yusif Mohammed Kpajal a ɔyɛ obi a ɔde ne ho. Eyinom nyaa abatow 17,312, 218, 136, 376 ne 538 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyi ne abatow a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 44.83%, 0.56%, 0.35%, 0.97% ne 1.39% yɛ pɛ.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Mohammed yɛ Nkramofo.  Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baanum.

Hwɛ nso 

 MP a wɔpaw wɔn wɔ afe 2004 Ghana mmrahyɛbagua abatow mu din
 MP a wɔpaw wɔn wɔ afe 2008 Ghana mmrahyɛbagua abatow mu din

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: David Nana Larbie
text:
David Nana Larbie (wɔwoo no 29 Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 1950) yɛ Ghana mmaranimni  ne ɔmanyɔni. Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani a ɔhwɛ Awutu-Senya mantam so ma mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 5 wɔ Ghana Republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Larbie wɔ 29 Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 1950.  Ɔfiri Awutu a ɛwɔ Central Region of Ghana.  Ɔsuaa adeɛ wɔ King’s College London baabi a ɔsuaa European Community Law na ɔnyaa Post Graduate Diploma.

Adwuma 
Na Larbie yɛ mmara ho ɔfotufo a ɔwɔ London ansa na ɔde ne ho rehyɛ Ghana amammuisɛm mu.  Ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ Mmara ho Ɔfotufo maa Sanana Mmara Ho Afotu Dwumadibea a ɛwɔ Stratford, London.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔpaw no sɛ National Democratic Congress Member of Parliament maa Awutu-Senya mantam mu wɔ afe 2008 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ ananmusifoɔ wɔ Ghana republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 5 no mu. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ a wɔde maa amansin no mu de abatoɔ 25,666, na ɛyɛɛ 49.61%, wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu. Ɔne Oppey Abbey a ofi New Patriotic Party, Kofi Akotua-Obeng a ofi Democratic Freedom Party, Richard Paa-Tawia a ofi Convention People’s Party ne Haroon Tetteh Mensah a ɔyɛ ɔmanpanyin a ɔde ne ho sii akan. Eyinom nyaa abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 45.10%, 1.33%, 1.90% ne 2.05%.

Ankorankoro asetra 
David Nana Larbie aware a ɔwɔ mma 6.  Ɔyɛ Kristoni.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Gifty Klenam
text:
Gifty Klenam yɛ Ghana amanyɔni na na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma Lower West Akim a ɛwɔ Ghana Apueeɛ Mantam mu wɔ Ghana republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 5 mu.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Klenam wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn da a ɛtɔ so 12, afe 1970.  Ɔfiri Asamankesefoɔ a wɔwɔ Ghana Apueeɛ Mantam mu.  Ɔnyaa adansedie krataa wɔ Administration Management mu wɔ Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration wɔ afe 2008.

Adwuma 
Ansa na wɔpaw no na ɔbɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbaguani no, Gifty Klenam yɛ mfiridwumayɛfo ne okuafo, Na ɔsan yɛ Sunharvest Company Limited a ɛwɔ Pokuase no panyin.  Mprempren, ɔsom sɛ oguamtrani wɔ Ghana Export Promotion Authority .

Amammui mu adwuma 
Klenam yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni .  Wɔdii kan paw no sɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni sɛ ɔmmɛgyina Lower West Akim Mansin ananmu wɔ afe 2008 Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ no mu na ɔdii n’adwuma wɔ 7 Ɔbɛnem 2009.  Wɔsan paw no wɔ afe 2012 Amansan Abatoɔ no mu nanso ɔhweree ne primaries wɔ Eyiah Kyei-Baffour anim wɔ afe 2015 mu na wantumi annsi akan wɔ afe 2016 Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ no mu .

Abatow a wɔyɛ 
Wɔpaw Klenam wɔ afe 2008 Ghana amansan abatow mu sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani muni ma Lower West Akim mantam wɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 5 a ɛwɔ Ghana man a ɛto so 4 no mu . Wɔpaw no wɔ New Patriotic party no tekiti so bere a onyaa abatow 21,912 wɔ abatow 36,337 a ɛfata a wɔtow no mu, a ɛne abatow a wɔtow nyinaa mu 60.3% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Yahuza Mohammed Awale a ofi Ɔmanfo Ɔman Nhyiam no mu, Seth Otchere a ofi Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua no mu, Nyadua Kofi Evans a ofi Democratic Nnipa Kuw no mu, Patrick Kwabena Adjei a ofi Nhyiam no mufo Ɔmanfo Kuw no mu ne Martin Bruce Opare a ɔyɛ ɔmanpanyin a ɔde ne ho. Eyinom nyaa abatow a ɛfata nyinaa mu 1.69%, 35.45%, 0.32% ne 2.23%.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Klenam aware na ɔwɔ mma baanu.  Ɔyɛ Kristoni a ɔsom wɔ International Central Gospel Church .  Ɔne Salvation Gate Chapel nso asom.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Allowe Leo Kabah
text:
Kabah (wɔwoo no 11 April 1951) yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɔni ne mmaranimni. Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani nso ma Chiana-Paga Mantam a ɛwɔ Upper East Region of Ghana.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Allowe Leo Kabah wɔ April 11, 1951, wɔ Paga wɔ Upper East Region. Ɔnyaa Bachelor of Arts wɔ Psychology ne Political Science wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu wɔ afe 1977 mu na ɔsan nyaa ne Bachelor of Law (BL) wɔ Ghana School of Law (GSL) wɔ afe 2004.

Adwuma 
Na Kabah yɛ mmaranimfo wɔ n’adwuma mu. Na ɔyɛ Ɔman no Ntamgyinafo a ɔhwɛ Ɔman Mmabun Adwumayɛ Nhyehyɛe (NYEP) so.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ná Kabah yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni . Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma Chiana-Paga Mantam a ɛwɔ Upper East mantam mu wɔ Ghana a ogyina hɔ ma mmrahyɛbagua a Ɛto so Anum a ɛwɔ Fourth Republic of Ghana .  N’amammui adwuma no hyɛɛ aseɛ berɛ a ɔsii akan wɔ afe 2008 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu na ɔnyaa abatoɔ 8,323 wɔ abatoɔ 27,839 a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ a ɛgyina hɔ ma 29.9%.  Nanso, afe 2012 mu no, ɔhweree atenaeɛ no wɔ afe 2012 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu wɔ obi a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ National Democratic Congress (NDC) Abuga Pele .

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baanan. Ɔyɛ Kristoni na ɔsom wɔ Living Chapel International.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Sulemana Ibun Iddrisu
text:
Sulemana Ibun Iddrisu (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn 30, 1955) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni, ne asetena mu adwumayɛfoɔ.  Ɔsan nso yɛ kan ɔmantam kwankyerɛfo wɔ NADMO ne Ecowas Amanaman Ntam Abatow Ho Ɔhwɛfo.  Iddrisu yɛ Ghana republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 5 no muni ma Yendi mantam sɛ ɔman ho dɔ kuw foforɔ no ananmusifoɔ.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Iddrisu wɔ September 1955 mu na ofi Yendi a ɛwɔ Ghana atifi fam Mantam mu. Osuaa amammuisɛm ho ade wɔ Delhi Sukuupɔn mu na onyaa Bachelor of Arts abodin krataa wɔ 1982 mu. Afei ɔkɔɔ so nyaa amammuisɛm ho abodin krataa a ɛkorɔn wɔ sukuupɔn a wɔaka ho asɛm no mu wɔ afe 1984.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Iddrisu yɛ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 5 no muni na ɔyɛ ɔman demokrase nhyiamu no ananmusifo .  N’amammui adwuma hyɛɛ aseɛ wɔ afe 2004 mu baabi a ɔsii akan sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani maa Yendi Mantam no na ɔdii nkoguo wɔ ɔman ho dɔ kuw foforɔ no kandifoɔ bi anim.  Ɔsan sii akan wɔ afe 2008 abatoɔ no mu na ɔdii nkonim saa berɛ yi a ne dodoɔ yɛ 10831 wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu.  Iddrisu hweree n’akongua maa Mohammed Tijani a ɔfiri ɔman demokrase nhyiamu no mu wɔ afe 2012 abatoɔ no mu.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Iddrisu yɛ Muslimi na waware na ɔwɔ mma baanan.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Ahmed Ibrahim (Ghana amanyɛnyi)
text:
Ahmed Ibrahim yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ ne mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nson a ɛwɔ Fourth Republic of Ghana no muni a ɔgyina Banda Mansin ananmu wɔ Bono Mantam mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.   Mprempren ɔyɛ Deputy Minority Chief Whip wɔ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua no mu.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Ibrahim wɔ 6 May 1974, wɔ Banda Ahenkro wɔ Bono Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ibrahim suaa adeɛ wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu baabi a ɔnyaa abodin krataa wɔ Amanyɔsɛm ne Nyansapɛ mu wɔ afe 2001.

Adwuma 
Na ɔyɛ Flamingo Publications (Ghana) Limited adwumayɛfo panyin.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ibrahim hyɛɛ n’amammui adwuma ase wɔ afe 2009 mu bere a wɔkae sɛ ɔno na odii nkonim wɔ afe 2008 Ghana Amansan Abatow mu maa ne mansin no. Afei wɔpaw no sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 5 wɔ Ghana Aman a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu wɔ 7 Ɔbɛnem 2009. Bere a ɔwiee n’ahennie a ɛdi kan no, Ibrahim sii gyinaeɛ sɛ ɔbɛsi akan bio wɔ afe 2013 mu na ɔdii Joe Danquah so nkonim de kuraa n’akongua so. Wɔ afe 2015 mu no, ɔsii akan na odii nkonim wɔ NDC mmrahyɛbagua primaries mu maa Banda mantam a ɛwɔ Bono Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ saa mmrahyɛbagua atenaeɛ yi mu wɔ afe 2016 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu denam abatoɔ 6,167 a ɔnyaeɛ a ɛgyina hɔ ma 52.03% tiaa nea ɔne no reko no abatoɔ 5,660 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 47.76%.

Boayikuw ahorow 
Ibrahim yɛ Budget Boayikuo Titiriw no muni; Nkitahodi Boayikuw no muni; ɔyɛ Mpɔtam Aban ne Nkuraase Nkɔso Boayikuw no muni; ne Adwumayɛ Boayikuw no muni.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ibrahim yɛ Kristoni. Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ abofra baako.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Charles Hodogbey
text:
Charles Hodogbey (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn 21, 1948) yɛ ICT Ɔbenfoɔ ne amanyɔni a ɔwɔ Republic of Ghana . Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani a ɔgyinaa North Tongu (Ghana mmrahyɛbagua mantam) Volta Mantam ananmu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti ase wɔ 5th Parliament a ɛwɔ 4th Republic of Ghana.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Charles Hodogbey wɔ Dofor-Adidome wɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔsuaa adeɛ wɔ U.S. Ɔwɔ master’s degree wɔ management information systems mu wɔ De Paul University of Chicago wɔ afe 1985.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ɔwaree (ɔwɔ mma baanan) na ɔyɛ Kristoni (Evangelical Presbyterian).

Adwuma 
Ɔne Ɔmanfoɔ Akwahosan Dwumadibea, Chicago Kuropɔn, U.S., yɛɛ adwuma sɛ nhyehyɛeɛ/nhwehwɛmufoɔ titire ansa na ɔrebɛyɛ North Tongu mmrahyɛbaguani.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Charles Hodogbey yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua no muni . Ɔyɛ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua no muni ma North Tongu Constituency firi afe 2009 kɔsi afe 2013. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ 22,876 wɔ abatoɔ 29,116 a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ no mu = 78.6%.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: George Gyan-Baffour
text:
George Yaw Gyan-Baffour (wɔwoo no 27 Oforisuo 1951)  yɛ Ghana nkɔsoɔ sikasɛm ho ɔbenfo ne amanyɔni. Ɔyɛ kan mmrahyɛbagua no muni a ɔgyinaa Wenchi mantam ananmu firi afe 2005 kɔsi afe 2021. Na ɔyɛ ɔbenfo wɔ Howard Sukuupɔn a ɛwɔ Washington, DC ., fi 1993 kosi 2001. Ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party no muni na ɔyɛ nhyehyɛe ho Ɔsoafo wɔ Ghana.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Gyan-Baffour wɔ Wenchi wɔ Brong Ahafo Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔkɔɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu baabi a ɔnyaa Bachelor of Arts abodin krataa wɔ sikasɛm mu.  Ɔkɔɔ Helsinki Sikasɛm Sukuu a ɛwɔ Finland baabi a onyaa Diploma wɔ Sikasɛm mu. Akyiri yi onyaa ne master’s degree ne Doctor of Philosophy abodin krataa bere a ɔde ne din kɔhyɛɛ Wisconsin Sukuupɔn mu, Madison .   Ɔsan nso wɔ oduruyɛfo akyi abodin krataa wɔ Harvard Sukuupɔn mu.

Adwumayɛ asetra 
George Gyan-Baffour yɛ adwuma sohwɛ ho ɔbenfo wɔ Howard Sukuupɔn mu fi afe 1993 kosi afe 2001.  Bere a New Patriotic Party dii nkonim wɔ abatow mu wɔ Ghana amansan abatow mu wɔ afe 2000 mu no, ɔsan kɔɔ Ghana na Ɔmanpanyin John Kufour paw no sɛ Ɔman Nkɔso Nhyehyɛe Bagua no sohwɛfo Panyin wɔ afe 2002.    Saa bere yi mu na ɔde nhyehyɛe a edi kan a wɔde bɛhwɛ ɔman no nkɔso ntɛmntɛm so na wɔasusuw ho sii hɔ. Ɔhwɛɛ Nhyehyɛe a Wɔayɛ abom ama Ghana Sikasɛm ne Asetena mu Nkɔsoɔ no nkɔsoɔ so.

Amammui asetra 
Ogyaee dibea no wɔ afe 2004 mu sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a obetumi adi n’amammui mu atirimpɔw ahorow akyi. Saa afe no, ɔde New Patriotic Party no tekiti sii akan wɔ Wenchi mantam mmrahyɛbagua abatow no mu. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ no mu na ɔkɔɔ so dii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ mmiɛnsa a ɛdi akyire no mu wɔ afe 2008, 2012 ne 2016 mu. Ɔmampanyin Kufour paw no sɛ Ɔmanpanyin Kufour paw no sɛ Ɔmanpanyin Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Sikasɛm ne Sikasɛm Nhyehyɛe so fi March 2005 kosi December 2008.

Wɔ afe 2015 mu no, ɔsɔre tiaa nhyehyɛe a Mahama aban no ayɛ sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ aban mmoa afi Amanaman Ntam Sikakorabea hɔ wɔ baguam .  Ná ogye di sɛ wobetumi adi sikasɛm mu ahokyere a na ɔman no refa mu saa bere no ano aduru denam bosea a wobenya afi ɔman no mu no so.

2004 abatow mu 
Wɔdii kan paw Gyan-Baffour sɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni maa Wenchi mantam no bere a wɔbɔɔ no fii saa bere no Wenchi Apuei ne Wenchi Atɔe amansin no mu akyi. Wɔpaw no wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow mu. Ɔnam saayɛ so gyinaa amansin no ananmu wɔ Ghana republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu.  Wɔde abatow 18,183 paw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 33,806 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 53.8% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Abdul-Latif Umar Abdullah a ofi Convention People’s Party, Alhaji Alhassan Bene a ofi Every Ghanaian Living Everywhere Party ne Osei Kwadwo Hayford a ɔyɛ ɔkannifo a ɔde ne ho. Eyinom nyaa abatow 1,286, abatow 7,669 ne abatow 6,668 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 3.8%, 22.7% ne 19.7% yɛ pɛ. Gyan-Baffour dii nkonim wɔ saa abatow no mu wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so. Na ne mansin no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 14 no fã wɔ nkongua 24 a New Patriotic Party dii wɔ Brong Ahafo Mantam mu wɔ Ghana no nyinaa mu.   Sɛ yɛka ne nyinaa bom a, New Patriotic Party no nyaa dodoɔ no ara a ɛyɛ mmrahyɛbagua ananmusifoɔ 128 wɔ nkongua 230 a ɛwɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnan a ɛwɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu.

2008 abatow mu 
Wɔsan paw Gyan-Baffour sɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni ma Wenchi mantam no wɔ afe 2008 Ghana amansan abatow mu. Ɔnam saayɛ so gyinaa amansin no ananmu bio wɔ Ghana republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 5 no mu.  Wɔde abatow 18,516 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata nyinaa mu 32,573. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 56.84% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Yaw Osei Agyei a ofi National Democratic Congress, Akotia Kwaky Thompson a ofi Democratic Freedom Party ne Abdul-Latif Omaru Abdullay a ofi Convention People’s Party mu. Eyinom nyaa abatow 13,495, abatow 284 ne abatow 278 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 41.43%, 0.87% ne 0.85% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw Gyan-Baffour wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so. Na ne mansin no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 16 no fã wɔ nkongua 24 a New Patriotic Party no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu wɔ Brong Ahafo Mantam mu wɔ Ghana no mu.  Ne nyinaa mu no, New Patriotic Party no dii nkonim wɔ nnipa kakraa bi a wɔka bom yɛ mmrahyɛbagua ananmusifo 107 wɔ nkongua 230 a ɛwɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 5 a ɛwɔ Ghana man a ɛto so 4 no mu.

2012 abatow mu 
Wɔ afe 2012 mmrahyɛbagua abatoɔ mu no, Gyan-Baffour nyaa abatoɔ a ɛfata nyinaa mu 50.83% denam Yaw Osei Agyei a ɔfiri National Democratic Congress, Ebenezer Gyimah Koomson a ɔfiri Progressive Peoples’ Party ne Jacob Steve Kojo Akasampah Gyan a ɔfiri National Democratic Party mu.

mmrahyɛbagua no boayikuw ahorow 
Esiane sɛ Gyan-Baffour yɛ sikasɛm ho ɔbenfo nti, watra mmrahyɛbagua boayikuw ahorow a ɛfa n’adwuma ho no mu titiriw. Wɔn mu bi ne: Budget Boayikuw Titiriw; Aguadi, Nnwuma ne Nsrahwɛ Boayikuw; Nhomasua Boayikuw; Boayikuw a Wɔtew Ohia So; ne Budget Boayikuw Titiriw no guamtrani a ɔyɛ adwuma.

Asomfo a wɔpaw wɔn 
Wɔ 12 Ɔbɛnem 2017 no, Ɔmanpanyin Nana Akuffo-Addo yii no sɛ ɔsomfoɔ a wɔayi no sɛ ɔnyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ.  Ɔmanpanyin no frɛɛ no "sikasɛm ho ɔbenfo a wobu no a ɔwɔ nimdeɛ a ɛfata sɛ kan Ɔman Nkɔso Nhyehyɛe Bagua no panyin ". Wɔbɔɔ no sobo sɛ ɔkyerɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no abatow ho amanneɛbɔ ase nkɔ botae ahorow a ɛyɛ adwuma, a wobetumi adu ho ama ɔman nkɔso.

Vetting ne ntam a wɔka 
mmrahyɛbagua no Appointments Committee no hwehwɛɛ ne mu wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2017 mu. Bere a ɔreyɛ nhwehwɛmu no, ɔka kyerɛɛ boayikuw no sɛ Ghana nhia mfe 40 nkɔso nhyehyɛe efisɛ ɛhyɛ kateeyɛ ho nkuran.  Wɔ n’adwene mu no nhyehyɛe a ɛnkyɛ pii no bɛyɛ papa na aboa ma wɔakwati anohyeto biara a ɛbɛyɛ atamfo ama Ghana nkɔso.  Boayikuw no penee so bere a odii ahwehwɛde ahorow a ehia ma ɔman soafo nyinaa ho dwuma akyi.  Ɔmampanyin Akuffo-Addo kaa ntam wɔ 11 Ɔpɛpɔn 2017.

Asɔremma ne wɔn a wɔka ho 
Gyan-Baffour yɛ Ghana Sikasɛm Ho Nimdefoɔ Asoɛeɛ no yɔnko. Ɔayɛ Ghana Aban nnwuma ahodoɔ a ɛka ho ne Bank of Ghana, Council for Scientific and Industrial Research ne Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration no board member .

Ankorankoro asetra 
George Gyan-Baffour aware a ɔwɔ mma baason.  Ɔyɛ Katolek Asɔre a ɛwɔ Ghana no muni .

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Wisdom Gidisu
text:
Wisdom Gidisu (wɔwoo no 5 May 1967) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni a ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma Krachi East Constituency wɔ Oti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Gidisu wɔ 5 May 1967 wɔ kuro bi a wɔfrɛ no Adidome wɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Gidisu wiee Harvard Sukuupɔn mu John F. Kennedy Aban Sukuu a na ɔwɔ BSc wɔ Ɔman Adwumayɛ mu . Afei ɔsan kɔɔ saa asoɛe koro no ara mu kɔnyaa ne master’s degree wɔ Aban ne Akannifoɔ mu. Ɔsan nso nyaa ne Executive MBA wɔ GIMPA wɔ afe 2012 mu. Na ɔwɔ ne adansedi krataa wɔ Executive Education, Managing Change in Dynamic World mu fi Harvard Kennedy wɔ USA. Na ɔwɔ adansedi krataa nso wɔ Advance Health System Management mu wɔ Israel.

Adwuma 
Ɔyɛ Top-in-Town adwumayɛbea a ɛwɔ Dambai no kwankyerɛfo panyin.

Amammui mu adwuma 
Gidisu hyɛɛ n’amammui adwuma ase sɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2005 mu bere a ɔde National Democratic Congress (NDC) tekiti dii nkonim wɔ afe 2004 amansan abatow mu no.   Na ɔwɔ run of 3 terms wɔ office no mu.  Ɔhweree n’akongua maa Micheal Gyato a ofi New Patriotic Party mu wɔ afe 2016 Gha

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baawɔtwe. Ɔyɛ Kristoni (Evangelical Presbyterian).

Adɔeyɛ 
Ɔyɛɛ adesuadan ahorow na ɔmaa nsu ho nhyehyɛe ne gua ahorow nso maa mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔwɔ ne mantam mu. Ɔmaa anyinam ahoɔden a wɔde yɛ nkuraase nso yɛɛ mmerɛw maa nkuraa bi. Ɔkyekyɛɛ atoko afiri nso de som mpɔtam 80 bere a na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani wɔ ne mpɔtam hɔ no.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Joe Ghartey
text:
Joe Ghartey (wɔwoo no 15 June 1961, wɔ Accra) yɛ Ghana mmaranimni, nwomasua ne amanyɔni. Ɔyɛ Ghana Mmaranimfoɔ Panyin (2006–2009), mmrahyɛbagua no Kasafoɔ Abadiakyiri a ɔtɔ so mmienu (2013–2017) ne Keteke ne Nkɔsoɔ soafoɔ (2017–2021).  Joe Ghartey fi Shama, a ɛwɔ Republic of Ghana Atɔe Fam Mantam mu.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Joe Ghartey wɔ Accra, Ghana, na ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ bi a wɔfrɛ no Lauraine Ghartey (wɔwoo no Daniels), ne ɔman dwumayɛni bi a wɔfrɛ no Joseph Ghartey wɔ June 15, 1961. Ofii ne mmofraase nhomasua ase wɔ Ridge Asɔre Sukuu a ɛwɔ Accra no mu na akyiri yi otu kɔɔ ntoaso sukuu a wɔde mmofra kɔtra mu, Mfantsipim Sukuu, a ɛwɔ Cape Coast . Ɛyɛ bere a na ɔwɔ Mfantsipim Sukuu mu no na n’akannifo su ahorow fii ase daa adi. Wɔpaw no sɛ House Prefect of Pickard-Parker House wɔ n’afe a ɛtɔ so mmienu mu na ɔde n’adwumayɛbea pa no dii dwuma de bɔɔ agumadi ne asuafoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ agumadiɛ nhyehyɛeɛ mu wɔ Mfantsipim no nkɔsoɔ ho ban. Ná ɔbɛkɔ so abɛyɛ Team Manager ama agumadi akuw a ɛwɔ sukuu no mu.

Mfantsipim akyi no, Ghartey de ne din kɔhyɛɛ mmara mu sɛ ɔrekɔsua mmara na ɔnyaa ne LLB (Hons) abodin krataa wɔ afe 1986 mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu, ne BL wɔ Ghana Mmara Sukuu mu wɔ afe 1988 mu, wɔfrɛɛ no kɔɔ Ghana Mmaranimfoɔ wɔ saa afe no ara mu.

Mmara adwuma ne nhomasua 
Ghartey yɛɛ ne Ɔman Som adwuma sɛ Mmaranimfo wɔ Komenda Eguafo Abirem Mantam Bagua a ɛwɔ Ghana Mfinimfini Mantam mu. Ɔsan nso faa adwuma sɛ Associate wɔ Chambers of Lawyer Gwira wɔ Sekondi. Akyiri yi, na ɔbɛka adwumakuw a ɛwɔ Akufo-Addo, Prempeh & Co., mmara adwumayɛbea a ɛwɔ Ghana, a ne daakye yɔnko dwumayɛni mmrahyɛbaguani ne Kabinet Soafo wɔ John Kufuor nniso mu, Nana Akufo-Addo, boom hyehyɛɛ no. Ghartey gyaee saa adwumakuo yi wɔ mfeɛ nson akyi na wɔ afe 1994 mu no ɔne ne yere Efua Ghartey a ɔyɛ mmaranimfoɔ a wɔbu no wɔ n’ankasa mu no boom hyehyɛɛ mmara adwumakuo, Ghartey & Ghartey. Mprempren ɔyɛ Senior Partner wɔ Ghartey & Ghartey, adwumakuw a wobu no yiye a ɛyɛ barristers & Sand solicitors a ɛwɔ Labone wɔ Accra.

Wɔ ne mmara adwuma nyinaa mu no, Ghartey de sika pii ahyɛ mmara mu nnwuma a ɔde bɛma nnwuma a wɔn ani gye ho sɛ wɔbɛma nnwuma aba ama Ghana sikasɛm a ɛyɛ den. Wɔ n’ankasa nsɛm mu no, “Sikasɛm a ɛyɛ den gyina nnwuma a ɛyɛ den so.” Ɛsɛ sɛ nnwuma a ɛyɛ den nya mmara mu nnyinaso a ɛyɛ den". Ɔde mmara mu dwumadie ama nnwumakuo ne adwumayɛfoɔ akuo ahodoɔ, wɔ ɔman no mu ne amanaman ntam, ɛfiri Toɔtua mu kɔsi Adwumayɛfoɔ mmara, Atwa Yɛn Ho Ahyia ne Nnwumakuo mmara . Ɔyɛ tumidifo wɔ Nnwumakuw ne Sikasɛm ho mmara mu.

Ɔde ka ho aboa Nnipa Hokwan ho nsɛm pii wɔ Ghana. Sɛ́ obi a ɔka wɔn a wɔhyehyɛɛ Ghana Boayikuw a Ɛhwɛ Hokwan a Nnipa ne Nnipa Ho So no, Hon. Ghartey de nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ akyiri a ɛfa Nnipa Hokwan, Ɔmanfoɔ Hokwan ne Asɛdeɛ ho ama ɔman mma akuo ahodoɔ. Ne saa nti wɔmaa boayikuw no dibea sɛ ɔhwɛfo wɔ Afrika Bagua a Ɛhwɛ Hokwan a Nnipa ne Nnipa Wɔ So . Ɔsan nso yɛɛ Inter African Network of Human Rights Organizations a ɛwɔ Zambia no Titenani .

Sɛ́ ɔkasafo ne ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo no, Ghartey nso ama ɔkasa ahorow wɔ Mmara ne Sikasɛm mu nsɛm ahorow mu. Na ɔyɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ boafoɔ wɔ Investment Law ho wɔ University of Ghana Business School. Ɔsan nso ayɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ wɔ Nnwumakuo Aban ne Executive MBA wɔ Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration (GIMPA). Ɔsan nso yɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo wɔ Ghana Stock Exchange bere bi . Wɔ afe 2004 mu no, ɔkyerɛw deɛ abɛyɛ Ghana mmara kwan so nwoma a ɛdi kan a ɛfa Sikasɛm ne Adwumayɛ ho, "Doing Business and Investing in Ghana – Legal and Institutional Framework". Ɔsan nso kyerɛɛ Company Law wɔ Ghana School of Law ne Mountcrest Suapɔn a ɛwɔ Accra.

Amammui mu adwuma ne nniso 
Ghartey yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo (NPP) no muni.    Wɔhyɛɛ no nkuran sɛ ɔnkɔkaa Party no ho wɔ afe 1992 mu efisɛ ɛfoa gyinapɛn ahorow a emu yɛ den a n’ankasa kyɛ — Ahofadi, Demokrasi, Obu a Wɔde Ma Hokwan a Nnipa Wɔ ne Mmara nniso, ne Ankorankoro Nkɔso, nyansapɛ a n’ani gye ho kɛse wɔ ne koma mu. Ɔhyɛɛ aseɛ sɛ Sekondi Ɔsatuo Kuo no muni na akyiri yi ɔbɛyɛɛ Greater Accra Ɔmantam Nteɛsoɔ Boayikuo a ɛwɔ Party no mu no Titenani. Na ɔka kuw a wɔkyerɛw "Stolen Verdict" no ho, wɔ afe 1993 mu, a na ɛyɛ abatow mu nneyɛe bɔne a ɛtrɛwee thatr sii wɔ 1992 amansan abatow no mu no ho nsɛm a ɛkɔ akyiri. Ɔdii Ɔman Nhyiamu no Nhyiamu a ɛsesaa NPP amansan mmara wɔ Aguadiɛ Fair Centre wɔ Accra wɔ 22 Ɔbɛnem 2009 no guamtrani. Eyi ne bere a wɔtrɛw Abatow Kuw a wɔde bɛpaw ɔmampanyin no mu fii nhyiamfo mpempem kakraa bi so kɔɔ ananmusifo bɛboro mpem ɔha. Na ɔsan nso yɛ mmara ho abenfoɔ kuo a NPP Ɔman Badwa no paw wɔn sɛ wɔnhwɛ abatoɔ adesrɛ a wɔde kɔmaa Asɛnnibea Kunini no wɔ afe 2012 amansan abatoɔ no akyi no mufoɔ na wɔmfa nyansahyɛ ahodoɔ mma nkɔ akyiri. Boayikuw no de n’amanneɛbɔ no kɔmaa Ɔman Bagua no. Amanneɛbɔ no kaa nsusuwii ahorow a ɛfa nsakrae a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ abatow nhyehyɛe mu wɔ Ghana ho .

Ghana mpoano belt no nyinaa mu no, Ghartey aboa amansin bebree wɔ Western, Central, Greater Accra ne Volta Regions, a Shama, Sekondi, Takoradi, Effie Kwasimintsim, Tarkwa, Prestea, Amenfi, Korle Klottey, La-Dade Kotopon ne Hohoe ka ho . Wɔ afe 2000 mu no, na ɔyɛ odum wɔ Western Regional Presidential Campaign Team a ɛwɔ NPP no mu, na ɔne saa bere no kandifo John Kufuor, a ɔkɔɔ so dii nkonim wɔ amansan abatow mu wɔ December saa afe no mu no tuu kwan wɔ ɔmantam no tenten ne ne tɛtrɛtɛ mu.

Mprempren Ghartey yɛ NPP mmrahyɛbagua no muni ma Essikado/Ketan Mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Atɔe Fam Mantam mu.  Wɔdii kan paw no sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ atenaeɛ no wɔ December 2004 abatoɔ no mu na wɔsan paw no wɔ December 2008 ne December 2012 abatoɔ no nyinaa mu. Wɔ abatoɔ mmiɛnsa no nyinaa mu no, wɔansi akan wɔ NPP primaries no mu sɛ ɔbɛpaw mmrahyɛbaguani a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔbɛyɛ Constituency no.

Wɔ Ɔmampanyin John Agyekum Kufuor nniso mu no, wɔpaw Ghartey sɛ Mmaranimfo Panyin Abadiakyiri ne Atɛntrenee Soafo Abadiakyiri wɔ March 2005 mu. Ankyɛ na wɔmaa no dibea na wɔpaw no sɛ Mmaranimfo Panyin ne Atɛntrenee Soafo titiriw wɔ June 2006 mu, dibea a odii mu kosii January 2009 wɔ abatow mu nkogu a NPP dii wɔ afe 2008 amansan abatow mu no akyi. Ghartey yɛ Mmaranimfo Panyin ne Atɛntrenee Soafo a ɔde bere tenten asom wɔ Kufuor nniso no ase. Wɔsan nso maa no adwuma sɛ ɔfotufo wɔ Sierra Leone mmrahyɛbagua no mu na ɔkyerɛw abrabɔ ho mmara maa saa mmrahyɛbagua no. Wɔ May, 2017.

Mmaranimfo Panyin ne Atemmu Ho Ɔsoafo 
Wɔ June 2006 mu no, nsakraeɛ bi a Ɔmampanyin Kufuor yɛeɛ wɔ Ɔsomfoɔ mu no maa wɔmaa Ghartey so firii Mmaranimfoɔ Panyin Abadiakyiri ne Atemmuo Ɔsoafoɔ dibea so kɔɔ Mmaranimfoɔ Panyin ne Atemmuo Ɔsoafoɔ. Ɛno akyi no, Ɔmanpanyin Kufuor kaa ntam sɛ ɔbɛyɛ adwuma wɔ 16 June 2006 sɛ Mmaranimfo Panyin ne Ɔmanpanyin a ɔtɔ so 20 a ɔhwɛ Atemmuo so wɔ Republic of Ghana. Ɔyɛ obi foforo a ɛfata nkamfo a ɔde kaa kan Ghana Mmaranimfo Panyin a wɔagye din te sɛ Victor Owusu (1966–69), ne Nana Akufo-Addo (2001–03) no ho.

Sɛ Mmaranimfo Panyin no, Ghartey de Nsakrae Ho Nhyehyɛe bi sii hɔ wɔ Atemmu Dwumadibea no mu. Na botae titiriw ne sɛ wɔbɛma adwumayɛbea no adwumayɛ atu mpɔn kɛse na wɔanya atɛntrenee a wɔde ma wɔ Ghana no afa horow nyinaa so nkɛntɛnso kɛse. Na ne nhyehyɛe titiriw ne Atɛntrenee ma Obiara a nea ɛka nneɛma afoforo ho ne sɛ ɛbɛma nnipa a wɔde wɔn ato afiase bere tenten a wɔamfa wɔn nkɔ asɛnnibea no anya kwan akɔ asennibea ahorow. Saa dwumadi yi maa woyii nnipa ɔhaha pii a wɔde wɔn agu afiase a wɔankɔ asɛnnibea anaasɛ wɔammu wɔn fɔ nanso Ɔman no de wɔn agu afiase no fii afiase.

Sɛ Mmaranimfo Panyin no, odii ne mmaranimfo akuw no anim kɔɔ asɛnnibea wɔ nsɛm a ɛho hia pii ho.  N’anigye soronko a ɔwɔ wɔ Sikakorabea Mmara ho no daa adi wɔ mmara nhyehyɛe ne nnwuma a wɔyɛ maa Ngo ne Gas Nnwuma a ɛwɔ Ghana no mu. Sɛ mmrahyɛbagua no Boayikuw a Ɛhwɛ Atopae ne Ahoɔden So no muni no, ɔboaa kɛse ma wosii gyinae sɛ wɔbɛhyehyɛ Petroleum Commission of Ghana . Sɛ́ Kabinet Ɔmanpanyin no, ogyinaa Ɔmampanyin ananmu wɔ amanaman ntam nhyiam ahorow pii a ɛfa mmara ne sikasɛm ho nsɛm ho.

Ɔkasafo Abadiakyiri 
Wɔ afe 2012 amansan abatoɔ no akyi no, Hon. NPP kakraa bi a wɔwɔ mmrahyɛbagua no mu na wɔpaw Ghartey sɛ mmrahyɛbagua no Kasafo Abadiakyiri a ɔto so abien wɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 6 a ɛwɔ Republic a ɛto so 4 no mu. mmrahyɛbagua no Ɔkasafo Abadiakyiri a ɔto so 2 no gyinabea sɛnea wɔadi kan ayɛ no kɔ Party kakraa bi a ɛwɔ mmrahyɛbagua no mu nkyɛn. Nanso, wɔ NPP a wɔkasa tiaa sɛ John Dramani Mahama a wɔpaw no sɛ Ghana ɔmampanyin no yɛ nokware ne akyi a wɔpow n’ahyɛnsode no akyi no, na NDC a emufo dodow no ara mufo binom adwene ne sɛ, "ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔde dibea no tua NPP ka." esiane sɛ na wasi gyinae sɛ wɔbɛpow John Mahama a ofi NDC no a wɔbɛpaw no sɛ Ɔmampanyin wɔ abatow koro no ara mu nti ɛyɛ asɛnnennen." NDC no de NPP a bere bi a atwam no apaw sɛ ɔbɛtow aba ama Malik Alhassan Yakubu (NPP kandifo) atia NDC Ken Dzirasah no adi kan aka ho asɛm no pɛe sɛ wɔboa PNC foforo bi a ɔba dibea no mu mmom. Nanso, awieeɛ koraa no, mmrahyɛbagua no mufoɔ de adwene baako paw Joe Ghartey sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ saa wɔ 7 Ɔbɛnem 2013.

Efi bere a odii tumi no, wabɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔbɛhyehyɛ mmara a wɔde bɛbɔ wɔn ho ban afi Ghana mmrahyɛbaguafo ntam akasakasa ho. Ɛde besi bere a ɔsɔre bɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbagua no Ɔkasafo Abadiakyiri a ɔto so abien no, na ɔyɛ Ɔman Mmara ne Mmara Nsɛm Boayikuw no muni a ɔyɛ Ranking, Aban Awerɛhyem Boayikuw no muni ne Mines and Energy Committee no muni. Mprempren ɔyɛ Asɔremma Boayikuw a Wɔkura Mfaso Dwumadibea ahorow no guamtrani. Afei nso, ɔyɛ Amansan Mmara, Mmara ne mmrahyɛbagua Boayikuw ne Daa Ahyɛde Boayikuw no muni. Wɔsan nso paw no sɛ Sierra Leone mmrahyɛbagua no Fotufo na ɔkyerɛw Abrabɔ Ho Mmara maa saa mmrahyɛbagua no.

Kabinet Ɔmanpanyin 
Wɔ May 2017 mu no, Ɔmampanyin Akufo-Addo hyehyɛɛ Ministry of Railways Development sɛ cabinet dibea na ɔtoo Joe Ghartey din sɛ sector Minister ne cabinet .

Ɔsatu a wɔyɛ ma NPP Ɔmampanyin kandifo 
Hon. Joe Ghartey de too gua sɛ ɔpɛ sɛ ɔbɛsi akan wɔ dibea no ama ɔmampanyin a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party no ansa na afe 2016 amansan abatoɔ no aba. Ɔde ne din krataa a ɔde bɛkɔ dibea no kɔe wɔ 7 July 2014, ne nnipa baanum a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔpaw wɔn. Wɔyɛɛ Special Delegates Congress wɔ 31 August 2014 a Party no yɛeɛ sɛ wɔbɛtew wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔyɛ adwuma no dodoɔ so akɔ fam akodu anum, sɛdeɛ NPP Amanyɔ Mmara kyerɛ no. ɔdii nea ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa nanso ɔpaw sɛ ɔrenkɔ afã a ɛtɔ so mmienu no nanso ɔboaa ɔkannifoɔ a ɔdii nkonim Nana Addo Dankwa Akuffo-Addo, Ɔmampanyin no.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Joe Ghartey aware Efua Ghartey, mmaranimfo ne nea ɔka wɔn a wɔhyehyɛɛ mmara adwumakuw, Ghartey & Ghartey ho. Owurayere. Efua Ghartey nso yɛ Bible Fekuw a ɛwɔ Ghana no Titenani ne Amanaman Ntam Bagua a ɛwɔ United Bible Societies (UBS) a ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ aman bɛboro 200 so no Titenani. Ɔyɛ Greater Accra Ghana Mmaranimfo Kuw no titrani bio ne Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no Amanyɔ Mmara ne Mmara Boayikuw no muni nso . Wɔwɔ mma baanum.

Agumadi ne dwumadi afoforo 
Efi ne bere a na ɔyɛ Mfantsipim Sukuu agumadi akuw mu kuw sohwɛfo no, Ghartey ayɛ obi a ɔpɛ bɔɔlbɔ na ɔboa Ghana mpɔtam hɔ bɔɔlbɔ kuw no denneennen. Wadi kan asom sɛ Mmaranimfo ama Accra Hearts of Oak Supporters Union (National Chapters Committee) na akyiri yi ɔbɛyɛɛ Sekondi Eleven Wise Titenani, na odii kuw no anim fi bɔɔlbɔ kuw no fã a ɛto so abien kosi nea edi kan.

Ghartey nso yɛ ɔyamyefo na ɔboa nneɛma pii a n’ankasa gye di. Ɔyɛ akenkanfo a n’ani gye ho na ɔyɛ ɔkyerɛwfo a ne ho akokwaw na mprempren ɔreyɛ nhomanimfo adwuma ahorow a wobehu sɛ wobetintim bere a ɛsɛ mu.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Cassiel Ato Forson
text:
Cassiel Ato Baah Forson yɛ Ghana amanyɔni na ɔyɛ Ghana Mantam a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nson no muni na ɔyɛ Ghana Aman a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe no muni a ɔgyina Ajumako-Enyan-Esiam Mansin a ɛwɔ Central Region ananmu wɔ tekiti a wɔde Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua (NDC).   Wɔ afe 2013 mu no ɔyɛɛ ɔman soafoɔ abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Sikasɛm so.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Oduruyɛfo Forson wɔ 5 August 1978 na ofi Ajumako Bisease wɔ Central Region of Ghana .  Ɔnyaa PhD wɔ Adwumayɛ ne Adwumayɛ mu (sikasɛm a wɔpaw) wɔ September 2020 mu wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so (KNUST) wɔ Ghana.  Ansa na MP no renya oduruyɛfo abodin krataa no, na ɔwɔ master’s degrees abien: Nyansahu mu master of Science wɔ Towtua mu wɔ Oxford Sukuupɔn, UK ne Master of Science abodin krataa foforo wɔ sikasɛm mu wɔ KNUST. Onyaa akontaabu ho abodin krataa a edi kan wɔ South Bank Sukuupɔn a ɛwɔ London no mu .

Dr. Forson yɛ Institute of Chartered Accountants,Ghana no muni na ɔyɛ Chartered Institute of Taxation no yɔnko .

Adwuma 
Dr. Forson yɛ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua, Sikasɛm ho Ɔbenfoɔ, Chartered Accountant, Toɔ ho adwumayɛfoɔ ne Adwumayɛfoɔ a ɔwɔ adwumayɛ mu suahunu a ɛboro mfeɛ aduonu wɔ ankorankoro ne ɔman nnwuma nyinaa mu. Na ɔyɛ Forson Contracts Limited a ɛwɔ United Kingdom no kwankyerɛfo panyin . Na ɔsan nso yɛɛ adwuma sɛ Omega Africa Holding Limited adwumayɛfo panyin.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Oduruyɛfo Forson yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua (NDC) no muni . Ɔyɛ NDC mmrahyɛbaguani ananmusifoɔ ma Ajumako-Enyan-Esiam mantam firi afe 2009. Mprempren ɔyɛ Minority Spokesperson a ɔhwɛ Sikasɛm so.

2008 abatow mu 
Wɔ afe 2008 mu no, ɔsii akan wɔ Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ mu na ɔdii nkonim. Ɔnyaa abatoɔ 18, 593 a ɛgyina hɔ ma abatoɔ a wɔtoo no nyinaa mu 51.66% na ɛno nti ɔdii akansifoɔ afoforɔ a William Kow Arthur-Baiden, Alex Arthur, Rexford Mensah ne Evans Addo-Nkum ka ho no so nkonim.

2012 abatow mu 
Wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti ase bio no, ɔsii akan wɔ afe 2012 Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ no mu na ɔdii nkonim denam abatoɔ 24,752 a ɔnyaeɛ a ɛyɛ 52.67% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu.

2016 abatoɔ 
Wɔ afe 2016 mu no, ɔsan sii akan wɔ afe 2016 Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ no mu na ɔsan dii nkonim bio maa no hokwan sɛ ɔgyina ne mansin ananmu wɔ afe a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa. Wɔ afe 2016 abatoɔ no mu no, ɔne Ransford Emmanuel Kwesi Nyarko, Jerry Henry Quansah, Sarah Mensah ne Monica Daapong sii akan. Ɔdii wɔn so nkonim denam abatoɔ 25,601 a ɔnyaeɛ a ɛyɛ 53.55% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu.

2020 abatoɔ 
Wɔ afe 2020 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu, ɔsan dii nkonim wɔ mmrahyɛbagua atenaeɛ no mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 39,229 a ɛyɛɛ 58.1% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu berɛ a NPP mmrahyɛbaguani Etuaful Rashid Kwesi nyaa abatoɔ 28,229 a ɛyɛɛ 41.8% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu na NDP mmrahyɛbagua kandifoɔ Samuel Akombisa nyaa abatoɔ 117 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 0.2%.

Ɔmanpanyin Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Sikasɛm so 
Wɔ afe 2009 mu no ɔbɛyɛɛ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua no muni na ɔyɛɛ sikasɛm soafoɔ abadiakyiri wɔ afe 2013.  Sɛ Ɔmanpanyin abadiakyiri no, ɔyɛɛ Ghana Sikasɛm Sohwɛ Kuw no muni. Ɔsan nso asom wɔ board ahodoɔ bi mu a Bank of Ghana ne Ghana Cocoa Board deɛ ka ho. Ɔsan nso yɛ Ghana Amrado a Ɔsesa wɔ Amanaman Ntam Sikakorabea (IMF) ne Wiase Sikakorabea . Wɔdaa ne nimdeɛ nso adi bere a na ɔyɛ Boayikuw a wɔde Ghana Integrated Financial Management Information System Reforms (GIFMIS) dii dwuma no guamtrani no.

Boayikuw ahorow 
Forson yɛ Sikasɛm Boayikuw no muni a ɔwɔ Dibea; ɔyɛ Aban Boayikuw no muni; ɔyɛ Amannɔne Nsɛm Boayikuw no muni na ɔsan yɛ Boayikuw a Wɔpaw Nnipa Boayikuw no muni.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Forson yɛ Kristoni. Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baanu.

Akyinnyegye 
Wɔkyerɛe sɛ Forson maa Ghana hweree sika wɔ ambulance 200 a ɔtɔɔ wɔ afe 2014 ne 2016 ntam no mu

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Gabriel Kodwo Essilfie
text:
Gabriel Kodwo Essilfie (wɔwoo no 10 Ɔbɛnem 1950) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nsia a ɛwɔ Ghana Aman a ɛtɔ so nnan no muni a ɔgyina Shama Mansin ananmu wɔ Atɔeɛ Mantam mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Essilfie yɛ Kristoni na ɔyɛ fekubɔ wɔ Methodist asɔre mu. Ɔwaree (ɔwɔ mma baanan).

Mfitiase asetra 
Wɔwoo Essilfie wɔ 10 Ɔbɛnem 1950. Ɔfiri Abuesi, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Atɔeɛ Mantam mu . Ɔkɔɔ Glassboro State College ( Rowan Sukuupɔn ), New Jersey, wɔ U.S., na onyaa akontaabu ho abodin krataa.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Essilfie yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua (NDC) no muni. Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔsii akan wɔ Shama nkongua no so wɔ NDC mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nsia a ɛwɔ republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no tekiti so na odii nkonim. Wɔ mmrahyɛbagua mu no wasom wɔ boayikuw ahorow mu, a Boayikuw no muni a ɔhwɛ Sikasɛm, Aduan, Kuadwuma ne Kokoo Nsɛm so ka ho

Adwuma 
Ɔyɛ akontaabufo.   Ɔno na ɔhyehyɛɛ Gabdor Consultants Inc. a ɛwɔ Pennsauken Township, New Jersey no na ɔyɛ ne panyin .

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Emmanuel Kwame Duut
text:
Emmanuel Kwame Duut (wɔwoo no 6 June 1959) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbagua a Ɛto so Anum a ɛwɔ Ghana Aman a Ɛto so Anan no muni a ɔgyina Bunkpurugu-Yungoo Mansin ananmu wɔ Ghana Atifi Mantam mu.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Duut wɔ 6 June 1959 wɔ Najong, wɔ Ghana Atifi Mantam mu . Ɔkɔɔ Nhomasua Sukuupɔn, Winneba (UEW) wɔ afe 2004 mu na onyaa Bachelor of Education (B.Ed. ).

Adwuma 
Na ɔyɛ Bunkpurugu-Yunyoo Senior High School Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo Boafo ne mmrahyɛbaguani ma Bunkpurugu-Yunyoo Mansin (2009-2013).

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔdii kan paw no sɛ ɔmmra mmrahyɛbagua no mu wɔ National Democratic Congress (NDC) tekiti so wɔ December 2008 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu sɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni ma Bunkpurugu-Yunyoo Mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Mantam mu. Wɔ afe 2008 abatoɔ no mu no, ɔnyaa abatoɔ 9,205 wɔ abatoɔ 32,078 a ɛfata a wɔtoo no mu a ɛgyina hɔ ma 28.7%.  Ɔsan sii akan wɔ afe 2012 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu na Solomon Namliit Boar a ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party no muni a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 10,829 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 38.85% dii no so nkonim.  Ɔdii mfeɛ baako pɛ sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani .

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baakron. Ɔyɛ Kristoni na ɔyɛ Katolek Asɔre no muni .

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Nii Nortey Duah
text:
Nii Nortey Duah (1 Ɔpɛpɔn 1953 - 21 Ɔpɛpɔn 2017) yɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo, dawurubɔfo ne nkitahodi ho ɔbenfo. Na ɔsan yɛ amanyɔni ne kan mmrahyɛbaguani ma Ledzokuku mantam a ɛwɔ Greater Accra Mantam mu wɔ Ghana .

Mfiase asetra ne adwuma 
Wɔwoo Duah afe 1953 na ɔfiri Teshie -Accra a ɛwɔ Greater Accra Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔsuaa adeɛ wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu baabi a ɔnyaa Master of Arts abodin krataa wɔ Communication adesua mu wɔ afe 1989 mu. Ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo wɔ Ghana Institute of Journalism .

Amanyɔsɛm 
Duah amammui adwuma hyɛɛ aseɛ wɔ afe 2004 mu berɛ a ɔsii akan maa Ledzokuku atenaeɛ no wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so nanso ɔhweree nkongua no maa Gladys Nortey Ashitey.  Ɔsan sii akan wɔ afe 2008 mu na odii nkonim, na ɔbɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbagua a Ɛto so Anum no muni wɔ Fourth Republic of Ghana. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ Ledzokuku nkongua no so wɔ NDC tekiti so a ne nyinaa yɛ 42,087 wɔ abatoɔ 73,989 a ɛfata a wɔtoo no mu, na ɔnyaa ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 56.9% wɔ 100% mu. Wɔ afe 2012 abatoɔ mu no, ɔhweree Ledzokuku nkongua no maa Benita Sena Okity-Duah .

Ankorankoro asetra 
Na Duah yɛ Kristoni a ɔne Presbyterian Asɔre a ɛwɔ Ghana som . Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baanan.

Owuo 
Owui wɔ 37 Military ayaresabea wɔ 21 December 2017.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Emmanuel Aboagye Didieye
text:
Emmanuel Aboagye Didieye (23 Ɔbɛnem 1976 – 14 Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 2017) yɛ aduruyɛ ho oduruyɛfo ne amanyɔni a ɔfiri Ghana man mu. Na ɔyɛ Ghana Republic of 4 no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 5 ne 6 no muni a ogyina Bomasarefo Mansin ananmu wɔ Ghana Apuei Fam Mantam mu.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo no wɔ 23 November 1976, na ɔte Bomasarefo.  Ɔnyaa abodin krataa wɔ India nwomasua asoɛeɛ a ɛhwehwɛ mfasoɔ National Institute of Information Technology wɔ afe 2004. Ɔsan nso nyaa Master in Public Administration Degree wɔ Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration wɔ afe 2011.

Amammu mu adwuma 
Na ɔyɛ Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua no muni . Wɔdii kan paw Didieye sɛ ɔmmra mmrahyɛbagua no mu wɔ afe 2008 Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ mu, sɛ Afram Plains North ananmusifoɔ .   Ɔdii nkonim wɔ sanba a wɔsan paw no wɔ afe 2012 mu, nanso ɔdii nkoguo wɔ party primary mu wɔ afe 2015 mu na Betty Nana Effua Krosby Mensah na ɔdii n’adeɛ.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Na waware na ɔwɔ abofra biako na na ɔyɛ Kristoni a ɔsom wɔ The True Faith Church.

Owuo 
Ɔhwee ase wɔ coma mu wɔ Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 2017 mu, na wɔde no kɔɔ Trust Ayaresabea a ɛwɔ Accra, faako a ɔwuiɛ wɔ Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 14, afe 2017, a na wadi mfeɛ 41.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Anthony Christian Dadzie
text:
Anthony Christian Dadzie (9 July 1962) yɛ Abura Asebu Kwamankese mmrahyɛbagua no muni wɔ Ghana Mfinimfini mantam mu firi afe 2009 kɔsi afe 2016.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Dadzie wɔ 9 Ɔpɛpɔn 1962 wɔ Amosima wɔ Central mantam mu. Ɔkɔɔ Cape Coast Suapɔn mu baabi a ɔnyaa diploma wɔ Adwumayɛ ho adesua mu wɔ afe 2006. Ɔkɔɔ so kɔɔ GIMPA baabi a na ɔwɔ EMPA wɔ afe 2011.

Adwuma 
Dadzie yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua no muni . Ɔbɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni wɔ afe 2009 mu. Na ɔyɛ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua no Akwahosan ne Atemmu boayikuw, Transport Committee ne Communications Committee no muni. Ɔsan nso som sɛ adwumakuo no muni ma Ɔman Boayikuo a ɛhwɛ nnwuma nketewa so (NBSSI) Ɔyɛ akontabufoɔ ne Sikasɛm sohwɛfoɔ.  Na ɔyɛ Akontaabu Boafo Panyin wɔ Cape Coast Quarry.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Dadzie dii kan bɛyɛɛ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua no muni wɔ afe 2009 mu. Nanso, wɔ afe 2016 mu no, ɔsii akan wɔ National Democratic Congress (NDC) mmrahyɛbagua abatoɔ mu na ɔdii nkoguo wɔ Samuel Kweku Hayford a saa berɛ no ɔgyinaa NDC ananmu wɔ afe 2016 amansan abatoɔ mu nanso ɔdii nkoguo nso wɔ New Patriotic Party ’s Elvis Morris Donkoh anim.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Dadzie yɛ Kristoni ( Katolekni ) na waware na ɔwɔ mma baanan.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Emmanuel Armah Kofi Buah
text:
Emmanuel Armah Kofi Buah (wɔwoo no afe 1966) yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɔni a wayɛ adwuma wɔ Ghana aban mu sɛ Ɔmanpanin a ɔhwɛ ahoɔden ne Petroleum so firi afe 2013. Buah a ɔyɛ National Democratic Congress no muni no yɛ Ellembelle mantam a ɛwɔ Atɔe Fam Mantam no mu mmrahyɛbagua no muni.

Nwomasua 
Emmanuel Armah Kofi Buah wɔ mmaranim abodin krataa wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma Sukuupɔn mu ne Nyansahu mu abodin krataa a ɛkorɔn wɔ Adwumayɛ mu wɔ Maryland Sukuupɔn, Sukuupɔn Kɔlege wɔ United States .

Amanyɔsɛm 
Kofi Buah na Ɔmampanyin Atta Mills paw no wɔ afe 2009 mu sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ Ɔmanpanyin abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Ahoɔden so.  Wɔ 17 Ɔbɛnem 2013 no, wɔpaw Buah sɛ Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ Ahoɔden ne Petroleum so.  Ɔno na Hon. Boakye Agyarko wɔ afe 2017 mu bere a New Patriotic Party dii nkonim wɔ afe 2016 Ɔmanpanyin abatow mu no.  Ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma Ellembelle Mantam no firi afe 2009. Ɔsom wɔ Aguadi, Nnwuma ne Nsrahwɛ boayikuw, Members Holding Offices of Profit boayikuw, Privileges boayikuw ne Committee off Selection boayikuw no mu.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Buah wɔ mma mmienu.

Hwɛ nso 
Mahama aban asomfo din

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Jabaah John Bennam
text:
Jabaah John Bennam (wɔwoo no afe 1965) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni a ɔyɛɛ mmrahyɛbaguani maa Zabzugu-Tatale Mantam no firi 7 Ɔbɛnem 2009 kɔsi 6 Ɔbɛnem 2017.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Bennam wɔ 4 May 1965. Ɔfiri Kuntumbiyile kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Mantam mu .
