Ɔnyaa ne diploma wɔ mfitiaseɛ nwomasua mu wɔ University of Education, Winneba, ne ne Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) abodin krataa ne master’s degree wɔ Project Management mu wɔ University of Phoenix, Phoenix, Arizona, United States wɔ afe 2009 ne 2012 mu.

Adwuma 
Bennam yɛ Ghana Co-operative Market sohwɛfoɔ Abadiakyiri firi afe 1990 kɔsi afe 1993. Efi 1993 kosi 2001 no ɔbɛyɛɛ n’ankasa adwuma sɛ obiakofo a ɔyɛ adwuma.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Bennam yɛɛ Ɔsomfoɔ Abadiakyiri firi afe 2001 kɔsi afe 2005. Ɔkɔɔ mmrahyɛbagua mu wɔ 7 Ɔbɛnem 2013 wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so sɛ obegyina Zabzugu-Tatale Mansin ananmu . Ɔsom wɔ saa dibea no mu mfe abien a ɛtoatoa so. Wɔ afe 2016 mu no, ɔhweree nkongua no maa Alhassan Umar a ɔwɔ National Democratic Congress .

Ankorankoro asetra 
Bennam aware na ɔwɔ mma baason. Ɔda ne ho adi sɛ ɔyɛ Kristoni.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: John Duoghr Baloroo
text:
John Duoghr Baloroo (wɔwoo no 17 Ɔbɛnem 1956)  yɛ Ghana amanyɔni na ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanin a ɛtɔ so nnan mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nnum no muni. Ɔgyinaa Lambuissie mantam a ɛwɔ Upper West Region of Ghana ananmu .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Baloroo wɔ 17 December 1956. Ɔyɛ Lambussie kuromni wɔ Upper West Region wɔ Ghana . Ɔsuaa adeɛ wɔ City and Guilds wɔ afe 1984.

Adwuma ne amammusɛm 
Ɔyɛ aguadifo ne n’adwumakuw John Duoghr Construction no kwankyerɛfo panyin. Wɔdii kan paw no sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ mmrahyɛbagua wɔ afe 2008 Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ mu wɔ New Patriotic Party tekiti so .  Ɔdii nkonim a ne nyinaa yɛ 6,513 a egyina hɔ ma 55.4% wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoo no nyinaa mu a ɛyɛ 11,755. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ Alice Teni Boon a ɔdii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ 4,716, Amoah T. Basing a ɔdii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ 261, Baloroo Balisosie David a ɔdii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ 124, Bele-Irs Vitus a ɔno nso dii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ 141 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 40.1%, 2.2%, 1.1%, 1.2% .

Ɔdii Alice Teni Boon a ɔfiri Ɔman Democratic Congress no ananmu na Edward Kaale-Ewola Dery a ɔfiri National Democratic Congress mu dii n’anim .

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baasa na ɔyɛ Katolekni .

Hwɛ nso 
Lambussie Mantam (Ghana mmrahyɛbagua mantam).

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Fritz Baffour
text:
Fredric Fritz Baffour (wɔwoo no 11 Oforisuo 1952) yɛ Ghana nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo, amanyɔni ne nkitahodiɛ ho ɔfotufo. Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni a ɔhwɛ Ablekuma South mantam so wɔ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua no mu ne Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ Amanneɛbɔ so wɔ Mills nniso no mu.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Baffour wɔ 11 March 1952 wɔ Korle Gonno wɔ Accra, Ghana ahenkuro mu. Na ne papa yɛ R. P. Baffour a ɔyɛ adesua ho ɔbenfo ne Ghana mfiridwumayɛfo a wodii kan no mu biako ne saa ara nso na na ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanyin Abadiakyiri a odi kan wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Sukuupɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma So no mu . Na ne maame yɛ awogyefo. Ne ntoaso sukuu wɔ Prempeh College ne Technology Secondary School, abien no nyinaa wɔ Kumasi wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔnyaa ne GCE Ordinary Level adansedie krataa wɔ afe 1968 mu. Ne adesua a ɛto so asia no wɔ City of Bath College a ɛwɔ Somerset wɔ United Kingdom wɔ 1972 ne 1974 ntam hɔ, na ɔde GCE Advanced Level adansedi krataa wiei. Baffour nso kɔɔ Bristol Polytechnic wɔ 1974 ne 1976 ntam hɔ. Fritz Baffour yɛɛ master’s degree wɔ Nkitahodi Adesua mu wɔ Leicester Sukuupɔn mu wɔ afe 2007 ne 2012 ntam hɔ.

Adwuma 
Baffour yɛɛ adwuma sɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo. Na ɔyɛ ɔyɛkyerɛfo wɔ Ghana Television, TV dwumadibea a ɛwɔ ɔman no dea Ghana Broadcasting Corporation mu sɛ ɔyɛkyerɛfo ne ɔkwankyerɛfo. Ɔsan nso ne Liberia Television, Nigeria Television, Tyne Tees TV UK, Diverse Production wɔ UK ne Back to Back Productions USA ayɛ adwuma. Na ɔyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo fotufo nso ma Jerry Rawlings aban.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Baffour de ne ho hyɛɛ National Democratic Congress no mu fi bere a wɔhyehyɛɛ no wɔ 1991 mu. Ɔbɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbaguani wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2009 mu bere a odii nkonim wɔ Ablekuma Anafo fam agua so wɔ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua abatow mu wɔ afe 2008 mu no. Ɔmampanyin John Atta Mills na ɔpaw no sɛ Ɔsomfoɔ a ɔhwɛ nsɛm so wɔ afe 2012.

Hwɛ nso 

 Mills aban asomfo din a wɔahyehyɛ
 Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua
 Ablekuma South mantam mu

title: Seth Adjei Baah
text:
Seth Adjei Baah (wɔwoo no May 18, 1960) yɛ aguadifo ne ɔmanyɔni. Na ɔyɛ kan mmrahyɛbagua no muni ma Nkawkaw mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Apuei fam mantam mu .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Baah wɔ afe 1960 mu. Ɔfiri Kwahu-Asakraka a ɛwɔ Ghana Apueeɛ mantam mu. Osuaa ade wɔ Trinity College and University, Madrid, Spain baabi a onyaa Bachelor of Arts abodin krataa .

Ankorankoro asetra ne adwuma 
Baah yɛ Kristoni na waware na ɔwɔ mma baanan. Ɔne Pentekoste Asɔre no som .  Ɔyɛ aguadifoɔ ne Shaaba Enterprises Limited kwankyerɛfoɔ panin. Efi Ɔpɛpɔn 2011 kɔsi Ɔpɛpɔn 2016 na ɔyɛ Ghana Aguadi ne Nnwuma Kuo no titrani.  Ɔsan yɛ Pan African Chamber of Commerce and Industry (PACCI) no titrani .

Amanyɔsɛm 
Baah amammui adwuma fii ase afe 2008 bere a ɔbɛyɛɛ Ghana Aman a Ɛto so Anan no mmrahyɛbagua a Ɛto so Anum no muni maa Nkwakwa mantam no sɛ ɔmannifo a ɔde ne ho. Ɔdii nkoguo wɔ New Patriotic Party mmrahyɛbagua primaries mu wɔ afe 2008 mu wɔ Nkawkaw mantam mu na ɛno nti, ɔsii gyinaeɛ sɛ ɔbɛgyina hɔ sɛ obi a ɔde ne ho na ɔdii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ no mu.  Ɔdii nkonim wɔ atenaeɛ no mu a ne nyinaa yɛ 21, 640 wɔ abatoɔ 40, 004 a ɛfata a wɔtoo no mu a ɛyɛɛ 54.1%.  Ɔhwere n’akongua wɔ afe 2012 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu maa New Patriotic Party’s Eastern Regional sikakorafoɔ, Eric Kwakye Daffour. Ɛno akyi no onu ne ho sɛ ɔkɔɔ Amanyɔsɛm mu.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Alhassan Azong
text:
Alhassan Azong (wɔwoo no 18 December 1965) yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɔni ne mmrahyɛbagua no muni (MP) ma Builsa South amansin wɔ Ghana . Ɔsan nso yɛ ɔman soafoɔ wɔ Mills aban mu wɔ afe 2009 ne afe 2013 ntam.

Mfitiase asetra 
Wɔwoo Azong wɔ December 18, 1965 mu. Ɔfiri Wiesi a ɛwɔ Upper East Region wɔ Ghana. Ɔnyaa ACIS wɔ afe 1996 mu. Ɔsan nso kɔɔ Paris Graduate School of Management baabi a onyaa MBA . Akyiri yi ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo wɔ Bolgatanga Polytechnic, dibea a odii mu kosii sɛ ɔkɔɔ amammuisɛm mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Azong dii kan sii akan wɔ Builsa South nkongua no mu wɔ December 2008 mu wɔ tekiti a ɛwɔ People’s National Convention, na odii nkonim wɔ abatow ketewaa a ɛyɛ 59 (0.5%) mu. Ɔsomm wɔ Boayikuo a ɛhwɛ Asɔremma a Wɔkura Mfasoɔ Dwumadibea, Nhomasua Mmabun, Agumadi ne Amammerɛ Boayikuo ne Daa Ahyɛdeɛ Boayikuo no mu.  Wɔ abatoɔ a ɛdi hɔ wɔ December 2012 mu no, ne dodoɔ no kɔɔ soro koduu 6,048 (47.12).  Enti ɔbɛyɛɛ PNC MP koro pɛ wɔ Fourth Republic of Ghana mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 6 no mu.

Ɛwom sɛ na ɔnyɛ NDC muni deɛ, nanso ɔmampanyin Mills paw Azong sɛ ɔman Ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Ɔmanfoɔ Nnwuma mu Nsakraeɛ so wɔ NDC aban mu firi afe 2009 kɔsi afe 2013. Wɔ afe 2013 mu no, Ɔmampanyin Mahama san paw no sɛ Ɔman Minista a ɔhwɛ Ɔmanfoɔ Nnwuma mu Nsakraeɛ so, adwuma korɔ no ara a na ɔwɔ wɔ Mills aban ase.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Azong yɛ Nkramofo. Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baanum.

Adwumafa 
Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo, Bolgatanga Polytechnic

Hwɛ nso 

 Mills aban asomfo din a wɔahyehyɛ
 Mahama aban asomfo din

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Timothy Ataboadey Awotiirim
text:
Timothy Ataboadey Awotiirim (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn 1, 1970) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne nwomasua ho nimdefo. Ɔsan nso yɛɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni maa Builsa North mantam a ɛwɔ Upper East Region wɔ Ghana.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Awotiirim wɔ July 1, 1970, wɔ Wiaga, Upper East Region. Ɔnyaa Bachelor of Arts abodin krataa wɔ Geography ne Resource Development mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu wɔ afe 2000.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Awotiirim yɛ Ghana Aman a ɛtɔ so nnan mmrahyɛbagua no muni a wɔpaw no wɔ National Democratic Congress (NDC) tekiti so wɔ December 2008 Ghana amansan abatow mu sɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni ma Builsa Atifi (Ghana mmrahyɛbagua mantam) Odii Agnes A. Chigabatia a ofi New Patriotic Party (NPP) ne afoforo baanu so nkonim ma odii nkonim wɔ Builsa North mmrahyɛbagua no mu. MP a ɔdii dwuma afe baako no nyaa abatoɔ 8,259 wɔ abatoɔ 19,165 a ɛfata a wɔtoo no mu = 43.1%. James Agalga dii no so nkonim wɔ afe 2012 mu de faa Builsa North mmrahyɛbagua no. Wɔ General News a ɛbaa 8 December 2017 so no ɔkaa sɛ "Nnipa a wɔasua nhoma di aporɔw sen wɔn a wonnim akenkan ne akyerɛw".

Adwuma 
Ansa na wɔrepaw no sɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni no, Ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ Nhwehwɛmufo wɔ Commission on Human Rights and Administrative Justice (CHRAJ) fi 1994 kosi 2004. Ɔsan nso yɛɛ adwuma sɛ Christ the King JSS, Chiana kyerɛkyerɛfo.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Awotiirim yɛ Katolek Kristoni. Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baanu.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Kwesi Amoako Atta
text:
Kwasi Amoako-Attah  (wɔwoo no 5 Ɔbɛnem 1951) yɛ Ghana mmaranimfo, adwumayɛ ho ɔfotufo ne amanyɔni. Ɔyɛ Atiwa Atɔeɛ mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Apueeɛ Mantam mu no mmrahyɛbagua no muni. Ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party no muni na, ɛfiri afe 2017 no. Mprempren ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ akwan ne akwan akɛse so.

Kwasi Amoako-Attah  (wɔwoo no 5 Ɔbɛnem 1951) yɛ Ghana mmaranimfo, adwumayɛ ho ɔfotufo ne amanyɔni. Ɔyɛ Atiwa Atɔeɛ mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Apueeɛ Mantam mu no mmrahyɛbagua no muni. Ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party no muni na, ɛfiri afe 2017 no. Mprempren ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ akwan ne akwan akɛse so.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Kwesi Amoako Atta wɔ 5 Ɔbɛnem 1951 wɔ Akyem-Awenare wɔ Ghana Apuei Fam. Ɔkɔɔ Abuakwa State College baabi a ɔnyaa ne GCE Ordinary Level adansedie krataa na ɔtoaa so kɔɔ Tarkwa Senior High School maa ne GCE Advanced Level adansedie krataa. Ɔnyaa Bachelor of Science abodin krataa wɔ Administration mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn Legon . Afei ɔkɔɔ Ghana School of Law, Makola na wɔfrɛɛ no kɔɔ Ghana Bar wɔ afe 2002.  Ɔnyaa Executive Master of Business Administration wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu.

Adwumayɛ asetra 
Bere a Atta wiee Ghana Sukuupɔn no, wɔde no yɛɛ adwuma fi afe 1979 kosi afe 1985 wɔ Nam aguadi Bagua a mprempren enni hɔ bio no mu sɛ ɔmantam sohwɛfo. Afei ɔde ne ho kɔbɔɔ Unilever Ghana, baabi a wodii kan yɛɛ no brands manager afei ɔpanyin a ɔhwɛ logistics ne marketing so.  Bere a wɔfrɛɛ no kɔɔ Ghana Bar no, ɔde ne ho kɔbɔɔ mmara dwumadibea, na ɔforo kɔɔ Vlisco Ghana Kuw no Kuw Mmara ho Ɔfotufo. Ogyaee adwumakuw no wɔ afe 2010 mu kɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ amammuisɛm mu.

Amammu asetra 
Atta hyɛnee Ghana amammuisɛm mu wɔ afe 2010 mu bere a ɔne Atiwa Atɔe fam nkongua no sii akan. Wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔpaw wɔn foforo baasa, a wɔne Emmanuel Atta Twum a ofi National Democratic Congress, George Padmore Apreku a ofi New Vision Party, ne Kasum Abdul-Karim a ofi People’s National Convention nso sii akan wɔ afe 2010 mu abatow foforo a wɔyɛe wɔ Atiwa a wɔyɛe wɔ 31 August 2010. Atta dii nkonim wɔ abatow no mu denam abatow 20,282 a onyae wɔ 27,540 a wɔtow no mu, a egyina hɔ ma abatow a ɛfata nyinaa mu ɔha biara mu nkyem 75.0 so.

Wɔkaa no ntam sɛ ɔbɛkɔ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua no mu wɔ 19 Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 2010 a Joyce Bamford-Addo. Ɔkɔɔ so dii nkonim wɔ Atiwa amansin abatoɔ mmienu a ɛdi hɔ no mu wɔ afe 2012 mmrahyɛbagua abatoɔ ne afe 2016 mmrahyɛbagua abatoɔ mu .

Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ akwan ne akwan akɛse so 
Wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2017 mu no, Ɔmanpanyin Nana Akuffo-Addo yii Atta sɛ ɔnyɛ Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ akwan ne akwan akɛseɛ so wɔ Ghana. Wɔde adwuma hyɛɛ Atta nsa sɛ ɔntu mpɔn wɔ nkuropɔn ne feeder akwan a ɛwɔ ɔman no mu, titiriw nea ɛwɔ Ghana kuayɛ belt. Eyi bɛma ɔman no aduan a wobenya no atu mpɔn.

mmrahyɛbagua no mu nhwehwɛmu 
mmrahyɛbagua no Appointments Committee no hyiaa Atta wɔ 2 Ɔpɛpɔn 2017 na wɔhwehwɛɛ ne anisoadehunu a ɛfa ɔsom adwuma no ho. Ɔkaa n’anisoadehu a ɛne sɛ wɔbɛma mmeae a wotua tow wɔ ɔman no mu nyinaa ayɛ adwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ adwuma so no kyerɛɛ boayikuw no. Ɔkae sɛ ansa na wɔbɛyɛ adwuma a wɔde yɛ adwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ adwuma so no, ɔno ankasa bɛhwɛ sɛnea wɔbɛfa nnipa a wɔadi dɛm sɛ wɔn a wogye tow wɔ mmeae ahorow a wotua tow wɔ ɔman no mu nyinaa no so. Saa nhyehyɛe yi bɛma wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔn a wogye towtua nyinaa mu ɔha biara mu nkyem 50 bɛyɛ nnipa a wɔadi dɛm.  Sɛnea Atta kyerɛ no, eyi bɛtew ɔman no sikasɛm mu adesoa a ɛwɔ nnipa a wɔadi dɛm a wɔbɛhwɛ wɔn so no so.

Akuffo-Addo kaa ntam sɛ asomfoɔ a mmrahyɛbagua no apene wɔn so no nyinaa bɛba wɔ 10 Ɔpɛpɔn 2017.  Na Atta ka asomfo afoforo du a wonyaa wɔn asomfo nkrataa a wɔde befi adwuma ase wɔ wɔn som adwuma ahorow mu no ho.

Asomfo dwumadi ahorow 
Wɔ July 2017 mu no ɔde Persons with Disability Road Toll Initiative sii hɔ. Kuw a edi kan a emufo yɛ 80 a wɔadi dɛm no wiee ntetee nhyehyɛe no na wɔmaa wɔn adan a wotua ho ka sɛnea ɛsɛ sɛ wɔnyɛ adwuma wɔ mu  Atta san sii nokwasɛm a ɛyɛ sɛ wɔbɛma nnipa a wɔadi dɛm a wɔn dodow yɛ 200 adwuma wɔ nhyehyɛe no ase no so dua. Mprempren ɔyɛ Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ Akwan ne Akwan akɛse so.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Atta aware a ɔwɔ mma baanan. Ɔyɛ Presbyterian Asɔre a ɛwɔ Ghana no muni.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Puozaa Mathias Asuma
text:
Puozaa Mathias Asuma yɛ Ghana amanyɔni na ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanin a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 6 no muni  a ɔgyina Daffiama/Bussie/Issa mantam a ɛwɔ Upper West Region of Ghana ananmu.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Asuma wɔ 10 Ɔbɛnem 1948. Ɔyɛ Touri-Daffiama, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Upper West Region wɔ Ghana no mu nipa. Ɔyɛ obi a wawie sukuu wɔ Edinburgh Sukuupɔn, Scotland baabi a onyaa ne Master of Science abodin krataa wɔ Mpɔtam Nhomasua mu.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Asuma aware a ɔwɔ mma baanum. Ɔyɛ Katolekni Kristoni.

Adwuma ne amammuisɛm 
Puozaa yɛ nhomasua ho ɔbenfo. Ɔhyɛɛ n’adwuma ase sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ wɔ Ghana Suapɔn a agye din Legon, Accra ansa na ɔrebɛyɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni. Wɔdii kan paw no sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ adwuma wɔ afe 2004 Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ no mu na ɔbɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2005 mu de National Democratic Congress tekiti . Ɔnyaa mmirikatuo mpɛn 3 wɔ n’adwuma mu wɔ ɛno akyi na ɔgyaee n’adwuma wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2017. Bere a na ɔwɔ mmrahyɛbagua mu no, na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbagua no Boayikuw a Wɔapaw a Ɛhwɛ Nhomasua So no Titenani.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Nii Armah Ashitey
text:
Nii Armah Ashitey yɛ Ghana mmaranimni ne ɔmanyɔni . Ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni ma Korle Klottey na ɔsan nso yɛ kan ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ adwumayɛ ne adwumayɛfo telations so wɔ Ghana aban mu .

Adwuma 
Ashietey suaa adeɛ wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so wɔ Kumasi, Ashanti Mantam ahenkuro wɔ Ghana. Owiee sukuu wɔ 1975 mu na onyaa Bachelor of Arts abodin krataa wɔ asetra ho nyansahu mu . Akyiri yi ɔbɛyɛɛ mmaranimfo wɔ afe 1986 mu bere a osuaa ade wɔ Ghana Mmara Sukuu mu akyi no . Ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ Ocerec Company Limited a ɛwɔ Accra no panyin ansa na ɔrekɔ amammuisɛm mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ashitey yɛ adwumayɛfo panyin wɔ Tema Metropolitan Area fi 1993 kosi 2001. Ɔde ne ho bɔɔ National Democratic Congress na ɔgyinaa wɔn tekiti so wɔ Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu wɔ December 2004 mu, na ɔdii nkoguo ketewaa bi wɔ New Patriotic Party kandifoɔ Nii Adu Daku Mante anim. Mfeɛ nnan akyi no, ɔsan gyinaa nkongua korɔ no ara so, na ɔdii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ 50.6% ne dodoɔ no ara 2,622 (4.3%).

Wɔ afe 2009 mu no, Ɔmampanyin Mills paw no sɛ ɔmantam soafo ma Greater Accra Mantam no . Ɔkɔɔ so traa saa dibea yi mu wɔ Mills wu akyi. Bere a John Dramani Mahama dii nkonim wɔ Ghana amansan abatow mu wɔ December 2012 mu no, wɔpaw no sɛ ɔsomfo foforo a ɔhwɛ adwumayɛ ne adwumayɛfo ntam abusuabɔ so.

Hwɛ nso 
Korle Klottey

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Kofi Asare
text:
Na Kofi Asare yɛ Ghana aduruyɛ ho oduruyɛfo ne ɔmanyɔni. Na ɔyɛ Ghana Akwahosan Dwumadibea a ɛwɔ Central Region, Cape Coast . Ɔsan nso yɛɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni maa Akwatia mantam a ɛwɔ Apuei Fam Mantam no mu .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Asare wɔ December 12, 1954, wɔ Akyem-Wenchi wɔ Apuei Fam Mantam mu . Ɔnyaa Master of Science abodin krataa wɔ Ɔmanfoɔ Akwahosan mu wɔ London Suapɔn mu wɔ afe 1993.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Asare yɛ Fourth Republic of Ghana mmrahyɛbagua a Ɛto so Anum no muni . Ɔde New Patriotic Party (NPP) tekiti tuu mmirika wɔ afe 2008 amansan abatoɔ no mu no, Asare dii Ahmed Mohammed Baba-Jamal a ɔfiri National Democratic Congress ne afoforo mmiɛnsa so nkonim ma ɔdii nkonim wɔ Akwatia mmrahyɛbagua no mu. mmrahyɛbaguani a ɔdii dwuma afe baako no nyaa abatoɔ 17,900 de dii Owura Baba-Jamal a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 15,860 wɔ abatoɔ no mu no so nkonim.  Asare hweree atenaeɛ no mfeɛ nnan akyi wɔ afe 2012 Ghana Amansan abatoɔ no mu wɔ Owura Baba Jamal anim wɔ berɛ a Madam Mercy Adu-Gyamfi dii no nkoguo wɔ NPP primaries mu.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Na Asare yɛ Presbyteriani, na na waware na ɔwɔ mma baanan.

Owuo 
Ɔwui wɔ kar akwanhyia mu wɔ Nkawkaw - Accra kwan kɛseɛ so wɔ 21 Ɔpɛpɔn 2017 a na wadi mfeɛ 62.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Joses Asare-Akoto
text:
Joses Asare-Akoto (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn 25, 1950) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani wɔ mmrahyɛbagua a Ɛto so Anum a ɛwɔ Ghana Aman a Ɛto so Anan no mu. Ɔgyinaa Asuogyaman Mantam a ɛwɔ Apueeɛ Mantam no ananmu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Asare-Akoto fi Akwamufie, kurow bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Apuei Fam Mantam mu . Ɔkɔɔ City and Guilds College wɔ afe 1973.

Adwuma 
Na Asare-Akoto yɛ Ɔsɔfo wɔ Church of Philadelphia International. Sɛ yɛde amammuisɛm to nkyɛn a, ɔyɛ Reverend Minister wɔ n’adwuma mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Asare-Akoto yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua (NDC) no muni. Ɔde NDC tekiti sii akan wɔ Asuogyaman mansin no mu wɔ afe 2008 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu na ɔdii nkonim.   Wɔde abatoɔ 16,608 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata 32,372 a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu, a ɛne abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 51.3% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Kofi Osei-Ameyaw a ofi Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no mu, Slanzy Atsu Wornah a ofi Ɔmanfo Ɔman Nhyiam no mu ne Agnes Deprah Ayensu a ofi Nhyiam Nnipa Kuw no mu . Eyinom nyaa abatow a ɛfata nyinaa mu 47.80%, 0.33% ne 0.57%.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ɔkyerɛ sɛ ɔyɛ Kristoni (Church of Philadelphia International) na waware na ɔwɔ mma baanum.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Francis Kojo Arthur
text:
Francis Kojo Arthur (wɔwoo no 22 Ɔbɛnem 1954) yɛ obi a na ɔyɛ Ghana Mantam a Ɛto so Anan mmrahyɛbagua a Ɛto so Nsia no muni, na ogyina Gomoa Atɔe Fam Mansin ananmu wɔ Ghana Mfinimfini mantam mu .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Arthur wɔ 22 Ɔbɛnem 1954 wɔ Gomoa Abasa Number 2 wɔ Central region of Ghana.

Ɔkɔɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so wɔ hɔ a onyaa abodin krataa a ɛkorɔn wɔ Mmoa Awo mu wɔ afe 2000.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Arthur aware na ɔwɔ mma du. Ɔkyerɛ sɛ ɔyɛ Kristoni ( Katolekni ).

Adwuma 
Ansa na Arthur rebɛyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani no, na ɔyɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo wɔ Anglican Senior High School a ɛwɔ Kumasi .

Amanyɔsɛm 
Arthur yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua no muni . Wɔ afe 2009 mu no, ɔdii Joe Kingsley Hackman ananmu sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani maa Gomoa West wɔ berɛ a ɔsii akan na ɔdii nkonim wɔ atenaeɛ no mu wɔ afe 2008 Ghana abatoɔ no mu. Wɔ abatoɔ no mu no ɔnyaa abatoɔ 15,985 a ɛgyina hɔ ma abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 47.47% na ɛno nti ɔdii akansifoɔ afoforɔ no so nkonim.  Ɔsan sii akan wɔ afe 2012 Ghana Abatoɔ mu na ɔdii nkonim maa no hokwan sɛ ɔgyina ne mansin ananmu wɔ afe 2012 mu. Wɔ afe 2012 abatoɔ mu no, ɔnyaa abatoɔ 27,624 a ɛyɛ 56.67% wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu.

Nanso, afe 2016 mu no, wantumi annsi akan wɔ afe 2016 Ghana abatoɔ no mu ɛfiri sɛ ɔdii nkoguo wɔ National Democratic Congress (NDC) mmrahyɛbagua abatoɔ no mu. Enti nkonimdifoɔ, Samuel Fletcher, gyinaa NDC ananmu wɔ afe 2016 Ghana abatoɔ no mu.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Ernest Attuquaye Armah
text:
Ernest Attuquaye Armah (wɔwoo no 27 Ɔbɛnem 1957) yɛ Nkɔso Nhyehyɛeɛ, Ɔdansini ne Dodow Nhwehwɛmufo. Na ɔsan yɛ amanyɔni ne kan mmrahyɛbaguani ma Trobu-Amasaman mantam a ɛwɔ Greater Accra mantam mu wɔ Ghana .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Armah afe 1957 na ɔfiri Afuaman (Manhean Electoral Area) a ɛwɔ Greater Accra Region wɔ Ghana. Ɔnyaa Master of Science abodin krataa wɔ Architecture mu wɔ Kiev Civil Engineering Institute a ɛwɔ Ukraine wɔ afe 1988.

Ankorankoro asetra ne adwuma 
Armah yɛ Kristoni a ɔne Pentekoste Asɔre no som . Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baanan. Ɔyɛ adwuma sɛ Engineer Panyin wɔ Ga District Assembly.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔpaw Armah sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma Ga South mantam no wɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 3 wɔ ɔman a ɛto so 4 no mu wɔ afe 2000 Ghana amansan abatow no mu . Wɔpaw no wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so. Na ne mansin no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 6 no fã wɔ nkongua 22 a National Democratic Congress dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Greater Accra Mantam no mu.

National Democratic Congress dii nkonim kakraa bi a ne nyinaa yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 92 wɔ nkongua 200 a ɛwɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa a ɛwɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu.  Wɔde abatow 41,745 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 78,849 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 53.8% yɛ pɛ.

Wɔpaw no sen Samuel Nii-Aryeetey Attoh a ofi New Patriotic Party, Thelma Lantwei Lamptey a ofi Convention People’s Party, Abraham Lartey Joe a ofi National Reform Party, Daniel Addoquaye Pappoe a ofi People’s National Convention ne Edward Osei Bonsu a ofi United Ghana Movement . Eyinom nyaa abatow 30,425, 2,510, 1,556, 1,035 ne 335 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 39.2%, 3.2%, 2.0%, 1.3 ne 0.4% yɛ pɛ.

Nanso, wɔ afe 2004 abatoɔ no mu, berɛ a wɔguu Ga South mantam no akyi no, Armah gyinaa National Democratic Congress ananmu wɔ Amasaman mantam mu nanso ɔdii nkoguo wɔ Samuel Nii-Aryeetey Attoh anim .

Afe 2008 mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbagua a Ɛto so Anum a ɛwɔ Ghana Aman a Ɛto so Anan no muni . Ɔdii nkonim wɔ Trobu-Amasaman mantam mu wɔ afe 2008 mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ atenaeɛ no mu a ne nyinaa yɛ 34,797 wɔ abatoɔ 71,093 a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ no mu, na ɔnyaa 48.9% wɔ 100% mu. Wɔ afe 2012 abatoɔ mu no, wɔkyekyɛɛ ne mansin mu mmienu, seesei ɛyɛ Trobu mantam ne Amasaman mantam.  Nanso, wannya nkongua biara wɔ amansin abien yi mu.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Justice Joe Appiah
text:
Ɔtemmufo Joe Appiah (wɔwoo no December 21, 1959) yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɔni. Na ɔyɛ Ghana Mantam a Ɛto so Anan no mmrahyɛbagua a Ɛto so Nsia no muni a ogyina Ablekuma Atifi Fam Mantam no ananmu wɔ Greater Accra Mantam mu wɔ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no tekiti so .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Appiah wɔ December 21, 1959 mu. Ɔfiri Akim Oda, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Apueeɛ Mantam mu . Ɔnyaa Diploma wɔ Network Engineering mu, Net Africa Ghana wɔ afe 2007 mu. Ɔsan nso yɛ obi a wawie Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration na onyaa ne Certificate wɔ Administration and Management mu wɔ afe 2008.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Appiah yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo (NPP) no muni. Ɔbɛyɛɛ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 5 no muni bere a ɔdaa ne ho adi sɛ nkonimdifo wɔ afe 2008 Ghana Amansan Abatow a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ ne mansin mu no. Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔsii akan sɛ wɔbɛsan apaw no bio akɔ Ablekuma North mmrahyɛbagua adwumayɛbea no wɔ NPP mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nsia a ɛwɔ ɔman a ɛtɔ so nnan no tekiti so na odii nkonim.  Wɔ afe 2015 mmrahyɛbagua primaries mu no, ɔdii nkogu wɔ Hon. Nana Akua Owusu Afriyie, a ɔkɔɔ Ablekuma Atifi fam (2017-2021) MP .

Ankorankoro asetra 
Appiah yɛ Kristoni a ɔyɛ fekubɔ wɔ Assemblies of God Asɔre no mu. Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baanum.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Joseph Samuel Annan
text:
Joseph Annan (wɔwoo no Ɔbɛnem 18, afe 1953) yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɔni. Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni a ogyinaa Komenda/Edina/Eguafo/Abrem mantam ananmu wɔ Ghana man a ɛto so 4 no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 5 no mu .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Annan wɔ 18 December 1953 wɔ Komenda wɔ Central Region of Ghana . Ɔnyaa ne mfitiaseɛ nwomasua wɔ Ridge Asɔre Sukuu a ɛwɔ Accra no mu. Bere a onyaa ne GCE A ne O levels adansedi nkrataa akyi no osuaa Sociology, Psychology, statistics ne Zoology wɔ Chelsea College . Ɔbɛyɛɛ oduruyɛfo a ɔyɛ nsensan ho oprehyɛn bere a osuaa nsensan ho oprehyɛn wɔ Royal London Ayaresabea Aduruyɛ Sukuupɔn mu wɔ 1977 mu akyi. Ɔsan nso suaa Nyansahu mu Ɔbenfo wɔ sikasɛm, Akwahosan Nhyehyɛe ne Sikasɛm mu wɔ London Sukuu a Ɛhwɛ Sikasɛm So ne London Sukuu a Ɛhwɛ Ahotew ne Aduruyɛ a Ɛhwɛ Ɔhyew So .

Adwuma 
Annan yɛɛ adwuma sɛ oduruyɛfo a ɔyɛ anom oprehyɛn fi 1978 kosi 1982 na ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ oduruyɛfo a ɔyɛ nsensan ho oprehyɛn fi 1982 kosi 1988. Efi 1988 kosi 1992 no ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ aban sẽ ho ɔpanyin ne anim oprehyɛn ho ɔbenfo wɔ Akwahosan Dwumadibea a ɛwɔ Zimbabwe. Efi afe 1994 kosi afe 2002 no ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ JSA Consultants Int. wɔ Ghana mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Annan gyinaa Komenda/Edina/Eguafo/Abrem mantam ananmu sɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni wɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 5 no mu. Eyi yɛ bere a wɔpaw no wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so wɔ afe 2008 amansan abatow a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Ghana no akyi. Ɔnyaa abatoɔ a ɛfata nyinaa mu 48.83%. Stephen Nana Ato Arthur a ofi New Patriotic Party ne Joachim Bruku Eshun a ofi Convention People’s Party no dii nkogu denam abatow a wɔtow nyinaa mu 41.41% ne 9.76% a wonyae no so.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Annan aware a ɔwɔ mma baasa. Ɔyɛ Kristoni (Methodistni).

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Kwasi Annoh Ankama
text:
Kwasi Annoh Ankama (1 Ɔbɛnem 1957 – 1 Ɔpɛpɔn 2010) yɛ Ghana mmaranimni ne amanyɔni. Na ɔyɛ Atiwa mantam no mmrahyɛbagua no muni na na ɔyɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni . Owui bere a na ɔwɔ dibea wɔ aban ananmusifo bi a wɔkɔɔ London mu no. Kwesi Amoako Atta na odii n'ade sɛ MP .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Kwasi Ankama wɔ Abomosu wɔ Ghana Apuei Fam. Ɔnyaa Bachelor of Arts abodin krataa wɔ Mmara ne Amanyɔsɛm mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn, Legon, wɔ afe 1984 mu. Afei ɔkɔɔ Ghana Mmara Sukuu, Makola, na ɔwiee sukuu wɔ afe 1986 mu. Ɔnyaa adansedie krataa a ɛdi akyire wɔ Adan ho Mmara mu wɔ London Suapɔn mu wɔ afe 1997.

Adwuma ne amammui asetra 
Annoh Ankama yɛɛ adwuma sɛ mmaranimfo na na ɔyɛ Ɔmampanyin John Agyekum Kufour Boafo Titiriw .

Wɔ afe 2008 mu no, ɔsii akan na ɔdii nkonim wɔ Atiwa mantam abatoɔ no mu denam abatoɔ 26,423 a ɔnyaeɛ wɔ abatoɔ 34,570 a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ no mu, na ɛyɛ abatoɔ no ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 76.4. Annoh Ankama somm wɔ mmrahyɛbagua boayikuw ahorow mu, a mmrahyɛbagua Boayikuw, Atemmu Boayikuw, ne mmrahyɛbagua no Mpɔtam Aban ne Nkuraase Nkɔso Boayikuw ka ho.

Ne mmrahyɛbagua atenaeɛ no, Joyce Bamford-Addo, a na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbagua no Kasafoɔ saa berɛ no, ɔkaeɛ sɛ ɛda mpan wɔ 7 Ɔpɛpɔn 2010. Kwesi Amoako Atta na odii nkonim wɔ abatow bi a wɔyɛe de hyɛɛ nkongua a ɛda hɔ kwa no so.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Annoh Ankama waree na ɔwɔ mma baasa. Na ɔyɛ Kristoni na na ɔyɛ Katolek Asɔre a ɛwɔ Ghana no muni .

Owuo 
Wɔ June 2010 mu no, na Annoh Ankama ka aban ananmusifoɔ bi a wɔtuu kwan kɔɔ United Kingdom kɔhwehwɛɛ amammuisɛm mu nkɔmmɔdie no ho. Ɔyaree wɔ akwantuo no mu na wɔde no kɔɔ ayaresabea bi wɔ London, nanso ɔwuiɛ berɛ a na ɔrenya ayaresa wɔ July 1. Wɔsan de ne funu kɔɔ Ghana sɛ wɔrekɔsie no wɔ August 20, na wɔsiee no akyiri yi wɔ saa bosome no mu.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Joseph Ampomah Bosompem
text:
Joseph Ampomah Bosompem yɛ Ghana amanyɔni na na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni ma Akim Swedru Mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Apueeɛ Mantam mu.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Bosompeh wɔ 29 June 1957 wɔ Akim Swedru wɔ Ghana Apuei Fam mantam mu . Ɔkɔɔ Swedru Ntoaso Sukuu ne Ofori Panin Ntoaso Sukuu maa ne GCE Ordinary Level na owiee sukuu wɔ afe 1979 mu. Ɔnyaa abodin krataa a ɛkorɔn wɔ Adwumayɛ ho nimdeɛ mu wɔ Manchester Adwumayɛ Sukuu a ɛwɔ Manchester Suapɔn mu wɔ afe 2004 mu. Ɔwɔ adansedi krataa wɔ Assets Management mu wɔ Columbia Sukuupɔn a ɛwɔ USA, a onyaa wɔ afe 1994 mu. Bosompeh suaa ade wɔ Institute of Professional Studies and Self Tuition (IPS) maa ne ACCA wɔ afe 1990 mu. Ansa na eyi reba no, osuaa ade wɔ sukuupɔn a ɛwɔ Strathclyde Business School wɔ UK na owiee sukuu no na onyaa Certificate wɔ Public Finance Management Practice wɔ Central and Local government mu wɔ afe 1994.

Adwuma 
Bosompem ayɛ ɔfotufoɔ a ɔyɛ adwuma wɔ Integrated Intellect Limited firi afe 2004. Ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo ne adwumayɛfo panyin wɔ afe 2006 ne 2008 ntam. Ɔsan nso yɛɛ adwuma sɛ Deputy Commissioner of the Valued Added Tax (VAT) wɔ Ghana. Ansa na ɔreyɛ adwuma sɛ ɔfotufoɔ ne ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ a ɔde ne ho no, na ɔyɛ adwuma wɔ Ministry of Finance and Economic Planning wɔ Ghana Aban Counterpart wɔ Public Expenditure and Dept Management Project. Mmeaeɛ foforɔ a Bosompem ayɛ adwuma wɔ hɔ no bi ne, Controller and Accountants General Department, ne Ghana Suapɔn sɛ Accounts Officer.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔdii kan paw Bosompem sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ mmrahyɛbagua no wɔ New Patriotic Party tekiti so wɔ afe 2008 mu sɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni ma Akim Swedru Mantam no. Ɔnyaa abatoɔ 30,389 a ɛfata a wɔtoo no mu 19,314 a egyina hɔ ma 63.6%. Nanso, odii nkogu wɔ n'apam no mmrahyɛbagua primaries mu wɔ afe 2012.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Bosompem aware a ɔwɔ mma baanum. Ɔyɛ Kristoni na ɔyɛ Presbyterian asɔre no muni .

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Nana Amoakoh Gyampa
text:
Nana Amoakoh Gyampa  (wɔwoo no Oforisuo 15, afe 1958) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne aduruyɛ ho oduruyɛfo.  Ɔyɛ Fourth Republic of Ghana mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nson no muni a ɔgyina Upper Denkyira East Constituency ananmu wɔ Central Region wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Amoakoh wɔ 15 March 1958 na ɔfiri Denkyira-Akropong a ɛwɔ Central Region of Ghana. Ɔnyaa ne ntoaso sukuu wɔ Boa Amponsem Senior High School. Ɔkɔɔ York College na owiee sukuu no nyaa abodin krataa wɔ Adwene ne Nkate Ho Adesua mu.

Adwuma 
Amoakoh yɛ Adwene ne Nneyɛe Ho Ɔbenfo ne aguadifo.  Ɔbɛyɛɛ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua no muni wɔ afe 2005.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ɔyɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni. Afe 2005 mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua no muni. Wɔ afe 2020 mu wɔ NPP primaries no mu no, ɔhweree ne mmɔdenbɔ sɛ ɔbɛgyina Upper Denkyira East ananmu wɔ mmrahyɛbagua mu wɔ Festus Awuah Kwofie anim wɔ afe 2020 amansan abatoɔ no mu.

2004 abatow mu 
Wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu, ɔdii nkonim wɔ Upper Denkyira East Constituency mmrahyɛbagua no mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 21,440 a ɛyɛɛ 68.10% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu berɛ a NDC mmrahyɛbagua kandifoɔ Kojo Adjepong Afrifah nyaa abatoɔ 6,433 a ɛyɛɛ 20.40% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu, CPP mmrahyɛbaguani ɔkannifoɔ Beatrice Buadu nyaa abatoɔ 304 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ 1.00% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu, PNC mmrahyɛbagua kandifoɔ Amaniampong Owusu Offin nyaa abatoɔ 270 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoo no nyinaa mu 0.90% na Independent mmrahyɛbagua kandifoɔ Carl Ebo Morgan nyaa abatoɔ 3,047 a ɛyɛɛ 9.70% wɔ abatoɔ no nyinaa mu abatow a wɔtow.

2008 abatow mu 
Wɔ afe 2008 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu no, ɔsan dii nkonim wɔ Upper Denkyira East Constituency mmrahyɛbagua no mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 17,416 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ nyinaa mu 59.17% berɛ a NDC mmrahyɛbaguani Peter Kofi Owusu-Ahia Jnr nyaa abatoɔ 5,721 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 19.44% . wɔ abatow a wɔtow nyinaa mu.

2012 abatow mu 
Wɔ afe 2012 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu no, ɔsan dii nkonim wɔ Upper Denkyira East Constituency mmrahyɛbagua no mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 21,020 a ɛyɛɛ 53.98% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu berɛ a NDC mmrahyɛbagua no muni Dr Mark Kurt Nawaane nyaa abatoɔ 17,319 a ɛyɛɛ 44.47% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu, the PPP mmrahyɛbaguani Alex Nkansah nyaa abatoɔ 484 a ɛyɛɛ 1.24% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu, PNC mmrahyɛbagua mu kandifoɔ Amaniampong Owusu Offin nyaa abatoɔ 88 a ɛyɛɛ 0.23% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu na NDP mmrahyɛbagua kandifoɔ Peter Oliver Seim nyaa abatoɔ 31 a ɛyɛɛ 0.08% abatow a wɔtow no nyinaa.

2016 abatoɔ 
Wɔ afe 2016 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu no, ɔsan dii nkonim wɔ Upper Denkyira East Constituency mmrahyɛbagua no mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 22,212 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 55.69% berɛ a NDC mmrahyɛbagua mu kandifoɔ Emelia Ankomah nyaa abatoɔ 16,297 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 40.9%, CPP mmrahyɛbaguani ɔkannifoɔ Yaw Asamoah nyaa abatoɔ 810 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoo no nyinaa mu 2.0%, PNC mmrahyɛbagua mu kandifoɔ Amaniampong Owusu Offin nyaa abatoɔ 61 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 0.2%, Independent mmrahyɛbaguani bi Patrick Adu nyaa abatoɔ 233 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ no nyinaa mu 0.6% cast na PPP mmrahyɛbagua kandifo Fredrick Enchil nyaa abatow 275 a ɛyɛ 0.7% wɔ abatow a wɔtow nyinaa mu.

Boayikuw no 
Ɔyɛ kan mmrahyɛbagua no Boayikuw a Wɔapaw a Ɛhwɛ Adwumayɛ ne Adan Ho So no Titenani.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Amoakoh yɛ Kristoni. Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baasa.

Adɔeyɛ 
Amoakoh de atoko afiri, esiam afrafra afiri, rola, fononoo ne lester afiri maa Boa Amponsem Senior High School a ɛwɔ Central Region of Ghana.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Samuel Kwadwo Amoako
text:
Samuel Kwadwo Amoako (wɔwoo no 20 Oforisuo 1943) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni na ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanin a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 5 no muni. Bere bi na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbagua no muni ma Akim Abuakwa Atifi fam mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Apuei Fam mantam mu . Ɔyɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Samuel Kwadwo Amoako wɔ 20 March 1943 wɔ Kukurantumi-Akim wɔ Ghana Apuei Fam . Ɔkɔɔ Howard Sukuupɔn a ɛwɔ Washington DC, Columbia Sukuupɔn a ɛwɔ New York ne nyinaa wɔ afe 1986.

Adwuma 
Na Amoako yɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo wɔ City University of New York .

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔdii kan paw Amoako sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ mmrahyɛbagua no wɔ NPP tekiti so wɔ December 2008 Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ no mu sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma Akim Abuakwa Atifi fam mantam.

Ɔnyaa abatoɔ 14,820 wɔ abatoɔ 25,071 a ɛfata a wɔtoo no mu a egyina hɔ ma 59.10%. Nanso ɔdii nkoguo wɔ n’apam no mmrahyɛbagua primaries mu wɔ afe 2012 mu wɔ Joseph Boakye Danquah Adu .

Ankorankoro asetra 
Amoako aware a ɔwɔ mma baanum. Ɔyɛ Kristoni na ɔyɛ Methodist asɔre no muni.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Kwasi Ameyaw-Cheremeh
text:
Kwasi Ameyaw-Cheremeh (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn 6, 1966) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne mmrahyɛbaguani ma Sunyani Apueeɛ mantam a ɛwɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 5 wɔ ɔman a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu.

Kwasi Ameyaw-Cheremeh (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn 6, 1966) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne mmrahyɛbaguani ma Sunyani Apueeɛ mantam a ɛwɔ mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 5 wɔ ɔman a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Ameyaw-Cheremeh wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn da a ɛtɔ so 6, afe 1966. Ɔfiri Jinijini, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Brong Ahafo Mantam mu wɔ Ghana . Ɔkɔɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu na ɔnyaa ne Master of Philosophy abodin krataa wɔ Ɔmanfoɔ adwumayɛ mu wɔ afe 2008 mu. Ɔsan nso kɔɔ Ghana School of Law na onyaa ne Bachelor of Laws wɔ afe 1995 mu. Ɔsan nso akɔ Galilea College wɔ Israel na ɔne afe 2008 adesuakuw no awie sukuu.

Adwuma 
Ameyaw-Cheremeh resom mprempren sɛ Bui Power Authority Boayikuw no Titenani. Ɔyɛɛ Ɔkyerɛwfo Panyin wɔ Ɔman Fekuw a Ɛhwɛ Mpɔtam Hɔ Ghana (NALAG) so. Ɔyɛ Mmaranimfo wɔ n’adwuma mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ameyaw-Cheremeh yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo (NPP) no muni. Wɔpaw no wɔ afe 2008 Ghana amansan abatow mu sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani muni ma Sunyani Apuei mantam no ma mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 5 wɔ Ghana man a ɛto so 4 no mu .  Ɔnyaa abatoɔ 33,765 wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 53,844, a ɛne abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 62.71% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Alanyina Sampana Sampson a ofi People's National Convention, Ɔtemmufo Samuel Adjei a ofi National Democratic Congress, Peter Kwaw Alibah a ofi Democratic Freedom Party ne Kwakye Kofi a ofi Convention People's Party . Eyinom nyaa abatow a ɛfata nyinaa mu 1.25%, 34.97%, 0.29% ne 0.78%. Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔsan sii akan bio wɔ Sunyani Apuei mantam mu nkongua no so wɔ NPP tekiti so maa ɔmanpanin a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nsia na odii nkonim. Ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua no mu maa Sunyani Apuei mantam no na ɔyɛɛ ofie dodow no ara mpire panyin .  Sɛ New Patriotic Party (NPP) muni no, onyaa abatow 42,478 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no mu a egyina hɔ ma abatow a wɔtow wɔ afe 2012 Ghana amansan abatow no mu nyinaa mu 59.06% .

Boayikuw ahorow 
Ameyaw-Cheremeh yɛ Atemmu Boayikuw no Titenani; a ɔyɛ Daa Ahyɛde Boayikuw no muni; ɔyɛ Amansan Mmara, Mmara ne mmrahyɛbagua Nsɛm Boayikuw no muni; ne Nhomasua Boayikuw no muni.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ameyaw-Cheremeh yɛ Kristoni. Ɔwaree, na ɔwɔ mma baanan.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Christopher Ameyaw-Akumfi
text:
Christopher Ameyaw-Akumfi (wɔwoo no 21 Ɔbɛnem 1945 wɔ Techiman, Bono Apuei Mantam ) yɛ Ghana nhomanimfo ne ɔmanyɔni. Ameyaw-Akumfi yɛ Ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ nwomasua so wɔ John Agyekum Kufour nnisoɔ mu.

Mfitiase asetra ne amammuisɛm 
Wɔwoo Christopher Ameyaw-Akumfi wɔ 21 Ɔbɛnem 1945 wɔ ne kurom Jama-Techiman wɔ ne mansin mu. Ɔhyɛɛ n’amammui adwuma ase bere a wɔpaw no sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ mmrahyɛbagua wɔ afe 2008 mu a onyaa abatow no nyinaa mu bɛboro 53.4%.

Nwomasua 
Ameyaw-Akumfi kɔɔ Adisadel College wɔ Cape Coast maa ne GCE O’ ne A’ Levels. Ɔkɔɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu wɔ afe 1965 mu na owiee Bachelor of Science wɔ Mmoa Ho Adesua mu wɔ afe 1969 mu na onyaa ne master’s degree wɔ saa adwuma koro no ara mu afe biako akyi. Wɔ afe 1970 mu no, ofii hɔ kɔsuaa Mmoa Ho Adesua wɔ Michigan Sukuupɔn mu wɔ United States, faako a onyaa ne oduruyɛfo abodin krataa wɔ afe 1972.

Adwumayɛfo adwuma 
Ameyaw-Akumfi de ne ho ahyɛ University of Cape Coast ne University of Ghana nhyehyɛe no nyinaa mu mfe pii na waboa titiriw wɔ nsakrae ne amansin a wɔde ama sukuupɔn nhyehyɛe no mu wɔ ɔman no mu.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Alex Adomako-Mensah
text:
Alex Adomako-Mensah (wɔwoo no 5 Ɔbɛnem 1962) yɛ Ghana barima amanyɔni ne mmrahyɛbagua no muni ma Sekyere Afram Plains Constituency wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu, Ghana .

Mfitiase asetra 
Wɔwoo no 5 Ɔbɛnem 1962 na ɔfiri Kumawu wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu.

Nwomasua 
Alex Adomako-Mensah nyaa ne MBA wɔ (UK) mu firii... Leicester Sukuupɔn, wɔ afe 2001 mu. Ɔbɛyɛɛ Associate Member (ACIM) wɔ Chartered Institute of Marketing, UK wɔ afe 2003 mu na Chartered Institute of Marketing, UK hyɛɛ no anuonyam sɛ Chartered Management Institute (MCMI) no muni wɔ afe 2006.

Amammu asetra 
Ɔyɛ National Democratic Congress no muni a wɔtoo aba sɛ ɔka MPs a wɔpaw wɔn wɔ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua abatow mu wɔ afe 2016 mu sɛ wɔnkɔgyina Sekyere Afram asasetaw ananmu no ho. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ atenaeɛ no mu de abatoɔ 5,664 wɔ abatoɔ 9,275 a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ no mu a ɛmaa abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 60.85%.

Boayikuw ahorow 
Ɔyɛ Adwumayɛ, Asetra mu Yiyedi ne Ɔman Nnwuma Boayikuw no muni na ɔsan yɛ Sikasɛm Boayikuw no muni.

Adwowtwa ntua 
Wɔ August 14, 2017 no, adwowtwafoɔ bi a wɔnnim wɔn a wɔkurakura akodeɛ tow hyɛɛ MP no so berɛ a na ɔrefiri Kumasi rekɔ Kumawu anwummerɛ.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ɔyɛ Kristoni na waware (ɔwɔ mma baanum).

title: Frank Boakye Agyen
text:
Frank Boakye Agyen yɛ Ghana amanyɔni na na ɔyɛ Ghana Republic of 4th Parliaments a ɛtɔ so 5 ne 6 no muni a ɔgyina hɔ ma nnipa a wɔwɔ Effiduase Asokore mantam mu wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo no wɔ 6 Ɔbɛnem 1946. Ofi kurow bi a wɔfrɛ no Effiduase a ɛwɔ Ashanti mantam mu mu. Ɔnyaa ne Bachelor of Arts wɔ mmara ne amammuisɛm mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu wɔ afe 1984 mu. Afei ɔkɔɔ Ghana Mmara Sukuu mu kɔnyaa ne Bachelor of Laws wɔ afe 1989.

Adwuma 
Agyen yɛ mmaranimfo. Ɔne Boakye Agyen Chambers yɛɛ adwuma wɔ Accra sɛ ɔhokafoɔ panin ansa na ɔrekɔ amanyɔsɛm mu. Na ɔyɛ Ghana Cylinder Manufacturing Company no board chairman.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Na Agyen yɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanyin a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a Ɛto so Anum no muni . Ɔhyɛɛ n’adwuma ase wɔ amammuisɛm mu bere a wɔpaw no wɔ afe 2008 Ghana amansan abatow mu wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so sɛ mmrahyɛbagua muni ma Effiduase Asokore mantam a na abatow 18,859 wɔ abatow a ɛfata 23,799 a wɔtow no nyinaa mu, a ɛne 79.24% yɛ pɛ. Ɔdii nkonim tiaa Kwadwo Adae a ɔfiri National Democratic Congress, George Asiamah a ɔfiri Convention People’s Party ne Lovia Berko a ɔfiri People’s National Convention. Eyinom nyaa abatow a ɛfata nyinaa mu 18.72%, 0.71% ne 1.33%.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ɔyɛ Kristoni na waware na ɔwɔ mma baanan.

Mmoa nwoma

title: Pearl Amoah
text:
Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo no. Pearl Amoah yɛ kan Ghana amanaman ntam nhwɛsoɔ na seesei ɔyɛ ɔsomfoɔ a wɔahyɛ no. Ɔyɛ Miss Northern Region wɔ afe 1994 mu, Miss Ghana Universe wɔ afe 1996 mu ne Miss Ghana International akansi wɔ afe 2015. Ɔsan nso dii nkonim wɔ Africa Ebony mfonini a eye sen biara wɔ afe no mu wɔ 1999 mu. Wɔ afe 2000 mu no, wɔmaa no mfirihyia apem no mu nnwontofo a ɔsen biara wɔ Mfirihyia Apem Abasobɔde a Wɔde Ma no mu. Ɔayɛ mfonini wɔ Amerika, Paris, London, Germany, Ivory Coast ne Ghana .

Nneɛma a wɔde yɛ adwuma 
Ɔhyehyɛɛ PAF Outlet, aguadidan a edi kan a wɔde ama Ghana ntadehyɛ ahorow nkutoo. Wɔ afe 1999 mu no, ɔhyehyɛɛ Fashion House. Ɔsan nso wɔ PearlProjects a ɔde bɛkyerɛ n’adebɔ ne n’adwinni ho nimdeɛ. Ɔde Ghana Fashion Week bae wɔ afe 2001 mu. Wɔyɛ ho nhyehyɛe afe biara ma ntadehyɛfo atitiriw a wɔwɔ Afrika no hyiam na wɔkyerɛ wɔn nsaanodwuma ho anisɔ. Ɔde n’ankasa line Pearl sii hɔ wɔ afe 2004 mu. Akyiri yi saa afe no ara mu no, ɔne J. P. Miller boom na wɔde JosephPearl ahyɛnsode no sii hɔ. Afe a edi hɔ no, wobuee wɔn aguadidan a edi kan wɔ Soho, New York .

Adwuma a wɔyɛ wɔ modelling mu 
Ɔayɛ mfonini ama ntadehyɛ adwumakuw te sɛ Roberto Cavalli, Vivien Westwood, Halston, Donna Karen, Alberta Ferreti, Ralph Rucci, Jakie Rogers, Armani, Valentino ne afoforo. Mfoninitwafo te sɛ Peter Lindberg, Dewy Nicks, Marco Glaviano, Frank Otten ne Gean-Luca na wɔatow no ama nsɛmma nhoma ahorow te sɛ Vibe, Paris Voici, Essence, Black Elegance, Marie Claire, Cosmopolitan, ne Cosmo Girl .

Nwomasua 
Ɔnyaa ne ntoaso sukuu wɔ Labone Senior High School . Ne bachelor's degree a ɛyɛ Hospitality Management, fi Westbourne Sukuupɔn a ɛwɔ London . Ɔsan nso wɔ abodin krataa wɔ Architecture & Interior Design mu wɔ Parsons School of Design wɔ New York .

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ɔfiri La wɔ Accra na ɔno nko ara ne ne maame owufoɔ Madam Bernice Adjeley Adjei ba. . Ɔwaree wɔ afe 2008 mu ne Mac Diamond Kodjo Emekor Nyamekor na ɔwɔ mma mmiɛnsa.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Kenturah Davis
text:
Kenturah Davis (wɔwoo no afe 1984) yɛ nnɛyi mfoniniyɛni a ɔyɛ adwuma wɔ Los Angeles, New Haven ne Accra, Ghana ntam .

Nwomasua 
Davis nyaa ne BA wɔ Occidental College ne MFA wɔ Yale Sukuupɔn Sukuu a Ɛhwɛ Adwinni So.

Adwinni ho adeyɛ 
Davis adwuma no hwehwɛ abusuabɔ a ɛda nipasu, kasa, ne sɛnkyerɛnne kwan so agyiraehyɛde ntam. Davis yɛ adwuma wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ahorow mu fi mfoniniyɛ so kosi mfoniniyɛ so kosi nsusuwso so kosi agoru so.  N'adwuma no wɔ Walker Art Center nneɛma a wɔaboaboa ano no mu .

Wɔ afe 2020 mu no, Davis ne ntadehyɛ adwumakuw: Osei Duro yɛɛ biako. Los Angeles Metro na ɛhyɛɛ Davis sɛ ɔnyɛ adwuma akɛseɛ a wɔde bɛsi hɔ daa wɔ beaeɛ pɔtee bi wɔ K Line (Crenshaw/LAX) keteke kwan foforɔ no so.

Wɔ afe 2022 mu no, Ɔman Mfoniniyɛbea no daa Ava DuVernay mfonini, a Davis yɛe no adi.

Nneɛma a wɔde kyerɛ a wɔapaw 
2013 "Sonder" wɔ Papillion wɔ Los Angeles.

2019 "Blur wɔ Pɛpɛɛpɛ mu Anigyeɛ mu" wɔ Mathew Brown wɔ Los Angeles.

2020 "Biribiara a wontumi nhu" wɔ SCAD Tete Nneɛma Akorae a ɛwɔ Georgia.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Efe Grace
text:
Efe Grace yɛ Ghana odwontoni ne nnwom kyerɛwni. Ɔyɛ asɛmpa nnwontoni. Wɔyii Efe Grace sɛ ɔmmɛgye Gospel Artist of the Year abasobɔdeɛ wɔ afe 2021 Vodafone Ghana Music Awards mu .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Efe Grace fi Agogo a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu, Ghana. Grace yɛ Ghana asɛmpa somfo, Rev. Mensah Bonsu na ɔkyerɛwee. Ɔyɛ mmofra baasa mu panyin. Ɔkɔɔ Yaa Asantewaa Mmabaa Sukuu na ɔwiee wɔ afe 2006 mu. Ɔtoaa ne nwomasua so wɔ Christian Service University College a ɔwiee sukuu wɔ afe 2011 mu a ɔnyaa Bachelor of Business Administration wɔ Sikakorabea ne Sikasɛm mu.

Nnwom adwuma 
Grace fii ase too dwom bere a na ɔyɛ ɔbabun, na ɔde ne ho hyɛɛ mu som sɛ n’agya nnwontofo a ɔboa no. Awiei koraa no ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔsom kannifo wɔ n’asɔre mu bere a na ɔsan nso som sɛ jazz nnwontofo wɔ ahɔhodan, adidibea ne nsãdan ahorow mu wɔ Kumasi. Ɔsan nso yɛɛ nnwontofo a ɔboa Becca ne Kwabena Kwabena .

Grace fii ase sɛ odwontofo a ɔboa Sonnie Badu ne Ohemaa Mercy . Ɔyii ne debut single adi wɔ October 2018 mu a wɔato din " Yehowa ne M'abankese " a na ɛyɛ ne papa dwom a ɛwɔ asɛmti korɔ no ara no refix. Oyii King of Glory nnwom foforo adi. Wɔ afe 2020 mu no, ɔnyaa ne Vodafone Ghana Music Award nomination a ɛdi kan wɔ female Vocalist abasobɔdeɛ mu.

Wɔsan nso yii Efe Grace sɛ Ɔbea a Ɔreba a Ɔsen Biara wɔ Afe no mu ne Mmea a Ɔbɔ Nnwom a Ɔsen Biara wɔ 2021 3Music Awards .

Ɔnyaa din mmienu sɛ Gospel Artist of the Year ne Best Female Vocal Performance of the Year wɔ ne dwom Lord Have your way wɔ 2021 Vodafone Ghana Music Awards no mu.  Akyiri yi Abiana na onyaa Female Vocal Performance abasobɔde no . Wɔ September 2021 mu no, ɔyii ne nnwom a ɛtɔ so nnan ne deɛ ɛtɔ so mmienu a wɔato din Overflow ne Sounds of Heaven adi.

Wɔ afe 2022 mu no, Efe Grace san nyaa din mprɛnsa sɛ Gospel Act of the Year, Best Female Vocal Performance wɔ ne dwom Overflow ne Performer of the Year wɔ ne dwumadi wɔ 2021 3Music Women’s Brunch Performance.

Agorudi ahorow a ɛda nsow 
Efi bere a ofii ne solo adwuma ase no, wabɔ nnwom wɔ Ghana Music Awards a ɔne Ohemaa Mercy ne Joe Mettle bɔɔ nnwom. Anidaso Kɔnsɛt ne Ignite Virtual Kɔnsɛt. Ɔsan nso yɛɛ nnwom wɔ 2021 3Music Women's Brunch.

title: Gloria Sarfo
text:
Gloria Osei Sarfo yɛ Ghana odiyifo ne TV so ɔyɛkyerɛni.  Ɔdii nkonim wɔ 2020 Africa Magic Viewers' Choice Awards mu wɔ ne dwumadie wɔ Shirley Frimping Manso 's The Perfect Picture - Ten Years Later mu.

Adwuma

title: Nana Ama Agyemang Asante
text:
Nana Ama Agyemang Asante yɛ Ghana nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo, samufo ne ɔkyerɛwfo.  Efi afe 2012 besi nnɛ no wayɛ adwuma sɛ intanɛt so samufo abadiakyiri wɔ Citi FM wɛb portal citifmonline.com . Ɔsan nso bom yɛ “Citi Breakfast Show” wɔ radio dwumadibea a ɛwɔ Accra Citi FM, a ɔne Bernard Avle .

Asetra mu nsɛm 
Bere bi na Nana Ama Agyemang Asante yɛ ɔbea a wɔyɛ baguam ayayade sen biara wɔ Ghana. Sɛ́ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a ɔka amammuisɛm, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne aguadi ho asɛm no, Nana Ama aka nokware akyerɛ tumidi na wabu aban ahorow ho akontaa mfe pii. Ɔde mmea ho adwene a wohia kɛse wɔ ɔman nsɛm ne akyinnyegye ahorow a ɛkɔ so wɔ radio so no ama. Ɛwom sɛ n’ani gye nea ɔyɛ ho de, nanso n’adwene a ɛkorɔn ne mmea ho adwene a ɔwɔ no ama wanya ayayade a ennyae na ama wayɛ mmea radio so ahwɛfo a wɔde wɔn ani asi wɔn so kɛse wɔ Ghana no mu biako . Ɛno nsiw no kwan sɛ ɔde n’asɛnka agua so bɛko ama wɔn a wɔhyɛ wɔn so no. Nana Ama yɛ yɔnko wɔ Reuters Institute of Journalism a ɛwɔ Oxford Sukuupɔn mu ne National Endowment for Democracy a ɛwɔ Washington DC. Nnansa yi ara n’adwuma ne Ghana Mmea Abenfoɔ adwuma a ɛhwɛɛ mmaa abenfoɔ dodoɔ a wɔbisabisaa wɔn nsɛm wɔ Ghana nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu

Nwomasua 
Owiee ne ntoaso sukuu wɔ Cape Coast Sukuupɔn mu baabi a osuaa Asetra ne Sikasɛm ho ade.

Adwuma 
Nana Ama Agyemang Asante hyɛɛ ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ adwuma ase wɔ afe 2006 mu sɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a ɔbɔ amanneɛ wɔ radio dwumadibea Joy FM . Efi afe 2011 kɔsi afe 2012 no ɔne Journalists for Human Rights (JHR), NGO a wɔde sii hɔ wɔ Canada, baabi a ɔyɛɛ ɔman kwankyerɛfoɔ maa Ghana yɛɛ adwuma.

M24, Afrika anigyedeɛ dwumadibea bi, bɔɔ Nana Ama Agyemang Asante din sɛ “Radio Personality of the Year” wɔ afe 2015 mu esiane mmɔden a ɔbɔe daa sɛ ɔbɛka nokware akyerɛ tumidi nti.

Wɔ afe 2017 mu no, National Endowment for Democracy (NED) maa no “Reagan-Fascell Democracy Fellowship”, na ɛmaa no kwan ma ɔdii asram pii wɔ Washington DC, USA de boaboaa amanneɛbɔ bi ano wɔ sɛdeɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfoɔ bɛtumi ama Ghana mmaa de ayɛ den nne ahorow a ɛwɔ baguam.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Evelyn Amarteifio
text:
Ɔbenfo Evelyn Mansa Amarteifio (1916-1997) yɛ Ghana mmea nhyehyɛefo. Wɔ afe 1953 mu no, ɔhyehyɛɛ Ɔman Gold Coast Mmea Fekuw (NFGCW).

Mfitiase Asetra ne Nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Evelyn Amarteifio May 22, 1916 wɔ Accra . N’awofo, ne nuabeanom baanu, ne ne maame nuabeanom binom de wɔn ho hyɛɛ asetra ne atuhoama adwuma mu wɔ 1920 ne 1930 mfe no mu. Ɔsuaa ade wɔ Accra Mmabaa Sukuu ne Achimota Kɔlege . Wɔ afe 1937 mu no ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo wɔ Achimota Mfitiase Sukuu mu, na ɔkɔɔ so yɛɛ adwuma a ofi ne pɛ mu.

Wɔ 1953 mfiase no Amarteifio tuu kwan kɔɔ Britain kɔsuaa ade wɔ YWCA . Bere a ɔsan bae no – ɔne Annie Jiagge, Thyra Casely-Hayford, Amanua Korsah ne afoforo boom – ɔhyehyɛɛ YWCA wɔ Gold Coast . Ɔsan tuu kwan kɔɔ United States, faako a osuaa Jamaica Mmea Fekuw no ho ade . Ɔde eyi yɛɛ nhwɛso maa National Federation of Gold Coast Women, ɔman no mu mmea ahyehyɛde bi a ɛnyɛ aban de no. Ahofadi akyi no Amarteifio antumi ammɔ fekuw no ho ban amfi Kwame Nkrumah pɛ a na ɔwɔ sɛ obedi mmea ahyehyɛde ahorow so no ho, na wɔ afe 1960 mu no, wogyaee NFGCW no.

Owuo 
Amarteifio wui wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn da a ɛtɔ so 6, afe 1997.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Mercy ffoulkes-Crabbe
text:
Mercy Kwarley ffoulkes-Crabbe, née Quartey-Papafio (6 Ɔbɛnem 1894 – 14 Ɔbɛnem 1974) yɛ Ghana ɔkyerɛkyerɛni, ɔbaa a ɔdi kan a ɔyɛ aborɔfo a ɔdii sukuu bi anim wɔ Gold Coast . Na ɔyɛ mmea kyerɛwfo nso, wɔ edin hunu Gloria ase, ma Gold Coast Times .

Mfitiase Asetra ne Nhomasua 
Na Mercy Quartey-Papafio yɛ Benjamin Quartey-Papafio, Gold Coast oduruyɛfo a odi kan, ne Hannah Maria Duncan a ofi Cape Coast no babea. Ɔsuaa ade wɔ Wesleyan Methodist sukuu a ɛwɔ Cape Coast ne Accra Grammar School, a ne papa ne no hyehyɛɛ no. Bere a odii mfe 16 no, ɔbɛyɛɛ abeawa a odi kan wɔ Afrika Atɔe Fam a onyaa College of Preceptors ne Senior Cambridge Certificate. Wɔ 1911 mu no, ofii ase kyerɛɛ ade wɔ Accra Aban Mmabaa Sukuu, a na n’akatua yɛ £25 afe biara. Wɔ 1913 mu no, wɔde ɔne ne nuabea Ruby kɔɔ Saxonholme Sukuu a ɛwɔ Birkdale, na wɔsan kɔɔ Accra wɔ 1915 mu. Ná ɔyɛ sukuu panyin boafo wɔ Accra Aban Mmabaa Sukuu mu, na na ɔyɛ sukuu panyin a ɔyɛ adwuma wɔ bere bi mu.

Wɔ 1921 mu no wɔpaw no sɛ Cape Coast Aban Mmabaa Sukuu no panyin . Ɔkɔɔ so yɛɛ adwuma no kosii sɛ ogyaee adwuma wɔ 1949 mu, na ɔtetee n’akyerɛkyerɛfo wɔ sukuu akyi de siesiee ne ho maa abɔnten so adansedi sɔhwɛ. Ɔno na odii kan wɔ Gold Coast a ɔde Awofo Akyerɛkyerɛfo Fekuw bi bae, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ntease a ɛwɔ awofo ne akyerɛkyerɛfo ntam no atu mpɔn. Ɔde anwummere adesua nso bae ma mmea a wɔanyinyin wɔ Cape Coast, ɛwom sɛ na ɛsɛ sɛ ogyae adeyɛ no bere a okununom sɔre tiaa no de.

Wɔ 1949 mu no wɔmaa no MBE . Wɔ 1953 mu no ɔboaa Evelyn Amarteifio ma wɔhyehyɛɛ Ɔman Sikakɔbea Mmea Fekuw, na ɔsom sɛ ne titrani a odi kan.

Owuo 
Owui wɔ June 1974 mu, na wosiee no wɔ Osu amusiei.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Jeremie Van-Garshong
text:
Jeremie Van-Garshong yɛ Ghana radio ne television so ɔyɛkyerɛfo, ɔyɛɛ nsɛm wɔ 4syte TV so wɔ afe 2000 awiei, ne Y FM ne Live FM radio so.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: PM (Di Asa winner)
text:
Mensah a ɔsom bo a ɔno na onim no yiye stage name PM, yɛ Ghana gua so ɔbea bi a odii nkonim wɔ 2019 edition a ɛfa Di Asa, nokwasɛm ho ɔyɛkyerɛ a ɛkyerɛ gua so mmea a wɔapaw wɔn a wɔn kɛse yɛ kɛse a wofi Ghana mantam 16 mu . Saa mmea yi (a wɔsan frɛ wɔn ahemmaa wɔ akansi no mu) si akan wɔ asaw akansi bi mu na akyiri yi wotua wɔn ka wɔ akansi no awiei.

Dubai akyinnyegye 
Sɛ akatua a onyae wɔ akansi no mu nkonimdi ho no fa no, na wɔhwɛ kwan sɛ PM ne wɔn a wodii kan ne wɔn a wɔto so abien no bɛkɔ akwantu a wɔatua ho ka nyinaa akɔ Dubai

.Na ɛsɛ sɛ saa akwantuo yi yɛ PM akwantuo a ɛdi kan wɔ wimhyɛn mu na na wayɛ nhyehyɛeɛ dedaw wɔ nneɛma a ɔbɛyɛ bere a wadu Dubai pɛ a ebinom bi ne; aguadidan bi a ɔkɔɔ ansa na Buronya reba ne mmeae a ɛyɛ anigye a na wate ho asɛm a ɔbɛkɔ akɔhwɛ.  Bere a wobisaa no n’akwanhwɛ ho asɛm no ɔkae sɛ; "Mate ɔdan a ɛware sen biara ne asubura soronko bi ho asɛm." Mepɛ sɛ mihu wɔn na misua wɔn ho ade. Mepɛ nso sɛ mekɔsua Dubai amammerɛ ne afoforo pii."

PM antumi anforo wimhyɛn no esiane ne kɛse ne tebea a ɛbɛyɛ sɛ ɔbɛhaw akwantufo afoforo a ebetumi ama wɔde asɛm akɔdan wimhyɛn adwuma no ( Emirates Airlines ). Nanso, nnipa baanu a aka a wodii kan no tumi tuu kwan no

Sɛnea Atinka nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ akuraa kyerɛ no, wɔn a wɔboaa dwumadi no titiriw, wimhyɛn adwumakuw a ɛhwɛ wimhyɛn no so no, amma PM antra esiane ne kɛse nti.  Na wɔadi akwantuo ho nhyehyɛeɛ nyinaa akyi na wɔasan nso abɔ wɔn a wɔtɔn tekiti no amanneɛ wɔ hia a ɛhia sɛ wɔnya nkongua soronko ɛnam ahemmaa no kɛseɛ (sɛnea wɔka wɔn ho asɛm wɔ akansi no mu) nti. Nea ɛyɛ awerɛhow no, wɔ awia 5:30, simma kakraa bi ma bere a wɔde bɛforo wimhyɛn no, ɔnanmusifo bi a ofi wimhyɛn adwumakuw no mu bɔɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo adwumayɛbea no amanneɛ sɛ wimhyɛn adwumakuw no ( Emirates Airlines ) antumi anwie nhyehyɛe a wɔde kɔ PM no a wanka ntease biara a wotumi hu.

Sɛnea PM kyerɛ no nea Embosuohemaa kae no nyɛ nokware koraa na ɛnyɛ nea esii no pɛpɛɛpɛ. Ogye dii sɛ ofi koma pa mu kaa nea ɔkae no de bɔɔ mmɔden sɛ ɔde ne ho bɛhyɛ ne mpaboa mu. Ɔde kaa ho sɛ ɔmpɛ sɛ ɔka asɛm no ho asɛm na bere a ɛsɛ mu no, wɔde biribiara bɛda adi. Bio nso, esiane nea esii nti, ɔyɛɛ nhyehyɛe sɛ obefi ɔsatu bi ase a ɛbɛtwe adwene asi animtiaabu a wɔde ba mmea a wɔn kɛse yɛ kɛse so. Ɔkaa sɛ; "Mepɛ sɛ mede me ɔsatu no di dwuma de ma wiase hu sɛ nnipa ahorow wɔ hɔ a ɛsono wɔn nipadua na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔma obiara kwan ma ɔyɛ pɛ wɔ nneɛma bi ho." Mepɛ sɛ mede m'asɛnka agua no ka kyerɛ mmea a wɔte sɛ me sɛ wonsua sɛ wɔbɛdɔ wɔn ho na wɔagye biribiara a wɔyɛ." Ɔsan de kaa ho sɛ ne nsa aka nea wɔhyɛɛ no bɔ nyinaa afi Atinka Media Village hɔ na media fie no mfa no ka biara

Wɔ nsɛmbisa mu no, PM kae sɛ onnim sɛnea ne mu duru te nanso bere nyinaa na onim sɛ ne kɛse betumi ayɛ akwanside ama no wɔ tebea horow te sɛ eyinom mu.

Wɔ tebea no ho mmuaema mu no, Emirates Airlines de asɛm bi too gua sɛnea edidi so yi; "Yɛkyerɛ obu ma yɛn adetɔfo kokoam nsɛm na yentumi nsusuw adetɔfo ho nsɛm pɔtee anaa nsɛm pɔtee bi ho." Emirates de gyinapɛn a ɛkorɔn sen biara to wimhyɛn mu ahobammɔ so na sɛ eyi fã no, ɛyɛ ahwehwɛde sɛ akwantufo nyinaa bɛtra ase dwoodwoo na wɔn ho atɔ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ahobammɔ bɛlt abɔ. Nnwumayɛbea adeyɛ bi ma akwantufo a wontumi ntra nkongua biako so esiane wɔn kɛse nti ne sɛ wɔbɛtɔ nkongua foforo ama wɔn ankasa ahobammɔ ne ahotɔ, sɛ nkongua bi wɔ hɔ a."

Hwɛ nso 
Di Asa

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Fati Habib-Jawula
text:
Hajia Fati Habib Jawula (wuiɛ 15 Ɔbɛnem 2020)  yɛ Ghana ananmusini wɔ Denmark.  Ɛte sɛ nea aban ananmusifo dwumadibea a ɛwɔ Copenhagen no yɛ beae a Ghana mmea ananmusifo ani gye ho. Hajia Fati Habib Jawula yɛ ɔbaa ananmusifoɔ a ɔtɔ so nnan wɔ mfeɛ aduonu a atwam no mu. Wɔpaw no sɛ ɔka Ghana Amanaman Ntam Asɛmpatrɛwfo Titenani baanum ho bere a kan ɔmampanyin a wawu John Evans Atta-Mills de ne nsa hyɛɛ nkrataa a ɛkyerɛ sɛ Commission ne Credence ase no.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Agnes Asangalisa Chigabatia
text:
Agnes Asangalisa Chigabatia (wɔwoo no Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 20, afe 1956) yɛ Ghanani ɔbaa amanyɔni ne kan mmrahyɛbagua no muni ma Builsa North Constituency.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Agnes Chigabatia wɔ 20 Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 1956 wɔ Chuchuliga wɔ Upper East Region wɔ Ghana . Ɔnyaa ne mfimfini sukuu adesua wɔ Adda Mfinimfini Sukuu a ɛwɔ Navrongo ne Ayieta Mfinimfini Sukuu a ɛwɔ Sandema . Akyiri yi Agnes nyaa ne ntoaso sukuu adesua wɔ St. Francis Girls’ Senior High School, Jirapa. Ɔkɔɔ n’adesua so wɔ Accra Polytechnic baabi a onyaa Advance Level wɔ Catering Certificate mu.

Adwuma 
Chigabatia yɛ obi a ɔyɛ aduanmafo wɔ n’adwuma mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Agnes Chigabatia sii akan wɔ 2004 mmrahyɛbagua abatow no mu wɔ New Patriotic Party a odii nkonim wɔ mu no tekiti so. Ɔtwee abatow a ne nyinaa yɛ 6,160 a egyina hɔ ma 33.70%.  Ɔsomm mfeɛ nnan (7 Ɔbɛnem 2005 - 7 Ɔbɛnem 2009). Wɔ saa bere koro yi ara mu no, na Agnes nso yɛ Ɔsomfo Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Upper East Region so.  Agnes hweree ne dibea sɛ mmrahyɛbaguani wɔ afe 2008 abatoɔ no mu baabi a ɔdii nkoguo wɔ Timothy Awotiirim Ataboadey anim.

Abatow a wɔyɛ 
Wɔpaw Chigabatia sɛ mmrahyɛbagua muni maa Builsa North mantam a ɛwɔ Upper East Region of Ghana nea edi kan wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow no mu.  Odii nkonim wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so.  Na ne mansin no yɛ mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 2 no fa wɔ nkongua 13 a New Patriotic Party no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Upper East Region no mu.  New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbagua nkongua 128 wɔ nkongua 230 mu.  Wɔde abatow 6,160 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 18,273 mu.  Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 33.7% yɛ pɛ.  Wɔpaw no sen Thomas Akum-Yong a ofi Nnipa Ɔman Nhyiam no mu, Awontiirim Ataboadey Timothy a ofi Ɔman Demokrasi mmrahyɛbagua no mu ne Abaayiak Ayulim Grace a ofi Nhyiam no mu Nnipa Kuw no mu .  Eyinom nyaa abatow 5,657, 6,147 ne 309 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu.  Eyinom ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 31%, 33.6% ne 1.7% yɛ pɛ.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Chigabatia yɛ Kristoni.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Cecelia Ayanori Bukari-Yakubu
text:
Na Cecelia Ayanori Bukari-Yakubu yɛ Ghana amanyɔni. Ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani a ɔtɔ so mmienu a ɔgyinaa Atifi Mantam ne Atifi Mantam ananmu firi afe 1960 kɔsi 1965 na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani maa Pusiga firi afe 1965 kɔsi afe 1966.

Bukari-Yakubu ka mmea a wodii kan baa Ghana mmrahyɛbagua mu wɔ afe 1960 mu wɔ ɔmanfo (mmea asɔremma) ananmusifo mmara ase no ho. Ná ɔka mmea 10 a wɔpaw wɔn a wɔansɔre atia wɔn wɔ June 27, 1960 wɔ tekiti a ɛne Convention People’s Party .

Hwɛ nso 
MP a wɔpaw wɔn wɔ 1965 Ghana mmrahyɛbagua abatow mu din

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Catherine Katuni Tedam
text:
Catherine Katuni Tedam yɛ Ghana ɔkyerɛkyerɛni ne ɔmanyɔni. Ɔyɛɛ mmrahyɛbaguani maa Chiana-Paga mantam no fi 1970 kosi 1972. Na ɔyɛ mmea baanu pɛ a wɔwɔ Republican mmrahyɛbagua a Ɛto so Abien no mu biako.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Tedam wɔ March 15 1944 wɔ Paga . Ɔnyaa ne mfitiaseɛ nwomasua wɔ Local Council Primary School a ɛwɔ Paga firi afe 1951 kɔsi 1956 ne Girls’ Middle Boarding School wɔ Bolgatanga firi afe 1957 kɔsi 1960. Ɔhyɛn Mmea no mu Akyerɛkyerɛfo Ntetee Kɔlege a ɛwɔ Tamale sɛ wɔbɛtete wɔn ho sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo fi afe 1961 kosi afe 1965.

Adwuma 
Ne kyerɛkyerɛfo ntetee a odii wɔ Mmea no akyi Akyerɛkyerɛfo Ntetee Kɔlege wɔ 1965 mu no, onyaa adwuma wɔ Local Authority Primary School Paga . Ɔkyerɛɛ ade wɔ hɔ kosii afe 1966 bere a ɔde ne ho bɔɔ Akantome Mfinimfini Sukuu a ɛwɔ Bolgatanga akyerɛkyerɛfo no . Ɔkyerɛɛ ade wɔ hɔ afe biako nso na otu kɔɔ Abiba Mfinimfini Sukuu nso wɔ Bolgatanga akyerɛkyerɛ afe biako bio. Wɔ afe 1969 mu no ɔkyerɛɛ ade wɔ Adabase Mfitiase Sukuu a ɛwɔ Bolgatanga nso kosii sɛ ɔkɔɔ mmrahyɛbagua mu wɔ afe 1970 mu. Bere a na Catherine yɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛ adwuma no, na ɔyɛ Ɔman Panyin a ɔyɛ Mfitiase Akyerɛkyerɛfo Fekuw no muni fi 1966 kosi 1969.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Catherine bɛyɛɛ Chiana-Paga Mpɔtam Bagua no Sikasɛm Boayikuw no muni wɔ 1968 mu. Wɔ ɔman a ɛto so abien no mu no, wɔamma wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔpaw wɔn no bi ankɔ akansi wɔ 1969 abatow no mu esiane abusuabɔ a na wɔne Republic a Edi Kan no aban wɔ nti. Wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔpaw wɔn no mu biako ne Clement Kubindiwo Tedam (C. K. Tedam) a ɔyɛɛ mmrahyɛbaguani maa Paga mantam no wɔ First Republic bere so. Na ɛsɛ sɛ C. K. Tedam si akan wɔ Chiana-Paga nkongua no ho nanso nea wɔayi no afi mu no maa nkongua no da mpan. Wɔyɛɛ by-election wɔ March 1970 mu na Catherine a na ɔyɛ C. K. Tedam wɔfase no sii akan wɔ nkongua a ɛwɔ Progress Party no tekiti so no ho na odii nkonim. Bere a na ɔwɔ mmrahyɛbagua no mu no, ɔsom wɔ boayikuw ahorow mu, a emu bi ne; Aban Boayikuw, Nhomasua Boayikuw, Akwahosan Boayikuw, ne Nkuraase ne Asetra mu Nkɔso Boayikuw.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Catherine yɛ Katolekni. n’ani gye akenkan na otie nnwom wɔ n’ahomegye bere mu. Ná n’ani gye netball ne hockey nso ho.

Hwɛ nso 

 MP a wɔpaw wɔn wɔ 1969 Ghana mmrahyɛbagua abatow mu din
 Busia aban

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Ama Afo Blay
text:
Ama Afo Blay yɛ Ghana nhomasua ho nimdefo. Ɔyɛ obi a na anka ɔyɛ Ghana Nhomasua Dwumadibea no Ɔkwankyerɛfo Panyin .  John Kufuor na ɔpaw no sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ adwuma wɔ afe 2002 mu .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Blay wɔ Bachelor’s degree wɔ General Education mu wɔ Cape Coast Sukuupɔn mu ne adansedi krataa wɔ Trinity Theological Seminary a ɛwɔ Accra . Wanya Akwankyerɛ ne Afotu ho abodin krataa a ɛkorɔn nso wɔ Emporia State Sukuupɔn a ɛwɔ Kansas, United States of Aerica .

Adwuma 
Ansa na wɔrepaw no sɛ GES Ɔkwankyerɛfo Panyin wɔ December 11, 2002 no, na ɔyɛ GES Apuei Fam Ɔmantam kwankyerɛfo.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Miliky MiCool
text:
Beatrice Chinery a wonim no sɛ Milky MiCool ( bɛyɛ afe 1930 c. 1966 – Ɔberɛfɛw da 10, afe 2020) yɛ Ghana odiyifo. Ogyee din wɔ 2000 mfe no mfiase mu hɔ esiane ne dwumadi wɔ television so dwumadi a wɔfrɛ no Kejetia mu nti, na akyiri yi ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ Yolo mu .

Adwuma 
Ofii n’agorudi adwuma ase wɔ 1993 mu. MiCool dii dwuma wɔ television so dwumadi a agye din a wɔfrɛ no Kejetia mu wɔ 2000 mfe no mfiase mu hɔ. Ɔkɔɔ so yɛɛ sini afoforo a Jamestown Fisherman ne Yolo ka ho mu.

Owuo 
MiCool wui wɔ nsɛnnennen a ɛfa mogya mmoroso ho wɔ Korle-Bu Nkyerɛkyerɛ Ayaresabea a ɛwɔ Accra wɔ June 10, 2020. MiCool nuabarima Robert kaa sɛ ɔyaree asram bi nanso nneɛma sɛee na wɔde no kɔɔ Ayaresabea hɔ ntɛm nanso owui bere a oduu hɔ no.

Sini ho mfoniniyɛ 

 Kejetia na ɔkyerɛwee
 Yolo
 Jamestown Ɔpofoni

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Princess Shyngle
text:
Princess Shyngle (wɔwoo no 25 December 1990) yɛ Gambia odiyifo ne ɔyɛkyerɛfo.

Mfitiase asetra 
Wɔwoo Ɔhemmaa Shyngle wɔ Gambia. Na ne papa Winston Shyngle yɛ ɔmanpanyin abadiakyiri wɔ Gambia na na ne maame yɛ aguadifo. Na ɔwɔ ne mfitiase ne ntoaso sukuu nyinaa wɔ Gambia, ɔman ketewaa bi a ɛwɔ Afrika Atɔe fam .

Adwuma a wɔyɛ wɔ agodie mu 
Bere a Princess Shyngle daa ne ho adi sɛ nea ɔto so abiɛsa a oye sen biara wɔ Next Movie Star Africa akansi no mu akyi no, wayɛ sini ahorow pii fi saa bere no, titiriw wɔ Ghana . Wɔyii Princess Shyngle sɛ "afe no mu adehunu" wɔ 2015 Ghana Movie Awards . Ɔsan nso ne Ghana sini mu nsoromma afoforo te sɛ Juliet Ibrahim, John Dumelo, Martha Ankomah, ne D-Black ayɛ sini abien bi.  Nnwuma atitiriw a ɔyɛe no bi ne Why Do Men Get Married, Dormitory 8 a ɛtoatoa so, The 5 Brides series, ne The Hidden Fantasy . Wɔ afe 2020 mu no, ofii ne TV so dwumadi a ɛyɛ nokware a wɔtoo din Discovering Princess Shyngle .

Ankorankoro asetra 
Shyngle agye din kɛse esiane n’asen nketenkete ne nsɛm a akyinnyegye wom wɔ sohyial media so nti.  Wɔaka sɛ Princess ne Nigeriani afrobeat artist, Burnaboy wɔ abusuabɔ.  Wɔ asɛm bi a esii mu no, ɔkɔɔ ne social media krataafa so de n’ayeforohyia ho amanneɛ kyerɛɛ ne Senegal beau.  Akyinnyegye pii aba aware no so bere a bere bi ɔfrɛɛ n’adamfo abarima no sɛ wasisi wɔ abusuabɔ no mu na akyiri yi ɔpaa kyɛw.  Princess daa no adi sɛ wanyinsɛn  na wapere sɛ obetua ne ka fi bere a polisifo atumfoɔ kyeree ne hokafo no.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Cecilia Koranteng-Addow
text:
Cecilia Koranteng-Addow (woo Gaisie, 24 May 1936 – 30 June 1982) yɛ asɛnnibea Kunini temmufo wɔ Ghana firi afe 1975 kɔsii sɛ wɔkyeree no na wɔkumm no wɔ 30 June 1982, wɔ Jerry Rawlings asraafoɔ nnisoɔ a ɛtɔ so mmienu mu.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Cecilia Afran Gaisie wɔ Assin Nsuta, Gold Coast (mprempren Ghana) wɔ afe 1936  maa Philip Afran Gaisie a ɔyɛ aguadifo ne Mary Adwoa Kwansaa Boafo a ɔyɛ ofiehwɛfo ne Cecilia agya yerenom baanum no mu biako. Na ɔyɛ Adansi Medoma Ahemfo Asenie abusua no muni.

Cecilia kɔɔ mfitiase sukuu wɔ Roman Katolek Sukuu a ɛwɔ Assin Anyinabrim, ne Assin Edubiase Methodist Sukuu a ɛbɛn Assin Nsuta . Afei ɔkɔɔ ntoaso sukuu wɔ Cape Coast a ɛbɛn hɔ no, na odii kan kɔɔ mfinimfini sukuu wɔ Our Lady of Apostles (OLA) College of Education na afei owiee ne ntoaso sukuu wɔ Holy Child High School . Wɔ 1959 mu no, Cecilia tu kɔɔ United Kingdom baabi a osuaa LLB mmara wɔ Hull Sukuupɔn mu . Wɔfrɛɛ no kɔɔ asanombea a ɛwɔ Lincoln's Inn wɔ London wɔ afe 1963.

Adwuma 
Bere a Cecilia wiee ne sukuupɔn wɔ UK no, ɔsan kɔɔ Ghana wɔ afe 1964 mu na ofii ase yɛɛ adwuma sɛ mmaranimfo wɔ kokoam mmara adwumayɛbea a ɛwɔ Opoku Acheampong and Company. Awiei koraa no, Ghana Atemmu Dwumadibea no faa no sɛ ɔtemmufo . Bere a Cecilia yɛɛ adwuma mfe pii sɛ ɔtemmufo wɔ Ghana mantam asennibea ne ɔmansin asennibea no, wɔpaw Cecilia sɛ Asɛnnibea Kunini temmufo wɔ afe 1975 mu, saa dibea a odii mu kosii ne wu mu wɔ afe 1982.

Wɔ 1980 mu no, Cecilia buu atɛn de gyinaa aguadifo bi a wɔfrɛ no Owura Shackleford a wɔde no too afiase wɔ 1979 ɔman anidan a Jerry Rawlings dii anim no mu no akyi . Cecilia kae sɛ ntease biara nni hɔ a enti wɔde no too afiase na ɔhyɛɛ sɛ wogyae no. Cecilia ne ɔtemmufoɔ a ɔdi kan a ɔgyee nsakraeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛwɔ Armed Forces Revolutionary Council (AFRC) a wɔde hyɛɛ 1979 amansan mmara mu no ho kyim na ɔmaa AFRC deɛ wɔabu no fɔ no nyaa ahofadie. Ɔsan nso sii asɛm bi a ɛfa Ghana Industrial Holding Corporation (GIHOC) adwumayɛfo a wɔyɛ basabasa a wɔtow hyɛɛ mmrahyɛbagua so wɔ Ghana Third Republic no ho gyinae.  Akyiri yi Joachim Amartey Quaye, adwumayɛfo a wɔyɛ basabasa no akannifo no mu biako bɛyɛɛ Rawlings Bere Tiaa mu Ɔman Bammɔ Bagua (PNDC) a na ɛyɛ kuw a edi tumi bere a wokum Cecilia wɔ 1982 mu no muni. Akyiri yi wodii Amartey Quaye asɛm na wobuu no fɔ wɔ dwuma a odii wɔ Cecilia kum no mu no ho

Ankorankoro asetra 
Cecilia kunu a odi kan ne Nicholas Liverpool, a ɔkɔɔ so yɛɛ Dominica ɔmampanyin a ɔto so asia fi afe 2003 kosi afe 2012. Cecilia ne Nicholas hyiae bere a na wɔresua ade wɔ Hull Sukuupɔn mu no na wɔwaree wɔ 1963 mu. Wɔboom woo mma baanan. Wɔ 1969 mu no, wogyaee aware, na wɔ 1974 mu no, Cecilia waree Gustav Koranteng-Addow, ɔtemmufo a ɔyɛɛ Ghana Mmaranimfo Panyin fi 1975 kosi 1979. Cecilia ne Gustav nam adwuma so hyiae na wɔkɔɔ so waree kosii sɛ Cecilia wui wɔ 1982 mu. Wɔannya mma abom.

Owu ne agyapade 
Wɔkyeree Cecilia na wokum no wɔ kokoam wɔ June 30, 1982, ne Asɛnnibea Kunini no atemmufo baanu foforo, Frederick Poku Sarkodee ne Kwadjo Adgyei Agyepong, ne asraafo panyin bi a wakɔ pɛnhyen, Sam Acquah, wɔ Rawlings asraafo nniso a ɛto so abien no mu. Na Rawlings atu Ɔmampanyin Hilla Limann afi n’ahenni so wɔ atuatew mu wɔ December 31, 1981 mu. Awudisɛm no sii wɔ Bundase asraafo atuo a wɔtow wɔ Accra Asasetaw so wɔ nnɔnhwerew a na wɔahyɛ sɛ wɔmfa nkɔ baabiara anadwo no mu. Wohuu wɔn afunu a wɔahyew no wɔ beae koro no ara da a edi hɔ no. Wɔ nhyɛso a emu yɛ den a ɛbaa Rawlings ne PNDC so akyi no, aban no hyehyɛɛ Nhwehwɛmu Bagua Titiriw bi sɛ wɔnhwehwɛ awudi ahorow no mu. Wɔ afe 1992 mu no, The Independent bɔɔ amanneɛ sɛ wohui wɔ nhwehwɛmu a Special Investigation Board no yɛe wɔ Ghana, a wɔkae sɛ ɛkamfoo kyerɛe sɛ wɔmfa nnipa 10 nkɔ asɛnnibea wɔ awudisɛm no ho, a Ghana ɔman ahobammɔ so panyin a na ɔwɔ hɔ saa bere no Kojo Tsikata ka ho. Tsikata a na ɔyɛ Rawlings nsa nifa no de asɛm kɔdan The Independent wɔ March 26, 1993 mu sɛ ɔbɛsɛe ne din, na ɔpenee so sɛ obegyae bere a The Independent tintim nteɛso asɛm bi wɔ September 1998 mu, a wɔmaa emu daa hɔ sɛ na ɛnyɛ wɔn adwene sɛ wɔbɛkyerɛ saa Tsikata dii fɔ wɔ nsɛmmɔnedi no ho.  Wɔbɔɔ Lance Corporal Amedeka, Michael Senyah, Tekpor Hekli, Johnny Dzandu ne Joachim Amartey Quaye sobo wɔ awudisɛm no ho wɔ afe 1983 mu. Wɔ June 1983 mu, ansa na wɔrewie asɛnni no, Amedeka guan fii Nsawam ne Ussher Fort afiase a na wɔde wɔn gu mu no mu na ofii Ghana. Wobuu Senya, Hekli, Dzandu ne Amartey Quaye fɔ sɛ wɔadi awu, wobuu wɔn kumfɔ na wɔde atuo kum wɔn.

Wɔkae Cecilia ne atemmufo baanu a aka a wokunkum wɔn no wɔ afe afe atemmu dwumadi bi mu wɔ wɔn wu afeda a wɔfrɛ no Agyidifo Da, wɔ Ghana. Mmara nniso no Nkaedi a atemmufo baasa a wokunkum wɔn no nyinaa ahoni ka ho no gyina Ghana Asɛnnibea Kunini no adan anim nnɛ.

Wɔde Esi Afran Fapem no sii hɔ de kaee Cecilia wɔ afe 2011 mu, ne mmofraberem adamfo Josephine van Lare ne ne mma baanu, Philip Liverpool ne Nana Ama Brantuo (née Liverpool), a wɔn botaeɛ ne sɛ wɔbɛma mmabaa asetena atu mpɔn denam nwomasua ne nteteeɛ so . Mprempren fapem no reyɛ adwuma de ama nhomasua gyinapɛn atu mpɔn wɔ Ghana denam sika fam mmoa ne afotu a wɔde ma ahyehyɛde afoforo a wɔde wɔn adwene si nhomasua so no so.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Mary Winfred Koranteng
text:
Na Mary Winfred Koranteng yɛ Ghana ɔman adwumayɛni ne ɔmanyɔni . Ɔyɛɛ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua no muni fi afe 1960 kosi afe 1966. Efi 1960 kosi 1965 no, na ɔyɛ Apuei Fam Mantam no muni a ɔto so abien, na efi 1965 kosi 1966 no, na ɔyɛ Swedru-Achiase mmrahyɛbaguani.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Koranteng wɔ December 25, 1922 wɔ Achiase . Ɔnyaa ne mfitiaseɛ nwomasua wɔ Mmofraturo Sukuu mu, faako a ɔnyaa ne Standard Seven Certificate wɔ 1940 mu berɛ a ɔwiee sukuu no.

Adwuma ne amammuisɛm 
Koranteng fii ase sɛ ntadehyɛfo wɔ 1944 mu bere a na ɔwɔ sotɔɔ bi a wɔtɔn wax nkyerɛwee mu no. Ɔtraa Achiase kosii afe 1960 bere a wɔpaw no sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ mmrahyɛbagua wɔ afe 1960. Sɛ ntadehyɛ da nkyɛn a, na Koranteng nso de ne ho hyɛ nnua adwuma mu, na osiesie nnua ho kwan maa nnua aguadifo. Wɔ afe 1960 mu no, na Koranteng ka mmea a wodii kan hyɛn Ghana mmrahyɛbagua no mu wɔ ɔmanfo (mmea asɔremma) mmara ase. Ná ɔka mmea 10 a wɔpaw wɔn a wɔansɔre atia wɔn wɔ June 27, 1960 wɔ Convention People’s Party no tekiti so no ho . Ná ɔyɛ Apuei Fam Mantam no muni a ɔto so abien . Wɔ afe 1965 mu no, wɔyɛɛ no mmrahyɛbaguani maa Swedru-Achease kosii afe 1966 mu bere a wotuu Nkrumah aban no gui no.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Owiee sukuu akyi bere tiaa bi no ɔwaree Owura Asafu-Adjei kosii 1943 mu bere a owui no. Ɔwaree bio wɔ afe 1951 mu ne Kwame Nkrumah,  Ghana ɔmampanyin a odi kan, na wɔboom woo ɔbabea. Wɔ 1955 mu no, wogyaee aware no. Akyiri yi ɔwoo mma baanan foforo a wofi fekuw ne aware afoforo mu.

title: Jennifer Cudjoe
text:
Jennifer Cudjoe (wɔwoo no 7 Oforisuo 1994) yɛ Ghana bɔɔlbɔfoɔ a ɔyɛ adwumaden a ɔbɔ sɛ mfimfini bɔɔlbɔfoɔ ma NJ/NY Gotham FC wɔ Ɔman Mmea Bɔɔlbɔ Kuo (NWSL).

Club adwuma

Sky Blue FC 
Cudjoe de ne nsa hyɛɛ bere tiaa mu apam ase ne Sky Blue FC maa 2020 NWSL Challenge Cup . Ɔdii kan dii kan wɔ NWSL mu wɔ 30 June 2020.

Cudjoe na Racing Louisville FC paw no wɔ 2020 NWSL Expansion Draft,  nanso ankyɛ na Sky Blue nyaa n’akyi wɔ aguadi bi mu.
