title: Berɛ tenten mu wien bɔberɛ
text:
Wim tebea ne wim tebea a ɛtra hɔ kyɛ wɔ beae bi, na sɛ wɔkyekyem pɛpɛɛpɛ a, ɛboro mfe aduasa. Nea ɛyɛ katee kɛse no, ɛyɛ wim tebea mu nsakrae ahorow a ɛkɔ so wɔ bere tenten a efi asram kosi mfe ɔpepem pii mu ne sɛnea ɛsakrasakra. Wim tebea mu nsakrae ahorow a wɔtaa susuw no bi ne ɔhyew, wim nhyɛso, mframa, ne osutɔ . Beae bi wim tebea nya nkɛntɛnso wɔ ne latitude / longitude, asase, sorokɔ, asase a wɔde di dwuma ne nsu a ɛbɛn ne ne nsu a ɛsen no so.

Wim tebea ( from Tete Hela kasa κλίμα na ɛwɔ hɔ ‘inclination’ ) no, wɔtaa kyerɛkyerɛ mu sɛ wim tebea a wɔkyekyem pɛpɛɛpɛ wɔ bere tenten mu..Bere a wɔde gyina hɔ ma sɛ wɔkyekyem pɛpɛɛpɛ no yɛ mfe aduasa, nanso wobetumi de mmere afoforo adi dwuma a egyina atirimpɔw no so. Wim tebea nso ka akontaabu a ɛnyɛ nea wɔkyekyem pɛpɛɛpɛ te sɛ nsakrae kɛse a ɛba da biara da anaa afe biara mu no ho. Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change(IPCC) 2001 nsɛmfua nkyerɛaseɛ te sɛ nea edidi so yi:

 

World Meteorological Organization(WMO) ka " wim tebea a ɛfata " ho asɛm sɛ "nsɛntitiriw a wim tebea ho animdefo de di dwuma na ɔde toto wim tebea ho nsɛm a ɛkɔ so mprempren ho toto nea atwam anaa nea wobu no sɛ ɛyɛ nea ɛtaa ba ho. Wɔkyerɛ wim tebea a ɛfata ase sɛ akontaabu mu nkyɛmu a ɛwɔ wim tebea mu ade bi (sɛ nhwɛso no, ɔhyew) mu wɔ mfe aduasa mu. Wɔde mfeɛ aduasa bere di dwuma efisɛ ɛware sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobetumi ayi nsakrae anaa nneɛma a ɛnteɛ biara a ɛba afe ntam te sɛ El Niño–Southern Oscillation, nanso ɛyɛ tiaa nso sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ebetumi ada wim tebea a ɛware adi." 

World Meteorological Organization(WMO)  no fii Amanaman Ntam Wim Tebea Ho Ahyehyɛde a ɛhyehyɛɛ mfiridwuma ho bagua bi a ɛhwɛ wim tebea ho wɔ afe 1929 mu no mu. Wɔ ne 1934 Wiesbaden nhyiam ase no mfiridwuma bagua no paw mfe aduasa bere a efi 1901 kosi 1930 sɛ bere a wɔde bɛhwɛ wim tebea ho gyinapɛn a ɛfata. Wɔ afe 1982 mu no WMO penee so sɛ wɔbɛma wim tebea a ɛfata ayɛ foforo, na akyiri yi wogyinaa wim tebea ho nsɛm a efi January 1, 1961 kosi December 31, 1990 so wiee eyinom 1961-1990 wim tebea a ɛfata no yɛ bere a wɔde gyina so. Wim tebea ho nhyehyɛe a edi hɔ a WMO betintim no fi 1991 kosi 2010. Sɛ yɛde nneɛma a wɔboaboa ano firi wim nsakraeɛ a ɛtaa ba (mframa hyeɛ, nhyɛsoɔ, osutɔ ne mframa) mu to nkyɛn a, nsakraeɛ foforɔ te sɛ nsuo a ɛyɛ nwini, nea wotumi hu, mununkum dodoɔ, owia hann, asase mu hyeɛ, pan mu nsuo a ɛyɛ hyew, nna a aprannaa bɛbɔ ne nna a aprannaa bɛtɔ nso wɔ hɔ wɔaboaboa ano de asusuw nsakrae a ɛba wim tebea mu.

Wɔde kasasin a agye din a ɛne "Wim tebea ne nea wohwɛ kwan, wim tebea ne nea wunya" no bɔ nsonsonoe a ɛda wim tebea ne wim tebea ntam no mua wɔ ɔkwan a mfaso wɔ so.  Wɔ abakɔsɛm mu bere tenten mu no, ɛkame ayɛ sɛ nneɛma ahorow bi wɔ hɔ a ɛsakra daa a ɛkyerɛ wim tebea, a nea ɛka ho ne latitude, sorokɔ, asase ne nsu fã, ne po ne mmepɔw a ɛbɛn. Saa nneɛma a ɛsakra yi nyinaa sesa wɔ mfe ɔpepem pii mu nkutoo esiane nneɛma a ɛkɔ so te sɛ plate tectonics nti . Nneɛma afoforo a ɛkyerɛ wim tebea yɛ nea ɛyɛ nnam kɛse: po no mu thermohaline a ɛkyinkyini no ma 5 °C (41) a ɛwɔ hɔ °F) Atlantic Po no atifi fam hyew a ɛba bere a wɔde toto po mu nsukorabea afoforo ho no. Po mu nsu afoforo san kyekyɛ ɔhyew mu wɔ asase ne nsu ntam wɔ ɔmantam mu kɛse. Afifide a ɛdɔɔso ne sɛnea ɛkata so no ka owia hyew a ɛtwetwe, nsu a ɛkora so, ne osu a ɛtɔ wɔ ɔmantam no mu. Nsakrae a ɛba wim mframa a ɛma wim yɛ hyew dodow mu na ɛkyerɛ owia ahoɔden dodow a okyinnsoromma yi kura, na ɛde wiase nyinaa hyew anaasɛ wiase nyinaa onwini ba . Nsakraeɛ a ɛkyerɛ wim tebea no dɔɔso na nkitahodiɛ no yɛ den, nanso wɔpene so sɛ wɔte nsɛm a ɛtrɛ no ase, anyɛ yie koraa no, ɛfa nneɛma a ɛkyerɛ abakɔsɛm mu wim nsakraeɛ ho.

Wim tebea mu nkyekyem ahorow 

Wim tebea mu nkyekyem yɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛkyekyɛ wiase wim tebea mu akuwakuw. Ebia wim tebea mu nkyekyem bi ne biome nkyekyem bi wɔ abusuabɔ kɛse, efisɛ wim tebea yɛ nkɛntɛnso kɛse wɔ asetra so wɔ ɔmantam bi mu. Nea wɔde di dwuma kɛse no mu biako ne Köppen wim tebea mu nkyekyem nhyehyɛe a wodii kan yɛe wɔ afe 1899 mu no

Akwan pii wɔ hɔ a wɔfa so kyekyɛ wim tebea mu ma ɛyɛ nniso ahorow a ɛte saa ara. Mfiase no, wɔkyerɛɛ wim tebea ase wɔ Tete Hela mu de kyerɛkyerɛ wim tebea a egyina beae bi latitude so. Wobetumi akyekyɛ nnɛyi akwan a wɔfa so kyekyɛ wim tebea mu no mu kɛse ayɛ no awosu mu akwan, a ɛtwe adwene si nea ɛde wim tebea ba so, ne akwan a wɔfa so hwehwɛ nneɛma mu, a ɛtwe adwene si nea wim tebea de ba so. Nhwɛsoɔ a ɛfa awosuo mu nkyekyɛmu ho ne akwan a egyina mpɛn dodoɔ a mframa dodoɔ ahodoɔ anaa mmeaeɛ a ɛwɔ synoptic wim tebea mu basabasayɛ mu no so. Nhwɛsoɔ a ɛfa nkyekyɛmu a wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ mu no bi ne wimu tebea a wɔakyerɛkyerɛ mu denam afifideɛ a ɛtumi gyina ano,  evapotranspiration, anaa nea ɛboro so no Köppen wim tebea nkyekyɛmu a mfitiaseɛ no wɔyɛɛ no sɛ wɔde bɛkyerɛ wim tebea a ɛbata biomes binom ho. Sintɔ a ɛtaa ba wɔ saa nkyekyɛmu nhyehyɛe ahorow yi mu ne sɛ ɛma ahye soronko ba mmeae a wɔkyerɛkyerɛ mu no ntam, sen sɛ ɛbɛma wim tebea mu nneɛma a abu so kɛse wɔ abɔde mu no bɛsakra nkakrankakra.

Wien bɔberɛ nsakrae 

Wim bɔberɛ nsakrae yɛ nsakrae a ɛba wiase nyinaa anaa ɔmantam mu wim tebea mu bere a bere kɔ so no.  Ɛda nsakrae a ɛba wɔ wim tebea a ɛsakra anaasɛ sɛ wɔkyekyem pɛpɛɛpɛ no mu wɔ bere nsenia a efi mfe du du kosi mfe ɔpepem pii mu adi. Saa nsakrae yi betumi afi nneɛma a ɛkɔ so wɔ Asase no mu, tumi a efi akyi (sɛ nhwɛso no, nsakrae a ɛba owia hann ahoɔden mu) anaa, nnansa yi ara, nnipa dwumadi ahorow mu aba.   Wɔ nnansa yi dwuma a wɔde di dwuma mu, titiriw wɔ nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia ho nhyehyɛe mu no, asɛmfua "wim nsakrae" taa kyerɛ nsakrae a ɛba nnɛyi wim tebea mu nkutoo, a nea ɛka ho ne ɔhyew a ɛkɔ soro wɔ asase ani a wɔkyekyem pɛpɛɛpɛ a wonim no sɛ wiase nyinaa hyew . Wɔ tebea horow bi mu no, wɔde asɛmfua no nso di dwuma de susuw sɛ nnipa na ɛde ba, sɛnea ɛte wɔ Amanaman Nkabom Apam a Ɛfa Wim Tebea Nsakrae Ho (UNFCCC) mu no. UNFCCC de "wim tebea mu nsakrae" di dwuma ma nsakrae a ɛnyɛ nnipa de ba.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Doris Dartey
text:
Doris Yaa Korantenmaa Dartey (wuiɛ 19 July 2020) yɛ Ghana nkitahodiɛ ho ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo, ɔfotufo ne berɛ bi a ɔyɛ GJA Awards Committee no muni ne guamtrani. Na ɔyɛ Graphic Communications Group Limited a ɛwɔ Ghana no guamtrani.

Nwomasua 
Dartey suaa ade wɔ Cape Coast Sukuupɔn mu, faako a owiee BA wɔ nhomasua mu. Ɔsan nso nyaa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ne nnipadɔm nkitahodi ho adansedi krataa a ɔde wiei fii Nkitahodi Adesua Sukuu a ɛwɔ Ghana Sukuupɔn mu, ne MA wɔ amanaman ntam nsɛm mu (nkɔso nkitahodi), mmea adesua ho adansedi krataa a owiee ne PhD wɔ ahyehyɛde nkitahodi mu wɔ Ohio Sukuupɔn mu wɔ U.S.

Adwuma 
Na ɔyɛ nkitahodi ho ɔfotufo na ɔyɛɛ adwuma maa nnwuma a wɔn a wɔde mmoa ma no tua ho ka te sɛ African Union Commission, African Development Bank, UNESCO, GIZ, ne afoforo.

Ɔsan nso yɛɛ Ɔman Nsɛm ho Amanneɛbɔ Bagua no muni ansa na ɔrebɛyɛ GCGL mpanyimfo bagua no guamtrani . Ɔkyerɛɛ nkitahodi adesua wɔ USA ne Ghana wɔ Dayton Sukuupɔn, Mount Mercy Sukuupɔn, GIMPA, ne GIJ .

Ná ɔyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo na na ɔyɛ dwumadi ahorow bi  wɔ Ghana mfe bi. Ɔsan nso kyerɛw asɛm bi wɔ The Spectator atesɛm krataa mu wɔ Ghana a wɔfrɛ no The WatchWoman a ɛkaa nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia, ahotew, akwahosan, mmofra ne ɔmanfo nsɛm afoforo ho asɛm. Na ɔyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo, nkitahodifo ne ɔmanfo ntam abusuabɔ ho adwumayɛfo pii fotufo wɔ Ghana.

Owuo 
Owui wɔ KBTH wɔ Accra Kwasida, 19 July 2020 bere a owui wɔ nufu mu kokoram ho nsɛnnennen mu no. Wɔsiee no wɔ Lashibi Ayiyɛbea, beae bi a ɛbɛn Tema .

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Kokui Selormey Hanson
text:
Kokui Selormey Hanson, wɔsan frɛ no Kokui Selormey (wɔwoo no 4 Ɔbɛnem 1978) yɛ Ghana nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo nipa, ɔyɛkyerɛfo, broadcast journalist, producer, event host, odwontofo ne adwumayɛfo.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Kokui yɛ kan amanyɔni Victor Selormey babea. Owiee ne mfitiase nhomasua wɔ Ridge Asɔre Sukuu mu na onyaa ne ntoaso sukuu wɔ Holy Child Senior High School, Cape Coast . Ɔyɛɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow wɔ Allen Academy, Texas, ansa na ɔresua Nnwom ne Agoruhwɛbea wɔ Spelman College, Atlanta na akyiri yi onyaa nkɔso kɔɔ New England Conservatory of Music (NEC), Boston kɔyɛɛ master’s degree.

Adwuma 
Kokui yɛɛ adwuma wɔ afe 2009 mu, ne Ghana Ɔman Adwumayɛbea. Akyiri yi ɔtu kɔɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfoɔ atenaeɛ, ne Citi FM, sɛ ɔboafoɔ wɔ The Citi Breakfast Show ne ɔhwɛfoɔ wɔ Classic Citi saa berɛ no, sɛ ɔyɔnko ahɔhoɔ ne nsɛm a wɔde yɛ adwuma wɔ Viasat 1 ’s program, This Morning (2012-2016), a ɔne Patrice Amegashie ka ho .  Ɔsan nso na ɔdii kan de Healthline, TV so dwumadi bi a Vodafone Ghana boa . Na Kokui yɛ Head Start a ɛwɔ Kwesé TV so no ho ɔyɛkyerɛfo ne nea ɔyɛe. Ɔsan nso yɛɛ dwumadi afoforo ( Home Run ne Final Whistle ) wɔ saa nkitahodibea koro no ara so.

Sɛ odwontofo no, Kokui ayɛ nnwom wɔ Nubian Noel, Buronya nnwom a agye din album bi a ɔne South Africa nnwontofo a ɔyɛ anansesɛm Hugh Masekela . Ɔyɛ n’adwene sɛ obefi nnwom adwuma bi ase a Afrikafo amammerɛ nnwom ne ne nnwom kwan a wɔadi afra wom.

Wɔ afe 2014 mu no, wɔpaw no sɛ ɔnanmusifo ma Philips Avent ’s Mfirihyia 30 Afahyɛ a ɛwɔ Ghana. Kokui yɛ brand influencer ma Vlisco wɔ Ghana na wayɛ awofoɔ ambassador ama SKY Girls Ghana firi afe 2017. Ɔde ne fashion brand sii hɔ wɔ afe 2018.

Kokui yɛɛ Ghana Virtual Career Fair a edi kan wɔ July 2020 mu, a Ghana-German Center for Jobs, Migration and Reintegration (GGC) na ɛyɛɛ ho nhyehyɛe, a wɔne German Industry and Commerce Delegation in Ghana (AHK Ghana) ne Ministry of Employment yɛɛ biako ne Adwumayɛfo Abusuabɔ, a wɔde sika fi Germany Nkɔso Kuw no hɔ.

Ɔsan kɔka Citi FM anɔpa dwumadi The Citi Breakfast Show kuw no ho, a Bernard Avle, Kojo Akoto Boateng, Nathan Quao ne Godfred Akoto Boafo na wɔwom.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Wɔ afe 2011 mu no, Kokui waree Kobbi Hanson a mprempren ɔne no wɔ mma baanan. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔbɔɔ amanneɛ no de ne ho hyɛɛ ayaresabea drama bi a wɔato din ‘Accra Medic’ mu.

Abasobɔde ahorow 
Kokui dii nkonim wɔ 2016 Television Mmea Ɔyɛkyerɛfoɔ a ɔsen biara wɔ afe no mu ne 2016 Television Anɔpa Dwumadie Ho Ɔhwɛfoɔ a ɔsen biara wɔ afe no mu, wɔ 2016 Radio ne Television Personality Awards.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Wasila Diwura-Soale
text:
Wasila Diwura-Soale (wɔwoo no 1 September 1996) yɛ Ghana bɔɔlbɔfo a ɔbɔ sɛ mfimfini bɔɔlbɔfo ma Ghana mmaa ɔman kuo . Diwura-Soale bɔɔ bɔɔl maa Ghana wɔ U-17 level wɔ afe 2012 mu na ɔkaa Black Maidens kuw a wɔdii nea ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa wɔ 2012 World Cup a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Azerbaijan no ho. Ɔsan nso dii dwuma maa Ghana U-20 kuw, Black Princesses, wɔ afe 2014 ne 2016 Wiase Kupɔn a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Canada ne Papua New Guinea no mu.

Club adwuma 
Diwura-Soale fii ne bɔɔlbɔ adwuma a ɛyɛ adwumayɛfo de ase wɔ Ghana Mmea Premier League kuw Hasaacas Ladies . Wɔ ne berɛ a ɔne kuro no mu no, ɔdii nkonim wɔ apam no mu wɔ mmerɛ mmiɛnsa a ɛtoatoa soɔ mu wɔ afe 2012 ne 2015 ntam. Wɔ ne bere so no ɔne agodifo te sɛ Jennifer Cudjoe, Janet Egyir, Elizabeth Cudjoe ne Lily Niber-Lawrence dii agoru .

Kɔlege adwuma

Navarro Bulldogs, afe 2017–2018 
Wɔ afe 2017 mu no, Diwura-Soale tu kɔɔ Amerika wɔ ne agodie a ɔne Ghana U-20 dii wɔ 2016 FIFA U-20 Women’s World Cup no akyi. Ɔde ne ho kɔbɔɔ Navarro College wɔ Corsicana, Texas, maa ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo panyin Alicia Wilson . Wilson maa Diwura-Soale gye dii sɛ onni abodin krataa sɛ n’ahosiesie a ɔde bɛkɔ akɔyɛ adwumaden no fã bere a na ɔpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ bɔɔlbɔ adwuma a ɛyɛ adwumaden ntɛm ara no. Wɔ ne bere a edi kan mu no, ɔboaboaa nkontimmaa 36 ano wɔ bere a ɔbɔɔ bɔɔl 12 a bɔɔl 4 a odii nkonim wɔ akansi mu ka ho na ɔboaa 12 wɔ agoru 17 mu no.

Afe a ɛdi hɔ no, ɔnyaa nkɔsoɔ wɔ ne berɛ a atwam no mu denam nkontabuo 52 a ɔboaboaa ano denam botaeɛ 18 a ɔde bɔɔl 5 a ɔdii nkonim wɔ agodie mu ne mmoa 16 a ɔboaa wɔ agodie 19 mu ka ho de boaa wɔn ma wɔduruu National Junior College Athletic Association (NJCAA) mu.  Ne dwumadie a ɛda nsow paa ne 5 September 2018 berɛ a ɔbɔɔ bɔɔl anum na ɔboaa mmiɛnsa wɔ nkonimdie 11–0 wɔ Northeast Texas so .  Wɔ ne mfeɛ mmienu adwumayɛ mu wɔ Bulldogs, na ɔyɛ mprenu, NJCAA First Team All-American, a ɛmaa ɔbɛyɛɛ Navarro agofoɔ a ɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa wɔ abakɔsɛm mu a ɔnyaa saa anuonyam no.  Sɛ wɔka ne nyinaa bom a, ɔboaboaa nkontabuo 88 ano, ɔbɔɔ bɔɔl 30, ɔbɔɔ bɔɔl akron a ɔdii nkonim wɔ agodie mu na ɔboaa 28 wɔ agodie 36 mu wɔ ne mmerɛ mmienu a ɔde traa Navarro no mu.  Wɔ May 2018 mu no, ɔyɛɛ Navarro College spring President ne Dean’s Lists wɔ ne adesua mu nkɔsoɔ nti.

Lamar Awuraa Kardinalfoɔ, afe 2019 
Bere a ɔne Navarro dii mfe abien akyi no, ɔdan kɔɔ Lamar Sukuupɔn mu baabi a ɔde ne ho bɔɔ Lamar Lady Cardinals wɔ afe 2019. Ɔnyaa mfitiaseɛ pa wɔ Lamar denam ahyɛaseɛ a ɔhyɛɛ aseɛ wɔ nhyiamu anan a ɛdi kan no mu na ɔde mmoa baako maeɛ nanso wɔtew ne berɛ so wɔ berɛ a ɔfaa opira a ɛde ne ho too ne nkyɛn maa 2019 berɛ no nkaeɛ no. Wɔ bere a ne ho tɔɔ no mu no osusuw ho sɛ obegyae bɔɔlbɔ.

LSU Asono, 2020– 2020. 
Wɔ May 2020 mu no, ɔtu kɔɔ Louisiana State University na ɔde ne ho kɔbɔɔ LSU Tigers kuo no, na ɔbɛyɛɛ Afrikani bɔɔlbɔfoɔ a ɔdi kan a ɔdii kan bɔɔ bɔɔl maa Tigers. Ɔnyaa nkɛntɛnsoɔ ntɛm ara wɔ ekuo no so wɔ ne berɛ a ɛdi kan no mu, ɔdii agorɔ 19 berɛ a ɔboaa 4, a ɛyɛ kɛseɛ paa wɔ ekuo no mu.  Wɔ August 2021 mu no, owiee Louisiana State University na ɔnyaa abodin krataa wɔ nnipa ho adesua ne asetena mu nyansahu mu.

Amanaman ntam adwuma

Babunu 
Diwura-Soale dii kan wɔ ne mmerantebere mu maa Ghana maa wɔn a wonnii mfe 17 wɔ afe 2012. Wɔ October 2012 mu no, na Diwura-Soale ka Ghana kuw a wonnii mfe 17 no ho a wowiee nea ɛto so abiɛsa denam Germany so nkonim wɔ nea ɛto so abiɛsa mu wɔ 2012 FIFA U-17 Mmea Wiase Kupɔn a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Azerbaijan no mu . Wɔ akansi no mu no, odii agoru asia no mu anum.

Wɔ afe 2014 mu no, na ɔka kuw a wɔdii mfeɛ aduonu a wɔdii agorɔ wɔ afe 2014 FIFA U-20 Mmea Wiase Kupɔn a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Canada no ho . Afe a ɛdi hɔ no, Diwura-Soale dii dwuma titire wɔ 2015 African U-20 Women’s World Cup Qualifying Tournament, na ɔboaa Ghana ma wɔfatae maa 2016 FIFA U-20 Women’s World Cup wɔ Papua New Guinea .  Ɔyɛɛ kuw a etwa to maa wiase kuruwa no na ɔdii agoru wɔ kuw no mu akansi abiɛsa no nyinaa mu efisɛ Ghana fii mu wɔ saa bere no mu.

Panin 
Wɔ July 2016 mu no, Yusif Basigi frɛɛ Diwura-Soale kɔɔ senior team no mu sɛ ɔne Germany bɛbɔ adamfofa akansi. Wɔ 22 July 2016, ɔyɛɛ ne debut maa Black Queens wɔ animguase 11–0 nkogudi wɔ Germany, ɔhyɛɛ agorudi no ase, dii agoru simma 51 ansa na wɔde no sii Mary Essiful ananmu. Wɔ ɔman no mu ahomegyeɛ mfeɛ nnan akyi no, Diwura-Soale nyaa ɔfrɛ sɛ ɔbɛkɔ ɔman kuo a ɛwɔ mpaninfoɔ mu wɔ July 2021 mu ansa na Aisha Buhari Kuruwa ne 2022 Africa Women Cup of Nations qualifiers a wɔne Nigeria bedi . Ɔdii Aisha Buhari Kuruwa no mu akansi a ɛdi kan ne South Africa mmaa ɔman kuo wɔ 17 September 2021, a Ghana dii nkoguo 3–0.

title: Victoria Agyei
text:
Victoria Agyei (wɔwoo no 15 May 1996 ) yɛ Ghana bɔɔlbɔfo a ɔbɔ sɛ bɔɔlbɔfo ma Ghana mmaa ɔman bɔɔlbɔ kuo .

Club adwuma 
Wɔ August 2021 mu no, ɔde ne nsa hyɛɛ afe apam ase ne Ergotelis WFC . Ansa na ɔrebɛka Ergotelis ho wɔ Greece no, na Agyei wɔ adwuma no mu ma Kumasi Sport Academy Ladies FC

Amanaman ntam adwuma 
Agyei kaa Ghana kuw no ho wɔ FIFA 2012 FIFA U-17 Mmea Wiase Kupɔn a wɔyɛe wɔ Azerbaijan no mu . Kuw a ɛhyɛ Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo Mas-Ud Dramani akanni ase no nyaa kɔbere wɔ akansi no mu. Ɔsii akan maa Ghana Black Princesses wɔ afe 2014 ne 2016 FIFA U-20 Mmea Wiase Kupɔn mu wɔ Canada ne Papua New Guinea. Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ Mercy Tagoe-Quarcoo too nsa frɛɛ Agyei sɛ ɔmmɛsi akan mma Ghana Black Queens wɔ Aisha Buhari Cup .

Nidi a wɔde ma 
Ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔdi mu wɔ Nhyiamu no mu – Canada Vs. Ghana ( 2014 FIFA U-20 Mmea Wiase Kupɔn)

title: Regina Antwi
text:
Regina Antwi (wɔwoo no 26 Ɔbɛnem 1995) yɛ Ghana bɔɔlbɔfo a ɔyɛ adwumaden, a ɔbɔ sɛ ɔbɔfo ma 1207 Antalya Spor wɔ Turkey Mmea Bɔɔlbɔ Super League, ne Ghana mmaa ɔman bɔɔlbɔ kuo . Ɔgyinaa Ghana ananmu wɔ U17 level wɔ World Cup mmienu mu wɔ afe 2010 ne 2012 mu . Kan no na ɔbɔ bɔɔl ma Hungary kuw Diósgyőri VTK .

Club adwuma 
Antwi fii n’adwuma ase wɔ Vodafone Ladies ansa na ɔrebɛka Ghatel Ladies Accra ho. Akyiri yi ɔde ne ho bɔɔ Hasaacas Ladies wɔ afe 2012 mu. Na ɔbɛkɔ so abɛyɛ kuw no muni titiriw na waboa kuw no ma wɔadi nkonim wɔ Ghana Mmea Premier League mprɛnsa a ɛtoatoa so ne 2019 Ghana Mmea Akansie Titiriw no mu.

Wɔ afe 2019 mu no, ɔde ne ho bɔɔ Hungary kuw Diósgyőri VTK wɔ mfeɛ mmienu apam mu.  Ɔdii agorɔ maa Női NB I bere bi,  ansa na ɔresan akɔ Ghana akɔka ne kan kuo no ho bio. Ɔsan kɔɔ Hasaacas ansa na 2020–21 bere no reba a ɔboaa kuw no ma wodii nkonim wɔ treble, league, kuruwa ne 2021 WAFU Zone B Tournament a edi kan no mu.

Wɔ afe 2021 mu no, Antwi dan kɔɔ 1207 Antalya Spor sɛ ɔrekɔbɔ wɔ Turkey Mmea Bɔɔlbɔ Super League .

Amanaman ntam adwuma

Babunu 
Antwi dii kan wɔ ne mmerantebere mu maa Ghana wɔ under-17 level wɔ afe 2010 mu. Ɔkɔɔ so bɔɔ bɔɔl maa Ghana wɔ afe 2010 FIFA U-17 Mmea Wiase Kupɔn a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Trinidad ne Tobago .

Bere a onyaa osuahu wɔ afe 2010 de no mu no, wɔfrɛɛ no wɔ August 2012 mu, maa 2012 FIFA U-17 Mmea Wiase Kupɔn a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Azerbaijan . Ɔyɛ agofomma atitiriw no mu biako bere a Ghana kuw a wonnii mfe 17 no wiee nea ɛto so abiɛsa denam Germany a wodii nkonim wɔ nea ɛto so abiɛsa no mu no so . Wɔ akansi no mu no odii agoru asia no nyinaa mu na ne nyinaa dii simma 90.

Panin 
Antwi kaa Ghana kuw a wɔdii nea ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa wɔ 2016 Africa Women Cup of Nations no ho .

Club adwuma 
Badu abɔ bɔɔl ama Hasaacas Ladies wɔ Ghana, na ɔdaa ne ho adi wɔ 2021 CAF Women's Champions League akansi a etwa to no mu .  Ɔtu kɔɔ Norway kuo Avaldsnes IL mu maa afe 2022 berɛ no.

title: Justice Tweneboaa
text:
Justice Tweneboaa (wɔwoo no 28 Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 2001) yɛ Ghana bɔɔlbɔni a ɔbɔ sɛ ɔbɔfo ma Ampem Darkoaa a ɔsan yɛ no captains ne Ghana mmaa ɔman kuo .

Club adwuma 
Tweneboaa fii n'adwuma ase wɔ Ghana Mmea Premier League kuw Ampem Darkoa . Wɔ afe 2020 mu, ansa na 2020–21 bere no reba, wɔpaw no sɛ kuw no panyin .

Amanaman ntam adwuma

Babunu 
Tweneboaa abɔ bɔɔl ama Ghana wɔ U17, U20 ne senior level. Wɔ U17 level no, ɔgyinaa Ghana ananmu wɔ 2018 FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup, faako a ɔdii agorɔ 4 berɛ a Mexico yii Ghana wɔ quarter-finals denam penalty shootout so . Na ɔyɛ nnipa baanu a wɔantumi annye wɔn asotwe no mu biako. Wɔ saa Wiase Kupɔn no mu no ɔne agodifo te sɛ Mukarama Abdulai ne Nina Norshie dii agoru .

Saa afe no ara mu no, na Yusif Basigi afrɛ Tweneboaa aba U20 kuw mu bere a na wadi mfeɛ 16 wɔ July 2018 mu na wɔfrɛɛ no sɛ ɔmmra 2018 FIFA U-20 Mmea Wiase Kupɔn a ɔdii agorɔ wɔ kuw akansi no nyinaa mu.  Wɔ June 2020 mu no, wɔfrɛɛ no sɛ ɔnyɛ agofoɔ mpaninfoɔ no mu baako maa wɔn 2020 FIFA U-20 World Cup qualifying matches ne adamfofa akansi a wɔne Morocco bɛbɔ wɔ August ne October 2020 ntam.

Panin 
Wɔ March 2018 mu no, ɔnyaa ɔman kuo a ɛdi kan a wɔfrɛɛ no ansa na wɔredi adamfofa akansi a wɔne Japan bedi . Ɔdii kan dii kan wɔ 1 April 2018 a na wadi mfeɛ 16 wɔ adamfofa akansi a wɔne Japan dii a Ghana dii nkogu 7–1 Wɔ July 2021 mu no, Tweneboaa yɛɛ kuw a wɔde bɛkɔ Aisha Buhari Cup ne 2022 Africa Women Cup of Nations akansi a wɔne Nigeria bedi . Eyi bae wɔ ne nnwuma a ɛyɛ nwonwa wɔ league no mu a ɛmaa Ampem Darkoa kɔɔ 2nd place wɔ league no mu akyi. Ɔdii kan dii kan wɔ amanaman ntam wɔ Aisha Buhari Kuruwa adamfofa akansi bi mu ne South Africa mmaa ɔman kuo wɔ 17 September 2021.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Patience Peterson-Kundok
text:
Patience Peterson-Kundok (wɔwoo no 29 September 2001) yɛ Ghana bɔɔlbɔni a ɔyɛ adwumaden, a ɔbɔ sɛ mfimfini bɔɔlbɔfo ma Hakkarigücü Spor wɔ Turkey Mmea Bɔɔlbɔ Super League . Na ɔyɛ Ghana ɔman U-17 ne U-20 akuw no muni.

Club adwuma 
Peterson-Kundok bɔɔ bɔɔl maa Ampem Darkoa Ladies FC wɔ ne man Premier League mu . Wɔ afe 2020-21 berɛ mu no, ɔbɔɔ bɔɔl anum wɔ agodie 28 a ɔdiiɛ mu.

Ɔkɔɔ Armenia wɔ August 2021 mu, na ɔde ne ho kɔbɔɔ Noravank SC .    Wɔ October 2022 mu no, otu kɔɔ Turkey na ɔde ne nsa hyɛɛ afe biako apam ase ne Hakkarigücü Spor sɛ ɔbɛbɔ wɔ Women’s Super League .

Amanaman ntam adwuma 
Peterson-Kundok yii ne ho adi mpɛn pii wɔ Ghana ɔman U-17 (Black Maidens) ne U-120 (Black Princesses) akuw mu.  Ɔbɔɔ bɔɔl maa Ghana U-20 kuw no wɔ 2018 FIFA U-20 Mmea Wiase Kupɔn a wɔyɛe wɔ France no mu.  Wɔfrɛɛ no bio kɔɔ U-20 kuw no mu bio maa 2020 FIFA U-20 Mmea Wiase Kupɔn a wɔde bɛkɔ no.

title: Pascaline edward
text:
Pascaline Edwards (wɔwoo no afe 1970) yɛ Ghanani odiyifo, ɔdii nkonim wɔ Ghana Mmea Oyikyerɛfo a Ɔsen Biara wɔ afe 2002.  Wobu Edwards sɛ ɔyɛ diva wɔ Ghana sini mu, na ɔwɔ sini bɛboro ɔha a ɔde kamfo no wɔ adwumayɛfo adwuma a ɔde bɛboro mfe aduonu kakra ayɛ mu. Ɔsan nso ayɛ Nollywood sini ahorow pii. Mprempren, ɔde n’adwuma sɛ odiyifo ne ne sini agodie ntetee sukuu, Film Techniques, ne Ghana apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ a ɛkorɔn no biako, GeoDan Health and Fitness Centre a ɔhwɛ so no bom.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Pascaline Edwards wɔ Lomé, Togo wɔ afe 1970 mu, na ɔbaa Ghana wɔ afe 1986 mu na ɔkɔɔ Ghanatta Senior High School . Ɛkame ayɛ sɛ na onnii ne mmabunbere mu, na ɔmaa n’asɛnka agua so nimdeɛ yɛɛ yiye wɔ 1990 mfe no mfiase mu hɔ sɛ Ghana agodie akuw a wɔsen biara no mu biako, Talent Drama Group.

Adwuma 
Ɔsan kɔɔ asɛnka agua so agodie mu na n’ahomegyeɛ titire no baeɛ ne agodie a ɛyɛ nwonwa a ɛtoatoa soɔ berɛ a wɔde Emancipation Day afahyɛ a wɔde kaee nkoasom a wɔfiri hɔ no baa Ghana wɔ afe 1995 mu.

Ɔdii Fathia Nkrumah, Ghana Ɔmampanyin a odi kan Dr Kwame Nkrumah yere dwumadi wɔ drama bi a wɔyɛe wɔ afahyɛ no mu na ɔyɛɛ kan nkoa aguadifo a na ɔyɛ nnam wɔ nkoatɔn a woyi fi hɔ no yere wɔ drama a wɔato din Abolition (1995) mu. .

Ɛyɛ ne mfonini a ɔyɛe wɔ osuani bi a ne ho yɛ fɛ na ne ho yɛ fɛ, a ɔde n’adamfo bi ahotoso dii dwuma de daadaa n’adamfo no papa na ɔmaa abusua a wɔwɔ anigye yɛɛ basaa, wɔ Stab in the Dark (1997) mu no na ɛde ne sini adwuma no kɔɔ tebea foforo mu na ɛkyerɛɛ no sɛ ɔbɛyɛ mu nsoromma mu hwɛ.

Wɔ Ghanafo sini ahorow a wɔyɛe toatoa so akyi no, n’adwuma no nyaa nkɔso kɛse foforo bere a ofii ase yɛɛ dwumadi atitiriw wɔ Nollywood (Nigeria) sini ahorow mu ne Journey of the Dead (2001).

Edwards hyehyɛɛ sini agodie asoɛeɛ, Film Techniques wɔ afe 2007 mu, sɛ ɔrebɛkyɛ ne suahunu a ɛyɛ fɛ no akyerɛ agodie ne siniyɛfoɔ nkumaa, a wɔwɔ nimdeɛ ne anigyeɛ a wɔde yɛ sini.

Sini ahorow a agye din a ɔyɛɛ mu ɔyɛkyerɛ no bi ne A Stab in the Dark, Forbidden Fruit (2000), The Mask, House Arrest, My Father’s Wife (1998), Messages, Deadline for Asante, Without Her Consent, ne Jewels .

Ankorankoro asetra 
Edwards aware Dan Badu, Commissioner for TV3's Ghana's Strongest IV.

1999 - Ɔde Sekan bɔɔ obi wɔ Esum mu

title: Sherifa Gunu
text:
Sherifa Gunu yɛ Ghana ɔkra nnwontoni. Wɔwoo no sɛ ɔhemmaa wɔ Dagbon Ahemman mu adehye abusua bi mu, wɔ Ghana Atifi Fam Mantam mu. Ná Gunu ani gye nnwom ne asaw ho wɔ ne mmofraase.

Sherifa akɔ asaw akansi ahorow mu wɔ ɔmantam ne ɔman no mu.

Mfitiase asetra 
Wɔwoo Sherifa Gunu wɔ Dagbon Ahemman mu wɔ Ghana Atifi Mantam mu wɔ adehye abusua mu. Ogyaee sukuu wɔ ne mmofraase na akyiri yi osii akan wɔ ɔmantam ne ɔman no mu asaw akansi ahorow nyinaa mu.

Nnwom ho adwuma 
Sherifa Gunu bɛyɛɛ atifi fam Ɔmantam asaw mu ɔkannifo ne nea odi kan a ɔto so abien wɔ 1998 Embassy Pleasure, ɔman asaw akansi a agye din wɔ 1990 mfe no mu. Akyiri yi ɔne nnipa te sɛ Ɔhene Ayisoba ne Terry Bonchaka de ne ho hyɛɛ Hiplife asaw akansi a wɔyɛe wɔ afe 2003 mu no mu . Gunu bɛyɛɛ obi a odi kan a odii kan dii Terry Bonchaka akyi wɔ akansi no awiei. Wɔ afe 2017 mu no, ɔyii ne nnwom bi a wɔato din Salamatu, a ɛno nso yɛ ne nnwom nhoma no mu baako asɛmti. Ɔdaa no adi sɛ nea enti a wɔde single no din too so ne sɛ wobehu sɛnea Afrikafo din ahorow bi yɛ soronko.

Dwumadi ahorow a wɔyɛ 
Sherifa Gunu yɛɛ ne dwumadi wɔ National Theatre maa Zongofest a edi kan, ɔyɛkyerɛ a wɔde hyɛ Zongo nipasu atitiriw anuonyam na wohu mmerante ne mmabaa talente nso. Ɔsan nso bɔɔ nnwom wɔ nnwontofo kuw nnwom ho ɔyɛkyerɛ bi a wɔyɛe wɔ Golden Tulip ahɔhodan mu wɔ Accra bere a wɔrefi Ghana nkitahodi nhyehyɛe a ɛyɛ fɛ a wɔfrɛ no ‘Corporate Wednesday’ ase, ɔyɛkyerɛ a ɛhwehwɛ sɛ ɛbɛka nnwuma mufo nyinaa abom ama nkitahodi wɔ wɔn ntam.

Bio nso, wayɛ backings ama Kojo Antwi, Amakye Dede, Daddy Lumba, Nana Acheampong ne Sarkodie na ne nyinaa mu no wayɛ album abiɛsa.

Nea ɔto so 1, 1998 Ɔman Asaw Nkonimdi (The Embassy Pleasure).

Nea ɔto so 1, 2003 Hiplife Asaw Nkonimdi.

title: Estelle Akofio-Sowah
text:
Estelle Akofio-Sowah yɛ Scotland na wɔwoo no, ɔyɛ Ghana aguadifo na mprempren CSquared Ghana Ɔman sohwɛfo ne kan Google Ghana ɔman sohwɛfo. Bere bi na Estelle yɛ BusyInternet, intanɛt dwumadibea bi a ɛwɔ Ghana no kwankyerɛfo panyin.

Mfitiase asetra 
Wɔwoo Estelle wɔ Scotland na n’agya yɛ Ghana. N’abusua tu kɔɔ Osu wɔ Ghana bere a na wadi asram 6.

Nwomasua 
Ɔkɔɔ Ghana Amanaman Ntam Sukuu afei kɔɔ Sussex Suapɔn a ɔnya abodin krataa wɔ Sikasɛm ne Nkɔsoɔ Adesua na ɔsan nso yɛ Africa Leadership Initiative-West Africa adesuakuo a ɛtɔ so mmienu no muni ne Aspen Global Leadership Network no muni.

Adwuma 
Estelle ne ɔman a ɛdi kan mprempren ma Google Ghana. Kan no na ɔyɛ adwuma sɛ Busyinternet, adwumakuw bi a ɛne ISP, cybercafe ne adwumayɛ incubator di nkitaho no kwankyerɛfo panyin. Na ɔyɛ nhyiam ne apontow sohwɛfo wɔ La Palm Royal Beach Hotel ne adwuma sohwɛfo wɔ Ɔman Ohia a Wɔtew So Dwumadi So wɔ ProNet, mpɔtam hɔ NGO yɔnko a ɔne WaterAid UK yɛ. Na ɔyɛ Ghana Intanɛt Dwumadibea Fekuw no Titenani.

Abasobɔde ahorow 
WomanRising de Estelle kaa afe 2016 Nnwumakuo Mmea Akannifoɔ 50 a wɔdi mu wɔ Ghana no ho.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Tabitha Sybil Quaye
text:
Tabitha Sybil Quaye (wɔwoo no 20 September 1938) yɛ Ghana ama na na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma Takoradi wɔ Atɔeɛ mantam mu . Na ɔyɛ Ghana man a ɛto so anan no mmrahyɛbagua a edi kan no muni .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Tabitha Sybil Quaye wɔ afe 1938 mu wɔ Ghana Atɔeɛ Mantam mu. Ɔwɔ Diploma wɔ Catering mu wɔ Hotel and Catering Institute.

Adwuma 
Ɔyɛ kan mmrahyɛbaguani ma Takoradi fi January 1992 kosi January 1997 na ɔsan yɛ Hotelier ne Caterer.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔpaw Tabitha Sybil Quaye wɔ 1992 Ghana mmrahyɛbagua abatow mu sɛ Ghana man a ɛto so anan no mmrahyɛbagua a edi kan no muni wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so . Ɔdii William N. Gram a ɔwɔ Action Congress Party (ACP) a ɔgyinaa ɔmansin no ananmu wɔ 1979 Ghana mmrahyɛbagua abatoɔ mu no ananmu . Gladys Asmah a ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party no muni wɔ afe 1996 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu a ɔdii nkonim wɔ atenaeɛ no mu denam abatoɔ 26,431 a ɔnyaeɛ a ɛgyina hɔ ma kyɛfa no mu 73.50%. Ɔdii Esther Nkansah a ɔyɛ National Democratic Congress (NDC) muni a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 10,342 a ɛgyina hɔ ma kyɛfa no mu 23.00%, Alex Fosu Blankson a ɔyɛ Independent a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 1,323 a ɛgyina hɔ ma kyɛfa no mu 2.90%, Timothy Norbert Kublenu a ɔfiri National Convention Party (NCP ) a ɔsan nso nyaa abatow 792 a egyina hɔ ma 1.80% ne Crosby Mochia a ofi Convention People’s Party (CPP) a na onni abatow biara.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ɔyɛ Kristoni .

title: Alima Moro
text:
Alima Moro (wɔwoo no 5 Ɔpɛpɔn 1983)  yɛ Ghana bɔɔlbɔni.

Club adwuma 
Moro fii ne bɔɔlbɔ adwuma ase wɔ Bolgatanga -based Bolga Ghatel. Afe 2005 mu no, ofii ne kurom Ghana kɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ Ghana aban ananmusifo dwumadibea a ɛwɔ Rome, Italy. Moro toaa n’adwuma so wɔ Serie C wɔ Lighi. Bere biako pɛ akyi no, otu kɔɔ Serie B kuw Marostica. Wɔ afe 2007 osutɔbere mu no, otu kɔɔ Vicenza. Ɛhɔ no, Moro bɛyɛɛ obi a ɔyɛ adwuma yiye, ɛno maa onyaa apam wɔ Serie A mu wɔ Trevignano wɔ afe 2012. Wɔ Serie A mu no, wɔ afe a ɛdi kan a ɛyɛ den akyi no, wankɔ akyiri ansen reserve dwumadie no na ɔsan kɔɔ Serie C wɔ 2013–14 berɛ no mfitiaseɛ, bɔɔ bɔɔl maa Laghi.

Esiane sɛ ɔbɔɔ bɔɔl maa Udinese nti, Moro de ne nsa hyɛɛ Serie A kuw Tavagnacco ase maa afe 2018–19 bere no, sɛ bɔɔlbɔfo a wɔpaw no a ɔto so abiɛsa.

Amanaman ntam adwuma 
Moro bɔɔ bɔɔl maa Ghana mmaa ɔman kuo, wɔ afe 2011 ne afe 2013 ntam  Wɔyii no fii ɔman no kuo no mu wɔ afe 2013 mu berɛ a ɔbɔɔ kan ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, A. K. Edusei, soboɔ sɛ ɔyɛ adifudepɛ. Moro kae wɔ nsɛm a wobisabisaa Ghana da biara da atesɛm krataa bi mu sɛ ɔman kuw no mu agofomma no bi wɔ wɔn gyinabea. Wɔ December 2013 mu no, ɔsan kɔɔ ɔman no kuw no mu.

Abasobɔde ahorow 
Wɔ afe 2011–12 berɛ mu no, wɔtoo aba sɛ Afrika bɔɔlbɔfoɔ a ɔsen biara wɔ Italy. Wɔ 23 Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 2013 no, wɔmaa no Ghana-Italy Excellence Awards wɔ Brescia. Bio nso, Ghana Bɔɔlbɔ Fekuw no maa no bɔɔlbɔfo a ɔsen biara .

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Grace Omaboe
text:
Grace Omaboe (wɔwoo no 10 June 1946), a nnipa pii frɛ no Maame Dokono, yɛ Ghana odiyifo, odwontofo, television so nipa, ɔkyerɛwfo ne kan amanyɔni. Ɔhwɛ kan Asomdwoe ne Ɔdɔ Nyisaa Atrae a mprempren ɛyɛ Graceful Grace sukuu wɔ Accra no so . Wɔn a wɔyɛɛ 3Music Awards ho nhyehyɛe no hyɛɛ no anuonyam wɔ nea wayɛ wɔ anigyede adwuma mu wɔ Ghana no ho.

Mfitiase asetra 
Wɔwoo Grace Omaboe wɔ 10 June 1946 wɔ Birim North wɔ Ghana Apuei mantam mu. Ɔkɔɔ Abetifi Mmabaa Sukuu. Ɔyɛ odiyifoɔ a waben, Madam Rebecca Afia Daadom a ɔfiri Abirim wɔ Apueeɛ Mantam mu na ɔwuiɛ berɛ a na wadi mfeɛ 105 no maame. Grace bɛyɛɛ ofie din denam ne dwumadi a ɔyɛe wɔ Akan Drama Series a agye din " OBRA " a wɔde too gua wɔ GBC TV so no so . Wɔwoo Grace Omaboe sɛ anigyefoɔ na wɔate ne nkɛntɛnsoɔ ne ne tumi nka wɔ show business dwumadibea biara mu – ama wayɛ Ghana show business anim mfeɛ du du pii. Ansa na ɔreba no, na obiara nni hɔ a ɔte sɛ ne su ne ne mmerantebere mu; yɛda so ara rehwɛ nea edi hɔ no. Ɛkame ayɛ sɛ ɔyɛɛ adwuma no fã biara ho adwuma na ɔsen biara. Ɔyɛɛ nkyerɛwee kyerɛw, agodie, radio ne TV so dwumadi, ntadehyɛ, nnwom, ne adwumayɛ na ɔde nnadewa bɔɔ emu biara ma ɛyɛɛ pɛ . Efi ahobrɛase mfiase sɛ scriptwriter ma biako anansesɛm television series bere nyinaa, Osofo Dadzie – Grace Omaboe parlayed saa ma nkɔso titiriw wɔ screens. Ɔmaa n’ahokokwaw yɛɛ yiye sɛ Abetifi Mmabaa Sukuu no muni a ɔwɔ nkɛntɛnso na ogye toom sɛ ɔbɛyɛ nkyerɛwee kyerɛwfo ama Osofo Dadzie kuw no na bere a wɔguu kuw no mu akyi no, anansesɛm mu ɔyɛkyerɛfo, Nana Bosompra, hyɛɛ no nkuran sɛ ɔnyɛ agoru wɔ nsɛm a ɛtoatoa so a ɔne no yɛe a wɔfrɛ no Keteke mu wɔ Ghana Broadcasting Corporation so na ɛno na efii ne dwumadi a edi kan a ɔde yɛɛ agoru no ase. Bere bi akyi no, ɔsesaa TV so dwumadi no din na ɔsesaa asɛmti no yɛɛ no Obra – television so dwumadi a wɔakyerɛ akyɛ sen biara a ɛhyɛɛ sini so wɔ Ghana.

Adwuma 
Grace Omaboe yɛ ɔkyerɛwfoɔ wɔ Osofo Dadzi so mfitiaseɛ wɔ 70 mfeɛ no mu berɛ a Nana Bosompra hyɛɛ no nkuran sɛ ɔnyɛ adwuma wɔ series bi a ɔne no yɛeɛ a wɔfrɛ no Keteke. Grace Omaboe dii kan fii ase yɛɛ agoru wɔ Keteke TV so dwumadi ahorow a ɛwɔ Ghana Man dea TV, GTV . Ɔkɔɔ so firii hɔ bɛyɛɛ odiyifoɔ a wɔhwehwɛ wɔn paa wɔ ne berɛ so no mu baako berɛ a ɔyɛɛ 1980/1990 mfeɛ mu Akan drama series Obra wɔ GTV so na ɔyɛɛ no na ɔsan nso boom yɛɛ TV so dwumadiɛ a ɛka nsɛm a ɛkyerɛkyerɛ ma mmofra a yɛnim yɛn By The Ogya Afa . Wɔfrɛ no Maame Dokono (bere a ɔyɛɛ nipa bi sɛ kenkey tɔnfo akyi), ɔkɔɔ so yɛɛ ne ho wɔ Ghana sini ahorow pii mu Akan ne Engiresifo nyinaa. Ɔdii dwuma wɔ afe 2013 sini tiawa a wɔfrɛ no Kwaku Ananse ne Children of the Mountain (2016) mu.

Wɔ afe 2000 ne 2004 mu no Omaboe gyinaa hɔ sɛ mmrahyɛbagua kandifoɔ maa National Democratic Congress (NDC) wɔ New Abirem maa Birim North Constituency wɔ Eastern Region. Wɔ afe 2008 mu no, Omaboe guan kɔɔ New Patriotic Party (NPP) a ɛredi tumi no mu. Omaboe kyerɛ sɛ NDC no yɛɛ nsɛm tiaa no, a na ɛhwehwɛ sɛ ɔko na odi nkonim wɔ asɛnnibea asɛm a wɔde kɔdan ne nyisaa fie esiane nsɛmmɔnedifo anibiannaso nti. Ogyaee amammuisɛm wɔ afe 2016 mu, na ɔkaa sɛ ɛyɛ beresɛe, sika, ne nnipa a wɔka nsɛm a ɛnyɛ nokware ahyɛ mu ma.

Wɔpaw Omaboe sɛ ɔnyɛ 2017 Golden Movie Awards Africa (GMAA) asɛnni baguafo no Titenani.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Na Grace Omaboe aware nanso na wagyae aware.  Grace Omaboe wɔ mma baanum a wɔn baanu te United States, baanu wɔ Netherlands na wɔn a wɔaka no wɔ Ghana.

Grace Omaboe aware mprenu nanso mprempren ɔne ne kunu a ɔto so abien no atetew. Ɔne ne kunu a odi kan no woo mma baanan, na ɔne ne kunu a ɔto so abien no woo mma. Ɔka sɛ abusuabɔ a asɛe no fa bi fi agodie a wɔhwehwɛ ne nsonsonoe a wontumi nsiesie a ɛfa n’adwuma ho apɛde ahorow ne abusua ahwehwɛde ahorow ho.

Nsusuwii ahorow abu so wɔ baabi a Grace Omaboe ne David Dontoh ntam abusuabɔ koduu wɔ wɔn nna a na wɔwɔ Keteke ne Obra no mu no ho. Wogye di sɛ nnipa baanu yi bɔɔ fekuw bɛyɛ mfe anan wɔ wɔn nkɔso bere no mu. David nnsi saa nsɛm yi so dua anaasɛ ɔmpow  nanso osi so dua sɛ na wɔn baanu no yɛ nnamfo pa yiye na na wɔbɛn wɔn ho titiriw wɔ bere a Grace Omaboe ne ne kunu a odi kan no tetew mu no mu. Nanso Grace Omaboe ka wɔn abusuabɔ no ho asɛm penpen na wada no adi sɛ wɔdaa bere tiaa bi na mpo wɔboom tu kɔtraa hɔ bere bi.  Sɛnea Grace kyerɛ no, na wɔdɔ wɔn ho ankasa na na wɔasusuw aware ho mpo nanso wogyinaa akasakasa a wontumi nsiesie so sii gyinae sɛ wɔbɛkasa atia. Na David pɛ sɛ wɔbom nya abusua nanso na Grace awo mma baanum dedaw afi n’aware ahorow a atwam no mu. Ná wadi boro mfe 40 nso ma enti na n’ankasa asi gyinae sɛ ɔrenwo mma bio. Ná Dawid yɛ wɔn baanu no mu kumaa na na onnyaa n’ankasa mma biara. Enti wɔn baanu nyinaa penee so tetew wɔn ho nanso wɔakɔ so ayɛ nnamfo paa fi saa bere no.

title: Janet Owusu
text:
Janet Owusu (wɔwoo no 23 April 1991 wɔ Accra ) yɛ Ghanani ɔbaa bɔɔlbɔni.

Adwuma

Club 
Owusu fii n'adwuma ase wɔ La Ladies FC a ɛwɔ Accra . Wɔ afe 2014 ahuhuro mu no ɔfirii Ghana nea ɛdi kan na ɔbɛyɛɛ Ghanani a ɔdi kan wɔ Austria ÖFB Mmea Kuo no mu. Wɔ 20 July 2014 no, ɔde ne nsa hyɛɛ aseɛ maa SV Neulengbach .

Ɔman Kuw no 
Owusu de ne ho hyɛɛ Black Starlets mu wɔ FIFA U-20 Mmea Wiase Kupɔn 2010 a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Germany no mu.

Efi afe 2012 no Owusu ayɛ ɔman no mu agofomma wɔ Black Queens of Ghana .

title: Martha Bissah
text:
Martha Bissah (wɔwoo no Ɔbɛnem 24, 1997) yɛ Ghana agumadifo. Ɔnyaa sika kɔkɔɔ wɔ mmabaa mmirikatuo a ɛyɛ mita 800 mu wɔ 2014 Summer Youth

Nwomasua 
Bissah kɔɔ Aduman Senior High School wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Wɔ December 2020 mu no, ɔwiee abodin krataa wɔ adwumayɛ mu a ɔsii Adwumayɛ so dua wɔ Norfolk State University wɔ United States. Wɔ May 2021 mu no, owiee sukuu no nyaa abodin krataa a ɛto so abien wɔ General Business/Marketing mu wɔ Norfolk State University .

Adwuma 
Wɔ afe 2014 mu no, Bissah nyaa sika kɔkɔɔ wɔ mmeawa mmirikatu a wɔde tu mmirika mita 800 mu wɔ 2014 Summer Youth Olympics .

Ghana Agumadi Fekuw no baraa Bissah daa wɔ June 2016.

Wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2017 mu no, ɔnyaa sika kɔkɔɔ nkonimboɔ nnan wɔ Mid-Eastern Athletic Conference Indoor ne Track & Field Championships mu.

Wɔ afe 2018 mu no, wɔbɔɔ no din sɛ Ɔbea Agumadifo a Ɔsen Biara wɔ Afe no mu ne mprenu so wɔ Norfolk State University .

Wɔ afe 2019 mu no, ne mprenu so no, wɔbɔɔ Martha din sɛ Ɔbea Agumadifo a ɔsen biara wɔ afe no mu wɔ Norfolk State Sukuupɔn mu no, onyaa abasobɔde no bere a ɔde simma 17 ne sikani 16 kyerɛw ne din akyi, na ɔnam saayɛ so yɛɛ akansi ho kyerɛwtohɔ foforo.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Abena Appiah
text:
Evelyn Abena Akuaba Appiah (wɔwoo no June 2, 1993) yɛ Ghana –Amerika odwontoni, model ne ahoɔfɛ hemmaa a wɔhyɛɛ no abotiri sɛ Queen Beauty Universe 2016 ne Miss Grand International 2020 .  Wɔpaw no sɛ Miss Grand USA na ɔbɛyɛɛ Abibifo ɔbea a odi kan a onyaa Miss Grand International abotiri. Kan no na ogyina Ghana ananmu wɔ Big Four amanaman ntam ahoɔfɛ akansi abien mu nanso ɔhweree wɔ Miss Universe 2014 ne Miss Earth 2019 mu .

Adwuma a ɔyɛe mfiase 
Abena nso yɛ odwontofoɔ a wayi nnwom ahodoɔ pii adi, a "Akomah" (2015), "Earth" (2019), "No Hit and Run" (2019) ne "No More Hate" (2021) ka ho. Ɔayɛ adwuma sɛ model, wapue wɔ nnwom video ahorow mu ama " Wake Up in the Sky " a Bruno Mars, Gucci Mane ne Kodak Black too dwom, ne " El Anillo " a Jennifer Lopez too no nso.

Pageantry a wɔde di dwuma 
Abena hyɛɛ aseɛ de ne ho bɔɔ akansifoɔ berɛ a ɔdii nkonim wɔ Top Model Ghana wɔ afe 2013 mu na ɔgyinaa ne man ananmu wɔ Top Model of the World a ɔwieeɛ wɔ top 15. Afe a ɛdi hɔ no, ɔgyinaa Ghana ananmu wɔ Miss Universe 2014 nanso wɔannye no.

Ɔde ne ho bɔɔ Miss World America 2017 a ogyinaa New York ananmu. Mfeɛ mmienu akyi no, ɔgyinaa Ghana ananmu bio wɔ Miss Earth 2019, baabi a ɔde ne ho hyɛɛ Top 20 mu na ɔnyaa abasobɔdeɛ dodoɔ bi. Ɔtetee ne ho wɔ Kagandahang Flores nsraban, akansi nsraban bi a ɛwɔ Philippines a ɛtete ahemmaa a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔyɛ ahoɔfɛ ma mpɔtam hɔ ne amanaman ntam akansi ahorow ase.

Miss Grand Amanaman Ntam 2020 
Ɔde ne ho bɔɔ Miss Grand USA 2020, faako a wɔkamfoo no sɛ ɔno na odii nkonim ne Afrikani-Amerikani a odi kan a odii nkonim wɔ abodin no mu. Awiei koraa no, ɔbɔɔ abotiri sɛ nkonimdifo wɔ Miss Grand International 2020 mu denam nea ɔrefi adi no so Miss Grand International 2019, Valentina Figuera a ofi Venezuela, wɔ March 27, 2021, wɔ Show DC Hall wɔ Bangkok, Thailand a ɛmaa ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔbea a odi kan a ofi United States a odii nkonim abotiri no.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Israella Kafui Mansu
text:
Israella Kafui Mansu yɛ ababaa a wagye din a ɔyɛ adwuma wɔ Ghana, Ɔhyehyɛɛ Mansuki Ghana Ltd na ɔyɛ ne CEO.

Mfitiase asetra 
Wɔwoo Israella Kafui Mansu wɔ 26 October 1985 wɔ Sogakope wɔ Ghana na ɔne abusua no tu kɔɔ Liberia bere a na ɔyɛ abofra. Awerɛhosɛm ne sɛ ɛyɛ saa berɛ no mu na ɔko no paee wɔ Liberia enti abusua no san tu kɔɔ Ghana. Bere a odii mfe 6 no ɔde ne din kɔhyɛɛ Sogasco Primary wɔ Sogakope, otu kɔɔ Dabala Primary ne JHS na akyiri yi St. Francis Demonstration JHS wɔ Hohoe, faako a ɔfaa ne BECE nyinaa esiane transfers a na ɛsɛ sɛ ne maame fa mu sɛ sukuu matron nti. Bere a odii nkonim wɔ ne sɔhwɛ mu no, onyaa kwan kɔɔ Anfoega ntoaso sukuu a ɛwɔ Kpando Mantam mu sɛ ɔrekɔsua Ofie Sikasɛm na owiee ne sukuupɔn wɔ Ghana Sukuupɔn, Legon a onyaa Bachelor of Arts abodin krataa wɔ Adetɔfo Nyansahu ne Adwene ne Nneyɛe Ho Adesua mu

Nhomasua mu Nkɔso 
Bere a Israella wɔ sukuu mu no, ɔkɔ so da nsow wɔ n’atipɛnfo mu. Bere a Dabala JHS no, sukuu no paw no sɛ onni wɔn ananmu wɔ afe afe STME (Science Technology and Mathematics Education) nhyehyɛe a aban no di so de ma mmerante ne mmabaa tumi titiriw mmeawa na ɔsan nso gyinaa ne sukuu ananmu wɔ ɔmantam sɔhwɛ ne akansi ahorow mu. Wɔ Anfoega SHS no ɔsan nso de ne ho hyɛɛ nhoma akansi bi a wɔabue ano a wɔkyerɛɛ maa sukuu no nyinaa mu baabi a ɔkyerɛw adebɔ ho asɛm na odii nkonim wɔ nea ɛto so abiɛsa bere mpo a dodow no ara a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛɛ mu no yɛ mmarimaa ne mpanyimfo.

Adwumayɛ mu adwumayɛ 
Efi afe 2009 no Israella ne n’adwumakuw no ayɛ ahyɛnsode a agye din wɔ mpɔtam hɔ ne amanaman ntam gua so. Sɛ́ adwumayɛfo no, ɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ abɔde mu nneɛma a wɔde yɛ ahosiesie ho, ɔyɛ ho nhyehyɛe na ɔde di gua. Bere a Israella wiee ne Ɔman som adwuma wɔ afe 2009 mu no, onyaa adwuma nanso ankosi hwee. Saa tebea yi kanyan no na ɔde sika ketewaa bi a ɛyɛ GHS300 a ɔboaboaa ano fii sikakorabea wɔ ne Ɔman Dwumadibea apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ mu no fii n’adwumakuw a edi kan ase de ne dan mu aduannoa dii dwuma sɛ aduruyɛdan a ɔyɛɛ na osiesiee nneɛma kakraa bi a edi a wɔde yɛ ahosiesie Wɔ nsɛmbisa a ɛfa ne ho mu had with Akpah Prince she said “Wɔ adwumakuo no a mehyɛɛ aseɛ mu no, na mewɔ anisoadehunu titire mmienu wɔ m’adwene mu sɛ mɛnya sika de atra ase na mayɛ nnwuma de ayɛ nnipa adwuma ɛfiri sɛ adwuma a wonnya nyɛ dodoɔ wɔ ɔman no mu seesei no dɔɔso ara kwa na ɛyɛ awerɛhoɔ, enti saa nneɛma yi na ɛkanyan me sɛ mɛhyɛ saa adwumakuw yi ara ase”.

Gye to mu 
Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, Israella de ne ho hyɛɛ Enablis  Ghana Business Launch Pad akansi ne Ghana Startup Cup a ɔdii kan wɔ deɛ ɛtɔ so mmienu ne deɛ ɔdi kan. Wɔ afe 2013 mu no, Aguadi soafoɔ abadiakyiri ne Europa Mmea a Wɔyɛ Nneɛma ne Nneɛma Foforo Fekuo a ɛwɔ Sweden no maa no abasobɔdeɛ wɔ guasodeɛ bi ase wɔ South Africa. Wɔ afe 2014 mu no ɔde ne ho hyɛɛ YES nhyehyɛɛ a Ghana aban de sii hɔ no mu baabi a ɔtenaa ɔmampanyin no nifa. Wayɛ ne ho asɛm wɔ television so dwumadi ahorow mu wɔ Ghana ne nsɛm a ɛfa Young Entrepreneurs a wɔwɔ Ghana ne Afrika ho nso. Ɔsan nso de ne ho ahyɛ US Embassy Ghana nhyehyɛe ahorow mu na wakyekyɛ n’asɛm wɔ kasa nhyiam ahorow pii so.  Mprempren nso ɔwɔ nnipa baanum a wotwa to a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛɛ Ghana’s Next Young Entrepreneurs Reality Show wɔ Ghana no mu.

Nneɛma a wɔde kɔ amannɔne 
Esiane sɛ Israella di anim wɔ Made in Ghana nneɛma a wɔyɛ mu nti, ɛtɔ mmere bi a ɔde n’ahosiesie nneɛma kɔ Afrika aman afoforo, Asia, U.S. ne Europa gua so. Ne nneɛma kɔ akyiri kodu sɛ ɔpia Ghana kɔ hɔ denam Ghana frankaa a ɔma so kɔ soro paa no so.

Awie 
Israella Kafui Mansu ani gye ho sɛ ɔbɛdi nkɔsoɔ nsɛnnennen ho dwuma, ayɛ adwuma a ɛbɛtena hɔ daa na wakyerɛkyerɛ mmeranteɛ a wɔyɛ nnwuma.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Juliet Asante
text:
Juliet Yaa Asantewa Asante yɛ Ghana sini twafo, ɔyɛfo ne ɔkwankyerɛfo ne ɔyamyefo . Ne sini a ɛtwa to, Silver Rain, na wɔyii no sɛ "Best Film in West Africa" ne "Best costume" maa afe 2015 wɔ Africa Magic viewer's choice awards (AMVCA) ne 2015 nso "Best Overall Film In Africa".  Wɔ afe 1999 mu no, Asante fii ase yɛɛ adwumayɛbea a wɔyɛ nneɛma a wɔfrɛ no Eagle House Productions.  Saa afe no ara mu no ɔsan nso hyɛɛ aseɛ "Save Our Women International", adwumakuo a ɛnyɛ adwuma a wɔde hwehwɛ mfasoɔ a ɛtwe adwene si mmaa nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ so na ɔde nnoɔma foforɔ bi a ɛyɛ sini ntiantiaa ma mobile phone wɔ Afrika wɔ afe 2014 mu a wɔfrɛ no Mobile Flicks.   Ɔsan nso yɛ Black Star Amanaman Ntam Sini Afahyɛ no Fapemfo ne ne kwankyerɛfo panyin .  Eagle Productions aboa ama wɔatete agodie ne agodiefoɔ binom wɔ Ghana denam ne nteteeɛ basa, Eagle Drama Workshop so.

Mfitiase asetra 
Wɔwoo Asante wɔ Ghana na ɔyɛ mmofra baanum mu nea ɔto so abien. Ɔwɔ Ɔman Adwumayɛ mu abodin krataa a ɛkorɔn (MPA) ne Ɔmanfo Nhyehyɛe mu abodin krataa a ɛkorɔn (MPP) wɔ Harvard Kennedy Aban Sukuu mu . Ɔsan nso wɔ bachelor’s degree abien. Owiee sukuu wɔ Cape Coast Sukuupɔn mu, na owiee Ɔman Sini ne Television Asoɛe nso .

Adwuma 
Asante yɛ National film Authority of Ghana CEO, National Film and Television Institute (NAFTI) board chair ne Black Star International Film Institute no Titenani a Ɔhyehyɛɛ, Black Star International Film Festival (BSIFF) ho nhyehyɛefo.

Ɔyɛ Adebɔ ho Adwinni Sukuu, nhomasua ho adwene a ɛsakra nsakrae a Nhomasua Dwumadibea no de mae no Adesua Boayikuw no guamtrani. Ɔno na ɔhyehyɛɛ Yaa Asantewa Nhomakorabea adwuma no, ɔkyekyee nhomakorabea ahorow na ɔde sie wɔ Ghana mpɔtam hɔ. Ɔyɛ adwumayɛfoɔ ho ɔfotufoɔ, nsakraeɛ ho ɔnanmusifoɔ ne ɔkwankyerɛfoɔ a ɔdwene akwan ho a ɔwɔ osuahu a ɛfa nsasepɔn mmienu so bɛboro mfeɛ aduonu. Asante afi ase, aboa ma wɔakyekye, akyekye na wɔahwɛ ahyehyɛde ne nneɛma so wɔ wiase nyinaa.Asante nyaa abasobɔde sɛ 'Best Actress' wɔ Ghana wɔ afe 2001. Akyiri yi ɔkɔɔ National Film and Television institute of Ghana, faako a onyaa ne class anuonyam a edi kan wɔ Film Directing mu.

Sini ahorow a wayɛ agoru wom no bi ne Twin Lovers, Fresh Blood, Tears of Blood, Ripples, ne Thread of Ananse. Ɔdaa ne ho adi wɔ 1996 sini a wɔato din Deadly Voyage mu sɛ Albert Mensah yere. Ɔakyerɛw, akyerɛ kwan na wayɛ dwumadi ahorow wɔ Ghana television so, te sɛ Obaby, dating show, ne Secrets, drama series a ɔno nso yɛ executive producer.

Ne sini a ɛtwa toɔ, Silver Rain, na wɔyii no sɛ "Best Film in West Africa" ne "Best costume" maa afe 2015 wɔ Africa Magic viewer's choice awards (AMVCA) ne 2015 nso "Best Overall Film In Africa". Silver Rain kɔɔ so nyaa nnipa bɛboro 13 a wɔde wɔn din too gua wɔ wiase nyinaa.

Sɛ́ Adwumayɛfo ne Siniyɛfo no, Asante hyehyɛɛ Eagle Productions Limited wɔ afe 1999 mu, na ɔde adebɔ dii adwumakuw no anim ma wɔyɛɛ dwumadi ahorow a edii yiye sen biara wɔ Ghana Television so wɔ afe 2001 ne 2010 ntam no bi

Asante yɛ nnipa a wodii kan yɛɛ akwampaefo wɔ adwene a ɛne sɛ wɔbɛyɛ sini ntiantiaa a wɔayɛ ama wo fon a wokura kyin titiriw no mu biako. N’adwumakuw, Mobilefliks ne MTN yɛɛ adwuma yiye de yɛɛ sini ntiantiaa a atiefo betumi anya denam telefon a wokura kyin so.

Ɔyɛ ɔkyerɛwfo ne blogger daa ma The Huffington Post na wasom sɛ Ɔfotufo wɔ Adwumayɛ ho wɔ Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), Sloan sukuu a ɛhwɛ adwumayɛ so fi afe 2013 de besi nnɛ, ɔsan nso ma Mass Communication kasa wɔ Webster Sukuupɔn, Ghana sukuupɔn mu wɔ 2017.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Deborah Ahenkorah
text:
Deborah Ahenkorah (wɔwoo no 20 Ayɛwohomumɔ 1987) yɛ Ghana ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo ne ɔdeyɛfo, ɔne Golden Baobab, asetena mu adwumayɛkuo a ɛbɔ mmɔden sɛ ɛbɛhyɛ Afrika nwoma ho nkuran ama mmofra, na ɔde afe afe Sika Baobab Nkonimdie ma . Osuaa ade wɔ Bryn Mawr College, na Echoing Green Fellowship abɔ ne din sɛ "ntoboa foforo a ɛsen biara a ɛde nsakrae ba wɔ nnɛ wiase yi mu no mu biako."  Wɔ afe 2013 mu no, na Ahenkorah ka New Voices Fellowship ho wɔ Aspen Institute .

Asetra mu nsɛm 
Wɔwoo Ahenkorah na wɔtetee no wɔ Accra, Ghana . Ɔkɔɔ Bryn Mawr College, faako a ɔsom sɛ "Bryn Mawr's African Students" ahyehyɛde no guamtrani. Ɔsan nso na ɔhyehyɛɛ Project Educate wɔ Afrika, na ɔyɛ ɔfotufoɔ a ɔte hɔ na ɔde ne ho hyɛɛ Wiase Nyinaa Sika a Wɔde Ma Mmofra ne Europa Aman Nkabom mmrahyɛbagua no mu. Ahenkorah yɛ Starting Bloc Fellowship no fã, na ɔsan nso de ne ho hyɛɛ Goldman Sachs Mmea Nhyiam no mu.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Peace Hyde
text:
Peace Hyde yɛ Britania-Ghana television so ɔyɛkyerɛfo, TV so ɔyɛkyerɛfo, ɔbɔadeɛ, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo ne nhomasua ho dwumayɛni.  Ɔyɛ Netflix Afrika TV so dwumadi a edi kan a ɛyɛ nokware Young, Famous & African no bɔfo ne ne yɛfo panyin, ne dijitaal nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ne fekubɔ ho Titenani ne Afrika Atɔe Fam Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo wɔ Forbes Africa . Ɔno na ɔhyehyɛɛ Aim Higher Africa, ahyehyɛde bi a ɛnyɛ nea wɔhwehwɛ mfaso a ɛde n’adwene si nhomasua a wɔbɛma atu mpɔn wɔ mpɔtam a wodi hia wɔ Afrika nyinaa so. Wɔ afe 2018 mu no, wɔpaw no wɔ akannifoɔ 200 mu sɛ Obama Foundation Africa Leaders nhyehyɛeɛ no fã na afe 2019 mu no, wɔmaa no African Social Impact Award wɔ House of Parliament, House of Commons wɔ UK

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Hyde na wɔtetee no wɔ London, na ɔtenaa hɔ kɔsii afe 2015, ansa na ɔretu akɔ Ghana . Wɔ ne mfeɛ a ɛdi kan wɔ London no, ɔde bere tiaa bi yɛɛ adwuma sɛ mmofra adwene ho ɔbenfoɔ ansa na ɔrefi adwuma ase sɛ nyansahu kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ a ne ho akokwaw wɔ abɔdeɛ mu nneɛma, nnuruyɛ ne abɔdeɛ mu nneɛma ho adesua mu.

Hyde yɛ obi a wawie Middlesex Sukuupɔn, faako a owiee sukuu no nyaa adwene ne nneyɛe ho abodin krataa.

Adwuma 
Hyde yɛ Digital Media ne fekubɔ so panyin ne Afrika Atɔe Fam Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo wɔ Forbes Africa. Ɔno na ɔhwɛ samufoɔ nsɛm a ɛfiri Afrika Atɔeɛ mantam mu no so na ɔsan nso ma sika a wɔnya no nkɔanim ma ahyɛnsodeɛ no denam fekubɔ so.

Ɔsan yɛ nhomasua ho ɔdenimfo, na ɔreyɛ adwuma de nhomasua ne adwumayɛ mu nkɔso ama mmerante ne mmabaa a wodi hia ne wɔn a wonni adwuma. Adwuma a ɔne n’adɔe kuw Aim Higher Africa yɛe no maa Barack Obama paw Hyde sɛ Obama Foundation Leaders Africa yɔnko. Wɔ afe 2019 mu no, wɔsan nso maa Hyde Africa Social Impact Award wɔ UK House of Parliament wɔ adwuma a ɔne adɔeɛ kuo no yɛeɛ no ho.

Hyde adwuma sɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo ada ne ho adi wɔ Black Enterprise, Huffington Post, Ebony ne Fox News mu .  Wɔde no kaa Amanaman Nkabom no Nnipa a Wɔanya Nkɛntɛnso Sen Biara a Wofi Afrika Abusua mu din mu wɔ afe 2017 ne 2018. Hyde yɛ ɔtemmufoɔ ma CNBC All Africa Adwumayɛfoɔ Abasobɔdeɛ, The Chivas Venture Fund ne Veuve Clicquot Adwumayɛfoɔ Abasobɔdeɛ.

Nhomasua ho adwumayɛfo 
Hyde na ɔhyehyɛɛ nwomasua a ɛnyɛ mfasoɔ Aim Higher Africa a ɔde n’adwene si awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ a ɛdi hɔ a ɛyɛ nnwumayɛfoɔ ne nsakraeɛfoɔ a wɔbɛkyekyere wɔ Afrika denam nkyerɛkyerɛ, nhyɛsoɔ ne tumi a wɔde bɛma awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ a wɔyɛ mmeranteɛ akannifoɔ so. Ahyehyɛdeɛ no ayɛ adwuma na ɛde nkyerɛkyerɛ pa ama nnwumayɛfoɔ a wɔwɔ asasepɔn no so nyinaa ma wɔasua na wɔanya nkɔsoɔ denam nkitahodiɛ a wɔde bɛma atipɛnfoɔ a wɔn adwene yɛ pɛ, sika a wɔde bɛto mu, afotuo ne sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ nhyiamu a wɔde bɛma so. Efi bere a wɔhyehyɛɛ ahyehyɛde no, ayɛ nnwuma nketewa bɛboro 6000 wɔ Afrika Atɔe fam na adu bɛyɛ ɔpepem 3 ne sukuufo nkyɛn.

Wɔ afe 2018 mu no, Hyde hyɛɛ ne ahokokwaw a wɔnya beaeɛ ase wɔ Yaba sɛ ɔde nwomasua a wontua hwee bɛma na ɔsan nso de ahokokwaa nteteeɛ bɛma nnwuma a wɔrefi aseɛ wɔ Nigeria no ama wɔanya adwumayɛ ho nimdeɛ denam ne Mind-set Reorientation and Design Thinking (MRDT) adesua nhyehyɛeɛ so.

Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo adwumayɛ 
Asomdwoeɛ yɛ ɔbɔadeɛ ne adwumayɛfoɔ panin a ɔyɛɛ Afrika nokwasɛm TV so dwumadiɛ a ɛdi kan koraa wɔ Netflix, Young, Famous & African . Ɔno ne ɔbɔadeɛ, ɔyɛfoɔ ne saa ara nso na ɔyɛ ɔkasa dwumadi mmienu, Forbes Africa ’s My Worst Day with Peace Hyde (3 mmerɛ), baabi a ɔne Afrika ɔpepepemfoɔ ne Forbes Woman Africa’s Against the Odds (2 mmerɛ) kasa wɔ... CNBC Africa dwumadibea a ɛwɔ DSTV so . Ɔno na ɔyɛɛ Vice News kyerɛwtohɔ a wɔato din Inside Nigeria a wɔrepiapia sɛ wɔbɛma polisifo atirimɔdensɛm aba awiei no. Nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw no yɛ nea odii nkonim wɔ Top Shorts sini afahyɛ abasobɔde, Los Angeles Sini Afahyɛ, Lonely Wolf Sini Afahyɛ ne IMDB Abasobɔde Titiriw. Ɔsan nso yɛɛ n’ankasa ɔkasa dwumadi, Friday Night Live, a ɛkɔɔ so mfe 4 ne nnwom talente akansi a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Ghana, MTN Hitmaker, mfe 3 nso. CNN bɔɔ no din sɛ Ghana nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a odi yiye sen biara, na wɔaka Hyde adwuma no ho asɛm wɔ CNN, Black Enterprise, Huffington Post, Ebony, Fox News, ne Essence . Wɔbɔɔ ne din wɔ Amanaman Nkabom Kuo no din mu wɔ afe 2017 ne 2018 mu na wɔbɔɔ ne din sɛ mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa 100 a wɔwɔ nkɛntɛnsoɔ kɛseɛ wɔ Afrika no mu baako. Wɔ afe 2018 mu no, Ɔmampanyin Barack Obama paw Asomdwoeɛ tiawa firii Afrika akannifoɔ 30,000 mu sɛ wɔnyɛ Inaugural Obama Foundation Africa Leaders 200 no fa.

Baguam Ɔkasa 
Asomdwoeɛ Hyde ka tumi a adwene wɔ, asetena mu atirimpɔw a ɛdi mu, adwumayɛ mu nkɔsoɔ ne nwomasua, ne mmarima ne mmaa Pɛyɛ ne Mmea tumidie ho nsɛm. Hyde na ɔyɛ ɔkasafo titiriw maa Flourish Africa Conference, asɛnka agua a Afrika ɔbea ɔdefo sen biara, Folorunso Alakija, yɛe no. Na ɔyɛ ɔkasafoɔ wɔ TEDX Accra, TEDX Kumasi, Wiase Nyinaa Asetra mu Abasobɔdeɛ wɔ Prague, Essence, Afrika 2018 Nhyiamu a ɛwɔ Egypt, Social Media Nnawɔtwe Lagos, ne Hustle wɔ Heels London.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Monica Amekoafia
text:
Monica Amekoafia (30 June 1934 – 24 June 1990) yɛ Ghanani na ɔdii nkonim wɔ Miss Ghana akansi a ɛdi kan wɔ afe 1957 mu berɛ a na ɔgyina Trans-Volta Togoland ananmu .  Na ɔyɛ akansifo a ɔto so 9 . Ɛyɛ ne nɔma mu na wɔfrɛ nnipa a wofi Volta Mantam no mu sɛ Nɔma 9 .

Wɔwoo no maa Augustus Amekoafia ne Anastasia Apau wɔ June 1934 mu wɔ Alavanyo wɔ Trans-Volta Togoland wɔ Gold Coast . Akyiri yi ɔwaree Ghana ɔman nanmusifo bi a wɔfrɛ no Henry Kofi Marrah wɔ London, United Kingdom . Bere a wɔwaree no, na Monica wɔ mmabarima baanu a wofi abusuabɔ bi a atwam mu. Wɔ wɔn ntam no, wɔwoo mma baanan. Bere a wɔpaw ne kunu sɛ Ɔnanmusifo wɔ Czechoslovakia wɔ 1961 mu akyi no, Marrah abusua no tu kɔɔ Prague saa afe no. Wɔ 1963 mu no, wɔde Monica kunu kɔɔ Hungary baabi a ɔne n’abusua tenaa kosii 1966 mu. Wɔ atuatew a ɛde asraafo Ɔman Ahofadi Bagua no sii Nkrumah aban ananmu wɔ 24 Ɔpɛpɔn 1966 akyi no, ɔne n’abusua san kɔɔ Ghana. Monica kɔtraa asetena mu wɔ Ghana baabi a ɛwom sɛ na ɔyɛ ofiehwɛfo titiriw de, nanso ɔde ne ho hyɛɛ nnwuma ahorow mu a ɔyɛ adwuma fi fie. N’adwuma titiriw ne ntadeyɛ, na ɔde ne ho hyɛɛ krataa ne aduruyɛ adwuma ne samina a wɔyɛ ne afoforo nso mu.

Wɔsan nso yii ohoni bi adi de hyɛɛ no anuonyam wɔ Hohoe wɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Ghanaian cuisine
text:
Ghanafo aduane yɛ Ghanafo aduane . Wɔahyehyɛ Ghanafo nnuan atitiriw atwa aduan titiriw bi a starch wom ho ahyia, a ɛne sauce anaa soup a protein fibea wom kɔ. Nneɛma titiriw a wɔde yɛ soup ne stew dodow no ara ne tomato, ɛmo a ɛyɛ hyew ne ayɛyɛde. Ne saa nti, Ghanafo soup ne stew dodow no ara yɛ kɔkɔɔ anaa borɔdɔma.

Nnuan titiriw a wodi 
Nnuan titiriw a wɔtaa di wɔ Ghana kesee fam no bi ne cassava ne plantain . Wɔ atifi fam fã no, nnuan titiriw a wodi ne atoko ne atoko . Wɔde yam, atoko ne bankye di dwuma wɔ Ghana nyinaa sɛ nnuan titiriw. Ɛmo ne cocoyam nso ho hia wɔ Ghanafo aduan ne wɔn aduan mu . Bere a wiase nyinaa ayɔnkofa aba no, wɔde aburow te sɛ aburow ne awi ahyɛ Ghanafo aduan mu kɛse. Nnuan a ɛwɔ aseɛ ha yi gyina hɔ ma Ghanafoɔ nnuan a wɔde saa nnuan titire yi na ɛyɛ.

Nnuan a wɔde atoko ayɛ 

 Waakye — aduane a wɔde aburow ne bankye ayɛ a ne kɔla yɛ kɔkɔɔ-biribiri. Kɔla no fi sare a ɛwɔ hɔ no mu Sorghum bicolor .  Saa aduan a wɔde ka ho yi di nsɛ kɛse wɔ West India aburow ne peas ho. Wɔnoa aburow no na wɔde ɛhɔnom ahaban, akutu ne akutu te sɛ black-eyed peas anaa kidney beans na ɛyɛ hyew .
 Omo Tuo /Rice ball—aburow a wɔayam a ɛyɛ nnam, a wɔtaa di no ne asase mu soup.
 Aburow a ɛnyɛ den—aburow a wɔanoa ka aduan a wɔayam no kɔkɔɔ ahorow pii ho.
 Jollof aburow —aburow a wɔnoa wɔ aduan a wɔayam a wɔde stock, tomato, nnuhuam, ne nam a wɔanoa abom mu. Saa aduan yi fi Djolof aguadifo a wofi Senegal a wɔtraa Zongos ansa na atubrafo bere no reba no hɔ. Wɔayɛ no sɛnea ɛhɔnom Ghanafo ani gye ho, na wɔtaa di no ne abirekyi, oguammaa, akokɔ anaa nantwinam a wɔayam, wɔayam anaa wɔayam.
 Aburow a wɔayam—Chinafo kwan so aburow a wɔayam a wɔayɛ no sɛnea Ghanafo pɛ.
 Angwa moo —wɔsan frɛ no "aburow a wɔde ngo ayɛ". Eyi nte sɛ aburow a wɔayam a wonoa aburow no ansa na woahyew no. Wɔnoa aburow a wɔde ngo ayɛ denam ngo no a wodi kan de ayɛyɛde a wɔde hyew, afei wɔde nsu gu mu bere a ayɛyɛde no ayɛ bruu awie no so, na ɛma aburow no hua soronko. Afei wɔnoa aburow no wɔ nsu ne ngo a wɔde afra no mu, na ama aburow no ayɛ srade bere a wɔasiesie no. Wobetumi de nhabannuru anaa nam a wɔayam, de aka ho sɛnea ɛyɛ dɛ. Wɔde ɛmo a wɔde dɔte ayɛ na ɛyɛ kɛse, na sardines a wɔde ahyɛ tin mu anaa nkesua a wɔayam na ɛka ho.
 Ngwo moo (nnua aburow)—aduru a wɔde si aburow a wɔde ngo ayɛ ananmu, a wɔde mmɛw ngo noa mmom sen sɛ wɔde ngo a wɔde noa aduan bɛnoa. Wogyina nnuadewa ngo ko a wɔde di dwuma so na ɛkyerɛ sɛnea ɛyɛ dɛ.

Nnuan a wɔde bankye ayɛ 

 Kokonte anaa abete— a efi cassava powder a wɔayiyi a ayow a wɔtaa de ka asase so soup ho, a ɛyɛ nam ahorow te sɛ tripe, oguammaa, anaa wusiw a wɔde ma
 Fufu — cassava ne plantain a wɔayam, yam ne plantain a wɔayam, anaasɛ cocoyam/taro a wɔayam . Wɔde Ghanafo soup ahorow pii no mu biako ka saa aduan a ɛka ho yi ho bere nyinaa.
 Gari —a wɔde cassava na ɛyɛ. Wɔtaa de Red red, apataa ne black-eyed pea stew, anaa shito ne mpataa di dwuma.
 Attiéké anaa Akyeke— wɔde cassava na ɛyɛ na Ahanta, Nzema ne nnipa a wɔka Akan kasa a wɔwɔ Ivory Coast ani gye ho.
 Plakali —wɔde cassava na ɛyɛ na Ahanta, Nzema ne Akan kasafo a wɔwɔ Ivory Coast ani gye ho.
 Yakayake - a wɔde steamed grated cassava ayɛ no yɛ ade a Ewefo ani gye ho. Wɔde nnuan a wɔayam anaa soup ahorow na edi.

Soup ne nnuan a wɔayam 
Wɔde stew, soup anaa mako (aduru a ɛyɛ nnuhwam a wɔde akutu kɔkɔɔ ne ahabammono a wɔannoa, ayɛyɛde ne tomato ( ɛmo a wɔde ayɛ ) na ɛyɛ Ghanafo nnuan dodow no ara. Ghanafo aduan a wɔayam ne soups yɛ nea ɛyɛ nwonwa yiye, na wɔde nneɛma a ɛyɛ nwonwa, nneɛma ahorow pii a ɛyɛ dɛ, nnuhuam ne nneɛma a wɔde yɛ nneɛma di dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ mmerɛw so na ɛyɛ mmerɛw.

Nnuadewa te sɛ mmɛw, atoko, kokoyam nhaban, ayoyo, akutu, wuram nsenia, okra, turo mu nkesua ( eggplant ), tomato ne atoko ahorow ahorow ne nneɛma atitiriw a wɔde yɛ Ghana soup ne stews na wɔ pulses fam no, ebetumi abɔ mmɔho abien sɛ ade titiriw a wɔde yɛ protein.

Nantwinam, mprako nam, abirekyi, oguammaa, akokɔnam, akokɔnam a wɔayam no wusiw, tripe, nwansena a ayow, ne mpataa a wɔayam no taa nya protein fibea wɔ Ghanafo soup ne stew mu, ɛtɔ mmere bi a wɔde nam ahorow ne ɛtɔ mmere bi a mpataa frafra soup biako mu. Wɔde soup ma sɛ aduan titiriw sen sɛ wɔde befi ase. Ɛtaa nso sɛ wubehu nam, mpataa ne ɛpo mu nnuan a wɔayam no wusiw wɔ Ghanafo soup ne stews mu.
Wɔn mu bi ne krak, shrimp, periwinkles, octopus, nkraman, grubs, ananse, offal, ne mprako trotters . Afei nso oysters .

Wobetumi de nam, nsenia ne ɛpo mu nnuan ayɛ wusiw, wɔde nkyene ahyɛ mu anaasɛ wɔde ayow de ama dɛ ayɛ kɛse na wɔakora so. Wɔde nkyene mpataa di dwuma kɛse de ma aduan a wɔde mpataa ayɛ no dɛ. Wɔde nnuhuam te sɛ thyme, garlic, onions, ginger, peppers, curry, basil, nutmeg, sumbala, Tetrapleura tetraptera ( prekese ) ne bay ahaban di dwuma fɛfɛɛfɛ de nya dɛ a ɛyɛ nwonwa na ɛyɛ nnuhwam a ɛda adi wɔ Ghanafo aduan mu no.

Palm oil, coconut oil, shea butter, palm kernel oil ne peanut oil yɛ Ghana ngo a ɛho hia a wɔde noa aduane anaa wɔnoa na ɛtɔ da bi a ebia wɔremfa nsi ananmu wɔ Ghana nnuan bi mu. Sɛ nhwɛso no, sɛ wɔde mmɛw ngo di dwuma wɔ okro a wɔayam, eto, fante fante, kɔkɔɔ kɔkɔɔ anaa Gabeans, egusi a wɔayam ne mpihu/mpotompoto (a ɛte sɛ poi ) mu. Akutu ngo, nnuadewa ngo ne shea bɔta ahwere wɔn din wɔ aduannoa mu wɔ Ghana esiane ngo a wɔayɛ no yiye a wɔde aba ne Ghana nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo dawurubɔ bɔne a wɔde wɔn ani asi saa ngo no so nti. Mprempren wɔde di dwuma kɛse wɔ afie kakraa bi a wɔde di dwuma wɔ amanne kwan so mu, de yɛ samina ne wɔn a wɔtɔn nnuan a wɔtɔn ( mmɔnten so nnuan ) sɛ nea ne bo nyɛ den a wɔde besi ngo a wɔayam a wɔde noa aduan ananmu.Ghanafo soup a wɔtaa de di dwuma ne groundnut soup, light (tomato) soup, kontomire ( taro nhaban) soup, palm nut soup, ayoyo soup ne okra soup.

Ghana tomato stew anaa gravy yɛ stew a wɔtaa de aburow anaa waakye ka ho . Wɔde kontomire, turo mu nkesua, egusi (akutu aba), akutu, okra, ne nea ɛkeka ho na ɛyɛ nhabannuru afoforo a wɔayam.

Nnuan a ɛyɛ dɛ 
Mpɔtam hɔ nnuan a ɛyɛ dɛ pii wɔ hɔ a wɔde ato nkyɛn esiane nea wɔhwehwɛ pii ne bere tenten a wɔde siesie nti. Ghanafo nnuan a ɛyɛ dɛ (anaasɛ nnɔkɔnnɔkɔwade) betumi ayɛ nea wɔayam, wɔayam, anoa, wɔayam, tow anaa wɔayam .

Nnuan a ɛyɛ dɛ a wɔayam no bi ne plantain ( kelewele ) a abere a wɔde cubed ne nnuhuam ayɛ a ɛtɔ mmere bi a wɔde atoko ka ho. Koose a wɔde bankye a wɔayiyi ayɛ (ne ne twin twin acarajé anaa akara a wɔde bankye a wɔantutu), maasa, pinkaaso, ne bofrot / Puff-puff (a wɔde awi esiam ayɛ ) . ; waakye  dzowey ne nkate keeki (a wɔde atokoɔ na ɛyɛ); kaklo ne tatale  (plantain fritters a abere ); kube keeki ne kube toffee (a wɔde akutu na ɛyɛ); bankye krakro, gari bisket, ne krakye ayuosu (a wɔde atoko na ɛyɛ); nufusu a wɔayam, toffee, plantain chips (anaasɛ plantain a wɔayam ) ne wagashi  ( okuafo kyiisi a wɔayam ) yɛ Ghanafo nnuan a wɔayam a ɛyɛ dɛ (confectionery).

Kebab yɛ barbecue a agye din na wobetumi de nantwinam, abirekyi, mprako nam, soya esiam, soseji ne guinea nnomaa ayɛ. Nnuan afoforo a wɔayam a ɛyɛ dɛ ne plantain a wɔayam, atoko, yam ne cocoyam .

Atoko a wɔayam no foforo, yakeyake, kafa, akyeke, tubani, moimoi (bean keeki), emo dokonu ( aburow keeki ) ne esikyire dokonu ( kenkey a wɔayam no dɛ ) nyinaa yɛ nnuan a wɔayam ne nea wɔanoa bere a wɔde paanoo a ɛyɛ dɛ, (plantain keeki), ne nam ho nhwɛso pie a ɛte sɛ Jamaica patties ne empanadas yɛ nnuan a wɔato a ɛyɛ dɛ. Aprapransa, eto (yam a wɔayam) ne atadwe nufusu ( ɔsebɔ nnuaba nsu) yɛ nnuan afoforo a ɛyɛ dɛ. Gari soakings yɛ nnɛyi ade a wɔpɛ. Ɛyɛ gari (cassava a ayow, a wɔayam), asikre, asase mu nnua (atoko) ne nufusu a wɔde afra.

title: Mzbel
text:
Belinda Nana Ekua Amoah (wɔwoo no 26 December 1979), a nnipa pii frɛ no Mzbel, yɛ Ghana Hiplife adwumtoni. Ɔyɛ Mzbel Music, Bel Group, Bel Eye Media ne afoforo CEO. Mzbel yɛ radio so ɔyɛkyerɛfo na ɔsan yɛ odiyifo, na wayɛ sini ahorow pii . Ɔyɛ wiase nyinaa ɔnanmusifo ma nnipa a wɔadi dɛm. Wɔ afe 2022 mu no, wɔyɛɛ no brand ambassador ma Pinamang Cosmetics. afe 2022 mu no, ɔde ne nsa hyɛɛ Ginger Global Music Distribution ase.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Bere a onyinii wɔ James Town no, ɔkɔɔ Onyankopɔn Nyansa Ahosiesie sukuu ahorow, na ɔkɔɔ so kɔɔ Korle Gonno 1 ne Owusu Mills JHS wɔ Mamprobi [Accra kurotia] maa ne Ntoaso Sukuu Nhomasua. Mzbel agye atom sɛ ɔde ne ho yɛɛ honam ani fitaa wɔ ne mmabunbere mu efisɛ na ɛyɛ ade a wɔtaa yɛ wɔ Jamestown.

Afei Mzbel kɔɔ so yɛɛ Ntoaso sukuu wɔ Abuakwa State College . Ɔsuaa adwinni a ɛfa nneɛma nyinaa ho a na ɔyɛ sikasɛm, asase ho adesua ne Franse kasa titiriw. Afei ɔde nkra kɔsuaa adeɛ wɔ Ghana Institute of Languages, na ɔtetee ne ho sɛ ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔkyerɛwfoɔ a ɔka kasa mmienu.

Nnwom adwuma 
Wɔ n'adesua wɔ GIL ne stint wɔ Manifold Tutorial College akyi no, onyaa internship slot wɔ GBC Radio 1 baabi a ɔyɛɛ mmofra dwumadi "Mmofra Kyepem". Ofi GBC Radio 1 kɔkaa Groove FM, [mprempren Adom FM ], sɛ obi a ɔreyɛ adwuma wɔ hɔ na ɔne no yɛɛ dwumadi bi a ɛfa mmofra ho a wɔato din 'Kids on Groove'.

Haven ne Groove FM yɛɛ adwuma bere tiaa bi, nkonimbo a ɛkorɔn a wɔhwehwɛ no maa Mzbel kɔɔ TV3 sɛ ɔyɛkyerɛ boafo ma dwumadibea no dwumadi ahorow a ɛfa mmabun ho a wonim no sɛ Goldblast no biako. Ɔsan nso yɛɛ adwuma sɛ fam sohwɛfoɔ ma saa ara na ɔsan nso yɛɛ adwuma sɛ production assistant ma program foforɔ "Talking Drum".

Wɔ afe 2002 mu no, Mzbel nyaa hokwan ne Hush Hush Studios a saa bere no na ɛbae sɛ adwumakuw foforo a wɔyɛ nneɛma no yɛɛ adwuma. Bere a ɔwɔ Hush Hush no, ɛtɔ mmere bi a na wɔka kyerɛ no sɛ ɔnkɔ studio hɔ, na bere a mfiridwumayɛfo no rebɔ wɔn nnwinnade no, ɔtoo dwom kaa ho, nnwom a wabɔ. Ná eyinom yɛ nnwom a na ɔtaa to ma ne ho a onni adwene a anibere wom sɛ ɔbɛyɛ nnwom adwuma. Bere a ɔreyɛ adwuma bere fã wɔ Hush Hush Studios no, onyaa adwuma foforo, wɔ Metro TV sɛ dijitaal video samufo koro pɛ na ɔsan nso yɛ ‘Smash TV’, dapɛn awiei anigyede dwumadi.

Efi Metro TV no, wɔde no yɛɛ adwuma wɔ Apex Advertising sɛ video samufo ne adwumayɛ sohwɛfo. Na ɛsɛ sɛ ɔka Nnwom ne n’adwuma mu dwumadi ahorow bom wɔ Apex, na bere a ohui sɛ abien no hwehwɛ nneɛma pii dodo no, Mzbel paw sɛ ɔbɛma nnwom no anya n’adwene nyinaa. Bere kɔ so no, wɔakasa atia no wɔ ntade a ɔpaw a wɔaka ho asɛm sɛ "sexy" anaa "skimpy" no ho. wɔ n’ankasa nsɛm mu no, Mzbel gye di nanso sɛ́ mfoniniyɛfo no, ɛsɛ sɛ woyɛ soronko. Wanya ɔpɛ bere nyinaa sɛ ɔbɛyɛ nhyɛso fibea ama wɔn a wonni hokwan biara na watumi aboa wɔn a wɔatiatia wɔn so no.

title: Naa Ashorkor
text:
Naa Ashorkor (wɔwoo no 24 Ɔbɛnem 1988) a wɔsan frɛ no Nisirine Naa Ashorkor Mensah-Doku, yɛ Ghana odiyifo ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ nipa a mprempren ɔyɛ adwuma wɔ Asaase Radio radio dwumadibea bi a ɛwɔ Accra. Wonim no sɛ ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ " The Perfect Picture " (2009) , a Shirley Frimpong-Manso yɛe ne Iroko TV Poisoned Bait - sini a Leila Djansi kyerɛɛ no kwan.

Ɔnyaa Award for Best Actress wɔ afe 2010 mu wɔ African Movie Academy abasobɔdeɛ mu wɔ ne dwumadie wɔ " The Perfect Picture " (2009) mu. Naa Ashorkor nso ne Yvonne Okoro, Joselyn Dumas, John Dumelo dii dwuma .

Adwuma 
Naa Ashorkor, ne Oyikyerɛfoɔ Chris Attoh na wɔyɛɛ Vodafone Ghana Nnwom Abasobɔdeɛ 2016 (VGMAs 2016)  a wɔyɛɛ no Accra Amanaman Ntam Nhyiamu Asoɛeɛ . Ɔsan nso yɛɛ Miss Maliaka akansi no ho nhyehyɛe mfe awotwe. Wɔ afe 2008 mu no, ɔyɛɛ ne sini mu dwumadi a edi kan a Shirley Frimpong Manso yɛe no mu .  Askorkor fii ase sɛ ɔyɛkyerɛfo wɔ Starr 103.5 FM baabi a ɔyɛɛ anɔpa mfinimfini dwumadi bi a wɔtoo din The Zone.

Ashorkor yɛ brand ambassador ma Unilever Ghana, ɔdi wɔn ɔsatuo anim ma Lifebuoy Hand-Washing Ambassador, Verna Mineral Water, ɔkamfoo wɔ Verna Mineral Water Autism Awareness Ambassador  ne DKT International Ghana nso a ɔsom sɛ Lydia Contraceptives Brand Ambassador a ɔyɛ ɔnanmusifo.

Na Ashorkor de ne ho ahyɛ television so dawurubɔ ahorow pii a agye din mu titiriw esiane Tigo Ghana Drop That Yam ne Yensor Nkoaa dawurubɔ ahorow nti.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Naa Ashorkor waree ne hokafoɔ a ɔne no atena akyɛ Ahuma Cabutey Adodoadji wɔ afe 2014. Wɔ 15 Ɔbɛnem 2017 no, ɔnam nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ne sohyial media so de ne babarima awoɔ too gua. Ɔde ne ba a ɔtɔ so mmienu a ɔno nso yɛ ɔbabarima awoɔ too gua wɔ 1 July 2019.
