title: Lordina Mahama
text:
Lordina Mahama (née Effah ; wɔwoo no 6 Oforisuo 1963) yɛ Ghanani kan Awuraa a ɔdi kan wɔ Ghana a ɔsom sɛ ɔbaa a ɔdi kan firi afe 2012 kɔsi afe 2017. Ɔwaree Ghana Ɔmanpanyin a ɔto so nnan John Dramani Mahama . Ansa na ɔrebɛyɛ First Lady no, na ɔyɛ Ghana Lady a ɔtɔ so mmienu firi afe 2009 kɔsi afe 2012.

Ansa na Lordina Mahama rebɛyɛ Awuraa a ɔtɔ so mmienu no, na Lordina Mahama kunu yɛɛ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua no muni a ɔgyinaa Bole-Bamboi amansin ananmu firi afe 1997 kɔsi afe 2008.

Wɔtetee no wɔ Brong-Ahafo ne Tamale wɔ Ghana Atifi Mantam mu, Mahama yɛ obi a wɔatete no sɛ ɔyɛ aduanmafo na ɔyɛ Ahɔhoyɛ sohwɛfo. Ɔyɛ obi a wawie Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration, baabi a onyaa abodin krataa wɔ Hospitality Management ne Masters wɔ Governance and Leadership mu. Ɔsan nso yɛ obi a wawie De Montfort Sukuupɔn a ɛwɔ United Kingdom .

Mahama bɛkaa ne kunu ho wɔ ɔsatu akwan so ansa na afe 2008 reba bere a na ɔyɛ John Atta Mills yɔnko mmirikatufoɔ ne afe 2013 ne 2017 nyinaa mu nso berɛ a na ɔyɛ frankaa kurafoɔ ma National Democratic Congress, ɔdii nkonim wɔ afe 2013 mu nanso ɔdii nkoguo wɔ afe 2017 mu.

Bere a sɛ́ ɔbea a odi kan no Mahama yɛɛ nhwɛso maa mmea wɔ Ghana na ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ obi a ɔkamfo HIV/AIDS ho nimdeɛ, Nufu ne Awotwaa mu Kokoram ho nimdeɛ, nyisaa ne abayifo a wɔkyerɛ sɛ wɔyɛ. Mprempren ɔyɛ Lordina Mahama fapem no Titenani, adɔe kuw bi a wɔn asɛmti ne "Dodow a yɛkyɛ no, dodow no ara na yɛwɔ".

Mfitiase asetra 
Wɔwoo no Lordina Effah wɔ March 6, 1963, a Owura ne Owurayere a wɔawuwu no na wɔwoo no. Effah. Lordina fi Jema-Ampoma wɔ Nkoranza Mantam mu, a ɛwɔ Brong-Ahafo Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔno ne mma baasa mu nea otwa to. Ɔnyaa ne nteteeɛ a ɛdi kan wɔ Tamale, Ghana, wɔ Tishigu Anglikan mfitiaseɛ sukuu mu. Afei ɔkɔɔ Ghana Ntoaso Sukuu a ɛwɔ Tamale, na ɔwiee ne GCE adesua. Ɛyɛ Ghana Ntoaso Sukuu mu na Lordina hyiaa ne kunu a ɔbɛware no daakye, John Dramani Mahama.

Nhomasua ne adwumayɛ 
Mahama yɛ osuani wɔ Flair Catering Services, na onyaa mfeɛ nnan kɔlege adesua wɔ Hospitality Management mu wɔ Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration (GIMPA) Ɔsuaa Masters of Arts wɔ Governance and Leadership mu wɔ Ghana Asoɛe a ɛhwɛ adwumayɛ ne ɔman adwumayɛ so (GIMPA) na owiee sukuu wɔ afe 2012. Mahama wieeɛ ne Master of Laws (LLM) wɔ Adwumayɛ Mmara/Amanaman Ntam Adwumayɛ Mmara mu wɔ De Montfort Suapɔn a ɛwɔ United Kingdom wɔ afe 2019.

Amammui mu dwumadi ahorow

Ghana Awuraa a Ɔto so Abien 
Owurayere. Mahama bɛyɛɛ Awuraa a Ɔtɔ so mmienu berɛ a ne kunu John Dramani Mahama, a na ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanyin, bɛyɛɛ Ghana ɔmampanyin abadiakyiri maa Ɔmampanyin John Evans Atta-Mills wɔ 7 Ɔbɛnem 2009. Ɔsom sɛ Awuraa a ɔtɔ so mmienu kɔsii July 2012, berɛ a ɔbɛyɛɛ Ghana Awuraa a ɔdi kan.

Ghana ɔbea a odi kan 
Nea ɛne Ghana amansan mmara hyia no, ne kunu bɛyɛɛ Ghana Ɔmampanyin wɔ 24 July 2012 wɔ deɛ ɔdii n’anim, John Atta Mills wuo so na ɔkaa ntam wɔ mmrahyɛbagua no mu wɔ July 2012 mu, na ɛno ara na ɛmaa ɔbɛyɛɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanyin a ɔdi kan. Sɛ Awuraa a odi kan no ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ HIV/AIDS ho ɔkamfofo, Nufu ne awotwaa mu kokoram ho ɔkamfofo, ɔmaa mmea tumi denam ne fapem ne Mfiridwuma ne Adwumayɛ Ntetee (TVET) so bere a ɔsan nso gyinaa Ghana ananmu wɔ nhyiam ahorow ne nhyiam ahorow ase de susuw nsɛm a ɛfa mmea ne mmofra ho.

OAFLA 
Wɔ ne berɛ a ɔyɛ Ɔbaa Panyin no, wɔsan paw Mahama sɛ Afrika Mmea a Wɔdi Kan a Wɔko Tia HIV ne AIDS (OAFLA) Ahyehyɛdeɛ no Titenani wɔ June 2015 mu. Ansa na ɛno reba no, na wayɛ Ɔmampanyin Abadiakyiri ama Afrika Atɔe Fam Mantam a ɛwɔ OAFLA no.

Sɛ Afrika Mmea a Wodi Kan Ahyehyɛde a Ɛko Tia HIV ne AIDS (OAFLA) no Titenani no, wɔhyɛɛ Mahama anuonyam wɔ Amanaman Ntam Mmea Awia Aduan a ɛto so 50 a ɛbaa Rainbow Push Coalition a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Chicago (USA) no mu esiane ne dwumadi ne adwuma a ɛda nsow a ɔyɛe wɔ wɔn a wodi hia a ɔkamfoo wɔn no ho nti ne mmofra a wonni ahobammɔ wɔ Afrika ne ne dwumadi sɛ ɔmampanyin nso a ɔde bɛma mmea tumi ma wɔadi wɔn awo akwahosan hokwan ahorow ho dwuma, na wama HIV a ɛkɔ ɛna mu kɔ abofra mu no aba awiei.

HIV/AIDS ho nsɛm a wɔkamfo kyerɛ 
Efi afe 2013 kɔsii sɛ ɔgyaee adwuma no, Mahama ne Ghana AIDS Commission ne nnwumakuo foforɔ yɛɛ adwuma de HIV ne AIDS, Sexual Reproductive health, Nufu ne Awotwaa mu kokoram dwumadie a wɔaka abom baa mpɔtam du a ɛwɔ Ghana saa berɛ no nyinaa mu. Gyinae a wosii sɛ wɔde HIV ne AIDS som bɛka akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a ɛte saa ho no fi sɛ na wonim sɛ nnipa a wɔanya HIV no tumi nya kokoram kɛse. Esiane ɛno nti wɔ saa nkɔmmɔdie no mu no, kan Awuraa a ɔdi kan no faa hokwan no nso ne akannifoɔ, mpɔtam a ɔkɔɔ hɔ no mufoɔ dii nkitaho tẽẽ de kamfoo sɛ nnipa pii bɛhunu wɔn gyinabea na wɔafi ayaresa ase ntɛm. Ɔkɔɔ so yɛɛ obi a ɔkamfo nsɛm a ɛfa HIV/AIDS ho kyerɛ denneennen bere a na ɔresom sɛ Awuraa a Odi Kan no.

Nufu ne awotwaa mu kokoram ho nsɛm a wɔkamfo kyerɛ 
Wɔ ne bere so no, na Mahama yɛ obi a ɔkamfo Nufu ne Awotwaa mu kokoram kyerɛ.  Ɛnam ne fapem ne ne dwumadie sɛ Awuraa a Odi kan so no, ɔde nhyehyɛeɛ baeɛ a ɛbɛma wɔahu mmaa ntɛm titire wɔ Ghana nkuraaseɛ de ahwɛ sɛ sɛ ɛho hia a, wɔbɛsa wɔn yareɛ yie.

Ɛnam ne fapem ne mmoa a ɛfiri aban ne ankorankoro ne ahyehyɛdeɛ foforɔ a ɛnyɛ aban de hɔ so no, wɔde GAVI vaccination nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde siw awotwaa mu kokoram ne nyarewa foforɔ ano ama mmabaa binom a wɔwɔ Ghana. Obu mmea sɛ wɔyɛ mmoa titiriw ma wiase sikasɛm nya nkɔso sɛnea wɔahu wɔ mfe no mu no na ɔkɔɔ so frɛɛ ahyehyɛde ahorow a ɛnyɛ aban de sɛ wɔmmoa mma wonsiw akwahosan ho nkɔso ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔde ma mu nsonsonoe a ɛwɔ kokoram ho no ano bere a wɔde sika fibea titiriw ma no ma nnwuma a ɛtete saa a entumi nnyina aban ahorow a ɛde akwahosan ho sika ma no ano.

Ɔgyinaa Ghana ananmu wɔ Stop Cervical, Breast and Prostate Cancer nhyiamu a ɛtɔ so 8, 9, 10 ne 11 no ase. Wɔ nhyiamu a ɛtɔ so 8 no mu no, ɔbɔɔ amanneɛ sɛ Ghana rebɛhyɛ aseɛ de mfeɛ anum Ɔman Nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa Kokoram a wɔbɛsi ho no adi dwuma de akɔ nnwuma ahodoɔ a ɛbɛboa ama wɔadi nufu ne awotwaa mu kokoram, ne kokoram foforɔ a ɛwɔ ɔman no mu ho dwuma na wɔadi so.

Wɔ 21 Ɔpɛpɔn 2015 no, ɔfrɛɛ mmaa a wɔdi kan foforɔ wɔ 9th Stop Cervical, Breast and Prostate Cancer (SCCA) nhyiamu a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Nairobi, Kenya, sɛ ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔhunu nnwinnadeɛ sɛ adaeɛ na mmom wɔnyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ne ɔsatuo a wɔbɛyɛ de ahwɛ ahu ntɛm a wobehu na wɔadi ɔsatu a wɔayɛ ho nhyehyɛe, a ɛbɛkɔ so atra hɔ anim na wɔne nnwumakuw ne ahyehyɛde ahorow a ɛfa ho ayɛ adwuma de aboa kokoram a wosiw ano ne ne siw ano wɔ Afrika.

Mahama maa wɔdaa no adi sɛ afe biara wohu sɛ mmea bɛyɛ 2,900 na wɔwɔ nufu mu kokoram wɔ Ghana na wogyina nea Wiase Akwahosan Ahyehyɛde (WHO) hui so no, wobu akontaa sɛ mmea ɔpepem 6.7 a wonnii mfe 15 ne akyi wɔ Ghana wɔ asiane mu sɛ wobenya awotwaa ne nufu mu kokoram, denam ne nhyehyɛe ne aban ahorow no so no, na wɔwɔ anidaso sɛ wɔbɛma tebea no atu mpɔn wɔ Ghana na wɔatew kokoram a wowuwu no so ɔha biara mu nkyem 30.

Hwɛ wɔn a wonni ahotɔ 
Bere a na ɔyɛ Awuraa a Odi Kan no, Mahama dii nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde hwɛɛ wɔn a wonni ahobammɔ wɔ ɔmanfo no anim. Na n'adwene ne sɛ ɔde nnuan, ofiehwɛ nneɛma, ntade, ne nneɛma atitiriw afoforo bɛma nyisaa atrae ne ''abayifo nsraban' a ɛwɔ Ghana mu.

Ɔnam ne fapem so no, ɔfaa nyisaa atrae asia a wonni ahobammɔ ne abayifo nsraban biako wɔ Ghana sɛ mmeae a wɔde wɔn adwene besi so ama ne ntoboa bere a ɔda so ara reboa nyisaa atrae afoforo. Ná nyisaa atrae ne abayifo nsraban no yɛ abien wɔ Greater Accra Mantam mu ; Osu Mmofra Fie a ɛwɔ Osu ne Christ Faith Forster fie a ɛwɔ Frafraha, abien wɔ Brong Ahafo Mantam mu ; FrankMay Mmofra Fie ne Bethesda Mmofra Fie nyinaa wɔ Techiman, abien wɔ Atifi Fam Mantam mu ; Tamale Mmofra Fie ne Anfaani Mmofra Fie a ɛwɔ Tamale ne Gambaga Abayifo Nsraban a ɛwɔ Atifi Apuei Mantam mu nyinaa . Wɔ bere a ɔsomm no mu no ɔde ntoboa pii maa nyisaa atrae yi ne afoforo pii.

Wɔ May 2014 mu no, ɔkɔɔ Gambaga Witch Camp na ɔde Bags of rice, nkukuo, ntadeɛ asinasin ne nneɛma foforɔ maeɛ maa wɔn up keep. Ofii ase sii dabere maa wɔn a wɔkyerɛ sɛ wɔyɛ abayifo wɔ Gambaga nsraban no mu. Ɔsan nso kɔsraa Nyohini Mmofra Fie ne Anfaani Nyisaa Atrae a ɛwɔ Tamale, faako a ɔne mmofra no dii nkitaho na ɔde ntoboa maa nnuan a aburow nkotoku, asikre, nufusu, nneɛma a wɔde guare ne afoforo ka ho de hwɛɛ mmofra a wɔwɔ nyisaa atrae hɔ.

Wɔ December 2016 mu no, ɔne Nana Oye Lithur, Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ Bɔbeasu, Mmofra ne Asetra mu Ahobammɔ so no buee dabere a wɔde ma mmofra nkumaa a ne fapem a ɛwɔ Osu Mmofra Fie no de sika boae no ano. Ɔde nnuan ne ntade a wɔde ayɛ bales nso mae de boaa mmofra no ma wodii Buronya no.

Mmea Tumidi denam TVET so 
Ɔnam ne mmaa tumidi nhyehyɛeɛ so gyee Gambaga Abayifoɔ Nsraban a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Apueeɛ Mantam mu sɛ beaeɛ a ɛhia sɛ wɔhwɛ so. Ɔhyɛɛ nteteeɛ beaeɛ a wɔbɛsi adwuma bi ase wɔ nsraban no mu a wɔfrɛ no Gambaga Nteteeɛ Beaeɛ sɛ wɔde adwumayɛ ho nteteeɛ ne adwumayɛfoɔ ho nimdeɛ foforɔ bɛma de asom mmaa ne mmabaa a wɔwɔ nsraban no mu ne mpɔtam a ɛbɛn hɔ. Na saa ahokokwaw yi boa ma wonya tumi na ɛboa ma wofi wɔn ankasa nnwuma ase bere a wɔawie no. Sɛ́ ntetee beae no fã no na ɔde ahɔhodan bi reto hɔ ama sukuufo a wɔwɔ Gambaga ne ne mpɔtam a wɔbɛpɛ sɛ wɔtete wɔn ho wɔ beae hɔ.

Ɔsan nso de ntoboa pii a ɛyɛ mfitiaseɛ nneɛma maa nsaanodwumayɛfoɔ a wɔwɔ ɔman no mu nyinaa a wɔawie na wɔawie adwumayɛ nteteeɛ mmeaeɛ ne asoɛeɛ ahodoɔ sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a ɛbɛyɛ mmerɛ sɛ wɔbɛkɔ adwumayɛ wiase no mu na aboa wɔn ma  wɔn ankasa nnwuma ne, eyinom bi ne ntoboa a wɔde boa China Aban Nnanmusini a ɛwɔ Ghana denam wɔn Aban Asoɛe Sun Baohong so.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Lordina aware John Dramani Mahama na wɔabom wɔ mma baanum a wɔfrɛ wɔn Shafik, Shahid, Sharaf, Jesse ne Farida. Ɔka Borɔfo, Hausa, Dagbani ne Twi yiye.

Nnipa mmoa adwuma 
N’adɔeɛ kuo, The Lordina Foundation, aka wɔn a wɔnya mu mfasoɔ wɔ Ghana mantam ahodoɔ asetena. Fapem no asɛmti ne "Dodow a yɛkyɛ no, dodow no ara na yɛwɔ". Wɔde ntoboa ma titiriw wɔ Buronya bere mu ne mmere afoforo mu wɔ afe no mu.

Hwɛ nso 

 Ghana Awuraa a Ɔto so Abien
 Nana Konadu Agyeman Rawlings a ɔyɛ ɔbaabun
 Ernestina Naadu Mills na ɔkyerɛwee

Nidi ne agyede a wɔde ma 
Kan Awuraa a Odi Kan no wɔ abasobɔde ahorow bi a wɔde ama ne din ne ne ho anuonyam. Eyinom bi ne:

 Nidi Oduruyɛfo a Ɔhwɛ Nnipa Nkrataa Ho, a Fordham Sukuupɔn no Titenani ne Wɔn a Wɔhwɛ So no kyerɛwee .
 Abasobɔde a wɔde ma wɔ ɔsatu a wɔde ma wɔ awotwaa mu kokoram ho, Maputo, Mozambique. 
 Abasobɔde a wɔde kamfo awotwaa mu kokoram ho asɛm, Windhoek, Namibia. 
 Wɔde wɔn hyɛɛ Wiase Nyinaa Mmea Akannifo Asa a Wɔagye Din no mu. 
 Wiase Nyinaa Nkannyan Akannifo Abasobɔde wɔ Afrika-Mfinimfini Apuei-Asia nhyiam a wɔyɛe wɔ Dubai no ase. 
 Enstooled sɛ Sompahemaa a ofi Nkoranza Amammerɛ Mpɔtam, a ɔwɔ stool abodin (Nana Akosua Fremaa Ampomah Sika I)
 Enstooled sɛ Development Queen wɔ Bodom wɔ Brong Ahafo mantam mu wɔ Ghana. 
 Enstooled sɛ Development Queen wɔ Ampoma wɔ Brong Ahafo mantam mu wɔ Ghana. 
 Wɔde ne ho hyɛɛ mu sɛ Nkɔso Hemmaa wɔ Anloga wɔ Kumasi, Ashanti mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Patience Kpobi
text:
Patience Kpobi yɛ Ghana ɔman bɔɔlbɔni a ne agodie gyinabea bi ne mfinimfini ne defense .

Amanaman ntam adwuma 
Ɛwom sɛ biribiara nni hɔ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɔdaa ne ho adi wɔ akansi no mu de, nanso na ɔka akansi kuw a wɔde bɛkɔ asasepɔn ntam agodie a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Amerika Kesee Fam ne Afrika akuw a ɛto so abien no ntam, a wɔne Brazil, dii no ho bere a na wɔrefata ama 2008 Olimpik akansi no .

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Letitia Obeng
text:
Letitia Eva Takyibea Obeng FGA (wɔwoo no 10 Ɔbɛnem 1925 - 2023) wɔ Anum wɔ Apuei Fam Mantam mu ne Ghanani bea a odi kan a onyaa abodin krataa wɔ mmoa ho adesua mu na odi kan a wɔmaa no oduruyɛfo abodin krataa . Wɔka ne ho asɛm sɛ "nyansahufo mmea nanabea wɔ Ghana".

Nwomasua 
Letitia Obeng kɔɔ mfitiase sukuu wɔ Abetifi, Kwahu ne mfinimfini sukuu wɔ Kyebi . Wɔ 1939 ne 1946 ntam no onyaa ne ntoaso sukuu adesua wɔ Achimota College . Bere a na ɔwɔ sukuu mu no ɔyɛɛ London Sukuupɔn Amanaman Ntam Sɔhwɛ de toaa ne nhomasua so, esiane aban sika a ɔde maa no wɔ Birmingham Sukuupɔn mu (1948–1952), faako a na ɔno nkutoo ne Afrikani ɔbea sukuuni wɔ Edgbaston sukuupɔn no mu. Owiee sukuupɔn no na onyaa abodin krataa wɔ Mmoa Ho Adesua mu.  Wɔ n’abrabɔ ho asɛm mu no, ɔka osuahu a onyae bere a ɔbaa United Kingdom bɛsua ade wɔ ɔko no akyi mfe no mu, a adwemmɔne a ohyiae no ka ho.

Adwuma, nkɔso ne abasobɔde ahorow

Abodin krataa ahorow 
Letitia Obeng yɛ Ghanani bea a odi kan a wɔmaa no Bachelor of Science abodin krataa wɔ Mmoa ne Nnua Ho Adesua mu (1952), Master of Science abodin krataa wɔ Parasitology mu (1962) ne PhD wɔ Tropical Medicine mu (1964). Birmingham Sukuupɔn na ɛde ne Bachelor ne Master of Science abodin krataa nyinaa maa no na Liverpool Sukuu a ɛhwɛ Tropical Medicine so na ɛde ne PhD maa no, faako a osuaa nwansena tuntum ne sɛnea ɛfa asubɔnten mu anifurae ho ade no . Ohuu nsu pa ho adesua ahorow a ɛwɔ North Wales no yiye wɔ ne PhD adesua mu na na ɔtaa de ne mma baasa a na wɔadi mfe 8, 6 ne 3 saa bere no ba sɛ wɔmmɛfa nsubɔnten ne nsubɔnten a ɛwɔ mpɔtam hɔ no mu.

Dibea ahorow 
Ɔwiee sukuupɔn mu adesua wɔ United Kingdom no, ɔsan kɔɔ ne kurom Ghana na ɔmaa ɔkasa wɔ University College of Science and Technology a seesei wɔfrɛ no Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology wɔ afe 1952 ne 1959 ntam Wɔ afe 1952 mu no, Letitia Obeng bɛyɛɛ ɔbaa nyansahufoɔ a ɔdi kan wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so (KNUST) a ne kunu nso yɛɛ adwuma sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ.  Ne kunu wuo wɔ afe 1959 mu no, Letitia Obeng tu kɔɔ Council for Scientific and Industrial Research (CSIR) (kan no na wɔfrɛ no National Research Council of Ghana) na afe 1964 mu no, ɔhyehyɛɛ Institute of Aquatic Biology wɔ saa asoɛeɛ korɔ no ara mu sɛ wɔnyɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ Ghana deɛ ho Volta Ɔtare kɛse a nnipa ayɛ ne ne nsu a ɛwɔ asase mu no.  Letitia Obeng ne nyansahufo a odi kan a Ghana Ɔman Nhwehwɛmu Bagua no de no yɛɛ adwuma. Wɔ afe 1965 mu no, Letitia Obeng bɛyɛɛ Ghana Adesuabea a ɛhwɛ adwinni ne nyansahu so no yɔnko na afe 2006 mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ adesuabea no titrani a odi kan.  Wɔ 1972 mu no, Oduruyɛfo Obeng maa Caroline Haslett Nkaedi Ɔkasa no kyerɛɛ Royal Society a Ɛhyɛ Adwinni, Nneɛma a Wɔyɛ ne Aguadi Ho Nkuran . Na ne kasa no asɛmti ne “Ɔman a Wɔkyekye ne Afrikani Ɔbea  ”. Afei nso wɔ 1972 mu no, na ɔyɛ obi a wɔtoo nsa frɛɛ no sɛ ɔmfa ne ho nhyɛ Amanaman Nkabom Nnipa Atwa Yɛn Ho Ahyia Nhyiam a wɔyɛe wɔ Stockholm no ase . Wɔ 1974 mu no, ofii ase yɛɛ adwuma sɛ Ɔpanyin wɔ Amanaman Nkabom no Nneɛma a Atwa Yɛn Ho Ahyia Dwumadi (UNEP) mu . Wɔ afe 1980 mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ UNEP Ɔmantam Dwumadibea a ɛhwɛ Afrika so no Panyin ne UNEP Anamusini wɔ Afrika. Wɔpaw no sɛ ɔbaa a odi kan wɔ Fellowship of the Ghana Academy of Arts and Sciences, wɔ afe 2008 mu no, wɔde adwene koro paw no sɛ ɔnyɛ ne Titenani a odi kan a ɔyɛ ɔbea.

Abasobɔde ne nea wɔatumi ayɛ 
Wɔ 1992–1993 mu no, na Letitia Obeng yɛ Amanaman Ntam Nsrahwɛfo a Wɔagye Din wɔ Radcliff College . Wɔ afe 1997 mu no, onyaa CSIR Award for Distinguished Career and Service to Science and Technology, ɔbea a odi kan a onyaa abasobɔde a ɛte saa. Bio nso, wɔde ne din too CSIR Laboratory (a wɔfrɛ no The Letitia Obeng Block) no din wɔ afe 1997. Letitia Obeng nyaa Ghana ɔman abasobɔde a ɛkorɔn sen biara, Order of the Star of Ghana wɔ afe 2006 mu. Wɔ afe 2017 mu no, ɔnyaa Doctor of Science abodin krataa a ɛyɛ nidi wɔ KNUST.

Ɔtwerɛfoɔ 
Ɔde ne nwoma a ɛdi kan - Anthology of a Lifetime sii hɔ wɔ July 2019. Ɛyɛ nyansahufo a wagye din no kasa, ɔkasa, nkyerɛwee ne nhoma ahorow a wɔapaw wɔ mfe 60 a atwam no mu.

Nhwehwɛmu ne nhoma ahorow 
Letitia Obeng nhwehwɛmu ne ne nhoma tintim twe adwene si nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia, akwahosan ne nyansahu ho adesua so titiriw wɔ Afrika. Ne oduruyɛfo nhwehwɛmu no hwehwɛɛ Simuliidae a wohui sɛ ɛyɛ ɔyare mmoawa titiriw a ɛde ɔyare mmoawa no kɔ asubɔnten mu anifurae mu no nsu mu tebea horow mu . Nea ɛfa nhwehwɛmu yi ho ne n’asɛm a wɔato din “Life-history and population studies on the Simuliidae of North Wales”  ne “The identification of the aquatic stages of the British Simuliidae”  Wɔ krataa bi a wɔato din "Environmental of Impacts of Four African Impoundments”, Ɔbenfo Obeng susuw nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia a Afrika atare anan de ba no ho: Ɔtare Volta, Ɔtare Kariba, Ɔtare Kainji ne Ɔtare Nasser . Nhwehwɛmu ne nhoma afoforo a ɔyɛe no bi ne:

 Nwansena mmoa a wɔyɛ mpɔtorɔ a wɔwɔ abusua ketewa Murinae mu wɔ Ghana. (1965) .
 Atare a nnipa ayɛ (1969).
 Wim mmoa a wɔwɔ Volta Basin. Atare a Nnipa ayɛ (1969); ɔne Asibey, EOA, boom kyerɛw
 Volta Ɔtare: Abɔde mu nneɛma ne abɔde mu nneɛma (1973) .
 So ɛsɛ sɛ wosisi atare? Volta Ɔtare no nhwɛso (1977) .
 Pii Dodo anaa Kakraa Dodo (1975) .
 Ɔkɔm anaasɛ Bilharzia? nkuraase nkɔso ho asɛnnennen bi (1978) .
 Nkɛntɛnso a onipa nya wɔ nsubɔnten a ɛwɔ mmeae a osu tɔ na owia bɔ kɛse so (1981) .
 Nyansahu Nkɔso wɔ Afrika—wɔ Atetesɛm, Amammerɛ ne Nyamesom mu (1986) .
 Hokwan a obi wɔ sɛ onya akwahosan wɔ kuayɛ a wɔyɛ wɔ mmeae a osu tɔ na owia bɔ kɛse mu (1992)
 Ɔno nso ne ɔkyerɛwfo a ɔkyerɛw...  Parasites, Atamfo a Wɔyɛ Anifere ne Awiafo a Wɔwɔ Wo Mu . ISBN 978-9988010171 na wobɛtumi akyerɛw ., nhoma a wɔkyerɛw maa atiefo a wɔnyɛ nyansahufo titiriw. Sɛ ne nhoma ahorow a ɛfa nyansahu ho da nkyɛn a, Letitia Obeng nso na ɔkyerɛw...  Agyapade a Ɛnyɛ Komm: N’ankasa Asetra Ho Nsɛm . ISBN 9789988098834 na wobɛkyerɛw .

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ɔyɛ owufo Madam Theodosia Okoh a ɔyɛ Ghana frankaa ho nhyehyɛe no nuabea .  Na ne papa, Very Reverend EV Asihene Anad, yɛ Presbyterian Asɔre a ɛwɔ Ghana no Moderator na ne maame din de Dora Asihene. Ɔwaree George A. Obeng a owui wɔ afe 1959. Britania Ahyehyɛde ho nsusuwiifo, ɔbenfo ne ɔkyerɛwfo Edward David Asihene " Eddie" Obeng (wɔwoo no afe 1959) yɛ Letitia Obeng mma no mu biako.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Susan Ofori-Atta
text:
Susan Barbara Gyankorama Ofori-Atta nso de Graft-Johnson, DRCOG, DRCPCH, FGA (1917 – July 1985) yɛ Ghana aduruyɛ oduruyɛfo – ɔbea oduruyɛfo a odi kan wɔ Gold Coast . Ɔno ne Ghanani bea a odi kan ne West Africani bea a ɔto so nnan a onyaa sukuupɔn abodin krataa. Ofori-Atta nso yɛ Afrika Atɔeɛ fam ɔbaa a ɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa a ɔbɛyɛɛ oduruyɛfo wɔ Nigeriafo Agnes Yewande Savage (1929) ne Elizabeth Abimbola Awoliyi (1938) akyi. Wɔ 1933 mu no, Sierra Leone amanyɔsɛm ho ɔkwampaefo ne nhomasua a ɛkɔ anim ho ɔkwampaefo, Edna Elliot-Horton bɛyɛɛ Afrika Atɔe Fam ɔbea a ɔto so abien a owiee sukuupɔn na odii kan nyaa abodin krataa wɔ ahofadi adwinni mu . Awiei koraa no, Ofori-Atta bɛyɛɛ aduruyɛ so panyin a ɔhwɛ Kumasi Ayaresabea so, na akyiri yi, ɔfaa Princess Louise Ayaresabea a wɔhwɛ Mmea so no so. Ne bere sofo ne Matilda J. Clerk a ɔyɛ Ghanani bea a ɔto so abien ne Afrika Atɔe Fam ɔbea a ɔto so anan a ɔbɛyɛɛ oduruyɛfo a ɔno nso suaa ade wɔ Achimota ne Edinburgh . Ghana Suapɔn yɛɛ Ofori-Atta Nyansahu mu Oduruyɛfo a Ɔhyɛ Nidi wɔ adwuma a ɔyɛe wɔ aduan pa a wonnya nni wɔ mmofra mu no ho, na onyaa Royal Cross fii Pope John Paul II hɔ bere a ɔkɔsraa Ghana wɔ afe 1980 mu, de kyerɛe sɛ ɔde aduruyɛ adwuma a wontua hwee ma wɔ n’ayaresabea hɔ. Ɔboaa ma wɔhyehyɛɛ Mmea Kuo a ɛhwɛ ɔmanfoɔ nsɛm so na na ɔyɛ Ghana Adesuabea a ɛhwɛ Adwinni ne Nyansahu so no Fapem Fellow .  Na nea otumi yɛe no yɛ nhyɛso ho sɛnkyerɛnne ma mmea a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔyɛ nnuruyɛfo wɔ Ghana.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Ofori-Atta adehye abusua a wɔagye din no muni, Susan Ofori-Atta wɔwoo no wɔ Kyebi, Gold Coast (mprempren Ghana), wɔ afe 1917 mu maa Nana Sir Ofori Atta I, Okyenhene ne Ɔpanyin Panyin wɔ Akyem Abuakwa Amammerɛ Mpɔtam, 1917 mu. ne ne yere Nana Akosua Duodu.

Susan Ofori-Atta nyaa ne mfitiase nhomasua wɔ St. Mary’s Convent a ɛwɔ Elmina bɛyɛ 1921 mu na ɔde ne din kɔhyɛɛ Achimota Sukuu mu wɔ 1929 mu maa ne ntoaso sukuu .  Na ɔyɛ akwampaefo sukuufo no mu biako bere a wobuee kɔlege no ano wɔ 1927 mu akyi, faako a na ɔyɛ Mmabaa Sukuu Panyin wɔ n’afe a etwa to mu na ɔtraa ase maa Cambridge Sukuu Adansedi Krataa .  Osuaa awogye ho ade wɔ Korle-Bu Awogyefo Ntetee Sukuu, na owiee sukuu wɔ 1935 mu, na onyaa ntetee foforo wɔ awogye ho wɔ Scotland .  Bere a osuaa ade wɔ sukuupɔn mu wiei no, ɔyɛɛ awogyefo adwuma wɔ Korle-Bu Nkyerɛkyerɛ Ayaresabea . Ɔkɔɔ so toaa n’adesua so wɔ Edinburgh Sukuupɔn Aduruyɛ Sukuu, faako a onyaa ne MBChB abodin krataa wɔ afe 1947. Sika a n’agya ɔdefo Ofori Atta I a owui wɔ 1943 mu bere a na ɔda so ara yɛ aduruyɛ ho osuani wɔ Edinburgh de gyaw no maa no na ɛboaa ne nhomasua wɔ amannɔne.

Adwuma ne nsɛm a wɔka de gyina nkurɔfo akyi 
Ofori-Atta fii n’adwuma ase sɛ awogyefo na afei osuaa ade sɛ ɔbɛyɛɛ mmofra oduruyɛfo, na ɛmaa ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔbea oduruyɛfo a odi kan wɔ Gold Coast (mprempren wɔfrɛ no Ghana ).  Wɔ 1960 mu no, ɔde ne bere mae wɔ Congo ayaresabea bi a na adwumayɛfo nni hɔ pii. Bere a na ɔyɛ aduruyɛ ho ɔpanyin wɔ Princess Marie Louise Ayaresabea no, wɔtoo no din " बाल oduruyɛfo " (mmofra oduruyɛfo).  Ofii Princess Marie Louise Ayaresabea kɔkaa University of Ghana Medical School, faako a na ɔyɛ Mmofra Ayaresa Dwumadibea no muni a ɔhyehyɛɛ no ansa na ɔrefi n’ankasa kokoam aduruyɛ adwuma ase ama mmea ne mmofra wɔ n’ayaresabea, Accra Ayaresabea.  Na ɔyɛ Royal College of Obstetricians and Gynecology (1949) ne Royal College of Paediatrics and Child Health (1958) nso Ɔnanmusifo.

Na ɔyɛ obi a ɔkamfo mmea ne mmofra nsɛm na ɔsɔre tiaa Akan nhyehyɛe a ɛfa agyapade ho, na ɔkamfoo mmara a wɔde bedi asɛm no ho dwuma na wɔama awarefo ne mmofra hokwan sɛ wonya wɔn ahokafo a wɔawuwu ne agyanom a wowuwui a wonni adansedi krataa no agyapade.  Ne mmɔdenbɔ no na ɛde PNDC Intestate Succession Law a wɔde too gua wɔ afe 1985 mu no bae  Na ɔyɛ 1969 Amansan mmrahyɛbagua a ɛhyehyɛɛ Amanyɔ Mmara maa Ghana Aman a Ɛto so Abien no muni .

Ghana Suapɔn no hyɛɛ no anuonyam wɔ afe 1974 mu de Nyansahu mu Oduruyɛfo a nidi wom esiane n’akwampaefo nhwehwɛmu adwuma a ɔyɛe wɔ mmofra aduan pa a wonnya nni ho — " Kwashiorkor ", asɛmfua a ɔhyehyɛɛ a ɛbɛyɛɛ aduruyɛ asɛmfua wɔ wiase nyinaa.   Na ɔyɛ obi a ɔyɛ nnam wɔ Katolek Asɔre a ɛwɔ Ghana, titiriw Accra Asɔredan mu.  Na ɔyɛ Katolek Aduruyɛ Nnuruyɛfo Fekuw no muni panyin na na ɔyɛ Ghana Katolek Nnuruyɛfo Fekuw no muni.

Ankorankoro asetra ne abusua 
Ɔwaree EVC de Graft-Johnson, mmaranimfoɔ a ɔte Accra na ɔyɛ Joseph W. S. de Graft-Johnson, Ghana ɔmampanyin abadiakyiri firi afe 1979 kɔsi afe  no  Wɔ 1960 mfeɛ no mu no, EVC de Graft Johnson yɛɛ onipa baako ɔsɔretia wɔ asɛm bi a ɛfa mmara mu nnyinasosɛm ho wɔ Asɛnnibea Kunini no adan akyi.  Bere a woyii bara a wɔbaraa demokrase a aman pii wom no fii hɔ wɔ 1969 mu akyi no, EVC de Graft-Johnson bɛyɛɛ All People’s Party a mprempren enni hɔ bio no Kannifo ne Ɔkyerɛwfo Panyin.  Wɔ 1979 mu no, na EVC de Graft-Johnson yɛ mfinimfini benkum fam kuw, Social Democratic Front (SDF) no guamtrani abadiakyiri.

Susan Ofori-Atta nuabarima panyin ne William Ofori-Atta, Gold Coast amammuifo ne mmaranimfo, kan amannɔne soafo ne akannifo a wɔhyehyɛɛ United Gold Coast Convention (UGCC) no mu biako ne "The Big Six" no muni nso,  amammuifo kuw bi a Britania atubrafo aban no de wɔn guu afiase wɔ 1948 Accra basabasayɛ no akyi, na wofii apereperedi a wɔde hwehwɛɛ Ghana ahofadi ase wɔ 1957 mu no ase. Ne nuabarima foforo ne Kofi Asante Ofori-Atta, Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ Mpɔtam Aban so wɔ Convention People's Party (CPP) aban a ɛwɔ Kwame Nkrumah mu na akyiri yi ɔyɛɛ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua no Kasafo . Ne nuabea kumaa ne Adeline Akufo-Addo, Ghana Awuraa a odi kan wɔ Republic a Ɛto so Abien no mu .

Owu ne agyapade 
Susan Ofori-Atta wui wɔ abɔde mu wɔ July 1985 mu wɔ United Kingdom . Wɔde ne din too mmeawa fie bi a ɛwɔ ne alma mater, Achimota Sukuu, mu.

Hwɛ nso 

 Bere nhyehyɛe a mmea wɔ nyansahu mu
 Mmea wɔ aduruyɛ mu

title: Akosua Agyapong
text:
Akosua Agyapong (wɔsan kyerɛw no Agyepong ; wɔwoo no 17 Ɔbɛnem 1969 ), yɛ Ghanani ɔbea a ɔyɛ nnwontoni a ɔyɛ nnwontofo a ɔsen biara ne television so nipa.  ɔyɛɛ 3Music Awards no hyɛɛ no anuonyam wɔ nea wayɛ wɔ anigyede adwuma mu wɔ Ghana no ho .

Mfitiase asetra 
Wɔwoo Akosua Agyapong wɔ 17 Ɔbɛnem 1969 wɔ Accra, Ghana, na n’awofo yɛ Asante ne Akyem . Ɔnyaa ne ntoaso sukuu wɔ Holy Child Ntoaso Sukuu a ɛwɔ Cape Coast no mu . Na ne maame yɛ Katolekni bere a na ne papa yɛ Anglikanni.

Nnwom ho adwuma 
Agyapong fii ase too nnwom wɔ ne mmofraase na highlife artiste Nana Ampadu na ohui wɔ 1990 mfe no mu. Wobu no sɛ anansesɛm a ɛfa asetra ho kɛse. Wɔ afe 1992 mu no ɔne ne mfɛfo Highlife adwumfo Nat Brew ne Rex Omar boom hyehyɛɛ Highlife Supergroup NAKOREX, kuw no din yɛ asɛmfua tiawa a wɔde nkyerɛwde a edi kan a ɛwɔ emufo biara din mu na ɛyɛe na woyii dwom ‘Kpanlogo’ adi.

Ne album a edi kan ne, 'Frema' a woyii no adi wɔ January 1, 1990. Na ‘Frema’ album no wɔ nnwom a nhyɛsoɔ ahyɛ mu ma te sɛ ‘Me ye Obaa’ a ɛbɛyɛɛ nnwom a ɛyɛ dɛ ntɛm ara, ‘Born again’, ‘Anan tuo’, ‘San be hwe wo mba’ ne afoforo

Bere a ne album no dii yiye akyi no, ohyiaa Nat Brew ne Rex Omar, a wɔhyɛɛ no nkuran ma oyii ne album a edii hɔ a wɔato din ‘Esiwa’ adi, a ɛyɛ nnwom foforo a ɛyɛe ntɛm ara. Na ɛyɛ Akosua Agyapong nnwom nhoma a ɛto so abien. NAKOREX akyi no, ɔkɔɔ hiatus bere tenten mu na akyiri yi ɔsan puei sɛ asɛmpa adwumfo, ɔyɛ obi a wontumi nhu no kɛkɛ. Akosua wɔ album anum a ɔde kamfo no, biako ne NAKOREX yɛ biako na biako nso yɛ NAKOREX muni. Wɔhyɛɛ no anuonyam wɔ Oforisuo 2019 mu wɔ adeyɛ a wɔtoo din “Celebrating Akosua Adjepong 30@50” ase. Na eyi yɛ nea wɔde bɛhyɛ no afahyɛ sɛ wayɛ mfe 30 sɛ mfoniniyɛfo chalk.

Aware asetra 
Amandzeba Nat Brew fii ase ne no bɔɔ fekuw wɔ aban kwan so wɔ afe 1994 mu na wɔwaree mfe abien akyi. Seesei waware Ɔkɔmhyɛni Daniel Asamoah-Larbi, wɔ awaregyaeɛ akyi ne Amanzeba Nat Brew a wagye din wɔ NAKOREX .

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Hilda Akua
text:
Hilda Akua Frimpong (wɔwoo no afe 1991) yɛ Ghanani model ne ahoɔfɛ akansi titleholder a wɔhyɛɛ no abotiri sɛ Miss Universe Ghana wɔ afe 2015 mu na ɔgyinaa Ghana ananmu wɔ Miss Universe 2015 akansi no mu. Bere a wohui sɛ ɔwɔ scoliosis wɔ afe 2012 mu no, Frimpong bɛyɛɛ akwahosan ho ɔdenimfo na ɔkamfoo tebea no ano a wosiw ne ne sa. Wɔ afe 2021 mu bere a na ɔresua ade wɔ Syracuse University College of Law, wɔbɔɔ ne din sɛ Syracuse Law Review samufo panyin foforo, na ɛmaa ɔbɛyɛɛ Abibifo a odi kan a odii dibea no.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Frimpong fi Kumasi a ɛyɛ Ashanti Mantam ahenkurow a ɛwɔ Ghana, baabi a wɔtetee no nso. Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, wohui sɛ ɔwɔ scoliosis . Ne tebea no kanyan no ma ɔkamfoo nkurɔfo kyerɛe wɔ aduruyɛ mu tebea no ano a wobesiw ne ayaresa ho. Ɔwɔ Bachelor of Arts wɔ nnipa ho adesua mu wɔ Texas A&M Sukuupɔn mu, United States .

Mprempren Frimpong yɛ mmaranimfo sukuuni wɔ Syracuse Sukuupɔn Mmara Sukuupɔn mu . Wɔ March 2021 mu no, wɔbɔɔ ne din sɛ Syracuse Law Review, samufo panyin foforo, na ɛmaa ɔbɛyɛɛ Abibifo a odi kan a odii dibea no. Frimpong bɛdi Syracuse Mmara Nhwehwɛmu no anim ama 2021–22 adesua afe no a na mmaa dodoɔ no ara na wɔyɛ adwumakuo.

Adwuma 
Frimpong yɛ obi a ɔboa nnipa na ɔyɛ ɔyamyefoɔ wɔ Ghana. Ɔsan nso yɛ obi a ɔhyehyɛɛ Straight UP! Scoliosis adɔe kuw. Mprempren, ɔyɛ adwuma sɛ Ɔmantam Nkɔsofo ma Hay Kuw. Wɔ Syracuse Sukuupɔn mu no, ɔsom wɔ nnwuma afoforo mu a nea ɛka ho ne sɛ obi a otu ne ho ma ma Cold Case Justice Initiative, nsɛmmɔnedi ho mmara kyerɛkyerɛfo, nhwehwɛmu boafo, ne ɔnanmusifo ma Office of Admissions.

Pageantry a wɔde di dwuma

Akyerɛbaa Ghana USA 2012 
Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ Miss Ghana USA 2012 na ɔdii kan sɛ 2nd runner-up wɔ afe afe Miss Africa USA 2014 akansi no mu.

Miss Amansan Ghana 2015 
Wɔ Ɔbɛnem 29, 2015 no, wɔhyɛɛ Akua abotiri sɛ Miss Universe Ghana wɔ Alisa Hotel Accra. Sɛ Miss Universe Ghana 2015 no, ɔsii akan wɔ Miss Universe 2015 akansi no mu.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Nadia Eke
text:
Nadia Eke (wɔwoo no 11 Ɔbɛnem 1993, Accra  ) yɛ Ghanani a ɔhuruw mprɛnsa .

Nwomasua 
Eke wiee Columbia Suapɔn wɔ afe 2015.

Adwuma 
Wɔ afe 2014 mu no, ɔdii kan wɔ Commonwealth Games a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Glasgow, ɔdii dwetɛ wɔ African Championships a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Marrakech no mu na ɔdii kan wɔ IAAF Continental Cup mu .

Ɔsan nso nyaa kɔbere wɔ African Games a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Brazzaville wɔ afe 2015 mu. Wɔ afe 2016 mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ Afrikani ɔkannifoɔ wɔ afe 2016 Afrika Agumadi Nkonimdie mu .

Ɔfatae sɛ ɔgyina Ghana ananmu wɔ 2020 Summer Olympics no mu wɔ Mmea mmirikatuo mprɛnsa mu.

Ankorankoro nneɛma a eye sen biara

Abɔnten so 
Ahuruw mprɛnsa – 14.33m, June 2019, Jamaica ( Ghana kyerɛwtohɔ )

Wɔ dan mu 
Ahuruw mprɛnsa – 13.60m, 14 Ɔbɛnem 2017, New York Kuropɔn

title: Portia Boakye
text:
Portia Boakye (wɔwoo no 17 April 1989) yɛ Ghana amanaman ntam bɔɔlbɔni a ɔbɔ sɛ forward /defender ma Djurgården wɔ Sweden. Wobu no sɛ obi a ɔde nan benkum bɔ bɔɔl a eye sen biara wɔ Afrika asasepɔn no so.

Club adwuma

Östersunds DFF 2016 
Wɔ May 2016 mu no ɔde ne nsa hyɛɛ aseɛ maa Östersunds DFF na ɔyɛɛ ne debut a ɛdi kan maa Östersunds DFF wɔ AIK a ɔbaa mu sɛ obi a ɔbɛsi ananmu wɔ simma 46 mu na ɔbɔɔ bɔɔl baako pɛ wɔ saa akansi no mu ne AIK wɔ simma 67 mu.

Wɔ Oforisuo 2016 mu no, Portia san bɔɔ bɔɔl baako pɛ wɔ Elitettan akansi a wɔne AIK dii wɔ Stockholm no fa a ɛtɔ so mmienu no mu.

Ɔsan toaa so de ne su a ɛyɛ nwonwa maa Östersunds DFF wɔ Sunnanå SK, ɔbaa mu sɛ obi a ɔde ne ho besi ananmu wɔ simma 55 mu bere a Östersunds DFF de bɔɔl bɔɔ fam no, ɔde bɔɔl no yɛɛ pɛ wɔ simma 60 mu, na ɔsan nso kɔɔ so bɔɔ bɔɔl a ɛto so abien wɔ agorudi no mu wɔ simma 70 mu de Östersunds DFF dii kan a ɛboaa Östersunds DFF ma wodii nkonim wɔ agorudi no mu 3–1 wɔ Sunnana so, wɔ agorudi no akyi no wɔmaa no Ɔbea a ɔsen biara wɔ akansi no mu abasobɔde. Ɔde afe no baa awiei a Östersunds DFF bɔɔ League bɔɔl ason na ɔsan nso bɔɔ bɔɔl abien wɔ kuruwa akansi ahorow no mu.

Trabzon İdmanocağı 
Wɔ afe 2017 mu no, ɔne Trabzon İdmanocağı yɛɛ bere apam sɛ ɔde ne ho bɛhyɛ Turkey Mmea Bɔɔlbɔ Kuw a Edi Kan no mu .

Amanaman ntam adwuma

Ghana 
Wɔ June 2010 mu no, Boakye bɔɔ bɔɔl wɔ Ghana nkonim a wodii wɔ Senegal so 3–0 wɔ Accra Sports Stadium . Nkonimdie no maa Ghana nyaa baabi wɔ afe 2010 African Women’s Championship finals no mu.

Boakye kaa ɔman kuo a wɔsii akan wɔ 2014 African Women’s Championship qualification ne 2014 African Women’s Championship, na ɔdii agorɔ wɔ ekuo no akansi nson no nyinaa mu. Ɔdii agorɔ wɔ adamfofa akansi bi mu ne South Africa wɔ May 2014 mu na ɔbɔɔ bɔɔl a ɛdii nkonim.  Ɔsan nso bɔɔ nkonimdi botaeɛ wɔ afe 2015 All-Africa Games final no mu, a na aka simma mmiɛnsa kɔsi simma 90 regulation time no awieeɛ, de nyaa sika kɔkɔɔ a ɛdi kan wɔ Ghana wɔ akansi no mu.

Wɔ December 2015 mu no wɔpaw no sɛ Afrika Mmea Bɔɔlbɔfo a Ɔsen Biara wɔ Afe no mu, na ɔne Paris Saint-Germain bɔfo Ngozi Ebere, Gabrielle Onguene, Gaelle Enganamouit . Ɔhweree saa abasobɔde yi maa Gaelle Enganamouit a ɔwɔ FC Rosengård .

Wɔ June 2016 mu no, Sport Writers Association of Ghana too aba too no sɛ ɔbaa bɔɔlbɔfoɔ a ɔsen biara wɔ afe no mu.

Nidi a wɔde ma

Amansan 
Ghana

 Afrika Mmea Amanaman Kuruwa Kɔbere Nkonimdi: 2016

title: Helen Yawson
text:
Helen Yawson ( née Obadagbonyi, wɔwoo no 3 July 1967) yɛ nnɛyi asɛmpa odwontoni, nnwom kyerɛwfo ne ɔsɔfo a ɔte Ghana.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Wɔwoo Helen Yawson wɔ London wɔ afe 1967 mu. Bere a odii mfe anum no, ɔkɔɔ Lagos, Nigeria, na ɔsan kɔɔ London bere a na wadi mfe 19. Na sɛnea otumi to nnwom no daa adi fi ne mmofraase denam ahotoso a tumi wom na ɛyɛ awosu a ɔwɔ wɔ saa beae yi mu no so.

Bere a ɔsan kɔɔ London wɔ 1986 mu akyi bere tiaa bi no, ɔde ne ho kɔbɔɔ aberante Matthew Ashimolowo ’s Kristofo som adwuma a ɔyɛɛ asɛnnennen a ɛne sɛ ‘ɔbɛyɛ Onyankopɔn aniberesɛm’ no ho biribi. Wɔ 1988 mu no, mfiase no Helen kɔkaa Kingsway Foursquare Asɔre Nnwontofo Kuw no ho; afei wɔ 1989 mu no, ɔde ne ho bɔɔ Asɔre Nnwontofo Kuw no sɛ Odwontofo panyin. Mfeɛ 7 a ɛdi hɔ no, ne kwan a tumi wom na ɛde ɔyareɛ ba no dii kuw a na ɛrenya nkɔsoɔ no anim wɔ ayeyi ne ɔsom kwan so agodie mu wɔ nsrahwɛ pii mu wɔ Nigeria ne Canada, ne UK nyinaa.

Esiane sɛ Yawson tee nka sɛ ɔrebua ɔfrɛ a wɔde kɔma nyamesom frɛ, nti, otu kɔɔ Accra, Ghana wɔ afe 2002 mu baabi a Matthew Ashimolowo hyehyɛɛ no sɛ Ɔsɔfo Ɔsɔfo wɔ afe koro no ara mu. Helen asom fi bere a ɔbaa Ghana sɛ The Head of the Music and Creative Division na mprempren ɔyɛ KICC Winning Women Ministries no panyin. Helen Yawson aware Andrew Yawson, na awarefo no wɔ mmabea baanu.

Nnwom adwuma 
Helen a ɔbaa hɔ ne ne mmoa a ɔde mae wɔ nnwontofo kuw ne nnwom som adwuma mu wɔ Kingsway International Christian Center, (KICC) no bae wɔ bere titiriw bi mu bere a na asɔre no reyɛ nhyiam a ɛrenya nkɔso ntɛmntɛm sen biara wɔ UK nyinaa no. Wɔ ne Pastor ne ne kyerɛkyerɛfo, Matthew Ashimolowo som adwuma ase no, nnipa ɔhaha pii a wonnye nni bɛhuu Kristo. Wɔ afe 1997 mu no, wɔtrɛw Helen talente mu kɔɔ akyiri bere a ɔbɛyɛɛ Nnwom Ntamgyinafo wɔ KICC North London satellite asɔredan mu, ɔkyerɛɛ nnwontofo ne nnwontofo kuw bi a wɔwɔ nimdeɛ awotwe kwan, na ɔboaa ma wɔhyehyɛɛ KICC Mass Choir atitiriw 100 a wɔyɛ den no.

Saa bere yi mu no, Helen nso kyerɛw na ɔkyeree ne nnwom nhoma a edi kan, ‘Blessed and Highly Favoured’, a woyii no adi wɔ January 1999 mu. Saa album yi maa Helen nnwom som adwuma a ɛhyɛ nkuran ne nea wɔasra no ho ahwehwɛde kɔɔ soro wɔ UK nyinaa. Wɔ mfe abien a edii hɔ no mu no, wɔmaa onni adagyew sɛ ɔbɛkɔ kɔnsɛt ne nhyiam ahorow pii ase wɔ United Kingdom ho. Afe biako akyi no, wɔmaa no dibea sɛ Nnwontofo Kuw no sohwɛfo. Ɔyii ne album a ɛtɔ so mmienu, 'Forever Grateful' wɔ afe 2001. Wɔ August 2012 mu no, oyii ne nnwom nhoma a wayɛ mprempren, My God and I.

Efi bere a ɔbaa Ghana no, wayɛ nhyehyɛe na wahwɛ nnwom ne nne ho nhyiam, ɔsom ne asetra kwan ho nhyiam ahorow pii. Ɔsan nso de ne ho hyɛɛ kɔnsɛt ne ɔsom nhyiam ahorow pii mu wɔ Ghana mmeae ahorow ne Asɔre ahorow ne Kristofo Ahyehyɛde ahorow. Wɔ afe 2006 mu no, ɔyii ne single album 'Anyday' adi. Ɔsan nso ayɛ Voicemania, adwumakuw bi a wɔahyɛ bɔ sɛ wɔbɛtete nnwontofo a wɔn ho akokwaw na wɔwɔ ahotoso ne akasafo nso ma wɔadi mu wɔ wɔn adwuma mu na wɔatumi abɔ nnwom wɔ mpɔtam hɔ ne amanaman ntam nhyiam ase. Ɔnam saa asɛnka agua yi so yɛ afe afe Ɔsom Owura Adesua  ne The Voice Academy ho nhyehyɛe.

Nneɛma a wɔatumi ayɛ 

 Wɔ afe 1988 mu no, ɔde ne ho kɔbɔɔ Kingsway Four-Square Band and Singers
 Ɔbɛyɛɛ Kingsway Amanaman Ntam Kristofo Asoɛe (KICC) Nnwontofo Kuw no muni.
 Wɔyɛɛ nnwom wɔ Nigeria ne Canada ne Pastor Matthew Ashimolowo sɛ Ayeyi ne Ɔsom kuw no fã.
 Led vocally on the KICC Choir Albums – 1992 "Fa me Free", 1993 "Wo ne Me Biribiara" ne 1995 "Anigye". Helen kyerɛw nnwom maa album abiɛsa no mu abien – "Onyankopɔn wɔ hɔ bere nyinaa" – Set Me Free ne "Merennyaw Wo Da" – Woyɛ Me Biribiara.
 1997 Helen bɛyɛɛ Nnwom Ntamgyinafo wɔ KICC Tottenham, North London, satellite asɔredan mu.
 Wɔ afe 1997 ne 1998 ntam no, ofii ase kyerɛw ne nnwom a ɔno nkutoo ne nnwom a edi kan a ɔno nkutoo na ɔkyeree. Wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 1999 mu no oyii ' Blessed and Highly Favoured' adi.
 Wɔpaw no sɛ Nnwontofo Kuw Panyin maa KICC Mass Choir wɔ January 2000 mu 
 Wɔ afe 2001 mu no, ɔyii ne album a ɛtɔ so mmienu ‘Forever Grateful’ adi.
 Helen yɛ Artiste a ɔboaa Mary Mary wɔ Ɔhemmaa Ahosɛpɛw Nnwom, KICC London (2002) .
 Afe 2002 mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ nnwom kwankyerɛfo wɔ KICC Ghana
 Helen ne asɛmpa adwumfo afoforo a wɔagye wɔn atom, te sɛ Alvin Slaughter, Jessy Dixon, Ron Kenoly, Andrea Crouch ne Daniel Winans akyɛ asɛnka agua no so.
 Wabɔ nnwom wɔ nhyiamu ahodoɔ, kɔnsɛt ne afahyɛ ahodoɔ mu wɔ Ghana ne UK, a Cross Rhythms Roots and Branches Festival ‘One Voice’ a wɔyɛ wɔ Dudley Castle (UK), The International Gathering of Champions Conference (UK), afe afe 24hr Praise ka ho ne Ɔsom Nnwom (Ghana), Gye Ɔsom Nnwom (Benin) ne afoforo pii. 
 Wɔ afe 2006 mu no, oyii ne Single Album, Anyday adi
 Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, oyii Worship album bi adi, My God and I
 Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔsan nso hyɛɛ ne kɔnsɛt a edi kan Helen Yawson Live in Concert ase, na ɛde DVD a wɔkyeree no tee bae
 Wɔ afe 2014 mu no, ɔyii Hymns album bi adi, JUST HYMNS
 Wɔ afe 2015 mu no, ɔyii ne nwoma a ɛdi kan a ɛfa, More Than A Song adi

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Tina Gifty Naa Ayele Mensah
text:
Tina Gifty Naa Ayele Mensah (wɔwoo no Ɔbɛnem 23, afe 1964) yɛ  Ghanani ɔmanyɛfo na ɔyɛ  mmrahyɛbaguani ma Weija- Gbawe mantam. Ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party no muni na Nana Addo paw no sɛ Akwahosan Soafo abadiakyiri wɔ 15 March 2017.

Ne mmɔfrase  ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Mensah wɔ Ɔbɛnem 23, afe 1964 wɔ Jamestown, Britania Accra a ɛwɔ Greater Accra Mantam mu . Ɔnyaa ne ntoaso sukuu wɔ Accra Mmabaa Sukuu mu. Ɔwɔ Bachelor’s degree wɔ Ɔman Adwumayɛ mu ne Masters wɔ amanaman ntam abusuabɔ ne Diplomacy mu wɔ Ghana Institute of Public Administartion.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Mensah nyaa abatoɔ 34,216 wɔ abatoɔ 59,926 a ɛfata a wɔtoo wɔ afe 2016  mmrahyɛbagua abatoɔ no mu. Obuobia Darko-Opoku ne Jessica Adwoa Mannuel na wɔdii akan.

Ɔsii akan wɔ afe 2020 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu sɛ  mmrahyɛbagua mu kandifoɔ ma New Patriotic Party, na ɔdii nkonim.

Adwuma 
Ná ɔyɛ Gemens Company LTD no kwankyerɛfo panyin. wɔ Mamprobi, Accra, na ɛwɔ hɔ.

Abasobɔde ahorɔw 
Wɔ 4 Ɔbɛnem 2017 no, Ghana-Nigeria Mmabun Ahyehyɛde no maa no abasobɔde wɔ akanni a ɔda nsow ho. Wɔ afe 2017 mu no, FAKS Investigative Services buu no sɛ Ɔsomfoɔ Abadiakyiri a ɔsen biara.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Tina aware a ɔwɔ mma baasa. Ɔda ne ho adi sɛ ɔyɛ Kristoni.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Lydia Alhassan
text:
Lydia Seyram Alhassan (wɔ woo no 1 Ɔbɛnem 1970) yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ ne Mmarahye Bagua a ɛto so asɔn wɔ Ghanaman a ɛtɔ so nnan no muni a ɔgyina Ayawaso West Wuogon Mansin ananmu wɔ Greater Accra Mantam mu wɔ New Patriotic Party tekiti so

Nwomasua 
Ɔwɔ MBA wɔ Adwumayɛ mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn Adwumayɛ Sukuu, Legon ne Bachelor of Administration abodin krataa wɔ Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration (GIMPA).

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔ Ɔbɛnem 2019 mu no, Alhassan sii akan wɔ mmarahyɛ bagua no mu abatoɔ mu  wɔ Ayawaso West Wuogon Mantam no mu, na  ɔbɛsii ne kunu a wawuo no ananmu. Ɔde abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtow no ɔha biara mu nkyem 68.80 dii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ no mu. Wɔn a wɔdii nkonim afoforɔ no ne Kwasi Delali Brempong a ɔfiri asɔretiafoɔ National Democratic Congress (NDC) mu no nyaa ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu aduasa.52, William Kofi Dowokpor a ɔfiri Progressive People’s Party (PPP) mu no nyaa ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 0.58, na Clement Boadi a ɔfiri Liberal Party of Ghana (LPG) mu na ɔnyaa abatoɔ ɔha biara mu nkyem 0.10. 

Ɔdii nkonim wɔ afe 2020 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu wɔ New Patriotic Party tekiti ase na ɔdii nkonim wɔ Ghanafoɔ a wagye din ne NDC kandifoɔ John Dumelo, na ɔtoo abatoɔ a ɛfata no mu 9,851.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ɔwaree ɔmanyɛfo a wawu Emmanuel Boakye Agyarko kosii sɛ owui wɔ afe 2018. 
Ghana mmrahyɛbadwafoɔ 2021-2025
New Patriotic Party amanyɔfoɔ
Ghana mmrahyɛbadwafoɔ 2017–2021

title: Anthony Mandrea
text:
Anthony Mandrea (  wɔwoo no 25 December 1996) yɛ Algeriani bɔɔlbɔfo a ɔbɔ  ma  Ligue 2 kuw Caen ne Algeriaman bɔɔlbɔkuw.

Bɔɔlbɔ kuo 
Mandrea  yɛɛ ne Ligue 1 debut maa Nice wɔ 3 November 2013 wɔ 1–2 home nkogudi wɔ Bordeaux, de sii David Ospina a na wapira ananmu wɔ simma 51 akyi.  Bere a na wadi mfe 16 ne asram 10 no na ɔyɛ, saa bere no, bɔɔlbɔfo kumaa a ɔbɔɔ bɔɔl wɔ Ligue 1.  Ɔankɔ kuw a edi kan bio amma Nice, na wɔ afe 2016 ahohuru bere mu no otu kɔɔ Angers, faako a ɔde ne nsa hyɛɛ adwumayɛfo nsɛm ase wɔ mfe abiɛsa apam mu wɔ September 2017.  Ne Angers debut bae wɔ Coupe de la Ligue wɔ 12 December 2017 ne Metz, a ɔkoraa krataa a ɛho tew so.

Wɔ July 2020 mu, sɛ́ goalkeeper a ɔto so abiɛsa a wɔpaw no ma Angers no, wɔde no fɛm SO Cholet wɔ Championnat National mu de hwehwɛɛ bere a ɔde bɛbɔ bɔɔl.  Wɔ afe no awiei no wɔbɔɔ no din sɛ bɔɔlbɔfo a ɔsen biara wɔ Championna National bere no mu.

Wɔ 23 June 2022 no, Mandrea tu kɔɔ Caen wɔ mfeɛ mmienu apam mu.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Wɔwoo Mandrea wɔ France, na n’agya yɛ Franseni ne ɛna a ɔyɛ Algeria.  Ɔdii agorɔ baako maa France U18s wɔ Tournoi de Limoges wɔ afe 2013.  Wɔfrɛɛ no kɔɔ Algeria ɔman kuw a wɔyɛ mpanyimfo no mu wɔ May 2022.  Ɔde ne man adwuma a edi kan ne Algeria wɔ adamfofa akansi bi a ɔne Iran dii a ɛbaa awiei wɔ nkonim a wodii wɔ Algeria so 2-1 wɔ June 12th, 2022 mu.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Kofi Okyir
text:
Kofi Okyir (wɔwoo no 7 June 1951) yɛ Ghanani a na anka ɔyɛ aguamadifo.

Ɔyɛ mmirikatufoɔ titire, Okyir tuu mmirika kɔɔ Angelo State University  wɔ Texas na na ɔyɛ Ghanani a ɔtu mmirika tenten Joshua Owusu, a ɔne no nyinii wɔ Kumasi na na wakamfo Okyir akyerɛ wɔn a wɔregye nnipa.  Okyir na ɔyɛ NAIA ɔkannifoɔ wɔ 100 yard dash mu wɔ afe 1973.

Okyir nyaa dwetɛ nkonimbo wɔ mita 4 x 100 mu wɔ 1973 Afrika Nyinaa Aguamdi  ne 1974 Britania Amanaman Nkbom Aguamdi mu. Ɔno na okura Afrikafo kyerɛwtohɔ a ɛfa mmirikatu a ɛyɛ anammɔn 100 ho, na ɔde sikani 9.40 sii hɔ wɔ Austin wɔ 1974 mu.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Leonard Myles-Mills
text: Leonard ("Leo") Myles-Mills (wɔwoo no May 9, 1973, wɔ Accra, Greater Accra Region ) yɛ Ghanani kan agumadifo a na ne ho akokwaw wɔ mita 100 mirikatuo mu . Ɔtuu mmirika a ɛyɛ papa sen biara a ɛyɛ sikɔne 9.98 maa akansi no wɔ 1998 mu, na ɔbɛyɛɛ Ghanani a odi kan a obuu akwanside a ɛyɛ sikɔne 10 no. Nea ɛyɛ sen biara a ɔde sikɔne 6.45 twae wɔ mita 60 no mu no yɛ Afrika kyerɛwtohɔ . Myles-Mills gyinaa ne man ananmu mprenu wɔ Awɔw Bere mu Olimpik Agumadi no mu ne Commonwealth Agumadi no nso mu . Ná ɔyɛ obi a wabɔ NCAA Mmarima 100 mprenu m dash champion bere a ɔretu mmirika akɔ Brigham Young Sukuupɔn mu no . Ná ne nua John Myles-Mills nso yɛ obi a ɔde mmirika tu mmirika. Wanya sika kɔkɔɔ wɔ 1999 Afrika Nyinaa Agumadi mu, dwetɛ nkonimbo wɔ 2003 Afrika Nyinaa Agumadi mu ne kɔbere nkonimbo wɔ 1998 Afrika Nyinaa Agumadi mu . Wɔ 1999 mu no, ɔyɛɛ Afrikafo dan mu kyerɛwtohɔ foforo wɔ mita 60 a ɔde sikɔne 6.45 tu mmirika mu. N’ankasa nea eye sen biara a ɛboro mita 100; Na sikɔne 9.98 yɛ Ghanafoɔ kyerɛwtohɔ kɔsii sɛ Benjamin Azamati bubuu no denam mmirikatuo a ɛyɛ sikani 9.97 wɔ mita 100 mu wɔ Texas relays wɔ 26 March 2021. Bere a ɔde ne ho hyɛɛ 2004 Awɔw Bere mu Olimpik akansi no mu no, onyaa dibea a ɛto so abiɛsa wɔ mita 100 mmirikatu mu, na ɔnam saayɛ so nyaa hokwan fii ne hyew mu wɔ bere a eye sen biara wɔ bere bi mu. Bere a ɔhyɛn afã a ɛto so abien no mu no, otumi faata kɔɔ nea etwa to no fã, na odii nea ɛto so abiɛsa wɔ mmirikatu no mu akyi na ɔkyerɛw nkɔso foforo wɔ ne bere no mu nea eye sen biara no so. Owiee afã a etwa to no wɔ nea ɛto so asia, na ɔnam saayɛ so antumi ankɔ nea etwa to no mu. Myles-Mills yɛ the Church of Jesus Christ if Later-day Saints no muni . Amanaman ntam akansi ahorow Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Benjamin Azmati
text:
Benjamin Azmati-Kwaku (wɔwoo no 14 Ɔbɛnem 1998) yɛ Ghanani mmirikatufoɔ, a seesei ɔne ASICS Global resi akan.

Ɔyɛɛ abakɔsɛm denam mfeɛ 22 ɔman kyerɛwtohɔ a Leo Myles Mills kuraeɛ wɔ 26 Oforisuo 2021 wɔ Texas denam dɔn a ɔde sikɔne 9.97 diiɛ de maa ɔfatae sɛ ɔbɛkɔ Tokyo Awɔw Bere mu Olimpik akansi no so.

Mustafa Ussif, Agumadi soafoɔ ne Dr Bella Bello Bitugu, a ɔyɛ Ghana Suapɔn Agumadiɛ sohwɛfoɔ no sohwɛfoɔ, maa Benjamin Azati akwaaba wɔ ɔman no mu adeyɛ no ho.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Azamati wɔ 14 Ɔbɛnem 1998 maa John ne Faustina Azmati wɔ Akim oda, Ghana .

Agumadi a na ɔpɛ bere a na ɔrenyin no ne bɔɔlbɔ, nanso ɔdan kɔɔ agumadi mu bere a na ɔkɔ Presbyterian Boys’ Senior High School wɔ Accra baabi a ne PE wuranom (Nathaniel Botchway, Gideon Dukplah ne Kofi Dadzie) huu ne mmirikatu ho nimdeɛ.

Adwuma ne nidi a wɔde ma 
Sɛ́ obi a wadi mfe 21 no ɔdaa ne ho adi sɛ obi a ɔwɔ Olimpic anidaso ma Ghana wɔ mmirikatuo mu bere a otuu mmirika mita 100 wɔ sikani 10.02 HT mu wɔ 2019 Ghana Fastest Human akansi no mu no. Onyaa  sika kɔkɔɔ wɔ 4x100m relay mu wɔ 2019 Afrika aguamdi a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Rabat no mu. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ GUSA 100m mprenu. 

Wɔ afe 2021 mu no, ɔmaa ɔman no mu mmirikatu a ɛyɛ mita 100 no nyaa nkɔsoɔ de 9.97 na ɔmaa n’ankasa mmirikatuo a ɛyɛ mita 200 no nyaa nkɔsoɔ kɔɔ 20.13.

Wɔ 25 Oforisuo 2022 no, Azamati maa n’ankasa ɔman 100m ɔman kyerɛwtohɔ yɛɛ yie kɔɔ wiase kane a ɛdi kan a ɛyɛ sikani 9.90 wɔ Texas, USA, na ɛmaa ɔbɛyɛɛ kɔlegeni a ɔdii kan wɔ bere nyinaa mu a ɔto so 4 a ɔne Trayvon Bromell . Saa agyiraehyɛde yi nso maa ɔde no kaa mmirikatu a wɔde tu mmirika mita 100 a ɛsen biara no mu 50 a Afrikafo 6 pɛ na wotuu mmirika ntɛmntɛm wɔ asasepɔn no so saa bere no.

Ankorankoro nneɛma a eye sen biara

 Mita 100 - 9.90 (+2.0 mita/s, Texas 2022) .
 Mita 200 - 20.13 (+1.1 mita/s, Texas 2021)

Wɔ dan mu 

 Mita 60 - 6.54 ( Albuquerque 2022) Ɔde ne nsa kyerɛɛ ne so.
 200 mita - 20.57 (Texas 2022) Ɛyɛ a na me ne me yere kɔ.

title: Yawa Hansen-Quao
text:
Yawa Hansen-Quao (wɔwoo no wɔ Accra) yɛ Ghanani a ɔhyehyɛɛ adwuma, asetena mu adwumayɛfo ne ɔbaa ho ɔbenfoɔ . Ɔte Ashesi Sukuupɔn Kɔlege baguafo mu, ɔsom wɔ afotufo bagua no mu, Mmea Asoɛe a Ɛhwɛ Wiase Nyinaa Akannifo So, Benedictine Sukuupɔn. Ɔno na ɔhyehyɛɛ Leading Ladies Network (LLN), na ɔyɛ African Leadership Network ne World Economic Forum’s Global Shapers Community no muni . Ɔyɛ tumi a ɛsɛ sɛ wobu akontaa wɔ abeawa abofra no nhomasua ne ne yiyedi mu.

Mfitiase asetra 
Yawa Hansen-Quao yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɛfo bi babea panyin a wɔhyɛɛ no ma oguan fii ɔman no mu wɔ 1980 mfe no mfiase mu wɔ amammui mu basabasayɛ bere no mu. Ɔtraa ne mmofraase sɛ oguanfo wɔ Togo na afei ɔtraa United States. Te sɛ Afrika aguanfo pii a wɔhyɛɛ wɔn ma woguan fii wɔn asasepɔn no so no, wɔtetee no wɔ amammerɛ abien ntam na ɔde abien no nyinaa hyɛɛ ne mu. Na ɛnyɛ bere a ɛyɛ mmerɛw mma Yawa, na ɔtraa ahotoso a ɛne sɛ wɔbɛsan aba fie bere a ahobammɔ wom kɛse no ase, nanso saa mmofraberem a na amammerɛ abien wom yi nwene onipa ko a ɔyɛ nnɛ. Awiei koraa no ɔsan kɔɔ fie wɔ 1996 mu bere a na ɔyɛ ɔbabun. Kasa a wɔka ne amammerɛ mu akwanside ahorow no amma wantumi ne mmerante ne mmabaa afoforo a wɔtetee wɔn wɔ Afrika no mmɔ. Nkɔso hokwan ahorow a wɔabara a Afrikafo mmabaa betumi anya no daa adi ntɛmntɛm maa Yawa na bere a n’ahwɛfo no tew wɔn ho na abusua no hwee sikasɛm mu mmere a emu yɛ den mu akyi no, na ɛsɛ sɛ ɔhyɛ abusua no den na ɔhwɛ n’agya a na ɔyare kokoram no.

Wɔ saa ahokyere yi nyinaa akyi no na ɔwɔ nkitahodi nhyehyɛe a ɛboa wɔ n’agya, n’adamfo paa ne ne fotufo a ofi U.S. Mmofra Nkɔso nhyehyɛe no mu. Saa ɔfotufo yi huu tumi pii wɔ ne mu araa ma otuaa Yawa sukuu ka wɔ abusua no sikasɛm mu ahokyere mu sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a obetumi akɔ so akɔ sukuu. Na sukuu yɛ ɔkwan a Yawa akannifo tumi ne adebɔ ahoɔden fi adi. Wɔde dwumadi ahorow pii a odii wɔ sukuufo nniso mu tuaa ne ho akokwaw ne n’asɛyɛde so ka.

Ankorankoro asetra ne nhomasua 
Hansen-Quao bɛkaa Ashesi Suapɔn ho a na ɔwɔ anidasoɔ sɛ ɛbɛyɛ atenaeɛ a ɔbɛtumi abɛyɛ Ghana nsakraeɛ no fã. Ɛdenam nnwuma pii a ɔyɛe, a egyina sika fam mmoa ne nnamfo ayamye so no, ɔhyɛn mu na ɔde ne ho maa Ashesi. Bere a na ɔwɔ hɔ no ɔhyɛɛ Ashesi Business Club ne Women of Ashesi asuafo akuw ase. Ɔsan nso bɛyɛɛ HIV/AIDS atipɛnfoɔ kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ na awieeɛ koraa no wɔpaw no wɔ afe 2006 mu sɛ ɔbaa a ɔdi kan a ɔbɛyɛɛ kɔlegefoɔ aban titenani wɔ Ghana.

Bere a na ɔwɔ sukuu mu no osii gyinae sɛ obedi asɛm bi a ɛhaw Afrika sukuupɔn pii, adifudepɛ ahorow nyinaa ho dwuma. Wɔ nhomasua gyinabea nyinaa mu wɔ Ghana no, na nsisi, adanmude ne nna ho aguadi de nya abasobɔde abu so na ɔhwehwɛɛ sɛ ɔde nidi mmara bi bɛba ne sukuu mu. Ɛdenam nidi ho mmara a ogye toom so no, Ashesi a Hansen-Quao di n’anim no de gyinapɛn no sii hɔ wɔ nhomasua nhyehyɛe a ɛtrɛw no mu. Ɔkɔɔ so yɛɛ MA wɔ Bɔbeasu, Asomdwoe ne Ahobammɔ mu wɔ Kofi Annan Amanaman Ntam Asomdwoe Ntetee Asoɛe ne Honors abodin krataa wɔ Adwumayɛ ne Nneɛma Foforo Nkɔso mu wɔ Amerika Sukuupɔn a ɛwɔ Rome . Ɔsan nso dii adansedie krataa wɔ Radio ne TV so Nkyerɛkyerɛmu mu wɔ Ghana Institute of Journalism, na ɔnyaa Certified Corporate Etiquette and International Protocol Consultant wɔ Protocol School of Washington, USA.

Adwuma 
Bere a bere dui sɛ Hansen-Quao fi Ashesi no, na ɔpɛ sɛ ɔbɔ mpɔtam bi a wɔtete akannifo, a ɛte sɛ ne Ashesi osuahu no. Gyidie a emu yɛ den a ɔwɔ wɔ Afrika mmaa akannifoɔ a ɛwɔ wɔn mu no maa ɔhyehyɛɛ Leading Ladies Network (LLN), a ɛyɛ nneɛma ne abusuabɔ nnyinasoɔ ma mmabaa berɛ a wɔredi akannifoɔ dwumadie wɔ aban, ɔmanfoɔ, nnwumakuo ahyehyɛdeɛ ne afoforɔ mu. Ɛnam ne Mmea Akannifoɔ Nkɔsoɔ, Afotuo ne Tumidie Ntoatoasoɔ so no, LLN tete mmabaa ma wɔyɛ asetena mu nsakraeɛ nnwinnadeɛ, boa wɔn wɔ mmeaeɛ nyinaa na ɛsiesie wɔn sɛ wɔbɛyɛ nkoa akannifoɔ wɔ wɔn nnwuma a wɔapaw mu. Saa mmaa yi yɛ nnwuma a ɛbɛma wɔn amanfoɔ atu mpɔn na wɔasiesie wɔn ho sɛ wɔbɛfa akannifoɔ dwumadie foforɔ.

Sɛ yɛde n’adwuma a ɔyɛ daa sɛ obi a ɔhyehyɛɛ adwuma no to nkyɛn a, Hansen-Quao yɛ Ashesi Sukuupɔn Kɔlege no akwankyerɛfo bagua no muni, wɔ Mmea Asoɛe a Ɛhwɛ Wiase Nyinaa Akannifo So, Benedictine Sukuupɔn afotufo bagua no mu, Afrika Akannifo Nkitahodi ne Wiase no muni Sikasɛm Nhyiam no Wiase Nyinaa Nneɛma a Wɔyɛ no Kuw . Ɔsan nso som sɛ akannifoɔ fotufoɔ ma UN Mmea a ɔboa ma wɔyɛ akannifoɔ adesua nhyehyɛeɛ de ma mmaa akannifoɔ tumi kɔ anim wɔ Afrika Apueeɛ ne Anafoɔ fam.

Abasobɔde ne nea wɔatumi ayɛ 
Wɔ afe 2016 mu no, wɔmaa no afe 2016 Eisenhower Fellows wɔ Eisenhower Fellowship Africa Program a ɛdi kan no ho.

Wɔ March 2021 mu no, wɔde Hansen-Quao too gua sɛ Vlisco Ghana Ɔmanpanyin ama afe no. Wɔpaw no esiane dwuma a odii wɔ mmea akannifo ne afoforo a wɔwɔ Afrika kyerɛkyerɛ mu nti.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Stephen Amoah
text:
Stephen Amoah (a nnipa pii frɛ no Sticka )  yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɛfo a ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party (NPP) no muni.   Ɔyɛ Nhyiaeso Mantam no mmarahyɛbaguani .  Mprempren ɔyɛ GCB Sikakorabea no board member .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Stephen Amoah wɔ 27 Oforisuo 1970. Ɔfiri Kronum Afrancho a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔwiee Opoku Ware Sukuu, Kumasi. Ɔwɔ Nyansahu mu abodin krataa wɔ Strategic Finance Management mu wɔ University of Derby, United Kingdom wɔ afe 2007. Ɔsan nso nyaa ne Bachelor of Science Degree wɔ Computer Science mu wɔ Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology (KNUST), Ghana. Ɔsan nso wɔ Certificate in Entrepreneurship a efi MIT . Ɔsan nso wɔ PhD wɔ Actuarial Science mu wɔ KNUST .

Adwuma 
Amoah yɛ Kencity Sikasɛm sohwɛfoɔ Panyin na ɔsan nso yɛɛ adwuma wɔ mmerɛ a atwam no mu sɛ Ɔman Insurance Authority (NHIA) no Ɔman Ntamgyinafoɔ Abadiakyiri.  Wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2017 mu no, Ɔmanpanyin Akufo-Addo paw no sɛ adwumayɛfoɔ panin ma Sikasɛm nketewa ne Boa nketewa Asoɛeɛ (MASLOC).  Ɔyɛ Zintex Portfolio Services Limited no kwankyerɛfo panyin . Ɔyɛ sikasɛm ne sikasɛm ho ɔfotufo.

Bɔɔlbɔ kuw 
Wɔ August 2022 mu no, Amoah hyehyɛɛ Kumasi FC a ɛyɛ bɔɔlbɔ kuo wɔ Kumasi titiriw Nhyiaeso. Ɛyɛ bɔɔlbɔ sukuu a ɛwɔ ntetee beae, apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ dan, aduruyɛbea ne mmeae afoforo.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Amoah gyinaa NPP primaries no anim wɔ afe 2020 abatoɔ no anim.  Wɔ June 2020 mu no ɔdii nkonim wɔ primaries a wɔyɛ maa Nhyiaeso Constituency no akyi a ɔdii  mmrahyɛbaguani a ɔdi tumi seesei Kennedy Kwasi Kankam a na ɔyii Richard Winfred Anane firii n’ahengua so wɔ 2016 NPP primaries mu no so nkonim.

Ɔdii nkonim denam abatoɔ 332 a ɔnyaeɛ so berɛ a nea ɔdi tumi no nyaa abatoɔ 315 wɔ abatoɔ 647 a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu.

Wɔpaw Amoah sɛ  mmrahyɛbaguani maa Nhyaieso wɔ afe 2020 December  mmrahyɛbagua abatow mu. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ atenaeɛ no mu berɛ a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 51,531 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 81.71% tiaa nea ɔbɛn no paa Richard Kwamina Prah a ɔfiri National Democratic Congress a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 11,033 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 17.49%.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

New Patriotic Party amanyɔfoɔ
Ghana mmrahyɛbadwafoɔ 2021-2025

title: Zuta Mary Nartey
text:
Zuta Mary Nartey (a wɔsan frɛ no Mary Zutah Narteh, wɔwoo no 14 Ɔbɛnem 1987) yɛ Ghanani a ɔtow peaw .

Peaw tow 
Wɔ afe 2012 mu no ɔdii anan wɔ African Championships wɔ Athletics mu wɔ Porto Novo a ɔde mita 49.69

Wɔ afe 2014 mu no, ɔdii kan wɔ Commonwealth Games a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Glasgow, ɔdii dwetɛ wɔ African Championships wɔ Athletics mu wɔ Marrakech a ɔde n’ankasa deɛ ɛsen biara a ɛyɛ mita 52.57, na ɔdii awotwe wɔ IAAF Continental Cup a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Marrakech.

Ɔsan nso nyaa dwetɛ nkonimbo wɔ Afrika Agumadi a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Brazzaville wɔ afe 2015.

Ɔdii kan wɔ afe 2016 mu wɔ African Championships in Athletics a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Durban a ɔdii mita 45.40.

Wɔ afe 2018 mu no ɔnyaa dwetɛ nkonimboɔ wɔ Sekondi-Takoradi GAA(Ghana Athletics Association) Circuit mu a ɔde mita 45.35.

Tuo a wɔde tow tuo 
Wɔ afe 2002 mu no Nartey yɛɛ tuo a wɔde tow tuo ho kyerɛwtohɔ a ɛyɛ 11.70 bere a na ɔwɔ Osei Kyeretwie Senior High School wɔ Ashanti Regional Super Zonal agumadi akansi a ɛkɔɔ so mfe 18 kosii sɛ Rashida Abass a ofi Prempeh College bubuu no wɔ afe 2019 mu

title: Annie Ruth Jiagge
text:
Annie Ruth Jiagge, Ɔbenfo a ɔhwɛ GM (nee Baëta ; 7 Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 1918 – 12 Ɔbɛnem 1996) , a wɔsan frɛ no Annie Baëta Jiagge , yɛ Ghana mmaranimni, ɔtemmufo ne mmaa hokwan ho ɔbenfo. Ɔno ne ɔbea a odi kan wɔ Ghana ne Amanaman Nkabom no mu a ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔtemmufo . Ná ɔyɛ obi a ɔkyerɛw Mpaemuka a Ɛfa Nyiyim a Wɔyɛ Tia Mmea a Wobeyi Afi Hɔ Ho no titiriw, na na ɔka wɔn a wɔhyehyɛɛ ahyehyɛde a ɛbɛyɛɛ Mmea Wiase Sikakorabea no ho .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Annie Ruth Baeta wɔ Ɔkɔtɔber 7 1918 wɔ Lomé, France Togoland . Na n’awofo yɛ sukuu kyerɛkyerɛfo, Henrietta Baëta ne Presbyterian somfo, Robert Domingo Baëta. Na ɔka Ewe abusuakuw a ɛwɔ Ghana ne Togo kesee fam apuei no ho . Na ɔyɛ Baëta abusua a ɛda nsow no muni, na na ɔyɛ mmofra baawɔtwe no mu biako, ɛwom sɛ Annie ne ne nuanom Christian, Lily, ne William nkutoo na wɔtraa ase kosii wɔn mpanyin afe so de. Na ne nuabarima panyin, Christian Baëta yɛ nhomanimfo ne Presbyterian somfo a wɔpaw no sɛ Synod Clerk wɔ Evangelical Presbyterian Church of the Gold Coast fi 1945 kosi 1949   na ɔboaa kɛse ma wɔde Sukuupɔn a ɛwɔ Ghana, Legon wɔ afe 1948. Na n’awofo pɛ sɛ osua Engiresi kasa na ɔne ne nanabea a ɔyɛ ne maame te mpoano kurow Keta (saa bere no na ɛwɔ Britania Togoland ) mu.

Baeta kɔɔ Achimota College na onyaa ne kyerɛkyerɛfo adansedi krataa wɔ afe 1937 mu. Ná ɔyɛ Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo Panyin ne Sukuu Kyerɛkyerɛfo wɔ Evangelical Presbyterian Girls School fi 1940 kosi 1946. Bere a ɛpo no hohoroo Evangelical Presbyterian Sukuu a Wɔde Ma Mmabaa no adan wɔ 1940 mu akyi no, woyii mmeawa no kɔɔ Evangelical Presbyterian Sukuu a Wɔhwɛ Mmarimaa So no mu. Ná nnipa ahyɛ sukuu no mu ma dodo, na na Baeta nim sɛ ɛbɛyɛ den sɛ obenya sika de asi adan foforo. Ɔkɔɔ Evangelical Presbyterian Asɔre Nnwontofo Kuw no nkyɛn na ɔdanee no yɛɛ no drama kuw a wɔde George F. Rool nnwom ho dwumadi David the Shepherd Boy . Agorudi ahorow no dii yiye na wɔtoo nsa frɛɛ kuw no sɛ wɔmmɛbɔ nnwom wɔ Gold Coast nkurow akɛse mu ne Togo . Baeta tumi boaboaa sika ano maa sukuu foforo maa mmeawa no a wosii wɔ December 1945.

Adesua a wɔyɛe wɔ London 
Bere a Baeta de traa Evangelical Presbyterian Mmabaa Sukuu no mu no yɛɛ nea abotɔyam wom nanso ɛmaa no yɛɛ basaa. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ London Matriculation Sɔhwɛ mu wɔ afe 1945. Ne nuabarima panyin Christian bisabisaa London Sukuupɔn nsɛm wɔ ne din mu na ne maame gyee bosea maa no. Wogyee no kɔɔ London Sukuu a Ɛhwɛ Sikasɛm ne Amanyɔsɛm So wɔ 1946 mu. Ne mfɛfo mmarima a wofi Gold Coast no hyɛɛ no sɛ onnyae n’adesua, a na wosusuw sɛ ɛyɛ den dodo ma ɔbea. Obiako kae sɛ ɔbɛyɛ dibea ho nhyehyɛe ama no wɔ Paris Adesuabea hɔ ma wasua ntadehyɛ ho ade. Ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ sɛ wantwa ne sɔhwɛ a edi kan no mu a, ɔbɛsan akɔ Gold Coast . Ɔtwam, na mmarima no anhaw no bio. Ɔnyaa ne LLB wɔ 1949 mu na wɔfrɛɛ no kɔɔ Bar wɔ Lincoln’s Inn afe a edi hɔ no. Baëta nso de ne ho hyɛɛ nyamesom ne asetra mu nnwuma mu wɔ n'ahomegye bere mu wɔ London . Ɔne mmabun nsraban ahorow a Mmabun Kristofo Fekuw (YWCA) hyehyɛe no yɛɛ adwuma na wɔpaw no sɛ Wiase YWCA Adwumayɛkuw no muni wɔ ne mfe a etwa to sɛ osuani no mu.

Mmara adwuma, mmea hokwan ahorow ho adwuma ne agyapade 
Baeta hyehyɛɛ kokoam adwumayɛbea bi bere a ɔsan kɔɔ Gold Coast wɔ 1950 mu no. Ɔdii ɔmanfoɔ ntam abusuabɔ nhyehyɛeɛ bi anim sɛ wɔbɛhyehyɛ ɔman YWCA ama atubraman no na wɔyɛɛ sini a wɔde kyerɛw nsɛm sɛ adwuma a wɔde bɛkyerɛkyerɛ ɔmanfoɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ no ho adeɛ no fã. Baeta waree Fred Jiagge wɔ 10 Ɔbɛnem 1953. Ɔgyaee Bar no na ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔtemmufoɔ maa Bench no wɔ June 1953. Wɔ 1954 mu no, ofii ase kɔɔ Wiase Nyinaa Asɔre Bagua no nhyiam ahorow daa . Efi 1955 kosi 1960 no, na ɔyɛ YWCA no titrani. Ɔne ne kunu faa abofra bi a wɔfrɛ no Rheinhold sɛ wɔn mma wɔ 1959 mu. Wɔ 1959 mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔtemmufo maa Ɔmansin Asɛnnibea.

Bere a Jiagge tee ababaa bi a wɔtoo no mmonnaa wɔ Accra bere a ofii nkuraase baa hɔ sɛ ɔrebɛbisabisa no adwuma ho nsɛm akyi no, ɔhwehwɛɛ aban mmoa na ama mmea a wɔbɛsra no no anya dabere a ahobammɔ wom. Ɔne Ghana ɔmampanyin Kwame Nkrumah nyaa atiefo na ɔmaa ogye dii sɛ adwuma no ho hia. Ɔdii ɔsatuo bi a ɛdi mu anim wɔ 1961 mu a ɛnyaa sika kɛseɛ maa YWCA mmaa ahɔhodan bi. Saa afe no ɔbɛyɛɛ Asɛnnibea Kunini no temmufo. Efi afe 1961 kosi afe 1976 no na ɔyɛ Ghana Sukuupɔn no agyinatukuw muni . Wɔ afe 1962 mu no wɔpaw no sɛ onnyina Ghana ananmu wɔ Amanaman Nkabom Bagua a Ɛhwɛ Mmea Gyinabea So no mu . Wɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ ɔnyɛ Bagua a Ɛhwehwɛ Ɔman Adwumayɛfo Panyin ne Amanyɔsɛm mu Akannifo a Wɔabobɔ Wɔn Din no Agyapade mu no guamtrani wɔ 1966 mu. Ɔnam n’adwuma a ɔyɛe wɔ Amanaman Nkabom, a ogyinaa Ghana ananmu kosii 1972 no so bɔɔ mmea hokwan ahorow ho ban. Wɔ 1966 mu no, wɔpaw no sɛ Aban Asoɛe no amanneɛbɔfo. Wɔ nhyiam bi a wɔyɛe wɔ Iran wɔ 1967 mu no, wɔbɔɔ Aban Asoɛe no sobo sɛ wɔnyɛ krataa bi a ɛfa nyiyim a wɔyɛ tia mmea a wobeyi afi hɔ ho . Esiane sɛ na Jiagge haw sɛ bere a wobefi Iran no renwie sraadi bi nti, ohyiaa kuw no mufo afoforo, a Iran Ɔhemmaa Ashraf Pahlavi ka ho, na ɔkyerɛw krataa no anadwo biako. Wɔde kɔmaa aman a wɔka UN ho sɛ wɔmmɛka wɔn adwene na akyiri yi wogye toom. Ná Mpaemuka no yɛ ade titiriw a edii 1979 Apam a ɛfa Nyiyim a Wɔyɛ Tia Mmea Nyinaa a Wobeyi Afi Hɔ Ho a ɛyɛ mmara kwan so de no anim . Wɔpaw Jiagge sɛ Commission no nhyiam a ɛto so 21 no guamtrani wɔ afe 1968.

Wɔmaa Jiagge Ghana Abasobɔde Kɛse ne Gimbles Amanaman Ntam Abasobɔde a ɛfa Nnipa mmoa adwuma ho wɔ afe 1969 mu. Wɔbɔɔ no din sɛ Asɛnnibea a Ɛhwɛ Asɛm a Wɔde Kɔdan Asɛnnibea no temmufo saa afe no ara, asɛnnibea a ɛkorɔn sen biara wɔ Ghana saa bere no. Ɔno ne ɔbea temmufo a odi kan wɔ Asɛnnibea a Ɛhwɛ Asɛm a Wɔde Kɔdan Asɛnnibea no. Wɔmaa no mmaranimfoɔ abodin krataa a ɛyɛ nidi wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu wɔ afe 1974 mu. Afe 1975 mu no, ɔhyehyɛɛ Ghana Ɔman Bagua a ɛhwɛ Mmea ne Nkɔso so na ɔno ne ne guamtrani a odi kan. Sɛ́ oguamtrani no, ɔfrɛɛ Ghana mmea nhyiam bi sɛ wɔrebesua wɔn adwene wɔ Pɛyɛ, Nkɔso ne Asomdwoe, a ɛyɛ 1975 Amanaman Ntam Mmea Nhyiam a wɔyɛe wɔ Mexico no asɛmti no ho . Ɔtee sɛ bosea a wobenya no yɛ ade titiriw ma ne man mu mmea na odii Ghana ananmusifo no anim kɔɔ nhyiam no ase. Ɔne afoforo hyɛɛ bɔ sɛ wɔde aba sika bɛma mmea sikakorabea, na wɔhyehyɛɛ ahyehyɛde a wɔfrɛ no Stitching to Promote Women’s World Banking (mprempren Women’s World Banking ) na wɔn adwumayɛbea ti wɔ New York . Akyiri yi ɔyɛɛ Women’s World Banking board a ɛwɔ Ghana no mu. Jiagge nso yɛɛ Wiase Nyinaa Asɔre Bagua no titrani fi 1975 kosi 1983. Wɔ afe 1979 mu no, na ɔyɛ amansan bagua a wɔkyerɛw Ghana Ɔman a Ɛto so Abiɛsa no  mmrahyɛbagua no muni . Ná ɔyɛ Wiase Nyinaa Asɔre Bagua no kwankyerɛfo ma wɔn Dwumadi a Wɔde Ko Tia Mmusuakuw mu Nnyiyim fi 1984 kosi 1991 na ɔboaboaa wɔn ho ano tiaa South Africa nhyehyɛe a ɛne nnipa mu nyiyim .

Wɔpaw Jiagge sɛ Asɛnnibea a Ɛhwɛ Asɛm a Wɔde Kɔdan Asɛnnibea no Titenani wɔ 1980 mu. Saa afe no ɔdii Ghana ananmusifoɔ no anim bio kɔɔ Amanaman Ntam Mmea Nhyiamu a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Copenhagen. Ɔkɔɔ so yɛɛ Asɛnnibea a Ɛhwɛ Asɛm a Wɔde Kɔdan Asɛnnibea no Titenani kosii sɛ ogyaee adwuma wɔ 1983 mu. Ɔboa ma wɔyɛɛ Wiase Nyinaa Nhyiam a Ɛto so Anan a Ɛfa Mmea Ho no ho nhyehyɛe sɛ Amanaman Nkabom Ɔkyerɛwfo Panyin no afotufo kuw no muni saa afe no. Wɔ 1985 mu no, ɔsom wɔ Amanaman Nkabom no bagua bi a wɔyɛɛ Baguam Asɛnnibea a Ɛfa Amanaman Ntam Nnwumakuw a Wɔyɛ wɔ South Africa ne Namibia no Dwumadi Ho no mu . Ɔsan nso yɛɛ Abenfoɔ Boayikuo a wɔhyehyɛɛ Ghana Amanyɔ Mmara wɔ afe 1991.

Efi afe 1993 kosi ne wu no, Jiagge yɛɛ Ghana Ɔman Bagua no muni. Owui wɔ June 12 1996 wɔ Accra . Mmea ne Mmofra Dwumadibea na ɛde Justice Annie Jiagge Nkaedi Ɔkasa ahorow no sii hɔ wɔ afe 2009. Wɔtoo ahɔhodan bi a wɔtra mu, Annie Baëta Jiagge Fie, a kan no na ɛyɛ, Fie 17, wɔ ne alma mater, Achimota Sukuu no din de kaee no de kyerɛɛ ne dwumadi sɛ obi a ɔyɛ ɔkwankyerɛfo wɔ mmara adwuma mu wɔ Ghana .

Abasobɔde ahorow 

 Ghana Abasobɔde Kɛse (1969) .
 Gimbles Amanaman Ntam Abasobɔde (1969) .

Hwɛ nso 
Mmea mmaranimfo a wodi kan wɔ wiase nyinaa

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Irene Agyepong
text:
Irene Akua Agyepong yɛ Ghana ɔmanfo akwahosan ho oduruyɛfoɔ a ɔwɔ Dodowa Health Research Center na ɔyɛ Ghana College of Physicians and Surgeons Faculty of Public Health no muni . Agyepong dii The Lancet bagua a ɛhwɛ akwahosan ho daakye so wɔ Afrika Sahara anafo fam no anim.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Bere a Ageypong yɛ abofra no, na ɔpɛ sɛ ɔkyerɛw, ɔpam ade na ɔyɛ oduruyɛfo. Awiei koraa no osuaa aduruyɛ wɔ Ghana Sukuupɔn Aduruyɛ Sukuu mu . Otu kɔɔ West African College of Physicians, faako a ne maame nuabea Phyllis Antwi hyɛɛ no nkuran sɛ ɔnyɛ ɔmanfo akwahosan ho ɔbenfo. Bere a Ageypong wiee sukuu no, ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ aduruyɛ mu ɔpanyin wɔ asɛmpatrɛw ayaresabea bi. N’adwuma a edi kan no mu biako ne adwuma a ɔyɛe wɔ awo ho; a ohui sɛ ɛyɛ nkate fam asɛnnennen no. Wɔ nsɛm a wobisabisaa The Lancet mu no Agyepong kyerɛkyerɛɛ mu sɛ, “Na eyi yɛ Ghana wɔ 1980 mfe no mu —na yɛda so ara repue afi sikasɛm bere a emu yɛ den ankasa mu. Ɛtɔ da bi a na nsateaa nni hɔ, na nnade a ɛfata nni hɔ, ɛtɔ da bi nso a na wuntumi nnya nneɛma a ɛnyɛ den te sɛ scalpel...Na na mogya akorae biara nni hɔ...Wobɛtumi ama obi awu ansa na mogya a ɛdɔɔso aba. Anka wubehu nea wobɛyɛ —nanso wuntumi”. Saa bere no Aduruyɛ Dwumadibea sohwɛfo Moses Adibo hyɛɛ no nkuran sɛ ɔnyɛ adwuma wɔ amanaman ntam, na otu kɔɔ United Kingdom kɔsuaa ɔmanfo akwahosan ho ade wɔ Liverpool School of Tropical Medicine . Awiei koraa no Agyepong tu kɔɔ United States, na owiee oduruyɛfo abodin krataa a ɔde suaa asramma ano aduru ho ade wɔ Ghana .

Nhwehwɛmu ne adwumayɛ 
Bere a Ageypong nyaa ne oduruyɛfo abodin krataa no, ɔsan kɔɔ Ghana . Awiei koraa no, wɔyɛɛ no Greater Accra mantam no Akwahosan ho Ɔkwankyerɛfo. Na ɔwɔ dibea a wɔbom yɛ wɔ Ghana Sukuupɔn Sukuu a ɛhwɛ ɔmanfo akwahosan so.

title: Samira Suleman
text:
Samira Suleman (wɔwoo no Ɔbɛnem 16, 1991) yɛ Ghana amanaman ntam bɔɔlbɔni a ɔbɔ sɛ ɔbɔfo wɔ Iceland ma Víkingur Ólafsvík .

Iceland 
Suleman baa Víkingur Ólafsvík wɔ afe 2015 mu na ɔdii agorɔ 10 wɔ afe 2015 berɛ no mu.

Amanaman ntam adwuma 
Ɔbɔɔ bɔɔl wɔ nkonim a ɔdii wɔ Ethiopia so 2–0 wɔ 2014 African Women’s Championship qualification match mu. Na ɔka Ghana kuw a wɔrekɔ 2014 Afrika Mmea Nkonimdi no ho . Ɔbɔɔ bɔɔl wɔ nkonim a Ghana dii wɔ Ivory Coast so 1–0 wɔ afe 2015 Afrika Agumadi no fa a etwa to no mu . title: Grace Armah
text:

title: Josephine Oppong Yeboah
text:
Josephine Oppong Yeboah (wɔwoo no June 19, 1979) a wɔsan frɛ no Lady Joy yɛ Ghana broadcast nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho ɔkamfofo ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo. Mprempren ɔyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo panyin, ɔyɛfo, amanneɛbɔfo panyin ne ɔmantam samufo/Ntamgyinafo wɔ Metro TV Ghana . Mprempren ɔyɛ GJA no muni na ɔsan yɛ amanaman ntam nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Yeboah wiee Bachelor of Arts degree wɔ Information Studies/Political Science mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu na ɔsan nso nyaa Diploma wɔ Communication Studies mu wɔ Ghana Institute of Journalism (GIJ).

Adwuma 
Na Yeboah yɛ ɔman no sohwɛfo ma Africa Watch Magazine. Na ɔsan nso yɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo panyin ne ɔyɛkyerɛfo wɔ E.TV Ghana ne Sky 96.7 FM. Na ɔsan yɛ Brong Ahafo mantam mu nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo ma Joy FM . Na ɔsan yɛ dwumadi no sohwɛfo ne ɔkwankyerɛfo wɔ Top FM (kan no na wɔfrɛ no Top Radio). Na ɔsan nso yɛ Metro TV so Good Morning Ghana dwumadi no ho ɔkwankyerɛfo.

Abasobɔdeɛ 
Wɔ afe 2019 mu no, Yeboah nyaa Female Media Personality Award wɔ ne mmea tumidi ɔsatu ahorow ho.

title: Anita Erskine
text:
Anita Erskine-Amaizo (wɔwoo no Vered - Marian Anita Erskine ; 3 December 1978) yɛ Ghanani a ɔka kasa abien (Borɔfo ne Franse) ɔbɔ amanneɛ, adwumayɛni compère, ɔkasa dwumadi kwankyerɛfo, odiyifo ne mmeawa nhomasua ho ɔkamfofo. Ɔyɛ Executive Producer ne Sheroes of Our Time a ɛkɔ so wɔ Akwaaba Magic wɔ DSTV so no sohwɛfo . Ɔsan nso yɛ Ahɔhoyɛfoɔ ne Ɔfotufoɔ wɔ 2020 de a ɛfa Africa Netpreneur Prize Initiative (Jack Ma Foundation’s flagship pilanthropic entrepreneur program in Africa) no ho.

Mfitiase asetra 
Wɔwoo Anita wɔ Jerusalem, Israel maa kan Ghana sraani ne ɔmanyɛfo, Ɔsahene Panyin Emmanuel Erskine ne Rose Anastasia Erskine. Wɔtetee no wɔ Ghana na wɔ ne mmabunbere awiei no otu kɔɔ Canada. Anita wɔ Bachelor of Arts abodin krataa wɔ Amammerɛ Ho Adesua mu wɔ Trent Sukuupɔn mu .

Nwomasua 
Ɔnyaa ne Mfitiaseɛ Nhomasua wɔ Christ the King International School na ne Ntoaso Nhomasua wɔ Ghana International School . Erskine wɔ Amammerɛ Ho Adesua mu abodin krataa wɔ Trent Sukuupɔn a ɛwɔ Peterborough, Ontario Canada.

Adwuma 
Anita TV so dwumadi a edi kan a ɔdaa ne ho adi wɔ Ghana TV so ne afe 1998 bere a ɔyɛɛ Bold and Beautiful Omnibus Talk Show wɔ Metro TV so no. Wɔ Canada no ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ adwumayɛfo boafo na afei ɔyɛɛ radio so dwumadi ho ɔkwankyerɛfo wɔ FLOW 93.5 wɔ Toronto. Wɔ afe 2006 mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ TV3 dwumadibea a wɔfrɛ no Mentor . Bere a ɔyɛɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ afe 2007 mu akyi no, ɔbɛyɛɛ Ghana nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo maa MNET Studio 53. Akyiri yi Wɔ afe 2009 mu, bere a na ɔwɔ awo akwamma mu no, ofii ase yɛɛ adwuma wɔ Viasat 1 wɔ Ghana sɛ Lead Producer maa station no ankasa dwumadi ahorow. Bere a ofii Viasat 1 ne Modern African Productions mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ Ifactory Live’s Pamper Your Mum, Cooking With ne Making of a Mogul no ho ɔkwankyerɛfo.

Wɔ afe 2007 ne afe 2009 mfiase ntam no, na Anita yɛ Tigo (a Millicom na ɔwɔ) no Adwumakuw Nkitahodi Sohwɛfo, na ɔfaa dwumadi ahorow wɔ Ghana ne Democratic Republic of Congo.

Ɔsan baa Viasat 1 baa "The One Show" wɔ afe 2014. Bere koro no ara mu no, ɔsan nso yɛɛ +233 Discovery a Discovery Learning Alliance - mprempren Impact Ed International na ɛyɛe no.

Wɔ afe 2015 mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ co host maa Accra - a ɛwɔ Starr FM "Starr Drive" a ɔne Bola Ray na afei ɔne Giovanni Caleb. Ɔgyaee adwuma wɔ kuw no mu wɔ November 2017 mu sɛ ɔde n’adwene sii ne advocacy ne production company a ɔbɛkyekyere no so.

Ɔhyehyɛɛ ne Communications Consultancy, Anita Erskine Media wɔ June 2016 mu na ɔkyekyee adwumakuo baako a wɔfrɛ no Bosslady Productions. Ɔno na ɔhwɛ Anita Erskine Media so.

title: Ohemaa Mercy
text:
Wɔwoo Mercy Amoah a nnipa pii frɛ no Ohemaa Mercy wɔ Weija, Accra maa Fantis awofo, Owura ne Owurayere Amoah, a wɔfiri Abakrapa ne Elmina . Ɔtraa ne mmerantebere mu fã kɛse no ara wɔ Koforidua . Ohemaa Mercy yɛɛ ne mfitiaseɛ adesua wɔ St. Peter’s Anglican Primary School, Koforidua ne ntoaso sukuu wɔ Ghana Senior High School, Koforidua . Ɔtoaa so kɔɔ SDA Akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ Nteteeɛ Kɔlege, Asokore, Koforidua baabi a ɔnyaa ne Akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ Abodin krataa ‘A’.

Nnwom adwuma 
Ohemaa Mercy yii ne nnwom nhoma a edi kan adi wɔ November 2004 awiei. Wɔtoo din Adamfo Papa, album no nyaa anigye kɛse wɔ mframa mu bere a woyii no adi akyi, na ɛmaa Ohemaa baa anim. Ɔdii nkonim mpɛn nson wɔ 2006 Ghana Music Awards nanso wannya abasobɔdeɛ no mu biara. Akyiri yi onyaa Discovery of the year wɔ Gospel Music Awards afe koro no ara mu.

Wɔ afe 2007 mu no, asɛmpa somfo no yii ne nnwom nhoma a ɛto so abien, Edin Jesus . Ohemaa Mercy tɔn 875,000 wɔ asram asia akyi bere a woyii album a ɛto so abien no adi a ɛmaa ɛbɛyɛɛ album a wɔtɔn sen biara wɔ afe no mu.

Edin Jesus album no maa Ohemaa Mercy nyaa din 10 sɛ ɔnkɔ 2008 Ghana Music Awards . Eyi ne nnipa dodow a wɔayi wɔn din sen biara de besi nnɛ wɔ abasobɔde nhyehyɛe no abakɔsɛm mu. Wɔ adeyɛ no mu no otumi de abasobɔde abiɛsa kɔɔ fie: Gospel Artiste of the Year, Album of the Year ne Gospel Album of The Year. Afe koro no ara mu no onyaa Grand Medal During National Honors Award fii Ghana Ɔmanpanyin dedaw, John Kufuor hɔ .

Wɔ afe 2010–11 mu no Ohemaa yii ne album a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa, Wobeye Kese, a ɛsan yɛ album a wɔtɔn no kɛseɛ na ɛdii nkɔmmɔdie akɛseɛ a ɛwɔ ɔman no mu nyinaa so.

Asram anan akyi a woyii no adi no, saa album yi san dii nkonim wɔ ne din anan mu wɔ 2014 Ghana Music Awards.

Ɔdii nkonim wɔ Gospel Artiste a ɔsen biara wɔ afe no mu na wɔ Canada afe no ara mu no, ɔnyaa Gospel Artiste of the Year-Canada. Wɔpaw no sɛ Best Female Artiste West Africa afe koro no ara mu maa Africa Gospel Music abasobɔde a wɔde mae wɔ London no. Ɔsan nso dii nkonim wɔ Vodafone Ghana Music Awards 23 "Gospel Song Of The Year" ne Ote Me Mu ft MOG nnwom  Ohemaa Mercy ayɛ nnwom wɔ platform akɛse so de nnwom a ɛma anyinam ahoɔden a ama wanya anigyede kɛse, ɛnyɛ ɔdɔ a ɔwɔ nko ne nnwom nanso ɛyɛ ne nnwom a ɔbɔ wɔ asɛnka agua so nso.

title: Elsie Owusu
text:
Elsie Owusu OBE RIBA FRSA yɛ Britania dansini a wɔwoo no wɔ Ghana, ɔyɛ asɔremma a ɔhyehyɛɛ no na ɔyɛ Society of Black Architects no guamtrani a ɔdi kan. Wonim nso sɛ ɔne no dii anim wɔ United Kingdom Asɛnnibea Kunini a wɔresiesie no mu wɔ afe 2009 mu na ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ Green Park tube station . Ɔyɛ Royal Institute of British Architects (RIBA) Council muni a wɔapaw no fi afe 2014, ne London School of Architecture no guamtrani abadiakyiri .

Nhomasua ne adwumayɛ 
Wɔwoo Elsie Owusu wɔ Ghana na wɔ November 1962 mu no, ɔne n’awofoɔ tu kɔɔ UK, baabi a na n’agya yɛ ɔmanpanyin wɔ London. Ɔkɔɔ Streatham ne Clapham ntoaso sukuu wɔ London.

Ɔayɛ adwuma sɛ ɔdansifoɔ firi afe 1986, ɔhyehyɛɛ n’ankasa adansiɛ adwumayɛbea, Elsie Owusu Architects (EOA), a ɔda so ara yɛ ne sukuu panyin. EOA ne mfoniniyɛfo Sir Peter Blake ayɛ adwuma wɔ ofie a ahoɔden nnim, 60 Aden Grove, a wɔboaboaa ano wɔ nnansa mu no ho. Sɛ́ ɔdansifo panyin ma saa adwuma yi no, EOA nso ayɛ afie ne adan akɛse ho nhyehyɛe ama Ujima Adan Fekuw no. Mprempren EOA ne Symbiotica ne NS Design Consultants reyɛ adwuma abom wɔ UK/Nigerian mfoniniyɛfo Yinka Shonibare atrae ho .

Ɔne Fielden+Mawson yɛɛ ɔhokafo mfe 10,  faako a na ɔne no yɛ ɔdansifo panyin ma UK Asɛnnibea Kunini no ne nhyehyɛe kɛse kuw a wɔyɛ ma London Green Park Station . Owusu ne Fielden+Mawson yɛɛ adwuma bom nso hwɛɛ Lammas Center for St. Bernard’s Hospital no dabere so.  Sɛ́ obi a ɔyɛ nneɛma a wɔkora so ho ɔdansifo no, wayɛ adwuma nso wɔ ɔmanfo kar ne nneɛma a wɔbɛsan asiesie mu wɔ Ghana ne Nigeria. Ɔyɛ UK adwumakuw JustGhana a ɛhyɛ sikasɛm, nkɔso a ɛtra hɔ daa ne asetra mu nkitahodi a ɛma denhyɛ ho nkuran wɔ Ghana no kwankyerɛfo, ne ArchQuestra, "wɔhyehyɛɛ sɛ wɔde Britania adansi, adwinni ne mfiridwuma mu nneɛma a eye sen biara bɛma de aboa sikasɛm a ɛrenya nkɔso no kwankyerɛfo". Wɔ afe 2015 mu no na ɔyɛ nnipa 12 a wɔbɔɔ wɔn din sɛ "RIBA nhwɛsoɔ" de boaa nnipa a wɔka ho ne nnipa ahodoɔ no mu baako.

Wayɛ ahyehyɛde ahorow a Arts Council England, National Trust of England, ne UK Supreme Court Arts Trust ka ho no baguafo, na wayɛ Royal Institute of British Architects (RIBA) ne Architectural Bagua no sohwɛfo Fekuw .

Wɔ afe 2017 mu, de hyɛ Stephen Lawrence, a na ɔwɔ anidasoɔ sɛ ɔbɛyɛ ɔdansifoɔ a wɔkumm no mfeɛ aduonu nnum no, Owusu hyɛɛ aseɛ, ne Stephen Lawrence Charitable Trust, RIBA+25 ɔsatuo a ɛbɛma nneɛma ahodoɔ akɔ soro wɔ adansiɛ mu, adwuma bi a no, Architects' Journal bɔɔ amanneɛ wɔ afe 2015 mu sɛ "ɛyɛ wɔn a wɔnni ahodoɔ pii wɔ UK no mu baako, a wɔakyerɛ adansifoɔ ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 94 ase sɛ wɔyɛ aborɔfoɔ", na RIBA adansifoɔ 27,000 a wɔagye wɔn atom no mu 4,000 pɛ na wɔyɛ mmaa. Wɔ "+25" nhyehyɛe no akyi, a enyaa mmoa fii mfɛfo adwumayɛfo te sɛ David Adjaye, Alison Brooks ne Richard Rogers hɔ no, na Owusu nkutoo nyɛ RIBA sodikuw no muni a ɔnyɛ aborɔfo bio na mmom na ɔyɛ 12 no mu biako.

Wɔ afe 2017 mu no wɔde Owusu too gua sɛ obi a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ RIBA titenani, a adansifoɔ bɛboro aduɔson a wɔagye wɔn atom a Sir David Adjaye OBE, Owen Luder CBE, Deborah Saunt ne Yasmin Shariff ka ho na wɔpaw no, na Baroness Doreen Lawrence na ɔpenee so. Owusu aka nsɛm a ɛfa ahyehyɛdeɛ mu mmusua mu nyiyim ne ɔbarima ne ɔbaa mu nyiyim ho asɛm wɔ adansiɛ adwuma no mu.

Abasobɔde ahorow 
Wɔpaw no sɛ Afrika Adwumayɛfo Ɔbea a Ɔsen Biara wɔ afe 2014.

Wɔpaw no sɛ OBE wɔ Ɔhemmaa no 2003 Awoda Nidi din mu, na waka sɛ: "Ɛde m'ahantan kɛse sɛ me nsɛm a mede too gua wɔ me OBE ho no yɛ sɛ Society of Black Architects no guamtrani." Meyɛ ɔdansifo a meyɛ ɔsatu. Saa na meyɛ. Ɛyɛ m'abrabɔ a ɛfa adansi ho no fã." Wɔapaw no nso sɛ Royal Society of Arts no muni .

Owusu nyaa Recognition Award wɔ afe 2017 Women4Africa no mu.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Mary Chinery-Hesse
text:
Mary Chinery-Hesse, FAAS, OSG, ne Ɔbenfo a ɔhwɛ ayarefo so , née Blay (wɔwoo no 29 Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 1938 ) yɛ amanaman ntam ɔman adwumayɛfoɔ ne ɔman nanmusifoɔ a ɔsom sɛ ɔbaa a ɔdi kan wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu Chancellor, a wɔfaa no wɔ 1 Ɔbɛnem 2018. Ɔyɛ ɔbea a odi kan a ɔyɛ Amanaman Ntam Adwumayɛ Ahyehyɛde no Ɔkwankyerɛfo Panyin Abadiakyiri.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Mary Blay maa Robert Samuel Blay, na ɔyɛ mmaranimfo, mmaranimfo ne Ghana Asɛnnibea Kunini no Temmufo wɔ First Republic bere so. Na ne maame din de Dinah Blay. Ɔkɔɔ ntoaso sukuu wɔ Wesley Girls’ Senior High School a ɛwɔ Cape Coast no mu . Ɔsan nso wɔ BA (Hons) wɔ Sociology ne Economics mu, ne Doctor of Laws (honoris causa) wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu na ɔyɛɛ postgraduate ntetee wɔ Development Economics mu wɔ Dublin University .

Adwuma 
Wɔ n’adwuma mfiase no, na Mary Chinery-Hesse yɛ Ɔkyerɛwfo Panyin wɔ Sikasɛm ne Sikasɛm Nhyehyɛe Dwumadibea, ne Ɔman Sikasɛm Nhyehyɛe Bagua no Ɔkyerɛwfo. Ɔde ne ho bɔɔ UN wɔ afe 1981 mu baabi a ɔpaw Afrikani Ɔbea a odi kan a ɔte Amanaman Nkabom Nhyehyɛe no Ntamgyinafo ne UNDP Anamusini a Ɔte hɔ wɔ aman pii a nea ɛka ho ne, Sierra Leone, Tanzania, Seychelles, ne Uganda . Ɔdii Amanaman Nkabom no Boayikuo a Ɛhwɛ Dwumadie ne Dwumadie Ho Nsɛmmisa So (CCPOQ) anim fi 1993 kɔsi 1998, Amanaman Nkabom Abenfoɔ Kuo a Wɔyɛ Nnipa a Wɔagye din wɔ Nhyehyɛeɛ mu Nsakyeraeɛ ne Mmea ho na ɔboaa kɛseɛ wɔ amanneɛbɔ a wɔtintimii, Engendering Adjustment no mu. Ɔkaa Afrika Afotufo Bagua a ɛwɔ Wiase Sikakorabea no muni wɔ afe 1992 ne 1998 ntam hɔWɔ 1990 mfe no mu no, ɔyɛɛ Nnipa a Wɔagye Din Bagua a Ɛkorɔn a Ɛhwɛ Nkɔso a Wɔayɛ wɔ Dwumadi a Wɔde Di Dwuma Ma Aman a Wonnyaa Nkɔso Kɛse no Mu no guamtrani . Na ɔyɛ Afrika Aman Nkabom no Nnipa a Wɔagye Din Afotufo Kuw no muni na na ɔsom wɔ Zedillo Bagua a wɔfrɛ no kɛse sɛ Nnipa a Wɔagye Din Bagua a Wɔkorɔn a Wɔkorɔn a Ɛhwɛ Sikasɛm a Wɔde Ma Nkɔso So no mu.

Wɔ 1989 mu no, wɔpaw no sɛ ɔbea a odi kan a ɔyɛ Amanaman Ntam Adwumayɛ Ahyehyɛde no Ɔkwankyerɛfo Panyin Abadiakyiri a ɔwɔ Geneva, Switzerland . Ɔyɛɛ John Kufour a na ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔmampanyin no fotufo . Ná ɔyɛ Ɔman Nkɔso Nhyehyɛe Bagua no Titenani Abadiakyiri .

Wasom wɔ bagua ahorow pii a nea ɛka ho ne nea ɛwɔ Center for Policy Analysis ne Voluntary Fund for Technical Cooperation- UN High Commissioner for Human Rights . Na ɔyɛ Ɔpanyin nso wɔ Ɔmanfo Nnwuma Ho  mmrahyɛbagua ne Bagua a Ɛhwɛ HIV/AIDS ne Aban so wɔ Afrika no mu .

Wɔpaw no sɛ Ghana Sukuupɔn no Ɔmanpanyin . Ɔfaa saa dibea yi wɔ 1 August 2018, na odii Kofi Annan, kan UN Ɔkyerɛwfo Panyin no ade.

Chinery-Hesse Boayikuw no 
Kan Ɔmampanyin John Kufour aban a na ɛwɔ hɔ no na ɛhyɛɛ no sɛ ɔnhwɛ ɔsom mu mfaso/akatua a wɔde bɛma Ahyɛde 71 mu mpanyimfo a wɔwɔ Ahyɛde 71 no awiei.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ɔwaree Lebrecht James Chinery-Hesse (1930-2018), Ghana mmaranimfoɔ ne kan ɔman mmaranimfoɔ titire a na wayɛ amanaman ntam stints wɔ Sierra Leone, Zambia ne Uganda, na Ghana aban maa no Grand Medal . Wɔn babarima, Herman Chinery-Hesse yɛ software adwumayɛfo.

Adwuma 
Chinnery-Hesse, Mary ne afoforo. (1989) " Engendering nsakrae ma 1990 mfe no. " : amanneɛbɔ a efi Amanaman Nkabom ho abenfo kuw bi a ɛfa mmea ne nhyehyɛe mu nsakrae ho " London: Amanaman Nkabom Ɔkyerɛwfo

Agyapadeɛ 
Efi afe 2010 kosi afe 2013 no, na ɔyɛ Panel of the Wise, a ɛyɛ Afrika Aman Nkabom Kuo a ɛhwɛ Afrika Atɔeɛ fam no afotuo kuo no muni ne Zenith Bank, Ghana Boayikuo no Titenani.

Abasobɔde ne agyede a wɔde ma 
Chinery-Hesse nyaa ɔman abasobɔde a ɛkorɔn sen biara a efi Ghana hɔ a ɛne Order of the Star of Ghana wɔ John Kufour nniso ase. Wɔsan nso maa no Gusi Asomdwoeɛ Nkonimdie a ɛfa Amanaman Ntam Nkitahodiɛ ne Nnipa Mmoa Ho wɔ Manila, Philippines, wɔ 24 Ɔbɛnem 2010. Wɔ November 2021 mu no, London Sukuupɔn maa no oduruyɛfo abodin krataa a ɛyɛ nidi wɔ ne mmoa a ɔde mae wɔ ɔman adwuma mu no ho.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Nana Afia Kobi Serwaa Ampem II
text:
Nana Afia Kobi Serwaa Ampem II (1907 – 15 Ɔpɛpɔn 2016) yɛ Ɔhemmaa ɛna ( Ohemaa ) a ɔwɔ Ashanti Ahemman no mu ne mprempren Asantehene, Otumfuo Nana Osei Tutu II, a ɔyɛ ne mma baanum no babarima kumaa. Ná ɔyɛ Ashanti Ahemman no maame a ɔto so 13.

Nana Afia Kobi Serwaa Ampem II wui wɔ 15 Ɔbɛnem 2016 wɔ ne nna mu, na wadi mfeɛ 109. Ebia ɔno ne obi a ɔtraa ase kyɛ sen biara wɔ adehye abusua biara mu. Wɔsiee no anɔpatutuutu wɔ guasodeɛ a ɛdi mũ mu wɔ Breman Royal Mausoleum (Ban mu) wɔ 20 Ɔbɛnem 2017, berɛ a wɔyii ne funu firii Bantama Royal Mausoleum sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛnya atetesɛm amanneɛ a ɛtwa toɔ.

Ansa na ɔrewu no, na ɔyɛ Asantehemaa (Ɔhemmaa ɛna) wɔ Ashanti Ahemman no mu mfe 39. Ashantifo gye di sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ Ɔhemmaa ɛna a wodii kan siee no wɔ Bantama Amusiei no ne adehye nananom di kan hyia ansa na wakɔ baabi a etwa to a wɔde gye wɔn ahome no.

Asie 
Wɔde Ɔhemmaa ɛna a wawu no too ɔman no mu nnansa na wɔsiee no Dwoda, 19 Ɔbɛnem 2017. Wɔde curfew too Kumasi manfoɔ so, na ɛsɛ sɛ obiara tra dan mu firi anadwo nnɔnwɔtwe kɔsi anɔpa nnɔnnan. Otumfuo kasa ho nimdefoɔ panin Nana Osei Tutu II, Nana Nsuase Agyeman Poku Agyemang III na ɔde saa akwankyerɛ yi too gua Fida, 6 Ɔbɛnem 2017.

Gye to mu 
Wɔde ne din too Afia Kobi Serwaa Ampem Mmabaa Mmabaa Ntoaso Sukuu no din. Wɔde ne din too ɔkwan bi a ɛyɛ kurukuruwa wɔ Kumasi so.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Barbara Mensah
text:
Barbara Mensah yɛ Britania ɔtemmuni a ɔfiri Ghana . Ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔmansin temmufo a odi kan a ofi Afrika wɔ England ne Wales bere a wɔpaw no sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ Kesee Fam Apuei Ɔmansin no muni wɔ afe 2005 mu no. Ɛde besi October 2016 no ɔte Crown Court wɔ Luton, England.

Mfitiase asetra 
Wɔwoo Mensah wɔ Ghana, na ɔyɛ adwumayɛni kɛseɛ bi babaa. Ɔtenaa Ghana kosii sɛ odii mfe asia bere a otu kɔɔ United Kingdom . Ɔno ne obi a odi kan a owiee sukuupɔn fii n’abusua mu.

Nwomasua 
Mensah suaa Nyansapɛ wɔ Wales Sukuupɔn mu wɔ Swansea ansa na ɔretete ne ho sɛ ɔbɛyɛ mmaranimfo. Ɔsan nso yɛ obi a wawie City University London ne Queen Mary University London, a ne nyinaa wɔ London.

Adwuma 
Wɔfrɛɛ Mensah kɔɔ Bar a ɛwɔ Lincoln’s Inn wɔ 1984 mu. Wɔ n’adwuma no mfiase no ɔde ne ho hyɛɛ ankorankoro adwumayɛbea adwuma mu na afei ɔkɔɔ so traa Sikasɛm ho Asɛnnibea. N’ani begyee atemmu adwuma foforo ho. Wɔpaw no sɛ obi a ɔkyere nnwom gu kasɛt so wɔ afe 2003 mu. Wɔpaw no sɛ ɔmansin temmufo wɔ South Eastern Circuit wɔ afe 2005 mu na mprempren (2016) ɔyɛ ɔmansin temmufo wɔ Luton Crown Court, ɔbea a odi kan a ofi Afrika a onyaa saa dibea no. City, University of London maa no juris Doctor abodin krataa wɔ afe 2015 mu de kyerɛɛ ne mmoa a ɔde ama mmara adwuma no.

Mensah asi hia a ɛhia sɛ wɔhunu mmaa a wɔn ho akokwa ne nnipa nketewa foforɔ wɔ benkyi so sɛ wɔbɛyɛ nhwɛsoɔ ama mmaranimfoɔ, na waka sɛ "sɛdeɛ ɛho hia paa ma ɔmanfoɔ - ɔmanfoɔ nyinaa - sɛ wɔbɛhunu sɛ atemmuo a egu ahodoɔ wɔ hɔ no, ɛte saa nso ho hia ma adwuma no".

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Sophia Oboshie Doku
text:
Sophia Oboshie Doku yɛ Ghana ɔbea amanyɔni na ɔyɛ mmea  mmrahyɛbaguani a wodii kan wɔ Ghana Ɔmanpanyin a Edi Kan no  mmrahyɛbagua a Edi Kan no mu wɔ Ghana Ɔmampanyin a odi kan Dr Kwame Nkrumah ase no mu biako .

Nwomasua

Na Doku yɛ amammuifoɔ a ɔsom wɔ dibea ahodoɔ ase na ɔyɛ Independent aperepereɛ adwumayɛfoɔ no mu baako.
