title: Rose Mensah-Kutin
text:
Dr Rose Mensah-Kutin (wɔwoo no 22 November 1955) yɛ Ghanani a ɔkamfo ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho asɛm na ɔyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a ɔyɛ adwumaden. Ɛde besi October 2016 no, ɔyɛ West Africa Regional director ma ABANTU for Development.

Mfitiase asetra 
Wɔwoo no na wɔtetee no wɔ Brofoyedru, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Adans Anafoɔ mantam mu wɔ Ashanti mantam mu wɔ Ghana, na ɔyɛ koko ne kɔfe kuafoɔ.

Nwomasua 
Bere bi na Ɔbenfo Mensah-Kutin yɛ Brofoyedru Mfinimfini ne United Methodist Mfinimfini Sukuu sukuuni. Owiee Accra Mmabaa Ntoaso Sukuu na akyiri yi ɔkɔɔ Aggrey Memorial Zion Ntoaso Sukuu kɔyɛɛ ne adesua a ɛto so asia. Owiee Bachelor’s degree wɔ Borɔfo ne Abakɔsɛm mu 1978 wɔ Ghana Sukuupɔn mu na ɔsan kɔɔ hɔ yɛɛ master’s degree wɔ Mass Communication mu fii sukuupɔn koro no ara mu wɔ afe a edi hɔ no mu. Ɔwɔ abodin krataa a ɛto so abien wɔ Asetra mu Adesua Asoɛe, The Hague, ne PhD wɔ Bɔbeasu ne Ahoɔden Ho Adesua mu wɔ Birmingham Sukuupɔn mu, UK .

Adwuma 
Mfiase wɔ n’adwuma mu no, ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ samufo boafo ma Daily Graphic wɔ Ghana bere a ɔne no hyehyɛɛ Network for Women’s Rights wɔ Ghana wɔ afe 1999 mu akyi bere tiaa bi. Bere bi na ɔyɛ Social Impact Assessment officer wɔ Ghana Ministry of Mines and Energy. Ɔte The Netherlands-based International Gender and Energy Network (ENERGIA) ne Afrika Mmea Nkɔso Foto a ɛwɔ Accra, Ghana no baguafo mu .  Mprempren ɔyɛ West Africa Regional director ma ABANTU for Development, amanaman ntam ahyehyɛde a ɛnyɛ aban de a ɛma mmea tumi denam akannifo ntetee a wɔde ma wɔ nkɔso a ɛtra hɔ daa mu.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ɔware Ɔbenfo Kwame Karikari a ɔwɔ mma baanan.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Theo Sowa
text:
Theo Sowa CBE (wɔwoo no afe 1957) yɛ ɔfotufo a ɔde ne ho a wɔwoo no wɔ Ghana a ɔreyɛ adwuma wɔ amanaman ntam nsɛm ahodoɔ pii a ɔde n’adwene si asetena mu nkɔsoɔ ho nsɛm so na wakasa wɔ baguam wɔ asetena mu amammuisɛm ho nsɛm dodoɔ bi ho. Ɔne ahyehyɛde ahorow bi a UNICEF, Stephen Lewis Foundation, African Union, DfID, ne UNDP, ne afoforo ayɛ adwuma na mprempren ɔyɛ Afrika Mmea Nkɔso Foto no panyin. Nea ɛka n’adwuma no ho ne sɛ ɔne Graça Machel bɛyɛ adwuma wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa mmabun ho ne nhoma dodow bi a ɔde bɛboa na wasiesie. Ɔsan yɛ Comic Relief adwumakuw no sohwɛfo . Wɔ June 2010 mu no, wɔpaw Sowa sɛ Ɔsahene wɔ Order of the British Empire (CBE) so.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Sowa wɔ Cape Coast, Ghana, wɔ afe 1957 mu, na ɔde ne mmofraase wɔ United States of America . Wɔ 1967 mu no, ɔde ne din kɔhyɛɛ Blessed Sacrament Convent a ɛwɔ Brighton, England, na akyiri yi ɔkɔɔ so bɛyɛɛ Abeawa Panyin wɔ St Leonards-Mayfield Sukuu a ɛwɔ Mayfield, Sussex .

Esiane n’agya adwuma nti, ɔtenaa Afrika aman ahodoɔ so, Europa, Asia, ne USA nso. Ne saa nti, onyaa mmusua mu nyiyim, ɔbarima ne ɔbea ntam nyiyim, nyiyim ne animtiaabu wɔ ne mmofraase pɛɛ. Nanso, ɛte sɛ nea eyinom hyɛɛ n’akannifo ho nimdeɛ a ɛkɔ so hyɛ n’asetra ne n’adwuma agyirae no mu den ara kwa. Wɔ 17 Ayɛwohomumɔ 2015 no, ɔkasa tiaa Nigeria Aban a ɛyɛ brɛoo wɔ Chibok mmabaa 219 a Boko Haram kyeree wɔn wɔ 14–15 Ayɛwohomumɔ 2014 no a wɔgyaee wɔn no ho. Ɔfrɛɛ Muhammadu Buhari, Nigeria Ɔmampanyin a ɔredi tumi mprempren no sɛ ɔnyɛ ade ntɛm wɔ ɔko a ɔbɛko atia atuatew ne mmeawa no a wobegyae wɔn no mu.

Sowa kɔɔ Afrika ne Asia Adesua Sukuu wɔ Sussex Sukuupɔn mu fi 1977 kosi 1980, na onyaa abodin krataa wɔ amanaman ntam abusuabɔ mu . Wɔ sukuupɔn no mu no, na n’ani gye mmea hokwan ahorow, pɛyɛ ne atɛntrenee ho. Sukuupɔn akyi no Sowa dii saa anigye yi akyi na ɔdii "The Lady In Purple" wɔ Ntozake Shange agodie For Colored Girls Who Have Considered Suicide / When the Rainbow is Enuf mu. Wɔhwɛɛ sini no mu yiye na wogye toom. Akyiri yi Sowa nyaa abodin krataa a ɛkorɔn wɔ nhomasua a wɔde toto nneɛma ho mu wɔ Institute of Education, University of London, fi 1986 kosi 1988.

Adwuma 
Ɔsan nso de ne ho hyɛɛ television mu a wayɛ adwuma wɔ BBC, ITV ne Channel Four Television (1988–1991) mu a ɔde asetra mu nsɛm kyerɛ na ɔbɔɔ amanneɛ. Ɔsom sɛ amanneɛbɔfo ne ɔyɛkyerɛfo wɔ dwumadi ahorow mu, a nea ɛka ho ne Mmoa, Abusua Nsɛm, Never on A Sunday, ne nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw ne dwumadi ahorow pii. Ɔyɛɛ nkɔsoɔ sohwɛfoɔ a ɔhwɛ nkɔsoɔ so Ɔman Fekuo a ɛhwɛ Mmaratofoɔ a Wɔhwɛ wɔn ne Wɔn a Wɔsan De Wɔn Kɔtena, NACRO (1985–1987). Sowa ayɛ ITV Telethon mmoa a wɔde ma kuw no muni (1990/91), wɔapaw no sɛ Duke of Edinburgh mpanyimfo bagua no muni ne Rainer Foundation mpanyimfo bagua no muni (1990/1993) ne ahotoso/adwumakuo no muni ma Conciliation Resources, a NGO a wosiesie ntawntawdi (1995/2005). Wɔ 1992 mu no, saa bere no Ɔman Ɔkyerɛwfo a ɔhwɛ Nhomasua so John Patten paw no sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ UK Ɔman Mmabun Dwumadibea no baguafo, dibea a ogyaee adwuma bere a otu kɔɔ South Africa kɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ Commonwealth Ɔkyerɛwfo Dwumadibea no Mfiridwuma Ho Afotufo kuw no fã wɔ ɔman no mu South Africa abatow a edi kan a mmusuakuw ahorow pii wom.

Sowa yɛɛ adwuma sɛ amanaman ntam ɔfotufo mfe pii, na ɔboaa ahyehyɛde ahorow a agye din te sɛ UNICEF, Stephen Lewis Foundation, African Union, Department for International Development, ne UNDP, ne afoforo. Na ɔyɛ African Grantmakers Network no guamtrani nso. Na ɔsan nso yɛ nhyehyɛe ho ɔfotufo panyin wɔ UN Adesua a Ɛfa Mmofra ne Akode Ho Nkodi Ho (Machel Amanneɛbɔ) ho na odii anim wɔ mfe anum nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛe wɔ amanneɛbɔ no mu no ho. Wɔ saa dibea yi mu no, ɔde abusuabɔ sii hɔ na ɔboa ma wɔyɛɛ nhyehyɛe kaa ɔman ne amanaman ntam NGO ahorow, aban ahorow a ɛwɔ nsasepɔn anum no so ne wɔn ananmusifo a wɔwɔ New York wɔ UN adwumayɛbea ahorow no nkyɛn. Odii nkitahodi ahorow anim, mfiridwuma ne amammuisɛm nyinaa, de dii amanneɛbɔ no nyansahyɛ ahorow a ɛfa mmofra a wɔakyere wɔn wɔ ntawntawdi mu ne amanaman ntam NGO ahorow, UN nnwumakuw a ɛfa ho, UN amammui ahyehyɛde ahorow ne aban ananmusifo mpanyimfo a wɔwɔ UN no ho dwuma. Ne ho a ɔde hyɛɛ mmofra nsɛm mu no maa wɔpaw no sɛ Ɔmampanyin Nelson Mandela ne Awuraa Graça Machel fotufo wɔ wɔn adwuma a wɔyɛe wɔ mmofra ne akannifo nsɛm ho maa Wiase Nyinaa Mmofra Kuw no.

Adwuma a ɛkɔ so 
Sowa yɛ Afrika Mmea Nkɔso Foto no panyin . Ɔsan yɛ ɔfotufo ne ɔfotufo a ɔde ne ho, a ne ho akokwaw wɔ amanaman ntam asetra mu nkɔso mu a osi mmofra hokwan ne ahobammɔ ho nsɛm so dua titiriw.

Sowa yɛ Comic Relief, ne Comic Relief Amanaman Ntam Mmoa Boayikuw no guamtrani, ɔyɛ Stephen Lewis Foundation no Afrika Afotufo Bagua no muni, Britania Aguanfo Bagua no Akannifo Boayikuw no muni, ɔyɛ Adanse ho ɔboafo ma Nkɔso ne Graça Machel Trust no baguafo panyin. Sowa wɔ baguam paw sɛ Charity Commission for England and Wales no baguafo .

Abasobɔde ne agyede a wɔde ma 
Wɔpaw no sɛ Britania Ahemman no Ahyehyɛde (CBE) no Sahene wɔ afe 2010 Ɔhemmaa Awoda Nidi mu .

Nhoma ahorow 

 Ɔkyerɛwfo a ɔboaa, Mmofra ne Nsakrae Atɛntrenee
 Ɔkyerɛwfo a ɔboaa, Nkɛntɛnso a Ɔko Nya wɔ Mmofra So ; a ɔne Graca Machel kyerɛwee
 Ɔyɛ Harvard Mmara Sukuu/UNICEF Innocenti nhoma bi, ‘Mmofra ne Nsakrae Atɛntrenee’ no samufo.
 Ɔkyerɛwfo a ɔka ho a ɔkyerɛw ‘Groupwork and IT’, ntetee nhoma a wɔde ma adwumayɛfo a wɔne mmerante ne mmabaa.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Meri Nana-Ama Danquah
text:
Meri Nana-Ama Danquah (wɔwoo no 13 September 1967) yɛ Ghana-Amerikani ɔkyerɛwfo, samufo, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo ne baguam ɔkasafo, a ne din wɔ awo mu ne Mildred Mary Nana-Ama Boakyewaa Brobby . Wonim no yiye wɔ ne 1998 nkae nhoma Willow Weep for Me: A Black Woman’s Journey Through Depression . N'asɛm tiawa "Bere a Ɔbarima Dɔ Ɔbaa" no, wɔpaw no tiawa maa 2022 AKO Caine Nkonimdi a ɛfa Afrika Akyerɛw ho .

Nkwa 
Wɔwoo Danquah wɔ Accra, Ghana, na ne maame ne Josephine Nana Korantemaa Danquah ne Norbert Duke Brobby. Ne maame nana ne Ɔbenfo J. B. Danquah, ɔkyerɛwfo ne Ghana amammui mu nipa a wagye din, na na ɔyɛ odiyifo Paul Danquah, a wakyerɛw ne ho asɛm wɔ The Washington Post mu no wɔfase.

Danquah tu kɔɔ United States bere a na wadi mfe asia no ne ne maame a na otu kɔɔ hɔ mfe abiɛsa a atwam ni kɔtena Howard Sukuupɔn . N’awofo gyaee aware mfe asia akyi, na wɔtetew mu bere a Danquah dii mfe 11. Bere a na ɔkɔ Foxcroft, sukuu a mmeawa nyinaa te mu a ɛwɔ Middleburg, Virginia, no, Danquah sii gyinae sɛ ɔbɛsesa ne din afi Mildred Brobby ayɛ no Meri Danquah. : 1 . 130 na ɛwɔ hɔ Bere a ogyaee Maryland Sukuupɔn no, awiei koraa no otu kɔɔ Los Angeles bere a na wadi mfe 20. : 27. Ɔde ne nsa kyerɛɛ ne so 

Danquah woo ne babaa wɔ afe 1991 mu, : 39. Ɔde ne nsa kyerɛɛ ne so na wɔne Danquah adamfo abarimaa a na ɔwɔ hɔ saa bere no ne ne babea no agya tenaa. Bere a ɔde ahyɛde a ɛbɛma ne babea no papa agyina ofie basabasayɛ so akɔdan no akyi no, : 41. Ɔde ne nsa kyerɛɛ ne so Danquah ne ne babea san tu kɔɔ Washington DC, faako a na n’awofo ne ne nuabea da so ara te no. Bere a na ɔwɔ DC no, Danquah hui sɛ ɔwɔ adwenemhaw a ɛwɔ ayaresabea, yare a ɛbɛyɛ nea obegyina so ayɛ ne nkae nhoma Willow Weep for Me: A Black Woman’s Journey Through Depression, a wotintimii wɔ 1998 mu ma ɛkamfoo no kɛse.  Wotintim nhoma no mu nsɛm bi wɔ nhoma a wɔaboaboa ano a wɔato din Out of Her Mind: Women Writing on Madness . Ɔman Adwene ne Nkate Ho Akwahosan Fekuw no paw Danquah sɛ wɔn Campaign on Clinical Depression, a nhyehyɛe a wɔde sii Afrikafo-Amerikafo mmea so titiriw no kasamafo.

Wɔ afe 1999 mu no, Danquah nyaa ne Master of Fine Arts abodin krataa wɔ Adebɔ Akyerɛw ne Nkyerɛwee mu, na ɔde n’adwene sii Adebɔ a Ɛnyɛ Ayɛsɛm so, fii Bennington College, ɛmfa ho sɛ wanwie abodin krataa a edi kan da. Wakyerɛ ade wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu, wɔ Otis College of Art and Design, ne Antioch College MFA nhyehyɛe mu, na wɔhwehwɛ no sɛ ɔkasafo ne ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo.

Ɔsan nso asiesie mmea nkyerɛwee a wɔaboaboa ano, a Shaking the Tree: A Collection of New Fiction and Memoir by Black Women (2003) ka ho, a Maya Angelou kaa ho asɛm wɔ asɛm bi a ɔkae wɔ anim asɛm bi mu sɛ: "Ms. Danquah awosow nhoma dua bi ampa." Aduaba a ɛhwee ase no bɛma akenkanfo aduan akyɛ. . . ." 

Wɔ afe 2011 mu no, Danquah de too gua sɛ ɔreyɛ ayɛsɛm bi. Ɔakyerɛw nsɛm ne nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw wɔ nhoma ahorow a The Washington Post, The Village Voice, The Los Angeles Times, Allure, Essence, The Africa Report ne The Daily Graphic ka ho mu . Ɔyɛ Afrikafo nhoma ne amammerɛ ho samufo panyin wɔ Los Angeles Review of Books .

Ɔyɛ obi a ɔboaa 2019 nhoma a wɔaboaboa ano New Daughters of Africa, a Margaret Busby na ɔhyehyɛɛ no, a ɔde nkae nhoma "Saying Goodbye to Mary Danquah".

Wɔ June 2022 mu no, wɔde n'asɛm "When a Man Loves a Woman", a mfiase no wotintimii wɔ Accra Noir, no too gua wɔ Caine Prize for African Writing, no din tiawa mu na Doreen Baingana kaa ho asɛm wɔ Brittle Paper mu sɛ "ɛyɛ anigye." asiane, abotɔyam ne ahintasɛm a ɛwɔ ɔdɔ mu ho adesua".

Nhoma ahorow a wɔahyehyɛ

Sɛ ɔkyerɛwfo no 
Willow Su Ma Me: Ɔbea Abibifo Akwantu a Ɔfa Adwenemhaw Mu, W. W. Norton & Company, 1998, 1998.

Sɛ́ samufo no 

 Dua no Wosow: Ayɛsɛm ne Nkaesɛm Foforo a Wɔaboaboa Ano a Mmea Abibifo kyerɛwee, W. W. Norton, 2003, 2003. 
 Nipadua Tuntum no, Nsɛm Ason Press, 2009, 2009. 
 Amerikani a Wɔbɛyɛ: Ankorankoro Nsɛm a Awo Ntoatoaso a Edi Kan Mmea Atubrafo Kyerɛw, Hyperion Books, 2000, 2000. 
 Amerikani Ɔbaa: Ankorankoro Nkyerɛwee a Awo Ntoatoaso a Edi Kan Mmea Atubrafo kyerɛwee (Expanded Second Edition), Seven Stories Press, 2012, 2012.

title: Zanetor Agyeman-Rawlings
text:
Zanetor (wɔbɔ no Zɑ-nɛ-tɔ) Agyeman-Rawlings (Dr.) (wɔwoo no June 1, 1978) yɛ Ghana aduruyɛ ho oduruyɛfo ne ɔmanyɔni a ɔyɛ Ɔmampanyin a ɔto so 1 wɔ Ghana Republic a ɛto so 4 ase no babea panyin Jerry Rawlings ( 1993–2001) ne kan ɔbea a odi kan Nana Konadu Agyeman (1993–2001). Ɔyɛ Ghana  mmrahyɛbagua no muni ma Klottey-Korle Mansin na ɔyɛ aduruyɛ ho oduruyɛfo ne nnipa mmoa ho ɔbenfo.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Agyeman-Rawlings wɔ 1 June 1978 wɔ Accra, Ghana wɔ West Africa . Ɔfiri Dzelukope a ɛwɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔkɔɔ North Ridge Lyceum sukuu ne Achimota Sukuu maa ne mfitiaseɛ nwomasua. Afei owiee Wesley Mmabaa Ntoaso Sukuu a ɛwɔ Cape Coast wɔ 1996 mu.

Esiane sɛ na ne papa wɔ amammui asɛnka agua so nti, bere a na ɔyɛ abofra no, Zanetor de ne bere dodow no ara ne ne maame, kan ɔbea a odi kan, Nana Konadu Agyeman Rawlings . Zanetor kɔɔ Royal College of Surgeons a ɛwɔ Ireland no kɔyɛɛ n’aduruyɛ ho abodin krataa. Ɔsan nso wɔ adansedie nkrataa wɔ ahobammɔ ho dwumadie ne ntawntawdie ne ɔhaw ho dwumadie mu firi Ghana Armed Forces Command and Staff College .

Adwuma

Aduruyɛ mu adwuma 
Agyeman-Rawlings yɛɛ adwuma sɛ oduruyɛfo wɔ ayaresabea a wɔhwɛ ayarefo nyinaa mu wɔ n’adwuma mfiase. Ɔde ne ho ahyɛ fapem ne nnwuma ahorow a ɛbɔ mmea ne mmofra hokwan ne ahotew a ɛkɔ anim wɔ Ghana no mu.

Nnipa mmoa adwuma 
Agyeman-Rawlings adi anim wɔ mmoa mmɔdenbɔ ahorow mu de abrɛ amanehunu a nnipa pii a tebea bi ayɛ wɔn ayayade no ase. Wɔ June 2015 mu no, ɔdii kuw bi anim ma wɔde mmoa nneɛma maeɛ maa wɔn a Goil Oil gya ne nsuyiriɛ asiane a ɛkunkum Ghanafoɔ bɛyɛ 150 na ɛmaa nnipa pii tu fii wɔn afie mu no. Ɔsan nso sii bridge maa Osu Anorhor mpɔtam hɔfo a aboa ma nsuyiri ne akwantuo a ɛnyɛ den wɔ mpɔtam hɔ ho asɛm no so ate. Wɔ Oforisuo, 2014 mu no, na Ɔbenfoɔ Rawlings yɛ ɔhɔhoɔ titire wɔ Afrika Mmea Nhyiamu soronko a ɛwɔ crans-Montana Forum on Africa ne South-South Cooperation a ɛwɔ Dakhla no nhyehyɛeɛ mu, a na ne botaeɛ ne sɛ ɛbɛhyɛ wiase a nnipa ne animhwɛ nni mu kɛseɛ ho nkuran .

Amanyɔsɛm 
Na Agyeman-Rawlings akɔ so atra amammuisɛm mu asɛm titiriw no akyi wɔ n’asetra fa kɛse no ara mu. Wɔ June 2015 mu, berɛ a na ɔresom sɛ Ɔnanmusifoɔ ama TV3 sika a wɔboaboa ano ɔsatuo, "TV3 June 3 Disaster Support Fund", a na wɔn botaeɛ ne sɛ wɔbɛboaboa sika ano de aboa wɔn a nsuyiri ne ogya asiane a ɛsiiɛ wɔ June 3 no mu no, amanneɛbɔ bi wɔ hɔ a ɛkyerɛe sɛ ɔde ne mmoa mmɔdenbɔ no redi dwuma de afi amammui ɔsatu bi ase. Ɔpoo amanneɛbɔ ahorow no a ɔkae sɛ ne dwumadi ahorow a ɔyɛe wɔ adapɛn no mu no gyinaa sika a ɔbɛboaboa ano ama wɔn a asiane no ato wɔn no so.

mmrahyɛbagua no mu mmɔdenbɔ 
Wɔ September 11, 2015 no, Ɔbenfoɔ Agyeman-Rawlings de ne din kɔeɛ sɛ ɔnkɔsi akan wɔ Korle Klottey  mmrahyɛbagua primaries no mu sɛ  mmrahyɛbagua no muni, na ɔne Korle Klottey MP a ɔwɔ hɔ seesei Nii Armah Ashitey ne Leeford Kpakpo Quarshie tuu mmirika.

Bere a wɔde ne din ahorow no kɔe no, ɔkɔɔ so kae sɛ na onni amammui mu atirimpɔw biara da na ne gyinaesi sɛ obesi akan no yɛ nnansa yi ara. Sɛnea ɔkyerɛ no, na ne ho a ɔde hyɛɛ mu no gyina ɔfrɛ a nnipa pii de mae sɛ wɔmfa wɔn ho nhyɛ amammuisɛm mu, a efii n’ahotew ɔsatu ne nneɛma afoforo a atwa yɛn ho ahyia ho adwuma mu bae no so. Efi saa bere no, ne papa a na anka ɔyɛ ɔmampanyin no apene ne babea no gyinaesi no so.

mmrahyɛbagua no muni 
Ɔdii nkonim wɔ 10 November 2015 primaries maa Korley Klottey constituency wɔ Greater Accra Region na ɔkɔɔ so dii nkonim wɔ 2016 Ghana amansan abatoɔ a wɔyɛɛ no 7 December 2016. Mprempren ɔyɛ Klottey Korle Mantam no MP. Ɔsom wɔ Bɔbeasu ne Mmofra Boayikuw ne Nneɛma a Atwa Yɛn Ho Ahyia, Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma Boayikuw no mu. Ɔkuraa n’akongua so Wɔ afe 2020 amansan abatoɔ no mu.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Zanetor Agyeman-Rawlings wɔ mma mmiɛnsa.

Hwɛ nso 

 Nana Konadu Agyeman Rawlings a ɔyɛ ɔbarima a ɔyɛ ɔdefo.
 Jerry John Rawlings na ɔkyerɛwee

title: Genevive Delali Tsegah
text:
Genevive Delali Tsegah (wɔwoo no 8 Ɔbɛnem 1951) yɛ Ghana ɔmanpanyin.

Nwomasua 
Wɔ afe 1976 mu no, Tsegah wiee abodin krataa wɔ Nnɛyi Kasa mu wɔ Ghana Sukuupɔn mu, na ɛno akyi no onyaa abodin krataa wɔ Amanaman Ntam Abusuabɔ mu wɔ Nairobi Sukuupɔn mu wɔ afe 1982 mu.

Adwuma 
Tsegah kɔkaa aman ntam nkitahodi adwuma no ho wɔ afe 1977 mu, sɛ ɔman dwumayɛni wɔ Amammerɛ Dwumadibea a ɛwɔ Amannɔne Nsɛm Ho Dwumadibea no mu, na odii dwuma kosii 1981 mu. Efi 1982 kosi 1983 no na ɔyɛ ɔpanyin wɔ Mfinimfini Apuei ne Asia Dwumadibea, na saa bere no na ɔwɔ Amannɔne Nsɛm Ho Dwumadibea, kosii 1985. Wɔ 1988 mu no, ɔfaa adwuma afe biako wɔ Amerika dwumadibea hɔ, ansa na ɔrebɛyɛ  mmrahyɛbagua no muni wɔ Paris, faako a ɔtraa hɔ mfe anan a edi hɔ no. Wɔ afe 1993 mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ Sikasɛm, Aguadi ne Sikasɛm Dwumadibea no Ɔkwankyerɛfo Abadiakyiri, kosii 1996, bere a otu kɔɔ Cotonou, Benin, faako a ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ ɔfotufo na ɔsan nso yɛɛ adwuma sohwɛfo fi 1997 kosi 1998. Efi afe 2000 kɔsi afe 2002 no, na ɔyɛ Dwumadibea a ɛhwɛ Sikasɛm, Aguadi ne Sikasɛm so no Titenani, ansa na ɔresom mfeɛ nnan sɛ ɔnanmusifoɔ wɔ Ouagadougou, Burkina Faso (2002–06). Afei ɔsan bae bɛyɛɛ Amannɔne Nsɛm Ho Dwumadibea no Sikasɛm, Aguadi ne Sikasɛm Dwumadibea no kwankyerɛfo mfe abien bio.

Efi afe 2008 kosi afe 2009 no na ɔyɛ Daa Ɔnanmusifo no ananmusifo wɔ Amanaman Nkabom Asafo Ti a ɛwɔ New York Kuropɔn mu . Efi 15 Ɔbɛnem 2010 kɔsi 14 Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 2014 na ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanyin wɔ Paris, na UNESCO ne Ahemman Kronkron no gyee no toom .

title: Sylvia Boye
text:
Sylvia Boye yɛ Ghanani bea, kan Adwumayɛni Panyin ne ɔbea a odi kan a ɔyɛ Ɔkyerɛwfo wɔ West African Examination Council .

title: Melody Millicent Danquah
text:
Melody Millicent Danquah (6 Ɔbɛnem 1937 – 18 Ɔpɛpɔn 2016) yɛ Ghana wimhyɛnkafoɔ na ɔyɛ ɔbaa wimhyɛnkafoɔ a ɔdi kan wɔ Ghana ne saa ara nso na ɔyɛ wɔn a wɔdii kan wɔ Afrika no mu baako. Ɔdii Lotfia Elnadi anammɔn akyi a na ɔyɛ Misrini ɔbaa a ɔdi kan ne ɔbaa a ɔdi kan a ɔfiri Afrika a ɔnyaa wimhyɛnkafoɔ tumi krataa wɔ 27 September 1933.

Mfitiase asetra 
Wɔwoo Melody Danquah wɔ Larteh Akuapem, wɔ 6 Ɔbɛnem 1937 maa Ibinijah Rexford Addo-Danquah, a na ɔyɛ Asɛnnibea Ɔkyerɛwfo ne Ɔtemmufo a wagye din wɔ Larteh. Ná ne maame de Selina Gyamfi. Ná Melody yɛ anuanom 10 no mu nea ɔto so asia.

Nwomasua 
Danquah suaa ade wɔ Methodist Mfitiase ne Mfinimfini sukuu ahorow a ɛwɔ Larteh ne Wesley Girls Ntoaso Sukuu a ɛwɔ Cape Coast no mu . Na ɔyɛ Aban Ɔkyerɛwfo Sukuu no nso ade.

Adwuma 
Wɔpaw no kaa mmea baasa a wodii kan wɔ afe 1963 awiei a wɔtetee wɔn kɔɔ Ghana Wim Asraafo mu sɛ wimhyɛnkafo. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ abasobɔdeɛ no ne asraafoɔ nteteeɛ titire a ɛdi akyire wɔ Ghana Asraafoɔ Adesuabea. Wɔ June 22, 1964 mu no, Flt. Cadet Danquah de wimhyɛn a ɔno nkutoo tuu wimhyɛn nea edi kan wɔ de Havilland Canada DHC-1 Chipmunk wimhyɛn mu, na ɔbɛyɛɛ Ghanani a odi kan a ɔno nkutoo tu wimhyɛn. Ɔnyaa ne Wings a ɛma ɔfata sɛ wimhyɛnkafoɔ firii Kofi Baako a na ɔyɛ Ɔman Bammɔ sohwɛfoɔ wɔ 15 April 1965. Owiee ne wimhyɛn adwuma no wɔ June 1968 mu na ofii ase yɛɛ adwumayɛfo adwuma wɔ Asraafo no mu. Wɔ 1984 mu no, woyii no fii ayaresabea esiane sɛnea n’akwahosan te nti. Onyaa Ɔsom Bere Tenten abasobɔde ne The Efficiency Medal.

Asetra wɔ ɔsom a ɛyɛ nnam akyi 
Bere a ogyaee sraadi no, ɔyɛɛ adwuma maa Wiase Nyinaa Aduan Dwumadibea no bere tiaa bi na afei ɔyɛɛ adwuma maa Ɔman Ɔsom Ɔkyerɛwfo Dwumadibea. Bere a odii mfe 60 no, onyaa Diploma wɔ Bible Adesua ne Nyamekyerɛ mu na ofii ase kaa asɛm no kyerɛɛ asraafo atiefo. Akyiri yi ɔde ne ho kɔbɔɔ Ghana Asoɛe a ɛhwɛ adwumayɛ ne ɔmanfo so no so.

Aseda a wɔde ma 
Owurayere na ɔkaa ne ho asɛm. Rebeca Akufo-Addo, Ghana ababaa a ɔdi kan wɔ afe 2017 Amanaman Ntam Mmea Da afahyɛ no mu sɛ ɔyɛ nhyɛsoɔ ma mmaa. Wɔde The Companion of the Order of the Volta hyɛɛ no anuonyam wɔ afe 2006 mu, a Ɔmampanyin John Kufuor de mae sɛ ɔyɛ obi a ɔwɔ akokoduru a ɔde mmirika tu mmirika.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Patricia Mawuli Nyekodzi
text:
Patricia Mawuli Nyekodzi (wɔwoo no afe 1988) yɛ ɔbaa a ɔdi kan a ɔwɔ Ghanani a ɔwɔ tumi krataa, wimhyɛn mfiridwumayɛfo, ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo ne ɔtetefo na ɔno nko ara ne ɔbaa a ɔfata sɛ ɔyɛ Rotax Aircraft Engines .

Mfitiase asetra 
Mawuli nyinii wɔ atɛkyɛ dan bi mu wɔ Mepe, nkuraase akuraa ketewa bi a ɛwɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ Ghana . Onyaa wimhyɛn ho dɔ bere a ɔde mfe pii hwɛɛ wimhyɛn a ɛretwam wɔ soro no.

Bere a Mawuli dii mfe 19 no, ɔkɔɔ Kpong Wimhyɛn Gyinabea kɔhwehwɛɛ adwuma nanso wimhyɛn gyinabea no mfiridwuma ho ɔkwankyerɛfo, Jonathan Porter powee. Ɔde no yɛɛ adwuma sɛ ɔmfa nwura ntwa sukuu no ho nhyia na ɔtwe nnua a wɔde ayɛ nnua fi wimhyɛn kwan no so, bere a ɔde ne som mae kwa no. Mawuli de ahokokwaw twitwaa nnua no, na ɛkyerɛɛ sɛnea otumi yɛ nhwehwɛmu de hu ɔkwan a etu mpɔn sen biara a wɔfa so yi nnua no. Porter huu ahokokwaw koro no ara bere a ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ ɔmmoa no wɔ wimhyɛn bi a ɔreboaboa ano mu no. Mawuli tumi a otumi sua ade ntɛmntɛm, onim ahokokwaw ne nnwinnade a wɔde yɛ wimhyɛn no yiye no maa Porter maa no adwuma a wotua ho ka sɛ n’asuafo na ɔkyerɛɛ no wimhyɛn.

wɔ afe 2015 mu no, Patricia ne ne kunu tu kɔɔ Wales baabi a wɔboom hyehyɛɛ wimhyɛn mfiridwuma adwuma foforɔ wɔ Haverfordwest Wimhyɛn Gyinabea.

Nnansa yi ara wɔmaa Patricia OBE.

Adwuma 
Mawuli bɛyɛɛ Ghana ɔbaa a ɔdi kan a ɔyɛ ɔmanfoɔ wimhyɛnkafoɔ wɔ afe 2009 mu. Ɔsan nso yɛ Afrikani abibifo a odi kan a wanya adansedi krataa sɛ ɔyɛ Rotax Aircraft Engines, ne ɔbea a odi kan wɔ Afrika Atɔe fam a wanya adansedi krataa sɛ ɔnyɛ Rotax engine ahorow na ɔhwɛ so.

Porter ne Mawuli hyehyɛɛ wimhyɛn sukuu, Aviation and Technology Academy Ghana, a wɔfrɛ no AvTech, wɔ afe 2010 mfitiaseɛ a ɔtetee mmabaa baanan afe biara. Wɔatete mmeawa no ma wɔayɛ wimhyɛn a emu yɛ hare yiye na wɔahwɛ so, wimhyɛn ho akwankyerɛ, wimhyɛn gyinabea dwumadi, robɔt mfiridwuma ne kɔmputa. Bere a ɔde n’ankasa akatua hyɛ sukuu no mu no, ɔde n’adwene si mmeawa a wofi nkuraase a anka ebia wɔrennya nhomasua hokwan ahorow no kyerɛkyerɛ so.

Mawuli bɛyɛɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ wɔ Kpong Airfield baabi a ɔkyerɛɛ adeɛ wɔ AvTech. Wɔ afe 2013 mu no, wɔpaw no sɛ adwumayɛfoɔ panin wɔ Operations for Kpong Airfield. Mawuli yɛ wimhyɛnkafoɔ sɛ obi a ɔtu ne ho ma ne Medicine on the Move, ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛne Aviation Academy yɛ adwuma bom de nnuruyɛfoɔ kɔ, de aduruyɛ ho nneɛma ne nnwuma, ne akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ma nkuraasefoɔ wɔ Ghana tenten ne ne tɛtrɛtɛ nyinaa. Ɛtɔ mmere bi a na ɔhwe ase. nhomasua nhomawa ahorow a ɛfa nkuraa a ɛwɔ akyirikyiri ho.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Lucy Quist
text:
Lucy Quist, née Afriyie, (wɔwoo no bɛyɛ c. 1974) yɛ Ghana-Britania adwumayɛfo ne mfiridwuma sohwɛfoɔ. Ɔyɛ Morgan Stanley kwankyerɛfo panyin

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Lucy Quist wɔ London maa n’awofo a wofi Ghanafo, Peter ne Mary Afriyie, na ɔde ne mfe a ɔde yɛɛ ne su wɔ Europa ne Afrika nyinaa. Ɔkɔɔ Wesley Mmabaa Ntoaso Sukuu a ɛwɔ Cape Coast na ɔkɔɔ kɔlege a ɛto so asia wɔ Presbyterian Boys’ Senior High School . Ɔkɔɔ so suaa ade wɔ East London Sukuupɔn mu, na owiee sukuu no nyaa abodin krataa a edi kan a ɛyɛ nidi wɔ Electrical and Electronic Engineering mu . Ɔwɔ MBA wɔ INSEAD wɔ France .

Adwuma 
Wɔ n’adwuma mfiase no, na ɔyɛ Electrical and Electronic Engineer wɔ Ford Motor Company, na onyaa ne Chartered Engineer adansedi krataa. Ɔde ne ho bɔɔ Royal Bank of Scotland sɛ nsakraeɛ sohwɛfoɔ ansa na ɔredan akɔ telefon so nkitahodiɛ adwuma mu wɔ afe 2008 mu wɔ Millicom International Cellular, na ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ adwumayɛ nkɔsoɔ, adetɔn, nkyekyɛmu, ne aguadi mu. Wɔpaw Lucy Quist sɛ Ɔpanyin a ɔhwɛ Akwankyerɛ ne Nhyehyɛe so wɔ Vodafone adwumakuw a ɛwɔ Ghana no mu. Nea ɛka ho no, ɔhwɛɛ adwumakuw no aguadi akɛse ne nnwuma akɛse so. Ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ Airtel Ghana CEO . Wɔ n’akannifoɔ dwumadie mu no, ɔkamfoo mmabun a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ STEM mu kɛseɛ wɔ Ghana denam n’adwumakuw no adwumayɛkuo asetena mu asɛdeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ so. wɔn ho hyɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu. Ɔno na ɔhyehyɛɛ Quist Blue Diamond.  Ɔsan nso boom hyehyɛɛ FreshPay sikatua nhyehyɛe wɔ Democratic Republic of Congo ne Executive Women Network. Wɔ September 2018 mu no, FIFA paw no sɛ wɔn Titenani Abadiakyiri wɔ Normalization Committee a wɔbɛsan asiesie bɔɔlbɔ wɔ Ghana.  Mprempren ɔyɛ Ɔkwankyerɛfo Panyin wɔ Morgan Stanley wɔ n’adwumayɛbea a ɛwɔ London no. Ɔsan nso de ne ho ahyɛ baguam kasa amansin mu wɔ nhyiamu te sɛ Mobile World Congress, Hogan Lovells African Forum 2017, Pan African Women Forum, TEDxEuston, Wharton Africa Business Forum, Sanford C. Bernstein Center for Leadership and Ethics Conference wɔ Columbia Adwumayɛ Sukuu ne Afrika Nkɔso Sikasɛm Apam.

title: Esi Sutherland-Addy
text:
Esi Sutherland-Addy yɛ Ghanani nhomanimfo, ɔkyerɛwfo, nhomasua ho ɔbenfo, ne nnipa hokwan ho ɔbenfo. Ɔyɛ ɔbenfo wɔ Afrika Adesua Asoɛe, faako a wayɛ nhwehwɛmufo panyin, Kasa, Nhoma, ne Drama Ɔfã no panyin, ne Afrika Nnipa Ho Adesua Asoɛe Dwumadi a ɛwɔ Ghana Sukuupɔn mu no kwankyerɛfo panyin. Wɔkyerɛ sɛ ɔkyerɛw nhoma bɛboro 50 wɔ nhomasua nhyehyɛe, nhomasua a ɛkɔ anim, mmea nhomasua, nhoma, agoru ne amammerɛ mu, na ɔsom wɔ boayikuw, bagua ne bagua ahorow pii mu wɔ mpɔtam hɔ ne amanaman ntam. Ɔyɛ ɔkyerɛwfo ne amammerɛ ho ɔdenimfo Efua Sutherland babea .

Asetra mu nsɛm 
Wɔwoo no wɔ Ghana sɛ Esi Reiter Sutherland, ɔyɛ agorɔ kyerɛwfo ne amammerɛ ho ɔbenfo Efua Sutherland ne Afrikani-Amerikani Bill Sutherland (1918–2010), atubrafo ɔmanfo hokwan ho ɔbenfo a ɔkɔɔ Ghana mma baasa  no mu panyin mu wɔ George Padmore nyansahyɛ a ɔde maa Kwame Nkrumah so . Ɔsuaa ade wɔ St. Monica Ntoaso Sukuu, Mampong ne Achimota Sukuu (beae a ohyiaa ne kunu).

Wadi dibea ahorow wɔ nhomasua mmeae ahorow wɔ Europa ne U.S., a nea ɛka ho ne sɛ Senior Fellow wɔ Institute of International Education wɔ Manchester University, UK, ne sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo nsrahwɛfo wɔ Indiana Sukuupɔn, Bloomington, U.S.A., Center for African Studies, . Birmingham Sukuupɔn, UK, ne L’Institut des Hautes Etudes en Sciences Sociales, Paris, France .

Ɔne Ghana aban yɛɛ Ɔmanpanyin Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Nhomasua a Ɛkɔ Anim, Amammerɛ ne Nsrahwɛ so (1986–93) na efi afe 1994 kosi 1995 sɛ Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ Nhomasua ne Amammerɛ so. Wayɛ adesua titiriw wɔ nhomasua mu ama amanaman ntam ahyehyɛde ahorow pii a UNESCO, UNICEF, Wiase Sikakorabea ne Fekuw a Ɛhwɛ Nhomasua Nkɔso wɔ Afrika, adi dwuma titiriw wɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow a ɛnyɛ aban de mu a mpanyimfo kuw no ka ho a ɛwɔ Afrika Mmea Nhomasua Ho Adesuafo Nhyiam (FAWE)  ne Mmofra Fapem no mu.

Abasobɔde ahorow 
Sutherland-Addy anya abasobɔdeɛ ahodoɔ bi, a nea ɛka ho ne Nidi Fekuo a ɛfiri College of Preceptors, UK (1998), Kuo Abasobɔdeɛ a Rockefeller Foundation de maeɛ (2001 ne 2002) ma Women Writing Africa Project, Honorary Doctorate of Letters efi Nhomasua Sukuupɔn, Winneba (2004), ne Akyirikyiri Nhomasua mu Abasobɔde a efi Commonwealth of Learning (2008).

Nhoma ahorow a wɔapaw

Ɔkyerɛwfo 

 (Editor) Perspectives on Mythology (Nhyiam bi a Goethe-Institut ne Afrika Adesua Asoɛe, Ghana Sukuupɔn, hyehyɛe, wɔ October 21 ne 24, 1997 ntam no ho nsɛm), Goethe-Institut/Woeli Publ. Nnwuma, 1999. 
 (Ɔne Aminata Diaw yɛ samufo ) Mmea a Wɔkyerɛw Afrika: Afrika Atɔe Fam ne Sahel, The Feminist Press wɔ CUNY, 2005. ISBN 978-1558615007 na wobɛtumi akyerɛw.
 (Ɔne Anne V. Adams yɛɛ samufoɔ) Efua Sutherland Agyapadeɛ: Pan-African Amammerɛ Dwumadie, Banbury: Ayebia Clarke Publishing, 2007. ISBN 978-0-9547023-1-1 na ɛyɛ adwuma.
 (Ne Ama Ata Aidoo ) Ghana, baabi a Bead no Kasa, Fapem ma Nnɛyi Adwinni-Ghana, 2008. ISBN 9789988153601 na ɛyɛ adwuma.
 (Nea ɔne Takyiwaa Manuh yɛɛ samufo ) Afrika wɔ Nnɛyi Adwene mu: Adesua Nhoma a Wɔde Ma Asuafo a Wɔnnya Nnya Nwiei . Ghana: Sahara Anafoɔ Adawurubɔfoɔ, 2013. ISBN 9789988647377 na ɛyɛ adwuma.

Nkrataa 

 "Mmarima ne Mmea Pɛyɛ wɔ Mmofra ne Mpanyimfo Ntoaso Nhomasua mu wɔ Afrika Sahara Anafo fam", Wiase Sikakorabea Nwoma, Wiase Sikakorabea, nɔma 6500, Ɔpɛpɔn 2008.
 "Mmea, Agyapade a Wontumi Nhu ne Nkɔso: Adwene a efi Afrika Mantam mu", ICH UNESCO.

Akenkan a ɛkɔ akyiri 

 Sutherland-Addy, E. (2018) Ɔkwan a wɔfa so yɛ adwuma. "Ama Ata Aidoo wɔ Nkɔmmɔbɔ mu ne Esi Sutherland-Addy" (2017). Obsidian: Nwoma a ɛwɔ Afrikafoɔ a wɔatu akɔtena hɔ, 44(2), 124+.
 Sharma, Veena, ne Esi Sutherland-Addy na wɔyɛɛ saa. "Nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔne Esi Sutherland-Addy bɔe", India Amanaman Ntam Asoɛe Afe Abiɛsa, po. 38, no. 1, 2011, kr. 124–133 na ɛwɔ hɔ.

title: Johanna Odonkor Svanikier
text:
Johanna Odonkor Svanikier yɛ Afrika Agyapadeɛ ne Amammerɛ Kuo no Titenani a ɔhyehyɛɛ ne CEO. Ɔsan nso yɛ Ghana Ɔman Ba a atwam ntɛm ara wɔ France ne Portugal, ne Amanaman Ntam Ahyehyɛde a ɛwɔ La Francophonie ne OECD Nkɔsoɔ Asoɛeɛ nso. Ɔsan nso yɛɛ Ghana Daa Ɔnanmusifo wɔ Amanaman Nkabom Nhomasua, Nyansahu ne Amammerɛ Ahyehyɛde (UNESCO) mu. Wɔfrɛɛ no kɔɔ England ne Wales bar wɔ afe 1990 mu na wɔfrɛɛ no Ghana bar wɔ afe 1991 mu. Ɔyɛ Mfinimfini Asɔredan no muni. Wayɛ adwuma nso sɛ sukuupɔn mu ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo ne nkɔso ho ɔfotufo.

Nwomasua

Nea ɛto so abien 
Johanna Svanikier kɔɔ Aburi Mmabaa Ntoaso/Ntoaso Sukuu wɔ Ghana.

Sukuupɔn ne adesua akyi adesua 
Svanikier wɔ abodin krataa a ɛma ɔyɛ bachelor (LL. B.) ne master’s abodin krataa (LL. M.) a ofi London Sikasɛm Sukuu mu . Onyaa abodin krataa a ɛkorɔn wɔ ɔman adwumayɛ mu (MPA) wɔ Harvard Sukuupɔn Kennedy Sukuu a Ɛhwɛ Aban So a na ɔyɛ Fulbright nhomanimfo no . Ɔsan nso anya amammuisɛm ho abodin krataa (M.Sc) wɔ Oxford Sukuupɔn mu .

Adwuma 
Wɔ Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 24, 2014 no, Ɔmanpanyin Svanikier de ne “nkrataa a ɔde gye di” maa France Ɔmampanyin François Hollande wɔ Elysée Ahemfie a ɛwɔ Paris, France no wɔ aban kwan so. Wɔ ne nsɛm mu no, Hollande kamfoo Ghana sɛ wanya anuonyam ne obu wɔ amanaman ntam.

Svanikier yɛɛ Commissioner wɔ National Development Planning Commission of Ghana wɔ afe 2010 ne 2014 ntam na wayɛ Fidelity Bank, Ghana Ltd kwankyerɛfoɔ a ɔnyɛ adwumayɛfoɔ firi afe 2009 a ɔyɛ Adwumayɛfoɔ Yiedie ne Akatua Boayikuo no guamtrani. Ɔsan nso ka Afotufoɔ Kuo a ɛwɔ Ministry of Lands and Natural Resources a ɛwɔ Ghana no ho.

Wɔ afe 2016 mu no ɔhyehyɛɛ Heritage and Cultural Society of Africa a ɛhyehyɛɛ Destination Ghana! African Diaspora Homecoming Conference a wɔde bedi Ghana Ahofadi Mfirihyia 60 ne nea ɛho hia ma Afrikafo a wɔwɔ Diaspora ne nnipa a wofi Afrika. Nnipa a wɔda nsow a wofi Afrika ne Atubrafo nyinaa mu a Awurade Paul Boateng a ofi Akyem ne Wembley, Lisa Mensah a na anka ɔyɛ Ɔman Ɔkyerɛwfo Panyin a ɔhwɛ Nkuraase Nkɔso so wɔ Obama nniso mu, odiyifo Hugh Quarshie a ofi Star Wars ne Holby City agye din, Patrick Awuah na wɔbaa ase ɔhyehyɛɛ Ashesi Suapɔn, Fred Swaniker a ɔhyehyɛɛ Afrika Akannifoɔ Suapɔn ne Fuse ODG a ɔgyee ‘Azonto’ ne ‘Antenna’ din na ɔkamfoo ‘This is New Africa’ (TINA).

Ɔno na ɔkyerɛw "Mmea Hokwan ne Mmara wɔ Ghana".

Ankorankoro asetra 
Johanna Odonkor Svanikier aware Thomas Svanikier, a ɔhyehyɛɛ Svani Kuw no ne ne guamtrani panyin ne DreamOval Limited kyɛfa wura. Wɔwɔ mma baasa.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Ethel Delali Cofie
text:
Ethel Delali Cofie yɛ IT adwumayɛfo, adwumayɛfo ne ɔfotufo ma IT nnwuma. Ɔfiri Republic of Ghana . Ɔyɛ Women in Tech Africa, ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛyɛ adwuma ma Afrika mmaa tumi denam mfiridwuma fibea a wɔbɛma atumi ayɛ adwuma no muni a ɔhyehyɛɛ no.

Nwomasua 
Cofie wɔ Bachelor’s degree wɔ Computer Science mu wɔ Valley View University wɔ Ghana, master’s degree wɔ Distribution Systems wɔ University of Brighton, ne Executive Degree wɔ Leadership, Business and Entrepreneurship mu wɔ Yale School of Management

Adwuma ne fekubɔ ahorow 
Ɔyɛɛ mfiridwuma ne aguadi mu dwumadi ahorow wɔ n'adwuma a na wadi kan ayɛ wɔ United Kingdom, Nigeria, ne Sierra Leone no mu . Ɔne Vodafone Ghana nso ayɛ adwuma sɛ Commercial Solutions Titenani.

Cofie yɛ EDEL Technology Consulting, adwumakuw bi a ɛde IT ho afotu ma wɔ Afrika Atɔe fam ne Europa no panyin ne nea ɔhyehyɛɛ no.

Wɔada no adi wɔ BBC na wama wɔatintim n’adwene wɔ CNN a ɛfa mfiridwuma ho nsɛmti wɔ gua a ɛrenya nkɔso, ne mmea akannifo ho. Ɔyɛ nnwumakuw a ɛwɔ Afrika nyinaa a Egotickets ne AMOSS Holdings SA ka ho no bagua no muni.

Abasobɔde ne agyede a wɔde ma 
Wɔagye Ethel ne ne nhyehyɛe ahorow atom:

 United States Ɔmampanyin Barack Obama Afrika Akannifo Mmabun Dwumadi Nkitahodi Kuw (YALI) no yɔnko
 Wɔbɔɔ Mmea 5 a wɔsen biara a wɔanya IT so nkɛntɛnso wɔ Afrika no mu biako 
 Wɔpaw no tiawa maa Amanaman Nkabom GEM Tech Award wɔ October 2014.
 Mmea Nnwumayɛfo a Wɔda Nsow Sen Biara 100 Wɔ Ghana 
 Afrika Ɔbea a ɔwɔ nkɛntɛnso wɔ Adwumayɛ mu: ICT Category

 CEO Global gye toom sɛ Afrika Ɔbea a ɔwɔ nkɛntɛnso sen biara wɔ Adwumayɛ ne Aban mu ma ICT
 USA Ɔkyerɛwfo a ɔhwɛ aguadi so Penny Pritzker kaa Ethel Cofie ho asɛm wɔ ne 2014 Wiase Nyinaa Adwumayɛfo Nhyiam no kasa a ɔmae wɔ Morocco no mu

title: Maureen Abla Amematekpor
text:
Maureen Abla Amematekpor (wɔwoo no afe 1954) yɛ Ghana ɔman nanmusifo a wakɔ pɛnhyen na na anka ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔnanmusifo wɔ Namibia ne Botswana .

Adwuma 
Amematekpor yɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo wɔ Ho Polytechnic fi 1979 kosi 1992. Wɔ 1984 mu no, onyaa sɔhwɛ fii Nhomasua Sukuupɔn Winneba mu. efi 1992 kosi 2001. Na ɔwɔ Aguadibea wɔ Ho Polytechnic . Wɔ afe 2003 mu no, Amematekpor nyaa abodin krataa wɔ adwumayɛ ho nhyehyɛe mu; wɔ afe 2004 mu no onyaa Adwumayɛ ho Ɔbenfo wɔ Universität Maastricht .

Efi 30 Ɔpɛpɔn 2002 kosi 13 Ɔpɛpɔn 2006 no, na ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanyin wɔ Windhoek, Namibia, wɔ Commission for Gaborone, Botswana . Efi 13 Ɔpɛpɔn 2006 kosi 2009 no, na ɔyɛ ɔnanmusifo wɔ Copenhagen, Denmark, na bere koro no ara mu no, na wɔagye no atom wɔ Nordic aman anan a ɛne Sweden, Norway, Finland ne Iceland mu.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Ayesha Harruna Attah
text:
Ayesha Harruna Attah (wɔwoo no December 1983) yɛ ayɛsɛm kyerɛwfo a wɔwoo no wɔ Ghana . Ɔte Senegal .

Mfitiase mfe ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Ayesha Harruna Attah wɔ Accra, Ghana, wɔ afe 1980 mfeɛ mu, wɔ asraafoɔ aban ase, maa ɛna bi a na ɔyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfoɔ ne agya a ɔyɛ mfoniniyɛfoɔ. Attah aka sɛ: “M’awofo ne me nkɛntɛnso atitiriw a edi kan.” Na wɔyɛ nhoma ho nsɛmma nhoma bi a wɔfrɛ no Imagine, a na Accra ho nsɛm wom; nsɛm a ɛfa adwinni, nyansahu, sini, nhoma ahorow ho; cartoons—a na m’ani gye ho titiriw. Na wɔyɛ (na wɔda so ara yɛ) m’abran. Mihuu Toni Morrison bere a na madi mfe dumiɛnsa, na na me ho atɔ me. Memenee biribiara a ɔkyerɛwee. Mekae sɛ mekenkanee Paradise, na bere a ne ntease kwatii me koraa saa bere no, wogyaw me tee nka sɛ ɛyɛ nhoma a ɛyɛ nwonwa sen biara a wɔakyerɛw na da bi mepɛ sɛ mekyerɛw wiase a mmea a wɔyɛ den ahyɛ mu ma, te sɛ nea Ms. Morrison yɛe no ara pɛ. " 

Bere a onyinii wɔ Accra no, otu kɔɔ Massachusetts na osuaa abɔde mu nneɛma ho ade wɔ Mount Holyoke College, ne afei Columbia Sukuupɔn, na onyaa MFA wɔ adebɔ ho nkyerɛwee mu wɔ New York Sukuupɔn mu .

Retwerɛ 
Watintim ayɛsɛm nhoma anum.  Wɔkyerɛw ne nhoma a edi kan Harmattan Rain (2008) sɛ nea efi fekubɔ a efi Per Ankh Publishers — wɔ Ghana ayɛsɛm kyerɛwfo Ayi Kwei Armah akwankyerɛ ase — ne TrustAfrica, na wɔpaw no tiawa maa 2010 Commonwealth Writers’ Prize (Africa Region ). N'ayɛsɛm a ɛtɔ so mmienu Saturday's Shadows, a World Editions  tintimii wɔ afe 2015 mu, no, wɔyii no sɛ ɔmfa mma Kwani? Manuscript Project, na wɔatintim wɔ Dutch kasa mu (De Geus). N'ayɛsɛm a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa ne The Hundred Wells of Salaga (2019), a ɛfa "abusuabɔ, akɔnnɔ ne aperepereɛ a ɛwɔ mmaa asetena mu wɔ Ghana wɔ afeha a ɛtɔ so dunkron awieeɛ wɔ Afrika ho apereperediɛ mu". Wakyerɛw The Deep Blue Between, ayɛsɛm a wɔde ma mmerante ne mmabaa a wɔadu mpanyin afe so. Na n’ayɛsɛm a ɛtɔ so anum, Zainab Takes New York no bɛyi no adi wɔ April 2022 mu.

Sɛ́ obi a onyaa 2014 AIR Award no, na Attah yɛ ɔkyerɛwfo a ɔte Instituto Sacatar a ɛwɔ Bahia, Brazil . Ɔsan nso dii nkonim wɔ Miles Morland Foundation Writing Scholarship wɔ afe 2016 mu maa nwoma a wɔahyɛ ho nyansa sɛ ɛnyɛ ayɛsɛm a ɛfa kola nut abakɔsɛm ho.

Harmattan Osu (2008) 
Harmattan Rain, a wotintimii wɔ afe 2008 mu no di Ghana abusua bi a wɔyɛ awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ mmiɛnsa a Lizzie-Achiaa, Akua Afriyie ne Sugri ka ho asɛm akyi.

Na Lizzie-Achiaa yɛ wɔn abusua no matriarch akokodurufo, a oguan kɔhwehwɛɛ ne dɔfo no na bere koro no ara mu no, ɔyɛɛ ayarehwɛ adwuma. Ne babea otuatewfo, mfoniniyɛfo Akua Afriye, ankasa bɔ ne ho mmɔden sɛ ɔwofo a onni ɔhokafo wɔ ɔman a atuatew ahorow a ɛtoatoa so wosow no mu, na na Akua Afriye babea koro pɛ Sugri yɛ abeawa a ne ho yɛ fɛ, onyansafo a onyinii a na ɔwɔ ahobammɔ dodo afei ofi fie kɔ sukuupɔn wɔ New York, faako a ohu sɛ ɛtɔ mmere bi a obi betumi anya ahofadi dodo.

Kwasida Sunsuma (2015) 
Wɔde sii hɔ wɔ 1990 mfe no mu wɔ Afrika Atɔe Fam, Saturday's Shadows no fa "abusua bi a wɔrepere sɛ wɔbɛkɔ so akura wɔn biakoyɛ mu wɔ amammui tebea a ɛyɛ mmerɛw mfinimfini", a wɔaka ho asɛm sɛ: "Attah san da ne nimdeɛ adi sɛ ɔkyerɛwfo. Ɔda n’ahokokwaw adi sɛ ɔkyerɛwfo denam ne suban nkɔso a ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ na emu da hɔ no so."

Abura Ɔha a ɛwɔ Salaga (2019) 
Aminah bɔ asetena a ɛyɛ anigye kosi sɛ wɔbɛtetew no afi ne fie ho atirimɔden so na wɔhyɛ no ma watu kwan a ɛdannan no fi obi a ɔda dae awiabere mu ma ɔbɛyɛ ɔbea a otumi gyina tebea horow ano. Wurche, ɔpanyin bi babea a ɔhyɛɛ da yɛe no pɛ denneennen sɛ obedi dwuma titiriw bi wɔ n’agya ahemfie hɔ. Saa mmea baanu yi asetra hyia bere a ntɔkwaw a ɛkɔ so wɔ Wurche nkurɔfo ntam no de ɔmantam no to asiane mu, bere a nkoatɔn no yɛɛ kɛse wɔ afeha a ɛto so dunkron no awiei no.

Ɛdenam Aminah ne Wurche osuahu ahorow so no, The Hundred Wells of Salaga de nkoasom ne sɛnea Afrika ho apereperedi no kaa nnipa a wɔyɛ da biara da asetra ho adwene a ɛyɛ nwonwa ma.

Nnipa a Wɔte Ntam (2020) 
Anuanom mmea mmanoma Hassana ne Husseina fie asɛe bere a wɔtow hyɛɛ wɔn so atirimɔden so akyi. Nanso eyi nyɛ awiei na mmom wɔn asɛm no mfiase, nea ɛde wɔn bɛkɔ nkurow ne amammerɛ ahorow a wonnim mu, baabi a wɔbɛhyehyɛ mmusua foforo, asiw asiane ahorow ano na wɔafi ase ahu wɔn ho ankasa. Bere a mmanoma no di akwan horow a ɛsono emu biara akyi wɔ Brazil ne Afrika Atɔe Fam Gold Coast no, wɔda so ara wɔ abusuabɔ denam nsu ho adaeso a wɔbom da so. Nanso so wɔn nkrabea bɛtwe wɔn asan abom da bi? The Deep Blue Between yɛ akwantu a ɛtrɛw a abakɔsɛm mu tebea horow a ɛkanyan adwene pii wom no yɛ abusuabɔ a ebetumi agyina nsakrae a ɛyɛ nwonwa sen biara mpo ano ho asɛm a ɛkanyan adwene.

title: Grace Amponsah-Ababio
text:
Grace Amponsah-Ababio (wɔwoo no 22 December 1941) yɛ Ghana Dentist na ɔyɛ Diplomat a wakɔ pɛnhyen.

Nwomasua 
Grace nyaa ntoaso sukuu fi afe 1955 kosi afe 1959 Wesley Girls' Senior High School, Cape Coast, Ghana . Firi 1961 kosi 1962 mu. Ɔsuaa adeɛ wɔ Ɔman Mfiridwuma Sukuupɔn a ɛwɔ Ukraine "KPI" wɔ Soviet Union . Efi 1962 kosi 1966 no, osuaa ade wɔ Odessa Ɔman Aduruyɛ Sukuupɔn a ɛwɔ Soviet Union no mu. Sɛ́ ntini ho oduruyɛfo no, na ɔyɛ ne ho titiriw wɔ stomatology mu.

Adwuma 
Efi afe 1967 kosi afe 1969 no, na ɔyɛ ofie sohwɛfo wɔ Komo Anokye Nkyerɛkyerɛ Ayaresabea a ɛwɔ Kumasi. Efi 1972 kosi 1974 no na ɔyɛ nsensan ho oduruyɛfo panyin wɔ Korle-Bu Nkyerɛkyerɛ Ayaresabea. Efi 1974 kosi 1978 no na ɔyɛ nsensan ho oprehyɛn ho ɔbenfo a wagye din wɔ kurow no mu polyclinic a ɛwɔ ɔmantam Ussher Fort wɔ Accra no mu. Efi January 1979 kosi September 2001 no odii n’ankasa ntini ho adwumayɛbea no anim. Efi afe 1989 kɔsi afe 2001 no, na ɔyɛ wɔn a wɔhyehyɛɛ "Mobile Dental Clinic" ne "Social Dental Outreach" a ɛne nsensan ho dwumadie ma mpɔtam a wohia mmoa wɔ Ghana no mu baako. Efi September 2001 kosi September 5, 2004 no, na ɔyɛ ɔnanmusifo wɔ The Hague (Netherlands) na Ahyehyɛde a Ɛbara Nnuru Akode no gyee no toom.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Ama Ampofo
text:
Ama Ampofo yɛ Ghana odiyifo ne model. Wɔwoo mma baanan mu nea ɔto so abiɛsa, wɔ Accra wɔ 22 June 1991. Wɔ afe 2014 mu no, ɔyɛɛ "Claudia" wɔ Shirley Frimpong-Manso sini, Devil in the Detail, dwumadie a ɛmaa onyaa Africa Movie Academy Award for Best Supporting Actress ne Golden Movie abasobɔdeɛ. Ansa na Ama reba ne sini a ɛyɛ nwonwa no, na ɔyɛ TV so dawurubɔ ahorow ( Fidelity Bank Ghana, Kiss Condom) ne nnwom video ahorow (Lies by Sarkodie feat. Lil Shaker)wɔ Ghana mu.

Asetra mu nsɛm 
Wɔwoo Ama Ampofo na wɔtetee no wɔ Cantoments a ɛwɔ Greater Accra mantam mu wɔ Ghana . Ɔkɔɔ ntoaso sukuu wɔ St. Paul’s Lutheran wɔ Kanda na afei otu kɔɔ Calvary International School wɔ Teshie. Bere a owiee ne ntoaso sukuu wɔ Archbishop Porter Girls’ Senior High School a ɛwɔ Takoradi no, ɔde ne din kɔhyɛɛ Ghana Sukuupɔn mu baabi a onyaa Bachelor’s degree wɔ Abakɔsɛm ne Theatre Arts mu.

Ansa na agodie rebɛyɛ adwuma a wɔpaw mpo no, Ama antwe ne ho ankɔ anim da. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ afe 2001 Golden Tulip Hotel Children Playback Show, asaw akansi a wɔyɛe wɔ Accra National Theatre, na ɔsan de ne ho hyɛɛ 2012 Miss Malaika Ghana, ahoɔfɛ akansi mu nokwasɛm ho ɔyɛkyerɛ mu, na ɔyɛɛ anum a wɔdii kan wɔ awieɛ.

Adwuma 
Ama dii kan yɛɛ ne agodie wɔ afe 2014 mu denam agodie a wɔkamfoo no kɛse wɔ Shirley Frimpong-Manso ’s sini, Devil in the Detail, a ɛno nti onyaa 2015 Golden Movie Awards for Best Supporting Actress wɔ Drama Category mu na onyaa Africa Movie Academy Awards nomination ama Oyikyerɛfo a Ɔboa a Ɔsen Biara. Bere a ogyaee bere nyinaa agodie akyi no, wɔ afe 2021 mu no, Ama nyaa nkamfo foforo wɔ akasatiafo mu wɔ dwuma titiriw a odii wɔ Shirley Frimpong-Manso ’s sini foforo Chasing Lullaby : A Mother’s Day Story ne nokwasɛm TV kwan so dwumadi Boys and Girls: The Ultimate Battle of Ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna !

Ansa na Ama ɔreyɛ agoru no, odii nkonim wɔ 2001 Golden Tulip Hotel Children Playback Show, asaw akansi a wɔyɛe wɔ Accra National Theatre, na ɔde ne ho hyɛɛ 2012 [Miss Malaika Ghana], ahoɔfɛ akansi mu nokwasɛm ho ɔyɛkyerɛ mu, na ɔyɛɛ anum a wɔdii kan wɔ awieɛ.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Ellen Serwaa Nee-Whang
text:
Ellen Serwaa Nee-Whang (wɔwoo no 2 Ɔbɛnem 1952 wɔ Ghana) yɛ Ghana ɔmanpanyin a wakɔ pɛnhyen.

Nwomasua 
Ɔnyaa ne ntoaso sukuu wɔ Aburi Girls’ Senior High School, baabi a onyaa bi GCE Ɔfa a Ɛyɛ Daa ne Ɔfa a Ɛkɔ Anim . Wɔ afe 1973 mu no onyaa abodin krataa wɔ Borɔfo kasa mu ne Postgraduate Diploma wɔ Amanaman Ntam Abusuabɔ mu wɔ Ghana Sukuupɔn mu .

Adwuma 
Wɔ 1974 mu no, ɔde ne ho kɔbɔɔ ne man amannɔne adwuma. Efi 1985 kosi 1989 no, ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ ɔfotufo wɔ Ghana ananmusifo dwumadibea a ɛwɔ Monrovia, Liberia, na wɔde hyɛɛ no nsa sɛ ɔnhwɛ aban ananmusifo dwumadibea no so.

</br> Wɔ afe 1989 ne 1993 ntam no ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Ghana (Policy Planning and Research Bureau).
</br> Efi afe 1993 kosi afe 1997 no, na ɔyɛ aban ananmusifo dwumadibea panyin wɔ Ghana Asɛmpatrɛw Daa wɔ Amanaman Nkabom Dwumadibea a ɛwɔ Geneva, Switzerland.
</br> Efi April 2000 kosi November 2005 no, na ɔyɛ Ɔmanpanyin wɔ Pretoria, South Africa a bere koro no ara mu no, aban ahorow a ɛwɔ Maseru, Antananarivo, Port Louis, Victoria, Mbabane ne Moroni nyaa tumi krataa.

</br> Efi January 2006 kosi October 2008 no, ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ ɔman adwumayɛfo panyin a na ɔyɛ Amannɔne Nsɛm ne Mpɔtam Nkabom Dwumadibea no Ɔkwankyerɛfo Panyin.
</br> Efi November 2008 kosi December 2012 no, na ɔyɛ Ɔman Ba wɔ Berne, Switzerland a bere koro no ara mu no, aban no maa no tumi krataa wɔ Vienna, Austria . Ɔsan nso yɛ Ɔman Ba ne Daa Ɔnanmusifoɔ wɔ Amanaman Nkabom Dwumadibea a ɛwɔ Geneva firi afe 2009 kɔsi afe 2012. Ɔkɔɔ pɛnhyen wɔ n’adwuma no awiei wɔ afe 2012 mu.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Bozoma Saint John
text:
Bozoma "Boz" Saint John ( née Arthur ) yɛ Amerikani aguadifo ne aguadi so panyin a na ɔyɛ aguadi so panyin (CMO) wɔ Netflix . Kane no, na ɔyɛ CMO wɔ Endeavor, ne chief brand officer (CBO) wɔ Uber kɔsii June 2018. Saint John nso yɛ aguadi sohwɛfo wɔ Apple Music kɔsii June 2017, berɛ a ɔde ne ho bɔɔ adwumakuo no wɔ ne gyeɛ Beats Music . Efi afe 2005 kosi afe 2014 no ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ PepsiCo, awiei koraa no ɔsom sɛ nnwom ne anigyede aguadi panyin. Wɔ May 2021 mu no, Leading Ladies Africa bɔɔ ne din kaa Mmea Akannifoɔ 50 a wɔwɔ nkɛntɛnsoɔ kɛseɛ wɔ Afrika wɔ nnwumakuo ne adwumayɛ mu.

Mfitiase asetra 
Wɔwoo Ɔhotefo Yohane maa Rev. Oduruyɛfo Appianda Arthur ne Aba Arthur (wɔwoo no Enim) wɔ Middletown, Connecticut wɔ United States. Abusua no tu kɔɔ Ghana bere a na wadi asram asia. Wɔ ne mmofraase no, na n’abusua nso te Nairobi, Kenya ne Washington, DC Wɔsan kɔɔ United States na wɔtraa Colorado Springs, Colorado bere a na wadi mfe 12. Ná ne papa yɛ clarinet bɔfo na ɔyɛ Ghana Asraafo no muni ansa na ɔretu akɔ Amerika akɔkɔ sukuu a wɔawie. Ɔhotefo John fa n’agya ka sɛ ne nhyɛso kɛse.

Wɔ 1999 mu no, Saint John wiee Wesleyan Sukuupɔn na onyaa abodin krataa wɔ Engiresi ne Afrikafo ne Amerikafo adesua mu . Ne papa nyaa Ph.D. wɔ ethnomusicology mu wɔ 1977 mu, a ɔno nso fi Wesleyan hɔ.

Ne nuabea Alua Arthur yɛ mmaranimfo ne owu doula .

Adwuma

Adwumayɛ ho aguadi 
Wɔ kɔlege akyi no, Saint John yɛɛ adwuma wɔ aguade ho dawurubɔ adwumayɛbea ahorow Arnold Worldwide ne Spike Lee Spike DDB. Ɔsan yɛɛ adwuma wɔ ntadehyɛ adwumakuw Ashley Stewart, faako a na ɔyɛ aguadi ho ɔmampanyin abadiakyiri no.

Saint John bɛkaa PepsiCo ho sɛ aguadi sohwɛfo panyin wɔ afe 2005. Akyiri yi odii PepsiCo anim wɔ nnwom afahyɛ a egyina aguadi so sɛ nnwom ne anigyede aguadi so panyin. Ɔtenaa adwumakuo no mu bɛyɛ mfeɛ du ansa na ɔrebɛka Beats Music ho wɔ afe 2014 mu, berɛ a Jimmy Iovine a ɔfiri Beats faa Saint John gyinaa ne suahunu wɔ nnwom aguadi mu. Saint John tu fii New York kɔɔ Los Angeles sɛ ɔrekɔdi aguadi ho anim maa adwumakuw no.

Beats na Apple tɔɔ no wɔ ɛno akyi bere tiaa bi, na Saint John bɛyɛɛ wiase nyinaa adetɔfo aguadi so panyin ma iTunes ne Apple Music, na ɔde ne ho kɔ Los Angeles ne Apple Cupertino adwumayɛbea ti ntam mpɛn pii dapɛn biara.  Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfoɔ kaa Saint John a ɔde Apple Music a wɔayɛ no foforɔ no kyerɛɛ wɔ asɛnka agua so wɔ 2016 Apple Worldwide Developers Conference no mu sɛ ne nkɔsoɔ berɛ, a ɔwɔ "anigyeɛ" ne nipasu a ɛyɛ nwonwa a ɛkyeree mpɔtam hɔ ne intanɛt so atiefoɔ nyinaa. Biz Carson a ɔwɔ Business Insider no kae sɛ ne honam ani hwɛbea boa ma wosii sɛnea Apple asan ayɛ ne Apple Music softwea no koraa no so dua. BuzzFeed kyerɛwee sɛ ɔno ne onipa a "ɔyɛ nwini sen biara" a ɔkɔɔ asɛnka agua so pɛn wɔ Apple kasa titiriw bi ase.

Wɔ June 6, 2017 no, Saint John bɛyɛɛ brand officer panyin wɔ Uber.

Wɔ June 2018 mu no, Saint John gyaee Uber kɔkaa Endeavor ho sɛ aguadi sohwɛfoɔ panin. Ɔkaa nea ɔpaw sɛ obefi hɔ no ho asɛm sɛ: "Bere a miduu Uber no midii nokware wɔ ɔpɛ a mewɔ sɛ mɛkɔ akɔsesa titiriw nea misusuwii sɛ ɛyɛ tebea a emu yɛ den, titiriw ma mmea ne nnipa a wɔn kɔla yɛ kɔkɔɔ." . . Nea mihui ne nnipa pii a na wɔwɔ ɔpɛ sɛ wɔbɛyɛ yiye, nokwarem no, nanso wontumi mfi wɔn ankasa kwan so. . . Eduu bere bi no, ɛbɛyɛɛ nea ɛboro so maa me. . . Ɛbɛyɛɛ asuadeɛ pa maa yɛn nyinaa: Ɛho nhia sɛ woyɛ agyenkwa no, wobɛtumi agye wo ho nso." Bere a ɔwɔ Endeavor no, Saint John boa ma wodii "ɔhaw" branding adwuma bi anim maa Papa John's Pizza bere a adwumakuw no fapemfo, John Schnatter, de mmusua mu nyiyim kasa dii dwuma wɔ nhyiam frɛ bi mu akyi.

Netflix bɔɔ Saint John din sɛ ne aguadi sohwɛfoɔ panin foforɔ wɔ June 30, 2020, na ɛmaa ɔbɛyɛɛ CMO a ɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa ma adwumakuo no wɔ afe 2019–2020 mu. Ɔno ne Black C-level adwumayɛfo panyin a odi kan wɔ Netflix. Saint John besii Jackie Lee-Joe a ogyaee adwumakuw no esiane n’ankasa nneɛma nti no ananmu. Saint John hyɛɛ dwumadie foforɔ no ase wɔ Oforisuo 2020  na ɔfirii hɔ wɔ Oforisuo 2022.

Akyerɛw ne podcasting 
Wɔ May 2020 mu no, Saint John hyɛɛ aseɛ yɛɛ iHeart Media podcast a ɛwɔ anohyetoɔ a ɛka ho ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfoɔ Katie Couric, "Back to Biz with Katie and Boz". Podcast no fii ase de adwene sii sɛnea nnwuma nketewa ne akɛse a ɛwɔ ɔman no mu nyinaa fii ase buee ano wɔ coronavirus ɔyaredɔm no nyinaa mu, nanso wɔ George Floyd kum akyi no ɛtrɛwee de n'adwene sii nhyehyɛe mu mmusua mu nyiyim ne nsɛmmɔnedi ho atɛntrenee mu nsakrae nso so.

Ɔhotefo John kyerɛw nkae nhoma bi a wɔato din The Urgent Life, a ɔka n’adwuma sɛ aguadi ho adwumayɛfo panyin, ne kunu a ɔhweree no, na ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔwofo a onni ɔhokafo ho asɛm wom. Da a wɔde betintim ne Ɔpɛpɔn 21, 2023, a Viking Press .

Adwuma afoforo 
Wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2021 mu no, Saint John kyerɛɛ adesua tiawa bi a ɛyɛ den (SIP) maa wɔn a wɔrehwehwɛ MBA wɔ Harvard Adwumayɛ Sukuu a wɔfrɛ no "Anatomy of a Badass".

Dwumadi, afotu, ne adɔeyɛ 
Ɔhotefo John de #ShareTheMicNow Instagram nhyehyɛe no sii hɔ a ɔne Luvvie Ajayi, Glennon Doyle, ne Stacey Bendet kaa ho. Wɔ June 10, 2020 no, Abibifoɔ mmaa 52 faa Instagram feeds a ɛfa mmaa aborɔfoɔ 52 a wɔwɔ platform akɛseɛ ho de twee adwene sii adwuma a wɔreyɛ no so sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛma nsakraeɛ aba. Saint John faa Instagram akontaabu a ɛfa Abibifo mmea atitiriw a Elaine Welteroth, Angelica Ross, ne Gia Peppers ka ho no faa mmea aborɔfo a Julia Roberts, Elizabeth Warren, ne Diane von Fürstenberg ka ho akontaabu .

Saint John adɔeɛ mmɔdenbɔ no bi ne sɛ ɔgyinaa Pencils of Promise ananmu sɛ Wiase Nyinaa Ɔnanmusifoɔ wɔ Ghana na ɔsom wɔ Girls Who Code ne Vital Voices boards mu.  Ɔhotefo John ayɛ Ɔmampanyin no Afotufo Bagua a ɛhwɛ Wesleyan Sukuupɔn, n’alma mater so no muni. Ɔsan yɛ Abibifo Afotufo Bagua a Ɛhwɛ Nkɛntɛnso So no muni, adeyɛ a Amerika Ntadehyɛfo Bagua no ayɛ de adi Abibifo a wɔayi wɔn afi ntadehyɛ adwuma mu wɔ nhyehyɛe kwan so no ho dwuma.

Wɔ May 2022 mu no, wɔde Saint John kɔɔ Amerika Adwumayɛkuo a Wɔtɔn Aguadiɛ Asoɛeɛ a Ɛgye Din no mu .

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ɔhotefo John waree Peter Ɔhotefo John kosii sɛ owui wɔ afe 2013. Wɔwoo abofra biako.

title: Doreen Andoh
text:
Doreen Andoh yɛ Ghana radio so nipa, brand ambassador, TV so nipa a ɛtɔ mmere bi, ne nsɛm a esisi ho ɔyɛkyerɛfo. Ɔde bɛboro mfeɛ aduonu ayɛ radio so enti ɔyɛ asɛnkafoɔ a wɔadi dwuma akyɛ wɔ Ghana asɛnka agua so no mu baako.

Mprempren ɔyɛ Cosmopolitan Mix, radio so dwumadi a wɔyɛ no anɔpa mfinimfini wɔ Joy FM so no ho ɔkasafo na wɔtaa ka ne ho asɛm sɛ ɔyɛ Ghana radio hemmaa.

Abasobɔde ahorow 
Doreen ne ɔbea a odi kan a onyaa Afe no mu Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo a Ɔsen Biara abasobɔde wɔ afe 2001 mu. Leading Ladies’ Network ama no dibea sɛ Mframa Asorɔkye Hemmaa, na afe 2013 mu no, odii nkonim wɔ ɔbea a ɔyɛ ɔkasafo a ɔda nsow wɔ Ghana Mmea Abasobɔde mu.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Antoinette Delali Kemavor
text:
Antoinette Delali Kemavor yɛ Ghanani model ne ahoɔfɛ akansi titleholder a wɔhyɛɛ no abotiri sɛ Miss World Ghana wɔ afe 2015 mu na ɔgyinaa Ghana ananmu wɔ Miss World 2016 akansi no mu. Wɔahu no wɔ nnwom video ahorow a wontumi nkan mu, ne TV so dawurubɔ ahorow mu.

Ankorankoro asetra

Miss World Ghana 2015. Ɔde ne nsa kyerɛɛ ne so 
Wɔdii Antoinette abotiri sɛ Miss World Ghana wɔ afe 2015 mu. Sɛ Miss World Ghana 2015, ɔsii akan wɔ Miss World 2016 akansi no mu.

Miss Wiase 2016 
Antoinette gyinaa Ghana ananmu wɔ Miss World 2016 akansi a ɔde Top 20 sii hɔ no.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Nuong Faalong
text:
Edith Nuong Faalong yɛ Ghana nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo, ɔkyerɛwfo, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho ɔbenfo ne odiyifo. Mprempren ɔyɛ television so ɔhwɛfo ma Spotlight, mprempren nsɛm ho dwumadi wɔ Mx24gh nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ne television dwumadibea bi a ɛwɔ Ghana.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Nuong fi Lawra a ɛwɔ Upper West Region wɔ Ghana, nanso wɔwoo no wɔ Tamale, Northern Region . Ɔnyaa ne ntoaso sukuu wɔ Aburi Girls Senior High School na akyiri yi ɔkɔɔ so kɔɔ Ghana Suapɔn, Legon baabi a ɔsuaa Sikasɛm ne Asase ho adesua.

Adwuma

Nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi 
Faalong yɛ obi a ɔkamfo affirmative action wɔ Ghana  mmrahyɛbagua mu na n’ani gye pɛyɛ ne nkɔso a ɛka obiara ho. Ɔka ne ho asɛm sɛ ɔbea ho ɔpɛfo a ɔkamfo mmea hokwan ahorow wɔ asetra ne mmɔdenbɔ afã horow nyinaa mu.

Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ 
Faalong bɛkaa Media General Ghana Limited ho wɔ afe 2017 mu sɛ obi a ɔbɔ amanneɛ wɔ 3 FM ne TV3 so . Ɔno ne ɔbea a odi kan ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo kumaa a ɔyɛ Hot Issues, mprempren nsɛm ho dwumadi wɔ TV3 so. Ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ TV3 nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ dan mu na na ɔyɛ atesɛm nkrataa mu nhwehwɛmu kuw no muni nso. Wohu sɛ Nuong nim nsɛm pii na ɔka nsɛm penpen wɔ asetra mu nsɛm a ɛwɔ ne man mu ho.

Agorudi a wɔyɛ 
Sɛ́ odiyifo no, ɔde ne sɔre ntɛmntɛm bere tiaa bi pɛ wɔ Ghana sini adwuma mu no yɛɛ nsɛmti. Wɔabɔ no tip sɛ odiyifoɔ a ɛsɛ sɛ ɔhwɛ no yie titire wɔ ne dwumadie wɔ Garrett Batty Freetown a ɛmaa no Oyikyerɛfoɔ a ɔsen biara wɔ Afe no mu (Non-Nigerian) wɔ 2016 Nigeria Entertainment Awards (NEA) . Ɔayɛ ne ho wɔ TV so dwumadi ne sini ahorow bi te sɛ ‘Living with Trisha’, ‘ A Northern Affair’, ‘Broadway’, ‘Sins Of Our Fathers’ ne ‘Crime in Love’, ne afoforo.

title: Salma Frances Mancell-Egala
text:
Salma Frances Mancell-Egala yɛ Ghana ɔmanpanyin na ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party of Ghana no muni. Mprempren ɔyɛ Ghana ananmusifo wɔ Turkey.

Ɔnanmusifo a wɔpaw no 
Wɔ July 2017 mu no, Ɔmampanyin Nana Akuffo-Addo bɔɔ Salma Mancell-Egala din sɛ Ghana ɔnanmusifo wɔ Turkey . Na ɔka Ghanafo atitiriw aduonu mmienu a wɔbɔɔ wɔn din sɛ wɔnyɛ Ghanafoɔ asɛmpatrɛ adwuma ahodoɔ anim wɔ wiase.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Amerley Ollennu Awua-Asamoa
text:
Amerley Ollennu Awua-Asamoa (wɔwoo no afe 1956) yɛ Ghana aban ananmusifo, adwumakuo ne adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔnyɛ adwuma. Ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party of Ghana no muni, ɔyɛɛ Ghana Ɔnanmusifo wɔ Denmark Ahemman mu firi afe 2017 kɔsi afe 2021. Sɛ́ ɔnanmusifo no, na ɔwɔ aman ntam nkitahodi ho tumi krataa bere koro mu wɔ Finland, Iceland ne Sweden .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Amerley Ollennu wɔ afe 1956 mu. Ɔyɛ Nii Amaa Ollennu, mmaranimfo, ɔtemmufo ne bere tiaa mu ɔmampanyin ne Ghana  mmrahyɛbagua no Kasafo wɔ Ɔman a Ɛto so Abien no mu no babea. Ne maame ne Nana Afua Frema Busia, Wenchi Amammerɛ Mpɔtam Hemmaa. Ne papa nua barima ne Kofi Abrefa Busia, nhomanimfo ne amammuifo a na ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanyin fi afe 1969 kosi afe 1972. Na ne mfitiaseɛ nwomasua wɔ Mmofraturo Girls’ Boarding School, Kumasi. Afei ɔkɔɔ Kumasi Adesuabea ne Apam Ntoaso Sukuu. Ɔnyaa ne abodin krataa wɔ Mmara ne Asetra mu Adesua mu wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma Sukuupɔn mu . Ɔnyaa MA wɔ Nkɔsoɔ Adesua mu a ɔde n’adwene sii Mmea ne Nkɔsoɔ so wɔ Institute of Social Studies a ɛwɔ The Hague, Netherlands . Ɔsan nso wɔ EMBA wɔ Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration ne Diploma wɔ Principles of Management mu wɔ The College of Professional Management a ɛwɔ Jersey, UK . Ɔwɔ adwumayɛfoɔ asɔremma a ɛfiri Network for Women’s Rights (NETRIGHT) Ghana, Ghana Institute of Management ne Institute of Human Resource Management Practitioners (IHRMP).

Adwuma 
Wɔ ne mfitiaseɛ adwuma mu no, ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ nnipa ahoɔden sohwɛ mu wɔ Electricity Company of Ghana (ECG) baabi a ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔbaa a ɔdi kan a wɔpaw no sɛ general manager wɔ adwumakuo no abakɔsɛm mu. Na ɔyɛ Power Queens (Ladies Association of ECG) no Ɔman Titenani mpɛn pii a ɛtoatoa so. Na ɔyɛ Mmea Dwumadibea Panyin wɔ Wiase Nyinaa Amanaman Nkabom Fekuw (WFUNA) Afrika Dwumadibea a ɛwɔ Ghana. Ɔyɛ Co-Founder Executive Director a ɔwɔ mpɔtam hɔ NGO, Association of African Women in Development (AAWID) no mu. Na ɔyɛ Ɔmanpanyin Abadiakyiri wɔ Society for Women and AIDS in Africa (SWAA) Ghana. Ɔsan nso ayɛ adwuma sɛ primary care field kyerɛkyerɛfo wɔ mpɔtam a wonnya mmoa pii wɔ Ghana ne nsɛm a esisi sohwɛ mu.

Ɔnanmusifo a wɔpaw no 
Wɔ July 2017 mu no, Ɔmanpanyin Nana Akuffo-Addo bɔɔ Awua-Asamoa din sɛ Ghana ananmusifoɔ wɔ Denmark. Na ɔka Ghanafoɔ foforɔ aduonu mmienu a wɔabobɔ wɔn din sɛ wɔnni Ghanafoɔ asɛmpatrɛ adwuma ahodoɔ anim wɔ wiase nyinaa no ho. N’ananmusifo bere no baa awiei wɔ January 2021 mu.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ɔyɛ Kristoni na waware Dr. Michael Awua Asamoah a ɔwɔ mma mmiɛnsa.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Martha Ama Akyaa Pobee
text:
Martha Ama Akyaa Pobee (wɔwoo no 4 September) yɛ Ghana ɔmanpanyin a wayɛ Ɔkyerɛwfo Panyin Boafo wɔ Amanaman Nkabom a ɛhwɛ Afrika so wɔ Amanaman Nkabom no Ɔkyerɛwfo Dwumadibea fi afe 2021. Wɔ saa dibea yi mu no, ɔka Amanaman Nkabom Asoɛe a Ɛhwɛ Amanyɔsɛm ne Asomdwoe Ho Nsɛm So .

Ansa na Pobee rebɛka UN ho no yɛ Ghana ɔbea a odi kan a ɔyɛ Daa Ananmusifo wɔ Amanaman Nkabom no mu . Kan Ɔmampanyin John Dramani Mahama na ɔpaw no wɔ July 2015 mu .

Nwomasua 
Pobee nyaa ne bachelor’s degree wɔ Borɔfo ne nyansapɛ mu wɔ Ghana Sukuupɔn mu na ne master’s degree wɔ nkɔso ho adesua mu wɔ International Institute of Social Studies a ɛwɔ The Hague . Ɔsan nso suaa aman ahodoɔ ntam nkitahodiɛ wɔ Graduate Institute of International and Development Studies (IHEID) ne Ɔmanfoɔ Nnwuma wɔ Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration (GIMPA).

Adwuma 
Na Pobee yɛ adwuma ho ɔnanmusifo, na na ɔsom wɔ Amannɔne Nsɛm Ho Dwumadibea . Wɔde no too Tel Aviv fi afe 2000 kosi afe 2004. Ɔyɛ Head of Chancery wɔ Ghana Aban Nnanmusini a ɛwɔ Washington DC firi afe 2006 kɔsi afe 2010.

Efi afe 2010 kosi afe 2012 no, na Pobee yɛ Amanneɛbɔ ne Ɔmanfo Nsɛm Dwumadibea no Panyin wɔ Amannɔne Nsɛm Dwumadibea. Akyiri yi ɔbɛyɛɛ Asɛmpatrɛw Panyin Abadiakyiri wɔ Ghana Aban Asoɛe a ɛwɔ Pretoria fi afe 2012 kosii sɛ Ɔmanpanyin John Dramani Mahama paw no sɛ Ghana Daa Ananmusifo wɔ UN mu wɔ July 2015.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Pobee aware John Samuel Pobee a ɔyɛ Anglikan sɔfo ne Ɔbenfo a Wɔapaw no . Afahyɛ no kɔɔ so wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu wɔ 26 July 1994. Ɔyɛ Roman Katolekni .

title: Kobi Hemaa Osisiadan
text:
Kobi Hemaa Osisiadan-Bekoe (wɔwoo no 30 Ɔbɛnem 1983) yɛ Ghanani ɔbaa a ɔyɛ adwuma, TV so ɔyɛkyerɛfo ne nkitahodi ho ɔbenfo. Ɔde bɛboro mfe du ayɛ adwuma wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ adwuma mu. Mprempren ɔyɛ nnwumakuw nkitahodi so panyin wɔ Ghana Post Company Limited na ɔhyehyɛɛ Angeles Foundation adwumakuw bi a ɛtwe adwene si mmarimaa ne mmofra ahoɔden ne adwumayɛ ho nimdeɛ so.

Nwomasua 
Ɔwɔ abodin krataa wɔ Akontaabu ne Amanneɛbɔ Nhyehyɛe mu wɔ Regent Sukuupɔn Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma Sukuupɔn a ɛwɔ Accra . Ɔkɔɔ so yɛɛ Master of Business Administration wɔ Corporate Strategy ne Economic Policy mu wɔ Maastricht School of Management wɔ Netherlands firi afe 2011 kɔsi afe 2013.

Adwuma 
N'anammɔn a edi kan wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ adwuma mu ne TV Africa baabi a ɔyɛɛ "Ghana's Pride" wɔ afe 2007 mu. Dwumadi no hwehwɛɛ sɛ wɔbɛkyerɛ Ghanafo amammerɛ a ɛyɛ fɛ no bere a wɔde Ghanafo nneɛma ahorow a ɛwɔ gua so no kyerɛ no.

Afe 2009 mu no, ɔde saa dwumadi koro no ara kɔɔ Ghana Broadcasting Corporation . Ɔyɛɛ nhyehyɛe foforo a wɔtoo din "Ohemaa Dwaso".

Ɔde n'ani kyerɛɛ Multi TV wɔ afe 2014 mu de dwumadi bi a wɔfrɛ no "Exclusive to Cancer". Wɔ afe 2015 mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ dwumadi no sohwɛfoɔ wɔ Light TV na akyiri yi ɔbɛyɛɛ Homebase TV a ɔyɛɛ anɔpa dwumadiɛ sohwɛfoɔ ne TV dwumadibea no panyin mmɔho mmienu.

Ɔyɛ TV sohwɛfoɔ wɔ Homebase television so kɔsii Oforisuo 2018.

Ɔne Homebase TV anɔpa dwumadi a wɔfrɛ no Eboboba  no yɛɛ adwuma kosii sɛ ɔde dwumadi bi a wɔfrɛ no ‘Beyond the Ballot’ a ɛyɛ asetra mu amammuisɛm ho dwumadi a ɛkɔ so wɔ TV so Dwoda biara anadwo nnɔnwɔtwe kosi anadwo nnɔn du bae.

Kobi Hemaa Osisiadan yɛ obi a nnipa pii nim no sɛ ɛnne a ɛhyɛ Made-in-Ghana nneɛma ho nkuran na ɔsan nso di ɔmanfoɔ nsɛm pii ho dwuma.

Ɔdii ne mfeɛ du wɔ Ayɛwohomumɔ 2017 mu na sɛ afahyɛ no fa no, ɔhyɛɛ fapem bi a wɔfrɛ no Angeles Foundation a ɛtwe adwene si mmarimaa ne mmofra ahoɔden, kokoram ho nkyerɛkyerɛ ne adwumayɛ ho nimdeɛ a wɔbɛma anya nkɔsoɔ so.

Mprempren ɔyɛ nnwumakuw nkitahodi so panyin wɔ Ghana Post Company Limited .

Ankorankoro asetra 
Wɔwoo Kobi Hemaa Osisiadan maa Sylvia Ofori ne Prince Anane-Acheampong Osisiadan, na ɔyɛ abofra a ɔto so anan wɔ n’awofo mma baanum mu. Ɔwaree ne mma baasa ma Owura Emmanuel Bekoe a ɔyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo wɔ Peace FM .

title: Raquel Naa Ayorkor Ammah
text:
Raquel Naa Ayorkor Ammah (wɔwoo no 12 August 1987) na wɔde stage din Raquel nim no, yɛ Ghana nnwontoni, nnwom hyehyɛfo, choreographer, odiyifo ne script kyerɛwfo. Ɔyɛ obi a wonim no kɛse wɔ ne dwom a ɛyɛ dɛ "Sweetio" a na Sarkodie .

Mfitiase asetra 
Ghanafo awofo na wɔwoo Raquel wɔ United Kingdom . Ɔne ne maame, ne nuanom mmarima baanu ne ne nuabea bi nyinii wɔ West London . Raquel kɔɔ sukuu pii efisɛ n’abusua tu kɔɔ afie mpɛn kakraa bi. Nanso, sukuu ahorow a n’ani gye ho paa no kɔɔ so yɛɛ Hogarth Mfitiase Sukuu a ɛwɔ Chiswick, ne West Thames College.

Adwuma 
Raquel hyɛɛ nnwom mu wɔ aban kwan so wɔ afe 2005 na efi saa bere no ɔne amanaman ntam nnwontofo te sɛ Mario, Movado, Young (US) Lloyd (US), Kas (Nigeria), Cabbo Snoop (Angola), Duncan Mighty (Nigeria) akyɛ asɛnka agua koro ), Stephanie Benson (Akwantuo/Ghana). Ɔyii "Odo" adi sɛ ne official hit single wɔ July 2010.

Adɔeyɛ 
Sɛ n’asetra mu asɛyɛde fa no, Raquel afi ne pɛ mu ayɛ ɔfotufo ama ankorankoro adɔe kuw bi a ɛwɔ ne mpɔtam hɔ mpɔtam wɔ Ghana a wɔfrɛ no Christ Humanitarian Foundation (CHF). Ɔyɛ adwuma sɛ ɔmanfo kamfofo ma fapem no de boa wɔn ma wɔboaboa sika ano afe biara.

Abasobɔde ne nnipa a wɔde wɔn din ma 
Ɔdii nkonim wɔ Ɔbaa Adwumfoɔ a Ɔsen Biara wɔ afe 2012 mu, wɔ YFM All Star Weekend Awards, December, 2012. Ɔsan nso nyaa din baako wɔ Hip Hop ne RnB Awards 2011.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Rama Brew
text:
Rama Brew yɛ Ghana odiyifo a waben, television so nipa ne jazz nnwontofo.

Mfitiase asetra 
Bere a na Rama yɛ abofra no na ɔpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ asawfo nanso ne papa ampene so. Afei ne maame nuabea a ɔyɛ adwuma wɔ Ghana Broadcasting Corporation (GBC) na ɔde no kyerɛɛ television.

Adwuma asetra 
Rama Brew hyɛɛ agodie mu wɔ afe 1972 mu. Ɔdii dwuma wɔ TV so samina te sɛ "Avenue A" ne "Villa Kakalika" mu. Ne sini a edi kan ne " Farewell To Dope" ma saa bere no Ghana Films, a seesei wɔfrɛ no TV3. Rama bɛyɛɛ " Ultimate Paradise " TV so dwumadi a edi kan wɔ afe 1993 mu bere a otu kɔɔ Ghana no. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ odiyifoɔ a ɔsen biara mu wɔ afe 1994. Rama nso yɛ jazz odwontofo ne nnipa a wofii jazz nnwom ase wɔ 90 mfe no mu no mu.  Na ɔyɛ ɔyɛkyerɛfo ma mmofra dwumadi bi wɔ saa bere no ‘Groove FM’. Akyiri yi ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔtemmufo wɔ TV3 nnwom talente dwumadi, ‘Mentor’ mu.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ɔwɔ ɔbabea bi a wɔfrɛ no Michelle Attoh a ɔno nso yɛ odiyifo.

Hwɛ nso 

 Kojo Paapa na ɔkyerɛwee
 Home Sweet Fie a Ɛyɛ Fɛ

title: Sandra Appiah
text:
Sandra Appiah (wɔwoo no Oforisuo 30, 1989) yɛ obi a ɔka wɔn a wɔhyehyɛɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ adwuma Face2face Africa, baabi a ɔyɛɛ CEO firi afe 2016 kɔsi afe 2020. Wɔ afe 2019 mu no, ɔde PanaGenius Inc. Face2face Africa yɛ ne ahyɛnsodeɛ titire no, PanaGenius nam ne intanɛt so nkitahodiɛ so du nnipa bɛboro ɔpepem 2 nkyɛn bosome biara na ɛnam nhyiamu te sɛ Pan-African Weekend Conference wɔ New York City ne ɔman no mu 30 Black Stars Conference & Awards so de wɔn ho hyɛ mpempem pii mu.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Appiah wɔ Ghana apuei fam wɔ kuro ketewa bi mu wɔ afe 1989 mu, tu kɔɔ Italy bere a na wadi mfe 8, na ɔte Milan .  Bere a odii mfe 12 no, n’abusua no san tu kɔɔ New York Kuropɔn mu . Appiah kɔɔ ntoaso sukuu wɔ Bronx, faako a owiee sukuu sɛ valedictorian na onyaa sika a wɔde bɛkɔ SI Newhouse School of Public Communications wɔ Syracuse Sukuupɔn mu . Ɔyɛɛ television, radio, ne sini ho adesua titiriw a na ɔwɔ agorudi mu adesua ketewaa bi, na owiee sukuu magna cum laude, a New York Times College Scholarship ne Jonathan Levin(Time Warner)Scholarship boaa no. Onyaa mmusua mu nyiyim ne gyidi ahorow a ɛnteɛ a ɛfa Afrikafo a wɔwɔ Italy ne U.S. ho, fii Amerikafo a wɔyɛ abibifo ne mmusuakuw afoforo mu nso. Ne saa nti, n’ani wui wɔ n’agyapade ho, kosii sɛ ɔsan kɔɔ Ghana wɔ n’afe a ɛto so abien wɔ sukuupɔn mu.

Adwuma 
Bere a owiee sukuu no, Appiah yɛɛ adwuma maa The New York Times, HBO, ne MTV . Na ɔyɛ siniyɛfo a ɔyɛ sini ahorow pii a wɔagye abasobɔde nso. Wɔ afe 2011 mu no, Appiah ne ne hokafoɔ Isaac O. Babu-Boateng hyɛɛ Face2Face Africa, Afrika aman nyinaa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ adwuma. Wɔn baanu no de wɔn suahu ahorow a wonyae bere a na wɔrenyin sɛ Afrikafo atubrafo wɔ United States no yɛɛ adwuma wɔ intanɛt so ne nsɛmma nhoma a wotintim sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛboa ma wɔasan ahyɛ Afrika mfonini no din wɔ wiase nyinaa. Appiah yɛ Face2face Africa nsɛmma nhoma a wɔatintim no samufo panyin. Wɔ afe 2020 mu no, wɔde PanaGenius Inc sii hɔ, a ɛbɛyɛ awofoɔ adwumakuo ama Face2face Africa ne digyital platforms foforɔ.

Appiah nso ayɛ intanɛt so ɔkasa dwumadi, abisabisa afoforo nsɛm ne Jesse Jackson, Alek Wek, Femi Kuti, Serge Ibaka, ne Lira . Wakasa wɔ nhyiam ahorow ne nhyiam ahorow a ɛfa Afrika, mmea tumidi, ne asetra mu nsɛm afoforo a ɛfata ho.

title: Jemila Abdulai
text:
Jemila Wumpini Abdulai yɛ Ghanani blogger, ɔkyerɛwfo ne dijitaal aguadifo. Wɔ afe 2007 mu no, ɔhyehyɛɛ Circumspecte.com, asetena ho blog a wɔde ama Afrikafoɔ. Ne blog no nyaa African Blogger Awards wɔ afe 2016.

Wɔ afe 2015 mu no, wɔde Jemila asɛm tiawa, "Yennenga" kaa Caine Prize Anthology 2015 nwoma no ho: "Lusaka Punk ne Asɛm Afoforo." Na Afrikafo akyerɛwfo nsɛm ntiantiaa afoforo 16 nso kaa nhoma no ho.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Jemila yɛ Mohammed-Sani Abdulai, Madina Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma Asoɛe, Accra titrani abadiakyiri no babea.

Nwomasua 
Jemila nyaa ne ntoaso sukuu wɔ Wesley Girls’ High School a ɛwɔ Cape Coast, Ghana, na owiee Mount Holyoke College a ɛwɔ Massachusetts, USA a ɔyɛɛ Sikasɛm ne Franse kasa ho adesua mmɔho abien.

Ɔsan nyaa Master of Arts abodin krataa wɔ Amanaman Ntam Sikasɛm ne Amanaman Ntam Abusuabɔ mu wɔ Johns Hopkins Sukuupɔn SAIS a ɛwɔ Washington DC, U.S.A.

Nsɛm a wɔka de gyina akyi 
Ɔyɛ obi a ɔkamfo mmea hokwan ahorow wɔ Ghana, na ɔsan nso bɔ nne wɔ social media, wɔ nsɛmti a ɛfa mfiridwuma, mmea tumidi, ne ɔman nkɔso ho. Jemila nso yɛ #SisterhoodMatters, afe afe adeyɛ bi a wɔyɛ wɔ Ghana a ɛhyɛ Afrika mmaa afahyɛ na ɛde nkɔmmɔdie a ɛfa mmaa akwahosan ne wɔn yiedie ho ba.

Wɔ afe 2016 mu no, Jemila Abdulai, a ɔyɛ BloggingGhana – Ghanafoɔ blogfoɔ kuo bi sohyial media kannifoɔ, boaa ma wɔboaboaa nsɛm a ɛnyɛ ɔfã biara akyi wɔ Ghana 2016 Amansan Abatoɔ no ano na wɔkyekyɛɛ mu denam social media so . Na eyi wɔ nhyehyɛe a ɛne "Ghana Decides" ase. Jemila Abdulai kaa sɛ wɔn botaeɛ ne sɛ wɔde adwene a ɛnni animhwɛ bɛkyerɛ wɔ abatoɔ no ho: "Atetesɛm mu nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a ɛwɔ Ghana agye din sɛ wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ amammuisɛm mu, titire wɔ abatoɔ berɛ mu." Ɛno nti na social media nhyehyɛe te sɛ Ghana Decides ho hia." 

Jemila Abdulai yɛ akasafoɔ no mu baako wɔ TEDxAccraWomen nhyiamu a wɔyɛɛ no 28 Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 2016 wɔ Accra, Ghana.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Eno Barony
text:
Ruth Eno Adjoa Amankwah Nyame Adom (wɔwoo no 30 Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 1991), a wɔde ne stage din Eno Barony frɛ no wɔ adwumayɛ mu no yɛ Ghana rapfo ne nnwom kyerɛwfo .  Wɔwoo no wɔ Tema, Accra, ɔyii ne debut single, "Wats Ma Name" ne nso "Tonga", remix a ɛyɛ dwom "Tonga" a Joey B ft Sarkodie yɛeɛ wɔ afe 2014 mu a ɛmaa no kɔɔ limelight. Wɔkae sɛ ɔno ne ɔbea rapfo a odi kan a nnipa ɔpepem biako hwɛɛ no wɔ YouTube so .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Rapper Eno Barony Ruth Eno Adjoa Amankwah Nyame Adom wɔ Ghana hyɛn gyinabea ne adwumayɛ kuropɔn Tema, maa agya, Ɔsɔfo Abraham Nyame Adom ne ne maame, Awuraa. Rebecca Nyame Adom. Eno fii ne sukuu ase wɔ Shallom Preparatory School na ɔkɔɔ Cambridge Academy kɔyɛɛ ne mfitiase sukuu a ɛba fam. Owiee ne ntoaso sukuu wɔ Methodist JHS na ɔtoaa ne ntoaso sukuu a ɛto so abien wɔ Methodist Day Secondary School wɔ Tema na ɔkɔɔ so nyaa ne ntoaso sukuu wɔ Kumasi Polytechnic .

Nnwom adwuma 
Ɛwom sɛ na wadi kan akyere nnwom afoforo agu hama so deɛ, nanso Eno baa adwene mu kɛseɛ berɛ a ɔyii ne nnwom a ɛdi kan, "Tonga", wɔ afe 2014 mu, a ɛnyaa aguadiɛ airplay . Akyiri yi ɔkyeree nnwom pii a "Megye Wo Boy" ka ho wɔ afe 2015 mu, a ɔne Abrewa Nana yɛɛ adwuma wɔ ho . Afe 2015 mu no, ne maame wui. Asram pii a ɔde dii awerɛhow akyi no, ɔde hip hop dwom a wɔato din "The Best" a ɔne Togoni nnwontofo a wagye abasobɔde pii ne Brand Ambassador ma Togocel, Mic Flammez, bubuu kommyɛ no. Ɔkyeree nnwom baako, "Daawa", ne Shatta Wale wɔ afe 2016. Saa afe no ara mu no, ɔne rapfo Kwaw Kese yɛɛ biako wɔ nnwom bi a wɔfrɛ no "GARI" mu. Ɔsan nso yɛɛ adwuma wɔ nnwom afoforo abien a ɛyɛ biako mu, "Touch the Body" ne Stonebwoy, ne "King of Queens" ne Medikal . Wɔ afe 2017 mu no, ɔyii dwom bi a wɔato din "Juice Me" adi akyi no, ɔyii dwom foforɔ a ɔne Ebony Reigns, a wɔtoo din "Obiaa Ba Ny3".

Abasobɔde, nnipa a wɔayi wɔn din ne nea wɔatumi ayɛ 
Ɛwom sɛ wonim no sɛ ɔyɛ rap de, nanso ɔne Stay Jay, FlowKing Stone, Dr Cryme ne adwumfo afoforo a wɔagye din yɛɛ Save Mama Today adwuma no. Wɔ afe 2014 mu no, wɔde no too gua sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ Vodafone Ghana Music Awards a edi kan wɔ ɔfã a wɔanto dwom no mu. Ɔne Popcaan ne Jah Vinci bɔɔ nnwom wɔ Ghana Nnwom Nnawɔtwe a wɔyɛe wɔ Accra Agumadi Agumadibea no mu . Ɔsan nso yɛɛ Closeup afahyɛ no asɛmti ne Ghana rapfo, Sarkodie . Wɔyii no sɛ ɔmmɛgye Jigwe abasobɔdeɛ. Ne adwuma a ɔne Togoni Mcee Mic Flammez yɛe no nyaa nomination sɛ Best Hiphop video wɔ 4Syte Music Video Awards. Ɔtuu mmirika maa Rapfoɔ a Ɔyɛ Mmea a Ɔsen Biara na wɔyii no sɛ ɔmfa Jigwe Abasobɔdeɛ a ɛfa Nnwom Foforo a Ɛsen Biara ho afe a ɛdi hɔ no. Wɔ afe 2015 mu no, ɔbɔɔ nnwom afe a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa a ɛtoatoa so wɔ Ghana Music Week Festival. . Ɔbɔɔ nnwom wɔ Ghana DJ Awards ne Ghana Freedom Concert (S Concert) ase. Saa afe no ara mu no ɔyɛɛ Joy FM Old School reunion no asɛmti ne Stonebwoy na ɔde ne ho hyɛɛ Adom FM ’s Temafest mu wɔ afe 2016 mu kaa artistes afoforo ho. Wɔyɛɛ no nnwom sohwɛfoɔ wɔ Ghana Meets Naija 2017. Rapfo a wɔpaw no yiye wɔ Vodafone Ghana Music Wards 2018. Wɔ November 2020 mu no, onyaa African Muzik Magazine Awards (AFRIMMA) abasobɔde a ɛfa Mmea Rap Dwumadi a Ɛsen Biara wɔ Afrika ho.

Wɔ Oforisuo 2021 mu no, ɔkaa Mmea 30 a Wɔanya Nkɛntɛnso Kɛseɛ wɔ Nnwom mu no ho denam 3Music Awards Women’s Brunch no so.  Ɔnyaa abasobɔdeɛ wɔ afe 2021 3Music Awards mu de bɛyɛɛ ɔbaa adwumfoɔ a ɔdi kan wɔ Ghana a wanya ‘Rapper of the Year’ abasobɔdeɛ. Ɔbɛyɛɛ Ghanani ɔbaa a ɔdi kan a wɔmaa no Best Rapper wɔ VGMA a ɔdii nnipa te sɛ Sarkodie, Amerado, Medikal, Strongman ne Joey B so nkonim wɔ afe 2021.

title: Sista Afia
text:
Francisca Gawugah (wɔwoo no 7th January 1993) a wonim no sɛ stage din Sista Afia, yɛ Ghana odwontofo ne nnwom kyerɛwfo a ofi Accra. Ɔnyaa agyedeɛ wɔ ne nnwom "Jeje" a ɔyii no adi akyi, a dancehall artist Shatta Wale ne Afezi Perry ka ho.

Mfiase asetra ne adwuma 
Sista Afia yɛ Afro-pop nnwontofo, na ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔsɔfopɔn Nicholas Duncan-Williams wɔfase . Onyinii wɔ Accra ne Kumasi . Ɔkɔɔ Reverend John Teye Memorial Institute ansa na ɔretu akɔ UK akɔ akyiri wɔ ayarehwɛ mu.

Sista Afia san baa Ghana wɔ afe 2015 mu sɛ ɔrebɛhyɛ ne nnwom adwuma ase. Ɔgyee nhyɛsoɔ firii nnwontofoɔ Bisa Kdei hɔ na ɔyɛɛ adwuma boom wɔ dwom ' Kro Kro No'.

Akyinnyegye ahorow 
Sista Afia ne rapfo Freda Rhymz dii honam fam aseresɛm bere a wɔde nnwom a ɛyɛ dɛ dii agoru akyi.

title: Joy Henrietta Mensa-Bonsu
text:
Henrietta Anigyeɛ Abena Nyarko Mensa-Bonsu, JSC, FGA (wɔwoo no Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 29, afe 1957) yɛ Asɛnnibea Kunini Temmufo wɔ Republic of Ghana . Ɔmampanyin Nana-Akufo-Addo na ɔpaw no . Ɔyɛ ɔbea a ɔto so 5 wɔ Asɛnnibea no muni. Ansa na wɔrepaw no sɛ Asɛnnibea Kunini no, na ɔyɛ Ghana mmara ho ɔbenfo a ɔsom sɛ Amanaman Nkabom Kuw a Ɛhwɛ Asomdwoe Dwumadi So a ɛde ne ho no muni.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Mensa-Bonsu wɔ Ɔkɔtɔber 29, 1957 wɔ Kumasi. Ɔkɔɔ Wesley Girls High School, Ghana Suapɔn ne Yale Suapɔn, na onyaa Master of Laws (LLM) wɔ afe 1985 mu.

Adwuma 
Mensa-Bonsu yɛ ɔbenfo ne mmara ho ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo panyin wɔ Ghana Sukuupɔn mmara sukuu mu. Ɔbɛyɛɛ mmara ho ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo a ɔdi mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu wɔ afe 2002 mu, na afe 2003 mu no wɔpaw no sɛ ɔyɔnko wɔ Ghana Adesuabea a ɛhwɛ Adwinni ne Nyansahu so . Wɔpaw no sɛ Adesuabea no Titenani wɔ afe 2019 mu.

Ɔde nhyiam ase a ɔwɔ no adi dwuma de akamfo asomdwoe a ɛbɛma ɔman no anya nkɔso ntɛmntɛm. Na ɔyɛ ɔkasafo ahɔho wɔ Afe afe Asomdwoe Ɔkasa a Ɛto so Abien a Rotary Kuw ne Institute for Democratic Governance (IDEG) ti a ɛwɔ Accra West boaboaa ano no mu, faako a ɔkaa "hia a ehia sɛ wɔma asomdwoe nya nkɔso" ho asɛm a wantwɛn "kosi sɛ ɛho behia ama asomdwoeɛ ansa na yɛakɔ akɔhwehwɛ". Ɔmaa afe 2014 University of Ghana Alumni Association ɔkasa a ɛfa asɛmti "Abibiman Nkabom Kuo no Asomdwoeɛ ne Ahobanbɔ Nhyehyɛeɛ: Asomdwoeɛ ne ahobanbɔ ho bɔhyɛ wɔ asasepɔn no so"

Wɔ afe 2017 mu no, Mensa-Bonsu antumi wɔ mmɔden a ɔbɔe sɛ wɔbɛpaw no sɛ Amanaman Ntam Nsɛmmɔnedi Asɛnnibea (ICC) no Temmufo no mu . Na ɔyɛ Ɔmampanyin Bagua a Ɛhwɛ Nhwehwɛmu So a ɛhwehwɛɛ Ayawaso West Wuogon abatow mu basabasayɛ no mu no muni .  Mprempren ɔyɛ Ghana Adesuabea a ɛhwɛ adwinni ne nyansahu so no titrani.

Asɛnnibea Kunini no paw 
Mensa-Bonsu na Nana Addo Danquah Akufo-Addo, Ghana Ɔmanpanyin na ɔpaw no wɔ May 2020 mu sɛ wonsusuw ho sɛ wɔbɛpaw no sɛ ɔnkɔ Ghana Asɛnnibea Kunini no benkyi so .

Ɔmampanyin Nana-Akufo-Addo ne atemmufo baasa afoforo de ne din kɔmaa  mmrahyɛbagua no sɛ wɔmpaw no sɛ Asɛnnibea Kunini no benkyi. Afoforo no ne Ɔtemmufo Clemence Jackson Honyenuga, Ɔtemmufo Issifu Omoro Tanko Amadu ne Ɔtemmufo Emmanuel Yonny Kulendi .  mmrahyɛbagua no penee so bere a Boayikuw a Wɔpaw no kamfoo no kyerɛe akyi.Ɔmampanyin Nana Akufo-Addo na ɔkaa no ntam sɛ ɔbɛdi tumi .

Ankorankoro asetra 
Mensa-Bonsu aware Kwaku Mensa-Bonsu na wɔwɔ mmabea baasa a wɔanyinyin, mmanana baanum, mmabarima baasa a wɔagye wɔn atom ne mmanana baasa a wɔagye wɔn atom.

Hwɛ nso 

 Ghana Asɛnnibea Kunini
 Ghana Asɛnnibea Kunini no atemmufo din
 Ghana Adesuabea a ɛhwɛ adwinni ne nyansahu so
