title: Akua Asabea Ayisi
text:
Akua Asabea Ayisi (3 April 1927 – 21 April 2010) yɛ ɔbea ho ɔbenfo, kan Asɛnnibea Kunini Temmufo ne ɔbea a odi kan a ɔyɛ Ghana nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo.  Bere a Ghana ahofadi kuw no resɔre no, Akua Asabea Ayisi ne Mabel Dove-Danquah ne Kwame Nkrumah, a akyiri yi ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔman no ɔmanpanyin ne ɔmanpanyin a odi kan no tetee ne ho sɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo.

Wobuu Ayisi gyinabea sɛ mmea asɛmti a ɛtwe adwene si mmea nsɛm so no samufo wɔ Accra Evening News atesɛm krataa mu sɛ adeyɛ a emu yɛ den saa bere no.

Abusua ne mmofraase asetra 
Wɔwoo Akua Asabea Ayisi wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosom ne da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa wɔ afe apen ahankron aduonu-nson (1927), wɔ Akuapim-Mampong . Ɔyɛ ba a ɔto so awotwe wɔ 10 a Mercy Adebra Mensah ne Okyeame Kofi Ayisi woo wɔn no mu.

Na Kofi Ayisi yɛ adehye ne kasa ho nimdefo ma Ɔhene a ɔno nso yɛ ne busuani. Na Akua Asabea Ayisi papa nuanom binom yɛ adehye fetish asɔfo. Kofi Ayisi woo mma 70, na wɔn mu 10 fi Mercy Adebra. Ayisi maame, Mercy Adebra nana, Tetteh Quarshie, duaa koko dua a edi kan wɔ Ghana. Mercy Adebra, ɔbea bi a ɔyɛ basabasa a na ɔpɛ sɛ ɔde ne ho no, awiei koraa no ogyaw Kofi Ayisi na otu kɔɔ Accra sɛ ɔrekɔbɛn n’abusua a na wɔyɛ Gas .

Akua Asabea Ayisi kɔɔ mfitiaseɛ sukuu wɔ Presbyterian Primary a ɛwɔ Mampong, na ɛno akyi no ɔkɔɔ Presbyterian Girls School wɔ Osu, Accra. Afei ɔkɔɔ Aban Ɔkyerɛwfo Sukuu no mu kowiee ne nhomasua. Saa bere no, na ɛntaa mma sɛ ɔbea benya nhomasua a ɛkorɔn saa. Nanso, na ne maame gye mmea nhomasua di paa.

Adwuma ne dwumadi a wɔyɛ 
Bere a Ayisi kɔkaa Convention People’s Party (CPP) a Kwame Nkrumah di wɔn anim no ho no, ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔbea nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a odi kan a wɔkyerɛw ne din wɔ Ghana (1948). Ɔne Nkrumah yɛɛ adwuma wɔ Accra Evening News, da biara da atesɛm krataa a kan ɔmampanyin no de sii hɔ wɔ afe 1948 mu, na ɔkyerɛw amammuisɛm nkratawa a ɛhwehwɛ sɛ wonya ahofadi na ɛboaboaa Ghanafo ano ma wɔsɔre tia atubrafo nniso. Ɔhwɛɛ mmaa asɛm a ɛwɔ atesɛm krataa no kratafa a ɛdi kan no so – ɔfa a Nkrumah de baeɛ sɛ ne botaeɛ a ɛne sɛ ɔbɛma mmaa so wɔ Ghana denam mmabaa nwomasua a ɔbɛtrɛ mu no fã. Accra Anwummere Amanneɛbɔ a wɔde sii hɔ wɔ 6 March 1949 no ne bere a woyii Nkrumah fii United Gold Coast Convention (UGCC) Party no Ɔkyerɛwfo Panyin no adwumayɛbea no hyiae. Ɛdenam atesɛm krataa no so no, na Nkrumah pɛ sɛ ɔko ma "ankasa nniso a edi mũ, ɛnyɛ bere tiaa bi mu, na mmom mprempren."  Esiane sɛ na Nkrumah ayɛ atesɛm nkrataa ne nhoma ahorow pii wɔ ne bere a na ɔyɛ sukuuni ɔdeyɛfo nti, obuu nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ sɛ adwinnade titiriw a wɔde boaboa nhomasua ne amammuisɛm ano.

Wɔ August 1948 mu no, Ayisi ne Kofi Baako, Cape Coast Daily Mail samufo, ne Saki Scheck, Takoradi Times samufo fii ase maa ɔkasa akwantu ahorow wɔ ɔman no mu nyinaa, na wɔhyɛɛ ɔsɔretia a wɔsɔre tia ahemman nniso ho nkuran. Akyiri yi ɔbɛyɛɛ Kwame Nkrumah kokoam kyerɛwfo a odi kan (1950–56) na ɔboaa Nkrumah ma ɔkyerɛw nsɛm a ɛboa ahofadi de ko tiaa Britania ahemman nniso, te sɛ "ne ahemman no wu."

Ɔde ne ho hyɛɛ amammui mu ɔsɔretia ahorow a wɔtoo din " Positive Action campaign " mu na akyiri yi wɔkyeree no de no too afiase esiane sɛ ɔde ne ho hyɛɛ mu nti. Nea ɛka ɔsɔretia no ho ne adwumayɛban mu adwumayɛ a wɔhwehwɛe sɛ wɔmma amannɔne nnwuma, na ɛhyɛɛ atuatew pii nkuran wɔ Gold Coast atubraman no nyinaa mu.

Wobu Ayisi sɛ odii dwuma titiriw wɔ Nkrumah amammerɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔhyehyɛe na wɔde dii dwuma no mu.

Wɔ ahofadi akyi bere tiaa bi no, Ayisi kɔɔ Newnham College wɔ Cambridge Sukuupɔn mu, faako a osuaa Abakɔsɛm, na osuaa matric wɔ afe 1959. Wɔfrɛɛ no kɔɔ Bar a ɛwɔ Lincoln’s Inn wɔ 1963 mu. Efi 1963 kosi 1964 no, Newnham College kyerɛwtohɔ ahorow kyerɛw ne ho sɛ ɔreyɛ adwuma wɔ Paris-Sorbonne Sukuupɔn mu .

Akyiri yi ɔsan baa Ghana no, Ayisi fii ase yɛɛ adwuma sɛ mmaranimfo, na awiei koraa no ɔbɛyɛɛ Asɛnnibea Kunini Temmufo. Esiane sɛ na ɔnyɛ amammuisɛm nti, wanpira no bere a asraafo no tuu Kwame Nkrumah aban gui no.

Wɔ afe 1968 mu no, ɔde ne ho hyɛɛ  mmrahyɛbagua a na ɛyɛ n’asɛyɛde sɛ wɔkyerɛw amansan mmara foforo no wɔ Kwame Nkrumah a wotuu no gui wɔ afe 1966 mu no mu.

Wɔ afe 1969 mu no, Ayisi yɛ mmea a wodii kan tuu mmirika kɔɔ  mmrahyɛbagua mu no mu biako, na ɔyɛɛ saa wɔ Akuapem Atifi Mantam mu, na awiei koraa no ɔhweree. Wɔ afe 1978 mu no, ɔboa ma wɔkyerɛw amansan mmara foforo a Ɔsahene Akuffo de sii hɔ no, bere a Ghana sesa fii Asraafo Bagua Kunini (SMC) so kɔɔ demokrase nniso so no.

Owuo 
Akua Asabea Ayisi wui wɔ 21 Ɔpɛpɔn 2010.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Marie Humbert
text:
Marie Humbert yɛ Switzerland-Ghana odiyifo. Ɔnyaa din mmienu wɔ afe 2016 Ghana Movie Awards mu sɛ obi a ɔhunuu no yie ne odiyifoɔ a ɔdi mu paa, ne 10th Africa Movie Academy Awards nso wɔ 10th Africa Movie Academy Awards mu sɛ ɔyɛ odiyifoɔ a ɔboaa no paa. Ɔne n’abusua nyinii wɔ aman asia so. Ne papa yɛ Swiss Franseni a ɔfiri Geneva na ne maame yɛ Ghanani a ɔfiri Akim Oda, wɔ Apueeɛ mantam mu.

Adwuma 
Humbert dii "Ebaner" wɔ mfeɛ 40 mu ne Single, a ɔdii nkonim wɔ atiefoɔ abasobɔdeɛ a ɛfa episodic pilot wɔ 2018 LA Film Festival ne "Susan" wɔ Potomanto, a ɛyɛ ne feature film a ɛdi kan na onyaa Africa Movie Academy Award for Best Actress in a Supporting Dwumadie a wɔde too gua ne Ghana Movie Award a wɔde too gua.  Ɔdii "Makena" wɔ An African City, kaa ne dwumadie wɔ sini no mu sɛ ɛyɛ n'ankasa suahunu a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɔtu kɔɔ Ghana mfeɛ kakra a atwam no. Ɔka Issa Rae ne Meryl Streep ne afoforo ho asɛm sɛ nnwuma mu adwumayɛfo a wɔhyɛ no nkuran. Wɔ 2016 Ghana Movie Awards, Humbert nyaa nominations sɛ odiyifoɔ a ɔsen biara wɔ drama series ne discovery of the year categories mu. Abasobɔde ho guasodeyɛ a wɔyɛe wɔ Kempinski Gold Coast Hotel, Accra wɔ December mu. Nnansa yi ara na Marie yii ne ho adi wɔ 2020 Netflix sini The Set Up mu.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Humbert fi Ghana ne Switzerland. Ɔsuaa agodie adwini wɔ Cours Florent wɔ Paris baabi a ɔnyaa ‘The Lesley Chatterley’ nkonimboɔ a ɛyɛ odiyifoɔ a ɔsen biara wɔ afe 2009 mu. Ansa na ɛno reba no, Onyaa adwinni ho abodin krataa wɔ Deakin Sukuupɔn a ɛwɔ Melbourne, Australia, a na ɔyɛ Drama ho adesua titiriw. Onim Borɔfo ne Franse kasa yiye.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Dorcas Coker-Appiah
text:
Dorcas Ama Frema Coker-Appiah (wɔwoo no 17 August 1946) yɛ Ghana mmaranimfo ne mmaa hokwan ho ɔbenfo, na ɔyɛ Gender Studies and Human Rights Documentation Center, a wɔsan frɛ no "Gender Centre", wɔ Accra, Ghana no kwankyerɛfoɔ panin. Wanya (na ɔda so ara wɔ) dwumadi ahorow a ɛho hia wɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow pii a ɛhyɛ mmea hokwan ahorow ho nkuran wɔ ɔman, ɔmantam ne amanaman ntam.

Mfitiase asetra 
Wɔwoo Dorcas Ama Frema Coker-Appiah wɔ 17 August 1946 wɔ Wenchi, wɔ Britania atubraman a ɛwɔ Gold Coast (mprempren Ghana) mu. Wɔ afe 1970 mu no, Coker-Appiah nyaa mmara ho abodin krataa wɔ Ghana Sukuupɔn mu .

Adwuma 
Wɔ afe 1974 mu no, na Coker-Appiah yɛ obi a ɔhyehyɛɛ FIDA Ghana, na ɔyɛɛ ɔmanpanyin abadiakyiri fi afe 1988 kosi afe 1989, na ɔdii n’akyi sɛ ɔmanpanyin fi afe 1990 kosi afe 1991. Ɔasom sɛ FIDA mmara mmoa akwankyerɛ boayikuw no titrani, ne mmara, akenkan ne akyerɛw ne nhoma tintim boayikuw no adwuma no sohwɛfo mfe bi.

Coker-Appiah yɛ Ɔbarima ne Ɔbea Nna Ho Adesua ne Hokwan a Nnipa Wɔ Ho Nkyerɛwde Asoɛe no kwankyerɛfo panyin .

Coker-Appiah yɛ Women in Law and Development in Africa (WiLDAF), Pan-African nkitahodi a ɛyɛ ahyehyɛde ne ankorankoro a emufo wɔ Afrika aman aduonu nsia mu no muni, na ɔyɛ WiLDAF Ghana a ɔhyehyɛɛ no ne ne Afrika mantam no guamtrani agyinatukuo.

Wɔ September 2017 mu no, ɔdii adwumayɛbea bi anim maa "Afrikafoɔ mmaa a wɔdi kan" kuo bi wɔ South Africa ahyehyɛdeɛ Masimanyane Women's Rights International, ne Dr Hilda Tadria, a ɔyɛ Mentoring and Empowerment Program for Young Women in Uganda no kwankyerɛfoɔ panin, na ɔde maeɛ "adwumayɛbea a tumi wom a ɛbue agyanom mpanyimfo nhyehyɛe no mu".

Nhoma ahorow 
Breaking the Silence & Challenging the Myths of Violence Tia Mmea ne Mmofra wɔ Ghana: Amanneɛbɔ a ɛfa Ɔman Nhwehwɛmu bi a ɛfa Basabasayɛ ho (Gender Studies & Human Rights Documentation Centre, 1999,  .

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Nana Darkoa Sekyiamah
text:
Nana Darkoa Sekyiamah yɛ Ghana ɔbea ho ɔkyerɛwfo ne blogger. Ɔne obi a ɔhyehyɛɛ blog a wɔagye abasobɔde a wɔfrɛ no Adventures from the Bedrooms of African Women na wakyerɛw ama The Guardian ne Open Democracy . Sekyiamah yɛ Nkitahodi ho Ɔkwankyerɛfo panyin wɔ Fekuw a Ɛhwɛ Mmea Hokwan wɔ Nkɔso mu so na ɔyɛ Abibifo Mmea Ho Nhyiam Adwuma Kuw a wɔyɛɛ abakɔsɛm mu Abibifo Mmea Nhyiam a edi kan ho nhyehyɛe wɔ Bahia, Brazil no muni .

Abrabɔ ashɛase 
Wɔwoo Nana Darkoa Sekyiamah wɔ London, England, na n’awofo yɛ Ghanafo, na onyinii wɔ Ghana. Ɔwɔ adansedi krataa wɔ adwumayɛ ho ntetee mu ne adansedi krataa wɔ ntawntawdi ntamgyinafo mu na wayɛ adwuma sɛ asetra mu ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo ne baguam ɔkasafo . North London Sukuupɔn nso maa no Nyansahu mu abodin krataa wɔ nkitahodi ne amammerɛ ho adesua mu ne Nyansahu mu abodin krataa a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne nkɔso ho wɔ London Sukuu a Ɛhwɛ Sikasɛm ne Amanyɔsɛm So . Wayɛ adwuma nso sɛ akannifo nteteefo ama London Metropolitan Police .

Sekyiamah boom hyehyɛɛ blog, Adventures from the Bedrooms of African Women, sɛ ɛbɛboa ma wɔatrɛw nna ne nna ho nkɔmmɔbɔ a Afrika mmea bɔ mu na ama wɔanya baabi a wɔbɛkasa pefee. Ɔnyaa nkonimboɔ wɔ blog a ɛyɛ papa wɔ ne nyinaa mu ne activist blog a ɛyɛ papa wɔ afe 2013 Ghana Blogging and Social Media Awards mu ne blog a ɛyɛ papa wɔ ne nyinaa mu bio wɔ afe 2014. Wɔ March 2011 mu no, Arise nsɛmma nhoma gyee Sekyiamah toom sɛ "Ghana Nsakraeyɛfo" no mu biako. Sekyiamah ne Fab Fem, mmea kuw bi a wohyiam daa wɔ Accra .

Sekyiamah akyerɛw nsɛm ama The Guardian, This Is Africa ne Open Democracy . Ɔkyerɛw Communications Handbook for Women’s Rights Organizations na wanya nsɛm ntiantiaa a wɔatintim wɔ nhoma ahorow a wɔaboaboa ano mu wɔ aman pii so. Sekyiamah akyerɛw pii afa Afrika mmea nna ho na wanya asɛm bi nso ("Standpoint: Adventures from Our Bedrooms – Blogging about diverse erotic experiences") a wɔatintim wɔ nhomasua nsɛmma nhoma a atipɛnfo ahwɛ mu Feminist Africa mu.

Sekyiamah yɛ adwuma sɛ Nkitahodi sohwɛfo wɔ Fekuw a Ɛhwɛ Mmea Hokwan wɔ Nkɔso mu (AWID). Ɔyɛ Black Feminism Forum Adwumayɛkuw no muni. Ɔne afoforo kyerɛw Creating Spaces and Amplifying Voices: The First Ten Years of the African Women’s Development Fund a ɛfa sikakorabea no mfitiase abakɔsɛm ho. Ɔsan nso kyerɛw Women Leading Africa: Conversations with Inspirational African Women, nsɛm a wobisabisaa mmea a wofi Afrika nyinaa wɔ nsɛmti a nea ɛka ho ne mmea ho asɛm, amammuisɛm ne adwinni a ɛnam adwuma a ɔne AWDF yɛe so bae.

Sekyiamah yɛ ɔkasafoɔ wɔ afe 2015 Writivism Afahyɛ a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Kampala, Uganda, ne afe 2016 Aké Adwinni ne Nhoma Afahyɛ a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Abeokuta, Nigeria .

Wɔ afe 2021 mu no, Sekyiamah nyaa nhoma bi a wɔaboaboa ano a wɔato din The Sex Lives of African Women a Dialogue tintimii, a wɔkaa ho asɛm wɔ nhwehwɛmu bi a Margaret Busby yɛe mu sɛ "adwuma a ɛyɛ nwonwa a ɛyɛ nnam". Akyiri yi wɔyɛɛ agoprama so dwumadi bi a wɔadan no wɔ Nairobi, Kenya .

Wɔ December 2022 mu no, wɔbɔɔ Sekyiamah din wɔ BBC 's 100 Women list mu sɛ wiase no mu mmea a wɔhyɛ nkuran na wɔwɔ nkɛntɛnso wɔ afe no mu no mu biako.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Akyaawa Yikwan
text:
Na Akyaawa Yikwan yɛ adehye bi a ofi Asante Ahemman mu a ɔyɛɛ nkitahodifo panyin wɔ 1831 Anglo-Asante asomdwoe apam no mu.

Akyi asɛm 
Akyaawa Yikwan yɛ ɔhene Osei Kwadwo a ɔfiri Ashanti Ahemman a ɛwɔ Afrika Atɔeɛ fam no babaa. Na ne maame yɛ ɔhene Osei Kwadwo yere a ɔyɛ amanne.

Ashantifoɔ gye toɔ firi abankɛseɛ ne abankɛseɛ a ɛwɔ Ghana mpoano abɔsoɔ no mu bɛyɛ afeha a ɛtɔ so dunwɔtwe no mfimfini. Bere a wɔhweree Akatamanso ko a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ anafo fam aman ne Ashanti ahemman ntam a ɛmaa wogyee Ga-Adangme ne anafo fam aman a aka no fii Ashanti nsam, ne Ashanti wurayɛ a wogyaee wɔ wɔn nsase so no no, Wɔkyeree Akyaawa Yikwan a wɔkaa ne ho asɛm sɛ "ɔbea a ɔwɔ ɔbarima honhom" na wɔde no dii gua maa Denmarkfo. Wokunkum ne nuanom baanu wɔ ɔko no mu na wotwaa n’asew Oti Payin ti.

Asomdwoe apam 
Aguadifo Bagua a ɛwɔ Accra a na Britaniafo ka ho no tee nka sɛ wobetumi de Akyaawa Yikwan dibea no abue nkitahodi ne aguadi hokwan ahorow ne Kumasi, Ashanti Ahemman no ahenkurow no. Britaniafo tɔɔ Akyaawa Yikwan na wogyaee no wɔ afe 1831 mu sɛ ɔsomafo wɔ Ashanti ahemman no mu de bɔɔ mmɔden sɛ obebue aguadi akwan wɔ aman abien no ntam.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Belinda Royall
text:
Belinda Sutton (wɔwoo no afe 1713 wɔ Afrika Atɔeɛ fam), a wɔsan frɛ no Belinda Royall, yɛ ɔbaa bi a wɔwoo no wɔ Ghana a Royall abusua no de no yɛɛ akoa wɔ Isaac Royall Fie a ɛwɔ Medford, Massachusetts, U.S.A. Isaac Royall Kumaa, gyaw no hɔ bere a oguan kɔɔ Nova Scotia wɔ Amerika Ɔman Anidan no mfiase no.

Wɔ February 1783 mu no, Sutton de adesrɛ kɔmaa Massachusetts Asɛnnibea Kunini no sɛ wɔsrɛɛ pɛnhyen sika mfi sika a wonya fi n’akoa no agyapade mu no mu. Esiane saa adesrɛ yi nti, wɔde afe afe pɛnhyen sika a ɛyɛ nkaribo dunum ne shilling dumien maa no. Wɔaka saa pɛnhyen sika yi ho asɛm sɛ ɛyɛ nsɛm a edi kan a wɔde tuaa nkoasom ne nkoatɔn ho ka no mu biako.

Adesrɛ ahorow a edi hɔ a wɔde kɔmaa Commonwealth of Massachusetts no kyerɛ sɛ bere a wotua sika mprenu a edi kan akyi no, na pɛnhyen sika a wotuae no mmae. Ɔkɔɔ so de adesrɛ kɔtoo sɛ wɔmfa sika a wɔde tua akyi no kosii sɛ wɔde too gua nea etwa to wɔ 1793.

Wɔ n'anwensɛm "Belinda Adesrɛ" a ɔkyerɛwee wɔ afe 1980 mu no mu no, Rita Dove de nne ma ɔbea bi a odii kan yɛɛ no akoa bere a na wadi mfe 12: "Nnansa yi ara mo Man mufo atwa / Atirimɔdensɛm Nkyekyere no," ɔka, na ɔde ka ho tiawa sɛ, "Mewɔ anidaso sɛ wo / wubesusuw ho Saa ara na me nso."

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Nana Akosua Konadu
text:
Eunice Nana Akosua Konadu, a wɔsan frɛ no Nana Akosua Konadu, yɛ Ghana broadcaster, CEO ne nea ɔhyehyɛɛ Enak Consult. Ɔyɛ The Hard Truth a ɛwɔ Joy News dwumadibea a ɛwɔ Multi TV so no ho ɔkwankyerɛfo.

Nwomasua 
Nana Akosua Konadu kɔɔ Pentecost University College Ghana firi afe 2006 kɔsi afe 2010 baabi a ɔwiee sukuu no nyaa Bachelor of Science Degree wɔ Human resource management mu . Ɔsan nso kɔɔ Yaa Asantewaa Senior High School maa ne ntoaso sukuu.

Adwuma 
Bere a owiee ne Sukuupɔn adesua akyi no ɔyɛɛ ne afe biako Ɔman Dwumadi a ɛyɛ ahyɛde wɔ Ɔman Atoyerɛnkyɛm Ho Ahyehyɛde (NADMO) sɛ nnipa adwumayɛfo panyin. Ne ɔman som akyi no ɔyɛ mprempren nsɛm ho ɔyɛkyerɛ The Hard Truth a ɛwɔ Viasat 1 a seesei atu akɔ Joy News no yɛfo ne ɔkwankyerɛfo . Ɔkaa AM Show no ho dwumayɛni wɔ Joy News channel so wɔ Multi TV so wɔ Ghana. Ɔyɛ mprempren CEO wɔ Enak Studios adwumakuw bi a ɛhwɛ nsɛm a esisi ne nneɛma a wɔyɛ so.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Nana Akossua Konadu waree Manuel Asante-Samuels Kwasida 14 May 2016 wɔ Pentecost Amanaman Ntam Ɔsom Beaeɛ Kokomlemle.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Ruby Yayra Goka
text:
Ruby Yayra Goka (wɔwoo no 15 May 1982, Accra ) yɛ Ghana nsensan ho oduruyɛfo ne ɔkyerɛwfo. Ɔwɔ nwoma 15 a ɔde kamfo no na wonim no yie sɛ ɔdii nkonim mpɛn pii wɔ Burt Award for African Literature wɔ Ghana.

Goka a ɔyɛ Ghana Sukuupɔn Dental School alumnus no, mprempren ɔyɛ Volta Regional Hospital, Ho.

Abrabɔ 
Wɔwoo Goka wɔ Accra, Ghana, Simon Yao Goka a ɔyɛ ɔmanpanyin a wakɔ pɛnhyen ne Lydia Aku Goka a ɔyɛ ɛna a ɔte fie. Bere a Ruby dii mfe abien no, n’abusua tu kɔɔ Ethiopia, faako a ɔkɔ Peter Pan Amanaman Ntam Sukuu. Bere a odii mfe asia no, n’abusua san kɔɔ Ghana na ɔtoaa ne mfitiase ne ntoaso sukuu so wɔ St. Anthony Sukuu (1988–96) ne Achimota Sukuu (1996–99) abien no nyinaa wɔ Accra.

Ɔnyaa BDS wɔ University of Ghana Dental School wɔ afe 2009  na ɔyɛɛ adwuma mfeɛ mmienu wɔ Ridge Hospital Accra, wɔ Accra. Akyiri yi otu kɔɔ Sogakofe, faako a ɔde mfe abien yɛɛ adwuma wɔ South Tongu Ɔmantam Ayaresabea no. Ɔbɛyɛɛ Ghana College of Physicians and Surgeons no muni wɔ afe 2016 mu berɛ a ɔwiee ne residency nteteeɛ wɔ Komfo Anokye Teaching Hospital, Kumasi. Mprempren ɔyɛ Volta Ɔmantam Ayaresabea, Ho., Nsõ Ho Dwumadibea no panyin.

Wɔ afe 2017 mu no, Goka nyaa abasobɔdeɛ wɔ Authorship and Creative Writing Category mu wɔ 40 under 40 abasobɔdeɛ mu wɔ Ghana. Wɔmaa no Aduruyɛ mu Nkɔso Abasobɔde wɔ Nsõ Ho Nnuruyɛ mu nso wɔ afe koro no ara mu. Goka yɛ Mandela Washington Fellow wɔ afe 2017 mu.

title: Yaa Ntiamoah Badu
text:
Yaa Ntiamoah Baidu (anaa Yaa Ntiamoa-Baidu) yɛ Ghana mmoa ho nimdefo, nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia ho ɔbenfo, adesua ne dwumadie ho ɔbenfo. Wɔ March 2017 mu no, wɔpaw no sɛ Ghana Mfirihyia Apem Nkɔso Bagua no Titenani. Ɔyɛɛ Pro Vice Chancellor wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu kɔsii sɛ ɔkɔɔ pɛnhyen wɔ afe 2011 mu. She is a member of the New Patriotic Party of Ghana no muni  .

Asetra mu nsɛm 
Yaa Ntiamoah Badu sua ade wɔ St. Monica Senior High School ma O-level, afei wɔ Konongo Odumase Senior High School ma A-level. Elle sua ade wɔ Ghana Sukuupɔn mu, baabi a onya abodin krataa a edi kan wɔ mmoa ho adesua mu wɔ afe 1975 mu,  afei PhD wɔ Edinburgh Sukuupɔn mu en 1980. Ɔyɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ wɔ Departement of zoology a ɛwɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu, wɔ afe 1985 mu, afei ɔyɛ ɔbenfoɔ a ɔka ho wɔ afe 1995 mu. Wɔ afe 2003 mu no, wɔpaw no sɛ ɔbenfo a ɔyɛ pɛ.

Wɔpaw no sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ sukuupɔn no sohwɛ boayikuw no mu sɛ Pro-vice-chancellor for Research, Innovation and Development. Bere a ɔwɔ sukuupɔn no mu no, na ɔyɛ Center for African Wetlands ne University of Ghana Carnegie Next Generation Of Academics a ɛwɔ Afrika no kwankyerɛfo. Ɔne Kwesi Yankah, a na ɔyɛ Pro-Vice Chancellor a ɔhwɛ Adesua ne Asuafo Nsɛm so no som. Ɔsomm wɔ saa dibea no mu kɔsii July 2011 berɛ a ɔkɔɔ pɛnhyen wɔ sukuupɔn no mu na ɔde Prof. John Gyapong na ɔkyerɛwee. Wɔ afe 2005 mu no, wɔde Yaa Badu ne akyerɛkyerɛfo afoforo baanan a wɔwɔ adesua ahorow mu yɛɛ adwuma sɛ Ghana Adesuabea a Ɛhwɛ Adwinni ne Nyansahu So no mfɛfo .

title: Maame Biney
text:
Maame Biney (wɔwoo no Ɔbɛnem 28, 2000) yɛ Amerikani a ɔde mmirika tiawa tu mmirika a ɔde mmirika sii akan wɔ 2018 Awɔw Bere mu Olimpik akansi a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ PyeongChang.

Mfitiase asetra 
Wɔwoo Biney wɔ Accra, Ghana. Bere a odii mfe anum no, otu kɔɔ United States kɔtraa ne papa nkyɛn. Biney fii ase bɔɔ skate bere a na wadi mfe asia wɔ Virginia Atifi fam no. Ofii ase bɔɔ figure skating nanso ɔdan kɔɔ speed skating so wɔ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo bi nyansahyɛ so.

Adwuma 
Biney nyaa kɔbere nkonimbo wɔ mita 500 mmirikatu mu wɔ 2017 Wiase Mmofra Mmofra Ahoɔhare Skating Championships . Ɔdii kan yɛɛ ne mpanyimfo kuw no akyiri yi wɔ saa afe no mu a odii nkonim wɔ Amerika Kuruwa mu wɔ U.S. Speedskating Short Track World Cup Qualifier. Wɔ December 16, 2017 no, Biney fatae sɛ ɔbɛkɔ 2018 Olympics denam nkonim a odii wɔ mita 500 mu wɔ US Olympic Trials no so, ɔbɛyɛɛ Afrikani a wɔwoo no agumadifo a ɔto so abien a ogyinaa U.S. ananmu wɔ Winter Olympics, wɔ Madagascar a ɔwoo no biathlete Dan Westover akyi mu wɔ 1998 mu .

Wɔ 2018 Olympics, Biney antumi antwa ne hyew a ɔfata wɔ mita 1500 mmirikatu no mu na wɔpam no fii mita 500 mmirikatu no mu wɔ quarterfinals.

Bere a ɔsan firii 2018 Olympics no, Biney yɛɛ yie wɔ 2018 World Junior Short Track Speed Skating Championships, ɔdii sika kɔkɔɔ wɔ mita 500 mu, kɔbere wɔ mita 1000 mu, ne kɔbere wɔ ne nyinaa mu.

Biney fatae maa 2022 Awɔw Bere mu Olimpik akansi no wɔ 2022 U.S. Olimpik Kuw Sɔhwɛ - Short Track Speedskating.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Thérèse Striggner Scott
text:
Thérèse Eppie Striggner Scott (29 Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 1932 – 5 Ɔbɛnem 2021)  yɛ Ghana mmaranimfo ne ɔmanpanyin a ɔyɛɛ Ɔtemmufo wɔ Ghana Asɛnnibea Kunini ne Zimbabwe Asɛnnibea Kunini ne Ghana Ɔnanmusifo wɔ France ne Italy .

Adwuma 
Wɔfrɛɛ Striggner Scott kɔɔ asanombea a ɛwɔ Middle Temple, United Kingdom . Ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ mmaranimfo wɔ Accra, faako a na ɔyɛ adwumakuw bi a wɔde mmara ho afotu ma no yɔnko titiriw no.

Striggner Scott yɛɛ adwuma wɔ Ghana Asɛnnibea Kunini  na afe 1983 mu no, ɔno ne ɔbaa a odi kan a wɔpaw no sɛ ɔnkɔ Zimbabwe Asɛnnibea Kunini no mu.

Striggner Scott yɛ Ghana ɔnanmusifo wɔ France, a Ahemman Kronkron ka ho, kosii afe 1994 na akyiri yi ɔyɛ ɔnanmusifo wɔ Italy. Na ɔsan yɛ Ghana ɔnanmusifo wɔ UNESCO na ɔsom sɛ UNESCO Mmara Bagua no muni. Wɔ afe 1991 mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ Afrikani bea a odi kan a wɔpaw no sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ UNESCO Adwumayɛkuw no muni.

Striggner Scott yɛ Ghana Mmara Nsakraeɛ Bagua no Titenani firi afe 2000 kɔsi afe 2004. Na ɔyɛ Bagua a Ɛwɔ Daa Nhwehwɛmu a Ɛfa Ɔmanfo Basabasayɛ ne Ehunahuna Ho wɔ South Africa no muni . Na ɔyɛ Economic Community of West African States Council of Elders no muni na wɔ afe 2002 mu no odii ananmusifo bi anim ma wɔhwɛɛ Sierra Leone  mmrahyɛbagua ne ɔmampanyin abatow so .

Wɔ afe 2004 mu no, Amanaman Nkabom Ɔkyerɛwfo Panyin Kofi Annan paw Striggner Scott sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ Amanaman Ntam Bagua a Ɛhwɛ Darfur Ho Nhwehwɛmu a emufo yɛ baanum no mu .

Ankorankoro asetra 
Wɔ August 1961 mu no Striggner Scott waree ne kunu a odi kan, Emmanuel Kodjoe Dadzie, a saa bere no na ɔyɛ mmara dwumadibea panyin wɔ Ghana Amannɔne Nsɛm Dwumadibea na asram bi akyi no wɔpaw no sɛ Ɔman Ba wɔ Rumania . Wɔwoo wɔn babea Geta (Georgetta) akyiri yi wɔ 1962 mu, na Striggner Scott nso woo Dadzie mma afoforo, Yasmin, Stella, Barry, ne Gary. Bere a aware no baa awiei wɔ awaregyae mu no, wɔ afe 1971 mu no, Striggner Scott waree ne kunu a ɔto so abien, Kenneth Winky Scott, Britania ɔdansifo bi a ɔte Ghana na ɔyɛ adwuma.

Ɔwui wɔ Ghana wɔ 5 September 2021, na wadi mfeɛ 88.

Hwɛ nso 
Mmea mmaranimfo ne atemmufo a wodi kan wɔ Afrika din

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Pauline M. Clerk
text:
Pauline Miranda Clerk (26 May 1935 – 25 Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 2013  ) yɛ Ghana ɔman adwumayɛfo, ɔman soafoɔ ne ɔmampanyin fotufo.

Asetra mu nsɛm

Mfitiase asetra ne abusua 
Wɔwoo Pauline Miranda Clerk wɔ May 26, 1935 wɔ Osu, Accra maa Richard Alfred Clerk, ɔman adwumayɛfo a na ɔyɛ atubrafo a na ɔyɛ adwuma wɔ Gold Coast ne Nigeria . Ná ne maame ne Martha Comfort Quaynor. Ne nuanom ne Robert, Richard ne Caroline. Na ɔyɛ Ghana Clerk abusua a ɛho hia wɔ abakɔsɛm mu no mu awo ntoatoaso a ɛto so anan. Ná ɔyɛ Alexander Worthy Clerk, Jamaicani Moravia ɔsɛmpatrɛwfo bi a oduu Danish Protectorate of Christiansborg, a ɛwɔ Gold Coast saa bere no mu wɔ 1843 mu no banana, sɛ mfitiase kuw a na wɔyɛ West India asɛmpatrɛwfo 24 a wɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ the BaselAsɛmpakafo Asɛmpatrɛwfo Kuw a ɛwɔ Switzerland.  A. W. Ɔkyerɛwfo yɛ ɔkwampaefo wɔ Presbyterian Asɔre a ɛwɔ Ghana no mu na ɔyɛ ɔkannifo wɔ nhomasua mu wɔ atubrafo Ghana, na ɔne afoforo hyehyɛɛ mfinimfini sukuu a wɔtra mu wɔ Osu, Salem Sukuu wɔ afe 1843. Na n’agya nanabea panyin, Pauline Hesse (1831–1909) fi Gold Coast, na na ɔwɔ Danish, German ne Ga nananom. Ne nanabea panyin ne Regina Hesse (1832–1898), ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo a ɔyɛ ɔkwampaefo ne sukuu panyin a ɔne Basel Asɛmpatrɛwfo a wɔwɔ Gold Coast yɛɛ adwuma.

Nea ɔda nsow wɔ n’abusuabɔ mu ne ne nanabea, Nicholas Timothy Clerk (1862–1961), nyamekyerɛfo ne ɔsɛmpatrɛwfo a wɔpaw no sɛ Synod Ɔkyerɛwfo a odi kan wɔ Presbyterian Asɔre a ɛwɔ Gold Coast no mu fi 1918 kosi 1932. N. T. Ɔkyerɛwfo yɛ agya a ɔhyehyɛɛ mmarimaa nyinaa ntoaso sukuu, Presbyterian Mmarimaa Ntoaso Sukuu a wɔde sii hɔ wɔ afe 1938. Na ne papa nua barima, Carl Henry Clerk (1895–1982) yɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo ne Presbyterian ɔsomfo ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔpaw no sɛ Synod Ɔkyerɛwfo a ɔto so anan wɔ Presbyterian Asɔre a ɛwɔ Gold Coast no mu fi 1950 kosi 1954 ne saa ara nso na Kristofo Ɔbɔfo no Samufo, amanneɛbɔ no bulletin a Presbyterian Asɔre a ɛwɔ Ghana de mae fi 1960 kosi 1963. Onua barima bi, Theodore S. Clerk (1909–1965) yɛ Ghanani a odi kan a ɔyɛ ɔdansifoɔ a ɔfiri Gold Coast a ɔyɛɛ nhyehyɛɛ na ɔyɛɛ hyɛn gyinabea kuro Tema  PM Clerk maame nuabeanom ne Jane E. Clerk (1904–1999), . Gold Coast ɔbaa akwampaefoɔ a ɔyɛ ɔbaa nwomasua sohwɛfoɔ ne Matilda J. Clerk (1916–1984), Ghanani ɔbaa a ɔtɔ so mmienu a ɔbɛyɛɛ oduruyɛfoɔ. Ne nuanom mmarima ne nhomanimfo Nicholas, George ne Alexander Clerk .

Nhomasua ne adwumayɛ 
Pauline Clerk suaa ade wɔ Osu Presbyterian Mmabaa Sukuu ne Achimota College, a abien no nyinaa wɔ Accra. Ɔhyɛɛ n’adwuma ase wɔ Ghana Broadcasting Corporation na ɔboaa ma wɔhyehyɛɛ ɔmanfoɔ broadcaster no nhwehwɛmu nwomakorabea.

Ɔde ne ho kɔbɔɔ Gold Coast Ɔman Adwumayɛbea wɔ 1950 mfe no mfinimfini na ɔbɛyɛɛ amannɔne adwumayɛfo panyin – ɔman nanmusifo a ɔyɛ adwumaden a ɔbata Amannɔne Nsɛm Ho Dwumadibea no ho . Mfiase no wɔde no kɔɔ kan Afrika Nsɛm Ho Ɔkyerɛwfo Dwumadibea a ɛwɔ Ghana ɔmampanyin, The Flagstaff House . Wɔ Ɔkyerɛwfo Dwumadibea hɔ no, Pauline Clerk ne Ghana ɔmanpanyin, KB Asante, a na Kwame Nkrumah apaw no sɛ ɔnhwɛ asoɛe no so no yɛɛ adwuma. Ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ ɔpanyin wɔ Afrika Apuei Fam Mantam mu na na ɔwɔ Kampala, Uganda, faako a osuaa Swahili kasa wɔ Makerere Sukuupɔn mu . Wɔ 1962 ne 1965 ntam no, na ɔyɛ Ghana aban ananmusifo wɔ Dahomey (mprempren Benin ).

Na Pauline Clerk yɛ aman ntam nkitahodi kyerɛwfo a ɔhwɛ nsɛm ne amammerɛ so wɔ Ghana aban ananmusifo dwumadibea a ɛwɔ Paris no. Ɔne Ghana aban ananmusifoɔ adwuma wɔ Washington, DC ne London. Ná ɔyɛ ɔman nanmusifo nso wɔ Togo ne kan Apuei Fam Aman a ɛne Yugoslavia ne Germany Apuei fam aman no mu . Ná Clerk yɛ amanaman ntam ɔhwɛfo a ɔde ne ho wɔ 1980 Uganda amansan abatow no mu . Wɔ 1980 mfe no mu no, wɔpaw no sɛ ɔfotufo wɔ Offices of the Provisional National Defence Council (PNDC) wɔ Jerry John Rawlings akanni ase . Bere a ɔsan baa ɔmanfo nniso mu wɔ 1990 mfe no mfiase no, ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔmampanyin fotufo panyin, a wɔde no kɔmaa Ɔman Bagua a Ɛhwɛ Mmea ne Nkɔso So (NCWD) sɛ ɔfotufo wɔ mmea hokwan ahorow ne asetra mu sikasɛm mu nkɔso ho nsɛm ho.

Owu ne ayi 
Pauline Clerk wui wɔ Accra wɔ 25 October 2013 esiane abɔde mu nneɛma nti . Na n’ayie wɔ Ebenezer Presbyterian Asɔre, Osu, na ɛno akyi no wɔsiee n’amu wɔ Osu Amusiei wɔ Accra.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Georgina Theodora Wood
text:
Georgina Theodora Nnua JSC na ɔkyerɛwee OSG (woo Lutterodt ; wɔwoo no 8 June 1947) yɛ Ghana ɔtemmufo na ɔsan nso yɛ polisini asɛnnifo. Ɔno ne Ghana Atemmufo Panyin ne ɔbaa a ɔdi kan a ɔdii saa dibea no. Ɔkɔɔ pɛnhyen wɔ afe 2017 mu wɔ mfeɛ aduonum a ɔde asom ɔman no akyi. Ɔyɛ Ɔman Bagua no muni .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Georgina Lutterodt wɔ 8 June 1947 wɔ Ghana . Ɔnyaa ne mfitiaseɛ nwomasua wɔ Bishop’s Girls and Methodist Schools, Dodowa . Afei ɔkɔɔ Mmofraturo Mmabaa Sukuu, Kumasi wɔ 1958 ne 1960 ntam hɔ. Wood ntoaso sukuu wɔ Wesley Girls’ High School, Cape Coast, a owiee wɔ 1966 mu. Ɔkɔɔ Ghana Suapɔn, Legon, na wɔmaa no LL. B. wɔ afe 1970 Afei Wood kɔɔ Ghana Mmara Sukuu a ɛno akyi no wɔfrɛɛ no kɔɔ bar. Ɔsan nso yɛɛ Post-Graduate Officers Training Course wɔ Ghana Polisifoɔ Kɔlege.

Adwuma 
Wood ne Ghana Polisifoɔ Dwumadibea yɛɛ adwuma sɛ ɔhwɛfoɔ abadiakyiri ne ɔman mmaranimfo mfeɛ mmiɛnsa. Akyiri yi ɔde ne ho kɔbɔɔ Atemmu Dwumadibea no sɛ Ɔmantam Ɔtemmufo wɔ 1974 mu. Ɔnam Ɔmansin ne Asɛnnibea Kunini no so sɔre bɛyɛɛ Asɛnnibea a Wɔde Nsɛm Kɔdan no no temmufo panyin wɔ 1991. Ɔmampanyin John Kufuor na ɔpaw no sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ Asɛnnibea Kunini no wɔ 12 November 2002, paw a na wadi kan apow.

Georgina Wood boayikuw no 
Wɔhyehyɛɛ Georgina Wood boayikuo no wɔ 4 July 2006 sɛ wɔnhwehwɛ mu wɔ po so hyɛn bi a wɔde fa po so hyɛn MV Benjamin mu a ɛyeraeɛ wɔ cocaine packets 77 mu wɔ 26 April 2006. Na ɛyɛ sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ adanmude a wɔkyerɛ sɛ ɛyɛ dɔla 200,000 a ɔbea bi a ɔne Venezuela nnubɔne ho ɔbenfo bi wɔ abusuabɔ tuaa polisifo mpanyimfo nso mu, ne 588 no nso kg cocaine a wogye fii Venezuelafo nsam wɔ Mempeasem, East Legon .

Ghana Ɔtemmufo Panyin 
Wɔyii no sɛ Ghana Ɔtemmufoɔ Panyin wɔ May 2007. Wɔ 1 June 2007, Ghana  mmrahyɛbagua no penee ne din sɛ Ghana Atemmufoɔ Panyin foforɔ no so denam adwene a wɔpene so. Ɛduruu June 2007 no, yei maa ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔbaa a ɔdi kan wɔ Ghana abakɔsɛm mu a ɔdii Atemmuo no anim na ɛsan nso maa ɔbɛyɛɛ saa berɛ no, ɔbaa a ɔwɔ dibea a ɛkorɔn paa wɔ Ghana amammuisɛm mu; saa dibea no boroo so denam Ɔtemmufo Joyce Adeline Bamford-Addo a wɔpaw no sɛ Ghana 4th Republic  mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so 5 no Kasafo wɔ January 2009 mu no so. Ɔtemmufo Panyin Wood fii ase dii n’adwuma wɔ 15 June 2007. Bere a na ɔwɔ dibea no, ɔkaa ntam sɛ Ɔmampanyin baanan: Ɔmampanyin John Evans Atta-Mills wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2009 mu, Ɔmampanyin Abadiakyiri John Dramani Mahama bere a Atta-Mills wui wɔ 24 Ɔpɛpɔn 2012, Ɔmampanyin a Wɔapaw no John Dramani Mahama, nkonimdifo wɔ December 2012 Amansan Abatoɔ a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ 7 Ɔbɛnem 2013, Nana Akuffo-Addo, nkonimdifoɔ wɔ December 2016 abatoɔ a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ 7 Ɔbɛnem 2017. Ɔkɔɔ pɛnhyen sɛ Ɔtemmufo Panyin wɔ June 2017. Ɔtemmufo Sophia Akuffo na odii n'ade .

Ɔman Bagua no 
Wɔ 20 June 2017 no, Ɔmampanyin Nana Akuffo-Addo kaa Wood ntam sɛ Ɔman Bagua no muni a ɔto so 25 ne nea otwa to. Ɔka agyinatukuw no ho esiane nokwasɛm a ɛyɛ sɛ ɔyɛ kan Ɔtemmufo Panyin nti. Ɛyɛ bere a edi kan wɔ mfe 22 mu a wɔhyɛɛ adwuma a ɛda hɔ no ma efisɛ na Ghana nni Ɔtemmufo Panyin a wakɔ pɛnhyen a ɔte ase fi 1995.

Nidi a wɔde ma 
Wɔ 7 July 2007 no, wɔde Order of the Star of Ghana, ɔman no anuonyam a ɛkorɔn sen biara siesiee Wood. Ɔmampanyin John Kufuor na ɔde no mae .

Dwumadi afoforo 
Wood yɛ nnwontofo kuw kannifo wɔ Ringway Gospel Center Assemblies of God Asɔre, Accra . Ɔsan yɛ Alternative Dispute Resolution a ɛwɔ Ghana no Titenani . Ɔsan nso asom sɛ Kenya Atemmufo ne Atemmufo Nhwehwɛmu Boayikuw no muni . Ɔyɛ Global Justice Center, amanaman ntam mmara ahyehyɛde bi a ɛfa nnipa hokwan ahorow ho a ɛwɔ New York Kuropɔn mu no baguafo mu .

Abusua 
Wood aware Edwin Wood, sikakorabea dwumayɛni bi a wakɔ pɛnhyen.

Akyinnyegye ahorow

September 2008 NPP Asase a Wɔkyekyɛ 
Dwoda 7 Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 2010 no, na Wood ka nnipa 15 a Committee for Joint Action bɔɔ wɔn din sɛ wɔn a wɔbɛnya mfasoɔ afiri asase a wɔkyerɛ sɛ mmara mma ho kwan a kan NPP aban no de ama no mu. Wɔ aban asɛm bi mu no, boayikuw no kae sɛ:

title: Apiorkor Seyiram Ashong-Abbey
text:
Apiorkor Seyiram Ashong–Abbey ( wɔwoo no 1 Ɔpɛpɔn 1988) yɛ Ghana anwensɛm kyerɛwfo, ɔkyerɛwfo, nhoma mu ɔkasatiafo. Mprempren ɔyɛ Head of Programs Production wɔ Citi FM /Citi TV na mprempren ɔyɛ Diplomatic license ho ɔkwankyerɛfo wɔ Citi TV ne Whats Cooking.

Ɔsan nso yɛ The InfluencHER Project, samufo nhyehyɛe ne wiase nyinaa nnipa a wɔrehwehwɛ sɛ wɔbɛma mmea nne tumi na wɔama ayɛ kɛse no samufo fotufo.

Nwomasua 
Apiorkor kɔɔ Tema International School a ɔwiee sukuu na ɔwiee Diploma nhyehyɛeɛ. Akyiri yi ɔkɔɔ Lafayette College wɔ US, na ɔsan baa Ghana sɛ ɔrebɛsua ade wɔ University of Ghana, Legon.

Akyerɛw nhoma ahorow 
Apiorkor na ɔkyerɛw The Matriarch's Verse, anwensɛm nhoma a ɛhwehwɛ sɛ ɛhyɛ afahyɛ, twa mpoa na ɛtwe adwene si nea ɛkyerɛ sɛ obi yɛ Ghanani wɔ Afeha a Ɛto so 21 yi mu; na wɔyɛ eyinom nyinaa fi n’adwene mu sɛ amammerɛ mu abofra a ɔto so abiɛsa.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Gertrude Torkornoo
text:
Gertrude Araba Esaaba Torkornoo (wɔwoo no 11 Ɔpɛpɔn 1962) yɛ Ghana ɔtemmufo ne ɔkyerɛwfo. Kan no na ɔyɛ Asɛnnibea a Wɔde Nsɛm Kɔdan no temmufo, na wɔpaw no sɛ Asɛnnibea Kunini no Temmufo wɔ November 2019 mu na wɔhwehwɛɛ mu wɔ 10 December 2019. Ɔkaa ntam wɔ 17 December 2019. Sɛ yɛde mmara to nkyɛn a wakyerɛw nhoma, agoru, adesua ho nsɛm, nsɛm ne nsɛm a wɔka kyerɛ.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Gertrude Torkornoo fi Winneba a ɛwɔ Ghana Mfinimfini Mantam mu . Wɔwoo no September 11 1962 wɔ Cape Coast . Ɔnyaa ne ntoaso sukuu wɔ Wesley Girls’ High School maa ne ordinary level adansedie ne Achimota Sukuu maa ne advanced level adansedie. Ɔnyaa ne ntoaso sukuu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu na ɔwiee Ghana Mmara Sukuu wɔ afe 1986.

Adwuma 
Ansa na Torkornoo rebɛka Fugar & Co., mmara adwumakuw bi a ɛwɔ Accra ho sɛ sukuuni yɔnko no, na ɔyɛ adwuma sɛ obi a otu ne ho ma wɔ FIDA Mmara Mmoa Dwumadibea na ɔyɛɛ ne dwumadi wɔ Nabarro Nathanson wɔ London. Ɔsan kɔɔ adwumakuw no mu (Fugar & Co., mmara adwumakuw) wɔ 1994 mu sɛ ɔrebɛyɛ ne kwankyerɛfo. Wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 1997 mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ Managing Partner wɔ Sozo Law Consult kɔsii 14 May 2004 berɛ a wɔpaw no sɛ Ɔtemmufoɔ wɔ Ghana Asɛnnibea Kunini no Ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ Asɛnnibea Kunini temmufo kosii October 2012 bere a wɔmaa no so kɔɔ Asɛnnibea a Ɛhwɛ Asɛm a Wɔde Kɔdan Asɛnnibea no. Na ɔyɛ Asɛnnibea a Ɛhwɛ Asɛm a Wɔde Kɔdan Asɛnnibea no temmufo kosii sɛ wɔpaw no sɛ Asɛnnibea Kunini no Temmufo wɔ November 2019. Ɔkaa ntam sɛ ɔbɛdi dwuma wɔ 17 December 2019.

Ansa na wɔrepaw no sɛ Asɛnnibea Kunini no temmufo no, Torkornoo adi akannifo dibea ahorow bi, a ebi ne; Aguadi Asɛnnibea Temmufo a ɔhwɛ so, Atemmufo ne Atemmufo Fekuw no Nsɛmma Nhoma Boayikuw no Titenani, Ɔkyerɛwfo Panyin a ɔhwɛ Atemmu Abrabɔ Pa Ntetee Nhoma no so, E-Atɛntenenee Akwankyerɛ/Ɔhwɛ Boayikuw no guamtrani abadiakyiri ne Internship ne Ɔkyerɛwfo no guamtrani abadiakyiri Dwumadi a Wɔde Ma Atemmufo. Ɔsan nso yɛ Atemmufo Ntetee Asoɛe no Faculty Member na ɔyɛ Atemmufo Ntetee Asoɛe no Sodikuw no muni.

Ɔka nnipa baason a wɔretie afe 2020 abatoɔ adesrɛ a John Mahama de too gua tiaa The Electoral Commission of Ghana ne Nana Akufo-Addo,

title: Chloe Asaam
text:
Chloe Asaam yɛ ntadehyɛ ho nimdefo ne nhyehyɛe sohwɛfo ma OR Foundation, ahyehyɛde bi a ɛde n’adwene si ntadehyɛ a wɔsɛe no ntɛmntɛm so wɔ Ghana, te sɛ gua ahorow te sɛ Kantamanto Market . N’adwene si ntade a ɛtra hɔ daa na wɔde nsa yɛ a ɛkyere Ghana tebea ka ntadehyɛ akɛse ho. Mercedes-Benz Ntadehyɛ Nnawɔtwe Tbilisi, Mercedes Benz Ntade Nnawɔtwe Accra, ne The Fashion Atlas na ɛsii so dua. Ɔyɛ obi a ofi Kumasi.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Mimi Plange
text:
Mimi Plange yɛ obi a wɔwoo no wɔ Ghana -a ɔyɛ ntadehyɛ ho nimdefo. Otu kɔɔ Amerika bere a na ɔyɛ abofra, na osuaa adansi ne ntadehyɛ ho ade.

Abrabɔ 
Wɔwoo Plange wɔ Accra, Ghana . Ɔne n’abusua tu kɔɔ California bere a na ɔyɛ abofra no. Ɔnyaa BA wɔ Architecture mu wɔ California Suapɔn a ɛwɔ Berkeley na ɔkɔɔ Fashion Institute of Design and Merchandising wɔ California. Bere a osuaa nhoma wiei no otu kɔɔ New York na ɔyɛɛ adwuma maa Patricia Fields ne Rachel Roy nyinaa

Ɔne n’adwumayɛ hokafoɔ, Ibrahim Ndoye, yɛɛ ntadeɛ ho adwuma Boudoir D’huîtres nanso akyiri yi ɔsesaa no yɛɛ no n’ankasa din Mimi Plange wɔ afe 2010.

Afrikafo agyapade nya ne mfonini ahorow so nkɛntɛnso.  N'atɔfo bi ne Rihanna, Serena Williams ne Awuraa a odi kan Michelle Obama . Michelle hyɛɛ ne A-line atade wɔ ABC TV so dwumadi a wɔfrɛ no The View mu. Plange na ɔyɛɛ Afe no mu Ɔdebɔneyɛfo a Ɔsen Biara wɔ Mercedes Benz Fashion Week South Africa.

Wɔ afe 2011 asɛm bi a ɛbaa The New York Times, mu no, wɔfaa Plange asɛm kae sɛ: “Mepɛ sɛ mekyerɛ nkurɔfo sɛ wontumi mfa Afrikafo ntadehyɛ nhyɛ mmorɔnoma mu.” . . . Metumi asi akan wɔ wiase nyinaa." Plange mfa Afrikafo amammerɛ kwan so nkyerɛwee anaa ntama nni dwuma wɔ ne mfonini ahorow mu. Wɔ ne Spring 2012 ahoboa, Scarred Perfection mu no, ɔkaa nipadua mu akuru a Afrikafoɔ de bedi dwuma sɛ ɔkwan a wɔfa so hu mmusuakuo. Plange kyerɛkyerɛ mu sɛ, "Saa nneɛma a ɛma yegye sɛnea yegyina yɛn ho ananmu kyerɛ nnipa afoforo no na ɛkanyan me." 

Wɔ afe 2015 mu no, ɔne wɔn a wɔyɛ dan mu nneɛma ho adwumfo Roche Bobois yɛɛ biako yɛɛ Mahjong tiles ne sofa ahorow a wɔde ne nneɛma a wɔyɛe wɔ Burkina Faso asiesie no .

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Samata (fashion entrepreneur)
text:
Samata Pattinson (wɔwoo no Ɔbɛnem 23, 1987) yɛ Ghanani a wɔwoo no Britania a ɔyɛ ntadehyɛ ho adwuma . Wonim no sɛ ɔyɛ adwuma sɛ Suzy Amis Cameron ’s Red Carpet Green Dress ahyehyɛde no panyin, a sɛ ne dwumadi ahorow no fã no, ɛde ntadehyɛ a ɛtra hɔ daa ma wɔ kapet kɔkɔɔ so wɔ Oscars afe biara. Samata aboa, The Guardian, EuroNews, Vogue ne Huffington Post ne afoforo. Nsɛmma nhoma ahorow aka n’adwuma a ɔyɛ wɔ ntadehyɛ ne nneɛma a ɛbɛkɔ so atra hɔ daa ho asɛm.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Samata wɔ Cambridge, England, ɔyɛ Ghana awofoɔ mfimfini babaa na ɔwɔ nuabeanom mmienu. Ná n’agya nana yɛ Dagombafo abusuakuw Panyin Yo Naa III. Ɔkɔɔ Katolek Mfitiase sukuu ansa na ɔrekɔ Perse School For Girls fi Secondary. Samata suaa sikasɛm, sikasɛm ne adwumayɛ ho abodin krataa wɔ Queen Mary Sukuupɔn a ɛwɔ London mu .

Ntadehyɛ adwuma 
Samata yɛ obi a ɔyɛ autodidact designer a ofii ne ntadehyɛ adwuma ase sɛ PR Director ma King’s Road boutique Elival. Wɔ afe 2005 mu no, Samata de n’ankasa ntade sii hɔ a ɔne Ken Livingstone yɛɛ adwuma wɔ Mmabun Adwinni Ntadehyɛ Afahyɛ wɔ Piccadilly Circus, na ɔkɔɔ so bɛyɛɛ Britania ɔbea abibifo a odi kan a ɔde ne ho kyerɛe wɔ Nolcha Fashion Week, New York. Gordon Brown ne Cameron aban no nyinaa ato nsa afrɛ Samata aba Number 10 Downing Street esiane n’adwuma a ɔyɛe wɔ ntadehyɛ adwuma mu nti. Wɔde no too gua sɛ ɔyɛ aberanteɛ a ɔyɛ adwumfo a ɔdii nkonim wɔ Suzy Amis Cameron Red Carpet Green Dress akansi mu, amanaman ntam adwini a ɛkɔ so daa ho nhyehyɛeɛ wɔ Oscars ’ red carpet so wɔ afe 2011. Wonim no nso wɔ ne Bloomsbury ‘Fashion Designer’s Resource Book’, ne n’adwuma sɛ ɔyɛfo ne nea ɔde nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia ho video tiawa ‘Designing Change’ kyerɛ.

Ntadehyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ 
Na Samata yɛ Fashion Editor a The Talent Magazine de mae wɔ Channel 4 Magazine a wɔde sii hɔ ne styling odiyifo Nicholas Holt maa anim nsɛmma nhoma a edi kan no. Samata nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ adwuma no fa ntadehyɛ ne ntadehyɛ adwuma a ɛtra hɔ daa ho asɛm titiriw. Nea ɔde too gua wɔ London Fashion Week mu maa The Guardian no na ɛde kasasin ‘Eco-Ghosting’ bae. Wɔn a wobisabisaa Samata nsɛm no bi ne Suzy Amis Cameron, Missi Pyle, Dame Vivienne Westwood ne Christopher Bailey . Wɔ afe 2016 mu no Samata kaa asɛm, ɔboaa kyerɛɛ kwan na ɔne Suzy Amis Cameron kaa nsɛm ntiantiaa a ɛfa ntadeɛ a ɛbɛtena hɔ daa ho a wɔato din Designing Change. Wapue wɔ ITV News At Ten, ITV News at Six, ne afoforo mu. ITV News srɛɛ no sɛ ɔmfa aban asɛm bi a ɛfa ne yɔnko Ghanani Edward Enninful a wɔpaw no sɛ Vogue UK Samufo nka dwuma a mmea di wɔ asɛnka mu no ho. Wɔ afe 2019 mu no ɔbisabisaa Christopher Raeburn nsɛm wɔ Copenhagen Fashion Summit.

Adwuma a wɔatintim 
Bloomsbury Publishing tintim Samata nwoma a wɔfrɛ no Fashion Designer’s Resource Book wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2013 mu. Samata kyerɛw anwensɛm ne ayɛsɛm, na wɔ afe 2006 mu no, wɔtoo nsa frɛɛ no sɛ ɔmmɛbɔ nsɛm a wɔka wɔ Tate Modern ase mma Surrealism ne Minimalism Afahyɛ no. Samata yɛ ɔkyerɛwfo a ɔkyerɛw mmea tumidi nhoma a agye din, THE TRIBETM Empowerment Journal, ne kuw THE TRIBE bu nnwontofo Shingai Shoniwa ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo Shaunagh Connaire ne Charlene White sɛ emufo.

Baguam ɔkasa 
Samata ama ɔkasa na wakasa wɔ nhyiam akɛse ne ntadehyɛ kɔlege ahorow te sɛ SXSW Eco, Central St Martins, London College of Fashion, Berkeley, Ravensbourne ne Fashion Institute of Technology mu . Wonim no sɛ ɔwɔ adwene a emu yɛ den wɔ nneɛma a ɛbɛkɔ so atra hɔ daa ho a wɔada no adi wɔ nhoma ahorow te sɛ Reuters, Business Insider, Business Of Fashion, Harper’s Bazaar, Wonderland China, Yahoo Finance ne WWD mu. Wɔ afe 2020 mu no, Cambridge Suapɔn paw Samata sɛ ɔmmɔ wɔn ntoatoasoɔ foforɔ no ho ban mma Cambridge Institute for Sustainability Leadership a wɔato din ‘Daakye yɛpɛ nhyehyɛeɛ’, de ka nhumu a wɔde bɛma IPBES a ɛdi kan, Global Biodiversity Podcast - Nature Insight ho. Samata, yɛ obi a ɔkamfo intersectional environmentalism, na ɔka nne kɛse fa hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔyɛ ananmusifo wɔ ntadehyɛ adwuma no mu ma BIPOC akuw ne abibifo adebɔfo, ne "wɔdi nsɛm a wɔka ho asɛm pɛpɛɛpɛ fi wiase nyinaa nhyiam ase, fi Vogue Poland kosi Wonderland China.

Adɔeyɛ 
Wɔ afe 2006 mu no, Samata kyeree mmerante ne mmabaa adɔe nnwom a wɔka no guu hama so maa nnwom adwuma bi a wɔato din Enfants Soldats de maa nkurɔfo huu mmofra asraafo. Wɔ December 2007 mu no, Samata yɛɛ asuafoɔ ntadeɛ ho ɔyɛkyerɛ ho nhyehyɛeɛ sɛ kɔnsɛt a wɔde bɛboaboa sika ano wɔ Freetown, Sierra Leone maa ɔmanfoɔ ahoteɛ adwuma bi, a SWAY, Dawn Richards, ne WFP nhyehyɛeɛ CatWALK the World ka ho. Wɔ September 2009 mu no, Samata yɛɛ ntadeɛ maa ITV News kuw no sɛ ‘Newsroom’s Got Talent’ sika a wɔboaboa ano a ɛboaa Leonard Cheshire Disability ne Helen & Douglas House Hospice for Children and Young Adults no fã. Saa bere no na ɔdebɔneyɛfo no hyɛɛ ntade te sɛ Romilly Weeks, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo Steve Scott ne Katie Derham nkutoo maa Grease ayɛyɛde ho ɔyɛkyerɛ bi, de kaa atade bi a ɔde mae ho.

Ahyehyɛde ahorow a ɛbata ho ne nidi ahorow 
Women foSamata yɛ Ghana ntadehyɛ adwuma mu nnipa a wɔagye din no mu biako na Ɔmanpanyin Kwaku Danso-Boafo too nsa frɛɛ no sɛ ɔmmɛkɔ Screen Nation ‘Ghana Mmabarima ne Mmabea’ wɔ Ghana Aban Asoɛe no ase . Samata buu Top Model of Color awiei no atɛn wɔ The Gambia, na ohyiaa The Gambia Titenani, Yahya AJJ Jammeh . Women Amanaman Ntam adɔe kuw

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Maame Esi Acquah Taylor
text:
Maame Esi Acquah Taylor yɛ Ghanani a ɔyɛ ntadehyɛ ho adwuma na na ɔyɛ ahoɔfɛ hemmaa. Wɔbɔɔ no abotiri sɛ Miss Universe Ghana wɔ afe 2000 mu na ogyinaa Ghana ananmu wɔ Miss Universe 2000 akansi a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Cyprus no mu. Mprempren ɔyɛ Aha Brands a ɔhyehyɛɛ ne adwumayɛfo panyin (CEO). Wɔwoo no na wɔtetee no wɔ Cape Coast, Central Region, Ghana, ɔyɛ obi a wawie Cape Coast Suapɔn.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Maame Esi Acquah Taylor wɔ afe 1980 mu wɔ Cape Coast, wɔ Central Region wɔ Ghana. Ɔhyɛɛ ne mfitiaseɛ nwomasua ase wɔ St Monica’s Primary ne Cape Coast University JSS wɔ afe 1986 ne 1994 ntam ansa na ɔrekɔ ntoaso sukuu wɔ Holy Child Secondary School wɔ Cape Coast. Ɔde General Arts mae bere a na ɔresua ade wɔ Holy Child no na akyiri yi ɔyɛɛ abodin krataa nhyehyɛe wɔ Cape Coast Sukuupɔn mu .

Miss Amansan Ghana 
Wɔ afe 2000 mu no, wɔhyɛɛ Taylor abotiri sɛ Miss Universe Ghana a ɛmaa ɔfatae sɛ ogyina Ghana ananmu wɔ Miss Universe akansi a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Cyprus .

Adwuma 
Taylor fii n’adwuma ase wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu denam adwuma a ɔyɛe sɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a ɔbɔ amanneɛ ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo wɔ Citi FM a ɛyɛ radio dwumadibea a ɛwɔ Accra-English so. Ɔkɔɔ so yɛɛ adwuma a ɔde ne ho ne State Broadcasting Corporation, Ghana Television baabi a ɔne Gifty Anti boom yɛɛ ‘The Breakfast Show’.

Na wayɛ Sikakorabea sohwɛfo Panyin wɔ Zenith Sikakorabea, Ghana. Wɔ September 2020 mu no, ɔsom sɛ ɔtemmufoɔ wɔ Accra Mall Future Fashion Fund were Edzordzinam Agrosah na wɔmaa no nkonimdifoɔ wɔ nea ɛtɔ so mmienu no mu.

Ne fapem Aha Pink Warriors de sii hɔ wɔ afe 2018 mu a n'atirimpɔw ne sɛ wɔbɛko atia nufu mu kokoram . Ɔhyehyɛɛ Aha Brands wɔ afe 2012 mu a ɛyɛ nneɛma a wɔde boa, ntadeɛ a ɛhyɛ ase, ntadeɛ a wɔde guare ne Lawen Taylor deɛ ho adwuma

Ankorankoro asetra 
Taylor aware na ɔwɔ mma baanum.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Sally Torpey
text:
Sally Esinam Torpey yɛ Ghanani a ɔyɛ ntadeɛ ho nimdefo ne adwumayɛfo. Ɔsan nso yɛ sikakorafo ma Greater Accra Chapter a ɛwɔ Association of Ghana Industries (AGI) ne Ɔmanpanyin a ɔfiri Afrika ma Fashion Business Association of America. Ɔwɔ aguadi asɛmpatrɛw adwuma wɔ wiase nyinaa a United States, United Kingdom ne Japan ka ho. Ɔyɛ KYEN (Kufuor Young Entrepreneurs) muni. Ɔno ne Sallet Fashion House Ghana wura; Sallet Fapem no; ne nneɛma ahorow a wɔfrɛ no Oheema, The Travelers Custom Made Clothing (TCMC), ne JAK Gentle Giant Collection.  Ɔyɛ amanaman ntam ɔkasafo a n’ani gye ntadehyɛ, aguadi, mmea tumidi, ne ankorankoro nkɔso ho. Wɔaka ne ho asɛm wɔ nhoma ne nsɛmma nhoma te sɛ Afrikan Post, Washington DC atesɛm krataa, Ghana wɛb, Caribbean nsɛmma nhoma, The CCWC ne Creative Magazine of Miami. Ɔyɛ asɛm a wɔayɛ ho nhwehwɛmu ama Growth Cap UK ne afoforo.

Sallet Ntadehyɛ Fie 
Wɔhyɛɛ Sallet Fashion House ase wɔ afe 2010 mu a wɔne Sallet Foundation ka ho. Na eyi bɛma ayɛ mmerɛw sɛ wɔbɛkyekye tumi a wɔde bɛyɛ ntade a wɔyɛ a ɛbɛkɔ so atra hɔ daa na ayɛ nea ɛwɔ hɔ nnɛ. Aguadi Dwumadibea no boa ntadehyɛ dan ne fapem no ma wɔhyehyɛ ntade ntetee ne mmeae a wɔyɛ ntade na ama adwuma a wonnya nyɛ so atew. Nneɛma a wɔyɛ ma nneɛma afoforo ne adwumfo yɛ ade a ebetumi aba sɛ Sallet Fashion House wɔ. Travelers Custom Made Clothing (TCMC) yɛ n’adebɔ ahorow no mu biako. TCMC yɛ ntade a wɔayɛ no sɛnea wɔpɛ na wɔma akwantufo a anyɛ yiye koraa no wɔde nnansa na wɔretu kwan no nya bi. Wada ne ho adi wɔ nhyiam ase pii wɔ Ghana ne amanaman ntam te sɛ African Sustainable Eco-Friendly show (Ghana) ne Miami ne New York ntadehyɛ dapɛn ahorow.

Sympathy Amanaman Ntam 
Sympathy International a mfiase no na wɔfrɛ no Millennium Ladies Club no, wɔde sii hɔ wɔ afe 2003 mu bere a na Sally yɛ sukuuni wɔ University Practice High School wɔ Cape Coast . Ne botae biako ne sɛ ɛbɛtete ntoaso sukuufo mmea ma wɔabɛyɛ mmea a wɔwɔ asɛyɛde. Ne botae titiriw ne sɛ ɛbɛbrɛ nsɛm a ɛhaw nnipa, titiriw mmea a wɔwɔ nkuraase wɔ Central Region of Ghana no ase. Anisoadehunu no ne sɛ wɔbɛma tebea a ɛfata a ɛbɛtena hɔ daa a ɛbɛma ɔmanfoɔ anya asetena a nidi wom denam nyarewa, ahokyere ne ohia a wobedi so. Nhyehyɛe a wɔayɛ ama mmeawa a wɔadi mfe a wɔbɛkɔ sukuu ne awo akwahosan ho nkyerɛkyerɛ, ne daakye nhyehyɛe. Wɔnam akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ, adwuma ho afotufoɔ ne Ghana AIDS Commission mmoa so na ɛyɛ yei.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Betty Acquah
text:
Betty Acquah (wɔwoo no 20 Oforisuo 1965) yɛ Ghanani mmaa mfoniniyɛfo. Ɔde akwan horow a ɛne pointillism, ngo mfonini ne acrylic di dwuma.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Ɔyɛ Cape Coast kuromni wɔ Ghana, na ɔde ne sukuu adesua no fã bi kɔɔ Wesley Girls’ Senior High School ne Holy Child School . Afei ɔkɔɔ n’anim wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so baabi a onyaa abodin krataa a ɛkorɔn wɔ Visual Arts mu a ɛyɛ mfoniniyɛ titire. Wɔ Japan, ɔsan nso wiee adwinni ho adesua wɔ Tokyo Adwinni Sukuu.

Adwuma 
Acquah de mfeɛ nson ayɛ adwuma ama adwinni dan a ɛwɔ Centre for National Culture a ɛwɔ Accra no na wahwɛ ɔyɛkyerɛ ahorow so wɔ Berj Art Gallery firi afe 2002 kɔsi afe 2005. Ɔyɛ Ghana Association of Visual Artists no muni . Wɔ June 2019 mu no, ɔkaa wɔ nsɛm a Newsday BBC bisabisaa no mu sɛ ɔwɔ anidasoɔ sɛ wɔbɛbue ɔman no adwini dan bi wɔ Ghana.

Acquah ayɛ ɔyɛkyerɛ wɔ Ghana, Nigeria, United Kingdom, India, Germany, Spain, Japan ne Amerika.

N'adwuma no si Ghana mmaa a ɔhunu wɔn sɛ "Ghana republic no abran a wɔmmɔ wɔn dwom" no so dua.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Anita-Pearl Ankor
text:
Anita-Pearl Mwinnabang Ankor yɛ Ghanani mfoniniyɛfo ne Muralist. Wɔfrɛ no kɛse sɛ Ɔbea Mfoniniyɛfo . Wɔ afe 2019 mu no, ɔde video bi too ne Instagram krataafa so a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɔde adwinni reyɛ ɔfasu bi ho mfonini. Saa video yi kɔɔ so trɛwee wɔ social media so.

Mfitiase mfe ne nhomasua 
Ankor yɛ Nandom kuromni a ɛwɔ Upper West Region wɔ Ghana nanso onyinii wɔ Accra . Ɔnyaa ne mfitiaseɛ nwomasua wɔ University Primary ne Junior High School. Ɔkɔɔ Mfantsiman Mmabaa Ntoaso Sukuu a owiee ne ntoaso sukuu. Wɔ afe 2011 mu no, ɔnyaa kwan kɔɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu baabi a ɔsuaa Kuadwuma ho nimdeɛ na ɔyɛɛ ne titire wɔ Post Harvest Technology mu.

Adwuma 
Bere a na ɔwɔ Level 400 wɔ Ghana Sukuupɔn mu no, Ankor fii ase yɛɛ pɛnsere adwini ne mfoniniyɛ sɛ n’anigyede. Bere a owiee sukuu no, ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ ɔman som adwumayɛfo wɔ Swedru . Ɔhyɛɛ n’adwuma ase wɔ mfoniniyɛ mu wɔ afe 2015 mu berɛ a ɔnyaa nhyɛsoɔ firii mfoniniyɛfoɔ baako adwuma a ɔhunuu no mu. Ɔhyehyɛɛ NYTAZ Arts, adwinni adwumakuw bi na ɔhwɛ so. N’adwuma titiriw ne sɛ ɔbɛyɛ afasu ho mfonini, pɛnsere adwinni, dan mu ne akyi mfoniniyɛ. Wɔ afe 2019 mu no, ɔde video bi too ne Instagram krataafa so a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɔreyɛ adwuma wɔ ɔfasuo bi so. Saa video yi kɔɔ so trɛwee wɔ social media so.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Grace Kwami
text:
Ɔdom Salome Kwami (1923. Ɔde ne nsa kyerɛɛ ne so – . 2006) yɛ Ghana odwumfo ne ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Kwami afe 1923 wɔ Worawora, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ Ghana (saa bere no na ɛyɛ Gold Coast). Ɔde ne din kɔhyɛɛ Basel Mission Mmea Akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ Nteteeɛ Kɔlege a ɛwɔ Agogo. Ɔtoaa so wɔ Kumasi College of Arts (mprempren Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology) wɔ afe 1951 mu, baabi a ɔsuaa adwinni.

Adwuma 
Bere a osuaa ade wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Sukuupɔn a Ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma So wiei no, wɔde no yɛɛ adwuma wɔ Ɔman Tete Nneɛma Akorae a ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ odumgyafo fi 1954 kosi 1957. Akyiri yi ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo wɔ Mawuli Sukuu ne Tamale Akyerɛkyerɛfo Ntetee Kɔlege fi afe 1957 kosi afe 1978.

Nneɛma a wɔde kyerɛ 
Na Kwami nimdeɛ yɛ adwini, mfoniniyɛ ne agude. Wɔakora n'adwuma so wɔ nneɛma a wɔaboaboa ano mu na wɔde akyerɛ wɔ National Museum of Ghana, Volta Regional Museum, ne Ghana Museums and Monument Board .

Ankorankoro asetra 
Kwami waree Robert Kwami wɔ afe 1954 mu. Ɔyɛ mfoniniyɛfo Atta Kwami maame . Ɔwui wɔ afe 2006.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Sandra "Alexandrina" Don-Arthur
text:
Sandra Don-Arthur (wɔwoo no 22 April 1980) a wɔsan frɛ no Alexandrina wɔ showbiz adwumayɛ mu yɛ makeup artist a ɔyɛ adwumaden ne Vlogger a ofi Ghana. Ɔno na ɔhyehyɛɛ Alexiglam Studio, Ghana adwumakuw bi a wɔyɛ aduru ne ahoɔfɛ a wɔde ahoɔfɛ ho adwuma ma mmea wɔ Ghana no ne ne kwankyerɛfo panyin.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo no maa Ghanani a ɔyɛ ɔdansifoɔ agya, Dr. Eric George Alexander Don-Arthur  ne Russiani maame, Awuraa Natalia Don-Arthur a ɔyɛ biochemist. Ɔne ne nuanom 4 nyinii wɔ Ghana ne Russia nyinaa na ɔyɛ Eric Don-Arthur, 2016 National Democratic Congress Parliamentary Candidate for the Effutu Constituency no nuabea kumaa.

Don-Arthur kɔɔ Morning Star Sukuu wɔ Cantonments na ɔtu kɔɔ St. Roses Senior High School wɔ Akwatia. Akyiri yi, ɔfirii hɔ kɔɔ United Kingdom kɔsuaa adeɛ wɔ West London College na wɔ afe 2011 mu no ɔkɔɔ Mink College baabi a ɔwiee sukuu no na ɔnyaa adansedie krataa wɔ makeup artistry, hair styling ne special effects mu. Ɔsan nso yɛ obi a wawie Ashesi Suapɔn a ɛwɔ Ghana.

Adwuma 
Wɔ afe 2011 mu no, Alexandrina hyɛɛ aseɛ yɛɛ makeup wɔ adwumayɛ mu berɛ a ɔwiee adesua wɔ UK. N’adwuma sɛ obi a ɔyɛ anim aduru no baa anim bere a ɔyɛfo a ɔyɛ animguasefo panyin no ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ ɔnyɛ aduru no mma Managing Director of MNET Africa, Biola Alabi sɛ ɔhɔho wɔ '@ Home With. . .’ TV so Dwumadi wɔ London no.

Don-Arthur ayɛ adwuma wɔ nnipa dodoɔ bi a wɔagye din wɔ Ghana ne Nigeria anigyeɛ adwuma mu te sɛ Omotola Jalade Ekehinde, Efya, Joselyn Dumas, Juliet Ibrahim, Nadia Buari, Jackie Appiah, Jim Iyke, Yvonne Okoro ne DJ Cuppy .

Maybelline New York, Ghana na ɛpaw no sɛ wɔn board of influencers no fã sɛ ɔmmoa mma onnya Maybelline dwumadi ahorow so nkɛntɛnso wɔ Ghana. Maybelline New York nso maa no hokwan sɛ ɔnyɛ Afrika TV so dwumadi a edi kan a wɔahyira so a wɔde siesie wɔn ho, “Makeup Diaries,” a wɔde too gua wɔ DSTV so wɔ aman 46 so no.

Na ɔsan nso yɛ ɔhɔhoɔ a ɔtaa kɔ hɔ na ɔyɛ animdefoɔ a ɔdi anim wɔ "Keeping It Real" ɔyɛkyerɛ a Ghana Oyikyerɛfoɔ ne Ɔhwɛfoɔ, Joselyn Dumas yɛeɛ no berɛ a ɛdi kan no mu a nnɛyi Ghanafoɔ mmaa kaa wɔn adwene wɔ nsɛmti ahodoɔ a ɛka wɔn wɔ afe 2017  Ɔayɛ makeup samufoɔ ama Glitz Africa Magazine, Debonair Afrik Magazine, Dream Wedding Magazine ne Haute Canoe Magazine a ɔne Ghanani Mfoninitwafoɔ, Gilbert Asante yɛ adwuma wɔ saa sets yi so

Ghana amammuifoɔ dodoɔ bi nso aka Alexandrina nsa a ɛyɛ abenfoɔ a wɔn mu bi ne Kan Ghana Awuraa a ɔdi kan, Nana Konadu Agyeman-Rawlings, Ursula Owusu, Nana Oye Lithur, Ghana Adwumayɛfoɔ Panyin a ɔdi kan a ɔyɛ Ɔbaa, Frema Osei Opare ne Amannɔne Nsɛm ɔsomfo, Shirley Ayorkor Botchway  na ɔyɛ ɔsomfo.

Wɔ afe 2015 mu no, ɔde nidi maa owufoɔ Kofi Ansah wɔ ayɔnkofa mu ne Maybelline New York denam ne Haute Avant Garde ahoboa a na ɛwɔ ntadeɛ a ɛfiri Ghanafoɔ a ɔyɛ anansesɛm mu adwumfo ne adebɔ mu aduruyɛ mu de kyerɛɛ Maybelline New York nneɛma ahodoɔ.

Wɔpaw no sɛ Ghanani a ɔyɛ aduruyɛfoɔ ne Afrika Atɔeɛ ananmusifoɔ nko ara a ɔde ne ho bɛhyɛ New York Fashion Week mu na ɔne Victoria's Secret model, Mayowa Nicholas, Sabah Koj yɛɛ adwuma wɔ Fall/Winter shows no mu. Wɔ afe 2019 mu no, ɔde n’ahoɔfɛ ahyɛnsodeɛ ne n’adesuabea, Alexiglam Studios sii hɔ sɛ ɛbɛboa ama Afrika ahoɔfɛ ho asɛm no anya nkɔsoɔ na wɔatete mmeranteɛ a wɔyɛ aduruyɛfoɔ.

Ɔka sɛ ne nyin sɛ obi a ɔyɛ animguasede no fi ne su a na ɔpɛ sɛ ohu nneɛma pii bere a na ɔyɛ abofra ne ɔdɔ a ɔwɔ ma nneɛma foforo a ɔhwehwɛ mu. Pat McGrath ne Bimpe Onakoya yɛ n’afotufo kakraa bi wɔ ahoɔfɛ adwuma mu.

Nnwuma a ɛda nsow 
Wɔ ahemfo nsrahwɛ a Charles, Prince of Wales ne ne yere, Camilla, Duchess of Cornwall kɔɔ Ghana wɔ November 2018 mu no, wɔyɛɛ ɔman apontow a wɔde mini-fashion show ka ho de hyɛɛ wɔn anuonyam na wɔpaw Alexandrina sɛ lead make-up artist maa ɔyɛkyerɛ no. Wɔdaa ne samufo adwuma a ɔyɛe wɔ Ghana-Nigeria amanaman ntam mfoniniyɛfo, Victoria Michaels anim ho asɛm wɔ Paris -based, Roots Magazine mu.

Adɔeyɛ 
Ɔsan nso yɛ obi a ɔka wɔn a wɔhyehyɛɛ Sickle Strong Warriors Foundation, ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛnyɛ adwuma a wɔde hwehwɛ mfasoɔ a ɛhwehwɛ sɛ ɛbɛma nkurɔfoɔ ate sickle-cell ho na wɔama biakoyɛ akɔ so wɔ sickle-cell ayarefoɔ mu wɔ Ghana.

Sɛ ne CSR ne adɔe adwuma no fã no, osuaa ne nimdeɛ nso kɔɔ Fair Justice Initiative adwuma, ‘Kae Me’. Na ɛyɛ adwuma a Ghana mfoninitwafo, Francis Kokoroko, Rania Odaymat, ne The Fair Justice Initiative a wɔde wɔn adwene sii mmea dumien a wɔabu wɔn fɔ sɛ wɔmfa wɔn nkɔto afiase wɔn nkwa nna nyinaa wɔ Nsawam Afiase ahorow no abom ayɛ adwuma . Wɔde amammerɛ ntadeɛ sesaa mmaa afiase ntadeɛ na wɔtwaa wɔn mfoni a wɔde kyerɛe wɔ ‘Make Be’ ɔyɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ La Maison wɔ Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 2018 mu. Efi saa bere no, wɔayɛ no kɔfe nhoma de ahyɛ nsɛm a wɔkamfo kyerɛ ho nkuran.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ɔne ne mma mmienu te Accra, Ghana.

title: Josephine Kuuire
text:
Josephine Ngminvielu Kuuire yɛ Ghanani mfoninitwafo, digyital adwumfo, mfoniniyɛfo ne ɔdeduani.

Asetra mu nsɛm 
Ghana na Josephine Ngminvielu Kuuire wɔ bachelor’s degree wɔ asetena mu adwuma ne nnwom mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu. Ofii ase hwehwɛɛ mfoninitwa mu sɛ mfoniniyɛfo wɔ Leonia Ntoaso Sukuu a ɛwɔ New Jersey, faako a ɔyɛɛ mfoninitwa ho adesua titiriw ne nea ɛkɔ akyiri no. Bere a ɔsan baa Ghana wɔ afe 2009 mu no, ɔsii gyinae sɛ ɔbɛtoa ne mfoninitwa adwuma so, na ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ mfoninitwafo a ɔyɛ adwuma wɔ ne sukuupɔn adesua mu.

Adwinni adwuma 
Kuuire yɛ Mumble Photography adwuma no kwankyerɛfo panyin. Wɔ afe 2016 mu no, mfoninitwafoɔ no de ne ɔyɛkyerɛ a ɛdi kan a wɔato din Second Chance, maeɛ wɔ Accra[dot]Alt. Ɛde ne ho to dijitaal nsakrae ne mfoniniyɛ so de ma ankasa ho mfonini afoforo. Digitals mfoniniyɛfo no de abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den di dwuma sɛ adwinnade a wɔde ko tia ne ayaresa kwan a ɛma asetra mu nhyɛso yɛ nea ɛfata.

Mfoniniyɛfo no nya ne da biara da osuahu ne nsɛnnennen ahorow a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ ɔbea soronko a ɔwɔ mu no kanyan no. Ɔde mfoninitwa di dwuma de hwehwɛ ahofadi, a ɔwɔ anidaso sɛ ɔbɛkanyan afoforo ma wɔahwehwɛ wɔn de, nanso obegye asetra mu nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde asi hɔ wɔ Ghanafo asetra mu no nso ho kyim.

N’adwuma no mu nsɛmti bi ne adansi, nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia a wɔasisi, nhyehyɛe, ne dwuma a mmea di wɔ abakɔsɛm ne nnɛyi amammui nhyehyɛe ahorow mu.

Wɔ afe 2016 mu no, Kuuire yɛɛ ne ho ɔyɛkyerɛ a ɛdi kan, Second Chance, wɔ Accra[dot]Alt, wɔ Accra, Ghana, ɔyɛɛ ne ho mfonini. Mfeɛ nnan akyi no, ɔne mmaa adwumfoɔ foforɔ de wɔn ho hyɛɛ Arts for All nhyehyɛeɛ: Phase II, a Creative Arts Council of Ghana na ɛhyɛɛ aseɛ no mu. Saa nhyehyɛe yi botae ne sɛ wɔbɛsan de kɔnkrit afasu a ɛwɔ Accra mmɔnten so no asiesie afasu akɛse. Ɔne adwuma no yɛɛ adwuma, ɔsan nso de ne ho hyɛɛ mfonini a wɔde yɛɛ mfonini a ɛwɔ afasu a atwa Tetteh Qurashie interchange ho ahyia no mu.

Wɔ adwumfo no fam no, saa ɔfasu ho mfonini soronko yi de nidi ma mmea a wɔaboa Ghana abakɔsɛm no bi, te sɛ Susan Ofori-Atta, ɔman no mu ɔbea oduruyɛfo a odi kan, Esther Afua Ocloo, Mabel Dove Danquah, Theodosia Okoh, nea odi kan ɔbea mmaranimfo Annie Jiagge, Laura Adorkor Coffie, Efua Sutherland, Yaa Asantewaa, Melody Millicent Danquah ne Rebecca Naa Dedei Aryeetey .

Abasobɔde ahorow 
Wɔ afe 2017 mu no, Kuuire na ɔdii nkonim wɔ Portraits Ghana Photography Prize a Dutch Embassy a ɛwɔ Ghana ne Nuku Studio na wɔyɛeɛ no mu. Wɔ afe 2018 mu no, wɔpaw n’adwuma no kaa nnipa du a wɔdii kan awieɛ wɔ Ghana no mu maa Kuenyehia Art Prize for Contemporary Ghanaian Arts.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Valerie Lawson
text:
Valerie O Lawson (wɔwoo no 1 August 1991), yɛ Ghanani makeup artist a wonim no sɛ ɔyɛ adwuma wɔ ayeforo ne aguadi mmeae nyinaa. Ɔsan nso yɛ Ghana adwini kwankyerɛfo ma Amerika ahosiesie adwumakuw, Maybelline New York na ɔhyehyɛɛ ahyɛnsode, Contours By Valerie Lawson.

Lawson ne Norway Ɔmanpanyin, Erna Solberg, Ghana Awuraa a ɔtɔ so mmienu, Samira Bawumia, HE Ms. Anne Sophie-Avé Franse Ɔnanmusifoɔ a ɔwɔ Ghana, Bozoma Saint John, Mastercard Foundation CEO, Reeta Roy, Nicole Ari Parker, ne Yolanda ayɛ adwuma Cuba.

Mfitiase asetra 
Wɔwoo Valerie Lawson wɔ Oforisuo 1, 1991, wɔ Ghana, na ne maame ne Asraafoɔ Panyin, Rtd Colonel Emmanuel Nii Lante Lawson ne Ntadeɛ Nsiesiei Awuraa. Joan Lawson na ɔkyerɛwee. Ɔyɛ mmofra baasa no mu nea ɔto so abien.

Valerie kɔɔ Katolekfo sukuu a mmeawa nyinaa tra mu, Holy Child Secondary School fi afe 2006 kosi afe 2009 na na n’ani gye ho sɛ ɔbɛyɛ ne mfɛfo sukuufo ho mfonini. Ɛno akyi no ɔkɔɔ Ghana Suapɔn wɔ afe 2009 mu baabi a ɔsuaa Business Administration.

Adwuma 
Wɔ afe 2014 mu no, ɔnyaa n’adwuma a ɛdi kan wɔ Wax print manufacturer, Printex na ɔhyɛɛ n’ayeforo makeup adwuma ase ne model bi a ɔwɔ set no so.

Ɔne Ghana ntadehyɛ adwumakuw ahorow pii nso ayɛ adwuma a Pistis Ghana, Christie Brown, Mina Evans, Charlotte Prive, Nadrey Laurent, Sarah Christian ne Hat Box Company ayɛ adwuma wɔ ntadehyɛ ho ɔsatu ne samufo nsɛm pii mu.

Wɔ afe 2016 mu no Valerie ne fashion house Pistis Ghana ne Let’s Be Seated Limited yɛɛ ayeforohyia ɔsatuo maa Kristofoɔ ne Nkramofoɔ ayeforo a ayeforohyia adwumakuo no gyee a ayeforohyia nhyehyɛeɛfoɔ, David Tutera kaa ho asɛm ka ho.

Ɔsatu no abɛyɛ afe afe adwuma na wɔayi no adi afe biara fi bere a edi kan a woyii no adi no.

Maybelline nhyehyɛe a wɔde yɛ adwuma 
Wɔ 8 Oforisuo 2020 no, wɔpaw Valerie sɛ adwini kwankyerɛfo maa Maybelline New York na ɔbɛyɛɛ Ghanani a ɔdi kan a ɔdii adwini kwankyerɛfoɔ dwumadie wɔ Ghana, maa Maybelline New York.

Nneɛma a wɔde yɛ ahosiesie line 
Ms Lawson wɔ afe 2017 mu de too gua sɛ wɔde ne cosmetic brand, CVL Beauty, reba. CVL ahoɔfɛ ayi ahoɔfɛ nnwinnade ne nneɛma ahorow bi adi a brɔs a wɔayɛ ama wɔn a wɔyɛ animdefo a wɔyɛ anim aduru wɔ Afrika nyinaa ne mmea abibifo ka ho.

title: Nana Akua Addo
text:
Nana Akua Addo yɛ Ghanani a wɔwoo no wɔ Germany a ɔyɛ mfoniniyɛfo, odiyifo ne siniyɛfo. Ɔno na ɔdii nkonim wɔ Miss Malaika mu wɔ afe 2003 mu na ɔdii nkonim wɔ Miss Ghana-Germany mu wɔ afe 2005. Wanya abasobɔde ahorow a Glitz Style Awards ne City People Entertainment Awards ka ho.

Nwomasua 
Eduu afe 2017 no, na ɔresua agodie ho ade wɔ New York Film Academy a ɛwɔ United States .

Adwuma 
Addo ayɛ sini ahorow a Destiny's Child, Blood, Wanna Be, Rain, Speechless, Never Again ne Tears ka ho mu. Ɔsan nso yɛɛ sini abien, Wannabe ne Nukuli (The Masked).

Abasobɔde ahorow

Abasobɔde ahorow a wanya no bi ne: 

 Ɔbea a wagye din a ɔyɛ fɛ/ɔhyɛ ntade a ɛyɛ fɛ sen biara (Africa) - Abryanz Style ne Fashion Awards Asfa) 2017 
 Ɔbarima a wagye din a ɔhyɛ ntade a eye sen biara - 2016 Glitz Style Awards 
 Nnipa a wɔagye din a wɔhyɛ ntade a eye sen biara - 2017 Glitz Style Awards. 
 Ɔyɛkyerɛfoɔ a ɔhyɛ ntadeɛ a ɛsen biara - 2015 Ghana Movie Awards red carpet

 Nidi Abasobɔde ma nnipa ne nnipa a wofi Awukugua - Bring Entertainment a wɔne Chiefs of Awukugua ayɛ biako

title: Nicole Amarteifio
text:
Nicole Amarteifio (wɔwoo no afe 1982) yɛ Ghana sini kwankyerɛfo, ɔyɛfo, ne sini kyerɛwfo.

Asetra mu nsɛm 
Wɔwoo Amarteifio wɔ Ghana wɔ afe 1982 mu nanso otu kɔɔ London sɛ abofra a wadi asram abiɛsa esiane asraafo atuatew a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ ne man mu nti, na ɔtraa England mfe asia. Ne nana a ɔyɛ aborɔfo ɔmantam sohwɛfo no waree ne nanabea wɔ Ghana wɔ afe 1945 mu. Akyiri yi ɔne n’abusua tu kɔɔ Scarsdale, New York, nanso afe biara ogyee akwamma wɔ Ghana.

Bere a na ɔrekɔ Scarsdale Mfinimfini Sukuu, wɔbɔɔ amanneɛ sɛ wɔtee sɛ ne yɔnko sukuuni bi rehyɛ nyansa sɛ wɔntopae Afrika sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobedi HIV haw no ho dwuma.

Amarteifio awofoɔ san tu kɔɔ Ghana wɔ afe 1997 mu. Ɔnyaa abodin krataa wɔ Afrika ne Afro-Amerika adesua mu wɔ Brandeis Suapɔn mu wɔ afe 2004.

Bere a owiee sukuu no, onyaa adwuma wɔ Washington, DC sɛ Afrika sikasɛm mu nkɔso ho ɔfotufo wɔ The Whitaker Group, na ɔyɛɛ adwuma maa Rosa Whitaker .

Afe 2006 mu no, Amarteifio tu kɔɔ Accra, Ghana, kɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ sikasɛm mu nkɔsoɔ mu wɔ African Development Foundation. Bere a otu kɔɔ Afrika akyi bere tiaa bi no, onyaa adwene sɛ ɔbɛyɛ ɔyɛkyerɛ bi te sɛ Sex and the City in Accra .

Amarteifio san kɔɔ Amerika kɔyɛɛ Georgetown Suapɔn na onyaa abodin krataa a ɛkorɔn wɔ nnwumakuw nkitahodi mu wɔ afe 2010. Wɔ Georgetown no, osuaa ade wɔ Mike Long ase, na ɔhyɛɛ n’anigye a ɔwɔ wɔ sini kyerɛw ho nkuran.

Amarteifio nyaa adwuma wɔ Wiase Nyinaa Sikakorabea sɛ obi a odi kan a ɔyɛ sohyial-media ho nhyehyɛe ho ɔbenfo wɔ Accra. Asram pii akyi a ɔsan baa Ghana no, ofii ase de n’adwene kyerɛɛ television ho adwumayɛfo, na wɔmpene so sɛ wɔbɛyɛ adwuma no nanso wɔhyɛɛ no nkuran sɛ onsua sɛnea wɔkyerɛw ɔyɛkyerɛ bi.

Amarteifio yɛɛ sikasɛm nhyehyɛe na ohui sɛ sika a ɛdɔɔso nkutoo na ohia na ama wafi ase sen sɛ obetumi ayɛ bere mũ nyinaa. Nea ɛbɛyɛ na wasua nneɛma a wɔyɛ ho ade no, odii wɔn a wɔyɛ nneɛma a wɔde nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ pii yɛ adwuma akyi na ɔde ne din kɔhyɛɛ mpɔtam hɔ kɔlege adesua bi mu. Amarteifio huu Sex and the City nsɛm ne dwumadi ahorow a ɛfa ho no ho nkyerɛwee wɔ intanɛt so, na ɔde dii dwuma sɛ nhwɛsode maa ne nkyerɛwee, ne nsɛm a efi ne nnamfo a wɔwɔ Afrika nyinaa hɔ nso. Onyaa agoruyɛfo wɔ casting calls mu, na ɔne ne yɔnko sukuuni dedaw bi, Maame Adjei, dii nkitaho sɛ ɔnyɛ Zainab dwumadi. Adjei ne Nana Mensah, a Amarteifio paw no maa Sadé suban no kɔɔ sukuu wɔ Connecticut.

Amarteifio de mpɔtam hɔ Ghana sini adwumayɛfo bi dii dwuma de too ne dwumadi no fã kɛse no ara dapɛn awiei ne anadwo sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ɔne n’adwuma a ɔyɛ wɔ Wiase Sikakorabea no remmɔ abira.

Ne dwumadi no bere a edi kan, An African City, no, woyii no adi wɔ YouTube wɔ March 2014 mu. Ɛdi nnamfo baanum a wɔsan tu kɔɔ Afrika bere a wɔtraa amannɔne akyi na wɔhwehwɛ ɔdɔ, adwuma, ne anadwo asetra mu wɔ Ghana ahenkurow mu no asetra akyi, na wɔbɔ nna ho nkɔmmɔ pefee. Amarteifio botae ne sɛ ɔbɛbɔ nkɔmmɔ a ɛfa nea ɛyɛ Afrika de ho, na obeyi ahyɛde ahorow afi hɔ. Wɔkasa tiaa nsɛm a ɛtoatoa so no sɛ egyina hɔ ma nnipa atitiriw a wɔne Afrika mmea dodow no ara nni nsɛ pii.

Amarteifio yii saa ɔkasatia yi fii hɔ, na ogyee adwene a Afrikani bea a wɔkyekyem pɛpɛɛpɛ wɔ no ho kyim. Ɔyɛkyerɛ no bere a ɛtɔ so mmienu no puei wɔ afe 2016. Ne TV so dwumadi a ɛto so abien, amammuisɛm mu anigyesɛm a wɔfrɛ no The Republic, nso woyii no adi wɔ afe 2016 mu, a egyina asetra mu nsɛm ankasa so wɔ Accra.

Wɔafrɛ Amarteifio sɛ "Ghana Shonda Rhimes ." Wɔbɔɔ no din sɛ OkayAfrica Mmea 100 no mu biako wɔ afe 2018. Ne sini a edi kan a ɔyɛe, Before the Vows, yii no adi nea edi kan wɔ Seattle Amanaman Ntam Sini Afahyɛ ase wɔ afe 2018 mu. Ɔdɔ ho aseresɛm, edi abusuabɔ a ɛda Afua ne Nii ntam bere a wɔresusuw aware ho no akyi.

Sini ho mfoniniyɛ 

 2012: Praing for Daylight (sini tiawa; ɔkyerɛwfo ne nea ɔne no yɛe)
 2014–mprempren: Afrika Kuropɔn bi (TV so dwumadi ahorow; ɔkyerɛwfo, ɔkwankyerɛfo a ɔka ho, ɔyɛfo)
 2016: The Republic (TV so dwumadi ahorow; ɔkyerɛwfo, ɔkwankyerɛfo, ɔyɛfo)
 2018: Before the Vows (ɔkyerɛwfo, ɔkwankyerɛfo, ɔyɛfo) .
 2020: Indie Nation (sɛ ɔno ankasa)

title: Akofa Edjeani Asiedu
text:
Akofa Edjeani (wɔwoo no 20 Ɔpɛpɔn 1969) yɛ Ghanani a ɔyɛ sini ho ɔyɛkyerɛfo, ɔyɛfo ne adwumayɛfo. Ne sini tiawa, Not My Daughter (sini a ɛfa mmea awotwaa a wotwitwa ho ), nyaa abasobɔde a ɛyɛ Sini Tiatiaa a Ɛsen Biara wɔ African Movie Academy Awards (AMAA) mu wɔ afe 2008 mu, na I Sing of a Well, sini a ɔyɛɛ mu ɔyɛkyerɛfo na ɔne no yɛɛ no, . onyaa abasobɔde abiɛsa ne Asɛnni Baguafo Abasobɔde a Ɛsen Biara a efi African Movie Academy Awards mu wɔ afe 2010.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Akofa wɔ 20 Ɔpɛpɔn 1969 wɔ Ghana . Ɔnyaa ne ntoaso sukuu wɔ Mawuli Sukuu mu baabi a ɔfirii aseɛ yɛɛ agodie sɛ sukuu no drama kuo no muni. Ɔwɔ bachelor’s degree wɔ adwinni mu wɔ University of Ghana Performing Arts ne adansedi krataa wɔ PR, Marketing ne advertising mu wɔ Ghana Institute of Journalism (1995). Ɔyɛ Constance Ama Emefa Edjeani-Afenu nuabea

Adwuma 
Edjeani yɛ odiyifoɔ wɔ n’adwuma mu, ɔsuaa Performing Arts wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu. Wayɛ Ghana ne Nigeria-Ghana sini ahorow pii fi 1990 mfe no mfinimfini. Wɔ afe 1995 mu no, ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ For Better For Worse, 2015 mu no ɔyɛɛ ne ho wɔ Britania-Ghana sini a wɔdii nkonim wɔ abasobɔdeɛ mu , The Cursed Ones . Na ɔyɛ Ghana Amammerɛ Nhyiam no Bere Tiaa mu Aban Bagua no muni.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Edjeani waree Robert Asiedu bɛboro mfe 20, akyiri yi awarefo no tetew mu na wogyaee aware. Wɔ July 2018 mu no, ɔmaa ɛdaa adi wɔ nsɛm a wobisabisaa Deloris Frimpong Manso, wɔ ne dwumadi, The Delay Show mu sɛ wagyae aware nanso ɔne obi rebɔ na ɔreyɛ nhyehyɛe sɛ ɔbɛsan aware.  Ɔwɔ mma baanu.

Nnwuma afoforo a wɔyɛ 
Edjeani runs a restaurant in Kanda, Accra, sɛdeɛ wɔ afe 2016 mu no ɔmaa wɔhunuu no wɔ nsɛmbisa a ɛhyehyɛɛ adidibea no mfeɛ 17 a atwam no sɛ wɔbɛtɔn aduane de ahwɛ n’abusua.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Lydia Forson
text:
Lydia Forson (wɔwoo no Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 24, afe 1984) yɛ Ghana odiyifo, ɔkyerɛwfo, ne ɔyɛkyerɛfo. Wɔ afe 2010 mu no onyaa African Movie Academy Award a ɛfa Oyikyerɛfo a Ɔsen Biara wɔ Dwumadi a Edi Kan mu.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Forson wɔ 24 Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 1984  wɔ Mankessim, Ghana . Ɔnyaa ne mfitiaseɛ nwomasua wɔ Wilmore Mfitiaseɛ Sukuu a ɛwɔ Kentucky . Bere a odii mfe akron no, n’abusua tu kɔɔ Ghana, faako a ɔtoaa ne nhomasua so wɔ Akosombo Amanaman Ntam Sukuu . Ɔsan nso kɔɔ St. Louis Ntoaso Sukuu, Kumasi, faako a owiee ne ntoaso sukuu adesua.

Forson wiee Ghana Suapɔn, na onyaa abodin krataa wɔ Borɔfo Kasa ne Amanneɛbɔ Adesua mu.

Adwuma 
Forson agodie adwuma no hyɛɛ aseɛ denam cameo dwumadie wɔ Hotel St. James (2005), Run Baby Run (2006), Different Shades of Blue (2007) ne stint wɔ nokwasɛm dwumadi The Next Movie Star in Nigeria (2007). Shirley Frimpong-Manso, Sparrow Productions kwankyerɛfo panyin a na ɔne no adi kan ayɛ adwuma wɔ Ghana television so dwumadi a wɔfrɛ no Different Shades of Blue mu no nam sini a wɔato din Scorned so san de Forson baa sini ahorow so. Saa dwumadie a ɛdi kan yi na ɛmaa wɔyii no a ɛdi kan wɔ African Movie Academy Awards (AMAA) sɛ Ɔbea Oyikyerɛfoɔ a Ɔreba a Ɔsen Biara.

Wɔ afe 2009 mu no, Forson dii dwuma wɔ The Perfect Picture a Shirley Frimpong-Manso yɛe a enyaa abasobɔde no mu. Wayɛ dwumadi ahorow wɔ A Sting in a Tale, Phone Swap, Masquerades, Keteke, ne Sidechic Gang mu .

Sini ho mfoniniyɛ 

 Hotel St. James (2005) – Cameo dwumadi ahorow
 Run Baby Run (2006) – Dwumadi a ɛboa

title: Dzifa Gomashie
text:
Ablah Dzifa Gomashie yɛ Ghanani ɔbaa a wayɛ odiyifo, ɔyɛfo, screen scriptwriter ne ɔmanyɛfo. Na ɔyɛ Ɔmanpanyin Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ nsrahwɛ so wɔ National Democratic Congress (NDC) mu wɔ wɔn tumidi mu wɔ afe 2013 ne 2017 ntam bere a na John Dramani Mahama yɛ ɔmampanyin no. Mprempren ɔyɛ NDC  mmrahyɛbagua kandifo wɔ Ketu South Constituency ne ɔhemmaa-ɛna wɔ Aflao Amammerɛ Mpɔtam.

Nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Gomashie wɔ Accra maa Owura Patrick Dotse Gomashie ne Helen Gomashie. Ɔfiri Aflao wɔ Volta mantam mu na wɔwoo no 25 July 1965. Ɔnyaa ne ntoaso sukuu wɔ St. Louis Senior High School wɔ Kumasi na afei ɔkɔɔ so wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu, faako a ɔnyaa diploma wɔ Theatre Arts, bachelor’s degree wɔ Theatre Management ne MPhil wɔ African Studies mu wɔ Institute of African Adesua ahorow .

Adwuma 
Gomashie adwuma sɛ odiyifo fii ase wɔ 1985 mu bere a ɔde ne ho kɔbɔɔ Talents Theatre Company no. Ɔayɛ ne ho wɔ agodie te sɛ Black Star, Mambo, Chaka the Zulu, Jogolo ne The Third Woman mu. Ɔsan nso ayɛ sini ahorow pii a nea ɛka ho ne: Ghost Tears, House of Pain, Heart of Gold ne National Arts NAFTI asuafoɔ dwumadiɛ dodoɔ bi. Ɔsan nso yɛ script kyerɛwfo a ɔkyerɛw na ɔyɛɛ ' By The Fire Side ', GTV dwumadi a ɛde abasɛm a wɔka di dwuma de hyɛɛ mmofra nkuran sɛ wɔnkenkan pii na wonyaa wɔn akenkan ho nimdeɛ nanso mprempren wɔagyae esiane sɛ wonni wɔn a wɔboa nti.

Sɛ yɛde agodie to nkyɛn a, ɔwɔ adidibea bi a wɔfrɛ no ‘Mama’s Kitchen’ wɔ Ashale Botwe, a ɛnyɛ adwuma bio.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔ afe 2013 mu no, Ɔmampanyin John Dramani Mahama na ɔpaw no na ɔpaw no sɛ Ɔmanpanyin John Dramani Mahama paw no sɛ Ɔmanpanyin abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Nsrahwɛ, Adwinni & Amammerɛ so, dibea a odii kosii sɛ n’apam no, NDC dii nkogu wɔ abatow no mu na wɔde hyɛɛ aban a edi hɔ no nsa wɔ afe 2017 mu

Wɔ 24 Ɔbɛnem 2019 no, ɔsii akan na ɔdii nkonim wɔ mmɔdenbɔ mu sɛ ɔbɛgyina Ketu South mantam ananmu wɔ National Democratic Congress (NDC) tekiti so wɔ afe 2020 abatoɔ no mu. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ bid mu de abatoɔ 586 berɛ a akansifoɔ afoforɔ, Foga Nukunu, Joseph Nyavi ne Nicholas Worklatsi dii nkoguo wɔ abatoɔ 555, 294 ne 302 mu.

Boayikuw ahorow 
Gomashie yɛ Ohia a Wɔtew So Ho Nhyehyɛe Boayikuw no muni na ɔsan yɛ Aguadi, Nnwuma ne Nsrahwɛ Boayikuw no muni.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Na Gomashie waree owufo Martin K. G. Ahiaglo. Na awarefo no nni abofra biara abom. Na Dzifa wɔ ɔbabarima bi a ofi abusuabɔ bi a atwam mu.

Animuonyamhyɛ 
Wɔn a wɔyɛɛ nhyehyɛe maa 3Music Awards no hyɛɛ no anuonyam wɔ nea wayɛ wɔ anigyede adwuma mu wɔ Ghana no ho.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Yvonne Nelson
text:
Yvonne Nelson (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn 12, 1985) yɛ Ghana odiyifo, mfoniniyɛfo, sini yɛfoɔ ne adwumayɛfo. Ɔayɛ sini ahorow pii, a House of Gold (2013), Any Other Monday, In April, ne Swings ka ho.

Mfitiase asetra 
Wɔwoo Yvonne Nelson wɔ Accra, Ghana. Ɔyɛ Fante ne Ga abusua mu. Ofii ne nhomasua ase wɔ St. Martin De Porres Sukuu a ɛwɔ Accra na akyiri yi ɔkɔɔ Aggrey Memorial Senior High School . Ɔnyaa ne sukuupɔn wɔ Zenith University College ne Central University, faako a ɔyɛɛ abodin krataa adesua wɔ nnipa ahoɔden sohwɛ mu . Ɔwiee Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration (GIMPA) na ɔnyaa abodin krataa wɔ Amanaman Ntam Abusuabɔ ne Diplomacy mu wɔ afe 2020.

Adwuma 
Nelson a na anka ɔyɛ Miss Ghana akansini no hyɛɛ n’adwuma ase wɔ akwanhyia mu berɛ a ɔkɔɔ baabi a n’ani gye ho sɛ ɔrekɔhwɛ audition na producer no bisaa sɛ ɔbɛpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ performance anaa. Akyiri yi onyaa ne nɔma bere a ɔpow nea wɔde maa no no. Sheand dii dwuma wɔ ne sini mu dwumadi a edi kan mu a ɔyɛɛ dwumadi akɛse wɔ sini mu wɔ Princess Tyra mu wɔ afe 2007 ne Playboy mu wɔ afe 2008. Ɔkɔɔ siniyɛ mu kɔɔ akyiri wɔ afe 2011 mu. Nea edi kan a ɔyɛe ne sini a wɔato din The Price, a woyii no adi saa afe no ara mu. Ɔsan nso yɛɛ Single and Married wɔ afe 2012 ne House of Gold wɔ afe 2013. Nea otwa to no nyaa Mfonini a Ɛsen Biara wɔ Ghana Sini Abasobɔde mu ne Ghana Sini a Ɛsen Biara wɔ 2013 City People Entertainment Awards .

Ankorankoro asetra 
Wɔ Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 29, 2017 no, Nelson ne n’adamfo dedaw, Jamie Roberts woo ɔbabea. Oyikyerɛfo no yɛɛ komm wɔ ne nyinsɛn ho nsɛm a wɔkae ho kosii sɛ ɔnam WOW Magazine Cover so de ne babea awo ho amanneɛbɔ mae.

Adɔeyɛ 
Nelson hyehyɛɛ Yvonne Nelson Glaucoma Foundation wɔ afe 2010 mu sɛ ɛbɛboa ama nkurɔfoɔ ate yareɛ no ho asɛm. Ɛdenam mmoa a efi Ghanafo afoforo a wɔagye din hɔ so no, ɔkyeree nsoromma nyinaa adɔe nnwom bi guu kasɛt so na ɔtow video bi de boaa ma wɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ nkurɔfo. Ɔsan too video bi de boaa ma wɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ nkurɔfo atiridiinini ho ade. Esiane n’adɔe dwumadi ahorow titiriw wɔ glaucoma mu nti, GoWoman Magazine ne Printex hyɛɛ no anuonyam wɔ ne fapem ne sini adwuma no ho.

Ntoabɔ 
Wɔ May 17, 2015 no, Nelson faa no too ne ho so, ne nnipa afoforo a wɔagye din, sɛ wɔde nne pii bɛka nnipadɔm no ho wɔ ɔsɔretia a wɔde tia ahoɔden ho haw a ɛwɔ ne man mu no mu. Ɔdii anim wɔ asomdwoeɛ mu ɔwɛn a wɔfrɛ no DumsorMustStop wɔ May 16, 2015. Mprempren wɔde hashtag #dumsormuststop redi dwuma wɔ social media so de ahyɛ Ghanafo haw a ɛfa ahoɔden ho ahokyere ho no mu den. Yvonne a wonim no sɛ ɔkasa kɛse nnansa yi wɔ amammuisɛm ho nsɛm a ɛwɔ ɔman no mu ho no dii awerɛhow sɛ nkɔso a ennyaa Ghana fi bere a ɔman no nyaa ahofadi wɔ afe 1957 Ɔka kyerɛɛ BBC wɔ nsɛm a wobisabisaa no mu sɛ ebia obesusuw ho sɛ ɔbɛpere amammui dibea daakye. Oyikyerɛfoɔ Yvonne Nelson tweet sɛ ɔrehwɛ da a Ghanafoɔ bɛpo sɛ wɔbɛto aba wɔ ɔmampanyin abatoɔ mu de nkra akɔma amanyɔfo

Gye to mu 
Wɔmaa Yvonne Nelson abasobɔde titiriw wɔ "MTN Heroes of Change" de kyerɛɛ n'adɔe adwuma a ɔyɛe wɔ atiridiinini a ɔko tiae no ho.

title: Brigitte Perenyi
text:
Brigitte Sossou Perenyi (wɔwoo no wɔ Togo wɔ afe 1990) yɛ Ghanani a ɔyɛ nwoma. Ɔtraa ase wɔ nkoasom tebea mu bere a wɔkyeree no bere a na wadi mfe ason na wɔde no kɔɔ Ghana kronkronbea a na Trokosi, anaa anyame yere, yɛ wiase adeyɛ a ɛma mmabaa kɔ adwuma a wɔhyɛ wɔn ma wɔyɛ de gye wɔn abusuafo bɔne no. Amerikani adwini atorofo bi gyee no sɛ ne ba na bere a na wanyin no ɔsan kɔɔ Ghana kɔhwɛɛ adɔe kuw a ɛboaa no, Ghana abusua a wɔhwɛɛ no ne n’awo abusua a ɛwɔ Togo no. N’asetena ho nsɛm anya abasobɔdeɛ na wɔ afe 2018 mu no wɔpaw no sɛ BBC Mmea 100 no mu baako .

Abrabɔ 
Wɔwoo no wɔ Togo wɔ afe 1990 mu. Na ɔyɛ mmofra baanum no mu nea ɔto so anum.

Bere a odii mfe ason no, ne maame somaa no sɛ ɔnkɔtra ne papa nua ba nkyɛn wɔ, Lome, Toga ahenkurow a na obetumi akɔ sukuu no. Brigitte na ne papa nua barima kyeree no de no kɔɔ Ghana kronkronbea bi sɛ ɔrekɔtua awaresɛeɛ a ne papa nua barima yɛeɛ no ho ka, sɛdeɛ Trojanfoɔ atetesɛm kyerɛ no. Ná asɔfo no nyan no wɔ nnɔnnum. Na ɔnte kasa no ase nanso na ɔprapra na ɔsiesie ansa na wayɛ adwuma wɔ afuw bi mu da mũ no nyinaa. Wɔanto no mmonnaa nanso wɔamma no nhomasua.  Na saa adeyɛ yi atra hɔ bɛboro mfe 300 na awiei koraa no wɔmaa ɛyɛɛ mmara so bu wɔ Ghana wɔ afe 1998 mu, ɛwom sɛ akɔ so na wɔadi ɔsɔfo biara ho asɛm da de. Mpɔtam a ɛwɔ Ghana, Benin, ne Togo kɔɔ so yɛɛ Trokosi wɔ ɔkwan a mmara mma ho kwan so. Afe a Brigitte hyɛn kronkronbea hɔ no, na mmea ne mmeawa 5,000 wɔ ɔman no mu wɔ Trokosi .

Wɔ 1997 mu no, CBS nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn no U.S. dwumadi a egye simma 60 no kyerɛɛ wiase no tebea horow a Brigitte traa ase denam kyerɛwtohɔ bi a wɔato din My Stolen Childhood so. Ɛnam NGO International Needs a Juliana Dogbadzi na ɔhyɛɛ aseɛ no mmoa so no, Kenneth Perenyi sii gyinaeɛ sɛ ɔbɛkɔ Ghana sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a ɔbɛgyae no.  Na Perenyi anya ahonyade afi mfonini ahorow a ɔyɛe mu na na FBI reyɛ ne ho nhwehwɛmu . Ne nyinaa mu no ɔyɛɛ nhyehyɛe sɛ wogyae no na wɔsomaa no sɛ ɔnkɔtra mfiase no wɔ Ghana Sabaa abusua no nkyɛn nkɔsua Borɔfo kasa na ɔmfa ne tebea no nyɛ nea ɛfata bɛyɛ mfe abien. Wɔ afe 1999 mu no, Kenneth Perenyi faa no sɛ ne ba na ɔde no kɔɔ United States, faako a na ɛyɛ den sɛ wɔboom bere a Brigitte bo fuwii na na Kenneth haw sɛ ebia wɔbɛkyere no wɔ atoro a wadi kan ayɛ ho. Wɔboom dii mfe 13 a edi hɔ no. Bere a wogyaee Brigitte bɛyɛ mfe 20 akyi no, ɔsan kɔɔ Togo kɔhyiaa n’abusua a ɔwoo no. Wɔ saa akwantu yi mu no, ɔne BBC kyerɛw n’asɛm no, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ɔbɛkasa atia trokosi adeyɛ.

Ɔsan kɔɔ Ghana bere a na wadi mfe 21 sɛ ɔrekɔyɛ adwuma wɔ Accra. Amanaman Ntam Ahiade adɔe kuw no boaa no bio. Ɔkɔɔ Sabaa abusua no nkyɛn na wɔhyɛɛ nyansa sɛ ɔnhwehwɛ n’awo abusua wɔ Togo. Ɔsan ne ne nuanom baanan, n’awofo a wɔwoo no, ne onuabarima bi a wɔwoo no bere a ofii hɔ akyi no boom. Nkitahodi anyɛ mmerɛw efisɛ na ne werɛ afi ne kasa a edi kan no, nanso ohui sɛ n’awofo nnim da sɛ ne papa nua ba de no kɔɔ Ghana. Na ne papa nua barima apow sɛ ɔbɛka baabi a ɔwɔ, na wosusuwii sɛ wawu. Kan no na osusuw sɛ wɔyɛ biako wɔ ne ayaresa a enye no mu na afei de otumi de kyɛ wɔn 
Ɔfaa kwan a ɛto so abien wɔ mfe abiɛsa akyi kɔkyerɛw n’asɛm maa Marie Claire nsɛmma nhoma . Wɔ afe 2017 mu no ɔsan kɔɔ Togo bio a na sini adwumayɛfoɔ bi a European Journalism Center ne Code4Africa de sika boa no ka ne ho. Ohui sɛ adeyɛ no ma tumi. BBC na ɛhwɛɛ sini no so na ɛde dwumadi bi bae. Afe a edi hɔ no, wɔkyerɛw ne din wɔ 100 Women BBC 2018 . Saa nsɛm a BBC akyerɛw yi ka mmea 100 a wɔanya nkɛntɛnso kɛse wɔ afe no mu no bom. Waka sɛ ne Kristofo gyidi a ɔne Sabaa abusua no nyae no ama watumi de ne papa nua barima ne n’ankasa bɔne akyɛ no.

Eduu afe 2017 no, afei de na wɔasiesie ne Amerikani a ɔhwɛ no, Kenneth Perengi, wɔamfa no ankɔ asɛnnibea na wɔtɔn n’atoro nneɛma no kɔ akyiri araa ma bere a atwam no araa ma mmara no nni dwuma bio. Ɔkɔɔ so nyaa n’asetrade fii mfonini ahorow mu, sen sɛ ɔbɛyɛ atoro, na ɔkyerɛw n’asetra ho asɛm a wanka ogye a ɔde ne ho hyɛɛ mu no ho asɛm.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Veronica Quarshie
text:
Veronica Martha Agowa Quarshie yɛ Ghanani a wagye din a ɔyɛ sini, ɔkwankyerɛfo ne sini kyerɛwfo, a wonim no sɛ wasakra tebea a na ɛwɔ hɔ saa bere no wɔ nsɛm a na wɔyɛ mmea ho mfonini sɛ akyi benkyifo. Ɔsesaa mmea ho asɛm fii asɛm a emu nna hɔ, ɛyɛ stilted na ɛnyɛ nea ɛkari pɛ wɔ mmarima ne mmea mu kɔɔ mmea a na wɔwɔ wɔn ahunmu.

Nwomasua 
Quarshie nyaa ne ntetee wɔ siniyɛ mu fii Ɔman Sini ne Television Asoɛe wɔ 1992 mu, faako a owiee sukuu no na onyaa Sini Akwankyerɛ ho adesua titiriw.

Adwuma 
Bere a Quarshie wiee sukuu no, ofii n’adwuma ase sɛ siniyɛfo. Ɔyɛɛ ne sini a edi kan, Twin Lover, a Piro Production yɛe wɔ 1994 mu. Efi saa bere no wayɛ afoforo pii a Ripples a wɔagye abasobɔde ne A Stab in the Dark ka ho. Ɔne nnwuma akɛseɛ te sɛ Ghana Broadcasting Corporation, TV Africa, Film Africa Limited ne Princess Films a ɛwɔ Accra ayɛ adwuma. Ɔasom na ɔda so ara som mprempren wɔ abasobɔde nhyehyɛe ahorow pii a Golden Movie Awards ka ho baguafo mu .

Abasobɔde ne agyede a wɔde ma

title: Zynnell Zuh
text:
Lydia Zynnell Zuh (wɔwoo no July 18, 1990) yɛ Ghanani ntadehyɛ ho ɔbenfo, odiyifo, ɔkyerɛwfo, ɔyɛkyerɛfo, television so nipa ne ɔyamyefo a ofi Volta mantam mu wɔ Ghana . Ɔde ne ho bɔɔ Ghana sini adwuma wɔ afe 2004 mu na ɛfiri saa berɛ no wanya abasobɔdeɛ ahodoɔ bi wɔ n’adwuma ho a nea ɛka ho ne, Glitz Style Awards, City People Entertainment Awards ne Golden Movie Awards .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Zynnell Zuh wɔ Accra, Ghana. Ɔnyaa ne ntoaso sukuu adesua wɔ Wesley Girls Senior High School . Na afei ɔkɔɔ so wɔ Ghana Sukuupɔn mu baabi a onyaa abodin krataa wɔ Asase ne Amanneɛbɔ Adesua mu .

Adwuma 
Zynnell Zuh bɛkaa Ghana Movie Industry ho wɔ afe 2004 mu. Nea edi kan a ɔdaa ne ho adi wɔ screen so ne TV so dwumadi a ɛne ‘Sticking to the Promise’ a Point Blank Media yɛe no. Oyikyerɛfoɔ yi a Shirley Frimpong-Manso na ɔhunuu no no, gyee din wɔ afe 2010 mu berɛ a ɔdii dwuma wɔ television so agodie ne sini ahodoɔ pii mu, a ‘Tears of a Smile’ ka ho. Akyiri yi ɔde ne ho hyɛɛ siniyɛ mu baabi a ɔyɛɛ When Love Comes Around, a ɛnyaa abasobɔdeɛ wɔ 2015 Africa Magic Viewer’s Choice abasobɔdeɛ mu.

Nnwuma 
Ɔyɛɛ Bere a Ɔdɔ Ba, Ɔdɔ a Ɛmfa Ho ne Anniversary.

Adɔeyɛ 
Ɛde besi afe 2016 no, na ɔyɛ United Against Child Poverty Campaign, nhyehyɛe a African Rights Initiative International yɛe de boa ma wɔtu mmofra ohia ase wɔ Afrika no ananmusifo. Ɔsan nso yɛ Inspire Africa NGO no Patron.
