title: Marian Ewurama Addy
text:
Marian Ewurama Addy FGA . Ɔde ne nsa kyerɛɛ ne so OV (woo Cole ; 7 Ɔpɛpɔn 1942 – 14 Ɔbɛnem 2014) yɛ Ghana biochemist ne Ɔman Nyansahu ne Nkontaabu Quiz no Host a odi kan .  Ghanani bea a odi kan a onyaa dibea a ɛyɛ abɔde ho nyansahu ho ɔbenfo a odi mũ, Addy bɛyɛɛ nhwɛso maa sukuu mmeawa ne mmea nyansahufo a wɔrefi ase wɔ hokwan ahorow a enni ano wɔ nyansahu, mfiridwuma, mfiridwuma ne akontaabu ( STEM ) nteɛso ahorow mu. Marian Addy nso yɛ Ghana Academy of Arts and Sciences Fellow, wɔpaw no afe 1999. Wɔ saa afe no ara mu no, wɔmaa no UNESCO Kalinga Nkonimdi a Ɛma Nyansahu Agye Din.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Ewurama Addy 7 Ɔpɛpɔn 1942 wɔ Nkawkaw wɔ Ghana Apuei Fam, na ne maame Samuel Joseph Cole ne Angelina Kwofie Cole. Ɔsuaa adeɛ wɔ St Monica’s Secondary School wɔ Mampong-Ashanti firi Ɔbɛnem 1956 kɔsi June 1960 baabi a ɔdii mu wɔ agumadiɛ mu na ɔnyaa ne ‘O’ ne ‘A’ level adansedie nkrataa. Ɔsan kɔɔ Holy Child Girls’ School a ɛwɔ Cape Coast no nso . Ɔnyaa ne bachelor’s degree a ɛdi kan wɔ afifideɛ ho nimdeɛ mu wɔ chemistry mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn, Legon . Akyiri yi onyaa abodin krataa a ɛkorɔn ne oduruyɛfo abodin krataa wɔ abɔde a nkwa wom ho adesua mu wɔ Pennsylvania Ɔman Sukuupɔn mu .

Adwuma 
Addy duu dibea sɛ biochemistry ho ɔbenfo a ɔyɛ pɛ wɔ Ghana Sukuupɔn mu, faako a ɛnyɛ sɛ na ɔyɛ ɔbea ɔbenfo a odi kan wɔ nyansahu mu wɔ sukuupɔn no mu nko, na mmom Ghana nso sɛ ɔman mũ no nyinaa. Wɔ saa sukuupɔn koro no ara mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ Dwumadibea a ɛhwɛ Biochemistry, Cell and Molecular Biology so no Titenani fi 1988 kosi 1991 ne 1994 kosi 1997. Addy kɔhyɛɛ pɛnhyen wɔ afe 2002 mu sɛ Ɔbenfo a ɔkyerɛ Abɔde a Nkwa Wom Ho Adesua.

Bere a na ɔyɛ ɔbenfo ne dwumadibea panyin no, na ɔyɛ Aman a Wɔrenya Nkɔso Ho Nhyehyɛe Boayikuw (PCDC) no guamtrani na na ɔyɛ Ɔman Bagua a Ɛhwɛ Adwumayɛfo ne Mfiridwumayɛfo Sɔhwɛ So (NABPTEX) no guamtrani . Ɔyɛɛ Dwumadie no sohwɛfoɔ maa Nyansahu Nhomasua Dwumadie a ɛwɔ Accra ma Afrika (SEPA), Pan Africa nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa nyansahu nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛdi kan wɔ sukuupɔn mu wɔ 1970 mfeɛ no mu. Ɔsomm wɔ Kwami Boayikuo, mfiridwuma boayikuo a ɛhwɛ polytechnic nkyerɛkyerɛ so a Ɔman Badwa a ɛhwɛ sukuupɔn so (NCTE) hyehyɛeɛ no mu, sɛ wɔbɛsua na wɔakamfo nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛbɛboa Ghana aban no ama wɔaboa polytechnic nkyerɛkyerɛ. Wɔ afe 1994 mu no, na ɔsan yɛ UNDP afotufoɔ kuo a emufoɔ yɛ 4 a wɔwɔ Ghana a wɔde ahyɛ wɔn nsa sɛ wɔnhyehyɛ Ɔman Dwumadie Nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma Nkɔsoɔ ho no muni. Na ɔyɛ Ghana Atomic Energy Commission no board member fi afe 1996 kosi afe 1998. Ɔsom sɛ WHO Ɔmantam Abenfo Boayikuw a Ɛhwɛ Amanne Aduruyɛ So no muni, na ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ ɔfotufo wɔ Amanaman Ntam Nyansahu Fapem, wɔ Stockholm, Sweden . Na ɔyɛ Western Africa Network of Natural Products Research Scientists (WANNPRES) a wɔde sii hɔ wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2002 mu no Fapemfo ne Ɔkyerɛwfo Panyin a odi kan

Na ɔwɔ osuahu pii wɔ mfitiaseɛ ne nyansahu a wɔde di dwuma nyinaa mu, ɔmaa ɔkasa kyerɛɛ adesuafoɔ a wɔrekɔwie, wɔn a wɔrewie sukuu, nsensan ne aduruyɛ ho adesuafoɔ wɔ Ghana Suapɔn, Legon ne akyiri yi wɔ Howard University College of Medicine wɔ Washington DC .

Wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2008 mu no, wɔpaw Addy sɛ Anglican University College of Technology, mfiridwuma ho nhyehyɛe a wɔyɛ wɔ ntoaso sukuu mu no Titenani a odi kan.

Ɔne ne nuabeanom baanu, Jane ne Elizabeth boom hyehyɛɛ Abasobɔde a wɔde ma “Abeawa a Ɔsen Biara” wɔ ne sukuupɔn, St Monica Ntoaso Sukuu mu. Ghana aban no paw no sɛ Officer of the Order of the Volta esiane ne mmoa a ɔde mae wɔ nyansahu ne mmabaa ne mmofra nhomasua mu nti.

Hwehwɛ mu 
Nea Addy de n’adwene sii so wɔ nhomasua mu nhwehwɛmu mu ne nnuru a wɔde nhabannuru yɛ a wɔde sa nyarewa a ɛtaa ba no biochemistry; titiriw wɔ mmeae a ɛfa wɔn ahobammɔ ne wɔn mmɔdenbɔ ho. Nhwehwɛmu a ɔyɛe wɔ nhwiren a wɔfrɛ no Desmodium adscendens a nhabannuru ho animdefo de sa ayamtu ne akisikuru ho no kyerɛe sɛ na ade a ɛyɛ adwuma no yɛ nnuru foforo a mprempren wɔfrɛ no soyasaponins . Eyi boae ma wohuu sɛ wɔde nnuru a ɛtete saa a wɔde sa ayamtu ne asikreyare a ɛto so abien di dwuma anaa.  Nhwehwɛmu a ɔyɛe wɔ asikreyare mu nneɛma a nkwa wom ho no maa afifide a wɔde nhabannuru yɛ a wɔde sa tebea no nyaa nkɔso. Wɔ n’asetra mu no, Marian Ewurama Addy tintim nhwehwɛmu nhoma ahorow 22 a ɛfa ayamtu, anaphylaxis, asikreyare a ɛto so abien, ne mogya mmoroso ho a ɛfa nhabannuru ayaresa ho.

Ɔman Nyansahu ne Nkontaabu Ho Nsɛmmisa 
Ɔbenfoɔ Addy mmoa titire baako a ɔde maa Ghana, ne obiara a ɔhwɛeɛ no, ne National Science and Math Quiz show.  Saa nsɛmmisa ho ɔyɛkyerɛ yi maa ntoaso sukuufoɔ a wɔatwa ho ahyia no nyaa hokwan sɛ wɔbɛsi akan wɔ ahokokwaa akontabuo ne nyansahu mu nsɛmmisa mu.  Addy atirimpɔw titiriw a ɔde fii ɔyɛkyerɛ no ase ne sɛ ɔbɛma nyansahu ne akontaabu anya nkɔso akyerɛ ɔmanfo na wakyerɛ hia a ɛho hia wɔ da biara da asetra mu, ne, sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a obenya mmofra pii so nkɛntɛnso, titiriw mmeawa nkumaa, ma wɔakɔ nyansahu mu. Ɔno na ɔyɛ shows first Quiz Mistress na ɔdaa ne ho adi pii wɔ sukuu ne akuw a wɔresi akan wɔ akansi no mu no mu. Nkɛntɛnso a onyae wɔ nyansahu mu nimdeɛ a ɛwɔ Ghana mmerante ne mmabaa nyinaa mu no maa mmea pii ani gyee ho na wodii adesua a ɛfa STEM ho akyi. Ɔsom sɛ quiz mistress firi afe 2001, akyiri yi ɔkamfoo Eureka Emefa Adomako sɛ ɔnsi n’ananmu wɔ saa dwumadie no mu.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Marian Ewurama Addy waree Ebenezer Charles Oko Addy, asetra ho ɔbenfo ne kan ogumadifo a onyaa sika kɔkɔɔ nkonimbo wɔ mita 4 x 100 mmirikatu mu wɔ 1966 Commonwealth Agumadi a wɔyɛe wɔ Kingston, Jamaica . Awarefo no woo mmabea baanu, Naa Lamiley Addy-Sadowsky ne Lamiokor Esi Addy.

Owu ne agyapade 
Ɔwuiɛ wɔ abɔdeɛ mu wɔ 14 Ɔbɛnem 2014 wɔ Korle-Bu Nkyerɛkyerɛ Ayaresabea a ɛwɔ Accra.  Wɔsiee no wɔ 1 March 2014 wɔ Saltpond, abakɔsɛm mu mpoano kuro bi a ɛwɔ Central Region of Ghana . Wɔtoo nyansahu mu nhwehwɛmu dan bi a ɛwɔ Department of Biochemistry, Cell and Molecular Biology wɔ Ghana Sukuupɔn mu, din “ Marian Ewurama Addy Laboratory for Medicinal Plants and Natural Products Research ” de hyɛɛ no anuonyam. Biochemistry dwumadibea no nso de afe afe Ɔbenfo Marian Ewurama Addy Nkaedi Ɔkasa no sii hɔ de kaee no. Nhwehwɛmu adwuma a ɔyɛe wɔ nnuru a wɔde yɛ nhabannuru mu biochemistry mu no maa nhabannuru yɛɛ nea nkurɔfo ani gyee ho kɛse na nyansahufo gye toom. Ɔman Nyansahu ne Nkontaabu Nsɛmmisa da so ara kɔ so afe biara na ɛkɔ so de nyansahu ba ɔmanfo adwene mu na ɛhyɛ akontaabu ne nyansahu ho nkuran ma mmofra nkumaa.

Abasobɔde ne anuonyam 

 Shell Prize, awarded by the Shell Company, Ghana Ltd, to the top six candidates who passed the General Certificate of Examinations, "A" Level, 1962
 McCallien Prize, awarded to the best student in Volta Hall, the female hall of residence, 1963
 Waddell Prize, awarded to the best science student, 1962–66
 California Prize, awarded by the Chemistry Department, University of Ghana, to the best freshman in Chemistry, 1962–63
 Fellow, African Graduate Fellowship Program (AFGRAD) of the African-American Institute, 1966–71
 Fellow of the International Seminar in Chemistry, at Uppsala University, Uppsala Sweden, 1985–86
 Fulbright African Senior Scientist Award in 1990
 CIMG Marketing Woman of the Year, in 1995, for marketing Science.
 The Africa-America Institute's Distinguished Alumna for Excellence in 1998.
UNESCO Kalinga Prize for the Popularization of Science in 1999.
 The Millennium Excellence Award for Educational Development in 1999.
 Inducted as a Fellow of the Ghana Academy of Arts and Sciences in 1999.
 National Award by the Enterprise Insurance Company Limited on the occasion of their 75th anniversary in 1999, for "invaluable contribution to educating Ghana's children and for creating enthusiasm in Mathematics and the Sciences"

Nhoma ahorow 

 Condensation of free [alpha]-amino acids as a pro-biological polymerization system (1971)
 Genetic Demonstrations: Instructor's Manual (1980); co-authored with Ebenezer Laing and Carol Markwei
 Putting Science into the Art of Healing with Herbs: From Smoked-drum Kymograph to ELISA (2003) 
 Training the Next Generation of Scientists (2004)
 Rewards: An Autobiography (2011)

title: Emma Morrison
text:
Emma Morrison yɛ Ghana television nipa ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho nimdefo.

Ɔhyɛɛ n’asɛm ho amanneɛbɔ adwuma ase, ɔne TV3 Network Limited yɛɛ adwuma bere a wɔde dwumadibea no sii hɔ wɔ afe 1997 mu sɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo.

Mfitiase asetra 
Wɔwoo no June 5 na ɔyɛ ne maame ba a ɔto so abiɛsa ne ne papa ba a ɔto so ason. Ne papa wɔ mma 13, mmeawa 11 ne mmarimaa baanu.

Ne papa yɛ owufoɔ Jacob Herbert Morrison na ne maame yɛ Victoria Morrison.

Nwomasua 
Morrison fii ne nhomasua ase wɔ United Kingdom, faako a ɔkɔɔ Dollis Junior High School ne Childshill School abien no nyinaa wɔ North West London.

Ɔtoaa so wɔ Goldfields Preparatory School bere a otu kɔɔ Ghana no . Ɔkɔɔ Wesley Mmabaa Ntoaso Sukuu ne Tarkwa Ntoaso Sukuu .

Ɔyɛ Ghana Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ Asoɛe no ade .

Adwuma 
Ɔhyɛɛ n’asɛm ho amanneɛbɔ adwuma ase wɔ TV3 mu wɔ afe 1997 mu sɛ amanneɛbɔfo/asɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo, ɔforoo soro faa dibea ahorow no mu bɛyɛɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ne agumadi sohwɛfo panyin wɔ TV3.

Mprempren ɔyɛ kuw no panyin a ɔhwɛ adwumayɛ ho nhyehyɛe, radio, TV, IM so wɔ Multimedia Group Ltd na ɔyɛ mmɔho abien sɛ ɔfotufo, adwumayɛfo panyin ma News Generation . Emma Morrison bɛka Gold Fields Ghana ho sɛ nnwumakuw nsɛm ho ɔpanyin.

Abasobɔde ahorow 
Wanya abasobɔde ahorow bi te sɛ Afe no mu Amanneɛbɔfo a Ɔsen Biara, TV so Nipa a Ɔsen Biara wɔ Afe no mu, na n’asɛm ho amanneɛbɔ dwumadi News 360 dii nkonim wɔ TV so Amanneɛbɔ Dwumadi a Ɛsen Biara wɔ Afe no mu. Wɔ April 2019 mu no, wɔbɔɔ no dawuru sɛ Adwumakuw nipa a Ɔsen Biara wɔ Afe no mu wɔ Glitz Ghana Mmea a Wɔsen Biara wɔ Afe no mu Nidi mu.

title: Adjoa Bayor
text:
Adjoa Bayor (wɔwoo no 17 May 1979) yɛ Ghanani kan bɔɔlbɔni a ɔbɔɔ sɛ mfimfini bɔɔlbɔni . Ɔyɛ Ghana mmea ɔman kuw no panyin .

Adwuma 
Na ɔyɛ World All Stars kuw no muni a ɔne China mmea ɔman bɔɔlbɔ kuw no bɛbɔ wɔ April 2007 mu wɔ Wuhan, China .

Ɔabɔ ama Ghatel Ladies wɔ Accra, Ghana na wabɔ ama FC Indiana nso wɔ Amerika nnansa yi.  Bayor de ne ho bɔɔ FF USV Jena wɔ 21 Ɔbɛnem 2009.

CAF paw no wɔ afe 2018 mu sɛ ɔmmoa Ɔkyerɛwfo Abadiakyiri wɔ bɔɔlbɔ ne nkɔso mu Anthony Baffoe ma ɔnyɛ Afrika Mmea Kuruwa a wɔtow no .

Amansan 
Wɔ September 2007 mu no, Adjoa Bayor yɛɛ Ghana ɔman kuo no panyin wɔ Wiase Kupɔn a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ China no mu. Ɛwom sɛ Ghana antumi amfi kuw no mu de, nanso Bayor bɔɔ bɔɔl a ɛyɛ nwonwa fii free kick a ɛwɔ Norway penalty area akyi pɛɛ bere a ohyiaa ɔkwan a ɛnteɛ so bere a agofomma foforo tuu mmirika kɔɔ soro na ohuruw faa bɔɔl no so no, afei ɔde anifere danee ne ho na ɔtow tuo.

Abodin ahorow 
CAF too aba paw no sɛ Afrika Mmea Bɔɔlbɔfo a Ɔsen Biara wɔ afe 2003 mu na na ɔwɔ akansi mu wɔ afe 2004 ne 2006.

Nidi a wɔde ma 
2003 — Afrika Mmea Agodifo a Ɔsen Biara wɔ Afe no mu.

title: Florence Dadson
text:
Florence Dadson (wɔwoo no 23 Ayɛwohomumɔ 1992) yɛ Ghanani ɔbaa bɔɔlbɔni, a mprempren ɔbɔ ma Gulf Coast Texans wɔ Amerika.

Club adwuma 
Dadson hyɛɛ n’adwuma ase wɔ Academy of Christ the King na ɔde ne ho bɔɔ Ghatel Ladies Cape Coast bere a na wadi mfe dumiɛnsa. Ɔfirii ne kurom Ghana wɔ September 2011 mu berɛ a ɔnyaa kwan kɔɔ Robert Morris Suapɔn  wɔ Illinois sɛ ɔrekɔtoa ne mfitiaseɛ adesua wɔ Business Administration – Majoring in Tourism Studies mu. Ɔne Ghana kuw no mufo Olivia Amoako ne Linda Eshun bɔɔ bɔɔl maa RMU .

Bere a owiee Robert Morris Sukuupɔn wɔ afe 2014 Ahohuru Bere mu no, ɔde ne ho kɔbɔɔ W-League kuw Gulf Coast Texans .

Amanaman ntam adwuma 
Dadson dii agorɔ sɛ forward na wagyina ne man ananmu wɔ U-17 ne U-20 levels nyinaa mu. Dadson bɔɔ bɔɔl maa Ghana wɔ afe 2008 FIFA U-17 Mmea Wiase Kupɔn  ne 2012 FIFA U-20 Mmea Wiase Kupɔn . Ogyina Black Queens kuw a wɔatrɛw mu no nso mu .

Ankorankoro asetra 
Dadson waree Ghana amanaman ntam bɔɔlbɔfoɔ David Accam wɔ 3 Ɔbɛnem 2019 wɔ Cape Coast, Ghana.

Nidi a wɔde ma

Ghana 
Afrika Mmea Kuruwa a Wɔde Di Dwuma : Nea ɛto so abiɛsa 2016

title: Eureka Emefa Adomako
text:
Eureka Emefa Ahadjie Adomako yɛ Ghanani afifideɛ ho nimdefo ne adesua ho ɔbenfo a seesei ɔyɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo panin wɔ Department of Plant and Environmental Biology, University of Ghana. Adomako yɛɛ asɛmmisa wura wɔ Ghana Ɔman Nyansahu ne Nkontaabu Nsɛmmisa (NSMQ) mu fi afe 2001 kosi afe 2005.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔ October 2005 mu no, onyaa Commonwealth Academic Staff Scholarship sɛ ɔbɛkɔ akɔyɛ Ph.D wɔ United Kingdom wɔ Aberdeen Sukuupɔn mu . Owiee wɔ November 2008 mu, na onyaa Nyansapɛ ho Oduruyɛfo abodin krataa wɔ Afifide Nyansahu mu .

N’asɛmti ne Nsonsonoe a Ɛwɔ Arsenic Dodow ne Nneɛma Afoforo a Ɛbɛtumi Ayɛ Awuduru a Ɛwɔ Ghana Asase ne Nnuadewa Mu: Nnipa Akwahosan Ho Nkyerɛkyerɛmu ma Mmeae a Atuo a Wɔtu.

Adwuma 
Wɔ March 2000 ne January 2002 ntam no, na Eureka Adomako yɛ Dwumadie Ntamgyinafoɔ Panyin wɔ adwumayɛbea a ɛnyɛ mfasoɔ, Conservation International -Ghana, faako a ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ ɔsatuo bi a wɔde bɛsiw wuram mmoa a wɔn ase reyɛ atɔre abɔmmɔ ne aguadi a wɔnyɛ nyiyim ano. Wɔ afe 2003 mu no, wɔpaw Adomako sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo wɔ Department of Plant and Environmental Biology, University of Ghana . Ɔkɔɔ soro koduu ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo panyin wɔ afe 2009.  Bere a wɔpaw no sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo no, Adomako nso faa nnwuma afoforo a ofii ase sɛ Volta Hall yɔnko wɔ Sukuupɔn no mu. Efi saa bere no ɔsomm wɔ dwumadi ahorow pii mu a nea ɛka ho ne Agumadi ho Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo fi afe 2012 kosi afe 2014, Ɔpanyin a ɔhwɛ Senior Common Room so fi afe 2011 kosi afe 2014 ne Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo Panyin fi afe 2014 kosi afe 2018. Sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo panyin no, na ɔyɛ Asa Bagua no muni, na ɔyɛ asa no sohwɛ bagua no muni ne Nkyerɛkyerɛ Boayikuw no Titenani.  Wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2019 mu no, wɔmaa no so na wɔpaw no sɛ Volta Asa no sohwɛfoɔ a ɔtɔ so 17 wɔ asa no mfeɛ aduosia afahyɛ a wɔde sii hɔ no mu.

Ɔman Nyansahu ne Nkontaabu Ho Nsɛmmisa 
Wɔ afe 2001 mu no, Adomako bedii Marian Ewurama Addy ananmu sɛ Ɔman Nyansahu ne Nkontaabu Quiz no Quiz Mistress bere a kan no ankasa kamfoo no kyerɛe no. Ɔdii nsɛmmisa no anim mfeɛ 4 firi afe 2001 kɔsi afe 2005 na ɔkamfoo Elsie Effah Kaufman, mprempren nsɛmmisa wura no sɛ ɔnsi n’ananmu berɛ a ɔreyɛ n’adesua a ɛtwa toɔ wɔ Aberdeen Suapɔn mu no.

Abasobɔde, nnɔnhwerew ne fekubɔ 

 ODA Cambridge-Commonwealth Akwankyerɛ, Cambridge Sukuupɔn (Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 1995 - Ɔpɛpɔn 1996) 
 Commonwealth Adesua Adwumayɛfoɔ Akwankyerɛ, Aberdeen Suapɔn (October 2005 – September 2008) 
 Commonwealth Adesua Fekubɔ a ɛhwɛ Oduruyɛfoɔ Akyi Adesua so, Aberdeen Suapɔn (October, 2010 – April, 2011) 
 Nhwehwɛmufo a wɔde nidi ma wɔ Abɔde a Nkwa Wom Ho Nyansahu Sukuu, Aberdeen Sukuupɔn mu

Ankorankoro asetra 
Adomako aware a ɔwɔ mma mmienu. Ɔyɛ Kristoni na ɔyɛ asɔre panyin wɔ Legon Interdenominational Church (LIC).

Nnwuma a wɔatintim 
Adomako ayɛ adwuma wɔ nhwehwɛmu adwuma a ɛwɔ afifideɛ, nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia ho nyansahu ne afifideɛ ne nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia ho adesua mu.

 Nsonsonoeɛ a ɛwɔ Arsenic dodoɔ ne Nneɛma foforɔ a ɛbɛtumi ayɛ awuduru a ɛwɔ Ghana asase ne aburoo mu: Nnipa akwahosan ho nsunsuansoɔ ma mmeaeɛ a atuo a wɔtuo no aka wɔn, August 2008 
 Arsenic a wɔde kɔ aburow mu a ɛkɔ anim ma aburow a wodua wɔ Bangladesh sɛ wɔde toto U.S. ne EU ho a, September 2008 
 Asase a ɛwɔ mfitiaseɛ no mu nsakraeɛ yɛ adeɛ titire a ɛma arsenic boaboa ano wɔ Bengal Delta aburow aburow mu, Ɔpɛpɔn 2009 
 Nsonsonoeɛ a ɛwɔ Arsenic ne nneɛma foforɔ a ɛbɛtumi ayɛ awuduru dodoɔ mu wɔ asase a wɔtuo ne aburoo ne nsuo a wɔde gugu nnɔbaeɛ so a ɛfiri Ghana Kesee Fam, Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 2010 
 Arsenic a ɛnyɛ abɔdeɛ ne nneɛma nketenkete a ɛwɔ Ghana aburow mu, July 2011 
 Nsunsuansoɔ a Sikakɔkɔɔ a Wɔtu no nya wɔ Aburoo a Wɔyɛ wɔ Anum Bonhwa mu wɔ Ghana, Ɔpɛpɔn 2014

title: Ama Ata Aidoo
text:
Ama Ata Aidoo, née Christina Ama Aidoo (wɔwoo no ɔbɛnim bosome no da a ɛtɔ so aduonu mmiensa (23 March) wɔ afe apem ahankron aduanan mmienu mu (1942) yɛ Ghanani ɔkyerɛwfo, anwensɛm kyerɛwfo, agorukyerɛwfo ne nhomanimfo. Na ɔyɛ Nhomasua soafo wɔ Jerry Rawlings nniso ase. Wɔ afe mpem mmienu (2000) mu no, ɔhyehyɛɛ Mbaasem Foundation sɛ ɛbɛhyɛ Afrikafoɔ mmaa akyerɛwfoɔ adwuma ho nkuran na wɔaboa.

Mfitiase asetra 
Wɔwoo Aidoo wɔ  ɔbɛnim bosome no da a ɛtɔ so aduonu mmiensa (23 March) wɔ  afe apem ahankron aduanan mmienu mu (1942) wɔ Saltpond wɔ Central Region of Ghana . Nsɛm bi a ɛka ho ne Megan Behrent, Brown University, ne Africa Who's Who aka sɛ wɔwoo no wɔ 31 March 1940. Na ɔwɔ onuabarima a ɔyɛ mmanoma, Kwame Ata.

Wɔtetee no wɔ Fante adehye fie, Nana Yaw Fama, Abeadzi Kyiakor panyin, ne Maame Abasema babea. Onyinii wɔ bere a na Britaniafo atubrafo foforo a wɔresan aba bio a na ɛrekɔ so wɔ ne kurom no mu. Atubrafo foforo na wokum ne nana, na ɛmaa ne papa huu hia a ɛho hia sɛ wɔkyerɛkyerɛ mmofra ne mmusua a wɔwɔ akuraa no ase no abakɔsɛm ne nsɛm a esisii wɔ bere no mu no so. Eyi maa obuee sukuu a edi kan wɔ wɔn akuraa ase na onyaa Aidoo so nkɛntɛnso ma ɔkɔ Wesley Girls’ High School, faako a odii kan sii gyinae sɛ ɔpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ ɔkyerɛwfo no.

Nwomasua 
Aidoo kɔɔ Wesley Girls’ Senior High School wɔ Cape Coast, fi afe apem ahankron aduosia baako (1961) kosi afe apem ahankron aduosia nan (1964) mu. Owiee ntoaso sukuu no, ɔde ne din kɔhyɛɛ Ghana Suapɔn mu, Legon baabi a onyaa abodin krataa a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɔyɛ Bachelor of Arts wɔ Borɔfo kasa mu na ɔsan nso kyerɛw n’agoru a edi kan, The Dilemma of a Ghost, wɔ afe 1964. Longman na otintim agoru no afe a edi hɔ no, na ɛmaa Aidoo bɛyɛɛ Afrikani bea drama kyerɛwfo a odi kan a wotintimii.

Adwuma 
Wɔpaw Ama sɛ Nhomasua soafo wɔ Bere tiaa mu Ɔman Bammɔ Bagua no ase wɔ afe 1982 mu. Ogyaee adwuma wɔ asram 18 akyi, na ohui sɛ ɔrentumi nni ne botae a ɛne sɛ ɔbɛma nhomasua wɔ Ghana ayɛ nea obiara betumi anya bi no ho. Wayɛ dwuma a Afrika mmea di wɔ nnɛyi asetra mu ho mfonini. Ɔanya adwene sɛ nnansa yi akannifo de ɔmampɛ ho adwene no adi dwuma sɛ ɔkwan a wɔfa so hyɛ nkurɔfo so. Wakasa atia saa Afrikafo a wonim akenkan ne akyerɛw a wɔkyerɛ sɛ wɔdɔ wɔn man nanso mfaso horow a ɛwɔ aman a wɔanya nkɔso mu no daadaa wɔn no. Ogye Afrikafo nipasu soronko bi di, na ofi ɔbea adwene mu bu no.

Ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ United States, faako a onyaa fekubɔ bi wɔ adebɔ ho nkyerɛwee mu wɔ Stanford Sukuupɔn, California .  Ɔsan nso yɛɛ nhwehwɛmufo wɔ Institute of African Studies, University of Ghana, ne sɛ Borɔfo kasa ho ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo wɔ University of Cape Coast, na awiei koraa no ɔforo kɔɔ hɔ koduu ɔbenfo dibea.

Ɔde bere pii nso akyerɛkyerɛ na watra amannɔne asram pii wɔ bere koro mu. Ɔtenaa United States, Britain, Germany ne Zimbabwe .

Wɔ London wɔ 1986 mu no, ɔmaa Walter Rodney Visions of Africa ɔkasa a kuw a wɔboa Bogle-L’Ouverture nhoma tintim adwumakuw no hyehyɛe no. Aidoo kyerɛɛ Engiresi kasa adesua ahorow wɔ Hamilton College wɔ Clinton New York, wɔ afe apem ahankron aduokron (1990) mfe no mfinimfini mfiase. Mprempren ɔyɛ ɔbenfo nsrahwɛfo wɔ Africana Adesua Dwumadibea a ɛwɔ Brown Sukuupɔn mu .

Aidoo yɛ Etisalat Nkonimdie a ɛfa Nwoma ho (a ɔka Dele Olojede, Ellah Wakatama Allfrey, Margaret Busby, Sarah Ladipo Manyika ne Zakes Mda ), a wɔbɔɔ no afe 2013 sɛ atenaeɛ ma Afrikafoɔ akyerɛwfoɔ a wɔkyerɛw ayɛsɛm nwoma a ɛdi kan no. Ɔnyaa Fulbright Scholarship abasobɔdeɛ wɔ afe 1988 mu ne Mbari press asɛm tiawa nkonimboɔ.

Sini 
Ɔyɛ asɛmti wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du nan (2014) documentary sini bi, The Art of Ama Ata Aidoo, a Yaba Badoe yɛe no mu.

Nkyerɛwee ahorow 
Aidoo agodie ahorow no bi ne The Dilemma of a Ghost, a wɔyɛe wɔ Legon wɔ 1964 (wɔdii kan tintimii wɔ 1965) ne Pittsburgh wɔ 1988 mu, ne Anowa, a wotintimii wɔ 1971 mu na wɔyɛɛ no London wɔ 1991 mu.

N’ayɛsɛm nhoma ahorow no ka ɔhaw a ɛda Atɔe Famfo ne Afrika wiase adwene ntam no ho asɛm titiriw. Wotintim n’ayɛsɛm a edi kan, Our Sister Killjoy, wɔ 1977 mu na ɛda so ara yɛ ne nhoma ahorow a agye din sen biara no mu biako. Ɛda nsow sɛ ɛkyerɛ adwene a ɛne ne ho nhyia wɔ nna ho wɔ Afrika ne titiriw no LGBT wɔ Afrika . Bere a adwene biako a agye din wɔ asasepɔn no so ne sɛ mmarima a wɔne wɔn ho da yɛ ahɔho wɔ Afrika, na ɛyɛ Atɔe Famfo amammerɛ ho adwene ahorow a wɔde hyɛ "Abibifo" amammerɛ a ɛho tew, a efi awosu mu a ɛfa mmarima a wɔne wɔn ho da ho no, Aidoo yɛ Killjoy nipa titiriw no ho mfonini sɛ ɔde ne ho hyɛ mmea a wɔne wɔn ho da ho nsusuwii hunu a n’ankasa yɛ mu, ne abusuabɔ a ayamhyehye wom a wɔne mmea a wɔne mmea da a wɔbɛkɔ so akura mu.

Aidoo nnipa atitiriw afoforo pii nso yɛ mmea a wɔsɔre tia mmea dwumadi ahorow a na wɔtaa yɛ wɔ wɔn bere so no, te sɛ nea ɛwɔ n’agoru Anowa mu no. N’ayɛsɛm Changes nyaa 1992 Commonwealth Akyerɛwfo Nkonimdi a Ɛfa Nhoma a Ɛsen Biara (Afrika) ho. Ɔsan yɛ anwensɛm kyerɛwfo a ne ho akokwaw —ne nhoma a ɔboaboaa ano Someone Talking to Sometime nyaa Nelson Mandela Prize for Poetry wɔ 1987 mu  —na wakyerɛw mmofra nhoma pii .

Ɔde asɛm "To be a woman" boaa 1984 nhoma a wɔaboaboa ano Sisterhood Is Global: The International Women's Movement Anthology, a Robin Morgan na ɔhyehyɛɛ no. N'asɛm "Two Sisters" pue wɔ 1992 nhoma a wɔaboaboa ano Daughters of Africa, a Margaret Busby na ɔhyehyɛɛ no mu.

Wɔ afe 2000 mu no ɔhyehyɛɛ Mbaasem Foundation, ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛnyɛ aban de a ɛwɔ Ghana a n'adwuma ne sɛ "ɛbɛboa Afrika mmaa akyerɛwfoɔ ne wɔn adwiniyɛ mu nkɔsoɔ ne wɔn nkɔsoɔ", a ɔne ne babaa Kinna  bom di so  ne adwumayɛfo bagua bi.

Aidoo yɛ afe 2006 nhoma a wɔaboaboa ano a wɔfrɛ no African Love Stories no samufo . Wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du mmienu (2012) mu no, ɔde Diplomatic Pounds & Other Stories a ɛyɛ nsɛm ntiantiaa a wɔaboaboa ano ne foforo a ɛyɛ nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw a akyerɛwfo a wɔagye din wɔ Ghana, Afrika ne Afrika Atubrafo .

Abasobɔde ne agyede a wɔde ma 
Aidoo anya abasobɔde ahorow pii a afe apem ahankron aduokron mmienu (1992) Commonwealth Writers’ Prize for Best Book (Africa) ka ho wɔ n’ayɛsɛm Changes .

Wɔde Aidoo-Snyder nhoma nkonimbo a Mmea Kuw a ɛwɔ Afrika Adesua Fekuw no de ma wɔ nhoma a ɛda nsow a ɔbea bi tintim a ɛde Afrika mmea osuahu ahorow di kan no din de ahyɛ Ama Ata Aidoo ne Margaret C. Snyder, a ɔhyehyɛɛ no no anuonyam UNIFEM kwankyerɛfo .

Wɔde Ama Ata Aidoo Center for Creative Writing (Aidoo Centre), a ɛwɔ Kojo Yankah Sukuu a ɛhwɛ Nkitahodi Adesua so wɔ Afrika Sukuupɔn Nkitahodi Sukuu (AUCC) a ɛwɔ Adabraka, Accra, a ɛwɔ Adabraka, Accra, no ase wɔ Oforisuo 2017 mu no, wɔtoo din de hyɛɛ no  —mfinimfini a edi kan a ɛte saa wɔ Afrika Atɔe fam, a Nii Ayikwei Parkes na ɔyɛ ne kwankyerɛfo.

Nnwuma a wɔapaw

 Anowa (agoru a egyina Ghana anansesɛm bi so), London: Longman, 1970. New York: Nnipa Ho Nsɛmma Nhoma Tintimbea, 1970.
 No Sweetness Here: Nsɛm ntiantiaa a Wɔaboaboa Ano, Longman, 1970.
 Yɛn Nuabea Killjoy: anaasɛ Nsusuwii a efi Aniwa Tuntum mu (ayɛsɛm), Longman, 1977.
 Obi a Ɔne Bere Bi Rekasa (anwensɛm a wɔaboaboa ano), Harare: College Press, 1986.
 Ɔkɔre ne Nkokɔ ne Nsɛm Afoforo (ma mmofra), Tana Press, 1986.
 Nnomaa ne Anwensɛm Afoforo, Harare: College Press, 1987.
 Krataa a Ɛyɛ Abufuw wɔ January mu (anwensɛm), Dangaroo Press, 1992.
 Nsakrae: Ɔdɔ ho Asɛm (ayɛsɛm), Mmea Nsɛmma Nhoma, 1991.
 Abeawa a Otumi ne Nsɛm Afoforo, Heinemann African Writers Series, 1997.
 Diplomatic Pounds & Nsɛm Afoforo, Ayebia Clarke Nhoma Tintim, 2012.

Sɛ́ samufo no 
Afrika Ɔdɔ Ho Nsɛm: Nsɛm a Wɔaboaboa Ano, Afrika Ɔdɔ Ho Nsɛm: Nsɛm a Wɔaboaboa Ano, Ayebia Clarke Publishing, 2006.

Akenkan a ɛkɔ akyiri 

 Aditya Misra, "Owuo a Ɛyɛ Ahodwiriw: Bɔbeasu ne Tumi Nkɔso wɔ Ama Ata Aidoo Anowa mu". Drama Adesua Ho Nsɛmma Nhoma, Po 1, kratafa 100. 6, No. 1, 2012, kr. 81–91 na ɛwɔ hɔ.
 Anne V. Adams (a ɔkyerɛwee. ), Essays in Honor of Ama Ata Aidoo at 70: Ɔkenkanfo bi wɔ Afrika Amammerɛ Ho Adesua mu . Ayebia Clarke Nsɛmma Nhoma Tintimbea, 2012.

title: Nana Aba Appiah Amfo
text:
Nana Aba Appiah Amfo (wɔwoo no 30 September 1971) yɛ Ghana kasa ho nimdefo, sukuupɔn sohwɛfoɔ ne mprempren Vice-chancellor wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu . Ɛde besi bere a wɔpaw no no, na ɔyɛ Pro Vice-Chancellor for Academics and Students Affairs wɔ Ghana Sukuupɔn a ɛwɔ Afrika Atɔe fam .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo no wɔ Kumasi, Nana Aba Appiah Amfo nyaa ne mfitiaseɛ nwomasua wɔ Suapɔn Mfitiaseɛ Sukuu (KNUST Mfitiaseɛ Sukuu), Services Mfitiaseɛ Sukuu wɔ Takoradi ne Goldfields Sukuu Complex wɔ Tarkwa. Amfo kɔɔ Holy Child School maa ne O’ Level nwomasua na akyiri yi ɔkɔɔ Archbishop Porter Girls’ Secondary School maa ne A’ Level. Ɔkɔɔ Ghana Sukuupɔn mu kɔyɛɛ Bachelor’s degree wɔ Franse ne Kasa Ho Adesua mu . Owiee Norway Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma Sukuupɔn wɔ Trondheim, Norway wɔ afe 2001 mu a na ɔwɔ MPhil abodin krataa wɔ Kasa Ho Adesua mu na onyaa PhD abodin krataa wɔ afe 2007 mu wɔ sukuupɔn koro no ara mu wɔ Kasa Ho Adesua mu.

Adwuma 
Amfo hyɛɛ n’adwuma ase sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ wɔ Department of Linguistics wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu wɔ afe 2001 mu. Bere a ofii hɔ kɔyɛɛ adesua foforo wɔ Norway no, ɔsan kɔɔ Ghana na ɔkɔɔ so maa ɔkasa wɔ Ghana Sukuupɔn mu. Wɔmaa no dibea sɛ Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo Panyin wɔ afe 2007 mu, afe koro no ara a onyaa ne PhD no. Ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔbenfoɔ a ɔka ho wɔ afe 2011 mu, ne Ɔbenfoɔ wɔ afe 2017. Wɔpaw no sɛ Fédération Internationale des Langues et Littératures Modernes adwumayɛfo boayikuw no muni . Nana Aba Amfo yɛɛ Pro Vice-Chancellor for Academic and Student Affairs wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu firi Ɔpɛpɔn 2019 kɔsi Ɔpɛpɔn 2021. Wɔ July 2021 mu no, wɔpaw no sɛ Acting Vice Chancellor.  Ɔnyaa adwumayɛfoɔ sohwɛ ho nteteeɛ wɔ University of Applied Sciences, Germany, INSEAD ne Harvard Business School . Ɔasom sɛ Kasa Ho Adesua Dwumadibea no Titenani (2013–14) ne Kasa Sukuu no Panyin. Amfo som wɔ Coalition of People Against Sexual and Gender-Based Violence and Harmful Practices (CoPASH) a ɛwɔ UNFPA akwankyerɛ ase no afotufo bagua no mu .

Asɔremma ne fekubɔ a wɔde ma 

 Member, Nkitahodi, Aduruyɛ ne Abrabɔ Pa Kuw
 Amanaman Ntam Pragmatics Fekuw (Afrikani a odi kan a ɔyɛ Consultation Board muni wɔ Fekuw no abakɔsɛm mu)
 Afrika Atɔe Fam Kasa Ho Adesua Kuw
 Kasa Ho Nimdeɛ Fekuo a ɛwɔ Ghana (Ɔmampanyin, 2010–2014) .
 Foundation Fellow, Afrika Nnipa Ho Adesua Dwumadi a ɛwɔ Amerika Asuafo Fekuw Bagua no mu
 Fellow, German Adesua Nsesa Dwumadibea (DAAD) .
 Amanaman Nkabom Ho Ɔbenfo.

Hwehwɛ mu 
Amfo nhwehwɛmu a n’ani gye ho no ayɛ nea ɛfa kasa mu sub-discipline of Pragmatics ho titiriw.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Wɔne ne kunu Frank Amfo abom wɔ mma mmiɛnsa, Yoofi, Maame Araba ne Efua Benyiwa.

title: Margaret Amoakohene
text:
Margaret Ivy Amoakohene (wɔwoo no 17 Ɔpɛpɔn 1960) yɛ Ghana nhomanimfo ne ɔmanpanyin . Wasom wɔ nniso ne nhomasua mu nnwuma ahorow mu. Na ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanyin wɔ Canada wɔ John Agyekum Kufour nniso mu. Ɔyɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo panyin ne ɔkwankyerɛfo a ɔyɛ adwuma wɔ Nkitahodi Adesua Sukuu a ɛwɔ Ghana Sukuupɔn mu wɔ Legon . Ɔyɛ saa mprempren  Ɔman Bagua no muni .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Margaret Ivy Amoakohene wɔ 17 Ɔpɛpɔn 1960 wɔ Wenchi wɔ Brong Ahafo Mantam mu . Ɔyɛ Nsawkaw kuromni a ɛyɛ Tain Mantam a ɛwɔ Brong Ahafo Mantam mu no ahenkurow . Ɔnyaa ne GCE Ordinary level adansedie krataa wɔ St. Francis Secondary School a ɛwɔ Jirapa, wɔ Upper West Region of Ghana firi afe 1974 kɔsi afe 1979. Afei ɔkɔɔ St. Louis Senior High School wɔ Kumasi kɔnyaa ne GCE Advanced level adansedie krataa. Wɔ afe 1981 mu no, ɔde ne din kɔhyɛɛ Ghana Sukuupɔn mu kɔhwehwɛɛ Bachelor of Arts abodin krataa wɔ Franse ne Spania kasa mu . Amoakohene nyaa ne adesua akyi adesua wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu baabi a owiee no na onyaa Nyansapɛ mu Master ne Post-graduate Diploma wɔ Nkitahodi Adesua mu. Akyiri yi onyaa Nyansapɛ ho Oduruyɛfo abodin krataa wɔ nnipa pii nkitahodi mu wɔ Leicester Sukuupɔn a ɛwɔ England no mu .

Adwumayɛ asetra 
Efi afe 1992 no, Ivy Amoakohene ama asuafoɔ kasa wɔ ɔmanfoɔ ntam abusuabɔ, akwan a wɔfa so yɛ nhwehwɛmu a ɛfa su pa ho, ne nkitahodiɛ a nnipa pii di ho wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu. Ɔde ne ho ahyɛ adesua ne ɔman asetena mu nneɛma pii mu denneennen, a nea ɛka ho ne sɛ ɔsom wɔ Ɔman Nsɛm ho Amanneɛbɔ Bagua, Ghana News Agency, Ghana Broadcasting Corporation, ne National Film and Television Institute baguafo mu. Asoɛe a ɛhwɛ ɔmanfo ntam abusuabɔ so Ghana yɛɛ no Ɔkyerɛwfo a wɔde nidi ma, ne ɔmampanyin abadiakyiri de kyerɛɛ dwuma titiriw a wadi wɔ ɔmanfo ntam abusuabɔ nkɔso mu wɔ Ghana no. Wɔ afe 2010 mu no, wɔpaw no sɛ sukuu a ɛhwɛ Nkitahodi Adesua so wɔ Ghana Sukuupɔn mu no kwankyerɛfo a ɔyɛ adwuma.

Ɔpanyin a ɔhwɛ Canada so 
Wɔ afe 2006 mu no, Ɔmampanyin John Agyekum Kufour paw Amoakohene sɛ ɔnyɛ Ghana Aban Nnanmusini a ɛwɔ Canada no panyin sɛ ne Ɔmanpanyin . Ɔhyɛɛ n’ananmusifoɔ asɛdeɛ ase wɔ aban kwan so wɔ September 26, 2006 berɛ a ɔde ne nkrataa a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɔyɛ adwuma no maa Canada Amrado Panyin, Nea Ɔkorɔn Michaelle Jean, wɔ ne Mantam adwumayɛbea ne ne tenabea a ɛwɔ La Citadel wɔ Quebec Kuropɔn mu no. Sɛ́ Ɔmanpanyin no, ofii adɔe dwumadi ahorow bi ase, na emu biako fa nnuruyɛ ho nnwinnade a wɔde maa Nsawkaw Ayaresabea no ho. Ɔyɛ Ɔmanpanyin a ɔto so abien wɔ Canada wɔ Kufour nniso mu na ɔsom wɔ saa dibea no mu fi July 2006 kosi February 2009.

Ɔman Bagua no 
Wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2017 mu no, Ɔmampanyin Nana Akuffo-Addo yii Amoakohene sɛ ɔman Bagua no mufo dumien a ɔmampanyin apaw wɔn no mu biako . Ɔman Bagua a emufo yɛ 25 no ne kuw a  mmrahyɛbagua no ahyɛ sɛ ɛde afotu ma Ɔmampanyin no.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Marian Asantewah Nkansah
text:
Marian Asantewah Nkansah FGA yɛ Ghanafoɔ a ɔyɛ nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia ho ɔbenfoɔ. Ne nhwehwɛmu adwuma no twe adwene si nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia ho haw ahorow a ɛfa nneɛma a awuduru te sɛ heavy/trace metals, persistent organic pollutants (POPs) ne polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) a ɛwɔ aduan, nsu, asase, abotan, nsu a ɛtɔ ne afoforo mu dodow ne ne nkrabea ho ano aduru a obenya so nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia ho nhwɛsode ahorow. Ɔsan yɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ sɛnea efĩ yi ne wɔn ho wɔn ho di nkitaho wɔ nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia mu no ho. Wɔ afe 2016 mu no, ɔne nyansahufoɔ binom a wɔfiri Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology, dii nhwehwɛmu bi anim a ɛmaa wɔsii so dua sɛ dɔteɛ fitaa a wɔtumi di no de kokoram ho asiane bɛba.  Wɔ afe 2016 mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ nyansahufoɔ a ɔdi kan a ɔdii nkonim wɔ Fayzah M. Al-Kharafi Nkonimdie, afe afe abasobɔdeɛ a ɛma mmaa nyansahufoɔ soronko a wɔfiri aman a wɔka akyi wɔ nyansahu ne mfiridwuma mu. Ɔne Collins Obuah, nyansahufoɔ foforɔ a ɔfiri Ghana Suapɔn mu, na wɔyɛ nyansahufoɔ mmienu a wɔpaw wɔn sɛ wɔnkɔ Lindau Nobel Laureate nhyiamu wɔ afe 2017. Wɔ afe 2021 mu no, na ɔka mmaa baanum a wɔnyaa OWSD-Elsevier Foundation Awards wɔ aman a afei na wɔrenya nkɔsoɔ mu no ho. Ɔnyaa afe 2022 Africa Role Model Overall Female Personality Award, na wɔde no too mu sɛ Ghana Academy of Arts and Sciences Fellow afe korɔ no ara.

Nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Nkansah wɔ Ghana maa Mary ne Joseph Nkansah a wɔn baanu nyinaa yɛ nhomasua ho nimdefo. Ɔnyaa ne mfitiaseɛ ne ntoaso sukuu wɔ St. Anthony’s Experimental School, Nkawkaw ne St. Roses Senior High School wɔ Akwatia, sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ biara na ne nyinaa wɔ Ghana Apueeɛ Mantam mu. Afei ɔkɔɔ so kɔɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so wɔ hɔ a onyaa abodin krataa wɔ nnuruyɛ mu ne abodin krataa a ɛkorɔn wɔ nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia mu nnuruyɛ mu. Ɔwɔ PhD wɔ Nneɛma a Atwa Yɛn Ho Ahyia Ho Nnuruyɛ mu wɔ Bergen Sukuupɔn mu wɔ Norway .

Adwuma 
Ɔyɛ Ɔbenfoɔ a ɔka ho wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so no Chemistry department a ɔkyerɛ Practical Chemistry, Nuclear/Radiochemistry, Chemistry and Society, ne Petroleum Chemistry. Ɔyɛ Africa Hall of Residence sohwɛfoɔ a atwam ne Asuafoɔ Nsɛm sohwɛfoɔ Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Yiedie so wɔ KNUST. Ɔsom Amanaman Ntam Nyansahu Mfitiase Afe a Ɛhwɛ Nkɔso a Ɛkɔ So Daa So no Boayikuw no muni. Nkansah yɛ obi a na anka ɔyɛ adwumayɛfoɔ panin ne Global Young Academy no alumna. Ɔsan nso yɛ Ghana Geological Survey Authority no board member na ɔyɛ Ghana Academy of Arts and Sciences Fellow.

Abasobɔde ne agyede a wɔde ma 
Wɔagye Nkansah atom na wɔama no abasobɔde wɔ n’adwuma a nea ɛka ho ne:

 Ghana Adesuabea a ɛhwɛ adwinni ne nyansahu so no muni
 Afrika Nyansahu Sukuu no fã
 Wɔaka ho asɛm wɔ nhoma a edi kan koraa a ɛfa Afrika Mmea wɔ Nyansahu mu ho no mu
 Einstein Forum Fellow a odi hɔ
 2016 - Ɔdii nkonim wɔ Fayzah M. Al-Kharafi Nkonimdie mu
 2017 - Wɔpaw no sɛ ɔnkɔ Lindau Nobel Laureate nhyiam no ase
 2017 - Wɔpaw no kɔɔ Wiase Nyinaa Mmabun Adesuabea

title: Elizabeth Asiedu
text:
Elizabeth Asiedu yɛ sikasɛm ho ɔbenfo wɔ Kansas Sukuupɔn mu . Wayɛ nhwehwɛmu a ɛfa amannɔne mmoa, amannɔne sika a wɔde bɛto mu (FDI), ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea ntam abusuabɔ ho nhyehyɛe. Ɔyɛ obi a ɔhyehyɛɛ Afrika Mmea Nkɔso Fekuw (AAAWE), ne mprempren ahyehyɛde no titrani. Asiedu yɛ Journal of African Development no samufo.

Nwomasua 
Asiedu nyaa ne abodin krataa a edi kan, BS (Hons) wɔ kɔmputa ho nimdeɛ ne akontaabu mu wɔ Ghana Sukuupɔn mu wɔ afe 1988 mu. Afei ɔkɔɔ so nyaa MS wɔ akontaabu mu (1992), MS wɔ sikasɛm mu (1994), ne PhD wɔ sikasɛm mu (1998) wɔ Illinois Sukuupɔn a ɛwɔ Urbana-Champaign .

Adwuma 
Efi afe 2012 no, Asiedu ayɛ sikasɛm ho ɔbenfo wɔ Kansas Sukuupɔn mu, baabi a ɔkyerɛ sikasɛm ho adesua a edi kan ne nea wɔawie. Asiedu nso yɛ oguamtrani a ɔka ho ne sikasɛm dwumadibea a ɛwɔ Kansas Sukuupɔn mu no adesua a wɔawie no kwankyerɛfo fi afe 2007 kosi afe 2009. Ɔte Afrika Sikasɛm Sikasɛm Fekuo (AFEA) board mu,  na ɔyɛ ahyehyɛdeɛ no titrani wɔ afe 2011 ne 2013 ntam, na na ɔyɛ ɔmampanyin abadiakyiri wɔ afe 2007 ne 2010 ntam  Bio nso, na ɔyɛ Journal of African Development (JAD) samufoɔ wɔ afe 2017 ne 2018 ntam Ɔbenfo Asiedu nso yɛ obi a ɔhyehyɛɛ Afrika Mmea Fekuw (AAAWE) no ne ne titrani.  Ɔtenaa Ɔman Sikasɛm Fekuo no board mu wɔ afe 2016 ne 2019 ntam Asiedu yɛ wɔn a wodi so yi muni;

 Wiase Nyinaa Nhwehwɛmu Akansie Akwankyerɛ Kuo, Wiase Nyinaa Nkɔsoɔ Nkitahodiɛ, India, Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 2011 – Mprempren 
 Abɔnten so Nhwehwɛmu Kuo a Wɔagye Din, Afrika Tumi a Wɔbɛhyehyɛ Fapem, Zimbabwe, Ayɛwohomumɔ 2012 – Mprempren 
 Amanaman ntam nhomanimfo baanan boayikuw a wɔbɛyɛ mfe du nhwehwɛmu wɔ Amanaman Nkabom Sukuupɔn/ Wiase Asoɛe a Ɛhwɛ Nkɔso ne Sikasɛm Ho Nhwehwɛmu So (UNU/WIDER), Finland, May 2010-January 2011 no muni

Nhwehwɛmu ne nhoma ahorow a wɔapaw

Nnwuma Nketewa a Wobenya Boa: Abusuakuw, Mmusuakuw, ne Bɔbeasu Ho Fa Dɛn? (2012) 
Wɔ saa asɛm yi mu no, Asiedu, James A. Freeman, ne Akwasi Nti-Addae hwehwɛ dwuma a abusuakuw, mmusuakuw, ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna di wɔ bosea a wobenya mu. Wɔn nhwehwɛmu no kyekyɛ abusuakuw ne mmusuakuw mu ayɛ no nea edidi so yi: Abibifo, Hispanicfo, Asiafo/Amerikafo Ankasa/Pacific Supɔw so (ANP), White ɔbea, ne Aborɔfo ɔbarima. Wohu sɛ nnwumakuw a nnipa kakraa bi a wotumi hu na wɔwɔ no wɔ pow dodow a ɛkɔ soro a Pow dodow a ɛkɔ soro sen biara ma Hispanicfo. Bio nso, dodow a wɔpow ma no akɔ soro wɔ 1998 ne 2003 ntam  Awiei koraa no, wohu sɛ nnwumakuw a nnipa kakraa bi na wɔwɔ nso tuaa mfaso kɛse sen nnwumakuw a White-male na wɔwɔ no. Wɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbea ntam abusuabɔ mu no, wohu sɛ nnwumakuw a White mmea na wɔwɔ no anhyia nyiyim bere a na wɔrenya bosea no, na wɔsan tuaa mfɛntom kakraa bi a wɔn ankasa bosea de ma sen wɔn mfɛfo mmarima no. Wɔn nhwehwɛmu no kyerɛ sɛ nokwarem no, nneɛma te sɛ abusuakuw, mmusuakuw ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna no nya bosea a wobenya ne mfɛntom a wotua wɔ boseabɔ ho no so nkɛntɛnso.

So Amannɔne Mmoa a Wɔde Ma Wɔ Nhomasua Mu no Hyɛ Sikasɛm mu Nkɔso Ho Nkɔso? (2014) . 
Krataa a wɔato din "So Amannɔne Mmoa a Wɔde Ma Wɔ Nhomasua Mu no Hyɛ Sikasɛm mu Nkɔso Ho Nkɔso? Adanse a Efi Afrika Sahara Anafo fam" hwehwɛ sɛ ebia amannɔne mmoa a wɔde asi nkyerɛkyerɛ so no tu mpɔn wɔ mfitiase nhomasua ne ntoaso sukuu mu wɔ Afrika Sahara anafo fam anaa. Asiedu nhwehwɛmu no twe adwene si aman 38 so fi 1990 kosi 2004. Ɔkyerɛ sɛ ɛwom sɛ sikasɛm mu mmoa a wɔde ma wɔ nhomasua mu no ne nkɔso wɔ abusuabɔ pa (efisɛ ɛma wonya nneɛma te sɛ nhoma, ntetee ma akyerɛkyerɛfo, ne nea ɛkeka ho) nanso eyi te saa wɔ mfitiase nhomasua nkutoo mu. Nanso, nhomasua mu sikasɛm mu mmoa a wɔde ma wɔ ntoaso sukuu mu no, mmoa mma sikasɛm mu nkɔso, nokwarem no, ebetumi anya nkɔso so nkɛntɛnso bɔne. Eyi te saa esiane adwuma a wonnya mma wɔn a wɔawie ntoaso sukuu (a ɔkyerɛ sɛ ɛyɛ nokware ma aman pii a ɛwɔ Afrika Sahara Anafo fam), ɔkyerɛ sɛ ade foforo nti a ebia eyi yɛ nokware ne ntoaso sukuu a wonni (te sɛ sɛ bere a wɔde kɔ sukuu a ɛkɔ soro no nni mfaso biara). Bio nso, ɔkyerɛ sɛ ebia eyi yɛ nokware efisɛ wɔde wɔn a wɔawie ntoaso sukuu pii yɛ adwuma wɔ nnwuma a ɛnyɛ adwuma pii mu, na ɛnam so ma sikasɛm mu nkɔso a ebetumi aba no so tew. Awiei koraa no, ɔkyerɛ sɛ honam fam kapital ne “nneɛma afoforo a wɔde boa” nni Afrika Sahara Anafo fam a anka ɛbɛhyɛ adwumayɛfo a wɔsow aba ho nkuran wɔ ɔmantam no mu.

Nsunsuansoɔ a HIV/AIDS nya wɔ Amannɔne sika a wɔde bɛto mu tẽẽ so (2015) . 
Wɔ krataa "Nkɛntɛnso a HIV/AIDS nya wɔ Amannɔne Sika a Wɔde Totɔ Tẽẽ So: Adanse a efi Afrika Sahara Anafo fam" mu no, Asiedu ne Jin ne Kanyama kyerɛkyerɛ abusuabɔ a ɛda HIV/AIDS ne amannɔne sikasɛm tẽẽ (FDI) ntam no mu. Wɔhwehwɛ eyi mu wɔ aman 41 mu wɔ Afrika Sahara Anafo fam na wɔn nhwɛso no de ba awiei sɛ FDI ne HIV/AIDS yare mmoawa a abu so no wɔ abusuabɔ a ɛne no bɔ abira esiane nneɛma ahorow bi nti; emu biako ne sɛ adwumayɛfo a wɔwɔ apɔwmuden no yɛ adwuma yiye, nnwumakuw a aman pii wom (MNC) a wɔhwehwɛ sɛ wɔde wɔn ho besi hɔ wɔ Afrika Sahara Anafo fam no besusuw ɔmanfo akwahosan ho. Adwumayɛfo akwahosan ho hia efisɛ ɛka adwumayɛfo a wonni adwuma no na ɛnam so ka adwumayɛ nyinaa. Nea ɛtɔ so mmienu, wɔn nhwɛsoɔ no kyerɛ sɛ abɔnten so nneɛma bɔne a ɛbata HIV/AIDS ho (yareɛ ne owuo dodoɔ a ɛkɔ soro a ɛbɛtumi aka mfɛfoɔ adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔn nso wɔnnya bi). Wohu sɛ sɛ wɔtew ɔyare mmoawa no so a, ɛbɛhyɛ FDI ho nkuran, na ɛnam so ahyɛ sikasɛm mu nkɔso ho nkuran wɔ Afrika Sahara Anafo fam.

Sika a Wɔde Kɔma ne Sika a Wɔde To Nhomasua mu (2015) . 
Krataa "Remittances and Investment in Education: Evidence from Ghana" hwehwɛ sika a wɔde mena (amanaman ntam ne ɔman no mu nyinaa) wɔ Ghana, ne sɛnea ɛka sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ yiye sɛ wɔbɛkyerɛw wɔn din wɔ mfitiase ne ntoaso sukuu nyinaa mu. Asiedu ne Kwabena Gyimah-Brempong ka sɛ sika a wɔde kɔ aman a wɔnnyaa nkɔsoɔ pii (LDCs) te sɛ Ghana no nkɔanim no nnya nkɛntɛnsoɔ pa wɔ GDP so nko (ɛyɛ bɛyɛ 5.5% wɔ Ghana GDP mu wɔ afe 2011 mu  ), na mmom yei wɔ turn ma afie a ɛwɔ Ghana tumi de wɔn sika hyɛ nnipa sika mu bere a ɛma sikasɛm mu ahokyere so tew. Bio nso, krataa yi kyerɛ sɛ saa nkɛntɛnso yi da adi kɛse bere a ɔbea na odi ofie no anim, na sika a wɔde hyɛ nnipa sika mu a ɛkɔ soro no ma wotumi brɛ ohia ase bere tenten wɔ Ghana. Krataa no de cross-sectional data a efi Ghana Living Standards Survey (GLSS) a efi asorɔkye 5, ne pseudo-panel data a efi GLSS asorɔkye 3-5  di dwuma enti ɛwɔ nhwehwɛmu a ɛtrɛw nhini. Asiedu ne Gyimah-Brempong de saa data yi di dwuma de hwehwɛ data no mu denam resource constraint model no so.

Amannɔne Sika a Wɔde Totɔ Tẽẽ, Abɔdeɛ mu Nneɛma, ne Adwumayɛ wɔ Afrika Sahara Anafoɔ fam (2015) . 
Wɔ krataa "Amannɔne Sika a Wɔde Totɔ Tẽẽ, Abɔde mu Nneɛma, ne Adwumayɛ wɔ Afrika Sahara Anafo Fam" mu no, Asiedu, Komla Dzigbede ne Akwasi Nti-Addae hwehwɛ sɛnea ngo a wɔyɛ ne Afrika Sahara Anafo fam no kɔ soro ne nkɛntɛnso a enya wɔ amannɔne sika a wɔde hyɛ amannɔne tẽẽ FDI so, wɔn akyerɛwfo nso gye nkɛntɛnso a FDI nya wɔ Afrika Sahara Anafo fam no ho kyim. Wɔkyerɛ sɛ ɛwom sɛ ebia FDI bɛyɛ ade titiriw a ɛbɛboa sikasɛm mu nkɔso wɔ Afrika Sahara Anafo fam de, nanso sikasɛm mu nkɔso yi fi adwumayɛ a aman pii nnwumakuw (MNC) de ba no mu kɛse efisɛ saa nnwumakuw yi taa tua wɔn adwumayɛfo akatua a ɛkɔ soro sen ɔman no mu nnwumakuw. Akyerɛwfo no de Tullow Oil, plc di dwuma sɛ nhwɛso de kyerɛ ɔmantam no kyɛfa a ɛrenya nkɔanim wɔ wiase ngo a wɔyɛ mu ne saa ara nso na wɔhwehwɛ dwuma a MNCs FDI di wɔ nkɔso ne sikasɛm mu nkɔso mu wɔ Afrika Sahara Anafo fam. Bio nso, wɔsi so dua sɛ su a ɛwɔ sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ sikasɛm mu nkɔsoɔ anaa nkɔsoɔ ho nkuran no gyina FDI ko a wɔyɛ so kɛseɛ - FDI a ɛwɔ nneɛma a wɔyɛ mu no ma wonya adwumayɛ pii sene FDI wɔ nnwuma a wɔtutu te sɛ ngo mu. Bio nso, akyerɛwfo no ka sɛ FDI nkonimdi nso gyina nneɛma afoforo te sɛ nhomasua gyinabea a ɛwɔ ɔman bi mu so, na ɛma ɛyɛ den kɛse sɛ wobenya mfaso ankasa afi FDI mu wɔ ɛkame ayɛ sɛ adwuma biara mu.

 Ɔbea a Ɔda Nsow Abasobɔde, 2008, Kansas Sukuupɔn 
 Ɔbea Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo a Ɔda Nsow Abasobɔde, 2003, Kansas Sukuupɔn

title: Rosemond Aboagyewa Boohene
text:
Rosemond Boohene yɛ Ghanani adesuafo, akontabufo, sukuupɔn sohwɛfo ne adwumayɛ ho ɔbenfoɔ a wɔapaw no sɛ Pro Vice Chancellor wɔ University of Cape Coast .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Owiee sukuu wɔ Cape Coast Sukuupɔn mu a na ɔwɔ Bachelor of Commerce (Hons) abodin krataa ne Diploma wɔ Nhomasua mu. Akyiri yi onyaa Postgraduate Diploma wɔ Commerce ne Master of Commerce (Accounting) wɔ Otago Sukuupɔn mu, New Zealand. Ɛno akyi no onyaa ne PhD wɔ New England Sukuupɔn, Armidale, Australia. Akyiri yi Ɔbenfo Boohene suaa ade wɔ Galilea College, Israel nyaa Diploma wɔ Small & Medium Scale Enterprises Management and Development mu. Wɔmaa no adansedi krataa wɔ Facilitating and Designing E-Learning (Level 5) mu fii Open Polytechnic, New Zealand. Ɔbenfo Boohene yɛ German Adesua Nsesa Dwumadibea (DAAD) Ɔbenfo.

Rosemond de ne ho ahyɛ ntetee nhyehyɛe ahorow mu wɔ ntoaso sukuu sohwɛ mu a nea ɛka ho ne Senior Academic Leadership Training for Senior University Managers wɔ Ghana Sukuupɔn mu ; Amanaman Ntam Nkitahodi a Wɔhwɛ So wɔ Leibniz Sukuupɔn mu, Germany; Nhomasua a ɛkɔ anim ho nhyehyɛe ma Afrika Aman a wɔka Anglophone wɔ Zhejiang Normal University, Jinhua China; ne Nhomasua a Ɛkɔ Anim sohwɛ ne Akannifo wɔ Osnabruck Sukuupɔn mu, Germany.

Adwuma 
Ɔbenfo Boohene fii n'adwuma ase sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo wɔ Adwumayɛ Sukuu a ɛwɔ Cape Coast Sukuupɔn mu no mu . Kan no na ɔyɛ Center for Entrepreneurship and Small Enterprise Development no Ɔkwankyerɛfo. Na ɔyɛ kan Adwumayɛfo Adesua Dwumadibea no Titenani, Adwumayɛ Sukuu no Panyin Abadiakyiri, Amanaman Ntam Nhomasua so Panyin, Cape Coast Sukuupɔn mu . Na ɔyɛ Ɔbenfo a ɔsra hɔ wɔ Bonn-Rhein-Sieg Sukuupɔn a Ɛhwɛ Nyansahu a Wɔde Di Dwuma So, Germany.

Ɔyɛɛ adwuma maa Council for Technical, Vocational Education and Training (COTVET) na ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ ɔtetefoɔ a ne ho akokwa wɔ adwumayɛbea ahodoɔ mu maa Coastal Network Consortium de maa Ɔmantam Nhyiamu adwumayɛfoɔ tumi tu mpɔn wɔ Functional and Organizational Assessment Tool (FOAT) adwuma no mu. Ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ nnwuma bebree a EXIM Sikakorabea Ghana, Rainforest Alliance, European Union (EU), Germany Federal Ministry for Economic Co-operation and Development (BMZ), ne Amanaman Nkabom Dwumadibea a ɛhwɛ Nnwumayɛbea Dwumadibea (UNOPS) a ɛfa Nketewa ne Nnwumakuw a Wɔyɛ Mfinimfini, Ɛlektrɔnik Nneɛma a Wɔsɛe no Ho Dwumadi ne Adwumayɛ.

Ɔdii akwampaefoɔ kuo bi anim a wɔhyehyɛɛ Center for Entrepreneurship and Small Enterprise Development, Design Thinking and Innovation Hub, University of Cape Coast Adwumayɛbea a wɔhwɛ so. Ɔdii anim ma wɔde adwumayɛ ho adesua bi dii dwuma wɔ Cape Coast Suapɔn no gyinabea nyinaa. Ɔde nkɔmmɔ maa n’atipɛnfo a wofi Turku Sukuupɔn, Finland, na ɔne wɔn yɛɛ adwuma de yɛɛ Amanaman Nkabom Sikasɛm Bagua a Ɛhwɛ Afrika So (UNECA) boa wɔ intanɛt so adesua bi a wɔde maa sukuupɔn ahorow a wɔyɛ nnwuma.

Asɔremma ne fekubɔ a wɔde ma 

 Ɔman Ba/Oguamtrani, Ghana Nhomasua Bagua (GTEC)/Ɔman Gyedi Boayikuw (NAB) .
 Afrika Sukuupɔn Fekuw (AAU) .
 Fellow, German Adesua Nsesa Dwumadibea (DAAD) .

Nhwewhɛmu 
Boohene nhwehwɛmu anigyeɛ ne nnwumayɛ nkɔsoɔ, akontabuo ne nnwuma nketewa ne akɛseɛ sohwɛ.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ɔbenfo Boohene aware a ɔwɔ mma.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Eugenia Date-Bah
Dora Francisca Edu-Buandoh
text:
Francisca Dora Edu-Buandoh yɛ Ghanani Borɔfo kasa ho ɔbenfo ne ɔbea a odi kan a ɔyɛ Pro Vice-Chancellor wɔ Cape Coast Sukuupɔn mu . Wɔpaw no wɔ UCC Aban Bagua Nhyiamu a ɛtɔ so 99 a wɔyɛɛ no 23 Ɔbɛnem 2018. Ɔgyee adwuma no fii Prof. George KT Oduro a n'adwuma bere twaam wɔ 13 December 2018.

Nwomasua 
Ɔbenfo Dora Edu-Buandoh wɔ PhD wɔ Iowa Sukuupɔn, U.S.A.; MPhil ne Bachelor’s abodin krataa wɔ Borɔfo kasa mu wɔ Cape Coast Sukuupɔn mu ne Abodin krataa a ɛkyerɛ Borɔfo kasa a wɔkyerɛkyerɛ ma wɔn a wɔka kasa afoforo (TESOL) fi Wisconsin Sukuupɔn, Madison, U.S.A. Ɔsan nso yɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo a ɔfata, na wanya Abodin krataa ‘A’ wɔ Komenda Training College, ne Diploma wɔ Nhomasua mu wɔ University of Cape Coast . Na ɔyɛ obi a ɔde ne ho hyɛɛ Amanaman Ntam Deans Adesua a DAAD boa ma Nhomasua a Ɛkɔ Anim Ho Dwumadie mu na wayɛ Galilee Amanaman Ntam Adwumayɛ Asoɛeɛ Diploma wɔ Nhomasua a Ɛkɔ Anim Dwumadie nhyehyɛeɛ mu.

Adwuma 
Mprempren ɔyɛ Pro Vice Chancellor wɔ Cape Coast Sukuupɔn mu . Ɔyɛ Provost wɔ College of Humanities and Legal Studies firi afe 2016-2018. N’adwumayɛ tumidi no kaa sukuufo a wɔtaa kɔ sukuu no mu nkyem abiɛsa mu biako ne Cape Coast Sukuupɔn no adesua akyerɛkyerɛfo no mu nkyem 30% . Ɔde Kɔlege-Nnwuma Nnawɔtwe dwumadi ahorow a edi kan sii hɔ na ɔde Kɔlege no kyerɛɛ Nnwumakuw wiase a ɛfa Oil ne Gas ne Adwumayɛ ho. Ɔmaa GNPC Nhwehwɛmu Titenani a ɛwɔ United States Dɔla Ɔpepem biako a ɛfa Petroleum Management ho no yɛɛ mmerɛw. Ɔhyɛɛ mmɔdenbɔ ase sɛ ɔbɛhyehyɛ Mmara ne Aban Asoɛe bi wɔ Sukuupɔn no mu.

Na ɔyɛ Faculty of Arts no Panyin, Engiresi kasa Dwumadibea no Titenani ne Nkitahodi Ho Nimdeɛ nhyehyɛe no Ntamgyinafo. Sɛ́ nhomanimfo no, wakyerɛ ade wɔ ne nteɛso mu wɔ Sukuupɔn no mu gyinabea ahorow nyinaa mu; ɔsan nso de nhwehwɛmu nkrataa ama wɔ ɔman ne amanaman ntam nhyiam ahorow ase na watintim Ɔkasa ahorow ho wɔ nsɛmma nhoma ne wɛbsaet ahorow a agye din mu, wɔ mpɔtam hɔ ne amanaman ntam nyinaa. Wahwɛ adesua ahorow pii a wɔyɛ wɔ adesua a wɔawie akyi.

Ɔbenfo a ɔbenfo. Edu-Buandoh asom sɛ Oguamtrani anaa ɔmannifoɔ wɔ mmara ne ad hoc board ne boayikuo ahodoɔ bi mu wɔ departmental, faculty ne university levels, a Adesua Boayikuo, Sikasɛm Boayikuo, Nkɔsoɔ Boayikuo, Senior Members Disciplinary Committee ka ho. Ɔsan nso nyaa hokwan yɛɛ Titenani maa Ɔmampanyin Boayikuo a ɛhwɛ Ahyɛdeɛ 71 Office Holders akatua so (2012-2016).

Hwehwɛ mu 
Ɔbenfoɔ Edu-Buandoh n’adwuma titire wɔ Borɔfo Kasa Ho Nimdeɛ, Borɔfo Kasa, Akenkan ne Akyerɛw mu na n’anigyeɛ wɔ nhwehwɛmu mu fa Ɔkasa Adesua, Kasa Ahodoɔ, Kasa ne Adwene ne Akenkan ne Akyerɛw nso.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ɔyɛ ɔbea warefo a ɔwɔ mma.

Abasobɔde ahorow 
Ɔbenfo Edu-Buandoh anya abasobɔde ahorow pii a nea ɛka ho ne T. Anne Cleary International Dissertation Award a Ohio Sukuupɔn de mae, Fulbright Abasobɔde a United States Aban de ma, Ghana Aban Akwankyerɛ, Graduate Fellowship a Ohio Sukuupɔn de mae, AILA Solidarity Award a Fekuw no de mae Internationale de Linguistique Appliquée (Amanaman Ntam Fekuw a Ɛhwɛ Kasa Ho Adesua So) ne Alpha Delta Kappa Amanaman Ntam Mmea Akyerɛkyerɛfo Abasobɔde.

Ntoboa a Wɔde Ma 
Ɔde adetɔ ho nkrataa, PPE ne nneɛma bi maa UCC asuafoɔ binom ɛnam COVID-19 nkɛntɛnsoɔ nti.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Audrey Gadzekpo
text:
Ɔbenfo Audrey Sitsofe Gadzekpo yɛ Ghanani a ɔyɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo ne ɔbea panyin wɔ Sukuu a ɛhwɛ Amanneɛbɔ ne Nkitahodi Adesua so wɔ Ghana Sukuupɔn mu . Kan no na ɔyɛ Nkitahodi Ho Ɔfotufo ne Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo a ogyina mmea akuw ananmu. Ɔsan nso yɛ Webster Ghana afotufoɔ kuo no muni.

Nwomasua 
Ɔyɛ Ɔbenfo a ɔka ho wɔ Nsɛm ho Amanneɛbɔ ne Nsɛm ho Amanneɛbɔ ho Adesua mu. Ɔkɔɔ Birmingham Sukuupɔn a ɛwɔ Britain baabi a owiee ne PhD wɔ Nhomasua mu wɔ Center for West African Studies. Ɔnyaa ne MA wɔ Nkitahodiɛ mu wɔ Brigham Young Suapɔn a ɛwɔ Utah wɔ USA ne ne Bachelor of Arts wɔ Borɔfo kasa mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu .

Adwuma 
Ɔhyɛɛ n’adwuma ase wɔ afe 1993. Wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2017 mu no, Ɔmanpanyin Nana Akufo-Addo bɔɔ ne din sɛ boayikuo no muni a ɔreyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ama Ghana Ahofadi mfeɛ aduosia.

Wɔ June 2017 mu no, na ɔka Ɔman Nsɛm ho Amanneɛbɔ Bagua no mufoɔ a wɔde wɔn hyɛɛ mu sɛ wɔmmoa mma wɔmfa Broadcasting ne Right to Information mmara no nyɛ mmara.

Wɔ June 2017 mu no, ɔne Ɔbenfoɔ Ayokoe Anim-Wright, Cynthia E. Ofori-Dwumfuo ne Gifty Bingley kasaeɛ wɔ Maiden Edition of Women in PR Ghana Nhyiamu ase.

Ne nhwehwɛmu no gyina mmarima ne mmea, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ne nniso ho nsɛm so titiriw.

Wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2021 mu no, na ɔka boayikuo a emufoɔ yɛ baawɔtwe a wɔrebɛpaw din foforɔ ama Sini adwuma a ɛwɔ Ghana no ho.

Mprempren ɔyɛ Sukuu a ɛhwɛ Amanneɛbɔ ne Nkitahodi Adesua so Panyin wɔ Ghana Sukuupɔn mu .

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ɔwɔ ɔbabea bi a wɔfrɛ no Nubuke a ɔyɛ Africa Leadership Initiative-West Africa adesuakuw a ɛto so abiɛsa no muni na ɔyɛ Aspen Global Leadership Network no muni.

Abasobɔde ne anuonyam 
Na ɔyɛ ɔbenfo nsrahwɛfo wɔ Northwestern Sukuupɔn a ɛwɔ Chicago wɔ USA wɔ Program of African Studies mu fi September kosi December 2005.

Ɔsan nso yɛ Ahɔho Nhwehwɛmufoɔ wɔ Nordic Africa Institute wɔ Afrika Ahɔhoɔ Nhwehwɛmufoɔ Dwumadie mu wɔ afe 2012 (Nhwehwɛmu Kuw ‘Ntawntawdi, Ahobanbɔ ne Demokrasi Nsakyeraeɛ).

Wɔ March 2020 mu no, ɔnyaa abasobɔdeɛ wɔ Ghana Women of Excellence Awards a ɛtɔ so 5 no mu wɔ n’akannifoɔ dwumadie ho.

Anas Aremeyaw Anas de nidi maa no wɔ dwuma a odii wɔ ne sɔre mu denam sum ase nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Ghana no ho.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Afua Adwo Jectey Hesse
text:
Afua Adwo Jectey Hesse, FRCSEd, FICS, FFGCS, FWACS , yɛ Ghana oduruyɛfo a ɔyɛ oprehyɛn ne ɔbea oduruyɛfo a odi kan a watete no wɔ Ghana a ɔbɛyɛɛ mmofra oprehyɛn ho oduruyɛfo . Wɔ August 2010 mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ Ghanani a odi kan ne Afrikani a ɔto so abien a wɔpaw no sɛ Aduruyɛ Mmea Amanaman Ntam Fekuw (MWIA) no Titenani.

Nhomasua ne ntetee 
Wɔwoo Afua Hesse wɔ September 11 wɔ Kumasi . Ɔnyaa ne ntoaso sukuu wɔ Wesley Girls’ Senior High School a ɛwɔ Cape Coast . Afei ɔkɔɔ so kɔɔ Ghana Suapɔn Aduruyɛ Sukuu mu baabi a ɔtetee ne ho sɛ ɔbɛyɛɛ aduruyɛ ho oduruyɛfo. Ɔyɛ Royal College of Surgeons of Edinburgh (FRCSE), UK, ne West African College of Surgeons (FWACS) no muni ne Ghana College of Physicians and Surgeons (FFGCS) no Fapem Fellow. Ɔsan yɛ Amanaman Ntam Nnuruyɛfo Kuw a Wɔyɛ Oprehyɛn (FICS) no muni. Ɔwɔ Level 8 Diploma wɔ Chartered Management Institute, London, UK Ɔsan nso wɔ adansedie krataa wɔ Health Management Administration for Senior Health Practitioners firi Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration (GIMPA), Abodin krataa wɔ Health Management Institute, 1999 mu. Nhyehyɛe ne Nhyehyɛe a efi Leeds Sukuupɔn mu .

Adwuma 
Ɔyɛ ɔbea a odi kan pii. Ɔyɛ ɔbaa Mmofra Oprehyɛn Oduruyɛfoɔ a ɔdi kan wɔ Ghana ne ɔbaa oprehyɛnfoɔ a ɔdi kan a ɔfiri ne alma mater na ɔsom sɛ Aduruyɛ Mmea Amanaman Ntam Fekuo no Titenani, foforɔ a ɛdi kan maa Ghanani wɔ Fekuo no mfeɛ 91 abakɔsɛm mu a ɛyɛ deɛ ɛdi kan Amanaman Ntam Mmea a Wɔyɛ Adwumayɛfo Fekuw. Ɔyɛ Oprehyɛn ho Ɔbenfoɔ wɔ Ghana Suapɔn Aduruyɛ Sukuu mu na wasom wɔ nnwuma ahodoɔ mu wɔ Aduruyɛ Sukuu ne Korle Bu Nkyerɛkyerɛ Ayaresabea nyinaa a ɔwɔ bɛboro mfeɛ aduasa osuahu. Ɔno ne ɔbea a odi kan a ɔsom sɛ Oprehyɛn Dwumadibea no Titenani, Aduruyɛ ho Nsɛm ho Ɔkwankyerɛfo, Mmofra Oprehyɛn Dwumadibea no Titenani na akyiri yi ɔyɛɛ Korle Bu Nkyerɛkyerɛ Ayaresabea no kwankyerɛfo panyin a ɔyɛ adwuma. Ɔno ne ɔbea a odi kan a ɔyɛ Ghana Aduruyɛ Fekuw no Nidi Ɔkyerɛwfo. Ɔma ɔkasa wɔ adesua a edi kan ne nea wɔawie akyi nyinaa wɔ Ghana Sukuupɔn Aduruyɛ Sukuu mu na ɔyɛ nhwehwɛmufo wɔ Amanaman Ntam aduruyɛ ho nsɛmma nhoma ahorow a atipɛnfo ahwɛ mu. Ɔayɛ nnwuma pii a nea ɛka ho ne sɛ ɔsom sɛ Ɔfotufoɔ ma Ministry of Health, ɔsom wɔ nnwumakuo ne sukuupɔn asoɛeɛ bi ne Ghana Aduruyɛ Fekuo ne Suapɔn Mpɔtam no boards mu wɔ dibea ahodoɔ mu. Mprempren, ɔyɛ Co-founder ne President of the Accra College of Medicine, Ghana ankorankoro Aduruyɛ sukuu a ɛdi kan a ɛbɛwie ne nnuruyɛfoɔ kuo a ɛdi kan wɔ afe 2020.

Nhoma ahorow a wɔapaw 
Afua Hesse akyerɛw na waboa ti ahorow wɔ nhoma ahorow pii a ɛho hia mu. Ɔwɔ nhoma bɛboro aduasa a ɔde kamfo no.

Gye to mu 
Afua Hesse anya anuonyam denam paw, dibea ne abasobɔde ahorow pii so. Wɔ afe 2010 mu no, ɔnyaa Mfirihyia Apem Abasobɔdeɛ a ɛfa Aduruyɛ mu Akannifoɔ ho na afe 2017 mu no, ɔnyaa Glitz Africa Excellence in Health Award.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Afua Hesse aware Adukwei Hesse, a ɔyɛ Mfinimfini Aduruyɛ ho Ɔbenfo ne saa ara nso na ɔyɛ Presbyterian Asɔre no Somfo ne Accra College of Medicine a ɔne no wɔ mma baanan no mu biako.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Priscilla Kolibea Mante
text:
Priscilla Kolibea Mante yɛ Ghana neuropharmacologist, nhwehwɛmufo ne ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo a ofi Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology, mprempren ɔte Kumasi sukuupɔn no mu. Ne nhwehwɛmu adwuma no twe adwene si akwan foforo a wɔfa so sa yare a egyina afifide so de adi akisikuru a nnuru ntumi nnye ne yare a ɛwɔ ɔhyew mu a wobu ani gu so a wɔfrɛ no neurocysticercosis . Wɔ n’adwuma mu no, ɔhwehwɛ afifide mu alkaloid cryptolepine ne ne solid-lipid nanoparticles dwumadi a ɛko tia akisikuru mu kɛse wɔ neurocysticercosis a ɛma akisikuru no di mu. Ne botae ne sɛ obehu ɔkwan bi a ɔbɛfa so aboa cryptolepine ma akɔ ntini a ɛwɔ mfinimfini no mu yiye na ama asiane a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wɔbɛtwetwe wɔn ho no so atew, na aboa ayarefo ma wɔadi wɔn tebea no ho dwuma yiye sɛnea wobetumi. Sɛ Mante adesua a ɛfa akisikuru ho no da nkyɛn a, wayɛ adwuma nso de anya ayaresa foforo a ɛbɛma ɛyaw, dadwen, ne adwenemhaw so atew.

Wɔ afe 2019 mu no, ɔno nko ara ne Afrikani a ɔnyaa L’Oréal-UNESCO For Women in Science International Rising Talent Award, na ne nyinaa yɛ dunum mu baako. Ɔsan nso yɛ obi a wanya 2018 L’Oréal-UNESCO For Women in Science Sub-Saharan Africa sub-doctoral fellowship. Ɔsan nso kɔɔ so dii nkonim wɔ 2019 OWSD Early Career Fellowship mu.

Nwomasua 
Mante wiee ne ntoaso sukuu wɔ Wesley Girls’ Senior High School, Cape Coast, Ghana. Ɔnyaa PhD wɔ Nnuruyɛ mu wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so wɔ afe 2013 mu. Mante oduruyɛfo nhwehwɛmu no twee adwene sii Antiaris toxicaria a wɔde di dwuma sɛ aduru a ɛko tia akisikuru, titiriw wɔ Ghana. Wɔ saa bere koro no ara mu no ɔsan yɛɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ ayaresa a egyina afifide so ma ntini a ɛwɔ nipadua no mfinimfini no mu. Mante nyaa ne oduruyɛfo akyi ntetee wɔ Michigan Sukuupɔn Aduruyɛ Sukuu a ɛwɔ USA, faako a na onya Michigan Sukuupɔn STEM Aba mmoa no.

Adwuma 
Mante yɛ nnuruyɛfo a wɔakyerɛw ne din wɔ Pharmaceutical Society of Ghana. Efi afe 2010 kosi afe 2014 no, ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ nnuruyɛfo wɔ Constant Pharmacy. Efi afe 2013 no, Mante ayɛ adwuma wɔ Pharmacology Department a ɛwɔ Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology a ɔyɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo panyin. Ɔyɛ Pharmacist a wɔakyerɛw ne din na mprempren ɔyɛ Ghana Young Academy no guamtrani. Wonim Mante nso sɛ n’ani gye nhomasua ho na odi mmea anim wɔ nyansahu mu ma wɔtoa wɔn adwuma so.

"Wiase no bɛma yɛn kwan." Dodow a mmea piapia dibea akɛse no, dodow no ara na ɛbɛyɛ den sɛ wobebu wɔn ani agu so." —Oduruyɛfo. Mante, ɛfa mmea a wɔrenya nkɔanim wɔ nyansahu mu ho.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Takyiwaa Manuh
Peace Adzo Medie
text:
Wɔwoo Medie wɔ Liberia na otu kɔɔ Ghana bere a na ɔyɛ abofra, na osuaa ade wɔ OLA Girls Senior High School .  Onyaa abodin krataa wɔ asase ho adesua mu wɔ Ghana Sukuupɔn mu . Afei owiee n’adesua akyi adesua wɔ United States, faako a onyaa Ph.D. wɔ ɔmanfo ne amanaman ntam nsɛm mu wɔ Pittsburgh Sukuupɔn mu .

Adwuma

Nhomasua mu adwuma 
Medie yɛɛ adwuma sɛ nhwehwɛmufo wɔ Ghana Sukuupɔn mu ne oduruyɛfo akyi nhwehwɛmufo wɔ Princeton Sukuupɔn Woodrow Wilson Sukuu a Ɛhwɛ Ɔmanfo ne Amanaman Ntam Nsɛm So .  Mprempren ɔyɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo panyin wɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbea ntam amammuisɛm ne amanaman ntam amammuisɛm mu wɔ Bristol Sukuupɔn a ɛwɔ United Kingdom no.  Wɔmaa n’adwuma no afe 2012-2013 African Affairs African Author Prize.

Ne nhomanimfo no twe adwene si ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, amammuisɛm, ne akodeyɛ so.

Wɔ afe 2020 mu no, Medie tintim ne nhoma a edi kan, nhomanimfo adwuma a wɔato din Global Norms and Location Action: The Campaigns to End Violence Against Women in Africa . Ɛka sɛnea aman a wɔkoe akyi no yɛ wɔn ade wɔ basabasayɛ a wɔyɛ mmea ho.

Ɔka nsɛmma nhoma Politics & Gender samufo bagua no ho na ɔne afoforo bom yɛ nsɛmma nhoma African Affairs .

Ayɛsɛm a wɔkyerɛw 
Wɔ ne nhomasua adwuma akyi no, Medie ayɛ ayɛsɛm ntiantiaa pii. Wɔ afe 2020 mu no, otintim n’ayɛsɛm a edi kan, Ne Yere Koro pɛ . Ɛka nnɛyi aware mu apereperedi a ɛwɔ Ghana ne mmea baasa, Afi, Evelyn, ne Muna asetra a ɛka bom ho. Wɔkaa ho asɛm sɛ "A Cinderella asɛm bi a wɔde sii Ghana" a Kirkus kyerɛwee .

Wogyee Ne Yere Koro no toom yiye, na epuei wɔ nnwom foforo a eye sen biara a wɔayi no adi no din pii mu, a New York Times ’ Staff Picks ka ho. Wɔ afe 2021 mu no, Ghana amanneɛbɔ adwumayɛbea Citi TV bɔɔ no din sɛ "Best Author" wɔ wɔn afe afe Entertainment Achievement Awards mu.

Medie ka n’ayɛsɛm no ho asɛm sɛ ne nhomasua mu nhwehwɛmu a ɔyɛe wɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna, basabasayɛ, ne amammuisɛm ho no nyaa so nkɛntɛnso kɛse.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Sophia Ophilia Adjeibea Adinyira
text:
Sophia Ophelia Adjeibea Adinyira yɛ Ghanani a wakɔ pɛnhyen wɔ Ghana Asɛnnibea Kunini no mu Ɔtemmufo na ɔyɛ Amanaman Nkabom Asɛnnibea a Ɛhwɛ Asɛm a Wɔde Kɔdan Asɛnnibea no muni.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Adinyira wɔ 1 September 1949 wɔ Cape Coast wɔ Central Region of Ghana .  Ɔkɔɔ Fijai Senior High School fi 1961 kosi 1966 maa ne ‘O’ Level adansedi krataa ne Wesley Girls’ High School fi 1966 kosi 1968 maa ne ‘A’ Level adansedi krataa.  Ɔnyaa ne mmara ho nteteeɛ wɔ Ghana Suapɔn ne Ghana Mmara Sukuu, na wɔfrɛɛ no kɔɔ Ghana Bar wɔ afe 1973.

Adwuma 
Adinyira yɛɛ adwuma wɔ Attorney General’s Department wɔ afe 1974 mu sɛ Ɔman Mmaranimfo Boafo.  Ɔsom saa dibea no kosii 1986 mu bere a wɔmaa no so kɔɔ Ɔman Mmaranimfo Panyin dibea no. Wɔ 1989 mu no, wɔpaw no sɛ ɔnkɔ Asɛnnibea Kunini no benkyi so.  Ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ Asɛnnibea Kunini no temmufo bɛyɛ mfe du, na wɔ 1999 mu no, onyaa dibea sɛ Asɛnnibea a Ɛhwɛ Asɛm a Wɔde Kɔdan Asɛnnibea no benkyi. Wɔpaw no sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ Asɛnnibea Kunini no wɔ March 15, 2006.  Ɔsan nso yɛɛ Amanaman Nkabom Asɛnnibea a Ɛhwɛ Asɛm a Wɔde Kɔdan Asɛnnibea no Temmufo fi July 2009 kosi June 2016, na ɔtraa New York ne Geneva .

Adinyira yɛ Amanaman Ntam Mmea Atemmufo Fekuw no muni na ɔyɛ Ɔman Boayikuw a Ɛhwɛ Mmofra Ho Banbɔ So a Ɛhwɛ Nnwuma Ahorow Ahorow So no guamtrani . Ɔkyerɛw mmofra atɛntrenee ho nhyehyɛe maa Ghana a Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ Bɔbeasu, Mmofra ne Asetra mu Ahobammɔ So ne UNICEF boae . Ɔsan nso yɛ General Legal Council, kuw a ɛhwɛ mmara ho adesua so wɔ Ghana no muni.

Abasobɔde ne agyede a wɔde ma 
Adinyira yɛ Mmaranimfo Bagua Kɛse no Nteɛso Boayikuw no muni.  Ɔnyaa ɔman abasobɔdeɛ wɔ ne mmoa a ɔde maeɛ de "maa Ghana abofra nkrabea yɛɛ kɛseɛ" firii Mmea ne Mmofra Ɔsoafoɔ hɔ wɔ Amanaman Nkabom Apam a Ɛfa Mmofra Hokwan Ho no mfeɛ aduonu afahyɛ ase .

Ankorankoro asetra 
Adinyira yɛ Anglikan Asɔre no muni na wayɛ Afrika Atɔe Fam Mantam Asɔre no Ɔmantam Panyin fi afe 1993. Wɔ afe 2019 mu no, wɔpaw no sɛ ɔyɛ ɔbea ne ɔsɔremma Kanon a odi kan wɔ Cathedral Church of St Peter wɔ Anglican Diocese of Koforidua .  Ɔyɛɛ Wiase Asɔre Bagua a ɛwɔ Geneva no kwankyerɛfo abadiakyiri na na ɔyɛ ne Boayikuw Mfinimfini no muni fi afe 2006 kosi afe 2013. Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baanum.

title: Vida Akoto-Bamfo
text:
Vida Akoto-Bamfo yɛ Ghana Asɛnnibea Kunini Temmufo a wakɔ pɛnhyen . Ɔdii Asɛnnibea Kunini no benkyi so firi afe 2009 kɔsi afe 2019.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Akoto-Bamfo wɔ 7 Ɔpɛpɔn 1949 maa Owura Alfred Kingsley Bannerman-Williams ne Madam Grace Darkua Dodoo wɔ Pokuase, wɔ Greater Accra Mantam mu wɔ Ghana . Ɔnyaa ne mfitiaseɛ nwomasua wɔ Accra Royal School a ɛwɔ James Town (British Accra). Wɔ afe 1963 mu no, onyaa kwan kɔɔ Mfantsiman Girls’ Secondary School baabi a onyaa ne ‘O’ Level adansedi krataa no.  Akyiri yi ɔkɔɔ so wɔ Aburi Girls’ Senior High School fi 1967 kosi 1969.  Ɔsuaa mmara wɔ Ghana Suapɔn Mmara Sukuu mu wɔ afe 1972 ne 1975 ntam. Afei ɔkɔɔ Ghana Mmara Sukuu a ɛwɔ Accra.

Adwuma 
Ansa na ɔrebɛka bench no ho wɔ afe 1981 mu no, na Akoto-Bamfo yɛ adwuma wɔ Mmaranimfo Panyin Dwumadibea sɛ Ɔman Dwumadibea adwumayɛfo.  Akyiri yi ɔde ne ho kɔbɔɔ British Indian Insurance Company wɔ Accra, ne Zenith Assurance a mprempren enni hɔ bio sɛ Manager a ɔhwɛ sika a wɔde gye sika so fi 1976 kosi 1981.  Ɛhɔ no, na n’asɛyɛde ne sɛ osiesie insurance ho nsɛm. Ɔbɛyɛɛ Ɔmantam Ɔtemmufo wɔ afe 1981.  Sɛ ɔtemmufo no, wodii kan de no kɔɔ New Town Magistrate Court wɔ ne mfe abien a edi kan no mu.  Akyiri yi woyii no kɔɔ Cocoa Affairs baabi a ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ Atemmufo a wodii kan wɔ hɔ no mu biako.  Akyiri yi wɔpaw no sɛ Ɔmansin Asɛnnibea temmufo a ɔde ne ho ahyɛ Tema bere tiaa bi ansa na ɔresan akɔ Cocoa Affairs wɔ 1986.  Ɔtraa Cocoa Affairs fi saa bere no kosii 1991 bere a wɔmaa no dibea sɛ Asɛnnibea Kunini no benkyi no. Bere a ɔsom sɛ Asɛnnibea Kunini no temmufo mfe abiɛsa akyi no, woyii no kɔɔ Gambia bere a wɔde no too afiase mfe abien sɛ Agyapade Bagua no Titenani.  Wɔpaw no sɛ Asɛm a Wɔde Kɔdan Asɛnnibea Temmufo wɔ afe 1999 mu na ɔkɔɔ so dii saa dibea yi kosii sɛ John Evans Atta Mills, Ghana Titenani paw no na ɔpaw no sɛ Ghana Asɛnnibea Kunini no temmufo wɔ afe 2009. Ɔkɔɔ pɛnhyen wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2019.  Wɔne Nasiru Sulemana Gbadegbe ne Benjamin Teiko Aryeetey (mprempren wakɔ pɛnhyen) boom paw no. Ɔkaa Atemmufo Stephen Alan Brobbey, Georgina Theodora Wood (saa bere no na Ɔtemmufo Panyin) ne Samuel K. Date-Bah, a wɔn nyinaa akɔ pɛnhyen no ho.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Vida Akoto-Bamfo waree owufoɔ Eugene Akoto-Bamfo Snr., a ɔyɛ Mmaranimfoɔ. Ɔkyerɛe sɛ ɔyɛ Methodist nanso ɔyɛ fekubɔ wɔ Polisifo Asɔre no mu.

Hwɛ nso

 Atemmuo a ɛwɔ Ghana

title: Avril Lovelace-Johnson
text:
Avril Lovelace-Johnson yɛ Ghana mmaranimfo . Wɔpaw no sɛ Asɛnnibea Kunini Temmufo wɔ November 2019 mu na wɔyɛɛ no nhwehwɛmu wɔ 9 December 2019.  Ɔkaa ntam wɔ 17 December 2019.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Lovelace-Johnson fi Mankessim a ɛwɔ Ghana Mfinimfini Mantam mu . Ɔnyaa ne ntoaso sukuu wɔ Wesley Girls’ High School maa ne ordinary level adansedie ne Aburi Girls’ Senior High School maa ne advanced level adansedie.

Adwuma 
Lovelace-Johnson yɛɛ adwuma sɛ Ɔman Mmaranimfo Boafo wɔ Mmaranimfo Panyin Dwumadibea a ɛwɔ Accra ne Mmaranimfo Panyin Dwumadibea a ɛwɔ Koforidua wɔ ne Ɔman Som akyi fi 1988 kosi 1989. Ɔyɛɛ Ɔmantam Ɔtemmufoɔ wɔ June 1994 mu kɔsii sɛ wɔpaw no sɛ Asɛnnibea Kunini no Temmufoɔ wɔ Accra ne Tema asennibea Kunini no mu wɔ June 2002 mu. Ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ benkyi no so sɛ Asɛnnibea Kunini no temmufo kosii afe 2012 bere a ɔbɛyɛɛ Asɛnnibea a Ɛhwɛ Asɛm a Wɔde Kɔdan Asɛnnibea no Temmufo. Commonwealth Ɔkyerɛwfo Dwumadibea a ɛwɔ London no de no kɔɔ The Gambia sɛ Asɛnnibea Kunini no Temmufo a ɔno nso yɛ Asɛnnibea a Wɔde Nsɛm Kɔdan no no Temmufo foforo fi December 2005 kosi 2009. Na ɔyɛ Asɛnnibea a Ɛhwɛ Asɛm a Wɔde Kɔdan Asɛnnibea no temmufo kosii sɛ wɔpaw no sɛ Asɛnnibea Kunini no Temmufo wɔ November 2019.  Ɔkaa ntam sɛ ɔbɛdi dwuma wɔ 17 December 2019.

Lovelace-Johnson adi akannifoɔ dibea ahodoɔ bi, a nea ɛka ho ne sɛ ɔyɛɛ Ɔmanfoɔ Anwiinwii ne Asɛnnibea Nhwehwɛmu Kuo a ɛwɔ Ghana Atemmuo Dwumadibea no sohwɛfoɔ ne Ghana Atemmufoɔ ne Atemmufoɔ Fekuo no Titenani Abadiakyiri. Bere bi na ɔyɛ Planned Parenthood Association of Ghana no baguafo a wɔde nidi ma no .

title: Mariama Owusu
text:
Mariama Owusu yɛ Ghana mmaranimfo . Mprempren ɔyɛ Asɛnnibea a Wɔde Nsɛm Kɔdan no temmufo, wɔpaw no sɛ Asɛnnibea Kunini no Temmufo wɔ November 2019 mu na wɔhwehwɛɛ mu wɔ 9 December 2019.  Ɔkaa ntam wɔ 17 December 2019.  Ansa na wɔrepaw no no, na wasom wɔ benkyi no so mfe aduasa awotwe (38).

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Mariama Owusu fi Beposo a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana . Ɔnyaa ne ntoaso sukuu wɔ TI Ahmadiyya Ntoaso Sukuu, Kumasi (TI Amass) firi Form One kɔsi Upper Six.

Adwuma 
Ofii ase som wɔ benkyi so sɛ Ɔmantam Ɔtemmufo fi 1990 kosi 1992. Ɔbɛyɛɛ Ɔmansin Asɛnnibea temmufo wɔ 1992 mu na ɔsom wɔ saa dibea no mu kosii afe 2000 mu bere a wɔyɛɛ no Asɛnnibea Kunini temmufo no. Wɔ afe 2003 mu no, wɔpaw no sɛ Asɛnnibea Kunini temmufo a ɔhwɛ Sunyani so kosii afe 2005. Ɔkɔɔ so yɛɛ Asɛnnibea Kunini no temmufo kosii afe 2006 mu bere a ɔtraa Asɛnnibea a Ɛhwɛ Asɛm a Wɔde Kɔdan Asɛnnibea no. Na ɔyɛ Asɛnnibea a Ɛhwɛ Asɛm a Wɔde Kɔdan Asɛnnibea no temmufo kosii sɛ wɔpaw no sɛ Asɛnnibea Kunini no Temmufo wɔ November 2019. Ɔkaa ntam sɛ ɔbɛdi dwuma wɔ 17 December 2019.

Owusu ayɛ Amanaman Ntam Mmea Atemmufoɔ Fekuo no Ghana Chapter no titrani mfeɛ nnan. Wayɛ Atemmu Dwumadibea no Abrabɔ Pa Boayikuw no muni nso. Efi afe 2010 kosi afe 2014 no, na ɔyɛ Performing Assets Committee, Judicial Service no muni.

Ɔka kuw bi a emufo yɛ baason a wɔbɛtie afe 2020 abatoɔ adesrɛ a John Mahama de too gua tia The Electoral Commission of Ghana ne Nana Akufo-Addo.

title: Tinchy Stryder
text:
Kwasi Esono Danquah III  ( /ˈ k w eɪ s i. Ɔde ne nsa kyerɛɛ ne so, na ɔde ne nsa kyerɛɛ ne so bio d æ ŋ ˈ k w ɑː / KWAY -hwɛ dang- KWAH ; wɔwoo no 14 Ɔpɛpɔn 1986),  a wɔde agoprama so din Tinchy Stryder, ɔyɛ Ghana- Britani  rapfo, odwontofo, nnwom kyerɛwfo, adwumayɛfo ne sikakorafo.

Stryder ayi solo studio album abiɛsa adi, Star in the Hood (2007), Catch 22 (2009), ne Third Strike (2010). Stryder adwumayɛ mu nnwuma bi ne ntadeɛ kwan Star in the Hood, Cloud 9 X Goji headphone ne audio mfiri ahodoɔ a wɔne Goji Electronics ayɛ adwuma abom.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Stryder Kwasi Danquah wɔ Accra, Ghana wɔ afe 1986.

Nnwom adwuma 
Stryder nnwom a wɔakyere agu hama so no fi 1998. Ɔpuee wɔ afe 2000 mu  wɔ adwowtwafoɔ radio so a ɔne Dizzee Rascal ne Wiley, na ɔkaa grime collective ne record production team Ruff Sqwad ho firi afe 2001. Ne din a wɔde frɛ no Tinchy Stryder no fi video so agodie Strider ne abodin a wɔde maa no "Tinchy":  ne tenten wɔ 5 anammɔn 3 wɔ (1.60 m). 

Wɔ afe 2002 mu no, Wiley na ɔhyehyɛɛ grime kuw Roll Deep, na na Stryder ne Dizzee Rascal ka ho. Ná wɔreyɛ nnwom a efi kar dan mu . Bere tiaa bi no, na wonni din mpo mma no. Edin "grime" no ne nea ɛbataa ho. Bere a ɔne Roll Deep reyɛ nnwom no, Stryder too nnwom bi a "U Were Always" ka ho wɔ afe 2002 mu, a woyii no adi mfe bi akyi wɔ Roll Deep nnwom nhoma a wɔaboaboa ano Street Anthems mu wɔ afe 2009 mu. Ɔsan nso yɛɛ ne dwumadi wɔ Roll Deep 2004 mixtape, Creeper Vol. 2 .

2006–08: Nsoromma a ɛwɔ Hood mu 
Stryder album a edi kan, Star in the Hood, no, woyii no adi wɔ 13 Ɔbɛnem 2007 wɔ Takeover . Album no woo nnwom titire mmienu, "Breakaway", a woyii no adi wɔ 9 April 2007 ne " Something About Your Smile ", a woyii no adi wɔ 6 August 2007. Bonus track " Mainstream Money " nso wɔyii no adi sɛ asase ase nnwom wɔ November 2007. 

Wɔ afe 2008 mu no, Stryder yii ne debut extended play, Cloud 9 The EP, a woyii no adi wɔ 31 March, nso wɔ Takeover.  Eyi akyi no, ɔne grime record producer Maniac yɛɛ biako wɔ album no mu, Tinchy Stryder vs. Maniac, a woyii no adi wɔ 24 Ɔbɛnem 2008.  Single baako pɛ na wɔyii no adi wɔ album no mu, "Rollin", a wɔyii no adi wɔ October 2008.  Saa dwom yi nso kaa ne 2009 solo studio album a ɛtɔ so mmienu, Catch 22, sɛ, Deluxe 2-Disc Edition no fã, na ɔne Amerikafoɔ nnwontofoɔ kuo Gang Gang Dance bɛyɛ adwuma abom wɔ wɔn album Saint Dymphna a wɔyii no adi wɔ Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 2008 mu.

2008–2010: Nkyeremu 22 
Stryder ne Engiresini a ɔyɛ nnwom a wɔbɔ ne nnwom kyerɛwfo Fraser T Smith fii ase yɛɛ biako . Sɛnea Smith kyerɛ wɔ nsɛm a wobisabisaa HitQuarters, "Kwasi nni beats ne cool sounding production a ɛho nhia, nanso misusuw sɛ na ɔpɛ sɛ ɔbɔ mmɔden na ɔpae mu kɔ mainstream no mu, na na mewɔ osuahu bi wɔ asase ase twa kɔɔ mainstream mu a ɔne adwumfo te sɛ Craig David ." 

Single " Stryderman ", wɔyii no adi wɔ 20 Ɔpɛpɔn 2008. Ɛyɛ nnwom a edi kan a wogye fii Catch 22 mu . Nnwom a ɛtɔ so mmienu, " Take Me Back ", wɔyii no adi wɔ 19 Ɔbɛnem 2009.  Ne nnwom a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa, a ɔne Engiresifoɔ hip-hop nnwontofoɔ kuo N-Dubz yɛɛ adwuma boom a wɔtoo din " Number 1 ," duu ne soro 6 wɔ European Hot 100 Singles ne nea ɛtɔ so 1 wɔ UK & Ireland na ɛbɛyɛɛ single a ɛdi kan a ɛwɔ asɛmti "Number 1" sɛ ɛbɛkɔ soro wɔ #1 wɔ ɔman biara mu. Ne nnwom a ɛtɔ so nnan a ɛfiri Catch 22, " Never Leave You ", no, wɔyii no adi wɔ 3 Ɔbɛnem 2009 a album no dii akyire wɔ 17 Ɔbɛnem 2009. "Never Leave You" no duu nea ɛto so 5 wɔ European Hot 100 Singles mu wɔ dapɛn a woyii no adi no mu. Catch 22 dii kan wɔ nea ɛto so 11 wɔ Europa Nnwom 100 a Ɛsen Biara no mu . Single a ɛtɔ so anum ne deɛ ɛtwa toɔ a ɛfiri Catch 22 ne " You're Not Alone ," a wɔyii no adi wɔ November 2009 mu na ɛyɛ Olive dwom a ɛwɔ din korɔ no ara no nhwɛsoɔ.  

Wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2010 mu no, Stryder asɛmti no kyinkyin ne mprɛnsa so, ɔtoo nsa frɛɛ Engiresini odwontofo Example ne rapfo JME sɛ ne nnwontofo a wɔboa no. Nsrahwɛ no yɛ Stryder akwantuo a ɛtɔ so mmienu a wɔtɔn wieeɛ wɔ berɛ a ɔkɔɔ akwantuo mu wɔ afe 2009 mu na ɛboaa ma wɔmaa Nhwɛsoɔ din kɔɔ soro.  Stryder buee ano wɔ pyramid asɛnka agua so wɔ England Glastonbury Afahyɛ, Kwasida, 27 June 2010. Ɔsan nso bɔɔ nnwom wɔ O2 Arena wɔ England, maa Transformation Trust awoda a edi kan a ɔne The Saturdays .

Adwumayɛ mu nnwuma ne endorsements 
Wɔ September 2006 mu no, Stryder yɛɛ ntadeɛ ahyɛnsodeɛ Star in the Hood, a wɔde ne din hunu "Star In The Hood" too so. Wɔ June 2010 mu no, ɔde Takeover Entertainment Limited, ne anigyede tumi akɛse Roc Nation LLC ne Live Nation yɛɛ biako, na ɔyɛɛ Takeover Roc Nation . Nkɔmmɔdie no baa awieeɛ wɔ afe 2013 mu nanso ɔda so ara bɛn Roc Nation.

Wɔ December 2008 mu no, Stryder hyehyɛɛ n’ankasa wiase nyinaa nhoma tintim adwumakuw, Takeover/Cloud 9 denam adwuma a ɔne EMI division EMI Music Publishing yɛɛ biako so. 

Wɔ 8 Ɔbɛnem 2011 no, Honda ’s moto fã no faa Stryder maa wɔn Europa nyinaa ɔsatu no. Ɔsatu a Stryder ka ho no, Facebook, Inc., ne tie-up ne fashion brand GAS boaa sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛpia Vision 50, Honda 50cc entry level scooter. Wɔde Vision 50 no too gua wɔ 8 Ɔbɛnem 2011 wɔ EICMA (Milan Motorcycle Show) wɔ Milan, Italy kaa sakre ahodoɔ foforɔ nsia ho.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Stryder daa no adi wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2010 mu sɛ ɔpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ bɔɔlbɔfoɔ sɛ aberanteɛ. Stryder yɛ obi a ɔde nan benkum bɔ bɔɔl a ɔtumi bɔ sɛ ɔbɔfoɔ anaa ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔtɔ so mmienu, na ɔde ne din kɔhyɛɛ Wimbledon FC adesua mu firi afe 2000 kɔsi afe 2003 ne mmabun kuo a ɛwɔ Leyton Orient FC firi afe 2003 kɔsi afe 2006. Stryder wɔ ɔbabea, Arabella, ne n’ayeforokunu Amba Miller. Wɔ May 2021 mu no, wɔwoo ɔbabarima.

Adɔe adwuma 
Dwoda 4 Ɔbɛnem 2010 Stryder kɔɔ O2 Shepherd’s Bush Empire wɔ England, maa Alicia Keys ’ adɔeɛ kuo Keep a Child Alive adɔeɛ bɔɔl ne aguadidan, ne ahɔhoɔ titire foforɔ. Wɔde sika a wonya fii aguadidan a wɔtɔn wɔ dwumadi no mu no nyinaa maa Keep a Child Alive (KCA).  Stryder de sika a onya fi Goji Electronics mu no ma adɔe akuw.

title: Yaw Skyface
text:
Isaac Adu Mensah (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn 18, 1988), a wɔfrɛ no Yaw Skyface, yɛ Ghana siniyɛfo, ɔkwankyerɛfo ne siniyɛfo . Ne sini a edi kan Door 2 Door no nyaa nsɛm pa dodow no ara bere a woyii no adi wɔ afe 2017.

Mfitiase asetra 
Wɔwoo Yaw wɔ ( Kwahu Abetifi, Apuei Fam Mantam ). Ɔde ne mmofraberem fã bi nyinii wɔ Takoradi, kosii sɛ n’abusua tu kɔɔ Accra. Bere a owiee Takoradi Polytechnic wɔ afe 2008 mu no, ofii ase yɛɛ adwuma sɛ video kwankyerɛfo wɔ afe 2009 mu.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Salifu Abdul Hafiz
text:
Salifu Abdul Hafiz (wɔwoo no March, 1990) yɛ Ghana Sini/Aguadi ne Nnwom Video sohwɛfo  a watow na wakyerɛ nnwom video ahorow pii ama artiste te sɛ Dobble, Mr. Eazi, Obrafour, Sarkodie, Guru, Maccasio, Medikal, Teephlow, YPEE ne artiste afoforo pii wɔ wiase nyinaa.

Ɔno na ɔhyehyɛɛ ne adebɔ kwankyerɛfoɔ wɔ Ghana video yɛ adwumakuo bi a agye din, Digital Creative Media a kan no na wɔfrɛ no DC FILMS PRODUCTION. Wɔayɛ nneɛma ama amanaman ntam nnwuma te sɛ USAID, IDH, DECATHLON, BETWAY, TULLOW OIL, CAL BANK ne afoforo pii.

Asetra ne adwuma 
Salifu Abdul Hafiz nyinii wɔ Abetifi-Kwahu baabi a ɔhyɛɛ mfitiaseɛ sukuu ase kɔsii ntoaso sukuu wɔ Abetifi Presbyterian Senior High School. 

Bere a owiee ntoaso sukuu wɔ afe 2009 mu no, ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ intanɛt cafe bi mu sɛ cafe sohwɛfo na akyiri yi wɔmaa no dibea sɛ baa dwumadibea no sohwɛfo. Bere a na ɔreyɛ adwuma wɔ cafe no, osuaa nnyigyei ho mfiridwuma ne video editing a ɛkanyan no ma ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ multimedia mu. Ɔyɛɛ demos maa n’ankasa ne nnwontofo a wɔreba no, a nnwom a wɔde kata so ka ho. 

Ɔtu kɔɔ Accra Ghana ahenkuro mu sɛ ɔrekɔdi n’adaesoɔ akyi wɔ afe 2010 mu. 

Ɔde ne din kɔhyɛɛ Takoradi Technical University afei Takoradi Polytechnic sɛ ɔrekɔyɛ Commercial Art wɔ afe 2012 mu. Bere a na ɔwɔ sukuu mu no, Hafiz yɛɛ mfoninitwa, twaa nsɛm a esisi, dawurubɔ ahorow a wɔde hyɛ nkurɔfo nkuran ne nnwom video ahorow a wɔde too gua wɔ ɔman TV so. 

Ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ NKACC adwumakuw bi a Ghana kwankyerɛfo a wagye abasobɔde pii, Nana Kofi Asihene a ɔtetee no na ɔtetee no kosii n’adwuma mfiase sɛ video kwankyerɛfo no dea. Ɔtoo nnwom video maa nnwontofo a wɔreba no. 

Wɔtoo nsa frɛɛ no sɛ ɔne EL, Ghana nnwontofo/nnwom kyerɛwfo ne ɔyɛkyerɛfo a wagye abasobɔde pii no ntie album. EL maa Hafiz hokwan sɛ ɔnto nnwom video maa dwom bi a ɔde Ghana rap anansesɛm Obrafour  kaa ho na ɛno akyi no wɔyɛɛ adwuma boom wɔ nnwuma afoforo pii a ‘Kaa Bu Ame’ ka ho. 

Salifu Abdul Hafiz atow nwoma ne dawurubɔ a ɛfa nneɛma a wɔyɛ te sɛ USAID,  IDH,  Betway,  YES Ghana,  Decathlon,  Tullow Oil, CalBank  ne afoforo pii ho. 

Ɔakyerɛ nnwom video ahorow ama nnipa te sɛ Owura Eazi, EL, Sarkodie, Obrafour, Guru, Dobble, Maccasio, GuiltyBeatz, King Promise, Mugeez (R2Bees), Joey B, YPEE, Nana Yaa, Cent Remmy, IWAN, TheWord, . D-Flex, Teephlow, YPee ne afoforo pii.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Akosua Adoma Owusu
text:
Akosua Adoma Owusu (wɔwoo no Ɔbɛnem 1, 1984) yɛ Ghana-Amerika siniyɛfo ne ɔyɛfoɔ. Ne sini ahorow no hwehwɛ abibifo atubrafo a wɔwɔ Amerika no nipasu a ɛne wɔn ho wɔn ho bɔ abira mu denam akwan horow pii so fi sini mu nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw so kosi asɛm a wɔde sɔ hwɛ so kosi Abibifo nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a agye din a wɔasan ayɛ so. Bere a Owusu rekyerɛ adwene a ɛne sɛ " adwene abien ," a asetra ho ɔbenfo ne ɔmanfo hokwan ahorow ho ɔbenfo WEB Du Bois de bae no ase no, ɔde asi n'ani so sɛ ɔbɛbɔ sini mu ahunmu anaa nhumu a ɛto so abiɛsa . Wɔ n’adwuma mu no, feminism, queerness, ne Afrikafo nipasu di nkitaho wɔ Afrikafo, Amerikafo aborɔfo, ne Amerikafo abibifo amammerɛ mmeae.

Mprempren ɔyɛ Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo a Ɔsrasra Hɔ wɔ Harvard Sukuupɔn ne Pratt Asoɛe a ɛwɔ Brooklyn, New York.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Ghanafo awofo na wɔwoo Owusu na wɔtetee no wɔ atubrafo mpɔtam bi wɔ Alexandria, Virginia . Ɔyɛ Grace ne Albert A. Owusu nuanom baasa mu akumaa, Sr. Owusu wɔ master’s degrees wɔ School of Film/Video ne School of Fine Art wɔ California Institute of the Arts, a onyaa wɔ afe 2008  Ɔwiee sukuu no nyaa Bachelors interdisciplinary degree wɔ Media Studies  ne Studio Art mu a ɔnyaa soronko wɔ Virginia Suapɔn mu wɔ afe 2005.  Owusu hyɛɛ n’adwuma ase sɛ ɔyɛ post-production boafoɔ wɔ Chris Rock ’s HBO documentary  “ Good Hair ” (2009). Ɛno akyi bere tiaa bi no, ɔdan yɛɛ n’ankasa sini ntiantiaa a wɔsɔ hwɛ .

Adwuma 
Bere a Owusu wiee CalArts wɔ afe 2008 mu akyi bere tiaa bi no, na ɔyɛ mfoniniyɛfo a wɔagye din  wɔ Robert Flaherty Sini Nhyiam a ɛto so 56 a ɔkasatiafo ne sini sohwɛfo a wagye din Dennis Lim yɛɛ ho nhyehyɛe no mu.  Indiewire bɔɔ ne din sɛ Avant-Garde Mmea Siniyɛfo baanum a Wɔsan kyerɛkyerɛɛ Sini mu no mu biako, ne The Huffington Post ’s Black Artists no mu biako: Nnɛyi Adwinniyɛfo 30 a wonnii mfe 40 a Ɛsɛ sɛ Wohu, Owusu yɛ 2013 MacDowell Colony Fellow  ne 2015 Guggenheim Mfɛfo . 

Wɔ afe 2020 mu no, Owusu nyaa Lincoln Center Award for Emerging Artists  a Film wɔ Lincoln Center de maa no.  

Owusu a ɔtɔn “abirabɔ a emu yɛ den” a ɛfa abibifo, atutra ne nkae ho no, ɔsakra sini a wɔsɔ hwɛ, adwinni pa ne Afrikafo atetesɛm ntam a biribiara nhaw no sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ɔbɛbɔ sini ahorow a ɛyɛ nwonwa a ɛgye sɛnea obi te ho kyim .   

Ne “adwene a ɛreko” sɛnea ɔka ho asɛm no bɛyɛ nea efi ase ma ne sini Me broni ba (me ba fitaa).  Bere a ɔde ti nhwi di dwuma sɛ amammerɛ mu ade, hwehwɛ Afrikafo ne Afrikafo-Amerikafo nipasu ne wɔn adwene mu de bɔ mmɔden sɛ obesiesie wɔn ntam nsonsonoe.  Ed Halter, wɔn a wɔhyehyɛɛ Light Industry wɔ Brooklyn no mu biako kyerɛw Me Broni Ba sɛ 2010 sini du a ɛsen biara wɔ Artforum nsɛmma nhoma mu no mu biako.   

Ɔayɛ sini ahorow a wagye abasobɔde a Reluctantly Queer (2016) ne Kwaku Ananse ka ho. Wɔ afe 2013 mu no, Kwaku Ananse  nyaa Golden Bear nomination wɔ Berlinale  na onyaa 2013 Africa Movie Academy Award  maa West Africa man Ghana wɔ Best Short Film mu. Sini yi a Ghanani adwumfoɔ Jojo Abot dii mu akoten no, Focus Features’ Africa First,  na ɛboaa no, na ɛdii kan wɔ Amerika Atifi fam wɔ 2013 Toronto International Film Festival .  Wɔde Kwaku Ananse nso kaa 2013 Académie des Arts et Techniques du Cinéma - César Golden Nights, nhyehyɛe a wɔde mmoa a efi UNESCO hɔ a ɛpaw sini ntiantiaa a ɛda nsow hyehyɛe no ho.   

Reluctantly Queer (2016) a wɔne Dr. Kwame Edwin Otu yɛɛ adwuma boom yɛɛ no,  a ɔyɛ Ɔbenfoɔ Boafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Afrika Amerikafoɔ ne Afrikafoɔ Adesua so wɔ Virginia Suapɔn mu  na wɔyii no sɛ ɔmfa Golden Bear ne Teddy Award  wɔ afe 2016 Berlin Amanaman Ntam Sini Afahyɛ ase.  Ɛyɛɛ nea edi kan wɔ Amerika Atifi fam sɛ Akwankyerɛfo Foforo/Sini Foforo Afahyɛ no fa . 

Owusu kaa sɛ wɔ afe 2015 nsɛmbisa a ɔne South Africa's Elle (magazine), Owusu kaa sɛ "Me hyɛɛ aseɛ yɛɛ sini wɔ Ghana sɛ ɔkwan a mɛfa so anya baabi wɔ me Ghana agyapadeɛ mu." Metaa frɛ me ho sɛ Ghana-Amerikani, nanso mibu me ho sɛ Amerikani siniyɛfo a ofi Ghana. Sɛ mewɔ Amerika a, mete nka sɛ meyɛ Ghanafo paa na sɛ mewɔ Ghana a, mete nka sɛ Amerikani kɛse. Me ne me nnamfo a wofi Amerika fii ase tuu kwan kɔɔ Ghana sɛ wɔrebɛboa me wɔ ahodwiriw a ɛne sɛ midii abibifo ho dwuma wɔ Afrika ne Afrikafo a wɔatu akɔtra mmeae foforo no nyinaa mu. Ɔdɔ a mewɔ ma Afrika no nam ɔdɔ ho adwene a ɛfa asasepɔn no ho sɛ ofie a ɛretwɛn me mmae no so. Sini a wɔyɛ wɔ Ghana, yɛ akwantu yi fa."

Nneɛma a wɔboaboa ano daa 
N’adwuma no ka Whitney Tete Nneɛma Akorae a Ɛhwɛ Amerika Adwinni So,  Center Georges Pompidou,  ne Fowler Tete Nneɛma Akorae a ɛwɔ UCLA no nneɛma a wɔaboaboa ano daa no ho.

Rex Siniyɛbea 
Wɔ afe 2013 mu no, Owusu hyɛɛ wiase nyinaa Kickstarter nhyehyɛe bi ase sɛ ‘Save the Rex’!  Rex Cinema yɛ Ghana sinidan a akyɛ sen biara no mu biako. Wɔ bere a na amammui mu ahobammɔ nni Ghana wɔ 60, 70 ne 80 mfe no mu no, Adwinni no so tew. Wɔtoo sinidan ahorow no nyinaa mu wɔ asraafo atuatew ne bere a wɔbaraa wɔn fie akyi . Owusu hwehwɛɛ sɛ obegye Rex Cinema nkwa de akora sini adan so.  Wɔ afe 2016 mu no, Owusu yɛɛ screenplay a egyina ne wiase nyinaa ɔsatu a ɔde kɔmaa Save the Rex Cinema  wɔ Ghana wɔ Camargo Foundation wɔ Cassis, France.  Wɔ afe 2017 mu no, The Guardian de too gua sɛ Owusu reyɛ adwuma wɔ asetra mu sini a ne fã bi yɛ ayɛsɛm a ɛfa ne ɔsatu a ɔde bɛsan de abakɔsɛm mu Rex sini no aba ho.

Amanaman ntam nneɛma a wɔatumi ayɛ 
Wɔ afe 2015 mu no, Two films a Owusu kyerɛɛ no kwan na ɔyɛɛ no yɛ akasatiafo paw wɔ Artforum nsɛmma nhoma mu.

Owusu sini Reluctantly Queer yɛ akasatiafo sini a eye sen biara wɔ afe 2016 mu no mu biako wɔ Sight & Sound, sini nsɛmma nhoma a Britania Sini Asoɛe (BFI) tintim ɔsram biara 

Wɔ afe 2016 mu no, Britain ’s Royal African Society bɔɔ Owusu din sɛ wɔn Nnipa a Ɔsen Biara wɔ Nnawɔtwe no mu na South Africa Elle (nsɛmma nhoma) nso bɔɔ no din sɛ mmea 50 a wɔn ho yɛ nwonwa no mu biako.

Wɔ afe 2017 mu no, wɔbɔɔ ne din wɔ Dazed nsɛmma nhoma mu sɛ ɔyɛ siniyɛfo du a wɔsɔ hwɛ a wɔredi wiase nsɛmti akɛse ho dwuma no mu biako. 

Wɔ afe 2018 mu no, Cobo Center  hyɛɛ Owusu sɛ ɔnyɛ video a wɔde besisi Jefferson ne Washington akwan so wɔ Detroit, Michigan kuro no mfimfini wɔ Abibifoɔ Abakɔsɛm Ɔsram mu.
