title: Shirley Frimpong-Manso
text:
Shirley Frimpong-Manso (wɔwoo no 16 March 1977) yɛ Ghana sini kwankyerɛfo, ɔkyerɛwfo, ne ɔyɛkyerɛfo. Ɔno na ɔhyehyɛɛ Sparrow Productions, adwumakuw bi a wɔyɛ sini, television ne aguade ho dawurubɔ no kwankyerɛfo ne ne kwankyerɛfo panyin.  Ɔdii nkonim wɔ Ɔkwankyerɛfoɔ a Ɔsen Biara wɔ Africa Movie Academy Awards a ɛtɔ so 6 no mu .  Frimpong-Manso nso yɛ Sparrow Station, video a wɔde fa so ma Afrikafo anigyede a efi Sparrow ne Afrika siniyɛfo afoforo hɔ no panyin.  Wɔ afe 2013 mu no, wɔde no too onipa a ɔwɔ nkɛntɛnsoɔ kɛseɛ wɔ Ghana a ɔto so 48 sɛdeɛ E.tv Ghana kyerɛ no.

Wɔka Frimpong-Manso ho asɛm sɛ obi a "ɔhwehwɛ sɛ ɔbɛma siniyɛ gyinapɛn akɔ soro wɔ Ghana ne Afrika denam Afrikafo nsɛm a ɛkɔ so nkɔso a ɔka sɛnea wohu wɔ Afrikafo ani so no so."  Ɔkwan a wɔfaa so yɛɛ Ghana mfonini a wɔsakrae no nso kanyan no ma ɔpaw adwuma.  Wonim ne sini ahorow nso sɛ ɛyɛ "mmea a wɔyɛ katee,"  bere a ɛkyerɛ Afrika mmea a wɔwɔ ahofadi a wobetumi ayɛ adidifo na wɔatra ase a ɛyɛ den.   Wɔ December 2019 mu no, ne sini ' Potato Potahto ' fii ase streaming wɔ Netflix .

Asetra mu nsɛm 

Frimpong-Manso fi Kwahu Pepease a ɛwɔ Ghana Apuei Fam . Bere a na ɔyɛ abofra no ɔyɛɛ agodie ho nhyehyɛe, a "ɛte nka sɛ ɛyɛ anigye kɛse sen sɛ ɔde anhwea ne abofra bedi agoru." Owiee sukuu wɔ afe 2000 mu wɔ National Film and Television Institute a agye din sɛ NAFTI wɔ Ghana na ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ ɔyɛkyerɛfo wɔ Radio Gold, ankorankoro dwumadibea bi a ɛwɔ Accra, na afei ɔkɔɔ so fii Sparrow Productions ase wɔ afe 2003. 

Ne kunu ne ne yɔnko dwumayɛni ne Ken Attoh, na wɔbom wɔ abofra.

Adwuma 
Frimpong-Manso ne ɔyɛkyerɛfo ne odiyifo Juliet Asante, boa ma wɔyɛɛ TV so dwumadi a wɔfrɛ no Heart to Heart mfe abien wɔ sukuu akyi bere tiaa bi. Ɔsan nso ayɛ: 

Different Shades of Blue - television so dwumadi a ɛfa sukuupɔn mmeawa baanum a wɔkyɛ dan a wɔda mu wɔ sukuupɔn ahɔhodan mu ho.  

 Personalities Kitchen - aduannoa nhyehyeɛ a ɛgye nipasu mmienu na ɛtwa wɔn mpoa wɔ aburow aduane a wɔpɛ ho. 
 Miss Ghana Pageant - ɔwoo semifinalist mmienu wɔ Miss World event no mu wɔ mfeɛ anum mu wɔ ne berɛ mu.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Kuukua Eshun
text:
Kuukua Eshun yɛ Ghana-Amerika sini kwankyerɛfo, adwumfo ne ɔkyerɛwfo. Kuukua nam ne nkyerɛwee ne sini so ma nnipa te ase wɔ asetra mu nsɛm ne adwenemyare ho.  Ɔyɛ obi a ɔka wɔn a wɔhyehyɛɛ Boxedkids no ho.

Adwuma 
Kuukua sini a edi kan a wɔato din Artist, Act of Love nyaa abasobɔde wɔ wiase nyinaa mmea sini afahyɛ no ase wɔ nneɛma a wotumi hu a eye sen biara ho.  Ɔyɛ obi a ɔka wɔn a wɔhyehyɛɛ Skate Gal Club no ho.  Kuukua gye di sɛ mmarima ne mmea pɛyɛ a apiapia no ma wayɛ ɔsɔretia pii wɔ Accra mmɔnten so. Ɔne UNFPA Ghana yɛɛ biako yɛɛ ayaresa nhyiam maa mmabaa a wɔanya wɔn ti adidi mu wɔ nna mu ɔbrasɛe mu.

Nnansa yi ara Kuukua ne Nigeriani nnwontofo 

Kuukua nyaa ne nnansa yi documentary sini "Unveiling" a wɔde kyerɛe nea edi kan wɔ Museum Ostwall Im Dortmunder U wɔ Germany na wɔde kyerɛe wɔ tete nneɛma akorae kosii March 2022. ANO Institute of Arts & Knowledge na ɛhyɛɛ sini no na Kuukua na ɔyɛɛ na ɔkyerɛɛ sini no kwan.  yɛɛ adwuma baabi a ɔkyerɛɛ agoru bi kwan maa no.

Kuukua nso kyerɛɛ Nigerian Nnwontofoɔ Wizkid sini tiawa maa ne Made In Lagos album a wɔato din Made In Lagos Deluxe Film a woyii no adi wɔ December 2021 mu. Ɔne Wizkid boom kyerɛɛ sini tiawa yi kwan.

Abasobɔde ne agyede a wɔde ma 
Urbanworld Sini Afahyɛ Awieifo ma Mmabun Adebɔfo Showcase.

title: Nuotama Bodomo
text:
Nuotama Frances Bodomo (wɔwoo no afe 1988) yɛ Ghana sini yɛfo, ɔkyerɛwfo ne ɔkwankyerɛfo.

Asetra ho nsɛm ne adwuma 
Wɔwoo Bodomo wɔ Ghana, maa awofoɔ a wɔn mmienu nyinaa yɛ akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, Bodomo yɛ Dagaaba . Wɔtetee no nso wɔ Norway ne Hong Kong, ansa na ɔretu akɔ New York akɔsua sini wɔ Columbia Sukuupɔn mu, na owiee BA wɔ afe 2010 mu, ne NYU 's Tisch Film School (MFA) . Ne sini a edi kan, Boneshaker (2013), a Oscar nominee Quvenzhané Wallis, dii kan wɔ 2013 Sundance Sini Afahyɛ ase ansa na ɔredi wɔ SXSW, Pan African Film Festival, ne Lincoln Center’s African Film Festival.  Ne sini Afronauts (2014) nyaa ne U.S. sini a edi kan wɔ 2014 Sundance Sini Afahyɛ,  ne amanaman ntam sini a edi kan wɔ 2014 Berlin Amanaman Ntam Sini Afahyɛ,  na wɔde kaa ɔyɛkyerɛ "Dreamlands: Immersive Cinema and Art, 1905– 2016" wɔ Whitney Tete Nneɛma Akorae a Ɛhwɛ Amerika Adwinni So . 

Wɔbɔɔ no din sɛ Filmmaker nsɛmma nhoma "25 New Faces in Independent Film" no mu biako wɔ afe 2014. Ɔte New York Kuropɔn mu . 

Ɔkyerɛɛ ɔfã tiawa a wɔato din "Obiara Wu!" ma omnibus afã Collective: Unconscious (2016), a wɔdii kan yii wɔ 2016 SXSW Sini Afahyɛ ase. Ɛdii nkonim wɔ Best Experimental Short wɔ 2016 BlackStar Film Festival. Wɔ Film Quarterly, Po 1 mu no. 71, Number 2, wɔ Black Film dossier a wɔato din "Death Grips,"  a Michael Boyce Gillespie kyerɛwee mu no, Bodomo kyerɛkyerɛ ne 2016 sini fã Everybody Dies! . Wɔ afe 2018 mu no, na Bodomo yɛ ɔkyerɛwfoɔ ne ɔkwankyerɛfoɔ wɔ Random Acts of Flyness, HBO series a Terence Nance yɛeɛ.  

Mprempren Bodomo reyɛ Afronauts, a Sundance Institute, Tribeca Film Institute, IFP Emerging Storytellers nhyehyɛe, ne Alfred P Sloan Foundation boa no fa kɛse no ara.  

Bodomo yɛ afe 2019 United States Adwumfoɔ Fellow wɔ Film mu.

title: Yaba Badoe
text:
Yaba Badoe (wɔwoo no afe 1955) yɛ Ghana - Britania documentary film yɛfo, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo ne ɔkyerɛwfo.

Adwuma 
Wɔwoo Yaba Badoe wɔ Tamale, Ghana atifi fam .  Ɔfirii Ghana kɔsuaa adeɛ wɔ Britain wɔ ne mmofraase pɛɛ.  Ɔyɛ obi a wawie King's College, Cambridge, Badoe yɛɛ adwuma sɛ ɔman dwumayɛni wɔ Ministry of Foreign Affairs wɔ Ghana,  ansa na ɔrefi n'adwuma ase wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu sɛ obi a ɔretete no wɔ BBC .  Na ɔyɛ nhwehwɛmufo nso wɔ Afrika Adesua Asoɛe a ɛwɔ Ghana Sukuupɔn mu . Wakyerɛ ade wɔ Spain ne Jamaica na wayɛ adwuma sɛ ɔyɛkyerɛfo ne ɔkwankyerɛfo a ɔreyɛ nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw ama television dwumadibea atitiriw a ɛwɔ Britain no.  Nea ɔde ayɛ adwuma no bi ne: Black and White (1987), nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛe wɔ mmusuakuw ne mmusua mu nyiyim ho wɔ Bristol, a wɔde video mfoninitwa mfiri a ahintaw dii dwuma maa BBC1 ; I Want Your Sex (1991), adwinni ho kyerɛwtohɔ a ɛhwehwɛ mfonini ne anansesɛm ahorow a ɛfa abibifo nna ho wɔ Atɔe Famfo adwinni, nhoma, sini ne mfoninitwa mu, ma Channel 4 ; ne Voluntary Service Overseas a ɛwɔ afã asia a wɔde maa ITV wɔ afe 2002. 

Wɔ siniyɛ akyi no, Badoe yɛ adebɔ ho ɔkyerɛwfo, n'ayɛsɛm a edi kan, True Murder, a Jonathan Cape tintimii wɔ London wɔ afe 2009.  Bere a Zagba Oyortey resan ahwɛ True Murder mu wɔ The Africa Report mu no, ɔkaa ho asɛm sɛ “anwonwade, adehwere, adamfofa ne prescience a ɛyɛ fɛ a ɛyɛ den fi Ajuba, Afrikani abeawa bi a ɔdan fii ne fie a ɛyɛ fɛ wɔ Ghana kɔɔ sukuu a wɔtra mu wɔ England nkuraase akyi no adwene mu n'awofo aware a ɛhwee ase."  Wɔde n'asɛm tiawa "The Rivals" kaa nhoma a wɔaboaboa ano a wɔfrɛ no African Love Stories (Ayebia, 2006), a Ama Ata Aidoo na ɔhyehyɛɛ no ho.  Ɔakyerɛw mmofra nhoma abiɛsa nso. 

Badoe na ɔkyerɛɛ kwan na ɔne Amina Mama boom yɛɛ (ne Amina Mama ) sini a ɛfa nsɛm ho a wɔfrɛ no The Witches of Gambaga, a edii nkonim wɔ Nkyerɛwee a Ɛsen Biara wɔ Abibifo Amanaman Ntam Sini Afahyɛ mu wɔ afe 2010 mu, na wɔmaa no Nkonimdi a Ɛto so Abien wɔ Nkyerɛwee fã a ɛwɔ FESPACO 2011  Ne sini a ɔyɛe nnansa yi ara, a wɔde sii hɔ wɔ afe 2014 mu no, wɔato din The Art of Ama Ata Aidoo .  

Wɔ afe 2016 mu no, ɔde ne ho hyɛɛ "Yɛn Fie Ho Nsɛm a Yɛka: Nhwehwɛmu ne Afahyɛ a Ɛresakra Afrika ne Afrika-Atubrafoɔ Mpɔtam" mu wɔ Chapel Hill, NC. 

Ɔyɛ obi a ɔboaa 2019 nhoma a wɔaboaboa ano New Daughters of Africa, a Margaret Busby na ɔhyehyɛɛ no .

title: Leila Djansi
text:
Leila Afua Djansi yɛ Amerikani ne Ghana siniyɛfo a ɔhyɛɛ ne sini adwuma ase wɔ Ghana sini adwuma mu.

Mfitiase asetra 
Wɔwoo Leila Djansi sɛ Leila Afua Djansi wɔ afe July 17  Na ne papa yɛ wimhyɛnkafo na ne maame yɛ Ayarehwɛfo Panyin. Djansi nyinii wɔ India ne Ghana. Ɛwom sɛ na agodie ne akyerɛw yɛ n’anigyede de, nanso na n’adwuma ho ɔpɛ ne sɛ ɔbɛyɛ mmea ho ɔyaresafo, nhyehyɛe a akyiri yi ɛsakrae bere a n’ani begyee asɛnnibea ho nhwehwɛmu ho no . Bere a na wasiesie ne ho sɛ ɔbɛkɔ nsɛmmɔnedi ho adesua mu, adwuma mu nsakrae foforo bae bere a ohyiaa Ghana odiyifo Sam Odoi, na ɔmaa ogye dii sɛ ɔbɛkyerɛw nkyerɛwee ama no no. Na wadi mfeɛ 19 berɛ a Producer Akwetey Kanyi yɛɛ ne script Babina yɛɛ no sini.

Nwomasua 
Djansi kɔɔ Kabore Mfitiaseɛ ne JSS, Mawuli Sukuu a wɔde sua mfitiaseɛ, nkumaa ne ntoaso sukuu a ne nyinaa wɔ Ho, wɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

Ɔhyɛɛ ne sini adesua ase wɔ Ɔman Sini ne Television Sukuu, nanso ofii Ghana kɔɔ Amerika kɔtoaa ne Sini ne Television Abodin krataa so wɔ Savannah College of Art and Design wɔ adwinni Honors Scholarship so.

Adwuma 
Ghana Nhomakorabea Boayikuw Akenkanfo kuw no titrani mfe abiɛsa, ne tra wɔ adwuma no mu fii ase bere a na ɔto so abien wɔ ɔmantam ahoɔfɛ akansi bi mu wɔ afe 1998 mu.

Ɔfaa adwuma wɔ Socrates Safo Movie Africa Productions, faako a ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ Ɔkyerɛwfo/Line Producer. Bere a na ɔwɔ adwumakuw no mu no, ɔkyerɛw Ghana Gay/Lesbian hokwan ho sini a edi kan, The Sisterhood, sini a na Ghana sini so odiyifo a wawu Suzzy Williams ka ho. Djansi ne ɔman no Gama Film Company yɛɛ adwuma, faako a ɔkyerɛw na ɔyɛɛ Legacy of love .

Wɔ United States no, ɔhyehyɛɛ Turning Point Pictures, adwumakuw bi a ɛde ne ho a ɛyɛ sini ahorow a wɔde asi wɔn ani so sɛ wɔbɛyɛ sini ahorow a ɛfa asetra mu nsɛm ho.

Abasobɔde ne agyede a wɔde ma 
Wɔmaa Djansi sini a edi kan no afe 2009 worldFest Platinum Award; sini a wɔato din Grass Between My Lips, no yɛ mmea twetiatwa ne aware a wɔyɛ no ntɛm ho asɛm, a wɔyɛe wɔ Ghana kusuu fam akuraa bi ase.

</br> Wɔ afe 2010 mu no, wɔde ne dwumadi a edi kan, I Sing of a Well, too gua sɛ ɔnkɔ Afrika Sini Academy Awards 11 . Sini no nyaa abasobɔde 3: Nnyigyei a Ɛsen Biara, Atade a Ɛsen Biara ne Asɛnni Baguafo Abasobɔde Titiriw a Wɔde Ma Sini a Ɛsen Biara a Ɛsen Biara. Wɔ afe 2011 mu no, wɔde BAFTA/LA Pan African Film Festival Choice Award maa Djansi wɔ sini a wɔato din I Sing of a Well .

Djansi sini a ɔyɛe wɔ afe 2011 mu a wɔfrɛ no Sinking Sands nyaa African Movie Academy Award 10, na Ama K Abebrese nyaa Oyikyerɛfo a Ɔsen Biara Abasobɔde na Djansi nyaa Mfitiase Nkyerɛwee a Ɛsen Biara Abasobɔde. Wɔ Ghana Movie Awards a edi kan wɔ afe 2011 mu no, Djansi's Sinking Sands nyaa abasobɔde wɔ "Best Art Direction", "Best Costume", "Best West African Film" ne "Best Picture". Wɔpaw Sinking Sands wɔ akuw 14 mu.

Djansi mmɔdenbɔ a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa sɛ ɔyɛ ɔkwankyerɛfoɔ Ties That Bind nyaa Black Reel Awards Nomination wɔ afe 2012 mu. Sini no nso dii nkonim wɔ Diaspora sini a eye sen biara wɔ 2012 San Diego Black Film Festival ase .

Wɔ afe 2016 mu no, Djansi kyerɛɛ Like Cotton Twines, nhwehwɛmu a ɛfa Trokosi adeyɛ ho wɔ ne kurom Ghana. Wɔpaw sini no sɛ "Wiase Ayɛsɛm Sini a Ɛsen Biara" wɔ Los Angeles Sini Afahyɛ ase . 

Djansi adwuma ne mmoa a ɔde ama wɔ Ghana sini adwuma mu no, UNiFEM Ghana, The African Women Development Fund, The Ghana Musicians Association ne mpɔtam afoforo a wɔdwene asetena mu nsɛm ho no agye atom.

title: Mansa Nettey
text:
Mansa Nettey yɛ Ghana sikakorabea panyin. Ɔno ne ɔbea panyin a odi kan a Standard Chartered Bank of Ghana paw no .  Awuraa a wogyaee no no. Mansa Nettey bedi Owura Kweku Bedu-Addo a wɔapaw no sɛ CEO, South Africa & Southern Africa ananmu, a ɛgyina mpɔtam hɔ pene a ɛfa ho a wɔanya. Nsɛm a wɔayi no adi no faa Bola Adesola asɛm kae sɛ: "Ɛyɛ me anigye sɛ mɛma Mansa akwaaba sɛ ɔbea CEO a odi kan ma Standard Chartered Bank wɔ Ghana." Ne nimdeɛ a ɛtrɛw ne nhumu a emu dɔ a ɔwɔ wɔ gua so no bɛma Ghana adwuma no anya nkɔso bio. Mepɛ sɛ meda Kweku ase wɔ ne akanni wɔ Ghana adwuma mu wɔ mfeɛ nsia a atwam no mu na mepɛ sɛ ɔyɛ yie wɔ ne dwumadie foforɔ no mu".  Sɛ n’adwuma no fã bi no, Ɔbɛbɔ amanneɛ tẽẽ akyerɛ Bola Adesola CEO, Nigeria ne West Africa.  Ɔnyaa ne ntoaso sukuu adesua wɔ Achimota Sukuu mu ansa na ɔrekyerɛw ne din sɛ ɔbɛnya abodin krataa a ɛdi kan wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so baabi a ɔpuee sɛ nnuruyɛfoɔ ne ne master’s degree wɔ Manchester Adwumayɛ Sukuu  Awuraa. Nettey wɔ bɛboro mfeɛ 19 osuahu wɔ sikakorabea adwumayɛ mu na wayɛ adwuma akɛseɛ ahodoɔ wɔ nnwumakuo ne ahyehyɛdeɛ sikakorabea.  Ɔka Standard Chartered Bank Nigeria Limited adwumakuo no ho na ɔka Standard Chartered Bank Ghana Limited adwumakuo no ho sɛ adwumayɛfoɔ panin.  Ɔno na ɔhyehyɛɛ Leukemia Project Foundation a ɛwɔ Ghana. Wɔde sii hɔ bere a ɔne mogya mu nkwammoaa ko tiaa mfe bi akyi.

Nwomasua 
Mansa Nettey yɛ alumna wɔ Achimota Sukuu ne Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so wɔ Ghana baabi a onyaa ne abodin krataa a edi kan. Afei onyaa ne MBA wɔ Manchester Adwumayɛ Sukuu mu.

Adwuma 
Ofii ne sikakorabea adwuma ase sɛ Standard Chartered Bank abusuabɔ sohwɛfo . Na ɔyɛ amannɔne sika tɔn so panyin wɔ Ghana ne Afrika Atɔe fam nyinaa  Na ɔsan nso yɛ sikasɛm gua so panyin wɔ Ghana Ɔyɛ Standard Chartered Bank of Ghana board no kwankyerɛfo panyin na ɔnyɛ obi a ɔnyɛ ɔyɛ Standard Chartered Bank of Nigeria bagua no kwankyerɛfo panyin. Wɔ afe 2017 mu no, wɔpaw no sɛ Standard Chartered Bank adwumayɛfo panyin, na ɛno ne ne dwumadi mprempren.

Abasobɔde ne nea wɔatumi ayɛ 
Owurayere. Nettey dii adetɔnfoɔ kuo bi anim ma wɔmaa sikasɛm mu gua a ɛwɔ Ghana no nyaa nkɔsoɔ  Bere a Mansa Nettey ne mogya mu kokoram dii ako mfeɛ bi akyi no, ɔhyehyɛɛ Leukemia Project Foundation wɔ Ghana.

title: Elizabeth Frances Sey
text:
Elizabeth Frances Baaba Sey ( woo Biney ) (Ayɛwohomumɔ 21, 1927 – 1991)  yɛ ɔbaa a ɔdi kan a ɔwiee Ghana Suapɔn . Bere a ɔkɔɔ Achimota Ntoaso Sukuu a ɛwɔ Accra,  no, wogyee no kɔɔ nea saa bere no na wɔfrɛ no University College of the Gold Coast, mprempren Ghana Sukuupɔn, wɔ afe 1950 mu na owiee sukuu no nyaa BA abodin krataa wɔ afe 1953.

Bere a owiee sukuu no ɔbɛyɛɛ Nhomasua sohwɛfo maa Sekondi . Na ɔyɛ Engiresi kasa Dwumadibea no Titenani wɔ Achimota Sukuu mu kosii sɛAmanaman ogyaee adwuma wɔ 1987 mu. Bio nso, ɔyɛɛ Ghana  Ntam Sukuu no Aban Bagua no mu kosii sɛ owui.  Ɔkyerɛɛ ade wɔ sukuu ahorow bi mu a Wesley Girls’ High School, Cape Coast ; Saint Louis Ntoaso Sukuu a ɛwɔ Kumasi ; ne Achimota Sukuu a ɛwɔ Accra no.  Ghana Suapɔn too atraeɛ dan a ɛwɔ adan 400 din Elizabeth Sey Hall wɔ afe 2011 mu, de hyɛɛ no anuonyam de kaee ne mmoa a ɔde maa sukuu no.  

Na ne kunu ne Samuel Sey, Barclays Bank Ghana Limited no Titenani na ɔsan yɛ Ghana Suapɔn Bagua no Titenani. Owui wɔ 10 Ayɛwohomumɔ 1991. Wɔwoo mma baanu.

title: Abibata Shanni Mahama Zakariah
text:
Wɔwoo Abibata Shanni Mahama Zakariah wɔ Yendi na ɔyɛ Alhaji Shanni Mahama babea, a na ɔyɛ kan MP ma Yendi Constituency ne Ɔmanpanyin Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Kuadwuma so wɔ kan ɔmanpanyin K. A. Busia aban mu.  Wɔpaw no sɛ Deputy CEO of the Microfinance and Small Loans Center (MASLOC) wɔ afe 2017 mu na wɔmaa no so kɔɔ dibea a ɛyɛ substantive Chief Executive wɔ September 2021 mu bere a n’adwumawura ntɛm ara, Stephen Amoah, fii hɔ kɔhyɛɛ adwuma ase sɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni ma Nhyiaso Constituency.

Ankorankoro asetra ne nhomasua 
Ɔkɔɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu baabi a ɔnyaa Bachelor of Arts abodin krataa wɔ Adwene ne Nneyɛe Ho Adesua mu. Ɔsan nso wɔ Master of Public Policy and Administration (MPPA) abodin krataa wɔ School of International and Public Affairs (SIPA) a ɛwɔ Columbia Sukuupɔn mu wɔ New York City a ɔde n’adwene si Sikasɛm ne Amanyɔsɛm mu Nkɔso so. 

Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baanan.

Adwuma 
Ɔyɛ Ghana Sikakorabea sohwɛfo, nhyehyɛe ho dwumayɛni, adwumayɛ nkɔso ho nhyehyɛe ho ɔbenfo ne ɔmanyɛfo.  Ɔwɔ adwumayɛ mu suahunu pii firi mpɔtam hɔ ne amanaman ntam ahyehyɛdeɛ ahodoɔ te sɛ Agricultural Development Bank (Ghana), The Millennium Cities Initiative – MCI a wɔne Earth Institute of Columbia University (Accra, Ghana), Consultancy for The Capacity Development Group (UNDP, 2019) ayɛ adwuma abom. New York), Merchant Bank Ghana Limited (Accra, Ghana) ne Jospong Nnwumakuw Kuw (Accra, Ghana). 

Ansa na afe 2020 amansan abatoɔ no reba no, ɔsii akan sɛ ɔbɛgyina n’apam, New Patriotic Party ananmu sɛ wɔn mmarahyɛ bagua kandifoɔ ma Yendi mantam no. Ɔhweree Farouk Aliu Mahama a ɔyɛ kan Ɔmampanyin Abadiakyiri a wawu Alhaji Aliu Mahama babarima .

title: Moesha Buduong
text:
Moesha Buduong yɛ Ghana TV so ɔyɛkyerɛfo, odiyifo ne mfoniniyɛfo a wonim no nso sɛ ɔmaa CNN amanneɛbɔfo Christiane Amanpour nsɛmbisa a akyinnyegye wom wɔ nna, ɔdɔ ne ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ho nsɛm ho.

Akyinnyegye 
Wɔ April 2018 mu no, Buduong baa ɔkasatia ase fii Ghanafo hɔ . wɔ nsɛm a akyinnyegye wom a obisabisaa CNN amanneɛbɔfo Christiane Amanpour ho . Wɔ nsɛmbisa no mu no, Buduong kaa sɛ Ghana mmaa de mmarima di dwuma sɛ wɔn sika titire, ɛfiri sɛ sikasɛm mu yɛ den. Wɔnam nna a wɔne mmarima no nya so na ɛyɛ eyi. Wɔfa ne asɛm kae sɛ "Wɔ Ghana no, yɛn sikasɛm yɛ ɔkwan bi a enti wuhia obi a ɔbɛhwɛ wo." Worentumi nnya sika a ɛdɔɔso sɛ ɔbea wɔ ha. Efisɛ sɛ wopɛ sɛ wonya dan mpo a, wɔ Ghana no wogye mfe abien advance na mehyɛɛ adwuma ase nkyɛe ɛhe na mɛnya sika de atua?" Ne nsɛm no nyaa ɔkasatia a emu yɛ den fii mmarima ne mmea nyinaa hɔ a wɔtee nka sɛ ɔreyɛ Ghana (ne sɛ yɛbɛtrɛw mu a, Afrikafo) mmea ho mfonini a enye. Nnipa a wɔagye din te sɛ John Dumelo, Lydia Forson, Eazzy, DKB ne Afia Odo kaa wɔn adwene wɔ Twitter, a wɔn mu dodow no ara yɛ nea enye. 

Nnipa afoforo nso tee nka sɛ ɔkasatia no nyɛ nea ɛfata, efisɛ nsɛm a wɔkae no yɛ nea ɛkyerɛ sɛnea Ghanafo asetra yɛ nokware. Radio so ɔhwɛfo Captain Smart kamfoo no na ɔsrɛɛ Ghanafo sɛ wɔmmɔ no nsam sɛ ɔka nokware.  

Christine Amanpour ankasa asrɛ ɔmanfoɔ sɛ mma wɔnnhyɛ Buduong aniwuo, na wafrɛ Ɔmanpanyin, Nana Akufo-Addo ne Gender Minister Otiko Afisa Djaba sɛ wɔmmoa no. Amanpour kae sɛ, "Mepɛ sɛ nkurɔfo hu hokwan a Moesha wɔ sɛ ɔkasa ne akokoduru a ɔdaa no adi denam n'ankasa asetra ho nsɛm a ɛbɛn saa a ɔkae no so." Sɛ́ ɔbea ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo no, ɛyɛ me yaw na me bo fuw sɛ mahu ɔbea a ne ho nni asɛm saa a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo ne nnipa pii kasa tia no wɔ sohyial media so wɔ saa kwan yi so. Ɛduruu baabi a Moesha nnim sɛ ɔbɛtumi asan akɔ Ghana dwoodwoo. Ɛyɛ me nwonwa yiye sɛ mahu sɛ eyi rekɔ so wɔ Accra, kurow a ɛfata sɛ wɔde adwene asi so kɛse nnansa yi esiane sɛ ɛyɛ Afrika ahenkurow a edi mu sen biara wɔ sikasɛm ne amammuisɛm mu no mu biako nti. Nokwarem no, ɛhyɛɛ me nkuran bere a na mewɔ Accra, tiee ɔkasa bi a Ɔmampanyin no ankasa mae, na ɔbɔɔ hokwan a nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔde wɔn ho wɔ sɛ wɔbɔ amanneɛ koraa, pɛpɛɛpɛ na wɔyɛ no yiye no ho ban."  

Akyiri yi Buduong paa kyɛw wɔ baguam.

Akyinnyegye a ɛfa akyinnyegye ho 
Nnipa pii tee nka sɛ Buduong adwene a akyinnyegye wom no fi agyanom mpanyimfo nniso a abu so wɔ aman pii mu nnɛ, titiriw wɔ Ghana no.

Amanpor nso bisabisaa Ghanani bi nsɛm wɔ asɛmti korɔ no ara a ɔbisabisaa Buduong nsɛm wɔ ho. Ɔkaa nokwasɛm a ɛyɛ sɛ wadi nokware ama ne hokafo esiane ne sikasɛm tebea ketewaa nti no ho asɛm, na ɔde kaa ho sɛ nea ɛnte sɛ ɔno no, nnipa a wɔn sikasɛm yɛ den no tumi tɔ ahokafo pii.  Nanso, wanka n’adwenkyerɛ ahorow no ho asɛm biara. Nnipa pii  tee nka sɛ eyi yɛ gyinapɛn abien, efisɛ wɔte nka sɛ wɔn ho tɔ wɔn kɛse wɔ adwene a ɛtete saa ho bere a efi mmarima hɔ, a ɛne bere a efi mmea mu bɔ abira.

Adɔe adwuma 
Wɔ ne Moesha Foundation ase no, ɔne Billaw Mfitiase Sukuu a ɛwɔ Upper East Region, faako a ne kurom wɔ no asuafo dii n’awoda a ɛto so 29 no. Ɔde sukuu bag, nhoma ne adesua nneɛma afoforo a ɛfa ho mae.

title: Halutie Hor
text:
Halutie Hor (wɔwoo no 4 Ayɛwohomumɔ 1999) yɛ Ghana mmirikatufo a ɔfiri Nmanduonu wɔ Upper West Region 

Ɔsii akan wɔ 2018 Commonwealth Agumadi no mu wɔ mita 100 ne mita 4x100 relay nyinaa mu .  Wɔ mita 100 mmirikatu mu no Hor fatae sɛ ɔkɔɔ nea etwa to a ɔde bere 11.54 wiee nea ɛto so awotwe no sikani, 0.44 wɔ sikɔne akyi wɔ Michelle-Lee Ahye a ofi Trinidad ne Tobago a onyaa sika kɔkɔɔ nkonimbo no akyi .

Wɔ mita 4x100 relay mu no na ɔka Ghana kuw bi a wɔfatae kɔ nea etwa to a wɔde bere 43.64 wiee nea ɛto so anum no ho sikani.

title: Juliet Appiah
text:
Juliet Appiah (wɔwoo no afe 1989) yɛ Ghana fekuw bɔɔlbɔ ɔtemmufo wɔ Ghana Premier League . Ɔyɛ Ghana polisini ne FIFA ɔtemmufo.  Afe 2018 mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ obi a odi kan wɔ Ghana Polisifo Dwumadibea a wɔmaa no FIFA tumi krataa sɛ ɔtemmufo.

FIFA ɔtemmufo 
Wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2018 mu no, Ghana Bɔɔlbɔ Fekuw no nyaa tumi krataa fii FIFA hɔ maa Ghanafo asɛnnibea 22 a na wɔabisa amanaman ntam atemmufo tumi krataa. Juliet Appiah bɛyɛɛ Ghana polisini a odi kan a ɔyɛ ɔbarima anaa ɔbea a wɔmaa no FIFA refereeing badge. 

Bere a ne nsa kaa ne badge no, wɔyɛɛ guasodeyɛ tiawa bi wɔ Ghana Polisifo adwumayɛbea ti.  Nkyerɛkyerɛmu no fa ananmusifoɔ bi a wɔfiri Ghana Bɔɔlbɔ Fekuo mu a wɔde Juliet Appiah nkɔsoɔ no too gua wɔ aban kwan so kyerɛɛ Polisifoɔ Panyin (IGP). Na Ghana Bɔɔlbɔ Fekuw no mfiridwuma kwankyerɛfo, Francis Oti Akenteng ne Ghana Mmea Kuw Boayikuw no guamtrani Linear Addy wɔ hɔ wɔ guasodeyɛ no mu. IGP, David Asante-Apeatu, tuu Juliet Appiah fo sɛ ɔnkura nokwaredi a ɛkorɔn sen biara mu wɔ bɔɔlbɔ abɔnten ne akyi.

Ɔpanyin a wɔyɛ 
Juliet Appiah ayɛ ɔhwɛfoɔ wɔ agodie ahodoɔ bi mu wɔ Ghana bɔɔlbɔ kuo no fã a ɛtɔ so mmienu no mu.  N’ahokokwaw a ɔde di agoru ahorow ho dwuma no bi anya nkamfo afi fekuw ahorow mpanyimfo hɔ.

GFA Atemmufoɔ Boayikuo a ɛpaw Appiah sɛ ɔnyɛ ɔhwɛfoɔ wɔ agodie da a ɛtɔ so 11 a ɛbɛkɔ so wɔ Dreams FC ne Inter Allies ntam wɔ Dawu . Ɔdii dwuma wɔ ne Ghana Premier League akansi a ɛdi kan no mu berɛ a agodie no hyɛɛ aseɛ Dwoda May 2, 2018.  Wɔtaa bu ne dwumadi no sɛ ɛyɛ nea wɔkyekyem pɛpɛɛpɛ efisɛ wobuu ne gyinaesi ahorow pii wɔ agorudi no mu sɛ ɛyɛ akyinnyegye.  Wɔ agodie no mu no ɔdii mfomso de asotwe maa fie kuw no bere a bɔɔl no bɔɔ Inter Allies agodini bi hwene akyi.

Nidi a wɔde ma 

 Ɔtemmufoɔ a ɔhyɛ bɔ kɛseɛ – 2015 MTN FA Cup Awards. 
 Ɔbea polisini a odi kan a ɔhwɛɛ Ghana Premier League akansi bi so.

title: Dzodzi Tsikata
text:
Dzodzi Tsikata yɛ Ghanani ɔbea ho ɔbenfo, nhomanimfo, ɔbenfo wɔ Development Sociology ne Director of Institute of African Studies (IAS) wɔ Ghana Sukuupɔn mu .

Asetra mu nsɛm 
Dzodzi Tsikata yɛ ɔbenfo wɔ Institute of Statistical Social and Economic Research a ɛwɔ Ghana Sukuupɔn mu . N’anigyeɛ wɔ adesua mu bi ne mmarima ne mmaa ne nkɔsoɔ Nsɛm, mmarima ne mmaa pɛyɛ ho nhyehyɛeɛ ne nneyɛeɛ. Wɔpaw no wɔ June 2015 mu sɛ Council for the Development of Social Science Research in Africa ( CODESRIA ) no titrani wɔ wɔn amansan nhyiamu a ɛtɔ so 14 wɔ Senegal.

Nhwehwɛmu a n’ani gye ho nso bi ne mpɔtam hɔ akuafo a wɔyɛ adwuma wɔ apam mu a nnwumakuw akɛse mfuw a wɔtaa kyerɛ sɛ ɛwɔ "abusuabɔ kakraa bi" wɔ aman a wɔyɛ adwuma wɔ mu no sikasɛm mu no de wɔn di dwuma. Dzodzi Tsikata ne nhwehwɛmufo a wofi Sussex Sukuupɔn ne Western Cape Sukuupɔn mu nyaa sika fii Sikasɛm ne Asetra mu Nyansahu Nhwehwɛmu Bagua no hɔ de hwehwɛɛ mfaso ne ɔhaw ahorow a ɛwɔ kuayɛ ho nhwɛso ahorow a wɔde di gua so wɔ Afrika.

Efi August 2016,  ɔyɛ Afrika adesua Asoɛe a ɛwɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu no kwankyerɛfo. Ɔyɛ obi a ɔkamfo aware a wodi kan wɔ Ghana mpɔtam hɔ, a mprempren ɛma mmeawa nkyem anan mu biako ware ansa na wɔadi mfe dunan.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Grace Amey-Obeng
text:
Grace Amey-Obeng yɛ Ghana adwumayɛfo na ɔhyehyɛɛ Forever Clair ahoɔfɛ nneɛma.

Asetra mu nsɛm 
Grace Amey-Obeng yɛ Forever Clear Group of companies no a ɔhyehyɛɛ ne adwumayɛfo panyin. Wɔ November 2017 mu no, ɔgyinaa hɔ na wɔpaw no sɛ adwumayɛfo panin na ɔkuraa dibea sɛ Ɔman Sikakorafoɔ wɔ Association of Ghana Industries, Ghana ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛnyɛ aban de a ɛyɛ adwumayɛkuo a wɔfiri wɔn pɛ mu a emufoɔ bɛboro 1200 a wɔayi wɔn afiri nketewa, mfimfini ne akɛseɛ mu scale nnwuma ahorow. 

Sɛ́ adwumayɛfo no, Amey-Obeng si hia a ehia sɛ "adwumakuw adɔeyɛ... sɛ ɔkwan a etu mpɔn, ɛyɛ nhyehyɛe na ɛtra hɔ daa a wɔfa so de mmoa a ɛho hia ma wɔ mmeae atitiriw a wohia" so dua. Wɔ afe 2017 mu no, ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ board chairperson maa Universal Merchant Bank Foundation a wɔhyehyɛɛ no sɛ ɔkwan a wɔfa so de nneɛma san ma Ghana man no.  

Wɔ May 2017 mu no, wɔhyɛɛ no anuonyam wɔ Ghana Mmea a Wɔsen Biara wɔ Afe no mu Nidi ho dwumadi a ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ "Adwuma mu Nkɔsoɔ mu".   

Amey-Obeng yɛ guamtrani ma Ghana Cosmetology and Wellness Federation, ahyehyɛde bi a wɔde adwumayɛkuw a efi Ghana Ministry of Trade and Industry ne Ministry of Tourism, Culture and Creative Arts, na ɛboaa fekuw ahorow a ɛwɔ cosmetology ne wellness adwumayɛ mu "to." bɔ wɔn a wɔboa wɔn no akwahosan ho ban"

title: Gifty Acheampong
text:
Gifty Acheampong (wɔwoo no 5 Ɔbɛnem 1999) yɛ Ghana mmaa bɔɔlbɔ anim . Ɔdii agorɔ wɔ Turkey Mmea League a Edi Kan mu maa 1207 Antalya Döşemealtı Belediye Spor a na ne jersey nɔma 19. Ná ɔyɛ Ghana mmea U-17 kuw no muni .

Mfitiase asetra 
Wɔwoo Gifty wɔ Koforidua, wɔ Ghana Apuei Fam wɔ 5 Ɔbɛnem 1999.  

N’awofo gyaw no hɔ a na onnim wɔn, na aguadifo nketewa awarefo Acheapong gyee no yɛɛ ne ba bere a na wadi ɔsram biako pɛ no. Ɔhweree ne papa wɔ ne mmofraase, na nneɛma mu yɛɛ den. Ne maame a ɔtetee no na ɔtetee no wɔ ne sukuu mfe mu. Nanso, na ɛsɛ sɛ ogyae ntoaso sukuu efisɛ na ne maame ntumi ntua ne keep bio. Ɔyɛɛ n’adwene sɛ ɔde n’adwene besi bɔɔlbɔ so sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a obenya sika de ahwɛ ne ho na waboa ne maame wɔ sika fam.

Club adwuma 
Acheampong fii ase bɔɔ bɔɔl dedaw bere a na wadi mfe du wɔ mpɔtam hɔ kuw Koforidua Gartel SC mu. Afei otu kɔɔ Accra, faako a ɔde ne ho kɔbɔɔ Immigration Ladies FC.  Akyiri yi ɔde ne ho bɔɔ Samaria Ladies mprempren Thunder Queens wɔ afe 2018 mu, faako a ɔsom sɛ kurow no panyin fi afe 2019 kosi afe 2020.

Efi December 2017 no, na 1.63 m (5.) a ft 4 na ɛyɛ in) -tall forward tu kɔɔ Turkey kɔkaa 1207 Antalya Döşemealtı Belediyespor ho sɛ ɔrekɔbɔ wɔ Turkey Mmea Bɔɔlbɔ Kuw a Edi Kan no mu .  Wɔ Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 2020 mu no, ɔde ne nsa hyɛɛ NWFL Premiership kuw, Rivers Angels FC  ase.

Amanaman ntam adwuma 
Ná Acheampong yɛ Ghana mmea ɔman bɔɔlbɔ kuw a wonnii mfe 17 no muni . Ɔde ne ho hyɛɛ 2016 FIFA U-17 Mmea Wiase Kupɔn - Kuw D a wɔyɛe wɔ Jordan no mu nhyiam anan mu, na ɔbɔɔ bɔɔl abien a ne nyinaa yɛ abiɛsa.

title: Selase Agbenyefia
text:
Selase Agbenyefia anaa Selase Yaaya Agbenyefia (wɔwoo no afe 1978) yɛ ɔsraani panyin wɔ Ghana Wim Asraafoɔ mu na ɔbɛyɛɛ Ghanani ɔbaa helikopta wimhyɛnkafoɔ a ɔdi kan.

Abrabɔ 
Wɔwoo Agbenyefia afe 1978 na afe 1989 ɔhyɛɛ aseɛ wɔ Mawuko Girls Secondary School. Mfe abien akyi no na ɔwɔ Mawuli Ntoaso Sukuu mu . Ɔyɛɛ BSc wɔ Adwumayɛ mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu, na ɔwiee sukuu wɔ afe 2009 mu. Agbenyefia nso wɔ Postgraduate Certificate wɔ Ɔman Adwumayɛ mu wɔ Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration.

Ná Agbenyefia anya ɔpɛ soronko a ɛne sɛ ɔbɛyɛ wimhyɛnkafo. Ɔde akwammisa krataa kɔe sɛ ɔmmɛka wimhyɛn asraafoɔ ho nanso berɛ a ɔne wɔn a wɔagye no afoforɔ no baeɛ no ɔhunuu sɛ wɔde no akɔ sraadi. Ɔne Ɔsahene Panyin Joseph Narh Adinkra twaa eyi mpoa na wɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ wimhyɛn asraafo no nnye mmea. Ɔkasa tiaa eyi na wonyaa ne pintinnyɛ no so ka bere a wɔde no ne afoforo a na wɔpɛ sɛ wɔyɛ wimhyɛnkafo kɔe sɛ wɔnkɔtete no no.

Wɔtew wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔpaw wɔn no so kɔɔ 20 na afei wɔtew wɔn so kɔɔ 15 bere a na wɔwɔ Ghana Asraafo Sukuu a ɛwɔ Teshie wɔ Accra no . Ne wimhyɛn a edi kan no wɔ Aero L-29 Delfín Jet Trainer a ɔne Air Commodore Philip Ayisa dii kan tu wɔ September 1998.  Na mmea a wɔyɛ wimhyɛnkafo wɔ Ghana pɛn nanso wɔn baanu a wɔyɛɛ wimhyɛn ampa no kɔhyɛɛ pɛnhyen wɔ 1966 atuatew no akyi wɔ Ghana, enti ɔno na odii kan mfe 35, wɔka sɛ ɔno ne ɔbea a odi kan a ɔde asraafo helikopta tu mmirika wɔ Afrika Atɔe fam mfe 48 . 

Wɔ afe 2015 mu no, wɔde ho anuonyam mae sɛ ɔgyee President John Mahama nkwa berɛ a ɔsii fam a wɔanhyɛ da.

Wimhyɛn mu Osuahu 

 Rating: Ahyɛde Pilot
 Nnɔnhwerew a wɔde tu kwan: bɛboro 1800
 Wimhyɛn: Aero L-29 Delfín, AgustaWestland AW109, Bell 412 ne Mil Mi-17 .

title: Marthe Eféwélé Kwami
text:
Marthe Eféw Kélé Kwami yɛ Ghana kyerɛwfo a wɔwoo no wɔ Accra, Gold Coast wɔ afe 1896 mu. Ná n’asetra ho asɛm no yɛ nkyerɛwee a edi kan a Afrikani bea bi kyerɛwee no mu biako. Wɔkyerɛwee wɔ Ewe kasa mu nanso wodii kan tintimii wɔ German kasa mu wɔ afe 1938 mu wɔ Afrikaner erzhählen ihr Leben (Afrikafo ka wɔn asetra) a Diedrich Westermann kyerɛwee, Afrikafo kurom hɔfo ho mfonini dumien a wɔaboaboa ano.

title: Ayorkor Korsah
text:
G. Ayorkor Korsah (kan no na wɔfrɛ no G. Ayorkor Mills-Tettey ) yɛ Kɔmputa Nyansahu Dwumadibea a ɛwɔ Ashesi Sukuupɔn mu wɔ Ghana no panyin .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Korsah yɛɛ mfiridwuma ho adesua titiriw wɔ Dartmouth College, na owiee sukuu no summa cum laude wɔ June 2003 mu. Ɔkɔɔ Carnegie Mellon Suapɔn mu maa ne doctoral adwuma wɔ kɔmputa nyansahu mu,  onyaa PhD wɔ afe 2011 mu maa n'asɛmti, "Exploring bounded optimal coordination for heterogeneous teams with cross-schedule dependencies".

Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo a Ɔsrasra, Ashesi Sukuupɔn Kɔmputa Nyansahu Dwumadibea, Accra, Ghana

title: Jane E. Clerk
text:
Jane Elizabeth Clerk (26 May 1904 – 5 July 1999) yɛ Gold Coast sukuu kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ ne ɔman nwomasua sohwɛfoɔ .  Wɔ atubrafo bere so no, na ɔka mmea akyerɛkyerɛfo akwampaefo awo ntoatoaso a edi kan a awiei koraa no wɔbɛyɛɛ aban sukuu akɛse mpanyimfo no ho.  Saa bere no mu no, na Jane Clerk yɛ Aban Mmabaa Mfinimfini Sukuu a ɛwɔ Kumasi no Sukuu Panyin .

Asetra mu nsɛm

Mfitiase asetra ne abusua 
Wɔwoo Jane Elizabeth Clerk wɔ Adawso wɔ Apuei Fam Mantam mu wɔ 26 May 1904 maa Nicholas Timothy Clerk (1862 –1961) ne Anna Alice Meyer (1873 –1934).  Ná Jane Clerk yɛ mmofra akron no mu nea ɔto so ason, na na ɔyɛ awo ntoatoaso a ɛto so abiɛsa a ɔyɛ Clerk abusua a ɛda nsow wɔ abakɔsɛm mu a ɛwɔ Accra no muni.   Na ne papa yɛ Basel ɔsɛmpatrɛwfo, na ɔyɛ Synod Ɔkyerɛwfo a odi kan wɔ Presbyterian Asɔre a ɛwɔ Gold Coast no mu fi 1918 kosi 1932 na ɔyɛ agya a ɔhyehyɛɛ mmarimaa ntoaso sukuu a wɔde mmofra kɔtra mu, Presbyterian Mmarimaa Ntoaso Sukuu, a wɔde sii hɔ wɔ afe 1938    [8]  Ne maame, Anna Alice Meyer, a ɔyɛ ofiehwɛfo ne ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo, yɛ Ga-Danish abusua mu, a ne wɔfase ne Emmanuel Charles Quist (1880 – 1959), mmaranimfo ne ɔtemmufo a ɔbɛyɛɛ nea odi kan Afrikani Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no so fi afe 1949 kosi afe 1951, ɔyɛ Ɔman Bagua no Kasafo fi afe 1951 kosi afe 1957 na ɔyɛɛ Ghana Ɔman Bagua no Kasafo a odi kan fi March 1957 kosi November 1957.   Jane Clerk agya nana, Alexander Worthy Clerk (1820-1906), Jamaica Moravia ɔsɛmpatrɛwfo bi duu Denmark Protectorate of Christiansborg (mprempren Osu kurotia ) wɔ Accra, wɔ 1843 mu, sɛ mfitiase kuw a na wɔyɛ West India asɛmpatrɛwfo 24 a yɛɛ adwuma wɔ Basel Asɛmpaka Asɛmpatrɛwfo Kuw a ɛwɔ Switzerland no akwankyerɛ ase.   A. W. Ɔkyerɛwfo yɛ ɔkwampaefo wɔ Presbyterian Asɔre a ɛwɔ Ghana no mu na ɔne wɔn hyehyɛɛ mfinimfini sukuu a wɔde mmofra kɔtra mu, Salem Sukuu wɔ afe 1843.   Na n’agya nanabea, Pauline Hesse (1831–1909) fi Gold Coast, na na ofi Danish, Ga ne German abusua mu.  Ne nanabea ne Regina Hesse (1832 –1898), ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo a ɔyɛ ɔkwampaefo ne sukuu panyin. 

Ne nuabarima panyin, Carl Henry Clerk (1895 –1982), samufo, kuayɛ ho adesua ho ɔbenfo, ɔhwɛfo, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo ne Presbyterian somfo yɛɛ Synod Ɔkyerɛwfo a ɔto so anan wɔ Presbyterian Asɔre a ɛwɔ Gold Coast no mu fi 1950 kosi 1954 ne Kristofo Ɔbɔfo no Samufo atesɛm krataa a ɛbaa afe 1960 ne 1963 ntam hɔ    Theodore Clerk (1909 – 1965), ne nua kumaa ne Ghanani ɔdansifoɔ a ɔdi kan a ɔyɛɛ nhyehyɛeɛ na ɔnyaa hyɛn gyinabea kuro Tema .  Ne nuabea kumaa, Matilda J. Clerk (1916 – 1984) yɛ Ghanani ɔbaa aduruyɛ ho ɔbenfoɔ a ɔtɔ so mmienu ne saa ara nso na ɔbaa a ɔdi kan wɔ Ghana ne Afrika Atɔeɛ fam a ɔnyaa postgraduate diploma.

Nhomasua ne ntetee 
Jane Clerk nyaa ne mfitiaseɛ nwomasua wɔ Basel Mission mfitiaseɛ sukuu a ɛwɔ Larteh Akuapem baabi a na ne papa te sɛ ɔmantam soafoɔ ma saa presbytery no.  Ɔkɔɔ sukuu bi a mmeawa nkutoo na wɔtra mu wɔ Aburi, kurow bi a na ne nana te mu  Ɔkɔɔ Aburi Mmea Akyerɛkyerɛfo Ntetee Kɔlege (mprempren Presbyterian Mmea Nhomasua Sukuu ) baabi a osuaa adekyerɛ ho ade na na ɔyɛ asuafo baanu a wɔwɔ sukuu no kuw a edi kan wɔ afe 1928 mu  Wɔ 1946 mu no, na Jane Clerk ka akyerɛkyerɛfo mpanyimfo kuw bi a wɔapaw wɔn a wɔmaa wɔn adwuma mfinimfini sika a wɔde bɛkɔ akɔtete wɔn adwuma wɔ amannɔne wɔ London Sukuupɔn Nhomasua Asoɛe a ɛnnɛ ɛyɛ Sukuupɔn Kɔlege London fa, faako a onyaa Ɔboafo no ho Abodin krataa wɔ Nhomasua mu bere a wɔawie asram dunwɔtwe adesua no.

Adwuma 
Jane Clerk kyerɛɛ ade wɔ sukuu ahorow mu wɔ Aburi ne Agogo wɔ n’adwuma mfiase.  Wɔde no kɔɔ Kumasi na wɔpaw no sɛ Aban Mmabaa Sukuu no Sukuu Panyin.  Akyiri yi wɔmaa no so sɛ nhomasua sohwɛfo boafo wɔ afe 1947.  Wɔ afe 1952 mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ nhomasua sohwɛfo maa Koforidua kurow no mu baabi a na ne dwumadi ne n’asɛyɛde ahorow no bi ne sukuu ahorow a ɔhwɛ so nyinaa na ɔhwɛ so, a na ɔbarima bi na ɔyɛ saa bere no.  Ɔkɔɔ pɛnhyen wɔ n’akyerɛkyerɛ adwuma mu wɔ afe 1959.

Owuo 
Owui wɔ abɔde mu wɔ afe 1999 mu wɔ Osu, Accra bere a na wadi mfe aduɔkron anum.  Wɔsiee n'amu no wɔ Osu Amusiei a ɛwɔ Accra .

title: Wesley Girls' High School
text:
Wesley Girls' High School ( WGHS ) yɛ nwomasua asoɛeɛ a wɔde ma mmabaa wɔ Cape Coast wɔ Central mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Harriet Wrigley, Methodist ɔsomfo bi yere na ɔde sii hɔ wɔ 1836 mu.  Wɔde sukuu no din too nea ɔhyehyɛɛ Methodism no John Wesley din .

Abakɔsɛm 
Wesley Mmabaa Ntoaso Sukuu no dii 68 wɔ ntoaso sukuu 100 a eye sen biara wɔ Afrika no mu denam Africa Almanac so wɔ afe 2003 mu, a egyina nhomasua pa, asuafoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu, ahoɔden ne dwumadie a alumnae yɛ, sukuu ho nsɛm, intanɛt ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ a wɔhunu so.

title: Senyuiedzorm Awusi Adadevoh
text:
Senyuiedzorm Awusi Adadevoh (wɔwoo no wɔ Dzelukope, Volta Mantam mu wɔ Ghana ) yɛ Ghana agumadi mfoninitwafo ne mfoninitwafo a ɔte Accra, Ghana . N’adwuma sɛ mfoninitwafo fii ase wɔ afe 1999 mu, na awiei koraa no ɔdan kɔɔ agumadi mfoninitwa mu wɔ 2000 mfe no mfinimfini. Afe 2008 mu no, Adadevoh hyɛɛ aseɛ ne Black Stars, Ghana ɔman bɔɔlbɔ kuo mpaninfoɔ yɛɛ adwuma. Adadevoh na ɔhyehyɛɛ mfoninitwa sikakorabea Solvers Ghana, mfoninitwa ne mfonini ho nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ adwumakuw Sports Unlimited ne Society Unlimited.

Mfitiase asetra 
Adadevoh kɔɔ Ghana Suapɔn Mfitiaseɛ Sukuu Legon na ɔkɔɔ Aburi Mmabaa Mpanyimfo ntoaso sukuu . Adadevoh wiee Afrika Nsɛm ho Amanneɛbɔ Asoɛe (mprempren Afrika Sukuupɔn Nkitahodi Sukuu ) a na ɔwɔ Diploma wɔ Nkitahodi Ho Adesua mu. Adadevoh yɛ mfoninitwafo a ɔkyerɛkyerɛ ne ho a mfiase no na ɔpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ videotwafo ansa na ɔredan akɔ mfoninitwa so.

Adwuma 
Adadevoh abɔ tuo wɔ wiase agumadi akɛseɛ bi mu, a Olympic Games mmienu, FIFA World Cups mmienu ( South Africa 2010 ne Brazil 2014 ) ne African Nations Cups nsia ka ho wɔ 2008-2017 ntam.

Adadevoh nso atow nnipa dodow bi a wɔagye din wɔ agumadi mu tuo, te sɛ Floyd Mayweather Jr. ne n’agya Floyd Sr., a wɔkaa Mayweather vs. McGregor ko wɔ August 2017.

Nnwuma afoforo a wɔyɛ 

 2005-1999 Ɔkataa adamfofa adɔe akansi a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Ghana agodifo a wɔadi kan wɔ mpɔtam hɔ ne wɔn a na wɔyɛ amannɔne agodifo ntam. Freelancing for a Ghanaian base societal life style magazine “Enjoy Accra” a ɛka ntadehyɛ ho ɔyɛkyerɛ a ɛkɔ mmofra apontow ahorow, ɔmanfo dwumadi ahorow a ɛkorɔn, amammui mu ɔyɛkyerɛ ahorow, ahofadi afahyɛ ahorow ne nea ɛkeka ho ho asɛm.
 2006 Ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ Ghana News Agency sɛ mfoninitwafoɔ a ɔtɔ so mmienu wɔ fie no mu.
 2007 Ɔtwee mfonini na ɔhyehyɛɛ “The Legacy Of War” mfonini ɔyɛkyerɛ de boaa adɔe ahyehyɛde bi a ɛnyɛ nea wɔhwehwɛ mfaso Self Help Initiative wɔ Bujumbura Aguanfo nsraban mu.
 2008 Freelancing maa BBC African Sports wɔ BBC 2007 afe no mu agofomma a ɔsen biara wɔ Togo no ho amanneɛbɔ mu . Freelancing ma KICK-OFF Ghana. Ɔkaa Beijing 2008 Ahuhuro Olimpik akansi no ho asɛm sɛ Ghanani mfoninitwafo koro pɛ. Ɔkaa 2008 Africa Cup of Nation ho asɛm sɛ ɔbea mfoninitwafo a ɔwɔ Sahara Anafo fam nkutoo. Wɔde sii hɔ na wotintimii “Sports Unlimited”. Ɔyɛɛ ɔman som wɔ Citi FM wɔ Accra sɛ mfoninitwafo a ɔwɔ fie hɔ.
 2009 Ɔkyerɛwfo ne nhoma tintimfo “Proudly Ghanaian” kɔfe pon so mfonini nhoma a ɛyɛ adwinni ho mfonini.
 2010 Ɔkaa South Africa 2010 FIFA Wiase Kupɔn no ho asɛm. Ɔboaa wɔ nwoma bi a wɔfrɛ no “Hopes & dreams” mu a asɛnkafoɔ mpaninfoɔ kuo bi te sɛ Farayi Mungazi a ɔfiri BBC, Piers Edwards, Mark Gleeson ne afoforɔ yɛeɛ. Vodafone Ghana na ɛyɛɛ apam sɛ wɔbɛkata Ghana Premier League Fans kuw bi so afiri Ghana akɔ London akɔ Premier League final. Ɔkaa 2010 Afrika Amanaman Kuruwa no ho asɛm .
 2011 Ɔkyerɛwfo ne nhoma tintimfo "Suarez Nsa" mfonini kalenda a ɛfa afe 2011 ho. Kataa agumadi dwumadi ahorow te sɛ golf, bɔɔlbɔ, polo, asuguare, baseball ne track dwumadi afoforo so maa m’agumadi nsɛmma nhoma Sports Unlimited. Shot company profile for Ghana mobile phone adwumakuw a ɛwɔ din MTN no mpanyimfo . Ɔkaa afe 2010 Afrika Bɔɔlbɔfo no ho asɛm a CAF yɛe wɔ Cairo, Egypt .
 2012 Publicies Ghana yɛɛ apam sɛ wɔbɛtow Guinness icons Ghana senior national team The Black Stars tuo. African Football Confederation (CAF) na ɛyɛɛ apam sɛ 2011 African Football Player a CAF yɛe wɔ Accra.
 2013 Ɔkaa 2014 FIFA qualifiers no bi ho asɛm. Ɔkaa Ghana Premier league (2013/2014 bere) ho asɛm. Dawurubɔ adwumakuw Fire House na ɛyɛɛ apam sɛ wɔbɛtow wɔn CLIENT brand GLOS’ icons. Covered 2013 Afrika Kuruwa Aman Nkabom Kuruwa .
 2014 Ɔkaa 2014 FIFA Wiase Kupɔn a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Brazil ho asɛm . Ɔkaa Ghana Premier league (2014/2015 bere) ho asɛm. Ɔkaa 2015 AFCON qualifiers no bi ho asɛm.
 2015 Ɛkaa 2015 Afrika Amanaman Kuruwa (AFCON) a wɔyɛe wɔ Equatorial Guinea no ho asɛm . Ɔkaa Ghana Premier League (2015/2016) bere no ho asɛm. Ɔkaa amanaman ntam bɔɔlbɔ akansi ahorow bi a adɔe agodie ahorow ka ho ho asɛm. Ɔkaa amanaman ntam akuturukubɔ ahorow bi a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Ghana ne United States ho asɛm, a Floyd Mayweather Jnr ne Andre Berto akodi a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Las Vegas ka ho .
 2016 Ɔkaa 2017 AFCON qualifiers no bi ho asɛm. Ɔkaa Ghana Premier League (2016) bere no ho asɛm. Ɔkaa GLO CAF Awards (2015) ho asɛm wɔ Nigeria . Ɔkaa amanaman ntam akuturukubɔ ntɔkwaw bi ho asɛm wɔ Ghana. Ɔkaa FIFA 2018 Wiase Kupɔn no mu akansi a edi kan no bi ho asɛm. Ɔkaa Ghana Mmea bɔɔlbɔ akansi ne FA Kuruwa akansi no fã bi ho asɛm. Ɔkaa 2016 UPAC basketball akansi no fã bi ho asɛm. Ɔkaa afe 2016 Afrika hockey akansi no kesee fam beaeɛ a ɛwɔ Ghana no ho asɛm. Ɔkataa Ghana Bɔɔlbɔ Fekuw no nhyiam a wɔyɛ no kwa no so .
 2017 Ɔkaa 2017 Afrika Amanaman Kuruwa (AFCON ) a wɔyɛe wɔ Gabon no ho asɛm . Ɔkaa CAF 2017 Amansan Nhyiamu abatoɔ a ɛmaa wɔpaw Ahmad Ahmad sɛ CAF titrani foforɔ no ho asɛm. Ɔkaa 2018 FIFA Wiase Kupɔn no awiei draw a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Russia no ho asɛm . Ɔkaa ntam a ɔkae wɔ Ghana Ɔmanpanyin a ɔto so 5, HE Nana Addo Dankwa Akufo-Addo . Ɔkaa Floyd Mayweather Jnr ne Conor McGregor ntɔkwaw a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Las Vegas no ho asɛm. Wobisabisaa Floyd Mayweather Jnr nsɛm live via facebook wɔ ne TMT akuturukubɔ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ dan mu wɔ Nevada, Las-Vegas. Ɔkaa FIFA 2018 Wiase Kupɔn no mu akansi ahorow bi ho asɛm. Ɔkaa 2017 Major League Soccer (MLS) agodie no bi ho asɛm. Wɔkaa 2017 Ghana Premier League bere no fã bi ho asɛm. Ɔkaa Ghana Mmea Kuw no bi ho asɛm. Ɔkaa Ghana Bɔɔlbɔ Fekuw no nhyiam soronko a wɔyɛe wɔ Accra no ho asɛm. Ɔkaa akuturukubɔ ntɔkwaw bi ho asɛm wɔ Ghana. Ɔkaa mpɔtam hɔ asuguare akansi bi ho asɛm.
 2018 Ɔkataa Aiteo CAF abasobɔdeɛ (2017) a wɔyɛɛ no Ghana --- Ɔpɛpɔn. Ɔkataa WBO bere tiaa mu Super Bantamweight akodi a ɛda Isaac Dogboe ne Cesar Juarez ntam a wɔyɛe wɔ Ghana ---January. Ɔkataa WBO super bantamweight abodin a ɛda Isaac Dogboe ne Jessie Magdaleno ntam wɔ Liacouras Center, Philadelphia

Nneɛma a wɔde kyerɛ 

 Ɔyɛɛ ne ɔyɛkyerɛ a edi kan a wɔato din "Ɔko Agyapade" a ɛtwee adwene sii sɛnea akodi sɛe ade ne aguanfo tebea a emu yɛ den so.
 Ghana mfonini ho nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo panyin Senyuiedzorm tow mfonini wɔ aguadidan mu de tɔ bɔɔl ma mpɔtam a ahia wɔn.

Abasobɔde ahorow 

 Ghana Agumadi Mfoninitwafo a Ɔsen Biara wɔ Agumadi mu Nkɔso Abasobɔde no ase.
 Top 50 Ghanafo Mmabun a Wɔanya Nkɛntɛnso Kɛse. 
 Senyueidzorm Awusi Adadevoh a WISA-Ghana de ama no.
 Hu Ghana mmea a wɔwɔ nkɛntɛnso kɛse wɔ agumadi mu no bi.

title: Cynthia Lamptey
text:
Cynthia Lamptey yɛ Ghana mmaranimfo ne ɔman adwumayɛfo. Ɔyɛɛ Ɔmanfoɔ Asɛmdifoɔ Panyin wɔ John Dramani Mahama nnisoɔ ase.  Wɔpaw no na akyiri yi wɔpaw no sɛ Ghana Mmaranimfo Titiriw abadiakyiri wɔ afe 2018. Ɔyɛɛ Ghana Mmaranimfoɔ Titiriw a ɔreyɛ adwuma wɔ berɛ a saa berɛ no Mmaranimfoɔ Titiriw, Martin Amidu gyaee adwuma wɔ 16 Ɔbɛnem 2020, kɔsii sɛ wɔyii Kissi Agyebeng wɔ 5 Ɔbɛnem 2021.

Adwumayɛ asetra 
Cynthia Lamptey yɛ mmaranimfoɔ wɔ n'adwuma mu na ɔwiee Ghana Mmara Sukuu . Wɔde no yɛɛ adwuma sɛ ɔman mmaranimfo wɔ Attorney-General’s Department wɔ afe 1995 mu na ɔkɔɔ soro wɔ dibea ahorow no mu kosii sɛ wɔpaw no sɛ Ɔmanfo Mmaranimfo Panyin wɔ John Mahama nniso no mu. Sɛ́ ɔman no mmaranimfo panyin no, odii nsɛm pii a wɔde kɔdan asɛnnibea a ɛkorɔn ho dwuma.  N'asɛm a wɔde kɔdan no no bi ne asɛm a wɔkyerɛ sɛ Ɔman Ɔsom Nhyehyɛe no Ɔkwankyerɛfo Panyin bi wiaa cedis ɔpepem 86.9 ne nsɛmmɔnedifo a wɔde Alfred Agbesi Woyome kɔɔ asɛnnibea no .  Ghana asennibea bi bɔɔ Alfred Woyome a wonim no sɛ ɔyɛ sikasɛm ho ɔbenfo wɔ National Democratic Congress no sobo sɛ ɔde nnaadaa gyee ɛka a wɔde asɛn Ghana atemmu a ɛyɛ cedis ɔpepem 52.  Wɔ afe 2014 mu no, wɔde Ghanafoɔ mmaa mmienu a na wɔadi dwuma titire wɔ cocaine a wɔde kɔ United Kingdom no kɔɔ asɛnnibea.  Bere a ɔde mfeɛ aduonu asom ɔman no akyi no, ɔgyaee dwumadibea no wɔ afe 2015.  Wɔde Yvonne Attakorah Obuobisa sii n’ananmu.

Ghana Mmaranimfo Titiriw Abadiakyiri 
Wɔ January 2018 mu, bere a aban de Martin Amidu paw no sɛ Ghana Mmaranimfo Titiriw a odi kan no, Ghana nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo fii ase tintim Cynthia Lamptey din sɛ n’abadiakyiri.  Na Cynthia Lamptey ayɛ adwuma wɔ Martin Amidu ase bere a na nea otwa to no yɛ Mmaranimfo Panyin titiriw wɔ John Atta Mills nniso no mu no. Nana Addo Dankwa Akuffo-Addo aban no na ɛhyehyɛɛ Office of the Special Prosecutor wɔ afe 2017 mu a na wɔn botaeɛ ne sɛ wɔbɛma kwan ama wɔadi amammuifoɔ ne nnipa a wɔde wɔn ho abɔ amammui akuo anaa wɔn mufoɔ a wɔbu wɔn sɛ wɔyɛ adifudepɛfoɔ no asɛm.  Wɔ ne din a wɔde too gua no akyi no, wɔpaw no, ɔyɛ Ɔman Mmaranimfo Titiriw abadiakyiri wɔ afe 2018 mu. Afei ɔbɛyɛɛ onipa a odi kan a ɔyɛɛ Ghana Mmaranimfo Titiriw abadiakyiri.  Seesei ɔsom sɛ Ghana Mmaranimfo Titiriw a ɔreyɛ adwuma wɔ bere a saa bere no Mmaranimfo Titiriw, Martin Amidu gyaee adwuma wɔ 16 November 2020 akyi.

title: Yaa Asantewaa Festival
text:
Yaa Asantewaa Afahyɛ yɛ afe afe afahyɛ a Ejisu Amammerɛ Mpɔtam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana mu mpanyimfo ne nnipa di . Wɔtaa di no wɔ August bosome mu.

Yaa Asantewaa Afahyɛ foforo a ɛho hia no, Ɔhemmaa Ɛna Saa Pogh Ahemfie Naa Yaa Asantewaa Ababio II na ɛde sii hɔ, de kae Ɔhemmaa Yaa Asantewaa Fie Frɛ Afe a Ɛto so 95, na wɔde ahyɛ N’akokoduru a werɛ remfi da ne n’akokoduru soronko, a Ɔdaa no adi wɔ bere no mu no anuonyam Ɔko a ɛyɛ Sikakɔkɔɔ Nsuo, aka Yaa Asantewaa Ahofadi Ko.

Nnafua 9 afahyɛ no nso de obuo maa Ɔhemmaa Ɛna Yaa Akya, Ɔhene Nana Prempeh Maame ne Ahene ne Atitire afoforɔ a Britaniafoɔ tuu wɔn kɔɔ Seychelles wɔ 1900 mfeɛ no mfitiaseɛ mu no nyinaa. Eyinom bi ne Sultan a ofi Perak Abdullah Muhammad Shah II a ofi Perak, Buganda Hene Mwanga II a ofi Buganda ne Bunyoro Hene Chwa II Kabalega  Amammui mu nnommumfa afoforo a wɔda nsow ne, Makarios III, Republic of the Seychelles Ɔmampanyin a odi kan ne Saad Zaghloul, Egypt Ɔmanpanyin a ɔto so 17.

Afahyɛ ahorow 
Wɔ Ejisu Kumasi no, durbar of chiefs wɔ hɔ a Ejisu ɔpanyin a ɔsen biara na odi anim . 

Wɔ Seychelles supɔw so no, wɔyɛɛ nkaeɛ guasodeɛ titire bi wɔ 17th October 2016, de hyɛɛ Afrikani ɔkofoɔ a ɔyɛ anansesɛm mu Ɔhemmaa Ɛna Nana Yaa Asantewaa wuo wɔ Seychelles wɔ Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 17, 1921 no mfeɛ aduɔkron nnum. Nkaeɛ guasodeɛ no, Office of the Reincarnation Successor Saa Pogh Naa Yaa Asantewaa Ababio II a ɔwɔ Tano Yaw (UNESCO) wiase agyapadeɛ din kronkronbea a ɛwɔ Ejisu Ghana no na ɛyɛɛ nhyehyɛeɛ; a Ethiopian Airlines na ɛboaa, a wɔne Seychelles ɔsom adwuma a ɛhwɛ amammerɛ so ka Ɔman Nneɛmakorabea ho no abom. 

Afei nso wɔ Seychelles, ɔyɛkyerɛ bi wɔ hɔ, a wɔato din Saint Yaa Asantewaa Nkaeɛ Ɔyɛkyerɛ, a Seychelles Aman bɔɔ amanneɛ sɛ ɛyɛ ɔyɛkyerɛ soronko, a wɔbuee ano wɔ aban kwan so wɔ Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 21, 2016, wɔ Ɔman Abakɔsɛm Tete Nneɛma Akoraeɛ a Ɔhemmaa Yaa Asantewaa Awoɔ foforɔ Ɔhemmaa Maame Saa Pogh Naa a odii n’ade, de hyɛ ɔkofo a onsuro anansesɛm mu Ɔhemmaa Maame Nana Yaa Asantewaa a ofi Ghana a owui wɔ Seychelles wɔ Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 17, 1921 no wuo mfeɛ aduɔkron nnum

Nea ɛho hia 
Ejisu mpanyimfo ne wɔn a wɔte hɔ no de nidi ma Yaa Asantewaa a na wonim no sɛ Ashanti ɔko mu ɔbran a odii anim wɔ ɔko a wɔne Britaniafo dii wɔ afe 1901 mu  Afahyɛ no nso kae n’akokoduru a ɔde sɔre tiaa Britaniafo sɛ wɔbɛfa Ashantifo Sikakɔkɔɔ Asɛnka a ɛde atuatew bae wɔ 1690 mfe no awiei mu hɔ no.

title: Joseph Arthur Ankrah
text:
Joseph Arthur Ankrah Born (18 August 1915 – 25 November 1992) yɛ Ghana asraafoɔ sahene a na ɔyɛ Ghana man ti firi afe 1966 kɔsi 1969 wɔ dibea sɛ Ɔman Ahofadie Bagua no Titenani . Ansa na Ankrah rebɛyɛ ɔman ti no, na ɔyɛ Ghana Asraafo panyin a odi kan . Ɔno ne Ghana asraafoɔ panin a odi kan. Ankrah nso yɛɛ Afrika Biakoyɛ Ahyehyɛde no Titenani fi 24 Ɔpɛpɔn 1966 kosi 5 Ɔpɛpɔn 1966.

Mfitiase asetra 
Wɔwoo Ankrah wɔ 18 Ɔbɛnem 1915 wɔ Accra maa Ga abusua a wɔyɛ Samuel Paul Cofie Ankrah, ɔhwɛfoɔ ma Kristofoɔ Asɛmpatrɛ Kuo ne Beatrice Abashie Quaynor, aguadifoɔ.  Ankrah fii ne sukuu ase wɔ afe 1921 mu wɔ Wesleyan Methodist Sukuu a ɛwɔ Accra, faako a na wɔtoo no din 'Ankrah Patapaa' esiane ne "ahoɔden a ɔde di akyinnyegye mu na ɔyɛ akannifo dwumadi bere nyinaa wɔ n'ahokafo mu" nti.  Wɔ 1932 mu no, ɔkɔɔ Accra Academy, faako a ɔde ne ho sii hɔ sɛ bɔɔlbɔfo pa.  Ɔnyaa Senior Cambridge Sukuu Adansedie krataa wɔ afe 1937.  Afei ɔde ne ho kɔbɔɔ Ghana Ɔman Adwumayɛbea. 

Ankrah nyaa Senior Cambridge Sukuu Adansedi krataa wɔ afe 1937 mu. Afei ɔde ne ho kɔbɔɔ Ghana Ɔman Adwumayɛbea.

Asraafo adwuma 
Ankrah kɔkaa Gold Coast Asraafo Kuw no ho wɔ afe 1939.  Bere a Wiase Ko II fii ase no, wɔboaboaa Ankrah ano kɔɔ Royal West African Frontier Force . Bere a na ne Brigade no wɔ Afrika Apuei fam wɔ 1940 mu no, wɔde no kɔɔ Record Office a ɛwɔ Accra a na ɔwɔ dibea a ɛne Warrant Officer Class II na wɔyɛɛ no nea ɔto so abien. Wɔ October 1946 mu no, ɔkɔɔ Marshfield Officer Cadets Training Unit a ɛwɔ United Kingdom na owiee sukuu wɔ February 1947 mu sɛ Afrikani ɔsraani panyin a odi kan wɔ Gold Coast Asraafo mu .Wɔmaa no adwuma sɛ ɔsraani panyin wɔ afe 1947   na ɔbɛyɛɛ Afrikani nsraban so panyin a odi kan wɔ Asraafo Dwumadibea Ti. Akyiri yi wɔyɛɛ no Ghana Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo Panyin a odi kan wɔ Nhomasua Dwumadibea no mu. Wɔmaa no dibea sɛ Ɔsahene wɔ afe 1956 mu na ɔbɛyɛɛ Afrikani a odi kan a ɔhwɛɛ adwumakuw bi a ɛwɔ Afrika nyinaa so, Charlie Company of the First Battalion wɔ Tamale, Ghana . Akyiri yi ɔbɛyɛɛ Ɔsahene Panyin na ogyee asraafo dɔm no nyinaa.  Ɔkɔɔ soro koduu ɔsraani panyin dibea so wɔ afe 1960 mu, bere a na Ghana asraafo mpanyimfo kakraa bi na wɔwɔ saa gyinabea no.  Bere a Amanaman Nkabom no reyɛ adwuma wɔ Congo no, na ɔyɛ asraafo a wɔwɔ Luluabourg, Kasai wɔ nnɛyi Democratic Republic of Congo no Brigade Commander . Ɔno nko ara ne Ghanani a wɔmaa no Asraafo Mmeamudua wɔ Leopoldville esiane akokoduru nneyɛe a ɛso bi nni wɔ Congo wɔ afe 1961 mu nti  Nsɛm a wɔafa aka no kenkan sɛ:

Saa ɔsraani panyin yi de ntease kɛse, onyin ne anifere dii tebea bi a ɛyɛ mmerɛw a anka ɛde nea efi mu ba a emu yɛ den bɛba wɔ Leopoldville ne Congo mmeae pii no ho dwuma. Ɔsahene Ankrah, a na obu n’ankasa nkwa koraa no, yii Armée Nationale Congolaise (ANC) ɔsraani bi a ɔde sten afiri carbine a wɔde nneɛma ahyɛ mu ma bɔɔ mmɔden sɛ ɔbɛtow Owura Lumumba tuo no akode afi ne ho . Ɔde Prime Minister no kɔɔ baabi a ahobammɔ wɔ wɔ kar bi a ANC a wɔtow hyɛɛ so no mu. Sɛ ɛnyɛ Ɔsahene Ankrah adeyɛ a ɛyɛ ntɛm na ɔde akokoduru yɛe de ne nkwa too asiane mu a, anka wɔbɛfa Owura Lumumba nkwa a nea ebefi mu aba a wontumi nka ho asɛm saa bere no. 

Bere a onyaa osuahu wɔ Congo akyi no, wɔmaa no dibea sɛ Brigadier afei Major General  bɛyɛɛ Ghana asraafo panyin a odi kan wɔ Ghana asraafo mu wɔ afe 1961 mu na afei Deputy Chief of Defence Staff .  Woyii no fii Ghana asraafo mu wɔ July 1965  mu esiane sɛ wosusuw sɛ ɔde ne ho ahyɛ atuatew pɔw bi mu nti.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ankrah bɛyɛɛ Ɔman Sikakorabea no panyin bere a ofii asraafo mu no. Nanso, ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔman no Ti ne Ɔman Ahofadi Bagua no Titenani wɔ February 24, 1966 atuatew no akyi.  Wɔ January 1967 mu no, ɔyɛɛ ntamgyinafo wɔ Nigeria Ɔmanko a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Biafra no mu akuw a wɔreko no ntam .    Wɔhyɛɛ no ma ogyaee adwuma sɛ NLC Titenani ne Ɔman Ti esiane adanmude ho animguasesɛm bi a ɛfa Nigeriani aguadifo bi ho nti.

Agumadi 
Ankrah yɛɛ Ɔmampanyin a odi kan koraa wɔ Council of Patrons of Accra Hearts of Oak SC na ɔkyerɛɛ bɔɔlbɔ kuw no kwan bere tenten.

Abusua 
Wɔ afe 1965 mu no ɔwaree ne yere a ɔto so abiɛsa, Mildred Christina Akosiwor Fugar (12 June 1938 – 9 June 2005), wɔ Accra . Ne babarima nso kɔɔ Accra Adesuabea . Na ɔwɔ ɔbabea bi a wɔfrɛ no Jackie Ankrah a ɔyɛ broadcaster, nnwom kyerɛwfo ne nnwontofo.  Ná ɔwɔ yerenom pii ne mma 18.

title: President of Ghana
text:
Ghana ɔmanpanyin ne ɔman ti a wɔapaw no ne Ghana aban panyin, ne Ghana Asraafo panyin nso . Ghana ɔmanpanyin mprempren ne Nana Akufo-Addo, a odii nkonim wɔ afe 2020 ɔmanpanyin abatow mu tiaa kan ɔmanpanyin, John Dramani Mahama, de 4.23%.  Ɔkaa ntam sɛ ɔbɛdi tumi wɔ n'ahennie a ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ 7 Ɔbɛnem 2021.

Fata a Wɔfata 
Sɛnea Ti 8, Ahyɛde 62 a ɛwɔ 1992 Ghana Amanyɔ Mmara mu kyerɛ no, obi rentumi mfata sɛ wɔpaw no sɛ Ghana ɔmanpanyin gye sɛ:

 (a) ɔyɛ Ghana ɔman ba fi awo mu
 (b) wadi mfeɛ aduanan; ne
 (c) yɛ obi a ɔkwan foforo so no ɔfata sɛ wɔpaw no sɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni, gye sɛ nsɛm a wɔayi afi mu a wɔakyerɛ wɔ nkyekyem (c), (d), ne (e) a ɛwɔ nkyekyem (2) a ɛwɔ asɛmti 94 mu wɔ saa Amansan Mmara yi mu no bɛyɛ wɔrenyi mfi hɔ, wɔ onipa a ɔte saa biara ho, denam ɔmampanyin bɔne fafiri anaasɛ bere a atwam sɛnea wɔakyerɛ wɔ saa asɛm no nkyekyem (5) mu no so.

title: Wim nsakrae wɔ Ghana
text:
Wim nsakrae a ɛwɔ Ghana no renya nnipa a wɔwɔ Ghana so nkɛntɛnso wɔ akwan horow so efisɛ ɔman no te mmeae abiɛsa a nsu yɛ wim tebea hyia no. Nsakrae a ɛba osutɔ, wim tebea ne po mu nsu a ɛkɔ soro mu no bɛka mpoano nsu mu nkyene. Wɔhwɛ kwan sɛ eyi bɛka kuayɛ ne mpataayi nyinaa wɔ ɔkwan a enye so Ɔman no sikasɛm gyina hɔ sɛ ɛrehu amane wɔ wim nsakrae nkɛntɛnso ahorow ho esiane sɛ ɛde ne ho to nnwuma a ɛfa wim tebea ho te sɛ kuayɛ, ahoɔden, ne kwae so nti . Bio nso, wɔhwɛ kwan sɛ nsuo pa a wɔbɛnya no bɛyɛ den kɛseɛ berɛ a nsuo a wɔbɛtew so no bɛnya nkɛntɛnsoɔ bɔne wɔ nsuo mu ahoɔden, a ɛma ɔman no anyinam ahoɔden ahoɔden 54%. Bio nso, ɛda adi sɛ Ghana behu nnipa pii a wɔanya asramma ne kɔlera, efisɛ nsakrae a ɛba nsu tebea mu no nya abien no nyinaa so nkɛntɛnso. Wɔ afe 2015 mu no, abam no yɛɛ krataa bi a wɔato din "Ghana's Intended Nationally Determined Contribution." Ɛno akyi no, Ghana de wɔn nsa hyɛɛ Paris Wim Tebea Apam ase wɔ afe 2016 mu. Mframa a ɛma wim yɛ hyew a wɔtow gu Nneɛma a wɔde yɛ pɛtro a efi abo mu Jubilee po so ngo adwumayɛbea no baa afe 2010 mu, na ɛmaa anidasoɔ kɔɔ soro sɛ wɔbɛnya ahonyadeɛ wɔ Ghana. Nanso, nneɛma a ehia na wɔde aboa Ghana ngo adwuma (adekora, po so hyɛn, nea wɔyɛ) ama ɛho abehia sɛ wɔyɛ ogyaframa. "Ebia gas a ɛbɛhyew bere tenten wɔ Jubilee Field no bɛyɛ nea wontumi nkwati" sɛ wɔannya nkɔso ntɛmntɛm wɔ nnwuma a wɔde bɛyɛ adwuma mu na ɛbɛma wɔanya CO bɛyɛ tɔn ɔpepem 1.5 afe biara (Ghana ɔman no mframa a wɔtow gu nyinaa mu ɔha biara mu nkyem 7). Nkɛntɛnso a enya wɔ abɔde mu nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia so Ɔhyew ne wim tebea a ɛsakra Ɔtare Volta, ɔtare a wɔde nsa ayɛ a ɛso sen biara wɔ wiase nyinaa sɛnea ne kɛse te no sesaa wim tebea wɔ Ghana. Atifi fam mmeae a ɛhɔ yɛ kusuu no ayɛ hyew ntɛmntɛm sen Ghana kesee fam. Sɛ yɛka ne nyinaa bom a, Ghana anya 1.0 °C. ɔhyew a ɛkɔ soro fi 1960. Ghana atifi fam wɔ osutɔ bere biako pɛ, bere a Ghana kesee fam wɔ abien na osu a ɛtɔ afe biara no sakra kɛse. Ɛyɛ den sɛ wobehu sɛnea osu tɔ bere tenten. Nanso, USDA Kwae Dwumadibea no de baa awiei wɔ afe 2011 mu sɛ "adanse biara nni hɔ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ osu a ɛtɔ kɛse no akɔ soro anaasɛ ɛso atew fi 1960." Nanso, sɛ obi de Köppen-Geiger wim tebea nkyekyɛmu asase mfonini a ɛfa afe 1980-2016 ho ne asase mfonini a wɔahyɛ ho nkɔm sɛ ɛbɛba afe 2071-2100 toto ho a, ɔhyɛɛ nsakraeɛ a ɛbɛba wɔ nkyekyɛmu mu afiri "ɔhyeɛ, sare so" akɔ "ɔsuo, sare so, ɛhɔ yɛ hyeɛ" wɔ mpoano mmeaeɛ bi ho nkɔm.
Mprempren / bere a atwam Köppen wim tebea nkyekyɛmu map ma Ghana (1980-2016) .
Köppen wim tebea nkyekyɛmu map a wɔahyɛ ho nkɔm ama Ghana 2071–2100
Po mu nsu a ɛkɔ soro Nsɛm a ɛwɔ hɔ nso kyerɛ sɛ ɛpo mu nsuo akɔ soro 2.1 mm afe biara wɔ mfe 30 a atwam no mu, na ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɛkɔɔ soro 5.8 cm, 16.5 na ɛwɔ hɔ cm, ne 34.5 cm ansa na afe 2020, 2050, ne 2080. Nsuo mu nneɛma Nsu a wɔhwɛ kwan sɛ ɛbɛtew wɔ nsubɔnten atitiriw a ɛma ɔman no nsu pa, Volta Asubɔnten, Bia Asubɔnten, ne Tano Asubɔnten, mu no betumi ama nsɛnnennen a ɛwɔ nsu pa a wɔbɛnom mu no ayɛ kɛse. Wɔhyɛɛ nkɔm sɛ nsuo dodoɔ a ɛwɔ Volta Basin no so bɛtew 24% ne 45% wɔ afe 2050 ne 2100 mu. Osutɔ a ɛkɔ so so tew ne nsu a ɛtɔ kɔ soro no betumi de amammui mu nhyɛso aba ɔmantam no mu bere a Burkina Faso reyɛ nhyehyɛe sɛ wɔbɛtwe nsu afi Volta Basin mu no. Nkɛntɛnso a enya wɔ nnipa so Sikasɛm mu nkɛntɛnso ahorow Kuadwuma Adwumayɛfo a wɔwɔ Ghana ɔha biara mu aduanan anum gyina kuayɛ a osu tɔ na ɛyɛ akuafo nketewa so . Ɔhaw a osu tɔ a ɛnkɔ so ne wim tebea afoforo a ɛyɛ hu nti no benya nkurɔfo sikasɛm mu yiyedi so nkɛntɛnso bɔne. Bio nso, wɔhwɛ kwan sɛ nnɔbae atitiriw te sɛ bankye, aburoo, ne kookoo (Ghana nnɔbae titiriw a wonya sika) no bɛma nnɔbae a wɔyɛ no so atew. Wɔgyina mfeɛ aduonu a wɔde ahwɛ wim tebea so no, wɔahyɛ nkɔm sɛ atokoɔ ne aburow nnɔbaeɛ foforɔ a wɔnya no so bɛtew 7% wɔ afe 2050 mu. Bio nso, kwae a wɔatutu ne atare foforo a ɛyow nsubɔnten a wɔaka abom no aka kua na ɛno nso de atutra aba Accra a ɛmaa nnipa a wɔte hɔ a wɔnyɛ ho nhyehyɛe a ɛnyɛ papa no yɛɛ kɛse wɔ nsuyiri a ebetumi aba ntɛmntɛm no kwan so. Mpataayi adwuma Po mu nnuan yɛ protein a wodi wɔ Ghana no ɔha biara mu nkyem 40-60. Wɔhwɛ kwan sɛ mmoa ahorow atitiriw ma sikasɛm no benya awo kyinhyia a enye koraa . Mpataayi mu nneɛma a wɔtew so no akanyan po mu nnuan a ne bo bɛboro dɔla ɔpepem 200 afe biara a wɔde fi amannɔne ba. Nsu mu ahoɔden Esiane sɛ ɔman no mu ahoɔden a wɔde yɛ anyinam ahoɔden no 54% yɛ nsu mu anyinam ahoɔden nti, ɛda adi sɛ osu a ɛtɔ a wontumi nhu no de adwenem naayɛ bɛka anyinam ahoɔden nhyehyɛe a ɛtaa twa adwuma dedaw (a wonim no sɛ dumsor ) no ho. Akontaabu binom kyerɛ sɛ tumi a ɛwɔ hɔ no betumi akɔ fam bɛyɛ 50% ama Volta Basin . Ghana nyaa GDP so tew wɔ afe 2012 ne 2015 ntam de buaa ahoɔden a enni hɔ no fã bi. Akwahosan ho nkɛntɛnso Wɔhwɛ kwan sɛ nyarewa a nsu mu te sɛ kɔlera ne nyarewa a nwansena de ba te sɛ asramma bɛdɔɔso. Nneɛma a wɔbrɛ ase ne sɛnea wɔyɛ nsakrae Ghana de ne nsa hyɛɛ Paris Apam no ase wɔ 22 April 2016 na wɔgye toom wɔ 21 September 2016. Wɔyɛɛ ɔman no wim nsakraeɛ ho nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛdi kan wɔ Ghana sɛ wɔde bedi dwuma wɔ afe 2010 ne 2020 ntam Nsakrae a wɔyɛ no hwehwɛ sɛ ɛbɛtew asiane ahorow a wim nsakrae de ba no so . Wobetumi adi kan ayɛ nhyehyɛe a ɛbɛma wɔatumi ayɛ nsakrae anaasɛ wɔde asi hɔ ara kwa de abua mpɔtam hɔ nhyɛso te sɛ kwae a wɔbɛhyehyɛ, asase a wɔbɛdannan, adan a ɛtumi gyina wim tebea ano, nneɛma a wɔde owia ahoɔden yɛ adwuma, ne nea Ministry of Environment Science, Technology and Innovation tintim nhyehyeɛ bi wɔ afe 2013. Wɔ afe 2015 mu no, Ghana yɛɛ nhyehyɛɛ bi a wɔato din ‘Ghana’s Intended Nationally Determined Contribution’ de kyerɛɛ nhyehyɛɛ a wɔde bɛtew carbon a wɔtow gu no so na wɔama asase a wɔde di dwuma, akwantuo, ne sikasɛm ne asetena mu nnwuma foforɔ a ɛbɛtena hɔ daa no atu mpɔn. Ɛda so ara hia sɛ Ghana yɛ nhyehyɛe a ɛbɛkyɛ a ɛbɛma wɔadi wim nsakrae ho dwuma efisɛ ɛte sɛ nea mpɔtam hɔ adwuma so ahwɛfo nni adwene a ɛfata wɔ ɛka a wɔbɔ wɔ ɔhaw ahorow a ɛtete saa a wobedi ho dwuma no ho. title: Akropong
text:
Akropong yɛ kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Apuei Fam na ɛyɛ Akuapim Atifi Mantam, mantam bi a ɛwɔ Apuei Fam Mantam  wɔ Ghana Kesee Fam no ahenkurow. Wonim kurow yi sɛ ɛyɛ nkraman ne nnuadewa ngo .  Akropong wɔ afe 2013 mu nnipa 13,785. 

Na Akropong yɛ beae a na asɛmpatrɛw gyinabea bi a Basel Asɛmpatrɛwfo no di so wɔ . Akwapim a yehu mu nnɛ no bɛyɛɛ nea ɛte fi atubrafo ne mmusuakuw akodi mu. Bɛyɛ afe 1300 Y.B.

Akropong–Akuapem na ɛwɔ hɔ 
Ná Akuapem ne Akropong yɛ ahenni aman wɔ Ghana  Apuei Mantam mu . Bere a wɔde Akyem Hene no sii ahengua so wɔ afe 1773 mu wɔ Akropong ahengua so kaa Akuapem ahengua no ho no, ahenni no bɛyɛɛ ɔman abien a wɔfrɛ no Akropong–Akuapem Ahemman.

Ɔhene Ɔseadeɛyɔ Addo Dankwa III a ofi Akropong kuraa "Ahengua krɔnkrɔn" a Akuapem-Asona, Akan mmusuakuw akɛse asɔn no mu biako, mfe dunsia. Wɔ afe 1733 mu no, Akwamu de n’asraafo tuu mmirika kɔtow hyɛɛ kurow-Akropong Man a na wɔagye afi Ashantifo nkonimdi ahorɔw no mu no so. Nea ɛbɛyɛ na kurow no abɔ ne ho ban no, wɔfrɛɛ asraafo a wɔn ani gye ɔko ho, Akimfo, na wɔn nso wɔyɛ Ashantifo atamfo a wonya fi awoɔ mu. Wogyee Akropong nkwa, na sɛ akatua no, wɔde Akimfo panyin (hene) sii ahengua so sɛ Akropong Hene.

Akanfoɔ 
Ghanafoɔ 49.1% yɛ Akan Aman, Akan Aman yɛ kasa ho akuo a ɛwɔ Afrika Atɔeɛ fam. Saa kuw yi bi ne Akuapemfo, Akyemfo, Asantefoo, Baouléfo, Brong/ Abronfo, Fantefo ne Nzemafo a wɔn ne Brong Ahafo, Ashanti, Atɔe, Mfinimfini, ne Apuei amantam, ne afei nso mfinimfini fã bi Frao Mantam, na ɛkɔ Ghana Atifi fam. Ɛtwa  kɔ Togo, na kɔfa Côte d’Ivoire Akanfo so; Akye, Aowin ne Baoulé Aman a wɔwɔ Ivory Coast Kesee Fam, Mfinimfini ne Apuei Mantam mu a wɔyɛ bɛyɛ 18-20% wɔ Ivory Coast nnipa dodow mu ne nhama a ɛfa ho kɔ akyiri kɔ Aman a ɛbɛn hɔ a wɔka francophone ne Nigeria, a wɔyɛ sɛ Ahenni Aman Mmusuakuw a wɔaka abom no mu biako Ahenni Aman Kɛse a ɛsõ sen biara wɔ Afrika Asasepɔn no so. Ɔhyew no fi 20 °C wɔ August ne 32 mu °C wɔ March mu a ɛyɛ bɛyɛ 23.88 °C.

Efi afeha a ɛtɔ so 15 kosi afeha a ɛtɔ so 19 no, Akanfo na wodii sika kɔkɔɔ a wotu ne sika kɔkɔɔ aguadi  wɔ ɔmantam no mu. Akanfo adwinni trɛw na agye din, titiriw esiane atetesɛm a ɛne sɛ wɔyɛ kɔbere sika kɔkɔɔ a wɔde kari nneɛma, a wɔde wax a ayera kwan a wɔfa so tow no na ɛyɛe nti. Akanfoɔ nkorabata bi ne Abron ne Afutufoɔ. Akanfo amammerɛ na ɛwɔ hɔ na ɛda adi kɛse wɔ nnɛyi Ghana.

Akropongfo no de Agyadeɛ nhyehyɛe a ɛfa agyapadeɛ ho no di dwuma.

Afahyɛ 
Akropongfoɔ di Odwira afahyɛ na wɔtaa yɛ saa guasodeɛ yi wɔ September/October mu. Odwira yɛ Ghana afahyɛ ahorɔw pii a nnipa a wofi asetra mu tebea horɔw nyinaa mu a atubrafo ka ho ba no mu biako.  

Mfe  pii ni no, Odwira Afahyɛ no ayɛ ade titiriw a wɔde da Ghana amammerɛ adi a ɛyɛ kɔla, ɛyɛ hyew na egu ahorow, na ɛka nnipa a wofi asetra mu tebea horɔw nyinaa mu bom di nkonimdi, aseda ne otwa asɛmti ahorɔw ho afahyɛ, wɔ biakoyɛ mu. Nanso, ansa na Odwira rebɛyɛ Ghana amammerɛ fã mpo no, na nnipa a wɔwɔ Akropong, Amankrom ne Aburi a ɛwɔ Apuei Fam Mantam mu no adi ho afahyɛ bere tenten.

Amammerɛ mu dwumadi atitiriw 

 (Dwoada) Da a wɔde tew wɔn ho

Ɔkwan a ɛkɔ Amanprobi no a wɔbɛprapra – atraeɛ a ɛdi kan a Akyem akofoɔ a Nana Safori di wɔn anim, a ɔkɔɔ so bɛyɛɛ Okuapehene a Odi kan wɔ afe 1733 mu de sii hɔ wɔ afe 1730 mu. Saa kokoam tete amanneɛ yi, Abrafoɔ (Ɔman Awudifo) ne wɔn Panyin, Adumhene na wodi anim. Wɔde Odwira no ba denam Ahenni no ho a wɔde nhabannuru tew so.

 (Benada) Da a wɔtwa 

Bayerɛ foforo a wotwa ho ɔyɛkyerɛ a wɔde fa Akropong, Okuapeman ahenkurow no mmɔnten atitiriw so a nnwom, sankubɔ ne asaw ka ho. Abrafo no gyina bere ne bere mu sɛ wɔbɛbubu bayerɛ foforo no mu asinasin na wɔagyaw wɔ mmɔnten so ma mmɔfra ne afoforo aboaboa ano, kodi. Awiabere no, Abrafofo a wɔwɔ atuo a wɔtotow mu no san kɔ Amanprobi kɔyɛ kokoam amanne ahorɔw na afei wɔde Odwira no ma Okuapehene a ɔne n'abediakyire ne mpanyimfo nketewa afoforo bɛtra ɔman mu wɔ Ahemfie hɔ no wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfata so. Sɛ wodu Ahemfie hɔ a, Abrafofoɔ no foro kɔ Okuapehene a wɔde amammerɛ ntama bɛkata wɔn so no nkyɛn tẽẽ. Etuo a wɔtow denneennen, sankubɔ ne asaw wie da a wɔde di dwuma wɔ amanne kwan so no.

title: Lingua Franca Nova
text:
Lingua Franca Nova, a wɔatwa no tiaa sɛ LFN na wɔfrɛ no wɔ kasa mu sɛ Elefen, yɛ kasa a wɔasi a ɛboa a C. George Boeree a ɔwɔ Shippensburg Sukuupɔn, Pennsylvania, na ɔyɛɛ no mfiase no, na wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no mu pii na wɔkɔɔ so yɛɛ no.

Lingua Franca Nova (“Elefen”) yɛ kasa a wɔayɛ sɛ ɛnyɛ den titiri, ɛnyɛ deɛ ɛkɔ so daa, na ɛnyɛ den sɛ wobɛsua ama amanaman ntɛm nkitahodie. Ɛwɔ su pa ahodoɔ bi:
 Ɛwɔ ɛnne nnyegyeɛ dodoɔ bi wɔm. Ɛte sɛ Italian anaa Spanish kasa.
 Wɔka no wɔ ɛnne nnyegyeɛ mu. Ɛnsɛ sɛ abofra biara de mfeɛ pii sua nnoɔma a ɛnkɔ so daa.
 Ɛwɔ kasa mmara a wɔde di dwuma daa, te sɛ wiase creolefo.
 Ɛwɔ nsɛmfua a wɔde hyɛ mu a ɛso aba a wɔde di dwuma ma nsɛmfua a wɔnya no.
 Ɛwɔ mmara a wɔakyerɛkyerɛ mu yie a ɛfa nsɛmfua nhyehyɛeɛ ho, a ɛne kasa atitiri pii hyia.
 Ne nsɛmfua a wɔde di dwuma no agye ntini denneennen wɔ nnɛyi Romance kasa ahodoɔ mu. Saa kasa ahodoɔ yi ankasa atrɛ na ɛwɔ nkɛntɛnso, na deɛ ɛka ho no, wɔde Engiresi kasa mu nsɛmfua fa titiri no aboa.
 Wɔayɛ no sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛgye Latin ne Greek mfidi dwuma ho nsɛm foforo, de facto “wiase gyinapɛn” ato mu.
 Wɔayɛ no te sɛ deɛ ɛyɛ “abɔdeɛ mu deɛ” sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a ɛbɛboa wɔn a wɔnim Romance kasa ahodoɔ no, a ɛnyɛ den mma afoforo sɛ wobɛsua.

title: Safia Abdul Rahman
text:

title: Elizabeth Addo
text:
Elizabeth Addo (wɔwoo no 1 Ɔpɛpɔn 1993) yɛ Ghana bɔɔlbɔfoɔ a ɔbɔ sɛ anim ma Djurgårdens IF a ɛwɔ Sweden Damallsvenskan . Ɔsan nso yɛ Ghana mmea ɔman bɔɔlbɔ kuw no panyin .

Club adwuma 
Addo hyɛɛ n'adwuma ase wɔ Ghana, ɔbɔɔ bɔɔl maa Tesano Ladies FC wɔ afe 2003 mu na akyiri yi ɔde ne nsa hyɛɛ Athleta Ladies FC a wɔfrɛ no mpɔtam hɔ sɛ "Ashaiman Ladies" a ɛwɔ Ashaiman wɔ afe 2007–2012 mu. Ɔdii mfeɛ mmienu wɔ hɔ na akyiri yi ɔde ne ho kɔbɔɔ Nigeriafoɔ kuo kɛseɛ Rivers Angels FC firi afe 2012 kɔsi afe 2014. Ne dwumadie no boaa ekuo no ma wɔdii nkonim wɔ 2012/2013 Nigeria Mmea Bɔɔlbɔ Kuo ne 2013/2014 Nigeria Mmea Bɔɔlbɔ Kuo a ɛhyɛ Rivers Angels FC Manager Edwin Okon ase. Port Harcourt mmea no, bɔɔ kan no mmɔho abien wɔ simma 56 mu bere a wɔde wɔn ho wɔn ho dii agoru fɛfɛɛfɛ wɔ Amazon adaka a ɛwɔ anammɔn 18 mu no, Addo bɔɔ bɔɔl no.

Addo san kɔɔ Ghana wɔ afe 2014 mu na akyiri yi ɔde ne ho kɔbɔɔ ŽFK Spartak Subotica wɔ Serbia afe korɔ no ara.

Ferencvárosi T. C., 2015. Ɔde ne nsa kyerɛɛ ne so 
Wɔ afe 2015 mu no, Addo san kɔɔ Europa na ɔde ne ho kɔbɔɔ Hungary adwumakuw kɛse Ferencvárosi TC wɔ Budapest Hungary . Na ɔyɛ kuw a edi kan no fã titiriw wɔ ɔpanyin Balázs Dörnyei ase na odii nkonim wɔ 2015/2016 Hungary Női NB I league abodin ne Hungary Mmea Kuruwa mu wɔ afe 2016.

Wobuu Addo sɛ kuw no mu agodifo baasa a wɔsen biara no mu biako. Ɔdii agorɔ 27 wɔ apam mu na ɔbɔɔ bɔɔl 17 boaa ne kuw no ma wɔdii nkonim wɔ Hungary Női NB I League akansi no mu. Ɔbɔɔ bɔɔl a ɛma ɛyɛ pɛ wɔ simma 89 mu wɔ akansifo MTK a ɛdanee nkontabuo kwan no Ferencvárosi TC 1 – 1 MTK . Ne botae a ɔde bɔɔ no pɛpɛɛpɛ no boaa ne kuw no ma wɔfatae sɛ wɔde asotwe maa Hungary FA Cup awiei. Ɔdii agorɔ simma 90 no nyinaa maa n’afã no dii Honved so nkonim 5–0 wɔ awieɛ no mu.

Addo bɔɔ bɔɔl maa Club Ferencváros wɔ 2015–16 UEFA Mmea Champions League na ɔdii kan wɔ kuw no mu.  Wɔ afe 2016 mu no, Addo yɛ agofomma baasa a wɔpaw wɔn tiawa maa 2015/2016 Női NB I Mmea Bɔɔlbɔfo a Ɔsen Biara wɔ Afe no mu abasobɔde no mu biako.

Kvarnsvedens I. K., 2016–2017 
Wɔ August 2016 mu no, Damallsvenskan League kuw Kvarnsvedens IK gyee Addo a na ɔde ne ho abɔ kuw no wɔ kwa.  Addo ayɛ nwonwa yiye wɔ Sweden Damallsvenskan league, Ɛde besi ha no wadi agoru 8 abɔ bɔɔl 5 ama Kvarnsvedens IK ( Ɔbɔɔ sɛ mfinimfini mfinimfini bɔɔlbɔfo wɔ Damallsvenskan league agodie 7 no mu na ɔbɔɔ 1, ɔboaa bɔɔl 2, ɔbɔɔ asotwe 2 wɔ agoru biara mu na ɔbɔɔ bɔɔl 4 wɔ Sweden FA Cup no mu. Ɔmaa wɔhyɛɛ ne din agyirae wɔ Sweden Damallsvenskan Best XII wɔ bosome September 2016 mu.

Seattle Ahenni, 2018 
Na Addo de ne nsa ahyɛ apam ase sɛ ɔbɛka Boston Breakers ho wɔ NWSL, nanso Breakers no bobɔɔ mu ansa na 2018 bere no reba. Seattle Reign na wɔpaw no wɔ Dispersal Draft mu a na 8th pick no.

Atɔe Fam Sydney Wanderers, 2018 (boseabɔ) 
Wɔ 11 Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 2018 no, wɔde Addo hyɛɛ aseɛ sɛ ɔrebɔ bosea ama Western Sydney Wanderers maa W-League 2018–2019 berɛ no.

Jiangsu Suning na ɔkyerɛwee 
Wɔ Ayɛwohomumɔ 2019 mu no, Chinafoɔ Mmea Super League kuw Jiangsu Suning de ne nsa hyɛɛ aseɛ wɔ afe 1 apam mu wɔ berɛ a ɔne Seattle Reign tetew mu wɔ berɛ a n’apam baa awieeɛ wɔ baabi a ɔde ne ho bɔɔ ne kan mfɛfoɔ, Tabitha Chawinga wɔ Sweden kuo Kvarnsvedens.  Ne tena a ɔne kuw no tenae no baa awiei ntɛmntɛm sen sɛnea ɛsɛ sɛ ɛyɛ awerɛhosɛm ne sɛ esiane COVID-19 ɔyaredɔm a ɛbaa afe 2020 mu nti. Bere a ɔwɔ kurow no mu no ɔdii agorɔ 14, ɔbɔɔ bɔɔl mpɛn 5 na ɔboaa 10.  Wɔ saa bere tiaa a ɔne kuw no dii mu no odii nkonim 4, The Chinese Women’s League, Women’s FA Cup, FA Tournament ne Women’s Super Cup. do yɛ kuw a wɔde 2nd wɔ AFC Women’s Club Championship a edi kan wɔ ne debut bere mu no fã titiriw.

Apollon Mmea 
Bere a ɔdii agorɔ afe baako wɔ China Mmea Super League Addo akyi no, ɔde ne nsa hyɛɛ Cypriot top-flight team Apollon Ladies FC ase wɔ afe 2020. Addo dii kan maa Cyprus kuw Apollon Ladies FC wɔ 4 November 2020 wɔ wɔn nkonimdi 3–0 wɔ Swansea Ladies so wɔ UEFA Women’s Champions League a edi kan a wɔde bɛkɔ no mu.

North Carolina Akokoduru, 2021– 2021. 
Wɔ 18 Ɔbɛnem 2021 no, Addo san kɔɔ United States wɔ bere a ɔkɔɔ National Women’s Soccer League club North Carolina Courage mu wɔ afe biako apam mu, a na ɔwɔ hokwan sɛ ɔbɛtrɛw mu asram 12.

Amanaman ntam adwuma

Mmabun kuw 
Addo ayɛ amanaman ntam bɔɔlbɔfoɔ a ɔdi mu ama Ghana firi afe 2007. Bere a odii mfe 14 no, ɔne ɔman kuw a wonnii mfe 14 no dii agoru wɔ 2007 FIFA Mmea a wonnii mfe 14 Wiase Kupɔn a wɔyɛe wɔ Switzerland no mu na ɔyɛɛ kuw no panyin koduu nea etwa to na awiei koraa no wodii nkonim .

Ɔyɛɛ Ghana captain wɔ 2008 FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup a wɔyɛɛ no New Zealand na na ɔyɛ captain abadiakyiri maa Ghana U-17 mmea kuw (Black Maidens) wɔ 2010 2010 FIFA U-17 Women's World Cup . Addo kaa ɔman kuo a wɔsii akan wɔ 2010 FIFA U-20 Mmea Wiase Kupɔn a wɔyɛɛ no Germany  na wɔsii akan wɔ 2012 FIFA U-20 Mmea Wiase Kupɔn a wɔyɛɛ no Japan .

Senior kuw 
Ɔsan nso ka ɔman kuo a wɔsii akan wɔ 2014 African Women’s Championship qualification mu no ho . Na ɔka Ghana Squared a ɛne Cameroon hyiae wɔ 2016 Rio Olympic Games qualifier mu wɔ Accra Sports Stadium -Ghana Ɔdii agorɔ wɔ adamfofa akansi bi mu ne Germany wɔ 22 July 2016. 12 April 2016, ɔdii dwuma titire wɔ Ghana qualifying for the 2016 Afrika Mmea Kuruwa a Wɔde Di Dwuma . Ɔdii Ghana kuo no anim sɛ captain kɔɔ Dibea a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa wɔ 2016 Africa Women Cup of Nations mu . Ɔnyaa man of the matches abasobɔdeɛ mmienu na ɔbɔɔ bɔɔl 3 wɔ Tournament no mu de wiee sɛ 3rd top scorer ne top scorer maa Ghana kuo no. Esiane ne nnwuma akɛseɛ wɔ akansi no mu nti wɔbɔɔ ne din wɔ Team of the Tournament no mu. Na ɔka Ghana kuw a wɔkɔɔ 2018 Africa Women Cup of Nations a wɔyɛɛ no Ghana no ho. Wɔ March 2020 mu no, na ɔka Ghana kuo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛɛ 2020 Turkish Women’s Cup a ɛyɛ afe afe mmaa bɔɔlbɔ akansi a wɔto nsa frɛ wɔn a wɔdi wɔ Turkey no ho. Ɔdii ekuo no anim ma wɔdii 2nd wɔ wɔn kuw no mu berɛ a ɔdii 3rd wɔ ne nyinaa mu wɔ akansi no mu de nyaa kɔbere nkonimboɔ ne nkonimboɔ.

title: Vivian Adjei
text:
Vivian Konadu Adjei (wɔwoo no 14 Ɔbɛnem 2000) yɛ Ghana bɔɔlbɔfoɔ a ɔbɔ sɛ anim ma Ghana mmaa ɔman kuo .

Mfitiase asetra 
Ɔyɛ Techiman kuromni wɔ Bono Apuei Fam Mantam mu wɔ Ghana, Adjei nyaa ne ntoaso sukuu a ɛyɛ kumaa ne mpanyin wɔ Kumasi Agumadi Adesuabea JHS ne SHS. Kumasi Agumadi Adesuabea yɛ bɔɔlbɔ adesua a ɛma bɔɔlbɔfo nkumaa nya nhomasua hokwan bere a wɔrenya nkɔso sɛ bɔɔlbɔfo.

Club adwuma 
Adjei fii n'adwuma ase wɔ Ghana Women's Premier League kuw Kumasi Sports Academy Ladies .  Akyiri yi ɔde ne ho bɔɔ Thunder Queens na ɔbɔɔ bɔɔl nson wɔ 2020–21 Ghana Mmea Premier League a ɛde afe no baa awiei sɛ kurow no mu bɔɔlbɔfo a ɔsen biara. Nea ɛda nsow kɛse wɔ saa botae ahorow no mu ne bere a wɔbɔɔ bɔɔl a ɛkɔ akyiri wɔ simma 85 mu de maa Thunder Queens dii nkonim 2-1 wɔ Immigration Ladies so wɔ 5 May 2021.  Wobuu no atɛn sɛ ɔbea a ɔsen biara wɔ akansi no mu wɔ simma 90 no awiei.

Amanaman ntam adwuma

Babunu 
Adjei abɔ bɔɔl ama Ghana wɔ U17 ne senior level. Wɔ afe 2016 mu no, ɔgyinaa Ghana U-17 ananmu wɔ 2016 FIFA U-17 Mmea Wiase Kupɔn no mu a ɔne agofoɔ te sɛ Sandra Owusu-Ansah . Ɔdii agorɔ mprɛnsa berɛ a South Korea yii Ghana wɔ quarter-finals .

Panin 
Wɔ July 2021 mu no, Adjei yɛɛ kuw a wɔde bɛkɔ Aisha Buhari Cup ne 2022 Africa Women Cup of Nations akansi a wɔne Nigeria bedi .  Ɔdii kan dii kan wɔ Aisha Buhari Cup akansi bi mu ne Cameroon mmaa ɔman kuo wɔ 20 September 2021. Ɔhyɛɛ nea edi kan no agyirae denam ne botae a edi kan a ɔbɔe wɔ simma 89 mu de boaa Ghana ma wodii nkonim 2-0.

title: Ophelia Serwaa Amponsah
text:
Ophelia Serwaa Amponsah yɛ Ghana bɔɔlbɔfoɔ a ɔyɛ adwumaden a ɔbɔ sɛ anim ma Ghana Mmea Premier League kuw Ampem Darkoa Ladies ne Ghana mmaa ɔman bɔɔlbɔ kuo . Ɔyɛ obi a ɔbɔ bɔɔl sen biara wɔ 2020–21 bere no mu. Wɔbuu no sɛ Mmea bɔɔlbɔfoɔ a ɔsen biara wɔ afe 2021.

Club adwuma 
Pokuaa bɛkaa Ampem Darkoa Ladies ho wɔ afe 2019 mu. Ɔbɔɔ bɔɔl 10 wɔ nhyiamu 5 mu wɔ afe 2019–20 berɛ no mu ansa na wɔretwa apam no mu. Afe a edi hɔ no, 2020–21 bere, ɔbɔɔ bɔɔl 17 de baa awiei sɛ nea ɔbɔ bɔɔl sen biara.

Amanaman ntam adwuma 
Wɔ afe 2020 mu, wɔ bere a ɛyɛ nwonwa a ɔne Ampem Darkoa dii akyi no, wɔbɔɔ ne din wɔ Ghana U17 mmea kuw (Abibifo Nkokoaa) kuw no mu ansa na wɔredi wɔn 2020 African U-17 Women’s World Cup Qualifying Tournament . Ɔbɔɔ bɔɔl wɔ ne debut a ɔne Liberia dii no mu de boaa Ghana ma wodii nkonim 2-0. Wɔ sanba nan mu no, ɔbɔɔ bɔɔl 4 wɔ fã a edi kan no mu wɔ nkonimdi a ɛyɛ anigye 8–0 mu.  Wɔtwaa qualifiers no mu wɔ afe 2020 mu ɛnam COVID-19 ɔyaredɔm nti nanso ɔwieeɛ sɛ nea ɔbɔɔ bɔɔl paa a ɔbɔɔ bɔɔl 5 wɔ agodie 2 mu. Wɔfrɛɛ no nea edi kan wɔ Ghana mmea ɔman bɔɔlbɔ kuw no mu wɔ afe 2020 mu maa 2020 CAF Mmea Olympic Qualifying Tournament .

title: Gifty Ayew Asare
text:
Gifty Ayew Asare (wɔwoo no 9 June 1998) yɛ Ghana bɔɔlbɔfo a ɔbɔ sɛ ɔbɔfoɔ. Wɔ afe 2018 mu no, wɔfrɛɛ no sɛ ɔmmɛbɔ mma Black Queens, Ghana mmaa ɔman bɔɔlbɔ kuo, berɛ a ɔbɔɔ bɔɔl 27 wɔ agodie 19 mu maa Northern Oklahoma College Lady Maverick FC Bɔɔlbɔ Kuo no.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Gifty maa wɔ Accra . Ɔkɔɔ Assin Manso Senior High School, Asuanse Technical Institute na ɔwiee Blessed Tutorial College maa ne cycle adesua a ɛtɔ so mmienu. Ɔkɔɔ so suaa Akwahosan, Apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ, ne Ahomegye ho ade wɔ Northern Oklahoma College .

Club adwuma 
Gifty fii ne bɔɔlbɔ adwuma ase bere a ɔbɔɔ bɔɔl maa PSK Soccer Queens Academy wɔ Komenda . Ɔde ne ho bɔɔ Bafana Ladies (mprempren Sealions FC) fi afe 2011 kosi afe 2013 ansa na ɔretu akɔ Samaria Ladies wɔ Lapaz . Akyiri yi ɔde ne ho bɔɔ Blessed Ladies FC wɔ Ghana Women's Premier League mu wɔ afe 2014/2015 bere mu.

Wɔ afe 2016 mu no, ɔnyaa sika a ɔde bɛtoa ne nwomasua so wɔ Northern Oklahoma College, baabi a ɔdii agorɔ maa sukuu no mmaa bɔɔlbɔ kuo, Lady Maverick FC na ɔnyaa Most Valuable Player Award wɔ afe 2017. Wɔsan nso paw no sɛ All-American Third Team wɔ wɔn 2017 NJCAA Division One Women’s League mu.

Wɔ afe 2017 mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ bɔɔlbɔfoɔ a ɔdi kan a ɔde ne ho hyɛɛ Miss Ghana USA mu.

Amanaman ntam adwuma 
Wɔ afe 2014 mu no, wɔmaa no ɔman asɛdeɛ a ɛdi kan sɛ ɔnkɔbɔ bɔɔl mma Black Maidens ansa na U17 World Cup a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ Costa Rica no reba nanso wantwa no. Wɔ afe 2017 mu no, saa bere no Black Queens ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo Dramani Mas-Ud Didi frɛɛ no wɔ ne bere tiaa mu kuw a emufo yɛ 28 mu sɛ ɔrekɔ nsraban mu ansa na amanaman ntam adamfofa akansi a wɔne France bedi wɔ October 23 wɔ Paris no reba.

title: Gifty Assifuah
text:
Gifty Assifuah (wɔwoo no 23 Ɔpɛpɔn 2000) yɛ Ghana bɔɔlbɔfo a ɔyɛ adwumaden, a ɔbɔ sɛ anim ma 1207 Antalya Spor wɔ Turkey Mmea Bɔɔlbɔ Super League .

Ankorankoro asetra 
Wɔwoo Gifty Assifuah wɔ Accra, Ghana.  Wɔsɛn n’awoda wɔ bagua mu fi 23 July 1998 kosii da koro no ara wɔ 2000 mu fi 5 July 2017.

Club adwuma

Esiane sɛ ɔyɛ forward, ɔbɔɔ bɔɔl maa Sekondi Hasaacas (2018–2019),   Halifax Ladies (2019–2020) ne Hasaacas Ladies (2020–2021) wɔ ne man mu.       hyɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu.

Wɔ afe 2021 mu no, ɔtu kɔɔ Turkey na ɔde ne ho kɔbɔɔ 1207 Antalya Spor sɛ ɔrekɔbɔ wɔ Turkey Mmea Bɔɔlbɔ Super League Ɔbɔɔ ne kuo no botaeɛ baako pɛ wɔ berɛ a wɔde kaa ho no mu, ne kuo no botaeɛ a ɛdi kan wɔ 2021-22 apam berɛ no mu akansi a ɛdi kan ne nkonimdie mu.

title: Edem Atovor
text:
Edem Atovor (wɔwoo no 10 Ayɛwohomumɔ 1994) yɛ Ghana bɔɔlbɔfo . Ɔdii agorɔ maa Lady Strikers, Maccabi Kishronot Hadera FC ne Ghana mmaa ɔman kuo, na seesei ɔbɔ ma Israel Kuo Hapoel Petah Tikva .

Adwuma

Club 
Atovor fii n'adwuma ase wɔ afe 2005 mu wɔ Ghatel Ladies a ɛwɔ Cape Coast no mu . Wɔ afe 2007 mu no, otu kɔɔ mpanyimfo kuw no mu. Mfeɛ mmiɛnsa akyi wɔ Ghatel Ladies wɔ Ghana league a ɛkorɔn mu no, ɔdan kɔɔ Cape Coast Vodafone Ladies. Afei bere bi wɔ zone Three Women’s League ma Vodafone Ladies, ɔsesaa 2011 kɔɔ kurow no akansifo Lady Strikers . Ɛhɔ na wantumi annyina ano na ɛno nti ɔsesaeɛ berɛ a afe 2012 berɛ no hyɛɛ aseɛ wɔ bosea a ɛfiri Lady Strikers hɔ, kɔɔ ne kan mmabun kuo Cape Coast Ghatel Ladies.  Saa bere yi, odii ne bere a odii yiye sen biara no ho afahyɛ na wɔde no too gua sɛ ɔmmɛgye Shield National Player Award sɛ 3 a wɔyɛ Most Valuable Players a wɔsen biara wɔ bere no mu no mu biako. Wɔyii no sɛ ɔmmɛgye Shield Ɔman Agodifoɔ Abasobɔdeɛ. Wɔ abasobɔde a edidi so yi mu wɔ Ɔman Apontow Asa so wɔ Accra, wɔmaa no Shield NP Abasobɔde sɛ Ɔbea Agodifo a Wɔahyira Ne Ho So Sen Biara. Afei ɔsan kɔɔ Lady Strikers kuw no nkyɛn.

Amansan 
Atovor de ne ho hyɛɛ Mmea 2008 U-17 Wiase Kupɔn mu ne Black Princess wɔ 2010 U-20 Wiase Kupɔn mu . Efi afe 2011 no wayɛ Ghana mmea ɔman kuw no muni .

title: Alice Kusi
text:
Alice Kusi (wɔwoo no 12 Ɔbɛnem 1995) yɛ Ghana bɔɔlbɔni a ɔbɔ sɛ mfimfini bɔɔlbɔfo ma Serbia kuo Spartak Subotica ne Ghana ɔman kuo . Ɔsii akan maa Ghana wɔ 2018 Africa Women Cup of Nations, ɔdii agorɔ wɔ akansi mmiɛnsa mu.

Club adwuma 
Ɔhyɛɛ n’adwuma ase wɔ Ghana wɔ Fabulous Ladies, Kusi tu kɔɔ Lebanon-based Zouk Mosbeh wɔ afe 2017 mu baako afe baako apam. Wɔ ne bere koro pɛ mu wɔ Lebanon no, odii nkonim wɔ league, kuruwa ne Super Cup, na wɔbɔɔ no abotiri sɛ nea ɔbɔɔ bɔɔl sen biara wɔ apam no mu. Kusi san kɔɔ Fabulous Ladies wɔ afe 2018 mu afe baako.

Wɔ 27 May 2019 no, Kusi tu kɔɔ Jordanfoɔ akansifoɔ Shabab Al-Ordon nkyɛn wɔ afe baako apam mu. Odii nkonim wɔ WAFF Mmea Kuw Nkonimdi a edi kan no mu sɛ akansi no mu bɔɔlbɔfo a ɔsen biara, na ɔbɔɔ bɔɔl akron wɔ akansi anan mu.

Wɔ 17 Ɔbɛnem 2020 no, Kusi san kɔɔ Lebanon, ɔde ne nsa hyɛɛ aseɛ maa Safa mfimfini 2019–20 berɛ . Ɔbɔɔ hat-trick maa ne kuo foforɔ no nnansa pɛ akyi, wɔ Stars of South so wɔ nkonimdie 5-0 mu. Kusi de bɔɔl 13 baa awiei wɔ bere ason mu, na ɔboaa n’afa no ma wɔdii nea ɛto so abien wɔ apam no mu.

Ɔde ne ho bɔɔ Serbia kuw Spartak Subotica ansa na 2021–22 bere no reba, na ɔde ne ho hyɛɛ UEFA Mmea Champions League .

title: Nina Norshie
text:
Nina Norshie (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn 14 2001) yɛ Ghana bɔɔlbɔni a ɔbɔ ma Berry Ladies, KC ne Ghana mmaa ɔman kuo.

Club adwuma 
Norshie hyɛɛ n’adwuma ase wɔ Valued Girls bere a na ɔka Ghana U17 kuw no ho wɔ afe 2015 ne 2019 ntam. Wɔ February mu no 2019, Norshie ne agodifoɔ mmienu foforɔ a wɔfiri Valued Girls no, Nigeria kuo Edo Queens de wɔn nsa hyɛɛ aseɛ sɛ wɔbɛbɔ bosea asram nsia.  Akyiri yi ɔgyaee kuro no daa na ɔde ne ho kɔbɔɔ Ghana Women’s Premier League kuw Berry Ladies wɔ afe 2020 mu. Wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn da a ɛtɔ so 18 no 2021, ɔyɛɛ ne debut wɔ nkonimdie 3–2 wɔ Immigration Ladies so. Ɔhyɛɛ aseɛ, ɔdii agorɔ simma 90 no nyinaa na ɔbɔɔ ne botaeɛ a ɛdi kan a ɛyɛ botaeɛ a ɛdi kan wɔ 2020–21 Ghana Mmea Premier League berɛ no mu.  Wɔ May mu no Afe 2022 mu no, Norshie kɔkaa KC Courage a ɛwɔ United Women Soccer League no ho. Ɔhyɛɛ aseɛ na ɔdii agorɔ simma 90 nyinaa wɔ afe 2022 berɛ no nyinaa mu. Wɔbɔɔ ne din sɛ United Women’s Soccer All-Central Conference First Team ne Iron Woman a ɔsen biara wɔ afe no mu (simma dodow no ara a wodii).

Amanaman ntam adwuma 
Norshie bɔɔ bɔɔl maa Ghana wɔ U17 ne U20 nyinaa. Wɔ U17 level no, ɔgyinaa Ghana ananmu wɔ 2016 FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup ne 2018 FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup, wɔ saa kwan yi so no ɔdii agorɔ 4 wɔ deɛ ɛtwa toɔ no mu.  Wɔ afe 2016 kuo no mu no ɔne Sandra Owusu-Ansah dii agorɔ berɛ a ɔne Mukarama Abdulai ne Millot Pokuaa dii agorɔ wɔ afe 2018 mu. Ɔsan nso yɛɛ ɔsraani panyin abadiakyiri maa U17 kuw no. Wɔ August 2020 mu no, wɔmaa no dibea kɔɔ U20 kuw a Yusif Basigi rekyerɛ wɔn kwan no mu. Ɔnyaa frɛ sɛ ɔmmra kuo no mu maa 2020 FIFA U-20 World Cup qualifying matches ne adamfofa akansi a wɔne Morocco bɛbɔ wɔ August ne October 2020 ntam

Norshie nyaa ne frɛ a edi kan a wɔfrɛɛ ɔman kuw a wɔyɛ mpanyimfo wɔ July mu 2021 ansa na Aisha Buhari Kuruwa ne 2022 Afrika Mmea Kuruwa a wɔde bɛkɔ akɔto gua a wɔne Nigeria bedi . Ɔdii kan dii kan wɔ amanaman ntam wɔ Aisha Buhari Kuruwa adamfofa akansi bi mu ne South Africa mmaa ɔman kuo wɔ 17 September 2021.

title: Sonia Opoku
text:
Sonia Opoku (wɔwoo no 25 December 2001) yɛ Ghana bɔɔlbɔni ,ɔbɔ mfimfini bɔɔl wɔ Turkey kuo 1207 Antalya Spor, ne Ghana mmaa ɔman kuo . Kan no na ɔbɔ bɔɔl ma Ghana kuw Ampem Darkoa Ladies .

Club adwuma 
Opoku hyɛɛ n’adwuma ase wɔ Ampem Darkoa Ladies. Wɔ afe 2017 mu no, opirae a ɛmaa ɔkɔɔ mu bɛyɛ mfeɛ mmiɛnsa kɔsii afe 2019 mu berɛ a wɔyɛɛ no oprehyɛn na ne ho tɔɔ no. Ɔsan baa agodie mu wɔ afe 2020 mu wɔ afe 2020–21 Ghana Mmea Premier League bere mu. Opoku dii dwuma titiriw wɔ ne sanba no mu denam Ampem Darkoa a ɔboaa no ma odii kan wɔ Northern Zone league no mu na ɔfatae sɛ ɔbɛkɔ play-off final no so . Nanso Ampem Darko dii nkogu wɔ awieɛ no mu wɔ Hasaacas Ladies a wɔdii nkoguo 2-0. Wɔbuu Opoku sɛ NASCO agodini a ɔsen biara wɔ bɔɔlbɔ no mu esiane ne dwumadi kɛse nti ɛwom mpo sɛ ne kuw no dii nkogu de.

Wɔ Ghana Women's FA Cup mu no, ɔsan nso dii dwuma titiriw ma Ampem-Darkoa yɛɛ final denam nkonimdi botae a ɔbɔɔ wɔ wɔn semi-final fixture a wɔne Thunder Queens dii no so. Ɔbɔɔ bɔɔl no wɔ simma 92 mu wɔ bere a wɔde kaa ho no mu bere a bɔɔlbɔ no kɔɔ so yɛɛ nea wɔantumi anbɔ bɔɔl wɔ bere nyinaa mu akyi. Wɔ FA Cup awiei no, Ampem Darkoa dii nkogu wɔ awiei no mu bio wɔ Hasaacas Ladies anim 2-0. Nanso wɔbuu Opoku sɛ ɔno na ɔbɔɔ bɔɔl a ɔsen biara wɔ afe no mu.

Eduu March 2022 no, ɔtu kɔɔ Turkey na ɔde ne nsa hyɛɛ Trabzonspor ase sɛ ɔrekɔbɔ wɔ 2021-22 Turkey Mmea Super League bere no fã a ɛtɔ so mmienu no mu. Wɔ {{2022-23 Turkey Mmea Bɔɔlbɔ Super League|afe a edi hɔ]] mu no, ɔdan kɔɔ 1207 Antalya Spor .

Amanaman ntam adwuma 
Opoku yɛ Ghana U-17 mmaa kuo no muni firi afe 2016 kɔsi afe 2018. En route to the 2016 FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup, ɔnyaa ACL opira wɔ wɔn nteteeɛ nsraban a ɛtwa toɔ a ɛde hokwan a ɔwɔ sɛ ɔbɛkɔ akansi no mu no baa awieeɛ.  Esiane sɛ na opira no san ba bio nti wɔamma no ankɔ 2018 FIFA U-17 Mmea Wiase Kupɔn no mu bere a na ɔka kuw no ho wɔ bere a edi kan a wɔde fata no mu no.

Opoku nyaa ne ɔman kuo a ɛdi kan a wɔfrɛɛ no wɔ July 2021 mu ansa na Aisha Buhari Cup ne 2022 Africa Women Cup of Nations qualifiers a wɔne Nigeria bedi . Ɔdii kan dii kan wɔ amanaman ntam wɔ Aisha Buhari Kuruwa adamfofa akansi bi mu ne South Africa mmaa ɔman kuo wɔ 17 September 2021.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Sonia Opoku wɔ nipasu ne asetra kwan a ɛte sɛ Neymar Jr a ofi PSG no ara pɛ. Nkurɔfo taa frɛ no, Neymar Jr, esiane ɔkwan bi a wɔfa so di agoru nti.ɔyɛ obi a ɔdɔ no wɔ abɔnten ne abɔnten so
