title: Xwalile
text:
Bere bi na Xwalile yɛ Lobengula, Ndebelefo hene wɔ nnɛyi Zimbabwe yere kɛse . Wonnim nna a wɔwoo no ne bere a owui, nanso wonim sɛ anyɛ yiye koraa no, ɔtraa ase fi 1870 mfe no mu kosi 1890 mfe no mu.

Mzila, Gazafoɔ hene babaa, Xwalile waree Lobengula wɔ afe 1879 mu; Gaza adehye mmea afoforo baason waree no wɔ guasodeyɛ koro no ara mu, na wɔyɛɛ no sɛ adehye yerenom a wɔde bɛsesa wɔn ho wɔn ho. Ankyɛ na ntawntawdi a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ ayeforo sika a wotua ho no de ɔhaw baa aware no mu, na saa ara na nokwasɛm a ɛyɛ sɛ na Ndebele mmea a wɔbɛware Mzila de sesa no ho ayɛ na no. Bio nso, ɔdaa ne ho adi sɛ ontumi nwo. Awiei koraa no, wɔhyɛɛ Xwalile ma ɔsan kɔɔ fie; ebia na abayisɛm a n’asew Mncengence a na wobekum no wɔ 1880 mu esiane ne nneyɛe nti no yɛɛ no tiaa no no fa bi.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Akheqa
text:
Na Akheqa yɛ Nubia hemmaa a na ɔwɔ Misrifo abodin sɛ ɔhene yere ne ɔhene nuabea . Wonnim n’ahemfie kunu no yiye. Ebia na ɔyɛ Aspelta babea ne Aramatle-qo yere, sɛnea Dows Dunham ne M. F. Laming Macadam hyɛɛ nyansa no. 

Wonim Akheqa fi n’asie wɔ Nuri nkutoo (Nu. 38) Na n’asie no yɛ pyramid a asɔredan ketewa bi wɔ n’anim. Antweri bi wɔ hɔ a esian kɔ amusiei adan abien a wohuu sɛ wɔafow nneɛma no mu. Anyɛ yiye koraa no, na ɔhemmaa no shabti mfonini 170 asinasin da so ara wɔ amusiei no mu, na na ɛde ne din ne abodin ahorow ma. Nhoma no ka sɛ ɛkame ayɛ sɛ na wɔne shabtifo no yɛ pɛ  a ɔhemmaa Madiqen yɛe na enti wɔyɛɛ no wɔ adwumayɛbea koro no ara mu. Wohuu ɔhemmaa Nasalsa, ɔhemmaa Madiqen ne Artaha shabtis nso wɔ hɔ .

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Akhrasan
text:
Na Akhrasan yɛ Nubia hemmaa, na ɛde besi nnɛ no, na wonim no fi nea wosiee no wɔ Nuri adehye amusiei nkutoo mu (Nu. 32). Ebia na ɔyɛ ɔhene Malewiebamani yere, ɛwom sɛ wɔansi eyi so dua yiye de. N’abodin biako pɛ a wonim ne ɔhene yere .  Na n’asie no yɛ pyramid ne amusiei adan a ɛwɔ asase ase no. Na antweri bi wɔ hɔ a ɛkɔ asase ase na ɛkɔ amusiei adan abien no mu. Wohuu amusiei no sɛ wɔabɔ korɔn, nanso anyɛ yiye koraa no, wohuu shabti 45 asinasin. Wɔkura ɔhemmaa no din ne abodin. Wohuu nkuku pii ne nneɛma nketenkete nso. /

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Amanikhatashan
text:
Na Amanikhatashan yɛ Kus hemmaa a odi tumi (bɛyɛ afe 62-bɛyɛ afe 85 Y.B.). Sɛ Ɔhemmaa no, na n'abodin a ɛfata ne " Kandake ". Ne pyramid no wɔ Meroe wɔ Sudan. Amanitenmemide (bɛyɛ 50–62) dii n’anim na Teritnide dii n’ade .

Amanikhatashan de mmoa maa Roma wɔ Yudafo ne Romafo Ko a Edi Kan (66-73 Y.B.) mu, na ɔsomaa apɔnkɔsotefo ne ɛbɛyɛ sɛ agyantofo nso.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Amanimalel
text:
Na Amanimalel (a wɔsan yɛ Amanimalēl ne Amanimalil ) yɛ Kushite hemmaa a ɔwɔ Napatan ahemman Nubia, a ɛbɛyɛ sɛ na ɔyɛ ɔhene Senkamanisken a ɔtenaa ase wɔ afeha a ɛto so 7 A.Y.B. Wonim no kɛse fi ne ohoni biako anaa ebia abien a ɛkorɔn yiye mu.

Mmere nnidiso nnidiso ne abusua 
Amanimalel tenaa ase wɔ afeha a ɛto so 7 A.Y.B. Wɔahyɛ da pii ho nyansa sɛ ɔbɛyɛ n’ahemmaa a egyina nea wobuu akontaa maa Senkamanisken nniso no so: 643–623 A.Y.B., [2] anaa 642–623 A.Y.B. [3]

Wosusuw sɛ Amanimael [4] yɛ Senkamanisken ɔhemmaa yere, [5] [6] [7] a na ɔno nso waree ɔhemmaa Nasalsa [6] ne, ebia, Masalaye. [8] Sɛnea ɛte no, Amanimalel betumi ayɛ ahemmaa Asata ne Madekan a wɔwaree ahene Aspelta ne Anlamani, no maame. [6] Nanso wɔgye saa nneɛma a ebetumi aba yi ho akyinnye esiane adanse tẽẽ a enni asɛm no ho nti. Amanimalel awofo nso nnim saa ara, obetumi ayɛ Atlanersa babea . [6]

Adanse ahorow a wɔde ma 

Amanimalel yɛ nea wɔde 141 di ho adanse ɔhemmaa no ohoni a ne kɛse te sɛ nkwa, a George Andrew Reisner hui wɔ April 1916 mu wɔ adekoradan bi mu wɔ Gebel Barkal asɔredan B 500 mu wɔ Harvard Sukuupɔn – Boston Tete Nneɛma Akorae a wɔbom yɛ akwantu bi mu. [9] [5] Ahoni no, Afrika adwinni akɛseɛ no mu baako, [10] kyerɛ ɔhemmaa no wɔ Misraimfoɔ atetesɛm mu anammɔntuo tebea mu, a ɔhyɛ Nubiafoɔ atadeɛ a ɛyɛ Misrifoɔ atadeɛ a anka wɔbɛtumi de dwetɛ akata so berɛ a ebia nan no wɔde sika kɔkɔɔ mpaboa asiesie wɔn ho. [10] ohoni no akyi adum no ka sɛ ɔyɛ "Amun a ofi Napata a ɔte bepɔw kronkron no so dɔfo", a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɔhemmaa no de ne ho hyɛɛ Amun som mu wɔ Napata wɔ dwumadi bi a ebia na ɛne de Onyankopɔn Yere a ɔyɛ Amun a ɔtraa ase wɔ Ahemman a Ɛto so Aduonu Anum a edii ɛno anim no mu . Na nkyerɛwee no wɔ onyamewa bi a ne mfonini asɛe nanso ebia ɛyɛ Mut dea no akwankyerɛ ase . Wɔakyerɛ ɔhemmaa no sɛ okura onyame abofra bi ohoni ketewaa bi a ɔhyɛ abotiri abien a ebia ɔyɛ Khonsu, Amun ba a ɔwɔ Thebes, na ɔnam saayɛ so de ɔhemmaa no bata nnipa baasa Amun, Mut ne Khonsu ho kɛse. [10]

Quartzite ohoni a ɛto so abien a ɛte sɛ nea ɛte no ara wɔ Neues Tete Nneɛma Akorae a ɛwɔ Berlin na wosusuw sɛ ɛyɛ Amanimalel dea esiane sɛnea mfonini abien no nyinaa di nsɛ kɛse nti. [2]

Ɔboda 
Wɔnkyerɛɛ ɔhemmaa Amanimalel ɔboda no yiye. Reisner de nyansahyɛ mae sɛ pyramid 22 a ɛwɔ Nuri adehye amu no yɛ ne dea. Wotutuu pyramid no wɔ 1917 mu. Saa nnwuma yi tutuu sika kɔkɔɔ asinasin, dwetɛ nneɛma nketenkete ne nhwiren. [11]

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Amanipilade
text:
Amanipilade (owui bɛyɛ afe 350 Y.B.), yɛ ɔhemmaa a odii Kush hene . Ɔno ne ɔhemmaa a otwa to a odii ade wɔ Meroë kurow no mu wɔ bɛyɛ afe 308 kosi 320 ntam hɔ 

Amanipilade di adanse fi meroitic nkyerɛwee bi a ɛwɔ Shiye ayi ase nkyerɛwee bi a wohuu wɔ Meroë so nkutoo mu. Wɔbɔɔ n’awofo din nso wɔ hɔ, n’agya; Tekye ne maame; Makehanye.

Ɛbɛyɛ sɛ owui bɛyɛ afe 350 Y.B.  Te sɛ Kus sodifo afoforo no ara pɛ na ne din de onyame Amun de kaa ho .

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Amanirenas
text:
Ɔhemmaa Amanirenas (a wɔsan kyerɛw no Amanirena ), a Strabo kaa ne ho asɛm sɛ n’ani biako ani afura no yɛ Kus Ahemman no hemmaa fi bɛyɛ afe 1000 mu. 40 A.Y.B. 10 A.Y.B. 

N'asɛmti a edi mũ ne Amnirense qore li kdwe li ("Ameniras, qore ne kandake"). Meroitic, Kush ahemman no mu kurom hɔ kasa no da so ara yɛ nea wontumi nhu; nanso nkyerɛwee ahorow a ɛma Ɔhemmaa Amanirenas abodin " qore " ne " kandake " nso kyerɛ sɛ na ɔyɛ ɔhemmaa a odi tumi ankorankoro.

Asetra mu nsɛm 
Ɔhemmaa Amanirenas yɛ Meroitic ahemmaa a wɔagye din sen biara no mu biako esiane dwuma a odii wɔ Kushifo asraafo a wodii wɔn anim tiaa Romafo wɔ ɔko a ɛkɔɔ so mfe abiɛsa (25 A.Y.B. kosi 22 A.Y.B.) mu nti. Ɔko yi na ɛmaa Roma ntrɛwmu a ɛkɔ anafo fam wɔ Afrika no gyaee.  Bere a odii kan dii nkonim wɔ Roma Misraim so akyi no, Ɔsahene Gaius Petronius pam Kus asraafo no fii Misraim na ɔde Roma hye foforo sii hɔ wɔ Hiere Sycaminos ( Maharraq ). 

Strabo kyerɛwtohɔ a ɛfa Meroitic Ko a edii anim tiaa Roma Ahemman no ho no bi ne ɔhemmaa bi a wɔfrɛ no “Candace,” Latin kasa a wɔde kandake . Ne din pue wɔ stelae so ka Teriteqas ne Akinidad de ho, nanso abusuabɔ pɔtee a ɛda saa baasa yi ntam no mu nna hɔ koraa wɔ abakɔsɛm kyerɛwtohɔ no mu; nanso, nhomanimfo taa bu Akinidad sɛ ne ba na Teriteqas yɛ ne kunu.

Strabo Akontaabu (17.53-54) .

Kushifo Ntua a Wɔbaa Misraim 
Sɛnea Strabo kyerɛwtohɔ kyerɛ no, Kushi asraafo no tow hyɛɛ Thebais ne Syene so bere a na saa bere no ɔmampanyin Aelius Gallus wɔ akyirikyiri reko atia wɔ Arabia wɔ afe 25 A.Y.B. Wodii nkonim wɔ Syene, Elephantine ne Philae a wɔfaa no mu . Bere a wɔfaa kurow no, wɔde emufo yɛɛ nkoa na wɔsɛee Kaesare Augusto ahoni . Ɛwom sɛ Strabo nka ho asɛm pɔtee de, nanso wosiee ohoni a ɛte saa no biako ti wɔ asɔrefie bi atrapoe ase, na ɛma wɔkoraa so soronko. Bust no kɔɔ so yɛɛ nea ɛte saa wɔ mfehaha no nyinaa mu na mprempren wɔde akyerɛ wɔ Britania Tete Nneɛma Akorae .

Petronius Nubia Ɔsatu no 
Strabo ka sɛ Gaius Petronius, Misraim ɔmanpanyin foforo no ne “asraafo a wɔnam fam a wonnu mpem du ne apɔnkɔsotefo ahanwɔtwe” nantew tiaa Kus mmarima mpem aduasa wɔ Syene. Kusfo no de “kyɛm akɛse a ɛyɛ tenten a wɔde nantwi nhoma a wɔannoa ayɛ” ne akode a ɛnyɛ den te sɛ agyan, pikes, ne nkrante koe. Esiane eyi nti, Petronius ntua no hyɛɛ wɔn so. Strabo ka Kus asraafo no ho asɛm sɛ “wɔahyehyɛ wɔn ho wɔ ɔkwan a enye so.”

Kus asraafo no kae sɛ wɔn ntua no fi asɛm bi a ɛda nomarchs, Misraim atemmufo panyin a na wɔyɛ atetesɛm mu no ntam; Strabo mfa nea na asɛm no yɛ ho nsɛm mma. Petronius dii nkonim akyi no, Kus asraafo no guan kɔɔ mmeae ahorow: ebinom kɔɔ nkurow akɛse mu, ebinom kɔɔ sare so, na afoforo nso kɔɔ supɔw bi a ɛbɛn hɔ so.

Strabo hu sɛ “wɔn a woguan yi mu ne Ɔhemmaa Kandace, Etiopiafo hemmaa, asraafo mpanyimfo. Ɔka ne ho asɛm sɛ “ɔbea a ɔyɛ ɔbarima, na n’ani biako ani afura.” Ɛkame ayɛ sɛ Strabo reka Amanirenas a na okura abodin kandake no ho asɛm ; "Candace” yɛ Latin kasa a wɔde kyerɛw n'abodin no na ɛnkyerɛ sodifo a ɔyɛ soronko. Bere a Petronius faa asraafo a na wɔreguan no akyi no, ɔsomaa wɔn kɔɔ Alexandria sɛ wɔnkɔtwɛn atemmu.

Amanirenas ankasa ne ne babarima no te Napata . Bere a Petronius bɛn hɔ, na ɔde Pselchis ne Premnis kɔɔ kwan so no, Amanirenas somaa ananmusifo ne nkrasɛm a ɛne sɛ ɔbɛsan de nnommum a wɔfaa wɔn wɔ Syene ne Kaesare ahoni no nyinaa aba. Wobuu wɔn ani guu n’adesrɛ no so na wɔsɛee kurow no. Wɔ nnommum a wɔdaa so tenaa ase a ɔfaa wɔn no mu no, wɔtɔn ebinom na wɔde afoforo kɔɔ Augusto sɛ ɔko mu nneduafo.

Nea ɛbɛyɛ na wɔabua no, Amanirenas dii ntua a ɛto so abien anim tiaa Petronius asraafo a wogyaw wɔn wɔ Premnis no. Strabo ka sɛ na ɔwɔ “mmarima mpempem pii.” Petronius dii Amanirenas so nkonim na odii kan duu Premnis, na ɔbɔɔ ho ban fii ne ntua no ho. Amanirenas somaa ananmusifo, a na Petronius de wɔn akɔ Augusto a ɔbaa hɔ bere bi ansa na wɔretu saa ntua yi nkyɛn no nkyɛn. Augusto amfa tow foforo biara amma na odii ananmusifo no apɛde ho dwuma.

Asomdwoe Apam a Ɛbɛba 
Bere a Petronius Nubia ɔsatu no dii nkonim akyi no, Roma Ahemman no anafo fam hye no tu kɔɔ Misraim akyi kɔɔ Primis (Qasr Ibrim). Asomdwoe apam a efii mu bae no maa Romafo tuu Thirty-Mile Strip, a Primis ka ho no fã bi fii hɔ.  Na wɔayi Meroifo no afi tow a wobetua ama Ahemman no ho. Apam no maa Romafo no kwan ma wɔkɔɔ so faa Dodekashoinos (“Asase a Ɛyɛ Akwansin Dumien”) sɛ asraafo hye so beae. Afei wɔde Roma hye no kɔɔ baabi a ɛbɛn Hiere Sycaminos (Maharraq).

Saa apam yi kɔɔ so yɛɛ adwuma kosii afeha a ɛto so abiɛsa Y.B.  Kus ahenni kɔɔ so yɛɛ tumi a ɛyɛ hu kosii sɛ ɛhwee ase wɔ afeha a ɛto so abien Y.B.

Meroë Ti 
Augusto ti a Amanirenas korae, a wɔfrɛ no Meroë Ti, no, Britania fam tutufo John Garstang na ohui wɔ 1910 mu Ahwehwɛ, dade, ne ahwehwɛ aniwa a ɛwɔ ohoni no mu a ɛtaa yera wɔ asinasin a ɛte saa ara mu no kɔɔ so yɛɛ nea ɛte saa esiane sɛ wosiee no nti. Wɔde Helafo kwan so na ɛyɛɛ mfonini no, na ɛkanyan mmerantebere ne tumi. Wɔde kɔbere na ɛyɛ ti no ankasa, ɛsõ sen nkwa, na ne su te sɛ Augustus Prima Porta. Wɔde calcite, dade nkaa, ne ahwehwɛ na ɛyɛ aniwa no. 

Wosiee ti no wɔ Meroitic asɔrefie bi a wɔahyira so ama Nkonimdi no anammɔn ase, na ɛbɛyɛ sɛ na wɔde rebɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔbɛma Augusto ahyɛ Kushifo nkurɔfo adwene mu na wɔde Roma asi hɔ sɛ tumi a wɔadi nkogu. Ebia mfonini ahorow a ɛwɔ asɔredan no ankasa mu no kyerɛ Romafo ɔko mu nneduafo a wogyina Kushini bi a odi tumi, ebia Akinidad, anim.

Sudan Boayikuw a Ɛhwɛ Tututu So no na ɛde sika boaa Meroë ( Nubia ) a wotutuu fam no. Bere a wohuu Meroë Ti no akyi no, wɔde maa Britania Tete Nneɛma Akorae a ɛda so ara te hɔ nnɛ no akyɛde.

Hamadab Stella 
Wɔde anhweatam na ɛyɛ Hamadab Stela, a wɔyɛe wɔ afeha a edi kan A.Y.B. Meroitic nkyerɛwee a ɛtoatoa so aduanan anum na ɛwɔ hɔ, a wɔakyerɛw so na wɔatwitwa mu. Kyerɛwsɛm no ka Ɔhemmaa Amanirenas ne Ɔhene Akinidad, a wosusuw sɛ ɔyɛ ne kunu no nyinaa ho asɛm. Awarefo no honi a wɔatwitwa a anyame bi wɔ so no yera; nan nkutoo na ɛda so ara yɛ nea wotumi hu. 

John Garstang, fam tutufo a ɔhwɛɛ Meroë Ti no so na ohuu stela no wɔ afe 1914. Na stela no gyina asɔredan ketewa bi pon ano, na na stela a ɛto so abien a ɛwɔ ɔfã a ɛne no bɔ abira ka ho. Stela no tenten bɛyɛ mita abien na ne tɛtrɛtɛ bɛyɛ mita biako. Wɔde Meroitic kasa no atwitwa mu.

Ebia anyame a wɔatwitwa wɔn ho wɔ Amanirenas ne Akinidad nkyɛn no ne Amun ne Mut ; onipa a otwa to no kura ankh, Misrifo daa nkwa ho sɛnkyerɛnne. Wɔayɛ nneduafo a wɔde nkɔnsɔnkɔnsɔn abɔ wɔn ho mfonini wɔ awarefo a wodi tumi no ne anyame no ase. Esiane sɛ stela no yɛ awarefo a wodi tumi a wɔde nneduafo a wɔakyekyere wɔn ho mfonini na efi afeha a edi kan A.Y.B.  Ɛda Meroitic asɛmfua “Areme” a ebia wɔbɛkyerɛ ase sɛ Roma adi.

Sɛ nkyerɛwee no ka Roma ɔsatu no ho asɛm a, ne nkyerɛase no ho hia kɛse ma nhomanimfo. Meroitic ne Roma ntawntawdi no ho nkyerɛkyerɛmu a ɛda so ara wɔ hɔ ara ne Romafo mfiase na mpɛn pii no nsɛmmɔnedi ahyɛ mu ma.

Agyapadeɛ 
Ɛwom sɛ mfiase no na wontumi nhu Amanirenas de, nanso wabɛyɛ obi a agye din esiane nhoma ahorow a agye din nnansa yi te sɛ Rejected Princesses: Heroines, Hellions, and Heretics a Jason Porath kyerɛwee ne nhomanimfo anigye foforo a wɔanya wɔ Roma nniso a wɔsɔre tia ho nti. Adesua a wɔde bae wɔ atubrafo akyi ne sɛnea wɔde wɔn adwene sii nipasu so wɔ ahemman nniso ase wɔ Classics no mu ne nhoma ahorow a efii mu bae no atrɛw asɛm no ho ntease mu, nanso Amanirenas ho nsɛm da so ara yɛ kakraa bi esiane sɛ Meroitic yɛ kasa a wontumi nkyerɛ ase nti. Esiane sɛ Strabo kyerɛwtohɔ no nkutoo ne fibea titiriw a wɔakyerɛ ase a ɛka Amanirenas ho asɛm tenten no to ɔhemmaa a n’ani yɛ biako no ho ntease ano hye bio.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Amanishakheto
text:
Na Amanishakheto yɛ Kandake a ofi Kush . Ɛte sɛ nea odii hene fi afe 10 A.Y.B.

Wɔ Meroitic hieroglyphs mu no wɔkyerɛw ne din "Amanikasheto" ( Mniskhte anaa (Am)niskhete ). Wɔ Meroitic cursive mu no wɔfrɛ no Amaniskheto qor kd(ke) a ɛkyerɛ Amanishakheto, Qore ne Kandake ("Sodifo ne Ɔhemmaa").

Nkaedum ahorow 
Wonim Amanishakheto fi nkaedum pii mu. Wɔaka ne ho asɛm wɔ Amun -asɔredan a ɛwɔ Kawa, wɔ stela bi a efi Meroe so, ne nkyerɛwee ahorow a ɛfa ahemfie dan bi a wohuu wɔ Wad ban Naqa, efi stela bi a wohuu wɔ Qasr Ibrim, stela foforo a efi Naqa ne ne pyramid a ɛwɔ Meroe (Beg. Daabi. N6). 

Wonim Amanishakheto yiye wɔ agude a wɔaboaboa ano a Italiani akorade hwehwɛfo Giuseppe Ferlini, a ɔsɛee pyramid no hwehwɛɛ n’asie nneɛma wiaa fii ne pyramid mu wɔ 1834 mu no.  Na ɛyɛ ademude a ɛmaa n’anidaso nyinaa baa mu: na ɛyɛ nkapo 10, kyɛm nkaa 9, signet nkaa 67, nkapo 2 ne atɛkyɛ pii, a ne nyinaa yɛ nea Meroë Ahemman no mu adwumfo a wɔsen biara na wɔbɔɔ  Saa asinasin yi yɛ mprempren ɛwɔ Egypt Tete Nneɛma Akorae a ɛwɔ Berlin ne Egypt Tete Nneɛma Akorae a ɛwɔ Munich .

Sandstone Relief a Wɔde Ma 
Wohuu anhweatam so mfonini bi a ɛkyerɛ ɔhemmaa no, a mprempren ɛwɔ Khartoum Ɔman Tete Nneɛma Akorae a ɛwɔ Sudan no wɔ Amun Asɔredan mu wɔ Naqa.  Mfonini no yɛ Ɔhemmaa Amanishakheto ho mfonini wɔ anyame abien nkyɛn. Wɔ Misrifo adwinni mu no, nnipa a wɔayɛ wɔn ho mfonini sɛ wɔte ase no ho hia kɛse a obiara a n’ani kyerɛ nifa di akyi. Ɛho hia nso sɛ yɛhyɛ sɛnea nsenia no nnidiso nnidiso no nsow. Wɔ saa mfonini yi mu no, Amanishakheto tenten sen mfonini abien no nanso, onyame a ɔte hɔ no bɛyɛ tenten asen mmea baanu no. Wɔakyerɛ sɛ anyame no ne Amesemi ne Apedemak, ɔkofo nyame ne nyamewa.  Wohu Amanishakheto nso sɛ ɔhyɛ adehye atade a ɛne Nubia ɔkofo ne abɔmmɔ anyame wɔ abusuabɔ a ɛsan si hia a ɛho hia sɛ n’ahenni no ho banbɔfo no so dua. Ɔhemmaa no ne anyame baanu no ho mfonini no si ne tumi ne ne dibea so dua bio.

Stele a Ɔhemmaa Amanishakheto ne onyamewa Amesemi 
Stele a ɛwɔ benkum so no yɛ Amanishakheto mfonini foforo a ɔkofo nyamewa Amesemi ka ho. Wɔde anhweatam na ɛyɛ saa stele yi na wohuu no wɔ Amun Asɔredan mu wɔ Naqa.  Wɔayɛ mmea baanu no ho mfonini a wɔhyɛ ntade a ɛte saa ara: ntade a ɛfata, akatawia a wɔde abɔso ayɛ, kɔla, ne wig kurukuruwa. Wɔayɛ wɔn nipadua ho mfonini wɔ akwan horow so nanso, onyamewa no wɔ nipadua a ɛyɛ tratraa a ɔhyɛ atade a ɛda nsɛm a ɛyɛ fɛ kɛse adi. Wɔayɛ Amanishakheto ho mfonini wɔ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ kurukuruwa kɛse so. Ɛte sɛ nea nkitahodi a ɛda wɔn baanu ntam no yɛ nea ɛbɛn a ɛno nso kasa fa tumi a na Ɔhemmaa Amanishakheto wɔ no ho. Nkyerɛwde a ɛwɔ stele no akyi no ma wohu mmea baanu no nyinaa.  Wɔde saa abopon yi guu Amun Asɔredan a ɛwɔ Naqa, a wosii wɔ Ɔhemmaa Amanishakheto wu akyi no mu.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Amanitakaye
text:
Na Amanitakaye yɛ Nubia adehye bea, na ɛde besi nnɛ no, wonim no fi n’asie wɔ Nuri adehye amusiei nkutoo mu (Nuri 26). Ebia na ɔyɛ ɔhene Malonaqen maame, nanso eyi yɛ nsusuwii hunu ara kwa, ɛwom sɛ nneɛma a saa ɔhene no din wɔ so wɔ n’asie mu na ɛfoa so de. Esiane sɛ na wonni adanse pii nti wɔkyerɛe sɛ ɔyɛ Aspelta babea ne Aramatle-qo nuabea yere .

Ɔkura abodin ɔhene maame ne ɔhene nuabea . 

Amanitakaye amusiei no yɛ pyramid a ɛwɔ asɔredan ne asase ase amusiei adan. Wɔ asɔredan no mu no, na stela bi da so ara gyina hɔ. Na antweri bi wɔ hɔ a ɛkɔ asase ase na ɛkɔ amusiei adan abien no mu. Wohuu amusiei no sɛ wɔabɔ korɔn, nanso anyɛ yiye koraa no, wohuu shabti 89 asinasin. Wɔkura ɔhemmaa no din ne abodin. Wohuu nkuku pii nso. Na nkrataa afoforo a wɔakyerɛw ne din ne ɔhene Malonaqen din wɔ so wɔ faience so. Ebia eyi bɛkyerɛ sɛ na ɔyɛ ne maame. Ade foforo a ne din wɔ so ne electrum cylinder. Wɔ saa cylinder yi so no, ɔkura abodin ɔhene nuabea nso.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Amanitore
text:
Amanitore (afeha a ɛto so 1 Y.B. mfiase anaa mfinimfini), a wɔsan kyerɛw Amanitere anaa Amanitare,  yɛ Nubia Kandake, anaa ɔhemmaa a odi ade, a ofi tete Kushite Ahemman Meroë, a wɔsan frɛ no Nubia wɔ tete nhoma pii mu no mu. Nkyerɛwde foforo bi ne Candace ne Kentake. Wɔ Misrifo nkyerɛwde a wɔde nkyerɛwde a ɛyɛ fɛ akyerɛw mu no, wɔkenkan ahengua din Amanitore sɛ Merkare . Wɔka Kandakefo pii ho asɛm sɛ akofo-ahemmaa a wodii asraafo anim wɔ ɔko mu.

Nkwa 
Wɔtaa ka Kandake Amanitore ho asɛm sɛ ɔne Natakamani yɛ co-regent ɛwom sɛ ɛnyɛ nea ɛda adi sɛ na ɔyɛ ne yere anaa ne maame de. 

Na n’ahemfie wɔ Gebel Barkal wɔ nnɛyi Sudan, a mprempren ɛyɛ UNESCO agyapade. Na beae a na odi tumi no wɔ Nil ne Atbara nsubɔnten ntam. 

Na ɔka Meroitic abakɔsɛm bere no ho na n’ahenni fii ase wɔ 1 A.Y.B. Amanitaraqide, a odii n’ade no nniso wiei wɔ afe 50 Y.B. 

Wɔasie Amanitore wɔ n’ankasa pyramid mu wɔ Meroë. Ɔboda no yɛ bɛyɛ mita asia ahinanan wɔ ne nnyinaso, na ɛnyɛ pyramid wɔ akontaabu ntease mu.

Adansi adwuma ahorow 
Na Amanitore ka Kush adansifo akɛse a wotwa to no ho. Ɔde ne ho hyɛɛ asɔredan kɛse a wɔsan sii maa Amun wɔ Meroë ne Amun asɔredan a ɛwɔ Napata bere a Romafo bubuu no akyi no mu. Wɔyɛɛ nsukorabea ahorow a wɔde bɛkora nsu so nso wɔ Meroë wɔ n’ahenni mu.  Sodifo baanu no nso sii Amun asɔredan ahorow wɔ Naqa ne Amara .

Adansi dodow a wosii wɔ afeha a edi kan no mfinimfini fa no kyerɛ sɛ na eyi ne bere a wodii yiye sen biara wɔ Meroitic abakɔsɛm mu.  Wosisii Nubia pyramid bɛboro ahanu, na wɔfow dodow no ara tete.

Apam Foforo 
Amanitore betumi ayɛ kandake a wɔaka ne ho asɛm wɔ Bible mu wɔ asɛm a ɛfa Etiopiani no adwensakra ho wɔ Asomafo no Nnwuma 8:26–40:

Na Awurade bɔfoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ Filipo sɛ: Sɔre kɔ anafoɔ fam kɔ ɔkwan a ɛsiane firi Yerusalem kɔ Gasa a ɛyɛ sare so no so. Na ɔsɔre kɔeɛ, na hwɛ, Etiopia barima bi a ɔwɔ tumi kɛseɛ wɔ Etiopiafoɔ hemmaa Kandake ase a ɔhwɛ n’akoradeɛ nyinaa so, na ɔbaa Yerusalem sɛ ɔrebɛsom no, resan aba, na ɔte hɔ wɔ ne teaseɛnam mu kenkan odiyifo Yesaia....

Wɔ amammerɛ a agye din mu 

 Amanitore di Nubia anibuei anim wɔ 2016 4X video agodie Civilization VI a Firaxis Games yɛe no mu .
 Amanitore yɛ ɔsahene a wotumi nya no wɔ video so agodie Rise of Kingdoms mu.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Artaha
text:
Na Artaha yɛ Nubia hemmaa a na Misrifo abodin hene yere . Ebia na ɔyɛ ɔhene Aspelta yere, ɛwom sɛ eyi yɛ nsusuwii hunu ara kwa de.  Wohu Artaha fi n’asie wɔ Nuri nkutoo (Nu 58). Ɛbɛyɛ sɛ na n’asie no yɛ pyramid a asɔredan ketewaa bi wɔ n’anim, nanso na ɛnonom nni hɔ koraa. Antweri bi wɔ hɔ a ɛsiane kɔ amusiei dan biako a wohuu sɛ wɔafow nneɛma no. Bere bi na wɔde plaster adura afasu no so na wɔde adwini ayɛ ho nanso nea wɔasiesie no yerae kɛse bere a wohuu no. Wohuu Alabaster nkuku. Anyɛ yiye koraa no, na shabtis a wɔakyerɛw so 180 nso wɔ hɔ, na ɛde ne din ne ne din ma.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Asata (Nubian hemmaa) .
text:
Na Asata yɛ Nubia hemmaa a na ɔwɔ Misrifo abodin sɛ ɔhene yere ne Misraim nipa. Ebia na ɔyɛ ɔhene Aspelta yere. Nanso, saa abusuabɔ yi yɛ nsusuwii hunu ara kwa. Wonim Asata titiriw fi nea wosiee no wɔ Nuri (Nuri 42). Na n’asie yɛ pyramid a asɔredan ketewaa bi wɔ n’anim. Wohuu pyramid no sɛ asɛe kɛse. Na asɔredan ahorow no nni hɔ koraa. Antweri bi wɔ hɔ a ɛsiane kɔ amusiei adan abien a wohuu sɛ wɔafow nneɛma, nanso na nneɛma pii da so ara wɔ mu, a ɔhemmaa no koma scarab, anyɛ yiye koraa no shabtis 270 (a ɛde ne din ne ne din ma), abo nkuku pii, amulets ne asinasin afoforo a ɛbɛyɛ sɛ ɛkataa amu no so.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Atasamale
text:
Atasamale (a wɔsan frɛ no Tesmalo ) yɛ Nubia hene Harsiotef (odii tumi bɛyɛ afe 400 A.Y.B.) maame. Wonim no fi ne babarima no stela ne nea wosiee no wɔ Nuri mu . N'abodin ahorow ne ahene maame, ɔhene nuabea ne Kus Awuraa .  Ebia na ɔyɛ Amanineteyerike yere, ɛwom sɛ eyi yɛ nsusuwii hunu ara kwa de.

Na n’asie wɔ Nuri yɛ pyramid a ɛwɔ asɔredan ne amusiei adan abien a ɛwɔ asase ase. Na antweri bi wɔ hɔ a ɛkɔ asase ase na ɛkɔ adan abien mu. Wohuu amusiei no sɛ wɔabɔ korɔn, nanso wohuu shabtis asinasin a wɔankyerɛw so. Na nkuku pii ne die bi a wɔde faience anaa aduru fitaa ayɛ wɔ hɔ. Wɔkoraa ne din so wɔ afɔrebɔpon bi a wohuu wɔ hɔ so

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Ampe
text:
Ampe (Agodie), Ghana mmɔfra agodie a ɛfa ahuruahurui  ne nsa a wɔbɔ.
 Gleichenia cryptocarpa, fern a ɛwɔ abɔde mu kyekyɛ wɔ Chile
 Lophosoria quadripinata, fern bi a wohu wɔ Amerika

title: Atmataka
text:
Na Atmataka yɛ Nubia hemmaa, na ɛde besi nnɛ no, na wonim no fi nea wosiee no wɔ Nuri adehye amusiei nkutoo mu . Ebia na ɔyɛ ɔhene Aramatle-qo yere . N’abodin biako pɛ a wonim ne ɔhene yere .  Na n’asie no yɛ pyramid ne amusiei adan a ɛwɔ asase ase no. Na antweri bi wɔ hɔ a ɛkɔ asase ase na ɛkɔ amusiei adan abien no mu. Wohuu amusiei no sɛ wɔabɔ korɔn, nanso anyɛ yiye koraa no, wohuu shabti 158 asinasin. Wɔkura ɔhemmaa no din ne abodin.  Wohuu ne koma scarab wɔ Nuri amusiei Nu. 47. Ɔde ne nsa kyerɛɛ ne so. Wonnim onii a wosie yi wura.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Batahaliye
text:
Na Batahaliye yɛ Nubia hene Harsiotef (odii tumi bɛyɛ afe 400 A.Y.B.) yere ne ne nuabea. Wonim no fi ne kunu stela ne nea wosiee no wɔ Nuri mu . Na n’abodin titiriw ne ɔhene kɛse yere, Hmt-niswt aAt.  (ɛnyɛ ɔhene kɛse yere sɛnea ɛtaa yɛ no). Abodin afoforo ne ɔhene yere ne ɔhene nuabea .

Wonim no nso fi bere a wosiee no wɔ Nuri . Na nea etwa to no yɛ pyramid a ɛwɔ asɔredan ne amusiei adan abien a ɛwɔ asase ase. Na antweri bi wɔ hɔ a ɛkɔ asase ase na ɛkɔ adan abien mu. Wohuu amusiei no sɛ wɔabɔ korɔn, nanso wohuu shabtis asinasin a wɔankyerɛw so. Wohuu stela bi nso wɔ ha a ɛkyerɛ Batahaliye wɔ Asase Nyame Osiris anim  Wɔde Misrifo nkyerɛwee a wɔakyerɛw so na ɛyɛɛ nkyerɛwee a ɛwɔ hɔ no, nanso nkyerɛwee no yɛ den sɛ wɔbɛkenkan.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Henutirdis
text:
Na Henutirdis yɛ Nubia adehye bi a ɔwɔ abodin ɔhene yere, ɛwom sɛ wontumi nhu abodin no akenkan de. Ebia na ne kunu yɛ Harsiotef . Ɛde besi ha no, wohu no fi n’asie wɔ Nuri nkutoo (Nu. 34).  Ɛyɛ nwonwa sɛ Misrifo din da no so. Nubia adehye mmea afoforo dodow no ara kura Nubia din.

N’asie wɔ Nuri yɛ pyramid a ɛwɔ asɔredan ne amusiei adan abien a ɛwɔ asase ase. Na antweri bi wɔ hɔ a ɛkɔ asase ase na ɛkɔ amusiei adan a wohuu sɛ wɔafow nneɛma pii no mu. Wohuu shabti 6 a wɔankyerɛw so asinasin. Wɔakora Henutirdis din so wɔ afɔrebɔ pon bi so.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Henuttakhebit
text:
Na Henuttakhebit yɛ Nubia hemmaa a ɔwɔ Misrifo abodin sɛ ɔhene yere, ɔhene babea ne ɔhene nuabea . Wonnim n’ahemfie kunu no yiye. Ebia na ɔyɛ Aspelta yere ne Senkamanisken babea, sɛnea Dows Dunham ne M. F. Laming Macadam hyɛɛ nyansa no.  Eyi nyɛ nea ɛyɛ nokware. Na ɔyɛ ɔhemmaa Madiqen babea anaa ne babea a wɔagye no ayɛ ne ba na odii n'akyi sɛ Amun nnwontofo wɔ Napata .

Wonim Henuttakhebit fi sɛnea wosiee no wɔ Nuri (Nu. 28) ne stela bi a ɛka sɛnea wɔfaa no sɛ ne ba no mu. Na n’asie yɛ pyramid a asɔredan ketewaa bi wɔ n’anim. Antweri bi wɔ hɔ a esian kɔ amusiei adan abien a wohuu sɛ wɔafow nneɛma no mu. Na abopon da so ara wɔ amusiei no so, na na ɛkyerɛ ne din. Shabti ahorow pii wɔ hɔ a wohuu wɔ amusiei no mmeae ahorow a ɛde ne din ma, wɔanhu emu biara wɔ ɔboda yi mu. Mmiɛnsa fi ɔdamoa Nu. 25, faako a wohuu shabti afoforo a efi ahemmaa afoforo hɔ nso. Ɛha na ɔwo ɔhene yere ara kwa .

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Madiqen
text:
Na Madiqen yɛ Nubia hemmaa a na ɔwɔ Misrifo abodin sɛ ɔhene yere, ɔhene yere a ɔte ase  ne ɔhene nuabea . Na ne maame yɛ ɔhemmaa Nasalsa . Ɛda adi kɛse sɛ na ne papa yɛ ɔhene Senkamanisken . Wonnim n’ahemfie kunu no yiye, nanso ɛda adi kɛse sɛ Aspelta ne Anlamani na wobetumi apaw.  Wonim Madiqen fi bere a wosiee no wɔ Nuri (Nu 27) . Na n’asie yɛ pyramid a asɔredan ketewaa bi wɔ n’anim. Antweri bi wɔ hɔ a esian kɔ amusiei adan abien a wohuu sɛ wɔafow nneɛma no mu. Wohuu sika kɔkɔɔ nkuku ne alabaster nkuku. Na shabti 80 nso wɔ hɔ a ɛde ne din ne ne din ma.  Wɔ Aspelta stela bi so no wɔka sɛ ɔhene no maa no dibea sɛ Amun odwontofo wɔ Napata . Afei wɔde saa dibea yi maa ne babea Henuttakhebit .

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Malaqaye
text:
Na Malaqaye yɛ Nubia hemmaa a ɔwɔ abodin sɛ ɔhene yere . Ebia na ne kunu yɛ Tantamani, nanso eyi yɛ nsusuwii hunu ara kwa. Ɛde besi ha no, wohu no fi n’asie wɔ Nuri nkutoo (Nu. 59). 

N’asie wɔ Nuri bere bi na ɛda adi kɛse sɛ na ɛyɛ pyramid a asɔredan ne amusiei adan abien a ɛwɔ asase ase wom. Bere a wotutuu fam no, na pyramid ne asɔredan no nni hɔ koraa. Na antweri bi wɔ hɔ a ɛkɔ asase ase a ɛkɔ amusiei adan abien a wohuu sɛ wɔafow nneɛma mu, nanso na mfitiase nnwinnade no fã kɛse da so ara wɔ mu, a dwetɛ amu akataso, amu a wɔde dwetɛ akata so pii ne amulet pii ka ho. Wɔkoraa ɔhemmaa no din so wɔ koma scarab bi so . Wohuu shabti bɛboro 100 a wɔankyerɛw so asinasin nso. f

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Maletaral
text:
Maletaral (a wɔsan frɛ no Maloraral ) (edin no akenkan yɛ nea wontumi nsi pi) yɛ Nubia hemmaa bi a na ɔwɔ Misrifo abodin hene maame . Ebia na ɔyɛ ɔhene Atlanersa yere ne ɔhene Senkamanisken maame .  Wonim maleteral fi koma mu scarab bi a wohuu wɔ amusiei bi mu wɔ Nuri (Nu 41). Na n’asie yɛ pyramid a asɔredan ketewaa bi wɔ n’anim. Antweri bi wɔ hɔ a esian kɔ amusiei adan abien a wohuu sɛ wɔafow nneɛma no mu. Wohuu sika kɔkɔɔ a wɔde ayɛ nkuku ne nkuku. Na shabti 283 nso wɔ hɔ. Na wɔankyerɛw wɔn din.  Na wɔtaa hu nneɛma a wɔde sie a efi adamoa ahorow a ɛwɔ Nuri amusiei no mu wɔ akyirikyiri fi baabi a wosie no ankasa. Enti ɛsɛ sɛ ɛkɔ so yɛ nea wontumi nsi pi sɛ ebia ɔboda Nuri 41 no yɛ Maleteral de ankasa, efisɛ ade biako pɛ na wohuu ne din.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Maletasen
text:
Na Maletasen yɛ Nubia hemmaa, na ɛde besi nnɛ no, na wonim no fi nea wosiee no wɔ Nuri adehye amusiei nkutoo mu (Nuri 39). Ebia na ɔyɛ ɔhene Aramatle-qo yere . N’abodin biako pɛ a wonim ne ɔhene kɛse yere .  (ɛnyɛ ɔhene kɛse yere sɛnea ɛtaa yɛ no). Na n’asie no yɛ pyramid a ɛwɔ asɔredan ne amusiei adan a ɛwɔ asase ase. Na antweri bi wɔ hɔ a ɛkɔ asase ase na ɛkɔ amusiei adan abien no mu. Wohuu amusiei no sɛ wɔabɔ korɔn, nanso anyɛ yiye koraa no, wohuu shabti 123 asinasin. Wɔkura ɔhemmaa no din ne abodin. f

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Masalaye
text:
Na Masalaye yɛ Nubia adehye bi a wonim no fi bere a wosiee no wɔ Nuri nkutoo (Nu. 23). Na n’asie no yɛ pyramid (bɛyɛ mita 10 ahinanan), asɔredan a ɛwɔ pyramid no anim ne adan a wɔtwe wosie wɔ pyramid no ase, a na wotumi fa antweri so kɔ hɔ. Wohuu amusiei dan no sɛ wɔafow nneɛma pii, nanso anyɛ yiye koraa no, na shabti mfonini ahorow 50 a ɛma ne din da so ara wɔ hɔ. Wohuu ɔhemmaa Nasala shabtis pii nso, a ebia ɛbɛba ɔdamoa no mu esiane amusiei no nyinaa a wɔfow no nyinaa nti.  Masalaye nkura abodin biara. Wɔakyerɛw ne din wɔ krataa bi a ɛkyerɛ adehye dibea mu. Na wɔahyɛ nyansa sɛ ɔyɛ Senkamanisken yere . Eyi yɛ nsusuwii hunu ara kwa.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Meqemale
text:
Na Meqemale (Makmalo) yɛ Nubia hemmaa, na ɛde besi nnɛ no, na wonim no fi nea wosiee no wɔ Nuri adehye amusiei nkutoo mu (Nuri 40). Ebia na ɔyɛ ɔhene Aspelta yere, nanso eyi yɛ nsusuwii hunu ara kwa. N’abodin biako pɛ a wonim ne ɔhene kɛse yere, Hmt-niswt aAt.  (ɛnyɛ ɔhene kɛse yere sɛnea ɛtaa yɛ no). Na n’asie no yɛ pyramid a ɛwɔ asɔredan ne amusiei adan a ɛwɔ asase ase. Na antweri bi wɔ hɔ a ɛkɔ asase ase na ɛkɔ amusiei adan abien no mu. Wohuu amusiei no sɛ wɔabɔ korɔn, nanso anyɛ yiye koraa no, wohuu shabti 108 asinasin. Wɔkura ɔhemmaa no din ne abodin. Wohuu nkuku pii ne afɔrebɔpon nso.  Wohuu shabti bi a ɔhemmaa no din wɔ so nso wɔ Sanam .

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Mernua
text:
Na Mernua yɛ Nubia hemmaa a wonim no fi bere a wosiee no wɔ Meroe nkutoo mu . Wohuu n’asie no sɛ ɛnyɛ hwee na na nnua funnaka abiɛsa ne amu a wɔde dwetɛ akata amu a amu akataso ka ho nkae da so ara wɔ hɔ.  nso na wɔde dwetɛ na ɛyɛe. Wɔakora ne din ne ne din so wɔ shabtis ne mummy covering a wɔahu so nkutoo. Wɔ mummy akataso no so no wɔfrɛ no ɔhene yere . Wɔnkora ɔhene biara din so wɔ amusiei no mu. Ɔkwan a wɔfaa so yɛɛ ayi no ne bere a wɔde yɛɛ ayi no nkutoo na yebetumi asusuw n’ahemfo kunu ho. Ɛte sɛ nea ɔtraa ase bɛyɛ afe 600 A.Y.B. Anlamani anaa Aspelta yɛ wɔn a wobetumi ayɛ ahokafo.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Nawidemak
text:
Nawidemak yɛ Kandake a ofi Kush a odii tumi wɔ afeha a ɛto so 1 A.Y.B. Wonim no fi n’asie dan no fasu ho mfonini, ne sika kɔkɔɔ abopon bi nso so. Ebia na ɔyɛ Kandakefo a wɔka wɔn ho asɛm wɔ Bible Apam Foforo no mu no mu biako nso .

Asetra mu nsɛm 
Nawidemak sɛ Kush Ahemman no sodifo, efi afeha a ɛto so 1 A.Y.B.,  anaa afeha a ɛto so A.Y.B.  Wonim no fi ɔfasu a wɔde ayɛ n’asie dan a ɛwɔ Meroe (Beg. N 6), a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɔhyɛ adehye atade, abɔso ne hama a wɔde tassell ayɛ; wɔtaa da saa nneɛma yi adi wɔ Kus sodifo mmarima ho.  Nhama a wɔde kyekyere n’atade so, ne hama no nyinaa yɛ aboa bi a ɔda mpa so, a ɛyɛ adehye ho sɛnkyerɛnne foforo. Saa agyiraehyɛde yi na epue nea etwa to wɔ Nawidemak mfonini no mu, na wɔde adi dwuma wɔ Kushifo mfonini ahorow mu fi afeha a ɛto so 3 A.Y.B. Wɔ ahotɔ no mu no, ɔhyɛ Osiris abotiri no wɔ ne ti so. 

Wɔ ɔdan no atifi fam ɔfasu no so no, wɔakyerɛ Nawidemak a ɔhyɛ atade tenten na ne nufu a ɛda hɔ kwa, a ɛyɛ n’awo ho sɛnkyerɛnne ne sɛ ɔyɛ sodifo foforo maame.  Sika kɔkɔɔ abopon bi a ɛkyerɛ Nawidemak ka Allen Nkaedi Adwinni Tete Nneɛma Akorae a ɛwɔ Oberlin, Ohio no nneɛma a wɔaboaboa ano no ho . 

Nawidemak yɛ Kush sodifo mmea a wɔtoatoa so a ɛto so anan a wɔfrɛ wɔn Kandakes . Wɔka saa sodifo yi mu biara ho asɛm wɔ Bible Apam Foforo no mu, a nsonsonoe biara nni wɔn ntam. Wogyina adwene a ɛne sɛ odii ade wɔ Afeha a Ɛto so  Y.B.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Piankhher
text:
Na Piankhher (Pi-ankh-her) yɛ Nubia hemmaa a na ɔwɔ Misrifo abodin hene yere . Wonnim n’ahemfie kunu no yiye, nanso esiane mmere nhyehyɛe nti ɛte sɛ nea ɛyɛ Aramatle-qo .  Wonim Piankhher fi nea wosiee no wɔ Nuri (Nu 57) nkutoo mu . Na n’asie yɛ pyramid, a bere a wotutuu no no, na enni hɔ koraa. Antweri bi wɔ hɔ a esian kɔ amusiei adan abien a wohuu sɛ wɔafow nneɛma no mu. Wohuu sika ne dwetɛ atɛkyɛ bi. Wohuu shabti bɛyɛ 200 a emu pii yɛ asinasin nkutoo nso. Wɔde ne din ne ne din ma.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Sekhmakh
text:
Na Sekhmakh yɛ Nubia hene Nastasen, a odii tumi wɔ afeha a ɛto so anan A.Y.B.

Wonim Sekhmakh fi ɔhene no stela kɛse no mu, baabi a wɔayɛ ne ho mfonini wɔ roundle no mu. N’asie stela  a wohuu wɔ asɔrefie bi mu wɔ Jebel Barkal na ɛda adi sɛ wɔsan de dii dwuma nso wɔ hɔ. Wonnim baabi a wosiee, faako a bere bi na wɔde stela no sie no. Sekhmakh kura abodin ahorow sɛ ɔhene babea, ɔhene yere ne Egypt wura . Wonnim n’ahemfo awofo.

Kasadwini 
Laszlo Török, wɔ: Fontes Historiae Nubiorum, Po 1, kratafa 100 mu. II, Bergen 1996, 468, 1996, Ɔde ne nsa kyerɛɛ ne so.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Shanakdakhete
text:
Na Shanakhdakheto anaa Shanakdakhete yɛ Kush Ahemman no Hemmaa, bere a na amammuisɛm no gyina Meroë, tete kurow bi a ɛwɔ Sudan atifi fam no. Ɔno ne Afrika hemmaa a odi kan a wonim no sɛ odi tumi wɔ tete Nubia, [1] na odii hene fi c. 170–150 A.Y.B., [3] ɛwom sɛ wɔaka bere 170–160 A.Y.B. [1] Wɔkyerɛ sɛ ɔde tumi koraa dii tumi wɔ Meroë Ahemman no mu. Wɔkyerɛ nso sɛ odii ade a na onni ɔhene. [3] Wɔsan nso ka sɛ sɛ́ ɔhemmaa no odii dwuma titiriw wɔ Meroitic som mu. [5] Wɔ afeha a ɛtɔ so mmienu A.Y.B. [6]

Nsɛm a wɔaka abom 

Wɔakyerɛw Shanakdakheto din sɛ adehye hemmaa wɔ Misrifo Meroitic nkyerɛwde mu . Saa nkyerɛwee yi ne nea wohu wɔ afɔremuka a ɛwɔ Asɔredan F a ɛwɔ Naqa no apon ano . [1] Shanakdakheto frɛɛ ne ho sɛ: Re ba, Asase Abien no Awurade, Shanakdakheto (Sa Re nebtawy, Shanakdakheto).  Nkyerɛwee no kenkan sɛ: [1]

Ahemfo-waab-sɔfo a Ɔba Re: Shanakdakheto a wɔmaa no nkwa da biara da 'Ma'at dɔfo' te sɛ... , . Re ba, ..Asase Abien no Awurade (Misraim): Shanakdakhete.

Meroitefo kyerɛw ankasa kasa wɔ afeha a ɛto so [8] A.Y.B wɔ Asɔredan F a ɛwɔ Naqa no mu. [9]

Ɛwom mpo sɛ n’abusua anim nsɛm da so ara yɛ nea wontumi nhu de, nanso wɔ ne nsusuwso biako a ɛwɔ akyi odum bi so no, wɔada no adi sɛ wɔde dibea agyiraehyɛde bi a ɛwɔ ne moma so ne abotiri a ɛte sɛ nea ahemfo a wɔredi tumi no hyɛ a wɔde owia-disk asiesie no asiesie no ne ntakra atenten. Wɔatwe atade a wɔde siesie no, a ɛte sɛ nea wohu wɔ Faraon adwinni mu, te sɛ Uraeus, no sɛ adehye atade a ɛwɔ afã abiɛsa. Kɔnmuade no ne n’asomuade no wɔ abirekyi ti asiesie, onyame Amun aboa kronkron bi a wɔde di dwuma wɔ Kushitefo ahosiesie atetesɛm a na agye din wɔ Nubia no mu. Wɔde ɔheneba a ogyina ne nkyɛn, a ɔhyɛ atade a wɔde abɔ ne mmati benkum ho no, a wɔde abɔso a ɛyɛ mpapahwekwa akyerɛ sɛ abotiri. Wɔde wɔn nan benkum akɔ anim akyerɛ mfonini abien no. Sɛ́ Afrikani ahoɔfɛfo no, wɔda ɔhemmaa no adi sɛ ne honam ani yɛ den, na ɔde aboɔden abo ayɛ no, su a ɛkyerɛ ahonyade, tumi ne yiyedi, ne awo tumi. [1]

Wɔ n’asɔredan a wɔde afunu gu mu no asiesie mu no, adansi ho nneɛma yɛ adwinni kɛse. [1] Wɔ mfonini biako a akɔ fam mu no, wɔayɛ ɔhemmaa no ho mfonini sɛ ɔhyɛ atade a wɔasiesie na wɔde aboɔden abo ayɛ, a ɔte adehye nkongua a wɔayɛ no sɛ gyata so, a okura peaw ne nsateaa nkorabata wɔ ne nifa so, a ne nsa benkum ama ne nsa benkum so. [10]

Wɔkyerɛ sɛ cartouche abien a wohuu wɔ Naqa no yɛ afeha a ɛto so abien A.Y.B. [11] Nanso, wɔfrɛ hieroglyphic cursive a ɛwɔ Ɔhemmaa no cartouche so no "classical" wɔ style mu, a wonhu wɔ Jebel Barkal slab a ɛwɔ Tanyidamani ’s cartouche a wobuu no sɛ Shanakdakhete adedifo no so. Wɔkyerɛɛ ne pyramid no wɔ Meroë, a ɛbɛn Tanyidamani de no nanso wɔansi so dua efisɛ wɔankora ne din so. [12] Wɔ Ɔhemmaa Shanakdakhete ɔdamoa asɔredan mu mfonini ahorow mu no, mfonini ahorow no kyerɛ mmarima a wokurakura agyan sɛ Meroifo amusiei amanne. [13] Wɔ anhweatam a wɔde ayɛ mfonini (mfonini no) a wɔde akyerɛ wɔ Britania Tete Nneɛma Akorae a ɛyɛ amusiei a ɛwɔ Meroe no pyramid ahorow a ɛso yɛ toro no fasu no fã no, wogye di sɛ wɔakyerɛ Ɔhemmaa Shanakdakhete sɛ ɔte ahengua so a ɔheneba bi gyina ne nkyɛn no wɔ Isis a ɔwɔ ntaban ahobammɔ ase. Wɔayɛ nyamesom afɔrebɔ ahorow, sɛnea ɔhemmaa no susuw nneɛma ho wɔ Osiris anim, ne nnipa dodow bi a wɔsoa akyɛde a wɔahyehyɛ wɔn ho wɔ anim a wokurakura akyɛde ho mfonini wɔ mfonini ahorow no mu.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Tagtal
text:
Na Tagtal yɛ Nubia hemmaa a ɔwɔ abodin ɔhene yere ne Misrini . Wonnim ne kunu no yiye. Na wɔahyɛ Malonaqen ho nyansa ɛwom sɛ eyi yɛ nsusuwii hunu ara kwa de. Ɛde besi ha no, wohu no fi n’asie wɔ Nuri nkutoo (Nu. 45). 

Tagtalis a wonim no nso fi bere a wosiee no wɔ Nuri . Na nea etwa to no yɛ pyramid a asɔredan ne amusiei dan biako wɔ asase ase. Wohuu pyramid ne asɔredan no sɛ asɛe koraa. Na antweri bi wɔ hɔ a ɛkɔ asase ase na ɛkɔ amusiei a wohui sɛ wɔafow nneɛma pii. Fragments pf 15 shabtis kora ne din a na ɛyɛ den sɛ wɔbɛkenkan esiane sɛ wɔankora so yiye nti. N’abodin ahorow nso pue, ɔhene yere ne nea ɛto so abien, a ebia wɔbɛkenkan no sɛ Misrini . /  Wɔde Misrifo nkyerɛwee a wɔakyerɛw so na ɛyɛɛ nkyerɛwee a ɛwɔ hɔ no, nanso nkyerɛwee no yɛ den sɛ wɔbɛkenkan.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Yeturow
text:
Yeturow ( Iretiru ) yɛ Nubia hemmaa a ɔwɔ Misrifo abodin sɛ ɔhene yere, ɔhene yere a ɔyɛ Misraimfo, ɔhene babea ne ɔhene nuabea . Ɛda adi kɛse sɛ na ne papa yɛ ɔhene Taharqa . Na n’ahemfie kunu ne ne nuabarima Atlanersa . 

Wonim Yeturow fi bere a wosiee no wɔ Nuri (Nu 53). Wohuu n’adamoa sɛ asɛe kɛse. Bere bi na ebia na pyramid bi wɔ hɔ a asɔredan wom nanso wɔanhu saa nneɛma no nkae biara. Wɔkora ɔdamoa no afã horow a ɛwɔ asase ase no so yiye. Antweri bi wɔ hɔ a ɛsiane kɔ amusiei dan a wohuu sɛ wɔafow nneɛma no. Wohuu mfonini ahorow wɔ ɔfasu no so, a ɛkyerɛ Yeturow wɔ Underwolrd nyame Osiris anim, Wohuu ne koma scarab wɔ baabi a ɛbɛn ɔboda foforo (Nu. 74). Bio nso, na anyɛ yiye koraa no shabti 389 asinasin da so ara wɔ hɔ, na na ne nyinaa nni nkyerɛwee biara. Wohuu asonse asinasin a wɔasiesie nso wɔ amusiei dan no mu, a ɛda adi kɛse sɛ bere bi na wɔde nneɛma afoforo ahyɛ mu  Ebia wɔde Yeturow ne adehye mmea afoforo nso kyerɛe wɔ adum bi so wɔ Jebel Barkal . Mprempren wɔasɛe adum no nanso wohu mfonini ahorow no fi mfonini dedaw ahorow mu.  Afeha a ɛto so 19 mu mfonini ahorow no mu nna hɔ koraa, enti ɛda so ara yɛ nea wontumi nsi pi sɛ ebia wɔakyerɛ Yeturow wɔ hɔ anaa.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Abar (Ɔhemmaa) .
text:
Na Abar yɛ Nubia hemmaa a ɔwɔ Kus Ahemman mu a wɔtraa ase wɔ Misraim Ahemman a Ɛto so Aduonu Anum mu . Wonim no fi stela ahorow a wohuu wɔ Sudan ne Egypt no mu . Nea ɔdaa ne ho adi no hyɛ no agyirae sɛ ɔyɛ Ɔhene Alara a ofi Nubia nuabea, a waware Ɔhene Piye ne Ɔhene Taharqa maame .

Nkwa 
Wonim Abar, Nubia hemmaa bi a ɔwɔ Kush Ahemman mu a wɔtraa ase wɔ Misraim Ahemman a Ɛto so Aduonu Anum mu, [1] fi stela (Stela V) bi a wohuu wɔ Kawa, Sudan, a ɛkyerɛw sɛ wohyiraa no so sɛ sistrum bɔfo wɔ asɔredan no mu a ne papa yɛe, ne afei nso wɔ adeyɛ a ɛte saa ara mu wɔ Jebel Barkal baabi a ɔda ne ho adi wɔ ne ba Taharqa akyi ne stela bi a efi Tanis, Egypt . [1] [2] Abar foforo a ɔdaa ne ho adi wɔ Amun Asɔredan a ɛwɔ Sanam, Sudan . [3]

Abar yɛ Ɔhene Taharqa maame na ɔwaree Ɔhene Piye . Na ɔyɛ Ɔhene Alara a ofi Nubia (ne nuabea babea) wɔfase. [1] Ɔtetew ne ho fii ne babarima, Taharqa, ho bere tenten na bere a wɔsan boom no, anigye pii sii efisɛ na wabɛyɛ Farao bere a na onni hɔ no. Ebetumi aba sɛ na eyi yɛ nea wɔhyɛɛ da kaa Misrifo nyame Isis ne ne ba Horus, a wɔsan boom wɔ tebea horow a ɛte saa ara mu no tetew mu. Nsusuwii foforo ne sɛ na ɛna ne ɔba a wɔtetew wɔn ho no yɛ atetesɛm wɔ Kushifo amammerɛ mu. [3]

Na ɔwɔ abodin ahorow pii: Ɔhene Maame ( mwt niswt ), Ɔhene Nuabea ( snt niswt ), Amannɔne nsase so Awuraa ( nbt kh3swt ), Misraim Atifi ne Asase ase Awuraa ( hnwt Sma'w mhw ), Asase Abien no Awuraa Kɛse ( wrt nbt t3wy ), Awuraa Anuonyam ( iryt p't ), Ayeyi Kɛse ( wrt hzwt ), ne Ɔdɔ a Ɛyɛ Dwo ( bnrt mrwt ). [2] Abar ho kyerɛwtohɔ ahorow gyina hɔ ma tumi a Queens wɔ wɔ Kush Ahemman no mu ho kyerɛwtohɔ a edi kan. [3] Reisner hyɛɛ nyansa sɛ wobetumi asie Abar wɔ Nuri wɔ ɔboda 35. [4]

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Arty (Queen)
text:
Na Arty yɛ Nubia Ɔhene yere a wɔtraa ase wɔ Misraim Ahemman a Ɛto so Aduonu Anum mu . 

Na Arty yɛ Ɔhene Piye babea na na ɔyɛ Shebitku yere . Wonim no fi Cairo ohoni 49157 a efi Karnak . Wɔabɔ ne din wɔ Haremakhet ohoni bi ase . 

Wosiee no wɔ amusiei a ɛwɔ El-Kurru, wɔ ɔboda Ku.6 mu.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Atakhebasken
text:
Na Atakhebasken ( Akhetbasaken ) yɛ Nubia hemmaa bi a wɔkyerɛw no wɔ Misraim Ahemman a Ɛto so Aduonu Anum mu .  Na ɔyɛ Farao Taharqa Ahemfie Yere Kɛse .

Asie 
Wonim Atakhebasken titiriw fi n’adamoa a ɛwɔ Nuri (Nu. 36). Nneɛma a wɔahu afi ɔdamoa no mu bi ne: shawabti, nkuku a wɔde ntama ayɛ, a mprempren ɛwɔ Boston, ne afɔremuka bi a mprempren ɛwɔ Meroe Tete Nneɛma Akorae wɔ Khartoum.   Wɔmaa n’adamoa no yɛɛ kɛse bere a wosii asɔredan no dedaw akyi.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Khensa
text:
Ná Khensa ( Khenensaiuw ) yɛ Nubia hemmaa a wɔkyerɛw no wɔ Misraim Ahemman a Ɛto so Aduonu Anum mu . 

Wɔbɔ Khensa din sɛ Ɔhene Yere ne Ɔhene Nuabea a ɔne Ɔhene Piye bom . Eyi kyerɛ sɛ ɔyɛ Farao nuabea yere ma enti ɛbɛyɛ sɛ ɔyɛ Kashta ne Pebatjma babea .

N’abodin ahorow a edi mũ no bi ne: Awuraa a Ɔyɛ Anuonyam ( iryt p't ), Ayeyi Kɛse ( wrt hzwt ), Ɔdɔ a Ɛyɛ Dwo ( bnrt mrwt ), Wadjet dɔfo ( mryt w3Dt ), Adom Awuraa ( nbt im3t ), Awuraa a ɔhwɛ obiara so Ɔbaa ( hnwt hmwt nbwt ), Ɔhene Yere ( hmt niswt ), Ɔhene Kɛse Yere ( hmt niswt wrt ), Misraim Atifi ne Asase ase Awuraa ( hnwt Sm'w mhw ), Asase Abien no Awuraa ( hnwt t3wy ), Ɔhene Babea ( s3t niswt ), Ɔhene Nuabea ( snt niswt ), ne nea ɔma Ɔhene no dwo da biara ( shtp niswt m hrt hrw ). 

Wɔadi Khensa ho adanse wɔ ohoni bi - a Piye ka ho - a wɔahyira so ama onyamewa Bastet so . Wɔsiee no wɔ pyramid bi mu wɔ el-Kurru (Ku4). Ná ayie nneɛma no afã horow te sɛ afɔrebɔ pon, nkuku, nkuku a wɔde kata so, ne nea ɛkeka ho da so ara wɔ ɔdamoa no

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Naparaye
text:
Na Naparaye yɛ Nubia hemmaa a wɔkyerɛw no wɔ Misraim Ahemman a Ɛto so Aduonu Anum mu . 

Naparaye yɛ Ɔhene Piye babea ne Ɔhene Taharqa nuabea yere .

Na okura abodin ahorow pii: Adom Kɛse ( wrt im3t ), Ayeyi Kɛse ( wrt hzwt ), Ɔdɔ a Ɛyɛ Dwo ( bnrt mrwt ), ( Kɛse? ) Ɔhene Yere ( hmt niswt (wrt? ) ), Asase Abien no Awuraa ( hnwt t3wy ), ne Ɔhene Nuabea ( snt niswt ). 

Wonim Naparaye din fi n’adamoa a ɛwɔ el-Kurru (Ku. 3). Wohuu alabaster afɔrebɔpon bi wɔ ne pyramid no so (Khartoum, No. 191).

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Nasalsa
text:
Na Nasalsa yɛ Nubia hemmaa a ɔwɔ Kus Ahemman mu a wɔtraa ase wɔ Misraim Ahemman a Ɛto so Aduonu Anum mu . Wonim no fi shabti, nkyerɛwee bi a ɛwɔ abopon ne nkuruwa so, nkyerɛwee a ɛwɔ Khaliut stela so, ahosohyira nkyerɛwee ne nkyerɛwee bi a efi Kawa.  Dodson ka sɛ wɔabɔ Nasalsa din wɔ Enthronement Stela a ɛwɔ Atlanersa ne Election and Adoption Stelae a ɛwɔ Aspelta no so. Na saa stelae yi fi Gebel Barkal hɔ .

Nkwa 
Na Nasalsa yɛ Atlanersa a ɔyɛ Senkamanisken nuabea yere ne Ahene Anlamani ne Aspelta ne Ɔhemmaa Madiqen nso maame babea.  

Anlamani stela (Kawa VIII) no wɔ nkyekyem bi a ɛka Nasalsa a wɔfrɛɛ no na ohui sɛ ne ba no te ahengua no so ho asɛm:

Afei na ɔhene maame Nasalsa, ma ɔntra ase daa, ka adehye anuanom mmea no ho. Ɔhene ɛna a ɔdɔ yɛ dɛ no, na ɔyɛ ɔyerenom nyinaa wura. N’Awurade somaa ahokafo sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔde no bɛba. Ohuu ne ba no sɛ ɔda ne ho adi te sɛ Horus wɔ n’ahengua so. N’ani gyei kɛse bere a ohui sɛ N’Awurade no ahoɔfɛ no. 

Aspelta’s Adoption stela no ka Nasalsa ho asɛm sɛ Ɔhene Nuabea, Ɔhene no Maame, Kus Awuraa, ne Re Babea. Nkyerɛwee no ka sɛ na Nasalsa yɛ Ɔhene Nuabea, Adoratrix a ofi Amen-Re wɔ Thebes Amenirdis no babea . Ɛbɛyɛ sɛ abusuabɔ no yɛ biako denam mmofra a wɔfa wɔn sɛ wɔn mma so, efisɛ na wosusuw sɛ Adoratrix a ɔwɔ Thebes no yɛ sigyani. "Daughter of Re" a wɔkaa ho asɛm no ne bere a edi kan a Kush Hemmaa bi de saa abodin no dii dwuma.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Pebatjma
text:
Na Pebatjma (anaa Pebatma ) yɛ Nubia hemmaa bi a wɔkyerɛw no wɔ Misraim Ahemman a Ɛto so Aduonu Anum mu . Na ɔyɛ Ɔhene Kashta yere .  Wɔaka ne ho asɛm wɔ ne babea Amenirdis I, a mprempren ɔwɔ Cairo (42198) no ohoni bi so. Wɔka ne ho asɛm nso wɔ ɔpon bi ano a efi Abydos so .

Abusua 
Na Pebatjma yɛ Ɔhene Kashta yere. Wɔakyerɛw mmofra pii ne mmofra a wobetumi ayɛ wɔn ho kyerɛwtohɔ:

Ɔhene Piye - Wosusuwii sɛ ɔyɛ Kashta ba na enti ebetumi aba sɛ ɔyɛ Pebatjma ba

Ɔhene Shabaka - Wokaa ne ho asɛm sɛ Amenirdis I nua, na ɛno nti ɔyɛ Kashta ne Pebatjma ba.  

Ɔhemmaa Khensa - Piye yere, a wosusuw sɛ ɔyɛ Kashta  ne ebia Pebatjma babea. 

Ɔhemmaa Peksater (anaasɛ Pekareslo) - Ɔwaree Piye na wosiee no wɔ Abydos. Ebia owui bere a na ɔne Piye rekɔ ɔsatu bi akɔ Egypt no.  Laming ne Macadam kyerɛ sɛ na ɔyɛ Pebatjma babea a wɔagye no ayɛ ne ba. 

Onyankopɔn Yere a ɔyɛ Amun Amenirdis I . Amenirdis ohoni bi ka sɛ ɔyɛ Kashta ne Pebatjma babea.

Neferukakashta - Wosusuw sɛ ɔyɛ Kashta  babea na ebia Pebatjma.

Ebia wobetumi de wɔn ho ahyɛ Pabtamer mu 
Ebetumi aba nanso ɛnyɛ nea ɛyɛ nokware ɔkwan biara so sɛ Pebatjma ne adehye bea bi a wɔfrɛ no Pabtamer (Pa-abt-ta-mer) yɛ pɛ. Stela bi a efi Abydos a ɛyɛ ɔsahene bi a wɔfrɛ no Paqattereru (Pekatror) dea kyerɛw sɛnea Osiris frɛɛ saa ɔsahene yi sɛ onsie ne maame Pabtamer a na ɔwɔ din fɛfɛ Meres-Nip ("Napata dɔfo" anaa "Ɔno a ɔdɔ Napata" no. ). Ɔkura abodin Amun Nnwontofo, Ɔhene Nuabea, Ɔhene babea, ne Onyankopɔn Somfo no Maame. Wɔakyerɛ sɛ Pa-abt-ta-mer yɛ Egyptfo a wɔde edin Pebatjma no ayɛ. Ɔhaw a ɛwɔ sɛnea wɔkyerɛ no mu ne sɛ Pa-abt-ta-mer kura abodin ahorow a ɛsono kakra sen nea wɔakyerɛw ama Pebatjma wɔ nkaedum afoforo so no. Bio nso, abodin a ɛne Ɔhene babea no yɛ ɔhaw kakra efisɛ ɔhene biara nni hɔ a wonim no a obetumi ayɛ n’agya. Paqattereru nyɛ Ɔhene ba, na ebia nokwasɛm ahorow yi bɛkyerɛ sɛ Pa-abt-ta-mer yɛ Piye anaa Taharqa yere a anka wonnim no, na ɔyɛ Shepenupet II anaa Amenirdis II maame.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Samuel Azu Crabbe
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm yi wɔ Asante Twi kasa mu

Samuel Azu Crabbe JSC ( wɔwoo no Obubuo bosome da a ɛtɔ so du nnwɔtwe wɔ afe apem ahankron ne du nnwɔtwe mu (1918) -  Ɛbɔ da ɛtɔ so du nnum wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne num mu(2005) mu na owuiɛ) yɛ Ghana mmaranimni, sɔlisita ne mmaratwerɛfoɔ. Ɔno ne ɔtemmuafo kunini a ɛtɔ nnum  efi bere a Ghana bɛyɛɛ ɔman a wɔade ne ho no.

Ne mmofraseɛ ne Nwomasua 
James Town kuro bi a ɛwɔ Nkran, a ɛyɛ Ghana nyinaa mantam kunini mu na wɔwoo Samuel Azu Crabbe. Ɔkɔɔ ntoasoɔ sukuu wɔ Accra Academy a na ɔyɛ sukuufoɔ no nyinaa kannifo wɔ afe apem aha nkron aduasa nkron (1939) na  ɔtoaa so wɔ Achimota College. Ɔwiee  ntoasoɔ sukuu no, ɔtoaa n'adesua so wɔ University College London. Ɔde mmaranim mu abɔdin na ɛwie sukuu  no wɔ afe apem aha nkron ne aduanan nsia (1946)  mu. Afe apem aha nkron aduanan nnwɔtwe (1948) mu no, Engeresi Mmaranimkuo Baatan too nsa frɛ no sɛ ɔmmɛka wɔn ho. Berɛ a na ɔyɛ adesuani no, ɔde ne ho gyee sukuu mu agodie mu pa ara. Ɛno maa no bɛdii agodie kuw ahodoɔ te sɛ bɔɔlobɔ, hɔki ne crikɛt so sahene wɔ sukuu mfiaseɛ ne suapɔn mu.

Agodie mu Nsɛm 
Bere Owura Azu Crabbe wie sukuu no, ɔkɔɔ so de ne gyee agodie mu pa ara. Na ɔbɛdii Ghana National Olympic Committee   so panin wɔ afe apem aha nkron aduosia nnwɔtwe (1968)  de kɔsi afe apem aha nsia ne aduosia nkron (1969) . Wɔ afe apem aha nkron aduoson nkron (1979) mu no, wɔsane too ne so aba sɛ ɔpanin  wɔ Ghana National Olympic Committee so bio.

Adwuma 
Bere a Owura Samuel Azu Crabbe wie ne nteteɛ wɔ UK no, ɔsane n'akyi baa Ghana w ɔ afe apem aha nkron ne aduonum mu bɛyɛɛ adwuma sɛ mmranimni ne sɔlisita. Wɔ afe apem aha nkron ne aduonum nkron mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ Ɔtemmuafoɔ Kunini na wɔpaw no sɛ ɔtemmuafo wɔ Ghana Asɛnnibea Kunini mu wɔ afe apem aha nkron adousia baako.

Sɛ yɛde ne adwuma a ɔdii sɛ Ɔtemmuafoɔ to nkyɛn a, Azu Crabbe dii nneɛma pii nso ho dwuma. Bere a National Liberation Council a wɔtuu Nkrumah aban so adeɛ so wɔ aban mu no, na ɔyɛ  National Finance Board so panin. Wɔ afe apem aha nkron aduosia nson mu no, wɔpaw no sɛ ɔnni  kuw a  wɔapaw wɔn sɛ wɔn hwehwɛ man panin dada Kwame Nkrumah ahodeɛ mu so panin (The Azu Crabbe Commission). National Redemption Council (NRC) no paw no sɛ Ɔtemmuafoɔ Kunini wɔ afe apem aha nkron aduoson mmiɛnsa mu. National Redemption Council (NRC) yɛ sogyafoɔ aban a wɔtuu Busia aban no adeɛ so wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn da ɛtɔ so du mmiɛnsa wɔ afe apem aha nkron aduoson mmienu mu. Wɔ nneɛma pa pii a Owura Azu Crabbe yɛɛ nti, International Association of Trial Lawyers de sika kɔkɔɔ mɛdal bɔɔ no aba so. Bere a General Acheampong da so redi adeɛ sɛ man panin wɔ afe apem aha nkron adouson nnum mu no, National Redemption Council (NRC) sesaa ne ho bɛyɛɛ Supreme Military Council (SMC). Akyire yi, Ghana Bar Association (GBA) too aba sɛ wɔnni Acheampong aban no mu gyidie bio. Wɔkɔɔ so ara teteete Supreme Military Council (SMC) ma enti Supreme Military Council (SMC) hyehyɛɛ mmara a ɛne Judicial Service (Amendment) Decree, 1977 (SMCD 101) na ɛno maa wɔyii no adi firii ne dibea sɛ Ɔtemmuafoɔ Kunini. Ɛsiane sɛ na wɔawe ataa so sɛ wɔbɛyi no adi nti, wɔde mmara ɛne Judicial Service (Amendment) Decree no kaa mmara a mmarahyɛ badwam kunini ahyehyɛ nwoma no ho.

Ɛkuw a ɛyɛ Nhwehwɛmu Soronko bi 
Jerry Rawling Provisional National Defence Council (PNDC) bere so no, wɔ faa atemmuafoɔ baasa ne sogyani a ɔkɔ ahomegyeɛ mu no mum firii wɔn afie mu wɔ Ahinime da ɛtɔ so 30 afe apem aha nkron aduowɔtwe mmienu mu. Kitawonsa da  ɛtɔ so mmiensa afe apem aha nkron aduowɔtwe mmienu mu no wɔhunuu wɔn muun wɔ Bundase Military Range, bɛyɛ kwansini aduonum de firi Nkran. Na wɔakum wɔn.

Nnipa baanan yi nyinaa na wɔadi nsɛm bi a ne di mu no wɔhyɛɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnyi nnipa bi a na wɔabu wɔn atɛn sɛ wɔnkɔ da afiase mfe1 pii wɔ Armed Forces Revolutionary Council (AFRC) amammuo a Jerry Rawlings dii anim wɔ afe apem aha nkron aduoson nkron mu. Ɛsiane ahohyehyeɛ a wɔde baa PNDC aban no so nti, wɔtew ɛkuw a ɛne Special Investigation Board (SIB) sɛ wɔnyɛ wɔn wuo no mu nhwehwɛmu. Wɔ paw Samuel Azu Crabbe sɛ SIB so panin. Adwuma a wɔyɛɛ de adwene kyerɛ baeɛ sɛ wɔnkum nnipa du bi. Nnipa du yi mu baanu ne Joachim Amartey Quaye ne Alolga Akata-Pore a wɔyɛ PNDC kuw no mufoɔ. Deɛ ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa ne sogyani panin a ɔkɔ ahomegyeɛ, Kojo Tsikata a na ɔsane nso yɛ PNDC no ɔfotufoɔ ne ahobammɔ panin wɔ ɔman no mu.

Berɛ a nhwehwɛmu no rekɔ so nyinaa no, aban koowa krataa a ɛne Ghanaian Times yɛɛ dede sɛ adwuma SIB no reyɛ no nyɛ ne kwan so. Wɔde Azu Crabbe ne n'abusua nyinaa faa ahunahuna mu pa ara, a ɛbi ne sɛ anyinam ahoden a ɛkɔ ne fie no wɔtwaa mu na afei nso, ne babaa a ɔwɔ London (England) nso wɔfrɛfrɛɛ no sɛ ne papa bɛwu nansa yi ara.

Ɛsiane ne ɔpɛ pa sɛ ɔbɛsom ne man nti wɔamma amanyɔsɛm mu ahohyeheɛ no ammɔ ne hunu koraa. Bere a ɔde ne nsunsuansoɔ ɛtwatoɔ too dwa no bere tiawa bi akyi no, Azu Crabbe ne Captain Tsikata dii anobaeɛbaeɛ wɔ amansan

kasafidie sɛ Crabbe ne Amerika CIA no wɔ biribi yɛ.

Abasobɔdeɛ 
Ɛsiane ne nnwuma pa ɔyɛɛ de somm Ghana nti wɔ afe apem aha nkron adouson nson mu no, wɔde Companion of the Order of the Volta bɔɔ no aba so.

Owuo 
Samuel Azu Crabbe wuu  Ɛbɔ da ɛtɔ so du nnum mfe  mpem mmienu ne du nnum mu  wɔ Aburii a ɛwɔ Ghana mu Apueiɛ mantam mu. Ɔgyaa ɔyere ne mma baanum ne banananom nkron.

Nwoma a wɔayɛ 
Crabbe, Samuel Azu (1998). Law of Wills in Ghana. Vieso Universial.ISBN 978-9988-0-1008-9.

Nkekaho 
Judicial Service (Amendment) Decree, 1977 (SMCD 101

 Ɛmfa ho mmara biara wɔahyehyɛ a ɛbɔ abira no, Owura Ɔtemmuafoɔ S.Azu Crabbe Ghana Ɔtemmuafoɔ Kunini no, wɔama no kɔ ahomegyeɛ mu sɛ Ɔtemmuafoɔ Kunini na ɔnka Atemmufoɔ Adwuma no ho bio de firi Ahinime da ɛtɔ so du nnum afe apem aha nkron aduoson nson.
 Ɛmfa ho sɛ Owura Ɔtemmuafo S. Azu Crabbe nka Atemmufoɔ Adwuma bio no de, nanso ahomegyeɛ a ɛnka ɛsɛ sɛ ɔnya bere a na wɔnyii no adi ne mfasodeɛ a ɛsɛ ɔnya no nyinaa ɛsɛ sɛ ɔnya sɛdeɛ anka ɔbenya bere anka ɔno ara ɔkɔɔ ahomegyeɛ mu saa da no.

title: Peksater
text:
Peksater ( Pekerslo  ) yɛ Nubia hemmaa bi a wɔkyerɛw no wɔ Misraim Ahemman a Ɛto so Aduonu Anum mu .

Asetra mu nsɛm 
Na Peksater yɛ Ɔhene Kashta ne Ɔhemmaa Pebatjma babea . Ɔne ne kunu Piye pue wɔ ahotɔ mu wɔ Amun Asɔredan a ɛwɔ Barkal no mu. Piye hyɛ atade sɛ ɔsɔfo panyin na ɔyɛ adwuma wɔ Amun barque anim.  Laming ne Macadam kyerɛ sɛ na ɔyɛ Pebatjma babea a wɔagye no ayɛ ne ba. 

Wosiee Peksater wɔ Abydos, Egypt . Wohuu ɔdan atifi afã horow, apon ano apon abiɛsa ne stela.   Ɛha na wɔfrɛ no ɔhene babea, ɔhene yere ne ɔhene kɛse yere .

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Qalhata
text:
Na Qalhata yɛ Nubia hemmaa a wɔkyerɛw no wɔ Misraim Ahemman a Ɛto so Aduonu Anum mu . 

Na Qalhata yɛ Ɔhene Piye babea na na ɔyɛ ne nuabarima Shabaka hemmaa yere . Wonim no fi Ɔhene Tantamani Dae Stela ne ne pyramid a ɛwɔ El-Kurru (Ku. 5) mu. 

Asiriafo kyerɛwtohɔ ahorow ka sɛ na Ɔhene Tantamani yɛ Taharqa nuabea ba. Qalhata ɔboda a ɛwɔ El-Kurru no kura nkyerɛwee ahorow a ɛka sɛ ɔyɛ Ɔhene Maame, na ɛde abusua no mu abusuabɔ ho adanse bi ma.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Tabekenamun
text:
Na Tabekenamun ( Tabakenamun ) yɛ Nubia hemmaa bi a ɔtraa ase wɔ Misraim Ahemman a Ɛto so Aduonu Anum mu . 

Na Tabekenamun yɛ Ɔhene Piye babea na ebia na ɔyɛ ne nua Taharqa hemmaa yere . Wonim no fi Cairo ohoni 49157 a efi Karnak . 

Afoforo nso akyerɛ sɛ na Tabekenamun yɛ Shabaka yere . Na ɔyɛ Ɔhene Babea, Ɔhene Nuabea ne Ɔhene Yere. Nea ɛka ho no, na ɔyɛ Hathor sɔfobea, Tepihu (Aphroditopolis) Awuraa ne Hathor a ofi Iunyt ( Dendera ) sɔfobea ne Neith sɔfobea nso. Asɔfodibea ahorow no betumi akyerɛ sɛ na ɔyɛ Libya Faraonom no mu biako babea.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Tabiry
text:
Tabiry yɛ Alara a ofi Nubia ne ne yere Kasaqa ne Ɔhene Piye yere babea . Na okura abodin ahorow bi a ɛyɛ anigye: Ɔhene Panyin Yere, nea odi kan wɔ n’anuonyam ( hmt niswt ’at tpit n hm.f ) (ɔhemmaa foforo biako pɛ a okura Ɔhene Kɛse Yere abodin ne Nefertiti ) ne “Amannɔne Ɔman no mu Ɔkɛseɛ” . ( ta-aat-khesut ). Ɔsan nso kura abodin ahorow a ɛyɛ gyinapɛn kɛse a ɛne Ɔhene Yere ( hmt niswt ), Ɔhene Babea ( s3t niswt ), ne Ɔhene Nuabea ( snt niswt ). 

Wɔsiee Tabiry wɔ pyramid bi mu wɔ El-Kurru (K.53). Afunsie a wɔde granite ayɛ a wohuu wɔ n’adamoa mu no ka sɛ ɔyɛ Alara a ofi Nubia ne Piye yere babea. Mprempren stela no wɔ Khartoum .   Stela no ma Tabiry abodin afoforo. Mfiase no na Reisner akyerɛ n’abodin biako ase sɛ ‘Temehufo panyin kɛse’ (Libyafo kesee fam), na ɔde baa awiei sɛ Kush ahemfie no ne Libyafo wɔ abusuabɔ wɔ ɔkwan bi so.  Afoforo nso ada no adi fi saa bere no sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ wɔkenkan n'abodin no sɛ "Ɔkɛseɛ (anaasɛ 'Ɔpanyin') a ɔte Anhweatam so, a ɛkyerɛ sɛ n'abodin no de no bata Nubiafoɔ ho.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Takahatenamun
text:
Takahatenamun ( Takahatamun, Takhahatamani ) yɛ Nubia hemmaa a wɔkyerɛw no wɔ Misraim Ahemman a Ɛto so Aduonu Anum mu .

Abusua 
Takahat(en)amun yɛ Ɔhene Piye babea ne Ɔhene Taharqa nuabea-yere . Na okura abodin ahorow pii: Awuraa a Ɔyɛ Anuonyam ( iryt p't ), Ayeyi Kɛse ( wrt hzwt ), Ɔhene Yere ( hmt niswt ), Mmea Nyinaa Awuraa ( hnwt hmwt nbwt ), ne Ɔhene Nuabea ( snt niswt ).

Adanse ahorow a wɔde ma 
Wonim Takahat(en)amun fi asɔredan mu mfonini bi a ɛwɔ Mut asɔredan mu wɔ Gebel Barkal baabi a wɔkyerɛ no sɛ ogyina Taharqa a ɔrebɔ afɔre ama Amun-Re ne Mut akyi.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: J. N. K Taylor
text: Yɛwoo Taylor wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduonu num (1925) mu a na ɔfiri Korankyem a ɛwɔ mfimfini mantam no mu.

Donyo

title: Barbara Frances Ackah-Yensu
text:
Barbara France Ackah-Yensu yɛ Ghanani mmaranimni. Ɔno ne Ɔtɛmmuafoɔ Kunini a ɔwɔ Ghana mprenpren.

N'abrabɔ Ahyɛaseɛ ne Nhomasua
Wɔwoo Ackah-Yensu wɔ Ɔgyefoɔ 2, 1955 ɛwɔ Cape Coast. Wɔnyaa ne mmɔfra berɛ mu sukuu nteteyɛ wɔ Christ the King sukuu mu firi afe 1965 kosi 1967. Ɛno akyi no, wɔtoaa so wɔ Wesley Girl's High School de gyee O' level (Ordinary Level) ne A' Level (Advanced Level) abodin nkrataa no wɔ afe 1972 ne 1974 mu. Wɔ afe 1974 mu no, wonyaa hokwan kɔ suaa Psychology ne Sociology wɔ University of Ghana. Wonyaa abodin krataa wɔ Psychology ne Sociology mu wɔ afe 1977 mu. Wɔ berɛ a wowiee suapɔn no akyi no, wɔsan nso kɔsuaa Mmara (Qualifying Certificate in Law) wɔ suapɔn koro no ara mu firi Ɔpɛpɔn bosome no mu wɔ afe 1979 kosi Ɛbɔ bosome no mu wɔ afe 1979. Afei wɔtoaa so wɔ Ghana School of Law, ɛhɔ na wɔpaw no kɔɔ aban mu wɔ afe 1981. Wɔ afe 2010 mu no, wonyaa abodin krataa firii China Europe International Business School, na wɔ afe 2019 mu nso, wonyaa abodin krataa wɔ International Arbitration mu firii The Queen's College, Oxford hɔ.

Adwuma
Wɔ Barbara suapɔn nhomasua akyi pɛɛ no, wɔ kɔ yɛɛ Ɔman-atu-ho-ama (National Service) wɔ Ghana Reassurance Organisation a ɛwɔ Nkran no mu sɛ Ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ adetɔn so (Marketing Officer) firi afe 1977 kosi 1979. Wɔ berɛ a wɔfrɛɛ no kɔɔ mmara mu no, wɔde ne ho dɔm ankorankorɛ adwumakuo bi te sɛ Lynes  Quarshie-Idun & Co., National Investment Bank (NIB), Non-Performing Assets Recovery Trust, Ghanaian Australian Goldfields Ltd, Ashanti Goldfields Ltd, ne World Bank/Non-Performing Assets Recovery Trust a ɛwɔ Uganda.

Wɔ Benada, Ɛbɔ da ɛtɔ so du-nsia afe 2003 no, wɔsuanee Ackah-Yensu sɛ Ɔtɛnmuafo wɔ  High Court a ɛwɔ Ghana. Na ɔyɛ n'adwuma no wɔ Tema High Court kosii sɛ wɔde no kɔɔ Commercial Court. Wɔyeree ne ho yɛɛ adwumaden kosii sɛ wɔpaw no sɛ Ɔtɛnmuafo wɔ Appeal Court a ɛwɔ Ghana wɔ afe 2012 bosome Ahinime mu.

Kuninin mu Hokwan ne Dwumadie 
Wɔ Kitawonsa da a ɛtɔ so nnan afe 2022 mu no, Ɔmanpanin de Judicial Council ne Council of State afutuo yɛɛ adwuma yii Ackah-Yensu kaa atɛnmuafoɔ mmiɛnsa ho (George Kingsley Koomson, Samuel Kwame Adibu Asiedu, and Ernest Yao Gaewu) sɛ wonhwɛ sɛ wofata sɛ wɔyɛ adwuma wɔ Mmarahyɛbadwafie Kunini mu anaa. Wɔ Kitawonsa da ɛtɔ so aduonu-nnum afe 2022 mu no, Mmarahyɛbadwafie Kasamafoɔ wɔ mmarahyɛbɛdwafie no de too dwa sɛ wɔmpɛɛpɛɛ nnipa nnan mu nhwɛ sɛ wofata ma dwumadie a wɔde rebɛhyɛ wɔn nsa no.

Wɔ Ahinime da a ɛtɔ so du-nnwɔtwe afe 2022 mu no, wɔtotoo Ackah-Yensu ano de hwɛɛ sɛ ɔfata anaa. Wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa da a ɛtɔ so nnson afe 2022, wɔgyee Ackah-Yensu ne Samuel Adibu Asiedu toom wɔ mmarahyɛbadwafie.  Abɛdwafoɔ no dii nnipa mmienu yi ho adanse sɛ wonim mmara no yie, wɔn ho akokwaw ma dwumadie no, na wɔsan nso wɔ suban pa. Wɔhyɛɛ bɔ sɛ wɔmma kwan mma ehu anaa osuro biara nka wɔn atɛnmuo biara. Wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa da a ɛtɔ so du-baako afe 2022 mu no, mmarahyɛbadwafie no gyee Ackah-Yensu toom na Ɔkasafoɔ Kunini de kaa ho sɛ Asiedu ne Ackah-Yensu ayɛ adwuma  wɔ Mmarahyɛbɛdwafie Kunini hɔ mu akyɛ yie paa ara. Ɔsan de kaa ho sɛ, " Acakah-Yensu yɛ ɔtɛnmuafoɔ a ɔbɔ ne ho mmɔden, ɔsuani a ɔda nsow, na ɔde adwumaden ne ahokeka ada no adi sɛ obi a ne ho akokwaw yie wɔ mmara mu. Minnim nea enti a wɔampaw no ntɛm anka Mmarahyɛbadwafie no mufoɔ ho".  

Ɔmanpanin Nana Akufo Addo suanee Ackah-Yensu kɔɔ aban mu Wukuada, Ɔpɛnima da a ɛtɔ so aduonu-nnwɔtwe afe 2022 mu.

N'asetena mu Nsɛm
Ackah-Yensu aware awo mma nnum, mmarima nnan ɛna ɔbaa baako. Ɔyɛ Kristoni mapa a ɔkɔ Roman Catholic asɔre. N'ani gye aduaneyɛ, nnwom, asa, akwantuo ne akenkan ho.

Baabi A Minyaa Mmoa Firii

title: Aboso
text:
Aboso yɛ kuro bi a ɛbɛn Tarkwa, na ɛyɛ Wassa Atɔe Mantam no kuropɔn   a ɛwɔ Ghana Atɔeɛ Mantam mu  Aboso yɛ nkuro a ɛtɔ so 78 wɔ Ghana a emu nnipa dodɔ yɛ 9,945.  Wɔ Ghana nnipa kenkan a wɔyɛe wɔ 18 March 1984 mu no, na nnipa 4,700 na wɔte kuro no mu. 

Kurow no wɔ beae titiriw bi wɔ sika kɔkɔɔ tubea a ɛde Tarkwa nkoko so fi afeha a ɛto so 19 awiei.  Kurow no  din a wɔde too Aboso Goldfield Ltd, Gold Fields adwumakuw bi a ɛyɛ Damang ho adwuma. 

Kan no na kurow no yɛ beae a na adwumakuo  Aboso Aboso, adwumakuw titiriw bi a wɔyɛ nkotoku na wɔde ma anonne adwuma no.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: J.N.K Taylor
text: Ɔwui wɔ Ɔsanaa bosome da a ɛtɔ so du-num wɔ mfe mpenu ne wɔtwe berɛ a na wadi mfeɛ aduowɔtwe mmiɛnsa (83).

title: Alfred Akainyah
text:
Alfred Augustus Akainyah( wɔ woo no afe apem aha nkron ne nson na afe apem aha nkron aduowɔtwe nnwɔtwe na ɔwuiɛ) yɛ Ghana mmranimni ne mmratwerɛfoɔ.Wɔ Ghana Kwasafoman berɛ a ɛdi kan no mu, na ɔyɛ ɔtemmuafoɔ wɔ Ghana asennibea kunini.

BAABI A MENYAA MMOA FIRIIƐ

Na Alfred yɛ Nzemani a wɔ woo no Ɔgyefoɔ da a ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ afe apem aha nkron ne nson. Ɔno ne abɔfra a ɔtɔ so mmienu wɔ Agya John Akainyah  a na ɔyɛ kuafoɔ ne Tufuhene a ɔtɔ so mmienu wɔ Nzema kuro bi a ɛwɔ Atɔeɛ Mantam mu. Ɔkɔɔ Gold Coast Police Training College na Ɔbɛyɛɛ Polisini wɔ afe apem aha nkron ne aduonuwɔtwe nnwɔtwe mu.

ADWUMAYƐ 
Alfred somoo wɔ Gold Coast Polisifoɔ no mu firii afe apem aha nkron aduonu nnwɔtwe de kɔsii afe apem aha nkron aduanan nsia berɛ a, ɔwɔ dibea a ɛso sene dibea a Afrikafoɔ bɛtumi anya no,Ɔgyaee adwuma a na ɔyɛ no sɛ Ɔhwɛfoɔ Panyin no de ne ho hyɛɛ mmara mu wɔ United Kingdom.Na Ɔyɛ Afrikafoɔ a wɔdi anim sene obiara wɔ Kibi Agyiraehyɛdeɛ a Wɔkum No ho nhwehwɛmu mu wɔ Akyea Mensah a wɔkumm no wɔ afe aha nkron aduanan mmiɛnsa mu akyi,sɛ Ɔsraani Panyin a Ɔboa.Wɔfrɛɛ no sɛ Middle Temple mmaranimfoɔ wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nsia,afe apem aha nkron aduanan nkron mu.Alfred Akainyah kɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ Nkran wɔ Mmaranimfoɔ Koi Larbi dan mu saa afe no ara mu,Ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ mmaranimfoɔ a Ɔhwɛ mmara so mfeɛ mmienu.Wɔ afe apem aha nkron aduonun baako mu no,wɔyɛɛ no Ɔmantamsodifoɔ berɛ a na Ɔyɛ Western Nzema mantam no Sikakorafoɔ no.Nanso,Ɔsan kɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ ankorankora fie kɔsii sɛ Ɛbɔ da a ɛdi kan wɔ afe apem aha nkron aduosia mmienu no,wɔyɛɛ no Ɔman Asɛnnibea Kunini no Tɛmmuafoɔ.Berɛ a na ɔyɛ asɛnnibea Kunini tɛmmuafoɔ no,wɔyɛɛ no wɔ afe apem aha nkron aduosia mmiɛnsa mu sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ kuo bi a wɔbɛdi nsɛm a ɛmfata a ɛfa nnoɔma a wɔde ba no ho nhwehwɛmu.Mfeɛ mmienu akyi no, wɔyɛɛ Ɔno ne Fred Apaloo ne Charles Sterling Acolatse sɛ Asɛnnibea Kunini Atɛmmuafoɔ a na wɔatu wɔn afiri wɔn ananmu wɔ ɔman no mu nkoasom ho asɛnni mu no ananmu.Berɛ a wɔtwaa asɛm no so bio no,wɔbuu no fɔ.Alfred Akainyah,ne Kwesi Armah a ɔyɛ CPP mu nnipa titirew a na ɔyɛ Nkrumah adamfo a ɔgye no die,ne Ɔmanpanyin Kwaw Swanzy, wɔn nyinaa yɛ Nzemafoɔ,ne Ɔmanpanyin Nkrumah hyiaeɛ sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛserɛ sɛ wɔmfa wɔn a wɔabu wɔn fɔ no bɔne nkyɛ wɔn.Berɛ a na ɔwɔ Asɛnnibea Kunini no, na Ɔdi Henry Djaba,F Y Asare a na ɔyɛ Nkrumah aban no mu Ɔmanpanyin, ne James Kuartey a na wɔwɔ GAMCO kuayɛ mu no asɛm no anim.Wɔdii wɔn fɔ maa wɔde wɔn guu afiase mfeɛ pii.Wɔpamoo no wɔ Ayɛwohomumu da a ɛtɔ so nson wɔ afe aha nkron aduosia nsia,wɔ Nkrumah a wɔtuu no guiiɛ no akyi,ɛwɔm mpo sɛ na wadi kan de n'ahofadeɛ ama wɔn NLC nniso no mu,esiane sɛ Ollenu Commission Of Inɛuiry bɔɔ ne yere, Victoria Adobea Akainyah soboɔ sɛ wadi amumɔyɛsɛm nti.Wɔbɔɔ ne yere soboɔ ,na wɔde no too afiase.Ɔbɔɔ ne yere no ho ban ɛfiri sɛ na ɔno ankasa na wɔtan no nti.Mfitiaseɛ no,na Britain mmaranimfoɔ a wagye din a wɔfrɛ no Sir Dingle Foot na ɔboa ne yere no, ɛfiri sɛ na mmaranimfoɔ foforɔ a wɔwɔ hɔ no mpɛ sɛ wɔboa no.Berɛ a Ɔkɔyɛɛ ankorankora asɛnnibea mmaranimni no,Ɔfirii aseɛ yɛɛ adwuma sɛ mmaranimfoɔ.

NABRABƆ 
Ɔwaree ɔbaa a ne din de Victoria Adobea Akainyah.Na ɔyɛ Kristoni mmapa a ɔsom wɔ Anglican asɔre mu,na ɔyɛ ɔkenkanfoɔ a ɔnyɛ ɔsɔfo,na ɔyɛ Saint Luke Anglican Asɔre a ɛwɔ Aburi no muni.Na ɔyɛ Ghana dwomtoni Samuel Akainyah ɔyɛɛ Akainyah gallary no papa.Ne mma mmiɛnsa a wɔn din ne Lawrence Benzo Akainyah,Emma Amakye ne Azanne Kofi Akainyah nso kɔɔ mmaranim sukuu bɛyɛɛ mmaranimfoɔ.

title: Bekwai
text:
Bekwai yɛ Bekwai Mansin no  Ahenkuro kuropɔn a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.   Bekwai yɛ kuro a ɛtɔ so aduɔson nkron wɔ nkuro a nnipa dɔɔso sen biara wɔ Ghana, a nnipa dodoɔ 7,267 na wɔte mu.  Bekwai ne Bekwai Mansin wɔ Ashanti mantam ahenkurow Kumasi anafoɔ fam, wɔ Obuasi atifi fam .

Telefon so nkitahodi 
Ɔmanfoɔ telefon a wotua ho ka 37 na ɛwɔ hɔ a ɛfiri telefon nhama 5,000 a ɛnam Bekwai Mansin nyinaa mu. Afei nso, wɔatew posɔfese bi.

Akwahosan ne ahotew ho nhyehyɛe 
Bekwai  wɔ ɔman Ayaresabea nso wɔ hɔ. Bekwai yɛ nkuropɔn nsia a ɛwɔ Bekwai Mansin a wɔtaa nya nsuo a ɛnam abɛɛforo kwan so mu no mu baako.

Nwomasua 
Seventh Day Adventist Ntoasoɔ sukuu, Wesley High Ntoasoɔ sukuu , College of Accountancy, St. John Ntoasoɔ sukuu

Keteke gyinabea 
Bekwai wɔ keteke gyinabea bi wɔ hɔ .

title: Tema
text:
Articles with short description
Short description is different from Wikidata

Tema yɛ kuropɔn bi a ɛwɔ  Bight of Benin ne Atlantic mpoano wɔ Ghana . Ɛda bɛyɛ 25 kilometres (16 mi) wɔ ahenkurow no apuei fam; Accra, wɔ Greater Accra mantam mu,  na ɛyɛ Tema koropɔn Mantam no ahenkurow. Ɛde besi afe 2013 no, na Tema tɔ so dubaako  wɔ nkurow  a nnipa dɔɔso sen biara wɔ Ghana a na nnipa dodow bɛyɛ 161,612  na ɛte hɔ– ɛso atew kɛse wɔ afe 2005 dodow a ɛyɛ 209,000 no ho.  Greenwich Meridian (00 Longitude) no  nam kuro no mu tẽẽ.  Wɔtoo Tema wɔ mpɔtam hɔ din "Harbour City" esiane sɛ ɛhɔ yɛ Ghana po so hyɛn gyinabea kɛse . Ɛwɔ mpɔtam ahodoɔ 25 a emu biara wɔ nɔma a wɔde hyɛ no agyirae , na  emu biara wɔ nneɛma a ema asetna kɔ so yiyie. 

Tema yɛ kurow a wɔasi wɔ beae a mpataayi akuraa ketewaa bi wɔ. Ghana mampanyin a odi kan, Kwame Nkrumah, na ɔhyɛɛ Tema ase, na enyaa nkɔso ntɛmntɛm bere a wosii  ɛpo so hyɛn gyinabea kɛse wɔ afe 1961  akyi. Tema Kuropɔn  no yɛ nea nkuropɔn  nhyehyɛefo a wagye abasobɔdeɛ ne Ghana Ɔdansifo a odi kan, Theodore S. Clerk na ɔyɛɛ ho nhyehyɛe. Ná adansifo dodow bi a wɔtetee wɔn wɔ London Adansie Fekuw ka adansie fekuo no ho.  Mprempren ɛyɛ guadibea kɛseɛ, ɛhɔ na adwumakuo a wɔyɛ fangoo ho nnwuma wɔ, ne nnwuma ahorɔw pii , na ɛnam kwan pa ne keteke kwan so na ɛne Accra di nhiamu. Tema yɛ Ghana po so hyɛn gyinabea mienu a emu dɔ no mu biako, nea ɛka ho ne Sekondi-Takoradi .  Tema nyaa fahodie  wɔ 1974 mu na wɔmaa no so yɛɛ no Mansin wɔ December 1990 mu. Tema kuropɔn no ka nkrupɔn , amantam ne mpɛsoa 16 a ɛwɔ Greater Accra Region no. Mansin no ne Ashaiman Mansin, Adenta Mansin, ne Ledzokuku-Krowor Mansin  bɔ hyeɛ wɔ  atɔeɛ fam, ɛne Kpone Katamanso bɔ hyeɛ wɔ apuei fam , wɔ Atifi fam no, ɛne Dangbe Atifi Atɔeɛ mpɛsoa bɔ hyeɛ, na wɔ Anafoɔ fam ɛne Gulf of Guinea.

Abakɔsɛm 
Wosii Tema wɔ beae a na mpataayi akuraa ketewaa bi a wɔfrɛ no Torman, a egyina hɔ ma kroa dua bi woduaa wɔ mpɔtam hɔ a ɛde Tor, a na wodua wɔ hɔ no. wonyaa "Tema" fi "Torman"  mu. Aban no huu beae no ansa na wonyaa fahodie wɔ 1952 mu no, wogyee 166 square kilometres (64 sq mi) asase a ɛwɔ hyɛn gyinabea no atifi fam, a wɔde hyɛɛ adwumakuo a ɛde Tema Development Corporation nsa sɛ wɔnfa hɔ nyɛ mfirinnwuma ne nnipa atenae. Wɔn a wɔtete Torman akuraa no tu kɔɔ mpataayibea foforo a ne tenten bɛyɛ 3 kilometres (1.9 mi) akyirikyiri, a wɔfrɛɛ no Newtown. 

Wosii Tema Kuropɔn  no, na wobuee ɛne Tema ɛposohyɛn gyinabea no ano  wɔ 1962 mu. Wɔ mfe du du a edi hɔ no mu no, Tema nyin bɛyɛɛ Ghana mfirinnwumabea titiriw, na wɔde ahwɛyiye yiyii akwan ne mmeae  ɛyɛ  fɛfɛɛfɛ ne mmɔnten so nkanea. Ahomegyebea ahorɔw ne asetra mu nneɛma afoforo a na ɛho yɛ na  wɔ Afrika nkurow mu saa bere no abu so wo Tema no ma enyaa hoahoa.  Ɔmanpanyin Nkrumah paw Theophilus Asiaw Mills sɛ Ɔmantam no Komisa a ɔdi kan. Ghana polis adwumakuo ahobanmɔ a wɔde maa Tema kuro no maa no daa adi sɛ ɛyɛ mfirinwumabe a ɛho hia paa.

Nnipa dodow a ɛbaa hɔ no fii ase wɔ 1960 mfie no mu esiane nwuma a na abu so wɔ kurow no mu nti, nanso Tema Nkɔso Adwumakuw no antumi ansisi adan a ebeso nnipa no so na wɔn antumi amfa nnwuma afoforo anak nea ɛwɔ dedaw no ho na aboa atubrafo no ahiade .  Tema Newtown mantam no yɛɛ kɛse esiane nnipa dodow a wotuu baa hɔ mpofirim nti, na ɛbɛyɛɛ Tema Kuropɔn no nua ketewaa hiani,kurow nnsa anka nneɛma a ɛbɛma mmpontuo aba no. Bio nso, wɔn amfa  Tema Newtown nnwumakuw sika a wotua ma wɔn a wotuu wɔn firii  akuraa no ase no  anni dwuma sɛnea ɛsɛ  esiane ahensɛm wantwiwantwi a ɛkɔɔ no  nti. Enti  mpataayi a na ɛwɔ mpɔtam hɔ no antumi anya nkɔsoɔ.

Ewiem bɔberɛ 
Tema yɛ  beae a ɛyɛ hyew na afei nso ɛyɛ kusuu ( BSh wɔ Köppen wim tebea nkyekyɛmu ase ). Ɛda Ghana kesee fam baabi a ɛhɔ yɛ kusuu sen biara, na sɛ wɔkyekyem pɛpɛɛpɛ a, osu tɔ bɛyɛ 750 millimetres (30 afe biara . Sɛ wɔkyekyem pɛpɛɛpɛ a, ɔhyew no yɛ hyew yiye kosi ɔhyew afe mũ no nyinaa, na mpɛn pii no ɛboro 28 °C anaa 82.4 °F da biara wɔ afe no mu, bere a minima ntaa nkɔ fam da 23 °C anaa 73.4 °F

Sikasɛm

Mfididwuma 

Tema Hyɛn Gyinabea a wobuee ano wɔ afe 1962 mu no ne po so hyɛn gyinabea abien a ɛwɔ Ghana no mu kɛse. Wɔ afe 2020 mu no, wɔwiee ntrɛwmu adwuma a ɛyɛ dɔla ɔpepepem 1.5 a ɛbɛma nsuo a wɔde gu nsuo mu no kɛseɛ akɔ soro akodu TEU ɔpepem 3. Mprempren, Tema hyɛn gyinabea no ne hyɛn gyinabea kɛseɛ a wɔde nneɛma gu mu wɔ Afrika no mu baako.  Ɛwɔ asase a nsuo atwa ho a ne kɛseɛ yɛ 1.7 square kilometres (0.66 sq mi) na asase no nyinaa tɛtrɛtɛ yɛ 3.9 square kilometres (1.5 sq mi). Sɛ yɛde Ghana nneɛma a wɔde fi amannɔne ba ne nea wɔde kɔ amannɔne ho dwuma to nkyɛn a, ɛsan nso yɛ beae wɛde kar far, a ɛfa nneɛma a wɔde fa nnipa a wɔde kɔ aman  ɛne Burkina Faso, Mali ne Niger. Tema hyɛn gyinabea na ɛhwɛ Ghana nneɛma a wɔde fi amannɔne ba ne nea wɔde kɔ amannɔne no mu 80% so, a ɔman no nneɛma titiriw a wɔde kɔ amannɔne, cacao, ka ho.

Hyɛn gyinabea no wɔ 5 kilometres (3.1 mi) of breakwaters, nsu a emu dɔ mu gyinabea 12, baabi a wɔde ngo gu a ɛsõ sen biara, hyɛn gyinabea, adekoradan, ne mmeae a wɔde fa nnipa. Hyɛn gyinabea no wɔ mmeae a wɔabue na wɔakata so a wɔde nneɛma besie, a beae a wɔabɔ so a ne kɛseɛ yɛ mita 77,200 (hekta 7.72) a wɔde nneɛma a wɔde gu mu, dade nneɛma ne nneɛma afoforo a wɔtaa de gu mu ka ho. Hyɛn gyinabea no gyaade a wɔde nneɛma gu mu no tumi kura TEU bɛboro 8,000 bere biara. Beae a wɔato mu a wɔde nneɛma gu a ne kɛseɛ yɛ bɛyɛ mita 25,049 (hekta 2.51) no yɛ adan asia a ne nyinaa betumi akora nneɛma ane dodoɔ bɛyɛ  tɔn 50,000. Hyɛn gyinabea no san nso wɔ gyinabea a ɛyɛ nea atɛkyɛ nni a ne keseɛ yɛ 100,000- dwtt. Ghana  Hyɛn Gyinabea Aban na ɛhwɛ hyɛn gyinabea yi so.

Mpataayi hyɛn gyinabea 
Ghana wɔ mpataayi ho abakɔsɛm a ɛkɔ akyiri paa. Tema mpataayi hyɛngyinabea no wɔ kurow no aguadi hyɛn gyinabea no apuei fam. Ɛwɔ Mpataayi Hyɛn Gyinabea a Ɛwɔ Mfinimfini, Kudoɔ gyinabea, Mpataayi Hyɛn Gyinabea a Ɛwɔ Akyi, ne aguadibea a ɛwɔ beae a wokora nnam so.

Wosii Mpataayi Hyɛn Gyinabea a Ɛwɔ Mu no wɔ Tema Hyɛn Gyinabea Kɛse no ho wɔ 1962 mu sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobenya baabi a wɔde mpataayi po so ahyɛn a ɛyɛ mfiridwuma a enyaa nkɔanim no dii dwuma, na atumi ahyɛ mpɔtam hɔ mpataayi adwuma no nkɔsoɔ ho nkuran . Wɔ 1965 mu no, wosii Outer Fishing Harbor maa mfiridwuma mu ahyɛn akɛse te sɛ trawlers, tuna po so ahyɛn, ne po hyɛn a ɛfa po a emu dɔ a wɔde fa nneɛma.  Trawlers a wɔyɛ nnwuma wɔ mpɔtam hɔ no tenten yɛ mita 30–45 na wotumi yi  mpataa a wɔn mu duru bɛyɛ tɔn 55–65 (mpɛn pii no redfish ne club ne scad mackerel )  wɔ mpataayi akwantu biara mu. Tuna ahyɛn no firi ahyɛmma nketewa a ne tenten bɛyɛ mita 45–50, a ɛtumi de mpataa tɔn 200–250 si fam, kɔsi akɛseɛ a ne tenten yɛ mita 50–65 na ɛtumi si fam kɔduru tɔn 650 wɔ mpataayie akwantuo biara mu.  Ahyɛn akɛse a wɔde yi mpataa, po a emu dɔ mu a wɔde fa nneɛma (a ne tenten yɛ mita 90–105) no mu dodow no ara yɛ po so ahyɛn a wɔagye .  Efi 1984 mu no, sɛ wɔkyekyem pɛpɛɛpɛ a, ɔman no mu mpataa bɛyɛ metric tɔn 200,000 kosi 300,000 afe biara. Tuna a wɔkyere wɔ Ghana no akɔ so ayɛ nea ɛyɛ  tɔn 30,000 afe biara fi afe 1981. 

Kudoɔ gyinabea no di mpataayifo a wɔyɛ nsaanodwuma no ho dwuma . Mpɛn pii no akorɔw bɛyɛ 400 na ɛtra asubɔnten no mu . Eyinom yɛ ahorɔw mienu : nnua kodoɔ, a temanmufo no frɛ no "Legelege", ne dadekodɛɔ. Nnua ahyɛmma no tenten wɔ ne nyinaa so ( LOA ) a efi mita 30 kosi 70,  na Ghanafo n wɔyɛ adwuma no.  Wɔn dwumadi no kɔ soro sen biara wɔ asram a efi June–September mu. Adwinni a wɔde hyɛmma mu mpataayi na ɛma woyi mpataa bɛyɛ 70%.

Mpuntuo 
Tema Development Corporation (TDC) yɛ Ɔman adwumakuo a wɔde ahyɛ wɔn nsa sɛ wɔnyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ne nkɔsoɔ a ɛbɛba Tema kuropɔn no nyinaa so.   Aban no ne TDC ne Ɔman Adansie Adwumakuw no boom yɛɛ adan a ne boɔ yɛ fo maa ɔmanfoɔ no.  Adwumakuw no aboa kɛse wɔ Tema hyɛngyinabea nkɔso mu, a  adan a etu mpɔn wɔ mu.  Wɔhyehyɛɛ adwumakuw no wɔ afe 1952 mu a na wɔn botae  titiriw ne sɛ wɔbɛma Tema kurow no anya nkɔsoɔ na wɔahwɛ so.  Wɔ afe 1963 mu no, wɔhyehyɛɛ Tema Development Corporation Mmara no.  Nnansa yi mfeɛ mu no, adwumakuo no anya sika pii afiri Korea, a nhyehyɛeɛ ka ho, ɛfiri afe 2013, sɛ wɔbɛsi agumadibea foforɔ, adwene  a ɔmanfoɔ no a ani annye ho.  Adwumakuw no panyin a odi kan ne Theodore S. Clerk, Ghanani a odi kan a ɔyɛ ɔdansifo ne nkurow akɛse ho nhyehyɛefo a onyaa abasobɔde, na ɔsom sɛ ɔkannifoɔ fi 1963, bere a wɔhyehyɛɛ mmara no akyi, kosii 1965 mu.

Akwantuo 
Nnipa dodoɔ akwantuo nhyehywi wɔ hɔ a efi Tema kɔ nkurow akɛse te sɛ Kumasi ; Accra ; Mim, Ahafo, Cape Coast, Sunyani na ɛwɔ hɔ ; Takoradi ; Tamale ; Ho ; Wa ; Bolgatanga ; Elubo ; Aflao, Techiman, ne wɔn a wɔyɛ adwuma wɔ hɔ .

Nwomasua 
SOS-Hermann Gmeiner International College (SOS-HGIC), ankorankoro sukuu a wɔde  mmɔfra afrafra a wɔde ma adesuakuw a ɛto so 10 kosi 13 no wɔ Tema. Kan no na ɛde International General Certificate of Secondary Education (IGCSE) di dwuma ma adesuakuw a ɛto so 10 ne 11 ne Amanaman Ntam Baccalaureate (IB) ma adesuakuw a ɛto so 12 ne 13 nanso mprempren ɛyɛ IB Diploma nhyehyɛe a edi mũ ma adesuakuw anan no nyinaa. Margaret Nkrumah na ɔdii sukuu no anim bɛboro mfeɛ 15, na seesei Owura Israel Titi Ofei ne Nii Amaa Akita na wɔdi wɔn anim. Tema nso wɔ amanaman ntam sukuu, Tema International School (TIS), a ɛto so abien wɔ HGIC akyi, ne ntoaso sukuu a ɛkorɔn, Tema Secondary School (TSS anaa Temasco), a wosii wɔ 22 September 1961. Tema wɔ ɔman Ntoaso sukuu dodoɔ bi te sɛ Chemu Senior High School wɔ Community 4, Tema Methodist Day School, Mahean Senior High School, Our Lady of Mercy Senior High School ne Tema Technical Institute. Ankorankoro Ahosiesie Sukuu ahorow te sɛ Ɔbɔadeɛ Sukuu, St Paul Methodist Mfitiase ne JHS, Marbs Ahosiesie Sukuu, Datus Complex, Deks Nhomasua Asoɛe, Naylor SDA Sukuu, Tema Kristofo Asoɛe, Tema Awofo Fekuw, First Baptist Sukuu, Tema Daa Baptist Sukuu, Queen Esther Sukuu, Dorsons Sukuu, Adwenie Nkaedi, Ɔbɔadeɛ Sukuu, Apam Foforo Sukuu, St Alban Sukuu, Lorenz Wolf Sukuu, Bexhill Sukuu Adan, Asetra Amanaman Ntam Sukuu, Mazon Grace Adesua, Santabarbera Sukuu, Abɔfo Titiriw Sukuu, Nsoromma a Edi Kan Adesua, Pentekoste Sukuu, Nsoromma Sukuu Adan, Tema Ridge, St John Bosco Sukuu ne Rosharon Montessori Sukuu. Ɔman mfitiaseɛ ne ntoaso sukuu wɔ Tema. Twedaase Mfitiaseɛ Sukuu, Star Sukuu, Aggrey Road Sukuu, Republic Road Sukuu, Padmore Sukuu, Mante Din Drive, Amen Mfitiaseɛ, Manhean SDA, Sukuu, Bethel Methodist Sukuu ne afoforo.
