title: J. N. K. Taylor
text: Taylor someɛ sɛ abotire ho afutuo, ɔman mmaranimfoɔ,ɔman mmaranimfoɔ panyin, mmaranimfoɔ panyin a ɔreyɛ adwuma ɛna panyin a ɔhwɛ atɛntrenee so wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduosia nkron(1969).

title: Samuel Kwame Adibu Asiedu
text:
Samuel Kwame Adibu  Asiedu yɛ Ghana mmaranimfoɔ. Ɔyɛ mmarahyɛni wɔ Ghana Mmarahyɛfie Kunini mu mprenmpren.

Abrabɔ ne Nhomasua 

Wɔwoo Asiedu Oforisuo da ɛtɔ so nkron, afe 1996, wɔ Nkran. Asiedu nhomasua firii ase wɔ Seventh Day Adventist (SDA) Primary School wɔ Koforidua, Kaneshie North 3 ne 4, Local Authority Primary School, Methodist Primary School wɔ Mangoase, ne Universal Academy Preparatory School wɔ Bubuashie. Asiedu de ne mfitiaseɛ nhomasua no baa awieɛ wɔ afe 1979. Wɔ saa afe koro no ara mu no, wonyaa hokwan firii ntoasoɔ sukuu ase wɔ City Secondary and Business College, ɛhɔ na wonyaa ne Ordinary Level anaa nea wɔtaa frɛ no O' Level Abodin Krataa no wɔ afe 1983. Afei wɔtoaa so wɔ Accra Academy na ɛhɔ na na wonyaa ne Advanced Level anaa nea wɔtaa frɛ no A' Level Abodin Krataa no wɔ afe 1985. Asiedu nyaa hokwan kɔɔ suapɔn wɔ University of Ghana, na wɔsuaa Mmara (LLB) nyaa ho abodin krataa wɔ afe 1990 mu. Wɔ saa afe no ara mu no, wɔtoaa ne nhomasua so wɔ Ghana School of Law de nyaa abodin krataa wɔ afe 1992 mu na wɔde Sam Okudjeto Prize maa no bɔɔ n'aba so sɛ osuani a wɔbɔ mmɔden paa wɔ Legal Accountancy mu. Wɔ afe 2009 kosi 2011 mu no, Asiedu suaa Public Administration wɔ Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration (GIMPA),wɔ afe akyi no, wɔkɔ suaa International Maritime Law wɔ University of Swansea na wonyaa abodin krataa (LLM) wɔ afe 2013.

Adwuma
Wɔ ne ntoasoɔ sukuu akyi no, Asiedu yɛɛ ɔman atu-wo-ho-ama adwuma (National Service) wɔ Kinbu Junior Secondary School firi afe 1986 kosi 1986. Akyiri yi, wɔkɔ kaa K. E. Wood and Company adwumayɛkuo no ho sɛ nhomakorafoɔ na wɔyɛɛ adwuma firi afe 1986 kosi 1987. Wɔ berɛ a wɔfrɛɛ nu kɔɔ mmara mu wɔ afe 1992 no, wɔyɛɛ ɔman atu-wo-ho-ama  adwuma (National Service) a ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ Legal Aid/Oyirifie Chambers wɔ Koforidua. 

Wɔ afe 1994 mu no, wɔkɔkaa Commission on Human Rights and Adnministration Justice (CHRAJ) adwumakuo ho sɛ aban nnipa a wɔagye no ato mu. Wɔ firii ase yɛɛ adwuma sɛ Magistrate wɔ afe 1996 de maa Judicicial Service of Ghana kosii sɛ wobɛyɛɛ Circuit Court ɔtɛnmuafoɔ. Asiedu bɛyɛɛ Mmarahyɛni wɔ High Court wɔ afe 2006 mu na afei nso wɔyɛɛ n'adwuma no bi nso wɔ Fast Track (Automated) High Court  ne Commercial Court a ɛwɔ Nkran.  Asiedu yeree ne ho yɛɛ adwumaden kosii sɛ wɔpaw no sɛ Mmarahyɛni wɔ Court of Appeal of Ghana wɔ afe 2019 mu.Wɔ afe 2016 ne 2018 ntɛm no, wɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛni wɔ suapɔn Wisconsin University ne Central University mu. Wɔ berɛ a wɔyɛ adwuma wɔ Appeal Court no, Asiedu sane nso yɛɛ adwuma sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛni panin wɔ Ghana School of Law firii afe 2020 kosii sɛ wɔpaw no sɛ odwumayɛfo wɔ Supreme Court wɔ afe 2022 mu.

Asiedu aka Association of Magistrates and Judges kuo no ho firi afe 1996, wɔaka Institute of Taxation Ghana kuo no ho firi afe 2016 ɛna afei nso wɔyɛɛ Ghana Bar Association kuo no mu ni firii afe 1992 kosi 1996. Asiedu yɛ nnipa a wɔanya ne so mfasoɔ paa ma Judicial Training Institute firi afe 2016.

Berɛ a wɔpaw no kɔɔ Mmarahyɛbɛdwafie Kunini mu
Wɔ Kitawonsa da a ɛtɔ so nnan afe 2022 mu no, Ɔmanpanin Nana Akufo Addo de Judicial Council ne Council of State afutuo yɛɛ adwuma paw Asiedu ne Atemmuafoɔ foforɔ mmiɛnsa a ɛka ne ho (George Kingsley Koomson, Barbara Frances Ackah-Yensu ne Ernest Yao Gaewu) kɔkaa Mmarahyɛfie Kuninin mufoɔ ho. Wɔ Kitawonsa da a ɛtɔ so aduonu-nnum afe 2022 mu no, Ɔkasafoɔ Kuninin wɔ Mmarahyɛbadwafie (Speaker of Parliament) de too dwa sɛ wɔapaw Asiedu ne atɛnmuafoɔ a wɔka ne ho no na wɔhwehwɛɛ wɔn mu huu sɛ wofata anaa.

Wɔ ɔsram Ahinime da a ɛtɔ so du-nkron afe 2022 mu no, wɔtotoo Asiedu ano de hwɛɛ sɛ ɔfata ma dwumadie a wɔde rebɛhyɛ ne nsa no anaa,  na ɛno akyi no, wɔpaw no ne Barbara Frances Ackah - Yensu sɛ wonsom wɔ Mmarahyɛfie Kunini no mu.  Wodii Ackah-Yensu ne Asiedu ho adanse sɛ wɔnim mmara, wɔwɔ suban pa na afei nso wɔn ho akokwaw ma dwumadie no. Wɔsan nso kaa wɔn ho asɛm sɛ nnipa a wɔte wɔn ho ase na  na wɔayɛ krado sɛ wɔde baakoyɛ bɛyɛ adwuma wɔ tebea biara mu. Wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa bosome no da a ɛtɔ so du-baako afe 2022 mu no, Ghana Mmarahyɛfie nu gyee Asiedu too mu. Owura Alban Bagbin a wɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwafie Kasamafoɔno kaa Barbara ne Asiedu ho asɛm sɛ na wofata dadaada sɛ wɔyɛ adwuma wɔ Mmarahyɛbadwafie Kunini no mu. Bagbin sane nso bisaa nea enti a wɔgyaw Asiedu sɛ wɔnyɛ adwuma wɔ High Court berɛ a na wɔfata paa sɛ wɔyɛ adwuma wɔ Mmarahyɛbadwafie Kunini mu wɔ afe 2006 kosi 2019 mu. Owura Bagbin annya nteaseɛ wɔ nea enti a Asiedu anhwehwɛ dibea titiriw biara kosii sɛ wɔpaw no sɛ Ɔtɛnmuafoɔ wɔ Mmarahyɛbadwafie Kuninin mu no.

Ɔmanpanin Akufo Addo suanee Asiedu kɔɔ aban mu wɔ Wukuada, Ɔpɛnima da a ɛtɔ so 28 afe 2022 mu.

Baabi A Minyaa Mmoa Firii

title: Fred Apaloo
text:
Frederick Kwesi Apaloo CV FGA JSC(wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn da a ɛtɔ so nkron wɔ afe 1921 na Oforisuoda ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ afe 2000 na ɔwuiɛ) yɛ Ghana mmaranimni ne Ɔtɛmmuafoɔ a na ɔyɛ Kenya Ɔtɛmmuafoɔ Panyin wɔ afe 1993 kɔsii 1995 ne Ɔtɛmmuafoɔ Panyin wɔ Ghana firii afe 1977 kɔsii 1986.Ɔyɛ Ɔtɛmmuafoɔ a ɔdi kan a wabɔ Ghana Asɛnnibea Kunini no mu wɔ Ghana amansan ahodoɔ mmiɛnsa ase.

MMƆFRASE 
Wɔwoo Apaloo wɔ Woe,akuraa bi a ɛbɛn Keta wɔ Volta mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana,a saa berɛ no na wɔfrɛ no Gold Coast no mu.Berɛ a Ɔdii mfeɛ nson no, ne papa wuiɛ,enti ne wɔfa a ɔyɛ Kadjebi agudifoɔ no hwɛɛ no kɔsii sɛ ɔkɔ sukuu.Ɔkɔɔ sukuu wɔ Accra Academy wɔ Accra a ɔwiee wɔ afe 1942 mu.Ayire yi ɔsuaa mmara wɔ Hull University College.

ATƐMMUAFOƆ ADWUMA 
Wɔ afe 1950 mu no, Middle Temple frɛɛ Apaloo ma ɔkɔyɛɛ England mmaranimfoɔ. Akyire yi,ɔsan kɔɔ Ghana kɔyɛɛ mmaranimfoɔ.Ɔbɔɔ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛɛ Anloga basabasayɛ a ɛbaa Britain amammuosɛm mu no ho ban.Berɛ a Ghana nyaaa ahofadie firii Britain nnisoɔ ase no,wɔyɛɛ no Ɔtɛmmuafoɔ kɛseɛ wɔ afe 1960 mu.Wɔ afe 1964 mu no, ɔdii nnipa num a wɔn mu mmiɛnsa yɛ Ɔmanpanyin Kwame Nkrumah nnamfo no anim wɔ ɔman mu nkoasom ho.Na wɔyɛ Tawia Adamafio,nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ sohwɛfoɔ,Ebenezer Ako-Adjei,amannɔne sohwɛfoɔ ne Hugh Horatio Cofie Crabbe,Convention People's Party a ɛwɔ tumi saa berɛ no twerɛfoɔ.Ɔtɛmmuafoɔ foforɔ no mu baako ne Edward Akufo-Addo a akyire yi ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔtɛmmuafoɔ panyin wɔ afe 1966 mu na ɔbɛyɛɛ Ghana Mpanyin wɔ afe 1970 mu.Saa atɛmmuo no maa Ɔmanpanyin a na ɔdi adeɛ saa berɛ no,Nkrumah bɔɔ mmɔden sɛ ɔbɛte atɛmmuafoɔ no ho.Wɔpaa no Kɔɔto a wɔde asɛm kɔdan no wɔ afe 1966 mu ne Ghana Asɛnnibea Kunini mu wɔ afe 1971 mu.

GHANA ASƐNNIBEA KUNINI 
Wɔpaa no sɛ Ghana Ɔtɛmmufoɔ Panyin wɔ afe 1977. Na ɔyɛ onipa a ɔto so nsia a ɔdi saa diberɛ yi so firi berɛ a Ghana bɛyɛɛ ɔman a edi mu no.Yei sii wɔ Ghana Ɔsraani Panyin no berɛ so. Berɛ a Hilla Limann dii adeɛ wɔ ɔman no mu wɔ Ɛbɔ,afe 1979 mu no, People's National Party aban no bɔɔ mmɔden sɛ wobɛsi no ananmu sɛ Ɔtɛmmufo Panyin a ɔwɔ hɔ no deɛ ɛnam so a wɔhyɛɛ no sɛ ɔnhwehwɛ adwuma a na ɔyɛ dada no mu.Ghanani bi a wɔfrɛ no Amoako Tuffuor de asɛm no kɔɔ Asɛnnibea Kunini no anim, na ɔtɛmmufo panyin, Ɔtɛmmufo E. N. P. Sowah, a ɔdii n'adeɛ wɔ ne (Apaloo's) pɛnhyen so no, sii agyinaeɛ sɛ Apaloo bɛyɛɛ Ɔtemmufo Panyin wɔ Ghana Manpanyinfoɔ Ahemman a Ɛto so Mmiɛnsa no mu berɛ a Ghana mmara a wɔhyɛeɛ wɔ afe 1979 no baa mu no ara pɛ.Ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ Ghana manpanyin a ɔtɔ so miɛnsa no mu na ɔtoaa so wɔ Limann aban no a wɔtoo no guiɛ wɔ Ɔpɛnimma da a ɛtɔ so aduasa baako,afe 1981 no akyi. Esiane ne faahodie nti, asraafo aban foforɔ no, Ɔman Gyinaeɛsi Boayikuo a Jerry Rawlings di anim no nso bɔɔ mmɔden sɛ wobɛtu no afiri hɔ sɛdeɛ na Nkrumah abɔ mmɔden pɛn nanso anyɛ yie wɔ 1983 mu no. Ɔgyaee adwuma berɛ a na wadi mfeɛ aduosia num wɔ afe 1986 mu.

KENYA ASƐNNIBEA KUNINI 
Na ɔnyaa Kenya Asɛnni Panyin no  ho kwan wɔ afe 1993 mu a na ɔnni obi a ɔbɛhyɛ mu ama enti wɔpaa no sɛ Kenya Asɛnni Panyin wɔ Ɔbɛnem,afe 1993 mu.Wɔkaaeɛ sɛ berɛ a ɔwɔ Kenya no, na ɔmpɛ owuo ho afɔbuo.Ɔkɔɔ so yɛɛ Ɔtɛmmufoɔ Panyin kɔsii afe 1995,berɛ a Abdul Majid Cockar bɛdii n'adeɛ no.

NNOƆMA FOFORƆ 
Ɔsan nso somee wɔ Wiase Bank Asɛnnibea no mu firii afe1990 kɛsiiafe 1995 mu.

NANKASA ASETENA 
Apaloo waree Georgina Kumasenu wɔ afe 1953 mu. Na wɔwɔ mmammarimaa mmienu ne mmammaa mmiɛnsa.

NNIDIE 
*Afe 1979 - Volta mantam Ahyɛdeɛ(Ghana) 

*Afe1986 - Wɔpaa no sɛ Ghana Academy of Arts and Sciences mu nnipa.

*Afe1993 – Ɔpanin a ɔda Golden Heart ano (Kenya).

NNOƆMA WƆDE GYEGYE WƆN ANI 
Nneɛma a na Apaloo ani gye ho no bi ne asa, hyɛmma, golf ne tennis.

HWƐ YEI NSO 
*Ghana Asɛnnibea Kunini.

*Ghana Asɛnnibea Kunini no atɛmmuafoɔ din.

NKYERƐKYERƐMU

title: Robert Samuel Blay
text:
Robert Samuel Blay, JSC na ɔyɛ Gaanni mmaranimfoɔ ne ɔtɛmmuafoɔ. Na ɔyɛ Supreme Court of Ghana Atɛnteneeni wɔ fahoodie fa ɛdi kan no mu. na wɔtaa frɛ no Nzema mmaranimni. Ɔbɛyɛɛ titenani maa Gaana Mmaranimfoɔ Kuo no wɔ ne mprenu so na afei nso ɔsane bɛyɛɛ akannifoɔ kuo a edi kan maa Gaana Sikakorabea Baatan.

Mfiase Asetena Ne Nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Robert wɔ Oforisuo, wɔ afe apem ahankron ne baako mu (April 1901) wɔ Esiama a ɛwɔ Gaana Atɔeɛ Mantam. Ɔfirii aseɛ suaa adeɛ wɔ Tarkwa Methodist Sukuu wɔ Tarkwa. Ɔkɔɔ Government Training Institution (a akyiri yi wɔde kaa Achimota College ho) sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛni. Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduonu (1920) mu no, ɔsii mu kɔɔ United Kingdom kɔsuaa mmara. Wɔfrɛɛ no sɛ mmaranimfoɔ wɔ Ayɛwohomumu wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduonu nsia mu (June 1926). Berɛ a na ɔyɛ sukuuni wɔ London Suapɔn mu no na Robert de ne ho hyɛɛ sukuufoɔ amanyɔsɛm mu. Ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ sukuufoɔ akuo ahodoɔ mu. Berɛ bi na ɔyɛ Afrikafoɔ Asuafoɔ Kuo no titenani, kuo bi a na wɔgye wɔn a wɔfiri Caribbean ne Afrika aman a na wɔhyɛ wɔn ase no mufoɔ to mu. Afei nso na ɔyɛ West African Students Union no mu panyin. Berɛ a ɔwɔ London no, ɔde adwene baeɛ sɛ ɔbɛte Gold Coast Asuafoɔ Kuo a na ɛwɔ hɔ saa bere no.

Adwumayɛ Ne Amanyɔsɛm 
Berɛ a Robert wieeɛ akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ nteteeɛ no, ɔkyerɛɛ adeɛ bɛyɛ mfeɛ mmiɛnsa wɔ Tarkwa Methodist Sukuu mu. Berɛ a Robert sane baa Gaana wɔ afe apem ahankron aduonu nsia (1926) mu no, ɔkɔkaa Aborigines Rights Protection Society ho. Akyiri yi ɔbɛyɛɛ United Gold Coast Convention no ho akannifoɔ ne ɔkannifoɔ a ɔdi kan wɔ United Gold Coast Convention no mu, na ɔyɛ kannifoɔ a ɔto so mmiɛnsa. Wɔ afe apem ahankron aduonum nwɔtwe (1958) mu no, berɛ a na ɔyɛ ɔman panyin saa bere no, Dr. Kwame Nkrumah na ɔdii kan too  Gaana Sikakorabea Baatan titenani. Ɔyimm Sekondi wɔ mmarahyɛ badwa mu sɛ n'ahenkuro muni.

Sɛ woyi amanyɔsɛm ne aban adwuma to nkyɛn a, Robert bɛyɛɛ mmaranimfoɔ wɔ Sekondi. Ɔhyehyɛɛ Nzema Chambers wɔ afe apem ahankron aduonu nsia (1926) mu (a akyiri yi wɔbɛfrɛɛ no Blay ne Associates). Ɔyɛɛ Gaana Mmaranimfoɔ Kuo no titenani mprenu. Ɔbɛyɛɛ Gaana Mmaranimfoɔ Kuo no titenani a ɔdi kan wɔ afe apem ahankron aduonum nson (1957) mu. Ɔbɛyɛɛ kuo no titenani kɔsii afe apem ahankron aduonum nkron (1959). Archie Casely-Hayford na ɔdii n'adeɛ. Wɔ afe apem ahankron aduosia (1960) mu no, ɔsane bɛyɛɛ nhyiamu no titenani, na ɔyɛɛ saa adwuma no kɔsii afe apem ahankron aduosia mmienu (1962). N'animuonyam a ɔnyaeɛ wɔ ankorankorɛ adwuma mu nti, ɔfaa Kwame Nkrumah a na ɔyɛ ɔmampanyin saa berɛ no sɛ Ɔtɛmmuafoɔ wɔ Asɛnnibea Kunini mu wɔ afe apem ahankron aduosia mmienu (1962) mu. Ɔne Kofi Adumua Bossman ne Edward Akufo-Addo a na ɔyɛ Ghana manpanyin saa berɛ no; Kwame Nkrumah twaa kwan wɔ Ɔbɛnem, da a ɛto so mmiɛnsa wɔ afe apem ahankron aduosia nnan mu (March 2, 1964) esiane sɛ wɔkasa tiaa Sir a wɔyii no no nti. Sir Kobina Arku Korsah ne William Bedford Van Lare wɔ Tawia Adamafio ne afoforɔ a wɔyii wɔn firii ɔman mu afɔdie mu no ho. Wɔ afe apem ahankron aduosia nkron (1969) mu no, na ɔbɛyɛɛ badwam kasafo wɔ badwam nhyiam a wɔyɛɛ ɔmanpanin a ɔto so mmienu no mmara no mu. Wɔ afe apem ahankron aduoson nwɔtwe (1978) mu, Ghana aban abatoɔ no akyiri no, ɔde ne ho too afiase saa afe no ara denam habeas corpus a ɔde kɔmaa Sekondi Asɛnnibea Kunini no so. J. Da Rocha ne K. A. Gbedemah kɔ asɛnnibea kɔkyerɛ wɔn nea enti a wɔkyeree wɔn.

N'ankasa asetena 
Ɔwaree Mrs. Dinah Blay. Na ɔyɛ Ghana man mu aban mu adwumayɛni, aman-aman ntam nkutahodieni ne ɔbaa a ɔdii kan a ɔsan bɛyɛɛ ɔmampanyin wɔ Ghana suapɔn (Legon) mu, Mary Chinery-Hesse, ne Dr. Mokowa Blay Adu-Gyamfi, kane Ghana Ɔmampanyin wɔ Sierra Leone na seesei ɔyɛ Ghana Aids Commission Director. N'ani gye tɛnnis, cricket, gɔf ne bɔɔlɔ bɔ ho.

Owuo 
Owuiɛ wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa, da a ɛto so nnum wɔ afe apem ahankron aduoson nkron (December 5, 1979) mu wɔ Sekondi. Wɔsiee no wɔ ne kurom Esiama wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa da ɛto so aduonu mmienu wɔ afe apem ahankron aduoson nkron mu. (December 22, 1979).

Beaɛ A Menyaa Mmoa Firiiɛ

title: Charles Acolatse
text:
Charles Acolatse Sterling yɛ Gaana mmaranimfoɔ ne mmarakyerefoɔ. Ɔyɛɛ mmaranimfoɔ na akyiri yi ɔbɛyɛɛ Gaana Asɛnnibea Kunini no temmufo.

Abrabɔ Mfitiaseɛ ne Nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Charles wɔ Ayɛwohomumu, da a ɛto so aduonu nson wɔ afe apem ahanwɔtwe ne aduokron nkron mu (June 27, 1899). ne papa ne Ohene Joachim Acolatse  a na ɔwɔ Keta wɔ British Togoland (seesei Gaana Frao Mantam) ne ne maame Catherine a ɔfiri Togo. Berɛ a na ɔyɛ abɔfra no, African Methodist Episcopal Missionaries faa no sɛ ɔnkɔsua adeɛ wɔ Amerika. Ɔsuaa adeɛ wɔ Livingstone College, Salisbury, North Carolina na ɔtoaa n'adesua so wɔ Cambridge Suapɔn, England.

Adwumayɛ 
Wɔfrɛɛ Charles kɔɔ Lincoln Inn wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn, da ɛto so nson wɔ afe apem ahankron aduasa (January 7, 1930) mu, na wɔfrɛɛ no sɛ ɔbisafoɔ ne mmaranimfoɔ wɔ Gold Coast Colony wɔ berɛ a na Ɔtɛmmufo Panyin Sir George Campbell Deane te adwa so wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn, da ɛto so aduonu nkron wɔ afe apem ahankron aduasa baako (January 29, 1931). Ɔde ne ho hyɛɛ mmara mu yɛɛ adwuma mfeɛ dumienu. Wɔ Ɔbɛnem bosome, da a ɛto so du-nson wɔ afe apem ahankron aduanan mmiɛnsa (17 March 1943) mu no, wɔpaa no sɛ ɔmantam ɔtɛmmuafoɔ na wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da ɛto so nson mu wɔ afe apem ahankron aduonum mmienu (January 7, 1952) mu no wɔmaa no tumi sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ ɔtɛmmuafoɔ ketewa. Wɔ 1955 mu no wɔsomaa no kɔɔ Sierra Leone sɛ ɔnkɔyɛ Commission of Inquiry into the Strikes and Riots wɔ Freetown. Wɔ afe  afe apem ahankron aduonum-nnum (1964) mu no, wɔpaa no sɛ Asɛnnibea Kunini no Tɛmmufoɔ. Ɔyɛɛ adwuma yi kosii sɛ ogyaw adwuma no wɔ 1965 mu. Wɔsesaa no maa Ɔtɛmmufoɔ G. S. Lassey, a kane no na ɔyɛ Oguaa Asɛnnibea Kunini no mmaranimfoɔ.

N'ankasa Asetena 
Charles waree Mary Adjuah Kuokor Vanderpuye, a na ɔyɛ J. Addo Vanderpuye a na ɔyɛ Adawso Hotel wura. Na n'ani gye ho sɛ ɔde n'ahomegyeberɛ bɛdi gɔf agorɔ. Owuiɛ wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa da ɛto so aduonu nnum wɔ afe apem ahankron aduosia nson (December 25, 1967) mu.

Beaɛ A Menyaa Mmoa Firiiɛ

title: Josiah Ofori Boateng
text:
Josiah Ofori Boateng yɛ ɔtemmuafoɔ a w’akɔ n’ahomegyeɛ mu wɔ Ghana kɔɔto baatan no mu ɛw a ɔdwamtenani dadaa ma asɔeɛ a ɔhwɛ abatoɔ ho nsɛm soɔ wɔ ɔman Ghana mu. Ɔdii ne dwuma wɔ Ghana kɔɔto baatan adwa no so firii afe apem ahankono aduɔkono nkono(1999) de kɔsi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne baako(2001) ɛna ɔyɛɛ ɔdwamtenani maa asɔeɛ a ɔhwɛ abatoɔ ho nsɛm soɔ wɔ ɔman Ghana mu firii afe apem ahankono aduɔnwɔtwe nkono(1989) di kɔsi afe apem ahankono aduɔkono mmienu(1992) 

Na Ofori Boateng yɛ kuo ba wɔ Ghana Bar Association, otitenani wɔ International Bar Association, ɔdwamtenani ma Council for Law Reporting ne kuo ba ma International Juridical Organization.

ABRABƆ AHYASEƐ NE NWOMASUA 

Ofori Boateng nyinii wɔ Aburi a ɛwɔ Apueɛ mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Baasele sɔfoɔ bi a ɔwɔ kanee Gold Coast no mu na ɔwoo no wɔ afe apem ahankono aduasa ahyaseɛ no mu no(1930s). Ɔnyaa ne ntoaso sukuu wɔ Achimota school ne ne suapɔn wɔ University College of the Gold Coast (sesei University of Ghana), ne University College of London a ɛhɔ na ɔnyaa ne Bachelor of Law(llb) abodin. Ɔnyaa nteteɛ wɔ Lincoln’s Inn ɛna ɔde frɛɛ no kɔɔ English bar wɔ afe apem ahankono aduosia mmiɛnsa (1963). Akyire yi ɔfrɛɛ no kɔɔ Ghanaian bar wɔ afe apem ahankono aduosia nnum (1965)

ADWUMA 
Ofori Boateng hyɛɛ aseɛ sɛ aban nanmusini a ɔhwɛ awudie ho nsɛm soɔ, mmranimni ne okyigyinafoɔ, ne mansini temmuafoɔ de kɔsi sɛ ɔtoo nsa frɛɛ no sɛ twerɛtwerɛfoɔ abedeɛkyire a ɔhwɛ mmra ho nsɛm soɔ wɔ afe apem ahankono aduosia nkono (1969). Firi afe apem ahankono aduɔson mmiɛnsa(1973) de kɔsi afe apem ahankono aduɔson nsia(1976) no mu no na ɔyɛ otitenani ma Ghana Law Reform Commission . Wɔ afe apem ahankono aduɔson nsia(1976) no, ɔbɛyɛɛ mmra mu futufoɔ panin wɔ mpɔtɛm haw ho ma amansan nkabomu kuo United Nations, ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ beaɛ yi de kɔsi afe apem ahankono aduɔnwɔtwe baako(1981). Ɔsan n’akyi baa Ghana berɛ a w’asom wɔ amansan nkabomu United Nations na ɔbɛgyee adwuma sɛ Ɔkwantwerɛfoɔ panin ma mmranim adesua (panin wɔ Ghana School of Law). Ɔyii no sɛ Appeal kɔɔto temmuafoɔ wɔ afe apem ahankono ne aduonwɔtwe nkono(1989) ɛna ɛwɔ afe apem ahankono ne aduɔkono mmienu(1992) mu no ɔyii no sɛ ɔtitenani ma asoeɛ a ɔhwɛ abatoɔ ho nsɛm soɔ wɔ Ghana a na Kwadwo Afari-Gyan yɛ no abedeɛkyire. Sɛ ɔtitenani ma asoeɛ no, ɔhwɛɛ Ghana afe apem ahankono aduɔkono mmienu(1992) Amanpanin abatoɔ no mu de ho nsunsuansoɔ too dwa. Ɔyɛɛ otitenani de maa asoeɛ no de kɔsi afe apem ahankono aduɔkono mmiɛnsa(1993) berɛ a ɔfrii Appeal kɔɔto adwa no soɔ no. Wɔ afe apem ahankono aduɔkono nkono(1999) mu no, ɔpaw no sɛ ɔnkɔ ka ɔtemmuafoɔ John Debra Sapong ho wɔ kɔɔto baatan no mu. Ɔtotoo n’ano gyee no too mu wɔ mmrahyɛbadwam Ɔbɛnem bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduasa wɔ afe apem ahankono aduɔkono nkono(30 March 1999). Ɔne otemmuafoɔ Sapong na ɔsoɛɛ wɔn bɔɔ mu sɛ kɔɔto baatan no mu atemmuafoɔ wɔ Oforisuo bosome da a ɛtɔ so dunum afe apem ahankono aduɔkono nkono(15 April 1999). Ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ otemmuafoɔ wɔ kɔɔto baatan no mu de kɔsi berɛ a ɔkɔɔ n’ahomegyeɛ mu wɔ Ɔpɛpon bosome da ɛtɔ so nnan mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne baako(4 January 2001). Ofori Boateng twerɛɛ amammra ne mpɔtɛm nsɛm ho nwoma bebree. Na ɔsan nso yɛ nwomanimni a ɔtaa kɔ Harvard Law School mu nsrahwɛ ne mpɔtɛm adesuabea a ɛwɔ Washington.

BAABIA MENYAA MMOA FIRIIƐ

title: Sebɔ
text:

title: Johnson Boateng Siriboe
text:
Johnson Yaw Kusi Bodum Boateng Siriboe yɛ Ghana mmaranimfoɔ  ne ɔtemmufoɔ. Ɔyɛɛ Ghana Asɛnnibea Kunini no temmufoɔ firi afe apem ahankron aduosia nnan kosii afe apem, ahankron aduosia  nsia ; afei firi  afe apem, ahankron aduoson nson nso.

Abrabɔ ahyaseɛ 
siriboe firi Asante Juaben a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Na ɔyɛ adwumakuo a ɛtɔ nneɛma (PBC) no mu twerɛtwerɛfoɔ  kɔsii afe apem, ahankron aduanan nsia (1946) mu bere a ɔkɔɔ Nglesi Abrokyiman mu kɔsuaa mmara. Wɔfrɛɛ no ​​kɔɔ Mmaranimfoɔ  kuo no mu wɔ afe apem , ahankron aduanan nkron (1949) mu. Berɛ a ɔsan kɔɔ Gold Coast no na akyiri no,  ofii aseɛ yɛɛ kokoam mmaranimfo adwuma.

Adwumayɛ 

Ɔfirii n’adwuma ase wɔ benkyi so sɛ ɔtemmufoɔ. Na osii William Bruce-Lyle ananmu wɔ Swedru. Akyire no ɔbɛyɛɛ Asɛnnibea Kunini temmufo na wɔmaa no dibea kɔɔ Asɛnnibea Kunini no benkyi boom William Bruce-Lyle wɔ afe apem, ahankron aduosia nnan ( 1964 )  Afe apem ahankron aduosia nsia (1966) mu, berɛ a wotuu Kwame Nkrumah, aban a na ɛwɔ hɔ saa berɛ no guiɛ akyi no, adehyeman Ghana  de Asɛnnibea Kunini no sii Asɛnnibea a Ɛhwɛ Asɛm a Wɔde Kɔdan Asɛnnibea no ananmu. Na woyii ɔne ɔman mpanyimfo afoforo a wɔsom wɔ Ghana atemmu benkyi wɔ ɔman a edi kan no mu no firii mu. Akyire yi wɔpaw no sɛ Asɛnnibea a Wɔde Nsɛm Kɔdan no temmufo na wɔ August 1970 mu no, wɔpaw no sɛ Ghana Asɛnnibea Kunini no temmufo.Ɔsomm wɔ saa dibea yi mu kosii 1972 mu bere a asraafo nniso a na edi tumi saa bere no, Ɔman Agyede Bagua no, tuu Asɛnnibea Kunini no fii hɔ bio no. Na ɔyɛ Abatoɔ Bagua a nnipa 16 na wɔwom a wɔde ahyɛ wɔn nsa sɛ wɔnhwɛ mu na wɔmfa nyansahyɛ mma wɔ asɛm biara a ɛfa abatoɔ ho wɔ Ghana a ɔman mmarahyɛ bagua biara de asi hɔ wɔ amansan mmara a ɛsɛ sɛ amansɛm bagua no hyehyɛ no ase . Na ɔsan yɛ titenani wɔ ahenfo kuo no mu

Abrabɔ mu asɛm 
Ɔwaree Esme Siriboe. Wɔbɔɔ mu tee "Morning Star" sukuu a ɛwɔ Cantonment  no.

OWUO 
owuu wɔ kar akwanhyia mu wɔ Osino wɔ Apuei Fam Mantam mu Memeneda, 16 July 2001 bere a na wadi mfe 85.[2][12] Wɔsiee no wɔ 8 Ɔpɛpɔn 2001 wɔ ne kurom Asante Juaben.[2]

owuu wɔ lɔre akwanhyia mu wɔ Osino a ɛwɔ Apuei Fam Mantam mu , Memeneda, 16 Kutawonsa, 2001 berɛ a  na wadi mfeɛ aduowɔtwe nnum Wɔsiee no wɔ 8 Ɔpɛpɔn 2001 wɔ ne kurom Asante Juanaben.

title: Anselmus Kludze
text:
Anselmus Kodzo Paaku Kludze (1934- Ɛbɔ 5, 2013) yɛ Ghana mmaranimfo, nwomatwerɛni, ne onimdifo a ɔsomm sɛ ɔtemmuafo wɔ Kɔɔto Baatan a ɛwɔ Ghana na ɔsan nso yɛ Prɔfɛsa. Na ɔyɛ mmara mu prɔfɛsa panin paa a pɔtɔ kasa mu wɔka no 'Emeritus professor of law' wɔ Rutgers Suapɔn a ɛwɔ Camden, New Jersey a ɛwɔ USA. Na na ɔsan yɛ Otitenani a na ɔda Law Reform Commission a ɛwɔ Ghana ano. Na ɔyɛ ekuoba wɔ Ghana Academy of Arts and Science, na ɔsan nso yɛ ekuoba wɔ Royal Society of Arts a ɛwɔ London.

N'abrabɔ ahyɛase ne  Nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Kludze wɔ afe apem aha-nkron aduasa nan mu, na Stephen Komla Kludze na ɔwoo no. Ɔfiri Gbi- Kpeme, Hohoe a ɛwɔ Firaw Mantem a ɛwɔ Ghana. Ne Papa firimu nt3m, saa berɛ no, na ɔresua ade wɔ Adisadel Kɔlegyi a ɛwɔ Capecaost a na ɔda Aban Skɔlahyep so. Ne wɔfa, Anko Kludze boa hwɛ ne sika ho nsɛmsɛm ma no tumi  wie ne ntoasoɔ sukuu. Ne Ntoasoɔ sukuu akyiri no, ɔnya kwan wura Legon Suapɔn mu, na ɛhɔ na onyaa ne Suapɔn Abɔdin krataa wɔ 'Bachelor of Arts' wɔ afe 1963. Ɔtoa so kɔ Ghana mmaranim Sukuu (Ghana School of law), na ɛhɔ na ɔbɛyɛ Baresta wɔ afe apem aha-nkron aduosia-num. Ɔsan toa so kɔ UK Aburokyie man mu kɔtoa n'adesua so wɔ mmara mu, na  ɛhɔ  na ɔsan nya ne 'Doctorate Degree' wɔ afe apem aha-nkron aduosia nkron. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne mmienu mu, onyaa Doctorate Degree a ɛwɔ anim pa ara wɔ mmara mu, skɔlahyep a  na ɔda so wɔ London Suapɔn mu boa ma ne tumi nya saa abɔdin krataa yi.

Adwumayɛ

Suahunu 
Kludze wura Law Fakɔti sɛ lɛkyera panin wɔ Legon Suapɔn mu, ɔkyer3 adeɛ wɔ Ghana Mmara Sukuu, saa ber3 yi, na ɔsan nso yɛ ɔsra prɔfɛsa wɔ Temple University School of law. Na na ɔsan nso yɛ Mmara mu prɔfɛsa ne Dean a na ɔda Law fakɔti a ɛwɔ Calabar Suapɔn a ɛwɔ Nigeria. N'adekyerɛ ne ne suahunu nyinaa akyiri no, na ɔsan nso yɛ mmranimfo ne sɔleseta wɔ Ghana Kɔɔto Baatan.

Ɔtemmuafo wɔ Asennibea Kunini a ɛwɔ Ghana 
Wɔ Kɔtɔnimaa bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduonu-baako wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne mmienu mu no, Ghana manpanin a na ɔte so a na ne din de John Kufuor yii no sɛ ɔtemmuafo wɔ Kɔɔto Baatan a ɛwɔ Ghana. Ɔsomm wɔ saa diberɛ yi mu kɔpem sɛ ɔkɔ n'ahomgyeɛ mu wɔ Ɔbɛnem da a ɛtɔ so du-baako wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan mu.

N'abrabɔ Mu Nsɛm  
Ɔno na ɔwoo Ave Kludze a ɔyɛ Rɔket abɔdeɛmu nyansapɛfo a ɔka National Aeronautic and Space Administration (NASA) ho.

title: Eco Akofo Kuw (Eco Warriors Movement)
text:
Eco Akofo Kuw (Eco Warrior Movement) yɛ kuw a ɛnyɛ aban de a ɛwɔ Gaana (Ghana) a ɛne mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa reyɛ adwuma wɔ wim nsakraeɛ ne nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia a ɛbɛkɔ so atra hɔ daa ho. Kuw no yɛ kuw a mmabun di anim a wɔn botae nso ne sɛ wɔbɛsan de nsase a asɛe no aba na wɔabrɛ wim nsakrae ase denam ɔkwan a wɔaka abom na ɛka obiara ho so. Otuo-Akyampong Boakye a ɔyɛ nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia ho nyansahufoɔ (environmental scientist) a ɔfiri Ghana, na ɔde Eco-Akofo Kuw no sii hɔ wɔ afe 2020 mu.

Dwumadie ahorow 
1. Wim Tebea Nyansa Dua (Climate Smart Tree): Dwumadie no de nyansahu a ɛfa nnua dua ho di dwuma de tew mframa a atwa yɛn ho ahyia ho wɔ ɔkwan foforo so, de sie carbon, de yɛ atrae ma nnua mu mmoawa na wɔhyɛ kotokuo a ɛwɔ nkuropɔn mu kwaeɛ a ɛtwa mmeaeɛ a ɛfa ahotew ho te sɛ nwura a wɔtow gu ne ɔmanfoɔ tiafi a ɛwɔ nkuropɔn mu wɔ Gaana (Ghana) ase.

2. Nneɛma a Atwa Yɛn Ho Ahyia Ho Abakɔsɛm (Environmental Storytelling): Abakɔsɛm adwuma no de abasɛm di dwuma sɛ akadɛ a wɔde di nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia ho nimdeɛ ho nkitaho na wɔkyerɛkyerɛ mmerante ne mmabaa, kyɛ yɛn mmofraberem nkae wɔ sɛnea abɔde maa yɛn na ɛhwɛɛ sɛ yɛne yɛn ho bɛbɔ wɔ mpɔtam hɔ tebea horow mu.

3. Eco Club a Wɔhyehyɛe (Eco Club Formation): kamfo mmɔdenbɔ a nhomasua nhyehyɛe no rebɔ sɛ wɔbɛkyerɛkyerɛ asuafoɔ wɔ nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia a ɛbɛtena hɔ daa ne wimu nsakraeɛ ho denam akuo a wɔbɛhyehyɛ wɔ sukuu ahodoɔ mu a asuafoɔ di nkitaho na wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu de hwehwɛ ano aduru wɔ nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia ho nsɛnnennen a ɛwɔ wɔn mpɔtam hɔ no ho.  

Nimdeɛ a emu Ebue (Open Knowledge) a wɔde di dwuma ahyɛ nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia ho adesua ho nkuran denam Wikimedia nnwuma ahorow no so.

title: William Bruce-Lyle
text:
Na William Stacey Bruce-Lyle yɛ mmranimfoɔ ne ɔtemmufoɔ panin wɔ Ghana asɛnnibea baatan ne zambia asɛnniibea kunini no mu.

N'abrabɔ ahyɛaseɛ ne ne nimdepɛ. 
Wɔwoo Bruce-Lyle wɔ afe mpem ɔha nkron ne du-nkron wɔ da a ɛtɔ so dummiɛnsa wɔ bosome du no mu wɔ Nkran man mu. Ɔhyɛɛ n'adesua ase wɔ Government Boys sukuu a ɛwɔ Nkran man mu. Ɔsane toaa n'adesua so wɔ Mfantsipim ntoasoɔ sukuu kɔsii sɛ ɔfirii hɔ afe mpem ɔha nkron ne aduasa nkron mu. Ɔsane toaa n'adesua no so wɔ mmranim sukuu a ɛwɔ London man mu a wɔ frɛ no The Inn of Court School of Law.

Adwuma 
Wɔ ntoaso sukuu akyi no, Bruce-Lyle yɛɛ adwuma sɛ second division clerk wɔ Ghana Civil Service kosii afe mpem ɔha nkron ne aduanan nsia. Wɔpaw no sɛ ɔmantam ɔtemmufoɔ wɔ afe mpem, ɔtemmuafoɔ panin wɔ afe mpem ɔha nkron ne aduonum nwɔtwe mu ne ɔmansin temmuafo wɔ afe mpem ɔha nkron ne aduasia. Wɔpaw no sɛ asɛnnibea kunini no temmufo wɔ afe mpem du nkron ne aduasa baako mu na ɔno ɔsom wɔ saa dibea no mu mfeɛ miɛnsa. Wɔ afe mpem ɔha nkron ne aduasia nan  mu no, wɔpaw no sɛ Ghana Asɛnnibea Kunini no temmuafoɔ na ɔtraa saa dibea no mu kosii afe mpem ɔha nkron ne aduasia nsia bere a wotuu Nkrumah aban fii tumidi mu no. Ɔtu kɔɔ Zambia baabi a ɔbɛyɛɛ Zambia ɔtemmufoɔ panin firi afe mpem ɔha nkron ne aduasia nwɔtwe kɔsi afe mpem du nkron ne aduoson baako. Ɔbɛyɛɛ asɛnnibea kunini temmuafoɔ wɔ Zambia firi afe mpem ɔha nkron ne aduoson baako kɔsi afe mpem ɔha nkron ne aduoson nsia. Wɔpaw no sɛ Zambia Asɛnnibea Kunini no temmuafoɔ wɔ afe mpem ɔha nkron ne aduoson nsia mu kɔsii sɛ ɔkɔɔ pɛnhyen wɔ afe mpem ɔha nkron ne aduowɔtwe mu.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ansa na ɔreware Rosamond Alexandra Bannerman wɔ afe ɔha nkron ne aduonum baako mu no, na ɔwɔ babaa Emma Lilian. Ɔne Rosamond woo mmammarima baanu Leslie, Frederick ne ɔbabaa Desiree. Ne babarima a ɔtɔ so mmienu, owufoɔ N’animuonyam Owura Ɔtemmufoɔ Frederick Victor Bruce-Lyle yɛ mmaranimfoɔ wɔ Eastern Caribbean Asɛnnibea Kunini a ɛwɔ Saint Vincent ne Grenadines na ne babaa Desiree Bruce-Lyle yɛ mmaranimfoɔ wɔ San Diego Asɛnnibea Kunini, United States.

N’anigyede ahorow bi ne akenkan ne golf.

Sɛnea ne babarima Frederick wu ho krataa bi kyerɛ no, William Bruce-Lyle nso awu.

Beaeɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Akim Swedru
text:
Akim Swedru yɛ kuro ne Birim Atifi mansin Mantam,  ɛwɔ Apueeɛ Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Akim Swedru wɔ afe 2013 mu nnipa 10,379.

Nnipa 
Akim Swedrufoɔ yɛ Akyemfoɔ. Twɔ yɛ akuo a ɛka bom yɛ Akanfoɔ wɔ Ghana no mu baako.

Beaeɛ 
Kuro a ɛda Swedru atifi  atɔe fam no ne Aduasa. Wɔ atifi fam no, akuraa bi a wɔfrɛ no Jedem wɔ hɔ na efi atifi apuei  kɔ apuei fam no,Akim Oda, ɔmantam no ahenkurow no wɔ hɔ. Nkuro ne nkuraa foforɔ a ɛwɔ apueeɛ ne Ewisa, Akim Asawaase, Ntutumerim, Anyinam, Aboabo, Asene, Batabe, Manso, Asuboa ne Anamasi. Wɔ anafo fam no, Akyease ne Aperade nso wɔ hɔ.

Asase ho nsɛm 
Nkoko,nsutene ne nsubɔnten  pii atwa Akim Swedru ho ahyia . Osutɔ bere mienu na ɛkɔ so wɔ May–June ne September–October mu. Nsuo a ɛyɛ nwunu no firi 56% wɔ ɔpɛ berɛ mu ne 70% wɔ osutɔ berɛ mu. Kurow no da kwae bi a kyɛn mu.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Kpandai
text:
Kpandai yɛ kuro na ɛyɛ Kpandai Mantam no ahenkuro  a ɛwɔ Ghana atifi fam Atifi Mantam mu .  na nnipa a na wɔn wɔ Kpandai no yɛ 11,239  wɔ afe 2012 mu. 

Nnipa dodoɔ

Gonjafoɔ ne Nawurisfoɔ  a wɔn  baanu nyinaa fi Guan mmusuakuw mu no pre Kpandai so. Akasakasa no maa ntɔkwaw pii bae wɔ 1990 mfe no maa Nawurifo dii Gonjafo so nkonim.

Kpandai wɔ  akuo ahodoɔ pii a wɔn , Nawurifoɔ, Komkombafoɔ, Bassaresfoɔ ne Kotokolifoɔ ka ho. Akuw nketewa afoforo nso wɔ hɔ a Akanfo aguadifo a wɔte hɔ no ka ho. Kpandai wɔ Frao Atifi fam ne Atifi fam mantam no Anafo fam ano nyinaa. Nnipa a wɔte hɔ no mu dodow no ara yɛ akuafo a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ kuayɛ mu a afifide a wodua no bi ne bayerɛ , aburow  ne atoko . Wɔde bayerɛ dodow no ara kɔ  Nkran ne amannɔne. Nnipa pii a wofiri Kurow no  awie sukuupɔn na pii  akɔ so sdi yiye. N a nka eyinom mu dodow no ara benya wɔn Ntoaso sukuu wɔ Salaga, ne ntoaso sukuu pii a ɛwɔ Tamale no. Wonim Kpandai sɛ ɛwɔ mango nnua pii ne Kube  mfuw ketewaa bi.

Katolek Asɔre, Seventh Day Adventist Asɔre a ɛwɔ Ghana ne Pentekoste Asɔre no ne nyamesom ahyehyɛde akɛse wɔ hɔ. Nanso Nkramofoɔ  nso dɔɔso na nkramosom renya nkɔanim. Nnipa a wɔte hɔ no mu pii ka atetesɛm mu nyamesom gyidi ne Atɔe Fam/Arabia som bom.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Kibi, Ghana
text:
Kibi anaa Kyebi yɛ kuro ne ahenkuro a ɛwɔ Akim Apuei mpɛsoa so  wɔ Apuei Fam Mantam mu wɔ Ghana kesee fam, ɛwɔ Atewaa mmepɔw no apuei fam. Kibi da beae a ɛkorɔn 318 m na, afe 2013 mu no, na nnipa 11,677 na wɔte mu.

Hyɛn

Keteke 
Kibi wɔ akwan tiawa bi a kateke fa so tu kwan na afei nso, keketek gyinabea.

Abakɔsɛm 
Kibi yɛ Akyem Abuakwa mantam no tetekuro ahenkuro a ɛwɔ Ghana Apuei fam mantam (a wɔsan frɛ no Okyeman). Ofori Panyin Ahengua  a ɛyɛ Ɔkyehene  atetesɛm nkongua no wɔ Kibi.

Nwomasua 
Kibi wɔ nwomasua asoɛeɛ dodoɔ,  mfitiaseɛ sukuu kosi ntoasoɔ sukuu na afei,  Kibi nso wɔ asotifo sukuu a wɔde sii hɔ wɔ afe 1975 mu, wɔ afe  2008 mu no, na asuafoɔ a wɔn wɔ sukuu no mu yɛ 213.

Sikasɛm 
Wɔahu Tarkwaian abotan, a ɛyɛ sika kɔkɔɔ fibea titiriw, wɔ baabi a ɛbɛn Kibi.  Nnwumakuo pii a wotu fagude a adwumakuo a ɛde Paramount Mining Corporation ka ho ayɛ nhwehwɛ mu akɔ akyire.  RUSAL, Russia adwumakuo kɛseɛ bi a wɔyɛ Aluminum  ho nnwuma srɛɛ Ghana Minerals Commission ne Ghana Integrated Aluminum Industry Committee sɛ wɔmma wɔn kwan ma wɔnkɔhwehwɛ Ghana bauxite akoraeɛ a ɛbɛn Kibi no bi.  Wonim kuro no sɛ ɛwɔ galamsey dwumadi pii na saa dwumadi ahorɔw yi ama asubɔnten Birim agu fĩ.

title: Bechem
text:
Bechem yɛ kuro na ɛyɛ Tano Atifi mantam ahenkuro wɔ Ahafo a wɔwɔ Ghana mu, na Bechem yɛ mantam ahenkuro ma Tano Atifi Mantam no .    Bechem bɛn Bono ahenkurow Sunyani . Wonim kurow no sɛ ɛhɔ na Bechem Presbyterian Ntoaso Sukuu no wɔ.   Sukuu no yɛ ntoasoɔ sukuu.  Kurow no wɔ akyerɛkyerɛfo ntetee sukuu a ɛyɛ sen biara wɔ ɔman no mu a wɔfrɛ no St. Joseph kɔlege (JOSCO) no mu biako, na ɛwɔ nkuraa mienu a wonim no sɛ Techimantia ne Derma a mienu no nyinaa agye din wɔ tomato a wɔyɛ wɔ ɔman no mu ho no.

Ɛyɛ Bechem United Football Club a mprempren wɔbɔ wɔ top division wɔ Ghana no fie.

title: Jasikan
text:

title: Worawora
text:
Worawora yɛ kuro bi a ɛwɔ Oti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana .  Ɛyɛ Biakoye mantam no fã .  Worawora Ntoaso Sukuu na wonim wɔ kuro no.   Sukuu no yɛ asoɛe ntoasoɔ sukuu.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Dome, Ghana
text:
Dome (wɔbɔ no Dor-mi) yɛ kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ga mansin  a ɛwɔ Nkran mantam mu wɔ Ghana .  Wɛ afe 2012 no, na Dome yɛ nkuro a ɛtɔ so dunkron wɔ Ghana, wɔ nnipa dodoɔ mu, na nnipa dodoɔ yɛ 78,785.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Ejura
text:
Ejura yɛ ahenkuro wɔ  Ejura/Sekyedumase , mansin bi a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana .  Ejura wɔ nnipa 70,807 a wɔte mu .  Ejura yɛ ɔmantam a wodua aburo pii wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana . Ɛwɔ ɔmantam no atifi fam akyirikyiri, ɛbɛn Afram Asubɔnten no .  Ejura  ne nkurow Mampong, Yeji ne Techiman di nkitaho wɔ akwan akɛseɛ na    Ejura yɛ Digya Ɔman Mmoa Yɛmmea / Kujani Mmoa Yɛmmea.

Abakɔsɛm

2021 mu a wɔtow tuo 
Wɔ June 28, 2021 no, banbɔfoɔ too tuo kum nnipa mienu   wɔ Ejura na afoforo nnan pirapiraeɛ wɔ ɔyɛkyerɛ bi a ɛdanee basabasayɛ mu.  Ejurafo nso yɛ asantefoɔ. wɔn adwuma ne kuayɛ. Afahyɛ a wodi ne Sikiyerene a ɛyɛ bayerɛ afahyɛ

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: 1965 Ghanaian Mmarahyɛbadwa abatoɔ
text:
Mmarahyɛ badwa abatoɔ no kɔɔ so wɔ Ghana wɔ afe 1965 mu. Saa bre no, na ɔman yɛ amanyɔkuo baako man, na amanyɔkuo foforo bia nni ho ka manpanyin Kwame Nkrumah amanyɔkuo Conventions Peoples Party (CPP) ɔde ne hyee abatoɔ no mu.

Eho nsɛm 
Esiane mmara nsesae a ɛkɔɔ so afe a atwa mu no nti, amanyɔkuo CPP bɛyɛɛ amanyɔkuo baako pe  a mmara ma no kwan sɛ amanyɔkuo. Na eyi ne mmarahyɛbadwa abatoɔ a edikan wɔ 1956 abatoɔ a na saa bre no ɔman nnyaa fahodie no akyi; Nkunimdie a Nkrumahdii wɔ afe 1960 no mu no yɛ nea wɔhuu no sɛ akwanya foforo a wa’nya afriri ne manfo no ho maa wɔtwee mmarahyɛ kuo mmere kɔɔ anim mfie nnum.

Nea efiri mu bae 
Esiane sɛ na Ghana abɛyɛ amanyɔkuo baako man nti, mmarahyɛ baguafo 198 a wɔpaw wɔn no nyinaa yɛ wɔn a wogyina wɔ amanyɔkuo CPP din a obiara ne wɔn ampere ho.

Nea esi akyire 
Nkrumah aban no baa awie wɔ abantuguo a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ February afe 1966 maa amanyɔkuo CPP gui maa wɔtwe ɔmammara no sesɛn. Amanyɔkuodɔm amanyɔsɛm yɛ nea wɔ san di sii wɔ abatoɔ a edi eyi anim wɔ afe 1969 mu.

title: 1992 Ghana Mmarahyɛ badwa abatoɔ
text:
1992 Ghana Mmarahyɛ badwa abatoɔ yɛ nea ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Decemba da ɛtɔ so 29, afe 1992 mu. Eyi yɛ mmarahyɛ badwa abatoɔ a edikan wɔ afe 1979 batoɔ no a ɛyɛ mfie 13 akyi. Na w’adikan ato mpanyin abatoɔ no wɔ November da ɛtɔ so 3, afe 1992 mu.  Nnipa a wɔkyerɛtw wɔn din no mu ɔha mu nkyekyemu 28.1% na ɛbɛtoo aba no wɔ mmarahyɛ abdwa abatoɔ no mu. Ahwefo a wofiri amanɔne bɛhwɛɛ manpanyin abatoɔ no kae sɛ ɛyɛ nea ɛkɔɔ tɔteen. Nanso, ɔperetiafo amanyɔkuo no kae sɛ kɛtɛasehyɛ bi kɔɔ so wɔ abatoɔ no mu maa ɛno nti, w’amfa wɔn anhyɛ mmarahyɛ badwa abatoɔ a ɛkɔɔ so no mu.

Amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress na edii nkunim wɔ abatoɔ no mu ma wonnya mmarahye badwa agua a ne dodoɔ yɛ 200 no mu 189.

title: Adwamammɔ
text:
Adwamammɔ  yɛ nna mu kyɛfa  nnipa mienu a wɔnwaree de wɔn ho hyɛ mu. Sɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ saa adeyɔ yi mu yɛ awarefoɔ a, yɛfrɛ no awaresɛi. Nanso, John Calvin huu nna mu ɔbrasei sɛ, nna mu kyɛfa biara a ɛnfa mmara kwan so, a adwamammɔ nso ka ho bi.

Wɔ nnipa pii fam no, asɛmfua no yɛ nea ɛfa abrabɔpa anaa nyamesom akyiwade ho, nanso nna mu kyɛfa a saa asɛmfua yi kyerɛ no yɛ nea nsonsonoeɛ da mu wɔ sɛnea anyamesomkuo, mmusuakuo ne ammamere ahorɔw te ase. wɔ nnɛmafo mu no, wɔde nsɛmfua te sɛ nna a edi awareɛ anim anaa  nna mu ɔbrasei asi anan mu.

Farebae 
Wɔ Hella Kyerɛwnsɛm a ɛwɔ kane Greek kasa mu no, asɛmfua a ɛne porneia (πορνεία - ''Adwamanbo) no puei mpen 25 (a wɔde asɛmfua πορνεία no gyina ho ma Adwmammɔ no.

Wɔ afeha a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu no, Latin Vulgate a ɛyɛ Latin nkyerɛase nhoma a ɛkyerɛ Greek nsɛmfua ase no kyerɛ asɛmfua no ase sɛ fornicati, fornicatus, fornicata, ne fornicatae. Asemfua Adwammo ne adwamanbofo ye nea epuei wɔ afe 1599 Geneva Kyerewnsem mu, afe 1611 kyrewnsem a ɛne King James no mu, Catholic Rheims Kyerɛwnsɛm ne 1901 kyerɛwnsɛm a ɛde American Standard Version no mu. Kyerɛwnsɛm ahorɔw a ɛbaa wɔ wiase ko a ɛtɔ so mienu no akyi no yɛ nea w'akati asɛmfua a ɛne Adwamammo ne adwamammɔfo. Kyerɛwnsɛm a ɛne English Standard Version, New Living Translation, New International Version, Christian Standard Bible, Good News Bible and Contemporary English Version yɛ nea wɔnfa asɛmfua adwamammɔ anaa adwmammɔfo nni dwuma. Sɛ nkyerɛase baako de asɛmfua Adwammɔ di dwuma no, nkyerɛase foforo de asɛmfua a te sɛ nna mu ɔbrasei (Nhwɛso wɔ Mateo 19;9), anaa tiawa no, wɔ ɔbrasei di dwuma.

Wɔ Latin kasa mu no, asɛmfua a ɛne Fornix no kyerɛ kankofa. Wɔ tete Rome no, adwamanfoɔ yɛ nea wɔtwɛn adwadifoɔ no wɔ kankofa no ase senea nsuo nhwe wɔn, na ɛno na ɛmaa asɛmfua kankofa no begyinaa hɔ maa tuutuudan anaa agyantrafoɔfie, na Latin asɛmfua a ɛne fonicare no gyina hɔ ma ɔbirima a ɔkɔ agyantrafoɔfie. Kyerɛwtohɔ a edikan wɔ Brɔfo kasa no mu yɛ nea ɛwɔ Cursor Mundi, c. 1300; Nnwoma a ɛde Oxford Dictionary no nso de sɛnea wɔde ne kasakoa di dwuma;

Abakɔsɛm,amammerɛ, ne mmara 
Nhwehwɛmu a adwumakuo a wɔn din de American Sociological Review yɛe wɔ afe  2000 ne  2008 ntam wɔ aman 31 a afei na wɔrenya mpontuo no kyerɛ sɛ, Jewfoɔ mu ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 94 na anya nna a edi awareɛ anim mu kyefa, Akristofoɔ a w'anya nna a edi awareɛ anim mu kyɛfa no dodoɔ nso yɛ ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 79, Buddhafoɔ yɛ ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 65, Nkramofoɔ yɛ ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 43 na afei Hindufoɔ yɛ ɔha mu nkyekyemu 19.

Roman Aheman 
Wɔ afeha a ɛtɔ so nsia no mu no, ɔhempɔn a ɔde Justinian hyehyɛɛ mmara bi na ɛbɛyɛ ɔkwan a w'agye atom sɛ ɔkwan wɔfa so de hyehyɛ awareɛ wɔ afe apem a ɛbae yi mu.Wɔ saa mmara no ase no, nnipa meinu a wɔte bomu nanso wɔnfaa mmara kwan so no nyɛ nea wohu wɔn sɛ awarefoɔ na wohu wɔn mma nso sɛ wɔmfata, na wohu wɔn  te sɛ nea wohu atuutuufoɔ mma. Nanso, sɛ awofoɔ no ware a, wɔn mma no gyinapɛn sesa bɛyɛ nea mmara no gye to mu.

Britain Aheman 
Wɔ afe 1170 no mu, ''na ɛyɛ nea abu so sɛ nnipa mienu bɛtena abom sɛ ɔyere ne okunu wɔ bre a wɔnwaree, na afei nso anuanom a wɔ ware wɔn ho no nso yɛ nea ɛkɔɔ so'', na afei nso na ɛnyɛ aniwaude wɔ kane England sɛ obi bɛyɛ adwaman ba. Sɛ nhwɛsoɔ no, akwanya a na , William the Conqueror wɔ sɛ odi ade wɔ Normandy no anhyia akwansideɛ biara a ɛnfa ho sɛ na ɔyɛ adwaman ba, na akasakasaa ɛkɔɔ ɔne Harold Godwinson ntam no nanso anyɛ akwnside wɔ nea ɔfata sɛ odi England so. Nanso afoforɔ nneyɛe de fa adwaman mma ho ma no bɛyɛɛ den sɛ adwaman mma bedi ade wɔ England . 

Bre a Puritan bedii adeɛ no,  ekuo a ɛne English Council of State de mmara a ɛbra  akyiwade te sɛ mmogyafra, awareɛ akyi adwamammɔ, adwamammɔ ase bae wɔ afe 1650 mu. Wɔ bre a w'ato din Resotoration wɔ afe 1660 mu no, wogyaa mmara no too hɔ a w'amfa andi dwuma biom na wogyae sɛ wɔde kwaadu bɔ  adwamammɔfo. ɛmfa ho saa no , abrabɔ bɔne a wɔyɛ no  wɔ nnipa mu no kɔɔ so yɛ nea etia mmara nonso, sɛ obi bɔ adwaman wɔ kokoa mu a, entia mmara.

Ansa na wɔde mmara a ɛde Marriage Act 1753  bɛhyehyɛ so no, na mmara a etia adawaman mma yɛ ade ɛkɔɔ  so katee wɔ afe 1730 ne 1740 mu ho.

Wɔ Victorian bre so no, adwumayɛfo kuo kɔɔ  so nyaa adwene soronko fa nna ho firi wɔn a wɔn niimdeɛ akɔ nkan no hɔ. Nna a edi awareɛ anim no yɛ nea adwumuyɛkuo no gye tom wɔ bre a nnipa mienu no anante akyɛ kakra. Na baanu no yɛ nea wɔɔyɛ nhyehyɛe fa awareɛ ho. Sɛ ɔbaa no nyensɛn na sɛ awareɛ no amma so a, ɛde aniguase ba.

United States 
Nsɛm ɛsɔre wɔ nnipa w'adu wɔn mpanyin mfie so a ɛfa nna mu nso  yɛ nea wohu no sɛ ɛyɛ ankorɛnkorɛ gyinaesie nti, wɔnhu no sɛ ɛho nhia sɛ wɔde kwaadu bɛbɔ obi denam saa adeyɔ no ho. Saa mmara yi yɛ nea United State nyaa firii United kingdom hɔ. Akyire, mmeae ahorɔw 16 a wɔn wɔ Atifi ne Atɔe fam wɔ United States, a Wisconsin ne Utah ka ho no, yɔ nea wɔhyehyɛɛ mmara a ɛbra adwamammɔ (ɛtwɛ) nna mu kyɛfa a ɛfa baanu a wɔnwaree ho. Saa mmara yi mu dodoɔ no ara yɛ nea asɛnndibea a ɛwɔ  aman ahorɔw so kyerɛ sɛ etia wɔn amanmmara ma nti w'atam. San nso hwɛ State v. Saunders, 381 A.2d 333 (N.J. 1977), Martin v. Ziherl, 607 S.E.2d 367 (Va. 2005). ɛde besi March 2020 mu no, na mantam a wɔn mmara bra adwamammɔ no yɛ Idaho ne Mississippi, a na North Carolina nso mmara kakra na ɛka ho asɛm sɛ ''Sɛ ɔbararima ne ɔbaa a wɔnwree nya nna mu anyɔnkofa na wɔtena bom sɛ awarefoɔ a, w'afom mmara nanso bɔne ketewa bi.

Bre a na wɔkyerɛkyerɛ bɔne kɛseɛ mmara a ɛfa fa a obi bɛfa obi to no mu no, mmara no ka adwamammɔ fa bi.Nanso bre a Asɛnnibea kunini a ɛwɔ US de ne gyinaesie a ɛfa Lawrence v. Texas (2003) no kae sɛ mmara no bi a ɛfa obi to a obi afa no yɛ nea ɔman no ntumi mfa nyɛ adwuma. Nnipa pii kyerɛ sɛ gyinae a efii Lawrence V. Texas mu bae no yɛ nea abetwa mmara a ɛfa adwamammɔ no mu; gyanaesie no twaa mmara a ɛbra fa a obi bɛfa obi to no mu, wɔkaa sɛ saa adeyɔ no ye  ankorɛankorɛ ne kokoa mu adeyɛ ma nti mmara a ɛfa ho no tia amammara ɛwɔ United States.

Australia 
Nhwehwɛmu a wɔyɛɛ no wɔ afe 2003 mo no kyerɛ sɛ wɔn a wonnyɛ anyamesomfoɔ wɔ Australia no dwen sɛ nna a edi awareɛ anim no yɛ nea ɛfata. ɛdaa adi sɛ, abusuabɔ  da nhomasua, gyedie, wɔn a wonni anyamesom mu gyedie ne sɛnea wɔgye nna a edi awaree anim no tom.

Nkramoman Ahorɔw 
Wɔ Nkramoman bi so te sɛ Saudi Arabia, Pakistan, Afghanistan, Iran, Kuwait, Maldives, Morocco, Oman, Mauritania, Qatar, Sudan ne Yemen  mu no, nna mu nkitaho biara enfa awaree kwan so no tia mmara.

Zina (nna edi aware anim) ne adwamammɔ yɛ nea etia nkramosom kɔkɔɔkɔ, esiane sɛ saa nneyɛe de mmofra a wonnim won awofo na ɛba, na saa nneyɛe no nso sɛi botae a ɛtaa abusuasɛm no ho. Nkramosom si Abusua so dua paa na wɔ hyɛ sɛ mmɔfra nhwɛ wɔn awofo. Asotwe a ɛkɔ ma Zina wɔ nkramosom mu no yɛ abosie a wosi wɔn a w'awaree  ne mmaabɔ a wɔbɔ wɔn a wɔnwaree. Ansa na saa asotwe yi  bɛyɛ adwuma no, ɛwɔ sɛ wonnya nnipa nnan sɛ adansefo a wɔbebɔ amane, ɛnte saa a, ɛsɛ sɛ nea ɔbɔ soboɔ  no yɛ okunu a ne botae ne sɛ ɔbɔ ne yere soboɔ. Sɛ wodi saa ahwehwɛdeɛ yi so pepɛɛpɛ a, wɔn a mmara ma wɔn kwan sɛ wosi aboɔ no yɛ saa.

title: Agnese Grigio
text:
Agnese Grigio (wɔwoo no Ɔbɛnem 12, 1963 Albignasego) yɛ Italiani Paralympic agumadifo a n’ani nna hɔ yiye. Ɔnyaa dwetɛ ne kɔbere nkonimbo.

Adwuma 
Ɔkɔɔ so sɛ pentathlete, ne mfinimfini mmirikatufo. Ɔsii akan wɔ 1984 Awɔw Bere mu Paralympic Agumadi a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ New York, na onyaa kɔbere nkonimbo wɔ mita 800 B3, ne dwetɛ nkonimbo wɔ Pentathlon B3 mu.

Esiane n’ankasa ntease nti, ankyɛ na otwaa n’agumadi adwuma no mu, na ɔkɔɔ so yɛɛ torball (nteɛso a enni Paralympics mu), wɔ ɔman no ne amanaman ntam.

Ɔyɛ Emanuela Grigio nuabea.

title: Akwantuo kɔ germany
text: Germany ɛtɔ so mmienu, ɛdi United States of America pɛ ɛkyiri sɛ yɛ rekan nkuro dodoɔ a akwantufoɔ pii de wɔn ani kyerɛ a.

title: Akwantutenten Afahyɛ
text:
Akwantutenten Afahyɛ yɛ afehyia afahyɛ a ahenfo ne wɔn manfo a wɔn wɔ Worawora a ɛwɔ Jasikan mpɛsoa so wɔ Oti Mantam a ɛyɛ kane Frao Mantam, a wɔyɛ Akanfo no di wɔ Ghana. Wodi Saa afahyɛ yi wɔ bosome a ɛtɔ so nkrɔn no mu.

Afa hyɛ 
Wɔ afahyɛ no bere so , ahenfo no bɔ dwa dataa  ma wɔtenase gye nkyea firi wɔn manfo ho. Afoforo a wofiri akanman ahorɔw mu no ba Worawora kuro no mu bedi agorɔ. Wɔyɛ Ahowtew ne ahodwira ammaerɛ ma abosom no bre a wohyehyɛ ntedade tuntum.

Mfaso 
Wodi saa afahyɛ yi de kae Woraworafo a wotu firii Kuntunase a ɛwɔ Asantefo asase so baa babia wɔn wɔ sesia yi. Wonam afahyɛ no so foro wɔn kane tenabwa a ɛwɔ bepɔw so, na wotwa wɔn ani hwɛ fam a ɛyɛ wɔn tenabea no.

title: Anna Beninati
text:
Anna Beninati (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛnimma 24, 1992) yɛ Amerikani Paralympic alpine skier . Ɔnyaa kɔbere nkonimboɔ wɔ afe 2016 Wiase Kupɔn no mu.

Adwuma 
Osuaa ade wɔ Colorado Ɔman Sukuupɔn mu.

Odii kan sɔɔ sit-ski (afiri a wɔde tu mmirika a wɔtra ase a wɔde ski abien gu ase) hwɛe wɔ afe 2011 mu, wɔ akwanhyia no akyi asram abien pɛ. Bere a Beninati ne Dave Schoeneck ne Peter Mandler sua ade wiei no, ɔdan kɔɔ skiing a wɔde tu mmirika biako so, na ɛde ne ho kɛse. Bere a ɔresiesie ne ho ama Paralympics no, otu kɔɔ Park City, na ɔde ne ho kɔbɔɔ Paralympic kuw bi a wɔde mmirika tu mmirika wɔ mmepɔw so wɔ mmepɔw so. Wɔ afe 2015 mu no ɔdii nkonim wɔ ɔman no mu abodin a ɛdi kan na afe akyi no ɔdii nkonim wɔ Wiase Kupɔn no mu.

Wɔ 2016 Wiase Kupɔn no mu no, Beninati dii nea ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa wɔ seated slalom mmirikatuo mu, a ɔde bere 1:54.05 dii Anna-Lena Forster , a ɔde sika kɔkɔɔ wɔ 1:27.98 ne Laurie Stephens, a ɔde dwetɛ wɔ 1:34.83 akyi.

Afe a edi hɔ no, wɔbɔɔ ne din sɛ ɔnkɔ United States Paralympic National Ski Team mu maa 2018 Awɔw Bere mu Paralympic Agumadi a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Pyeong Chang, South Korea, na wɔde no too Agumadi no mu ɔsram biako.

Wɔ 2019 Wiase Para Alpine Skiing Championships, wɔ Kranjska Gora/Sella Nevea wɔ Slovenia no, ɔdii anum wɔ seated slalom mmirikatu mu, wɔ super combined ne seated super-G mu.

Wɔ Paralympic alpine skiing akansi ahorow a wɔyɛe wɔ United States ne Canada mu no, oduu asɛnka agua so mpɛn 10. Ɔyɛ obi a ɔkyerɛkyerɛ ski wɔ Snowbird.

References

title: Art Deco a Wɔde Yɛ Nneɛma
text:
Art Deco yɛ adwinni kuw a wɔwoo no wɔ 1910 mfe no mu, titiriw wɔ Wiase Ko I (1918) anɔpa na ɛkɔɔ soro wɔ 1920 mfe no mu ansa na ɛrekɔ fam nkakrankakra fi 1930 mfe no mu, ma ɛbaa awiei wɔ Wiase Ko II (1939) mu. Eyi ne adansi-ahosiesie kuw a edi kan wɔ wiase nyinaa.

Art Deco kwan no nyaa ne din fii Amanaman Ntam Nnɛyi Afɛfɛde ne Mfiridwuma mu Adwinni Ho Ɔyɛkyerɛ a wɔyɛe wɔ Paris wɔ 19251 mu no mu.

"Art Deco" yɛ "Decorative Arts" tiawa, na ɛfa adansi ho, titiriw no, mfinimfini adansi a ɛwɔ ne tapestries, stained glass windows, mfonini ne ahosiesie a wɔde ayɛ, ne cabinetwork, ceramics a wɔde di dwuma, sika kɔkɔɔ adwini. Wobetumi de adwini a efi ase wɔ nnwinnade akɛse a ɛtoatoa so a wɔde si adan ne adwumayɛbea ahorow so no abata ho, ne ntadehyɛ ne sɛnea wɔkyerɛw nsɛnkyerɛnne ne aguade ho dawurubɔ ahorow a wɔde kyerɛ ne nsɛnkyerɛnne.

Saa kuw yi abɛyɛ nea wɔde demokrase di dwuma kɛse wɔ Europa ne titiriw no wɔ France baabi a kuw no adu ankorankoro afie mu a wɔde mfonini ahorow a wɔde asiesie hɔ no (tableau de décoration).

Art Deco kwan no fii ase ansa na Wiase Ko I reba tiaa nhoma mmobɔwee ne Art Nouveau a wɔmfa nnuru nni dwuma wom no. Ɛyɛ tete kateeyɛ a wɔsan kɔ: symmetry, tete nhyehyɛe ahorow (a mpɛn pii no wɔayɛ no stylized kɛse), freestone (a mfonini biara nni mu). Nneɛma a wɔde asiesie hɔ a mpɛn pii no ɛda so ara wɔ hɔ kɛse no nni ahofadi a na ɛwɔ hɔ wɔ 1900 mfe no mu no bio; wɔn a wɔyɛɛ no ​​na wɔhwɛ so denneennen na ne nhyehyɛe no fi Cubist geometry mu.

Nhyehyɛe, kɔla ne geometry: wɔde Art Deco nsɛmfua no mu nsɛm titiriw ato hɔ. Nsɛmfua a ɛfa akwan horow so sɛnea mpɔtam ahorow no te, sɛnea adansifo ne wɔn a wɔkra no kyerɛ no, ne stylistic biakoyɛ no fi geometry (geometrization) a wɔde di dwuma a n’awiei titiriw yɛ asiesie - na ɛnyɛ nhyehyɛe -, a ɛnte sɛ amanaman ntam avant-garde no kankan , a wɔsan frɛ no modernism anaa amanaman ntam kwan, a ɛde adansi nnyinasosɛm ahorow a ɛfa volumes of bays ne harmonic circulations ho si hɔ. Saa adansi abien yi a "adefo" asiesie ne ɔkwan foforo so no "ahotew" a wɔde ma denam mmerɛwyɛ so no bɛka bridges a ɛda wɔn ntam ho ankasa sɛnea nnyinasosɛm ahorow a wɔde di dwuma wɔ adansifo mu wɔ ɔman a wɔde di dwuma no mu ne nsakrae a ɛwɔ ankorankoro mu no mu katee ɔkwan a wɔfa so yɛ nneɛma a mfaso wɔ so.

Art Deco yɛ ɔkwan a edi kan a ɛwɔ wiase nyinaa trɛw, wɔbɔɔ no wɔ Belgium na afei ɛkaa France, Portugal, Spain, Afrika Atifi fam, ne Anglo-Saxon aman nyinaa (United Kingdom, United States ne ne "Art Deco" fekuw ahorow a ɛyɛ nnam , Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India, Philippines, ne nea ɛkeka ho), ne Vietnam nkurow atitiriw a wɔyɛɛ mfiase no, China nkurow pii te sɛ Shanghai ne Hong Kong, anaa Japan, sɛ nhwɛso no, maa Prince ahemfie Asaka, a ɛwɔ Tokyo no.

title: Brydee Moore
text:
Brydee Moore (wɔwoo no 1 May 1990) yɛ Australiani ogumadifoɔ a ɔwɔ amemene mu yareɛ a ɔsi akan wɔ tuo a wɔde tow, discus ne peaw a wɔde bɔ mu. Ɔnyaa dwetɛ nkonimboɔ wɔ 2015 IPC Athletics World Championships mu. Ɔgyinaa Australia ananmu wɔ 2016 Rio Paralympics wɔ agumadi mu.

Wɔwoo Moore wɔ May 1, 1990 wɔ Melbourne. na ɔwɔ amemene mu yare.

Moore fii agumadi ase bere a na wadi mfe ason efisɛ na ɔpɛ sɛ ɔde ne ho hyɛ Kwasida agumadi mu te sɛ ne nuabeanom. Ne amanaman ntam akansi kɛse a edi kan ne 2006 FESPIC Agumadi a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Kuala Lumpur a onyaa sika kɔkɔɔ nkonimbo abien. Ɔsii akan wɔ 2008 Summer Paralympics mu wɔ seated shot put, discus ne peaw akansi mu bere a na wadi mfeɛ dunwɔtwe. Owiee dumiɛnsa wɔ mmea peaw a wɔtow (F33/34/52/53) akansi no mu. Ɔne Madeleine Hogan tetee wɔn ho ansa na Agumadi no reba. Wɔ Agumadi no mu no, John Eden na ɔkyerɛɛ no kwan. Ɔsii akan wɔ afe 2010 Commonwealth Agumadi no mu. Wɔ mmea quadriplegia/cerebral palsy shot put event a emu yɛ den kosi nea ɛkɔ fam mu no, ɔtow twaa kwan a ɛyɛ mita 5.85. Wɔ afe 2012 London Paralympics no ɔdii kan wɔ Mmea Shot Put F32-34 mu a ɔtoo 6.05m na ɔdii du wɔ Mmea Javelin F33-34/52-53 mu a ɔtoo 10.55m.

Moore nyaa ne amanaman ntam nkonimboɔ a ɛdi kan denam dwetɛ nkonimboɔ a ɔnyaeɛ wɔ Women’s Shot Put F33 mu wɔ 2015 IPC Athletics World Championships a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Doha a ɔtoo 5.20m a ɛyɛ papa wɔ berɛ no mu. Mfiase no Moore dii nea ɛto so abiɛsa nanso esiane sɛ wɔantumi ankɔ no nti ɔkɔɔ nea ɛto so abien. Bere a odii dwetɛ nkonimbo no akyi no, Moore kae sɛ: "Eyi yɛ adaeso a abam. Mansusuw da sɛ eyi bɛba. Bere nyinaa na misusuw sɛ manya hokwan, nanso nokwarem no, minnye nni. Ɔkwan biako pɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ ne soro mprempren. Metumi." nko ara na mɛnya yie afiri ha na anidasoɔ wɔ mu sɛ ɛno kyerɛ sɛ ɛbɛfiri mu aba yie mpo wɔ Rio afe a ɛreba no. Ɛyɛ anigyeɛ ankasa Eyi kyerɛ sɛ metumi ayɛ nneɛma korɔ no ara a obiara betumi ayɛ, wɔ ɔkwan soronko so kɛkɛ.Mada no adi sɛ anadwo yi ne me me hoahoa me ho kɛse sɛ mapue wɔ hɔ na mayɛ nea eye sen biara."

Ne nyansapɛ ne sɛ "hwɛ ogumadifo no na ɛnyɛ dɛmdi no".

Moore sii akan wɔ 2016 Rio Paralympics mu na ɔdii kan wɔ Mmea F33 Shot put akansi no mu.

Wɔ 2017 World Para Athletics Championships a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ London, England no, ɔdii anum wɔ Women’s Shot Put F33 mu a ɔtoo 4.40m.

title: Candace Cable
text:
Candace Cable (wɔwoo no July 15, 1954) yɛ obi a wabɔ Paralympian mpɛn akron. Ɔno ne ɔbea a odi kan a onyaa nkonimbo wɔ Awɔw Bere ne Awɔw Bere mu Paralympic Agumadi no mu. Cable nso yɛ obi a wadi nkonim mpɛn asia wɔ Boston Marathon, mmea mmubuafo akongua mu fã ne nkonimdifo wɔ Los Angeles Marathon anan a edi kan no mu.

Wɔwoo Cable wɔ Glendale, California. Otu kɔɔ South Lake Tahoe/Truckee, California bere a owiee ntoaso sukuu, na odii atoro wɔ ne mfe ho sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a obenya adwuma wɔ kyakyatow dan mu. Opirapirae wɔ kar akwanhyia mu wɔ Kingsbury Grade wɔ 1975 mu bere a na wadi mfe 21. Akwanhyia no akyi, a wamfa ne nan anni dwuma no, ofii ase huu ne ho mmɔbɔ na heroin yɛɛ ne su. Saa bere no ɔkae sɛ “Ɛnsɛ sɛ obi a ɔte mmubuafo akongua mu gye n’ani anaasɛ n’ani gye. M’ayɛ abien no nyinaa. Ɛno da nkyɛn a, minya mmeae a eye sen biara a wɔde kar sisi wɔ aguadidan ahorow mu, na enhia sɛ metwɛn wɔ ntonto mu wɔ sini ahorow mu.” Ɔfaa nnubɔne ho ahosiesie mu wɔ 1978. Ohuu mmubuafo akongua agumadi bere a na ɔkɔ California Ɔman Sukuupɔn, Long Beach dii kan sɔɔ asuguare hwɛe ansa na ɔrehu sɛ mmubuafo akongua mmirikatu betumi ama ɔne ne nnamfo a wotumi ayɛ apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ.

Bere a Cable tete ne ho asram anan akyi no, ɔde ne ho hyɛɛ 1980 Wiase Agumadi a edi kan a wɔyɛ maa mmubuafo, 1984 Awɔw Bere mu Olimpik akansi no mu wɔ mmubuafo akongua mmirikatu mu sɛ ɔyɛkyerɛ, ne 1984, 1988, 1992, ne 1996 Awɔw Bere mu Paralympic Agumadi, ne Awɔw Bere mu Olimpik Agumadi anum nso . Cable nyaa Paralympic nkonimbo dumien a emu awotwe yɛ sika kɔkɔɔ nkonimbo. Ɔno ne ɔbea a odi kan a onyaa nkonimbo wɔ Awɔw Bere ne Awɔw Bere mu Paralympic Agumadi no mu.

title: Cecilia Paulson
text:
Cecilia Paulson yɛ Swedenni a ɔyɛ Paralympic mmirikatufo a ɔde mmirika tu mmirika wɔ mmepɔw so. Ɔgyinaa Sweden ananmu wɔ Paralympic Alpine skiing mu, wɔ 1994 Paralympic Winter Games, 1998 Paralympic Winter Games, ne 2002 Paralympic Winter Games mu. Onyaa nkonimbo anan: dwetɛ abien ne kɔbere abien.

Adwuma 
Ɔsii akan wɔ 1994 Awɔw Bere mu Paralympics, wɔ Lillehammer, de 1: 43.07 Paulson dii asia wɔ super-G LWX-XII mu, na odii Sarah Will akyi wɔ 1:26.67, Gerda Pamler wɔ 1: 28.24, Stephanie Riche wɔ 1: 37.99, Vreni Stoeckli de 1: 38.03 ne Sandra Mittelholzer de 1:41.62. Ɔsii akan wɔ Mmea Slalom LWX-XII, ne Mmea Giant Slalom LWX-XII mu, nanso wanwie.

Wɔ 1998 Awɔw Bere mu Paralympics mu, wɔ Nagano no, Paulson nyaa kɔbere nkonimbo abien: wɔ super-G mmirikatu no mu, na onyaa bere a onyaa mu 1:13.33 (sika kɔkɔɔ maa Sarah Will wɔ 1: 09.49 ne dwetɛ maa Kuniko Obinata wɔ 1: 11.24), na ɔsiane LW10-11 wɔ 1:31.29 (wɔ asɛnka agua a ɛwɔ n’anim no so, Kuniko Obinata a ɔde 1:18.00 ne Sarah Will de 1:19.02).

Wɔ 2002 Awɔw Bere mu Paralympics, wɔ Salt Lake City no, Paulson nyaa dwetɛ nkonimbo abien, slalom LW10-12, ne giant slalom LW12. Ɔdii 4th wɔ super-G LW10-12, ne downhill LW10-12.

title: Chantal Vandierendonck
text:
Chantal Vandierendonck (wɔwoo no 31 Ɔbɛnem 1965) yɛ Dutchni a na anka ɔyɛ mmubuafo akongua tɛnis bɔfo a ɔyɛ adwumaden. Vandierendonck dii nkonim wɔ mmubuafo akongua tennis akansi ahorow a Amanaman Ntam Tennis Fekuw no yɛe ne Paralympic nkonimbo pii fi 1988 kosi 1996. Wɔde no kɔɔ Amanaman Ntam Tennis Hall of Fame mu wɔ afe 2014 mu.

Mfitiase asetra 
Wɔwoo Vandierendonck wɔ Ɔbɛnem 31, 1965 wɔ Netherlands. Ɔbɛyɛɛ obubuafo wɔ kar akwanhyia akyi bere a na wadi mfe dunan no.

Adwuma 
Bere a ohyiaa mmubuafo akongua mu tɛnis bɔfo Jean-Pierre Limborg wɔ Paris akyi no, Vandierendonck fii ne tɛnis adwuma ase wɔ Franse akansi bi mu wɔ 1983. Wɔ 1985 mu no, odii nkonim wɔ Super Series U.S. Open akansi ason mu nea edi kan a odii nkonim a etwa to wɔ 1993. Ɔkwan foforo so no, Vandierendonck de ne ho hyɛɛ mu wɔ kuw akansi a edi kan mu wɔ ITF Wheelchair Tennis Tour wɔ afe 1996 mu na ɔne no dii nkonim wɔ ITF mmea abien kuruwa mu wɔ afe 1997. Wɔ ne bere a na ɔwɔ ITF wɔ 1990 mfe no mu no, wɔbɔɔ no din sɛ ITF Wiase Nkonimdifo mprɛnsa na odii nkonim wɔ Wheelchair Tennis Masters mu wɔ 1996 mu.

Wɔ ITF akyi no, Vandierendonck sii akan wɔ Paralympic Agumadi no mu maa mmubuafo akongua tɛnis wɔ obiakofo ne abien nyinaa mu. Nkonimdi a edi kan a onyae wɔ Paralympic mu ne mmubuafo akongua tɛnis ho ɔyɛkyerɛ wɔ 1988 Awɔw Bere mu Paralympic akansi no mu. Onyaa Paralympic nkonimbo foforo wɔ 1992 Awɔw Bere mu Paralympic ne 1996 Awɔw Bere mu Paralympic mu.

Awards and honours 
Wɔ afe 2010 mu no, wɔmaa Vandierendonck Brad Parks Award. Bere a wɔde no too International Tennis Hall of Fame wɔ afe 2013 mu akyi no, wɔde Vandierendonck kɔɔ ITHF mu wɔ afe 2014 mu sɛ obi a odi kan a wɔde no too mmubuafo akongua tennis mu.

title: Email ntua
text:
Ɛlektrɔnik nkrataa (email) yɛ dijitaal nkrasɛm nhyehyɛe a ɛma wɔn a wɔde di dwuma no tumi fa Intanɛt so de nkrasɛm mena na wogye. Wɔde email nkitahodi ahorow no mena na wogye denam email server ahorow so, a wobetumi anya afi Intanɛt Dwumadibea (ISP) nyinaa hɔ.

Wɔde email ahorow kɔ server folda ahorow abien ntam: wɔn a wɔde mena ne wɔn a wɔde ma. Obi a ɔde mena no sie, de mena, anaa ɔde email nkra kɔma, bere a nea ɔde mena no kɔ email server bi so kɔhwɛ anaa twe email ahorow.

Email Ntua Ahorow 
Wɔ saa asɛm yi mu no, yɛbɛhwɛ akwan bi a kɔmputa so nsɛmmɔnedifo fa so de email tow hyɛ wɔn a wɔyɛ mmerɛw no so.

Phishing a wɔde di dwuma 
Phishing yɛ nnaadaa bi. Intanɛt so nsɛmmɔnedifo de email, nkrasɛm a wɔde mena ntɛm ara, ne sohyial media afoforo di dwuma de yɛ wɔn ho sɛ obi a wogye no di de nya nsɛm te sɛ adansedi krataa a wɔde kɔ mu.

Sɛ adebɔne bi de atoro email a ɛte sɛ nea efi baabi a ɛfata a wotumi de ho to so mena a, wɔfrɛ no phishing. Nkrasɛm no botae ne sɛ ɛbɛdaadaa nea ogye no ma watwe malware anaasɛ wada n’ankasa anaa sikasɛm ho nsɛm adi.

Spear phishing yɛ phishing ntua bi a ɛyɛ pɔtee yiye wɔ ɔkwan a wɔfa so yɛ no mu. Bere a phishing ne spear-phishing de email di dwuma de ne wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn basabasa no di nkitaho no, spear-phishing de email a wɔayɛ ama ankorankoro biako. Ansa na ɔde email no bɛmena no, ɔsɛmmɔnedifo no yɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ nea ɔde n’ani asi no so no anigye ho.

Ɔpɛ 
Ɛyɛ phishing bi a wɔde nne nkitahodi mfiridwuma di dwuma. Sɛ nsɛmmɔnedifo de IP mfiridwuma a wɔde nne di dwuma di dwuma a, wobetumi ayɛ atoro frɛ a efi mmeae a ɛfata. Ebia wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn basabasa no nso benya nkrasɛm bi a wɔakyere agu hama so a wɔkyerɛ sɛ efi aban bi mu. Nsɛmmɔnedifo bɔ mmɔden sɛ wobewia nea wɔayɛ no bɔne no din denam credit card nɔma anaa n’ankasa ho nsɛm afoforo a wobenya so. Vishing de nkurɔfo gyidi a wɔwɔ wɔ telefon nhyehyɛe no mu no di dwuma.

Smishing a wɔde di dwuma 
Ɛyɛ phishing bi a wɔde telefon a wokura kyin di dwuma de text message mena. Nea ɛbɛyɛ na nsɛmmɔnedifo anya nea wɔayɛ no bɔne no mu ahotoso no, wosuasua fibea bi a ɛfata. Sɛ nhwɛso no, smishing ntua betumi de wɛbsaet krataafa URL amena nea wɔayɛ no bɔne no. Wɔde malware gu nea wɔayɛ no bɔne no fon so bere a wɔrekɔ krataafa no so no.

Whale a wɔkyere wɔn 
Wɔfrɛ phishing ntua a wɔde wɔn ani si wɔn a wɔagye din kɛse wɔ adwuma bi mu te sɛ mpanyimfo mpanyimfo so no sɛ whaling. Amanyɔfo ne nnipa a wɔagye din nso betumi ayɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ani asi wɔn so.

Nnuru a wɔde yɛ nnuru 
Pharming yɛ wɛbsaet a agye din a wɔyɛ de daadaa ankorankoro ma wɔde wɔn ho nsɛm kɔma. Pharming ma adetɔfo kɔ wɛbsaet bi a ɛyɛ atoro a ɛte sɛ nea ɛfata so. Afei wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn basabasa no de wɔn data ma wɔ adwene a ɛne sɛ wɔadu wɛbsaet bi a ɛfata so.

Spyware a wɔde di dwuma 
Ɛyɛ softwea a ɛma ɔsɛmmɔnedifo tumi boaboa obi a ɔde di dwuma no kɔmputa dwumadi ho nsɛm ano. Dwumadie trackers, keystroke collecting, ne data capture nyinaa yɛ standard features a ɛwɔ spyware mu. Spyware taa sesa ne ahobammɔ nhyehyɛe ahorow de bɔ mmɔden sɛ ebekwati ahobammɔ ho nhyehyɛe ahorow. Spywares taa de application ahorow a ɛfata anaa Trojan apɔnkɔ ba. Spyware ahyɛ shareware site ahorow pii so.

Nneɛma a wɔde yɛ hu 
Ɛyɛ softwea a ɛde ehu di dwuma de hyɛ nea ɔde di dwuma no nkuran ma ɔyɛ adeyɛ pɔtee bi. Scareware yɛ pop-up windows a ɛte sɛ nea wohu wɔ operating system ahorow mu. Saa mfɛnsere yi da nkrasɛm a ɛnyɛ nokware adi a ɛkyerɛ sɛ nhyehyɛe no wɔ asiane mu anaasɛ ɛhwehwɛ sɛ wɔyɛ nhyehyɛe pɔtee bi na ama wɔasan afi ase ayɛ adwuma daa. Nokwarem no, nsɛm biara nni hɔ, na sɛ wɔpene so na wɔma dwumadi a wɔakyerɛ no kwan ma ɛyɛ adwuma a, malware no ka nea ɔde di dwuma no PC no.

Adware a wɔde yɛ adwuma 
Adware ma wɔn a wɔyɛ no nya sika denam pop-up ahorow a ɛnyɛ dɛ a ɛda adi no so. Ɛdenam nkratafa a wɔakɔ hɔ no akyi a wobedi so no, ebia malware no betumi ahu nea nea ɔde di dwuma no ani gye ho. Afei ebetumi de pop-up dawurubɔ ahorow a ɛfata akɔ saa wɛbsaet ahorow no so. Wɔde adware ahyɛ software ahorow bi mu default so.

Nwura 
Wɔfrɛ email a wɔmmisa no spam (a wɔsan frɛ no junk mail). Ɛkame ayɛ sɛ bere nyinaa na spam yɛ aguade ho dawurubɔ. Spam ahorow betumi ayɛ link ahorow a asiane wom, virus, anaa nsɛm a ɛnyɛ nokware. Botae titiriw ne sɛ wɔbɛboaboa nsɛm a ɛho hia te sɛ social security nɔma anaa sikakorabea akontaabu ho nsɛm ano.

Spam dodow no ara fi kɔmputa pii a ɛwɔ nkitahodi nhyehyɛe bi a virus anaa ɔkraman bi ahyɛ mu ma no mu. Kɔmputa ahorow a ɔyare mmoawa wom yi de spam email ahorow pii mena sɛnea wobetumi.

title: Emanuela Grigio
text:
Emanuela Grigio (wɔwoo no Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 7, 1964 Albignasego) yɛ Italiani Paralympic agumadifoɔ a n'ani nhu ade yiye. Onyaa dwetɛ ne kɔbere nkonimbo.

Ɔsii akan wɔ 1984 Awɔw Bere mu Paralympic Agumadi a wɔyɛe wɔ New York no mu. Onyaa dwetɛ nkonimbo, wɔ mita 800 B2 mu, ne kɔbere nkonimbo wɔ mita 400 B2 mu.

Wɔ 1988 Summer Paralympic Games mu no ɔsii akan, na ɔnyaa dibea a ɛtɔ so nnan wɔ mita 400 B2 mu, ne dibea a ɛtɔ so nsia wɔ mita 800 B2 mu.

Akyiri yi ɔde ne ho hyɛɛ IBSA Europa akansi a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Rome, wɔ 1985 mu no mu.

Ɔkɔɔ pɛnhyen wɔ ne amanaman ntam agumadi adwuma mu ansa na 1992 reba, na ɔde ne ho hyɛɛ torball (agumadi a na enni Paralympics) nkutoo mu, na ɔyɛɛ no wɔ ɔman no mu ne amanaman ntam.

Ɔyɛ Agnese Grigio nuabea .

title: Emmanuel Nii Tettey Oku
text:
Emmanuel Nii Tettey Oku (wɔwoo no 13 Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 1990) yɛ Ghana Paralympic agumadifoɔ ne para powerlifter.

Ɔgyinaa Ghana ananmu na ɔsii akan wɔ mmarima 72 kg akansi mu wɔ 2020 Summer Paralympics wɔ Tokyo.

title: Evelyn Werner
text:
Evelyn Werner yɛ Germanni a ɔbɔ ski wɔ Paralympic mu. Ogyinaa Germany ananmu wɔ para-alpine skiing mu wɔ 1980 Paralympic Winter Games no mu. Onyaa kɔbere nkonimbo.

Wɔ 1980 Awɔw Bere mu Paralympic Agumadi mu no, Werner nyaa kɔbere wɔ 3B slalom mu bere a ɔde bere 1: 45.87; (wɔ 1st Sabine Barisch a ɔde 1: 38.23 wiee mmirikatu no na ɔdii 2nd Brigitte Madlener wɔ 1: 40.68).

Also at the 1980 Winter Paralympic Games, Werner finished fourth in the giant slalom category 3B, time achieved 3: 22.55; on the podium Brigitte Madlener (gold in 2: 52.86), Sabine Barisch (silver in 3: 13.47) and Sabine Stiefbold (bronze in 3: 15.88).

title: Founders' Day (Ghana)
text:
''Founders' Day'' yɛ Ghanaman afofida a yɛde kae yɛn Nananom (''the Big Six''), ko a wokooɛ de gyee faahodie maa yɛn. Akane no na yɛfrɛ ɛda no, Kɔfabae da, efirisɛ na yɛde kae Ɔsagyefo Dr. Kwame Nkrumah ɛwɔ ne mmɔdenmɔ wɔ Ghana faahodie gyeɛ firi aborɔfo no nsam' mu. Ɛsan sɛ n'awoda yɛ ɛbɔ 21 nti, na yɛhyɛ saa ɛfa yi ɛbɔ 21 afe biara. Nsakyeraeɛ a ɛbaaeɛ wɔ saa afofida yi die mu sii Ɔman Panyin Akuffo Addo berɛ so,  berɛ a ɔkyerɛɛ sɛ wɔn a na wɔka Ɔsagyefo Nkrumah ho a yɛfrɛ wɔn ''the Big Six'' no nso fata sɛ yɛhyɛ wɔn anuonyam firi sɛ wɔn nso boaaeɛ ɛwɔ ɔman yi faahodie ko no mu. Saa nnipa nnum yi ne: Edward Akufo-Addo, Joseph Boakye Danquah, Emmanuel Obetsebi-Lamptey, William Ofori Atta, ɛne Ebenezer Ako-Adjei. Saa Nipa kuo yi na ɛka Ɔsagyefo Nkrumah ho ma wɔyɛ nsia a afe biara yɛhyɛ wɔn anuonyam, Ɔsanaa 4, Ghana kɔfabae afofida no mu.

Abakɔsɛm 
Na yɛhyɛ Ɔman kɔfabae fa yi ɛbɔ, 21 afe biara de kae Ɔsagyefo Kwame Nkrumah, ɔmanpanin a odi kan ɛwɔ ne mmɔdenmɔ ɔbbɔeɛ, ɔne ɔman no akunini nsia (Big Six) ɛwɔ ɔman no ko ma faahodie no. Ɔmanpanin Nana Addo Dankwah Akuffo Addo na ɔhyɛɛeɛ sɛ yɛnsesa ɛda a yɛde hyɛ fa no nnkɔ Ɔsanaa, 4 na yɛnfa nnkae akunini nsia no ne obiara a  ɔboaaeɛ wɔ ɔman no faahodie mu  na mmom nnyɛ Kwame Nkrumah nko ara. Afei Ɔmanpanin san yɛ nhyehyeɛ sɛ,  ɛbɔ 21, no nnyɛ Kwame Nkrumah nnkae da; Kwame Nkrumah awoda ne saa da no. Saa nhyehyeɛ yi maa yɛnnyaa kɔfabae da, sɛ ɛda a yɛde kae ɔman mo mu akunini nyinaa na afei Kwame Nkrumah awoda; ɛda a yɛde kae Nkrumah na yɛhyɛ no anuonyam sɛ Ghana manpanin odi kan ne okunini a odii anim' ko gyee Ghana faahodie.

Ɛwɔ bosome ɔbɛnim, afe 2019, mu no, ɔman mu afofida ho nhyehyeɛ sɛ Ɔsanaa 4, nnyɛ kɔfabae da bɛyɛɛ mmara. Ɔsanaa 4, a ɛyɛ kɔfabae afofida no nso ne bere a yɛtee ɔman yi mu  amanyɔkuo a edi kan, UGCC no kɔ pɛ; Ɔsanaa 4, afe 1947. Kɔfabae da yɛ da bi a yɛde hyɛ akunini nsia no a yɛboa gyee Ghana faahodie,  ɛna Kwame Nkrumah nkae da no yɛ ɛda a yɛde kae Nkrumah sɛ Ɔman no manpanin a odi kan na afei yɛde di n'awoda.

title: Gerda Pamler
text:
Gerda Pamler (wɔwoo no 1958 Zangenstein) yɛ Germanni Paralympic alpine skier. Ɔsii akan wɔ 1992 Paralympic Winter Games, 1994 Paralympic Winter Games, ne 1998 Paralympic Winter Games mu. Onyaa nkonimbo asia, sika kɔkɔɔ abien, dwetɛ abiɛsa ne kɔbere biako.

Wɔ 1986 mu no, opirapiraa skiing akwanhyia mu. Ɔtintim ne nsa sakre akwantu ahorow no wɔ alpenvereinaktiv so.

Wɔpaw no wɔ Germany ɔman Paralympic ski kuw no mu sɛ ɔmfa ne ho nhyɛ Paralympic Awɔw Bere mu Agumadi abiɛsa mu, wɔ 1992, 1994 ne 1998 mu.

Wɔ 1992 Awɔw Bere mu Paralympics a wɔyɛe wɔ Albertville no, Pamler nyaa sika kɔkɔɔ wɔ slalom LW 10/11 mmirikatu no mu (wɔ bere a ɛyɛ 2:03.83 mu). Onyaa dwetɛ nkonimbo abien: wɔ super-G (wɔ 1: 34.48 mu, dii Sarah Will akyi wɔ 1:27.66, dii Toshiko Gouno a ɔto so abiɛsa anim wɔ 1:48.89 ); ne sian (a ɔde bere 1:31.09 ), di Sarah Will akyi wɔ 1:24.08, na odii Candace Cable anim wɔ 1:37.02.

At the 1994 Winter Paralympic Games,she won three medals: gold in 3:12.39 in the giant slalom LWX-XII, silver in the super G LWX-XII (time 1: 28.24), and bronze in the downhill LWX-XII (in a time of 1:36.23, behind Sarah Will 1: 30.46 and Kelley Fox 1:34.55).

Pamler sii akan wɔ 1998 Paralympic Winter Games a wɔyɛe wɔ Nagano , nanso wɔamma no kwan.

title: Ghana wɔ Paralympics akansi no mu
text:
Ghana dii kan wɔ Paralympic Games mu wɔ 2004 Summer Paralympics a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Athens no mu, na ɔsomaa ananmusifoɔ mmiɛnsa sɛ wɔnkɔsi akan wɔ agumadiɛ mmienu mu. Nkegbe Botsyo, wɔ agumadi mu, de ne ho hyɛɛ mmarima mmirikatuo a ɛyɛ mita 100, mita 200 ne mita 400 mu, wɔ T54 mu. Ajara Mohammed hyɛn mmea 800m ne marathon a ɛno nso wɔ T54 mu no mu. Alfred Adjetey Sowah sii akan wɔ powerlifting mu, wɔ mmarima a ɛkɔ soro kodu kilogram 52 mu.

Botsyo ne Mohammed san baeɛ sɛ wɔrebɛsi akan bio wɔ 2008 Summer Paralympics a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Beijing, kane no wɔ mmarima 100m ne 200m (T54), na deɛ ɔdi akyire no wɔ mmaa 200m ne 1,500m (T54).

Ghanani biara nni hɔ a wanya nkonimbo wɔ Paralympic Agumadi no mu da.

Ghana de ne ho hyɛɛ afe 2012 Summer Paralympics mu, na National Paralympic Committee a ɛwɔ Ghana no paw Bedford sɛ UK ntetee beae ma ne Paralympians.

title: Grace Robinson
text:
Grace Robinson (wɔwoo no December 31, 1998) yɛ Australiani mmirikatufo a ɔde mmirika si akan wɔ discus, peaw a wɔtow, ne tuo a wɔtow mu. Ɔgyinaa Australia ananmu wɔ mmaa a wɔtow tuo wɔ 2014 Summer Youth Olympics ne 2015 Commonwealth Youth Games mu, na ɔnyaa sika kɔkɔɔ wɔ deɛ ɛtwa toɔ no mu.

Adwuma 
Ansa na ɔrekɔ amanaman ntam akansi no, Robinson dii nkonim ntɛm wɔ ɔman no mu akansi mu, onyaa sika kɔkɔɔ wɔ mmea a wɔtow tuo mu wɔ 2012 Australia Little Athletics Championships mu na ɔgyee ɔman no mu mmofra nkumaa kyerɛwtohɔ ahorow pii te sɛ atuo a wɔtow gu a wonnii mfe 13 kyerɛwtohɔ ne discus kyerɛwtohɔ a wonnii mfe 11. Eduu afe 2013 no, na ɔwɔ Australia ɔman kyerɛwtohɔ anan na wɔde no too nea ɛto so abien. 1 Australiani junior thrower, bere a odii nkonim wɔ sika kɔkɔɔ mu wɔ mmea tuo a wɔde tow ne discus nyinaa mu wɔ 2013 Australia Mmofra Agumadi Nkonimdi mu no, ɔde tuo a wɔde tow tuo ho kyerɛwtohɔ a ɛyɛ 14.66m sii hɔ. Ɔsan nso tow saa bere no ankasa a eye sen biara a ɛyɛ mita 16.05, a ɛboro mita 15 a ehia na ama wafata ama 2013 Wiase Mmabun Nkonimdi wɔ Agumadi mu. Nanso, na ontumi nsi akan esiane mfe a wɔadi wɔ Wiase Mmabun Akansi no ho nti.

Wɔ afe 2014 mu no, wɔpaw Robinson sɛ Australia kuw a wɔsomaa wɔn kɔɔ 2014 Summer Youth Olympics wɔ Nanjing, China, sɛ wɔnkɔsi akan wɔ mmeawa a wɔtow tuo no mu. Ɔfatae maa kuw no bere a odii Queensland ogumadifo Luisa Sekona so nkonim ketewaa bi wɔ ɔman no sɔhwɛ ahorow mu maa Mmabun Olimpik Agumadi no, na ɔtow sɛntimita 4 pɛ sen Sekona, wɔ mita 15.91. Wɔ mmeawa a wɔtow tuo no mu no, Robinson tow 15.61m wɔ ne mmɔdenbɔ a ɛto so abiɛsa no mu, na ɛmaa odii nea ɛto so asia na onyaa baabi wɔ nea etwa to no mu. Nanso, awiei koraa no, odii nea ɛto so ason wɔ nea etwa to no mu, na ɔtow twaa kwan a ɛyɛ mita 15.42 na wantumi annye nkonimbo. Ɛmfa ho nea efii mu bae no, Robinson daa aseda adi wɔ nsɛm a wobisabisaa no wɔ adeyɛ no akyi, na ɔkae sɛ, "ɛwom sɛ na ɛnyɛ tow pa de, nanso m’ani agye yiye sɛ mewɔ Mmabun Olimpik akansi no mu. Ɛyɛ hokwan kɛse saa."  Akyiri yi na Robinson de ne ho bɛhyɛ mita 8 × 100 afrafra kuw relay akansi a edi kan no mu dapɛn a edi hɔ no, na ɔbɛka mmeawa afoforo baanan ne mmarimaa baanum a wofi NOC ahorow ho sɛ Kuw 020 no fã wɔ akansi no mu. Nanso, kuw no antumi ankɔ nea etwa to no, ɛmfa ho sɛ wodii nea ɛto so abiɛsa wɔ akansi no mu ɔhyew a ɛto so abiɛsa no mu, na wɔde bere 1:52.45 na ɛyɛe.

Robinson bɛsan apue wɔ amanaman ntam akansi mu wɔ 2015 Commonwealth Youth Games a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Apia, Samoa, na ɔne ne yɔnko Australiani agumadifo Kristina Moore resi akan wɔ mmea a wɔtow tuo no mu. Robinson tow 16.39m wɔ akansi no mu, na oduu ne botae a ɛne sɛ ɔbɛboro n’ankasa nea eye sen biara a na wadi kan ayɛ a ɛyɛ mita 16.25, na odii Britania ogumadifo Sophie Merritt tow a ɛyɛ mita 15.78 ne 61 so nkonim, de gyee sika kɔkɔɔ nkonimbo no. Nkonimdi no yɛ sika kɔkɔɔ nkonimbo a edi kan a Robinson nyae wɔ amanaman ntam akansi bi mu, na ɛsan nso yɛɛ Commonwealth Mmabun agodie ho kyerɛwtohɔ wɔ mmea a wɔtow tuo mu.

Nasetra 
Wɔwoo Robinson wɔ 31 December 1998. Wɔtetee no ne ne wɔfase Pita Toamotu a ɔno nso yɛ ogumadifo no, na ɔne no tete wɔn ho kɛse. Robinson papa Chris tetee ɔne Toamotu sɛ anuanom baanu, bere a Toamotu papa wui wɔ ne mmofraase mfiase no. Robinson ne Toamotu nyinaa fii agumadi ase bere a na wɔadi mfe asia, na bere a wodii mfe 13 no, na wɔn baanu nyinaa tete wɔn ho mpɛn anan dapɛn biara. Kan no na Ray Russell a ɔwɔ St George District Athletic Club no na ɔkyerɛkyerɛ Robinson, nanso mprempren ne papa Chris Robinson na ɔkyerɛ no kwan.

title: Homowo
text:
Homowo yɛ otwa bre afahyɛ a wɔn a wodi no yɛ nnipa wɛyɛ Ga-Adangbefo a wofiri Ghana. Afahyɛ no hyɛɛ ase wɔ Kotonimma bosome no mu, na nea wodikan yɛ ne nnuane a wodua (aburo ne bayerɛ) bre nsutɔbre no ahyɛ ase. Wɔ afahyɛ no ase no, wodi asa bi w’ato din Kpanlogo.Nnipa a wɔ yɛ Ga foɔ no di Homowo afahyɛ no de kae ɛkɔm bi a esii wɔ tete Ghana abakɔsɛm mu no.

Eho nsɛm 
Asɛmfua Homowo (Homo-ɛkɔm, wɔ-Ehuro) betumi akyerɛ ehuro a wohuro ɛkɔm wɔ Ga kasa mu. Homowo amammerɛ no hyɛɛ ase wɔ bre bi a ɛkɔm a ano yɛ den sii wɔ Nkran Mantam no mu a ɛyɛ beae a Ga nkorɔfo no wɔ no esiane osutɔbre a ɛboa ma wɔn nnuane gyina no antɔ nti. Bre a nsuo baa wɔ ne bere mu akyire no, Ga nkurɔfo no yɛ nea wɔn ani gyee na ɛno na ɛkɔfaa afahyɛ a ɛde Homowo no bae. Homowo yɛ afahyɛ a wodi no wɔ Ga nsase nyinaa so, na ne mpɛnpɛnso keseɛ no yɛ nea ɛkɔ so wɔ Gamashie. Afahyɛ no hyɛɛ ase wɔ bre a wodua aburo a wɔde bɛyɛ aduane soronko a ɛne kpokpoi anaa kpekple afehyɛ da no. Sɛ saa bre no duru so a, ɛyɛ adea  wɔbra twenebɔ anaa dede yɛ esiane sɛ wɔgyedi sɛ dede no yɛ nea ebetumi ama nnobae a w’adua nnyin. Aduane no yɛ nea wɔde abɛnkwa na edi, na afei wɔde bi petepete kuro no mu. Mmuasuko no ti ahorɔw na edi sa dwumadie no. Abusuakuo ti biara pete aduane bi gu wɔn mmuasua fie. Wodi afahyɛ no bre a wɔde nwomtoɔ, twene ne nsakubo, asa ne osebɔ to santene fa kuro no mu. Edu saa bre yi a, wosii akwan ahorɔw wɔ kuro no mu na ama w’atumi adi afahyɛ no yiyie. Enfa ho sɛ afahyɛ no yɛ Ga fo dee no, ɛyɛ ade wɔgye aforo a wofi kasa ahorɔw nyina atoo wɔ afehyɛ no ase.

Nkuro ahorɔw bi a wodi Homowo no ne La, Teshie Nungua, Osu, Ga – Mashie, Tema, Ningo, Prampram.

title: Hope Lewellen
text:
Hope Lewellen (wɔwoo no April 20, 1967) yɛ Amerikani Paralympic a ɔbɔ volleyball.

Nasetra mu nsɛm 
Wɔwoo Lewellen wɔ Palos Park, Illinois. Wɔ afe 1996 mu no onyaa ne nkonimbo a edi kan a na ɛyɛ dwetɛ esiane ne kyɛfa a onyae wɔ mmubuafo akongua tɛnis mu wɔ Paralympic Games, Atlanta, Georgia. Mfe anan, wɔ Sydney, Australia no, ɔbɛyɛɛ nea ɔto so anan wɔ agumadi koro no ara mu. Wɔ afe 2004 mu no, onyaa kɔbere nkonimbo wɔ Paralympic Agumadi a wɔyɛe wɔ Athens, Greece no mu. Mfe anan akyi no wɔmaa no kɔbere nkonimbo foforo, saa bere yi de esiane ne ho a ɔde hyɛɛ Wiase Ahyehyɛde Volleyball for Disabled Intercontinental Cup mu wɔ Ismaïlia, Egypt no nti. Afe koro no ara mu no onyaa dwetɛ nkonimbo wɔ Women’s Sitting Volleyball mu wɔ 2008 Summer Paralympics a wɔyɛe wɔ Beijing, China no mu.

title: J.B. Danquah
text:
Joseph Kwame Kyeretwie Boakye Danquah (firi Ɔpɛnimma bosome da a ɛtɔ so dunwɔtwe wɔ afe apem ahanwɔtwe ne aduokron num(1895) de kɔ si Ɔgyefoɔ bosome da a ɛtɔ so nan wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduosia num(1965) ) na ɔyɛ Ghana amanyɔni, ɔbemfo, mmaranimfoɔ san so ka yɛn nananom a wɔko gyee ɔman Ghana sii hɔ no ho. Odii dwuma soronko wɔ berɛ aborofo bɛdii Ghana so ne berɛ wɔkɔeɛ akyi no nso a na wɔfrɛ Ghana Gold Coast no, yɛbɔ ne din sɛ nipa a ɔmaa nnɛ Ghana din. Wɔ ne amanyɔsɛm dwumadie mu no, na ɔka wɔn a na wɔreko tia Kwame Nkrumah a na ɔyɛ Ghana mampanini ne mfahodie pre kuo mu panini. Watson Commission a na wɔrehwehwɛ basabasaeɛ a esii wɔ Nkran wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduanan nwɔtwe(1948) mu no ka ne ho asɛm sɛ ɔyɛ "Gold Cost amanyɔsɛm mu nipa wagye din pa ara yɛbu no.
Sɛ abakɔsɛm nu ɔbemfoɔ, ɔhwehwɛɛ abakɔsɛm faa Akan nnipakuo ho, na ɔmaa wɔn kuro din a ɛbɛfata wɔn sɛ ɔman no nya mfahodie a. Na ɔpɛ sɛ awoɔ nnidisoɔ hunu wɔn nkyi ne wɔn man ho abakɔsɛm.

Abrabɔ ahyɛaseɛ ne nwomasua 
Yɛwoo Danquah wɔ Ɔpɛnimma bosome da a ɛtɔ so dunwɔtwe(18) wɔ afe apem ahanwɔtwe ne aduokron num mu (1895) wɔ Bepong a ɛwɔ Kwahu wɔ apueeɛ  mantam mu wɔ Ghana (kane Gold coast). Ɔfiri Ofori Panini Fie adehyeɛ abusua no mu a na wɔyɛ Akyem man ahemfo, ne abusua a wɔde akotene yie wɔ Ghana amanyɔsɛm mu. Ne nua barima panini ne Nana Sir Ofori Atta l na ne babarima ne Paul Danquah.

Odii mfeɛ nsia no, ɔhyɛɛ sukuu ase wɔ Basel Mission Sukuu a ɛwɔ Kyebi. Ɔkɔɔ Basel Mission ntoasoɔ sukuu wɔ Begoro. Ɔtwerɛɛ ne nsɔhwɛ wiee di nkunim wɔ afe apem ahankron ne dummienu (1912) mu no, Vidal J.Buckle a ɔyɛ mmaranimfoɔ a ɔtumi di asɛm wɔ kɔɔto (barrister) a na ɔyɛ adwuma wɔ nkran faa no adwuma mu sɛ kɔɔto twerɛtwerɛfoɔ (clerk), saa adwuma yi bɛkanyan n'anigyeɛ wɔ mmara mu.

Otwaa Civil Service nsɔhwɛ wiee wɔ afe apem ahankron ne dunan(1914) mu no, Danquah bɛyɛɛ kɔɔto twerɛtwerɛfoɔ(clerk) wɔ Asɛnnibea Kunini(Supreme Court) a wɔ Gold Coast mu a ɛmaa no nyaa suahunu a ɛnam so maa ne nua barima, Nana Sir Ofori Atta I a na wabɛyɛ ɔhene mfeɛ mmienu a adi kan no mu sɛ Omanhene Tribunal twerɛtwerɛfoɔ (secretary) wɔ Kyebi. Ɛnam ne nua barima so maa wɔyii no sɛ Ahemfo a ɛwɔ Apueeɛ mantam nhyiamu twerɛtwerɛfoɔ abediakyire. Ɛnam N'adwene mu na emu dɔr nti ne nua barima no de ne kɔɔ Britain wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduonu baako (1921) mu sɛ ɔnkɔsua mmara.

Adwuma 
Berɛ a Danquah baa Ghana wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduonu nson (1927) mu no, ɔbewuraa private legal practice mu. Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduonu nkron (1929) mu no ɔboaa J.E. Casely Hayford ma ɔtee Gold Coast Youth Conference (GCYC) a na ɔyɛ wɔn twerɛtwerɛfoɔ panin firi afe apem ahankron ne aduasa nson (1937) de kɔ si afe apem ahankron ne aduanan nson (1947) mu. Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduasa baako(1931) mu no, Danquah yɛɛ krataa bi a ɔtoo din The Times of West Africa, a wɔfrɛ no West Africa Time, a ɛyɛ koowa krataa( newspapeer) a adi kan wɔ Ghana a wɔdii ho dwuma wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduasa baako(1931) ne afe apem ahankron ne aduasa num (1935) mu. Krataa ne fa baabi a na wɔfrɛ no mmaa bea (Women's Corner) na Mabel Dove a ɔyɛ mmaranimfoɔ titire a yɛfrɛ no Francis Dove ba. Ɔbɛyɛɛ Danquah yere a odi kan wɔ afe 1933 mu a ɔwoo babarima baako maa no. Akyire no, Danquah bɛwaree Elizabeth Vardon.

Amanyɔsɛm 

Danquah bɛkaa kuo a na wɔhyɛ mmara wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduanan nsia mu(1946). Wɔ afe 1947 mu no ɔboa maa wɔtee United Gold Coast Convention (UGCC) a na wɔnyaa mfahodie a na nnipakuo a na wɔka ho bi ne ahemfo, abemfo ne mmaranimfoɔ bi te sɛ George Alfred Grant, Robert Benjamin Blay, R.A. Awoonor-Williams, Edward Akufo-Addo, ne Emmanuel Obetsebi-Lamptey.Danquah abakɔsɛm nhwehwɛmu nam so maa no gyee Nkrumah agyina a na ɛfa Gold Coast mfahodie ho sɛ ɔbɛsesa din Gold Coast no ayɛ no Ghana.

Danquah dwumadie wɔ University of Ghana teeɛ mu 
Danquah di dwumasom wɔ University of Ghana teeɛ mu, Suapɔn ɛso wɔ Ghana. Ɔtumi maa nnipa tee suapɔn yi si nka yie wɔ afe 1948 berɛ a Britishni bi bɛkaa nnwomasua a ɛwɔ soro ho nsɛm sɛ suapɔn kɛseɛ baako a ɛrebɛba Nigeria a wɔne University of London na ɛbedi dwuma na ɛbɛyɛ ketewa ama abibirem atɔeɛ foɔ nyinaa.

Ne kyere ne ne wuo ho nsɛm 
Danquah gyina sɛ mampanini gyinafoɔ tiaa Nkrumah wɔ Oforisuo bosome mu wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduosia baako mu(1961) nanso ɔdii nkuguo wɔ abatoɔ no mu. Wɔ Ahinime bosome da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduosia baako (1961) mu no, wɔnam Preventive Detention Act so kyeree Danquah sɛ watete sɛ ɔde ne aka nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde resubvert CPP aban. Wɔgyaa no wɔ Ayɛwohommumɔ bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduonu mmienu wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduosia mmienu (1962) mu. Wɔtoo aba yii no sɛ Ghana Bar Association kuo no panini akyire no.

Wɔkyeree Danquah bio wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da a ɛtɔ so nnwɔtwe wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduosia nan(1964) mu, sɛ watete sɛ ɔreyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ bɔne bi atia mampanini no. Berɛ na ɔwɔ Nsawam Medium Prison a na wɔrehwehwɛ saa nsɛm no mu no, ɔnyaa akoma yareɛ wuiɛ wɔ Ogyefoɔ bosome da a ɛtɔ so nan wɔ 1965 mu.

Abusua 
Kwaku Boateng ne J. B. Danquah bɛyɛɛ anuafoɔ ɛnam awareɛ so.

Din pa a ɔgya too hɔ 
Wɔsii J. B. Danquah Memorial Lecture Series wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduosia nwɔtwe (1968) mu sɛ nkae deɛ ma Danquah, a na ɔsan so yɛ Ghana Academy of Arts and Science (GAAS) mu kuoba. Wɔyɛɛ saa nnoɔma yi nyinaa sɛdeɛ wɔde bɛkae n'adwuma pa.

Danquah Circle, ntwaahobea a ɛwɔ Osu a ɛwɔ Nkran na wɔde too no.

title: Janet Penn
text:
Janet Penn yɛ Amerikani Paralympic skier, a ne ho akokwaw wɔ para-alpine skiing ne para-Nordic skiing mu. Ogyinaa United States ananmu wɔ 1980 Awɔw Bere mu Paralympics, 1984 Awɔw Bere mu Paralympics, ne 1988 Awɔw Bere mu Paralympics mu. Onyaa nkonimbo abiɛsa wɔ mmepɔw so skiing mu: sika kɔkɔɔ ne kɔbere nkonimbo abien.

Wɔ 1980 Awɔw Bere mu Paralympics, wɔ Geilo no, Penn nyaa kɔbere wɔ alpine skiing, 2A giant slalom mmirikatu mu; ɔde bere 2:46.91 dii nea ɛto so abiɛsa, na odii Canadafo Lana Spreeman a ɔde 2: 39.60 ne Lorna Manzer akyi wɔ 2: 46.88.

Mfe anan akyi, wɔ 1980 Awɔw Bere mu Paralympics, wɔ Innsbruck no, Penn nyaa sika kɔkɔɔ nkonimbo wɔ slalom LW4 mu bere a ɔde bere 1:30.00, (dwetɛ maa Reinhild Möller wɔ 1: 43.55 ne kɔbere maa Elisabeth Zerobin wɔ 1: 43.99 ). Penn dii nea ɛto so abiɛsa wɔ LW4 giant slalom mmirikatu no mu, na odii 1:45.85, na odii Germanni Reinhild Möller akyi de 1: 36.24 ne Canadani Lana Spreeman a ɔde 1: 39.18 dii akyi.

Ɔsan sii akan wɔ Paralympic Nordic skiing mu wɔ 1988 Winter Paralympics a wɔyɛe wɔ Innsbruck no mu, na wankɔ asɛnka agua so. Odii nea ɛto so 4 wɔ mmirikatu a ɛyɛ kilomita 5 a ɛkɔ akyirikyiri LW3 / 4/9 (wɔ Canadani Francine Lemire , Germanni Anneliese Tenzler ne Switzerlandni Monika Waelti akyi), ne nea ɛto so 5 wɔ mmirikatu a ɛyɛ kilomita 10 LW3 / 4 / 9 (in n’anim Francine Lemire, Anneliese Tenzler, Monika Waelti ne Austriani Gisela Danzl ) .

title: Jennifer Kehoe
text:
Major Jennifer "Jen" Kehoe MBE (wɔwoo no 15 Obubuo 1983) yɛ ɔkyerɛwfo ne kan skier a ɔyɛ adwumaden, kan no na ɔne ogumadifo a onhu ade yiye Menna Fitzpatrick resi akan sɛ ne kwankyerɛfo a ohu ade yiye wɔ IPC Wiase Kupɔn amansin mu na wagyina Great Britain ananmu adi nkonim anan a sika kɔkɔɔ ka ho wɔ Pyeongchang 2018 Paralympic Agumadi a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ South Korea no abɛyɛ Britain awɔw bere mu Paralympiafo a wɔasiesie wɔn ho sen biara. Ná ɔyɛ Britania Asraafo Panyin.

Nea ɛka akansi no ho no, ɔne asraafo a wɔapirapira ne ɔsom adwumayɛfo yɛɛ adwuma de boaa wɔn wɔ wɔn akwantu a wɔde bɛsan anya ahoɔden no mu sɛ Asraafo Para-Snowsport Kuw no Adwumayɛ sohwɛfo. Ɛnam Asraafo mmirikatu so na Jennifer bɛyɛɛ para-alpine ski kwankyerɛfo. Wɔ afe 2014 mu no, ɔhyɛɛ n’akwankyerɛ adwuma ase wɔ skiing mu ne Paralympian Millie Knight, ɛwom sɛ opira kɛseɛ bi maa Kehoe antumi ansi akan wɔ Sochi Paralympics mu. Mprempren a wɔne Menna Fitzpatrick rekɔ ski so no, wɔn baanu no boroo nea wɔhwɛɛ kwan wɔ Awɔw Bere mu Paralympics a wɔyɛe wɔ South Korea no mu. Wɔyɛɛ baanu baanu wɔ September 2015 mu, a ɛreda adi sɛ ɛyɛ fekubɔ a ɛdi mu kɛseɛ. Sikakɔkɔɔ ne Dwetɛ nkontabuo bɛboro 20 a wɔde too wɔn din so no, wɔyɛɛ abakɔsɛm wɔ afe 2016 mu denam Britania agumadifoɔ a wɔdi kan a wɔdii nkonim wɔ Wiase Kupɔn mu ahwehwɛ wiase nyinaa mu na wɔhyɛɛ wɔn abotiri sɛ Wiase Kupɔn mu akansifoɔ. Kehoe ne Fitzpatrick nso dii nkonim wɔ nteɛso abodin mu maa giant slalom saa bere no, ne nea ɛto so abien wɔ super-G nkyekyem mu ne nea ɛto so abiɛsa wɔ downhill ne slalom gyinabea mu.

Fitzpatrick ne Kehoe nyaa kɔbere nkonimbo wɔ slalom kɛseɛ mu wɔ 2017 World Para Alpine Skiing Championships wɔ Tarvisio, ɛmfa ho sɛ Fitzpatrick nsa bubuiɛ wɔ super-G nteteeɛ akwanhyia mu wɔ October 2016 mu ansa na 2016-17 berɛ no reba, na ɛmaa ɔkɔɔ sukyerɛmma so asram abien na ɛhwehwɛ sɛ wɔyɛ no oprehyɛn. Afe a edi hɔ no baanu no faa nteɛso Wiase Kupɔn abodin maa super-G.

Wɔ 2019 Wiase Para Alpine Skiing Championships Fitzpatrick ne Kehoe nyaa nkonimboɔ anum, nyaa kɔbere wɔ slalom kɛseɛ no mu ne dwetɛ wɔ slalom mu ansa na wɔredi sika kɔkɔɔ wɔ downhill mu dii wɔn manfoɔ Kelly Gallagher ne Gary Smith anim, na wɔbɛyɛɛ Britania skiers a wɔdi kan a wɔdii nkonim wɔ Paralympic mmienu no nyinaa mu ne Wiase Para mu abodin ahorow. Afei wɔfaa sika kɔkɔɔ a ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ super-G mu ansa na wɔde dwetɛ a ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ nkabom no mu rewie wɔn akansi no.

Wɔpaw Kehoe sɛ Britania Ahemman no Order no muni wɔ 2018 Awoda Honors mu esiane ɔsom a ɔde maa Paralympic Winter Olympic Sport (sic) nti.

Wɔ 25 Ɔbɛnem 2021 no, ɔde too gua sɛ ɔne Fitzpatrick fekubɔ no aba awiei na ɔkaa sɛ ne daakye wɔ Britania asraafoɔ mu.

Asraafo adwuma 
Kehoe nyaa ɔsraani panyin ntetee wɔ Royal Military Academy Sandhurst. Wɔ 12 December 2009 no, wɔmaa no adwuma sɛ ɔnkɔ Royal Engineers, British Army, sɛ lieutenant a ɔwɔ seniority wɔ saa dibea no mu fi 16 June 2008. Wɔmaa no dibea sɛ captain wɔ 12 June 2012. Bere a ɔkɔɔ staff college akyi no, wɔmaa no dibea sɛ major on 31 Ɔpɛpɔn 2019.
