title: Kokoran
text:
Kansa anaa se kokoram ye yadee bi  eka a yare hodo bi ho. Ema onipa honam akwa no.

Nsusanso a kokoran de ba ebi ne mogyatuo,asotee, ewa ekyere ene nsesae a eba agynam mu.

Enewma yi a a yeka nso betumi efiriri yare foforo.

Sigaret ema kokoram wuo 22% of cancer deaths. Anot 10% no  aka no no nso firi kesee .

Wobetumi abo woho ban efiri kokoram se wo anom sigaret . Afei nso wo taa tenetene wapom nso etumi yi wo fri kokoram mu.

title: Kwaku Boateng (Amanyoni)
text:
Kwaku Boateng (1926- May 2006) yɛ kane Ghanani mmaranimfo, amanyɔni, asɛmpatrɛwfo ne soafo a ɔhwɛ asoafo so.

Ne mmɔfrase ne Mhomasua 
Opanyin Acheampong ne maame Anima Acheampong a wofiri Old Tafo a ɛwɔ Akyem Aboakwa na wɔ woo Boateng.  Ɔhyɛɛ sukuu ase wɔ Old Tafo Primary School na ɔtoaa so kɔɔ suapɔn sukuu a ɛne Begoro Secondary School. Onyaa akwanya wuraa mfantsip School a ɛwɔ Cape Coast  wɔ afe 1941 na ɔhyɛɛ hɔ kosii afe 1944 bre a woyii no firii hɔ de no kɔɔ Presbyterian Secondary School a ɛwɔ Odumase Krobo, ma no konyaa abodin krataa a ɛne Cambrdge School Certificate. Ɔtoaa so koo sukuu a ɛne Fourah Bay College ,a ɛwɔ Sierra Leone  wɔ afe 1948 nanso ofirii hɔ wɔ afe 1949 mu bɛsen kɔɔ suapɔn a ɛne Kings College London University. Ɔde n’adesua no baa awie wɔ afe 1954 ma no nyaa abodin krataa wɔ mmaranim ho, na wɔfrɛɛ no kaa Abrokyire mmarainimkuo a ɛne English Bar wɔ Gray’s Inn , afe 1956. Wɔfrɛɛ no kaa Ghana mmaranikuo a ɛne Ghana bar no ho wɔ saa afe no ara mu na ohyɛɛ ase wɔ La Chambers se Lɔyani kumaa. Ɔhyɛɛ ɔno anakasa lɔya adwuma ase wɔ afe 1956 na ɔkɔɔ so yɛɛ adwuma sɛ ankorɛnkorɛ kosii sɛ wɔpaw no sɛ mmarahyɛ baguani wɔ December saa afe no are mu ma no kogyinaa wɔ Tafo abatoɔ mpɛsoa so.

Amanyɔkuo 
Na kwaku Boateng yɛ amanyokuo Conventions Peoples Party no mu ni na ɔsoom wɔ asoe pii wɔ Nkruma aban mu.  Na ɔyɛ soafo a ɔhwɛ nkitahodie so na wɔ afe 1961 mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ soafo a ɔhwɛ afisɛm so. Na ɔyɛ Soafo a ɔhwɛ nhomasua so wɔ Nkruma aban mu wo afe 1964.

Asuotwa 
Wɔ February afe 1966 mu bre a abantuguo a National Liberation Council ne kofabae no bae no, ɔne afoforo a wɔsoom wɔ Nkruma aban ase no dwane firii ɔman no mu. ɔne N’abusuafo kɔɔ United Kingdom.

Nnwuma afoforo 
Bre a ɔyɛ soafo a ɔhwɛ nhomasua so no, obue adwumakuo bi ɛne Bible House a adwuma no asoe ne Bible Society of Ghana wɔ Nkuruma din mu wɔ afe 1965.  Na ɔyɛ sikasohwɛfo wɔ Bible Society of Ghan kosii sɛ owui. ɛde kɔ n’amanyɔsɛm aweie no, Boateng bɛyɛɛ asɛmpakafo.

Abusua 
Paul Boateng a oyɛ Brtish amanyoni, a ɔyɛ mmarahyɛ baguani ma Brent South firi afe 1987 kosii 2005 yɛ ne ba. Kwaku Boateng yere, Owura yere Eleanor Boateng a ɔyɛ Scottish. Ne nua barima Andrew Boateng wɔ New York, Francis Boateng a ɔyɛ polisi wɔ Los Angelis. Wɔ afe 1950 mu no, 1950 mu no, Kwaku Boateng ne abeawaa bi woo aberimaa a ne din de Isaac Boateng.

Owuo 
Kwaku Boateng wuu wo May da a edikan afe 2006 wɔ beae bi a ɛne Paul’s home a ɛwɔ Cape Town, South Africa bre a w’adi mfie 80

title: Mary Grant
text:
Mary Grant (6 Ɔsanaa 1928 – 18 Ɛbɔ 2016), na ɔyɛ Ghanani oduruyɛfo ne amanyɔni. Na ɔyɛ Ghana 'Council of State' muni a odi kan ne Wesley Girls High School osuafo a ɔbɛyɛɛ oduruyɛfo a odi kan. Grant ne ɔbea a ɔtɔ so abiesa a yɛgyee no tom sɛ oduruyɛfo wɔ Susan Ofoti-Atta(1947) ne Matilda J. Clerk (1949) akyi. Na ɔyɛ Paa Grant a yɛfrɛɛ no "Gold Coast amanyɔsɛm mu agya" no busuani..

Mary Grant nyaa ntoaso sukuu ho nimdeɛ wɔ Wesley Girls High School a ɛwɔ  Cape Coast na ɔtoa so kɔɔ skuupɔn kɔsua aduruyɛ wɔ amanɔne United Kingdom.

Mary Grant fii amanyɔsɛm ase bere a yɛ paw no sɛ Secretary of Health wɔ 1985. Grant nyaa gyinabea ahorow pii a ebi ne Deputy Minister of Health and Member of the Provisional National Defense Council (PNDC). Akyiri no ɔbɛyɛɛ Minister of Education ne Culture ne afie nso Member of Council of State.

Odii Ghana anamusifo wɔ amanɔne nhyiam ahorow te sɛ World Health Organisation(WHO) General Assemblies wɔ Geneva ne Ɔmantam Nhyiam a ɛwɔ Africa, World Bank Nhyiam a ɛfa Africa Apowmuden ho, Cairo Nhyiam a ɛfa  Population and Development ho ne Beijing Nhyiam a ɛfa "Women Rights" ho.

Grant nyaa abasobɔde bre a wɔyɛɛ Maiden Women's Award.

Ofii mu a na wadi 88, owia beremu Ɛbɔ da a ɛtɔ so 18 2016 wɔ 37 Military Hospital (Accra). Wɔmaa no ɔman asiei.

title: Monika Sikora
text:
Monika Sikora Weinmann (wɔwoo no 1 Ɔbɛnem 1958 Ennigerloh) yɛ Germanyni a ɔbɔ pon so tɛnis . Onyaa sika kɔkɔɔ wɔ Paralympics ne Wiase Nyinaa Akansi mu mpɛn pii.

Wɔ June 23, 1993 mu no, wɔmaa no Silver Laurel Leaf wɔ n’agumadi mu nkɔso ho.

Sikora sii akan wɔ wiase akansi ahorow no mu mpɛn pii. Ɛha na ɔne kuw no dii nkonim wɔ sika kɔkɔɔ mu wɔ afe 1990, 1998 ne 2002. Wɔ afe 2002 mu no, ɔsan nso yɛɛ wiase akansifo wɔ akansi a obiakofo mu.

Wɔ 1991 mu wɔ Salou no ɔbɛyɛɛ Europa akansifo wɔ obiakofo ne German kuw no mu. Ɔsan yɛɛ saa nkonimdi yi wɔ 1995 mu wɔ Hillerod. Wɔ 1997 mu no, onyaa ankorankoro dwetɛ ne kuw sika kɔkɔɔ wɔ Europa Akansi a wɔyɛe wɔ Stockholm no mu.

Wɔ 1988 Awɔw Bere mu Paralympics mu no, onyaa dwetɛ nkonimbo wɔ Singles 4 mu.

Wɔ 1992 Awɔw Bere mu Paralympics mu, wɔ Barcelona no, onyaa sika kɔkɔɔ wɔ Singles 4 akansi mu, ne dwetɛ wɔ team 5 akansi no mu.

Wɔ 1996 Ahuhuro Paralympics mu no, ɔdii kan wɔ Teams 3–5 akansi no mu.

Wɔ afe 2000 Ahuhuro Paralympics mu no, onyaa dwetɛ nkonimbo wɔ Singles 4, ne Teams 4–5 mu.

Wɔ afe 2004 Awɔw Bere mu Paralympics mu no, onyaa sika kɔkɔɔ wɔ Singles 4 mu.

Wɔ afe 2008 Ahuhuro Paralympics mu no, onyaa dwetɛ nkonimbo wɔ Mmea kuw – Adesuakuw 4–5 mu.

Sikora competed at the world championships several times. Here she won gold with the team in 1990, 1998 and 2002. In 2002 she was also world champion in singles.

title: Monique Kalkman-Van Den Bosch
text:
Monique Kalkman-Van den Bosch (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn 28, 1964) yɛ Dutchni a na anka ɔyɛ mmubuafo akongua tɛnis ne pon so tɛnis bɔfo. Monique sii akan wɔ Paralympics mu wɔ afe 1984, 1988, 1992 ne 1996. Wɔ afe 2017 mu no, wɔde no kɔɔ Amanaman Ntam Tennis Hall of Fame.

Naetra mu nsɛm 
Wohuu sɛ Monique Van den Bosch anya kokoram esiane obubuafo nti bere a na wadi mfe 14 pɛ no. Mfiase no ɔfaa pon so tɛnis agumadi no wɔ ne mmofraase ansa na ɔrebɛyɛ mmubuafo akongua tɛnis bɔfo a ɔyɛ adwumaden. Bere a odii mfe 20 no, ɔde ne ho hyɛɛ Paralympic akansi mu nea edi kan wɔ 1984 Awɔw Bere mu Paralympic akansi no mu na osii akan wɔ table tennis akansi ahorow mu.

Monique Kalkman nyaa sika kɔkɔɔ ne kɔbere nkonimbo wɔ mmea pon so tɛnis akansi ahorow mu sɛ 1984 Awɔw Bere mu Paralympics no fã. Afei osii akan wɔ 1988 Awɔw Bere mu Paralympics mu sɛ mmubuafo akongua mu tɛnis bɔfo na ogyee sika kɔkɔɔ nkonimbo wɔ mmea a wɔyɛ biako mu ɛwom sɛ na adeyɛ no yɛ ɔyɛkyerɛ agumadi wɔ 1988 Awɔw Bere mu Paralympics mu de. Monique Van den Bosch toaa ne nkonimbo hwehwɛ so wɔ Awɔw Bere mu Paralympics bere a ɔgyee sika kɔkɔɔ nkonimbo wɔ mmea a wɔyɛ biako ne mmea abien a ɔne Chantal Vandierendonck yɛɛ biako wɔ 1992 Ahuhuro Paralympics no mu no.

Ɔsan nso dii nkonim wɔ ITF Wiase Titles mu wɔ afe 1992, 1993, 1994 ne 1995 mu.

mu no, nnuruyɛfo no tuu no fo sɛ ɔnkɔbɔ golf efisɛ na ɔwɔ yare a ɛma obubuafo. Ogyaee mmubuafo akongua tɛnis akansi mu wɔ 1997 mu na ofii ase bɔɔ golf wɔ n’ahomegye bere mu. Ɔsan nso hyehyɛɛ Going4Golf, golf fapem a ne botaeɛ ne sɛ ɛbɛhyɛ golf agodie ho nkuran ama nnipa a wɔadi dɛm

title: Nancy Olson (tennis)
text:
Nancy Olson (wɔwoo no March 8, 1957 wɔ Stony Point, New York) yɛ Amerikani a ɔbɔ mmubuafo akongua tɛnis . Osii akan wɔ Paralympic Agumadi abien mu, na onyaa dwetɛ nkonimbo abien.

Owiee sukuu wɔ Slippery Rock Sukuupɔn mu.

Wɔ 1992 Awɔw Bere mu Paralympics mu no, Monique Kalkman yii no fii mu wɔ singles mu wɔ quarterfinals mu, bere a ɔne Lynn Seidemann duu nea etwa to no mu wɔ doubles mu no . Wɔn baanu no dii nkogu wɔ Monique Kalkman ne Chantal Vandierendonck anim ma wonyaa dwetɛ nkonimbo no.

Wɔ 1996 Awɔw Bere mu Paralympics no, ɔsan duu quarterfinals wɔ singles mu, faako a saa bere yi de ɔhweree Chantal Vandierendonck. Na wɔ abien mu no, onyaa dwetɛ nkonimbo foforo, ne Hope Lewellen, wɔkɔɔ nea etwa to no mu, a Monique Kalkman ne Chantal Vandierendonck san dii nkonim.

Efi 1993 kosi 1997 no, wɔde no too Top 10, wɔ wiase . Ɔdii agorɔ wɔ ne akansi a etwa to no mu wɔ 1999 mu.

title: Nea enti a ananse tare odanpan mu
text:
NEA ENTI A ANANSE TARE ƆDANPAN MU.
Mmere bi, Ananse ne ne yere Ákɔnɔre Yaa yɛɛ afuw.  afuw no ye mu no, Ananse yɛɛ ne ho se obi a ɔyare, nti se wɔkɔ afuw no mu a na ɔdeda hɔ a ɔnnye hwee.  Eduu mmere bi no ne yere sree no sɛ sɛ woba  afuw mu a ɔntew nani na wonye na atumi aboa wone won mma no.  Ananse de aniwu yeyaw ne yere se 'Ah wo obea akoko nini, tumi ben na wowo a wode bekyere me nea menye?'

Eyi akyi no Ananse bɔɔ mmoden de ne ho gyee mu kakra boaa ne yere ma woyee afuw no.  Nnobae no nyinn, a emu bayere, bankye, mankani ne ade abobo akeseakese, na atosode nyina nso asosow kosoo no, Kwaku ananse ani bree afuw no.  Eyi nti adwene a ofae ne se, ononkoa bebo mmoden adi nnobae no nyina agya ne yere ne ne mma no. Opatu yaree na oka kyeree ne yere se, 'Okonore, yare a me yare yi de magyanom nsamanfo se owu ara na mewu, enti se mewu a da no ara monsie me. Esiane se eye nananom nsamanfo na woretow nsa afre me nti, wose, se mewu a mommfa nnadewa mmobo madaka no mu na mmom momfa owaduru, woma, nkyensee, nkyene, mankyese ne sekanma nhye madaka no mu na momfa nsie me wo afuw no mu.'

Okonore de oyaw ne su ka kyeree ne kunu se orenwu nti onnyae nea oreye no nanso wantie.  Nansa pe na Kwaku Ananse gyaee mu.  Okonore boo moden yee senea ne kunu kae ansa na orewu no nyinaa pepeepe. Ode awerehow betenaa ne fi bedii kuna na ne mma no nso bedann nyisia.  

Esiane se na okonore ye okunafo nti, na ontumi nko afum na mmom ne mma no na woko. Da biara a wobeko ho no, na obi abetutu afuw no mu nneema no atwitwa borode a anyinyin no nyinaa. Afei nso atosode ne neema a aka no nyina nso wobeko no na obi abewiewia de ko.  Se eba no saa na mmofra no kobo won maame amanee a na adan ayiye foforo koraa wo fie ho.  Otumi su bo abubuo pii se se ne kunu te ase a anka owifo ko no rentumi nye sa.  Adebone yi koo so ara kosii se dakoro de Okonore Yaa ankasa de ahometew koo afuw no mu kohuu senea onii no adi won awu afa.  Ode eho amanee koboo Omanhene ma one ne mpanimfo yee adwene se wobeye biribi a ebetumi akyere owifo ko no.

Wode dua sen abaduaba de amman pii yee ho senea obi ho ka ara pe a ebekyere no no.  Wode kosii afuw no mu gyaw ho koe dinn.  Eduu anadwo no Ananse sore baa afuw no mu bedii ne dwuma a odi no. Oguso retutu nnobae no saa no, ohuu abaduaba no se egyina ho.  ode ahopopo bisaa se eye hena, nanso wammua.  Eyi maa ode abofuw koboo abaduaba no asom. Eho ara na nensa aka. Ode ne nan boo no, na eno nso kae saa ara.  Ode abofuw yeyaw abaduaba no na oka kyeree no se se wanyaw nensa ne ne nan mu a ode ne ti bebo nano, Ananse ano ansi mpo na ode ne ti ne ne yafuanu apempem abaduaba no ama ne nyinaa akeka ho a oye ne ho hwee a enye yie.  Ofii ase de su sree no nanso abaduaba no anyae no, nti otaree ho ara kosii se adekyee a kurow mma no nyina de anibre kohwee se ebia wobekyere owifo no anaa?  wobeko a Ananse na otare abaduaba yi ho yi.  Wo maa okaa nanom nsem nyinaa ansa na woreyi no wo ho, nanso animguase ne ahoyeraw nti ogyee ne ho kofam odampare ho a obiara anhu no bio.

title: Nkran Mantam mu
text:
Nkran Mantam mu ne mantam a n'asase sua koraa wɔ Ghana mantam 16 no mu, ne tɛtrɛtɛ yɛ kilomita 3,245.ɛyi gyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 1.4 wɔ Ghana asase mu. ɛno ne Mantam a ɛto so meinu a emu nnipa dɔɔso yiyie a edi Asante mantam  akyi. Nnipa akenkan a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ afe 2010 mu no kyerɛ sɛ, emu nnipa dodoɔ yɛ 4,010,054  a egyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyemu 16.3.

Nkran mantam no yɛ mantam a nkurow, adan ne nwuma akɛse wo mu paa na nnipa no mu ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 87.4 na ɛtete mmeae a ɛte saa. Nkran mantam no Ahenkrow no ne Nkran na, ɛno nso ne ɔman Ghana Ahenkurow.

Abakɔsɛm 
Wɔ  afe 1960 mu no, na  wɔfrɛ Nkran mantam no Nkran mpesua, na na asase no ka Apuei mantam nsase ho. Wɔ  bosome a ɛtɔ  so nson no da a ɛtɔ  so 23, afe 1982 no, ɔsoafo no de mmara a ɛne (PNDCL 26) tee Nkran Mantam fii Apuei Mantam ho.

Nsaase

Beaɛ ne ne keseyɛ 
Wo atifi fam no, Nkran mantam no Apuei Mantam na ɛbɔ hyeɛ, wɔ apuei fam nso, ɛne Frao mantam na ɛbɔ hyeɛ. Sɛ ɛba atɔe fam nso a , nkran mantam ne  ɛpo kɛse Gulf of Guinea na ɛbɔ hyeɛ na wɔ anafo fam nso, ɛne mfinini mantam na ɛbɔ hyeɛ. Nkran mantam ne asase a esua koraa wɔ mantam 16 no mu.

Nkranfo di afayɛ bi a wato din Homowo a ase kyerɛ ne sɛ ''ɔkɔm huro''. Saa afahyɛ yi fii ase mfi pii a atwam. Wɔhyɛ saa fa yi de kae ɛkɔm kɛse bi esii wɔ nkranfo mu mfe bebree bi. Adangbefo yɛ wɔn a wofi Ada na wɔn afahyɛ a wodi ne  Asafotu afahyɛ a wɔnsan nso frɛ no 'Asafotufiam'. ɛyɛ afahyɛ a wodi de  kae akofo ne nkunim a wodii wɔ wɔ ako ahorow mu. Wɔhyɛ saa fa yi ase wɔ yawada wɔ Kitawonsa bosome no mu kosi nawotwe a edi kan wɔ Ɔsanaa bosome no mu.

sɛnea wɔbekae nnema nti, sɛ  edu afahye yi a, akofo no hyɛ won ako ntade ahorow na wɔde agorɔ asi anni. Saa bere yi nso yɛ bre wɔde ntetee ma mmabun wɔ ɔko ho. Saa afahyɛ yi ne otwa afahyɛ no hyia ma nti wɔyɛ amaneɛ ahorɔw a ahotew amammerɛ ka ho. Afahyɛ no du ne mpɔnpɔn so bre a ahenfo fura wɔn tam ahorɔw tenatena wɔn apankan mu,na wɔn manfoɔ de twenebɔ,  osebɔ , nnwom ne asaw di wɔn akyi . Ahenfo no de nkyea ma wɔn ho wɔn ho, gu nsa na wɔhye wɔn ho wɔn ho den.

Asoe a ehw3 nnipa akekan so wo Nkran mantam no mu.  Nkran mantam no wo mpesua a edidi so yi; La Nkwantanang Madina Mantam mu, Ashaiman Mantam mu Ledzokuku-krowor Mantam muAdenta Mantam ,Ga apuei Mantam .

Nnipa akenkan a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ afe 2010 mu no kyerɛ sɛ, emu nnipa dodoɔ yɛ 4,010,054 ,ɛma no bɛyɛɛ mantam a ɛto so mienu a wɔn mu nnipa dɔɔso yi paa. Asante mantam na edikan ma Nkramantam to so mienu. Nea nti a ɛte saa ne sɛ nkrufo di mu atukotena paa.

Mmusuakuo 
Ga-Dangmefo no yɛ Nkranfo kuo a wɔdɔɔso paa wɔ Nkran mmuasukuo no nyinaa mu. wɔn dodoɔ yɛ ɔha mu nkyekyɛm 18.9. Nkranfo nhenkurow  no gu ahorɔw nsia; Ga Mashie, Osu , La, Tshie Nungua ne Tema. Wɔn mu biara wɔ ahengua a woyi so apayɛ. La kurow no wɔ Sika korabea a ɛsom La manfoɔ no.  Nkran bɛyɛɛ titriw wɔ Ga-Dangme nkuro no mu ma nnɛ, abɛyɛ Ghana Ahenkurow. Na Nkranfo no adwuma ne kuayɛ nanso nnɛ, apopo dwuma ne adetɔn ne nwuma a agye nkran man no afa. Mmaa no pii yɛ dwadifoɔ na wɔn kununom nni wɔn yerenom sika so tumi. Nkranfo di ɛnade nti mmaa pii yɛ adedifo. Mmarima no yɛ ade a wodi agya ade ma nti wɔtena wɔn agyanom fie, Nanso sɛ mmea no ware mpo a, wɔn ne wɔn maamenon ne wɔn mma tena wɔn na fie.

Ofie biara mu wɔ nkranfo fie wɔ won abosom a wɔyɛ nyankomade ma wɔn na afahyɛ pii nso na ɛwɔ hɔ. Adangmefo no yɛ wɔn a wɔte bɛn Ghana mpoano efi Kpone kosi Ada, nsuo Frao  ne Gulf of Guinea. Adangmefo no ne Ada, Kpone, Krobo, Ningo, Osuduku, Prampram ne Shai, won nyinaa ka Adangme a ne fibea ne Kwa,a ɛwɔ Congo mmusua mu. Adangmefo ne wɔn a wɔ dɔɔso wɔ nkranfo mu na nkran nsase ɔha mu nkyekyemu 70 yɛ wɔn dea.

Atukɔtena 
Nnipa  a wɔte Nkran mantam no mu ɔha mu nkyekyɛm  1.3 yɛ won a watu afri Ghana nkro afoforo so abetena.

Nnipa dodoɔ a wɔte nkran no mu dodoɔ  no yɛ Akanfo na wogyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛm 39.8. Nea edi hɔ ne Ga-Dangme a wɔn dodoɔ yɛ ɔha mu nkyekyɛm 30.7. ɛno akyi no, ɔha mu nkyekyɛm 18 yea Ewe.

Nnipa dodoɔ 
Wɔ afe 1960 mu no, na nkrofo dodoɔ a na wɔ wɔ Nkra Mantam no yɛ 491817. Nnipa dodoɔ a na wɔ wɔ hɔ wɔ afe 2000 mu no yɛ 2,905,76. Nnipa akenkan a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ afe 2010 no kyerɛ sɛ nnipa 4,10,054 na ɛwo nkran mantam.

title: Nsu mu nwaw atiridii
text:
Nsu mu nwaw atiridii, a wͻsan frε no schistosomiasis, yε yare bi a nsonsono bi a wͻte nipadua mu a wͻye nsonsono tratraa a a wͻfrε noschistosome de ba. Dwensͻtwaa no anaa obi nsono ho betumi aba asεm. Nsεnkyerεnne no bi ne ayaase yaw , ayamtu , mogya a εwͻ agyanan mu , anaa mogya a εwͻ dwensͻ mu . Wͻn a wͻanya yare yi bere tenten betumi anya berεbo mu haw , asaabo mu haw , awo a εmma , anaa dwensͻ kotoku mu kokoram  Wͻ mmofra mu no, ebetumi ama wͻrennyin papa ne adesua mu haw .

Yare no trεw denam nsu a εwͻ mmoawa no a εka obi. Mmoawa yi fi nsu mu nwaw a wͻwͻ mmoawa yi mu. Yare yi abu so wͻ mmofra a wͻwͻ aman a ehia wͻn mu esiane sε mmofra yi taa di agoru wͻ nsu a mmoawa yi wom mu. Afoforo a wotumi nya bi ne akuafo, apofofo, ne afoforo a wͻde nsu yi di dwuma.Yare yi wͻ yare a nsonsono de ba .Wͻnam nsonsono yi nkesua a wͻhwehwε wͻ obi dwensͻ anaa agyanan mu na εyε yare yi mu nhwehwεmu. Wobetumi nso ahu denam nipaduam nnuru a εko yare mu a wͻhwehwε wͻ mogya mu.

Akwan a wͻfa so siw yare yi kwan bi ne nsu a emu tew a wͻde di dwuma ne nsu mu nwaw a wokum wͻn. Wͻ mmeae a yare yi abu so no, aduru praziquantel yε nea wobetumi de ama nnipakuw no. Wͻyε eyi de tew nipa a wͻanya yare yi dodow so, na εnam so asiw yare no trεw ano. Praziquantel ne aduru a Wiase Akwanhosan Ahyehyεde (WHO) akamfo de akyerε.

Nipa bεyε ͻpepem ahanu ne du na wonyaa nsu mu nwaw atiridii(schistosomiasis) wͻ wiase nyinaa wͻ afe 2012 mu.  Nipa bεyε mpem dumien kosi mpem ahanu na wͻfa mu wu afe biara. Yare yi abu so wͻ Afrika, Asia ne Amεrika Anafo. Nipa bεyε ͻpepem ahansͻn wͻ aman bεboro aduosͻn na wͻtete mmeae a yare yi abu so mu. Wͻ aman a ͻhyew wom no, nsu mu nwaw atiridii na edi atiridii(ntontom de) akyi wͻ nyarewa a εtete saa mu a εde sikasεm haw ba. Wͻakyerε sε nsu mu nwaw atiridii(schistosomiasis) yε yare a wͻabu ani agu so .

title: Nyansa nni obiakofo ti mu
text:
Mmere bi, Kwaku Ananse faa nyansa se ope se odi obiara so na watumi asisi won agye won nneema afi won nsam a wonnhu ho hwee. Eyi nti ode mmrada ne nnaadaa gyigyee nnipa ne mmoa nyinaa nyansa na ode hyee kuku bi mu kyekyeree ano dendeenden senea ebeye a ebi rentumi mmpue.

Afei, oyee n'adwene ne se ode kuku a nyansa wo mu no beforo akosi dua nkon mu baabi a obiara rentumi nhu nkofa.  Ode kuku no kyekyeree ne kon mu fii ase de foroo dua tenten bi.  Oboo mmoden foroo kakra duu baabi, na afei aye den ama no a onhu nea onye.

Otare dua no ho rebre saa no, otee nne bi fi nwura no mu se "Papa, se wode kuku no sen w'akyi a anka wobetumi aforo dua no ntem."  Ananse tee no ode ahoohare dan n'ani hwee nea orekasa no.  Ommehwe a ne ba Ntikuma!  Eyi maa Ananse huu see wantumi annye nyansa no nyinaa.

Ode abofuw ne animguase yii kuku no tow kyenee maa nyansa a ewo mu no nyinaa pue kohyehyee omanfo no nyinaa tim.  Eno nti na nyansa wo obiara tim no.

title: Nyansahufoɔ
text:
Nyansahu yɛ mmɔdenbɔ a ɛyɛ katee, nhyehyɛe a ɛkyekye na ɛhyehyɛ nimdeɛ wɔ nkyerɛkyerɛmu ne nkɔmhyɛ ahorow a wotumi sɔ hwɛ a ɛfa amansan no ho. Wɔtaa kyekyɛ nnɛyi nyansahu mu ayɛ no nkorabata atitiriw abiɛsa:abɔde ho nyansahu (e.g., abɔde a nkwa wom, nnuruyɛ, ne abɔde mu nneɛma ho adesua), a ɛsua abɔde mu wiase; asetena mu nyansahu (e.g., sikasɛm, adwene ne asetra ho adesua), a ɛsua ankorankoro ne aman ho ade;ne nyansahu a wɔde di dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfata so (e.g., ntease, akontaabu, ne kɔmputa ho nyansahu a wɔde susuw nneɛma ho), a ɛsua nhyehyɛe a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ, a axioms ne mmara ahorow.Wɔn adwene nhyia sɛ nyansahu a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ no yɛ nyansahu mu nteɛso,efisɛ wɔmfa wɔn ho nto adanse a wonya fi osuahu mu so.Nyansahu a wɔde di dwuma yɛ nteɛso a wɔde nyansahu mu nimdeɛ di dwuma de yɛ nneɛma a mfaso wɔ so, te sɛ mfiridwuma ne nnuruyɛ mu.

Nyansahufoɔ yɛ obi a ɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu de ma nimdeɛ kɔ anim wɔ abɔdeɛ ho nyansahu fã bi mu.

Nyansahufo Abakɔsɛm 

"Obiara nni anibuei abakɔsɛm mu a wasiesie yɛn ntease a yɛwɔ wɔ nyansahu ne abɔde mu nyansapɛ ho sen Helani nyansapɛfo ne nyansahufo kɛse Aristotle (384-322 A.Y.B.), a onyaa nkɛntɛnso a emu dɔ na ɛtrɛw bɛboro mfe mpem abien" —Gary B .Ferngrenna ɔte saa.

Nnipa pii bu Alessandro Volta a ɔyɛɛ anyinam ahoɔden batere na ohuu methane no sɛ nyansahufo a wɔsen biara wɔ abakɔsɛm mu no mu biako.

Mary Somerville, a wɔde asɛmfua "nyansahufo" maa no.

Francesco Redi a wɔfrɛ no "nnɛyi mmoawa a wɔsɛe nnɔbae ho agya" no ne nea ɔhyehyɛɛ abɔde a nkwa wom dwumadie.

Albert Einstein na ɔyɛɛ relativity ho nsusuwii a ɛkɔ akyiri no na ɔboaa nneɛma pii wɔ abɔde mu nneɛma ho nimdeɛ mu.

Wɔkyerɛ sɛ abɔde mu nneɛma ho nimdefo Enrico Fermi na ɔyɛɛ atom topae ne nuklea afiri a edi kan wɔ wiase.

Atɔm abɔde mu nneɛma ho nimdefo Niels Bohr boaa nneɛma atitiriw ma wɔtee atom nhyehyɛe ne quantum nsusuwii ase.

Po mu Abɔde a Nkwa Wom Ho Ɔbenfo Rachel Carsonno fii afeha a ɛto so 20 mu nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia ho kuw no ase.

Bɛbia Mmoa Efiri

title: Obuasi Nsanonnuma Ntoaso Sukuu
text:
Obuasi  Nsanonnuma Ntoaso Sukuu yɛ  sukuu a ɛyɛ nsanonnuma ne ntoaso sukuu wɔ Obuasi a ɛwɔ Asante Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. ɛnkyɛe biaa na sukuu nu nyaa nkɔanim wc cman nkuntabuo ne abodie mu nyansapɛ  akansie mu. Sukuu no dii nkunim wɔ Asante mantam bɔɔl bɔ akansie wɔ afe 2005 ne afe 2015 mu. ɛfa sukuu ahoro akansie a ɛfa mmirekatuo ho nso no, w'adi nkunim mpɛn pii. Sukuufoɔ no nso ɛyɛɛ  totrowa a yɛ de nwura gu mu a yɛnfa yɛn ho nka, a wɔde ku tia COVID-19.

Biom nso, sukuu nu yɛ  sukuu a edi kan a edii nkunim wɔ Maiden Sci-Tech Innovation akansie wɔ afe 2021.

title: Ona Batlle
text:
Ona Batlle Pascual (wɔwoo no 10 Ayɛwohomumɔ 1999) yɛ Spain bɔɔlbɔfoɔ a ɔyɛ adwumaden a ɔbɔ sɛ full-back ma Engiresi Mmea Super League kuo Manchester United ne Spain ɔman kuo.

Wɔwoo Ona Batlle Pascual wɔ 10 June 1999 wɔ Vilassar de Mar, kurow bi a ɛwɔ Barcelona mantam mu, na ofii ase ne Vilassar de Mar bɔɔ bɔɔl Wɔ afe 2011 mu no, FC Barcelona hwehwɛɛ no bere a wɔne Catalonia a wonnii mfe 12 dii agoru no ekuo. Ɔde ne ho bɔɔ FC Barcelona mmabun nhyehyɛeɛ La Masia na ɔnyaa nkɔsoɔ wɔ dibea no mu, na ɔnyaa nkɔanim kɔɔ Barcelona B, Barcelona mmabun kuo a ɛkorɔn a wɔdii agorɔ wɔ Segunda División mu, wɔ afe 2014. Wɔ 9 Ɔbɛnem 2016 no, wɔfrɛɛ Batlle kɔɔ ekuo a ɛdi kan no mu na na ɔyɛ obi a wɔmfaa nsi ananmu wɔ Barcelona Champions League agodie a wɔne FC Twente dii no mu.

Wɔ afe 2017 ahohuru berɛ mu no, Barcelona sesaa wɔn adwene kɔɔ sɛ wɔbɛfa agofoɔ mpaninfoɔ a wɔagye din, na ɛmaa ɛyɛɛ den maa mmabun agofoɔ sɛ wɔbɛtumi akɔ kuo a ɛdi kan no mu. Batlle yɛ La Masia agodifo baason a wofii hɔ wɔ awɔw bere mu kɔhwehwɛɛ mpanyimfo kuw a edi kan hokwan ahorow akyi ne akuw afoforo no mu biako. Bere a ɔrekɔ no, Batlle kae sɛ ɔrennye ntom sɛ ɔbɛsan akɔ kuw a "ɛhyehyɛɛ no" no mu.

Madrid CFF 
Batlle de ne nsa hyɛɛ Madrid CFF ase wɔ July 2017 mu, na ɛno ne deɛ ɛdi kan a wɔde wɔn nsa hyɛɛ aseɛ wɔ kuro no mu wɔ wɔn nkɔanim a wɔkɔɔ Primera División akyi. Ɔdii kan yɛɛ ne senior debut wɔ club no Primera División akansi a ɛdi kan no mu, sɛ obi a ɔde ne ho sii Laura del Río ananmu wɔ fã bere mu wɔ 1-1 a wɔne Levante dii mu. Batlle sii ne gyinabea sɛ obi a ɔhyɛ aseɛ wɔ afe no mu, ɔdii agorɔ wɔ 28 mu wɔ 30 league matches a 26 starts ka ho berɛ a Madrid CFF baa wɔn Primera División ɔsatuo a ɛdi kan no mfimfini pon so wɔ beaeɛ a ɛtɔ so du.

Levante 
Bere a ɔne Madrid dii bere biako akyi no, Batlle de ne nsa hyɛɛ Levante ase wɔ June 2018. Nanso, ansa na bere no refi ase no, Batlle pirapirae wɔ FIFA U-20 World Cup wɔ August mu, na ɛmaa ne bere a edi kan a ɔde bɛkɔ kurow no mu no kyɛe. Awiei koraa no ɔyɛɛ ne Levante anim a edi kan sɛ obi a ɔde ne ho besi ananmu wɔ nkonim a odii 3–2 wɔ abɔnten wɔ kan kurow Madrid CFF so wɔ 5 December 2018. Batlle bɔɔ ne Primera División bɔɔl a edi kan wɔ nkonim a odii wɔ Logroño so 4–2 wɔ 22 December 2018. Wɔ 24 June 2020 mu no, Batlle de asɛm bi too gua sɛ ɔrennyɛ ne kontrata a ɔne Levante yɛ no foforo na mmom ɔbɛbɛyɛ free agent. Ɔkɔɔ so yɛɛ agodifo 17 no mu biako wɔ kuw asɛm bi a wɔde kɔdan Mmea Bɔɔlbɔ Kuw Fekuw (ACFF) ne Spain Bɔɔlbɔ Agodifo Fekuw (AFE) saa bere no mu, na ogyee Akatua Nhoma a wɔde bedi dwuma a ɛbɛma sika a ɛho hia ma no ayɛ kɛse no ho akyinnye Primera División afoforo sɛ wɔmfa wɔn nsa nhyɛ agodifo a wɔakyekyɛ wɔn nsa sɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho. Wɔde €500,000 sii hɔ sɛ Batlle akatua.

Manchester United 
Wɔ 13 July 2020 no, Batlle de ne nsa hyɛɛ mfeɛ mmienu apam ase a na ɔwɔ hokwan sɛ ɔbɛnya nea ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa ne English FA WSL kuo Manchester United. Ɔdii kan yɛɛ ne debut wɔ 6 September 2020, ɔfirii aseɛ wɔ season opener mu berɛ a United ne defending champions Chelsea bɔɔ 1–1. Sɛ wɔka ne nyinaa bom a, Batlle yii ne ho adi wɔ United agodie 27 no mu 23 mu wɔ bere no mu na wɔbɔɔ no din sɛ Mmea Agodifo a Ɔsen Biara wɔ Afe no mu wɔ ɔsatu no awiei. Wɔ league agodie a ɛdi kan wɔ 2021–22 berɛ no mu no, Batlle bɔɔ ne botaeɛ a ɛdi kan maa kuro no wɔ nkonimdie 2-0 a wɔdii wɔ Reading so. Ɔdii agorɔ 21 wɔ league mu wɔ 2021–22 ɔsatuo no mu na wɔgyee no toom wɔ PFA Team of the Year anuonyam.

Batlle agyina Spain ananmu wɔ under-17, under-19 ne under-20 level a nea ɛka ho ne mmabun akansi akɛseɛ anum: UEFA Women’s Under-17 Championship editions mmienu (2015 ne 2016), 2016 FIFA U-17 Women’s World Cup, 2017 UEFA Mmea a wonnii mfeɛ 19 akansi ne 2018 FIFA U-20 Mmea Wiase Kupɔn.

Spain dii nkonim wɔ afe 2015 UEFA Mmea a wonnii mfeɛ 17 akansi mu, na wɔdii Switzerland so nkonim 5–2 wɔ awieɛ no mu. Batlle fii ase wɔ agodie anum a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ akansi no mu no mu anan mu. Wɔwieeɛ sɛ wɔn a wɔdii kan wɔ afe 2016 no mu, wɔdii nkoguo wɔ Germany wɔ asotweɛ mu wɔ awieɛ no mu. Batlle fii agodie biara ase maa Spain wɔ akansi no mu. Nea efii mu bae no maa Spain fatae wɔ 2016 FIFA U-17 Mmea Wiase Kupɔn no mu. Batlle fii ase dii agoru asia no mu anum a knockout round no nyinaa ka ho bere a Spain dii nea ɛto so abiɛsa, na wɔhweree Japan wɔ semi-finals ansa na wɔredi Venezuela so nkonim wɔ playoff a ɛto so abiɛsa no mu.

Wɔ July 2017 mu no, Pedro López paw Batlle sɛ ɔmmɛgyina Spain ananmu wɔ 2017 UEFA Mmea a wonnii mfeɛ 19 akansi no mu. Spain dii nkonim wɔ akansi no mu denam bere a wɔde gyinaa hɔ bɔɔl a Patricia Guijarro de bɔɔ France so. Batlle san fii agodie biara ase wɔ akansi no mu na na ɔyɛ Spainfo agodifo baason a wɔpaw wɔn sɛ wɔnkɔ akansi no kuw no mu no mu biako. Nea efii mu bae no nso maa Spain faata maa 2018 FIFA U-20 Mmea Wiase Kupɔn no. Batlle kowiee bɔɔlbɔ biako pɛ wɔ Wiase Kupɔn no mu, na opirae bere a ɔne Paraguay dii wɔ akansi a edi kan a ɛde ne akansi no baa awiei no mu. Mfɛfo kuw no muni Patricia Guijarro hyiraa ne botae a ɔde bɔɔ United States so maa Batlle denam n’atade a ɔmaa so maa mfoninitwa afiri no ne akyidifo no so. Spain wiee sɛ nea ɛto so abien, na wɔdii nkogu 3-1 wɔ Japan anim wɔ nea etwa to no mu.

Wɔ 17 May 2019 no, Batlle yɛɛ ne senior debut wɔ adamfofa akansi a ɔne Cameroon dii mu, na ɔde Eunate Arraiza sii ananmu wɔ fã bere mu. Wogyaw no wɔ agodifo 23 a wɔbɛkɔ 2019 FIFA Mmea Wiase Kupɔn no mu nnansa akyi.

Wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2020 mu no, wɔfrɛɛ Batlle kɔɔ Spain kuw no mu maa ne mpanyimfo amanaman ntam akansi hokwan a edi kan, 2020 SheBelieves Kuruwa. Ɔhyɛɛ akansi no mu akansi abien a edi kan ase, nkonim a odii wɔ Japan so 3–1 ne nkogu ketewaa bi 1–0 wɔ Wiase Nkonimdifo United States a na ɛredi tumi no so bere a Spain wiee nea ɛto so abien wɔ wɔn SheBelieves a edi kan no mu.

title: Rabies
text:
This article should be merged with Kraman a ͻwͻ ne yare no a anya nkͻanim

Rabies yɛ yare bi a ɛma obi adwene yɛ kɛse wɔ nnipa anaa mmoa afoforo mu.  Ne mfitiase no, ɛba te sɛ ne obi anya atiridii. Eyi ba saa akyi a, eyinom betumi adi akyi aba: nkekaho basabasa, anigye mmoroso, nsu ho suro, ne afei nnipadua no afa horow a obi ntumi nfa nyɛ adwuma,  Ɛbere a eyi nyinaa asi no, mpɛn pii no, onii a ɔte saa taa wu. Efi bere a obi benya saa yare no, de kosi bere a ɛho nsunsuanso bɛda adi no tumi di bɛyɛ bosome mmiɛnsa, nanso, saa bere no tumi sesa: etumi yɛ nnawotwe baak, anaa mpo afe biako. Ɛbere dodow a edi no gyina bere tenten a ebedi ansa na yare no atumi akodu obi akyi nnompe mu.

Nea ɛde rabies ba ne lyssaviruses a rabbies mmoawa ne Australian bat lyssavirus kaho. Nea ɛma Rabbies trɛw ne bere a aboa a ɔwɔ yare no de ho aka obi anaa woaka obi no. Ntasu a efi aboa a ɔwɔ saa yare no betumi ama rabies mmoawa no akɔ obi hɔ. Ne nyinaa mu no, nkraman na wɔtaa nya saa yare no. Bɛboro 99% rabbies a esi nyinaa no fi nkraman. Wɔ Americas no, ampan na wɔtaa de Rabies no ba, na nea esua sen 5% de, nkraman na ɛde ba. Rodents nso, ɛtɔ mmere bi a, wotumi nya rabbies no bi. Rabies yare no kɔ aboa no adwene mu denam ne ntini ahorow no mu. Wɔhu yare no bere a ada ne ho adi no nkoaa.

title: Robyn Lambird
text:
Robyn Lambird (wɔwoo no Ɔbɛnem 19, 1997) yɛ Australiani mmubuafo akongua mmirikatufo ne mfoniniyɛfo a ɔwɔ amemene mu yare. Wɔnyaa kɔbere nkonimboɔ wɔ Mmea 100m T34 mu wɔ 2020 Ahuhuro Paralympics mu, wɔbɛyɛɛ Paralympian a ɔnyɛ binary a ɔdi kan a ɔdii nkonim de kaa sɛ ɔkaa agumadifoɔ mmiɛnsa a wɔdii kan a wɔnyɛ binary a wɔsii akan wɔ Paralympics no ho.

Nasetra 
Wɔwoo Robyn Lambird wɔ Ɔbɛnem 19, 1997. Wɔwoo Robyn wɔ England nanso otu kɔɔ Perth, Australia Atɔe fam bere a na wadi mfe akron. Wohui sɛ wɔwɔ amemene mu yare bere a na wɔadi mfe akron na wɔyɛɛ wɔn oprehyɛn de trɛw wɔn akyi ntini ne wɔn achilles ntini mu.

Lambird yɛ mfonini na ɔno ne onipa a odi kan a ɔte mmubuafo akongua mu a wɔdaa no adi wɔ Target ɔsatu ahorow a wɔde hyɛ ntade a ɛyɛ nnam no biako mu. Wɔayɛ mfonini ama Tommy Hilfiger, Bonds, ne ModiBodi.

Lambird nyɛ binary na ɔde wɔn/wɔn ne ɔno/ne edinnsiananmu di dwuma.

Wɔde Lambird ato hɔ sɛ T34. Wɔdii mmubuafoɔ akongua rugby ne mmubuafoɔ akongua basketball ansa na wɔrefa Para-athletics wɔ afe 2016. Wɔ 2018 World Para-athletics Grand Prix a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Nottwil, Switzerland no, wɔdii deɛ ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ Mmea 100m T34 mu na wɔdii anan wɔ Mmea 200m T34 mu.

Wɔ 2019 World Para Athletics Championships no, Lambird dii anum wɔ Mmea 100m T34 mu. Wɔdii nkonim wɔ Mmea 100m T34 mu wɔ 2020 Summer Paralympics mu de bere a ɛyɛ sikani 18.68, na wɔbɛyɛɛ Paralympian a ɔnyɛ binary a ɔdi kan a ɔdii nkonim. Wɔka agumadifo baasa a wodii kan fii mu a wɔnyɛ agumadifo abien a wosii akan wɔ Paralympics mu no ho, na wɔka Maz Strong ne Laura Goodkind ho.

Wɔ afe 2022 Commonwealth Agumadi mu no, wɔdii 4 wɔ Mmea 100m T34 mu.

title: Rossella Inverni
text:
Rossella Inverni (wɔwoo no 22 April 1962 Cittadella) yɛ Italiani Paralympic agumadifo a n’ani afura. Ogyinaa Italy ananmu wɔ Awɔw Bere mu Paralympic Agumadi no mu, na onyaa dwetɛ nkonimbo abiɛsa ne kɔbere abiɛsa. Wɔmaa no 1990 Michelangelo abasobɔde.

Adwuma 
Wɔ 1984 Awɔw Bere mu Paralympic Agumadi a wɔyɛe wɔ New York , mu no, Rossella nyaa dwetɛ nkonimbo wɔ mita 800 B1 mu, ne kɔbere nkonimbo wɔ mita 400 B1 mu. Odii nea ɛto so du-baako wɔ Mmea mita 100 mmirikatu B1 mu.

Wɔ 1988 Awɔw Bere mu Paralympic Agumadi a wɔyɛe wɔ Seoul mu no, onyaa nkonimbo anan, dwetɛ abien (mita 800, ne mita 1500 B1) ne kɔbere nkonimbo abien (mita 100 B1, ne mita 400).

Wɔ 1985 mu no, ɔde ne ho hyɛɛ Europa akansi a wɔyɛe wɔ Rome no mu, na onyaa kɔbere wɔ mita 800 ne 1500 mmirikatu mu; wɔ 1987 mu no, ɔwɔ Europa akansi a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Cadiz ne 1989 mu no, ɔwɔ Europa akansi a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Zurich , faako a onyaa sika kɔkɔɔ wɔ mita 400 mmirikatu mu, ne dwetɛ wɔ mita 100 mu.

Wɔ 1986 wiase akansi mu, wɔ Gothenburg no, onyaa sika kɔkɔɔ nkonimbo wɔ mita 400 mmirikatu mu. Ɔsan nso nyaa dwetɛ wɔ mita 1500 mu, ne kɔbere wɔ mita 800 mu. Awiei koraa no, wɔ Assen wɔ afe 1990 mu no, Rossella yɛɛ wiase akansifo wɔ mita 200 ne 400 mu, na onyaa dwetɛ nkonimbo wɔ mita 100 mmirikatu mu.

Ɔde ne ho hyɛɛ ɔman no akansi a wɔyɛe wɔ Rome wɔ 1985 mu no mu, na onyaa sika kɔkɔɔ wɔ mita 100 ne 400 mmirikatu mu; ɔsan kaa nea efii mu bae yi wɔ akansi ahorow a edidi so yi mu wɔ Milan 1986, Palermo 1987, Florence 1988, Vigna di Valle 1989, ne Tirrenia 1990 mu.

title: Sandra Opoku
text:
Sandra Opoku yɛ Ghanani mmaranimfo. Wɔ afe 2019 bre a Nanan Addo Dankwa Akuffo-Addo  paw no sɛ n’adwumayeni no, ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔbaa a odikan a wɔfaa no sɛ Tema Po so hyɛn gyinabea no kandifo. Kane na ɔyɛ ɔhwɛfo ma Tema Po so hyɛn gyinabea mmaranimfo kuo no.

Adesua ho nsem 
Opoku kɔɔ ntoaso sukuu a ne din St. Roses Senior High a ɛwɔ Akwatia wɔ Apuei Mantam mu, maa no nyaa abodn kraa a ɛne O Level wɔ afe 1992 na afei, A Level wɔ afe 1994 mu. Bre a na ɔwɔ sukuu mu no, na ɔnɔ na ɔhwɛ nhyehyɛe ne aduane so. Owie St. Roses no, onyaa akwanya kosuaa mmaranim wɔ Ghana Suapon a wɔfrɛ no University of Ghana. ɔtoa so kɔɔ Ghana mmranimfo sukuu a wɔfrɛ no Ghana School of Law ma wɔtoo nsa frɛ no ma no kɔkaa Ghana mmaranimfo nkabom kuo a wɔfrɛ no Ghana Bar association no ho wɔ afe 2001.  Wɔ afe 2004 mu no, onyaa akwanya kɔɔ Sukuupon a wɔfrɛ no International Maritime Law institute a ɛwɔ Malta, ma no nyaa nimdeɛ wɔ ɛpo so dwadie mmra ho.

Nnuma ho nsem 
Opoku hyɛɛ n’adwuma ase wɔ adwumakuo a wɔfrɛ no Ghana Ports and Harbours Authority wɔ afe 2003 mu. Efiri hɔ no,  w’ayɛ adwuma ama wɔn sɛ lɔyani, ɔhwɛfo a ɔda mmara ntotoe ano ne ɔkyerɛwfo ama Ghana Ports and Harbours Authority. Sesei, ɔno na Nana Addo Dankwa Akuffo-Addo apaw no  sɛ kandifo a ɔda Tema Po so hyɛn gyinabea wɔ march bosome no mu, afe 2019 bre a Edward Kofi Osei afiri hɔ no.

Ne ho nsem 
Opoku ye Presbyni. ɔyɛ owarefo a ɔwɔ mmofra miensa.

title: Sandra Paños
text:
Sandra Paños García-Villamil (wɔwoo no 4 Ɔbɛnem 1992) yɛ Spain bɔɔlbɔfoɔ a ɔyɛ adwumaden a ɔbɔ sɛ bɔɔlbɔfoɔ ma Barcelona ne Spain ɔman kuo. Mprempren Paños yɛ Barcelona captain a ɔto so abiɛsa.

Wɔ Barcelona no, Paños adi nkonim wɔ apam mu nkonimdi abien, Copas de la Reina abiɛsa, ne UEFA Mmea Champions League, a nea etwa to no dii nkonim wɔ 2020–21 bere mu sɛ Barcelona asasepɔn so abiɛsa a edi kan no fã. Wɔ amanaman ntam no, wagyina Spain ananmu wɔ akansi akɛseɛ mmiɛnsa mu- 2015 FIFA Mmea Wiase Kupɔn, 2017 UEFA Mmea Euro, ne 2019 FIFA Mmea Wiase Kupɔn.

A Paños anya Zamora Trophies anan a ɛsen biara, abasobɔde a wɔde ma bɔɔlbɔfo a ɔbɔ bɔɔl kakraa bi wɔ Primera Division bere bi mu.

Wɔwoo Sandra Paños García-Villamil wɔ 4 Ɔbɛnem 1992, na ne maame ne Luis Ernesto Paños ne Gemma García-Villamil. Paños fii ase bɔɔ bɔɔl sɛ bɔɔlbɔfo bere a na gyinabea bi da mpan wɔ bɔɔlbɔ mu ma ne futsal kuw no. Kan no na ne papa bɔ bɔɔl ma Hércules wɔ 1980 mfe no mu.

Wɔ 4 June 2015 no, Paños bɔɔ bɔɔl a ɛdi kan ne baako pɛ wɔ n’adwuma mu denam free-kick a ɔfirii mfimfini wɔ Espanyol so.

Barcelona (2015– Seesei) 
Bere a odii mfe aduonu mmienu (22) no, Paños tu fii Levante kɔɔ Barcelona wɔ 2015 FIFA Mmea Wiase Kupɔn no akyi, awɔw bere a Catalan kuw no maa wɔn mmea kuw no yɛɛ adwumaden no. Wɔ ne Champions League bere a edi kan mu no, wɔbɔɔ Panos din sɛ UEFA Mmea Champions League Kuw a ɛsen biara wɔ afe no mu, Barcelona bɔɔlbɔfo a odi kan a ɔyɛɛ saa. Ɔno nso na onyaa ne Zamora Trophy a edi kan.

Wɔ afe 2017–18 berɛ mu wɔ Barcelona no, ɔnyaa ne Zamora Trophy a ɛtɔ so mmienu sɛ ɔbɔɔ bɔɔl 12 pɛ wɔ league akansi 26 mu. Paños ne Laura Ràfols kyekyɛɛ bɔɔlbɔ adwuma kɔsii sɛ Ràfols kɔhyɛɛ pɛnhyen wɔ afe 2018. Afe a ɛdi Ràfols kɔeɛ akyi no, ɔfaa captaincy dwumadie nea ɛdi kan wɔ blaugrana na wɔbɔɔ no din sɛ club no captain a ɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa. Wɔ afe 2019 mu no, wɔmaa Paños ne Zamora Trophy abasobɔdeɛ a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa, ɔmaa n’ankasa botaeɛ 11 a ɛyɛ papa wɔ 2018–19 league berɛ no mu. Wɔ 2019–20 berɛ no mu no, ne dwumadie sɛ captain no so tew kɔɔ captain a ɔtɔ so nnan berɛ a Alexia Putellas yɛɛ ahurututu no kɔɔ captain a ɔtɔ so mmienu.

Wɔ afe 2020 mu, ɛnam sɛ afe 2019–20 league bere no baa awiei ntɛm esiane COVID-19 ɔyaredɔm nti no, wɔmaa Paños ne Zamora Trophy a ɛto so anan, dodow a ɛsen biara. Saa bere no, ɔmaa n’ankasa bɔɔl 0.26 a eye sen biara wɔ agoru biara mu.

Wɔ UEFA Women’s Champions League no quarterfinals mu no, Paños gyee asotwe bi fii Manchester City’s Chloe Kelly nsam na ɔkyerɛw krataa a ɛho tew wɔ nkonimdi 3-0 mu. Wɔ May 2021 mu no, Paños trɛw ne Barcelona apam mu kɔɔ June 2024. Nna bi akyi a ɔde too gua sɛ wɔatrɛw ne kontrata mu no, ofii Champions League awiei a ɛto so abien ase wɔ n’adwuma mu na ɔkyerɛw krataa a ɛho tew wɔ Chelsea so, bere a kuw no dii nkonim wɔ akansi no mu 4-0. Wɔbɔɔ Paños din sɛ 2020-21 UEFA Mmea Champions League Kuw a ɛsen biara wɔ afe no mu, na akyiri yi onyaa 2020-21 UEFA Mmea Champions League bɔɔlbɔfo a ɔsen biara wɔ afe no mu abasobɔde. Wɔ afe 2020-21 league bere no awiei no, na wagye bɔɔl 12 a eye sen biara wɔ league no mu. Nanso Paños mfata sɛ odi nkonim wɔ Zamora Trophy no mu, efisɛ opirapiraa n’asen wɔ October 2020 mu a ɛmaa ontumi nni agoru asram abiɛsa, na anyɛ yiye koraa no wanwie wɔ akansi 28 mu.

Paños san kɔɔ ne dwumadie sɛ Barcelona captain a ɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa ansa na 2021–22 berɛ no reba, berɛ a daa captain Vicky Losada tu kɔɔ Manchester City. Wɔ Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 2021 mu no, wɔbɔɔ ne din sɛ obi a wɔayi no sɛ ɔnkɔ 2021 Ballon d'or. Wɔ Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 31 no, Paños dii agorɔ wɔ ne akansi a ɛtɔ so aduonu mu maa Barcelona wɔ akansi nyinaa mu berɛ a n’afã no dii nkonim 8–1 wɔ Real Sociedad so.

Ɔno ne bɔɔlbɔfoɔ a wɔdii kan paw no wɔ 2009 U-17 Euro ne 2010 ne 2011 U-19 Euros mu.

Wɔ September 2011 mu no, wɔfrɛɛ no kɔɔ Spain ɔman kuw a wɔanyinyin no mu nea edi kan, na ɔde no sii María José Pons a na wapira no ananmu. Asram anum akyi no odii kan dii agoru wɔ adamfofa akansi bi a ɔne Austria dii mu. Na ɔka Spain kuw no ho wɔ 2015 FIFA Mmea Wiase Kupɔn no mu, faako a na ɔyɛ Spain bɔɔlbɔfo a ɔto so abiɛsa.

Efi bere a Jorge Vilda faa ɔman kuw no wɔ afe 2017 mu no, Paños ayɛ obi a ɔde ne ho hyɛ Spain daa. Ɔhyɛɛ Spain akansi anan no mu biara ase wɔ UEFA Mmea Euro 2017 mu, na ɔyɛɛ kuw no panyin wɔ wɔn Kuw D akansi a etwa to a wɔne Scotland dii no mu. Spain kɔɔ quarterfinals nanso woyii wɔn fii mu wɔ penalty shoot-out a Austria de mae mu, na wɔbɔɔ wɔn penalty 5 no nyinaa.

Ɛmfa ho sɛ ɔne Lola Gallardo dii akɔneaba wɔ botaeɛ mu wɔ ɔhyeɛ akansiɛ mu maa 2019 FIFA Mmea Wiase Kupɔn no, Paños hyɛɛ Spain akansi anan no nyinaa ase wɔ akansi a ɛtwa toɔ no mu. Spain kɔɔ anim kɔɔ Mmea Wiase Kupɔn mu knockout round nea edi kan wɔ wɔn abakɔsɛm mu, na wohyiaa United States wɔ Round of 16. Paños hyiaa asotwe abien, a Megan Rapinoe na ɔbɔɔ abien no nyinaa, na United States dii nkonim wɔ akansi no mu 2–1.

Abusua 
Ne nuabarima Javi nso yɛ bɔɔlbɔfo.

title: Sarah Will
text:
Sarah Will yɛ obi a ɔde mmirika tu mmirika wɔ ski so a ɔde mfe 11 yɛɛ adwuma wɔ U.S. Disabled Ski Team no mu. Saa bere yi mu no, onyaa nkonimbo 13 a ɛsen biara (sika kɔkɔɔ 12, dwetɛ 1) bere a osii akan wɔ Awɔw Bere mu Paralympic Agumadi anan mu wɔ 1992 ne 2002 ntam no. Wɔbɔɔ ne din sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ United States Olympic Hall of Fame wɔ Kutawonsa 2009 mu na ɔsan yɛ ɔman no muni U.S. Ski ne Snowboard Asa a Ɛgye Din.

Will som sɛ akwannya ho ɔfotufo, baguam ɔkasafo na ɔyɛ ahɔho kyerɛkyerɛfo a ɔyɛ nsakrae wɔ wiase nyinaa. Sarah yɛ obi a ɔkamfo nnipa a wɔadi dɛm wɔ Vail mpɔtam hɔ.

Ɔyɛɛ obubuafo wɔ 1988 mu wɔ akwanhyia bi a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ skiing mu.

Bere a Will gyaee akansi no, ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ nkyerɛkyerɛmufo maa ESPN XGames. Sarah nso yɛɛ nkyerɛkyerɛmufoɔ maa NBC Universal Sports a ɛkaa Paralympic agodie a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Vancouver, BC ne agodie a ɛdidi soɔ yi ho asɛm wɔ Sochi, Russia.

title: Se eka ani a na aka hwene
text:
Ohenkese bi tenaa ase a na owo mmoa ne agyapade ne nkoa pii nanso na owo babea biako pe. Ne saa nti na onni ne ho agoru koraa. Da biara a ohene nkoa ne ne mmoa no bedidi amee no na ato anigye ne ahurusidi wo ahenfi ho. Da biara anwumire a wobedidi awie no, afurum ba bi de anigye mmoroso huruwhuruw de ne ho yanam fam, tutu ne nan ko wim de ne nensa bobo nneema mu. Se eba no saa a na agyinamoa bi a owo ho no afre no atu no fo se onnyae nea oreye no na dabi ode asem beba. Otu no fo saa a na ode serew ne oyaw aka akyere no se, oye okuraseni nti onnim anigye. Ayinamoa kae, kae a wammua no no, oboo oguanten, abirekyi, nantwi, oponko, nkoko ne nkoa a won aka no nyinaa amanee se wontu afurum ba no fo na daakye ode asem beba. Won nyinaa nsem a na woka ne se Agyinamoa nwene ne ho, na woredwene won ho, enti se afurumba kofa asem biara ba a ono nko ara na obenya asem. Nanso nea na Agyinamoa tae ka ne se 'obi asem fa obi ho' afei nso esiane se won nyinaa bo abusua koro nti se won mu biara ho ka a obiara nso ho beka efise, 'se eka ani a na aka hwene'. Se oka saa a na obiara da no fam twee, na woreserew no. Se eba no saa a na Agyinamoa de n'asem akobutuw baabi dinn rehwe won.
Da koro anwumire a won adidi amee na obiara regye nani no, Afurum yi san soo n'agorubone yi mu bio. Ode ahuruwhuruw ne ne nan tutu ara, se na Ohene babea koro yi retwa mu, Afurum tuu ne nan biako na ohenebabea yi ayaase surudu. Mmogya na erepram ohene babea a orewu yi. Nkoa no de mmirika koboo ohene amanee. Omaa wokofaa oponko de no tenaa ne so koo ayaresabea. Woduu ho no na won apon nti womaa oponko tuu mmirika tente bi a ontuu bi da de ohene babea yi koo odunsini bi ho. Wodui no na ohene babea aye onyame dea. Na ese se oponko san turu no ba fie, na obedui no na ote nka se wabre ankasa.
Ohene somaa nkoa ne mponko no nyinaa kosee adofo ayi. Eyi no duu so no, na eho hia se wonoa aduan ma ahoho, nti woso oguanten mu a na sekan da ne menem, woso abirekyi mu a saa ara, nantwi ne nkoko nso ho kaa adwaa mu saa ara ma eyee awerehowsem wo fie ho. Na mmere a nkoa no renoa nnuan na woreye adwumaden no, Agyinamoa benn ho kae won nea mmere bi oka kyeree won se wontu Afurum fo no. na won nso wokae se eye nokware se, 'se eka ani a na aka whene'. Mmoadoma a wode won nkwa twaa so no nyinaa de dibem maa Agyinamoa nanso na aka akyi dedaw. Esiane se na anibre aba fie nti na obiara nni kwan a ode bema afurum aduan adi, mereka yi nso na won amantam no abo dua bi mu enti ontumi nko mma. Okom ne awerehow hyee ne so ma kosii se eduu nnanan a ayi no ho asem asi no na ono nso aye Nyame dea. Agyinamoa de awerehow kobutuw baabi dinn na okae se, 'eye ampa se, opanin tena fie ma mmofra we onanka na se worekan annankawefo a wokan no ka ho bi.'

title: Sheila Holzworth
text:
Sheila Holzworth (Ɔsanaa 28, 1961 – Oforisuo 29, 2013) yɛ Amerikani a ɔyɛ para-alpine skier. Bere a n’ani afura bere a na wadi mfe du no, ɔkɔɔ so nyaa sika kɔkɔɔ abien ne dwetɛ nkonimbo wɔ 1984 Awɔw Bere mu Paralympics akansi no mu sɛ United States ananmusifo no fã, ne nneɛma afoforo a otumi yɛe.

Wɔ 1981, Amanaman Ntam Mmubuafo Afe mu no, Holzworth ne ɔbea anifuraefo a odi kan a ɔforoo Bepɔw Rainier. Owiee foro no sɛ nnipa a wɔadi dɛm kuw bi fã.

Wɔ 1982 mu no, onyaa sika kɔkɔɔ wɔ slalom akɛse mu ne dwetɛ wɔ slalom mu wɔ ɔman no ski akansi a United States Anifuraefo Agumadifo Fekuw no yɛe no mu.

Holzworth nyaa sika kɔkɔɔ wɔ mmepɔw so skiing akansi abien mu, Women’s Giant Slalom B1 ne Women’s Alpine Combination B1, wɔ 1984 Awɔw Bere mu Paralympics no mu. Nea ɛka ho no, onyaa dwetɛ nkonimbo wɔ Women’s Downhill B1 mu. Ɔsan sii akan wɔ 1988 Awɔw Bere mu Paralympics akansi no mu.

Ɔsii akan na onyaa nkonimbo wɔ akansi afoforo pii mu, a Wiase Kupɔn Nkonimdi a ɛfa Awɔw Bere mu Agumadi a Wɔde Ma Mmofra a Wɔadi M dɛm a wɔyɛe wɔ Switzerland ne Ɔman Sukyerɛmma So Ski Akansi ne Amerika Anifuraefo Nsu So Ski Akansi wɔ 1983 mu, ne Amanaman Ntam Anifuraefo Nsu So Ski Akansi a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Norway wɔ 1984 mu ka ho. Ɔsan yɛɛ kyerɛwtohɔ afoforo, a nea ɛka ho ne wiase kyerɛwtohɔ a ɔyɛe wɔ anifuraefo ne mmubuafo a wɔde anifere tu mmirika wɔ nsu so wɔ 1989 mu, ne obi a odi kan a onhu ade a ohuruw faa nsu so ski so wɔ United States.

Onyaa Amerika Mmabun Du a Wɔda Nsow abasobɔde wɔ 1989. Ɔmampanyin Ronald Reagan ne George H. W. Bush too nsa frɛɛ no kɔɔ White House apontow ahorow ase wɔ mmere ahorow mu.

title: Shock site
text:
Shock website yɛ wɛbsaet a wɔayɛ sɛ ɛbɛma nsrahwɛfo pii ho adwiriw wɔn sɛnea wobetumi na wɔde yɛ agoru ahorow.

Nnyinasosɛm no ne sɛ wɔde mfonini anaa video, basabasayɛ, nguamansɛm, scatological, macabre anaa foforo bi bɛma fi kratafa a edi kan no so, a wɔammɔ kɔkɔ. Wɔahyehyɛ nsɛm a wɔde bɛma no sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ɛbɛma ahodwiriw ne ahodwiriw ayɛ kɛse. Ɛtɔ mmere bi a, wɔde nneɛma bi ka ho de hyɛ nsrahwɛfo a wɔkyeree no no aniwu, te sɛ nnyigyei a ɛtwetwe wɔn a wɔatwa wo ho ahyia no adwene anaasɛ mfɛnsere a wobue bere ano.

Prank a wɔde shock site di dwuma no taa yɛ sɛ wɔde hyperlink bɛma, wɔ e-mail anaa nkɔmmɔbɔ beae bi, denam hyperlink a wɔde bɛkɔ wɛbsaet no so denam nea wɔde bɛma sɛ hyperlink a wɔde kɔ wɛbsaet foforo so. Wɔde saa kwan yi di dwuma titiriw wɔ Slashdot nkɔmmɔbɔ beae no efisɛ ɛma ɛyɛ yiye sɛ wobɛdan asɛmfua biara ayɛ no link. Nanso, Slashdot wuranom asesa wɔn softwea no sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛda hyperlink bi wɛb address a wɔde rekɔ no adi. Eyi ma wɔyɛɛ redirects. Afei nso, nokwasɛm tiawa a ɛne sɛ wode asɛmfua bi bɛbata ho wɔ wɛbsaet a ɛma ahodwiriw so no betumi abɛyɛ aseresɛm afei.

Bere a na wonim no yiye no, wɔdan adwene no nso denam nkitahodi ahorow a wɔde siee mmeae a “ɛko tia ahodwiriw” so, na wɔde nhwiren nketewa anaa nea ɛtete saa mfonini ahorow a ɛyɛ fɛ kyerɛe.

Nhwɛso a wonim no yiye a ɛfa shock site ho ne goatse.cx, a ɛde parodies, ahwehwɛ, ne support sites pii aba. Wɔgyaee saa beaeɛ yi wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2004. Nnansa yi ara, wɔato beaeɛ a ɛyɛ ahodwirideɛ a wɔfrɛ no Bestgore no mu koraa firi November 15, 2020.

Adwumakuw a edi kan wɔ Switzerland a wɔayɛ wɛbsaet ahorow a site web choc

title: Sika Osei
text:

title: Solomon Kuyon
text:
Solomon Kuyon (wɔwoo no 28 Ɔbɛnem 1975) yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɛfo. Ɔyɛ Ghana Aman a Ɛto so Anan no Mmarahyɛ Bagua a Ɛto so Nwɔtwe no muni a ogyina Krachi Nchumuru Mantam a ɛwɔ Krachi Nchumuru Mantam mu wɔ Oti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ná ɔyɛ Krachi Nchumuru mantam no soafo panyin.

Wɔwoo Kuyon wɔ 28 August 1975. Ɔfiri Chinderi. Ɔwɔ Masters Degree wɔ Demokrasi, Aban, Mmara ne Nkɔsoɔ mu (2016), Bachelor of Art Degree wɔ Amanyɔsɛm ne Mpanyimfo Nhomasua mu (2014) ne Diploma wɔ Mmabun wɔ Nkɔsoɔ Adwuma mu. Ná ɔyɛ Stevedore Ɔhwɛfo wɔ Golden Gate Services.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Kuyon yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni. Wɔ September 2012 mu no, Ɔmampanyin John Dramani Mahama na ɔpaw no na ɔsii so dua sɛ Ɔmantam no panyin ma Krachi Nchumuru Mantam Nhyiam.Na ɔyɛ n’apam no kandifo wɔ December 2020 abatow no mu. Odii nkonim wɔ mmarahyɛ bagua abatow no mu de abatow 13,488 a egyina hɔ ma abatow a wɔtow nyinaa mu 44.3%, na ɔboroo nea ɔne no reko titiriw Kakateche Innocent Tache a ofi New patriotic Party a onyaa abatow 12,404 a egyina hɔ ma abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 40.8%.

Ɔsom sɛ Mmabun, Agumadi ne Amammerɛ Boayikuw no muni ne Members a wokura Office of Profit Committee no mu biara wɔ Fourth Republic of Ghana Mmarahyɛ Bagua a Ɛto so Awotwe no mu.

title: Solomon Sampah
text:
Solomon Sampa Nii Otokonor Sampa anaa Solomon Sampa (ogyefo da a ɛtɔ so 14, afe 1945 – ɔpepɔn da a ɛtɔ so 24, afe 2016) wɔ san nso frɛ no edin a ahorɔw a ɛne Pap Solo, Paa Solo, Quench Walahi yɛ kane Ghanani oyekyerɛni a nea wɔde kae no paa ne ɔyɛkyerɛ a ɔyɛe de bɔɔ dawuru maa tɔfe a ne din de Original Hacks.

N'asetena mu 
Wɔ woo no wɔ James town, British Accra. Na ɔyɛ nnwomtoni ne asawdifo a ɔne agofomma a wɔn din de Slim Traditional Band na edii nsawosoɔ nea wɔfre no Anansekromain ka ho wɔ agodi adwumakuo bi a w’ato din National Flkloric adwumakuo.

Nnwuma 
Na ɔyɛ yɛkyereni a ɔka ɔman yɛkeyerɛ kuo a wɔtee wɔ afe 1960 mu na wɔn din de National Drama kuo no ho, na afe ɔka kuo foforo a ɛne Abibigromma kuo na ɛho na ɔde n’adwuma baa awie. Na ɔyɛ obi a ɔbɔ atwene a w’ato din Congas ne nsankuo ahorɔw maa kuo a wɔn din de Amartey Hedzoleh agofomma a wɔbɔɔ King Ampah nnwom a ɛne Kukurantumi; Road to Accra’ a ɛye sini a wɔyɛɛ no wɔ afe 1983 mu, ɔsan so yɛ kane yiyedie so hwɛfo ma siniyɛfo kuo a w’ato din Ghana Actor’s Gild (GAG).

title: Sometutuza Afahyɛ
text:
Sometutuza yɛ afehyia Otwa afahyɛ a ahenfo ne wɔn manfo a wɔn wɔ Agozome a ɛwɔ keta, wɔ Frao Mantam no di wɔ Ghana. Wodi saa afahyɛ yi nnawɔtwe mienu bere a w’adi Hogbetsotso afahyɛ no akyi. Wodi no wɔ memenada a ɛtɔ so miensa wɔ Bosome a ɛtɔ 11 no mu.

Afa hyɛ 
Wɔyɛ oyikyerɛ wɔ ntaadehyɛ mu ne asaw die wɔ afahyɛ no ase. Ahenfo ne wɔn asoafo nso bɔ dwa data. Ahenfo de nkyea kɔma wɔn manhene no ma wɔhyɛ no bɔ sɛ wɔtaa n’akyi. Wɔda Ewefoɔ kente ahorɔw adi wɔ afahyɛ no ase na ntoma afoforo a wɔde wɔn nsa anwene no nso da adi wɔ afahyɛ no ase.

Mfasoɔ 
Wodi afahyɛ no de kae bere a, wotuu firii wɔn tenabea dedaw no mu.

title: Sophia Karen Edem Ackuaku
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Sophia Karen Edem Ackuaku yɛ Ghanani amanyɔni ne mmarahyɛ baguani wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛ bagua a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu, na  ɔyɛ onimusini ma Domeabra-Obom mpesua so a ɛwɔ Nkran Mantam no mu. ɔyɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Party (NDC) no mu ni.

Ne mmɔfrase ne Nhoma sua 
Wɔ woo Ackuaku wɔ October da a ɛtɔ so 7, afe 1972. Ofiri kuro a wɔfrɛ no Anyako a ɛwɔ Frao Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ackuaku anya ntete ahorɔw pii ma ɔnam saa yɛ so anya abodin krataa wɔ nnipa mu nktahodie, nneama ho dawurobɔ ne adetɔn ho  firii suapɔn a ne din de Ghana Institute of Journalism. ɔsan nso kura abodin krataa firi Suapɔn a wɔfrɛ no School of Social Works a ɛwɔ Osu-Nkran mantam mu ne abodin krataa a ɛkyerɛ sɛ w’asua Dutch kasa wɔ suapɔn a ɛne Zadkine College a ɛwɔ Rotterdam, Holland. Ackuaku san nso kura abodin krataa a ɛkyerɛ sɛ w’anya asuade wɔ Adikansɛm, nnipa fahodie ne HIV/AIDS firi ekuo bi wɔfrɛ no Ark Foundation a ɛwo Ghana.

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Sophia Karen Edem Ackuaku yɛ  ɔwarefo a ɔwɔ mmofra nnum. ɔyɛ  Kristoni.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Sophia ko sii Akan ma no dii nkonim wɔ mmarahyɛ  bagua abatoɔ ma Domeabra-Obom mpesua so wɔ afe 2016. ɔne nnipa nnan na esii akan no a wɔn ne Darison Barba Mohammed a ogyinaa wɔ New Patriotic Party din mu, Ekow Jones Mensah a ogyinaa wɔ amanyɔkuo Conventions Peoples Party din mu, Gideon Dudu a ogyinaa wɔ Progressive Peoples Party din mu ne Pius Kwame Fiakuna a ogyinaa kwantenkorɔ. ɔde aba no mu 14301 a egyina hɔ ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 68.3 dii nkunim a na aba no dodoɔ ne 21506. Sesei, ɔsom wɔ mmarahyɛ  bagua kuo bi a ne din Fodd, Agriculture and Cocoa Affairs Committee ne Poverty Reduction Strategy Committee

Nnwuma ho nsɛm 
Ackuaku ayɛ  nnwuma ahorow pii.  Sɛ  mmarahyɛ  baguani wo Ghana mmarahyɛ  begua  mu no,  w’asom wɔ kuo ahorɔw a ɛne Kuo a ɛhwɛ  Nnuane, Mfumnwuma ne Cocoa ho nsɛm, Kuo a ɛhwɛ  nhyehyɛi ne  ɔkwan a wɔnam so tu ohia ase wɔ mmarahyɛ  bagua mu.  Ansa na ɔbɛyɛ  mmarahyɛ  baguani no, na ɔyɛ  adwuma sɛ  ɔkwankyerɛfo abediakyire ma adwumakuo bi a ne din de Ghana National Service Scheme firi afe 2013 kosi 2016.  Firi afe 2004 kosi 2013 no, na ɔyɛ  ɔkwankyerɛfo ma adwumakuo Eligreen/Amsos Ghana Limited. Ansa na eyi no, na wayɛ  adwuma sɛ  ɔkwnkyerɛfo abediakyire ama adwumakuo Golden Souvenir Lotto wo Atifi Mantam mu wɔ Ghana efi 1995 kosi 2000 na ɔne adwumakuo Federation of Business Women Entrepreneurs ns oyee adwuma firi 2001 kosi 2010.

title: Staci Mannella
text:
Staci Mannella yɛ Amerikani a ɔde mmirika tu mmirika wɔ mmepɔw so wɔ Paralympic. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ nkonimbo ahodoɔ mu wɔ IPC Alpine World Ski Championships ne World Cups mu.

Adwuma 
Wɔ 2016 Wiase Kupɔn a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Kranjska Gora, Slovenia, a ɛbuee afe no ano wɔ Ɔbɛnem 16 no, Mannella a Sadie De Baun kyerɛɛ no kwan no dii nkonim wɔ sika kɔkɔɔ no mu wɔ 1:37.72, na ɔpiaa South Koreani Jae Rim Yang kɔɔ 2nd (wɔ 1:38.16 mu, wɔkyerɛɛ no kwan Un So Ri Koe na ɔkyerɛwee), ne ɔman ba Danelle Umstead a ɔto so 3 (wɔ 1:40.40 mu, a ne kunu Robert kyerɛɛ no kwan).

Wɔ afe 2016 berɛ mu no, Mannella ne ne kwankyerɛfoɔ a ɔhunu ade Sadie de Baun wɔ asɛnka agua so mprɛnsa wɔ slalom mu, na wɔdii nkonim mprenu. Saa nea efii mu bae yi maa wɔkɔɔ soro wɔ gyinabea no mu, na wɔde nkontimmaa 20 dii Danelle Umstead ne ne kwankyerɛfo, ne kunu Rob so sen no. Wɔ slalom kɛse no mu no, Mannella huu sɛ odii Belgiumni Eléonor Sana ne ne kwankyerɛfo Chloe Sana akyi nkontimmaa 80. Staci Mannella ne ɔkwankyerɛfoɔ Sadie de Baun duu 1st, wɔ giant slalom mu wɔ IPC Paralympic Alpine Ski World Cup wɔ Tarvisio wɔ afe 2016 mu, wɔ bere a ɛyɛ 2:05.87, na Eléonor Sana ne ɔkwankyerɛfoɔ Chloe Sana dii n’akyi, a ɔdii deɛ ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ 2: 09.40 na ɛwɔ hɔ. Nea ɔto so 3 no kɔɔ Marie-Morgane Dessartwine ɔkwankyerɛfo Antoine Marine Francois wɔ 2:29.51.

Wɔ afe 2017 Aspen Mmea Slalom Wiase Kupɔn a wɔde ma Anifuraefoɔ no, wɔsii akan kɛseɛ wɔ slalom ne giant slalom mmirikatuo no mu; ɔde 1:29.36 Mannella dii nkonim wɔ slalom mmirikatu VI mu na ɔde 2:02.97 dii nea ɛto so abien wɔ slalom mmirikatu kɛse VI no mu, na odii ne yɔnko dwumayɛni Danelle Umstead akyi.

Wɔ 2017 World Para Alpine Skiing Championships mu no, ɔnyaa kɔbere nkonimboɔ wɔ Super combined mu, na ɔdii anum wɔ Women’s Super-G VI mu.

Mannella yɛ U.S. ɔman alpine ski kuw no muni kumaa sen biara wɔ 2014 Paralympic Winter Games a wɔyɛe wɔ Sochi, faako a odii kan wɔ slalom, ne giant slalom akansi ahorow mu.

Wɔ 2018 Paralympic Winter Games a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Pyeongchang no, Mannella bubuu ne nsateaa, nanso ɔda so ara tumi sii akan, na ɔdii kan wɔ Mmea Slalom a wɔn ani nhu ade yie mu, na ɔdii kan wɔ Mmea Slalom Giant Visually Impaired, ne Women’s Super-G Visually Impaired mu.

title: Stephen Allen Dzirasa
text:
Stephen Allen Dzirasa kane Ghana nhomsua mu okunini, ɔsɔfo ne amanyoni. Na ɔyɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo ansa na ɔbɛyɛɛ Methodist ɔsofo. Na ɔyɛ ɔman suafo wo Kwasafoman a edikan no mu. ɔsoom sɛ Ghana soafoa a ɔwɔ Gunea na afei nso, na ɔyɛ soafo a ɔhwɛ amanɔne nsɛm so abediakyire. Na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛ baguani a na ogyina hɔ ma Upper Tongu abatoɔ mpɛsoa so.

Ne mmɔfra ase ne Nhomasua 
Wɔ woo Dzirasa wɔ July da ɛtɔ so 23, afe 1918 wɔ Tongu mpɛsoa so a ɛwɔ Frao Mantam no mu , na n’awofo din de Doefe ne Andrews Torgbemu Dzirasa. Ne mmɔfrase pɛɛ na n’awofoɔ ntam tetee ma no dii ne maame akyi kɔtenaa ne nana barima a ne de Awittor hɔ wɔ kuro a ɛne Kpong. Ne papa nyaa akwanya kɔfaa no baa ne nkyɛn bre a na w’adi mfie nwotwe, ɛhɔ na ɔhyɛɛ ne nhomasua ase. Wɔ afe 1926 mu no, ɔkɔɔ Aveyime Salem; Metodisefo sukuu a na ɛwɔ akuara no ase saa bre no. ɔtoa n’adesua no so kɔɔ sukuu a ne din de Presbyterian Boarding School a na ɛwɔ Ada Foa, osan nso kɔɔ sukuu a ene Trinity College a ɛwɔ Kumasi..

Nnwuma ne amanyɔsɛm 
Dzirasa yɛ adwuma sɛ nmmoakuo so hwɛfo wɔ ne papa afu mu bre a na ɔyɛ abrantewaa no, na ɔde ne papa anantwie kɔ adidie bre nyinaa. ɔsan nso suaa apopodwuma, kuayɔ ne ade tɔn firii ne papa ne ne wɔfa ho. Owie sukuu no, Dzirasa nyaa adwuma wɔ adwumkuo a ne din de U.T.C sɛ sotoo so hwɛfo abediakyire. ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛni mmere kakra bi akyi no, wɔpaw no sɛ Metodisfo sɔfo. Wɔ afe 1951 mu. Wɔpaw no sɛ asɔfo nhyiamu so ɔkyerɛwfo a ɔtɔ so mienu firi afe 1952 kosi 1954

Na ɔyɛ otitenani ma Lower Tongu mansin no mmarahyɛkuo na wɔ afe 1953 mu no, wɔpaw no Van Lare Commission kuo no mu ni. Wɔ too aba yi no sɛ upper Tongu no mansin no mmarahyɛ kuo mu ni wɔ afe 1954. Wɔ July afe 1960 mu no, wɔpaw no sɛ Guinea so soafo na wɔ December 1960mu no, wɔ yɛɛ no Soafo a ɔhwɛ amanɔne nsɛm so no abediakyire (soafo kyerewfo).  ɔsoom sɛ soafo kosii sɛ wotuu Nkrumah wo February, afe 1966.

N'asetena mu nsɛm 
Na Dzirasa ne ɔba a ɔtwa toɔ wɔ ne maame mma nnan ntam, na na ɔyɛ ɔbakofo a ne maame woo no maa ne papa

title: Stephen Willie Yeboah
text:
Stephen Willie Yeboah Yɛ kane Ghanani amnyoni. Ɔsoom sɛ Soafoa a ɔhwɛ Bono ne Ahafo Mantam mu, Asante Mantam mu ne Atɔe Mantam mu. Ɔsan nso soom sɛ mmarahyɛ baguani a ogyina hɔ ma Sunyani Atoe mpɛsoa so na akyire, Dormaa abatoɔ mpɛsoa so.

Ne mmɔfrase ne Nhomsua 
Wɔ woo Stephen wɔ October da ɛtɔ 26 afe 1928 wɔ Dormaa Akwamu a ɛwɔ Bono ne Ahafo Mantam no mu.  Ɔhyɛɛ Nhomasoa ase wɔ Dormaa Ahenkuro a ɛwɔ Bono ne Ahafo Mantam mu ne Bewai a ɛwɔ Asante Mantam no mu. Onyaa abɔdin krataa a ɛne San 7 no, Otoaa so kɔɔ sukuu a ɛne Elthanus Commercial Academy a ɛwɔ Saltpond. Osuaa nkontabuo, akyerɛw, ne nhomakora ho nimdeɛ mfie mienu

Nnwuma ne Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔ afe 1950 mu no, Stephen kɔ yɛɛ adwuma wɔ sukuu a ɔkɔe no mu (Elthanus Commercial Academy) na ɔyee adwuma wɔ ho mfie mienu. Ofiri ho no, ɔkɔ kyerɛɛ ade wɔ sukuu a ɛne Dormaa Ahenkuro Commercial Secondary School. Wɔ afe 1953 mu no, ɔde n’adwuma too hɔ ma no de ho kɔdɔɔm ahwefo a wɔda adwumakuo a wɔtɔ kookoo no.

Wo afe 1954 mu no, Stephen kogyinaa ma wɔtoo ne so aba se mmarahye baguani wɔ Sunyani Atoe mpesoa so.  Ɔyee mmarahye baguani kosii afe 1966 mu bre a wotuu Nkrumah aban gui. Wɔ May da etɔ so 22, afe 1957 mu no, wɔpaw no se Soafo Abediakyire wɔ asoe a ehwe kuayɔ so. Wɔ June da edikan wɔ afe 1959 mu no, wɔpaw no se Soafo a ɔhwe Bono ne Ahafo Mantam mu na wɔ October afe 1963 mu no, wɔpaw no sɛ Soafo a ɔhwɛ Asante Mantam mu. Ɔsoom wɔ saa dibea yi kosii afe 1965 mu bre a wɔpaw no Soafo a ɔhwɛ Atɔe Mantam no mu.

title: Tafi Atome Nnoe Guankobea.
text:
Tafi Atome Nnoe Guankɔbea yɛ ammamerɛ krɔnkrɔnbea a efiri ase wɔ afe 1993 mu a wɔn a wɔde bae no yɛ atuhoamafo a wfrɛ wɔn ‘’Peace Corps Volunteers’’ , na wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ nsrabea mu kena. Tafi yɛ nnoe a wɔfrɛ wɔn Mona ne Patas no atenae.

Beae 
Guankɔbea no da beae a efiri  Nkra kuropɔn Atifi-Atɔe  mu kɔ hɔ no yɛ bɛyɛ sɛ kilomita 230 na, efiri Hohoe a ɛwɔ Frao mantam no Atɔe kɔ hɔ no nso yɛ kilomita 43.

Abakɔsɛm 
Bɛyɛ mfie ahanu a atwam no, wohuu sɛ nnoe no wɔ osutɔe kwaebrentuo a ɛwɔ akura a wɔfrɛ no Tafi atome, na ɛhɔ yɛ krɔnkrɔnbea efiri sɛ na wɔgye di sɛ wɔ yɛ asomafo a wofiri abosom no hɔ. Efiri 1996 mu no, temanmufo no si gyinae sɛ wɔbɛbɔ wɔn ho mmɔden ama wɔn kwae brentuo no ne nnoe no ada adi wɔ amansan mu, na afei nso w’ama bɛhwɛadefo nso ho kwan ama w’anya akwanya aba nsrahwɛ. Wɔn a wɔkaa wɔn ti bɔɔ mu dii saa dwumadie yi ne nkura no mu foɔ no, aban nnwumakuo ahorɔw ne nwumakuo a ɛnhyɛ aban ase. Esiane saa anamontuo yi nti, nnoe no dodoɔ akɔ anim, na kwae a nnomaa ne afofantɔ ahorɔw wɔ mu no ye nea wotumi bɔɔ ho ban.

Nsiesie

title: Tannin a wɔde yɛ mmerɛw
text:
Brazilfo, Koreafo, Japanfo ne Amerikafo nnuru a wɔde teɛteɛ ti nhwi ne nea wɔde teɛteɛ ti nhwi yɛ ade titiriw wɔ nnɛyi ti nhwi adwuma mu. Nea wɔde aka gua so nnansa yi ne tannin a ɛma ɛyɛ mmerɛw. So woate eyi ho asɛm? Sɛ wopɛ sɛ wusua pii fa tannin smoothing ho a, di yɛn akwankyerɛ a ɛfa tannin smoothing ho no akyi.

Nkyerɛaseɛ, Ka, Adeyɛ, Mfasoɔ, ne nea ɛkeka ho.

Dɛn ne tannin a ɛma ɛyɛ mmerɛw ? 

Tannin smoothing yɛ ɔkwan foforo a wɔfa so yɛ smoothing. Ne nnyinasosɛm ne sɛ wode bedi dwuma polyphenols a efi afifide mu sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a nwi no bɛyɛ mmerɛw. Wɔde

maceration a wɔde bobe, oak ne chestnut were ayɛ, ne su ahorow no ye yiye ma nwi nhama no a wɔhwɛ so. Ne mfiase fi Brazil baabi a wɔyɛɛ taninoplasty kwan no sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ɛbɛma abɔde mu ade a ɛyɛ mmerɛw a ɛsono Brazilfo a wɔde yɛ mmerɛw no.

Tannin smoothing: henanom dea? 
Mmea nyinaa betumifa no di dwumatannin a wɔde yɛ mmerɛw, a ɛka ho wɔn wɔn a wɔwɔti nhwi a ɛyɛ fɛ anaasɛ asɛe. sen wo ti nhwi yɛ teateaa, kurukuruwa, kinky anaasɛ ɛyɛ den, wo betumi anya mfaso afi a smoothing a ɛyɛ mmerɛw a wɔde tannins ahyɛ mu.

So tannin a wɔde teɛteɛ ti nhwi no sɛe ti nhwi no? 
Nifa 100% abɔde mu nneɛma. Wɔmfa nnuru biara nni dwuma, enti asiane biara nni ho sɛ wode tannin straightening bɛsɛe wo ti nhwi.

Mfaso bɛn na ɛwɔ tannin a wɔde yɛ mmerɛw so? 
Smoothes, aduannuru na ɛhyɛ ti nhwi no den denam repair tannins aseda abɔde mu nneɛma a ɛyɛ adwuma ne restorative ne moisturizing  .Smoothes frizz a enni mu.

Mfaso titiriw a ɛwɔ so ne sɛ ɛtra hɔ kyɛ, na ɛnte sɛ akwan afoforo a wɔfa so teɛteɛ nneɛma. Nokwarem no, nea efi mu ba no da so ara da adi asram pii wɔ bere a wɔateɛteɛ nwi no akyi na ɛtra hɔ kodu asram 4 anaa 8 a egyina sɛnea ti nhwi no te so. Nwi no yɛ mmerɛw, ɛhyerɛn, ɛyɛ den na ɛwɔ apɔwmuden.

Tannin a wɔde teɛteɛ nneɛma no bo yɛ ahe? 
Sɛnea ɛte wɔ aduru biara a wɔde yɛ smoothing ho no, tannin smoothing bo gyina gyinapɛn ahorow pii so.

ti nhwi su ne ne tebea (srade, dry, neutral, fine, curly, tẽẽ, curly, wavy, curly);

wo tenten (nwi atenten, tiawa, ne tenten mfinimfini);

ne kɛseyɛ.

Nso dodoɔ no ara yɛ nneɛma wɔ intanɛt so sɛ nhwɛso no .Sɛ wɔhwehwɛ gyinapɛn no nyinaa mu wie a, nea ɔyɛ ti nhwi no betumi de bo a ɛwɔ 150€ kosi 400€ ama. Nneɛma a wɔde yɛ tannin a ɛyɛ mmerɛw a wɔayɛ wɔ fie no bo fi dɔla 50 kosi dɔla 170.

Yɛ tannin smoothing w’ankasa 
Wopɛ sɛ wo nkutoo wo tan wɔ fie? Hyɛ no nsow sɛ ade bi wɔ hɔ a ɛma tannin yɛ mmerɛw. Nanso hwɛ yiye, biribiara nni hɔ a ɛsen nsrahwɛ a wobɛkɔ akɔhwɛ baabi a wɔyɛ ahoɔfɛ no na ama woawie pɛpɛɛpɛ.

Nneɛma ahorow a wɔde yɛ tannin a wɔayɛ no mmerɛw wɔ fie:

1) Shampoo a ɛma nneɛma mu da hɔ:

Ɛtaa ba sɛ wode aduru a ɛma wo ti nhwi mu da hɔ bedi dwuma ansa na woafi ase abue ti nhwi no nsenia na ama ne nwene atu mpɔn esiane ne tannic su nti.Ebetumi ate wo ti nhwi no ho kɛse. Nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma:

2) Hohoro, mpopaho dry na fi ase de ayaresa no di dwuma wɔ detangled ti nhwi. Biribiara a wuhia (gloves, brushes, ne nea ɛkeka ho) wɔ kit no mu. Fi ase wɔ kɔn no akyi, na kyekyɛ ti nhwi a aka no mu. Sɛ wode regu so a, fi ase de gu so fi baabi a ɛne ntini no ntam kwan yɛ sɛntimita 1-2. Fa ahama a ɛtrɛw sɛnea ɛsɛ a ne tenten yɛ sɛntimita 4-5. Trɛw nsensanee no mu pɛpɛɛpɛ.

3) Gyae wɔ ti so bɛyɛ 30 simma (simma 20 ma nwi kɔla ahorow).

4) Hohoro na wesee.

5) Ma ɔhyew mprɛte no yɛ hyew na teɛteɛ wicks fi soro kosi ase. Wɔhwehwɛ sɛ wɔde pass ahorow pii di dwuma ama afiri biara.

6) Hohoro bio wo ti nhwi.

7) Fa ma ayaresa pɔtee bi (a mpɛn pii no ɛka kit no ho).

8) Hohoro ho na ɛyow a wɔmfa brush nhyɛ mu.

title: Tawia Adamafio
text:
Tawia Adamafio (ne din a wɔde woo no ne Joseph Tawia Adams) yɛ kane Soafo wɔ Nkrumah aban mu wɔ Ghana adeyeman a edikan.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Na Adamafio yɛ amanyɔkuo Conventions People’s Party ne na onyinii bɛyɛɛ ɔkyerɛwfo wɔ afe 1960 mu, Kwame nkruma wɔpaw no sɛ Soafo a ɔhwɛ nkitohodie ne amanɛebɔ so. Na okuraa dibea a ɛne Soafo a ɔhwe manpanyin asɔe so saa bre koro no ara mu. Na saa dibea yɛ nea tumi wɔ mu paa saa bre no mu.

1963 Atemmuo 
Adamafio ka wɔn akwame Nkrumah ne wɔn hwɛ bo mu a wɔde wɔn kogyina asenni no mu baako, de fa Topae a ɛtoe wɔ Kulungugu, ne boate ne sɛ na anka wɔ pɛ sɛ woku Kwame Nkrumah. Adamafio dii nkunim wɔ asenni a edikan no mu nanso odii fɔ wɔ attemuo a ɛtɔ so mienu a wɔn a wodii asɛm no yɛ atɛmmufo kuo foforo a aban no hyehyɛe. Attɛnmmufo a wɔtenaa asɛm no so ne Kobina Arku korsah, wɔ bre a Ghana mmaranimfo kuo kwankyerɛfo ne asɛndibea kunini attɛmmufo William Van Lare ne Edward Akuffo-Addo a ɔbeyɛɛ mmaranimfo kuo kwankyerɛfo ne Ghana manpyin akyire no bre so.

text:

Owiee Urbana ntoaso sukuu, ne Illinois Sukuupɔn Urbana-Champaign.

Career

title: Teshie
text:
Teshie yɛ mpoano kuro a ɛwɔ Ledzokuku Mansin mu, a ɛwɔ Nkran Mantam mu wɔ Ghana .  Teshie yɛ nkuro a ɛtɔ so nkrɔn a nnipa dɔɔso sen biara wɔ Ghana, na nnipa 171,875 na wɔte mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Teshie wɔ Ledzokuku Mansin a Onuonyamfoɔ  Ben Ayiku, a ɔyɛ Amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress no muni, ɔno na   osii Hon. Ɔbenfoɔ Benard Okoe Boye a   ɔdɔm Amanyɔkuo New Patriotic Party anan mu.

Atetesɛm ahorow 

Teshie yɛ Nkran Mantam no nkurow a ɛde ne ho no mu biako, August biara, kurow no di afahyɛ a ɛne Homowo afahyɛ no.   Wogye di sɛ,  Teshiefoɔ no ase fi La, kurow bi a ɛda Teshie atɔe fam.

Fort Augustaborg, a Denmarkfo sii wɔ 1787 mu no wɔ Teshie na Britaniafo na wɔtenaa mu fi 1850 kosi 1957. Wogye di sɛ Teshie dii mfie ɔha minsa wɔ afe 2011. 

Kurow no mu nneɛma ahorɔw pii wɔ hɔ ɛbae denam ɔman no demokrase ne nkɔso nhyehyɛe a egu akwan mu no so.

Teshie trɛw fi Kpeshie Lagoon kosi Teshie Nungua Estates (nhyiam a edi kan) fi Apuei kɔ Atɔe wɔ Teshie Kwan so. Teshie anya nkɔso kɛse abɛyɛ nkurow akɛse a ɛwɔ Ghana no mu biako.

Kane Kwei Duadwumfo Adwumayɛbea 
Wɔsan frɛ Teshie kurow no sɛ funnak fiefie, a Seth Kane Kwei  na ɔyɛɛ no wɔ 1950 mfe no mu na wɔda so ara yɛ wɔ Kane Kwei Duadwumfo Adwumayɛbea ( Eric Adjetey Anang na ɔhwɛ so) ne mfoniniyɛfo afoforo pii na wɔyɛe.

Labadi Mpoano 
Labadi Mpoano, anaasɛ wɔfrɛ no La Anigye Mpoano  no bɛn Teshie. Mpoano no yɛ mpoano a nnipa pii kɔ hɔ wɔ Ghana mpoano. Ɛyɛ Nkran Mantam mpoano kakraa bi no mu biako na kuromhɔfo na ɛhwɛ so.

title: Thomas Dominic Baffoe
text:
Thomas Dominic Bafffoe yɛ kane Ghanani nsɛmkyerɛwni ne anmanyɔni. Na ɔyɛ koowaa krataa mu samufo ma nsɛmkyerɛw adwumakuo a ɛde Ghanaian Time firi afe 1964 kosii afe 1965. Ɔsan nso soom sɛ okandifo maa nsɛmkyerɛwfo kuo a ɛne Ghana JournalistsAssociation wo afe 1964 mu. Firi afe 1965 kosi afe 1966 mu no, na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛ baguani a ogyina ho ma Gomoa –Assin abatoɔ mpɛsoa so.

Ne mmɔfrase ne Nhomsua 
Wɔ woo Baffoie wɔ afe 1930 mu wɔ Mankessim a ɛwɔ Mfinfin mantam mu Ghana (nkane Gold Coast). ɔhyɛɛ sukuu ase wɔ Tarkwa Catholic school firi afe 1939 kosii afe 1941 ne Obuasi Methodist and Catholic schools firi afe 1942 kosii afe 1946 ma no nyaa abodin krataa a ɛne Middle School Leaving Certificate . ɔno akyi no, Baffoe suaa ade wɔ fie na ɔfaa so kosuaa nsɛmkyerɛw adwuma.

Nnwuma ne Amanyɔsɛm 
Baffoe hyɛɛ adwuma ase wɔ adwumakuo a ɛne Ashanti Times wo obuasi bre a owie sukuu no wɔ afe 1947 se nsesmkyerewni adwumayefo boafo. Wɔ afe 1949 mu no, ɔde ne ho kɔdɔɔm Jonathan Kwesi Lamptey adwumakuo a ɛne Gold Coast Leader wɔ Sekondi. Ofirii ho de ne ho kɔdɔɔm adwumakuo foforo a ɛne Takoradie press a ne wura ne Saki Scheck wo afe 1950 na ofirii ho saa afe no mu kɔɔ Kumasi kɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ koowaa krataa mu samufo abediakyire wo nsɛmkyerɛw adwumakuo a ɛne Ashanti Sentinel. Wɔ afe 1951 awie no mu no, onyaa adwuma se nsɛmkyerɛwni panyin wɔ adwumakuo a ɛne Daily Graphic. wɔ afe 1952 mu no, Baffoe san n’akyi kɔɔ Ashanti Times sɛ koowaa krataa mu samufo Panyin. Okuraa saa dwumadie no kosii afe 1955 bre a onyaa adwuma se koowaa krataa mu samufo panyin maa nsɛmkyerɛw adwumakuo a ɛyɛ Indiafo de.

Baffoe soom sɛ aban adwumayeni firi afe 1958 kosii afe 1960 ma no bɛyɛɛ koowaa krataa mu samufo ma adwumakuo a ɛne Ghanaian Worker a ɛyɛ Trades Union Congress dea. Wɔpaw no sɛ koowaa krataa mu samufo ma nsɛmkyerɛw adwumakuo a ɛne Ghanaian Times wɔ April afe 1960 na wɔyii no adi nawotwe mienu akyi wɔ afe 1961.Wɔ saa afe no mu no, amanyɔkuo Conventions Peoples Party paw no sɛ kuo a ɛne Central Committee no mu ni na ɛno maa no bɛyɛɛ obi a osua koraa a w’abɛyɛ kuo mu ni saa bre no. Wɔ afe 1964 mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ koowaa krataa mu samufo ma nsɛmkyerɛw adwumakuo a ɛne Ghanaian times kosii 1965.Wɔ saa afe no mu, wɔpaw no sɛ okandifo maa nsɛmkyerɛwfo kuo a ɛne Ghana Journalist Association. Wɔ afe 1965 mu no, ɔsan n’akye koyee samfo adwuma no bio.  Okuraa saa dibea no mu kosii February da a ɛtɔ so afe 1966 bre a wotuu Nkrumah aban gui. Wɔ afe 1965 mu no, wɔpaw no sɛ mmarahyɛ baguni a ogyina ho ma Gomoa-Asin mpɛsooa so.  Okuraa saa dibea no mu kosii sɛ abantugu no bae. ɔbɛyɛɛ Ghanaian Times adwumakuo no mu mpanyinfo no mu baako.

N'setnea mu nsɛm 
Baffoe waree awuara Josephine Ashorkor Vejisu a sesei ɔyɛ Owurayere Josephien Baffoe wɔ June da a ɛto 18, afe 1960 mu. Owurayere kura mmɔfra mienu ansa na ɔne no waree. Owui wɔ Wukuada February da ɛtɔ so 14, afe 2005 mu

title: Tsatsu Tsikata
text:
Tsatsu Tsikata (wɔ woo no October da a edikan, afe 1950) yɛ Ghanani nwomanimfo ne mmaranimfo. ɔyɛ kane kandifo ma adwumakuo a  ɛde Ghana National Petroleum Corporation. Wonim no sɛ ɔyɛ amanyokuo National Democratic Congress no mapanyinfo no mu baako ne amanyɔkuo no mmaranimfo kunini.

Ne mmɔfrase ne Nhomasua 
Wɔ woo Tsikata wɔ Keta a ɛwɔ Frao Mantam no atɔe fam wɔ Ghana . Nanso, wɔtetee no Adabraka, borɔn a ɛwɔ Nkran, a ɛyɛ Ghana kuropɔn . ɔhyɛɛ sukuu ase ntɛm esiane sɛ na ɔwɔ ɔpɛ sɛ obedi ne nua pinyin a ɔde Fui akyi akɔ sukuu. Odikan kɔɔ sukuu a ɛde Additrom Preparatory School ne Mrs Sam’s Preparatory school, a ɛyɛ sukuu a kane Ghana Manpanyin Jerry Rawlings nso kɔe. Ofirii hɔ kɔɔ sukuu a ɛde Accra Newtown Experimental School, na ɛhɔ na wɔma no bɔ traa mfie mienu kɔɔ mfie miɛnsa maa ɔne ne nua panyin Fui no kɔtenaa sukuu dan baako mu . Onyaa nhomasua mu mmoa firii United Africa Company (UAC) Scholarship de kɔɔ ntoaso sukuu a ɛne Mfantsipim School, beae a ne papa ne ne nua panyin Fui Sokpoli Tsikata nso kɔe,  bre a na w’adi mfi nkrorɔn  . Bre a owiee mfie nnum adesua no, onyaa akwannya kɔɔ Suapɔn a ɛne University of Ghana, Legon, wɔ bre a na w’adi mfie dunsia no, na onyaa mmaranim abɔdin krataa a ɛde LL.B first class bre a na w’adi mfie dunwɔtwe. Saa bre no, na onipa foforo baako a w’adi mfie dunwɔtwe na w’atumi anya suapɔn abodin krataa. N’akyerɛkyerɛfo no mu bi ne ɔbenfo Ofosu Amaa ne Dr. Obed Asamoa, a ɔyɛ kane amanɔne suafo ne Ghana aban mmaranimfo no. ɔsan nso nyaa nhomasua mu mmoa  a ene Post-Graduate Scholarship firii suapɔn a ɛene University of Ghana hɔ kosua ade wɔ Suapɔn a ɛde Oxfod University, ma no nya abɔdin krataa a ɛfa temanmufo mmaranim, a ɛde Bachelor of Civil Law, saa abɔdin yi nsosuanso ne abɔdin a ɛde master’s degree a wonya firi suapon a ahorɔw a efeiri Bretain no yɛ pɛ.

Nnwuma

Nhomasua 
Tsikata kuraa dibea a ɛfa nhwehwemu ho a w’ato din Junior Research Fellowship wɔ Suapɔn a ɛde Oxford University, beae a na ɔyɛ adwuma sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo no . Ofirii ho baa Ghana wo fe 1974 mu no,  wɔpaw no sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo  wɔ Suapɔn a ɛne University of Ghana mmrasuabea. N’adesuafo no mu bi Kwamena Ahwoi, Alban Bagbin a ɔyɛ kane Ghana mmarahyɛ baguakuo dɔm kumaa no animdifo ne Ghana mmarahyɛ bagua a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe no kasamafo no, na afei Freddie Blay a ɔyɛ kane Ghana mmarahyɛ baguakuo no kasamafo abediakyire

Mmaranimfo 
Tsikata gyinaa hɔ sɛ mmaranimfo twitwa gyee akukudam ahorɔw wɔ mfie pii a abetwam kɔ. Wɔn mu bi ne Captain Kojo Tsikata a ɔyɛ ne wɔfa ba, Kofi Awono ne kane Ghana manpanyin Jerry Rawlings. Wɔ National Redemption Council/Supreme Military Council a ɛyɛ asraafo aban a naAcheampong, da ano no, ogyninaa hɔ sɛ mmaranimfo twitwa gyee Samuel Okudjeto ne William Ofori Atta a na wɔde wɔn akogyina asɛnnibea denam amanyɔsɛm ho nti. Wɔ May 15 atuatew  a ɛkɔɔ so akyi no,ogyina hɔ sɛ mmaranimfo maa Jerry Rawlings bre a wɔde ɔmanbɔfo kwaduu bɔɔ no wɔ asɛnnibea no, asɛm no to twae bre wotuu SMC Asrafo aban a na Fred Akuffo da ano no gui wɔ June , afe 1979 no . Na ɔyɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress mmaranimfokuo no kandifo wɔ abatoɔ ho mansotwe a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Ghana. ɔyɛ mmaranimfokuo no kandifo wɔ abatoɔ ho mansotwe ɛyɛ nea edikan wɔ Ghana, a amanyɔkuo New Patriotic Party de kɔɔ asennibea wɔ afe 2012 mu, na wɔn asɛm ne sɛ wɔgye abatoɔ a ɛkɔɔ so no ho nsosuanso no ho akyinnye . Amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress de kɔtoo asɛnnibea no anim sɛ wɔpɛ sɛ wɔde wɔn ka asɛm no ho na wɔde ano yie ma .

Ghana Fangoo Adwuma (GNPC) 
NDC amammuo a na Jerry Rawlings da ano no  paw Tsikata sɛ Okwankyerɛfo wɔ Ghana fangoo adwumakuobea a ɛne Ghana National Petroleum Corporation (GNPC), firi October afe 19988 kosi Decmebr , afe 2000 mu. dutafilm.org

Atemmuo, Afiase nna ne Fafiri 
Wɔbɔɔ Tsikata kwaadu sɛ w’abɔ ɔman Ghana ka GHC230, 000 bre a na ɔyɛ titenani ma adwumakuo a ɛne Ghana National Petroleum Corparation (GNPC) no, saa asɛm yi kɔɔ so wɔ asɛnnibea a ɛne Accra Fast Track Tribunal a ɛyɛ asɛnnibea ahorɔw a Kufour Aban no de sii hɔ sɛ ɛbɛhwɛ saa nsɛmnsɛm no mu baako. Asennie no hyɛɛ ase wɔ afe 2002 ma no kɔɔ so mfie nsia. Owura yere Henrietta Abban buu no fɔ wɔ Ayɛwɔhomumo da a ɛtɔ so 18, afe 2008 mu . Mmere a wɔde dii n’asem no bɛyɛɛ nsɛnnaho a ɛne sɛ, n’asɛm no ne nea wɔde mmere pii dii wɔ Ghana abakɔsɛm mu. Manpanyin Koffour ne amanyɔkuo New Patriotic (NPP) akyitaafo no hu eyi sɛ ade a amanmusɛm anya nkoanim, na Tsikata ne  amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress (NDC)  akyitaafo no nso huu no sɛ nea ɛkɔɔ  so so yɛ amanyosɛm . Eyi maa Ekuo bi a ɛne Free Tsatsu yii ne ti adi. Bre amanyɔkuo New Patriotic Party (NPP) dii nkuguo wɔ afe 2008 Ghana abatoɔ no mu na aka nnafua baako ama Manpanyin John Kuffour de n’amanmmuo aba n’wie no, ɔmaa no bɔne fafiri. Saa bre no, na ɔda ayaresabea kunini a ɛne Korle Bu Teaching Hospital, na w’anya ntehyewa, na afiasehwɛfo no bɔ ne ho ban wɔ ayaresabea hɔ . Tsatsu Tsikata poo saa fafari a manpanyin de maa no na ɔde too dwa wɔ adwabɔ bi ase sɛ, ɔnnye nni sɛ nea ɔmanpanyin no yɛe no fifiri n’akoma mu enti, ɔno ankasa bɛfa mmara kwan so ate ne din ho .

Agyinamu, Dwantoa ne Ahofadie 
Bre a ɔpoo fafiri a ɔmanpanyin de maa no akyi no, mmaranimfo Justice Edward Amoako Asante a ɔwɔ Accra-Fast Track high court no maa no agyinamu wɔ ɔpepɔn da a ɛtɔ so 13, afe 2009,  ne nnyinasoɔ ne sɛ, esiane sɛ ɔde dwantoa abɛda asɛnnibea sɛ wɔnhwehwɛ n’asɛm no mu bio nti, ɛho nhia se ɔbɛkɔ so ada afiase . Saa bre no nyinaa na ɔda so da ayaresabea esiane ntehyewa yareɛ no. Mfie nwɔtwe akyi bre a wɔde soboɔ bɔɔ no sɛ w’abɔ ɔman no ka akyi no, Dwantoa asɛnnibea a na Justice Dennis Adjei da ano de too dwa sɛ, ɔkwan a wɔfaa so de no too afiase no nnyɛ nea ɛfa ne kwan mu, nti asɛnnibea no twaa mfie nnum a wɔde maa no sɛ ɔnkɔda afiase no mu,  na wɔtee ne din ho wɔ November da a ɛtɔ so 30, afe 2016 mu.

N'asetena mu nsɛm 
Tsikata yɛ Kristoni a ɔyɛ asɔre panyin wɔ Asubury Dunwell Asore a ɛwɔ Nkran . Wonim no sɛ obi a ɔwɔ ntehyewa na eyi ama nnwuma ahorɔw a anka obetumi ayɛ no aba fam, eyi kaa  bre a na ɔde ko sukuu wɔ ne mmɔfrase no. Bre a wɔbɔɔ no kwaadu a wɔde no too afiase wɔ afe 2008 mu no, onyaa ntehyewa yareɛ a emu yɛ den maa nti woyii no firi Nsawam nnaduafie de no kɔɔ ayaresabea . Na Tsikata yɛ obi a ɔpɛ agodie a w’ato din kriket no paa.

Abusua 
Tsikata ne ne nuanom yɛ nsɔn. Na ne papa din de Godwin Kwaku-Sru Tsikata na ɔyɛ ɔkwankyerefo ma ntama tɔn adwumayɛkuo a ɛde United Africa Corporation, na ɔyɛ obi a w’akɔ ahomegyeɛ mu. ɔyɛ ɔwarefo a ne hokafo din de Esther Cobbah na, ɔne no woo mmɔfra miɛnsa . Ghana nwom abasabɔ gyefo a ɔde M. manifest no yɛ ne mma no baako.

Nkekaho

title: Tubrow Kapeon Yentu
text:
Tubrow Kapeon Yentua yɛ kane Ghanani amanyɔni. ɔyɛ kane mmarahyɛ baguani a ogyina hɔ ma Frafra atɔe mpɛsoa so firi afe 1954 mu kosii afe 1965 ne mmarahyɛ baguani a ogyina hɔ ma Nabdam mpɛsoa so firi afe 1965 kosii afe 1966 mu.

Yentu yɛ kane amanyɔkuo Northern People’s Party(NPP) no mu ni, na eyi maa no bɛyɛɛ amanyɔkuo Unite Party (UP) no mu ni esian sɛ amanyɔkuo nyinaa gye sɛ Conventions People kaa bom ma wɔ bɛyɛɛ amanyɔkuo baako a ne din de United Party wɔ afe 1957. Nanso, ɔne Mumuni Bawumia ne Mahama Tampuri gyaee amanyɔkuo no hɔ de wɔn ho kɔdɔɔm amanyɔkuo a na edi adeɛ saa bre no; Conventions Peopels Party wɔ afe 1958 mu.

title: Tudu, Ghana
text:
Tudu yɛ borɔno a ɛwɔ Nkran, wo nkranManatam mu wɔ Ghana.

Beae

Nhomasua

Ntotoho

title: Tweneboa Kodua
text:
Nana Tweneboa Kodua yɛ kane ɔman hene wɔ Kumawu a ɔde ne ho bɔɔ afore maa Asantefo nkunimdie. Ɔkomfo anokye de afotuo a ɛnɛ sɛ ansa na Asantefo betumi ade wɔn afiri Denkyirafo nsam wɔ Fahodieko a na ɛrekɔso mu no, gye sɛ ɔde ne ho ma.

Asantefo no ne Denkyirahene a   ɔde Ntima Gyakari de ɔko sii ani bre bisaa wɔn sɛ wɔnye biribi a ɛhyɛɛ wɔn abufuo no. Nnipa miɛnsa na ɛde wɔn ho bɔɔ afɔree maa asanteman nkunimdie a na Tweneboa Kodua yɛ wɔn mu baako. Odii asrafo no anim kɔɔ ɔko no nanso ɛmfa ho sɛ okura akode ahorɔw pii no, wɔde afutuo maa no sɛ onni ho kwna so ɔto tuo no, Eyi maa wokuu no wɔ ɔko no mu. ɔde abisade too dwa sɛ, ɛnse sɛ wɔde obi a ofiri ne man mu bɔ afɔreɛ biom esiane sɛ w’ayɛ saa ama wɔn nyinaa.

Wɔkyere Ntim Gyakari wɔ Yeyiase na wɔtwaa ne ti. Denkyirafo bɛyɛɛ nkoa maa Asanteman.
