title: United Gold Coast Convention amanyɔkuo
text:
United Gold Coast Convention' a yɛtwa no tia sɛ 'UGCC' yɛ amanyɔ kuo a yɛtee wɔ afe 1947 mu. Na wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛgye faahodie ama Ɔman Ghana. Wɔn mpaninfoɔ a na wɔda kuo no ano no bi ne Kwame Nkrumah, na ɔyɛ twerɛtwerɛfoɔ ma amanyɔ kuo yi. Ntawatadie maa kuo no akannifoɔ no mu kyɛeɛ na Kwame Nkrumah tee ne ho na afei ɔtee amanyɔ kuo a ne din ne 'Convention People's Party, CPP' no, de sii n'ani so sɛ ɔbɛgye faahodie mprenmpren ama Ghana. Akyemfo kuro no mu na yɛtee amanyɔkuo UGCC.

Abakɔsɛm 
Ɛwɔ afe 1940 mu no,  abibirem' adwadifoɔ bi te sɛ George Alfred Grant (Paa Grant) yɛɛ krado sɛ wɔde wɔn sika bɛhyɛ amanyɔkuo UGCC mu sɛdeɛ  ɛbɛboa ma wɔn dwadie akɔso.  Owura JB Danquah na ɔtee amanyɔkuo yi wɔ Ɔsanaa 4, 1947 mu.  Na atitire bi sɛ ahenfo, nwomanimfoɔ ne atɛmmuafoɔ bi te sɛ, R.A Awoonor -Williams, Robert Samuel Blay, Edward Akuffo Addo ne Emmanuel Obetsebi Lamptey ka amanyɔkuo yi akannifoɔ ho.

Ɔpɛnnima 10, afe 1947 mu no, Kwame Nkrumah baa Ghana a na yɛfrɛ no Gold Coast no, bere a na w'agye JB Danquah adesrɛ sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ UGCC twerɛtwerɛfoɔ ato mu. Owura Ebenezer Ako-Adjei na ɔsusu kyerɛɛ kuo no ma wɔtoo nsa frɛɛ Nkrumah.Na Owura Ako Adjei ahyia Nkrumah wɔ Lincoln suapɔn mu dada. Paa Grant tuaa n'ahyɛnkadeɛ firi Liverpool ɛɛba Gold Coast. Na Nkrumah gye £250, bosome biara sɛ n'akatua. Nkrumah ne amanyɔkuo UGCC nhyehyeɛ wɔ faahodie gyeɛ ho no bɔɔ ebira ne saa nti ɔtee ne ho mfeɛ mmienu akyi a na ɔne wɔn ayɛ adwuma. Nkrumah tee amanyɔkuo CPP wɔ afe 1949 mu, na ɛnam so ma ɔbɛyɛɛ Ɔmanpanin a odi kan wɔ Gold Coast mu.Nkrumah ne amanyɔkuo mpaninfoɔ binom hyiaeɛ wɔ Akyemfo, mfinfini mantɔw mu, na atesɛm kyerɛ sɛ Nkrumah angye anto mu bere a yɛde nsusueɛ baaeɛ sɛ ɔmmoa na ankorɛ ankorɛ faahodie nkɔ nkan. 

Wɔ afe 1951 abatoɔ mu no, UGCC mmɔdenmɔ na ansɔ ani. Afe a edi nim no, ɔne National Democratic Party amanyɔkuo no ne CPP foɔ a na w'ate wɔn ho no ka bɔɔ mu yɛɛ kuo baako a na yɛfrɛ wɔn Ghana Congress Party.

title: Vanessa Low
text:
Vanessa Low OAM (wɔwoo no 17 July 1990) yɛ Australiani Paralympic ogumadifoɔ a wɔwoo no wɔ Germany a ɔsi akan wɔ T42 mmirikatuo ne mmirikatuo tenten akansi mu. Wɔwoo no wɔ East Germany, na onyaa Australiani wɔ June 2017 mu.

Wɔ afe 2016 mu no, Low nko ara ne ɔbaa a ɔde mmirika resi akan wɔ mmirikatuo mu a wɔtwaa ne nan mprenu wɔ ne kotodwe atifi. Ɛmfa ho sɛ beaeɛ a wɔtwaa saa ntini yi na ɛmfa ho sɛ na ɛsɛ sɛ ɔne agumadifoɔ a wɔwɔ nan baako a ɛyɛ adwuma koraa si akan no, ɔdii nkonim kɔɔ ne mmirikatuo ne mmirikatuo tenten akansiɛ nyinaa awieeɛ wɔ 2012 Ahuhuro Paralympics wɔ London ne 2016 Summer Paralympics wɔ Rio. Wɔ Rio no ɔnyaa sika kɔkɔɔ nkonimboɔ a ɔdii wiase kwan a ɛyɛ mita 4.93 wɔ T42 mmirikatuo tenten mu ne dwetɛ nkonimboɔ wɔ T42 mita 100 akansi no mu. Wɔsan yɛɛ eyi wɔ 2020 Summer Paralympics a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Tokyo no mu de T63 ahuruhuruw tenten sika kɔkɔɔ nkonimbo ne wiase kyerɛwtohɔ ɛmfa ho mpo sɛ wɔde no too T61 mu.

Wɔwoo Low wɔ July 17, 1990 wɔ Schwerin, East Germany, na onyinii wɔ Ratzeburg. Wɔ June 2006 mu, bere a na wadi mfe 15 no, keteke bi bɔɔ no wɔ keteke kwan bi so bere a wankari pɛ no. Akwanhyia no twaa ne nan benkum na ɛmaa ɔdaa komayare mu asram abien. Bere a wɔreyɛ no oprehyɛn a egye nkwa no, wɔhyɛɛ ne nnuruyɛfo ma wotwaa ne nan foforo no. Egyee Low mfe abien ansa na ɔresan asua sɛnea ɔde ne nipadua a wɔde yɛ nipadua no bedi dwuma no nantew.

Low aware Australiani a onya sika kɔkɔɔ wɔ Paralympic akansi mu Scott Reardon.

Low ani gyee agumadi ho ansa na n’akwanhyia no reba, na na ɔpɛ sɛ ɔkɔ so di agoru wɔ ɛno akyi. Ɔsan kae sɛ Amerikani a wadi dɛm a otu mmirika tenten Cameron Clapp na ɔhyɛɛ no nkuran. Ɔde ne ho hyɛɛ agumadi mu wɔ afe 2008 mu na ɔyɛɛ ne mpanyimfo agumadi a edi kan wɔ afe koro no ara mu, nanso obuu ne nsateaa wɔ afe 2009 mu, na ɛmaa no fii akansi mu asram abiɛsa. Mfeɛ mmienu akyi no wɔpaw no maa Germany ɔman kuo no, ɔtuu kwan kɔɔ Christchurch wɔ New Zealand kɔsii akan wɔ 2011 IPC Athletics World Championships. Ɛhɔ na odii anan wɔ mmirikatu tenten mu na onyaa kɔbere wɔ T42 100m mmirikatu mu.

Wɔ afe 2012 mu no Low fatae maa mmirikatuo a ɛyɛ mita 100 ne mmirikatuo tenten mmirikatuo no nyinaa maa Summer Paralympics wɔ London. Na ahuruhuruw tenten no abue wɔ nkyekyem abiɛsa mu, F42 kosi F44, na wosii gyinae wɔ nkontaahyɛde nhyehyɛe so. Nea efii mu bae a eye sen biara a ɛyɛ mita 3.93 no maa owiee nea ɛto so asia. Wɔ mmirikatu no mu no onyaa bere 16.78, na ɛmaa ɔtraa nkonimbo gyinabea ahorow no akyi pɛɛ, na odii nea ɛto so anan wɔ ne yɔnko kuw no muni Jana Schmidt akyi. Low abam bui wɔ ne mmɔdenbɔ wɔ Agumadi no mu ne ntetee a onyae wɔ ɔkwan a ɛkɔ akyiri so a ɛde Paralympics no bae no ho. Ɔkɔɔ ne nteteefo Steffi Nerius nkyɛn, na osii gyinae sɛ obegyae akansi agumadi.

Wɔ afe 2013 mu no, Low kɔsraa n’adamfo ne ne yɔnko Germanni agumadifo Katrin Green a na ɔte United States na waware Amerikani agumadifo Roderick Green. Bere a ɔne Greens retete ne ho no, Low hui sɛ n’anigye a ɔwɔ wɔ agumadi ho no san sɔree na osii gyinae sɛ obetu akɔ States, na ɔfaa Roderick sɛ ne nteteefo foforo. Eduu afe no awiei no na wasan agyina Germany ananmu, saa bere yi wɔ 2013 Wiase Nyinaa Akansi a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Lyon no. Ɛhɔ na onyaa kɔbere nkonimbo abien, wɔ mita 100 mmirikatu ne mmirikatu tenten mu. Afe a ɛdi hɔ no, ɔnyaa nkɔsoɔ kɛseɛ wɔ ne mmirikatuo tenten mu, berɛ a ɔsii akan wɔ 2014 IPC Athletics European Championships wɔ Swansea. Ne kwan a ɛyɛ mita 4.24 no yɛ nkɔso kɛse wɔ ne akansi akɛse a atwam no mu, faako a na onhuruw nsen mita anan no. Nea efii mu bae no maa onyaa sika kɔkɔɔ, na nea ɛho hia sen saa no, odii ne wiase akansifo atitiriw baanu so nkonim: Schmidt ne Italyni Martina Caironi.

Wɔ 2016 Summer Paralympics a wɔbɛyɛ wɔ Rio no mu no, Low sii akan wɔ 2015 Wiase Nkonimdie a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Doha no mu. Wɔ mmirikatu a ɛyɛ mita 100 mu no ɔde n’ankasa nea eye sen biara a ɛyɛ 15.41s too hɔ de dii dwetɛ nkonimbo no, nanso ɛyɛ ne wiase kyerɛwtohɔ kwan a ɛyɛ mita 4.79 wɔ mmirikatu tenten mu no na ɛnyɛ sɛ ɛmaa no sika kɔkɔɔ nko na mmom ɛde no sii hɔ sɛ ogumadifo a ɛsɛ sɛ odi so nkonim Rio.

Wɔ 2016 Summer Paralympics a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Rio de Janeiro no, Low nyaa sika kɔkɔɔ nkonimboɔ a ɔdii nkonim wɔ wiase nyinaa kwan a ɛyɛ mita 4.93 wɔ T42 mmirikatuo tenten mu ne dwetɛ nkonimboɔ wɔ T42 mita 100 akansiɛ mu a ɔdii nkonim wɔ n’ankasa 15.17s mu.

Wɔ 2019 World Para Athletics Championships a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Dubai no, ɔnyaa sika kɔkɔɔ nkonimboɔ wɔ Women’s Long Jump T61-63 mu a ɔhunuu 4.68m. Ɛno ne amanaman ntam nkonimbo kɛse a edi kan a onyae a ogyinaa Australia ananmu.

Low sii akan maa Australia wɔ 2020 Summer Paralympics a wɔyɛe wɔ Tokyo no mu. Odii nkonim wɔ mmea T63 ahuruhuruw tenten mu sika kɔkɔɔ nkonimbo, na ɔboroo wiase kyerɛwtohɔ a atwam no mprɛnsa wɔ tebea horow a ɛyɛ nsu mu, na ne ahuruhuruw a etwa to ne mita 5.28.

Low ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo ne Scott Reardon.

References

title: Veronika Preining
text:
Veronika Preining yɛ Austriani a ɔbɔ ski wɔ Paralympic mu. Ogyinaa Austria ananmu wɔ Para-Alpine skiing mu wɔ 1984 Paralympic Winter Games a wɔyɛe wɔ Innsbruck no mu ne Nordic skiing mu wɔ 1988 Paralympic Winter Games a wɔyɛe wɔ Innsbruck no mu. Onyaa nkonimbo asia, sika kɔkɔɔ abien, dwetɛ abiɛsa ne kɔbere biako.

Adwuma 
Wɔ 1984 Paralympic Winter Games a wɔyɛe wɔ Innsbruck no, odii kan wɔ mmirikatu a ɛkɔ fam mu wɔ 2: 06.14 ( Sheila Holzworth wiee mmirikatu no wɔ 2: 32.42 na Cara Dunne wiee mmirikatu no wɔ 2:36.93). Onyaa dwetɛ nkonimbo wɔ super combined B1 (a bere a wɔahu sɛ ɛyɛ 2:44.63), ne kɔbere wɔ giant slalom mmirikatu kuw B1 mu wɔ 6:15.91.

Wɔ 1988 Paralympic Winter Games mu no, onyaa sika kɔkɔɔ wɔ kilomita 5 mmirikatu mu wɔ Finland ogumadifo Kirsti Pennanen ne Russiani Valentina Grigoreva anim, dwetɛ wɔ kilomita 10 mmirikatu mu, ne kɔbere wɔ kilomita 3x5 mmirikatu mu wɔ ɔfã B1-3 mu .

Osii akan wɔ 1990 Wiase Nyinaa Nordic mmubuafo akansi no mu, na onyaa sika kɔkɔɔ nkonimbo, wɔ kilomita 10 mu.

title: Victor Owusu
text:
Victor Owusu (December 26, afe 1923 – December 16, afe 2000) yɛ kane Ghanani amanyɔni ne mmaranimfo. Ɔsoom ɔman mmaranimfo, Soafo ɔwhɛ atɛntrenee ne Soafo a ɔhwɛ amanɔne nsɛm so mprenu. Na yɛ okandifo ma amanyɔkuo a enni aban mu wɔ Ghana adeyeman a edi kan no m firi afe 1979 kosii afe 1981

N'asetena mu 
Wɔ woo Owusu wɔ December da a ɛɔ 26, afe 1923 wo Agona a ɛwɔ Asante Mantam mu. Owusua yɛ obi a wɔ nimdeɛ wɔ ɛkonomis mu ana afei, okosuaa mmaranim.  Na ɔka akukudam a na wodi akotene wɔ National Liberation Movement a wotoo wɔn so aba wɔ Gold Coast abatoɔ no mu. Wɔ Ghana adehyeman a edikan no mu no, Kwame Nkrumah aban de mmara a ɛne Prevention Detention Act Act ( 1958) de no too afiase.  Woyii no wɔ February da a ɛtɔ so 24, afe 1966 bre abantuguo a amanyokuo National Liberation Council de bae. Wɔpaw no sɛ Aban Loya panyin ne Soafo a ɔhwɛ atɛntreene so wɔ NLC aban ase.

Nhomasua 
Victor Owusu kɔɔ Achimota School wɔ  afe 1937 kosii afe 1945. Wɔ saa bre no, na n'atipenfo ne K. B Asante ne Joe Reindof. ɔtoaa so kɔɔ United Kingdom kosuaa Ekonomis wɔ suapɔn a ɛne University of Nothingham na afe, mmaranim wo University of London wɔ afe 1946 mu. wɔfrɛɛ no kaa abrokyire mmaranimfo kuo a ɛne English bar no wɔ lincoln’s Inn wɔ afe 1952.

Wɔ aban no mu 
Na ɔyɛ amanyɔkuo Progressive Party amanyɔkuo a edii nkunim wɔ abatoɔ a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ afe 1969 mu. Dr. Kofi Abrefa Busia paw no sɛ Soafo a ɔhwɛ amanɔne nsɛm so mprenu wɔ Ghana adeyeman a ɛtɔ mienu no mu.  Nea edikan no wɔ afe 1969 mu na nea ɛtɔ so mienu no wɔ afe afe 1969 ne 1971 nta.  Wɔ ne mienunu no nyinaa mu no, osii Partrick Dankwa Anin a ɔno nso soom mprenu no anan mu. Ghana adehyeman a ɛtɔ mienu no baa awie wɔ Janury da ɛtɔ so 13 afe 1972 mu bre a Gneral (Kane Colonel) I. K Acheampon tuu aba no gui no.

ɔperetiafo kwankyerɛfo 
Owusu yɛ okwankyerɛfo ne wɔn a wɔtew amanyɔkuo Popular Front Party wɔ Ghana adehyeman a ɛtɔ so miensa no mu. ɔtoo so mienue maa Dr. Hilla Liman a ogyinaa wɔ amanyɔkuo People’s National Party (PNP) dii nkunim wɔ afe 1979 abatoɔ a ɛkɔɔ so no mu,  onyaa mma no mu nkyekyɛ mu 38% wo abatoɔ a wɔtoo no mprenu no mu. Wɔ abatoɔ no akyi no, amanyɔkuo PFP ne ɔperatia amnyokouo afofor kaa bom yɛ amanyɔkuo baaka a ɛne All Peoples Party (APP) a na owusu di anim. Wɔ braa amanyɔkuo AFP ne amanyɔkuo ahorow wɔ December da ɛtɔ 31, afe 1981 bre a Proviusional National Defence Council a nea odi anim ne Flt. Lt. Jerry Rawlings tuu aban no gui.

N'asetena 
Firi afe 1991 kosii sɛ owui no, Victor Owusu Putney, London, UK. Owui wɔ London wɔ December da a ɛtɔ so 16, afe 2000. Owaree Agnes Owusu.

References

title: Vincent Kwabena Damuah
text:
Reverend Father Dr. Vincent Kwabena Damuah ( Oforisuo1930 – Ɔsanaa 1992) yɛ  Catholic ɔsɔfoɔ , nyamesɛm nimdefoɔ  ne ɔmanyɔnin wɔ Ghana. Na ɔka Provisional National Defence Council (PNDC) aban no ho, ɔyɛ  kɔfabaaɛ  ma Afrikania Mission asɔre no, a na wɔfrɛ no Ɔsɔfo-kɔmfoɔ Damuah. Dr Damuah nyaa  Ph.D. abɔdin wɔ African Studies mu Ph.D. firii Howard University, afe 1971 mu. Ɔno ne Catholic obibinin sɔfoɔ a odi kan gyaee asɔre san n’akyi baa abosomsom mu na afei nso ɔboa twerɛɛ nwoma maa saa som yi  na ɔtoo ne din EDU. Ɛno nti ɔno na ɔhyɛɛ ekuo a wɔfrɛ no Afrikania Mission a ahyeta wɔ South Africa titiriw no ase; ma no yɛɛ opeemu wɔ Afrika nyamesom fawohodie mu nso.

Rev. Father Damuah yɛɛ Roman Catholic sɔfoɔ firi 1957 kɔsi 1982. Ɔyɛɛ Consultant of Afro-American Affairs pɛn wɔ Pittsburg diocese a ɛwɔ Amerika. Ɔsan baa Ghana 1976. Ne ho a ɔde bataa PNDC nti. Ɔpɛimaa 1982 mu na ɔtee ne som Afrikania Mission, ɔsomkuo a wɔfoa abosomsom so.

Wɔkyeree Rev. Damuah too mu wɔ Nkrumah berɛ so sɛ wabɔ Convention People’s Party (CPP) aban akyi sɛ wɔampam Bishop Reginald Richard Roseveare a na ɔyɛ Accra Anglican bishop kɔ ne kurom.  Archbishop John Kodjo Amissah, a na ɔyɛ Cape Coast Catholic bishop na ɔde n’ano too mu ma wɔgyae Rev Damuah. Armed Forces Revolutionary Council (AFRC) abosome nnan ɔmambuo berɛ wɔ 1979 mu no, na amanfoɔ de wɔn ano sii no so sɛ ɔgye nnipakum a na ɛrekɔso no tomu; wɔ berɛ a na Christan Council of Ghana mpene so. Na amanpanin mmiɛnsa nso ka wɔn a wɔkum wɔn no ho. Na ɔtwerɛɛ biribi sɛyi faa ho:

Ɛnnyɛ  sɛ yɛtan wɔn a yɛreku wɔn no, na yɛdɔ yɛn man dodo. Ɛdeɛn ne akekakeka fa nnipakum ho yi? Megyedi sɛ AFRC wɔ tumi sɛ wɔde kumfɔ bɛyɛ adwuma de apɛ ɔman no yie. Yɛrebɔ anidaso mpaeɛ mmom sɛ wɔn a ɛbɛdi fɔ no rennɔɔso.  Kristo wu asɛndua no so de gyee amansan. Yɛbɔ anidaso mpaeɛ nso sɛ wɔn a ɛsɛ sɛ owu no bɛgye atomu saa na wɔde akokoduro ne  nyamesuro agye Ghana.

Wɔde Rev. Damuah yɛɛ PNDC badwanin Ɔpɛpɔn 2, 1982, ɛmaa Catholic Church no bɔɔ no sensɛneɛ. Ɛrekɔ 1982 awieɛ no ono ara firii ɔmanbuo no mu..

title: Volo Afahyɛ
text:
Volo Afahye yɛ afehyia afahyɛ a ahenfo ne wɔn manfo a wɔn wɔ Akuse ɛwɔ Frao Mantam wɔ Ghana no di. Wodi saa afahyɛ yi wɔ bosome a ɛtɔ so miensa no mu.

Afa hyɛ 
Wɔde nnuane ne nsa gye ahohoɔ wɔ afahyɛ no ase. Amanfoɔ no hyɛ wɔn amammere ntade ahorɔw de kɔ dwa dataa a ahenfo no abɔ no ase. Asa ne nnwomtoɔ nso kɔ so wɔ afahyɛ no ase

Mfasoɔ 
Twodi afahyɛ yi de kae Volofo no bre a ɛbaa awiee wɔ bere a Ohene trimodenfo bi nneyɛe ma wodwane firii Togo no.

Nkekaho

title: Wa Naa's Ahenfie
text:
Wa Naa's Ahenfie yɛ Wala  fuo Ohene fie a, wɔn na wɔ dƆƆso wɔ Wa a ɛwɔ Upper West Region,Gana.Ahenfie no wɔ kuro no mfimfim a ɛyɛ abusua no nyinaa,ahenfie adwumayɛfuo,ne ahenfie nipa tittre wɔ hɔ.Ɛye bia a amanie ne amamrɛ ne mfasodeɛ ma amanmofuo.

Features 
Ahenfie no hwƐɛ tete Sudanese nƐtea dan no.Dan no sie no yɛ  Moorish dan sie ne Sahel-Sudan.

ɛdan a na ɛte sei nyinaa aanka wɔ Upper West region ,esan sɛ na adansei fuo nnim nimdieƐ ne asasɛwɔsuoƆ .

Abakɔsem 
Abakɔsem kyerɛ sɛ Wa fuo firi Sudan atoyƐ mantel wɔ Africa.Na won taa hwƐ moa so a wɔ bɛtenaa bia a won wɔ ɛnɛ no.Wɔn sii Ohene a na wɔfrƐ no Wa Naa a ɛbɛ yɛɛ din.

Wɔgyidi sɛ ɛdan no dea na ɛyɛ nɛtea bricks ne dua a ɛsɛ Y de kuraa dan no suro a atɛkyƐ wɔ 19th Century.

Wɔsii dan no sɛ wo b3 bɔ won ho ban ɛfiri atamfo nsamu.ɔhɔ nso bɛyƐƐ bia a na wɔ sie wɔn ahenfo.

Partnership 
In 2009,  World Monuments Fund  Ghana Museums and Monuments Board ka bomu dwenee sɛ sea wɔ bɛ hon ban sɛ ɛnsei. Wo gyituum sɛ Ɛyɛ bia a ɛka abackɔ honsem ne sɛdeɛ wɔ siesie ahenfie no .   Wɔ wie wɔ afe 2012.

title: Wechiau Nkramosombea
text:
Wechaiu Nkramosombea yɛ nkramo som bea a wosii no wɔ Sudanfo adansie sɛ so ne Djenne adansie sɛ so wɔ akura a wɔfrɛ no Wechiau a ɛwɔ Atifi Atɔe mantam wɔ Ghana . Ne su te sɛ Nkramo som bea a ɛwɔ Larabanga no pɛpɛɛpɛ.

Ne su 
Wosii dan wɔ sɛnea Sudanfo ne Djennefo si wɔn adan pɛpɛɛpɛ. Na ɛwɔ beae a wɔtena gye ahome te sɛ nea Sudanfo deɛ no te nanso sesei, aka baako pɛ. Emu no yɛ nea w’akyekyɛ no nketenkete na afei nso, w’akyekyɛ mu sɛnea ɛne atifi no bɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ.

Nkekaho

title: Wen Xiaoyan
text:
Wen Xiaoyan (wɔwoo no Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 12, 1997) yɛ Chinani Paralympic agumadifoɔ. Ɔgyinaa China ananmu wɔ 2016 Summer Paralympics na ɔnyaa sika kɔkɔɔ mmienu ne dwetɛ nkonimboɔ baako. Ɔsan nso nyaa sika kɔkɔɔ nkonimbo abiɛsa wɔ 2020 Summer Paralympics a wɔyɛe wɔ Tokyo, Japan no mu.

Onyaa sika kɔkɔɔ nkonimbo wɔ mmea mmirikatu tenten T37 akansi mu ne dwetɛ nkonimbo wɔ mmea mita 400 T37 akansi mu. Wɔ mmea 4 × 100 mita relay T35-T38 akansi no mu no ɔne Jiang Fenfen, Chen Junfei ne Li Yingli boom nyaa sika kɔkɔɔ nkonimbo.

Wɔ 2017 World Para Athletics Championships a wɔyɛɛ no London, United Kingdom no, ɔnyaa sika kɔkɔɔ nkonimboɔ wɔ mmaa mmirikatuo tenten T37 akansi no mu. Mfeɛ mmienu akyi wɔ 2019 World Para Athletics Championships a wɔyɛɛ no Dubai, United Arab Emirates no ɔnyaa sika kɔkɔɔ nkontabuo mmiɛnsa ne dwetɛ nkonimboɔ baako. Onyaa sika kɔkɔɔ nkonimbo wɔ mmea mita 100 T37, mmea mita 200 T37 ne mmea mmirikatu tenten T37 akansi mu. Ɔsan nso nyaa dwetɛ nkonimbo wɔ mita 4 x 100 relay akansi no mu.

Ɔnyaa sika kɔkɔɔ wɔ mita 200 T37 akansi mu wɔ 2020 Summer Paralympics a wɔyɛɛ no Tokyo, Japan no mu. Ɔnyaa sika kɔkɔɔ nkonimboɔ wɔ mita 100 T37 mmirikatuo mu a ɔnyaa wiase kyerɛwtohɔ a ɛyɛ 13.00. Ɔsan nso nyaa sika kɔkɔɔ wɔ Long Jump T37 akansi no mu.

title: Wenchi Tomato adwumayebea
text:
Wenchi Tomato Factory iyɛ adwumakuo a wɔyɛ tomantose ho adwuma de go ntotorowa mu

Beae 
Adwumako ne da kilometa 2 wɔ Wench de kɔ Ofum kwan no so a ɛwɔ Bono ne Ahafo mantam mu.

Eho  nsɛm 
Wɔ mfie pii a atwam no, nnipa firi Ghana mmeae ahorɔw aba wenchi a wonim sɛ ɛyɛ beae a Tomantose nnyɛ na, wɔn botae ne sɛ wobɛtɔ tomantose. Naso sɛ tomantose no bre no so, ne boɔ no yɛ ade a ɛba fɔm koraa ma nti akuafoɔ ntumi ntɔn wɔn nnɔbae no, na eyi ma tomantose no fa dodoɔ no ara sɛi kwa. Wɔhyehyɛɛ Wenchi dwumadibea no wɔ afe 1960 mu sɛnea ebetumi aboa akauafo no na w’atumi abɔ wɔn nnobae ho no ban. Wɔhyɛɛ adwumkuo no mu kena bere a adwumakuo bi a ne din de Ghana Industrial Holding Corporation too firii aban no ho wo afe 1997.Wogyaa adwumakuo no too ho mmere bi , na wɔ san nso bue ano wɔ 2002 kosi 2007 ma wɔhyɛɛ ase danedane tomantose no de guu ntotonturowa mu, a edin a ɛda so ne ‘’Wench Fresh””. Wɔ afe 2007 mu no, wotuu adwumakuo no mu biom esiane sɛ na wonnya Tomantose a ɛyɛ akadeɛ no mfa nni adwuma. Nea nti a ɛte saa ne sɛ na akuafoɔ no de wɔn nnɔbae no kɔ edwa so kɔtɔn ma dwadifoɔ esiane sɛ wonya mfasoɔ wɔ saa kwan no so sen sɛ wɔde bɛkɔ adwumakuo no mu akɔtɔn.

title: Wickiana
text:
Wickiana a Johann Jakob Wick ofiri Zürich (1522-1588) twerɛɛ yɛ nkrataa wɔn aboa ano. Ne dodoɔ yɛ 24 a wɔn hyehyɛe fri 1560 kɔsi 1587.

Examples

title: Willa Afahyɛ
text:
Willa Afahyɛ afehyia afahyɛ a ahenfo ne wɔn manfoɔ a wɔn wɔ Takpo a ɛwɔ Nadowli mansin a ɛwɔ Atɔe Mantam mu wɔ Ghana no di. Wodi saa afahyɛ yi wɔ bosome a ɛtɔ so ɛtɔ so nnan no mu. Afoforo nso di no wo bosome a ɛtɔ so nnum no mu.

Afa hyɛ 
Wɔde nnuane ne nsa gye ahohoɔ wɔ afahyɛ no ase. Amanfoɔ no hyɛ wɔn amammerɛ ntadeɛ ahorɔw de kɔ dwa dataa a ahenfo no abɔ no ase. Asa ne nnwomtoɔ nso kɔ so wɔ afahyɛ no ase.

Mfasoɔ 
Wodi saa afahyɛ yi de da wɔn anyame no ase, wɔde srɛ akwankyerɛ ne ahobammɔ na afei nso, woyi apaya ma abosom no.

title: William Atia Amoro
text:
William Atia Amoro yɛ kane Ghanani amnyɔni wɔ Ghana adehyeman edikan no mu. Na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛ baguani a ogyina hɔ ma Bongo abatoɔ mpɛsoa firi afe 1956 kosii afe 1966 mu. Bre a ɔwɔ mmarahyɛ bagua mu no, wɔpaw no sɛ soafo abediakyiere wɔ asoe a ɛhwɛ Nhomasua so ne asoe a ɛhwɛ afisɛm so.

.

Ne mmɔfrase 
Wɔ wɔɔ Amoro wɔ afe 1929 mu wɔ Bongo a ɛwɔ Atifi Apue Mantam mu wɔ Ghana (Kane Gold coast). Ɔkɔɔ sukuu wɔ Tamale aban Sukuu na akyire, Tamale aban akyerɛkyerɛfo ntetee sukuu.

Nnwuma ne Amanyosɛm 
Amoro hyɛɛ ade kyerɛɛ ase wɔ afe 1951 mu wɔ Nangodi Day School. ɔkyerɛɛ ade kosii afe 1954 mu bre a wɔpaw no sɛ mmarahyɛ baguani a ogyina ho ma Bongo abatoo mpesoa so. Wɔ san paw no ne mprenu soo wɔ afe 1956 mu ma no kɔɔ so gyina hɔ sɛ mmarahyɛ baguani a ogyina hɔ Bongo abatoɔ mpɛsoa so kosii afe 1966 bre a wotuu Nkrumah aban no gui. Wɔ November afe 1957 mu no, wopaw no se soafo abaedakyire wɔ asoe a ɛwhɛ Nhomasua so na wɔ July afe 1959 mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ soafo a ɔwhɛ afisɛm so abediakyire. ɔsoom wɔ saa dibea yi kosii afe 1961 mu

N'asetena mu nsɛm 
Nnneɛma a n’ani gye ho ne nnwom tie, afikyifuo nhwiren ho nnwuma

Nkekaho

title: William Godson Bruce-Konuah
text:
Dr. William Godson Bruce – Konuah (May da ɛtɔ so 14, afe 1932 – October da ɛtɔ so 2, afe 2002) yɛ kane Ghanani oduroyɛfo, amanyɔsɛm ne Soafo wɔ adehyeman a ɛtɔ so mienu no mu

Ne mmɔfrase 
Wɔ woo no wɔ May da ɛtɔ so 1932 mu. Na ne papa ne Dr. Kofi George Konua, CBE, a ɔyɛ nhomasua mu kunini. ɔhyɛɛ Sukuu ase wɔ Accra Government boys Sukuu firi afe 1936 kosii afe 1945 na ɔtoaa so kɔɔ ntoaso sukuu a ɛne Accra Academy firi afe 1946 kosii afe 1951. Wɔ afe 1955 mu no, ɔtoaa so kɔɔ Suapɔn a ɛne Norwood College, London ma no nyaa abɔdin krataa wɔ afe 1957 mu, ne suapɔn a ɛne University of Liverpool firi afe 1958 kosii afe 1963 ma no nyaa abɔdin krataa wo nnuroye mu (Mb Chb).

Nnwuma 
Bre a owie ntoaso sukuu no, ɔkɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛni wɔ kane sukuu a ɔkɔe a ɛde Accra Academy firi afe 1953 kosii afe 1955 mu. ɔsan n’akyi baa Ghana bre a owiee ne nhomasua wɔ Liverpool Suapɔn no maa no kɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ asoeɛ a ɛhwɛ Akwahosan so sɛ aduroyɛfo wɔ Korlebu na akyire sɛ aduroyɛfo panyin a ɔda Tema Mansin ne Tema Ayaresabea, ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ saa dibea yi kosii afe 1969 bre a ɔde n’adwuma too hɔ ma ɔde ne ho kɔhyɛɛ amnyɔsɛm mu. ɔhyɛɛ ase yɛɛ adwuma sɛ ankorɛankorɛ aduroyɛfo.  Osii Ghana anan mu (asoe a ɛhwɛ akwahosanso) wɔ dwumadie amansan akwahosan kuo a ɛne World Health Organisation yɛ faa sɛnea wosi nsamanwa kwan.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔ afe 1969 mu no, wɔpaw no sɛ mmarahyɛ badwani a ogyina hɔ ma Tema abatoɔ a mpɛsoa so. Wɔsan nso paw no sɛ Soafo a ɔhwɛ Adansie so wɔ September bosome no mu wɔ afe 1969, ɔsoom wɔ saa dibea kosii January afe 1972 bre a General I.K Acheampong kuo a ɛne Supreme Military Council (Ghana) no tuu Busia aban no gui

Nkeka ho

title: William Kwabena Aduhene
text:
William Kwaben Aduhene yɛ kane Ghanani nhomasa mu kunini ne amnyɔni. ɔye Kane mmarahyɛ baguani a ogyina hɔ ma Sefwi Wiaso abatoɔ mpɛsoa so firi afe 1956 kosii afe 1965 mu. Wɔ afe 1965 mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ mmarhye baguani a ogyina hɔ ma Wassaw –Akropong abatoɔ mpɛsoa so. Bre ɔwɔ mmarahyɛ bagua mu no, okuraa dibea ahorɔw pii; na ɔyɛ soafo abediakyire ma ɔman soafo a ɔhwɛ ma aban nyehyɛe kɔ so mmarahyɛ bagua mu, wɔpaw no akyire sɛ soafo abediakyire a ɔhwɛ ahobanbɔ so, na ɔsoom sɛ otitenani maa adwumakuo a ɛne State Diamond Corperations. Ansa na ɔde ne ho bɛhyɛɛ amanyosɛm mu no, na ɔyɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛni wɔ Sefwi Wiawso

Ne mmɔfrase ne nhomasua 
Wɔ woo Aduhene wɔ August da a ɛtɔ so 8, afe 1927 wɔ Aboduam wɔ Sefwi – Wiawso mansin a ewɔ Atɔe Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.  ɔhyee nhomsua ase wɔ Sefwi Wiawso Aban sukuu firi afe 1937 kosii afe 1944 ma no nyaa abodin krataa a ene Standard Seven Middle Leaving Certitificate. ɔtoaa so kɔɔ St. Augustiens College wo afe 1946 mu kosuaa ade sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfni.  Owie adekyerɛ ntetee sukuu no wɔ afe 1949 ma no nyaa abodin krataa wɔ adekyerɛ mueceived his teanhers' certificate "A" and qualified as a teacher in 1949.

Nnwuma ne amanyɔsɛm 
Aduhene hyɛɛ adwuma sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo wɔ Sefwi – Wiawso Local Council School a ɛwɔ Dabunso wɔ afe 1950 mu. Ogyaa adekyerɛ adwuma no too hɔ de ne ho kɔhyɛɛ amanyɔsɛm mu wɔ afe 1956. Wɔ afe 1956 mu no, ogyina ma wɔtoo aba wɔ ne so sɛ mmarahyɛ begauani a ogyina hɔ ma Sefwi – Wiawso abatoɔ mpɛsoa wɔ amanyɔkuo Convntions Peoples Party din mu. Okuraa saa dibea no mu kosii afe 1965 bre a ɔbeye mmarahye baguani ma Wassaw – Akropong abatoɔ mpesoa so. Okuraa saa dibea no mu kosii afe 1966 bre a wotuu Nkruma ban no gui. Bre ɔwɔ mmarahyɛ bagua mu no, okuraa dibea ahorɔw pii; na ɔye soafo abediakyire ma ɔman soafo a ɔhwe ma aban nyehye kɔ so mmarahyɛ bagua mu, wɔpaw no sɛ akyire sɛ soafo abediakyire a ɔhwɛ ahobanbɔ so. Ansa na 1966 abantuguo no bɛba no, na ɔyɛ otitenani maa adwumakuo a ɛne State Diamond Corperations

N'asetena mu nsɛm 
Aduhene waree wɔ afe 1951 mu nanso, awareɛ no gui wɔ afe 1952 mu a na ɔwɔ abɔfra baako. Wɔ afe 1959 mu no, ɔwaree Awura Jane Ghartey.

title: Wiz Kudowor
text:
Wisdom Wiz Kudowor (wɔ woo no September da ɛtɔ so 19, afe 1957) yɛ mfoni ho dwumadifo a ofiri Ghana man mu.

Kudowor nyaa sukuu pɔn ho kyɛfa wɔ suapɔn a ɛne College of Art, University of Science and Technology, Ghana . ɔde n’adesua baa awie  wɔ afe 1981 a na ɔne odikanfo wɔ mfoniho dwumadie mu

.W’ahyehyɛ nneɛma pii wɔ Ghana man mu a emu baako ne mfoni ɛwɔ Kwame Nkrumah Memorial Park. Ne nwuma da adi wɔ ankorɛankore ne amansan nyinaa mu a emu bi nea ɛwɔ Artists Alliance Gallery a ɛwɔ Labadi, Accra.

References

title: Wli Aworoeɛ Afahyɛ
text:
Wli Aworoeɛ Afahyɛ yɛ afehyia afahyɛ a ahenfo ne won manfoɔ a wɔn wɔ Wli a ɛwɔ Frao Mantam mu wɔ Ghana no di. Wɔn a wodi ne Todzi, Agoviefe ne Afegame mpoatam ho fo. Wodi afahye wɔ Bosome a ɛtɔ so nsɛn mu. Wli Aworoeɛ da bɛyɛ kilomita 20 firi Hohoe.

Afahyɛ 
Wɔ afahyɛ no bere mu, wɔda akokurokosɛm ne nneɛma a woyi kyere adi. Ahenfo ne wɔn manfoɔ no nso de nnaseɛ ma wɔn ho wɔn ho.

Mfasoɔ 
Wodi afahyɛ no de da Onyankopon ase sɛ w’ama wɔn aworoeɛ a ɛhɔ daa na ɛma wɔn nsuo wɔ mpɔtam hɔ.

Nkekaho

title: Woyiram Boakye-Danquah
text:
Woyram Boakye-Danquah yɛ ɔhwɛfoɛ ne kane Manpanyin ananmusifo a ɔwɔ South Dai mansin a ɛwɔ Frao Mantam mo wɔ Ghana.

Boachie-Danquah ayɛ adwuma sɛ ɔhwɛfo wo nnwuma pii mu ansa na ɔde ne kɔhyɛɛ amanyɔsɛm mu. Manpanyin John Kuffour paw no wɔ afe 2005 mu sɛ manpanyin ananmusifo a ɔwɔ Dayi South Mansin no mu.  Okuraa saa dibea no kosii bre a Kofour aban no baa n’awaie wɔ abatoɔ a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ afe 2008 no akyi. Manpanyin Mills de Kafui Bekui a ɔyɛ nsumnam mu nimdeɛfo no sii n’anan mu wɔ afe 2009.

Nkekaho

title: Yaa Asantewa Akorae
text:
Yaa Asantewa Akorae yɛ akorae a ɛwɔ Atwima Mponua mpɛsoa so wɔ Ghana.Wosii sɛ wɔde bɛbɔ Asantefoɔ kandifo Yaa Asantewaa, a na ɔyɛ ɔhemmaa wɔ Ejisu no aba so.

Wosii akorae no wɔ afe 2000 mu sɛ wɔ de bedi mfeha a Asante ko no adi no. Ne boate ne sɛ wɔde besi Asante ahenfie sɛnea ɛte pɛpɛɛpɛ wɔ afe ca.1900 mu.

Wɔ afe 2004 mu no, ogya tɔɔ akorae no mu na nneɛma ahorɔw a ɛwɔ mu no hyee koraa ma ayɔwa ne nhinna kakra bi na wotumi fae. Eisane a ogya a ɛhyee nneɛma na wotuu akorae no mu nti, akwansrafo a wɔkɔ hɔ no so ate koraa.

Wɔ October afe 2009 mu no, mpanyinfoɔ a wɔn wɔ kuro no mu de wɔn tii bɔɔ mu kae sɛ wɔpɛ sɛ wɔn ankasa siesie akorae no, na wɔ afe 2016 mu no, adwumakuo a ne din de UNICEF gyee pene sɛ ɔde sika &100 Million bɛboa wɔn. Akorae fofro no bɛkɔ so wɔ asase a ne kɛseɛ yɛ ɛka 14.

Nkekaho

title: Yaa Asantewaa Afahyɛ
text:
Yaa Asantewa Afahyɛ yɛ afehyia afahyɛ a ahenfo ne wɔn manafo a wɔn Ejisu a ɛwɔ Asante mantam no di wɔ Ghana. Wodi afahyɛ yi wɔ bosome a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe no mu.

Afa hyɛ 
Ahenfo no bɔ dwa kɛseɛ a nea ɔda edwabɔ no ane ne ɔmanhene a ɔwɔ Ejisu.

Mfasoɔ 
Ahenfo ne Ejisumanfo no kyerɛ obuo ma Yaa Asantewa a wonim no sɛ Asantefo ɔhoɔdenfo a odii wɔn anim kodii nkunim wɔ Britishfo no so wɔ afe 1901 mu. Wɔsan nso de afahye no kae akokoduru a ɔdaa no adi bere a osii Britishfo no kwan ma w’antumi angye Sikadwa no amfiri Asantefo nsam no, na eyi na ɔde ɔsɔretia bae wɔ afe 1690 awie mu ho.

Saa Pogh Naa a ofori Ahenfi na ɔde Yaa Asantewaa afahyɛ no sii hɔ sɛ nea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔde bɛkae Asantehemaa, Nana Prempeh ne Ahenfo afoforo a Britishfo no twaa wɔn asu kɔɔ Seychelles wɔ afe 1900s mu no.

Nkekaho

title: Yagle-Kuure Afahyɛ
text:
Yagle-Kuure Afahyɛ yɛ afahyɛ a ahenfo ne wɔn manfo a wɔn wɔ Tindongsbligo a ɛbɛn Bolgatanga wɔ Atifi Apuei Mantam wɔ Ghana no di. Wodi afahyɛ no wɔ bosome a edikan no ne bososome a ɛtɔ mienu no mu.

Afa hyɛ 
Wɔ afahyɛ bere no mu no, wotu amanfo no fo ma wɔtwe won ho firi ogya ahyeahye ho ne titiriw wɔ mmeae wɔn abosom dan ne kwae krɔnkrɔn no wɔ.

Mfasoɔ 
Amanfoɔ no di afahyɛ no te sɛ mmusua amammere a wɔde da won anyame ne wɔn nananom nsamanfo ase sɛ wɔbɔɔ wɔn ban na wɔmaa wɔn nuane pii wɔ saa afe no mu .

title: Yakubu Tali
text:
Tolon Naa Alhaji Yakubu Alhassan Tali yɛ kane Ghanani amnyɔni ne ɔhenpɔn a ɔwɔ Tolon ne amanyɔkuo Nothern People’s Party no hyehyefo no mu baako.

Nkekaho

title: Year of Return, Ghana 2019
text:
Year of Return, Ghana 2019 yɛ  Ghana aban ne Adinkra kuo a ɛwɔ Amerika na akabom yɛeɛ, a ne botae ne sɛ ɛbɛhyɛ abibifoɔ a ɛwɔ amanɔne nkuran ama wɔasan aba wɔn nkyi Africa (Ghana titiriw) abɛtena na wɔabɛbuebue nnwuma nso. Ɔmanpanin Nana Akufo-Addo na ɔkɔdaa nadi 2018 wɔ Washington, sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ na amanɔne Abibifoɔ ne Afrikafoɔ bɛnya nkabomu. Afe 2019 nkaeɛ afe ma mfe ahanan a wɔde Afrika nkoa dii kan kɔɔ America asaase so wɔ Jamestown ne Virginia. Dwumadie yi nso kyerɛ yɛn ani a ɛsɔ amanɔne abibifoɔ mɔdemmɔ ne wɔn kankɔ wɔ saa berɛ yi mu. Ghana Tourism Authority ne Ministry of Tourism, Arts and Culture nso ahyehyɛ dwumadie ahodoɔ de rehyɛ "Abibifoɔ a yɛnnhinhim suban" no kutupa. Afrika Amerikafoɔ bebree nso dii nkɔmɔ faa wɔn Ghana nsra ne wɔn suahunu saa berɛ yi.

Botaeɛ 

 Sɛdeɛ yɛbɛma Ghana ayɛ anika ama Afrika Amerikafoɔ ne amanɔne Afrikafoɔ aba nsrahwɛ. 
 Sɛdeɛ yɛbwhehwɛ asiesie deɛ yɛahwere wɔ mfeɛ 400 a atwamu yi.
 Sɛdeɛ nnwumayɔ bɛkɔ so na yɛahyɛ ayɔnkofa a ɛda Afrika Amerikafoɔ ne Amanɔne Afrikafoɔ ntɛm.

Nsrafoɔ 
Jackson Lee kaa saa dwumadie yi bɔɔ African American History Commission Act a wchyehyɛɛ no Congress afe 2017 mu no ho. Amerika siniyini Michael Jai White bɛsraa Ghana afe 2018 awieɛ hɔnom. Amanɔne Afrkafoɔ a wɔfiri aman aduanan ne akyire mu ka wɔn a wɔba bɛdii "Full Circle Festival" no bi. Ebinom nso ne

Akwamuhene Odeneho Kwafo Akoto III, Akwamumanhene sii Jai White ɔhene berɛ a ɔbaaɛ no, maa no din Nana Oduapɔn. Ɔhene White akondwadin no aseɛ ne sɛ "Dua a ne nhini mu yɛ den nti ɛnsuro mframa".

Sikasɛm 
Yɛrehwɛ anim sɛ ebeduru afe yi awieɛ no na nsrahwɛfoɔ, atitire, amanaman mu amanyɔfoɔ ne akandifoɔ bɛyɛ ɔpepem 1.5 aba ɔman yi mu ama yɛanya sika bɛyɛ ɔpepepem $1.9 afiri "Year of Return" dwumadie no mu. Nsrahwɛ fa no nso kɔɔ anim paa kɔsii 18% wɔ Amerikafoɔ, Britainfoɔ, Carribeanfoɔ ne amantitire bi a  wɔbaaɛ. Ɛna yɛnyaa ntomu 45% wɔ nsrahwɛfoɔ a wɔfaa wiemhyɛn gyinabea hɔ afe afe no mu.

Yɛabu no sɛ ankorɛnkorɛ nsrahwɛfoɔ sikayie nso kɔɔ anim ara firii $1,862 wɔ 2017 mu kɔɔ seisei $2,589, a ɛbɛma ɔman sikasɛm wɔ nsrahwɛmu no abɛyɛ ɔpepepem $1.9.

title: Zika atiridii
text:
Zika atiridii (a wͻsan frε no Zika mmoawa yare yε yare a nea εde ba ne Zika mmoawa.Wͻn a wonya yare yi dodow no ara ntaa nnya εho nsεnkyerεnne, nanso mpεn pii no εda ne ho adi bͻkͻͻ na ebetumi asε ntontom atiridii.Nsεnkyerεnne no bi ne ahoͻhyew, ani a ayε kͻkͻͻ, dompe mu yaw, tipae, ne nsawansawa.Mpεn pii no, εho nsεnkyerεnne ntaa nni nnansͻnWͻ yare no mfiase mu no, εmmaa obi nhweree ne nkwa ε.Wͻde yare yi abata Guillain–Barré yare(GBS) ho.

Nea εde Zika atiridii ba titiriw ne ntontom a  εyε Aedes de a waka obi no.Ebetumi nso atrεw denam nna mu yare a εnam nna mu trεw fi barima ho de ma wͻn a ͻne wͻn da na ebetumi atrεw nso denam mogya a wͻde ma mu. Wͻn a wͻanyinsεn a wͻanya bi betumi de ama wͻn mma na wͻde abata nyinsεn a εsεe ho ne ti a εyε ketewaa. Wͻyε yare yi mu nhwehwεmu denam mogya, dwensͻ, anaa ntasu mu a wͻhwehwε sε wobehu Zika mmoawa no anaa RNAbere a nipa no yare.

Wosiw ano denam ntontom a εde ba a wokunkum wͻn wͻ mmeae a yare no wͻ ne kͻndͻm a wͻde di dwuma wͻ nna mu so. Mmͻden a wͻbͻ de siw ntontom yi kwan ne nnuru a εpam ntummoa, ntade a wͻhyε, ntama a εpam ntontom, ne nsu a εtaataa hͻ a woyi fi hͻ. Wonni nsu a εko tia yare ma eyi. Akwanhosan ho adwumayεfo hyε nyansa sε mmea a wͻwͻ mmeae a yare Zika mmoawa a aba (afe 2015 de ba) kosi 2016 Zika a aba besusuw ho sε wͻbεtwe nyinsεn akͻ akyiri na wͻn a wͻanyinsεn nso nnkͻ mmeae yi. Bere a wonni ayaresa pͻtee no, paracetamol(acetaminophen) betumi aboa adwudwo ano. Mpεn pii no, εho nhia sε obi da ayaresabea.

Wodii kan huu mmoawa a εde yare yi ba wͻ afe 1947 mu. Yare yi a edii kan bae a wͻayε ho kyerεwtohͻ sii wͻ afe 2007 wͻ Micronesia aman mu. Ebedu Ɔpεpͻn afe 2016 mu no,  na yare no wͻ amantam aduonu wͻ Amεrika amanmu. Wonim sε asi wͻ Afrika, Asia, ne Pacific amantam nso mu. Esiane sε yare no bae wͻ Brazil wͻ afe 2015 mu nti, Wiase Akwanhosan Ahyehyεde akyerε sε εyεAman nyinaa Akwanhosan  ho asεm a egye Ntεmpε wͻ Ogyefo afe 2016 mu.

Nsεm afoforo

Nkyekyem:Gao lazamankwala

title: Zumbenti Afahyɛ
text:
Zumbenti Afahyɛ afehyia afahyɛ a ahenfo ne wɔn manfoɔ a wɔn wɔ Kaleo a ɛwɔ Nadowli mansin a ɛwɔ Atɔe Mantam mu wɔ Ghana no di. Wodi saa afahyɛ yi wɔ bosome a ɛtɔ so ɛtɔ so nnan no mu. Afoforo nso di no wo bosome a ɛtɔ so nnum no mu.

Afa hyɛ 
Wɔde nnuane ne nsa gye ahohoɔ wɔ afahyɛ no ase. Amanfoɔ no hyɛ wɔn amammerɛ ntadeɛ ahorɔw de kɔ dwa dataa a ahenfo no abɔ no ase. Asa ne nnwomtoɔ nso kɔ so wɔ afahyɛ no ase.

Mfasoɔ 
Wɔdi saa afahyɛ de da wɔn anyame ase, wɔde tew wɔn nsaase firi ahomhom bɔne ho na afei nso, wɔde afahyɛ no ka mmusua bomu. Wohu no sɛ saa bere no yɛ bre a ɛsɛ ma awareɛ nhyehyei.

Nkekaho

title: Ɔbea awode sɛe
text:
Ɔbea awode sɛe, FGM, a wɔsan frɛ no ɔbea awode twitwa ne ɔbea twetiatwa, sɛnea Wiase Akwanhosan Ahyehyɛde (WHO) kyerɛ “akwan ahorow nyinaa a wɔfa so yi ɔbea awode anim fa bi anaa anim nyinaa anaa biribi foforo a ɛte saa a wɔyɛ ɔbea awode bere a ɛnyɛ aduruyɛ anaa ayaresa nti na wɔreyɛ saa.” Wɔyɛ FGM sɛ amammere ade wɔmmusuakuw wɔ aman aduonu asɔn mu Sahara anafo ne Afrika Atifi apuei, ne Asia, Apuei Mfinimfini ne atukɔfo mu wɔ mmeae afoforo.  Mfe a obi bedi ansa na wɔayɛ no eyi gu ahorow, fi nna kakra wɔ awo akyi kosi bere a wafi bra ase; wɔ aman a wɔbɔ ho amaneɛ no, emu fa kyere sɛ emu dodow no ara na wɔde yɛ mmea a wonnii mfe anum.

Ɔkwan a wɔfa so yɛ eyi no gu ahorow, na egyina abusuakuw no so. Nea ɛka eyi ho ne yi a woyi(fa bi anaa ne nyinaa ɔbea awode ano ne awode ano nkataso awode no ano nyinaa anaa ne fa bi ne awode no anim; na nea ɛkɔ akyiri mu no infibulation ne nyinaa anaa ne fa bi ne awode anim ne n’ase a wɔkata ani. Wɔ ɔkwan a etwa to yi mu, a WHO frɛ no Type III FGM, wogya tokuru ketewa na ama ɔbea no atumi adwensɔ na wayɛ bra, na wobue n’ase tokuru no mu na ama ɔne barima atumi ahyia na wawo nso. Akwanhosan ho nsunsuanso gyina ɔkwan a wɔfaa so yɛe no so ebi ne nyarewa a ɛba bere ne bere mu, ɛyaw a ano yɛ den, kotoku a ahyɛ nsu, nyinsɛn a ɛmma, awo mu ɔhaw ahorow ne mogyatu.

Adeyɛ yi ase fi bɔbeasu ho nhwehwɛanim, mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ mmea so, ne nsusuwii a ɛfa krɔnnyɛ, ahobrɛase ne hwɛbea. Mpɛn pii no mmea na wɔtaa yɛ, na wobu no sɛ ɛma nidi, na wosuro sɛ sɛ wɔamma wɔn mmabea ne wɔn nananom anyɛ a, ɛbɛma mmea no ahyia ankonamyɛ wɔ mpɔtam hɔ. Mmea bɛboro ɔpepem ɔha aduasa na wɔayɛ wɔn FGM yi bi wɔ aman aduonu akrɔn a ɛrekɔ so wom no mu. Nnipa bɛboro ɔpepem awotwe na wɔatwa wɔn twetia yi, na wohu eyi titiriw wɔ Djibouti, Eritrea, Somalia ne Sudan.

Wɔabara anaasɛ wɔde anohyeto ato FGM so wɔ aman a ɛrekɔ so wom pii mu, nanso mmara ahorow no nnyɛ adwuma. Amanaman abɔ mmɔden fi 1970 mfe no mu sɛ wɔbɛma nkurɔfo agyae adeyɛ yi, na wɔ afe 2012 mu no Amanaman Nkabom Nhyiam Kɛse, sii gyinae sɛ FGM yɛ obi fahodi a wɔsɔre tia. Ebinom kasa tia sɔre a wɔsɔre tia adeyɛ yi, ne titiriw nnipa abakɔsɛm animdefo.Eric Silverman kyerɛw sɛ FGM abɛyɛ asɛm titiriw a nnipa abakɔsɛm nhwehwɛmufo de wɔn adwene asi so, na ɛma nsɛntitiriw binom sɔre faamammere a egu ahorow, afoforo nneyɛe a wɔma ho kwan ne nnipa fahodi ho mmara a wɔma ɛfa obiara ho no.

title: Ɔhene Okaikoi
text:
Ohene Okaikoi ye kane Sahene a ɔde asrafodɔm kuo a ɛde Akwashong sii hɔ, ɛno na ɛnam so maa wonyaa Ga-Dangbefoɔ asrafodɔm nsesae nhyehyɛe no bae.

Abakosɛm 
Na Koikoi awofo ne Mampong Okai ne Doded Akabi. ɔhene Okai Koi ne Denmark yɛɛ daa apam a ɛfa dwadie ho wɔ abankɛse Christianborg wɔ ɔsana bosome da ɛtɔ so 18, afe 1661 mu. Ɔno na ɔde Osu asase no maa Danefo maa wɔhyee Christianborg abankese no si ase.

Bre a na ɔne Akwamufo de ɔko sii ani, ɔno ankasaa asrafo ne Sahene yii no mae na odwane gyaa no wɔ ɔko no mu. Okaikoi bɔɔ wɔn a wodwane gyaa no n no dua na ohyiraa wɔn a wɔne no Koe kosii awie. Na ɔno anksaa kuu ne ho akyire. Eno na ɛde basabasa bae wɔ Gaodangbe abakɔsɛm mu. Mmea ne mmɔfra bɛyɛ mpem bebree yɛ nea wɔfaa wɔn wɔ Ayawaso esiane n’akooduru a ɔdaa  no adi nti. Ne wuo na ɛde Ayawaso nnisoɔ no baa n’awie; Nkranfoɔ dodɔ no ara san wɔn akyi kɔɔ Ancho anaa Little Popo na nkaefoɔ no kɔɔ wɔn akyi wɔ mpoano. Dwadie hyɛɛ ase kɔɔ so yiyie esiane sɛ na Abrɔfo no ama Nkran (Ga Mashi) anya mpontuo asen Ayawaso.

Ɔheneba Ashangmong toa ɔko a w’ato din guerrilla ɔsa no so ma no pamoo Akwamufo no kɔɔ Mfanteman mu. Ɔheneba Ashangmong papa ne Okai Yai a na ɔyɛ Kokikoi nuaberima. Afei, ɔhene ba no de Nkranfo no nyinaa firii Labadi kopue mu wɔ Ningo.

Nkekaho

title: Ɔkra
text:
Ɔkraman a ɔte fie (Felis catus) ne ɔkwan a efi wuram ɔkraman (Felis silvestris), a ɔyɛ nufuboa a odi nam a ofi Felidae abusua mu no a wɔyɛn no mu ba. Kan no na wobu no sɛ eyi fã ketewaa bi, wɔ edin Felis silvestris catus ase.

Ɛyɛ afieboa atitiriw no mu biako na ɛnnɛ ɛwɔ mmoa ahorow bɛyɛ aduonum a adansedi ahyehyɛde ahorow no gye tom. Wɔ aman pii mu no, ɔkraman hyɛ mmara a ɛfa afie mu mmoa a wodi nam te sɛ akraman ne akraman ho no ase. Ne titiriw no, ɔkraman yɛ asasesin mu de, na ɔkyere mmoa nketewa te sɛ mpɔtorɔ anaa nnomaa. Mpataa wɔ nne ahorow ahorow a nea ɛka ho ne purrs, meows, hisses, anaa growls, ɛwom sɛ wɔnam anim ne nipadua gyinabea ne pheromones so titiriw na edi nkitaho de.

Mpataa a wɔwɔ dan mu nya wɔn ahomegye titiriw wɔ nketewa mu.

text: Ɔkɔdeɛ ahorrow bɛyɛ 60 na ɛgu Afrika ne Eurasia. Ɔkɔdeɛ yɛ anomaa bi a ne mu yɛ du na ne ho yɛ den yiyie.

title: Ɛda a yɛde kae yɛn kɔfabae (Ghana)
text:
''Founders' Day'' yɛ Ghanaman afofida a yɛde kae yɛn Nananom (''the Big Six''), ko a wokooɛ de gyee faahodie maa yɛn. Akane no na yɛfrɛ ɛda no, Kɔfabae da, efirisɛ na yɛde kae Ɔsagyefo Dr. Kwame Nkrumah ɛwɔ ne mmɔdenmɔ wɔ Ghana faahodie gyeɛ firi aborɔfo no nsam' mu. Ɛsan sɛ n'awoda yɛ ɛbɔ 21 nti, na yɛhyɛ saa ɛfa yi ɛbɔ 21 afe biara. Nsakyeraeɛ a ɛbaaeɛ wɔ saa afofida yi die mu sii Ɔman Panyin Akuffo Addo berɛ so,  berɛ a ɔkyerɛɛ sɛ wɔn a na wɔka Ɔsagyefo Nkrumah ho a yɛfrɛ wɔn ''the Big Six'' no nso fata sɛ yɛhyɛ wɔn anuonyam firi sɛ wɔn nso boaaeɛ ɛwɔ ɔman yi faahodie ko no mu. Saa nnipa nnum yi ne: Edward Akufo-Addo, Joseph Boakye Danquah, Emmanuel Obetsebi-Lamptey, William Ofori Atta, ɛne Ebenezer Ako-Adjei. Saa Nipa kuo yi na ɛka Ɔsagyefo Nkrumah ho ma wɔyɛ nsia a afe biara yɛhyɛ wɔn anuonyam, Ɔsanaa 4, Ghana kɔfabae afofida no mu.

Abakɔsɛm 
Na yɛhyɛ Ɔman kɔfabae fa yi ɛbɔ, 21 afe biara de kae Ɔsagyefo Kwame Nkrumah, ɔmanpanin a odi kan ɛwɔ ne mmɔdenmɔ ɔbbɔeɛ, ɔne ɔman no akunini nsia (Big Six) ɛwɔ ɔman no ko ma faahodie no. Ɔmanpanin Nana Addo Dankwah Akuffo Addo na ɔhyɛɛeɛ sɛ yɛnsesa ɛda a yɛde hyɛ fa no nnkɔ Ɔsanaa, 4 na yɛnfa nnkae akunini nsia no ne obiara a  ɔboaaeɛ wɔ ɔman no faahodie mu  na mmom nnyɛ Kwame Nkrumah nko ara. Afei Ɔmanpanin san yɛ nhyehyeɛ sɛ,  ɛbɔ 21, no nnyɛ Kwame Nkrumah nnkae da; Kwame Nkrumah awoda ne saa da no. Saa nhyehyeɛ yi maa yɛnnyaa kɔfabae da, sɛ ɛda a yɛde kae ɔman mo mu akunini nyinaa na afei Kwame Nkrumah awoda; ɛda a yɛde kae Nkrumah na yɛhyɛ no anuonyam sɛ Ghana manpanin odi kan ne okunini a odii anim' ko gyee Ghana faahodie.

Ɛwɔ bosome ɔbɛnim, afe 2019, mu no, ɔman mu afofida ho nhyehyeɛ sɛ Ɔsanaa 4, nnyɛ kɔfabae da bɛyɛɛ mmara. Ɔsanaa 4, a ɛyɛ kɔfabae afofida no nso ne bere a yɛtee ɔman yi mu  amanyɔkuo a edi kan, UGCC no kɔ pɛ; Ɔsanaa 4, afe 1947. Kɔfabae da yɛ da bi a yɛde hyɛ akunini nsia no a yɛboa gyee Ghana faahodie,  ɛna Kwame Nkrumah nkae da no yɛ ɛda a yɛde kae Nkrumah sɛ Ɔman no manpanin a odi kan na afei yɛde di n'awoda.

Ɛda no so mfasoɔ 
Kɔfabae da nso yɛ da bi a Ghanafoɔ de kaekae akunini ne anintini a woboaeɛ wɔ Ghana faahodie gyeɛ mu. Wɔsan di ɛda yi de hyɛ te manmu foɔ ne wɔn a ɛtutu kwan nyinaa nkuran sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a wɔn ani bɛgye wɔn kuro (Ghana) ho. Ɛwɔm sɛ wɔdi afofida yi de kae wɔn Nananom deɛ, wɔsan nso de yɛ nnyinasoɔ de wɔn ho hyɛ ɔman no dwumadie nyinara mu.

Ɔmanmu Nkyerɛkyerɛ 

 Ɔsanaa 4, 2019

da no yɛɛ nnawɔtwe awieɛ ɛno nti Aban soafoɔ a ɔhwɛ afisɛm so de krataa ba abɔnten a na efiri manpanin asoeɔɛ de kaa sɛ,  yɛbɛhyɛ ɛfa no dwoada a na ɛyɛ,  Ɔsanaa 5, 2019. Wɔyɛɛ abɔnten nkyerɛkyerɛ ne anuonyam hyɛ maa ɔman no mu mpaninfoɔ wɔ 'Accra International Conference Center'.

 Ɔsanaa 4, 2020

Wɔ ɔsanaa 4, 2020 no, Dagbon hene,  Yaa Naa Abubakari Mahama II na ɔyɛɛ ti tena ni maa dwumadie no. Ahenfo ahodoɔ baa dwumadie no ase na mmarahyɛ badwam kasamafo,  Prof. Aaron Mike Oquaye na ɔkasaa wɔ dwumadie no ase. Yaa Naa kasamafoɔ   Zamgbali Naa, Dr  Jacob Mahama wɔ ne nkasaeɛ mu no bɔɔ obiara a ɔboaeɛ ɛwɔ ɔman no faahodie gyeɛ mu na ɔsan hyɛɛ mu kena sɛ ɛwɔ sɛ yɛbɔ obibiara aba so wɔ faahodie ko no mu wɔ bere koro a yɛnfa yɛn ani nsi Kwame Nkrumah nkoaa so.

Mmarahyɛ badwam dɔm dodoɔ baano da fo, Mr. Osei Kyei-Mensah Bonsu, Dr. Owusu Afriyie Akoto, Mr. Kojo Oppong Nkrumah,  nsɛmtwerɛfoɔ panin,  Mr. Roland Affail Monney ne atitire binom a wɔn baa dwumadie no ase.

Dwumakuo yɛfrɛ wɔn The Open Foundation West Africa nso de Ghana Kɔfabae ho atwerɛ akansie baae sɛdeɛ ɛbɛboa ama atwerɛ ɛfa Ghana mpaninfoɔ ho adɔɔso wɔ Wikipedia.

Akansie yi firi Ɔsanaa 1, de kɔsii Ɔsanaa 31, 2020, na ɛboa ma nkyerɛkyerɛ a ɛfa Ghana kɔfabae na yɛɛbɔ ɔman no abakɔsɛm ho ban no kɔɔ nkan

Ntawantawadie 
Amanyɔkuo NDC ne CPP nfoa manpanin Akuffo Addo nhyehyeɛ foforɔ sɛ ɔman no de Ɔsanaa 4, no bɛkae Ɔman no akunini no. Wɔn nnyinasoɔ ne sɛ Akuffo Addo pɛ sɛ ɔsesa ɔman no abakɔsɛm, na ɔma ne wɔfɔ JB Danquah;amanyɔkuo UGCC baanodani nkuto nya anuonyam firi sɛ Kwame Nkrumah tee ne ho firi saa amanyɔkuo no mu bɛtee ɔnoaa ne amanyɔkuo CPP na ɛnam ne saa yɔ so maa ne bɛyɛɛ Ghana manpanin a odi kan.

title: George Kingsley acquah
text:
Na atɛnteneeni George Kingsley Acquah MSG JSCy3 kɔɔto banodani  na ɔtɔ so aduonu mmiensa wɔ kɔɔto kunini a ɛwɔ oman Ghana mu. Wɔ yii no sɛ kccto banodani wc kitawonsa bosome mu ne da ɛtɔ so nnan wc afe mpem mmienu ne mmiensa mu na wcyɛɛ adwuma kc pem sɛ baamoɔ wuo b3faa no kɔɔ yɛ.

Abrabc mfitiaseɛ 
wɔ woo atɛnteeneni Acquah wc ɔbɛnem bosome mu ne da a ɛtɔ so nnan wɔ afe   apem ahankron ne aduanan mmienu(4 march 1942)   wc sekondi a ɛwɔ apue mantam mu wc oman Gold Coast a sesia yɛfrɛ no Ghana no mu. Ɔhyɛɛ ne mmɔfra sukuu ase wɔ sukuu ahodoɔ pii, ɛbi ne Half Assini Methodist sukuu, Cape Coast Methodist sukuu, Ashanti Bekwai Methodist sukuu, Akim Oda Methodist sukuu, Nkawkaw Methodist sukuu ne Dunkwa-on-Offin Angelican school. Ɔkɔɔ ne ntosoɔ sukuu wɔ Adisadel College wɔ cape coast wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduonom nson (1965) de kɔsi afe apem ahankron ne aduosia mmiensa. Wɔ afe ahankron ne aduosia nnan (1964) de kɔsi afe ahankron ne aduosia nson (1967) na ɔwie  ne mpanimfoɔ sukuu wɔ university of Ghana, Legon na ɔkura abodin krataa wc B.A (Hons) degree in philosophy. Wɔ saa sukuu no a mu afe apem ahankron ne aduoson na ɔsan nyaa abodin krataa wc LL.B (Hons) degree in law. Afei ɔkɔɔ mmra nnim sukuu, na ɛhɔ na ɔkɔ nyaa adwuma ho adansidie krataa wɔ mmra mu na wɔfrɛ no baa bar wɔ afe ahankron ne aduoson mmienu.

Adwuma mu 
Na atɛteneeni George Acquah yɛ di ne dwuma wɔ nkorɔfoɔ mmra mu wɔ cape coast firi afe ahankron aduoson mmienu (1972) ansa na ɔbɛyɛɛ court kunini a ɔyɛ adwuma wɔ Ho a ɛwɔ Volta region wɔ ɛbɔ bosome ne da a ɛtɔ so aduokron wɔ afe ahankron ne aduowɔtwe nkron mu (1989). Afei ɔsan bɛyɛɛ atɛnteneeni wɔ me nte me ho ase kɔɔto wc Ayɛwohomumɔ bosome wc afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nnan mu na afe akyi no ɔbɛyɛɛ atɛnteneeni wɔ kɔɔto kunini mu.

Anidie krataa 
Wɔ Ayɛwohomumc bosome mu wɔ afe mpenu ne nsia mu no, wɔmma no anidie krataa wc “order of the state of Ghana”, saa anidie hi mu ɛdu paa wɔ Ghana.

owuo 
Kokoram yadeɛ na ɛkuu atɛnteneeni Acquah wɔ cbɛnem bosome ,da ɛtc aduo nnum wɔ afe mpenu ne nson mu wɔ Accra. Na ɔyɛ barima warefoɔ a wa wo mma nsia

title: A. K. B. Ampiah
text:
Alexander Kobina Baah Ampiah yɛ Ghana asɛnnibea kunini tɛmmuafoɔ a wakɔ ahomegyeɛmu. Ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ asɛnnibea kunini no mu sɛ mmaranimfoɔ fi afe apem ahankron ne aduokron mmiɛnsa kosi mfe mpem mmienu ne mmiɛnsa mu. Ansana ɔresom sɛ Asɛnnibea kunini no, na ɔyɛ mmaranimfoɔ a ɔnam dibea ahorow so kɔɔ n'anim sɛ asɛnnibea kunini no tɛmmuafoɔ de kɔɔ Ghana asɛnnibea a ɛyɛ metemehoase kɔɔto no.

Adwuma 
Ampiah suaa mmara wɔ UK. Ɔfatae sɛ mmaranimfo na ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ kokoam wɔ Aumog adan mu. Ɔnam dibea ahorow so fii Asɛnnibea Kunini tɛmmuafoɔ so kɔyɛɛ ɔtɛmmuafoɔ wɔ metemehoase kɔɔto mu ansa na wɔrepaw no sɛ Asɛnnibea Kunini wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosom da a ɛtɔ so nsia afe apem ahankron ne aduokron mmiɛnsa  (January 6, 1993). Bere a na ɔwɔ atemmuo adwuma mu no, na ɔyɛ titenani de ma Ghana Bɔɔlbɔ Fekuw (GFA) no, ekuow a ɛmu gyinaesie ɛwɔ n'anim. 

Ampiah kɔɔ ahomegyeɛ mu de firii Asɛnnibea Kunini tɛmmuafoɔ mu wɔ Kitawonsa bosomda a ɛtɔ so dunum, afe mpem mmienu ne mmiɛmsa (25 July 2003). Wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne nkron (2009) mu no, Ghana ɔmanpanyin a na ɔwɔ hɔ saa bere no John Evans Atta Mills paw no sɛ University of Cape Coast bagua no guamtrani. Wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne dubaako (2011) mu no, wɔmaa no Order of the Volta abasobɔde wɔ ne som a ɔyɛ maa ɔman no ho.

title: Hohoe
text:
Hohoe Mantam yɛ Frao Mantam  a ɛwɔ Ghana mantam 25 a wɔhwɛ so no mu biako . Wɔtee no fii kan Kpando Mantam no mu . Mmarahyɛ Bagua (LI 2072) a ɛbaa afe 2012 na ɛde sii hɔ. Mansin no asase kɛseɛ yɛ 1,172 km 2, a ɛyɛ ɔmantam no asase kɛse ɔha mu nkyem 5.6. na  Ɛne Republic of Togo bɔ hyeɛ wɔ apuei fam, na ɛka Ghana amanaman ntam hyeɛ no fã; ɛda anafoɔ apueeɛ fam wɔ Afadzato mansin no fa,  na ɛda anafoɔ atɔeɛ fam wɔ Kpando Mansin no fa; atifi fam no, ɛne Jasikan mansin na ebɔ hyeɛ; na atifi  atɔe  no ɛne Biakoye mantam no na ɛbɔ hyeɛ.  N’ahenkurow a ɛyɛ Hohoe no yɛ bɛyɛ 78 kilomita fi Ho, ɔmantam no ahenkurow no mu twe 220 kilomita fi Nkran, ɔman no ahenkurow no. Nnipa dodoɔ a wɔwɔ Hohoe Mantam,  sɛnea afe 2010 Nnipa  ne Adan akenkan no kyerɛ no,  yɛ 167,016 a ɛgyina hɔ ma nnipa dodoɔ a wɔwɔ Frao Mantam no nyinaa mu ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 7.9. Ɛyɛ mmea ɔha biara mu 52.1 ne mmarima ɔha biara mu 47.9.

Mmeae atitiriw 
Alavanyo-Dzogbedze, Alavanyo-Deme, Alavanyo Agorme, Alavanyo-Kpeme, Alavanyo-Wudidi, Alavanyo-Agorxoe, Alavanyo-Abehenase, Gbi-Bla, Gbi-Kpeme, Gbi- Godenu Gbi-Abansi, Gbi-Wegbe, Kpoeta, Gbi Atabu, Gbi-Kledzo, Gborxome, Blave, Kitikpa, Ne bo a ɛba fam, Segbedeme, Likpe, Lolobi, Bayika, Fodome, Torkorni.

Nwomasua 
Ankorankoro ne ɔman mfitiase sukuu pii wɔ Hohoe. Nhomasua asoɛe ahorɔw a ɛwɔ Hohoe no din ne nea edidi so yi:

Ntoaso sukuu

Nsrahwɛ   
Hohoe Mansin yɛ beaɛ a nsrahwɛfo betumi ama sikasɛm anya nkɔanim, ne mmoa a ɛde ma wɔ ɔman no sikasɛm mu nyinaa bere a wɔde di dwuma koraa no. Ɛwɔ nsase fɛfɛ, mmeae pii a ɛhwɛ nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia so a ɛma ɛyɛ mmeae a nsrahwɛfo kɔ hɔ a ɛho hia sen biara wɔ ɔman no mu no mu biako. Hohoe Mansin no wɔ nsrahwɛ ho nneɛma a wɔahyɛ no agyirae a edidi so yi:  

i. Bepɔw a ɛkorɔn sen biara wɔ Ghana Bepɔw Afadja (Afadjato) a ɛda Liati Wote ne Gbledi mpɔtam ntam

ii. Awusubɔm a ɛkorɔn sen biara wɔ Afrika Atɔeɛ fam – Wli Nsuo a ɛwɔ Wli.

iii. Tsatsadu awusubɔm a ɛwɔ Alavanyo

iv. Tagbo Nsuo a ɛtɔ wɔ Liati Wote

v. Wadjakli Nsuo a ɛtɔ a ɛwɔ Likpe Todome

vi. Tete dade a wotu dedaw a ɛyɛ nwonwa sen biara wɔ Akpafu –Todzi 

vii. Nananom abodan anan a ɛwɔ Likpe-Todome no

title: G. E. K. Aikins
text:
George Emmanuel Kwesi Aikins (wɔwoo no Ɛbɔ da a ɛtɔ so mmienu afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduonu mmiɛnsa no mu; ɔwuu Oforisuo bosom da a ɛtɔ so du nson wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du mmiɛnsa no mu a na  ɔyɛ mmaranimfoɔ ne ɔmanyɔni ma PNDC aban aberɛ so wɔ Ghana. Na ɔsan nso yɛ Ghana Asɛnnibea Kunini ne tɛmmuafoɔ wɔ kwasafoman a ɛtɔ so nan no mu.

N'abrabɔ mfitiaseɛ ne ne nnwomasua 
Wɔwoo Aikins wɔ Ɛbɔ da ɛtɔ so mmienu afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduonu mmiɛnsa (1993) no mu. Ne mfitiaseɛ nwomasua hyɛɛ aseɛ wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduasa nan(1934)  mu wɔ Ahmadiya Mfitiaseɛ Sukuu mu. Wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduanan mmienu (1942) mu no, wɔde no kɔɔ African Methodist Episcopal School a ɛwɔ Cape Coast, osuaa adeɛ wɔ hɔ afe baako. Na ɔwɔ kokoam adesua ne bere fã adesua nso. Wɔkyerɛ sɛ na ɔyɛ sukuufoɔ a wɔyɛ basabasa tiaa sɛ wɔkyeree nnipa nsia akɛseɛ no wɔ afe  apem ɔha nkron ne aduanan nwɔtwe (1948) mu  sɛ Mfantsipim  sukuuni no mu nipa. Ɔtoaa so wɔ Ghana Mmara Sukuu mu wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduonum nwɔtwe (1958) mu na ɔnyaa ne mmara ho adansedie krataa wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduosia baako (1961). Ɔkaa asuafoɔ nkron a wɔdii kan gye wɔn din sɛ mmaranimfoɔ firi sukuu no mu wɔ Ayɛwohomumuɔ da a ɛtɔ so aduonu mmienu afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduasia mmiɛnsa (22 June,1963) . Ɔsan nso sua ade sɛ abɔnten so osuani wɔ London Sukuupɔn mu.

Adwuma ne Amanyɔsɛm 
Aikins kɔkaa ɔman adwumayɛfoɔ ho wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduanan nkron (1949) mu sɛ ɔkyerɛfoɔ a ɔto so mmienu wɔ ɔfã a ɛto so mmienu, na akyiri no ɔbɛyɛɛ adwumayɛfoɔ panyin. Ɔsomm saa dibea no kosii afe  apem ɔha nkron ne aduasia mmiɛnsa (1963) mu berɛ a wɔfrɛɛ no ​​kɔɔ Ghana bar. Saa afe no ara mu no ɔfaa dibea sɛ ɔman mmaranimfoɔ boafoɔ akyire no ɔkɔɔ so kɔɔ ɔman mmaranimfoɔ panyin dibea mu wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduoson nnum (1975). Na ɔyɛ Ɔman Aban Asoɛe no fotufoɔ fi afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduoson mmiɛnsa (1973) kosi afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduoson nsia (1976) na na ɔyɛ Polisifoɔ Bagua no mu kuoba fi afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduoson nkron (1979) kosi afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduowɔtwe baako (1981). Na ɔsan nso yɛ Afiase Dwumadibea Boayikuw no mu kuoba wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduoson nkron (1979). Wɔ afe apem cha nkron ne aduowɔtwe mmienu (1982) mu no, bere tiaa mu Ɔman Bammɔ Bagua no paw no sɛ Atemmuo Ɔkyerɛfoɔ ne Mmaranimfoɔ Panyin. Ɔdii saa dibea yi kɔsii afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduowɔtwe nwɔtwe (1988). Akyiri yi wɔpaw no sɛ Ghana Asɛnnibea kunini no temmuafoɔ. Ɔkɔɔ pɛnhyen wɔ Ɛbɔ da a ɛtɔ so mmienu afe mpem ɔha nkron ne aduokron nwɔtwe (1998).

Ankorankorɛ asetra 
Ná waware na ɔwɔ mma nson. N’anigyedeɛ ahorow bi ne bɔɔlbɔ, turoyɛ ne pon so tɛnis.

Sɛnea afeda afahyɛ bi a wɔde mae wɔ Daily Graphic nhoma mu kyerɛ no, Oforisuo da a ɛtɔ so du nson mfe mpem mmienu ne du nan (April 17, 2014) no mu na ɔwuiiɛ.

title: Edward Wiredu
text:
Edward Kwame Wiredu JSC (bɛyɛ 1936 – 31 Ɔbɛnim 2008) yɛ Ghana Ɔtemmuafoɔ Panyin wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne baako ne mfe mpem mmienu ne mmiɛnsa (2001 & 2003) ntam. Ɔno ne nea ɔto so du fi berɛ a Ghana bɛyɛɛ ɔman a ɛde ne ho. Wɔahyɛ no nso sɛ ɔde Fast Track Kɔɔto a ɛwɔ Ghana ne Alternate Dispute Resolution ne Judicial Institute nso bae.

N'abrabɔ ahyɛaseɛ 
Wɔgyee Edward Wiredu kɔɔ Achimota Sukuu mu nanso ɔfirii hɔ ɛnam asɛm bi a ɛsiiɛ nti. Ɔbɛyɛɛ osuani wɔ Accra Academy na akyiri yi ɔtu kɔɔ Adisadel College baabi a ɔnyaa Cambridge Sukuu Adansedie krataa. Wiredu nyaa nyansahu mu adesua a ɛto so nsia wɔ Kumasi College of Science and Technology nanso wanwie.

Adwuma 
Wiredu suaa mmara wɔ Inns of Kɔɔtot Sukuu a ɛwɔ London no mu. Wɔfrɛɛ no ​​kɔɔ Britainfoɔ asadan mu wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduasia (1960) mu berɛ a ɔwiee Middle Temple no. Ɔkɔɔ so som wɔ Bench no so mfeɛ aduasa nan (34) a ne nyinaa yɛ bere a na ɔyɛ kokoam adwuma no. Wɔpaw no sɛ Asɛnnibea Kunini temmuafo wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduasia nkron (1969). Wɔ atuate a ɛyɛɛ nyinsɛn a ɛbaa Kotonimma da a ɛtɔ so du nnun afe mpem ɔha nkron ne aduoson nkron (15 May, 1979) akyi no, wɔhyɛɛ no ​​nsow sɛ ɔde ne ho hyɛɛ asɛm a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɔnni fɔ mma Jerry Rawlings, ɛwom sɛ na Rawlings ankasa agye ne ho adi wɔ n’asɛnnibea no mu deɛ. Wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduowɔtwe (1980)  mu no, wɔmaa no so sɛ Asɛnnibea a wɔde asɛm kɔdan no temmuafo. Ɔbɛyɛɛ Asɛnnibea Kunini Temmufoɔ wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduokron(1990). John Kufuor paw no sɛ Ɔtemmufoɔ Panyin wɔ Kwasafoman a ɛtɔ so nan wɔ ne titenani dibea mfitiaseɛ wɔ Obubuo da a ɛtɔ so nkron afe mpem mmienu ne baako (9 November, 2001) no mu. Ebinom bu no sɛ ɔyɛ ɔbi a ɔkamfo Atemmufoɔ ahofadie denneennen. Ɔkɔɔ pɛnhyen sɛ Ɔtemmufo Panyin wɔ Kotonimma a ɛyɛ mfe mpem mmienu ne mmiɛnsa (2003) no mu esiane akwahosan nti.

title: George Kingsley Acquah
text:
George Kingsley Acquah 
Justice George Kingsley Acquah MSG JSC, Ɔbɛnem bosom da ɛtɔ so nnan wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduanan mmienu (4 March 1942) na ɔyɛ kɔɔto banodani a na ɔtɔ so aduonu mmiensa (23rd) wɔ kɔɔto kunini a ɛwɔ ɔman Ghana mu. Wɔyii no sɛ kɔɔto banodani wɔ Kitawonsa bosome da ɛtɔ so nnan wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne mmiensa (2003) mu na ɔyɛɛ adwuma kɔpem sɛ baamoɔ wuo bɛfaa no kɔeɛ.

Abrabɔ mfitiaseɛ 
Wɔwoo Justice Acquah wɔ Ɔbɛnem bosom da a ɛtɔ so nnan wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduanan mmienu (4 march 1942) wɔ Sekondi a ɛwɔ apue mantam mu wɔ ɔman Gold Coast a sesie yɛfrɛ no Ghana no mu. Ɔhyɛɛ ne mmɔfra sukuu aseɛ wɔ sukuu ahodoɔ pii, ɛbi ne Half Assini Methodist sukuu, Cape Coast Methodist sukuu, Ashanti Bekwai Methodist sukuu, Akim Oda Methodist sukuu, Nkawkaw Methodist sukuu ne Dunkwa-on-Offin Angelican school. Ɔkɔɔ ne ntoasoɔ sukuu wɔ Adisadel College wɔ Cape Coast wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduonom nson (1957) de kɔsi afe apem ahankron ne aduosia mmiensa (1963) ɛne ne college adesua a ɛtɔ so nsia no. Wɔ afe ahankron ne aduosia nnan (1964) de kɔsi afe ahankron ne aduosia nson (1967) na ɔwie ne mpanimfoɔ sukuu wɔ University of Ghana, Legon a na ɔkura abodin krataa wɔ B.A (Hons) wɔ philosophy. Wɔ saa sukuu no ara mu afe apem ahankron ne aduoson (1970) na ɔsan nyaa abodin krataa wɔ mmara mu LL.B (Hons). Afei ɔkɔɔ mmrannim sukuu, na ɛhɔ na ɔkɔ nyaa adwuma ho adansidie krataa wɔ mmra mu na wɔfrɛ no baa Bar wɔ afe ahankron ne aduoson mmienu (1972).

Adwuma mu abrabɔ 
Na Justice George Acquah yɛ dwuma wɔ ankorankora mmra mu wɔ Cape Coast firi afe apem ahankron ne aduoson mmienu (1972) ansa na ɔbɛyɛɛ kɔɔto kunini a ɔyɛ adwuma wɔ Ho a ɛwɔ Volta region. Wɔ Ɛbɔ bosom ne da a ɛtɔ so aduokron wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe nkron mu (1989). Afei ɔsan bɛyɛɛ atɛnteneeni wɔ me nte me ho ase kɔɔto wɔ Ayɛwohommumɔ bosom wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nnan (1994) mu na afe akyi no ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔtɛmmuafoɔ wɔ kɔɔto kunini mu.

Abasobɔdeɛ 
Wɔ Ayɛwohomummɔ bosom mu wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nsia mu no (2006), wɔ mma no anidie krataa wɔ “order of the state of Ghana”, saa anidie yi yɛ abɔdin a na ɛwɔ soro paa wɔ Ghana.

Owuo 
Kokoram yadeɛ na ɛkuu Justice Acquah wɔ Ɔbɛnem bosom ,da ɛtɔ so aduonu num wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nson mu wɔ Nkran. Na ɔyɛ barima warefoɔ a na ɔwɔ mma nsia.

title: Joanna Dorothy Haigh
text:
Joanna Dorothy Haigh yɛ Britain ni a ɔsane nso yɛ nwomanimni. Wɔwoo no wɔ Kɔtɔnimaa bosome no da a ɛtɔ so nson mu wɔ afe apem ahankron aduonum nan mu. Ansana ɔrebɛkɔ ahomegyeɛ mu wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du nkron mu no, na ɔwɔ abɔdin sɛ ɔkunin a ɔwɔ Atmospheric Physics adesua mu wɔ suapɔn a yɛfrɛ no Imperial College a ɛwɔ London. Na ɔsane nso yɛ tenenee de ma Grantham Institute Climate Change and Environment.

Ɔsane nso bɛyɛɛ panin a na ɔda Imperial College a ɛwɔ London no nkorabata a ɔhwɛ Physics adesua so. ɔyɛ Royal Society kuo ba (FRS), na ɔsane nso somm sɛ Royal Meteorological Society panin paa a ɔda wɔn ano.

ƆBRA AHYEASEƐ NE NWOMASUA 
Wɔwoo Haigh wɔ afe apem ahankron aduonum nan mu. Ɔnya n’adesua mu nteteeɛ wɔ Hiltchin Girls’ sukuu, saa mmerɛ no na yɛfrɛ no All-girls grammar school a na ɛwɔ Hiltchin, Hertfordshire. Na ɔwɔ ɔdɔ de ma wiem nsakrae ho adesua, nti ɔsii beaɛ bi wɔ ne mmabaawa berɛ mu wɔ ne dan akyi a na ɔde hwɛ sɛdeɛ wiem si fa dane dane. ɔsuaa Physics wɔ Somerville college, a ɛwɔ Oxford, ɔwieɛ gyee abɔdin krataa a yɛka no Borɔfo kasa mu sɛ Bachelor of Arts degree; sɛdeɛ amanneɛ teɛ no, ɔtoa n’adesua no so kɔgyee n’abɔdin krataa a ɛtɔ so mmienu a wɔato no din wɔ Borɔfo mu sɛ Master of Arts (Oxon) degree.

Anso hɔ ara, ɔsane nso toaa n’adesua no so kɔgyee n’abɔdin krataa foforɔ a ɛtɔ so mmiensa a wɔato no din wɔ Borɔfo mu sɛ Master of Science in meteorology wɔ Imperial College a ɛwɔ London. ɔkɔ wiee ne nwomasua no wɔ Oxford suapɔn no mu kɔgee n’abɔdin krataa foforɔ a ɛtɔ so nan a wɔato no din wɔ Borɔfo mu sɛ Doctor of Philosophy (DPhil) wɔ atmospheric physics a C.D Walshaw foɔ na wɔhwɛɛ ne so maa ɔwiee n’adesua no. wɔgyee saa abɔdin krataa yi wɔ afe apem ahankron aduowɔtwe mu berɛ a ɔyɛɛ nhwehwɛmu a ɔtoo din wɔ Borofo kasa mu sɛ Experiments with a two-dimensional model of the general circulation.

N'ABRABƆ NE NHWEHWƐMU AHODOƆ 
Haigh yɛ okunini a yɛbɔ no mmarane sɛ Emeritus wɔ atmospheric physics adesua mu a, ɔsane nso kyerɛ adeɛ wɔ Imperial College mu wɔ London. ɛfiri afe mpem mmienu ne du-nan mu (2014) no, ɔyɛɛ tenenee de maa Grantham Institute-Climate Change and Environment. wasane nso ayɛ panin a na ɔda Imperial College a ɛwɔ London no nkorabata a ɛhwɛ Physics adesua so de firi afe mpem mmienu ne nkron (2009) de bɛsi afe mpem mmienu ne du-nan mu (2014).

BAABI A MENYAA MMOA FIRIIƐ

title: Benjamin Aryeetey
text:
Ná Benjamin Teiko Aryeetey yɛ Ghana nwomanimfo ne ɔtemmufoɔ. Ɔyɛ Ghana Asɛnnibea Kunini no temmufo a wakɔ pɛnhyen. Ɔde mfeɛ aduanan (40) yɛɛ adwuma wɔ Ghana Atemmuo benkyi so. Na ɔyɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo nso wɔ Ghana Mmara Sukuu mu.

Abrabɔ Ahyɛaseɛ Ne Nwomasua 

Wɔwoo Aryeetey wɔ Ayɛwohomumɔ da a ɛtɔ so dunan wɔ afe apem ne ahankron aduanan baako (14 June 1941). Ɔsuaa adeɛ maa ne division Certificate a ɛdi kan wɔ West African School Certificate Examination mu wɔ Mfantsipim Sukuu mu firi afe apem ne ahankron aduonum nsia (1956) kɔsi afe apem ne ahankron aduosia (1960). Ɔkɔɔ Winneba Nteteeɛ Kɔlege wɔ afe 1960 mu baabi a ɔnyaa Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ Abodin krataa 'A' wɔ afe afe apem ne ahankron aduosia mmienu mu (1962). Wɔ afe  apem ne ahankron aduosia mmiensa (1963) mu no ɔkɔɔ Achimota Sukuu mu nyaa ne general Certificate of Education Advance Level (GCE A-Level) wɔ afe apem ne ahankron aduosia num mu (1965). Ɔnyaa ne Bachelor of Laws (LLB) abodin krataa wɔ afe apem ne ahankron aduosia nwɔtwe mu (1968) mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu na ɔnyaa ne mmara mu abodin krataa a ɛdi akyire wɔ sukuupɔn korɔ no ara mu.

Adwuma 

Aryeetey fii n’adwuma ase wɔ benkyi so sɛ Ɔmantam Ɔtemmufo grade II wɔ Oforisuo bosome no mu wɔ afe apem ne ahankron aduoson baako mu (April 1971). Wɔpaw no sɛ Asɛnnibea Kunini no Temmufo wɔ afe apem ne ahankron aduɔwɔtwe nkron mu (1989) na afe akyi no ɔne Ghana Asraafo yɛɛ Ɔtemmufoɔ Mmaranimfo. Akyiri yi wɔmaa no dibea sɛ Asɛnnibea a Ɛhwɛ Asɛm a Wɔde Kɔdan Asɛnnibea no Temmufoɔ wɔ Ayɛwohomumɔ bosome no mu wɔ afe apem ne ahankron aduɔkron nkron ( June 1999) na ɔyɛɛ saa dibea no kosii afe  mpem mmienu ne nkron (2009) a wɔpaw no sɛ Ghana Asɛnnibea Kunini no Temmufo. Berɛ a na ɔwɔ benkyi no so no, ɔde ne ho hyɛɛ nhyiam ne adwumayɛbea ahoroɔ bi mu, a emu bi ne; Afrika Dwumadi a Ɛhwɛ Amerika Mmara Asoɛe ne Mmara Ho Nsɛm So wɔ United States, Operation Cross Roads ne Commonwealth Atemmufoɔ, ne Atemmufoɔ Fekuw Nhyiam a ɛwɔ The Gambia.

Ɔtemmufoɔ Aryeetey nso yɛɛ adwuma wɔ badwam ne fekuw ahoroɔ mu na ɔyɛɛ dwamtrani. Na ɔyɛ Atemmufoɔ ne Atemmufoɔ Fekuo no muni na ɔsan nso yɛɛ Maranatha Suapɔn Kɔlege Boayikuo no Titenani.

Sɛ yɛde benkyi so som to nkyɛn a, Aryeetey yɛɛ adwuma wɔ afuw mu adesua mu. Na ɔyɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ ma Career Magistrates Program a ɔkyerɛ Atemmuo Abrabɔ Pa ne sɔhwɛfoɔ ma afe a ɛtwa toɔ Practical Advocacy adesua wɔ Ghana School of Law.

Yi obi 

Ghana ɔmampanyin a na ɔwɔ hɔ saa berɛ no, John Evans Atta Mills na ɔpaw Aryeetey wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nkron mu. Akyiri yi wɔhwehwɛɛ ne mu Memeneda, Ahinime da a ɛtɔ so  Dummienu wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nkron mu (12th October, 2009) na mmarahyɛ badwam no penee so wɔ Kotonimma da a ɛtɔ so aduasa baako wɔ afe 2009. Ɔmampanyin a na ɔwɔ hɔ saa berɛ no kaa no ntam wɔ Obubuo da a ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nkron mu (2nd November 2009).

title: Nasiru Gbadegbe
text:
Nasiru Sulemana Gbadegbe yɛ Ghana mmaranimfoɔ ne ɔtemmufoɔ. Na ɔyɛ Ghana Asɛnnibea Kunini no temmufo wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nkron mu (2009) ne wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne aduonu mu (2020) ntam.

Abrabɔ ahyɛaseɛ ne nwomasua 
Gbadegbe fi Volta Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Wɔwoo no wɔ  Openima da a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe  wɔ afe apem ne ahankron aduonum (8th December 1950). Ɔnyaa ne bachelor of laws (LLB) abodin krataa wɔ afe 1973 mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu na ɛno akyi no ɔnyaa ne qualifying Certificate in Law wɔ Ghana School of Law wɔ afe apem ne ahankron aduoson num mu (1975 ).

Adwuma 
Ansa na wɔrepaw Gbadegbe sɛ Ghana Asɛnnibea Kunini wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nkron (2009) mu no, na wasom wɔ Ghana bench no so mfeɛ aduonu (20). Wɔpaw no sɛ Asɛnnibea Kunini no Temmufo wɔ afe 1989 mu na ɔsom wɔ saa dibea no mu mfeɛ du. Wɔ afe 1999 mu no, wɔmaa no so kɔɔ Asɛnnibea a Ɛhwɛ Asɛm a Wɔde Kɔdan Asɛnnibea na ɔtraa saa dibea no mu kosii afe mpem mmienu ne nkron (2009) mu berɛ a wɔpaw no sɛ Asɛnnibea Kunini no temmufo.

Yi obi 
Ghana ɔmanpanyin a na ɔwɔ hɔ saa berɛ no, John Evans Atta Mills na ɔpaw Gbadegbe wɔ afe  mpem mmienu ne nkron (2009) mu. Wɔhwehwɛɛ ne mu Memeneda, Ahinime da a ɛtɔ so Dummienu wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nkron mu (12th October, 2009) na mmarahyɛ badwam no penee so wɔ Kotonimma da a ɛtɔ so aduasa baako wɔ afe  mpem mmienu ne nkron (2009) mu. Ɔmampanyin a na ɔwɔ hɔ saa berɛ no kaa no ntam wɔ Obubuo da a ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nkron mu (2nd November 2009).

Ahomegyeɛ (Pɛnhyɛn) 
Gbadegbe kɔɔ pɛnhyen wɔ Openima bosome no mu wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne aduonu mu (2020) wɔ Asɛnnibea Kunini no mu berɛ a ɔde ne valedictory atemmuo wɔ mfeɛ aduasa baako a ɔde asom wɔ atemmuo mu akyi.

title: Ellie Highwood
text:
Ellie Highwood yɛ ahodoɔ ne nkabom ho ɔfotufoɔ ne ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ ma adesuafoɔ, nhwehwɛmufoɔ ne nyansahufoɔ.

Kane no na ɔyɛ Wiem Tebea ho Adesua ho Ɔbenfo wɔ Reading Sukuupɔn mu a na ɔyɛ saa dwumadibea no mu panyin firi afe 2012 kɔsi afe 2015 mu. Kan no na ɔyɛ RMetS Bagua ne Nwomasua Boayikuw no mu ni. Wɔ Ahineme, 1 2016 mu no,  ɔbɛyɛɛ Royal Meteorological Society (RMetS) no Titenani a ɔtɔ so 81, ɔsom kɔsii mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du-nwotwe (2018).

Highwood suaa abɔdeɛ mu nneɛma ho ade wɔ Manchester Sukuupɔn mu na afei ɔsuaa PhD wɔ Akenkan Sukuupɔn mu. Ne nhwehwɛmu no twe adwene si wiem nneɛma nketenkete a ɛwɔ wiem tebea mu so, titiriw nkɛntɛnso a aerosol nya wɔ wiem nsakraeɛ ne wiem tebea ho nhwɛsode so.

Efiri afe 2015-2019 no ɔsan nso faa adwuma sɛ Dean for Diversity and Inclusion wɔ Reading Sukuupɔn mu, a na ɔne Ɔbenfo Simon Chandler-Wilde yɛ adwuma.

Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du-nkron (2019) mu no ɔfirii adesua mu nhwehwɛmu wiase no ase na ɔhyɛɛ n’ankasa nnwuma ase a ɔde n’adwene sii ahyehyɛdeɛ a ɛka obiara ho a ɔbɛnya nkɔsoɔ ne sɛ ɔbɛboa adesuafoɔ, nhwehwɛmufoɔ ne nyansahufoɔ ara kɔsi ankorankoro ne akuo nteteeɛ so.

N’adwuma a ɛfa aerosols ne nsonsuansoɔ a enya wɔ wiem tebea ne wiem nsakraeɛ so ho asɛm wɔ nhoma ahorow a ɛda nsow mu, te sɛ The Independent ne BBC. Waka sɛ okyinnsoromma yi a wɔbɛma ayɛ nwini wɔ ɔkwan a wɔayɛ so denam "nneɛma nketenkete a ɛma hann a wɔde bɛhyɛ wiem" (sɛ nhwɛso no, Paul Crutzen de too gua no)bɛtumi "de ɔpɛ ne wiem tebea mu basabasayɛ aba" wɔ aman a wɔdi hia mu, ɛwom sɛ ɛte saa de nso ka sɛ "ɛbɛyɛ nea nyansa wɔm sɛ yɛbɛhwehwɛ akwan foforo a ɛbɛtumi aboa yɛn wɔ mfie du du a ɛreba no mu".

title: Julius Sarkodee-Addo
text:
Julius Sarkodee-Addo  JSC, ɔwoo no wɔ ɛbɔ bosome ne da ɛtɔ so nnwɔtwe wɔ afe apem aha nkron ne nnwɔtwe na ɔwuu wɔ ɔpɛpɔn bosome wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduoson mmienu(8/09/1908-01/1972).

Na ɔyɛ Ghana man ɔtɛmmuafoɔ panin a ɔtɔso mmienu wɔ adehyeman amanmuo a ɛtɔso baako.

NNWOMASUA NE ADWUMA 
Wɔkɔsua mmra no wɔ King's College a ɛwɔ ɔhenekrom. ɔde no bɛka wɔn a wɔkyerɛ wɔn mmra ho nsɛm wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduonu nnwɔtwe, ɛna ɔfrɛ no bɛkaa mmranimfoɔ ho wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduasa mmienu. Wɔde no bɛhyɛɛ Ghana ɔtɛmmuafoɔ panin a ɔdikan a ɛyɛ Owura Kobina Arku Korsah anan wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduosia nan. Wɔtuu no abrɛ asogyafoɔ bɛdii man no so wɔ ɔgyefoɔ bosome ne da a ɛtɔso aduonu nan wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduosia nsia a na wɔfrɛ wɔn National Liberation Council a ɔtee no wɔbrɛ a ɔtuu man panin dada Kwame Nkrumah firii akonnwa no so. 

Sarkodee-Addo kɔ wuu wɔ Korle-Bu aban ayaresabea a ɛwɔ Nkran wɔ afe apem aha nkron ne aduoson mmienu.

title: Augustus Molade Akiwumi
text:
Augustus Molade Akiwumi JSC wɔwoo no wɔ Oforisuo bosome ne da ɛtɔso nson wɔ afe apem ɔha nnwɔtwe ne aduokron baako ɛna ɔwuu wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduowɔtwe num. Na ɔyɛ mmranimni na ɔsane yɛ ɔtɛmmuafoɔ. ɛkyire ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔkasamafoɔ de ma Ghana mmrahyɛbɛdwafie firi afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduonum nnwctwe de kɔsi afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduosia. Wɔdii nseɛ baa atentenenee wɔ Ghana asɛnnibea keseɛ a ɔfrɛ no Supreme Court wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduosia ne afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduosia baako ntɛm.

ABRABO AHYEASE 
Wɔwoo Augustus Akiwumi wɔ Lagos wɔ Nigeria maa Yoruba abusua keseɛ a na ɔyɛ mma du mmienu. Wɔbesesan nkrataa bɛyɛɛ Ghana ni wɔbrɛ a ɔne ɔpapa a ɔfrɛ no S.O Akiwumi baa Gold Coast brɛ na ɔyɛ abɔfra no. Na S.O Akiwumi yɛ abɛdiakyire de ma Red Cross League. Wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne du mu no  wɔ somaa Augustus Akiwumi maa no ne n'ahyɛfoɔ a wɔfrɛ Smith abusua a wɔwɔ Crosby, Cumbria a ɛwɔ England kɔtenaɛ hɔ. ɔkɔɔ Queen's College, Taunton Somerset. Ne nnuanom nson nso baa sukuu wɔ England abrokyire man mu. Wɔtuaa so kɔɔ Fitzwilliam College, Cambridge ɛhɔ na ɔkɔ suaa mmra. Wɔsane kɔsuaa adeɛ sɛ obi a ɔyɛ adwuma wɔ sikakorabea wɔ Midland Sikakorabea, Ludgate Hill wɔ London wɔbrɛ na ɔrebɛba Ghana no.

ADWUMA 
Wɔfrɛɛ no bɛkaa mmranimfoɔ ho wɔ Lincoln's Inn wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduonu baako. Wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduosia nan mu no wɔbrɛ a na ɔyɛ ɔtɛmmuafoɔ wɔ High Court wɔ Ghana no, ɔyii no  mmra kwan so sɛ ɔtwerɛtwerɛfoɔ de maa East African Common Service Organisation. Wɔyii no sɛ ɔkasamafoɔ ma mmrahyɛbedwafie wɔ ɔgyefoɔ bosome wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduonum nnwɔtwe ma Ghana. Wɔbɛyɛɛ ɔtɛmmuafoɔ wɔ Ghana ɛna akyire ɔyii no baa asɛnnibea keseɛ a wɔfrɛ no Supreme Court de firi Kitawonsa bosome wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduosia saa de kɔsi berɛ a ɔkɔɔ ahomegyeɛmu wɔ Oforisuo bosome wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduosia baako.

N'ABUSUA 
Akiwumi waree Grace Aryee ɛna akyire nso ɔwaree Helen Kabuki Ocansey a ɔmo nyinaa yɛ Ghanafoɔ.
