title: Mary Kalin Arroyo
text:
Wɔwoo Ɔbenfo Mary Therese Kalin-Arroyo wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduonan nnan (1944) wɔ New Zealand. Mprenpren yi, ɔyɛ Ɔbenfo ɛwɔ abɔde a nkwa wɔ mu ho adesua (Biology) wɔ asuapɔn a ɛwɔ Chile. Kalin-Arroyo yɛ obi a ɔda nsow na ɔsan hwehwɛ Ourisia abusua no na ohunu mmoa ahorow foforo pii wɔ New Zealand. N'adesua nso ama wɔakyerɛ sɛ Chile mfinimfin fam yɛ beaeɛ a ɛyɛ afifide a agu ahorow so.

Abrabɔ mfitiaseɛ ne nwomasua 
Ɔnyaa ne BSc abɔdin ɛwɔ Canterbury a ɛwɔ Christchurch asuapɔn mu, New Zealand a ɔde adesuakuo a ɛdikan na ewieɛ wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduosia nson (1967). Afei ɔwie ne PhD wɔ Botani mu wɔ UC Berkeley wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduoson baako (1971). Afei  a ɛtoa so no, Kalin-Arroyo ne Peter Raven yɛɛ post doctoral wɔ New York Botanical Garden.

Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduoson nwɔtwe (1978), ɔware ne kunu Manuel Arroyo ne wɔn ba barima tu kɔɔ asupɔn a ɛwɔ Chile, baabi a na ɔbɛyɛ adwuma sɛ okunini. Akyire yi, ɔbenfo Kalin-Arroyo bɛyɛɛ okunini kɛseɛ wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe nnan (1984). Mprenpren yi, ɔyɛ panyin wɔ asoeɛ a ɛhwɛ abɔde a nkwa wɔm wɔ asuopɔn a ɛwɔ Chile.

Nhwehwɛmu 
Kalin-Arroyo adwuma ne sɛ ɔhwɛ awoɔ a ɛfa afifide a nkwa wɔm, titiriw no nneɛma a afifiri ɛwɔ mmaeɛ a ɛkorɔn ne awo nhyehyeɛ ahorow a ɛdennan. Ne nhwehwɛmu a ɛtɔ so bio ne biogeography, faako a ɔhwɛ sɛnea afifide a ɛwɔ mmeaeɛ a ɛkorɔn no. Ɔde akwammisa krataa kɔeɛ sɛ ɔde ne nhwehwɛmu a ɔyɛɛ wɔ afifide awo nhyehyeɛ ho ne nhwehwɛmu a ɔyeɛ wɔ mpɔtam a ɛfa nneɛma a wokora so no ho. Afei nso, Obenfo Kalin-Arroyo nso ayɛ nneɛma a wɔkora so ho adwuma a ɔhwɛɛ sɛnea nneɛma a wɔkora so no ayɛ yie wɔ Chile mmea du-nsia (16) a wɔabɔ ho ban no mu. Wei aboa ama Chile mfinimfin beaeɛ ɛde abɔde a nkwa wɔm na agu mu ahodoɔ no ato dwa.

Adeɛ foforɔ a ɔtumi yɛɛ ne sɛ ɔnyaa adwene bi a ɔde bɛbɔ   Asubɔnten Kɔndor nsuo a ɛyɛ asase ɔpepe aduosia-nwɔtwe (68,000), Ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduonu-num (25%)  a ɛkɔ fam a ɛwɔ Chile no ho ban daa.

Abasobɔdeɛ 
Kalin anya ɔman ne amanaman ntam anuonyam pii. Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe nnan (1984) mu no ɔdii nkonim wɔ John Simon Guggenheim kuo a agye din no mu. Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nnwɔtwe (1998) mu no, wɔpaw no sɛ kuoba ɛwɔ "Linnean Society of London" wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron num (1995) mu ne "Corresponding member of the Botanical Society of America". Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia (1996) mu, onyaa abasobɔdeɛ ɛwɔ "Merit Labarca" de kyerɛɛ ne nhomasua mu nkɔso a ɛda nsow wɔ wɔn adwuma mu wɔ amammerɛ ne ɔsom a wɔde ma aman no mu. Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nson(1997) de kɔsi afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nkron (1999) mu no, Chile Ɔmanpanin maa no Ɔmanpanin diberɛ wɔ nyansahu mu. Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nwɔtwe (1998) mu no, wɔpaw no sɛ  New Zealand Ahemfo kuw no muni a ɔhyɛ nidi maa ne kurom. Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron-nkron (1999) mu no, ɔne Ramon Latorre, na wɔpaw wɔn sɛ "Amannɔne Kuoba ɛwɔ US Nyansahu Sukuu", na wɔyɛɛ nyansahufo baanu a wodii kan wɔ ɔman no mu a wɔanya saa nidi kɛse yi no mu baako. Wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne mmiɛnsa (2003) mu no ɔde ne ho kɔbɔɔ Chile Nyansahu Sukuu no sɛ Ɔmanpanyin a Ɔkyerɛw Nsɛm. Wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du (2010) mu no, onyaa Chile Ɔman Nkonimdi a Ɛfa Abɔde Ho Nyansahu Ho.

Beaeɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ 

Ɔbaa

title: Penny Whetton
text:
Penelope Whetton (Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da a ɛtɔ so num (5 ) wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduonum nwɔtwe(1958)  kɔsi Ɛbɔ bosome da a ɛtɔ so dubaako (11) wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne dunkron mu 2019) na ɔyɛ wiem tebea hwehwɛmufoɔ (climatologist )neɛ na wakwadare mu yie paa ne mantam wiem nsakraeɛ dwumadie a ɛnam asase so hyew so de ba, ne ɛso nsunsunsoɔ a saa nsesa no de ba. Beaeɛ a na ɔdi ne dwuma pa ara ne Australia.

Abrabɔ ahyɛaseɛ 
Wɔwoo whetton wɔ Melbourne, Victoria, wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da a ɛtɔ so num wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduonum nwɔtwe (1958) mu. Ɔnyaa Bachelor of Science abasobɔdeɛ wɔ physics mu, ne meteorology mu firii University of Melbourne. Ɔnyaa Doctor of Philosophy degree wɔ saa suapɔn no ara mu wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe nsia(1986).

N'adwuma 
Whetton hyɛɛ n'adwuma ase wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe (1980) afe no awieeɛ mu sɛ ɔhwehwɛfoɔ wɔ Department of Geography a ɛwɔ Monasah Suapɔn mu wɔ Clayton, Victoria.

Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe nkron (1989) mu no, ɔde ne ho kɔkaa Atmospheric Research division of CSIRO ho (a akyire no ɔbɛyɛɛ CMAR CSIRO Marine ne Atmospheric hwehwɛmufoɔ). Whetton bɛyɛɛ hwehwɛmufoɔ panin wɔ afe apam ahankron ne aduokron nkron(1999) mu na wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nkron(2009) mu nso ɔbɛyɛɛ nhwehwɛmu dwumadie no kuo panin.

N'ankasa Abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Whetton ne ne yere Janet Rice  a na ɔyɛ Greens senator ne kane Maribyrnong manyɔni ne ne mma barima mmienu tenaa Footscray, Victoria. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne mmiɛnsa mu no, Whetton kɔyɛɛ oprehyɛn sesaa ne bɔbeasu a na ɔyɛ no.

Whetton wuiiɛ wɔ Ɛbɔ bosome da a ɛtɔ so dubaako wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne dunkron mu wɔ Sisters Beach, Tasmania.

Beaeɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Maisa Rojas
text:
Maisa Heloísa Juana Rojas Corradi (wɔwoo no 10 Ɔbɛnem 1972) yɛ Chile amammuifoɔ, abɔdeɛ mu nneɛma ho nimdefoɔ ne wim tebea ho nimdefoɔ a wasom sɛ Ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia so firi afe 2022.

Mmofraase asetra ne Nhomasua 
Rojas nyaa ne abodin krataa a edi kan wɔ abɔde mu nneɛma ho adesua mu wɔ Chile Sukuupɔn mu ne ne Ph.D. wɔ wim abɔde mu nneɛma ho adesua mu wɔ Lincoln College, Oxford.

Adwuma

Adwuma a wɔyɛ wɔ nhomasua mu 
Afei na Rojas yɛ oduruyɛfo akyi yɔnko wɔ Amanaman Ntam Nhwehwɛmu Asoɛe a Ɛhwɛ Wim Tebea ne Ɔmanfo So wɔ Columbia Sukuupɔn mu wɔ afe 2001 mu. Afei ɔsan kɔɔ Universidad de Chile sɛ oduruyɛfo akyi yɔnko, nhwehwɛmufo, na afei ɔbenfo wɔ asase ho nimdeɛ ho.

Saa bere no mu no, Rojas bɛyɛɛ amanaman ntam wim nsakrae ho nyansahufo a wagye din. Na ɔyɛ Paleoclimate ti no kyerɛwfo panyin ma UN Aban Ntam Bagua a Ɛhwɛ Wim Tebea Nsakrae So (IPCC) amanneɛbɔ a ɛto so anum (AR5), na na ɔsan yɛ ɔkyerɛwfo panyin a ɔyɛ nhyehyɛe ma IPCC amanneɛbɔ (AR6). Wasom wɔ ɔmampanyin bagua ahorow ne boayikuw ahorow a ɛhwɛ wim nsakrae so.

Adwuma a wɔyɛ wɔ aban mu 
Wɔ afe 2022 mu no, Chile Ɔmampanyin Gabriel Boric bɔɔ Rojas din sɛ ɔnyɛ Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia so wɔ ne aban mpanyimfo kuw mu.

Rojas ne Jennifer Morgan dii adwumakuo no anim wɔ 2022 Amanaman Nkabom Wim Tebea Nsakraeɛ Nhyiamu a wɔyɛɛ apam bi a ɛfa sika a wɔhwere ne nneɛma a wɔsɛe no ho.

Beaeɛ a me nya moa firi

title: Yonny Kulendi
text:
wɔwoo kulendi wɔ 29 Ɔbɛnem 1963. Ɔfiri Issa, akuraa bi a ɛwɔ Upper West Region wɔ Ghana. Na ne papa yɛ Wiase Ko II mu ɔsraani panyin na ne maame yɛɛ Pito nsa na ɔtɔn wɔ Wa Zongo. Ɔyɛ ne maame mma baason mu nea ɔto so anan.

ɔyɛɛ ne mfitiaseɛ nwomasua wɔ Ndama Mfitiaseɛ Sukuu ansa na ɔrekɔ Wa Ntoaso Sukuu (mprempren Wa Senior High Technical School).Wɔ n’afe a ɛto so anum wɔ ntoaso sukuu mu no, ɛkame ayɛ sɛ odii mfe abien wɔ Wa afiase ahorow mu a wɔde no too afiase, na saa asɛm yi maa osii gyinae kɛse sɛ ɔbɛyɛ mmaranimfo. Asɛm no akyi no, Kulendi kɔkaa Navrongo Senior High School ho baabi a ɔkyerɛw ne din sɛ ankorankoro sukuuni maa ne O-Level sɔhwɛ

title: Simona Bordoni
text:
Simona Bordoni (a wɔwoo no afe apem ahanson ne mmienu) yɛ Italini a ɔhwɛ ewiem nsakraeɛ ne Okunini a ɔyɛɛ environmental Science ne engineering a ɔda Simona Bordoni Research kuo wɔ California Institute of Technology. Ɔsuaa ewiem ho nnoɔma a ne tirimpɔ ne sɛ ɔbɛte sɛdeɛ anaa ɔbɛhunu sɛdeɛ yɛyɛ "large- scale circulations ne hydrological cycle.

Nnwuma 
Bordoni yɛɛ ne M.SC wɔ Atmospheric Sciences firii UCLA wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne mmiɛnsa mu, ɛbaa ne ɔyɛɛ ne PhD wɔ Atmospheric ne Oceanic Sciences firii UCLA wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nson mu.

Bordoni ne Tapio Schneider wɔ nnwoma bi a yɛfrɛ no "onset of the Asian monsoon" yɛabɔ wɔn din wɔm a wɔde ewiem nsakraeɛ sononko bi de kyerɛ sɛ monsoon nsesaeɛ no kɔ ntɛm so wɔ mantam mmienu a ɛdi akɔneaba mu. Simone ne Salvatore Pascale nso ayɛ adwuma asua sɛdeɛ yɛma North American monsoon no yɛ mmerɛ ne nsunsuansoɔ a ɛwɔ nsuo a ɛwɔ mantam ahodoɔ no mu. Sɛdeɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ ɛpo mframa ɛfa Gulf of California ne northeast Pacific Ocean ho no maa emu nokorɛ daa adi sɛ mframa a ɛwɔ Gulf a ɛba berɛ pɔtee bi no na ɛsesa ma ɛpɛ no hyɛ aseɛ ba.

Beaɛ a n'ani gye ho 
Monsoons, Tropical dynamics, climate Dynamics nkitahodie a ɛwɔ mesoscale ne large-scale circulations ntam.

Abasobɔdeɛ 

 2014 ISSNAF (Italian Scientists and Scholars of North America Foundation) Young Scientist Award in Environmental Sciences
 2009 James R. Holton Junior Scientist Award

title: Antoine Somdah
text:
Antoine Somdah (wɔwoo no 12 June 1962) yɛ Burkina Faso ɔmanpanyin ne ɔman nanmusifo. Burkina Faso Ɔnanmusifoɔ a ɔyɛ soronko na ɔwɔ tumi nyinaa wɔ Russia Aman Nkabom no mu firi afe 2014.

Asetra mu nsɛm 
Wɔwoo Antoine Somdah wɔ June 12, 1962. Wɔ 1988 mu no, owiee Mmara Sukuu a ɛwɔ Ouagadougou Sukuupɔn mu na ɔtoaa ne USSR adesua so. Wɔ 1993 mu no, owiee Peoples’ Friendship University, na wɔ 1995 mu no, onyaa amanaman ntam ɔmanfo mmara mu abodin krataa a ɛkorɔn nso wɔ hɔ. Wɔ 1990 mfe no mfiase mu hɔ no, owiee adwumayɛ ho ntetee wɔ Moscow Kuropɔn Bagua ne Moscow Mmaranimfo Dwumadibea.

Wɔ afe 1996 mu no, ofii n’adwumayɛ ase wɔ Burkina Faso Amannɔne Nsɛm Ho Dwumadibea. Wɔ afe 2007–2012 mu no, na ɔyɛ Ɔfotufoɔ a ɔdi kan wɔ Burkina Faso Daa Asɛmpatrɛ adwuma mu wɔ Amanaman Nkabom no mu wɔ New York na ɔde ne ho hyɛɛ Amanaman Nkabom Bagua Kɛseɛ no nhyiamu 63, 64, 65, 66 ne 67 mu . Wɔ afe 2008–2009 mu no, na ɔyɛ Amanaman Nkabom Ahobammɔ Bagua no muni .

Wɔ afe 2012–2014 mu no, na ɔyɛ Ɔkyerɛwfo Panyin wɔ Asoɛe a Ɛhwɛ Amanaman Ntam Adesua a Ɛkorɔn so (IHIS) wɔ Burkina Faso. Ɔyɛ mmara ho ɔbenfo wɔ nuklea ahoɔden ho na ɔde ne ho hyɛɛ IAEA Nhyiam Kɛse no nhyiam ahorow pii mu. 

Wɔ Ɔbɛnem 8, 2014 no, wɔpaw no sɛ Burkina Faso Ɔnanmusifo a Ɔyɛ Ɔsoro ne Tumidifo wɔ Russia . Wɔ March 7 no, ɔde ne adansedi nkrataa no bi maa Russia Ɔman no Amannɔne Nsɛm Ho Ɔsoafo Abadiakyiri, Mikhail Bogdanov,  na June 27 no, wɔde no kyerɛɛ Ɔmampanyin Vladimir Putin, a ɔne no susuw ɔhaw ahorow a ɛwɔ Syria, Afghanistan, . Iraq, Iran nuklea asɛm ne Ukraine ahokyere, na ɔsan nso kyerɛɛ ahoboa a Burkina Faso Aban no ayɛ sɛ wɔbɛma nyansahu, mfiridwuma ne aguadi mu biakoyɛ a wɔne Russia bɛyɛ no mu ayɛ den.  Mprempren, aban ananmusifo dwumadibea a Antoine Somdah di anim no nkutoo ne Burkina Faso aman ntam nkitahodi adwuma a ɛwɔ Russia, bere a Russia nni aman ntam nkitahodi anaa aban ananmusifo dwumadibea biara wɔ Burkina Faso. 

Ɔka Franse, Russia ne Borɔfo kasa yiye,  nanso ɔnte German kasa yiye .

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Sika Bella Kaboré
text:
Sika Bella Kaboré (wɔwoo no Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 20, 1959) yɛ Burkinabé mmaranimfo a wɔwoo no wɔ Togo, akwahosan ho ɔkamfofo, ne kan Burkina Faso Ɔmampanyin, Roch Marc Christian Kaboré yere. Ɔyɛɛ Burkina Faso Awuraa a odi kan fi December 29, 2015 kosi January 24, 2022, bere a asraafo tuu ne kunu, Roch Marc Christian Kaboré, fii n’ahengua so no.

Asetra mu nsɛm 
Wɔwoo Kaboré Sika Bella Adjoavi wɔ Lomé, ɛnnɛ Togo,  maa Mawupé Valentin Vovor, Togoni oduruyɛfo, ne Emilia Moreira. Wɔtaa frɛ no Bella, na ɛno ne ne mfinimfini din.

Kaboré wiee ne mmara ho abodin krataa a ɛkorɔn wɔ Lomé Sukuupɔn mu . Afei otu kɔɔ France kɔtoaa n’adesua so wɔ Burgundy Sukuupɔn mu. Ohyiaa ne kunu a ɔbɛware no daakye, Roch Marc Christian Kaboré, bere a na wɔn baanu nyinaa yɛ sukuufo wɔ Franse sukuupɔn ahorow mu no. Wɔwaree wɔ afe 1982 mu na wɔwɔ mma baasa. Wɔtu kɔɔ Kaboré kurom Burkina Faso wɔ 1980 mfeɛ no mu, faako a ɔde ne ho kɔbɔɔ Chamber of Commerce and Industry (CCI) a ɛwɔ Ouagadougou sɛ mmara ho adesua sohwɛfoɔ, berɛ a wɔpaw ne kunu sɛ Ɔkwankyerɛfoɔ Panyin wɔ Amanaman Ntam Sikakorabea a ɛwɔ Burkina Faso no. 

Wɔ afe 2006 mu no, Kaboré bɛyɛɛ KIMI Foundation a ɛde akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe a wɔde siw yare ano ma Burkinabé mmea ne mmofra no panyin.  KIMI Fapem a ɛkyerɛ "nkatanim" wɔ Dyula kasa mu, twe adwene si nyarewa a enni sabea a nufu mu kokoram, awotwaa mu kokoram, ne sickle cell yare ka ho ayaresa so . 

Wɔbɔ amanneɛ sɛ Kaboré ne kan Awuraa a odi kan Chantal Compaoré bɛnee bere a ne kunu amammui adwuma nyaa nkɔso wɔ 1990 ne 2000 mfe no mu no F Na wɔn baanu no wɔ asetra mu abakɔsɛm koro. Na mmea baanu no nyinaa waree Burkinabé amammui akannifo na wɔwoo wɔn wɔ amannɔne - Kaboré yɛ Togoni, bere a Compaoré yɛ Ivoryani . Amanyɔfo binom gye dii sɛ wɔn baanu no yɛ nnamfo paa, nanso na ɛte sɛ nea Ɔmampanyin Kaboré amammui kuw no mufo gye saa adwene yi ho akyinnye, na wɔka kyerɛɛ Jeune Afrique, sɛ, “Na wɔn kununom dwumadi nti na wɔbɛn wɔn ho.” Nanso so yebetumi aka sɛ na wɔyɛ nnamfo ankasa? Me ntumi nnye nni."  

Eduu afe 2015 no, na ɔyɛ Chamber of Commerce and Industry’s (CCI) adwumayɛkuw no muni. Ɔbɛyɛɛ Burkina Faso Awuraa a odi kan wɔ December 29, 2015, wɔ nkonim a ne kunu dii wɔ November 2015 ɔmampanyin abatow mu akyi .

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Hadja Fatimata Ouattara
text:
Hadja Fatimata Ouattara (nee Sanon ) yɛ Burkina Faso amanyɔni a wayɛ Digital Sikasɛm ne Postal Nkɔsoɔ soafoɔ firi Ɔpɛpɔn 2017.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Ouattara kɔɔ Sainte-Marie College wɔ Bobo-Dioulasso mpɔtam wɔ Tounouma na ɔwɔ kɔmputa mfiridwuma ho abodin krataa wɔ Polytechnic University of Bobo-Dioulasso ne Masters wɔ kɔmputa ntam nkitahodi ne multimedia mu wɔ International Center for Applied Advanced Studies wɔ Humber College wɔ Canada .

Adwuma 
Wɔ afe 2005 mu no, Ouattara bɛyɛɛ Burkina Nimdeɛ Dwumadie Nkitahodiɛ no wɛbsaet sohwɛfoɔ na ɔhyehyɛɛ Burkinabè Fekuo a ɛhwɛ Linux ne Free Software so.Na ɔyɛ ICT Ministry no Mfiridwuma ho Ɔfotufo. Ɔsan nso yɛɛ adwuma maa NGO ahorow pii na ɔyɛ African Free Software Network no muni a ɔhyehyɛɛ no. Wɔ nsakrae bere a ɛbaa Burkinabé atuatew no akyi wɔ afe 2014 mu no, na ɔwɔ dibea sɛ Mfiridwuma ho Ɔkyerɛwfo ma Ɔman Adwumayɛbea no.

Ɔmampanyin Roch Marc Christian Kaboré paw Ouattara sɛ Ɔmanpanyin Roch Marc Christian Kaboré sɛ Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ Digitals Sikasɛm ne Postal Nkɔso so wɔ 23 Ɔpɛpɔn 2017. Wɔ Ayɛwohomumɔ 2017 mu no, ɔhyɛɛ aseɛ sii nkuropɔn mu fiber optic loops dumiɛnsa wɔ ɔman no mantam ahenkuro biara mu, adwuma a ɛyɛ euro ɔpepem 36 a wɔayɛ no sɛ "G-cloud", a wɔde sika kɛseɛ nam Danish International Development Agency so na ɛyɛeɛ.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Dr Juliana Abane
text:
Juliana Abagsonema Abane yɛ Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ Panyin wɔ Adwumayɛ ho adesua ne ɔman adwumayɛ mu wɔ Abakɔsɛm ne Amanyɔsɛm Adesua Dwumadibea, Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so, Kumasi, Ghana. 

NWOMASUA

Ɔwɔ PhD wɔ Nkɔsoɔ Adwumayɛ mu a ɔwɔ nimdeɛ titire wɔ Nkɔsoɔ Ho Dwumadie ne Nhyehyɛeɛ mu firi Ɔman Asoɛeɛ a ɛhwɛ Nkɔsoɔ so (NIDA), Bangkok, Thailand, ne MPhil wɔ Ɔmanfoɔ Nnwuma mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn, Legon. Ɔbenfoɔ Abane nhwehwɛmu anigyeɛ ne adwumayɛ ho nhyehyɛeɛ, ɔman adwumayɛ, ahyehyɛdeɛ ho nsusuiɛ ne nneyɛeɛ, ɔman nhyehyɛeɛ ne nnisoɔ, nnipa ahoɔden sohwɛ.

Nhoma ahorow 
Watintim wɔ amanaman ntam atipɛnfo nhwehwɛmu nsɛmma nhoma ahorow a wɔakyerɛw so te sɛ Ɔman Ahyehyɛde Nhwehwɛmu, Ɔmanfo Budget & Sikasɛm, Daakye Adwumayɛ Nsɛmma Nhoma, Amanaman Ntam Nsɛmma Nhoma a Ɛfa Nnipa Nneɛma Ho Adesua Ho, Wiase Nyinaa Asetra mu Yiyedi, Wiase Nyinaa Encyclopedia of Public Administration, Ɔmanfo Nhyehyɛe, ne Aban ho.

title: Professor Edward Brenya
text:
Ɔbenfo Edward Brenya yɛ Amanyɔsɛm ho nimdefo, Nhyehyɛe mu Nhwehwɛmufo, ne Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo Panyin wɔ Abakɔsɛm ne Amanyɔsɛm Adesua Dwumadibea, Kwame Nkrumah Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma Sukuupɔn mu. Ɔsan yɛ ɔmanyɛfo.

Nwomasua 
Ɔnyaa ne mfitiaseɛ abodin krataa wɔ Amanyɔsɛm mu nyansapɛ mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn, Legon-Ghana; Master of Arts wɔ Amanaman Ntam Nsɛm mu (African Studies) abodin krataa wɔ Ohio Sukuupɔn, U.S.A., Master of Public Administration abodin krataa wɔ Ohio Sukuupɔn, U.S.A.; Ɔnyaa Amanyɔsɛm mu Ɔbenfoɔ Abodin krataa wɔ West Virginia Suapɔn, U.S.A. ne Nyansapɛ mu Oduruyɛfoɔ wɔ Amanyɔsɛm mu abodin krataa wɔ West Virginia Suapɔn, U.S.A.

Nnwoma Ahorow 
Watintim nsɛm pii wɔ nsɛmma nhoma ahorow a agye din mu na ne nhwehwɛmu no twe adwene si ɔmanfo akwahosan ne tawa ano aduru ho nhyehyɛe, ɔmanfo adwumayɛ, petroleum ne ahoɔden amammuisɛm ne nhyehyɛe so; demokrase ne demokrase a wɔde di dwuma.

title: Professor Samuel Adu-Gyamfi
text:
Ho Asem 
Ɔbenfo Samuel Adu-Gyamfi yɛ Social abakɔsɛm kyerɛwfo a odi kan a wɔatete no wɔ aduruyɛ ho fi Kwame Nkrumah Sukuupɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so (KNUST), Kumasi-Ghana. Ɔma ɔkasa wɔ Sukuupɔn koro no ara mu Abakɔsɛm ne Amanyɔsɛm Ho Adesua Dwumadibea.

Nnwomasua 
Ne nhwehwɛmu adwene si Abakɔsɛm a Wɔde Di Dwuma a akwahosan ne nnuruyɛ ho asetra mu adesua ka ho wɔ Afrika. Ɔdenam Abakɔsɛm a Wɔde Di Dwuma so no, ɔbɔ mmɔden pefee sɛ ɔbɛma mprempren nsɛnnennen ne nea wɔpaw no mu ada hɔ denam abakɔsɛm mu nsɛm a atwam ne nea ɛne no di nsɛ a ɔhwehwɛ mu no so.

title: Anita Akua Akuffo
text:
Anita Akua Akuffo a wɔsan frɛ no Anita Akuffo yɛ Ghana television nipa ne model a wagye din na wɔadi no anuonyam yie.

Anita Akua Akuffo yɛ ahɔhoɔ ne ɔkasafoɔ wɔ Media General wɔ Ghana mprempren. Ɔyɛ Ghana’s Most Beautiful ne Date Rush ho ɔyɛkyerɛfo a ɔka ho wɔ Tv3 so. Ɔsan nso yɛ brand ambassador ma brands a ɛwɔ soro te sɛ Vitamilk, Strawberry, Duffys Health, ne Beauty. Wade ne ho ahyɛ ahoɔfɛ akansi ahorow mu. Ɔyɛ Miss ECOWAS Ghana 2012 2nd Runner Up na ɔsan nso yɛ Top 10 finalist wɔ 2014 Miss Malaika Ghana mu.

Nnowumasua 
Anita Akua Akuffo yɛ obi a wawie Wesley Girls Senior High School. Ɔkɔɔ akyiri de ne din kɔhyɛɛ Ghana Institute of Journalism mu baabi a ɔnyaa abodin krataa wɔ Bachelor of Communications Studies mu. Ɔwɔ anidaso sɛ da bi ɔbɛba abɛyɛ mmaranimfo.

title: Cookie Tee
text:
Cookie Tee yɛ Ghana television so nipa, event host, model, ne adɔeyɛfo. Mprempren ɔne Berla Mundi bom yɛ TV3 Ghana anɔpa dwumadi, New Day. Bio nso, ɔyɛ Today’s Women, Kitchen Wars, aduannoa ho ɔyɛkyerɛ bi a ɛwɔ TV3 so no kwankyerɛfo, na ɔne afe afe TV so nokwasɛm dwumadi Ghana Most Beautiful no ho ɔkwankyerɛfo. Cookie ayɛ baguam nhyiam ahorow, a Ghana Club 100 Awards a ɛto so 19 no ka ho.

Nnowumasua 
Cookie Tee sukuu a edi kan ne Hohoe Gbohome LA Sukuu. Ɔtoaa ne nhomasua so fii Adesuakuw a ɛto so 5 wɔ Harrow International School a ɛwɔ Abeka, Lapaz, Accra kurotia, na owiee Junior High wɔ hɔ. Ɔkɔɔ St. Mary’s Senior High School, faako a ɔbɛyɛɛ sukuu no panyin. Bere a owiee ntoaso sukuu no, ɔkɔɔ Ghana Sukuupɔn, na osuaa Agoruhwɛ ne Amanyɔsɛm.

title: JULIUS ANSAH
text:
Julius Ansah (wɔwoo no afe 1950) yɛ Ghana ɔtemmuafoɔ a ɔbɛyɛɛ Ghana Asɛnnibea Kunini no Temmuafoɔ firi afe 2004 kɔsi afe 2020.

Ɔkɔɔ Ofori Panin ntoaso sukuu a ɛwɔ Apueɛ mantan mu wɔ Ghana ɛna ɔsane kɔɔ Prempeh ntoaso sukuu a ɛwɔ Asantemantan Ghana. 

John Kufuor a na ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔmampanyin saa bere no na ɔde Ansah kɔɔ Ghana Asɛnnibea Kunini no mu. John Kufuor kaa ntam wɔ Ahinime berɛ 2004 mu ne Asɛnnibea Kunini atemmufoɔ foforɔ mmienu, Felix Michael Lartey ne Richard Twum Aninakwah. 

Sɛ ɔtemmufoɔ panin paa saa berɛ no, ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ Ghana Ɔtemmufoɔ Panyin wɔ 20 Ɔpɛnimaa 2019 ne 7 Ɔpɛpɔn 2020 ntam wɔ Sophia Akuffo a ɔgyae adwuma sɛ Ɔtemmufoɔ Panyin no akyi. Kwasi Anin-Yeboah bɛdii Sophia Akuffo ananmu sɛ Ɔtemmufo Panyin a ɔdi hɔ. 

Wɔ afe 2018 mu a ɔsan nso bɛyɛɛ Ɔtemmuafoɔ Panyin a ɔreyɛ adwuma no, ɔtwerɛɛ krataa de kyɛw kɔmaa atemmuafoɔ nkron a na Ɔman Asɔredan Kɛseɛ Dwumadie a Ghana Aban asusu ho no bɛka wɔn afie. 

Atemmufoɔ a asɛm no aka wɔn no mu mmienu, Mariama Owusu ne Avril Lovelace-Johnson akyiri yi bɛkaa ne ho wɔ Asɛnnibea Kunini no mu wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa 2019 mu.

title: Koi larbi
text:
Koi Obuadabang larbi yɛ Ghana mmaranimfoɔ ne ɔtemmuafoɔ. Na ɔyɛ Ghana Asɛnnibea Kunini no temmuafoɔ firi afe apem ahankron ne aduoson mu (1970) de kɔsi afe apem ahankron ne aduoson mmienu mu (1972).

NE HO ASEM 
Wɔwoo Koi Larbi wɔ afe apem ahankron ne du nan mu (1914 ) wɔ Gold Coast. Ɔnyaa ne mmaranim abodin krataa wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduanan mmiɛnsa mu (1943) wɔ Durham Suapɔn ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ West Indian po so hyɛn mu adwumayɛfoɔ ahɔhodan mu sɛ ɔwɛmfoɔ. Berɛ a na ɔwɔ sukuu mu no, na ɔyɛ West African Students Union (WASU) no muni. Ɔfatae sɛ mmaranimfo wɔ Middle Temple   wɔ afe apam ahankron ne aduanan nan mu (1944) bosome a ɛdi kan na ɔhyɛɛ ase yɛɛ kokoam adwuma wɔ London. Ɔbɛyɛɛ mmara ho ɔfotufoɔ maa Gold Coast Akuafoɔ ananmusifoɔ a wɔwɔ United Kingdom wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduanan num mu (1945) ', na afe a ɛdi hɔ no, ɔbɛyɛɛ mmara ho ɔfotufoɔ maa West African National Secretariat (WANS).  Na ɔsane yɛ African Progress Association sane yɛ dwantinani ma Committee for the Defence of People of African Descent, wɔate saa kuo yi sɛ wɔmfa mmara kwan so mmoa mma Abibifoɔ fa wɔn mmara ho nsɛm ho.

Koi Larbi sane kɔɔ Gold Coast sɛ ɔrekɔhyɛ kokoam mmara adwuma ase bio. Wɔfrɛɛ no ​​kɔɔ Gold Coast bar wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduanan nsia mu (1946) Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduosia nkron mu no (1969), wɔpaw no sɛ Ɔman Badwani no muni na afe akyi no, wɔpaw no sɛ Ghana Asɛnnibea Kunini no Tɛmmuafoɔ wɔ Ɔbɛnem boseme da a ɛtɔ so num.  Wɔyii no firii adwuma mu wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduoson mmienu mu (1972) berɛ a Ɔman no Rɛdɛmhyen Kansele no tuu Asɛnnibea Kunini no fii hɔ no.

title: Amanaman Nkabom Amanneɛbɔfo Titiriw a Ɔhwɛ Awuduru ne Hokwan a Nnipa Wɔ So
text: Amanaman Nkabom Bagua a Ɛhwɛ Hokwan a Nnipa Wɔ So (United Nations Commission on Human Rights) na ɛde Amanaman Nkabom Amanneɛbɔfo Titiriw a Ɔhwɛ Awuduru ne Hokwan a Nnipa Wɔ So (United Nations Special Rapporteur on Toxics and Human Rights) no ahyɛde sii hɔ wɔ afe 1995 mu.

title: Amanaman Nkabom Amanneɛbɔfo Titiriw a Ɔhwɛ Awuduru ne Hokwan a Nnipa Wɔ So (United Nations Special Rapporteur on Toxics and Human Rights)
text:
Amanaman Nkabom Bagua a Ɛhwɛ Hokwan a Nnipa Wɔ So (United Nations Commission on Human Rights) na ɛde Amanaman Nkabom Amanneɛbɔfo Titiriw a Ɔhwɛ Awuduru ne Hokwan a Nnipa Wɔ So (United Nations Special Rapporteur on Toxics and Human Rights) no ahyɛde sii hɔ wɔ afe 1995 mu.

Abakɔsɛm 
Wɔ afe 1995 mu no, Bagua a Ɛhwɛ Hokwan a Nnipa Wɔ So no de ahyɛde sii hɔ sɛ wɔnhwehwɛ nea nnipa hokwan ahorow kyerɛ bere a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ nneɛma a ɛyɛ hu (hazardous substances) ne nwura a awuduru wom mu (toxic waste). Nea ɛka eyi ho ne nea nneɛma a ɛrekɔ so te sɛ kar a wɔde di dwuma a mmara mma ho kwan (illicit traffic) ne nneɛma a awuduru wom na ɛyɛ hu a wɔayi no adi bere a asraafo dwumadi ahorow (military activities), ɔko ne ntawntawdi (war and conflict), po so ahyɛn a wɔbubu no kyerɛ (shipbreaking). Mmeae afoforo a ɛka ahyɛde no ho ne nnuruyɛ mu nwura (medical waste), nnwuma a wotutu fam (extractive industries) - (titiriw ngo, gas ne nea wotu (mining), adwumayɛfo tebea wɔ nneɛma a wɔyɛ ne kuayɛ mu (abour conditions in manufacturing and agricultural sectors), nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma, nneɛma a ɛyɛ hu a efi mmeae nyinaa fi nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia mu ba (environmental emissions of hazardous substances from all source), ne nwura a wɔtow gu (disposal of waste).

Wɔ afe 2011 mu no, Amanaman Nkabom Bagua a Ɛhwɛ Hokwan a Nnipa Wɔ So no sii so dua sɛ nneɛma a ɛyɛ hu ne nwura betumi ayɛ asiane kɛse ama nnipa hokwan ahorow a wobenya koraa . Ɛtrɛw ahyɛde no mu ma ɛkaa nneɛma a asiane wom no nkwa nna nyinaa ho (whole life-cycle of hazardous products), efi ne yɛ so (from manufacturing) kosi nea etwa to a wɔtow gu so (final disposal). Wonim eyi sɛ ɔkwan a wɔfa so fi akokoaa so kɔ ɔdamoa mu (cradle-to-grave approach). Nnuru a wɔyɛ no ntɛmntɛm(rapid acceleration in chemical production) no kyerɛ sɛ ɛda adi sɛ eyi yɛ asiane a ɛrenya nkɔanim, titiriw ma nnipa hokwan ahorow a ɛwɔ ɔmanfo afã horow a wonni ahobammɔ kɛse no mu.

UN si so dua sɛ amanaman ntam mmara a ɛfa nnipa hokwan ahorow ho (international human rights law) hwehwɛ sɛ aman yɛ nneɛma a ɛyɛ nnam de siw ankorankoro (individuals) ne mpɔtam hɔfo (communities) a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ nneɛma a awuduru wom (toxic substances) ano. Wɔtaa bu ɔmanfo a wonni ahobammɔ sɛ wɔn a ɛka wɔn kɛse. Wɔn mu bi ne nnipa a wɔdi hia (people living in poverty), adwumayɛfoɔ, mmofra, akuo nketewa (minority groups), aborɔfoɔ (indigenous peoples), atubrafoɔ (migrants), ne akuo foforɔ a wɔn ho yɛ den, a ɛwɔ nkɛntɛnsoɔ kɛseɛ wɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbaa ntam (highly gendered impacts).

Ɔbenfo a ɔde ne ho (Independent expert) 
Amanaman Nkabom Bagua a Ɛhwɛ Hokwan a Nnipa Wɔ So (UN Human Rights Council) na ɛpaw Amanneɛbɔfo Titiriw no (The Special Rapporteur). Nnipa Hokwan Ahorow Bagua (Human Rights Council) no hwehwɛ sɛ onimdefo a wɔapaw no no hwehwɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔayɛ de ahyɛ nnipa hokwan ahorow a nneɛma a ɛyɛ hu ne nwura a wɔmfa nni dwuma yiye a wɔmfa nni dwuma yiye no ho nkuran na wɔabɔ ho amanneɛ na ɔsan de amanneɛbɔ ma Aman a wɔka ho no.

Nsɛmti a Amanneɛbɔfo Titiriw no abɔ ho amanneɛ a wɔpaw (Selection of topics reported on by the Special Rapporteur) 

 Wɔ bosome Ɔbɛnem afe 2022 mu no, Human Rights Watch de asɛm bi kɔmaa Amanneɛbɔfo Titiriw (Special Rapporteur) no amanneɛbɔ a ɛfa mercury, nsaanodwuma (artisanal) ne Sikakɔkɔɔ a wotu nketewa ho (small-scale Gold Mining). Wɔde mercury di dwuma wɔ sika kɔkɔɔ a wotu mu de gye sika kɔkɔɔ no fi aboɔden abo no mu. Mercury a epira mmofra titiriw no (harmful to children) tow hyɛ ntini a ɛwɔ nipadua no mfinimfini (central nervous system) no so na ebetumi asɛe amemene no (brain damage) na wawu. Mpɛn pii no, mmofra adwumayɛfo a wonni asiane a ɛwɔ mercury mu ho nsɛm kakraa bi anaa atoro so na wɔyɛ adwuma a wotu fagude no.

 2021 - Amanneɛbɔ: Plastik kyinhyia no fa ahorow ne nkɛntɛnso a enya wɔ nnipa hokwan ahorow so (The stages of the plastics cycle and their impacts on human rights)

Amanneɛbɔ no twe adwene si nnipa hokwan ahorow a awuduru a wɔde ka plastic ho ne plastic asetra mu nsɛm, a hokwan ahorow a mmea, mmofra, adwumayɛfo, ne aborɔfo wɔ ka ho so dua. Wɔtaa de nnuru a awuduru wom (Toxic chemicals) ka plastic ho, na ɛde asiane kɛse ba hokwan ahorow a nnipa wɔ ne nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia so (causing serious risks to human rights and the environment). Amanneɛbɔfo Titiriw (Special Rapporteur) no de nyansahyɛ ahorow (recommendations) a n’atirimpɔw ne sɛ wobedi nea enye a plastic de ba nnipa hokwan ahorow so no ho dwuma ma (negative consequences of plastics on human rights).

 2015 - Amanneɛbɔ: Hokwan a obi wɔ sɛ ɔnya nsɛm a ɛfa nneɛma a ɛyɛ hu ne nwura ho (Right to Information on Hazardous Substances and Wastes)

Wɔ amanneɛbɔ yi mu no, Amanneɛbɔfoɔ Titiriw (Special Rapporteur) no ma hokwan a ɛwɔ sɛ wɔnya nsɛm wɔ nneɛma a ɛyɛ hu ne nwura nkwa nna nyinaa mu no kɔ mu pefee (life cycle of hazardous substances and wastes), ɔkyerɛ nsɛnnennen (identifies challenges) a aba wɔ saa hokwan yi a wɔbɛnya mu na ɔkyerɛ ɔhaw ahodoɔ yi ano aduru a ɛbɛtumi aba (outlines potential solutions to these problems). Wɔaka Aman no asɛyɛde (Obligations of States) ne adwumayɛfo asɛyɛde ahorow (responsibilities of business) a ɛfa hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wonya nsɛm a ɛfa nneɛma a ɛyɛ hu (hazardous substances) ne nwura (wastes) ho a wɔde bedi dwuma ho.

title: Hokwan a ɔwɔ sɛ wonya aduru a etu mpɔn (Right to an effective remedy)
text:
Hokwan a obi wɔ sɛ onya ayaresa a etu mpɔn (Right to an effective remedy) yɛ hokwan a obi a wɔabu ne hokwan ahorow so wɔ sɛ onya mmara kwan so ayaresa (legal remedy). Ɛsɛ sɛ ano aduru a ɛte saa no yɛ nea wotumi nya (accessible), ɛkyekyere (binding), etumi de wɔn a wɔyɛ bɔne no kɔ asɛnnibea (capable of bringing perpetrators to justice), de akatua a ɛfata ma (appropriate reparations), na esiw onipa no hokwan ahorow (person's rights) a wobu so bio no ano. Hokwan a ɔwɔ sɛ onya ano aduru a etu mpɔn no ma onipa no nya tumi a ɔde bɛhwehwɛ ano aduru afi ɔman no hɔ tẽẽ sen sɛ ɔbɛfa amanaman ntam nhyehyɛe bi so. Ɛyɛ ɔkwan a mfaso wɔ so a wɔfa so bɔ nnipa hokwan ahorow ho ban wɔ ɔman no mu na ɛnyɛ sɛ ɛhwehwɛ sɛ ɔman no bɔ nnipa hokwan ahorow ho ban de jure nko na mmom wɔ nneyɛe mu nso ma ankorankoro nsɛm. Wɔtaa gye hokwan a obi wɔ sɛ onya ano aduru a etu mpɔn (right to an effective remedy) tom sɛ hokwan a nnipa wɔ wɔ amanaman ntam nnipa hokwan ho nkrataa (international human rights instruments) mu.  

Wɔada hokwan a obi wɔ sɛ onya ano aduru a etu mpɔn adi wɔ Amansan Mpaemuka a Ɛfa Hokwan a Nnipa Wɔ ho (Universal Declaration of Human Rights) no Ahyɛde awotwe (8), Amanaman Ntam Apam a Ɛfa Ɔmanfo ne Amammui Hokwan Ho (International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights) Ahyɛde mmenu (2), Europa Apam a Ɛfa Hokwan a Nnipa Wɔ Ho (European Convention on Human Rights) no Ahyɛde dumiɛnsa (13), ne Europa Aman Nkabom Mmarahyɛ Bagua (European Union Charter on Fundamental Rights) no Ahyɛde aduanan-nson (47) a ɛfa Hokwan a Nnipa Wɔ ho no mu Hokwan a Ɛho Hia.

Guankɔbea hwehwɛfo (Asylum seekers) 
Wɔde hokwan a ɛwɔ hɔ sɛ wobenya ano aduru a etu mpɔn adi dwuma wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa guankɔbea hwehwɛfo (asylum seekers) ho a wɔanya hokwan a ɛbɛma ɔman bi asiw guankɔbea hwehwɛfo bi kwan ansa na wɔabu guankɔbea hwehwɛfo no atɛn, na sɛ wɔpow guankɔbea adesrɛ a, ɛsɛ sɛ nea ɔrehwehwɛ guankɔbea no wɔ tumi a mfaso wɔ so a wɔde bɛkɔ asɛnnibea denam bere a ɛdɔɔso a wɔbɛma wɔn ne kwan a wɔbɛfa so anya mmara kwan so ananmusifo (legal representation) no so. Mpɛn pii no, asennibea ahorow nhuu sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ ɔman no de mmaranimfo ma, bere mpo a guankɔbea hwehwɛfo ntumi ntɔ bi no, sɛ ɛho nhia sɛ mmaranimfo bi na ama wanya aduru a etu mpɔn a. Asɛnnibea ahorow ahu sɛ ɔkwan a wɔfa so yɛ ade a ɛboro so betumi asɛe hokwan a obi wɔ sɛ onya ano aduru a etu mpɔn, titiriw bere a wɔamfa European Unionmmaranimfo (lawyer) amma no.

Europa Aman Nkabom Kuw (European Union) 
Wɔ Europa Aman Nkabom Kuw mmara mu no (European Union law), hokwan a obi wɔ sɛ onya ano aduru a etu mpɔn no fa hokwan ahorow a EU mmara de ma a wɔde di dwuma wɔ aman a wɔka ho no asennibea ahorow nyinaa ho sen hokwan ahorow a nnipa wɔ.

Ayayade (Torture) 
Amanaman Nkabom Boayikuw a Ɛhwɛ Hokwan a Nnipa Wɔ So (United Nations Human Rights Committee) no aka sɛ wɔ ayayade ho nsɛm mu no, hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wonya ano aduru a etu mpɔn no hwehwɛ sɛ aman no hwehwɛ nsɛm a wɔka sɛ wɔyɛɛ wɔn ayayade no mu, di wɔn a wɔyɛɛ bɔne no asɛm (prosecute perpetrators), tua wɔn a wɔayɛ wɔn ayayade no ka (provide compensation to victims), na wɔmma mmara so bu a ɛte saa ara mma bio. Wɔada nnyinasosɛm a ɛfa hokwan a obi wɔ sɛ onya ayaresa a etu mpɔn ho no adi wɔ Amanaman Nkabom Apam a Ɛko Tia Ayayade (United Nations Convention against Torture) no asɛmti dunnan (14) mu.

 Hokwan ahorow a nnipa wɔ (Human rights)
 Hokwan a ɔwɔ sɛ wodi n’asɛm wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfata so (Right to a fair trial)
 Anihwɛ a wonni (Impartiality)

title: Mpaemuka a Ɛfa Hokwan a Abibifo Wɔ Ho (Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous)
text:
Mpaemuka a ɛfa Hokwan a Abibifo wɔ ho (Declaration on the Rights of Indigenous Peoples - UNDRIP anaa DOTROIP  ) [note 1]  yɛ gyinaesi a ɛnyɛ nea ɛkyekyere wɔ mmara kwan so a Amanaman Nkabom no (United Nations) penee so wɔ afe 2007 mu. Ɛkyerɛkyerɛ na ankorankoro ne nnipakuw hokwan ahorow a Abibifo wɔ (rights of Indigenous peoples), a wɔn wurayɛ hokwan ahorow (ownership rights) a wɔwɔ wɔ amammerɛ ne amanne kwan so nkyerɛkyerɛmu (cultural and ceremonial expression), nipasu (identity), kasa (language), adwumayɛ (employment), akwahosan (health), nhomasua (education), ne nsɛm afoforo ho ka ho (other issues). Wɔn wurayɛ nso trɛw kɔ wɔn adwene ne amammerɛ mu agyapade (intellectual and cultural property) a wɔbɔ ho ban so. Mpaemuka no "si hokwan a Abibifo wɔ sɛ wɔbɛkɔ so akura wɔn ankasa ahyehyɛde, amammerɛ ne atetesɛm mu na wɔahyɛ mu den, na wɔadi wɔn nkɔso akyi ma ɛne wɔn ankasa ahiade ne wɔn apɛde hyia so dua" - (emphasizes the rights of Indigenous peoples to maintain and strengthen their own institutions, cultures and traditions, and to pursue their development in keeping with their own needs and aspirations). "Ɛbara nyiyim a wɔyɛ tia aborɔfo," na "ɛhyɛ wɔn kyɛfa a edi mũ na etu mpɔn wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa wɔn ho nyinaa mu ne hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔkɔ so yɛ soronko na wodi wɔn ankasa anisoadehu ahorow a ɛfa sikasɛm ne asetra mu nkɔso akyi no ho nkuran" - (it prohibits discrimination against indigenous peoples," and it "promotes their full and effective participation in all matters that concern them and their right to remain distinct and to pursue their own visions of economic and social development).

Mpaemuka no botae ne sɛ ɛbɛhyɛ aman nkuran ma wɔne aborɔfo ayɛ adwuma de adi wiase nyinaa nsɛm te sɛ nkɔsoɔ (development), demokrase a amammerɛ ahorow pii wom (multicultural democracy), ne amanyɔde (decentralization).

Yawoada, Ɛbɔ 13, 2007 no, Amanaman Nkabom (United Nations) no de nnipa dodow no ara 143 too aba de gyinaa Mpaemuka no so (anan (4) tiaa, dubaako (11) annye antom, na aduasa anan (34) annye antom).

Efi afe 2007 no, aman anan a wɔtow aba tiaa no no adan wɔn gyinabea na mprempren wɔtaa Mpaemuka no akyi. Ɛde besi bosoome Ɔgyefoɔ afe 2020 no, Amanaman Nkabom Dwumadibea a ɛhwɛ sikasɛm ne asetra mu nsɛm so, Abibifo ka (A/RES/61/295) ho asɛm sɛ "...amanaman ntam adwinnade a ɛkɔ akyiri sen biara a ɛfa abibifo hokwan ahorow ho." Ɛde amansan nhyehyɛe a ɛfa gyinapɛn a ɛba fam koraa a ɛbɛma wiase abibifo nkwa, nidi ne yiyedi asi hɔ na ɛkyerɛkyerɛ nnipa hokwan gyinapɛn a ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw ne ahofadi atitiriw a ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw no mu kɔ akyiri sɛnea ɛfa aborɔfo tebea pɔtee ho no. 

Sɛ́ Amansan Nhyiam Mpaemuka no, UNDRIP nyɛ adwinnade a ɛkyekyere wɔ mmara kwan so wɔ amanaman ntam mmara ase (international law). Sɛnea UN nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ bi kyerɛ no "egyina hɔ ma amanaman ntam mmara mu gyinapɛn ahorow a ɛrenya nkɔsoɔ a ɛyɛ nnam no ampa na ɛda UN aman a wɔka ho no bɔhyɛ sɛ wɔbɛkɔ akwan horow bi so"; UN ka ho asɛm sɛ ɛde “gyinabea titiriw bi si hɔ ma sɛnea wɔyɛ aborɔfo (indigenous peoples) a akyinnye biara nni ho sɛ ɛbɛyɛ adwinnade titiriw a wɔde beyi nnipa hokwan ahorow (human rights violations) a wobu so tia okyinnsoromma (planet's) yi so aborɔfo ɔpepem 370 no afi hɔ, na wɔaboa wɔn ma wɔako atia nyiyim (discrimination) ne nnipa a wɔde wɔn to nkyɛn (marginalisation). 

UNDRIP kyerɛw "Abibifoɔ abakɔsɛm mu anwiinwii (grievances), nnɛyi nsɛnnennen (contemporary challenges) ne asetena mu sikasɛm (socio-economic), amammuisɛm ne amammerɛ mu apɛdeɛ (political and cultural aspirations)" na ɛyɛ "awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ tenten mmɔdenbɔ a Abibifoɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ abɔ sɛ wɔbɛnya amanaman ntam adwene, sɛ wɔbɛgye wɔn apɛdeɛ atom, na wɔanya mmoa ama wɔn amammuisɛm ho nhyehyɛe ahorow."  Canada Nhwehwɛmu Titenani ne ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo panyin wɔ Saskatchewan Sukuupɔn mu (University of Saskatchewan) Ken Coates kyerɛ sɛ UNDRIP ne Abibifo di nkitaho denneennen, bere a aman nniso ahorow nnya nte nkɛntɛnso a enya no ase yiye.

Abakɔsɛm 
Fapem a wɔde yɛɛ saa mpaemuka yi fii ase wɔ 1923 ne 1925 mu denam Haudenosaunee Panyin Deskaheh ne Māori T. W. Ratana, a wɔbɔɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔde nsɛm a ɛfa Canada ne New Zealand a wɔantumi ankura apam ahorow mu no bɛba Amanaman Apam (League of Nations), Amanaman Nkabom no anim no nnwuma so (United Nations' precursor). Wofii ase san susuw Abibifo ho nsɛm ho wɔ wiase nyinaa wɔ afe 1982 mu bere a wɔhyehyɛɛ Adwumakuw a Ɛhwɛ Abibifo So, a Sikasɛm ne Asetra mu Bagua (ECOSOC) hyehyɛe no. Na wɔn botae ne sɛ wɔbɛyɛ krataa a ɛfa biribiara ho a ɛbɛboa ma wɔabɔ Abibifo hokwan ne hokwan ahorow ho ban wɔ wiase nyinaa.

Mpaemuka no faa nhyehyɛe ahorow pii mu fi afe 1994 kosi afe 2006,  na na Vienna Mpaemuka ne Dwumadi Nhyehyɛe no akamfo nkyerɛase (Vienna Declaration and Programme of Action) bi akyerɛ dedaw wɔ afe 1993 mu.

title: Seth Twum
text:
Seth Twum yɛ kane Ɔtenmuafoɔ ma Ghana kɔɔto baatan. Ɔhyɛɛ ne dwumadie ase wɔ kɔɔtɔ bantan mu firi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne mmienu (2002) mu kɔ si mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nson mu (2007).

Ne ho nsɛm 
Wɔwoo Twum Ɔbɛnem bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduonu (20) wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduasa nson (1937) mu. Ɔkɔɔ ne ntoasoɔ sukuu wɔ Achimota ntoasoɔ sukuu mu.

Wɔ Kitawonsa bosome mu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne mmienu (2002) mu na wɔdaa no adi kyerɛeɛ san so yɛɛ ne ho nhwehwɛmu totoo n'ano wɔ Ɛbɔ bosome no mu saa afe korɔ no ara. Bosome akyi no, Ɔman panin John Agyekum Kufour a na ɔyɛ Ghana man panin saa berɛ no gyee no tomm wɔ mmarahyɛbadwafie na wɔde no baa kɔɔto sɛ ɔtenmuafoɔ wɔ Obubuo bosome mu saa afe no ara. Seth Twum ne Justice Georgina Theodora Wood, Justice Stephen Alan Brobbey ne Justice Samuel Glenn Baddoo nyinaa na wɔgye wɔn tomm da korɔ. Ɔde ne dwumadie wɔ kɔɔto baa awieeɛ wɔ Ɔbɛnem bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduonu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nson mu (2007) a na ne mfeɛ wanya no ne berɛ ɛsɛ sɛ ɔde ne dwumadie ba awieeɛ wɔ kɔɔto a ɛyɛ mfeɛ aduoson (70years) no yɛ pɛ.

Twum wuuiɛ wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu mmienu mu (2022) na wɔsiee no wɔ Kitawonsa bosome da a adikan wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu mmienu (2022) mu.

title: E.D.K.Adjabeng
text:
Elliot Divine Kwami Adjabeng yɛ Ghana asɛnnibea kunini tɛmmuafoɔ a wakɔ ahomegyeɛ mu. Ɔdii asɛnnibea no fi afe apem ahankron ne aduokron num kosi mfe mpem mmienu ne mmienu mu.(1995 - 2002).

Adjabeng fi Avatime a ɛwɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔno ne mmaranimfo kumaa a ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔtɛmmuafo wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe nnan (1984) mu bere a ɔsom sɛ mmaranimfo mfe ason ansa na wɔrepaw no sɛ ɔnyɛ ɔtemmuafoɔ no. Saa bere no ɔmampanyin Jerry John Rawlings na ɔpaw no sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ Asɛnnibea Kunini no wɔ Ɔgyefoɔ bosom da a ɛtɔ so aduonu mmienu wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron num (February 22, 1995).

Ɔdii dwuma firi saa berɛ no so kɔsii Ahinime bosom no mu wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne mmienu no mu (2002) berɛ a ɔgyaee adwuma a na wadi mfeɛ aduosia nnan (64), na aka afe nsia (6) na mfeɛ a wɔhyɛ sɛ ɔbɛkɔ pɛnhyen a ɛyɛ mfeɛ aduɔson (70) no adu. Saa bere no ɔmampanyin a wɔde krataa a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ɔregyae adwuma no kɔmaa no no, John Agyekum Kufuor gyee krataa no toom na ɔdaa no ase wɔ ɔsom kɛse a ɔde ama ɔman no ho na ɔsan nso maa no da yie.

Berɛ a na ɔresom wɔ Asɛnnibea Kunini no mu wɔ saa berɛ no so no, na okura gyinabea a emu yɛ den tiaa Fast Track Courts (FTCs) no,  ɔkaa sɛ, asɛnnibea ahorow no mu mpaapaemu soronko a wɔbɛhyehyɛ a nneɛma titiri wom no rentumi nyɛ adwuma a wɔanyɛ nsakrae biara wɔ kɔɔto kɛseɛ mmara no mu.

Na ɔgye di sɛ ( FTC) de akwankyerɛ ahorow bi a ɛyɛ soronko firi mmara a aberɛ biara no Kɔɔtɔ kɛseɛ no de di dwuma na deɛ ɛbɛba ne sɛ  wei ɛbɛsɛe mmara no.

title: Kwaku the Traveller
text: "Kwaku the Traveller" yɛ dwom a Ghana drill nnwontofo Black Sherif too. Wɔyii no adi wɔ 31 Oforisuo 2022, ɛnam Blacko, ne Empire so.  Black Sherif na ɔkyerɛwee "Kwaku the Traveller", na Joker Nharnah na ɔyɛɛ produsɛn no.

title: Konongo, Ghana
text:
Konongo (a wɔsan frɛ no Konongo-Odumase) yɛ beae a wotu sika kɔkɔɔ ne manganese a wotu wɔ Ashanti, Ghana. Kurow no yɛ Asante Akim Mfinimfini Kuropɔn no ahenkurow. Ɛde besi afe 2012 no, Konongo wɔ nnipa 41,238 a wɔte hɔ. Konongo ne Kumasi, Ashanti ahenkurow no ntam kwan bɛyɛ kilomita 53 (akwansin 33).

title: Isaac K. Abban
text:
Isaac Kobina Donkor Abban JSC (1933 – 21 April 2001) ma ɔyɛ Ghana ɔtemmuafoɔ panyin wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron num ne mfe mpem mmienu ne baako (1995 and 2001) ntam. Ɔno ne onipa a ɔtɔ so nkron a ɔdii saa dibea yi firi berɛ a Ghana bɛyɛɛ ɔman a ɛde ne ho.

Abrabɔ mfitiaseɛ ne nwomasua 

Wɔwoo Abban wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduasa mmiɛnsa (1933) mu wɔ Agona Nkum a  ɛwɔ mfinimfin mantam mu. Ɔnyaa ne ntoaso sukuu wɔ Mfantsipim Sukuu mu firi afe afe apem ahankron ne aduanan nnwɔtwe (1948)  kɔsi afe apem.ahankron ne aduonum baako (1951) mu. Ɔfirii hɔ kɔɔ United Kingdom kɔsuaa mmara wɔ Nottingham Suapɔn mu.

Adwuma 
Wɔfrɛɛ no ​​kɔɔ Engiresifo asoeɛ wɔ Ayɛwohomumu bosom da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nan wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduonum nnwɔtwe (24 June 1958) mu. Ɔsan baa Ghana wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduonum nkron (1959) na ɔde ne ho kɔhyɛɛ ankorankoro adwuma mu kosii sɛ wɔfrɛɛ no ​​kɔɔ Asɛnnibea Kunini no mu wɔ Kotonimaa bosom no mu  wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduoson  (May 1970) mu.

Aban kɔmmisa 
Wɔfrɛɛ ɔtemmufoɔ Abban kɔɔ Ghana mmaranimfoɔ adwuma mu wɔ Oforisuo bosom da a ɛtɔ so dunwɔtwe wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduonum nkron (18 April 1959) mu. Bere a na ɔyɛ Asɛnnibea Kunini temmuafoɔ no, wɔpaw no sɛ abatoɔ sohwɛfoɔ na ɔhwɛɛ ‘Union Government (UNIGOV)’ abatoɔ nsɛm so wɔ Ɔbɛnem bosom da a ɛtɔ so aduasa afe apem ahankron ne aduoson nnwɔtwe (30 March 1978) mu wɔ Supreme Military Council (SMC) aberɛ so.

Wɔ bere bi mu a na ɔmanfoɔ no pɛsɛ wɔpaw no no, ɔde ne ho kɔsie efiri sɛ na osuro sɛ asraafo mpanyimfoɔ no bɛgye ne nkwa. Ɛfiri sɛ ɔsɔre tiaa mmɔdenbɔ a na asraafoɔ SMC aban no reyɛ sɛ wɔbɛsɛe UNIGOV amanfoɔ a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔpaw wɔn no. Ɔtemmufoɔ Kinsgley Nyinah a ɔdii n’adeɛ no na ɔhwɛɛ afe afe apem ahankron ne aduoson nkron (1979) abatoɔ no a ɛmaa Dr Limann dii nkonim bɛyɛɛ Ghana ɔmampanyin.

Ɔtemmuafoɔ Panin 
Ɔfii hɔ kɔɔ Seychelles baabi a ɔsom sɛ Ɔtemmuafoɔ panyin firi apem ahankron ne aduokron (1990) kosi afe apem ahankron ne aduokron mmiɛnsa (1993) mu. Bere a ɔsan kɔɔ Ghana no, ɔsan kɔkaa Ghana Atemmuo dwumadibea no ho na wɔpaw no sɛ ɔnkɔ Ghana Asɛnnibea Kunini no mu. Wɔ Ɔgyefoɔ da a ɛtɔ so aduonu mmienu afe apem ahankron ne aduokron num (February 22, 1995) mu no, Ɔmampanyin Jerry Rawlings paw no sɛ Ɔtemmufoɔ Panyin.

Owuo 
Na ɛsɛ sɛ ɔtemmuafoɔ Abban kɔ ahomegyeɛ mu wɔ Kotonimaa da a adi kan wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne baako (May 1, 2001) mu ɛnam akwahosan bi nti. Owui nna kakra ansa na ɛno reba wɔ Ɔforisuo da a ɛtɔ so aduonu baako afe mpem mmienu ne baako (21 April 2001) mu wɔ Nkran, Ghana, bere a na wadi mfe aduosia nson (67).

title: Isaac K. Amuah
text:
Isaac K. Amuah (1929-1997) yɛ Ghana ɔtemmuafoɔ. Na ɔyɛ Ghana Asɛnnibea Kunini no temmuafoɔ firi  Obubuo bosom da a ɛtɔ so aduasa afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nnum de kɔsi Ɔsanaa da a a ɛtɔ so afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nson (30 November 1995 and 19 August 1997).

Abarabɔ mfitiaseɛ ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Amuah wɔ Ɔbɛnem da a ɛtɔ so afe apem ahankron ne aduonu nkron (1929) mu wɔ Nkran. Ɔnyaa ne mfitiaseɛ nwomasua wɔ Nkran Aban Sukuu ne Methodist Mmarimaa Sukuu a ɛwɔ Nkran. Akyiri n7o, ɔkɔɔ Mfantsipim Sukuu, Cape Coast , baabi a ɔnyaa ne ntoaso sukuu ne Fourah Bay College, Freetown, Sierra Leone nso yɛ babia ɔtoa ne nwomasua ne so firiiɛ.

Adwuma 
Wɔfrɛɛ Amuah kɔɔ Lincoln's Inn wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduonum  nkron (1959)  mu, ɛnam ɛno so nti ɔne Mmaranimfo afoforo yɛɛ adwuma wɔ Ghana mmara adwumayɛbea bi mu firi afe apem ahankron ne aduonum nkron de kɔsii afe apem ahankron ne aduosia mmienu  (1959 and 1962). Wɔ Ɔgyefoɔ da a ɛtɔ so dunson afe apem ahankron ne aduosia mmienu (17 February, 1962) mu no, wɔpaw no sɛ Ɔmantam Ɔtemmuafo wɔ Kumasi. Akyiri no ɔbɛyɛɛ mansini Asɛnnibea temmuafo wɔ Nkran, baabi a na ɔwɔ Jamestown. Amuah sɔre faa dibea ahorow no mu bɛyɛɛ temmufo wɔ mentemehoase kɔɔto mu na ɔno akyiri no ɔbɛyɛɛ Asɛnnibea Kunini no temmuafo wɔ Obubuo da a ɛtɔ so aduasa wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nnum (30 November 1995) no mu. Ɔtenaa saa adwumayɛbea yi mu kosii sɛ owui wɔ Ɔsanaa bosom no mu da a ɛtɔ so dunkron afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nson (19 August 1997).

N'abrabɔ 
Amuah wui wɔ n’adwuma mu wɔ Ɔsanaa bosom no mu da a ɛtɔ so dunkron afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nson (19 August 1997). Deɛ na n’ani gye ho paa yɛ akenkan.

Beaeɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ 

Owufoɔ
Ɔtɛmmuafo

title: Richard Aninakwah
text:
Richard Twum Aninakwah yɛ Ghana kɔɔto baatan tenmuafoɔ a ɔdi ne dwumadie wɔ asɛmdibea aba awieeɛ. Firi mfeɛ mpem.mmienu ne nan (2004) kɔsi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nwɔtwe (2008) na  ɔsomm wɔ kɔɔtɔ baatan hɔ.

Ne ho nsɛm 
Wɔwoo Aninakwah wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nwɔtwe wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduasa nwɔtwe (1938) mu. Ɔkɔɔ ne ntoasoɔ sukuu wɔ  Prempeh College na John Agyekum Kufour a ɔyɛ kane Ghana man panin yɛ meete (mate) berɛ a na wɔwɔ sukuu no.

Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan (2004) na wɔyii no na wɔ ɛda wukuada, Ɛbɔ bosome da a ɛtɔ so dunum wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan mu (2004) na wɔyɛɛ ne ho nhwehwɛmu totoo n'ano. Ɔne Justice Felix Michael Lartey ne Mr Justice Julius Ansah na wɔgye wɔn tomm wɔ kɔɔto de wɔn sii nkwannwa so wɔ Fiada, Ahinime bosome da a ɛtɔ so dunum wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan (2004) mu.

Beaeɛ menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: William Atuguba
text:
William Atuguba yɛ obi a na ɔyɛ Ghana Asɛnnibea Kunini no temmuafo.

Adwuma 
Atuguba dii kan de ne din hyɛɛ mu sɛ ɔtemmufo wɔ  Ahinime da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa afe apem ahankron ne aduoson nnan (3 October 1974). Ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ ankorankoro mmaranimfo na ɔsom sɛ mmaranimfo ne ɔman mmaranimfo ansa na Ɔmampanyin Rawlings repaw no sɛ Asɛnnibea Kunini Temmufo wɔ afe 1995 mu.

Na ɔyɛ Ɔtemmufoɔ panyin a ɔyɛ adwuma firi Kotonimaa da a ɛtɔ so aduonu num, afe mpem mmienu ne dunsia mu de kɔsii Ayɛwohomumɔ ne da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa, afe mpem mmienu ne dunsia mu (May 25, 2016, to June 3, 2016), berɛ a na Ɔtemmufoɔ Georgena Theodora Woode wɔ ɔman no akyi wɔ aban nnwuma mu. Na ɔyɛ ɔtemmufo panyin wɔ Asɛnnibea Kunini no mu wɔ saa berɛ no so.

Ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ Ɔtemmufoɔ Panyin firi Ɔgyefoɔ bosom no mu,afe mpem mmienu ne dunson  (February 2017) ansa na Georgeina Theodora Wood rekɔ n'ahomegyeɛ mu wɔ Ayɛwohomumɔ da a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe afe mpem mmienu ne dunson (8 June 2017) de kɔsii Ayɛwohomumɔ ne da a ɛtɔ so dunkron afe mpem mmienu ne dunson (19 June 2017) berɛ a Sophia Akuffo kaa ntam kyerɛ Ɔmampanyin Akufo-Addo sɛ Ɔtemmufoɔ Panyin foforɔ no.

Ɔyɛ obi a wadi dwuma ɛwɔ Gh"ana Asɛnnibea Kunini no mu akyɛ yie. Ɔyɛɛ ɔtemmufoɔ no mfeɛ aduanan nnan (44) ne Asɛnnibea Kunini temmufoɔ firi afe afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nnum (1995) de  kɔsii afe mpem mmienu ne dunwɔtwe (2018) mu, a ɛno nyinaa bɛyɛ mfeɛ aduonu mmiɛnsa (23).
