title: Nipadua mu mudi mu kura (Bodily integrity)
text:
Nipadua mu mudi mu kura yɛ honam nipadua no a wontumi mmu so na esi hia a nnipa ankasa ahofadi (autonomy), wɔn ankasa wurayɛ (self-ownership), ne wɔn ankasa gyinaesi ho (self-determination) hia sen wɔn ankasa nipadua so dua. Wɔ nnipa hokwan (human rights) ahorow mu no, wobu obi foforo nipadua mu mudi mu kura a wobu so sɛ mmara so bu a ɛnteɛ, ɔde ne ho hyɛ mu, na ebia ɛyɛ nsɛmmɔnedi.

Aban ne mmara (Government and law)

Ireland 
Wɔ Republic of Ireland no, asennibea ahorow agye nipadua mu nokwaredi atom sɛ hokwan a wontumi nkan (unenumerated right), a wɔde “ankorankoro hokwan ahorow (personal rights)” a ɛwɔ Ireland amansɛmdi (Irish constitution) Ahyɛde aduanan (40) mu ho bɔhyɛ a wɔde ma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛkɔ akyiri so no abɔ ho ban. Wɔ Ryan v Attorney General mu no wɔkae sɛ "wowɔ hokwan sɛ woremfa wo nipadua anaa wo nipasu (personhood) ntwitware mu." Wei kyerɛ sɛ ebia Ɔman no renyɛ biribiara mfa nsɛe w’asetra anaa w’akwahosan. Sɛ woda afiase a, wowɔ hokwan sɛ woremma w'akwahosan nkɔ asiane mu bere a wowɔ afiase".

Wɔ asɛm foforo bi a M (Immigration - Rights of Unborn) -v- Minister for Justice and Equality & ors mu no, Ireland Asɛnnibea Kunini no buu atɛn sɛ hokwan a obi wɔ sɛ ɔyɛ nipadua mu nokwaredi no trɛw kɔ mmofra a wɔanwo no so. Wɔ asɛm no mu nsɛm tiawa a ɛwɔ ɔfa 5.19 mu no, Asɛnnibea Kunini no kae sɛ:...hokwan baako pɛ a abofra a ɔhyɛ yafunu mu wɔ sɛdeɛ Amanyɔ Mmara no teɛ seesei a ɛtwetwe hokwan a ɔwɔ sɛ ɔnya ahobanbɔ ne bem ne deɛ nsakraeɛ a ɛwɔ Ahyɛdeɛ 40.3.3 mu no ahyɛ no nsow a ɛne sɛ, hokwan a ɔwɔ sɛ ɔnya nkwa anaa, ɔkwan foforɔ so no, hokwan a ɔwɔ sɛ ɔwo no na, ebia, (na eyi yɛ asɛm a ɛsɛ sɛ wosi ho gyinae daakye) hokwan ahorow a ɛka ho te sɛ hokwan a obi wɔ sɛ onya nipadua mu nokwaredi a ɛwɔ hokwan a obi wɔ sɛ ɔtra ase ankasa mu na wontumi ntetew mu.

Mmea hokwan ahorow (Women's rights) 
Ɛwom sɛ wɔma onipa biara nipadua mudi mu kura de, nanso mpɛn pii no ɛka mmea wɔ nea wobu so, denam nyinsɛn a wɔmpɛ, ne akwanside a wonnya nni nyinsɛn ano so . Wɔkaa saa nnyinasosɛm ahorow yi ho asɛm wɔ CCL Adwumayɛ Nhyiam a ɛfa Mmea Hokwan sɛ Nnipa Hokwan ho no mu. Nhyiam no kyerɛɛ nipadua mu nokwaredi ase sɛ hokwan a mmea nyinaa fata: "nipadua mu mudi mu kura ka mmea bom na ɔbea biara nni hɔ a obetumi aka sɛ ɛfa wɔn ho".

Sɛnea nhyiam no mufo kyerɛkyerɛɛ mu no, nea edidi so yi yɛ nipadua mu nokwaredi hokwan ahorow a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔde ma mmea:

 Ahofadi a wɔde tu kwan (Freedom of movement)
 Nnipa ahobammɔ (Security of persons)
 Awo ne nna mu hokwan ahorow (Reproductive and sexual rights)
 Mmea akwahosan (Women's health)
 Mmea a wɔtew wɔn ho fi afoforo ho a wobubu
 Nhomasua (Education)
 Nkitahodi a Wɔde Di Dwuma (Networking)

Mmofra hokwan ahorow (Children's rights)

United States 
Akyinnyegye a ɛfa hokwan a mmofra wɔ wɔ nipadua mu mudi mu ho no anya nkɔanim wɔ nnansa yi mfe mu. Wɔ Jerry Sandusky asɛnni (Jerry Sandusky trial) a wɔbɔɔ ho dawuru kɛse no akyi no, wɔahyɛ awofo nkuran kɛse sɛ wɔnhyɛ wɔn ba no nipadua mu nokwaredi ho adwene ho nkuran sɛ ɔkwan a wɔbɛfa so atew mmofra a ɛyɛ mmerɛw sɛ wɔbɛyɛ wɔn a wɔyɛ nna mu basabasayɛ (sexual violence), nnipa a wɔtɔn wɔn (human trafficking) ne mmofra tuutuusi no so (child prostitution).

Akwan a wɔfa so ma mmofra adwene a ɛwɔ nipadua mu ahofadi ho no yɛ kɛse no bi ne:

 Mmofra a wɔbɛma wɔapaw bere a wɔbɛyɛ atuu/afew (Allowing children to choose when to give hugs/kisses)
 Mmofra a wɔbɛhyɛ wɔn nkuran ma wɔadi nkitaho afa ahye ho (Encouraging children to communicate about boundaries)
 Fa nneyɛe foforo ma (sɛ nhwɛso no , anum a ɛkorɔn, nsa a wobɛkyere, ne nea ɛkeka ho) - Offer alternative actions (e.g. a high five, handshake, etc.

Aduro (Medicine) 
Amanaman Ntam Apam a Ɛfa Ɔmanfo ne Amammui Hokwan Ho (International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights) no ka nea edidi so yi: “Wɔrenyɛ obiara ayayade anaa atirimɔdensɛm, nea enni nnipa mu anaa animtiaabu (inhuman or degrading treatment) anaa asotwe (punishment).” Titiriw no, wɔremfa obiara nkɔ aduruyɛ anaa nyansahu mu sɔhwɛ mu a onnyaa ne kwan so".

Hwɛ eyi nso 

 Akuw ahorow a wɔpɛ sɛ woyi nyinsɛn gu (Abortion-rights movements)
 Ahofadi a wɔde ma (Autonomy)
 Tumi ahorow kwan (Capabilities approach)
 Mmofra hokwan ahorow (Children's rights)

 Ahofadi a obi wɔ sɛ ɔpaw nea ɔpɛ (Freedom of choice)
 Hokwan ahorow a nnipa wɔ (Human rights)
 LGBT hokwan ahorow (LGBT rights)
 McFall ne Shimp ntam asɛm (McFall v. Shimp)
 Mera Jism Meri Marzi na ɔkyerɛwee (Mera Jism Meri Marzi)

title: Zuwera Ibrahimah
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu
Zuwera Mohammed Ibrahimah (wɔwoo no Kitawonsa bosome da ɛto so aduonu nson wɔ afe apem ahankron aduoson mu, 27 July 1970) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni. Ɔyɛ National Democratic Congress (NDC) muni. Ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma Salaga South Constituency wɔ Savannah mantam wɔ Ghana. Ɔno ne ɔbaa a ɔdi kan wɔ Salaga mantam no mu a wɔato aba ama no sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ ɔmanpanin a ɔto so nnan no mu.

Abrabɔ Ahyɛaseɛ Ne Ne Nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Ibrahimah wɔ Kitawonsa bosome da ɛtɔ so aduonu nson (27) afe apem ahankron aduoson mu (1970) maa owufoɔ Kuntundawura, Alhaji Mohammed Zublilah Ibrahimah a ɔfiri Kpembe, a na ɔyɛ sukuu panyin (former principal and rector) ma Tamale Technical University a kane no na yɛfrɛ no Tamale Polytechnic ne Adisah Nassamu Ibrahimah.

Ɔfiri Kpembe a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi fam (Northern Region). Ɔdii ne mmofraberɛm wɔ Winneba baabi a ɔfiri mfitiaseɛ nwomasua ase. Ɔyaa ne ntoasoɔ sukuu wɔ Tamale Senior High School na akyiri ɔkɔɔ Nigeria a saa berɛ no na ne papa som sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ wɔ Adu Bayero Suapɔn (Adu Bayero University) mu wɔ Kano a ɛwɔ Nigeria. Ɔwɔ Bachelor of Arts abɔdin krataa wɔ Management Studies mu wɔ Cape Coast Suapɔn mu firi afe apem ahankron aduokron nwɔtwe mu (1998) ne Post Graduate Diploma wɔ Community Development mu, wɔ Trent Suapɔn (Trent University) mu wɔ Canada. Ɔsane nso wɔ Master of Arts (MA) abɔdin krataa wɔ Nkitahodi Adesua (Communication Studies) mu firi nkitahodi adesua sukuu (school of communication studies), Ghana Suapɔn mu firi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nsia mu (2006). Ɔsane nso wie Adwumayɛ ho Ɔbenfo Panyin wɔ Adwumayɛ abodin krataa mu (Executive Master of Business Administration - EMBA) wɔ Ghana Suapɔn Adwumayɛ Sukuu (University of Ghana Business School) mu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nson mu (2007) mu.  

Onyaa ne master's abodin krataa wɔ Diplomacy ne International Trade Business (Diplomacy) mu wɔ Anglia Apuei Suapɔn (University of East Anglia) a ɛwɔ United Kingdom (UK) wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du mmienu (2012) mu. Mprempren ɔreyɛ n’asɛmti adwuma no de hwehwɛ PhD wɔ Nsɛm ho Amanneɛbɔ ne Nkitahodi (PhD in Media and Communication) mu wɔ Goldsmiths Kɔlege, London Suapɔn (University of London) a ɛwɔ United Kingdom

Adwumayɛ 
Ibrahimah ayɛ adwuma wɔ nnwuma ahodoɔ pii mu titiri wɔ mpɔtam nkɔsoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ (community development planning), adwumayɛ (administration) ne aman ntam nkitahodie mu (diplomacy). Ansa na ɔrekɔ amanyɔsɛm mu no, na ɔyɛ Amanneɛbɔ Dwumadibea no kwankyerɛfoɔ abadiakyiri (deputy director of the Information Services Department).

Ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ adwuma sohwɛfoɔ (project officer) wɔ Atifi Fam Mpɔtam mmiɛnsa (Upper East Region, Upper West Region ne Northern Region) wɔ Nkuro nketewa mu Nsuo a Wɔde Ma Ho Nhyehyɛeɛ adwuma (Small Town Water Supply Systems project) no mu na ɔsane nso yɛɛ adwuma sɛ adwuma sohwɛfoɔ (project officer) wɔ Katolekfoɔ Mmoa Dwumadibea a ɛfa Nkɔsoɔ a Ɛba wɔ Mfitiaseɛ sukuu mu nhyehyɛeɛ (Catholic Relief Services on the Quality Improvements in Primary school programme) no ho wɔ Atifi Fam Mantam nyinaa nso mu.

Ibrahimah yɛɛ adwuma sɛ ɔfotufoɔ (consultant) wɔ Nsuo a Wɔde Ma Ahoteɛ ne Ahoteɛ Ho Nhyehyɛeɛ a Wɔbom Hwɛ (Joint Monitoring Program for Water Supply Sanitation and Hygiene - JMP) a WHO/UNICEF yɛeɛ wɔ Ghana. Ɔsane nso yɛɛ adwuma sɛ ɔman sohwɛfoɔ (country Manager) wɔ Akontaabufoɔ a Wɔagye Din a Fekuo (Association of Chartered Certified Accountant - ACCA) ne ɔman Ananmusifoɔ (country Representative) wɔ Discovery Channel Wiase Nyinaa Nwomasua Fekubɔ (Discovery Channel Global Education Partnership).

Wɔ aman ntam nkitahodie (diplomacy) mu no ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ Soafoɔ-Fotufoɔ (Minister-Counsellor) ne Amanneɛbɔ ne Ɔmanfoɔ Nkitahodiɛ Titenani wɔ Ghana Aban Asoɛeɛ a ɛwɔ London.(Head of Information and Public Relations of the Ghana High Commission)

Amanyɔsɛm

Mmarahyɛbadwam mmɔdemmɔ 
Wɔ Ɔsanaa bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nkron (August 2019) mu no, osii akan wɔ Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛ Badwa (National Democratic Congress - NDC) abatoɔ mu (primaries) maa Salaga South Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa (Salaga South Constituency) na odii nkonim sɛ ɔkannifoɔ a ɔbɛgyina akuo no ananmu wɔ  Ɔpɛnimma bosome mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu (2020) Abatoɔ no mu.

Zuwera Ibrahimah nyaa mma ahanan aduoson mmienu (472) de dii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ no mu tiaa Ibrahim Dey Abubakari a na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani mfeɛ nwɔtwe maa amansin no, Ahmed Saaka Shaibu Dan ne Lukman Jawula a wonyaa mma no aha mmienu ne aduosia (260), ɔha ne du nsia (116) ne aba baako (1) sɛdeɛ ɛdidi soɔ no.

Ibrahimah dii nkonim wɔ afe 2020 mmarahyɛbadwam abatoɔ mu maa Salaga South Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa (Salaga South Constituency) de yɛɛ abakɔsɛm sɛ ɔbaa a ɔdi kan a ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma Savannah Mantam mu. Ɔdii nkonim berɛ a ɔnyaa mma mpem aduonu ne ahanum aduonu nnum (20,525) a egyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛ mu aduanan nkron akyiri pɔ nnum. (49.5%) tiaa mmarahyɛbadwani na ɔwɔ hɔ mprempren Salifu Adam Braimah a ɔfiri Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo (New Patriotic Party) a ɔno nso yɛɛ Savannah Mantam mu Ɔsoafoɔ (Savannah Regional Minister) mmɔho mmienu (2), ɔnyaa mma mpem du nkron ne aduowɔtwe nsia (19,086) a egyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛ mu aduanan nnum akyiri pɔ nkron (45.90%) no akyi.

Mmarahyɛbadwani 
Ibrahimah kaa ntam dii nsiɛ sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔgyina Salaga South Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa (Salaga South Constituency) ananmu wɔ Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so awotwe (8) wɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4) mu wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da ɛtɔ so nson (7) mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu baako (7th January 2021). Ɛde bɛsi Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da ɛtɔ so nson (7) mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu baako 2021 no, ɔyɛ mmaa aduanan  (40) no mu baako na ɔno nko ara na ɔfiri Savannah Mantam a wɔregyina wɔn mmarahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa ananmu wɔ Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so awotwe (8) no mu.

Ɔsom sɛ Amannɔne Nsɛm Boayikuo (Foreign Affairs Committee) ne Mmarahyɛbadwa no Boayikuo a Wɔpaeɛ Nnipa no muni (Appointments Committee of Parliament).

title: Yusif Sulemana
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Yusif Sulemana yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4) no muni a ogyina Bole ananmu wɔ Atifi Mantam mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so. Wɔwoo no wɔ Ghana.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Sulemana firi Bole. Ɔwɔ adansedi krataa wɔ Monitoring ne Evaluation mu wɔ GIMPA ne B.S.C ne E.M.B.A wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Yaw Osei Adutwum
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei wɔ Asante kasa mu

Dr. Yaw Osei Adutwum yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson (7th) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so nan (4) no muni a ɔgyina Bosomtwe Mmarahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa ananmu wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuo Foforo (New Patriotic Party) no tekiti so. Wɔhyɛ no nso wɔ ne nkyerɛkyerɛ nsrahwɛ a ɔmmɔ ho amanneɛ wɔ sukuu ahodoɔ mu ɛwom sɛ ɔnyɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛ adwuma a ɛyɛ nnam mu. Wɔ Ɔbɛnem bosome da ɛtɔ so nnum wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu baako (5th March 2021) mu no, Nana Akufo-Addo paa no sɛ Nwomasua soafoɔ (Minister of Education).

N'asetena Mfitiaseɛ  Ne Ne Nwomasua 
Adutwum firi Jachie a ɛwɔ Ashanti mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Dr. Yaw Osei Adutwum nyaa bachelor’s abodin krataa wɔ Asase Sikasɛm - Adwumayɛ ho nimdeɛ a wɔ adesua titiri wɔ Real Estate mu (bachelor's degree in Land Economy - Business Administration with a major in Real Estate) wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ nyansahu ne mfiridwuma so (Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology) ansa na ɔretu akɔ USA na ɔsane nso wɔ abɔdin krataa wɔ Nwomasua sɔhwɛ mu (master’s degree in Education Management) wɔ La Verne Suapɔn mu (University of La Verne) ne PhD wɔ Nwomasua Nhyehyɛe, Nhyehyɛe ne Adwumayɛ mu (PhD in Educational Policy, Planning and Administration) wɔ California Anafo Suapɔn mu (University of Southern California). Ɔsane nso yɛ Kumasi ntoaso sukuu a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam-Ghana sukuuni deda, baabi a na ɔnyaa ne Advanced level nwomasua adansedie krataa.

Adwumayɛ 
Ɔhyehyɛɛ Nsusuiɛ Foforo Charter Sukuu ahodoɔ (New Designs Charter Schools) nanso ansa na ɛno reba no, ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ Nkontaabuo ne Amanneɛbɔ Mfididwuma kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ (Mathematics and Information Technology teacher) wɔ Manual Arts ntoaso sukuu mu (Manual Arts High Schoo) bɛyɛ mfeɛ du (10) mu na wɔ saa berɛ no mu, ɔhyehyɛɛ Amanaman Ntam Adesua Sukuu (International Studies Academy) a ɛyɛɛ adesua kuo ketewa ma asuafoɔ (small learning community for students) sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobɛdi yie wɔ nwomasua ne asetena mu (academically and socially). Ɔsane nso yɛɛ Nkontaabu kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ panyin (lead Maths teach) wɔ Manual Arts Mpɔtam Adesua Dwumadi mu. (USC/ Manual Arts Neighborhood Academic Initiative (NAI). Ɔsane nso ka adwumakuo a Ɔman Nhwehwɛmu a ɛfa Adwumayɛ ne Mfididwuma ho hyehyɛeɛ (National Research for Career and Technical) sɛ wɔbɛhyehyɛ ɔman no nhwɛsoɔ a ɛfa adwumayɛ ne mfididwuma ho adesua ho wɔ Ntoasoɔ Sukuu ne Kɔlegyi gyinabea (national model for career and technical education in High School and College levels).

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani ma Bosomtwe Mmarahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa wɔ Ashanti mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia (2016) abatoɔ mu no, ɔnyaa mma mpem aduanan nsia, aha-mmienu ne aduasa nwɔtwe (46,238) wɔ abatoɔ mpem aduonum nnan, ɔha baako ne aduanan nnan (54,144) a wɔtoo no nyinaa mu a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛ mu aduowɔtwe nnum akyiri pɔ aduowɔtwe mmienu (85.82%) berɛ a nea ɔbɛn no paa saa berɛ no Ɔmantam Panyin (DCE) a ɔwɔ Bosomtwe Mansini mu Veronica Antwi-Adjei a ɔfiri Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛ Badwa (National Democratic Congress - NDC)  mu no nyaa mma mpem nson ne ɔha mmienu ne du nnum 7,215 a egyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛ mu du mmiɛnsa ne akyiri pɔ aduasa nkron (13.39%).

Boayikuo ahodoɔ 
Ɔka Adwuma ne Adan Boayikuo (Works and Housing Committee) no ho na ɔsane nso ka Ɔhia a wɔbɛte so ho nhyehyɛeɛ Boayikuo (Poverty Reduction Strategy Committee) no ho wɔ Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so nson (7th) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin ɛtɔ so anan (4th) no mu.

Wɔ  Ɔbɛnem bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nson (2017) mu no, Ɔmanpanyin Nana Akufo-Addo paa Adutwum sɛ ɔnyɛ Ɔsoafoɔ Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ nwomasua so (Deputy Minister for education). Mprempren ɔresom sɛ Ɔsoafoɔ Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Nwomasua so a ɔhwɛ Nwomasua a Wɔde Di Dwuma ansa na Wɔrekɔ Nkɔanim so (Deputy Minister for Education in charge of Pre-tertiary Education). Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nkron (2019) mu no, nhwehwɛmu akuo mmienu (2) too aba ma no sɛ Ɔsoafoɔ Abadiakyiri a ɔyɛ adwuma yie wɔ afe no mu: Apam a Ɛhwɛ Asetra mu Pɛyɛ Ho ne Ɔmanfo Akontaabu ne Nhwehwɛmu Dwumadibea (Alliance for Social Equity and Public Accountability (ASEPA) and FAKS Investigative Services).

N'asetena Mu 
Waware a ɔwɔ abɔfra. Ɔyɛ Kristoni na ɔsom wɔ Pentekoste Asɔre mu (Pentecost Church).

title: Kwame Twumasi Ampofo
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Kwame Twumasi Ampofo (wɔwoo no 3 June 1968) yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ na mprempren ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanin a ɛtɔ so nnan Mmarahyɛ Bagua a ɛtɔ so nson no muni na ɔyɛ Ghana Aman a ɛtɔ so nnan no Mmarahyɛ Bagua a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe a ɔgyina Sene Atɔeɛ Mansin ananmu wɔ Bono Apueeɛ Mantam mu wɔ National Democratic Congress (NDC) tekiti so.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Ampofo wɔ 6 Oforisuo 1968 wɔ Kwame Danso, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Bono Apueeɛ Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔkɔɔ Essex County College, NJ, USA, afe 2005 na ɔmaa BSC wɔ Adwumayɛ mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ampofo yɛ National Democratic Congress (NDC) amanyɔkuw no muni.

2012 Abatow mu 
Wɔdii kan paw no sɛ ɔmmra Mmarahyɛ Bagua no mu wɔ afe 2012 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu sɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni ma Sene Atɔeɛ Mantam a ɛwɔ Bono Apueeɛ Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Wɔ abatow no mu no, onyaa abatow 12,511 wɔ abatow 19,504 a ɛfata a wɔtow a egyina hɔ ma ɔha biara mu nkyem 64.14 no mu.

2016 Abatow mu 
Ɔsan sii akan wɔ afe 2016 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu na ɔnyaa abatoɔ 10,229 a ɛyɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 51.86 bere a NPP mmarahyɛ baguani kandifo Joseph Mackay Kumah nyaa abatow 8,747 a ɔyɛɛ abatow a wɔtow nyinaa mu ɔha biara mu nkyem 44.3, PPP mmarahyɛ baguani kandifo Dramani Manu nyaa abatow 565 a ɔyɛɛ abatow no nyinaa mu ɔha biara mu nkyem 2.9 na CPP mmarahyɛ baguani kandifo Daniyawu Mohammed nyaa abatow 184 a ɛyɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 0.9.

2020 Abatow mu 
Ɔsan sii akan wɔ afe 2020 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu na ɔnyaa abatoɔ 13,116 berɛ a NPP mmarahyɛ baguani Joseph Markay Kuma nyaa abatoɔ 13,100.

Boayikuw ahorow 
Ampofo yɛ Aban Awerɛhyem Boayikuw no muni; na ɔyɛ Adwumayɛ ne Adan Boayikuw no muni nso.

Adwuma 
Ampofo yɛɛ adwuma sɛ adwumayɛfoɔ panin wɔ Premier Pharmaceuticals firi afe 2006 kɔsi afe 2012. Ɔsan nso yɛɛ adwuma sɛ adwuma sohwɛfoɔ boafoɔ wɔ Ghana Oil Premier Pharmaceuticals firi afe 2003 kɔsi afe 2006. Ɔyɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ ma Ghana Education Service firi afe 1993 kɔsi afe 1995. Na ɔsan yɛ Nhomasua soafo Abadiakyiri. Ɔyɛ mprempren mmarahyɛ baguani ma Sene West Constituency (efi afe 2012 de besi nnɛ).

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baasa. Ɔyɛ Kristoni na ɔyɛ Seventh-Day Adventist Asɔre no muni.

Beaɛ a menyaa mmoa fii

title: William Owuraku Aidoo
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

William Owuraku Aidoo1] (wɔwoo no 30 Ɔpɛpɔn 1964) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni na ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so nson (7th) ne Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so awotwe (8th) Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4) no muni, a ogyina Afigya Kwabre Anafo Mmarahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa ananmu wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo (New Patriotic Party) no tekiti so.[2]

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo William Owuraku Aidoo wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da ɛtɔ so aduasa (30) afe 1964 mu. Ofiri Hemang-Kwabre wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Onyaa ne GCE adansedie krataa (GCE O Level) wɔ Tetrem Ntoaso Sukuu (Tetrem Secondary School) ne A Level adansedie krataa (A Level) wɔ St Augustine's Kɔlege.[3] Onyaa ne Bachelor of Arts abodin krataa wɔ Adwumayɛ mu wɔ Ghana Asoɛe a Ɛhwɛ Adwumayɛ ne Ɔmanfoɔ So (Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration - GIMPA) wɔ afe 2005 mu.[2][4]

Adwuma 
William Wuku Aidoo yɛ ahoɔden ho ɔfotufoɔ (energy consultant) ne okuafoɔ (farmer). Ansa na ɔrekɔ amanyɔsɛm mu no, na ɔyɛ Kucons Adwumakuw a Wɔahyehyɛ (Kucons Company Limited), adansi adwumakuw bi a ɛde ne ho hyɛ atare a wosisi ne ne siesie (a construction company involved in the construction and rehabilitation of dams) mu no kwankyerɛfo panyin (managing director). Na ɔyɛ Ɔhwɛfo Panyin (Senior Superintendent) wɔ Ghana Nhomasua Dwumadibea (Ghana Education Service - GES) wɔ afe 1991 ne afe 1994 ntam na ɔyɛ kwankyerɛfo panyin (Senior Manager) wɔ Ghana Aguadi Sikakorabea (Ghana Commercial Bank - GCB) firi afe 1995 kosi afe 2012. Bere a ɔreyɛ adwuma wɔ sikakorabea no, ɔyɛɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ mmɔho mmienu (2) wɔ Nhomasua Suapɔn (University of Education) mu a ɛwɔ Winneba fi afe 2009 kosi afe 2012. Sɛ okuafo (farmer) no, onyaa ɔman no mu okuafo a ɔsen biara abasobɔde wɔ cashew (national best farmer award for cashew production) a wɔyɛe wɔ Ghana wɔ afe 2011 mu.[2][4]

Amanyɔsɛm 
William Owuraku Aidoo hyɛɛ mmarahyɛ bagua mu wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da ɛtɔ so nson (7) afe 2013 sɛ Afigya Kwabre Anafo Mmarahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa no ananmusifoɔ wɔ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo (New Patriotic Party) no tekiti so. Ɔsan sii akan wɔ atenaeɛ no ho bio wɔ afe 2016 mmarahyɛbadwa abatoɔ no mu na ɔdii nkonim.[2] William, wɔ afe 2020 Amansan abatoɔ no mu na ɔdii nkonim de gyinaa ne manfoɔ ananmu wɔ Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so awotwe (8) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4) no mu. Mprempren ɔyɛ Ɔsoafoɔ abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Ahoɔden so (deputy Minister for Energy).[4][5][6][7]

Boayikuw ahorow 
William yɛ Amansan Mmara, Mmara ne Mmarahyɛ Badwa Nsɛm Boayikuo (member of Constitutional, Legal and Parliamentary Affairs Committee) no muni na ɔsan yɛ Mmarahyɛ Boayikuo Nkabom Kuo (member of Subsidiary Legislation Committee) no muni.[3]

N'asetra mu 
William Wuku Aidoo aware a ɔwɔ mma baanum (five children). Ɔyɛ Kristoni na ɔyɛ Katolek Asɔre (Catholic Church) no muni

title: Ghana Education Service
text:
Ghana Education Service (GES) yɛ aban adwumakuo a ɛhyɛ Ministry of Education ase a ɛhwɛ sɛ wɔde aban nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛbɛma Ghanafoɔ a wɔadi mfeɛ a wɔde kɔ sukuu a wɔn abusuakuo, wɔn bɔbeasu, dɛmdi, nyamesom ne amammuisɛm mu su mfa ho no bedi dwuma. Ghana Nhomasua Dwumadibea no, agyinatukuw a emufo yɛ dunum a wɔfrɛ no GES agyinatukuw na ɛhwɛ so.

Ɔman Agyede Bagua no na ɛde adwumakuw no sii hɔ wɔ afe 1974 mu. Ɛne ahyehyɛde ahorow yɛ adwuma bom na wɔakyekyɛ mu akuw ahorow de ahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔde n’ahyɛde no bedi dwuma yiye wɔ Ghanafoɔ man mu.

Beaɛ a menyaa mmoa fii

title: Vincent Oppong Asamoah
text:
Vincent Oppong Asamoah (wɔwoo no Ɔbɛnem 13, 1966) yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ ne Mmarahyɛ Bagua a Ɛto so Anan no muni. Ɔgyinaa Dormaa West Constituency ananmu wɔ Brong-Ahafo Mantam mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so. Ɔyɛ Kan Ɔmanpanyin Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Mmabun ne Agumadi so wɔ Ghana.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Asamoah yɛ Kristoni (Katolekni). Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baasa.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Asamoah yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛ Bagua (NDC) no muni. Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔsii akan wɔ Dormaa West atenaeɛ no ho wɔ NDC mmarahyɛ bagua a ɛtɔ so nsia a ɛwɔ republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no tekiti so na ɔdii nkonim.

Boayikuw Ahorow 
Asamoah yɛ Ranking Member wɔ Adwumayɛ ne Adan Boayikuo no mu na ɔsan yɛ Ohia a Wɔbɛtew Ho Nhyehyɛeɛ Boayikuo no muni.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Asamoah wɔ Ɔbɛnem 13, 1966. Ɔfiri Nsoatre a ɛwɔ Bono Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔsan nso wɔ MBA wɔ Ɔman Adwumayɛ mu wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so, ne BA wɔ Cape Coast Suapɔn mu.

Adwuma 
Na Asamoah yɛ asetena mu adwumayɛfoɔ ansa na ɔretu mmirika akɔdi amammuisɛm mu wɔ afe 2012. Ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ OLAM Ghana limited wɔ Asawinso wɔ Western Region. Wɔpaw no sɛ Municipal Chief Executive ma Dormaa Municipality firi 29 April 2009, kɔsii sɛ ɔkaa ntam sɛ MP wɔ Fourth Republic of Ghana Mmarahyɛ Bagua a ɛtɔ so nsia mu wɔ 7 January 2013.

Beaɛ a menyaa mmoa fii

title: Vincent Ekow Assafuah
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Vincent Ekow Assafuah (wɔwoo no 27 Ɛbɔ 1990) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni a ɔyɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo (New Patriotic Party - NPP) muni.[1] Na ɔyɛ Ɔmanfoɔ Nkitahodiɛ sohwɛfoɔ (Public Relations Officer - PRO) ma Nhomasua Dwumadibea (Ministry of Education).[2][3] Ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani ma Old-Tafo Mmarahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu.

Adwuma 
Assafuah sii akan na odii nkonim wɔ Ɔman Ɔsom Adwumayɛfo Fekuw (National Service Personnel Association - NASPA) sɛ Kuo Ɔman titrani bere a na ɔreyɛ ne Ɔman Som (National Service) wɔ ne mmɔdenbɔ a ankosi hwee wɔ USAG ɔmampanyin abatow mu akyi,[7] ɔsom wɔ saa dwumadi no mu afe biako. Ɔyɛ ɔboafoɔ titiriw ma Ɔbaa a ɔtɔ so mmienu (2) Samira Bawumia firi afe 2015 kɔsi afe 2017.[2] Wɔ afe 2017 mu no, na ɔyɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo (New Patriotic Party - NPP) no Nkitahodi sohwɛfo Abadiakyiri (Deputy Communication Director) a ɔreyɛ adwuma.[10] Bere a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo (New Patriotic Party - NPP) no baa tumidi mu wɔ bosome Ɔpɛpɔn afe 2017 akyi no, akyiri wɔpaw no sɛ ɔmanfo ntam abusuabɔ panyin wɔ Nhomasua Dwumadibea (Ministry of Education) wɔ afe 2018 mu.[11][4] Ɔsan nso yɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo a ɔde ne bere fa yɛ adwuma (part-time lecturer) wɔ Dominion Suapɔn Kɔlege (Dominion University College).[12]

N'asetra mu 
Ɔyɛ Kristoni

title: Mustapha Ussif
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Mustapha Ussif (wɔwoo no 16 Ɔsanaa 1979) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni. Ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party no muni na ɔyɛ Ghana Republic a ɛtɔ so anan (4) no mmarahyɛ badwa a ɛtɔ so awotwe (4) no muni a ogyina Yagaba-Kubori Mmmahyɛbadwa mpɛsoa ananmu wɔ Ghana Atifi Apueeɛ Mantam mu.[1] Wɔ 21 Ɔpɛpɔn afe 2021 mu no, Nana Akufo-Addo yii no sɛ ɔnsom sɛ Mmabun ne Agumadi ho Ɔsoafoɔ (Minister of Youth and Sports).[2][3]

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Ussif wɔ Ɔsanaa bosome da ɛtɔ so dunsia (16) afe 1979. Ofiri Tantaala a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Mantam mu. Ɔsuaa adeɛ wɔ Bagabaga Akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ Nteteeɛ Kɔlege (Bagabaga Teacher Training College) ne Anglia Ruskin Suapɔn mu (Anglia Ruskin University) baabi a onyaa ne Bachelor of Arts abodin krataa wɔ Amanaman Ntam Adwumayɛ mu (Bachelor of Arts degree in International Business and Management) wɔ afe 2010. Ɔtoaa so wɔ Gloucestershire Suapɔn mu (University of Gloucestershire) baabi a ɔwiee wɔ afe 2011 mu a onyaa abodin krataa wɔ Sikasɛm mu (master's degree in Finance and Investment).

Adwuma 
Ussif yɛɛ adwuma sɛ Sikasɛm mu Nhwehwɛmufo (Investment Analyst) wɔ Ray ne Nkitahodifo (Ray and Associates) a ɛwɔ United Kingdom - UK wɔ afe 2010. Saa afe no ara mu no, ɔde ne ho kɔbɔɔ Action Aid UK baabi a ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ Freelance Consultant.[4][5]

Amanyɔsɛm

Mmarahyɛbadwani 
Ussif hyɛɛ mmarahyɛbadwa eduma ase wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da ɛtɔ so nson (7) afe 2013 wɔ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo (New Patriotic Party) tekiti so bere a odii mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔwɔ hɔ mprempren Abdul-Rauf Tanko Ibrahim so nkonim no. Ogyinaa Yagaba-Kubori Mmmahyɛbadwa mpɛsoa ananmu firi afe 2013 kosi afe 2017 wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nsia (6) no mu nanso ɛno akyi no ɔdii nkoguo wɔ mmɔden a ɔbɔeɛ sɛ wɔbɛsan apaw no akɔ mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson (7) no mu wɔ ne kan sɔretiafoɔ Abdul-Rauf Tanko Ibrahim a ɔfiri Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛ Badwa (National Democratic Congress) mu wɔ afe 2016 Ghana Amansan abatoɔ no mu.4][5 Wɔ saa mmarahyɛ badwa a ɛtɔ so nsia (6) no mu no, ɔsom wɔ Fam agudie ne Ahoɔden Boayikuw (Mines and Energy Committee) ne Daa Ahyɛde Boayikuw (Standing Orders Committee) no mu.[4][5]

Ogyinaa NPP mmarahyɛbadwa mfitiaseɛ abatoɔ (NPP's parliamentary primaries) a wɔansɔre antia no na wɔpaee mu kae sɛ ɔno ne onipa a ɔbɛgyina akuo no ananmu wɔ afe 2020 Ɔpɛnimma abatoɔ no mu.[6][7] Odii mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔdi tumi seesei (incumbent member of parliament) Abdul-Rauf Tanko Ibrahim a ɔhyiaa no mprenu wɔ abatoɔ a atwam no mu. Ɔde amba 18,153 edi nkonim a egyina hɔ ma 64.01% berɛ a nea ɔne no reko no nyaa amba 9,393 a egyina hɔ ma 33.14%.[1][8]

NSS no Ɔkwankyerɛfo Panyin 
Wɔ afe 2017 mu no, ɔmampanyin, Nana Akufo-Addo paw no sɛ ɔnyɛ Ɔman Ɔsom Nhyehyɛe (National Service Scheme) no kwankyerɛfo panyin (executive director) wɔ n’aban bere a edi kan no mu.[9]

Mmabun ne Agumadi ho Ɔsoafo 
Bere a ɔsan dii nkonim wɔ Yagaba-Kubori Mmmahyɛbadwa mpɛsoa atenaeɛ no mu wɔ afe 2020 mu no, Ɔmampanyin Nana Akufo-Addo paw no wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da ɛtɔ so aduonu baako (21) afe 2021 sɛ ɔnsom sɛ Mmabun ne Agumadi ho Ɔsoafoɔ (Minister of Youth and Sports) wɔ n’ahennie a ɛtɔ so mmienu (2) mu (second term).[2][3] Bere a ɔfaa nhwehwɛmu mu wɔ Ghana Mmarahyɛ Badwa mu na ɔtwam akyi no wɔkaa ntam sɛ ɔbɛdi dwuma wɔ Ɔbɛnem bosome da ɛtɔ so anum (5) afe 2021 ne asomfoɔ foforɔ aduonu nson (27) a wɔayi wɔn wɔ Jubilee House, Accra.[10][11][12]

N'asetra mu 
Ussif aware wɔ mma baanu. Ɔyɛ Kramoni.

title: Ursula Owusu
text:
Nidifoɔ Ursula Owusu-Ekuful (wɔwoo no Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 20, afe 1964) firi Akim Oda a ɛwɔ Ghana Apueeɛ Mantam mu. Ɔyɛ mmaranimfoɔ, ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔhwɛ mmaa hokwan so na ɔyɛ Ghana mmarahyɛ baguani a ɔgyina Ablekuma West mantam ananmu. Mprempren ɔyɛ Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ Nkitahodi ne Digitals so.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Ursula fi Akim Oda a ɛwɔ Ghana Apuei Fam mantam mu. Ɔkɔɔ Labone Senior High School na ɔkɔɔ Mfantisman Girls Secondary School kɔyɛɛ adesua a ɛtɔ so nsia. Ɔtoaa so kɔɔ Ghana Suapɔn ne Ghana School Of Law, ɛhɔ na onyaa LLB. Wɔfrɛɛ no ​​kɔɔ asanombea hɔ wɔ afe 1990 mu. Ɔnyaa abodin krataa a ɛkorɔn wɔ Ntawntawdi, Asomdwoeɛ ne Ahobanbɔ mu wɔ Kofi Annan Amanaman Ntam Asomdwoeɛ Nteteeɛ Asoɛeɛ.

Adwuma a wɔyɛe ansa na amammuisɛm reba 
Ɔde mfe du yɛɛ adwuma sɛ mmaranimfo wɔ Akufo-Addo, Prempeh & Co. mmara adwumayɛbea ansa na ɔretu akɔ telefon so nkitahodi adwuma mu akɔdi telefon so nkitahodi, mfiridwuma adwumakuw bi anim.

Ursula, wɔ n’adwumayɛ mu no asom wɔ board ahorow ne dibea ahorow mu.

 Managing Consultant with N. U. Consult Mmara, Aban ne Bɔbeasu Ho Afotufo.
 Amanaman Ntam Mmea Mmaranimfo Kuw (FIDA), Ghana, 1999 no muni.
 Kan FIDA Ghana Titenani
 Kan Afrika Ɔmantam FIDA Amanaman Ntam no Titenani Abadiakyiri.
 Ghana Mmaranimfo Kuw no muni.
 Afrika Mmea Mmaranimfo Fekuw (AWLA) no muni.
 Western Telesystems (Westel) sohwɛfoɔ a ɔreyɛ adwuma (September 2005 kɔsi May 2008), ne
 Nnwumakuw ne Amannɔne Nsɛm Ho Ɔkwankyerɛfo, ZAIN Ghana (April 2008 kosi January 2009).

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, wɔpaw no sɛ ɔnyɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni ma amansin foforo Ablekuma West Mantam no sɛ wɔn mmarahyɛ baguani a odi kan.

Wɔ afe 2015 mu no, ɔsii akan na ɔdii nkonim wɔ NPP mmarahyɛ bagua primaries mu wɔ Ablekuma West Constituency. Ɔkuraa ne mmarahyɛ bagua atenaeɛ wɔ afe 2016 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu denam nkonimdie a ɔdii wɔ abatoɔ 34,376 wɔ abatoɔ 60,558 a ɛfata a wɔtoo no mu a ɛyɛɛ ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 56.96. Wɔtow hyɛɛ ɔne mmea Mmarahyɛ Bagua no mufo afoforo so bere a akasakasa sii wɔ mmeae a wɔde asie ama mmarahyɛ baguafo mmea ho no. Wɔbɔɔ amanneɛ sɛ ɔkaa sɛ ɔresusuw ne daakye ho wɔ amammuisɛm mu, nanso afe a edi hɔ no ɔbɛyɛɛ Nkitahodi Soafo.

Wɔ afe 2017 mu no, Ɔmampanyin Akufo-Addo paw no sɛ Ɔsomfoɔ sɛ ɔnhwɛ Nkitahodi Dwumadibea no anim. Mprempren ɔyɛ Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ Nkitahodi ne Digitals so.

Wɔ December 2020 mu no, ɔsii akan sɛ wɔbɛsan apaw no sɛ mmarahyɛ baguani wɔ afe 2020 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu sɛ mmarahyɛ bagua kandifoɔ ma NPP. Bere a ɔkɔɔ abatow no mu sɛ Ablekuma West Constituency Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni a ɔwɔ hɔ mprempren no, ɔkɔɔ so kuraa n’akongua so bere a ɔtoo abatow 37,363 wɔ abatow 69,353 mu akyi. Ne akansifoɔ a ɔbɛn no paa Rev. Kweku Addo a ɔfiri National Democratic Congress (NDC) no dii deɛ ɛtɔ so mmienu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 30,733, berɛ a akansifoɔ afoforɔ a wɔsii akan firii akuo foforɔ, GUM, LPG ne PNC mu no nyaa abatoɔ 359, 330 ne 65 sɛnea ɛte biara.

Boayikuw ahorow 
Mprempren ɔresom wɔ Mmarahyɛ Bagua boayikuw ahorow a edidi so yi mu:

Amanyɔ Mmara, Mmara ne Mmarahyɛ Bagua Nsɛm Boayikuw (Mmarahyɛ Bagua a ɛto so 7)

Apaw Boayikuw (Mmarahyɛ Bagua a ɛto so 7).

ASETENAM-AMAMMƆNE 
Wɔ afe 2015 mu no, wɔtoo ɔne mmaa MPfoɔ foforɔ so ntua wɔn ankasa so wɔ berɛ a akasakasa bi sii wɔ mmeaeɛ a wɔde asie ama mmaa mmarahyɛ baguafoɔ no ho. Wɔbɔɔ amanneɛ sɛ ɔkae sɛ ɔresusuw ne daakye ho wɔ amammuisɛm mu, nanso afe a edi hɔ no ɔbɛyɛɛ Nkitahodi Soafo. Ansa na ɔreba mprempren dibea sɛ Nkitahodi Soafo no, na ɔsom wɔ bagua ahorow mu ne dibea ahorow mu wɔ n’adwumayɛ mu.

Wɔ Ayɛwohomumɔ 2018 mu no, Ghanafoɔ no fã bi kasa tiaa no berɛ a ɔyɛɛ nsɛmti wɔ asɛm bi a ɔde too social media so a ɛkyerɛ sɛ Ghana Muslimfoɔ nni abodwokyɛreɛ. Kwasida, Ɔpɛpɔn da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nkron, afe 2018, Amanneɛbɔ akannifoɔ ne nnipa a wɔwɔ Akem Asuom wɔ Ghana Apueeɛ Mantam mu na wɔde no sii hɔ sɛ Nkosuohemaa (Nkɔsoɔ Hemmaa). Wɔyɛɛ no ​​fã bi wɔ Asuomhene Osabarima Ofosuhene Apenteng II Ahemfie.

Wɔ afe 2021 mu, berɛ a wɔde Ghana mmara a ɛtia LGBT ho nyansahyɛ maeɛ no, ɔkasa tiaa mmara no afã bi sɛ ɛyɛ nkannyan a wɔde hyɛ ɔbrɛ ne nokwaredi a ɛnni ho nkuran enti ɛho bɛhia sɛ wɔsan hwɛ mmara no mu. Ɔsan nso wɔ May 2021 mu no, ɔtuu LGBT ankorankoro a wɔwɔ Ghana fo sɛ wɔmfa wɔn dwumadiɛ nkɔ kokoam ɛfiri sɛ Ghanafoɔ ntumi nnye mmarima ne mmaa ntam abusuabɔ ntom.

Ankorɛankorɛ 
Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ abofra baako ma Ghana aniwa ho oduruyɛfo bi a ɔwɔ UK, Dr Sam Ekuful. Ɔda ne ho adi sɛ ɔyɛ Kristoni.

Nidi a wɔde ma 
Kwasida, 29 September 2018 no, atetesɛm akannifoɔ ne Akyem Asuomfoɔ a wɔwɔ Kwaebibirem Mantam mu wɔ Ghana Apueeɛ Mantam mu no de no sii hɔ sɛ Nkosuohemaa (Nkɔsoɔ Hemmaa). Wɔyɛɛ guasodeyɛ no wɔ Asuomhene Osabarima Ofosuhene Apenteng II Ahemfie.

Wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2019 mu no, Amanaman Ntam Mmea Mmaranimfoɔ Kuo (FIDA) hyɛɛ no ​​anuonyam de kyerɛɛ adwuma a ɔyɛeɛ wɔ mmaa ne mmofra hokwan ahodoɔ ho banbɔ mu wɔ 2019 FIDA Africa Regional Congress a wɔyɛɛ no ​​Abuja, Nigeria.

Beaɛ a menyaa mmoa fii

title: Ahmed Ibrahim (Ghanaian politician)
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Ahmed Ibrahim yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson (7) a ɛwɔ Ghana Aman a ɛtɔ so anan no muni a ogyina Banda Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Bono Mantam mu wɔ Ɔman Demokrasi Nhyiam Kuw (National Democratic Congress) tekiti so. Mprempren ɔyɛ Minority Chief Whip Abadiakyiri wɔ Ghana Mmarahyɛ Badwa no mu.

Ne mmofraase abrabɔ ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Ibrahim wɔ Kotonimma bosome da a ɛtɔ so nsia (6) afe 1974, wɔ Banda Ahenkro wɔ Bono Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ibrahim suaa adeɛ wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu baabi a onyaa abodin krataa wɔ Amanyɔsɛm ne Nyansapɛ mu (bachelor's degree in Political Science and Philosophy) wɔ afe 2001 mu.

Adwuma 
Na ɔyɛ Flamingo Publications (Ghana) Limited adwumayɛfoɔ panin (Chief Executive Officer - CEO.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ibrahim hyɛɛ n’amanyɔsɛm adwuma ase wɔ afe 2009 mu bere a wɔkae sɛ ɔno na odii nkonim wɔ afe 2008 Ghana Amansan Abatow mu maa ne mansin no. Afei wɔpaw no sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so anum (5th) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4th) muni wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da a ɛtɔ so nson (7) afe 2009. Bere a Ibrahim wiee n’ahennie afe a ɛdi kan no, ɔsii gyinaeɛ sɛ ɔbɛpere ahennie foforɔ wɔ afe 2013 mu na ɔdii Joe Danquah so nkonim sɛ ɔbɛkora n’akongua so. Wɔ afe 2015 mu no ɔsii akan na odii nkonim wɔ NDC mmarahyɛ badwa primaries mu maa Banda Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Bono Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ saa mmarahyɛ badwa atenaeɛ yi mu wɔ afe 2016 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu denam abatoɔ 6,167 a onyaeɛ a ɛgyina hɔ ma 52.03% tiaa nea ɔne no reko no abatoɔ 5,660 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 47.76%.

Boayikuw ahorow 
Ibrahim yɛ Budget Boayikuo Titiriw no muni; Nkitahodi Boayikuw (Communications Committee) no muni; ɔyɛ Mpɔtam Aban ne Nkuraase Nkɔso Boayikuw (Local Government and Rural Development Committee) no muni; na ɔyɛ Adwumayɛ/Edwadie Boayikuw (Business Committee) no muni.

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Ibrahim yɛ Kristoni. Waware na ɔwɔ abofra baako (1).

Ntotoho

title: Thomas Nyarko Ampem
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa muThomas Nyarko Ampem yɛ Ghana amanyɔfoɔ ne Mmarahyɛ Bagua a ɛtɔ so nson a ɛwɔ Ghana Aman a ɛtɔ so nnan no muni a ɔgyina Asuogyaman Mansin ananmu wɔ Apueeɛ Mantam mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Ampem fi Anum, Ɔkɔɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so na ɔwɔ MSC wɔ Sikasɛm mu wɔ Virginia Commonwealth Suapɔn, U.S.A.

Beaɛ a menyaa mmoa fii

title: Theresa Lardi Awuni
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa muTheresa Lardi Awuni (wɔwoo no 2 Ɔbɛnem 1979) yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɛfo a ɔyɛ Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛ (NDC) Bagua no muni. Ɔyɛ mmarahyɛ baguani ma Okaikwei North Constituency a ɛwɔ Greater Accra mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Ɔfiri Winkongo a ɛwɔ Upper East Region. Ɔnyaa Bachelor of Science abodin krataa wɔ Project Management mu wɔ Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration wɔ afe 2018 mu.

Adwuma 
Ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ National Disaster Management Organization of Ghana sɛ atoyerɛnkyɛm ho ɔpanyin titiriw ne Langdi Enterprise (sɛ owura).

Amanyɔsɛm 
Awuni yɛ obi a na anka ɔyɛ Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration TEIN Mmea Komisafo. TEIN (Tertiary Education Institutions Network) yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛ (NDC) Bagua no fã a ɛwɔ soro. 

Ɔsan nso yɛ Ɔmansin Mmea Nhyehyɛefo mprɛnsa wɔ Okaikwei Atifi Fam Mantam mu.

Wɔ Oforisuo 2019 mu no, ɔsii akan maa National Democratic Congress primaries maa Okaikwei North Constituency na ɔdii nkonim sɛ ɔkannifoɔ a ɔde party no bɛkyerɛ wɔ December 2020 Abatoɔ no mu. Awuni dii nkonim wɔ abatow 342 mu wɔ abatow 866 a wɔtow no nyinaa mu bere a ne akansifo afoforo Richard Kwarshie Kudjordjie, Abdul Nasiru Abass ne Malik Adama nyaa abatow 220, abatow 179 ne abatow 12.

Wɔpaw no sɛ mmarahyɛ bagua muni maa Okaikwei Atifi Fam Ɔmansin wɔ December 2020. Ɔne mmarahyɛ baguani a ɔwɔ hɔ mprempren Fuseini Issah a ofi New Patriotic Party no sii akan na odii nkonim bere a ɔtoo abatow 29,281 a egyina hɔ ma ɔha biara mu nkyem 51.07 tiaa ne abatow 27,242 a egyina hɔ ma ɔha biara mu nkyem 47.52 akyi. Ɔyɛ mmaa 40 a wɔgyina wɔn amansin ananmu wɔ Mmarahyɛ Bagua a ɛtɔ so 8 firi 7 Ɔbɛnem 2021 no mu baako.

Ɔyɛ Subsidiary Legislation Committee ne Aguadi, Nnwuma ne Nsrahwɛ Boayikuw a ɛwɔ Ghana Mmarahyɛ Bagua no mu no muni.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Awuni yɛ Kristoni a ɔwɔ ahofama.

Beaɛ menyaa mmoa fii

title: Akwasi Boateng
text:
Akwasi Darko Boateng yɛ mmarahyɛbaguani a ɔhwɛ Bosome Freho Mansini mu, Asante Mantam mu, Ghana. Ɔyɛ mmarahyɛ baguani firi 7 Ɔbenem 2021.

Mfitiase asetena ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Boateng Yawda, 20 Ayɛwohomummɔ 1967 na ɔfiri Apewu-Dwumako a ɛwɔ Asante Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔnyaa ne Executive Masters wɔ Aban ne akannifoɔ mu ne ne Post Graduate Diploma wɔ Adwumayɛ mu wɔ afe 2018. Ɔsan nso nyaa ne Ordinary ne Advance levels wɔ afe 1990 ne 1993.

Adwuma 
Boateng yɛ Ghana amanyɛni. Ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbaguani wɔ Bosome Freho Mantam mu firi Ɔpɛpɔn 2021. Ansana ɔrehyɛn mmarahyɛbagua mu no, ɔne Auto-Life Company Limited ne Pescourt Hotel yɛɛ adwuma.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Boateng fii adi nkonimdifoɔ berɛ a ɔde New Patriotic Party (NPP) tekiti so sii akan wɔ nnipa mmienu a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔdi kan no so wɔ mmarahyɛbagua no mfitiaseɛ abatoɔ a wɔhyehyɛɛ sɛ wɔbɛnya obi a ɔbɛdi NPP ananmu wɔ 2020 Openima abatoɔ no mu. Wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔpaw wɔn no baanu a ɔne wɔn sii akan ne Hon Joyce Adwoa Akoh Dei ne Owura Peter Adjei Agyemang. Wɔ nhyiamfo 415 a wɔtoo aba no mu no, Boateng dii nkonim wɔ abatow a edi kan no mu denam abatow 191 so tiaa nea odi kan, Agyemang a ɔtoo abatow 140 bere a saa bere no na MP a na ɔwɔ tumi no, Dei dii nea ɛto so abiɛsa de abatow 76, wɔpow abatow.

Wɔ 7 Ɔpɛnimma, 2020 mmarahyɛbagua abatoɔ mu no, Boateng nyaa abatoɔ 20,401 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 73.10% wɔ abatoɔ 27,910 a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu. Wogyinaa nea efii mmarahyɛ bagua abatow no mu bae so kae sɛ ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbagua no muni a wɔapaw no ama Bosome Freho Mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu, Ghana.

Boayikuw 
Boateng yɛ Mmabun, Agumadi ne Amammerɛ Boayikuw no muni na ɔsan yɛ Atemmu Boayikuw no muni.

Ayɛ myɛ nnwuma 
Wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2021 mu no, ɔde nsa hohoro mfiri 2,400, mfiri a wɔde yiyi ti nhwi 50 maa wɔn a wɔpam ti 130, sukuu ntadeɛ 1,500, hwene akatasoɔ 2,400, sterilize cabinets 30, mpaboa nnaka 5 ne machetes nnaka 5 maa famers wɔ Bosome Freho Constituency wɔ Ashanti Mantam. Ɔsan nso de nkyerɛkyerɛ sikakorabea no sii hɔ sɛ ɔde aba sika a ɛyɛ GHS30,000 bɛhwɛ asuafo a wohia nanso wɔn ho akokwaw na ɔsan nso hyɛɛ bɔ sɛ ɔbɛboa GHS20,000 afe biara.

Beaeɛ menyaa mmoa firii

title: Akwasi Konadu
text:
Akwasi Konadu yɛ Ghana amanyɔni na ɔsan yɛ New Patriotic Party (NPP) ni. Ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbaguani ma Manhyia Atifi abatoɔ Mpasuaso wɔ Asante Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Mpreprei,  ɔyɛ Director wɔ Ghana Water Company Limited.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo no wɔ Konadu wɔ 25 Kitawonsa 1982 na ɔfiri Paakoso a ɛwɔ Asante Mantam. Na ɔhyɛ ne mfinimfini sukuu adesua wɔ Opoku Ware Secondary School. Nyaa ne Diploma wɔ Adesua ɛfiri University of Education - Winneba. Ɔsan nso nyaa Bachelors degree wɔ Sociology ne Philosophy ɛfiri 2005 wɔ University of Ghana. Ɔsan nso nyaa Masters degree wɔ Development Policy ne Planning ɛfiri KNUST.

Adwuma 
Konadu bɛ Assistant Auditor ma KDA Accounting Services wɔ Kumasi. Ɔsan nso kɔyɛ Project supervising officer ma Bonsafo Barwuah Foundation. Na ɔyɛ Operations manager ma Greenfield Company Limited.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ɔkɔɔ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua bere a ɔkɔɔ primaries 2020 wɔ New Patriotic Party tekiti so wɔ Manhyia Atifi Abatoɔ Mpasuaso wɔ. Ɔtuu nea na ɔwɔ mmrahyɛbagua a yɛfrɛ no Collins Owusu Amankwah, a na wotena mmrahyɛbagua ɛfrɛ Opepon 2013. Ɔdii nkonim wo saa abatoɔ akansie afe 2020. Ɔyaa nmma no 278 ɛbere ne opponent no yaa 275, ɔde nmma no 5 na ɛtwaa no. Ansa na ɔbɛ di nkonim no, na wade kan akɔ primaries 2012 ne 2016 a na wadi nkuguo ɛwɛ Collins Owusu Amankwah nsa ano. 

Konadu dii nkonim wɔ 2020 mmrahyɛbagua abatoɔ ɔwɔ Manhyia Atifi Abatoɔ Mpasuaso wɔ Openima 2020. Ɔyaa nmma no 39,562 a na agyina ho ma 69.9% atia National Democratic Congress nipa ɔde,  Hamza Swallah ɔyaa nmma no15,943 a agyina ho ma 28.2%.

Boayikuw ahorow 
Ɔyɛ kwan a yɛ bɛfaso ayi kɔm muni a ɔwɔ dibea, ɔsan yɛ apomoden mu nipa wɔ mmrahyɛbɛtwamu.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Konadu yɛ Kristoni

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Alexander Kwamina Afenyo-Markin
text:
Alexander Kwamina Afenyo-Markin (wɔwoo no 27 Kɔtonima 1978) yɛ Ghana Mmarahyɛbagua no muni ma Effutu mantam, mfinimfini mantam. Ɔsan nso yɛ adwuma sɛ boayikuo a ɛhwɛ Bammɔ ne Mfinimfini Boayikuo so wɔ Ghana Mmarahyɛbagua no muni. Mprempren ɔyɛ ɛdɔm dodowoɔ panin Abadiakyiri wɔ Ghana Mmarahyɛbagua no mu.

Mfitiase Asetena Ne Nhomasua 
Ɔsuaa mmara wɔ University of Buckingham, (LLB/mgt, 2003–2006), Ghana School of Law a ɔnyaa Barrister at Law adansedie (2007-2009), na ɔnyaa M.A wɔ amanaman ntam amammuisɛm ne ahobanbɔ adesua mu wɔ Suapɔn no mu a ɛwɔ Bradford

Adwuma 
Wɔ afe 1999 ne 2003 ntam no, Effutu mmarahyɛbaguani no yɛɛ adwuma sɛ Principal Postal Officer wɔ Ghana Post Company Limited. Afei nso, ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ Excel Courier Ghana Limited sɛ Ɔkwankyerɛfoɔ wɔ afe 2004 ne 2011 ntam na ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ Dehenya Chambers firi afe 2010 kɔsi afe 2016.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, wɔ NPP tekiti so no, Afenyo-Markin sii akan wɔ NDC mmarahyɛbagua no muni, Mike Allen Hammah na odii nkonim.

Ɔbɛyɛɛ Ghana Water Company Ltd (GWCL) guamtrani wɔ afe 2017 mu. Wɔkyerɛe sɛ ɔde ne ho hyɛɛ GWCL a ɛkame ayɛ sɛ ɛhwee ase ne sikasɛm mu nsɛm afoforo a ɛmfata mu, ɛno nti ɔde asɛm a ɛfa ahohorabɔ ho too gua wɔ asɛnnibea hɔ. Wayɛ Bammɔ Boayikuo ne Mfinimfini Sikasɛm Boayikuo a ɛwɔ Ghana Mmarahyɛ Bagua mu

Wɔ afe 2021 mu no, Afenyo-Markin ne Abdul-Aziz Ayaba Musah, Johnson Kwaku Adu, Laadi Ayii Ayamba ne Emmanuel Kwasi Bedzrah kaa ntam wɔ ECOWAS Mmarahyɛbagua no Nhyiamu soronko 2021 a ɛsii wɔ Freetown wɔ Sierra Leone no mu.

title: Sam Nartey George
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa muNimuonyamfo Samuel Nartey George (wɔwoo no Ɔbɛnem 22, 1985) yɛ Ghana amanyɔfoɔ. Ɔfiri Ahwiam, Ningo Dedaw. Ɔyɛ Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni. Wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2015 mu no, ɔdii E. T. Mensah a ɔdi tumi seesei no so nkonim sɛ ɔgyinaa akuo no ananmu wɔ afe 2016 mmarahyɛ bagua abatoɔ a ɛfa Ningo-Prampram Mansin mu. Mprempren ɔyɛ Fourth Republic of Ghana Mmarahyɛ Bagua a Ɛto so Ason no muni a ogyina Ningo-Prampram mantam ananmu.

https://bit.ly/3pyJ4pY

https://bit.ly/42ZEtM0

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Sam Nartey George wɔ 22 Ɔbɛnem 1985 wɔ Somanya wɔ Ghana Apuei Fam. Ɔnyaa BSc. wɔ Kuadwuma mu Mfiridwuma (Asaase & Nsuo ho nimdeɛ) wɔ KNUST ne L.L.B wɔ London Sukuupɔn mu. Ɔwɔ Adwumayɛfo Awuranom (Dissertation) (Ntawntawdi, Asomdwoe, ne Ahobammɔ) a efi Kofi Anann Amanaman Ntam Asomdwoe ne Ntetee Asoɛe(KAIPTC). Wɔ December 2022 mu no, owiee MSc wɔ Amanaman Ntam Nkitahodi ne Diplomasi mu wɔ London Sukuu a ɛhwɛ Sikasɛm ne Amanyɔsɛm so.

Adwuma 
Sam Nartey George yɛ ɔkwankyerɛfoɔ boafoɔ wɔ Ɔman Adwumayɛfoɔ Panyin Dwumadibea firi afe 2010 kɔsi afe 2014 ne nkitahodiɛ ho ɔbenfoɔ wɔ Ɔmanpanin adwumayɛbea firi afe 2014 kɔsi afe 2016.

Amanyɔsɛm

Abatow 
Sam George wɔ 21 Ɔbɛnem 2015 tuu Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni a ɔwɔ hɔ mprempren no gui ma Ningo-Prampram Hon. Enoch Teye Mensah (MP firi 1996-2015) wɔ NDC primaries mu sɛ ɔbɛnya hokwan agyina party no ananmu wɔ 2016 mmarahyɛ bagua abatoɔ no mu. Odii nkonim de abatow 4,910 a egyina hɔ ma abatow nyinaa mu ɔha biara mu nkyem 53.4 bere a E. T. Mensah nyaa abatow 2,831 a egyina hɔ ma ɔha biara mu nkyem 38.5.

Wɔ afe 2020 abatoɔ no mu no, wɔbɔɔ George sɛ ɔdi nkonim wɔ Ningo-Prampram Constituency mmarahyɛ bagua Abatoɔ no mu denam abatoɔ 23, 860 a ɔnyaeɛ a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 63 de dii nea ɔbɛn no paa, Owura Sylvester Tetteh a ɔfiri NPP, a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 13, 588 so nkonim.

Wɔkoraa Sam George so wɔ Kwasida, 13 May 2023 sɛ National Democratic Congress mmarahyɛ bagua ananmusifoɔ maa Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni a ɔhwɛ Ningo-Prampram Mantam so denam Michael Kwettey Nettey a ɔboroo no wɔ NDC 2023 mfitiaseɛ abatoɔ mu maa hokwan sɛ ɔgyina asɔre no ananmu wɔ afe 2024 mmarahyɛ bagua abatoɔ mu.

Mmarahyɛ Bagua no boayikuw ahorow 
Mprempren Sam George yɛ Ɔmanfo Akontaabu Boayikuw ne Nkitahodi Boayikuw no nyinaa muni.

Adwene a Wɔde Di Dwuma 
Sam George kura adwene a ɛko tia LGBTI na waka mmarima a wɔne wɔn ho da ho asɛm sɛ "akyidi". Wɔ afe 2021 mu no, ɔne Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni afoforo boom de mmara bi a ɛbɛma mmarima a wɔne wɔn ho da ayɛ nsɛmmɔnedi ne LGBTI mmoa ne dwumadi ahorow pii, aduruyɛ mmoa mpo ho nyansahyɛ mae. Nnipa hokwan ahorow ho adwumayɛfo akasa atia nhyehyɛe no kɛse wɔ ne "atirimɔdensɛm" ho.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Sam George yɛ Kristoni.

Beaɛ a menyaa mmoa fii

title: Alexander Gyan
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu
Alexander Gyan yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɔni ɔsan yɛ  mmrahyɛbagua no muni  ɛma Kintampo Anaafoɔ abatoɔ Mpasuaso wɔ Bono Apueeɛ Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo no wɔ Alexander wɔ 26 Ɔbɛnem 1980 a ɔfre Ampomah-Kintampo Anaafoɔ ɔwɔ Bono Apueeɛ Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔyaa ne SSCE wɔ 1999. Ɔsan tua so yaa BSc wɔ Nfumdwoma mu adesua wɔ 2012.

Adwuma 
Alexander bɛyɛ Mansine Krakyi Mpanyin wɔ Mansini ɔhwɛ Nkrokro ne Nkrokro nketwa so wɔ Kintampo Anaafoɔ Mansini mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Alexander yɛ NPP ni ɛna ɔsan yɛ mmarahyɛbaguani ɛma Kintampo Anaafoɔ abatoɔ Mpasuaso

Boayikuw ahorow 
Alexander yɛ kuoni ma Aban Gyidie ɔsan so yɛ Nkitaho kuo wɔ Mmarahyɛbagua mu.

Adɔyɛ 
Ɛwɔ Obubuo 2021, Alexander kɔ kyɛ adua ne lorri sika maa sukuu mmofra bɛyɛ 1357 a na wɔn rekyerw BECE wɔ Kintampo Anaafoɔ Mansini mu.

Manso 
Ɛwɔ Ahinime 2020 bere a na ɔyɛ Mansin Krakyi Mpanyin wɔ Kintampo Anaafoɔ Mansin, ɔkɔ bɔ ne papa abaso sɛ akuafo ɛwɔ ne mansin no mu nyinaa ɔno na ɔyɛ adeɛ.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Alexander R. Hottordze
text:
Alexander Roosevelt. Hottordze yɛ Ghana amanyoɔni na ɔyɛ Ghana Aman a ɛtɔ so nnan Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson no muni a ɔgyina mfinimfini Tongu Mansin ananmu wɔ Firaw Mantam mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Mfitiase Asetena Ne Nnwomasua 
Hottordze fi Mafi- Kumase. Ɔnya M.B.A wɔ Cape Coast Suapɔn mu ne M.A wɔ Sukuupɔn a ɛhwɛ Asetena mu Adesua so.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Andrew Asiamah Amoako
text:
Andrew Asiamah Amoako (24 Ɔgyefo 1966) yɛ Ghana mmaranimfoɔ, amammuifoɔ ne Ghana Aman a ɛtɔ so nnan Mmarahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so awotwe no muni, wɔpaw no sɛ ɔnyɛ adwuma wɔ Ɔpɛnima 2020 mu sɛ obi a ɔde ne ho. Mprempren ogyina Fomena Mantam no ananmu wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu. Ɔsan nso yɛ Mmarahyɛbagua no Kasafo Abadiakyiri a ɔto so abien.

Mfitiase Asetena Ne Nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Amoako wɔ 24 Ɔgyefo, 1966 wɔ Wioso-Adansi wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu. Ɔwɔ MSc wɔ Environmental Resources Management, Master of Arts wɔ Conflict Resolution ne LLB (Law) wɔ Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology ne adwumayɛfoɔ mmara tumi krataa (BL) wɔ Ghana School of Law.

Adwuma 
Ansa na ɔrekɔ amammuisɛm mu no, na ɔyɛ mmaranimfo wɔ Minka Premo and Co. (Akosombo Chambers). Na ɔyɛ Agyapadeɛ sohwɛfoɔ, Asase sohwɛfoɔ ne Botaeɛ sohwɛfoɔ wɔ Kumasi Metro Nhyiamu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Bere a osii gyinae sɛ ɔrensi akan wɔ akuw no primaries ansa na afe 2020 amansan abatow no aba esiane sɛnea n’ankasa kuw no yɛɛ no ​​wɔ ɔkwan a ɛnteɛ so nti, osii gyinae sɛ obetu mmirika sɛ obi a ɔde ne ho. Na ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party (NPP) no muni, a ɛde n’amanyɔ mmara no Ahyɛdeɛ 3(9) too mu, na ɛtwaa ne muniyɛ mu na wɔbɔɔ Mmarahyɛbagua no Kasafoɔ amanneɛ, a ɔbɔɔ amanneɛ sɛdeɛ ɛfata sɛ n’akongua no da mpan wɔ 13 Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 2020 wɔ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛwɔ Ahyɛdeɛ 97 (1)g a ɛwɔ Amanyɔ Mmara no mu. Amoako kasa tiae sɛ, sɛ wɔpam no fi asɔre no mu a, ɛnkyerɛ sɛ ɔnyɛ mmarahyɛbaguani bio, na Ghana Mmarahyɛbagua no nkutoo na ebetumi atwa ne dibea sɛ ɔmanpanyin a wɔapaw no no mu. Mmaranimfo Kwaku Asare ne Amoako yɛɛ adwene, na ɔkae sɛ gyinaesi a ɛte saa no yɛ mmara mu asɛm a ɛhyɛ Asɛnnibea Kunini no tumi ase, sɛnea wɔakyerɛ wɔ Ahyɛde 99(1) a ɛwɔ Ɔman Mmara no mu no.

Amoako dii nkonim wɔ Fomena mmarahyɛ bagua no mu wɔ Ɔpɛnima 2020 abatoɔ no mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 12,805, na ɔdii nea ɔne no reko titire, ne kan kuo no muni Philip Ofori-Asante, a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 10,798 no so nkonim. Amoako bɛyɛɛ obiakofoɔ a ɔde ne ho a ɔdii nkonim wɔ afe 2020 mmarahyɛbagua abatoɔ no mu. Ne gyinabea sɛ mmarahyɛbaguani a ɔde ne ho no bɛyɛɛ nea ɛho hia kɛse mpo wɔ abatow no akyi esiane sɛ amammui akuw atitiriw abien no mu biara (NPP ne National Democratic Congress) antumi annye dodow no ara koraa nti. Wɔ nsɛmbisa a wɔbisabisaa Amoako wɔ abatoɔ no akyi mu no, ɔkyerɛɛ sɛ onni nkateɛ bɔne biara wɔ NPP ho wɔ n’apam no muni a wɔagyae no ho. NPP Ɔkyerɛwfo Panyin, John Boadu, ahyɛ nyansa sɛ Amoako betumi asan abisa ne NPP muni a ɔmfa ne ho nhyɛ akuw no mmara ne tebea pɔtee bi so. Wɔ 7 Ɔbɛnem 2021 no, wɔpaw Asiamah sɛ Mmarahyɛbagua no Kasafo Abadiakyiri a ɔto so abien. Ɔno nko ara ne mmarahyɛbaguani a ɔde ne ho a wɔapaw no sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ saa dibea no wɔ Ghana abakɔsɛm mu.

Boayikuw 
Amoako yɛ Members Holding Offices of Profit Committee no guamtenani, Standing Orders Committee no muni, Subsidiary Legislation Committee no muni, Nhomasua Boayikuw no muni ne Mines and Energy Committee no muni.

N'ABRABɔ 
Amoako yɛ ɔkristoni.

title: Alhassan Suhuyini
text:
Alhassan Sayibu Suhuyini (wɔwoo no 12 Ɛbɔ 1979) yɛ Ghana broadcast nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo ne ɔmanyɛfo. Ɔyɛ Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛbadwani no muni. Mprempren ɔyɛ Fourth Republic of Ghana Mmarahyɛbadwani a Ɛto so Ason a egyina Tamale North ananmu no muni.

Nwomasua 
Alhassan Suhuyini kɔɔ Ghana Ntoaso Sukuu a seesei ɛyɛ Ghana Senior High School (Tamale), GHANASCO wɔ Tamale. Ɔwɔ B.Sc. Ɔman Adwumayɛ ne M.Sc. Nkɔsoɔ sohwɛ a ɛfiri Ghana Asoɛeɛ a ɛhwɛ adwumayɛ ne ɔman adwumayɛ so.

Adwuma 
N’adwuma sɛ radio so ɔkasafoɔ no hyɛɛ aseɛ wɔ Diamond FM a ɛwɔ Tamale ansa na ɔretu akɔ Ghana ahenkuro mu. Ɔyɛɛ adwuma bere tiaa bi wɔ Citi FM ne Metro TV wɔ Nkran ansa na ɔne Radio Gold retra. Radio atiefoɔ a wɔwɔ Ghana na wɔpaw no sɛ Talk Show Host of the year wɔ afe 2011, 2012 ne 2013 mu wɔ Ghana Radio ne Television Personality Awards mu. Wɔ afe 2013 mu no, South Korea aban paw no na ɛboaa no sɛ ɔnkɔkyinkyin South Korea sɛ ne Next Generational Leaders from Africa nhyehyɛe no fã. Na ɔyɛ ɔnanmusifoɔ wɔ afe 2014 Amanaman Ntam Nsrahwɛfoɔ Akannifoɔ Dwumadie, United States Ɔman Dwumadibea a ɛhwɛ adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔsesa wɔn ho wɔn ho nhyehyɛeɛ mu. Ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ Radio Gold a ɛwɔ Nkran, faako a na ɔyɛ dwumadibea no dwumadi atitiriw abien ho ɔkwankyerɛfo no; anɔpa dwumadi a wɔfrɛ no "Gold Power Drive" ne dapɛn awiei asetra-sikasɛm ne amammuisɛm mu nsɛm a ɛrekɔ so mprempren - Alhaji ne Alhaji nkɔmmɔbɔ dwumadi.

Amanyɔsɛm Mu Adwuma 
Ɔmampanyin John Dramani Mahama na ɔpaw no wɔ afe 2013 mu sɛ Ghana Civil Aviation Authority (GCAA) board member. Ɛde besi afe 2014 no na ɔyɛ Nkitahodi sohwɛfo ma Ɔman Hajj Bagua (Ghana). Odii nkonim wɔ Tamale North nkongua no so denam National Democratic Congress tekiti so wɔ afe 2016 Amansan abatoɔ mu sɛ ɔbɛyɛɛ mmarahyɛbadwa no muni. Odii nkonim wɔ atenaeɛ no mu denam abatoɔ 21,280 a ɔnyaeɛ a ɛgyina hɔ ma dodoɔ no nyinaa mu 67.79% so.

title: Andy Kwame Appiah-Kubi
text:
Andy Kwame Appiah-Kubi yɛ Ghana amanyɔni na ɔsan yɛ New Patriotic Party (NPP) ni. Ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbaguani ma Asante-Akim Atifi abatoɔ Mpasuaso wɔ Asante Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

Nhomasua 
Ɔyaa ne BA (Hons), MBA ne LLB firi University of Ghana, Legon. Ɔsan wɔ suapɔn krataa firi Ghana School of Law.

Adwuma 
Ɛwɔ afi 1988, Andy na naa ɔyɛ Chief Executive Officer ma Ideal Veterinary Supply kɔ pem 1994. Ɔsaa yaa adwuma foforo sɛ Country Director ma AFEX International Group kɔ pem 2001, ɔsan gyae kɔyɛɛ Deputy Executive Secretary ma Free Zones Board, a ɔyɛɛ kɔpem 2009. Ɔsan bɛyɛɛ Chief Executive Office ma Appiah-Kubi and Associates.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Andy gyina wɔ New Patriotic Party din mu na ɔdii nkonim wɔ 2016 mmarahyɛbagua abatoɔ Asante-Akyem Atifi abatoɔ Mpasuaso wɔ Asante Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Wɔ yii no sɛ Deputy Minister ma Railways Development a Ɔmanpanyin, Nana Addo Dankwah Akufo-Addo. 

Ɔmo san to aba maa no wɔ 2020 abatoɔ maa no gyina mu maa ne manfoɔ. Ɔyaa mba no 25,009 a ɛgyina ho ma 63.91% ɛbrɛ a NDC ni a ɔgyina hɔ maa wɔn mo, Alhaji Adams Sulley Yussif yaa 14,123 mba a ɛgyina ho ma 36.1%.

Boayikuw ahorow 
Ɔyɛ kuoba ma Members Holding Offices of Profit Committee na ɔsan yɛ kuoba ma Foreign Affairs Committee wɔ Mmarahyɛbagua mu.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Andy yɛ Kristoni

Manso 
Ɛwɔ Ɛbɔ 2020, asɛnnibea kyii Andy kɔmtempt sɛ ɔno ankasa ayi neho sɛ ɔhim frankaa ama NPP. Ɔsisi billboard ne lorry ahodow sɛ ɔno na ɔgyina NPP din mu ɛbere ɔmo bɛto Mmarahyɛbagua aba no

title: Samuel Okudzeto Ablakwa
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa muSamuel Okudzeto Ablakwa (wɔwoo no Ɔbɛnem 11, 1980) yɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni ma North Tongu wɔ Volta mantam mu. Ɔyɛɛ ɔman soafo abadiakyiri wɔ John Atta Mills ne John Dramani Mahama nyinaa ase.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Samuel Okudzeto Ablakwa wɔ 11 Ɔbɛnem 1980 na ɔfiri Aveyime-Battor wɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔyɛ osuani dedaw wɔ Presbyterian Boys’ Senior Secondary School - Legon ( Presec-Legon) nso yɛɛ Vice President wɔ kyerɛwsɛm nkabom no mu.

Ɔkɔɔ Ghana Suapɔn, na onyaa Bachelor of Arts wɔ Political Science and Philosophy mu wɔ afe 2002 ne 2006 ntam. Wɔ Leicester Suapɔn mu no, onyaa ne Master of Arts wɔ Communication Media ne Public Relations mu. Project Management Practitioner - (PRINCE 2).

Ablakwa nso wɔ Akannifoɔ ho adansedie krataa a ɛfiri Harvard Kennedy School of Governance, USA ne Master of Science wɔ Defence ne International Politics mu firi Ghana Armed Forces Command and Staff College.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ɔyɛɛ National Union of Ghana Students (NUGS) Titenani firi afe 2005 kɔsi afe 2006 berɛ a na ɔyɛ osuani wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu. Na ɔsan nso yɛ kuw a wɔkyerɛw n’apam no mmabun nhyehyɛe wɔ NDC manifesto a ɛfa afe 2008 ɔsatu no ho no muni. Ná ɔyɛ Committee for Joint Action (CJA) kuw bi a wɔboa nnipadɔm nhyɛso kuw no muni. Ɔyɛ Accredited Member (APR)wɔ Asoɛe a ɛhwɛ ɔmanfo ntam abusuabɔ so (IPR) Ghana.

Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni 
Ablakwa hyɛɛ amammuisɛm mu wɔ ne mmofraase a na wadi mfe 28 bere a ɔde National Democratic Congress tekiti sii akan maa mmarahyɛ bagua abatow no maa North Tongu agua no wɔ afe 2008. Ɔde abatow a wɔtow no ɔha biara mu nkyem 78.6 dii nkonim wɔ atenae no mu. Ɔsan dii nkonim wɔ atenaeɛ no mu wɔ afe 2012 abatoɔ no mu wɔ dodoɔ kɛseɛ mu, na ɔgyina hɔ ma abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ no ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 90.5. Ɔkuraa n’akongua no mu bio wɔ afe 2016 abatoɔ no mu ɛwom sɛ n’apam no dii nkogu wɔ Ɔmampanyin Abatoɔ mu. Wɔayɛ boayikuw a wɔpaw nnipa no muni mprenu dabi,w wɔ afe 2017 ne 2020 mu. Mprempren ɔsan nso yɛ therRankingmMember of Parliament's Foreign Affairs Committee.

Ɔman Ɔsoafo Abadiakyiri 
Wɔ ne ntua mu wɔ ɔman amammuisɛm mu no, na ɔyɛ John Evans Atta Mills Ɔsatu Nkitahodi Kuw a na wɔrehwehwɛ saa bere no muni na kosii sɛ wɔpaw no sɛ Ɔmanpanyin Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Amanneɛbɔ so bere a na wadi mfe 28 wɔ owufo John Atta Mills titrani ase no, ɔsom wɔ Aban Nsakrae Kuw sɛ Ɔkyerɛwfo a Ɔyɛ adwuma. Ablakwa yɛɛ Ɔmanpanyin abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Nhomasua so a ɔhwɛ Nhomasua so wɔ saa bere no mu Ɔbenfo Jane Naana Opoku Agyemang ase wɔ John Dramani Mahama Aban ase.

Nidi a wɔde ma

Abasobɔde ahorow 
Owura Okudzeto Ablakwa anya abasobɔdeɛ bebree a nea ɛka ho ne TNG Corporate Excellence Awards - Accra, 2010, Mmabun Kannifoɔ a ɔda nsow wɔ West Africa a West Africa Students’ Union (WASU) - Kaduna, Nigeria 2009, Special Alumnus Award a National Union of Ghana de maeɛ  wɔ afe 2009, Old Vandal Abasobɔdeɛ - 2008, Abasobɔdeɛ a wɔde gye tom a Volta Hall JCR a ɛwɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu de maeɛ – 2005 ne Ɔmanpanyin titiriw a ɔwɔ Private University Students Association of Ghana (PUSAG) no mu. Mepe Amammerɛ Bagua ne Tepa Amammerɛ Bagua a wɔfrɛ no "Mmrantiehene" nso ahyɛ no anuonyam.

Adwumafa 
Ɔmanpanyin Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Amanneɛbɔ so, 2009-2013 (Ghana Aban).

Nhomasua soafo abadiakyiri, 2013-2016 (Ghana Aban).

Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni, 2009 - de besi nnɛ (Mmarahyɛ Bagua Dwumadibea).

Saavi Solutions, managing director (2007- 2009).

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ɔwaree Nuhela Seidu, Mumuni Abudu Seidu a ɔyɛ mmaranimfo babaa na wɔwɔ ɔbabea ne ɔbabarima.

Adɔeyɛ 
Wɔ August 2022 mu no, ɔmaa Samelia Mekporsigbe a wadi mfeɛ 8 a ɔyɛ adesuakuw a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa wɔ Battor DA Mfitiaseɛ Sukuu mu no sika a wɔde bɛboa no nyinaa. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ afe 2022 Volta Regional Competition a USAID Learning Initiative hyehyɛeɛ no mu. Ɔdaa ne ho adi sɛ osuani a ɔsen biara wɔ ɔmansin, ɔmantam ne ɔmantam mu.

title: Freda Akosua Prempeh
text:
Freda Akosua Oheneafrewo Prempeh (yɛ woo no 23 Opepon, 1966) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni na ɔsan yɛ New Patriotic Party (NPP) ni. Ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbaguani ma Tanɔ Atifi abatoɔ Mpasuaso wɔ Ahafo Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Mpreprei, ɔyɛ Ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Adansi. Ɔdi kan yɛ Ɔsoafoɔ abediakyere ma Gender, Children and Social Protection. ɔsan yɛɛ "Assembly Woman" efiri 2002 kɔsi 2010 ma Lakoo Electoral Area wɔ La-Dadekotopo Abatoɔ mpesoaso wɔ Nkran Mantam mu. 

Ɛwɔ 2017, yɛyii no sɛ ɔtitireni ma 11 kuobaatan a ɔmo bɛhwɛ sɛ Ghana bɛyɛ 2018 African Women Cup of Nations.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Yɛ woo no 23 Opepon, 1966 wɔ Nkran wɔ adehyie abusua. Na ɔyɛ akora ɔtɔ mmiesa wo ne nua no mu. Na wofoɔ yɛ Ohenenana Akwasi Agyeman Dua-Prempeh a na ɔfi Asante Adehyɛ Abusua ne maame, Nana Amma Serwaa, Kontihemaa a ɔfiri Duayaw Nkwanta (dodow no frɛ no Georgina Ansah).

Freda hyɛ mfiri aseɛ sukuu wɔ University Primary School, Kumasi na ɔtua so kɔ yaa Ordinary(O) level wɔ Technology Secondary School (sesia yɛfrɛ no KNUST Senior High School) wɔ Kumasi, Ghana, ɔsan tua so yaa ne Advanced level Certificate (A level) wɔ Accra Workers College, Accra, Ghana. Ɔsan tua so kɔ  Ghana Institute of Journalism, ɛhɔ na ɔyaa Diploma wɔ Public Relations ne Advertising. Ɔsan yaa  Certified Public Accountant ɛfiri Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration wɔ 1998. Wo san kura Certificate ne Advanced Certificate wɔ Marketing, DipM, MCIM, Chartered Marketer Professional Postgraduate Diploma in Marketing, ɛfiri Chartered Institute of Marketing wɔ United Kingdom. Ɔyaa (Business Administration), Human Resource Management Option Ɛfiri University of Ghana wɔ 2006. Ɔsan sua ade yaa MA Comms, Media ne Public Relations ɛfiri University of Leicester wɔ UK ɛna ne PhD wɔ Business Administration ɛfiri Ghana Technology University College.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Freda Akosua Prempeh ɛfiri Duayaw Nkwanta, ɛyɛ kuropɔn ma Tano North Mmarahyɛbagua a ɛwɔ Ahafo Region, Ghana. Ɔyɛ Kristoni w'awre a ɔwɔ abaamoa baako.

Ɛka kakra neka Freda firi atiasefoɔ asaase yi so, ɛbere nsuo brane bi to ɛwɔ 3 Ayewohomommo 2015 nsuo ne agya tɔ wɔ circle wɔ Accra.

Ansa na Freda ɛkɔ gyina sɛ mmarahyɛbaguani wɔ 2013, na ɔyɛ Manageress wɔ Point Four Hotel a wɔ Sunyani ɔsan ne Ghana Prision Service nfie bɛyɛ 10. Ɔsan pɛ agrode nna ɔsan gye mma di.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Freda ɛka New Patriotic Party (N.P.P.) ni. Ɔhyɛɛ amnyɔsɛm wɔ 2002 sɛ Assembly member wɔ Lakoo Electoral Area ɛwɔ La-Dadekotopo Constituency wɔ Nkran Mantam, bɛyɛ nfie 8. Ɔwɔ Ɔgyefoɔ, 2006, na ɔka kuobaatan National Reconciliation Commission sɛ Public Affairs Officer bɛyɛ bosome 9. 

Mpreprei ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbaguani ma Tanɔ Atifi abatoɔ Mpasuaso wɔ Ahafo Mantam mu wɔ Ghana ɔka kuo a ɔmo hyɛ Mines ne Energy, Government Assurance Committee wɔ Mmarahyɛbagua mu. Ɔmanpanyin hyi no sɛ Ɔsoafoɔ abediakyere ma Gender, Children and Social Protection.

Ɔgyina wɔ 2020 sɛ mmarahyɛbaguani wɔ Tanɔ Atifi abatoɔ Mpasuaso wɔ Ahafo Mantam mu wɔ Ghana ɛwɔ New Patriotic Party anan mu na ɔdi nkonim a ɔyaa 51%. Saa nkonim yi maa no yɛ mpre 3 a ɔkɔ mmarahyɛbagua sɛ mmarahyɛbaguani.

title: Stephen Jalulah
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Stephen Pambiin Jalulah yɛ Ghana amanyɔni na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma Pru West mmarahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Bono Apueeɛ mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Mprempren, ɔyɛ Ɔmanpanyin Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ akwan ne akwan akɛse (Deputy Minister for Roads and Highways) so bere a Nana Akufo-Addo kaa ne ntam akyi.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo no Ahinime bosome da ɛtɔ so aduonu mmienu (22), afe 1974 na ɔfiri Saboba a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi fam mantam mu. Onyaa ne GCE Ordinary Level wɔ General Science mu wɔ afe 1992 mu na onyaa ne GCE adansedie krataa (GCE Ordinary Level) wɔ Dwadie mu wɔ afe 1994. Ɔsan nso nyaa ne GCE adansedie krataa (GCE Advance Level) wɔ Dwadie mu wɔ afe 1996. Ɔsan nyaa ne abodin krataa wɔ Sikasɛm ne Sikakorabea (Degree in Finance and Banking) wɔ afe 2003 mu na ɔsan nso nyaa ne abodin krataa wɔ mmara mu (bachelor’s degree in law) wɔ afe 2014. Ɔsan nso nyaa ne abodin krataa wɔ aguadi mu (master’s degree in marketing) wɔ E-Commerce wɔ afe 2011 mu.[1]

Adwuma 
Na ɔyɛ Ɔmantam Panyin (District Chief Executive) wɔ Mpɔtam Aban Dwumadibea (Ministry of Local Government) ma Pru West mmarahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa no ne Pru Mansin no nso. Na ɔsan yɛ Ɔmantam Akwahosan Nsiakyibaa Dwumadibea (National Health Insurance Authority) no Ɔmantam sohwɛfo (District Manager).[1]

Amanyɔsɛm mu adwuma 
Stephen yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo (New Patriotic Party) muni na mprempren ɔyɛ Pru West mmarahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa no Mmarahyɛbadwani.[4] Odii nkonim wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa no mu a onyaa amba 16,606 a onyaa abatoɔ no nyinaa mu 56.7% berɛ a Masawud Mohammed a ɔdi tumi seesei no nyaa amba 12,671 a onyaa abatoɔ no nyinaa mu 43.3%.[5] Mprempren, ɔyɛ Ɔsoafoɔ Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ akwan ne akwan akɛse so (Deputy Minister for Roads and Highways).[6][7][8][9]

Boayikuw ahorow 
Stephen yɛ Asɔremma a Wɔkura Mfaso Boayikuw no Dwumadibea ahorow (Members Holding Offices of Profit Committee) no muni na ɔsan yɛ Adwumayɛ ne Adan Boayikuw no muni (member of the Works and Housing Committee).[1]

N'asetra mu 
Stephen yɛ Kristoni

title: Collins Adomako-Mensah
text:
Collins Adomako-Mensah yɛ Ghana amanyɔfoɔ na ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party no muni. Ɔgyina Afigya Kwabre North Constituency ananmu wɔ 4th Republic mmarahyɛ bagua a ɛtɔ so 8 wɔ Ghana.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Adomako Mensah wɔ 2 Ɔbɛnem 1983 na ɔfiri Boaman Maase wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu. Ɔkɔɔ Presbyterian Boy’s Senior Secondary School, Legon maa ne ntoaso sukuu adesua. Wɔmaa no Bachelor of Arts abodin krataa wɔ sikakorabea ne sikasɛm mu ne Executive Master of Business Administration wɔ afe 2007 ne 2016 mu.

Adwuma ne amammuisɛm 
Adomako-Mensah ne sikasɛm asoɛeɛ te sɛ GCB, Fidelity sikakorabea ayɛ adwuma sɛ ɔpanin abadiakyiri ne abusuabɔ sohwɛfoɔ. Na ɔyɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni. Wɔ afe 2020 NPP mmarahyɛ bagua primaries mu no Adomako-Mensah sii akan wɔ Afigya Kwabre North nkongua no ho ne saa bere no MP, Nana Marfo Amaniampong na odii nkonim. Wɔ afe 2020 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu no, Adomako- Mensah dii nkonim wɔ atenaeɛ no mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 20,441 a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 65.75 sene ne sɔretiafoɔ Emmanuel Jackson Agumah a ɔfiri NDC a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 10646 a ɛgyina hɔ ma abatoɔ 34.25.

Wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2021 mu no, Adomako-Mensah de akontabuo sets ne nkrataa foforɔ maa wɔn a wɔrehwehwɛ akɔ sukuu wɔ Afigya Kwabre North Constituency wɔ Ashanti mantam mu.

Boayikuw ahorow 
Adomako-Mensah yɛ sikasɛm boayikuo no muni na ɔsan nso yɛ akwahosan boayikuo no muni.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Adomako-Mensah yɛ Kristoni.  Ɔyɛ Albert Kan-Dapaah wɔfase.

Akyinnyegye 
Wɔ afe 2020 mu no, wɔkyerɛe sɛ ɔde ne ho ahyɛ GHS264,094 korɔnbɔ mu.

Ɔde sika bi a ɛyɛ Gen X Trading Company Limited dea kɔmaa n’adwumakuw a wɔfrɛ no AND Financial Services bere a na ɔyɛ adwumakuw no afɛfo adwumayɛfo panyin no. Ɔyɛɛ no ​​afe 2016 ne 2017 ntam a wannya wɔn kwan ne nimdeɛ a ɛfa ho.

title: Dominic Akuritinga Ayine
text:
Dominic Akuritinga Ayine (wɔwoo no 6 Ɔpɛpɔn 1966) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so nson (7) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4th) no muni a ogyina Bolgatanga Apueeɛ Mmarahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa ananmu a ɛwɔ Upper Apueeɛ Mantam wɔ Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛ Badwa (National Democratic Congress) tekiti so.[3]

Mfitiase asetra 
Wɔwoo Ayine wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da ɛtɔ so nsia (6) afe 1966 wɔ Zuarungu, Upper Apueeɛ mantam wɔ Ghana.[1]

Onyaa Bachelor of Arts abodin krataa wɔ mmara mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn, Legon (University Of Ghana) a ɛwɔ Ghana ne GSL wɔ afe 1995.Onyaa ne LLM wɔ Amanaman Ntam Sikasɛm Mmara (International Economic Law) mu wɔ Michigan Suapɔn Mmara Sukuu (University of Michigan Law School) wɔ afe 1998. Afei ɔkɔɔ Stanford Suapɔn Mmara Sukuu (Stanford University Law School) wɔ California a ɛwɔ U.S. A maa JSD (Aguadi ne Demokrasi - Trade and Democracy) wɔ afe 2006 mu.[1]

title: Augustine Collins Ntim
text:
Augustine Collins Ntim (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn 24, 1964) yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɛfo ne nhomasua ho nimdefo. Ɔyɛ Fourth Republic of Ghana Mmarahyɛ Bagua a ɛtɔ so nson no muni a ɔgyina Offinso North Constituency ananmu wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Augustine wɔ 24 September 1964 wɔ kuro bi a wɔfrɛ no Nkenkaasu mu wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu. Ɔwɔ Bachelor of Science abodin krataa ne Master of Science abodin krataa wɔ Reproductive Biology mu wɔ Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology. Ɔsan nso wɔ adesua ho adansedi nkrataa abien a efi Harvard Kennedy Sukuu mu.

Amammui mu adwuma 
Wɔpaw no sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ mmarahyɛ bagua wɔ afe 2009 mu a ɔde abatow bɛboro 3000 dii nkonim. Wɔsan paw no wɔ 7 Ɔbɛnem 2013 wɔ afe 2012 Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ no akyi na wɔsan paw no sɛ ɔbɛkɔ mmarahyɛ bagua mu wɔ 7 Ɔbɛnem 2017 wɔ afe 2016 Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ no awieeɛ a ɔnyaa abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu aduonum 53.15. Wɔsan paw no wɔ afe 2020 Amansan abatoɔ no mu baabi a ɔnyaa abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 48.67.

Adwumafa 
Ɔyɛ Ɔmantam Adwumayɛfoɔ Panyin wɔ Mpɔtam Aban Dwumadibea no firi afe 2005 kɔsi afe 2009. Ntim akɔ Ghana mmarahyɛ bagua mu firi afe 2009 de bɛsi nnɛ. Ɔyɛ Aban Awerɛhyem Boayikuw a ɛhwɛ bɔhyɛ ne awerɛhyem a asomfo de ma nyinaa mmamu no muni. Ɔsan yɛ Akwahosan Boayikuw no muni.

Boayikuw ahorow 
Ɔyɛ Mmabun, Agumadi ne Amammerɛ Boayikuw no muni na ɔsan yɛ Members Holding Offices of Profit Committee no muni.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ɔyɛ Kristoni na waware na ɔwɔ mma baanum.

title: Augustine Tawiah
text:
Augustine Tawiah (wɔwoo no Dwoda, Ɔpɛpɔn 27, 1961) yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ ne Mmarahyɛ Bagua a ɛtɔ so nson a ɛwɔ Ghana Aman a ɛtɔ so nnan no muni a ɔgyina Bia West Mansin ananmu wɔ Western North Region wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Mfitiase asetra 
Augustine Tawiah fi Sefwi Asuopiri a ɛwɔ Atɔe Fam Mantam mu.

Nwomasua 
Augustine Tawiah hyɛɛ ne mfitiaseɛ sukuu ase wɔ Bia Mantam a ɛwɔ mprempren Western North Region, Ghana. Afei otwaa ne sɔhwɛ a ɔtaa yɛ a ɔde kɔ sukuu no mu sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a obetumi akɔ Ntoaso Sukuu. Ntoaso sukuu a Augustine Tawiah kɔɔ ne St. Thomas Aquinas Senior High School (SHS Ordinary Level) ne akyiri yi wɔ Labone Senior High School (SHS Advanced Level). Augustine Tawiah nyaa Doctor of Ministry (Applied Theology) wɔ afe 2006 mu, Doctor of Education Certificate (Leadership and Policy Studies) wɔ afe 2009 mu, Master of Theology, Nyansahu mu Master of Science firii Memphis Suapɔn mu ne afei nso Certificate wɔ University Teaching mu. Augustine Tawiah nso wɔ Ɔsom ho Ɔbenfoɔ wɔ Harding Suapɔn mu, Master of Arts wɔ Lipscomb Suapɔn mu, ne Cert-Hr Nteteeɛ a ɛfiri Oklahoma Suapɔn mu.

Adwuma ne Dibea Ahorow 
Augustine Tawiah yɛ adwuma wɔ Ghana Mmarahyɛ Bagua mu sɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni (MP). Ɔyɛ Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ ne Ɔfotufoɔ wɔ Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration (GIMPA). Ɔdii dwuma sɛ Ɔkyerɛwfoɔ Panyin wɔ Ɔman Nkyerɛkyerɛ Badwa a ɛwɔ Ghana ne Adesua Panyin nso wɔ Ghana Christian University College.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Augustine Tawiah yɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni (MP) ma Bia West Constituency wɔ Western North Region.

title: Bede Ziedeng
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Bede Anwataazumo Ziedeng (wɔwoo no Fida, 22 Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 1954) a nnipa pii frɛ no Bede Ziedeng yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ. Wɔ afe 2008 mu no, Bede Ziedeng de Democratic Freedom Party tekiti sii akan wɔ Lawra-Nandom Mmarahyɛ Bagua no mu. Ɔdii nkogu wɔ Hon. Ambrose Dery of the New Patriotic Party. Ziedeng yɛɛ Democratic Freedom Party (DFP) no Ɔkyerɛwfo Panyin wɔ afe 2006 mu.

Mfitiase asetra 
Bede Ziedeng fi Eremon-Lawra a ɛwɔ Upper West Region no mu. Na ɔwɔ ne Ordinary ne Advance level adansedie krataa wɔ afe 1978. Bede Ziedeng nyaa LLB Hons wɔ afe 1984 mu ne Barrister at Law wɔ afe 1986 mu.

Adwuma 
Bede Ziedeng yɛ sikakorabea kyerɛwfo a ɔhwɛ adan ne adansi so. Ná ɔyɛ ɔmantam guamtrani wɔ Office of Revenue Commissioners (Northern & Upper East). Ɔsom sɛ Ɔmantam Ɔsoafo Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Atifi ne Atifi Atɔe Mantam so. Ɔka Mmarahyɛ Bagua Boayikuw no ho sɛ Oguamtrani Abadiakyiri wɔ mmarahyɛ bagua no mu. Bede Ziedeng nso som wɔ Akwan ne Transport Boayikuw mu wɔ mmarahyɛ bagua no mu.

Wɔ afe 2008 mu no, Ziedeng de Democratic Freedom Party tekiti sii akan wɔ Lawra-Nandom Mmarahyɛ Bagua no mu, nanso ɔdii nkogu wɔ Hon. Ambrose Dery a ɔwɔ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no mu. Afei ɔsii akan wɔ afe 2016 mmarahyɛ bagua abatoɔ mu, na ɔsan dii nkogu bio. Bede Ziedeng sii akan wɔ afe 2020 mu na odii nkonim. Ɔyɛ mmarahyɛ baguani (MP) ma Lawra Mantam a ɛwɔ Upper West Region.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Bede Ziedeng yɛ Kristoni.

title: Sanja Nanja
text:
Sanja Nanja yɛ Ghanani a wɔwoo no Ogyefuo bosome no da a ɛtɔ so mmiensa, wɔ afe apem ahankron aduosia nnwɔtwe mu (born February 3, 1968). Ɔyɛ amannyɔni a ɔka Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a wɔtɔ so nwɔtwe no ho wɔ Ghana kwasafoman a ɛtɔ so nan no mu,  ɔno na ɔyɛ ananmusini de ma Atebubu Amantin abatoɔ mpesua no so a wɔwɔ Bono East mantam no mu. Amannyɔkuo a ɔdɔm a ɛnam wɔn so maa ɔkɔpue mmarahyebadwam no ne Kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo National Democratic Congress.

Ɔbra ahyɛaseɛ ne Nwomasua 
wɔwoo Nanja wɔ Ogyefuo bosome no da a ɛtɔ so mmiensa, wɔ afe apem ahankron aduosia nnwɔtwe mu (born February 3, 1968). Ɔfiri kuro a yɛfrɛ no Saboba a, ɛwɔ Atifido mantam no mu wɔ ɔman Ghana mu. Ɔnyaa n'abɔdin krataa wɔka no borofo mu sɛ  Bachelor of Arts in Sociology and History ɛfirii Ghana suapɔn a wɔfrɛ no University of Ghana wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne num mu (2005). Nanja yɛ kristoni a ɔne Assemblies of God asafo no na ɛsom bɔm. Waware a ɔwɔ mma num.

Amannyɔsɛm 
Amannyɔkuo a Nanja dɔm a ɛnam wɔn so maa ɔkɔpue mmarahyebadwam no ne Kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo National Democratic Congress (NDC).  Wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du-mmienu mu no (2012), ɔgyina maa yɛtoo ne so aba sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ Atebubu Amantin abatoɔ mpesua no so wɔ Amannyɔkuo National Democratic Congress (NDC) din mu wɔ mmarahyɛbadwakuo a na ɛtɔ so nsia no mu na ɔdii nkunim. Wɔtoo aba no wieɛ no ɔnyaa mma no mu mpem du-nsia ne ahankron aduosia nnan (16,964), nnipa dodoɔ a wɔtoo aba wɔ saa abatoɔ mpesua no so saa berɛ no na wɔn dodoɔ yɛ mpem aduasa nan, ahanan ne du-baako (34,411) a, ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu aduanan nkron ne akyiripɔ aduasa (49.30%). Nanja antumi anyina amma yɛanto ne so aba bio sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma adehyeɛ a wɔwɔ Attebubu Amantin abatoɔ mpesua no so wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du-nsia (2016) abatoɔ no mu ɛsiane sɛ na  Nananom a wɔwɔ  Attebubu Amantin abatoɔ mpesua no so de ɔhyɛ ato ne so abra no ɛsiane ne nsɛm bi a ɔkekaa ne wɔ kasafidie bi so a na Nananom ho no sɛ ɛyɛ atɛnnie a ɛtia ɔbaa hemaa a ɔwɔ kuro no mu.

Abadwakuo ahodoɔ 
Abadwakuo ahodoɔ pii na wadi dwuma wɔ so wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam hɔ. 

Nanja ayɛ kuo ba de ama mmarahyɛbadwam abadwakuo a na wɔhwɛ mmarasɛm so (Judiciary Committee),  

ɛna afei nso wasane nso ayɛ kuo ba de ama mmarahyɛbadwam abadwakuo a na wɔhwɛ nsaase ne Kwaeɛ ahodoɔ so (Lands and Forestry Committee).

N'adwumayɔ 

 Ghana Education Service (kyerɛkyerɛni, Atebubu shs), Assistant Director 11
 District Chief Executive (DCE), (Atebubu District) Ayɛwohomummɔ bosome no da a ɛtɔ so nson (May 7), wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nkron mu (2009) de kɔ si - ɔpɛpɔn bosome no da a ɛtɔ so nson (January 7), wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du-mmiensa mu (2013)
 Educationist

title: Benjamin Komla Kpodo
text:
Benjamin Komla Kpodo yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ ne Mmarahyɛ Bagua a ɛtɔ so nson a ɛwɔ Fourth Republic of Ghana no muni a ɔgyina Ho Central Constituency ananmu wɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Kpodo wɔ December 22, afe 1953 mu. Ɔfiri Tanyigbe, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔnyaa ne bachelor’s degree wɔ Administration-Accounting option mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu wɔ afe 1980 mu. Onyaa ne nyansahu mu abodin krataa a ɛto so abien wɔ Akontaabu mu wɔ Lagos Sukuupɔn mu wɔ afe 1991 mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Kpodo yɛ National Democratic Congress (NDC) no muni. Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔsii akan maa Ho Central atenaeɛ no wɔ NDC mmarahyɛ bagua a ɛtɔ so nsia a ɛwɔ republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no tekiti so na ɔdii nkonim. Ɔkuraa n’akongua so wɔ afe 2016 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu, na ɔdii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ no mu ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 79.5. Wɔ afe 2020 abatoɔ no mu no, ɔdii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ no mu ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu aduɔwɔtwe nnum de san kuraa n’akongua no mu.

Adwumafa 
Sikasɛm sohwɛfo, Nhomasua Sukuupɔn, Winneba.

Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni (Ɔpɛpɔn 7, 2013 – mprempren; afe a ɛtɔ so mmienu).

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ɔyɛ Kristoni (Evangelical Presbyterian) . Ɔwaree, na ɔwɔ mma baason.

title: Benson Tongo Baba
text:

Benson fi Tengzuk-Tongo. Ɔwɔ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ Abodin krataa A ɛfiri Pusiga Nteteeɛ Kɔlege ne nhomasua suapɔn wɔ University of Education Winneba.

title: Bernard Ahiafor
text:
Bernard Ahiafor (wɔwoo no 6 Ɔpɛpɔn 1973) yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ na ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni a ɔgyina Akatsi Anafoɔ ananmu wɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Nhomasua 
Bernard Ahiafor nyaa ne mfimfini sukuu adesua fi afe 1984 kosi 1988 na owiee ne sukuu a ɔtaa kɔ sukuu wɔ afe 1993 mu ne nea ɛkɔ anim wɔ afe 1995 mu.

Bernard Ahiafor fi Atidzive. Ɔnyaa O Level wɔ Abor Senior High School, ne Bachelor’s Degree wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu.

Afei ɔkɔɔ so na ɔyɛɛ ne Professional Law Course (Barrister & Solicitor At Law ) wɔ afe 2002 mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Bernard Ahiafor yɛ mmaranimfoɔ na ɔyɛ adwuma ma Justkingfoɔ ne wɔn a wɔka ne ho. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ ne abatoɔ a ɛdi kan wɔ afe 2012 amansan abatoɔ mu wɔ National Democratic Congress (NDC) tekiti so na ɛnam saa kwan yi so no ne mmarahyɛ bagua adwuma no hyɛɛ aseɛ wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2013. 

Ɔsan nso yɛ Kwame Gyan and Associates, Star Assurance Co. Ltd (Head, Legal and Claims) no muni.

Wasom wɔ boayikuw ahorow pii mu wɔ mmarahyɛ bagua no mu. Saa boayikuo yi bi ne gyinabea boayikuo, nwomasua boayikuo ne ɔmannifoɔ a ɔdi kan wɔ amansan mmara, mmara ne mmarahyɛ bagua boayikuo no mu.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Bernard Ahiafor aware wɔ mmara kwan so na ɔwɔ mma 3.
