title: Betty Krosbi Mensah
text:
Betty Nana Efua Krosbi (wɔsan kyerɛw no Crosby ne Krosby) Mensah, (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn 29, 1980) yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɛɔfo ne Mmarahyɛbadwa no muni ma Afram Plains North mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Apuei fam mantam mu. Ɔyɛ Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛbadwa no muni.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Mensah wɔ 29 Ɔbɛnem 1980 wɔ Donkorkrom, Apuei Fam Mantam. Ɔwɔ Bachelor’s degree wɔ Adwumayɛ mu wɔ Zenith University College, ne Higher National Diploma (HND) wɔ Akontaabu ho nimdeɛ mu wɔ Koforidua Technical University.

Adwuma 
Ansa na ɔrebɛyɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni no, na Mensah yɛ Best Pat Ghana Limited no kwankyerɛfoɔ panin firi afe 2013 kɔsi afe 2016. Ɔsan nso yɛɛ Ɔman Mmabun Adwumayɛ ho Ntamgyinafoɔ Abadiakyiri a ɔtɔ so mmienu firi afe 2009 kɔsi afe 2013. Mensah nso yɛ Ghana Cooperative Credit Union no Bɔbeasu ne Nkɔsoɔ Ntamgyinafoɔ firi afe 2003 kɔsi afe 2005. Ɔyɛ Young Parliamentarians Forum, Ghana Chapter no Titenani Abadiakyiri.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Mmarahyɛ Bagua no mu mmɔdenbɔ

Wɔ Ghana afe 2016 amansan abatoɔ a wɔde maa Mmarahyɛ Bagua atenaeɛ a ɛwɔ Afram Plains no mu no, Mensah twee abatoɔ dodoɔ a ɛyɛ 18,121 wɔ abatoɔ 23,606 a wɔtoo no mu a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 78.44 de dii Isaac Ofori-Koree a ɔfiri New Patriotic Party a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 4,795 a ɔyɛɛ ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 20.8 wɔ ne nyinaa mu, ne Micheal Ampontia a ofi Convention People’s Party mu a onyaa abatow 91 a onyaa abatow a wotowee nyinaa mu ɔha biara mu nkyem 0.4 de dii nkonim wɔ Ghana Republic of anan Mmarahyɛ Bagua a ɛto so 7 no mu.

2020 abatow mu

Wɔ afe 2020 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu no, ɔsan dii nkonim wɔ Afram Plains North Constituency mmarahyɛ bagua no mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 18,543 na ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ no nyinaa mu ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 68.30 berɛ a NPP mmarahyɛ baguani Isaac Ofori-Koree nyaa abatoɔ 8,605 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu aduasa a ɛmaa abatow a wɔtow no nyinaa mu ɔha biara mu nkyem 31.70 na NDP mmarahyɛ baguani Ferguson Asare nyaa abatow 0 a ɛmaa abatow a wɔtow no nyinaa mu ɔha biara mu nkyem 0.

Member of Parliament

Wɔ mmarahyɛ bagua a ɛtɔ so 8 no mu no ɔsom sɛ ɔmannifoɔ wɔ Bɔbeasu ne Mmofra Boayikuo ne Akwahosan Boayikuo no mu.

Personal life 
Mensah aware a ɔwɔ abofra baako. Ɔyɛ Krosbi Mensah, MP a odi kan a ɔhwɛ Afram Plains Constituency so no babea. Ɔyɛ Kristoni na ɔsom sɛ Roman Katolekni.

Philanthropy 
Wɔ July 2021 mu no, Mensah de laptop maa Michael Awingura a ɔyɛ Ghana Suapɔn sukuuni.

Wɔ June 2022 mu no, ɔde nneɛma maa nwomasua, kuayɛ ne ayaresabea nnwinnadeɛ maa akwahosan adwuma wɔ Afram Plains North Constituency.

Beaɛ a menyaa mmoa fii

title: Frank Annoh Dompreh
text:
Frank Annoh-Dompreh (wowoo no 25 Ahinime 1977) is a Ghana amanyɔni na ɔsan yɛ kɔnsultant. Ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party ni ɛna ɔsan yɛ mmarahyɛbaguani ma Nsawam-Adoagyiri. Ɔno na ɔyɛ titerani ma  Parliamentary Select Committee on Foreign Affairs ɔsan yɛ kuoba ma Subsidiary Legislation ne Roads ɛna Transport Committee wɔ mmarahyɛbagua mu.

Mfitiase asetra 
Annoh-Dompreh wowoo no 25 Ahinime 1977 wɔ Nsawam-Adoagyiri a ɛwɔ Apuei Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔwei sukuupɔn wɔ University of Cape Coast a ɔyaa Bachelor of Science wɔ nfumdwuma mu. Ɔsan sua ade wɔ Mountcrest University na ɔyaa LLB ne LLM

Amanyɔsɛm 
Annoh-Dompreh hwɛɛ amanyɔsɛm ase ɛfiri sukuu mu ɛbere a wo to aba ma no sɛ Ɔmanpanyi ma National Union of Ghana Students (NUGS) ɛbere a na ɔyɛ sukuuni wɔ University of Cape Coast ɛwɔ 2000. Ɔtoɔ aba ma no sɛ Apuei Mantam Nbaabuno Domfrefoɔ ma New Patriotic Party. Ɛwɔ 2012, ogyina wɔ Nsawam/Adoagyiri NPP Parliamentary primaries tia Seth Wiafe Danquah na ɔde nkonim ma no gyina party no anan mu wɔ 2012 mmarahyɛbaguani abatoɔ. Ɔyaa 366 ɛfi 482 aba wo toɔ yɛ. Ɔtua so ne Ben Ohene-ayeh ɔwɔ NDC kɔ wintam so. Ɔdi nkonim wɔ 2016 Ghanaian mmarahyɛbaguani abatoɔ no mu. Ɔka kuo ɛwɔ mmarahyɛbagua a yɛ frɛ ɔmo Select Committees on Subsidiary Legislation ne Roads & Transport.

Committees 
Annoh-Dompreh yɛ Vice-chairperson wɔ Housing Committee so wɔ mmarahyɛbagua mu. Ɔsan nso yɛ kuoba wɔ Finance Committee; kuoba wɔ Education Committee; kuoba wɔ Foreign Affairs Committee, kuoba wɔ Appointments Committee, kuoba wɔ Business Committee nna ɔsan yɛ kuoba wɔ Committee of Selection Committee.

Personal life 
Annoh-Dompreh yɛ Kristoni a ɔkɔ asore wɔ Church of Pentecost. W'aware a ɔwɔ nkora miesa

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Samuel Atta Mills
text:
Samuel Atta Mills yɛ Ghanani a wɔwoo no Oforisuo bosome no da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nsia, wɔ afe apem ahankron aduonum nsia mu (born 26 April 1956).  Ɔyɛ amannyɔni a ɔka Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a wɔtɔ so nson no ho wɔ Ghana kwasafoman a ɛtɔ so nan no mu, ɔno na ɔyɛ ananmusini de ma Komenda Edina Eguafo Abrem abatoɔ mpesua no so a wɔwɔ Mfimfini mantam no mu. Amannyɔkuo a ɔdɔm a ɛnam wɔn so maa ɔkɔpue mmarahyebadwam no ne Kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo National Democratic Congress.

Ɔbra ahyɛaseɛ ne Nwomasua 
wɔwoo Mills  wɔ Oforisuo bosome no da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nsia, a ɛyɛ Yawoada, wɔ afe apem ahankron aduonum nsia mu (born 26 April 1956) na ɔfiri kuro a yɛfrɛ no Kissi a ɛwɔ Mfimfini mantam no mu wɔ ɔman  Ghana mu. Ɔkɔɔ ntoasoɔ sukuu wɔ Mfantsipim Sukuu, a ɛhɔ na ɔkɔnyaa ne GCE Certificate. Ɔtoaa so kɔɔ Komenda College kɔgyee adekyerɛ mu nteteeɛ abɔdin a yɛka no borofo mu sɛ Diploma in Education.  Ɔwiee n'adesua wɔ Komenda no, Mills toaa so kɔɔ Belmont University a ɛhɔ na ɔkɔgyee n'abɔdin krataa wɔ sikasɛm ne ne ntotoeɛ mu a yɛka no borofo kasa mu sɛ BBA in Economics and Accounting wɔ afe apem ahankron aduowɔtwe nan (1984) mu, ɛna afei ɔnyaa n'abɔdin krataa wɔ sikasɛm ne sikakorabea ho dwumadie mu a yɛka no borofo kasa mu sɛ MBA in Finance and Banking wɔ afe apem ahankron aduowɔtwe nsia (1986) mu.

N'abrabɔ 
Samuel Atta Mills yɛ kristoni a ɔne  Methodist asafo no na ɛsom bɔm. Ɔnua ne Ghana manpanin dada a wanya ne baabi korɔ a yɛfrɛ no Ɔbenfo  John Atta Mills.   

Ansa na ɔrebɛkɔ mmarahyɛbadwam hɔ no, na Mills adi kan ayɛ adwuma wɔ Ghana Tourism Development Company a na ɔno na ɔyɛ chief executive officer ɛfiri afe 2003 de kɔ si 2005. Wɔ afe 2005 mu no, ɔkɔyɛɛ adwuma maa Panera Bread a na ɔno na ɔyɛ Regional Manager. Ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ hɔ ara kɔ sii afe 2009 mu na yɛpaw no sɛ ɔnkɔ yɛ Presidential Aide mfa mma Ghana manpanin a na ɔte akonnwa so saa berɛ no a yɛfrɛ no Obenfo John Atta Mills. Afei nso ɔsane nso yɛɛ adwuma wɔ First American Bank a na ɔno na ɔyɛ Commercial Loans Manager.

Amannyɔsɛm 
Amannyɔkuo a Nanja dɔm a ɛnam wɔn so maa ɔkɔpue mmarahyebadwam no ne Kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo National Democratic Congress (NDC).

Afe mpem mmienu ne du-nsia abatoɔ 
wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du nsia (2016) abatoɔ a yɛtoo wɔ Ghana no, ɔdii nkunim wɔ Komenda-Edina-Eguafo-Abirem abatoɔ mpesua no so wɔ Kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo NDC din mu. Yɛtoo aba no wieɛ no, ɔnyaa mma no mu mpem aduonu baako ahankron aduonum nson (21,957) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu aduasa nwɔtwe ne akyiripɔ nan (38.4%), ɛna ɔsono amannyɔkuo NPP ananmusini a yɛfrɛ no Stephen Nana Ato Arthur nso nyaa mma no mu mpem dunum ahankron aduosia (15,960) a ɛno nso gyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu aduonu nson ne akyiripɔ nkron (27.9%),  afei PPP amannyɔkuo no nso ananmusini a yɛfrɛ no John Sterlin nso nyaa mma no mu mpem dunwɔtwe ahawɔtwe ne aduosia (18,860) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu  aduasa mmiensa ne akyiripɔ hwee (33.0%), ɛna CPP amannyɔkuo no ananmusini a yɛfrɛ no Mrs.  Rose Austin Tenadu nso nyaa mma no mu ahanan ne du (410) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu hwee ne akyiripɔ nson (0.7%).

Afe mpem mmienu ne aduonu abatoɔ (2020) 
wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne aduonu abatoɔ no mu nso Mills bɔɔ ne ho mmɔden sane dii nkunim bio wɔ Komenda-Edina-Eguafo-Abirem abatoɔ mpesua no so.  Yɛtoo aba no wieɛ no na wanya mma no mu mpem aduonu nsia, ahanwɔtwe aduowɔtwe nsia (26,886) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu aduanan mmienu ne akyiripɔ nson (42.7%), saa ara nso na Samuel Joe Acquah, a na ɔyɛ NPP ɔsono amannyɔkuo no ananmusini no nso nyaa mma no mu mpem aduonu mmiensa, ne aduasa nkron (23,039) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu aduasa nsia ne akyiripɔ nsia (36.6%),  afei GUM amannyɔkuo no ananmusini a yɛfrɛ no Abubakr Sadiq Cann nso nyaa mma no mu apem, ɔha ne aduonu mmienu (1,122) a ɛno nso gyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu baako akyiripɔ nwɔtwe (1.8%), ɛna PPP amannyɔkuo no nso ananmusini John Sterlin nso nyaa mma no mu mpem du-baako, ahankron ne aduosia nan (11,964) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu du nkron ne akyiripɔ hwee (19.0%).

Abadwakuo ahodoɔ 
Abadwakuo ahodoɔ pii na wadi dwuma wɔ so wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam hɔ. Samuel Atta Mills ayɛ kuo ba de ama mmarahyɛbadwam abadwakuo a na wɔhwɛ Akwan ne akwantusɛm so (Roads and Transport Committee), ɛna afei nso wasane nso ayɛ otitenani de ama mmarahyɛbadwam abadwakuo a na wɔhwɛ Amansan fotoɔ ne nkontabuo so (Public Accounts Committee)

Baabi a Menyaa mmoa firiiɛ.

title: Bright Wireko-Brobby
text:
Bright Wireko-Brobby (wɔwoo no 6 Ɔpɛpɔn 1972) yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ na ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanin a ɛtɔ so nnan Mmarahyɛbadwa no muni a ɔgyina Hemang Lower Denkyira Mansin ananmu wɔ Mfinimfine Mantam wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so. Ɔsan nso yɛ Ɔmanpanyin Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Adwumayɛ ne Adwumayɛfo Nkitahodi so.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Wireko-Brobby wɔ 6 Ɔbɛnem 1972 na ɔfiri Twifo Hemang wɔ Mfinimfini Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔwɔ MSC wɔ Nhyehyɛeɛ mu ne LLB wɔ Faculty of Law wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so. Ɔtoaa so kɔɔ Dortmund Suapɔn mu baabi a ɔnyaa Postgraduate Diploma wɔ Spatial Planning mu.

Adwuma 
Wireko-Brobby ne ahyehyɛdeɛ te sɛ USAID, UNHCR ne UNDP ayɛ adwuma. Ɔne Ghana Nhomasua Dwumadibea nso yɛɛ adwuma. Na ɔsan nso yɛ Ɔkwankyerɛfoɔ Panyin a ɔhwɛ Community Empowerment Associates so.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wireko-Brobby yɛ New Patriotic Party no muni. Mprempren ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwa no muni ma Hemang Lower Denkyira Abatoɔ Mpɛsua wɔ Mfinimfini Mantam mu.

2016 election 
Wɔ afe 2016 Ghana amansan abatow mu no, odii nkonim wɔ Hemang Lower Denkyira Constituency mmarahyɛ bagua no mu a na abatow 15,043 na ɛyɛ 58.4% wɔ ne nyinaa mu abatow a wɔtow bere a NDC mmarahyɛ baguani Foster Joseph Andoh nyaa abatow 10,338 a ɛyɛɛ abatow a wɔtow nyinaa mu 40.1%, PPP mmarahyɛ baguani Paul Kinsley Ambantem nyaa abatow 257 a ɛyɛɛ abatow a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 1.0% na CPP mmarahyɛ baguani John Felix Krampah nyaa 119 votes making 0.5% of the total votes cast.

2020 abatoɔ 
Wɔ afe 2020 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu no, ɔsan dii nkonim wɔ Hemang Lower Denkyira Constituency mmarahyɛbadwa atenaeɛ no mu de abatoɔ 14,791 yɛɛ 52.9% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu berɛ a NDC mmarahyɛbadwa no ɔkannifoɔ Foster Joseph Andoh nyaa abatoɔ 12,692 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 45.4% na GUM mmarahyɛ baguani kandifoɔ Appiah Kubi nyaa abatoɔ 473 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 1.7%.

Boayikuo 
Wireko-Brobby yɛ Aguadiɛ no muni , Nnwuma ne Nsrahwɛ Boayikuw na ɔsan yɛ Mpɔtam Aban ne Nkuraase Nkɔso Boayikuw no muni.

N'asetena 
Wireko-Brobby yɛ Kristoni.

title: Bryan Acheampong
text:
Bryan Acheampong (wɔwoo no 27 Ɔbɛnem 1972) yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ ne Mmarahyɛbadwa no muni wɔ Abeti mpɛsoa so wɔ Ghana Apueeɛ Mantam mu. Ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party of Ghana no muni. Ɔdii Peter Wiafe Pepera a owuiɛ berɛ a na ɔwɔ dibea no ananmu. Na ɔyɛ Ɔman Minista wɔ Ministry of Interior wɔ Ɔgyefoɔ 2019 kɔsi afe 2020. Wɔ afe 2016 mu no, ɔtɔɔ Okwawu United F.C. Mprenpren ɔyɛ ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ kuadwuma so.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo no wɔ 27 Obubuo 1972 wɔ Suhum a ɛwɔ Ghana Apuei fam mantam mu. Bryan firi Nkwatia a ɛwɔ Kwahu Apuei Fam Mansini mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔnyaa ne mfitiaseɛ sukuu wɔ Achimota Mfitiaseɛ Sukuu mu na ɔkɔɔ so kɔɔ Presbyterian Boys Secondary School wɔ Legon. Ɔwiee Johnson ne Wales Sukuupɔn a ɛwɔ USA a na ɔwɔ bachelor’s degree ne MBA wɔ Business Administration mu. Ɔyɛ PhD kandifoɔ wɔ Information Systems mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu. Ɔwɔ Adansedi Krataa a efi Massachusetts Mfiridwuma Asoɛe hɔ. Ɔsan nso wɔ HP Accredited Sales Professional a ofi HP Suapɔn mu.

Adwuma 
Ɔsomm wɔ U.S. Wim Asraafoɔ mu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnan de kɔsi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nsia  (2004 -2006) ntam hɔ.Na ɔyɛ Ɔman Soafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Ɔman Ahobanbɔ so wɔ berɛ a wɔpaw no na ɔkaa ntam sɛ Ɔmampanyin Dwumadibea no. Ɔyɛ Ɔfotufo. Na ɔyɛ INTU-Group a ɛwɔ Nkran no kwankyerɛfo panyin. Mprempren ɔyɛ Ɔman Ɔsoafo Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Mfinimfini Fam so.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ɔyɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni. Ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma Abeti Mansin a ɛwɔ Ghana Apuei fam mantam mu.

2016 abatoɔ

Wɔ afe 2016 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu no, ɔdii nkonim wɔ Abetifi Constituency mmarahyɛbadea no mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 23,432 a ɛyɛ 74.61% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu berɛ a NDC mmarahyɛbadwa kandifoɔ Tabi Emmanuel nyaa abatoɔ 7,975 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 25.39%.

2020 abatow mu

Wɔ afe 2020 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu no, ɔsan dii nkonim wɔ Abetifi Constituency mmarahyɛbadwa no mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 25,035 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 72.42% berɛ a NDC mmarahyɛbadwa mu kandifoɔ Samuel Asamoah nyaa abatoɔ 9,536 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 27.58%.

Boayikuw 
Ɔyɛ Amannɔne Nsɛm Boayikuw no Titenani, Ɔyɛ Bammɔ ne Mfinimfini Boayikuw no muni, ɔyɛ Boayikuw a Wɔpaw Nnipa no muni na ɔsan yɛ Boayikuw a Wɔpaw Boayikuw no muni.

N'Adwuma sɛ Ɔsoafoɔ 
Ɔno na ɔyɛ Ɔmanpanin a ɔhwɛ Aduane ne Kuadwuma so wɔ Ghana.

Wɔ Benada, February 7, 2023, Ɔkasafo no, Alban Sumana Bagbin bɛpae mu aka wɔ mmarahyɛ badwa no ase. Ɔdii Ɔbenfo Dr. Owusu Afriyie Akoto, a na ɔyɛ Minister fi afe 2017 kosi afe 2023. Nnansa yi ara na ɔtuee ne nan ase sɛ ɔbɛdi NPP a ɛredi tumi no anim wɔ wɔn abatoɔ a ɛreba no mu.

Wɔpaw no sɛ Ɔman Soafo, Ɔmanpanyin Adwumayɛbea wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 4, 2017, na akyiri yi ɔfaa Ɔman Soafo adwuma wɔ Ɔman mu Asɛnka Dwumadibea wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 13, 2020, wɔ ne nhyiamu ase no akyi. 22]

Ankorankoro asetena 
Ɔnwaree. Ɔyɛ Kristoni na ɔsom sɛ Presbyterian.

Adɔeɛ 
Wɔ Kitawonsa 2019 mu no, ɔde 150kv generator maa Presbyterian College of Education (ABETICO) wɔ Abetifi wɔ Apuei Fam Mantam my.

Wɔ Oforisuo 2019 mu no, Bryan nam Bryan Acheampong Foundation so de GH¢250,000 check maa Presbyterian University College.

Wɔ Ayɛwohomumɔ 2020 mu no, ɔde bɛboro ¢820,000 maa Afram Asasetaw Atifi, Afram Asasetaw Anafoɔ, Abirem, Mpraeso, Nkawkaw, Abetifi ne Suhum.

Wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2021 mu no, ɔboaa ma wɔsii abura bɛboro ɔha wɔ Abetifi, Pampaso, Abetifi Christian Quarters, Nkwatia, Kwahu-Tafo, Bokuruwa, Nteso, Ankomah, Akwasiho, Dwerebease ne Suminakese.

Wɔ Kitawonsa 2021 mu no, ɔde afuo mu nneɛma a ne boɔ yɛ ¢500,000 maa akuafoɔ bɛboro 6,000 a wɔwɔ Kwahu Apueeɛ Mantam mu sɛ wɔmmoa wɔn kuayɛ adwuma.

Wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2022 mu no, ɔmaa Suzuki Swift SRS Kar maa Awogyefoɔ a ɔsen biara wɔ Abetifi Mantam mu.

Wɔ Ɔsanaa 2022 mu no, ɔde ¢170,000, mfiri a wɔde pam ade 42 ne mfiri a wɔde twitwiw ti nhwi 26 maa Dressmakers and Hairdressers Associations a ɛwɔ ne mansin mu.

Abɔdin Ahodoɔ 
Wɔ Ayɛwohomumɔ 2020 mu no, Kasapreko Company Limited mpanyimfo kamfoo no wɔ mmoa a ɔde ko tia COVID-19 ɔyaredɔm no ho.

Wɔ Ɔsanaa 2021 mu no, Ghana Ɔman Akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ Fekuo hyɛɛ Bryan anuonyam sɛ ɔmaa wɔn asɔremma a wɔwɔ Kwahu Apueeɛ Mantam mu no sika a wɔde bɛboa no.

Mmeaeɛ A Menyaa Mmoa Firiiɛ

title: Carlos Kingsley Ahenkorah
text:
Carlos Kingsley Ahenkorah yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɛfo ne Tema West mantam mu Mmarahyɛbadwa no muni. Afei nso, na ɔyɛ Ɔmanpanyin Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Aguadi ne Nnwuma so wɔ Ghana. Ɔsan nso yɛ Carlos King Freight Services no kwankyerɛfo panyin.

Nwomasua 
Ahenkorah kɔɔ Tema Ntoaso Sukuu ne Abuakwa State College. Ɔnyaa Master of Arts ( Ports and Shipping Administration) abodin krataa wɔ Regional Maritime University, Nungua Nkran/ University of Ghana Business School wɔ afe 2013 mu.

Adwuma 
Ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ Jospong Consortium sɛ adetɔnfoɔ panin firi afe 2004 kɔsi afe 2006. Ɔyɛ Zoomlion Ghana Limited aguadi sohwɛfoɔ ne J. A. Plant Pool Limited adwuma sohwɛfoɔ wɔ afe 2007 ne 2012 ntam.[3] Ɔyɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ wɔ Regional Maritime University firi afe 2005 na ɔmaa ɔkasa wɔ Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration (GIMPA) firi afe 2010. Ɔyɛ Carlos King Freight Services firi afe 1992.

Akyinnyegye 
Wɔhyɛɛ no ​​ma ogyaee ne dibea sɛ Ɔman Minista bere a wɔhwehwɛɛ mu sɛ ɔwɔ COVID-19 na obuu akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe ahorow so na ofii adi sɛ ɔne akuw no akyigyinafo dii nkitaho no. Wɔ afe 2020 mu no, ɔkɔɔ baabi a wɔkyerɛw wɔn din bere a na ɔwɔ COVID-19.[5] Na eyi yɛ bere a na ɛsɛ sɛ ɔtew ne ho fi afoforo ho. Wɔ saa adeyɛ nhyɛso kuw yi nti Occupy Ghana hwehwɛɛ sɛ wɔpam no fi aban mu.[6] Ɔmampanyin no maa no tumi krataa a ɛtwa toɔ sɛ ɔmfa ne ho nhyɛ mu.[7] Wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa, afe 2020 no, ɔgyaee adwuma. Wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2021 mu, wɔ ɔman no television so dwumadi a ɛfa Ghana Mmarahyɛbadwa no Kasafo a wɔpaw no ho no, wohuu Ahenkorah sɛ ɔregye abatow nkrataa afi dan no mu bere a na wɔreto aba no, ansa na ahobammɔ adwumayɛfo ne asɔretiafo mmarahyɛbadwafo regye, bere a ɔde bolt bɔɔ no ɔkwan a wɔfa so fi adi no.

Ghana mmarahyɛbadwa awotwe no mu dodow no ara Kannifo, Osei Kyei-Mensah Bonsu pow nsɛm a wɔkae sɛ ɔhyɛɛ Carlos Ahenkorah sɛ ɔnnye abatow nkrataa.

title: Samuel Abu Jinapor
text:
Samuel Abu Jinapor  yɛ Ghanani a ɔyɛ mmaranimfoɔ sane nso yɛ amannyɔni. wɔwoo no  wɔ afe apem ahankron aduowɔtwe mmiensa mu (born 1983). Ɔyɛ amannyɔni a ɔka Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a wɔtɔ so nwɔtwe no ho wɔ Ghana kwasafoman a ɛtɔ so nan no mu, ɔno na ɔyɛ ananmusini de ma Damongo abatoɔ mpesua no so a wɔwɔ Savannah mantam no mu.

Amannyɔkuo a ɔdɔm a ɛnam wɔn so maa ɔkɔpue mmarahyebadwam no ne ɔsono amannyɔkuo NPP. Wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du nson (2017) mu no,  Ghana manpanin Nana Addo Dankwah Akufo-Addo bɔɔ ne din sɛ ɔnkɔyɛ "Deputy Chief of Staff in charge of Operations at the Office of the President", saa mmerɛ no na wadi mfie aduasa mmiensa (33), wɔ ɔman Ghana abakwasɛm mu no, ɔno na ɔbɛkuraa saa diberɛ yi a na ɔsua yie pa ara.  Mprɛmprɛn yi deɛ, ɔno na ɔyɛ ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Nsaase ne nyame abɔdeɛ so (Minister for Lands and Natural Resources).

Ɔbra ahyɛaseɛ ne Nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Jinapor wɔ afe apem ahankron aduowɔtwe mmiensa (1983) mu. Owura a ɔwoo Samuel Abu Jinapor ne Abudulai Jinapor, a ɔyɛ polisini a wakɔ ahomegyeeɛ mu a, na ɔsane nso yɛ ɔhene wɔ Buipe a ɛwɔ Savannah mantam no mu wɔ ɔman Ghana mu. Ɔkɔɔ Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology kɔgyee nteteɛ gyee n'abɔdin krataa a yɛka no wɔ borofo kasa mu sɛ Bachelor of Science degree in physics wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nsia (2006) mu. ɔwiee Kwame Nkruma suapɔn no, ɔsane nso toaa so kɔɔ University of Ghana wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nwɔtwe (2008) mu a ɛhɔ na ɔkɔnyaa n'abɔdin krataa wɔ mmarasua mu a yɛka no borofo kasa mu sɛ Bachelor of Laws wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du (2010) mu. saa afe korɔ no ara mu na ɔnyaa adesua mu akwannya kɔtoaa ne mmarasua adesua no so (LLB) wɔ Ghana School of Law, a ɛwɔ Makola, wɔ Nkran.  Ɔsane nso kura Master of Laws in Alternative Dispute Resolution a ɛno nso ɔnyaa no wɔ Faculty of Law, University Of Ghana.

Baabi a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Sampson Ahi
text:
Sampson Ahi  yɛ Ghanani amannyɔni a ɔka Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a wɔtɔ so nson no ho wɔ Ghana kwasafoman a ɛtɔ so nan no mu,  ɔno na ɔyɛ ananmusini de ma Bodi  abatoɔ mpesua no so a wɔwɔ Atɔeɛ mantam no mu. Amannyɔkuo a ɔdɔm a ɛnam wɔn so maa ɔkɔpue mmarahyebadwam no ne Kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo National Democratic Congress.

Ɔbra ahyɛaseɛ ne Nwomasua 
wɔwoo Ahi wɔ ɛbɔ bosome no da a ɛtɔ so du nan wɔ afe apem ahankron aduoson nsia mu (14 September 1976). ɔfiri kuro a yɛfrɛ no Sefwi Bodi a ɛwɔ Atɔeɛ mantam no mu wɔ ɔman Ghana. ɔnyaa n'abɔdin krataa a yɛka no wɔ borofo kasa mu sɛ Bachelor of Arts degree de firii University of Ghana, a ɛwɔ Legon ɛna ɔtoaa so kɔnyaa deɛ yɛfrɛ no Executive Masters in Governance and Leadership (EMGL) ɛfirii Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration (GIMPA).

Ne Bra 
Ansana ɔrebɛwura mmarahyɛbadwam no, na, Ahi adi kan sɛ sector manager de ama  Armar Jaro a wɔtotɔ kookoo ɛfiri afe (2003) de bɛ si afe (2004).  ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔsoafoɔ abadiakyire a na ɔhwɛ adan ne adansie nwuma so wɔ ɔmanpanin Jonh Dramani Mahama amanmuo no mu.

waware a ɔwɔ mma num.

Amannyɔsɛm 
Ahi kɔɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwam hɔ wɔ ɔpɛpɔn bosome no da a ɛtɔ so nson (7 January) wɔ afe (2005) a na ɔyɛ ananmusini de ma Juabeso abatoɔ mpesua no so. Amannyɔkuo a ɔdɔm a ɛnam wɔn so maa ɔkɔpue mmarahyebadwam no ne Kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo National Democratic Congress. ɔno ara na wayɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ hɔ saa ara de bɛsi sɛ wɔtee abatoɔ mpesua fororɔ wɔ afe 2012 mu  a wɔfrɛ no Bodi a ɛno nso ɔdii nkunim a ɔda so yɛ wɔn ananmusini de bɛsi nɛ.

Baabi a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Charles Agbeve
text:
Charles Akwesi Agbeve (wɔwoo no 21 Kitawonsa 1970) yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ ne Mmarahyɛbdwa a Ɛtɔ so Nwɔtwe a ɛwɔ Fourth Republic of Ghana no muni a ɔgyina Agotime-Ziope Mansin ananmu wɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Mfitiase Asetena Ne Nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Charles Agbeve wɔ Ziope Honugo wɔ Firaw Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Charles Agbeve twaa ne Common Entrance Examination wɔ afe 1982 mu a ɛmaa ɔtumi nyaa ne Ordinary Level wɔ afe 1987 mu ne Advanced Level wɔ afe 1989. Afei ɔkɔɔ so nyaa ne Bachelor of Science(Bsc) ne Maths Diploma In Education wɔ afe 1995 mu wɔ University of Cape Coast. Charles Agbeve kɔɔ so nyaa ne Master of Business Administration – Finance Option (Akwahosan Insurance) wɔ afe 2002 mu firii Ghana Suapɔn, Legon – Ghana. Charles Agbeve nso nyaa ne Master of Arts (Sikasɛm Nhyehyɛeɛ Ho Dwumadie) firi afe 2017–2018.

Adwuma 
Charles Agbeve yɛɛ Nkontaabu ne Nyansahu Kyerɛkyerɛfo wɔ Ghanatta Senior High School. Charles Agbeve nso ayɛ adwuma sɛ Aguadi sohwɛfo wɔ Ghana Alumnium Products Limited. Ɔsan nso yɛɛ adwuma sɛ Ɔmantam /Kuropɔn sohwɛfoɔ wɔ Ɔman Akwahosan Insurance Authority, Ho Municipal Office firi afe 2009 kɔsi afe 2016. Mprempren Charles Agbeve reyɛ adwuma sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwa no muni (MP) ama Agotime-Ziope abatoɔ mpasua firi afe 2021 kɔsi afe 2025.

Amanyɔsɛm Mu Nsɛm 
Wɔ afe 2015 mu no, Charles Agbeve sii akan na ɔdii nkonim wɔ NDC mmarahyɛ bagua mfitiaseɛ abatoɔ mu maa Agotime-Ziope Mantam a ɛwɔ Firaw Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Charles Agbeve nso dii nkonim wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa no mu wɔ ne mansin mu wɔ afe 2016 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so sɛ ɔbɛkɔ akɔka Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson (7) a ɛwɔ Fourth Republic of Ghana no ho. Ɔsan dii nkonim bio de abatoɔ 19143 (87.80%) wɔ afe 2020 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so sɛ ɔbɛka Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so Awotwe (8) a ɛyɛ mprempren Mmarahyɛbadwa no seesei kɔsi afe 2025.
Boayikuw 

Boayikuw 

Charles Agbeve yɛ Aban Awerɛhyem Boayikuo ne Akwahosan Boayikuo a ɛwɔ Mmarahyɛbadwa a Ɛtɔ so Nwɔtwe (8) a ɛwɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no muni.

Ankorankoro asetena 
Charles Agbeve yɛ Kristoni.

title: Ebenezer Kojo Kum
text:
Ebenezer Kojo Kum (wɔwoo no Memeneda 17 Ayɛwohomumɔ 1967) yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ, mmaranimfoɔ a na ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanin Mmarahyɛbadwa a Ɛtɔ so Nson no muni na seesei ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanin Mmarahyɛbadwa a Ɛtɔ so Nwɔtwe a ɔgyina Ahanta Atɔeɛ Mansin ananmu no muni wɔ Ghana Atɔe Fam Mantam mu wɔ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no tekiti so.

Mfitiase asetena ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Ebenezer Kojo Kum na ɔfiri Dixcove a ɛwɔ Ghana Atɔeɛ Mantam mu. Ebenezer Kojo Kum nyaa ne Ordinary Level(O - Level) wɔ afe 1984 mu ne Advanced Level(A - Level) wɔ afe 1986. Ebenezer Kojo Kum kɔɔ so nyaa ne Bachelor of Arts(Hons) ne Diploma wɔ Nhomasua mu, a ne nyinaa fi University of Cape Coast wɔ afe 1991 mu na ɔyɛɛ Mmaranimfo (General Practice) wɔ Ghana Mmara Sukuu mu wɔ afe 2020 mu.

Adwuma 
Ebenezer Kojo Kum yɛ Ɔkwankyerɛfoɔ Abadiakyiri/Amammerɛ sohwɛfoɔ Panyin/Amammerɛ sohwɛfoɔ Panyin firi afe 1992 kɔsi afe 2005 wɔ Ɔman Amammerɛ Asoɛeɛ.

Ebenezer Kojo Kum nso yɛ mmaranimfoɔ kumaa firi afe 2000 kɔsi afe 2002 wɔ Kendicks Law Firm, ɔyɛ Associate partner fi afe 2002 kɔsi 2007 ne General Manager firi afe 2007 kɔsi 2016 wɔ Kendicks Law Firm.

Mprempren Ebenezer Kojo Kum reyɛ adwuma sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwa no muni (MP) ama Ahanta West Abatoɔ Mpasua wɔ Atɔee Mantam wɔ Ghana wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so.

Amanyɔsɛm mu Asetena 
Ebenezer Kojo Kum sii akan na odii nkonim wɔ afe 2016 NPP mmarahyɛbadwa mfitiaseɛ abatoɔ mu maa Ahanta West abatoɔ mpasua wɔ Atɔe Mantam wɔ Ghana.Ebenezer Kojo Kum kɔɔ so dii nkonim wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa no mu wɔ ne mantam (Ahanta West abatoɔ mpasua) mu wɔ Atɔe Mantam wɔ Ghana wɔ afe 2016 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so sɛ wɔbɛka Seventh (7th) Parliament of the Fourth Republic of Ghana a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 30,596 (68.1%) tiaa George Kwame Aboagye(Late) a ɔfiri National Democratic Congress a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 13,784 (30.7%) ne Isaac Kweku Annan a ɔfiri Convention People’s Party(CPP) a ɔnyaa aba 546 (1.2%). 

Ebenezer Kojo Kum san sii akan na ɔdii nkonim wɔ afe 2020 NPP mmarahyɛ bagua mfitiaseɛ abatoɔ mu maa Ahanta West Abatoɔ mpasua wɔ Atɔe Mantam mu wɔ Ghana a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 472(65.46%) tiaa Kwesi Biney a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 249 (34.54%). Ebenezer Kojo Kum san kɔɔ so dii nkonim wɔ afe 2020 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so sɛ ɔbɛkɔ akɔka Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so awotwe (8) a ɛwɔ Fourth Republic of Ghana no ho a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 27,946 (51.60%) tiaa Dr. Emmanuel Okumi Andoh (a kan Pro-Vice Chancellor a ɔwɔ Takoradi Technical University) a ɔwɔ National Democratic Congress a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 23,957 (44.24%), Ismail Buadii a ɔfiri Ghana Union Movement (GUM) a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 1,797 (3.32%), Ebo Mensah a ɔfiri Convention People’s Party (CPP) a onyaa abatow 214 (0.40%), Nathaniel Adusei a ofi All People’s Congress (APC) a onyaa abatow 139 (0.25%) ne Dominic Akalga a ofi People’s National Convention (PNC) a ɔno nso nyaa abatow 101 (0.18% ).

Ebenezer Kojo Kum yɛ Ɔmanpanyin ne Nyamesom Nsɛm Ho Ɔsoafo.

Boayikuw 
Ebenezer Kojo Kum yɛ Atemmu Boayikuw no muni . Ɔsan nso yɛ Fourth Republic of Ghana Mmarahyɛbadwa a Ɛto so Awotwe (8) no Aguadi, Nnwuma ne Nsrahwɛ Boayikuw no muni.

N'asetena 
Ebenezer Kojo Kum yɛ Kristoni na ɔyɛ Anaji Christ the King Methodist Asɔre a ɛwɔ Takoradi no muni. Ebenezer Kojo Kum aware wɔ anigye mu a ɔwɔ abofra.

Adɔeɛ 
Ebenezer Kojo Kum de aduruyɛ nnwinnade bi maa Ahanta West akwahosan ho adwumayɛbea a ɛwɔ Ahanta West Constituencyon Fida, 24 Ɔbɛnem 2020. Nnwinnade a ne bo yɛ cedis mpempem pii no bi ne moto abien, moto abiɛsa sakre abien (a wɔfrɛ no Mahama Canbu), mpa so ntama asinasin , ne Samsung Television a ne kɛse yɛ nsateakwaa 55, wɔde hyɛɛ Municipal Health Director, Madam Caroline Efah Otoo nsa.

Ebenezer Kojo Kum de Ghana Cedis Mpem Du, Ahanson Aduɔwɔtwe Awɔtwe(10,788) maa Sankor Senior High School a ɛwɔ ne mantam mu (Ahanta West Abatoɔ mpasua) sɛ wɔntɔ agyiraehyɛdeɛ board dumiɛnsa (13) a ɛwɔ graph.

Ebenezer Kojo Kum san dii bɔhyɛ bi a ɔhyɛɛ Kristofo Ɔsoro Asɔre a ɛwɔ Dixcove no so. Ɔde sika ntoboa a ɛyɛ GHS 5,400 maeɛ wɔ asɔre no nsrahwɛ mu ansa na afe 2020 amansan abatoɔ no reba de aboa Awurade adwuma. Eyi sii bere a Ɔsɔfo Panyin, Paul Essien hyɛɛ nkɔm sɛ obedi nkonim wɔ abatow no mu akyi.

title: Jennifer Nanaubuga Makumbi.
text:
Ɛbɛyɛ afe apem ahankron ne aduasia mu(1960s) na wɔwoo Jennifer Nanaubuga Makumbi.' Ɔyɛ Uganda- Amerika nwoma twerɛfoɔ na ɔsiase twerɛ nwoma nketewanketewa keka ho. Wɔyii no kaa nipakuo a wɔn mmɔndenmɔ sɛ ani wɔ nwomatwerɛ ho  siane bɔbɔɔ n'abaso ɛwɔ  ne nwoma a na ɛfa  'The Kintu Saga' ho a ɔtwerɛeɛ. Kwani nso ɛ?  Afe mpenu ne du mmiɛnsa(2013)  'Manuscript Project.  'Kwani Trust ɛwɔ afe mpenu ne du nam too nwoma no din 'Kintu' siane  de atwensɛm nwoma yi bɛtoo twa.  Nwumakuo bi sɔɔ n'asene maa ɔtwerɛɛ  ne nwoma 'Manchester Happened'  maa ɔde too dwa ɛwɔ afe mpenu ne du nkron mu(2019). Commonwealth Short Story Prize dwumadie a wɔdii no wɔ  afe aduonu ne du nan(2014) mu no, wɔyii ne nwoma 'Let's Tell This Story Properly''  kaa  nkorɔfokuo a wɔbɔɔ wɔn aba so no ho.  Ɔbɛyɛɛ Mpɔtamni nkonimdifoɔ ɛwɔ  Abibi man mu. Afe mpenu ne du nan(2014) Commonwealth Short Prize dwumadie no kɔɔ n'awieɛ no, wɔyii no sɛ ɔno na wɔabɔ ne ho mmɔden pa ara ɛwɔ dwumadie no mu.  Afe mpenu ne du nan(2014) Etisalat Prize for Literature nso wɔde ne din kaa ho bɔɔ n'abaso wɔ hɔ.  Ɔyɛ 'Creative Writing'  ɔkyerɛkyerɛni ɛwɔ  Lancastera Suapɔn no mu. . Wɔbɔɔ n'aba so bio  ɛwɔ Windham-Campbell Prize  ɛwɔ ɛsiane ne bɔsrɛmka ho nsɛm a na ɔtwerɛ ɛwɔ afe mpenu ne du nwɔtwe mu(2018).  Ɔde ne nwoma,"The First Woman ' nso nyaa Jhalak Prize akabasobɔdeɛ ɛwɔ afe mpenu ne aduonu baako mu(2021).Ɔne ne kunu,Damian ɛne be ba Jordan tenaa Manchester.

Abrabɔ ahyɛaseɛ ɛne sukuukorɔ 
Abrabɔ ahyɛaseɛ ne Sukuukorɔ. 

Wɔwoo Jennifer Nanaubuga Makumbi ɛwɔ Kampala a ɛwɔ Uganda man mu.Ɔno ne ba panin wɔ Anthony Kizito Makumbi mma mu. Ɛyɛ ba a ɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa ɛwɔ Evelyn Nnakalembe mma mu. N'awofoɔ ntam teteɛ berɛ a na wadi mfeɛ mmienu ɛna ɔne Elieza Makumbi a na ɔyɛ ne nana barima tenaa mfeɛ mmienu. 

Idi Amin amamuo abrɛ so no  ,wɔkyeree ne papa  a na ɔyɛ adwuma wɔ sikakorabea hyɛɛ no aniayaa Berɛ a wɔde ne nkwa kyɛɛ no no,ɔnyaa adwene mu haw ne nkwa nna nyinaa de kɔsii berɛ a ɔwuiɛ. Makumbi sewaa, Catherine Makumbi-Kulubya na ɔtetee no. Ahyɛaseɛ no,na ɔne n'abusua te Nakasero.Ɛyɛ kakra no, wɔkɔtenaa Kololo.

Ɔnyaa ne O-Level abɔdin krataa ɛwɔ Trinity College Nabbingo ɛna ne A-Levels nso, ɔnyaa B.A degree in English abɔdin krataa ɛwɔ King's College Budo. Ɔdɔɔ sukɔ ɛwɔ adekyerɛ mu a ɛfa kasa dwini ho ɛwɔ Brɔfo kasa mu ɛwɔ Islamic Suapɔn a ɛwɔ Uganda.  Ɔbɛyɛɛ atwerɛ mu samufoɔ saa supɔn no nwomadahɔ mu,IUIU Mirror no. Makumbi dii kan kyerɛɛ adeɛ ɛwɔ Nakasero Sukuu ntoasoɔ mu a ɛyɛ A-level sukuu. Ɔsiase kyerɛɛ adeɛ mfeɛ nwɔtwe ɛwɔ Hilside High  School. Ɛyɛ ankorankorɛ ntoasoɔ  sukuu a ɛwɔ Uganda.

Inta-sonu akansie a ɛkɔɔ so ɛwɔ Luganda no,ɔtwerɛɛ ahwɛgorɔ nwoma a ɔtoo ne din sɛ Sitaani Teyebase.Ɔde saa nwoma yi dii nkonim ɛwɔ akansie no mu maa ɔde kɔɔ aporɔ ɛwɔ SDA nsɔrensɔre ahodoɔ a wɔwɔ Kampala.  

Afe mpenu ne baako ɛwɔ Ɛbɔ bosome mu no, wɔgyee no sɛ suani ɛwɔ Manchester Metropolitan  University maa ɔkɔnyaa abɔdin krataa(MA) ɛwɔ Creative Writing .  Ɔwiee PhD ɛwɔ Creative Writing mu ɛwɔ Lancaster Suapɔn mu. Makumbi akyerɛ adeɛ ɛwɔ UK suapɔn ahodoɔ pii mu a na ɔrekyerɛ Brɔfo kasa ɛne  Creative Writing te sɛ deɛ ɔyɛ suapɔn kyerɛkyerɛni.N'atwerɛ dan Granda anum kasadwini adi pa ara ɛnkanka atesɛm a ɛfa gyidiehunu ho,abakɔsɛm a ɛfa nnipa titire bi ho, anansesɛm na kasa mmɛbuo ho.

Atwerɛ

title: Samuel Atta Akyea
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Samuel Atta Akyea (wɔwoo no 20 Ɔsanaa 1962) yɛ Ghana mmaranimfoɔ ne amanyɔni. Ɔyɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo (New Patriotic Party) a ɛwɔ Ghana no muni, ɔyɛɛ Ɔsoafo a ɔhwɛ Adwumayɛ ne Adan ho so (Minister for Works and Housing) kosii bosome Ɔpɛpɔn afe 2021, ne mprempren Mmarahyɛ Badwa no muni wɔ Akim Abuakwa Anafo Mmarahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa. Ɔyɛ onipa a ɔtɔ so mmienu (2) pɛ sɛ Ɔmampanyin Nana Akufo-Addo da nkyɛn a wɔapaw no sɛ saa Mmarahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa no Mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔɔ so anan no mu (4th Republic of Ghana).

Ne mmofraase abrabɔ ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo no wɔ Kyebi wɔ Ghana Apuei Fam mantam mu. Ɔkɔɔ Ghana Suapɔn, Legon (University of Ghana) na owiee sukuu no nyaa Bachelor of Arts abodin krataa wɔ Mmara ne Nyansapɛ mu (Bachelor of Arts degree in Law and Philosophy) wɔ afe 1989 mu. Ɔkɔɔ Ghana Mmara Sukuu mu (Ghana School of Law) na onyaa ne tumi krataa a ɔde yɛ adwuma (practising license) wɔ afe 1993 mu.

Adwumayɛ asetra 
Bere a owiee mmaranim sukuu (law school) no wɔde no yɛɛ adwuma sɛ ɔman mmaranimfo (state attorney) wɔ Mmaranimfo Panyin Dwumadibea (Attorney General's Department). Akyiri yi ɔde ne ho kɔbɔɔ ankorankoro mmara adwumayɛbea (private law firm), Akufo-Addo Prempeh & Co a ɛwɔ Nkran (Accra). Wɔ afe 1995 mu no, ɔde ne ho kɔbɔɔ ankorankoro mmara adwumayɛbea foforo, Zoe Akyea & Co., faako a wɔyɛɛ no ɔhokafo (partner) na ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ hɔ mfe dunan (14 years). Ogyaee kokoam mmara adwuma (private legal practice ) kosi akan (contest) wɔ afe 2008 Abuakwa Anafo (South) Mmarahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa abatoɔ no mu.

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Waware na ɔwɔ mma baasa (3) na ɔyɛ Kristoni. Ɔyɛ Amanaman Ntam Asɛmpa Asɔre (International Central Gospel Church) no muni.

Abasobɔdeɛ 
Atta Akyea nyaa Nobles Amanaman Ntam Abasobɔdeɛ firii Afrika Atɔe Fam Anuonyamfo Nhyiam foɔ nkyɛn. (West African Nobles Forum).

Akyinnyegye 
Wɔ bosome Ɔbɛnem afe 2022 mu no, nnipa a wɔwɔ Abuakwa Anafo Mmarahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa no pam no. Wɔkyerɛe sɛ wantumi anni (failed to honor) ne ɔsatu bɔhyɛ ahorow (campaign promises) a ɔde maa nkurɔfo no so.

Adɔeyɛ 
Wɔ bosome Ɔbɛnem afe 2020 mu no, ɔde ahotew ho nneɛma bi maa ne Mmarahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa wɔ ɔko a wɔreko atia COVID-19 ɔyaredɔm no mu.

Ntotoho

title: Rockson-Nelson Dafeamekpor
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Rockson-Nelson Etse Kwami Dafeamekpor yɛ Ghanani amanyɔni a ɔka Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtɔ so nson (7) no ho wɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4) no mu,  ɔno na ɔyɛ ananmusini de ma  Anafoɔ Dayi mmarahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa no so a wɔwɔ Volta mantam no mu.  Amannyɔkuo a ɔdɔm a ɛnam wɔn so maa ɔkɔpue mmarahyebadwam no ne Kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo National Democratic Congress. Ɔyɛ Ghanani amanyɔni a ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani a ogyina Anafoɔ Dayi Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa wɔ Volta Mantam mu. Ɔyɛ Ɔman Demokrasi Mmrahyɛ Badwa (National Democratic Congress) no muni.

Ne mmofraase abrabɔ ne nhomasua 
Dafeamekpor nyaa B.Sc. abodin krataa wɔ nsrahwɛ mu (B.Sc. degree in tourism) wɔ Cape Coast Suapɔn (University of Cape Coast) mu. Ɔsan nso wiee LL. B. wɔ Ghana Suapɔn (University of Ghana) mu. Ɔkɔɔ Ghana Mmara Sukuu (Ghana School of Law) mu baabi a ɔfatae sɛ Mmara Mmaranimfo (Barrister-at-Law).

Adwuma 
Ansa na ɔrebɛyɛ Mmrahyɛbadwani no, na Dafeamekpor yɛ Ɔpanyin a ɔne no yɛ adwuma (Senior Associate) wɔ Hayibor, Djarbeng ne Adwumakuo mmra adwumayɛbea a ɛwɔ Kokomlemle, Nkran (Accra) kurotia (suburb of Accra).

Amanyɔsɛm 
Berɛ a ɛdi kan a ɔde kɔɔ mmarahyɛbadwam hɔ yɛ afe mpem mmienu ne du nsia (2016) abatoɔ no mu na ɔdii nkunim. Berɛ a abatoɔ no nyinaa baa n'awieɛ no na wanya mma no mu ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu aduoson baako ne akyiripɔ aduanan nan (71.44%) afiri mma dodoɔ a wɔtoo no wɔ saa mpesua no so no.

wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne aduonu (2020) abatoɔ no mu no nso, ɔbɔɔ ne ho mmɔden dii nkunim bio, abatoɔ no baa n'awieɛ no na wanya mma no ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu aduoson mmienu ne akyiripɔ nson (72.7%).

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Dafeamekpor yɛ Kristoni na waware na ɔwɔ mma baanan (4).

Akwanhyia 
Wɔ Ɔsanaa bosome da ɛtɔ so dunan (14) afe 2021 mu no, wɔbɔɔ amanneɛ sɛ onyaa akwanhyia wɔ Aveyime kwan so wɔ Volta mantam mu. Wɔkyerɛe sɛ ne kar no kɔɔ fam mprenu bere a Kia lɔre bi twaa ne nanmusifo no na ɛbɔɔ ne kar no. Akyiri yi woyii no fii Asraafo Ayaresabea a ɛwɔ 37 (37 Military Hospital) no mu bere a wɔmaa no ayaresa no.

Ntotoho

title: Robert Wisdom Cudjoe
text:
Robert Wisdom Cudjoe yɛ Ghanani amannyɔni a ɔka Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a wɔtɔ so nson no ho wɔ Ghana kwasafoman a ɛtɔ so nan no mu, ɔno na ɔyɛ ananmusini de ma  Prestea-Huni Valley abatoɔ mpesua no so a wɔwɔ Atɔeɛ mantam no mu.  Amannyɔkuo a ɔdɔm a ɛnam wɔn so maa ɔkɔpue mmarahyebadwam no ne Kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo National Democratic Congress.

Ɔbra ahyɛaseɛ 
wɔwoo owura Robert Wisdom Cudjoe wɔ Ayɛwohomummɔ bosome no da a ɛtɔ so nsia (6 June) wɔ afe apem ahankron aduosia num (1965). Ɔfiri kuro a yɛfrɛ no Aboso Nsuaem a ɛwɔ Atɔeɛ mantam no mu wɔ ɔman Ghana. Ɔsane nso bɛyɛɛ mansini krakye panin de maa abatoɔ mpesua no so foɔ firi mfie mpem mmienu ne nwɔtwe mu (2008) de kɔ si afe mpem mmienu ne du nsia mu (2016).

Baabi a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Ebenezer Okletey Terlabi
text:
Ebenezer Oklety Terlabi (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn 3, 1963) yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɛfo na na ɔyɛ Ghana Apuei Fam Ɔmanpanyin abadiakyiri.[1] Ɔmanpanyin John Evan Atta Mills na ɔpaw no na ɔyɛɛ adwuma kɔsii Ɔpɛpɔn 2013. Mprempren ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔman Bammɔ sohwɛfoɔ abadiakyiri.

Ankorɛankorɛ 
Terlabi yɛ Kristoni (Pentekoste Asɔre). Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baasa.

Mfitiase asetena ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Terlabi wɔ Ɛbɔ 3, 1963. Ɔfiri Odumase-krobo, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Apueeɛ Mantam mu.[2] Ɔkɔɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so na onyaa ne Master of Philosophy abodin krataa wɔ biochemistry mu wɔ afe 2000 mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Terlabi yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛbadwa (NDC) no muni. Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔsii akan maa Lower Manya Krobo atenaeɛ no wɔ NDC mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nsia a ɛwɔ republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no tekiti so na ɔdii nkonim.

Adwuma 
Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo a ɔkyerɛ Biochemistry.

Easter Ɔmantam Soafoɔ Abadiakyiri, 2011 – Ɔpɛpɔn 7, 2013

title: Christian Corleytey Otuteye
text:
Christian Corleytey Otuteye (wɔwoo no Ahinime 23, 1973) yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ ne Ghana Ɔmanpanin a ɛtɔ so nnan Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson no muni a ɔgyina Sege mantam ananmu wɔ Nkran Kuropɔn Mantam mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Mfitiase asetena ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Otuteye wɔ Ɛbɔ 23, 1973, wɔ Sege, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Nkran Kuropɔn Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔkɔɔ Kaiserslautern Sukuupɔn, Germany na onyaa ne Master of Science abodin krataa wɔ Sikasɛm ho Nkontaabu mu wɔ afe 2004 mu.

Amammui mu adwuma 
Otuteye yɛ New Democratic Congress  (NDC) no muni. Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔsii akan maa Sege atenaeɛ no wɔ NDC mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nsia a ɛwɔ republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no tekiti so na ɔdii nkonim.[5] Wɔ afe 2020 Ghana abatoɔ mu no, ɔkɔɔ so kuraa Sege Abatoɔ mpasua mmarahyɛbadwa no mu.

N'asetena 
Otuteye yɛ Presbyteriani. Ɔwaree.

Adwumasɛm 
Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ wɔ Nkontaabuo dodoɔ, Akontaabuo ne Nhwehwɛmu akwan mu, Ghana Asoɛeɛ a ɛhwɛ Adwumayɛ ne Ɔmanfoɔ so, Nkran

Mmarahyɛbadwa no muni (Ɔpɛpɔn 7, 2013–mprempren; afe a ɛtɔ so mmienu)

title: Dominic Napare
text:
Dominic Napare (wɔwoo no Obubuw 3, 1960) yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ ne Ghana Mantam a ɛtɔ so nnan Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson no muni na ɔyɛ Ghana Aman a ɛtɔ so nnan Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe no muni a ɔgyina Sene Apueeɛ Mansin ananmu wɔ Bono Apueeɛ Mantam mu wɔ tekiti no so a ɛyɛ New Democratic Congress no.

N'asetena 
Napare yɛ Kristoni (Katolekni). Ɔwaree (ɔwɔ mma baanan).

Mfitiase Asetena Ne Nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Napare wɔ Obubuw 3, 1960. Ɔfiri Kajaji, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Bono Apueeɛ Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔkɔɔ Sukuupɔn a ɛhwɛ Nhomasua so, Winneba na onyaa ne Bachelor of Education abodin krataa wɔ Management ne Secretarial Studies mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Napare yɛ New Democratic Congress (NDC) no muni. Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔsii akan maa Sene Apueeɛ nkongua no wɔ NDC mmarahyɛ bagua a ɛtɔ so nsia a ɛwɔ ɔman a ɛtɔ so nnan no tekiti so na ɔdii nkonim.[2]

2020 abatoɔ

Wɔsan paw Napare sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani maa Sene Apuei wɔ 2020 December mmarahyɛbadwa abatow no mu. Wɔpaee mu kae sɛ odii nkonim wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa abatow no mu bere a onyaa abatow 13,401 a egyina hɔ ma 64.4% tiaa nea ɔbɛn no paa a ɔne New Patriotic Party kandifo Luchoun Nicholas Bitagan a na ɔwɔ abatow 7,424 a egyina hɔ ma 35.7% no.

Boayikuw 
Napare yɛ Ohia a Wɔtew So Ho Nhyehyɛe Boayikuw no Titenani Abadiakyiri; Aban Boayikuw no muni; Hokwan Boayikuw no muni;[8] na ɔsan yɛ Mpɔtam Aban ne Nkuraase Nkɔso Boayikuw no muni.

Adwumafa 
Ɔmantam Panyin (DCE) (Sene Apuei Mantam), 28 Ayɛwohomumɔ 2009 kɔsi 2012.

Mmarahyɛbadwa no muni (Ɔpɛpɔn 7, 2013 – mprempren; afe a ɛtɔ so mmienu).

Nhomasua ho ɔbenfo.

Adɔeyɛ 
Wɔ afe 2021 mu no, ɔde moto maa polisifoɔ adwumayɛbea 3 wɔ ne mantam mu.

title: Edward Abambire Bawa
text:
Edward Abambire Bawa (wɔwoo no Kwasida 1 Ɔpɛpɔn 1973) yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ a na ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanin Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson no muni na seesei ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanin a ɛtɔ so nnan Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so awotwe a ɔgyina Bongo Mansin a ɛwɔ Atifi Apueeɛ no ananmu Mantam mu wɔ Ghana wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Mfitiase asetena ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Edward Abambire Bawa na ɔfiri Bongo-Lungu wɔ Atsifi Epuei Mantam wɔ Ghana. Edward Abambire Bawa twaa ne Common Entrance Examination wɔ afe 1986 mu a ɛmaa ɔtumi nyaa ne Ordinary Level(O – Level) wɔ afe 1991 mu ne Advanced Level(A – Level) wɔ afe 1993. Edward Abambire Bawa kɔɔ so nyaa ne Bachelor of Education wɔ Chemistry mu wɔ University of Cape Coast, Ghana wɔ afe 2002 mu, Master of Business Administration wɔ Business Finance mu wɔ University of Liverpool wɔ afe 2007 mu, Certificate wɔ Development Communications mu wɔ afe 2012 mu, Certificate wɔ Risk Communications mu wɔ afe 2014. Ɔsan nyaa Postgraduate adansedi krataa a efi Harvard School of Public Health, Postgraduate adansedi krataa a efi University of Southern California ne Postgraduate adansedi krataa a efi Setym International.

Adwuma 
Edward Abambire Bawa yɛ Nkitahodiɛ Titenani ma Wiase Sikakorabea Dwumadie (Oil and Gas Capacity building Project) a ɛwɔ Petroleum Ministry a ɛwɔ Accra, Ghana. Edward Abambire Bawa reyɛ adwuma seesei sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani (MP) ma Bongo Mantam a ɛwɔ Atifi Apuei Manyam wɔ Ghana wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Amamyɔsɛm mu bra 
Edward Abambire Bawa sii akan na ɔdii nkonim wɔ afe 2016 NDC mmarahyɛbadwa mfitiaseɛ abatoɔ mu maa Bongo Mantam a ɛwɔ Atifi Apuei Mantam wɔ Ghana. Edward Abambire Bawa kɔɔ so dii nkonim wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa no mu wɔ ne mansin (Bongo Mantam) mu wɔ Atifi Apuei Mantam Ghana wɔ afe 2016 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so sɛ ɔbɛka Mmarahyɛ Bagua a ɛtɔ so nson (7) a ɛwɔ Fourth Republic of Ghana a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 18,442 (47.9%) tiaa Gabriel Nsoh Ade Agana a ɔfiri New Patriotic Party a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 6,800 (17.7%), Afari George A-Engbinge a ɔfiri Progressive People’s Party(PPP) a ɔno nso nyaa abatoɔ 12,932 (33.6%) ne Awillum Ebenezer Awine a ofi Convention People's Party(CPP) mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 295 (0.8%).

Edward Abambire Bawa san sii akan na odii nkonim wɔ afe 2020 NDC mmarahyɛbadwa primaries mu maa Bongo Abatoɔ Mpasua wɔ Atifi Apuei Mantam mu wɔ Ghana de abatow 590 tiaa Dr. Rainer Akumperigya a na ɔwɔ abatow 291 no.Edward Abambire Bawa san kɔɔ so dii nkonim wɔ afe 2020 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so sɛ ɔbɛkɔ akɔka Mmarahyɛ Bagua a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe (8) a ɛwɔ Fourth Republic of Ghana no ho a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 26,268 (57.7%) tiaa Ayinbisa Ayamga Peter a ɔfiri New Patriotic no mu Party a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 17,276 (37.9%), Afari George A-Engbinge a ɔfiri Progressive People’s Party(PPP) a ɔnyaa aba 1,548 (3.4%) ne Akamah Richard a ɔfiri Ghana Union Movement(GUM) a ɔnyaa aba 439 (1.0%) .

Wɔyii Edward Abambire Bawa fii mmarahyɛ bagua mu wɔ NDC Primaries mu na ankorankoro mmaranimfoɔ Mmaranimfo Charles Bawadua hwee no wɔ Kwasida, 13 May 2023 a ɛmaa ɔhweree ne mmɔdenbɔ sɛ wɔbɛsan apaw no akɔ Mmarahyɛbadwa no mu sɛ ɔmmɛgyina Bongo Mansin ananmu. Mmaranimfo Charles Bawadua dii nkonim wɔ abatow 535 mu, Edward Abambire Bawa nyaa abatow 509 na Avea Ephram Nsoh nso nyaa abatow 75.

Boayikuw 
Edward Abambire Bawa yɛ Ohia a Wɔtew So ho nhyehyɛe Boayikuw no muni. Ɔsan nso yɛ Fourth Republic of Ghana Mmarahyɛbadwa a Ɛto so Nwɔtwe (8) no Mines and Energy Committee no muni.

N'abrabɔ 
Edward Abambire Bawa yɛ Kristoni

Adɔeyɛ 
Edward Abambire Bawa de nsa (a ɛhɔnom gin "Kalahari bitters" ne "Akpeteshie" ) maeɛ de ko tia coronavirus(COVID-19) wɔ ne mansin (Bongo Constituency) mu wɔ Atifi Apuei Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Edward Abambire Bawa de ɔko a wɔreko atia Coronavirus wɔ ɔman no mu no kɔɔ baabi foforo.

title: Richard Kwame Sefe
text:
Richard Kwame Sefe yɛ Ghanani amannyɔni a ɔka Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a wɔtɔ so nwɔtwe no ho wɔ Ghana kwasafoman a ɛtɔ so nan no mu,  ɔno na ɔyɛ ananmusini de ma  Anlo abatoɔ mpesua no so a wɔwɔ Frao mantam no mu. Amannyɔkuo a ɔdɔm a ɛnam wɔn so maa ɔkɔpue mmarahyebadwam no ne Kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo National Democratic Congress. Wɔwoo Richard Kwame Sefe wɔ Ahinime bosome no da a ɛtɔ so du baako wɔ afe apem ahankron aduoson mmienu mu (born 11 October 1972)

Abatoɔ 
Wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne aduonu (2020) abatoɔ a wɔtoo no wɔ ɔman Ghana mu, ɔgyinaa sɛ wɔnto ne so aba ma ɔmmɛyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ Kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo National Democratic Congress din mu. Abatoɔ no nyinaa baa awieɛ no na wanya mma no mu dodoɔ no ara a ɛyɛ mpem aduasa mmienu, ahankron ne aduonu (32,920) a ɛnam so maa ɔtumi de dii nkunim. Ɔna na ɔbɛdii owura Clement Kofi Humado a na watena saa mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa firi ɔpɛpɔn bosome no mu wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne num (2005) no adeɛ.

Adɔeɛ ahodoɔ 
Wɔ ɛbɔ bosome no mu wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne aduonu baako (2021) mu no, Richard de nnoɔma ahodoɔ a ɛsombo na ɛboa adekyerɛ ne adesua kɔkyɛɛ mfitiaseɛ sukuu ahodoɔ a wɔwɔ  Anloga a ɛwɔ Volta Frao mantam no mu wɔ ɔman Ghana.

Baabi a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Rita Naa Odoley Sowah
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Rita Naa Odoley Sowah (wɔwoo no 2 Kitawonsa 1968) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni. Ɔyɛ Ɔman Demokrasi Mmrahyɛ Badwa (NDC) no muni Ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbadwani ma La Dade Kotopon Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa. Ɔyɛ Labadi kuromni wɔ Greater Accra Mantam mu, kan no na ɔyɛ Municipal Chief Executive (MCE) ma La Dade kotopon Municipal Assembly (LADMA) firi afe 2013 kosi afe 2017.

Ne mmofraase abrabɔ 
Wɔwoo Rita Naa Odoley Sowah wɔ 2 Kitawonsa 1968. Ɔyɛ Nkran ni na ɔyɛ La kuromni a wɔsan frɛ no Labadi wɔ Greater Accra Mantam wɔ Ghana.

Adwuma

Adwuma a ɔyɛe mfiase 
Sowah yɛɛ adwuma sɛ ɔkyerɛwfo (secretary) wɔ Premix Secretariat a ɛhyɛ Mpataayi Badwa a ɛwɔ Ghana (Fisheries Commission of Ghana) ase. Ɔsan nso yɛɛ adwuma sɛ Data Entry Officer wɔ Department of National Lotteries a seesei ɛyɛ National Lottery Authority wɔ Ghana ne sɛ ɔkyerɛwfo (secretary) wɔ La Dade Kotopon Mmarahyɛ Badwam no adwumayɛbea.

Kuropɔn Adwumayɛfo Panyin 
Ɔyɛɛ Municipal Chief Executive (MCE) a odi kan maa La Dade kotopon Municipal Assembly (LADMA) firi afe 2013 kosi afe 2017. Ɔsan nso yɛɛ Ɔman Fekuw a Ɛhwɛ Mpɔtam Hɔ Ghana so (National Association of Local Authorities of Ghana - NALAG) sikakorafoɔ (treasurer).

Amanyɔsɛm

Mmarahyɛ Badwa no mu mmɔdenbɔ 
Ɔtu mmirika kɔ NDC primaries sɛ wɔbɛpaw no sɛ wɔn candidate a ɔrekɔ 2020 abatoɔ no mu na odii nkonim.  Ɔyɛɛ abakɔsɛm sɛ ɔbaa a odi kan a odii nkonim wɔ La Dade-Kotopon mmarahyɛ badwa akongua no mu wɔ afe 2020 Mmarahyɛ Bagua abatoɔ no mu. Odii nkonim denam 47,606 a onyaeɛ a ɛgyina hɔ ma 53.67% bere a Joseph Gerald Tetteh Nyanyofio a ɔbɛn no paa a ɔfiri NPP no nyaa amba 41,101 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 46.33%..  Ɔyɛ mmaa aduanan (40) a wɔregyina wɔn Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa ananmu wɔ Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so nson (8) firi Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da a ɛtɔ so nson (7) afe 2021 no mu baako.

Mmarahyɛbadwani 
Sowah kaa ntam sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani a ogyinaLa Dade Kotopon Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa ananmu wɔ Ghana Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so awɔtwe (8) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4) mu wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da a ɛtɔ so nson (7) afe 2021. Ɔsom sɛ ɔmannifoɔ wɔ Mmabun, Agumadi ne Amammerɛ Boayikuo (member on the Youth, Sports and Culture Committee) ne Mmarahyɛ Badwa no Boayikuo a ɛfa Bɔbeasu ne Mmofra ho (Gender and Children Committee of Parliament).

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Sowah yɛ Kristoni.

Ntotoho

title: Edwin Nii Lante Vanderpuye
text:
Edwin Nii Lante Vanderpuye (wɔwoo no 11 Ayɛwohomummɔ 1965) yɛ Ghana agumadi ho nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo ne ɔmanyɛfo ne mprempren Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni wɔ Odododiodio mantam mu. Ɔyɛɛ ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Mmabun ne Agumadi so ne Ɔsoafoɔ Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Aguadi ne Nnwuma so wɔ John Dramani Mahama aban mu.

Nhomasua 
Ɔyɛ obi a wawie Bechem Presbyterian Mmarimaa Ntoaso Sukuu ne Mfantsipim Sukuu, Cape Coast.Ɔwɔ Master’s degree wɔ Governance & Leadership mu wɔ Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration (GIMPA) ne B.A. wɔ Borɔfo, Nyansapɛ ne Nneɛma a Wɔagye Din mu wɔ Ghana Sukuupɔn mu.

Adwuma 
Efi afe 1990 kɔsi afe 2004 no, ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ Ghana Broadcasting Corporation a ɔbɛyɛɛ Agumadiɛ Titenani Abadiakyiri. Wɔ afe 2005 ne 2008 ntam no, na ɔyɛ Agumadi so Panyin wɔ Network Broadcasting Limited.

Amanyɔsɛm adwuma 
Na ɔyɛ ɔboafoɔ titire ne adwumayɛ sohwɛfoɔ wɔ ɔmampanyin dibea wɔ kan Ghana Ɔmampanyin Mills ase na ɔsan nso yɛ kan Ɔmanpanyin Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Aguadi ne Nnwuma so wɔ John Mahama ase.

Mmarahyɛbadwa no mu ni 
Wɔpaw no sɛ MP wɔ afe 2012 abatoɔ no mu, faako a ɔne Victor Okaikoi a ɔfiri New Patriotic Party mu no hyiaeɛ. Vanderpuye nyaa ahotosoɔ yie wɔ hokwan a ɔwɔ sɛ ɔbɛdi nkonim no ho, na ɔgyee din sɛ ɔkaa wɔ Obubuo 2012 mu sɛ sɛ ɔnya abatoɔ a ɛnnu 65% a, ɔbɛma Okaikoi atenaeɛ no.Awiei koraa no, Vanderpuye dii nkonim denam asase a ɛhwee ase ketewaa bi so sen sɛnea na wɔhwɛ kwan no, na abatow 45,967 (63%) tiaa 26,269 (36%) maa Okaikoi na 745 (1%) maa Emmanuel Odoi a ofi Convention People’s Party mu.

Wɔ Ɔpɛnimma 2016 mu no wɔkoraa no sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwa no muni ma Odododiodio Mantam no mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 36,606 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 57.04% tiaa nea ɔbɛn no paa a ɛne New Patriotic Party a ne kandifoɔ, nyaa abatoɔ 26,671 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 41.56%.[ Ɔsom wɔ Mmarahyɛbadwa no mu sɛ ɔmannifoɔ a ɔdi kan wɔ Mpɔtam Aban ne Nkuraaseɛ Nkɔsoɔ Boayikuo mu ne sɛ ɔmannifoɔ wɔ Hokwan boayikuo ne Paw boayikuo no mu.

Ɔmanpanyin Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Mmabun ne Agumadi so 
Wɔ Ɔbenema 2013 mu no, wɔpaw no sɛ Ɔmanpanyin Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Aguadi ne Nnwuma so wɔ John Mahama aban ase. Ɔsomm wɔ saa dwumadie no mu kɔsii afe 2014 berɛ a wɔtuu no sɛ ɔnkɔsom sɛ Ɔsoafoɔ Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Mpɔtam Aban ne Nkuraaseɛ Nkɔsoɔ so wɔ baabi a ɔsom kɔsii afe 2015. Wɔ nsakraeɛ a ɛbaa asomfo mu wɔ afe 2015 mu akyi no, John Dramani Mahama bɔɔ Vanderpuye din sɛ Mmabun ne Agumadi ho Ɔsoafoɔ sɛ ɔmmɛsi Ɔbenfoɔ Mustapha Ahmed ananmu.

title: Richard Acheampong
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Richard Acheampong (wɔwoo no Kotonimma 18, 1970) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne Mmrahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so nson (7) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4) no muni a ogyina Bia Apueɛ Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa ananmu wɔ Atɔeɛ Mantam wɔ Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛ Badwa (National Democratic Congress) tekiti so.

Ne mmofraase abrabɔ ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Acheampong wɔ Kotonimma bosome da ɛtɔ so dunwɔtwe (18), afe 1970. Ofiri Adabokrom, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Atɔeɛ Mantam mu. Ɔkɔɔ Suapɔn Kɔlege a Ɛhwɛ Adwumayɛ Ho Adesua So (University College of Management Studies) a ɛwɔ Kumasi wɔ afe 2011 mu na ɛhɔ na onyaa ne bachelor’s abodin krataa wɔ Nnipa Nnwuma mu (bachelor's degree in Human Resource). Ɔsan nso kɔɔ Mountcrest Suapɔn Kɔlege (Mountcrest University College) a ɛwɔ Kanda-Accra wɔ afe 2016 mu na onyaa ne bachelor’s abodin krataa wɔ mmara mu (bachelor's degree in law).

Adwuma 
Na Acheampong yɛ sikakorabea dwumayɛni (banker). Ɔsan nso yɛɛ adwuma sɛ ɔpanyin boafo (assistant manager) wɔ Nfana Rural Bank Sampa.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Acheampong yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛ Badwa (NDC) no muni. Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔsii akan maa Bia Apueɛ nkongua no wɔ NDC mmarahyɛ badwa a ɛtɔ so nsia (6) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4) no tekiti so na ɔdii nkonim.

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Acheampong yɛ Kristoni (Onyankopɔn Nhyiam Asɔre - Assemblies of God Church). Waware a ɔwɔ mma baanum (5).

Akyinnyegye 
Wɔ bosome Oforisuo afe 2017 mu no, wɔkyerɛ sɛ British High Commission a ɛwɔ Ghana no bɔɔ Acheampong, George Boakye, Johnson Kwaku Adu, ne Joseph Benhazin Dahah soboɔ sɛ wɔboaa wɔn abusuafoɔ ma wɔhyɛn UK wɔ ɔkwan a mmara mma ho kwan so de wɔn diplomatic passport di dwuma. Ɔde ne diplomatic passport no nyaa akwamma visa maa ne hokafo maa adapɛn abien akwamma, ɔkɔɔ so traa UK bɛboro afe.

Ntotoho

title: Philip Basoah
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Philip Atta Basoah yɛ Ghana amanyɔni na ɔyɛ  Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so nson (7) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4)no muni a ogyina Kumawu Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa ananmu wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo (New Patriotic Party) no tekiti so.

Ne mmofraase abrabɔ 
Wɔwoo Philip wɔ Obubuo bosome da ɛtɔ so dunwɔtwe (18), afe 1969, na owui Memeneda, Ɔbɛnem bosome da etɔ so aduonu nson (27), afe 2023. Ofiri Kumawu a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

Nhomasua 
Onyaa master’s abodin krataa wɔ Paris sukuu a wɔawie a ɛhwɛ adwumayɛ so (Paris graduate school of management) wɔ afe 2012 mu na ɔsan nso nyaa Bachelor of Arts wɔ Cape Coast Suapɔn mu (University of Cape Coast, Ghana) wɔ afe 2000 mu. Ɔsan nso nyaa ne A level adansedie krataa (GCE Advanced level) wɔ afe 1994 mu ne ne O level adansedie krataa (GCE Ordinary level) wɔ afe 1991 mu ne ne MLSC wɔ afe 1986 mu.

Adwuma 
Na ɔyɛ nnwuma sohwɛfo ma Ghana Nhomasua Dwumadibea (Ghana Education Service) wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu. Ɔsan nso yɛ Ɔmantam Panyin wɔ Mpɔtam Aban Dwumadibea (Ministry of Local Government) ma Sekyere Apueɛ Mansin (Sekyere East District) firi bosome Ayɛwohomumɔ afe 2005 kosi bosome Ɔpɛpɔn afe 2009 mu. Na ɔyɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ wɔ Agogo Ntoaso Sukuu (Agogo Senior High School).

Amanyɔsɛm adwuma 
Na ɔyɛ NPP muni ne mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔhwɛ Kumawu Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa so wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu. Wɔ afe 2016 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu no, odii nkonim wɔ mmarahyɛ badwa no mu a onyaa amba 21,794 a ɛyɛɛ 78.2% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu bere a NDC mmarahyɛ badwa mu ɔkannifoɔ Emmanuel William Amoako nyaa amba 5,899 a ɛyɛ 21.2% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu bere a CPP mmarahyɛ badwa mu ɔkannifoɔ Opoku Kyei Clifford nyaa amba 188 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 0.7%. Wɔ afe 2020 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu no, ɔdii nkonim wɔ mmarahyɛ badwa no mu a onyaa amba 14,960 a ɛyɛɛ 51.1% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoo no nyinaa mu bere a NDC mmarahyɛ badwa mu ɔkannifoɔ Bernard Opoku Marfo nyaa amba 2,439 a ɛyɛɛ 8.3% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu bere a mmarahyɛ badwa mu ɔkannifoɔ Duah Kwaku a ɔde ne ho (independent) nyaa 11,698 abatoɔ a ɛyɛɛ 40% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu na GUM mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ Nana Amoako nyaa amba 174 a ɛyɛɛ 0.6% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu.

Boayikuw ahorow 
Na ɔyɛ Adwumayɛ (Employment), Asetena mu Yiedie (Social Welfare) ne Ɔman Nnwuma Boayikuo (State Enterprises Committee) no Titenani (Chairperson) na ɔsan yɛ Asase ne Kwaeɛ Boayikuo no muni  member of Lands and Forestry Committee) na ɔsan yɛ Boayikuo a Wɔpaw Nipa no muni (member of the Selection Committee).

Adɔeyɛ 
Wɔ bosome Oforisuo afe 2021 mu no, ɔde nteteeɛ nnwinnadeɛ maa adwumfo (artisans) a wɔwɔ Kumawu Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa mu de boaa mmabun (youth) no ma wɔanya nimdeɛ (employable skills) a wɔbɛtumi ayɛ adwuma.

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Na ɔyɛ Kristoni.

Owuo 
Basoah wui wɔ Ɔbɛnem bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nson (17), afe 2023, na na wadi mfeɛ aduonum anan (54).

title: Peter Yaw Kwakye-Ackah
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Peter Yaw Kwakye-Ackah (wɔwoo no 15 Ayɛwohomumɔ 1957) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so nson (7) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4) no muni a ogyina Amenfi Mfinimfini Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa ananmu wɔ Atɔeɛ Mantam mu wɔ Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛ Badwa (National Democratic Congress) tekiti so.

Ne mmofraase abrabɔ ne nhomasua 
Kwakye-Ackah fi Manso-Amenfi. Ɔwɔ MBA wɔ Po so Mfiridwuma mu (MBA in Marine Engineering) wɔ Leicester Suapɔn (Leicester University) a ɛwɔ UK ne Adesuakuw a edi kan Po so Mfiridwuma wɔ South Glamoorgan Asoɛe a Ɛhwɛ Nhomasua a Ɛkɔ Anim (1st Class Marine Engineering South Glamoorgan Institute of Higher Education) a ɛwɔ Cardiff, Wales.

title: Muhammad Bawah Braimah
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Alhaji Muhammad Bawah Braimah yɛ Ghana amanyɔni na ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so nson (7) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansi n a ɛtɔ so anan (4) no muni a ogyina Ejura-Sekyedumase Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa ananmu wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛ Badwa (National Democratic Congress) tekiti so.

Ne mmofraase abrabɔ 
Wɔwoo Braimah wɔ 28 Obubuo 1959 na ofiri Kulungugu wɔ Upper East Region wɔ Ghana. Ɔkɔɔ Tamale Ntoaso Sukuu a na ɛwɔ na onyaa ne O Level adansedie krataa (GCE Ordinary Level). Onyaa ne MBA wɔ Ntotoeɛ mu (MBA in Management) wɔ Almond Asoɛe (Almond Institute).

Adwuma 
Braimah yɛ NADMO Kuropɔn Ntamgyinafoɔ (Municipal Coordinator for NADMO) firi afe 2009 kosi afe 2013 na akyiri yi ɔbɛyɛɛ Kuropɔn no sohwɛfoɔ panin (Municipal Chief Executive) maa Ejura-Sekyedumase Kuropɔn Nhyiamu (Ejura-Sekyedumase Municipal Assembly) firi afe 2013 kosi afe 2016. Ɔsan nso yɛ Mubabra Adwumakuw a Wɔahyehyɛ (Mubabra Company Limited) a ɛwɔ Ejura no Ntotoeɛ sohwɛfoɔ (Managing Director).

Amanyɔsɛm 
Braimah yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi Nhyiam Kuw (National Democratic Congress) no muni na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma Ejura-Sekyedumase Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Wɔ afe 2016 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu no, Braimah nyaa amba 23,277 dii nkonim wɔ mmarahyɛ badwa no mu bere a NPP mmarahyɛ badwani Mohammed Salisu Bamba nyaa amba 21,795. CPP ɔpɛfoɔ Abdalla Mahawan Sani nso nyaa amba 132 bere a PNC ɔpɛfoɔ Laari Samuel nyaa amba 83. Wɔ afe 2020 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu no, ɔsan dii nkonim wɔ mmarahyɛ badwa atenaeɛ no mu nyaa amba 30,056 bere a NPP mmarahyɛ badwa mu ɔkannifoɔ Mohammed Salisu Bamba nyaa amba 25,009. CPP ɔpɛfoɔ Adams Hussein nso nyaa amba 119 bere a PNCɔpɛfoɔ Laari Samuel nyaa amba 53.

Boayikuw ahorow 
Braimah yɛ Ɔmanfoɔ Akontaabuo Boayikuo  (Public Accounts Committee) no muni na ɔsan yɛ Defense ne Interior Committee no muni.

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Braimah yɛ Nkramoni.

Animuonyamhyɛ 
Ejura Mmabun a Wɔhaw Wɔn no (Concerned Youth of Ejura) hyɛɛ Braimah anuonyam wɔ mmɔden a ɔbɔe wɔ nhomasua a ɛkɔ anim wɔ mpɔtam hɔ no ho.

title: Peter Nortsu-Kotoe
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Peter Kwasi Nortsu-Kotoe (wɔwoo no 6 Kotonimma 1956) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so nson (7) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4) no muni a ogyina Akatsi Atifi Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa ananmu wɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛ Badwa (National Democratic Congress) tekiti so.

Ne mmofraase abrabɔ 
Wɔwoo Nortsu-Kotoe wɔ Kotonimma bosome da ɛtɔ so nsia (6) afe 1956. Ofiri Kpeduhoe wɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

Nhomasua 
Nortsu-Kotoe yɛ obi a wawie Ghana Suapɔn (University of Ghana) a wanya abodin krataa wɔ Borɔfo kasa mu (bachelor of degree in English). Ɔwɔ nkɔsoɔ ho nimdeɛ a ɛsen biara (master of development management) wɔ Ghana Asoɛeɛ a ɛhwɛ adwumayɛ ne ɔmanfoɔ so (Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration)..

Adwuma 
Nortsu-Kotoe yɛ nhomasua ho ɔbenfoɔ (educationist) wɔ n’adwuma mu. Na ɔyɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ (tutor) wɔ Accra Academy na ɔyɛ Ghana Nhomasua Dwumadibea (Ghana Education Service) no kwankyerɛfoɔ boafoɔ (assistant director) wɔ dibea mu..

Adwumafa 

 Ghana Nhomasua Dwumadibea (Ghana Education Service) - (ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo (tutor), Accra Adesuabea(Accra Academy), Bubiashie-Accra / Ɔkwankyerɛfo Boafo(Assistant Director)[7]

 Ɔmantam Panyin (District Chief Executive) - (Akatsi Mansin / Akatsi Anafoɔ Mantam(Akatsi South District), Oforisuo, 2009 – Ɔpɛpɔn 6, 2013[7]

 Mmrahyɛbadwamni (Ɔpɛpɔn 7, 2013 – mprempren; afe a ɛtɔ so mmienu)[7]

Amanyɔsɛm 
Nortsu-Kotoe yɛ Ɔmantam Panyin wɔ Akatsi Mansin ne Akatsi Anafoɔ Mansin mu firi bosome Oforisuo afe 2009 kosii sɛ ɔhyɛnee mmrahyɛ badwa mu wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da ɛtɔ so nson (7) afe 2013. Wɔpaw no sɛ ɔmmɛgyina Akatsi Atifi Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa ananmu wɔ Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛ Badwa (National Democratic Congress) tekiti so wɔ afe 2012 Ghana ɔsahene no mu abatow a wɔpaw. Wɔ afe 2016 mu no, wɔsan paw no sɛ ɔmmɛgyina Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa no ananmu mfeɛ anan (4) a ɛdi hɔ no wɔ mmrahyɛ badwa mu..

N'asetra mu 
Nortsu-Kotoe aware a ɔwɔ mma baasa (3). Ɔkyerɛ sɛ ɔyɛ Kristoni na ɔyɛ Evangelical Presbyterian Asɔre, Ghana no muni..
