title: Peter Lanchene Toobu
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Peter Lanchene Toobu (wɔwoo no 8 Ayɛwohomumɔ 1968) yɛ Ghana polisini ne amanyɔni a wakɔ pɛnhyen a ɔyɛ Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛ Badwa (National Democratic Congress) no muni. Ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma Wa Anafoɔ Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Upper West mantam mu. Ɔyɛ Polisifoɔ Panyin a wakɔ pɛnhyen wɔ Ghana.

Ne mmofraase abrabɔ ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Toobu wɔ Ayɛwohomumɔ bosome da a ɛtɔ so awɔtwe (8) afe 1968. Ofiri Jirapa a ɛwɔ Atifi Atɔe Mantam wɔ Ghana. Onyaa ne ntoaso sukuu adesua wɔ Lawra Ntoaso Sukuu (Lawra Secondary School) a ɛwɔ Lawra wɔ Atifi Atɔe Mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana. Wɔtetee no sɛ Polisini wɔ Ghana Polisifoɔ Adesuabea (Ghana Police Academy). Ɔwɔ Master of Arts abodin krataa wɔ Akannifoɔ mu (Master of Arts degree in Leadership) wɔ Kofi Annan Amanaman Ntam Asomdwoeɛ Nteteeɛ Beaeɛ (Kofi Annan International Peacekeeping Training Centre).

Adwuma 
Toobu yɛɛ adwuma wɔ Ghana Polisifoɔ Dwumadibea (Ghana Police Service) na ɔforo kɔɔ Polisifoɔ Panyin dibea (Superintendent of Police) ansa na ɔrekɔ pɛnhyen (retiring). Ɔyɛɛ Ɔkyerɛwfoɔ Panyin (Executive Secretary) maa kan Polisifoɔ Panyin (ormer Inspector General - IGP) David Asante Apeatu firi afe 2017 kosii sɛ ɔgyaee adwuma na ɔgyaee (resigned) adwuma no sɛ ɔrekɔ Amanyɔsɛm mu wɔ afe 2019 mu.

Amanyɔsɛm

Mmarahyɛ Badwa no mu mmɔdenbɔ 
Toobu dii nkonim wɔ mmarahyɛ badwa no mu sɛ ɔbɛgyina Ɔman Demokrasi Nhyiam Kuw (National Democratic Congress) ananmu ama Wa Anafoɔ Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa ansa na afe 2020 abatoɔ no aba wɔ bosome Ɔsanaa afe 2019 mu akyi a onyaa amba 775 de dii mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔwɔ hɔ seesei kan Ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Mpɔtam Aban so Joseph Yieleh Chireh a onyaa amba 317 na wasom no so nkonim sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani fi afe 2004.

Ansa na afe 2020 Amansan abatoɔ no reba no wɔpaw no sɛ Ɔman Demokrasi Nhyiam Kuw (National Democratic Congress) Kasamafoɔ wɔ Bammɔ mu (Security) na wɔtee no wɔ radio ne television dwumadibea ahorow so sɛ ɔreka nhyehyɛe ahorow a n’apam no wɔ a ɛfa ahobammɔ ho ho asɛm.

Wɔ bosome Ɔpɛnimma afe 2020 mu no, Toobu dii nkonim wɔ Wa Anafoɔ Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa atenaeɛ no mu wɔ mmarahyɛ badwa abatoɔ no mu. Odii nkonim denam abatoɔ 27,550 a ɔde tiaa nea ɔne no reko paa, Dari Daniel Kuusongno a onyaa amba 13,143 firii abatoɔ 40,829 a wɔtoo no nyinaa mu.

Mmarahyɛbadwani 
Wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da a ɛtɔ so nson (7) afe 2021 mu no, Toobu kaa ntam sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani a ogyina Wa Anafoɔ Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa ananmu wɔ Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so awɔtwe (8) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4) no mu. Ɔsom sɛ Asɔremma a Wɔkura Mfaso Boayikuw no Dwumadibea ahorow (Members Holding Offices of Profit Committee) ne Mmarahyɛ Badwa no Bammɔ ne Mfinimfini Boayikuw (Defence and Interior Committee) no muni.

Wɔ Oforisuo bosome da a ɛtɔ so nsia (6) afe 2021 mu no, ɔde adesrɛ kɔtoo Mmarahyɛ Badwa no Kasafo (Speaker of Parliament), Alban Bagbin sɛ ɔntwe Ɔmanpanin no adwene nkɔ nsɛm a ɛfa ahobammɔ ho na onni ahobammɔ a enni hɔ a ɛrenya nkɔanim wɔ Ghana mu no ho dwuma. Ɔkyerɛɛ akodeɛ a wɔde korɔn wɔ ne Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa, Wa Anafoɔ ne mmeaeɛ a atwa ho ahyia firi Sissala Apueɛ kosi Bawku Atɔeɛ.

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Toobu yɛ Kristoni.

Ntotoho

title: Andrew Egyapa Mercer
text:
Andrew Kofi Egyapa Mercer (wɔwoo no 25 Kɔtonima 1973) yɛ Ghana mmaranimfoɔ ne ɔmanyɛfo. Ɔyɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni. Ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwa no mu ni a ɔdi tumi seesei ma Sekondi Mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Atɔeɛ Mantam mu. Odii Papa Owusu-Ankomah a na ɔyɛ MP mfeɛ aduonu.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Andrew Kofi Egyapa Mercer wɔ Sekondi wɔ Ghana Atɔeɛ Mantam mu maa James Mercer a ɔyɛ Ghana mmaranimfoɔ ne ɔmanpanyin. Ɔkɔɔ Chapel Hill Ahosiesie Sukuu a ɛwɔ Takoradi maa ne mfitiaseɛ adesua. Ɔkɔɔ Adisadel College a ɛwɔ Cape Coast, faako a ɔnyaa ne GCE Ordinary level ne GCE Advanced level adansedie nkrataa nyinaa.Onyaa kwan kɔɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu, na ɔnyaa Honors wɔ Bachelor of Arts wɔ Humanities ne Bachelor of Laws mu. Ɔsuaa adeɛ wɔ Ghana School of Law na ɔfata sɛ mmaranimfoɔ wɔ Ghana berɛ a ɔtwaa ne bar sɔhwɛ no akyi.

N'adwuma titir 
Egyapa Mercer hyɛɛ n’adwuma asetena ase sɛ osuani wɔ Messrs. Acquah-Sampon and Associates, adwumakuo a ɛyɛ mmaranimfoɔ a ɛwɔ Accra wɔ afe 2004. Ɔde ne ho kɔbɔɔ First Atlantic Bank wɔ Accra wɔ afe 2007 mu sɛ adwuma sohwɛfoɔ boafoɔ na ɔkɔɔ anim bɛyɛɛ mmara dwumadibea no panyin. Bere a ɔwɔ First Atlantic no, ɔsii akan na ɔdii nkoguo wɔ afe 2011 Mmarahyɛ Bagua primaries a ɛfa New Patriotic Party a ɛwɔ Sekondi no anim wɔ Papa Owusu-Ankomah a ɔdi tumi seesei no anim.Ɔgyaee adwuma wɔ afe 2013 mu sɛ ɔrekɔhyehyɛɛ Messrs. Mercer and Company, nnwumakuw ne sikasɛm ho mmara adwumayɛbea a ɛwɔ Accra.

Amanyɔsɛm asetena 
Egyapa Mercer dii kan hyɛn akuw amammuisɛm mu wɔ afe 2011 mu bere a ɔsii akan wɔ Sekondi Constituency NPP mmarahyɛ bagua primary no mu. Ɔne nnipa baanu foforo a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔyɛ saa no sii akan: ɔmanpanyin a na ɔwɔ hɔ saa bere no, Owusu Ankomah, ne Kweku Sam Amoah. Ɔhweree primary no maa Owusu-Ankomah. Ɔsii gyinae sɛ ɔbɛsan asi akan wɔ 2016 mmarahyɛbadwa abatoɔ no mu bio wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so. Eyi sii bere a saa bere no Mmarahyɛbadwa no muni Owusu-Ankomah sii gyinae sɛ ɔrensi akan wɔ nkongua a odii nkonim mpɛn anum a ɛtoatoa so no akyi. Egyapa Mercer de ne nkrataa kɔmaa mfitiaseɛ abatoɔ no wɔ May 2015 mu na ɔsii akan a obiara antia no wɔ afe 2015 mfitiaseɛ abatoɔ no mu.

Mmarahyɛfoɔ abatoɔ 
Egyapa Mercer hyɛɛ ne ɔsatuo ase wɔ 14 Ɔbɛnem 2016 wɔ Sekondi. Wɔ bere a wɔrefi ase no, akasafo ahorow a Alan John Kyerematen ka ho tuu aman a wɔpaw no no fo sɛ wɔntow aba mma Egyapa Mercer ne Nana Akuffo-Addo sɛ wɔn mmarahyɛbadwani ne wɔn titrani. Ansa na December 2016 abatoɔ no reba no, wɔhyehyɛɛ dwumadiɛ ahodoɔ bi de kyerɛɛ wɔn a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔpaw wɔn ahodoɔ no kyerɛɛ wɔn a wɔpaw no. Eyinom mu biako ne amansin ho akyinnyegye a wɔyɛ maa amammui akuw ahorow no mufo ahorow a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔpaw wɔn wɔ Sekondi Methodist Park no. Egyapa Mercer dii nkonim wɔ mmarahyɛ bagua abatow no mu denam Emmanuel Assifuah a ofi National Democratic Congress, Daniel Essuman a ofi Progressive People’s Party, ne Peter Arthur a ofi Convention People’s Party mu a odii nkonim no so. Egyapa Mercer nyaa abatow 16,839, a egyina hɔ ma abatow a ɛfata nyinaa mu 59.47%.

Mmarahyɛbadwa no mu ni 
Sɛ́ Mmarahyɛbadwa no muni no, Egyapa Mercer ne wɔn a wɔpaw no no dii nkitaho denneennen na odii bɔ ahorow a ɔhyɛe wɔ ɔsatu kwan no so no so. N’ayeforohyia ahorow no bi ne kɔmputa ahorow anum a wɔde di dwuma wɔ pon so ne nneɛma a wɔde boa a ne bo yɛ U.S. dɔla 4,000 a ɔde maa Sekondi Nhomakorabea no. Na eyi bɛma nkyerɛkyerɛ ne adesua atu mpɔn wɔ amansin no mu.Ɔsan nso boa ma wɔtuaa ɛka a Sekondi Eleven Wise, Division 1 league kuo a ɛwɔ amansin no mu, de GH₵5,000 de mae no; afoforo a wɔboa no tuaa GH₵1,300 a aka no de tuaa officiating fees.

title: Elizabeth Ofosu-Adjare
text:
Elizabeth Ofosu-Adjare (wɔwoo no Ɔbenem 1, 1974) yɛ Ghana mmaranimfoɔ ne ɔmanyɛfoɔ a ɔyɛɛ Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ Nsrahwɛ, Amammerɛ ne Adebɔ Adwini so. Ɔmampanyin John Mahama na ɔpaw no wɔ saa dibea yi mu wɔ afe 2013 mu bere a ɔhyehyɛɛ n’aban a edi kan a ɛyɛ nokware no. Ɔyɛ Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni. Mprempren ɔyɛ Ghana Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛto so 8 no muni a ogyina Techiman North Constituency ananmu.

Mfitiase Asetena Ne Nhomasua 
Mrs. Elizabeth Ofosu-Adjare yɛ mmeawa du a n’awofo woo wɔn no mu nea ɔto so abiɛsa, owufo Hon Adjei-Mensah yɛ mmaranimfo, aguadifo ne Amanyɔfo ne Awuraa Adjei-Mensah yɛ aguadifo. Ɔkɔɔ St Monica's Secondary School wɔ Mampong, Kumasi baabi a ɔnyaa ne O & A level adansedie nkrataa mmienu no nyinaa. Afei Elizabeth Ofosu-Adjare kɔɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so wɔ hɔ a onyaa Bachelor of Arts wɔ Social Science mu. Ɔtoaa so kɔɔ Ghana Suapɔn, Legon kɔyɛɛ adesua foforo wɔ Mmara mu na onyaa nidi wɔ LLB mu wɔ afe 2002. Akyiri yi onyaa abodin krataa wɔ mmara mu wɔ afe 2004 mu.

Adwuma 
Mrs. Elizabeth Ofosu-Adjare hyɛɛ ne mmara adwuma ase wɔ Holy Trinity Chambers a ɛwɔ Kumasi, Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ afe 2004 mu na ɔsɔre bɛyɛɛ Firm no hokafoɔ. Ɔsan bɛyɛɛ mmaranimfo maa Mmaranimfo Mmoa Nhyehyɛe a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu no. Ɔayɛ Multi Trust Financial Company a ɛwɔ Kumasi no board member firi afe 2004 de bɛsi nnɛ. Mprempren ɔyɛ Federation Commodities Limited adwumakuo no mu ni.

Wɔde no kɔɔ Tema Oil Refinery Boayikuo no mu wɔ afe 2009 mu na ɔdii dwuma firi afe 2009 kɔsi afe 2013. Elizabeth Ofosu-Adjare yɛ wɔpaw no wɔ 1 March 2013 denam Ɔmampanyin John Dramani Mahama so sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ Ministry of Tourism, Culture & Creative Arts a wɔayɛ no foforo/wɔasan ayɛ no foforo.

Amanyɔsɛm adwuma 
Sɛ́ Ministry of Tourism, Culture & Creative Arts

Wɔpaw Ofosu-Adjare wɔ 1 Ɔbenem 2013 denam President John Dramani Mahama de kɔma Ministry of Tourism, Culture & Creative Arts a wɔabɔ/asan ayɛ no foforo. Sɛ́ Sector Minister no, ɔne Agencies dunan (14) a ɛwɔ ne som adwuma ase no yɛɛ adwuma a ɛfata sɛ wɔde nsrahwɛ nhyehyɛe foforo,a ɛyɛ foforo bae sɛ nea wɔde kaa Ghana Tourism products & Offerings ho.

ExploreGhana project 
Worthy of mention is the ExploreGhana project launched in 2014 to stimulate na ɛma ɔman no mu nsrahwɛfo kɔ Ghana. Mfeɛ mmiɛnsa akyi a wɔde sii hɔ no, ɔman no mu nsrahwɛ anya nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfoɔ & ahyehyɛdeɛ a wɔka ho asɛm kɛseɛ. Enti wɔrehwɛ sɛ ɔman no rehyɛ ''Responsible Tourism'' a ɛde nsrahwɛ ho nneɛma ahorow a wɔde afrafra ma, a mpɔtam hɔ ne amanaman ntam nsrahwɛfo nyinaa nya so mfaso.

Ɔman Afahyɛ a ɛfa Adwinni & Amammerɛ ho 
Atetesɛm afahyɛ titiriw foforo a wɔde bae ne Homogeneous Afahyɛ ma Ga Man no. Nea edi kan wɔ Ghana no, ɔsom adwuma no hwɛɛ Homogeneous Afahyɛ yi so sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a Greater Accra Region no benya n’ankasa brand afahyɛ. Ɔsan nso hyehyɛɛ Ɔman Afahyɛ a ɛfa Adwinni ne Amammerɛ ho (NAFAC)[8] ne Ghana Carnival a agye din a wɔde bae wɔ n’afe a edi kan wɔ n’adwuma mu no.[9] Wɔsan nso de anuonyam ma no sɛ ɔhyehyɛɛ Tourism levy secretariat sɛ ɛbɛboa ama wɔatu mpɔn wɔ 1% Tourism levy no a wɔboaboa ano & wotua ho. Saa toɔ yi ama wɔanya sika kɛseɛ a wɔde bɛyɛ nsrahwɛ adwuma titire wɔ beaeɛ a ɛfa tumi a wɔde bɛhyɛ ne nsrahwɛ ho nkɔsoɔ mu.[10]

Film Bill 
Wɔyɛɛ Awuraa Ofosu-Adjare nkɔsoɔ foforɔ wɔ beaeɛ a mmarahyɛ bagua bi boa adwuma a adebɔ Arts adwumayɛkuw no yɛ. Ɔdii anim ma wɔpenee Film Bill a ɛfaa cabinet mu na Mmarahyɛ Bagua no penee so sɛ ɛbɛyɛ mmara. Saa mmara foforɔ yi besii Sini Mmara dedaw a ɛwɔ afe 1961 mu no ananmu na ɛno ne berɛ a ɛdi kan a wɔde mmara foforɔ a ɛte saa baeɛ de hwɛɛ sɛ Sini ne Television adwumakuo no bɛnya mmara kwan so mmoa a ɛhia paa wɔ Ghana.

Seychelles Akikɔ Akwantuo 
Ɔdii Aban Nnanmusifoɔ a wɔwɔ tumi kɛseɛ anim ma wɔkaa Ashanti Ahemman hene, Asantehene Otumfuo Osei Tutu II sanba ho kɔɔ Seychelles Nsupɔ so baabi a wɔsomaa Ashanti Hene, Nana Prempeh I kɔɔ nnommumfa mu wɔ berɛ a Ashanti-British ɔko wɔ afe 1900. Ɛyɛ bere a edi kan a Ashanti King a ɔte ase akɔsra Seychelles Islands.[12][13]

Amanaman ntam dwumadi ahorow 
Wɔ Amanaman Ntam gyinabea no, wadi Ghana nsrahwɛ adwuma no anim denam daa ne ho adi wɔ major no mu Nsrahwɛ ho guasodeyɛ ne ɔyɛkyerɛ ahorow te sɛ Wiase Akwantu Guadi, Amanaman Ntam Nsrahwɛ Bourse (ITB), FITUR Amanaman Ntam Akwantu Fair, Vakantiebeurs Ahomegye Fair, & China Outbound Nsrahwɛ & Akwantu Guadi (COTTM). Wɔntɔn Ghana da wɔ amanaman ntam firi mfeɛ mmiɛnsa a atwam a ɔde yɛɛ Sector Minister.

Ɔbɔɔ ne yɔnko African Ministers & the top echelons of the United Nations World Tourism Organization (UNWTO) sɛ wɔnnya Ghana yɛ Brand Africa nhyiamu a ɛdi kan koraa wɔ Accra wɔ Oforisuo 2015 mu.[15] Ne agye din ne dwumadie a ahoɔden wom wɔ Amanaman Ntam Nsrahwɛ ho nsɛm mu no boaa Ghana ma wɔpaw no sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ Amanaman Nkabom Nsrahwɛ kuo no Executive Council wɔ ne UNWTO Nhyiamu a ɛtɔ so aduonu baako wɔ Medellin Colombia.[16]

Boayikuo 
Ɔyɛ Akwahosan Boayikuo no muni na nso ɔyɛ Appointments Committee no muni.[17]

Ankorankoro asetena 
Ɔware Owura Lawrence Ofosu-Adjare. Ɔyɛ owufoɔ Isaac Kwadwo Adjei-Mensah babaa, a ɔsom sɛ Nsuo, Adwumayɛ ne Adan ho Ɔsoafoɔ wɔ Rawlings aban berɛ mu, na na ɔsan yɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni ma Techiman North baabi a mprempren ɔyɛ MP

title: Elvis Morris Donkoh
text:
Elvis Morris Donkoh (wɔwoo no 25 Ɔgyefo 1983) yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ a na ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanin Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson no muni na seesei ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanin a ɛtɔ so nnan Mmarahyɛbadwa no muni a ɔgyina Abura-Asebu-Kwamankese Mansin ananmu wɔ Mfinimfini Mantam wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Elvis Morris Donkoh wɔ 25 Ɔpɛpɔn 1983 na ɔfiri Cape Coast wɔ Central Region of Ghana. Elvis Morris Donkoh nyaa ne Diploma (Youth In Development Work) wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu wɔ afe 2008 mu ne Post Graduate Diploma (Project and Quality Management) wɔ Business University of Costa Rica wɔ afe 2016 mu.

Adwuma 
Elvis Morris Donkoh yɛ Alliance for Youth Development no kwankyerɛfo panyin. Mprempren ɔreyɛ adwuma sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwa no muni (MP) ma Abura-Asebu-Kwamankese Mantam a ɛwɔ Mfinimfini Mantam wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so.

Amanyɔsɛm Mu Nsɛm 
Elvis Morris Donkoh sii akan na odii nkonim wɔ 2016 NPP mmarahyɛbadwa no mfitiaseɛ a wɔde bɛma Abura-Asebu-Kwamankese Mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Mfinimfini Mantam mu. Elvis Morris Donkoh kɔɔ so dii nkonim wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa atenaeɛ a ɛwɔ ne mansin (Abura-Asebu-Kwamankese Mansin) mu wɔ Mfinimfini Mantam wɔ Ghana wɔ afe 2016 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so sɛ wɔbɛka Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson (7) a ɛwɔ... Fourth Republic of Ghana a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 22,245 (50.7%) tiaa Samuel K. Hayford a ɔfiri National Democratic Congress a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 20,508 (46.7%), Clement Abaidoo a ɔfiri Progressive People’s Party (PPP - Ghana) a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 1,054 (2.4%) ne Kwame Edu Ofori a ofi Nnipa Ɔman Nhyiamu (PNC - Ghana) a ɔno nso nyaa abatoɔ 116 (0.3%).

Elvis Morris Donkoh san sii akan na dii nkonim wɔ afe 2020 NPP mmarahyɛbadwa mu abatow mu maa Abura-Asebu-Kwamankese Mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Mfinimfini Mantam mu no de abatow 475 tiaa Kobina Nyanteh a na ɔwɔ abatow 220 no.[18][19][20][21] Elvis Morris Donkoh san kɔɔ so dii nkonim wɔ afe 2020 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so sɛ ɔbɛkɔ akɔka Mmarahyɛ Bagua a Ɛto so Nwɔtwe (8) a ɛwɔ Fourth Republic of Ghana no mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 25,048 (49.2%) tiaa Felix Ofosu Kwakye a ɔfiri National Democratic Congress a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 24,872 (48.8%) ne Francis Eghan a ɔfiri Ghana Union Movement (GUM) a ɔno nso nyaa abatoɔ 1,001 (2.0%).

Boayikuo 
Elvis Morris Donkoh yɛ Ɔpanyin Abadiakyiri) wɔ Mines and Energy Committee no mu. Ɔsan nso yɛ Privileges Committee no muni ne saa ara nso na Aguadi, Nnwuma ne Nsrahwɛ Boayikuw a ɛwɔ Mmarahyɛbadwa a Ɛto so Awotwe (8) a ɛwɔ Ghana Aman a Ɛto so Anan no mu.

Ankorankoro asetena 
Elvis Morris Donkoh yɛ Kristoni na ɔyɛ Seventh Day Adventist Asɔre (SDA) no muni.

title: Emmanuel Kwasi Bedzrah
text:
Emmanuel Kwasi Bedzrah yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson a ɛwɔ Ghana Republic of the Fourth Republic no muni a ɔgyina Ho West Abatoɔ Mpasua ananmu wɔ Firaw Mantam mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Bedzrah wɔ 28 Kɔtonima 1967. Ɔfiri Tsitso-Awudome, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Firaw Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Onyaa ne diploma sɛ Chartered Surveyor wɔ Ghana Institute of Surveyors. Ɔsan nso nyaa ne Construction Technicians Certificate I (CTC I) firii Takoradi Polytechnic ne Bachelor of Science abodin krataa wɔ Administration mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu. Ɔwɔ master's degree wɔ Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration (GIMPA).

Adwuma ne amammuisɛm 
Ansa na ɔrehyɛn amammuisɛm mu no, na Bedzrah yɛ adwumayɛni panin wɔ Procurement na Project Management Consultancy.

Wɔpaw no sɛ ɔmmɛgyina Ho West amansin ananmu wɔ afe 2008 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu. Ɔwɔ mmarahyɛ bagua mu firi 7 Ɔpɛpɔn 2009. Wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa mu no, wasom wɔ boayikuo ahodoɔ mu, a ebi ne; Adwuma ne Adan Boayikuo, ne Daa Ahyɛdeɛ Boayikuo.

Wɔ afe 2021 mu no, Bedzrah ne Alexander Kwamena Afenyo-Markin, Abdul-Aziz Ayaba Musah, Johnson Kwaku Adu ne Laadi Ayii Ayamba boom wɔkaa ntam wɔ ECOWAS Mmarahyɛbadwa no Nhyiam Kɛseɛ 2021 a ɛsiiɛ wɔ Freetown wɔ Sierra Leone no mu.

N'asetena Mu 
Bedzrah aware na ɔwɔ mma baanan. Ɔda ne ho adi sɛ ɔyɛ Kristoni

title: Patrick Yaw Boamah
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Patrick Yaw Boamah (wɔwoo no afe 1974) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne Mmrahyɛ Badwa a Ɛtɔ so Nson (7) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so nnan no muni a ogyina Okaikwei Mfinifini Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa (Okaikwei Central Constituency) ananmu wɔ Greater Accra Mantam wɔ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforɔ (New Patriotic Party) no tekiti so.

Ne mmofraase abrabɔ ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Boamah wɔ Ɛbɔ bosome da ɛtɔ so dunkron (19) afe 1974. Ofiri Mourso-Effiduase, wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Onyaa ne bachelor of laws ne master’s degree wɔ Amanaman Ntam Nsɛm mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu (University of Ghana) wɔ afe 2004 ne afe 2005 mu. Akyiri yi ɔkɔɔ Ghana Mmara Sukuu mu (School of Law) baabi a onyaa ne mmaranimfo abodin krataa (barrister-at-law degree) wɔ afe 2009 mu.

Adwuma 
Boama yɛ mmaranimfo (lawyer) wɔ n’adwuma mu. Ansa na ɔrehyɛn amanyɔsɛm mu no, na ɔyɛ Ɔboafoɔ (Associate) wɔ Sam Okudzeto ne Associates mmara adwumayɛbea (Sam Okudzeto and Associates law firm).

Amanyɔsɛm 
Boamah kɔɔ mmarahyɛ badwa mu wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da ɛtɔ so nson (7) afe 2013 wɔ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo (New Patriotic Party) a ogyinaa Okaikwei Mfinifini Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa (Okaikwei Central Constituency) ananmu no tekiti so. Wɔsan paw no wɔ afe 2016 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu sɛ ɔmmɛgyina Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa no ananmu mprenu a ɛtoatoa soɔ.

Wɔ mmarahyɛ badwa mu no, wasom wɔ boayikuw ahorow mu, a emu bi ne; Mmarahyɛ Boayikuw a Ɛka Ho (Subsidiary Legislation Committee), Atemmu Boayikuw (Judiciary Committee), ne Amannɔne Nsɛm Boayikuw (Foreign Affairs Committee).

Ɔsii akan wɔ afe 2020 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu sɛ mmarahyɛ badwa mu kandifoɔ ma Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo (New Patriotic Party) na ɔdii nkonim.

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Boama aware a ɔwɔ mma baanu (2). Ɔkyerɛ sɛ ɔyɛ Kristoni na ɔyɛ Methodist Asɔre a ɛwɔ Ghana no muni.

Ntotoho

title: Patrick Banor
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Patrick Banor yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne ɔhwɛfoɔ. Ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma Asutifi Atifi Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa firi Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da ɛtɔ so nson (7) afe 2021.[1]

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Banor Fida wɔ Ayɛwohomumɔ bosome da ɛtɔ so dummiɛnsa (13) afe 1975 wɔ Kenyasi No.2.[1] Onyaa ne Mfitiase Nhomasua Adansedi Krataa (Basic Education Certificate) wɔ afe 1991 mu, ne ne Ntoasoɔ Sukuu Adansedi Krataa (Secondary School Certificate) wɔ afe 1994 mu.[1] Wɔmaa no ne Bachelor of Arts abodin krataa wɔ Asetra mu nsɛm ho adesua ne Asetra mu Adwuma (Bachelor of Arts degree in Sociology and Social Work) wɔ afe 2009 mu.[1]

Adwuma ne amanyɔsɛm 
Ansa na ɔrekɔ amanyɔsɛm mu no, na ɔyɛ Sarfpok Company Limited (Sarfpok Adwumakuw a Wɔahyehyɛ) no sohwɛfo panyin (General Manager).[1] Wɔ afe 2020 NPP mmarahyɛ badwa primaries mu no, Banor ne Evans Bobie Opoku sii akan wɔ Asutifi Atifi Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa nkongua no ho na odii nkonim.[2] Wɔ afe 2020 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu no, Banor ne Ebenezer Kwaku Addo a ofiri NDC, ne Kofi Annan a ofiri GUM sii akan wɔ Asutifi Atifi nkongua no ho. Onyaa amba 18505 a ɛgyina hɔ ma abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoo no nyinaa mu 52.62% tiaa Addo abatoɔ 16546 ne Anane abatoɔ 116, a ɛgyina hɔ ma abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 47.05% ne 0.33%.

Boayikuw no 
Patrick yɛ Mmarahyɛ Boayikuw a Ɛka Ho (Subsidiary Legislation Committee) no muni na ɔsan yɛ Efie boayikuw (House Committee) no muni.[1]

N'asetra mu 
Patrick yɛ Kristoni.[5]

Adɔeyɛ 
Wɔ bosome Ɛbɔ afe 2020 mu no, Patrick maa nnipa 1,348 a wɔrehwehwɛ BECE no akontaabuo nhyehyɛeɛ (mathematical sets).[6]

Wɔ bosome Ɔsanaa afe 2021 mu no, ɔde bɛyɛ 400 desk maa Ola Girls' SHS.[7]

title: Emmanuel Adjei Anhwere
text:
Emmanuel Adjei Anhwere, (MP) (Ɛbɔ 20, 1962) yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson a ɛwɔ Ghana Ɔmanpanin a ɛtɔ so nnan ne Ghana Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so awotwe mu, a ɔgyina hɔ ma nnipa a wɔwɔ Atwima-Nwabiagya South abatoɔ mpasua so wɔ  Ashanti mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Anhwere wɔ 20 Ɛbɔ 1962 na ɔfiri Asante Mampong wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Onyaa BBA wɔ University of Education Winneba, wɔ afe 2010. Ɔkɔɔ Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology baabi a ɔnyaa CEMBA (Public administration ) wɔ afe 2015.

Adwuma ne amammuisɛm 
Wɔ afe 2016 mu no, Anhwere gyinaa tekiti a ɛfa Ɔman Ho Kuw Foforo no ho a wɔbɛpaw no sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwa no muni wɔ Fourth Republic mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛto so ason no mu. Odii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ 48,264 a ɛfiri abatoɔ 58,313 a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ no mu, a ɛgyina hɔ ma 83.15% berɛ a nea ɔne no reko titire wɔ National Democratic Congress (NDC) tekiti so Nana Asare Bediako, nyaa 9,780, a ɛgyina hɔ ma 16,85%. Ɔkuraa n’akongua so wɔ afe 2020 Amansan abatoɔ no mu sɛ ɔbɛgyina n’amanfoɔ ananmu wɔ Fourth Republic Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so awotwe mu. Ɛde kɔsii sɛ wɔpaw no wɔ afe 2016 mu no, na ɔyɛ Senior Quality Control Officer wɔ COCOBOD baa dwumadibea a ɛwɔ Kumasi.

N'asetena 
Emmanuel yɛ ɔbarima warefo a ɔwɔ mma baanum. Ɔyɛ Kristoni na ɔne Anglikan asɔre no som.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Patrick Boakye-Yiadom
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Patrick Boakye-Yiadom yɛ Ghana amanyɔni na ɔyɛ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4) no Mmarahyɛ Badwaa a ɛtɔ so Nson (7) ne Ghana Aman Mmarahyɛ Bagua a Ɛtɔ so awɔtwe (8) no muni a ɔde Obuasi Apueeɛ Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu no gyina hɔ wɔ Ɔman Ho Kuo Foforo (New Patriotic Party) no tekiti so. 2][3]

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Patrick wɔ Obubuo bosome da ɛtɔ so mmienu (2) afe 1976 na ofiri Obuasi wɔ Ashanti mantam mu. Ɔwiee ne mfitiaseɛ wɔ afe 1988 ne ne BECE wɔ afe 1991. Ɔsan nyaa ne SSSCE wɔ afe 1994. Ɔsan nyaa ne bachelor’s wɔ Nyansahu mu abodin krataa wɔ Nnipa Abɔde a Nkwa Wom Ho Adesua mu (bachelor's in Science degree in Human Biology) wɔ afe 2000. Akyiri yi onyaa ne MBChB wɔ Aduruyɛ Ho Ɔbenfo Panyin (MBChB in General Medical Practitioner) mu wɔ afe 2003. Ɔyɛ KNUST sukuuni wɔ afe 2003 Adesuakuw a ɛwɔ Aduruyɛ Nyansahu Sukuu mu (2003 Class of the School of Medical Science).[4]

Adwuma 
Patrick yɛ Aduruyɛ ho Ɔkwankyerɛfoɔ Abadiakyiri (Deputy Medical Director) ma Bryant Mission Ayaresabea (Bryant Mission Hospital) a ɛwɔ Obuasi.[1][5] Ɔyɛ oduruyɛfo (medical doctor).[6]

Amanyɔsɛm adwuma 
Patrick yɛ NPP muni na mprempren ɔyɛ Obuasi Apueeɛ Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu no MP.[5][7][8]

N'asetra mu 
Patrick yɛ Kristoni.[5]

Adɔeyɛ 
Wɔ afe 2020 mu no, Patrick de mpa bɛyɛ aduonu (20) maa ayaresabea anan (4) a ɛwɔ Obuasi Apueeɛ Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa mu.[13][14]

Wɔ Ɔsanaa bosome 2022 mu no, ɔde popcorn mfiri, deep freezers,mfiri a yɛde yɛ (fufu pounding machine) ne fango nkotokuo (charcoal) bi maa PWDfoɔ a wɔwɔ Obuasi Apueɛ Mansin.[15][16]

title: Kwaku Afriyie
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu Kwaku Afriyie yɛ Ghana amanyɔni, okuafoɔ ne New Patriotic Party no muni wɔ Ghana. Ɔyɛ Ghana Atɔeɛ Mantam soafoɔ firi afe 2017 kɔsi afe 2018. Ɔmanpanyin Nana Addo Danquah Akuffo-Addo na ɔpaw no wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2017 mu na Mmarahyɛbadwa no mufoɔ penee so wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2017 mu.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Kwaku Afriyie wɔ Kitawonsa 7, 1954 wɔ Sefwi Wiawso. Ɔwɔ MB CBH wɔ University of Ghana Medical School ne Master of Public Health wɔ Tulane University, New Orleans, US Ɔsan nso yɛ Ghana College of Physicians and Surgeons yɔnko.

title: Kwaku Agyenim Boateng
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu Kwaku Agyenim-Boateng (wɔwoo no 1 Obubuo 1972) yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ na ɔyɛ Ghana Aman a ɛtɔ so nnan Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson no muni a ɔgyina Berekum West mantam ananmu wɔ Brong-Ahafo Mantam mu wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so.

Nhomasua 
Ɔnyaa ne Bachelor of Science abodin krataa wɔ Nhyehyɛeɛ mu wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma mu wɔ afe 1997. Ɔkɔɔ ne Masters of Science wɔ Ɔmanfoɔ Nhyehyɛeɛ ne Adwumayɛ mu wɔ London Suapɔn mu wɔ afe 2008. Ɔsan nso wɔ Post Graduate Certificate wɔ Mmara mu wɔ Anglia Ruskin Suapɔn mu, wɔ UK 2004 ne LLB (GIMPA) wɔ afe 2014 mu.

Mfitiaseɛ nkwa 
Wɔwoo Boateng wɔ 1 Obubuo 1972, wɔ Jinijini kuro mu wɔ Bono Ɔmantam, afei Brong Ahafo Mantam.

Amanyɔsɛm adwuma 
Boateng yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo (NPP) no muni.Wɔdii kan paw no sɛ ɔmmra Mmarahyɛbadwa no mu wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2009 mu wɔ berɛ a ɔdaa ne ho adi sɛ ɔdi nkonim wɔ afe 2008 Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ no mu. Afei wɔsan paw no sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛto so 6 ne 7. Odii n’asɔretiafoɔ no so nkonim wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata nyinaa mu 56.33% wɔ afe 2016 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no akyi. Ɔsan dii nkonim wɔ afe 2020 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 11,245 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoo no nyinaa mu 47% berɛ a NDC mmarahyɛbadwani Dickson Kyere-Duah nyaa abatoɔ 10,296 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 43% na Independent kandifoɔ bi Derrick Obeng Mensah nyaa abatoɔ 2,395 10% wɔ abatow a wɔtow nyinaa mu. Na ɔyɛ kan Ɔmanpanyin Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Keteke Nkɔsoɔ so.

Boayikuo 
Ɔyɛ Adwumayɛ, Asetena mu Yiedie ne Ɔman Nnwuma Boayikuo no muni na ɔsan yɛ Ohia a Wɔbɛtew Ho Nhyehyɛeɛ Boayikuo no mu ni.

Adwuma 
Boateng yɛɛ adwuma sɛ nkɔsoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ ne Mmara dwumadie ho Ɔfotufoɔ firi1998 kɔsi afe 2008.

N'abrabɔ 
Boateng yɛ Kristoni.

Adɔeɛ 
Wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2020 mu no, ɔhyɛɛ sɛ wɔnyɛ awoɔ dan na ɔde aduruyɛ nneɛma maeɛ ma Nkyekyemamu Akwahosan Asoɛe a ɛwɔ Berekum Atɔeɛ Mantam mu. Ɔsan nso de ayaresabea mpa, afiri a wɔde kari nneɛma, adwumayɛbea nkongua, television ne nea ɛkeka ho maa Amankwokwa Community-based Health Planning and Services.

Ngyinasoɔ

title: Ophelia Hayford
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu Ophelia Mensah Hayford yɛ Ghana Amanyɔfoɔ. Osii akan wɔ afe 2020 Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ mu na Odii nkonim wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa no mu maa Mfantsiman Mansin.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Hayford wɔ 29 Ahinime 1973 na ofiri Akwapim-Akropong wɔ Ghana Apueeɛ Mantam mu. Onyaa ne Bachelor’s degree wɔ Political Science ne Linguistics mu wɔ afe 2012. Ɔsan nyaa ne LLB. wɔ Nsɛmmɔnedi Mmara mu; Amanaman Ntam Nnipa Hokwan Mmara ne Adwumayɛ Mmara wɔ afe 2018 mu.

Adwuma ne paw a wɔpaw 
Ophelia yɛ Assistant superintendent of Police(ASP). Na ɔyɛ Inspector panyin wɔ Ghana Polisifo Dwumadibea. Ophelia Hayford nso ne Interpol Unit a ɛwɔ CID Asafo ti no yɛɛ adwuma. Ophelia bɛkaa Ghana Polisifoɔ ho wɔ afe 1993 mu sɛ obi a wɔagye no. Na efi saa bere no, wasom wɔ ɔsom adwuma no mu mfe 27.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Hayford yɛ New Patriotic Party no muni. Na ne kunu a wawu, Ekow Hayford yɛ mmarahyɛbadwani muni ma Mfantsiman Mantam no. Bere a ne kunu wui bere a na ɔresom wɔ dibea mu akyi no, osii gyinae sɛ obesi n’ananmu sɛ mmarahyɛbadwa no muni ma Mfantsiman Mantam no. Sɛ́ Assistant Superintendent wɔ Ghana Polisifoɔ Dwumadibea no, ɔde ne tender sɛ ɔbɛgyae adwuma sɛdeɛ afe 1992 Amanyɔ Mmara no hwehwɛ sɛ ɔbɛtumi asi akan wɔ abatoɔ no mu.

2020 abatoɔ 
Wɔ Ɔpɛnimma 2020 mu no, wɔpaw no sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwa no muni ma Mfantsiman Mansin akyi a osii akan wɔ 2020 Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ mu wɔ New Patriotic Party tekiti ase na ɔdii nkonim. Ɔnyaa abatoɔ 36,091 a ɛyɛ 51.83% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu. Wɔpaw no sen James Essuon a ofi National Democratic Congress ne Alijatu Ibrahim a ofi Ghana Union Movement mu. Eyinom nyaa abatow 32,379 ne 911 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne 46.76%, ne 1.31% yɛ pɛ wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu.

Boayikuw 
Hayford yɛ oguamtrani Abadiakyiri ma Defense ne Interior Committee na ɔsan yɛ House Committee no muni.

N'asetena 
Ɔyɛ  Ekow Hayford a wanya ne baebi akɔ yere. Ɔwɔ mma baanu. Ɔyɛ Kristoni.

title: Nicholas Amankwah
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa muNicholas Amankwah' yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɛfo a ɔyɛ National Democratic Congress no muni. Ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwa no muni ma Amenfi Apueeɛ Mantam a ɛwɔ Atɔeɛ mantam mu.

Adwuma 
Amankwah yɛɛ Ɔmantam Panyin (DCE) maa Wassa Amenfi Apueeɛ Mantam Nhyiamu seesei Wassa Amenfi Apueeɛ Kuropɔn Bagua firi afe 2016 to 2017.

Amanyɔsɛm

Mmarahyɛbadwani 
Amankwah hyɛn akansi a ɛfa mmarahyɛbadwani no ho wɔ National Democratic Congress primaries wɔ Amenfi East abatoɔ mpɛsua ansa na afe 2020 abatoɔ no reba. Wɔkamfoo no wɔ Ɔsanaa 2019 mu akyi a ɔkɔɔ so kasa tiaa no wɔ National Democratic Congress primaries mu a ɛmaa ɔyɛɛ NDC kandifoɔ ma Amenfi East abatoɔ mpɛsua.

Wɔ Ɔpɛnimma 2020 mu no,Ghansah dii nkonim wɔ atenaeɛ no mu maa Amenfi East Constituency wɔ parliamentary elections mu wɔ abatoɔ akyi Abatoɔ 36,215 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 53.90% tiaa nea ɔbɛn no paa, Edward Amo-Acquah a ɔfiri New Patriotic Party a na ɔwɔ abatoɔ 29,954 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 44.58%.

Ansa na wɔreyɛ abatoɔ no, wɔ 4 Obubuo 2020 no wɔbɔɔ amanneɛ wɔ radio ne... television so sɛ adwowtwafo a wokurakura akode tow hyɛɛ no ​​so wɔ ne fie wɔ Wassa Akropong.

title: Chenjerai Hove
text:
Chenjerai Hove (Ɔgyefoɔ da ɛtɔ so nkron afe apem aha nkron aduonum nsia (Ɔgyefoɔ 9,1956) kosi  Kitawonsa da ɛtɔ so du mmienu afe mpem mmienu ne du nnum (Kitawonsa 12, 2015), yɛ Zimbabweni anwensɛm twerɛfoɔ, ayɛsɛm twerɛfoɔ ne  sɛntwerɛfoɔ a ɔde Brɔfo Kasa ne Shona Kasa na edi dwuma. Hove ayɛsɛm ahodoɔ a ɔtwerɛeɛ no, aboa nnɛɛmafoɔ berɛ a wɔretwerɛ nsɛm pɔ titriw bi ho asɛm nanso wɔde nsɛm a yɛde yɛn ano ka redi dwuma na aboa ma wɔtumi yɛ nhwehwɛmu a ɛmu dɔ wɔ adwene ne asetra mu de fa nnipa a wɔte nkuraaseɛ ɛnkanka Fahodie Ntɔkwa mmerɛ mu wɔ Zimbabwe. Kitawonsa da ɛtɔ so du mmienu afe mpem mmienu ne du nnum (Kitawonsa 12, 2015) wɔtwaa no asu kɔɔ Norway na mmerɛboɔ mu yareɛ bɔɔ no maa no wuiiɛ.

Abrabɔ Mu Nsɛm 
Wɔwoo Chenjerai Hove a ɔyɛ ɔhene ba barima wɔ Mazvihwa a ɛbɛn Zvishavane a kane no na wɔfrɛ no Rhodesia. Ɔkɔɔ sukuu wɔ Kutama Kɔlegye ne Marist Brothers Dete a ɛwɔ Zimbabwe man no mansini a ne din de Hwange mu. Ɔsuaa adeɛ wɔ Gweru wieɛ no, ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ na ɔtoaa so gyee nwomasua abɔdin ahodoɔ wɔ South Africa Suapɔn ne Zimbabwe Suapɔn mu. Ɔsane nso yɛɛ adwuma sɛ sɛntwerɛfoɔ na ɔboaa ma wɔtwerɛɛ anwensɛm wɔato din, "Seisei deɛ Awenensɛm Atwerɛfoɔ no Akasa" deɛ Brɔfo Kasa mu yɛka no, "And Now the Poets Speak". Na ɔtaa tintim nsɛm wɔ kowaa krataa wɔato din The Zimbabean a ɛkasa tia aban no a wɔyɛɛ no afe mpem mmienu ne nnum (2005) mu.

Ɛsiane sɛ na ɔyɛ obi a ɔkasa tia Mugabe aban no nti, wɔtwaa Hove asu wɔ ne wu mmerɛ mu berɛ a na ɔwɔ House of Culture a ɛwɔ Stavanger, Norway, nhyehyɛɛ a ɛka International Cities of Refuge Network (ICORN) ho. Ansa saa bere yi, na ɔwɔ hokwan a yɛde srasra Lewis ne Clark Kɔlegye ne Brown Suapɔn; na ɔsane nso yɛ awensɛm twerɛfoɔ a ɔte fie wɔ Miami. Nneɛma a Chenjerai Hove ayɛ no, wɔakyerɛ ase akɔ kasa ahodoɔ bi te sɛ Japan Kasa, German Kasa ne Dutch Kasa mu. N'asetena nyinaa mu no, ɔnyaa abasobɔdeɛ ahodoɔ pii a ebi ne " 1989 Noma Award for Publishing in Africa."

Nneɛma a Wɔatwerɛ 

Chenjerai Hove tintiim ayɛsɛm, awensɛm ne ntwerɛw ahodoɔ ne nsusuiiɛ. Nneɛma ɔtwereɛ no bi ne:
 And Now the Poets Speak (co-editor; poetry), 1981
 Up In Arms (poetry), Harare: Zimbabwe Publishing House, 1982
 Red Hills of Home (poetry), 1984; Gweru: Mambo Press, 1985.
 Bones (novel), Harare: Baobab Books, 1988; Heineman International AWS, 1989. ISBN 0-435-90576-7
 Shadows (novel), Harare: Baobab Books, 1991; Heinemann International Literature and Textbooks, 1992. ISBN 0-435-90591-0
 Shebeen Tales: Messages from Harare (journalistic essays), Harare: Baobab Books/London: Serif, 1994
 Rainbows in the Dust (poetry), 1997
 Guardians of the Soil (cultural reflections by Zimbabwe's elders), 1997. ISBN 0-908311-88-5
 Ancestors (novel), 1997. ISBN 0-330-34490-0
 Desperately Seeking Europe (co-author; essays on European identity), 2003
 Palaver Finish, atwerɛ ahodoɔ a ɛfa amanyɔsɛm ne abrabɔ wɔ Zimbabwe, 2003
 Blind Moon (poetry), 2004. ISBN 1-77922-019-7
 The Keys of Ramb (children's story), 2004

Abasobɔdeɛ Ahodoɔ 
Deɛ ɛdidisoɔ yi yɛ abasobɔdeɛ ahodoɔ a Chenjerai Hove nyaeɛ: 
 1983 Special Commendations for the Noma Award for Publishing in Africa, for Up in Arms
 1984 Inaugural President, Zimbabwe Writers Union
 1988 Winner, Zimbabwe Literary Award, for Bones
 1989 Winner, Noma Award for Publishing In Africa, for Bones
 1990 Founding Board Member, Zimbabwe Human Rights Association (Zimrights)
 1991–94 Writer-in-Residence, University of Zimbabwe, Zimbabwe
 1994 Visiting Professor, Lewis ne Clark Kɔlegye, Portland, Oregon, USA
 1995 Guest Writer, Yorkshire ne Humberside Arts ne Leeds Suapɔn, UK
 1996 Guest Writer, Heinrich Böll Foundation, Germany
 1998 Second Prize, Zimbabwe Literary Award, for Ancestors
 2001 German Africa Prize for literary contribution to freedom of expression
 2007-08 International Writers Project Fellow, Brown Suapɔn

title: Osei Bonsu Amoah
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Osei Bonsu Amoah (wɔwoo no Ɔsanaa 15, 1961) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so nson (7) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4) no muni na ogyina hɔ ma nnipa a wɔwɔ Akwapim Anafoɔ Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa mu wɔ Ghana Apuei Mantam mu wɔ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo (New Patriotic Party) frankaa ase.1][2][3][4][5]

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Amoah wɔ Ɔsanaa bosome da a ɛtɔ so dunum (15), afe 1961. Ofiri Aburi, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Apuei Mantam mu.[6] Odii ne ntoaso sukuu mfeɛ no wɔ Prempeh Kɔlege a agye din no mu na onyaa ne Nyansahu mu Bachelor abodin krataa wɔ mmara mu (Bachelor of Science degree in law) wɔ Ghana Suapɔn(University of Ghana) mu wɔ afe 1985 mu.[6] Wɔ Ghana Mmara Sukuu mu no onyaa Mmara abodin krataa (Bachelor of Law degree) wɔ afe 1995 mu.[6]

Amanyɔsɛm adwuma 
Ɔyɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo (New Patriotic Party) no muni.[7] Mprempren ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani ma Akwapim Anafoɔ Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa.

Adwumafa 
Ansa na wɔrepaw no sɛ mmarahyɛ badwa no, Amoah yɛɛ adwuma sɛ Towtua Ho Nhwehwɛmufo (Inspector of Taxes), IRS wɔ afe 1988 ne afe 1996 ntam hɔ. Wɔpaw no sɛ Mmoa Titiriw, Ɔmanpanyin no Dwumadibea, na ɔsomm firi afe 2001 kosi afe 2005.[6]

Ntɛm ara na wɔpaw no sɛ Ɔsoafoɔ Abadiakyiri wɔ Nhomasua Mmabun ne Agumadi Dwumadibea (Ministry of Education Youth and Sport), na ɔsomm firi afe 2005 kɔsi afe 2008.[6]

N'asetra mu 
Ɔda ne ho adi sɛ ɔyɛ Kristoni, na waware ne yɔnko mmaranimfo na wɔwɔ mma baasa (3).[6]

title: Emmanuel Marfo
text:
Emmanuel Kwabena Marfo (wɔwoo no Kitawonsa 27, 1973) yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɛfo a na ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwa ɛto so ason a ɛwɔ Ghana a ɛto so anan no muni na mprempren ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwa a Ɛto so Akron a ɛwɔ Ghana a ɛto so awotwe no muni a egyina hɔ ma aban no mufo wɔ ɔmansin no mu Ashanti mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana no wɔ ɔman ho dɔ apontow foforo no tekiti so.Ɔyɛ Forest Plantation Development Fund Management Board no mu ni.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Emmanuel Marfo na ɔfiri Bonwire wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Onyaa ne Bachelor of Sciences(BSC) wɔ Natural Resource Management (Forestry) ne Masters of Sciences(MSC) wɔ Forest Policy mu wɔ Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology(KNUST) wɔ afe 1997 ne 2001 mu. Ɔsan nyaa ne Nyansapɛ ho Oduruyɛfo (PHD) wɔ Atwa Yɛn Ho Ahyia Ho Nhyehyɛe mu fii Wageningen Sukuupɔn, Netherlands wɔ afe 2006 mu.

Adwuma 
Emmanuel Marfo yɛ Nyansahufo Panyin ma The Council of Scientific & Industrial Nhwehwɛmu(CSIR) - (Kwaeɛ mu Nhwehwɛmu Asoɛeɛ) wɔ Fumesua, Kumasi wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

Seesei Emmanuel Marfo reyɛ adwuma sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwa no mu ni (MP) ama Oforikrom Mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana wɔ tekiti a wɔde... New Patriotic Party.

Amanyɔsɛm asetena 
Emmanuel Marfo sii akan na odii nkonim wɔ afe 2016 NPP mmarahyɛbadwa primaries mu maa Oforikrom Mpɛsua wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Wɔ afe 2020 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu no, ɔde abatoɔ 60,156 kuraa Oforikrom Mpɛsua mmarahyɛbadwa no mu bere a NDC mmarahyɛbadwani Henry Osei Akoto nyaa abatoɔ 24,747 na PNC mmarahyɛbadwa mu kandifoɔ Muniru Seidu nyaa abatoɔ 545.

Boayɛkuw 
Marfo yɛ Atwa Yɛn Ho Ahyia, Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma Boayikuw no guamtrani;[9] Ɔyɛ ɔbarima ne ɔbea ne mmofra boayikuw no muni; Asomfo a wokura mfaso boayikuw no muni na oye akwan ne akwantu boayikuw no muni.[3]

N'asetena 
Marfo yɛ Kristoni.

title: Clement Abas Apaak
text:
Clement Abas Apaak yɛ Ghana amanyɔni na ɔsan yɛ National Democratic Congress ni. Ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbaguani ma Builsa Anaafoɔ abatoɔ Mpasuaso wɔ Atifi-Apueeɛ Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Mpreprei, ɔyɛ deputy ranking member wɔ Mmarahyɛbadwa Education Committee no so. Ɔsan wɔ Public Accounts Committee no so.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Ɔfiri Dorninga wɔ Ghana na ɔya ne Bachelor of Arts degree ɛfiri University of Ghana. Dr. Clement Abas Apaak ɛkura PhD wɔ archaeology ɛfiri Simon Fraser University (SFU), Canada; M.Phil. wɔ Archaeology ɛfiri University of Bergen, Norway; International Certificate wɔ African Archaeology ɛfiri University of Brussels; na odi kan yaa ne Bachelor of Arts degree wɔ Archaeology ne History ɛfiri University of Ghana.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Apaak ɛka National Democratic Congress (NDC) kuo neho na ogyina mu Builsa Anaafoɔ abatoɔ Mpasuaso wɔ Atifi-Apueeɛ Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔkaa sɛ mmarahyɛbaguani ɛdePublic University Bill ɛho nhia

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Nelson Kyeremeh
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Nelson Kyeremeh yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne ɔhwɛfoɔ. Ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma Berekum Apuei Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Bono Mantam mu firi Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da a ɛtɔ so nson (7) afe 2021.

Ne mmofraase abrabɔ ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Kyeremeh wɔ Ɔbɛnem bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nson (27) 1985 na ofiri Berekum a ɛwɔ Bono Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Onyaa ne mfitiaseɛ nhomasua adansedie krataa (basic education certificate) wɔ afe 2000 mu ne ne ntoaso sukuu adansedie krataa (secondary school certificate) wɔ afe 2003. Wɔmaa no ne Nyansahu mu Bachelor abodin krataa wɔ Ntotoeɛ Nhomasua (Bachelor of Science degree in Management Studies - Administration/Management) mu wɔ afe 2012 mu na onyaa ne Diploma abodin krataa wɔ Mfitiaseɛ Nhomasua mu (Diploma in Basic Education) wɔ afe 2009 mu.

Adwuma 
Kyeremeh yɛ Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ Panyin Boafoɔ (Assistant Headteacher) wɔ Ghana Nhomasua Dwumadibea (Ghana Education Service) na akyiri yi ɔyɛɛ Ɔhwɛfoɔ wɔ Agyengoplus Transport and Logistical Service Limited.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Kyeremeh dii nkonim de sii akan sɛ NPP Mmarahyɛbadwani ma Berekum Apuei Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa no mu tiaa MP a ɔwɔ hɔ mprempren Kwabena Twum-Nuamah. Ɔsan dii nkonim wɔ afe 2020 amansan abatoɔ no mu denam amba 27,731 a onyaa abatoɔ nyinaa mu 61.3% bere a NDC mmarahyɛbadwani Simon Ampaabeng Kyeremeh nyaa amba 17,305 a onyaa abatoɔ 38.2% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu na Independent kandifoɔ bi Francis Manu-Gyan nyaa amba 217 a ɛyɛɛ 0.5% . wɔ abatow a wɔtow nyinaa mu.

Boayikuw ahorow 
Kyeremeh yɛ Asɔremma a Wɔkura Mfaso Boayikuw no Dwumadibea ahorow (Members Holding Offices of Profit Committee) no muni na ɔsan nso yɛ Adwumayɛ ne Adan Boayikuw (member of Works and Housing Committee) no muni.

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Kyeremeh yɛ Kristoni.

Adɔeyɛ 
Wɔ bosome Obubuo afe 2021 mu no, ɔde nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma bi maa aban sukuu bɛyɛ aduanan baako (41).

Ntotoho

title: Henry Quartey
text:
Henry Quartey (wɔwoo no 12 Ɔbɛnem 1971) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so nson (7) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4) no muni a ogyina Ayawaso Mfinimfini Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa ananmu wɔ Greater Accra Mantam mu wɔ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo (New Patriotic Party) no tekiti so. 3][4][5][6] Mprempren ɔyɛ Ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Greater Accra Mantam so.[7][8][9]

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Quartey wɔ 12 Ɔbɛnem 1971. Ofiri Otublohum-Accra, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Greater Accra Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.[10] Onyaa ne ntoaso sukuu wɔ Hams Ntoaso Sukuu a ɛwɔ Dansoman ne Zams Ntoaso/Mfiridwuma Sukuu a ɛwɔ Bolgatanga. Ná ɔwɔ ne G.C.E. O'level wɔ Osu Presbyterian Ntoaso Sukuu a Ɛyɛ Mpanyimfo. Ɔkɔɔ Ghana Asoɛe a Ɛhwɛ Adwumayɛ ne Ɔmanfoɔ So (Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration) na onyaa ne postgraduate adansedie krataa wɔ Ɔmanfo Adwumayɛbea mu (postgraduate certificate in Public Administration).[10][2]

Amanyɔsɛm 
Quartey yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo (New Patriotic Party - NPP) no muni. Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔsii akan maa Ayawaso Mfinifini atenaeɛ no wɔ NPP mmarahyɛ badwa a ɛtɔ so nsia (6th) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4) no tekiti so na ɔdii nkonim.[10][11] Na ɔyɛ Akwan ne Kar Boayikuw no muni (member of the Roads and Transport Committee) ne Bɔbeasu ne Mmofra Boayikuw no muni (Gender and Children Committee).[1]

Boayikuw ahorow 
Quartey yɛ Akwan ne Akwantuo Boayikuw no muni (member of Roads and Transport Committee) na ɔsan yɛ Appointments Boayikuw no muni.[12]

Adwuma 
Ɔyɛ Krafty Hospitality Services Limited a ɛwɔ Accra no kwankyerɛfoɔ (Chief Executive Officer - CEO) firi afe 2003 besi nnɛ.[10] Ɔsan nso yɛ B.B.C Trading Adetɔn ne Adwumayɛ sohwɛfoɔ (Sales and Marketing Manager) firi afe 1992 kosi afe 1996. Akyiri yi ɔbɛyɛɛ Dalebrook Company Limited Ɔmantam sohwɛfoɔ (Regional Director) firi afe 1997 kosi afe 1998. Ɔsan nso yɛ Pecoll Aluminiuim Systems Adetɔn sohwɛfoɔ ne Ɔkwankyerɛfoɔ (Sales Manager and Director of Pecoll Aluminiuim Systems) firi afe 1995 kosi afe 2000 ][13]. Na ɔyɛ Ɔsoafox Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Mfinimfini Fam so (Deputy Minister for Interior).[14][15][16] Na ɔyɛ Ɔman Ahobammɔ Soafoɔ Abadiakyiri (Deputy Minister for National Security).[3] Mprempren ɔyɛ Greater Accra Ɔmantam Soafoɔ (Greater Accra Regional Minister).[17]

N'asetra mu 
Quartey yɛ Kristoni. Ɔwaree Sybil Ansah Quartey na wɔwɔ mma baanum (5).[10][2]

Adɔeyɛ 
Wɔ bosome Ɛbɔ afe 2021 mu no, Henry hyɛɛ bɔ sɛ ɔbɛboa Psalm Adjeteyfio de sika a ɛyɛ GH¢1,500 bosome biara. Henry kaa sɛ Psalm nkɛntɛnsoɔ wɔ sini (film) ne anigyeɛ adwuma mu (entertainment industry) wɔ Ghana na ɛkanyan no nti na ɔhyɛɛ bɔ no.[18]

title: Naser Toure Mahama
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Naser Toure Mahama (wɔwoo no Ɔbɛnem 17, 1965) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so nson (7) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4) no muni a ogyina Ayawaso Apuei Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa ananmu wɔ Greater Accra Mantam mu wɔ Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛ Badwa (National Democratic Congress) tekiti so.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Mahama wɔ Ɔbɛnem 17, afe 1965. Ofiri Nima-Accra, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Greater Accra Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.[2] Ɔkɔɔ West Africa Senior High School. Ɔkɔɔ Mfinifini Suapɔn Kɔlege (Central University College), Ghana na onyaa ne Nyansahu mu Bachelor abodin krataa wɔ aguadi mu (Bachelor of Science degree in marketing) wɔ afe 1987 mu.[2]

Amanyɔsɛm 
Mahama yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛ Badwani (NDC). Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔde NDC mmarahyɛ badwa a ɛtɔ so nsia (6th) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4) no tekiti so sii akan wɔ Ayawaso Apuei fam nkongua no so na odii nkonim.[2]

Adwumafa 

 Ɔkwankyerɛfo panyin, Aminasei Ngo Adwumakuw, Accra (managing director, Aminasei Oil Company, Accra)[2]

 OTA Sikasesa Dwumadibea, Accra (OTA Forex Bureau, Accra)[2]

 Mmarahyɛbadwani (Ɔpɛpɔn 7, 2013 besi ɛnɛ; afe a ɛtɔ so mmienu)[2]

 Adwuma ahorow (Varied profession) [3].

N'asetra mu 
Naser yɛ Nkramoni. Waware na ɔwɔ mma mmienu (2).[2

title: Nana Ayew Afriye
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Dr. Nana Ayew Afriye yɛ Ghana amanyɔni na ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so nson (7) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan no muni a ogyina Effiduase-Asokore Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa ananmu wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuo Foforɔ (New Patriotic Party) no tekiti so.

Ne mmofraase abrabɔ ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Afriye wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduonu mmienu (22) 1978 na ofiri Effiduase wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Wɔ afe 2004 mu no, onyaa ne Bachelor wɔ Aduruyɛ ne Bachelor wɔ Oprehyɛn Ho Ɔbenfo mu (Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery) wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu (University of Ghana) na ɔsan nso nyaa Post Graduate abodin krataa wɔ Akwahosan Sikasɛm (Post Graduate Certificate in Health Economics) mu wɔ Oxford Suapɔn mu (Oxford University). Wɔ afe 2009 mu no, ɔsan nyaa ne MA wɔ Sikasɛm ho nhyehyɛe sohwɛ mu (MA in Economics Policy Management) wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu. Wɔ afe 2011 mu no, onyaa ne MPH wɔ Akwahosan Sikasɛm mu wɔ Leeds Suapɔn mu (University of Leeds) a ɛwɔ United Kingdom (UK).

Adwuma 
Na Afriye yɛ St. Johns Ayaresabea ne Awo a ɛwɔ Tantra Hills wɔ Accra no panyin (CEO - St. Johns Hospital and Fertility). Ɔsan nso yɛ Ɔmanfoɔ Akwahosan Asoɛeɛ Titenani (Head Institutional Public Health) wɔ Ridge Ayaresabea (Ridge Hospital).

Amanyɔsɛm 
Afriye yɛ New Patriotic Party no muni na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma Effiduase-Asokore Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu.

Boayikuw ahorow 
Afriye yɛ Akwahosan Boayikuo no Titenani (Chairperson for the Health Committee) na ɔsan yɛ Sikasɛm Boayikuo no muni (member of the Finance Committee).

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Afriye yɛ Kristoni. Ɔwɔ mma baasa (3).

Ntotoho

title: Nana Ama Dokua Asiamah-Adjei
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Oheneba Nana Ama Dokua Asiamah-Adjei (wɔwoo no 24 Kitawonsa 1982) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma Akropong Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Ghana Apuei fam mantam mu.[1] Ɔyɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo (New Patriotic Party) no muni a mprempren ɔyɛ Ghana ɔsoafoɔ abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Aguadi & Nnwumayɛbea so (deputy minister of Trade & Industry). Kan no na ɔyɛ Ɔsoafoɔ Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Amanneɛbɔ so (Deputy Minister of Information).[2][3][4][5]

Adwuma 
Adjei yɛ Bekleen Limited kwankyerɛfoɔ panin (managing director) firi afe 2007 kosi afe 2016 ne Pongas Limited nso firi afe 2007 kosi afe 2015.[9]

Amanyɔsɛm 
Adjei yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo (New Patriotic Party) no muni.[10] Mprempren ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani ma Akropong Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Ghana Apuei Fam.[1][11]

N'asetra mu 
Adjei aware Charles Cromwell Nanabanyin Bissue na wɔwɔ ɔbabarima ne mmabea baanu.[8][15] Ɔda ne ho adi sɛ ɔyɛ Kristoni.[7]

Adɔeyɛ 
Wɔ bosome Obubuo afe 2021 mu no, ɔde kɔmputa ne nneɛma a wɔde yɛ adwuma maa Mangoase Methodist Sukuu (Mangoase Methodist School) a ɛwɔ Akuapim Atifi Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa.[16]

Wɔ bosome Kotonimma afe 2022 mu no, Adjei de sika GHc30,000 maeɛ sɛ wɔmfa nsi ahemfie kɛseɛ wɔ Adawso.[17] Wɔ bosome Kitawonsa afe 2022 mu no, ɔboaa ma wɔsiesiee Akropong Daakye Ayaresabea no (Akropong Daakye Clinic).[18]

title: Dorcas Affo-Toffey
text:
Dorcas Affo-Toffey (wowoo 4 Kotonimma 1972) yɛ Ghanani akorakora adwumani, ɔboafoɔ nna ɔsan yɛ amanyɔni. Ɔyɛ National Democratic Congress (NDC) ni. Ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma Jomoro abatoɔ Mpasuaso wɔ Atɔeɛ Mantam.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Dorcas Affo-Toffey wowoo 4 Kotonimma 1972, wɔ Tikobo No. 1 a na ɔyɛ Stephen Ackah Toffey ne Mary Afo Danyi ba. Yɛ woo no to abusua kesɛ, na ɔno na ɔtɔso18 ɛwɔ ne papa nma na ɔmo yɛ aduonu mmiɛnsa nanso ɔno na ɔtwa toɔ wɔ ne maame mma na ɔmoyɛ enum. Ɔkɔɔ nekora sukuu wɔ Tikobo No. 1 ne Ideal Preparatory sukuu wɔ Takoradi na ɔyaa sukuu mu kwan wɔ Nkroful Agriculture Secondary School wɔ 1986. Ɔwie sukuu no na ɔtuu kwan kɔ USA ɔne ne nua barima mpanyinfoɔ. Ɔkɔɔ yɛ, ɔkɔ sua  dental hygiene, real estate management, branding ne customer service.

Ɔkura diploma wɔ Branding ne Customer Service Management. Ɔsan tua so kɔ sua ade wɔ Knutsford University College ɛhɔ na ɔsua Bachelor of Science degree wɔ Marketing ɔsan sua Master of Business Administration (MBA) wɔ marketing.

Adwuma 
Bɛyɛ nfie aduonu num, Afo-Toffey ɛyɛ adwuma bebree wɔ USA. Baabia ɔyɛ adwuma no bi ne apɔmuden, nwomasua adwuma, adansie, akorakora adwumani ne ɔboafoɔ. Ɛfiri 2002 besi nne, w'ahyɛ adwuma ɛne kurakura ndwuma wɔ Atlanta Georgia wɔ USA, ebi ne; Queen D Beauty ne Topeka Properties, adansie adwuma. Ɔsan yɛɛ adwuma payin Selfie Homes wɔ Atlanta Georgia USA. Ɔsan baa Ghana wɔ 2012 bɛ tua ne akurakura adwuma a ɔyɛ chief executive officer ne Country Representative ma Nano Fix IT Company, ne Sebastian Closet Inc.

Amanyɔsɛm

Mmarahyɛbadwa 
Ɔmo to aba ma Affo-Toffey sɛ National Democratic Congress mmarahyɛbadwani dibeaperefoɔ wɔ Jomoro abatoɔ Mpasuaso  Osanna 2019. Ɔyaa 1,324 mma a ɛyɛ 87.4% a obi ɔno ne contesting a yɛfrɛ no Akatia Kwaidoo, Nda Blay Armah yaa 188 a ɛgyinho ma 12.4%, 4 ɛgyina ho 0.2%.

Affo-Toffey san di nkonim wɔ 2020 mmarahyɛbadwa abatoɔ wɔ Jomoro mmarahyɛbadwa ebere a ɔyaa 24,356 mma ɛgyinaho ma 55.5% etia nea ɔwɔ so dadaw sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani, Paul Essien a ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party a ɔyaa 19,889 ɛgyina ho 44.95%. Ɛfiri 7 Opepon 2021, ɔkaa mma 40 ɛne nipa baako a ɔfiri Atɔeɛ Mantam.

Mmarahyɛbadwani 
Ɛyɛ 7 Opepon 2021, Affo-Tottey wɔ mo ma no kaatam dii nsie sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani ma Jomoro abatoɔ Mpasuaso wɔ Atɔeɛ Mantam. Mprepre ɔwɔ Gender ne Children Committee kuo ne Lands ne Forestry Committee wɔ Mmarahyɛbadwa mu.

Ɛda a edi kan a ɔkasa wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa mu wɔ 24 Ɔbɔnem 2021, ɔhyɛ aban sɛ ɔbue twa ho hyia ɛbere COVID-19 asie ndwuma. Baabia na ɛwɔ Mmarahyɛbadwa Jomoro tesɛ Elubo, Jaway wharf, Newtown, Ellenda wharf ne twa ho hyia wɔ Ghana. Na saa nkuro yi a ɛwɔ ne Mmarahyɛbadwa mpɛsua so ɛbua nkuro nkuro wɔ Ghana ne Ivory Coast.

Agorodie 
Ɛwɔ 24 Ɔbɛnem 2021, Affo-Toffey tɔɔ Ghana Division One League club Proud United. Ɔsesa agorokansie kuo ne din kɔ Jomoro FC ɛna ɔde ɔmo fi Nkran, Nkran Mantam de kɔ Jomoro wɔ  Atɔeɛ Mantam. Agorokansie kuo no bɔ wɔn bɔɔlɔ wɔ Crosby Awuah Memorial Park (CAM), wɔ Aiyinase, bia Karela United bɔ wɔn bɔɔlɔ.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ne kunu ne Joseph Lawrence Ashun a ɔne ne wo mma mienu: Francine Koffi (Fantana, a ɔyɛ dwontoni wɔ Ghana) ne Lynelle Koffi (ɔsua dɔkuta wɔ USA)

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Mohammed Adamu Ramadan
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Mohammed Adamu Ramadan (wɔwoo no 3 Kotonimma 1975) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni. Ɔyɛ Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛ Badwani (National Democratic Congress). Ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma Adenta Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa. Ɔyɛ amanyɔni Ahmed Ramadan babarima ne Samira Bawumia ɔyɛ Ghana Awuraa a ɔtɔ so mmienu (Second Lady of Ghana) no nuabarima panin (elder brother).

Ne mmofraase abrabɔ ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Mohammed Adamu Ramadan wɔ Kotonimma bosome da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa (3) afe 1975. Ofiri Ashalley Botwe wɔ Greater Accra Mantam mu. Ɔwɔ Bachelor’s abodiin krataa wɔ Adwumayɛ ho nhyehyɛe mu (bachelor's degree of Business Administration), master’s abodiin krataa wɔ Adwumayɛ ho nhyehyɛe mu (Master's degree in Business Administration) a ne ho akokwaw wɔ Sikasɛm mu (specialization in Finance). Ɔsan nso wɔ Master of Arts abodin krataa wɔ Sikasɛm ho nhyehyɛe sohwɛ mu (Master of Arts in Economic Policy Management).

Adwuma 
Ramadan yɛ Ɔboafoɔ Titiriw ne ɔmampanyin adwumayɛfoɔ wɔ Flagstaff Fie (Flagstaff House) wɔ kan Ɔmampanyin John Mahama berɛ mu.

Amanyɔsɛm

Mmarahyɛ Badwa no mu mmɔdenbɔ 
Wɔ afe 2016 Mmarahyɛ Badwa abatoɔ mu no Ramadan gyinaa Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛ Badwani (National Democratic Congress) akyi wɔ Adenta Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa mu na odii nkoguo wɔ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforɔ (New Patriotic Party) no Yaw Buaben Asamoa Anim. Asamoa nyaa amba 33,952 a egyina hɔ ma 50.64% sɛ Ramadan abatoɔ 32,588 a ɛyɛ 48.61%. Ɔsan gyinaa primaries maa NDC na odii nkonim de gyinaa wɔn ananmu wɔ 2020 Abatoɔ no mu. Odii nkonim wɔ kan Ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Bɔbeasu, Mmofra ne Asetra mu Ahobammɔ so (former Minister for Gender, Children and Social Protection), Nana Oye Lithur so. Odii nkonim denam amba 730 a onyaeɛ tiaa ne amba 558 a ɔde too dwa sɛ odii nkonim no so.

Wɔ ne mmɔdenbɔ a ɛtɔ so mmienu (2) sɛ ɔbɛdi nkonim wɔ Adenta Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa atenaeɛ no mu no, odii nkonim wɔ mmarahyɛbadwni a odii tumi mprempren Yaw Buaben Asamoah a ɔne no sii akan wɔ afe 2016 abatoɔ no mu no, Otumi nyaa amba 63,436 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 55.9% sene abatoɔ 49,255 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 43.4% wɔ ɔno so.

Mmarahyɛbadwani 
Mohammed Adamu Ramadan kaa ntam sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani a ogyina Adenta Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa ananmu wɔ Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so awɔtwe (8) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4)  mu wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da a ɛtɔ so nson (7) afe 2021 mu. Ɔsom sɛ Mmarahyɛ Badwa no Akwahosan boayikuw (Health committee) ne Adwumayɛ Boayikuw (Business Committee) no muni.

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Ɔyɛ Ahmed Ramadan a na ɔyɛ Nnipa Ɔman Nhyiam guamtrani (former chairman of People's National Convention - PNC) ne Ghana Awuraa a ɛtɔ so abien (Ghana's Second Lady) Samira Bawumia nuabarima panyin no ba a odi kan. Ɔyɛ Nkramoni a ɔyɛ ɔhokafo. Ansa na ɔrekɔ amanyɔsɛm mu no, ɔne kan ɔman wimhyɛn adwumayɛkuw Ghana Airways ne Ghana International Airlines yɛɛ adwuma.

Ntotoho

title: Mohammed Adams Sukparu
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Mohammed Adams Sukparu (wɔwoo no 6 Ɔpɛpɔn 1985) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni a ɔyɛ Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛ Badwani (National Democratic Congress). Ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani ma Sissala Atɔeɛ Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Atifi Atɔeɛ Mantam mu.

Ne mmofraase abrabɔ ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Sukparu wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da a ɛtɔ so nsia (6) 1985, ofiri Bouti a ɛwɔ Sissala Atɔeɛ Mansin mu wɔ Atifi Atɔeɛ Mantam wɔ Ghana. Ɔkɔɔ Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Adwumayɛfoɔ Adesua so Accra (UPSA). Na ɔyɛ asuafoɔ kannifoɔ na ɔyɛɛ Ankorankoro Suapɔn Asuafoɔ Fekuo a ɛwɔ Ghana (Private Universities Students’ Association of Ghana - PUSAG) titrani (president). Wɔ ne bere a na ɔyɛ PUSAG Titenani no, ɔde ahoɔden ne nsɛm pii baa asuafoɔ anim. Ɔsan nso yɛɛ Ghana ananmusifoɔ wɔ Afrika Nyinaa Asuafoɔ Kuo (All-Africa Students Union - ASSU) mu.

Amanyɔsɛm

Mmarahyɛbadwani 
Sukparu hyɛɛ akansi a ɛfa mmarahyɛbadwani no ho wɔ NDC primaries wɔ Sissala Atɔeɛ Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa ansa na afe 2020 abatoɔ no reba. Sukparu dii nkonim wɔ mmarahyɛ badwa no mu sɛ ɔbegyina Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛ Badwa (National Democratic Congress) ananmu ama Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa no ansa na afe 2020 abatow no aba wɔ bosome Ɔsanaa afe 2019 mu bere a onyaa abatow 345 de dii n’asɔretiafo afoforo baanu Mumuni Hakeem Duwiejuah ne Mary Hagbana Abu a wonyaa amba ɔha aduonu aduasa anum (235) ne amba aduasa anum (35) no so nkonim.

Wɔ bosome Ɔpɛnimma afe 2020 mu no, Sukparu dii nkonim maa Sissala Atɔeɛ Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa wɔ mmarahyɛ badwa abatoɔ mu akyi a ɔtoo aba 17,731 a egyina hɔ ma 52.54% tiaa nea ɔsɔre tia no paa, Naliwie Baluwie Salifu a ofiri Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo (New Patriotic Party), a na anka ɔyɛ Ɔmantam no sohwɛfo panyin (District Chief Executive) ma Sissala Atɔeɛ Mansin (Sissala West District), a na ɔwɔ 13,994 abatow a egyina hɔ ma 43.87%.

Ntotoho

title: Mohammed Abdul Aziz
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu
Mohammed Abdul Aziz yɛ Ghana amanyɔni. Na ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani ma Mion Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Mantam a ɔdii nkonim wɔ afe 2016 Ghana mmarahyɛ badwa abatoɔ mu.

Ntotoho

title: Matthew Opoku Prempeh
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Matthew Opoku Prempeh, (wɔwoo no 23 Kotonimma 1968) yɛ Ghana aduruyɛ ho oduruyɛfo (medical doctor) ne amanyɔni. Ɔyɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo (New Patriotic Party) no muni na ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani ma Manhyia Anafoɔ Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔyɛ kan Nhomasua Soafoɔ (former Minister of Education). Wɔfrɛ no kɛse sɛ NAPO. Mprempren ɔyɛ Ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Ahoɔden so (Minister for Energy).

Ne mmofrase abrabɔ ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Prempeh wɔ Kotonimma bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduonu mmiɛna (23)1968 na ofiri Pakyi No 2 wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu. Ɔsuaa Nnipa Abɔdeɛ ne Aduruyɛ ho adeɛ (Human Biology and Medicine) wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so (Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology), akyiri yi ɔtoaa adesua akyi wɔ Netherlands Akwahosan Ho Nyansahu Asoɛe ne Kennedy Aban Sukuu (Netherlands Institute of Health Sciences and the Kennedy School of Government) wɔ Harvard Suapɔn (Harvard University) mu.

Adwuma 
Ansa na ɔreyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani no, Prempeh yɛɛ Keyedmap Security Services Limited Adwumayɛfo Panyin (Chief Executive Officer - CEO) firi afe 2004 kosi afe 2009. Ɔsan yɛ aduruyɛ ho oduruyɛfo (medical doctor)  na ɔsom sɛ Royal Kɔlege ma Nnuruyɛfo ne Oprehyɛn Ho Nnuruyɛfo (Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons) a ɛwɔ United Kingdom no muni fi afe 1999 kosi afe 2003.

Amanyɔsɛm

Mmarahyɛbaguani 
Sɛ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwani no, ogyina Manhyia Anafoɔ Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa ananmu wɔ Kumasi, kan no na ogyina Manhyia ananmu. Wɔdii kan paw no sɛ ɔnyɛ mmarahyɛ badwa wɔ afe 2008 mu na ɔyɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforɔ (New Patriotic Party) no muni. Wɔ afe 2016 mu no, wɔsan paw no bio de amba 35,958, anaa abatoɔ a wɔtoo wɔ ɔmantam no mu no mu 87.17%. Na ɔyɛ akwahosan boayikuw (health committee) ne boayikuw a wɔpaw nnipa (appointments committee) no muni. Prempeh sii akan wɔ afe 2020 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu sɛ mmarahyɛ badwafoɔ kandifoɔ maa Manhyia Anafoɔ Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa no, wɔ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforɔ (New Patriotic Party) frankaa ase na odii nkonim wɔ nkontabuo kɛseɛ mu.

Nhomasua ho Ɔsoafoɔ 
Ɔmanpanin Nana Akufo-Addo na ɔpaw no wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da a ɛtɔ so du (10) afe 2017 sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ Ghana Nhomasua Soafoɔ (Minister for Education of Ghana). Ɔsomm wɔ saa dwumadie no mu mfeɛ anan (4) kosii Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da a ɛtɔ so nsia (6) afe 2021 mu bere a ɔmampanin ne n’asomfo dibea no baa awieeɛ.

Wɔ bosome Kotonimma afe 2017 mu no, Ɔmanpanin Nana Akufo-Addo bɔɔ Prempeh din sɛ asoafoɔ dunkron (19) a wɔbɛhyehyɛ ne kabinet no fa. Wɔde asomfo dunkron (19) no din kɔmaa Ghana Mmarahyɛ Badwa no na kan Aban no Kasafo, Mike Ocquaye na ɔde too gua. Sɛ Kabinet ɔsoafoɔ no (Cabinet minister), na Prempeh ka ɔmampanin no mu kuw no ho na na ɛsɛ sɛ ɔboa wɔ gyinaesi dwumadi atitiriw (decision-making activities) mu wɔ ɔman no mu.

Prempeh nso boaa Ghana nhomasua dwumadibea sɛ Nhomasua soafoɔ (Minister of Education) te sɛ nnwuma a ɔmaa nkɔsoɔ ne adwumayɛ ne mfiridwuma ho adesua (Vocational and Technical Education - TVET) a ɔhyɛɛ ho nkuran ne aban no dwumadiɛ titire ''FREE SHS'' a odii anim.

Boayikuw ahorow 
Prempeh yɛ Defense ne Interior Boakyikuo no muni na ɔsan yɛ Appointments Boakyikuo no muni.

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Ɔyɛ Kristoni na ɔyɛ kan Ghana ɔmampanyin, John Kufuor banana (grandson). Wagyae awarɛ (divorced).

Wɔ bosome Kotonimma afe 2022 mu no, kuw bi a wɔfrɛ wɔn Friends of NAPO de nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma bi maa sukuu ahorow a ɛwɔ Manhyia South Constituency de hyɛɛ n’awoda a ɛtɔ so aduonum anan (54) ho fa.

title: Martin Kwaku Adjei-Mensah Korsah
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Martin Kwaku Adjei-Mensah Korsah yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so awɔtwe (8) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4) no muni a ogyina Techiman Anafoɔ Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa ananmu wɔ Bono Apueɛ Mantam mu wɔ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo (New Patriotic Party) no tekiti so. Mprempren ɔyɛ Ɔsoafoɔ Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Mpɔtam Aban, Decentralization ne Nkuraase Nkɔso so (Deputy Minister for Local Government, Decentralization and Rural Development).

Ne mmofrase abrabɔ ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Korsah wɔ Oforisuo bosome da ɛtɔ so aduonu mmienu (12) afe 1978 na ofiri Techiman wɔ Bono Apueɛ Mantam mu. Owiee ne SSSCE wɔ afe 1998 mu baabi a osuaa Aban, Abakɔsɛm ne Kristofo Nyamesom Adesua (Government, History and Christian Religious Studies). Onyaa ne Bachelors abodin krataa wɔ Amanyɔsɛm mu (Bachelors of Arts in Political Science) wɔ afe 2005 mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu (University of Ghana), ne ne master’s abodin krataa wɔ Amanyɔsɛm ne Amanaman Ntam Abusuabɔ mu (master's degree in Politics and International Relations) wɔ afe 2007 mu.

Adwuma 
Na Korsah yɛ GES sukuu mfitiaseɛ ntamgyinafoɔ (basic school coordinator). Na ɔsan yɛ Techiman Municipal Assembly no muni. Na ɔsan nso yɛ Abatow ne Nhwehwɛmu sohwɛfo ma Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo (Director of Elections and Research for the New Patriotic Party).

Amanyɔsɛm mu adwuma 
Korsah yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo (NPP) muni na mprempren ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma Techiman Techiman Anafoɔ Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa wɔ Bono Apueɛ Mantam. Wɔ afe 2020 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu no, ɔdii nkonim wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa akongua no mu a onyaa amba 49,682 a ɛyɛɛ 50.24% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoo no nyinaa mu berɛ a NDC mmarahyɛ badwa mu ɔpɛfoɔ Christopher Beyere Baasongti nyaa amba 49,205 a ɛyɛɛ 49.76% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu. Wɔpaw no sɛ ɔman Ɔsoafoɔ Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Mpɔtam Aban, Decentralization ne Nkuraase Nkɔso so (Deputy Minister for Local Government, Decentralization and Rural Development).

Boayikuw ahorow 
Korsah yɛ Aban no boayikuo no muni (member of the House committee) na ɔsan yɛ Amannɔne Nsɛm Boayikuo no muni (member of Foreign Affairs Committee).

title: Mark Kurt Nawaane
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Mark Kurt Nawaane (21 Oforisuo 1966) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so nson (7) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4) no muni a ogyina Nabdam Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa ananmu wɔ Atifi Apueɛ Mantam wɔ Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛ Badwa (National Democratic Congress) tekiti so.

Ne mmofrase abrabɔ ne nhomasua 
Nawaane firi Kongo-Nangodi. Ɔwɔ M.B.A wɔ ParisSukuu a Wɔawie a Ɛhwɛ Adwumayɛ So (Paris Graduate School of Management) ne M.D. wɔ Aduruyɛ ne Ahotew Asoɛe (Institute of Medicine and Hygiene) wɔ St.Petersburga ɛwɔ Russia.

title: Laadi Ayii Ayamba
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Laadi Ayii Ayamba yɛ Ghana amanyɔni na ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so awɔtwe (8th) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4) no muni a ogyina Pusiga Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa ananmu wɔ Atifi Apueɛ Mantam wɔ Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛ Badwa (National Democratic Congress) tekiti so. Na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛ badwa a ɛtɔ so nsia (6th) ne nson (7th) no muni nso. Ɔyɛ ɔbaa a ɔyɛ adwumaden (woman activist) na ne dodoɔ no ara di nsɛm a ɛfa mmaa ho wɔ mmarahyɛ badwa no fam. Odii dwuma sɛ Boayikuo a ɛhwɛ Bɔbeasu ne Mmofra so no guamtrani (chairperson of the Committee on Gender and Children) wɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4th) no mmarahyɛ badwa a ɛtɔ so (6th) mu firi afe 2013 kosi afe 2017.

Ne mmofrase abrabɔ ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Laadi Ayi Ayamba wɔ Ɔpɛnimma bosome da ɛtɔ so aduonu nsia (26) afe 1961, Ɔyɛ Pusiga kuromni a ɛwɔ Atifi Apueɛ Mantam. Ɔkɔɔ mfinimfini sukuu wɔ Pusiga Ntoasoɔ Mfinimfini Sukuu mu (Pusiga Continuation Middle School). Ɔtoaa n’adesua so fi saa bere no wɔ Gbewaa Akyerɛkyerɛfo Ntetee Kɔlege (Gbewaa Teacher Training College), faako a owiee sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo a wɔatete no (trained teacher). Akyiri yi ɔkɔɔ Nhomasua Suapɔn (University of Education), Winneba baabi a onyaa abodin krataa wɔ Mfitiase Nhomasua mu (bachelor's degree in Basic Education).

Adwuma 
Ayamba hyɛɛ n’adwuma ase sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ (teacher ) firi afe 1981 kosi afe 1991. Saa berɛ no na ɔyɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ panin (head-teacher) kosii afe 2000, baabi a Ghana Nhomasua Dwumadibea no san paw no sɛ Ɔpanin (Officer) a ɔhwɛ Da Nkokoaa Sukuu Ahorow (Day Nursery Schools) so.

Amanyɔsɛm

Mmarahyɛbadwani 
Ayamba yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛ Badwa (National Democratic Congress) muni na ɔfaa n’akongua wɔ mmarahyɛ badwa mu sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani ma Pusiga Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Atifi Apueɛ Mantam bere a onyaa amba sen n’asɔretiafo Simon Akunye Atingban ne Osman Aludiba Ayuba a na wɔrepere dibea koro no ara no. Odii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ no mu a ne nyinaa yɛ amba 15,847 wɔ abatoɔ 29,592 a ɛfata mu, a ɛyɛ 46.78% wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata nyinaa mu.

ECOWAS 
Wɔ afe 2021 mu no, Laadi ne Alexander Kwamena Afenyo-Markin, Abdul-Aziz Ayaba Musah, Johnson Kwaku Adu ne Emmanuel Kwasi Bedzrah kaa ntam wɔ ECOWAS Mmarahyɛ Badwa no Nhyiamu soronko 2021 (Extraordinary Session 2021 of the Parliament of the ECOWAS) a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Freetown wɔ Sierra Leone no mu.

Boayikuw a Ɛhwɛ Bɔbeasu ne Mmofra So no Titenani 
Ɔyɛɛ Mmarahyɛ Badwa Boayikuo a ɛhwɛ Bɔbeasu ne Mmofra so no Titenani (Chairperson of the Parliamentary Committee on Gender and Children) ogyinaa Ghana ananmu wɔ Geneva, Switzerland wɔ Amanaman Nkabom Apam a Ɛfa Nyiyim a Wɔtu Mmea Nyinaa Fi hɔ nhyiamu a ɛtɔ so aduonum nkron (59th session of UN Convention on the Elimination of all forms of Discrimination against Women - CEDAW) no mu  de boaa mmɔden a Ghana rebɔ sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ wɔbɛyi nyiyim afiri hɔ nyiyim a wɔyɛ tia mmea nyinaa. Wɔ ne dwumadie mu no ɔkaa sɛ Ghana rebɔ mmɔden sɛ ɔbɛdi amammerɛ mu nneyɛeɛ a epira a ne bere atwam ho dwuma denam mmara a wɔbɛbɔ de abara saa nneyɛeɛ no so. Ɔsan nso kaa ɔman no nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa Asetena mu Tumi a Wɔde Ko Tia Ohia (Livelihood Empowerment Against Poverty - LEAP) a wɔde adi dwuma na ɛhia sɛ wɔhyɛ mu den wɔ nkuraaseɛ a mmabaa nkumaa tu kɔ nkuropɔn mu na ɛboa wɔn ma wɔtena wɔn nkitahodiɛ mu na wɔnya nimdeɛ a ɛfata a wɔde bɛma wɔn fekuw ahorow. Ɔsan nso dii nyansahyɛ a mmarima ne mmea boayikuw (gender committee) no de mae sɛ oguamtrani (chairperson) no anim sɛ wɔbɛma nna ho nkyerɛkyerɛ akɔ soro wɔ sukuu ahorow mu na aboa ma wɔasiw mmabun nyinsɛn (teenage pregnancy) a ɛkɔ soro no ano.

Sii so dua Anamɔntuo Mmara a Wɔde Di Dwuma (Affirmative Action Bill) 
Ɔyɛ ɔbea a ɔkamfo kyerɛ a ɔboaa Affirmative Action Bill no na ɔboaa mmara no nhyehyɛe a ɛbɛma wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ ɔha biara mu nkyem aduanan (40) a wɔde bɛma mmea de wɔn ho ahyɛ amanyɔsɛm mu na afei nso ɛsɛ sɛ wɔma mmea kwan ma wosi akan wɔ wɔn akuw ahorow no ''nkongua a ahobammɔ wom'' ho na ama wɔahwɛ ahu sɛ nneɛma pa bi bɛba mmea ananmusifo.

Afe 2020 abatoɔ 
Ɔkuraa n’akongua so wɔ afe 2020 Ɔpɛnimma abatoɔ no mu berɛ a odii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ dodoɔ no ara mu 63. Odii nea ɔsɔre tia no paa Abdul-Karim Zanni Dubiure a ofi NPP no so nkonim denam abatow 14,929 a onyaa a egyina hɔ ma 42.31% bere a 14,866 gyina hɔ ma 42.13% no so.

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Ayamba yɛ Nkramoni. Wagyae awareɛ (divorced) na ɔwɔ mma dunum (5).

title: Kwasi Boateng Adjei
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Kwasi Boateng Adjei (wɔwoo no Ɔsanaa 29, 1954) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni na ɔyɛ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4th) no Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so nson (7th) no muni a ogyina New Juaben Atifi Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa ananmu wɔ Apueɛ Mantam mu wɔ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo (New Patriotic Party - NPP) tekiti so. Ɔyɛ Ɔsoafoɔ Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Mpɔtam Aban ne Nkuraaseɛ Nkɔsoɔ so firi afe 2017 besi ɛnnɛ.

Ne mmofrase abrabɔ ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Adjei wɔ Ɔsanaa bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nkron (29), afe 1954. Ofiri Asokore – New Juaben, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Apueɛ Mantam mu. Ɔkɔɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu na onyaa ne Nyansahu mu Bachelor abodin krataa wɔ adwumayɛ mu (Bachelor of Science degree in business administration) wɔ afe 1980 mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Adjei yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo (NPP) no muni. Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, osii akan wɔ New Juaben Atifi nkongua no so wɔ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo (NPP) mmarahyɛ badwa a ɛtɔ so nsia (6) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4) no tekiti so na odii nkonim.

Adwumafa 

 Municipal Adwumayɛfo Panyin (MCE, Kotonimma afe 2001 – Ɔpɛpɔn afe 2009)

 Ɔpanyin (Managing Head) a ɔhwɛ adwuma so wɔ New Juaben Kɔlege a ɛhwɛ aguadi so (New Juaben College of Commerce), Koforidua

 Ɔpanyin (Manager), ɔhwɛfo (administrator), HR adwumayɛfo (HR practitioner)

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Adjei yɛ Kristoni (Methodist). Waware a ɔwɔ mma baasa (3).
