title: Emmanuel Akwasi Gyamfi
text:
Emmanuel Akwasi Gyamfi yɛ Ghana amanyɔni na ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so nson (7) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4th) no muni a ogyina Odotobri Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa ananmu wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo (New Patriotic Party) no tekiti so.

Ne mmofrase abrabɔ ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Gyamfi wɔ Ɔpɛnimma bosome da a ɛtɔ so baako (1) afe 1974. Ofiri Homase a ɛtɔ so mmienu (Homase No. 2) wɔ Ashanti mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Onyaa ne Nyansahu mu Bachelor abodin krataa wɔ Nhyehyɛeɛ mu (Bachelor of Science degree in Planning) wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so (Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology), Kumasi.

Onyaa abodin krataa no wɔ afe 2000 mu. Ɔsan nso yɛ Ghana Asoɛe a ɛhwɛ adwumayɛ ne ɔman adwumayɛ so (Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration - GIMPA) no ade. Onyaa Executive master’s degree wɔ institute no mu. Eyi sii wɔ afe 2008 mu.

Adwuma 
Ansa na wɔrepaw no sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ mmarahyɛ badwa no, na ɔyɛ adwuma sɛ adwuma sohwɛfo wɔ Odotobri Rural Bank Limited. Ɔsan nso yɛɛ adwuma sɛ ɔhwɛfoɔ (administrator) ne ɔkwankyerɛfoɔ panin (lead facilitator) maa ahyehyɛdeɛ bi a ɛnyɛ aban de (non-governmental organization) firi afe 2001 kosi afe 2002.

Amanyɔsɛm adwuma 
Gyamfi kɔɔ mmarahyɛ badwa mu sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani a wɔpaw no maa Odotobri Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa no wɔ mmarahyɛ badwa a ɛtɔ so anan (4) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4) no mu. Ɔkuraa n’atenabea wɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4) no mmarahyɛ badwa a ɛtɔ so anum (5) mu firi Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da a ɛtɔ so nson (7) 2008 kosi Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da a ɛtɔ so nsia (6) afe 2013. Wɔde amba 22,914 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatoɔ 27,700 a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ no mu a ɛne 82.7% yɛ pɛ wɔ abatoɔ a ɛdi mu nyinaa mu abatoɔ a wɔtoo wɔ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo (New Patriotic Party) no tekiti so wɔ afe 2008 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu. Wɔsan paw no sɛ ɔmmra mmarahyɛ badwa mu wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da a ɛtɔ so nson (7) afe 2013 bere a wɔwiee afe 2012 Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ no. Afei wɔsan paw no wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da a ɛtɔ so nson (7) afe 2017 wɔ afe 2016 Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ no akyi baabi a onyaa abatoɔ a ɛfata no mu 66.13%. Ɔyɛ Fam agodie ne Ahoɔden Boayikuw (Mines and Energy Committee) ne Mmofra ne Bɔbeasu Boayikuw a ɛwɔ Mmarahyɛ badwa a ɛtɔ so nson (7th) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4th) no muni.

Boayikuw ahorow 
Gyamfi yɛ Mpɔtam Aban ne Nkuraase Nkɔsoɔ Boayikuo no guamtrani (chairperson of the Local Government and Rural Development Committee), ɔyɛ Aban Awerɛhyɛmu Boayikuo (member of the Government Assurance Committee) no muni na ɔsan yɛ Akwahosan Boayikuo no muni (member of the Health Committee).

Abatow 
Wɔpaw Gyamfi sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma Odotobri Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa ananmu wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana nea edi kan wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow no mu. Odii nkonim wɔ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforɔ (New Patriotic Party) no tekiti so. Na ne mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa no yɛ mmarahyɛ badwa nkongua aduasa nsia (36) no fa wɔ nkongua aduasa nkron (39) a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforɔ (New Patriotic Party) no dii wɔ saa abatoɔ no mu maa Ashanti Mantam no mu. Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforɔ (New Patriotic Party) no nyaa dodow no ara a ɛyɛ mmarahyɛ badwa nkongua ɔha aduonu awɔtwe (128) wɔ nkongua ahanu aduasa (230) mu. Wɔde amba 23,804 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 28,967 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 82.2% yɛ pɛ. Onyaa amba sen George Adu-Mensah a ofi Ɔman Demokrasi Nhyiam Kuw (National Democratic Congress), Thomas Appiah-Kubi a ofi Nhyiam Nnipa Kuw (Convention People's Party) ne Johnny Owusu-Boadi a ɔyɛ obi a ɔde ne ho (independent candidate). Eyinom nyaa amba 3,740, 423 ne 1,000 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 12.9%, 1.5% ne 3.5% yɛ pɛ.

Afe 2008 Amansan abatoɔ 
Wɔ afe 2008 mu no, odii nkonim wɔ amansan abatoɔ no mu wɔ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforɔ (New Patriotic Party) tekiti so maa ɔmansin korɔ no ara. Na ne mansin no yɛ mmarahyɛ badwa nkongua aduasa anan (34) no fa wɔ nkongua aduasa nkron (39) a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforɔ (New Patriotic Party) no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Ashanti Mantam no mu. Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforɔ no nyaa mmarahyɛ badwa nkongua ɔha nkron (109) wɔ nkongua ahanu adasa (230) mu. Wɔde amba 22,914 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 27,700 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 82.72% yɛ pɛ. Onyaa amba sen Isaac Mensah a ofi Nnipa Ɔman Nhyiam Kuw (People's National Convention) no mu, Kingsley Anning a ofi Ɔman Demokrasi Nhyiam Kuw (National Democratic Congress) no mu ne Owusu Nhyira a ofi Nhyiam Nnipa Kuw (Convention People's Party). Eyinom nyaa amba 230, 3,146 ne 1,410 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne 0.83%, 11.36% ne 5.09% yɛ pɛ wɔ abatow a wɔtow nyinaa mu.

Afe 2012 Amansan abatoɔ 
Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, odii nkonim bio wɔ amansan abatoɔ mu maa saa mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa korɔ no ara. Wɔde amba 27,526 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 35,221. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 78.15% yɛ pɛ. Onyaa amba sen Robert Bennett Forkuoh a ofi Ɔman Demokrasi Nhyiam Kuw (National Democratic Congress) ne Kojo Ego Ayeboafo a ɔyɛ ɔkannifo a ɔde ne ho (independent candidate). Eyinom nyaa amba 6,226 ne 1,469 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne 17.68% ne 4.17% yɛ pɛ wɔ abatow a wɔtow nyinaa mu.

Afe 2016 Amansan abatoɔ 
Wɔ afe 2016 mu no, odii nkonim bio wɔ amansan abatoɔ no mu maa mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa korɔ no ara. Wɔde amba 23,255 na ɛpaw no. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 53.87% yɛ pɛ. Onyaa amba sen Dede Appiah Emmanuel a ofi Ɔman Demokrasi Nhyiam Kuw (National Democratic Congress), Anthony Danso-Appiah a ɔyɛ ɔkannifo a ɔde ne ho (independent candidate), Abraham Anokye nso yɛ obi a ɔde ne ho (independent candidate), Owusu Francis a ofi Nkɔsoɔ Nnipa Kuw (Progressive People's Party - Ghana) ne Minkah Prince a ofi Nhyiam Nnipa Kuw (Convention People's Party (CPP). Eyinom nyaa 12,098; 4,005 na ɛwɔ hɔ; 3,133 na ɛwɔ hɔ; 451 ne 223 na wɔtow aba wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne 28.03%, 9.28%, 7.26%, 1.04% ne 0.52% yɛ pɛ wɔ abatow a wɔtow nyinaa mu.

2020 Amansan abatoɔ 
Wɔ afe 2020 mu no, odii nkonim bio wɔ amansan abatoɔ no mu maa mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa korɔ no ara. Wɔde abatow 28,021 na ɛpaw no. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 57.38% yɛ pɛ. Onyaa amba sen Emmanuel Obeng Agyemang a ofi Ɔman Demokrasi Nhyiam Kuw (National Democratic Congress) ne Paul Agyeman-Bannor a ofi Ghana Nkabom Kuw (Ghana Union Movement - GUM). Eyinom nyaa amba 10,456 ne10,358 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne abatow a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 21.41% ne 21.21% yɛ pɛ.

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Gyamfi aware na ɔwɔ mma baasa (3). Ɔyɛ Kristoni ne katolekni.

Ntotoho

title: Eric Afful
text:
Eric Afful yɛ Ghanani a wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn bosome no da a ɛdi kan, wɔ afe apem ahankron aduoson nan mu (born 1 January 1974) . Ɔyɛ amannyɔni a ɔka Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a wɔ tɔ so nson no ho wɔ Ghana kwasafoman a ɛtɔ so nan no mu,  ɔno na ɔyɛ ananmusini de ma Amenfi West  abatoɔ mpesua no so a wɔwɔ Atɔeɛ mantam no mu. Amannyɔkuo a ɔdɔm a ɛnam wɔn so maa ɔkɔpue mmarahyebadwam no ne Kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo National Democratic Congress.

Ɔbra ahyɛaseɛ ne Nwomasua 
wɔwoo Eric Afful wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome no da a ɛdi kan, wɔ afe apem ahankron aduoson nan mu (born 1 January 1974) . Ɔfiri kuro a yɛfrɛ no  Asankragwaa, ɛwɔ Atɔeɛ mantam no mu wɔ ɔman Ghana mu. Ɔnyaa n'abɔdin krataa wɔka no borofo mu sɛ Bachelor of Arts in Economic ɛfirii Kwame Nkrumah suapɔn a wɔfrɛ no Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du mu (2010). Ɔsane nso toaa so kɔɔ Cape coast suapɔn no mu kɔgyee n'abɔdin a ɛtɔ so mmienu a yɛka no borofo mu sɛ Masters of Art in Human Resource Development wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du nsia (2016) mu. Eric Afful yɛ kristoni a ɔne Methodist asafo no na ɛsom bɔm. Waware a ɔwɔ mma mmiensa.

Amannyɔsɛm 
Eric Afful amannyɔkuo a ɔdɔm a ɛnam wɔn so maa ɔkɔpue mmarahyebadwam no ne Kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo National Democratic Congress (NDC). Wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du mmienu mu no (2012), ɔgyinaa wɔ Amenfi West abatoɔ mpesua no so maa wɔtoo ne so aba maa ɔdii nkunim wɔ NDC amannyɔkuo no din mu kɔgyinaa ɔmanfoɔ a wɔwɔ Amenfi West abatoɔ mpesua no so.

Baabi a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ.

title: Eugene Boakye Antwi
text:
Eugene Boakye Antwi (wɔwoo no afe 1970) yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ na ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanin a ɛtɔ so nnan Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson no muni a ɔgyina Subin Mansin ananmu wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so. Ɔyɛ kan Ɔmanpanyin Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ adwuma ne adan so.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo no wɔ 7 Kɔtonima1970 wɔ Baman, Kwabre wɔ Ashanti mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Na ɔwɔ ne PGDIP a efi Post Certificate Market Research mu. Ná ɔwɔ ne Ɔman Abodin krataa a Ɛkorɔn wɔ Westminster College, UK. Ɔsan nyaa ne BA wɔ Adwumayɛ mu wɔ Westminster Suapɔn mu.

Adwuma 
Ɔyɛ sikakorabea dwumayɛni wɔ Barclays Sikakorabea a seesei ɛyɛ ABSA firi afe 1999 kɔsi afe 2002. Na ɔyɛ Lord Chancellors Department sohwɛfoɔ firi afe 2002 kɔsi afe 2006. Ɔyɛ na ɔyɛ EUGASS Limited no sohwɛfoɔ firi afe 2006 kɔsi afe 2016.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party no muni.[4] Ɔyɛ mmarahyɛ baguani ma Subin Mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti mantam mu.[5][6]

Boayikuw 
Ɔyɛ Budget Boayikuw Titiriw no muni na ɔsan yɛ Asase ne Kwae Boayikuw no muni.

title: Isaac Yaw Opoku
text:
Isaac Yaw Opoku yɛ Ghana amanyɔfoɔ ne mmarahyɛbadwani ma Offinso South amansin a ɛwɔ Ashanti mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo no wɔ 27 Ɔsanaa 1957 na fi Offinso a ɛwɔ Ashanti mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔnya PhD wɔ Mycology mu wɔ afe 1993 mu.

Adwuma 
Ɔyɛ Cocoa Research Institute of Ghana kwankyerɛfoɔ panin wɔ Cocobod ase.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ɔyɛ NPP muni na mprempren ɔyɛ Offinso South Abatoɔ Mpɛsua MP. Wɔ afe 2020 Amansan Abatoɔ mu no, ɔde abatoɔ 39,971 dii nkonim wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa no mu berɛ a Yussif Haruna nyaa abatoɔ 19,952.

Boayikuo 
Ɔyɛ Members Holding Offices of Profit Committee no muni na ɔsan yɛ Trade, Industry ne Tourism Committee.

N'asetena 
Opoku yɛ Kristoni.

title: Ernest Henry Norgbey
text: Ernest Henry Norgbey yɛ Ghanani a wasom akyɛ yie pa ara. Ɔyɛ amannyɔni a ɔka Ghana mmarahyɛbadwakuo a wɔtɔ so nwɔtwe no ho wɔ Ghana kwasafoman a ɛtɔ so nan no mu, ɔno na ɔyɛ ananmusini de ma  Ashaiman  abatoɔ mpesua no so a wɔwɔ Nkran mantam no mu. Ɔkɔɔ mmarahyɛbadwam wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du nson (2017) mu. Amannyɔkuo a ɔdɔm a ɛnam wɔn so maa ɔkɔpue mmarahyebadwam no ne Kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo National Democratic Congress.

title: Kweku George Ricketts-Hagan
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Kweku George Ricketts-Hagan yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so nson a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan no muni a gyina Cape Coast South Mmarahyɛbadwa mpɛsoa ananmu wɔ Ghana Mfinifini Mantam wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Ne mmofrase abrabɔ ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Ricketts-Hagan wɔ 21 August 1963 wɔ Cape Coast wɔ Ghana Mfinifini Mantam. Ɔwɔ MBA wɔ Chicago Suapɔn Adwumayɛ Sukuu mu ne master’s degree wɔ Sikasɛm mu wɔ London Suapɔn mu.

Adwuma 
Na Ricketts-Hagan yɛ SAS Sikasɛm Kuw no kwankyerɛfo panyin.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ricketts-Hagan yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni. Mprempren ɔyɛ mmarahyɛ badwa no muni ananmusifo ma Cape Coast South Constituency.

Afe 2020 Abatoɔ 
Wɔ afe 2020 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu no, ɔsan dii nkonim wɔ Cape Coast South Constituency mmarahyɛ badwa no mu a onyaa amba 21,118 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoo no nyinaa mu 51.7% bere a NPP mmarahyɛbadwani Ernest Arthur nyaa amba 19,714 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoo no nyinaa mu 48.3%.

Ɔsoafoɔ 
Afe 2016 mu no, Ricketts-Hagan bɛyɛɛ ɔsoafoɔ wɔ Ghana Mfinifini Manta.m Odii dwuma wɔ Ghana Aban som adwuma mu sɛ sikasɛm soafoɔ abadiakyiri firi afe 2013 kosi afe 2014 ne ɔman soafoɔ abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Aguadiɛ ne Nnwuma so firi afe 2014 kosi afe 2016.

Boayikuw ahorow 
Ricketts-Hagan yɛ Dibea a Ɔyɛ Hokwan Boayikuw no muni, ɔsan yɛ Bɔbeasu ne Mmofra Boayikuw no muni na ɔsan yɛ Aguadi, Nnwuma ne Nsrahwɛ Boayikuw no muni.

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Ricketts-Hagan yɛ Kristoni. Waware na ɔwɔ mma baanum

Akyinnyegye 
Wɔ Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 2021 mu no, Owura Ernest Arthur a na ɔyɛ Metropolitan Chief Executive for Cape Coast no de Ricketts-Hagan kɔɔ asɛnnibea wɔ ne nsɛm a ɔde bɔɔ no ahohora no ho. Cape Coast Asɛnnibea Kunini no ka kyerɛɛ Ricketts-Hagan sɛ ɔnsan n’akyi na ɔmpa Owura Arthur kyɛw. Wɔsan nso bɔɔ Ricketts-Hagan ka GH¢100,000.

title: Farouk Aliu Mahama
text:
Umar Farouk Aliu Mahama (wɔwoo no 27 Ayɛwohomumɔ 1981) yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ a ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party (NPP) muni. Ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma Yendi Mantam no mu nkonimdie wɔ afe 2020 mmarahyɛ bagua abatoɔ mu akyi.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Mahama nyaa ne mfitiaseɛ nwomasua wɔ Sakasaka Presby Experimental School wɔ Tamale ne Achimota sukuu mu. Ɔkɔɔ ntoaso sukuu wɔ Prempeh College a ɛwɔ Kumasi, Ashanti Mantam mu. Afei ɔkɔɔ Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration (GIMPA) baabi a owiee ne Bachelor of Science abodin krataa wɔ aguadi mu.

Mahama nso wɔ master's degree wɔ Supply Chain Management mu wɔ Coventry University a ɛwɔ England, United Kingdom na ɔsan nso wɔ adansedi krataa International Supply Chain Professional a ɔnya fii International Purchasing and Supply Chain Management Institute-USA.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔ Ayɛwohomummɔ 2020 mu no, Mahama dii nkonim wɔ primaries mu na wɔbɔɔ no dawuru sɛ ɔyɛ Foforo Patriotic Party (NPP) Mmarahyɛbadwa no muni a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ Yendi mantam a ɛwɔ Atifi Mantam mu ansa na afe 2020 mmarahyɛ bagua ne ɔmampanyin abatow no aba. Wɔpaee mu kae sɛ Mahama yɛ nkonimdifo bere a ɔtoo abatow 244 tiaa Abibata Shanni Mahama Zakaria, a ɔyɛ Microfinance and Loans Center (MASLOC) no sohwɛfo panyin abadiakyiri ne Baba Daney, Chartered Accountant a onyaa abatow 210 ne 139 

Wɔ Ɔpɛnimma 2020 mu no, odii nkonim wɔ 2020 December mmarahyɛbadwa abatow mu maa Yendi Mantam no. Wɔpaee mu kae sɛ ɔyɛ nkonimdifo bere a onyaa abatow 40,624 tiaa nea ɔbɛn no paa Alhassan Abdul Fatawu a ofi National Democratic Congress (NDC) a na ɔwɔ abatow 24,755 no.

Mahama gye adwuma no fi Mohammed Habib Tijani, Ɔmanpanyin Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ amannɔne nsɛm so wɔ Akufo- ase no nsam. Addo aban, a na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛ baguani firi berɛ a ɔsan gyee atenaeɛ maa New Patriotic Party wɔ afe 2012 abatoɔ no mu nanso ɔsii gyinaeɛ sɛ ɔrensi akan wɔ afe 2020 abatoɔ no mu.

Adwuma 
Wɔ Oforisuo 2021 mu no, Nana Akufo-Addo paw Farouk sɛ adwumakuo no chair of the Ghana Integrated Iron and Steel Corporation.

N'asetena 
Ɔyɛ Ghana ɔmanpanyin ne kan ɔmampanyin abadiakyiri owufo Aliu Mahama ne Hajia Ramatu Mahama ba. Alhaji Imoro Egala yɛ Farouk nana a ɔyɛ ɛna

title: Francis Asenso-Boakye
text:
Francis Asenso-Boakye (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn 24, 1977) yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ ne aguadifoɔ.Ɔyɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni. Ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma Bantama Mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Na ɔyɛ Adwumayɛfoɔ Panyin abadiakyiri ne Nana Addo Dankwa Akufo-Addo Amanyɔsɛm Boafoɔ; Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanyin so. Mprempren ɔyɛ Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ Adwumayɛ ne Adan Ho so.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo no wɔ 24 Ɛbɔ 1977 na ɔfiri Maase wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.[6] Ansa na ɔrebɛka amammuisɛm titire ho wɔ Ghana no, na ɔyɛ sukuuni a ɔyɛ ɔman ho dɔ Kuw Foforo a ɔyɛɛ akwampaefo adwuma wɔ kuw no mu adesuafo kuw a ɛwɔ sukuupɔn mu, Tertiary Students Confederacy of the New Patriotic Party (TESCON[7) no a wɔhyehyɛɛ no ​​mu ]), na ɔsom sɛ ne Titenani a Ɔhyehyɛɛ no ​​bere a na ɔreyɛ ne mfitiase adesua wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma Sukuupɔn (KNUST) mu. Asenso-Boakye bere a owiee abodin krataa wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so no, onyaa abodin krataa wɔ Ɔmanfo Nhyehyɛe ne Adwumayɛ mu sɛ Rotary Ɔbenfo wɔ Michigan State University, Michigan, USA.

Adwuma 
Sɛ́ nkɔso nhyehyɛe, adwuma sohwɛ, ne nhyehyɛe ho ɔbenfo adwumayɛfo no, Asenso-Boakye wɔ mfe pii adwumayɛfo osuahu a ɛtrɛw wɔ saa nnwuma yi mu. Ansa na ɔrebɛka HE Nana Addo Dankwa Akufo-Addo adwumayɛfoɔ ne ɔsatuo ho no, na ɔwɔ dibea wɔ Ministry of Employment and Social Welfare (MESW), Global Media Alliance (GMA), Delta Acquisitions and Development, Delaware, USA, Michigan House of Ananmusifoɔ, Michigan, USA, Nhyehyɛeɛ sohwɛfoɔ wɔ Ghana Free Zones Board (GFZB), Project Manager ma Tema Export Processing Zone (TEPZ)ne Nhwehwɛmu Nhwehwɛmufoɔ wɔ Ghana Investment Promotion Center (GIPC).[8]

Sɛnea a Project Analyst wɔ Delta Acquisitions and Development, LLC, Delaware, USA, Asenso-Boakye na ɔhwɛɛ na ɔhwɛɛ adwumakuo no adan ne afie a wɔagye ne nkɔsoɔ so na ɔhwɛɛ afie/duplex a wɔsi wɔ Dover, Delaware.

Asenso-Boakye nso som sɛ nhyehyɛe ne nhwehwɛmu boafo wɔ Office of State Representative ne Michigan Legislative Black Caucus (MLBC) – Michigan House of Representatives, USA, faako a n’adwuma no twee adwene sii nhyehyɛe ne mmara ho nsɛm a ɛka Afrika Amerikafo ne nnipa kakraa bi anigye so. 9] . Bere a ɔsan baa Ghana no, Asenso-Boakye yɛɛ adwuma maa saa bere no NPP Presidential Candidate ne mprempren president of the republic of Ghana; Nana Addo Dankwa Akufo-Addo sɛ Amammui Boafoɔ dibea a wadi mu kɔsi sɛ wɔpaw no sɛ ɔnyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani.

Amanyɔsɛm asetena 
Wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2017 mu no, wɔpaw Francis Asenso-Boakye sɛ amammui boafoɔ ne Ɔpanin Abadiakyiri adwumayɛfoɔ wɔ Flagstaff Fie a Ɔmampanyin Nana Addo Dankwa Akufo-Addo yɛeɛ.Wɔ Ayɛwohomummɔ 2020 mu no, Asenso-Boakye dii nkonim wɔ Bantama NPP primaries mu tiaa Daniel Okyem Aboagye a ɔdi tumi seesei no de bɔɔ mmɔden sɛ ɔbɛsi akan wɔ Ghana Mmarahyɛ Bagua no mu.Wɔ afe 2020 Amansan Abatoɔ mu no, ɔnyaa abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 88.84% sɛ ɔbɛpue sɛ Bantama (Ghana mmarahyɛbadwa mantam) mmarahyɛbadwa ananmusifoɔ. Ne saa nti, wɔayi no sɛ ɔsomfoɔ a wɔayi no ama Ministry of Works and Housing (Ghana).

Boayikuo 
Asenso-Boakye yɛ Aban Awerɛhyɛmu Boayikuo no muni na ɔsan nso yɛ Asase ne Kwaeɛ Boayikuo no muni .[6]

N'asetena 
Asenso-Boakye aware a ɔwɔ mma mmiɛnsa. Ɔyɛ Kristoni.

title: Kwamena Minta Nyarku
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Kwamena Minta Nyarku (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛnimma) yɛ Ghanani nhomasua ne amanyɔni a ɔyɛ National Democratic Congress (NDC) muni.[1][2][3] Ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma Cape Coast Atifi Mmarahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Ghana Mfinifini Mantam.

Ne mmofrase ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Nyarku wɔ Ɔpɛnimma bosome da a ɛtɔ do nson (7) afe 1974. Ofiri Apewosika, Cape Coast wɔ Ghana Mfinifini Mantam.[4] Ɔwiee ne GCE Ordinary level ne GCE Advanced level adansedie krataa wɔ Adwumayɛ mu wɔ afe 1992 ne 1996 mu wɔ Adisadel Kɔlege, Cape Coast. Ɔsan kɔɔ Komenda Nteteeɛ Kɔlege wieeɛ ne Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ Abodin krataa A (3 year Post Sec Teacher Cert A) wɔ afe 1995 mu.[5][6] Wɔ afe 2000 mu no, owiee bachelor’s degree wɔ nhomasua mu a osii Adwumayɛ Nhomasua so dua wɔ Cape Coast Sukuupɔn mu.[7][4] Ɔkɔɔ Ghana Suapɔn Adwumayɛ Sukuu mu, na ɔwiee Master of Business Administration (MBA) wɔ Marketing mu wɔ afe 2003. Ɔsan nso wiee sukuu wɔ Leicester Suapɔn mu, baabi a ɔwiee Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) wɔ Marketing mu wɔ afe 2019 mu ne Chartered Institute of Marketing a ɛwɔ United Kingdom.[5]

Adwuma 
Nyarku yɛ Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ Panyin wɔ Department of Marketing and Supply Chain Management, School of Business, Cape Coast Suapɔn, Ghana.[7][2][8][9]

Amanyɔsɛm

Mmarahyɛ Badwa no mu mmɔdenbɔ 
Nyarku gyinaa National Democratic Congress primaries anim ansa na afe 2020 abatoɔ no reba. Odii nkonim wɔ mmarahyɛ badwa no mu sɛ ɔbɛgyina National Democratic Congress ananmu ama Ɔmansin no wɔ Oforisuo 2019 mu wɔ bere a wankɔ a wɔansɔre atia no ɛnam sɛ wɔn a wɔrepere no mmienu no amfata nti.

Mmarahyɛbadwani 
Nyarku kaa ntam sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani a ogyina Cape Coast Atifi Mmarahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa ananmu wɔ Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so awɔtwe (8) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan no mu wɔ 7 Ɔbɛnem 2021. Ɔsom sɛ ɔmannifoɔ wɔ Ohia a wɔbɛtew so ho nhyehyɛeɛ Boayikuo no mu.

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Nyarku yɛ Kristoni. Wɔyɛ obi a nkurɔfo nim no a wɔde ne din Ragga frɛ no.

title: Francis-Xavier Kojo Sosu
text:
Francis-Xavier Kojo Sosu (wɔwoo no 12 Ɔgyefo 1979) yɛ Ghana Mmaranimfo ne ɔmanyɛfo. Ɔyɛ Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛbadwa NDC no muni. Mprempren ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛto so 8 a ɛwɔ Ghana a ɛto so 4 no muni a ogyina Madina Mantam no ananmu. Ɔsan nso yɛ Mmarahyɛbadwa no Amanyɔ Mmara, Mmara ne Mmarahyɛbadwa Nsɛm Boayikuw no muni Abadiakyiri.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Ɔyɛ Denu kuromni wɔ Firaw Mantam mu nanso wɔwoo no wɔ Accra New Town. Ɔkɔɔ St John's Grammar Senior ntoaso sukuu. Sosu anya Bachelor of Arts (BA) (Honors) wɔ Sociology mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu ne Bachelor of Law (LLB) nso wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu. Ɔsan kɔɔ Ghana School of Law kɔhwehwɛɛ Professional Certificate sɛ ɔnyɛ mmaranimfo na wɔfrɛɛ no ​​kɔɔ Bar wɔ Ahinime 2010 mu. Sosu wɔ master’s degree wɔ Oil and Gas Law (LLM) mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu. Ɔsan nso wɔ Master of Arts (MA) abodin krataa wɔ Economic Policy Management mu, firi Economics Department of University of Ghana ne Master of Philosophy (MPhil) wɔ Conflict, Human Rights and Peace Studies mu wɔ University of Education, Winneba.

Adwuma 
Sosu yɛ mmaranimfo wɔ n’adwuma mu. Ɔhyɛɛ aseɛ sɛ mmaranimfoɔ wɔ Logan & Associates ansa na ɔrehyehyɛ FX Law & Associates, Human Rights and Public Interest Law firm a ɛrenya nkɔsoɔ wɔ Accra wɔ afe 2012 mu, a mprempren ɔsom sɛ Managing Partner.

Amanyɔsɛm

Parliamentary bid 
Wɔpaw Sosu sɛ National Democratic Congress candidate ma Madina Constituency ma afe 2020 mmarahyɛbadwa abatow no bere a onyaa abatow 661 de dii nea ɔbɛn no paa Sidii Abubakar a na ɔyɛ Ɔman Mmabun Nhyehyɛefo ma kuw no, a ɔnyaa abatow 480 no so nkonim. Ibrahim Hussein Faila dii nea ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 217 a Hajia Rukaya nso nyaa abatoɔ 16 pɛ. Wɔ Obubuo 2015 mu no, ɔdii nkogu ketewaa bi wɔ primary a ɛte saa ara mu tiaa Amadu Bukari Sorogho a na ɔdi tumi saa berɛ no. Sosu nyaa abatoɔ 1,486 a ɛne abatoɔ 1,738 a Sorogho a na ɔgyina amansin no ananmu firi afe 2005 nanso awieeɛ koraa no ɔdii nkoguo wɔ Abu-Bakar Saddique Boniface anim.

Wɔ afe 2020 Abatoɔ no mu no, Sosu dii mmarahyɛ baguani a ɔdi tumi seesei, Abu- so nkonim. Bakar Saddique Boniface kan Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ Zongo ne Kuropɔn Nkɔsoɔ so denam abatoɔ 62,127 a ɔnyaeɛ tiaa ne abatoɔ 46,985 a ɔde too dwa sɛ wɔbɛpaw no sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani a wɔayi no ama Madina Mantam no mu.

Mmarahyɛbadwa no mu ni 
Sosu kaa ntam wɔ sɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni a ɔgyinaa Madina Mantam no ananmu wɔ Ghana Ɔmanpanin a ɛtɔ so nnan Mmarahyɛ Bagua a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe mu wɔ 7 Ɔbɛnem 2021. Ɔsom sɛ ɔmannifoɔ wɔ Amansan Mmara, Mmara ne Mmarahyɛbadwa Nsɛm Boayikuo ne Mmarahyɛbadwa no Apawfoɔ Boayikuo mu.

N'asetena 
Sosu aware Felicia Adwoa Konadu Sosu na wɔaka abom wɔ mma 4: ɔbabea a ɔdi kan a wɔfrɛ no Marita Klenam Pokua Sosu ne mmabarima baanu, Francis-Xavier Kadi Sosu (Jnr) ne Ian-Xavier Eli Sosu. Wɔn babea a otwa to no din de Mia Gayra Ahenkan Sosu.

title: Frederick Obeng Adom
text:
Frederick Obeng Adom' (wɔwoo no 11 Ɔpɛpɔn 1984) yɛ Ghana Amanyɔfoɔ. Ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanin a ɛtɔ so nnan Mmarahyɛbadwa no muni a ɔgyina Upper West Akim Mansin ananmu wɔ Apueeɛ Mantam mu wɔ New Patriotic Party (NPP) tekiti so.Ɔyɛ akwantufoɔ abadiakyiri.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne n'adwuma 
Wɔwoo Adom wɔ 11 Ɔpɛpɔn 1984. Ɔfiri Aburi. Ɔyɛ obi a wawie Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration, baabi a wɔmaa no Bachelor of Science marketing wɔ afe 2013 mu. Na ɔyɛ Fonak Technologies Ltd adwumayɛ nkɔso sohwɛfo ne Surveying Precision Market Ltd adwumayɛfo panyin.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Adom yɛ New Patriotic Party (NPP) no muni. Wɔ June 2020 NPP parliamentary primaries mu no, ɔsii akan na ɔdii nkonim sɛ ɔbɛgyina NPP ananmu wɔ 2020 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ Upper West Akim Abatoɔ Mpɛsua nkongua so wɔ amansan abatoɔ no mu de yii mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔdi tumi seesei Ohene Assifo Derek Bekoe a ɔfiri NDC, Ɔtoo abatoɔ a ɛfata no mu 21,863. Ɔsom sɛ House Committee ne Mines and Energy Committee no muni wɔ Fourth Republic of Ghana Mmarahyɛbadwa a Ɛto so Nwɔtwe no mu.

Ɔmampanyin Nana Akufo-Addo na ɔyii no na ɔpaw no sɛ akwantuo soafoɔ abadiakyiri.

title: Kwame Governs Agbodza
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Kwame Governs Agbodza yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so nson a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan no muni a ogyina Adaklu Mmarahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa ananmu wɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so. Mprempren ɔyɛ Chief Whip wɔ Ghana Mmarahyɛ Badwa no mu.

Ne mmofrase ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Kwame Governs wɔ 22 September 1973 wɔ Adaklu Kordiabe a ɛwɔ Volta mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Afei onyaa ne Diploma wɔ adansi ho adesua akyi wɔ Westminster Suapɔn mu, toaso nyaa ne Diploma wɔ adansi mu wɔ East London suapɔn mu. Afei ɔsan kɔɔ Ghana kɔyɛɛ ne Bachelor of Science abodin krataa wɔ architecture mu wɔ kwame Nkrumah University of science and technology . Ɔkɔɔ Royal institute of British Architects sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a obenya ne chartered architecture adansedi krataa na onyaa chartered architecture adansedi krataa foforo nso.

Adwuma 
Kwame Governs yɛ managing director ma southworld technical services firi afe 1999 de bɛsi ɛnnɛ, ɔyɛ adwumayɛfoɔ panin wɔ Architects Co partners firi afe 2010 de bɛsi ɛnnɛ na ɔsan yɛ adwumayɛfoɔ panin wɔ kay ne partners firi afe 2012 de bɛsi ɛnnɛ.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Kwame Governs dii nkonim wɔ atenaeɛ no mu wɔ abatoɔ 11,825 mu wɔ abatoɔ 13,440 a ɛfata a wɔde too gua a ɛne 87.98% yɛ pɛ. Afei Mmarahyɛ Badwa no paw no sɛ ɔmmɛka Akwan ne akwantu ho boayikuw ne emufo a wokura mfaso boayikuw no adwumayɛbea ahorow no ho.

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Wɔkyerɛ sɛ ɔyɛ Kristoni na waware a ɔwɔ mma baanu (2).

title: Frimpong Yaw Addo
text:
Frimpong Yaw Addo yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ ne Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson a ɛwɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan ne mmarahyɛbadwa awotwe a ɛwɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no muni a ɔgyina Manso Adubia Mansin ananmu wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so.  . Mprempren ɔyɛ Ɔmanpanyin Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Aduan ne Kuadwuma so.

Mfitiase asetena ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Addo wɔ 2 Ɛbɔ 1962 wɔ kurow bi a wɔfrɛ no Manso Gyeduako mu wɔ Amansie Anafo fam Ɔmantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu. Ɔnyaa ne Bachelor of Arts abodin krataa wɔ Sociology ne Diploma wɔ Borɔfo kasa mu wɔ Cape Coast Sukuupɔn mu. Ɔsan nso nyaa ne Executive Masters adansedie krataa wɔ Ntawntawdi, Asomdwoeɛ ne Ahobanbɔ mu wɔ afe 2016 mu wɔ Kofi Annan Amanaman Ntam Asomdwoeɛ Nteteeɛ Asoɛeɛ a ɛwɔ Accra.

Adwumayɛ 
Addo yɛ Manager wɔ nnwumakuw nsɛm dwumadibea wɔ Private Ent. Fapem. Na ɔsan yɛ Social and Environment impact ho ɔbenfo wɔ Comptran Engineering. Na ɔsan yɛ Asetena ne Atwa Yɛn Ho Ahyia nkɛntɛnso ho ɔbenfo wɔ Transtel Consult. Ɔsan nso yɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ntam nkitahodifoɔ wɔ National Democratic Institute for International Affairs.

Amanyɔsɛm adwuma 
Addo yɛ New Patriotic Party no muni na mprempren ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma Manso Adubia Abatoɔ Mpɛsua wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu. Ɔbɛyɛɛ MP a odi kan wɔ ne mansin mu bere a ɔdaa ne ho adi wɔ 2012 Ghana Amansan Abatow mu no. Afei wɔsan paw no bio maa ne mprenu so wɔ afe 2016 Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ mu baabi a ɔnyaa abatoɔ a wɔtoo no nyinaa mu 69.86%. Wɔ afe 2020 Amansan abatoɔ mu no, ɔdii nkonim wɔ mmarahyɛ bagua no mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 17,652 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 38.8% berɛ a NDC mmarahyɛbadwa no muni Simon Kwaku Agyei nyaa abatoɔ 10,753 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ no nyinaa mu 23.6%. Independent kandifoɔ Kofi Osei-Afoakwa nso nyaa abatoɔ 17,149 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 37.7%.

Boayikuo 
Addo yɛ Ohia a wɔbɛtew so ho nhyehyɛeɛ Boayikuo no muni na ɔsan yɛ Atwa Yɛn Ho Ahyia, Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma Boayikuo no mu ni

N'asetena 
Ɔyɛ Kristoni na waware na ɔwɔ mma baanum.N’ani gye kuayɛ ne bɔɔlbɔ ho.

title: Eric Opoku (politician)
text:
Eric Opoku yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so nson (7) ne Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4) no muni a ogyina Asunafo Anafoɔ Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa ananmu wɔ Brong-Ahafo Mantam mu wɔ Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛ Badwa (National Democratic Congress) tekiti so.

Ne mmofrase ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Eric Opoku wɔ Ayɛwohomumɔ bosome da a ɛtɔ anum (5) afe 1970. Ofiri kuro bi a wɔfrɛ no Sankore a ɛwɔ Brong Ahafo mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Onyaa ne Bachelor of Arts abodin krataa wɔ Asetra mu Nyansahu mu (Bachelor of Arts degree in Social Science) wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma mu (Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology) wɔ afe 2004 mu.

Adwuma 
Opoku yɛ okuafoɔ (farmer)/ kuayɛfoɔ (agriculturist). Ansa na wɔrepaw no sɛ ɔnyɛ mmarahyɛ badwa no, ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ (teacher) wɔ Ghana Nhomasua Dwumadibea (Ghana Education Service) wɔ SDA Mfitiaseɛ Sukuu (SDA Primary School) a ɛwɔ Sankore, firi afe 1997 kosi afe 2000. Ɔne Kuapa Kookoo Ltd nso ayɛ adwuma sɛ Asafo Nkɔsoɔ Ɔkyerɛwfoɔ Society Development Secretary) firi afe 1998 kosi afe 2001.

Amanyɔsɛm adwuma 
Wɔdii kan paw Opoku sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ mmarahyɛ badwa wɔ mmarahyɛ badwa a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa (3) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4) mu sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma Asunafo Anafoɔ Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Brong Ahafo mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɛwom sɛ ɔhweree n’akongua wɔ abatoɔ a ɛdi hɔ no mu deɛ, nanso wɔsan paw no sɛ ɔkɔɔ mmarahyɛ badwa mu wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da a ɛtɔ so nson (7) afe 2013 mu bere a ɔkaa sɛ odii nkonim wɔ afe 2012 Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ no mu sɛ ɔbɛgyina Asunafo Anafoɔ Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa ananmu na ɔdii dwuma kosii Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da a ɛtɔ so nsia (6) afe 2017 mu. Afei wɔsan paw no wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da a ɛtɔ so nson (7) afe 2017 wɔ afe 2016 Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ no akyi baabi a onyaa abatoɔ a ɛfata no mu 52.97%.

Ɔayɛ adwuma sɛ Brong Ahafo Ɔmantam Ɔsoafoɔ Abadiakyiri (Deputy Brong Ahafo Regional Minister) firi afe 2009 kosi afe 2013.  Wɔ mmarahyɛ badwa a ɛtɔ so nson (7) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4) no mu no ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ Aduan (Food), Kuadwuma (Agriculture) ne Kokoo Nsɛm (Cocoa Affairs) Boayikuo no mu sɛ Ɔsoafoɔ a odi kan (ranking Member).  Ɔsan nso som wɔ Hokwan Boayikuw (Privileges Committee) ne Nnipa a Wɔpaw Wɔn Boayikuw (Appointments Committee) no mu wɔ mmarahyɛ badwa koro no ara mu.

Opoku nyaa abasobɔdeɛ sɛ mmarahyɛ badwani a ɔsen biara wɔ mpɔtam ne nkuraaseɛ nkɔsoɔ ho wɔ afe 2017 mu firii Bureau a wɔyɛ Nhwehwɛmu wɔ Aban, Aguadi ne Adwumayɛ ho (Bureau of Research on Governance, Commerce and Administration - BORGCA) hɔ. Wɔde saa abasobɔdeɛ yi maeɛ wɔ ne mmoa a ɔde maeɛ wɔ nkɔsoɔ nnwuma mu wɔ Asunafo Anafoɔ Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa mu.

Abatow 
Wɔpaw Opoku sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani maa Asunafo Anafoɔ Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Brong Ahafo mantam mu wɔ Ghana wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow mu. Odii nkonim wɔ Ɔman Demokrasi Nhyiam Kuw (National Democratic Congress) tekiti so. Na ne mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa no yɛ mmarahyɛ badwa nkongua du (10) no fa wɔ nkongua aduonu anan (24) a Ɔman Demokrasi Nhyiam Kuw (National Democratic Congress) dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Brong Ahafo mantam no mu. Asunafo Anafoɔ Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa no hunuu ‘skirt ne blouse’ a abatoɔfoɔ too aba wɔ saa abatoɔ no mu ɛfiri sɛ ɔmampanyin a wɔpaw no a mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa mu abatoɔfoɔ no paw no ne John Kufour a ofiri ɔsɔretia kɛseɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforɔ (New Patriotic Party) mu. Ɔman Demokrasi Nhyiam Kuw (National Democratic Congress) dii nkonim kakraa bi a ne nyinaa yɛ mmarahyɛ badwa nkongua aduonkron anan (94) wɔ nkongua ahanu aduasa (230) mu wɔ saa abatow no mu. Wɔde amba 14,076 na ɛpaw Opoku wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 29,345, a ɛne abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 48% yɛ pɛ. Onyaa amba sen George William Amponsah a ofi Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforɔ (New Patriotic Party) no mu, Jack Kennedy Brobbey a ɔyɛ ɔkannifo a ɔde ne ho (independent candidate) ne Fredrick Nkrumah a ofi Nhyiam Nnipa Kuw (Convention People's Party) no mu. Eyinom nyaa abatow a ɛfata nyinaa mu 43.80%, 7.30% ne 0.90%. 

Wɔsan paw Opoku wɔ afe 2020 Mmarahyɛ Badwa abatoɔ mu sɛ ɔmmɛgyina wɔn ananmu wɔ mmarahyɛ badwa a ɛtɔ so awɔtwe (8) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4) no mu.

To hyɛ (Attack) 
Wɔtow hyɛɛ Opoku so wɔ ne fie wɔ Ɔpɛnimma bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduonu anum (25) 2017 wɔ Sankore wɔ Brong Ahafo mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛ Badwa (National Democratic Congress) no bɔɔ sobo sɛ na ntuafo no yɛ wɔn a wokurakura akode a wɔtaa asɔretiafo Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo (New Patriotic Party) no akyi. Wɔtow hyɛɛ no so ne mprenu so (second time), wɔ Oforisuo bosome da a ɛtɔ so baako afe 2018, nso wɔ ne fie wɔ Sankore a mmarima a wokurakura akode. Ɛwom sɛ wɔanpira ntuafo no de, wɔkyerɛ sɛ wɔde sika bɛyɛ GHS 10,400.00, television ne decoder bi kɔe na wɔsɛee Opoku kar abiɛsa.

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Opoku yɛ Kristoni.. Waware na ɔwɔ mma baanan (4)..

title: Geoffrey Kini
text:
Geoffrey Kini (wɔwoo no Yawɔda 1 Ɔpɛpɔn 1970) yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ ne Mmarahyɛbadwa a Ɛtɔ so Nwɔtwe no mu ni a ogyina Nkwanta Anafoɔ Mansin ananmu wɔ Oti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Geoffrey Kini na ofiri Bakpa New Town a ɛwɔ Oti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Geoffrey Kini nyaa ne Middle School Leaving Certificate (MSLC) wɔ afe 1985 mu, 2nd Division wɔ afe 1991 mu ne ne Bachelor’s degree wɔ Human resource management (2nd Class Upper) wɔ afe 2017. Ɔsan nso yɛ Graduate (Conflict Peace and Security) wɔ afe 2020 mu.

Adwuma 
Geoffrey Kini yɛ Kini Geoffrey adwumayɛfo panyin (CEO). Ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ managing director wɔ FairCom (A Database Technology Company) firi afe 1994 kɔsi afe 2016. Seesei ɔreyɛ adwuma sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwa no muni (MP) ama Nkwanta South Abatoɔ Mpɛsua wɔ Oti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Amammuo asetena 
Geoffrey Kini sii akan na odii nkonim wɔ afe 2016 NDC mmarahyɛbadwa primaries mu maa Nkwanta South Abatoɔ Mpɛsua wɔ Oti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.Geoffrey Kini toaa so nyaa mmarahyɛ bagua atenaeɛ wɔ ne mansin (Nkwanta South Constituency) mu wɔ Oti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana wɔ afe 2016 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so sɛ ɔbɛka Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson (7) a ɛwɔ Fourth Republic of Ghana no ho na ɔnyaa abatoɔ 21,691 (59.3%) tiaa Edusei Cephas Kujo a ɔfiri New Patriotic Party a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 8,903 (24.4%), Njonam Wisdom Wagya (An Independent Candidate) a ɔno nso nyaa abatoɔ 5,670 (15.5%) ne Nyame Maxwell a ɔfiri Convention People’s Party no mu (CPP) a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 297 (0.8%).

Geoffrey Kini san sii akan na ɔdii nkonim wɔ afe 2020 NDC mmarahyɛbadwa primaries mu maa Nkwanta South Abatoɔ Mpɛsua wɔ Oti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana de aba 891 tiaa Richard Manuribe a na ɔwɔ abatow 189. Geoffrey Kini san kɔɔ so dii nkonim wɔ afe 2020 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so sɛ ɔbɛkɔ akɔka Mmarahyɛbadwa a Ɛto so Nwɔtwe (8) a ɛwɔ Fourth Republic of Ghana no mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 29,189 (57.7%) tiaa Sherifa Sekyere-Tijani a ɔfiri New Patriotic no mu Party a onyaa abatow 20,272 (40.1%) ne Ograh Felix William a ofi Progressive People's Party(PPP) a onyaa abatow 1,127 (2.2%).

Boayikuw 
Geoffrey Kini yɛ ɔman no muni Daa Ahyɛde Boayikuw. Ɔsan nso yɛ Communications Committee a ɛwɔ Fourth Republic of Ghana Mmarahyɛbadwa a Ɛto so Awotwe (8) no muni.

N'asetena 
Geoffrey Kini yɛ Kristoni.

Adɔyɛ 
Geoffrey Kini de ntoboa Cement Nkotoku Ɔha de maa Breweniase Akwahosan Asoɛe sɛ wɔmfa mmoa mma wɔnsi laboratory unit wɔ health center.

Geoffrey Kini de Cement Bags Ɔha(100) maa Bonakye mpɔtam hɔfo wɔ Nkwanta South Constituency sɛ wɔbɛboa ma wɔasisi beaeɛ foforɔ wɔ Akwahosan Asoɛeɛ hɔ ɛfiri sɛ Chief ne Bonakyefoɔ de adesrɛ too dwa sɛ wɔpɛ sɛ wɔde adan foforɔ si hɔ de trɛw wɔn akwahosan asoɛeɛ no mu sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a ɛho renhia sɛ nkurɔfoɔ tu kwan nkɔ Nkwanta ansa na wɔanya akwahosan ho dwumadie titire. 

Geoffrey Kini san de moto maa St. Joseph Katolek Ayaresabea ne Municipal Ayaresabea a ɛwɔ ne mantam(Nkwanta South Constituency) a ɛwɔ Oti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana efisɛ na wonni kar biara a wɔde bɛhwɛ ntɛmpɛ so na wɔasan nso ayɛ mmerɛw akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔbaa COVID-19 ɔyaredɔm no ase no tu. Sɛ yɛde moto no to nkyɛn a, Geoffrey Kini nso de sika a ɛyɛ GHc10,000 maa ayaresabea no sɛ ɛbɛboa wɔn ma wɔatɔ Personal Protective Equipment (PPEs) de abɔ wɔn ho ban. Geoffrey Kini san de nnuru a wɔde kum mmoawa, nnuru a wɔde tew nsa, samina a ɛyɛ nsu ne nneɛma afoforo galɔn pii mae.

title: Mohammed Elsannour
text:
Mohammad Ayman Elsannour (Arab kasa: محمد أيمن السنور) yɛ Misrini ɔkyerɛwfo, ayɛsɛm kyerɛwfo, ne nnuruyɛfo. Wɔwoo no wɔ United Arab Emirates.

Asetena mmu nsem 
Wo wo nu etitii no wo kro bi a yefre no Al Ain, Abu Dhabi. na ɔnya master’s degree wɔ biochemistry mu, ne master’s degree wɔ amanaman ntam nnipa ahoɔden sohwɛ mu ne master’s wɔ akwahosan ho nnoɔma foforɔ mu firi France ne United States of America.

Ne nkyerɛwee no twe adwene si nsɛm a ɛfa mmusua mu nyiyim ho ne Arabfo mfiase a wɔkora so nso so. 

Ɔakyerɛw ayɛsɛm ahorow pii, a nea ɛka ho ne Louise Membership (2019), a ɛfa nnuruyɛ adwumakuw bi a wɔfrɛ no Louise ho, ne Placebo (2020), Om Ghafa (2020), ne I Can't Breathe (2020).  .

Nwoma a wɔatwere 
Louise AsɔremmaEdit

Midwest Book Review kyerɛw sɛ Louise Membership yɛ "adwumakuw a wɔyɛ nnuru a wɔfrɛ no Louise, a nokwarem no ɛyɛ basabasayɛ kuw a ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ yiye na ɛyɛ wiase nyinaa." Nhwehwɛmu bi a Monika Kosman yɛe wɔ Global Comment mu ka Louise Membership ho asɛm sɛ "mfonini a ɛka koma na ɛyɛ anifere a ɛkyerɛ sɛnea nnubɔne nnwumakuw anim ankasa," na ɔhyɛ no nsow sɛ nsɛmmɔnedi Nkonimdi a wɔde mae wɔ ayɛsɛm mu wɔ saa adwuma yi ho no "Misrifo Mfinimfini Asoɛe no de anigye kɛse gyee no, efisɛ wobu ne nhoma no sɛ ɛyɛ nhyɛso fibea ma polisifo pii a wɔyɛ adwuma wɔ sum ase aguadi ne nnubɔnetɔn adwuma foforo wɔ Mfinimfini Apuei."

Nhwehwɛmu bi a Tony Ramzy yɛe wɔ Arabian Book Review mu ka sɛ Louise Membership "yɛ akenkan a ennyae, a wɔhyɛ. Ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ ɔkenkanfo no so te sɛ nnubɔne, na ɛma ɔkɔm de wo sɛ wobɛdan kratafa no, sɛ wobɛkenkan pii, pii Sɛ wobɛhwehwɛ pii, pii wɔ sum no mu.Ɛyɛ akenkan a ɛyɛ anigye, ɛyɛ hu —ɛte sɛ ayɛsɛm a ɛyɛ hu a eye sen biara, nsɛmmɔnedi ho ayɛsɛm a ɛkorɔn sen biara, na awiei koraa no, ayɛsɛm no gyina hɔ sɛ emu biako a eye literature mu ejuma kesi ." 

Ɔsan de ka ho sɛ, "sɛ nnipa a wɔka ho asɛm no da so ara wɔ tumi a wɔde kanyan atirisopam na wɔma akwanhwɛ yɛ basaa a, sɛ ɛnyɛ sɛ nsɛm no twetwe ɔkenkanfo no nko, na mmom ɛbɔ ne ti kosi sɛ ɔbɛtra ase ahu sɛ ebia wɔde wɔn ani asi no so ampa, enti “Louise Membership”, ne tiawa koraa no, nhoma a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔkenkan.".

ME NTUMI NHOME EDIT( I CAN'T BREATHE EDIT)

Me Ntumi NhomeEdit I Can't Breathe EditNhwehwɛmu bi a Fairuz Ahmed yɛe wɔ The Authors of The Middle East mu ka I Can't Breathe ho asɛm sɛ "asɛm a ɛyɛ abofono a ɛfa nnipa a wɔabubu, koma a abubu ne asetra a abubu ho. Elsanour, nokwarem no akyerɛw biribiara ankasa, a enni suban kum biara. Ɔsan ka sɛ "I Can't Breathe, yɛ nwonwa ampa, na ɛwom sɛ ɛyɛ ayɛsɛm ayɛsɛm de, nanso ɛkame ayɛ sɛ ɛyɛ nokware na efi komam kodu baabi a ɛsen biara, titiriw esiane sɛ na Elsanour ho akokwaw wɔ nokwasɛm ne ayɛsɛm a wɔde frafra mu wɔ ɔkwan a ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ na ɛyɛ anigye so kɛse nti." bere koro no ara mu." 

Sarah Khalid kyerɛw wɔ nhwehwɛmu bi a ɔyɛ maa Arabian Book Review mu sɛ "Saa nhoma yi ho hia koraa wɔ si a wɔde besi hɔ, prɛko pɛ, sɛ nnipa a wɔn kɔla gu ahorow no sɔre tia nhyehyɛe bi a ɛwɔ adwemmɔne tia wɔn, na sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ saa nhyehyɛe no sesa."Na ɔka I Can't Breathe ho asɛm sɛ "ɛyɛ anigye kɛse na ɛyɛ adwinni, a nsɛm a ɛyɛ hu kɛse ahyɛ mu ma." Ɔsan nso kyerɛw sɛ I Can't Breathe no "mu yɛ duru yiye, ɛmfa ho sɛ ɛkame ayɛ sɛ ɛwɔ nkratafa 200 no, ɛte sɛ aduan a ɛyɛ dɛ a efi adidibea ahorow a wodi nnuan ntɛmntɛm, a srade wom kɛse na ɛma w'amammerɛ mu kɔm di wo ho dwuma."

Nneɛma a  ɔde ne hwo hyemu 
Ɔde ne ho hyɛɛ amanaman ntam ne Arabfo ɔyɛkyerɛ ahorow pii mu ti sɛ Cairo International Book Fair, Abu Dabi International Book Fair and Sharjah International Book Fair ɛni Arab dwadie bebree, Ɔsan sheshɛ dwumade bebree ɛwɔ tv so.

title: Kwaku Kwarteng
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Kwaku Agyemang Kwarteng (wɔwoo no Ɔgyefoɔ 12, 1969) yɛ Ghana aban mfiridwumayɛfoɔ (civil engineer), sikasɛm ho ɔbenfoɔ (economist), ne amanyɔni. Ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔdi mfeɛ mmienu wɔ Obuasi Anafoɔ Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa mu wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo (New Patriotic Party) no muni na ɔyɛ sikasɛm ɔsoafoɔ abadiakyiri (deputy minister of finance).

Abrabɔ

Ne mmofrase abrabɔ 
Wɔwoo Kwaku Kwarteng wɔ Ɔgyefoɔ bosome da a ɛtɔ so dummiɛnu (12), afe 1969, wɔ Kokofu wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔkɔɔ Kwame Nkrumah Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma Suapɔn (Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology) a ɛwɔ Kumasi a ɛbɛn hɔ no, baabi a onyaa Nyansahu mu Bachelor abodin krataa wɔ aban mfiridwuma mu (Bachelor of Science degree in civil engineering) wɔ afe 1996 mu. Akyiri yi onyaa Nyansahu mu Ɔbenfo abodin krataa nso wɔ aban mfiridwuma ho nimdeɛ mu (Master of Science degree also in civil engineering) wɔ suapɔn koro no ara mu wɔ afe 2013 mu. Ɔsan nso wɔ M.A. wɔ Sikasɛm ho nhyehyɛeɛ mu (M.A. in Economic Policy Management) wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu (University of Ghana) wɔ afe 2009 mu.

Adwuma 
Kwaku Kwarteng adwumayɛ asetra mu dodow no ara ayɛ amanyɔsɛm. Ɔyɛɛ Ghana Aban kasamafoɔ (Government of Ghana spokesperson) wɔ sikasɛm ho (finance) firi afe 2006 kosi afe 2009. Bere a John Agyekum Kufour aban no gyaee tumidi wɔ afe 2009 mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ nhyehyɛe ho ɔfotufo (policy advisor) maa Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo (New Patriotic Party) firi afe 2010 kosi afe 2013.

Wɔ afe 2011 mu no wɔpaw no sɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo (New Patriotic Party)  kandifo sɛ ɔnkɔsi akan wɔ Obuasi Anafoɔ Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa a wɔabɔ no foforo no mu. Wɔ afe 2012 Amansan abatoɔ mu no, ɔne John Alexander Ackon a ofiri Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛ Badwa (National Democratic Congress), Abubakar Sadick Iddris a ofiri Nnipa Kuw a Ɛkɔ Nkɔso (Progressive People’s Party), Aishetu Tahiru a ofiri Ɔman Demokrasi Kuw (National Democratic Party), Mohammed Issifu a ɔfiri People’s National Convention, ne Isaac Fordjour a ɔde ne ho no sii akan (Independent candidate). Kwarteng nyaa amba 31,101 wɔ abatoɔ 48,254 a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ no mu, a ɛyɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 64.45%. Bere a ɔwɔ mmarahyɛ badwa mu no, wasom wɔ boayikuw ahorow pii mu a Nkitahodi Boayikuw (Communications Committee) ne Ohia a Wɔtew So Ho Nhyehyɛe Boayikuw ka ho (Poverty Reduction Strategy Committee).

Wɔ bosome Ɔpɛpɔn afe 2017 mu no, Ɔmanpanyin Nana Akufo-Addo yii Kwarteng ne Charles Adu Boahen sɛ wɔnyɛ sikasɛm soafoɔ abadiakyiri (deputy ministers of finance). Na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ adwuma wɔ Ken Ofori-Atta ase. Mmarahyɛ Badwa no Boayikuo a ɛpaw Kwarteng no hwehwɛɛ mu wɔ bosome Ɔbɛnem afe 2017 mu. Bere a wɔreyɛ ne nhwehwɛmu no, ɔkae sɛ John Dramani Mahama nniso no agyaw cedis ɔpepepem nson (7 billion cedis) a aka a wontuae wɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow a ɛwɔ ɔman no mu no. Nnipa kakraa bi kuw (The minority) no buu asɛm no animtiaa kae sɛ ɛka a ɛte saa biara nni hɔ. Kwarteng nso san kaa ɔpɛ a aban no wɔ sɛ ɔbɛtew mfɛntom (interest rate) no so. Boayikuw no penee so maa dibea a wɔpaw no sɛ ɔnyɛ no.

Wɔ afe 2016 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu no, ɔde amba 32,049 dii nkonim wɔ mmarahyɛ badwa no mu bere a NDC mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ John Alexander Ackon nyaa amba 11,587.

Wɔ afe 2020 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu no, ɔde amba 33,383 dii nkonim wɔ mmarahyɛ badwa no mu bere a NDC mmarahyɛbaguani a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ Faustilove Appiah Kannin nyaa amba 15,141.

Ɔsan nso yɛ Ɔsoafoɔ Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Sikasɛm so (Deputy Minister for Finance).

Boayikuw ahorow 
Ɔsomm sɛ Sikasɛm Boayikuw (Finance Committee) no muni na ɔsan nso yɛɛ Ohia a Wɔtew So Boayikuw (Poverty Reduction Committee) no mu. Bere a ɔwɔ mmarahyɛ badwa mu no, wasom wɔ boayikuw ahorow pii mu a Nkitahodi Boayikuw (Communications Committee) ka ho. Mprempren ɔyɛ Sikasɛm Boayikuw (Finance Committee) no Titenani (Chairperson ) na ɔsan yɛ Nkitahodi Boayikuw no muni.

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Kwarteng aware a ɔwɔ mma baasa (3). Ɔyɛ Katolekni.

title: George Takyi
text:
George Kwabena Obeng Takyi (wɔwoo no 29 Ɔbenim 1965) yɛ akontabufoɔ a wɔagye no atom na seesei ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwa a Ɛtɔ so Nwɔtwe a ɛwɔ Ghana Aman a Ɛto so Anan no muni ma Manso Nkwanta Mansin a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Takyi 29 March 1965 wɔ Mpatuam, wɔ Amansie West District fi afe 1988. Ɔwɔ MBA wɔ Chartered Accountancy, Business Communication mu. Ɔsan nso wɔ PhD kandifoɔ wɔ Akontaabuo, Sikasɛm ne Toɔtua mu.

Adwuma 
Ansa na ɔrekɔ amammuisɛm mu no, Takyi yɛɛ adwuma sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ wɔ Kumasi sukuupɔn a ɛwɔ Nhomasua Suapɔn mu, Winneba.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ɔyɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni na mprempren ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma Manso Nkwanta Mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu.Odii nkonim wɔ NPP Mmarahyɛ Bagua no primaries mu maa Manso Nkwanta atenaeɛ no tiaa Joseph Albert Quarm. Akyiri yi ɔne Bance Musah Osmane a ɔyɛ NDC kandifoɔ sii akan wɔ Ɔpɛnimma 2020 abatoɔ no mu. Takyi nyaa abatoɔ 34,408 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 76.1% de dii nkonim wɔ Manso Nkwanta Abatoɔ Mpɛsua nkongua no so wɔ New Patriotic Party (NPP) tekiti so berɛ a NDC mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ ɔmanpanyin no nyaa abatoɔ 10,798 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 23.9%.

Boayikuo 
Ɔyɛ Aban Awerɛhyɛmu Boayikuo no muni na ɔsan yɛ Aduan, Kuadwuma ne Kokoo Nsɛm Boayikuo no muni.

N'asetena 
Ɔyɛ Kristoni.

Adɔyɛ 
Wɔ Ɔgyefo 2021, ɔde sukuu ntadeɛ bi ne PPE maa sukuu ahodoɔ bi a ɛwɔ Manso Nkwanta Mansin mu wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu.

title: Gifty Twum-Ampofo
text:
Gifty Twum-Ampofo (wɔwoo no Ayɛwohomummɔ 11, 1967) yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ na ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party no Mmarahyɛbadwa no muni. Mprempren ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwa no muni ma Abuakwa Atifi mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Apuei Fam. Ampofo yɛ ɔmanpanyin abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Bɔbeasu, Mmofra ne Asetra mu Ahobammɔ so wɔ Ghana.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Gifty Twum-Ampofo wɔ Ayɛwohomummɔ 11, 1967, wɔ Kukurantumi wɔ Ghana Apuei Mantam mu. Ná ɔwɔ ne BSc. wɔ Abɔde a Nkwa Wom Ho Adesua mu wɔ Ogua Sukuupɔn mu wɔ afe 1997 mu. Ɔsan nyaa ne MBA wɔ Strategic Management mu wɔ afe 2018 mu.Ɔsan nso nyaa ne BSc wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu.

Adwuma 
Ampofo yɛɛ Nyansahu kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ wɔ Akosombo International School ansa na ɔrebɛyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwa no muni.Na ɔsan yɛ Nyansahu Dwumadibea Panyin ne Sɔhwɛ Panyin wɔ Volta Asubɔnten Aban no mu. Mprempren ɔyɛ Ɔmanpanyin Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Nhomasua so a ɔhwɛ Mfiridwuma ne Adwumayɛ Nhomasua Ntetee so.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔ Ɔbenem 2016 mu no, ɔsii akan na ɔdii nkonim wɔ NPP mmarahyɛbadwa primaries mu maa Abuakwa North Constituency wɔ Eastern Region of Ghana wɔ Joseph Boakye Danquah-Adu wuo akyi. Akyiri yi odii nkonim wɔ Abuakwa North Abatoɔ Mpɛsua by-elections no mu a na abatow 10,033 na ɛyɛɛ abatow a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 89.60% bere a Ghana Freedom Party mmarahyɛ baguani Samuel Frimpong nyaa abatow 263 a ɛyɛɛ abatow nyinaa mu 2.35% na United People’s Party mmarahyɛ bagua kandifo Isaac Kwarteng nyaa abatow no nyinaa Abatoɔ 901 na ɛyɛɛ 8.05% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu.

2016 abatoɔ 
Wɔ afe 2016 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu no, ɔdii nkonim wɔ Abuakwa North Abatoɔ Mpɛsua mmarahyɛbadwa atenaeɛ no mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 17,838 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 59.23% berɛ a na ɔyɛ NDC mmarahyɛbadwani kandifoɔ Victor Emmanuel Smith nyaa abatoɔ 11,754 a ɛyɛɛ 39.03% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu na Independent candidate bi Adjei Danquah Patrick nyaa abatoɔ 524 a ɛyɛɛ 1.74% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu.

2020 abatoɔ 
Wɔ afe 2020 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu no, ɔsan dii nkonim wɔ Abuakwa North Constituency mmarahyɛ bagua no mu de abatow 17,653 na ɛyɛɛ abatow a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 53.2% bere a NDC mmarahyɛ bagua no muni Charles Yeboah Darko nyaa abatow 15,551 a ɛyɛɛ abatow a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 46.8%.[15][16]

Boayikuw 
Ɔyɛ ɔyɛ Ɔmanfoɔ Akontaabuo Boayikuo no muni na ɔsan yɛ Amannɔne Nsɛm Boayikuo no mu ni.

N'asetena 
Ɔyɛ okunafoɔ a ɔwɔ mma mmiɛnsa. Ɔyɛ Kristoni na ɔsom sɛ Methodist.

Adɔyɛ 
Wɔ Ɔpɛnimma 2022 mu no, ɔde nnuan maa nnipa bɛboro 35,000 wɔ ne mansin mu.

title: Kwaku Ampratwum-Sarpong
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Kwaku Ampratwum-Sarpong yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so nson (7) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4) ne Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so awɔtwe (9) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4) no muni a ogyina Mampong Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa ananmu wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuo Foforɔ (New Patriotic Party) no tekiti so. Mprempren ɔyɛ Ɔsoafo Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Amannɔne Nsɛm ne Mpɔtam Nkabom so (Deputy Minister for Foreign Affairs and Regional Integration).

Ne mmofrase abrabɔ ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Kwaku Ampratwum-Sarpong wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da a ɛtɔ so awɔtwe (8), afe 1958, wɔ Mampong wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu. Ɔwɔ post graduate abodin krataa wɔ Adan Ho Nsɛm mu (post graduate diploma in Housing Management) wɔ Westminster Suapɔn mu (University of Westminster), London. Ɔkɔɔ ne mfitiaseɛ adesua wɔ Ghana Suapɔn (University of Ghana) mu baabi a onyaa B.A.(Hons) abodin krataa (B.A.Hons Degree). Ɔsan nso wɔ adwumayɛfoɔ adansedie krataa a ɛkɔ anim (advanced executive certificate) a ɛfiri Sukuu a Wɔawie a Ɛhwɛ Aban ne Akannifo So (Graduate School of Governance and Leadership) a ɛwɔ Nkran (Accra), Ghana. Ampratwum-Sarpong nso yɛ Asoɛe a Wɔagye atom a ɛhwɛ Adan ne Akwankyerɛfo Asoɛe (Chartered Institute of Housing and the Institute of Directors) a ɛwɔ United Kingdom no muni a ɔka ho.

Adwuma 
Kwaku Ampratwum-Sarpong yɛ Ɔpanin Abadiakyiri (Deputy High Commissioner) wɔ Ghana Amannɔne Nsɛm Ho Dwumadibea (Ghana's Foreign Affairs Ministry) firi afe 2006 kosi afe 2009 na ɔsan nso yɛ Ghana-India Adwumayɛ Nkitahodiɛ (Ghana-India Business Network), Nkran (Accra) no kwankyerɛfoɔ panin (executive director). Ɔyɛ Amannɔne Nsɛm Boayikuw a ɛwɔ Mmarahyɛ Badwa (Foreign Affairs Committee in Parliament) no mu no Titenani Abadiakyiri (Vice Chairman). Ansa na ɔrekɔ amanyɔsɛm mu no, na Ampratwum-Sarpong yɛ ɔfa som adwuma sohwɛfo (divisional service manager) wɔ Hanover wɔ Hackney Ltd, UK firi afe 2002 kosi afe 2005. Efi afe 1991 kosi afe 2002 wɔ London Brough of Hackney, UK no, na ɔsan yɛ ɔfa som adwuma sohwɛfo (divisional service manager). Efi afe 1990 kosi afe 1991 na ɔyɛ adwumayɛfo panyin (senior administration officer) wɔ London Brough of Lambeth, UK.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ɔyɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforɔ (New Patriotic Party) no muni na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma Mampong Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa. Odii nkonim wɔ mmarahyɛ badwa atenaeɛ maa Mampong Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa no mu wɔ afe 2016 abatoɔ no mu a onyaa amba 36,532 wɔ abatoɔ 48,085 a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ no mu. Mohammed Kojo Aboasu a ofi Ɔman Demokrasi Nhyiam Kuw (National Democratic Congress), Rebecca Otum a ofi Nnipa Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw (People’s Patriotic Party), Osei Kofi Edward Adepa a ofi Nkabom a ɛkɔ Anim Kuw (United Front Party), Ahmed Ibraham Saleh a ofi Nnipa Ɔman Nhyiam Kuw (People’s National Convention), Christopher Adansi Bona a ofi Nhyiam Nnipa Kuw (Convention People’s Party), ne Richmond Akuoko a ofi Nnipa Kuw Kɛse a Wɔaboaboa Ano (Great Consolidated People’s Party) na wɔyɛɛ saa afoforo a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔyɛ saa. Ɔsan dii nkonim wɔ mmarahyɛ badwa atenaeɛ mu maa Mampong Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa no wɔ afe 2020 abatoɔ no mu a onyaa amba 36,159 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ no mu 69.8%. Frank Amoakohene a ofi Ɔman Demokrasi Nhyiam Kuw (National Democratic Congress) nyaa amba 14,070 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoo no nyinaa mu 27.2% bere a Bright Adomako, a ɔde ne ho kandifoɔ no nyaa amba 1,576 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 3%.

Boayikuw ahorow 
Ɔyɛ Aguadi (Trade), Nnwuma (Industry) ne Nsrahwɛ (Tourism) Boayikuw (Committee ) no muni na ɔsan yɛ Bɔgyete Boayikuw Titiriw (Special Budget Committee) no muni.

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Waware na ɔwɔ mma baasa (3). Kwaku Ampratwum-Sarpong yɛ Kristoni. Ɔpɛ mpataayi (fishing), bɔɔlbɔ hwɛ (watching football), akenkan (reading) ne tete nnwom a otie (listening to classical music).

title: Kwadjo Asante
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Oboafo Kwadjo Asante (wɔwoo no Ayɛwohomumɔ 21, 1977) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne aguadifoɔ (businessman). Ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔhwɛ Suhum (Ghana mmarahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa) so.

Ne mmofrase abrabɔ 
Wɔwoo Oboafo wɔ Ayɛwohomumɔ bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduonu baako (21), afe 1977. Ofiri Akropong Akuapem a ɛwɔ Ghana Apueɛ Mantam mu.

Nhomasua 
Oboafo' wɔ bachelor wɔ nhomasua mu abodin krataa wɔ Nyansahu (bachelor in education degree in Science - Chemistry), diploma wɔ nyansahu nhomasua mu, Post Graduate abodin krataa wɔ Adwumayɛ mu Nhwehwɛmu (Post Graduate Diploma in Business Analytics - PGDBA) ne abodin krataa wɔ Adwumayɛ ho Ɔbenfo - Sikasɛm (Master of Business Administration - Finance).

Adwuma 
Oboafo Kwadjo yɛ ɔkwankyerɛfoɔ panin (managing director) wɔ Kay ne Moby Adwuma Kuw (Kay and Moby Company Limited).

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔ afe 2020 mu no, ɔsii akan na odii nkonim wɔ NPP mmarahyɛ badwa primaries mu maa Suhum (Ghana mmarahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa) wɔ Ghana Apueɛ Mantam mu. Odii nkonim wɔ mmarahyɛ badwa no mu wɔ afe 2020 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu. Ɔsom sɛ mmarahyɛ badwa no Bammɔ ne Mfinimfini Boayikuw (member of the Defence and Interior Committee of parliament) no muni.

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Oboafo yɛ Kristoni.

Ntotoho

title: Anwensɛm Twerɛfoɔ
text:
Awensɛm twerɛfoɔ yɛ nipa bi a ɔsua san so yɛ awensɛm. Awensɛm twerɛfoɔ bɛtumi aka wɔn ho nsɛm anaa sɛ afoforɔ nso bɛka wɔn ho nsɛm. Awensɛm twerɛfoɔ bɛtumi ayɛ ɔyɛfoɔ (ɔdwenefoɔ, nnwom twerɛni, ɔtwerɛfoɔ, anaa nwoma twerɛfoɔ) a ɔyɛ anaa hyehyɛ anwensɛm sɛ deɛ yɛde ano ka anaa deɛ yɛtwerɛ. Ɔbɛtumi nso de ne dwumadie no adi dwuma wɔ ahwɛfoɔ anim.

Awensɛm twerɛfoɔ adwuma hia ma nkɔmmɔdie, woreda adwenepɔ bi adi sɛ ne traa mu(sɛ woredi beaeɛ pɔtee bi ho nkɔmmɔ) anaa ne nteaseɛ a ɛmu yɛ duru mu. Awensɛm twerɛfoɔ baaeɛ ansa na abakɔsɛm bɛba, wɔ kasa ahodoɔ bebree mu, na ne dwumadie sesa wɔ amammerɛ ahodoɔ ne mmerɛ mu.

Abakɔsɛm 
Wɔ tete Rome no, anwensɛm twerɛfoɔ a ɛyɛ wɔn adwuma ankasa no wɔ mpanimfoɔ(patron), asikafoɔ a wɔdi mu a ebi yɛ asraafoɔ na  a wɔsɔ wɔn ase (sponsor) mu.

Beaeɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Kwabena Okyere Darko-Mensah
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Kwabena Okyere Darko-Mensah (wɔwoo no 18 June 1974 wɔ Takoradi) yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ na mprempren ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni ma Takoradi mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Atɔeɛ Mantam mu. Ná ɔwɔ ne ntoaso sukuu wɔ Mfantsipim Sukuu mu. Ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party (NPP) no muni na ɔyɛ ɔmanpanyin abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ wimhyɛn so wɔ Ghana.

Mmofraase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Darko-Mensah wɔ 18 June 1974 wɔ Takoradi. Ɔfiri Anwhiankwanta, kuro bi a ɛwɔ (Ghana). Ɔnyaa ne Bachelor of Science abodin krataa wɔ biochemistry mu wɔ afe 2000 mu wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so. Akyiri yi onyaa abodin krataa wɔ Demokrase, Aban, Mmara ne Nkɔsoɔ mu wɔ Cape Coast Suapɔn mu wɔ afe 2006. Ɔsan nso anya adansedie nkrataa afiri Sangonet, South Africa, ne Empretec Ghana.

Adwuma 
Darko-Mensah yɛ biochemist ne ahɔhodan sohwɛfo wɔ n’adwuma mu. Efi 1995 kosi 1998 no na ɔhwɛ adwumayɛ so wɔ Ahenfie Ahɔhodan mu. Efi afe 2001 kosi afe 2006 no na ɔwɔ e-Base Africa Ltd sɛ ne kwankyerɛfo panyin. Ɔyɛɛ adwuma mmɔho mmienu sɛ Adwumayɛfoɔ sohwɛfoɔ wɔ Guest House Maggi firi afe 2003 kɔsi afe 2008. Ɔsan nso yɛ sikasɛm boayikuo titrani wɔ Sekondi- Takoradi kuropɔn nhyiamu, Ghana kuropɔn a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa ansa na ɔrehyɛn mmarahyɛ bagua mu.

Amammuisɛm 
Darko-Mensah hyɛɛ mmarahyɛ bagua mu wɔ 7 Ɔbɛnem 2009 sɛ mmarahyɛ baguani ma Takoradi mantam no wɔ New Patriotic Party tekiti so. Ɔda so ara wɔ mmarahyɛ bagua mu adi nkonim wɔ abatoɔ a ɛdi hɔ (2012 ne 2016) mu firi afe 2009.

Nana Akufo-Addo na ɔpaw Darko-Mensah sɛ ɔmanpanyin abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ wimhyɛn so wɔ afe 2017 mu. Ɔtenaa saa dibea no mu kɔsii Ɔpɛpɔn 2019 berɛ a wɔpaw no sɛ Ɔmantam Soafoɔ ma Atɔeɛ Mantam.

Wɔ mmarahyɛ bagua mu no, wasom wɔ boayikuw ahorow mu, a emu bi ne; Mmarahyɛ Boayikuw a Ɛka Ho, Nhomasua Boayikuw, Adwumayɛ Boayikuw ne Akwan ne Kar Boayikuw.

title: Kwabena Mintah Akandoh
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Kwabena Mintah Akandoh yɛ Ghana amanyɔni na ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so nson (7) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4) no muni a ogyina Juanoso Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Atɔeɛ Mantam no ananmu wɔ Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛ Badwa (National Democratic Congress) tekiti so.

Ne mmofrase abrabɔ ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Akandoh wɔ 19 Ayɛwohomumɔ bosome da a ɛtɔ so dunkron (19) afe 1980. Ofiri Sefwi Antobia kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Atɔeɛ Mantam mu. Onyaa ne Nyansahu mu Bachelor wɔ Akontaabu ne Nkontaabu mu (Bachelor of Science in Statistics and Mathematics) wɔ Cape Coast Suapɔn (University of Cape Coast) mu wɔ afe 2007 mu.

Adwuma 
Ansa na Akandoh rekɔ amanyɔsɛm mu no, na ɔyɛ ɔkwankyerɛfo boafo (assistant director) a ɔhwɛ Ɔman Ɔsom Nhyehyɛe no Ɔman Tuhoama Dwumadi so (National Voluntary Programme of the National Service Scheme) wɔ ne Dwumadibea Ti (Head Office) a ɛwɔ Nkran (Accra).

Amanyɔsɛm 
Akandoh kɔɔ mmarahyɛbadwa mu wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da a ɛtɔ so nson (7) afe 2013 a na ogyinaa Juanoso Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa ananmu wɔ Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛ Badwa (National Democratic Congress) tekiti so. Wɔpaw no sɛ ɔmmɛgyina amansin no ananmu ne mprenu so wɔ afe 2016 mu

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Akandoh aware a ɔwɔ mma baanum (5). Ɔyɛ Kristoni na ɔka Anglikan asɔre no ho (Anglican denomination).

Ntotoho

title: Kwabena Donkor
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Kwabena Donkor (wɔwoo no 5 Ɔgyefoɔ 1958) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne kan Ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Tumi so (Minister for Power). Ɔyɛ mprempren Mmarahyɛbadwani ma Pru Apueɛ Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa, wɔ Bono Apuei Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ogyaee n’adwuma sɛ ɔsoafoɔ ɛnam sɛ wantumi anwie load shedding agye din a wɔfrɛ no Dumsor, ɛfiri sɛ na ɔhyɛɛ bɔ sɛ sɛ wansiesie yei ansa na afe 2015 aba awieeɛ a, ɔbɛgyae adwuma no.

Ne mmofrase abrabɔ ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Donkor wɔ Ɔgyefoɔ bosome da a ɛtɔ so anum (5), afe 1958, wɔ Lonto a ɛwɔ Yeji wɔ Bono Apuei Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔwɔ PhD ne master’s degree wɔ Bristol Suapɔn mu (University of Bristol), ne abodin krataa wɔ adwumayɛ ho nimdeɛ mu (master of business administration) wɔ Lancaster Suapɔn mu (Lancaster University).

Adwuma 
Donkor dii dwuma sɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfoɔ ɔsoafoɔ abadiakyiri (deputy minister of information) firi afe 2013 kosi afe 2014. Ɔyɛ Petroleum Badwa no muni a ɔhyehyɛɛ no (founding member of Petroleum Commission) na ɔyɛɛ ne panin (executive officer) wɔ afe 2014. Saa afe no ara mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ Ghana Aban no soafoɔ panin (cabinet minister of the Government of Ghana). Ɔbɛyɛɛ Ghana Mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ afe 2015 mu na ɔyɛɛ Boayikuo a ɛhwɛ Atopaeɛ ne Ahoɔden so no Titenani (Chairman of the Committee on Mines and Energy). Mprempren ogyina Pru Apueɛ Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa ananmu wɔ Bono Apuei Mantam mu wɔ Ghana wɔ Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛ Badwa (National Democratic Congress) tekiti so.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Donkor sii akan maa Pru Apueɛ Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa no atenaeɛ wɔ afe 2016 amansan abatoɔ no mu na odii nkonim. Onyaa amba 13,512 a ɛyɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 56.19% na ɛno nti odii akansifoɔ afoforɔ a David Amoah, Danjumah Desmond, Noah Ken Boadai ne Zevor Mattaw Tsiditsey ka ho no so nkonim. Ɔkuraa n’akongua so wɔ afe 2020 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu.

Boayikuw ahorow 
Donkor yɛ Adwumayɛ (Employment), Asetena mu Yiedie (Social Welfare) ne Ɔman Nnwuma Boayikuo (State Enterprises Committee) no muni a ɔdi kan (Ranking Member); ɔsan yɛ Daa Ahyɛde Boayikuw (Standing Orders Committee) no muni; na ɔsan yɛ Fam Agodie ne Ahoɔden Boayikuw (Mines and Energy Committee) no muni.

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Donkor yɛ Kristoni. Waware na ɔwɔ mma baanan (4).

Ntotoho

title: Kwabena Amankwa Asiamah
text:
Kwabena Amankwa Asiamah (wɔwoo no wɔƆsanaa bosome da a ɛto so aduonu nwɔtwe wɔ afe apem ahankron aduonum nwɔtwe, August 28, 1958) yɛ Ghana sikasɛm ho nimdefoɔ ne amanyɔni. Ɔyɛ Ghana Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so nson (7) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4) no muni a ogyina Fanteakwa Atifi Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa ananmu wɔ Apueɛ Mantam wɔ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforɔ (New Patriotic Party) no tekiti so.

Ne mmofrase abrabɔ ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Asiamah wɔ Ɔsanaa bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduonu awɔtwe (28), afe 1958 mu. Ofiri Bɛgorɔ, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Apueɛ Mantam mu. Owiee sukuu wɔ Hull Suapɔn mu (University of Hull) na onyaa ne Adwumayɛ ho Ɔbenfo abodin krataa wɔ akwankyerɛ a wɔde di dwuma mu (Master of Business Administration degree in strategic management) wɔ afe 1999 mu. Ɔsan nso wɔ EMGL abodin krataa (EMGL degree) wɔ Ghana Asoɛe a Ɛhwɛ Adwumayɛ ne Ɔmanfoɔ So (Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration - GIMPA).

Adwuma 
Asiamah yɛ sikasɛm ho ɔbenfo (economist) ne sikakorabea dwumayɛni (banker) wɔ n’adwuma mu. Ansa na ɔrebɛyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani no, na ɔyɛ Fanteakwa Nkuraase Sikakorabea (Fanteakwa Rural Bank) no guamtrani (board chairman).

Amanyɔsɛm 
Asiamah yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforɔ (New Patriotic Party - NPP) no muni. Wɔdii kan paw no sɛ ɔmmra Ghana Mmarahyɛ Badwa no mu wɔ bosomeƆpɛpɔn afe 2009 mu, bere a ɔbɛyɛɛ Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so anum (5) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4) no muni. Wɔ bosome Ɔpɛnimma afe 2012 mu no, ɔsan sii akan wɔ afe 2012 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu sɛ ɔbɛkora n’akongua so wɔ NPP tekiti so. Odii nkonim na ɔbɛyɛɛ Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so nsia (6) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4) no muni. Ɔsan dii nkonim wɔ ne abatoɔ mu wɔ afe 2016 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu a onyaa abatoɔ nyinaa mu 57% na ɔbɛyɛɛ mprempren Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so nson (7) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4) no muni.

Ɔyɛ sikasɛm boayikuo no guamtrani abadiakyiri (vice chairperson) na ɔsan yɛ boayikuo muni ma Aguadiɛ Nnwuma ne Nsrahwɛ Boayikuo (member for Trade Industry and Tourism Committee).

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Asiamah yɛ Kristoni (Presbyni). Waware a ɔwɔ mma baason (7).

Ntotoho 

Ghanaian Mp's 5th Parliament of the 4th Republic

title: Joseph Akuerteh Tettey
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu
Joseph Akuerteh Tettey (yɛwoo no ɔsaaa 5, 1974) ɔyɛ Ghana amanyɔni. Ɔyɛ Ghana Aman a Ɛtɔ so Anan no Mmarahyɛ Bagua a Ɛtɔ so Nwɔtwe no mu ni a ɔgyina Kpone Katamanso Mantam a ɛwɔ Kpone Katamanso Kuropɔn Mantam mu wɔ Greater Accra Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

Mmɔfra ase asetena ne adwuma 
Wɔwoo Tettey wɔ Ɔbɛnem 5, 1974. Ɔfiri Kpone. Ɔnya Degree Masters wɔ Adwumayɛ mu (2011) wɔ Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration (GIMPA) ɛna ne Bachelor of Arts Degree wɔ Sikasɛm mu (2002) wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu. Na ɔyɛ Kpone Katamanso Mantam sohwɛfoɔ ma Ɔman Akwahosan Insurance Authority ne Jobiz Enterprise kwankyerɛfoɔ panin.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Tettey yɛ Ɔman Democratic Congress(NDC) no mu ni. Ɔsii akan na ɔdii nkonim wɔ NDC Parliamentary Primaries wɔ Kpone Katamanso Constituency bɛyɛɛ party no kandifoɔ wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa 2020 abatoɔ no mu. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ ɔpɛnimaa 2020 mmarahyɛ badwa abatoɔ no mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 51,755 a ɛgyina hɔ ma abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 55.3%, na ɔboroo nea ɔne no reko titire Hopeson Yaovi Adorye a ɔfiri New patriotic Party a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 39,546 a ɛgyina hɔ ma abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 42.3%.

Ekuo ahodoɔ 
Ɔsom sɛ Asase ne Kwaeɛ kuo no mu ni wɔ Mmarahyɛ Bagua a Ɛtɔ so Nwɔtwe a ɛwɔ Ghana Aman a Ɛto so Anan no mu.

Ne asetena 
Ɔyɛ okristoni

Beaɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Habib iddrisu
text:
Habib Iddrisu yɛ Ghana amanyɔni wɔ New Patriotic Party(NPP). ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbɛni de ma Tolon abatoɔ mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Apueɛ mantam wɔ Ghana.

N'ADWUMA 
Iddrisu yɛ mprɛmprɛn twerɛtwerɛfoc abɛdie akyire de ma Ghana Free Zones Authority ɛwɔ Tema ne ne mpotamu.

AMANYɔSɛM 
ɛwɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne du nsia mmrahyɛbedwa abatoɔ no, Iddrisu gyina maa Sagnarigu abatoɔ mpesoa de tia Alhassan Bashir Fuseini a ɔwɔ NDC amanyɔkuo mu. Mma mpem nson ɔha nnwɔtwe ne aduowɔtwe nnwɔtwe na fri ne nsa a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu aduonu a Fuseini nso nyaa mpem aduonu nsia ɔha nnwɔtwe ne aduokron nnwɔtwe a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduowɔtwe.

ɛduru mfe mpem mmienu ne aduonu mu abatoɔ no so no Iddrisu bɛgyina mu biom na afe wei deɛ ɔgyina maa Tolon abatoɔ mpɛsoa.Wɔ Ayɛwohomumo bosome wɔmfe mpem mmienu ne aduonu mu no ɔnyaa aba a ɔto de ma wɔn a ɔgyina mu ma amanyɔkuo no de ma Tolon mpɛsoa de tia Wahab Wumbei Suhuyini a wasom wɔ mmrahyɛbɛdwafie mprɛnu de fri ɔpɛpɔn bosome wɔmfe mpem mmienu ne du mmiensa. ɔde mma ɔha mmiensa ne aduasa nnwɔtwe na di nkunim wɔ berɛ afoforɔ nyenya ɔha baako ne aduosia mmienu ne aduasa.

Iddrisu bɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbedwani de maa Tolon wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne aduonu wɔ ɔpɛnimaa bosome wɔ mmrahyɛbɛdwafie abatoɔ no mu. ɔde no bɛyɛɛ mmrahyɛbɛdwani frisɛ ɔnyaa mma mpem aduosa baako ɔha nan ne aduonu nkrona ɛgyina h ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduonum ne nnwɔtwe de tia Yussif Adam a ɔdom NDC amanyɔkuo no a ɔnyaa mma mpem mmienu ne mmienu ɔha baako ne aduanan num a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu aduanan baako.
