title: Isaac Adjei Mensah
text:
Isaac Adjei Mensah yɛ Ghana amammuini ne Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson a ɛwɔ Ghana Republic of the Fourth Republic no mu ni a ɔgyina Wassa East Abatoɔ Mpɛsua ananmu wɔ Atɔeɛ Mantam wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Isaac Adjei Mensah wɔwoo no Benada 26 Ɔbenem 1963. Ofiri Dompim Number 1, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Atɔeɛ Mantam mu. Ɔkɔɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu wɔ afe 1988 mu na onyaa ne bachelor’s degree wɔ Sociology mu wɔ afe 1991. Akyiri yi ɔkɔɔ Tromsø Suapɔn, Norway wɔ afe 1992 mu kɔyɛɛ n’adesua akyi adesua. Owiee sukuu wɔ afe 1997 mu na ɔnyaa ne MBA wɔ Ɔmanfoɔ Nhyehyɛeɛ mu.

Adwuma 
Ansa na ɔrehyɛn amammuisɛm mu no, na Isaac yɛ Ɔmantam Nnipa Nnwuma sohwɛfoɔ wɔ Newmont Ghana Limited firi afe 2006 kɔsi afe 2012

Amanyɔsɛm 
Isaac Adjei Mensah yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛbadwa (NDC) no muni. Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, osii akan maa Wassa Apueeɛ nkongua no wɔ NDC tekiti so na odii nkonim. Wɔsan paw no bio wɔ afe 2016 mu sɛ ɔmmɛgyina amansin no ananmu wɔ aban a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmarahyɛ bagua a ɛtɔ so nson no mu. Wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa mu no wasom wɔ boayikuw ahorow mu, a emu bi ne; Nhomasua Boayikuo, Fie Boayikuo ne Budget Boayikuo Titiriw.

N'asetena 
Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baanum na ɔda ne ho adi sɛ ɔyɛ Kristoni ne Pentekoste Asɔre no mu ni.

title: Isaac Adongo
text:
Isaac Adongo (wɔwoo no Ahinime 12, 1972) yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ ne Ghana Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so 8 no muni a ɔgyina Bolgatanga Mfinimfini Mansin a ɛwɔ Atifi Apuɛɛe Mantam ananmu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Adongo firi Bolgatanga. Ɔyɛ obi a wawie Institute of Chartered Accountants ne University of Ghana.

Adwuma 
Wɔdii kan paw no wɔ afe 2016 mu na wɔsan paw no wɔ afe 2020. Onyaa amanaman ntam agyedeɛ wɔ afe 2022 mu sɛ ɔde atirimɔdensɛm dii defender of Manchester United ne England ɔman kuw, Harry Maguire, na ɔde no totoo Ghana ɔmampanyin Abadiakyiri, Mahamudu Bawumia ho, denam ka a ɔkae sɛ ɔyɛ ‘Sikasɛm mu Maguire’ a ɔbɔ n’ankasa bɔɔl wɔ ɔman no sikasɛm mu no so.

title: James Agalga
text:
James Agalga yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ na ɔyɛ Ghana Mantam a ɛtɔ so nnan Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson no muni a ɔgyina Builsa North Abatoɔ Mpɛsua ananmu wɔ Atifi Apueɛ Mantam wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so. Agalga yɛ Ɔmanpanyin Abadiakyiri wɔ John Mahama Aban ase. Mprempren ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwa no Bammɔ ne Mfinimfini Boayikuw no mu ni Abadiakyiri.

Mfitiase asetena ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo James wɔ Chuchuliga wɔ Atifi Apueɛ Mantam wɔ Ghana wɔ 10 Ayɛwohomummɔ 1979. Ɔkɔɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu baabi a ɔwiee ne LLB Hons wɔ afe 2002. Ɔsan nso nyaa ne BL wɔ Ghana School of Law wɔ afe 2004. Ɔsan nso wiee MA wɔ Conflict, Peace and Security mu wɔ afe 2018 mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ɔyɛ National Democratic Congress no muni.

Adwuma 
Ɔyɛ Managing Partner of Law Temple firi afe 2008 kɔsi afe 2013. Na ɔyɛ Associate wɔ Center for Public Interest Law. Ɔsan nso yɛ Barrister wɔ NDEZEB Law Consult.[8][9]

Ne som 
Ɔyɛ Katolekni.

Boayikuw 
Na ɔka Members Holding Offices of Profit Committee, Constitutional, Legal and Parliamentary Affairs ho Boayikuw ne nso Apaw Boayikuw.

title: John Frimpong Osei
text:
John Frimpong Osei (wɔwoo no 5 Ɔbenem 1971) yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ a na ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanin Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson no muni na seesei ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanin a ɛtɔ so nnan Mmarahyɛbadwa no mu ni a ogyina Abirem Mansin ananmu wɔ Apueeɛ Mantam mu wɔ tekiti a ɛyɛ New Patriotic Party.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo John Frimpong wɔ Akim Ntronang wɔ Ghana Apueeɛ Mantam mu. John Frimpong nyaa ne Mfinimfini Sukuu Abodin krataa wɔ afe 1986. Akyiri yi onyaa ne Ordinary Level wɔ afe 1991 mu ne Advanced Level wɔ afe 1993. John Frimpong kɔɔ so nyaa ne Bachelor of Arts (Geography Resource Development) wɔ afe 1998 mu ne M.PHIL (Micro Finance Geography) wɔ 2004 firii Ghana Suapɔn, Legon – Ghana.

Adwuma 
John Frimpong yɛ OM Finance and Business Service Limited sohwɛfoɔ firi afe 1999 kɔsi afe 2000, Ɔsan nso yɛ ɔsom adwuma no boafoɔ titire firi afe 2002 kɔsi 2005 wɔ Sikasɛm ne Sikasɛm Nhyehyɛe Dwumadibea ne Nhomasua Dwumadibea ne Mmabun ne Agumadi Dwumadibea. John Frimpong reyɛ adwuma seesei sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwa no muni (MP) ma Abirem Mantam.

Amanyɔsɛm mu asetena 
John Frimpong dii nkonim wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa no mu wɔ ne mansin (Abirem Mantam) mu wɔ Apuei Fam Mantam mu wɔ afe 2016 Ghana ɔsahene no mu abatoɔ a ɛwɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so sɛ wɔbɛka Ghana Republic a Ɛto so Anan Mmarahyɛbadwa a Ɛto so Ason (7) no ho a wɔanya abatoɔ 19208 (61.0%) atia Mavis Ama Frimpong a ɔfiri National Democratic Congress a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 12,217 (38.8%). Ɔsan dii nkonim bio wɔ afe 2020 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so sɛ ɔbɛkɔ akɔka Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe (8) a ɛwɔ Fourth Republic of Ghana no ho a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 19,151 (55.2%) tiaa Mavis Ama Frimpong a ɔfiri National Democratic Congress a na ɔwɔ 15,110 abatoɔ (43.5%).

Boayikuo 
John Frimpong yɛ Aduan, Kuadwuma ne Kokoo Nsɛm Boayikuo no muni sɛ oguamtrani. Ɔsan nso yɛ Privileges Committee a ɛwɔ Fourth Republic of Ghana Mmarahyɛbadwa a Ɛto so Awotwe (8) no mu ni.

N'asetena 
John Frimpong yɛ Kristoni.

Adɔyɛ 
John Frimpong de ntoboa ama Abɔnten so bɔlɔb asinasin 100 a wɔde bɛboa amanne kwan so awudi anadwo wɔ ne kuropɔn mu. Sɛnea John Frimpong kyerɛ no, ɛbaa n’adwene mu sɛ, asram bi a atwam wɔ afe 2022 mu no, wɔakum mmea a wɔabɔ dam a wɔayi wɔn nipadua akwaa a wɔfrɛ no sɛ ɛyɛ amanne kwan so awudi.

Abasobɔdɛe Ahodoɔ 
Wɔmaa John Frimpong sɛ United Asɔfoɔ Amanaman Ntam Fekuo (UCIA) 2020 Hall Of Fame Award For Excellence In Leadership a The United Clergy International Association (UCIA) yɛeɛ no yɛɛ ne abasobɔdeɛ a ɛtɔ so 11 wɔ All Nations University wɔ 8 Ɔsanaa 2020.

title: John Abdulai Jinapor
text:
John Abdulai Jinapor a wɔwoo no (Ayɛwohomummɔ 8, 1979) yɛ Ghana amanyɔfoɔ na na ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔman Soafoɔ. Ɔyɛ National Democratic Congress of Ghana no muni na ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwa no muni a ogyina Yapei-Kusawgu mantam ananmu.

Nhomasua 
Jinapor kɔɔ Ghana Senior High School wɔ Tamale.Onyaa ne master’s degree wɔ Development Finance mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu wɔ afe 2019. Post Graduate Diploma wɔ Sikasɛm ne Sikasɛm Mmara mu wɔ London Suapɔn mu wɔ afe 2015. Masters of Science wɔ Energy Economics mu wɔ Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration (GIMPA) . wɔ afe 2021. Bachelor's degree wɔ University for Development Studies, Master's degree wɔ aguadi mu wɔ University of Ghana, 2008.

Amanyɔsɛm adwuma 
Wɔpaw no sɛ Ɔmanpanyin Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ ahoɔden so wɔ John Mahama nniso ase. Ɔyɛ Fourth Republic of Ghana Mmarahyɛbadwa a Ɛto so Ason no muni a ogyina Yapei Kusawgu Mantam a ɛwɔ Atifi Mantam no ananmu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

N'asetena 
Abudulai Jinapor a na ɔyɛ polisini na ɔwoo Jinapor ne Buipe Panyin wɔ Savanna Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔyɛ Samuel Abu Jinapor a na ɔyɛ Ghana Adwumayɛfoɔ Panyin abadiakyiri na mprempren ɔyɛ Asase ne Abɔdeɛ mu Ahodeɛ soafoɔ no nua. ne Oduruyɛfo Ahmed Jinapor, ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo. Ɔwaree Owurayere Josephine Jinapor, .

title: John Oti Bless
text:
John Oti Bless (wɔwoo no Ahinime 19, 1979) yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ ne Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson a ɛwɔ Ghana Aman a ɛtɔ so nnan no muni a ɔgyina Nkwanta Atifi Mansin ananmu wɔ Oti Mantam mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Ankorankoro asetena 
Bless yɛ Kristoni (Pentekoste Asɔre). Ɔwaree (ɔwɔ mma baanan).

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Bless  Ahinime 19, 1979. Ofiri Saboba, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Mantam mu. Ɔkɔɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu na ɔnyaa ne Diploma wɔ Youth Development mu wɔ afe 2002 mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Bless yɛ National Democratic Congress (NDC) no muni. Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔsii akan wɔ Nkwanta North seat no so wɔ NDC mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nsia a ɛwɔ republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no tekiti so na odii nkonim.

Adwuma 
MD, Blessed Pharmacy/Blessed cleansing services, Accra

Deputy Minister for local aban ne nkuraase nkɔsoɔ, Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 27, 2016 – Ɔpɛpɔn 6, 2017

Mmarahyɛbadwa no mu ni (Ɔpɛpɔn 7, 2013 – mprempren; afe a ɛtɔ so mmienu)

title: John Ntim Fordjour
text:
Reverend John Ntim Fordjour yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ ne Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson a ɛwɔ Fourth Republic of Ghana no muni a ɔgyina Assin South Abatoɔ Mpɛsua ananmu wɔ Mfinimfini Mantam mu  wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so. Mprempren ɔsom sɛ Nhomasua soafo Abadiakyiri wɔ Nana Addo Dankwa Akufo-Addo a ɔpaw no akyi na onyaa Mmarahyɛbadwa no pene.

Adwuma 
Ɔyɛ mprempren Ɔmanpanyin Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Nhomasua so ne Mmarahyɛbadwa no muni ma Assin South Abatoɔ Mpɛsua a ɛwɔ Ghana Mmarahyɛbadwa no mu, Ghana-Canada Mmarahyɛbadwa Adamfofa Fekuw no Titenani, Mmarahyɛbadwa Boayikuw a Ɛhwɛ Asomfo a Wɔkura Mfaso Dwumadibea ne Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni Boayikuw a Wɔapaw Amannɔne Nsɛm so no Titenani Abadiakyiri.[citation needed] Ɔ yɛ VBCI Higher Heights Sanctuary wɔ East Legon Pastor.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Fordjour wɔ 28 Kɔtonima 1986 na ɔfiri Assin Kruwa wɔ  Mfinimfini Mantam mu  wɔ Ghana. Ɔkɔɔ Assin Manso Senior High School. Ɔwɔ nnwuma ahodoɔ pii wɔ Mining, Economic Policy ne International Relations mu, Ntim Fordjour mprempren yɛ PhD Candidate wɔ Department of Political Science a ɛwɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu. Ɔwiee abodin krataa wɔ Mineral Engineering mu wɔ University of Mines and Technology (UMaT), Tarkwa wɔ afe 2007 mu, na ɛno akyi no, Ghana Suapɔn maa no Master of Arts Degree wɔ Economic Policy Management mu wɔ afe 2014 mu.[6]

Amanyɔsɛm 
Fordjour yɛ New Patriotic Party no muni.

Wɔ afe 2016 abatoɔ mu no, ɔnyaa abatoɔ 23,308 wɔ abatoɔ 39,887 a ɛfata a wɔtoo no mu a ɛgyina hɔ ma abatoɔ 58.99% sɛ ɔbɛyɛɛ mmarahyɛ baguani ma Assin South Constituency.

Mprempren ɔyɛ guamtrani abadiakyiri ma asɔremma Holding Offices of Profit Committee na ɔsan yɛ Amannɔne Nsɛm Boayikuw no muni wɔ mmarahyɛ bagua no mu. John Ntim Fordjour yɛ Ghana Integrated Iron & Steel Development Corporation (GIISDEC) Aban Kuo no muni na ɔsan nso yɛ Boayikuo no Sikakorabea ne Akwankyerɛ Boayikuo no Titenani.

N'asetena 
Fordjour aware na wayɛ mmofra baasa, a wɔn nyinaa yɛ mmeawa. Ɔyɛ Kristoni

title: Kofi Okyere-Agyekum
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Kofi Okyere-Agyekum (wɔwoo no Ɔbɛnem 8, 1958) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni na ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so nson (7) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4)  no muni a ogyina Fanteakwa Anafoɔ Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa ananmu wɔ Apueɛ Mantam mu wɔ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforɔ (New Patriotic Party) no tekiti so.

Ne mmofrase abrabɔ ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Okyere-Agyekum wɔ Ɔbɛnem bosome da a ɛtɔ so awɔtwe (8), afe 1958 mu. Ofiri Osino, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Apueɛ Mantam mu. Ɔkɔɔ Ghana Suapɔn (University of Ghana) mu na onyaa ne Nyansahu mu Bachelor abodin krataa wɔ kuayɛ sikasɛm mu (Bachelor of Science degree in agricultural economics) wɔ afe 1981 mu. Ɔsan nso kɔɔ Ghana Asoɛe a Ɛhwɛ Adwumayɛ ne Ɔmanfoɔ So (Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration) na onyaa Adwumayɛ Ho Nsɛm mu abodin krataa wɔ sikasɛm mu (Master's of Business Administration degree in finance) wɔ afe 2007 mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Okyere-Agyekum yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforɔ (New Patriotic Party - NPP) no muni. Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔde NPP mmarahyɛ badwa a ɛtɔ so nsia (6) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4) no tekiti so sii akan wɔ Fanteakwa Anafoɔ nkongua no so na odii nkonim.

Adwumafa 

 Adwumakuw no sohwɛfo (Corporate manager), Uniliver, afe 1984 kosi afe 2000

 Ɔhwɛfoɔ a ɔhwɛ nneɛma a wɔde ma (Supply chain manager), Cleansing Solution Limited, Tema

 Mmarahyɛbadwani (Ɔpɛpɔn 7, 2013 besi Ɛnnɛ; afe a ɛtɔ so mmienu)

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Okyere-Agyekum yɛ Kristoni (Presbyni). Waware na ɔwɔ mma baasa (3).[2]

Ntotoho

title: Joseph Betino
text:
Joseph Betino (wɔwoo no 27 Ɔsanaa 1966) yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ na ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe a ɛwɔ Fourth Republic of Ghana a ɔgyina Suaman Mansin ananmu wɔ Atɔɛe Atifi Mantam. Ɔbɛyɛɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Ɔfiri Nandom na wɔwoo no wɔ 27th Ɔsanaa 1966. Wɔ afe 1990 mu no, Betino nyaa ne A level nwomasua.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Betino kan no na ɔyɛ Ɔmantam Panyin ma Suaman Mantam no. Ɔsii akan na ɔdii nkonim wɔ NDC Parliamentary Primaries wɔ Suaman Abatoɔ Mpɛsua sɛ ɔbɛyɛɛ party no kandifoɔ wɔ Ɔpɛnimma 2020 abatoɔ no mu. Ɔtwee abatoɔ 8900 a egyina hɔ ma abatoɔ a wɔgyeeɛ nyinaa mu 51.2% de dii nkonim.

Boayikuo 
Ɔsom sɛ mmarahyɛbadwa no Nhyehyɛeɛ Boayikuo a ɛgyina hɔ ne Aduan, Kuadwuma ne Kokoo nsɛm Boayikuo no mu ni.

Ne Som 
Ɔyɛ Kristoni.

title: Mohammed Hardi Tufeiru
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Mohammed Hardi Tufeiru yɛ Ghana amanyɔni, na ɔka Ghana adehyeman amanmuo a ɛtɔso nson na ɔgyina mu ma Nanton mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Apueɛ mantam ma NPP amanyɔkuo no. ɔyɛ nnwomanimni a w'akɔ sukuu de abɛyɛ wɔn a wɔhwɛ sikasɛm so ne bi. ɔkɔɔ sukuu wɔ Institute of Chartered Accountant na ɔsane toaso kɔɔ biom wɔ University of Ghana  sane kɔɔ bi nso wɔ University of Cape Coast. Mprenmpren yi deɛ ɔyɛ suafoɔ abɛdiakyire a wɔhwɛ afuoyɛ ne mmoa sɛm so.

NE SUKUU 
Wɔnyaa ne GCE wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduokron nsia na ɔtoaso so wɔ University of Cape  Coast de kɔ pɛɛ nkrataa wɔ sikasɛm so wɔ mfe mpem mmienu mu. Wɔnyaa ne MBA wɔ sikasɛm mu wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne nsia. ɔbɛkaa Institute of Chartered Accountant wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne nkron. ɔbɛkaa nnwuma 

kuo a wɔhyehyɛ sikasɛm mu.

N'ADWUMA 
Hon. Mohammed Hardi Tufeiru na ɔyɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ wɔ suapɔn mu de firi mfe mpem mmienu ne baako de kɔsi mfe mpem mmienu ne nsia wɔ Tamale Technical University na ɔsane yɛ panin a ɔda wɔn a ɔhwehwɛ sikasɛm mu de firi mfe mpem mmienu (2006) ne nsia de kɔsi mfe mpem mmienu ne du nsia (2016). ɔyɛɛ panin no saa de firi mfe mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe de kɔsii mfe mpem mmienu ne du nsia de maa University of Development Studies ne Tamale Technical University. Wɔ Tamale Technical University no ne wɔn a wɔn a ɔsuadeɛ sane adwuma no na ɔkyerɛ ɔmo sika ho nsɛm, ɛtoɔ ne deɛ ɛkeka ho wɔ University of Cape Coast, University of Ghana ne Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and  Technology.

NE SUM Wɔ MMRAHYɛBɛDWAFIE 
Wɔ Ghana adehyeman amanmuo a ɛtɔso nson mu no na ɔyɛ abɛdiakyire de ma Public Accounts Committee na ɔsane dɔm Committee on Environment, Science and Technology. Na ɔyɛ African Parliamentary Union anamsini. Na ɔka Petroleum Commission Boards of Directors ho de firi mfe mpem mmienu ne du nson (2017) de kɔsii mfe mpem mmienu ne aduonu baako (2021). Na ɔka mpanimfoɔ a wɔ ɔhwɛ sikasɛm mu de maa Ghana Gas Company ne Local Goverment, Rural Development ne Decentralization mprempren mu wɔ mmrahyɛbɛdwafie.

BEAEɛ A MENYAA MMOA FIRII

title: Joseph Cudjoe (politician)
text:
Joseph Cudjoe yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ ne Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson a ɛwɔ Fourth Republic of Ghana no muni a ɔgyina Effia Mansin a ɛwɔ Atɔɛe Mantam no ananmu wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Cudjoe da 2 Ahinime 1964. Ɔfiri Effia kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Atɔeɛ Mantam mu. Onyaa ne Bachelor of Science abodin krataa wɔ akontabuo mu wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so, Kumasi ne ne MBA wɔ Sikasɛm mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu.

Adwuma 
Joseph Cudjoe hyɛɛ n'adwuma ase sɛ a ɔyɛ Nkontaabu kyerɛkyerɛfo wɔ Archbishop Porter Girls Secondary School fi Ɔpɛpɔn 1995 kosi  Ahinime 1995. Cudjoe yɛɛ adwuma sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo wɔ Takoradi Technical University fi 1995 kosi 2000. Akyiri yi ɔde ne ho kɔbɔɔ Eno International, LLC baabi a ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ Sikasɛm mu Nhwehwɛmu & Nhyehyɛe sohwɛfo fi 2000 kɔsi afe 2001. Ɔbɛyɛɛ Ɔfotufoɔ Panyin wɔ SEM International Associates wɔ Ayɛwohomumɔ 2002 kɔsi Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 2003 na afei akyiri yi ɔbɛyɛɛ adwuma sohwɛfoɔ panin wɔ SEM International LTD firi Ɔpɛpɔn 2003 kɔsi Oforisuo 2004.Efi Ayɛwohomumɔ 2004 kɔsi Ɔpɛpɔn afe 2012 no, na Cudjoe yɛ Sikasɛm sohwɛfoɔ wɔ Ghana Cocoa Board.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Cudjoe kɔɔ mmarahyɛbadwa mu wɔ 7 Ɔpɛpɔn 2013 a ogyinaa Effia mantam ananmu wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so. Wɔpaw no bio sɛ ​​ɔmmɛgyina amansin no ananmu wɔ afe 2016 mu.

N'asetena 
Cudjoe aware a ɔwɔ mma mmiɛnsa. Ɔda ne ho adi sɛ ɔyɛ Kristoni.

title: Kofi Arko Nokoe
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Kofi Arko Nokoe yɛ Ghana amanyɔni a ɔyɛ Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛ Badwa (National Democratic Congress) no muni. Ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani ma Evalue-Ajomoro-Gwira Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Atɔe Fam mantam mu.

Ne mmofrase abrabɔ ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Nokoe wɔ Kotonimma bosome da a ɛtɔ so dumiɛnsa (13) afe 1983 mu na ofiri Axim wɔ Ghana Atɔeɛ Mantam mu. Ɔhyɛɛ ne ntoaso sukuu ase wɔ Komenda Nhomasua Kɔlege (Komenda College of Education). Ɔkɔɔ Ghana Suapɔn (University of Ghana), na ɛhɔ na owiee ne Bachelor wɔ Adwinni mu abodin krataa wɔ Amanyɔsɛm adesua mu (Bachelor of Arts degree in Political studies). Nokoe nso wɔ abodin krataa wɔ Nkɔso Ho Adesua mu (master's degree in Development Studies) wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so (Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology).

Adwuma 
Na Nokoe yɛ Ɔhwɛfoɔ Panyin (Senior Superintendent) wɔ Ghana Nhomasua Dwumadibea (Ghana Education Service). Na ɔsan yɛ Ɔkwankyerɛfo Boafo (Assistant Director) wɔ Mpɔtam Aban Dwumadibea (Ministry of Local Government).

Amanyɔsɛm

Mmarahyɛbadwani 
Nokoe dii nkonim wɔ mmarahyɛ badwa no mu sɛ obegyina Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛ Badwa (National Democratic Congress) ananmu ama Evalue-Ajomoro-Gwira Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa ansa na afe 2020 abatow no reba wɔ 28 Ɛbɔ bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduonu awɔtwe afe 2019 mu bere a ɔtoo abatow 546 a egyina hɔ ma 64.2% akyi a ɔboroo nea ɔne no resi akan titiriw, Herbert Kua Dickson a na ɔwɔ amba 297 a egyina hɔ ma 34.9% no so nkonim.

Wɔ bosome Ɔpɛnimma afe 2020 mu no, Odii nkonim wɔ Evalue-Ajomoro-Gwira Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa mu wɔ mmarahyɛ badwa abatoɔ mu a oyii mmarahyɛ badwani a ɔdi tumi seesei Catherine Ablema Afeku a ɔyɛ kan Ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Nsrahwɛ, Amammerɛ ne Adebɔ mu (Minister of Tourism, Culture and Creative Arts). Odii nkonim denam abatoɔ 19,830 a ɔnyaeɛ a ɛgyina hɔ ma 53.4% tiaa nea ɔsɔre tia no paa a ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔdi tumi seesei, Catherine Ablema Afeku a ofiri Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforɔ (New Patriotic Party) a onyaa amba 17,287 a ɛgyina hɔ ma abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ no mu 46.6%. Evalue-Ajomoro-Gwira nkongua no yɛ nkongua a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforɔ (New Patriotic Party) gyee fii Ɔman Demokrasi Nhyiam Kuw (National Democratic Congress) no nsam wɔ afe 2016 Mmarahyɛ Badwa Abatoɔ mu nanso kuw no antumi ankora so mfeɛ anan (4) foforɔ.

Boayikuw ahorow 
Nokoe yɛ Budget Boayikuo Titiriw no muni na ɔsan yɛ Amannɔne Nsɛm Boayikuo no muni.

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Nokoe yɛ Kristoni na ɔsom sɛ Methodistni.

Ntotoho

title: Habib Iddrisu
text:
Habib Iddrisu yɛ Ghana amanyɔni a ɔyɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforɔ (New Patriotic Party - NPP) no muni. Ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani a wɔayi no ama Tolon Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Mantam mu.

Adwuma 
Mprempren Iddrisu reyɛ Ghana Free Zones Authority no Ɔkyerɛwfo Abadiakyiri (Deputy Executive Secretary) a ɔhwɛ Tema enclave so.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔ afe 2016 mmarahyɛ badwa abatoɔ mu no, Iddrisu gyinaa Sagnarigu Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa no akyi tiaa mmarahyɛ badwa no muni Alhassan Bashir Fuseini a ofiri NDC na ɔdii nkoguo a onyaa amba 7,888 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 20.7% tiaa Fuseini a onyaa amba 26,898 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 70.7%.

Ansa na afe 2020 abatoɔ no reba no, Iddrisu hyɛɛ akansi a ɛfa mmarahyɛbadwani no ho wɔ NPP mfitiaseɛ (primaries) abatoɔ mu, saa bere yi wɔ Tolon Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa mu. Wɔ bosome Ayɛwohomumɔ afe 2020 mu no odii nkonim wɔ primaries a wɔde maa Tolon Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa no akyi bere a odii mmarahyɛbadwani Wahab Wumbei Suhuyini a na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani mfeɛ mmienu na ɔwɔ mmarahyɛ badwa mu firi bosome Ɔpɛpɔn afe 2013 no so nkonim. Odii nkonim denam amba 338 a onyaeɛ so bere a deɛ ɔdi tumi no nyaa amba 164 na wɔn a wɔredi tumi no mu mmiɛnsa a wɔaka no nyaa amba 32.

Wɔpaw Iddrisu sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani maa Tolon wɔ afe 2020 bosome Ɔpɛnimma mmarahyɛ badwa abatow mu. Wɔpaee mu kae sɛ odii nkonim wɔ mmarahyɛ badwa abatow no mu bere a onyaa amba 31,429 a egyina hɔ ma 58.37% tiaa nea ɔbɛn no paa Yussif Adam a ofi Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛ Badwa (National Democratic Congress) a na ɔwɔ amba 22,145 a egyina hɔ ma 41.13% no.

Ntotoho

title: Haruna Seidu
text:
Alhaji Haruna Seidu yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne mmarahyɛbaddwani ma Wenchi Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Bono mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

Ne mmofrase abrabɔ ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Haruna wɔ 4 Ɔgyefoɔ 1974 na ofiri Wenchi a ɛwɔ Bono mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Onyaa ne abodin krataa wɔ Adwumayɛ mu Dwadie (Masters in Business Administration in Marketing) wɔ afe 2015 mu.

Adwuma 
Haruna yɛ Lamini Investment Ghana Limited no aguadi ne adwumayɛ sohwɛfo (Marketing and Administrative Manager). Ɔyɛ okuafo (farmer).

Amanyɔsɛm adwuma 
Haruna yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi Nhyiam Kuw (National Democratic Congress) muni na mprempren ɔyɛ Wenchi Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa no muni. Odii nkonim wɔ mmarahyɛ badwa no mu a onyaa amba 26,068 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ no nyinaa mu 51.1% bere a NPP mmarahyɛbadwani George Yaw Gyan-Baffuor nyaa amba 23,102 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ no nyinaa mu 45.3%

Boayikuw ahorow 
Haruna yɛ Bɔgyete Boayikuw Titiriw no muni (Special Budget Committee).

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Haruna yɛ Nkramoni.

Adɔeyɛ 
Wɔ bosome Ɔpɛpɔn afe 2022 mu no, ɔde mmubuafoɔ nkongua foforɔ (new wheelchairs) aduasa nsia (36) maa PWDfoɔ binom wɔ Wenchi Kuropɔn (Wenchi Municipal).

title: Isaac Kwame Asiamah
text:
Isaac Kwame Asiamah (wɔwoo no 24 Ɔpɛnimma 1975) yɛ Ghanaamanyɔni wɔ Ghana Amansin mu. Ɔyɛ Atwima Mponua Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa no Mmarahyɛbadwani. Ɔayɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ama Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa no wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so anan (4th), anum (5th), nsia (6th), nson (7th) ne awɔtwe (8th) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4th) mu. Ɔyɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforɔ (New Patriotic Party) no muni. Efi bosome Ɔgyefoɔ afe 2017 kosi bosome Ɔpɛpɔn afe 2021 no, ɔyɛɛ Mmabun ne Agumadi ho Ɔsoafo (Minister of Youth and Sports).

Ne mmofraase abrabɔ ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Isaac Asiamah wɔ Mampong, Ghana wɔ Ɔpɛnimma da a ɛtɔ so aduonu anan (24), afe 1975 mu. Ɔkɔɔ Ghana Suapɔn (University of Ghana), Legon baabi a onyaa Adwinni mu abodin krataa wɔ Asase ne Amanyɔsɛm mu (Bachelor of Arts degree in Geography and Political Science), wɔ afe 2000. Ɔkɔɔ Ghana Asoɛe a Ɛhwɛ Adwumayɛ ne Ɔmanfoɔ So (Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration) na hɔ na onyaa ne master’s abodin krataa wɔ Aban ne Akannifo mu (master's degree in Governance and Leadership), na ɔwiee afe 2008.

Adwuma 
Asiamah anya adwumayɛ ho nimdeɛ ahorow, a nea ɛka ho ne sɛ wɔde no yɛɛ adwuma sɛ Nhyehyɛe Ho Nhwehwɛmufo (Policy Analyst) wɔ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw no Asafo Ti Foforo (New Patriotic Party Headquarters) a ɛwɔ Nkran (Accra) no. Na ɔsan yɛ Ɔman Mmabun Ɔkyerɛwfo (National Youth Secretary) wɔ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo (New Patriotic Party) no mu.

Amanyɔsɛm mu adwuma 
Asiamah hyɛɛ Ghana amanyɔsɛm mu wɔ ne mmofraase bere a ɔsii akan na odii nkonim wɔ Atwima Mponua Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa abatow mu wɔ NPP tekiti so wɔ afe 2005 mu. Bere a odii nkonim wɔ atenae no mu no, na wadi mfe aduonu akron (29 years old), na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani kumaa sen biara wɔ Ghana amanyɔsɛm abakɔsɛm mu.  Mprempren nea ɔwɔ mmarahyɛbadwani kumaa no abodin ne Francisca Oteng-Mensah a ɛwɔ afe 2016 mu no, wɔpaw no bere a na wadi mfe aduonu mmiɛnsa (23 years old).

Mmabun ne Agumadi ho Ɔsoafoɔ 
Wɔ bosome Ɔpɛpɔn afe 2017 mu no, Ɔmanpanyin Nana Akuffo-Addo yii no sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ Ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Mmabun ne Agumadi so (Minister of Youth and Sports) wɔ Ghana. Wɔmaa no adwuma sɛ ɔmma agumadi mu nteɛso(sporting disciplines) ne dwumadi ahorow (activities ) a ɛwɔ ɔman Ghana no mu ntu mpɔn denam agumadifo nkumaa (young athletes) a ɔbɛma wɔanya nkɔso no so. Ɔmanpanyin no hyɛɛ no nkuran sɛ ɔmfa nhyehyɛe ahorow (structures) nsi hɔ a ɛbɛma Ghana agumadi ayɛ mmerɛw na ɔde adi dwuma sɛ asɛnka agua a ɔde bɛkyerɛ Ghana agumadifo (Ghanaian athletes) wɔ wiase asɛnka agua so (world stage).

Mmarahyɛ Badwa no mu nhwehwɛmu 
Mmarahyɛ Badwa no Boayikuw a Wɔpaw Nipa (Appointments Committee) no hwehwɛɛ Asiamah mu wɔ Ɔgyefoɔ bosome da a ɛtɔ so nson (7) afe 2017 mu. Wɔ nhwehwɛmu no mu no, ɔkaa n’adwene wɔ sɛdeɛ wɔbɛtumi ama agumadiɛ atu mpɔn wɔ Ghana. Nsakrae titiriw biako a na wabɔ ne tirim sɛ ɔde bɛba ne sɛ ɔbɛma nneɛma a ɛda adi pefee wɔ ɔman akuw ahorow ne aban no ho dwuma titiriw wɔ sika a wɔde ma ne akatua a wɔde ma agodifo no ho.

Ntam a wɔka 
Ɔmanpanin Akuffo-Addo kaa ntam sɛ wɔde asoafoɔ a Mmarahyɛ Badwa no apene wɔn so no nyinaa bɛba wɔ Ɔgyefoɔ bosome da a ɛtɔ so du (10) afe 2017 mu. Asiamah ka asoafoɔ foforɔ du a wɔnyaa wɔn asoafoɔ mmara sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ aseɛ ayɛ adwuma wɔ wɔn som adwuma ahodoɔ mu.

Abatow

Afe 2004 Abatow 
Wɔpaw Asiamah sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani maa Atwima Mponua Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana nea edi kan wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow no mu. Odii nkonim wɔ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforɔ (New Patriotic Party) no tekiti so. Na ne Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa no yɛ mmarahyɛbadwam nkongua aduasa nsia (36) no fa wɔ nkongua aduasa nkron (39) a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforɔ (New Patriotic Party) no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Ashanti Mantam no mu. Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforɔ (New Patriotic Party) no nyaa dodow no ara a ɛyɛ mmarahyɛ badwa nkongua ɔha aduonu awɔtwe (128) wɔ nkongua ahanu aduasa (230) mu. Wɔde amba 30,012 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 44,217 a ɛne abatoɔ a ɛfata nyinaa mu 67.9% yɛ pɛ. Onyaa amba sen John Macitse Oduro H. a ofi Ɔman Demokrasi Nhyiam Kuw (National Democratic Congress) no mu ne Stephen Osei Bossman a ofi Nhyiam Nnipa Kuw (Convention People's Party) no mu. Eyinom nyaa abatow a ɛfata nyinaa mu 30.5% ne 1.7%.

Afe 2008 Abatow 
Wɔ afe 2008 mu no, odii nkonim wɔ amansan abatoɔ no mu wɔ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforɔ (New Patriotic Party) tekiti so maa Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa koro no ara. Na ne Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa no yɛ mmarahyɛ badwa nkongua aduasa anan (34) no fa wɔ nkongua aduasa nkron (39) a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforɔ no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Ashanti Mantam no mu. Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforɔ no nyaa mmarahyɛ badwa nkongua ɔha nkron (109) wɔ nkongua ahanu aduasa (23)0 mu. Wɔde amba 25,350 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 44,948 a ɛne abatoɔ a ɛfata nyinaa mu 56.4% yɛ pɛ. Onyaa amba sen Amoah Sarpong a ofi Ɔmanfo Ɔman Nhyiam (People's National Convention) no mu, Ali Yeboah a ofi Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛ Badwa (National Democratic Congress) no mu, Kofi Takyi a ofi Demokrasi Nnipa Kuw (Democratic People's Party) no mu, Appiahhene Peter a ofi Nhyiam Nnipa Kuw (Convention People's Party) no mu ne Raphael Baffour Awuah a ɔyɛ ɔkannifo a ɔde ne ho. Eyinom nyaa abatow a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 0.68%, 32.01%, 0.42%, 1.12% ne 9.37%.

Afe 2012 Abatow 
Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, odii nkonim wɔ amansan abatoɔ no mu wɔ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforɔ (New Patriotic Party) tekiti so maa Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa koro no ara. Wɔde amba 33,961 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 59,300 a ɛne abatoɔ a ɛfata nyinaa mu 57.27% yɛ pɛ.  Onyaa amba sen Kwaku Agyemang-Mensah a ofi Ɔman Demokrasi Nhyiam Kuw (National Democratic Congress) no mu ne Frank Tachie Mensah a ofi Nhyiam Nnipa Kuw (Convention People's Party) no mu.  Eyinom nyaa abatow a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 41.94% ne 0.79%.  Wɔsan paw no wɔ afe 2016 ne 2020 amansan abatoɔ no mu sɛ ɔmmɛgyina hɔ wɔ Ghana Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so nson (7) ne awɔtwe (8) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4) nyinaa mu.

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Asiamah aware a ɔwɔ mma baasa (3).  Ɔkyerɛ sɛ ɔyɛ Kristoni na ɔyɛ Anglikan Asɔre (Anglican Church) a ɛwɔ Ghana no muni.

Hwɛ eyi nso 

 Minister of Youth and Sports
 Atwima Mponua constituency
 List of MPs elected in the 2016 Ghanaian parliamentary election

title: Isaac Ashai Odamtten
text:
Isaac Ashai Odamtten (wɔwoo no 13 Kotonimma 1972) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni a ɔyɛ Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛ Badwa (National Democratic Congress) no muni. Ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani a Wɔapaw no ama Tema Apuei Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa no. Efi afe 2013 kosi afe 2017 no, ɔsomm sɛ Mayor ne Metropolitan Adwumayɛfo Panyin (Metropolitan Chief Executive).

Ne mmofrase abrabɔ ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Odamtten wɔ Kotonimma bosome da a ɛtɔ so dumiɛnsa (13) afe 1972 mu. Ɔyɛ Tema kuromni wɔ Nkran Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔwiee Cape Coast Suapɔn (University of Cape Coast) wɔ afe 1999 mu a na ɔwɔ aguadi ho abodin krataa (bachelor of commerce degree - BCom). Ɔsan nso wɔ Adwumayɛ ho adwumayɛ ho nimdeɛ abodin krataa (Master of Business administration - MBA) wɔ Akontaabu ho nimdeɛ mu ne adansedie krataa wɔ adwuma no sohwɛ mu ( certificate in project management).

Adwuma

Adwuma a ɔyɛe mfiase 
Odamtten yɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ (teacher ) wɔ n’adwuma mu na ɔhyɛɛ n’adwuma ase sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ (tutor ) wɔ Ghana Nhomasua Dwumadibea ansa na ɔresɔre abɛyɛ Sikasɛm sohwɛfoɔ ne Bursar wɔ asoɛeɛ korɔ no ara ase. Ɔtu kɔɔ Amanaman Ntam Aguadi Sikakorabea (Ghana Education Service) sɛ ɔrekɔsom sɛ sikasɛm sohwɛfoɔ (Finance officer) ne nnwumakuo dwumadie sohwɛfoɔ panin (Bursar ) ansa na John Dramani Mahama repaw no sɛ ɔnsom sɛ Tema Mayor wɔ afe 2013 mu.

Tema kurow sohwɛfo 
Ɔyɛɛ kurow sohwɛfo (Mayor) ne Kuropɔn Adwumayɛfo Panyin (Metropolitan Chief Executive) wɔ Tema Kuropɔn Nhyiam (Tema Metropolitan Assembly) no mu firi afe 2013 kosi afe 2017. Nea otumi yɛe no mu biako ne sɛ ɔboaa mpataayifo (fishemen) na ɔmaa mpataayi (fisheries) ne nsu mu mmoayɛn adwuma (aquaculture sector) no nyaa sika pii denam abɔnten mfiri (outboard motors) a wɔde bɛma apofofo fekuw ahorow (fishermen associations) a ɛwɔ Tema no so.

Wɔ Ɔbɛnem bosome da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa (3) afe 2016 no, wɔpaw no sɛ Ɔman Fekuo a ɛhwɛ mpɔtam hɔfoɔ so wɔ Ghana (National Association of Local Authorities of Ghana - NALAG) no titenani (president) na ɔkaa ntam wɔ ɔman ananmusifoɔ nhyiamu a ɛtɔ so dunkron (19th biennial national delegates conference) a wɔyɛ no afe mmienu (2) biara wɔ Sunyani no ase. Wɔkaa no ntam bere a onyaa amba 624 fii abatow 980 a ɛfata a wɔtowee nyinaa mu de dii nea ɔne no resi akan nkutoo, James Gunu, ɔmantam no panyin (District Chief Executive - DCE) ma Akatsi Atifi, a onyaa amba ahasa aduonum nsia (356) no akyi.

Ɔyɛɛ Afrika Nkurow a Wɔaka abom ne Mpɔtam Aban Ahorow mpanyimfo boayikuw a emufo yɛ dunsia (16) no muni (member of the 16-member executive committee of the United Cities and Local Governments of Africa - UCLG Africa). Ɔsan nso som sɛ badwafo baanu (2) a wogyinaa Afrika Atɔe Fam ananmu wɔ Commonwealth Mpɔtam Aban Nhyiam (West Africa on the Commonwealth Local Government Forum - CLGF) no mu biako. Wɔ Wiase Nkuropɔn Da afe 2016 (World Cities Day), ne Habitat III akyi no, na ɔyɛ akasafoɔ a wɔde wɔn firi nkuropɔn mu wɔ wiase nyinaa baeɛ no mu biako ɛnam Amannɔne Nkɔso Asoɛe (Overseas Development Institute - ODI) Global Challenges adeyɛ no mu baeɛ sɛ wɔrebɛhwehwɛ sɛdeɛ nkuropɔn mu mmeaeɛ bɛtumi de wɔn wiase nyinaa SDG botaeɛ ama.

Efi Ɔbɛnem bosome da a ɛtɔ so dunsia (6) kosi aduonu mmienu (22) afe 2016 no, odii ananmusifoɔ anim kɔɔ Ahemfo Kurow a Ɛwɔ Greenwich (Royal Borough Of Greenwich) a ɔboaa GUBA Adwumayɛbea (GUBA Enterprise) a Dentaa di wɔn anim. Nsrahwɛ no yɛ ayɔnkofa a ɛda Tema kuropɔn ne Ahemfo Kurow a Ɛwɔ Greenwich (Royal Borough Of Greenwich) ntam a ɛfa adwumayɛkuo a ɛda mpɔtam mmienu (2) no ntam wɔ Nhomasua, Agumadi ne Aban mu (areas of Education, Sports and Governance) no fa.

Amanyɔsɛm

Mmarahyɛ Badwa no mu mmɔdenbɔ 
Odamtten dii nkonim wɔ mmarahyɛ badwa no mu sɛ obegyina National Democratic Congress ananmu ama Tema Apueɛ Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa ansa na afe 2020 abatow no aba.

Wɔ bosome Ɔpɛnimma afe 2020 mu no, Odamtten dii Mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔdi tumi mprempren wɔ Tema Apueɛ Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa mu Daniel Titus Glover so nkonim wɔ abatow 41,692 so bere a wɔde abatow 31,956 dii nkonim wɔ 2020 Abatow no mu.

Mmarahyɛbaguani 
Wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da a ɛtɔ so nson (7) afe 2021 no, wɔkaa Odamtten ntam sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani a ogyina Tema Apueɛ Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa ananmu wɔ Mmarahyɛ Bagua a ɛtɔ so awɔtwe (8) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4)  no mu.[5] Ɔsom sɛ ɔmannifoɔ wɔ Bɔbeasu ne Mmofra Boayikuo (member of the Gender and Children Committee) ne Adwumayɛ, Asetena mu Yiedie ne Ɔman Nnwuma Boayikuo a ɛwɔ Mmarahyɛ Badwa (Employment, Social Welfare and State Enterprises Committee of Parliament) no mu.

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Odamtten yɛ Kristoni.

Ntotoho

title: Joseph Frempong
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Joseph Frempong yɛ Ghana amanyɔni sane yɛ mmrahyɛbɛdwani wɔ mmrahɛbɛdwa a ɛtɔso nnwɔtwe Ghana adehyeman amanmuo a ɛtɔso nan a ɔgyina mu ma Apueɛ mantam ma NPP amanyɔkuo no.

Abrabɔ ahyeaseɛ ne nnwomasua 
Wɔwoo Frempong wɔ Kitawonsa bosome ne da a ɛtɔso du nsia wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduosia nkron wɔ Obo Kwahu wɔ apueɛ mantam. ɔwie ne GCE O'L evel wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduokron ne ne GCE A'Level wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduokron mmienu. Akyire no ɔkɔ toaso wɔ suapɔn keseɛ mu a ɔkɔ sua Social Studies wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne nan. ɔsane toaso so wɔ Public Affairs mu wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne du baako.

N'adwuma 
Na Frempong yɛ kyerɛkyerɛni wɔ Adosu Islamic sukuu. Na ɔkyerɛ Geography nso wɔ Sendema Senior High Technical .Na ɔsane kyerɛ Geography wɔ Nkawkaw Senior High. Akyire ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ panin wɔ suapɔn mu akyidifoɔ wɔ University of Education, Winneba.

Amanyɔ Adwuma 
Frempong yɛ NPP amanyɔni a ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbɛdwani de ma Nkawkaw mpɛsoa wɔ apueɛ mantam mprempren. Wɔ mfe mpem ne aduonu Ghana abatoɔ keseɛ mu no,ɔnyaa mma mpem aduanan nan ɔha ne aduosia nson de tia NDC ni Oppong Francis a ɔnyaa mma mpem du nan ɔha mmienu ne aduoson mmienu.

Akuokuo 
Frempong ka kuo Gender and Children sane ka ɔCommunications ho.

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Frempong yɛ ɔkristoni.

N'ayɛmyɛ adwuma 
Wɔ ɔsanaa bosome wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne aduonu baako mu no Frempong boaa nnipa mpem du num wɔ ne mpɛsoa so sɛ ɔnyɛ ne National Health Insurance Scheme. Wɔsane de nyinam mpa kɔ maa Nkawkaw ayaresabea.

title: James Klutse Avedzi
text:
James Klutse Avedzi yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so nson (7) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4) no muni a ogyina Ketu Atifi Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa ananmu wɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ Ɔman Demokrasi Nhyiam Kuw (National Democratic Congress) tekiti so.

Ne mmofraase ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo James Klutse Avedzi wɔKitawonsa bosome da a ɛtɔ so dunan (14) afe 1964 mu. Ofiri Xipe a ɛwɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔkɔɔ Liverpool Suapɔn (University of Liverpool) mu na ɔwiee sukuu no nyaa master’s abodin krataa wɔ Sikasɛm ne Akontaabuo (master's degree in Finance and Accounting) mu wɔ afe 2016. Ɔkɔɔ so yɛɛ oduruyɛfoɔ abodin krataa wɔ Amanaman Ntam ne Amanyɔsɛm Sikasɛm mu wɔ Adwumayɛ mu (doctorate in International and Political Finance in Business) wɔ Costa Rica Suapɔn (University of Costa Rica) mu. Ɔsan nso nyaa ne ICA-G firi Asoɛe a Ɛhwɛ Akontaabufo a Wɔagye Din So (Institute of Chartered Accountant) a ɛwɔ Ghana ne ne MCIT nso firi Ghana Chartered Asoɛe a Ɛhwɛ Towtua So (Ghana Chartered Institute of Taxation). Na ɔwɔ ne FCFIA nso firi Chartered Asoɛe a Ɛhwɛ Sikasɛm ne Sikasɛm mu Nhwehwɛmu So (Chartered Institute of Financial and Investment Analysis) a ɛwɔ Ghana.

Adwuma 
James Klutse Avedzi yɛɛ adwuma sɛ akontabuofoɔ titire wɔ Controller ne Akontaabufo Generals Dwumadibea wɔ Nkran (Accra) firi afe 1995 ansa na ɔrehwehwɛ amammui dibea wɔ afe 2004 mu. Ɔyɛ kan Sikasɛm Boayikuo ( Finance Committee) no Titenani (Chairman) wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛ badwa mu. Na ɔsan yɛ mmarahyɛ badwa no Ɔmanfo Akontaabu Boayikuw (Public Accounts Committee of parliament) no Titenani (Chairman). Ɔsan nso yɛ Minority Kannifoɔ Abadiakyiri (Deputy Minority Leader) ma NDC wɔ mmarahyɛ badwa mu.

Amanyɔsɛm mu adwuma 
James yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi Nhyiam Kuw (National Democratic Congress - NDC) muni, Ɔsi akan na odii nkonim wɔ mmarahyɛ badwa no mu maa Ketu Atifi Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa no wɔ afe 2005 mu. Efi saa bere no wagyina Ketu Atifi Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa ananmu wɔ Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so anum (5th), nsia (6th) ne nson (7th)  a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4th) no mu.

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
James aware na ɔwɔ mma baanan (4). Ɔyɛ Kristoni a ɔsom wɔ Global Evangelical Asɔre mu Ne yere wuiɛ wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da a ɛɛtɔ so aduasa (30) afe 2020 bere a na ne ho nyɛ no den bere bi wɔ Ketu Anafoɔ Mansin Ayaresabea (Ketu South District Hospital).

Nneɛma a wɔatumi ayɛ 
Ɔyɛɛ akwan na ɔmaa sukuufo a wɔwɔ ne mmarahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa mu no sika a wɔde bɛboa wɔn sukuu kɔ mu. Ɔsisii sukuu ahorow na ɔmaa mpɔtam hɔfo a na wɔwɔ nsu ho haw no nsu. Sɛɛ mmarahyɛbadwani no, ɔde nkuraa bɛyɛ ɔha aduonum (150) bataa ɔman no nhama ho (national grid).

Ntotoho

title: Kingsley Nyarko
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Dr. Kingsley Nyarko yɛ Ghana amanyɔni sane yɛ mmrahyɛbedwani de ma Kwadaso mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Asante mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana. ɔyɛ ɔtwerɛtwerɛfoɔ de ma National Accreditation Board wɔ Ghana. ɔyɛ NPP amanyɔni.

Abrabɔ ahyeaseɛ ne nnwomasua 
Wɔwoo Nyarko wɔ Ayewohomumɔ bosome ne da a ɛtɔso mmienu wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduoson mmiɛnsa wɔ Obo Kwahu wɔ apueɛ mantam wɔ Ghana. Wɔtwerɛɛ JSS nsɔhwɛ wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduowɔtwe nsia na ne O'Level wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduokron mmienu ɛna ne A'Level wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduokron nson ne ne kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ nkrataa wɔafe apem ɔha nkron ne aduokron num. Wɔkɔɔ suapɔn kɔgyee ne nkrataa ɛdikan wɔ suapɔn mu wɔ Education and Psychology wɔ mfe mpem mmienu mu, ɔtoaso gyee deɛ ɛtɔso  wɔ Educational Psychology wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne num ne deɛ so biom Educational Psychological wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe.

N'adwuma 
Na Nyarko yɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ panin wɔ Mile 18 JHS. Na ɔkyerɛ adeɛ nso wɔ Ejisuman Senior High sukuu. Na ɔsane yɛ  si a nan mu ma African Representative and Marketing ma Voicecash. Na ɔyɛ panin na Danquah Institute. Na ɔsane ɔyɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛni panin wɔ University of Ghana. Na ɔyɛ panin twerɛtwerɛfoɔ de ma National Accreditation Board.

Amanyɔsɛm adwuma 
Nyarko yɛ mmrahyɛbdwani wɔ mmrahyɛbɛdwafie a ɛtɔso nnwɔtwe wɔ Ghana adehyeman a ɛtɔso nan ma Kwadaso mpɛsoa. N'amanyɔsɛm hyɛɛ aseɛ wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne aduonu wɔ Ghana abatoɔ keseɛ̯ maa NPP. ɔyii no sɛ mmrahyɛbedwafie de maa Kwadaso wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne aduonu abatoɔ keseɛ no mu. Wɔnyaa mma mpem aduosia baako ɔha nson ne aduoson mmienu a ɛyɛ ɔha mu nkyɛnkyɛmu aduonwɔtwe ne aduoson.

Akuo 
Nyarko ka ɛkuo Poverty Reduction Strategy ne Education ho.

N'abrabɔ 
Nyarko yɛ ɔkristoni.

N'ayɛmyɛ adwuma 
Wɔ Ahinime bosome wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne aduonu baako Nyarko kyekyɛ sukuu ntadeɛ mpem baako de maa Nwamase M/A, Asuoyeboah M/A, Kwadaso M/A, Beposo M/A Block A ne B, Prempeh Experimental M/A Block A,B ne C ne Central Agric Station Primary wɔ Kwadaso mpɛsoa.

Beaeɛ menyaa me mmoa firii

title: John Kumah
text:
John Ampontuah Kumah (wɔwoo no 4 August 1978) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni, adwumayɛfoɔ (entrepreneur), ɔsɛnkafoɔ (preacher) ne mmaranimfoɔ (lawyer).[1][2][3][4] Ɔyɛɛ Ɔman Adwumayɛ ne Nneɛma Foforo Dwumadie (NEIP) no soafoɔ panin (Chief Executive Officer) kɔsii sɛ wɔpaw no sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani maa Ejisu Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa no wɔ afe 2020 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu wɔ New Patriotic Party (NPP) tekiti so.[7][8]

Adwuma 
Wɔ afe 2013 mu no, wɔgyee no kɔɔ Ghana Bar sɛ Mmaranimfo (Solicitor) ne Mmaranimfoɔ (Legal Practitioner) ma Ghana Asɛnnibea Kunini (Supreme Court of Ghana).[11] Ɔyɛ Aduaprokye Chambers, Mmara Adwumakuw bi a ɛwɔ Adabraka no muni a ɔhyehyɛɛ ne Managing Partner. Ɔsan nso yɛɛ adwuma sɛ nea ɔhyehyɛɛ Majak Associates Ltd, adansi ne adansi adwumakuo, kɔsii sɛ wɔpaw no sɛ NEIP CEO wɔ afe 2017 mu.[11] John Ampontuah Kumah wɔ bɛboro mfeɛ dunum (15) osuahu wɔ akanni, adebɔ, nneɛma foforɔ ne nneɛma a wɔde yɛ adwuma wɔ nnwuma a wɔyɛ, ne mmabun nkɔsoɔ a wɔboa mu.[12

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔ afe 2020 mu no, John Kumah sii akan na odii nkonim wɔ Mmarahyɛ Badwa no mu wɔ Ejisu Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛso no mu wɔ New Patriotic Party (NPP) tekiti so.[13][7] Mprempren Kumah yɛ Sikasɛm soafoɔ Abadiakyiri.[14][15][16]

Boayikuw ahorow 
Kumah yɛ Ɔman Mmara, Mmara ne Mmarahyɛ Badwa Nsɛm Boayikuo no Titenani Abadiakyiri na ɔsan yɛ Apawfoɔ ne Mmarahyɛ Badwa no boayikuo no muni.[15][17]

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
John aware Ɔsomafo Awuraa Lilian Kumah a ɔyɛ Kristo Suani Ɔsom adwuma no Fapemfo ne Ɔsɔfo Panyin wɔ Wiase Nyinaa. Wɔwɔ mma baanum (6) a wɔwoo wɔn ne mmofra afoforo pii a wɔagye wɔn atom.[1][4]

Adɔeyɛ 
Wɔ August 2022 mu no, Kumah tuaa nipadua a wɔde yɛ nipadua no apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ ahorow (different sets of prosthesis) anum (5) maa wɔn a akwanhyia bi sii wɔ akwan so no bi. Wɔn ne Petro Mensa ne Mose Addai.[23]

title: John Peter Amewu
text:
John-Peter Amewu (wɔwoo no afe 1972 mu) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne mprempren Ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Keteke Nkɔsoɔ so wɔ Ghana na ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani (MP) wɔ Hohoe Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa mu wɔ Ghana Mmarahyɛ Badwa mu.[1][2][3] Na ɔyɛ kan Ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Ahoɔden so[4] ne kan Ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Asase Ne Abɔdeɛ mu Nneɛma so wɔ Ghana.[5][6][7]

Ne mmofraase ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo John-Peter Amewu wɔ afe 1972 mu wɔ Wli-Todzi wɔ Hohoe Kuropɔn mu wɔ Volta Mantam mu. Ɔkɔɔ ne ntoaso sukuu wɔ Hohoe E. P. Senior High School, St. Mary’s Seminary/Senior High School, Lolobi ne Adisadel College, Cape Coast. John-Peter Amewu nyaa ne bachelor’s degree wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so. Ɔtoaa ne nhomasua so na onyaa MBA wɔ sikasɛm mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn, Legon, na ɔkɔɔ so nyaa abodin krataa a ɛdi akyire wɔ amanaman ntam ahoɔden adwumayɛ sohwɛ mu ne abodin krataa a ɛkorɔn wɔ petroleum mmara ne nhyehyɛeɛ mu wɔ Dundee Suapɔn (UK) 9][10

Adwuma 
Ɔyɛ obi a ɔka wɔn a wɔhyehyɛɛ Africa Center for Energy Policy (ACEP), faako a ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ nhyehyɛe ne nhwehwɛmu kwankyerɛfo, na ɔde nhyehyɛe ho afotu mae de boaa aban ne ankorankoro nnwuma ahorow.[11]

Amanyɔsɛm

Mmarahyɛbadwani 
Ɔpɛnimma bosome da a ɛtɔ so nson (7), afe 2020, amansan abatoɔ akyi no, John-Peter Amewu bɛyɛɛ New Patriotic Party kandifoɔ a ɔdi kan a ɔdii nkonim wɔ mmarahyɛ badwa abatoɔ mu wɔ Hohoe Mantam mu firi afe 1992.

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Ɔyɛ Kristoni. Waware na ɔwɔ mma baanan (4)

title: Kennedy Osei Nyarko
text:
Kennedy Osei Nyarko (wɔwoo no 2 Ahinime 1979 wɔ Apueɛ Mantam, Ghana) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni. Wɔpaw no sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ afe 2016 mu a ogyinaa Akim Swedruo Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa ananmu. Wɔ November 2017 mu no, wɔpaw no sɛ Ɔsoafoɔ Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ kuayɛ so wɔ Ghana Amansin mu.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Kennedy wɔ 2 Ahinime 1979 na ɔfiri Akyem Swedru a ɛwɔ Apueɛ Mantam, Ghana. Ɔkɔɔ sukuu wɔ Ghana Insitute of Management and Public Administration bia ɔya bachelor degree wɔ Marketing wɔ afe 2010. Ɔsan toa so kɔ Charted Institute of Marketing wɔ UK bi a ɔya Postgraduate Diploma wɔ Marketing wɔ afe 2011. Ɛwɔ 2012, ɔwie ne postgraduate degree wɔ marketing ɛfiri University of Ghana. Ɔtoa so yɛɛ no Master of Science degree wɔ Climate Change ne Sustainable Development wɔ afe 2019 a ɛfiri University of Ghana.

Adwuma 
Ansa na ɔbɛhyɛ amanyɔsɛm ase no, na Kennedy yɛ technical sales manager wɔ J. A Plant Pool, ɛyɛ Ghana ɛfɔmagudeɛ adwuma bɛyɛ nfie mmiesa ɛna ɔsan yɛɛ General manager ɛma adwumakuo wɔ Atifi mantam npɔtɛmu. Na ɔyɛ Head of Sales/Marketing ma Jospong Group of Companies. Na ɔsan so yɛ Head of Marketing ma Zoomlion Ghana Limited. Ɔwɔ akasafidie adwuma a yɛfrɛ no Bosome FM.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Kennedy yɛ kuoba wɔ New Patriotic Party na sasiaa ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma Akyem Swedru Abatoɔ mpesoaso wɔ Apueɛ Mantam, Ghana. 

Wɔ afe 2012, ɔgyina sɛ Mmrahyɛbadwani na ɔdii nkonim a ɔyɛ nba no 7143. Ɔkɔɔ di dwuma saa afe no mu a. Wɔ afe 2017, ɛsan sɛ William Quaitoo de ne dwuma too hɔ sɛ ɔsoafoɔ abadiakyere ma Mfuomdwuma Asoayɛ, Ɔmanpanyin Nana Akufo-Addo yii no sɛ ɔdi saa dwuma no.

2012 abatoɔ 
Wɔ afe 2012 aba toɔ mu no, ɔdii nkonim wɔ Akyem Swedru Abatoɔ mmpesoaso a ɔyaa mba no 8,865 a ɛgyina ho ma 55.78% a na nea ɔgyina ho ma NDC kuo, Robery Samuel Ansah yaa 3,533 a ɛgyina ho ma 22.23%, nea ɔgyina ho ma PPP, Akwasi Amankwah Marfo nso yaa 231 a ɛgyina ho ma 1.45%, na nea ɔgyina ho sɛ kwantekoro Godwin Boadi yaa 48 a ɛgyina ho ma 0.30%.

2016 abatoɔ 
Wɔ afe 2016 Ghana abatoɔ, ɔsan di nkonim wɔ Akyem Swedru abotoɔ mpesoaso a ɔyaa nba no 11,458 a ɛgyina ho ma 71.4% bere a NDC kuo no nipa Robert Samuel Ansah yaa 4,056 a ɛgyina ho ma 25.3%, PPP kuoba no Obiri Ernest Amo nso yaa 502 a ɛgyina ho ma 3.1% na CPP kuo ba Anim Adoo nso yaa 25 a ɛgyina ho ma 0.2%.

2020 abatoɔ 
Wɔ afe 2020 Ghana abatoɔ ɔsan di nkonim wɔ Akyem Swedru abotoɔ mpesoaso a ɔyaa nba no 11,180 a ɛgyina ho ma 71.3% bere a NDC kuo no nipa Taaju Abdu Rahim yaa 4,503 a ɛgyina ho ma 28.7%.

Kuo ɔwɔ mu wɔ mmrahyɛbadwa 
Wɔ afe 2017, na ɔyɛ otitenani ma Kɔmitee a ɔmɔhyɛ Local Government wɔ mmrahyɛbadwa wɔ Ghana. 

Kennedy san so yɛ otitenani ma Roads ne Transport Kɔmitee na ɔsan nso yɛ kuoba ma Special Budget Kɔmitee, biom ɔsan so yɛ kuoba ma Public Accounts Kɔmitee

Ankorankoro asetra 
Kennedy yɛ Kristoni

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Joseph Kwame Kumah
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Joseph Kwame Kumah (wɔwoo no 24 Ɔpɛpɔn 1974) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni a mprempren ɔyɛ Ghana Mmarahyɛbadwani ma Kintampo Atifi fam Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa.

Ne mmofraase abrabɔ ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Kumah wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduonu anan (24) afe 1974 mu na ofiri Sugliboini wɔ Bono Apuei Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Onyaa bachelor abodin krataa wɔ nhomasua mu wɔ afe 1999. Wɔ afe 2010 mu no, ɔwiee sukuu no na onyaa postgraduate adansedie krataa wɔ Ɔmanfo Adwumayɛbea mu (postgraduate certificate in Public Administration). Akyiri yi onyaa Master of Arts abodin krataa wɔ Mpɔtam Aban Adwumayɛ ne Ahyehyɛde mu (Master of Arts degree in Local Government Administration and Organization) fii Mpɔtam Aban Adesua Asoɛe (Institute of Local Government Studies)..

Adwuma 
Na Kumah yɛ ofie wura (house master) wɔ Ghana Nhomasua Dwumadibea (Ghana Education Service).

Amanyɔsɛm mu adwuma 
Kumah yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛbadwani. Wɔpaw no sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani ma Kintampo Atifi fam Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa wɔ afe 2020 Ghana amansan abatow mu. Odii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ 33,460 (abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ no mu 62.98%). NPP kandifoɔ, Micheal Sarkodie Baffoe, na odii kan wɔ 16,499 (31.05%).

Boayikuw ahorow 
Kumah yɛ Atemmu Boayikuo (Judiciary Committee) no muni na ɔsan yɛ Nhomasua Boayikuo (Education Committee) no muni.

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Kumah yɛ Kristoni.

Ntotohu

title: Joseph Kwasi Mensah
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Joseph Kwasi Mensah (wɔwoo no 18 Obubuo 1962) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni a mprempren ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani ma Nkoranza Atifi Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Bono Apueɛ Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

Ne mmofraase abrabɔ ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Joseph Kwasi Mensah na ofiri Manso wɔ Bono Apueɛ Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Joseph Kwasi Mensah nyaa ne Mfitiaseɛ Nhomasua (Basic Education) wɔ afe 1975 mu a ɛmaa ɔtumi nyaa ne Mfinimfini Sukuu Awieeɛ Abodin krataa (Middle School Leaving Certificate - MSLC) wɔ afe 1979 mu, O-Level adansedie krataa (GCE Ordinary Level) wɔ afe 1989 mu ne O-Level adansedie krataa (GCE Advanced Level) wɔ afe 1990. Afei ɔkɔɔ so nyaa ne Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ Nteteeɛ (Teacher Training) wɔ afe 1984 mu, Diploma wɔ Adwumayɛ Nhomasua mu (Akontaabuo ne Nkontaabuo) - (Diploma in Business Education (Accounting & Mathematics) wɔ afe 1998 mu, Nhomasua mu Bachelor(B.Ed.) - (Akontaabuo ne Nkontaabuo) - (Bachelor of Education(B.Ed.) - (Accounting & Mathematics)) wɔ afe 2000 mu.

Adwuma 
Joseph Kwasi Mensah yɛ adwuma sɛ Ghana Nhomasua Dwumadibea (Ghana Education Service) no Kurowpɔn Mfinimfini Akontaabufo (Municipal Internal Auditor) wɔ Nkoranza Atifi Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa wɔ Bono Apueɛ Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Joseph Mensah nso reyɛ adwuma sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani ma Nkoranza Atifi Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa wɔ Bono Apueɛ Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Joseph Kwasi Mensah sii akan na odii nkonim wɔ NDC mmarahyɛ badwa primaries mu maa Nkoranza Atifi Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa wɔ Bono Apueɛ Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Joseph Kwasi Mensah dii nkonim bio wɔ afe 2020 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu wɔ Ɔman Demokrasi Nhyiam Kuw (National Democratic Congress) tekiti so a onyaa amba 15,124 (57.9%) de kɔkaa Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so awɔtwe (8) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin no ho tiaa Derrick Oduro (Major Rtd.) a ɔfiri Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforɔ (New Patriotic Party) a wonyaa abatow 10,978 (42.1%).

Boayikuw ahorow 
Joseph Kwasi Mensah yɛ Asɔremma a Wɔkura Mfaso Boayikuw no Dwumadibea ahorow (Members Holding Offices of Profit Committee) no muni na ɔsan yɛ Ɔman Mmara, Mmara ne Mmarahyɛ Badwa Nsɛm Boayikuo (member of Constitutional, Legal and Parliamentary Affairs Committee) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4) no Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so awɔtwe (8) no muni.

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Joseph Kwasi Mensah yɛ Kristoni.

Adɔeyɛ 
Joseph Kwasi Mensah de dan mu nneɛma a ne boɔ yɛ GHC75,000 maa mfitiaseɛ sukuu ahodoɔ (basic schools) a ɛwɔ ne Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa (Nkoranza Atifi Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa) a ɛwɔ Bono Apueɛ Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔsan de aduruyɛ nnwinnade pii (large quantity of medical equipment) maa Ɔmantam Akwahosan Dwumadibea (District's Health Directorate) a ɛwɔ ne Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa (Nkoranza Atifi Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa) a ɛwɔ Bono Apueɛ Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Joseph Kwasi Mensah de semɛnte (cement) nkotoku aduonum (50) maa Dromankese sɛ wɔmfa nsi mpɔtam hɔ mfiridwuma sukuu (community's technical school) wɔ ne Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa (Nkoranza Atifi Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa) a ɛwɔ Bono Apueɛ Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

Ntotoho

title: Joseph Osei-Owusu
text:
Joseph Osei-Owusu (wɔwoo no 22 Ɔpɛpɔn 1962, wɔ Bekwai) yɛ Ghana mmaranimfoɔ, ne amanyɔni. Ɔyɛ ɔkasafoɔ abadiakyiri (first deputy speaker) a ɔdi kan wɔ Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so awɔtwe a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4) no mu na ɔsan yɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani ma Bekwai Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa wɔ Ghana Mmarahyɛ Badwa no mu.

Ne mmofraase abrabɔ ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Osei-Owusu wɔ 22 Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduonu mmienu (22) afe 1962 mu na onyaa ne mfitiaseɛ nhomasua wɔ ne kurom, Bekwai. Onyaa ne O-level ntoaso sukuu adesua wɔ Juaben Ntoaso Sukuu (Juaben Secondary School) a ɛwɔ Juaben wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ afe 1981. Wɔ afe 1983 mu no, ɔsan nso nyaa ne A-level wɔ Wenchi Ntoaso Sukuu mu (Wenchi Secondary School). Afei ɔkɔɔ so nyaa Bachelor wɔ Adwinni mu wɔ  Nneɛma a Wɔagye Din ne Mmarawɔ mu firi Ghana Suapɔn (University of Ghana) mu wɔ afe 1987 mu, Barrister of Law (BL) wɔ Ghana Mmara Sukuu (Ghana School of Law) wɔ afe 1989 mu ne Executive master’s abodin krataa wɔ Aban ne Akannifo mu (Executive master's degree in Governance and Leadership) wɔ Ghana Asoɛe a ɛhwɛ adwumayɛ ne ɔman adwumayɛ so (Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration - GIMPA) wɔ afe 2007 mu.

Adwuma 
Osei-Owusu ayɛ adwuma sɛ mmaranimfoɔ (lawyer ) mfeɛ aduonu nkron (29 years) wɔ Ghana akyi a wɔfrɛɛ no sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ mmaranimfoɔ wɔ afe 1990. Ɔhyɛɛ n’adwuma ase wɔ Yaw Barimah & Co dan mu na akyiri yi ɔde ne ho kɔbɔɔ George Sarpong Legal Services baabi a akyiri yi ɔsɔre bɛyɛɛ Assistant Head of Chambers a ɛwɔ hɔ. Akyiri yi ɔbɛyɛɛ adwumayɛfo panyin (Chief Executive Officer - CEO) wɔ Aban a Ɛma Karkafo ne Kar Tumi Krataa (Driver and Vehicle Licensing Authority - DVLA) amammui mu paw a onyae wɔ John Agyekum Kufour bere so.

Ɔkasafo Abadiakyiri a Odi Kan 
Wɔpaw no sɛ Ɔkasafo Abadiakyiri a odi kan (First Deputy Speaker) wɔ Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so nson (7) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4) no mu na wɔsan paw no wɔ saa dibea no mu maa Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so awɔtwe (8) no. Odii kan bɛyɛɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ afe 2009 mu, bere a wɔpaw no a onyaa abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 86.06%.

Boayikuw ahorow 
Mprempren ɔyɛ Hokwan Boayikuw no guamtrani (chairperson) ne Boayikuw a Wɔpaw Wɔn wɔ mmarahyɛ badwa no mu (Appointments Committee in parliament) nso. Ɔsan nso yɛ Daa Ahyɛde Boayikuw (Standing Orders Committee) ne Akwan ne Akwantuo Boayikuw (Roads and Transport Committee) no muni.

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Osei-Owusu yɛ Kristoni.

Ntotoho

title: Kofi Adams
text:
Kofi Iddie Adams (wɔwoo no 2 Kotonimma 1975) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni a ɔyɛ Ɔman Demokrasi Nhyiam Kuw (National Democratic Congress) no muni. Ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani ma Buem Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Oti mantam mu. Ɔyɛ kan Ɔman Nhyehyɛefo (National Organizer) ma Ɔman Demokrasi Nhyiam Kuw (National Democratic Congress).

Ne mmofraase abrabɔ ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Kofi Iddie Adams wɔ 2 Kɔtonima 1975. Ɔfiri Teteman, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Jasikan Mantam mu wɔ Oti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔwɔ Bachelor of Science abodin krataa wɔ Mmoa Ho Adesua mu a ɔsi Epidemiology of Parasitic Diseases so dua.

Adwuma 
Adams som sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ wɔ Adisadel College. Akyiri yi ɔyɛɛ Ɔkasafo Ne Ɔmanfo Nsɛm Ho Ɔkwankyerɛfo (Spokesperson And Director Of Public Affairs) ma Flt. Lt. Jerry John Rawlings (Rtd), kan Ghana Ɔmanpanin.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Adams ayɛ Ɔkyerɛwfo Panyin abadiakyiri wɔ bere a atwam no mu ama National Democratic Congress. Wɔ bosome Ɔpɛnimma afe 2014 mu no, wɔpaw no sɛ Ɔman Nhyehyɛefo (National Organizer) ma kuw no wɔ Ɔman Adwumayɛkuw no abatow mu (National Executive elections). Wɔ afe 2016 abatoɔ no mu run-off mu no, wɔpaw no sɛ NDC ɔman ɔsatuo kuo (campaign coordinator of the NDC) a emufoɔ yɛ dunum (15) no ɔsatuo ntamgyinafoɔ (national campaign team), ne nnipa te sɛ oyce Bawah Mogtari, Felix Kwakye Ofosu, Daniel Ohene Agyekum, Dan Abodakpi, Samuel Ofosu-Ampofo nyinaa som sɛ asɔremma na Johnson Asiedu Nketia sɛ oguamtrani (chairman).

Mmarahyɛbadwa mu mmɔdenbɔ 
Adams dii nkonim wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa mu mmɔdenbɔ mu sɛ obegyina Ɔman Demokrasi Nhyiam Kuw (National Democratic Congress) ananmu ama Buem Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa no ansa na afe 2020 abatow no reba. Adams nyaa abatoɔ 388 de yii mmarahyɛbadwani Daniel Kosi Ashaimah a ɔdii tumi seesei a onyaa amba 280 no fii n’ahengua so. Afoforo no Ibrahim Adams Muniru ne Daniel Adeapena nyaa abatoɔ 95 ne nkron (9).

Wɔ bosome Ɔpɛnimma afe 2020 mu no, Adams dii nkonim wɔ Buem Buem Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa mu. Odii nkonim denam abatoɔ 18,528 a onyaeɛ a ɛgyina hɔ ma 71.84% tiaa ne akansifoɔ a ɔbɛn no paa Lawrence Kwami Aziale a ofiri Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforɔ (New Patriotic Party) a onyaa amba 6,843 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 26.5%.

Mmarahyɛbadwani 
Adams kaa ntam sɛ ɔbɛyɛ Ɔman Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛgyina hɔ ma Buem Buem Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa no wɔ Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so awɔtwe (8) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4) no mu wɔ 7 Ɔpɛpɔn 2021. Ɔsom sɛ Ɔmanfoɔ Akontaabuo Boayikuo (Public Accounts Committee) ne Mmarahyɛbadwa no Bammɔ ne Mfinimfini Boayikuo (Defence and Interior Committee of Parliament) no muni.

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Adams yɛ Kristoni.

Ntotoho

title: Kofi Ahenkorah Marfo
text:
Kofi Ahenkorah Marfo yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so awɔtwe (8) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4) no muni a ogyina Achiase (Ghana mmarahyɛbedwam mpɛsoa) a ɛwɔ Apueɛ Mantam no ananmu wɔ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforɔ (New Patriotic Party) no tekiti so. Mprempren ɔyɛ Metro Mass Transit Limited Boayikuw no Titenani (Board Chairman).

Ne mmofraase abrabɔ ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Marfo wɔ 26 Oforisuo 1968 na ɔfiri Akim Bieni wɔ Apueeɛ mantam mu. Ɔwiee ne Junior Secondary School Certificate wɔ afe 1981 mu na ne GCE O level wɔ afe 1986. Akyiri yi onyaa ne Proficiency Certificate wɔ amanneɛbɔ dan adwumayɛbea (custom house agency) mu wɔ afe 2000 mu ne ne Executive certificate wɔ afe 2013. Ɔsan nyaa ne Executive Masters wɔ afe 2014 mu.

Adwuma 
Marfo yɛ KAM-G Services Limited ne KAMPHA Logistics Limited no sohwɛfoɔ (Managing Director).

Amanyɔsɛm adwuma 
Marfo yɛ NPP muni na mprempren ɔyɛ MP ma Achiase Constituency wɔ Apueeɛ mantam mu . Wɔ afe 2020 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu no, ɔdii nkonim wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa no mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 14,796 a ɛyɛɛ 61.16% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu berɛ a NDC mmarahyɛbadwa mu ɔkannifoɔ Kwasi Akyem Apea-Kubi nyaa abatoɔ 9,154 a ɛyɛɛ 37.84% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu ne GUM mmarahyɛbadwa kandifoɔ Christiana Yeboah nyaa abatoɔ 243 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoo no nyinaa mu 1%.

Boayikuo 
Marfo yɛ Hokwan boayikuo no muni na ɔsan yɛ Akwan ne Kar Boayikuo no muni.

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Marfo yɛ Kristoni.

Adɔyɛ 
Marfo de nwi dryers 16, bus foforo mmienu (2), mfiri foforo 70 a wɔde pam ade ne sika a ɛyɛ Ghana cedis 10,000 mae sɛ sika a wɔde bɛma asuafo 20 a wɔwɔ tertiary level wɔ Achiase.

Ntotoho

title: Kofi Amankwa-Manu
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Kofi Amankwa-Manu yɛ Ghana amanyɔni a ɔyɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforɔ (New Patriotic Party - NPP) no muni. Ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma Atwima-Kwanwoma Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

Ne mmofraase abrabɔ ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Amankwa-Manu wɔ Oforisuo bosome da a ɛtɔ so dubaako (11) afe 1969 na ofiri Atwima Foase a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Onyaa ne O-Level adansedie krataa (GCE Ordinary Level) wɔ afe 1989 mu ne ne O-Level adansedie krataa  (GCE Advanced level) wɔ afe 1991. Ɔsan nyaa ne BSc abodin krataa wɔ Sikakorabea ne Sikasɛm (BSc in Banking and Finance) mu wɔ afe 2012 ne ne LLB wɔ afe 2015.

Adwuma 
Amankwa-Manu yɛɛ adwuma wɔ ɔmanpanyin adwumayɛbea sɛ Nkɛntɛnso Nhwehwɛmu Dwumadibea no Titenani (Head of Impact Assessment Unit) wɔ ɔmanpanin Nana Akufo-Addo bere a edi kan (first term) sɛ Ghana ɔmampanyin no mu. Na ɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu boafo (research assistant) wɔ Fonaa Asoɛe (Fonaa Institute). Ɔsan nso yɛ Waltons Limited adwumakuw no panyin (Chief Executive Officer - CEO).

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ansa na afe 2020 abatoɔ no reba no, Amankwa-Manu hyɛɛ akansi a ɛfa mmarahyɛ badwa no mu wɔ NPP primaries mu wɔ Atwima-Kwanwoma Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa mu. Wɔ bosome Ayɛwohomumɔ afe 2020 mu no odii nkonim wɔ primaries a wɔyɛ maa Atwima-Kwanwoma Atwima-Kwanwoma Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa no mu bere a odii mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔwɔ hɔ mprempren Kojo Appiah Kubi a na wayɛ mmarahyɛbadwani mprɛnsa na wakɔ mmarahyɛbadwa mu fi bosome Ɔpɛpɔn afe 2009 no so nkonim akyi. Odii nkonim denam amba 415 a onyaeɛ bere a deɛ ɔdi tumi no nyaa abatoɔ 69.

Wɔpaw Amankwa-Manu sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani maa Atwima-Kwanwoma Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa wɔ afe 2020 bosome Ɔpɛnimma mmarahyɛbadwa abatow mu. Wɔpaee mu kae sɛ w'adi nkonim wɔ mmarahyɛ badwa abatow no mu bere a onyaa amba 78,209 a egyina hɔ ma 83.78% tiaa nea ɔbɛn no paa a ɔyɛ Ɔman Demokrasi Nhyiam Kuw (National Democratic Congress) kandifo Grace Agyemang Asamoah a ne mu no nyaa amba 14,730 a egyina hɔ ma 15.78%.

Boayikuw ahorow 
Amankwa-Manu yɛ Bɔbeasu ne Mmofra Boayikuw no muni (member of the Gender and Children Committee) na ɔsan yɛ Aduan, Kuadwuma ne Kokoo Nsɛm Boayikuw no muni (member of the Food, Agriculture and Cocoa Affairs Committee).

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Amankwa-Manuyɛ Kristoni.

Ntotoho

title: University of lowa
text:
University of Iowa (UI, U of I, UIowa, anaa tiawa  Iowa no) yɛ amansan  nhwehwɛmu suapɔn a ɛwɔ lowa kuropɔn mu, lowa, United States. Wɔtee no age apem ahanwɔtwe ne aduanan nson (1847) mu, ɛno ne suapɔn a akyɛ pa ara ɔman no mu. Lowa suapɔn no wɔ kɔlege (college) dummienu (12) a wɔma adesua ahodoɔ beboro ahanu (200) ne adwuma ho abɔdin krataa nson (7).

Suapɔn no asase no kɛseɛ yɛ apem, ahanwɔtwe ne aduowɔtwe (1,880-acre) a ɛwɔ lowa asubɔnten ano, lowa suapɔn no ka "R1: Doctoral universities no ho- suapɔn a wɔakwadare wɔ nhwehwɛmu adwuma mu." Ɛwɔ mfeɛ mpem aduonu ne aduonu-baako (2021) wɔ suapɔn no sikasɛm ho no, nhwehwɛmu sika nko ara lowa suapɔn no de dii dwuma yɛ Amerikafoɔ sika ɔpepe ahanwɔtwe ne dunwɔtwe ($818). Deɛ nnipa bebree no ara de nim suapɔn no yɛ wɔn apɔmudensɛm, mmara, ne wɔ awenneɛ ɛyɛ fɛ, ne dwumadie a wɔkan ka amansan dwumadie a ɛtɔ so aduonu-num ho wɔ saa beaeɛ no.

Beaeɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Angélique Kidjo
text:
Angélique Kpasseloko Hinto Hounsinou Kandjo Manta Zogbin Kidjo, wowɔɔ no wɔ Kitawonsa bosome da a ɛtɔ so dunan afe apem ahankron ne aduosia (July 14, 1960), edin a nnipa dodoɔ no ara de nim no ne Angélique Kidjo, ɔyɛ Beninese-Franse nnwontoni-nnwom kyerɛwfo, siniyifo, ne ɔdeyɛfo a wagye din wɔ ne nnwom ahorow ne mfonin nnwom ahorow a afa adebɔ ho. Wɔwoo Kidjo to abusua bi a wɔyɛ mfoniniyɛfoɔ na wɔsan nso yɛ agorɔdifoɔ. Na ne papa yɛ nnwontoni, na ne maame nso yɛ adwuma sɛ obia ɔkyerɛ asa ho nnwom ne agorɔhwɛfo.  Kidjo anya Grammy abasobɔdeɛ anum. Ɔgyee ‘Polar Music Prize’ wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne aduonu mmiɛnsa 2023 mu. 

Wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nson (2007) mu no, akenkan nhoma a ɛyɛ ‘Time’ no frɛɛ no ​​"Africa's premier diva." Ɔdii dwumadie bi wɔ Tokyo afe mpem mmienu ne aduonu (2020) Olympic agodie a wabuei ano wɔ Kitawonsa bosome ne da a ɛtɔ so aduonu mmiɛnsa, afe mpem mmienu ne aduonu baako (July 23, 2021). Wɔ Ɛbɔ bosome ne da a ɛtɔ so dunum, afe mpem mmienu ne aduonu baako (September 15, 2021) mu no, Time de no kaa nnipa ɔha (100) a wɔwɔ wiase yi mu a wagye din no ho.

Ne album Logozo a ɛtɔɔ so aduasa nson (37) wɔ asaw nnwom nhoma akɛseɛ a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ saa berɛ no so, Vice akenkan nhoma a Thump wɛbsaet boaboaa ano no.

Kidjo ka kasa ahodoɔ nnum: Fon, Franse, Yorùbá, Gen (Mina), ne Borɔfo. Ɔto dwom wɔ ne nyinaa mu, na ɔsan nso wɔ ɔno ankasa ne kasa a ɔka, ebi ne nsɛmfua a ɛboa no ma no nya nnwom atifi asɛm bi te sɛ "Batonga".   Kidjo taa de Benin atetesɛm Zilin nne ne bocalese di dwuma.

Abrabɔ mfitiaseɛ 
Wɔwoo Kidjo wɔ Ouidah, Franse Dahomey, baabi a mprempren yi wɔfrɛ hɔ Benin no. Ne papa firi Fon cman a ɛwɔ Ouidah mu na ne maame fi Yoruba a ɛwɔ Nigeria. Ɔnyinii a na ɔtiee Yoruba ne Beninfo amammerɛ nnwom, Miriam Makeba, Hugh Masekela, James Brown, Manu Dibango, Otis Redding, Jimi Hendrix, Fela Kuti, Stevie Wonder, Osibisa, ne Santana.

Mmerɛ a ɔnya mfeɛ nsia no, na Kidjo ne ne maame na ɛyɛ adwuma wɔ agorɔhwɛfo kuw no mu, na ɛmaa no nyaa anisɔ de maa amammerɛ nnwom ne asaw. Ɔfiri ase too nnwom wɔ ne sukuu nnwontoc kuw, Les Sphinx mu, na ɔnyaa nkonimdie sɛ ɔbabun ɛnam deɛ osua no wɔ Miriam Makeba nnwom "Les Trois Z," a na wɔto no wɔ ɔman kasafidie so no so. Kidjo ne Kameroonni nnwomtuni panin Ekambi Brilliant ne ne nuabarima Oscar na ɛtintim Pretty nnwom guu adeɛ so. Ɔyɛɛ nnwom "Ninive," "Gbe Agossi", ne ayɛyɛdeɛ de ma nnwontoni Bella Bellow, ne hwɛsofoc no mu baako. Sɛdeɛ abɔm no dii yie no maa no tumi tutu akwan kɔɔ Abibirim atɔe fam nyinaa. Amammuo mu ntawantawa a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Benin no amma wantumi anyɛ mfoniniyɛfo a ɔde ne ho wɔ n’ankasa ne man mu na ɛmaa no tu kɔɔ Paris wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe mmiɛnsa (1983) mu.

Paris 
Ɛsian amammuo mu ntawantawa nti, na ɛsɛ sɛ Kidjo firi ne kurom na ɔtu kɔ Paris wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe (1980) no mu. Mfitiase no, ɔyɛɛ nhyehyɛe sɛ ɔbɛyɛ mmaranimfo a ɔhwɛ nnipa fahodie nanso awieɛ no ɔsuaa nnwomtoɔ. Bere a na ɔreyɛ daa daa nnwuma ahorow de tua ne adesua ho ka no, Kidjo suaa nnwom wɔ CIM, jazz sukuu a agye din wɔ Paris, faako a ɔhyiaa nnwontofoɔ ne nnwontoni Jean Hebrail, a na ɔne no ahyehyɛ ne nnwom dodoɔ no ara ɛne deɛ ɔwaree no wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe nson (1987) no mu.

Ɔhyɛɛ aseɛ sɛ nnwontoni a ɔboa mpɔtam nnwontofoɔ kuw ahorow no. Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduowctwe num (1985) mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ Jasper van 't Hof Euro-African jazz/rock nnwontofoɔ kuo Pili Pili no nnwontoni. Pili Pili stadio abɔm mmiɛnsa na ɛdi: Jakko (1987), Be In Two Minds (1988, Marlon Klein na ɔyɛɛ) ne Hotel Babo (1990) akyi.

Ɛduru afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe (1980) no awieɛ no, na wabɛyɛ nipa titiriw a na wagye din wɔ nnwomtoɔ mu wɔ Paris na ɔtintim solo abɔm a wɔfrɛ no Parakou maa Open Jazz Label.

Abɔm 
Parakou

Kidjo amanaman nnwom a jdi kan yj Parakou, a ɔdiikan paa ho ntoma wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe nkron (1989) mu no yɛ mfitiaseɛ a ɔne nea ɔyɛ ne nnwom hyehyɛfoɔ Hébrail yɛɛ baako na ɔde Jasper van’t Hof nso baa mu bi.

Logozo

Wɔkyereɛ ne nnwom nhoma a ɛdi kan a ɔyɛ maa Island no firi aseɛ wɔ Miami ne Paris mu na sankubɔ ngyegyejɛ afidie a Joe Galdo na ɔyɛej ​​na ɔde Branford Marsalis ne Manu DiBango nso too saxophone so. Woyii no ɛdi wɔ wiase nyinaa mu wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron baako (1991) mu na ɛduruu ammansan dawurubɔ nnowma nhyehyeɛ a ɛdi kan no so. Wɔyii mfonin nnwom ahorow a ɛfa nnwom "We We" ne "Batonga" ho adi na Kidjo tumi kɔɔ wiase akwantuo a ɛdi kan no, ɔpuiee wɔ afahyɛ ahodoɔ pii ase na ɔyɛɛ titiri wɔ Olympia Hall wɔ Paris wɔ Ahinime bosome no mu ne da a ɛtɔ so aduasa baako, afe apem ahankron ne aduokron mmienu (31, 1992). Logozo na ɛtɔ so aduasa nson (37) wɔ asaw akukudam abɔm wc mmerɛ nyinara mu a Thump wɛbsaet na ɛboaboaa ano.

Ayé

Wɔpaa abɔm Ayé ho adi wɔ afe apem ahankro ne aduokron nnan (1994) mu, David Z na ɔyɛɛeɛ ​​wɔ Prince’s Paisley Park beaeɛ a ɛwɔ Minneapolis na Will Mowat nso na ɔyɛɛ no ​​wɔ Soul To Soul beaeɛ a ɛwɔ London. "Agolo" nso kaa ho bi, a ɛmu sene no Michel Meyer na ɔhwɛ dii ho dwuma nna ɛmaa ho ​​kwan mma Kidjo nyaa Grammy abasobɔdeɛ a ɛdi kan.

Fifa

Kidjo ne Jean Hebrail tuu kwan kɔɔ Benin nyinaa wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron num (1995) mu kɔkyeree atetesɛm nnwom a ɛbɛyɛ nea wɔde bɛyɛ Fifa abɔm no nnyinaso. Carlos Santana yii n'anim wɔ "Naima" so, asɛm bi a Kidjo kyerɛw de maa ne ba baa. Nnwom "Wombo Lombo" ne ne sene a Michel Meyer dii ho dwuma no ​​boa mma no dii nkonim kɛse wɔ abibirem yi mu nyinaa wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia (1996) mu. Wɔyɛɛ: Benin, Paris (Guillaume Tell), London, Los Angeles, Sausalito Plant (Carlos Santana).

Oremi

Peter Mokran ne Jean Hebrail na wɔyɛeɛ, na wɔbɔɔ no wɔ New York, Oremi yɛ nnwom a wɔaboaboa ano a wɔde abibifoɔ ne abibifoɔ-amɛrikafo na ɛyɛeɛ. Cassandra Wilson, Branford Marsalis, Kelly Price ne Kenny Kirkland ne Kidjo ka bɔmu yɛɛ adwuma yi. Nnwom a wɔde buei ano no yɛ Jimi Hendrix "Voodoo Child".

Batonga Fapem

Wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nsia (2006) mu no, Kidjo hyehyɛɛ Batonga Foundation a na ne botaeɛ ne sɛ ɔbɛma mmayewa a wɔrekɔ wɔn  mpanin mfeɛ so a wɔwɔ Afrika Sahara anafo fam no sɛwcbɛhyɛ wɔn den na wɔama wɔn nkyerɛkyerɛ nso so. Batonga botae ne sɛ ɔbɛkɔ "akɔ akyiri asen ɔkwan a wɔabɔ so no" a wɔn anisoadeɛ ne sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ mmabaa na wɔde nimdeɛ ne nsano nnwuma a wohia ama wɔn na ama watumi atena ase a ahoɔden wɔm, na wɔade wɔn ho wɔ sikasɛm mu nso. Batonga kwan a wɔfa so de data di dwuma no ma wotumi de wɔn ani si mmaayewa a ɛyɛ den sɛ wobedu wɔn nkyɛn no so, fa wɔn kɔɔ Mmabaa Kuw ahorow no mu, ma wonya baabi a ahobammɔ wɔ a wobetumi asua ade, ahyiam, abɔ wɔn ho ban, na wɔatu mpɔn wɔ wɔn asetena mu. Ɛwɔ wei mu no, Batonga da so ara di n’adwuma titiriw no— sɛ ɔbɛhyerɛn hann bi wɔ mmaayewa a wobu wɔn ani gu wɔn so kɛseɛ wɔ Francophone West Africa no so na wama wɔn tumi ma wɔayɛ nsakraeɛ wɔ wɔn mpɔtam ne wɔn ankasa asetena mu.

Abakwasɛm 
Bere a Kidjo renyin no, na ɔyɛ abaayewa a na ɔte Benin a ɔnyaa nhomasua wɔ hɔ. Ɔyɛɛ asɛmfua "Batonga" sɛ mmuae a wɔde anigye ka de tia wɔn a wɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ mmaa ɛmfata sɛ wɔbɛkɔ sukuu no. Akyiri no, ɔde ‘wor’ na ɛbaae na ɛbɛyɛ nnwom a agye din mma Grammy nnwontofoɔ/nnwom kyerɛwfoc a wagye din ɛne n'adwumakuo a ɛhwehwɛ mfaso no.

Wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nsia (2006) mu no, Kidjo hyehyɛɛ Batonga Foundation a na ne botaeɛ ne sɛ ɔbɛma mmayewa a wɔrekɔ wɔn mpanin mfeɛ so a wɔwɔ Afrika Sahara anafo fam no sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ wɔn den na wɔama wɔn nkyerɛkyerɛ nso so. Ɛfiri saa berɛ no, Batonga ama mmaayewa a wɔwɔ abibirem aman num (Mali, Benin, Sierra Leone, Ethiopia, ne Cameroon) anya mfe mpem num (5,000) nhomasua ɛnam sika a wɔde maa wɔn ne mmoa a wɔde maa wɔn no, ama asuafoɔ mfeɛ mpem nwɔtwe, ahason ne aduonu nson (8,727) anya abura ne agyanan bea wɔ sukuu ahorow nson (7) mu wɔ Benin, mpɔtam a wɔdi hia sene biribi biara de TOMS mpaboa na ɛnante kɔ sukuu. Wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne dunum de afe mpem mmienu ne dunsia (2015 ne

2016) mu no, wɔ akwankyerɛ a ɛfiri amanaman ntam adwini kuo a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ wɔ nnipa dodoɔ ho bagua no ase no, Batonga hyɛɛ aseɛ twee ne ho firii nwomasua abasobɔdeɛ ne nhomasua a ɛfata nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛtaa gyaw amandi a wɔn ho taa ka mu no ho. Batonga firii aseɛ de n’adwene sii nhomasua nhyehyɛe foforo a wɔayɛ ama mmabaa ne mmabunu dodoɔ no ara so.

(2009, 2012 and 2014) no mu.

Na ɔyɛ Tavis Smiley dwumadie a ɛkɔ so wɔ PBS wɔ Ɔbenem bosome no mu wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du (2010) ne Ɔgyefoɔ bosome no mu wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne dunan (2014) ɛna "Late Night" ne Jimmy Fallon nso yɛeɛ wɔ Kitawonsa bosome no mu afe mpem mmienu ne du (2010) mu. 

Ɔdaa ne ho adi sɛ "Aunt Angelique" wɔ "Pink afahyɛ" soronko a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Neo Yokio no wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne dunson (2017) no mu.

Abasobɔdeɛ ne agyedeɛ a wɔde ma 
Wɔ Ɛbɔ boseme ne da a ɛtɔ so dunum, afe mpem mmienu ne aduonu baako (September 15, 2021) mu no, Time yii no kaa nnipa ɔha (100) a wɔfa wɔn no ho na wɔagye din wɔ wiase yi mu no. Wɔ afepem mmienu ne du (2010) mu no, BBC Focus a ɛwɔ abibibirem yi nnwoma magazime no de Kidjo kaa ne din a ɛfa abibirem asasepɔn no so nnipa aduonum (50) a wɔagye din sen biribi biara 

no ho, na agyina akenkanfo abatow no so, na wɔ afe mpem.mmienu me aduonu (2020) mu no, na ɔka BBC mmaa ɔha (100) a wɔde wɔn din too dwa wɔ Obubuo bosome ne da a ɛtc so aduonu mmiɛnsa afe mpem mmienu ne aduonu (23 November 2020) no mu. 

Wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne dubaako (2011) mu no, Guardian paw no sɛ ɔbaa a ɔdi kan wɔ mmaa ɔha 100 a wɔwɔ adwinnie, sene, nnwom ne ahosiesie adwuma no mu, Kidjo yɛ ɔbaa a ɔdi kan a Forbes nsɛmm nhoma de too gua sɛ ɔka nnipa titiriw aduana a wɔwɔ abibirem ha no ho. 

Daadaa tɛlegrafi a ɛwɔ London no kaa ne ho asɛm sɛ "abibirem nnwom hemmaa a wonnye ho akyinnyeɛ" wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne dummienu (2012) Olympic agodie asubɔnten mu nnwom afahyɛ no ase. Wɔ Ayɛwohomumɔ bosome ne da a ɛtɔ so nsia, afe mpem mmienu ne dummiɛnsa (June 6, 2013) no, wɔpaw Kidjo sɛ Confédération Internationale des Sociétés d’Auteurs et Compositeurs (CISAC) no titrani abadiakyiri. Seesei ɔte New York Kuropɔn mu, [nea ɛnyɛ fibea titiriw a wohia] ɔyɛ obi a ɔdi dwuma wɔ New York Times adwuma mu. Kidjo anya abodin krataa afi Yale Sukuupɔn, Berklee Nnwom Sukuu, Middlebury Kɔlege ne UCLouvain. Kidjo nyaa afe mpem mmienu ne dunum (2015) crystal abasobɔdeɛ a Wiase Sikasɛm Nhyiamu a ɛwɔ Davos wɔ Switzerland de maa no no na ɔnya Ambassador of Conscience abasobɔdeɛ de firii amnesty International wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne dunsia (2016) no mu Ɔsan nso ka ɔyɛkyerɛ a ɛwɔ ɔman no tete nneɛma korabea "National Museum" a jwc abakɔsɛm a ɛfa abibirem amɛrika ho a wobuee ano wɔ Ɛbɔ bosome ne da ɛtɔ so aduonu nan, afe mpem mmienu ne dunsia (September 24, 2016) mu, wɔ ɔman dwadibea no ho. Asaw/klab nnwom a wɔbɔ 
Kidjo nnwom a wafra mu a ɔne ɔyɛkyerɛfoɔ a wɔagye din Norman Cook ("We We") ne Tricky ("Agolo") ka ho na wɔyɛeɛ. Ne nnwom a ɔyɛe no pii adu asaw dawurubɔ/klab agodie nhyehyɛeɛ mu. Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nsia (1996) mu no, Junior Vasquez afra nnwom a ɔyɛeɛ wɔ ne nwom "Wombo Lombo" mu no maa nwom no batɔɔ so dunsia (16). Wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne mmienu (2002) mu no, King Britt afra nnwom a ɔyɛeɛ wɔ ne dwom "Tumba" no boaa ma nwom no bɛtɔɔ so aduonu nsia (26). Mark Kinchen na ɔsan yɛɛ "Agolo" nnwom no foforɔ, Junior Vasquez nso yɛɛ "Shango" nnwom no foforɔ, na , Jez Colin nso yɛɛ "Conga Habanera" nwom no foforɔ. "Salala" a efi, Djin Djin, no, Junior Vasquez ne Radioactive Sandwich na wɔsan yɛɛ no foforɔ wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nson (2007) no mu. Move On Up" no, Radioclit, kuw a wofi "Very Best" no na ɔsan yɛɛ no foforɔ.

title: Sony Lab'ou Tansi
text:
Sony Lab'ou Tansi (kitawonsa da a ɛtɔ so num wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduanan nson kɔsi Ayɛwohomumɔ bosome da a ɛtɔ so du nan wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron num), wɔwoo no wɔ Marcel Ntsoni, a na ɔyɛ congoni a ɔtwerɛ Ayesɛm, ahwɛgorɔ ne anwonsɛm ne anwonsɛm wɔ French kasa mu. Ɛwɔ mu sɛ ɔdii mfeɛ aduanan nson, nanso Tansi da so yɛ ɔtwerɛfoɔ a nea watwerɛ biara ɛso aba wɔ abibire mu ha ne wiase afanan nyinaa. N'Ayɛsɛm "Antipeople" ama no anya abasobɔdeɛ 'Grand Prix Littéraire d'Afrique Noire'. Wɔ mfeɛ bi a atwam no, Ɔbuee dwumakuo bi wɔ Brazzaville wɔ Congo man mu.

Abrabɔ ne nnwuma 
Anuanom nson no ɔno na ɔyɛ ba panin, yɛwoo Tansi wɔ ɛnkane Belgian Congo a ɛwɔ Kimwaanza akurase,  ɛwɔ kuro no anaafoɔ fam a wɔfrɛ no Kinshasa wɔ ɛnnɛ mmerɛ Congo man mu. Wɔkyerɛɛ no adeɛ wɔ Kikongo kasa mu na wɔhyɛɛ aseɛ kyerɛɛ no French kasa berɛ a na wadi mfeɛ du mmienu, berɛ n'abusuafoɔ tu firii Congo-Brazzaville a ɛnnɛ yɛfrɛ no kwasafoman Congo. Ɔkɔɔ sukuu wɔ École Normale Supérieure d'Afrique Centrale a ɛwɔ Brazzaville, ɛhɔ na Ɔsuaa kasadwini. Ɔwiee n'adesua wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduoson baako no ɔbɛyɛɛ French ne Borɔfo kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ wɔ Kindamba ne Pointe-Noire. Berɛ a ɔkyerɛkyerɛni ketewa yi hyɛɛ aseɛ sɛ ɔretwerɛ ama agohwɛbea saa afe no, ɔbɛnyaa twerɛdua bi din "Sony Lab'ou Tansi" sɛ adanseɛ ma Tchicaya U Tam'si, Congolesenii a ɔtwerɛɛ anwonsɛm bi a ɛfa ateetee bi a ɛkɔ so wɔ ɔman no amanyɔsɛm mu.

N'adwuma no ahyɛaseɛ mu no, Tansi toaa so bɔɔ mmɔden boaa ne ho wɔ adekyerɛ mu ɛna ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ Borɔfo kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ wɔ Tchicaya-Pierre Collége a ɛwɔ Pointe Noire berɛ a ɔredi dwuma wɔ n'ayɛsɛm ahodoɔ mmienu ne ahwɛgorɔ pii ho no. Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduoson nkron no, ɔtee Rocado Zulu agohwɛbea, a ɔbɛkɔ akɔyi yɛkyerɛ wɔ n'ahwɛgorɔ no ho wɔ Abibirem, Europe ne United States na wasan akɔ "Festival International des Francophonies" a ɛwɔ Limoges da biara. 

Ɔkyerɛɛ adeɛ mfeɛ pii akyire no, Tansi kɔyɛɛ aban adwuma, ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ adwuma mu totoiɛfoɔ wɔ asoeɛ ahodoɔ wɔ Brazzaville.  Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduowɔtwe mu no, ɔne Bernard Kolélas a ɔne kuo afoforɔ adwene nkɔ benkorɔ na ka bomm tee Congolese anamɔntuo ma kabi mame nkabi "Congolese November for Democracy and Integral Development" (MCDDI), amanyɔkuo a preko atia Ɔmanpanin Denis Sassou Nguesso ne Congolese adwuma kuo. Ekuo a ɛwɔ nsa benkum soɔ no bɔɔ mmɔden pia Ɔmanpanin Sassou wɔ kabi mame nkabi na ɛnkane ɔsoafoɔ Pascal Lissouba firii amanehunu kɛseɛ bi mu na wɔyii no sɛ ɔmanpanin wɔ ɔsanaa bosome wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron mmienu abatoɔ mu. Wɔ saa afe no ara mu no, wɔyii Tansi maa no kɔɔ mmrahyɛbedwafie sɛ Makélékélé a ɛwɔ Brazzaville abɛdiakyire, nanso n'anammɔntuo sɛ kuo a ɔne afoforɔ adwene nkɔ benkorɔ no hyɛɛ ɔmanpanin Lissouba abufuo maa wɔgyee no krataa a wɔde tu kwan wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron nan mu.

Tansi hunuu sɛ wanya n'abaso werɛmfo, nanso ɛnam sɛ Lissouba sii no kwan wɔ n'akwantuo ho nti wantumi ankɔgye yarehwɛ wɔ amanɔne amma ɔne ne yere. Tansi hokani Pierrette wɔ wɔ saa yareɛ no mu wɔ Ayɛwohomumɔ bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduasa baako wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron num mu ɛna nna du nan akyire no Tansi nso wui.

title: Francis bebey
text:
Francis Bebey, ɔwoo no wɔ afe apem ɔha  nkron ne aduonu nkron wɔ Duoala, Cameroon na ɔwuiɛ wɔ Kotonimaa bosome ne da a ɛtɔso aduonu nnwɔtwe wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne baako wɔ Paris, France man mu. Na ɔyɛ Cameroonni a ɔtwerɛ na ɔsane bɔ nnwom.

ABRABɔ AHYEASEɛ 
Wɔwoo Francis Bebey wɔ Duoala, Cameroon wɔ Kitawonsa bosome ne da a ɛtɔso du num wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduonu nkron. Bebey kɔɔ kolege wɔ Duoala ɛhɔ na ɔkɔ sua Mathematics ansa na ɔkɔsua Broadcasting wɔ University of Paris. Bebey kɔɔ United States kɔ toa Broadcasting so wɔ New York University. Wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduonum nson no Bebey dii Kwame Nkrumah asɛm so baa nsra wɔ Ghana bɛyɛɛ nsɛm twerɛni.

NNWOM ADWUMA 
Wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduosia anim mu no, Bebey kɔɔ France bɛhyɛɛ ntwerɛ dwuma ase wɔberɛ ɔreyi ne adi akyerɛ sɛ nnwomtoni,atwerɛ ne sculptor mu. Na ɔyɛ bibini nnwomtoni a ɔdikan de Electrical Keyboard ne Programmable ntwene mfidie ka yɛn abibirem mfidie yɛɛ adwuma. Ne nnwoma agye din Agatha Moudio's Son. Wɔberɛ a na ɔne UNESCO reyɛ adwuma wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduosia baako de kɔsi afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduoson nan ɔbɛyɛɛ nnwomtoɔ panin wɔ Paris.Wei boa maa ɔ̯bɛyɛɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ abibifoɔ nnwomtoɔ mu.

Bebey yii ne nnwom a ɛbom a ɛdikan wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduosia nkron. Bebey yii ne nnwom ne nnwom a ɛbom bebree bɛyɛ aduonu wɔ Ozileka wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduoson num de kɔsi afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduokron nson. Na ɔtaa de Guitar na yɛ nnwom nanso na ɔde abibifoɔ mfidie nso ka ho.Ne nyinaa mu no ɔyi Bebey ayɛ wɔ ne nnwomtoɔ mu nanso na nnwomtoɔ no tia ne kasa ho nnwom ahyeaseɛ no. Na ne neɛ nyinaa ayɛ sɛ Cameroon Makossani a ɔde gyitar, yass ne pop a na amanfoɔ hunu no sɛ ɔyɛ ade ɛpaa, nimdefoɔ. anika na ɛyɛ nyansa nso.

ɔde Duoala, French ne English too ne nnwom.

Bebey boa yii Manu Dibango dwuma pueɛ. Bebey de ne nnwom akuoakuo aduonu na baa abonten wɔ berɛ na ɔwɔ adwuma no mu, na ɔtwerɛ nsɛm bi te sɛ Black Tears a ɔtwerɛ maa March on Washington for Jobs and Freedom.

Bebey di ntintiman wɔ n'dehou wɔ one-note bamboo flute a Central African Pygmies yɛɛ yɛ no. ɛnam beaeɛ na ɔtete no nti bebree noaa nnim Pygmies nanso Bebey fa too ne ho so sɛ ɔbɛsua wɔn amamrɛ afiri African Pygmies na ankasa hɔ ne titire ne wɔn nnwom ne wɔn nyansa fa wiase ho.

NNWOMA ADWUMA 
Bebey twerɛɛ nnwoma, anwensɛm, agorɔ,  ne deɛ ɛkeka ho. ɔhyɛɛ atwerɛ no ase sɛ nsɛm twerɛni wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduonum ɛduruu berɛ bi ɔbɛyɛɛ nsɛm twerɛni wɔ Ghana ne Abibiman maa French radio mfidie bi te sɛ Societe de radiodiffusion de la France d'outre-mer(SORAFAM).

Na Bebey ntwereɛ a ɛdikan Le Fils d'Agatha Moudio(Agatha Moudio's Son) a ɔde baa abɔten wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduosia nson na ɔnyaa n'abasobɔdeɛ Grand Prix Litteraire d'Afrique Noire wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduosia nnwɔtwe a ɛyɛ n'adwuma ɛsɔ ani paa. ɔde ne nnwoma L'enfant Pluie(The child of rain) a ɔde baa abɔnten wɔ afe apem ɔha aduanan ne nan nso nyaa abasobɔdeɛ The Prize Sai a nt Exupery.

Bebey de ne nimdeɛ wɔ Abibifoɔ ho twerɛɛ nnwoma faa mmɔfra ne mpaninyɛ ho nsɛm.

NE WUO NE DEɛ YɛDE KAE NO 
Bebey wuu wɔ Paris, France Kɔtonima bosome ne da a ɛtɔso aduonu nnwɔtwe wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne baako. ɔgyaa ne mma Patrick, Toups, ne Kidi Bebey ne ne yere.

John Williams twerɛɛ "Hello Francis" de kae Bebey. Nnwom no gyina Makossa asa a agye din wɔ Cameroon a na Francis taa de sa ne nsɛm a ɛfiri nnwom no mu The Magic Box ne Hidden Bit a ɛyɛ J.S. Bach dea.

Arcade Fire nnwom a ɔne Francis bɔɔeɛ Everything Now ne "The Coffee Cola nnwom. Nnwom no mu fa baabi no Patrick Bebey a ɛyɛ Francis ba barima na bɔɔɔeɛ.

N'ABASOBODEɛ 
Francis Bebey de n'atwerɛtwerɛ nyaa abasobodeɛ wɔ Grand Prix de la Memiore GPLA wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne du mmiɛnsa mu.Grand Prix de la Memoire yɛ abasobodeɛ a ɔde ma atwerɛtwerɛfoɔ na ɔdi ntintiman wɔ Cameroon atwereɛ mu a wawu. ɔde ne nnwoma ɛdikan Le Fils d;Agatha Moudio(Agatha Moudio's Son ) na nyaa Grand Prix Litteraire de L'Afrique Noire abasobodeɛ wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduosia nnwɔtwe mu. Grand Prix Litteraire  abasobodeɛ no deɛ ɔyɛ maa  Abibifoc. Ne nnwoma L'Enfant Pluie(Rain Child) no ɔde nyaa Prix Saint Exupery abasobɔdeɛ no wɔ afe afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduokron nan. Prix Saint Exupery abasobodeɛ deɛ ɔyɛ maa atwerɛtwerɛfoɔ a ɔdɔ mmranteɛ na mmranteɛ nso dɔ ne nnwoma.

NE NNWOM HO NSɛM
