title: Fela Kuti na ɔkyerɛwee
text: Fela Aníkúlápó Kuti Olufela Olusegun Oludotun Ransome-Kuti ; wɔwoo no wɔ Ahinine bosome no da a,ɛtɔso 15 wɔ mfie 1938 wɔ Ɔsanaa bosome no, ne da a ɛtɔso mmienu (2) wɔ mfie 1997 no mu na ɔsanso frɛ no Abami Eda, yɛ Nigeriani nnwontoni, ɔpanin a ɔda nnwomtofoɔ kuo ano, ɔsanso yɛ nnwom hyehyɛfoɔ, amamyoɔnsɛm mu ɔbenfoɔ, ne Pan Africanist. Wobu no sɛ ɔyɛ Panin a ɔyɛ Afrobeat nnwomtoni, Nigeriafoɔ nnwom nkorabata a ɛka Abibirem Atɔeɛ Aman no nnwom ne Americafoɔ nnwom a yɛ frɛ no Jazz ne Funk bom. Wɔ mmerɛ na ɔregye ne din paa ara no, na wɔka ne ho nsɛm sɛ Africa anaa sɛ Abibiman mu nnwontoni a ne ho yɛ den na ne suban a ɔdan no adi wɔ ne nnwomtoɔ mu no yɛ soronko. Allmusic nso daa no adi sɛ "nnwom ne asetena mu amammunsɛm nne" a ɛho hia wɔ amanaman ntam. Ná Kuti yɛ Nigeriani baa Funmilayo Ransome-Kuti a a ɔhwɛ mmaa yiedie ne pɛripɛriyɔ ahodoɔ soɔ no ba barima. Mmerɛ a onyaa suahu ahodoɔ a edi kan wɔ amannɔne akyi no, ɔne ne nnwontofoɔ kuo a yɛ frɛ wɔn sɛ Africa 70 (ne nsankubɔfoɔ ne nnwom kwankyerɛfoɔ a ne din de Tony Allen pɛgyaa wɔn mu so kɔɔ suro sɛ nsoroma wɔ wɔn nnwomtoɔ dwumadie mu maa amannsan nyinaa hunuu wɔn ɛwɔ Nigeria man no mu wɔ mfie 1970 no mu, mmerɛ a na ɔyɛ ɔkasatiafo a ɔkasa tia nsɛm pefee maa Nigeria asraafoɔ mpaninfoɔ de wɔn ani sii so no .Wɔ 1970 mu no, ɔtee ɛkuo bi a na wɔn din de Kalakuta Republic commune a wɔ dan n'adi sɛ pefee sɛ w'ate ne ho afiri asraafo abae ho. Wɔsɛee ɛkuo no wɔ afe 1978 no mu a wɔde ntua bi a epirapiraa Kuti ne ne maame. Muhammadu Buhari aban de no too efiase wɔ afe 1984 mu, nanso wogyaee no wɔ abosome 20 akyi. Ɔkɔɔ so ara yɔɔ nnwom na ɔtɔɔ nnwom kosii afe 1980 ne 1990 mfe no mu. Efiri saa mmerɛ a owueɛ wɔ afe 1997 mu no, ne ba barima Femi Kuti na ɔhwɛɛ ne nnwom no so na ɔsanso kekaa deɛ aka no nyinaa boaboa ano hwɛɛ so. Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ ne adwuma Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ Olufela Olusegun Oludotun Wɔwoo Ransome-Kuti. baa Ransome-Kuti abusua no mu wɔ Nigeriafoɔ abusua a ɛwɔ mfinfini mpaninfoɔ abusua mu, wɔ Ahinime bosome no ne da a ɛtɔso 15 wɔ afe 1938 wɔ Abeokuta a ɛnnɛ yi yɛ nim no sɛ Ogun Man Ahenkuro.a na saa mmerɛ no na ɛyɛ kuro a ɛwɔ British Colony of Nigeria man no mu. Na ne maame, ɔkandifoɔ Funmilayo-Kuti, yɛ ɔbaa a ɔsɔre tia atubrafoɔ a na ne papa, Ɔsɔfopanin Israel Olodotun Ransome-Kuti, a na ɔyɛ Anglican sofoɔ, sukuu panyin, ne Nigeria akyerɛkyerɛ kuo no titrani a odi kan. Kuti awofoɔ mmienu no nyinaa dii dwuma dendeenden wɔ ɛkuo a ɔsɔre tia abrofo wɔ Nigeria man no mu, ne ɛyɛ ahyensodeɛ kɛseɛ paa ne Abeokuta mmaa basabasaeɛ a ne maame dii anim wɔ afe 1946.Ná wonim ne nuanom Beko Ransome-Kuti ne Olikoye Ransome-Kuti, a wɔn baanu nyinaa yɛ nnuruyɛfo, yiye wɔ ɔman no mu.Kuti Yɛ ɔkyerɛwfo ne nea onyaa nkonimbo Wole Soyinka, a onyaa Nobel Akyɛde wɔ Nhomakorabea no wɔfase .Wɔn baanu nyinaa yɛ Josiah Ransome-Kuti, a ɔyɛ Kuti nana wɔ n’agya fam ne Soyinka nana wɔ ne maame fam no asefo. Kuti kɔɔ Abeokuta Kasa Mmara Sukuu . Wɔ 1958 mu no, wɔde no kɔɔ London sɛ ɔnkɔsua aduruyɛ nanso osii gyinae sɛ obesua nnwom mmom wɔ Trinity College of Music, na torobɛnto ne sanku a ɔpɛ. Bere a ɔwɔ hɔ no, ɔhyehyɛɛ nnwontofo kuw Koola Lobitos na ɔbɔɔ jazz ne highlife nnwom a wɔde afrafra. Wɔ 1960 mu no, Kuti waree ne yere a odi kan, Remilekun (Remi) Taylor, a ɔne no woo mma baasa ( Femi, Yeni, ne Sola).Wɔ 1963 mu no, Kuti san kɔɔ Nigeria Fekuw a na ɛde ne ho foforo no mu, ɔsan hyehyɛɛ Koola Lobitos, na ɔtetee ne ho sɛ radio so yɛfo maa Nigeria Broadcasting Corporation . Ɔne Victor Olaiya ne ne All-Stars bɔɔ bɔɔl bere bi. Ɔfrɛɛ ne su no Afrobeat, Fuji nnwom, funk, jazz, highlife, salsa, calypso, ne Yorubafo amammerɛ nnwom a wɔaka abom.Wɔ 1969 mu no, Kuti de nnwontofo kuw no kɔɔ United States na odii asram du wɔ Los Angeles. Bere a ɔwɔ hɔ no, ɔnam Sandra Smith (mprempren wɔfrɛ no Sandra Izsadore anaa Sandra Akanke Isidore),a na ɔyɛ Black Panther Party no fã bi so huu Abibifo Tumi kuw no. Saa osuahu yi nyaa ne nnwom ne amammui adwene so nkɛntɛnso kɛse.Ɔsesaa nnwontofo kuw no din Nigeria 70. Ɛno akyi bere tiaa bi no, obi a ɔhyɛ nkurɔfo nkuran bɔɔ amanneɛ kyerɛɛ Immigration and Naturalization Service sɛ Kuti ne ne nnwontofo kuw no wɔ U.S. a wonni adwuma ho tumi krataa. Nnwontofo kuw no yɛɛ nnwom a wɔkyere gu kasɛt so ntɛmntɛm wɔ Los Angeles a akyiri yi wobeyi no adi sɛ The '69 Los Angeles Sessions. 1970 mfe no mu Bere a Kuti ne ne nnwontofo kuw san kɔɔ Nigeria akyi no, wɔsesaa kuw no din (the) Africa ’70 bere a nnwom mu nsɛmti sesa fii ɔdɔ so kɔɔ asetra mu nsɛm so no. Ɔhyehyɛɛ Kalakuta Republic — commune, recording studio, ne fie a nnipa pii a wɔne nnwontofo kuw no wɔ abusuabɔ te — a akyiri yi ɔkae sɛ ɛde ne ho fi Nigeria man no ho. Kuti hyehyɛɛ anadwo agoprama bi wɔ Empire Hotel, na odii kan too din Afro-Spot na akyiri yi wɔtoo din Afrika Kronkronbea, faako a ɔyɛɛ nnwom daa na ɔyɛɛ Yorubafo amammerɛ mu guasodeyɛ ahorow a wɔayɛ ama obiara de hyɛɛ ne man no nananom gyidi anuonyam. Ɔsan nso sesaa ne din yɛɛ no Anikulapo (a ɛkyerɛ sɛ "Nea ɔsoa owuo wɔ ne kotokuo mu", a nkyerɛaseɛ ne sɛ: "Mɛyɛ m'ankasa me nkrabea wura na mɛsi berɛ a ɛberɛ a ɛsɛ sɛ owuo fa me").gyaee abusua din a wɔde nkyerɛwde ahyɛ mu "Ransome" no di dwuma efisɛ obuu no sɛ ɛyɛ akoa din .  Ná Nigeria ɔmanfo ne Afrikafo nyinaa ani gye Kuti nnwom ho.Osii gyinae sɛ ɔbɛto dwom wɔ Pidgin Borɔfo kasa mu sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ankorankoro a wɔwɔ Afrika nyinaa betumi anya ne nnwom no mu anigye, baabi a ɛhɔnom kasa ahorow a wɔka no gu ahorow na ɛdɔɔso . Ɛmfa ho sɛnea na Kuti nnwom agye din wɔ Nigeria ne mmeae afoforo no, na aban a edi tumi no ani nnye ho, na na wɔtaa tow hyɛ Kalakuta Republic so. Wɔ 1972 mu no, Ginger Baker kyere Stratavarious , na Kuti ne odwontofo ne sankubɔfo Bobby Tench puei.Bɛyɛ saa bere yi mu no, Kuti de ne ho hyɛɛ Yoruba som mu kɛse mpo. Wɔ afe 1977 mu no, Kuti ne Africa 70 yii album Zombie, a ɛkasa tiaa Nigeria asraafo kɛse, na wɔde zombie kasakoa no dii dwuma de kyerɛkyerɛɛ Nigeria asraafo akwan mu. Album no dii yiye kɛse na ɛhyɛɛ aban no abufuw, na wɔde asraafo 1,000 tow hyɛɛ Kalakuta Republic so. Wɔ ntua no mu no, wɔboroo Kuti denneennen, na ne maame a ne mfe akɔ anim (ɔbea a odi kan a ɔkaa kar wɔ Nigeria) pirapirae kɛse bere a wɔtow no fii mfɛnsere mu no. Wɔhyew commune no, na wɔsɛee Kuti studio, nnwinnade, ne master kasɛt ahorow . Kuti kae sɛ sɛ ɛnyɛ ɔsraani panyin bi de ne ho gyee mu bere a na wɔreboro no no a, anka wobekum no. Kuti mmuae a ɔde mae wɔ ntua no ho ne sɛ ɔde ne maame funnaka no kɔɔ Dodan Barracks a ɛwɔ Lagos, Ɔsahene Olusegun Obasanjo atrae, na ɔkyerɛw nnwom abien, "Adaka a wɔde ma Ɔman Ti" ne "Ɔsraani a Wonnim," de twee adwene sii aban nhwehwɛmu a ɛkyerɛe no so na ɔsraani bi a wonnim no asɛe kurow no. Kuti ne ne nnwontofo kuw no bɛtraa Crossroads Hotel bere a wɔsɛee Kronkronbea no kaa kurow no ho akyi. Wɔ 1978 mu no, ɔwaree mmea 27, na na wɔn mu pii yɛ asawfo, nnwom hyehyɛfo, ne nnwontofo a ɔne wɔn yɛɛ adwuma. Ɛnyɛ sɛ aware no yɛɛ ntua a wɔde baa Kalakuta Republic so no afeda nko, na mmom ɛbɔɔ Kuti ne ne yerenom ho ban fii atumfoɔ atoro nsɛm a wɔkae sɛ Kuti rekyere mmea no ho nso.Akyiri yi, ɔfaa nhyehyɛe bi a wɔde di akɔneaba a ɛne sɛ ɔbɛma ɔyerenom 12 atra hɔ bere koro mu. Na kɔnsɛt abien nso wɔ afe no mu: nea edi kan no wɔ Accra, a basabasayɛ sii wɔ dwom "Zombie" bere mu, a ɛmaa wɔbaraa Kuti sɛ ɔnkɔ Ghana ; nea ɛto so abien no yɛ Berlin Jazz Afahyɛ no akyi bere a Kuti nnwontofo dodow no ara gyaw no hɔ esiane nsɛm a wɔkae sɛ wayɛ nhyehyɛe sɛ ɔde sika a obenya no nyinaa bedi dwuma de atua ne ɔmampanyin ɔsatu no nti. Wɔ afe 1978 mu no, Fela ne ne nnwontofo kuw Africa 70 bɔɔ nnwom wɔ Berliner Jazztage a ɛwɔ Berlin no. Esiane sɛ Tony Allen, nnwontofo kuw no kannifo ne nnwontofo no nyinaa abam bui wɔ wɔn ka no ho nti, wogyaee adwuma.fi saa bere no, Baryton sankubɔfo Lekan Animashaun bɛyɛɛ nnwontofo kuw kannifo na Fela hyehyɛɛ kuw foforo bi a wɔtoo din Egypt80 . Wɔ afe 1979 mu no, Kuti hyehyɛɛ n'amammui kuw a ɔfrɛɛ no Movement of the People (MOP), sɛ "ɛbɛtew ɔmanfo ho te sɛ mop", nanso ntɛm ara na ɛnyɛ adwuma esiane ne akasakasa a ɔne aban a na ɛwɔ hɔ saa bere no dii nti. MOP kaa Nkrumahism ne Afrikasom ho asɛm. title: Fela Kuti
text:
Fela Aníkúlápó Kuti Olufela Olusegun Oludotun Ransome-Kuti ; wɔwoo no wɔ Ahinime bosome no da a,ɛtɔso 15 wɔ afe  1938 wɔ Ɔsanaa bosome no, ne da a ɛtɔso mmienu (2) wɔ afe  1997 no mu na ɔsanso  frɛ no Abami Eda, yɛ Nigeriani nnwontoni, ɔpanin a ɔda nnwomtofoɔ kuo ano, ɔsanso yɛ nnwom hyehyɛfoɔ, amamyoɔnsɛm mu ɔbenfoɔ, ne Pan Africanist. Wobu no sɛ ɔyɛ Panin a ɔyɛ Afrobeat nnwomtoni, Nigeriafoɔ nnwom nkorabata  a ɛka Abibirem Atɔeɛ Aman no nnwom ne Americafoɔ nnwom a yɛ frɛ no Jazz ne Funk  bom. Wɔ mmerɛ na ɔregye ne din paa ara no, na wɔka ne ho nsɛm sɛ Africa anaa sɛ Abibiman mu nnwontoni a ne  ho yɛ den na ne suban a ɔdan no adi wɔ ne nnwomtoɔ mu no yɛ soronko. Allmusic nso daa no adi sɛ "nnwom ne asetena mu amammunsɛm nne" a ɛho hia wɔ amanaman ntam.

Ná Kuti yɛ Nigeriani baa Funmilayo Ransome-Kuti a a ɔhwɛ mmaa yiedie ne pɛripɛriyɔ ahodoɔ soɔ no ba barima. Mmerɛ  a onyaa suahu ahodoɔ a edi kan wɔ amannɔne akyi no, ɔne ne nnwontofoɔ kuo a yɛ frɛ wɔn sɛ Africa 70 (ne nsankubɔfoɔ ne nnwom kwankyerɛfoɔ a ne din de Tony Allen pɛgyaa wɔn mu so kɔɔ suro sɛ nsoroma wɔ wɔn nnwomtoɔ dwumadie mu maa amannsan nyinaa hunuu wɔn ɛwɔ Nigeria man no mu wɔ afe 1970 no mu, mmerɛ  a na ɔyɛ ɔkasatiafo a ɔkasa tia nsɛm pefee maa Nigeria asraafoɔ mpaninfoɔ  de wɔn ani sii so no .Wɔ 1970 mu no, ɔtee ɛkuo bi a na wɔn din de  Kalakuta Republic commune a wɔ dan n'adi sɛ pefee sɛ w'ate ne ho afiri asraafo abae ho. Wɔsɛee ɛkuo no wɔ afe 1978 no mu a wɔde ntua bi a epirapiraa Kuti ne ne maame. Muhammadu Buhari aban de no too efiase wɔ afe 1984 mu, nanso wogyaee no wɔ abosome 20 akyi. Ɔkɔɔ so ara yɔɔ nnwom na ɔtɔɔ nnwom kosii  afe 1980 ne 1990 afe no mu. Efiri saa mmerɛ a owueɛ wɔ afe 1997 mu no, ne ba barima Femi Kuti na ɔhwɛɛ ne nnwom no so na ɔsanso kekaa deɛ aka no nyinaa boaboa ano hwɛɛ so.

Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ ne adwuma

Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ 
Olufela Olusegun Oludotun Wɔwoo Ransome-Kuti. baa Ransome-Kuti abusua no mu wɔ Nigeriafoɔ abusua a ɛwɔ mfinfini mpaninfoɔ abusua mu, wɔ  Ahinime  bosome no ne da a ɛtɔso 15 wɔ afe 1938 wɔ Abeokuta a ɛnnɛ yi yɛ nim no sɛ Ogun Man Ahenkuro.a na saa mmerɛ no na ɛyɛ kuro a ɛwɔ British Colony of Nigeria man no mu. Na ne maame, ɔkandifoɔ Funmilayo-Kuti, yɛ ɔbaa a ɔsɔre tia atubrafoɔ a na ne papa, Ɔsɔfopanin Israel Olodotun Ransome-Kuti, a na ɔyɛ Anglican sofoɔ, sukuu panyin, ne Nigeria akyerɛkyerɛ kuo no titrani a odi kan. Kuti awofoɔ mmienu no nyinaa dii dwuma dendeenden wɔ ɛkuo a ɔsɔre tia abrofo  wɔ Nigeria man no mu, ne ɛyɛ ahyensodeɛ kɛseɛ paa ne Abeokuta mmaa basabasaeɛ a ne maame dii anim wɔ afe 1946.Ná wonim ne nuanom Beko Ransome-Kuti ne Olikoye Ransome-Kuti, a wɔn baanu nyinaa yɛ nnuruyɛfo, yiye wɔ ɔman no mu.Kuti Yɛ ɔkyerɛwfo ne nea onyaa nkonimbo Wole Soyinka, a onyaa Nobel Akyɛde wɔ Nhomakorabea no wɔfase .Wɔn baanu nyinaa yɛ Josiah Ransome-Kuti, a ɔyɛ Kuti nana wɔ n’agya fam ne Soyinka nana wɔ ne maame fam no asefo.

Kuti kɔɔ Abeokuta Grammar School Wɔ afe 1958 mu no, wɔde no kɔɔ London sɛ ɔnkɔsua aduroyɛ nanso osii gyinae sɛ obesua nnwom wɔ (Trinity College of music), a ɛyɛ suapɔn  a wɔkyerɛ nnwomtoɔ, na torobɛnto ne nsanku ne nea ɔpɛ. Mmerɛ  a ɔwɔ hɔ no, ɔhyehyɛɛ nnwontofoɔ kuo bi a ne wɔfrɛ wɔn Koola Lobitos na ɔbɔɔ Jazz ne Highlife  nnwom a wɔde afrafra. Wɔ 1960 mu no, Kuti waree ne yere a odi kan, Remilekun (Remi) Taylor, a ɔne no woo mma baasa ( Femi, Yeni, ɛne Sola).Wɔ 1963 mu no, Kuti san kɔɔ Nigeria Fakuo a na ɛde ne ho foforɔ no mu, ɔsan hyehyɛɛ Koola Lobitos, na ɔtetee ne ho sɛ radio so dwumadifoɔ maa  Nigeria Broadcasting Corporation . Ɔne Victor Olaiya ne ne All-Stars bɔɔ bɔɔl bere bi.

Ɔfrɛɛ ne su no Afrobeat, Fuji nnwom, funk, jazz, highlife, salsa, calypso, ne Yorubafo amammerɛ nnwom a wɔaka abom.Wɔ 1969 mu no, Kuti de nnwontofo kuw no kɔɔ United States na odii asram du wɔ Los Angeles. Bere a ɔwɔ hɔ no, ɔnam Sandra Smith (mprempren wɔfrɛ no Sandra Izsadore anaa Sandra Akanke Isidore),a na ɔyɛ Black Panther Party no fã bi so huu Abibifo Tumi kuw no. Saa osuahu yi nyaa ne nnwom ne amammui adwene so nkɛntɛnso kɛse.Ɔsesaa nnwontofo kuw no din Nigeria 70. Ɛno akyi bere tiaa bi no, obi a ɔhyɛ nkurɔfo nkuran bɔɔ amanneɛ kyerɛɛ Immigration and Naturalization Service sɛ Kuti ne ne nnwontofo kuw no wɔ U.S. a wonni adwuma ho tumi krataa. Nnwontofo kuw no yɛɛ nnwom a wɔkyere gu kasɛt so ntɛmntɛm wɔ Los Angeles a akyiri yi wobeyi no adi sɛ The '69 Los Angeles Sessions.

1970 mfe no mu 
Bere a Kuti ne ne nnwontofo kuw san kɔɔ Nigeria akyi no, wɔsesaa kuw no din (the) Africa ’70 bere a nnwom mu nsɛmti sesa fii ɔdɔ so kɔɔ asetra mu nsɛm so no.  Ɔhyehyɛɛ Kalakuta Republic — commune, recording studio, ne fie a nnipa pii a wɔne nnwontofo kuw no wɔ abusuabɔ te — a akyiri yi ɔkae sɛ ɛde ne ho fi Nigeria man no ho.

Kuti hyehyɛɛ anadwo agoprama bi wɔ Empire Hotel, na odii kan too din Afro-Spot na akyiri yi wɔtoo din Afrika Kronkronbea, faako a ɔyɛɛ nnwom daa na ɔyɛɛ Yorubafo amammerɛ mu guasodeyɛ ahorow a wɔayɛ ama obiara de hyɛɛ ne man no nananom gyidi anuonyam. Ɔsan nso sesaa ne din yɛɛ no Anikulapo (a ɛkyerɛ sɛ "Nea ɔsoa owuo wɔ ne kotokuo mu", a nkyerɛaseɛ ne sɛ: "Mɛyɛ m'ankasa me nkrabea wura na mɛsi berɛ a ɛberɛ a ɛsɛ sɛ owuo fa me").gyaee abusua din a wɔde nkyerɛwde ahyɛ mu "Ransome" no di dwuma efisɛ obuu no sɛ ɛyɛ akoa din . 

Ná Nigeria ɔmanfo ne Afrikafo nyinaa ani gye Kuti nnwom ho.Osii gyinae sɛ ɔbɛto dwom wɔ Pidgin Borɔfo kasa mu sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ankorankoro a wɔwɔ Afrika nyinaa betumi anya ne nnwom no mu anigye, baabi a ɛhɔnom kasa ahorow a wɔka no gu ahorow na ɛdɔɔso . Ɛmfa ho sɛnea na Kuti nnwom agye din wɔ Nigeria ne mmeae afoforo no, na aban a edi tumi no ani nnye ho, na na wɔtaa tow hyɛ Kalakuta Republic so. Wɔ 1972 mu no, Ginger Baker kyere Stratavarious , na Kuti ne odwontofo ne sankubɔfo Bobby Tench puei.Bɛyɛ saa bere yi mu no, Kuti de ne ho hyɛɛ Yoruba som mu kɛse mpo.

Wɔ afe 1977 mu no, Kuti ne Africa 70 yii album Zombie, a ɛkasa tiaa Nigeria asraafo kɛse, na wɔde zombie kasakoa no dii dwuma de kyerɛkyerɛɛ Nigeria asraafo akwan mu. Album no dii yiye kɛse na ɛhyɛɛ aban no abufuw, na wɔde asraafo 1,000 tow hyɛɛ Kalakuta Republic so. Wɔ ntua no mu no, wɔboroo Kuti denneennen, na ne maame a ne mfe akɔ anim (ɔbea a odi kan a ɔkaa kar wɔ Nigeria) pirapirae kɛse bere a wɔtow no fii mfɛnsere mu no. Wɔhyew commune no, na wɔsɛee Kuti studio, nnwinnade, ne master kasɛt ahorow . Kuti kae sɛ sɛ ɛnyɛ ɔsraani panyin bi de ne ho gyee mu bere a na wɔreboro no no a, anka wobekum no. Kuti mmuae a ɔde mae wɔ ntua no ho ne sɛ ɔde ne maame funnaka no kɔɔ Dodan Barracks a ɛwɔ Lagos, Ɔsahene Olusegun Obasanjo atrae, na ɔkyerɛw nnwom abien, "Adaka a wɔde ma Ɔman Ti" ne "Ɔsraani a Wonnim," de twee adwene sii aban nhwehwɛmu a ɛkyerɛe no so na ɔsraani bi a wonnim no asɛe kurow no.

Kuti ne ne nnwontofo kuw no bɛtraa Crossroads Hotel bere a wɔsɛee Kronkronbea no kaa kurow no ho akyi. Wɔ 1978 mu no, ɔwaree mmea 27, na na wɔn mu pii yɛ asawfo, nnwom hyehyɛfo, ne nnwontofo a ɔne wɔn yɛɛ adwuma. Ɛnyɛ sɛ aware no yɛɛ ntua a wɔde baa Kalakuta Republic so no afeda nko, na mmom ɛbɔɔ Kuti ne ne yerenom ho ban fii atumfoɔ atoro nsɛm a wɔkae sɛ Kuti rekyere mmea no ho nso.Akyiri yi, ɔfaa nhyehyɛe bi a wɔde di akɔneaba a ɛne sɛ ɔbɛma ɔyerenom 12 atra hɔ bere koro mu. Na kɔnsɛt abien nso wɔ afe no mu: nea edi kan no wɔ Accra, a basabasayɛ sii wɔ dwom "Zombie" bere mu, a ɛmaa wɔbaraa Kuti sɛ ɔnkɔ Ghana ; nea ɛto so abien no yɛ Berlin Jazz Afahyɛ no akyi bere a Kuti nnwontofo dodow no ara gyaw no hɔ esiane nsɛm a wɔkae sɛ wayɛ nhyehyɛe sɛ ɔde sika a obenya no nyinaa bedi dwuma de atua ne ɔmampanyin ɔsatu no nti.

Wɔ afe 1978 mu no, Fela ne ne nnwontofo kuw Africa 70 bɔɔ nnwom wɔ Berliner Jazztage a ɛwɔ Berlin no. Esiane sɛ Tony Allen, nnwontofo kuw no kannifo ne nnwontofo no nyinaa abam bui wɔ wɔn ka no ho nti, wogyaee adwuma.fi saa bere no, Baryton sankubɔfo Lekan Animashaun bɛyɛɛ nnwontofo kuw kannifo na Fela hyehyɛɛ kuw foforo bi a wɔtoo din Egypt80 . Wɔ afe 1979 mu no, Kuti hyehyɛɛ n'amammui kuw a ɔfrɛɛ no Movement of the People (MOP), sɛ "ɛbɛtew ɔmanfo ho te sɛ mop", nanso ntɛm ara na ɛnyɛ adwuma esiane ne akasakasa a ɔne aban a na ɛwɔ hɔ saa bere no dii nti. MOP kaa Nkrumahism ne Africa som ho nsɛm.

title: Daddy lumba
text:
Daddy Lumba a  Wɔwoo no Ɛbɔ bosome da ɛtɔ so aduonu-nkron wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduosia- nnan mu no yɛ Ghanani nnwomtoni a Ɔsane nso twerɛ  nnwom. Ɔde nnwom apaawa bɛyɛ sɛ aduasa nnan na ato dwa. Wɔwoo  Lumba a ne din ankasa ne Charles Kwadwo Fosu wɔ akuraa bi a wɔfrɛ no Nsuta Amangoase ɛwɔ Sekyere Central District a ɛbɛn Mampong  wɔ Ashanti mantam mu. Nnipa pii no ara na ɛtaa ka sɛ Daddy Lumba yɛ nnwomtoɔ mu akonini aberɛ nyinaa

Ne mmɔfra  ase ne Nabusua 
Lumba agya a ɔde no baa wiase ne Owoahene Kwadwo Fosuh na,ɔyɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛni, ɔwui na Lumba da so yɛ abɔfra kumaa bi. Ne maame nso din ne Comfort Gyamfi a wɔtaa frɛ no Ama Saah no nso yɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛni . Ɔwuiɛ wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne baako no mu wɔ Kumasi. Ne Maame wuo yi haa no yie ɛfiri sɛ na ɔno ne Lumba adeɛ nyinaa. Lumba  nnwom pii no a ɛbi  ne  "Anidasoɔ Wɔhɔ Ma Obiara", "Ohia Asɛm", "Ɛmmere Pa Bɛba", "Agya Bi Wua Agya Bi Tease", no nyinaa ɔyɛ de hyɛɛ ne Maame anionyam.

Lumba aware wɔ mma.

Adwuma 
Daddy Lumba nwomtoɔ adwuma no hyɛɛ aseɛ wɔ aberɛ a na wadi mfeɛ du- nsia. Na ɔno ne panin a ɔda Juaben ntoasoɔ sukuu no kuo a Wɔto nnwom no ano firi afe apem ahenkron aduowɔtwe mmiɛnsa de kɔsi afe apem ahenkron aduowɔtwe nnan mu aberɛ a na Awuraa Christabel na ne ɔyɛ nnwomtoɔ kyerɛkyerɛni ɛna ɔweiɛ sukuu no afe apem ahenkron aduowɔtwe nnum. Ɛwɔ Juaben ntoasoɔ sukuu mu no, Lumba ne ne nnamfo bi te sɛ Yaw ,Kwabena ne ne mpena Theresa Abebrese  tee ɛkuo a na wɔfrɛ no "Lumba Brothers group".

Wɔwei sukuu no,Daddy ne ne mpena Theresa tuu kwan kɔɔ Germany sɛ ɔkɔ hwehwɛ yie die.

Ɛwɔ Germany,Lumba kɔ hyiaa Ernest Nana Acheampong. Na Acheampong ate ɛkuo a wɔfrɛ "talking dreams with a white man" dada. Adeɛ na Lumba nim saa berɛ no ne Nyame nwomtoɔ ɛna ɔsrɛɛ Nana Acheampong sɛ ɔmfa no nwura "highlife music" nnwomtoɔ no mu.

Wɔtee ɛkuo foforɔ na,wɔfrɛ no "Lumba Brothers" te sɛ ɛdin korɔ no ara wɔdii kan tee wɔ Juaben ntoasoɔ sukuu mu no.

Wɔn mmienu hyehyɛɛ sɛ wɔde nnwom apaawa bɛto dwa wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduowɔtwe nsia nanso sikasɛm nti nwom apaawa no baa ɛdwa so afe apem ahenkron aduowɔtwe nkron mu berɛ a Lumba yere Akosua Serwaa boa wɔn no. Nnwom no din ne "Yɛɛyɛ Aka Akwantuo Mu".

Daddy Lumba ne nyinaa mu no de nnwom apaawa aduasa mmiɛnsa na ato dwa. Nnwom apaawa no bi ne Aben Wɔha, Awosuɔ, Obi Ate Me So Buɔ, Sika Asɛm ne Ebi Se Ɛyɛ Aduro.

Seisei ɔpɛ sɛ ɔde nnwom apaawa a ɛtɔ so aduasa nnan a wato no din " Nnipa Foo Na Ɛka Nsɛm Foo.

Ɔyɛ adeɛ pa ara,  ɛfiri sɛ ɔtaa de nnwom ahodoɔ a ɛgye din ba adwa so ɛfiri bere a ɔno ara yɛ ne ho Ghanafoɔ nnwomtofoɔ mu akunini no baako wɔ" Highlife genre" no.

Ɔno na ɔde baa highlife nnwomtoɔ mu ɛwɔ bere a, ɔreyɛ "blockbuster" nnwom apaawa a, yɛfrɛ no 'Woho Kyere' a ɛgyee din afe apem ahenkron aduokron nkron mu. Daddy Lumba ne Ofori Amponsah kaa wɔn ho bɔɔ mu saa afe no de nnwom nnum  a ɛgyee din pa ara baeɛ no na ɛyii Ofori Amponsah nsoroma pueɛ. Ne nyinaa mu Lumba aboa Ghana nnwomtofoɔ du- mmiɛnsa wɔ wɔn nnwomtoɔ adwuma mu.

Ɛwɔ afe apem ahenkron aduokron nkron mu no, Daddy Lumba nyaa abodin mmiɛnsa a Ɛno ne  "Best Album, Artist of the Year ne the Most popular Song of the Year" ɛwɔ abodin kuo a wɔfrɛ no  " Ghana Music Awards".

Ansa na yɛ wuraa Mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne mmienu mu no, na afe biara Daddy Lumba de nnwom a ɛgye din ba adwa so.

Ne nnwomtoɔ adwuma no nyɛ deɛ ɔhaw biara nni mu, ɛbere bi mu na ɔde Nyame nnwom ato dwa ɛbere foforɔ nso na wama Nnipa ho adwiri wɔn wɔ wiase nnwom mu ne mfoni ho. 

Nnipa abɔ no sommoa pii sɛ Lumba asesa ne wedeɛ berɛ a ɔsraeɛ no. Nanso ɔnnye ntom sɛ biribi saa akɔ so.

Daddy wɔ no ara ne beaeɛ a ɔyɛ ne nnwom ne mfidie a ɔde di nnwom ho dwuma. Ne nnwomtoɔ no sesa afe biara de hyia nsesaeɛ a ɛba berɛ ano berɛ ano ne deɛ Nnipa rehwehwɛ abere biara no. Wɔbɛtumi akan no aka nnɛ mmerɛ mu "highlife nnwomtofoɔ ho. Daddy Lumba agye abodin pii wɔ "Ghana Music Awards " ne afoforɔ bi ase. Ɛna ɔda so sɔ nnɛ mmerɛ mu mmaa ne,mmariama ani.

Ne nnwom pii no ara Ɔbaa Yvonne Ohene Dian a wɔtaa,frɛ no 'SHE' na ɔto Akyire deɛ no.

Ɛwɔ Ɔpɛnimaa bosome da ɛtɔ so aduonu mmiɛnsa wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu mmienu mu na, Daddy Lumba de nnwom a nnipa atwen akyɛre a wato no din , 'Ofo Na Edi Asem Fo' baa ɛdwa so

Ne nnwuma 
Ɛwɔ Ɛbɔ bosome mu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu mmienu mu no, Daddy Lumba o

Buses DLFM (106.9 MHz), kasa fie a ɛdi ne dwuma wɔ Twi kasa mu wɔ  Nkran kuro no mu.

title: Norbert Zongo
text:
Norbert Zongo (31 July 1949 – 13 December 1998), a wɔsane frɛ no Henri Segbo anaa H.S., yɛ Burkinabe nhwehwɛmufoɔ sɛntwerɛfoɔ a na ɔhwɛ atesɛm krataa L'Indeacute–pendant wɔ Ouagadougou, Burkina Faso. Wɔ Zongo akwankyerɛ ase no, L &39;Indeacute;pendant daa amumɔyɛsɛm ne asotwe a ɛnni ano adi wɔ Burkina Faso Ɔmanpanyin Blaise Compaore mu. Wɔkum no berɛ a n'asɛmpatrɛfoɔ no firii aseɛ sɛ wɔresusu obi a na ɔyɛ Compaore nuabarima no kwankyerɛfoɔ ho.

Abrabɔ Mfitiaseɛ Ne Ne Nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Norbert Zongo wɔ Koudougou mantam mu, French Upper Volta wɔ Kitawonsa bosome da a ɛto so aduasa mmiɛnsa mu afe apem ahankron aduanan nkron mu (July 31, 1949) wɔ Gnougnoossi abusua mu, Mossifo abusua no mu. Berɛ a ɔwɔ ntoasoɔ sukuu mu wɔ afe apem ahankron aduosianan (1964) mu no, ɔbɔɔ atesɛm krataa bi a wɔfrɛ no La Voix du Cours Normal, na ɔtwerɛ nkrataa wɔ ne dwumadie nkrataa no so de nsɛm a ɔnya firi Radio France Internationale, BBC World Service, ne amanaman ntam radio adwumayɛbea ahodoɔ no anɔpa dwumadie ahodoɔ mu. Akyiri yi sukuu mpanimfoɔ no baraa ne nwoma no esiane sɛ na ɛfa amanyɔsɛm ho nti. Berɛ a Zongo wieeɛ ntoasoɔ sukuu no, ɔsuaa mmara wɔ Abidjan Suapɔn a ɛwɔ Côte d'Ivoire ne nsɛm ho nsɛm ho adesua wɔ Benin Suapɔn a ɛwɔ Togo. Berɛ a Zongo tintimm ne amanyɔsɛm nwoma Le Parachutage no, sukuupɔn a ɛtwa toɔ no pamm no, na wɔde no too afiase wɔ Burkina Faso. Ɔwieeɛ n'adwuma wɔ University of Yaounde, Cameroon

Zongo yɛ onipa ho bammɔ ho ɔboafoɔ, na ɔboaa nnipa ne nnipa ho bammɔ ho kuo a ɛwɔ Burkina Faso nso. 

Wɔsiee Norbert Zongo amu no wɔ Gounghin Asraafo Amusieɛ a ɛwɔ Ouagadougou apueɛ fam.

Adwumayɛ 
Wɔ afe apem ahankron aduoson baako (1971) mu no, Norbert Zongo firi n'adwuma ase sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ wɔ Ouagadougou, Kadiogo mantam mu.

Na Zongo yɛ ɔtwerɛfoɔ nso. Ne nwoma a edi kan a ne din de Le Parachutage no yɛ amanyɔsɛm mu nsɛm a na ɔreka atia Togo Ɔmampanyin Gnassingbé Eyadema a na ɔwɔ berɛ a wɔadi ade no akyi. Wɔ afe apem ahankron aduowɔtwe nwɔtwe (1988) mu no, Zongo kaa sɛ wɔkyeree no boroo no esiane sɛ ɔtwerɛɛ nti. Ɔdii saa nwoma yi akyiri de amammerɛ a na ɛwɔ ɔman no mu no too Rougebeinga mfeɛ mmienu akyi, a na ɛno nso yɛ amanyɔsɛm a wɔde di kan.

Wɔ afe apem ahankron aduokron baako (1991) mu no, Zongo, berɛ a na ɔreyɛ adwuma wɔ ɔman da biara da atesɛm krataa Sidwaya mu no, na ɔde Saturnin Ki hyehyɛɛ La Clef. Ɛyɛ atesɛm krataa a edi kan wɔ Burkina Faso a ɛkasa tiaa aban no pefee, na Zongo de Henri Sebgo (anaa H.S.). Wɔkekaa krataa no mu wɔ 1993 mu. Saa June no, Zongo hyehyɛɛ dapɛn dapɛn L'Indépendant, a na ɛtaa ka aban porɔeɛ ho asɛm. Wɔ afe 1996 mu no, ofiri ase hwehwɛɛ nkontompo ne nsisi ho nsɛm pii a na ɛfa akuw ahorow bi a wɔyɛ adwuma wɔ abɛɛfo mfiri mu a na wɔne amanyɔfo mpanyimfo ne Ɔmampanyin Blaise Compaore abusua no wɔ abusuabɔ ho. Adwuma a ɔyɛe no maa aban no ani wui kɛse. Afe a edi hɔ no, Zongo kasa tiaa gyinae a Ɔman Mmarahyɛ Bagua no sii sɛ wɔbɛsesa Mmara no ma Compaore atumi adi ade a ɛto so mmiɛnsa.

Ne Wuo 
Wɔ December 1997 mu no, David Ouedraogo a na ɔyɛ Françoise Campaor a na ɔyɛ Ɔmampanyin Blaise Campaor nuabarima no kwankyerɛfo no yerae a ɛyɛ hu, na anka wobetumi akum no no maa Zongo yɛɛ nhwehwɛmu. Wɔyɛɛ Ouedrago ayayade kum no esiane sika pii a na wɔabɔ no sobo sɛ owiaa nti. Zongo bɔɔ asɛm no ho amanneɛ, na ɔkyerɛw nsɛm nketenkete nnawɔtwe biara maa ne atesɛm krataa. Ofii ase nyaa owuo ho ahunahuna na aban no buu n'ani guu so. Ne yere, Genevieve Zongo, sii so dua sɛ efi afe 1997 kosii sɛ owui wɔ afe 1998 mu no, na onyaa owu ho ahunahuna. Wɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ sɛ Norbert te ne moto so a, kar taa di n'akyi. Zongo nso kɔɔ hɔ kɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ onnyae n'aguamansɛm no, nanso ɔkɔɔ so ara kɔsii ne wuo so.

Wɔ December 13, 1998 mu no, wohuu afunu baanan a wɔabɔ wɔn tuo na wɔhyew wɔn wɔ Toyota Land cruiser bi mu wɔ kwan ho wɔ Sapouy, Ziro mantam mu. Wɔhuu sɛ saa nnipa yi ne Norbert Zongo; Zongo nua Yembi Ernest Zongo; Blaise Ilboudo, ne yɔnko; ne Abdouleye Ablass; Nikiema, a na ɔyɛ Zongo kwankyerɛfoɔ.Zongo wuo no maa ɔman mu haw baa Burkina Faso. 

Wɔ January 1999 mu no, wɔtwee Françoise Compaore a ɔyɛ Ɔmampanyin Blaise Compaore nuabarima no aso wɔ awudi ne awudifo no funu a wɔde siee no ho wɔ David Ouedraogo a na ɔyɛ n'akɔnnɔfoɔ a ɔwuiɛ wɔ January 1998 mu no wu ho. Akyiri yi, asraafo asɛnnibea bi yii sobo ahorow a wɔde bɔɔ wɔn no gui bere a François Compaor faa asɛm no too nkyɛn no. 

Wɔhuu sɛ ɔmanpanin no bammɔfo nsia na wɔkyere wɔn dii wɔn ho nsɛm wɔ awudi no ho. Wɔ August afe 2000 mu no, wɔde Ouedraogo kum ho sobo bɔɔ ɔmanpanin no bammɔfoɔ baanum. Wodii Marcel Kafando, Edmond Koama ne Ousseini Yaro, a wɔn nso yɛ wɔn a wosusuw sɛ wɔwɔ Norbert Zongo asɛm no mu no fɔ, na wɔde wɔn guu afiase mfe pii. Edmond Koama wui wɔ January 4, 2001. Marcel Kafando nkutoo na wɔbɔɔ no sobo wɔ saa bɔne no ho, nanso akyiri yi wogyaee sobo no July 19, 2006. Marcel Kafando wui mfe abiɛsa akyi, wɔ afe 2009 mu. Reporters Without Borders frɛɛ atemmu no sɛ "ɛhaw adwene". Wɔ afe 2013 mu no, wɔde asɛm no kɔɔ asɛnnibea sɛ wɔmfa atemmu mma abusua no. Afrika Asɛnnibea a Ɛhwɛ Nnipa ne Nnipa Ahofadi Ho no gye di sɛ Burkina Faso aban no kataa asɛm no so, na ebuu ECOWAS apam no so a ɛma nsɛm ho ahofadi ne nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ ho kwan. ACHPR no sii gyinae sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ wɔsan bue asɛm no sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wobetumi atua wɔn a wɔn ho aka no abusuafoɔ ka.

Nkɛntɛnsoɔ 
Berɛ a wɔrekɔsie no no, nnipa bɛyɛ mpem aduonu (20,000) nantee kilomita du (6.2 mi) firi afunu dan no mu kɔɔ amusieɛ hɔ sɛ wɔrekɔhyɛ no animuonyam na wɔaboa no. Wɔ afe 2006 mu no, wɔyii Zongo asɛm no firi hɔ a wɔanhunu obiara sɛ ɔbɔnefoɔ. 

Norbert Zongo yere a ɔyɛ okunafo, Genevieve kɔɔ so de ne atesɛm krataa, L'Indeacute;pendant no tenaa ase wɔ ne wu akyi. Ɔda so ara yɛ ne kunu a wawu no ho kyerɛwfo ne ne kyerɛwfo titiriw.

Wɔ afe 2014 mu no, wɔhuu sɛ Norbert Zongo asɛm no yɛ asɛm a wɔmpene so esiane sɛ aban no ani nnye ho nti. 

Wɔ October 29, 2017 anɔpa no, wɔkyeree François Compaore wɔ Roissy-Charles-de-Gaulle wiemhyɛn gyinabea, wɔ May 2017 amanaman ntam akyere ahyɛdeɛ so.

Nkɛntɛnsoɔ Ahodoɔ 

Committee to Protect Journalists' Africa dwumadi no ho ɔhwɛfo Sue Valentine kaa sɛ " Yɛkamfo Burkinabe atumfoɔ no sɛ wɔasi gyinae yi (wɔakyere ɔmanpanyin no asraafo baasa a na wɔkaa wɔn ho wɔ Zongo kum yi mu) na yɛto nsa frɛ wɔn sɛ wɔnhwɛ mma wonhu nea ɔbɔɔ saa kum yi na wɔnni n'asɛm. Mfe 17 akyi no, Norbert Zongo abusuafo, nnamfo, ne ne mfɛfo adwumayɛfo fata sɛ wɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu a emu da hɔ na ɛde wɔn kɔ atɛntrenee mu koraa. "

Reporters Without Borders Africa dwumadibea panyin, Cléa Kahn-Sriber, kae sɛ, "Asɛm yi yɛ gyinaesi titiriw wɔ Zongo asɛm no mu, a ɛhaw adwene paa wɔ amumɔyɛ a Burkina Faso asɛnni nhyehyɛe no agyina ano mfe pii yi mu."

Reporters Without Borders, a wɔde anigye bɔɔ Zongo asɛm no ho dawuru no kae sɛ, "Eyi yɛ asɛm a ɛyɛ amammui asɛm bere nyinaa. Wɔkum Zongo maa no. Franccedil Compaor a ɔyɛ Ɔmampanyin Blaise Compaor nuabarima no ka ho. Aban no annyae awudifo no ho ban da. Ɔmanpanyin no nsa aka nea na ɔpɛ bere nyinaa no. – ntɛnkyea."

Ɔmanpanyin a Ɔde Ne Ho Hyɛ Nhwehwɛmu Kuw no mu no de asɛm a edidi so yi mae: "Wɔkum Norbert Zongo esiane sɛ na ɔyɛ nsɛm ho nhwehwɛmufo nti. Ɔgyinaa amanyɔsɛm ho adwene akyi na ɔpaw sɛ ɔne n'asɛmpatrɛwfo no bɛko ama nnipa ahofadi ne atɛntrenee, ne aban aban no a wonni no yiye ne wɔn a wɔmpɛ sɛ wɔtwe wɔn aso.

Agyapadeɛ ne Nkaeɛ 
Burkinafoɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo pii kyerɛ sɛ Zongo ne nwoma twerɛfoɔ a odi kan wɔ ɔman no mu a ɔyɛɛ nhwehwɛmu nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ. 

 Ɔdwontofo Alpha Blondy twerɛɛ dwom bi, Journalistes en danger, faa Zongo kum no ho. 
 Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, wɔsii nkaedum bi wɔ N6 (Ouagadougou – Lécute;o) kwan a ɛbɛn Sapouy, wɔ baabi a wokum no no.

Abasobɔdeɛ 
Wɔ afe 2001 mu no, wonyaa Zongo Nokwafo Akatua wɔ ne nnwuma a ɔyɛe de yii aban porɔeɛ adi no ho.

title: Véronique Tadjo
text:
Wↄwoo Veronique Tadjo wↄ afe 1955. Ↄyԑ ↄtwerԑfoↄa ↄtwerԑ anwonsԑm ne ayԑsԑm a ↄfiri Cote d’Ivoire. Watena abibrem ne aman ahodoↄ so ayԑ adwuma nanso ↄwↄ atenka ne ↄdↄ soronko ma Abibiman. Ne nwuma nyinaa no ↄyԑ de bↄ Abibiman ho dawupa

N'asetena mu nsɛm

N’ABRABↃ AHYԐASEԐ NE NE NWOMASUA 
Wↄwoo no wↄ Paris, Veronique Tadjo maame firi Ivory Coast a ↄde ne nsa ne dↄteԑ yԑ adwinie.  Tadjo nyinii wↄ Abidjan a ԑwↄ Cote d’Ivoire, ↄne n’abusua tuu akwan bebree.

Tadjo wiee n’abↄdin krataa a ԑdikan a ԑyԑ B.A Degree wↄ University of Abidjan ԑna deԑ ԑtↄ so mmiԑnsa a ԑyԑ Doctorate wↄ Sarbronne  wↄ Africa-America kasadwini ne anibue.  Afe 1983 mu no, ↄkↄↄ Howard University a ԑwↄ Washington D.C a Fulbright nhwehwԑwmu  boa no sↄↄ n’asene.

N’adwuma 
Afe 1973 mu no, Tadjo kyerԑԑ Borↄfo kasa wↄ Lycee Mordene de Korhogo(ntoasoↄ sukuu) wↄ Cote d’Ivoire atifi afa mu. Ↄbԑyԑԑ ↄkyerԑkyerԑni a na ↄkyerԑ adeԑ wↄ University of Abidjan ne fa a ԑkyerԑ Borↄfo kasa wↄ afe 1993.

Ↄdaa n’anwonsԑn nwoma a ԑdikan adi wↄ afe 1984 a ↄtoo no din Literite/Red Earth. Ↄde saa nwoma yi nyaa abasobↄdeԑ firii Agence de Cooperation Culturelle et Technique

Tadjo nwoma a ↄtwerԑeԑ no bi ne Dauters of Africa a Margaret Busby na ↄsaa mu maa no.

Afe 1998 mu no, na ↄka Rwanda Ecrire par devoir de memoire dwumadie no ho bi a na ԑyԑ ekuo a ԑyԑ L’Ombre d’Imana (2000) yii ne ti wↄ Rwanda saa berԑ no.

Mfeԑ kakraa bi a atwa mu, ↄdii nteteԑ dwumadie a ԑfa mmↄfra nwoma atwerԑ anim wↄ Mali, Benin, Chad, Haiti, Mauritius, French, Guiana, Burundi, Rwanda, The United States and South Africa. Afe 2006 mu no, na ↄka wiase nyinaa aterԑ dwumadie(International Writing Program) a ԑkↄↄ no wↄ University of lowa

Tadjo atena Paris, Lagos, Mexico City, Nairobi and London. Afe 2007 akyi no na ↄte Johannesburg a na panin a French adesua ano wↄ University of the Witwatersrand.

Abasobↄdeԑ 
Tadjo nyaa atwerԑ abasobↄdeԑ wↄ L’Agence de Coopreation Culturelle et Technique wↄ afe 1983 ne UNICEF abasobↄdeԑ no wↄ afe 1993 wↄ ne Mamy Wata ne Monster a na ԑno nso wyi kaa ↄha a adi mu wↄ abibire mu ne 20th Century mu no ho

Afe 2005 mu no, ↄnyaa abasobdeԑ kԑseԑ a ԑyԑ Grand Prix litteraire d’Afrique noire ԑna afe 2016 no, Bernard Dadie national grand prize for literature. Ne nwoma In the company of men no nso nyaa abasobↄdeԑ wↄ Los Angeles Times Book Award.

title: Botswana Adwumayɛfo Kuw Fekuw (Botswana Federation of Trade Unions)
text:
Botswana Adwumayɛfo Kuw Fekuw (Botswana Federation of Trade Unions - BFTU) yɛ ɔman adwumayɛfo akuw fekuw ma Botswana. Wɔde sii hɔ wɔ afe 1977 mu, na ɛgyina hɔ ma adwumayɛfoɔ akuo a ɛwɔ ɔman no mu nyinaa mu bɛboro 90%, a nkabom akuo akɛseɛ nyinaa ka ho. Mprempren BFTU reyɛ nhyehyɛe foforo a ɛbɛma wɔaka wɔn a wɔka ho aduonu anum (25) no abom na wɔatew wɔn dodow so akɔ dumiɛnsa (13).

BFTU no wɔ Amanaman Ntam Adwumayɛfo Kuw Fekuw ne Afrika Adwumayɛfo Kuw Biakoyɛ Ahyehyɛde no mu.

Wɔhyehyɛɛ Central Bank Union (CBU) wɔ afe 1980 mu na ɛka Botswana Federation ne Trade Unions (BFTU) ho. Wɔn a wɔfata sɛ wɔyɛ Sikakorabea a ɛwɔ Botswana no mu nyinaa betumi akɔ ne mufo.

Botae ahorow 
Nneɛma atitiriw a ɛma Kabom no wɔ hɔ no bi ne sɛ:

 Wɔ hwɛ ma abusuabɔ a ɛda sikakorabea adwumayɛfo ntam, ne adwumayɛfo ne Sikakorabea no ntam kɔ yie.
 sɛ wɔbɛyɛ adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔbom yɛ nkitahodiɛ ho asɛdeɛ wɔ adwumayɛfoɔ ananmu
 bɔ dawuro na ɔsan hyɛ ne manfoɔ anigyeɛ a ɛwɔ mfiridwuma, amammerɛ, nwomasua ne nnwuma foforɔ a Sikakorabea no yɛ no ho nkuran na ama wɔanya nkɔsoɔ;
 de afotu ne mmoa a ɛho hia bɛma emufo; ne
 boa fekuo foforɔ biara a ɛwɔ mmara kwan so a ɛka wɔn botaeɛ ho sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ adwumayɛfoɔ anigyeɛ ho nkuran na titire no, wɔne nkabom foforɔ biara a ɛwɔ anigyeɛ ne botaeɛ a ɛte saa ara wɔ adwumayɛkuo anaa adwumayɛkuo bi a ɛfa ho mu no adwuma.

Gyinabea ne Adwumayɛ a Wɔyɛ 
CBU no dwumadi ahorow no, ne mmarahyɛ bagua no na ɛkyerɛ. Mmara kwan so krataa a hokwan a ɔwɔ sɛ ɔde asɛm kɔdan asɛnnibea na wɔde no kɔ asɛnnibea ka ho. Aban Asoɛe no nam Apam no so gye Kabom no tom sɛnea ɛsɛ.

Kuw mma ne Hokwan a Wɔwɔ 
CBU no abue ama adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔfata a Bank of Botswana de wɔn yɛ adwuma nyinaa, ɛwom sɛ ɔmannifoɔ biara a ɔnni mfeɛ aduonu baako rentumi nyɛ Adwumayɛkuo no muni anaasɛ ɔhwɛfoɔ. Gye sɛ wɔakyerɛ sɛ, asɔremma nyinaa benya hokwan a ɛyɛ pɛ wɔ CBU no mu na wɔde amansan mmara no bɛkyekyere wɔn. Eyinom bi ne hokwan a asɔremma nyinaa wɔ sɛ wɔtow aba wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa CBU ho nyinaa ho sɛnea wɔakyerɛ wɔ mmara a ɛfa ho no mu no.

title: Adwumayɛfo kuw (Trade union)
text: Adwumayɛfo kuo (trade union - Britania Borɔfo) anaa adwumayɛfoɔ kuo (labor union - Amerika Borɔfo), a wɔtaa frɛ no ara kwa sɛ adwumayɛkuo, yɛ adwumayɛfoɔ ahyehyɛdeɛ a wɔn adwene ne sɛ "wɔbɛkura anaa wɔbɛma wɔn adwumayɛ tebea atu mpɔn ",[1] te sɛ akatua a ɛyɛ papa ne mfaso, adwumayɛ tebea a ɛbɛma atu mpɔn, ahobammɔ gyinapɛn a ɛbɛma atu mpɔn, anwiinwii ho nhyehyɛe a wɔde besi hɔ, mmara a ɛfa adwumayɛfo gyinabea ho a wɔbɛhyehyɛ (mmara a ɛfa nkɔanim a wɔde ma, tebea horow a ɛfata a ɛma wogyae adwuma) ne adwumayɛfo tumi a wɔde di nkitaho a wɔbɔ ho ban na wɔma ɛkɔ soro.

title: Botswana Aduru a Wɔde Esiw Nyarewa Ano Asoɛe Adwumayɛfo Kuw (Botswana Vaccine Institute Staff Union)
text:
Botswana Aduru a Wɔde Esiw Nyarewa Ano Asoɛe Adwumayɛfo Kuw (Botswana Vaccine Institute Staff Union - BVSU) yɛ adwumayɛfo kuw a ɛka Botswana Adwumayɛfo Kuw Fekuw a ɛwɔ Botswana no ho. Efi ne mfiase a ɛba fam wɔ afe 1978 mu no, BVI a ɛwɔ hɔ nnɛ no yɛ adwumakuw a anya nkɔsoɔ kɛse nanso ɛnhinhim mfi ne botae ahorow a ɛde sii hɔ a ɛne sɛ nea edi kan no bɛhwɛ sɛ nantwinam aguadi kɔ so wɔ Botswana (Wɔda so ara de Botswana Nantwinam kɔ Europa Aman Nkabom no mu) denam mmoa nyarewa a wɔde di dwuma wɔ ɔkwan a ɛfata so ne nyarewa a ɛhaw ɔmanfo akwahosan so. Ɛdenam amanaman ntam nnuru a wɔde bɔ nkurɔfo ho ban gyinapɛn ahorow (OIE) a wodi so denneennen so no, esiane sɛ wɔde nhyehyɛe pa a wɔde hwɛ nneɛma pa so ne ɔkwan a wɔfa so hwɛ adetɔfo so nnɛ no, wɔde nnuru a wɔde bɔ nkurɔfo ho ban a wɔyɛ wɔ BVI nyinaa mu nkyem abiɛsa mu abien kɔ aman bɛboro dunum (15) so afe biara wɔ Afrika ne Mfinimfini Apuei (Middle East). Aman yi mu pii de BVI nnuru a wɔde bɔ nkurɔfo ho ban adi dwuma ama wɔn Ɔman afe afe nhyehyɛe ahorow a wɔde siw nyarewa ano mfe du du pii ni. BVI nnɛ wɔ ahyɛdeɛ a wɔatrɛ mu a seesei ɛma ɛyɛ Ɔman (National), Ɔmantam (Regional) ne Wiase nyinaa agofoɔ a ɔde mmoa akwahosan ano aduru a ɛtena hɔ daa ma (Global player providing sustainable animal health solutions). BVI de ahoahoa ne ho sɛ wɔredi ɔko no anim wɔ Afrika mmoa tumi kɛse no a wobebue mu denam mmoa nyarewa a ɛde mfe pii asiw saa ɔfa yi nkɔso kwan no a wobesiw ano no so.

title: South Africa Adwumayɛfo Kuw Mmarahyɛ Badwa
text:
South Africa Adwumayɛfo Kuw Mmarahyɛ Badwa (Congress of South African Trade Unions - COSATU anaa Cosatu) yɛ adwumayɛfo akuw a ɛwɔ South Africa. Wɔde sii hɔ wɔ afe 1985 mu na ɛyɛ ɔman no mu adwumayɛfo akuw atitiriw mmiɛnsa (3) no mu nea ɛso sen biara, na adwumayɛfo akuw aduono baako (21) na ɛka ho.

Abakɔsɛm

Fapem ne abakɔsɛm a edi kan 
Wɔ Obubuo bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduasa (30) afe 1985 no, akuw aduasa mmiɛnsa (33) hyiaam wɔ Natal Suapɔn mu maa nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛfa adwumayɛfo akuw nkabom a wɔbɛhyehyɛ ho. Eyi dii mfe anan (4) biakoyɛ ho nkɔmmɔbɔ a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ nkabom akuw ne nkabom akuw a wɔsɔre tia nnipa mu nyiyim a "wɔde wɔn ho ama South Africa a ɛnyɛ mmusuakuw, ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne demokrase nniso" ntam no akyi. Wɔde COSATU sii hɔ wɔ aban kwan so wɔ Ɔpɛnimma bosome da a ɛtɔ so baako (1) afe 1985. Nnwumakuw a wɔhyehyɛɛ no bi ne South Africa Adwumayɛfo Kuw (Federation of South African Trade Unions - FOSATU), Ɔman Adwumayɛfo Fekuw ketewa, ne nnwumakuw bi a wɔde wɔn ho, titiriw Ɔman Adwumayɛfo a Wɔtow Fam Agodie Fekuw no. Elijah Bar ne ahyehyɛde no titrani (first president) a odi kan na Jay Naidoo ne ɔkyerɛwfo panyin (general secretary)a odi kan.

Wɔsii gyinaeɛ ahodoɔ pii wɔ saa nhyiamu a ɛdi kan yi ase a ɛkyerɛɛ nkabom no botaeɛ ne sɛdeɛ nkabom no yɛ adwuma, a ɛne:

 Sɛ wɔbɛhyehyɛ nkabom biako ama nnwuma biara wɔ asram asia ntam.
 Sɛ wɔde wɔn adwene besi mmea adwumayɛfo a wɔde wɔn di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so no so.
 Sɛ wɔbɛfrɛ sɛ wonyi tebea a egye ntɛmpɛ no mfi hɔ, wɔtwe asraafo mfi nkurow akɛse mu na wonyi amammuisɛm mu nneduafo nyinaa.
 Sɛ wɔbɛtoa ɔfrɛ a ɛne sɛ wɔmfa amanaman ntam nhyɛso mma, a sika a wɔmfa nsie ka ho no so.
 Sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wɔyɛ adwumaden na wɔyɛ picket.
 Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a wɔbɛkyerɛ ɔman no akatua a ɛba fam koraa.
 Sɛ wɔbɛtrɛw apereperedi a wɔde hwehwɛ adwumayɛfo akuw hokwan ahorow wɔ kurom hɔ no mu.

Wɔ Kotonimma bosome da a ɛtɔ so anum (5) kosi nsia (6) afe 1987 mu no, wɔyɛɛ adwumayɛban mu adwumayɛban sɛ COSATU Asetra mu Akatua Ɔsatu no fã a ɛne 1987 Amansan Abatow no (1987 General Election) hyiae . Adwumayɛfo bɛboro ɔpepem 2.5 (2.5 million) na wɔde wɔn ho hyɛɛ adwuma a wɔde traa baabi a wɔbɛtra hɔ no mu. Wɔ Kotonimma bosome da a ɛtɔ so nson (7), afe 1987 mu no, anɔpatutuutu no, atopae abien (two bombs) paee wɔ baabi a ɛbɛn adum a ɛboa wɔ ɔman no adwumayɛbea ti, COSATU Fie, dan ase no. Ɔsɛe a efii mu bae no ma wɔkae sɛ ɔdan no nni ahobammɔ.

Ko tia Nnipa mu nyiyim 
Wɔ ɔman nhyiam a ɛtɔ so mmienu (2) a wɔyɛe fi Kitawonsa bosome da a ɛtɔ so dunan (14) kosi dunwɔtwe (18) afe 1987 mu no, ɔman no mufo no gyee Ahofadi Mmara no toom bere a Ɔman Adwumayɛfo a Wɔtow Fam Agodie Kuw no de gyinaesi no too gua akyi.

Wɔ nhyiam a ɛtɔ so abiɛsa (3) a wɔyɛe fi Kitawonsa bosome da a ɛtɔ so dumienu (12) kosi dunsia (16) afe 1989 mu no, wogyee gyinaesi bi toom a ɛfrɛɛ COSATU mufo sɛ wɔmfa wɔn ho nhyɛ ɔsatu bi a wɔde "adeyɛ a ɛkɔ so daa" a wɔde tia nnipa mu nyiyim mu, wɔ dapɛn a edii afe 1989 Amansan Abatow (1989 General Election) a wɔyɛe wɔ South Africa no anim no mu.

Wɔ Kitawonsa bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nsia (26) afe 1989 mu no, COSATU, Demokrasi a Edi Anim a Wɔaka Abom ne Nnipadɔm Demokrasi Kuw (United Democratic Front and Mass Democratic Movement), kanyan National Defiance Campaign, a wɔtow hyɛɛ mmeae a wɔde asie maa aborɔfo so, na ahyehyɛde a na ɔman no abara no kae sɛ ‘wɔnbara’.

title: Polisifo ne Afiase Ɔmanfo Hokwan Kuw (Police and Prisons Civil Rights Union)
text:
Polisifoɔ ne Afiaseɛ Ɔmanfoɔ Hokwan Kuw (Police and Prisons Civil Rights Union - POPCRU) yɛ adwumayɛfoɔ kuo a ɛwɔ South Africa a ɛgyina hɔ ma polisifoɔ, kar akwan so adwumayɛfoɔ ne nteɛsoɔ adwumayɛfoɔ, ɛwɔ emufoɔ bɛyɛ 120,000. Wɔhyehyɛɛ POPCRU wɔ afe 1989 mu.

Abakɔsɛm 
Wɔ Ɛbɔ bosome da a ɛtɔ so anum (5) afe 1989 mu no, abibifo polisifo kuw bi a wɔwɔ South Africa Polisifo mu buu ahyɛde ahorow so na wɔpowee sɛ wɔbɛtow ahyɛ wɔn a wɔsɔre tia nnipa mu nyiyim no so. Wɔn mu binom ne afiasehwɛfo kuw bi yɛɛ adwuma de hyehyɛɛ POPCRU, wɔ bosome  Ɛbɔ mu. Nkabom foforo no antumi annye ntom, na woyii n’akannifo no pii fii adwumam, na wɔde ebinom guu afiase. Wɔ afe 1993 mu no, awiei koraa no, wogyee no toom.

POPCRU yɛ South Africa Adwumayɛfoɔ Kuo Mmarahyɛ Badwa (COSATU) no fa.

title: Ɔman Nhomasua, Akwahosan ne Adwumayɛfo a Wɔka Ho Kuw (National Education, Health and Allied Workers' Union)
text:
Ɔman Nhomasua, Akwahosan ne Adwumayɛfo a Wɔka Ho Kuw (National Education, Health and Allied Workers' Union - NEHAWU ) yɛ adwumayɛfo kuw a ɛwɔ South Africa. Ɛnam sɛ emufoɔ yɛ 276,000 nti ɛyɛ ɔman adwumayɛkuo a ɛso sen biara wɔ ɔman no mu. Ɛhyehyɛ Ɔman, Akwahosan, Nhomasua ne Yiyedi adwumayɛfo.

Abakɔsɛm 
Wɔhyehyɛɛ nkabom kuw no wɔ afe 1987 mu, bere a Akwahosan ne Adwumayɛfo a Wɔka Wɔn Ho Kuw no ne Adwumayɛfo Kuw a Wɔka Ho ne South Africa Adwumayɛfo Kuw a Wɔka Ho no boom no .

NEHAWU ne South Africa Adwumayɛfoɔ Kuo Mmarahyɛ Badwa (COSATU), ne Ɔmanfoɔ Nnwuma Amanaman Ntam ne Adwumayɛfoɔ Kuo Amanaman Ntam Ɔmanfoɔ Adwumayɛfoɔ ne Ayɔnkofoɔ adwumayɛfoɔ abɔ.

title: Air commodore Joshua Lartei Mensah-Larkai
text:
AIR COMMODORE JOSHUA LARTEI MENSAH-LARKAI - ACCRA AIR FORCE BASE COMMANDER 
Wɔwoo Air Commodore Joshua Lartei Mensah-Larkai wɔ Accra,wɔ Greater Accra Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔkɔɔ Accra Academy ntoaso sukuu maa ne General Education adansedi krataa. Afei wɔde ne din kɔhyɛɛ Ghana Asraafoɔ Sukuu mu maa ne mfitiaseɛ asraafoɔ nteteeɛ.Owiee ntetee no yiye na wɔmaa no adwuma sɛ ɔnkɔ Ghana Wim Asraafo Sukuu mu wɔ 26th October 1992 na wɔde kɔmaa saa bere no Wim Asraafo gyinabea,Accra,wɔ afe koro no ara mu. Wimhyɛn mu ɔsraani panyin Mensah-Larkai yɛ NO3 Helikopta kuw no wimhyɛnkafo.Wɔde nkonimbo ne abasobɔde ahorow a Long Service and Efficiency Medal ka ho asiesie no,UNMIL ne UNOCI nkonimbo ahorow. Ɔwɔ Diploma ne Bachelor of Arts Degree(Honours) wɔ Public Adminstration mu wɔ GIMPA,Accra,Ghana.Ɔsan nso wɔ Masters' Degrees(Honours) wɔ Asraafoɔ Adwumayɛ Adwini ne Nyansahu ne Amanaman Ntam Ahobanbɔ ne Akwankyerɛ mu efi Air Sukuupɔn a ɛwɔ Montgomery, Alabama ne King’s College, London, mu.Air Commodore Joshua Lartei Mensah-Larkai aware Patricia Dzifa Mensah-Larkai na wɔahyira wɔn wɔ mmabea baanu.N’ani gye golf bɔ, bɔɔlbɔ hwɛ ho na n’ani gye akenkan ho.

title: Wing Commander Appianing Boateng
text:
WING COMMANDER APPIANING BOATENG BOATENG 
Wing Commander Appianing Boateng ɔsom sɛ ɔsraani panyin a ɔhwɛ Engineering Wing so, dibea a wayɛ fi afe 2018. Wɔmaa no adwuma wɔ Ghana Air Force wɔ afe 2004 mu na wayɛ Engineering Wing Adjutant, Officer commanding Mechanical Transport Flight, ne nkitahodi Squadron kannifo.Wɔ afe 2010 Amanaman Nkabom Dwumadi bi mu wɔ Cote d'Ivoire,Wing sahene Appianing Boateng yɛ ɔsraani panyin Commanding Aircraft servicing Flight.Ɔwɔ Master’s Degree wɔ Defense ne International Politics mu ne Postgraduate Diploma wɔ Public AdminIstration mu, a ne nyinaa fi GIMPA. Ɔnyaa Bachelor of science abodin krataa wɔ Mfiridwuma mu wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so na ɔsan nso wiee wimhyɛn ho adesua ahorow bi wɔ India ne China. Ɔyɛ obi a wawie Mfantsipim sukuu. Sɛ yɛde ɔsraani panyin a ɔhwɛ Engineering Wing so no to nkyɛn a, ɔde ne ho hyɛ nsiesie no mu denneennen nso of Falcon 900 EX-EASY, wimhyɛn a wɔde type-rated wɔ so. Wing Commander Appianing Boateng aware wɔ anigye mu a ɔwɔ mma baasa a wɔn ho yɛ fɛ. N’ani gye aduannoa, Francophone nnwom a otie ne bɔɔlbɔ ho.Wonim no sɛ ɔwɔ ayamhyehye ma nnipa ne ahofama a ɔwɔ ma n’adwuma.

title: Demokrase Ayarehwɛfo Kuw a ɛwɔ South Africa (Democratic Nursing Organisation of South Africa)
text:
Demokrase  Ayarehwɛfo Kuw a ɛwɔ South Africa (Democratic Nursing Organization of South Africa) yɛ adwumayɛfo kuw bi a ɛwɔ South Africa a ɛka ne ho asɛm sɛ "ahyehyɛde a wofi wɔn pɛ mu yɛ ma South Africa ayarehwɛfo ne awogyefo".

Wɔde sii hɔ wɔ ne mprempren tebea mu wɔ Ɔpɛnimma bosome da a ɛtɔ so anum (5) afe 1996 mu. 

Ɛyɛ South Africa Adwumayɛfo Kuw Mmarahyɛ Badwa no fa na ɛbɛyɛɛ Amanaman Ntam Ayarehwɛfo Bagua no muni koraa wɔ Ayɛwohomumɔ bosome da a ɛtɔ so dunum (15), afe 1997. Nkabomkuo no gyaee ne kyɛfa a wɔde bɛhyɛ nhyiamu no akannifoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ mu wɔ Obubuo bosome da a ɛtɔ so du (10), afe 2014 ɛnam sɛ nkabom ahodoɔ no pam Ɔman Nkabom Kuo a ɛhwɛ dadeɛ adwumayɛfoɔ so wɔ South Africa wɔ Obubuo bosome da a ɛtɔ so nson (7), afe 2014.

Wɔ ne nhyiam a wɔyɛe wɔ afe 2010 mu no, kuw no sii gyinae sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ Ɔman Adwumayɛkuw no kɔ so de nkabom no ne South Africa Democratic Nurses’ Union. 

Ɛde nnwuma pii asi hɔ a ne botae ne sɛ ɛbɛma akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe atu mpɔn wɔ South Africa. Eyinom titiriw ne nhyiam ahorow a wɔyɛ de kyerɛkyerɛ ayarehwɛfo wɔ HIV/AIDS ne nsamanwaw a nnuru pii ntumi nyɛ ho hwee

title: Barbara Minishi
text:
Barbara Minishi yɛ Kenya Siniyɛfo, Mfoniniyɛfo, ntadehyɛ mfoninitwafo ne Adwinni kwankyerɛfo a n’asɛmti a ɛhwehwɛ nneɛma mu no nam anansesɛm akwantu ahorow a ɛkyinkyini a ɛfa ne ho, Abɔde, Alchemy ne Arcana ne intuitive embodied nkyerɛkyerɛmu aniwa adwinni. Sɛ́ adwinni kwankyerɛfo no wayɛ adwuma wɔ sini ne nnwom video mu, na wayɛ adwuma nso ama Kapringen (A Hijacking), Denmark sini a ɛyɛ anigye a efi afe 2003.Wɔ Kenya no, ɔka ntadehyɛ mfoninitwafo a wɔyɛ adwumaden a wobu wɔn kɛse no ho. Wɔaka Minishi mfonini ahorow a ɛtoatoa so no ho asɛm wɔ nhoma 9 Photographers from Kenya a wɔne National Museums of Kenya abom tintimii no mu.

Asetra mu nsɛm 
Barbara Minishi a ofi Nairobi, Kenya, wiee sukuu wɔ afe 2003 mu na onyaa BA abodin krataa wɔ nkitahodi mu. N’adwuma sɛ Mfoninitwafo a ɔyɛ adwumaden no fii ase bere a ohui sɛ koma nkitahodi mfonini ahorow a ɛkanyan no wɔ ne mu no.

Minishi se, "Mfoninitwa yɛ sɛnea mifii m'adebɔ nhwehwɛmu ase na ɔkwan bi so no obi betumi aka sɛ mfoninitwa afiri no bɛyɛɛ adwinnade maa me sɛ mɛda nkyerɛwee a ɛte saa a ɛkyerɛ sɛ meyɛ no adi, deconstruct, na mede di agoru. Na ɛyɛ me ‘nne’ ne ɔkwan a mefa so yɛ ade a ɛde ‘nsɛm a esisi’ a metumi de me ho ahyɛ nsɛmti te sɛ nsusuwii hunu ne mmusuakuw, asase ne nea meyɛ, nkate a wɔda no adi, nkurow akɛse mu nkɛntɛnso ne ahoɔfɛ mu.

Ɛmfa ho sɛ aguadi mu ‘nkonimdi’ no mifii ase gyee me dwumadi sɛ Afrikani ɔbea a ɔyɛ Aniwa so Nkitahodifo ne sɛnea m’anisoadehu, akwankyerɛ ne adwuma nipadua betumi adan afi mu akɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu ne adeyɛ a ɛyɛ katee kɛse a ɛfa atiefo no ho sɛnea ɛsan nso bɛma mmeae a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu na wɔde wɔn ho ahyɛ mu no ho kyim.

Me adeyɛ no akɔ so anya nkɔso na ɛne no nso nnwinnade a mede bɔ, a mprempren nea ɛka ho ne Sini, Asaw, Ahoɔden Mfonini, Dae Adwuma ne Nnyigyei ne Kankyee a Wɔte nka.

Seesei mihu me ho wɔ beae a ɛda hɔ, a mede me ho hyɛ nsakrae a ɛkɔ so wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ a wɔde aniwa hu a ɛwɔ ntoatoaso mu, nimdeɛ a wɔde nipadua ayɛ ho asɛm a wɔhwehwɛ mu, ɔsoro ɔbea ne adwennwen ho asɛmmisa no mu. Nkitahodi bi wɔ hɔ a ɛne adwene a ahintaw ne biakoyɛ a ɛne nsakrae nkyerɛkyerɛmu a ɛrepue ka ho ne adebɔ a ɛwɔ adwene mu a ɛne asase foforo, amammerɛ ne adwene foforo ka ho."

N’adwuma no kɔ so nya nkɔsoɔ na mprempren ɔreyɛ adwuma de akyerɛw na wakyerɛ ne sini a ɛyɛ anigye ne nnwuma afoforo te sɛ sini ntiantiaa a wɔsɔ hwɛ, ntadehyɛ video, nsɛm a wɔahyɛ sɛ wɔmfa nkyerɛw, Mfonini, ne Akyerɛw kwan.

Abasobɔde ahorow 
Minishi dii nkonim wɔ Adwini ho Ɔkwankyerɛfoɔ a Ɔsen Biara wɔ n’adwuma a ɔyɛeɛ wɔ sini Nairobi Half Life ho wɔ 2014 African Magic Viewer’s Choice Awards wɔ Oforisuo 2014 mu.

Beaɛ a menyaa mmoa fii

title: Akothee
text:
Esther Akoth (wɔwoo no 8 Ayɛwohomumɔ 1983), a wonim no yie sɛ Akothee, yɛ Kenya nnwontofoɔ ne aguadifoɔ. Ɔno na ɔhyehyɛɛ Akothee Safaris, akwantufo adwumakuw a ɛwɔ Kenya, Akothee Foundation, adɔe kuw, ne Aknotela ne Akothee Homes, adan ne afie adwuma.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Akoth wɔ afe 1983 mu wɔ Kisumu Mantam mu, ɔyɛ agya a ɔyɛ adwuma sohwɛfo ne ɛna a ɔyɛ amammuifo babea, na onyinii wɔ Migori Mantam mu. Akothee kɔɔ Nyabisawa ntoaso sukuu kɔyɛɛ ne ntoaso sukuu. Nanso, ogyaee sukuu bere a na wadi mfe 14 bere a na ɔwɔ adesuakuw a ɛto so abien mu sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ɔne n’adamfo abarimaa no bɛtra saa bere no. Akothee ne abarimaa no boom kɔɔ n’asew nkyɛn. Ɛno akyi bere tiaa bi no, na ɛsɛ sɛ n’adamfo abarimaa no san kɔ sukuu, biribi a ɛhyɛɛ no ​​ma ogyaw no wɔ mfe ason a edi hɔ no mu, na ɔsom sɛ ofie boafo maa asew no.

Saa bere yi mu no, na wanyinsɛn ne ba a odi kan a ɔwoo no bere a na wadi mfe 14. Akothee woo ne mma a ɔto so abien ne nea ɔto so abiɛsa bere a na wadi mfe 15 ne 16. Nanso, ne ba a ɔto so 2 no wui esiane nyarewa a ɛfa nkokoaabere ho nti, biribi a na onni sika a ɔbɛboa no ma wahwehwɛ ayaresa. Bere a Akothee dii mfe 20 no, ɔwoo ne ba a ɔto so 4. Eyi sii wɔ afe 2000. Asram kakraa bi akyi no, Akothee ne n’asew nyaa nsɛmnsɛm, biribi a ɛmaa ofii hɔ kɔyɛɛ n’asetra.

Nnwom adwuma 
Akoth nnwom adwuma no hyɛɛ aseɛ wɔ afe 2008 mu. Efi saa bere no, wayi solo tracks adi ne saa ara nso na ɔne adwumfo afoforo a Diamond Platnumz ka ho ayɛ biako. Nnwom a wayi no adi no bi ne "Oyoyo" a MC Galaxy ka ho,[1] "Give It To Me" a Flavour ka ho, "Sweet Love" a Diamond Platnumz ka ho, "Benefactor", "Yuko Moyoni", "New Dance" a Oc ka ho, "Osilliation", "Nimechoka", "Pashe", "Katika", "Djele Djele", "Shengerera", "Mama Bougerie", ne "Tucheze" na ɛyɛ nea ɛyɛ nwonwa. Wɔ March 2020 mu no, Akoth yii "Mwitu asa", dwom a wɔkyerɛw na wɔtoo wɔ Kamba kasa mu.

Abasobɔde ahorow 
Wanya abasobɔdeɛ pii, a nea ɛka ho ne "Best Female Artist (East Africa)" wɔ African Muzik Magazine Awards wɔ afe 2016 ne 2019, "Best Video" wɔ African Muzik Magazine Awards wɔ afe 2016, ne "Best Female Artist" wɔ Afrika Anigyede Abasobɔde USA.

Akoth wɔ akyidifo bɛboro ɔpepem biako wɔ Instagram, na  na ɔka Afrika afe 2019 nipa a wagye din paa na nkurɔfo di n'akyi sen biara kraa ahodoɔ no ho. ɔtɔɔ so du baako.

Adwumayɛ mu adwuma 
Akoth hyehyɛɛ Akothee Safaris, adwumakuw bi a ɛyɛ akwantu ne akwantu adwuma a ɛwɔ Nairobi, Kenya, na ɔpaw ne babea sɛ adwumakuw no kwankyerɛfo. Ɔsan nso hyehyɛɛ adɔeɛ kuo bi a wɔfrɛ no Akothee Foundation, na ɔhwɛ adwumakuo bi a wɔtɔn adan ne afie, Aknotela ne Akothee Afie Ahorow.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Akoth wɔ mma baanum, mmabea baasa ne mmarimaa baanu. Ɔwɔ afie wɔ Mombasa, Migori Mantam, ne Zurich.

Beaɛ a menyaa mmoa fii

title: Goddy Leye
text:
Goddy Leye (24 Ɔbɛnem 1965 wɔ Mbouda, Cameroon – 19 Ɔpɛpɔn 2011 wɔ Bonendale, Cameroon) yɛ Cameroonni adwumfo ne onyansafoɔ.

N’adwuma no twe adwene si video ahorow, installations, conceptual art ne theoretical contributions so. Ɔno na ɔhyehyɛɛ adwinni beaeɛ ArtBakery a ɛwɔ Bonendale, Cameroon na na ɔyɛ adwinni ne amanaman ntam nnwuma a ɛfa beaeɛ pɔtee bi ho no sohwɛfoɔ ne nea ɔhyɛ ho nkuran. Ná ne dwumadi no yɛ ade titiriw wɔ amammerɛ ne adwinni mu wɔ Cameroon ne amanaman ntam.

Asetra ne adwuma 
Wɔwoo Goddy Leye (edin ankasa Godfried Kadjo) wɔ 24 Ɔbɛnem 1965 wɔ Mbouda, Cameroon. Onyaa ne adansedi krataa wɔ ntoaso sukuu bi a wɔka kasa abien mu wɔ 1989 mu na osuaa Afrika nhoma ne kasa ho adesua wɔ Yaoundé Sukuupɔn mu wɔ 1986 ne 1991 ntam hɔ. Wɔ afe 1990 mu no, onyaa ne master’s wɔ Afrika nhoma mu. N’adwinni ntetee fii ase wɔ 1987 mu wɔ mfoniniyɛfo ne adwinni ho abakɔsɛm kyerɛwfo Pascal Kenfack nkyɛn wɔ Yaoundé kosii 1992. Ɔtoaa ne nteteeɛ so wɔ afe 1994 mu wɔ Ɔman Adwini Asoɛeɛ a ɛwɔ Bamako, wɔ afe 1997 mu wɔ ZKM Karlsruhe Center for Art and Media wɔ Germany, wɔ afe 1999 mu wɔ 18th Street Arts Complex wɔ Santa Monica, California ne afe 2002 ne 2002 ntam wɔ Rijksakademie van Beeldende Kunsten wɔ Amsterdam. Wɔ Netherlands no ɔne obi bom de sika boa na ɔbɛyɛ Rijksakademie International Network (RAIN), adwumfo kuw bi a wɔboa nnɛyi amammerɛ nneyɛe wɔ aman a wofi mu no muni. Titiriw esiane n’anigye a ɔwɔ sɛ ɔbɛboa adwinni nneyɛe nti, Leye san kɔɔ Douala wɔ afe 2002 mu kɔyɛɛ adwinni beae ArtBakery wɔ Bonendale, a wɔde wɔn ho ama titiriw sɛ ɛbɛma adwinni ntetee ne nsakrae a ɛba adwumfo ntam no ayɛ mmerɛw na wɔaboa multimedia, installations, video ne digital art.

Wɔ afe 2002 mu no na ɔyɛ adwuma no sohwɛfo Bessengue City, adwumayɛbea ne adwinni adwuma ahorow a ɛfa beae pɔtee bi ho wɔ Bessengue mpɔtam hɔ wɔ Douala; adwuma no fa Goddy Leye, James Beckett, Hartanto, Jesus Palomino ne mpɔtam hɔfo ka ho. Wɔ afe 2006 mu no ɔhyɛɛ Exit Tour ho nkuran na ɔde ne ho hyɛɛ mu. Wɔ afe 2007 mu no ɔboaa Ars ne Urbis Adwumayɛbea a wɔhyehyɛɛ wɔ Douala denam doual'art so de siesiee SUD Salon Urbain de Douala na na ɔwɔ tenabea wɔ Blachère Foundation wɔ Apt, France. Wɔ afe 2008 mu no na ɔwɔ tenabea wɔ Gasworks amammerɛ beaeɛ a ɛwɔ London; wɔ afe 2009 mu no ɔde ne ho hyɛɛ adwuma a ɛne Image Art After mu wɔ nkɔmmɔdie mu ne Florence Ayisi na ɔboaa wɔ Cairo Residency Symposium.

Leye adwuma no nyaa nkonimbo fii UNESCO, Rockefeller Foundation ne Dutch Amannɔne Nsɛm Ho Dwumadibea hɔ. Sɛ́ mfoniniyɛfo ne onyansafo no, ɔde ne ho hyɛɛ animdefo boayikuw ahorow pii mu; na ɔyɛ Africa Center a ɛwɔ Cape Town no adwene kuw no muni na na ɔyɛ CAN (Creative Africa Network) ananmusifo.

Adwuma 
Leye fii ase yɛɛ adwuma sɛ mfoniniyɛfo wɔ afe 1992 mu. Na n’adwuma no twe adwene si nkae, Afrika atubrafo akyi ne abakɔsɛm a wɔkyekyee so. Nea ɛkɔ akyiri no ɔdaa ne ho adi denam multimedia adwuma, video ne video a wɔde ahyɛ mu so. Bere kɔɔ so no, ofii ase de ne ho hyɛɛ nnwuma ahorow a wɔyɛ mu kɛse wɔ Cameroon ne amanaman ntam nyinaa. Ɔboaa nhoma ahorow, ɔyɛɛ na ɔhwɛɛ adwinni ahorow a ɛfa beae pɔtee bi ho na ɔhyehyɛɛ mfinimfini ArtBakery. Mfinimfini no de nnwinnade ne nhyehyɛe ma adwumfo a wɔn ani gye multimedia productions ho na ɛyɛ nea ɛda nsow wɔ dwuma a ɛyɛ nnam wɔ ntetee mu. Ná Cameroonfo mfoniniyɛfo a wɔtraa ase wɔ n’awo ntoatoaso mu ne nea ennu saa no bu Leye sɛ mfoniniyɛfo ne onyansafo titiriw.

Leye daa n’adwene adi wɔ akwan a wɔfa so ka abakɔsɛm ne nimdeɛ a wɔde ma na wɔn werɛ fi denam n’adwinni, nkyerɛwee ne ne ho a ɔde hyɛ nhyiam akɛse ne adwene ho akuw mu denneennen so. Ne nsusuwii mu mmoa no twee adwene sii amammerɛ ahyehyɛde ahorow nhyehyɛe so, nkitahodi nhyehyɛe ahorow, adwinni ne amammerɛ nneyɛe so ne nkurow akɛse mu nsakrae so.

title: Cameroon
text:
Cameroon, wɔ aban kwan so sɛ Republic of Cameroon, yɛ ɔman bi a ɛwɔ Afrika atɔe fam mfinimfini. Ɛne Nigeria wɔ ahye wɔ atɔe ne atifi fam, Chad wɔ atifi apuei, Central African Republic wɔ apuei fam, ne Equatorial Guinea, Gabon ne Republic of the Congo wɔ anafo fam. Ne mpoano da Bight of Biafra, Gulf of Guinea ne Atlantic Po no fã bi so. Esiane sɛ ɛwɔ gyinabea pa wɔ Afrika Atɔe Fam ne Afrika Mfinimfini kwan no ntam nti, wɔakyekyɛ mu sɛ ɛwɔ nsraban abien no nyinaa mu. Ɛkame ayɛ sɛ emu nnipa ɔpepem 27 ka kurom kasa 250 ne Borɔfo anaa Franse anaa n’abien nyinaa.

title: Nonini
text:
Hubert Mbuku Nakitare (wɔwoo no 2 Ɔberɛfɛw 1982), a wɔtaa frɛ no ne agoprama so din Nonini, yɛ Kenya hip hop nnwom a wɔkyere gu kasɛt so, anigyefoɔ, radio so ɔkasafoɔ, aguadifoɔ ne ɔyamyefoɔ. Wɔtaa frɛ no Onyankopɔn Agya efisɛ wonim no yiye.

Nwomasua 
Hubert Nakitare, a wɔfrɛ no Nonini, kɔɔ Kawethei Ntoaso Sukuu a ɛwɔ Machakos Mantam mu.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Wɔwoo Nonini (Hubert Nakitare) wɔ Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 1982 mu wɔ California Estate a ɛwɔ Kamukunji mantam mu wɔ Nairobi, Kenya. Ɔyɛ luhya mfiase. Nonini bɛyɛɛ akokoaa barima bi papa wɔ afe 2012 awiei.

Asetra mu nsɛm 
Mfiase no wɔde Nonini hyɛɛ Calif Records ase, nanso akyiri yi ɔde ne ho kɔbɔɔ Homeboyz nneɛma a wɔyɛ. Wɔnam ne nnwom a edi kan "Nonini ni Nani?". Ɔnyaa ɔman ne ɔmantam mu agyedeɛ denam ne 2002 dwom "Manzi wa Nairobi," dwom a ɛkamfoo Kenya mmaa ahoɔfɛ ne dwom a ɛdi akyire "Weh Kamu". Ɔkɔɔ so yii ne nnwom nhoma a edi kan Hanyaring Game adi wɔ afe 2004 awiei, a na nnwom a agye din "Keroro," Kenyafo kasafĩ (sheng) asɛmfua a wɔde gyina hɔ ma nsa ka ho. 

Ɔwɔ video production company bi a wɔfrɛ no "Pro Habo" a ɛdii nkonim maa P Unit baeɛ.

Nnwuma a wɔbom yɛ ne nneyɛe a ɛka ho 
Akyiri yi, Nani Mwenza, ne dwom a ɔne Tanzania nnwontofo Juma Nature yɛɛ biako no bɛyɛɛ ɔmantam no mu dwom a agye din. Bio nso, ɔne mpɔtam hɔ adwumfo Nameless ayɛ biako ayɛ Fida dwom bi a wɔato din "furahi-day" sɛnea ɛfata. Nnwom mmienu no nyinaa wɔ ne album a ɛtɔ so mmienu Mwisho Ya Mawazo a woyii no adi wɔ afe 2007. Nnwomfoɔ ahɔhoɔ dodoɔ bi na ɛwɔ album no mu, a Nyota Ndogo, Mercy Myra, Professor Jay ne Q-Chief ka ho.

P-Unit 
Ɔno na ɔhyehyɛɛ P-Unit (Pro-Habo Unit), a rapfo Bonnie, Frasha, Gabu ne n’ankasa na wɔwom. Adwumayɛfo no ayɛ nnwom pii, nea ɛda nsow kɛse ne "Si Lazima", Swahili kasasin a wɔkyerɛ ase ankasa sɛ "Ɛnyɛ nea ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ." Dwom no ka mmere bi wɔ abusuabɔ mu a enhia sɛ awarefo da – wobetumi akɔ fie kɛkɛ na wɔagye wɔn ahome. Nkurɔfo ahu sɛ dwom no ne nkrasɛm a ɔde mae wɔ nnwom a atwam mu no bɔ abira koraa. Wɔ afe 2007 Kisima Nnwom Abasobɔdeɛ mu no, P-Unit dii nkonim wɔ Boomba Kuo no mu. Ɛno ne bere a edi kan a Nonini nyaa Kisima Abasobɔde. Wɔn single a ɛtɔ so mmienu no, wɔfrɛ no "Kushoto-Kulia"; asekyerɛ ne "Benkum-Nifa". Nnwom mmienu no nyinaa wɔ Nonini "Mwisho ya Mawazo" album mu.

Gye a wogye tom ne abasobɔde a wɔde ma 
Wɔ August 2007 mu no, The Standard atesɛm krataa paw Nonini sɛ Kenyafo 100 a wɔwɔ nkɛntɛnso kɛse no mu biako. Wɔ afe 2009 mu no, Limkokwing Sukuupɔn a ɛwɔ Malaysia no paw no sɛ Amanaman Ntam Asetra Ho Ɔnanmusifo.

Wɔde MCSK 2012 Cross Over Artiste Award hyɛɛ Noni anuonyam na onyaa Hip-Hop Dwom a Ɛsen Biara ne Nnwom Video sohwɛfo a Ɔsen Biara, abien no nyinaa maa Color Kwa Face, wɔ 2012 Kisima Abasobɔde no mu.

Nonini ayɛ Top Earner MCSK Royalties Artiste mprenu.

Wɔ afe 2013 mu no, wɔpaw Nonini sɛ ɔkwankyerɛfoɔ a ɔgyina Audio Visual Sector ananmu wɔ Performance Rights Society of Kenya (PRSK), baabi a ɔhwɛ kwan sɛ ɔbɛboa wɔ mmɔden a wɔbɔ wɔ ahemfo sika a wɔboaboa ano no mu den na ɔgyina hɔ ma adwumfo a wɔwɔ anigyeɛ adwuma mu tebea a ɛyɛ hu.

title: Monski
text:
Sarah Mukethe Kiatine (wɔwoo no 8 Ɔpɛpɔn 1994), a wonim no yie wɔ n’asɛnka agua so din Monski, yɛ Kenya hip hop rapfoɔ, odwontofoɔ ne nnwom kyerɛwfoɔ. Wɔhyɛɛ no ​​abotiri sɛ Unkut Hip-hop Award sɛ ɔbea adwumfo a ɔsen biara wɔ afe no mu wɔ afe 2019 mu.

Mfitiase asetra 
Wɔwoo Monski wɔ Nairobi, Kenya wɔ taksi a ɛde mmirika rekɔ Pumwani Ayaresabea mu. Ɔyɛ Akamba abusuakuw na ɔyɛɛ nyisaa wɔ ne mmofraase. Monski suaa ade wɔ Baba Dogo mfitiaseɛ sukuu, St Benedict mfitiaseɛ sukuu ne Beadom Mfitiaseɛ Sukuu a ɛwɔ Nairobi, afei ɔkɔɔ so kɔɔ Kyangala ntoaso sukuu wɔ Machakos, faako a ɔhunuu ne rap tumi na ɔmaa ne talente yɛɛ yie, ɔdii nnwom akyi sɛ adwuma wɔ ntoaso sukuu akyi. Eyi yɛ bere a ɔsɔɔ adwumayɛ dibea ahorow a ɔfrɛɛ no ​​"ɛnyɛ nea ɛfata" hwɛe akyi.

Adwuma 
Ne recording adwuma no hyɛɛ aseɛ wɔ afe 2014 mu berɛ a ɔkyeree na ɔde demos ahodoɔ bi too SoundCloud so; nyaa nsɛm pa ne abisade ahorow fii akyidifo a wɔrenya nkɔanim hɔ sɛ wonyi pii adi na ankyɛ na ɔrekyerɛw gigs bere a na ɔrenya airplay nso afi Kenya hip-hop radio so dwumadi ahorow mu no. Wɔ afe 2017 mu no, Pulse Magazine (Standard Media Kenya) kyerɛw no sɛ ‘hip hop freshmen adwumfo a ɛsɛ sɛ wɔhwɛ wɔn yiye afe a edi hɔ no mu biako. Ɔno ne Kenyani ɔbea rapfo a odi kan a ɔbɔɔ nnwom wɔ afe afe Nyege Nyege Afahyɛ a wɔyɛ wɔ Uganda no ase. Monski ka ne nnwom ho asɛm sɛ raw wordplay rap ne experimental, a ɛde oldschool hiphop ne sukuu nnyigyei foforo frafra. Wɔ afe 2019 mu no wɔpaw no sɛ Owura Eazis empawa 100 adwumfo no mu biako, talent incubation nhyehyɛe a wɔde bɛtete na wɔaboa adwumfo a wɔreba wɔ Afrika. Wɔ December 2020 mu no ɔyii ne debut Album 'Gold' adi.

title: African Continental Free Trade Area
text:
Afrika Asasepɔn so Aguadi a Wɔde Wɔn Ho Adi Beae (AfCFTA) yɛ aguadi a wɔde wɔn ho to so a ɛka Afrika fã kɛse no ara ho. Wɔde sii hɔ wɔ afe 2018 mu denam Afrika Asasepɔn so Free Trade Agreement 2018 so, a ɛwɔ akuw 43 ne aman 11 foforo a wɔde wɔn nsa ahyɛ ase, na ɛma ɛyɛ beae a ɛso sen biara a aman a wɔka ho no dodow te, na ɛyɛ beae a ɛso sen biara a wotumi di gua a wontua hwee, wɔ Wiase Nyinaa Aguadi Ahyehyɛde no akyi, na ɛyɛ nea ɛdɔɔso sen biara wɔ nnipa dodow ne asasesin mu, na ɛwɔ nnipa ɔpepepem 1.3 wɔ wiase asasepɔn a ɛto so abien a ɛso sen biara no so.

Apam a ɛde AfCFTA sii hɔ no, Afrika Aman Nkabom Kuo (AU) na ɛyɛɛ ntamgyinafoɔ na aman 55 a wɔka ho no mu 44 na wɔde wɔn nsa hyɛɛ aseɛ wɔ Kigali, Rwanda wɔ 21 Oforisuo 2018. Wɔhyehyɛɛ sɛ wɔde nyansahyɛ no bɛhyɛ aseɛ adi dwuma nnafua aduasa akyi a aman a wɔde wɔn nsa hyɛɛ aseɛ no mu 22 agye atom akyi. Wɔ 29 April 2019 no, Saharawi Republic de nkrataa a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wɔagye atom no too hɔ mpɛn 22, na ɛde apam no dii dwuma wɔ May 30; ɛhyɛn ne dwumadie fã mu wɔ nhyiamu bi akyi wɔ 7 Ɔpɛpɔn 2019, na ɛfirii aseɛ wɔ aban kwan so 1 Ɔbɛnem 2021. AfCFTA nkitahodiɛ ne dwumadie no, ɔkyerɛwfoɔ adwumakuo a ɛwɔ hɔ daa a ɛwɔ Accra, Ghana na ɛhwɛ so.

Wɔ apam no ase no, AfCFTA mufoɔ ahyɛ bɔ sɛ wɔbɛyi toɔ a wɔbɔ wɔ nneɛma ne nnwuma dodoɔ no ara ho no afiri hɔ wɔ mfeɛ 5, 10, anaa 13 mu, a egyina ɔman no nkɔsoɔ dodoɔ anaa nneɛma no su so. Botae ahorow a wɔde bere tenten ayɛ titiriw bi ne sɛ wɔbɛbɔ gua biako a wɔama ho kwan; akwanside ahorow a ɛwɔ kapital ne adwumayɛfo ho a wɔbɛtew so na ama sika a wɔde bɛto mu no ayɛ mmerɛw; ne asasepɔn so amanneɛbɔ nkabom a wɔde besi hɔ. AfCFTA botaeɛ nyinaa ne sɛ ɛbɛma asetena mu sikasɛm mu nkɔsoɔ akɔ soro, atew ohia so, na ama Afrika ayɛ akansifoɔ kɛseɛ wɔ wiase nyinaa sikasɛm mu.

Amanaman Nkabom Sikasɛm Bagua a ɛhwɛ Afrika so no bu akontaa sɛ AfCFTA bɛma Afrika ntam aguadi akɔ anim ɔha biara mu nkyem 52 wɔ afe 2022 mu. Amanneɛbɔ bi a efi Wiase Sikakorabea hɔ kyerɛ sɛ AfCFTA betumi ayi Afrikafo ɔpepem 30 afi ohia buruburoo mu, ama nnipa bɛyɛ ɔpepem 70 sikasɛm akɔ soro, na ebedu afe 2035 no, wɔanya sika dɔla ɔpepepem 450. Wɔ Ɔbɛnem 13, 2022 no, AfCFTA tuu anammɔn kɛseɛ bi kɔɔ ne botaeɛ no ho denam Pan-African Payments and Settlements System (PAPSS) a wɔde sii hɔ, a ɛma kwan ma wɔde mpɔtam hɔ sika biara tua ka wɔ nnwumakuo a wɔyɛ adwuma wɔ Afrika mu.

title: Gitura Mwaura na ɔkyerɛwee
text:
Gitura Mwaura yɛ ɔbariama a ɔyɛ ɔkyerɛwfo a ɔwɔ Nairobi (ahenkurow a ɛne kenya), Kenya oman a ɛwɔ apuei mantam wɔ Afrika a mprempren ɔreyɛ adwuma sɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo fotufo wɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow mu. Ɔyɛ ɔkyerɛwkyerɛwni ne nkɔso ho nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a na wadi kan de ne ho ahyɛ mmeae ahorow, ne afoforo, a ɛfa mmarima ne mmea ne ntawntawdi ho dwumadie ho sɛ nhwehwɛmufoɔ ne nnipa hokwan ho ɔbenfoɔ a ɔne mpɔtam hɔ ne amanaman ntam ahyehyɛdeɛ ahodoɔ a ɛnyɛ aban de yɛ adwuma wɔ beae a ɔwɔ no.

Gitura ayɛ adwuma wɔ ɛlɛtrɔnik ne nhoma a wɔatintim nyinaa mu, na ɔboa ma mpɔtam hɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ, wɔ Rwanda ne Kenya aman a ɛwɔ afrika apue fam nyinaa . Ɔkyerɛw asɛm bi dapɛn biara ma Rwanda atesɛm krataa The New Times.(Mmere Foforo no)

Wotintim n’asɛm ntiantiaa a ɔboaboaa ano, Portraits of the Heart(Mfonni Ahorow firi akoma,)  , wɔ afe 2001 mu (Focus Books)-(nhoma ahorow a wɔde wɔn adwene a si so). Ɔne afoforo kyerɛw nhoma, Resilience of a Nation: A History of the Military in Rwanda(Fountain Publishers, 2009). Wɔde n’asɛm ntiantiaa no mu baako, The Request, aka nhoma a wɔaboaboa ano, The doomed conspiracy ne nsɛm afoforo ho (East African Educational Publishers, 2011). Wotintim ne nwoma, The Painting: Four Sketches and a Poem, wɔ afe 2013 mu (Amazon).

Gitura kan no na ɔyɛ Kenya Nkabom Kuo a Ɛhwɛ Nnuru a Ɛho Hia a Wɔnya (KCAEM) no guamtrani, a ɛdii dwuma titire wɔ nkonimdie a wɔde hwehwɛɛ Kenya Aban, Mmarahyɛ Bagua ne amanaman ntam nnuruyɛ nnwumakuo no mu sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a ɛnyɛ den sɛ wɔbɛnya nneɛma a ɛho hia a wɔde sa asramma ne TB, ne, nea ɛda nsow kɛse ne nnuru a wɔde ko tia HIV.

Mprempren ɔyɛ Dwumadie no mu Ɔhokafoɔ wɔ ɔmantam East African Community Media Network (EACOMNET) mu.

Koma no Mfonini Ahorow 
Gitura nhoma a ɔde ne nsa hyɛɛ ase, Portraits of the Heart, yɛ nsɛm ntiantiaa du-baako a wɔaboaboa ano a ɛfa nsɛmti te sɛ ntetewmu, yare ne owu ho wɔ abusua nhyehyɛe mu. Nsɛm afoforo a wɔadi ho dwuma wɔ nhoma no mu ne AIDS, awo a wontumi nwo ne awofo ne mma ntam abusuabɔ Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo no ay3 adwuma pa wɔ nhoma yo mu.

Mfonini no: Mfonini Anan ne Anwensɛm Bi 
The Painting: Four Sketches and a Poem yɛ ayɛsɛm mu nsɛm a wɔaboaboa ano a ɛkyerɛ mmere a ɛka koma na ɛkanyan adwene wɔ mmea baanan a wɔwɔ Afrika Apuei fam asetra mu, a Lucy, hominid( a ɛyɛ aboa ) a wadi ɔpepem 3.2 a wagye din sɛ ɔyɛ nnɛyi nnipa nananom mu biako ka ho.

Ɔman Bi Atumi Agyina Ano: Asraafo a Wɔte Rwanda Abakɔsɛm 
Wogye di sɛ Rwanda man a ɛwɔ apue fam no puei bɛyɛ Afeha a Ɛto so Du anaa Dubiako a egyinaa asetra ne sraadi ɔman bi ano no mu. Resilience of a Nation hwehwɛ dwuma a asraafo adi wɔ Rwanda abakɔsɛm nyinaa mu de besi nnɛ no mu. Nhoma no hwɛ mmere ahorow a Rwanda asraafo afa mu, efi atetesɛm, atubrafo ne ahofadi akyi ntɛm ara asraafo so kosi mprempren.

Nsɛm a wɔakyerɛw 
Akyerɛwfo a wɔagye din kɛse wɔ Afrika Apuei fam mantam mu no mu biako, na atesɛm nkrataa ne nsɛmma nhoma ahorow atintim Gitura Mwaura nsɛm pii. Saa nhoma ahorow yi bi ne The Standard, The New Times, The Daily Nation, The EastAfrican, Blogger News Network, ne nea ɛkeka ho.

title: Shasha Marley
text:
Julius Amua-Sekyi, a nnipa pii frɛ no Shasha Marley yɛ Ghana ntini reggae. Wɔahyɛ no nsow wɔ nnwom te sɛ "Twin City Mafia", "M'ani Nnye Asɛmpa no ho", ne "Maata Abusua" ne afoforo.

Mfitiase asetra 
Wɔwoo Shasha Marley wɔ Sekondi-Takoradi wɔ Ghana Atɔeɛ Mantam mu, na n’agya yɛ nwomasua ho nimdefoɔ a wakɔ pɛnhyen na ɔyɛ nnwontofoɔ kuo sohwɛfoɔ. Wɔ afe 1979 ne 1983 ntam no, na ɔyɛ osuani wɔ St. John’s Secondary School wɔ Sekondi baabi a ɔne sukuu no nnwontofo kuw a wɔfrɛ wɔn Mathew Chapter 5 bɔɔ nnwom. Bere a owiee ntoaso sukuu pɛɛ no, ɔkɔɔ nnwom atitiriw mu na afei ɔkɔɔ n’anim yii nnwom nhoma ahorow pii adi.

Adwuma 
Wɔ ne mfitiaseɛ nna mu no, Shasha Marley kaa Bob Marley, Burning Spear, Steel Pulse ne Jimmy Cliff ho asɛm sɛ ne nkɛntɛnsoɔ titire. Ɔyii ne dwom a ɛdi kan, "Tell Freedom", a ɛbɛyɛɛ nnwom kɛseɛ wɔ Ghana ne akyirikyiri. Efi saa bere no wakɔ so ayi nnwom afoforo pii adi.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Shasha Marley aware a ɔwɔ mma baanu.

Akyinnyegye a ɛfa Maata Abusua ho 
Ɛwom sɛ na Shasha Marley agye din dedaw wɔ ne kurom ne amannɔne de, nanso dwom biako a akyinnye biara nni ho sɛ ɛmaa ɔdaa no adi kɛse titiriw wɔ Ghana ne "Maata Abusua". Dwom a woyii no adi wɔ afe 2007 mu no, na nsɛmfua a ɛkyerɛ sɛ obi ayɛ akisikuru wɔ Ghana kasa mu. Sɛ nhwɛso no, abodin Maata, wɔ Akan kasa mu no kyerɛ flatulence na nkurɔfo twee no esiane sɛ ɔde nsɛmfua a ɛtete saa dii dwuma wɔ ne dwom mu nti. Afei nso, Maata Tui, Maata Pue ne Mataa Fish a wɔde dii dwuma no maa dwom no ntease yɛɛ nokware wɔ ɔkwan bi so. Nanso efi saa bere no Shasha Marley abɔ asɛm no agu na wakyerɛkyerɛ mu sɛ na dwom no ntease ne flatulence nni hwee yɛ, na mmom ne pals a wɔwɔ Papua New Guinea no din i.e Maata Tuitui, Maata Pue ne Maata Mpataa.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Ngugi wa Mirii
text:
Ngugi wa Mirii (1951 – 2/3 May 2008) yɛ Kenya - Zimbabweni (Kenya yɛ ɔman a ɛwɔ afrika apuei fam na Zimbabwe nso wɔ afrika kesee fam) agodie kyerɛwfo, asetena mu adwumayɛfo ne ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo, a wonim no kɛse wɔ n'agoru Ngaahika Denda, a ɔne ne yɔnko Gikuyu kyerɛwfo Ngũgĩ wa Thiong'o boom kyerɛwee.  Agorudi no kyerɛ ntɛnkyea ne nneɛma a ɛboro so a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Kenya(apuei fam) wɔ atubrafo akyi, na wɔn a wɔnyɛ anyansafo na wɔyɛɛ no wɔ agoprama bi a ɛwɔ abɔnten wɔ Kamirithu Nhomasua ne Amammerɛ Asoɛe a ɛwɔ Limuru   (saa beae yi wɔ kenya).

Mfitiase asetra 
Wɔwoo Ngugi wa Mirii wɔ Roromo, Limuru, Kenya, na ɔyɛ nea ɔto so abien wɔ abusua a John Mirii ne Elizabeth Wanjiku woo mma baanum mu. Osuaa ade wɔ Ngenia Ntoaso Sukuu mu na efi 1972 kosi 1974 no ɔne Kenya Posts and Telecommunications Corporation (Kenya Nsemma ne Telefon Nkitahodi Adwuma Kuw) yɛɛ adwuma . Onyaa Mpanyimfo Nhomasua ho adansedi krataa wɔ Mpanyimfo Adesua Asoɛe, Nairobi Sukuupɔn mu, ( Nairobi yɛ ahenkurow Kenya kuropɔn)na afei ɔde ne ho kɔbɔɔ Nkɔso Ho Adesua Asoɛe no.  Bere a ɔreyɛ adwuma wɔ hɔ no ɔne akuafo ne adwumayɛfo de wɔn ho hyɛɛ mpɔtam nkɔso mu wɔ Kamiriithu, Limuru.

Agorudi kyerɛwfo 
Wɔ afe 1977 mu no, Ngugi wa Mirii ne Ngugi wa Thiong’o boom kyerɛw agoru bi a wɔtoo din Ngaahika nɔda ( Mɛware Bere a Mepɛ ).  Wɔkyeree agoru akyerɛwfo baanu no nyinaa wɔ adapɛn asia akyi wɔ agoru no mfiase, na wɔde wɔn guu afiase.

Mfe anum akyi no, wɔn agoru a edi hɔ a wɔfrɛ no Mother Cry for Me ( Maame Su Ma me), hyɛɛ agoru akyerɛwfo baanu no nyinaa ma wɔkɔɔ nnommumfa mu, na Ngugi wa Mirii kɔtraa Zimbabwe bere a Ngugi wa Thiong’o dii kan guan kɔɔ Britain, na afei ɔkɔɔ United States.

Nnommumfa mu 
Wɔ afe 1982 mu no, Ngugi wa Mirii guan kɔɔ Zimbabwe baabi a ɔtenaa nnommumfa mu. Afe akyi no, ne yere Wairimu wa Ngugi ne ne babea a wadi afe biako, Elizabeth Wanjiku Ngugi bɛkaa Ngugi wa Mirii ho.  Afei ɔde ne ho kɔbɔɔ Zimbabwe Foundation for Education with Production (ZIMFEP) a ɔyɛɛ adwuma mfeɛ pii. 

Wɔ Zimbabwe no, ɔkyerɛw Pan-African (Pan Afrikafo) asɛm no ho nsɛm pii. Wɔ 1985 mu no, wɔmaa no sika de hyehyɛɛ Zimbabwe Fekuw a Ɛhwɛ Mpɔtam Agoruhwɛbea So no. Wɔmaa no Zimbabwe ɔman ba wɔ ɛno akyi bere tiaa bi. 

Ná wonim Ngugi wa Mirii sɛ obi a ɔboa Robert Mugabe ne Zanu-PF .

Owuo 
Wɔ 3 May 2008 no, Ngugi wa Mirii wui wɔ kar akwanhyia mu wɔ Zimbabwe, bere a ɔde kar kɔɔ lɔre bi a egyina hɔ a ɛbɛn Eastlea kurotia mu akyi.  Saa bere no na wadi mfe 57.

Adwuma 

 Ngaah Hinikada (Mɛware Bere a Mepɛ) , a ɔne Ngugi wa Thiong'o (1977) boom kyerɛwee

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Salah Hassan Asetra mu nsɛm
text:
Wɔwoo Salah Hassan  wɔ July 1964 mu

Wɔ afe 2000 mu no ɔboaa ma wɔhyehyɛɛ Forum for African Arts a ɛyɛɛ nhyehyɛeɛ maa nhyiamu bi ne no sohwɛfoɔ wɔ  de kaa Afrikafoɔ kyɛfa a wɔnya wɔ ho ɔyɛkyerɛ akɛseɛ mu ho asɛm. Wɔ afe 2001 mu no na ɔne boom yɛɛ ɔyɛkyerɛ Authentic/Ex-Centric, adeyɛ bi a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ sohwɛfo.

Wɔ afe 2001 mu no na ɔne no yɛ ɔyɛkyerɛ Unpacking Europe, a wɔyɛɛ ho nhyehyɛe wɔ Tete Nneɛma Akorae Boijmans Van Beuningen wɔ Rotterdam Amammerɛ Ahenkurow a ɛwɔ Europa (2001-2002) amammerɛ nhyehyɛe no mu no sohwɛfo. Ɔyɛkyerɛ no twe adwene si Europa ne nipasu ho adwene so, na ɛkyerɛ sɛnea Europa nipasu yɛ adwene a ɛyɛ biribiara gye. Bless.

.

 Sudanfo a wɔatu akɔtena amannɔne ho anisoadehu ahorow, Johannesburg a Edi Kan, 28/02-30/04/1995. Fa wo ho hyɛ dwumadi no mu nso wɔ BUA nhyiam no mu! Nne a Ɛrepue wɔ Adwinni Mu .
 Nsɛm Ason a Ɛfa Nnɛyi Afrika Adwinni Ho, Whitechapel Art Gallery, London, September 1995 (wɔ Africa 95 ɔyɛkyerɛ nhyehyɛe no mu).

Africa Asono 
Africa asono (Loxodonta) yɛ abusua bi a ɛwɔ asono ahodoɔ mmienu a wɔte ase, Africa kwae mu asono (L. africana) ne Afrika kwae mu asono ketewa (L. cyclotis). Wɔn baanu nyinaa yɛ asetena mu mmoa a wodi nhabannuru a wɔn honam ani yɛ fitaa, nanso ɛsono wɔn ntini kɛseɛ ne ahosuo, wɔn aso ne wɔn tiri nhwi nsusuiɛ ne wɔn kɛse.

title: East Africa
text:
Sɛ wopɛ adwumakuo a wɔfrɛ no (British) East Africa a, hwɛ East Africa Protectorate. Sɛ wopɛ Afrika Aman Nkabom no mantam a, hwɛ Afrika Aman Nkabom no Mpɔtam § Apuei fam.

Afrika Apuei fam, Afrika Apuei fam, anaa Afrika Apuei fam, yɛ Afrika asasepɔn no apuei fam mantam ketewa. Wɔ Amanaman Nkabom Akontaabuo Dwumadibea nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa asasesini ho no, nsasesini 10-11-(16*) na ɛka bɔm yɛ Afrika Apuei Fam:

Nyansahufoɔ adwene hyia ka sɛ Afrika Apuei fam mantam no ne baabi a nnɛyi nnipa dii kan danee wɔn ho wɔ nipadua mu bɛyɛ mfie 200,000 a atwam ni ansa na wɔretu afiri Afrika akɔ atifi fam.

Esiane abakɔsɛm ɛwɔ Oman Ahemman ne atubrafoɔ nsasesini a ɛwɔ Britania East Africa Protectorate ne German East Africa nti, wɔtaa de asɛmfua East Africa di dwuma (titiriw wɔ Borɔfo kasa mu) de kyerɛ beaeɛ pɔtee a mprempren yi  ɛka aman mmiensa a ɛne Kenya, Tanzania, . ne Uganda.

Nanso, wei nyɛ saa wɔ kasa afoforo pii mu, baabi a na asɛmfua no taa wɔ wɔ asase ho nsɛm a ɛtrɛ, a ɛwɔ mu na ɛtaa ka Djibouti, Eritrea, Ethiopia, ne Somalia ho.

• Tanzania, Kenya, Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi, Democratic Republic of Congo ne South Sudan ka Afrika apueiɛ fam nkuro ho.  Enum a edi kan no nso ka Afrika Ɔtare Kɛseɛ mantam no ho. Ɛtɔ mmerɛ bi a wɔbu Burundi ne Rwanda nso sɛ mfinimfini Afrika fa baabi.  

 Djibouti, Eritrea, Ethiopia ne Somalia nyinaa frɛ no Afrika Abɛn. Mpɔtam no yɛ Afrika asasepɔn no apuei fam pɛɛ.
 Socotra -  Yemen amrado a ewɔ India Po no mu.
 Comoros, Mauritius, ne Seychelles – yɛ nsupɔ aman nketewa a ɛwɔ India Po no mu.
 Réunion, Mayotte (asasesini mu no ɛyɛ Comoro Nsupɔ no fa) ne Nsupɔ a Apete wɔ India Po no mu – Franse amannɔne nsasesini nso wɔ India Po no mu.
 Mozambique ne Madagascar – wɔtaa bu no sɛ ɛyɛ Afrika Keseɛ Fam fa, wɔ asasepɔn no apuei fam. Madagascar ne Asia Keseɛ Fam Apuei ne Afrika Apuei fam nyinaa wɔ amammerɛ mu abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den, ne India Po no nsupɔ no.
 Malawi, Zambia, ne Zimbabwe – na wɔtaa nso ka Afrika Keseɛ Fam ho, na kane no na ɛyɛ Central African Federation (a wɔsan frɛ no abakɔsɛm mu sɛ Rhodesia ne Nyasaland Federation).
 South Sudan ne Sudan – sɛ wɔka bom a, ɛyɛ Nile Bon no fa. Wɔwɔ asasepɔn no atifi fam apuei fa. Afei nso Common Market for Eastern and Southern Africa (COMESA) adwadie a wɔde wɔn ho to so no mufoɔ.

Asase ho nsɛm ne wiem tebea 
Afrika Apuei fam mmeaɛ bi agye din wɔ wuram mmoa a wɔdɔɔso te sɛ "akɛseɛ nnum": asono, anantwinini, gyata, asono tuntum, ne asono, ɛwom sɛ wɔn dodoɔ so ate wɔ adwennwen a ɛkɔ so mu nnansa yi de , titiri deɛ  ɛyɛ asono ne asono de no.

Afrika Apuei fam asase no taa yɛ nwonwa na ɛyɛ fɛ. Wiase nyinaa mprɛte tectonic tumi ahodoɔ a ɛde Afrika Apuei Fam Mpaapaemu aba no na ɛyɛɛ Afrika Apuei fam, na ɛhɔ na Bepɔ Kilimanjaro ne Bepɔ Kenya, mmepɔ mmienu a ɛware pa ara wɔ Afrika no wɔ. Ɛsane nso ka wiase no mu ɔtare a ɛtɔ so mmienu a nsu pa wɔ mu, Ɔtare Victoria, yɛ ɔtare a ɛtɔ so mmienu a emu dɔ sen ɔtare biara wɔ wiase, Ɔtare Tanganyika.

Afrika Apuei fam wiem tebea nyɛ dea ɛte wɔ equatorial mpɔtam hɔ mmom. Mpɛn pii no ɛyɛ kusuu anaa sɛ ɛyɛ kusuu fa a osu a ɛtɔ nyinaa wɔ asasetaw so mmeaɛ dodoɔ no ara a ɛba fam sen mm 600 afe biara. Nokware mu no, wɔ Somalia mpoano no, mfe pii bɛtumi atwam a osu biara ntɔ koraa. Wɔnte dea ɛde osu dodoɔ a ɛba fam no ase yiye. Ade baako a ɛde ba ne Somali Jet (mframa a ɛbɔ ntɛnntɛm nhyehyɛeɛ) a ɛwɔ hɔ wɔ boreal awɔ bere mu, a ɛde kesee fam mframa a ɛyɛ nwono ba Afrika Apuei fam.Ade a ɛtɔ so mmienu a ɛde ba ne asubɔnten bon a ɛwɔ apuei kɔ atɔe wɔ Afrika Apuei Fam Rift a ɛde mframa a ano yɛ den a nsu wɔm firi India Po no mu kɔ Afrika Apuei fam na ɛkɔ Congo Basin kwaeɛ a osu tɔ na owia bɔ kɛseɛ wɔm no mu. Wɔ mmeaɛ afoforo no, osu a ɛtɔ afe biara no taa kɔ soro kɔ anafoɔ fam na ɛkɔ soro, ɛyɛ bɛyɛ mm 400 (nsateakwaa 16) wɔ Mogadishu ne mm 1,200 (nsateakwaa 47) wɔ Mombasa wɔ mpoano, bere a wɔ asase mu no ɛkɔ soro firi bɛyɛ mm 130 (nsateakwaa 5) wɔ Garoowe kɔsi bɛboro mm 1,100 (43 in) wɔ Moshi a ɛbɛn Kilimanjaro. Nsuo dodoɔ no ara tɔ wɔ nsutɔ berɛ ahoroɔ mmienu a ɛsono emu biara mu, baako gyina April so ɛna baako nso tɔ wɔ ahinime anaa obubuo mu. Wɔtaa ka sɛ wei firi Intertropical Convergence Zone a ɛfaa mantam no mu nyinaa wɔ saa asram no mu no, nanso ebiara ɛne osutɔberɛ mu osutɔberɛ mu osu a ɛtɔ wɔ Sri Lanka, Vietnam, ne Brazil Nordeste mmeae bi nso.

Abakɔsɛm 
Asɛm titiriw: Afrika Apuei Fam Abakɔsɛm

Nsɛm foforo:  Sub-Saharan Africa § East Africa, African empires § East Africa, ne Ahennie ahodoɔ a na ɛwɔ Afrika ansa na atubrafoɔ  § East Africa.

Abakɔsɛm a edii kan baeɛ 
Sɛdeɛ nsusuiɛ a ɛfa nnansa yi Afrika mfitiase a nnɛyi nnipa firi mu kyerɛ no, gyidie a na fam tutufo dodoɔ no ara kura titiri ne sɛ, Afrika Apuei fam wɔ Afrika Atare akɛseɛ no mpɔtam hɔ ne baabi a nnɛyi nnipa dii kan puei wɔ nipadua mu. Nsusuiɛ ahodoɔ wɔ hɔ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ebia na atutra biako pɛ na ɛwɔ hɔ anaa sɛ nnipa pii; nhwɛsoɔ a ɛfa apete pii ho no fa Kesee Fam Apete nsusuiɛ ho. Nhwehwɛmufoɔ binom akyerɛ sɛ Afrika Atifi fam ne Afrika mantam a nnɛyi nnipa a wɔdii kan nante firi asasepɔn no so firi.

Sɛdeɛ awosu ne tetefo adanse nyinaa kyerɛ no, wɔatwerɛ sɛ tete Homo sapiens danee nnɛyi nnipa wɔ nipadua mu wɔ Afrika Abɛn bɛyɛ mfe 200,000 a atwam ni na wɔpetee firi hɔ. Homo sapiens idaltu ne Omo Kibish a wobɛgye atom sɛ wɔyɛ nnɛyi nnipa wɔ nipadua mu no bɛma wɔabu nnɛyi nnipa ho nkyerɛkyerɛmu a wɔde din ketewaa bi a wɔfrɛ no Homo sapiens sapiens no ayɛ deɛ ɛfata. Esiane sɛ wɔn berɛ a wodii kan yɔeɛ ne nipadua mu su soronko nti idaltu ne kibish gyina hɔ ma nnipa a wɔyɛ nnɛyi nnipa a wɔwɔ nipadua mu no nananom pɛɛ sɛdeɛ Out-of-Africa nsusuiɛ no kyerɛ no.Wɔ afe 2017 mu no, wɔhunuu nnɛyi nnipa afunu, a ɛfirii bɛyɛ mfeɛ 300,000 a atwam wɔ Jebel Irhoud wɔ Morocco, kyerɛɛ sɛ nnɛyi nnipa sɔree ntɛm na ebiara wɔ Afrika beaɛ kɛseɛ sene sɛdeɛ na wɔsusu kane no.

Afrika Apuei fam yɛ mmeaɛ a wogye di sɛ Homo sapiens tenaeɛ mfitiase no mu baako. Wohunu adanseɛ wɔ afe 2018 mu, a efiri bɛyɛ mfeɛ 320,000 a atwa mu ni, wɔ Kenya beaɛ a ɛwɔ Olorgesailie, a ɛkyerɛ sɛdeɛ nnɛyi nneyɔeɛ a ɛfa Homo sapiens ho no puei ntɛm, a deɛ ɛka ho ne: adwadi a ɛkɔ akyirikyiri (a nneɛma te sɛ obsidian ka ho), a wɔde di dwuma pigments, ne sɛdeɛ wobɛtumi ayɛ projectile points. Wɔahyɛ no nson wɔ atwerɛfoɔ a wɔyɛɛ nhwehwɛmu mmiɛsa a wɔyɔeɛ wɔ afe 2018 mu wɔ beaɛ no, sɛ adanse a ɛfa saa nneyɔeɛ yi ho no bɛyɛ berɛ korɔ mu de ne Homo sapiens nnompe nkaeɛ a edi kan a wonim a efiri Afrika (te sɛ deɛ ɛwɔ Jebel Irhoud ne Florisbad), na wɔkyerɛ sɛ ɛyɛ den na ɛyɛ nnɛyi de na nneyɔeɛ ahyɛ aseɛ deda wɔ Afrika bɛyɛ berɛ a Homo sapiens baeɛ no.

Wɔ ɛbɔ 2019 mu no, nyansahufoɔ bɔɔ amanneɛ sɛ wɔde kɔmputa sii gyinae, a egyina CT scan 260 so, wɔ ti nhwi a ɛte sɛ deɛ ɛte sɛ onipa nana a otwa to a ɔtaa yɛ ma nnɛyi nnipa/H. sapiens, a ɔyɛ Homo sapiens a edi kan no ananmusifoɔ, na ɔkyerɛeɛ sɛ Homo sapiens sɔree wɔ mfeɛ 350,000 kɔsi 260,000 a atwam ni denam nnipa dodoɔ a wɔka bɔm wɔ Afrika Keseɛ Fam ne Apuei fam no so.

Ɛbɛyɛ sɛ "Out of Africa" ​​nsusuiɛ no atutra kwan no sii wɔ Afrika Apuei fam nanso ɛnam Bab el Mandeb so.

Ɛnnɛ wɔ Bab-el-Mandeb asubɔnten mu no, Po Kɔkɔɔ no trɛw bɛyɛ akwansin du-mmienu (12) (kilomita 19), nanso mfeɛ 50,000 a atwa mu ni no, na ɛyɛ teateaa koraa na na ɛpo no mu nsuo si fam mita aduoson (70). Ɛwom sɛ wɔantoto asubɔnten no mu koraa da de, nanso ebi a na nsupɔn bi wɔ ntam a wɔbɛtumi de ahyɛmma a ɛnyɛ den akɔ hɔ.

Wɔahu hominin nnompe nkaeɛ a edi kan no bi wɔ ɔmantam a ɛtrɛ no mu, a nnompe a wohuu wɔ Awash Bɔn mu wɔ Ethiopia, ne Koobi Fora a ɛwɔ Kenya ne Olduvai Gorge a ɛwɔ Tanzania ka ho.

Tete abakɔsɛm 
Wobu Djibouti, Eritrea, Ethiopia, Somalia, ne Po Kɔkɔɔ mpoano wɔ Sudan sɛ ɛyɛ beaɛ a ɛda adi kɛseɛ sɛ asase a Tete Misrimfoɔ nim no sɛ Punt no wɔ. Ahennie deda no ho asɛm a edi kan no firi afeha a ɛtɔ so 25 A.Y.B.[47] Ná tete Puntifoɔ yɛ nnipa a wɔne Farao Misraim wɔ abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den wɔ Farao Sahure ne Ɔhemmaa Hatshepsut berɛ so.

Na Aksum Ahemman no yɛ adwadie ahemman a na ɛwɔ Eritrea ne Ethiopia atifi fam. Na ɛwɔ hɔ firi bɛyɛ 100–940 Y.B., na enyini firi proto-Aksumite Dade Mmerɛ berɛ c. mu na ama wanya din wɔ afeha a ɛtɔ so 1 Y.B. Wɔkaa ahennie no ho asɛm wɔ Periplus a ɛwɔ Erythraean Po no mu sɛ dwa titiri a wɔtɔn asɔnse, a na wɔde kɔ amannɔne wɔ tete wiase nyinaa. Saa berɛ no na Zoskales a ɔno nso di Adulis hyɛn gyinabea so na ɔdi Aksum so. Aksumite sodifoɔ no maa adwadie yɛɛ mmerɛ ɛnam wɔn ankasa Aksumite sika a wɔyaeɛ no so. Ɔman no nso de ne tumidi sii Kush Ahemman a na ɛrekɔ fam no so na ɛhyɛn ahennie ahodoɔ a ɛwɔ Arabia supɔn no so no amammuosɛm mu daa, na awieɛ koraa no, ɛtrɛ ne tumi mu wɔ mantam no so berɛ a wɔdii Himyarite Ahennie no so nkonim no.

title: Organization of Africa Unity
text: Organization of Africa Unity (OAU; Franse kasa: Organization de l’unité africaine, OUA) yɛ aban ahodoɔ ntam ahyehyɛdeɛ a wɔde sii hɔ wɔ Kotonimaa bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduonu num wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduosia mmiɛnsa (May 25, 1963) wɔ Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, a aban ahodoɔ aduasa (32) de wɔn nsa hyɛɛ ase.

title: Economic community of West African States
text:
