title: Mmabunuberɛ
text:
Mmabunuberɛ (a ɛfiri Latin adolescere mu a ɛkyerɛ sɛ ‘sɛ worenyini’) yɛ nsakraeɛ bi a ɛba nipadua ne adwene mu a ɛtaa ba wɔ berɛ a ɛfiri mmeranteberɛ ne mmabaaberɛ so kosi mpanin mfeɛ so (a mpɛn pii no ɛne mfeɛ a obi adi hyia).Mpɛn pii no, mmeranteberɛ ne mmabaaberɛ bata mmabunberɛ ho, nanso ne honam fam, adwene anaa amammerɛ mu nkyerɛkyerɛmu bɛtumi ahyɛaseɛ ntɛm anaasɛ ɛbɛba awieeɛ akyiri koraa. Mpɛn pii no, mmeranteberɛ ne mmabaaberɛ hyɛaseɛ berɛ a wonnii mfeɛ aduonu,ne titire wɔ mmaa mu. Nipadua mu nyini(titire wɔ mmarima mu) ne adwene mu nkɔsoɔ bɛtumi atrɛ asene mmabunu. Mfeɛ a obi adi ma yɛhunu sɛ obi aduru ne mpanin mfeɛ so, na abemfo nnye nkyerɛaseɛ pɔtee bi ntumi. Nkyerɛmu ahodoɔ bi hyɛaseɛ ntɛm bɛyɛ sɛ du (10) na aba awieeɛ wɔ aduonu num (25) anaa aduonu nsis(26)akyi.Wiase Nyinaa Kuo a ɛhwɛ yɛn Nnuro so ahyehyɛdeɛ no nkyerɛaseɛ no kyerɛ sɛ, ɔbabunu yɛ obi a wadi mfeɛ du (10)kosi du nsia(19).

Nkakraeɛ a ɛkɔ so wɔ Abɔdeɛ Akwaa ho 
Mmabunuyɛ Ankasa

Mmabunberɛ yɛ berɛ a nipadua mu nyini ntɛmntɛm ne adwene mu nsakraeɛ ba mfeɛ pii mu, na ɛma obi nyini wɔ nna mu. Adantam mfeɛ a ɛma obi duru ne Mpanimfeɛ so yɛ dubaako wɔ mmaa afam ɛna dummienu wɔ mmarima afam. Ankorankorɛ biara berɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɔde bɛhyɛ ne mmabunberɛ mu no nya adedie titire so nkɛntɛnsoɔ. Ɛwɔm sɛ nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia te sɛ aduane ne apomuden ateneatene nso nya nkɛntɛnsoɔ bi. Saa nnoɔma yi nso bɛtumi ama obi nnyini ntɛm.

Adeɛ baako a ɛho wɔ mfasoɔ paa wɔ Mmabunberɛ mu a ɛma nkɔsoɔ paa ahodoɔ no bi fa nsakraeɛ a ɛba ankorankorɛ nipadua tenten ho, wɔn mu duru, wɔn nipadua mu nneɛma, ne mogya a ɛdi afurusane wɔ yɛn mu ne ɔhome a ɛkɔ so wɔ yɛn mu ho.Nsakraeɛ ahodoɔ yi firi nkwaadɔm a ɛma nipadua no yɛ adwuma no so nkɛntɛnsoɔ kɛse. Nkwammoaa di dwuma wɔ nhyehyɛeɛ mu, ɛhyɛ nipadua no ma ɛyɛ n’adeɛ wɔ ɔkwan pɔtee bi so berɛ a babunberɛ ahyɛ aseɛ pɛ no, na ɛdi dwuma a ɛyɛ nnam, a ɛkyerɛ nsakraeɛ a ɛba nkwaadɔm mu wɔ mmeranteberɛ ne mmabaaberɛ mu a ɛkanyan suban ne nipadua mu nsakraeɛ.

Mmabunberɛ nam adeɛ a ne kwan ware yie so na ɛhyɛ aseɛ denam nkwaadɔm a ɛma nipadua no yɛ adwuma a ɛkɔ soro so, na ɛno nso de nipadua mu nsakraeɛ ahodoɔ pii ba. Ɛyɛ asetena mu fa a ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nna su a ɛto so mmienu ɛda adi na ɛkɔ so (nhwɛso ne, nne a emu dɔ ne mene a emu dɔ anaa yɛ duru wɔ mmarimaa mu, ne nufo ne ɛtoɔ a ɛyɛ kurukuruwa na ɛda adi kɛse wɔ mmaa mu) ne nsakraeɛ a emu yɛ den ne atenka a ɛkɔ soro sɛ yɛduru yɛn Mpanimfeɛ so a. Nea ɛma no ba yɛ pituitary gland a ɛma hormone ahodoɔ a ɛkɔ mogya no mu kɔ mogya no mu, na ɛfiri aseɛ yɛ kurukuruwa. Ɛnam so ma ɔbarima ne ɔbaa gonads no yɛ adwuma, na ɛma ɛkɔ tebea a ɛma wɔnyini ntɛmntɛm mu; mprempren gonads a ɛkanyan no no firi aseɛ yɛ nkwaadɔm ahodoɔ pii. Hwoa no titire na ɛma awotwaa no, na nea ɛkura nkosua no titire na ɛma estrogen. Nkwammoaa yi a wɔyɛ no kɔ soro nkakrankakra kosi sɛ wobɛduru nna mu nyini ho. Mmarimaa binom bɛtumi anya mmaa mu yare esiane ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nna mu nkwaadɔm a ɛnkari pɛ, ntini a ɛyɛ adwuma anaa kɛseyɛ mmoroso nti.

Mpɛn pii no, anim nwi a ɛwɔ mmarima mu no pue nnidisoɔ nnidisoɔ pɔtee bi wɔ mmeranteberɛ ne mmabaaberɛ mu: Anim nwi a ɛdi kan a ɛda adi no taa nyini wɔ anofafa a ɛwɔ soro no ntwea so, mpɛn pii no ɛfiri mfeɛ du nnan kɔsi du nson.Afei ɛtrɛ ma ɛyɛ abɔgyesɛ wɔ anofafa a ɛwɔ soro no nyinaa so. Wei akyi no, nwi a ɛda adi wɔ afono no atifi, ne baabi a ɛwɔ anofafa a ɛwɔ fam no ase.Awieeɛ koraa no, nwi no trɛ kɔ anim ne ase hye so, ne anim ase nkae no ma ɛyɛ abɔgyesɛ a ɛyɛ ma.Sɛnea ɛte wɔ nnipa abɔde mu nneɛma dodow no ara ho no, nhyehyɛe pɔtee yi bɛtumi ayɛ soronko wɔ ankorankorɛ binom mu. Anim nwi taa ba wɔ mmeranteberɛ ne mmabaaberɛ awieeɛ, bɛyɛ mfeɛ du nson (17 )ne du nnwɔtwe 18, nanso ebia ɛrempue kɔsi akyiri yi kɛse.Mmarima binom nnya anim nwi a ɛyɛ pɛ mfeɛ 10 wɔ wɔn mmabunberɛ akyi. Anim nwiii kɔ so yɛ mmerɛ, ɛyɛ tuntum kɛse na ɛyɛ den mfe mmienu kɔsi nnam–4 bio wɔ mmeranteberɛ ne mmabaaberɛ akyi.Ade titiri a ɛkyerɛ mmarima mmabunberɛ ne spermarche, ɔbarima ne ɔbaa nna a ɛdii kan, a sɛ wɔkyekyem pɛpɛɛpɛ a, ɛba bere a wɔadi mfe 13.Wɔ mmea fam no, ɛyɛ brayɛ, brayɛ mfiase, a sɛ wɔkyekyem pɛpɛɛpɛ a, ɛba wɔ mfe 12 kosi 13 ntam.Mfeɛ a obi adi wɔ brayɛ mu no nya awosuobso nkɛntɛnsoɔ, nanso abaayewa aduan ne n’asetra kwan nso boa.Ɛmfa ho awosuo mu nkwaadɔm no, ɛsɛ sɛ abaayewaa nya nipadua mu sradeɛ fa bi na ama wanya brayɛ. Ne saa nti, mmayewa a wɔwɔ aduane a srade pii wom na wɔnyɛ apɔ-mu-teɛteɛ fi ase brayɛ ntɛm, sɛ wɔkyekyem pɛpɛɛpɛ a, sene mmayewaa a sradeɛ kakraa bi na ɛwɔ wɔn aduan mu na wɔn dwumadi ahorow no fa apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ a ɛtew srade so (e.g. ballet ne apɔw-mu-teɛteɛ).Ne saa nti, mmaayewaa a a wodi aduane a sradeɛ pii wɔm na wɔnyɛ Mmabaa a wonnya aduan pa nni anaasɛ wɔwɔ aman a wɔhwɛ kwan sɛ mmofra bɛyɛ nipadua mu adwuma wom mu no nso fi ase kɔ brayɛ mu wɔ wɔn mfeɛ a ɛdi akyiri mu.

Nyini a ɛba Ntɛnmtɛm 
Sɛ mmaa duru wɔn Mmabunuberɛ berɛ mu a nsesaeɛ a ɛba wɔn mu honam fa mu no, wɔbɛtumi akyekyɛmu akuo mmiɛnsa a ɛsono emu biara. Wɔ ahyɛaseɛ a mpɛn pii no ɛma nnipa nyini ntɛmntɛm no, nufoɔ yɛ kɛseɛ na ne baa ne ne mmɔtoam ho fu nwii. Berɛ a nipadua mu nyini akɔ soro no ɛba bɛyɛ afe baako akyi a ɛne nna mu nyini gyinapɛn a ɛtɔ so mmienu no hyia. Bɛyɛ mfeɛ baako kɔsi baako ne fa wɔ ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna mu su a ɛtɔ so mmienu akyi no, mmaa kɔ gyinapɛn a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa a mpɛn pii no nea ɛka ho ne brayɛ mu. Saa berɛ yi deɛ, na wɔanyini ntɛm so na wɔn serɛ atrɛ ayɛ kɛseɛ na ɔsane nso nya sradeɛ nyini yɛ mpanin nso. Bio nso, nufoɔ no nyini wie koraa na nwii a ɛwɔ be baa so ne ne mmɔtoam no (axillary hair) nyinaa bɛyɛ tuntum na atrɛ. Sɛ wɔde toto mmaa ho a, ɛbɛtumi ayɛ ayɛ den sɛ wɔbɛkyerɛ berɛ pɔtee a mmarimaa ho akwaa hyɛ aseɛ nyini.

Wɔ mmarimaa fam no, mpɛn pii no ɛdi bɛyɛ mfeɛ nnum ansa na wɔawie, sɛdeɛ ɛyɛ mfeɛ mmiɛnsa pɛ wɔ mmaa fam no (menarche). Ɛduru saa berɛ yi mu a,  wɔanyini ntɛmntɛm dada na nsakraeɛ a ɛda adi wɔ wɔn nipadua, wɔn serɛ nso atrɛ dada ayɛ sɛ mpanin. Saa berɛ no nufoɔ no nyini wie. Wɔ mmarimaa fam no, wobɛtumi anya agyinapɛn nnan a ɛbata sɛnea nipadua no nyini nyinaa wɔ mmeranteberɛ ne mmabaaberɛ mu no ho. Mpɛn pii no, nsɛnkyerɛnne a ɛdi kan a ɛkyerɛ sɛ mmarimaa nyini ne "ɛbɛyɛ gramoo." Abarimaa a wanyini no mu yɛ duru yɛ kɛse na ɛkame ayɛ sɛ ne ho yɛ kurukuruwa, na sradeɛ a ɛba mmaa mu no ma wɔyɛ frɔmfrɔm. Ebia wei  ba ɛfiri sɛ wɔkanyan estrogen a Leydig nkwammoaa a ɛwɔ awotwaa mu no yɛ ansa na Sertoli nkwammoaa a ɛdɔɔso kɛse no ahyɛaseɛ ayɛ testosterone dodoɔ a ɛho hia. Bɛyɛ sɛ afe baako a hwoa no hyɛ aseɛ yɛ kɛseɛ no, wobɛhunu gyinapɛn a ɛtɔ so mmienu no. Saa berɛ yi mu no, sradeɛ a ɛwɔ honam ani no san kyekyɛ na ne baa ho nwii hyɛ aseɛ fu. Bɛyɛ bosome nnwɔtwe kɔsi dummienu mu no wɔnyinii ahoɔhare so, na gyinapɛn mmiɛnsa atoa so. Saa berɛ yi yɛ berɛ a ne srɛ trɛ yɛ akɛseɛ te sɛ mpanimfoɔ deɛ na nufoɔ no nyini. Sɛ wɔka ne nyinaa bom a, saa nneɛma mmiɛnsa yi kɔwie nkɔso a ɛba ma ankorankorɛ dodoɔ no ara. Saa berɛ yi deɛ, ammɔtoam nwii pue na anim nwii pue wɔ anofafa a ɛwɔ soro nkoaa so. Nnipadua no nyini ntɛmntɛm, na sradeɛ a ɛwɔ honam ani a ɛma no nyini no so te. Nwii a ɛba yɛnsa so fu pii na mmom ɛmfu mma yɛn srɛ ho. Ɔbarima no barima  ne ne hwoa no bɛyɛ kɛseɛ te sɛ mpanimfoɔ deɛ. Ɛyɛ den sɛ wobɛhunu gyinapɛn a ɛtɔ nnum a wɔde ma mmarimaa, a ɛba baabiara firi bosome du num kɔsi aduonu nan wɔ gyinapɛn a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa akyi no. Saa berɛ yi deɛ, tenten a ɔyɛ no pem. Nwii ba n'afono ho ne anofafa a ɛwɔ soro, mpanin su ne ho nnoɔma ne ahosuo a ɛwɔ wobaa so ne mmɔtoam nwii, ne nnipadua no nyini yie.

Beaeɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ.

title: Grease
text:
Grease yɛ 1978 Amerika nnwom ɔdɔ ho aseresɛm sini a Randal Kleiser kyerɛɛ no kwan (wɔ ne dwumadi a edi kan a ɔyɛ ɔkwankyerɛfo titiriw mu) a efi Bronté Woodard sini a ɔkyerɛwee ne Allan Carr a ɔdan no, a egyina asɛnka agua so nnwom a Jim Jacobs ne Warren Casey yɛe a ɛwɔ din koro no ara so. Sini no kyerɛ Danny Zuko (John Travolta) a ɔyɛ srade ne Australiani osuani a ɔde kɔ baabi foforo Sandy Olsson (Olivia Newton-John) asetra, a wonya wɔn ho wɔn ho ho anigye wɔ awɔw bere mu ɔdɔ mu.

Paramount Pictures na woyii Grease adi wɔ United States wɔ June 16, 1978. Sini no dii yiye wɔ kasatia ne aguadi mu, na ɛbɛyɛɛ nnwom sini a enyaa sika kɛse sen biara saa bere no.[4] Ne nnwom nhoma no baa awiei wɔ afe 1978 mu sɛ nnwom nhoma a ɛto so abien a wɔtɔn sen biara wɔ afe no mu wɔ United States, na ɛwɔ 1977 sini Saturday Night Fever (a Travolta nso dii mu akoten) no nnyigyei akyi nkutoo,[5] na wɔde dwom "Hopelessly Devoted to You" too gua sɛ ɛnyɛ Academy Award for Best Original Song wɔ 51st Academy Awards. Sini no nso nyaa din anum wɔ Golden Globe Awards a ɛto so 36 no mu, a nea ɛka ho ne sɛ ɛyɛ Sini a Ɛsen Biara – Nnwom anaa Aseresɛm ne abien a ɛyɛ Mfitiase Dwom a Ɛsen Biara, wɔ "Grease" ne "You're the One that I Want" ho. Wɔ afe 2020 mu no, wɔpaw Grease sɛ wɔmfa nkora so wɔ United States National Film Registry mu wɔ Library of Congress sɛ "ɔyɛ nea ɛho hia wɔ amammerɛ, abakɔsɛm, anaa afɛfɛde mu".[6][7]

Woyii nea ɛtoa so, Grease 2, adi wɔ 1982 mu, a Maxwell Caulfield ne Michelle Pfeiffer dii mu akoten sɛ sradefo kuw foforo. Mfitiase sini no mufo kakraa bi na wɔsan yɛɛ wɔn dwumadi ahorow no. Ɛde besi afe 2023 no, television so dwumadi a edi kan a enni bere tiaa bi, Grease: Rise of the Pink Ladies, dii kan wɔ Paramount +, a sini a edi kan, a wɔato din Summer Lovin', a mprempren wɔreyɛ.[8][9]

Asase 
Wɔ 1958 ahohuru bere mu no, ɛhɔnom abarimaa Danny Zuko ne Australiani Sandy Olsson a ɔrekɔ akwamma hyiam wɔ mpoano na wɔdɔ wɔn ho. Sɛ awɔw bere no ba awiei a, Sandy haw sɛ ebia wɔrenhyia bio, nanso Danny ka kyerɛ no sɛ wɔn dɔ no yɛ "mfiase nkutoo".

Wɔ mpanyimfo bere mfiase wɔ Rydell ntoaso sukuu mu no, Danny san fi ne dwumadi ase sɛ T-Birds srade kuw a Doody, Sonny, Putzie, ne n’adamfo paa Kenickie ka ho no kannifo. Sandy awofoɔ da so ara wɔ Amerika na wɔkyerɛw Sandy din wɔ Rydell baabi a ohyia greaser girl clique the Pink Ladies a Frenchy, Marty, Jan ne ɔkannifoɔ Rizzo ka ho.

Danny ne Sandy ka wɔn ɔdɔ tiawa no ho asɛm kyerɛ wɔn akuw no mu biara, Sandy kae awɔw bere bi a na ɔdɔ wom na Danny kyerɛ sɛ onyaa honam fam osuahu kɛse. Bere a awiei koraa no Sandy bɔ Danny din no, Rizzo yɛ nhyehyɛe ma wɔsan hyia bio wɔ pep nhyiam bi ase a Sandy hyia Tom, jock, na Kenickie da ne kar foforo a wɔde adi dwuma, Greased Lightnin’, a wayɛ nhyehyɛe sɛ obetu mmirika wɔ mmɔnten so bere a wɔasan asiesie akyi no adi. Esiane sɛ Danny akyere ne nkate ne ne din sɛ abarimaa bɔne nti, ɔbɔ Sandy animtiaa wɔ ne kuw no anim na ne bo fuw.

Wɔ Pink Ladies pajama apontow bi ase no, Sandy yare esiane sɛ ɔnom, ɔsɔ sigaret hwɛe, na ɔma Frenchy tow n’aso nti, bere a Rizzo, bere a wadi Sandy nipasu a ɛyɛ papa na ɛho tew ho fɛw akyi no, ofi hɔ kɔda Kenickie wɔ ne kar mu, na bere a wɔn kɔndɔm no bubu Leo, basabasayɛ kuw a wɔredi akan, Scorpions, no kannifo ne n’adamfo abeawa Cha-Cha haw wɔn. Bere a nna apontow no aba awiei no, Sandy hu sɛ ɔda so ara dɔ Danny wɔ ne nyinaa akyi.

Ade kyee no, Danny pa Sandy kyɛw sɛ ɔbɔɔ no brush anadwo a atwam no na, ɛdenam Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo Calhoun mmoa so no, ɔbɛyɛ mmirikatufo na odi nkonim wɔ ne nsam bio fi Tom nsam, nanso wɔn nnamfonom bɔ wɔn date no hwe ase, na Kenickie ne Rizzo tetew mu wɔ akyinnyegye akyi. Bere a ahoɔfɛ adesuakuw bi a asiane wom gyaw Frenchy a ne ti nhwi yɛ pink a ɛte sɛ ahwiesa akyi no, ɔmpɛ sɛ osi gyinae sɛ ɔbɛsan akɔ Rydell akɔwie ne ntoaso sukuu adesua.

Wɔ sukuu asaw no mu no, wɔbɔ amanneɛ tee wɔ National Bandstand na DJ Vince Fontaine na ɔyɛ ho nhyehyɛe, Rizzo ne Kenickie spite wɔn ho wɔn ho denam Leo ne Cha-Cha a wɔde ba sɛ wɔn date no so. Wɔ nsa jive akansi a basabasayɛ wom mu no, Danny ne Sandy saw yiye, nanso ansa na wɔrebɔ nkonimdifo no amanneɛ no, Sonny twe Sandy kɔ na Cha-Cha twa mu ma ɔne Danny di nkonim, bere a Sandy de ahum refi adi no. Danny bɔ mmɔden sɛ ɔbɛma Sandy ayɛ nea ɛfata denam no a ɔde no bɛkɔ agoprama bi a wɔde kar kɔ mu no so, nanso nkɔso a ɛkɔ tẽẽ na ɛyɛ den kɛse no ma Sandy guan de ahopopo. Rizzo suro sɛ wanyinsɛn bere a wankɔ nna mu akyi na ɔka ne kokoam asɛm kyerɛ Marty, na ɔka kyerɛ Sonny, na ɔtrɛw asɛm no mu kɔma Kenickie a ɛda adi sɛ ɔyɛ agya no a wanhyɛ da, ɛwom sɛ Rizzo pow no de.

Mmirikatu da no, Kenickie ankasa kar pon ma ne ho popo, enti Danny fa ntwahonan no, na odi nkonim wɔ mmirikatu no mu bere a Leo twitwiw ne ho akyi no. Sandy a ofi akyirikyiri rehwɛ na n’ani agye wɔ Danny nkonimdi no ho no de ba awiei sɛ ɔda so ara dɔ no na ɔhwehwɛ mmoa fi Frenchy hɔ ma ɔsakra ne suban na ɔhwɛ sɛ n’ani begye ho.

Adeyɛ 
Ɔkwankyerɛfo Randal Kleiser faa ahofadi pii de mfitiase fibea nsɛm no, nea ɛda nsow kɛse ne sɛ ɔde tebea no fii Chicago nkurow akɛse mu tebea mu (a egyina William Howard Taft ntoaso sukuu so[10]), sɛnea na mfitiase nnwom no te no, kɔɔ nkurow no akyi beae kɛse, a ɛda n’ankasa mmabunbere adi wɔ Radnor ntoaso sukuu a ɛwɔ Philadelphia kurotia no mu. Ná onni sini no mu nnwom afã horow no so tumi kɛse; wɔpoo dwom a ɔpaw a ɛyɛ asɛmti dwom, a Charles Fox ne Paul Williams hyehyɛe no, bere a Robert Stigwood ne Allan Carr hyɛɛ dwom bi fii Stigwood afɛfo Barry Gibb hɔ wɔ simma a etwa to no mu no.[11][12]

Casting a wɔtow gu 
John Travolta adi kan ne Stigwood ayɛ adwuma wɔ Saturday Night Fever, ɔkyeree nnwom 10 a ɛyɛ dɛ sen biara "Let Her In" wɔ 1976 mu, na na wadi kan ayɛ Doody wɔ akwantuo mu adeyɛ bi a ɛfa Grease asɛnka agua so fã no ho. Sɛ́ mfonini abiɛsa apam a wɔne Stigwood yɛe no fã no, wɔmaa Travolta dwumadi titiriw bere a Henry Winkler pow dwumadi no esiane suro a na osuro sɛ wɔbɛkyerɛw no sɛ obi a ɔde srade srade gu mu nti, efisɛ wayɛ bad-boy sradefo a ɔte saa ara Arthur Fonzarelli wɔ Anigye Nna mu fi 1974. (Akyiri yi Winkler benu ne ho wɔ gyinaesi no ho.)[13][14] Ná ɔkwankyerɛfo Randal Kleiser nkyerɛɛ agoruhwɛbea dwumadi biara kwan da ansa na eyi reba nanso na wakyerɛ Travolta kwan wɔ 1976 television so sini a wɔato din The Boy in the Plastic Bubble mu) sɛ ɔkwankyerɛfo; Kleiser ne Travolta nyaa platonic abusuabɔ a emu yɛ den wɔ bere a wɔreyɛ no mu, na ɛboaa Travolta ma ɔde n’adwene sii so bere a odii Diana Hyland (n’adamfo abeawa saa bere no ne ne maame a ɔwɔ sini mu wɔ Bubble) wu ho awerɛhow no.[13] Ansa na wɔrefa Newton-John adwuma no, na Allan Carr resusuw din ahorow pii te sɛ Carrie Fisher,[15][16] Ann-Margret, Deborah Raffin,[17] Susan Dey ne Marie Osmond ho sɛ wɔnyɛ adwuma titiriw. Fisher a na wawie Star Wars nkyɛe no, awiei koraa no wɔpoo efisɛ na Stigwood anaa Carr nnim sɛ obetumi ato dwom anaa.[13] Ɛkame ayɛ sɛ Osmond faa dwumadi no ansa na ɔrehu baabi a onipa no danee atuatewfo koduu na ɔpowee[18] sɛ ɔnyɛ Goin’ Coconuts mu ɔyɛkyerɛfo mmom. Awiei koraa no, Carr paw Newton-John bere a ohyiaa no kwa wɔ apontow bi a Helen Reddy yɛɛ ho nhyehyɛe mu akyi.[19] Ná Newton-John anyɛ agodie pii ansa na sini yi reba, na na sini abien pɛ na wɔde ho anuonyam maa no (1965 Funny Things Happen Down Under ne 1970 sini a wonhuu no pii a wɔfrɛ no Toomorrow, a edii n’anim ansa na ɔreto nnwom mu nkɔso) de besi saa bere no; ɔsrɛɛ sɛ wɔnyɛ no screen test ansa na ɔregye dwumadie no atom.[19] Newton-John penee so sɛ wɔbɛtew bo a wɔsrɛ so de agye nsoromma ho ka ne tumi a wɔde bɛsan akyerɛw nkyerɛwee no, a nea ɛka ho ne sɛ ɔbɛsesa ne suban no mfiase ayɛ no Australiani otubrafo (sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a ɛho renhia sɛ osuasua Amerikani kasa a wɔka no) na ɔmma ɔnyɛ obi a ɔnyɛ hwee. Wɔ asetra a wosuasua adwinni ho asɛm mu no, na Newton-John ankasa nnwom adwuma no bɛsakra te sɛ Sandy Olsson nipa no de no; ne nnwom nhoma a edi hɔ a odii Grease akyi, a wɔtoo din Totally Hot a ɛkanyan akɔnnɔ no, de ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne pop ho kwan a ɛsen biara adi, a Newton-John puei wɔ album no anim wɔ atade a ɛte saa ara a wɔde aboa nhoma nyinaa ayɛ ne ti nhwi a wɔserewee mu.

Lucie Arnaz yɛɛ nhwehwɛmu maa Rizzo fã, nanso wɔpaw Carr talente afɛfo, Stockard Channing, wɔ mfe pii akyi wɔ ne sini mu dwumadi titiriw a etwa to ne nea edi kan wɔ The Fortune mu.[13] Bere a odii mfe 33 no na ɔyɛ sini no muni a wanyin sen biara a ɔyɛɛ ntoaso sukuuni, na Kleiser maa ɔne agoruyɛfo afoforo a wɔyɛ asuafo no yɛɛ "crow’s feet test" de hwɛɛ sɛ ebia wobetumi atwam ama nkumaa wɔ mfonini a wɔabɛn mu anaa.[13] Wɔde adwene a ɛyɛ brɛoo dii dwuma wɔ agoruyɛfo a wɔn mfe akɔ anim no bi anim.[18] Channing bɔɔ mmɔden kɛse sɛ wɔbɛma dwom a ɛyɛ den "There Are Worse Things I Could Do" no nkɔ so wɔ nkyerɛwde no mu esiane Carr kasatia nti.[18]

Grease yɛ sini a edi kan a ɛmaa varsity jacket ahorow gyee din no mu biako.

Wɔsusuu Elvis Presley ho sɛ ɔbɛyɛ The Teen Angel nanso owui ansa na wɔreyɛ.[18] Marie Osmond nuabarima ne ne hokafoɔ a ɔne no yɛ duet Donny Osmond yɛ Teen Angel foforɔ a ɔbɛtumi ayɛ ansa na wɔreyi Avalon,[18] sɛdeɛ na Frankie Valli nso teɛ, a na wɔama no kwan sɛ ɔbɛto dwom asɛmti no anaasɛ ɔbɛda ne ho adi sɛ Teen Angel (ɔpaw kan no).[21]

Ná Jeff Conaway, te sɛ Travolta, adi kan apue wɔ Grease asɛnka agua so dwumadi no mu; na wayɛ Danny Zuko bere a na ɔyɛkyerɛ no retu mmirika wɔ Broadway no. Wannya kwan ankɔbɔ Kenickie featured number "Greased Lightnin'" esiane Travolta nkɛntɛnso ne ɔpɛ a ɔwɔ sɛ obenya saa dwom no ama n'ankasa nti.[18] Jamie Donnelly san yɛɛ ne dwumadi sɛ Jan a ofi Broadway dwumadi no mu, na ɔyɛ sini no muni biako pɛ a ɔyɛɛ saa; bere a na ne ti nhwi afi ase reyɛ fitaa saa bere yi no, na ɛsɛ sɛ ɔde kɔla yɛ ne ti nhwi ma ɛyɛ te sɛ nea ɔyɛ wɔ agoprama so no.[22] Ná Kelly Ward adi kan ada ne ho adi sɛ obi a ɔboa no a ɔyɛ kasatia a ɔte saa ara wɔ The Boy in the Plastic Bubble a Travolta ka ho wɔ Kleiser ase no mu; wɔpaw no sɛ Putzie, a na ne fã kɛse no ara yɛ obi foforo.

Lorenzo Lamas yɛ obi a ɔde simma a etwa to sii Steven Ford a onyaa ehu wɔ asɛnka agua so bere tiaa bi ansa na wɔreyɛ sini no na ɔsan n’akyi, ne Mark Fidrych a ɔne ne bere nyinaa adwuma sɛ baseball bɔfo no nyaa ntawntawdi no ananmu. Na nkɔmmɔbɔ biara nni ne dwumadi no mu na na ɛhwehwɛ sɛ Lamas yɛ ne ti nhwi fitaa na wakwati sɛ ɔbɛyɛ sɛ T-Nnomaa no mu biako.[22][18]

title: N.W.A
text:
N.W.A (a wɔatwa no tiaa ama Niggaz Wit Attitudes[5][6]) yɛ Amerikafo hip hop kuw bi a wɔhyehyɛɛ no wɔ Compton, California. Na wɔka wɔn a wodii kan gyee din na wɔkyerɛɛ akyinnyegye wɔ gangsta rap nnwom ketewa no mu ho, na nnipa pii bu kuw no sɛ kuw akɛse ne nkɛntɛnso kɛse wɔ hip hop nnwom abakɔsɛm mu no mu biako.

Wɔyɛɛ nnam fi 1987 kosi 1991,[1] rap kuw no gyinaa akyinnyegye ano esiane ne nnwom no mu nsɛm a ɛda adi pefee, a nnipa pii buu no sɛ ɛyɛ mmea ho tan, ne sɛnea wɔhyɛɛ nnubɔne ne nsɛmmɔnedi anuonyam nso nti. Akyiri yi wɔbaraa kuw no sɛ wɔnnkɔ Amerika radio dwumadibea atitiriw pii mu. Eyi nyinaa akyi no, kuw no atɔn bɛboro ɔpepem 10 wɔ United States nkutoo. Bere a kuw no de wɔn mufo ankasa osuahu ahorow a ɛfa mmusua mu nyiyim ne polisifo a wɔtra so ho dii dwuma no, wɔyɛɛ amammui nnwom a efi awosu mu.[9] Ná wonim kuw no mufo sɛ wɔtan polisifo nhyehyɛe a ɛde akyinnyegye pii aba mfe pii mu no kɛse.

Mfitiaseɛ nnwontofoɔ a wɔhyehyɛɛ no afe 1987 mfitiaseɛ,[1] no yɛ Arabian Prince, Dr. Dre, Eazy-E, ne Ice Cube, a DJ Yella ne MC Ren bɛkaa ho akyiri yi wɔ saa afe no mu. Woyii wɔn nnwom nhoma a edi kan a wɔaboaboa ano sɛ kuw wɔ 1987 mu a wɔfrɛ no N.W.A. ne Posse a ɛkɔɔ soro sen biara wɔ Billboard nsɛmma nhoma no Top R&B/Hip-Hop Albums nhyehyɛe mu. Arabian Prince fii hɔ bere a woyii N.W.A studio album a edi kan, Straight Outta Compton, adi wɔ afe 1988 mu akyi bere tiaa bi, na Ice Cube dii n’akyi wɔ December 1989. Akyiri yi Eazy-E, Ice Cube, MC Ren ne Dr. Dre bɛyɛɛ nnwontofo a wɔn nkutoo na wɔtɔn platinum wɔ wɔn ankasa mu wɔ 1990 mfe no mu. Kuw no album a edi kan no hyɛɛ gangsta rap bere foforo no mfiase bere a na nnwom a wɔyɛe ne asetra mu nkyerɛkyerɛmu a wɔde mae wɔ wɔn nnwom no mu no yɛɛ nsakrae kɛse wɔ nnwom no mu. N.W.A studio album a ɛtɔ so mmienu, Niggaz4Life, yɛ hardcore rap album a ɛdi kan a ɛduruu nea ɛdi kan wɔ Billboard 200 adetɔn nnwom mu.[6]

Rolling Stone de N.W.A too nea ɛto so 83 wɔ ne din a ɛne "Adwumfo a Wɔsen Biara 100 a Wɔayɛ Bere Nyinaa" no mu.[10] Wɔ afe 2016 mu no, wɔde kuw no kɔɔ Rock and Roll Hall of Fame mu, wɔ nnipa mmiɛnsa a wɔadi kan apaw wɔn no akyi.

Abakɔsɛm 
N.W.A ahyɛnsode no

Nneɛma a Wɔhyehyɛ ne "Ehu Beae" (1987–1988) . 
N.W.A kɔnsɛt ahorow a edi kan a wɔyɛe wɔ Compton skating rink no biako ho krataa, 1988

Eazy-E a ɔwɔ Compton a ɔne Jerry Heller boom hyehyɛɛ Ruthless Records no na ɔboaboaa N.W.A ano. Eazy-E hwehwɛɛ Steve Yano nnianim asɛm. Ɛwom sɛ mfiase no Yano pow no de, nanso n’ani gyee Eazy-E nsiyɛ no ho, na ɔyɛɛ nhyehyɛe sɛ ɔne Oduruyɛfo Dre bɛyɛ nhyiam.[11] Mfiase no, na N.W.A yɛ Eazy-E ne Oduruyɛfo Dre. Wɔde Ice Cube ne ne yɔnko producer Arabian Prince kaa roster no ho bere a ofii ase sɛ rapfo maa kuw C.I.A.[12] Akyiri yi Dre de DJ Yella nso baa hyɛn no mu.[13]

Kan no na Dre ne Yella nyinaa yɛ World Class Wreckin’ Cru no mufo sɛ DJfo ne wɔn a wɔyɛ sini. Ruthless yii dwom "Panic Zone" adi wɔ afe 1987 mu ne Macola Records, a akyiri yi wɔde kaa nnwom a wɔaboaboa ano N.W.A. ne Possefo no. Na N.W.A da so ara wɔ ne nkɔsoɔ fã, na wɔde ho anuonyam ma no wɔ nnwom du-baako no mu mmiɛnsa pɛ, titire no, kyerɛwtohɔ a ɛnyɛ ne su "Panic Zone", "8-Ball", ne "Dopeman", a ɛhyɛɛ Arabian Prince, DJ Yella, Dr. Dre, ne Ice Cube adwumayɛkuo a ɛdi kan agyiraeɛ. Mexiconi rapfo Krazy-Dee boom kyerɛw "Panic Zone", a mfiase no na wɔfrɛ no "Hispanic Zone", nanso akyiri yi wɔsesaa asɛmti no bere a Oduruyɛfo Dre tuu Krazy-Dee fo sɛ asɛmfua "hispanic" besiw adetɔn kwan.[14] Nea ɛka ho nso ne Eazy-E solo dwom "Boyz-n-the-Hood".[15]

Ɔde ne nsa kyerɛɛ ne so, na ɔde ne nsa kyerɛɛ ne so bio.

N.W.A boom yɛɛ Public Enemy 1988 "Bring the Noise" kɔnsɛt akwantuo no asɛmti 
N.W.A yii wɔn studio album a edi kan, Straight Outta Compton, adi wɔ 1988. Bere a kuw no de nnwom abiɛsa a agye din a wɔde buee ano no daa nkurow akɛse mu mmerante ne mmabaa abufuw a ɛrekɔ soro no adi. Dwom a wɔde buee ano "Straight Outta Compton" na ɛde kuw no bae, "Fuck tha Police" kasa tiaa polisifo atirimɔdensɛm ne mmusuakuw mu nyiyim, na "Gangsta Gangsta" yɛɛ wiase adwene a kurow no mu mmerante ne mmabaa wɔ no ho mfonini. Bere a akyiri yi wɔde kuw no ho anuonyam mae sɛ wɔyɛɛ akwampaefo wɔ gangsta rap subgenre a ɛrenya nkɔso no mu no, N.W.A kaa wɔn nnwom ho asɛm sɛ "reality rap".[16]

Mfeɛ aduonu nson akyi no, Straight Outta Compton sini no muni ne ne mfɛfoɔ a ɔyɛɛ no, Ice Cube, kaa sɛ "na wɔreka deɛ ɛde aba ankasa wɔ ɔkwan a yɛfaa so yɛɛ no mu, a seesei wɔfrɛ no hardcore gangster rap. D.O.C., Ice Cube, ne MC Ren na wɔkyerɛw kuw no nsɛm dodow no ara, a "Fuck tha Police" ka ho, ebia kuw no dwom a agye dimmɔne sen biara, a ɛmaa wɔne mmarahyɛ bagua ahorow nyaa ntawntawdi. Wɔ nhyɛso a efi Focus on the Family hɔ ase no,[18] Milt Ahlerich, FBI kwankyerɛfo boafo de krataa kɔmaa Ruthless ne n’adwumakuw a ɛkyekyɛ nneɛma a wɔfrɛ no Priority Records, de tuu rapfo no fo sɛ "basabasayɛ ne ntua a wɔkamfo kyerɛ no yɛ mfomso na yɛn a yɛwɔ mmarahyɛ baguafo kuw no mu no yɛ nea ɛyɛ soronko wɔ adeyɛ a ɛte saa ho." Woda so ara tumi hu saa krataa yi wɔ Rock and Roll Hall of Fame a ɛwɔ Cleveland, Ohio.[19] Polisifo ampene so sɛ wɔbɛma kuw no kɔnsɛt ahorow no ahobammɔ, na ɛmaa wɔn nhyehyɛe a wɔyɛe sɛ wɔbɛkɔ akɔkyinkyin no yɛɛ wɔn yaw. Ne nyinaa mu no, nea FBI krataa no maa kuw no bɔɔ amanneɛ kɛse ara kwa.

Straight Outta Compton nso yɛ album ahorow a edi kan a wɔdii Parental Advisory label nhyehyɛe foforo no so no mu biako, saa bere no na ɛda so ara wɔ ne mfiase: label no saa bere no yɛ "KƆBƆ: Moderate impact coarse language and/or themes" nkutoo. Nanso, sɛnea N.W.A nnwom no yɛ taboo no ne ade titiriw a ɛmaa nnipa pii ani gyee ho. Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a wɔkaa ho asɛm no tuaa kuw no mframa a wɔmfa nni dwuma no so ka, na awiei koraa no ne nnwom nhoma no kɔɔ platinum mmɔho abien.[20] Ɔsram biako wɔ Straight Outta Compton akyi no, woyii Eazy-E solo debut Eazy-Duz-It adi. Na Eazy persona na ɛdi album no so (MC Ren nko ara ne rapfoɔ a ɔyɛ ahɔhoɔ) nanso wɔ akyi no na ɛyɛ kuw mmɔdenbɔ.

Oduruyɛfo Dre ne DJ Yella na wodii nnwom ho dwuma; nnwom no mu nsɛm no fã kɛse no ara yɛ nea M. C. Ren na ɔkyerɛwee, na Ice Cube ne The D.O.C. Album no yɛ platinum nkonimdi foforo a ɛyɛ mmɔho abien maa Ruthless[21] (de ka mmeawa kuw J.J. Fad ho wɔ 1988 ne odwontofo Michel'le wɔ 1989 mu). Afe 1989 mu no, wɔsan yii N.W.A ne Posse ne Straight Outta Compton wɔ CD so, na woyii The D.O.C. nnwom a wɔfrɛ no No One Can Do It Better adi. Na ne album no titiriw yɛ adwuma a ɔne Dr. Dre yɛe na titiriw no na "gangsta rap" nsɛm nni mu, a N.W.A posse cut "The Grand Finalé" ka ho. Ɛbɛyɛɛ album foforo #1 maa record label no.

Akwansin 100 Ne Mmirikatu’ ne Niggaz4Asetra (1989–1991) . 
Ice Cube gyaee kuw no wɔ December 1989 mu esiane ahemfo ntawntawdi nti;[6] esiane sɛ ɛkame ayɛ sɛ ɔkyerɛw nnwom no mu fã wɔ Straight Outta Compton ankasa so nti, ɔtee nka sɛ onnya mfaso no mu kyɛfa a ɛfata.[22] Wɔsiesiee asɛm bi a Ice Cube de kɔdan nnwontofo kuw panyin Jerry Heller wɔ asɛnnibea akyi.[23] Ɔsɛee bere pii de boaboaa ne solo debut a edi kan, 1990 mfe no mu AmeriKKKa’s Most Wanted ano, nanso ɔkwatii sɛ ɔbɛka ne kan label mfɛfo ho asɛm. N.W.A asɛmti dwom a efi wɔn 1990 EP 100 Miles ne Runnin', nanso, na diss bi a ɛkɔ Cube ka ho: "Yɛde anum na efii ase, nanso yo / Obiako antumi annye—Enti afei ɛyɛ anan / Cuz nea ɔto so anum no antumi annye." Video a wɔde yɛɛ dwom no kyerɛɛ N.W.A mufo a wɔaka no sɛ wɔabom wɔ afiase dan bi mu, bere a woyi obi a ɔte sɛ Ice Cube adi no.

Afei nso wɔtee wɔ EP (a enyaa ne kwan wɔ Efil4zaggin album no mu) ne "Real Niggaz", diss a ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ ma Ice Cube a emufo a wɔaka no bɔ no sobo sɛ ɔyɛ ohufo, na wogye ne nokware, nkwa tenten ne ne mfitiasesɛm ho kyim: "How the fuck you think a rapper lasts / With your ass sayin' shit that was said in the past / Yo, be original, your shit is sloppy / Get off the dick, you motherfuckin' carbon-copy", ne "Yɛde nneɛma pii na efii ase / Enti m'ani agye sɛ yeyii Benedict Arnold fii hɔ, yo."

Dwom "100 Miles and Runnin'" yɛ Dr. Dre uptempo recording a etwa to, a na ɛyɛ ade a ɛtaa ba wɔ 1980 mfe no awiei hip hop mu. Eyi akyi no, ɔde n'adwene sii midtempo, synthesizer based sound a wɔbɛfrɛɛ no G-funk, a efii ase wɔ "Alwayz Into Somethin'" a efi Efil4zaggin mu wɔ 1991. G-funk kwan no dii West ne East Coast hip hop nnwom nyinaa so mfe pii a ɛreba no.

Wɔka N.W.A ho asɛm wɔ Ice Cube 1990 EP, Kill at Will, faako a ɔbɔ ne kan kuw no din (ɛbɛyɛ sɛ wɔ fɛwdi kwan so) wɔ dwom "Jackin' For Beats" so. Wɔ "I Gotta Say What Up!!!" so no, Ice Cube de nteɛteɛm ma n'atipɛnfo a wɔyɛ rap saa bere no, a wɔn mu bi ne Public Enemy, Geto Boys, ne Sir Jinx. Wɔ dwom no awiei, wɔ nea ɛte sɛ nea ɛyɛ telefon so nsɛmbisa mu no, wobisa Ice Cube sɛ, "Esiane sɛ wokɔɔ solo no, dɛn na ɛrekɔ so wɔ adwumayɛfo a aka no ho?" na wɔde telefon no sɛn nea ɔrebisabisa no nsɛm no so mpofirim.

Kuw no nnwom a ɛto so abien a ɛyɛ ne nyinaa a woyii no adi, 1991 Efil4zaggin ("Niggaz4Life" a wɔkyerɛw no akyi), san de nnwontofo kuw no sii hɔ wɔ Ice Cube a ɛkɔɔ so dii nkonim a ɔno nkutoo dii no anim. Oduruyɛfo Dre adwuma a eye sen biara a ɔyɛe wɔ album no ho, na ɛbɔɔ G-Funk bere no mfiase ho dawuru. Ɛsan nso kyerɛɛ nitan a ɛda adi pefee wɔ wɔn kan kuw no muni no ho, na wohu Ice Cube ho nsɛm a ɛyɛ animtiaabu wɔ nnwom pii mu. Ntamgyinafo "Nkrasɛm a wɔde kɔma B.A." echoes ne dwom "Turn Off the Radio" mfiase a efi AmeriKKKa's Most Wanted: Ice Cube di kan de edin Benedict Arnold (Amerika Ɔman Anidan no ɔfatwafo a wagye dimmɔne no din) frɛ no nanso afei wɔbɔɔ no din pefee wɔ ayayade asubɔnten a efi kuw no ne n'akyidifo nyinaa hɔ mu: "Sɛ yehu yo' afunumu a, yɛkɔ' twa yo' ti nhwi na yɛde broom fuck wo " a M. C. Ren na ɔkae.[24]

Awiei koraa no, N.W.A–Ice Cube ntawntawdi no mu yɛɛ den, wɔ kyerɛwtohɔ ne asetra ankasa mu nyinaa. Na AmeriKKKa’s Most Wanted akwati ntua a wɔde bɛba N.W.A so tẽẽ, nanso wɔ Death Certificate, Ice Cube a ɛto so abien a woyii no adi a ɛyɛ ne nyinaa adi no so no, ɔde tuaa so ka. Ɔde nhwɛso na odii "Message to B.A." skit ansa na woafi ase ayɛ tirade a ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ, "No Vaseline" a agye dimmɔne no. Wɔ nkyekyem ahorow a ɛtoatoa so mu no, Ice Cube de n'ano too kuw no so sɛ: "Wo te sɛ bozos a wɔyɛ tẽẽ / mihuu no sɛ ɛreba ɛno nti na mekɔɔ solo / Kept on stompin' / When y'all Muthafuckas moved Straight outta Compton / Wo nyaa ahoɔyaw bere a menyaa m'ankasa adwumakuw no / Nanso meyɛ ɔbarima, na ɛnyɛ obiara humpin' me."[24]

N.W.A yɛ nnwontofo kuw a wodii kan maa american jacket (vestes de type américaines) ahorow gyee din no mu biako

Ɔsan nso buaa asɔremma MC Ren, Dr. Dre, ne Eazy-E ankorankoro wɔ "100 Miles and Runnin'", a ɔkae sɛ "Mede nneɛma pii na efii ase / Dropped four niggaz and now I'm makin' all the dough", de homophobic kasakoa dii dwuma de kyerɛkyerɛɛ wɔn adwumayɛ mu abusuabɔ a ɛnyɛ pɛ ne Jerry Heller, a ɔbɛyɛɛ nea wɔde animtiaabu a emu yɛ den no botae no mu: "Get rid of that devil real simple / Put a bullet wɔ n'asɔredan mu / Cuz wo ntumi nyɛ 'Niggaz 4 Life' crew / With a white Jew telin' you what to do." Dwom no twee akyinnyegye wɔ ne antisemitism (sobo a ɛte saa a wɔbɔɔ Ice Cube bere a na ɔne Nkramofo Man no bɔe no mfiase), a egyina Heller som a wɔkasa tiaa no so.[24]

Woyii dwom no fii UK a woyii no adi no mu, na akyiri yi nea wɔde miaa dwom no bi ne dwom no fã bi a wɔahwɛ so. Wɔ September 1990 mu no, hip hop nnwontofo kuw Above the Law no mufo ne Ice Cube ne ne posse Da Lench Mob dii asi wɔ afe afe New Music Seminar nhyiam no ase, na ɛhyɛɛ wɔn a wotwa to no ma woguan fii Times Square Marriott Marquis, beae a wɔyɛɛ dwumadi no. Wɔ January 27, 1991 no, Oduruyɛfo Dre tow hyɛɛ Dee Barnes a ɔyɛ hip hop dwumadi Pump It Up no kwankyerɛfo so bere a ɔkaa N.W.A/Ice Cube nantwinam ho asɛm[26] akyi. Sɛnea Rolling Stone amanneɛbɔfo Alan Light kyerɛ no:

Ɔfaa no na "ofii ase bɔɔ n'anim ne ne nipadua nifa so mpɛn pii wɔ ɔfasu bi a ɛbɛn antweri no so" bere a ne nipadua wɛmfo no siw nnipadɔm no kwan no. Bere a Dre bɔɔ mmɔden sɛ ɔbɛtow no agu antweri no so na wantumi no, ofii ase bɔɔ no mpampam ne ne nsa. Oguan tuu mmirika kɔɔ mmea ahomegye dan no mu. Dre dii n'akyi na "ɔkyeree no fii n'akyi wɔ ne ti nhwi mu na ɔtoaa so bɔɔ no wɔ ne ti akyi."[27]

Wɔ mmuaema mu no, Dre kaa sɛ: "Nkurɔfo ka saa shit yi nyinaa, nanso wunim, sɛ obi ne me bɔ fuck a, me ne wɔn bɛbɔ fuck. Meyɛɛ no ara kwa, wunim. Ain't nothing you can do now by talking about it. Besides, it ain't no big thing —I just threw her through a door."[27]

N.W.A (1991–1995) awiei . 
Eazy-E (a ne mfonini wɔ 1993 mu) ne kan kuw no mufo afoforo no dii akasakasa kosii sɛ owui wɔ 1995 mu.

1991 Niggaz4Life yɛ kuw no album a etwa to. Oduruyɛfo Dre akyi no, The D.O.C. na Michel'le fii Ruthless kɔkaa Death Row Records ho na sobo ahorow a wɔbɔe wɔ Eazy-E a wɔhyɛɛ wɔn ma wɔde wɔn nsa hyɛɛ wɔn apam ase (bere a nanso wɔkoraa wɔn hokwan a wɔwɔ sɛ wotintim nhoma no fã bi so) ho no, akansi a emu yɛ den bae. Dr. Dre fii asesesa no ase wɔ afe 1992 mu denam Death Row a edi kan a woyii no adi, "Fuck Wit Dre Day (And Everybody's Celebratin')", na ne video a ɛka ho no daa nipa bi a wɔfrɛ no "Sleazy-E" (a odiyifo A.J. Johnson dii n'ade) a otuu mmirika dii akɔneaba denneennen sɛ obenya sika adi. Animtiaabu no toaa so wɔ The Chronic so de "Bitches Ain't Shit". Eazy-E buae wɔ afe 1993 mu de EP It's On (Dr. Dre) 187um Killa wɔ nnwom "Real Muthaphuckkin G's" ne "It's On" mu.

Eazy-E bɔɔ Dr. Dre sobo sɛ ɔyɛ ɔbarima a ɔne ɔbarima da, ɔfrɛɛ no "she thang", na ɔkasa tiaa Dre mfonini foforo no denam ɔne Snoop a ɔfrɛɛ no "studio gangsters" no so. Nnwom video a wɔde yɛɛ "Real Muthaphuckkin G's" no kyerɛɛ Dre a ɔhyɛ make-up ne jumpsuit a wɔde sequined ayɛ. Mfonini ahorow no fi Oduruyɛfo Dre World Class Wreckin’ Cru nna no mu, bere a na ntadehyɛ a ɛte saa abu so wɔ West Coast electro hop nnwontofo mu, ansa na N.W.A rema gangsta rap agye din no. Eazy-E kɔɔ so dissing Dre ne Death Row wɔ ne nnwom dodow no ara mu kosii sɛ owui wɔ AIDS ho wɔ March 26, 1995.

Eazy-E adamfo a ɔne no atena akyɛ MC Ren mpo kaa sɛ ɔmpɛ Eazy-E wɔ afe 1994 mu, frɛɛ Eazy-E sɛ "ti kɛse" ne "wannabe mega-star", na mpo ɔhyɛɛ nyansa sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ N.W.A san ka bom a Eazy-E nka ho. Akyiri yi MC Ren kae sɛ abusuabɔ biako pɛ a ɔne Eazy-E wɔ ne Ruthless Records, faako a oyii EP a wɔtɔn platinum Kizz My Black Azz (1992) ne album Shock of the Hour (1993) adi. Eazy-E ne MC Ren de wɔn ntawntawdi no baa awiei bere tiaa bi ansa na kan no rewu wɔ wɔn 1995 duet '"Tha Muthaphukkin' Real" mu wɔ mfe abien a wɔne wɔn ho wɔn ho nkasae akyi. Awiei koraa no, mogya bɔne nyinaa gyaee wɔ kuw no mufo a aka no mu. Akyiri yi Dr. Dre, MC Ren ne Ice Cube daa wɔn nkate a wɔasan asusuw ho adi kyerɛɛ wɔn adamfo dedaw no wɔ 1998 "Ruthless for Life", 1999 "What's the Difference" ne "Chin Check", 2000 "Hello", 2006 "Growin' Up", ne 2011 nnwom video "I Need a Doctor" mu.

Reunions (1995–mprempren) . 
Esiane sɛ wɔn baanu nyinaa ne Ruthless Records tetew mu wɔ nsɛm bɔne mu nti, awiei koraa no, Ice Cube ne Oduruyɛfo Dre ntam ntawntawdi no brɛɛ ase wɔ wɔn ankasa mu. Bere a Ice Cube yɛɛ cameo wɔ Dr. Dre "Let Me Ride" video mu wɔ 1993 mu akyi no, wɔn baanu no kyere dwom a agye din "Natural Born Killaz" maa Snoop Dogg 1994 sini tiawa ne nnyigyei Murder Was the Case. Ice Cube nso akyiri yi puei wɔ MC Ren album Ruthless for Life mu wɔ dwom "Comin' After You" mu. MC Ren puei wɔ Dre 1999 album 2001 mu, na N.W.A emcees baasa a wɔaka no san boom maa "Hello" wɔ Ice Cube 2000 album War & Peace Vol. 2 (The Peace Disc), ne dwom "Chin Check" wɔ afe 1999 mu maa Next Friday nnyigyei, sini a Ice Cube dii mu akoten.[2]

Nanso na West Coast ne "gangsta" nnwom no ahwe ase afi anim fi bere a Tupac Shakur wui wɔ 1996 mu, na ɛyɛ bere a Oduruyɛfo Dre dii nkonim wɔ Eminem ne Dre nnwom nhoma a ɛsan bae wɔ 2001 mu no akyi nkutoo na saa nnwom no ne n'adwumfo san nyaa ɔman no anim. 2000 mu nsoromma nyinaa Up In Smoke Tour san kaa N.W.A ne Death Row mmusua no mu dodow no ara boom, na bere a wɔde traa kwan so no, Dre, Ice Cube, MC Ren, de ɔhɔho titiriw Snoop Dogg[29][3][4][30] ne Eminem fii ase kyeree nnwom wɔ mobile studio. Wɔyɛɛ nhyehyɛɛ sɛ wɔbɛsan aba album a wɔato din Not These Niggaz Again[31] (na DJ Yella a na onni hɔ wɔ akwantuo no mu ka ho).

Nanso, esiane nhyehyɛe a adagyew nnim na ɛbɔ abira ne akwanside ahorow a ɛwɔ sɛ wɔbɛhyehyɛ nnwom ahorow abiɛsa (Priority, No Limit ne Interscope), hokwan ahorow a wobenya wɔ edin N.W.A no so na wɔapene adwuma no nyinaa so de anya hokwan ahorow a ɛyɛ soronko nti, album no amma mu da. Nnwom mmienu pɛ na wɔyii saa nhyiamu ahodoɔ yi adi: "Chin Check" a yɛadi kan aka ho asɛm (a Snoop Dogg yɛ N.W.A muni) a ɛfiri 2000 Next Friday soundtrack mu ne "Hello" a ɛfiri Ice Cube 2000 album War & Peace Vol. 2 (Asomdwoe Disk no). Nnwom abien no nyinaa nso puei wɔ N.W.A nnwom a wɔasan ayɛ no Greatest Hits mu. Wɔsan nso yɛɛ nhyiamu fã bi wɔ nnwuma foforɔ mu, titire "Set It Off", a ɛfiri Snoop Dogg Tha Last Meal (2000), a na MC Ren ne Ice Cube na ɛwɔ mu, ne The D.O.C. "The Shit", a ɛfiri ne 2003 album Deuce, a MC Ren, Ice Cube, Snoop Dogg ne Six-Two ka ho. Ná Oduruyɛfo Dre ne DJ Yella wɔ studio hɔ maa dwom a etwa to no.

Wɔ Greatest Hits a Priority yii no adi mfiase no wɔ 1996 mu akyi no, Capitol ne Ruthless Records boom yii The N.W.A Legacy, Vol. 1: 1988–1998 wɔ 1999 mu, nnwom a wɔaboaboa ano a na nnwom a rap nnwontofo afoforo yɛe ne nnwom abiɛsa pɛ a efi kuw ankasa no mu nanso nnwom ahorow a wɔn nkutoo na wɔwom a efi emufo baanum no hɔ. Sɛnea album no dii yiye no kanyan nhoma a ɛto so abien, The N.W.A Legacy, Vol. 2, mfe abiɛsa akyi. Ɛsuasua sɛnea na nnwom a edii n’anim no yɛe no, na na N.W.A nnwom ankasa abiɛsa pɛ ne mmɔdenbɔ pii a adwumayɛfo no nkutoo bɔe. Wɔ afe 2007 mu no, woyii nnwom foforo a ɛyɛ dɛ sen biara adi, a wɔtoo din The Best of N.W.A: The Strength of Street Knowledge.

Wɔ afe 2014 mu no, Ice Cube puei wɔ MC Ren remix a ɔyɛ maa "Rebel Music" no mu. Eyi ne bere a edi kan a saa nnipa baanu yi boom yɛɛ adwuma fi bere a wɔsan hyiaa N.W.A wɔ afe 2000 mu no.[33]

Wɔ June 27, 2015 no, MC Ren ne DJ Yella bɛkaa Ice Cube ho wɔ ne solo set mu sɛ BET Experience show no fã wɔ Staples Center wɔ Los Angeles, California. Eyi ne kuw no dwumadi a edi kan a wɔasan ahyiam (a wɔayi Oduruyɛfo Dre afi mu) wɔ mfe 15 mu. Mfeɛ aduonu nson a wɔde gyaeeɛ no akyi no, kuw no san ne emufoɔ a wɔda so te aseɛ no boom ne Ice Cube, MC Ren, Dr. Dre ne DJ Yella a wɔkɔɔ asɛnka agua so wɔ dapɛn awieeɛ a ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ Coachella Valley Nnwom ne Adwinni Afahyɛ no mu wɔ April 2016 mu, nna kakraa bi akyi wɔ kuw no Rock N’ Roll Hall of Fame a wɔde wɔn hyɛɛ mu no akyi.

title: Nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia ho banbɔ (Environmental protection)
text:
Nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia ho banbɔ yɛ adeyɛ a ankorankoro, akuw ne aban ahorow yɛ de bɔ abɔde mu nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia ho ban. Ne botae ahorow ne sɛ ɛbɛkora abɔde mu nneɛma ne abɔde mu nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia a ɛwɔ hɔ dedaw no so na baabi a ɛbɛyɛ yiye no, asiesie nneɛma a asɛe na wɔadan nneɛma a ɛrekɔ so no.

Esiane nhyɛso a ɛwɔ nneɛma a wɔde di dwuma boro so, nnipa dodow a ɛredɔɔso ne mfiridwuma mu nti, nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia a ɛwɔ abɔde mu no resɛe, ɛtɔ mmere bi a, ma asɛe no, woyɛ no hwee a ɛrenyɛ yie. Wɔahu eyi, na nniso ahorow afi ase de anohyeto ahorow reto dwumadi ahorow a ɛde nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia sɛe ba no so. Efi 1960 mfe no mu reba no, nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia ho akuw ama nkurɔfo ahu nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia ho haw ahorow pii. Wɔn mu pii adwene nhyia wɔ baabia a nnipa dwumadi aka nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia no ho akosi, enti ɛtɔ mmere bi a wogye ahobammɔ ho akyinnye.

Akwan a wɔfa so bɔ nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia ho ban

Nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia ho apam ahorow a wofi wɔn pɛ mu yɛ 
Wɔ aman a wɔyɛ mfiridwuma mu no, nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia ho apam ahorow a wofi wɔn pɛ mu yɛ no taa ma wonya kwan ma wogye nnwumakuw tom sɛ wɔakɔ akyiri asen mmara a ɛba fam koraa no na wɔnam saayɛ so aboa nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia ho nneyɛe a eye sen biara a wɔbɛyɛ. Sɛ nhwɛso no, wɔ India no, Nneɛma a Atwa Yɛn Ho Ahyia Nkɔso Ahotoso (Environment Improvement Trust (EIT)) ayɛ adwuma de abɔ nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia ne kwae ho ban fi afe 1998. Wɔ aman a afei na wɔrenya nkɔso te sɛ Latin Amerika mu no, wɔtaa de saa apam ahorow yi di dwuma de siesie mmara a wɔhyɛ sɛ wɔmfa nni dwuma kɛse no.

Abɔdeɛ a nkwa wom ho nhyehyɛeɛ kwan a wɔfa so yɛ adwuma 
Abɔdeɛ a nkwa wom ho nhyehyɛeɛ kwan a wɔfa so di nneɛma ho dwuma ne nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia ho banbɔ botaeɛ ne sɛ wɔbɛsusu abusuabɔ a ɛyɛ den a ɛda abɔdeɛ a nkwa wom nyinaa ntam wɔ gyinaesie mu sene sɛ wɔbɛdi nsɛm ne nsɛnnennen pɔtee bi ho dwuma kɛkɛ. Sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ yiye no, gyinaesi nhyehyɛe ahorow a ɛwɔ ɔkwan a ɛte saa ase no bɛyɛ ɔkwan a wɔfa so yɛ nhyehyɛe ne gyinaesi a wɔbom yɛ a ɛfa nnipa ahorow pii a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ mu wɔ aban dwumadibea ahorow a ɛfa ho nyinaa mu, ne nnwuma ananmusifo, nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia akuw, ne mpɔtam hɔfo nso. Saa kwan yi boa ma wɔsesa nsɛm yie, hu akwan a wɔbɛfa so asiesie ntawntawdi ne ɔmantam no mu nneɛma a wɔkora so a wɔbɛma atu mpɔn. Nyamesom ahorow nso di dwuma titiriw wɔ nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia a wɔbɛkora so no mu.

Amanaman ntam nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia ho apam ahorow 

Asase so nneɛma pii yɛ nea ɛyɛ mmerɛw efisɛ nnipa nkɛntɛnso wɔ aman ahorow so nya so nkɛntɛnso. Esiane eyi nti, aman bɔ mmɔden pii sɛ wɔbɛyɛ apam ahorow a aban ahorow pii de wɔn nsa ahyɛ ase de asiw ɔsɛe ano anaasɛ wɔadi nkɛntɛnso a nnipa dwumadi nya wɔ abɔde mu nneɛma so no ho dwuma.
