title: Kwaku Agyenim-Boateng
text:
kwaku  Boateng (Wɔwoo no Obubuo, afe Apem, Ahankron ne aduonu nsia) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni  wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson wɔ kwasafoman/ Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nan no mu.

Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ Ne Nwomasua 
Awofoɔ a wɔwoo kwaku Boateng ne Ɔpanin Acheampong ne Maame Anima Acheampong a wɔfiri Old Tafo wɔ Akyem Abuakwa, Gold Coast. Ɔhyɛɛ sukuu ase  wɔ Old Tafo Mfitiaseɛ  Sukuu ( Old Tafo Primary School) na ɔtoaa so wɔ Bɛgorɔ Ntoasoɔ Sukuu ( Begoro Senior School) wɔ ne mfimfini sukuu adesua no mu. Ɔkɔɔ Mfantsipim Sukuu, a ɛwɔ Oguaa , (Cape Coast), wɔ afe Apem, Ahankron ne Aduanan Baako (1941) mu na ɔtenaa hɔ kɔsii afe Apem, Ahankron ne Aduanan Nnan (1944), bere a ɔdane kɔɔ Baasere Ntoasoɔ Sukuu ( Presbyterian Senior High School ) a ɛwɔ Odumase Krɔbɔ na ɛhɔ na onyaa ne Cambridge Sukuu Abɔdin  krataa no. Boateng kɔɔ Fourah Bay College, Freetown, Sierra Leone, wɔ afe apem, Ahankron ne Aduanan nwɔtwe (1948) mu nanso ofii hɔ wɔ afe Apem Ahankron ne Aduanan Nkron (1949) mu na ɔde ne din kɔhyɛɛ King’s College London Sukuupɔn mu. Owiee sukuu wɔ afe Apem Ahankron ne Aduonum Nnan (1954) mu, nyaa ne Bachelor of Laws Abɔdin krataa, na wɔfrɛɛ no ​​kɔɔ Engiresi Baa a ɛwɔ Gray’s Inn wɔ afe Apem Ahankron ne Aduonum-nson (1955). Wɔfrɛɛ no ​​kɔɔ Ghana Bar akyire yi wɔ saa afe no mu na akyire yi ɔkɔɔ La Chambers sɛ oduruyɛfoɔ kumaa.

Boateng hyɛɛ n’ankasa mmara adwuma ase wɔ afe Apem Ahankron ne Aduonum-nsia (1956) mu na ɔkɔɔ so yɛɛ kokoam adwuma kosii Ɔpɛnimaa saa afe no mu, bere a wɔpaw no sɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni maa Tafo mantam no.

Ammanyɔsɛm 
kwaku Boateng yɛ Convention People’s Party -CPPno muni na ɔsom wɔ dibea ahodoɔ  mu wɔ Nkrumah aban mu. Na ɔyɛ Amanneɛbɔ Soafo na, wɔ afe 1961 mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ Ɔman no mu Ɔsoafo.Ɔyɛ Nhomasua Soafoɔ wɔ Kwame Nkrumah ase firi Ayɛwohomumɔ bosome no mu wɔ afe 1964.

Nnɔmmumfa 

Wɔ Ɔgyefuo bosome no da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nan (24),  Afe Apem Ahankron ne Aduosia Nsia (1966) atuateɛ a Ɔman Ahofadi Badwa (National Liberation Party ) no yɛeɛ akyi no, Boateng ne aban no mufo afoforo kɔɔ nnommumfa mu. Ɔne n’abusua kɔɔ United Kingdom.

Dwumadie Nkaeɛ 
Bere a na ɔyɛ Nhomasua Soafo no,  Boateng buee Bible Fie, Bible Fekuo a ɛwɔ Ghana no adwumayɛbea ti wɔ Kwame Nkrumah ananmu wɔ afe Apem Ahankron ne Aduosia Num (1965).  Ɔyɛ Bible Fekuw no sohwɛfoɔ kosii ne wuo mu.[9] Ɛrekɔ n’amammui adwuma no awiei no, Boateng bɛyɛɛ ɔsɛmpakafo.

Abusuabɔ 

Paul Boateng, Nglesi Abrokyiman mu amanyɔni  a na ɔyɛ Brent South Mmarahyɛbadwani no firi afe Apem Ahankron ne Aduɔwɔtwe Nson 1987 kɔsi mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Num 2005 no yɛ ne ba. Kwaku Boateng yere ne Awuraa Eleanor Boateng a na ɔyɛ Scotlandni. Ne nuanom ne Andrew Boateng, a ofiri New York, ne Francis Boateng, Los Angeles Polisifoɔ Dwumadibea (a ɔwɔ Adwadie mu Nsɛmmɔnedie Dwumadibea) no so panyin. Wɔ Afe Apem Ahankron ne Aduonum (1950) mfitiaseɛ mu no, Kwaku Boateng ne ababaa bi nyaa ayɔnkofa, na ɔwoo ɔbabarima, Isaac Boateng maa no. Kwaku Boateng ne J. B. Danquah nam awareɛ so yɛɛ abusuafoɔ.

Ne Wuo 
Kwaku Boateng wuu wɔ Ɔbnem 2, Mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Nsia a na wadi mfeɛ Aduowɔtwe wɔ ne ba Paul fie a ɛwɔ Cape Town, South Africa no .

Wɔ

woo no maa Opanin Acheampong ne Madam Anima Acheampong a wɔfiri Old Tafo wɔ Akyem Abuakwa, Gold Coast. Ɔhyɛɛ aseɛ suaa sukuu wɔ Old Tafo Primary School na ɔtoaa so wɔ Begoro Senior School maa ne mfimfini sukuu adesua. Ɔkɔɔ Mfantsipim Sukuu, Cape Coast, wɔ afe 1941 mu na ɔtraa hɔ kosii afe 1944, bere a ɔdan kɔɔ Presbyterian Ntoaso Sukuu a ɛwɔ Odumase Krobo na ɛhɔ na onyaa ne Cambridge Sukuu Adansedi krataa no. Boateng kɔɔ Fourah Bay College, Freetown, Sierra Leone, wɔ afe 1948 mu nanso ofii hɔ wɔ afe 1949 mu na ɔde ne din kɔhyɛɛ King’s College London Sukuupɔn mu. Owiee sukuu wɔ afe 1954 mu, nyaa ne Bachelor of Laws abodin krataa, na wɔfrɛɛ no ​​kɔɔ Engiresi Bar a ɛwɔ Gray’s Inn wɔ afe 1955. Wɔfrɛɛ no ​​kɔɔ Ghana Bar akyiri yi wɔ saa afe no mu na akyiri yi ɔkɔɔ La Chambers sɛ oduruyɛfo kumaa.

title: Alexander Asum-Ahensah
text:
Alexander Asum-Ahensah (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn 23, Afe Apem Ahankron ne Aduonum Mmeɛnsa 1953) yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɔni ne nhomasua ho nimdefoɔ. Ɔyɛ kane mmarahyɛbadwani ma Gyaam Atifi (Jaman North) Mansini a ɛwɔ Brong Ahafo Mantam mu wɔ Ghana

Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ ne Nnwoasua 
wɔwoo Asum-Ahensah wɔ Kitawonsa da a ɛtɔ so Aduonu-mmeɛnsa,afe Apem Ahankron ne Aduonum-mmeɛnsa (1953). Ne kurom ne Goka wɔ Brong Ahafo mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Wɔ afe Apem, Ahankron ne Aduɔwɔtwe -nkron (1989) mu no, ɔnyaa Diploma wɔ Nwomasua mu wɔ Accra Technical Training Centre.Wɔ afe Apem , Ahankron ne Aduɔkron-Nson (1997) mu no, owiee sukuu no na onyaa Nwomasua mu Bachelor of Education wɔ Cape Coast Sukuupɔn mu. Ɔnyaa Executive Masters wɔ Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration.

Adwumayɛ 
Asum-Ahensah yɛ nwomasua ho nimdefoɔ. Ɔne Ghana Nwomasua Dwumadibea ( Ghana Education Service)ayɛ adwuma sɛ ɔkwankyerɛfoɔ boafoɔ a Ɔhwɛ Nwomasua so wɔ ma Jaman Atifi Mantam. Berɛ a ɔhyɛn amammuisɛm mu akyi no, wɔpaw no sɛ Ɔsofoɔ a ɔhwɛ Amammerɛ ne Amanneɛ so wɔ Kyinii amanyɔkuo ( National Democratic Congress-NDC) aban a Ɔmampanyin John Atta Mills di wɔn anim no mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Asum Ahensah na wɔpaw no sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani  deɛ edi kan wɔ mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne nnan (2004) Ghana Amansan abatoɔ no mu. Wɔpaw no sɛ ongyina  Jaman North amansin no ananmu wɔ mmarahyɛbadwafie, berɛ a wɔhyehyɛɛ no ​​foforoɔ wɔ Ghana Adehyeman  a ɛtɔ so 4 no mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nan no akyi.Wɔpaw no wɔ kyiniiɛ Ammanyɔkuo ( National Democratic Congress-NDC)tekiti so. Na n'abatoɔ mpɛsoa no ka mmarahyɛbadwa nkondwa du   10  kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo (National Democratic Congress-NDC) nya firii mmarahyɛbadwa nkondwa aduonu-nan (24)  wɔ Bono Ahafo mantam no mu saa berɛ no ho. National Democratic Congress dii nkonim kɛseɛ  bi a wɔnyaa mmarahyɛ badwa nkondwa Aduɔkron-Nson (94) wɔ nkondwa Aha-mmienu ne aduasa (  230 ) a na ɛwɔ mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nan (4) a ɛwɔ kwasafomam  a ɛtɔ so 4 no mu.  Wɔde mma mpem du-mmienu ne Aduonu-mmeɛnsa (12,027) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyem aduonum-mmienu ne akyiri pɔ aduonum ( 52.50%)na ɛpaw Asum Ahensah wɔ mma mpem aduonu -mmienu, ahanwɔtwe ne nwɔtwe a wɔtoeɛ no mu. Ɔdii Kofi Oti Adinkrah a ofiri ɔsono kokroko ammanyɔkuo ( New Patriotic Party-NPP) no so nkunim. Afei , Twene Aduasare Kwasi a ofiri Convention People’s Party ne M. Abdulai Freeman a ofiri Democratic People’s Party mu no nyinaa, ɔdii wɔn so nkonim. Yeinom nyaa mma a wɔnyaeɛ no nyinaa ne Ɔha nkyekyem aduana-num ne akyiri pɔ aduonum, (45.50%), ɔha nkyekyem baako ne akyiri pɔ aduɔkron(1.90%) ne  ɔha nkyekyem hwee (0.00%) pɛpɛɛpɛ.

Wɔsan paw Asum-Ahensah sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ Gyaaman Atifi (Jaman North) mantam no mu wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa  a ɛtɔ so num (  5 ) Ghana Adehyeman  a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu. Wɔpaw no wɔ kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo (National Democratic Congress-NDC ) tekiti so. wɔde mma mpem Du-mmeɛnsa Aha-mmeɛnsa ne aduonum nkron (13,359) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyem aduonum -num ne akyiri pɔ aduonu nwɔtwe (55.28%) na ɛpaw no, wɔ mma  mpem aduonu-nan, ɔha ne aduasa nsia (24,166)  a wɔteɛ no. Ɔdii Siaka Stevens a ofiri ɔsono kokroko ammanyɔkuo ( New Patriotic Party-NPP)no mu no so nkonim ; Afei nso Otteng Atta Dickson a ofiri Convention People's  Party no mu ne Nyuah Abraham a ɔfiri ( People's National Congress-). Yeinom nyinaa nyaa mma no mu ɔha nkyekyem Aduanan-Mmienu(42.94%), ɔha nkyekyem baako ne akyiri pɔ nan(1.04%) ne ɔha nkyekyem hwee ne akyiri pɔ aduɔson-nan (0.74%)

N'ankasa Abrabɔ 
Asum-Ahensa aware awo mmamu nsia . Ɔyɛ kristoni a ɔsom wɔ Pɛntikɔso Asafo no mu.

Baabi a menyaa mmoa friiɛ 

Ateasefoɔ
Mmarahyɛbadwani

title: Abdul-Rashid Hassan Pelpuo
text:
Abdul-Rashid Hassan Pelpuo yɛ Ghana amanyɔni. Ɔyɛ mprempren mmarahyɛbadwani ma Wa Central mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Upper West Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

Abrabɔ Ahyɛase ne nnwomasua 
Wɔwoo no wɔ Kontonimaa bosome da a ɛtɔ so num(5) wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduosia nan(1964) na ɔfiri Wa a ɛwɔ Upper West mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔnyaa ne Middle School Leaving Certificate wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduoson nsia (1976) mu. Ɔsan nso nyaa ne O level nwomasua wɔ afe 1983 mu ne ne A level nwomasua wɔ afe 1986. Ɔsan nso wɔ Diploma wɔ Sikasɛm mu wɔ afe 1994 mu na ɔkɔɔ so nyaa Degree wɔ Adwene ne Nkateɛ mu wɔ afe 1994. Ɔsan nso wɔ master’s degree wɔ Amanaman Ntam Nsɛm mu wɔ afe 1998. Ɔnyaa PhD wɔ Nkɔsoɔ Nhyehyɛeɛ mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn, Afrika Adesua mu wɔ afe 2013.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ɔkɔɔ Ghana Mmarahyɛbadwam no mu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne num(2005) mu bere a odii nkonim wɔ kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo( National Democratic Congress) tekiti so wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwam abatoɔ mu wɔ Ɔpɛnimma bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan(2004) mu no.

Pelpuo yɛɛ Ɔsoafoɔ wɔ Ɔmanpanyin adwumayɛbea berɛ a Ɔmanpanin John Atta Mills paw no sɛ Mmabun ne Agordie soafoɔ wɔ Ɛbɔ bosome wɔ 2009 mu wɔ Muntaka Mohammed Mubarak a ɔno nso yɛ Asawase MP no gyaee adwuma no akyi. Ɔsomm wɔ saa dibea yi mu kɔsii berɛ a wɔyɛɛ nsakraeɛ wɔ kabinet mu wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2010 mu. Wɔde Ghana ɔbea a odi kan a ɔhwɛ Agumadi so, Akua Dansua, sii n’ananmu na wɔpaw no sɛ Dodow no Kannifo abadiakyiri wɔ Mmarahyɛbadwam no mu mmom. Wɔsan nso too aba sɛ Ghanafoɔ baanum a wɔwɔ Afrika Mmarahyɛbadwam no mu baako wɔ South Africa baabi a ɔdii dwuma berɛ bi kɔsii afe 2013. Wɔ John Mahama nnisoɔ mu (2012 - 2016) wɔpaw no sɛ Ɔman Ɔsoafoɔ wɔ Ɔmampanyin a ɔhwɛ Ankorankoro Nkɔsoɔ ne Ɔmanfoɔ Ankorankoro Nkɔmmɔdie (PPP) so no Dwumadibea. Ná ɔsan yɛ Sikasɛm sohwɛ Kuw (EMT) no muni. Wɔ afe 2016 mu no ɔdii nkonim wɔ n’akongua so ne mpɛn anan wɔ mfeɛ nnan bio sɛ ​​Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni ma Wa Central Constituency. Wɔpaw no sɛ caucus kɛseɛ a ɛwɔ Ghana Mmarahyɛ Bagua, The Population and Development Caucus no guamtrani ne Parliamentarians for Global Action, Ghana Chapter no kannifoɔ. Ɔsan nso kuraa Aban Awerɛhyem Boayikuo no mufoɔ dibea a ɛdi mu, boayikuo a ɛho hia a ɛhwɛ so a ɛhwɛ aban Asomfo so na wɔde wɔn ho to wɔn so wɔ bɔhyɛ a wɔhyɛ nkurɔfoɔ no ho na wɔnni saa bɔhyɛ ahodoɔ no akyi.Hwɛ Standing Orders (order 151, 2j ) ne Mmarahyɛ Bagua Boayikuo a ɛhwɛ Paw Amanneɛbɔ so, 2020. Hon Pelpuo nso sii akan wɔ 2020 Mmarahyɛ Bagua ne Ɔmampanyin amansan abatow no mu na odii nkonim wɔ afe a ɛto so anum a ɛyɛ mfe 4 sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwamni ma Wa Central wɔ 2020 Ɛmfa ho sɛ Nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo wɔ hɔ. Wɔpaw no sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ Ɔmanfo ne Nkɔso Kuw no Titenani ne Asase Boayikuw no muni a ɔto so abiɛsa. Ɔsan nso yɛ Ahoɔden ne Adwumayɛ Boayikuw no muni. Hwɛ amanneɛbɔ a ɛfiri 2021 Mmarahyɛ Bagua Boayikuo a ɛfa paw ho.

Mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nan(2004) abatoɔ 

Wɔpaw Pelpuo sɛ Wa Central mansin no mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ mfeɛ 2004 Ghana amansan abatow mu. Enti ɔgyinaa mansin no ananmu wɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmarahyɛ bagua a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu. Wɔde abatow 21,272 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata 41,501 a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 51.3% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Mornah Anbataayela Bernard a ofi Ɔmanfo Ɔman Nhyiam no mu, Mohammed Adama Kpegla a ofi Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no mu, Abu Mumuni a ofi Nhyiam Nnipa Kuw no mu, Osman Mohammed a ofi Demokrase Ɔmanfo Kuw no mu ne Osman Imam Sidik a ɔyɛ ɔmanpanyin a ɔde ne ho ] . Eyinom nyaa abatow 12,280, abatow 7,249, abatow 376, abatow 172 ne abatow 152 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne 29.6%, 17.5%, 0.9%,0.4% ne 0.4% yɛ pɛ wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu.[8][9] Wɔpaw Pelpuo wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so. Ne nyinaa mu no, National Democratic Congress dii nkonim wɔ nnipa kakraa bi a wɔka bom yɛ mmarahyɛ bagua ananmusifo 94 wɔ nkongua 230 a ɛwɔ mmarahyɛ bagua a ɛto so 4 a ɛwɔ Ghana man a ɛto so 4 no mu.

N'ankasa abrabɔ 
Abdul-Rashid yɛ Nkramoni.

Adwuma 
Na ɔyɛ ɔfotufo ma Institute of Policy Alternatives. Ɔsan nso yɛ Sikasɛm ho Ntamgyinafoɔ Abadiakyiri ma Ɔman Mmabun Badwa no na akyiri yi ɔyɛɛ asoɛeɛ korɔ no ara sohwɛfoɔ na ɔkɔɔ so bɛyɛɛ Kuadwuma Ag. Regional a ɛwɔ asoɛe koro no ara mu.

Beaeɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Joseph Boakye Danquah Adu
text:
Joseph Kwame Kyeretwie Boakye Danquah (firi Ɔpɛnimma bosome da a ɛtɔ so dunwɔtwe wɔ afe apem ahanwɔtwe ne aduokron num(1895) de kɔ si Ɔgyefoɔ bosome da a ɛtɔ so nan wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduosia num(1965) ) na ɔyɛ Ghana amanyɔni, ɔbemfo, mmaranimfoɔ san so ka yɛn nananom a wɔko gyee ɔman Ghana sii hɔ no ho. Odii dwuma soronko wɔ berɛ aborofo bɛdii Ghana so ne berɛ wɔkɔeɛ akyi no nso a na wɔfrɛ Ghana Gold Coast no, yɛbɔ ne din sɛ nipa a ɔmaa nnɛ Ghana din. 

Wɔ ne amanyɔsɛm dwumadie mu no, na ɔka wɔn a na wɔreko tia Kwame Nkrumah a na ɔyɛ Ghana mampanini ne mfahodie pre kuo mu panini. Watson Commission a na wɔrehwehwɛ basabasaeɛ a esii wɔ Nkran wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduanan nwɔtwe(1948) mu no ka ne ho asɛm sɛ ɔyɛ "Gold Cost amanyɔsɛm mu nipa wagye din pa ara yɛbu no. 

Sɛ abakɔsɛm nu ɔbemfoɔ, ɔhwehwɛɛ abakɔsɛm faa Akan nnipakuo ho, na ɔmaa wɔn kuro din a ɛbɛfata wɔn sɛ ɔman no nya mfahodie a. Na ɔpɛ sɛ awoɔ nnidisoɔ hunu wɔn nkyi ne wɔn man ho abakɔsɛm.

Abrabɔ ahyɛaseɛ ne nwomasua 
Yɛwoo Danquah wɔ Ɔpɛnimma bosome da a ɛtɔ so dunwɔtwe (18) wɔ afe apem ahanwɔtwe ne aduokron num mu (1895) wɔ Bepong a ɛwɔ Kwahu wɔ Apueeɛ Mantam mu wɔ Ghana (kane Gold coast). Ɔfiri Ofori Panini Fie adehyeɛ abusua no mu a na wɔyɛ Akyem man ahemfo, ne abusua a wɔde akotene yie wɔ Ghana amanyɔsɛm mu. Ne nua barima panini ne Nana Sir Ofori Atta l na ne babarima ne Paul Danquah.

Ɔdii mfeɛ nsia no, ɔhyɛɛ sukuu ase wɔ Basel Mission Sukuu a ɛwɔ Kyebi. Ɔkɔɔ Basel Mission ntoasoɔ sukuu wɔ Begoro. Ɔtwerɛɛ ne nsɔhwɛ wiee di nkunim wɔ afe apem ahankron ne dummienu (1912) mu no, Vidal J.Buckle a ɔyɛ mmaranimfoɔ a ɔtumi di asɛm wɔ kɔɔto (barrister) a na ɔyɛ adwuma wɔ nkran faa no adwuma mu sɛ kɔɔto twerɛtwerɛfoɔ (clerk), saa adwuma yi bɛkanyan n'anigyeɛ wɔ mmara mu.

Otwaa Civil Service nsɔhwɛ wiee wɔ afe apem ahankron ne dunan(1914) mu no, Danquah bɛyɛɛ kɔɔto twerɛtwerɛfoɔ(clerk) wɔ Asɛnnibea Kunini(Supreme Court) a wɔ Gold Coast mu a ɛmaa no nyaa suahunu a ɛnam so maa ne nua barima, Nana Sir Ofori Atta I a na wabɛyɛ ɔhene mfeɛ mmienu a adi kan no mu sɛ Omanhene Tribunal twerɛtwerɛfoɔ (secretary) wɔ Kyebi. Ɛnam ne nua barima so maa wɔyii no sɛ Ahemfo a ɛwɔ Apueeɛ mantam nhyiamu twerɛtwerɛfoɔ abediakyire. Ɛnam N'adwene mu na emu dɔr nti ne nua barima no de ne kɔɔ Britain wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduonu baako (1921) mu sɛ ɔnkɔsua mmara.

Adwuma 
Berɛ a Danquah baa Ghana wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduonu nson (1927) mu no, ɔbɛwuraa private legal practice mu. Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduonu nkron (1929) mu no ɔboaa J.E. Casely Hayford ma ɔtee Gold Coast Youth Conference (GCYC) a na ɔyɛ wɔn twerɛtwerɛfoɔ panin firi afe apem ahankron ne aduasa nson (1937) de kɔ si afe apem ahankron ne aduanan nson (1947) mu. Wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduasa baako(1931) mu no, Danquah yɛɛ krataa bi a ɔtoo din The Times of West Africa, a wɔfrɛ no West Africa Time, a ɛyɛ koowa krataa(newspapeer) a adi kan wɔ Ghana a wɔdii ho dwuma wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduasa baako(1931) ne afe apem ahankron ne aduasa num (1935) mu. Krataa ne fa baabi a na wɔfrɛ no mmaa bea (Women's Corner) na Mabel Dove a ɔyɛ mmaranimfoɔ titire a yɛfrɛ no Francis Dove ba. Ɔbɛyɛɛ Danquah yere a odi kan wɔ afe 1933 mu a ɔwoo babarima baako maa no. Akyire no, Danquah bɛwaree Elizabeth Vardon.

Amanyɔsɛm

Danquah bɛkaa kuo a na wɔhyɛ mmara wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduanan nsia mu (1946). Wɔ afe 1947 mu no ɔboa maa wɔtee United Gold Coast Convention (UGCC) a na wɔnyaa mfahodie a na nnipakuo a na wɔka ho bi ne ahemfo, abemfo ne mmaranimfoɔ bi te sɛ George Alfred Grant, Robert Benjamin Blay, R.A. Awoonor-Williams, Edward Akufo-Addo, ne Emmanuel Obetsebi-Lamptey. 

Danquah abakɔsɛm nhwehwɛmu nam so maa no gyee Nkrumah agyina a na ɛfa Gold Coast mfahodie ho sɛ ɔbɛsesa din Gold Coast no ayɛ no Ghana. Nanso, Danquah ne Nkrumah adwene anhyia wɔ faako a wɔn ani gye sɛ wɔn ani gye faahodie ho no ho, na mfeɛ mmienu akyi no, wɔtwee wɔn ho. Nkrumah kɔɔ so yɛɛ Convention People's Party (CPP) na awieɛ koraa no ɔbɛyɛɛ Ghana manpanin a ɔdi kan.

Danquah dwumadie wɔ University of Ghana teeɛ mu 
Danquah di dwumasom wɔ University of Ghana teeɛ mu, Suapɔn ɛso wɔ Ghana. Ɔtumi maa nnipa tee suapɔn yi si nka yie wɔ afe 1948 berɛ a Britishni bi bɛkaa nnwomasua a ɛwɔ soro ho nsɛm sɛ suapɔn kɛseɛ baako a ɛrebɛba Nigeria a wɔne University of London na ɛbedi dwuma na ɛbɛyɛ ketewa ama abibirem atɔeɛ foɔ nyinaa.

Ne kyere ne ne wuo ho nsɛm 
Danquah gyina sɛ mampanini gyinafoɔ tiaa Nkrumah wɔ Oforisuo bosome mu wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduosia baako mu(1961) nanso ɔdii nkuguo wɔ abatoɔ no mu. Wɔ Ahinime bosome da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduosia baako (1961) mu no, wɔnam Preventive Detention Act so kyeree Danquah sɛ watete sɛ ɔde ne aka nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde resubvert CPP aban. Wɔgyaa no wɔ Ayɛwohommumɔ bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduonu mmienu wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduosia mmienu (1962) mu. Wɔtoo aba yii no sɛ Ghana Bar Association kuo no panini akyire no.

Wɔkyeree Danquah bio wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da a ɛtɔ so nnwɔtwe wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduosia nan(1964) mu, sɛ watete sɛ ɔreyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ bɔne bi atia mampanini no. Berɛ na ɔwɔ Nsawam Medium Prison a na wɔrehwehwɛ saa nsɛm no mu no, ɔnyaa akoma yareɛ wuiɛ wɔ Ogyefoɔ bosome da a ɛtɔ so nan wɔ 1965 mu.

Bere a National Liberation Council (NLC) tow CPP aban no guiiɛ wɔ February 1966 mu no, wɔde ɔman ayi maa Danquah.

Ne Nwoma Ahodoɔ 
Ne ntwerɛ no bi ne Gold Coast: Akan Laws and Customs and the Akim Abuakwa Constitution (1928), The Third Woman (1943), ne The Akan Doctrine of God (1944). Nwoma a ɛtwa to no kyerɛeɛ sɛ Afrika som ne Kristosom hyia, na wobu no sɛ "mfasoɔ" ma Afrika Protestantfoɔ a wɔrehwehwɛ akwan a wɔbɛfa so anya wɔn Afrika agyapadeɛ no.

Abusua 
Kwaku Boateng ne J. B. Danquah bɛyɛɛ anuafoɔ ɛnam awareɛ so.

Din pa a ɔgya too hɔ 
Wɔsii J. B. Danquah Memorial Lecture Series wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduosia nwɔtwe (1968) mu sɛ nkae deɛ ma Danquah, a na ɔsan so yɛ Ghana Academy of Arts and Science (GAAS) mu kuoba. Wɔyɛɛ saa nnoɔma yi nyinaa sɛdeɛ wɔde bɛkae n'adwuma pa.

Danquah Circle, ntwaahobea a ɛwɔ Osu a ɛwɔ Nkran na wɔde too no.

title: Joseph Kwadwo Ofori
text:
Joseph Kwadwo Ofori  (wɔwoo no 13 Oforisuo 1967) yɛ kane Ghana amanyɔni ne Mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwafie a Ɛtɔ so Nsia a ɛwɔ Ghana adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu a ɔgyina sii akan wɔ mansin no ananmu wɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ Ghana sɛ ɔman a ɔde ne ho.

Ne Abrabɔ mu Nsɛm 
Ofori aware wɔ ɛba baako. Ɔyɛ kristoni a asɔre a ɔkɔ ne Evangelical Presbyterian.

Abrabɔ Ahyɛase ne Nnwomasua 
Wɔwoo Ofori wɔ Ɔbɛnem bosome da a ɛtɔ so dummiɛnsa(13) wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduosia-nson(1967) mu. Ɔfiri Kadjebi, kuro a ɛwɔ volta mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔnyaa ne GCE 'O' Level wɔ Kadjebi Asato Senior High School wɔ 1990.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ofori yɛ Kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo (National Democratic Congress(NDC) ) no muni. Odii kan bɛyɛɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ mfeɛ 2009 mu bere a odii nkonim wɔ ne abatoɔ mu wɔ mfeɛ 2008 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu na ogyinaa Akan amansin ananmu. Ɛno na ɛmaa ɔbɛyɛɛ Ghana adehyeman amammuo a ɛtɔ so nan mmarahyɛbadwafie  a ɛtɔ so num no mu ni. Wɔ mfeɛ 2012 mu no, Ɔsii akan sɛ wɔbɛsan apaw no bio akɔ Akan nkongua so wɔ NDC tekiti so wɔ mfeɛ 2012 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu na ɔdii nkonim.[6]

Na ɔyɛ Adwumayɛ, Asetra mu Yiedie ne Ɔman, sikasɛm ntotooeɛ titiriw no boayikuw mu ni.

Adwuma 
Ofori yɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani firii mfeɛ 2009 kɔsi mfeɛ 2012 maa Akan amansin a ɛwɔ Volta Mantam mu.[3] Ɔyɛ aguadifo.[2]

Na ɔyɛ Wafa Paye Company Limited no kwankyerɛfo panyin.[2]

Beaeɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Charles Obeng-Inkoom
text:
Charles Obeng-Inkoom (wɔwoo no 30 Ayɛwohomumɔ 1958) yɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma Agona West wɔ Central mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

N'ankasa Abrabɔ 
Charles aware na ɔwɔ mma baanan. Ɔyɛ Kristoni (Pentekoste Asɔre).

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo no wɔ 30 April 1958 wɔ Agona-Abodom wɔ Central mantam mu. Ɔnyaa ne LLB wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu wɔ afe 1985 mu na ɔnyaa ne BL wɔ Ghana Mmara Sukuu mu wɔ afe 1988.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ɔyɛ National Democratic Congress no muni.

Adwumafa 
Ɔyɛ mmaranimfo. Ɔyɛ Ɔpanyin Boafoɔ (Mmara) wɔ The Ecobank Ghana Limited a ɛwɔ Accra firi afe 2012/05/01- 2012/10/01.

Trust Bank no sohwɛfoɔ Panyin Boafoɔ firi afe apem ahankron aduokron nsia 1996/11/04- 2012/04/30. Ɔpanin Boafo a ɔhwɛ Meridian Biao Sikakorabea so.

Mmeaeɛ A Menyaa Mmoa Firiiɛ 

Ghanaian Mp's 5th Parliament of the 4th Republic

title: Samuel Ato Amoah
text:
Samuel Ato Amooah (wɔwoo no Ɔbɛnem bosome ne da a ɛtɔ so 7 wɔ afe 1966) yɛ obi a na ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua a Ɛto so Nsia a ɛwɔ Ghana Aman a Ɛto so Anan no muni.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Amoa aware a ɔwɔ mma baanan. Ɔyɛ Kristoni a ɔyɛ fekubɔ wɔ Seventh Day Adventist.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 

Wɔwoo Amoah wɔ Ɔbɛnem bosome ne da a ɛtɔ so 7 wɔ 1966 wɔ Twifo Nyinase a ɛwɔ Central region of Ghana. 

Ɔkɔɔ Cape Coast Suapɔn na owiee sukuu no nyaa bachelor’s degree wɔ Business Administration mu wɔ afe 2009 mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Amoah yɛ  National Democratic Congress (NDC) no muni . Ɔsii akan wɔ afe 2012 Ghana abatoɔ no mu wɔ NDC tekiti ase na ɔdii nkonim maa no hokwan sɛ ɔbɛgyina Twifo Atti Morkwaa mantam no ananmu. Ɔnyaa abatoɔ 19,410 a ɛyɛ abatoɔ a ɛfata nyinaa mu ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 56.16 na ɛno nti ɔdii akansifoɔ afoforɔ a Francis Owusu-Mensah, Ringo Gottah ne Seth Kwame Ofori ka ho no so nkonim. afe 2016 mu no, ɔsii akan wɔ amansan abatoɔ no mu na ɔdii nkoguo wɔ Abraham Dwuma Odoom anim; ne saa nti, wantumi agyina ne mantam no ananmu ne mprenu so.

Adwumafa 
Na Amoah yɛ Ɔmantam Akwahosan Insurance Authority a ɛwɔ Ho.

title: Joe Kwashie Gidisu
text:
Joe Kwashie Gidisu yɛ amanyɔni ne kyerɛkyerɛni ne kane ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ akwantempɔn ne akwan keseɛ so wɔ Ghana.

Abrabɔ Ahyɛase ne Nnwomasua 
wɔwoo Joe Gidisu wɔ  Ɔpɛpɔn bosome 1952 wɔ Bakpa Alabonu wɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔnyaa ne mfitiaseɛ nwomasua wɔ Bakpa Alabonu Mpɔtam Aban Mfitiaseɛ Sukuu mu wɔ afe 1959 ne 1963 ntam.

Afei ɔkɔɔ Mafi Devime Local Authority Middle School a ɔwiee wɔ afe 1967. Afei ɔkɔɔ Kibi Men’s Training College baabi a ɔnyaa Teachers’ Certificate ‘A’. Wɔ afe 1975 ne 1977 ntam no, ɔkɔɔ Advanced Teacher Training College wɔ Winneba baabi a onyaa Specialist Teachers’ Certificate.

Afei Gidisu kɔɔ University of Ghana mu baabi a ɔnyaa B.A. Hons wɔ afe 1981. Ɔkɔɔ Netherlands baabi a ɔyɛɛ adesua akyi adesua wɔ Institute of Social Studies, The Hague baabi a onyaa M.A. wɔ Development Studies mu.

Adwuma 
Gidisu kyerɛɛ ade wɔ Bontibor Mpɔtam Aban Mfitiaseɛ Sukuu mu wɔ afe 1971 ne 1973 ntam hɔ.Bere a ɔfirii Kibi Mmarima Nteteeɛ Kɔlege no, ɔkyerɛɛ adeɛ wɔ Dormaa Ntoaso Sukuu mu wɔ afe 1977 ne 1978 ntam.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔpaw Gidisu sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwamni ma North Tongu Ɔpɛnimma bosome wɔ mfeɛ 2000 mmarahyɛbadwam abatoɔ mu. Bere a wɔsan twee ahye no akyi no, ogyinaa Central Tongu akyi na odii nkonim wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwam abatoɔ mu wɔ mfeɛ  2004 muna ɔfaa saa agua no wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2005 mu.

Ɔkɔɔ so kuraa n’akonnwa so wɔ mfeɛ 2008 Ghana mmarahyɛbadwam abatoɔ mu. Saa abatoɔ yi akyi no, John Evans Atta Mills, Ghana Ɔmanpanyin na ɔpaw no sɛ ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ akwan ne akwan akɛseɛ so wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn, 2009 mu.

Beaeɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Yaw Afful
text:
Yaw Maama Afful (wɔwoo no Ayɛwohomumɔ da ɛtɔ so du (10), afe Apem, Ahankron ne Aduonum-nkron (1959) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne Mmarahyɛbadwa  a Ɛtɔ so num ne nson a ɛwɔ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu ni a na  ɔgyina Gyaaman Anaafoɔ (Jaman South )Abatoɔ mpɛsoa no ananmu wɔ kane Bono Ahafo Mantam no mu wɔ Ɔsono kokroko Ammanyɔkuo (New Patriotic Party-NPP )tekiti so

Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ 
Wɔwoo Afful  wɔ   Ayɛwohomumɔ da ɛtɔ so du (10), afe Apem, Ahankron ne Aduonum-nkron (1959).  Ɔfiri Mpuasu, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Bono Ahafo  mantam no mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔkɔɔ ( Kennesaw State) Suapɔn , (Atlanta, USA) na onyaa ne (Bachelor of Arts ) abɔdin krataa wɔ amanaman ntam nsɛm ne amammanyɔsɛm mu (wɔ afe Apem , Ahankron ne Aduɔkron-nson(1997) mu.

Adwumyɛ 
Na Afful yɛ EO, Kids Heaven Learning Center a ɛwɔ Aworth, Atlanta wɔ U.S. no panyin. ɔyɛ dwadifoɔ

Amanyɔsɛm

Amanyɔsɛm 
Afful yɛ ɔsono kokroko ammanyɔkuo (New Patriotic Party-NPP)  mu ni. Wɔ mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Nwɔtwe (2008)mu no, wɔpaw no wɔ NPP tekiti so sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani. Na ɔgyina hɔ  ma Gyaaman Anafoɔ ( Jaman South) Abatoɔ mpɛsoa no . Enti ɔgyinaa mansin no ananmu wɔ Adehyeman a  ɛtɔ so nnan 4 no mmarahyɛbadwa  a ɛtɔ so num 5 no mu.Wɔde mma mpemdunsia, ahanwɔtwe ne aduɔson nwɔtwe(16,878)  a na ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyem aduonum-num, ne akyiri pɔ aduɔson nson (55.77) na ɛpaw no wɔ mma mpem aduasa-mmeɛnsa, ah-mmienu ne Aduosia-Nsia ( 30,266) a  wɔtoeɛ no  mu . Ɔnyaa mma no mu ɔha nkyekyem aduonum num ne akyiri pɔ aduɔson nson( 55.77% ).  

Ɔdii  Ofori Aikins, a ɔgyina maa (People's People's National Congress- PNC) , Peter Kwabena Ankomah a ɔfiri  kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo (National Democratic Congress-NDC) mu, Jacob Oteng-Ahyemang a ɔfiri (Convention People's Party-CPP) mu ne Kwadwo Boakye Djan a ɔyɛ ɔkannifoɔ a ɔde ne ho no nyinaa so nkunim. Yeinom nyaa mma no mu mu ɔha nkyekyem hwee, akyiri pɔ aduɔson nson(0.75%), aduasa nan, akyiri pɔ aduonu ndon (34.27%), hwee, akyirikyiri pɔ aduanan nan (0.44%) ne nwɔtwe , akyiri pɔ aduɔson nson (8.77%) pɛpɛɛpɛ.Ɔsan sii akan bio maa Jaman South North nkondwa no wɔ NPP tekiti so maa Mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nsia wɔ Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nan no mu na odii nkonim.

N'ankasa Abrabɔ 
Afful kristoni a ɔyɛ Baasere asafo no ba. Ɔware woo mma mmɛnsa.

title: Samuel Ayeh-Paye
text:
Samuel Ayeh-Paye yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɛni na na ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanin a Ɛto so Anan no Mmarahyɛ Badwa a Ɛto so Nson no muni a ɔgyina Ayensuano Mpɛsua a ɛwɔ Apueeɛ Fam Mantam no anan mu wɔ Ɔman Ho Kuo Foforo no tekiti so.

Mfitiaseɛ abrabɔ 
Wɔwoo Samuel Yawoda, Kɔtɔnimaa bosome da a ɛtɔ so du-nson wɔ afe apem ahankron aduoson mmiɛnsa (17 May 1973) na ɔfiri Aburi, Ghana Apueeɛ Mantam.

Nwomasua 
Ɔwɔ HND wɔ Accra Polytechnic a ɛwɔ Accra (mprempren Accra Technical University ) a ɛwɔ Accra, Ghana. Ɔsan nso nyaa MVM nteteɛ firii Accra Technical Training Center (ATTC) a ɛwɔ Accra, Ghana, ne adansedie krataa wɔ Indian Institute of Management Studies wɔ India

Adwumayɛ 
Efiri afe apem ahankron aduokron nkron de kɔsi mfeɛ mpem mmienu (1999 - 2000), Ɔyɛ akwantufoɔ sohwɛfoɔ wɔ Accra Metropolitan Assembly a ɔyɛ adwuma wɔ Waste Management Department Ɔbɛyɛɛ adwumayɛbea sohwɛfoɔ firi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne mmiɛnsa de kɔsi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnum (2003 - 2005) wɔ Metro Mass Transit wɔ Ghana. Ɛfiri hɔ no ɔbɛyɛɛ mfiridwuma sohwɛfoɔ boafoɔ firi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnum de kɔsi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nwɔtwe (2005 - 2008) wɔ DVLA wɔ Ghana.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wayɛ mmarahyɛ badwa a ɛtɔ so num (5), nsia (6) ne nson (7) wɔ Ghana adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nan (4th Republic) ayɛ mmarahyɛ badwa no muni firi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nkron kɔsi mfeɛ mpemmienu ne aduonu baako (2009 - 2021).

Sɛ́ kan DVLA panin no, wakasa wɔ Mmarahyɛ Badwa no mu afa hia a ehia sɛ wɔyɛ akwan so ahobammɔ ho nhyehyɛeɛ pa ho.

Wɔ Ɔbɛnem bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nson (March 2017) mu no, ɔfrɛɛ sɛ wɔmfa Upper Chamber a wɔapaw no nsi Ɔman Badwa no ananmu.

N'ankasa Abrabɔ 
Samuel aware a ɔwɔ mma nnan.

Mmeaeɛ Menyaa Mmoa Firiiɛ 

Ghana mmrahyɛbadwamfoɔ a wɔtɔ so nnum wɔ ammamu a ɛto so nnan mu

title: Derrick Oduro
text:
Derrick Oduro (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn da a ɛtɔ so aduonu-mmeɛnsa, afe Apem Ahankron ne sɛ duonum-nwɔtwe -1958) yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɔni a ɔno nso yɛ ɔsraani a wakɔ pɛnhyen wɔ Ghana Asraafo mu. Ma ɔwɔ dibea a ɛyɛ ɔsraani panyin. Ɔyɛ Ɔsono kokroko ammanyɔkuo (New Patriotic Party-NPP) mu ni na ɔyɛ Ɔman Bammɔ Soafo abadiakyiri wɔ Ghana.Ɔsan nso yɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma Nkoranza Atifi abatoɔ mpɛsoa no wɔ saa bere no Brono Ahafo mantam no fa baabi a mprempren yi ɛyɛ Bono Apueiɛ mantam no mu .

Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ ne Nwomasua 
Derick Oduro  firi Dromankɛse a ɛwɔ saa bere no Bono Ahafo Mantam a mprempren ɛyɛ Bono Apueiɛ Fam Mantam wɔ Ghana. Ɔwɔ (Masters of Arts ) wɔ nniso ne akandifosɛm mu( Governance and Leadership) wɔ Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration (GIMPA). Ɔsan nso wɔ Diploma wɔ Ɔman Sikasɛm mu (Economics) wɔ Institute of Accountancy Training ne Certificate wɔ Cranfield University.

Adwumyɛ ne Amanyɔsɛm 
Oduro hyɛɛ n’adwuma ase sɛ sikasɛm  hwɛsofoɔ wɔ (Akosas Business College ) firi afe Apem Ahankron Aduɔson Nson (1977 )kɔsi afe Apem Ahankron Aduɔson Nkron (1979). Ɛno akyiri no, wɔfaa no sɛ ɔnkɔ asraadie firi afe Apem Ahankron ne Aduɔson-kron (1979) kɔsi afe mfe Mpem Mmienu ne anum (2005). Ɔkɔɔ ahomegyeɛ mu wɔ asraafoɔ mu. Na ɔbɛyɛɛ Nkoranza Mantam Nhyiamu no  titenani firi mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Num (2005 )kɔsi  Mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Nson (2007).  Wɔ afe 2007 mu no, wɔ Ɔsono kokroko amdnyɔkuo (New Patriotic Party-NPP) tekiti So. Derrick Oduro dii n’asɔretiafoɔ a wɔfiri amanyɔkuo ahodoɔ mu so nkonim . Na ɔbɛgyinaa Nkoranza Atifi abatoɔ mpɛsoa no ananmu. Wagyina ne mansin ananmu de bɛsi nnɛ.

Ɔde Kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo (National Democratic Congress-NDC)no tekiti sii akan wɔ mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Aduonu (2020 ) Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu na ɔdii nkoguo wɔ Joseph Kwasi Mensah a ɔfiri National Democratic Congress no anim. Joseph Mensah nyaa mma no mu 15,124 berɛ a Oduro nyaa ɛmu  mpemdu, ahankron ne aduɔson -nwɔtwe (10,978)

N'ankasa Abrabɔ 
Derrick Oduro, awo mmamu nsia. Na ɔyɛ memeneda asɔre ADA ne.

Abadwakuo 
Mprenpren yi, ɔka abadwakuo a ɛhwɛ mma, mmarima ne mmɔfra nsɛm so no ho. Ɔsan ka sikasɛm abadwakuo no ho. Afei, ɔsan ka abadwakuo a we ɔhwɛ mmabunu ne agudie ne ammamerɛ ho nsɛm so no ho.

Baabi a Menyaa Mmoa Friiɛ.

title: Kwabena Amankwah Asiamah
text:
Kwabena Amankwa Asiamah (wɔwoo no wɔ Ɔsanaa bosome da a ɛto so aduonu nwɔtwe wɔ afe apem ahankron aduonum nwɔtwe,( August 28, 1958) yɛ Ghana sikasɛm ho nimdefoɔ ne amanyɔni. Ɔyɛ Ghana Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so nson (7) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4) no muni a ogyina Fanteakwa Atifi Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa ananmu wɔ Apueɛ Mantam wɔ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforɔ (New Patriotic Party) no tekiti so.

Ne mmɔfrase abrabɔ ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Asiamah wɔ Ɔsanaa bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduonu awɔtwe (28), afe apem ahankron aduonum nwɔtwe (1958) mu. Ɔfiri Bɛgorɔ, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Apueɛ Mantam mu. Owiee sukuu wɔ Hull Suapɔn mu (University of Hull) na onyaa ne Adwumayɛ ho Ɔbenfo abodin krataa wɔ akwankyerɛ a wɔde di dwuma mu (Master of Business Administration degree in strategic management) wɔ afe apem ahankron aduokron nkron (1999) mu. Ɔsan nso wɔ EMGL abodin krataa (EMGL degree) wɔ Ghana Asoɛe a Ɛhwɛ Adwumayɛ ne Ɔmanfoɔ So (Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration - GIMPA).

Adwumayɛ 
Asiamah yɛ sikasɛm ho ɔbenfo (economist) ne sikakorabea dwumayɛni (banker) wɔ n’adwuma mu. Ansa na ɔrebɛyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani no, na ɔyɛ Fanteakwa Nkuraase Sikakorabea (Fanteakwa Rural Bank) no guamtrani (board chairman).

Amanyɔsɛm 
Asiamah yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforɔ (New Patriotic Party - NPP) no muni. Wɔdii kan paw no sɛ ɔmmra Ghana Mmarahyɛ Badwa no mu wɔ bosomeƆpɛpɔn mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nkron mu (2009) mu, berɛ a ɔbɛyɛɛ Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so anum (5) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4) no muni. Wɔ bosome Ɔpɛnimma afe 2012 mu no, ɔsan sii akan wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du mmienu mu (2012) Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu sɛ ɔbɛkora n’akonnwua so wɔ NPP tekiti so. Odii nkonim na ɔbɛyɛɛ Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so nsia (6) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4) no muni. Ɔsan dii nkonim wɔ ne abatoɔ mu wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du nsia mu (2016) Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu a onyaa abatoɔ nyinaa mu 57% na ɔbɛyɛɛ mprempren Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so nson (7) a ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan (4) no muni. Ɔyɛ sikasɛm boayikuo no dwamtenani abadiakyiri (vice chairperson) na ɔsan yɛ boayikuo muni ma Adwadie Nnwuma ne Nsrahwɛ Boayikuo (member for Trade Industry and Tourism Committee).

N'ankasa Abrabɔ 
Asiamah yɛ Kristoni (Presbyni). Waware a ɔwɔ mma baason (7).

Mmeaeɛ A Menyaa Mmoa Firiiɛ 
Ghanaian Mp's 5th Parliament of the 4th Republic

title: Seth Kwame Acheampong
text:
Seth Kwame Acheampong (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛnimaa bosome da a ɛtɔ so du nwɔtwe wɔ afe apem ahankron aduoson baako, Ɔpɛnimaa (18, 1971) yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ na na ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanin a ɛtɔ so nnan Mmarahyɛ Bagua a ɛtɔ so nson no muni a ɔgyinaa Mpraeso Mansin ananmu wɔ Apueeɛ Mantam mu wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so. Wɔ afe 2020 mu no, ɔdii nkogu wɔ mmɔden a ɔbɔe sɛ ɔbɛdi New Patriotic Party a ɛrekɔ mmarahyɛ bagua abatoɔ mu no anim wɔ Davis Ansah Opoku. Mprempren ɔresom sɛ Apuei Fam Mantam no soafoɔ.

N'ankasa Abrabɔ 
Acheampong yɛ Kristoni (Presbyterian). Ɔwaree.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Acheampong wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa bosome da a ɛtɔ so du nwɔtwe wɔ afe apem ahankron aduoson baako (December 18, 1971) mu. Ɔfiri Atibie-Kwahu, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Apueeɛ Mantam mu. Ɔkɔɔ Graduate School of Management, France, Paris na ɔnyaa ne postgraduate diploma wɔ Management mu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nwɔtwe (2008).

Amanyɔsɛm 
Acheampong yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo (NPP) no muni. Ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtɔ so num, nsia ne nson a ɛwɔ Ghana adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nan no muni. Ɔdii kan baa mmarahyɛ badwa no mu wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2009 mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 17,519 wɔ abatoɔ 25,468 a ɛfata wɔ ne Mpɛsoa mu. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu (2012) mu no, ɔsii akan sɛ wɔbɛsan apaw no bio wɔ Mpraeso Mpɛsoa mmarahyɛ badwa no mu wɔ NPP tekiti so sɛ ɔbɛyɛ mmarahyɛ bagua a ɛtɔ so nsia wɔ republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no muni na odii nkunim. Ɔda so ara gyina ne mpɛsoa ananmu de bɛsi nnɛ.

Mmeaeɛ A Menyaa mmoa firiiɛ 

Ghanaian Mp's 5th Parliament of the 4th Republic

title: Kwasi Ameyaw-Cherimeh
text:
kwasi Ameyaw-Cheremeh (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn 6, afe Apem, Ahankron ne Aduosia nsia (1966) yɛ Ghana manyɔni ne mmarahyɛbadwani  ma Sunyani Apueɛ mannsini no  wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so num 5 wɔ Adehyeman  a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu.

Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ ne Nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Ameyaw-Cheremeh wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn da a ɛtɔ so 6, afe 1966.Ɔfiri Jinijini, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Brong Ahafo Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.Ɔkɔɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu na ɛhɔ na  ɔnyaa ne Master of Philosophy abodin krataa wɔ Ɔmanfoɔ Nnwuma mu, mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Nwɔtwe (2008). Ɔsan nso kɔɔ Ghana School of Law na ɔnyaa ne Bachelor of Laws wɔ afe Apem, Ahankron ne Aduɔkron-num (1995). Ɔsan nso akɔ Galilee College wɔ Israel na wawie sukuu wɔ mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne nwɔtwe (2008 ) adesuakuo no mu .Ɔde ne nsa kyerɛɛ ne so.

Adwumayɛ 
Ameyaw-Cheremeh mprempren reyɛ Bui Power Authority Boayikuw no Titenani. Ɔyɛɛ Ɔtwerɛtwerɛfoɔ Panyin wɔ Ɔman Fekuw a ɛhwɛ mpɔtam hɔ mpanyimfo so wɔ Ghana (NALAG). Ɔyɛ Mmaranimfo wɔ n’adwuma mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ameyaw-Cheremeh yɛ Ɔsono kokroko ammanyɔkuo ( New Patriotic Party-NPP) no mu ni. Wɔpaw no wɔ mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Nwɔtwe (2008 ) Ghana amansan abatoɔ no  mu sɛ mmarahyɛbadni  ma Sunyani Apueɛ mansini no mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛto so num(5) wɔ Ghana Adehyeman/Kwasafoman a ɛtɔ so nan(4) no mu.  Ɔnyaa mpem aduasa-mmeɛnsa, aha-nson ne aduosai-num (33,765 ) wɔ mmamu  mpem Aduonum-mmeɛnsa , aha-nwɔtwe ne Aduanan-nsia ( 53,844), a wɔtooeɛ no. Yei gyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyem aduosia-mmienu ne akyiri pɔ aduɔson-baako (62.71% ). Wɔpaw no gyaa Alanyina Sampana Sampson a ofiri Convention People's Party-CPP, Ɔtemmufo Samuel Adjei a ɔfiri kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress-NDC, Peter Kwaw Alibah a ofi Demokrasi Ahofadi Kuo no mu ne Kwakye Kofi a ɔfiri People's National Congress- PNC) no mu. Yeinom nyinaa nyaa mma a wɔtoeɛ no mu ɔha nkyekyem baako ne akyiri pɔ aduonu-num (1.25%), ɔha nkyekyem Aduasa-nan ne akyiri pɔ aduɔkron nson (34.97%), ɔha nkyekyem hwee ne akyiri pɔ aduonu-nkron (0.29% ) ne ɔha nkyekyem whee , akyiri pɔ pɔ aduɔson-nwɔtwe (0.78%) pɛpɛɛpɛ. Wɔ mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Du-mmienu(2012) mu no, ɔsan sii akan bio maa Sunyani Apueiɛ mansini mu nkondwa no wɔ New Patriotic Party-NPP  tekiti so maa Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmarahyɛdwa a ɛtɔ so nsia na odii nkonim. Ɔsomm wɔ Ghana Mmarahyɛbadwa mu maa Sunyani Apueiɛ mansini no na ɔyɛɛ afie dodoɔ no ara mpire panyin. Sɛ New Patriotic Party (NPP) mu ni no, onyaa mma mpem Aduanan-mmienu, aha-nson ne aduɔson-nwɔtwe(42,478 ) wɔ mma a  wɔtooeɛ  no mu a ɛgyina hɔ ma abatoɔ a wɔtoo no  wɔ mfeɛ Mpem-Mmienu ne Du-mmienu (2012) Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu nyinaa mu ɔha nkyekyem Aduonum-nkron, ne akyiri pɔ nsia(59.06%).

Abadwakuo Ahodoɔ 
Ameyaw-Cheremeh yɛ Atemmu abadwakuo no Titenani; a ɔyɛ Daa Ahyɛde abadwakuo no mu ni; ɔyɛ Amansan Mmara, Mmara ne Mmarahyɛbadwa Nsɛm Boayikuw no muni; na ɔyɛ Nhomasua Boayikuw no muni.

Ankorankoro asetena 
Ameyaw-Cheremeh yɛ Kristoni. Ɔwaree, na ɔwɔ mma baanan.

Baabi as Menyaa Mmoa Friiɛ

title: Mathias Kwame Ntow
text:
Mathias Kwame Ntow yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ ne Mmarahyɛ Bagua a ɛtɔ so nson a ɛwɔ Ghana Republic of the Fourth Republic no muni a ɔgyina Aowin Mansin ananmu wɔ Western Region wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Ankorankoro asetena 
Elder Ntow yɛ Kristoni, Pentekoste Asɔre no muni. Ɔware Owurayere Victoria Sam (a ɔwɔ mma baanum)

Mfitiase asetena 
Wɔwoo Ntow wɔ Nkwanta No.2 wɔ Dwoada Obubuo bosome ne da a ɛtɔ  so 11 wɔ afe 1957.Ɔkɔɔ Winneba Sukuupɔn na na ɔwɔ Bachelor of Education Degree wɔ Social Studies mu. Ná ɔwɔ Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo Abodin krataa A nso a efi Enchi College of Education

Ntow wiee Sukuupɔn a ɛhwɛ Nhomasua Winneba so a na ɔwɔ Masters of Art wɔ Nnipa Hokwan ahorow mu wɔ afe 2007 mu.

Adwuma 
Owura Ntow yɛ Nhomasua ho Ɔbenfo wɔ n’adwuma mu. Na GES (Principal Supt ne Social Science Tutor, Enchi College of Education) nso de no yɛ adwuma.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ntow yɛ  National Democratic Congress  amanyɔkuw (NDC) no muni. Wɔ afe 2008 mu no, ɔsii akan wɔ Aowin atenaeɛ a ɛwɔ NDC tekiti so maa ɔmanpanin a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmarahyɛ bagua a ɛtɔ so nnum no na ɔdii nkonim. Ná ɔyɛ Aowin Mantam, Atɔe Fam Mantam no muni. Na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛ baguani nso ma Republic of Ghana a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmarahyɛ bagua a ɛtɔ so nsia ne ason.

Beaɛ a menyaa mmoa fii

title: Joseph Sam Amankwanor
text:
Joseph Sam Amankwanor (wɔwoo no Ahinime bosome da a ɛtɔ so dunan wɔ afe apem ahankron aduonu nnan mu, 14, 1954) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni na mprempren ɔyɛ Ghana mmrahyɛbadwa no muni a ɔgyina Upper West Akim mpɛsoa anan mu. Wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduonu mmienu, (January 22, 2012) no, ɔdii nkunim wɔ abatoɔ a edi kan wɔ National Democratic Congress mu; Na ɔyɛ Republic of Ghana mmrahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so 5 ne 6 no muni.

N'ankasa abrabɔ 
Amankwanor yɛ Kristoni (Royal House Church). Wawaree a ɔwɔ mma nnum.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Amankwanor wɔ Ahinime bosome da a ɛtɔ so dunan wɔ afe apem ahankron aduonu nnan mu (October 14, 1954). Ɔfiri Adeiso, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Apueeɛ Mantam mu . Ɔyɛ obi a wawie sukuu wɔ Institute of the Motor Industry, London na onyaa ne adansedie krataa wɔ afe apem ahankron aduowɔtwe mu (1980).

Amanyɔsɛm 
Amankwanor yɛ National Democratic Congress (NDC) no muni. Wɔdii kan paw no sɛ ɔmmɛdi tumi wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nwɔtwe mu (December 2008) mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 18,736 wɔ abatoɔ 34,741 a ɛfata mu. Ɔgyinaa Upper West Akim mantam ananmu wɔ Ghana Republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so 5 no mu. Ɔdii tumi a ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ berɛ a wɔsan paw no wɔ afe 2012 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu denam abatoɔ 15,308 a ɔnyaeɛ wɔ abatoɔ 28,517 a ɛfata wɔ ne mansin mu no so.

Mmeaeɛ A Menyaa mmoa Firiiɛ 
Ghanaian Mp's 5th Parliament of the 4th Republic

title: Raymond Tawiah
text:
Raymond Tawiah Abraham (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da a ɛtɔ so du wɔ afe apem

ahankron aAuonu-num, January 10, 1955) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni akontaabufoɔ a na ɔyɛ Ghana Republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nnum ne anan no muni, na ɔgyina Yilo Krobo mpasua ananmu wɔ Apueeɛ Mantam.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Abraham wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da a ɛtɔ so du wɔ afe apem ahankron aduonu-num, (January 10, 1955) wɔ Yilo Krobo wɔ Ghana Apuei Fam. Ɔfiri Somanya wɔ Apueeɛ Mantam mu. Ɔkɔɔ Ghana Suapɔn na onyaa Diploma wɔ Ɔmanfoɔ adwumayɛ mu. Ɔnyaa ne MBA (Post Graduate School of Management, Paris, France) wɔ afe  mpem mmienu ne nsia (2006) mu, onyaa ne BSc (Administration) UG wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nson mu (2007) mu na onyaa ne EMGL (GIMPA) wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nwɔtwe mu (2008).

Adwumayɛ 
Abraham yɛɛ adwuma sɛ El Shaddai Medical Laboratory Limited kwankyerɛfo panyin. Ɔyɛ akontabufoɔ wɔ n’adwuma mu na na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbaguani ma Yilo Krobo Mansin a ɛwɔ Ghana Apueeɛ Mantam mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔpaw Abraham sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ mmrahyɛbagua no wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so wɔ ɔpɛnimaa bosome no mu wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nan mu (2004) Ghana Amansan abatow mu sɛ mmrahyɛbagua muni wɔ Fourth Republic of Ghana mmrahyɛbagua a ɛto so anan mu ma Yilo Krobo Mansin a ɛwɔ Ghana Apueeɛ Fam Mantam mu. Ɔnyaa abatoɔ no mu amma mpem aduonu ne ahansia aduowɔtwe nnum (20,685) wɔ abatoɔ no nyinaa a na ɛyɛ mpem aduasa nsia ne aha mmiɛnsa ne aduowɔtwe nson (36387) a ɛfata a wɔtoo no mu a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛ mu aduonum nsia akyiri pɔ nwɔtwe (56.80%). 

Ɔsan sii akan wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nwɔtwe (2008) Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu na ɔnyaa abatoɔ no mu amma mpem dunwɔtwe ne aha mmiɛnsa ne aduanan nnum (18,345) wɔ abatoɔ amma no nyinaa a ɛyɛ mpem aduosa nnan ahanwɔtwe ne aduokron nsia (34,896) a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ no mu a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛ mu aduonum mmienu akyiri pɔ aduonum mmiɛnsa (52.53%) tiaa wɔn a wɔsɔre tia no, Christian Kofi Tettey a ɔfiri New Patriotic Party a ɔno nso nyaa abatoɔ no mu amma mmpem du-mmiɛnsa , ahansia  ne aduonum nwɔtwe (13,658) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛ mu aduasa nkron akyir pɔ du baako (39.11%), Francis Opai Tetteh a ɔfiri Convention People’s Party a ɔnyaa abatoɔ dodoɔ a ɛyɛ mpem mmienu, ahanum ne aduokron nwɔtwe (2,598) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛ mu nson akyiri pɔ aduannan nnan (7.44%) ne Terkpetey Fred Kwasi a ɔfiri People’s National Convention a ne abatoɔ dodoɔ yɛ aha-mmiɛsa ne aduonu nnum (325) a ɛgyina hɔ ma hweɛ akyiri pɔ aduokron mmiɛnsa (0.93%) a ɛmaa ɔkuraa n’akonwa sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani ama mmrahyɛbadwa a Ɛto so Anum a ɛwɔ Ghana Adehyeman a Ɛto so nnan no mu ama Yilo Krobo Mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Ghana Apueeɛ Fam.

N'ankasa abrabɔ 
Abraham yɛ Kristoni na ɔyɛ Methodist asɔre a ɛwɔ Ghana no muni. Waware a ɔwɔ mma nnan.

Mmeaeɛ A Menyaa Mmoa Firiiɛ

title: Ignatius Baffour Awuah
text:
Ignatius Baffour-Awuah (wɔwoo no Ɔbɛnem 24, 1966), Ghana ɔmanyɛfoɔ yɛ Adwumayɛ ne Adwumayɛfoɔ Nkitahodiɛ soafoɔ.

Mfitiase asetena ne nwmasua 
Wɔwoo no wɔ Ɔsanaa,  Afe Apem Ahankron ne Aduosia-nsia(1966) na ɔfiri Nsoatre a ɛwɔ Bono Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔnyaa ne bachelor’s degree wɔ akontabuo mu wɔ afe Apem Ahankron ne aduɔkron mmienu (1992). Ɔsan nso nyaa ne post-graduate diploma wɔ management consultancy mu wɔ mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Du-nson (2017).

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ɔde ne ho kɔbɔɔ ɔsono kokroko Amanyɔkuo ( New Patriotic Party-NPP)no na na ɔyɛ Ɔmampanyin dadaa John Agyekum Kufour aban no mu ni sɛ Ɔmantam soafoɔ wɔ Sunyani Mantam badwa no mu.Akyiri yi ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔmantam soafo abadiakyiri maa Brong-Ahafo mantam no na akyiri yi ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔmantam soafo wɔ Kuffour aban koro no ara mu. Ɔperee Mmarahyɛbadwa akondwa no wɔ Sunyani West mansini no na odii nkonim wɔ afe 2008 mmarahyɛbadwa  abatoɔ no mu. Nanso ne akuo, NPP dii nkoguo wɔ ɔmampanin abatoɔ no mu. Wɔsan paw no sɛ MP wɔ saa amansin koro no ara mu wɔ afe 2012 ne 2016. Enti ɔyɛ mprempren mmarahyɛbadwani ma Sunyani atɔeɛ amansini no. Ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ deputy minority chief whip firi afe 2013 kosi afe 2017.

Kabinet soafoɔ . 
Wɔ May 2017 mu no, Ɔmanpanin Nana Akufo-Addo bɔɔ Baffour-Awuah din sɛ asomfoɔ dunkron a wɔbɛhyehyɛ ne kabinet no fã. Wɔde asomfo 19 no din kɔmaa Ghana Mmarahyɛ Bagua no na Aban no Kasafo, Rt. Hon. Ɔbenfo Mike Ocquaye. Sɛ́ Kabinet soafo no, Baffour-Awuah yɛ ɔmampanin no mu kuo no fã na ɛsɛ sɛ ɔboa wɔ gyinaesi dwumadi atitiriw mu wɔ ɔman no mu.

Abadwakuo ahodoɔ 
Baffour-Awuah yɛ Ofie abadwakuo no mu ni; ɔyɛ Hokwan Abadwakuo no mu ni na ɔyɛ Abadwakuo a Wɔpaw Nnipa Abadwakuo no muni nso.

Adwumayɛ 
Hon Baffour Awuah hyɛɛ n’adwuma ase sɛ Accountant a ɔne Europa Aman Nkabom Kuo a wɔde sika boa Micro-projects wɔ Atebubu. Afei ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ obi a ɔretete adwuma wɔ adwumayɛ so na awiei koraa no ɔbɛyɛɛ Adwumayɛ sohwɛfo wɔ Nsotreman Nkuraase Sikakorabea.

Wɔ afe 2001 mu no, ɔkɔɔ mpɔtam hɔ amammuisɛm mu wɔ aban kwan so a wɔpaw no sɛ Ɔmantam Panin (DCE) maa Sunyani Mantam no. Ɔyɛɛ DCE mfeɛ nnan ansa na ɔrebɛyɛ Brong Ahafo Mantam no Ɔmantam Ɔsoafoɔ Abadiakyiri wɔ afe 2005 mu na akyire yi wɔ afe 2006 -2008 mu no, wɔyɛɛ no ​​Ɔmantam Ɔsoafoɔ a ɔdi mu.

Baabi a Menyaa Mmoa Friiɛ 

Ateasefoɔ
New Patriotic party

title: Ahmed Ibrahim
text:
Ahmed Ibrahim yɛ Ghana amannyɔni a na ɔka mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtɔ so num ne nson no mu ɛwɔ ɔman Ghana mu, na ɔgyina hɔ ma  Banda abatoɔ mpesua no a ɛwɔ Bono mantam no mu, ɔnam kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo National Democratic Congress so na ɛkɔɔ mmarahyɛbadwam hɔ.

Abrabɔ ahyeaseɛ 
wɔwoo Ibrahim kɔtɔnimaa bosome no da a ɛtɔ so nsia (6) wɔ afe 1974 mu, wɔ Banda Ahenkro a ɛwɔ Bono mantam no mu wɔ ɔman Ghana mu. Ibrahim kɔgyee n'adesua nteteeɛ wɔ Ghana suapɔn University of Ghana ɛhɔ na ɔnyaa n'abɔdin krataa wɔ amannyɔsɛm mu ne Philosophy adesua mu wɔ afe 2001.

Adwuma 
Na ɔyɛ Flamingo Publications (Ghana) Limited adwumayɛfoɔ panyin

Amannyɔsɛm 
Ibrahim hyɛɛ n’amannyɔsɛm adwuma ase wɔ afe 2009 mu bere a wɔkaa sɛ ɔno na ɔdii nkonim wɔ afe 2008 Ghana Amansan Abatow mu maa ne mansin no. Afei wɔyii no sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so num (5) wɔ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu wɔ  Ɔbɛnem bosome no da a ɛtɔ so nson (7) wɔ afe 2009 mu.

Bere a ɔwiee n’ahennie a ɛdi kan no, Ibrahim sii gyinaeɛ sɛ ɔbɛsi akan bio wɔ afe 2013 mu na ɔdii Joe Danquah so nkonim de kuraa n’akonnwa no mu. Wɔ afe 2015 mu no, ɔsii akan na bio na ɔdii nkonim wɔ NDC mmarahyɛ badwa primaries mu maa Banda mansini a ɛwɔ Bono Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ saa mmarahyɛ badwa atenaeɛ yi mu wɔ afe 2016 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu, ɔnyaa mma no mu 6,167 a na ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 52.03% tiaa nea ɔne no reko no abatoɔ a ɔno nso nyaa 5,660 a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 47.76%.

Abadwakua ahodoɔ 
Ibrahim ka abadwakuo a wɔhwɛ sikasɛm so ntotoeɛ so; Nkitahodi abadwakuo no mu ni; ɔyɛ Mpɔtam Aban ne Nkuraase Nkɔso abadwakuo no mu ni; ne Adwumayɛ abadwakuo no mu ni.

Abrabɔ 
Ibrahim yɛ kristoni a waware, ɔwɔ ba baako.

Baabi a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Robert Kwasi Amoah
text:
Robert Kwasi Amoah (wɔwoo no Ahinime bosome a ɛtɔ so du-nson wɔ afe apem ahankron aduanan nwɔtwe, October 17, 1948) yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɔni ne Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so nson a ɛwɔ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nnan no muni a ɔgyina Achiase Mansin ananmu wɔ Apueeɛ Mantam mu wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so.

N'ankasa Abrabɔ 
Amoah yɛ Kristoni. Waware a ɔwɔ mma nwɔtwe.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Amoah wɔ Ahinime bosome da aɛtɔ so du nson wɔ afe apem ahankron aduanan nwɔtwe (October 17, 1948). Ɔfiri Achiase, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Apueeɛ Mantam mu . Ɔkɔɔ Osei Tutu Training College baabi a na ɔwɔ ne Certificate A. Ɔsan nso nyaa ne Diploma wɔ Agricultural education mu wɔ St. Andrews College  Ɔkɔɔ University of Education, Winneba na onyaa ne Bachelor of Education ne Master of Philosophy abodin krataa wɔ Guidance mu ne Afotu a Wɔde Ma.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Amoah yɛ New Patriotic Party (NPP) no muni. Wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne aduonu mu (2020) New Patriotic Party primaries mu no, ɔdii nkogu wɔ Kofi Ahenkorah Marfo anim.

Mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu (2012) abatoɔ mu 
Wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du mmienu (2012) mu wɔ Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu no, ɔdii nkonim wɔ Achiase mpɛsoa mmarahyɛ badwa no mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ no amma mpem dunan, ahammiɛnsa ne nkron (14,395) a ɛyɛɛ ɔha nkyekyɛ mu aduosia mmienu akyiri pɔ aduosia nson (62.67%) wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu berɛ a NDC mmarahyɛ badwa no muni Dr. Kwasi Akyem Apea-kubi nyaa abatoɔ no amma mpem nwɔtwe ahanum ne mmiɛnsa (8,503) a ɛyɛɛ ɔha nkyekyɛ mu aduasa nson akyiri pɔ mmienu (37.02%) wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu na... NDP mmarahyɛ badwa kandifoɔ Charles Kwabena Kurankye nyaa abatoɔ 73 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 0.32%.

2016 abatoɔ 
Wɔ afe 2016 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu, ɔsan dii nkonim wɔ Achiase Constituency mmarahyɛ bagua no mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 14,659 a ɛyɛɛ 68.74% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu berɛ a NDC mmarahyɛ bagua kandifoɔ Yaw Sam-Korankye nyaa abatoɔ 6,339 a ɛyɛɛ 29.72% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu na CPP mmarahyɛ baguani ɔkannifoɔ Botwe Ernest nyaa abatoɔ 328 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ no nyinaa mu 1.54%.

Badwakuo ahodoɔ 
Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu (2020) mu no, na Amoah yɛ Select Committee no Titenani a ɔreyɛ adwuma.

Adwumayɛ 
Amoah yɛ Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ Panin wɔ LA JSS wɔ Achiase

Adɔeɛ 
Wɔ kɔtɔnimaa bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne dunwɔtwe (May 2018) mu no, ɔsii dan wɔ oil palm adwumayɛbea a ɛwɔ ne mantam mu.

Wɔ Ɔgyefoɔ wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu aduonu  (2020) mu no, Amoah sii dan bi sɛ ɛbɛyɛ Achiase Mantam Polisifoɔ adwumayɛbea ti. Ɔsan nso maa sukuufoɔ du 10 sika a wɔde bɛkɔ akɔtoa wɔn sukuupɔn so. Ɔsan maa akuafoɔ a wɔwɔ ne mantam mu no nufuo na ɔkyekyɛɛ ngo nnuadewa bɛyɛ mpem aduosia 60,000.

Mmeaeɛ A Menyaa Mmoa Firiiɛ 

Ghanaian Mp's 5th Parliament of the 4th Republic

title: Joseph Appiah Boateng
text:
Joseph Appiah Boateng (a wɔde ɔdɔ frɛ no JAB1) yɛ Ghana amammuifo ne National Democratic Congress muni. Ɔyɛ mmarahyɛ baguani a ɔhwɛ Afram Plains South wɔ Ghana Apuei Fam mantam mu.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Joseph wɔ Ɔsanaa da a ɛtɔ so nnan wɔ afe apem ahankron aduoson nnum (August 4 1975) wɔ Obo-Kwahu wɔ Apuei fam mantam mu. Ɔnyaa Diploma wɔ Ayarehwɛ mu wɔ Australia Ayarehwɛfoɔ Kɔlege wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nwɔtwe (2008) kɔ si afe mpem mmienu ne du baako (2011) mu wɔ Paramatta. Ɔsan nso nyaa ne Post-Graduate wɔ Strategic Management mu wɔ afe 2020.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ɔyɛ National Democratic Congress no muni. Ná ɔyɛ Selection, Lands, and Forestry boayikuw no muni. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia (2016) mu no, Joseph paw sɛ ɔrenkɔ mmarahyɛ bagua akansi no mu bere a asɛnnibea bi penee nsusuwii bi a Dickson Adjei Danso de too gua sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ wosiw no kwan esiane nsɛmmɔnedi ho asɛm bi a wɔde tia Joseph nti.

Mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu (2012) abatoɔ mu 
Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu (2012) Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu, ɔdii nkunim wɔ Afram Plains South Constituency mmarahyɛ badwa no mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ no mu amma mpem dunan ahankron aduanan nsia (14,946) a ɛyɛɛ ɔha nkyekyɛ mu aduosia baako akyiri pɔ aduanan nsia (61.46%) wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu berɛ a NPP mmarahyɛ badwa mu kandifoɔ Adongo Anthony nyaa abatoɔ no mu amma mpem nson aha mmiɛnsa ne aduanan nwɔtwe (7,348) a ɛyɛɛ ɔha nkyekyɛ mu aduasa akyiri pɔ aduonu mmienu (30.22%) wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu, Independent mmarahyɛ badwa kandifoɔ Ahaligah Rapahel Kofi nyaa abatoɔ apem ahanwɔtwe ne du nnan (1,814) a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoo no nyinaa mu yɔ ɔha nkyekye mu nson akyiri pɔ aduanan nsia (7.46%) na CPP mmarahyɛ badwani Darfour Janet nyaa abatoɔ no mu aha mmienu ne nkron (209) a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ no nyinaa mu ɔha nkyekyɛ mu hweeɛ akyiri pɔ aduowɔtwe nsia (0.86%).

Mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu (2020) abatoɔ mu 
Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu (2020) Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu, ɔdii nkonim wɔ Afram Plains South Constituency mmarahyɛ bagua no mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ no mu amma mpem du nwɔtwe, aha mmienu ne aduanan nsia (18,246) a ɛyɛɛ  ɔha nkyekyɛ mu aduosia nsia akyiri pɔ aduonu nnan (66.24%) wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu berɛ a NPP mmarahyɛ badwa mu kandifoɔ Willie Horr nyaa abatoɔ 9,300 a ɛyɛɛ 33.76% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu.

Boayikuo hodoɔ 
Ɔyɛ Aban Awerɛhyem Boayikuw no muni na ɔsan nso yɛ Atwa Yɛn Ho Ahyia, Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma Boayikuw no muni.

Adwumayɛ 
Joseph yɛ nkɔsoɔ adwumayɛfoɔ/ɔdansifoɔ/dodoɔ nhwehwɛmufoɔ. Na ɔyɛ Twenties Jog Company Limited a ɛwɔ Sowutuom, Accra no kwankyerɛfo panin. Ɔyɛ Twimbros Enterprise aguadi sohwɛfo fi afe 1996 kosi afe 2007. Ɔsan nso yɛɛ adwuma wɔ Regis Care sɛ Ɔyarehwɛfoɔ firi afe 2008 kɔsi afe 2011.

N'ankasa abrabɔ 
Yosef aware a ɔwɔ mma baasa. Ɔyɛ Kristoni ( Pentekoste Asɔre)

Adɔeyɛ 
Wafi ase reyɛ nnwuma te sɛ sukuu, mmɔnten so akanea ne boreholes a wɔde bɛma.

Akyinnyegye 
Wɔkyerɛe sɛ wɔpam no fii Ghana, akyiri yi ɔde ne ho kɔbɔɔ National Democratic Congress na ogyinaa Afram Plains South Constituency ananmu wɔ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no mu wɔ afe 2012. Wɔkyerɛe sɛ ɔyɛɛ nsɛmmɔnedi wɔ New Zealand ne Australia. Wɔ 8 December 2017 no, wɔyii no fii bɔne biara mu ɛfiri sɛ na adanseɛ a ɛfata nni hɔ a ɛbɛfoa soboɔ no so.

Mmeaeɛ A Menyaa Mmoa Firiiɛ 

Ghanaian Mp's 5th Parliament of the 4th Republic

title: Muntaka Mohammed Mabarak
text:
Alhaji Mohammed Mubarak Muntaka yɛ Mmarahyɛdwani ma Asawase a ɛwɔ Asanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛ badwa a ɛtɔ so nnan, nnum, nsia , nson ne nnwwɔtwe a ɛwɔ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu. Na ɔyɛ Dɔm Kumaa kandifoɔ wɔ Ghana Mmarahyɛbadwa no mu.

Ne Mmɔfra Ase ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Muntaka wɔ Ahinime bosome 17,1971. Ɔfirii Akuse a ɛwɔ Ghana Apueɛ Mantam mu nanso n’awofoɔ firi Ghana atifi fam wɔ kuro bi a wɔfrɛ no Kumbungu mu. Ɔyɛ obi a ɛkɔɔ sukuu wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so. Ɔnyaa Masters of Science abodin krataa wɔ "Development Policy ne Planning" mu wɔ sukuupɔn no mu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnan (2004) mu. Muntaka twerɛɛ ne 'common entrance exam' wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduowɔtwe nson (1987), na ɔkɔɔ so nyaa ne "B.Sc Agric (Agriculture Economist) wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ( 2000) mu ɛna ɔnyaa ne "MSc Development Policy and Planning (Development Planner)" wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnan ( 2004) mu.

Adwuma 
Muntaka yɛ nkɔsoɔ nhyehyɛeɛfoɔ wɔ n’adwuma mu. Na ɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu so panyin wɔ 'Adwumapa Buyers Limited' adwumakuo bi a wɔtɔ kokoo ne nkrobata(RME) baako mu.

Amammuo mu adwuma

Mmarahyɛbadwani 
Muntaka dii kan kɔɔ Ghana Mmarahyɛbadwafie no mu wɔ National Democratic Congress din mu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne num (2005) mu bere a ɔdii nkonim wɔ 'by-election' mu wɔ Asawase mansini mu a na ne mma dodoɔ no ara yɛ mpem du-baako, Ɔha ne aduanan -mmienu (11,142 votes ), de sii  owufo Dr Gibril Adamu Mohammed nso a ɔfiri NDC a na w'adi nkonim wɔ akondwa no mu wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa  bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnan (2004) no anan mu, a na nnipa dodoɔ no ara wɔtoo aba no maa no no yɛ mpem nnan,  ahanan ne aduoson - nnan ( 4,474 votes ). 'Ghana Centre for Democratic Development' buu saa abatoɔ foforɔ yi sɛ "ɛteɛ na ɛda adi pefee, nanso ɛnyɛ nea ehu nni mu''. Akyiri yi ɔkuraa n'akondwa no mu  wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwa abatoɔ a wɔtoo no ​​Ɔpɛnimaa  bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe (2008) no mu. Ɔsan nso dii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ a ɛdi hɔ no mu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du- mmienu (2012) no mu. Muntaka yɛɛ 'Chief Majority Whip' wɔ mmarahyɛbadwafie mu maa National Democratic Cingress, Dɔm Kɛseɛ a na wɔwɔ mmrahyɛbadwafie ne dodoɔ no ara wɔwɔ Aban mu.

Ɔsoafo a ɔhwɛ Mmabunu ne Agodie so 
Na ɔyɛ Mmabunu ne Agodie ho soafo wɔ Ghana aban mu. Wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nkron (2009) mu no, Ɔmampanyin John Evans Atta Mills paa Mubarak sɛ Ɔsomfo a wɔayi no ama Mmabunu ne Agodie dwumadiberɛ no. Aman Mmabunu Badwa no bɔɔ ne nsam wɔ ne paa yi ho ɛsiane sɛ ɔyɛ abranteɛ na  mmrantebere mu anigye  wɔ ne mu nti . Ɛfiri sɛ bere a wɔpaa no no, na wadi mfeɛ aduasa - nkron (39years ). Ɔyɛɛ Ɔsoafo a ɔhwɛ Mmabunu ne agodie so kɔsii sɛ wɔmaa no kɔɔ akwamma bere a wɔrehwehwɛɛ soboɔ ahodoɔ a wɔdebɔɔ no faa kɛtɛasehyɛ ho no. Nanso, ɔgyaeɛ aban adwuma too hɔ wɔ bere a Ɔmampanyin Mills gyee nea nhwehwɛmufoɔ boayikuo no hunuiɛ no toom akyi. Akyiri yi wɔde Oduruyɛfo Abdul-Rashid Pelpuo sii n’anan mu.

Boayikuo Ahodoɔ 
Muntaka yɛɛ somfoɔ wɔ boayikuo ahodoɔ pii mu, a nea ɛka ho ne Aban Boayikuo, Boayikuo a Wɔpa Nnipa, Daa Ahyɛde Boayikuo, Akwahosan Boayikuo, Aboɔden abo ne Ahoɔden Boayikuo, Adwumayɛ Boayikuo, ne Boayikuo a Wɔpa Boayikuo.

Abatoɔ 
Wɔpaa  Muntaka sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani maa Asawase mansini no wɔ abatoɔ a ɛbaa mu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne num (2005) mu wɔ Ɔbenfoɔ Gibril Adamu Mohammed a na ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani saa berɛ no ma Asawase mansin no wuo akyi.

Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe ( 2008) mu no, ɔdii nkonim wɔ amansan abatoɔ no mu wɔ National Democratic Congress din mu maa ɔmansin korɔ no ara. Na ne mansin no yɛ Asanti Mantam mmarahyɛbadwa nkonnwa mmiɛnsa  no mu baako wɔ aduasa nkron a National Democratic Congress dii nkonim wɔ saa abatow no mu no mu. National Democratic Congress dii nkonim dodow no ara a ɛyɛ mmarahyɛbadwa nkonnwa ɔha ne du- baako 113 wɔ nkonnwa Ahanu ne aduasa (230) no mu. Wɔde mma mpem aduasa nsia, ahenum ne aduonum nson (36,557  votes) na ɛpaa no wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu a na ɛyɛ mpem aduosia- nnan, ahenan ane aduanan- mmiɛnsa (total votes  64,443) a ɛne abatoɔ a ɛfata nyinaa mu Ɔha mu nkyekyemu aduonum nsia akyire po aduonson mmiɛnsa ( 56.73%) yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Ɔbenfo Mohammed Abdul-Kabir a ofi New Patriotic Party  amanyɔkuo no mu, Elyasu Mohammed a ɔfiri People's National Convention  no mu, Mohammed Bashir Tijani a ɔfiri Democratic Freedom Party mu ne Alhaji Baba Musah a ɔfiri  Convention People's Party no mu. Yeinom nyaa mma  27,168, 371, 86 ne 261 wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ no nyinaa mu. Yei ne 42.16%, 0.58%, 0.13 ne 0.41% yɛ pɛ wɔ abatow a wɔtow nyinaa mu.

Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du- mmienu ( 2012) mu no, ɔdii nkonim bio wɔ amansan abatoɔ mu maa ɔmansin korɔ no ara. Wɔde mma 43,917 na ɛpaa no wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu  na ɛyɛ 77,034. Yei ne abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu ɔha mu nkyekyemu aduonum nson 57.01% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaa no sen Nana Okyere-Tawiah Antwi a ɔfiri New Patriotic Party, Jerry Joseph Quayson a ɔfiri Progressive People’s Party, Abdulai Umaru a ɔfiri People’s National Convention, Elias Mohammed a ɔfiri Convention People’s Party, Yakubu Adams Zakaria a ofi National Democratic Party ne Alhassan Abdul Majeed yɛ kontokrɔ no. Wɔnom nyaa mma 31,013, 458, 267, 251, 182 ne 946 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne abatow a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 40.26%, 0.59%, 0.35%, 0.33%, 0.24% ne 1.23% yɛ pɛ.

Muntaka kuraa mmarahyɛ bagua atenaeɛ no mu wɔ afe 2020 amansan abatoɔ no mu sɛ ɔbɛgyina ananmu wɔ Fourth Republic Mmarahyɛ Bagua a ɛtɔ so 8 no mu. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ 51,659 mu berɛ a New Patriotic Party mmarahyɛ baguani kandifoɔ no nyaa abatoɔ 31,256.

Muntaka wɔ Kwasida, Kɔtɔnimaa 17, 2023 no, wɔkoraa no sɛ National Democratic Congress mmarahyɛ bagua ananmusifoɔ maa Mmarahyɛbadwani ma Asawase Mantam no denam Masawudu Mubarick a ɔboroo no wɔ NDC 2023 mfitiaseɛ abatoɔ mu maa hokwan sɛ ɔgyina asɔre no ananmu wɔ afe 2024 mmarahyɛ bagua abatoɔ mu. Ɔde abatoɔ 1,063 dii nkonim tiaa Masawudu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 735. 

Ɛwom sɛ wɔn a wɔtaa Muntaka Mubarak ne nea ɔne no resi akan no akyi de, nanso Masawudu Mubarick nyaa ntɔkwaw bi a Ghana Polisifo Dwumadibea no adwumayɛfo tew so ntɛmntɛm. Polisifo no de wɔn ho gyee mu no amma adwene a ɛyɛ basaa no ankɔ soro. Muntaka akyigyinafoɔ bɔɔ soboɔ sɛ Masawudu Mubarick akyigyinafoɔ binom bɔɔ Asawase mmrahyɛbadwani a ɔdi tumi seesei a ɔrefiri mfimfini hɔ berɛ a ɔtoo aba no akyi.

Akyinnyegye Ahorow 
Wɔ afe 2020 amansan abatoɔ no mu no, wɔkaa sɛ Muntaka maa ne babaa a wadi mfeɛ 6 kwan sɛ ɔmfa ne nsateaa nkyerɛw ne abatoɔ krataa no, adeyɛ a ɛtwee kasatia kɛseɛ ɛfiri sɛ Ghana abatoɔ ho mmara ma nnipa a wɔadi boro mfeɛ 18 nko ara kwan sɛ wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ abatoɔ mu.

Ɔmampanyin John Atta Mills srɛɛ no ​​sɛ ɔnkɔ so nnya akwamma bere a wɔreyɛ adifudepɛ ho sobo ahorow a wɔbɔɔ no ho nhwehwɛmu no. Nanso ogyaee aban adwuma wɔ bere a Ɔmampanyin Mills gyee nea nhwehwɛmu boayikuw no hui no toom akyi.

Wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2021 mu no, wɔkyerɛ sɛ ɔkaa sɛ Asɛnnibea Kunini temmufoɔ bi de biribi a ɛbɛkanyan NDC mmarahyɛ baguani ɔbaa bi maeɛ de abɔ mmɔden sɛ ɔbɛma wato aba ama Mike Oquaye wɔ mmarahyɛ bagua no Kasafoɔ abatoɔ mu. Mmaranimfo kasa tiaa no kɛse na wɔka kyerɛɛ no ​​sɛ ɔmfa adanse mma.

Wɔbɔɔ no sobo sɛ Mmabunu ne Agumadi Dwumadibea no mpanyimfo binom bɔɔ no sobo sɛ ɔde n’adwuma di dwuma ɔkwammɔne so na n’ani nnye ho esiane sɛ ɔde ne dibea no dii dwuma de nyaa German visa maa n’adamfo abeawa a wɔkyerɛ sɛ ɔyɛ no nti. Nanso, nhwehwɛmu a 'CHRAJ' yɛeɛ akyi no, wɔyii no fii soboɔ no nyinaa mu wɔ nnyinasoɔ a ɛne sɛ adanseɛ a ɛdɔɔso nni hɔ a ɛbɛma wɔabu no fɔ wɔ nsɛmmɔnedi no ho sɛdeɛ Ghana mmara kyerɛ no.

Hon. Mutaka ne Assin Central mmrahyɛbadwani Kennedy Agyapong dii ntɔkwaw mu bere a ɔne no hyiae sɛ ɔbɛtwe no akɔ Mmarahyɛ Bagua Hokwan Boayikuw ahorow no mu esiane sɛ wɔkyerɛ sɛ ɔfrɛɛ ntuafo sɛ wɔne Ahmed Hussein Suale nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo a ɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ Tiger Eye a akyiri yi obi a wonnim no kum no no nni dwuma nti awudifo. Wɔn baanu mmrahyɛbadwafoɔ baabi a wohuu wɔn wɔ video bi mu sɛ wɔrebɔ wɔn ho wɔn ho ahohora wɔ mmarahyɛ bagua mu.

Ankorankoro Abrabɔ 
Muntaka aware Meimuna Ezideen Adul Wahab na ɔwɔ mma baanum (5). Ɔyɛ Kramoni.

title: William Agyapong Quaittoo
text:
William Agyapong Quaitoo (wɔwoo no Ɛbɔ da a ɛtɔ so du baako wɔ afe apem ahankron aduosia nsia, {September 11, 1966} wɔ Akim Gyadam) yɛ Ghana amanyɔfoɔ. Ɔyɛɛ mmarahyɛ badwani maa Akim Oda Mpɛsoa so, Apueeɛ Fam Mantam wɔ Mmarahyɛ Bagua a ɛto so nson (7) no mu. Wɔpaw no sɛ Ɔsoafoɔ Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ kuayɛ so wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmiɛnsa (2013). Ɔyɛ Tree Crops Development Authority no panyin.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Quaitoo wɔ Ɛbɔ da a ɛtɔ so du baako wɔ afe apem ahankron aduosia nsia (September 11, 1966) na ɔfiri Akim Gyadam a ɛwɔ Ghana Apueeɛ Mantam mu. Ɔkɔɔ Kalpohin Mfitiaseɛ Sukuu wɔ Tamale, Yoo Roman Katolek Mfitiaseɛ Sukuu wɔ Savelugu kasa mu ne Vitting Experimental Junior Secondary School wɔ Tamale ne nyinaa wɔ Ghana Atifi Fam Mantam mu. Ɔkɔɔ Ghana Secondary Technical School maa ne GCE 'O' Level wɔ Takoradi ne Oda Secondary School maa ne GCE 'A' Level wɔ Akim Oda. Ɔsuaa adeɛ wɔ Galilee College wɔ Israel baabi a ɔnyaa Diploma wɔ Agribusiness, Export ne Marketing Management mu. Ɔkɔɔ Cape Coast Suapɔn a ɔwiee sukuu no, ɔnyaa BSC (HONS) wɔ Chemistry ne Diploma wɔ Nhomasua mu. Ɔsan nso wɔ MBA wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu.

Adwumayɛ 
Quaitoo hyɛɛ n’adwuma ase wɔ afe mpem mmienu (2000) mu bere a wɔpaw no sɛ Market Development Manager wɔ OIC International. Ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ adwumayɛbea no sohwɛfo kosii afe mpem mmienu ne mmienu (2002) mu. Wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne mmienu (2002) mu no, wɔpaw no sɛ Programs Manager of Enterprise Works, Ghana baabi a ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ saa dibea no mu kɔsii afe mpem mmienu ne nsia (2006). Wɔ afe  mpem mmienu ne nsia (2006) awieeɛ no, wɔmaa no adwuma foforɔ sɛ Ghana Cocoa Board no sohwɛfoɔ kɔsi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu (2012).

Amanyɔsɛm 
Quaitoo yɛ Ɔsono kokroko amanyɔkuo New patriotic party no muni. Ɔyɛ kan Mmarahyɛ Badwa no muni a ɔhwɛ Akim Oda Mpɛsoa so. Wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne aduonu (2020) mu wɔ NPP mmarahyɛ badwa primaries mu no ɔhweree n’akongua maa Alexander Ackum.

Mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu (2012) abatoɔ mu 
Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu (2012) Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu, ɔdii nkunim wɔ Akim Oda abatoɔ mpɛsoa so mmarahyɛ bagua no mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ no mju amma mpem dunwɔtwe ahankron aduowɔtwe mmienu (18,982) a ɛyɛɛ ɔha nkyekyɛ mu aduosia akyiri pɔ aduonson nnan (62.74%) wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu berɛ a NDC mmarahyɛ badwa kandifoɔ Kwabena Nkansah Asare nyaa abatoɔ mu amma no mpem nsia , aha mmiɛnsa ne du nnum (6,315) a ɛyɛɛ ɔha nkyekyɛ mu aduonu akyiri pɔ aduowɔtwe nson (20.87%) wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu, PPP mmarahyɛ baguani Kofi Asamoah-Siaw nyaa abatoɔ 782 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ 2.58% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu, NDP mmarahyɛ badwa kandifoɔ Aninakwah Joshua Kwabena nyaa abatoɔ 278 a ɛyɛɛ 0.92% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu, Independent mmarahyɛ badwa kandifoɔ Baa Abora nyaa abatoɔ apem, aha nsia ne aduonu nsia (1,626) a ɛyɛɛ ɔha nkyekyɛ mu nnum akyiri pɔ aduasa mmiɔnsa (5.37%) wɔ abatoɔ no nyinaa mu amma a wɔtoeɛ ne Independent mmarahyɛ badwa kandifoɔ foforo Augustus Ennin Attafuah nyaa abatoɔ no mu amma apem ahankron aduokron mmiɛnsa (1,993) a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ no nyinaa mu  ɔha nkyekyɛ mu nsia akyiri pɔ aduonum nkron (6.59%).

Mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia (2016) abatoɔ 
Wɔ afe mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia (2016) Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu no, ɔsan dii nkunim wɔ Akim Oda mpɛsoa mmarahyɛ badwa no mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ mpem aduonu mmienu baako ɔha ne aduasa baako (21,131) a ɛyɛɛ ɔha nkyekyɛ mu aduoson mmiɛnsa akyiri pɔ nnan (73.4%) wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu berɛ a NDC mmarahyɛ badwa kandifoɔ Kwabena Nkansah Asare nyaa abatoɔ no mu amma mpem nsia, ahanwɔtwe ne aduokron mmienu (6,892) a ɛyɛɛ nkyekyɛ mu aduonu mmiɛnsa akyiri pɔ 9 (23.9%) wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu, PPP mmarahyɛ baguani ɔkannifoɔ Baa Abora nyaa abatoɔ 599 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoo no nyinaa mu 2.1% na CPP mmarahyɛ bagua no muni George Owusu Agyemang nyaa abatoɔ 161 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ no nyinaa mu 0.6%.

Boayikuo no 
Ná Quaitoo yɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no Boayikuw a Wɔapaw Wɔn a Ɛhwɛ Nhomasua So no Titenani.

Ɔgyaee adwuma sɛ Ɔsomfoɔ Abadiakyiri 
Wɔ August 2017 mu no, Quaitoo kaa nsɛm bi a ɛfa mmusuakuw ho faa nnipa a wɔwɔ Ghana Atifi fam mantam mu ho. Wɔ n'asɛm mu no ɔkaa sɛ " Yɛn nuanom [wɔ Ghana atifi fam], ɛyɛ den paa sɛ yɛbɛdi wɔn ho dwuma." Metenaa hɔ mfeɛ aduonu nson, meka Dagbani te sɛ Dagomba ne ne nyinaa. Wɔyɛ nnipa a wɔn ho yɛ den paa. Obiara ntumi nsi so dua. Sɛ obi ka sɛ asraafo nwansena sɛee n’afuw a, ɛsɛ sɛ onipa no ba bɛkyerɛ sɛ ɛyɛ nokware. Yenni saa asɛm no ho kyerɛwtohɔ biara. Ɛyɛ ɔkwan a wɔfa so gye sika fi aban hɔ ara kwa; ɛno na wɔyɛ bere nyinaa. " Bere a ɔkaa asɛm no wiei no, ɔmanfo nyinaa kae sɛ onnyae adwuma no kasa tiaa nsɛm a wɔkae no sɛ ɛyɛ mmusuakuw de. Wɔ ne frɛ a ɔfrɛɛ no sɛ onnyae adwuma no akyi no, wɔ Oforisuo 29, 2017 no, ɔgyaee adwuma wɔ aban kwan so sɛ Kuadwuma ho Ɔsoafoɔ Abadiakyiri. Kennedy Osei Nyarko na odii n'adeɛ.

N'ankasa Abrabɔ 
Quaitoo aware na ɔwɔ mma baanum. Ɔyɛ Kristoni na ɔsom sɛ Baptistni. Ɔka Borɔfo, Twi, Dagbani, Hausa ne Ga.

Mmeaeɛ A Menyaa Mmoa Firiiɛ 

Ghanaian Mp's 5th Parliament of the 4th Republic

title: Alex Kofi Agyekum
text:
Alex Kofi Agyekum (wɔwoo no Ɔbɛnem 18, 1962) yɛ Ghana amannyɔni a ɔka marahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so num ne nson a ɛwɔ Ghana Aman a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu a ɔgyina Mpohor Mansin ananmu wɔ Atɔeɛ Mantam no mu wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so.

Abrabɔ ahyɛaseɛ ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Agyekum wɔ Oforisuo 18, afe 1962. Ɔnyaa BA wɔ Cape Coast Suapɔn mu ne M.ED wɔ Management ne diploma wɔ Nhomasua mu.

Adwuma 
Agyekum yɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ ne nhwehwɛmu boafoɔ wɔ Cape Coast Suapɔn mu firi afe 1991 kɔ si afe 1992. Na ɔyɛ sikasɛm ho dwumadibea panyin wɔ Holy Child School firi afe 1993 kɔ si 2003. Ɔyɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo panyin boafo wɔ Holy Child School firi afe 2003 kɔ si afe 2013.

Amannyɔsɛm 
Agyekum kɔɔ mmarahyɛ Badwa mu wɔ Ɔbɛnem bosome no da a ɛtɔ so nson (7) wɔ afe 2013 mu sɛ mmarahyɛ Badwa ma Mpohor Mansini no wɔ New Patriotic Party tekiti so . Ɔda so ara wɔ mmarahyɛ Badwa mu, na wadi nkonim wɔ abatoɔ a ɛdi hɔ ( 2012 ne 2016 ) mu firi afe 2012.

Mmarahyɛ Badwa no paw no sɛ mmabun, agodie ne amammerɛ abadwakuo no dwamtrani a wɔbɛhwɛ Ghana Bɔɔlbɔ Fekuw no nsɛm mu.

N'abrabɔ 
Agyekum aware a ɔwɔ mma nan. Ɔyɛ Kristoni na ɔne Methodist asafo no na ɛsom.

Baabi a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Baba Jamal Mohammed Ahmed
text:
Ahmed Mohammed Baba Jamal ( wɔwoo no Kɔtɔnimaa bosome no da a ɛtɔ so nson(7 May) wɔ afe apem ahankron aduosia nkron (1969) mu) yɛ Ghana amanyɔfoɔ. Na ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni ma Akwatia Mantam. Ɔyɛɛ ɔsomfo abadiakyiri a wɔayi no sɛ ɔhwɛ Mpɔtam Aban ne Nkuraase Nkɔso so.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Baba Jamal wɔ afe apem ahankron aduosia nkron (1969) mu wɔ Akwatia wɔ Ghana Apuei fam mantam mu. Ɔwɔ MPhil wɔ Amanaman Ntam Amanyɔsɛm mu ne mmara mu abodin krataa wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu.

Adwumayɛ 
Ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ Meeme Business venture a ɛwɔ Akwatia no kwankyerɛfo panyin. Na ɔsan nso yɛɛ National Democratic Congress no kyerɛwfo panyin abadiakyiri. Mfeɛ nkron akyi no, Baba Jamal tumi kɔɔ bar no mu na ɛba sɛ ɔka mmaranimfoɔ 219 a wɔfrɛɛ wɔn kɔɔ bar no mu wɔ afe 2015 mu no ho.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔ  ɔpɛnimaa bosome no da a ɛtɔ so nson wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du mmienu mu (2012) no, Baba Jamal dii nkonim wɔ mmarahyɛ bagua no mu maa Akwatia mantam no nea edi kan, wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du mmienu 2012 Ghana Amansan Abatow mu a onyaa abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 50.44%.

Nanso ɔhweree nkongua no maa Mercy Ama Sey wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du nsia (2016) Amansan Abatoɔ no mu wɔ abatoɔ 15,905 akyi berɛ a Mercy Ama Sey nyaa abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoo no nyinaa mu 21,433.

N'ankasa abrabɔ 
Ɔyɛ Muslimini na ɔyɛ ɔwarefoɔ a ɔwɔ mma baanum.

Mmeaeɛ A Menyaa mmoa Firiiɛ 

Ghanaian Mp's 5th Parliament of the 4th Republic

title: Mark Assibey-Yeboah
text:
Mark Assibey-Yeboah (March 2, 1974) yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɛfoɔ ne Mmarahyɛ  Badwa a ɛtɔ so nsia ne ason a ɛwɔ Fourth Republic of Ghana, a ɔgyina New Juaben South Constituency ananmu wɔ Apueeɛ Mantam mu wɔ New Patriotic Party (NPP) tekiti so. 

Ɔyɛɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua a Ɛto so Nsia no Sikasɛm ne Mmabun ne Agumadi Boayikuw no muni na ɔyɛɛ Sikasɛm Boayikuw a ɛhwɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua a Ɛto so Ason a ɛwɔ Ghana Ɔman a Ɛto so Anan no Titenani.

N'ankasa Abrabɔ 
Assibey-Yeboah yɛ Kristoni. Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baasa.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Mark Assibey-Yeboah wɔ Oforisuo da a ɛtɔ so mmienu, afe 1974. Ɔfiri Obo-Kwahu, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Apueeɛ Mantam mu.

Ɔyɛ Presbyterian Mmarimaa Ntoaso Sukuu, Legon, Accra (GCE Ordinary Level) ne Ghana Ntoaso Sukuu, Koforidua (GCE Advanced Level) sukuuni dedaw. Ɔwɔ BSc (Hons) Kuadwuma Sikasɛm abodin krataa wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma Suapɔn (KNUST), Ghana ne MS (Kuadwuma ne Nneɛma Sikasɛm) wɔ Delaware Suapɔn, USA. Ɔsan nso wɔ MA ne Ph.D. wɔn baanu nyinaa wɔ Sikasɛm mu fi Tennessee Sukuupɔn, USA a wɔyɛ wɔn ho titiriw wɔ Amanaman Ntam Sikasɛm Kɛse, Sikasɛm mu Sikasɛm ne Sikasɛm Ho Nhwehwɛmu mu.

Wɔatintim Mark Assibey-Yeboah wɔ nsɛmma nhoma ahorow a agye din te sɛ Economic Record, International Journal for Finance and Economics, Journal for International Trade and Economic Development, ne The North American Journal of Economics and Finance mu.

Adwumayɛ 

 Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo, Tennessee Sukuupɔn, U.S.A
 Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo Boafo, Milligan Kɔlege, Tennessee, U.S.A
 Sikasɛm ho ɔbenfo panyin, Bank of Ghana
 Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo, Ghana Telecom (Mfiridwuma) Sukuupɔn Kɔlege, Accra, Ghana 
 Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ, Ghana Asoɛeɛ a ɛhwɛ adwumayɛ ne ɔman adwumayɛ so (GIMPA), Accra, Ghana
 Mmarahyɛ Badwa no muni, Ghana (Ɔpɛpɔn da aɛtɔ so nson wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du-mmiɛnsa mu de kɔsi Ɔpɛpɔn da aɛtɔ so nsia wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne dunson mu, January 7, 2013 - January 6, 2017; 1st term)
 Mmarahyɛ Badwa no muni, Ghana (Ɔpɛpɔn da a ɛtɔ so nson wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne dunson mu de kɔsi Ɔpɛpɔn da aɛtɔ so  nson wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu baako mu, January 7, 2017– January 6, 2021; afe a ɛtɔ so mmienu), odwamtenani, Sikasɛm Boayikuo 
 Ɔfotufoɔ
 Adwumakuo no muni, ADB Sikakorabea Ghana, Ɔpɛpɔn wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nwɔtwe mu de kɔsi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu mu, January 2018 - 2021
 Amerika Sikasɛm Fekuo no muni

title: Joseph Baiden-Aidoo
text:
Joseph Boahen Aidoo (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛnimma bosome ne da a ɛtɔ so 13 wɔ afe 1957) yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ a ɔyɛɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni maa Amenfi Apueeɛ mantam a ɛwɔ Atɔeɛ Mantam mu.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo no wɔ   Ɔpɛnimma bosome ne da a ɛtɔ 13 wɔ afe 1957 wɔ Wassa Afransie wɔ Wassa Amenfi Apuei Mantam mu wɔ Ghana Atɔeɛ mantam mu.Wɔ Wassa Afransie wɔ Wassa Amenfi Apuei Mantam mu wɔ Ghana Atɔeɛ mantam mu. Ɔwɔ abodin krataa wɔ Asase ho adesua mu titiriw wɔ Resource Development mu wɔ Ghana Sukuupɔn mu na ɔwɔ MPhil abodin krataa wɔ Asase ho adesua mu nso wɔ University Of Ghana. Ɔwɔ adansedie krataa wɔ Asase Nsakraeɛ, Kuadwuma ne Nkuraaseɛ Nkɔsoɔ mu firi Asase Nsakraeɛ Asoɛeɛ LRTI Taoyuang,Taiwan.

Adwuma 
Ɔyɛ Nhwehwɛmufo ne ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo. Na ɔyɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so na ɔyɛ nhwehwɛmufoɔ. Na ɔyɛ nhwehwɛmufo wɔ Institute of Land Management and Development ILMAD na ɔyɛɛ adwuma pii wɔ asase ne kokoo ho. 

Ɔayɛ ɔman nhwehwɛmufoɔ titire ama Amanaman Ntam Ahyehyɛdeɛ dodoɔ bi te sɛ Amanaman Nkabom Aduan Ne Kuadwuma Ahyehyɛdeɛ FAO ne Amanaman Ntam Aduan Ho Nhyehyɛeɛ Nhwehwɛmu Asoɛeɛ (IFPRI), Washington, ne H. R. Wallingford nso. Ɔwɔ nwoma dodoɔ bi a ɔde ne din ahyɛ mu.Wɔn mu titire ne K.Otsuka, J.B Aidoo ne ne mfɛfoɔ.A. R. Quisumbing, J.B AIDOO ne afoforo. 1998 "Mmea asase Hokwan wɔ Nsakrae a Ɛkɔ Ankorankoro a Wɔyɛ no Mu". K. Otsuka, J. B. Aidoo ne afoforo. 1998 "Nea ɛde Asase a Wɔde Di Dwuma Asoɛe a Ɛresakra wɔ Ghana Atɔe fam no ba ne nea efi mu ba". Cornish, G. ne Aidoo, J. ne Ayamby, I. (2001) Nsuo a wɔde gugu nnɔbaeɛ so wɔ nkuropɔn ho wɔ Kumasi, Ghana - akuafoɔ dwumadie ne aba a wɔnya ho nhwehwɛmu. Cornish, G. ne Aidoo, J. ne Ayamby, I. (2001) Nsuo a wɔde gugu nnɔbaeɛ so wɔ nkuropɔn ho wɔ Kumasi, Ghana - akuafoɔ dwumadie ne aba a wɔnya ho nhwehwɛmu. Dwumadie no Amanneɛbɔ. HR. Wallingford Ltd. Cornish, G. ne Aidoo, J. (2000) Nsuo a wɔde gugu nnɔbaeɛ so wɔ nkuropɔn ho mpɔtam wɔ Kumasi, Ghana: nsɛm a wɔhunuu firii nsɛmmisa nhwehwɛmu a ɛdi kan mu. Dwumadie no Amanneɛbɔ. HR Wallingford Ltd. Saa bere no Ɔmampanyin John Agyekum Kuffour na ɔpaw no sɛ Atɔe Fam Ɔmantam Soafo fi afe 2001 kosi afe 2006. Ɔsan nso yɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni ma Amenfi East Constituency firi afe 2001 kɔsi afe 2012 wɔ NPP New Patriotic Party tekiti so. Afe 2020 mu no, ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ Ghana Cocoa Board no sohwɛfoɔ panin. Ná ɔyɛ kan Atɔe Fam Ɔmantam Soafo nso. Wɔmaa no Best Construction Industry CEO of SIGA Award wɔ afe 2020-2021 mu

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuw no muni. Na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛ baguani ma Amenfi Apuei mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Atɔeɛ mantam mu ma mmarahyɛ bagua a ɛtɔ so 5 wɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu. Wɔde abatow 18,576 paw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so nyinaa mu 35,832. Eyinom nyaa abatow a ɛfata nyinaa mu ɔha biara mu nkyem 45.33 ne ɔha biara mu nkyem 2.83 Wɔpaw no sɛ Ɔman Soafo a ɔhwɛ Atɔe Fam Mantam no so.     

Wɔ afe 2000 mu no, wɔpaw Joseph Boahen Aidoo sɛ mmarahyɛ baguani ma Amenfi Apuei fam mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Atɔe Fam Mantam mu wɔ afe 2000 Ghana amansan abatow mu. Odii nkonim wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so. Na ne mansin no yɛ mmarahyɛ bagua nkongua 9 no fã wɔ nkongua 19 a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Atɔe Fam Mantam no mu.    

Onyaa abatow 14,578 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Onyaa abatow 14,578 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Wɔpaw no sen George Buadi a ofi National Democratic Congress ne Gabriel Yaw Amoo-Gyedu a ofi Convention People’s Party mu. Eyinom nyaa abatow 10,802 ne 694 wɔ abatow a wɔtow no nyinaa mu.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baanum. Ɔwaree na mmaanom.

title: Matthew Nyindam
text:
Matthew Nyindam (wɔwoo no ɔpɛnimaa 1, afe Apem, Ahankron Aduɔson Num 1975) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni , aban a ɛtɔ so nso wɔ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nson no mu a ɔgyina Kpandai Mantam a ɛwɔ Atifi Mantam no ananmu wɔ NPP  tekiti so.

N'ankasa Abrabɔ 
Nyindam yɛ Kristoni (Katɔlekni). Waware awo mma nnan.

wɔwoo nyindam wɔ December 1, 1975. Ɔfiri Kumdi, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Fam Mantam mu.[1] Ɔkɔɔ Sukuupɔn a ɛhwɛ Nhomasua so, Winneba na onyaa ne Bachelor in Education abodin krataa wɔ Social Studies mu wɔ afe 2007 mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Nyindam yɛ New Patriotic Party (NPP) no muni. Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔsii akan maa Kpandai atenaeɛ no wɔ NPP mmarahyɛ bagua a ɛtɔ so nsia a ɛwɔ republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no tekiti so na ɔdii nkonim.

Adwumayɛ 
Ghana Nhomasua Dwumadibea (ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo, Barikese SHS, Kumasi)

title: Magnus Kofi Amoatey
text:
Magnus Kofi Amoatey (wɔwoo no wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa da a, ɛtɔ so du wɔ afe apem ahankron aduanan nwɔtwe,10 December 1948) yɛ MP-a wɔpaw no ma Yilo Krobo Mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Apueeɛ Fam mantam mu. Ɔbɛyɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanin a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmarahyɛ badwa a ɛtɔ so nsia no muni wɔ berɛ a wɔaka mmarahyɛ badwa foforɔ no ntam wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn da a ɛtɔ so nson wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmiɛnsa (7 January 2013) wɔ berɛ a wɔagyae mmarahyɛ badwa a ɛtɔ so nnum no anadwo fa wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn da a ɛtɔ so nsiawɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmiɛnsa (6 January 2013). Sɛnea aban aba a Ghana Abatoɔ Badwa no de too dwa kyerɛ no, Amoatey dii nkunim wɔ Yilo Krobo mpɛsoa so mu abatoɔbea  ɔha ne aduonu nnan (124) no nyinaa mu gye mmiɛnsa (3) na ɔtoo abatoɔ a ne nyinaa yɛ mpem aduonu nsia, ahanum ne aduowɔtwe nnan (26,584), a egyina hɔ ma abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoo no ɔha nkyekyɛ mu aduosia baako akyiri pɔ aduannan nkron (61.49%).

N'ankasa Abrabɔ 
Amoatey yɛ Kristoni a ofi Presbyterian asɔre mu. Waware a ɔwɔ mma nnan.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Amoatey wɔ 10 December 1948. Ɔfiri Sra, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Apueeɛ Mantam mu. Ɔkɔɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu na onyaa ne Bachelor of Art wɔ Sociology mu wɔ afe 1990 mu. Ɔsan nso kɔɔ Ghana School of Law na onyaa ne bachelor’s degree wɔ mmara mu wɔ afe 1995.

Adwumayɛ 

 Nhyehyɛeɛ sohwɛfoɔ, Ɔman Badwa a Ɛhwɛ Amammerɛ So (wakɔ ahomegyeɛ mu)

title: Jeff Kavianu
text:
Jeff Kavianu (wɔwoo no wɔ Kɔtɔnimaa da a ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ afe apem ahankron aduosia nnan, May 2, 1964) yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɔni na ɔyɛ Ghana Republic of the Fourth Parliament a ɛtɔ so nsia no muni a ɔgyina Upper Manya Krobo Central Mpɛsoa so ananmu wɔ Apueeɛ Mantam wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

N'ankasa abrabɔ 
Kavianu yɛ Kristoni (Nkwa Asubura Foforo Ministries International; Ɔpanin a ɔdi Titenani). Waware a ɔwɔ mma nnan.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Kavianu wɔ Kɔtɔnimaa da a ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ afe apem ahankron aduosia nnan (May 2, 1964) mu. Ɔfiri Odumase-Krobo, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Apueeɛ Mantam mu. Ɔkɔɔ Gothenburg Sukuupɔn, Sweden, na ɔnyaa ne nyansahunu mu abɔdin krataa wɔ asetena mu adwumayɛ mu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nsia (2006).

Amanyɔsɛm 
Kavianu yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛ Badwa (NDC) no muni. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu (2012) mu no, ɔsii akan wɔ Upper Manya Krobo Central akonwa no so wɔ NDC mmarahyɛ badwa a ɛtɔ so nsia a ɛwɔ republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no tekiti so na ɔdii nkunim.

Adwumayɛ 

 CEO, Nkuraase Nsuo ne Ahoteɛ Dwumadibea
 Ɔpanin/ɔhwɛfoɔ/HR adwumayɛfoɔ.

title: Francis Kabenlah Anaman
text:
Francis Kabenlah Anaman (wɔwoo no 26 Ɔpɛpɔn 1960) yɛ Ghana amannyɔni ne Mmarahyɛ Bagua a Ɛtɔ so Nsia a ɛwɔ Ghana Aman a ɛtɔ so nnan no muni . Ɔgyinaa Jomoro mansini a ɛwɔ Atɔeɛ Mantam no ananmu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so..

Abrabɔ ahyɛaseɛ ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Anaman wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome no da a ɛtɔ so 26, wɔ afe 1960. Ɔfiri Tikobo, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Atɔeɛ Mantam mu . Ɔkɔɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so na onyaa abodin krataa wɔ Sikasɛm ne Asetra mu Adesua mu. Ɔnyaa ne postgraduate diploma wɔ Ɔman Adwumayɛ mu wɔ Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration wɔ afe 1999.

Adwuma 
Na Anaman yɛ asraafo

Amannyɔsɛm 
Anaman yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛ Bagua (NDC) no muni. Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔsii akan wɔ Jomoro atenaeɛ no so wɔ NDC tekiti so wɔ afe 2012 Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ no mu na ɔdii nkonim.  Ɔdii nkonim wɔ mmarahyɛ bagua a ɛwɔ hɔ seesei Samia Nkrumah a ɔyɛ Ghana ɔmampanyin a odi kan no babea no so.

N'abrabɔ 
Anaman aware a ɔwɔ mma baasa. Ɔyɛ Kristoni .
