title: Daniel Botwe
text:
Daniel Kwaku Botwe (wɔwoo no Ɔgyefoɔ da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nsia wɔ afe apem ahankron aduonum nwɔtwe mu, February 26, 1958) yɛ Ghana Mmarahyɛbadwani ma Okere abatoɔ Mpɛsoa so wɔ Apueeɛ Mantam wɔ Ghana. Ɔyɛ Ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Information ne 
National Orientation wɔ Ɔmanpanin dada John Agyekum Kufour ammamuo mu. Ɔsane bɛyɛ Ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Regional Reorganisation ne Development. Ɔsan bɛyɛ Ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Local Government, Decentralisation ne Rural Development wɔ Nana Akufo-Addo ammammuo mu.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Dan Kwaku Botwe wɔwoo no  Ɔgyefoɔ da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nsia wɔ afe apem ahankron aduonum nwɔtwe mu, (February 26, 1958) wɔ Apueeɛ Mantam wɔ Ghana. Ɔfiri Abiri Akuapem. Ɔkɔɔ sukuu wɔ Presbyterian Primary and Middle Schools wɔ Mabang wɔ Ahafo-Ano Mansini wɔ Asante Mantam wɔ ahyesia sukuu. Ɔyaa ne GCE Ordinary level certificate ɛfiri Kumasi Academy, na ɔyaa GCE Advanced level certificate wɔ 1977 ɛfiri Achimota School. Ɔyaa sukuu mu kwan kɔ Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology kɔ sua computer science.

Adwumayɛ 
Wɔ 1985, Ghana Cocobod faa Botwe adwuma sɛ kɔmputa analyst. Ɔyɛ adwuma no kɔ pem afe apem ahankron aduokron mmiɛnsa (1993), na ɔgyaeɛ kɔ yɛɛ akorankora adwuma. Yɛ yi sɛ director ma Danmaud Limited, akorankoran adwuma ɛwɔ Accra.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Bere a na ɔwɔ KNUST, ɔmo yi no sɛ kyerekyere foɔ panyin ma National Union of Ghana Students (NUGS) ɛfiri 1982 kɔsi 1983. N'abatoɔ no ne asolgyafoɔ manmou a Provisional National Defence Council nsa hyɛ asie. Ɛna sɛ ɔkasa tia sogyafoɔ amamou nti, ɔmo hu no sɛ ɔha adwene. Ɔmo de ɔno ne Ghanafoɔ bi kɔto afiase wɔ Ivory Coast. Ɔsan ba a Ghana bɛyɛ adwuma sɛ computer analyst wɔ Ghana cocoa board ɛfiri 1985 kɔsi 1993 ansa na ɔkɔyɛ n'adwuma.

Botwe kɔ gyina sɛ New Patriotic Party tweretwerefoɔ panin na ɔdi nkunim wɔ 1998. Na ɔdi akotene wɔ Ɔmanpanin dada John Kufour abatoɔ sɛ ɔmanpanyin wɔ 2000 abatoɔ. Ɔsan som amanyoɔ kuo wɔ akwan bebree, ɔkɔ yɛɛ National Treasurer ma Mmabunu kuo wɔ New Patriotic Party, ɔsan bɛyɛ Director of Operations and Research wɔ National Headquarters. Ɔmanpanyin Akufo-Addo kyere sɛ ɔyɛ nipa a ɔsom bo sɛ ɔyi New Patriotic Party ɛfiri opposition ɛde ɔmo ɛba aban mu wɔ 2001.

Mmarahyɛbadwani 
Dan Botwe kɔgyina sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ Okere wɔ afe 2008, bere na nea ɔgyina mmarahyɛbadwa mu deda, Brandford Kwame Daniel Adu yɛɛ n'adwene sɛ ɔtua so bioam sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani. Botwe yaa 11,974 mba ɛfiri 19,684 mma no nyinaa a ɛgyina hɔ ma 60.8% a ɛtumi ma no bɛyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani. Ɔtua so di nkonim wɔ 2012, 2016 ne 2020. 

Na ɔyɛ minority chief whip wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa ɛtɔ so nsia ɛfiri 2013 kɔ si 2017. Ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani w'aboa ne npesoa so bebree. Ɔhyɛɛ bo sɛ Dreams FC, agoro kansie kuo ɛwɔ Ghana Premier League sɛ ɔbɛboa mɔ ma wɔ abo wɔ bɔɔ wɔ Dawu a ɛwɔ ne mpɛsua so.

Frakaatuo 
Botwe kɔ gyina wɔ afe 2007 sɛ New Patriotic Party frankaatuofoɔ akansie. Saa akansie no nea amanyɔ kuo no hyehyɛ sɛ wode bɛyi obi ama no agyina mu ama wɔn mo ɛbere a Ɔmanpanyin dadaw John Agyekum Kufour ɛfiri aban mu sɛ Ɔmanpanyin. Botwe ne nipa 16 na ɛgyina wo saa akansie. Abatoɔ kɔ so wɔ Nkran ɛwɔ 22 Opɛnima, 2007. Botwe susu sɛ frakaatuo no hyia obi ɔyɛ ɔbabunu na nyɛ obi a wayin. Ɔdii nkuguo maa Nana Akufo-Addo dii nkunim.

Ɔsoafoɔ ɔhwɛ amanneɛ so 
Ɛfiri 2006 kɔsi 2007, ɔsom sɛ Ɔsoafoɔ ɔhwɛ amanneɛ so wɔ Ɔmanpayin dada John Agyekum Kufour amanmuo mu. Ɔbɛ dii Kwamina Bartels adeɛ wɔ asoa hɔ.

Ɔsoafoɔ ɔhwɛ regional reorganisation so 
Wɔ Opepon 2017, Ɔmanpanyin Akufo-Addo bɔɔ Botwe din sɛ ɔsoafoc a ɔhwɛ asoɔyɛ foforo wate, Regional Reorganization ne Development. Akufo-Addo tee asoayɛ sɛ ɛhyɛ mantam foforo ɔmo rebɛte. Ɔmo kyɛɛ Firaw Mantam yaa Oti Mantam, Atɔeɛ Atifi Mantam.

Aban asoafoɔ mpanimfoɔ 
Wɔ Kotonimma 2017, Ɔmanpanyin Nana Akufo-Addo bɔɔ Dan Botwe din sɛ ɔka asoafoɔ 19 ɔde tea n'aban mpanimfoɔ. Ɔde wɔn asoafoɔ 19 din no kɔ mmarahyɛbadwa fie maa mmarahyɛbadwa kasamafoɔ, Rt. Hon. Prof. Mike Ocquaye ka kyerɛ mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ no. Ɔka asoafoɔ mpanimfoɔ nti Dan Botwe ka asoafoɔ wɔn mo tu Ɔmanpanyin foɔ.

N'ankasa abrabɔ 
Dan Kwaku Botwe aware wo nkwadaa mmiɛnsa. Ɔyɛ Kristoni a ɔkɔ asore wɔ Baasere.

Nsɛm a ɛwɔ saa atwerɛwsɛm yi mu sua. Wobɛtumi di bi aka ho aboa Wikipedia.

title: David Oppong Kusi
text:
David Oppong Kusi yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ na ɔyɛ Fourth Republic of Ghana Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so nsia no muni a ɔgyina Ofoase/Ayirebi Mansin ananmu wɔ Apueeɛ Mantam mu wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so.

N'ankasa abrabɔ 
Kusi yɛ Kristoni (Methodistni). Waware a (ɔwɔ mma nson).

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Kusi wɔ Ɔsanaa bosome da a ɛtɔ so nkron wɔ afe apem ahankron aduonu nwɔtwe (9 August 1958). Ɔfiri Akyem Ofoase, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Apueeɛ Mantam mu. Ɔkɔɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfididwuma so na ɔnyaa ne Bachelor of Science abɔdin krataa wɔ adansie mfididwuma mu wɔ afe 1987 mu. Ɔsane nso kɔɔ Ghana Suapɔn na ɔnyaa ne Master of Business Administration abɔdin krataa wɔ adwumayɛ ho dwumadie mu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nsia mu (2006).

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔdii kan paw Kusi sɛ ɔmmra mmarahyɛ bagua mu wɔ New Patriotic Party (NPP) tekiti so wɔ  Ɔpɛnimaa bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nwɔtwe (December 2008) amansan abatoɔ mu sɛ mmarahyɛ badwani ma Ofoase/Ayirebi mpɛsua so. Ɔnyaa abatoɔ no amma mpem dunan ne ahankron aduasa nwɔtwe (14,938) wɔ abatoɔ no amma no nyinaa mu mpem mmienu ne ahansia ne dunan (27,614) a ɛfata a wɔtoo no mu a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekye mu aduonu nnan akyiri pɔ baako (54.10%). Ɔsane sii akan wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu (2012) abatoɔ mu a ɔdii nkunim wɔ abatoɔ no amma mpem du-nkron ne aduonu nnum (19,025) wɔ abatoɔ amma a ɛyɛ mpem aduasa mmiɛnsa, ahammienu ne aduosia mmienu (35,262) a ɛfata a wɔtoo no mu a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekye mu aduonu mmiɛnsa akyiri pɔ aduokron nnum (53.95%).

Adwumayɛ 

 Apam Sohwɛfo, Nkurow akɛse mu Akwan Dwumadibea, Accra
 Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni (Ɔpɛpɔn, 2005–mprempren; afe a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa)
 Nkɔsoɔ adwumayɛni/ɔdansifoɔ/dodoɔ ho nhwehwɛmufoɔ

Bara a Wɔbara Plastik 
Kusi kaeɛ sɛ wɔbara plastic a wɔde di dwuma wɔ Ayɛwohomumɔ bosome da a edikan mu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnum mu (June 1, 2005). Ɔkaa sɛ,"Sɛ yɛanyɛ ade seesei a,efi bɛka yɛn ho na yɛatua boɔ a ɛyɛ den daakye". Ɔsan nso kaa asɛm bi sɛ,"Yɛde pɛsɛmenkominya de daakye awo ntoatoasoɔ nkwagyeɛ reto dan mu sɛdea ɛbɛyɛ a mprempren awoɔ ntoatoasoɔ no bɛyɛ mmerɛ".

title: Alhassan Sualihu Dandaawa
text:
Alhassan Sualihu Dandaawa (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn 17, 1983) yɛ Ghana amamyɔni ne Mmarahyɛbadwa  a Ɛtɔ so Nson a ɛwɔ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nan no mu ni .  Ɔgyina Karaga abatoɔɔ mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Atifi Mantam no ananmu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

N'ankasa Abrabɔ 
Dandaawa yɛ Muslimi na waware a ɔwɔ abofra.

Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ ne Nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Dandaawa wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn da a ɛtɔ so du-nson, afe Apem, Ahankron ne Aduɔwɔtwe -mmeɛnsa (1983). Ɔfiri Karaga, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi fam Mantam mu. Ɔkɔɔ Islamic University College, Accra. Ɛhɔ na  ɔnyaa ne Bachelor of Business Administration abodin krataa wɔ Sikakorabea ne Sikasɛm mu wɔ afe 2009 mu. Ɔsan nso kɔɔ Mouncrest Suapɔn Kɔlege, Kanda-Accra kɔnyaa onyaa mmara ho abodin krataa.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Dandaawa yɛ kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress-NDC mu ni. Wɔ mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Du-mmienu (2012 ) mu no, ɔsii akan pereee mmarahyɛbadwa akondwa a ɛwɔ Karaga  no; na ɔnam ɔdii nkunim bɛyɛɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ Kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress-NDC tekiti so, mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson wɔ Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nan .

Adwumayɛ 
Adwumayɛfoɔ Boafoɔ, Amannɔne Nsɛm ne Mpɔtam Nkabom Dwumadibea, Accra

Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni (Ɔpɛpɔn 7, 2013–mprempren yi afe a ɛtɔ so mmienu).

title: Eric Kwakye Darfour
text:
Eric Kwakye Darfour yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɛfo na ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party no muni wɔ Ghana . Ɔyɛ Ghana Apuei Fam Ɔmantam soafo. Ɔmanpanin Nana Addo Danquah Akuffo-Addo na ɔpaw no wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2017 mu na Mmarahyɛ Badwa no mufoɔ penee so wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2017.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo no wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nkron, afe 1957 wɔ Achimota Accra. Ɔhyɛɛ ne mfitiaseɛ adesua ase wɔ Obo Aban Sukuu a ɛwɔ Obo Kwahu ne kurom. Ne mfinimfini sukuu adansedi krataa akyi no ɔyɛɛ adwuma kɔɔ St. John Grammar School ne Ofori Panin Senior High maa ne 'O" Level Ne 'A' Level.

Wɔ afe 1981 mu no, Kwakye Darfour suaa ade wɔ Dakar Suapɔn, Senegal kɔhwehwɛɛ abodin krataa a ɛkorɔn wɔ Franse kasa mu na akyiri yi onyaa BA (HONS) wɔ Franse ne Kasa Ho Adesua mu wɔ Ghana Sukuupɔn, Legon.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔpaw no wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu mu (2012) Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ no wie akyi na wɔsan paw no wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nson (2017) mu berɛ a ɔnyaa abatoɔ nyinaa mu ɔha nkyekye mu aduoson mmiɛnsa, akyiri pɔ aduanan nwɔtwe (73.48%) wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne dunsia mu (2016) Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ no mu.

title: Cecilia Abena Dapaah
text:
Cecilia Abena Dapaah a

wɔwoo no Ɔbubuo bosome da ɛtɔ so aduonu - nson wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduonum- nnan  (27th March,1954) no yɛ Ghana amanyɔni. Ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuo ni na ne ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani ma Bantama mansini no. Na,ɔyɛ Ɔmansoafo abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Nsuo Ho Nneɛma, Adwumayɛ ne Adan, ne Ɔmansoafo a ɔhwɛ Wimhyɛn ne Ahonidie ne Nsuo Ho Nsɛm so.

Ne Mmɔfrase ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Dapaah wɔ Ɔbubuo bosome da ɛtɔ so aduonu - nson wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduonum nnan. Ɔfiri Mpasatia a ɛwɔ Asanti Mantam mu. Ɔkɔɔ Ghana Suapɔn, na owiee sukuu no na ɔnyaa 'Bachelor of Arts' abodin krataa wɔ Franse ne kasa ho adesua mu wɔ afe  apem ahenkron aduoson nkron. Ɔwɔ adansedie krataa wɔ akannie mu wɔ Harvard Kennedy Sukuu mu, ne abodin krataa akyi adansedie krataa wɔ Amanaman Ntam Nkɔso Adesua mu wɔ Oslo Sukuupɔn mu.

Amammuo Mu 
Na Dapaah yɛ nkɔsoɔ adwumayɛfoɔ wɔ n’adwuma mu  na ɔyɛ Ɔmampanyin John Kufour boafoɔ titire. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne baako mu no, wɔpaw no sɛ 'Ghana Cocoa Processing Company Boayikuo no titenani. Wɔyii no firii adwumakuo no mu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne num mu, na ɔkɔ yɛɛ Ɔsoafoɔ abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Nsuo, Adwumayɛ ne Adan ho so nsɛm so. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nson  mu no, wɔyɛɛ no ​​ɔsoafoɔ titire kɔsii sɛ John Kufour amammuo no baa awieeɛ wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe mu.

Cecilia Dapaah yɛɛ Ghana Mmarahyɛbadwani firi  mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne num de kɔsi mfeɛ  mpem mmienu ne du mmiɛnsa. Ɔyɛɛ mmarahyɛbadwafie boayikuo ahodoɔ mu adwuma wɔ Ghana a ɛbi ne Adwumayɛ ne Adan; Afotufoɔ Boayikuo a wɔde ma Mmarahyɛbadwa no Kasafoɔ; Adwumayɛ, Asetra mu yiedie ne Mmabunu; Amannɔne Nsɛm Ho ; ne ɔman sika ho nsɛmTitiriw.

Mmarahyɛbadwani 
Wɔpaa Dapaah sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma Bantama mansini a ɛwɔ Asanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana nea ʋdi kan wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnan Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ New Patriotic Party no din mu .  Na ne mansin no yɛ mmarahyɛbadwa nkonnwa aduasa nsi no fa wɔ nkonnwa aduasa nkron a New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuo  no dii wɔ saa abatoɔ no mu  wɔ Asanti Mantam no mu. New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuo  no nyaa nkonnwa dodoɔ no ara a ɛyɛ mmarahyɛbadwa nkonnwa ɔha ne aduonu nwwɔtwe wɔ nkonnwa ne dodoɔ nyinaa yɛ ahanu ne aduasa mu. Wɔde mma  mpem aduanan baako ne aduosia nnan (41,064 votes) na ɛpaa no wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu a na ɛyɛ mpem aduanan nkron, ɔha ne aduoson nnan ( 49,174 total valid votes) a ɛne abatoɔ a ɛfata nyinaa mu Ɔha nkyekyemu aduowɔtwe mmiɛnsa akyire po num ( 83.5%) yɛ pɛ.[5][6] Wɔpa no sen Alhasan Napoh a ɛfiri National Democratic Congress ne Yaw Owusu Boafo a ɔfiriConvention People's Party mu. Yeinom nyaa mma a ɛfata nyinaa mu 14.8% ne 1.7% sɛdeɛ wɔ din didisoɔ no.

Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe mu no, ɔdii nkonim wɔ amansan abatoɔ no mu wɔ New Patriotic Party din mu maa ɔmansin korɔ no ara.Na ne mansin no yɛ mmarahyɛbadwa nkonnwa aduasa nnan  no fa wɔ nkonnwa aduasa nkron a New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuo  no dii wɔ saa abatoɔ no mu wɔ Asanti Mantam no mu.  New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmrahyɛbadwa nkonnwa ɔha ne nkron wɔ nkonnwa ahanu ne aduasa  no mu.  Wɔde mma mpem aduasa nsia,  ahenson ne nnwɔtwe (36,708 votes ) na ɛpaa no wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu na ɛyɛ mpem aduanan nnwɔtwe,  ahenan ne aduoson nsia (48,476 total valid votes cast) a ɛne abatoɔ a ɛfata nyinaa mu  ɔha mu nkyekyemu aduoson nnum akyire po aduoson mmienu (75.72%) yɛ pɛ.   Wɔpaa no sen Nana Osei Akoto-Kuffour a ɔfiri Ɔmanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress, Osei-Tutu Richard a ɔfiri Convention People's Party, Eunice Owusu-Ansah a ɔfiri Reformed Patriotic Democrats ne Stephen Kwaku Saahene a na ɔgyina sɛ kontokrɔ ho. Yeinom nyaa mma a wɔtoɛ no nyinaa mu 14.45%, 5.52%, 0.91% ne 3.39% sɛdeɛ wɔn din didisoɔ no.

Ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Wimhyɛn akwantuo so 
Wɔ 7 Ɔbɛnem 2017 no, Ɔmanpanyin  Akuffo-Addo yii no sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ Ɔmansoafo a ɔhwɛ wimhyɛn so.  Ghana Mmarahyɛbadwa no Boayikuo a ɛpaw no no yɛɛ nhwehwɛmu wɔ 8 Ɔpɛpɔn 2017.  Wɔ ne nhwehwɛmu mu no, ɔdii adanseɛ sɛ ɔbɛma wimhyɛn adwuma atu mpɔn wɔ Ghana, na nea ɛhia ne sɛ ɔbɛsan ahyɛ ɔman no mu wimhyɛn adwuma ase wɔ afe 2019 mu. Na ɔwɔ adwene sɛ, sɛ adwumakuo a ɛde nneɛma kɔ no nni hɔ a, ɛrema Ghana anya sika a ɛyɛ cedis ɔpepem pii.   Ɔman no mu wimhyɛn a etwa to ne Ghana International Airlines a ɛhwee ase wɔ afe 2010 mu.  Wɔ Oforisuo 2017 mu no, ɔbɔɔ amanneɛ sɛ Ghana renya nkɔsoɔ wɔ ɔpɛ a ɔwɔ sɛ ɛbɛyɛ wimhyɛn gyinabea wɔ Afrika Atɔeɛ mantam mu.

Ɔsoafo a ɔhwɛ Ahoteɛ ne Nsu Ho Nsɛm so 
Wɔde Dapaah kɔɔ Asoaeɛ a ɛhwɛ Ahonidie ne Nsuo ho Nsɛm so (Ministry of Sanitation and Water Resources) wɔ afe 2018 mu.[Wɔyɛɛ no ​​ɔhwɛfoɔ Ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Bɔbeasu, Mmofra ne Asetena mu Ahobanbɔ so afe baako (2021–2022).  Ɔsomm wɔ ne dwumadie mu sɛ Ɔmansoafo a ɔhwɛ Ahoteɛ ne Nsuo Ho Nsɛm so ansa na ɔregyae adwuma wɔ Kitawonsa 22, 2023, ɛnam aniwusɛm bi a wɔkyerɛ sɛ ɛfa ne fie aboafoɔ a ɔde wiaa $1,000,000, €300,000 ne Ɔpepem pii wɔ mpɔtam hɔ sika mu wɔ ne mpa mu nti.

Akyinnyegye 
Sɛnea nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo asɛm bi a Office of the Special Prosecutor (OSP) de too gua kyerɛ no, wɔde Dapaah too afiase Memeneda, Kitawonsa  24, 2023, wɔ 11:55 GMT. Na kyere no fa adifudepɛ ne dwumadi ahorow a wɔkyerɛ sɛ ɛfa adifudepɛ ho a ɛfa sika kɛse ne nneɛma a ɛsom bo ho, a wɔbɔɔ amanneɛ sɛ ne fie adwumayɛfo baanu wiaa fii ne fie wɔ afe 2022 mu.

Madam Hannah Fosua bi a wɔkyerɛ sɛ ɔyɛ Ɔmansoafo no kan karkafoɔ yere kaa sɛ ne kunu hweree n’adwuma a na ɔreyɛ ama Ms Dapaah ɛfiri sɛ ɔtwee adwene sii nnipa a wɔabɔ wɔn soboɔ no nneyɛeɛ so.

Andy Appiah-Kubi, Mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔhwɛ 

so no hyɛɛ nyansa wɔ TV3 so sɛ anka ɛsɛ sɛ Ɔmampanyin Nana Addo Dankwa Akufo-Addo de ne nsɛm a ɛfa Ɔsomfo no ho a ne ho nni asɛm anaa nea ɛnte saa ho no sie n’ankasa. 

Wɔ Ɛbɔ bosome 2023 mu no, Accra Asɛnnibea Kunini no hyɛɛ 'Office of the Special Prosecutor' sɛ wɔmfa sika a ɛwɔ ne sikakorabea akontaabu mu no mfi frigye mu na wɔmfa mma.  Dwumadibea no dii akwankyerɛ no so nanso akyiri yi wɔde ne sikakorabea akontaabu ne ne sika a ɔde asie no too nwini mu bio. Ɔfese no san de ne sika a ogye fii ne nsa no bae.

Na Abrabɔ
Dapaah aware a ɔwɔ abofra baako. Ɔyɛ Methodist Asɔre no muni.

title: Simon Osei Mensah
text:
Simon Osei-Mensah a wɔwoo no Kɔtɔnimaa bosome da ɛtɔ so aduonu nson wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduosia baako mu no yɛ Ghana amanyɔni, a na ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ mmrahyɛbadwa  a ɛtɔ so Nsia wɔ Ghana Adehyeman  nnan no mu. Na ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuoni wɔ Ghana. Ɔyɛ Asanti Mantam soafoɔ wɔ Ghana. Ɔmanpanyin Nana Addo Danquah Akuffo-Addo na ɔpaw no wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome mu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nson mu . Ɛna mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ no penee so wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome mu wɔ afe korɔ no ara mu.

Mfitiase Asetra ne Nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Osei-Mensah wɔ Kɔtonimaa bosome da ɛtɔ so aduonu nson wɔ Afe apem ahenkron aduosia baako mu. Ɔfiri Yachie kuro a ɛwɔ Asanti mantam mu. Ɔnyaa suahunu mu abodin krataa wɔ sikasɛm mu wɔ Ɔman ne Wiase Sikasɛm Suapɔn mu wɔ Sofia, Bulgaria, wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduokron baako mu. Ɔsan nso wɔ Sikakorabea ho Abodin krataa a ɛfiri Adwumayɛ Asoɛeɛ a ɛwɔ Odense, Denmark, a ɔnyaeɛ wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduokron nnwɔtwe mu.

Adwuma 
Osei-Mensah yɛ sikasɛm ho ɔbenfo ne sikakorabea dwumayɛni. Ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ adwumayɛ sohwɛfo wɔ Kuapa Kokoo Credit Union ansa na ɔrepɛ sɛ ɔnya amammuo dibea.

Amammuo mu adwuma 
Osei-Mensah yɛ New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuo ni. Ɔbɛyɛɛ mmarahyɛbadwani firi Ɔpɛpɔn bosome mu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne num  berɛ a ɔdaa ne ho adi sɛ ɔdii nkonim wɔ Amansan Abatoɔ mu wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa bosome mu wɔ Mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnan mu. Ɔtuu mmirika dii afe a ɛtɔ so mmienu ne mmiɛnsa na ɔdii nkonim. Na ɔyɛ ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Bosomtwe mansini so.Wɔpaa no sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani maa saa mansini yi wɔ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nnan, nnum ne nsia mu. Wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome mu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu mu, bere a n’apam no san baa n’adwuma mu akyi no, Ɔmampanyin Nana Akuffo-Addo paa no sɛ Asanti mantam soafo.[8]

Abatoɔ Ahodoɔ 
Wɔpaa Osei-Mensah sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani maa Bosomtwe mansini a ɛwɔ Asanti Mantam mu nea ɛdi kan wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnan Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuo no din mu.[5] Na ne mansin no yɛ mmarahyɛbadwa nkonnwa aduasa nsia no fa wɔ nkonnwa aduasa nkron  a New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuo  no dii wɔ saa abatoɔ no mu wɔ Asanti Mantam no mu.[9] New Patriotic Party no nyaa dodow no ara a ɛyɛ mmarahyɛbadwa nkonnwa ɔha ne aduonu nnwɔtwe firii nkonnwa ahanu ne aduasa no mu.[10] Wɔde mma mpem aduonu nnwɔtwe,  ne aduonum mmienu (28,052 votes ) na ɛpaa no wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu a na ɛyɛ mpem aduasa nnan ahanu ne aduonu num (34,225 total valid votes cast) a ɛne abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu ɔha mu abupɛn aduowɔtwe mmienu  (82% ) yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaa no sen Suleiman Mohammed a ɔfiri National People's Convention amanyɔkuo  no mu, Edward Isaac Boateng a ofi National Democratic Congress  amanyɔkuo no mu ne Paul Adomako Ansah a ɔfiri Convention People's Party amanyɔkuo  no mu. Yeinom nyaa abatoɔ a ɛfata nyinaa mu 1.0%, 14.3% ne 2.8% sedeɛ wɔn din didisoɔ no.[5]

Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe  mu no, ɔdii nkonim wɔ amansan abatoɔ no mu wɔ New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuo no din mu maa ɔmansin korɔ no ara.[6] Na ne mansin no yɛ mmarahyɛbawa nkonnwa aduasa nnan no fa wɔ nkonnwa aduasa nkron  a New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuo  no dii wɔ saa abatoɔ no mu wɔ Asanti Mantam no mu.[11] New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmarahyɛbadwa nkonnwa Ɔha ne nkron (109 seats) wɔ nkonnwa Ahanu aduasa (230seats) mu.[12] Wɔde mma mpem aduonu num, ahenkron aduowɔtwe nwɔtwe ( 25,988 votes) na ɛpaa no wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata wɔtoeɛ a na ɛyɛ mpem aduasa nson, ɔha ne aduokron nnan( 37,194 total votes ) a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu, a ɛne 69.87% yɛ pɛ, na wɔpaw no sene Suleiman Mohammed a ɔfiri People’s National Convention, Dr. Joseph Oteng Adjei a ɔfiri National Democratic Congress ne Gilbert Adler Alhassan a ɔfiri Convention People’s Party. Eyinom nyaa abatow a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 1.46%, 27.67% ne 0.99%.[6]

Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔdii nkonim wɔ amansan abatoɔ no mu bio wɔ New Patriotic Party tekiti so maa ɔmansin korɔ no ara. Wɔde abatow 34,790 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 52,269 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 66.56% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Joe Oteng-Adjei a ofi National Democratic Congress, Kwame Ofosu Chei a ofi Progressive People’s Party ne Yaw Wiredu a ofi People’s National Convention. Eyinom nyaa abatow a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 32.97%, 0.36% ne 0.11%.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Osei-Mensah yɛ Katolek Kristoni. Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baanum.

title: Tia Sugri Alfred
text:
Tia Sugri Alfred (wɔwoo no 12 Oforisuo 1956) yɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni ma Nalerigu/Gambaga mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi fam mantam mu ma Mmarahyɛ Bagua a ɛtɔ so 5 wɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu

Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ ne Nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Tia wɔ 12 March 1956. Ɔfiri Samini wɔ Ghana Atifi fam mantam mu. Ɔnyaa Mmoa Ho Nnuruyɛ ho Oduruyɛfoɔ wɔ Ibadan Suapɔn mu wɔ Nigeria.

Tia yɛ mmoa ho oprehyɛn ho ɔbenfo wɔ n’adwuma mu. Na ɔyɛ Central Veterinary Company a ɛwɔ Tema no kwankyerɛfo panyin.

Ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni firi Ɔpɛpɔn 2001 kɔsi Ɔpɛpɔn 2005.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Tia yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛ Bagua (NDC) no muni.[1] Na ɔyɛ boayikuw muni a ɔhwɛ Akwahosan, Budget Titiriw so.[2] Wɔdii kan paw Tia sɛ ɔbɛyɛ adwuma wɔ afe 2008 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu sɛ mmarahyɛ baguani muni ma Nalerigu Gambaga mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi fam mantam mu. Wɔde abatoɔ 15,443 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatoɔ 34,701 a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ no mu, a ɛne abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 44.5% yɛ pɛ.[4][5] Wɔpaw no sen Hajia Alima Mahama a ofi Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no mu, Banaba M Alando a ofi Ɔmanfo Ɔman Nhyiam no mu, John Bibirim a ofi Demokrase Ahofadi Kuw no mu ne Alhassan Zibilim a ɔyɛ ɔkannifo a ɔde ne ho. Eyinom nyaa abatow a ɛfata nyinaa mu 32.96%, 20.83%, 0.54% ne 1.17%.[5] Na ɔyɛ akwahosan soafo abadiakyiri a odii Rojo Mettle-Nunoo ade.

2000 Abatoɔ 
Wɔ afe 2000 mu no, ɔdii nkogu wɔ abatoɔ 12 a ɛfata a ɛne 44.30% yɛ pɛ wɔ amansan abatoɔ no mu sɛ mmarahyɛ baguani ma Nalerigu mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Fam Mantam mu no maa Issahaku A.Emmanuel a ɔfiri Peoples National Convention Party mu a wɔpaw no a ɔde 9,515 abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 33.70% yɛ pɛ. Abatoɔfoɔ foforɔ a wɔfirii mu wɔ abatoɔ no mu ne Alima Mahama a ɔfiri New Patriotic Party, Joshua D.Wundowa a ɔfiri National Reform Party, Hamidu Napoleon Dawuni a ɔfiri Convention Peoples Party, Majeed Inusah a ɔfiri Ghana Movement a wɔaka abom no mu. Eyinom nyaa abatow 4,407, 911,461,440 ne 12 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne 15.60%, 3.20%, 1.60% ne 1.60% yɛ pɛ wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu.

N'ankasa Abrabɔ 
Ɔwɔ mma baanum. Ɔyɛ Kristoni (Presbyterian).

Baabi a Menyaa Mmoa Friiɛ

title: Kweku Tanikyi Kesse
text:
Kweku Tanikyi Kesse yɛ Ghana mfiridwumayɛfoɔ ne amammuifoɔ.Ɔyɛ kanee Mmarahyɛ Badwa no mu ni a na ɔhwɛ Evalue Gwira abatoɔ mpesua so a, na ɔyɛ National Democratic Congress amannyɔkuo a ɛwɔ Ghana no mu ni. Ɔdii nkoguo wɔ ne sanba a na ɔpɛ sɛ ɔsan ba bio no mu maa Catherine Afeku dii nkunim wɔ afe 2016 mmarahyɛ Badwa abatoɔ mu a na wadi kan adi Catherine so nkonim wɔ afe 2012 mmarahyɛ Badwa abatoɔ no mu

Abrabɔ ahyɛaseɛ ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Kesse wɔ  July bosome no da a ɛtɔ so nson (7) wɔ afe 1967. Ɔfiri Bamiankor, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Atɔeɛ Mantam mu. Ɔnyaa ne Master of Science abodin krataa wɔ Automatic Control Engineering mu wɔ Universidad Central de Las Villas, Cuba wɔ afe 1994 mu.

Abrabɔ 
Kesse yɛɛ adwuma wɔ Tema Oil Refinery sɛ Projects Engineer firi afe 1997 kɔ si afe 2002. Akyiri yi ɔde ne ho kɔbɔɔ RAM Engineering Limited baabi a ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ Project Manager firi afe 2004 kɔsi afe 2009. Efi afe 2009 kɔsi afe 2012 no, Kesse yɛ KABK Engineering Limited no kwankyerɛfoɔ panin ][3] .

Amanyɔsɛm 
Kesse kɔɔ mmarahyɛ Badwa mu wɔ  Ɔbɛnem bosome no da a ɛtɔ so nson (7) wɔ afe 2013 a ɔgyinaa Evalue-Gwira mansini no ananmu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so. Ɔhweree atenaeɛ no wɔ afe 2016 mu maa Catherine Afeku a ɔfiri New Patriotic Party[2][3]

N'asetena mu nsɛm 
Kesse aware a ɔwɔ mma mmiensa. Ɔda ne ho adi sɛ ɔyɛ Kristoni.

Baabi a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Alhassan Mumuni
text:
Alhassan Mumuni (wɔwoo no Ɛbɔ da a ɛtɔ so Aduonu-mmeɛnsa, afe Apem Ahankron ne Aduosia-nson -1967) yɛ Ghana amamanyɔni  na ɔyɛ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nan Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson no mu mmarahyɛbadwani. Ɔgyina adehyeɛ a wɔwɔ  Salaga Atifi Fam mansini  no ananmu wɔ Atifi Mantam mu no anan mu wɔ mmarahyɛbadwafie . Ɔdi saa dwuma yi wɔ kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress-NDC tekiti so. 

Wɔwoo Mumuni wɔ ɛbɔ da a ɛtɔ so Aduonu-mmeɛnsa, afe Apem, Ahankron ne Aduosia-nson (1967) wɔ Gbung wɔ Ghana atifi fam mantam mu.

Nnwomasua 
Mumuni kɔɔ Nwomasua Sukuupɔn, Winneba; na owiee sukuu no nyaa Bachelor of Education abodin krataa.

N'ankasa Abrabɔ 
Mumuni yɛ Muslimi, na waware a mprenpren yi, ɔwɔ mmamu num.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Mumuni yɛ Kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress-NDC (NDC) no mu ni. Wɔ mfeɛ mmienu mmienu ne du-mmienu(2012) mu no, ɔsii akan wɔ Salaga atifi fam nkondwa  no so wɔ NDC mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nsia a ɛwɔ Adehyeman/Kwasafoman a ɛtɔ so nan no tekiti so.  Ɔdii nkonim.

Adwumayɛ.

title: Emmanuel Armah-Kofi Buah
text:
Emmanuel Armah Kofi Buah (wɔwoo no afe 1966) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni a ɔsomm wɔ Ghana aban mu sɛ Ɔmanpanin a ɔhwɛ ahoɔden ne Petroleum so wɔ Ghana manpanin John Mahama aberɛ so firi afe 2013 kɔsi afe 2016. Buah a ɔyɛ National Democratic Congress mu ni no yɛ Mmarahyɛ Badwa no mu ni a ɛwɔ Ellembelle mansini no mu wɔ Atɔe Fam Mantam mu.[3] Ɔyɛ Dɔm kumaa (Minority Leader) baanodani abadiakyiri wɔ Ghana Mmarahyɛ Badwa no mu bere a ɔde no bɛsii James Klutse Avedzi  ananmu no.

Abrabɔ ahyɛaseɛ ne nwomasua 
Emmanuel Armah Kofi Buah firi Atuabo wɔ Atɔeɛ Mantam mu. Ɔwɔ mmaranim abodin krataa wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so ne Nyansahu mu abodin krataa wɔ Adwumayɛ mu wɔ Maryland Suapɔn, suapɔn Kɔlege wɔ Amerika.[1][2]

Amannyɔsɛm 
Kofi Buah na Ɔmampanyin Atta Mills yii no wɔ afe 2009 mu sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ Ɔmanpanyin abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ ahoɔden so. Wɔ Ɔbɛnem bosome no da a ɛtɔ so du-nson (17) mu wɔ afe 2013 mu no, wɔyii Buah sɛ Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ Ahoɔden ne Petroleum so.[7] Ɔno na Hon. Boakye Agyarko bɛhyɛɛ n'anan wɔ afe 2017 mu berɛ a New Patriotic Party dii nkonim wɔ afe 2016 Ɔmampanyin abatoɔ mu.[8] Ɔyɛ mmarahyɛ badwani ma Ellembelle Mansini no firi afe 2009.[9] Ɔsom wɔ Adwadie, Nnwuma ne Nsrahwɛ badwakuo, Members Holding Offices of Profit badwakuo, Privileges badwakuo ne badwakuo a wɔhwɛ Selection so.

N'asetena mu nsɛm 
Buah wɔ mma mmienu. Ɔyɛ Kristoni.

Ɔkaa ne nhumu wɔ nneɛma mmiensa a ɛwɔ soro a akannifoɔ yɛ wɔ Logistics dwumadie bi mu a atirimpɔw wom. Wɔ saa podcast yi mu no ɔkaa ne mfitiaseɛ asetena nso ho asɛm .

Ɔkyerɛkyerɛɛ mu sɛ ne papa yɛ postmaster a owui bere a na wadi mfeɛ ason (7) pɛ. Sɛ́ agya a na ɔno nkutoo na ɔhwɛ fie no gyaa wɔn aban bungalow nkutoo no wɔtenaa hɔ kɔ sii sɛ wɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ wɔntu mfiri dan no mu. Ne maame faa asɛdeɛ a ɛne sɛ ɔbɛdi wɔn ahiadeɛ ho dwuma na wahwɛ ahu sɛ wɔbɛyɛ wɔn fie nnwuma ɛmfa ho sɛ na ɔnsuaa nwoma no. Owura Buah kyerɛɛm sɛ ɔno deɛ na ɔnnim da sɛ ne maame nnim nwoma kɔsii sɛ ɔnyinii kɛse efiri sɛ na ne maame dwene wɔn adesua mu nkɔsoɔ ho yie. Apereperedie a ne maame faa mu sɛ ɔbɛhwɛ sɛ wɔbɛdi wɔn ahiadeɛ ho dwuma no kanyan no wɔ nkonimdie kwan no so, na ɛyɛ n’asɛdeɛ sɛ ɔrenni ne maame hwammɔ.

Baabi a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Mutawakilu Adam
text:
Mutawakilu Adams (wɔwoo no  Oforisuo da a ɛtɔ so mmienu, afe Apem, Ahankron ne aduɔson-nan-1974) Ɔyɛ Ghanani akontabufoɔ ne amamanyɔni a ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson a ɛwɔ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu ni.  Ɔgyina Damango abatoɔ mpɛsoa no ananmu wɔ Savanna Mantam mu wɔ kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo (National Democratic Congress -NDC) tekiti so.

Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ ne Nwomasua 
Mutawakilu Adam firi Damango a ɛwɔ Savanna Mantam no mu. Ɔyɛ nkontaabufoɔ ne Sikasɛm sohwɛfoɔ. Ɔwɔ akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ abɔdin krataa  a ɛfiri Bagabaga Training College. Ɔnyaa abodin krataa wɔ (Buisiness Administration) mu wɔ University of Ghana,  mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne mmienu (2002 )mu, ne (Commonwealth Executive Master of Business Administration (CEMBA) wɔ  

Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne edu (2010) mu.

Adwuma 
John Evans Atta Mills na ɔpaw Mutawakilu sɛ ɔnsom sɛ mansini krakye wɔ West Gonja mansini a n’ahenkuro yɛ Damango, ɔno ankasa kurom no. Mutawakilu yɛɛ Ɔmansini Panin (DCE) maa West Gonja mansini no wɔ Ɔbɛnem, mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nkron (2009) kɔsi Ɔpɛpɔn, mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du-mmeɛnsa (2013) ntam.] Sɛ mansini krakye , no ɔyɛɛ adwuma de boa maa nnipa a wɔwɔ ne mpɔtam hɔ no asetena tuu mpɔn. Titiriw,  ɔde n’adwene sii nwomasua, nsuo, ahonidie ne apɔwmuden so. Na yeinom yɛ adeɛ a na ɛda n'akoma so pa ara.

Ansa na wɔrepaw no sɛ mansini krakye no, Mutawakilu yɛɛ adwuma sɛ Sikakorabea Panin ne Sikakorabea sohwɛfoɔ firi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne pɔ nan (2004) kosi mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne nkron (2009) wɔ Sukuupɔn a ɛhwɛ Nkɔsoɔ Adesua so, kane ( University of Develpement Studies),  Central Administration a ɛwɔ Tamale no mu. Ɔsan nso yɛɛ adwuma sɛ Class Tutor firi afe Apem Ahankron ne Aduɔkron -nsia) 1996 kɔsi mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Mmeɛnsa (2003) wɔ 

(Ghana Education Service).

2012 Abatoɔ 
Ɔsii akan wɔ Damango abatoɔ mpɛsoa no so wɔ  mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du-mmienu(2012 ) mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so. Ɔdii nkonim berɛ a ɔnyaa mma   9,518 a  na ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyem aduonum-nsia ne akyiri pɔ Aduɔson-nkron(56.79%) tiaa Albert Kassim Diwura a na  ɔbɛn no paa no. Ɔno nso sii akan wɔ New Patriotic Party tekiti so. Na a ɔnyaa mma a wɔtooeɛ no mu 7,041 a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyem Aduanan-Mmienu  ne akyiri pɔ baako(42.01%) Mutawakilu dii dwuma sɛ ɛdɔm kɛseɛ a wɔwɔ mmarahyɛbadwafie no baanodani wɔ  mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du-mmeɛnsa (2013) ne mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du-nson (2017) ntam.  Ɛfiri sɛ n’apam no nyaa tumi wɔ abatoɔ no mu ɛnam Ɔmampanin John Dramani Mahama so na wɔakura wɔn nkondwa dodoɔ no ara mu wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa  mu.

2016 Abatoɔ 
Wɔ mfeɛ Mpem-Mmienu ne du-nsia (2016) mu no, Mutawakilu sii akan san pere mmarahyɛbadwa akondwa  no wɔ Damango abatoɔɔ mpɛsoa no so  Ɔdii nkonim wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa abatoɔ no mu a ɔnyaa mma no mpemdu, Aha-mmienu ne aduosia-mmeɛnsa ( 10,263 ) a  ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyem aduonum-num ne akyiri pɔ Aduonu-Mmienu (55.22% ) ɔdii nkonim tiaa Albert Kassim Diwura, ɔkannifoɔ korɔ no ara a ɔfiri mfeɛ Mpem-Mmienu ne Du-mmienu (2012) abatoɔ no mu, a saa berɛ no na ɔwɔ mma no mpem nwɔtwe, ɔha ne aduasa-nkron(8,139)  a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyem aduasa-mmeɛnsa ne akyiri pɔ Aduɔson-nkron (33.79% ).  N’akuo no dii nkoguo wɔ Ɔmampanin Abatoɔ no nyinaa mu wɔ Ɔsono kokroko Ammanyɔkuo New Patriotic Party-NPP anim  no anim na na wɔahwere wɔn nkodwa dodoɔ no ara enti saa bere yi na ɛsɛ sɛ ɔsom wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa no benkyi a nnipa kakraa bi te no so.

Mprenpren yi, Mutawakilu Adam ɛdɔm kumaa a wɔwɔ mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson wɔ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nan no mu ni . Ɔyɛ Nnipa dodoɔ  kasamafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Atopaeɛ ne Ahoɔden so.Ɔsan nso yɛɛ Members Holding Officees of Profit Committee no mu ni.

Ɔsom sɛ Ranking member on Mines and Energy. Mutawakilu piapiaa sɛ ɔbɛnya sika afiri Ghana National Petroleum Corporation (GNPC) fapem hɔ ama nnwuma a ɛwɔ ne mansin mu. Nnwuma a wɔde besi hɔ no bi ne sɛ wɔbɛtu ntokuru nan a wɔde mfidie ayɛ,  KVIP mmienu  a nnipa 12 te mu wɔ mpɔtam bi a wɔapaw sɛnea West Gonja Mansini no bɔɔ amanneɛ no.  Wɔ Ɛbɔ 2020 mu no, Ɔsan nso de ambulance maa Busunu Apɔwmuden Asoɛeɛ no de dii bɔhyɛ bi a ɔde maa titire ne nkurɔfoɔ no so, sɛ ɔbɛboa wɔ ayarefoɔ a wɔde wɔn bɛfiri ayaresabea nketewa mu  akɔ ɔmantam ayaresabea no mu no. 

Mutawakilu wɔ ne dibea sɛ ɔmannifoɔ a ɔdi mu wɔ atopaeɛ ne ahoɔden ho no frɛɛ sɛ wɔkyere Ɔbenfoɔ Frimpong-Boateng, Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma ho Ɔsoafoɔ ne Asase ne Abɔdeɛ mu Nneɛma ho Ɔsoafoɔ nyinaa wɔ animguaseɛ a ɛfa mfiri a wɔtu fam bɛyɛ 500 a wɔyeraeɛ a wɔgye fii wɔn a wɔtu fam a mmara mma ho kwan no nsam no nyinaa ho adwumakuo a wɔfrɛ no Galamstop na ɛyɛe.

N'ankasa Abrabɔ 
Ɔyɛ Muslimi, na waware a ɔwɔ mma 5.

title: John Majisi
text:
John Majisi (wɔwoo no 11 Oforisuo 1956) yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ ne Mmarahyɛ Bagua a Ɛtɔ so Nson a ɛwɔ Ghana Aman a Ɛto so Anan no muni a ɔgyina Krachi Nchumuru Mansin ananmu wɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Abrabɔ mu Nsɛm 
Majisi yɛ Kristoni (Seventh-day Adventistni). Ɔwaree (ɔwɔ mma baason).[1]

Abrabɔ ahyɛase ne nnwomasua 
Wɔwoo Majisi wɔ Ɔbɛnem bosome da a ɛtɔ so dubaako(11) wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduonum nsia mu(1956). Ɔfiri Boafri, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.[1] Ɔkɔɔ Sukuupɔn a ɛhwɛ Nhomasua so wɔ University of Education, Winneba na onyaa ne MPhil wɔ Nhomasua Titiriw mu wɔ afe 2007 mu

Amanyɔsɛm 
Majisi yɛ kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo (National Democratic Congress) mu nipa. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem aduonu ne dummienu (2012) mu no, ɔgyina maa Krachi Nchumuru mpɛsoa no wɔ kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo no anan mu wɔ mmarahyɛbadwafie a ɛtɔ so nsia wɔ Ghana adehyeman amammuo a ɛtɔ so nan ne mu na ɔdii nkunim.

Adwuma 

 Kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ (Lecturer), University of Education, Winneba
 Mmarahyɛbadwani ( firi Ɔpɛpɔn bosome dɛ a ɛtɔ so nson bɛsi mprenprem yi,  afe ɛtɔ so mmienu)

title: Francis Adu-Blay Koffie
text:
Francis Adu-Blay Koffie yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ a ɔyɛɛ mmarahyɛ baguani wɔ Prestea-Huni Valley Constituency firi afe 2009 kɔsi afe 2017.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Koffie wɔ Ahinime bosome ne da ɛtɔ 25 wɔ afe 1962. Ɔfiri Heman a ɛwɔ Ghana Atɔeɛ Mantam mu. Ɔnyaa ne mfitiaseɛ nwomasua wɔ Prestea LA Mfinimfini Sukuu mu a ɔde ne Mfinimfini Sukuu Awieeɛ Certificate wieeɛ wɔ afe 1979 mu.Ɔnyaa ne diploma wɔ akontabuo mu wɔ Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration..

Adwuma 
Koffie yɛ obi a otu fam wɔ n’adwuma mu.  Ansa na ɔrekɔ amammuisɛm mu no, na ɔyɛ Prestea Sankofa Goldfields Company Limited sotɔɔ sohwɛfo boafo.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Koffie kɔɔ mmarahyɛ bagua mu wɔ 7 Ɔbɛnem 2009 a ogyinaa Prestea-Huni Bon mu Mansin ananmu wɔ National Democratic Congress (NDC) tekiti so. Ɔkɔɔ so traa mmarahyɛ bagua mu bere a ɛto so abien a ɛtoatoa so nanso odii nkogu wɔ Barbara Oten-Gyasi a ofi Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no mu wɔ mmɔden a ɛto so abiɛsa a ɔbɔe sɛ obegye agua no mu.

Bere a na ɔwɔ mmarahyɛ bagua mu no, Koffie somee wɔ mmarahyɛ bagua boayikuw ahorow mu, a emu bi ne; Budget Boayikuw Titiriw, ne Adwumayɛ ne Adan Boayikuw no.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Koffie aware na ɔwɔ mma baanan. Ɔda ne ho adi sɛ ɔyɛ Kristoni.

title: Theophilus Tettey Chaie
text:
Theophilus Tetteh Chaie (wɔwoo no Ayɛwohomumɔ 4, 1972) yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ ne Ɔman a ɛtɔ so nnan Mmarahyɛ Bagua a ɛtɔ so nsia no muni a ɔgyina Ablekuma Mfinimfini Mansin ananmu wɔ Nkran Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Chaie wɔ Ayɛwohomumɔ 4, afe 1972. Ɔfiri Osudoku, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Kurowpɔn Nkran Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Owiee Chartered Institute of Marketing, UK, na onyaa ne Abodin krataa wɔ aguadi mu wɔ afe 1981 mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔdii kan paw Chaie anaa wɔtoo aba yii no sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ Mmarahyɛ Baguafo wɔ National Democratic Congress (NDC) tekiti so maa Ablekuma Mfinfini mantam mu wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2009 mu. Onyaa abatow no mu 43,253, a egyina hɔ ma ɔha biara mu 51.01. Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔsii akan sɛ wɔbɛsan apaw no bio wɔ Ablekuma Mfifini mantam mmarahyɛ bagua atenaeɛ no so wɔ NDC mmarahyɛ bagua a ɛtɔ so nsia a ɛwɔ ɔman a ɛtɔ so nnan no tekiti so na ɔdii nkonim nyaa abatoɔ 43,253 wɔ abatoɔ 84,785 a ɛfata a wɔtoo wɔ ne Mansin mu no mu.

Ankorankoro Asetra 
Chaie yɛ Kristoni na ɔyɛ Methodist Asɔre no muni. Wɔaware na ɔwɔ abofra baako.

Adwuma 
Na Chaie yɛ St. Charles Ahosiesie Sukuu a ɛwɔ Nkran no Panyin na ɔyɛ nhomasua ho ɔbenfo, ansa na ɔregye penee no sɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni.

title: Joseph Cudjoe
text:
Joseph Cudjoe yɛ Ghana amannyɔni ne Mmarahyɛ Badwani a ɔka mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson a ɛwɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu a ɔgyina hɔ ma Effia Mansini a ɛwɔ Atɔeɛ Mantam mu wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so.

Ɔbra ahyɛaseɛ ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Cudjoe wɔ Ahinimi bosome no da a ɛtɔ so mmienu (2) wɔ afe 1964 mu. Ɔfiri Effia kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Atɔeɛ Mantam mu. Ɔnyaa ne Bachelor of Science abɔdin krataa wɔ akontabuo mu wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so, Kumasi ne ne MBA wɔ Sikasɛm mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu.

Adwumayɛ 
Joseph Cudjoe hyɛɛ n’adwuma ase sɛ Ɔkyerɛkyerɛni a ɔkyerɛ Nkontaabuo wɔ Archbishop Porter Girls Secondary School firi ɔpɛpɔn bosome no mu wɔ afe 1995 kɔsi Ahinimi bosome no mu wɔ afe 1995. Cudjoe yɛɛ adwuma sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ wɔ Takoradi Technical University firi afe 1995 kɔsii 2000. Akyiri yi ɔde ne ho kɔbɔɔ Eno International, LLC baabi a ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ  Sikasɛm mu Nhwehwɛmu ne Nhyehyɛeɛ sohwɛfoɔ firi afe 2000 kɔsi afe 2001. Ɔbɛyɛɛ Ɔfotufoɔ Panyin wɔ SEM International Associates wɔ Ayɛwohomumɔ bosome no mu wɔ afe  2002 kɔsi Ahinime bosome no mu wɔ afe 2003 na afei akyiri yi ɔbɛyɛɛ adwuma sohwɛfoɔ panin wɔ SEM International LTD firi Ɔpɛpɔn bosome no mu wɔ afe 2003 kɔsi Oforisuo  bosome no mu wɔ afe 2004.Efi Ayɛwohomumɔ bosome no mu wɔ afe 2004 kɔsi Ɔpɛpɔn  bosome no mu wɔ afe 2012, Cudjoe na ɔyɛ Sikakorabea sohwɛfo wɔ Ghana Koko badwakuo no mu.

Amannyɔsɛm 
Cudjoe kɔɔ mmarahyɛ badwa mu wɔ Ɔbɛnem  bosome no da a ɛtɔ so nson (7) mu wɔ afe 2013 a ɔgyinaa Effia mansini no ananmu wɔ New Patriotic Party tekiti so. Wɔpaw no bio sɛ ɔmmɛgyina mansini no ananmu wɔ afe 2016 mu

N'asetena mu nsɛm 
Cudjoe aware na ɔwɔ mma mmiensa. Ɔkyerɛ sɛ ɔyɛ Kristoni.

title: Shaibu Mahama
text:
Shaibu Mahama (wɔwoo no Ahinime 15, 1970) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne Mmarahyɛbadwa a Ɛtɔ so Nson a ɛwɔ Ghana Adehyeman mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔgyina Daboya-Mankarigu abatoɔ mpɛsoa no ananmu wɔ Atifi Mantam mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ ne Nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Mahama wɔ Ahinime 15, 1970. Ɔfiri Daboya, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Fam Mantam mu. Ɔkɔɔ Leicester Adwumayɛ Sukuu, UK na onyaa ne Master of Business Administration abodin krataa wɔ sikasɛm mu wɔ afe 2001 mu . Afei, ɔsan nso kɔɔ Cape Coast Suapɔn, Ghana na onyaa Bachelor of Commerce a Diploma wɔ Nhomasua mu wɔ afe 1997 mu. Ɔsan nso kɔɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so, ne Ghana Mmara Sukuu, wɔ afe 2008 ne 2010 mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Mahama yɛ kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress -NDC) no mu ni. Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔsii akan maa Daboya-Mankarigu atenaeɛ no wɔ NDC mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nsia a ɛwɔ ɔman a ɛtɔ so nnan no tekiti so na ɔdii nkonim.

Adwumayɛ 
Mmara Dwumadibea, Savanna Nkɔso a Ɛyɛ Ntɛmntɛm Bagua (SADA), Accra Dwumadibea

N'ankasa Abrabɔ 
Mahama yɛ Muslimi, na waware na ɔwɔ mma baanum.

Ateasefoɔ
Mmarahyɛbadwani
National Democratic Congress-NDC

title: Azumah Namoro Sanda
text:
Azumah Namoro Sanda (wɔwoo no  Ɔbɛnem 4 afe Apem, Ahankron ne Aduonum Nsia 1956) yɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani ma Kyerepɔni wɔ Ghana Atifi fam mantam mu. Ɔyɛ Fourth Republic of Ghana Mmarahyɛ Bagua a Ɛto so Nsia no muni a ogyina Kyerepɔni Mantam a ɛwɔ Atifi Mantam no ananmu wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so.

Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ ne Nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Sanda wɔ 4 Ɔbɛnem 1956 wɔ Tiekasu wɔ Atifi fam mantam mu. Ɔnyaa abodin krataa wɔ Mfitiaseɛ Nwomasua mu wɔ Sukuupɔn a ɛhwɛ Nhomasua so, Winneba wɔ afe 2005 mu.

Adwuma 
Azmah yɛ nwomasua ho ɔbenfo.  Ɔyɛ Ɔmantam Ntamgyinafoɔ, Sukuu firi Ɛbɔ, mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Mmeɛnsa(2003) kɔsi Ɔpɛpɔn , mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne nkron(2009). Ɔyɛ okuani.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Sanda yɛ ɔsono kokroko ammanyɔkuo ( New Patriotic Party-NPP) no mu ni. Wɔ mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Du-mmienu(2012) mu no, ɔsii akan wɔ Chereponi atenaeɛ no so wɔ NPP mmarahyɛ bagua a ɛtɔ so nsia a ɛwɔ republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no tekiti so na ɔdii nkonim.

Ankorankoro 
Sanda aware na ɔwɔ mma baakron. Ɔyɛ Nkramofo.

title: Kingsley Aboagye-Gyedu
text:
Kingsley Aboagye Gyedu (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn 29, 1969) yɛ Ghana amannyɔni na ɔyɛ Ghana Mmarahyɛ Badwa no mu ni. Ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party no mu ni, na ɔyɛ ɔman soafoɔ abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ akwahosan so ne kan ɔmantam soafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Ghana Atɔeɛ Atifi Mantam so.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Gyedu wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome no da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nkron, wɔ afe apem ahankron aduosia nsia (29, 1969. Ɔfiri Sefwi Anhiawuso kuro a ɛwɔ Ghana atɔeɛ mantam mu.[6] Ɔwɔ MBA wɔ sikasɛm mu wɔ Leister Suapɔn a ɛwɔ UK, na ɔnyaa ne CA wɔ Ghana ne ne BA wɔ sikasɛm mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn, Legon.

Adwuma 
Gyedu yɛ sikasɛm mu nhwehwɛmufoɔ wɔ USAID wɔ afe 2005 mu, na ɔyɛ Sikasɛm sohwɛfoɔ wɔ Bat West Africa Area firi afe 2005 kɔsi afe 2007 ne ɔkwankyerɛfoɔ panin wɔ Kingsag Associates Limited firi afe 2007 kɔsi afe 2012.

Ankorankoro asetena 
Gyedu da ne ho adi sɛ ɔyɛ Kristoni ne Methodistni. Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma nan.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Gyedu nyaa abatoɔ 33,145 a ɛyɛ abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 51.80%, na ɔnam saa kwan yi so dii nkonim wɔ Bibiani-Anwiaso-Bekwai mansini a ɛwɔ Ghana Atɔeɛ Mantam mu no atenaeɛ.[6] Wɔpaw no sɛ ɔmmɛka asase ne kwaeɛ ho badwakuo ne ɔmanfoɔ akontaabu badwakuo no ho.

Baabi a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Kobena Mensah Woyome
text:
Kobla Mensah Wisdom Woyome yɛ Ghana amannyɔni ne Mmarahyɛ Badwa ni a na ɔwɔ mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtɔ so nson a ɛwɔ Fourth Republic of Ghana no mu a ɔgyina South Tongu abatoɔ mpesua no a ɛwɔ Volta Mantam mu no ananmu  wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Mfitiase asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Woyome wɔ ɛbɔ bosome no da a ɛtɔ so aduonu baako wɔ afe 1971. Ɔfiri Dabala kuro bi a ɛwɔ South Tongu Mansini no mu wɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Woyome yɛ obi a wawie Presbyterian Mmarimaa Ntoaso Sukuu ne Sixth Form Science College, Legon. Woyome wiee ne Bachelors of Science abɔdin krataa wɔ Computer Science and Statistics mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn, Legon wɔ afe 1997. Ɔsan nso nyaa ne postgraduate diploma wɔ adwumayɛ mu wɔ Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration (GIMPA).

Adwuma 
Kobla Mensah yɛ Stewise nnwumakuo kuo no panyin firi afe 2009 kɔsii sɛ ɔbɛyɛɛ South Tongu MP.

Amannyɔsɛm 
Na ɔyɛ Ghana republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmarahyɛ badwa a ɛtɔ so nsia no mu ni kakraa bi. Wɔpaw no sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ Mmabun, Agodie ne Amammerɛ badwakuo no mu ni sɛ ɔmannifoɔ a ɔwɔ dibea. Na ɔsan yɛ Amannɔne Nsɛm badwakuo ne Daa Nhyehyɛe badwakuo no mu ni.

Ankorankoro asetena 
Wɔkyerɛ sɛ Kobla Mensah Wisdom Woyome yɛ Kristoni na ɔyɛ Action Chapel International asafo no mu nipa. Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma mmiensa.

Baabi a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Ameen Salifu
text:
Ameen Salifu (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn bosome ne da a Ɛtɔ so  25,  wɔ afe 1965) yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ ne Mmarahyɛ Bagua a Ɛtɔ so Nsia a ɛwɔ Ghana Aman a ɛtɔ so nnan no muni a ɔgyina Wa Apueeɛ Mansin ananmu wɔ Upper West Region of Ghana wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so

Ankorankoro asetra 
Salifu yɛ Muslimi (Ahmadi). Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baasa.

Early life and education 
Wɔwoo Salifu wɔ July 25, 1965. Ɔfiri Goripe, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Atɔeɛ Mantam mu. Ɔkɔɔ East London Suapɔn mu na ɔnyaa ne master’s degree wɔ NGO ne Development Management mu wɔ afe 2007 mu. Ɔsan nso kɔɔ London Sikasɛm Sukuu na onyaa ne nyansahu mu abodin krataa a ɛkorɔn wɔ Amanaman Ntam Adan ne Asetra mu Nsakrae mu wɔ afe 2000 mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Salifu yɛ National Democratic Congress amanyɔkuw  (NDC) no muni. Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔsii akan wɔ Wa East nkongua no so wɔ NDC mmarahyɛ bagua a ɛtɔ so nsia a ɛwɔ republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no tekiti so na odii nkonim.

Adwumafa 

 Capital Works Surveyor, Presentation Housing Association, London
 District Chief Executive (Wa District), April 2009 – January 7, 2013

title: George Loh
text:
George Loh yɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma North Dayi wɔ Volta mantam mu wɔ Ghana.Mprempren ɔyɛ Volta Mantam dwamtenani abadiakyire wɔ kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo( National Democratic Congress).

N'abrabɔ 
Loh aware wɔ ba baako. Ɔyɛ kristoni (Evangelical Presbyterian).

Abrabɔ ahyɛase ne nnwomasua 
Wɔwoo Loh wɔ Kitawonsa bosome da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduoson mmienu(1972) mu wɔ Anfoega a ɛwɔ Volta mantam mu. Ɔnyaa  LLB nnwomasua abasobɔdeɛ wɔ University of Ghana wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne num mu(2005). Ɔnyaa ne BL wɔ mmara nnwomasua wɔ Ghana School of Law wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nson (2007) mu, Ghana.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Loh yɛ National Democratic Congress(NDC) kuo no mu nipa. Na ɔka ekuo a wɔpaw a ɛyɛ  mmarahyɛ, deɛ ɛwɔ mmara mu ne mmarahyɛbadwam ho nsɛm, ne Amansan sikasɛm.

Adwuma 
Na ɔyɛ ɔhokafoɔ wɔ Oak House ne Wuuda wɔ Nkran sɛ mmaranimfoɔ ɔtumi de asɛm wɔ asɛnnibea ne mmaranimfoɔ a ɔntumi nni asɛm wɔ asɛnnibea  firi mfeɛ 2012. Ɔyɛ Hayibor, Djarbeng ne Company no Mfɛfoɔ firi afe 2007 kɔsi afe 2012.

Beaeɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: John Oti Kwabena Bless
text:
John Oti Bless (wɔwoo no Fida, Ahinime 19, 1979) yɛ Ghana amannyɔni ne Mmarahyɛ badwani a na ɔwɔ mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson a ɛwɔ Ghana Aman a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu  a ɔgyina Nkwanta Atifi Mansin ananmu wɔ Oti Mantam mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Ankorankoro asetena 
Bless yɛ Kristoni (Pentekoste Asɔre). Ɔwaree (ɔwɔ mma baanan).

Mfitiase asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Bless wɔ  Ahinime bosome no da a ɛtɔ so du nkron (19), wɔ afe 1979 Ɔfiri Saboba, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Fam mantam mu. Ɔkɔɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu na ɔnyaa ne Diploma wɔ Mmabun Nkɔsoɔ mu wɔ afe 2002 mu. Ɔsan nso wɔ MA wɔ Ɔmanfoɔ Nsɛm (Ɔmanfoɔ Nsɛm) mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Bless yɛ kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo NDC no mu nipa. Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔsii akan wɔ Nkwanta Atifi fam nkonnwa no so wɔ NDC mmarahyɛ badwa a ɛtɔ so nsia a ɛwɔ ɔman a ɛtɔ so nnan no tekiti so na ɔdii nkonim.

Adwuma 

 MD, Nnuruyɛbea a Wɔahyira so/Ahotew adwuma a Wɔahyira so, Accra.

 Ɔmanpanyin Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ mpɔtam aban ne nkuraase nkɔsoɔ so, Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 27, 2016 – Ɔpɛpɔn 6, 2017. 

 Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni (Ɔpɛpɔn 7, 2013 – mprempren; afe a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa)

 Ɔsan nso yɛ Ranking Member wɔ Aban Awerɛhyem Boayikuo mu wɔ Ghana Mmarahyɛ Bagua no mu.

 Ɔsan nso som sɛ Akwan ne Transport Boayikuw no muni wɔ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no mu.

Baabi a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Kwabena Owusu-Aduomi
text:
Kwabena Owusu Aduomi a wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da ɛtɔ so du- nson wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduosia mu no yɛ Ghana amanyɔni a na ɔyɛ Ghana Mmarahyɛbadwani. Ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party (NPP) amanyɔkuoni na na ɔyɛ ɔsoafo abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Akwan ne Akwan akɛse so wɔ Ghana.

Ne Mmɔfra Ase 
Wɔwoo Aduomi wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da ɛtɔ so du- nson wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduosia mu wɔ Ejisu-Besease a ɛwɔ Asanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

Ankorankoro Abrabɔ

Aduomi da ne ho adi sɛ ɔyɛ Kristoni a ɔsom wɔ 'Assemblies of God'Asɔre no mu. Ɔwareɛ na ɔwɔ mma mmienu .

Nwomasua 
Ɔnyaa ne suahunu mu abodin krataa wɔ aban mfiridwuma mu wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma ( Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology) so wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduowɔtwe -num mu.[6]

Adwuma 
Aduomi bɛyɛɛ nsiesie mfiridwumayɛfoɔ wɔ akwan akɛseɛ sohwɛfoɔ a ɛwɔ Tamale wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduowɔtwe -nson de kɔsi afe apem ahenkron aduokron - nnan (1987–1994) mu, afei ɔkɔɔ so yɛɛ nnwuma sohwɛfoɔ wɔ akwan akɛseɛ sohwɛfoɔ wɔ Atɔeɛ mantam mu wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduokron - nnan de kɔsi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne mmienu (1994–2002) mu. Ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔmantam kwankyerɛfoɔ a ɔhwɛ akwan akɛseɛ so wɔ Asanti mantam mu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne mmienu de kɔsi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nwɔtwe (2002–2008) mu. Afei ɔbɛyɛɛ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nsia  no mu ni.

Amammuo 
Wɔpaw no sɛ mmrahyɛbadwani ma Ejisu Mansini a ɛwɔ Asanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nkron mu (2009). Wɔpaw no sɛ ɔremɛka mmarahyɛ boayikuo a ɛka ho ne Mpɔtam Aban ne Nkuraase Nkɔso Boayikuo no ho.[7]

title: Francis Addai-Nimoh
text:
Francis Addai-Nimoh a wɔwoo no Oforisuo bosome da ɛtɔ so aduonu -mmiɛnsa  wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduosia -num mu no yɛ Ghana amanyɔni a na ɔyɛ Ghana mmrahyɛbadwani wɔ Ghana mmrahyɛbadwa  a ɛtɔ so nsia wɔ Ghana Adehyeman  ɛtɔ so nnan no mu. Ɔgyinaa Mampong Mansini a ɛwɔ Asanti Mantam mu no ananmu wɔ New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuo no din mu.

N'abrabɔ 
Ɔda ne ho adi sɛ ɔyɛ Kristoni,  na waware a ɔwɔ mma mmiɛnsa. [1]

Ne mmɔfrase ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Addai-Nimoh wɔ Oforisuo bosome da ɛtɔ so aduonu -mmiɛnsa wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduosia - num . Ɔfiri Mampong-Nyinampong, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Asanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔkɔɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma ( Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology ) so wɔ hɔ a ɔnyaa Bachelor of Science abodin krataa wɔ 'Civil Engineering' mu wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduokron -mmiɛnsa . Ɔsan nso kɔɔ 'Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration' na ɔnyaa 'executive master’s degree' wɔ 'Public Administration' mu.

Adwuma 
Addai-Nimoh yɛ Nkɔsoɔ nhyehyɛeɛfoɔ wɔ n’adwuma mu.[4] Ɔsane yɛ aban mfiridwumayɛfo.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Addai-Nimoh yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuo Foforo (New Patriortic Party) no muni. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du- mmienu mu no, ɔsii akan maa Mampong atenaeɛ no wɔ New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuo no din mu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du- mmienu Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu na ɔdii nkonim.  Ɔsan nso yɛɛ mmarahyɛbadwani maa Mampong wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nwɔtwe ne mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du- nsia mu. Ɔsii akan wɔ New Patriotic Party ɔmampanyin 'primaries' mu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du-nnan mu. Ɔdii nkoguo wɔ mmɔden a ɔbɔeɛ sɛ ɔbɛgyina ɛkuo no ananmu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du- nummmarahyɛbadwa 'primaries' mu.[5] Wɔ Afe Afe Ɔman Nnanmusini Nhyiamu 2022 mu no, Owura Nimoh hyɛɛ nkɔm sɛ ɛbɛyɛ nwonwa sɛ wɔbɛhunu anim foforɔ wɔ New Patriotic Party akannifoɔ mu. Ɔde ne ho ahyɛ akansi a ɛfa New Patriotic Party frankaatu akansie a wɔde  bɛyi ɔkandifoɔ akɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu -nnan  abatoɔ no ho nnansa yi.

title: Helen Adjoa Ntoso
text:
Helen Adjoa Ntoso (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn 1958) yɛ Ghana amannyɔni na ɔyɛ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwani  ma Krachi West mansini a ɛwɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔyɛ kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo NDC no mu nipa. Awyraa Ntoso yɛ kane mantam soafoɔ a ɔhwɛɛ Volta Mantam no so.

Mfitiaseɛ asetea ne nwomasua 
Ntoso firi Kete Krachi wɔ saa bere no Volta Mantam mu nanso mprempren Oti Mantam mu. ɔwiee ne ntoasoɔ sukuu akyi adesua wɔ St Francis Training College. Ɔwɔ Advanced Diploma wɔ Nwomasua mu wɔ Lambeth College a ɛwɔ London. Ɔsan nso wɔ Master of Arts wɔ Ntawantawadie mu Asomdwoe ne Ahobammɔ mu wɔ Kofi Annan Amanaman Ntam Asomdwoe Nteteɛbea.

Adwuma 
Na ɔyɛ Senior Child Care ɔhwɛfoɔ wɔ Elizabeth Hamwod Nursery School firi afe 2005 kɔsi afe 2007. Na ɔyɛ Ɔsɛmpatrɛni ma Bright Church Army firi afe 2003 kɔsi afe 2005. Ɔsan nso yɛ Adwumayɛ ho Ɔkwankyerɛfoɔ wɔ NADMO 2009 kɔsi 2012.

Amammui mu adwuma 
Ɔyɛɛ mantam soafoɔ firi afe 2013 kɔsii afe 2016 (Ɔmampanyin no Dwumadibea). Ɔyɛɛ Volta Mantam Soafoɔ wɔ afe 2015 mu.

Abasobɔde ahorow 
Helen Ntoso nyaa abasobɔdeɛ sɛ Ɔmantam Ɔsoafoɔ a ɔdi mu wɔ afe 2015 mu, a West African International Magazine hyehyɛeɛ.

Baabi a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Bukari Nikpe Joseph
text:
Joseph Nikpe Bukari (wɔwoo no afe Apem Ahankron ne Aduosia Nkron 1969) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni  ne Mmarahyɛbadwa a Ɛtɔ so Nsia a ɛwɔ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nan no mu ni a ɔgyina Saboba Mansin ananmu wɔ Ghana Atifi Mantam mu.

N'ankasa Abrabɔ 

Joseph yɛ Kristoni na ɔyɛ Evangelical Presbyterian kuo no mu ni. Ɔwareeɛ na ɔwɔ mma mmienu.

Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ ne Nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Joseph Bukari Nikpe wɔ   afe Apem Ahankron ne Aduosia Nkron 1969. Ɔfiri Saboba, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Mantam mu.  Wɔ afe 2006 mu no, ɔnyaa kwan kɔɔ Sukuupɔn a ɛhwɛ Nhomasua so, Winneba na ɔnyaa ne Bachelor of Education abodin krataa wɔ Mfiridwuma mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔdii kan paw Joseph sɛ ɔmmra mmarahyɛbadwa  mu wɔ kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo (National Democratic Congress- NDC ) tekiti so wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa, mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Nwɔtwe 2008 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani ma Saboba mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Mantam mu. Wɔ abatoɔ no mu no, ɔnyaa mma 10,331 wɔ mmamu 20,839 a wɔtoeɛ a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyem aduanan nkron ne akyiri pɔ aduonum nwɔtwe 49.58%.Ɔsan sii akan wɔ mfe Mpen Mmienu ne Du-mmienu 2012 Ghana amansan abatoɔ akansie no mu. Ɔyaa  mma 13,409 wɔ abatoɔ 26,058 a ɛfata a wɔtoo no mu a ɛgyina hɔ ma 51.09%.Wɔdii no so nkonim wɔ afe 2016 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu wɔ Charles Binipom Bintin a ɔgyinaa New Patriotic Party ananmu no so.

Adwumayɛ 
Bukari yɛ nhomasua ho ɔbenfo. Ansa na ɔrebɛyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwa no mu ni no, ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ Ɔmantam Nteteɛ sohwɛfo wɔ Ghana Nwomasua dwumadibea a ɛwɔ Saboba. Ɔde ne ho kɔbɔɔ Adwumayɛ, Asetena mu Akodie ne Ɔman fie abadwakuo no. Ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛdwa no mu ni firi afe 2009 kɔsi afe 2013 de ma adehyeɛ a wɔwɔ Saboba mansini no no. Ɔpɛpɔn da a ɛtɔ so du-mmeɛnsa (2013)

Bukari yɛ ɔman somfoɔ a onni pɛsɛmenkominya koraa. Ɔhwehwɛ ne nkurɔfoɔ yiyedie aberɛ nyinaa. Ɔbɛyɛ, ayɛ nea obetumi biara ama ne manfoɔ ani agye. Ne dwumadie no bi ne sɛ Onimuonyamfoɔ Joseph Bukari Nikpe daa no adi sɛ ɔne Ministry of Health (WOH) rebɔ nkɔmmɔ denneennen sɛ wɔbɛma mmoa bi akɔ anim de ahyɛ X’ray block ne amusie dan a wɔde bɛma A/G aduruyɛbea a ɛwɔ mpɔtam hɔ no mu den.

Bio nso ɔkaa sɛ, ɔbɛhwɛ sɛ wɔde nnwinnadeɛ pii besisi hɔ na wasan ayɛ wards no nnwinnadeɛ foforɔ de ayɛ adwuma a ɛbɛma wɔabue beaeɛ no ama akwahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛyɛ papa a wɔde ma ɔmanfoɔ no no akɔ anim.

A/G aduruyɛbea no yɛ beaeɛ kɛseɛ a ɛwɔ ɔmantam no mu a ɛtrɛ akwahosan ho dwumadie mu kɔ mmeaeɛ ahodoɔ a ɔwɔ Saboba mpɔtam nyinaa . Na obiaa anya so mfasoɔ.

Saa akwahosan ho nnwuma yi a X’Ray block ne mortuary ka ho no, wɔyɛɛ no ​​titire wɔ adwumayɛkuo a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ MP no ne Saboba mantam nhyiamu no ntam.

Hon. Bukari Nikpe kyerɛɛ sɛ wɔawie adwumayɛbea ahodoɔ no nyinaa, nanso na ɛho hia sɛ wɔsan yɛ nnwinnade foforo na ama nnwuma a etu mpɔn anya nkɔsoɔ wɔ saa adan ahodoɔ no nyinaa mu .

Ɔkaa sɛ, adwuma no nyinaa hwehwɛ sɛ nhyiamu no na ɛbɛyɛ n’asɛdeɛ sɛ wɔde ɔdan no besi hɔ berɛ a ɔno nso bɛboa wɔ nnwinnadeɛ ne nneɛma a wɔde besisi hɔ no mu.
