title: Fifi Fiavi Franklin Kwetey
text:
Fiifi Fiavi Kwetey (wɔwoo no 2 June 1967) yɛ Ghana amannyɔni ne Ɔyɛ kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo NDC mu twerɛtwerɛfoɔ Panyin. Ɔyɛ obi a na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani  wɔ Ketu South mansini no mu wɔ Ghana. Na ɔyɛ Propaganda twerɛtwerɛfoɔ ma National Democratic Congress (NDC).

Mfitiase asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Kwetey wɔ Hohoe nanso ɔfiri Nogokpo a nkuro mmienu no nyinaa wɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔkɔɔ Bishop Herman College wɔ Kpando wɔ afe 1987 mu, na ɔnyaa ne O level adansedie krataa. Ɔsan kɔɔ Achimota Sukuu mu kɔhwehwɛɛ ne A level adansedie krataa. Ɔnya Bachelor of Arts wɔ Sikasɛm ne Adwene ne Nneyɛe Ho Adesua mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu. Wɔ afe 1994 mu no, ɔnyaa Diplômes de la Chambre de Commerce et d'industrie de Paris (CCIP) (Adwadie ne Nnwumakuo no Diploma a Ɛkorɔn, Paris). Kwetey nyaa B.A HONS wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu

Adwuma 
Suapɔn no akyi no, Kwetey yɛɛ ne ɔman som adwuma wɔ Mmarahyɛ Badwa adwumayɛbea firi Ahinime bosome no mu wɔ afe 1993 kɔsi Kutawonsa bosome no mu wɔ afe  1994. Wɔ afe baako ɔman som adwuma a ɛyɛ ahyɛdeɛ akyi no ɔtu kɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ Sikasɛm mu Nhwehwɛmufoɔ ne sikakorafoɔ wɔ Sikakorabea adwumakuo, Strategic African Securities Ltd wɔ July 1995. Akyiri yi otu kɔɔ CDH Financial Holdings Ltd sɛ Sikakorabea sohwɛfo, Sikakorabea Nhwehwɛmufo ne a Stockbroker a ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ hɔ firi Oforisuo bosome no mu wɔ afe 1998 kɔsi Ɔpɛpɔn bosome no mu wɔ afe 2002, berɛ a na ɔsan nso som sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ ma sikasɛm Adesua bi wɔ Ghana Stock Exchange.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Bere a na ɔwɔ sukuupɔn mu no, na Kwetey yɛ sukuuni kannifoɔ, na ɔsom sɛ dwamtrani ma National Democratic Congress nkorabata dwumadibea a ɛwɔ University of Legon Campus. Wɔ ɔpɛnimaa bosome no mu wɔ afe 2005 mu no, Kwetey sii akan wɔ NDC mpanyimfoɔ abatoɔ mu na ɔdii nkonim ma ɔbɛyɛɛ nkitahodifoɔ panyin maa NDC. Bere a ɔsom sɛ nkitahodifoɔ panyin a n’akuo no frɛɛ no kuo no Nsɛmmɔnedi twerɛtwerɛfoɔ no, wɔhuu no sɛ onipa a ɔbɛkasa atia akuo afoforo no na wama nsɛm a ɛfata a ɛfa wɔn akuo ahorow ho asɔre bere a ɔrebɔ n’apam no ho ban wɔ nhyiam hodoɔ a ɛho hia no so  . Akyiri yi wɔsesaa dibea a ɛne Propaganda Secretary no yɛɛ no Ɔman Nkitahodi Sohwɛfoɔ.

Ɔsoafoɔ Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Sikasɛm so 
Wɔ afe 2009 mu no, John Atta Mills yii Kwetey sɛ ɔnyɛ Sikasɛm soafoɔ abadiakyiri mma Kwabena Duffuor a saa berɛ no na ɔyɛ Sikasɛm soafoɔ. Wɔkaa ntam sɛ ɔbɛdi tumi wɔ Ayɛwohomumɔ bosome no mu wɔ afe 2009 mu berɛ a ɔfaa nhwehwɛmu mu wɔ mmarahyɛ badwa mu akyi. Ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ saa dwumadie no mu kɔsii Ɔpɛpɔn bosome no mu wɔ afe 2013.

Mmarahyɛ Badwa mu adwumayɛ 
Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, Kwetey dii nkonim wɔ Ketu South National Democratic Congress primaries mu kɔɔ afe 2012 Mmarahyɛ Bagua Abatoɔ no mu. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ primaries no mu denam abatoɔ 403 a ɔnyaeɛ no so a ɛne abatoɔ 60 a saa berɛ no na ɔdi tumi saa berɛ no Albert Ziga a ɔdii nea ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa ne Raphael Alorwu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 82, berɛ a Nyphson Agbagedy nso nyaa abatoɔ 30. Akyiri yi Kwetey dii nkonim wɔ Ketu South mmarahyɛ bagua abatow mu denam abatow 77,837 a onyae a egyina hɔ ma abatow a wɔtow tiaa nea ɔbɛn no paa Godwin Yayra Nkuawu a ofi New Ptriotic kuw no mu a onyaa abatow 4,122 a egyina hɔ ma 4.71% no mu 88.92%.

Wɔ afe 2015 mu no, wɔkɔɔ so kuraa Fiifi Kwetey mu sɛ National Democratic Congress kandifoɔ ma Ketu South mantam a ɔrekɔ afe 2016 mmarahyɛ bagua abatoɔ no mu. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ primaries no mu denam abatoɔ 146,10 a ɔnyaeɛ a ɛgyina hɔ ma 86.13% de dii Sylvanus Amedorme a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 1,375 ne Famous Kuadugah, abatoɔ 637 wɔ Denu wɔ Volta Mantam mu.

Wɔpaw no wɔ afe 2016 Abatoɔ no mu sɛ ɔnsom sɛ mmarahyɛ baguani mma Ketu South wɔ afe foforɔ mu wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛ bagua mu wɔ berɛ a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 48,723 a ɛgyina hɔ ma abatoɔ nyinaa mu 65.47% tiaa ne akansifoɔ a ɔbɛn no paa Jim Yao Morti a ɔyɛ ɔkannifoɔ a ɔde ne ho a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 18,643 a ɔgyina hɔ ma 25.04% na ɛwɔ hɔ. Jim Yao Morti yɛ kan NDC muni a na wɔayi no afiri mu wɔ nhwehwɛmu nhyehyɛe no mu na akyiri yi NDC gyaee no na na ɔrepere sɛ obi a ɔde ne ho.

Ɔman Soafo a ɔhwɛ ɔman no so 
Ɔmampanyin John Dramani Mahama na ɔyii Kwetey sɛ ɔnsom sɛ Ɔman Soafoɔ wɔ ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Sikasɛm ne Apam Asoɛe ahodoɔ so wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome no mu wɔ afe 2013 mu. Na ne dwumadie ne sɛ ɔne sikasɛm adwumayɛbea no bɛyɛ adwuma abom denam ɔmampanyin no adwumayɛbea so de ahwɛ sikasɛm ne ahyehyɛdeɛ ahodoɔ a ɛka ho no so na wɔahwɛ so. Ɔsom saa tumi no ɔbuee akwankyerɛ badwakuo a ɛmufoɔ yɛ num maa Ɔman Pension Regulatory Authority (NPRA) sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ mfeɛ mmiɛnsa tumi a wɔde bɛkyekyere apam a wɔne Switzerland Aban ayɛ no so. Na Switzerland aban no ama Ghana Aban no sika ɔpepem mmienu ne akyiripɔ nan (2.4) sɛ wɔmfa mmoa Aban no mma wɔn nnipa tumi nkyekyere wɔn, hyehyɛ ahyehyɛdeɛ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛyɛ adwuma yie a ɛbɛboa wɔn ama wɔayɛ wɔn dwumadie sɛ mmarahyɛfoɔ a ɔhwɛ sɛ pɛnhyen nhyehyɛeɛ ne nhyehyɛeɛ no bɔ ho ban na ɛhyɛ nkuran ampa anigyeɛ a ɛwɔ wɔn a wɔagye pɛnhyen wɔ Ghana.

Aduane ne Kuadwuma ho Ɔsoafoɔ 
Ɔsomm wɔ saa dwumadie yi mu kɔsii sɛ wɔsan de no hyɛɛ aseɛ sɛ ɔnsom sɛ Aduane ne Kuadwuma ho Ɔsoafoɔ mfa nsi Clement Kofi Humado ananmu. Na ne dwumadie sɛ sikasɛm nipa ne sɛ ɔbɛhwɛ sɛ Ghana Kuadwuma no bɛhunu sɛ nneɛma a wɔyɛ no bɛkɔ soro na nneɛma a wɔde firi amannɔne ba no so ate na nneɛma a wɔde kɔ amannɔne no akɔ soro. Na n’anisoadehunu ne sɛ ɔbɛpia kuayɛ som adwuma no akɔ kuayɛ adwuma a ɛfa kuayɛ ho mmom sene sɛ ɔbɛma kuayɛ adwuma a ɛfa aduane a wɔyɛ ara kwa ho.

Akyiri yi wɔde no kɔɔ asoeɛ a ɔhwɛ akwantuo so wɔ berɛ a Awuraa Dzifa Ativor gyaee adwuma no wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa GHS 3.6m baase re-branding apam a akyinnyegyeɛ wɔ ho no akyi

Ankorankoro asetena 
Ɔwaree Naomi Kwetey na wɔbom wɔ mma nnan .

Nsɛm a wɔka tia Nkramofoɔ 
Wɔ ne dibea sɛ NDC nsɛmmɔnedie ho ɔtwerɛfoɔ ne kane Ɔmampanyin Rawlings fotufoɔ no, Fiifi Kwetey kaa wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne nson (2007) mu wɔ nkitahodie bi a ɔne U.S. aban ananmusifoɔ dwumadibea mpanyimfoɔ dii mu sɛ "wɔ nsɛm a wontumi nsi pi mu sɛ Nkramofoɔ ntumi nyɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanyin da". Ɔkɔɔ n'anim sɛ "Bere a Ghanafoɔ dodoɔ no ara rennye yei ntom pefee deɛ, nanso wontumi nyi Nkramofoɔ sɛ Ghana Ɔmampanyin". Wɔde baa hann mu wɔ U.S. aman ntam nkitahodie nhama pii a ɛtrɛɛ wɔ afe 2010 mu akyi no, ne nsɛm no maa Ghana Nkramofoɔ bo fuiɛ a wɔahwehwɛ sɛ ɔtwe ne nsɛm no na ɔpa kyɛw. Ɛde besi ɔbenem bosome no mu wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du num (2015) mu no, ɔnnya nnyee ne nsɛm no bio na ɔmpaa Nkramofoɔ kyɛw.

Baabi a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Amin Amidu Sulemana
text:
Amin Amidu Sulemana yɛ Ghana ɔmanpanyin ne ɔmanyɛfo. Ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni ma Sissala West mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana. Na ɔsan nso yɛ Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ akwan ne akwan akɛse so wɔ Ghana.

Aminu Amidu Sulemana yɛ Ghana ɔnanmusifoɔ wɔ Egypt kɔsii sɛ President Mills paw no sɛ Upper West Regional Minister wɔ January 2012 mu wɔ cabinet nsakraeɛ akyi.Ɔdii nkonim wɔ Sissala West mantam mu atenaeɛ no so wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so wɔ December 2012 abatoɔ no mu na ɔdii n’akongua wɔ Ghana Mmarahyɛ Bagua no mu wɔ Ɔbɛnem bosome no ne da a ɛtɔ so 7 wɔ afe 2013. He was appointed Minister for Roads and Highways by President Mahama in January 2013.

Mfitiase asetra 
Wɔwoo Amidu wɔ 20 Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 1955 wɔ Gyawia wɔ Upper West Region wɔ Ghana. Ɔkɔɔ Nandom Senior High School (kan no na ɛyɛ Nandom Secondary School) wɔ ne mantam mu baabi a ɔtraa ase yɛɛ ne General Certificate Examination (GCE). Ɔkɔɔ so toaa n’adesua so wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so, Kumasi kɔyɛɛ ne Bachelor of Science abodin krataa wɔ mfiridwuma mu. Ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ mfiridwumayɛfo ansa na ɔrekɔ amammuisɛm mu wɔ 1992 mu.

Amammui mu adwuma 
Wɔpaw no sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmarahyɛ bagua a edi kan wɔ Ɔbɛnem bosome ne da a ɛtɔ so 7 wɔ afe 1993 bere a wɔkae sɛ odii nkonim wɔ 1992 Ghana mmarahyɛ bagua abatow a wɔyɛe wɔ 29 December 1992 no akyi.

Wɔsan paw Amidu sɛ ɔmanpanyin a ɛto so anan no mmarahyɛ bagua a ɛto so abien wɔ Ɔbɛnem bosome ne da a ɛtɔ so  7 wɔ afe  1997  bere a wɔkae sɛ odii nkonim wɔ 1996 Ghana Amansan Abatow no mu bere a odii Moses Dani Baah a ofi Ɔmanfo Ɔman Nhyiam no mu ne Solomon Salia Nmangu a ofi Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no so nkonim no. Ɔnyaa ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 44.00 wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata nyinaa mu a ɛne abatoɔ 16,688 yɛ pɛ berɛ a n’asɔretiafoɔ kaa sɛ ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 33.20 a ɛne abatoɔ 12,589 yɛ pɛ ne ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 3.00 a ɛne abatoɔ 1,150 yɛ pɛ. N’adwuma no baa awiei wɔ 6 Ɔbɛnem 2001.

2012 abatow mu 
Bere a Amidu de mfe pii asom sɛ ɔnanmusifo wɔ Egypt akyi no, osii gyinae sɛ ɔbɛsan akɔ mmarahyɛ bagua no mu na ɔbɛyɛɛ National Democratic Congress no frankaa kurafo bio sɛ ​​obegyina ne mantam foforo a wɔatew no Sissala West mantam ananmu. Ɔdii Patrick Al-hassan Adamahof a ɔyɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuo Foforɔ, Bayirga Haruna a ɔfiri Nnipa Ɔman Nhyiamu no mu ne Abu Fatawu a ɔfiri Demokrasi Kuo Foforɔ no mu so nkonim. Ɔnyaa abatoɔ a ɛfata nyinaa mu ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 50.29 a ɛne abatoɔ 11,294 yɛ pɛ berɛ a wɔn a wɔsɔre tia no no kaa sɛ ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 36.26 a ɛne abatoɔ 8,144 yɛ pɛ, ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 13.10 a ɛne abatoɔ 2,943 yɛ pɛ ne ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 0.34 a ɛne abatoɔ 77 yɛ pɛ.

Hwɛ nso 

 Sissala West
National Democratic Congress

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: James C. Yanwube
text:
James Cecil Yanwube (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛnimaa da a ɛtɔ so aduonu-num,  afe Apem Ahankron ne Aduosia- Mmienu 1962) yɛ Ghana amamyɔni ne Mmarahyɛdwa  Ɛtɔ so Nsia a ɛwɔ Ghana Adehyeman /Kwasafoman a ɛtɔ so nan no mu ni. Ɔgyina adehyeɛ a wɔwɔ Tatale-Sanguli Mmansini a ɛwɔ Atifi Mantam no ananmu sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ ɔsono kokroko ammanyɔkuo (New Patriotic Party-NPP) no tekiti so. Mprempren yi, ɔredi dibea sɛ Tatale/Sanguli Mansini no Mmarahyɛbadwani  wɔ Ghana atifi fam mantam mu.

N'ankasa Abrabɔ 
Yanwube yɛ Kristoni (Baptist). Ɔwaree woo mma nan.

Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ ne Nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Yanwube wɔ da a ɛtɔ so aduonu-num, afe Apem Ahankron ne Aduosia-mmienu (25, 1962). Ɔfiri Sheini, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Fam mantam no mu.Ɔhyɛn Lincolnshire ne Humberhshide, London, UK na onyaa ne (master’s degree )wɔ (Information Technology) mu wɔ mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu (2000 )mu. Ɔkɔɔ (Fellowship Chartered Certified Accountant ) wɔ afe Apem , Ahankron ne Aduɔkron -nson(1997) mu.Ɔsan nso kɔɔ (Associates of Cost and Management Accountants ) ne Institute of Chartered Accountants (Ghana) wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu (2000 ) mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Yanwube yɛ New Patriotic Party (NPP) no muni. Wɔ mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Du-mmienu 2012 mu no, ɔsii akan maa Tatale-Sanguli atenaeɛ no wɔ Ɔsono kokroko ammanyɔkuo -NPP mmarahyɛbadwa  a ɛtɔ so nsia a ɛwɔ Adehyeman/Kwasafoman a ɛtɔ so nnan no tekiti so na ɔdii nkonim.

Adwumayɛ 
Ɔyɛ Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo Panin/Ɔpanin wɔ Sukuu a Wɔawie, Wisconsin Amanaman Ntam Sukuupɔn Kɔlege, Accra.

Ɔyɛ adwuma sɛ akontaabufoɔ ne sikasɛm sohwɛfo.

Baabi a Menyaa Mmoa Friiɛ 

Nwomasua
Ateasefoɔ
Mmarahyɛbadwani

title: Richard Quashigah
text:
Richard Mawuli Koku Quashigah (wɔwoo no 16 October 1968) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne Ghana mmarahyɛbadwafie a ɛtɔ so nson wɔ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nan no mu a na ɔresi Keta mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo no abrɛ so anan mu.

N'abrabɔ 
Quashigah yɛ Kristoni (Action Chapel Int.). Ɔwaree (ɔwɔ abofra baako)Richard, na ɔyɛ NDC Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni, Keta Mantam, firi 7 Ɔbɛnem 2013 kɔsi 7 Ɔbɛnem 2021, na ɔyɛ Ɔmanfoɔ Akontaabuo Boayikuo no muni ne saa ara nso na Mmarahyɛ Bagua no Nkitahodi Boayikuo no muni. Ɔsan nso yɛ Deputy Ranking wɔ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no Boayikuw a ɛhwɛ Adwumayɛ, Asetra mu Yiyedi ne Ɔman Nnwuma so. Ɔsan nso yɛ Ghana/Korea Mmarahyɛ Bagua Adamfofa Fekuw no Titenani Abadiakyiri.[1]

Abrabɔ ahyɛase ne nnwomasua 
Wɔwoo Quashigah wɔ 16 Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 1968. Ɔfiri Kedzi-Keta, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Volta mantam mu wɔ Ghana.[1] Ɔkɔɔ Wales Sukuupɔn mu, Cardiff, UK na onyaa ne master’s degree wɔ amanaman ntam nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu wɔ afe 2002 mu.[1]

title: Wahab Suhiyini Wumbei
text:
wahab Wumbei Suhuyini (wɔwoo no  Ɛbɔ, 30 afe Apem, Ahankron ne Aduanum-num 1955) yɛ Ghana amamanyɔni ne Mmarahyɛ badwani wɔ Mmarahyɛ badwa a ɛtɔ so nson a ɛwɔ Adehyeman/Kwasafoman a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu ni a ɔgyina Tolon Mansin ananmu wɔ Atifi Mantam mu wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so.

N'ankasa Abrabɔ 
Suhuyini yɛ Nkramofo. Ɔwaree, na ɔwɔ mma baanum.

Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ ne Nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Suhuyini wɔ 30 September 1955. Ɔfiri Gburimani, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Fam Mantam mu.Ɔkɔɔ Nhomasua Suapɔn, Winneba na onyaa ne Bachelor of Education abodin krataa wɔ Ghana Kasa mu wɔ afe 1997 mu.

Adwuma 
Ɔpanyin Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Ntetee so, Ghana-Denmark Community Program (ahyehyɛde a ɛnyɛ aban de), Dalun

Ghana Nhomasua Dwumadibea Choggu, JSS Tamale

Amanyɔsɛm 
Suhuyini yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo (NPP) no muni. Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔsii akan maa Tolon atenaeɛ no wɔ NPP mmarahyɛ bagua a ɛtɔ so nsia a ɛwɔ republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no tekiti so na ɔdii nkonim.

title: Woyome Kobla Mensah
text:
Kobla Mensah Wisdom Woyome yɛ Ghana amannyɔni ne Mmarahyɛ Badwa ni a na ɔwɔ mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtɔ so nson a ɛwɔ Fourth Republic of Ghana no mu a ɔgyina South Tongu abatoɔ mpesua no a ɛwɔ Volta Mantam mu no ananmu  wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Mfitiase asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Woyome wɔ ɛbɔ bosome no da a ɛtɔ so aduonu baako wɔ afe 1971. Ɔfiri Dabala kuro bi a ɛwɔ South Tongu Mansini no mu wɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Woyome yɛ obi a wawie Presbyterian Mmarimaa Ntoaso Sukuu ne Sixth Form Science College, Legon. Woyome wiee ne Bachelors of Science abɔdin krataa wɔ Computer Science and Statistics mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn, Legon wɔ afe 1997. Ɔsan nso nyaa ne postgraduate diploma wɔ adwumayɛ mu wɔ Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration (GIMPA).

Adwuma 
Kobla Mensah yɛ Stewise nnwumakuo kuo no panyin firi afe 2009 kɔsii sɛ ɔbɛyɛɛ South Tongu MP.

Amannyɔsɛm 
Na ɔyɛ Ghana republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmarahyɛ badwa a ɛtɔ so nsia no mu ni kakraa bi. Wɔpaw no sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ Mmabun, Agodie ne Amammerɛ badwakuo no mu ni sɛ ɔmannifoɔ a ɔwɔ dibea. Na ɔsan yɛ Amannɔne Nsɛm badwakuo ne Daa Nhyehyɛe badwakuo no mu ni.

Ankorankoro asetena 
Wɔkyerɛ sɛ Kobla Mensah Wisdom Woyome yɛ Kristoni na ɔyɛ Action Chapel International asafo no mu nipa. Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma mmiensa.

Baabi a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Bernice Adiku Heloo
text:
Bernice Adiku Heloo (wɔwoo no  September 24, 1954) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne kane mmarahyɛbadwani ma Honoe mpɛsoa no.

Abrabɔ Ahyɛase 
Wɔwoo Heloo wɔ Hohoe, Volta Mantam mu, a ne awofoɔ ne  Rev. E. T. Adiku ne Comfort Adiku.

Nnwomasua 
Heloo kɔɔ Mawuli Sukuu ne OLA Mmabaa Ntoaso Sukuu, Ho. Ɔnyaa BA wɔ nyamesom adesua mu ne MPhil wɔ mpaninfoɔ nwomasua mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu. Ɔsan nso nyaa M.Ed. wɔ mpanyimfo nhomasua mu no, akenkan ne akyerɛw ma nkuraase nkɔso fi Manchester Sukuupɔn mu. Ɔnyaa ne oduruyɛfoɔ abodin krataa wɔ amammuisɛm mu sikasɛm mu wɔ Switzerland Management Center Suapɔn mu.

Adwuma 
Heloo yɛ Society For Women and AIDS in Africa no titrani a atwam ntɛm ara na ɔhyehyɛɛ Prolink, NGO bi a ɛwɔ Ghana. Mprempren ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani ma Hohoe mansisni.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Mmarahyɛbadwamni

Na Heloo yɛ nnipa kakraa bi wɔ Ghana republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nsia(6) no mu. Na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbawani ma Hohoe, Volta Mantam firi Ɔbɛnem 7, 2013, de bɛsi nnɛ; eyi ne n’ahenni afe a ɛto so abien. Sɛ mmarahyɛbawani a ɔhwɛ Hohoe Mantam so no, Heloo kasa tiaa Ghana ɔmanpanyin Nana Addo Dankwa Akufo-Addo sɛ wanka Takoradi mmeawa a wɔkyeree wɔn sie no ho asɛm wɔ afe 2019 ɔman no tebea mu ɔkasa no mu.

Soafoɔ  Abadiakyiri

John Dramani Mahama na ɔpaw no wɔ mfeɛ 2013 mu sɛ ɔnyɛ soafoɔ abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia, nyansahu ne mfiridwuma ne nneɛma foforo so. Ɔsomm wɔ saa dwumadie no mu wɔ John Mahama nnisoɔ mu firi afe 2013 kɔsi afe 2017.

N'ankasa abrabɔ 
Heloo yɛ kristoni na w'aware.

Beaeɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Henry Ford Kofi Kamel
text:
Henry Ford Kofi Kamel (21 Ɔbɛnem 1961 – 25 Ɔbɛnem 2012) yɛ Ghana sikakorabea dwumayɛni ne amannyɔni . Ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani  ma Buem mansini no firi Ɔpɛpɔn bosome no wɔ afe 2005 na ɔsan yɛ Volta Mantam Ɔsoafoɔ firi Oforisuo  bosome no wɔ afe 2012 kɔsii sɛ ɔwuiɛ wɔ  Ɔpɛpɔn bosome no da a ɛtɔ so aduonu num wɔ afe2012.

Mfitiase asetena ne nwomasua 
Kamel firii Guanam, beae bi a ɛwɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Wɔwoo no wɔ  ɔpɛnimaa bosome no da a ɛtɔ so aduonu baako wɔ afe 1961. Ɔkɔɔ Ho Technical University.

Adwuma 
Kamel tetee ne ho sɛ sikakorabea dwumayɛni ne sikasɛm ho ɔbenfo wɔ n’adwuma mu. Ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ North Volta Rural Bank Limited kwankyerɛfo panyin.

Mmarahyɛ Badwam 
Ná Kamel yɛ kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo NDC Mmarahyɛ Badwa no mu ni. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ a ɛtwa toɔ mu wɔ 7 December 2012 de mma dodoɔ a ɛboro 13,627 so. Ɔdii kan dii nkonim wɔ atenaeɛ no mu wɔ afe 2004 abatoɔ mu de sii Emil Kwadzo Brantuo ananmu sɛ MP wɔ Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so nnan a ɛwɔ Republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu a na dodoɔ no ara yɛ 10,488.[5] Ɔdii nkonim bɔɔ n’akongua ho ban wɔ afe 2008 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ no mu 65.8%.[6]

Aban 
Wɔ Oforisuo 2012 mu no, Ɔmampanyin John Atta Mills yii Henry Kamel sɛ Volta Ɔmantam Ɔsoafoɔ foforɔ, a ɔde no bɛsi Joseph Amenowode ananmu.[7][8][9] Ɔtenaa saa dibea yi mu kɔsii sɛ ɔwuiɛ wɔ Buronya Da wɔ afe 2012. Ansa na wɔrepaw no yi, na ɔyɛ Ɔsoafoɔ Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Asase ne Kwaeɛ so.[10]

Nea ɔyɛe a ɛda nsow no mu biako ne sɛ ɔde asomdwoe baa Gbi Amammerɛ Mpɔtam hɔ wɔ Hohoefoɔ a wɔyɛ aborɔfo ne Zongo Mpɔtam hɔfo ntam. Gbi Amammerɛ Mpɔtam Panyin Panyin, Togbega Gabusu VI, hyɛɛ saa asomdwoe mmɔdenbɔ ahorow no anuonyam.[11]

Owuo 
Wɔbɔɔ amanneɛ sɛ Kamel san kɔɔ ne kurom, Guaman a ɛwɔ Jasikan mansini no mu wɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ 25 ɔpɛnimaa bosome no mu wɔ afe 2012.[12] Bere a ɔne abusuafo ne nnamfo binom rebɔ nkɔmmɔ da a edi hɔ no, ɔhwee ase mpofirim. Owui ansa na ɔreduru Jasikan Aban Ayaresabea.[13] Ná wadi mfe 51.

Ankorankoro asetena 
Ná waware na ɔwɔ mma mmiensa. Ná ɔyɛ Kristoni ne Katolekni.

Ne babaa de Kamel for Hope fapem sii hɔ de hyɛɛ no anuonyam sɛ ɔde bɛkɔ nnipa a wɔabɔ wɔn ka wɔ Ghana nkyɛn. Wɔhyehyɛɛ fapem no wɔ  kɔtɔnimaa bosome no da a ɛdi kan wɔ afe 2013.

Baabi a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Adamu Daramani
text:
Adamu Daramani Sakande ( wɔwoo no 6 May 1962 – 22 September 2020) na ɔyɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne mmarahyɛbadwamfie a ɛtɔ so num wɔ Ghana adehyeman amammuo a ɛtɔ so nan no mu nipa a Ɔtenaa mmarahyɛbadwam maa Bawku Central mpɛsoa, wɔ Upper East mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

Abrabɔ ahyɛase ne nnwomasua 
Wɔwoo Adamu wɔ Kontonimaa bosome 6,1962, wɔ Bawku a ɛwɔ Upper East Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔkɔɔ Portsmouth University, NHS-UK na ɔsuaa studied Counter Fraud ne Security Management Service Accredited SMS wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne mmiɛnsa mu(2003).

Amanyɔsɛm 
Adamu baa mmarahyɛbadwafie berɛ a Ɔpɛnimma bosome no abatoɔ wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nwɔtwe(2008) Ghana man nyina abatoɔ mu wɔ Ɔsono amanyɔkuo(New Patriotic Party, NPP) din mu sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani ma Bawku Central Mpɛsoa a Upper East Mantam mu. Ɛwɔ abatoɔ no mu no, ɔnyaa mma mpem aduonu, ɔha ne aduonum-nson(20,157) wɔ mma dodoɔ mpem aduasa nson, ahason ne dunkron(37,719) ɛbaaeɛ no nyinaa mu a ne mma ɔnyaaeɛ no yɛ mma dodoɔ no mu ɔha nkyɛmu aduonum mmiɛnsa ne akyirepɔ nan(53.4%). Ɔsomm wɔ mmarahyɛbadwafie ɔfa baako pɛ.

Adwuma 
Adamu ne NHS Primary Case Trust, London yɛɛ adwuma. Na ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani ma Bawku Central mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Upper East Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

Asɛnnie ne afiasenna 
Wobuu Adamu fɔ sɛ odii atoro adanse na ɔyɛɛ atoro. Enti wɔde no too afiase mfe abien bere koro mu wɔ nsɛm no nyinaa ho. Wɔkyerɛe sɛ, ansa na afe 2008 abatoɔ no reba no, ɔkaa atoro asɛm bi wɔ akwammisa krataa bi a ɔde kɔmaa sɛ wɔmfa ne din nhyɛ abatoɔfoɔ din mu na akyiri yi ɔkɔɔ n’anim kɔtoo aba wɔ December 2008 amansan abatoɔ no mu berɛ a na onni hokwan sɛ ɔyɛ saa. Anantwinini tɔnfo bi kae sɛ Daramani kura Britania ne Burkinabe akwantu tumi krataa. Ne mmaranimfo no de asɛm no kɔdan asɛnnibea no sɛ wɔntew atemmu no mu den so esiane Adamu akwahosan ho haw ahorow bi nti.

Beaeɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Saani Iddi
text:
Saani Iddi (Kotonimaa  26, Afe Apem Ahankron ne Aduonum Nsia 1956 – Ayɛwohomumɔ 5, Mfeɛ Mpem-Mmienu ne Du-mmienu 2012) yɛ Ghana amamyɔni .Na ɔyɛ kane soafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Nsuo Ho Nneɛma, Adwumayɛ ne Adan so ne Mmarahyɛbadwa no mu ni ma Wulensi abatoɔ mpɛsoa a wɔ Ghana Atifi Mantam mu no.Saani san nso yɛ kane mansini krakye wɔ Nanumba Anaafoɔ Mansini no mu.

Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ ne Nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Iddi wɔ Kotonimaa 26, 1956, na ɔfiri Wulensi a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Fam Mantam mu no. Onyaa nwomasua ho adansedie krataa a ɛkɔ akyiri wɔ Advanced level.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Na Iddi yɛ Ghana Adehyeman  a Ɛtɔ so nan no Mmarahyɛbadwa a Ɛtɔ so num no mu ni.Na ɔyɛ ɔkannifoɔɔ wɔ afe 1996 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu sɛ New Patriotic Party no ananmusifoɔ .  Ɔdii nkonim wɔ atenaeɛ bi mu maa akuo no a ne nyinaa mpem nsia, ahansia ne aduasa-nsia (6,636) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyem aduonu-nsia ne akyiri pɔ aduɔson(26.70% ) wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ saa afe no nyinaa mu. Ɔhweree mmarahyɛbadwa no akondwa  wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu (2000) Ghana amansan abatoɔ no  mu na kan ɔmampanin John Agyeikum Kuffour paw no sɛ Ɔmantam Panyin wɔ Nanumba atifi fam mantam mu. Berɛ a New Patriotic Party no hweree wɔn dibea wɔ mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Ɛnan (2004) Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu no, ɔmampanin Evans Atta Mills a wawu no paw no sɛ ɔsoafoɔ abadiakyire a ɔhwɛ nsuo ho nneɛma, adwumayɛ ne adan so afe baako. Iddi sii akan sɛ obi a ɔde ne ho wɔ afe 2008 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu . Ɛno mu no, ɔdii nkonim a berɛ a ɔnyaa  mma 10,174.  Owui wɔ n’afe a etwa toɔ wɔ n’adwuma mu.

N'ankasa Abrabɔ 
Na Iddi yɛ Muslimini. Ɔware woo mma nson. Owui wɔ Korle Bu akyerɛkyerɛ ayaresabea wɔ Accra bere a na ɔyare bere bi akyi.

Owuo 
Ɔwuiɛ wɔ Ayɛwohomumɔ 5, 2012.

Baabi a Menyaa Mmoa Friiɛ. 

Awufoɔ
Mmarahyɛbadwani
New Patriotic party

title: Simon Edem Asimah
text:
Simon Edem Asimah yɛ Architect/Quantity surveyor na ɔyɛ amannyɔni wɔ Republic of Ghana. Ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani   ma South Dayi abatoɔ mpesua no wɔ Volta mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

Ankorankoro asetena 
Simon aware a ɔwɔ mma baanum. Ɔyɛ Kristoni (Evangelical Presbyterian).

Mfitiase asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Simon Edem Asimah wɔ Oforisuo bosome no da a ɛtɔ so du nkron wɔ afe 1955 mu. Ɔyɛ Peki-Wudome a ɔfiri Volta mantam mu wɔ Ghana no mu nipa.

Ná ɔwɔ Master of Arts abodin krataa wɔ Development Studies mu. Ɔkɔɔ so suaa ISS wɔ Hague wɔ Netherlands wɔ afe 1992 mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Simon yɛ yɛ kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo NDC mu nipa. Ɔgyinaa South Dayi Mansini ananmu wɔ Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so num a ɛwɔ Republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu. Wɔ ɔpɛnimaa bosome no mu wɔ afe 2012 mu no, Ɔsan nso daa ne ho adi sɛ nkonimdifoɔ wɔ afe 2012 Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ mu a ɔdii nkonim kɛseɛ a ɛyɛ 87.5% wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata nyinaa mu wɔ ne Mansin mu a ɛbɛyɛɛ ne mmirikatuo a ɛtɔ so mmienu sɛ MP a ɔgyina South Dayi abatoɔ mpesua no anan mu. Na ɔyɛ badwakuo a ɛhwɛ nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia, nyansahu ne mfiridwuma so no Titenani.

Adwuma 
Reg. Ɔkwankyerɛfo, Greater Accra Ɔmantam Dwumadibea a ɛhwɛ Mpɔtam Nsu ne Ahotew Dwumadibea so.

Ɔyɛ Nkɔsoɔ Nhyehyɛeɛ, ɔdansifoɔ, ne dodoɔ ho nhwehwɛmufoɔ.

Baabi a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Sagre Bambangi
text:
Sagre Bambangi (wɔwoo no Kotonimaa da ɛtɔ so mmienu, afe Apem Ahankron Aduosia-Nsia- 1966) yɛ Ghana amamyɔni ne Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nnan no Mmarahyɛ Badwa  a ɛtɔ so nson no mi bi a ɔgyina Walewale Mansin ananmu wɔ Atifi Mantam mu wɔ Ɔsono kokroko Amanyɔkuo (New Patriotic Party-NPP) no tekiti so.

N'ankasa Abrabɔ 
Bambangi yɛ Nkramofo. Ɔwaree (ɔwɔ mma baanum).

Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ ne Nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Bambangi wɔ Kotonimaa da a ɛtɔ mmienu, afe Apem Ahankron ne Aduosia-nsia (1966). Ɔfiri Wungu, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Fam Mantam mu.Ɔkɔɔ Navrongo Senior High School na ɔnyaa SC/GCEO O level ne GCE A kevel.Ɔkɔɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu na ɔnyaa ne Doctor of Philosophy abodin krataa wɔ Kuadwuma mu Sikasɛm mu wɔ afe 2009 mu.[1] Ɔyɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ wɔ Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nkɔsoɔ Adesua so firi afe Apem Ahankron ne Aduɔkron-nson (1997) kɔsi mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Du-nsia (2016).

Amanyɔsɛm 
Bambangi yɛ ɔsono kokroko ammanyɔkuo New Patriotic Party-NPP  (NPP) no muni. Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔde NPP mmarahyɛ bagua a ɛtɔ so nsia a ɛwɔ republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no tekiti so sii akan wɔ Walewale atenaeɛ no ho na ɔdii nkonim.

Adwumayɛ 
Ɔyɛ sikasɛm ho ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ wɔ Sukuupɔn a ɛhwɛ Nkɔso Adesua so - Wa Campus.

Ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛda no mu ni firi Ɔpɛpɔn da a ɛtɔ nson, mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du-mmeɛnsa (2013) ; ɔwɔ n’ahennie afe a ɛtɔ so mmienu mu.

Baabi a Menyaa Mmoa Friiɛ

title: Sulemana Alijata
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Sulemana Alijata (25 Ɔbɛnem 1975) yɛ kane mmarahyɛbadwani  ma Sissala Apuei wɔ Upper West mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Alijata aware (wɔ mma). Ɔyɛ Nkramoni.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Alijata wɔ Ɔbɛnem bosome no da a ɛtɔ so aduonu num wɔ afe 1975 mu wɔ Tumu wɔ Upper West mantam mu.

Ɔnyaa ne diploma wɔ Community Development mu wɔ Rural Development College firi afe 2005 kɔsi afe 2007.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Alijata yɛ yɛ kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo NDC mu no mu nipa.

Na ɔyɛ badwakuo a ɛhwɛ nnipa Bɔbea su ne Mmofra, Asase ne Kwae so no muni.

Adwumafa 
Na Alijata wɔ Ɔmampanyin Dwumadibea.

Ɔyɛ Ɔmansini Panyin wɔ Sissala West Mansini no mu firi afe 2008 kɔsi afe 2013.

Ɔyɛ asetena mu nsɛm ho dwumayɛni.

Ɔyɛ obi a ɔtu ne ho ma ma NGO People Action to Win Life All-round.

Baabi a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Benjamin Kunbuor
text:
Benjamin Bewa-Nyog Kunbuor yɛ Ghana ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Ghana Bammɔ Dwumadie so, na ɔyɛ Ghana amannyɔni . Ná ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani  ma Nandom mansini no.

Nwomasua 
Kunbour nyaa ne ntoasoɔ sukuu wɔ Nandom Ntoasoɔ Sukuu mu, ɔnyaa ne LLB firi Ghana Sukuupɔn mu, na ɔfatae sɛ mmaranimfoɔ bere a ɔwiee Ghana Mmara Sukuu no.

Ɛno akyi no ɔkɔɔ Warwick Sukuupɔn a ɛwɔ United Kingdom no mu na ɔnyaa ne LLM a ɛda nsow. Akyiri yi wɔmaa no Britania Chevening Scholarship sɛ ɔmfa nwie ne PhD wɔ Mmara mu wɔ Nkɔso mu wɔ afe (1997-2000).

Ɔsan nso nyaa Amannɔne Asuafoɔ Abasobɔdeɛ (OSSA) Oduruyɛfoɔ Abasobɔdeɛ wɔ Warwick Suapɔn mu.

Adwuma 
Bere bi na Kunbour yɛ adwuma sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ boafoɔ a wawie sukuu wɔ Warwick Sukuupɔn a ɛwɔ United Kingdom no mu. Efiri saa bere no wama ɔkasa nso wɔ Ghana Mmara Sukuu mu. Ɔsan nso ayɛ ɔkwankyerɛfoɔ wɔ Commission on Human Rights and Administrative Justice wɔ Ghana.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Kunbour yɛ yɛ kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo NDC mu nipa. Ɔdii kan gyinaa wɔ abatoɔ a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ afe 2000 mmarahyɛ badwam abatoɔ mu na ɔdii nkonim a ɔnyaa mma no mu dodoɔ no ara a ɛyɛ ɔha nkyekyɛmu 62.5%. Ɔkuraa n'akonnwa no mu wɔ abatoɔ a ɛdi hɔ no mu mfeɛ nnan akyi, nanso ɔhweree no wɔ afe 2008 abatoɔ no akyi berɛ a n'apam no san baa tumidie mu.[5] Wɔ afe 2009 mu no, George Yankey gyaee adwuma wɔ NDC aban mu wɔ adifudepɛ animguaseɛ bi akyi. President Mills paw Kunbuor sɛ ne soafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Akwahosan so.

Wɔ nsakraeɛ a wɔyɛeɛ wɔ aban mpanyimfoɔ mu wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome no mu wɔ afe 2011 akyi no, Ɔmanpanyin Mills paw Kunbour sɛ  ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Mfinimfini no so.

Martin Amidu, Mmaranimfoɔ Panyin a ɔgyaee adwuma wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2012 mu akyi no, Ɔmampanyin Mills paw Owura Kunbuor sɛ Mmaranimfoɔ Panyin.

2000 Abatow a Wɔtoeɛ 
Wɔyii Kunbour sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani  maa Lawra-Nandom mantam a ɛwɔ Upper West mantam mu wɔ Ghana wɔ afe 2000 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu. Enti ɔgyinaa mansini no ananmu wɔ Ghana adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu.

Wɔde abatoɔ a wɔtoo nyinaa mu 22,347 na ɛdii nkunim.  ɔnyaa mma no pii kyɛn  Tenku Charles a na ɔgyina Peoples National Convention,amanyɔkuo no ananmu, ɛne Stephen Yir-Eru Engmen a ɔgyinaa New Patriotic Party ne David Nandoh a ɔgyinaa National Reform Party anan mu..

Yeinom nyaa abatoɔ no mu mma 2,2347, abatoɔ no mu mma 3,570, abatoɔ no mu mma 3,487 ne abatoɔ no mu mma 641.Yeinom gyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu 74.40%, 11.90%, 11.60%, 2.10% yɛ pɛ wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoo no nyinaa mu. Wɔyii Kunbour wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so. National Democratic Congress no nyaa mmarahyɛ badwa nkonnwa no mu nson wɔ Upper West mantam, no mu wɔ saa abatoɔ no mu.

Sɛ yɛka ne nyinaa bom a, kuo no nyaa mmarahyɛ badwa ananmusifo kakraa bi a wɔn dodoɔ yɛ 89 wɔ nkonwa 200 a na ɛwɔ mmarahyɛ badwa a ɛto so mmiensa  a ɛwɔ Ghana adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu.

2004 Abatow a Wɔtoeɛ 
Wɔyii Kunbuor sɛ mmarahyɛ badwani ma Lawra-Nandom mansini a ɛwɔ Upper West mantam mu wɔ Ghana wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu. Enti ɔgyinaa amansin no ananmu wɔ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmarahyɛ badwa a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu.

Wɔde abatoɔ no mu mma  19,306 yii no wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu a nnipa dodoɔ 31,138 na wɔtoo aba no. Yei gyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 62.0% yɛ pɛ. Ɔnyaa mma no bi senee Bapullu Debis Dery a ɔfiri  People's National Convention,  no mu, Dery Ambrose P a ɔfiri  New Patriotic Party ne Seidu Adama Billah a ɔfiri   Convention People's Party

Yeinom nyaa abatow mu mma 912, mma10,549 ne mma 371 wɔ nnipa dodoɔ a wɔtoo aba no nyinaa mu. Yeinom ne abatowɔ a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu ɔha nkyekyɛmu 2.9%, 33.9% ne 1.2% yɛ pɛ. Wɔyii Kunbuor wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Na ne mansin no yɛ amansin nson  a National Democratic Congress dii nkonim wɔ Upper West mantam no mu wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu no fã. National Democratic Congress dii nkonim wɔ mmarahyɛ badwa ananmusifoɔ kakraa bi a wɔn dodoɔ yɛ 94 wɔ nkonnwa 230 a ɛwɔ mmarahyɛ badwa a ɛtɔ so nnan a ɛwɔ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu.

Ankorankoro asetena 
Kunbuor aware na ɔwɔ mma mmiensa.

Baabi a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Samson Abu
text:
Samson Abu (wɔwoo no 18 ɔpɛnimaa1969) yɛ Ghana amannyɔni ne mmarahyɛbadwani  a na ɔka mmarahyɛbadwa a Ɛtɔ so Nsia a ɛwɔ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu ni a ɔgyina ma Lawra Mansin abatoɔ mpesua no wɔ Upper West mantam no mu wɔ Ghana.

Ankorankoro asetena 
Abu aware a ɔwɔ mma nan. Ɔyɛ Kristoni (Katolekni).

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Abu wɔ ɔpɛnimaa bosome no da a ɛtɔ so du nwɔtwe wɔ afe 1969, na ɔfiri Dikpe - Lawra wɔ Upper West Region.Ɔkɔɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu baabi a ɔnyaa ne Bachelors’ degree wɔ Administration mu wɔ afe 2004 mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Abu yɛ National Democratic Congress mu nipa na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani  ma Lawra abatoɔ mpesua no firi afe 2013 kɔsi afe 2017.

Na ɔyɛ badwakuo a ɔhwɛ Nwomasua, Mmabun, Agodie ne Amammerɛ ne Atemmu so no mu nipa.

Kɔtɔnkorɔ 
Wɔ afe 2016 mu no, Abu gyaee NDC na ɔbɛyɛɛ obi a ɔde ne ho bere a Bede Ziedeng dii no so nkonim wɔ wɔn primaries mu.

Adwumafa 
Na Abu yɛ Ghana Akwahosan Dwumadie sohwɛfoɔ wɔ Lawra Ayaresabea. Na ɔwɔ Ɔmampanyin Dwumadibea sɛ DCE firi Ayɛwohomumɔ bosome no mu wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne num (2005) kɔsi Ɔpɛpɔn bosome no mu wɔ afe 2013 mu. Na ɔyɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ wɔ Ghana Education Service firi afe 1994 kɔsi afe 2000. Ɔyɛ akwahosan ho adwumayɛfoɔ.

Baabi a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Paul Derigubah
text:
Paul Derigubah (wɔwoo no Ayɛwohomumɔ 23, 1963) yɛ Ghana amannyɔni nemmarahyɛbadwani a na ɔka mmarahyɛbadwa a Ɛ  ɛtɔ so Nsia a ɛwɔ Ghana Aman a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu ni a ɔgyina Jirapa Mansin no ananmu wɔ Upper West mantam sɛ ɔman a ɔde ne ho.

Ankorankoro asetena 
Deriguba yɛ Kristoni (Katolekni). Ɔwaree (ɔwɔ mma mmienu).

Mfitiase asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Derigubah wɔ Ayɛwohomumɔ bosome no da a ɛtɔ so aduonu mmiensa (23), wɔ afe 1963. Ɔfiri Jirapa, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Upper West mantam no mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔkɔɔ Agriculture University of, Wageningen, Netherlands na ɔnyaa ne master’s degree wɔ Kuadwuma mu wɔ afe 1985 mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Deriguba yɛ obi a ɔde ne ho. Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔsii akan maa Jirapa atenaeɛ wɔ mmarahyɛ badwa a ɛtɔ so nsia wɔ republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu na ɔdii nkonim.

Adwumafa 
Dwumadie ho Ɔbenfoɔ, Amanaman Nkabom Nkɔsoɔ Dwumadie, Accra

Okuafo/kuafo

title: Alhassan Dubie Halutie
text:
Alhassan Dubie Halutie yɛ Ghana amannyɔni ne ɔyarehwɛfoɔ. Ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani  ma Sissala-East mansini a ɛwɔ Upper West mantam no mu wɔ Ghana.

Mfitiase asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Halutie wɔ Obubuo bosome no da a ɛtɔ so aduonu mmienu wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduanan -nson wɔ Kong wɔ Upper West Region wɔ Ghana na ɔfiri Tumu wɔ Upper West mantam no mu. Ɔkɔɔ Bolgatanga Ayarehwɛfoɔ Nteteeɛ Sukuu firi afe apem ahenkron aduosia - nnan kɔsi afe apem ahenkron aduosia nson mu. Na ɔkɔɔ toaso wɔ Koforidua Awogyefoɔ Nteteeɛ Sukuu firi afe apem ahenkron aduosia -nnwɔtwe kɔsi afe apem ahenkron aduosia nkron.

Ɔsan nso yɛ Kintampo Nkuraase Ntetee Sukuu na ɔkɔɔ Abusua Nhyehyɛe Ntetee Sukuu a ɛwɔ Tamale.

Ɔyɛɛ adesua wɔ Women in Management Supervisory wɔ 'Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration' (GIMPA) ne Community Interactive ne Country Planning adesua wɔ Tamale wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu mu.

Adwuma 
Ná ɔyɛ ɔyarehwɛfoɔ wɔ n’adwuma mu. Ɔyɛ Tumu Ayaresabea Aduruyɛ Boafoɔ Panyin wɔ afe 1997 mu ne Tumu Ayaresabea Aduruyɛ Boafoɔ Panyin firi afe apem ahenkron aduokron - nsia kɔsi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nson mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔpaw Halutie wɔ afe apem ahenkronaduokron - nnan  mu sɛ ananmusini  maa Sissala Mansini Badwa no. Akyiri yi ɔbɛyɛɛ Ɔpanyin a ɔhwɛ mansini no so wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne baako ntam.

Na ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ National Democratic Congress (NDC) din mu wɔ Sissala East abatoɔ mpasua so wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnan  abatoɔ no mu. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nsia   mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ Ɔmantam Mmea Nhyehyɛefoɔ Abadiakyiri a ɔdi kan wɔ National Democratic Congress mu wɔ Upper West mantam no mu, na wɔpaa no sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani  (NDC) maa Sissala Apuei Mantam.

Ankoarankoro asetena 
Ɔyɛ Nkramoni na waware na ɔwɔ mma num.

Ateasefoɔ
Ghana Mmarahyɛbadwani

title: Ambrose P. Dery
text:
Ambrose Dery (wɔ 23 Ɔbɛnem 1956), yɛ Ghana amannyɔni , na ɔyɛ Ɔman no mu Ɔsoafoɔ ne mmarahyɛbadwani  ma Nandom Mansini no. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ mansini no mu wɔ afe 2016 abatoɔ no mu wɔ New Patriotic Party tekiti so.

Asetena mu nsɛm 
Hon. Dery yɛ mmaranimfoɔ a ɔkɔɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu wɔ afe 1977 mu bere a ɔwiee Navrongo Ntoaso Sukuu na ɔwiee ne Bachelor of Law (LL. B) na afei ɔfrɛɛ no kɔɔ Mmaranimfoɔ kuo mu wɔ afe 1982 mu.

Adwuma 
Na Dery yɛ Dery & Co no panyin ne ne kwankyerɛfoɔ panyin.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ansa na ɔrekɔ mmarahyɛ badwa mu wɔ afe 2008 mu no,  Wɔpaw Dery sɛ Mmaranimfoɔ Panyin Abadiakyiri wɔ afe 2003. Ɔsan nso yɛɛ asomfoɔ dibea mmienu sɛ mantam soafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Upper West mantam no so firi afe 2004 kɔsi afe 2006 ne Ɔman Soafoɔ wɔ Atɛntrenee Dwumadibea fi afe 2005 kɔsi 2007. Hon. Dery yɛɛ adwuma sɛ Minority Leader Abadiakyiri maa Ghana mmarahyɛ badwa a ɛto so num. Hon. Dery dii nkonim wɔ Nandom mmarahyɛ badwa akonwa abatoɔ no mu, afei Lawra-Nandom Mansini wɔ afe 2008 mu nanso ɔhweree akonwa no maa Benjamin Kumbuor wɔ afe 2012 abatoɔ mu. Hon. Dery yɛɛ Water Aid Partner Round Table, mpɔtam hɔ NGO ahodoɔ fekuw a Nsu Mmoa de sika boa no no Titenani mfeɛ du (1993-2003). Wɔ din a wɔde kɔmaa mmarahyɛ badwa no sɛ wɔmfa nnye ntom wɔ Ɔbɛnem bosome no da a ɛtɔ so aduonu baako wɔ afe 2021 mu no, Ɔmampanyin no na ɔpaw Dery sɛ ɔnkɔ so nkura ne som adwuma mu sɛ Ɔman no mu ɔsoafoɔ.

Ankorankoro asetena 
Ambrose yɛ Katolekni na waware a ɔwɔ abɔfra baako.

Badwakuo ahodoɔ 
Na ɔyɛ Amansan Mmara, Mmara ne Mmarahyɛ badwam Nsɛm no mu ni na na ɔsan yɛ Selection Committee no mu ni.

Baabi a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Mathew Opoku Prempeh
text:
Matthew Opoku Prempeh a wɔwoo no Kɔtɔnimaa bosome da ɛtɔ so aduonu -mmiɛnsa wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduosia - nnwɔtwe mu no yɛ Ghana aduruyɛ ho oduruyɛfo ne amanyɔni. Ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuo ni a, ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani ma Manhyia South abatoɔ mpasua a ɛwɔ Asanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔyɛ kane Nwomasua ho Soafo.  Wɔfrɛ no kɛse sɛ NAPO.    Mprempren ɔyɛ Ɔsoafo a ɔhwɛ Ahoɔden so.

Ne Mmɔfraase ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Matthew Opoku Prempeh wɔ Kɔtɔnimaa bosome da ɛtɔ so aduonu -mmiɛnsa wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduosia -nnwɔtwe mu wɔ Asanti New Town, Kumasi kurotia, na ɔfiri Pakyi No. 2 wɔ Asanti Mantam mu.

Ɔhyɛɛ ne mfitiaseɛ nwomasua ase wɔ KNUST Primary na ɔkɔɔ so kɔɔ Prempeh College a ɛwɔ Kumasi, Asanti mantam wɔ Ghana, maa ne mfimfini sukuu adesua.

Ɔsuaa 'Human Biology ne Medicine' wɔ Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology (KNUST) na ɔwiee ne MB CHB wɔ Afe apem ahenkron aduokron - nnan mu. Ɔtoaa so yɛɛ 'Post-graduate' adesua wɔ 'MSc. Clinical Epidemiology' wɔ 'Netherlands Institute of Health Sciences' wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduokron - nnwɔtwe    ne 'Kennedy School of Government' wɔ Harvard Suapɔn mu a ɔsuaa Akannifoɔ ne Aban ho adeɛ.  Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne mmienu mu no, ɔkɔɔ oprehyɛn ho ntetee akyi wɔ United Kingdom (MRCS).

Adwuma 
Ansa na ɔrehyɛn mmarahyɛbadwa mu no, Prempeh yɛɛ 'Keyedmap Security Services Limited' CEO firi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnan  kɔsi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nkron.Ɔsane yɛ aduruyɛ ho oduruyɛfo  na ɔsom sɛ 'Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons' a ɛwɔ United Kingdom no muni firi afe apem ahenkron aduokron -nkron kɔsi mfeɛ mpem mpem mmienu ne mmiɛnsa  mu.

Amanyɔsɛm

Mmarahyɛbadwani 
Sɛ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwani no, ɔgyinaa Manhyia South ananmu wɔ Kumasi, kane no na ɔgyina Manhyia ananmu.Wɔdii kan paa,no sɛ ɔnyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe  mu a na ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party amayɔkuoni. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du- nsia  mu no, wɔsane paa no bio berɛ a ɔde mma mpem aduasa num, ahenkron aduonum nnwɔtwe ( 35,958), anaa abatoɔ a wɔtoo wɔ ɔmantam no mu Ɔha abupɛn aduowɔtwe nson akyire po du- nson ( 87.17%). Na ɔyɛ akwahosan boayikuo ne boayikuo a wɔpaa nnipa no muni. Prempeh sii akan wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu  Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani kandifoɔ maa Manhyia South mansini no wɔ New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuo no din mu  na ɔdii nkonim kɛseɛ.

Nwomasua ho Ɔsoafo 
Ɔmanpanyin Nana Akufo-Addo na ɔpaa no wɔ Ɔbɛnem bosome da ɛtɔ so du  wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du- nson mu sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ Ɔsoafoɔ  a ɔhwɛ Nwomasua so wɔ Ghana.[12] Ɔsomm wɔ saa dwumadie no mu mfeɛ nnan kɔsii Ɔbɛnem bosome da ɛtɔ so nsia wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu - baako mu  berɛ a ɔmampanyin ne n’asomfo berɛ baa awieeɛ.

Wɔ Kɔtɔnimaa bosome mu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du- nson mu no, Ɔmanpanyin Nana Akufo-Addo bɔɔ Prempeh din sɛ asomfoɔ du -nkron a wɔbɛhyehyɛ ne kabinet no mu baako.[18] Wɔde asomfo du- nkron no din kɔmaa Ghana Mmarahyɛbadwa no na kane Mmrahyɛbadwafoɔ Kasamafoɔ, Mike Ocquaye na ɔde too dwa.[18] Sɛ́ Kabinet soafo no, na Prempeh ka ɔmansoafo no mu kuo no ho na na ɛsɛ sɛ ɔboa wɔ gyinaesi dwumadi atitiri mu wɔ ɔman no mu. 

Prempeh nso boaa Ghana nwomasua adwuma no mu sɛ Nwomasua soafoɔ, te sɛ nnwuma a wɔbɛma atu mpɔn,adwuma ne mfiridwuma ho adesua (TVET) a ɔhyɛɛ ho nkuran, ne aban nhyehyɛeɛ titire ''FREE SHS'' a ɔdii anim.

Ɔmansoafo a ɔhwɛ ahoɔden so 
Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu baako  mu no, Ghana Ɔmampanyin, Nana Akuffo-Addo, bere a wɔsane paa no sɛ Ɔmansoafoɔ no, ɔbɔɔ Ɔbenfo Matttew Opoku Prempeh din sɛ Ɔmansoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Ahoɔden so.  Na wadi kane asom sɛ Nwomasua Soafo wɔ Ɔmampanyin Nana Akuffo-Addo afe a ɛdi kan no.[12]

Boayikuo ahodoɔ 
Prempeh yɛ 'Defense and Interior Committee' no muni na ɔsan yɛ 'Appointments Committee' no muni.[9]

Abasobɔdeɛ  Ahodoɔ 
Wɔbuu Dr. Matthew Opoku Prempeh sɛ Ɔsomfoɔ a ɔsen biara wɔ Ghana wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du- nson ne mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du- nkron no mu. Ɔsane nso nyaa 'Harvard Ministerial Medal of Achievement' wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu no mu.

Wɔ Kɔtɔnimaa bosome mu wɔ Mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu - baako mu no, Nwomasua Suapɔn Winneba maa no Nidie sɛ Oduruyɛfo Abodin krataa.

Wɔ Kitawonsa bosome mu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu - baako  mu no, Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Adwumayɛfoɔ Adesua so nso maa no Nidie sɛ Oduruyɛfoɔ a ɔhwɛ Nnipa Nkrataa so.[23]

Sɛ Ghana Mmarahyɛbadwani no, ɔgyinaa Manhyia South ananmu wɔ Kumasi, kan no na ɔgyina Manhyia ananmu.

Cape Coast Suapɔn ne asoɛeɛ a ɛtwa toɔ a ɛgye Ɔbenfoɔ Prempeh mmoa a ɔde ama Ghana nkɔsoɔ ne ne som kɛseɛ a ɔde maa Cape Coast Suapɔn, Ghana no atom.

Ankorankoro Abrabɔ 
Ɔkyerɛ sɛ ɔyɛ Kristoni[9] na ɔyɛ kane Ghana ɔmampanyin John Agyekum Kufuor ba nana. 

Wɔ Ɔbɛnim  bosome mu wɔ Mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu -mmienu mu no, kuo bi a wɔfrɛ wɔn 'Friends of NAPO' de nkyerɛkyerɛ nneɛma bi maa sukuu ahodoɔ a ɛwɔ Manhyia South abatoɔ mpasua so de hyɛɛ n’awoda a ɛto so aduonum nnan ho fa. 

Prempeh College too ne din wɔ wɔn 'dormitory block' bi so wɔ Ayɛwohommɔbɔ bosome da ɛtɔ du nson wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu mmiɛnsa mu  .

title: Laliri George Maban
text:
laliri George Maban (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛnimaa da a ɛtɔ so Aduonu-num, afe Apem, Ahankron ne aduonum-nan- 1954.) yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɛfo. Ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani  ma Wulensi Mantam no firi 7 Ɔbɛnem 2013 kɔsi 6 Ɔbɛnem 2017.

Mfitiase Asetena ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Maban wɔ 25 Ɔpɛnimaa da ɛtɔ so aduoaduomu-num , afe Apem Ahankron ne Aduonum-nan- -954. Ɔfiri Wulensi wɔ Ghana Atifi Fam Mantam mu. Ɔsuaa adeɛ wɔ EP Training College, Bimbilla baabi a ɔnyaa ne Teachers’ Certificate ‘A’ wɔ afe 1979 mu.

Adwumayɛ 
Ansa na ɔrehyɛn amamyɔsɛm mu no, na Maban yɛ Ɔmantam Ntamgyinafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Nhomasua Dwumadibea a Ɛnyɛ Mmara kwan so (NFED) a ɛwɔ Nhomasua Dwumadibea a ɛwɔ Nanumba Anafoɔ Mantam mu no so.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Maban kɔɔ mmarahyɛbadwafie wɔ  wɔ Ɔbɛnem da a 2013 wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so. Ɔgyinaa Wulensi Mansin ananmu firi afe 2013 kɔsi afe 2017 berɛ a ɔhweree atenaeɛ no wɔ Thomas Donkor Ogajah a ɔfiri New Patriotic Party mu wɔ afe 2016 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu.Ɔnyaa abatoɔ 11,061 a ɛne Ogajah abatoɔ 14,950.

Wɔ mmarahyɛ bagua mu no, wasom wɔ abadwakuo ahodoɔ mu, a Daa Ahyɛdeɛ abadwakuo ne Adwumayɛ ne Adan abadwakuo

Ankorankoro asetena 
Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baakron. Ɔkyerɛ sɛ ɔyɛ Kristoni ne Katolek Asɔre no muni.

Adwumayɛ 
Ɔmantam Nkitahodi a ɛwɔ NFED – Nanumba Anafo Mantam Wulensi

Nhomasua ho ɔbenfoɔ

title: David Adakudugu
text:
David Adakudugu (October 23, 1968 – September 19, 2019) yɛ Ghana amannyɔni ne mmarahyɛbadwani a na ɔka mmarahyɛbadwa a  ɛtɔ so Nsia a ɛwɔ Ghana  Fourth Republic no mu ni a ɔgyina Tempane  abatoɔ mpesua foforɔ no ananmu wɔ Upper East mantam no mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Ankorankoro asetena 
Na Adakudugu yɛ Kristoni (Assemblies of God Asɔre). Ɔwaree Akanvariva Lydia Lamisi a na ɔwɔ mma num.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Adakudugu wɔ Ahinime bosome no da a ɛtɔ so aduonu mmiensa (23), wɔ afe 1968. Ɔfiri Basyonde, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Upper East mantam no mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔkɔɔ Methodist Sukuupɔn, a ɛwɔ Accra na ɔnyaa ne bachelor’s degree wɔ adwadie mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Na Adakudugu yɛ yɛ kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo NDC no mu nipa. Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔsii akan maa Tempane  abatoɔ mpesua foforɔ no wɔ NDC amanyɔkuo no din mu wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa a  ɛtɔ so so nsia a ɛwɔ republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no tekiti so na ɔdii nkonim.

Adwumafa 

 Ɔkwankyerɛfoɔ Panyin, Noryini Commercial Limited, Kasoa (2005–2009) .

 Ɔmantam no sohwɛfoɔ panin, Garu-Tempane Ɔkwankyerɛfoɔ (April, 2009–January, 2013)

Owuo 
Adakudugu wuiɛ wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome no da a ɛtɔ so dunkron, wɔ afe 2019 wɔ Tamale Nkyerɛkyerɛ Ayaresabea.

Baabi a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Akosua Frema Osei-Opare
text:
Frema Opare, Akosua Frema Osei-Opare (wɔwoo no afe 1947) yɛ nkɔsoɔ ho nimdefoɔ, ɔbenfoɔ, ne Ghana amammuifoɔ. Ɔgyinaa Ayawaso West Wuogon Mansin ananmu wɔ Ghana Mmarahyɛ Bagua no mu. Ɔyɛ ɔbea a ɔyɛ Ghana Adwumayɛfo Panyin mprempren ne nea odi kan.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Frema wɔ Ayɛwohomumɔ bosome no da a ɛtɔ so 5 wɔ afe 1947. Ɔfiri Wiamoase a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔkɔɔ St. Monica Ntoaso Sukuu, Mampong- Ashanti. Ɔkɔɔ St. Monica Ntoaso Sukuu, Mampong- Ashanti. Ɔkɔɔ Guelph Sukuupɔn mu kɔyɛɛ abodin krataa a ɛkorɔn wɔ Aduan Ho Nyansahu mu.

Adwuma 
Frema maa ɔkasa wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ wɔ Department of Home Science firi afe 1976 kɔsi afe 1982. Awieeɛ koraa no ɔbɛyɛɛ dwumadibea no Titenani. Ɔne Amanaman Nkabom no nso ayɛ adwuma wɔ Women In Fisheries adwuma no mu wɔ dibea ahorow mu wɔ Uganda, Ethiopia, Congo ne Namibia. Frema wɔ afe 2005 - 2008 mu yɛɛ adwuma wɔ Ɔmanpanyin John Agyekum Kufuor aban ase sɛ Ɔmanpanyin Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Adwumayɛfoɔ, Mmabun ne Adwumayɛ so. 

Fida, Ɔpɛpɔn da a ɛtɔ so nson, afe 2023 no, The Valley View University de nidi Doctorate Degree maa Akosua Frema Osei-Opare, Adwumayɛfoɔ Panyin, de kyerɛɛ ne nnwuma soronko ne ntoboa a ɛso bi nni a ɔde ama Ghana nkɔsoɔ. Nsɛm a wɔafa aka no sii so dua sɛ, "Ɛgyina saa nkɔsoɔ ne ntoboa a wo, w'animuonyam, de ama Ghana nkɔsoɔ ne adesamma nkɔsoɔ nyinaa so no, Valley View Suapɔn nam ha so gye saa nkɔsoɔ yi tom na ɛnam yei so de Doctor Science Abodin krataa ma wo." (Honours Causa) da yi, Fida, Ɔpɛpɔn bosome ne da a  ɛtɔ so 7  wɔ afe 2023.

Amammui mu adwuma 
Frema yɛ New Patriotic Party no muni titiriw.Ɔdii dwuma mfeɛ mmienu sɛ mmarahyɛ baguani a ɔgyinaa Ayawaso West Wuogon Mansin ananmu wɔ afe 2005 ne 2013 ntam wɔ NPP tekiti ase.

2004 Abatoɔ 
Wɔpaw Opare sɛ mmarahyɛ baguani wɔ Ayawaso West-Wuogon mantam mu wɔ afe 2004 Ghana Amansan abatow mu. Ɔnam saayɛ so gyinaa amansin no ananmu wɔ Ghana republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmarahyɛ bagua a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu. Wɔde abatow 28,636 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 54,988 mu. Wɔpaw no sen Henry Haruna Asante a ofi Ɔmanfo Ɔman Nhyiam no mu, Samuel Adiepena a ofi Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛ Bagua no mu ne Greenstreet Kobina a ofi Nhyiam no mu Nnipa Kuw no mu Eyinom nyaa abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu ɔha biara mu nkyem 1.0, ɔha biara mu nkyem 37.9, ne ɔha biara mu nkyem 9.0. Wɔpaw Opare wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so. Ná ne mantam no yɛ amansin 17 a New Patriotic Party dii nkonim wɔ Greater Accra mantam mu wɔ saa abatow no mu no fã. Sɛ yɛka ne nyinaa bom a, New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmarahyɛ bagua nkongua 128 wɔ Ghana republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmarahyɛ bagua a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Frema aware na ɔwɔ mma baanan. Ɔyɛ Kristoni.

title: Robert Nachinab Doameng
text:
Robert Nachinab Doameng (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn 1, 1953) yɛ Ghana amannyɔni ne mmarahyɛbadwani a na ɔka mmarahyɛbadwa a Ɛtɔ so Nsia a ɛwɔ Ghana Ɔman a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu ni a ɔgyinaa Talensi Mansini no abatoɔ mpesua no so a ɛwɔ Upper East mantam no ananmu wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so.

Ankorankoro asetena 
Doameng yɛ Kristoni (Katolekni). Ɔwaree (ɔwɔ mma mmiensa).

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Doameng wɔ obubuo bosome no da a ɛdi kan (1), wɔ afe 1953. Ɔfiri Tongo, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Upper East mantam no mu wɔ Ghana.[1] Ɔkɔɔ Cape Coast Suapɔn, Ghana na ɔnyaa ne master’s degree wɔ Environmental Management and Policy wɔ afe 2008 mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Doameng yɛ ɔsono amannyɔkuo (NPP) no mu ni. Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔsii akan maa Talensi abatoɔ mpesua no wɔ NPP din mu wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nsia a ɛwɔ ɔman a ɛtɔ so nnan no tekiti so na ɔdii nkonim.

Baabi a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Timothy Awotiirim Ataboadey
text:
Timothy Ataboadey Awotiirim (wɔwoo no July 1, 1970) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne nnwomasuani. Ɔsan somm sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma Builsa North mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Upper East Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

Abrabɔ ahyɛase ne nnwomasua 
Wɔwoo Awotiirim wɔ Kitawonsa bosome da adi kan wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduoson(1970) mu wɔ Wiaga kuro a ɛwɔ Upper East Mantam mu. Ɔnyaa ne suapɔn mu abasobɔdeɛ wɔ Bachelor of Arts degree wɔ Geography ne Resource Development adesua mu wɔ University of Ghana mfeɛ mpem mmienu mu (2000).

Adwuma 
Ansa na wɔrepaw no sɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni no, Ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ Nhwehwɛmufo wɔ Commission on Human Rights and Administrative Justice (CHRAJ) fi 1994 kosi 2004. Ɔsan nso yɛɛ adwuma sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo wɔ Christ the King JSS, Chiana.

N'ankasa abrabɔ 
Awotiirim yɛ kristoni a ɔsomm wɔ Katolik asɔre mu. W'aware wɔ mma mmienu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Awotiirim yɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ Ghana adehyeman amammuo a ɛtɔ so nan mmarahyɛbadwafie a ɛtɔ so num mu nipa a  wɔpaw no wɔ National Democratic Congress (NDC) tekiti so wɔ December 2008 Ghana amansan abatow mu sɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni ma Builsa Atifi (Ghana mmarahyɛ bagua mantam). Odii Agnes A. Chigabatia a ofi New Patriotic Party (NPP) ne afoforo baanu so nkonim ma odii nkonim wɔ Builsa North mmarahyɛ bagua no mu. MP a ɔdii dwuma afe baako no nyaa abatoɔ 8,259 wɔ abatoɔ 19,165 a ɛfata a wɔtoo no mu = 43.1%. James Agalga dii no so nkonim wɔ afe 2012 mu de faa Builsa North mmarahyɛ bagua no. Wɔ General News a ɛbaa 8 December 2017 mu no ɔkaa sɛ "Nnipa a wɔasua nhoma di aporɔw sen wɔn a wonnim akenkan ne akyerɛw".

Beaeɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Kwame-Osei Prempeh
text:
Kwame -Osei Prempeh yɛ mmrahyɛbadwani a yɛwoo no Ɔpɛnima 19, 1957. [1]Ɔka Mmrahyɛbadwa nnum a ɛyɛ Adehyeman, Ghana ma Nsuta-kwamang Beposo wɔ Asante mantam.[2]

N'abrabɔ ne ne Sukuu mu nsɛm 
Yɛwoo Prempeh wɔ Kwamang a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam, Ghana. [2]Ɔkɔɔ sukuu wɔ Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology ma.Onyaa Degree wɔ Bachelor of Social Science mu wɔ afe 1982.[2] Ɔsane toaso wɔUniversity of Ghana afe 1987 mu na ɛhɔ nso ɔkɔyɛɛ Quantum Chemistry Laboratory, QCL. Ɔsan kɔɔ sukuu biom wɔ Ghana school of Law ma onyaa Degree wɔ Bachelor of Law mu afe 1989.[1]

Adwuma a ɔyɛ 
Na Prempeh ka adwumakuo Sarpong Legal Services a ɛwɔ Ashanti Region -Kumasi ho. Na ɔka mmrahyɛ badwa akonnwa ma Nsuta-Kwamang Beposo mansini a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam, Ghana.[2] Ɔbɛyɛɛ Panin a ɔhwɛ ma biribiara totɔ yie wɔ Group Chief Executive a ɛwɔ GOIL Company Limited wɔ Ayewohomumu 3, 2019, ansa na ɔrebɛyɛ panin mfie mmienu akyi.[3][4]

Mmrahyɛbadwani mu nsɛm 
Prempeh ka New Patriotic Party ho.[1] Ɔno na yɛ dii kan yii no baa mmrahyɛbadwa mu wɔ ɔpɛnimaa, 1996 Ghana abatoɔ kɛseɛ no mu sɛ tikitu ma New Patriotic Party.[2] Ɔgyinaeɛ no ɔnyaa abatoɛ 12,586 a yɛte firi abatoɔ 24,444 nnyinaa mu a ɛyɛ 51.5% a ɛtu.Thomas Fokuo Agyepong a ɔyɛ NDC ni a aba 10,313 na ɔnyaeɛ de gyina hɔ ma 33.70%. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ afe 2000 Ghana abatoɔ kɛseɛ no mu wɔ ma onyaa aba 13,568 a yɛte firi 21,358 a ɛyɛ 63.50% a etia Ebenezer A. Frimpong Prempeh a ɔyɛ NDC ni, Osei O. Emmanuel a ɔyɛ NRP ni, Osei Kwadwo a ɔyɛ CPP ni, Salisu Muhammed a ɔyɛ PNC ni ne Kofi A. Kankam a ɔyɛ UGM ni a wɔn nyaa aba 6,889 aba 304, aba 285, aba 221, ne aba 91 nnidisoɔ sa ara.[5] Ɔnyaa aba beberee a ɛyɛ 15,704 sɛ yɛte firi aba 24,344 a ɛyɛ 64.50% de tia Samuel Otu a ɔyɛ NDC mu nnipa E.O.Adu-Amankwaah a ɔyɛ IND mu nnipa ne George Osei Owusu Amankwah a ɔyɛ CPP, wɔn nyaa aba 7,769, 547 ne 324 nnidisoɔ sa ara.[6] Ɔnyaa 17,403 a yɛte firi aba 24,879 ne mu a ɛgyina hɔ ma 69.95% mmerɛ a afe 2008 abatoɔ kɛseɛ no kɔɔ so no.[7] Ɔdii Kwame Asafu-Adjei so nkonim wɔ 2012 abatoɔ kɛseɛ no mu.[8]

Adwuma mu suahunu ahodoɔ 
Owura Osei-Prempeh wɔ osuahu pii a wanya wɔ Ɔman Adwumayɛ ne Ankorankoro Adwumayɛ mu sɛ mmaranimfo panyin. Ɔyɛɛ Ghana Mmaranimfoɔ Panyin Abadiakyiri ne Atemmuo soafoɔ firi June 2006 kɔsi Ɔpɛpɔn 2009 na na ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni ma Nsuta- Kwamang Beposo wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ afe 1997 ne 2013 ntam.

Bere a na ɔwɔ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no mu no, ɔyɛɛ Boayikuw a ɛhwɛ Amansan Mmara, Mmara ne Mmarahyɛ Bagua Nsɛm so ne Atemmu Boayikuw no Titenani.[9]

N'asetena abrabɔ 
Prempeh yɛ ɔwarefoɔ a ɔwɔ mma nnan. Ɔyɛ kristoni na ɔkɔ Adventist Asɔre ho.[2]

title: Boniface Gambila Adagbila
text:
Boniface Gambila Adagbila (wɔwoo no June 9, 1959) yɛ Ghana amannyɔni ne mmarahyɛbadwani a na ɔka mmarahyɛbadwa a Ɛtɔ so Nsia a ɛwɔ Ghana Aman a ɛtɔ so nnan no muni a na ɔgyina Nabdam Mansini no ananmu wɔ Upper East mantam no mu wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so.

Ankorankoro asetena 
Adagbila aware a ɔwɔ mma mmiensa. Ɔyɛ Katolekni.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Adagbila wɔ Ayɛwohomumɔ bosome no da a ɛtɔ so nkron (9), wɔ afe 1959. Ɔfiri Damolg-Tindongo, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Upper East mantam no mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔkɔɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu na ɔnyaa ne master’s degree wɔ Adwene ne Nneyɛe Ho Adesua mu wɔ afe 1986. Ɔsan nso kɔɔ Manchester Suapɔn mu na ɔnyaa postgraduate diploma wɔ Human Resource Training and Development mu wɔ afe 1992 mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Adagbila yɛ Ɔsono amanyɔkuo NPP no mu nipa. Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔsii akan maa Nabdam abtoɔ mpesua no so  wɔ NPP din mu wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa a Ɛtɔ so nsia a ɛwɔ republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no tekiti so na ɔdii nkonim.

Adwumayɛ 
Ɔhwɛfoɔ/ɔhwɛfoɔ.

Nnipa ahoɔden ho ɔbenfo .

Ɔman Dwumadie Nhyehyɛeɛ sohwɛfoɔ Panyin, 2002–2005

Apueɛ Fam mantam Soafoɔ, 2005–2007

Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo Panyin (BSMP & PTUA), VRA Accra .

title: Mark Owen Woyongo
text:
Mark Owen Woyongo (wɔwoo no 9 June 1946) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne Ghana ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ ɔman no mu banbɔ nsɛm  so ma Ghana hwɛ ɔman no mu banbɔ Dwumadibea. Na ɔsan yɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma Navrongo Central mansini a ɛwɔ Ghana.

Woyongo dii kan gyinaa abatoɔ no so wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so wɔ afe 2008 Ghana mmarahyɛ badwa abatoɔ mu, ɔdii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ no mu a ɔnyaa 41.7% na ɔde dii Joseph Kofi Adda a ɔfiri New Patriotic Party no anim wɔ abatoɔ no mu no so nkunim, a ɔno nso nyaa mma no mu  1,130 (3.5%). Nanso Ɔmampanyin Mills paw no sɛ Upper East mantam no soafoɔ wɔ n’aban mu wɔ afe 2009. Ɔmampanyin Mahama na ɔde no kɔɔ saa dibea yi mu wɔ Mills wuo akyi. Wɔ afe 2013 mu no, Ɔmampanyin Mahama na ɔyii no sɛ ɔnyɛ ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Bammɔ so.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Mark Owen Woyongo wɔ Ayɛwohomumɔ bosome no da a ɛtɔ so nkron wɔ afe 1946 mu wɔ Bolgatanga wɔ Upper East mantam no mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔkɔɔ Notre Dame Secondary School wɔ Navrongo wɔ afe 1966. Ɔwiee Diploma wɔ Journalism mu wɔ Ghana Institute of Journalism wɔ afe 1971. Wayɛ adwumayɛfoɔ adesua bebree wɔ Ghana ne amannɔne.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Mark Owen Woyongo yɛ Ɔmanfoɔ Nkitahodiɛ sohwɛfoɔ wɔ Upper East mantam no Administration so firi afe 1978 ne 1985. Wɔpaw no sɛ mantam Amanneɛbɔ sohwɛfoɔ, Upper East mantam no mu wɔ afe 1985. Wɔ afe 1994 mu no, wɔpaw no sɛ Ɔsomfoɔ Fotufoɔ a ɔhwɛ Amanneɛbɔ so wɔ Ghana High Commission wɔ London, United Kingdom, na ɛwɔ hɔ. Mark Woyongo yɛ ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Upper East mantam no so firi afe 2009 – 2012. ɔnyaa ne ti didii mu wɔ akwanhyia a ɛyɛ hu mu bere a ɔfiri NDC nhyiam a wɔyɛeɛ wɔ Upper East mantam mu no sane aba no.

Ɔdii nkonim wɔ afe 2012 mmarahyɛ badwa abatoɔ no mu wɔ National Democratic Congress (NDC) tekiti so. Wɔ afe 2013 mu no, wɔpaw no sɛ Ɔman Bammɔ Soafoɔ na akyiri yi ɔyɛɛ Ɔman no mu Ɔsoafo wɔ bere a na ɔyɛ Upper East mantam no soafoɔ .

Ankorankoro asetena 
Mark Woyongo aware na ɔwɔ mma mmienu.

title: Abuga Pele
text:
Abuga Pele (wɔwoo no Oforisuo 3, 1958) yɛ Ghanaamannyɔni ne mmarahyɛbadwani a na ɔka mmarahyɛbadwa a Ɛtɔ so mmienu, mmiɛnsa, anan, anum ne nsia a ɛwɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu a ɔgyinaa Chiana-Paga Mansin no ananmu wɔ Upper East mantam no mu wɔ kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo NDC din mu.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Pele wɔ Oforisuo bosome no da a ɛtɔ so mmiensa (3), wɔ afe 1958 mu. Ɔfiri Paga Buru Nakolo, akuraa bi a ɛwɔ Upper East mantam no mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔkɔɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu na ɔnyaa ne Master of Philosophy (MPhil) abodin krataa wɔ afe 1988 mu.

Adwuma 
Pele yɛ adwuma sohwɛfoɔ ne adwuma sohwɛfoɔ. Ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ Internal Revenue Service sɛ toɔtua ho ɔhwɛfoɔ. Na ɔyɛ Ghana Mmabunu Adwumayɛ ne Adwumayɛ Nkɔsoɔ Dwumadibea (GYEEDA) no Ɔman Ntamgyinafoɔ.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Pele yɛ yɛ kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo NDC no mu nipa. Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔsii akan maa Chiana/Paga abatoɔ mpesua no so wɔ NDC tekiti so wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nsia wɔ republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu na ɔdii nkonim.

title: Dominic Ayine
text:
Dominic Akuritinga Ayine (wɔwoo no 6 Ɔbɛnem 1966) yɛ Ghana amannyɔni ne mmarahyɛbadwani a na ɔka mmarahyɛbadwa a Ɛtɔ so nson a ɛwɔ Ghana Aman a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu nipa a ɔgyinaa Bolgatanga Apueeɛ Mansin ananmu wɔ Upper East mantam no mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Mfitiase asetra 
Wɔwoo Ayine wɔ  Ɔbɛnem bosome no da a ɛtɔ so nsia (6) wɔ afe 1966 mu wɔ Zuarungu, a ɛwɔ Upper east mantam no mu wɔ Ghana.

Nwomasua 
Ɔnyaa Bachelor of Arts abodin krataa wɔ mmara mu wɔ University Of Ghana, Legon wɔ Greater Accra mantam no mu wɔ Ghana ne GSL wɔ afe 1995. Ɔnyaa ne LLM wɔ (International Economic Law) mu wɔ University of Michigan Law School wɔ afe 1998. Afei ɔkɔɔ Stanford Suapɔn Mmara Sukuu, wɔ California, USA maa JSD (Adwadie ne Demokrasi) wɔ afe 2006 mu.

Adwumafa 
Mmaranimfo

Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo, Mmara Sukuu, Ghana Sukuupɔn, Legon-Accra

Ɔmanpanyin Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Atɛntrenee so

Ankorankoro asetra

Ayine yɛ Kristoni. Ɔwaree (ɔwɔ mma baason).

title: Albert Abongo
text:
Albert Abongo (wɔwoo no September 15, 1959) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne amansan mfididwumayɛni. Abongo firi Bongo mansini a ɛbɛn Bolgatanga kuro no a ɛwɔ Upper East mantam mu, na ɔyɛ kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo( NDC) no mu kuoba ne mmarahyɛbadwani ma Bongo mansini no.

Abrabɔ ahyɛase ne nnwomasua 
Wɔwoo Albert Abongo wɔ afe 1959 mu wɔ Gowrie-Bongo wɔ Upper East Region wɔ Ghana. Ɔwɔ Bachelor of Science abodin krataa wɔ civil engineering mu wɔ Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology wɔ afe 1986. Ɔsan nso kɔɔ Trondheim Suapɔn wɔ Norway na osuaa Ports and Coastal Engineering wɔ afe 1992 mu. Ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ civil engineer wɔ Ghana Ports and Harbors Authority ansa na ɔrehyɛn amammuisɛm mu. Ɔyɛ Kristoni na waware na ɔwɔ mma baason.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Abongo yɛ Kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo (National Democratic Congress) no mu nipa na na ɔyɛ Upper East mantam no mu soafo. Wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome mu wɔ mfeɛ 2009 mu no, Ɔmampanyin John Atta Mills paw no sɛ Ɔsoafo a ɔhwɛ Nsuo Ho Nneɛma, Adwumayɛ ne Adan So. Ɔnyaa mmirikatuo mpɛn 4 wɔ n’adwuma mu sɛ mmarahyɛ bagua no muni a ɔgyinaa Bongo Mansin ananmu a ɔbaa n’adwuma mu wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2001 mu. Na ɔsan yɛ boayikuw a ɛhwɛ Akwahosan, Ofie, Asase ne Kwae so no muni

Abatoɔ 
Abongo na wɔpaw no sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani  ma Bongo mantam a ɛwɔ Upper East Region of Ghana nea edi kan wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow no mu. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so. Na ne mansin no yɛ mmarahyɛ bagua nkongua 9 no fã wɔ nkongua 13 a National Democratic Congress dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Upper East Region no mu. National Democratic Congress dii nkonim wɔ nnipa kakraa bi a wɔka bom yɛ mmarahyɛ bagua nkongua 94 wɔ nkongua 230 mu. Wɔde abatow 17,397 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 28,645 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 60.7% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Abugre Felix a ofi People’s National Convention, Andrews Awuni Aberibire a ofi New Patriotic Party ne Amoro Mpuse a ofi Convention People’s Party mu. Eyinom nyaa abatow 719, 10,311 ne 218 wɔ abatow a wɔtow nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 2.5%, 36% ne 0.8% yɛ pɛ.

N'ankasa abrabɔ 
Abongo yɛ kristoni.

title: Kwame Osei Prempeh
text:
Kwame Osei-Prempeh (wɔwoo no 19 December 1957) yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɔni na ɔyɛ Ghana Mmarahyɛ badwa a Ɛto so Anum no muni a ogyina Nsuta-Kwamang Beposofo ananmu wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

Mfitiase asetra ne Nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Prempeh wɔ Kwamang wɔ Asante Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔkɔɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so na onyaa ne Abodin krataa wɔ Bachelor of Social Science mu wɔ afe 1982 mu. Ɔkɔɔ Ghana Suapɔn wɔ afe 1987 mu na osuaa Quantum Chemistry Laboratory, QCL. Ɔsan nso kɔɔ Ghana mmara sukuu na onyaa Abodin krataa wɔ Bachelor of Law mu wɔ afe 1989 mu.

Adwuma 
Ná Prempeh yɛ Sarpong Mmara Dwumadibea a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu, Kumasi no mu dwumayɛni. Na ɔsan yɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni ma Nsuta-Kwamang Beposo mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔbɛyɛɛ Ɔkwankyerɛfo Panyin a ɔreyɛ adwuma ne Kuw no Adwumayɛfo Panyin wɔ GOIL Adwumakuw a Wɔahyehyɛ nom wɔ June 3, 2019, akyi a ɔyɛɛ board member firi mfeɛ mmienu a atwam no.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Prempeh yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo (NPP) no muni. Wɔdii kan paw no sɛ ɔmmra Mmarahyɛ Bagua no mu wɔ December 1996 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu wɔ New Patriotic Party no tikiti so. Ɔnyaa abatoɔ 12,586 wɔ abatoɔ 24,444 a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 51.5 tiaa Thomas Fokuo Agyepong a ɔyɛ NDC amanyɔkuw muni a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 10,313 a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 33.70. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ afe 2000 Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ no mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 13,568 wɔ abatoɔ 21,358 a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ no mu a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 63.50 tiaa Ebenezer A. Frimpong Prempeh ne NDC muni, Osei O. Emmanuel a ɔyɛ NRP muni, Osei Kwadwo yɛ CPP muni, Salisu Muhammed yɛ PNC muni ne Kofi A. Kankam a ɔyɛ UGM muni a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 6,889, abatoɔ 304, abatoɔ 285, abatoɔ 221, abatoɔ 91. Ɔnyaa abatoɔ 15,704 wɔ abatoɔ 24,344 a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ no mu a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 64.50 tiaa Samuel Otu a ɔyɛ NDC muni, E.O.Adu-Amankwaah a ɔyɛ IND muni ne George Osei Owusu Amankwah a ɔyɛ CPP muni a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 7,769, 547 ne 324. Ɔnyaa abatoɔ 17,403 wɔ abatoɔ 24,879 a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 69.95 wɔ afe 2008 Amansan Abatoɔ no mu. Kwame Asafu-Adjei dii no so nkonim wɔ afe 2012 Amansan Abatoɔ no mu.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Prempeh aware na ɔwɔ mma baanan. Ɔyɛ Kristoni na ɔyɛ Adventist Asɔre no muni.

title: Noah Ben Azure
text:
Noah Ben Azure (wɔwoo no December 5, 1960) yɛ Ghana amannyɔni ne mmarahyɛbadwani a na ɔka mmarahyɛbadwa a Ɛtɔ so Nsia a ɛwɔ Ghana Republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu ni a ɔgyina Binduri Mansini no ananmu wɔ Upper East mantam no mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Ankorankoro asetena 
Azure yɛ Kristoni (Assemblies of God Asɔre). Ɔwaree (ɔwɔ mma mmiensa).

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Azure wɔ ɔpɛnimaa bosome no da a ɛtɔ so num (5), wɔ afe 1960 mu. Ɔfiri Binduri, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Upper East mantam no mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔkɔɔ Sukuupɔn a ɛhwɛ Nhomasua so, Winneba, Mampong Campus na ɔnyaa ne bachelor’s degree wɔ nwomasua mu wɔ afe 2000 mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Azure yɛ kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo NDC mu nipa. Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔsii akan maa Binduri abatoɔ mpesua no so wɔ NDC din mu wɔ  mmarahyɛbadwa a Ɛtɔ so nsia a ɛwɔ republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no tekiti so na ɔdii nkonim.

title: Ben Abdallah Banda
text:
Ben Abdallah Banda  (wɔwoo no Ɔbɛnem 15, 1971) yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɔfo ne Mmarahyɛ Bagua a ɛtɔ so nson a ɛwɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no muni a ɔgyina Offinso South Constituency ananmu wɔ Asantie mantam mu wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so.

Abrabɔ Ahyɛaseɛ 
Wɔwoo Banda wɔ August 15, 1971. Ɔfiri Abofour-Offinso kuro bi a ɛwɔ Asante Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔnyaa ne bachelor’s degree wɔ mmara mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu wɔ afe 1998 mu. Ɔsan nso nyaa mmara ho abodin krataa wɔ Ghana Mmara Sukuu mu wɔ afe 2000 mu.

Mmrahyɛbadwa mu nsɛm 
Mmarahyɛ Bagua a ɛtɔ so nnum a ɛwɔ Fourth Republic of Ghana a egyina Offinso Anafo fam mantam ananmu wɔ Ashanti mantam mu wɔ Ghana wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so. Ɔyɛɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni maa Offinso South Constituency mfeɛ mmiɛnsa a ɛtoatoa soɔ firi afe 2009 kɔsi afe 2021.

Ná ɔyɛ Atemmu Boayikuw no guamtrani. Ɔsan nso yɛɛ Amansan Mmara, Mmara ne Mmarahyɛ Bagua Nsɛm Boayikuw no guamtrani ne Mmarahyɛ Bagua Boayikuw no muni.

Adwuma 
Banda yɛ mmranimfo.Ɔyɛ ɔhokafoɔ wɔ Obeng Manu Law Firm, Kumasi. Wɔ June 30, 2021, Ɔmampanyin Akufo-Addo bɔɔ Ben Abdallah Banda din sɛ Ɔmampanyin ntamgyinafoɔ ma Zongo Nkɔsoɔ Fotoɔ, na ɔshɛ ne bɔ sɛ ɔbɛma Zongo mpɔtɛm a ɛwɔ Ghana anya nkɔsoɔ no so dua. 

Wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 15, 2023 no, Ɔmanpanin Akufo-Addo fä no sɛ Hajj Boayikuo no Titenani wɔ adwumakuo a atwam no a wɔsan hyehyɛɛ no ​​akyi. Saa paw yi ne sɛ wɔbɛhwɛ sɛ wɔbɛyɛ Hajj akwantuo no a biribiara a ɛnha wɔn.

Abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Banda yɛ kramoni. Waware wɔ mma mmiɛnsa.

title: Akolbire Emmanuel Opam-Brown
text:
Emmanuel Opam-Brown Akolbire (wɔwoo no November 15, 1960) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne kane mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ mmarahyɛbadwafie a ɛtɔ so nsia wɔ Ghana Adehyeman amammuo a ɛtɔ nan no mu a ɔgyina maa Bolgatanga Central mpɛsoa no wɔ Upper East Mantam mu wɔ kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo(NDC) no ananmu.

Abrabɔ ahyɛase ne nnwomasua 
Wɔwoo Akolbire wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 15, 1960. Ɔfiri Daportindongo-Bolgatanga, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Upper East Region wɔ Ghana. Ɔyɛ obi a wawie Vrije Universiteit Brussel na onyaa ne master’s degree wɔ Management Information System mu wɔ afe 1998 mu.

Adwuma 
akolbire yɛ ICT ho ɔbenfo wɔ n’adwuma mu. Na ɔyɛ ICT Ɔkwankyerɛfoɔ wɔ Central Administration a ɛwɔ Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ nkɔsoɔ adesua so wɔ Tamale.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Akolbire yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛ Bagua (NDC) no muni. Wɔpaw no sɛ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no Mmarahyɛ Bagua a ɛtɔ so 5 no muni sɛ ɔmmɛgyina Bolgatanga Central Constituency ananmu wɔ December 2008 mu na ɔdii tumi wɔ January 2009 mu. Wɔde abatoɔ 28,656 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata 49,694 a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu, a ɛne abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 57.66% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Mercy Alima Amusah A. a ofi Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no mu, David Apasera a ofi Ɔmanfo Ɔman Nhyiam no mu , Anyema Robert Abiiro a ofi Democratic People’s Party mu, Awuni Atia Solomon a ofi Democratic People’s Party mu ne Evelyn Lamisi Anabila a ofi Convention People’s Party no mu. Eyinom nyaa abatow a ɛfata nyinaa mu 20.25%, 20.14%, 0.46%, 0.20% ne 1.29%. Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔsii akan sɛ wɔbɛsan apaw no sɛ ɔbɛyɛ ɔman a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmarahyɛ bagua a ɛtɔ so nsia no muni na odii nkonim. Ɔhweree ne abatoɔ wɔ afe 2016 Amansan Abatoɔ no mu na ɔresan aba bio wɔ December 2020 Amansan Abatoɔ no mu. Na ɔyɛ boayikuw ahorow a ɛhwɛ Adwumayɛ, Asetra mu yiyedi ne Ɔman so ne Sikasɛm Boayikuw nso muni.

N'ankasa abrabɔ 
Akolbire yɛ Kristoni (Katolekni).[2] Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baanum.

title: Ama Pomaa Andoh
text:
Ama Pomaa Boateng a wɔwoo no Ɔbɛnem bosome da ɛtɔ so du- nkron wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduoson nnum mu no yɛ Ghana amanyɔni. Ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party mmarahyɛbadwani ma Juaben Mansini a ɛwɔ Asanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

Ne Mmɔfrasea  ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Ama Pomaa da  Ɔbɛnem bosome da ɛtɔ so du- nkron wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduoson nnum mu wɔ Juaben, Asanti Mantam mu. Ɔnyaa ne ntoaso sukuu a ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ 'Holy Child School' a ɛwɔ Cape Coast na ɔnyaa master’s degree wɔ nsɛm ho adesua mu wɔ Anglia Ruskin Suapɔn mu.  Ama wɔ adansedie krataa wɔ kɔmputa ho wɔ 'Westminster' Sukuupɔn a ɛwɔ London, UK. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du- mmienu mu no, ɔnyaa adansedie krataa wɔ 'E-waste' mu firii Amanaman Nkabom e-waste Academy.[6] Ɔsan nso wɔ adansedie nkrataa firi Penn Foster, Wild PCS, Harvard Suapɔn ne House of Democracy Partnership/ NDI.

Adwuma 
Ama Pomaa yɛ IT ho ɔfotufoɔ wɔ n’adwuma mu na ɔyɛ Ghana High-tech Women in Accra, NGO a ɛwɔ IT nteteeɛ mu no kwankyerɛfoɔ panin.  Ɔyɛ Ghana Parliament /ICT Akwankyerɛ Kuo no dwamtenani.[7] Ama yɛ Ɔman Petroleum Authority a ɛwɔ Ghana no board member, baabi a ɔyɛ Complaints and Settlements Subcommittee no Titenani.[7]

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ama Pomaa sii akan na ɔdii nkonim wɔ mmarahyɛbawa akondwa no mu maa Juaben Mansini a ɛwɔ Asanti Mantam mu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du- nsia , Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu. Nnipa mmiɛnsa foforɔ a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔpa wɔn, a wɔne Nana Prempeh Amankwaah a ɔfiri National Democratic Congress, ne Gallo Stephen Ayitey a ɔfiri Convention Peoples Party mu nso sii akan wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du- nsia mu abatoɔ a ɛbaa so Juaben Mansin mu a wɔtoeɛ no ​​Ɔpɛnimaa bosome da ɛtɔ so nson wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du- nsia no mu. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ no mu berɛ a Ɔnyaa  mma mpem aduonu mmienu,  ahasa ne aduonu - mmiɛnsa wɔ nnipa mpem aduonu nkron,  ahensia ne nsia a wɔtoo aba no mu, a ɛyɛ abatoɔ a ɛfata nyinaa mu ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu aduoson nnum akyire po aduanan ( 75.40%).[6]

Boayikuo ahodoɔ 
Ama Pomaa yɛ Bɔbeasu ne Mmofra Boayikuo no muni na ɔsan yɛ Aduan, Kuadwuma ne Kokoo Nsɛm Boayikuo no muni.[1]

fapem

Ɔnam ne fapem so yɛɛ Cisco Networking Academy nhyehyɛe bi maa mmabaa.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ama Pomaa aware a ɔwɔ abofra baako. Ɔsan yɛ Kristoni.[1]

title: Anthony Akoto Osei
text:
Wɔwoo Anthony Akoto Osei wɔ( Oforisuo 18,1953 – Ɔbɛnem 20,2023) na ɔyɛ Ghana sikakorabea dwumayɛni ne ɔmanyɔni. Osei dii kan wɔ Ɔmanpanyin John Agyekum Kufuor aban mpanyimfo kuw mu sɛ Ɔman Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ Sikasɛm ne Sikasɛm Nhyehyɛe so na afei na ɔyɛ Sikasɛm soafo a ɔyɛ adwuma. Na ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni ma abatow mantam a ɛwɔ Tafo Dedaw a ɛwɔ Ashanti mantam mu.

Abrabɔ Ahyɛaseɛ ne adesua 
Wɔwoo Osei wɔ Kumasi, Ashanti Mantam no ahenkurow mu, wɔ 18 Ayɛwohomumɔ 1953.Ɔnyaa ne ntoaso sukuu wɔ Achimota Sukuu ne Opoku Ware sukuu. Ɔtoaa so wɔ Oberlin College wɔ Ohio baabi a onyaa Bachelor’s degree wɔ sikasɛm mu.Ɔnyaa Master of Arts abodin krataa wɔ sikasɛm ho nimdeɛ a wɔde di dwuma mu wɔ Amerika Suapɔn a ɛwɔ USA. Ɔsan nso wiee Howard Suapɔn wɔ afe 1987 mu a ɔnyaa PhD wɔ sikasɛm mu.

Adwuma 
Ná Osei yɛ sikasɛm ho ɔbenfo wɔ n’adwuma mu. Wɔ 27 Oforisuo 2002 no, Osei bɛyɛɛ Merchant Bank (Ghana) Ltd. adwumayɛfoɔ kuo no muni Kan no, na ɔyɛ adwuma sɛ ɔbenfoɔ boafoɔ wɔ Dillard Suapɔn (USA) na ansa na ɛno reba no na ɔyɛ nhwehwɛmu boafoɔ wɔ Center for Policy Analysis (Ghana).

Mmrahyɛbadwa adwuma 
Sikasɛm Nhyehyɛeɛ soafoɔ abadiakyiri

Osei yɛɛ adwuma sɛ Sikasɛm ne Sikasɛm Nhyehyɛeɛ soafoɔ abadiakyiri wɔ May 2003 mu na na ɔyɛ sikasɛm ho ɔfotufoɔ ma aban.Wɔmaa no so sɛ Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ Sikasɛm ne Sikasɛm Nhyehyɛe so a ɔyɛ adwuma kɛse wɔ bere a saa bere no sikasɛm soafo, Kwadwo Baah Wiredu wu akyi. Ɔdii saa dwumadie no mu kɔsii 6 Ɔbɛnem 2009 berɛ a New Patriotic Party de aban hyɛɛ ɔsɔretia National Democratic Congress nsa, a na wɔadi nkonim wɔ afe 2008 amansan abatoɔ no mu.

Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ Nhwehwɛmu ne Nhwehwɛmu so

Wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2017 mu no, wɔkaa Osei ntam sɛ Ɔmanpanyin Nana Akufo-Addo paw no na ɔfaa nhwehwɛmu nhyehyɛe no mu wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛ bagua mu akyi. Na Monitoring and Evaluation yɛ ɔsom adwuma foforɔ a wɔayɛ sɛ ɛbɛhwɛ na wɔayɛ nhyehyɛeɛ ama nhwehwɛmu nhyiamu ne nhyiamu, de adi aban no nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa n’ankasa nnwumakuo nkɔsoɔ a wɔbɛsɔ ahwɛ ho no mmamu.

Kabinet Ɔmanpanyin

Wɔ May 2017 mu no, Ɔmanpanyin Nana Akufo-Addo bɔɔ Anthony Akoto Osei din sɛ asomfoɔ 19 a wɔbɛhyehyɛ ne kabinet no mu baako. Wɔde asomfo 19 no din kɔmaa Ghana Mmarahyɛ Bagua no na Aban no Kasafo, Right Honorable Professor Aaron Mike Oquaye na ɔde too gua. Sɛ́ aban soafo no, na Osei ka ɔmampanyin no mu kuo no ho na ɔboaa wɔ gyinaesi atitiriw mu wɔ Ghana.

Dibea afoforo a wokuraa mu

Asoɛe a Ɛhwɛ Nhyehyɛe Ho Nhwehwɛmu So (CEPA), Accra; ɔfotufo wɔ Wiase Nyinaa Sikakorabea (Korea Division), 1987; ɔbenfoɔ a ɔka ho wɔ sikasɛm mu wɔ Howard Suapɔn mu firi afe 1984 kɔsi 1995; Ɔfotufoɔ Titiriw, Sikasɛm ne Sikasɛm Nhyehyɛeɛ Dwumadibea, 2001–2003; Sikasɛm soafo Abadiakyiri, 2003–2007; Ɔman Ɔsoafoɔ, 2007–2008; Sikasɛm soafoɔ a ɔreyɛ adwuma, Ɔpɛpɔn 2008 - 6 Ɔbɛnem 2009; MP a ɔhwɛ Tafo-Pankrono Dedaw so ne MP a ɔhwɛ Tafo Dedaw so (Ɔpɛpɔn 2005 kɔsi Ɔpɛpɔn 2017).

title: Nii Armah Ashietey
text:
Nii Armah Ashitey yɛ Ghana mmaranimfoɔ ne amanyɔfoɔ. Ɔyɛ Korle Klottey Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni na ɔsan nso yɛ kan ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ adwumayɛ ne adwumayɛfo ntam abusuabɔ so wɔ Ghana aban mu.

Adwuma 
Ashietey suaa adeɛ wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so wɔ Kumasi, Ashanti Mantam ahenkuro wɔ Ghana. Owiee sukuu wɔ 1975 mu na onyaa Bachelor of Arts abodin krataa wɔ asetra ho nyansahu mu. Akyiri yi ɔbɛyɛɛ mmaranimfo wɔ afe 1986 mu bere a osuaa ade wɔ Ghana Mmara Sukuu mu no. Ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ Ocerec Company Limited a ɛwɔ Accra no panyin ansa na ɔrekɔ amammuisɛm mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ashitey yɛ adwumayɛfo panyin wɔ Tema Metropolitan Area fi 1993 kosi 2001. Ɔde ne ho bɔɔ National Democratic Congress na ɔgyinaa wɔn tekiti so wɔ Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu wɔ December 2004 mu, na ɔdii nkoguo ketewaa bi wɔ New Patriotic Party kandifoɔ Nii Adu Daku Mante anim. Mfeɛ nnan akyi no, ɔsan gyinaa nkongua korɔ no ara so, na ɔdii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 50.6 ne dodoɔ no ara 2,622 (ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 4.3).

Wɔ afe 2009 mu no, Ɔmampanyin Mills paw no sɛ ɔmantam soafo ma Greater Accra Mantam no. Ɔkɔɔ so traa saa dibea yi mu wɔ Mills wu akyi. Bere a John Dramani Mahama dii nkonim wɔ Ghana amansan abatow mu wɔ Ɔpɛnimma bosome no mu wɔ afe 2012 mu no, wɔpaw no sɛ ɔmanpanyin foforo a ɔhwɛ adwumayɛ ne adwumayɛfo ntam abusuabɔ so.

title: Tina Gifty Naa Ayeley Mensah
text:
Tina Gifty Naa Ayele Mensah (wɔwoo no Ɔbɛnem 23, afe 1964) yɛ Ghana amannyɔni na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma Weija-Gbawe mansini no. Ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party no mu nipa na Nana Addo yii no sɛ Akwahosan Soafoɔ abadiakyiri wɔ ɔbɛnem bosome no da a ɛtɔ so du num wɔ afe 2017 mu.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Mensah wɔ Ɔbɛnem bosome no da a ɛtɔ so aduonu mmiensa (23) wɔ afe 1964 mu wɔ Jamestown, Britania Accra a ɛwɔ Greater Accra Mantam mu. Ɔnyaa ne ntoaso sukuu wɔ Accra Mmabaa Sukuu mu. Ɔwɔ Bachelor's degree wɔ Ɔman Adwumayɛ mu ne Masters wɔ amanaman ntam abusuabɔ ne Diplomacy mu wɔ Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Mensah nyaa abatoɔ mma no mu 34,216 na nnipa dodoɔ a wɔtow aba no nyinaa yɛ 59,926 a ɛfata a wɔtoo wɔ afe 2016 mmarahyɛbadwam abatoɔ no mu. Obuobia Darko-Opoku ne Jessica Adwoa Mannuel na wɔyɛɛ akansifoɔ.

Ɔsii akan wɔ afe 2020 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu sɛ mmarahyɛbadani a ɔnam New Patriotic Party so na ɔdii nkonim.

Adwuma 
Ná ɔyɛ Gemens Company LTD no kwankyerɛfoɔ panyin. wɔ Mamprobi, Accra.

Abasobɔdeɛ ahodoɔ 
Wɔ Ɔbɛnem bosome no da a ɛtɔ so nan wɔ afe 2017 no, Ghana-Nigeria Mmabun Ahyehyɛdeɛ no maa no abasobɔde wɔ akanni a ɔda nsow ho. Wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du nson (2017) mu no, FAKS Nhwehwɛmu Dwumadibea no buu no sɛ Ɔsomfoɔ Abadiakyiri a ɔsen biara.

Ankorankoro asetena 
Tina aware a ɔwɔ mma mmiensa. Ɔda ne ho adi sɛ ɔyɛ Kristoni.

Baabi a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Carlos Kingsley Ahenkora
text:
Carlos Kingsley Ahenkorah yɛ Ghana amannyɔni ne Tema West mansini no mu Mmarahyɛbadwani. Afei nso, na ɔyɛ ɔsoafoɔ Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Adwadie ne Nnwuma so wɔ Ghana. Ɔsan nso yɛ Carlos King Freight Services no kwankyerɛfoɔ panyin.

Nwomasua 
Ahenkorah kɔɔ Tema Ntoaso Sukuu ne Abuakwa State College. Ɔnyaa Master of Arts (Ports and Shipping Administration) abodin krataa wɔ Regional Maritime University, Nungua-Accra ne University of Ghana Business School wɔ afe 2013 mu.

Adwuma 
Ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ Jospong Consortium sɛ adetɔnfoɔ panin firi afe 2004 kɔsi afe 2006. Ɔyɛ Zoomlion Ghana Limited adwadie sohwɛfoɔ ne J. A. Plant Pool Limited adwuma sohwɛfoɔ wɔ afe 2007 ne 2012 ntam. Ɔyɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ wɔ Regional Maritime University firi afe 2005 na ɔmaa ɔkasa wɔ Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration (GIMPA) firi afe 2010. Ɔyɛ Carlos King Freight Services firi afe 1992.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ahenkorah yɛ Ɔsono amanyɔkuo NPP no mu nnipa. Mprempren ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani ma Tema West abatoɔ mpesua no so.

Badwakuo ahodoɔ 
Ahenkorah yɛ Odwamtrani a ɔhwɛ Adwadie, Nnwuma ne Nsrahwɛ Badwakuo so; ɔyɛ Hokwan Badwakuo no muni na ɔsan yɛ Adwumayɛ ne Adan Badwakuo no muni.

Akyinnyegye 
Wɔhyɛɛ no ma ɔgyaee ne dibea sɛ Ɔman soafoɔ bere a wɔhwehwɛɛ mu sɛ ɔwɔ COVID-19 na obuu akwahosan ho nhyehyɛe so na ɔfii adi sɛ ɔne akuo no akyigyinafoɔ dii nkitaho no. Wɔ afe 2020 mu no, ɔkɔɔ baabi a wɔtweree wɔn din bere a na ɔwɔ COVID-19. Ná eyi te saa bere a na ɛsɛ sɛ ɔte ne ho fi afoforo ho. Wɔ saa adeyɛ nhyɛso kuw yi nti Occupy Ghana hwehwɛɛ sɛ wɔpam no fi aban mu. Ɔmampanyin no maa no tumi krataa a etwa to sɛ ɔmfa ne ho nhyɛ mu. Wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa, afe 2020 no, ɔgyaee adwuma. Wɔ Ɔbɛnem bosome no mu wɔ afe 2021 mu no, wɔ ɔman no television so dwumadi a ɛfa Ghana Mmarahyɛ Badwa no kyeame a wɔreyi no ho no, wohuu Ahenkorah sɛ ɔregye abatow nkrataa afi dan no mu bere a wɔreto aba no, ansa na ahobammɔ adwumayɛfoɔ ne asɔretiafo mmarahyɛ badwafoɔ regye, bere a ɔde bolt bɔɔ no ɔkwan a wɔfa so fi adi no.

Baabi a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Linda Obenwaa Akweley Ocloo
text:
Linda Obenewaa Akweley Ocloo yɛ Ghana amannyɔni ne mmarahyɛbadwani a na ɔka mmarahyɛbadwa a Ɛtɔ so nson no mu nipa a ɔgyinaa Shai-Osudoku Mansin ananmu wɔ Greater Accra Mantam mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Nwomasua 
Wɔ afe 2000 mu no, Linda nyaa ne Diploma wɔ Sikakorabea wɔ Cambridge Academy a ɛwɔ Accra ne Business Administration (BA) wɔ University of Cape Coast, Ghana. Ɔwɔ Insurance ho adansedie krataa a ɔnyaeɛ wɔ National Insurance College a ɛwɔ Airport Accra wɔ afe 2004 mu.

Adwuma 
Linda Obenewaa Akweley Ocloo yɛ Sikasɛm ho ɔbenfoɔ, Sikakorabea ne Insurance wɔ n’adwuma mu. Ɔsom sɛ Client Service Consultant wɔ Old Mutual Assurance, a kane no na wɔfrɛ no Provident Life Insurance.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ocloo yɛ okunafoɔ na ɔwɔ mma num. Ne kunu, Desmond William Ocloo, na ɔyɛ NDC mmarahyɛ bagua mu ɔkannifoɔ a ɔdi kan maa Shai-Osudoku mantam no nanso ɔwuiɛ ansa na wɔreyi no wɔ akwan so kar a ɛbɔeɛ wɔ Kɔtɔnimaa bosome no mu wɔ afe 2016. Afei amanyɔkuo no yii no sɛ ɔngyina ne kunu ananmu, na ɔno na ɔdii nkonim, abatoɔ no baa awieɛ no ɔnyaa mma no mu dodoɔ no ara a na ɛyɛ 13,596. 

Ɔyɛ Kristoni ( Mission of God Asɔre, Dodowa)

title: Edward K. Dery
text:
Edward Kaale-Ewola Dery (wɔwoo no Ɔbɛnem bosome da a ɛtɔ so nsia wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduosia nkron, 6 March 1969) yɛ Ghana amammuo ne Mmarahyɛ Badwa a Ɛtɔ so Nson a ɛwɔ Ghana Aman a Ɛto so Anan no muni a ɔgyina Lambussie Mansin ananmu wɔ Upper West Region wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so

Abrabɔ mfitiaseɛ 
Wɔwoo Dery wɔ Ɔbɛnem bosome da a ɛtɔ so nsia wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduosia nkron (6 March 1969). Ɔfiri Kpare a ɛwɔ Upper West mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

Nwomasua 
Dery nyaa abɔdin krataa wɔ Sukuupɔn a Ɛhwɛ Adwumayɛfoɔ Adesua So. Ɔsan nso wiee sukuu sɛ Certified Information Systems Auditor wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu (2012) mu wɔ U.S.

N'ankasa Abrabɔ 
Dery yɛ Kristoni. Ɔne ne yere atete mu a ɔwɔ mmɔfra mmiɛnsa.

Adwumayɛ 

 Nhwehwɛmu sohwɛfoɔ, Joseph Odame ne Partners Consult Limited, Accra
 Mmarahyɛ Badwa no muni (Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da ɛtɔ so nson wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmiɛnsa 7, 2013–mprempren; afe a ɛtɔ so mmienu)

Mmeaɛ A Menyaa Mmoa Firiiɛ
