title: Frimpong John Osei
text:
John Frimpong Osei (wɔwoo no Ɔbɛnem da a ɛtɔ so nnum wɔ afe apem ahankron aduoson baako, 5 March, 1971) yɛ Ghana amamyɔni a na ɔyɛ Ghana Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson no mu ni na seesei ɔyɛ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nnan Mmarahyɛbadwa no mu ni a ɔgyina Abirem Mpɛsoa ananmu wɔ Apueeɛ Mantam mu wɔ tekiti a ɛyɛ New Patriotic Party.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo John Frimpong wɔ Akim Ntronang wɔ Ghana Apueeɛ Mantam mu. John Frimpong nyaa ne Mfinimfini Sukuu Abɔdin krataa wɔ afe apem ahankron aduowɔtwe nsia (1986). Akyiri yi ɔnyaa ne Ordinary Level wɔ afe apem ahankron aduokron baako (1991) mu ne Advanced Level wɔ afe apem ahankron aduokron mmiɛnsa (1993). John Frimpong kɔɔ so nyaa ne Bachelor of Arts (Geography Resource Development) wɔ afe apem ahankron aduokron nwɔtwe (1998) mu ne M.PHIL (Micro Finance Geography) wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnan (2004) firii Ghana Suapɔn, Legon – Ghana.

Adwumayɛ 
John Frimpong yɛ OM Finance and Business Service Limited sohwɛfoɔ firi afe apem ahankron aduokron nkron kɔsi mfeɛ mpem mmienu (1999- 2000). Ɔsan nso yɛ ɔsom adwuma no boafoɔ titire firi afe 2002 kɔsi 2005 wɔ Sikasɛm ne Sikasɛm Nhyehyɛe Dwumadibea ne Nwomasua Dwumadibea ne Mmabunu ne Agumadie Dwumadibea. John Frimpong reyɛ adwuma seesei sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwa no muni (MP) ma Abirem Mpɛsoa so.

Amanyɔsɛm 
John Frimpong dii nkonim wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa no mu wɔ ne mansin (Abirem Mantam) mu wɔ Apuei Fam Mantam mu wɔ afe 2016 Ghana ɔsahene no mu abatoɔ a ɛwɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so sɛ wɔbɛka Ghana Republic a Ɛto so Anan Mmarahyɛbadwa a Ɛto so Ason (7) no ho a wɔanya abatoɔ 19208 (61.0%) atia Mavis Ama Frimpong a ɔfiri National Democratic Congress a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 12,217 (38.8%). Ɔsan dii nkonim bio wɔ afe 2020 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so sɛ ɔbɛkɔ akɔka Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe (8) a ɛwɔ Fourth Republic of Ghana no ho a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 19,151 (55.2%) tiaa Mavis Ama Frimpong a ɔfiri National Democratic Congress a na ɔwɔ 15,110 abatoɔ (43.5%).

Boayikuo ahodoɔ 
John Frimpong yɛ Aduane, Kuadwuma ne Kokoo Nsɛm Boayikuo no muni sɛ oguamtrani. Ɔsan nso yɛ Privileges Committee a ɛwɔ Fourth Republic of Ghana Mmarahyɛbadwa a Ɛto so Nwɔtwe (8) no mu ni.

N'ankasa abrabɔ 
John Frimpong yɛ Kristoni.

Adɔeɛ 
John Frimpong de ntoboa ama Abɔnten so bɔlɔb asinasin 100 a wɔde bɛboa amanne kwan so awudi anadwo wɔ ne kuropɔn mu. Sɛnea John Frimpong kyerɛ no, ɛbaa n’adwene mu sɛ, asram bi a atwam wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu mmienu (2022) mu no, wɔakum mmea a wɔabɔ dam a wɔayi wɔn nipadua akwaa a wɔfrɛ no sɛ ɛyɛ amanne kwan so awudie.

Abasobɔdeɛ Ahodoɔ 
Wɔmaa John Frimpong sɛ United Asɔfoɔ Amanaman Ntam Fekuo (UCIA) 2020 Hall Of Fame Award For Excellence In Leadership a The United Clergy International Association (UCIA) yɛeɛ no yɛɛ ne abasobɔdeɛ a ɛtɔ so 11 wɔ All Nations University wɔ 8 Ɔsanaa 2020.

Mmeaeɛ A Menyaa Mmoa Firiiɛ 
Ghana mmrahyɛbadwamfoɔ a wɔtɔ so nnum wɔ ammamu a ɛto so nnan mu

title: Eric Owusu Osei
text:
Eric Osei-Owusu yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɔni ne Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so nson a ɛwɔ Fourth Republic of Ghana no muni a ɔgyina Afram Plains South Constituency ananmu wɔ Eastern Region wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Mfitiase asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Osei-Owusu wɔ 11 September 1963 na ɔfiri Kwanim a ɛwɔ Ghana Apueeɛ Mantam mu. Ná ɔwɔ ne adansedi krataa wɔ Voronezh Ɔman Sukuupɔn a ɛwɔ Russia no mu. Ɔsan nyaa ne bachelor’s degree wɔ adwumayɛ mu wɔ Middlesex Sukuupɔn a ɛwɔ Britain wɔ afe apem ahankron aduokron nkron (1999) mu.

Adwuma 
Na Osei-Owusu yɛ National Food Buffer Stock Company (NAFCO) adwumayɛfoɔ panin wɔ Aduane ne Kuadwuma Dwumadibea a ɛwɔ Accra.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Osei-Owusu yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi Kuw no muni. Ɔyɛ mmarahyɛ baguani wɔ Afram Plains South Constituency firi afe 2017 kɔsi afe 2021. Wɔ National Democratic Congress primaries wɔ Oforisuo 2019 mu no, Osei-Owusu dii nkoguo wɔ ne sanba a ɔpɛ sɛ wɔsan paw no no anim wɔ Joseph Appiah Boateng anim sɛ ɔmmɛgyina Afram Plains South Constituency ananmu wɔ mmarahyɛ bagua mu.

2016 abatoɔ 
Wɔ afe 2016 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu, ɔdii nkonim wɔ Afram Plains South Mpɛsoa so mmarahyɛ badwa no mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 11,479 a ɛyɛɛ 54.1% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu berɛ a NPP mmarahyɛ baguani Hor William nyaa abatoɔ 9,376 a ɛyɛɛ 44.2% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu ne CPP mmarahyɛ bagua kandifoɔ Jordan Yumbow Michael nyaa abatoɔ 360 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 1.7%.

Boayikuo no 
Ná Osei-Owusu yɛ Mmarahyɛ Badwa no Kuadwuma Boayikuo no muni.

N'ankasa asetena 
Osei-Owusu yɛ Kristoni.

Adɔeyɛ 
Wɔ June 2017 mu no, Osei-Owusu de akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ ɔha kɔɔ hɔ sɛ wɔmmɛboa nwomasua wɔ Afram Plains South mpɛsoa so.

Wɔ 30 March 2020 no, ɔde PPEs te sɛ Veronica bokiti, nsa hohoro, nsa samina ne dijitaal thermometers maa Kwahu Afram Plains Health Directorate wɔ ɔko a wɔreko atia COVID-19 ɔyaredɔm no mu.

Wɔ Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 2020 mu no, ɔde nneɛma a wɔde kɔ amannɔne te sɛ posters ne exercise nwoma maa Kade Constituency, Abetifi Constituency, Mpraeso Constituency ne Nkawkaw Constituency wɔ Eastern Region.

Mmeaeɛ A Menyaa Mmoa Firiiɛ

title: Mercy Adu-Gyamfi
text:
Mercy Adu Gyamfi (wɔwoo no wɔ Kɔtɔnimaa bosome da a ɛdi kan wɔ afe apem ahankron aduoson baako ,1{ May 1971}) yɛ Ghana Mmarahyɛ Badwa no muni, ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party, kuo a wɔdɔɔ so wɔ mmarahyɛ badwa no mu na ɔyɛ Ghana adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nnan no Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so nson no muni. Waware a ɔwɔ mma nsia.

Mfitiase asetena 
Mercy Adu-Gyamfi firi Akwatia, wɔ Eastern Region, wɔ Ghana na wɔwoo no wɔ Kɔtɔnimaa bosome da a ɛdi kan wɔ afe apem ahankron aduoson baako (1 May 1971).

Nwomasua 
Owurayere. Mercy Adu-Gyamfi kɔɔ Presby Mfifini Sukuu wɔ Akwatia na afe apem ahankron aduowɔtwe nwɔtwe (1988) mu no, ɔnyaa Mfinimfini Sukuu Awieeɛ Krataa. (MSLC) (MSLC) a ɛwɔ hɔ.

Adwumayɛ 
Ɔyɛ adwumayɛfoɔ baa na ɔyɛ ti nhwi ho adwuma wɔ n’adwuma mu na ɔbɛyɛɛ Ghana mmarahyɛ badwa no muni wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia (December 2016) mu berɛ a ɔdii nkunim maa Akwatia mantam a ɛwɔ Apueeɛ Mantam mu no. Ná ɔyɛ ɔkwankyerɛfoɔ panin, wɔ Amasey Nnuruyɛbea, a ɛwɔ Kade, wɔ Apuei Fam Mantam mu. Ɔyɛ boayikuo ahodoɔ bi muni wɔ Mmarahyɛ Badwa no mu, ɔsom wɔ Adwumayɛ ne asetena mu yiedie fie boayikuo no mu. Ɔnyaa abatoɔ no amma mpem aduonu mmienu, aha-nnan ne aduasa mmiɛnsa (21,433) wɔ abatoɔ amma dodoɔ a wɔtoeɛ no mu a ɛyɛ mpem aduasa nson, ahanson ne du-nsia (37,716) a ɛfata a wɔtoo no mu, a ɛne ɔha nkyɛ mu aduonu nson, akyiri pɔ aduonu baako (57.21%) yɛ pɛ wɔ n’asɔretiafoɔ Baba Jamal Mohammed Ahmed ne Joice Sakei so.

N'ankasa Abrabɔ 
Mercy Adu Gyamfi aware a ɔwɔ mma nsia. Ɔyɛ Kristoni na ɔyɛ Pentekoste Asɔre no muni.

Mmeaeɛ A Menyaa Mmoa Firiiɛ 

Ghanaian Mp's 5th Parliament of the 4th Republic

title: Kwabena Ohemeng-Tinyase
text:
Wɔtwerɛ a nsɛm wei wɔ Asante Kasa muKwabena Ohemeng-Tinyase yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɛni na ɔyɛ Amammuo Ɛtɔ so Nnan wɔ Ghana Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so nson no muni a ɔgyina Kade Mpɛsoa so a ɛwɔ Apueeɛ Mantam no ananmu wɔ Ɔsono Kukurudu Amanyɔkuo no tekiti so.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Ohemeng-Tinyase wɔ Oforisuo bosome da a ɛtɔ so nsia wɔ afe apem ahankron aduosia mmienu (6 April 1962) wɔ Kade wɔ Ghana Apueeɛ Fam. Ɔnyaa ne bachelor of Arts abɔdin krataa wɔ Sikasɛm ne Amanyɔsɛm mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu wɔ afe apem ahankron aduoson nwɔtwe (1978) mu. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnan (2004) mu no, ɔnyaa ne adansedie krataa wɔ wɔ Sikasɛm mu Ntotoeɛ (Charted Accountancy) mu wɔ Suapɔn a Ɛhwɛ Sikasɛm Ntotoeɛ so(Institute of Chartered Accountants Ghana), ne master’s degree wɔ Adwadie Ntotoeɛ (Business Administration) mu wɔ Warwick Suapɔn

Adwumayɛ 

 Sikasɛm ntotoeɛ/ Ɔman Anototoni maa Wiase Sikakorabea (Chartered Accountant/Country Consultant with World Bank) ( Nkuro Nkumaa ne Ankorankorɛ Mpuntuo Dwumadie {Rural and Private Sector Development Project}), Freetown, Sierra Leone, wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du de kɔsi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du-num (2010 - 2015)
 Anototofoɔ ma Amanaman Sikasɛm ma Kuayɛ Mpuntuo (Consultant, International Fund for Agricultural Development), Freetown, Sierra Leone,  wɔ mfeɛ mpem du-num ne du-nsia mu (2015- 2016)

Mmeaeɛ A Menyaa Mmoa Firiiɛ 

Ghanaian Mp's 5th Parliament of the 4th Republic

title: Ohene Assifo Derek Bekoe
text:
Derek Darko Ohene Assifo Bekoe yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so

nson a ɛwɔ Fourth Republic of Ghana no muni a ɔgyina Upper West Akim Mpɛsoa so anan mu wɔ Apueeɛ Mantam wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Ohene wɔ Ɔforisuo da a ɛtɔ so nsia wɔ afe apem ahankron aduosia nson (April 6, 1967). Ɔfiri Abamkrom-Adeiso, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Apueeɛ Mantam mu. Ɔkɔɔ University of Leicester, UK. Ɔnyaa abɔdin a ɛno ne MBA (Marketing) wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nwɔtwe (2008).

Adwumayɛ 

 CEO, Ghdev Ghana Limited; DCE (Upper West Akyem District), Ɔforisuo wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mu kɔsi Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da a ɛtɔ so nson wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nson (April, 2010 - January 7, 2017)

Baabi A Menyaa Mmoa Firiiɛ 

Ghanaian Mp's 5th Parliament of the 4th Republic

title: Joseph Tetteh
text:
Joseph Tetteh yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɔni a ɔyɛ Ghana Mmarahyɛ Badwa no mmarahyɛ badwani . Ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party no muni na ɔyɛ ɔmantam soafoɔ abadiakyiri wɔ Ghana Apueeɛ Fam Mantam mu.

Mfitiaseɛ abrabɔ ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo no wɔ Kɔtɔnimaa bosome da a ɛtɔ so dunum wɔ afe apem ahankron aduosia nsia (15 May 1966). Graduate School of Government Leadership no ama Joseph Tetteh adansedie krataa.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔ Ɔbɛnem bosme wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du-nson (2017) mu no, Ɔmampanin Nana Akufo-Addo, bɔɔ Tetteh din sɛ ɔmantam soafoɔ abadiakyiri du a wɔbɛyɛ n’aban no fã no mu baako. Ghana Mmarahyɛ Badwa no Appointments Committee no hwehwɛɛ ne mu wɔ saa bosome no ara mu. Boayikuo no penee so na wɔde ne din kɔmaa Mmarahyɛ Badwa no Kasafoɔ ma mmarahyɛ badwa no fie kɛseɛ no nnye ntom bio.

Mmeaeɛ A Menyaa Mmoa Firiiɛ 

Ghanaian Mp's 5th Parliament of the 4th Republic

title: Kojo Oppong-Nkrumah
text:
Kojo Oppong Nkrumah ( wɔwoo no Oforisuo bosome da a ɛtɔ so nnum wɔ afe apem ahankron aduowɔtwe mmienu, April 5 1982) yɛ Ghanani amanyɔni  ne mmaranimfoɔ. Na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛ badwani a ɔgyina hɔ ma Ofoase-Ayirebi mpɛsoa wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwam.

Abrabɔ mfitiaseɛ 
Wɔwoo Kojo Oppong Nkrumah, Oforisuo bosome da a ɛtɔ so nnum wɔ afe apem ahankron aduowɔtwe mmienu (April 5 1982) wɔ Koforidua a ɛwɔ apueeɛ mantam wɔ Ghana. N'awofo ne Kwame Oppong Nkrumah ne Felicia Oppong Nkrumah. Na ne maame yɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛni. Na ne papa nso kyerɛ ade nanso, akyiri ɔgyae ade kyerɛ kɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ sika korabea. Ɛwom sɛ wɔwoo Nkrumah wɔ Koforidua de nanso Nkrumah firi Akyim Anyinase.

Nwomasua 
Nkrumah hyɛɛ ne sukuu ase wɔ St. Bernadette Sukuu a ɛwɔ Dansoman na ɔtoaa so kɔɔ ntoaso sukuu wɔ Pope John Senior High School a ɛwɔ Koforidua. Kojo toa n'adesua no so kɔɔ sukuupɔn wɔ Cape Suapɔn no mu ma no gyee abodin krataa.

Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu (2012) mu no, Kojo wiee Suapɔn a ɛwɔ Nkran mantan mu; University of Ghana ma no nyaa abodin krataa wɔ dwadie ho nsɛm mu.

Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nnan (2014) mu no,  Kojo san nyaa abodin krataa a ɛfa mmaranim ho, a ɛyɛ (LLB) fi suapɔn a ne din Gimpa hɔ. Mfeɛ mmienu na ɔde suaa adeɛ de gyee saa abɔdin krataa no.

Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia (2016) mu, asemdibea kunini a ɛwɔ ɔman Ghana mu de abodin krataa maa Kojo se Ghana mmaranimfoɔ.

Ansa na ɔrebɛkɔ akɔyɛ mmaranimfoɔ no, na wayɛ ne ho adwuma na watumi adi nkunim wɔ Afrika akanni nhyehyɛeɛ no mu. Saa osuahu yi maa ne nimdeɛ ne n'ani so yɛɛ den, na ɛsan nso maa n'abrabɔ ne n'adwuma mu nkɔsoɔ yɛɛ kɛseɛ.

Adwumayɛ 
Nkrumah hyɛɛ n’adwumayɛ ase wɔ adwumakuo bi a ne din de British American Tobaco wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nsia (2006) mu. Na saa adwumakuo yɛ tawa ho nnwuma. Ɔfirii hɔ kɔɔ Joy Fm, kɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ sɛntwerɛfoɔ. Akyiri wɔfaa no sɛ ɔtitenani ma wɔn anɔpa dwumadie, berɛ a nea na  ɔdi saa dwumdie  a ne din de Komla Dumor firi hɔ. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nnan (2014) mu no, Nkrumah de ne dwumadie sɛ sɛmkyerɛfoɔ no too hɔ na obue ɔno ankasa n'adwumakuo a wɔfrɛ no West Brown Stone Capital. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du-nsia (2016) mu no, ɔhyɛ aseɛ yɛɛ adwuma sɛ mmaranimfoɔ wɔ mmarahyɛ adwumakuo a wɔfrɛ no Kulendi, Attefuah and Amponsah.

Wiase Sikasɛm Nhyiamu no paw no sɛ wiase mmeranteɛ ɔha ne du-num (115) a wɔyɛ wiase nyinaa akannifoɔ wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu (2020) mu no mu baako.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du-nnum (2015) mu no, Kojo Oppong Nkruma kɔgyinaeɛ wɔ New Patriotic Party(NPP) din mu sɛ wɔnto ne so aba, na watumi abɛyɛ mmarahyɛ bɛdwani a ɔgyina hɔ ma Ofoase-Ayirebi abatoɔ mpɛsoa so wɔ Ghana ma NPP amanyɔkuo no. 

Ɔdii nkunim wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du-nsia (2016) Ghana Mpɛsoa abatoɔ mu sɛ mmarahyɛ badwani ma Ofoase-Ayirebi mpɛsoa wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwam. Sesei, ɔresom sɛ ɔsoafo a ɔhwɛ amaniebɔ so wo Ghana. Ɔsan yɛ kasamafo ma aban no wɔ sikasem ho amaneɛbɔ ho.

Ɔmanpanin Nana Akufo-Addo paa Kojo Nkrumah sɛ amaniebɔ soafo berɛ a ɔdii nkunim wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu (2020) abatoɔ mu no. 

Na ɔka wɔn a Ɔmanpanin paw wɔn no sɛ asoafoɔ, a Mavis Hawa Koomson ne Ɔsofoɔ a Ɛhwɛ Aduane ne Kuayɛ so, Dr Owusu Afriyie Akoto a wɔpaw no sɛ ɔsoafoɔ no, na mmarahyɛbadwa mu kuo kumaa no annye no anto mu. 

Nanso, wɔpenee no so wɔ mmarahyɛbadwafie no mu, berɛ a wɔdwennwenee nsɛm pii a Appointments Committee no de too dwa akyi no.

Wɔ Ɔsanaa bosome wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu mmiɛnsa mu (August 2023), Kojo Oppong Nkrumah, a ɔyɛ Amanneɛbɔ Soafoɔ no, hyɛɛ CSOs ne dawurobɔ nnwuma sɛ wɔmmɔ mmɔden a wɔrebɔ sɛ wɔbɛfa kwan bi so adi nsɛmnsɛm a ɛrekɔ so wɔ Niger no ho dwuma.]

N'ankasa abrabɔ 
Kojo ne Akua aware, na wɔn baanu nyinaa yɛ Kristofoɔ anokwafoɔ. Wɔwɔ mma mmiɛnsa, Kwaku, Afua ne Kofi.

Nkrumah yɛ Kristoni.

Adɔeɛ 
Oppong Nkrumah Education and Skills Development Fund no yɛ biribi a Ofoase Ayirebi MP ne Ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Amanneɛbɔ so, Kojo Oppong Nkrumah, de sii hɔ wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du-nson (2017) mu sɛ wɔde bɛboa mmabunu a wɔwɔ mpɛsoa no mu ama wɔanya nteteeɛ ne nimdeɛ. Ɛfiri mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du-nson (2017) kɔsi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu mmienu (2022) no, sika yi ama sukuufoɔ bɛboro aha-mmiɛnsa (300) a wɔwɔ sukuu ahodoɔ a ɛwɔ ɔman no mu no sika.

Mmeaeɛ A Menyaa Mmoa Firiiɛ 
Ghanaian Mp's 5th Parliament of the 4th Republic

title: Frank Annoh-Dompreh
text:
Frank Annoh-Dompreh (wɔwoo no wɔ Ahinime bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nnum wɔ afe apem ahankron aduoson nson, 25 October 1977) a ɔyɛ Ghana amanyɔni na ɔsan yɛ kɔnsultanti. Ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party ni ɛna ɔsan yɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma Nsawam-Adoagyiri. Ɔno na ɔyɛ titerani ma Parliamentary Select Committee on Foreign Affairs ɔsan yɛ kuoba ma Subsidiary Legislation ne Roads ɛna Transport Committee wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa mu.

Mfitiase asetena 
Annoh-Dompreh wowoo no wɔ Ahinime bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nnum wɔ afe apem ahankron aduoson nson 25 October 1977) wɔ Nsawam-Adoagyiri a ɛwɔ Apueeɛ Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔwiee sukuupɔn wɔ University of Cape Coast a ɔyaa Bachelor of Science wɔ mfumdwuma mu. Ɔsan suaa adeɛ wɔ Mountcrest University na ɔyaa LLB ne LLM.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Annoh-Dompreh hyɛɛ amanyɔsɛm ase ɛfiri sukuu mu berɛ a wo to aba ma no sɛ Ɔtetinani ma National Union of Ghana Students (NUGS) berɛ a na ɔyɛ sukuuni wɔ University of Cape Coast wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu (2000) mu. Wɔ tii no sɛ Apuei Mantam Mmaabunu Domfrefoɔ ma New Patriotic Party. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu (2012) mu no, ɔgyina wɔ Nsawam/Adoagyiri NPP Parliamentary primaries tia Seth Wiafe Danquah na ɔdii nkunim ma no gyina party no anan mu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu (2012) mmarahyɛbadwani abatoɔ. Ɔnyaa mma aha-mmiɛnsa ne aduosia nsia firi amma aha-nnan ne aduowɔtwe mmienu (366 from 482) aba wo toɔ yɛ. Ɔtoaa so ne Ben Ohene-ayeh ɔwɔ NDC kɔwintam so. Ɔdii nkunim wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia (2016) Ghana mmarahyɛbadwani abatoɔ no mu. Ɔka kuo ɛwɔ mmarahyɛbadwa a yɛfrɛ wɔn Select Committees on Subsidiary Legislation ne Roads & Transport.

Boayikuo Ahodoɔ 
Annoh-Dompreh yɛ Dwamtenani-abadiakyiri wɔ Adan Boayikuo so wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa mu. Ɔsan nso yɛ kuoba wɔ Finance Committee; kuoba wɔ Education Committee; kuoba wɔ Foreign Affairs Committee, kuoba wɔ Appointments Committee, kuoba wɔ Business Committee na ɔsan yɛ kuoba wɔ Committee of Selection Committee.

N'ankasa Abrabɔ 
Annoh-Dompreh yɛ Kristoni a ɔkɔ asore wɔ Church of Pentecost. Waware a ɔwɔ mma mmiɛnsa.

Mmeaeɛ A Menyaa Mmoa firiiɛ 
Ghanaian Mp's 5th Parliament of the 4th Republic

title: Eyiah Kyei Baffour
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei wɔ Asante Kasa muEyiah Kyei Baffour yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɔni ne Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so nson a ɛwɔ Ghana Amammuo a ɛtɔ so nnan no muni a ɔgyina Akim Anaafoɔ Atɔeɛ Mpɛsoa ananmu wɔ  Apueeɛ Mantam  wɔ Ɔsono Amanyɔkuo no tekiti so.

Mfitiaseɛ abrabɔ 
Wɔwoo Baffour wɔ Ɔgyefoɔ bosome da a edi kan wɔ afe apem ahankron aduosia nwɔtwe (February 1, 1968) na ɔfiri Asamankese, Ghana Apueeɛ Mantam.

Nwomasua 
Ɔnyaa MBA wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu, Legon CA wɔ Beaeɛ A Ɛhwɛ Sikasɛm ho Nkontabuo so (Institute of Chartered Accountants), Ghana ne CTA wɔ Beaeɛ A Ɛhwɛ Ɛtoɔ ho Nkontabuo So (Chartered Institute of Tax Accountants) wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du-nnan (2004).

Adwumayɛ 

 Ɔne K, Asane ne Ne Nkrɔfoɔ yɛɛ adwuma wɔ Dompe - Nkran (Partner K, Asane and Associates, Dome - Accra)
 Ghana Toɔ Adwumakuo (Ntotoeɛ Abadiakyiri, toɔ nketenkete Tua Ɔfise) (Ghana Revenue Authority (Deputy Manager, small Tax Payer Office) wɔ Ashaiman, wɔ afe apem ahankron aduokron nwɔtwe - mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du-nsia (1998–2016)

Mmeaeɛ A Menyaa Mmoa Firiiɛ 

Ghanaian Mp's 5th Parliament of the 4th Republic

title: Collins Owusu Amankwah
text:
Collins Owusu Amankwah yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne Mmarahyɛbagyadwa a ɛtɔ so nson wɔ Ghana Adehyeman  a ɛtɔ so nnan no muni a ɔgyinaa Manhyia North abatoɔ mpasua so anan mu wɔ Asanti Mantam mu wɔ New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuo no din mu.

Ne Mmɔfrase ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Collins wɔ Ɔsanaa bosome da ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduowɔtwe mu. Na ɔfiri Gyinyase wɔ Asanti Mantam mu. Ɔnyaa ne 'Bachelor of Art' abodin krataa wɔ Asetena mu Adesua mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn, Legon na ɔsane nso nyaa ne LLB wɔ GIMPA. Ɔyɛ Kumasi ntoaso sukuu sukuuni dada.

Adwuma 
Collins yɛɛ adwuma sɛ 'General Manager' maa 'All Friends FM' (94.5 MHz), Kumasi firi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du-baako kɔsi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du- mmiɛnsa  mu ansa na ɔrekɔ Mmarahyɛbadwa no mu.[1] Ɔsan nso yɛ 'Sale manager' wɔ 'Jakwapo Express Limited ' firi Mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne mmienu mu  kɔsi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnan mu. Ɔsane nso yɛɛ 'Executive Director ma Clean City Initiative' firi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe  kɔsi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du- nnwɔtwe.

Amammuo  mu adwuma 
Ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuo  ni.  Wɔtoo aba maa no kɔɔ Mmarahyɛbadwa mu nea edi kan wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du- mmiɛnsa mu bere a wɔwiee wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du- mmienu Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ no. Bere a ɔdii ne mfeɛ nnan nniso akyi no, wɔsan paa no bio bere a ɔdii n’asɔretiafo no so nkonim a na ɔnyaa mma Ɔha mu nkyekyemu aduoson baako akyire po aduowɔtwe ( 71.80%) wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata nyinaa mu.[1]

Ankorankoro asetra 
Collins yɛ Kristoni. Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ abofra.

title: Anthony Osei Boakye
text:
Anthony Osei Boakye yɛ Ghana amanyɔni a wɔwoo no wɔ Ahinime bosome ne da a ɛtɔso du num wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduanan nkron, ɔsane ka mmrahyɛbɛdawfie keseɛ a ɛtɔso nsia ɛwɔ Ghana adehyeman a ɛtɔso nan ho a na ɔgyina mu ma ne manfoɔ a ɔwɔ Atwima Nwabiagya South a ɛwɔ Asante mantam wɔ Ghana.

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm ne sukuu nsɛm 
Wɔwoo Boakye wɔ Ahinime bosome ne da ɛtɔso du num wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduanan nkron wɔ Toase wɔ Kumasi. Wɔwie ne suapɔn adesua wɔ University of Cape Coast wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduoson nson,

Wɔsane yɛ panin dada a na ɔhwɛ Produce Buying Company. 

Boakye yɛ ɔkristoni a waware na ɔwɔ mma mmiɛnsa ne nanamma nson.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔyii Boakye kɔɔ mmrahyɛbedwafie wɔ ɔpɛpɔn bosome ne da a ɛtɔso nson wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne du mmiɛnsa wɔ berɛ a ɔdii nkunim wɔ abatoɔ keseɛ a ɛkɔɔso wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne du mmienu mu a ɔnyaa ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu aduoson nan ne kakra. Wɔsom kɔsii ɔpɛpɔn bosome ne da a ɛtɔso nsia wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne du nson mu.

title: Isaac Osei
text:
Isaac Osei yɛ kane Mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ Subin Mansini mu wɔ Asanti Mantam mu. Ɔsan nso yɛ kan 'Tema Oil Refinery' no kwankyerɛfoɔ panin ne Ghana Kokoɔ Boayikuo no adwumayɛfoɔ panin na berɛ bi na ɔyɛ Ghana Aban anan mu sini  wɔ United Kingdom. Na Osei yɛ Ghana Hyɛn Gyinabea ne Hyɛn Gyinabea Aban, Algebra Securities Ltd, 'Algebra Capital Ltd, ne Intravenous Infusions Ltd' dwamtenani.

Ne Mmɔfrase ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Isaac Osei wɔ Oforisuo bosome da ɛtɔ so aduonu- nkron wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduonum -baako mu wɔ Asanti Newtown a ɛwɔ Asanti Mantam mu, Kumasi. Ɔkɔɔ Ɔman Mfitiaseɛ Sukuu wɔ Kumasi firi afe apem ahenkron aduonum- nson de kɔsi afe apem ahenkron aduosia mu , na ɛno akyi no ɔkɔɔ Achimota Mfitiaseɛ Sukuu firi afe apem ahenkron aduosia kɔsi afe apem ahenkron aduosia -mmiɛnsa. Ɔkɔɔ Achimota Sukuu mu wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduosia - mmiɛnsa mu. Bere a ɔwiee Achimota Sukuu wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduoson mu no, ɔsuaa adeɛ wɔ Ghana Suapɔn, Legon baabi a ɔwiee sukuu wɔ B.Sc. (Hons) Degree wɔ Sikasɛm mu wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduoson -mmiɛnsa. Ɔkɔɔ so suaa Nkontaabu ne Akontaabuo wɔ Sikasɛm Asoɛe a ɛwɔ Colorado Sukuupɔn mu wɔ Boulder, U.S.A. Nea ɛka ho no, Osei wɔ abodin krataa a ɛkorɔn wɔ Nkɔso Sikasɛm mu, wɔ Williams College a ɛwɔ Massachusetts, U.S.A. firi afe apem ahenkron aduoson -nsia de kɔsi afe apem ahenkron aduoson -nson.

Adwuma 
Ɔhyɛɛ n’adwuma ase wɔ 'Ministry of Finance and Economic Planning' wɔ Ghana baabi a ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ Industry, Mining and Forestry Division ansa na ɔretu akɔ Macro- Economic Section of the Ministry.

Ɔhyehyɛɛ 'Ghanexim Economic Consultants Ltd' na ɔde afotuo maa Wiase Sikakorabea, USAID ne Ghana Aban wɔ nnwuma pii mu wɔ Ghana. Ná Owura Osei nso yɛ E.K Osei & Engineers & Contractors Company, ne Intravenous Infusions Ltd, adwumakuo a ɛyɛ nnuru a wɔde fa ntini mu ne nea wɔde twitwiw nipadua mu kakraa bi wɔ Afrika Atɔe fam no kwankyerɛfo panyin. Osei yɛ sikasɛm ho ɔbenfo wɔ n’adwuma mu. Mprempren ɔyɛ Ghana 'Ports and Harbors Authority' no dwamtenani. Kane no na ɔyɛ 'Tema oil Refinery no Managing director' ne 'Ghana CoCoa Board' no soafo panyin.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔpaw Osei sɛ ɔnanmusifo wɔ United Kingdom ne Ireland firi Mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne baako mu de kɔsi Mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nsia mu (2001–2006). Bere a na ɔwɔ London no, wɔpaa no sɛ Ɔdwamtenani wɔ Commonwealth Ɔkyerɛwfo Dwumadibea, UK, amrado badwa no mu.

Wɔyii no sɛ Ghana Cocoa Board (Cocobod) no panyin wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nsia mu no, Owura Osei dii Adwumakuo no anim ma wɔde sika yɛɛ nhyehyɛɛ a ɛbɛma aba a wɔnya no akɔ soro, kookoo yareɛ ne mmoawa a wɔsɛe nnɔbaeɛ ano ne saa ara nso na adwadie ho nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛmaa Cocobod nyaa botaeɛ a ɛyɛ nwonwa a ɛyɛ ɔpepem baako kookoo tɔn pii wɔ mfe mmiɛnsa  mu, na ɛyɛ kyerɛtohɔ a na ɛso bi nni saa bere no. Ɔyɛɛ Amanaman Ntam Kookoo Ahyehyɛdeɛ no mpanyimfo boayikuo no dwamtenani abadiakyiri, na na ɔyɛ Wiase Nyinaa Kookoo Sikasɛm Ho Afotuo Badwani.

Na ɔyɛ 'Cocoa Marketing Company (UK) Ltd' dwamtenani na na ɔyɛ 'Aluworks Ghana Ltd', 'Cocoa Processing Company Ltd' ne 'WAMCO' mpanyimfo kuo no muni. Ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ 'Intravenous Infusions Limited' kwankyerɛfo panyin, ansa na John.A. Kufuor na ɔkyerɛwee. Ɔsomm wɔ saa dibea no mu firi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne baako de kɔsi mfeɛ mpem mmienu nensia mu  .  Ɔgyinaa sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ New Patriotic Party din mu maa Subin Mansin wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnwɔtwe mu na ɔdii nkonim. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nwɔtwe Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu no ɔnyaa mma mpem aduanan num ne aduonum- nnwɔtwe  (45,058 ) firii mma  mpem aduosia baako,  Ɔha ne aduokron -num c61,195) a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ no mu a ɛyɛ Ɔha mu abupɛn aduoson mmiɛnsa akyire po nsia 73.6%. Wɔ Mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mu no ɔgyinaa hɔ sɛ ɔmampanin a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ ɔmampanyin wɔ afe 2010 New Patriotic Party ɔmampanyin mfitiase abatow no mu. Ɔdii nea ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa wɔ Alan John Kyeremanten akyi, berɛ a wɔpaw Ghana Ɔmampanyin Nana Akufo-Addo sɛ New Patriotic Party no frankaa tufoɔ. Wɔpaa no sɛ Tema Oil Refinery CEO wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du-nson mu kɔsii sɛ ɔgyaeɛ adwuma wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du-nkron (2019). Wɔde anuonyam ama no sɛ ɔhyɛɛ aseɛ yɛɛ adwuma a ɛhia sɛ wɔto mu na ama refinery no adwumayɛ ne ahotosoɔ atu mpɔn wɔ berɛ a na ɛyerae mpɛn mmiɛnsa a wɔayɛ nhyehyɛeɛ sɛ wɔbɛto mu ansa na wɔrepaw no .

Wɔsan nso de kan TOR MD no ho anuonyam ma sɛ ɔtuaa 120tph steam boiler a ɛma steam generation capacity kɔ soro ma adwumayɛbea adwumayɛ na ɛhwɛ ma Refinery no utility system no yɛ nea wotumi de wɔn ho to so.

Ankorankoro asetra

Ɔyɛ Kristoni (Katolekni), a waware na ɔwɔ mma nnum, a wɔn mu mmiɛnsa yɛ mmaranimfo.

Beaɛ Manyaa Mmoa firiiɛ

title: George Oduro
text:
George Boahen Oduro yɛ Ghana amanyɔni sane yɛ mmrahyɛbedwani a ɔka mmrahyɛbedwa a ɛtɔ so nson wɔ Ghana adehyeman a ɛtɔso nan mu a na ɔgyina mu ma New Edubease wɔ Asante mantam ma NPP amanyɔkuo. Na ɔyɛ ɔkyi taafoɔ a ɔhwɛ nnuane ne kuayɛ so.

N'abrabɔ ahyɛaseɛ ne sukuu nsɛm 
Wɔwoo Oduro wɔ Ahinime bosome ne da a ɛtɔ so du wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduasia num (1965) a ɔfri Atobiase wɔ Asante mantam. Wɔkɔɔ suapɔn wɔ Ghana Institutes of Management and Public Administration wɔ mfe mpem mmienu ne du mmiɛnsa mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔka NPP amanyɔkuo ho na wɔsane yɛ mmrahyɛbedwani dada de ma New Edubease mpɛsua.

N'adwuma 
Oduro yɛ panin baako a ɔhwɛ Project of Cedar Seal Company Limited wɔ Nkran.

Ayɛmyɛ adwuma 
Wɔ June 2019 ɔde motor kɔmaa Ghana Education Service. Wɔ December 2020 wɔde adepam afidie kɔmaa ne manfoɔ wɔ ne mpɛsoa so.

N'abrabɔ 
Oduro yɛ ɔkristoni.

Beaeɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Mohammed Habibu Tijani
text:
Mohammed Habibu Tijani yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ na na ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanin a ɛtɔ so nnan Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson no muni a ɔgyina Yendi Mantam a ɛwɔ Atifi Mantam no ananmu wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so.

Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ ne Nwomasua 

 Wɔwoo Tijani wɔ 16 Ɔpɛpɔn 1965. Ɔfiri Yendi a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Fam Mantam mu. Ɔkɔɔ Ghana College, seesei Ghana Senior High School(GHANASCO), Tamale. Ɔnyaa ne Teachers’ Certificate ‘A’ wɔ afe 1989 mu wɔ Bagabaga Training College. Akyiri yi ɔkɔɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu baabi a ɔnyaa ne Bachelor of Arts (BA) abodin krataa wɔ Nyamesom Adesua mu a ɔde nidi a ɛdi kan wɔ afe 2000. Ɔwɔ master’s degree wɔ Aban ne Akannifoɔ mu wɔ Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration ( GIMPA) ne post graduate diploma wɔ nwomasua mu a ɔnyaa wɔ afe 2016 mu wɔ Valley View University, Oyibi.

Adwumayɛ 

 Tijani yɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo wɔ n’adwuma mu. Na ɔyɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ ma Yendi Senior High School 1995 kɔsi 1997. na ɔsan nso yɛɛ ɔkwankyerɛfoɔ boafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Monitoring and Supervision so ma Central Gonja District Office of the Ghana Education Service firi afe 2009 kɔsi 2013. Ɔsan yɛ Islam Ɔsɔfo.Habib Tijani yɛ Municipal Chief Executive ma Yendi firi afe 2001 kɔsi afe 2009.[5]

Amanyɔsɛm 

 Tijani yɛɛ kuropɔn no mu adwumayɛfoɔ panin maa Yendi firi afe 2001 kɔsi afe 2009. Ɔkɔɔ mmarahyɛ bagua mu wɔ 7 Ɔbɛnem 2013 wɔ New Patriotic Party tekiti so. Wɔsan paw no wɔ afe 2016 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu sɛ ɔmmɛgyina Yendi Mantam no ananmu mma mmarahyɛ bagua no afe a ɛtɔ so mmienu. Wɔ afe 2017 mu no, wɔpaw no sɛ ɔmanpanyin abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Amannɔne Nsɛm so.Bere a na ɔwɔ mmarahyɛ bagua no mu no, ɔyɛɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no Adwumayɛ ne Adan ne Adwumayɛ ne Ofie Boayikuw ahorow no muni. Waboa wɔn a wɔpaw no no wɔ akwan pii so, a nea ɛka ho ne nnwuma a edidi so yi a waboa:  Yendi Akwahosan Ho Nyansahu Sukuu a wɔde besi hɔ wɔ Yendi  Ɛnanom ne Mmofra Akwahosan Ho Asoɛe a Wɔbɛkyekye wɔ Yendi  Wɔreyɛ 37 units 3 Classroom Blocks wɔ Yendi  Wɔresisi adan 13 a ɛyɛ Adesuadan 6 wɔ Yendi Kuropɔn mu  CHPS Compounds 13 a wɔresi wɔ Yendi Municipality mu .

N'ankasa Abrabɔ 

 Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baanan. Ɔkyerɛ sɛ ɔyɛ Nkramofo.

Baabi a Menyaa Mmoa Friiɛ

title: Joseph Bipoba Naabu
text:
joseph Bipoba Naabu (wɔwoo no Ɔbɛnem 24, 1964) yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ ne Mmarahyɛ Bagua a Ɛtɔ so Nson a ɛwɔ Ghana Ɔmanpanin a ɛtɔ so nnan no muni a ɔgyina Yunyoo Mantam a ɛwɔ Atifi Mantam no ananmu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ ne Nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Naabu wɔ 24 Ɔbɛnem 1964 wɔ Namong, Ghana Atifi Fam mantam mu.

Naabu nyaa bachelor of art degree wɔ amammuisɛm mu wɔ University of Ghana wɔ afe 2006. Afei ɔkɔɔ Ghana School of Law kɔsuaa Bachelor of Law na akyiri yi ɔkɔɔ London university kɔsuaa Literally Legum Baccalaureus, 2009.

Adwumayɛ 
Naabu yɛ okuafoɔ. Na ɔyɛ J.B. Naabu Farms and Company Limited kwankyerɛfo panyin ansa na ɔrehyɛn amammuisɛm mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔpaw Naabu sɛ ɔmmɛgyina Yunyoo amansin ananmu wɔ afe 2012 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so. Wɔsan paw no wɔ afe 2016 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu sɛ ɔnkɔdi dibea wɔ saa dibea no mu afe a ɛtɔ so mmienu.[2][3]

N'ankasa Abrabɔ 
Naabi aware a ɔwɔ mma baanan. Ɔkyerɛ sɛ ɔyɛ Kristoni na ɔyɛ Katolek Asɔre no muni.[2][3]
Ateasefoɔ

title: Henry Kwabena Kokofu
text:
Henry Kwabena Kokofu (wɔwoo no 5 Ahinime 1960) yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ na na ɔyɛ Ghana Aman a ɛtɔ so nnan Mmrahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nsia no muni a ɔgyinaa Bantama Mansin ananmu wɔ Bantama wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so.

Abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Kokofu yɛ christo ni. Woa ware.

Abrabɔ Ahyɛaseɛ ne adesua 
Wɔwoo Kokofu wɔ  Ahinime bosome no da a ɛtɔ so num wɔ afe 1960. Ɔfiri Adiebeba-Kumasi, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔkɔɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so na onyaa ne Bachelor of Science abodin krataa wɔ Natural Resource Management mu wɔ afe 1971. Wɔ afe 2007 mu no, onyaa Master of Science abodin krataa wɔ Agroforestry mu wɔ saa sukuupɔn koro no ara mu. Ɔsan nso kɔɔ Ghana School of Law na onyaa ne Bachelor of Laws abodin krataa wɔ mmara mu. Ɔyɛ Kumasi ntoaso sukuu sukuuni dedaw.

Mmrahyɛbadwa mu nsɛm 
Kokofu yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo (NPP) no muni. Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔde NPP mmarahyɛ bagua a ɛtɔ so nsia a ɛwɔ ɔman a ɛtɔ so nnan no tekiti so sii akan wɔ Bantama (Ghana mmarahyɛ bagua mantam) nkongua no so na odii nkonim. Wɔ abatoɔ no mu no ɔnyaa abatoɔ 49,054, a ɛyɛ abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 83.26%, na ɛno nti ɔdii akansifoɔ afoforɔ a wɔn mu bi ne Samuel Yaw Adusei, Benjamin Owusu-Achaw, Jerry F. Akonnor, Nana Kwasi Abayie, Regina Serwaa Adjei ne Samuel Appiah so nkonim .Wansi akan wɔ afe 2016 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu; mmom no, Daniel Okyem Aboagye gyinaa New Patriotic Party ananmu na odii nkonim. Ɛno nti, Kokofu yɛɛ mmarahyɛ baguani maa Bantama (Ghana Ghana Mmrahyɛbadwa no mantam) kɔsii 6 Ɔbɛnem2017.

Bɛbia mmoa efiri

title: Ras Mubarak
text:
Ras Mubarak (wɔwoo no Ayɛwohommumɔ da a ɛtɔ so mmeɛnsa, afe Apem, Ahankron ne Aduɔson nkron -1979) yɛ Ghana nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfoɔ, okuafoɔ, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfoɔ a ɔde ne ho, ne amammuifoɔ. Ɔyɛ kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress-NDC no mu ni. Ɔbɛyɛɛ  Ɔman Mmabun Aban (Ghana) adwumayɛfoɔ panin firi  mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Du-mmeɛnsa ( 2013) kɔsi mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Du-nsia (2016.)

Ras Mubarak kan no na ɔyɛ Reggae nnwom ho Ɔyɛkyerɛfoɔ wɔ Ghana Broadcasting Corporation, baabi a ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ radio ne Television nyinaa so.

Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ ne Nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Ras Mubarak wɔ  Tamale, wɔ Ghana Atifi Fam Mantam mu nanso ofi Satani, wɔ Kumbungu mantam mu a na ne nana panyin yɛ Paramount Chief.

Ɔnyaa Diploma wɔ Journalism mu wɔ London School of Journalismwɔ afe 2009 mu ne Post Graduate Diploma(NIBS) wɔ International Development Studies mu wɔ University of OsloNorway wɔ afe 2010 mu, ne Post Graduate Certificate wɔ Adwumayɛ ho Dwumadibea a efi Nobel Amanaman Ntam Adwumayɛ Sukuu a ɛwɔ Accra no mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ras Mubarak sii akan maa National Democratic Congress (Ghana) Mmarahyɛbadwa no kwan ma Ablekuma North wɔ afe 2011 mu.Ɔdii nkonim wɔ akansi no mu na ɛno akyi no ɔgyinaa party no mu sɛ ɔrebɛsi akan wɔ amansan abatoɔ no mu wɔ afe 2012 mu sɛ ɔbɛgyina Ablekuma North ananmu sɛ wɔn Mmarahyɛbadwa no mu ni.  Ɔdii nkoguo wɔ akansi no mu wɔ New Patriotic Party Candidate no anim. Afei ɔkɔɔ so sii akan maa NDC Mmarahyɛbadwa  no gyinabea wɔ Kumbungu wɔ afe 2015 mu. Ɔsan dii nkonim na ɔsii akan sɛ Kumbungu (Ghana Mmarahyɛbadwa mantam) Mmarahyɛbadwa  no mu ni wɔ Ghana Atifi Mantam mu wɔ afe 2016 Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ no mu.

N'ankasa Abrabɔ 
Mubarak yɛ kramoni. Waware, awo mmeɛnsa

title: Nana Marfo Amaniampong
text:
Nana Amaniampong Marfo (wɔwoo no 6 Oforisuo 1957) yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ na ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanin a ɛtɔ so nnan Mmarahyɛ Bagua a ɛtɔ so 6 no muni.

Abrabɔ Ashasiɛ ni Adesua 
Marfo nyaa ne GCE O level adansedie krataa wɔ Tetrem Sukuu mu na ne GCE A level wɔ St. Augustine's College, Cape Coast.Ɔnyaa BSc Admin wɔ Sikasɛm ne Adwumayɛ mu ne MBA wɔ Adwumayɛ mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu.

Abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Marfo fi Tetrem-Afigya a ɛwɔ Asante Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.[2Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baanu.

Ɔyɛ Kristoni (Baptist).

Mmrahyɛbadwa mu nsɛm 
Nana yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ na ɔyɛ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan Mmarahyɛ Bagua a ɛtɔ so nson no muni a ɔgyina Afigya-Kwabre North Constituency ananmu wɔ Asante mantam mu wɔ Ghana wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so.

Adwuma 
Bere a Marfo wiee n’adesua wɔ Ghana Sukuupɔn mu wɔ afe 1989 mu no, ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ ɔman som adwumayɛfo wɔ National Mobilization. Efi afe 1991 kosi afe 1994 no na ɔyɛ Ɔhwɛfo Panyin wɔ Ghana Nwomasua Dwumadeibea (GES). Afe baako akyi a ɔfirii GES no, wɔpaw no sɛ Ghana Commercial Bank no sohwɛfoɔ panin a ɔyɛ adwuma sɛ SME titenani wɔ Northern Sector. Ɔsomm wɔ saa dibea no mu firi afe 1995 kɔsi afe 2012. Efi afe 2009 kɔsi afe 2012 no ɔyɛɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ mmɔho mmienu wɔ Suapɔn Nhomasua Sukuupɔn mu.

Bɛbia Mmoa Efiri

title: Tia Alfred Sugri
text:
Tia Sugri Alfred (wɔwoo no ɔbɛnem bosome da ɛtɔ so du-mmienu afe Apem, Ahankron ne aduonum-nsia-1956) yɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani ma adehyeɛ a wɔwɔ Nalerigu/Gambaga mansini a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi fam mantam mu no. Ɔyɛ  Mmarahyɛbadwa  a ɛtɔ so num  5 wɔ Ghana adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nan no mu mmarahyɛbadwani

Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ ne Nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Tia wɔ Ɔbɛnem bosome da a ɛtɔ so du-mmienu, afe Apem Ahankron ne Aduonum-nsia(1956). Ɔfiri Samini wɔ Ghana Atifi fam mantam mu. Ɔnyaa Mmoa Ho Nnuruyɛ ho Oduruyɛfoɔ nimdeɛ wɔ Ibadan Suapɔn mu wɔ Nigeria.

Adwumayɛ 
Tia yɛ mmoa ho oprehyɛn ho ɔbenfo wɔ n’adwuma mu. Na ɔyɛ Central Veterinary Company a ɛwɔ Tema no kwankyerɛfoɔ panin.

Ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwa  no mu ni firi Ɔpɛpɔn 2001 kɔsi Ɔpɛpɔn 2005.

Amanyɔsɛm 

Tia yɛ kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress-NDC   no mu ni. Na ɔyɛ abadwakuo no mu ni a ɔhwɛ Akwahosan, Budget Titiriw so.Wɔdii kan paw Tia sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ adwuma wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nwɔtwe (2008)  Ghana amansan abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ no  mu sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔgyina  Nalerigu Gambaga mansini a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi fam mantam mu no anan mu.  Wɔde mma Mpem du-num, Ahanan ne aduanan-mmeɛnsa (15,443 ) na ɛpaw no wɔ mma dodoɔ mpem aduasa-nan, ahanson ne baako  (34,701) a wɔtoeɛ no mu. Mma a Tia nyaeɛ no gyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyem aduanan-nan, ne akyiri pɔ num (44.5%pɛpɛɛpɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Hajia Alima Mahama a ofiri Ɔsono kokroko ammanyɔkuo New Patriotic Party-NPP  mu no, Banaba M Alando a ɔfiri Convention People's Party-CPP mu no , John Bibirim a ɔfiri Demokrase Ahofadi Kuo no mu ne Alhassan Zibilim a ɔyɛ ɔkannifo a ɔde ne ho. Yeinom nyinaa nyaa mma no mu ɔha nkyekyem aduasa-mmienu, na akyire pɔ aduɔkron-nsia(32.96%), ɔha nkyekyem aduonu ne akyiri pɔ Aduɔwɔtwe-mmeɛnsa(20.83%), ɔha nkyekyem whee ne akyiri pɔ aduonum-nan(0.54%) ne ɔha nkyekyem baako ne akyiri pɔ du-nson (1.17%) pɛpɛɛpɛ. Na ɔyɛ akwahosan soafo abadiakyire a odii Rojo Mettle-Nunoo adeɛ

2000 Abatoɔ 
Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu (2000 )mu no, ɔdii nkoguo berɛ deɛ ɔdii nkunim de mma du-mmienu pɛ tuu no a ɔnyaa mma no mu ɔha nkyekyem aduanan-nan ne akyiri pɔ aduasa(44.30%) pɛpɛɛpɛ wɔ amansan abatoɔ no mu sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma Nalerigu mansini a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Fam Mantam mu no maa Issahaku A.Emmanuel a ɔfiri Peoples National Convention Party mu na wɔpaw no a ɔde mma mpemnkron ahanum ne du-num(9,515) dii nkunim. Yei gyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyem aduasa-mm 33.70% yɛ pɛ.Abatoɔfoɔ foforɔ a wɔfirii mu wɔ abatoɔ no mu ne Alima Mahama a ɔfiri New Patriotic Party, Joshua D.Wundowa a ɔfiri National Reform Party, Hamidu Napoleon Dawuni a ɔfiri Convention Peoples Party, Majeed Inusah a ɔfiri Ghana Movement a wɔaka abom no mu. Eyinom nyaa abatow 4,407, 911,461,440 ne 12 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne 15.60%, 3.20%, 1.60% ne 1.60% yɛ pɛ wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu.

N'ankasa Abrabɔ 
Alfred aware na ɔwɔ mma num Ɔyɛ Kristoni (Presbyterian).

title: Ato Panford
text:
Ato Panford  yɛ Ghana amannyɔni ne mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔka Mmarahyɛdwa a ɛtɔ so nson a ɛwɔ  Ghana adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nan no mu ni a, ɔgyinaa Shama Mansin no ananmu wɔ Atɔeɛ Mantam mu wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so.

Amanyɔsɛm 
wɔ afe 2020 mmarahyɛbadwa abatoɔ no mu no, New Patriotic Party (NPP) yɛɛ wɔn mmarahyɛbadwam mfitiaseɛ abatoɔ ho nhyehyɛeɛ de yii obi a ɔbɛgyina abatoɔ mpesua  no ananmu. Ato Panford de ne ho hyɛɛ mu nanso ɔdii nkoguo wɔ nea ɔne no resi akan a yɛfrɛ no Mmaranimfo Samuel Erickson Abakah a akyiri yi ɔdii nkonim wɔ amansan abatow no mu no anim.

Ne wuo 
Dr Ato Panford, a na ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party (NPP) Mmarahyɛ Badwa no mu ni a ɔhwɛ Shama so wɔ Atɔe Fam Mantam mu no awu bere a na wadi mfeɛ aduosia baako (61).

Wɔkaa sɛ ɔwuiɛ Kwasida anɔpa, Ɔpɛpɔn bosome no da a ɛtɔ so du mmienu wɔ afe, 2023 mu, wɔ GPHA Ayaresabea a ɛwɔ Takoradi, baabi a na wɔde no akɔ ayaresabea sɛ wɔrekɔhwɛ no, esiane yareɛ tiawa bi nti.

Na Ɔbenfo Panford yɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni (MP) ma Shama Mansin wɔ Mmarahyɛ Bagua a Ɛto so Ason a ɛwɔ Republic a Ɛto so Anan no mu, na na ɔyɛ Adwumayɛfo Sikasɛm ho Ɔfotufo Panyin – AfCFTA’s National Coordinating Office.

Adɔfoɔ bi nsɛm a wɔkaa faa ne ho 
Owura Joe Ghartey, a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ NPP ɔmampanyin, ne Essikado-Ketan MP, wɔ ne Instagram krataafa so, nyaa tema maa abusua no wɔ Ɔbenfo Panford wuo no ho.

Ɔkaa sɛ Shama ne Essikado-Ketan kyɛ ɔhyeɛ na amansin mmienu no yɛɛ adwuma boom.

“Me nyaa anigyeɛ kɛseɛ sɛ menim no na me ne no yɛɛ adwuma, na ɔyɛ nhyɛsoɔ ma obiara”.

“Sɛ́ obuo agyiraeɛhyɛdeɛ no, watwerɛ no ɔman no nyinaa akwantuo a ɛfa ‘Anidasoɔ ne Baakoyɛ’ a na ɛbɛhyɛ aseɛ Memeneda, Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da a ɛtɔ so du mmiensa, wɔ Atɔeɛ Mantam mu no akɔ si Dwoada Ɔpɛpɔn bosome no da a ɛtɔ so du num wɔ afe 2023”.

title: Joseph Mensah
text:
Joseph Mensah (wɔwoo no Ɔbɛnem 22, 1957) yɛ Ghana amannyɔni na ɔyɛ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nnan no Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson no mu nipa a ɔgyina Kwesimintsim Mansin ananmu wɔ Atɔeɛ Mantam mu wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so.

Nwomasua 
Ɔnyaa abodin krataa wɔ nwomasua mu ne B.A wɔ Asetena mu Nyansahu mu wɔ University of Cape Coast , ne Masters abodin krataa wɔ University of Antwerp , Belgium, na na ɔyɛ Chartered Institute of Logistics Transport no muni.

Adwuma 
Joseph Mensah dii dibea a edidi so yi wɔ Ghana Ports and Harbours; adwumayɛ sohwɛfoɔ firi afe 2013 kɔsi afe 2016, nnipa ahoɔden sohwɛfoɔ firi afe 2005 kɔsi afe 2016, nteteeɛ sohwɛfoɔ firi afe 1998 kɔsi afe 2013, ne akontabuo sohwɛfoɔ firi afe 2013 kɔsi afe 2016.

Adwuma 
Joseph Mensah dii dibea a edidi so yi wɔ Ghana Hyɛn Gyinabea ne Hyɛn Gyinabea; adwumayɛ sohwɛfoɔ firi afe 2013 kɔsi afe 2016, nnipa ahoɔden sohwɛfoɔ firi afe 2005 kɔsi afe 2016, nteteeɛ sohwɛfoɔ firi afe 1998 kɔsi afe 2013, ne akontabuo sohwɛfoɔ firi afe 2013 kɔsi afe 2016.

Amanyɔsɛm

Joseph Mensah yɛ New Patriotic Party no muni na na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛ baguani ma Kwesimintsim (Ghana mmarahyɛ bagua mantam) wɔ Atɔeɛ Mantam mu wɔ Mmarahyɛ Bagua a ɛtɔ so nson wɔ Fourth Republic of Ghana.

2016 abatoɔ 
Joseph Mensah sii akan maa Kwesimintsim mantam a ɛwɔ Western Region no wɔ New Patriotic Party tekiti so wɔ afe 2016 Ghania amansan abatoɔ no mu na ɔdii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ no mu de abatoɔ 20, 382 a ɛgyina hɔ ma abatoɔ no nyinaa mu 64.50%. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ no mu wɔ Augustine Arthur a ɔfiri National Democratic Congress, Nana Abakah a ɔfiri Convention People’s Party, Samuel Kwabena Antwi a ɔfiri PPP ne Richard Kwame Amissah a ɔfiri IND. Wonyaa abatow 8, 260, abatow 1, 637, abatow 987 ne abatow 332. Eyinom ne abatow nyinaa mu 26.14%, 5.18%, 3.12% ne 1.05% yɛ pɛ.

NPP 2020 Primaries 
Joseph Mensah sii akan wɔ New Patriotic Party 2020 primaries mu sɛ wɔbɛpaw no sɛ mmarahyɛ bagua kandifoɔ ama Kwesimintsim mantam nanso ɔdii nkoguo wɔ abatoɔ no mu wɔ Prince Hamidu Armah anim

title: Emmanuel Kwasi Bedzra
text:
Emmanuel Kwasi Bedzrah yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne mmarahyɛbadwam a ɛtɔ so nson wɔ Ghana adehyeman amammuo a ɛtɔ so nan mu nipa a na ɔregyina hɔ ama Ho West mpɛsoa wɔ Volta Mantam wɔ kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo(National Democratic Congress) no ananmu.

Abrabɔ ahyɛase ne nnwomasua 
Wɔwoo Bedzrah wɔ Kontonimaa bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduonu-nwɔtwe (28) wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduosia nson(1967) mu. Ɔfiri Tsitso-Awudome, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔnyaa ne diploma sɛ Chartered Surveyor wɔ Ghana Institute of Surveyors. Ɔsan nso nyaa ne Construction Technicians Certificate I (CTC I) fii Takoradi Polytechnic ne Bachelor of Science abodin krataa wɔ Administration mu wɔ University of Ghana Sukuupɔn mu. Ɔwɔ abodin krataa a ɛkorɔn wɔ Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration (GIMPA).

Adwuma ne amanyɔsɛm 
Ansa na ɔrehyɛn amanyɔsɛm mu no, na Bedzrah yɛ adwumayɛfoɔ panin wɔ Procurement and Project Management Consultancy.

Wɔpaw no sɛ ɔmmɛgyina Ho West amansin ananmu wɔ mfeɛ 2008 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu. Ɔwɔ mmarahyɛbadwam  mu firi Ɔbɛnem bosome da a ɛtɔ so nson wɔ mfeɛ  2009. Wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam  mu no, wasom wɔ boayikuo ahodoɔ mu, a emu bi ne; Adwumayɛ ne Adan Boayikuw, ne Daa Ahyɛde Boayikuw.

Wɔ afe 2021 mu no, Bedzrah ne Alexander Kwamena Afenyo-Markin, Abdul-Aziz Ayaba Musah, Johnson Kwaku Adu ne Laadi Ayii Ayamba kaa ntam wɔ ECOWAS Mmarahyɛbadwam no Nhyiamu soronko 2021 a ɛsii wɔ Freetown wɔ Sierra Leone no mu.

N'ankasa abrabɔ 
Bedzrah aware wɔ mma nan(4). Ɔyɛ kristoni.

Beaeɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Henry Yeboah Yiadom-Boachie
text:
Henry Yiadom Boakye (wɔwoo no 12 Ayɛwohomumɔ 1969) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni a mprempren ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛ-Bagua no muni ma Akwatia Mantam.

Mfitiase Asetena ne Nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Henry Yiadom Boakye wɔ Akwatia a ɛwɔ Ghana Apueeɛ Mantam mu. Henry Yiadom Boakye nyaa ne Diploma wɔ Engineering mu wɔ afe 1989 mu.

Adwuma 
Henry Yiadom Boakye yɛ Okoyo Foundation no Fapemfoɔ ne ne adwumayɛfoɔ panin. Ɔsan nso reyɛ adwuma seesei sɛ Mmarahyɛ-Bagua no muni (MP) ma Akwatia Mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Apuei Fam mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Amammui Asetena 
Henry Yiadom Boakye sii akan na odii nkonim wɔ NDC mmarahyɛ bagua primaries mu maa Akwatia Mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Apuei Fam mantam mu. Henry Yiadom Boakye dii nkonim bio wɔ afe 2020 Ghana ɔman abatoɔ no mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so, onyaa abatoɔ dodoɔ 19,899 (51.5%), na ɔkɔkaa Mmarahyɛ Bagua a ɛtɔ so awotwe (8) a ɛwɔ Fourth Republic of Ghana no ho tiaa Ernest Kumi a ɔfiri New Patriotic Party a na ɔwɔ 18,742 na wɔtow aba (48.5).

Boayikuw 
Henry Yiadom Boakye yɛ Mmabun, Agumadi ne Amammerɛ Boayikuo no muni. Ɔsan nso yɛ Fourth Republic of Ghana Mmarahyɛ-Bagua a Ɛto so Awotwe (8) no Hokwan Boayikuw no muni.

Ankorankoro Asetena 
Henry Yiadom Boakye yɛ Kristoni.

Beaɛ a nsɛm no firi

title: David Hennric Yeboah
text:
Hennric David Yeboah (1957 – 1 Oforisuo 2019) yɛ aguadifoɔ  ne Ghana amammuifoɔ a ɔfiri Ghana Republic.Na ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni a ogyina hɔ ma Afigya Sekyere Apuei fam mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana Mmarahyɛ Bagua a ɛto so 4, 5, ne 6 wɔ Ghana Republic a ɛto so 4 no mu.Na ɔka Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo( NPP) no muni.

Abrabɔ Ashasiɛ ni Adesua 
Wɔwoo Yeboah wɔ 11 Oforisuo 1957. Ɔfiri Agona, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔsuaa adeɛ wɔ Malcolm X College a ɛwɔ Chicago, Illinois. Ɔnyaa diploma wɔ afe 1986 mu wɔ kɔlege a wɔaka ho asɛm no mu.

Adwuma 
Na Yeboah yɛ aguadifoɔ na na ɔyɛ Daphelia Enterprise Limited kwankyerɛfoɔ panin wɔ Spintex kwan so wɔ Accra, Ghana.

Amammui mu adwuma 
Na Yeboah yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muniƆdii kan kɔɔ mmarahyɛ bagua mu wɔ afe 2004 mu na na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛ baguani ma Afigya Sekyere East Constituency wɔ Ashanti mantam mu wɔ Ghana.Ɔdii akan bio wɔ Mmarahyɛ Bagua a ɛtɔ so 5 ne 6 a ɛwɔ Republic a ɛtɔ so nnan ni mu. Wɔ afe 2015 mu no, ɔdii nkoguo wɔ New Patriotic Party primaries mu wɔ Mavis Nkansah Boadu anim.

Abatoɔ 
Wɔpaw Yeboah sɛ mmarahyɛ baguani maa Afigya Sekyere Apuei fam mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana nea edi kan wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow no mu. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so. Na ne mansin no yɛ mmarahyɛ bagua nkongua 36 no fã wɔ nkongua 39 a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Ashanti Mantam no mu. New Patriotic Party no nyaa dodow no ara a ɛyɛ mmarahyɛ bagua nkongua 128 wɔ nkongua 230 mu.Wɔde abatoɔ 32,143 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 41,220 a ɛne abatoɔ a ɛfata nyinaa mu 78% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Edward Kusi Ayarkwah a ofi Ɔman Democratic Congress, Adamu Alhassan a ofi Convention People's Party ne Alhaji Amidu Adam a ofi Democratic People's Party mu.[10][6] Eyinom nyaa abatow a ɛfata nyinaa mu 20.5%, 1% ne 0.60%.

Wɔ afe 2008 mu no, ɔdii nkonim wɔ amansan abatoɔ no mu wɔ New Patriotic Party tekiti so maa ɔmansin korɔ no ara.[14][7] Na ne mansin no yɛ mmarahyɛ bagua nkongua 34 no fã wɔ nkongua 39 a Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Ashanti Mantam no mu.[15] New Patriotic Party no nyaa mmarahyɛ bagua nkongua 109 wɔ nkongua 230 mu.[16] Wɔde abatoɔ 33,080 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 43,505 a ɛne abatoɔ a ɛfata nyinaa mu 76.04% yɛ pɛ.[14][7] Wɔpaw no sen Edward Ayarkwah a ofi Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛ Bagua no mu, Osman Isshak a ofi Ɔmanfo Ɔman Nhyiam no mu, Amidu Alhaji Adam a ofi Democratic Nnipa Kuw no mu ne Obeng Nyantakyi Clement a ofi Ɔman Demokrasi Kuw no mu. Eyinom nyaa abatow a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 21.61%, 0.59%, 0.29% ne 1.47%.[14][7].

title: Patrick Bogyako-Saim
text:
Patrick Bogyako-Siaime yɛ Ghana amannyɔni ne mmarahyɛbadwani a na ɔka mmarahyɛbadwa a Ɛtɔ so nson a ɛwɔ Ghana adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nan no mu ni a ɔgyinaa Amenfi East abatoɔ mpesua no ananmu wɔ Atɔeɛ mantam no mu wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so

title: Paul Essien
text:
Paul Essien yɛ Ghanaamannyɔni ne mmarahyɛbadwani a na ɔka mmarahyɛbadwa a Ɛtɔ so nson a ɛwɔ Ghana adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nan no mu ni a ɔgyinaa Jomoro Mansini a ɛwɔ Atɔeɛ Mantam no mu no ananmu wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so.

Nwomasua 
Ɔkɔɔ Nass Senior High School nyaa ne Ordinary level adansedie krataa, na ɔnyaa ne Advanced Level no ɔtu kɔɔ Nsein Senior HIgh School. Ɔsan nso wɔ Bachelor Science abodin krataa wɔ Akontaabu mu wɔ Cape Coast Sukuupɔn mu. Ansa na ɛno reba no Essien, na wanya Ɔman Diploma a Ɛkorɔn (HND) afiri Takoradi polytechnic a mprempren ɛyɛ Takoradi Technical University. Ɔyɛɛ ne ɔman som a ɛyɛ ahyɛdeɛ wɔ GRA (VAT) firi afe 2007 kɔ si afe 2008.

Adwuma 
Essien yɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛni wɔ n’adwuma mu. Ɔkyerɛɛ adeɛ sɛ akontabuo kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ berɛ a na ɔresom sɛ form master ne agodie kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ wɔ Annor Adjaye Senior High School firi afe 2008 kɔsi afe 2016. Ɔyɛ mantam agodie Titenani firi afe 1998 kɔsi afe 2003.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Essien yɛ ɔsono amanyɔkuo NPP no mu ni. Ɔyɛ Ghana adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nan no mu  mmarahyɛbadwani a na ɔka mmarahyɛbadwa a Ɛtɔ so nson no ho a ɔgyina Jomoro Mansin no ananmu. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ mmɔdenbɔ mu sɛ ɔbɛgyina mansin no ananmu berɛ a ɔdii nkonim wɔ afe 2016 mmarahyɛ badwa ne ɔmampanyin abatoɔ no mu. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ a wɔdii kan denneennen mu tiaa Thomas Elleamo Yankey a ɔfiri National Democratic Congress ne Samia Yaaba Christina Nkrumah a ɔfiri Convention People’s Party a ɔyɛ kan mmarahyɛbadwani (2009-2013) na ɛba sɛ ɔyɛ Ghana ɔmampanyin a ɔdi kan no babaa Kwame Nkrumah na ɔkyerɛwee. ɔdii nkonim bere a ɔnyaa abatoɔ no mu mma 18,694 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 39.49%, bere a Thomas Yankey ne Samia Nkrumah nyaa abatoɔ no mu mma 14,241 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 30.08% ne abatoɔ 9,714 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 20.52%.[6]

Essien som wɔ Adwadie, Nnwuma ne Nsrahwɛ badwakuo ne Atemmu badwakuo mu wɔ mmarahyɛbadwakuo  a ɛto so nson (7) no mu.

title: Charles Bintin Binipon
text:
Charles Binipom Bintin yɛ Ghana amamnyɔni ne Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson a ɛwɔ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu ni a ɔgyina Saboba abatoɔ mpɛsoa ananmu wɔ Atifi Mantam mu wɔ Ɔsono kokroko ammanyɔkuo New Patriotic Party no tekiti so.

Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ ne Nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Charles Binipom Bintin wɔ Kuntuli-Saboba wɔ Ghana Atifi Fam Mantam mu wɔ 22 Ɔsanaa afe Apem Ahankron ne Aduosia -nan (1964). Ɔkɔɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu na ɔnyaa Diploma wɔ Mpanimfoɔ Nwomasua mu wɔ afe 1999 mu na akyire yi, ɔkɔɔ Cape Coast Suapɔn mu kɔyɛɛ ne post graduate adesua wɔ Arts mu wɔ afe 2007 mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Charles Binipom Bintin hyɛɛ mmarahyɛdwa mu wɔ 7 Ɔpɛpɔn  2005 wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so na wɔpaw no sɛ mmarahyɛ baguani ma Saboba Mantam no wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu wɔ ɔpɛnimaa mu. Wɔpaw no sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma Saboba Mantam no wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa a  ɛtɔ so nan a ɛwɔ Ghana Adehyeman  a ɛtɔ so nan no mu.  Ɛyɛ Ɔmanpanin dada J.A Kufour abrɛ so. Ɔnya mma  a wɔtoeɛ no nyinaa mu mpem-du, Ahanan ne aduanan baako10,441 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 53.60% berɛ a wɔn a wɔbe no sii akan no, Bilijo Nayon a ɔfiri National Democratic Congress no nyaa mma 7,892 a ɛgyina hɔ ma abatoɔ no 40.50% na Kenneth Wujangi a ɔfiri People’s National Convention no nyaa 1,157 nso gyina hɔ ma abatoɔ no nyinaa mu 5.90% to. Charles Binipom Bintin na ɔnyaa nkunimdie abotire no wɔ Saboba Mantam no mu.

Adwumayɛ 
Charles Binipom Bintim ne Ghana Nnomasua Dwumadibea yɛɛ adwuma sɛ Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo wɔ Evangelical Presbyterian Ntoaso Sukuu mu wɔ afe 1999 kosi 2001. Ɔyɛ Ɔmantam Panin ma Sababa-Chereponi Mantam wɔ afe 2001 kosi 2003. Na ɔyɛ Ɔsoafoɔ Abadiakyire wɔ Atifi Mantam mu wɔ afe 2003 kɔsi 2005 na ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwa no mu ni wɔ Saboba Mantam mu wɔ afe 2005 kɔsi afe 2009. Ɔsan nso yɛ Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ Mpɔtam Aban so wɔ afe 2005 kɔsi 2009.

N'ankasa Abrabɔ 
Charles Binipom Bintim aware a ɔwɔ mma baasa na wɔrekyerɛ sɛ ɔyɛ Kristoni.

Ateasefoɔ
Mmarahyɛbadwanni

title: Abdul-Samed Gunu Mohammed
text:
bdul-Samed Muhamed Gunu (wɔwoo no Ayɛwohomumɔ da a ɛtɔ so nsia, 1966) yɛ Ghana amamyɔni na ɔyɛ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nan Mmarahyɛdwa a a ɛtɔ so nson no muni a ɔgyina Savelugu Mansin no ananmu wɔ Atifi Mantam mu wɔ ɔsono kokroko ammanyɔkuo (New Patriotic Party-NPP)no tekiti so.

Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ ne Nwomasua 
Gunu fi Savelugu a ɛwɔ Ghana atifi fam mantam mu. Ɔkɔɔ Ghana Senior High School wɔ Tamale, a nnipa pii frɛ no GHANASCO. Ɔsuaa akontabuo wɔ Tamale Polytechnic wɔ afe 2000 mu na ɔkɔɔ so nyaa master’s degree wɔ NGO ne Rural Development mu wɔ University for Development Studies wɔ afe 2010 mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Gunu yɛ ɔmanyɛfoɔ a ɔfiri  ɔsono kokroko ammanyɔkuo (New Patriotic Party-NPP ) mu na ɔyɛ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ nan no mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson no mu ni . Ɔdi dwuma sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma adehyeɛ a wɔwɔ  Savelugu abatoɔ mpɛsoa no mu no . Ɔsii akan wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du-nsia (2016) Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu na ɔdii nkonim nyaa mmarahyɛbadwa akondwa no. Ɔnyaa mma mpem du-mmeɛnsa, Aha-mmeɛnsa ne aduasa nan (  13,334) a  ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyem aduasa nan ne akyiri pɔ aduonu-baako (34.21% ) wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ saa afe no nyinaa mu.

N'ankasa Abrabɔ 
Ɔyɛ Muslimi na waware na ɔwɔ mma nwɔtwe.

title: Kwabena Twum-Nuamah
text:
kwabena Twum-Nuamah (wɔwoo no 17 Ɔbɛnem 1978) yɛ Ghana amamanyɔni ne aduroyɛ ho oduruyɛfoɔ. Ɔyɛ ɔsono kokroko ammanyɔkuo New Patriotic Party-NPP mu ni no muni na ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwa no muni a ɔwɔ hɔ mprempren wɔ Berekum Apueiɛ fam. Ɔsan nso yɛ Mmarahyɛbadwa no abadwakuo a Wɔapaw a Ɛhwɛ Akwahosan So no dwamtenani  ne Sikasɛm abadwakuo no muni.

Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ ne Nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Twum-Nuamah wɔ afe 1978 wɔ Berekum, Ghana. Ɔsuaa adeɛ wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so wɔ hɔ a ɔnyaa Bachelor of Science wɔ Human Biology (2000–2003), Commonwealth Executive Masters wɔ Business Administration (CEMBA) General Management (2009–2012) ne MSc Public Health ( 2011–2012).

Amanyɔsɛm 
Twum-Nuamah yɛ Mmarahyɛbadwa  no abadwakuo a Wɔayiyi a ɛwɔ Mmarahyɛbadwa a  ɛtɔ so nson a ɛwɔ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nan no titenani. Ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party no muni firi afe 2013. Ɔgyinaa mmarahyɛ bagua no akyi wɔ afe 2013 mmarahyɛ bagua abatoɔ mu wɔ Berekum West mantam a wɔhyehyɛɛ no ​​foforɔ no mu.Ɔkuraa n’atenaeɛ wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛ bagua abatoɔ a ɛbaa afe 2016. Ɔsan nso yɛ Mmarahyɛbdwa no abadwakuo a wɔayiyi a ɛhwɛ Sikasɛm so no mu ni.

N'ankasa Abrabɔ 
Twum-Nuamah yɛ ɔwarefoɔ (ɔwɔ mma mmiɛnsa). Ɔyɛ Kristoni (Methodist).

title: Charles Ageve
text:
Charles Akwesi Agbeve (wɔwoo no 21 Ɔpɛpɔn 1970) yɛ Ghana amannyɔni ne mmarahyɛbadwani a na ɔka mmarahyɛbadwa a Ɛtɔ so Nwɔtwe a ɛwɔ Ghana adehyeman a Ɛto so nan no mu ni a ɔgyina Agotime-Ziope Mansin ananmu wɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ  kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo NDC tekiti so.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Charles Agbeve wɔ Ziope Honugo wɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Charles Agbeve twaa ne Common Entrance Examination wɔ afe 1982 mu a ɛmaa ɔtumi nyaa ne Ordinary Level wɔ afe 1987 mu ne Advanced Level wɔ afe 1989. Afei ɔkɔɔ so nyaa ne Bachelor of Science(Bsc) ne Maths Diploma In Education wɔ afe 1995 mu wɔ University of Cape Coast. Charles Agbeve kɔɔ so nyaa ne Master of Business Administration – Finance Option (Akwahosan Insurance) wɔ afe 2002 mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn, Legon – Ghana. Charles Agbeve nso nyaa ne Master of Arts (Sikasɛm Nhyehyɛeɛ Ho Dwumadie) firi afe 2017–2018.

Adwuma 
Charles Agbeve yɛɛ Nkontaabu ne Nyansahu Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ wɔ Ghanatta Senior High School. Charles Agbeve nso ayɛ adwuma sɛ Adwadie sohwɛfoɔ wɔ Ghana Alumnium Products Limited. Ɔsan nso yɛɛ adwuma sɛ Ɔmantam /Kuropɔn sohwɛfoɔ wɔ Ɔman Akwahosan Insurance Authority, Ho Municipal Office firi afe 2009 kɔsi afe 2016. Mprempren Charles Agbeve reyɛ adwuma sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani (MP) ama Agotime-Ziope Mansin firi afe 2021 kɔsi afe 2025.

Amammuo asetena 
Wɔ afe 2015 mu no, Charles Agbeve sii akan na ɔdii nkonim wɔ NDC mmarahyɛ badwa primaries mu maa Agotime-Ziope abatoɔ mpesua no wɔ Volta mantam no mu wɔ Ghana. Charles Agbeve nso dii nkonim wɔ mmarahyɛ badwa atenaeɛ wɔ ne mansin mu wɔ afe 2016 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so sɛ ɔbɛka Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so nson (7) a ɛwɔ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nan no ho. Ɔsan dii nkonim bio de abatoɔ no mu mma 19143 a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu (87.80%)[13] wɔ afe 2020 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti a wɔde bɛka Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe (8) a ɛyɛ mprempren Mmarahyɛ Badwa no seesei kɔsi afe 2025 no so.

Wɔ afe 2019 mu no, ɔne Mmarahyɛ Badwa no mufoɔ foforɔ kɔsraa Tepa, kɔsrasra Kumawu Sekeyere Mansini Ayaresabea a wɔagyaa hɔ ne Fomena Mansini Ayaresabea no de baa awieeɛ sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ Aban no hwɛ akwahosan asoɛeɛ so.

Abadwakuo ahodoɔ 
Charles Agbeve yɛ Aban Awerɛhyem Badwakuo ne Akwahosan Badwakuo a ɛwɔ Mmarahyɛ Badwa a Ɛtɔ so Nwɔtwe (8) a ɛwɔ Ghana Adehyeman a Ɛto so nan no muni.

Akyinnyegyeɛ ne mmara mu asɛm 
MP Charles Agbeve hyɛɛ IGP George Dampare sɛ ɔnhwehwɛ asɛm bi a wɔsusu sɛ ɛyɛ polisifoɔ atirimɔdensɛm a ɛmaa ɔbarima bi a wadi mfeɛ aduasa wuiɛ. Wɔkaa saa asɛm yi bere a owufoɔ Felix azibodzi abusua no ka sɛ, wɔkyeree no sɛ ɔka kar a wɔkyeree ho asɛm bi ho wɔ Ho, bere a wɔdaadaa no kɔɔ nhwehwɛmu nsɛm bi mu akyi.

Ankorankoro asetena 
Charles Agbeve yɛ Kristoni.

title: Yaw Michael Gyato
text:
Michael Yaw Gyato yɛ Ghana amannyɔni ne mmarahyɛbadwani a na ɔka mmarahyɛbadwa a Ɛtɔ so nson a ɛwɔ Ghana adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nnan no muni a ɔgyina Krachi Apueeɛ Mansini a ɛwɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne Nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Michael Gyato wɔ Oforisuo bosome no da a ɛtɔ so mmienu (2), wɔ afe 1970, wɔ Dambai, wɔ Volta Mantam mu. Ɔnyaa ne HND wɔ Accra Polytechnic na ɔnyaa Master's wɔ Ghana Institute of Management. Ɔyɛ Smiling Heart Foundation no Fapemfoɔ, Badwakuo no muni ne Ɔkwankyerɛfoɔ Panyin. Ahyehyɛdeɛ bi a ɛnyɛ nea wɔhwehwɛ mfasoɔ wɔ Krachi East mansini no mu a ɛwɔ Oti mantam no mu a ɛhwehwɛ sɛ ɛbɛboa ahiafoɔ na ɛde mmoa ama nnipa a wɔadi dɛm.

Hon. Gyato yɛɛ ɔsoafoɔ Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Ahoteɛ ne Nsuo Ho Nneɛma so wɔ aban a Akuffo-Addo di anim no afe a ɛdi kan no mu firi afe 2017-2021

title: William Kwasi Sabi
text:
william Kwasi Sabi (wɔwoo no Ɔsanaa 23, 1966) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne Adehyeman a  ɛtɔ so nnan Mmarahyɛbadwa a  ɛtɔ so nson no mu ni. Ɔgyina Dormaa Apueeɛ Mansin no ananmu a ɛwɔ Bono Ahafo Mantam no mu wɔ  Ɔsono kokroko Ammanyɔkuo NPP tekiti so.

Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ ne Nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Sabi wɔ Ɔsanaa da a ɛtɔ so aduanu-mmeɛnsa, afe Apem, Ahankron ne Aduosia-Nsia mu. Ɔfiri Wamfie a ɛwɔ Bono mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔwɔ Bachelor of Science abodin krataa wɔ Administration mu wɔ Ghana Legon Suapɔn no mu ne Master's wɔ Ɔmanfoɔ Akwahosan mu wɔ Cape Town Suapɔn mu.]

Adwuma 
Sabi hyɛɛ n’adwuma ase sɛ ayaresabea hwɛsofoɔ wɔ Catholic Health Service, Sunyani firi afe Apem Ahankron Aduɔkron-Nson (1997 )kɔsi mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Mmeɛnsa 2003. Ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ wɔ Catholic University College of Ghana firi afe 2005 kɔsi afe 2009. Wɔ afe 2008 mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ adwumayɛ sohwɛfoɔ wɔ National Health Insurance Authority . Akyiri yi ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ adwumayɛ ho ɔfotufo wɔ MDF West Africa Limited.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Sabi sii akan wɔ Dormaa Apueeɛ mansini no mu wɔ Ɔsono kokroko Ammanyɔkuo NPP tekiti so wɔ afe 2012 amansan abatoɔ no mu na ɔdii nkonim. Ɔnyaa mma no mu mpem du-mmeɛnsa, aha-nson ne du-mmienu (13,712 ) a  ɛgyina hɔ ma abatoɔ a wɔtoo no nyinaa mu mu ɔha nkyekyem aduonum-nsia ne akyiri pɔ Aduɔwɔtwe -non (56.87% )na ɛno nti ɔdii akansifoɔ afoforɔ a Ali Adjei Ibrahim, Felix Kumi Kwaku, Asante Oppong Alexander, ne Adoma Hayford ka ho no so nkonim.  Ɔyɛɛ Ɔsomfoɔ Abadiakyiri wɔ Ministry of Monitoring and Evaluation firi afe 2016 kɔsi afe 2020, na seesei, ɔyɛ Mfiridwuma ho Ɔfotufoɔ wɔ Monitoring and Evaluation Secretariat, Office of the President.

N'ankasa Abrabɔ 
Sabi yɛ Kristoni. Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ abɔfra baako.

title: Papa Owusu-Ankomah
text:
Papa Owusu-Ankomah (wɔwoo no 27 Ayɛwohomumɔ 1958) yɛ Ghana mmaranimfoɔ ne amanyɔfoɔ. Ɔyɛ Ɔsono amanyɔkuo NPP kuo ba. Ɔyɛɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma Sekondi mansini no firi afe 1996 kɔsi afe 2016. Wɔ Ayɛwohomumɔ bosome no mu wɔ afe 2017 mu no, wɔyii Papa Owusu-Ankomah sɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanyin anaa ananmusifoɔ wɔ UK ne Ireland. Ne akwantuo a ɔde yɛɛ adwuma no baa awieeɛ wɔ Obubuo bosome no da a ɛtɔ so aduasa wɔ afe 2020 mu nanso wɔsan yii no sɛ ɔnyɛ saa dibea korɔ no ara wɔ afe 2021 mu na ɔyɛ High Commissioner de bɛsi nnɛ. ɔhyiaa Ɔhemmaa Elizabeth II bere a na ɔde ne Letters of Credence rema wɔ Buckingham Ahemfie wɔ London.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena 
Wɔwoo Owusu-Ankomah wɔ Sekondi-Takoradi, Ghana, wɔ Oforisuo bosome no da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nson wɔ afe 1958. Ne papa, Yaw Owusu-Ankomah, firi Atibie wɔ Kwahu Mansini no mu wɔ Apueeɛ Mantam mu, berɛ a ne maame, Araba Owomoye Owusu-Ankomah, firi Dixcove wɔ Atɔeɛ Mantam mu.

Nwomasua 
Owusu-Ankomah hyɛɛ n’adesua ase wɔ mfitiaseɛ sukuu ahodoɔ mu wɔ Takoradi, na ɔkɔɔ so kɔɔ ntoaso sukuu kɔɔ Mfantsipim Sukuu, faako a ɔnyaa West African Examination Council’s Advanced-Level Examination adansedie krataa de kɔɔ sukuupɔn mu.

Wɔ Ghana Suapɔn a ɛwɔ Legon no, ɔsuaa mmara de nyaa ne bachelor’s degree. Ɔwiee LL.B (Hons) 2nd Class Upper Division wɔ afe 1979 mu kɔɔ Ghana School of Law, na ɔwiee n’adwumayɛ adesua wɔ Law mu wɔ afe 1981. Wɔfrɛɛ no kɔɔ Ghana Bar saa afe no ara mu.

Adwumayɛfo adwuma 
Owusu-Ankomah yɛɛ Ghana Mmaranimfoɔ Panyin firi afe 2003 kɔsi afe 2005. Ansa na ɔrehyɛn amannyɔsɛm mu no, na ɔyɛ adwuma sohwɛfoɔ wɔ Owusu-Ankomah, Amanquah & Co.

Party activism a wɔyɛ 
Owusu-Ankomah yɛ obi a ɔhyehyɛɛ no, na bere bi na ɔyɛ dwamtrani, wɔ Atɔe Fam Mantam baa dwumadibea a ɛwɔ Ɔsono amanyɔkuo NPP no mu, na ɔsane yɛ Danquah-Busia Kuo no mu ni a ɔhyehyɛɛ ne Atɔe Fam mantam Ɔsatuo kuo no mu ni wɔ afe 1992 ne 1996. Na ɔyɛ NPP Camp Board no Publicity Committee no mu ni wɔ afe 2000 abatoɔ no mu, na ɛfiri Ahinime bosome no mu wɔ afe 2001 kɔsi ɔbenem bosome no mu wɔ afe 2003 no na ɔyɛ Nkitahodiɛ badwakuo no Titenani ne Ɔman Akwankyerɛ badwakuo no mu ni – a na wɔde "Positive Change" asɛmti no bae. Ɔyɛ NPP man Adwumayɛkuo no mu ni na ɔyɛ NPP Ɔman Badwa no mu ni firi afe 1997. Wɔ afe 2006 mu no, na ɔyɛ ɔman no Ɔsatuo badwakuo a ɛwɔ ɔman no mu no mu ni.

Owusu-Ankomah nyaa abatoɔ no mu mma 28,802 wɔ abatoɔ a nnipa dodoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa yɛ 44,507, a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 53.80% sene n’asɔretiafoɔ Albert Bosomtwi-Sam, NDC mu ni a ɔnyaa aba no mu 14,990, ne Anthony Ackah, PNC mu ni a ɔnyaa aba no mu 715 wɔ afe 1996 Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ no mu .

Wɔ afe 2000 Abatoɔ mu no, ɔnyaa abatoɔ no mu mma 28,434, a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 67.60% sene n’asɔretiafoɔ Anthony Richard Cudjoe, NDC mu ni a ɔnyaa abatoɔ no mu mma 11,661 a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 27.70%, Charles Van Dyck, CPP mu ni a ɔnyaa abatoɔ no mu mma 1,223 a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 2.90%, ne Abu Seidu, . PNC mu ni bi a ɔnyaa abatoɔ no mu mma 759 a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 1.80%.

Ɔdii nkonim wɔ afe 2004 Amansan abatoɔ no mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ no mu mma 17,433 wɔ abatoɔ a nnipa dodoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa yɛ 26,307, a ɛgyina hɔ ma  ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu  66.30% sene n’asɔretiafoɔ Betty Busumtwi-Dam, NDC mu ni a ɔnyaa abatoɔ no mu mma 8,086, Omar Ahmed Bekure a ɔyɛ PNC mu ni a ɔnyaa abatoɔ no mu mma 444, ne Joe Victor Eghan a ɔyɛ CPP mu ni a ɔnyaa abatoɔ no mu mma 344.

Ɔsane dii nkonim bio wɔ afe 2008 abatoɔ no mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ no mu mma 13,005 wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ no mu a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 55.41% sene n’asɔretiafoɔ Betty Busumtwi-Sam a ɔnyaa abatoɔ no mu mma 9,578, Awuraa Hildergard Krakue a ɔnyaa abatoɔ no mu mma 727, Frederick Akor Larbi a ɔnyaa abatoɔ no mu mma 88, ne Oliver Peter Vanderpuye-Orgle a ɔnyaa abatoɔ no mu mma 72.

Owusu-Ankomah ayɛ Western Region NPP no mu ni firi bere a wɔhyehyɛɛ no; ɔne wɔn a wɔhyehyɛɛ kuo no, a owufoɔ Owura Stephen Krakue ka ho, yɛɛ adwuma de hyehyɛɛ amammuo kuo bi de sii akan wɔ National Democratic Congress no ho. Wɔ afe 1996 mu no, Owusu-Ankomah dii nkonim wɔ Sekondi mansini no mu wɔ NPP tekiti so na bere a na ɔwɔ ɔsɔretia no mu no, ɔyɛɛ sunsuma soafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Amanneɛbɔ so.

Mmarahyɛ Bagua adwuma 
Bere a New Patriotic Party dii nkonim wɔ afe 2000 Ghana Amansan Abatow mu no, wɔyii Owusu-Ankomah sɛ mmarahyɛbadwam dɔm Dodoɔ no kannifoɔ abadiakyiri na akyiri yi wɔyii no sɛ dɔm Dodoɔ no kannifoɔ wɔ mmarahyɛ badwa mu.

Bere a na ɔwɔ mmarahyɛ badwa mu no, ɔsom wɔ badwakuo ahodoɔ bi mu, a nea ɛka ho ne Daa badwakuo a ɛhwɛ Mmarahyɛ Badwa So, badwakuo a Wɔapaw a Ɛhwɛ Amannɔne Nsɛm So, Sikasɛm badwakuo ne badwakuo a Ɛhwɛ Amansan Mmara, Mmara ne Mmarahyɛ Badwa Nsɛm So.

Amamuo mu suahunu 
Wɔ Aban adwumayɛkuo no mu no, Owusu-Ankomah adi adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔaka abom anim wɔ Ministry of Justice, Youth and Sports, Parliamentary Affairs, Interior; Nwomasua, Nyansahu ne Agodie, ne Adwadie, Nnwuma, Ankorankoro Nkɔsoɔ ne Ɔmampanyin Nnwuma Titiriw Dwumadibea. Wɔ ne dibea sɛ ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Nwomasua, Nyansahunu ne Agodie so no, Ghana Black Stars no yɛɛ wɔn abakɔsɛm wɔ amanaman nyinaa bɔɔlobɔ nyiyimu akansie a wɔtumi kɔduruu ɔfa a ɛkaa aman dunsia wɔ Wiase Kupɔn no mu wɔ afe 2006. Ɔno nso na ɔhwɛɛ mfitiaseɛ nwomasua mu nsakraeɛ wɔ Ghana. Ɔgyaee adwuma wɔ afe 2007 mu sɛ ɔrekɔpere ne kuo New Patriotic Party no frankaa. Ne mmɔdenbɔ no ankɔsi hwee ɛfiri sɛ ɔdii kan dii akuo afoforo a wɔrepere wɔn ho no anim. Na saa bere no ɔmampanyin, John Agyekum Kufour yii no sɛ ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Adwadie nnwuma, Ankorankoro Nkɔsoɔ ne Ɔmampanyin Nnwuma Titiriw so. Owusu-Ankomah yɛɛ Sekondi mmarahyɛbadwani bɛboro mfeɛ aduonu.

Ankorankoro asetena 
Owusu-Ankomah aware Augustina Owusu-Ankomah na awarefoɔ yi wɔ mma mmiɛnsa a wɔanyinyin a wɔn nyinaa yɛ mmaranimfoɔ.

Owusu-Ankomah nyaa COVID-19 wɔ  Oforisuo bosome no da a ɛtɔ so du mu wɔ afe 2020 na wɔde no kɔɔ Intensive Care Unit a ɛwɔ Royal Free Hospital wɔ London. Akyiri yi ne ho tɔɔ no.

title: Martin Oti Gyarko
text:
Martin Gyarko Oti yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne Mmarahyɛ-Bagua a ɛtɔ so nson a ɛwɔ Fourth Republic of Ghana no muni a ɔgyina Techiman North Constituency ananmu wɔ Bono East Region wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so. Ná ɔyɛ kan Ɔsomfo Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Bono Apuei Fam Mantam so.

Mfitiase Asetena ne Nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Oti wɔ 3 April 1980,  na ɔfiri Aworowa a ɛwɔ Bono Apueeɛ Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔnyaa ne Bachelor’s degree wɔ Social Science mu wɔ Cape Coast Suapɔn mu wɔ afe 2008 mu.

Adwuma 
Ná Oti yɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo wɔ Ayeasu-Atrensu Mantam Nhyiam Mmofra Ntoaso Sukuu mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Oti yɛ New Patriotic Party no muni. Na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛ baguani wɔ Techiman North Constituency firi afe 2017 kɔsi afe 2021. Wɔ afe 2020 Ghana ɔman abatoɔ mu no, ɔhweree mmarahyɛ bagua atenaeɛ no maa NDC mmarahyɛ bagua kandifoɔ Elizabeth Ofosu-Agyare. Ɔnyaa abatoɔ no dodoɔ 21,008 a ɛyɛɛ 47.5% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ no mu berɛ a Elizabeth nyaa abatoɔ no mu dodoɔ 23,252 a ɛyɛ 52.5% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ no mu.

Oti yɛ Kristoni.

title: Patrick Al-hassan Adamah
text:

Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ ne Nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Patrick Al-Hassan Adamah wɔ Obubuo da a ɛtɔ so aduonu-mmienu, afe Apem Ahankron ne Aduanan-nwɔtwe wɔ Tumi, Ghana atifi fam.Mprenpren yi, ɔwɔ  BSc (Mining Engineering), wɔ Imperial College a ɛwɔ Kensington, London, UK abrokyiman mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du-nsia (2016) Ghana amansan  abatoɔ no mu no, wɔpaw Onimuonyamfoɔ Patrick Al-Hassan sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani mfa mma adehyeɛ a wɔwɔ Sissalaa abatoɔ mpɛsoa so no wɔ ɔsono kokroko Amanyɔkuo New Patriotic Party-NPP tekiti so.

title: Abass Ridwan Dauda
text:
Abass Ridwan Duada yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ ne Mmarahyɛ Bagua a ɛtɔ so amannyɔni ne mmarahyɛbadwani a na ɔka mmarahyɛbadwa a Ɛtɔ so nson a ɛwɔ Ghanaadehyeman a ɛtɔ so nan mu ni a ɔgyina Sissala East abatoɔ mpesua no ananmu wɔ Upper West mantam no mu wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so.

Amansan Adɔeɛ ahodoɔ 
Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni (MP) a ɔhwɛ Sissala East abatoɔ mpesua no so, Owura Abass Ridwan Dauda, agye mock fees ama 2019 Basic Education Certificate Examination (BECE) adesuafoɔ wɔ aban sukuu ahodoɔ a ɛwɔ Municipality no mu.

Ɔkae sɛ: “Saa sɛnkyerɛnne yi a wɔde kyerɛ nnipa pii a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔpaw wɔn wɔ Sissala Apuei Fam Mantam no mu no yɛ sɛ ɛbɛma awofo a anka wobetua wɔn mma atoro ka no anya ahotɔ kɛse.”

Mock no hyɛɛ aseɛ Memeneda Kɔtɔnimaa bosome no da a ɛtɔ so du mmiensa (13) na ɛbaa awieeɛ Kɔtɔnimaa bosome no da a ɛtɔ so du nson (17), 2019 wɔ sukuu ahodoɔ a wɔde wɔn a wɔrehwehwɛ sɔhwɛ no kɔeɛ wɔ Constituency no nyinaa mu

Bere a Owura Dauda rekyerɛkyerɛ ntease a ɛwɔ sikatua no akyi no, ɔkae sɛ: “Meyɛɛ eyi sɛ obi a ɔwɔ yɛn awo ntoatoaso a ɛbɛba daakye no tebea a emu yɛ den wɔ ne komam na ɔmfa sikasɛm mu adesoa kɛse nso nto awofo so”.

“Enti, mehyɛ obiara sɛ ɔmfa sɔhwɛ yi aniberesɛm efisɛ wɔ BECE mu no, mobɛhyia nsɛmmisa a ɛte saa ara,” Dauda de kaa ho. “Mock no ne sɛ ɛbɛboa wo ma woatwa sɔhwɛ a etwa to no mu”.

“Mepɛ sɛ mo nyinaa nya anigye wɔ mock ne final exams no mu”.

Owura Godfrey Beveru Kanton a ɔwɔ Inspectorate Division of the Ghana Education Service wɔ Sissala East Municipality mu no ka kyerɛɛ GNA sɛ mmoa a mmarahyɛ baguani no de maeɛ no ne sɛ ɔbɛma sɔhwɛ ketewa tebea bi aba ama wɔn a wɔrehwehwɛ akɔ sukuu no sɛ wɔn ahosiesie a wɔde bɛkɔ sɔhwɛ titire no fã.

“Wɔ saa sɔhwɛ a wɔde yɛ atoro yi mu no, anka wɔrensua ansa na wɔrekyerɛw sɔhwɛ atitiriw no efisɛ dwumadi ahorow pii ahyɛ mpɔtam hɔfo so,” ɔde kaa ho.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni a ɔhwɛ Sissala Apuei fam mantam so, Hon. Ridwan Abass Dauda akyerɛ sɛ, sɛ́ mmarahyɛ baguani no, wadi n’ahyɛde no ho dwuma wɔ afã horow nyinaa mu a osi so dua sɛ ɔbɛtoa nnwuma pa a wayɛ ama nnipa a wɔwɔ Sissala Apuei mantam mu no so mpo bere a wafi mmarahyɛ bagua no agua so mpo no.

Ɔkaa sɛ, ɛnhia sɛ ɔkannifoɔ pa bɛyɛ MP ansa na watumi de ne mmoa ama ne nkurɔfoɔ de kaa ho sɛ, ne nnwuma pa no, nnipa a wɔwɔ Sissala East constituency no bɛhunu na wɔakae daa. Hon. Ridwan yɛɛ ntɛm de kaa ho sɛ waboa mmabun pii a wofi amansin no mu ma wɔanya nnwuma na ɔbɛda so ara akɔ so saa wɔ ne dibea sɛ MP akyi.

“Ɛnyɛ sɛ wobɛyɛ Member of Parliament na wobɛtumi aboa nkurɔfoɔ, matua y dues sɛ Member of Parliament, sɛ wokɔ Sissala East a mayɛ pii ama mmabun na wɔnim deɛ mayɛ ama wɔn, ɛnam me so de wɔn mu binom ayɛ adwuma wɔ ahobammɔ adwumayɛbea na maboa afoforo ma wɔanya nnwuma a akatua pa wom” ɔhyɛɛ no nsow.

Afe 2016 abatoɔ

title: Siaka Stevens
text:
stevens Siaka yɛ Ghana amamanyɔni na Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nan wɔ Ghana Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson no mu ni a ɔgyina Jaman North amansini ananmu wɔ Bono Mantam mu wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so. Siaka Stevens yɛ kane Mmarahyɛbadwa abadwakuo a Wɔapaw Wɔn a Ɛhwɛ Nhomasua So no Titenani. Na mprempren yi ɔyɛ Ɔsoafoɔ Abadiakyire  a ɔhwɛ Bono Mantam no  so.

Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ ne Nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Siaka wɔ ɔpɛnimaa da a ɛtɔ so aduasa baako, afe Apem, Ahankron ne Aduosia-nsia (1964 )na ɔfiri Sampa a ɛwɔ Bono Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Na ɔwɔ ne master’s degree wɔ Public Administration ne Post Graduate Diploma wɔ GIMPA. Ɔsan nso nyaa ne bachelor’s degree wɔ Management ne Diploma wɔ Accounting ne Business Management mu wɔ University of Education, Winneba. Ɔsan nso nyaa Diploma wɔ Akontaabuo ne Adwumayɛ Ho Nhwehwɛmu mu wɔ Cambridge Tutorial College a ɛwɔ London . Afei, ɔnyaa adansedie krataa wɔ adwadie Mmara mu wɔ Institute of Management Studies.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Siaka yɛ Ɔsono kokroko ammanyɔkuo New Patriotic Party-NPP no mu ni . Ɔyɛ Ɔmantam Ɔsoafoɔ Abadiakyire wɔ Bono Mantam mu firi 27 Oforisuo 2019 kɔsi Ɔpɛpɔn 2021. Siaka yɛ amyɔni a n'ani ku asomdoeɛ ho pa ara. Wɔ Obubuo, mfeɛ Mpem-Mmienu ne aduonu(2020) mu  no, ɔtuu ɔmanfoɔ fo sɛ wɔbɛsɔ ɔman Ghana asomdwoeɛ a atena hɔ daa no mu yie na ama 2020abatoɔ no ayɛ Asomdwoeɛ. Ɔkaa sɛ, obiara mmɔ ne ho mmɔden sɛ ɔbɛhwɛ ama asomdwoeɛ aba beaeɛ ahodoɔ na abotoɔ no rebɛkɔ so no.

Bono Mantam soafoɔ Siaka ka too so biom sɛ amanyɔkuo ahodoɔ no ne wɔn akyidifoɔ mma ɔmanfoɔ nka ho nhia wɔn wɔ abatoɔ a na ɛrebɛkɔ so no mu berɛ a wɔrehwehwɛ amanyɔsɛm mu tumidie no.

title: Francis Bawaana Dakurah
text:
Francis Bawaana Dakura yɛ Ghana amannyɔni ne mmarahyɛbadwani a na ɔka mmarahyɛbadwa a Ɛtɔ so nson a ɛwɔ Ghana adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu ni a ɔgyina Jirapa Mansin a ɛwɔ Upper West mantam no ananmu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so

Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ ne Nwomasua 
Wɔwoo no wɔ Ahinime, du-nson, afe Apem Ahankron ne Aduosia-baako(1961).Owiee St. Andrews Sukuupɔn a ɛwɔ Fife, Scotland. Ɛhɔ na  onyaa Ph.D. ne M.LITT Masters abodin krataa. Bio nso, ɔwɔ Master’s degree wɔ University of London Goldsmiths College, B.A. a onyaa nidi wɔ Havering College a ɛwɔ United Kingdom, ne Diploma wɔ Institute of Social Sciences. Wɔyɛ Chartered Institute of Secretaries ne Administrators CISA Awiei wɔ UK.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Dakura yɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma Jirapa Abatoɔ mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Ghana atifi Atɔeɛ mantam (Upper West Region). Ɔdi saa dwuma yi wɔ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nan no mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson no mu. 
amnkyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo 
Ɔde National Democratic Co-NDC gress tso skiti sii akafe an wɔ 201  Ghana amansan abatoɔ.ɔdii nkunim wɔ Jirapa nyaa mmarahyɛbadwa akondwa no. Ɔde mma   15, 390,  a ɛgyina hɔ ma mma ɔha nkyekyem 59.29% . Ɔdii wɔn  a ɔne wɔn sii akan no nyinaa so nkonim wɔ abatoɔ no  mu. Paul Derigubaa a ɔfir Kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo

National Democratic Congress-NDC no nyaa mma no 8, 249 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 31. 78% New Patriotic Party-NPP  kandifoɔ Kpieta Jesse Sungnsoanyaa mma no mu   2, 071 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 7.98%, ɔkandifoɔ a ɔfiri Convention people’s party Bagbulo Joseph nso ɔnyaa  mma 90 a ɛgyina hɔ ma a  0.35%  , Kaawasan Petterri a ɔfiri GCPP nyaa abatoɔ 89 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 0.34% na APC mmarahyɛbadwa kandifo Paalee Jacqueline nyaa abatoɔ 70 a ɛgyina hɔ ma abatoɔ no nyinaa mu

N'ankasa Abrabɔ 
Ɔyɛ VALCO abadwakuo no mu ni. Ɔyɛ nnipa ammamerɛ ho ɔbenfo.  Ɔsan nso yɛ dwadifoɔ ne okuani. Ɔbenfo Dakura yɛ obi a ɔde n’ani si nnipa so, ɔde n’adwene si nneɛma so na ɔhwɛ n’anim. N'ani ku  adwuma ho yie pa ara.  Ɔyɛ okristoni a ɔdan  Onyankopɔn adeɛ Nyinaa mu. Na Berɛ nyansa ɔda  ɔtumfoɔ no  ase wɔ akyɛdeɛ soronko  ahodoɔ  a ɔde ama no na ɔnam so sɔ amansan haw adodoɔ ano   wɔ nnɛ yi. Ɔyɛ abɔdeɛ mu nyansapɛ ne mfididwuma adwumayɛni. Wadi dwuma wɔ abadwakuo bebree mu.

title: Emmanuel Kwadwo Agyekum
text:
Emmanuel Kwadwo Agyekum yɛ Mmarahyɛbadwa  no mu ni ma Nkoranza Anaafoɔ wɔ wɔ Ghana , Bono Apueiɛ mantam . Wɔ Kotonimaa, mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu -mmienu (2022) mu no, ɔkaa sɛ Ghana Polisifoɔ too atuo  wɔ Nkoranza tuo atotoatotoɔ a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ abatoɔ berɛ no mu no.  Otuu Ghanafoɔ fo sɛ wɔnsɔre ntia polisifoɔ  atirimɔdensɛm a na ɛrekɔ so saa berɛ no.

Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ ne Nwomasua 
Wɔwoo no wɔ Ɔpɛnimma da  a ɛtɔ so mmeɛnsa, afe Apem, Ahankron ne Aduɔson-Mmeɛnsa (1973 )wɔ Nkoranza  Ghana Bono Apueiɛ Mantam mu .Ɔkɔɔ University of Westminster wɔ London, UK baabi a ɔnyaa MA wɔ Global Business mu wɔ afe 2007. Ɔsan nso nyaa IMBA wɔ International Graduate Center. Ɔkɔɔ so kɔɔ Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu a Wɔde Di Dwuma So wɔ Bremen, Germany wɔ afe 2008 mu.

N'ankasa Abrabɔ 
Emmanuel yɛ Kristoni (Seventh-day Adventistni).

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ɔyɛ kyiniiɛ Amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress-NDC  no mu ni.  Ɔdii nkonim wɔ Nkoranza Anaafoɔ abatoɔ mpɛsoa no mmarahyɛbadwa atenaeɛ no mu a ɔnyaa mma a wɔteɛ no mu Mpem Aduonu-nkron, Ahana ne Nwɔtwe (29,408 ) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyem Aduonum-nsia ne akyiri pɔ nwɔtwe (56.8%) wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu berɛ a Kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo NPP mmarahyɛbadwa  kannifoɔ Konadu-Yiadom Charles nyaa mma no mu Mpem Aduonu-Mmienu, Aha-mmienu ne Du-nkron.

22,) a ɛgyinaya hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyem Aduanan-Mmienu ne akyiri pɔ nkron (ɛɛ 42.) 9% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa .  na PNC kandifoɔ Florence Ampour nyaa abatoɔ 121 a ɛyɛ 0.2%. wɔ abatow a wɔtow nyinaa mu.a ɔhwɛ Mpɔtam Aban so.

Abadwakuo Ahodoɔ 
Ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwa  no mu ni na ɔsan yɛ Adwumayɛ ne Adan Abadwakuo no mu ni.

Adwumayɛ 
Ná ɔyɛ Special Care Recruitment Consultancy a ɛwɔ London, UK no panyin. Ɔsan nso yɛ Nkoranza South Municipality no Municipal Chief Executive firi May 2009- Ɔpɛpɔn 2013.

title: Masawud Mohammed
text:
Masawud Mohammed (wɔwoo no Oforisuo da a ɛdi kan, afe Apem, Ahankron ne aduɔson-baako- 1971) yɛ Ghana amantɔni na na ɔyɛ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nan no Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson no mu ni a ɔgyinaa Pru Atɔeɛ Mansini no ananmu wɔ kane Bono-Ahafo Mantam mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ ne Nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Mohammed wɔ Oforisuo da a ɛdi kan, afe Apem Ahankron ne Aduɔson-baako (1971)  wɔ Prang a ɛwɔ Brong-Ahafo Mantam no mu. Ɔkɔɔ Cape Coast Sukuupɔn ; na owiee sukuu no nyaa bachelor's degree ne (master's degree); mmienu no nyinaa wɔ Nwomasua mu.

Adwumayɛ 
Na Mohammed yɛ mmarahyɛbadwani  a ɔhwɛ Pru Atɔeɛ abatoɔ mpɛsoa no  so. Ansa na yei reba no, na ɔyɛ adwuma sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ wɔ Atebubu College of Education . Afei, ɔsan nso ɔsom sɛ Pru mansini no  krakye.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ɔdii kan bɛyɛɛ mmarahyɛbadwa no mu ni wɔ mpem mmienu ne du-mmeɛnsa (2013) mu. Saa brɛ no mu no, ɔgyinaa Pru Atɔeɛ abatoɔ mpɛsoa no  ananmu. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du-nsia (2016) mu no, ɔsan sii akan wɔ atenaeɛ no ho wɔ mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Du-nsia (2016 )amansan abatoɔ no mu na ɔdii nkonim. Ɔnyaa mma no nyinaa mu mpem-du, aha-nson ne aduanan(10,740 )a ɛgyina hɔ ma mma a  wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu ɔha nkyekyem Aduanan-Mmienu ne akyiri pɔ aduosia-nsia(49.66% )na ɛno nti ɔdii akansifoɔ afoforɔ a Stephen Pambiin Jalulah, Eric Kwabena Asamoah ne Akurugu Zakarai Atiah ka ho no so nkonim.

N'ankasa Abrabɔ 
Mohammed yɛ Nkramofo. Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baanan.

Baabi a Menyaa Mmoa Friiɛ

Mmarahyɛbadwani

title: Rosemund Comfort Abrah
text:
Abrah Comfort Rosemond (July 16, 1960) yɛ ɔbaa a ɔyɛ Ghana ɔmanyɛfoɔ. Na ɔyɛ Weija Gbawe Mantam no mmarahyɛ badwani.

Asetena ne nwomasua 
Ɔnyaa MPhil (akwankyerɛ ne afotuo) wɔ Cape Coast University mu wɔ afe 2002 mu.

Adwuma 
Comfort nso yɛ nwomasua ho nimdefoɔ a wɔatete no na wɔpaw no sɛ ɔmantam kwankyerɛfoɔ wɔ Kwaebibirem Mantam Dwumadibea a ɛwɔ GES no mu. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ afe 2012 mmarahyɛ badwa abatoɔ no mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 32,861 a ɛgyina hɔ ma abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 53.59%.

Comfort Rosemond aware a ɔwɔ mma mmienu.
