title: Shaibu Mahama Kalba
text:
Shaibu Mahama (wɔwoo no Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 15, 1970) yɛ Ghana amannyɔni ne mmarahyɛbadwani a na ɔka mmarahyɛbadwa a Ɛtɔ so Nson a ɛwɔ Ghana adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu ni a ɔgyina Daboya-Mankarigu Mansini no ananmu wɔ Atifi Mantam mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Mahama wɔ Ahinime bosome no da a ɛtɔ so du num (15), wɔ afe 1970. Ɔfiri Daboya, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Fam Mantam mu.[2] Ɔkɔɔ Leicester Adwumayɛ Sukuu, UK na ɔnyaa ne Master of Business Administration abodin krataa wɔ sikasɛm mu wɔ afe 2001 mu.[2] Ɔsan nso kɔɔ Cape Coast Suapɔn, Ghana na ɔnyaa Bachelor of Commerce a Diploma wɔ Nwomasua mu wɔ afe 1997 mu.[2] Ɔsan nso kɔɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahunu ne Mfiridwuma so, ne Ghana Mmara Sukuu, wɔ afe 2008 ne 2010 mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Shaibu Mahama yɛ yɛ kyiniiɛ amannyɔkuo NDC  no mu ni. Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔsii akan maa Daboya-Mankarigu mmarahyɛbadwa akonnwa no wɔ NDC din mu wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa a  ɛtɔ so nsia a ɛwɔ Ghana adehyeman  a ɛtɔ so nnan no tekiti so na ɔdii nkonim.

Adwumayɛ 
Mmara Dwumadibea, Savanna Nkɔso a Ɛyɛ Ntɛmntɛm Badwa (SADA), Accra Dwumadibea

Ankorankoro asetena 
Mahama yɛ Kramoni, na waware a ɔwɔ mma num.[2]

title: Kwadwo Kyei Frimpong
text:
Kwadwo Kyei Frimpong yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ na ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanin a ɛtɔ so nnan Mmarahyɛ Bagua a ɛtɔ so 6 no muni a ɔgyina Bosome Frehofoɔ ananmu wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

Abrabɔ Ashasiɛ ni Adesua 
Wɔwoo Frimpong wɔ August 26, 1946, wɔ kurow bi a wɔfrɛ no Amansie Nsuaem mu wɔ Ashanti mantam mu. Ɔnyaa ne Bachelor of Science abodin krataa wɔ Asase Sikasɛm mu wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so, Kumasi wɔ afe 1974 mu.

Adwuma 
Ɔyɛ asase so asase ho ɔbenfoɔ a ɔkasa tia na ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ Land Commission, Accra sɛ Senior Lands Officer.

Ankorankora asetena 
Ɔyɛ Kristoni na waware na ɔwɔ mma enum.

Amammui mu adwuma 
Frimpong hyɛɛ n'amammui adwuma ase wɔ afe 2012 mu bere a ɔdii n'asɔretiafoɔ so nkonim wɔ 57.82%.

Bɛbia mmoa efiri

title: Alima Hajia Mahama
text:
Hajia Alima Mahama (wɔwoo no 17 Ɔbɛnem 1957, Walewale, North East Region) yɛ Ghana ɔbaa a ɔdi kan a ɔyɛ ɔnanmusifoɔ wɔ U.S.. Ɔyɛ mmaranimfoɔ na ɛfiri Ɔpɛpɔn bosome no mu wɔ afe 2005 kɔsi Ɔpɛpɔn  bosome no mu wɔ afe 2009 na ɔyɛ Ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ mmaa ne mmofra nsɛm so wɔ Ghana wɔ Ɔmampanyin John Kufuor ase. Ɔsan nso yɛ Ghana Ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Mpɔtam Aban ne Nkuraase Nkɔsoɔ so, a Ghana Ɔmampanyin Nana Akuffo-Addo yii no sɛ ɔnyɛ adwuma wɔ Ɔbɛnem bosome no da a ɛtɔ so du wɔ afe 2017 kɔsi Ɔbɛnem bosome no da a ɛtɔ so nson wɔ afe 2021. Hajia Alima nso yɛɛ mmarahyɛbadwani  maa Nalerigu/Gambaga mansini no ne ɔsono amanyɔkuo NPP no muni wɔ Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛto so nson  (7) a ɛwɔ Ghana adehyeman a ɛto so nan no mu.

Wɔyii no sɛ Ghana Ɔman Ba wɔ Amerika wɔ ayɛwohomumɔ bosome no mu wɔ afe, 2021 mu.

Nwomasua 
Alima Mahama nyaa ne ntoaso sukuu a ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ Wesley Girls Senior High School, Cape Coast.[7] Ɔtoaa ne nwomasua so wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu baabi a ɔnyaa abodin krataa wɔ Mmara ne Asetena mu Adesua mu. Wɔ Rutgers Sukuupɔn ne Ottawa Sukuupɔn mu no, na ɔwɔ n’adesua akyi abodin krataa wɔ Ɔmanfo Nhyehyɛeɛ ne Nkɔsoɔ Nhyehyɛeɛ ne Adwumayɛ mu. Ɔsan nso anya master’s degree wɔ Development Studies mu wɔ Institute of Social Studies, wɔ Netherlands.[9][10] Hajia Mahama yɛ Ghana Mmara Sukuu no adeɛ na wɔfrɛɛ no kɔɔ mmaranimfoɔ adwuma mu wɔ afe 1982 mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ɔsomm wɔ John Agyekum Kufuor aban mu, nea edi kan sɛ ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Mmaa ne Mmɔfra Nsɛm so, ɔsoafoɔ Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Adwadie ne Nnwuma so ne ɔsoafoɔ Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Mpɔtam Aban ne Nkuraase Nkɔsoɔ so wɔ afe 2001 ne 2008 ntam.[12] Alima Mahama sii akan wɔ afe 2016 abatoɔ no mu wɔ New Patriotic Party (NPP) tekiti so na ɔdii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ bɛboro 53% wɔ Nalerigu/Gambaga mantam mu.

Dwumadie afoforo 
Clean Cooking Alliance, Akannifoɔ Badwa no mu ni

title: Kwabena Owusaduomi
text:
Kwabena Owusu Aduomi (wɔwoo no 17 Ɔpɛpɔn 1960) yɛ Ghana amanyɔfoɔ na ɔyɛ Ghana Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni. Ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party (NPP) no muni na ɔyɛ ɔmanpanyin abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Akwan ne Akwan akɛse so wɔ Ghana.

Abrabɔ Ashasiɛ 
Wɔwoo Aduomi wɔ 17 Ɔpɛpɔn 1960 wɔ Ejisu-Besease, Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

Ankorankora asetena 
Aduomi da ne ho adi sɛ ɔyɛ Kristoni ne Assemblies of God Asɔre no muni. Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baanum.

Nwomasua 
Ɔnyaa ne nyansahu mu abodin krataa wɔ aban mfiridwuma mu wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so wɔ afe 1985 mu.

Adwuma 
Aduomi bɛyɛɛ nsiesie mfiridwumayɛfoɔ wɔ akwan akɛseɛ sohwɛfoɔ a ɛwɔ Temale wɔ afe 1987–1994 mu, afei ɔkɔɔ so yɛɛ nnwuma sohwɛfoɔ wɔ akwan akɛseɛ sohwɛfoɔ wɔ atɔeɛ mantam mu wɔ afe 1994–2002 mu. Ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔmantam kwankyerɛfoɔ a ɔhwɛ akwan akɛseɛ so wɔ Ashanti mantam mu wɔ afe 2002–2008 mu. Afei ɔbɛyɛɛ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmarahyɛ bagua a ɛtɔ so 6 no muni.

Amammuisɛm 
Wɔpaw no sɛ MP ma Ejisu Mantam a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana wɔ afe 2009. Wɔpaw no sɛ ɔmmɛka mmarahyɛ boayikuw a ɛka ho ne Mpɔtam Aban ne Nkuraase Nkɔso Boayikuw no ho.

Bɛbia mmoa efiri

title: Samuel Abdulai Jabanyite
text:
Samuel Abdulai Jabanyite yɛ Ghana amannyɔni ne mmarahyɛbadwani a na ɔka mmarahyɛbadwa a Ɛtɔ so nson a ɛwɔ Ghana adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nan no mu ni a ɔgyina Chereponi Mansin a ɛwɔ Atifido mantam no mu ananmu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Nwomasua 
Ɔnyaa Master of Governance adansedie krataa firi Governance and Leadership sukuu, GIMPA, B.ED (Social Studies) wɔ University of Cape Coast, adansedie krataa firii Cranfield University, Ghana Armed Forces ne Staff Command College, Management Development and Productivity Institute , Mpɔtam Aban Adesua Asoɛe ne Madison Pine, U.K.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Samuel Abdulai Jabanyite ayɛ mmarahyɛbadwani  ama Chereponi firi afe mpem mmienu ne du mmienu (2012) mu. Ɔsan nso yɛ C.E.O wɔ Satco Limited firi afe 2013, na ɔyɛ board Chairman wɔ Y.E.A firi afe 2015.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so 

National Democratic Congress (Ghana) Amanyɔfoɔ
Ghana mmrahyɛbadwafoɔ 2017–2021

title: Kwasi Agyemang Gyan-Tutu
text:
Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ ne Nwomasua 
Kwasi Agyemang Gyan-Tutu (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn da a ɛtɔ so du-mmienu , afe Apem Ahankron ne Aduonum-nson 1957) yɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔgyina hɔ ma Tain abatoɔ mpɛsoa no a  ɛwɔ kane Brono Ahafo mantam no mu no.

Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ ne Nwomasua 
Wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn da a ɛtɔ so du-mmienu ,afe Apem, Ahankron ne Aduonum-nson (1957 ) wɔ Badu a ɛwɔ kane Bono-Ahafo mantam mu no mu.

Ɔnyaa ne BA (Hons) wɔ Amanyɔsɛm mu a onyaa no  Ghana Suapɔn Legon mu firi afe Apem Ahankron ne Aduowɔtwe-Nwɔtwe-Nwɔtwe (1988) kɔsi afe Apem, Ahankron ne Aduɔkron-baako(1991). Ɔsan nso nyaa MPHIL wɔ Amanyɔsɛm mu firi afe Apem, Ahankron ne Aduɔkron-num (1995) kɔsi afe Apem, Ahankron ne Aduɔkron-nkron (1999)

N'ankasa Abrabɔ 
Kwasi yɛ Kristoni.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ɔyɛ kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo (National Democratic Congress-NDC)no muni.

Na ɔyɛ abadwakuo a ɛhwɛ Bɔbeasu ne Mmofra, Adwumayɛ, Asetena mu Yiedie ne Ɔman ne Ɔmanfo Akontaabuo abadwakuo ahodoɔ so no mu ni.

Adwumayɛ 
Ansa na ɔrebɛyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani no, ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ dibea ahodoɔ pii mu wɔ mpɔtam hɔ wɔ aban mu. Ná ɔyɛ mantam Ntamgyinafoɔ Abadiakyire. Ɔyɛ Eastern Flour Mill no sohwɛfoɔ firi afe 2011 kɔsi afe 2012 wɔ Koforidua wɔ Ghana. Ɔyɛ Regional Admin Officer wɔ CWSA firi afe 2005 kɔsi afe 2006. Ɔyɛ Ɔman Adwumayɛfoɔ Panin firi afe 2000 kɔsi afe 2005. Assistant District Co-ord. Ɔkwankyerɛfo fi 1998 kosi 2000.

Baabi a Menyaa Mmoa Friiɛ 

Ateasefoɔ
Kristoni

title: Solomon Namliit Boar
text:
Solomon Namliit Boar (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn 15, 1968) yɛ Ghana amannyɔni ne mmarahyɛbadwani a na ɔka mmarahyɛbadwa a Ɛtɔ so nson. Ɔyɛ ɔsono amanyɔkuo NPP no mu ni na ɔyɛ Kane mantam Soafoɔ wɔ Ghana Atifi Apueɛ Mantam a wɔabɔ no foforo no mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔ Oforisuo bosome no mu wɔ afe 2017 mu no, Ɔmampanyin Nana Akufo-Addo bɔɔ Boar din sɛ mantam asomfoɔ abadiakyiri du a wɔbɛka n’aban no ho. Ghana Mmarahyɛ Badwa no Appointments Committee no hwehwɛɛ ne mu wɔ saa bosome no ara mu. Badwakuo no penee so na wɔde ne din kɔmaa Mmarahyɛ Badwa no Kasafoɔ ma mmarahyɛ Badwa no fie kɛseɛ no gye tom bio.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Boar wɔ Kutawonsa bosome no da a ɛtɔ so du num (15), wɔ afe 1968 mu. Ɔfiri Bunkpurugu, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Fam Mantam mu. Ɔkɔɔ Cape Coast Suapɔn, Ghana na ɔnyaa ne Bachelor of Arts abodin krataa wɔ adwumayɛ ho adesua mu wɔ afe 2007 mu. Ɔsan nso kɔɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so na ɔnyaa ne Executive Master of Business Administration (CEMBA) abodin krataa wɔ afe 2012 mu.

Adwumayɛ 
Sikasɛm ne Adwumayɛ sohwɛfo, Ahoɔden Foforo, Tamale

Ɔhwɛfoɔ/ɔhwɛfoɔ/HR adwumayɛfoɔ.

Ankorankoro asetena 
Boar yɛ Kristoni (Baptist). Ɔwaree (ɔwɔ mma num).

Baabi a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Andrew Amoako Asiamah
text:
Andrew Asiamah Amoako (24 Ɔpɛpɔn 1966) yɛ Ghana mmaranimfoɔ, amammuifoɔ ne Mmrahyɛbadwa a Ɛtɔ so Nwɔtwe a ɛwɔ Ghana Aman Nkabom Kuo a Ɛtɔ so Anan no muni, wɔpaw no sɛ ɔnyɛ adwuma wɔ December 2020 mu sɛ obi a ɔde ne ho. Mprempren ogyina Fomena Mantam no ananmu wɔ Asante Mantam mu. Ɔsan nso yɛ Mmrahyɛbadwa no Kasafo Abadiakyere a ɔto so mmienu.

Abrabɔ Ashasiɛ ni Adesua 
Wɔwoo Amoako wɔ 24 Ɔpɛpɔn 1966 wɔ Wioso-Adansi wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu. Ɔwɔ MSc wɔ Environmental Resources Management mu, Master of Arts wɔ Conflict Resolution mu ne LLB (Law) wɔ Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology ne adwumayɛfoɔ mmara tumi krataa (BL) wɔ Ghana School of Law.

Adwuma 
Ansa na ɔrekɔ amammuisɛm mu no, na ɔyɛ mmaranimfo wɔ Minka Premo and Co. (Akosombo Chambers). Na ɔyɛ Agyapadeɛ sohwɛfoɔ, Asase sohwɛfoɔ ne Botaeɛ sohwɛfoɔ wɔ Kumasi Metro Nhyiamu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Bere a osii gyinae sɛ ɔrensi akan wɔ akuw no primaries ansa na afe 2020 amansan abatow no aba esiane sɛnea n’ankasa kuw no yɛɛ no ​​wɔ ɔkwan a ɛnteɛ so nti, osii gyinae sɛ obetu mmirika sɛ obi a ɔde ne ho. Na ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party (NPP) no muni, a ɛde n’amanyɔ mmara no Ahyɛdeɛ 3(9) too mu no, ɛtwaa ne muniyɛ mu na wɔbɔɔ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no Kasafoɔ amanneɛ, na ɔbɔɔ amanneɛ sɛdeɛ ɛfata sɛ n’akongua no da mpan wɔ 13 Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 2020 wɔ nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛfa Ahyɛdeɛ 97 (1)g a ɛwɔ Amanyɔ Mmara no mu. Amoako kasa tiae sɛ, sɛ wɔpam no fi asɔre no mu a, ɛnkyerɛ sɛ ɔnyɛ mmrahyɛbadwa no muni bio, na Ghana Mmrahyɛbadwa no nkutoo na wobetumi atwa ne dibea sɛ ɔmanpanyin a wɔapaw no no mu. Mmaranimfo Kwaku Asare ne Amoako yɛɛ adwene, na ɔkae sɛ gyinaesi a ɛte saa no yɛ mmara mu asɛm a ɛhyɛ Asɛnnibea Kunini no tumi ase, sɛnea wɔakyerɛ wɔ Ahyɛde 99(1) a ɛwɔ Ɔman Mmara no mu no.

Amoako dii nkonim wɔ Fomena mmarahyɛ bagua no mu wɔ December 2020 abatoɔ no mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 12,805, na ɔdii nea ɔne no reko titire, ne kan kuo no muni Philip Ofori-Asante, a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 10,798 no so nkonim. Amoako bɛyɛɛ obiako pɛ a ɔde ne ho a ɔdii nkonim wɔ afe 2020 mmrahyɛbadwa abatoɔ no mu. Ne gyinabea sɛ mmarahyɛ baguani a ɔde ne ho no bɛyɛɛ nea ɛho hia kɛse mpo wɔ abatoɔ no akyi esiane sɛ amammui akuw atitiriw abien no mu biara (NPP ne National Democratic Congress) antumi annye dodow no ara koraa nti. Wɔ nsɛmbisa a wɔbisabisaa Amoako wɔ abatoɔ no akyi mu no, ɔkyerɛɛ sɛ onni nkateɛ bɔne biara wɔ NPP ho wɔ n’apam no muni a wɔagyae no ho. NPP Ɔkyerɛwfo Panyin, John Boadu, ahyɛ nyansa sɛ Amoako betumi asan abisa ne NPP muni a ɔmfa ne ho nhyɛ akuw no mmara ne tebea pɔtee bi so. Wɔ 7 Ɔbɛnem 2021 no, wɔpaw Asiamah sɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no Kasafo Abadiakyiri a Ɔto so Abien. Ɔno nko ara ne mmarahyɛ baguani a ɔde ne ho a wɔapaw no sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ saa dibea no wɔ Ghana abakɔsɛm mu.

Akuo ahodoɔ 

Amoako yɛ Members Holding Offices of Profit Committee no guamtrani, Standing Orders Committee no muni, Subsidiary Legislation Committee no muni, Nhomasua Boayikuw no muni ne Mines and Energy Committee no muni.

Bɛbia Mmoa Efiri

title: Felicia Adjei
text:
Felicia Adjei (wɔwoo no 3 Oforisuo 1974) yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ na ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛ Badwa no mu ni ma Kintampo South Constituency wɔ Brong Ahafo Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔyɛ National Democratic Congress no mu ni.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Adjei wɔ Anyima, Brong Ahafo Mantam mu. Ɔnyaa ne mfitiaseɛ nwomasua wɔ Kintampo Methodist Sukuu mu.[5] Ɔwɔ abodin krataa a ɛkɔ akyiri wɔ Catering,Food and Nutrition mu firi Adventist Vocational Institution a seesei ɛyɛ Techiman Campus a ɛwɔ Valley View University. Ɔsane nso wɔ Cookery for Catering Industry abodin krataa a ɛfiri Sunyani Polytechnic a seesei ɛyɛ Sunyani Technical University.

Adwuma 
Ɔtu kɔɔ United States of America kakra berɛ a ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ Catering Guest House wɔ Sunyani akyi. Ɔsane kɔɔ Ghana kɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ Addfal FA Limited adwumayɛfoɔ panin. Ɔsane nso hyehyɛɛ Felicia Adjei fapem a na ne botaeɛ ne sɛ ɔbɛma mmaa tumi denam adwumayɛ nteteeɛ, mmabunu nkɔsoɔ denam nwomasua ne adwumadiɛ so, kuayɛ, mmoa a wɔde bɛboa wɔn a wɔn honam ani yɛ den ne akwahosan ho nhyehyɛeɛ ne mpɔtam  foforɔ a wɔde bɛma.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ɔyɛ National Democratic Congress no mu ni. Ɔdii nkunim wɔ afe 2016 mmarahyɛ badwa abatoɔ mu sɛ ɔbɛyɛɛ mmarahyɛ badwani wɔ Kintampo South Constituency wɔ 7th parliament wɔ 4th Republic of Ghana. Ɔdii nkonim berɛ a onyaa abato 15,266 a egyina hɔ ma 51.79% tiaa deɛ ɔne no resi akan Gyan Alexander a ɔfiri New Patriotic Party a na ɔwɔ 14,210 a egyina hɔ ma 48.21%. Wɔ mmarahyɛ badwa a ɛto so 7 no mu no ɔsom wɔ Gender and Children boayikuo ne nkitahodie boayikuo no mu.

Ankorankorɛ asetena 
Ɔyɛ sigyani na ɔwɔ ababaawa baako. Felicia yɛ Kristoni.

title: Mohammed Salisu Bamba
text:
Mohammed Salisu Bamba (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn 17, 1975) yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ ne Ghana Aman a ɛtɔ so nnan Mmarahyɛ Bagua a ɛtɔ so nsia no muni a ɔgyina Ejura-Sekyedumase Mansin ananmu wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuo Foforɔ no tekiti so .

Abrabɔ Ashasiɛ ni Adesua 
Wɔwoo Bamba wɔ September 17, 1975. Ɔfiri Yendi, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Mantam mu. Ɔkɔɔ Ghana Suapɔn na onyaa ne Bachelor of Arts abodin krataa wɔ Adwene ne Nkate Ho Adesua mu.Ɔyɛ Muslimi na waware na ɔwɔ mma mmienu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Bamba yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo (NPP) no muni. Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔsii akan wɔ Ejura-Sekyedumase atenaeɛ no so wɔ NPP tekiti so wɔ afe 2012 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu na ɔdii nkonim.Wɔ abatoɔ no mu no, ɔnyaa abatoɔ 21,461 a ɛyɛ abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 49.78% na ɛno nti ɔdii akansifoɔ afoforɔ no so nkonim.Nanso, afe 2016 mu no, ɔsan sii akan wɔ atenaeɛ no ho bio na ɔdii nkoguo wɔ afe 2016 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu, na ɛno nti, ɔtumi gyinaa ne mansin ananmu ne mprenu so.

Bɛbia Mmoa Efiri

title: Feda Prempeh
text:
Freda Akosua Oheneafrewo Prempeh (wɔwoo no 23 Ɔbɛnem 1966) yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ, na ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛ Badwa no muni wɔ Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so nson ne Mmarahyɛ Bagua a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe wɔ Ghana adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu a ɔgyina Tano Atifi Mansin ananmu wɔ Ahafo Mantam mu, Ghana. Mprempren ɔyɛ Ɔmanpanyin, ma adwumayɛbea a ɛhwɛ adwuma ne adan so, Ghana. Kan no na ɔyɛ Ɔsoafoɔ Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ mmarima ne mmaa so na ɔsan nso yɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni – "Assembly Woman" firi afe mpem mmienu ne mmienu (2002) kɔsi afe mpem mmienu ne du (2010) maa Lakoo Abatoɔ Beaeɛ a ɛwɔ La-Dadekotopo Mansin mu wɔ Greater Accra Mantam mu. Wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du nson 2017 mu no, wɔpaw no sɛ mpɔtam hɔ nhyehyɛe boayikuo a emufo yɛ 11 a wɔde adwuma ahyɛ wɔn nsa sɛ wɔnyɛ afe mpem mmienu ne du nwɔtwe (2018) Afrika Mmaa Kuruwa no dwamtenani.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo no wɔ  Ɔbɛnem bosome no da a ɛtɔ so aduonu mmiensa wɔ afe apem ahankron aduosia nsia mu (1966) wɔ Accra wɔ Ghana Ahemfo abusua mu. Ɔyɛ owufoɔ Ohenenana Akwasi Agyeman Dua-Prempeh, a ɔfiri Ashanti Ahemfie abusua mu ne owufoɔ Nana Amma Serwaa, Kontihemaa a ɔfiri Duayaw Nkwanta,( a wonim no wɔ kokoam asetena mu sɛ Madam Georgina Ansah) babaa a ɔtɔ so mmiɛnsa. 

Freda hyɛɛ ne mfitiaseɛ nwomasua ase wɔ University Primary School, Kumasi na ɔkɔɔ so de ne Ordinary(O) level wɔ Technology Secondary School (mprempren KNUST Senior High School) wɔ Kumasi, Ghana na ɔtoaa so de ne Advanced level Certificate (A level) wɔ Accra Workers Kɔlege a ɛwɔ Accra, Ghana. Afei ɔkɔɔ Ghana Institute of Journalism, na ɔkɔɔ Diploma wɔ Public Relations and Advertising mu. hyɛɛ no anuonyam sɛ Certified Public Accountant wɔ afe apem ahankron aduowɔtwe nwɔtwe (1998). Ɔwɔ Certificate ne Advanced Certificate wɔ Marketing, DipM, MCIM, Chartered Marketer Professional Postgraduate Diploma wɔ Marketing mu, ne nyinaa firi Chartered Institute of Marketing, United Kingdom na ɛwɔ hɔ. Ɔnyaa ne abodin krataa wɔ (Business Administration), Human Resource Management Option mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu wɔ afe 2006 mu. Ɔsane nso suaa MA Comms, Media ne Public Relations wɔ University of Leicester, UK na ɔsane nso wɔ PhD wɔ Business Administration mu wɔ Ghana Technology University College.

Ankorankorɛ asetena 
Freda Akosua Prempeh firi Duayaw Nkwanta, ne mmarahyɛ badwa Mantam, Tano North, ahenkurow a ɛwɔ Ahafo Mantam mu, Ghana. Ɔyɛ Kristoni, na waware wɔ ɔbabarima. Ɛkaa kakraa bi na Freda hweree ne nkwa wɔ Ayɛwohomumɔ bosome no da a ɛtɔ so mmiensa wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du num mu (2015) nsuyiri ne ogya asiane a esii wɔ circle, Accra. Ansa na wɔrepaw Freda sɛ ɔmannifoɔ wɔ mmarahyɛ badwa mu wɔ afe 2013 mu no, na ɔyɛ adwuma sohwɛfoɔ wɔ Point Four Hotel a ɛwɔ Sunyani na na ɔne Prison Service nso ayɛ adwuma mfeɛ 10. Ɔyɛ obi a ɔpɛ agumadi na ɔgye mmaa tumi di denneennen.

Amammuo asetena 
Freda Prempeh yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuo Foforo (N.P.P.) no muni. N’amammuo adwuma hyɛɛ aseɛ wɔ afe 2002 mu tɔnn, sɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni ma Lakoo Abatoɔ Beaeɛ a ɛwɔ La-Dadekotopo Mantam mu wɔ Greater Accra Mantam mu, mfeɛ 8, Wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2006 mu no, wɔfrɛɛ no sɛ ɔmmɛsom wɔ Ɔman Mpata Badwa no mu sɛ Ɔmanfoɔ Affairs Officer a ɔyɛ asram 9. Mprempren ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni ma Tano North Constituency, na ɔsom wɔ Mines and Energy, Aban Awerɛhyem Boayikuo mu wɔ mmarahyɛ badwa no mu. Wɔpaw no sɛ Ɔmanpanyin Akufo-Addo sɛ Ɔmanpanyin Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Adwumayɛ ne Adan So, wɔ afe 2017 mu. Mprempren ɔyɛ Ɔmanpanyin Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Bɔbeasu, Mmɔfra ne Asetena mu Ahobammɔ so. Ɔsii akan wɔ afe 2020 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu sɛ mmarahyɛ badwani a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔdi Tano North seat no so wɔ New Patriotic Party tekiti so, na ɔdii nkonim bɛboro 51%. Eyi ma ɛyɛ ne bere a ɛto so 3 sɛ MP na mprempren ɔyɛ Fourth Republic mmarahyɛ badwa a ɛto so 8 no muni.

2006/2007 Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhyehyɛɛ ne Ɔmampanyin Abadiakyiri, Tertiary Students Adesua Afe Confederacy (TESCON), Ghana Sukuupɔn, Accra City Campus 2008 Member, Nkitahodi Boayikuw. Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo, Ɔman Ɔsatu Kuo President ne Ɔdehyeɛ, Women Supporters Union of Ghana

title: Issah Fuseini
text:
== Abrabɔ Ahyeaseɛ ne Nwomasua == 
Fuseini Issah( a wɔwoo no 2 Ɔpɛpɔn 1975) yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɔni ne Ghana  Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nan no mmarahyɛbadwa  a ɛtɔ so nson. Ɔgyina hɔ ma Okakwei Atifi fam abatoɔ mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Nkran Punpuni mantam no mu no  wɔ Ɔsono kokroko ammanyɔkuo (New Patriotic Party-NPP) tekiti so.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Onimuonyamfoɔ Fuseini  dii ntwo  wɔ Sagnarigu, National Democratic Congress (NDC) mmarahyɛbdwa  abatoɔ no mu berɛ a ɛdi kan a ɔsii ɔkɔpereee mmarahyɛbadwa ankwondwa no

Atta Issa a ɔyɛ obi a ɔbaa mu foforo no dii no so nkonim. 

Atta Issah, akontaabɔufo bi a ɔwɔ National Democratic Congress (NDC) adwumayɛbea ti no nymmatno ahanwɔtwe ne baako (ow )801 de dii Fuseiatɔnyaa mma  Aha-mmeɛnsa ne aduasa-mmeɛnsa (ow )3no s3 so nkon 

wo ne Ghana asɔretiafoɔ kuo kɛseɛ; san kɔ IPAC – Fuseini Issah kɔ NDC

Faako a wonyae: Ernest K. Arhinful. 

Ɛwɔ 7 Ɔpɛpɔn 2023 mu no, kane mmarahyɛbadwani de ma Okahwei kasa de ne nne kaa ɔfrɛ a ɛne sɛ National Democratic Congress (NDC) nsan nkɔ Inter-Party Advisory Committee (IPAC) no mu no ho.     

Ɔkaa sɛ ɛno nko ara ne akwanya a amanyɔkuo ahodoɔ no bɛtumi anya de wɔn ho akɔhyɛ abatoɔ kɔmisan  (EC) no adwuma mu.

Ɔse,  ɔrebɔ mmɔden sɛ ɔbɛsan aba bio . Berɛ a ɔrekasa wɔ nsɛm a wobisabisaa no wɔ Metro TV so no, ɔsii so dua sɛ ekuo biara mfa n’adwene nto Abatoɔ kɔmisan no so. 

Enti Owura Issah se, ɛreyɛ aka hɔ sɛ  wɔn a wɔn aban wɔ so ne wɔn a wɔn aban nni so no taa boa  Abatoɔnkɔmisan no. Ɔgye di sɛ ɛsɛ  sɛ ɔmanfoɔ  

twe wɔn ho firi saa suban no ho  . Sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ na Abatoɔ no nsusuansoɔ no nokorɛdie bɛba mu.

"Saa suban yi reyɛ aka ɔmamfoɔ so a sɛ wowɔ ɔsɔretia mu na sɛ wowɔ aban mu a woboa nso a, ɛyɛ a wonoa EC adwuma no. Mesusu sɛ ɛsɛ sɛ yɛtwe yɛn ho fi saa suban ho," ɔka saa ndy Abbey 

N’afotuo no baeɛ wɔ Ɔmampanin John Mahama nsɛm a ɔkaa no wɔ  Facebook a ɔde rehwehwɛdeɛ bi a ɛfiri EC hɔ ansa na abatoɔ a wɔtweɛ wɔn din kakraa bi a wɔayɛ sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ aseɛ wɔ Yawda, Ɛbɔ da a ɛtɔ so du-mmienu, mfeɛ mpem-mmienu ne du-mmienu (12 ) no akyi.

title: Edwin Nii Lantey Vanderpuye
text:
Edwin Nii Lante Vanderpuye (wɔwoo no Ayɛwohomumɔ da a ɛtɔ so du-baako, afe Apem Ahankron ne Aduosia-num (1965).  yɛ Ghana adwadie ho nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfoɔ ne ɔmanyɔni  ne mprempren yi Mmarahyɛbadwani ma  adehyeɛ a wɔwɔ  Odododiodio abatoɔ mpɛsoa so no. ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ mmabunu ne Agodie so ne ɔsoafoɔ Abadiakyire a ɔhwɛ adwadie ne Nnwuma ho nsɛm  so wɔ John Dramani Mahama aban mu.

Nhomasua 
Ɔyɛ obi a wawie Bechem Presbyterian Mmarimaa Ntoaso Sukuu ne Mfantsipim Sukuu, 

Cape Coast. Ɔwɔ Master’s degree wɔ Governance & Leadership mu wɔ Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration (GIMPA) ne B.A. wɔ Borɔfo, Nyansapɛ ne Nneɛma a Wɔagye Din mu wɔ Ghana Sukuupɔn mu.

Adwumayɛ 
Ɛfiri afe Apem Ahankron ne Aduɔkron (1990) de kɔsi  mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne Ɛnan( 2004) no, ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ Ghana Broadcasting Corporation a na ɔyɛ dwumadie Titenani Abadiakyire.  mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne enum (2005) ne mfeɛmpem mmienu ne nwɔtwe (2008) ntam no, na  ɔyɛ dwumadie so Panin wɔ Network Broadcasting Limited.

Amanyɔsɛm mu adwuma 
Na ɔyɛ ɔboafoɔ titire ne adwumayɛ sohwɛfoɔ wɔ ɔmampanin atenaeɛ wɔ kane Ghana Ɔmampanin John Evans Fiifi Atta Mills abrɛ so  Na ɔsan nso yɛ kane soafoɔ abadiakyire a ɔhwɛ Adwadie ne Nnwuma so wɔ John Mahama abrɛ so.

Mmarahyɛbadwa Mu 
Wɔpaw no sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ wɔ mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Du-mmienu (2012) abatoɔ no mu, faako a ɔne Victor Okaikoi a ɔfiri Ɔsono kokroko ammanyɔkuo (New Patriotic PartyNPP) mu no hyiaeɛ. Vanderpuye nyaa ahotosoɔ yie wɔ akwanya  a na ɛda hɔ ma no sɛ ɔbɛdi nkonim no ho. Na ɔgyee din sɛ ɔkaa wɔ Obubuo , mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Dmmienu (2012) mu sɛ sɛ ɔnya mma  a ɛnnu ɔha nkyekyem Aduosia-num (65% ) a, ɔbɛgyae akondwa no ama Okaikoi atenaeɛ no. Awieiɛ koraa no, Vanderpuye dii nkonim a ɛkaa kakra bi na nka wanya deɛ na ɔrehwehwɛ sɛ nka Ɔbɛduruu no .  Ɔnyaa mma no mu mpem aduanan-num, ahankron ne aduosia-nson( 45,967) a ɛno gyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyem aduosia-mmeɛnsa (63%) ma  Okaikoi a ɔne no sii akan no nso nyaa mma no mu mpem aduonu-nsia , Aha-mmienu ne aduosia-nkron ( 26,269) a na ɛno nso gyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyem aduasa-nsia (36%) pɛpɛɛpɛ . Emmanuel Odoi, Convention People's Party-CPP ni a na ɔka wɔn ho no nso nyaa mma no mu ahanson ne aduanan-num(745) a ɛno nso gyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyem baako (1%) pɛ maa .

Wɔ mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Du-nsia (2016) mu no wɔkoraa no sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwa no muni ma Odododiodio mansini no mu a ɔnyaa mma no mu mpem aduasa-nsia ahansia ne nsia (36,606) a na ɛno gyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyem aduonum nson ne akyire pɔ hwee ne Ɛnan (57.04%) tiaa nea ɔbɛn no paa a ɛne New Patriotic Party a ne kannifoɔ, nyaa mma no mu mpem aduonu-mmienu, ahansia, ne aduɔson-baako ( 26,671) a na ɛno gyina hɔ ma  ɔha nkyekyem aduanan-baako ne akyiri pɔ ɛmu(41.5%) Ɔsom wɔ Mmarahyɛbadwa  no mu sɛ ɔmannifoɔ a ɔdi kan wɔ Mpɔtam Aban ne Nkurasenkurase Nkɔsoɔ Abadwakuo no mu ne sɛ ɔmannifoɔ wɔ Hokwan Abadwakuo no mu ni.

Ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ mmabunu dwumadie so 

Wɔ Ɔbɛnem, mfe Mpem Mmienu ne Du-mmeɛnsa (2013) mu no, wɔpaw no sɛ ɔsoafoɔ Abadiakyire a ɔhwɛ adwadie ne Nnwuma ho nsɛm so wɔ John Mahama aban so. Ɔsom wɔ saa dwumadie no mu kɔsii mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Du-nan (2014) berɛ a wɔtuu no sɛ ɔnkɔsom sɛ Ɔsoafoɔ Abadiakyire a ɔhwɛ Mpɔtam Aban ne Nkuraseɛ Nkɔsoɔ so wɔ baabi a ɔsom kɔsii afe 2015. Wɔ nsakraeɛ a ɛbaa asomfo mu wɔ afe 2015 mu akyi no, John Dramani Mahama bɔɔ Vanderpuye din sɛ Mmabunu ne Agodie ho Ɔsoafoɔ sɛ ɔmmɛsi  Ɔbenfoɔ Mustapha Ahmed ananmu.

title: Elizabeth K. T. Sackey
text:
Elizabeth Kwatsoe Tawiah Sackey (wɔwoo Kotonima bosome da a  ɛtɔ so 6 wɔ afe 1958) yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ na na ɔyɛ Okaikwei North Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni. Na ɔyɛ Ghana Aman a Ɛto so Anan no Mmarahyɛ Bagua a Ɛto so Nsia no muni a ogyina Okaikwei North Constituency ananmu wɔ Greater Accra Mantam mu wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so.

Wɔpaw no sɛ Accra kuropɔn sohwɛfo.  Akyiri yi wɔsii so dua sɛ Accra kuropɔn sohwɛfoɔ na ɔbɛyɛɛ ɔbaa a ɔdi kan a ɔdii saa dibea no.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Sackey wɔ Asere wɔ Accra, Ghana, wɔ Kotonima bosome da a  ɛtɔ so 6 wɔ afe 1958. Elizabeth K. T. Sackey yɛ sikakorabea dwumayɛni ne sikasɛm ho ɔbenfo. Ɔwɔ Ceficate in Marketing a ɔnyaa wɔ afe 2003 mu na seesei ɔreyɛ Bachelor of Science wɔ Administration abodin krataa wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Sackey yɛ New Patriotic Party  (NPP) no muni. Wɔdii kan paw no sɛ ɔmmɛgyina Okaikwei North Constituency ananmu wɔ January 2005 mu. Ɔsan sii ananmu wɔ adwumayɛbea no mu wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛ bagua a ɛtɔ so 5 no mu wɔ ne san a wɔsan paw no wɔ Ɔpɛnimma 2008 mu wɔ afe  2008 Amansan Abatoɔ no akyi.

Adwuma 
Ansa na Sackey rebɛyɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni no, na ɔyɛ adwuma sɛ Ɔkyerɛwfo Panyin wɔ Ghana Commercial Bank. Afei ɔbɛyɛɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni. Ɔyɛ ɔsomfoɔ abadiakyiri maa Greater Accra mantam no firi afe 2017 kɔsi afe 2020. Wɔ Ɔbɔ bosome no mu wɔ afe 2021 mu no, Nana Akufo-Addo yii no sɛ AMA Adwumayɛfoɔ Panyin. Mprempren ɔyɛ Accra kuropɔn sohwɛfo.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Sackey aware na ɔwɔ mma baanan. Ɔyɛ Kristoni a ɔsom wɔ Pentekoste Asɔredan mu.

title: Yaw Frimpong Addo
text:
Frimpong Yaw Addo yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ ne Mmrahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson a ɛwɔ Ghana Aman a ɛtɔ so nnan no muni ne mmarahyɛ bagua a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe a ɛwɔ Ghana a ɛtɔ so nnan a ɔgyina Manso Adubia Mansin ananmu wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so.  . Mprempren ɔyɛ Ɔmanpanyin Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Aduan ne Kuadwuma so.

Abrabɔ Ashasiɛ ni Adesua 
Wɔwoo Addo Kwasida, 2nd September 1962 wɔ kuro bi a wɔfrɛ no Manso Gyeduako mu wɔ Amansie South District wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu. Ɔnyaa ne Bachelor of Arts abodin krataa wɔ Sociology ne Diploma wɔ Borɔfo kasa mu wɔ University of Cape Coast wɔ afe 1990. Ɔsan nso nyaa ne Executive Masters adansedie krataa wɔ Conflict, Peace and Security mu wɔ afe 2016 mu wɔ Kofi Annan International Peace Keeping Training Center wɔ Accra.

Adwuma 
Na Addo yɛ Nnwumakuw Asetra mu Asɛyɛde Dwumadibea, Ankorankoro Nnwuma Fapem no sohwɛfo. Na ɔsan yɛ Social and Environment impact ho ɔbenfo wɔ Comptran Engineering. Na ɔsan yɛ Asetena ne Nneɛma a Atwa Yɛn Ho Ahyia nkɛntɛnso ho ɔbenfo wɔ Transtel Consult. Na ɔsan yɛ nhyehyɛe ahorow ho nkitahodifo panyin wɔ National Democratic Institute for International Affairs.

Amammui mu adwuma 
Addo yɛ New Patriotic Party no muni na mprempren ɔyɛ mmarahyɛ baguani ma Manso Adubia Constituency wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu. Ɔbɛyɛɛ MP a odi kan wɔ ne mansin mu bere a ɔdaa ne ho adi wɔ 2012 Ghana Amansan Abatow mu no. Afei wɔsan paw no bio maa ne mprenu so wɔ afe 2016 Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ mu baabi a ɔnyaa abatoɔ a wɔtoo no nyinaa mu 69.86%.Wɔ afe 2020 Amansan abatoɔ mu no, ɔdii nkonim wɔ mmarahyɛ bagua no mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 17,652 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 38.8% berɛ a NDC mmarahyɛ bagua no muni Simon Kwaku Agyei nyaa abatoɔ 10,753 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ no nyinaa mu 23.6%. Independent kandifoɔ Kofi Osei-Afoakwa nso nyaa abatoɔ 17,149 a ɛyɛ 37.7% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu.

Ɔhyiaa pawfoɔ boayikuo no wɔ 3 June 2021 na ɔfirii adi yie sɛ Kuadwuma soafoɔ Abadiakyiri.

Addo yɛ Ohia Tew Ho Nhyehyɛe Boayikuw no muni na ɔsan yɛ Atwa Yɛn Ho Ahyia, Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma Boayikuw no muni.

Asetenam mu nsɛm 
Ɔyɛ Kristoni na waware a ɔwɔ mma baanum. Ɔpɛ kuayɛ ne bɔɔlbɔ.

Bɛbia Mmoa Efiri

title: Samuel George Nartey
text:
Samuel Nartey George yɛ obi a wɔwoo no am 22 Ɔbɛnem, afe Apem, Ahankron ne Aduɔwɔtwe num (, 1985).Ɔyɛ Ghana amamyɔni . Ɔfiri Old Ningono. Ɔyɛ NDC nipa.Wɔ Obubuo, mfe Mpem Mmienu ne Du-num (2015) mu no, ɔtwaa E.T. Mensah wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa abatoɔ a wɔtoo no Ningo Prampram no mu. Seesei, mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson wɔ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nan no mu.  Ɔgyina Ningo Prampram abatoɔ mpɛsoa no ananmu.

Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ ne Nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Sam Nartey George wɔ  Ɔbɛnem da a ɛtɔ so aduonu -mmienu, afe Apem Ahankron ne Aduɔwɔtwe-num (1985) wɔ Somanya a ɛwɔ Apueiɛ Mantam wɔ Ghana mu. Ɔnya BSc. wɔ Kuadwuma mu Mfididwuma (Asase & Nsu Ho Mfiridwuma) mu wɔ KNUST ( L.L.B ) ne University of London.Ɔnyaa Executive Masters (Dissertation) (Ntawntawdie Asomdwoeɛ, ne Ahobanbɔ) firi Kofi Anann Amanaman Ntam Asomdwoeɛ ne Nteteeɛ Asoɛeɛ (KAIPTC).Wɔ ɔpɛnimaa 2022 mu no, owiee sukuu ne MSc wɔ Amanaman Ntam Nhyehyɛeɛ den Diplomacy mu wɔ 

London School of Economics and Political Science.

Adwene 
George kura adwene a ɛko tia LGBTI.  Ɔtaa ka sɛ mmarima a wɔne wɔn ho deda yɛ "akyiwadeɛ". ɔfoa mmarahyɛbadwa no mmara a ɔde ba faa LGBTQ ho wɔ mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Aduonu -baako no so. nsɛmmɔnedie ɔboa  ma LGBTQ ho a wɔpɛ sɛ wɔbra no ho nsɛm kɔ n'anim. Wɔkasa tia sɛ ɛyɛ atirimuɔdensɛm a ɛnsɛ sɛ mmara ma ho kwan".

Adwumayɛ 
Na Sam Nartey George yɛ de aboafoɔ kwankyerɛfoɔ ma de Office of de Head of Civil Service firi afe 2010 ba 2014 na  ɔsan bɛyɛɛ nkitahodiɛ ho ɔbenfoɔ wɔ Ghana mampanin atenaeɛ (office of the President) firi mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Du-nan (2014)de kɔsi ba mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du-nsia (2016).

Abadwakuo 

Mprempren Sam George yɛ Ɔmanfoɔ Akontaabuo abadwakuo ɛwɔ mmarahyɛbedwafie no mu ni.

N'ankasa Abrabɔ 
Sam George yɛ Kristoni.

title: Elizabeth Afoley Quaye
text:
Elizabeth Afoley Quaye (wɔwoo no afe 1970), mprempren ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwa no mu ni ma Krowor mmansini a ɛwɔ Nkran punpuni (Greater Accra ) mantam mu wɔ Ghana no.  Ɔsan nso yɛ ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Mpataayie, afarefodwuma, ne Nsuo mu Nneɛma ho nsɛm  so.

Nhomasua . 
Elizabeth wɔ Bachelor of Science abɔdin krataa wɔ (Agribusiness) mu wɔ Central University College. Ɔnyaa (National Diploma )wɔ (General Agriculture) mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu, na ɔsan nso nyaa adansedie krataa wɔ General Agriculture mu wɔ Kwadaso Agricultural College.

Adwuma 
Elizabeth ne asoeɛ a ɛhwɛ nnuane ne kuayɛ ho nsɛm so (Ministry of Food and Agriculture) ayɛ adwuma sɛ Principal Production Officer mfeɛ aduonu ni. Ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma krowor mansini no

Ɔsan nso yɛ Ɔsomfoɔ a wɔapaw no sɛ ɔhwɛ Mpataayie ne Nsuo mu Nneɛma ho nsɛm so.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Mprempren yi, Elizabeth Afoley Quaye yɛ Mmarabadwani  ma Krowor Mansini a ɛwɔ Nkran punpuni (Greater Accra ) mantam mu wɔ Ghana no.  Ɔsan nso yɛ ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Mpataayie ne Nsuo mu neɛma ho nsɛm so.  Afoley Quaye sii akan na ɔdii nkonim wɔ ɔsono Kokroko ammanyɔkuo (New Patriotic Party-NPP) tekiti so wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa abatoɔ a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Nkran mantam no mu no. Ɔgyina maa Krowor abatoɔ mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Greater Accra Mantam mu wɔ mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Du-num(2015). Wɔ mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Du-nsia (2016 ) Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu no, ɔdii nkonim wɔ saa mmarahyɛbadwa no ara mu de bɛyɛɛ mmarahyɛbadwani  maa Krowor Mansini no bio. Ɔne nnipa afoforoɔ mmeɛnsa na wɔpɛ sɛ wɔn nso bɛyɛ mmarahyɛbafoɔ na ɛsii Akan no a na wɔn nyinaa wɔpɛ sɛ wɔpaw wɔn sɛ mmarahyɛbadwafie wɔ Krowor mansin no mu no. Na ɔdii wɔn nyinaa so nkonim. Wɔne Agnes Naa Momo Lartey a ɔfiri kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo (National Democratic Congress-NDC), Hugo Kofi Huppenbauer a ɔfiri (Progressive People’s Party-PPP) ne Amartey Fanny a oɔfiri (Convention People’s Party-CPP) mu. Afoley Quaye dii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ no mu a ɔnyaa mma  mpem Aduasa-mmienu, Ahanan ne aduosia nsia  (32,463) wɔ mpem aduosia mmeɛnsa, ahanum ne aduonum-num (63,555) a wɔtoeɛ no mu, a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha  nkyekyem aduonum-baako ne akyiri pɔ whee ne nwɔtwe (51.08).

Elizabeth na ɔyɛ asoeɛ a ɛhweɛ kuadwuma ne nnuane so (Ministry of Food and Agriculture) no mu panin a ɔhwɛ nnɔbaeɛ dua so. Wadi saa dwuma yi  bɛyɛ mfeɛ  aduonu ni. 

Elizabeth Afoley Quaye a ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwa  no mu ni ma Krowor mansini no ani ku kwadwuma ho pa ara. Nti mpɛn pii no, ɔhyɛ ɔmanfoɔ nkuran sɛ wɔmfa wɔn ho nhyɛ kuadwuma mu. Sɛ  Ɔmsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Mpataayie e Nsuo mu Nnuadeɛ no, ɔmfa afarefoɔ nni agorɔ koraa. Ɔde ne nimdeɛ a ɔwɔ no wɔ Bachelor of Science wɔ Agribusiness mu no boa de akwan ahodoɔ a ɔmanfoɔ nam so bɛnya nkɔsoɔ wɔ wɔn  kuadwuma ne Mpataayie mu bɛ 

Elizabeth bɔɔ ne ho mmɔden , na ɔgu so yɛ adwumaden ma Ministry of Food and Agriculture a ɔne wɔn ayɛ adwuma sɛ Principal Production Officer mfeɛ aduonu no 

Elizabeth Afoley Quaye  nkonimdie a ɔnyaa no wɔ ne Mmarahyɛbadwa  abatoɔ no mu no yɛɛ krabɛhwɛ Krowor Mansini a ɛwɔ Greater Accra Mantam mu no de anigyeɛ paw no sɛ wɔn kannifoɔ wɔ afe 2015. 

Nnipa mmiɛnsa a Ɔne wɔn sii akan no mpo ammɛe no ababaa. Na abatoɔ no akyiri no, wɔn nyinaa de anigye hyɛɛ bɔ sɛ, ɛwom sɛ wɔanya aba no deɛ, nanso wɔbɛboa no ama wayɛ adwuma. Na ɛnam saa so ama Krowor mansini no afa ne ntoma pa afira.

N'ankasa Abrabɔ 
Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baanan. Ɔda ne ho adi sɛ ɔyɛ Kristoni.

Baabi Menyaa Mmoa Friiɛ 

Ateasefoɔ
Nkran mantam
Mmarahyɛbadwani

title: Benard Oko-Boye
text:
=== 
 ===
 Benarnard Okoe-Boye yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɔni na na ɔyɛ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nan no Mmarahyɛbadwa  a ɛtɔ so nson no mu ni a ɔgyina Ledzokuku Mansini no ananmu wɔ Nkran Punpuni Greater Accra Mantam mu wɔ Ɔsono kokroko ammanyɔkuo (New Patriotic Party-NPP ) tekiti so. Berɛ bi a atwam,  na ɔyɛ Korle Bu Nkyerɛkyerɛ Ayaresabea(Korle-Bu Teaching Hospital) ɔman no mu aduruyɛbea kɛseɛ no abadwakuo dwamtenani. Mprempren,  ɔresom wɔ Ɔman Akwahosan (Insurance) Dwumadibea (NHIA) a wɔahyɛ no sɛ ɔnhwɛ Ghana akwahosan ho ahotɔsoɔ  nhyehyɛeɛ so a ɛka Ɔman no Akwahosan Insurance Nhyehyɛeɛ no ho nsɛm so.

Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ ne Nwomasua 
Ɔfiri Teshie a ɛhyɛ Ledzokuku abatoɔ mpɛsoa no ase.  Ɔsom sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwa no mu ni. Ɔkɔɔ Field Engineers Junior High School, baabi a ɔnyaa ne  Mfitiaseɛ Nwomasua no.  Ɛhɔ na ɔnyaa ne BECE Abodin krataa. Okoe-Boye kɔɔ Presbyterian Boys’ Secondary School ( Presec-Legon) ɛhɔ na owiee ne ntoasoɔ sukuu adesua wɔ mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu pɛpɛɛpɛ (2000). Bernard Okoe Boye yɛ oduruyɛfoɔ a ɔwɔ tumi krataa wɔ n’adwuma mu. Ɔwɔ BSC wɔ Human Biology, Medicine mu ne Oprehyɛnyɛ mu . Ɔnyaa saa abɔdin krataa yi frii Kwame Nkrumah Sukuupɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so no mu.Ɔsan nso wɔ abɔdin krataa a ɛkorɔn wɔ Ɔmanfo Akwahosan (MPH) mu wɔ Hamburg School of Applied Science ne A1 adansedie krataa wɔ German kasa mu wɔ Geothe Institute, Accra.Aduruyɛ ho tumi krataa (Aduruyɛ ne nsɛm ho gyinatufoɔ).

Adwuma

Akwahosan ho adwumayɛ 
Okoe-Boye nyaa ne fie adwuma wɔ Ghana Health Service firi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nkron 2009 kɔsi afe 2012. wɔ Central Regional Hospital, Department of Surgery, Pediatrics and Obstetrics and Gynecology, Cape Coast firi afe 2009 kɔsi afe 2011 na afei wɔ Department of Internal Medicine, . Tema Ayaresabea Kɛse.Afei ɔkɔɔ so yɛɛ aduruyɛ sohwɛfoɔ wɔ saa asoɛeɛ korɔ no ara mu mfeɛ nnan baabi a ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ Kibi Aban Ayaresabea, Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology ne La General Hospital. Ansa na ɔrekɔ mmarahyɛbadwa mu no, na Oko-Boye yɛ aduruyɛ so panin  wɔ LEKMA Ayaresabea a ɛwɔ Accra.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔpaw Okoe-Boye sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma Ledzokuku abatoɔ mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Greater Accra   Matam no , mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Du-nsia (2016 ) Naa ɔsɔɔ akufena mu suaee wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn da a ɛtɔ so nson, mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du-nson (2017). Ɔyɛ Akwahosan ne Aban Awerɛhem Abadwakuo a ɛwɔ Ghana  Mmarahyɛbadwafie  no mu ni.

Wɔ Ayɛwohomumɔ da a ɛtɔ so nan, mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Aduonu ( 2020) no, Ɔmampanyin Nana Addo Dankwa Akufo-Addo paw Okoe-Boye sɛ ɔnyɛ akwahosan soafoɔ abadiakyirie na ɛno akyi no, ɔkaa ntam wɔ Ayɛwohomumɔ da a ɛtɔ so Aduonu-baako, mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Aduonu (2020).Nanso ɔhweree Ledzokuku mmarahyɛbadwa atenaeɛ akondwa no  wɔ mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Aduonu (2020) Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu maa Benjamin Narteh Ayiku a ɔfiri  Kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress-NDC  mu no. wɔ Oforisuo da a ɛtɔ so aduonu baako, mfe Mpem Mmienu ne Aduonu-mmienu (2022) mu no, wɔpaw no sɛ Ɔman Akwahosan Insurance Dwumadibea a ɛhwɛ Ɔman Akwahosan Insurance Nhyehyɛe so no CE

Abadwakuo Ahodoɔ

title: Joseph Nii Laryea Afotey Agbo
text:
Efi Wikipedia, encyclopedia a wontua hwee

Joseph Nii Laryea Afotey-Agbo (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn bosome ne da a ɛtɔ so  31 wɔ afe 1967) yɛ Ghana amanyɔfoɔ na na ɔyɛ Greater Accra Mantam Ɔmanpanin wɔ Ghana.  Ansa na yei reba no, na ɔyɛ Volta Mantam Ɔmanpanin.  Ansa na eyi reba no, na ɔyɛ Volta Ɔmantam Soafo. Ɔyɛ

Ɔyɛ Fourth Republic of Ghana Mmarahyɛ Bagua a ɛtɔ so nson no muni a ɔgyina Kpone-Katamanso Mantam a ɛwɔ Greater Accra Mantam mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Ankorankoro asetra 

Ɔyɛ Kristoni (Presbyterian). Ɔwaree (ɔwɔ mma baason) .

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Afotey-Agbo wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn osome ne da a ɛtɔ so  31, afe 1967. Ɔfiri Katamanso-Nungua, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Greater Accra Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Owiee Ghana Institute of Journalism na onyaa ne diploma abodin krataa wɔ ɔmanfo ntam abusuabɔ mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Afotey-Agbo yɛ  National Democratic Congress ( (NDC) no muni. Ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni a ɔgyina Kpone-Katamanso Mansin ananmu  ɛtɔ so 4, 5, 8, ne mprempren ne 7 Parliament wɔ 4th Republic of Ghana. Ɔsom sɛ boayikuw muni wɔ boayikuw ahorow a ɛhwɛ Atwa Yɛn Ho Ahyia, Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma Boayikuw, Mmabun, Agumadi ne Amammerɛ Boayikuw, ne Hokwan Boayikuw so. Ɔyɛɛ Aman soafoɔ wɔ afe 2009 ne 2012. Ɔsan nso yɛɛ Ɔmantam Ɔsoafoɔ wɔ Greater Accra Mantam mu wɔ afe 2012 ne 2014 ntam.

Adwuma 
Ɔyɛ JNL Afotey-Agbo Ventures kwankyerɛfo panyin (MD). Ɔayɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni firi Ɔpɛpɔn 2005 kɔsi nnɛ.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Kwame Asafu-Adjei
text:
Kwame Asafu-Adjei  yɛ Ghana amanyɔni sane yɛ mmrahyɛbedwani wɔ mmrahyɛdwa a ɛtɔso nson wɔ Ghana adehyeman a ɛtɔso nan a na ɔgyina mu ma Nsuta-Kwamang Beposo a ɛwɔ Asante mantam ma NPP   

amanyɔkuo

N'abrabɔ ahyeaseɛ ne nnwomasua 
Wɔwoo Adjei wɔ Ahinime bosome ne da a ɛtɔso du wɔ afe apem ɔha nkron ne aduonum wɔ Nsuta a ɛwɔ Asnte mantam. Wɔkɔɔ suapɔn ntoasoɔ wɔ Tennessee State University, Nashville, USA wɔ 1980.

N'adwuma 
Na ɔka mpaninfoɔ a ɔhwɛ Asafaco Consult Company Limited wɔ Nkran. Na ɔsane ka mpanimfoɔ a ɔhwɛ Policy,planning, monitoring and evaluation ho ne panin a ɔda Livestock planning committee wɔ MOFA.

Amanyɔsɛm nnwuma 
Wɔyii no baa mmrahyɛbedwafie a ɛtɔso wɔ Ghana adehyeman a ɛtɔso nan wɔ 7 January 2013 wɔ berɛ a ɔtoo ne so aba wɔ wɔ 2012 abatoɔ no.

Wɔsane yii no baa mmrahyɛbedwafie a ɛtɔso nson wɔ Ghana adehyeman a ɛtɔso nan wɔ 7 January 2017 wɔ berɛ wɔnyaa ɔha mu nkyɛmu aduonum baako ne kakra a ɔnyaa no wɔ 2016 abatoɔ kɛseɛ no mu. Wɔyɛ mmrahyɛbedwani dadaa de ma Nsuta Kwamang-Beposo.

N'abrabɔ 
Wɔyɛ ɔkristoni a waware na ɔwɔ mma mmiɛnsa.

title: Kofi Amoakohene
text:
Kofi Amoakohene yɛ Ghana amanyɔni sane yɛ mmrahyɛbedwani wɔ mmrahyɛbedwafie a ɛtɔ so nson wɔ Ghana adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nan a ɔgyina mu maa Atebubu Amantin wɔ Bono mantamma NPP amanyɔkuo no. Na ɔyɛ suafoɔ panin a ɔhwɛ Bono mantam so.

N'abrabɔ ahyɛaseɛ ne nnwomsua 
Wɔwoo no wɔ oforisuo bosome no da a ɛtɔ so du baako wɔ afe 1969 mu wɔ Atebubu a ɛwɔ Bono Atɔeɛ a ɛwɔ Ghana. Wɔkɔɔ suapɔn sukuu wɔ Cental University wɔ Nkran wɔ 2005.

N'adwuma 
Amoakohene ka mpanimfoɔ a wɔhwɛ Cusstomer Company Limited a ɛwɔ Nkran no so.

Amanyɔsɛm

Amoakohene ka NPP amanyɔkuo ho. 
Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbedwani ma Atebubu Amantin. Wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du mmienu (2012) Ghana abatoɔ keseɛ mu no ɔdii nkuguo de maa NDC mmrahyɛbedwani a ɔfrɛ no Sanja Nanja.Na ɔyɛ sauafoɔ ma Bono Atɔeɛ mantam. Wɔgyae mma 22,785 a ɛyɛ ɔha nkyɛmu aduanan baako ne kakra.

N'abrabɔ 
Amoakohene yɛ ɔkristoni.
