title: Kwasi Etu-Bonde
text:
Kwasi Etu-Bonde yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne Mmarahyɛ-Bagua a ɛtɔ so nson a ɛwɔ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nnan no muni a ɔgyina Kintampo North Constituency ananmu wɔ Bono Apueeɛ Mantam mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Wɔ afe 2019 mu no, wɔyii no sɛ Mmarahyɛ-Bagua no muni a ɔto so abien a ɔyɛ adwuma yiye wɔ Bono Apuei Mantam mu.

Mfitiase Asetena 
Wɔwoo Etu-Bonde wɔ Vume wɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

Nwomasua 
Etu-Bonde suaa adeɛ wɔ GIMPA (SME, Development and Management) baabi a ɔnyaa EMBA wɔ afe 2004 mu.

Adwuma 
Etu-Bonde yɛ adwumayɛfoɔ ne SKY-3 Investments Limited ne Sustenance Agro Ventures a ɛwɔ Kintampo no kwankyerɛfoɔ. Ɔyɛ mmarahyɛfo ne kuayɛ ho nimdefo.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔ afe 2015 mu no, ɔsii akan na odii nkonim wɔ NDC mmarahyɛ bagua primaries mu maa Kintampo North mantam a ɛwɔ Bono East Region wɔ Ghana. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ saa mmarahyɛ bagua atenaeɛ yi mu wɔ afe 2016 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ 22,407 mu a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoo no nyinaa mu 53.89% berɛ a NPP mmarahyɛ baguani Nkangmah Mateerl Charles nyaa abatoɔ 17,610 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 42.36%. Joseph Kwame Kumah na odii n’ade wɔ National Democratic Congress primaries wɔ Kintampo North Constituency mu bere a wampene sɛ ɔbɛsi akan no.

Ankorankoro Asetena 
Etu-Bonde aware a ɔwɔ mma baanum.

Ɔsom 
Etu-Bonde yɛ Kristoni.

Beaɛ a nsɛm no firi

title: Kennedy Kwasi Kankam
text:
Kennedy Kwasi Kankam yɛ Ghana amamanyɔni ; na ɔyɛ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nnan Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson no mu ni  a ɔgyina Nhyiaeɛso Mansin no ananmu wɔ Asante Mantam mu wɔ ɔsono kokroko Ammanyɔkuo (New Patriotic Party-NPP)  tekiti so.Mprempren ɔyɛ Asokore Mampong Kuropɔn Badwa no panin.

Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ ne Nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Kankam wɔ 22 Ɔbɛnem 1978 na ɔfiri Adiebeba a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Esiane sɛ na ɔyɛ mmofra baanan mu panyin nti, onyinii wɔ ofie a nnipa a wɔte mfinimfini mu. Ná Kennedy yɛ osuani a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ adwuma na ɔpɛ anuonyam a wasi ne bo sɛ obesi yiye wɔ asetra mu. Ɔnyaa ne mfitiaseɛ nwomasua wɔ Nhyiaeɛso International School wɔ Kumasi firi Kitawonsa ,afe Apem Ahankron ne Aduɔwɔtwe -mmienu (1982) Kɔsi Kitawonsa , afe Apem Ahankron ne Aduɔkron-nsia(1994). Ɔtoaa ne nwomasua so wɔ Prempeh College firi Ɛbɔ , afe Apem, Ahankron ne Aduɔkron-num (1995)  kɔsi Obubuo, afe Apem Ahankron ne Aduɔkron-Nson(1997). Akyire yi, ɔkɔɔ (Christian Service University College),  baabi a ɔwiee sukuu no, nyaa bachelor’s degree wɔ administration mu firi mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Nkron (2009) kɔsi mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Du-mmeɛnsa (2013). Akyire yi, ɔkɔɔ KNUST, kɔyɛɛ ne master’s degree wɔ akontabuo mu firi mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Du-nan (2014) kɔsi mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Du-nsia (2016). Ɔkɔɔ Oxford Suapɔn mu kɔyɛɛ ne diploma wɔ mpuntuo atwerɛ mu wɔ Ɛbɔ, mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Du-nson(2017).

Adwuma 
Kankam yɛ Kekka Company Limited kwankyerɛfoɔ panin firi mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Enum (2005). Ɔdii dwuma sɛ adwuma baanodani Abadiakyire de ma Metro Mass Transit Limited firi mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Mmienu (2002 ) kɔsii mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Ɛnan(2004). Na ɔyɛ Nick ne Cilogar Investment Limited )adwadie  sohwɛfoɔ. Ɔsan yɛ (kumasi Royal Golf Club) no panyin mprempren.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Kankam yɛ ɔsono Kokroko ammanyɔkuo (New Patriotic Party- NPP) no mu ni na na ɔyɛ Nhyiaeɛso Mantam no mmarahyɛbadwani.Wɔ Ayɛwohomumɔ, mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Aduonu (2020 ) mu no, ɔhwree ne mmarahyɛbadwa  atenaeɛ no maa Stephen Amoah wɔ NPP mmarahyɛbadwa  mfitiaseɛ abatoɔ no mu. Nana Akufo-Addo na ɔpaw no na mprempren yi,  ɔyɛ Municipal Chief Executive wɔ Asokore Mampog Mansini  a ɛwɔ Ashanti Mantam mu no mu.

Abadwakuo Ahodoɔ 

Kankam yɛ Ɔmanfoɔ Akontabuo abadwakuo no mu ni na na ɔsan yɛ abɔdeɛ mu nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia, Nyansahunu ne Mfididwuma abadwakuo no mu ni.

N'ankasa Abrabɔ 
Kankam yɛ Kristoni. Ɔwaree. N’ani gye golf bɔ ne bɔɔlbɔ ho yie pa ara.

Nsɛnsɛm 
Wɔ Ayɛwohomumɔ , mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Aduonu -baako (2021)  mu no, nkontabufoɔ Panin no kyerɛɛ Kankam sɛ ɔmfa sika bɛyɛ cidi Mpem Ahanum (₵500,000) a ɔde maa nnipa bɛboro ahasa 300 wɔ Nhyiaeɛso Mansin mu mmra.  Wɔkyerɛɛ sɛ, sika no kɔeɛ sɛ bosea, nanso wɔangye biara.

Nkontaabuo amanneɛbɔ no ka sɛ, wɔammɔ mmɔden biara sɛ wobɛgye sika no wɔ bosome pii akyi wɔ berɛ a wɔde maeɛ no akyi.

“Wɔde sika a ɛyɛ GH500,000.00 fii (MPs Constituency Labor Project Fund )ne (Social Investment Fund )mu kɔɔ sikakorabea bi a ɛyɛ ankorankorɛ dea saa bere no.  Mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔhwɛ Nhyiaeso so (Hon. Kennedy Kwasi Kankam), kaa kane Sikasɛm no ho Officer (Owura Daniel Kofi Kankam) ne Coordinating Director (Owura Samuel Donkor), sɛ wɔbɛkyekyɛ ama nnipa Ahanan ne aduasa 430 a wɔabɔ bosea. Na wɔbɛtua ansa na Ɔsanaa mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Aduonu 2020 adu”.

Adɔeyɛ 
Wɔ Oforisuo 2019 mu no, Kankam de bɔs a ɛtumi fa nnipa 33 maeɛ na ɔsan nso hayaa adwumayɛbea maa NPP baa dwumadibea a ɛwɔ ne mantam mu.

Baabi a Menyaa Mmoa Friiɛ

title: Samuel Nsowah-Djan
text:
Samuel Nsowah-Djan yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne mmarahyɛbadwafie a ɛtɔ so nson(7th) wɔ Ghana adehyeman amammuo mu nipa a ɔregyina ma Upper Denkyira West mpɛsoa wɔ Mfinimfin Mantam mu(Central Region) wɔ Ɔsono amanyɔkuo(New Patriotic Party) no din mu.

Abrabɔ ahyɛase ne nnwomasua 
Wɔwoo Samuel wɔ Ayɛwohomumu bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduonu-nsia(26) wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduosia baako mu(1961). Ɔfiri Denkyira Breman a ɛwɔ mfinimfin mantam mu (Central Region) wɔ Ghana. Ɔwiee University of Ghana Suapɔn, Legon na ɔwɔ bachelor’s degree wɔ Sociology mu wɔ afe 2005. Ɔsan nso wɔ diploma wɔ University of Education, Winneba. Mprempren ɔreyɛ MPhil wɔ Nkɔso Adesua mu wɔ Sukuupɔn a ɛhwɛ Nkɔso Adesua so.

Adwuma 
Na Samuel yɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo panyin wɔ Denkyira-Breman Anglikan Mfitiase Sukuu no mu. Ɔsan nso yɛ Nsowah Mining Company Limited a ɛwɔ Dunkwa-On-Offin no panyin.[1]

N'ankasa abrabɔ 
Samuel yɛ Kristoni.

Adɔeɛ dwumadie 
Wɔ COVID-19 ɔyaredɔm no mu wɔ Ghana no, ɔde nneɛma te sɛ Veronica buckets, nsuo a wɔde gu mu, afidie a wɔde kyerɛ sɛdeɛ obi ho hyeɛ si teɛ (thermometer), nsa hohoro aduro(sanitizers) ne PPE foforɔ maa Upper Denkyira West Mansini apɔmuden mpanimfoɔ.

Ɔyɛɛ mfiri a wɔde tu fam wɔ Aburi, Gyaman ne Kakyerenyansa.

Beaeɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Joseph Albert Quarm
text:
Joseph Albert Quarm a nnipa pii no ara frɛ no Prof. Quarm yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson wɔ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nan no mu mmarahyɛbadwani  a ɔgyina Manso-Nkwanta Mansin ananmu wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ ɔsono kokroko ammanyɔkuo (New Patriotic Party-NPP) tekiti so.

Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ ne Nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Quarm wɔ Ɔbɛnem da a ɛtɔ so nson, afe Apem, Ahankron Aduɔson-num(1975) wɔ Manso  Nsiana   beaeɛ a ɔfiri wɔ Ghana Ashanti Mantam mu no.  Ɔwɔ BSc, MPhil ne PhD abɔdin krataa wɔ Abɔdeɛ a Nkwa Wom Nyansahu mu wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛwɔ Kumasi, (KNUST) no mu.

Adwumayɛ 
Quarm yɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛni wɔ Vicande Sukuu no mu firi afe Apem, Ahankron ne Aduɔkron-nsia (1996) de  kɔsi afe Apem, Ahankron ne Aduɔkron-nwɔtwe(1998). Ɔsan nso yɛɛ adwuma wɔ (Central Gold African Ghana Limited )sɛ obi a ɔhwɛ nkrɔfoɔ atenaeɛ ho nsɛm so (Environmental Officer) wɔ Mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Nson(2007).  Ɔsan nso yɛɛ Prof Quarm Publications Limited baanodani firi afe Apem Ahankron ne Aduɔkron-nsia(1995) kɔsi mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Du-nsia (2016 )ne baanodani nso wɔ (Prof Quarm Health Complex firi mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Du-mmienu (2012 ) kɔsi mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Du-nsia (2016). Ɔsan nso dii dwuma sɛ Ɔbenfoɔ Quarm Bɔɔlbɔ Kuo no kwankyerɛfoɔ ne Ɔbenfoɔ Quarm Construction Limited kwankyerɛfoɔ panin.Ɔyɛ asase ho ɔbenfoɔ, asase ho ɔkamfofoɔ, nhwehwɛmu , nyansahufoɔ ne ɔfotufoɔ a ɔhwɛ fagudeɛ so.

Wɔ Kitawonsa da a ɛtɔ so nson, mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Aduonu (2020 ) mu no, Suapɔn abadwakuo a ɛwɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn no mu no paw no sɛ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn(KNUST) Fapem no Titenani foforo a ɔde mfeɛ 2 bɛyɛ adwuma.  .

Adɔyɛ 
Wɔ Yawda, Ɔpɛnimaa da a ɛdi kan wɔ mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Aduonu (2020 ) mu no, Ghana Ɔmanpanyin, H. E. Nana Addo Darkwa Akufo-Addo hyɛɛ adwuma sɛ wɔnyɛ Prof. Quarm ayaresabea a ɛbɛfa  mpa ɔha wɔ Manso Nsiana wɔ Amanseɛ Atɔeɛ Mansini a ɛwɔ Ashanti mantam mu no mu. 

Wɔde nwomasua nneɛma a ne boɔ yɛ cidi Mpem Ahanan (¢400,000) maa Otumfour Osei Tutu II Foundation sɛ wɔmfa mma nwomasua pa nkɔ anim wɔ Prof. Quarm Publications so wɔ Ayɛwohomumɔ, mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Aduonu-Mmienu (2022).

Amanyɔsɛm 
Quarm yɛ ɔsono kokroko Amanyɔkuo (New Patriotic Party-NPP ) no mu ni. Ɔyɛ kane mmarahyɛbadwani ma Manso Nkwanta abatoɔ mpɛsoa no wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu. Wɔ Ayɛwohomumɔ , mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Du-num(2015) . Ɔdii nkonim wɔ NPP primaries mu tiaa Grace Addo a na ɔyɛ Manso Nkwanta Abatoɔ mpɛsoa no Mmarahyɛbadwani saa berɛ no. Wɔ mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Du-nsia (2016) Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu no, Quarm dii nkonim wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa  no mu a ɔnyaa mma Mpem Aduasa-mmienu, ɔha ne Aduanan (32,140) na ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyem Aduɔwɔtwe mmeɛnsa ne akyiri pɔ aduonu-nsia (83.26% ) wɔ mma a  wɔtoo no nyinaa mu, berɛ a Kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo( National Democratic Congress-NDC) mmarahyɛbadwa mu ɔpɛfoɔ Alex Kwame Bonsu nyaa mma no mu Mpemnum, Ahanum ne Mmeɛnsa (5,503 ) a na ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyem Du-nan ne akyiri pɔ aduonu-nsia ( 14.26%) wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoo no nyinaa mu.

Wɔ Ayɛwohomumɔ mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Aduonu (2020 ) mu wɔ New Patriotic Party (NPP) mmarahyɛbadwa primaries mu no, ɔhweree party tekiti a ɔde bɛkɔ so atena mmarahyɛbadwa akondws no so sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani no  wɔ amansan abatoɔ a na ɛreba wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa , mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Aduonu (2020) no mu.  Ɛmfa ho sɛ na ɔyɛ  Mmarahyɛbadwani  a ɔdi tumi saa berɛ no wɔ Manso Nkwanta Abatoɔ mpɛsoa no so.

Galamsey Nsɛmsɛm 
Berɛ a Ɔmampanyin Nana Addo Darkwa Akufo-Addo hyɛeɛ ma wɔde tabono too  (galamsey)so sɛ mmara mma ho kwan no,  wɔ ɔman no mu nyinaa, Quarm yɛɛ n'afa mu deɛ de boa maa  aban nhyehyɛeɛ tii pi de kyerɛɛ hia a ɛhia  sɛ  wɔbɔ nsuo ne nsase a wɔtumi dua so nnɔbaeɛ no ho ban ɛmfa ho sɛ Ɔmanpanin no adeyɛ no kaa nnipa a wɔte Amanseɛ Atɔeɛ a ɛwɔ Manso Nkwanta Mansin a ɛwɔ Ashanti mantam mu. Ɔsan sii so dua sɛ, ɔhweree  primaries ɛsiane ne ko a ɔko tiaa galamsey a mmara mma ho kwan wɔ ne mansin mu nti.

Wɔ krataa a ekura nkratafa 36 a kane soafoɔ a na ɔhwɛ nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia, nyansahu ne mfididwuma so twerɛeɛ a ɛfa nneɛma nketewa a wotu fi fam a mmara mma ho kwan wɔ Ghana a wɔsan frɛ no galamsey ho no, wɔbɔɔ Quarm din sɛ ɔne aban mpanimfoɔ afoforo de wɔn ho hyɛ nneɛma nketewa a mmara mma ho kwan mu. Ɔmanpanyin adwumayɛbea no wɔ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu akyerɛ sɛ, krataa a nkratafa 36 no ayɛ ma na nsɛm a wɔte ahyɛ mu ma na wɔamfa adanseɛ biara amma a ɛkyerɛ sɛ nsɛm a wɔkaeɛ no yɛ nokorɛ. Enti, wontumi nhwehwɛ saa nsɛm ne nsɛm a wɔte yi mu.

Agya Owusu bɔɔ Quarm somboɔ sɛ ɔtɔn tumi krataa a wɔde tu fam agudeɛ maa no a akyire yi ɛdaa adi sɛ ɛyɛ mmara so bu ɛsiane sɛ beaeɛ a wotu fam agudeɛ no bɛn asubɔnten bi nti. Asraafo mpanimfoɔ kɔto hyɛɛ Agya Owusu beaeɛ so hyee ne nnwinnadeɛ ɛmfa ho sɛ na wɔwɔ tumi krataa a wɔde tu fam agudeɛ. Asanti Mantam (Ghana National Association of Small Scale Miners ) nso bɔɔ no somboɔ sɛ wagye beaeɛ bi a wɔde asi hɔ ama mpɔtam hɔ atom adwuma bi ɛnam ne nkɛntɛnsoɔ a ɔde dii dwuma sɛ (Minerals Commission) no abadwakuo no mu ni. Wɔ Oforisuo 21, Mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Aduonu-mmeɛnsa(2023) wɔ nsɛmbisa mu wɔ JoyFM’s Midday news mu no, Quarm bɔɔ nsɛm a wɔkaeɛ sɛ ɔwɔ mining concessions wɔ ne din mu no guiɛ . Ɔkyerɛɛ sɛ wɔregu ne  din ho fi.

Wɔ Ayɛwohomumɔ,mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Aduonu-mmeɛnsa( 2023) mu no, Quarm de Ɔbenfo Frimpong-Boateng kɔɔ asɛnnibea sɛ ɔbɔɔ ne din ase hwehwɛɛ sɛ wɔmma no kwan a ɛbɛma wakɔka nsɛm foforoɔ afa ne somboɔ adoɔ no ho.

Nidie. 
Wɔ Oforisuo 2022 mu no, West Africa International Press Limited de Heroes of Distinction Award hyɛɛ Quarm anuonyam.

Nsɛmnsɛm 
Wɔ afe 2016 mu no, Quarm kaa wɔ ne nwoma ‘Natural Science for Primary Schools – Pupil’s Book 1,’ mu sɛ wɔde onipa ti soa nnesoa. Kofi Bentil, IMANI Ghana Ɔmampanyin Abadiakyiri ne wɔn a wɔde social media di dwuma a ɔkae sɛ wonyi nhoma ahorow no mfi mfitiase sukuu ahorow mu no kasa tiaa no. Nnomasua Dwumadibea no yii asɛm bi adi kyerɛɛ sukuu ahorow a ɛwɔ Ghana sɛ ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔboa nhoma no.

N'ankasa abrabɔ 
Quarm yɛ Kristoni.

Baabi a Menyaa Mmoa Friiɛ

title: Ekow Hayford
text:
Ekow Hayford (a wɔwoo no 24 December 1970 - 9 October 2020) na ɔyɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne mmarahyɛbadwafie a ɛtɔ nson(7) wɔ Ghana adehyeman amammuo a ɛtɔ so nan no mu nipa a ɔgyina maa Mfantseman mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ mfinimfin mantam(Central Region) wɔ Ɔsono amanyɔkuo(New Patriotic Party) no din mu. Wɔkuu no wɔ Ahinime bosome da a ɛtɔ so nkron(9) wɔ mfeɛ mpem aduonu ne aduonu mu(2020). Na ɔsan so yɛ Apam bɔɔlbɔ kuo(Apam Football Club) no baanodani.

Abrabɔ ahyɛase ne nnwomasua 
Wɔwoo Hayford wɔ Ɔpɛnimma bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduonu-nan(24) wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduoson mu(1970) wɔ Mankessim, Central Region, Ghana. Na ɔyɛ ne maame Madam Mena Aba Attah ba koro pɛ. Na ɔwɔ Bachelor of Business Administration abodin krataa wɔ Methodist Sukuupɔn Kɔlege. Ɔsan nso nyaa Master of Business Administration (Supply Chain Management) abodin krataa wɔ Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration (GIMPA).

Adwuma ne amanyɔsɛm 
Hayford adwuma a edi kan ne Ghana Polisifo Dwumadibea, a ɔsom wɔ mu fi 1993 kosi 1998. Ɔkɔɔ soro koduu dibea sɛ Corporal. Ogyaee adwuma no na ɔkɔɔ ankorankoro nnwuma mu. Na ɔyɛ MODISA Lodge ne MANTRAC Ghana Limited adwumayɛfoɔ panin ne Manager ansa na ɔrekɔ amanyɔsɛm mu. Wɔ afe 2015 mu no, New Patriotic Party a ɛwɔ Mfantseman no ananmusifoɔ paw no sɛ ɔmmɛgyina akuo no ananmu wɔ afe 2016 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu. Ɔdii nkunim wɔ mmarahyɛbadwafie no mu de mma ɔha nkyɛmu aduanan nsia ne akyirepɔ aduowɔtwe mmienu (46.82%) wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu. Na ɔyɛ Atemmuo kuo mu nipa ne Ahobammɔ ne Mfinimfini kuo a ɛwɔ Mmarahyɛbadwafie no mu no mu nipa.

N'ankasa abrabɔ 
Hayford ware woo mma nan(4) na ɔyɛ Methodist asafo no asoreba. Ɛbaa abɔten sɛ ɔwɔ yerenom mmienu, Ophelia Quansah Hayford ne Sarah Quansah Hayford.

Ne wuo 
Wɔ Ahinime bosome da a ɛtɔ so nkron(9) wɔ mfeɛ mpem aduonu ne aduonu(2020), berɛ a ɔrefiri ɔsatuo akwantuo mu resan aba no, nnipa a wɔnnim no too Hayford tuo kum no.Wei sii wɔ Abeadze Dominase – Abeadze Duadzi – Mankessim kwan so bere a ofii ɔsatu akwantu bi mu resan aba no. Wɔbɔ amanneɛ sɛ ɔkwan kɛse so adwowtwafo baanum a wokurakura akode tow hyɛɛ no ​​so bɛyɛ Fida anɔpa 1:00. Amanneɛbɔ kyerɛ sɛ wɔ ɔkwan bi so no, wɔkyerɛe sɛ Hayford yɛ mmarahyɛbadwamni no wɔ adwowtwa no mu na adwowtwafo no de wɔn ani sii no so pɔtee na wɔtoo no tuo, na wɔde ɔhaw ahorow a nnipa a wɔwɔ ɔman no mu rehyia no ho asodi too no so.

Deɛ ɛfirii ne wuo no akyi baaeɛ 
Na ne yere Ophelia Hayford yɛ polisini kosii sɛ ne kunu wui. NPP amanyɔkuo no na wɔyii no sɛ ɔmmɛsi ne kunu ananmu sɛ ɔman no kandifoɔ wɔ Mfantseman atenaeɛ no mu wɔ afe 2020 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu. Ɛbɛdaa adi nso sɛ na Hayford wɔ yerenom baanu ankasa. Nea ɔtɔ so mmienu, Sarah Quansah Hayford, nso wɔ mma baanu na na ɔwɔ ayiyɛ amanne a edi kan a wɔyɛe wɔ Mankessim no ase.

Beaeɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Bright Wireko Brobbey
text:
Bright Wireko-Brobby (wɔwoo no 6 January 1972) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne mmarahyɛbadwafie a ɛtɔ so awɔtwe(8) wɔ Ghana adehyeman amammuo a ɛtɔ so nan no mu nipa a ɔregyina hɔ ama Hemang Lower Denkyire mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ mfinimfin mantam mu(Central Region) wɔ Ɔsono amanyɔkuo(New Patriotic Party) no din mu. Ɔsan yɛ asoafoɔ ɔhwɛ adwuma sɛm soɔ no abediakyire.

Abrabɔ ahyɛase ne nnwomasua 
Wɔwoo Wireko-Brobby  Ɔbɛnem bosome da a ɛtɔ ao nsia(6) wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduoson mmienu (1972) mu na ɔfiri Twifo Hemang wɔ Central Region wɔ Ghana.Ɔwɔ M.S.C wɔ Nhyehyɛeɛ mu ne L.L.B wɔ Mmara Sukuu mu wɔ Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology Suapɔn mu. Ɔtoaa so kɔɔ Dortmund Suapɔn mu baabi a ɔnyaa Postgraduate Diploma wɔ Spatial Planning mu.

Adwuma 
Wireko-Brobby ne nnwumakuo bi tesɛ  USAID, UNHCR ne UNDP ayɛ adwuma. Ɔsan so ne Ghana Education Service yɛɛ adwuma. Na ɔsan so yɛ Community Empowerment Associates kuo no executive Director.

N'abrabɔ 
Wireko-Brobby yɛ Kristoni.

Beaeɛ menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Samiu Kwadwo Nuamah
text:
Samiu Kwadwo Nuamah yɛ Ghana nhomanimfoɔ,  ne amanyɔni. Ɔyɛ Ɔsono kokroko amanyɔkuo (New Patriotic Party -NPP) no mu ni na ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔwɔ hɔ mprempren yi ma Kwadaso Mansini no.

Abrabɔ ahyaseɛ 
Wɔwoo Nuamah wɔ Kitawonsa da a ɛtɔ so aduonu-num, na ofiri Tanoso, Kumasi kurotia a ɛwɔ Asante mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔwɔ engineering doctorate (EngD) ne master's degree wɔ The University of Nottingham UK ne Cranfield University UK, na ɛno akyi no ɔmaa ɔkasa wɔ University of Ghana ansa na ɔrehyɛn mmarahyɛ bagua mu wɔ mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne du-nson (2017) mu.

2015 mmarahyɛbadwafie 
Wɔ Ayɛwohomumɔ , mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne du-num (2015 ) mu no, Nuamah sii akan wɔ amansin mu mfitiaseɛ abatoɔ no mu a na ɔwɔ anidasoɔ sɛ ɔbɛnya abatoɔ a ɛdɔɔso a ɛbɛma watumi asi akan wɔ amansin no mmarahyɛ bagua abatoɔ no mu. Nnipa baanum afoforo a nea odi tumi mprempren Owusu Afriyie Akoto ne Josephine Hilda Addo a na anka ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni ma ɔmantam no ka ho na wɔpere abatow no. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ no mu de abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 191.

2016 amansan abatoɔ 
Wɔ abatoɔ 68541 a wɔtoo wɔ Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu no, Nuamah dii nkonim. Ɔnyaa mma no mu bɛyɛ ɔha nkyekyem aduɔkron ne akyire (90%,) na ɔboroo n'akansifoɔ Monica Buamah a ɔfiri Kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo (National Democratic Congress-NDC) , David Akwasi Adongo a ɔfiri (People’s National Convention-PNC) ne Kwame Boateng Antwi a ɔfiri (Convention People’s Party -CPP) mu sɛ ɔngyinaa mu ma adehyeɛ a wɔwɔ  Kwadaso mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Mmarahyɛbadwa no.

N'ankasa abrabɔ 
Nuamah aware Nana Akosua Serwaa Nuamah na ɔne no wɔ abofra baako.

Baabi a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Daniel Okyem Aboagye
text:
Daniel Okyem Aboagye (Ɔpɛnimaa da a ɛtɔ so aduasa-baako, afe Apem, Ahankron ne Aduɔson -mmiɛnsa (1973 ) Ɛbɔ da a ɛtɔ so aduonu-mmeɛnsa, mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne aduano-mmiensa -2023) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson wɔ Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nan no mu ni. Ɔgyinaa Bantama Mansin ananmu wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ ɔsono kokroko ammanyɔkuo (New Patriotic Party-NPP)  tekiti so

Abrabɔ ahyaseɛ ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Aboagye wɔ Atwima Boko mu wɔ Asante Mantam mu,  Ghana wɔ (Ɔpɛnimaa da a ɛtɔ so aduasa-baako, afe Apem, Ahankron ne Aduɔson -mmeɛnsa (1973).

Aboagye suaa adeɛ wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu baabi a ɔnyaa bachelor’s degree wɔ (Business Administration) mu. Owiee sukuu wɔ mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne mmienu (2002) mu a na ɔwɔ (MBA)ne( MIS )wɔ Akontaabu mu wɔ Troy Sukuupɔn, Alabama, U.S.A. Okyem Aboagye nyaa adansedie wɔ mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Mmeɛnsa ( 2003) mu sɛ ɔman akontabufoɔ wɔ (Certified Public Accountant of USA).

Adwumayɛ 
Aboagye hyɛɛ n’adwuma ase sɛ SINAPI ABA TRUST sikakorabea sohwɛfo wɔ afe Apem , Ahankron ne Aduɔkron-nwɔtwe(1998). Akyire yi, ɔbɛyɛɛ (Opportunity International) adwuma sohwɛfo wɔ mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Mmeɛnsa (2003)– mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Nsia (2006). Okyem Aboagye bɛyɛɛ (Globe Union ) sikasɛm sohwɛfoɔ wɔ U.S. ne MGI Microfinance baanodani wɔ afe (2008–2012 )mu. Na ɔyɛ ( 2M Express Transport Services) no kwankyerɛfo panin.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔ afe 2015 mu no ɔsii akan na odii nkonim wɔ NPP mmarahyɛbadwa primaries mu maa Bantama (Ghana mmarahyɛ bagua mantam) wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ saa mmarahyɛbadwa  atenaeɛ yi mu wɔ afe 2016 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu. Wɔ June 2020 mu no, ɔdii nkoguo wɔ mmɔden a ɔbɔeɛ sɛ ɔbɛgyina New Patriotic Party ananmu no akyi berɛ a ɔdii nkoguo wɔ primaries mu wɔ Francis Asenso-Boakye a seesei ɔyɛ mmarahyɛ baguani ma Bantama (Ghana parliament constituency).

Abadwakuo ahodoɔ 
Aboagye yɛɛ Sikasɛm ne Sikasɛm abadwakuo no mu ni wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson wɔ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nan no mu ni. Aboagye waree a ɔwɔ mma.

N'ankasa abrabɔ 
Aboagye wui wɔ Komfo Anokye Nkyerɛkyerɛ Ayaresabea wɔ ɛbɔ bosome no da a ɛtɔ so aduonu mmiensa wɔ afe mpem mmieniu ne aduonu mmiensa (2023) mu, bere a na wadi mfe 49.

Baabi a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ 

Ateasefoɔ
Mmarahyɛbadwani

title: Eric Opoku
text:
Eric Opoku (born on 5th June, 1970) yɛ Ghana manyɔni ne Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson ne Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nwɔtwe a ɛwɔ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nnan no muni a ɔgyina Asunafo South abatoɔ mpasua no ananmu wɔ Brong-Ahafo Mantam mu wɔ  National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ ne Nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Eric Opoku wɔ Ɔbɛnem bosome no da a ɛtɔ so num wɔ afe 1970 mu. Ɔfiri kuro bi a wɔfrɛ no Sankore a ɛwɔ Brong Ahafo mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔnyaa ne Bachelor of Arts abodin krataa wɔ Social Science mu wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma mu wɔ afe 2004 mu.

Adwuma 
Opoku yɛ okuani. Ansa na wɔrepaw no sɛ ɔnyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani no, ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ wɔ Ghana Nhomasua Dwumadibea wɔ SDA Mfitiaseɛ Sukuu a ɛwɔ Sankore, firi afe 1997 kɔsi afe 2000.Ɔne Kuapa Kookoo Ltd nso ayɛ adwuma sɛ Asafo Nkɔsoɔ Ɔkyerɛwfoɔ firi afe 1998 kɔsi afe 2001.

Amammui mu adwuma 
Wɔdii kan paw Opoku sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa mu sɛ mmarahyɛ badwa no muni ma Asunafo North mansini a ɛwɔ Brong Ahafo mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɛwom sɛ ɔhweree n’akonwa wɔ abatoɔ a ɛdi hɔ no mu deɛ, nanso wɔsan paw no sɛ mmarahyɛbadwa no muni wɔ  Ɔbɛnem 7, 2013 berɛ a ɔkaa sɛ ɔdii nkonim wɔ afe 2012 Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ no mu sɛ ɔgyina Asunafo Anafoɔ mantam ananmu na ɔdii dwuma kɔsii 6 Ɔbɛnem 2017. Afei wɔsan paw no bio wɔ 7 Ɔbɛnem 2017 akyi wɔ afe 2016 Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ a ɔnyaa abatoɔ a ɛfata no mu 52.97%.

Wayɛ adwuma sɛ Brong Ahafo Ɔmantam Ɔsoafoɔ Abadiakyiri firi afe 2009 kɔsi afe 2013. Wɔ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmarahyɛ badwa a ɛtɔ so nson mu no ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ Aduan, Kuadwuma ne Kokoo Nsɛm Boayikuo mu sɛ Ɔmanpanyin a ɔdi kan. Ɔsan nso yɛɛ Hokwan Boayikuw ne Nnipa a Wɔpaw Wɔn Boayikuw no mu wɔ mmarahyɛ bagua koro no ara mu.

Opoku nyaa abasobɔdeɛ sɛ mmarahyɛ baguani a ɔsen biara wɔ mpɔtam ne nkuraaseɛ nkɔsoɔ ho wɔ afe 2017 mu firii Bureau of Research on Governance, Commerce and Administration (BORGCA) hɔ. Wɔde saa abasobɔdeɛ yi maeɛ wɔ ne mmoa a ɔde maeɛ wɔ nkɔsoɔ nnwuma mu wɔ Asunafo Anafoɔ mantam mu.

Abatoɔ 
Wɔ to aba ma Opoku sɛ mmarahyɛ baguani maa Asunafo Anafo mantam a ɛwɔ Brong Ahafo mantam mu wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow mu. Odii nkunim wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so. Na ne mansin no yɛ mmarahyɛ bagua nkongua 10 no fã wɔ nkongua 24 a National Democratic Congress dii wɔ saa abatow no mu maa Brong Ahafo Mantam no mu. Asunafo South mantam no hunuu ‘skirt and blouse’ a abatoɔfoɔ too aba wɔ saa abatoɔ no mu ɛfiri sɛ ɔmampanyin a wɔpaw no a amansin mu abatoɔfoɔ no paw no ne John Kufour a ɔfiri ɔsɔretia kɛseɛ New Patriotic Party mu. National Democratic Congress dii nkonim kakraa bi a ne nyinaa yɛ mmarahyɛ bagua nkongua 94 wɔ nkongua 230 mu wɔ saa abatow no mu. Wɔde abatoɔ 14,076 na ɛpaw Opoku wɔ abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 29,345, a ɛne abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 48% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen George William Amponsah a ofi Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no mu, Jack Kennedy Brobbey a ɔyɛ ɔkannifo a ɔde ne ho ne Fredrick Nkrumah a ofi Nhyiam Nnipa Kuw no mu. Eyinom nyaa abatow a ɛfata nyinaa mu 43.80%, 7.30% ne 0.90%.

Wɔsan paw Opoku wɔ afe 2020 Mmarahyɛ Bagua abatow mu sɛ ɔmmɛgyina wɔn ananmu wɔ Ghana Republic of anan no Mmarahyɛ Bagua a ɛtɔ so 8 no mu.

Tu hyɛ soɔ 
Wɔtow hyɛɛ Opoku so wɔ ne tenabea wɔ 25 December 2017 wɔ Sankore wɔ Brong Ahafo mantam mu wɔ Ghana. National Democratic Congress bɔɔ sobo sɛ na ntuafo no yɛ wɔn a wokurakura akode a wɔtaa asɔretiafo New Patriotic Party no akyi. Wɔtow hyɛɛ no ​​so ne mprenu so, wɔ 1 April 2018, nso wɔ ne fie wɔ Sankore a mmarima a wokurakura akode. Ɛwom sɛ wɔanpira ntuafo no de, wɔkyerɛ sɛ wɔde bɛyɛ GHS 10,400.00, television ne decoder bi kɔe na wɔsɛee Opoku kar abiɛsa.

Ankorankora asetena 
Opoku yɛ Kristoni. Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baanan.

Bɛbia Mmoa Efiri

title: Kwaku Agyeman Kwarteng
text:
Kwaku Agyemang Kwarteng (wɔwoo no Ɔgyefoɔ 12, 1969) yɛ Ghana aban 
mfiridwumayɛfoɔ (civil engineer), sikasɛm ho ɔbenfoɔ (economist), ne amanyɔni. Ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔdi mfeɛ mmienu wɔ Obuasi Anafoɔ Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa mu wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo (New Patriotic Party) no muni na ɔyɛ sikasɛm ɔsoafoɔ abadiakyiri (deputy minister of finance).

Abrabɔ

Ne mmɔfrase abrabɔ 
Wɔwoo Kwaku Kwarteng wɔ Ɔgyefoɔ bosome da a ɛtɔ so dummiɛnu (12), afe 1969, wɔ Kokofu wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔkɔɔ Kwame Nkrumah Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma Suapɔn (Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology) a ɛwɔ Kumasi a ɛbɛn hɔ no, baabi a onyaa Nyansahu mu Bachelor abodin krataa wɔ aban mfiridwuma mu (Bachelor of Science degree in civil engineering) wɔ afe 1996 mu. Akyiri yi onyaa Nyansahu mu Ɔbenfo abodin krataa nso wɔ aban mfiridwuma ho nimdeɛ mu (Master of Science degree also in civil engineering) wɔ suapɔn koro no ara mu wɔ afe 2013 mu. Ɔsan nso wɔ M.A. wɔ Sikasɛm ho nhyehyɛeɛ mu (M.A. in Economic Policy Management) wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu (University of Ghana) wɔ afe 2009 mu.

Adwumayɛ 
Kwaku Kwarteng adwumayɛ asetra mu dodow no ara ayɛ amanyɔsɛm. Ɔyɛɛ Ghana Aban kasamafoɔ (Government of Ghana spokesperson) wɔ sikasɛm ho (finance) firi afe 2006 kosi afe 2009. Bere a John Agyekum Kufour aban no gyaee tumidi wɔ afe 2009 mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ nhyehyɛe ho ɔfotufo (policy advisor) maa Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo (New Patriotic Party) firi afe 2010 kosi afe 2013.

Wɔ afe 2011 mu no wɔpaw no sɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo (New Patriotic Party) kandifo sɛ ɔnkɔsi akan wɔ Obuasi Anafoɔ Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa a wɔabɔ no foforo no mu. Wɔ afe 2012 Amansan abatoɔ mu no, ɔne John Alexander Ackon a ofiri Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛ Badwa (National Democratic Congress), Abubakar Sadick Iddris a ofiri Nnipa Kuw a Ɛkɔ Nkɔso (Progressive People’s Party), Aishetu Tahiru a ofiri Ɔman Demokrasi Kuw (National Democratic Party), Mohammed Issifu a ɔfiri People’s National Convention, ne Isaac Fordjour a ɔde ne ho no sii akan (Independent candidate). Kwarteng nyaa amba 31,101 wɔ abatoɔ 48,254 a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ no mu, a ɛyɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 64.45%. Bere a ɔwɔ mmarahyɛ badwa mu no, wasom wɔ boayikuw ahorow pii mu a Nkitahodi Boayikuw (Communications Committee) ne Ohia a Wɔtew So Ho Nhyehyɛe Boayikuw ka ho (Poverty Reduction Strategy Committee).

Wɔ bosome Ɔpɛpɔn afe 2017 mu no, Ɔmanpanyin Nana Akufo-Addo yii Kwarteng ne Charles Adu Boahen sɛ wɔnyɛ sikasɛm soafoɔ abadiakyiri (deputy ministers of finance). Na ɛsɛ sɛ wɔyɛ adwuma wɔ Ken Ofori-Atta ase. Mmarahyɛ Badwa no Boayikuo a ɛpaw Kwarteng no hwehwɛɛ mu wɔ bosome Ɔbɛnem afe 2017 mu. Bere a wɔreyɛ ne nhwehwɛmu no, ɔkae sɛ John Dramani Mahama nniso no agyaw cedis ɔpepepem nson (7 billion cedis) a aka a wontuae wɔ ahyehyɛde ahorow a ɛwɔ ɔman no mu no. Nnipa kakraa bi kuw (The minority) no buu asɛm no animtiaa kae sɛ ɛka a ɛte saa biara nni hɔ. Kwarteng nso san kaa ɔpɛ a aban no wɔ sɛ ɔbɛtew mfɛntom (interest rate) no so. Boayikuw no penee so maa dibea a wɔpaw no sɛ ɔnyɛ no.

Wɔ afe 2016 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu no, ɔde amba 32,049 dii nkonim wɔ mmarahyɛ badwa no mu bere a NDC mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ John Alexander Ackon nyaa amba 11,587.

Wɔ afe 2020 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu no, ɔde amba 33,383 dii nkonim wɔ mmarahyɛ badwa no mu bere a NDC mmarahyɛbaguani a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ Faustilove Appiah Kannin nyaa amba 15,141.

Ɔsan nso yɛ Ɔsoafoɔ Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Sikasɛm so (Deputy Minister for Finance).

Boayikuo ahodoɔ 
Ɔsomm sɛ Sikasɛm Boayikuw (Finance Committee) no muni na ɔsan nso yɛɛ Ohia a Wɔtew So Boayikuw (Poverty Reduction Committee) no mu. Bere a ɔwɔ mmarahyɛ badwa mu no, wasom wɔ boayikuw ahorow pii mu a Nkitahodi Boayikuw (Communications Committee) ka ho. Mprempren ɔyɛ Sikasɛm Boayikuw (Finance Committee) no Titenani (Chairperson ) na ɔsan yɛ Nkitahodi Boayikuw no muni.

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Kwarteng aware a ɔwɔ mma mmiɛnsa (3). Ɔyɛ Katolekni.

Baabi a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Adjei Mensah
text:
Isaac Adjei Mensah yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ na ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanin a ɛtɔ so nnan Mmarahyɛ Bagua a ɛtɔ so nson no muni a ɔgyina Wassa Apueeɛ Mantam a ɛwɔ Atɔeɛ Mantam no ananmu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Abrabɔ Ashasiɛ ni Adesua 
Wɔwoo Isaac Adjei Mensah wɔ Yawda 26 Oforisuo 1963. Ɔfiri Dompim Number 1, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Atɔeɛ Mantam mu. Ɔkɔɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu wɔ afe 1988 mu na onyaa ne bachelor’s degree wɔ Sociology mu wɔ afe 1991. Akyiri yi ɔkɔɔ Tromsø Suapɔn, Norway wɔ afe 1992 mu kɔyɛɛ n’adesua akyi adesua. Ɔwiee sukuu wɔ afe 1997 mu a na ɔwɔ ne MBA wɔ Ɔmanfoɔ Nhyehyɛeɛ mu.

Adwuma 
Ansa na ɔrekɔ amammuisɛm mu no, na Isaac yɛ Ɔmantam Nnipa Nnwuma sohwɛfoɔ wɔ Newmont Ghana Limited firi afe 2006 kɔsi afe 2012.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Isaac Adjei Mensah yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛ Bagua (NDC) no muni.Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔsii akan maa Wassa Apueeɛ nkongua no wɔ NDC tekiti so na ɔdii nkonim. Wɔsan paw no bio wɔ afe 2016 mu sɛ ɔmmɛgyina amansin no ananmu wɔ aban a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmarahyɛ bagua a ɛtɔ so nson no mu. Wɔ mmarahyɛ bagua mu no wasom wɔ boayikuw ahorow mu, a emu bi ne; Nhomasua Boayikuw, Fie Boayikuw ne Budget Boayikuw Titiriw.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baanum na ɔkyerɛ sɛ ɔyɛ Kristoni na ɔyɛ Pentekoste Asɔre no muni.

Bɛbia Mmoa Efiri

title: Nana Ayew Afriyie
text:
Dr. Nana Ayew Afriye yɛ Ghana amanyɔni na ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so nson (7) a 
ɛwɔ Ghana Amansin a ɛtɔ so anan no muni a ogyina Effiduase-Asokore Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa ananmu wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuo Foforɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so.

Ne mmofraase abrabɔ ne nomasua 
Wɔwoo Afriye wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da a ɛtɔ so aduonu mmienu (22) 1978 na ofiri Effiduase wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Wɔ afe 2004 mu no, onyaa ne Bachelor wɔ Aduruyɛ ne Bachelor wɔ Oprehyɛn Ho Ɔbenfo mu (Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery) wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu (University of Ghana) na ɔsan nso nyaa Post Graduate abodin krataa wɔ Akwahosan Sikasɛm (Post Graduate Certificate in Health Economics) mu wɔ Oxford Suapɔn mu (Oxford University). Wɔ afe 2009 mu no, ɔsan nyaa ne MA wɔ Sikasɛm ho nhyehyɛe sohwɛ mu (MA in Economics Policy Management) wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu. Wɔ afe 2011 mu no, onyaa ne MPH wɔ Akwahosan Sikasɛm mu wɔ Leeds Suapɔn mu (University of Leeds) a ɛwɔ United Kingdom (UK).

Adwuma 
Na Afriye yɛ St. Johns Ayaresabea ne Awo a ɛwɔ Tantra Hills wɔ Accra no panyin (CEO - St. Johns Hospital and Fertility). Ɔsan nso yɛ Ɔmanfoɔ Akwahosan Asoɛeɛ Titenani (Head Institutional Public Health) wɔ Ridge Ayaresabea (Ridge Hospital).

Amanyɔsɛm 
Afriye yɛ New Patriotic Party no muni na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma Effiduase-Asokore Mmrahyɛbadwam mpɛsoa wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu.

Boayikuw ahorow 
Afriye yɛ Akwahosan Boayikuo no Titenani (Chairperson for the Health Committee) na ɔsan yɛ Sikasɛm Boayikuo no muni (member of the Finance Committee).

N'abrabɔ mu nsɛm 
Afriye yɛ Kristoni. Ɔwɔ mma baasa (3).

Ntotoho

title: Ali Maiga Halidu
text:
Ali Maiga Halidu yɛ Ghana amanyɔni na ɔyɛ Ghana Mantam a ɛtɔ so nnan no Mmarahyɛbadwani a ɛtɔ so nson no muni a ɔgyina Dormaa West Mansin ananmu wɔ Brong-Ahafo Mantam mu wɔ   Ɔsono kokroko amanyɔkuo tekiti so.

Wɔwoo Ali Maiga Halidu wɔ Oforisuo 11, afe 1980. Ɔfiri Nkrankwanta, wɔ Brong Ahafo Mantam mu.

Nwomasua 
Halidu nyaa ne bachelor’s degree wɔ Cape Coast Suapɔn mu; afei ɔtoaa ne nwomasua so nyaa Nyansapɛ mu Ɔbenfo wɔ Cambridge wɔ United Kingdom abrotsi mman mu.

Adwuma 
Halidu yɛɛ adwuma sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ boafoɔ wɔ Cape Coast Suapɔn mu afe baako na afei ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ a ɔyɛ adwuma wɔ Ghana Education Service afe baako firi afe 2006 kɔsi afe 2007. Ɔbɛyɛɛ mmara sohwɛfoɔ maa aduane ne kuayɛ adwumakuo mfeɛ mmiɛnsa. Mprempren ɔyɛ nkɔso ho ɔfotufo ne bere nyinaa amanyɔni.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔ afe 2016 amansan abatoɔ mu no Halidu sii akan na ɔdii nkonim wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa no mu maa Dormaa West Constituency wɔ Brong-Ahafo Mantam mu, wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so. Ɔnyaa abatoɔ 8,422 wɔ abatoɔ 16,725 a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ a egyina hɔ ma abatoɔ no mu 50.88%.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ali Maiga Halidu aware a ɔwɔ mma ennum.

Bɛbia Mmoa Efiri

title: Francisca Oteng Mensah
text:
Francisca Oteng-Mensah (wɔwoo no Ɔgyefoɔ da ɛtɔ so du nan wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron mmiɛnsa 1993) yɛ amanyɔkuo New Patriotic Party no mu ni ne mmarahyɛbɛdwani a ɔgyina hɔ ma Kwabre Apueɛ mpɛsoa so, ɔno ne mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔsua koraa wɔ mmarahyɛbadwakuo a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia mu (2016).

Abrabɔ mfitiaseɛ 
Wɔwoo Oteng-Mensah wɔ Aboaso Ayaresabea wɔ Mamponten, a ɛwɔ Asante Mantam mu, wɔ Ɔgyefoɔ da ɛtɔ so du nnan wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduokron mmiɛnsa (February 14,1993). N’awofoɔ ne Owura yere Joyce Oteng ne Dr. Kwaku oteng a ɔyɛ dɔkota ne dwadini, a ɔsane so yɛ ɔkwankyerɛfoɔ ma adwumakuo a ne din de Angel Group of Companies.

Nwomasua 
Oteng-Mensah kɔɔ mfiaseɛ sukuu ahodoɔ mmiɛnsa. Ɔkɔɔ sukuu a ne din de Manponteng Roman Catholic Sukuu, afei ɔkɔɔ Revival Preparatory sukuu a ɛwɔ Breman. Owie ne mfiaseɛ sukuu no wɔ Savior International School. Ɔwie ne JHS wɔ Angel Education Complex. Ɔtoaa so kɔɔ St. Roses Senior High School, faako a ɔwie ne ntoasoɔ sukuu.

Ne botaeɛ a ɛne sɛ ɔbɛsua ade akɔ akyi no boaa no ma no toaa so kɔɔ suapɔn a ɛne Kwame Nkrumah University (KNUST) maa no kɔsuaa mmara. Francisca sii abatoɔ akansie no wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia (2016) mu berɛ a na ɔwɔ ne mfeɛ mmienu soɔ wɔ Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology. Ɔwɔ ne mfie mmienu soo wo Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology.

Adwumayɛ 
Ansa na ɔbɛyɛ mmarahyɛ badwani no, na ɔyɛ ɔtwerɛfoɔ ma adwumakuo a ɛne Angel Group of Companies a ɛwɔ Kumasi. Wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa bosome no mu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nson (2017) mu no, wɔpaw no sɛ ɔtitenani ma adwumakuo a ɛne National Youth Authority.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ɔdii nkunim wɔ Kwabre Apueɛ abatoɔ mpɛsoa so a ɛwɔ Asante Mantam mu sɛ mmarahyebadwani wɔ abatoɔ a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ mfeɛ mpem dmmienu ne du nsia (2016).

Ɔsom 
Oteng-Mensah yɛ Kristoni a ɔsom wɔ Asembles of God asore.

Mmeaeɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ 

Ghanaian Mp's 5th Parliament of the 4th Republic

title: Gabriel Osei
text:
Gabriel Kweku Osei yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ ne Ghana Ɔmanpanin a ɛtɔ so nnan Mmarahyɛ Bagua a ɛtɔ so nson no muni a ɔgyina Tain Mansin ananmu wɔ Brong-Ahafo Mantam mu wɔ New Patriotic Party tekiti so. Mprempren, ɔyɛ Adwumayɛ Nkɔso sohwɛfo ma Ɔman Ɔsom Nhyehyɛe Dwumadibea Ti.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Osei wɔ June 2, 1974 na ofi Badu a ɛwɔ Brong Ahafo Mantam a na ɛwɔ hɔ saa bere no, mprempren Bono Mantam mu. Ɔnyaa ne Bachelor of Science abodin krataa wɔ sikasɛm mu wɔ Katolek Suapɔn Kɔlege a ɛwɔ Fiapre wɔ afe 2008. Na ɔwɔ ne adansedi krataa nso wɔ Executive Master of Business Administration (CEMBA) mu wɔ KNUST.

Adwumayɛ 
Na Osei yɛ sikasɛm sohwɛfoɔ wɔ St. Ambrose College of Education wɔ Dormaa Akwamu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Osei yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni. Ɔyɛ kan MP a ɔhwɛ Tain Mantam so wɔ Bono Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Wɔ afe 2020 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu no ɔhweree n'akongua no maa Adama Sulemana. Ɔnyaa abatoɔ 18,346 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 40.87%.

Adɔeyɛ 
Wɔ Ɔkɔtɔberɛ 2020 mu no, ɔde semɛnte nkotokuo bɛyɛ 150 maeɛ sɛ ɛbɛboa wɔ Brodi Senior High School ne Polisifoɔ Dwumadibea a wɔbɛsi wɔ mpɛsoa so.

N'ankasa Abrabɔ 
Osei yɛ Kristoni.

Mmeaeɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ 

Ghanaian Mp's 5th Parliament of the 4th Republic

title: Ambre Samuel
text:
Samuel Ambre (wɔwoo no 1 Oforisuo 1972) yɛ Ghana Aman a ɛtɔ so nnan no Mmarahyɛ Bagua a Ɛto so Nsia no muni a ɔgyina Assin Atifi fam ananmu wɔ Ghana Mfinimfini mantam mu.

Abrabɔ Ashasiɛ ni Adesua 
Wɔwoo Ambre wɔ 1 March 1972 wɔ Oppong Bon mu wɔ Ghana Atɔeɛ mantam mu. Ɔwɔ abodin krataa wɔ nhomasua mu wɔ Mmofra Hwɛ ne Nkɔso mu wɔ Nhomasua Sukuupɔn, Winneba.

Adwuma 
Ambre yɛ nhomasua ho ɔbenfo. Ansa na ɔrebɛyɛ Ghana Mmarahyɛbadwa no muni no, na ɔyɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo wɔ Twifo Praso Mfitiase Sukuu a ɛwɔ Twifo Praso.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ɔyɛ Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛbadwa (NDC) no muni. Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, Ambre sii akan wɔ afe 2012 Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ no mu wɔ NDC tekiti ase na ɔdii nkonim, na ɛmaa no hokwan sɛ ɔgyina Assin North mantam no ananmu. Ɔnyaa abatoɔ 14,338 a ɛgyina hɔ ma abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoeɛ no mu 51.64% na ɛno nti ɔdii akansifoɔ afoforɔ a Ebenezer Appiah-Kubi, Akakpo John Gameley, Sanni Mahama ne Daniel Gibson Gyetuan ka ho no so nkonim.

Nanso, berɛ a ɔsii akan wɔ afe 2016 Ghana Amansan abatoɔ no mu no, ɔdii nkoguo wɔ Abena Durowaa Mensah a ɔfiri New Patriotic Party mu no anim ma enti wantumi annya hokwan a ɛtɔ so mmienu sɛ ɔbɛgyina ne mansin ananmu.

Ankorankora asetena 
Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baasa. Ɔyɛ Kristoni (Methodist).

Bɛbia Mmoa Efiri

title: Charles Konadu-Yiadom
text:
Charles Konadu-Yiadom yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ ne Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so nson a ɛwɔ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nan no muni a ɔgyina Nkoranza South Constituency ananmu wɔ Bono East Region wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Konadu-Yiadom wɔ  kɔtɔnimaa bosome no da a ɛtɔ so aduonu nan wɔ afe apem ahankron aduosia nwɔtwe mu (1968) na ɔfiri Nkoranza a ɛwɔ Bono Apueeɛ Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔnyaa ne Diploma wɔ Demokrase, Aban, Akannifoɔ ne Nkɔsoɔ mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu.

Adwumayɛ 
Konadu-Yiadom na na ɔyɛ Ɔkwankyerɛfo wɔ Brite Life Microfinance.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Konadu-Yiadom yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni . Ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni wɔ Nkoranza South Constituency firi afe 2017 kɔsi afe 202.

2016 abatoɔ 
Wɔ afe 2016 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu no, ɔdii nkonim wɔ mmarahyɛ bagua no mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 22,300 a ɛyɛɛ 50.7% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu berɛ a NDC mmarahyɛ baguani Emmanuel Kwadwo Agyekum nyaa abatoɔ 21,315 a ɛyɛɛ 48.5% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu, PPP mmarahyɛ bagua kandifoɔ Emmanuel Osei Antwi na ɔwɔ abatoɔ 227 a ɛyɛɛ 0.5% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu, CPP mmarahyɛ bagua kandifoɔ Justice Baah Mathuselah nyaa abatoɔ 100 a ɛyɛɛ 0.2% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu, PNC mmarahyɛ bagua kandifoɔ Florence Ampour nyaa abatoɔ 25 a ɛyɛɛ 0.1% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu.

2020 abatoɔ 
Wɔ afe 2020 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu no, ɔhweree mmarahyɛ bagua no nkongua no maa NDC mmarahyɛ bagua no muni Emmanuel Kwadwo Agyekum. Konadu-Yiadom nyaa abatoɔ 22,219 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ 43.04% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu berɛ a NDC mmarahyɛ baguani kandifoɔ Emmanuel Kwadwo Agyekum nyaa abatoɔ 29,408 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoo no nyinaa mu 56.96%, PNC mmarahyɛ baguani kandifoɔ Florence Ampour nyaa abatoɔ 0 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ no nyinaa mu 0% to.

N'ankasa Abrabɔ 
Konadu-Yiadom yɛ Kristoni.

Adɔeyɛ 
Wɔ afe 2018 mu no, ɔde aduane maa BECE abatoɔfoɔ a wɔwɔ ne mantam mu wɔ sɔhwɛ berɛ no mu. Ɔsan nso de pon bɛyɛ 200 maa Nkoranza Senior High Technical School.

Wɔ afe 2019 mu no, ɔsan nso de bɛyɛ GHS 26,000.00 maeɛ de boaa borehole a wɔbɛsi ama Nkoranza Senior High Technical School.

Akyinnyegye 
Wɔ November 2017 mu no, wɔkyerɛe sɛ Konadu-Yiadom too tuo guu Diana Attaa Kissiwaa a na ɔyɛ Nkoranza Municipal Chief Executive saa bere no so wɔ social media so. Akyiri yi Ghana Polisifoɔ no poo saa nsɛm no.

Mmeaeɛ A Menyaa Mmoa Firiiɛ 
Ghanaian Mp's 5th Parliament of the 4th Republic

title: Hanna Serwaa Tetteh
text:
Hanna Serwaa Tetteh (wɔwoo no 31 kɔtɔnimaa 1967)yɛ Ghana mmaranimfo ne ɔmanyɛfo.Ɔdii Ghana aban mu sɛ Ɔmanpanin a ɔhwɛ Aguadiɛ ne Nnwuma so firi afe 2009 kɔsi afe 2013ne Ɔmanpanin a ɔhwɛ amannɔne nsɛm so firi afe 2013 kɔsi afe 2017.Ɔsan nso yɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni ma Awutu-Senya Atɔeɛ mantam. Mprempren ɔsom sɛ Amanaman Nkabom Ɔkyerɛwfo Panyin no Ɔnanmusifo Titiriw a ɔhwɛ Afrika Abɛn no so.

Abrabɔ Ashasiɛ ni Adesua 

Wɔwoo Tetteh wɔ Szeged, Hungary, na n’agya yɛ Ghana na ne maame yɛ Hungary. Ne ntoaso sukuu wɔ Wesley Girls’ High School, Cape Coast, wɔ Central Region of Ghana, fi afe 1978 kosi 1985. Wɔ afe 1986 ne 1989 ntam no, osuaa mmara wɔ Ghana Sukuupɔn mu, ɛhɔ na onyaa Bachelor of Law (LL. B) abodin krataa.[6] Afei ɔkɔɔ Ghana Mmara Sukuu, na ɔbɛyɛɛ mmaranimfoɔ wɔ afe 1992 mu.

Adwuma 
Tetteh yɛɛ ne Ɔman Dwumadi sɛ Mmaranimfo wɔ Amanaman Ntam Mmea Mmaranimfo Fekuw (FIDA) fi 1992 kosi 1993. Bere a owiee ne Ɔman Dwumadi no ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ Private legal practice mu wɔ Law firm Ansa-Asare and Company, a ɛwɔ Hencil Chambers wɔ Accra, Ghana.

Mfeɛ mmienu a ɔde yɛɛ kokoam mmara adwuma akyi no, Tetteh kɔkaa Commission on Human Rights and Administrative Justice ho sɛ Mmaranimfoɔ, nanso akyiri yi saa afe no ara mu no, ɔde ne ho kɔbɔɔ Ghana Agro Food Company (GAFCO) sɛ Mmara ho Ɔfotufoɔ; Na GAFCO yɛ adwumakuw a wɔyɛ nnuan a wɔyɛ awi esiam, nkokɔ ne mmoa aduan, mpataa a wɔayam ne tuna a wɔde ahyɛ toa mu. Adwumakuw no nso dii nnuan ne mmoa ho nneɛma afoforo ho gua na na ɛwɔ Tema Hyɛn Gyinabea Mpɔtam wɔ Temana ɔwɔ adwumayɛfo dibea afoforo wɔ adwumakuw no mu a ɛne Nnipa Nnwuma ne Mmara Dwumadibea sohwɛfo na ɛno akyi no, Ɔhwɛfo Panyin Abadiakyiri (Sikasɛm ne Adwumayɛ sohwɛfo kosii sɛ ɔkɔɔ kɔɔ amammuisɛm mu wɔ afe 2000. Bere a ɔdii dwuma wɔ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no mu akyi no, wansi akan ntɛm ara sɛ wɔbɛsan apaw no bio na ɔsan kɔkaa GAFCO ho sɛ General Manager (Corporate, Administration and Legal) baabi a ɔyɛɛ adwuma kosii December 2009.

Efi afe 2019 no, ɔyɛɛ Amanaman Nkabom no Ɔkyerɛwfo Panyin no Ananmusifo Titiriw wɔ Afrika Aman Nkabom Kuw no mu ne Amanaman Nkabom Dwumadibea a ɛwɔ Afrika Aman Nkabom Kuw (UNOAU) no Titenani.

Mprempren Hannah Tetteh resom sɛ Amanaman Nkabom Ɔkyerɛwfo Panyin Ɔnanmusifo Titiriw a ɔhwɛ Afrika Abɛn no so.

Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ Aguadi ne Nnwuma so, 2009–2013

NDC nkonimdie akyi wɔ afe 2008 abatoɔ mu no Tetteh bɛyɛɛ Aban a wɔapaw no foforɔ no kasamafoɔ berɛ a na nhyehyɛeɛ a wɔde bɛpaw nnipa foforɔ no rekɔ so na wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2009 mu no, Ɔmanpanin John Atta Mills yii no sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ Aguadi ne Nnwuma so. Wɔ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no si so dua akyi no ɔgyee adwuma no na ɔdii dibea sɛ Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ Aguadi ne Nnwuma so firi Ɔpɛpɔn 2009 kɔsii Ɔpɛpɔn 2013.

Bere a na ɔyɛ Aguadi ne Nnwuma ho Ɔsoafo no na ɔsan yɛ Aban no sikasɛm sohwɛ kuw no muni, na ɔyɛ Mfirihyia Apem Nkɔso Bagua no bagua no muni a na ɛhwɛ Mfirihyia Apem Nsɛnnennen Kuw Apam a edi kan a wɔde bedi dwuma wɔ Ghana no so. Ɔsan nso yɛɛ adwuma wɔ Ɔman Nkɔsoɔ Nhyehyɛeɛ Bagua no mu, na na ɔyɛ Ghana Free Zones Board (GFZB) no Titenani.

San kɔ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no so, 2013–2017

Berɛ a John Mahama bɛdii Ɔmampanyin Atta Mills a wawuo no ananmu wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔsan nso paw Tetteh sɛ Nkitahodiɛ sohwɛfoɔ maa ne afe 2012 abatoɔ ɔsatuo. Ɔsan nso sii gyinae sɛ ɔbɛsan asi akan ama mmarahyɛ bagua atenaeɛ bio na wɔpaw no sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ Awutu Senya West amansin atenaeɛ a wɔayɛ no foforɔ no wɔ December 2012 abatoɔ no mu berɛ a ɔyɛɛ mmarahyɛ baguani maa Awutu Senya Mansin mantam firi afe 2001 kɔsi afe 2005 no.

Ɔdii nkonim wɔ atenaeɛ no akyi a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 23,032 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 55.47% tiaa nea ɔbɛn no paa Oppey Abbey a ɔno nso yɛ kan Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni ma Awutu Senya Mantam a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 18,487 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 44.53%.

Ɔhweree atenaeɛ no maa George Andah wɔ afe 2016 mmarahyɛ bagua abatoɔ mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 28,867, 52.27% tiaa ne abatoɔ 25,664 a ɛgyina hɔ ma 46.87%.

Ankorankora asetena 
Tetteh yɛ Gizella Tetteh Agbotui nuabea a ɔyɛ mmarahyɛ baguani ma Awutu Senya West Constituency baabi a ɔsan nso yɛɛ mmarahyɛbadwani.

Bia Mmoa Efiri

title: Dominic Kwaku Fobih
text:
Dominic Fobih (wɔwoo no 16 Ɔpɛpɔn 1942) yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ, ɔbenfoɔ ne Nwomasua ho nimdefoɔ /Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ. Ɔyɛ mmarahyɛ badwani ma Assin South wɔ Central region of Ghana firi January 2001 kɔsi January 2017 wɔ New Patriotic Party tekiti so. Ɔsan nso yɛ ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ Asase, Kwae ne Aboɔden so wɔ Ɔmanpanyin dedaw John Agyekum Kufour nniso ase.

Mfitiase asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Dominic wɔ 16 Ɔpɛpɔn 1942. Ɔfiri kuro bi a wɔfrɛ no Assin Jakai a ɛwɔ Central mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔnyaa ne PhD wɔ Nwomasua adwene mu wɔ Alberta Suapɔn mu wɔ Canada wɔ afe 1979.

Adwumayɛ 
Fobih yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni . Ɔyɛɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni mfeɛ mmienu no wɔ Ɔmanpanyin Kan John Agyekum Kuffou r nnisoɔ mu firi Ɔpɛpɔn 2001 kɔsi Ɔpɛpɔn 2009. Wɔ afe 2000 Ghana mmarahyɛ bagua abatoɔ mu no ɔnyaa abatoɔ 16,963 wɔ 31,843 no mu a ɛmaa abatoɔ a ɛfata a wɔtoo no nyinaa yɛ 53.3%. Ɔsan nso yɛ Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ Asase, Kwaeɛ ne Atopaeɛ so firi afe 2003 kɔsi afe 2007, wɔ John Agyekum Kuffour nnisoɔ ase. Ɔkuraa n’akongua sɛ mmarahyɛ baguani maa Assin South Constituency berɛ a John Atta Mills dii nkonim wɔ afe 2008 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu firi Ɔpɛpɔn 2009 kɔsi Ɔpɛpɔn 2012. Ɔsan kuraa n'akongua so sɛ mmarahyɛ baguani maa Assin Anafoɔ wɔ afe 2012 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu wɔ New Patriotic Party a ɛwɔ John Dramini Mahama nnisoɔ mu no tekiti ase. Ɔyɛɛ Nhomasua ne Aban boayikuo no muni berɛ a n’apam NPP baa ɔsɔretia mu wɔ afe 2012 mu  na na ɔyɛ nnipa kakraa bi kasamafoɔ wɔ nwomasua ho.

Na Dominic nso yɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo wɔ Cape Coast Sukuupɔn a ɛwɔ Ghana Mfinimfini Mantam mu.

Ɔyɛ Ghana Education Trust fund (GETFUND) no board chairman mprempren.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔpaw Fobih sɛ mmarahyɛ baguani wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnan (2004) Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu wɔ mmarahyɛ bagua a ɛto so anan a ɛwɔ Ghana man a ɛto so anan mu wɔ Assin South Mpɛsoa so mu. Ɔkuraa ne nkongua sɛ mmarahyɛ baguani maa Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmarahyɛ badwa a ɛtɔ so nnum ne nsia wɔ  mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nwɔtwe ne  mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu (2008 ne 2012) Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu.

N'ankasa abrabɔ 
Dominic aware a ɔwɔ mma nkron. Ɔyɛ Kristoni wɔ ɔsom mu na ɔyɛ Ghana Katolek asɔre no muni.

Mmeaeɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ 

Ghanaian Mp's 5th Parliament of the 4th Republic

title: Ebo Barton Odro
text:
Ebo Barton-Odro yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ na na ɔyɛ Ghana Mmarahyɛ Bagua no Kasafoɔ Abadiakyiri a ɔdi kan.Ɔyɛ mmarahyɛ baguani wɔ Cape Coast North mantam mu firi afe 2008 kɔsi afe 2016.

Abrabɔ mfitiase ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Barton-Odro wɔ Saltpond, Central Region. Ɔkɔɔ Mfantsipim Sukuu ne Ghana Mmara Sukuu na ɔsan nso nyaa mmara ho abodin krataa wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu.

Adwuma 
Barton-Odro yɛ mmaranimfo. Ɔsomm sɛ Barton ne Mfɛfo Nnwumakuw no Titenani. Afe 2009 mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ Ghana Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Barton-Odro yɛ National Democratic Congress (NDC) muni . Na ɔyɛ NDC mmarahyɛ bagua no muni ananmusifo ma saa bere no Cape Coast Constituency. Wɔ afe 2008 mu, wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti ase no, ɔsii akan wɔ afe 2012 Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ no mu na ɔdii nkonim. Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔsan sii akan wɔ afe 2012 Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ no mu na ɔdii nkonim. Ɔdii akansifoɔ afoforɔ a Henrietta Abane ne Sarah Mary Bucknor ka ho no so nkonim denam abatoɔ 21,189 a ɔnyaeɛ a ɛyɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 51.53%.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Barton-Odro yɛ Kristoni. Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baanan.

Bia mmoa firi

title: Nana Amoakoh
text:
Nana Amoakoh Gyampa  (wɔwoo no Oforisuo 15, afe 1958) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne aduruyɛ ho oduruyɛfoɔ. Ɔyɛ Fourth Republic of Ghana mmrahyɛbagua a ɛtɔ so nson no muni a ɔgyina Upper Denkyira East Constituency ananmu wɔ Central Region wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Amoakoh wɔ 15 March 1958 na ɔfiri Denkyira-Akropong a ɛwɔ Central Region of Ghana. Ɔnyaa ne ntoasoɔ sukuu wɔ Boa Amponsem Senior High School. Ɔkɔɔ York College na owiee sukuu no nyaa abodin krataa wɔ Adwene ne Nkateɛ Ho Adesua mu.

Adwumayɛ 
Amoakoh yɛ Adwene ne Nneyɛe Ho Ɔbenfo ne aguadifo. Ɔbɛyɛɛ Ghana mmrahyɛbagua no muni wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnum (2005) mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ɔyɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni. mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnum (2005) mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ Ghana mmrahyɛbadwa no muni. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu mu (2020) mu wɔ NPP primaries no mu no, ɔhweree ne mmɔdemmɔ sɛ ɔbɛgyina Upper Denkyira East ananmu wɔ mmrahyɛbadwa mu wɔ Festus Awuah Kwofie anim wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu (2020) amansan abatoɔ no mu.

Mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnan (2004) abatoɔ mu 
Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnan (2004) Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu, ɔdii nkonim wɔ Upper Denkyira East Constituency mmrahyɛbagua no mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 21,440 a ɛyɛɛ 68.10% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu berɛ a NDC mmrahyɛbagua kandifoɔ Kojo Adjepong Afrifah nyaa abatoɔ 6,433 a ɛyɛɛ 20.40% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu, CPP mmrahyɛbaguani ɔkannifoɔ Beatrice Buadu nyaa abatoɔ 304 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ 1.00% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu, PNC mmrahyɛbadwa kandifoɔ Amaniampong Owusu Offin nyaa abatoɔ 270 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoo no nyinaa mu 0.90% na Independent mmrahyɛbagua kandifoɔ Carl Ebo Morgan nyaa abatoɔ 3,047 a ɛyɛɛ 9.70% wɔ abatoɔ no nyinaa mu abatow a wɔtoeɛ.

Mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nwɔtwe (2008) abatoɔ mu 
Wɔ afe 2008 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu no, ɔsan dii nkonim wɔ Upper Denkyira East Constituency mmrahyɛbagua no mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 17,416 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ nyinaa mu 59.17% berɛ a NDC mmrahyɛbaguani Peter Kofi Owusu-Ahia Jnr nyaa abatoɔ 5,721 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 19.44% . wɔ abatow a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu.

Mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu (2012) abatoɔ mu 
Wɔ afe 2012 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu no, ɔsan dii nkonim wɔ Upper Denkyira East Constituency mmrahyɛbagua no mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 21,020 a ɛyɛɛ 53.98% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu berɛ a NDC mmrahyɛbagua no muni Dr Mark Kurt Nawaane nyaa abatoɔ 17,319 a ɛyɛɛ 44.47% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu, the PPP mmrahyɛbaguani Alex Nkansah nyaa abatoɔ 484 a ɛyɛɛ 1.24% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu, PNC mmrahyɛbagua mu kandifoɔ Amaniampong Owusu Offin nyaa abatoɔ 88 a ɛyɛɛ 0.23% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu na NDP mmrahyɛbadwa kandifoɔ Peter Oliver Seim nyaa abatoɔ 31 a ɛyɛɛ 0.08% abatoɔ a wɔtoo no nyinaa.

Mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia (2016) abatoɔ 
Wɔ afe 2016 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu no, ɔsan dii nkonim wɔ Upper Denkyira East Constituency mmrahyɛbagua no mu a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 22,212 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 55.69% berɛ a NDC mmrahyɛbagua mu kandifoɔ Emelia Ankomah nyaa abatoɔ 16,297 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 40.9%, CPP mmrahyɛbaguani ɔkannifoɔ Yaw Asamoah nyaa abatoɔ 810 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoo no nyinaa mu 2.0%, PNC mmrahyɛbagua mu kandifoɔ Amaniampong Owusu Offin nyaa abatoɔ 61 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 0.2%, Independent mmrahyɛbaguani bi Patrick Adu nyaa abatoɔ 233 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ no nyinaa mu 0.6% cast na PPP mmrahyɛbagua kandifo Fredrick Enchil nyaa abatow 275 a ɛyɛ 0.7% wɔ abatow a wɔtooeɛ nyinaa mu.

Boayikuo no 
Ɔyɛ kan mmrahyɛbadwa no Boayikuw a Wɔapaw a Ɛhwɛ Adwumayɛ ne Adan Ho So no Titenani.

N'ankasa abrabɔ 
Amoakoh yɛ Kristoni. Wawaree a ɔwɔ mma mmiɛnsa.

Adɔeyɛ 
Amoakoh de atoko afiri, esiam afrafra afiri, rola, fononoo ne lester afiri maa Boa Amponsem Senior High School a ɛwɔ Central Region of Ghana.

Mmeaeɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ 
Ghanaian Mp's 5th Parliament of the 4th Republic

title: Foster Joseph Andoh
text:
Foster Joseph Andoh (wɔwoo no Ɔbɛnem 18, 1961) yɛ Hemang Lower Denkyira a ɛwɔ Ghana Mfinimfini mantam mu no mmarahyɛ baguani.

Ankorankora asetena 
Foster aware na ɔwɔ mma baasa. Ɔyɛ Kristoni (Assemblies of God Asɔre).

Mfitiase asetena ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Foster wɔ 18 Ɔbɛnem 1961 wɔ Twifo-Hemang wɔ Central mantam mu.Ɔnyaa ne BA wɔ adwumayɛ mu wɔ UCC wɔ afe 2009. Ɔnyaa Diploma wɔ Ghana Institute of Journalism wɔ afe 1988–1990, Ɔnyaa ne Post-Sec Cert 'A' wɔ afe 1976–1981.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Foster yɛ Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni.

Adwuma 
Ná ɔyɛ Amanaman Ntam Ɔmanpanyin.Ɔyɛ Ɔmantam no sohwɛfoɔ panin firi afe 2009 kɔsi afe 2012.Ɔyɛ Pasica Ghana Limited Adetɔn sohwɛfoɔ firi afe 1991 kɔsi afe 2008. Ɔyɛ Marketer/Manager.

Bia Mmoa firi

title: Suhuyini Alhassan Sayibu
text:
Alhassan Sayibu Suhuyini (wɔwoo no wɔ Ɛbɔ bosme da a ɛtɔ so du mmienu wɔ afe apem ahankron ne aduoson nkron mu,September 12, 1979) yɛ Ghana broadcast nsɛntwerɛni ne ɔmanyɔni. Ɔyɛ Ɔman Demokrasi Mmarahyɛbadwani no muni. Mprempren ɔyɛ Fourth Republic of Ghana Mmarahyɛbadwani a Ɛto so nson a ɛgyina Tamale North ananmu no muni.

Nwomasua 
Alhassan Suhuyini kɔɔ Ghana Ntoaso Sukuu a seesei ɛyɛ Ghana Senior High School (Tamale), GHANASCO wɔ Tamale. Ɔwɔ B.Sc. Ɔman Adwumayɛ ne M.Sc. Nkɔsoɔ sohwɛ a ɛfiri Ghana Asoɛeɛ a ɛhwɛ adwumayɛ ne ɔman adwumayɛ so. Seesei ɔreyɛ ne PhD wɔ Public Administration mu.

Adwumayɛ 
N’adwuma sɛ radio so ɔkasafoɔ no hyɛɛ aseɛ wɔ Diamond FM a ɛwɔ Tamale ansa na ɔretu akɔ Ghana ahenkuro mu. Ɔyɛɛ adwuma bere tiaa bi wɔ Citi FM ne Metro TV wɔ Nkran ansa na ɔne Radio Gold retra. Radio atiefoɔ a wɔwɔ Ghana na wɔpaw no sɛ Talk Show Host of the year wɔ afe 2011, 2012 ne 2013 mu wɔ Ghana Radio ne Television Personality Awards mu. Wɔ afe 2013 mu no, South Korea aban paw no na ɛboaa no sɛ ɔnkɔkyinkyin South Korea sɛ ne Next Generational Leaders from Africa nhyehyɛe no fã. Na ɔyɛ ɔnanmusifoɔ wɔ afe 2014 Amanaman Ntam Nsrahwɛfoɔ Akannifoɔ Dwumadie, United States Ɔman Dwumadibea a ɛhwɛ adwumayɛfoɔ a wɔsesa wɔn ho wɔn ho nhyehyɛeɛ mu. Ɔyɛɛ adwuma wɔ Radio Gold a ɛwɔ Nkran, faako a na ɔyɛ dwumadibea no dwumadi atitiriw abien ho ɔkwankyerɛfo no; anɔpa dwumadi a wɔfrɛ no "Gold Power Drive" ne dapɛn awiei asetra-sikasɛm ne amammuisɛm mu nsɛm a ɛrekɔ so mprempren - Alhaji ne Alhaji nkɔmmɔbɔ dwumadie so.

Amanyɔsɛm Mu Adwuma 
Ɔmampanyin John Dramani Mahama na ɔpaw no wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmiɛnsa (2013) mu sɛ Ghana Civil Aviation Authority (GCAA) board member. Ɛde besi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nnan (2014) no na ɔyɛ Nkitahodi sohwɛfoɔ ma Ɔman Hajj Badwa (Ghana). Ɔdii nkunim wɔ Tamale North akonwa no so denam National Democratic Congress tekiti so wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne ne du-nsia (2016) Amansan abatoɔ mu sɛ ɔbɛyɛɛ mmarahyɛbadwa no muni. Ɔdii nkunim wɔ atenaeɛ no mu denam abatoɔ no mu amma a ɔnyaeɛ a mpem aduonu mmienu ne aha mmienu ne aduowɔtwe (21,280) a ɔnyaeɛ a ɛgyina hɔ ma dodoɔ no nyinaa mu ɔha nkyɛ mu aduosia nson akyiri pɔ aduoson nkron (67.79%) so.

Mmeaeɛ a menyaa mmoa firiɛ

title: Alhassan Dahamani
text:
Alhassan Dahamani (wɔwoo no wɔ Ayɔwohomumɔ da a ɛtɔ so nsia wɔ afe apem ahankron aduosia nwɔtwe, June 6, 1968) yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɔni ne Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so nsia a ɛwɔ Ghana Amammuo Ɛtɔ so Nnan no muni a ɔgyina Tamale North Mpɛsoa so anan mu wɔ Atifi Mantam sɛ kɔntinkrɔ. Ɔfiri Damankunyali a ɛwɔ Tamale, Atifi Mantm.

N'ankasa abrabɔ 
Dahamani yɛ Kramoni. Wawaree a (ɔwɔ mma mmiɛnsa).

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Dahamani wɔ Ayɔwohomumɔ da a ɛtɔ so nsia wɔ afe apem ahankron aduosia nwɔtwe (June 6, 1968). Ɔfiri Damankunyili – Tamale, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Fam Mantam mu. Ɔkɔɔ University of Cape Coast (UCC), Ghana na ɔnyaa ne bachelor’s wɔ Management Studies mu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nwɔtwe (2008).

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmienu (2012) mu no, ɔsii akan sɛ obi a ɔde ne ho maa Tamale Atifi akonwa no wɔ tekiti a ɛwɔ mmarahyɛ badwa a ɛtɔ so nsia a ɛwɔ amammuo a ɛtɔ so nnan no so na ɔdii nkunim.

 Adwumayɛfoɔ Boafoɔ Panin, VRA-NEDCo, Sunyani

title: Samuel Evans Ashong Narh
text:
Samuel Evans Ashong Narh (wɔwoo no Oforisuo bosome ne da a ɛtɔ so  5, wɔ afe 1943) yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ ne mfiridwumayɛfoɔ. Ɔyɛ kan production manager wɔ GHACEM na ɔyɛ kan mmarahyɛ baguani wɔ Tema East mantam a ɛwɔ Greater Accra Region of Ghana. Ashong Narh nso yɛ kan Tema apuei fam Metropolis kuropɔn sohwɛfo.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Ashong Narh nyaa mfiridwuma ho abodin krataa wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma Sukuupɔn mu wɔ afe 1996 mu. Afei ɔkɔɔ Poland Sukuupɔn mu baabi a onyaa Diploma wɔ mfiridwuma mu wɔ 1968 mu.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ashong Narh comes from Tema, Manhean in the Greater Accra Region of Ghana. He is a Christian and a Presbyterian

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Shirley Ayorkor Botchway
text:
Shirley Ayorkor Botchwey (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn bosome ne da a ɛtɔ so  8 wɔ afe 1963), yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɛfo a ɔsom sɛ Ghana ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ amannɔne nsɛm ne ɔmantam nkabom so. Ghana ɔmanpanyin Nana Akufo-Addo na ɔpaw no sɛ Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ amannɔne nsɛm so wɔ 10 Ɔbɛnem 2017. Ɔyɛ Anyaa-Sowutuom Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni firi afe 2013 kɔsi afe 2021. na na wayɛ Amannɔne Nsɛm Ho Ɔsoafoɔ Abadiakyiri ne Ɔman Ɔsoafoɔ wɔ Nsuo, Adwumayɛ ne Adan Dwumadibea wɔ John Kufuor ase. Ɔyɛ  New Patriotic Party no muni.

Mfitiase asetra 
Wɔwoo Shirley Ayorkor Botchwey wɔ Accra wɔ 8 Ɔpɛpɔn 1963. Ɔnyaa ne ntoaso sukuu wɔ St. Mary’s Girls’ Senior High School wɔ Korle-Gonno. Ɔyɛ adeɛ a ɛfiri Ghana Suapɔn Adwumayɛ Sukuu (UGBS), Ghana Asoɛeɛ a ɛhwɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ so (GIJ), Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration (GIMPA), Pitman’s Central College, London Suapɔn ne Westminster Suapɔn nyinaa wɔ United Kingdom (UK).

Ɔyɛ Minister holds an Executive MBA, (Project Management option), MA in Public Communication, Bachelor of Laws Degree (LLB), a Diploma in Public Relations and Advertising as well as a certificate in Marketing Management.

Amammui asetra 
Wɔ NPP nnisoɔ a ɛtwa toɔ a ɛhyɛɛ Ɔmampanyin John Agyekum Kufuor ase no, Hon Ayorkor Botchwey yɛɛ Ɔmanpanyin Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Amannɔne Nsɛm, Amanneɛbɔ, ne Aguadi ne Nnwumayɛbea nso so. Ɔrensi akan sɛ ɔbɛsan apaw no bio wɔ afe 2020 amansan ne mmarahyɛ bagua abatow no mu. 

Wɔ party level no, Hon. Minister dii dwuma sɛ Amannɔne Nsɛm ho ɔkasafo wɔ afe 2009 ne 2013 ntam.

WɔWɔ saa bere koro no ara mu no, na ɔyɛ Ranking Member ma Mmarahyɛ Bagua Boayikuw a Wɔapaw a Ɛhwɛ Amannɔne Nsɛm So ne akyiri yi, Mmarahyɛ Bagua no Boayikuw a Wɔpaw Wɔn, Bammɔ ne Mfinimfini Fam. 

ECOWAS Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni firi afe 2013 – 2017, Hon. Shirley Ayorkor Botchwey ne ne mfɛfoɔ yɛɛ adwuma de boaa Community Parliament no wɔ n’afotuo dwumadie mu wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa ɔmantam no ho titire wɔ nsɛm a ɛfa nnipa hokwan titire ne ahofadie ho a wɔbɛsusu ho, berɛ a ɔde nyansahyɛ rema ECOWAS ahyehyɛdeɛ ne akwaa ahodoɔ. Hon Minister no nso yɛɛ Vice Chair wɔ NEPAD no so     

Mprempren ɔte Nkitahodi ne saa ara nso na Mmarahyɛ Bagua no Bɔbeasu ne Mmofra Boayikuw ahorow mu a ɔne ne mfɛfo adwumayɛfo yɛ adwuma de hwɛ nsɛm a ɛfa nkitahodi ho wɔ ɔkwan a ɛkɔ akyiri so ne afei nso ɔhwehwɛ nsɛm a ɛfa ɔbarima ne ɔbea nna ne mmofra ho nyinaa mu de hwɛ hu sɛ wɔde bɛka mmara a ɛfata nyinaa ho. wɔ din a wɔde kɔmaa mmarahyɛ bagua no sɛ wɔmfa nnye ntom wɔ 21 Ɔbɛnem 2021 mu no, Ghana ɔmanpanyin Nana Akuffo-Addo na ɔyii no sɛ Madam Shirley Ayorkor Botchwey sɛ ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ Amannɔne Nsɛm ne Ɔmantam Nkabom so.

Adwuma 
Ansa na Shirley bɛhyɛn anim amammuisɛm mu no, na ɔwɔ Marketing and Communications Company a na ɔyɛ ɔfotufo ma Ministry of Tourism.         

Sɛ́ obi a ɔyɛ ɔman adwumayɛ ho adwuma no, ɔne ahyehyɛde ahorow te sɛ Worldspace Ghana, Divestiture Implementation Committee, Glaxo Group Research ne Hodge Recruitment yɛɛ adwuma.         

Mprempren Shirley yɛ ECOWAS Asomfo Bagua no Titenani ne Ɔmanpanyin a ɔhwɛ Amannɔne Nsɛm ne Mpɔtam Nkabom so wɔ Ghana.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Shirley Ayorkor Botchwey yɛ sigyani a ɔwɔ mma baanu. Ɔyɛ Kristoni a ɔyɛ Anglikanni wɔ asɔre mu.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Ernest Akobuor Debrah
text:
Ernest Akobuor Debrah (3 Ɔbɛnem 1947 – 6 Ɔpɛpɔn 2016) yɛ Ghana amanyɔfoɔ.

Mfitiase asetra ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Ernest Kwaku Akobour Debrah wɔ Ɔbɛnem da a ɛtɔ so mmiɛnsa, afe apem ahankron aduɔson nson, na ne papa James Emmanuel Debrah ne Elizabeth Akosua Kontoh Debrah. Ná ɔyɛ mma dumien a n’awofo woo wɔn no mu nea ɔto so abiɛsa. Ɔfiri Tanoso a ɛwɔ Brong Ahafo Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Bere a Ernest Debrah ne mfitiaseɛ ne ntoaso sukuu wɔ Sunyani Ntoaso Sukuu ne Ghana Ɔman Kɔlege akyi no, ɔwiee Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma so wɔ afe 1972 mu a ɔnyaa Bachelor of Science abodin krataa wɔ Asase Sikasɛm mu.[2] Afei ɔkɔɔ so nyaa Master of Business Administration abodin krataa wɔ adwumayɛ mu wɔ Strathclyde Sukuupɔn, Glasgow wɔ afe 1995 mu.

Adwuma 
Debrah yɛ sikasɛm ho ɔbenfo wɔ n’adwuma mu.[2] Ɔayɛ adwuma sɛ Retain Banking Unit no sohwɛfoɔ panin wɔ Société Générale - Social Security Bank a akyiri yi wɔbɛfrɛɛ no ​​Societe Generale Ghana Limited adwumayɛbea ti.[2]

Amanyɔsɛm 
Na Debrah yɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani ma Tano North mantam no wɔ mmarahyɛ bagua a ɛtɔ so nnan ne 5 wɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu. Na ɔyɛ Aduane ne Kuadwuma ho Ɔsoafoɔ (Ɔpɛpɔn 2005 kɔsi Ɔpɛpɔn 2009), na wadi kan ayɛ Ɔmantam Ɔsoafoɔ ama Brong-Ahafo na afei Ɔmantam Ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Atifi Mantam so firi Ɔpɛpɔn 2001 kɔsi Ɔpɛpɔn 2004. Wɔpaw no sɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni firii Tano Atifi fam wɔ December 2004. Wɔmaa no abasobɔdeɛ wɔ afe 2009 mu wɔ Akuafoɔ Da afahyɛ no mu.

Abatow ahorow 
Wɔdii kan paw Debrah sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani maa Tano North mantam no wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu. Wɔde abatow 15,868 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 26,983 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 58.80% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Charles Appiagyei a ofi National Democratic Congress, Nyamekye Florence a ofi Democratic People’s Party, Daniel Dabie Boateng a ofi People’s National Convention ne Nana Ampabeng Daniel K Kyeremeh a ofi Convention People’s Party. Eyinom nyaa abatow 10,253, abatow 485, abatow 210 ne abatow 167 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne 38.00%, 1.80%, 0.80% ne 0.60% yɛ pɛ wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow wɔ saa abatow no mu nyinaa mu. Debrah dii nkonim wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so.  

Na ne mansin no yɛ amansin 14 a ɛwɔ amansin 24 a New Patriotic Party dii nkonim wɔ Brong Ahafo mantam mu wɔ saa abatow no mu no fã. Sɛ yɛka ne nyinaa bom a, New Patriotic Party no nyaa dodoɔ no ara a ɛyɛ mmarahyɛ bagua ananmusifoɔ 128 wɔ mmarahyɛ bagua nkongua 230 a ɛwɔ mmarahyɛ bagua a ɛtɔ so nnan a ɛwɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu. 

Wɔsan paw Debrah sɛ mmarahyɛ baguani muni wɔ Tano North mantam mu wɔ afe 2008 Ghana amansan abatow no mu. Wɔde abatow 15,868 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 26983 mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 58.80% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Opoku Atuahene a ofi National Democratic Congress, Alhassan Kabore a ofi Convention People’s Party, George Owusu Yeboah a ofi People’s National Convention, Arkoh Ernest a ofi Democratic Freedom Party ne Amanfo Antwi a ofi Democratic People’s Party mu. Eyinom nyaa abatow 11,120, abatow 363, abatow 214, abatow 144 ne abatow 101 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne 38.36%, 1.25% , 0.74%, 0.50% ne 0.35% yɛ pɛ wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu. Wɔsan paw Debrah wɔ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no tekiti so. 

Na ne mansin no yɛ mmarahyɛ bagua nkongua 16 no fã wɔ nkongua 24 a New Patriotic Party dii wɔ Brong Ahafo mantam mu wɔ saa abatow no mu. Sɛ yɛka ne nyinaa bom a, New Patriotic Party no dii nkonim wɔ nnipa kakraa bi a wɔka bom yɛ mmarahyɛbadwa ananmusifo 107 wɔ nkongua 230 a ɛwɔ mmarahyɛ bagua a ɛto so 5 a ɛwɔ Ghana man a ɛto so 4 no mu.[7]

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ná Ernest Akobuor Debrah yɛ Kristoni na ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baanan.[2]

Owuo

Ɔwuiɛ wɔ yareɛ tiawa bi akyi Dwoda 6 Ayɛwohomumɔ 2016, wɔ ne tenabea.

title: George Yaw Gyan-Baffuor
text:
George Yaw Gyan-Baffour (wɔwoo no 27 Oforisuo 1951) yɛ Ghana nkɔsoɔ sikasɛm ho ɔbenfoɔ ne amammuifoɔ. Ɔyɛ kan Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni a ɔgyinaa Wenchi mantam ananmu firi afe 2005 kɔsi afe 2021. Ɔyɛ ɔbenfoɔ wɔ Howard Suapɔn a ɛwɔ Washington, D.C., firi afe 1993 kɔsi afe 2001. Ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party no muni ne kan Minister of Planning wɔ Ghana.

Mfitiase asetra ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Gyan-Baffour wɔ Wenchi wɔ Brong Ahafo Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔkɔɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu baabi a ɔnyaa Bachelor of Arts abodin krataa wɔ sikasɛm mu. Ɔkɔɔ Helsinki Sikasɛm Sukuu a ɛwɔ Finland baabi a onyaa Diploma wɔ Sikasɛm mu. Akyiri yi onyaa ne master’s degree ne Doctor of Philosophy abodin krataa bere a ɔde ne din kɔhyɛɛ Wisconsin Sukuupɔn mu, Madison. Ɔsan nso wɔ post-doctoral diploma wɔ Harvard Suapɔn mu.

Adwumayɛ asetra 
George Gyan-Baffour yɛ adwumayɛfoɔ ho ɔbenfoɔ wɔ Howard Suapɔn mu firi afe 1993 kɔsi afe 2001. Bere a New Patriotic Party dii nkonim wɔ abatow mu wɔ Ghana amansan abatow mu wɔ afe 2000 mu no, ɔsan kɔɔ Ghana na Ɔmanpanyin John Kufour paw no sɛ Ɔman Nkɔso Nhyehyɛe Bagua no sohwɛfo panyin wɔ afe 2002 mu. Saa bere yi mu na ɔde nhyehyɛe a edi kan a wɔde bɛhwɛ ɔman no nkɔso ntɛmntɛm so na wɔasusuw ho sii hɔ. Ɔhwɛɛ Ghana Sikasɛm ne Asetena mu Nkɔsoɔ Ho Nhyehyɛeɛ a Wɔayɛ no Bom no so.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ogyaee dibea no wɔ afe 2004 mu sɛnea ɛbɛyɛ a obetumi adi n’amammui mu atirimpɔw ahorow akyi. Saa afe no, ɔde New Patriotic Party no tekiti sii akan wɔ Wenchi mantam mmarahyɛ bagua abatow no mu. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ no mu na ɔkɔɔ so dii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ mmiɛnsa a ɛdi akyire no mu wɔ afe 2008, 2012 ne 2016. Ɔmampanyin Kufour paw no sɛ Ɔsoafoɔ  Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Sikasɛm ne Sikasɛm Nhyehyɛeɛ so firi Oforisuo 2005 kɔsi December 2008.

Wɔ afe 2015 mu no, ɔsɔre tiaa Mahama aban no nhyehyɛeɛ a ɛne sɛ wɔbɛhwehwɛ aban mmoa afiri Amanaman Ntam Sikakorabea hɔ wɔ baguam. Ná ogye di sɛ wobetumi adi sikasɛm mu ahokyere a na ɔman no refa mu saa bere no ano aduru denam bosea a wobenya afi ɔman no mu so.

2004 Abatow mu 
Wɔdii kan paw Gyan-Baffour sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani maa Wenchi mansini no akyi a wɔbɔɔ no fii saa bere no Wenchi Apuei ne Wenchi Atɔe amansin mu.[8][9] Wɔpaw no wɔ afe 2004 Ghana amansan abatow mu. Enti ɔgyinaa amansin no ananmu wɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu. Wɔde abatow 18,183 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 33,806. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 53.8% yɛ pɛ.  Wɔpaw no sen Abdul-Latif Umar Abdullah a ofi Convention People's Party , Alhaji Alhassan Bene a ofi Every Ghanaian Living Everywhere Party ne Osei Kwadwo Hayford a ɔyɛ obi a ɔde ne ho. Eyinom nyaa abatow 1,286, abatow 7,669 ne abatow 6,668 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyinom ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 3.8%, 22.7% ne 19.7% yɛ pɛ. Gyan-Baffour wɔ saa abatoɔ no mu dii nkonim wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so. Na ne mansin no yɛ mmarahyɛ bagua nkongua 14 fã wɔ nkongua 24 a New Patriotic Party dii wɔ Brong Ahafo Mantam mu wɔ Ghana no mu. Sɛ yɛka ne nyinaa bom a, New Patriotic Party no nyaa dodoɔ no ara a ɛyɛ mmarahyɛ bagua ananmusifoɔ 128 wɔ nkongua 230 a ɛwɔ mmarahyɛ bagua a ɛtɔ so nnan a ɛwɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu.

2008 Abatow mu 
Wɔsan paw Gyan-Baffour sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani ma Wenchi mantam wɔ afe 2008 Ghana amansan abatow mu. Enti ɔgyinaa amansin no ananmu bio wɔ Ghana man a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmarahyɛ bagua a ɛtɔ so 5 no mu. Wɔde abatow 18,516 na ɛpaw no wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow nyinaa mu 32,573. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu 56.84% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Yaw Osei Agyei a ofi National  Democratic Congress, Akotia Kwaky Thompson a ofi Democratic Freedom Party ne Abdul-Latif Omaru Abdullay a ofi Convention People's Party mu. Eyinom nyaa abatow 13,495, abatow 284 ne abatow 278 wɔ abatow a ɛfata a wɔtow no nyinaa mu. Eyi ne abatow a ɛfata nyinaa mu 41.43%, 0.87% ne 0.85% yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw Gyan-Baffour wɔ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no tekiti so. Na ne mansin no yɛ mmarahyɛ bagua nkongua 16 no fã wɔ nkongua 24 a New Patriotic Party no dii wɔ saa abatow no mu wɔ Brong Ahafo Mantam mu wɔ Ghana no mu. Ne nyinaa mu no, New Patriotic Party no dii nkonim wɔ nnipa kakraa bi a wɔka bom yɛ mmarahyɛ bagua ananmusifo 107 wɔ nkongua 230 a ɛwɔ mmarahyɛ bagua a ɛto so 5 a ɛwɔ Ghana man a ɛto so 4 no mu.

2012 Abatow mu 
Wɔ afe 2012 mmarahyɛbadwa abatoɔ mu no, Gyan-Baffour nyaa abatoɔ a ɛfata nyinaa mu 50.83% denam Yaw Osei Agyei a ɔfiri National Democratic Congress, Ebenezer Gyimah Koomson a ɔfiri Progressive Peoples’ Party ne Jacob Steve Kojo Akasampah Gyan a ɔfiri National Democratic Party mu.

Mmarahyɛ Bagua no boayikuw ahorow 
Esiane sɛ Gyan-Baffour yɛ sikasɛm ho ɔbenfo nti, watra mmarahyɛ bagua boayikuw ahorow a ɛfa n’adwuma ho no mu titiriw. Wɔn mu bi ne: Budget Boayikuo Titiriw; Aguadi, Nnwuma ne Nsrahwɛ Boayikuw; Nwomasua Boayikuw; Boayikuo a Wɔtew Ohia So; ne Budget Boayikuo Titiriw no dwamteni a ɔyɛ adwuma.

Asomfo a wɔpaw wɔn 
Wɔ 12 Ɔbɛnem 2017 no, Ɔmampanyin Nana Akuffo-Addo yii no sɛ ɔsomfoɔ a wɔayi no sɛ ɔnyɛ nhyehyɛeɛ. Ɔmanpanyin no frɛɛ no ​​"sikasɛm ho ɔbenfo a wobu no a ɔwɔ nimdeɛ a ɛfata sɛ kan Ɔman Nkɔso Nhyehyɛe Bagua no panyin". Wɔbɔɔ no sobo sɛ ɔkyerɛ New Patriotic Party no abatow ho amanneɛbɔ ase nkɔ botae ahorow a ɛyɛ adwuma, a wobetumi adu ho ama ɔman nkɔso.

Nsɔhwɛ ne ntam a wɔka 
Mmarahyɛbadwa no Appointments Committee no hwɛɛ no ​​mu wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn 2017. Wɔ ne nhwehwɛmu no mu no, ɔka kyerɛɛ boayikuo no sɛ Ghana nhia mfeɛ aduanan nkɔsoɔ nhyehyɛeɛ ɛfiri sɛ ɛhyɛ kateeyɛ ho nkuran. Wɔ n’adwene mu no nhyehyɛe a ɛnkyɛ pii bɛyɛ papa na aboa ma wɔakwati anohyeto biara a ɛbɛyɛ atamfo ama Ghana nkɔso. Boayikuo no penee so bere a odii ahwehwɛde ahorow a ehia nyinaa ho dwuma ma ɔman soafo. Ɔmampanyin Akuffo-Addo kaa ntam wɔ 11 Ɔpɛpɔn 2017.

Kuw ne Nhyehyeɛ Ahorow 
Gyan-Baffour yɛ Ghana Sikasɛm Ho Nimdefoɔ Asoɛeɛ no yɔnko. Wayɛ Ghana Aban nnwuma ahodoɔ a ɛka ho ne Bank of Ghana, Council for Scientific and Industrial Research ne Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration no board member.

Ankorankoro asetra 
George Gyan-Baffour aware a ɔwɔ mma baason. Ɔyɛ Katolek Asɔre a ɛwɔ Ghana no muni.

title: Emmanuel Nii Ashie Moore
text:
Emmanuel Nii Ashie Moore (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛnimma bosome ne da a ɛtɔ so 26, wɔ afe 1969) yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ ne Mmarahyɛ Bagua a Ɛtɔ so Nsia a ɛwɔ Ghana Aman a ɛtɔ so nnan no muni a ɔgyina Adenta Mansin ananmu wɔ Greater Accra Mantam mu na mprempren ɔyɛ Ɔmantam Titenani wɔ Greater Accra Mantam mu wɔ tekiti so.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Moore yɛ Kristoni (Assemblies of God Asɔre). Ɔwaree

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Moore wɔ Ɔpɛnimma 26 bosome ne da a ɛtɔ so wbosome ne da a wɔ 1969 mu. Ɔfiri Teshie-Accra, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Greater Accra Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔkɔɔ Europa Suapɔn a ɛwɔ Hasselt, Belgium, na onyaa ne Bachelor of Science abodin krataa’s Business Administration – Marketing wɔ afe 2003 mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Moore yɛ National Democratic Congress (NDC) muni na ɔsan yɛ mprempren Greater Accra mantam mu guamtrani ma National Democratic Congress. Wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔsii akan maa Adenta atenaeɛ no wɔ NDC mmarahyɛ bagua a ɛtɔ so nsia a ɛwɔ republic a ɛtɔ so nnan no tekiti so na ɔdii nkonim.

Bere a odii nkonim wɔ Greater Accra Regional Chairmanship abatow mu akyi no, ɔde check a ɛyɛ GH¢150,000.00 maa amansin a wɔapaw wɔ ɔmantam no mu sɛ ne ɔsatu bɔhyɛ a ɔde bɛma nneɛma na wasan ahyɛ ɔmantam no din foforo de agye tumi wɔ afe 2024 mu no mmamu.

NDC Ɔman Nnanmusini Nhyiamu no akyi no, Owura Moore maa Accra ananmusifoɔ akwaaba sɛ wɔtoo aba kɛseɛ maa John Dramani Mahama sɛ frankaa a ɔdi hɔ ne NDC a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ Ɔmampanyin wɔ afe 2024 Amansan Abatoɔ no mu. Ansa na NDC Primaries reba wɔ Kwasida, 13 May 2023 no, John Dramani Mahama hyɛɛ bɔ sɛ ɔbɛtua sika a ɛyɛ pɛpɛɛpɛ a ɛyɛ GH¢40.00 ama nhyiamufoɔ biara de akanyan wɔn ma wɔato aba. Nanso, NDC Ɔmantam Ɔkyerɛwfo a ɔwɔ Greater Accra Mantam mu no abɔ Owura Moore sobo sɛ ɔde sika a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ ama nhyiamfo no asie sɛnea wɔn a wɔrepere NDC frankaa akansi no mu biako hyɛɛ bɔ no.

Mmɔden a wɔbɔ sɛ wobekum no 
Memeneda, 27 Ɔpɛpɔn 2023 no, wɔhwehwɛɛ Owura Moore adwumayɛbea a ɛwɔ Teshie no mu na wɔwiaa nneɛma bi. Ɔkyerɛe sɛ eyi ne mprɛnsa so a ɔrehyia asɛm a ɛte saa. Ghana Polisifoɔ Dwumadibea no aba ɔkasatia a emu yɛ den mu afiri Owura Moore hɔ sɛ wɔamfa ahunahuna a ɛwɔ ne nkwa mu aniberesɛm wɔ anwiinwii mpɛn pii akyi.

title: Vincent Sowah-Odote
text:
Vincent Sowah Odotei yɛ Ghana amanyɔni.  Ɔgyina    

La Dadekotopo abatoɔ mpɛsoa a ɛwWanin i wɔ Ghana Nkran punui mantam u no anan mu wɔ mmaryɛbadwafiea. .   Ɔyn Ɔsono kokroko ammanyɔkuo ( New Patriotic Party-NPP) mu ni ; na ɔyɛɛ ɔsoafoɔbɛdiakyire  ei a ɔhwɛ Nkitahodie ho nsɛm so wɔ Ghana kosii sɛ woyii no firii hɔ wɔ Oforisuo da a ɛtɔ so nsia, mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Aduonu (2020iman mpanin Nana Akufo-Addo de no bae.

Ɔdii Onimuonyamfoɔ Nii Amah Namoale so nkonim wɔ mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Du-nsia (2016 ) abatoɔ no mu.

Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ ne Nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Vincent Odotei wɔ, afe Apem, Ahankron ne Aduosia-nwɔtwe(1968) wɔ Nkran. Ɔwɔ B.A firi Ghana Suapɔn ne Post Graduate Diploma a ɛfiri Graduate School of Business Suapɔn a ɛwɔ Strathclyde Scotland.

Adwumayɛ 
Ɔasan yɛ abadwakuo a wɔhwɛ Accra Hearts of Oak bɔɔlobɔ kuo no so no mu ni. Wɔpaw no sɛ bɔɔlobɔ kuo no hwɛsofoɔ wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du-nsia (2016) Na wasi nkete sɛ ɔrengye bɔɔlobɔ kuo no akyi di da . Waka sɛ ɔrengyae ne dibea ɛmfa ho sɛ nhyɛsoɔ a bɔɔlobɔ kuo no akyidifoɔ d bɛma  no.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Vincent Sowah Odotei daa ne turimupɔ  adi sɛ  ɔpɛ sɛ ɔsi akan pre La Dadekotopo mmarahyɛbadwa akondwa no wɔ nkongua no a ɛwɔ Accra no wɔ Ɔsono krokrokoko amanyɔkuo New Patriotic Party-NPP tekiti so.Odotei a wɔde anigye frɛ no Obama no yɛ obi a na anka ɔyɛ Hearts of Oak ne King Faisal bɔɔlobɔ kuo  no panin.

"Wɔ Ghana no, bɔɔlbɔ ne amanyɔsɛm  nkɔ bɛn korɔ mu. Nanso ɔkaa sɛ " Megye tom sɛ mantumi anyɛ bɔɔlbɔ agodie no nnɛ yi deɛ sɛnea maso daeɛ sɛ mɛyɛ firi berɛ a mehyɛn mu no," ɔdwennwen ho wɔ nkɔmmɔbɔ bi a ɔne Joy Sports bɔe wɔ Yawda no mu. Odotei twee adwene sii mmɔden a ɔbɔeɛ mpɛn pii sɛ ɔbɛma (Ghana Football Association) no aboa no ama Kwesi Nyantakyi a na ɔdi tumi saa berɛ no afiri n’ahendwa no  so. Ne kasa mu no,  ɔkaa sɛ "Nanso wobetumi anya awerɛhyem sɛ mede saa honhom, mmɔdenbɔ ne anisoadehunu  koro no ara bɛkɔ amanyɔsɛm  mu ahwɛ sɛ metumi aboa me nkurɔfo wɔ La amansin no mu anaa."Sɛnea ɔbɔɔ mmɔden sɛ ɔbɛboro Nyantakyi mfe du na wantumi no, saa ara na adwadifoɔ no behyia ɔsɔretiafoɔ a ne ho yɛ den saa ara wɔ ne akyidi foforo no mu - yei nso ne nsɛm a Nii Amasa Namoale a ɔwɔ (NDC) no nso ka faa ne ho.

Mprenpren Ahofama 
Vincent Sowah Odotei wɔ Wiase Nhyiamu Abasobɔdeɛ a ɛtwa toɔ a ɛbaa awieeɛ wɔ Accra, Ghana a wɔteɛ  no ​​firi Obubuo da a ɛtɔ so mmeɛnsa, mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Du-nwɔtwe (201, kɔsi Obubuo da a ɛtɔ so nso, mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Du-nwltwe (2018) baabi a ɔdaa ne som adwuma no pɛ adi sɛ ɔne ankorankorɛ adwumayɛbea no bɛbom ayɛ adwuma ama ankorankorɛ adwumayɛbea no.

title: Yussif Issaka Jajah
text:
Yussif Issaka Jajah yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne Ghana mmarahyɛdwa a ɛtɔ so nson wɔ Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nan no mu ni a ɔgyina Ayawaso Atifi  abatoɔ mpɛsoa no ananmu wɔ Greater Accra Region wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ ne Nwomasua 
Wɔwoo no Ahinime da a ɛtɔ so Aduonu -baako, afe Apem Ahankron ne Aduɔson-nkron (1979). Ɔfiri Bole a ɛwɔ Savannah mantam no  mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔnyaa ne MBA wɔ International Oil and Gas Management mu wɔ University of Dundee a ɛwɔ Scotland, UK aburokyiman mu, mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Du-baako (2011) mu. Ɔsan nso nyaa ne BSc wɔ Akontaabuo mu wɔ UPSA wɔ afe 2009 mu. Ɔsan nso wiee sukuu wɔ Institute of Chartered Accountants a ɛwɔ Ghana.

Adwumayɛ 
Na ɔyɛ Nhwehwɛmufoɔ wɔ Inter- Ministerial Coordinating Committee on Decentralization wɔ Accra firi mfe Mpem Mmienu ne Du-mmeɛnsa (2013) kɔsi mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Du-nsia (2016). Ɔsan nso yɛ fangoo ne mframagyaa ho Ɔfotufoɔ firi Mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Du-baako (2011) kɔsi mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Du-mmienu (2012) ne MDPI ne Goodwill International.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress-NDC  no mu ni.yɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma Ayawaso-Atifi abatoɔ mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Nkran punpuni  mantam mu no wɔ Ghana.

N'ankasa Abrabɔ 
Yussif yɛ Nkramoni. Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma mmienu.

Ɔfotufoɔ 
Onimuonyamfoɔ Yussif yɛ ɔfotufoɔ a, ɔtaa tu ne nkrɔfoɔ, titiriw, mmabunu fo berɛ nyinaa. Ɔde afutuo kɔ maa Nima ne Mamobifoɔ , titiriw mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa no sɛ wɔntena  ase na wɔmfa animia ne nsiyɛ honhom mmɔ wɔn bra. Yei sii wɔ nsɛm a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ etutotoɔ a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Nima ne Mamobifoɔ ntam wɔ Yawada anwummerɛ bi no akyi. Ɔka kyerɛɛ wɔn sɛ. Ɛhɔ ara na ɔnyini, kɔɔ sukuu ne wɔn Boom dii agorɔ baako. Nti sɛ wabɛyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani a, bibiara nni hɔ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ obiara gyina ɔno nko ara ne ho so. Sɛdeɛ ɛteɛ biara no, wɔhia wɔn ho wɔn ho.   

Onimuonyamfoɔ Yussif tuu  fo sɛ mmabunu no nyinaa ngyina nea ɛbɛfiri mu aba wɔ asɛm a ɛsii wɔ Nima ne Mamobi ntam  wɔ Yawda no so na wɔnfa ntu wɔn ho fo. Berɛ a ɔde n’afotuo a ɛyɛ anigyeɛ maa Nima nkorɔfoɔ no, ɔsan kaa sɛ ɛyɛ no ya yie  ankasa wɔ ne mu sɛ adeɛ a ɛte saa aba na ne nyinaa mu no, wɔ mmeranteɛ ne mmabaa asetena mu. Na ɔbɛhwɛ ama asomdwoeɛ aba wɔn ntam. 

Onimuonyamfoɔ Yussif de  n'abrabɔ mu nsɛm ahodɔ wɔ berɛ a ɔrenyini wɔ mpɔtam a asomdwoeɛ nni mu  te sɛ Nima mu no ho yɛɛ mfatoho maa mmabunu no. “Sɛ onyinii wɔ Nima na  wabɛyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani a, dɛn nti na wɔrentumi nyɛ baako,” na ɛnonom ne ne nsɛm a abubu wɔn akoma ankasa.

Akyire yi ɔhyɛɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ, ɛnsɛ sɛ nkɔmmɔbɔ ahodoɔ a ɛkɔ so wɔ wɔn ntam no kɔ wie atirimɔdensɛm. Wɔbetumi abɔ wɔn nkɔmmɔ a ɛnyɛ aniberesɛm a wɔde ɔdɔ ne  nnamfofa su bɛka nanso ɛnsɛ sɛ ɛkɔsi baabi a ɛbɛgye obi nkwa afiri ne nsam ɛsiane sɛ wɔanyɛ wɔn asedeɛ nti.

Saa berɛ no nyinaa, Polisifoɔ Ɔmanfo Nsɛm sohwɛfo Panin, ACP Kwesi Ofori, a ɔkasa kyerɛɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo wɔ polisifo adwumayɛbea ti no ɔka sɛ wɔnkad sɛ ɛnam nsɛm yi so,  sɛ, nnipa mmienu  wɔ polisifoɔ nsam wɔ dwuma a wɔkyerɛ sɛ wodiiɛ wɔ atuo a wɔtotoweɛ wɔ Nima no mu no. Ɛsɛ sɛ obiara bɔ ne ho ban firi nsɛm bi a ɛtete saa ho.

title: Ebenezer Gilbert Nii Narh Nartey
text:
Ebenezer Gilbert Nii Narh Nartey yɛ Ghana amanyɔni  ne Mmarahyɛbadwa  a ɛtɔ so nson wɔ Ahyehyem a ɛtɔ so nan no mu ni a ɔgyina hɔ ma Ablekuma Central Mansini no wɔ mmarahyɛbadwafie

Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ ne Nwomasua 
Ɔfiri Ningo a ɛwɔ Nkran mantam  mu.

Ɔwɔ diploma wɔ nnipa ahoɔden sohwɛ mu wɔ Institute of Commercial Management. Diploma wɔ adansie ho nhyehyɛeɛ mu a ɛfiri Kwame Nkrumah Nyansahunu ne Mfididwuma Sukuupɔn  NVTI adansedie krataa a ɛfiri nnɛ yi Sukuu a Ɛhwɛ Nsɛm So no mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ɔyɛ Ɔsono kokroko Ammanyɔkuo(New Patriotic Party -NPP) mu ni.  Ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani  ma  ma Ablekuma Mfimfini mansini a ɛwɔ Nkran punpuni mantam no mu no.

Adwumayɛ 
Ɔkyerɛɛ adeɛ wɔ Islamic Education Program firi mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Ɛnan (2004) kɔsii  Mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne enum (2005). Na ɔsan nso yɛ Executive Secretary de ma atuhoakyɛ kuo bi a ɛnhyɛ aban ase.  Ɔbɛyɛɛ Afɛfoɔ Afɛfoɔ som sohwɛfoɔ abadiakyiri firi Mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Nson (2007 ) de kɔsii Mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne du-baako (2011) wɔ Lands Commission. Na ɔyɛ Ednark Limited no sohwɛfoɔ firi mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Du-baako(2011) kɔsi mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Du-nsia (2016).

2021 Nsɛmnsɛm 
Ɔgyefuo da a ɛdi kan, mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Aduonu -baako mu no, Awake News kyerɛ sɛ,  basabasayɛ kɔɔ so wɔ NPP amanyɔkuo a ɛwɔ Ablekuma mfimfini abatoɔ mpɛsoa no so no mu a na ɛfa  obi a wɔbɛpaw no sɛ mansini krakye ho.    Sɛnea wɔn  a ɔbɛn ekuo no ne Awake Newsfoɔ   kyerɛ no, Mmarahyɛbadwani a na wadi  nkoguo wɔ mpɔtam hɔ no, ɛyɛ Ebenezer  Nii Narh Nattey na na ɔhyɛ mmabunu bi a wɔwɔ mpɔtam hɔ ɔnni kutupa sɛ wɔnkada ntia Mariama Karley Amui , mansini krakye a na wɔayi no fororɔ no, ngu ne din ho fi. Wɔkyerɛɛ sɛ Nii Bae Nartey yɛɛ yei, sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a ɔbɛnya kwan abɛyɛ mansini krakye. 

Nsɛm foforobinefinom neɛ kɛ.erɛ sɛ, berɛ a na saa nsɛmsɛm yi rekɔ so no nyinaa, na Onimuonyamfoɔ Nii Narh Nartey asi nkete sɛ ɔbɛsan nso ɔkɔpere mmarahyɛbadwa akondwa no wɔ abatoɔ a ɛbɛba biom no mu. Nti nokorɛ biara nniu sɛ ɔhyɛ saa mmabunu basabasayɛ no ase.

.
