title: Francis Kingsley Ato Codjoe
text:
Francis Kingsley Ato Codjoe  yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne  mmrahyɛbadwani wɔ Ghana Adehyeman  a ɛtɔ so nnan no mmrahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson no mu a ɔgyinaa Ekumfi Mansin ananmu wɔ Central Region wɔ New Patriotic Party no din mu . Ɔyɛ kane Ɔsoafoɔ Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Mpataayi ne Nsuo mu Nkɔsoɔ so.

Ne Mmɔfrase ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Codjoe wɔ Kitawonsa  bosome da ɛtɔ aduasa -baako wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduoson - baako mu. Na ɔfiri Ekumfi Essarkyir a ɛwɔ Central Region of Ghana. Ɔwiee sukuu no nyaa sikasɛm mu abodin krataa wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu.[5]

Adwuma 
Codjoe na ɔyɛ ɔman no sohwɛfoɔ wɔ NCR (Ghana) Limited a ɛwɔ Accra.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Codjoe yɛ New Patriotic Party amanyɔkuo ni .

2016 abatoɔ 
Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du- nsia mu Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu no, ɔdii nkonim wɔ Ekumfi abatoɔ mpasua mmarahyɛbadwa no mu a ɔnyaa mma mpem du mmienu,  ahanu ne aduanan(12,240) a ɛyɛ ɔha mu abupɛn aduonum akyire po baako  (50.1%) wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu berɛ a National Democratic Congress mmarahyɛbadwa mu kandifoɔ Abeiku Crentsil nyaa abatoɔ mpem du- baako ahensia aduasa - mmienu (11,632) a ɛyɛɛ ɔha mu abupɛn aduanan nson Akyire po nsia (47.6%) wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu, Progressive People's Party mmarahyɛbadwa kandifoɔ  Stephen Quansah nyaa mma,Ahenum ne num (505votes) a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu ɔha mu abupɛn mmienu akyire po baako (2.1%) na 'Convention People's Party mmarahyɛbadwa kandifoɔ Kweku Essuoun nyaa mma aduoson (70) a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu ɔha mu hwee akyire po mmiɛnsa  (0.3%).

Ɔsomfo 
Codjoe yɛ Ɔsoafoɔ Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Mpataayie ne Nsuo ho nsɛm ho firi Ayɛwohomumɔ bosome da ɛtɔ so du- baako wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du- nson  kɔsi  Ɔbɛnem bosome da ɛtɔ so nson wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu - baako. 

2020 abatoɔ

Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu mu no wɔ Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu no, ɔhweree Ekumfi abatoɔ mpasua mmarahyɛbadwa akondwa  no maa National Democratic Congress mmarahyɛbadwani  Abeiku Crentsil. Ɔdii nkogu wɔ bere a ɔnyaa mma mpem du- mmiɛnsa,  ahenan ne aduosia - nnwɔtwe (13,468votes ) a ɛyɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu ɔha mu abupɛn Aduanan - num ( 45.0%)  berɛ a Abeiku nyaa mma mpem du- nsia ne aduasa - nsia (16,037votes ) a ɛyɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu Ɔha mu abupɛn aduonum - mmiɛnsa akyire po nsia (53.6%), GUM mmarahyɛbadwani Regina Amoah nyaa abatoɔ 371 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ nyinaa mu 1.2% ne Convention People's Party mmarahyɛbadwa kandifoɔ Ibrahim Anderson nyaa abatoɔ 0 a ɛyɛɛ 0.0% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu.

title: Abraham Dwuma Oddom
text:
Abraham Dwuma Odoom yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ na ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanin a ɛtɔ so nnan Mmarahyɛ Bagua a ɛtɔ so nson no muni a ɔgyina Twifo Atti-Morkwa Mansin ananmu wɔ Central Region wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so. Wɔkyerɛ sɛ ɔno na ɔyɛɛ adwene a wɔakyerɛw wɔ Nigeria aburoo a wɔyɛ ho asɛm a ‘edii yie’ no akyi.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Odoom wɔ 11 August 1952 na ɔfiri Twifo Ayaase wɔ Central Region of Ghana. Ɔwɔ adansedie krataa wɔ Amanyɔsɛm ne Sikasɛm mu Nsakyeraeɛ mu wɔ J. F. Kennedy School of Governance, Harvard University mu wɔ afe 2007 mu na ɔsane nso wɔ Diploma wɔ Akontaabuo mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu wɔ afe 1979 mu.

Adwuma 
Odoom yɛ Lead Consultant wɔ Cocoa Redevelopment mu firi June 2016 kɔsi 6 January 2017. Ɔsane nso yɛɛ adwuma wɔ Ministry of Agriculture and Natural Resources wɔ Akwa Ibom State wɔ Nigeria. Na ɔsane yɛ Nhyehyɛeɛ ho Ɔfotufoɔ wɔ Bill/Melinda Gates/J. Kufuor Foundation Akansie Afrika Aburow Dwumadie a ɛwɔ Nigeria firi afe 2014 kɔsi May 2016.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Odoom yɛ New Patriotic Party no muni. Na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛ badwani wɔ Twifo Atti-Morkwa Mansin mu wɔ Central Region of Ghana firi afe 2017 kɔsi afe 2021.

2016 abatoɔ 
Wɔ afe 2016 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu no, Odoom dii nkonim wɔ Twifo Atti Morkwa Constituency mmarahyɛ badwa no mu. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ 21,231 a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 58.2% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu berɛ a NDC mmarahyɛ badwa kandifoɔ Samuel Ato Amoah nyaa abatoɔ 14,887 a ɛyɛɛ 40.8% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu, PPP mmarahyɛ badwa kandifoɔ Abu Ayuba nyaa abatoɔ 273 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 0.8% na CPP mmarahyɛ bagua kandifoɔ Ebenezer Appiah nyaa abatoɔ 115 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 0.3%.

Ɔsomfoɔ 
Odoom yɛ kan Ɔmanpanyin Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Akwahosan so wɔ Kufuor nniso no mu.

Ɔyɛ kan Ɔmanpanyin Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Mpɔtam Aban so.

Boayikuo no 
Na Odoom yɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua Boayikuw a Wɔapaw a Ɛhwɛ Aduan ne Kuadwuma So no muni ne Titenani Abadiakyiri.

Ankorankorɛ asetena 
Odoom yɛ Kristoni.

Abasobɔdeɛ ahorow 
Wɔ afe 2004 mu no, ɔdaa ne ho adi sɛ Ɔmantam Panyin a ɔsen biara ma Twifo Hemang Lower Denkyira Mantam Nhyiam a na ɛwɔ hɔ saa bere no wɔ Ghana.[9]

Wɔ November 2019 mu no, wɔmaa no Nkwa Nna Nyinaa Nkɔsoɔ Honorary Award.[13]

Adɔeyɛ 
Wɔ June 2018 mu no, ɔde moto maa akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ ne kuayɛ ntrɛmu adwumayɛfoɔ wɔ ne mantam mu.

title: Albert Akuka Alaalzuga
text: Akuka Albert Alalzuuga yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ ne Mmarahyɛ Bagua a ɛtɔ so nson a ɛwɔ Ghana Republic of the Fourth Republic no muni a ɔgyina Garu Constituency ananmu wɔ Upper East Region wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so

title: Ussif Mustapha
text:
Mustapha Ussif (wɔwoo no Ɔbɛnem 16, afe 1979) yɛ Ghana ɔmanyɛfo. Ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party no muni na ɔyɛ Ghana Republic of 4th mmarahyɛ badwa no mu ni a ɔgyina Yagaba-Kubori abatoɔ mpesua no ananmu wɔ North East mantam no mu wɔ Ghana. Wɔ 21 Ɔbɛnem 2021 no, Nana Akufo-Addo yii no sɛ ɔnsom sɛ Mmabun ne Agumadi ho Ɔsoafoɔ.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Ussif wɔ ɔsanaa bosome no da a ɛtɔ so du nsia wɔ afe 1979. Ɔfiri Tantaala a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Fam Mantam mu. Ɔsuaa adeɛ wɔ Bagabaga Akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ Nteteeɛ Kɔlege ne Anglia Ruskin Suapɔn mu baabi a ɔnyaa ne Bachelor of Arts abodin krataa wɔ Amanaman Ntam Adwumayɛ ne Adwumayɛ mu wɔ afe 2010. Ɔtoaa so wɔ Gloucestershire Suapɔn mu baabi a ɔwiee wɔ afe 2011 mu a ɔnyaa abodin krataa wɔ Sikasɛm ne Sikasɛm mu.

Adwuma 
Ussif yɛɛ adwuma sɛ Investment Analyst wɔ Ray and Associates, UK wɔ afe 2010. Saa afe no ara mu no, ɔde ne ho kɔbɔɔ Action Aid UK baabi a ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ Freelance Consultant.

Amanyɔsɛm

Mmarahyɛ Badwa no mu adwuma 
Ussif kɔɔ mmarahyɛ badwa mu wɔ Ɔbɛnem bosome no da a ɛtɔ so nson wɔ afe 2013 mu wɔ New Patriotic Party tekiti so bere a ɔdii mmarahyɛ badwam ni a saa mmerɛ no na ɔwɔ hɔ mprempren, Abdul-Rauf Tanko Ibrahim so nkonim no. Ɔgyinaa Yagaba-Kubori Mansin ananmu firi afe 2013 kɔsi afe 2017 wɔ mmarahyɛ badwa a ɛtɔ so nsia no mu nanso ɛno akyi no ɔdii nkoguo wɔ mmɔden a ɔbɔeɛ sɛ wɔbɛsan ayi no akɔ mmarahyɛ badwa a ɛtɔ so nson no mu wɔ ne kane sɔretiafoɔ Abdul-Rauf Tanko Ibrahim a ɔfiri National Democratic Congress mu wɔ afe 2016 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu. Wɔ saa mmarahyɛ badwa a ɛtɔ so nsia (6) no mu no, ɔsom wɔ Mines and Energy Committee, ne Standing Orders Committee no mu.

Ɔgyinaa NPP mmarahyɛ badwa mfitiaseɛ abatoɔ wɔto no wɔ amanyɔkuo no ara mu a obi ara ansɔre antia no na wɔbɔɔ no dawuro sɛ ɔno ne onipa a ɔbɛgyina akuo no ananmu wɔ 2020 ɔpɛnimaa abatoɔ no mu. Ɔdii mmarahyɛbadwani Abdul-Rauf Tanko Ibrahim a ɔhyiaa no mprenu wɔ abatoɔ a atwam no mu no so nkunim bio. Ɔde mma 18,153 a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyɛmu 64.01% dii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ  no mu berɛ a nea ɔne no reko no nyaa abatoɔ no mu mma 9,393 a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 33.14%

NSS no sohwɛfo panyin 
Wɔ afe mpem mmienu ne du nson (2017) mu no, ɔmampanyin, Nana Akufo-Addo na ɔyii no sɛ ɔnyɛ Ɔman Ɔsom Nhyehyɛeɛ no kwankyerɛfoɔ panyin wɔ n’aban bere a ɛdi kan no mu.

Mmabun ne Agodie ho soafo 
Bere a ɔsan dii nkonim wɔ Yagaba-Kubori abatoɔ mpesua no so mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no mu wɔ afe 2020 mu no, Ɔmampanyin Nana Akufo-Addo yii no wɔ Ɔbɛnem bosome no da a ɛtɔ so aduonu baako wɔ afe 2021 mu sɛ ɔnsom sɛ Mmabun ne Agodie ho soafoɔ wɔ n'amanmuo a ɛtɔ so mmienu no mu. Bere a ɔfaa nhwehwɛmu mu wɔ Ghana Mmarahyɛbadwan mu na wɔgyee no toom no wɔkaa ntam sɛ ɔbɛdi dwuma wɔ  Oforisuo bosome no da a ɛtɔ no num wɔ afe 2021 ne asomfoɔ foforɔ aduonu nson (27) a wɔayi wɔn wɔ Jubilee House, Accra.

Ankorankoro asetena 
Ussif aware a ɔwɔ mma mmienu. Ɔkyerɛ sɛ ɔyɛ Nkramoni.[4][5]

title: Joseph Dindiock Kpemka
text:
Joseph Dindiok Kpemka yɛ Ghana amammuofoɔ ne Mmarahyɛ Bagua a ɛtɔ so nson a ɛwɔ Ghana Republic of the Fourth Republic no muni a ɔgyina Tempane Mansin a ɛwɔ Upper East Region ananmu wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so.

Nwomasua 
Ɔnya Bachelor of Arts abodin krataa wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu ne LLB wɔ The Ghana School of Law.

Adwuma 
Ɔkyerɛɛ Borɔfo kasa wɔ Ghana Nwomasua Dwumadibea firi afe 2002 kɔsi afe 2005. Efiri afe 2008 kɔsi afe 2009 na ɔyɛɛ Ɔmansin Panyin. Ɔbɛyɛɛ mmaranimfoɔ na ɔmaa ɔkasa wɔ Bolgatanga Technical University firi afe 2009 kɔsi afe 2016.

Wɔ afe 2020 amansan abatoɔ no mu no, wantumi ankura n’akonnwa mu tiaa asɔretiafoɔ, Miss Lydia Akanvariba Lamisi a ɔfiri National Democratic Congress (NDC). Ɔnyaa abatoɔ 16,462 tiaa abatoɔ 20,939 maa NDC kandifoɔ no.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Stephen Nana Ato Arthur
text:
Stephen Nana Ato Arthur yɛ mmarahyɛ baguani ma Komenda-Edina-Ehuafo-Abirem wɔ Ghana Mfinimfini mantam mu.

Ankorankora asetena 
Nana aware a ɔwɔ mma baasa. Ɔyɛ Kristoni (Katolekni).

Abrabɔ mfitiase  ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Nana wɔ 24 December 1961 wɔ Abrem Berase wɔ Central mantam mu.Ɔkɔɔ KNUST baabi a na ɔwɔ MSc wɔ Development Planning and Management mu. Ɔsan nso nyaa PG Dip wɔ Ɔmantam Nhyehyɛe ne Adwumayɛ mu wɔ Universitat Dortmund wɔ Germany. Ɔsan nso nyaa ne BSc wɔ Eng mu wɔ South China Kuadwuma Sukuupɔn a ɛwɔ Guangzhou, China.Ɔsan nso nyaa PhD wɔ Nkɔsoɔ Adesua mu wɔ Center of Development Research wɔ University of Bonn wɔ afe 2012 mu wɔ Germany.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Nana yɛ Ɔman Ho Dɔ Kuw Foforo no muni. Ɔyɛ Ɔmantam Soafoɔ wɔ Central Regional Coordinating Council wɔ Cape Coast firi May 2006-January 2009.Ɔyɛ ɔmantam Ɔsoafoɔ Abadiakyiri wɔ Central Regional Coordinating Council wɔ Cape Coast firi May 2005- May 2006.Ɔyɛ DCE wɔ Komenda-Edina-Eguafo-Abrem Mantam Nhyiamu no mu firi Oforisuo 2001-May 2005 wɔ Elmina.

Adwuma 
Na ɔyɛ Engineer wɔ Ghana Irrigation Development Authority (GIDA) a ɛwɔ Accra firi March 1991- December 1998. Ɔyɛ Ɔman Nnwuma Bagua a ɛwɔ Nkran no Adwumayɛ ho Ɔfotufoɔ firi December 1998-March 2001.Ɔyɛ mprempren Amanaman Nkabom Fekuw a Ɛhwɛ Ɔmanfo Adwumayɛ ne Nnwuma So (CAPAM) no titrani Abadiakyiri,

Bia a Mmoa Efiri

title: Frank Fuseini Adongo
text:
Frank Fuseini Adongo yɛ amanyɔni a ɔwɔ Ghana Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni. Ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party no muni ne ɔmantam no mu mmarahyɛbadwani no abadiakyiri wɔ Atifi-Apueeɛ a ɛwɔ Ghana.

Amammui asetena 
Wɔ March 2017 mu no, Ɔmanpanyin Nana Akufo-Addo, bɔɔ ne din sɛ ɔmantam asomfo abadiakyiri du a wɔbɛka n’aban no ho no mu biako. Ghana Mmarahyɛ Bagua no Appointments Committee no hwehwɛɛ ne mu wɔ saa bosome no ara mu. Boayikuw no penee so na wɔde ne din kɔmaa Mmarahyɛ Bagua no Kasafoɔ no. Mmarahyɛ bagua no fie kɛse no gyee ne toom bio.

title: Dominic Aduna Bingab Nitiwul
text:
Dominic Aduna Bingab Nitiwul (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛpɔn 4, 1977) yɛ Ghana amannyɔni  ne mmarahyɛbadwani  (MP) ma Bimbilla mansini a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Mantam mu. Ɔsan nso asom wɔ Pan-African Mmarahyɛ Badwa no mu. Efiri Ɔpɛpɔn bosome no mu wɔ afe 2017 no, Nitiwul ayɛ Ghana Ɔman Bammɔ Soafoɔ dibea.

Mfitiasea asetena ne nwomasua 
Dominic Nitiwul suaa adeɛ wɔ nwomasua asoɛeɛ ahodoɔ mu wɔ Ghana, Germany, ne United Kingdom. Dominic wiee ne O level wɔ St Charles Secondary and Seminary School wɔ afe 1992. Wɔ Germany no ɔnyaa adansedie nkrataa wɔ ntawntawdie ano aduru (2003) ne ntawntawdie ho dwumadie (2005) mu firii Amanaman Ntam Akannifoɔ Adesuabea. Ɔnyaa ne Master of Business Administration wɔ sikasɛm mu wɔ South Wales Suapɔn mu, ne ne Master of Laws wɔ nnwuma sikasɛm mu wɔ Westminster Suapɔn mu.

Amanyɔsɛm

mmarahyɛbadwam adwuma 
Wɔyii Nitiwul sɛ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwani  wɔ afe 2002 mu bere a na wadi mfeɛ 25. Wɔ ne nkonimdie kasa no mu no, ɔtwee adwene sii nokwasɛm a ɛyɛ sɛ ɔpɛ sɛ wɔma no abasobɔdeɛ wɔ asomdwoe dodoɔ a ɔde bɛba mansin no mu no so. Yei firi mmusuakuo ntam ntawantawadie a ɛkɔɔ so bere tenten wɔ Konkombafoɔ ne Nanumbafoɔ ntam no. Ɔsomm wɔ badwakuo bebree mu wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛ badwa ne Pan-African Mmarahyɛ badwa no nyinaa mu. Yeinom bi ne: Sikasɛm badwakuo , Sikasɛm ne Sika ho ntotoeɛ badwakuo , Adwumayɛ badwakuo , badwakuo a Wɔpaw Nnipa, Mmabun ne Agodie badwakuo , Akwan ne Kar badwakuo , ne Nwomasua badwakuo. Ɔyɛɛ Ghana Mmarahyɛ Badwa no Kannifoɔ Abadiakyiri wɔ afe 2012 kɔsi afe 2016.

2016 Mmarahyɛ Badwa no abatoɔ 
Nitiwul dii nkonim wɔ afe 2016 Mmarahyɛ Badwa abatoɔ mu maa ne mansin no ɔdii National Democratic Congress ananmusini Dr Joseph Mamboah Rockson so nkonim. Ansa na wɔreyɛ abatoɔ no na Nitiwul aka sɛ ɔbɛdi nkonim esiane nokwasɛm a ɛyɛ sɛ nea ɔne no reko no nyɛ mansin no mu ni na ɔnnim nea ɛrekɔ so wɔ mansin no mu nti; ɔsan nso kaa nkɔsoɔ adwuma pii a wayɛ ho asɛm. Nea ɔsɔre tia no no nyaa adwene sɛ Nitiwul asom akyɛ dodo na ɔgye di sɛ wɔn a wɔyii no no hia anim foforɔ.

Nkɔsoɔ nnwuma 
Nitiwul ahyɛ aseɛ reyɛ nkɔsoɔ adwuma wɔ Bamboi sɛdeɛ ɛbɛyɛ a wɔn a wɔyii no no tebea bɛyɛ yie. Ɔmaa wɔtuu nsubura aduosia nkron (69) wɔ mpɔtam ahodoɔ mu wɔ ne mansini no mu, na ɔmaa abadwakuo a wɔhwɛ anyinam nkanea so wɔ ɔman Ghana mu no trɛɛ anyinam ahoɔden mu kɔɔ mpɔtam dunsia (16). Ɔsii ayaresabea mmienu, akwan ho adwuma dumienu, ne adesuadan mu adan ahodoɔ.

Ɔman Bammɔ Soafoɔ 
Wɔ Ɔbɛnem bosome no da a ɛtɔ so du mmiensa wɔ afe 2017 no, na Nitiwul ka asomfoɔ kuo a ɛdi kan a Ɔmampanyin Nana Akuffo-Addo yii wɔn no ho. Ne din a wɔde too dwa no yɛ asoeɛ a ɛhwɛ Bammɔ so (Ministry of Defence). Wɔyɛɛ yei bere a ne kuo, New Patriotic Party, gyee tumi wɔ afe 2016 Ghana amansan abatow mu akyi. Ghana mmarahyɛ badwa no mufoɔ penee Nitiwul so sɛ ɔnyɛ ɔsom adwuma no, ne afoforɔ nwɔtwe. Ɔmampanyin Akuffo-Addo na ɔhyɛ maa ne kaa ntam wɔ Ɔbɛnem bosome no da a ɛtɔ so aduono nson 2017. wɔ din a wɔde kɔmaa mmarahyɛ badwa no sɛ wɔmfa nnye ntom wɔ Ɔbɛnem bosome no da a ɛtɔ so aduonu baako wɔ afe 2021 no, ɔmampanyin yii Owura Nitiwul sɛ ɔnkɔ so nkura ne somfoɔ dibea sɛ Ɔman Bammɔ soafoɔ.

Galamsey ko 
Nitiwul ama ɔko a ɔde bɛko atia wɔn a wɔtu famgudeɛ a mmara mma ho kwan, a wonim wɔn sɛ galamsefoɔ no ayɛ ne botae titire no mu baako sɛ Ɔman Bammɔ Soafoɔ. Wɔn a wɔyɛ adwuma a mmara mma ho kwan no tu dadeɛ a ɛsom bo wɔ Ghana mmeaeɛ ahodoɔ a won nwene nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia ho kɛse anaasɛ  won nwene ho koraa. Nsuo dodoɔ bi a ɛwɔ ɔman no mu ayiri ɛnam nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia  ɛnam sɛ wɔtu no nti, na wɔde nnuru a ɛpira te sɛ cyanide agu nsuo a wɔnom ho fĩ. Ná nnisoɔ ahodoɔ a atwam no abɔ mmɔden sɛ wɔbɛsi famgudeɛ a mmara mma ho kwan no ano na wɔantumi esiane mmɔden a wɔammɔ abom nti. Bere a ɔne Ghana Asraafo asraafo mpanyimfo ne Asase ne Abɔdeɛ mu Nneɛma Ho Dwumadibea no yɛɛ adwuma no, Nitiwul boa ma wɔhyehyɛɛ akwan a wɔbɛfa so agye mfidie, afiri wɔn a wɔtu famgudeɛ no afiri hɔ, na wɔasan de nsase a asɛe wɔ ɔman no mu asi hɔ.

Basabasayɛfoɔ atɛntɛnenee ko 
Bere a wɔkumm Ɔsahene Maxwell Mahama wɔ Kɔtɔnimaa bosome no mu wɔ afe 2017 mu no, Nitiwul hyɛɛ bɔ sɛ wɔbɛhyɛ nhwehwɛmu a ɛdi mũ ase de ahu na wɔakyere wɔn a wɔyɛɛ bɔne no. Na Diasofo binom ayɛ mfomso akum Ɔsahene Mahama ɛfiri sɛ na wɔsusu sɛ ɔyɛ adwowtwafoɔ a ɔkura akodeɛ.

Kabinet Ɔmanpanyin 
Wɔ Kɔtɔnimaa bosome no mu wɔ afe, 2017 mu no, Ɔmanpanyin Nana Akufo-Addo bɔɔ Dominic Nitiwul din sɛ asomfoɔ dunkron a wɔbɛhyehyɛ ne kabinet no fã. Wɔde asomfoɔ dunkron (19) no din kɔmaa Ghana Mmarahyɛ Badwa no na Aban no Kasafo, Rt. Hon. Ɔbenfo Mike Ocquaye. Sɛ́ Kabinet soafoɔ no, Nitiwul yɛ ɔmampanyin no mu kuo no fã na ɛsɛ sɛ ɔboa wɔ gyinaesi dwumadi atitiriw mu wɔ ɔman no mu.

Ankorankoro asetena 
Nitiwul aware a ɔwɔ mma num.

title: Benson Tongo Baaba
text:
Benson Tongo Baba (ɔwoo no 23 September 1948) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne Mmarahyɛ-Bagua a ɛtɔ so nson a ɛwɔ Fourth Republic of Ghana no muni a ɔgyina Talensi Mansin ananmu wɔ Atifi-Apueeɛ Mantam mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so.

Mfitiase Asetena ne Nhomasua 
Benson fi Tengzuk-Tongo. Ɔwɔ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo Cert A a efi Pusiga Ntetee Kɔlege ne Nhomasua Sukuupɔn Winneba.

Beaɛ a Nsɛm no firi

title: Kojo Asemanyi
text:
Kojo Asemanyi yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ ne Mmarahyɛ Bagua a ɛtɔ so nson a ɛwɔ Ghana Aman a ɛtɔ so nnan no muni a ɔgyina Gomoa Apueeɛ Mansin ananmu wɔ Central Region wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so.Ɔyɛ Pentekoste Asɔre no mu Panyin na ɔyɛ Kristoni, ɔyɛ agya. Mprempren ɔyɛ Cape Coast Mayor.

Abrabɔ Ashasiɛ ni Adesua 
Wɔwoo Asemanyi wɔ 10 September 1979 na ɔfiri Gomoa Buduatta wɔ Central Region wɔ Ghana. Ná ɔwɔ ne Ɔman Abodin krataa a Ɛkorɔn wɔ Cape Coast Polytechnic. Ɔnyaa ne bachelor’s degree wɔ Management Studies mu wɔ University of Cape Coast wɔ afe 2011. Ɔsan nyaa ne master’s degree wɔ Public Administration mu wɔ University of Phoenix wɔ Arizona wɔ USA..

Adwuma 
Asemanyi yɛɛ adwuma wɔ US Postal Service sɛ Rural Carrier Associate wɔ Delaware wɔ USA firi afe 2013 kɔsi afe 2016.Ɔsan nso yɛ Program Officer wɔ World Vision Ghana firi afe 2005 kɔsi afe 2008. Ɔsan nso yɛ Sales supervisor ma Tigo firi afe 2008 kɔsi afe 2012. Ɔsan nso yɛ Production Associate ma Nixon Uniforms firi afe 2012 kɔsi afe 2013..

Amanyɔsɛm 
Asemanyi ɛka NPP kuo ni hwo. Ogyina wɔ NPP abatoɔ akansie mu di nkunim tia Dr Marqus Yaw Danso. Na ɔyɛ  Mmrahyɛbadwani ma Gomoa East Constituency wɔ Central Region.

2016 abatoɔ 

Ɔdii Desmond De-Graft Paitoo so nkonim wɔ afe 2016 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu de dii nkonim wɔ Gomoa East Constituency mmarahyɛ bagua no mu. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ 17,654 a ɔyɛɛ 50.0% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu berɛ a Desmond nyaa abatoɔ 15,010 a ɛyɛɛ 42.5% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu, Independent candidate Marcus Yaw Danso a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 1,604 yɛɛ 4.5% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu, Eunice Assuman a ɔfiri PPP a ɔno nso nyaa abatoɔ 920 a ɛyɛɛ 2.6% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu na Godfred Kumedzro Cudjo a ɔfiri CPP nyaa abatoɔ 105 a ɛyɛɛ 0.3% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu.

Boayikuw no

Na Asemanyi yɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no Boayikuw a Wɔapaw a Ɛhwɛ Agumadi So no Titenani Abadiakyiri.

2020 abatoɔ

Asemanyi hweree Gomoa East Constituency mmarahyɛ bagua atenaeɛ wɔ afe 2020 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu maa NDC mmarahyɛ bagua kandifoɔ Desmond De-Graft Paitoo.Ɔdii nkogu wɔ abatoɔ 35,873 a ɔyɛɛ 48.4% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu berɛ a Desmond nyaa abatoɔ 36,637 a ɛyɛɛ 49.5% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu, Samuel Kofi Essel a ɔfiri GUM a ɔnyaa abatoɔ 1,397 a ɔyɛɛ 1.89% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu ne Emmanuel Otchere a ɔfiri UPP a nso nyaa abatoɔ 173 a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu 0.23%.

Ankorankora asetena 
Asemanyi ɛyɛ Kristo ni.

Adɔyɛ 
Wɔ June 2017 mu no, ɔde ayaresabea mpa bɛyɛ 15 maa Gomoa Nyanyano Akwahosan Asoɛe, Buduatta Akwahosan Asoɛe ne Ojobi Akwahosan Asoɛe a ɛwɔ Mfinimfini Mantam mu.

Wɔ June 2019 mu no, Asemanyi de premix fuel bɛyɛ lita 35,000 maa apofofoɔ bɛyɛ 2,300 a wɔwɔ Central Region of Ghana.

Wɔ December 2019 mu wɔ Okuafoɔ ne Apofoɔ Da Afahyɛ wɔ Gomoa Apueeɛ mu no, ɔde sakre mmiɛnsa maa okuafoɔ a ɔyɛ papa.

Bia  ɛmmoa efiri

title: Duut Emmanuel Kwame
text:
Emmanuel Kwame Duut (wɔwoo no 6 ayɛwohomumɔ 1959) yɛ Ghana amannyɔni na ɔyɛ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nnan no Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so nnum no muni a ɔgyina Bunkpurugu-Yungoo Mansin ananmu wɔ Ghana Atifi Mantam mu.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Duut wɔ Ayɛwohomumɔ bosome no da a ɛtɔ so nsia wɔ afe 1959 mu wɔ Najong, wɔ Ghana Atifi Fam Mantam mu. Ɔkɔɔ Nwomasua Sukuupɔn, Winneba (UEW) wɔ afe 2004 mu na ɔnyaa Bachelor of Education (B.Ed.).

Adwuma 
Na ɔyɛ Bunkpurugu-Yunyoo Senior High School Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ Boafoɔ ne mmarahyɛ badwani ma Bunkpurugu-Yunyoo Mansin (2009-2013).

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔdii kan yii no sɛ ɔmmra mmarahyɛ badwa no mu wɔ National Democratic Congress (NDC) tekiti so wɔ ɔpɛnimaa bosome no mu wɔ afe 2008 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu sɛ Mmarahyɛ Badwa no mu ni ma Bunkpurugu-Yunyoo Mansini a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Mantam mu. Wɔ afe 2008 abatoɔ no mu no, ɔnyaa abatoɔ no mu mma 9,205 wɔ abatoɔ a nnipa dodoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa yɛ 32,078 a ɛfata a wɔtoo no mu a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 28.7%. Ɔsan sii akan wɔ afe 2012 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu na Solomon Namliit Boar a ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party no mu ni a ɔnyaa abatoɔ no mu mma 10,829 a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 38.85% dii no so nkonim. Ɔdii mfeɛ baako pɛ sɛ mmarahyɛ badwani.

Ankorankoro asetena 
Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma nkron. Ɔyɛ Kristoni na ɔyɛ Katolek Asɔre no mu ni.

title: Zenator Agyeman Rawlings
text:
Zanetor (wɔbɔ no Zɑ-nɛ-tɔ) Agyeman-Rawlings (Dr.) (wɔwoo no 1 Ayɛwohomumɔ 1978) yɛ Ghana aduruyɛ ho oduruyɛfoɔ, ɔmanyɛni, Activist & Campaigner[3] a ɔyɛ Ɔmampanyin a ɔdi kan  wɔ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nnan no, Jerry Rawlings babaa panyin  (1993–2001) ne kan ɔbaa a ɔdi kan wɔ Nana Konadu Agyeman[4] (1993–2001) ase. Ɔyɛ Ghana mmarahyɛ badwani ma Klottey-Korle Mansini no[5] na ɔyɛ aduruyɛ ho oduruyɛfoɔ ne nnipa mmoa ho ɔbenfo. Ɔsan nso yɛ National Democratic Congress (NDC) a ɔdii nkonim wɔ amanyɔkuo no din mu sɛ ɔbɛyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ama ne mansini no mu foɔ.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Agyeman-Rawlings wɔ  Ayɛwohomumɔ bosome no da a ɛdi kan wɔ afe 1978 wɔ Accra, Ghana wɔ Abibirem Atɔeɛ fam. Ɔfiri Dzelukope a ɛwɔ Volta Mantam no mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔkɔɔ North Ridge Lyceum sukuu ne Achimota Sukuu maa ne mfitiaseɛ nwomasua. Afei ɔwiee Wesley Mmabaa Ntoasoɔ Sukuu a ɛwɔ Cape Coast wɔ afe 1996 mu.

Esiane sɛ na ne papa wɔ amammuo akonnwa no so nti, bere a na ɔyɛ abɔfra no, Zanetor de ne bere dodoɔ no ara tenaa ne maame, kane ɔbaa a ɔdi kan, Nana Konadu Agyeman Rawlings. Zanetor kɔɔ Royal College of Surgeons wɔ Ireland kɔyɛɛ n’aduruyɛ ho abɔdin krataa. Ɔsan nso wɔ adansedie nkrataa wɔ ahobanbɔ ho dwumadie ne ntawantawadie ne ɔhaw ho dwumadie mu firi Ghana Armed Forces Command and Staff College. Ɔsan nso wɔ Masters Degree adansedie krataa wɔ Ntawantawadie, Asomdwoe ne Ahobammɔ (EMCPS) mu firi Kofi Annan Amanaman Ntam Asomdwoe ne Ntetee Asoɛe (KAIPTC).

Adwuma

Aduruyɛ mu adwuma 
Agyeman-Rawlings yɛɛ adwuma sɛ oduruyɛfoɔ wɔ ayaresabea a wɔhwɛ ayarefoɔ nyinaa wɔ n’adwuma mfiaseɛ. Ɔde ne ho ahyɛ fapem ne nnwuma ahodoɔ a ɛbɔ mmaa ne mmɔfra hokwan ahodoɔ ho ban na ɛma ahoteɛ tu mpɔn wɔ Ghana mu.

Nnipa mmoa adwuma 
Agyeman-Rawlings adi anim wɔ mmoa mmɔdenbɔ ahodoɔ mu de abrɛ amanehunu a nnipa pii a tebea bi ayɛ wɔn ayayadeɛ no ase. Wɔ Ayɛwohomumɔ bosome no mu wɔ afe 2015 mu no, ɔdii kuo bi anim ma wɔde mmoa nneɛma maeɛ maa wɔn a Goil Oil gya ne nsuyiriɛ asiane a ɛkunkum Ghanafoɔ bɛyɛ 150 na ɛmaa nnipa pii tu firi wɔn afie mu no. Ɔsan nso sii bridge maa Osu Anorhor mpɔtam hɔfoɔ a aboa ma nsuyiri ne akwantuo a ɛnyɛ den wɔ mpɔtam hɔ ho asɛm no so ate. Wɔ Oforisuo bosome no mu wɔ afe 2014 mu no, na Ɔbenfoɔ Rawlings yɛ ɔhɔhoɔ titire wɔ Afrika Mmaa Nhyiamu soronko a ɛwɔ crans-Montana Forum on Africa ne South-South Cooperation a ɛwɔ Dakhla no nhyehyɛeɛ mu, a na ne botaeɛ ne sɛ ɛbɛhyɛ wiase a nnipa wɔ nnipa ne animhwɛ kɛseɛ ho nkuran.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ná Agyeman-Rawlings akɔ so atena amammuosɛm mu asɛm titiriw no akyi wɔ n’asetra fã kɛseɛ no ara mu. Wɔ Ayɛwohomumɔ bosome no mu wɔ afe 2015 mu, berɛ a na ɔresom sɛ Ɔnanmusifoɔ ama TV3 sika a wɔboaboa ano ɔsatuo, "TV3 Ayɛwohomumɔ bosome no da a ɛtɔ so mmiensa Atɔrenkyɛm ho mmoa fotoɔ( Disaster Support Fund)", a na wɔn botaeɛ ne sɛ wɔbɛboaboa sika ano de aboa wɔn a nsuyiri ne ogya asiane a ɛsiiɛ wɔ  Ayɛwohomumɔ bosome no da a ɛtɔ so mmiensa no mu no, amanneɛbɔ bi wɔ hɔ a ɛkyerɛe sɛ ɔde ne mmoa mmɔdenbɔ no redi dwuma de afiri amammuo ɔsatuo bi ase. Ɔpoo amanneɛbɔ ahodoɔ no a ɔkae sɛ ne dwumadie ahodoɔ a ɔyɛe wɔ adapɛn no mu no gyinaa so sɛ ɔbɛboaboa sika ano ama wɔn a asiane no asɛe wɔn no

Mmarahyɛbadwa no mu mmɔdenbɔ 
Wɔ  ɛbɔ bosome no da a ɛtɔ so du baako wɔ afe 2015 mu no, Ɔbenfoɔ Agyeman-Rawlings de ne din krataa kɔeɛ sɛ ɔbɛsi akan wɔ Korle Klottey mmarahyɛ badwa primaries no mu sɛ Mmarahyɛ Badwa no mu ni, na ɔne Korle Klottey MP a ɔwɔ hɔ seesei Nii Armah Ashitey ne Leeford Kpakpo Quarshie sii akan no.

Bere a wɔde ne din a wɔde too dwa no kɔe no, ɔkɔɔ so kae sɛ na ɔnni amammuo mu atirimpɔw biara na ne gyinaesi sɛ ɔbesi akan no yɛ nnansa yi ara. Sɛnea ɔkyerɛ no, na ne ho a ɔde hyɛɛ mu no gyina ɔfrɛ a nnipa pii de mae sɛ wɔmfa wɔn ho nhyɛ amammuo nsɛm mu, a ɛfiri n’ahoteɛ ɔsatuo ne nneɛma afoforo a atwa yɛn ho ahyia ho adwuma mu bae no so. Efiri saa bere no nyinaa, ne papa a na ɔyɛ kane ɔmampanyin no apene ne babaa no gyinaesie no so.

Mmarahyɛbadwa  no mu ni 
Ɔdii nkonim wɔ  Ɔbɛnem bosome no da a ɛtɔ so du wɔ afe 2015 primaries maa Korley Klottey mantam a ɛwɔ Greater Accra mantam no na ɔkɔɔ so dii nkonim wɔ mmarahyɛbadwam akonnwa no abatoɔ mu wɔ afe 2016 Ghana amansan abatoɔ a wɔyɛɛ no ɔpɛnimaa bosome no da a ɛtɔ so nson wɔ afe 2016 mu.Mprempren yi ɔyɛ Klottey Korle Mansini no mmarahyɛbadwani . Ɔsom wɔ Bɔbeasu ne Mmɔfra badwakuo ne Nneɛma a Atwa Yɛn Ho Ahyia, Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma badwakuo no mu. Ɔkuraa n'akonwa so Wɔ afe 2020 amansan abatoɔ no mu.

Ankorankoro asetena 
Zanetor Agyeman-Rawlings wɔ mma mmiɛnsa.

title: Habiab Saad
text:
Habib Saad yɛ Ghana amannyɔni ne mmarahyɛbadwani a na ɔka mmarahyɛbadwa a Ɛtɔ so nson no mu ni a ɔgyina Bortianor-Ngleshie-Amanfro Mansin ananmu wɔ Greater Accra Mantam no mu wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so.

Abrabɔ ahyɛaseɛ 
Wɔwoo Habib Saad Ahinimie bosome no da a ɛtɔ so du wɔ afe apem ahankron aduosia nwɔtwe (1968) mu wɔ Antoakrom wɔ Asante Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. ɔyɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne Mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛtɔ so nson no mu ni wɔ wɔ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nan no mu, na ɔgyina Bortianor-Ngleshie-Amanfro Mansin ananmu wɔ Greater Accra Mantam mu wɔ ɔsono amanyɔkuo NPP din mu

Nwomasua 
Ɔnyaa ne Bachelor of Arts wɔ Techno Global University, a ɛwɔ India. Habib Saad ayɛ Go Enterprise no mu Managing Director firi afe mpem mmienu (2000) de bɛsi nnɛ.

title: Alexandar Kodwo Kom Abban
text:
Alexander Kodwo Kom Abban yɛ Ghana amannyɔni ne mmarahyɛbadwani a na ɔka mmarahyɛbadwa a  ɛtɔ so nson no mu Ghana adehyeman a Ɛtɔ so nnan no mu ni a ɔgyina Gomoa West abatoɔ mpesua no ananmu wɔ Mfimfini mantam no mu wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so.

Mfitiaseɛ asetea ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Abban wɔ ɔpɛnimaa bosome no da a ɛtɔ so nsia wɔ afe 1973 na ɔfiri Gomoa Dawurampong a ɛwɔ Mfimfini mantam no mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔnyaa ne Master of Law abodin krataa wɔ Sikakorabea ne Sikasɛm ho mmara mu wɔ Boston Suapɔn Mmara Sukuu mu wɔ afe 2008 mu. Ná ɔwɔ ne Aduruyɛ ho Tumi krataa a ɛfiri Aduruyɛ ne Nsõ Ho Badwa no hɔ. Ɔsan nso nyaa ne Bachelor of Science abodin krataa wɔ Human Biology mu wɔ Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology, Bachelor of Science abodin krataa wɔ Medicine ne Surgery mu wɔ saa asoɛeɛ korɔ no ara mu. Ɔsan nyaa ne master’s degree wɔ Ɔmanfo Akwahosan mu wɔ Hamburg School of Applied Science. Na ɔwɔ adansedie krataa nso wɔ German kasa mu firi Goethe Institut a ɛwɔ Accra.

Adwuma 
Abban yɛ Mmara ho Ɔfotufoɔ firi afe 2013 kɔsi afe 2014 wɔ Ghana Stock Exchange. Ɔsan nso yɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ wɔ Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration firi afe 2009 kɔsi afe 2010. Ɔsan nso yɛ Part-time ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ wɔ Ghana School of Law firi afe 2010 kɔsi afe 2015. Ɔyɛ fie sohwɛfoɔ firi afe 2009 kɔsi afe 2012 wɔ Ghana Akwahosan Dwumadibea ne Aduruyɛ sohwɛfoɔ wɔ saa asoɛeɛ korɔ no ara mu firi afe 2012 kɔsi afe 2016.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Abban yɛ Ɔsono amanyɔkuo NPP no mu ni. Na ɔyɛ kane Mmarahyɛ Badwa no mu ni wɔ Mmarahyɛ Badwa a Ɛto so nson wɔ Ghana Adehyeman a Ɛto so Anan no mu ma Gomoa Atɔe Fam Mansini a ɛwɔ Ghana Mfinimfini Mantam mu.

2016 abatoɔ 
Wɔ afe 2016 Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu no, Abban dii nkonim wɔ Gomoa West abatoɔ mpesua no mmarahyɛ Badwa no mu. Ɔde mma 22,741 a ɔnyae a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 49.6% na ɛdii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ no mu, wɔ nnipa dodoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu berɛ a NDC mmarahyɛ Badwa ananmusini Samuel Fletcher nyaa abatoɔ no mu 21,004 a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 45.8% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu, PPP mmarahyɛ Badwa ananmusini Charles Yawson nyaa abatoɔ no mu 2,086 a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 4.6% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu na CPP mmarahyɛ  Badwa ananmusini Stephen Afriyie nyaa abatoɔ (0) a ɛyɛɛ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 0.0%.

Badwakuo ahodoɔ 
Na Abban yɛ Aban Awerɛhyem badwakuo no muni na na ɔyɛ Akwahosan badwakuo no muni nso.

Ɔsomfo 
Ɔyɛ kane ɔsoafoɔ Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Akwahosan so. Ɔsan nso yɛ kane ɔsoafoɔ Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Nkitahodie so.

2020 abatoɔ 
Abban hweree Gomoa West abatoɔ mpesua no mmarahyɛ badwa akonnwa no wɔ afe 2020 Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu maa NDC mmarahyɛ badwani Richard Gyan Mensah. Ɔde mma 25,235 a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 44.9% na ɛdii nkoguo wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu berɛ a Richard nyaa abatoɔ no mu mma 29,822 a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 53.0% wɔ abatoɔ a wɔtoeɛ nyinaa mu, GUM mmarahyɛ  Badwa ananmusini  Edmond Panyin Enchill nyaa abatoɔ 716 a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 1.3%, ne PPP mmarahyɛ baguani ɔkannifoɔ Charles Yawson nyaa abatoɔ no mu mma 481 a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 0.9%.

Ankorankoro asetena 
Ɔyɛ Kristoni (Katolekni). Ɔware Owurayere Anastasia Antoinette Abban, na awarefoɔ yi wɔ mma nan.

title: Paul Collins Appiah-Ofori
text:
Paul Collins Appiah Ofori yɛ Ghana amanyɔfoɔ na na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma Asikuma-Odoben-Brakwa abatoɔ mpesua no a wɔwɔ Mfimfini mantam no mu wɔ ɔman Ghana mu.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Appiah-Ofori wɔ Ɔbɛnem bosome no da a ɛtɔ so du nkron wɔ afe apem ahankron aduanan mmiensa (1943). Ɔfiri Breman Asikuma a ɛwɔ Ghana Mfinimfini Mantam mu. Owiee sukuu wɔ Institute of Chartered Secretaries and Administrators, London.

Adwumafa 
Appiah-Ofori yɛɛ adwuma sɛ adwumayɛfoɔ panin maa SIO Industries wɔ Aseba, Delta State, Nigeria firi afe 1987 kɔsi afe 1996.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔdii kan yii no sɛ ɔnkasa na ɔnyɛ ananmusifoɔ wɔ amanyɔkuo no abatoɔfoɔ no mu wɔ afe 1996 mu na ɔdii n’akongua nso wɔ afe 2000, 2004 ne 2008 Ghana mmarahyɛ badwa amammuo  gyinaesie abatoɔ mu. Ɔyɛ ankorankoro bi a ɔfi Ɔsono amanyɔkuo NPP no mu. Wɔyii no sɛ Mmarahyɛ badwa no muni ma Asikuma-Odoben-Brakwa mantam no wɔ mmarahyɛ badwa a ɛto so num (5) a ɛwɔ Ghana adehyeman a ɛto so nan (4) no mu. Wɔde abatoɔ a nnipa dodoɔ  37,015 a wɔtoeɛ no mu 18,908 na ɛdii nkunim, a ɛgyina hɔ ma abatoɔ no mu ɔha nkyekyɛ mu 48.9% yɛ pɛ.

Wɔyii no sɛ ɔne Georgina Nkrumah Aboah a ɔfiri kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress, Anthony Robert Frempong a ɔfiri Democratic Freedom Party ne Comfort Willson Aggrey a ɔfi Convention People’s Party mu. Eyinom nyaa abatow a ɛfata nyinaa mu ɔha mu nkyekyɛmu 47.88%, 1.29% ne 1.95%.

Ankorankoro asetena 
Appiah-Ofori aware a ɔwɔ mma mmiensa.[2] Ɔyɛ Kristoni (Methodist).

title: Aaron Michael Oquaye
text:
Aaron Mike Oquaye (wɔwoo no 4 Ayɛwohomumɔ 1944) yɛ Ghana mmaranimfoɔ ne amannyɔni a ɔyɛɛ Mmarahyɛ Badwa no Kasafoɔ anaa kyeame a ɔtɔ so nsia wɔ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu firi afe 2017 kɔsi afe 2021. Ɔyɛ adesuafoɔ, ɔman amannyɔni ne Baptist ɔsomfoɔ, na ɔdii kan kuraa cabinet ministerial portfolios a ɛfa ahoɔden ne nkitahodiɛ ho na ɔsan nso yɛ Ghana High Commissioner wɔ India (2002–04) wɔ Kufuor amanmuo mu.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena 
Wɔwoo Michael Aaron Oquaye wɔ Ayɛwohomumɔ bosome no da a ɛtɔ so nan wɔ afe 1944 wɔ Osu, Accra, Ghana (saa bere no na ɛyɛ Gold Coast), na ne papa ne E. G. N Oquaye a ɔfiri Osu ne Felicia Awusika Abla Oquaye (nee Azu) a ɔfiri Odumase-Krobo. Wɔtetee no wɔ Asamankese wɔ ɔman no Apuei Fam Mantam mu, faako a ɔkɔɔ Roman Katolek Mfitiaseɛ Sukuu ne Presbyterian Mfinimfini Sukuu ansa na ɔrekɔ Presbyterian Mmarimaa Ntoasoɔ Sukuu (PRESEC), wɔ Odumase-Krobo ne afei Apam Senior High School.

Ná Oquaye papa, E. G. N. Oquaye, yɛ United Gold Coast Convention (UGCC) a wɔhyehyɛɛ no wɔ Asamankese no mu ni. Na ɔsane nso yɛ sikakorafoɔ ne sikasɛm sohwɛfoɔ titire wɔ UGCC, Gold Coast Party (GCP), National Liberation Movement (NLM) ne United Party (UP) wɔ Asamankese. Bere a na Oquaye yɛ abofra no, n’abusua gyee amanyɔfoɔ ne anuonyamfoɔ te sɛ Ɔbenfo J. B. Danquah ne Ɔbenfo Kofi Abrefa Busia sɛ ahɔhoɔ wɔ wɔn fie. Okyenhene Nana Ofori Atta II, bere a na ɔwɔ nnommumfa mu wɔ Accra no, na ɔsane kɔ Oquaye abusua fie a ɛwɔ Asamankese no mu daa.

Nwomasua ne mmara adwuma 
Oquaye kɔɔ Presbyterian Boys' Senior Secondary School, faako a ɔnyaa ne GCE "O"-Level Certificate, na afei Apam Secondary School maa ne "A" Level Certificates. Ɔkɔɔ Ghana Suapɔn na akyiri yi ɔkɔɔ London Suapɔn, wɔ Lincoln's Inn, London. Ɔwɔ B.A. (Hons.) Amanyɔsɛm ho nyansahunu, L.L.B. (Hons.), B.L., na ɔyɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ. ne PhD. Ɔyɛ mmaranimfoɔ ne mmaranimfoɔ a ɔfata, ne nea ɔhyehyɛɛ n’ankasa mmara adwumayɛbea ne ne yɔnko panyin. Ɔyɛ England ne Wales Asɛnnibea Kunini no mmaranimfoɔ, Ghana Mmaranimfoɔ Kuo no mu panyin, na ɔyɛ mmaranimfoɔ ma nnwumakuo ne sikasɛm asoɛe ahodoɔ bi a wɔagye din.

Nwomasua mu adwuma 
Oquaye yɛ Amanyɔsɛm ho ɔbenfo wɔ Ghana Suapɔn, (Legon), na kan no na ɔyɛ Amanyɔsɛm Dwumadibea no Titenani ne sukuupɔn no Adesua badwa no mu ni, tumidie a ɛkorɔn sen biara wɔ faculties no gyinabea. Ɔnyaa ne Ph.D wɔ School of Oriental and African Studies wɔ London, na ɔnyaa Rockefeller Senior Scholar Award wɔ afe 1993 ne Senior Fulbright Scholar Award wɔ afe 1997. Wayɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ nsrahwɛfoɔ wɔ George Mason Suapɔn mu wɔ Virginia. Efi 1997 kɔsi afe1999 no, na ɔyɛ Afrika Amanyɔsɛm Fekuo (AAPS) a ɛwɔ Zimbabwe no titenani abadiakyiri.

Nwoma ahodoɔ ne nsɛm a wɔka de gyina nkurɔfoɔ akyi 
Sɛ́ nwoma twerɛfoɔ no, Oquaye ayɛ nhwehwɛmu na watintim nwoma ahodoɔ pii a ɛfa nnisoɔ pa, ntawantawadie, amammusɛm ho adesua, decentralization ne nkɔsoɔ, nnipa hokwan ahodoɔ, asraafoɔ a wɔde wɔn ho hyɛ amammusɛm mu, NGO ahodoɔ, nkuraase nkɔsoɔ ne mmarima ne mmaa ho nsɛm ho. Ɔkamfoɔ hokwan ahodoɔ a mmaa wɔ, a affirmative action ka ho.

Ɔno na ɔkyerɛw nwoma a ɔdii nkonim wɔ abasobɔdeɛ mu a wɔfrɛ no Politics in Ghana, 1972–1979, a ɔkyerɛɛ, nea ɛka ho ne, asraafo sɛ Aban ne Amanyɔsɛm mu ɔhaw wɔ Afrika na ɔkaa nsɛm a ɛfa nnipa hokwan ahodoɔ a wɔabu so, amammusɛm a ntawantawadie wom, sikasɛm ho asɛm adwumayɛ a ɛnteɛ ne ɔman no mu ɔsɛe. ɔtwerɛɛ nwoma a ɛto so mmienu, Politics in Ghana, 1982–1992, a ɛfa ɔman anidane amammusɛm, CDRs, Ɔmanfoɔ Asɛnnibea ahodoɔ, ɔmanfo tumi, animtiaabu pa ne nnipa hokwan ho nsɛm a na ɛwɔ hɔ saa bere no ho. Wɔatintim ne nwomanimfoɔ nsɛm wɔ amanaman ntam nsɛmma nhoma ahodoɔ te sɛ Human Rights Quarterly (U.S.), Journal of Commonwealth and Comparative Politics (UK), African Affairs (UK), ne Review of Human Factor Studies (Canada) mu.

Amammuo mu adwuma 
Sɛ́ osuani wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu no, Oquaye de ne ho hyɛɛ ɔsatuo no mu maa J. B. Danquah / Kofi Abrefa Busia asɛm no. Oquaye foaa Busia ɔfrɛ a ɛne sɛ wɔnsane nkɔ ɔmanfoɔ nnisoɔ mu ntɛm na wɔasiw ɔman no asraafo a wɔde wɔn ho bɛhyɛ mu no akyi denneennen na ɔne n’abusua boa ma wɔhyehyɛɛ Nkɔsoɔ Kuo no wɔ Osu wɔ afe 1969 mu.

New Patriotic party 
United Party-Progress Party atetesɛm no na ɛma wɔhyehyɛɛ, wɔ afe 1992 mu, New Patriotic Party (NPP), a Oquaye yɛ ɔmannifoɔ a ɔhyehyɛɛ no. Ɔyɛ NPP mantam Ɔtwerɛfoɔ a ɔdi kan ma Greater Accra wɔ afe 1992 mu, na ɔsan nso yɛ Party no Titenani a ɔdi kan ma Ga Mantam Nkuraaseɛ Mansini, a akyiri yi ɛpaapaee yɛɛ no Ga West Mansini ne Ga Apuei Mansini . Na ɔyɛ Nhwehwɛmu Badwakuo no twerɛfoɔ na na ɔyɛ NPP man Ɔsatuo Kuo a ɛdi kan no mu ni wɔ afe 1992 bosome mmiensa mu.

Ɔne NPP mfinimfini nnipa afoforɔ a wɔn mu bi ne Ɔmampanyin John Kufuor, Nana Addo Dankwa Akufo-Addo, R. R. Amponsah, Ɔbenfo Adu-Boahen, Peter Ala Adjetey, B. J. da Rocha ne Samuel Odoi-Sykes yɛɛ adwuma de bɔɔ mmɔden yiye maa NPP nkonimdie wɔ afe 2000 amansan abatow no. Oquaye dwumadie wɔ party no nkonimdie mu, a na ɛfa nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfoɔ ntoboa ne ho a ɔde hyɛɛ party no dwumadiɛ foforɔ mu wɔ afe 1993 ne 2000 ntam no, wobu no sɛ ɛho hia.

Ɔmanpanyin ne Ɔman Soafoɔ 
Efiri afe 2001 kɔsi afe 2004 no, Oquaye yɛɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanyin wɔ India. Wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome no mu wɔ afe 2005 mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ Ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Ahoɔden so, na akyiri yi wɔde no kɔɔ Ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Nkitahodie so.

Mmarahyɛbadwa adwumayɛ 
Oquaye yɛ NPP Mmarahyɛ Bagua no mu ni wɔ Dome-Kwabenya mprɛ mmienu, ɛfiri afe 2004 kɔsi afe 2012. Ɔyɛɛ n’adwene sɛ ɔrennyina hɔ mma dibea foforo. Ɔboaa ne ba barima, Mike Oquaye Jnr, sɛ ɔnko sɛ ɔbɛyɛ NPP Mmarahyɛ Bagua no mu ni ma ɔmansin no. Nanso ne ba no dii nkogu wɔ Sarah Adwoa Safo anim, na ɔkɔɔ so dii nkonnwa no.

Efiri afe 2009 kɔsi afe 2013 no, na Oquaye yɛ Mmarahyɛ Badwa no Kasafo anaa kyeame Abadiakyiri a ɔto so mmienu. Joe Ghartey na ɔdii n’ade wɔ afe 2013 mu.

Mmarahyɛ Badwa no Kasafoɔ anaa kyeame 
Oquaye yɛɛ Mmarahyɛ Badwa no Kasafo anaa kyeame wɔ Ghana adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nan mmarahyɛ Badwa a ɛto so ason no mu. Wɔ afe 2021 mu no, New Patriotic Party no yii no sɛ ɔnyɛ Mmarahyɛ Badwa no Kasafo a ɔdii nkoguo wɔ Alban Kingsford Sumani Bagbin wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome no da a ɛtɔ so nson a National Democratic Congress yii no no. Alban Kingsford Sumani Bagbin de too dwa wɔ mmarahyɛ Badwa no nhyiamu a ɛdi kan no mu sɛ wɔde abatoɔ 138 na ɛyii no berɛ a Mike Oquaye nyaa abatoɔ 136.

Ankorankoro asetena 
Oquaye yɛ Baptist Asɔre no sɔfo. Ɔwaree Alberta Oquaye (woo Asafu-Adjaye) (Major Rtd.) a ɔyɛ ɔyarehwɛfoɔ a ɔyɛ adwumaden. Ɔyɛ Mike Oquaye Jnr, Ghana High Commissioner a ɔwɔ India mprempren no agya.

Nneɛma a Oquaye ani gye ho ne bɔɔlbɔ, pon so tɛnis, nwoma akenkan, atwerɛ, ne nnwom a ɔtie.

Nwoma ahodoɔ a wɔahyehyɛ

Nnwuma a wɔatwerɛ 
Amanyɔsɛm wɔ Ghana, 1982–1992 (Tornado Nwoma, 1980, ISBN 9789964980085)

Kabimamenkabi, Amanyɔsɛm ne Ntawantawadie Ho Nsiesiei wɔ Nnɛyi Ghana (Gold-Type Publication, 1995) .

Akyinnyegyeɛ ahodoɔ 
Wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome no mu wɔ afe 2020 mu no, nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfoɔ yɛɛ basabasa wɔ amanneɛbɔ a ɛkyerɛ sɛ Mmarahyɛ Badwa no kasafoɔ, Aaron Mike Oquaye ahunahuna sɛ ɔbɛbara nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfoɔ a wɔfa nsɛm foforɔ a ɛsisiiɛ wɔ Mmarahyɛ Badwa no dan afoforɔ mu a ɛnyɛ dan a mmarahyɛbadwafoɔ no nyinaa hyia mu no mu.

Wɔ ɔsanaa bosome no mu wɔ afe 2020 mu no, ɔmaa badwam kasa bi wɔ Founders' Day a wɔdi ho, a ɔkaa wɔ mu sɛ "Ahofadie nyɛ onipa baako ɔyɛkyerɛ, na ɛyɛ mmɔdenbɔ a wɔbom yɛ". Sɛnea Oquaye kyerɛ no, ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔhyɛ kane ɔmampanyin Kwame Nkrumah nkutoo ni na mmom ɛsɛ sɛ wɔka bom ne Ghana agyanom a wɔhyehyɛɛ no nyinaa. Oquaye nso kaa sɛ ɛnyɛ Nkrumah nko ara na ɔrepere ahofadie ɛwom sɛ ɔko maa Ghana ahofadie. Nkrumah ba barima Sekou Nkrumah kasa tiaa Ɔbenfo Oquaye wɔ saa nsɛm no ho, na ɔkaa sɛ sɛ mmarahyɛ badwa no kasafoɔ no pɛ sɛ ɔkasa tia n’agya a wawu a, ɛsɛ sɛ ɔka ɔman baako nhyehyɛe ne Preventive Detectionn Act (PDA) a wɔde bae wɔ Nkrumah bere so no ho asɛm.

title: Jonathan Nii Tackie Komey
text:
Jonathan Nii Tackie-Komme yɛ Ghana ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo, ɔman somfo ne ɔmanyɛfo. Ɔyɛ Odododiodoo mansini no Mmarahyɛ Badwani a ɔtwaa mu nkyɛeɛ. Wɔnam abatoɔ foforɔ a wɔyɛeɛ wɔ Oforisuo bosome no da a ɛtɔ so aduasa wɔ afe 2005 so na wɔyii no sɛ MP. Ɔdii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ no mu wɔ National Democratic Congress (NDC) tekiti so wɔ afe 2005 mu denam akansifoɔ foforɔ num a ɔdii nkonim no so.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua 
Hon. Wɔwoo Tackie-Komme ɔdehyeɛ a wɔwoo no too Ga adehyeɛ abusua mu. Ná ne papa yɛ kane Hene (ɔpanyin a ɔsene obiara) wɔ Gafoɔ a wɔwɔ Accra no so. Ɔkɔɔ Accra Sempe Sukuu ne akyiri yi Kinbu Senior Technical School (kane no na ɛyɛ Aban Mmarimaa Sukuu) baabi a ɔwiee sukuu no a na ɔwɔ Mfinimfini Sukuu Gyee adansedi krataa. Ɔkɔɔ ɔman adwuma mu wɔ ɛno akyi pɛɛ. Wɔ afe 1970 ne 1974 ntam no mu, na ɔyɛ sukuu kyerɛkyerɛfoɔ. Ɔde ne ho bɔɔ Greater Accra Regional House of Chiefs sɛ ɔman somfoɔ wɔ afe 1974 ne 1985 ntam hɔ na ɔkɔɔ soro ntɛmntɛm koduu Ɔkyerɛfoɔ Boafoɔ dibea. Efiri afe 2003 kɔsi afe 2005 no, na ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛ Badwani wɔ Accra Metropolitan Assembly ma Kinka Abatoɔ Mpesua no so, na ɛfiri afe 2005 kɔsi afe 2012 no, wɔyii no sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani ma Odododiodioo Mansini no.

Wɔ adwumayɛ mu no, Hon Tackie-Komme yɛ Institute of Directors-Ghana no mu ni a ɔnyaa adansedie krataa ne diploma wɔ Corporate Governance mu. Ɔsan nso wɔ Executive Masters wɔ Aban ne Akannifoɔ mu (EMGL) a ɛfiri Ghana Asoɛeɛ a ɛhwɛ adwumayɛ ne ɔmanfoɔ so.

Mfeɛ a ɔde tenaa Mmarahyɛbadwam  no mu 
Hon. Tackie-Komme dii mfeɛ nson wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa mu firi afe 2005 kɔsi afe 2012 a ɔboaa kabimamenkabi ne mmara nnisoɔ wɔ Ghana. Na ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwam abadwakuo a Ɛhwɛ Aban Awerɛhyem So no dwamtenani abadiakyiri, na na ɔyɛ afoforo nan mu ni: abadwakuo a Ɛhwɛ Adwadie, Nnwuma ne Nsrahwɛ So; abadwakuo a Ɛhwɛ Akwan ne akwantusɛm so; abadwakuo a Ɛhwɛ Subsidiary ne Mmarahyɛ So; ne abadwakuo a Ɛhwɛ Asomfoɔ a Wɔkura Mfasoɔ Dwumadibea no. Sɛ́ mmarahyɛ badwani no, ɔgyinaa Ghana ananmu wɔ amanaman ntam nhyiam ahodoɔ ase. 

Wɔ kutawonsa bosome no mu wɔ afe 2012 mu no, ɔde ne ho hyɛɛ mmarahyɛ badwam abadwakuo bi a ɛhwɛ Aban Awerɛhyem nsakrae nhyehyɛeɛ so ne Uganda Mmarahyɛ badwa a ɛwɔ Uganda no mu. Wɔ ɔsanaa bosome no mu ne ɛbɔ bosome no mu wɔ afe, 2010 ntam no, ɔyɛɛ mmarahyɛ badwa adesua akwantuo bi a ɛfa Akwan ne akwantusɛm ho abrabɔ ho wɔ United Kingdom, Netherlands ne Germany no fã. 

Wɔ Ahinime bosome no mu wɔ afe 2009 mu no, ɔde ne ho hyɛɛ mmarahyɛ badwam adesua akwantuo bi mu wɔ Tariff Advisory Board wɔ Washington, D.C., United States. Saa afe no ara mu wɔ Oforisuo bosome no mu no, ɔde ne ho hyɛɛ adwumayɛbea ahodoɔ pii a ɛfa opira ano aduru ho a Kwame Nkrumah Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma Sukuupɔn, Washington Sukuupɔn (Seattle, U.S.A.) ne Harborview Injury Prevention & Research Center hyehyɛe mu. 

Sɛ yɛde ne mmarahyɛ badwa nnwuma to nkyɛn a, ɔde nwomasua, akwahosan, adwadie, asetena, ICT ne nnwuma mu nkɔsoɔ pii baa ne nkurɔfoɔ nkyɛn. Ussher Polyclinic, te sɛ ayaresabea afoforo a ɛsom mansini no nyaa nnwuma mu nkɔsoɔ bere a wɔtrɛɛ baabi a wɔgye mmaa ayarefoɔ toɔ no mu na wɔkyekyɛɛ nnwinnadeɛ a ɛwɔ hɔ nnɛ: mmubuafoɔ nkonnwa, ayaresabea mpa, drip stands, generator ne poly tanks ne afoforɔ. Wɔyɛɛ ayarehwɛfoɔ ahomegyeɛ dan no nso foforɔ koraa. 

Mfitiaseɛ ne ntoasoɔ sukuu a ɛwɔ mpɔtam hɔ nyinaa nyaa wɔn kyɛfa a ɛfata wɔ nwoma, agodie ho nneɛma, adesua pon ne kɔmputa dan mu nneɛma a wɔde si hɔ. Wɔsane yɛɛ James Town Polisifoɔ adwumayɛbea a ɛwɔ Motor Transport and Traffic Unit (MTTU) no nso foforɔ. Wɔboaa Ahyehyɛdeɛ ahodoɔ a ɛnyɛ Aban deɛ, ahyehyɛdeɛ ahodoɔ a wɔahyɛ da ayɛ ne asetena mu akuo ahodoɔ ma wɔadu ɔmanfoɔ botae ahodoɔ ho. Wɔde ne kyɛfa a ɔwɔ wɔ District Assemblies Common Fund, Ghana Education Trust Fund(GETFund) ne Heavily Indebted Poor Countries (HIPC) sikakorabea no na ɛbɔɔ nkɔsoɔ no ho ban. Ɔdii nkoguo wɔ ne mmɔdenbɔ sɛ ɔbɛgyina mansin no ananmu wɔ afe 2012 NDC primaries no mu maa Edwin Nii Lante Vanderpuye tuu no adeɛ so.

Ghana manfoɔ Wimhyɛn Asoɛeɛ 
Wɔ afe 2009 mu no, HE John Atta Mills (kane Ghana manpanyin) yii Hon. Tackie-Komme kɔɔ Ghana Civil Aviation Authority badwakuo mu baabi a ɔsom kɔsii afe 2014 mfitiaseɛ berɛ a wɔguu adwumakuo no mu. Ɔhyehyɛɛ ananmusifo a wɔkɔɔ amanaman ntam dwumadie ahodoɔ mu wɔ Amanaman Ntam Ɔmanfo Wimhyɛn Ahyehyɛdeɛ no adwumayɛbea ti wɔ Montreal, Quebec, Canada. Wɔ Obubuo bosome no mu wɔ afe, 2010 mu no, ɔdii ananmusifo anim kɔɔ Wiase Akwantu dwadie a wɔyɛe wɔ London, United Kingdom no ase.

Ghana Ahyɛmma ne Ahyɛmma Tumi Fekuo 
Hon Tackie-Komme wɔ agodie ho anigyeɛ a ɛmu yɛ den. Ɔyɛ Ghana Rowing and Canoeing Association no titenani a atwam ntɛm ara. Ɔboaa ma wɔhyɛɛ canoeing ho nkuran wɔ Ghana. Saa berɛ yi mu no, Ghana de ne ho hyɛɛ ne amanaman ntam canoeing akansie a ɛdi kan koraa mu: West African Canoe Kayak Championship a wɔyɛɛ no Cote d’Ivoire wɔ Ahinimie bosome no mu wɔ afe, 2009. N’akannifoɔ nso maa Ɔman Agodie Badwa (NSC) a ɛwɔ Accra no gyee Canoes aduonu nsia (26) ne ahyɛmma aduasa (30) sɛ ntoboa a efi Amanaman Ntam Ahyɛmma Fekuo (ICF), a n’adwumayɛbea ti wɔ Switzerland, de hyɛ agodie no ho nkuran na wɔama anya nkɔso wɔ ɔman no mu. Ná ɔka Ghana aban ananmusifoɔ a wɔkɔɔ 2012 Summer Olympics wɔ London no ho.

Abadwakuo ne Asoɛe ahodoɔ 
1. Adwumakuo no mu ni, Accra Kar akwan sohwɛ (Accra Kuropɔn Nhyiamu), (2012 kɔsi nnɛ).

2. Badwakuo no mu ni, Ghana Ɔmanfoɔ Wimhyɛn Aban, (2009 kɔsi 2014) .

3. Ɔman Agodi e Dwumadibea no Titenani, Ahyɛmma ne Ahyɛmma Atuo Fekuw, (2008 kosi 2014) .

4. Adwumakuo no mu ni, Ga-Mashie Nkɔsoɔ Dwumadibea, (2000 kɔsi nnɛ) .

5. Dwamtenani, Amrado badwa (Holy Trinity Snr. High Sch.), (2003 kosi 2005) .

title: Moses Anim
text:
Moses Anim yɛ Ghana amanyɔni na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson wɔ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nan no mu mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔgyina Trobu mansini a ɛwɔ Nkran punpuni mantam nomu no anan mu wɔ mmarahyɛbadwafie .Ɔdi saa diberɛ yi wɔ ɔsono kokroko ammanyɔkuo (New Patriotic Party -NPP)no tekiti so.

Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ ne Nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Anim wɔ Oforisuo da a ɛtɔ so Aduonu-num, afe Apem, Ahankron ne Aduosia-num(1965). Ɔfiri Adukrom wɔ Ghana Apueeiɛ Mantam mu. Ɔsuaa adeɛ wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu baabi a ɔnyaa ne Bachelor of Science abodin krataa wɔ Biochemistry ne ne( Master of Business Administration) abodin krataa wɔ (Project Management) mu wɔ afe 1991 ne 2005 mu.

Adwumayɛ 
Ansa na ɔrehyɛn amammɔsɛm mu no, na Anim yɛ ' Wilhelm Construction Company Limited" a ɛwɔ Nkran  kuro pɔn no mu no Dwumadie sohwɛfoɔ.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Anim kɔɔ mmarahyɛbadwafie  wɔ  Ɔbɛnem da a ɛtɔ so nson, mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Du-mmeɛnsa ( 2013 ) wɔ ɔsono kokroko ammanyɔkuo (New Patriotic Party-NPP ) tekiti so.  Ɔgyina Trobu abatoɔ mpɛsoa no ananmu wɔ mmarahyɛbadwafie . Mma Mpem Aduɔson-nso, Aha-nson ne Aduɔwɔtwe -mmienu (76,782 ) a ɛbaeɛ no, Anim nyaa mu  Mpem Aduanan -nsia, Ahanan ne Aduanan-nsia( 46,446) a ɛgyina hɔ ma ɔha nkyekyem Aduonum-nwɔtwe ne akyiri pɔ Aduɔkron-nsia(58.96%) na ɔde dii nkonim wɔ nkodwa no so. Wɔsan paw no wɔ mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Du-nsia (2016) mu sɛ ɔnkɔ so ntena mmarahyɛbadwa  no mu mfeɛ nan (4) bio.

N'ankasa Abrabɔ 
Ɔkyerɛ sɛ ɔyɛ Kristoni na ɔyɛ Pentikɔso  asɔre no mu ni.

title: Daniel Titus-Glover
text:
Daniel Nii Kwartei Titus Glover (wɔwoo no Ɔbɛnem da a ɛtɔ so Aduonu nwɔtwe, afe Apem Ahankron ne Aduosiq-nsia -1966) yɛ Ghana amanyɔni na ɔyɛ Tema Apueiɛ mansin no mmarahyɛbadwani. Ɔyɛ Ɔsono kokroko ammanyɔkuo (New Patriotic Party-NPP ) no mu ni. Ɔsan yɛ Ɔsoafoɔ  a ɔhwɛ akwantuo ho nsɛm  so wɔ Ghana no Abadiakyire.

Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ ne Nwomasua 
Daniel Nii Kwartei Titus Glover (wɔwoo no 28 Ɔbɛnem 1966) yɛ Ghana amamyɔni na ɔyɛ Tema Apueiɛ amansin no Mmarahyɛbadwani . Ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party no mu ni na ɔno ne

ɔyɛ Ɔsoafoɔ Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ akwantuo so wɔ Ghana.

Wɔwoo Glover wɔ Ɔbɛnem da a ɛtɔ so Aduonu nwɔtwe, afe Apem Ahankron ne Aduosiq-nsia -1996) wɔ Asere-Ga Mashie a ɛwɔ Nkran punpuni mantam no mu.

Glover kɔɔ ne  ntoasoɔ sukuu wɔ N'asete ntoasoɔ sukuu a ɛwɔ Nungua 'Nungua Presbyterian Secondary School' no mu wɔ afe Apem, Ahankron ne Aduɔwɔtwe -baako (1981). Ɔsuaa adeɛ na ɔnyaa ne ( ordinary level certificate) wɔ (Presbyterian Boy’s Senior High School), Legon wɔ afe Apem Ahankron ne Aduɔwɔtwe -mmienu (1982) afe Apem Ahankron ne Aduɔwɔtwe -nsia (1986) ntam. Ɔtoaa so wɔ Accra Academy kokoam firi afe Apem Ahankron Aduɔwɔtwe -nson (1987) de kɔsi afe Apem, Ahankron ne Aduɔwɔtwe -nwɔtwe (1988). Onyaa ne (Advanced Level Certificate). Glover wɔ abodin krataa a ɛkorɔn wɔ Warwick Sukuupɔn, Coventry. Ɔsan nso wɔ adansedi krataa a ɛkyerɛ sɛ wakɔ sukuupɔn wɔ Ruskin College, Oxford, ne abɔdij krataa wɔ adwumayɛ ho adesua mu firii University of Cape Coast.

N'ankasa Abrabɔ 
Ɔyɛ Miracle Life Gospel Asɔre no mu ni. Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma nan.

Amanyɔsɛm

Ɔsii akan wɔ mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Aduonu 2020 , Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani  New Patriotic Party tekiti so . na ɔhweree n’akongua maa nea ɔne no reko wɔ National Democratic Congress (Ghana) no, Isaac Ashai Odamtten

title: Emmanuel Nii Okai Laryea
text:
Emmanuel Nii Okai Laryea yɛ Ghana amanyɔni a na ɔka Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson a ɛwɔ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nnan no ho a ɔgyinaa Amasaman Mansin ananmu wɔ Greater Accra Mantam mu wɔ National Democratic Congress din mu.

Ankorankoro Abrabɔ ne Nwomasu 
Wɔwoo Laryea wɔ Ɔsanaa bosome da ɛtɔ so du-nsia wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduowɔtwe -mmiɛnsa mu  wɔ kuro bi a wɔfrɛ no Gbese-Accra wɔ ne mantam mu. Ɔnyaa ne Bachelor of Arts abodin krataa wɔ Amanyɔsɛm ne Amanneɛbɔ Adesua mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn, Legon. Ansa na wɔrepa no sɛ mmarahyɛbadwa  no, na ɔyɛ adwumayɛfo panyin wɔ 'Commanex Investment Limited'.

Amammuo mu adwuma 
Wɔdii kan paa no sɛ ɔmmra mmarahyɛbadwa mu wɔ  Ɔbɛnem bosome da ɛtɔ so nson wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du-mmiɛnsa  berɛ a wɔwiee Mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du-mmienu  Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ no. Afei wɔsan paa no wɔ Ɔbɛnem bosome da ɛtɔ so nson wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du- nsia bere a wɔwiee  Ghana Amansan Abatoɔ a ɔnyaa mma a ɛfata a wɔtoo no mu ɔha mu abupɛn aduanan -nkron akyire po aduowɔtwe -mmiɛnsa (49.83%).

Ankorankoro asetra 
Ɔyɛ Kristoni na ɔyɛ ɔhokwafo.[1][2]

title: Emmanuel Kyeremateng Agyarko
text:
Emmanuel Kwabena Kyeremateng Agyarko a Wɔwoo no(10 Ɔpɛnimaa bosome da ɛtɔ so du wɔ Afe apem ahenkron aduonum -nson  kɔsi   Ahinime  bosome da ɛtɔ so aduonu -baako wɔ Mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du- nwɔtwe mu a ɔfirii mu no  yɛ Ghana amanyɔni a ɔfiri New Patriotic Party (NPP) mu. Na ɔyɛ mmrahyɛbadwani maa Ayawaso West Wuogon Mansini a ɛwɔ Accra firi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du-mmienu  kɔsii ne wuo wɔ Mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du -nwɔtwe mu.  Wɔbɔɔ amanneɛ sɛ nea ɛde ne wu baeɛ, wɔ Yale–New Haven Ayaresabea no, ne acid a ɛsan kɔ nipadua no mu ne yare a ɛyɛ hu a ɛwɔ akisikuru mu.

Na Abrabɔ ne Nwomasua 
Na ɔyɛ nnuruyɛfoɔ denam nteteeɛ so na ɔkɔɔ Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology, baabi a ɔnyaa abodin krataa a ɛdi kan wɔ nnuruyɛ mu. Na ne maame firi Krobo Odumase a ɛwɔ Ghana Apueeɛ Mantam mu na ne papa nso firi Kumasi wɔ Asanti Mantam mu. Na waware na na ɔwɔ mma nson. Owuiɛ Dwoda, 21 Ɔpɛpɔn bosome da ɛtɔ so aduonu -baako wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du-nwɔtwe mu wɔ yareɛ tiawa bi a ɔyareɛ no ​​oprehyɛn a wɔde siesie no akyi. 

Ɔfiri amammuo abusua mu. Ne nuabarima, Boakye Agyarko yɛɛ Ahoɔden Soafoɔ wɔ New Patriotic Party aberɛ so a ɛdi kan a Nana Akuffo Addo yɛeɛ no mu na ɔsan nso yɛɛ Aduane ne Nnuru Boayikuo no soafoɔ panin.[3] Ne nuabea, Dedo Difie Agyarko-Kusi, yɛ Ghana ɔnanmusifoɔ a ɔwɔ South Korea mprempren na ɔyɛ kan Mmarahyɛbadwa kandifoɔ ma Lower Manya Krobo wɔ New Patriotic Party din mu.

Agyarko nso yɛ Mmarahyɛbadwa no Atwa Yɛn Ho Ahyia, Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma Boayikuo no Titenani na bere bi na ɔyɛ Aban no Awerɛhyem ne Akwahosan Boayikuo ahorow no mu.

title: Bright Edward Kodzo Demordzi
text:
Bright Edward Kodzo Demordzi a wɔwoo no Ɔpɛnimaa  bosome da ɛtɔ so du-nnwɔtwe  wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduoson -mmienu no yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne Mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ Ghana mmrahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nsia a ɛwɔ Ghana Adehyeman  a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu a na ɔgyina Bortianor/Ngleshie/Amanfro (foforo) Mansin ananmu wɔ Greater Accra Mantam mu wɔ National Democratic Congress din mu wɔ Mmarahyɛbadwa no.[1]

Ankorankoro Abrabɔ 
Demordzi yɛ Kristoni (Nkonimdifo Ayeyi Nhyiam Amanaman Ntam). Ɔwaree na ɔwɔ mma baasa.

Ne Mmɔfraase ne ne Nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Demordzi wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa  bosome da ɛtɔ so du - nnwɔtwe wɔ Afe apem ahenkron aduoson - mmienu. Ɔfiri Anloga, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.[1] Ɔkɔɔ 'Ghana Institute of Management and Public Administration' na ɔnyaa ne Master of Business Administration abodin krataa wɔ Marketing mu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nkron. Ɔsan nso kɔɔ 'Chartered Institute of Marketing'(CIM UK) na ɔnyaa ne professional postgraduate diploma wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nkron mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Demordzi yɛ National Democratic Congress  (NDC) amanyɔkuoni. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du- mmienu mu no, ɔsii akan maa Bortianor/Ngleshie/Amanfro (foforo) atenaeɛ wɔ National Democratic Congress  mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nsia a ɛwɔ Ghana adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nnan no din mu na ɔdii nkonim.

Adwumafa 
Adwadie sohwɛfo, Yara (Ghana), Limited, Wimhyɛn Gyinabea - Accra[1]

title: Ahmed Arthur
text:
Arthur Ahmed yɛ Ghana amanyɔni  a na ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani no  ma Okaikwei South abatoɔ mpasua so wɔ Greater Accra Region firi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du -mmiɛnsa   kɔsi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du - nson  wɔ New Patriotic Party no din mu.

Ne Mmɔfraase ne Nwomasua 
Ɔfiri Nsuta Mampong a ɛwɔ Asanti Mantam mu. Arthur nyaa ne Ordinary level adansedi krataa firii Accra Academy na ne GCE Advanced Level adansedi krataa firui Abuakwa State College.

Adwuma 
Ɔyɛ Ackwell Entreprise kwankyerɛfo panyin na ɔyɛ adwuma wɔ apam ahodoɔ mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Wɔpaa no sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani ma Okaikwei South abatoɔ mpasua so firi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du- mmiɛnsa  na wɔsan paa no wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du- nsia mu.

Aware Tebea 
Wa'waree na ɔwɔ mma mmiɛnsa .

Ɔsom 
Ɔyɛ Kristoni.

title: Alex Narh Tettey-Enyo
text:
Alexander Narh Tettey-Enyo a wɔwoo no wɔ 6  Ayɛwohummɔ bosome da ɛtɔ so nsia wɔ Afe apem ahenkron aduanan mu no yɛ nwomasua ho nimdefo ne ɔmanyɔni. Ɔyɛ Ada Mmarahyɛbadwani firi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne num. na ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔsoafo a ɔhwɛ nwomasua so wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nkron   ne mpem mmienu 2011 ntam.

Mfitiase asetra ne nhomasua 
Wɔwoo Alex Tettey-Enyo wɔ Akuse wɔ Greater Accra Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔhyɛɛ ne mfitiaseɛ adesua ase wɔ Akuse Methodist Mfitiaseɛ Sukuu mu wɔ afe 1946. Wɔ afe 1948 mu no, ɔkɔɔ so wɔ James Town Accra Methodist Mfitiaseɛ Sukuu mu na ɔwiee wɔ Somanya Methodist Mfitiaseɛ/Mfinimfini Sukuu a ɔsuaa adeɛ wɔ afe 1949 ne 1953 ntam hɔ.Ne ntoaso sukuu hyɛɛ aseɛ wɔ Volta District Secondary School, Odumase Krobo wɔ afe 1954. Ɔtoaa so wɔ Presbyterian Boys’ Secondary nso wɔ Odumase Krobo wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduonum nsia ne afe apem ahenkron aduonum nson ntam hɔ.Ɔwiee ntoasoɔ sukuu akyi akyerɛkyerɛfoɔ adesua wɔ Wesley College, Kumasi wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduonum nkron ne afe apem ahenkron aduosia  ntam. Ɔkɔɔ Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology  mu wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduosia baako ne afe apem ahenkron aduosia - mmienu  mu na afei ɔkɔɔ Cape Coast Suapɔn mu baabi a ɔsuaa adeɛ wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduosia mmienu   ne afe apem ahenkron aduosia num ntam, na ɔnyaa Bachelor of Arts abodin krataa wɔ nwomasua mu . Ɔkɔɔ Nyansahu ne Mfiridwuma Sukuupɔn, Kumasi (1961-1962) ne Sukuupɔn Kɔlege a ɛwɔ Cape Coast (1963-1965).

Adwuma

Nwomasua 
Ɔhyɛɛ n’akyerɛkyerɛ adwuma a ɛdi kan ase wɔ Yilo State School a ɛwɔ Somanya wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduonum -nwɔtwe . Ne dwuma a ɛdi hɔ ne Ghanata Secondary School, Dodowa. Ne sukuupɔn adesua akyi, bere a na ɔyɛ ɔman sohyialist sukuufo ahyehyɛde (Ghanaso) no Titenani no, ɔde ne ho kɔbɔɔ sukuufo kuo bi a wofi Kwame Nkrumah Adwene Ho Asoɛe a wɔkɔɔ GDR mfinimfini kuo sukuu a ɛwɔ Berlin kɔsuaa ade tenten no ho. Bere a ɔwɔ hɔ no, Kwame Nkrumah asehwe akyi no, wɔn a wɔtaa Ɔmampanyin a wɔatu no afi n’ahendwa so no akyi no kɔɔ ne nkyɛn sɛ ɔmmɛsane nkɔyɛ adwuma wɔ ne din mu, nanso wampene. Adanse a ɛkyerɛ bere a ɔtraa Berlin no wɔ Bundesarchiv, Berlin Lichterfelde, SAPMO-BArch, DY 30, IV A 2/ 9.09/ 125. Ɔsan kɔɔ ne kane sukuu mu wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduosia - nsia mu, na awieɛ koraa no ɔbɛyɛɛ Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfo Panyin Boafo firi afe apem ahenkron aduoson baako kɔsi afe apem ahenkron aduoson nnan mu. Wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduowɔtwe mmienu mu no ,wɔpaa no sɛ Ada Ntoaso Sukuu no panyin, dibea a ɔdiiɛ kɔsii afe apem ahenkron aduokron. Wɔyɛɛ no ​​Nwomasua sohwɛfo maa Dangme Apuei Mantam wɔ Ghana Nwomasua Dwumadibea (GES) wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduokron mu. Wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduokron - baako  mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ Ntoaso Nwomasua sohwɛfo wɔ GES adwumayɛbea ti wɔ mu. Mfeɛ nnan akyi no, na ɔyɛ Adwumayɛfoɔ ne Nteteeɛ sohwɛfoɔ wɔ GES adwumayɛbea ti. Wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduokron - nsia mu no, ɔbɛyɛɛ Ghana Nwomasua Dwumadibea no Ɔkwankyerɛfo Panyin Abadiakyiri na afei ɔbɛyɛɛ Ɔkwankyerɛfo Panyin a ɔyɛ adwuma firi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne baako no mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Tettey-Enyo yɛɛ adwuma sɛ Ɔmantam Ɔkyerɛwfo maa Dangme Apuei Mansini  no wɔ afe  apem ahenkron aduokron mu.  ɔdii kan gyinaa mmarahyɛbadwa no akyi wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛbadwa abatoɔ mu wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa bosome mu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nnan  mu wɔ National Democratic Congress din mu, na ɔkɔɔ mmarahyɛbadwa no mu wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome mu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne num mu. Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nkron mu no, Ɔmampanyin John Atta Mills paa Tettey-Enyo sɛ Ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Nwomasua so wɔ n’aban mu. Tettey-Enyo bere sɛ ɔsomfo no baa awiei wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du- baako  mu wɔ nsakraeɛ a Ɔmanpanyin John Evans Atta Mills yɛɛ wɔ aban mpanyimfo kuo mu no akyi.

Abusua 
Tettey-Enyo aware a ɔwɔ mma nnum.[2]

Nneɛma a wɔde gye wɔn ani 
Nneɛma a Tettey-Enyo ani gye ho ne akenkan, stamp a wɔboaboa ano, asuguare ne akyinnyegye.[2]

text:

title: Kofi Brako
text:
kofi Brako yɛ Ghana amanyɔni  na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson wɔ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nan no mmarahyɛbadwani a  ɔgyina Tema Mfimfini Abatoɔ mpɛsoa no anan mu wɔ Nkran punpuni mantam no mu wɔ Ɔsono kokroko ammanyɔkuo (New Patriotic Party-NPP ) tekiti so.

Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ ne Nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Brako wɔ Ɛbɔ da a ɛtɔ so du-baako , afe Apem, Ahankron ne Aduonum-nkron(1959). Ɔfiri Akyem Bieni a ɛwɔ Ghana Apueeɛ Mantam mu. Ɔnyaa ne Diploma wɔ (Freight Forwarding )mu wɔ (Zurich,Switzerland ), mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Du-mmeɛnsa (2013) mu.

Adwumayɛ 
Ansa na ɔrekɔ amanyɔsɛm mu no, na Brako yɛ (Teamwork Freight Services ) a ɛwɔ Tema no panyin.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Brako kɔɔ mmarahyɛbadwafie  wɔ ɔbɛnem da a ɛtɔ so nson, mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu nedu- mmeɛnsa. Ɔgyinaa  Tema Mfimfini abatoɔ mpɛsoa no  ananmu wɔ ɔsono kokroko ammanyɔkuo (New Patriotic Party-NPP)tekiti so. Wɔ mma Mpem Aduanan-baako, Ahanum ne Aduɔwɔtwe-baako (41,581 ) a ɛbaeɛ wɔ abatoɔ no mu no , onyaa Mpem Aduonu-nwɔtwe, Aha-mmeɛnsa ne Aduasa-nan (28,334) a ɛno gyina hɔ ma mma no mu ɔha nkyekyem aduosia-nwɔtwe ne akyiri pɔ aduasa-baako(68.31%%) de dii nkonim wɔ nkondwa  no so. Wɔsan paw no wɔ mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Du-nsia (2016 )mu sɛ ɔnkɔ so ntena mmarahyɛbadwa no mu mfeɛ nnan (4) bio.

Wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa mu no, wasom wɔ abadwakuo ahodoɔ mu. Ebi ne; Akwan ne Kar Abadwakuo, Bɔbeasu ne Mmofra Abadwakuo ne Mmabun, Agumadi ne Amammerɛ Boayikuw.

N'ankasa Abrabɔ 
Brako aware a ɔwɔ mma baanan. Ɔda ne ho adi sɛ ɔyɛ Kristoni na ɔyɛ Yesu Kristo Asɔre a ɛwɔ Nna a Ɛdi Akyire Ahotefoɔ(The Church Of Jesus  Christ Of Latter Day Saint ) mu ni.

title: Rachel Florence Appoh
text:
Rachel Florence Appoh a wɔwoo no Kɔtɔnimaa bosome da ɛtɔ so nsia wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduowɔtwe mu no yɛ Ghana   amanyɔni ne kane National Democratic Congress (NDC)  Mmarahyɛbadwani ma Gomoa Central Abatoɔ mpasua a ɛwɔ Mfinimfini Mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana. Sane nso yɛ Ɔsoafoɔ Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Mmaa, Mmɔfra ne Asetena mu Ahobammɔ so. 

Naana Ayiah Quansah na ɔdii Rachel adeɛ wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du- nsia mmarahyɛbadwa abatoɔ no mu

Ne Mmɔfrase  ne nwomasua 
Rachel Florence Appoh wɔwoo no  Kɔtɔnimaa  bosome da ɛtɔ so nsia wɔ afe apem Mmarahyɛbadwani ma Gomoa Central Region of [Ghana].Ɔwɔ master's degrees mmienu mprempren. 'MSC International Finance and Accounting' wɔ 'University of Buckinghamshire' (UK) wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du- num ne 'Masters in Governance and Leadership'(MGL) wɔ Gimpa Accra wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du- nkron. Ɔkɔɔ ne sukuupɔn wɔ Pentecost sukuupɔn, Accra baabi a ɔnyaa Bsc Accounting wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nwɔtwe mu. Ɔyɛ National Democratic Congress amanyɔkuo ni na ɔgyina hɔ ma dodoɔ no ara wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa no mu.

Adwuma 
Ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ 'Auditor' wɔ 'KAMA Health Service', Labone wɔ Accra.Ɔsan nso yɛɛ adwuma sɛ Cost controller/ Ac countant wɔ Anglo Gold Ashanti Ltd ne Peace Fm.[6] Ɔgyinaa Gomoa Central abatoɔ mpasua  ananmu sɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du mmiɛnsa  ne mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du nsia . Ɔbɛyɛɛ Ɔsoafoɔ Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Bɔbeasu, Mmofra ne Asetena mu Ahobanbɔ so wɔ ɛno akyi

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ɔsan nso yɛ Ɔsoafo Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Mmaa, Mmɔfra ne Asetena mu Ahobammɔ so.[3][4] Naana Ayiah Quansah na ɔsii Rachel ananmu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du- nsia 2016 mmarahyɛbadwa abatoɔ no mu.

Kristosom (Pentekoste Asɔre)[6] Rachel Florence Appoh, a na anka ɔyɛ Ɔsoafo Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ Mmaa, Mmɔfra ne Asetena mu Ahobammɔ so wɔ kane Ɔmanpanin JohnMahama aban no ase no ada apereperedi ahodoɔ a amammuofoɔ fa mu wɔ abatoɔ mu adi. Sɛnea ɔkyerɛ no, wɔde sika ayɛ Ghana amammuo nhyehyɛe no akodu baabi a sɛ sika nni hɔ a obi ntumi nni nkonim wɔ abatoɔ biara mu. Wɔ nsɛmmisa bi a 'The Ghana Report' hwɛɛ so no, Ms. Appoh kaa sɛ, ɔfaa bosea a ɛyɛ GHC700,000 de tuaa ne 2016 mmarahyɛbadwa mu mmɔdenbɔ wɔ Gomoa Central Abatoɔ mpasua  wɔ Central Region, a ɔdii nkoguo.

Ankorankoro Abrabɔ 
Appoh aware Samuel Nana Opoku, na ɔwɔ abɔfra baako.

Beaɛ Menyaa Mmoa firiiɛ

title: Alfred Okoe Vanderpuije
text:
Alfred Oko Vanderpuije (wɔwoo no Ɔbɛnem bosome ne da a ɛtɔ so 4 wɔ afe  1955) yɛ Ghana nhomasua ho nimdefo ne ɔmanyɛfo a mprempren ɔyɛ mmarahyɛ baguani. Mprempren ɔyɛ mmarahyɛ baguani ma Ablekuma South Constituency a ɛwɔ Greater Accra Region wɔ Ghana. 

Ne Dutch abusua din no da ne Euro-African abusua adi. Mfiase no na Vanderpuije nananom fi Sint-Maartensdijk a ɛwɔ kan supɔw Tholen a ɛwɔ Netherlands no so. Ná ne nana, Jacobus van der Puije, yɛ Dutch Gold Coast amrado wɔ 1780 mu.

Mfitiase asetra 
Jamestown kuromni, wɔwoo no na wɔtetee no wɔ Mamprobi, Darkuman, ne Dansoman wɔ ne mmofraase mmere ahorow mu.

Nwomasua 
Vanderpuije suaa ade wɔ Accra Akyerɛkyerɛfo Ntetee Kɔlege maa mfe 3 Postsecondary abodin krataa wɔ Nhomasua mu. Ɔwɔ Masters wɔ Nhomasua mu wɔ Mid America Nazarene College ne Nhomasua ho Ɔbenfo wɔ Missouri Sukuupɔn, Kansas City, U.S.A.

Amammui mu adwuma

Sɛ́ Accra Mayor no 
Na ɔyɛ kan Accra Mayor, ɔmampanyin John Atta Mills de no sii saa adwumayɛbea no mu wɔ afe 2009 mu na Ɔmampanyin John Dramani Mahama na ɔhwɛɛ no ​​so wɔ saa adwumayɛbea no mu, na ɔwiee n’ahennie a ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ afe 2017 mu.

Sɛ́ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni 
Wɔpaw Vanderpuije sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ Ghana Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni wɔ afe 2016 abatoɔ no mu wɔ National Democratic Congress (NDC) tekiti so sɛ ɔmmɛgyina Ablekuma South Constituency ananmu wɔ Greater Accra Region mu mfeɛ nnan. Odii nkonim wɔ abatow no mu de abatow 31,927 wɔ abatow 59,041 a ɛfata a wɔtow a egyina hɔ ma abatow no ɔha biara mu nkyem 54.36 no mu. Sɛ́ MP no, ɔyɛ Amannɔne Nsɛm Boayikuw ne Mmarahyɛ Bagua no Aban Boayikuw no muni.

Ankorankoro asetra 
Vanderpuije hweree ne yere Gifty Naa Adei Vanderpuije wɔ afe 2012 mu, bere a owui wɔ Korle-Bu Nkyerɛkyerɛ Ayaresabea no. Vanderpuije san waree Cynthia Amerley Ayiku bere a wahwere ne yere mfe ason akyi.

Agyapadeɛ 
Dwoda 9 September 2021 anadwo no, ɔkyerɛɛ kar akwan a ɛwɔ Sakaman Junction no kwan kɔɔ Dansoman roundabout stretch no so. Osii gyinae sɛ ɔbɛkyerɛ kar kwan bere a polisifo nni hɔ no. Ne nneyɛe no maa wɔn a wɔde saa kwan no di dwuma no nyaa ahotɔ.

Akyinnyegye ahorow

LGBTQ 
Alfred Oko Vanderpuije, MP for Ablekuma South Constituency, wɔ October, 2021 mu no san sii so dua sɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no apow LGBTQ mmara kwan so de wɔ Ghana. Ɔdaa adwene a ɛne sɛ wɔ Ghana amammerɛ abakɔsɛm nyinaa mu no, wɔampene adwene a ɛne sɛ mmarima ne mmea aware ho no animtiaa denneennen, na ɛboro asasesin ne mmusuakuw mu nsonsonoe so. Osii so dua sɛ ɛnyɛ nea ɛda adi sɛ adwene a agye ntini kɛse yi rennya nsakrae titiriw biara daakye. Osii so dua sɛ yɛrebɛn nea adi sɛ yɛregye atom yi rennya ntɛm. Ɔsii Ghana gyinaesi a ɛne sɛ wɔbɛhyehyɛ mmara a ɛfoa LGBTQ hokwan ahodoɔ no so dua, na ɛhyɛɛ nsonsonoeɛ agyiraeɛ wɔ adwene a ɛwɔ U.S. ne Europa no ho.

Afoforo nso 
Wɔ Citi News nsɛmbisa mu no, Owura Vanderpuije, Ablekuma South ananmusifoɔ no, kyerɛɛ Accra nsuyiriɛ no sɛ asɛm a ɛho hia a ɛsɛ sɛ nea wɔayi no no sɛ wɔsi so dua a, ɔdi ho dwuma. Ɔhyɛɛ Madam Elizabeth Sackey sɛ ɔne Accra Ɔmantam Soafo no nyɛ biako bere a wafi dibea no.

Nsɛm a wɔde gyinaa so

title: Atta Boafo Daniel Kingsley
text:
Atta Boafo Daniel Kingsley yɛ Ghana amanyɔni na ɔyɛ Ghana mmrahyɛbadwani wɔ Mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson wɔ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu . Na ɔgyina Fomena mansin ananmu wɔ Asanti Mantam  ɛwɔ New Patriotic Party no din mu.

Adwuma 
Na ɔyɛ Transport Analyst wɔ Kumasi Metropolitan Assembly. Wɔpaa  no wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn bosome mu wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du- nson  mu bere a odii n’asɔretiafo kuo a ɛdi kan no so nkonim a ɔde mma ɔha mu abupɛn aduosia nson Akyire po aduoson num (67.75%) wɔ abatoeɛ a wɔtoeɛ no nyinaa mu.

title: Naser Mahama Toure
text:
Nasser Toure Mahama a wɔwoo no Oforisuo bosome da ɛtɔ so du-nson wɔ Afe apem ahenkron aduosia -nnum mu no yɛ Ghana amanyɔni ne Mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ Ghana mmrahyɛbadwa a Ɛtɔ so Nson  ɛwɔ Ghana Adehyeman a Ɛto so Anan no mu a na ɔgyina Ayawaso Apueeɛ Mansin ananmu wɔ Greater Accra Mantam mu wɔ National Democratic Congress din mu .

Ne Mmɔƒrase ne nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Mahama wɔ Oforisuo da ɛtɔ so du- nson wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduosia num mu. Ɔfiri Nima-Accra, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Greater Accra Mantam mu wɔ Ghana.[2] Ɔkɔɔ West Africa Senior High School.Ɔkɔɔ 'Central University College', Ghana na ɔnyaa ne Bachelor of Science abodin krataa wɔ adwadie mu wɔ afe apem ahenkron aduowɔtwe -nson mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Mahama yɛ 'Ɔman Demokrasi'  National Democratic Congress (NDC) Mmarahyɛbadwani.  Wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du-mmienu mu no, ɔde National Democratic Congress mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ Ghana mmrahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nsia a ɛwɔ Ghana Adehyeman  a ɛtɔ so nnan no sii akan wɔ Ayawaso Apuei fam akondwa no so na ɔdii nkonim.[2]

Adwuma 
Ɔkwankyerɛfo panyin, Aminasei Ngo Adwumakuo, Accra 

Mmrahyɛbadwani (Ɔpɛpɔn 7, 2013–mprempren; afe a ɛtɔ so mmienu)

Adwuma ahorow

Ankorankorɛ Abrabɔ

title: Abdul-Aziz Mohammed
text:
Mohammed Abdul Aziz yɛ Ghana amanyɔfoɔ. Na ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no muni ma Mion mantam a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Mantam a ɔdii nkonim wɔ afe 2016 Ghana mmarahyɛ bagua abatoɔ mu.

Abrabɔ Ashasiɛ ni Adesua 
Wɔwoo no Ɔkɔtɔber 27th, 1975, na ɔfiri Kulinkpegu a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Fam Mantam mu.

Onyaa adansedi krataa a edidi so yi; Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ adansedie krataa (Tamale Nteteeɛ Asoɛeɛ) Ɔman Diploma a ɛkorɔn (Tamale Polytechnic) Bachelor Of Commerce (University of Cape Coast) Post-Graduate Certificate (Ghana Telecom Suapɔn) Masters wɔ Adwumayɛ mu (Coventry Suapɔn/Ghana Telecom Suapɔn).

Bɛbia Mmoa Efiri

title: Mohammed Hardi Tuferu
text:
Mohammed Hardi Tufeiru yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ na ɔyɛ Ghana Ɔmanpanin a ɛtɔ so nnan Mmarahyɛdwa a ɛtɔ so nson no muni a ɔgyina Nanton Mansin a ɛwɔ Atifi Mantam no ananmu wɔ New Patriotic Party no tekiti so. Ɔyɛ adesua ho nimdefoɔ ne akontabufoɔ a ne ho akokwa, ɔfiri Institute of Chartered Accountant (ICAG) na ɔwɔ MBA wɔ Akontaabuo mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu ne Bachelor of Commerce abodin krataa wɔ University of Cape Coast. Mprempren ɔyɛ Kuadwuma ho Ɔsoafo Abadiakyiri.

Nwomasua 
Ɔnyaa GCE wɔ afe 1996 mu na ɔkɔɔ University of Cape Coast kɔnyaa B.Comm (Accounting) wɔ afe 2000. Ɔsan nso nyaa M.B.A wɔ akontabuo mu wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu wɔ afe 2006. Ɔbɛyɛɛ Institute of Chartered no muni Akontaabufoɔ ( Akontaabuo) wɔ afe 2009. Ɔyɛ IIA ( Auditing) 2016 no muni.

Adwuma 
Hon. Mohamed Hardi Tuferu yɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ firi afe 2001 kɔsi afe 2006 wɔ Tamale Mfiridwuma Suapɔn mu ne Akontaabuo Panyin firi afe 2006 kɔsi afe 2016.Ɔtenaa Audit Reports Implementation Committees a ɛwɔ ntoaso sukuu akyi asoɛeɛ dodoɔ bi mu wɔ afe 2008 ne 2016 ntam, a Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nkɔsoɔ Adesua ne Tamale Mfiridwuma Suapɔn ka ho. Efi afe 2007 kosi afe 2016 no, na ɔyɛ Tamale Mfiridwuma Sukuupɔn no mu Nhwehwɛmu Dwumadibea no Titenani. Wɔ Tamale Technical University ne Institutes for Distance Learning no, ɔkyerɛɛ akontabuo, Towtua, Cost & Management Accounting, Auditing, MIS, Public Sector Accounting, ne Quantitative Methods (University of Cape Coast, University of Ghana ne Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology ).

Ɔsom wɔ Mmarahyɛ Bagua no mu 
Wɔ Mmarahyɛbadwa ɛtɔ so nson no mu no, na ɔyɛ Ɔmanfoɔ Akontaabuo Boayikuo (PAC) no muni Abadiakyiri ne Boayikuo a ɛhwɛ nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia, nyansahu ne mfiridwuma so no muni. Ná ɔyɛ Afrika Mmarahyɛbadwa kuo no nanmusifo nso. Na ɔyɛ Petroleum Commission Ghana Board of Directors no muni firi afe 2017 kɔsi afe 2021, na ɔyɛɛ Sikasɛm ne Mpɔtam hɔ Nsɛm Boayikuo no guamtrani. Efi afe 2017 kɔsi afe 2021 no, ɔsan tenaa Akontaabuo Boayikuo a ɛwɔ Ghana Gas Co. Ltd. Boayikuo no mu .

Ankorankora asetena 
Tuferu yɛ muslim,ɔware ɔyerenom mmienu a wɔwɔ mma.

Bɛbia Mmoa Efiri

title: Tampi Achemapong Simon
text:
Simon Acheampong Tampi yɛ Ghana amammuifoɔ na ɔyɛ Ghana Mantam a ɛtɔ so nnan Mmarahyɛ Bagua a ɛtɔ so nson no muni a ɔgyina Tatale-Sanguli Mantamananmu wɔ Atifi Mantam mu wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so. Wɔwoo no April 24, 1975 mu.

Adwuma 
Wɔ afe 1996 ne 2002 ntam no, na Simon yɛ asase sohwɛfoɔ wɔ Nulux Plantation Limited na ɔsan nso yɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ wɔ Nakpalu-Borle Mfitiaseɛ Sukuu mu wɔ afe 2005 ne 2016 ntam.

Wanya nkɔso wɔ B.S. adansedi krataa a efi Sunyani Polytechnic, adansedi krataa wɔ adwumayɛ ne mfiridwuma ho adesua mu fi Sukuupɔn a Ɛhwɛ Nhomasua Winneba so ne B.S adansedi krataa wɔ Adansi Nhomasua mu.

title: Simon Acheampong Tampi
text:
Simon Acheampong Tampi yɛ Ghana amanyɔni sane yɛ mmrahyɛbedwani wɔ mmrahyɛbedwafie a ɛtɔ nson wɔ Ghana adehyeman a ɛtɔso nan ho a na ɔgyina mu ma Tatale-Sangui mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Atifi mantam ma NDC

title: Nyanpong Kojo Aboagye
text:
Kwadwo Nyanpon Aboagye yɛ Ghana amanyɔni sane ka mmrahyɛbedwafie a ɛtɔso nson wɔ Ghana adehyeman a ɛtɔso nan ho a na ɔgyina ma Biakoye mpɛsoa wɔ Oti mantam mu ma NDC amanyɔkuo no ho. Wɔ Oforisuo 2022 ɔbɔɔ dwa yɛɛ ani nhwehwɛmu ne operesan maa ne manfoɔ kwa wɔ Biakoye.

N'abrabɔ ahyeaseɛ ne nnwomasua 
Aboagye firi Apesokubi. Wɔkura nkrataa wɔ Civil Engineering a ɔnya firii Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology, nkrataa wɔ corporate governance mu firi GIMPA. Wɔ sane ka Ghana Institutes of Engineers and Civil Institution of Engineers, UK.

Beaeɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Robert Baba Kuganab-Lem
text:
Robert Baba Kuganab-Lem yɛ Ghana amanyɔni san ka mmrahyɛbedwafie a ɛtɔso nson ho a ɔgyina mu ma Binduri Abatoɔ mpɛsoa a ɛwɔ Atifi Apueiɛ mantam no wɔ Kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress-NDC tekiti so  ɔdi saa dwuma yi wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nson wɔ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nan no mu.

Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ ne Nwomasua 
Wɔwoo no Obubuo, afe Apem, Ahankron ne Aduosia-nsia wɔ Binduri a ɛwɔ Ghana atifi fam mu. Ɔyɛɛ adwuma sɛ  nhwehwɛmufoɔ boafoɔ wɔ Kintampo Health Research firi afe Apem Ahankron ne Aduɔkron-nan (1994 ) kɔsii afe Apem Ahankron ne Aduɔkron-nsia (1996). Ɛfiri 1999 kɔsii 2016 no, ɔkyerɛɛ adeɛ  wɔ University for Development Studies ansa na wɔrebɛpaw no sɛ ɔsoafoɔ abadiakyire a ɔhwɛ mansini amanyɔsɛm soɔ. 

Robert wɔ BA wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu, MSC wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn no mu. Ɔsan nso wɔ Ph.D. wɔ Keele Suapɔn a ɛwɔ United Kingdom, no mu. Afei, ɔwɔ MPHE wɔ Suez Canal Suapɔn a ɛwɔ  Egypt no mu; ɛna MSC wɔ Ghana Suapɔn Legon mu.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ansa na wɔrebɛpaw no sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ama Binduri Abatoɔ mpɛsoa no, na ɔyɛ Atifi Apueiɛ matam no soafoɔ firi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du-nsia de kɔsi mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu. Mmom, na ɔno ankasa ne nkorɔfoɔ kyerɛ mu a, wɔnhyɛ da nhu adwuma a na ɔyɛ ma wɔn. Ɛnan so ma no hweree Binduri mmarahyɛbadwa akondwa no wɔ mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne aduonu Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu.  Ɔsusu sɛ nkrɔfoɔ binom a wɔmpɛ NDC  amanyɔkuo no yie no na na wɔhyehyɛ ntwo a ɔdiiɛ no akyi. Dr. Kuganab-Lem kaa saa asɛm yi wɔ nkɔmmɔdie bi  a ɛkɔɔ so wɔ Dreamz Fm  radio dwumadibea hɔ no mu. 

Ɛwom mpo sɛ Ɔbenfo Kuganab-Lem ankasa kaa sɛ na Owura Mahmou a ɔne  no sii akan saa berɛ no akwannya n pa sɔ ɛbenymmgrahyɛbdwa                 akondwa a no ama NDC ɛde, nanso ɔgye di nso sɛ wɔn a wɔatwa Mmabadwani agua  no muni a wɔapaw no ho ahyia no yɛ nnipa a nyaadwomfoɔ a wɔ mpɛ NDC

amanyɔkuo no yie.no.

Ankorankoroɛ Abrabɔ ne Adwumyɛ 
Wayɛ adwuma sɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛni panin a na ɔkyerɛ apɔwmuden ne Sikasɛm ( Health Economic) ho adeɛ wɔ (University of Develpement Studies) fa a ɛwɔ Tamale . Wasan nso ayɛ adwuma sɛ ɔsoafoɔ abadiakyire a ɔhwɛ apɔwmuden so firi , Ɔbɛnem, mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du-nsia (2016) de kɔsi  Ɔpɛpɔn da a ɛtɔ so nsia, mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du-nson(2017)

title: Anthony N-Yoh Abayifaa Karboh
text:
Anthony Abayifaa Karbo (wɔwoo no  Ɔbɛnem da a ɛtɔ so du-mmienu, afe Apem, Ahankron ne aduɔson -nkron -1979) yɛ Ghana mmanyɔni ne Mmarahyɛbadwani  ma wɔ Lawra mansini a ɛwɔ Ghana atifi atɔeɛ mantam mu no. Ɔyɛ Ɔsono kokroko ammanyɔkuo (New Patriotic Party-NPP ) no mu ni. Ɔsan nso yɛ ɔsomafoɔ a ɔhwɛ Ghana akwantempɔn  ne akwan ho nsɛm so no Abadiakyire.

Abrabɔ Ahyaseɛ 
Karbo yɛ Dagaaba abusuakuo no mu ni ; na ɔfiri Lawra a ɛwɔ Ghana Atifi Atɔeɛ mantam (Upper West Region ) mu no. Wɔwoo no wɔ Jekarayili kuro ketewa bi a ɛwɔ Tamale, Ghana Atifi fam mantam ahenkuro mu. Ɔyɛ  Abayifaa adehyeɛ abusua kɛseɛ no mu ni. Wɔde Karbo baa ammanyɔsɛm  mu wɔ ne mmofraase. Na ne papa, Abeifaa Karbo yɛ (Northern People’s Party) Adikanfoɔ a wɔtwerɛ no mu baako. Awieɛ koraa no ɔbɛyɛɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani a ɔdi kan ma Lawra- Nandom mansini no. Na ɔyɛ nne a odi kan wɔ Ghana Ɔmampanyin a ɔdi kan, Dr. Kwame Nkrumah nhyɛsoɔ nnisoɔ no mu.

Nhomasua 
Karbo suaa adeɛ wɔ Suapɔn a ɛhwɛ Nkɔsoɔ Adesua so,(University of Develpement Studies).Ɔnyaa abodin krataa wɔ (Integrated Development Studies ) mu wɔ mfeɛ Mpem-Mmienu ne nenum(2005). Sɛ osuani no, Karbo daa ne ho adi sɛ sukuuni kannifoɔ na ɔkɔɔ soro faa dibea no mu bɛyɛɛ ( Central Student Representative Council-SRC, President) wɔ (University for Development Studies ) wmfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Ɛnan (2004). Ansa na ɛno reba no, na ɔyɛ Ɔsono kokroko ammanyɔkuo (New Patriotic Party-NPP) asuafoɔ kabom kuo-TESCON a ɛwɔ Navrongo Campus no titenani. Karbo san nso bɛyɛɛ (Central Committees) a ɛwɔ (National Union of Ghana Students ne (University Students Association of Ghana) nyinaa mu. Ne mmɔdenmmɔ wɔ saa dwumadie yi mu no maa wɔpaw no sɛ ɔmmɛka ( Upper West Regional Campaign Team) no ho ansa na NPP 2004 amansan abatoɔ no reba. Wɔ mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Nsia (2006) mu no, owiee Masters wɔ Sikasɛm Nhyehyɛe ne Amanaman Ntam Adwumayɛ mu wɔ Birmingham Sukuupɔn mu.

Wɔ mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Nson (2007) mu no, ɛnam saa bere no frankaa kurafoɔ a na ɔwɔ New Patriotic Party no ahyɛdeɛ so no, Nana Akufo-Addo Karbo san kɔɔ Ghana kɔdii amanyɔsɛm a ɛyɛ nnam akyi.

Amanyɔsɛm 

Wɔ Ɔbɛnem , mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne nwɔtwe (2008) mu no, wɔpaw Karbo sɛ ɔman nhwehwɛmu abadwakuo a ɛwɔ (New Patriotic Party) no mu ni. Wɔmaa no dibea wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa, mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne nwɔtwe (2008 ) mu sɛ Ɔsatuo Ntamgyinafoɔ maa ɔsono kokroko ammanyɔkuo (New Patriotic Party-NPP ) Dr. Mahamudu Bawumia a ɔpɛ sɛ ɔyɛ ɔmampanyin abadiakyiri. Berɛ a Party no dii nkoguo wɔ mfeɛ Mpem-Mmienu ne Nwɔtwe (2008) abatowɔ no mu akyiri no, Karbo san kɔɔ NPP amanyɔkuo no dwumadibea (Party's Office); na ɔsom sɛ amanyɔkuo no nkitahodie  kuo no mu ni.

Wɔ mfeɛ Mpem -mmienu ne edu (2010) mu no, wɔpaw Karbo sɛ ɔmmoaboa ɔman no mmabunu a wɔwɔ kuo no mu no ano.Karbo dii saa dwuma yi kɔsii mfeɛ Mpem-mmienu ne Du-mmienu (2012 ) berɛ a ɔgyaee adwuma sɛ ɔrekɔdi ne mmɔdenbɔ a ɛne sɛ ɔbɛyɛ Party no mmarahyɛbadwani kandifoɔ ama Lawra Mansin a na wɔabɔ no foforɔ no akyi sɛdeɛ amanyɔkuo no nhyehyɛeɛ teɛ. Karbo antumi wɔ ne mmɔdenbɔ no mu no, ɔsan kɔsom sɛ Ɔman (New Patriotic Party-NPP) Nkitahodie so wɛfoɔ Abadiakyire ne manpanin no kasamafoɔ.

Mmarahyɛdwam 
Wɔdii kan paw no sɛ Ghana Mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ NPP tekiti so wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa , mfeɛ Mpem-mmienu ne Du-nsia (December 2016) mu berɛ   a odii  Sampson Abu ne Atifi Atɔeɛ Mansini soafoɔ a ɔdi dwuma mprenpren yi,  Onimuonyamfoɔ Bede Ziedeng so nkonim no.Ansa na wɔreyɛ abatoɔ no, na nnipa pii agye hokwan a obɛtumi adi nkonim no ho kyim ɛfiri sɛ na kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo

Natioa  Democraticsɔɔnakotena mu ayare sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani nna ɔmamfoɔ kekakekaae ɛd Ghana amamnebɔ nsɛm mu sɛ u

a

a kakraa Ɔsofoɔ aaa ntam se MP no, wɔkaa no kɛse wɔ Ghana nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔ mu sɛ wɔbɛpaw no sɛ Ɔmanpanyin abadiakyiri.

Ɔperee  wɔ mfeɛ Mpem-mmienu ne Aduonu (2020) Ghana amansan abatoɔ mu sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani  New Patriotic Party tekiti so

Ɔsofoɔ Abadiakyire 
Wɔ Oforisuo, mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne du-nson ( April 2017) mu no, wɔpaw Karbo sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ ɔsomafoɔ abadiakyire a ɔhwɛ Ghana akwantempɔn ne akwantuo ho nsɛm so wɔ asoeɛ a ɛhwɛ akwantempɔn ne akwantuo ho nsɛm so(Ministry for Road and Highways ) no mu. Sɛ Ɔsofoɔ abadiakyire no, Karbo yɛɛ titenani wɔ abadwakuo a na wɔnam (Sinohydro deal) so di wɔn dwuma no  wɔ adansie ho dwumadie kɛseɛ (infrastructure barter) wɔ Ghana abakɔsɛm mu. Karbo akɔ so asi n'adwene pi sɛ wɔbɛma nkitahodie a ɛda adi pefee sɛ ɔkwan a wɔbɛfa so ama Ghana akwan ho nhyehyɛeɛ anya nkɔsoɔ.

2)017 mu no, wɔpaw Karbo sɛ Ɔmanpanyin Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ akwan ne akwan akɛse so. Sɛ́ Ɔmanpanyin Abadiakyiri no,  yɛɛ adwuma boayikuw a ɛfa Sinohydro apam no ho wɔ Ministry for Road and Highways, a ɛyɛ nnwuma a wɔde sesa nneɛma a ɛso sen biara wɔ Ghana abakɔsɛm mu no guamtrani. Karbo akɔ so agye akyinnye sɛ wɔbɛbɔ fekubɔ a wɔabue ano sɛ ɔkwan a wɔbɛfa so ama Ghana akwan ho nhyehyɛe anya nkɔso.

N'ankasa Abrabɔ 
Karbo aware Awenlue Kante-Karbo (woo Kante) na ɔwɔ mma mmeɛnsa. Ɔyɛ Kristoni, wɔwoo no na wɔtetee no sɛ Katolekni na ɔyɛ Katolek Asɔre no Lawra Parish no mu ni a ɔyɛ hye. Sɛ ammanyɔsɛm  da nkyɛn a, Karbo de nsiyɛ di kuayɛ akyi na n’ani gye ho  Yie pa ara. Wayɛ kuayɛ dwumadie ahodoɔ a wɔbom yɛ no na ɔnam saayɛ so ahyɛ ne nipasu mu den kɛse sɛ amanyɔni a ofiri gam. Wɔtaa bu Anthony Karbo sɛ ɔboa Afrikafo na ɔtaa ahiafo akyi wɔ ne gyidi ahorow mu. Bere a Karbo nmpow amannɔne biakoyɛ ne mmoa no, mpɛn pii no wafrɛ sikasɛm mu fekubɔ a ɛbɛboa Afrika Aman mu ɔman mma mpapahwekwa tẽẽ.

Ɔfoa Kramannam weɛ so 
Wɔbɔɔ amanneɛ wɔ afe 2017 mu sɛ akraman nam a wɔhwehwɛ a ɛrekɔ soro (esiane gyidie a ɛwɔ sɛ ɛma ahoɔden pii nti) ama amammuifoɔ Anthony Karbo ahyɛ nyansa sɛ wɔnyɛ akraman nam adwumayɛbea wɔ Ghana atifi fam mantam mmiɛnsa mu.

title: Rudolph Nsowine Amenga-Etego
text:
Rudolf Amenga-Etego (wɔwoo no Ɔpɛnimaa da a ɛtɔ so du-nson, afe Apem, Ahankron ne aduonum-nwɔtw-1958) yɛ Ghana mmaranimfoɔ ne nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia ho ɔbenfoɔ. Wɔmaa no

(Goldman Environmental Prize )  wɔ mfeɛ Mpem-Mmienu ne Ɛnan ( 204 mu, esiane mmɔden a ɔbɔe sɛ ɔbɛma nsuo a ɛho yɛ na ma ɔmanfoɔ, na mpɛn pii de boɔ taa yɛ den no ho nsɛm ayɛ mmrɛ ama ɔmanfoɔ ɔmanfoɔ  no nti.Ɔsɔre tia titire ne Wiase Sikakorabea ne Amanaman Ntam Sikakorabea a wɔde bosea rema Ghana aban no na ama nsuo ho nhyehyɛeɛ atu mpɔn wɔ ɔman no mu nyinaa. Ɔhaw  biako pɛ a ɛwɔ saa boseabɔ  yi ho ne wɔn nhyehyeɛ  a ɛhwehwɛ sɛ wɔde nsuo a wɔde ma no yɛ ankorankorɛ deɛ.

N'abrabɔ 
Sɛ aberanteɛ  a ɔyɛ mmaranimfoɔ no, ohunuu sɛ ɔrebɔ ahiafoɔ a wontuaa wɔn nsuo ho ka ne wɔn a wɔne aban redi ntetɛntetɛ ɛsiane sɛ wɔmfa mmarakwan so mfa nsuo no nni dwuma no nti . Saa apereapereɛ  yi hyɛɛ no ​​ma ɔhwehwɛɛ ade korɔ pɔtee a ɛde saa  nsuo ho haw no nyiaa ba. Yei yɛ Ɔmanfoɔ akoma so adeɛ ne anigyesɛm pa ara. Ɛsiane sɛ wɔsusu sɛ ɛbɛboa atu wɔn nsuo ho nsem a ayɛ den no ase koraa ama we ɔn ho atɔ wɔn.). .Siaka kyerɛ mu a n'ani bɛgyee nsuo ho wɔ afe Apem, Ahankron ne Aduɔkron-nkron (1999) mu berɛ a n’afipamfoɔ a wɔwɔ Ghana ahenkuro Accra mu nwiinwii sɛ wotwaa wɔn nsuo mu berɛ  a ɛrekame ayɛ sɛ ne boɔ kɔɔ soro mmɔho mmienu na wɔkaa akyiri wɔ wɔn sikatua mu no. Asoeɛ a ɛhwɛ wiase nsuo ho nsɛm so , ne IMF gyinaa akyirie , na mprenpren yi, Ghana aban no resiesie ne nsuo nhyehyɛeɛ no ama wɔde ahyɛ ankorankorɛ nsa.

Adwumayɛ 
Ɔnyaa Bachelor of Arts wɔ Ghana Suapɔn mu, EMGL wɔ Ghana ( Institute of Management and Public Administration),  ne (Barrister at Law) wɔ (Ghana School of Law). Wɔmaa no (Goldman Environmental Prize )wɔ mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Ɛnan(2004) mu, ɛsiane mmɔden a ɔbɔeɛ sɛ ɔbɛma nsuo a wɔde ma no ho nsɛm ayɛ mrɛ ama amamfrafoɔ; na  ɔbɔɔ ɔsatuo tiaa nsuo a wɔde bɛma ankorankorɛ wɔ Ghana no nti. Ɔsɔre tiaa titire ne asoeɛ ne Amanaman Ntam Sikakorabea a wɔde bosea rema Ghana aban de ama nsuo ho nhyehyɛeɛ atu mpɔn wɔ ɔman no mu nyinaa.

Sɛ́ Wiase Nyinaa Mmuae Nhyehyɛeɛ a Ɛhwɛ Asetena mu Nkɔso Asoɛe a Wɔaka abom no panyin no, Amenga nokwaredi, ɔhyew, ne ne tumi soronko a ɔde tu mmirika wɔ wiase ahoroɔ a ɛwɔ tumi, ne ahiafo ntam no boa ma wɔmaa nsu a wɔde ma ankorankoro no kɔɔ soro sɛ ammanyɔni . Ɔmanfoɔ ɔmanfoɔ apɔwmuden/akwahosan ho asɛm a ɛho hia.

Abasobɔdeɛ 
Ɔnyaa Goldman nneɛma a atwa yɛn ho ahyia ho nkonimboɔ wɔ afe 2004 mu.
