title: Frederic Fritz Baffour
text:
Fritz Baffour (wɔwoo no ɔbɛnem da a ɛtɔ so du-baako, afe Apem Ahankron ne Aduonum-nmmienu-1952) yɛ Ghana nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfoɔ, amanyɔni ne nkitahodie ho ɔfotufoɔ. Na ɔyɛ Mmarahyɛbadwani ma adehyeɛ a wɔwɔ Ablekuma Anafoɔ  mansini no  mu no. Ɔdii saa dwuma yi wɔ Ghana Mmarahyɛbadwa no mu ne ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ amanneɛbɔ so wɔ Ɔmanpanin dada 

John Evans Fiifi Atta Mills berɛ so.

Mfitiaseɛ Asetena ne Nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Baffour wɔ ɔbɛnem da a ɛtɔ so Du-baako, afe Apem, Ahankron ne Aduonum-mmienu (1952) wɔ Korle Gonno a ɛwɔ Nkran , Ghana ahenkuro mu no.   Na n’agya yɛ R. P. Baffour, a na ɔyɛ Ghana mfididwumayɛfoɔ a wɔdii kan no mu baako ne saa ara nso na ɔyɛ Ghana Vice Chancellor a ɔdi kan wɔ Kwame Nkrumah Suapɔn no mu.  Na Fritz maame yɛ awogyefoɔ. Ɔkɔɔ ntoaso sukuu wɔ Prempeh College ne Technology Secondary School, a ne nyinaa wɔ Kumasi wɔ Ashanti Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔnyaa ne GCE Ordinary Level adansedie krataa wɔ afe Apem Ahankron ne Aduosia -nwɔtwe (1968. Ne sukuu afe a ɛtɔ so nsia no wɔ City of Bath College a ɛwɔ Somerset wɔ United Kingdom wɔ ( 1972 )ne afe Apem, Ahankron ne Aduɔson-nan (1974) ntam, na ɔde GCE Advanced Level adansedie krataa no wieeɛ. Baffour nso kɔɔ Bristol Polytechnic wɔ afe Apem Ahankron ne Aduɔson-nan  (1974) ne afe Apem Ahankron ne Aduɔson-nso(1976 )ntam hɔ. Fritz Baffour yɛɛ (master’s degree) wɔ Nkitahodie Adesua mu wɔ Leicester Suapɔn mu wɔ mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Du-nson (2007) ne mfeɛ mpem Mmienu ne Du-mmienu (2012 ) ntam.

Adwumayɛ 
Baffour yɛɛ adwuma sɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfoɔ. Na ɔyɛ ɔyɛkyerɛfoɔ wɔ (Ghana Television, TV )dwumadibea a ɛwɔ ɔman no dea Ghana Broadcasting Corporation mu sɛ panin ne ɔkwankyerɛfo. Ɔsan nso ne Liberia Television, Nigeria Television, Tyne Tees TV UK, Diverse Production wɔ UK ne Back to Back Productions USA ayɛ adwuma. Na ɔsan yɛ nsɛm ho amanneɛbɔfo fotufoɔ ma Jerry John Rawlings aban no.

Hon. Baffour yɛ anigyefoɔ  a wonim no sɛ onim aseresɛm. Ɔwɔ atiefoɔ wɔ Afrika Atɔeɛ fam ne akyirikyiri. Bere a wonim no sɛ ɔyɛ n’aseresɛm a ɛfiri awosuo mu no, okura suban a aniberɛ wom nso mu. N’adwuma sohwɛ ho nimdeɛ ne akannifoɔ su ahodoɔ ama wɔapaw no sɛ ɔmmɛyɛ nnwumakuo ahodoɔ mu mpanin ne sodifoɔ wɔ abadwakuo ahodoɔ mu, wɔ ɔman no mu ne amanaman ntam nyinaa.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Baffour ne kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo (National Democratic Congress-NDC )dii dwuma firi berɛ a wɔhyehyɛɛ no ​​afe 1991. Ɔbɛyɛɛ mmarahyɛdwani wɔ Ɔpɛpɔn mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Nkron (2009) mu berɛ a ɔdii nkonim wɔ Ablekuma Anaafoɔ atenaeɛ wɔ Ghana mmarahyɛdwa  abatoɔ a wɔtoo no mfeɛ mpem mmienu ne nwɔtwe no mu. Ɔmampanin John Evans Fiifi Atta Mills paw no sɛ ɔsoafoɔ a ɔhwɛ amanneɛbɔ ho nsɛm so wɔ mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Du-mmienu (2012) mu

title: Joseph K. Nayan
text:
Wɔatwerɛ nsɛm wei ɛwɔ Asante kasa mu

Joseph Kwaku Nayan yɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛni ne Ghana Amanyɔni a ɔyɛɛ mmarahyɛ baguani maa Nkwanta North Constituency wɔ 4th Republic ma Ghana Mmarahyɛ Bagua a ɛtɔ so nnan ne nnum mu.

Mfitiaseɛ asetena ne nwomasua ho nsɛm 
Wɔwoo Joseph wɔ Kotonimmaa 22, 1964. Ɔfiri Damanko kuro bi a ɛwɔ Volta Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔnyaa ne Diploma wɔ Nwomasua mu wɔ Nwomasua Suapɔn mu, Winneba wɔ afe 2006. Ɔtoaa so kɔɔ Cape Coast Suapɔn mu baabi a ɔreyɛ ne master’s degree wɔ Aban ne Akannifoɔ mu.

Adwuma 
Ɔyɛ Nwomasua ho Ɔbenfoɔ. Na ɔyɛ Damanko Junior High School Ɔhwɛfoɔ Panyin ne Ɔkyerɛkyerɛfoɔ Panyin. Na ɔyɛ kane Volta Mantam Soafoɔ Abadiakyiri. Na ɔsane nso yɛ Adwumayɛfoɔ Panyin Abadiakyiri a ɔhwɛ mmoa dwumadie so.

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ɔyɛ New Patriotic Party no muni. Wɔpaw no sɛ ɔnyɛ mmarahyɛ badwani ma ɔbɛgyina Nkwanta North Constituency ananmu wɔ Volta mantam mu wɔ Ghana wɔ January 2005. Ɔsii akan sɛ wɔbɛsan apaw no bio wɔ diberɛ a ɛtɔ so mmienu wɔ Ɔpɛnimaa 2012 abatoɔ no mu na ɔdii nkonim wɔ abatoɔ no mu ma ɔnyaa 9,426 nnipa to maa no a sɛ yɛte firi 21,676 a, ɛdi mu wɔ abatoɔ a ɛwɔ ne Mantam mu.

Ankorankorɛ asetena 
Ɔyɛ ɔwarefoɔ a ɔwɔ mma nsia. Ɔda ne ho adi sɛ ɔyɛ Kristoni.

Beaɛ a menyaa mmoa firiiɛ

title: Francis Y. Osei Sarfo
text:
Francis Yaw Osei Sarfo yɛ Ghana anmyɔni . Ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa a ɛtɔ so nan wɔ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nan no mu. Ɔyɛ kane mmarahyɛbadwani ma Krachi Atɔeɛ abatoɔ mpɛsoa no

Mfitiase Asetena ne Nwomasua 
Wɔwoo Francis wɔ Ahinime da a ɛtɔ ɛdi kan , afe Apem , Ahankron ne Aduonum-num (1955). Ɔfiri Bejamse, kuro bi a ɛwɔ Frao  Mantam mu wɔ Ghana. Ɔnyaa ne BA wɔ Amanyɔsɛm ne Asase Ho Adesua wɔ Ghana Suapɔn , Legon mu, afe Apem, Ahankron ne Aduɔwɔtwe -baako (1981 )mu. Ɔsan nso nyaa ne PLC firi Ghana Mmara Sukuu a ɛwɔ Makɔka no mu.

Adwuma 
Ɔyɛ adwuma sohwɛfo.  Ná ɔyɛ Akpabe Impex Limited adwumakuo no kwankyerɛfoɔ panin. Ɔsan nso bɛyɛɛ  mansini krakye firi Ɛbɔ, afe Apem Ahankron ne Aduɔkron-nsia(1996) kɔsi Ɔpɛpɔn, mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Baako (2001).

Amanyɔsɛm 
Ɔyɛ kyiniiɛ amanyɔkuo National Democratic Congress-NDC no mu ni.Na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani ma dehyeɛ a wɔwɔ Krachi  Abatoɔ mpɛsoa a  ɛwɔ Frao mantam mu wɔ Ghana.

2004 Abatoɔ 
Wɔpaw Sarfo sɛ mmarahyɛbadwani  ma Krachi Atɔeɛ  Abatoɔ Mpɛsoa no wɔ mfeɛ Mpem Mmienu ne Ɛnan (2004) wɔ Ghana amansan abatoɔ no mu. Enti na ɔyɛ mmarahyɛbadwani  ma Krachi atɔeɛ abatoɔ mpɛsoa  no wɔ mmarahyɛbadwa  a ɛtɔ so nnan a ɛwɔ Ghana Adehyeman a ɛtɔ so nnan no mu.

Wɔde mma mpemdu-num, ahansia ne Aduɔwɔtwe-nson(15,687) na ɛpaw no wɔ mma mpem Aduasa-nan, ahankron ne aduonum-mmienu ( 34,952) a wɔtooeɛ no. Na ne mma no gyina hɔ ma mma dodoɔ a ɛbaeɛ no mu ɔha nkyekyem aduanan-nan,  ne akyiri pɔ nkron (44.9% ) yɛ pɛ. Wɔpaw no sen Kofi Tarkum a ɔfiri Convention People's Party-CPP no mu no, Kofi Mensah Demitia a ofiri ɔsono kokroko ammanyɔkuo New Patriotic Party-NPP no mu no,  ne Alhaji Abu Safiano Baba, Owusu Michael Kwasi ne Apraku Kwadwo Sampson. Wɔn  nyinaa yɛ wɔn a wɔde wɔn ho. Yeinom nyinaa nyaa a  wɔtoeɛ no  no  mu ɔha nkyekyem Aduonu-mmeɛnsa, (  23%), ɔha nkyekyem aduonum-nan (25.4%), ɔha nkyekyem num ne akyiri pɔ baako (5.1%,), ɔha nkyekyem hwee ne akyiri pɔ mmeɛnsa (0.3% ) ne ɔha nkyekyem baako ne akyiri pɔ mmeɛnsa (1.3%) pɛpɛɛpɛ.

Wɔpaw Sarfo wɔ National Democratic Congress tekiti so. Na ne mansin no yɛ amansin 21 a National Democratic Congress dii nkonim wɔ Nkran Punpuni mantam no mu wɔ saa abatoɔ no mu no fa. 

Sɛ  yɛreka ne nyinaa abom a, National Democratic Congress no nyaa mmarahyɛbadwa nkondwa aduɔkron-nan (94) wɔ Ghana Adehyeman  a ɛɔ so nan no mmarahyɛbadwa  a ɛtɔ so nan no mu
